talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a small tree on my grass.
Oh, that is nice. Do you want to keep it?
I do not know if it will hurt my lawn.
Trees can spread roots. What kind of grass do you have?
It is just normal green stuff.
Most small trees help grass stay green. Do you like looking at leaves?
Yes, I like the leaves.
Then let it stay. It will be happy there.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do I need a stamp to send this letter?
Yes, you do. Is it for a friend?
I put the paper in the box, but it did not go down.
The box may be full. Do you want to try again?
It still will not go. I am so sad.
Let us look together. What shape is the letter?
It is very big and square.
It might be too thick. Do you want to ask the clerk?
Can you ask for me? Please?
I am here to help, but I cannot go to the window. You are brave enough to do it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. My little sister shared her toy with me today.
That is really sweet of her. Did you share yours with her?
Yes, we played together for a long time.
How long did you play?
We played for an hour. I am so glad she is my sibling.
That sounds like a great hour.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to climb a big mountain.
That is a great goal. Do you have any shoes that grip the ground well?
I have some, but they are very old.
Old shoes are not safe for climbing. Do you like to walk on rocks?
Yes, I love the feel of the rocks.
Good, that helps with balance. You must wear fresh shoes, though.
I will buy new ones right now.
That is smart. Do you know how to tie your laces tight?
I know how, but I always pull them loose.
You can ask a friend to check them for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am stuck on this shape puzzle. How do I put the last piece in?
That looks tricky. Do you have a picture of the full picture?
Yes, I do.
Look for a corner that matches the red line. Can you try sliding it in from the top?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished a book that made me smile all day.
That sounds like a wonderful feeling.
The main character is a small bear who loves to bake cookies.
Is the bear good at his job?
He burns his first batch but keeps trying until it is perfect.
I love a story about not giving up.
It reminds me that it is okay to make mistakes.
Thank you for sharing that thought with me.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My neighbor made too much noise last night. What should I do?
I think you should talk to them nicely. Did they stop?
Yes, they did, but I am still a bit upset.
That is okay to feel that way. Do you like them usually?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired of this. I never get it right.
That is hard, but you are trying hard. Do you like the sound of the words?
I hate the sounds. They are all wrong to me.
Your ears need time. Can you hear the song we played?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need to pack a big book case. How do I do this?
You can wrap the books in paper. Is it a tall case?
Yes, it is very tall. What is the next step?
Take the shelves out one by one. Do you have a friend to help?
My brother is here. How do I move the empty frame?
Lift with your legs, not your back. Do you have a cart?
Yes, I have a dolly. I feel ready now.
That is great. Good luck with the move.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to give my friend for her birthday.
That is a nice thought. Does she like to play outside?
Yes, she loves the park, but I have no idea what to buy.
A new jump rope would be great fun.
That sounds perfect. Thank you for the idea.
You are welcome. Will you bake a cake for her?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make pasta.
That sounds fun. Do you like it with cheese?
Yes, I like mozzarella.
Good choice. Should we start the water?
The pot is hot.
Please put on gloves. Are your hands okay?
They are fine now.
Great. Let’s boil the water. What sauce do you want?
Red sauce.
Okay, we will do that.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat down to drink my morning coffee, but I accidentally spilled it on my new shirt.
Oh no, that is very messy. Did you have to wear something else?
Yes, I had to wear an old t-shirt, but I looked for a long time in my closet.
That sounds like a hard start to the day. Do you know if you can clean the coffee stain?
My mom said I can wash it, but I still feel a bit sad about the mess.
I am sure it will be fine. Would you like to make some tea now to cheer you up?
That is a good idea. I will make tea and drink it slowly while I work.
That sounds like a very nice plan. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look, it is snowing!
Yes, the white flakes are falling. Do you like the cold?
It is very cold but fun.
Snow is soft and quiet. Is it deep on the ground?
Yes, I can hide in it!
Hiding in snow is a great game. Are your hands warm?
I have big warm mittens.
That is good to keep your hands safe. Do you want to make a snowman?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what to eat for breakfast.
That is a hard choice. Do you like warm food or cold food?
I want something sweet and easy to eat.
How about some toast with jam?
Yes, that sounds very good to me.
Great pick. Happy eating.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My teacher is very nice. Do you know her?
I do not know her, but that is good news. Is she kind to the class?
Yes, she helps me with my math. Why do you ask?
I am glad to hear that. Does she read books to you?
She reads every Friday. I like that.
That sounds like a great habit. Do you like the stories?
Yes, I love the dragons. Thanks for asking.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red bus today. It stopped right by the park.
A red bus is very nice. Did you get to ride it?
No, I stayed on the ground. I watched the birds fly by.
Birds are fun to watch. What kind of birds were they?
They were small and brown. They looked like little mice.
That is a sweet sight. Did you feed them any food?
No, I did not have food. I just waved my hand at them.
Waving is a friendly thing. Did they seem happy to see you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
They use tiny tubes in their roots to pull it up. Do you want to know how they do it?
Yes, why do they do that?
The water helps make food for the plant. Do you like food?
Yes, I do. Do they taste the water?
No, they only take what they need. Do you have a plant at home?
I do. Does the sun help them drink?
Yes, the sun helps push the water up. I do not know how the sun does that exactly.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big red apple and some warm bread.
That sounds very tasty. What else is in your basket?
There is a sweet cake and a box of grapes.
A lovely mix of foods. Are you going to eat it now?
Yes, the sun is warm and the grass is soft.
Enjoy your nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Do you like tea or coffee better?
I like tea because it is warm and sweet. Do you drink hot drinks in the morning?
I drink coffee to wake up, but it makes me feel shaky.
Coffee can make you feel too fast. Have you tried adding a little milk to slow it down?
I think milk will make it creamier and softer.
Yes, milk helps a lot. Do you like your tea sweet or plain?
I usually add two spoons of sugar to my tea.
That sounds good for a cold day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I start my new job tomorrow and I feel very scared.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you know how to get to the work place?
Yes, my mom will drive me there. But I do not know what to say to people.
A simple "hello" is good enough. What is your first task?
I have to file papers all day. It sounds boring.
It is good practice for learning. Can you walk to the exit if you need air?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to give Mom a surprise present.
That is very sweet of you. What does she like to do?
She likes to read books by the fire.
That is a lovely hobby. Do you have a book she has not read yet?
Yes, I found a blue one with cats.
Blue cats sound fun. Is the book new or old?
It is brand new from the shop.
Nice choice. Will you wrap it yourself?
I will use the shiny paper.
That will make it pop. Do you have a ribbon?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sitting by the lake. I do not know what to do.
Do you have a rod? Fishing is fun.
Yes, I have a red rod. I dropped my worm in the water.
That is a good start. Do you like small fish?
I want a big fish. But the line is just still.
Big fish take time. Do you like waiting?
I am tired of waiting. Should I leave?
Not yet. Try waiting a bit more.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the best thing to make for dinner?
A simple pasta meal is very tasty. Do you like meat or just vegetables?
I think I will put some chicken in it.
That sounds like a great choice. Do you have any fresh herbs?
I have some basil left in the fridge.
Basil will make it smell nice and fresh.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel sick and my nose is wet. What can I do?
Drink warm soup to help your throat. Do you have a fever?
Yes, I feel very hot. It hurts to breathe.
Rest in a soft bed to help your body fight the cold. Are you able to sleep?
I tried, but I could not stay down. My head hurts a lot.
Go to a doctor if your head hurts very bad. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very tired on this long flight.
Rest is good for your body. What do you usually do on planes?
I just stare at the wall most of the time.
That can feel very lonely. Have you tried looking out the window?
I do look out, but it is always dark or cloudy.
I do not know what the weather is like there. Do you see the lights below?
I see small lights, but I feel sick inside.
Drink some water to help your tummy. Did you eat a real meal before you boarded?
I only had a small cookie at the airport.
A small snack helps a lot. You are doing fine for a long trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad the lights work again after the rain.
That is good news. Do you like bright lights or soft ones?
I love how warm the room feels now.
Warmth is nice. Have you taken your shoes off?
The clock on the wall is ticking happily.
That sounds calming. I do not know why your clock ticked before.
I feel safe and cozy in this home.
Safety is best. Is there anything else that surprised you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad about the letter I am writing. It does not feel right.
That feels hard. Do you want to try again?
I just want to say what is in my heart. But the words get stuck.
You can start with one small thing. What is the first thing you want to share?
I do not know how to make it sound nice. I am getting sad again.
It is okay to be sad. Do you have a paper and pen ready?
Yes, I have the paper here. I feel a little better now.
Good. Take a deep breath and begin.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know if the chicken is sick.
Look at its eyes. Is it sleepy or bright? Do you see wet feathers?
Its eyes look closed and its feathers are wet.
That is not good. A sick bird needs help. Is the barn warm?
Yes, the barn is warm and dry.
Good. Please call the vet now. Do you have their number?
No, I do not have the number.
I do not know the number either. Please ask a grown-up to find it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad inside. I do not know what to do.
I am sorry you feel that way. What made you feel this way?
I do not know why. I just want to feel better.
That is a hard feeling. Do you want to talk more about it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the city so loud today?
The streets are full of cars and people. Do you like listening to music?
Why are there so many big lights?
People keep the lights on so they can see at night. Do you watch movies in the dark?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do bears sleep all winter?
They need to rest to save energy. Do you like watching bears?
Why do lions live in prides?
They work together to find food. I do not know if they are loud.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I put a dark line around my sun?
That dark line helps the sun stand out. Do you like when your picture pops?
Yes, it does. Why is my sky blue?
We paint the sky blue because that is what we see. Do you ever see a pink sky?
Sometimes, on a sunset. Why is the sun yellow?
I do not know why it is exactly yellow. What color do you like best?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the sand, please.
It is right here under your feet.
Do you know where the water is?
I do. The water is just ahead. Do you have time for a swim?
No, I must go fast.
I understand. Please walk carefully near the wet sand.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel so happy today.
Why do you feel that way?
I tried very hard at a game.
That is a good reason. Did you win?
No, but I did not give up.
That is why you feel proud. Do you like that feeling?
Yes, it feels warm and good.
I do not know why it feels warm. But it is true. Do you want to try again?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am worried about my train ride tomorrow.
Do not fear. Is it a long trip?
Yes, it takes many hours. I might feel sick.
Eat light food before you go. Do you have a phone?
I do, but I forgot my charger.
Bring a book to read. Will you sit by the window?
I will try to find a seat by the glass.
That is a good plan. Have a happy day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I got a gold star on my drawing.
That is wonderful! What did you draw?
It was a big blue whale swimming in the sea.
I love whales. Did you add any fun colors?
Yes, I used pink for the bubbles and green for the water.
That sounds like a beautiful picture.
My teacher said it is the best one in the whole class.
Wow! Are you going to put it on the wall?
Yes, I will hang it by my desk so everyone can see it.
I am glad you feel so proud.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a big magnet and a small metal clip. I am not sure what to do with them.
You can try to stick the clip to the magnet to see if they pull together. Does the clip jump to the magnet?
Yes, it jumped! But the magnet is stuck to my fridge now. How do I move it?
You can slide it along the smooth surface to take it off. Do you want to try moving it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can such a heavy metal ship stay on top of the water?
It floats because it pushes water away to make space for its weight. Do you want to build a little boat?
Yes, I want to make a boat from paper that does not sink.
You need to fold the sides up so they trap lots of air. Do you have any paper for this?
I have paper, but how do I make sure it holds the water out?
Make sure the folds are tight so no air can escape. Are your fingers steady enough to fold?
I think so, but what if the water gets inside the boat?
If water gets in, the air leaves and the boat will sink. Do you have a towel ready just in case?
I have a towel, so I think I am ready to try now.
Great, just put it in slowly and see how it bobs. How does it feel to have your own boat?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a very long day at work.
That sounds tiring. Did you get any food?
Not yet. I am very hungry now.
Let us fix that. What do you like to eat?
I think I want a warm bowl of soup.
A good choice. Do you want bread with it?
Yes, please. I want a small one.
Sure. One small bowl of soup and a small piece of bread coming right up.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to play.
That is okay. Do you like big or small numbers?
I have a six and a nine.
You can keep the six. The nine is small.
My friend has a ten.
A ten is high. Do you want to take a risk?
I am not sure if I should bet.
You should only bet if you are sure. Small is safe.
I think I will just keep my cards.
That is a smart choice. Have fun playing.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How should I say please?
You can just say it out loud. Do you like to practice?
I want to be nice at dinner.
Try holding the door for someone.
What if I forget to say thanks?
It is okay to just say it again. Have you tried that?
I will try my best.
That is a lovely plan. Good luck to you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the pig. Where is it?
I think it is in the mud. Do you want to help it get clean?
No, I must go. Tell me, does a cow have horns?
Yes, most cows do. Would you like to see the sheep next?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a paper plane?
You fold the paper in half, then fold the corners down. Do you like flying things?
Yes, I love planes. What is the next step?
Fold the top edges down to the middle line again. Is your paper long or short?
It is a long sheet. What do I do now?
Fold the whole plane in half along the center line. Do you have a thumb to hold it?
Yes, my thumbs are ready. How do I fly it?
Hold it flat and throw it forward with a gentle push. Have you tried this before?
No, this is my first time. Thank you for helping.
You will do a good job. I am happy to help you learn.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to go camping but I do not know where to start.
That is a great plan. Do you like sleeping in a tent or a cabin?
I think a tent is cooler, but I am scared of the dark.
Many people feel that way at first. A bright headlamp can help make the dark feel safe.
That sounds good. What else should I bring with me?
A warm blanket and plenty of water are key. Do you plan to cook your own meals?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are there so many stars in the sky at night?
The sun is so bright that it hides the stars during the day. Do you think it is dark enough to see them now?
I guess so. Why do some stars look like they are blinking?
That happens because of the air in our world. It moves and bends the light a little.
That is interesting. Are all stars like the sun?
Yes, they are all giant balls of hot gas. Do you like to look up at them?
I really do. Are there any stars closer than others?
Yes, some are very near and some are very far away. We cannot see the far ones without help.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy a toy, but I do not know what is good.
Tell me what you like to play with?
I like to read books and build small cars.
Look for a book about cars or a model kit.
That sounds fun. Do you know if they have them here?
I am sure the shop on the corner has both.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which train to take.
Where do you want to go?
I want to go to the coast, but I have two tickets.
That is tricky. What time is your ticket?
One ticket is for noon, the other for night.
I do not know your preference. Do you like the sun or the stars?
I like the quiet of the night ride.
The night train is good for sleep. Do you pack yet?
I have my bag, but I am not sure if I am ready.
You can always breathe deep. Ready is just a word.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad. I cannot find my book.
I am sorry you feel that way. Is it a story book?
Yes, it is about a dog. I have looked everywhere.
That is a tricky one. Did you check the small shelf?
I did, but it is not there. Please help me.
Let us look in the quiet room together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a picture stay on my screen?
You can take a picture of your screen. Do you have a computer?
Yes, I have a computer.
Look for a button that says "Capture." It will save the picture for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today. I want to share this with you.
That is lovely to hear. What made you feel so good?
I ate a big bowl of colorful fruit. It tasted sweet and fresh.
Fruit is a great choice for energy. Did you pick your favorite color?
I chose the red berries and yellow banana. They looked so nice.
That sounds like a tasty mix. Do you like fruit more than candy?
Yes, I do. My tummy feels good and I have power.
Good food helps your body work well. It is nice you care for it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went swimming today and I felt so free!
That sounds like a lot of fun. What did you see under the water?
I saw some tiny fish darting by.
Cool. Did you take any friends with you?
Yes, my best friend went with me.
That sounds great. Do you swim in the pool or the lake?
It was a big pool at the park.
Nice. Are you going back again soon?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Where is my laptop?
I do not know. Did you leave it in the car?
No. I think it is in the kitchen.
That sounds like a good plan. Do you have your coffee ready?
No. I need to find it first.
Can I help you look? I am here to help.
Please. I must go now.
Take your time. I will wait for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am painting a big blue sky.
That sounds fun. What color is your sun?
My sun is yellow and very bright.
Nice choice. Do you like to paint trees too?
Yes, I am making a green tree next.
I bet it will look great.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My dog is stuck in the box. I am late.
Is the box big enough? Tell me what you see.
The top is shut. He is barking.
I do not know how to open it fast. Please say hi when you are safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need a flashlight?
It is for the dark parts of the room. Do you have one?
Why does the bag feel heavy?
The books make it heavy. Do you want help carrying it?
Why is there a gap at the top?
The bag is full, so the zipper is tight. Is that okay for you?
Why do we need extra socks?
For the extra days we are away. I do not know how many you need.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to see the rain falling.
That is a nice sound. Do you like cold days?
The smell after the rain is my favorite part.
That is a true joy. Is the sun coming out?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a fun thing to do. Do you have your shoes on?
Yes, they are on my feet.
Make a loop with one lace and call it a bunny ear.
I made one bunny ear.
Now make a second bunny ear. Did you pull the laces tight?
Yes, I pulled them tight.
Cross the ears and pull them to make a bow. You are doing great.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to build a shed, but I do not know where to start.
That sounds like a fun job. Do you have a flat spot in your yard?
Yes, I do, but I am not sure how to make the walls.
You can use wood for the walls. Do you like the look of wood?
I think I do, but what if it gets wet and rains?
You can paint it to keep the rain out. I am not sure which paint is best for your area.
I will go ask at the store about the paint.
That is a smart step. Have fun with your new building.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very scared of my big test tomorrow.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you want to try studying together?
Yes, I want help. What is the best way to start?
Start with the easy parts to feel good.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My nose is very stuffy today. I coughed so much at school that my chest hurt.
That sounds really hard. Do you feel warm, or do you feel cold?
I feel very warm. I had a soup for lunch, but I was too tired to eat it all.
Soup is good for your throat. Did you drink any water with it?
Yes, I had a big glass of cold water. My mom gave me a hug and told me to rest.
That is a nice thing to do. You must be ready for bed now.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do foxes have warm fur?
Yes, their fur is very thick to keep them warm. Do you like foxes?
I think they are cute. Do they live in big houses?
No, they dig small holes in the ground called dens. Do you have a pet?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look up at the dark sky and feel very lost.
The stars are just lights far away. Do you see any bright ones?
Yes, there is a big one near the moon.
That is likely the planet Jupiter. It shines very well.
I still do not know where to go next.
I do not know your exact place. Do you feel safe there?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel so tired today.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you sleep well last night?
I slept fine, but work was very hard.
That sounds very tiring. Did your boss give you too many tasks?
Yes, there was a lot to do.
That can make you feel low. Do you like your job?
I do like it, but today was just a lot.
It is good that you like the work. Sometimes days are just harder than others.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very stuck and angry. I do not know what I should do next.
Take a deep breath. Do you want to try waiting for a few minutes?
Waiting feels too slow. I want the answer right now.
That is hard to do. Have you tried asking someone else for help?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big rainbow. I do not know what to do next.
That is a lovely sight. Do you like colors?
Yes, I love all the colors. But I feel very sad inside.
Sad feelings can leave you. Do you want to talk about it?
I do not know how to make them stop.
You can just breathe and wait. Is the rain gone now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, a tiny bird is here!
How lovely! Do you know what kind of bird it is?
I do not know, but it is very happy.
That is a good sign. Do you hear it singing?
Yes, it sings a sweet song for me.
Nature is sharing its joy with you. Do you want to watch it fly away?
I want it to stay, but I will let it go.
Letting go is kind.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I take care of a small chick?
Give it warm food and water every day. Do you have a nice, safe box for it to sleep in?
Yes, I have a box with some soft straw.
That sounds perfect. You need to keep the box clean to stop germs.
I do not know how to check if it is sick.
Watch its eyes and feathers closely. Is it eating and moving well?
It is very active and eats a lot.
That is good. Keep doing this and it will grow big.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to sleep every night?
Your body needs rest to fix itself and get strong. Do you like playing outside after a good night of sleep?
Yes, I do feel more happy. Why does a dark room help me sleep better?
Dark rooms make your body make a sleep helper that makes you tired.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I live on a very quiet street. How do I know if it is safe to play outside?
That is a good question. You should look for a place with open sight lines and few cars. Do you see neighbors there often?
Yes, the elderly lady next door waves at me every day. Is that a good sign?
Yes, friendly neighbors are a very safe sign. Do you have a ball to kick around?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How high should I make my new fence?
I think three feet is a good height. Do you have pets that might climb out?
I have a cat and a dog.
For them, you may need to add wire on top. Do they like to jump?
The cat jumps very high.
You should use tight mesh to stop her. Is the fence made of wood?
Yes, it is wooden boards.
Wood works well, but you must paint it to stop rot. Do you know where to buy paint?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park on Monday.
That sounds fun. Did you see any dogs?
Yes, one was very big.
Was it scary or friendly?
It was friendly and I hugged it.
A good day! What day is it now?
It is Tuesday.
A new day, too. Are you happy?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the bread so soft?
The baker adds water to the dough. It makes it light. Do you like sweet bread?
Yes, I do. Why is the sugar sticky?
Sugar turns to a thick liquid when hot. It dries hard but feels wet at first. Does it taste good to you?
It tastes very sweet. Why is the smell so nice?
Baking makes the food send out warm air. It smells like honey and toast. Do you smell honey?
I can smell it now. Why is the crust brown?
Heat changes the color of the outside. I do not know why it is brown, but I know it is hot.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My garden fence is broken and I am very sad.
I am sorry to hear that. How is it broken?
A big tree fell on it during the storm.
That sounds scary. Do you have tools to fix it?
No, I only have a small hammer.
I can help you move the wood. Is the whole fence gone?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can you tell me a story about a dragon?
Sure, once there was a small green dragon. Did you know dragons can fly very high?
Can he eat ice cream?
Yes, he likes chocolate ice cream the best. Do you like ice cream too?
I love it. What is his name?
I do not have a name for him. Would you like to pick one?
Let us call him Sparky.
Sparky is a great name. He feels happy about it.
Does he have any friends?
Yes, he has a best friend who is a dog. Is that a happy ending for you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the bus stop?
It is right over there by the tree. Do you like riding on big buses?
Yes, I do. Can you walk with me?
No, I must stay here to help others. Be safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My carrots are so big now. I am very happy to tell you.
That sounds like a great win. Do you think they will be sweet?
I hope so. I put them in a cool spot.
Cool spots help roots grow well.
Yes, they do. What should I do next?
Keep the soil damp and watch for bugs.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My teacher gave me a low grade.
That is very sad. Can you tell me why you are upset?
She did not read my story. She only looked at the picture.
I am sorry about that. Do you think she will let you try again?
I do not know. I want to fix it, but I am tired.
You can just ask her to look again. Would you like to write a note?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I watched a movie, but I do not know if I liked it.
That is okay. Did you laugh or cry?
I felt sad, but then happy at the end.
Sad then happy feels like a good story. What was the main part about?
It was about a dog finding its way home.
I know dogs love coming home. Do you want to see it again?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I get two magnets to stick together?
Put the north side of one magnet near the south side of the other. Do you have red and blue magnets?
I want them to push away from each other.
Line up the same sides, like north with north. Is that what you see?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I stand on the quiet street and I do not know where to go.
It is a calm place to think. Do you feel lonely here?
I am not lonely, but I am lost in my thoughts.
Try walking to the end of the road. I know that there is a park near there.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing, but my voice sounds funny.
Everyone's voice sounds different at first. Do you like singing with a mirror?
I like looking at myself, but I am shy to sing loud.
Start with a quiet hum. It takes time to feel brave. What song makes you happy?
I like the song from my favorite movie.
That is a great start. Do you know all the words to it?
I know some, but I forget the rest.
Look at the words on paper while you sing. You will get it soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a tree grow strong?
Give it water and let it sit in the sun. Do you have a small pot?
Yes, I do.
Good. Put the seed in the soil and cover it with a little dirt.
How deep should I bury it?
Keep it shallow, just under the surface. I do not know your exact plant type.
It is an oak seed.
Dig about one inch down for an oak. Is the soil dry or wet?
It looks a bit dry.
Water it now so the roots can drink.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my roses died. They looked so weak.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you give them enough water?
Yes, but it just stopped blooming. It makes me feel bad.
Flowers can die for many reasons. Maybe you want to try a new one?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you like that book so much?
It makes me feel safe when I am sad. Do you like sad stories?
I guess I do. Why does it make you feel safe?
The words are warm and soft. Are you feeling okay today?
Yes, I feel fine. Is it a story about animals?
No, it is about a little girl finding her way home.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate bugs. They are everywhere today.
That can be annoying. Do you see many of them?
Yes, there is one on my arm. It bit me.
Ouch. Do you know which bug it was?
I do not know. It just hurts.
Sorry you are in pain. Is the bite red?
It is red and itchy. I want it to stop.
Ice can help the itch. Do you have ice nearby?
I do not have any ice here.
I am sorry I cannot fix it right now. Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I drank a big cup of tea this morning.
That sounds warm and nice. Did you add sugar to it?
No, I liked the bitter taste.
I like sweet tea best. What else happened to you today?
I went for a short walk in the park.
How was the weather out there?
It was sunny and the air felt fresh.
Sunshine makes people feel happy. Did you see any birds?
Yes, I saw many small birds singing.
That is a lovely sound.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make bread. How do I start?
Start by mixing flour, water, and yeast. Do you have a bowl big enough?
The dough feels sticky. Is that bad?
Sticky dough is normal at first. Let it rest for a minute and try again.
It looks good now. What is the last step?
Put it in a hot oven. Do you know how long it takes?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the snow. It is so cold and wet.
I am sorry it feels bad. Do you have warm boots?
Yes, but my toes still hurt.
That is tricky. How long have you been outside?
A long time. I just want to go home.
Going inside sounds nice.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a king. Do I win?
A king is a big card. Are you playing rummy?
No, we are playing war.
Then the king beats a queen. Good luck!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a great idea for Saturday. I want to build a fort.
That sounds like fun. What do you want to use to build it?
I will use big pillows and my blanket.
Nice choice. Will you eat snacks inside?
Yes, I will bring cookies and juice.
Good plan. Where will you put the big pillows?
I will pile them by the couch.
I am glad you are happy. Have a good time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the river blue?
It is blue because the water reflects the sky. Do you like looking at the sky?
Sometimes, yes. Does the water taste like salt?
No, river water is usually sweet. Do you like to drink from it?
No, my mom says I should not. Why does the river move?
It moves because the land is not flat. I do not know why it is so fast there.
That is cool. Is the water cold?
Yes, it can feel very cold. Do you want to step in it?
No, that is too cold for me.
That is a wise choice. Stay dry and safe.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very happy today. Why does that happen?
It is nice that you feel good. Do you know what made you smile?
I do not know for sure. I just woke up feeling warm.
That is a lovely feeling. Would you like to share what is on your mind?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you know where the little pond is?
It is right by the old oak tree. Do you like ducks?
Yes, I love them! They make funny sounds.
That is nice. I do not know if there are fish in it.
I think there are! I saw one jump.
How lucky you are. Do you have a bucket?
Yes, my dad gave me a big one.
That is great for catching them. Are you hungry?
A little bit. I want a snack.
Maybe you can find some berries nearby.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun went down behind the tall trees at four.
That is a very nice start to your evening. Did you see any birds?
I lit a small candle on the table after dinner.
A warm light feels good at night. Do you like the smell of it?
Then I saw a big flash of orange light outside my window.
Oh no, that sounds like a fire. Are you safe inside your house?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am nervous about my work talk. Do I smile?
Yes, a big smile helps you feel calm. Are you ready for the questions?
I think so, but my hands feel cold. What should I do with them?
You can rest your hands on the table. I hope it goes well for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I took a picture but it looks all blurry and bad.
Oh no, that is sad. Did you hold your hands very still when you clicked the button?
I did, but the light is too dim and the camera just will not work right.
That makes sense. Low light can be tricky. Do you have a lamp you could use?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to run fast to catch the bus.
That sounds urgent. Do you have your shoes on?
Yes, but my legs feel very heavy.
Try to take bigger steps. Are you hurting anywhere?
No, just tired. I really need to go now.
You can do this. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did people live in caves a long time ago?
Caves kept them safe from cold winds and hungry animals. Did you know some caves have old paintings?
Yes, I saw a picture of a bison. Why did they paint it?
They painted to tell stories or pray for good hunts. Do you like looking at old pictures?
I do. Why did they stop living in caves later?
They learned to build warm houses with wood and stone. I do not know exactly when everyone moved out.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I can't do the front crawl. My arms get so tired.
That sounds hard. Are you resting your arms between strokes?
Yes, but my legs feel heavy. I just want to quit.
You are working very hard. Do you have dry land nearby to rest?
I am right in the deep water. I feel a bit scared.
It is okay to feel scared. Can you float on your back for a moment?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love the piano, but I am so late for work.
The piano is a lovely choice. Do you play any other songs?
I have to go, but I like your advice.
Have a safe trip. Do you listen to music on the bus?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The bees worked all day to make honey. They put the sweet stuff into tiny holes in their home.
That is a lovely job. Do you know if the bees keep the holes dry?
Yes, they dry it with their wings and heat. Then they seal it with wax to save it for winter.
Nature is very smart. Do you like the smell of the honey?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bike seat is too hard. I do not want to ride.
That sounds like a mean seat. Do you have a soft pillow at home?
Yes, but I forgot it. My legs hurt now.
Rest is good for sore legs. Would you like to walk a bit?
Just a little, please. I am still sad.
Sadness is okay. We can sit by the tree.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lighthouse is so bright and beautiful at night.
That sounds wonderful to see. Do you have a good view of the sea?
Yes, I can see the waves crashing far below.
The sound of the waves must be very calming. Do you bring any snacks for the climb?
I packed some warm soup and cookies.
A warm drink helps keep the cold away. Thank you for sharing that.
The keeper waved hello from the door.
That is a very nice sign of kindness. Is the keeper old or young?
He is quite old but has a strong heart.
He must love his home very much. I hope you have a safe trip home.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I can not sleep well at night. What can I do?
Try drinking warm milk before bed. Do you like warm milk?
I love it. Is there anything else I can do?
Turn off your phone early. Does that help you rest?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I clean the water in my fish tank?
You can use a net to scoop out the old water. How many fish do you have?
I have three small goldfish. What should I do next?
Let the new water sit for a day to remove chemicals.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I went to the doctor today.
That is good news. Are you feeling better now?
Yes, my tummy does not hurt. I did not get a shot either.
I am glad for you. I do not know if that will always happen, but I hope you stay well.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a small red leaf on the path today.
That sounds like a nice find. Did you keep it?
Yes, I put it in my pocket. I also saw a blue bird.
A blue bird is a lucky sign. What was the bird doing?
It was singing a sweet song. I waited for a while.
I love birds that sing. Did you take a picture?
No, I just watched it fly away. My day was full of small joys.
It is good to find happy things. Tell me more when you can.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go camping with my dad next week.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you know what to pack?
I have my sleeping bag and a teddy bear.
Your teddy bear will keep you warm at night. Have you picked a spot in the woods?
No, we have not decided yet.
You can ask your dad to find a place near a stream. I do not know which spot is best, but I hope you enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost on the court. What should I hit?
Try aiming for the back corner. Do you like to run fast?
I am tired. The ball is hard to catch.
Take a deep breath. It gets easier. Are you drinking water?
I want to win this point. I am very anxious.
Stay calm and watch the ball. Do you see it clearly?
I hit it into the net. I do not know what to do now.
Keep your head up. You will get it next time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to wear for the play.
What are you playing?
I am a tree.
Green clothes might work. Do you like green?
I like blue, but I think green is right.
You should listen to your heart. Is the costume yours?
Yes, it is mine.
Then wear the green. You will look nice.
Okay, I will wear the green.
Good luck with your show.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am late. What do I do?
That feels bad. What time is it?
I do not know what to do.
Just go. Are you safe?
I feel so stuck.
Take a deep breath. Can you walk?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am going to a party. I do not know what to do.
That sounds fun. Do you like to dance?
I do not like to dance. I get tired fast.
You can just talk to people. Have you made a friend list?
Yes, I have a long list. I am still nervous.
It is okay to feel scared. Just be kind.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the wood on the fence brown?
It is brown because the sun dried it out. Do you like the color?
I think it looks old. Why did we pick this wood?
We picked it because it is strong and cheap.
Is it hard to fix if it breaks?
It is easy to fix with a hammer and nails. Do you have a hammer?
No, I do not. Why do we need a fence?
It keeps the pets inside and the rabbits out.
That makes sense. Is it safe to climb?
No, please do not climb on it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am lost and I need to find my house.
Tell me the last place you went, so I can help you turn around.
I do not know how to read a map.
Look for a north arrow, and always walk toward the sun in the afternoon.
Please teach me how to use a compass.
I do not know the exact steps, but I am sure you will find a guide nearby.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my dog, but I cannot see him.
Did you check behind the big tree in the yard?
No, I did not look there. I am late for work.
I do not know where he is, but please look there first.
Thank you, I will run there now.
Good luck. Is he wearing his red collar?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I mixed the colors wrong and now my sky looks dirty.
That is a tricky mix. What color did you add last?
I added too much green and it all turned brown.
Brown can still work well. Do you want to try fixing it?
I do not know how to make it blue again.
We can add a tiny bit of white. Will you let me show you?
Yes, please. I feel better now that you are helping.
You have a good eye for details.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my toast brown?
Heat turns the white bread brown. Do you like it crisp?
Why do I like the crisp part?
I do not know, but it is a happy choice for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad. My plan broke.
That is okay. What broke?
The time for the game.
Let us pick a new time. Do you like the evening?
Yes, that works.
Good. We are set.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to buy a red ball. Where is it?
It is over there. Do you have your money?
Yes, I have a coin. Is that enough?
That is not enough. It costs two coins. Do you need help finding a bigger one?
Can I come back with more coins?
Yes, you can. I will be here.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see a small red bird on my roof. What is it eating?
It is likely eating seeds or mealworms. Do you see any bugs in your yard?
Yes, there are many ants near the flower beds.
Birds love ants, but seeds are easier to offer. You can use a shallow dish for water too.
How should I make a simple bird feeder?
Cut the top off an old plastic bottle and tie it to a branch. Would you like a drawing idea?
Yes, please. Also, where is the best spot to hang it?
Hang it in a quiet corner, away from busy roads. Do you have a strong pole nearby?
I do, right next to the fence.
That works well. Just keep the feeder clean with water and soap.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to say sorry for being late.
It is okay. Are you still in a rush?
Yes, I must go now.
Go with care. The words are safe.
Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Did that feel good?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the moon sometimes a ball and sometimes a sliver?
That is because the Earth blocks some of the sunlight. Do you like to look at the night sky?
I do. It is so bright when it is full.
Yes, the full moon looks like a big plate. Does your family have a special name for it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a map of my backyard. I am so happy to show it.
That is very cool. Do you have a big tree on it?
Yes, it is right next to my swing. Look at the grass I drew.
The grass looks very green. Is it real grass?
It is real, I checked. I want to give the map to my friend.
That is a kind thing to do. Will she like it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The bus is here, but I do not know which door to use.
Please use the front door. Do you have a ticket?
I think so, but it is in my pocket.
Check your left pocket. Is the bus full?
Yes, it looks very crowded inside.
Stand by the door and wait. Let us board together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start speaking a new language?
Start by finding one word you love. Do you have a favorite word yet?
I like the word for sun.
That is a great start. Just say it out loud every day.
What if I get it wrong?
It is okay to make mistakes. You learn by doing it.
I am ready to try today.
That is wonderful. What is the first sentence you want to say?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad about the wedding. The rain is messing up everything.
That is very hard. Do you want to talk about it?
Yes, the dress is ruined now.
I am so sorry to hear that. I do not know how to fix it, but I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dog will not stop barking.
Is he scared or just happy?
I do not know.
Try giving him a walk.
That might work.
Tell me if he stops.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the garden need a big fence?
It keeps the birds from eating the seeds. Is your garden near a tree?
Yes, it is right under a big oak. Do the roots hurt the fence?
Roots can push the wood up over time. Do you like plants or flowers best?
I like the bright red flowers. Can we keep the fence?
Yes, we can fix it with new boards. Does the sun hit that spot?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My legs hurt so much. I want to stop.
That sounds hard. Do you want a little water?
I did not run far today. It feels like a loss.
Even one step is good work. Did you walk after?
I felt slow next to the other runners. I hate that.
Your pace is yours alone. How did your feet feel?
I just want to quit this whole thing.
Resting is part of running too. Are you okay to sit for now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad. We have a new baby.
That is very nice. How does the baby look?
It is small and soft. It sleeps a lot.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I hate reading because it is hard.
That is okay. What book do you not like?
The one with the big words.
Try a story with pictures. Do you like stories about animals?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know who built the pyramids right now.
Ancient Egyptians built them for their kings. Do you know who is the king?
No, I have no time for names, just the time.
It was built a long time ago, in ancient times. Did you think they used magic?
Magic? I thought they used trucks.
No trucks then, only people and tools. Is that a fun picture to you?
It sounds hard, but I must go now.
You have a good day and do not be late.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to dust the shelves?
Dust can make your nose tickle. Do you have a pet?
Yes, I do. Why do we mop the floor?
Mops pick up dirt your feet make. Is the floor wet?
No, not yet. Why do we wipe the tables?
Wiping keeps food bugs away. Are you hungry?
A little. Why do we clean at all?
A clean home feels good to sit in.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to catch the 9 o'clock bus, but the road is blocked.
That is bad. Is the bus close?
No, it is not. I will miss my meeting.
Let us walk faster. Are you sure it is late?
Yes, I am late. Please help me get to the stop.
We are almost there. Is your bag light?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My head hurts bad.
Oh no. Did you hit it?
No, I just woke up with pain.
That is odd. Did you sleep on it?
I do not know why it hurts.
I do not know. Are you thirsty?
I drank water and it still hurts.
I am sorry. Please rest your eyes.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I put water in my pot today.
That is nice. Do you want to know how it reaches the leaves?
Yes, please tell me.
Tiny tubes in the stem pull the water up.
Like a straw?
Yes, much like a straw. Is your plant still happy?
Yes, it looks green.
That is great news.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. I need to go now.
Take a deep breath. Are you going to work?
Yes. I am very busy.
Do not worry about it. Is the bus coming?
No. I must run.
Running is good. Good luck.
Thank you. I have to go.
I hope you make it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the big white flakes falling from the sky.
The snow looks so soft and clean. Do you like to build a snowman?
I do love the feel of the cold air on my face.
That feels quite fresh and new. Are your hands warm enough?
I have my big red mittens on my hands.
That is good to keep you safe. Would you like some hot chocolate?
Yes, please, with extra marshmallows.
I will go get that for you now. Enjoy the winter view.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking up and I am confused. Why is the sky blue?
The sun sends light with many colors. The blue part bounces off the air for your eyes to see. Do you see clouds sometimes?
Yes, I see white puffs. I am still not sure what to do with my eyes.
Just keep looking and enjoying the view. It is a free show for everyone.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I caught a big fish today. It was so much fun!
That sounds wonderful. Was the water calm or wavy?
It was calm and clear. I felt very happy holding it.
I am glad you had a good time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a big rainbow in the sky today.
That is so pretty. Do you like the colors?
Yes, I love the red one.
Red is a strong color. Why do you like it?
It looks like fire to me.
That is a cool thought. Is it warm outside?
No, it is rainy here.
Rain makes rainbows. Thank you for telling me.
Can you make a rainbow?
I can not make one. You can try with water and light.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sea so salty?
Rain water washes salt from the rocks into the sea. Do you like salt on your food?
I do. But why does the water move?
The wind pushes the water to make waves. Do you ever go swim?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The waves are so loud and fun today!
That sounds nice. Do you like the sound?
Yes, I love the sand too.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My chair leg is loose. I do not know what to do.
Do you have a small hammer and some wood glue?
I have a hammer. I do not have glue.
You can tap the leg down first. Does it feel tight now?
No. It is still very wobbly.
I do not know how to fix it without glue. Have you tried turning the screw in the corner?
There is no screw there. I am so sad.
Do not be sad. We can find a solution together. Is the wood cracked?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am nervous about riding the train.
Do not worry. The ride is usually smooth and quiet.
What should I keep in my bag?
Bring a book and some water. Do you have them ready?
I am not sure when the train leaves.
I do not know the exact time. Please check the ticket.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I took a very nice picture of a red flower. I feel so happy to show you.
That sounds lovely. What did the flower look like?
It was bright and sunny in the photo. I took the photo on a big hill.
A hill is a great place for photos. Did you see any other things there?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is good manners?
Good manners are how we show we care for others. Do you know how to say please?
Yes, I say please when I want a cookie.
That is a very nice thing to do. Are you polite with your brother too?
Not always, I forget sometimes.
That is okay, we all forget things. Do you know what to say if you hit someone?
I say sorry, I think.
Yes, saying sorry is kind and true.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I find my seat on the train?
Look at the number on the door. Do you know which car number you have?
I do not see a number on the door.
Check your ticket again. Is there a car number on the paper?
Yes, it says car four.
Walk to car four and look for your row. Are you on the left or the right side?
I am on the left side.
Great, just look for your number on the wall. Have a nice ride.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake a cake, but I am very shy. My boss is very kind and helps me a lot.
That is wonderful. Is your boss patient with your mistakes?
Yes, he always smiles and shows me step by step. How do I start?
You need flour, sugar, and eggs. Do you have all those things at home?
I have them, but I am afraid I will make a mess. Can you help me feel brave?
You can do this. Just take one small step at a time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so mad because I forgot to say please.
Oh, that feels bad. Do you think it hurts people?
Yes, I think I made my friend sad.
I am sorry you feel that way.
How do I fix it now?
You can go and apologize. Do you feel ready?
I am scared she will not forgive me.
I do not know for sure.
I will just try my best.
That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The birds were singing all morning.
That sounds happy. Did you hear other sounds?
I saw a white car pass by.
A nice car. Do you like white?
I felt very calm and quiet.
Calm is good.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my apple on the floor today. It rolled far away.
Oh no, that is a bad luck. Did you chase it?
I tried, but my dog chased it first. He ran to the door.
That is funny. Is your dog a good helper?
He likes to eat fast. I gave him the apple instead of me.
A smart move for you. I do not know where the apple went, but you were happy?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great skill. Do you have a pair of laces here?
Yes, I have them right now.
Great. First, cross one lace over the other and pull tight.
I did that. Now what?
Next, make a little loop with one lace. Do you see the hole?
Yes, I see the hole.
Now slide the other lace through that hole. It is almost done.
How do I finish it?
Pull both ends tight to make a knot.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you know where my grandma is?
I am sorry, I do not know. Is she at the park?
No, she is not there. I am very worried.
Take a deep breath. Did you check the kitchen?
I already checked there. She is not home.
Let us look in the garden. Is she good at gardening?
Yes, she loves plants. I must go now.
I will stay here. Call me if you find her.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to count the months of the year. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help you start with January. Do you know what comes after it?
I think it is February, but I am not sure if that is right.
You are right, it is February. Would you like to try the next one?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am confused about why wars happen.
Often people fight over land or power. Do you like old stories?
Yes, I do.
Try reading about how kings ruled. Do you read books?
I read a lot of books.
That is good. You will learn much. Do you enjoy history?
I think it is fun.
Great. Keep asking questions. Do you have a favorite era?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is that horse so big?
It is big because it needs space to run. Do you like big animals?
I do. Why does it have soft hair?
The soft hair keeps it warm in cold weather. Is your bed warm too?
Yes, it is. Why does it eat grass?
Grass gives the horse energy and strength. Do you like eating vegetables?
Not always. Why does it kick its legs?
I am not sure why it kicked just now. Does it look angry?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel really good about my new drawing.
That sounds wonderful! What did you draw?
It is a big red bus.
A red bus is a fun choice! Is it your favorite drawing?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do cameras take pictures?
They catch light and keep it safe for you. Do you like looking at old photos?
Yes, I do. Why does the light stay in the box?
The sensor remembers the shapes and colors.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The wind is so loud and I do not like the rain hitting the glass.
That sounds scary, but it will stop soon. Do you want to hide under a warm blanket?
I am just worried the branches will break and fall on the house.
The tree is strong, so it will hold tight. Are you seeing any lightning flash?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I built a tall tower of blocks, but it fell down.
That sounds hard. Did you try again?
Yes, I built a bigger one this time and it stayed up.
I am happy for you. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late today.
Oops, that happens. Did you still have breakfast?
Yes, I ate toast with jam.
That sounds sweet. What color was your jam?
It was red like strawberries.
Nice. I am not sure what time it is now. Do you know?
It is one o'clock in the afternoon.
Ah, okay. That is a good time for a rest.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad because my little hen lost her chick.
Oh no, that is very hard. Are you eating enough today?
No, I do not feel like eating at all.
I am sorry you feel this way. Please try a small snack.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why do magnets stick?
They have north and south sides. Do you know which is which?
No time to learn that. Will this clip hold?
Yes, the blue side pulls the red one. What is the clip for?
It holds my papers. I am running now.
You will make it. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I must go. Did I promise?
Yes, you did. Where are you going?
To the shop. I forgot the promise.
That is not good. Do you have time?
No time. I need to rush.
Come back soon. Can you keep it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like these shoes. They feel too hard.
I am sorry you do not like them. What size do you wear?
I feel bad because I spent my last coins on them.
That is very true. Do they hurt your feet?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do I win fast?
Grab a knight and jump to the king. Do you want a trick?
No time. Is the queen always best?
She is strong, but not always safe. Did you check your corners?
I must go now. Thanks.
Good luck. Remember to breathe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go to the beach but I do not know what to pack.
Bring some water and a hat. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I love to swim. I also want to build a big sand castle.
A shovel is very useful for that. Do you have one?
I have a small bucket, but no shovel. Can I dig with my hands?
You can, but it is hard work. Let me check.
Is it hard? I am not very strong.
I do not know your strength. Try a small dig first.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am sad to leave my old room.
That feels hard to do. What is the one thing you are packing first?
My favorite blue box.
That is a good choice. Do you need help lifting it?
Yes, please. My arms are too small.
I will help you carry it. Let us go together now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My camera will not focus on the flowers.
That is tricky. Do you usually stand very close to them?
I am close, but they look all blurry. I want them to be clear.
Try moving back a bit. What do the flowers look like when you pull away?
Oh, they look sharp now. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I am glad they are clear.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. That movie made me cry.
I am sorry you feel bad. Do you like sad movies?
No, I do not. I wanted a happy story.
That is tricky. Do you want a funny film next?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My room looks like a mess and I do not know where to start.
Start with the floor. Do you have a broom?
Yes, I have a broom and a dustpan.
Sweep the floor into the dustpan first. Then put things in bins. Do you know what goes in the red bin?
The red bin is for paper.
That is right. Toss the paper there. Next, wipe the desk. What do you use to wipe it?
I use a wet cloth and some soap.
Wipe the desk clean, then let it dry. Good work. Do you feel better about your room now?
Yes, it looks much nicer and I feel happy.
That is great. A clean space helps you think. Take a rest now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the sun hot?
Yes, it is very hot. Are you wearing a hat?
No, but I must go. Does it move?
It looks like it moves, but we really spin. Bye!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to put up a new fence. How do I start?
First, you need to check if you have permission. Do you know who owns the land next door?
I think it is the man in the blue house. How do I dig the holes?
You use a shovel to dig straight down. Make the holes deep and straight.
I am digging now. They are very hard.
Take your time so you do not get hurt. Are your arms getting tired?
Yes, they are. I put the wood in. How do I keep it straight?
You can use a level tool to check it. Do you have a level at home?
I have a book, but no tool. What do I do?
I do not know if a book helps with this. You might need to ask a friend to look at it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my lunch taste better?
Try adding fresh vegetables to your bowl. Do you have a garden?
No, but I like carrots. How should I cut them?
Slice them into small rings so they are easy to eat. Do you like them sweet or crunchy?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The city is so loud and fast today.
It must feel like a big hum. Do you like the noise?
Yes, I love how everything moves so quick.
That sounds like a great adventure.
I saw a hundred new faces on the street.
That is a lot of people. Did you say hello to anyone?
I just watched them smile and hurry on.
Smiles are a good sound.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the king have to stay safe?
The game ends if you catch the king. Do you like protecting it?
Yes, I do. Why can a pawn only move forward?
It keeps the lines clear for bigger pieces. Do you like moving pawns?
That is a good idea. Why does the knight jump over pieces?
It lets you reach places others cannot. Do you enjoy the surprise?
It feels like magic. Why is the rook strong?
It goes straight for a long time. I do not know if you find that fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you have any warm soup today?
Yes, we have tomato soup. Do you like tomatoes?
I do not like tomatoes. What else is warm?
We have a nice chicken stew. Would you like to see the menu?
The stew sounds good. How much does it cost?
It is five dollars. Do you want to add some bread?
Yes, please add some bread. Can I get some water too?
I will get you a glass of water. Do you like sparkling or still water?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My chair leg broke today and I am sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you try to fix it?
I used glue, but the wood is still loose.
Glue may not hold if the wood is dry. Do you have screws at home?
Yes, I have a box of small screws.
Good. You can screw the legs back together.
I will try to tighten them now.
Great. Take your time so you do not hurt yourself.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Do sailors get seasick?
Yes, many do. Do you like the sea?
I must go now. Do they smoke on ships?
Some do, but most ships ban it. Is that all you need?
Just this. Can they swim well?
Yes, they must. Good luck with your rush.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love apples. I must go now.
Apples are sweet. Do you like them red or green?
Red ones. I am running late.
Okay, the red ones taste great. Have a safe trip.
Thanks. Bye.
Bye. I hope you get there fast.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the bus shake?
The road is not smooth. Do you like the view?
Why is it so loud?
The engine works hard. I do not know why it is noisy today.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My tomato plant looks sick.
I am sorry it feels bad. What color are the leaves?
They are yellow and brown. I think I killed it.
That is not true. It may just need more water.
I did water it every day. Why is it still sad?
Too much water can hurt roots. Do you see wet soil?
Yes. It is always wet. I made a mistake.
It is not a bad mistake. Let it dry out.
Will it live? I hope so.
It can live. Give it time and air.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start walking to stay healthy?
Pick a path near your home. Do you have a favorite place to walk?
I do not know where to begin.
Start with just ten minutes. That is enough to help your body.
Should I walk fast or slow?
Go at a speed where you can still talk. How does that feel to you?
What if I get tired quickly?
Rest for a bit and then try again. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to put in my bag.
Let us think. Do you need your lunch box?
I forgot to pack my lunch.
That is good you caught it. What about your shoes?
I have not packed my shoes yet.
Put them in now. Is there anything else?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I lost my fish hook and the line snapped. I do not know what to do.
Do not worry, you can fix it. Do you have a spare line?
No, I do not have any more line. I feel sad and tired.
Let us just sit and watch the water for now. Is the sun warm?
Yes, it feels nice on my face. Should I go home?
Yes, going home is a good choice for today.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The plane feels very small and tight.
That can feel scary. Do you like the view?
It is dark outside and I am tired.
Rest your eyes and breathe slow. Are you hungry?
My legs hurt from sitting so long.
Shake your toes if you can. Do you have a book?
I am so glad we are almost there.
It will be done soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do trees have leaves?
They help the tree make food from the sun. Do you like playing in the grass?
I do! But why are some trees big and some small?
Big trees are older than small ones. I do not know why each one grows a certain way.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I was so happy when I saw the red apples, but now I cannot find my basket.
I am sorry to hear that. Where did you last see it?
I do not know, and I am losing my patience. Did you see a green basket?
I did not see it, but I can help look. Is the basket empty?
No, it has my oranges and my money in it. This is very bad.
Do not panic, as things are usually fine. Let us check near the fish stand.
I am too tired to walk far, so I am quite upset. Can we just sit here?
Sitting may not help us find it. Do you want to look nearby?
Fine, I will try to look. Thank you for being kind.
You are welcome. Let us start looking now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The sky looks so gray. I feel sad.
Sometimes gray days feel heavy. Do you like rain?
No, not really. It is just too dark.
That makes sense. Let us watch for a sun break together.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do some neighbors talk all the time?
They might be lonely and want friends. Do you like talking to people?
Why do we have to be quiet when they are sick?
Loud sounds can hurt their healing. Are you feeling tired today?
Why do some neighbors never wave hello?
I do not know why they stay inside.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my fridge magnet today. It fell off the door.
That is a shame. Do you know where it might have rolled?
Yes, it is under the sofa. I used my other magnet to pull it out.
A clever trick. How did it feel to use the magnet?
It felt like magic. The steel can did not move, but the magnet stuck to it.
Magnets pull on steel very well. Did you find any other lost items?
I found a paperclip. It stuck to the magnet and stayed there for a while.
That makes sense. Do you like how magnets work?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I got a sticker on my paper for good work today.
That is a nice way to feel proud. Did you enjoy the work?
Yes, it was fun. The teacher smiled at me too.
A smile is a good sign. What did you do next?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
It is quiet because people are sleeping. Are you walking to school?
No, I am just looking at the birds.
Birds like the quiet morning air. What do you see up there?
I see a bird on the wire.
It is safe there in the morning. Do you hear the wind?
Yes, I hear the wind in the trees.
The wind is soft today. Is your coat warm enough?
Yes, my coat is warm.
That is good to keep you cozy. I must go now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad my clock is ticking again.
That is great to hear. Do you know why it stopped?
The battery was dead, but now it moves.
Nice work. I am not sure how the battery makes it move.
The gears turn to push the hands.
That is a good way to think about it. Do the hands spin fast?
No, they move very slow and steady.
I agree that a steady clock feels calm.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I did not win the race.
That sounds hard. What made you sad?
I ran my best but lost.
You should be proud of your effort. Did you have fun running?
Yes, but I want to win next time.
That is a good goal to have.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My cat is sleeping on the bed.
That is nice. Does he purr loudly?
Yes, he makes a big rumbling sound.
I think that sounds cozy. Is he a tabby cat?
No, he is black and white.
Like a cow. Do you like to brush his fur?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my dog spin in circles?
It helps them feel safe before resting. Do they spin a lot?
Yes, many times a day. Why do they do that?
It is an old habit to make a comfy spot. Is the spot clean?
It is always clean. Why does it matter?
Clean spots keep them from getting sick. I do not know the exact reason for your dog.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a fridge door shut tight with magnets?
Put strong magnets on the inside of the door and the outside of the fridge. Do you have any magnets at home?
I have some small ones. Are they good enough?
Small ones work, but you need many of them for a big door. How wide is your fridge?
It is about two feet wide. What size magnets should I use?
Use medium round magnets for that size. Do you know how to stick them on?
I plan to use strong glue. Will that hold?
Glue works well, but make sure the surfaces are clean. Do you have a sanding block?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The city is full of people and cars today. I love the noise.
That sounds very loud and busy. Do you see many new friends?
I saw a cat on a hot roof near the park. It looked like a king.
A cat on a roof is a nice sight. Is the sun shining bright there?
Yes, the sun is very warm on my face. I feel good about this day.
Warm sun and happy hearts are great. I am glad you are having fun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am going to a warm beach for my holiday.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like to swim in the sea?
Yes, the water is nice. I want to build a sand castle.
Building castles is a great game. Do you have a big bucket?
I have a small red bucket. My mom says we will eat fish.
Fish is tasty and good for you. Are you excited for the trip?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to build my tower again, but it fell down. I am so mad.
That is very hard to do. Do you want to sit with me first?
I just want it to work. Why is it so hard?
Some things take time to learn. Are you willing to try one more small piece?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big brown bear by the river today. It was eating a fish.
Wow, that is a lucky sight. Was the bear happy?
It looked very calm and slow. I did not move so I could watch it.
That is very smart. Did you see any other animals nearby?
No, just the bear and some birds in the trees. I went home after that.
A good day to be safe. I hope you saw more soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can you help me find the red spot on this map?
Sure, I see the red dot right there in the corner. What is that place to you?
It is where my grandma lives. I want to visit her.
That sounds lovely. Do you know if she likes pets?
Yes, she has a big brown dog named Bear.
A dog is a great friend to visit. Do you have a pet at home?
No, I do not have one yet, but I hope to.
That is a nice thought. I cannot say if you will get one soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the water in the lake cold?
Yes, it is very cold. Do you like swimming in cold water?
No, I do not like it. My toes hurt.
That makes sense. Would you like to sit on the warm grass instead?
Yes, please. I want to watch the ducks.
Good idea. Are there many ducks in the lake?
I see two big ones and one small one.
Nice. Can you tell me why they are swimming there?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I see smoke rising from the house next door.
That looks serious. Do you know who lives there?
No, they are new neighbors.
You are being very watchful. Is everyone okay?
I just hope they are safe tonight.
Please stay out of the way.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I moved to this new town last week.
Welcome! What is your favorite place so far?
I really like the park by the river.
That sounds lovely. Does the water look clean?
Yes, it is very clear and still.
How nice. Do you know who built it?
I do not know. Do you have any idea?
No, I do not know. I will ask the town clerk for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The waves are so big today!
That looks like a lot of fun. Do you like to splash in them?
Yes, I love to jump when the water hits my legs.
I am glad you are so happy out here.
I want to build a big sandcastle before the sun sets.
That sounds like a great plan. Do you have a bucket with you?
