I am glad you are happy. I do not know much about building forts, but I trust you can do it.
I will show you later. The water is clear and sweet too.
Thank you for sharing that. How deep does the water get?
It is only as high as my knees. It is perfect for playing all day long.
That is wonderful news. I am sure you will have a great time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to paint a tree but my leaves look sad.
Try using three kinds of green. Do you have dark green paint?
I only have light green and blue right now.
You can mix those to make a new color. What color do you want the sky to be?
I want the sky to be happy and bright.
Yellow is a warm color that feels happy. Are you mixing them in a cup or on a plate?
I am using a small white plate.
That is a good way to see the colors. Do you have water ready?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we blow out the candles?
It is a wish to make your wish come true. Do you have a big wish?
Why do we get gifts?
Gifts show we care about you. Is your favorite part the gift or the cake?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do we say please when we ask for help?
It shows you are kind. Do you like when people are nice to you?
Yes, I do. What else is good manners?
Saying thank you is very important. Do you remember to say it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: This leg is loose and I am so mad.
I am sorry it is broken. Is the screw still in the hole?
Yes, but it just spins and spins.
That is a common problem. Do you have a wood glue?
No, I did not think to bring any.
I do not know a quick fix without it. Can you sit on it for now?
It feels safe, I think, so I will.
Good. Let us go get some glue later.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like winter the best.
That is nice. Do you like snow?
Yes, I love cold days.
Winter is very cold. Is it dark outside?
It gets dark fast.
Yes, the days are short. Do you like long summer days?
Summer is hot and long.
That sounds fun. Do you swim?
I like to swim in summer.
That is a good way to cool off. Do you have a favorite season now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at this new phone! It is so fast.
That is a nice phone. What color is it?
It is blue. I love the screen.
Blue is a happy color.
Do you want to see a game on it?
Yes, I would like to see.
This game is very fun.
It looks fun. I do not know how to play it.
I will show you. It is easy.
Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a riddle on my walk today.
That sounds fun. What did it say?
It asked what has keys but no locks.
Oh, I know that one. Is it a piano?
Yes, that is the answer. I am glad I got it right.
Well done. Do you want to try another?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The bus was very slow today.
That sounds tiring. Did you walk the rest of the way?
Yes, I walked past many shops.
Walking is good for you. I love how the city smells like fresh bread at that hour.
I smelled bread too, but I was too busy.
You must be hungry now. Do you have time for a snack?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is so hot outside. I do not know what to do.
Would you like to eat a cold ice cream?
Maybe. But I do not want to go to the store.
I do not know a way to cool your house. Do you have a fan?
Yes, but it is not working.
Try sitting in the shade. Do you have a big tree?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to play a hand of cards, but I am late for work.
We can go fast. Do you want to play rummy or go fish?
Just pick a game. I have no time to choose.
Let us play go fish. It is quick and fun.
I grab a card from your hand. What do you have?
I have two pairs left. Would you like to skip the last round?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very lost and sad. I cannot find my house.
Take a deep breath. Do you see any familiar shops?
I just see buildings. I am scared.
I am sorry. You are safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to finish this cat drawing fast. My bus leaves soon.
Take a deep breath. Do you have a pencil?
Yes, but the tail is too wiggly. I am confused.
Try making it short. Do you like short tails?
That works. Now the face looks bad.
Add two dots for eyes. Do you want it to look happy?
Yes, a smile helps. Thank you for the help.
You did a great job. Drive safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I keep my bag safe on the bus?
Put it on your lap. Do you have a big bag?
Yes, it is big. Where should I sit?
Sit near the door. Is the bus very full?
It is almost full. How do I get off safely?
Wait for the stop and step out. Do you know where to go?
I am going home. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have a good ride.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I looked at an old map in school today.
That sounds interesting. Did you find a specific place?
Yes, I found where my great-grandfather lived a long time ago.
That is a wonderful find.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do these red boots cost five dollars?
Yes, they are five dollars. Do you like the red color?
My feet are very cold and wet today.
I am sorry your feet are wet. I do not know where your dry socks are.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The ground is white. Is that snow?
Yes, it is snow. Are you wearing boots?
No, I have to run to the bus.
The snow is cold on your feet. Do you have a scarf?
I forgot it at home. I am late.
I am sorry you are cold. Can I help you find your keys?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the fruits look so red?
They are ripe and ready to eat. Do you like sweet food?
Why is the noise so loud there?
Many people are talking and buying things. Is your head hurting?
Why do the prices go up?
I do not know why they change today. Do you bring enough coins?
Why do the flowers smell nice?
They grow in the sun and rain. Do you want a small one?
Why do people smile at each other?
They are happy to see friends there.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need bread now. It is late.
Mix flour, water, and yeast. Did you check the yeast date?
No time to check. Should I wait for it to get big?
Yes, wait until it doubles. Where are you baking it?
In the hot oven. I am running out of time.
Put it in now. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad today and I do not know why.
That feels bad. I am here with you. What made you feel this way?
I lost my favorite toy and it feels broken.
I am sorry about your toy. Do you want to talk about it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure if I should eat before my aunt.
Usually, you should let elders eat first.
But I have been waiting for a long time.
That is very hard. Are you very hungry?
Yes, my tummy is rumbling loud.
If she is still setting the table, it is okay to start.
Does that mean I am being rude?
Not if you smile and say please.
I think I will wait a little longer.
That is a very sweet choice.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad inside today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk about it?
I lost my favorite red ball.
That is a big thing to lose. It makes sense to feel blue.
Will the ball come back to me?
I do not know where it is. Have you looked under the couch?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a tall white tower by the sea. What is that?
That is a lighthouse. It helps ships see where to go. Do you like looking at the sea?
Yes, I do. How does the light inside work?
I do not know the exact parts inside. But the light shines out to keep boats safe. Is it dark out there now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do some clouds look like dogs?
That is a fun shape. Do you have a favorite cloud shape?
I think they are made of water. Is that right?
Yes, they are made of tiny water drops. Do you like looking up at the sky?
I want to know if they fall down.
I do not know for sure, but rain comes from them. Do you like rain?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is that menu so thick?
It lists many dishes for you to pick. Do you like spicy food?
Yes, I do. Why are the chairs red?
The chef chose that bright color. Do you want to sit there?
I think I will. Why does it smell so good?
The kitchen is making fresh bread. Would you like a slice?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That sounds great. What makes you feel this way?
I got a new puppy.
How nice. Does he have a name?
His name is Bear.
Bear is a strong name. I am glad you are happy.
Thank you for listening.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I had a scary dream about big teeth. I must go now.
That sounds like a nightmare. Did you wake up sweaty?
Yes, but my bus is coming.
Take a deep breath to calm down. Was the monster in the dream?
I don't know. I was too scared to look.
It is just a dream, so you are safe. Do you like the sun now?
I have to run. Thank you.
Go in peace.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I just cannot sing well and I feel bad.
It is hard to start, but you can try. What song do you want to learn?
I think my voice sounds too loud and shaky.
That is normal when you are new. Does that make you want to stop?
Yes, I want to quit right now.
You can rest your voice for a bit. Do you feel better now?
I will try one more time, I guess.
That is a great step. Good luck with your practice.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am so nervous about my big day. How can I stop feeling scared?
Take a deep breath and trust your partner. Do you know who is standing next to you?
My best friend is by my side. What should I say when I look in their eyes?
Just tell them the simple truth. Are you ready to say "I do"?
Yes, I am ready. What if I forget the words?
Do not worry, they will understand your love. Can you promise to smile?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat on the bus today. It was very loud.
That sounds busy. Did you have a good seat?
Yes, I had a window seat. I saw a big cat outside.
A cat on the street? That is interesting. Did you wave to it?
I tried to wave, but the bus was moving too fast.
Oh, that is tricky. It is nice you had a calm trip.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my tennis match. Do you know if I can still play?
I do not know your rules. Do you play singles or doubles?
Just singles. My friend is waiting on the court.
You should run now. Is the court near the big tree?
Yes, it is. I have to go.
Have a fun game. Good luck today.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I made a new friend but I do not know what to play.
That is nice. Do you like running or quiet games?
I like running but he is not fast.
That is okay. We can just walk together.
I am still not sure if he will feel left out.
I do not know his feelings, but you can ask him. What does he like?
He likes drawing pictures.
Then let us draw. I bet that will be fun.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked past the bakery this morning.
That smells good. What did you see?
A big cat was sleeping on the door.
That is a lucky cat. Did it wake up?
No, it just purred at me.
How sweet. Did you buy anything?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a raft on the river.
That sounds like big work. Do you have any long branches?
Yes, I have a lot of sticks.
Good. You need to tie them with strong rope.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do I make my tomato plant grow big?
You need warm sun and good water. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
Yes, but the leaves look yellow.
That usually means it needs a little food. Did you give it some?
No, not yet. What kind of food?
I do not know what you use, but many people use a small amount of compost. What color is your soil?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with my script.
That sounds hard. Do you want to read a bit of it?
I can, but the words feel all mixed up.
Let us just take a slow breath.
Okay, I will try that.
Good job. Is there one line you really like?
I like the part where the bear sings.
That is a nice start. Do you want to try saying it loud?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My chair leg is wobbly. What should I do?
I can help you start. Is the loose part a screw or a nail?
It is a big screw. I tried to tighten it, but it spins.
That means the wood is worn out. Do you have any glue?
Yes, I have some glue and tape. How do I fix it?
Mix a little sawdust with the glue. It sounds like a good trick, but I am not an expert.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have so many boxes. I do not know where to put them.
Do you have a list of things to pack?
No, I just have a big list of everything I own.
That is very long. Try packing only what you use every day first.
That sounds hard. I am tired.
You can rest for a bit. Is your truck ready to go?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I need to pack my bag for the trip.
Let us sort your clothes first. Do you like to bring toys?
Yes, I want my little car.
That is a good pick. Do you have your warm coat?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to start collecting shiny rocks. Do I need a big box?
A small box is fine to start. How many rocks do you have so far?
I have just five right now.
Five is a great number. Do you like blue rocks the most?
I think I do. Is it hard to find clean ones?
It takes time, but it is not hard. Do you look for them near water?
Yes, I look by the river.
That is a good place. Have you found any really bright ones yet?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a yummy cake, but I do not know which one to pick.
The chocolate one looks sweet. Do you like chocolate?
Yes, I love it. It is my favorite thing to eat.
Then that is a good choice. Is your wallet big enough?
No, it is not. I only have one coin in it.
That is too little for a whole cake. Would a small cookie work?
Yes, please. I will take the small cookie.
That is a smart plan. Enjoy your treat.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did my old friend move so far away?
I do not know for sure, but perhaps he needed a change. Did you say goodbye to him?
Why do you think he wanted a change?
Maybe he felt lonely and wanted fresh air. Was he often sad?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What shape has three corners?
A triangle has three corners. Do you like triangles?
I do not like them. What shape is round?
A circle is round and has no corners. Do you have a circle toy?
Yes, I have a ball. Is a square flat?
Yes, a square is flat and has four equal sides. Do you want to draw one?
I like squares. Can a cube be flat?
No, a cube is not flat, it is three-dimensional. Do you want to learn about cubes?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my dog, Biscuit, lost his bone.
That is very upsetting. Did you look in the yard?
I looked everywhere. He hid it in the big tree.
Trees are tricky spots. Did he dig it out?
No. He just sits there. I want to help him.
You are a kind helper. Can he bark to get help?
He barked all day. The bone is gone.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you know where he went?
He went to sleep in the shed. I feel alone.
You will play with him soon. Do you miss his tail?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are we waiting?
We wait so we are ready. Is the day busy for you?
I want to know what comes next.
The next thing brings new joy. Do you like surprises?
Do you know when we start?
I do not know the exact time. Are you feeling tired?
I just want to be done waiting.
Patience helps us stay calm. Can you take a deep breath?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because my little brother gave me a drawing.
That is very sweet. Is it a picture of you?
Yes, it is me holding his hand, and he made a funny face.
How cute that was. Do you know why he drew that?
I think he just wanted to show me he loves me, and I love him too.
I love that for you.
I am going to hang it on my wall right now.
What a nice way to end the day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My fish is swimming very fast. Is he angry?
He is probably just happy to play. Does he eat his food well?
Yes, he eats all the food in the bowl.
That is a good sign for health. Do you change the water every week?
I only change half the water once a month.
That may make him sick. Please clean the tank more often.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: It is so hot outside. I want to make ice water to cool down.
That is a great idea. Do you have a freezer?
Yes, I do. How do I keep it from getting wet?
You can put the ice in a bag first. Do you have any bags?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have this magnet and it feels weird.
Magnets pull on certain metals like iron. Do you like how it sticks?
It is stuck to my key ring now.
That is good because keys are usually metal. Are you trying to keep it safe?
I do not know if I should keep it or throw it away.
I would keep it if it still works. Does it pull a paper clip?
I do not have a paper clip nearby.
You can test it with a small nail or a coin. Is it holding tight?
It is holding tight and I feel happy now.
That is great news for you. Do you want to try lifting a spoon?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to help my friend but he is still sad. I feel bad.
That is a kind thing to do. Do you know why he is sad?
He lost his favorite toy. I do not know what to do.
You can sit with him. Would you like to bring him a snack?
Yes, I have some cookies. Thanks for helping me think.
You are a good friend. I am sure he will feel better.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking up and I do not know why the sky is blue.
The light mixes with the air to make blue. Do you like the color blue?
I think I do, but I am still unsure of the rest.
It is a big topic to learn fully. Try asking your teacher tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to help my friend but I do not know how.
That is a nice wish. What does your friend like to do for fun?
They like to ride their bike fast.
You could ride with them. Do you have a bike too?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I forgot what day it is.
It is okay. Do you like weekends?
I want it to be Friday.
We will see soon. What day was yesterday?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I promised my friend I would play with him today, but I do not want to.
That feels hard. Why do you not want to play?
I am tired, but I know I need to keep my promise.
Keeping a promise is good work. Do you have time to rest first?
Yes, I can rest for a bit, then play.
That sounds like a wise plan. How long will you rest?
Maybe twenty minutes.
Twenty minutes is a good goal. Let me know if you need help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to run, but I do not know where to start.
Let us take it slow. Do you have any shoes to run in?
I have old sneakers, but they feel heavy.
That is a good start. What time of day do you like to go out?
I think morning is best, but it is very cold.
Layer up with a warm coat. Do you have a buddy to run with?
No, I usually walk alone and feel shy.
That is okay, but running with someone can help. Do you have a short goal in mind?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat on my bed all day. The clock ticked loud and I felt very small.
That sounds like a heavy, quiet day. Do you have a window to look out?
Yes, I saw a dog run by. It barked at the wind and looked so free.
It is nice to see something alive moving. What color was the dog?
It was brown with a white tail. It ran away fast.
I do not know why it ran, but I hope you saw its happiness.
I felt even more alone after it left. My room feels too big now.
I am here with you in this talk. Do you want to tell me what you see next?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late and dropped my toast on the floor.
That sounds like a rough start. Did you get a new piece?
Yes, but then I lost my key to the house.
How did you get back in?
A neighbor helped me, which was nice, but I feel so anxious now.
Worry can feel heavy sometimes. What helps you feel calm?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: There was a big fire down the street at five. I watched it from my window. It was very bright and hot.
That sounds scary to watch from close by. Did the fire trucks come quickly to put it out?
Yes, three trucks arrived in ten minutes. The smoke cleared fast. I am glad no one was hurt.
That is a very good thing to hear.
Now I am just sitting here with a warm cup of tea. The air outside is getting cold. I feel safe in my room.
Tea sounds like a perfect way to relax. Do you like drinking it hot?
I love it when it is hot on a cold night. It helps me calm down. Thank you for listening to my story.
You are very welcome. I hope you have a peaceful rest tonight.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do for my birthday.
That can feel hard. Do you like food or games?
I like both, but I am still lost.
Maybe you can do a party at home. Do you want to keep it small?
A small party sounds nice and calm.
That is a good choice. Will you call your friend?
Yes, I will call them now.
Good luck. I hope you have a fun day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn about the sea. What should I know first?
The sea is very big and has a lot of water. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I love swimming. Why is the water salty?
Rivers bring salt from the land to the sea. Do you ever taste the water?
No, I do not drink it. It tastes bad.
You are right. Please do not drink seawater. Do you live near the beach?
Yes, I live near the beach. What lives there?
Many animals live there, like fish and crabs. Do you see shells on the sand?
Yes, I find them often. What are they made of?
They are made from the bones of sea animals.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The snow is falling hard and I do not know what to do.
Why not build a snowman? Do you have any carrot?
I do not have a carrot, but I have a stick.
A stick is fine for arms. Are you cold?
Yes, I am very cold.
You should go inside now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I failed the test again.
That feels bad. Did you feel scared when the car moved?
Yes, I froze. Now I do not want to try again.
It is okay to rest for a bit. What part was the hardest?
The parking. My hands shook and I hit the cone.
Shaking is common when you are nervous. You can practice just the parking to feel calm.
But I am wasting money. Why is this so hard for me?
Your brain is working very hard to learn. It is not your fault.
Maybe I should quit driving forever.
That is a big choice to make. Do you still want to go to other towns by yourself?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sun so bright?
It shines very hard to warm us up. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I do. Is it a big ball of fire?
It is a huge ball of hot gas, not fire. Do you look at it directly?
No, my mom says that is bad for my eyes.
That is very true and wise.
Does it ever get tired?
No, it burns for a very long time. Do you know how long?
How long does the sun burn?
It shines for about ten billion years.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to look far ahead?
It gives you more time to stop safely. Do you know how to check your mirrors?
Yes, I do check them. But why is the steering wheel so tricky to hold?
It takes practice to make smooth turns.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we bring food to the park?
We bring food to eat. Do you like sandwiches?
Yes. Why does the grass feel soft?
The blades are thin and bend. Have you sat down yet?
I have. Why is the sky blue?
I do not know the full reason. Do you see any clouds?
Yes, one. Why do ants walk in a line?
They follow a smell to find food.
That is cool. Why are we laughing?
We are happy and it is a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does a big ship float on the water?
It pushes water out of its way, and the water pushes it back up. Do you like boats?
Yes, I do. But why does the pushing back work?
The water pushes up just enough to hold the ship. Do you like to swim?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Please tell me how to be nice fast.
Say please and thank you. Do you like saying please?
Yes, but I forgot to hold the door.
That is a good idea for next time. Can you hold the door?
I am running. I need to sit in line.
Wait in line with care. Do you know how to wait?
I think so. Is it rude to cut?
Yes, it is very rude. I do not know what else to tell you.
Okay. I will be kind.
That is true and good. Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Do you see my boat?
Yes, it is by the water. Is it red?
It is blue. I need to go now.
I do not see a blue boat. Do you have a map?
No, I do not have a map. Help me.
Please wait. I will look around now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a sock under the sofa today.
That is a common hiding spot. Do you like that color?
I also spilled milk on the rug.
Oh no, that sounds messy. Did you get it all out?
I used soap and warm water.
That is a good way to clean it. Is the rug dry now?
It is almost dry, but I am tired.
You did a lot of work today. Have you taken a rest?
I need to wash the dishes next.
I cannot help with that, but you can do it. Do you want to listen to music?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how the ship stays up.
The water pushes back up. Do you feel that?
The boat seems too heavy to float.
It is light inside. Can you see the hollow part?
I still do not get it.
It is hard for me to say more. Is that clear?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I cannot tell time.
Take a deep breath. What is on your clock right now?
The short hand is here and the long one is there.
That looks like five o'clock. Did you check the numbers?
No, I just guessed.
Guessing is fun, but checking is true. Do you see the twelve?
Yes, the big number at the top.
Good eyes. Now look at the hands. Which one is smaller?
The one pointing to the five.
Yes, that is the hour hand. You did it!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I wish I could fly like a bird in the wind.
That is a fun dream. Do you have a kite?
No, I do not own one.
Building a kite is a great start.
Tell me how to make one.
You need paper and a cross of sticks. Is the paper light?
Yes, it is very thin.
Tie the sticks together and attach the paper.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so alone. Nobody wants to talk to me.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a pet or a plant?
No, just my phone and books. It is quiet here.
That can be hard. Reading can be a good friend, though.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so lost when I look at the pedals.
It is okay to feel that way. Are you holding the wheel tight?
Yes, but I keep forgetting to look in the mirrors.
That is a good question to ask. Do you have a helper with you?
My cousin sits in the seat next to me.
That is great for support. He will keep you calm.
Should I press the gas or the brake first?
Always press the brake first. It is safer.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy because I just washed my own clothes.
That is great news. Do they smell like the nice soap?
Yes, they smell very good and feel soft.
You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to sleep fast, please help.
Take a deep breath. Do you eat sugar at night?
I am too busy to think.
Try counting to ten. Is your room dark?
Just tell me what to do now.
Put the phone away. Do you have a cozy blanket?
This is not working.
I do not know your exact problem. Is it loud outside?
I must go, thank you.
You are welcome. Do you feel calm now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am sad because I forgot my friend's birthday.
That is a kind thought. Do you know when their birthday is?
I think it was last week. How can I fix this?
I do not know your friend, so I cannot be sure. A small gift might help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no time to say please, I am late.
Please is short. Do you want to be rude?
I do not want to be rude, but I am fast.
A small please is easy. Is your bag heavy?
It is full of books and I am tired.
Tired is okay. Do you know the words?
I know them, but I forgot the habit.
Practice makes it fast.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Which fruit do you love?
I like apples. They are red and sweet. Do you have time to eat one?
No, I have to run. Apples are nice but I need speed.
You are right to be careful. Do you like the green ones?
I do not care about color. Please let me pass.
I am sorry to hold you. Go with a safe step.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake a cake for my birthday, but I do not know how to mix the batter.
You just stir the wet and dry things together until they look smooth. Do you have a big bowl?
Yes, I have a big bowl, but how do I know when it is done?
It is done when the mixture flows like thick honey and has no lumps.
That sounds hard, can you help me measure the sugar?
Sure, I can help you scoop out the right amount. How much sugar did the recipe say?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have black pants but they look gray now. What should I do?
Put them in the wash with cool water. Do you use special soap?
Yes, I use the blue bottle.
That is good for dark colors. Add a spoon of salt to the water.
Why do I add salt?
Salt helps keep the dark color deep. Do you dry them in the sun?
No, I use the machine.
Run a short warm spin. Then hang them outside to air dry.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My pen smudged the paper and now it looks bad.
That is very frustrating. Do you want to try a new sheet of paper?
Yes, please. But what if the new one gets wet too?
Let us wipe the table first. Are you feeling better now?
I feel a bit calmer. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. You can do this well.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I can sing the happy song now. It feels so good in my chest.
That is wonderful news. Do you like the song well?
Yes, I love it very much. I want to sing it for my family tonight.
They will be so happy to hear you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My house is too quiet. I feel sad.
That is hard. Do you miss your friends?
Yes, I do. The computer hums too loud.
Sound can be annoying. Is the fan on?
I cannot think with all this noise.
Maybe a break will help. Would a walk feel good?
I will try that. I feel better now.
I am glad. Please stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am at a new restaurant. I do not know what to pick.
That is a fun choice. Do you like meat or fish?
I like both, but I am not sure. The list is so long.
You can try the soup first. Is it cold or hot outside?
It is hot outside. I want something cold.
A cold salad is a good idea. Do you like tomatoes?
I do. I will get that.
Great choice. I hope you enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It looks very gray outside. Do I need a coat?
Yes, it looks cold. Do you have a warm scarf?
I do, but it is wet. Should I go out?
Wait for the rain to stop. How do you feel about getting wet?
I hate getting wet. What should I do?
Stay in and drink warm tea.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I won the game today. I felt so happy.
That is great news. Did you win by checkmate?
Yes, I moved my queen to check. It was fast.
Nice play. What color did you play with?
I used white. It feels powerful.
Good for you. Do you play often?
I play every day at school. I love it.
That is good for your brain.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke the cup. How do I make it whole?
Sorry, I do not know how to fix glass. Did you get hurt?
No, I am fine. How do I clean the floor?
Use a dry towel to wipe it up. Is it all clean now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see leaves falling off the trees. Is it winter?
No, that is autumn. Do you like the orange colors?
I do, but what comes after autumn?
Winter comes next. The ground will get cold and white.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go fishing today. What should I bring?
Bring your rod, some bait, and a bucket. Do you like fish?
Yes, I love them. Where is the best spot?
The big lake is a great place to try.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look at the river, but I do not know what to do.
That is a nice view. Do you like the sound of the water?
It is loud, but I still feel stuck.
I do not know the best thing for you. Do you want to sit or walk?
I think I will just sit and watch it flow.
That sounds like a good rest.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was very bright today. I wore my big hat.
That is a smart choice to stay cool. Did you go outside?
Yes, I saw a butterfly. It had orange wings.
Orange is a warm color like the sun. Was the wind blowing?
A little bit. It made my flowers move.
Nature is quiet and calm. I do not know the name of your flowers.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a box with wires inside. Is it a robot?
Maybe. Do you see any lights or moving parts?
No, it is just quiet metal and black wires.
That sounds like a mystery. What color are the wires?
They are red, blue, and yellow. I do not know what to do.
That is a hard puzzle. Have you asked an adult for help?
Not yet. I am afraid it might hurt me.
That is smart to be careful. You should show it to a grown-up.
Okay, I will go ask my dad now. Thank you.
You are welcome. Tell me if you learn more.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do these magnets stick together?
They have two ends, and opposite ends pull each other close. Do you see which ends touch?
What happens if I turn one around?
Then the same ends push away from each other. It feels like they do not like each other.
Can I cut a magnet in half?
Yes, but you will get two new magnets with their own ends. I do not know if you should try that at home.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got off my train trip. It was so much fun.
That is great to hear. Did you enjoy the ride?
Yes, I watched the fields go by. They looked like a painting.
That sounds very peaceful.
I also talked to a nice person next to me. We shared some sweets.
How lovely. What kind of sweets did you share?
They were chocolate cookies. They were very good.
I am glad you had a happy time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a horse. I do not know what to do.
That is a big task. Is it safe?
It is calm. Where should I take it?
I do not know. Please call a vet.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I spilt my hot tea all over my new book. I am so mad.
Oh no, that is bad. Do you still have a warm drink?
No, I have none left. Coffee tastes too bitter for me.
I agree, coffee can be very sharp. Do you like sweet tea?
Yes, but I lost my only cup. This day is bad.
I am sorry to hear that. I do not know your secret recipe.
Please, make me something warm. I feel very cold.
I cannot touch anything, but I can wait for you. Will you call for help?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people wear white at a wedding?
Many people wear white because it shows that they are starting a new life. Do you like white dresses?
Why do people kiss each other at the end?
The kiss shows that they promise to love each other for a long time. I do not know if everyone does this.
Why is it a happy day?
It is happy because two friends join as one family. Do you think your house would be too loud for a wedding?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have so many days?
There are seven days to keep track of time. Do you like the weekend?
Yes, but why are there exactly seven?
I do not know the full story, but it is an old custom. Do you like sunny days?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost and I feel very scared. Where am I?
Take a deep breath and do not panic. What do you see near you?
There is a big red tower and a park. I need to go home now.
That sounds like the city center. Please walk slowly toward the main street.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big fish jump out of the lake today.
That is a fun story. Did it make a loud splash?
Yes, it was very loud.
I am glad you saw it. Do you like watching water?
I do. The water looked cold and blue.
Blue water is nice. Thank you for sharing that with me.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. None of these shoes fit right.
I am sorry you feel bad. Are they too tight?
Yes, they hurt my toes. I do not like it.
That is a real problem. Do you want socks on?
I just want a pair that fits. I am tired of trying.
Let us check the back of the shoe. Does the heel slip?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: H, why is the snow so white?
It looks white because the ice pieces bounce light around. Do you like to make snowmen?
Yes, I love making snowballs!
That sounds like lots of fun. Does it hurt your hands when you squeeze?
A little, but I wear my mittens.
Smart choice to keep them warm.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you like apples?
They are sweet and crunchy. Do you like them too?
I do. Why are they red?
The sun makes them change color. Do you watch the sun rise?
Yes, I do. Do you eat them raw?
Yes, I do. It is very healthy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a giant crab today on the wet sand.
That sounds like a big find. Did it look angry?
Yes, it snapped its claws at my shoe, and I ran away fast.
You were very smart to keep safe. What did the other people do?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to start a garden, but my plants die.
Do you water them too much?
I think so, but how do I tell?
Touch the soil near the root. If it is wet, wait. Is the pot sunny?
Yes, it sits by the window all day.
That light is good for leaves.
What else should I do?
I do not know your exact plant. Do they have big or small leaves?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the library today and found a big red book.
That sounds fun. Did you read it inside?
Yes, I sat by the window and read about a dog.
I like dogs. Was the story happy?
It was, but then I had to leave because it was closing time.
That is true. Do you want to go again?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I climb a big mountain safely?
Bring strong boots and plenty of water. Do you know how to check the weather?
No, I do not. How can I see if it will rain?
Look for dark clouds or feel the wind change. Is it windy where you live?
It is very windy today. Should I still go up the hill?
If the wind is strong, wait for a calmer day. I do not know the exact time it will stop.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make toast but I do not know how to start.
That is a great choice. Do you have a toaster in your kitchen?
Yes, I do. What is the first thing I should do?
Put a slice of bread in the slot. Press the lever down to start the heat.
Then what happens?
Wait for the light to go off. Is your bread fresh or old?
It is fresh. Thank you, that was easy.
You are welcome. Enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to spell all twelve months.
That is a great goal. Do you know which month comes first?
Yes, it is January. How do I say it with the letters?
You spell it J-A-N-U-A-R-Y. Is that letter easy for you to remember?
Yes, the big J helps me. What comes right after January?
The next month is February. Do you like its long name?
It feels a bit hard to spell. Can you help me with the letters?
Sure, it is F-E-B-R-U-A-R-Y. Tell me, do you know the month with the fewest days?
That is February again. I think I am ready for March.
Great! March is M-A-R-C-H. Do you know what makes March special?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am reading my favorite book again today.
That sounds fun. What is the book about?
It is about a red train that goes very fast.
A red train? That is a cool color.
Yes, but today the rain made the pages wet.
Oh no. Did you dry them out?
I used a towel, and they are safe now.
Good. What happens to the train next?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the island big?
Yes, it is quite big. Do you have a boat?
No, not yet. Will I get lost?
You might, but I will help you. What do you see first?
I see a tree. Is it safe?
Yes, it looks safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The rain is very loud today. Do you have any tips to feel better?
Try drinking some warm tea. Do you like tea?
I do not know what to wear. It is too wet for shoes.
You can put on your tall boots. Are your boots clean?
Yes, they are ready. I feel much better now.
That is great to hear. I do not know when it will stop, but stay dry.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at the big blue water. I do not know what to do here.
That water looks very cold and clear. Do you like boats?
Maybe. But I am not sure if I should sit by the edge.
Sit carefully if you like, or just walk around the path. It is safe to watch the ducks.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do robots move so smooth?
They use strong motors to help them move. Do you like watching them walk?
Why can they learn new things?
They read lots of data to get smart.
Why do some look like people?
That helps us feel close to them. Do you want a robot friend?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky red up there?
That is the color red. Do you like red?
Yes, I do. Why is the sun not there?
The sun is behind you. You see it in the rain.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do at my new work.
That is hard. Do you know what the job is?
I just need to sit there and wait for someone.
You can ask a friend for help. Do you have a friend there?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I light the lamp in the tower?
You turn the big dial to start the light. Do you like the view from up there?
Yes, I do. What if the power goes out?
We use the battery backup then.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights went out and I feel very scared.
Is your phone working right now? Please do not worry.
I do not know what to do next.
Stay safe and keep your door locked. I am glad you are still there.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big white tower by the sea today.
That sounds fun. Did the light turn on?
Yes, it shone very bright at night.
Nice. Was the water calm?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like snow. It is white and cold.
Snow is very pretty. Do you build snowmen?
Yes, I do. What do you like?
I love the sun in spring. It feels warm.
Warm is nice. Why do trees lose leaves?
Trees rest when it gets cold. Do you know why?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. The bus is coming.
I can see the bus too. Do you have your ticket?
Yes, it is in my bag.
Good luck with your ride. Is the road wet there?
Yes, it is raining hard.
Please wear your coat to stay dry.
I forgot my coat at home.
I am sorry you left it. Do you have an umbrella?
No, I have nothing to dry me.
I do not know where to get a cheap one.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go, but do you know how to serve?
Yes, you toss the ball up and hit it over the net. Are you playing soon?
I am late, so I must run.
Run fast and have fun. Do you like the sound of the ball?
I will talk later, thank you.
Good luck with your match.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very tired from the long train ride.
Oh no. Did you rest your head on the seat?
I tried, but my neck hurt.
That is too bad. Do you have a pillow with you?
No, I do not. What should I do?
Try to stretch your arms up high. It might help you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the bus go so slow?
It stops to let people on and off. Do you like riding the bus?
Why does it stop at every corner?
Some corners have signs that say it must stop. Is that a lot of stops?
Why does it hum like that?
The engine makes that sound when it works. Does the sound bother you?
Why do we get off here?
I do not know where we are going.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very scared about my first job tomorrow.
It is normal to feel that way. What worries you the most?
I do not know how to do the tasks well.
You will learn by trying. Do you have a list of duties?
Yes, but the list is long and I am afraid to fail.
Mistakes help you grow. Can you practice one small task today?
I think I can try that. Thank you for your help.
You can do this. Have a good night.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a blue beetle today. I feel so happy.
That is a lovely thing to see. Was it moving fast?
Yes, it zoomed off my hand. Do you know what it eats?
I am not sure about that one. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tell the doctor I have a bad cough?
Just say, "I have a cough." Do you feel sick all over?
Yes, I feel very tired. Should I wait in the room?
Yes, stay in the chair. Do you have any water with you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The plane bumped hard this morning.
That can feel scary. Did you feel okay?
My coffee spilled on my shirt.
Oh no. Is it still wet?
Yes, but I found a dry towel.
You found a good fix. Did the seat heat up?
The pilot said we are near the coast.
That sounds nice. Do you like looking out?
I feel better now that we land soon.
Good. Are you ready for home?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to float on my back.
Take a big breath and relax your body. Do you feel safe in the water?
Yes, I do. I think my arms should stay still.
That is a good start. Keep your head back.
I tried it, but I sank right away.
Try kicking your legs like a frog. Are you cold?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My head hurts so bad. I feel sick and mad.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you have a fever?
Yes, it feels hot to the touch. I just want to sleep.
Rest is good for you. Drink some water too.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the pool today.
That sounds like fun.
I jumped in the water.
Did you like the cold?
It was a bit cold at first.
Cold water feels waking up.
Then it got warm.
How long did you swim?
I swam for a long time.
You must be tired now.
Yes, I am very tired.
Rest well and drink some water.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I walk here and see small houses.
That is a nice place. What do you wish to see?
I do not know. I feel lost.
Try the square in the middle. Is there a table there?
Yes, I see people talking.
You can sit and listen. Do you like talk?
I am not sure if I can stay.
You can stay for a short time. Do you like the sound?
It feels soft and calm.
Then stay. Do you know where to go next?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I failed the test and I feel very bad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to try again?
I do not think I can do better.
You can try your best next time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do bees make honey? I want to know the whole thing.
They take sweet nectar from flowers and put it in their special pouches. Do you like sweet food?
I do, but they do not eat it right away. What do they do next?
They carry the nectar back to the hive and mix it with their own body fluids. Is your favorite flower a rose?
No, it is a daisy. Do they just let it sit there?
They fan it with their wings to dry it until it turns into thick honey. Do you want to visit a beehive?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am very tired, but I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
Rest first, please, because a tired mind learns slowly.
Okay, I rested a bit. How do I start?
Make a little loop with one string. Do you remember when you made one yesterday?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am packing my bag for the trip. I found a blue sock, but I cannot find its pair.
That is tricky to lose. Did you check the laundry basket?
I did, but it is not there. It might be lost under the sofa cushions.
Under the sofa is a good guess. Do you want to look now?
I will have to find it later. For now, I am just putting in my shoes and snacks.
Snacks sound good for the road. What kind are they?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because the lights in my room just turned on!
That is great news. What did you do to fix them?
I just flipped the switch by the door and they came on.
Nice. Do they flicker or stay steady?
They stay bright and steady all the time.
I am glad they are working well.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do leaves fall from trees in the fall?
Trees drop leaves to save energy for the winter. Do you see the branches looking bare?
I do. That makes it feel quiet.
It is a time for the tree to rest. Do you think it is tired?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the island before the boat leaves. How do I cross the water?
You can take the small boat at the pier. Are you going to swim there too?
No, just the boat. Is it expensive to ride?
It costs a few coins for one ride. Do you have enough money with you?
Yes, I have plenty. How long does the trip take?
It takes about ten minutes across the bay. Is the weather good there today?
It looks sunny. Where is the pier located?
Look for the red dock on your left. Can I help you carry your bags?
No, I must run now. Thank you for your help.
Good luck on your trip. Have a great day there.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. We are moving to a new home today.
That is wonderful news! Which part of the house are you packing first?
I am packing my books and toys.
Sounds like a fun job to do. Do you have a big truck ready for the ride?
Yes, the truck is big and blue.
A blue truck is a great choice. What is your favorite thing in your new place?
The garden has a big red rose bush.
Roses are very pretty plants.
I think we will have many nice days there.
I am sure you will feel at home soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to kick my legs when I swim.
That is a fun goal. Do you already know how to hold your breath?
Yes, I can hold my breath for a few seconds.
Great start. Kick small and fast like a frog.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The wind is too cold for this walk.
I am sorry the wind is chilly. Do you have a warm coat?
I forgot my coat at home.
That is very annoying. Would you like to sit on a bench?
I just want to go home.
We can walk back to the gate. Is it far from here?
It is a long way to go.
I will stay with you. Do you want to stop for hot cocoa?
Yes, that sounds nice.
Great. We will get some now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the wind so loud today?
The air is moving very fast. Do you feel it on your face?
I do. Why does it move the air?
The sun heats the ground unevenly. Do you know how the sun works?
I think it makes things warm. Why does warm air rise?
Warm air is lighter than cold air. Do you like flying?
Yes, I do. Why does the wind stop sometimes?
I do not know for sure. Do you want to check the sky?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the big lightning flash. I am so happy it is raining.
That is a big flash. Do you like the sound of the rain?
Yes, I love the loud thunder. It makes me feel safe inside.
Good for you. Is your house warm and cozy?
It is very warm. I am drinking hot cocoa.
That sounds nice. What is your favorite drink on a stormy day?
Cocoa is my favorite. It tastes sweet and smells good.
Sweet cocoa is great. Do you want to go outside?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am tired of running. My legs hurt.
Rest your legs. Do you like to walk?
I like to walk, but I want to run fast.
Slow running is good for you. Is your breath quick?
Yes, I can not breathe well.
Try small steps. It helps your chest.
Small steps feel very slow to me.
Slow is the start of speed. Do you have water?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the light on the top?
It helps ships see the rocks at night. Do you like to look at lights?
Yes. Why is the tower so tall?
A tall tower lets the light travel far. Do you think it is cold up there?
Probably. Why does it spin around?
Spinning makes a bright flash for sailors. Does it sound like it is spinning?
I have not heard it. Why is it only white?
I do not know the exact color reason. Do you see any other colors?
No. Why is it so famous?
It has saved many lives over the years. Do you want to visit one?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My head hurts and my feet hurt from today.
I am sorry you feel bad. Are you sitting down now?
Yes, I am on the couch. I am too tired to eat.
Please drink some water first. Do you have anything sweet?
I have some old cookies. I want to throw them away.
Keep them for later. Did you finish all your work?
No, I have one big task left. It is very hard.
Let it wait until tomorrow. You need to rest your brain now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I passed my test today! I got a big A.
That is great news! Are you proud of yourself?
Yes, I studied hard for it.
You worked hard, so you earned it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I need to give this book to Tom.
Is he at the park right now?
Yes, but I forgot my keys.
Try the door. It may be open.
It is not. I am stuck.
I do not know where he is.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My cat is eating a lot lately.
That can mean he is hungry or ill. Is he drinking extra water?
Yes, he drinks a lot too.
Please see a vet to be safe.
Is it bad if he sleeps all day?
Sleeping is normal for cats. Does he play sometimes?
He plays a little.
That is a good sign.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my first job.
You have to run. Do you have your keys?
Yes, they are in my hand.
Good luck. You will do fine.
I feel scared.
That is normal. Are you eating?
I skipped breakfast.
Please eat something later. Take your time now.
I am running!
Go! Good job.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very sad that summer is over.
I understand. What was your favorite part of the summer?
I loved jumping in the big pool.
That sounds like great fun. Do you miss the warm sun?
Yes, it is cold now.
That is true. Let us keep warm and wait for spring.
Okay, I will wait.
Good job. I hope you have a cozy night.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The good bread is gone. I am so hungry.
That is very sad. Is there other food you like?
I only want that warm bread. It was the best one.
I do not know if they will get more. Are you okay with a cookie?
A cookie is not the same. I feel so small.
You are not small. You just want a treat.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just found a song that makes me want to dance.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you have your shoes on?
Yes, I am ready to spin around in my room.
I do not know the song, but I can see your joy. What color is the song to you?
It feels like bright yellow sunshine and warm air.
Yellow is a happy color for sure. Do you plan to sing along?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss my old friend. I am sad he left town.
I am sorry you feel this way. Did you call him yesterday?
Yes, but he did not answer the phone.
That must be confusing. Have you tried writing a letter?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big secret to tell you.
I am happy you trust me. What is it?
I found a lost puppy behind the fence.
That is very kind of you. Is it safe now?
Yes, its owner is coming to pick it up.
You did a good job helping it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have these new plants. I do not know if I should water them.
Do they feel dry to the touch?
Yes, the soil feels like dust.
Give them a little water and ask your neighbor for advice.
Okay. What about the light?
I do not know their needs. Do they look happy in the sun?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look up! There is a big rainbow.
Wow, that is very pretty. Did you see the whole arc?
I saw the red and the blue. I am so happy right now.
It is good to share joy. What does the blue part look like?
It looks like a wet sky.
That is a nice way to say it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I played chess today and the white knight jumped over my pawn.
That is a fun move. Did you catch it in time?
No, my pawn got taken and I felt a bit sad about it.
It happens to every player. Have you tried a new opening since then?
I just played a simple game with my brother under the tree.
That sounds very nice and calm.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the rain.
It can feel sad. Is your window wet?
Yes, it is cold outside.
A warm drink helps. Do you have some?
Not right now. I feel blue.
You can count the drops. Do you see any?
Yes, they fall fast.
That is a nice sound. Do you like it now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many days are in one week?
There are seven days in a week. Do you know them all?
I know Monday, but I get mixed up on the others.
The days go in a line from Monday to Sunday. Which one do you like best?
I like Saturday because I can play outside.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Happy learning!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big fire outside my window this evening. The sky looked very red and hot.
That sounds scary. Did you see where the smoke was coming from?
Yes, it was from a small shed on the hill. I did not go near it, but I watched from inside.
You did the right thing to stay safe. Did you tell an adult right away?
I called my mom and she came to see. The fire went out before anyone was hurt.
I am glad everyone is safe. Do you feel better now that it is over?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My cat is hiding under the bed. I do not know what to do.
I am glad you asked. Have you tried leaving some food nearby?
I put down some treats, but he will not come out.
That is tricky. Is he meowing or is he very quiet?
He is very quiet and his eyes look small.
I do not know why he is doing this. If he is quiet and looks sick, please call a vet.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a paper boat?
Fold the paper in half, then push the sides down. Do you have some paper?
Yes, I have a square sheet. What is the next step?
Fold the top corners down to the center line. Does it look like a house yet?
Yes, it looks like a house. Now what?
Fold the whole thing in half along the crease. Are you careful with your hands?
I am folding it. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have fun on the water.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost in the days.
That sounds tricky. Do you start on Sunday?
I think so, but I am not sure.
Most places start on Monday. Do you work on weekends?
Yes, I work all the time.
That is very tiring. Do you rest?
I forget to stop.
Try to take a break. Do you like quiet days?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the king move only one step at a time?
It is the most important piece, so it must be careful. Do you like to move slow and steady?
Why is the knight the only piece that can jump?
It jumps over other pieces to surprise the enemy. Do you like surprises?
Why is checkmate the best win in the game?
It means your king has no safe spot left. I do not know why it feels so good to win, but it is true.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My neighbor has a loud dog that barks all day.
That sounds very annoying. Do you like the dog?
I like the dog, but I like quiet too. What should I do?
You could ask your grown-ups to talk to the neighbor. Do you know where they live?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start walking for my heart?
Start with a short walk each day. Do you walk alone or with a friend?
I usually walk alone. How long should I go?
Try walking for ten minutes first. Is your park quiet in the morning?
Yes, it is very quiet. How can I make it harder?
Try walking up small hills slowly. Do you have hills near your home?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why does my bread get big and soft?
Yeast eats sugar and makes gas. Do you add sugar?
Yes, I put in a little bit.
That helps the yeast wake up. Is your room warm?
It is pretty cold today.
Warmth helps the gas grow. Do you have a lamp?
I can put it by a lamp.
A light spot is a good place.
Should I wait for it to double?
Yes, wait until it is twice as big.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What is the weather?
It is sunny and warm. Do you have an umbrella?
No, I do not.
That is fine, then. It should not rain today.
I must go now.
Good luck with your day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting on the plane for so long.
Rest your feet on the seat in front of you. Are your shoes tight?
I think so. Should I take them off to feel better?
Yes, that is a good idea. Do you have socks with you?
Yes, I have thick socks in my bag.
Put those on right now. You will feel much cooler.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel really happy today.
That is wonderful. What made you smile?
I saw a big red balloon.
Red balloons are fun. Do you like to fly kites?
Yes, I love flying kites.
Kites help us feel free. Do you have a kite?
Not yet, but I want one.
A new toy is a big joy. What color is your dream kite?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say sorry when we hurt someone's feelings?
We say sorry to show we feel bad. Do you know why that feels good?
I do not know. What does it feel like?
It feels like we are trying to fix the hurt. Do you want to say it?
Yes, I want to fix it. How do I say it well?
Look at their eyes and speak with a kind voice.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I won the hand! I had three kings and two aces.
That is a very strong hand. Did you play the aces first?
Yes, I played them on the last turn. I was so happy.
Nice plan. Do you like playing with kings?
Yes, they are my favorite cards. They look so cool.
They do look bold. Do you want to deal the next hand?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad because my friend forgot my birthday.
That feels so bad. Do you still like to play with your friend?
I think yes, but I do not know what to say to them now.
You can just tell them you are sad. Do you want to try that?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to clean my room today.
That is a good plan. Do you like your toys?
Yes, but they are on the floor.
Put the toys in the box. Where is your box?
It is under the bed.
Great. Do you need help lifting it?
No, I can do it myself.
You are very strong. I am proud of you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start my computer?
Press the round power button on the front. Do you see a small light?
The light is on, but the screen is still black.
Try tapping the keyboard to wake it up. Does the picture change?
It works now. Thank you.
You are welcome. I am glad it works for you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to take a good picture of my dog, but it moves too fast.
You should try to take many pictures quickly. Is your dog wearing a collar?
Yes, it has a blue one. I also have a blurry photo.
The blur happens when you shake your hands. Put your elbow on a table to rest it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the clock hands move?
A spring inside them gets tight and then lets go. Do you like winding toys?
I like to watch them go around.
They circle around the numbers to tell time.
What if I break it?
It will stop moving, and we would need to fix it. Are you careful with things?
I will try very hard not to.
That is a good plan. I am glad you will be careful.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a horse! He is big and brown.
That sounds fun. Do you ride him?
Yes, I ride him every day. He goes so fast.
Wow, that is thrilling. Does he have a special name?
His name is Spot. I love him very much.
What a sweet name. I am happy for you and your horse.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How should I start my letter?
Start by saying hello to the person. Who are you writing to?
I am writing to my teacher.
That is a sweet choice. Do you want to thank her for help?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the lighthouse so tall?
It is tall to let ships see the light from far away. Do you like watching boats?
Does it work in the dark?
Yes, it shines a bright beam all night long.
Who builds a place like that?
Builders with strong hands and big tools make it. Is your house on a hill?
Can we go inside?
You can visit some during the day. Do you climb ladders?
Does it ever break?
We do not know if this one does.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love my warm lamp and my soft blanket for night reads.
That sounds very cozy. Do you have a favorite book?
Yes, it is a story about a brave little fox.
What a lovely choice. I am glad you are enjoying it so much.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not like math at school.
That feels hard. What part is the trickiest for you?
I get stuck on the big numbers.
You can ask the teacher to show you again. Do you feel scared to ask?
Yes, I worry they will be mad.
They usually want to help you learn. Do you have a friend who is good at math?
My friend Sam is very good.
Sam might be a nice study partner. Would you like to ask him to sit with you?
Yes, I will try that tomorrow.
That sounds like a great start. Good luck with your work.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I put the small blue fish back in the tank today.
That sounds nice. Did you see where it went?
It hid under the green plants.
Fish like to hide when they feel safe. Do you feed them in the morning?
Yes, I gave them tiny flakes for breakfast.
That is good for them. I do not know if they liked the taste.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn to sing, but I am scared.
Do not worry, everyone starts at zero. What song do you like?
I like fast songs with big jumps in the voice.
That is hard, so start with slow songs first. Do you have a quiet room to practice?
Yes, I can sing in my bedroom at night.
Good, but do not shout or hurt your throat. Can you show me a scale?
What is a scale? I do not know the word.
It is just going up and down like stairs. Try humming a low note.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here but I do not know where to sit.
The chairs by the window are free. Do you like the light there?
The light is nice but I do not know what to eat.
The red soup smells very warm. Are you hungry for something hot?
I am not sure if I like red soup.
You can try a small bowl first. It is sweet and mild.
That sounds good to me.
Happy eating. I am glad you chose that.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I made a promise to play with my friend, but I am busy.
That is hard. Do you love your friend?
Yes, but I have to help my mom now.
Tell her the truth. She will understand.
But what if she is angry?
She is kind. She will forgive you.
I will tell her I am sorry.
That is a good choice.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the end of the play. The hero dies.
That feels very sad. Did you cry?
I feel empty. Why did the writer do that?
I do not know for sure. Do you like sad stories?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a funny movie today. It was about a cat.
That sounds fun. Did the cat do anything silly?
Yes, it jumped into a fish tank.
Oh no. Did it get wet?
It did. Then it ran away.
How did you feel about that?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am stuck. This puzzle has no end. I want to quit.
That feels hard. Take a deep breath. What piece looks easy?
I do not know. Everything is wrong.
Let us try one small step. Can you find the top left corner?
Oh, yes. It fits.
Good job. You did that.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see leaves falling. How do I find the best ones for a craft?
Look for dry, bright leaves that are still stiff. Do you like red or yellow leaves?
I like red. What do I do with them?
Press them flat under a heavy book for a week. They will keep their shape.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I cannot swim well.
That sounds hard. Do you like the pool?
Yes, but I always worry about water.
It is normal to feel scared. Have you tried with floaties?
No, I think that is for babies.
Actually, they help many people. Do you want to try?
Maybe, but I might get in trouble.
A helper can stay close. What is your biggest fear?
I am afraid of going under.
We can practice in the shallow part.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My fish is not swimming well today.
That is not good. Did it eat its food?
No, it looks very sad and slow.
That sounds like it is sick. Do you have a net?
Yes, I have a small green one.
Do not catch it yet. Keep the water clean.
How do I keep the water clean?
Take out about ten percent of the water. Use fresh water to fill it back up.
Should I add any medicine?
I do not know what is wrong with your fish. Please check the water first.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My legs hurt so much today.
That is a bad feeling. Do you think you ran too fast?
I am so tired I want to quit.
Rest is good for your body. It helps you grow strong.
But I do not know how to stop the pain.
I do not know the secret trick. Try sitting down for a bit?
My shoe feels tight and scary.
Take it off right now. Was the shoe too small?
Maybe I just cannot run at all.
You did run today, so you can do it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run. My head hurts.
Take a deep breath. Are you sick?
No. I just need to go.
Sleep is key. Do you know when you stop?
I will be done soon.
Good luck. Please be safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My bike feels very hard to ride today.
That is strange. Is the tire soft and flat?
The tire looks okay, but I am stuck on the hill.
Try standing up and pushing hard. Do you have a friend to help push?
No, I am alone. I am getting tired.
Take a break and drink some water. Is your water bottle still full?
Yes, it is. I think I can try again now.
Good luck. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very tired today. I want to learn how to tie a shoe.
That is a good goal. How did you learn to tie it before?
I used to watch my dad do it. I forgot the steps.
Let us start with the knot. Do you have a pair of shoes with you?
Yes, they are right here. Show me the first step.
Cross the laces over each other. Can you do that part?
I did it. Now what?
Make a loop with one lace. Is it looking like a bunny ear?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Is it cold outside?
It is very cold and windy. Do you have a coat?
Yes, I do. Can I go now?
Yes, please go fast. I hope you stay warm.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see the big lake near my home.
That sounds like a nice plan. Do you like swimming?
Yes, I love cold water.
Great, but please check if the water is safe first.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late! Do you know where the party is?
It is down the street on the left. Are you going there now?
Yes, I am running. Is the house big or small?
It is a small house. Do you have your gift?
No, I left it at home! Can I borrow a crayon?
I do not have one, but you can draw a card later. Run!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a horse move forward?
You ask it nicely. Do you have a horse nearby?
Yes, I am standing near one.
You pat its neck and say "walk". Are you holding the reins?
I think so, but my hands are cold.
Warm your hands first. Is the horse calm?
It looks happy and just wants a snack.
Give it an apple. Does it have a special name?
No, it just likes apples.
Good. Feed it gently.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is good. Why is your day so bright?
I saw a big wolf in the woods.
A wolf is a wild animal. Did it look at you?
It did not even blink.
That is a cool fact. I do not know if it meant anything.
I want to see more of them.
That sounds like fun. What other wild animals do you like?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the rain today. It makes me feel so sad and tired.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like listening to the sound of the rain?
No, it is too loud and wet. I just want the sun to come back out.
That is a fair wish. Do you have a window seat to look through?
Yes, but I only see gray clouds. I want to go outside and play.
Playing in the rain can be fun sometimes. Do you have your rain boots ready?
I do, but I do not want to get my clothes wet. I just want to feel happy again.
I understand your frustration. Do you want to talk more about what makes you happy?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start my letter.
Do you want to tell a friend a secret?
Yes, but I am stuck on the first line.
Start with "Dear friend." Does that feel right?
That works, but what comes next?
I do not know your story, so you must add it.
I will write about the sunny day we shared.
That is a happy start. Do you have paper ready?
Yes, I am ready to write now.
Good luck with your words.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to send a letter right now. Can you help me quickly?
Yes, please. Do you have the stamps?
I have no stamps and no time to buy them.
We do not sell stamps here. Do you need a package instead?
No, just the letter. How can I do this fast?
Try the blue machine. It is very quick.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do for my birthday.
That sounds hard. What do you like to play?
I like to ride bikes, but I have no friends to ride with.
Your family can ride with you. Do you want to bake a cake?
I do not know if I can bake a good cake.
We can make it together. It will be fun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do roses have thorns?
I think they use thorns to keep bugs away. Do you like pink or red roses?
I like red ones.
Red roses look very bright and happy.
Is the dirt wet when it rains?
Yes, the soil gets soaked with water. Do you want to go outside to check?
Can flowers sleep at night?
I do not know if they sleep, but they grow slower at night.
My mum gave me a sunflower.
That is a big, happy flower. Does it look at the sun?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say please and thank you?
It shows we care for others. Do you like helping people?
Yes, I do. Why is it good to wait for my turn?
It keeps things fair for everyone. Is that clear to you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love bananas.
Nice choice. Do you eat them with a fork?
No. How do I peel one?
Hold the top and pull it down.
It is still stuck.
Try from the bottom next time. Does that help?
Yes. Thank you.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
Bees fly to flowers to get sweet nectar. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I do.
They put the nectar in special body bags to carry it home. The sun helps dry it into honey.
That is cool.
They use their wings to fan the air and make it thick. Is that how you dry soup?
No, I use a spoon.
Bees do not use spoons; they use air. Do you like to play with air?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
The tree stops making new leaves for the winter. It saves its energy for when it is warm again. Do you think that is a clever trick?
I suppose so. How do they know when to fall?
They feel the days get shorter and colder. That tells the tree to let go.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. What month is it?
It is March. Do you need to leave right now?
Yes, my bus leaves in five minutes. How many months come after March?
There are nine months left. Is this a big trip?
No, just to school. Can you count them for me?
April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December. Will you make it in time?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does that bird shake its head?
It is cleaning its eyes. Do you see the small seed in its beak?
I see a bug, not a seed.
It is eating the bug to stay strong.
Do birds feel cold?
Yes, they can get very cold. Do you have a warm hat on?
