I do, but what about them?
They grow more fluff to keep warm.
Can they fly in the wind?
Yes, strong winds help them float. Do you like watching them fly?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the library today and found a book about dragons.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you read it all the way to the end?
I read two chapters, but the dragon was too loud and I had to go home.
Loud books are tricky. What did the dragon say in the story?
It roared and broke a chair in the story, which made me feel a little scared.
I am sorry you felt scared. Did you tell a grown up about the loud noise?
Yes, I told my mom and she laughed and said dragons are often noisy.
She has a good point. Do you want to try a different book next time?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did people use candles so long ago?
The sun went down and it got very dark. We need light to see, so they burned things. Did you know fire was a big deal?
Did everyone have the same kind of house?
No, houses looked different in every place. Some were made of mud, while others used wood. What does your home look like?
How did people eat if there were no stores?
They grew their own food or hunted animals for meat. There were no big shops with shelves back then. Do you grow any plants?
Why did kings wear heavy crowns?
The crowns showed that the king was very important. It helped people know who the leader was. Why do you like wearing hats?
How do we know what happened long ago?
People wrote things down in books to remember them. I do not know every small detail from that time. Do you like reading old stories?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Is the next bus coming soon? I am late.
It should be here in five minutes. Are you going to school?
No, I am going to work. The roads are bad.
That is true, it is raining hard. Do you have an umbrella?
I forgot it at home. Can you help me?
I can look for a shelter for you. Where is the stop?
It is right over there by the tree.
I see it. It is not a far walk.
Thanks for helping me. I feel less scared now.
You are welcome. Is this your first time taking this bus?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a small fox cub in my yard. What do I do?
Do not touch it. The mother is likely nearby. Is it acting scared or sick?
It looks okay, just sleepy. Should I give it food?
No, human food can hurt it. It is best to watch from a distance. Do you see any parents nearby?
I do not see any. I am worried it will die.
I do not know where the mother went. Please call a local wild animal rescue line.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I really like bananas. How do I cut them safely?
Peel the skin off and cut it into small circles. Do you have a knife?
Yes, I have a small knife.
Hold the banana with one hand and the knife with the other. Cut down slowly. Did you use a knife before?
No, this is the first time.
That is fine. Start at the top and slice down. Be careful.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today! My teacher was very kind to me.
That is wonderful! What did she do for you?
She gave me a big smile and said my drawing was great.
Wow, that must feel amazing.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel very sad and alone today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a friend nearby?
I am late for work, please be quick.
Take a deep breath to calm down. What is making you rush?
My house is too quiet right now.
Silence can feel heavy sometimes. Do you like being alone?
I just want someone to talk to.
I am here to listen to you. Is there one small thing that makes you happy?
Thank you, I must run now.
You are not alone in feeling this way. Please be kind to yourself.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a cool rock today.
That sounds fun. Did you pick it up?
I kept it in my pocket all day.
Nice. It must have felt cool, right?
I think it might be a secret stone.
Oh, interesting. Do you know why it is secret?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The lights went out and I am scared. What should I do?
Do not worry, stay close to me. Have you found a flashlight?
I think yes, but the battery is low. Is there anything else I can use?
You can use a phone torch if you have one. I do not know your specific phone model.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my bread is flat.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have yeast?
I think I do, but I do not know.
Yeast makes air bubbles grow. Is it warm in your room?
It is a bit cold here.
Warmth helps yeast work hard. Do you have a towel?
Yes, I have a big towel.
Wrap the bread to keep it warm. It should rise soon.
Will it really get big?
Yes, if you wait a while. Are you willing to wait?
I guess I can wait.
Patience helps the bread grow. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must run. Do you see the quiet street?
Yes, it is very calm. Are you late?
I am. Can you tell me the way?
I do not know the map. Is the park nearby?
I think it is next to it. Do you see a blue door?
I see a blue door. Is that your place?
That is the place. I must go now.
Run safe. Will you come back later?
I will try to. Thanks for watching.
You are welcome. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I had a bad dream about falling. I feel very scared now.
That sounds scary. Do you want to talk about what happened?
I do not know what to do. It feels stuck in my head.
You can just let the thought go. Is there anything you like to do right now?
Maybe I should go back to sleep. But I am afraid it will come back.
You might try to count your toes. Does that make you feel better?
Counting toes makes me feel safe. But I am still not sure what to do next.
I do not know the right answer. Do you want to sit here for a bit?
Yes, sitting here feels good. Thank you for helping me.
I am happy to help. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. My cat will not come out of the box.
Do you have treats?
Yes, but he is too full. What should I do?
Try playing with a string.
I do not have a string. Is there another way?
I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to watch a funny cat video on my tablet today.
That sounds fun. Did the cat do anything silly?
It tried to jump onto the high shelf but missed and fell down.
Oh no, I hope it is okay.
It was fine, but now my screen is cracked and the internet is very slow.
I am sorry about your screen. Do you have a plan to fix it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did people build big stone walls?
They wanted to keep bad things out. Do you like building with blocks?
Yes, I do. Why do we still have old books?
They hold true stories from long ago. Do you enjoy reading?
I love stories. Why do we write them down?
So we do not forget the past. That is a good reason.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I cannot pick a meal.
I am sorry you feel bad. Do you like hot food or cold food?
I do not care. I just want to eat.
Okay, I will pick for you. A warm bowl of soup?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to buy fruit. Which shelf is it on?
The red apples are on the top shelf. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I love sweet things. Where are the cookies?
The cookies are near the cash register. Do you have a basket?
I do not have a basket. Can I just hold them?
You can hold them, but a bag is safer. Do you need a bag?
Yes, please. Where do I pay?
The cashier is right over there.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to sing a song today but my voice sounded strange.
That can happen when you are tired. Did you drink some water before you tried?
Yes, I had a big glass of water, but my throat still hurt a little.
A sore throat makes singing hard. Do you want to try humming just one note?
I hummed one note and it felt much better.
That is a good sign.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now, I just want to tell you.
That is great to hear, why are you so happy?
I finally found my lost toy and it made me smile.
I am glad it is safe, do you want to play with it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My square is lost.
That feels bad. Do you have a circle left?
No. I only have a triangle.
I am sorry. Is the triangle sharp?
Yes. It hurts my hands.
Please be careful with it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a very tall mountain today.
That must look so big. Do you like tall things?
It was white with snow on top.
Snow is cold but looks nice. Is the air cold there?
I feel so free standing near it.
Nature can make you feel calm. Does it help you feel good?
Yes, the silence is very nice.
Quiet places are good for rest. Do you hear birds there?
I want to go back next week.
I hope the weather is good for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to read this book fast. I have school tomorrow.
That is a lot of reading. What is your favorite part so far?
Just the end. I am almost done.
Good luck finishing it. Do you have a warm drink with you?
No time for that. I must go now.
Be safe. Sleep well tonight.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not want coffee today. It makes my head hurt.
That sounds hard. Do you want a warm cup of tea instead?
Tea is sweet, but I feel too tired for it. I just want to sit still.
Rest is good for you. I do not know what will make you feel better.
I hate that I cannot fix this feeling. It is very heavy.
You are being very brave. Is it a rainy day outside?
Yes, the gray sky matches my mood. I think I need a nap.
A nap sounds perfect. I hope you feel light soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I fixed my friend's broken bike tire today.
That was very kind of you. How did your friend feel about the help?
He was so happy and thanked me a lot.
It is good to make someone smile. Do you like doing good things?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do clouds look white?
Sunlight hits them and bounces back to your eyes. Do you see more clouds at night?
What makes them move?
The wind pushes the air inside them. Do you like windy days?
Do they get heavy?
Yes, they can get very heavy before it rains. I am not sure if they feel weight.
How do they make rain?
Tiny water bits join together and fall down. Are you thirsty when it rains?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look! A rainbow in the sky!
Yes, it is very pretty. Do you know what makes it?
No, I do not.
Rain and sun make it. What is your favorite color there?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The lighthouse light is broken.
That is very sad. Do you see any smoke?
No smoke, just dark.
Dark can be scary. What do you feel inside?
I feel cold and lost.
Let us sit down. Is your coat warm?
Yes, but I miss the glow.
We will wait for the fix. Do you like stars?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. How do I wash this shirt?
Put it in the machine with cold water. Is it very dirty?
Yes, there is red juice on it. What do I do?
Add a little soap and pick the hot wash. Do you have time to dry it?
I have no time. I must go now.
Leave it in the machine for now. It will be ready soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the bakery today to buy a big, warm loaf of bread.
That sounds tasty. Did you share it with anyone?
Yes, I brought it home and we ate it for lunch.
I am happy to hear you enjoyed your meal.
Then I walked to the park because it was sunny.
Walking is good for your body. Do you like the park?
I love the park, but I forgot my water bottle.
Oh no, that is not good. I do not know how you stayed cool.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a blue button on my walk.
Oh, that sounds fun. What did you do with it?
I put it in my pocket.
Nice. Was the pocket warm?
Yes, it felt soft.
Good. I do not know why it felt that way.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to buy new shoes, but I do not know what size to pick.
Try them on to see if they fit well. Do you like boots or sneakers?
I like boots, but the store only has sneakers in my size.
That is a tricky choice. Would you like help finding a shop with boots?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now because I found a new song.
That is great! What kind of music is it?
It has loud drums and makes me want to dance.
I love that! Do you sing along too?
Yes, I sing very loud and my cat runs away.
Haha, that is fun! Do you have a favorite part?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want my bread to get big and fluffy. How do I make it rise?
Yeast eats sugar and makes gas that puffs up the dough. Do you have warm water to help the yeast wake up?
Yes, I do have warm water. But the dough is still small after an hour.
It may need more time in a warm spot to grow. Do you live near a sunny window?
It is cloudy outside, so it is a bit cold. What should I do now?
Put the dough near your oven with the light on to make it warmer. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is it raining so hard?
The sky gets heavy with water. Do you like the sound of rain?
I like it, but I want to play outside.
You can wait for the sun to come out. Is your coat dry?
Yes, but I am bored here.
We can look at the drops on the glass. Do you see them?
Yes, they are like little races.
That is a fun way to see it. How fast are they going?
Very fast!
Rain always needs to stop. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does a big ship stay on the water?
It pushes water aside to make room for itself. Do you like boats?
Yes, I do. How can I make my own float?
You need a shape that holds air inside. Have you tried a bowl?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a song stuck in my head but I do not know how to stop it.
That can be a funny feeling. Do you know who sings it?
No, I only hum it. It makes me feel sad and happy.
That is a strange mix. Do you want to write it down?
I am afraid I will forget the words if I stop humming.
You are doing a good job keeping it safe. Take your time to remember.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I made a big tower with my blocks today.
That sounds like a lot of fun to build. Did it stand up tall?
Yes, it stood up very tall and did not fall down.
I am so happy you made it work. How did you feel when you saw it?
I felt very proud because I tried many times.
Your hard work paid off well.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found the perfect shoes and I am so happy to share this with you!
That is great news. Do they fit well?
Yes, they are very comfortable.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go now. My bike is not working.
Is the pump lost? I can help you fix the tire.
No, the chain is off. It is too hard for me.
That is tricky. Do you have a tool with you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to ride a bike but I am scared.
That is okay. How tall are you?
I am five years old.
You must practice slowly to get good.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now.
That is wonderful to hear. What makes you feel so good?
The wind is soft and the sun is warm.
Nature looks very nice in the fall. Do you like the color of the trees?
I love the orange and red leaves.
They look like a painting. Have you walked in the woods today?
No, but I want to go soon.
That sounds like a great plan. Are you packing a jacket?
Yes, because it is getting a bit cold.
Dressing warm is smart. I hope you have a lovely time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished a very long trip and I am so glad I made it home.
That sounds like a big challenge. How did you pass the time?
I read a funny book and watched two movies on the screen.
Those are great ways to stay busy. Did you have any snacks with you?
Yes, I packed lots of cookies and a big bag of chips.
Yum, that must have helped. Did you get to sleep a little?
I did, but the plane was very loud and hard to rest in.
Noise can be hard to ignore. Did you use earplugs to help?
I tried, but they did not block out much of the noise.
That is a tough spot. Are you happy to be back on the ground?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which side to sit on.
You sit on the left side. Do you know how to hold the wheel?
I do not know where my hands should go.
Put your hands on the wheel like a clock face.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My head hurts. The day was very long. I am too tired to think. What should I do?
Drink some water. Did you eat lunch today?
I skipped lunch. I was too busy to stop.
That is not good for you. Please eat a small snack now. Do you have food at home?
I have some apples. I will eat one and rest.
That is a good plan. I am glad you will rest.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is warm and the sky is very blue. I love it so much.
That sounds lovely. Do you feel happy too?
Yes, I do. The birds are singing outside my window.
I am glad to hear that. I do not know your weather, but I hope it stays nice.
It will stay sunny all day. Thank you for listening.
You are welcome. Have a great day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I took a picture but it looks all blurry and bad.
That can happen when your hands move. Did you hold it very still?
I tried, but the light was not good either.
Low light makes cameras struggle. Do you have a lamp nearby?
No, it is just a dark park.
I am sorry you are unhappy about it. Let us try again together.
Okay, but I think I failed at this.
Taking good photos takes time to learn. Are you willing to try once more?
I guess I can try just one more time.
That is a good start. Look at a bright spot to help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a picture for school now.
Draw a circle first. Do you have a red crayon?
I am rushing and I do not have time.
A sun is easy. Just add some lines for light.
How do I make it look fast?
Add small lines behind it. Do you like the blue sky?
I am almost done but it feels wrong.
It looks bright and happy. Is the paper big enough?
Thank you, I have to go.
Good luck with your drawing.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The waves are so loud today. I feel sad looking at the gray water.
That sounds heavy. Do you see any colors in the fog?
No, just gray. It feels like the sea is angry with me.
I do not know if the sea feels anger. Do you want to sit in the quiet?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to move to a new home?
The new house is bigger and has a big garden. Do you like playing outside?
I like the garden, but why does the house need to be bigger?
We need more room for your toys and for sleep. Are you ready to pack your boxes?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just moved to a new town and I am so happy about it.
That is wonderful to hear. What do you love most about it?
The trees are very tall and the air is clean.
Nature sounds peaceful and nice.
I also met a kind baker who gave me free bread.
That is a very sweet start. Do you like the food there?
Yes, the food is great and the people are nice.
A new home often brings new friends.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost near the big tower.
Do you like the sea?
I do not know what to do.
Let us walk to the top.
The dark is coming.
The light is safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very lost about the big test tomorrow.
It is okay to feel nervous. What part worries you the most?
I do not know how to study the words in the book.
You can just read the words out loud twice. Do you have a quiet place to sit?
Yes, my room is quiet, but I keep looking at the clock.
Time moves fast when you are busy. Try for ten minutes, then take a short break.
That sounds simple, but I am still afraid of failing.
You will do your best, and that is all that matters.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have these flowers but I am not sure what to do with them.
You can put them in a vase. Do you have a clear vase?
I do not know if they need food or water.
Flowers only need water and light. Do you want to sit by a window?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a bug in my room. I am not sure what to do with it.
Did it hurt you? If not, you can help it go outside.
It looks like a beetle. Should I squish it?
No, do not squish it. It is a friend of the earth.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to paint a big red sun.
That sounds like a fun idea. Do you have red paint?
Yes, I do have red paint.
Great! Remember to have fun.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I started my new job today.
That is a big step. How did it feel?
My hands shook a bit, but I was proud.
You did a good job. Did you like the work?
I made a mistake with a paper.
That happens to everyone. Did you fix it?
I told my boss and fixed it right away.
That shows you are honest. What did you do next?
I felt much better after that.
That is a great way to end the day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My chair leg wobbles. Why does that happen?
It is loose. Do you have a tool for it?
Why do I need a tool?
It holds things tight. I do not know if you have one.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to write a letter, but I do not know where to start.
A letter is just a way to say hello. Do you know who you are writing to?
Yes, it is for my friend who moved away.
That is a good reason to write. Start by saying "Dear Friend" at the top.
What should I say in the middle part?
Tell them what you did since you last saw them. What was the most fun thing you did?
I built a big sandcastle at the beach.
That sounds very cool. End with "Love" or "Best" and sign your name.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to wear for the changing weather.
Try a warm coat with a light shirt underneath. Do you like blue or red?
The air feels dry, but my skin is okay.
That sounds good, but I do not know why that happens. Is the sky clear today?
The trees are turning brown and falling apart.
That is just the trees getting ready to rest for the cold.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my new friend always laugh?
He finds small things funny. Do you like his jokes?
I think they are silly. Why is he so quiet at lunch?
He is just shy and likes to watch. Does that make you nervous?
A little bit. Why does he share his snacks with me?
He trusts you and wants you to be happy. That is a good sign.
I feel happy too. Why did he sit next to me today?
He just liked your company. Did you notice any other changes?
Yes, he smiled at me. Thanks for helping me understand.
You are welcome. It is nice to have a true friend.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very hungry. I want to go to the pizza place.
Pizza sounds yummy. Do you like cheese on yours?
Yes, I love cheese. Is the food there good?
Most people say it is very tasty. Do you want pizza with vegetables?
No, I just want meat. How far is it from here?
It is a short walk away. Do you want to bring your toy?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a map, but I do not know where to go.
Let us look at the colors together. Do you see any blue lines?
There are many lines, but none of them look right to me.
That is okay, we can start from the big red dot. Is that where you stand?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why is the light blinking?
It may mean a part is loose. Are you worried about it?
Yes, I do not know what to do. Please help me fast.
You can check if the bulb is tight. Do not look inside the box.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the clock tick?
The gears inside push each other to move. Do you like the sound of it?
Yes, I do. What makes the hands move?
A spring pushes the gears to turn the hands. Do you have a favorite color for clocks?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am lost. I am late for work. Help me.
Do not panic. Where do you see? Is there a big red tower?
No. I see a yellow bus. I need to go south.
South is that way. Do you know the name of this street?
I do not know. Please just tell me where to turn.
Turn left. Go straight for one block. You will find it.
Thank you. I must run.
Good luck. Be careful on the road.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have flour, but I do not know what to do next.
Is the flour wet?
No, it is dry. I just poured it from the bag.
That is good. You need to add water now.
How much water should I use?
I am not sure about your exact type of flour.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I want to learn to sing, but I feel shy.
It is okay to feel shy. Do you like to hum when you are alone?
Yes, I do hum in my room. Why is singing so hard for me?
Your body feels new moves. Is your chest tight when you breathe?
My chest feels tight. How do I make it stop?
Breathe in slow and deep. Do you feel a bit better now?
I feel a little better. What should I do next?
Try singing a happy song low. I do not know your favorite song.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a small boat in my room. How did it get here?
That is a mystery. Do you think you built it?
No, I found it by the door. Is it a real boat?
It looks very real to me. Do you want to play with it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is so hot today. I do not know what to do.
Have you tried drinking cold water? Is your house too warm inside?
The water is not helping. I feel stuck.
You might go to the pool. Do you like swimming?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How does the clock know what time it is?
It counts the beats of a spring or a battery. Do you like the sound it makes?
Yes, it goes tick tock. How does it keep counting?
A little motor pushes the hands around the dial. Do you have a favorite color?
Blue. Why does the hand go all the way around?
One full circle takes sixty minutes, which is one hour. Is your clock on the wall?
Yes, it is near my bed. How does the minute hand move?
It moves once every sixty seconds. Do you like big numbers?
I like small numbers. How does the second hand work?
It jumps once per second to track time closely. Are you happy now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. The snow is so deep.
Oh no. Is your car stuck?
Yes. I need to go now.
The plow comes soon. Stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the red book fast, but I cannot find it.
Is it about dinosaurs? I will help you look.
Yes, but my train leaves now.
I do not know, but I think it is near the door.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a new place to eat. The food was very hot and spicy. I did not like it.
That sounds like a hard meal. Did you try any water to help?
Yes, I drank a lot of cold water. It made me feel better. I will not go back.
I am glad you are feeling okay. Do you want to pick a softer place next time?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a scary dream about a big, dark hole. I felt so small.
That must have been very frightening. Did you wake up right away?
Yes, I woke up with a start. Then I drank some warm tea.
Warm tea often helps people feel safe again. Do you like the taste of it?
I do, it tastes sweet. I feel much better now.
I am glad you are feeling better. Let us talk about happy things instead.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make cookies?
First, mix butter and sugar, then add flour. Do you have a good recipe?
Yes, but my cookies are always flat.
Try adding one extra egg to help them rise. Did you preheat the oven?
I did, but they still look wrong.
Check if your oven is running too hot next time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn a new language, but it feels too hard. What should I do first?
Start with just five new words a day. Do you like to listen to music?
I do. How does that help me learn?
Listen to songs in that language to hear how words sound. Do you want to learn a song?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I like this book but I do not know how to end it.
That is hard. Do you know if the main character must win?
I think so, but I am not sure.
Maybe the character learns a lesson instead of fighting. What feels right to you?
Learning feels better than fighting.
That is a wise choice. Go with what feels true.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My neighbor waved at me from his window.
That is very nice. Did you wave back?
Yes, I gave him a big wave.
He looked happy to see you.
He gave me a bag of fresh apples.
Apples are good. Do you like sweet fruit?
Yes, they are so good and red.
Thank you for sharing that story.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big fish jump out of the sea today.
That sounds like a big splash. Did you see where it landed?
It went right into the wet sand near the trees.
I am not sure if that is safe for the fish. Did it swim back?
Yes, it swam away before I could get close.
Smart fish. Is the water warm there?
It felt cold on my feet, even in the sun.
That is a bit chilly. Did you wear socks?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a robot, but I do not know how to start.
That sounds fun. Do you have any tools yet?
I have a box of old screws and a hammer.
Great start. Do you want it to walk or just sit?
I want it to walk to my door.
Walking is hard. Do you like to draw pictures of machines?
I draw cars and trucks all the time.
You can start by drawing your robot. Do you want help with that?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the boat is broken.
That is very frustrating. Do you see any tools nearby?
No, I see no tools at all.
I do not know where they went. Is the boat far from the land?
Yes, it is stuck in the deep water.
That is dangerous. Please call for help right now.
Okay, I will call my dad.
That is a good plan. I am happy to help you wait.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the wind blow?
The air moves because the sun warms some places more than others. Do you like when it is windy?
I do. It feels free. Does the wind get tired?
I do not know if wind gets tired, but it can slow down. Is the wind loud today?
Yes, quite loud. How high does it go?
It can travel very far up into the sky. Can you feel it on your face?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the walls have no windows?
They keep the light out to save the art. Do you like dark rooms?
Why is that painting so old?
The artist made it a long time ago. Did you see the date below it?
Why is the museum free?
People give money to help pay for it. Do you like free things?
Why is the door heavy?
I do not know for sure. Maybe it is to keep the air inside.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I win a game of chess?
You win by trapping the king. Do you know how the queen moves?
Yes, she moves anywhere she wants.
That is true, but the other pieces have rules too. Why do you want to learn chess?
I want to get smart.
It is a good choice for your mind.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad about the meeting.
I hear you. Are you worried about the talk?
Yes, I made a big mistake there.
It is okay to feel that way. Was it a hard mistake to fix?
No one seemed to care at all.
That sounds unfair and tough. Did you try to tell them again?
I just want it to be over now.
I believe it will get better soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count from one to ten?
Because our hands have ten fingers. Do you have ten fingers?
Yes, I do. Why do we use our hands?
They help us hold the number in our mind. Can you count with your left hand?
I can try. Why is the number three big?
Three is a special number for many things. Do you like the number three?
I like it. Why does counting never end?
I do not know for sure. Maybe it is to find more things.
That is nice. Why do we stop at ten?
We stop to show a group of ten. Do you want to count again?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great skill to have. Do you already know how to make the first loop?
I think so, but I get stuck on the next part.
Just make a second loop and cross it over the first one. Do you have laces that are easy to hold?
Yes, I have thick laces.
Great. Now, push the bottom loop through the hole in the middle and pull tight. Did that work for you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now. Can you help me with the dust?
Yes, I can help. Do you want to start in the bedroom?
No, the kitchen is more important.
I will wash the dishes. Is the table clean?
I need to go. Please tidy up the room.
I will do my best. Goodbye.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. The blue paint looks like mud.
That is tricky. Do you want to try mixing in a drop of white?
It still looks wrong. I think I broke it.
It is not broken, just different. What color do you want it to be?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am hungry but I do not know what to pick.
That is hard. Do you like hot food or cold food?
I like both, but I want something sweet.
Sweet is good. Do you like fruit or cake?
I am not sure. What do you think is best?
I do not know your taste, but a pie is a safe pick. Does that sound good?
A pie sounds very good to me.
Great choice. Do you want it warm or cold?
Warm is best. Please order it.
I have done that. I hope you enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do bees have fuzzy bodies?
The fuzz helps them carry pollen. Do you like collecting stickers?
Yes, I do. Why do bugs grow their shells?
They shed old skin to get bigger. I am not sure why all bugs do it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we put sugar in the bread?
Sugar makes it sweet. Do you like sweet bread?
Why is the dough soft?
Water makes the flour stick. Is it sticky to you?
Why does the bread get hot?
The heat bakes it. Do you like warm food?
Why do we use yeast?
I do not know. Do you know the answer?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the tennis ball so bouncy?
It has air inside that pushes back when you hit it. Do you play tennis?
Yes, but why do the players run so much?
They run to get to the ball before it hits the ground. I am not sure why some players yell.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people move to a new home?
They often move for work or to be near friends. Do you have a new job coming up?
I also like the thought of more space.
More space lets you play and relax. Is your current home feeling too small?
Yes, my things are everywhere.
A fresh start can make things feel neat and calm.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the well in the middle of the village?
The well is there so everyone is close to the water. Do you like to swim?
No, I only drink from it. Why are the houses so small?
They are small because the land is small too. Do you have a big house?
My house is big. Why do the trees grow so close together?
The trees grow close to share warmth. Do you like the cold?
I do not like the cold. Why is the path covered in grass?
The grass grows on the path because it is soft. Do you like to walk on it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My computer is very slow today.
That feels bad. Did you try turning it off?
Yes, but it is still slow.
I do not know the fix. Is it making a loud noise?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Help me pack my bag now.
Take your deep breath. Do you need your shoes?
I forgot my water bottle. It is important.
I see it on the chair. Would you like to grab it?
My keys are missing. I have to go!
I do not know where they are. Check your pocket?
The bag is too heavy. Help me close it.
One last check. Did you pack your lunch?
Yes, I got it. Thank you for helping me.
Good luck on your trip.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The sky is very dark and loud outside. What is happening?
A big storm is coming to our house. It brings wind and rain. Do you see the flash of light?
I see the light but I do not know the name of this sound.
That loud noise is called thunder. It happens when the sky gets very angry. Is your heart beating fast?
My heart does beat a bit. Do we need to hide from it?
We do not need to hide because we are safe inside. Just stay near a wall.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just drew a big, red house.
That sounds fun. Do you have any trees?
Yes, I put two green trees next to it.
Nice choice. What color is the door?
The door is blue. It has a gold bell.
A gold bell is a nice touch. Does it ring?
I think it rings when the wind blows.
That is a lovely idea. Is the sky dark or light?
The sky is light and full of stars.
Stars in the day?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the paint dry so fast?
It loses water to the air. Do you use watercolor?
Yes, but it goes on thin.
That is how it should be. You can build up layers.
What if I want it thick?
Then you use oil or acrylic. Do you like thick paint?
I like smooth lines best.
Then keep the water mix right. I do not know your exact brand.
Is blue and red mixed green?
Yes, they make green. Do you want dark green?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the post office close so early?
They need time to sort your mail before night. Do you have a letter to send?
I do not understand the stamps.
Stamps show you paid to send the item. Is your letter heavy?
Why is it closed on Sunday?
Many workers rest on the weekend. Do you like working here?
How long does it take to arrive?
I do not know the exact time. It depends on the distance.
Can I buy a box here?
Yes, we sell boxes for shipping. Are you moving things?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: How do plants drink water? I have to go now.
Their roots pull water up into the leaves. Do you like plants?
Yes, I do. They are cool.
Roots take in water from the soil. That is how they drink.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read a book in bed last night.
That sounds like a cozy start to the evening. Did you fall asleep while reading?
No, I finished the whole story.
You are a very fast reader. What was the story about?
It was about a dog who found a bone.
A classic tale for any dog. Did the dog keep the bone for itself?
Yes, it guarded it all night.
That is a very good plan. Did the dog share any of it with others?
No, it ate it all alone.
That is very sweet, but perhaps a bit lonely. Do you think the dog was happy?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want new shoes. The blue ones look cool.
They are very nice. Do you like blue?
Yes, but I need to run fast for soccer.
These help you run fast. Are they too big?
No, they feel right. How much are they?
I do not know the price. Let me check.
Great. I will go to the counter.
Have fun there. See you soon!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I would like a chicken dinner. Do you have any vegetables with it?
Yes, we have peas or corn. Would you like the peas?
I like peas, but do they cost more?
No, the vegetables are free. Would you like a drink too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My light went out. Why is that?
Maybe the bulb broke. Is the plug in tight?
Yes, it is in. What else?
Check the main switch on the wall. Did you try flipping it off and on?
No, I did not. I am scared of it.
It is safe if your hands are dry. Do you see the little switch?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie a bow on my shoes.
That is a fun skill to learn. Do you have a partner to help you?
No, I am by myself. Can you show me?
I cannot see you, so I cannot show you. But I know the steps to say out loud.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! Look at my fish in the tank.
They look very calm and bright. Are they swimming fast?
Yes, they swim in a nice circle. I feel so good.
That sounds peaceful. Do they like their food?
Yes, they eat it all right away.
That is great to hear.
Thanks for listening to me.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The red ball sticks to the box but the blue one does not. Why is that?
The red ball is made of a metal that likes magnets. Is the blue ball made of plastic?
Yes, it is plastic. Does it have a name?
I do not know the exact name of that plastic. Do you know what the box is made of?
The box is steel. It feels very cold.
Steel is a great metal for magnets to stick to. Do you like when things stick?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I grow tomatoes in this small village?
Start with seeds in the warm soil. Do you have a sunny spot for them?
I have a corner near the house. What else do I need to do?
Water them every morning. Are they thirsty?
They look dry. How big will they get?
They can grow quite tall. Do you like sweet or sour fruit?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a horse.
That is a fun goal. Do you have a friend who rides often?
No, I do not know anyone. How do I start?
You can take a lesson at a local barn.
What should I bring to the first lesson?
Just wear comfortable clothes and closed shoes.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My new baby cries a lot at night. What should I do?
I think he is just tired or hungry. Is he eating well?
He eats fine but still cries. I feel very tired.
Rest helps, but I do not know your exact reason. Do you have help?
Yes, my friend helps. How do I sleep more?
Sleep when the baby sleeps. Is that hard for you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to look both ways before we cross the street?
We do this to keep our body safe from moving cars. Do you like to look left and right?
I am scared of the big wheel on the front.
That big wheel helps us turn the car to where we want to go. Are you brave enough to try today?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I got a job. I cleaned three rooms today.
That is very good work. Did you get to pick the rooms?
Yes. I chose the small ones. I felt tired after.
You worked hard. What did you do with your pay?
I saved half. I want to buy a new bike.
That is a great plan. Which color do you want?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am scared to take my test tomorrow.
That feels bad. Do you want to practice together?
Yes, please can you help me with the hard parts?
We can do that. What topic gives you the most trouble?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My baby cries a lot at night. I do not know why.
That is tiring. Is the baby hungry or cold?
It eats and I check the clothes. It still cries.
Many babies cry to feel close to their mom or dad. Try holding the baby for a bit.
The holding helps, but my arms hurt.
Resting helps too. Did you sleep last night?
No. I am very tired and worried.
You are doing a good job. It takes time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the red lights in the night. It is very bright.
That looks like a big fire. Are you safe?
Yes, I am safe. I just see it from my window.
Good. Do you know why it is burning?
No, I do not know. But it looks like a warm glow.
It can look pretty from far away. I hope it is put out soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have dirty clothes. What do I do?
Put them in the machine. Do you have soap?
I do not know. Should I use the hot button?
Yes, hot is good for very dirty things.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to sing, but my voice is too quiet.
That is okay. Singing is like a muscle. Do you like frogs?
I like frogs. They croak loud.
Good. Try to make that sound with your voice. Did it feel hard?
It felt funny, but my tummy tickled.
That is a good sign. You are learning.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late and need dinner now.
Do you want to make soup? It is fast.
Yes, but I have no bowls.
I can bring some from my house. What kind of soup do you like?
Chicken is good.
I have chicken too. Do you have potatoes?
No, just carrots and rice.
That is fine. Carrots and rice make a nice soup.
Okay, please bring the bowls.
I will be there soon. Tell me if you need anything else.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am in the dark. How do I find my light switch?
Please sit still and touch the wall slowly with your hand. Do you have a flashlight?
No, I do not. What should I do now?
Keep your eyes closed for a few moments so they get used to the dark. Can you see any shapes?
I see something on the wall. How do I turn it on?
Slide your finger up or down the wall to find the small click. Did you feel a button?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can you help me tie my shoes?
Yes, I can help. Do you know the first step?
I just make a knot.
That is a great start. Which foot should we do first?
Let us do the left one.
Perfect. Look at the loop I made.
Why is it shaped like a bunny?
I do not know why. Do you like the shape?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My horse is very tired. What should I do?
Let him rest in a quiet place. Is he eating his hay?
He is eating, but he looks sad. Why?
He may just need your time. Do you talk to him?
I usually just feed him. What else?
Brush his coat to make him feel good. Does he like that?
He likes it a lot. Thank you so much.
You are doing a great job. I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a red flower, but I am late.
I am sorry I do not know which one you mean. Do you like roses?
No, roses are too big. I need something small.
How about a tiny daisy? It is red and small.
No, daisies are yellow. I cannot wait.
I am not sure. Is it a tulip?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Did you promise to help me build my block tower?
Yes, I did. Do you have the red blocks ready?
I am not sure if I kept my promise to share the toy.
Honesty is good. Did your friend feel hurt?
I will go tell the truth now.
That is very brave. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do bugs have bones inside their body?
No, they do not. They have a hard shell on the outside to protect them. Do you have a favorite bug?
What do ants eat?
Ants love sweet things like sugar and honey. They also eat small bugs. Do you like sweet food?
Why do bees make a loud buzzing sound?
They buzz to fly. Their wings move very fast.
Are spiders bugs?
No, they are not. Spiders have eight legs, while bugs have six. Do you like watching spiders work?
I am scared of big bugs.
That is okay. Most big bugs will not hurt you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my sister today. She was in the park.
That sounds nice. What was she doing there?
She was flying a red kite. It went very high.
A red kite is pretty. Did you fly it too?
No, I just watched. My arms got tired from waiting.
Patience is hard. Did you go home?
Yes, we came home. I am hungry now.
That makes sense. Do you want snacks?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is a circle?
It is round like a coin. Do you like round things?
I think so. Is a square a shape too?
Yes, it has four equal sides.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running out of time here.
The boat leaves soon. Do you have your bag?
Yes, but where is the dock?
Go straight down that path.
Is the water cold today?
It is warm and safe.
Good. I must go now.
Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my bus. Where is the stop?
Look to the left, past the big tree. Are you going to work?
Yes, I must go now. The street is very loud and full of cars.
The cars move fast here, so please be careful. Do you like the noise?
No, it is too loud. I just want to sit on the bus and be quiet.
That sounds like a good rest. I hope the bus comes soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is my fish swimming so fast?
He might be playing or looking for food. Is he chasing anything?
No, he is just spinning in circles.
That can mean he is happy or needs clean water. Do you clean the tank often?
I clean it every week.
That is good to keep him healthy. What does he like to eat?
I give him little flakes.
Flakes are a good food choice.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend.
That is a nice plan. Do you know what you want to say?
I want to tell him about my dog.
A dog is a great topic. What is your dog’s name?
His name is Max. He is very big.
Big dogs are usually gentle. Do you have any pictures to send?
I have a picture of him eating a bone.
That will be very fun to see. Write it down now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The city looks so loud today.
It is very busy because so many people are here. Do you like the noise?
I like the cars, but I hate the shouting.
Loud voices can be scary for little ears. I do not know why everyone is shouting today.
Look at that big bus. It is blue.
That is a very nice blue bus. Is it going to stop for you?
I just want to eat some ice cream.
Ice cream sounds very sweet and cold. Do you like chocolate or vanilla?
I love chocolate. Can I go home now?
You can go home if you are tired. I hope you have a sweet treat.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the sky look blue?
The sun has all colors of light. Blue light bounces around in the air more than other colors. Do you see other colors in a rainbow?
Yes, I do. Why only blue up here?
The air lets other colors go straight through. Blue light sticks around to fill the whole sky. It is a pretty mix.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw an old friend at the park today.
That is a nice surprise. How did you feel?
I felt happy but also a bit shy.
I understand that mix. Did you stop to talk?
We just waved and smiled at each other.
A gentle hello is a good start.
I think we will play soon again.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look up! The moon is so bright tonight.
It is a beautiful sight. Do you see how big it looks?
Yes, it feels like it is right there. I feel very happy seeing it.
Joy is a wonderful feeling. What makes you feel this way?
It just makes me feel calm and free. I wanted to tell someone about it.
That is a kind thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, there is a big orange light in the dark! It looks so warm and nice.
That looks like a campfire, yes? Is it safe to look at?
Yes, it is very safe. The fire just sits in a big ring of stones.
Good, that is smart. Who started the fire?
My dad made it with dry sticks. I like watching the little sparks fly up.
Wow, sparks are fun. Do you like the smell of the smoke?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I seem to have lost my way here.
Let me look at the map with you. Are you trying to go home?
Why did the signs change?
The city made new signs last year. Do you see the blue road sign?
I do not understand why we are still here.
We are on the right path now. Does that place look familiar to you?
I am curious why the streets are so wide.
They built them for big trucks. Do you want to keep walking?
Yes, let us go together.
That sounds like a good plan.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the arc of the sky so bright?
The sun shines on rain drops. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I love the colors.
The rain bends the light into colors. Do you have a favorite color?
I like red best.
Red is at the top of the arc. Do you want to see it again?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. My computer will not turn on.
I am sorry. Is the plug in the wall?
Yes, it is. I am so mad.
Do you have a backup laptop?
I think so. I must find my code.
I hope you find it. Do you need help?
No, I am going now. Goodbye.
I wish you luck.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the chocolate cake in the display case?
Yes, it is right there on the left. Do you like chocolate?
I do. Is it fresh from the oven?
I think so, but I am not certain. Would you like to go check?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to walk for my health, but I do not know how to start.
Start with a short walk of ten minutes. Do you like walking outside?
Yes, but my legs hurt if I walk too long.
Take breaks when your body feels tired. Is it okay to slow down?
That helps. How many days a week should I go?
Try three days at first. Do you have a favorite place to walk?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun came up at eight this morning. I was still in bed.
That is a nice way to start the day. Did you eat breakfast soon after?
Yes, I ate toast. The hands on my clock moved.
The hands move to show the time. Do you know which hand moves the fastest?
The small one, I think. It goes around quickly.
Actually, the thin hand is the minute hand. It moves faster than the thick hour hand. Do you like watching them move?
A little. It tells me when to leave work.
That is why clocks are so helpful. They keep us on time. Do you have a favorite time of day?
No, I just like when I can rest. The clock says six.
Six o'clock is a good time to rest. I hope you enjoy your evening.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to build a shed, but I am lost.
That is a big job. Do you have any wood yet?
I have some wood, but no plan.
A plan helps a lot. Where will you put it?
In the yard, near the fence.
I do not know if that spot works. Is the ground flat there?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What did people wear a long time ago?
They wore clothes made from animal skins and plants. Do you like wearing soft clothes?
I do. Did they have lights like us?
No, they used fire in small lamps or torches. I do not know exactly how they kept the fire safe, but they were very careful.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my chest feel warm when I see the sun?
That warm feeling is your body telling you it likes the light. Do you sit in that spot often?
I sit there every morning with my cat.
Your cat probably feels the heat too. Do you talk to the cat while you sit?
Yes, we share the quiet time together.
It is nice to share calm moments.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent the whole day sweeping and dusting every room.
That sounds like hard work. Did you finish all of it?
Yes, the house is very clean now.
Good job. Do you want to rest for a bit?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am lost. I cannot find my house.
Do not worry. I will help you. Which street did you start on?
It is near the big red school.
That helps a lot. Is your house on the sunny side of the school?
Yes, it has a blue door.
I know that place. Turn left and walk to the corner.
Thank you. It feels safe now.
You are welcome. Can you see the blue door yet?
Yes, I see it. I found it.
Great job. You did well. Run home now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My cat is hiding under the bed and will not come out. I am sad.
That sounds scary for him. Does he like the quiet spot?
I do not know why he is hiding. I tried to call him, but he does not answer.
Maybe he is shy right now. Have you tried a small treat?
Yes, I gave him a snack, but he still looks grumpy. I am worried about him.
It is good that you care. Is he eating his food later?
I do not know if he will eat at all. He is just sitting there and looking at me.
Give him some space. He may feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just made my broken chair whole again.
That is great news. Did you use new wood?
Yes, I found a piece in the shed.
That sounds very neat. How tight did you make the screws?
I pulled them hard until the top stopped moving.
Good, that keeps it safe. Are you going to sit in it now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red bus today.
That is nice. Did you ride on it?
No, I just watched it stop.
It must have been busy there.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I move the knight?
The knight jumps in an L shape. Do you like jumping pieces?
I know the other parts, but what does the queen do?
The queen can go any way you like. Is she your favorite piece?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I need a big shed in my yard. What is the first thing to do?
You must pick a flat spot on the ground. Is your yard hard to keep clean?
Yes, grass grows fast there. How do I make the floor strong?
Put down thick wood boards on the dirt. Do you have a saw to cut them?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because the sun is out.
That is a lovely feeling. Do you like the warm sun too?
Yes, I do. The air smells sweet like flowers.
That sounds wonderful. Can you tell me more?
Birds are singing high in the trees.
How nice. I know that spring brings lots of life.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the clock tick?
It is a sound it makes to keep time. Do you like listening to it?
What are those little sticks for?
They point to the numbers to show the time.
Why do they move?
A battery or spring makes them move. Does the clock in your room make noise?
What happens when the battery dies?
The hands stop moving and the time is wrong.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make food that makes me feel strong.
Start with warm bowls of beans and rice. Do you like cooking with your hands?
I love mixing things in a big pot.
Stir in some chopped green leaves for extra power. What kind of leaves do you have?
I have some spinach lying on the counter.
Spinach is a great choice for energy.
Should I add anything else to the pot?
A spoon of oil helps it taste nice.
I think I am ready to start now.
You will do a great job eating well.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need dinner soon. What is the fastest food you know?
Let us make toast. It takes five minutes. Do you have bread?
Yes, I have bread. But I am so tired.
Toast is very easy to make. Put it in the machine and wait.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start a campfire?
Use dry sticks and leaves, then rub them until it sparks. Do you have a lighter?
Yes, I have one.
Great, place the little leaves in the middle and light them. Are your sticks dry?
I hope so.
If they are wet, the fire will smoke a lot. Pick the ones that feel light.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad I got lost on this street.
That is a happy thing to feel. What makes it so fun?
The houses are all different colors here.
I love colors too. Do you know where this street ends?
I think it goes to the big park.
A park is a great place to rest.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a bright red balloon today. It looked so happy.
That sounds lovely. Did it float away?
Yes, it went up to the sky. I watched it for a long time.
Watching something fly is fun. Did you feel calm?
Yes, I felt very calm inside. The sun was warm too.
Warm sun and calm feelings. Did you tell someone?
I told my mom about it. She smiled back at me.
Sharing joy is a great thing. How are you now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent all morning sweeping the floor.
That is a great start. Did you find a lot of dust?
Yes, there was dust everywhere.
I am sorry to hear that.
Then I wiped the tables with a wet cloth.
That makes things look very nice. Do you plan to clean the kitchen next?
I will try to wash the dishes later.
That sounds like hard work.
I am tired, but the house feels fresh.
You did a wonderful job today.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The trip is a mess.
I am sorry to hear that. What happened?
We have no tickets. We have no plans.
That sounds very hard. Do we have money?
Yes, we do. But I do not know where to go.
Let us think together. Do you like the park?
Yes, I do. But it might rain.
We can bring umbrellas. Is that okay?
Yes, that is a good plan.
Good. Let us go pack.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to read, but my eyes are tired. What should I do?
Try a very short book. Do you like happy stories?
I do not know which book to pick. I feel stuck.
Pick the one with the red cover. Is that a good choice for you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the food good there?
Yes, it is very good. Do you like pizza?
I do like pizza. How much is it?
It is ten dollars. Do you have enough money?
I have five dollars. Can I get a small one?
Yes, that works for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a great party last night.
That sounds fun. What games did you play?
We played tag and ate lots of cake.
Yum. Did you have enough cake for everyone?
Yes, there was plenty for all of us.
Good. I am glad you had a good time.
The music was loud and loud.
Loud music helps the fun. Did you dance?
Yes, I danced for a long time.
Great. I am happy you enjoyed it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is very loud outside. I do not know what to do.
I am sorry you feel scared. I do not know if it is safe for you, but are you inside right now?
Yes, I am in my room. Should I close the window?
It is a good idea to close the window to keep you dry. Is the sky dark?
It is very dark. I feel a bit sad.
I am here with you in this chat. Do you want to listen to a story?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up when the big hand hit the twelve.
That means it was noon. Did you see the sun?
Yes, I watched the small hand move to the one.
One o’clock is when the clock face turns. Was your soup still warm?
I ate at two, so the food was cold.
Two o’clock comes after one. Why did you wait so long?
The minute hand kept ticking fast in my head.
Ticking helps us know time passes. Do you like watching it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I wash my socks?
Put them in the bag and wash with cold water. Do they have any holes?
No, they are whole.
Good. Put the bag in the machine. What color are they?
They are white.
Use only white detergent. No dark colors please.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the island green?
The plants grow there. Do you like trees?
Why does the water look blue?
The sky reflects on it. Is it sunny there?
Why is it so quiet?
There are no cars. Do you enjoy the calm?
Why do you know this?
I learned it long ago.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the island round?
The water pushes on all sides. Do you like water?
Yes, I do. Why is the sand so white?
The shells break down into powder. Is the sea clear there?
It looks clear. Why are there so many birds?
I do not know for sure. Do you have a favorite bird?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I dropped my cup. Why did it break?
It broke because it hit the hard floor. Did you hear it?
Why does glass break but rubber does not?
Glass is hard but thin. Rubber is soft and strong. Do you have other cups?
I do not know how to stop the spill.
Use a dry cloth to wipe it up. It is done now.
I am sorry I was clumsy.
It is okay. Mistakes help us learn. Did you like the cup?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to float on the lake. Can you tell me how?
You take a deep breath and lie flat on your back. Do you feel scared of the water?
Yes, a little bit. How do I get under the surface to see the bottom?
You must only hold your breath for a few seconds. Are you ready to try it now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake bread. How do I start?
You mix flour, water, and yeast. Do you have those things?
Yes, I have them. What do I do next?
Stir it well to make a soft dough. Do you know how to mix?
I think so. What comes after mixing?
Let it sit until it gets big. That is called rising.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a home for the birds.
That is a nice idea. Do you have any wood?
I have a small piece of scrap wood.
You can cut a hole in it. Which tree do you like best?
The tall oak tree by the fence.
That spot is high and safe. Do you want help with the hammer?
Yes, please help me hang it up.
We will hang it on the branch. Watch the birds come.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here. But I do not know what to pick.
That is okay. Is there a color you like?
I like red. But I do not see a red one I want.
Tell me what size you need.
I do not know the size.
Let us look at the tag together.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people move houses?
They often move for work or school. Do you like your current home?
That makes sense. Why do we need a truck?
We use a truck to carry heavy things. Are you packing boxes yet?
I have some boxes. Why is it hard?
Moving is hard because things take space. Is it fun or tiring?
It is tiring. Why do we do it?
We do it to start a new life. I do not know your exact reason, but it is big. Do you have any pets?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I read books at night and then my eyes feel tired.
Try a warm lamp near your book. Do you read in bed?
Yes, I read in my bed with the main lights on.
That bright light can hurt your eyes. Do you use a small lamp?
No, I only have big ceiling lights.
Buy a small book lamp with a dim switch. Would you like tips on the light color?
Yes, please tell me about the light color.
Use soft white or yellow light, not blue. Do you plan to buy one soon?
I will buy one tomorrow.
That is a good plan. Good night.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to finish this picture right now.
Take a deep breath. Do you know what the main shape is?
I am not sure. I just want to be done.
That is okay. Start with a simple circle first.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my phone screen dark?
It might be asleep. Do you like to sleep too?
Yes, but I want to see it now.
Try pressing the side button. Was that for you?
It works. Thank you.
You are welcome. Is it bright enough?
Yes, it is perfect.
I am glad it is fixed. Do you want to talk more?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did it! I finally finished the hard book.
That is so great. How did you feel when you read the last page?
I felt very proud and happy. Do you like books too?
Yes, I do. I am glad you found something you enjoy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. The fire is very scary.
I am sorry you feel that way. Are you safe right now?
Yes, I am inside. It makes my eyes water.
That is good you are inside.
The smoke is everywhere. It smells bad.
I do not know exactly what caused it. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I have my phone. I will call for help.
That is the right thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky blue in that movie?
The painters used blue paint to make it look calm. Do you like calm skies?
I do. Why did the hero fall in the last scene?
He slipped on the ice to show how hard the trip was.
That is sad. Why did he keep going?
He had a promise to keep, so hope gave him strength.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to fix a flat tire.
That is a very useful skill. Do you have a spare tire ready?
Yes, I have a spare tire in my backpack.
Great, that makes things easier. Let us look at the valve first.
What is a valve?
It is the small part where air goes in. Is it round or long?
It is long and thin.
That is called a Presta valve. You must unscrew the tiny top.
Okay, I unscrewed the top.
Now use the pump to fill it up. How much do you usually ride?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I forgot which month comes after February.
Do not worry, it is March. Do you like the spring?
Yes, I do, but I still have so many things to do.
Taking small steps can help. What is your biggest task?
I must clean my room, but it is very messy.
You can start with just one corner. Can you do that?
I think I can, thank you for your help.
You are welcome. How does your heart feel now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to play the guitar.
That is a fun goal. Do you have a guitar yet?
Yes, I have one, but the strings hurt my hands.
That is normal at first. It will get easier soon.
How do I make the strings stop hurting?
Calluses will form on your fingers. Do you practice every day?
I only practice sometimes. Is that bad?
Daily practice helps most. Try to play for ten minutes a day.
Ten minutes is not too much. I will try that.
Good for you. Keep going and listen to your favorite songs.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to wait?
Waiting helps us be ready. Are you feeling bored?
I do not want to just sit here.
That feels hard, I know. Do you have a toy?
I do not bring anything.
We can look at the birds instead.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go that way now.
The path is clear ahead. Do you like the sun?
I am running late for work.
Please be careful on the grass.
Can I skip the bridge?
I do not know. Is it safe for you?
I must go now, thank you.
Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very happy because I finished my big book.
That is great news. Did you read it all by yourself?
Yes, I did. How do I tell my mom?
You can just say you are proud. She will be so happy to hear it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I get a pawn to become a queen?
Move it to the last row, then say "queen." Do you like playing white?
I do not know which is white.
White moves first. It always does.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read my favorite book again today.
That is a great thing to do. Do you like the ending?
The story was about a cat who lost a ball.
Cats can be very silly. Was it a blue ball?
The cat found the ball under the bed.
That is a nice surprise. Was the cat happy?
Yes, the cat felt very glad to have it back.
I am glad for the cat too.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished a very long flight. I am so happy to be back.
That sounds like a big trip. Did you sleep well on the plane?
Yes, I slept for many hours. It felt like a dream.
How nice for you.
I am very glad to be home now.
That is great news.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very sad today and I want to learn to cook soup.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have any vegetables to start with?
Yes, I have some carrots and potatoes.
That is a good start. Would you like me to tell you how to cut them safely?
Yes, please, I want to learn that part.
Cut the ends off and then cut the vegetables into small pieces.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a big river today. Can I swim in it?
Only if the water is clear and the adults say yes. Is it safe there?
The water looks clean, but I am not sure about the depth.
Ask a grown-up to check the depth first. You must be safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my favorite cup. I am so sad.
Oh no. Do you have a spare?
No. It was very old.
That is tough. Did you try to fix it?
I tried. It is in pieces.
I am sorry. Do you want to make a new one?
Maybe. I do not know how.
I do not know either. But I can help you learn.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a paper boat.
That is a fun idea. Do you have any paper?
Yes, I have a sheet of newspaper.
Great. Fold it in half down the middle first. Is it a big sheet?
It is pretty large.
Good. Now fold the corners down to meet the top line. Do you see a triangle?
I see it now.
Excellent. Fold the point down to the bottom edge. You have a boat!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am writing a letter to my friend.
That sounds like a nice way to share your day. What did you do first?
I watched a bird sit on my window sill.
A bird on a sill is a lovely start. Did it sing to you?
It did not sing, but it looked at me.
It is good to have a quiet observer. How does the letter look so far?
I wrote about the bird and my tea.
That is a simple and happy beginning.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: What is the sea made of?
It is mostly salty water. Do you like salty things?
Yes, I like soup.
The sea has many fish. Do you like to swim?
I do not know how.
That is okay. I can help you learn later.
Thank you for telling me.
You are welcome. I am glad to help.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to paint my bedroom blue.
That sounds like a lovely color. Do you like blue because of the sky?
Yes, I like the sky and the sea.
Both are very cool places. Do you have a big bucket of paint ready?
Yes, but my hands get very messy.
That is the fun part of making art. Does your parent help you wipe them clean?
My mom helps me wash my hands.
That is a very good helper.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel so hot inside?
Your body is fighting the germs. Are you drinking enough water?
Why do I keep sneezing?
That is your nose cleaning itself. Do you feel a bit better now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so tired of sitting here. My legs hurt a lot.
That is very tiring. Do you like watching the clouds go by?
Yes, they look like big soft pillows. I want to jump on them.
They are not real, but they do look nice. Are you hungry?
I had some crackers. I do not like the dry bread.
I am glad you ate something. Would you like some juice?
Yes please. My head feels very heavy.
I will get that for you. Do you like sleeping on the plane?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big mountain on my walk today.
That sounds fun. What color was the sky?
The sky was very blue and clear.
Nice. Did you take any photos?
I took a few pictures with my phone.
Great idea. Do you want to look at them later?
Yes, I plan to show them to my mom.
She will be happy. Was the walk hard?
It was hard because the road was steep.
You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see the water moving fast, but I am scared to go near.
That is a good feeling to have. Do you see any signs that say it is safe?
No, there are no signs, only rocks and deep water.
I do not know if it is safe for you. Have you asked an adult to check with you?
I will ask them now because you are right.
That is a smart choice. Tell me what you see first.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is it sunny outside?
I cannot see the sky, but I hope it is bright. Do you like sunny days?
The wind is very loud today.
Loud wind can be scary, but it is just air moving. Are you feeling safe in your room?
It looks like rain now.
Rain brings rainbows later, so that is a good thing. Do you want to wear your boots?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a red rose, please. I am late.
Here is your rose. Do you like red?
Yes, thank you. Can I pay fast?
Yes, here is your change.
Goodbye, I must run.
Goodbye, have a good day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to keep old bottle caps. Do you collect things too?
Yes, I love collecting. Do you have a special box for them?
I put them in a shoebox. Why do people like to keep old items?
It is fun to look at memories. Do you remember where your first cap came from?
It was from a grape soda at a park. How do I clean my collection?
Use a wet cloth to wipe them dry. Do you wash them often?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad and angry right now.
I am sorry you feel that way. What happened today?
My friend did not want to play with me.
That must hurt a lot. Do you have other friends who do like to play?
I do not know if I did something wrong.
It is hard to tell without more facts. Did you ask him why?
I just want to go home and hide.
That is a valid choice if you are tired. Take your time and breathe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love peaches, but I am late.
That is a nice fruit. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, but I must go now.
Okay, have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Look at that big puff in the sky. What is it made of?
It is made of tiny water drops. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. Will it make rain soon?
I cannot be sure about rain. Do you have an umbrella with you?
No, I do not. Is it wet inside?
Yes, it is full of water. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My cat slept on my feet all night. It was very cold.
That is a warm and cozy morning. Did you have to wake her up for breakfast?
I had to lift her off. Now she is chasing the dog.
Oh no, a chase is always exciting. Is the dog okay?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do next.
That feels hard. What is the very first step?
I am too scared to try it.
You can start small. Do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
