exchanges: Why do these shoes have laces?
Laces help hold the shoe tight on your foot. Do you like the red ones?
Why are the red ones so shiny?
The shiny part is made of plastic leather. It looks new and clean.
Why does the plastic leather not get wet inside?
That is called waterproof material. It keeps water out of the shoe. Do you have wet socks?
Why do my feet smell?
I do not know the exact reason. But clean socks will help fix it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My dog is barking at the wall. I have to leave now.
That is very noisy. Is he trying to tell you something?
I do not know. He is pulling at his leash.
You can try to walk him slowly. Do you have treats?
Yes. I will try that. Thank you.
Good luck. I hope he calms down.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do about my play.
That feels hard. Do you have a plan yet?
No, I just have the words on paper.
Reading them out loud is a good start. Do they make sense?
Some do, but the middle part is a mess.
Tell me what is confusing in the middle.
I do not know who should speak next.
Let us read it together to find the answer.
Okay, let us try that now.
Great, let us begin with the first line.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my fish have such big eyes?
It helps them see in the water. Do you watch what they eat?
Yes, I do. Why does it not talk to me?
Fish do not have voices to talk with. Do they swim fast or slow?
They swim slow. Why are their tails so floppy?
The tail pushes them forward. Do you like watching them swim?
I do. Why is the water always clear?
You keep it clean for them. Do you feel happy near the tank?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do sailors look at stars?
They use them to find their way. Do you like looking up at the sky?
Yes, I do. Why do they bring maps?
Stars can be hidden by clouds. Maps help them when it is dark.
That makes sense. Why do ships have big horns?
The horn makes a loud sound. It tells other boats where they are. Do you make loud sounds?
Not very. Why do sailors eat salt?
I do not know the exact reason for that. But I know salt keeps food from spoiling.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and saw a big dog.
That sounds fun. Did the dog have a ball?
No, it just chased a squirrel.
Wow, the squirrel must have been fast. What did you do then?
I went home and ate some soup.
Good for you. That sounds nice and warm.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very happy today. Why is that?
I do not know the exact reason. Did something good happen to you?
I do not know. I just feel warm inside.
That is a wonderful feeling. It is okay to not know why.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The moon looks so bright tonight. I am feeling very happy.
That is a lovely feeling. Do you think the moon sees you?
I see a big white circle high up. It makes me smile.
The moon reflects the sun’s light. Do you like the dark sky too?
Yes, I do. It feels calm and quiet here.
Quiet skies are good for rest. I hope you sleep well soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the light turn on?
A switch tells the wire to send power. Do you like bright rooms?
Yes, but why does it get hot?
The wire is small, so it warms up a bit. Is it safe to touch?
No, I do not touch it. Why does the plug fit in the wall?
The shape is built to match the hole. Do you check the plug first?
I look at it sometimes. Why does the house lose power?
I do not know for sure. Do you have a battery pack?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to cut a tomato for a movie scene.
You need a sharp knife and a steady hand. Do you have a cutting board?
Yes, but how do I keep from slipping?
Hold the tomato with your thumb tucked back and down. Is your knife clean?
It is clean. What do I do next?
Slice it in half carefully and slowly. Did that work for you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The leg of my chair is broken. I dropped it this morning. It hurts to sit on now.
That is a sad story. Did you hit your hand when it fell?
No, my hand is fine. The chair is just wobbly. I want to fix it.
A wobbly chair is bad. Do you have tape at home?
I have some thick tape. But it does not feel strong enough. What should I do?
You can try tying it with a strong rope. Do you have a rope?
Yes, I have a red rope. I will tie the leg tight. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. I hope the chair feels solid again.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my red cap. It is nowhere.
Did you look under the chair? I have not seen it.
No. I ran around the room. I am late.
Check the door. Is it cold outside?
Yes. I must go now.
Wait. Do you have your shoes?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what to do.
That is okay. Is the meeting soon?
Yes, it starts in one hour.
Take a deep breath. Do you have the papers ready?
I think I do, but I am scared.
You will do well. Ask for help if you need it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The lights went out and my game stopped working. This is so annoying.
That is very frustrating. Do you have a flashlight nearby?
Yes, I found one, but it feels weird to sit in the dark like this.
It does take some getting used to. Is your phone still charged?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I promised to plant a seed today, but I forgot.
That sounds like a hard morning. Did you tell anyone about the seed?
No, I felt too shy to speak up.
I am sorry you feel that way.
I finally planted it just now.
That is a good fix. Do you like gardening?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing like you.
That is a great goal. Do you like to sing in the shower?
Yes, I always sing in the bath.
Bath singing is a fun start. Can you tell me your favorite song?
I like the one with the penguins.
I do not know that specific tune. Do you hum the melody for me?
It goes down, then up, then down.
That sounds like a nice pattern. Try to breathe in slowly before you start.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big cloud.
It looks like a sheep. Do you like sheep?
Yes, but the wind is strong.
That is true. The wind moves it. Where is it going?
I do not know. I feel sad.
I am sorry you feel sad. Do you want to sit down?
Maybe, but my legs hurt.
Your legs are tired. Is the pain sharp or dull?
It is dull. What should I do?
Rest your legs.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Do I need to say please?
Yes, always say please. Are you going to school?
I will just rush in. Do I need to knock?
It is kind to knock. Is it a new door?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Oh no, the lights just went out. I am so frustrated.
That is really annoying. Did it happen all at once?
Yes, it just stopped. Now I cannot see anything.
I am sorry about that. Do you have a candle?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I am lost. Why did this happen?
The path was very small. Are you near a big tree?
Why does the path look so small?
I do not know. Are you holding a map?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I can not sleep. What should I do?
Try to take slow breaths. Do you feel calm now?
My mind is still busy. It will not stop.
That is hard to fix. What is on your mind?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel bad. Can you show me how to say sorry?
Yes, just look in their eyes and say the words. Do you know who you hurt?
I broke my sister’s cup. I am very sad.
That is a kind thing to admit. Did you try to clean up the glass?
Yes, I used a mop. Now I will tell her.
That is a very true and brave step. Go on and do it now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do people in that little village all know each other?
Yes, everyone waves hello to their neighbors every day. Do you have a favorite neighbor?
What is the most fun thing to do there?
We like to walk on the big grassy hill behind the church. Is your favorite place quiet or loud?
Are there any scary monsters hiding in the woods?
No, there are only gentle deer and small birds. Do you think we should say hello to the deer?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I met a new friend today. I do not know what to do.
That is good news. What did you do?
We just sat and looked at the ground. It felt strange.
Silence is okay too. Do you like them?
I think so, but I am not sure. Should I worry?
Do not worry yet. Give it time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I made a cake, but it looks bad.
Did you bake it by yourself?
Yes, and I am sad it is not pretty.
That is normal. Is the taste good?
It tastes sweet, but I feel foolish.
You should be proud of your try.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a bag of seeds, but I do not know what to do with them.
Put the seeds in warm dirt and give them water. Do you have a sunny spot to place the dirt?
I do not know where to put the dirt.
Look for a place that gets lots of sun. Do you know how much sun your window gets?
I think my window has some sun.
That is a good start.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make the plant grow tall?
Give it light and water. Do you have a sunny spot in your room?
Yes, but my pot is too small.
You can move it to a bigger pot.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to feed my horse.
Do you have a bucket? Just pour some oats into it.
I have a bucket, but I am still scared.
That is okay. Does he like apples?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am collecting shiny rocks in the garden.
That sounds fun! Do you have any big ones?
Yes, this one is like a giant egg.
Wow, that is cool. Why do you like rocks?
Because they are smooth and cold.
I understand. Do you keep them in a box?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I like to draw cats.
Cats are fun to draw. Do you draw them happy?
Yes, they look happy. Why do lines make shapes?
Lines hold the shape in place. Do you use colors?
I use lots of colors. Why is red red?
I do not know the deep answer. Do you like red?
I like blue better. Why is blue cold?
Blue makes us think of ice. Do you like ice?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate Mondays. They feel so long and hard.
I understand. Do you have a lot of work to do?
Yes, and I cannot wait for the weekend.
That sounds tough. Do you like weekends?
I do, but I always forget the days.
That happens to many people. Do you use a calendar?
No, I just guess, and I am wrong.
A small planner might help. Do you want me to write them down for you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does this song make me feel sad?
Music can share feelings without words. Do you like other sad songs?
I think so, but I am not sure why.
Your heart may just connect with the tone. What part makes you cry?
The end, when the voice stops.
Silence can be very powerful and quiet. Do you dance when you listen?
No, I just sit still and stare.
Sitting still is a fine way to listen. What color does the song look like?
I think it looks blue and deep.
Blue is often a calm and cool color. Does it make you want to sleep?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I won the big card game! I am so glad.
That is a great win. Did you use your lucky cards?
Yes, I had all the kings. Do you want to play?
I love to play. What kind of game is it?
We just match pairs. It is very fun.
Sounds like a nice game.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Can you keep my secret?
Yes, I will keep it safe. Is it for someone you love?
I forgot to wrap it. Is this too fast?
It is okay. Take a deep breath. Do you have the bag?
It is all in the bag. Thank you for helping.
You are welcome. Have a good day. See you soon?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Hi. My new friend gave me a red apple today. It looked sweet and shiny.
That sounds very nice. Did you share it with him?
Yes, we cut it in half and ate it together on the bench.
I am glad you enjoyed that moment. Do you plan to see him again soon?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very happy inside.
That is great. What made you feel this way?
I built a big tower with blocks.
That sounds fun. Did you finish it all alone?
Yes, I did not fall over once.
Wow, that is hard work. Are you proud of your focus?
Yes, I think I am proud.
Good for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new town that feels like home.
That is wonderful news. What is the best part of it?
The people smile at everyone who walks by.
A kind town is a rare joy. Do you plan to move there?
Yes, I will move my whole life there soon.
That is a big and happy step. What will you miss the most?
I will only miss my old bed for now.
A good bed is hard to replace. I hope you find a cozy one.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to help my friend, but I do not know how.
That is very sweet of you. What does your friend like to do?
He likes to draw pictures.
You can bring him some colored pencils.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the snow white?
Ice and water mix to make snow. Do you like cold weather?
Why do we put lights on trees?
Bright colors help us see at night. I do not know why we started this long ago. Do you like bright lights?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I wore my big shoes to work today.
That sounds important. How did you feel walking in them?
I felt quite tall, but my feet hurt a little.
Oh dear. Did you get a snack to make it better?
Yes, I ate a warm cookie with jam.
That is a nice treat. Did you finish the whole cookie?
Yes, every last crumb.
I am glad you enjoyed it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My boss is very kind to me. What should I do?
That is good news. Do you feel happy at work?
I am not sure how to say thanks.
You can just say it to their face. Do they smile a lot?
I want to give them a small gift.
I do not know what they like. A card is a safe start.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am so lost about where to put my tent.
Do you want to sleep near the fire? Pick a flat spot that is dry.
I do not know if I have enough food.
I am not sure what you packed. Have you checked your bag?
I feel too cold to set up the shelter.
Wrap up in your warm coat. Are you eating enough to stay warm?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a big red balloon today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What color is it?
It is bright red and very big.
I am glad you are happy. Do you have a friend with you?
Yes, my sister is holding the string.
Friends make things better. I love that.
She said she is so happy right now.
Happiness shares well. Where are you going?
We are walking to the park to fly it.
I hope the wind is kind today.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so worried about my big test tomorrow.
That feels scary. What is the one thing that worries you most?
I do not know all the answers yet and I am late for lunch.
You can take a small step now. Do you have five minutes?
No, I have to run, but thank you.
I hope you do well.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike. Do you know how to do it?
Yes, I do know. Do you have a helmet?
Yes, I do have one. Can you show me what to do first?
First, you sit on the seat and push the pedals. Do you want to try now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The baby is crying all night. I am tired. What should I do?
Give the baby a warm hug. Is the baby wet?
No, the diaper is dry. I just feel lost.
Take a deep breath. It gets easier soon. Do you have a friend to help?
Yes, my mom is coming soon. Thank you.
That is good news. Rest well now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to see a wild tiger. How do I do that safely?
Go to a safe place like a zoo. Do you like big cats?
Yes, I love tigers. What if I see one in the wild by accident?
Stay very still and back away slowly. Do you know how to stay calm?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My little goldfish looks so sad and still.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you change the water recently?
I did, but now it is not eating its food.
That can be stressful for a fish. Do you see any bubbles near its mouth?
Yes, there are many, and I am worried it will not be okay.
I do not know the exact cause, but clean water helps. Please be patient with it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel so good today.
That is wonderful. What made you smile?
My puppy ran to me.
That sounds very sweet. Do you play with your puppy often?
I played with my toy cars.
Cars are fun to drive. I do not know what your favorite car is, but I hope it was a good ride.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a warm loaf of bread and want to share it with you.
That smells so good! Do you add butter to your bread?
Yes, I put on lots of sweet butter.
That sounds very tasty.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need to pass the big test.
That sounds important. What kind of test is it?
It is about how to ride a bike.
Ah, balance is key. Do you have a safety helmet?
Yes, I have one. I am just afraid of falling.
Falling is part of learning. Do you want a tip to stay steady?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie a shoelace. Can you help me?
I love tying laces. Do you like solving puzzles?
Yes, they are fun. How do I start?
Make a loop with one end. It feels like a little ear.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the fence brown?
It is brown because the paint is old. Do you like to paint things?
I want to paint it red.
That sounds like fun. What colors do you like best?
I like red and blue.
Those are nice colors. I do not know how to mix them.
I can help you.
That is very kind of you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have so much homework?
It helps your brain practice new skills. Do you like reading?
I like reading, but I hate writing.
That is okay. Most people find writing hard. Is it the spelling?
Yes, I always misspell words.
Spelling takes time to learn. You are getting better each day.
Do you think I will get good at it?
I believe you will get very good. It is true for everyone.
That feels good to hear.
I am glad it helps. Happy studying.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck on my math page.
What is the hard part?
The numbers do not make sense to me.
Let us look at it together. Can you read the first line?
It looks too long and scary.
It is just a simple word problem. Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I dreamed my teeth fell out. Why does that happen?
I am not sure, but stress can cause it. Did you have a hard day?
I think so. Why did I feel so scared?
Dreams can be scary because your brain is awake. Did you wake up suddenly?
Yes, I was very afraid. Why do we dream at all?
Your mind uses sleep to sort through your day. Do you think that helps?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad today.
That sounds hard. What made you feel that way?
I lost my favorite toy.
I am sorry about that. Do you remember where you left it?
I do not know.
We can look for it. Are you willing to try?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does singing make my voice feel so good?
It shakes the air in your chest to help you breathe. Do you like the sound of your own voice?
I think I do, but it feels hard to start.
It is hard at first, but your body will learn soon. Do you want to try a simple note now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to fix my bike today. It made a loud pop sound.
Oh no, did you get hurt?
No, but the wheel is bent now. It wobbles a lot.
That sounds scary. Do you know how to fix it?
I asked my dad for help. He is outside now.
I am glad you have help. Is he good with tools?
Yes, he has a big wrench. He is very strong.
That is great. I bet he will fix it soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so tired and in a rush. How do I sleep fast?
Try to make your room very dark and quiet. Do you like a warm drink at night?
Yes, but I only have two minutes.
A warm cup of milk helps many people relax. I do not know if it works for everyone.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn a magic trick. What is the secret?
The secret is practice. Do you have your cards ready?
Yes, I have them in my hand.
Great. Just hide the top card behind your thumb. It is very simple.
That is cool. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. I am glad to help.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My brother took my favorite toy. I am so mad.
That is not fair at all. Did you try to talk to him?
Yes, but he just laughed at me.
That is really mean of him. How did that make you feel?
It made me cry. I want the toy back now.
I am sorry you are sad. We will ask a grown-up to help.
Okay, I guess I am less mad now.
That is good. Being kind works sometimes.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I make my bike go faster?
Pedal harder and sit tall. Do you wear a helmet?
Yes, I always wear it.
That is very safe. What size is your bike?
It is a small red one.
Nice choice. The wind pushes you from behind. Is the road flat?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my party.
That is exciting. Do you have a cake?
Yes, I just made it.
Good. Is it sweet?
Yes, it is very sweet.
I hope you like it.
I must run now.
Happy birthday. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is my friend Sam?
I do not know. Did you call him?
No, I forgot. Can you help me?
Yes, I can try. Is he at the park?
Maybe. I need to go now.
I hope you find him. Good luck.
Thanks. I must run.
Be careful. Bye.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I move the boat forward?
You push the lever up. Do you have a map of the lake?
No, I do not have one. Is that okay?
Yes, look at the water for signs. Are you holding the wheel tight?
I am holding it tight. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome. Be safe out there.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read my favorite book about a dragon today. It was very fun to hold the pages.
That sounds like a great way to spend the day. Did the dragon do anything surprising in the end?
I also ate some warm soup while reading. It made the story feel cozy and safe.
Reading with soup is a nice habit. What is the title of the book?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the baby cry so much?
They are hungry or tired. Do you like giving them a bottle?
Why does the baby have soft skin?
It is very new and not hard yet. Is it soft like a peach?
Why does the baby sleep all day?
They grow fast and need rest. I do not know if they dream.
Why does the baby smile at me?
They like your kind face. Do you smile back at them?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to shuffle the cards.
Hold the deck in one hand and split it into two halves. Do you have a flat table to do this on?
Yes, I have a table right here.
Good, place the two halves together and push them into each other. Watch how they weave together nicely.
The cards are sticking together and making a mess.
That is normal at first. Do you have a deck with a shiny finish?
Yes, these cards are very shiny.
Shiny cards slide easier. Just start slow and be gentle with your hands.
It looks like a zipper now. I think I am doing it.
Well done, you are getting the hang of it. Would you like to try some tricks next?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired of waiting. I want it now.
I hear you. It is hard to wait. Do you know why it takes time?
I do not know. I just feel sad and mad.
That is okay. Feelings are real. Is there something else you can do?
I guess I could draw a picture.
That sounds like a good plan. Would you like me to sit with you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the bus stop so often?
It stops so people can get on and off. Do you like riding the bus?
Yes, I do. Why is the driver looking in the mirrors?
He checks the mirrors to see if anyone is behind him. Is it fun to look out the window?
It is fun. Why are the seats hard?
They are hard so many people can sit on them. Do you have a comfortable spot?
Yes, by the window. Why is the bus moving in a wavy line?
He drives that way to avoid bumps in the road. Is the ride too bumpy for you?
No, it is fine. Why does the bus slow down here?
We are getting close to the stop. Thank you for asking me.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I made a promise to the park gatekeeper to return the lost glove by noon.
That is a good promise to keep. Did you find the glove?
Yes, I found it under a bench near the swings.
You are very kind. How did the gatekeeper feel?
She smiled and gave me a small apple.
What a nice reward. Was the apple sweet?
It was very sweet and crunchy.
That sounds tasty. I am glad you kept your word.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took my little green plant outside today and gave it some water.
That is a nice thing to do for your plant. Did it look happy after you watered it?
Yes, it stood up a bit taller. I wondered how the water got from the pot to the top leaves.
The roots take in the water and send it up thin tubes inside the stem. Do you know what we call those little tubes?
I do not know their name, but I guess they work like tiny straws.
You are right, they act just like straws. It is a cool way for the plant to drink.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water so blue?
The sky reflects on it. Do you like boats?
Yes. Why do the ships stop here?
They come to load goods.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I tried to fix the toy and broke it. I do not know what to do now.
That feels very hard. Do you still have the pieces?
Yes, the pieces are on the floor. I feel so sad and stuck.
Take a deep breath. Can we look at one piece together?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the river always move?
It moves because the water wants to reach the sea. Do you like watching it go?
Yes, I do. But why is it sometimes cloudy?
It gets cloudy when it is raining. Do you like the rain?
Not very much. Why does it smell like dirt after it rains?
That is the smell of wet soil on the land. I do not know why the soil smells that way.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made pancakes this morning!
That sounds delicious. Did you add syrup?
Yes, I did.
I am glad you enjoyed your food.
I feel so happy right now.
Your joy makes me smile too.
Thank you for listening.
I am always here to help.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you know where the big red book is?
It might be on the top shelf. Do you like red books?
Yes, it has a dragon on it.
That sounds fun. I am not sure if it is there, but you can look.
I will go look now.
Please be careful walking. Do you want to sit down first?
No, I will go.
Good luck. I will be here if you need help.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I learn to sing well?
Start by humming along to songs you like. Do you have a favorite song?
I hum, but my voice feels tight and small.
Try breathing from your belly, not your chest. Have you tried standing up?
I stood up, but I still feel shy to make noise.
Singing in a safe place is a great start. Do you have a quiet room?
Yes, my bedroom is very quiet.
That is a perfect spot to practice. Pick a song and just enjoy the sound.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The cow is very sad and will not eat her hay today.
That is hard to see. Is she tired or sick?
I do not know. I just want her to be happy again.
Give her a gentle rub and some quiet time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoelaces.
That is a great skill to learn. Do you have a favorite pair of shoes for this?
I make a bow, but it always falls apart.
You need to make a tight knot first. Do you know how to make a big circle?
I do not know how to make the final part.
I am not sure which step is hard for you. Can you show me your hands?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to build a shed right now. Where do I start?
First, you must lay a flat ground. Do you have a level handy?
No, I only have a hammer and bricks. Can I just start stacking them?
No, you will need to dig a small hole for the posts. Is your ground soft dirt?
Yes, it is just dirt. I am going to dig and build. Thank you.
Be careful with your back. Have a safe build.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to leave right now. The house is a mess.
I can help you quickly. What do you need done first?
The dust on the shelves. Just wipe it down.
I will clear the shelves for you. Do you want me to pick up the toys on the floor?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to walk to stay strong, but I am not sure how to start.
Start with a short walk near your home. Do you like being outside?
Yes, I like the fresh air, but my legs feel tired soon.
That is normal at first. Take breaks if you need to rest. What is your favorite place to walk?
I like the park, but I do not know how many steps are good.
I do not know the perfect number for you, but aim for a steady pace. Do you walk with a friend?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do horses have long tails?
They use them to keep flies away. Do you like watching them swing?
Why do they have big hooves?
The wide shape helps them stand on soft ground. Is your favorite horse big or small?
Why do they eat hay?
Hay is like their main food, kind of like bread for them. I do not know why they prefer it over grass.
Why do they run so fast?
Running fast helps them escape danger. Do you think they run for fun too?
Why are they so gentle?
They are trained to be calm with people. Do you like how soft their hair feels?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so sad today. I do not know what to do.
I am sorry you feel that way. What makes you feel down?
I just lost my favorite toy. It is gone.
That sounds very hard. Do you want to talk about the toy?
I do not know why it matters so much. I am just angry.
It is okay to be angry when you lose a thing. Have you tried to breathe slow?
Yes, I tried. It still hurts inside. I feel empty.
Pain can take time to fade. Would you like to read a book?
Maybe. I just want to feel better soon.
You will feel better in time. Do you want me to sit with you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to plant beans right now.
Beans like sun and warm soil. Do you have a sunny spot?
Yes, by the fence. How do I start?
Dig a small hole and drop the seed in. Is your soil dry?
It looks dry. What do I do?
Water it well before you cover it. Do you have a watering can?
I have a cup. Is that fine?
A cup works great for small plants. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today! I want to share this joy with everyone I meet.
That is wonderful. How do you usually start a day?
I smile at people and say hello. It makes me feel even better.
A simple smile goes a long way. Do you also say thank you?
Yes, I always say thank you to friends and family. I think kindness is key.
You are right that kindness matters. What else do you do?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see the boats, but I do not know where to go. Is the harbour open?
Yes, the harbour is open now. Do you like small boats or big ships?
I love small boats. Can I get close to the water?
You can walk right to the edge. Be careful not to fall in.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up to bright sun today and my dog barked to say hello.
That is a lovely start to your day. Did the sun feel warm on your face?
Yes, it was very warm, and I ate a big bowl of hot cereal with berries.
It sounds like you had a sweet and happy morning. What did you do next?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a magnet stick to my fridge?
Just press it flat against the metal door. Do you have a strong magnet?
Yes, I have a big one, but it is very slippery.
You can put a tiny piece of paper on the back. Do you want to test it now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a box under my bed.
That is exciting. What is inside?
It has a red card in it.
Is there a picture on the card?
Yes, it shows a cake.
I do not know who sent it.
I guess I will open it now.
That sounds like fun.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to buy roses right now, but I have no time.
Roses take time to pick out. Do you like red ones best?
No, I want yellow ones. Just make it quick.
Yellow roses say "hey, I care." Are you happy for them?
Yes, yes. Hand me a bunch.
Here you go. Do you have a bag for them?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see the hands on the clock, but I do not know how to tell the time. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help. Do you know how to count by five?
Yes, I can count by five. How do I use that to tell the time?
Just count by five on the big hand. It tells you the minutes past the hour.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the party on Saturday?
I picked that day so you could come. Do you like Saturdays?
Why did you invite so many people?
I wanted you to meet my friends. Are you nervous?
Why is the music so loud?
I do not know why it is loud. Do you hear it?
Why are we doing this at all?
I am here because I care about you. Do you want to leave?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad after eating junk food.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you feel full or sick?
My stomach hurts and I feel heavy.
Try drinking some water and resting. Have you eaten any fruit today?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to ride my bike, but I am afraid of falling.
That is okay, fear is normal. Do you have your helmet on?
Yes, I have it on, but the wheels spin too fast.
Slowing down is the key. Have you tried your brakes?
I pulled them, but my hands feel weak.
Practice on a flat spot. How does the seat feel?
It feels too high, so I cannot touch the ground.
Let us lower the seat for you. Do you feel more ready now?
Yes, I think I can do it now.
Great job, I am proud of you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My head hurts a lot today. I fell off the bike.
Oh no. Do you have a bandage on?
Yes, I have ice on it now. I feel cold.
That is good. Are you drinking water?
Yes, I am drinking some juice. It tastes sweet.
That helps. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does walking make me feel good?
It helps your heart work better and makes you feel calm. Do you like going outside?
I do. Does it help my brain too?
Yes, it helps your brain think clear. Do you walk with a friend?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and saw a big dog.
That sounds fun. Did the dog bark at you?
No, it just sat down and waited.
That is very calm. What did you do next?
I gave it a treat from my pocket.
You are very kind. I am happy you shared.
Then I went home and felt good.
That is a great way to end a day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to start a new hobby, but I do not know what to pick.
Maybe you could try drawing or gardening. Do you like staying inside or outside?
I like both, but I am still not sure which one is fun for me.
You can just try both for a week to see what you enjoy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I failed my driving test and I feel like a fool.
That is a hard day, but you are not a fool. What part was hardest for you?
The parking spot. I cut the line and the instructor yelled at me.
That makes sense to feel bad about. Did you try again right away?
No, I drove home with my head down.
Taking time to rest is okay. Do you want to book another lesson?
Yes, but I am still nervous.
Nervous is normal. We can practice in a quiet place first.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad because no one wants to play with me.
I am sorry to hear that. What games do you like to play?
I like to build tall towers with blocks, but I am always alone.
Building towers is a great way to have fun. Do you have a favorite animal?
Yes, I have a cat named Whiskers who sits with me.
A friend who listens is a good thing. Would you like to tell me about Whiskers?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a square and a circle. How can I make a triangle?
You can cut the square into two pieces and put them together differently. Do you have a ruler?
I do, but I am not sure how to cut it.
Cut from one corner to the middle of the opposite side. That makes two right triangles.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found an old bottle on the path today. It was full of sand and a tiny stone.
That is a special find. Did you open it to look inside?
I tried, but the cap was stuck tight. I kept it in my pocket for safekeeping.
It is smart to keep safe things close. Is the stone smooth or rough?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do here.
That is okay. Do you like quiet places?
I think I do, but I feel lost.
Not sure what to pick. Do you want to sit or walk?
I want to see the houses.
Go that way. Do you like red roofs?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am running very late for my job. I feel very bad and my heart beats fast.
Take a slow breath. Do you know how much time is left?
I only have five minutes. I do not know what to do.
Do not worry. Just drive safe and tell your boss the truth.
I am too shy to talk to my boss. Please help me.
Honesty is always best. Do you have a phone with you?
Yes, I have my phone. What should I say?
Say you are late and sorry. Would you like me to help you write it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to talk about months.
That is great. Do you like winter?
Yes, I like the snow in December.
Snow is fun. Do you jump in it?
I build big snowmen in January.
That sounds warm. What do you do in February?
I share my joy with everyone.
Sharing makes people smile.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My test was hard. I did not feel happy.
That is okay to feel sad. Did you try your best?
Yes, I tried hard, but I am scared of the grade.
Your work matters most to me. Tell me, was one part fun?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am reading a story about a hungry bear.
That sounds like fun. What does the bear eat?
He tries to eat bees but gets stung.
Oh no, that must hurt. Do you like the bear?
Yes, he is silly but I care for him.
That is nice of you. Is the book happy at the end?
Yes, he finds honey and makes a friend.
What a sweet ending. Do you want another story?
Yes, please. Tell me about a kind dog.
I do not know that book. Do you like dogs?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is a good way to say thank you?
You can use your words and look at the person. Do you always say it when someone helps you?
Sometimes I forget. Is looking at them enough?
No, words are best, but eye contact shows care. Do you practice saying it out loud?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my phone making a beep?
It might be a message for you. Are you checking your email?
I did not send a note. What else can it be?
It could be a low battery alert. Do you see a red battery icon?
I see a red bar. Why does it turn red?
It means the power is almost gone. Do you have a charger nearby?
I need to find my charger. Thank you.
You are welcome. Please plug it in soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am lost and I do not know which way to go. Is this the right path to the park?
I am not sure if that is the right path, but the park is usually near the big trees. Do you see any tall trees nearby?
I see a few trees, but I still feel very confused. Can you tell me if I should turn left or right?
I do not know exactly where you stand, so I cannot say for sure. Is there a sign or a building close to you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to clean my fish tank.
You should use a special net to pull out old leaves. Do you have a net?
Yes, I have a blue one. How do I do the water part?
Change half the water with warm water that has no soap. Is your water cold?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I caught nothing all day.
That feels really bad, I know. Did you try a different spot?
Yes, I moved twice. But the fish just swim away.
Fish can be shy sometimes. What kind of bait did you use?
I used worms. My dad said they work best.
Worms are a good choice. I do not know why they ignored them.
Maybe they just do not want to be caught today.
That is a smart way to look at it. You must be tired from waiting.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My nose runs a lot and I feel tired. Do I have a cold?
It sounds like a cold. Are you drinking water?
Yes, I am drinking lots of water. What else can I do?
Please rest and eat warm soup. Do you have a fever?
No, I do not have a fever. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people sing?
Singing feels good. It helps us share big feelings. Do you like loud sounds?
Yes, I do. Why does my voice sound small?
You need to breathe deep. Your body makes the sound. Do you hum for fun?
Sometimes. Why does singing make me happy?
Happy songs help your mind rest. It is like a warm hug. Do you sing in the car?
Yes, I do. Why do birds sing too?
Birds sing to find a mate. It is their job. Do you know any songs?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to keep my toys in one big box.
That sounds fun. Do you have a box big enough?
No, the box is too small for all of them.
Maybe you can use two boxes. Which toys go in first?
I want to put the cars in first.
Cars are great. Do you want to sort them by color?
Yes, blue cars in one pile and red in another.
That is a good plan. Are you done with the cars?
Almost. Can I add the dolls next?
Sure, dolls can wait. Do you have a box for soft things?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my fern looks sick.
I am sorry it feels that way. Do you think it needs a drink?
I do not know. How do plants actually drink?
They pull water up from their roots. Do you see brown leaves?
Yes, some are brown. Does the water just float up?
The water climbs up tiny tubes in the stem. Is the dirt dry?
It is very dry. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Give it water and see if it wakes up.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It was nine o'clock when I woke up.
That is a good time to start the day. Did you have breakfast?
Yes, I ate toast and fruit at ten.
Yum. What did you do next?
I walked to the park at noon.
The sun is bright at noon. Did you see any birds?
I came home at four and felt tired.
Tired is normal after a busy day. Good night.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It is so hot outside today.
That sounds very warm. Do you like the sun?
I went to the pool this morning.
That must be very fun. Did you swim for a long time?
I drank a lot of cold water.
That is a good idea to stay cool.
Now I am just resting in the shade.
The shade feels nice and cool. Are you tired?
Yes, I am very sleepy now.
Sweet dreams.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I packed all my books today. It was hard work, but I feel good now.
That is a great step. Did you choose a box for your favorite book?
Yes, I put it in the blue one. I hope the movers will be careful with it.
I hope so too. Are you excited to start a new chapter?
I am a bit scared, but mostly excited. The new house has a big garden.
A garden sounds lovely. Do you plan to plant flowers there?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is that big white building by the sea?
It is called a lighthouse. Do you see the light on top?
Why is the light so bright?
It shines to help boats find their way home. Do you like bright lights?
Does someone live in there?
Yes, a keeper lives there to watch the sea. Do you think they get bored?
Can I go inside and see it?
I do not know for sure, but you can ask a grown-up. Would you like to ask your mom?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. My teacher gave me a big hug.
That sounds very sweet. Did she give you a hug because you did well?
Yes, I got a good grade on my test. I worked very hard for it.
You should feel proud of yourself. Was the test easy for you?
Not really, it was a bit hard. But I kept trying until I got it right.
That shows you have a strong spirit. Do you like taking hard tests?
I guess I do when I know I can do it. My teacher says I am brave.
Your teacher sees your effort clearly. What do you like to do in her class?
I like when we read books together. I love the stories about dragons.
Dragon stories are fun to imagine. Do you have a favorite dragon book?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My chair leg is wobbly again. I tried to fix it with a shoe, but it fell off.
That is a tricky spot. Did you check if the screw is loose?
Yes, I tightened it, but it still tilts. It is the one I sit in every day.
Maybe a little sandpaper can help it grip. Do you have any rough paper?
I do have some. I will try that after dinner. Thanks for the idea.
Good luck with your fix. I hope it sits steady for you tonight.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate this picture. It looks bad.
That is okay. Mistakes help you learn. Do you want to start over?
No, I just want it to look nice. I am tired.
Tired hands make tricky lines. Take a deep breath. How is your back feeling?
My back hurts from sitting here.
That can make drawing hard. I do not know the best fix. Would a small break help?
Maybe, but I might fail again.
Failing is just part of trying. You are doing fine. What color do you like best?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to draw a cat today, but its ears look too big.
That is a fun problem. Did you try making the head smaller?
No, I just kept erasing it until the paper got thin.
Oh no, that sounds messy. Do you have a blank sheet nearby?
Yes, I have a whole pad of fresh paper right here.
Great. Start with a circle for the face. How is your pencil feeling?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The fence is broken and I am so mad.
That is very unfair. What did you use to fix it?
I tried to nail it, but the wood is wet.
Wet wood is hard to work with. Did you wait for it to dry?
No, I just wanted it done now.
You will do better when it is dry. Do you have any extra nails?
Yes, I have a whole box of them.
Good. Let us try again once it is dry.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do mountains look so tall?
They are very high up. Do you like to look up?
Yes, I do. What is on the very top?
Often it is snow. It is cold up there.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to grow tomatoes in my yard.
That is a great idea. Do you have enough sun?
Yes, my yard gets lots of sun.
Perfect. Put the seed in the dirt with a little water.
How much water do I need to give it?
Just enough to make the dirt damp. Do you have a small watering can?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I made a new friend today at the park.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What games did you play?
We played tag and ate cookies.
I am happy for you. Do you want to play with them again?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the water warm today?
Yes, the sun made the water feel nice. Do you like cold swims?
I like warm water better.
Warm water feels very cozy. Do you bring a towel?
Yes, I have a big red one.
A big red towel is great for drying off. Do you plan to swim deep?
No, I just want to float.
Floating is the best way to rest. Have fun out there.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I say thank you?
You can smile and say it out loud. Do you say it to your parents?
I forget to say it often.
It is good to try again. Do you use magic words?
What are the magic words?
Please and thank you. Do you like to be nice?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I like to ride bikes, but I am late.
That is a fun way to move. Is it a small bike?
Yes, it is my red bike.
Red is a nice color. Do you ride every day?
I usually ride, but I must go now.
Have a safe trip. Be careful on the road.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired, but my book is still long.
That sounds hard. What is your favorite part?
I just want to sleep now. My eyes hurt.
Rest is important. Can you put the book away?
I do not want to stop this story.
I agree, stories are fun. Do you have a night light?
Yes, but I am still mad about being sleepy.
It is okay to be mad. Sleep first, read later?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I did a hard task and feel very happy. What is this feeling?
That is called pride. It is a good thing. Do you like how it feels?
Yes, it makes me feel strong. How can I keep this feeling?
Just smile and rest. You earned it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very happy today. Why is that?
Maybe your heart just feels light and warm. Did something good happen?
Yes, a bird sang outside my window. Why does that make me feel good?
Beautiful sounds can calm our minds. Do you hear many songs here?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad and alone. I do not have friends to talk to.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like reading books?
I like books, but I still feel empty inside. What can I do?
Try joining a group that likes books. Are you brave enough to say hello?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know how bread gets big and fluffy, fast.
Yeast eats sugar and makes gas. Do you use warm water?
Yes, but it is not getting big. What is wrong?
The yeast may be dead or too cold. Is your kitchen warm?
It is cold here. How do I fix this now?
Put the dough near a lamp or heater. Do you have a towel?
I do. Will that save my bread?
Yes, cover it and wait. Trust the process.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the light turn on?
A switch opens the path for the power. Do you like bright lights?
How does the power get here?
Big wires carry it from far away to your wall.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the lights off?
I am not sure why this happened. Is your house very quiet now?
Yes, it is very quiet.
Often, storms break the power lines. Did you hear any loud noise before this?
I did not hear anything strange.
It may be a problem with the main wire. How do you feel about the dark?
I feel a little bit scared.
It will come back soon. Would you like a warm blanket?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a big blue shell on the sand this morning.
That sounds like a cool find. Was it smooth?
Yes, it was very smooth and cool to hold.
Nice. Do you plan to keep it?
I think I will put it on my shelf at home.
It will look great there.
The sun was warm and the waves were loud too.
It sounds like a fun day. Did you swim?
No, I just sat and watched the water for a long time.
That sounds very peaceful.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does bread get big and fluffy?
Tiny bugs called yeast eat sugar and make gas. This makes bubbles. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I do. Why are the bubbles soft?
The gas gets stuck in the dough and makes it airy. It is like blowing up a balloon.
That is cool. Why does it taste good when cooked?
Heat makes the dough firm and bakes the yeast. The sugar turns into a nice crust.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why is there a rainbow in the sky?
Rain and sun make it. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. Is it real?
It is light, not a thing to touch. Can you see the colors?
I see red and blue. What about the others?
Green, yellow, orange, and purple. Do you see any of them?
I only see the top part.
You must wait for the sun to move. Are you patient?
I will look later. Thank you.
You are welcome. Tell me if you see it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great goal. Do you have a buddy to help you?
No, I am doing it alone right now.
Okay, first loop the lace under the knot. Is it tight enough?
Yes, I made a little bow.
You did a wonderful job. Do you want to try the other shoe?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel lost at my desk. Where should I start?
Start with one small task first. How do you feel right now?
I am very tired. I want to give up.
Rest for ten minutes.
I did rest. Now I am ready. What do I do?
Open your computer and pick one job.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so scared about my test.
That is a heavy feeling. What part worries you most?
I do not know if I studied hard enough.
It is normal to feel unsure. Have you looked at your notes?
I think I did, but I forgot half of it.
Forgetting is okay. You will learn again.
Do I have enough time to study now?
Only you know how much time is left. Do you feel ready to try?
I guess I will just do my best.
That is the true way to go. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my red cup on the floor this morning.
Oh no, that sounds bad. Did the cup break?
Yes, it broke into three pieces.
That is very sad. I am sorry to hear that.
I was so angry for a moment.
Anger is okay. What did you do next?
I cleaned it up and got a blue cup.
Good job. The blue cup looks nice.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the sea made of salt water?
Yes, most of it is salty. Do you like to taste it?
Why is it salty?
The sun dries up old oceans and leaves the salt behind. Do you know where it rains?
No, I do not.
That is okay. Rain comes from the sky.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to move my king.
Is your king safe from the enemy queen?
Yes, but I am still stuck.
Try moving a pawn forward to open the way.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a red box. I do not know what is inside.
That sounds fun. Did you ask who the box is for?
My aunt. But I am not sure if she will like it.
Most people are happy to get a surprise. Do you have a favorite color?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My computer is slow. I am in a huge rush.
That is a common problem. Is it making any weird sounds?
No. It is just stuck on the blue screen.
We can try a hard restart. Do you have the power button nearby?
Yes. I am about to press it.
That should help you out. Let me know if it works.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy and feel very bad.
I am sorry you feel this way. Did you tell them what happened?
I did not tell them because I was scared.
Telling the truth helps you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited for the bus all morning. It came at last, but I was late for school.
That is a frustrating feeling. Did you have a special reason for being late?
I helped my neighbor carry her grocery bag. The rain made the path very slippery and slow.
You did a kind and helpful thing.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my new friend smile so much?
It shows they are happy to see you. Do you smile back?
I do. Why do they like playing with blocks?
They enjoy building things together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to swim in the big blue ocean. Do I need special help?
You should always swim with a grown-up nearby. Do you like the taste of salty water?
No, I do not like it in my mouth. How do I keep from sinking when I just float?
Take a deep breath and lie on your back to float. Do you wear a floaty vest?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, I found a shiny rock! I am so happy.
That is a lovely find. Did you pick it up from the garden?
Yes, I did. Can I keep it forever?
I think you should. How do you feel about it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I painted a big red sun in my room today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like red the best?
Yes, red makes me feel warm and happy inside.
I am glad it made you smile. What did you use for the paint?
I used some thick watercolors from the jar.
I have never used thick colors before. How do they feel on the paper?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
The sun makes light with all colors. Blue light bounces around in the air, so your eyes see it. Do you see blue in water too?
Yes, I think so.
That is a smart guess. Water and air both let some colors show through.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just had a great meeting with my team.
That sounds wonderful. Did you feel proud of the work?
Yes, we agreed on a clear plan for next week.
A clear plan is very helpful. What is the first step?
We will build a new website together.
Building a website sounds like fun. Will you be in charge of the design?
No, my partner handles the design for me.
That is a smart way to share the work. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a gift fast. The party is soon.
A book? It is simple. What do they like?
I do not know. Please help me.
Try a plant. It grows with care.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn more about my favorite fruit, the apple.
Apples are sweet and crunchy. Do you prefer red ones or green ones?
I like the red ones. How can I keep them fresh for a long time?
Put them in the fridge to keep them crisp. Do you eat them with a knife?
I usually cut them into small slices. Is there a trick to peel them easily?
Yes, use a sharp knife carefully. Do you like to eat the skin?
I do, because it has good health benefits. What is the best time to eat an apple?
Anytime is good, but a morning snack is great. Do you share them with friends?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why is the sky blue? I am confused by the color.
Sunlight has many colors hidden in it. Do you like rainbows?
Yes, I do. But why does the blue stay up in the sky?
Blue light bounces off tiny air pieces. It spreads out everywhere.
So the air makes the blue light dance? That is cool.
Yes, the air scatters the blue light all around us. What do you see when you look up?
I see clouds and blue. Do white clouds also come from the air?
Clouds are made of tiny water drops. They block the blue behind them.
Thank you for the help. Now I understand it better.
I am glad I could help. Do you want to know why sunsets are red?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does it rain?
Water goes up, makes clouds, and falls down. Do you like the wet sound?
Yes, it sounds nice. Why is the water up there?
The sun warms the sea, and the water flies up. Is the sun warm today?
I do not know why. Why do we need rain?
Plants drink it to grow big and green. Do you like green leaves?
I like them. Is the rain cold?
Yes, it is often cool. Do you have a warm coat?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a hard day with too much coffee. I need a warm cup of tea to feel calm.
That sounds like a good way to relax. Did you pick a sweet tea?
I chose mint tea. It makes me feel cool and happy.
Mint is a fresh choice. I do not know how you like it, but it must taste nice.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I failed again. Should I stop?
No, you do not have to stop. Why do you feel this way?
I feel very sad and tired.
That is a real feeling. Take a small rest now?
Yes, I will try once more.
That is a brave choice. I am here for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My boss made me redo the whole report. It took three hours.
That sounds very tiring. Did you take a break to rest your eyes?
No, I just stared at the screen. My brain hurts now.
Your body needs food and rest. I do not know if you ate lunch yet.
I only drank coffee. It was a bad choice.
Coffee is not a meal. Do you want to talk about the work?
Yes, but I just want to go home and sleep.
Going home is a good plan. A fresh face helps with hard work.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to cut onions.
That is a great skill to learn. Do you have a sharp knife?
Yes, I have a sharp knife.
Cut the top off first. Do you like eating onions?
I do not like their smell.
That is very common. Put the onion in a bowl with water to help.
Will that really stop the smell?
It helps a lot. Put the bowl on your sink.
I will try that now.
Good luck with your dinner.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a tall white lighthouse today.
That sounds like a great view. Did you climb to the top?
No, the door was locked tight.
That is a pity. Do you live near the sea?
Yes, I walk past it every morning.
How nice to see it daily.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see a big white cloud moving fast. Why does it go there?
The wind pushes it along like a boat. Do you feel the wind today?
No, it feels still. Do they get tired from floating?
No, clouds are light and do not get tired. What do you think they are made of?
I guess they are made of snow. Can I touch them if I fly up?
They are mostly tiny water drops, not snow. It would feel wet if you touched them.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look how much snow is falling! It is so white and soft. I am very happy.
That looks like a lot of fun. Do you like to make a snowman?
Yes, I want to build a big snowman with you. It is the best kind of day.
I would love to help you. What is your favorite part about snow?
I like how it is quiet and cold. It makes the world look like a blanket.
That is a very pretty picture in my head. Do you have warm boots on?
Yes, I am wearing my big red boots. They keep my toes dry and warm.
Good, you will not get wet. Are you ready to go outside now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the moon change its shape?
The moon does not really change. The sun shines on it, and we see different parts. Do you see the moon at night?
Yes, I do. Why is it so bright?
It reflects the sunlight to us. It is like a mirror in the sky. Have you ever used a mirror?
Yes, in the bathroom. Why do stars go out when it gets light?
The sun is very bright. Its light covers the stars. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. Why can I not see them during the day?
The sky is full of blue light. It hides the dim stars. It is hard to see them then.
That makes sense. Why is the sun hot?
The sun is a giant star of fire. It makes its own heat. Do you feel warm near a fire?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to read at night, but I do not know which book to pick.
That is hard. Do you like funny stories or scary ones?
I think I like funny ones, but I am tired.
Funny stories are great. Do you have a favorite funny book?
I have one, but I read it too much already.
You can read it again. Do you want help finding a new one?
Yes, please. What should I look for?
I do not know your taste. Do you like animals in your books?
Yes, I love dogs.
Look for a book with a dog. Do you want a short story?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want my body to stay strong. What should I eat?
Eat lots of vegetables and fruits. Do you like fruit?
I like bananas but not green beans.
Bananas are great for energy. Try the beans with some cheese?
Cheese makes them taste better.
That is a smart way to eat. Do you drink water with meals?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I mix red and blue?
To get purple. Do you like purple?
Why does the paint dry?
The water goes away. Do you have a blue brush?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a very good time at the party last night.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What did you eat there?
I ate a lot of cake and talked to my friends.
Cake is always a great choice.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The sun is too bright.
It helps us see. Do you like the heat?
Yes, but it is hot. Why is it yellow?
It looks yellow to us. I do not know why exactly.
I must go now. Does it move?
Yes, it moves across the sky. Are you going home?
Yes, I am running. Is it far away?
It is very, very far. Can you still feel warm?
Yes, I am warm. Thank you.
You are welcome. I am glad to help.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do birds fly in big lines?
They save energy by flying together. Do you have a favorite bird?
No, but why do bears sleep in winter?
They sleep to save energy when food is hard to find. I do not know why they pick certain caves.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see big orange lights on the roof next door.
That is a fire. Are you safe inside?
Yes, but my dog is scared and hiding under the bed.
Give your dog a gentle pat. I will help you find the phone.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a puzzle with many pieces, but I do not know where to start.
Try to find the pieces with smooth edges. Do you see any blue ones?
Yes, I see the blue corner piece, but the next step is hard.
Put the corner piece on the table first. How does the picture look?
It looks like a tree, but I am still stuck on the middle part.
Look for the green branch pieces next. Is it getting easier?
No, the green pieces do not fit well, so I am confused.
That is okay, you are doing fine. Would you like to take a break?
Yes, I will rest for a bit and try again later.
Good idea, you are working hard. I am happy to help again soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. I am late for work.
That is bad. Are you drinking water?
No. I need to go now.
Drink some water. Please be careful.
Can you fix it fast?
I do not know how to fix a hurt head. Do you feel dizzy?
No. Just a big throb.
Rest is good. Does the hurt go away?
I must go.
Take care. I hope you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I am late.
I am sorry. Is this a big deal?
Yes. I missed my bus.
That is bad. Can you ride a bike?
No. My bike is broken.
I do not know what to do.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you still like me?
Yes, I always like you. Do you still like me?
Yes, I do.
That is good to hear.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make my tulips grow tall. How do I do that?
Give them lots of bright sun and water. Do you have a sunny spot for them?
I have a pot in the kitchen window. Can I plant them there?
Yes, that works well for most flowers. Just be sure to drain the water.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I had a scary dream where I fell down a hole.
That must have been very upsetting. Do you usually get cold in your sleep?
No, I am warm, but I felt very small and alone.
Dreams often play with our feelings. Do you wake up feeling tired?
Yes, I was exhausted when I opened my eyes.
Resting your body is important after a bad night. Do you like talking about your feelings?
I think I do, because it makes me feel better.
That is a good way to handle worry. Do you have a favorite thing to do in the morning?
I like drinking hot cocoa by the window.
That sounds cozy and safe. I hope you sleep well tonight.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am very late for my class today. Can you teach me how to tie my shoes?
Oh no, you are in a hurry. Do you have time to sit down for a moment?
I have to go, but I really need to know the steps.
Cross the laces over each other and pull tight. It is a big bow.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love to draw cats in the park.
That is so much fun. Do you use big or small crayons?
I use red and blue crayons.
I love red and blue. What is your cat's name?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a cookie with a heart on it.
We have those right here. Do you like chocolate hearts?
Yes, but I also want something cold.
Try the blueberry muffin. It is fresh and tasty.
Can I see the big cake with red frosting?
I do not know if it has red frosting today.
Okay, I will take the cookie and the muffin.
Great choice! Would you like a little bag?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I do not want to go to the doctor. Why must I go?
Your body feels sick, so we need to look inside. Do you feel tired?
I feel hot and my head hurts. Why does that happen?
Your body is fighting a bug that made you unwell. Do you want a cold drink first?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my apple and it rolled under the bed.
That is a tricky spot. Did you use a book to reach it?
No, I used my hand and my arm.
You worked hard to get it back. Was the apple still okay?
Yes, it was fine and I ate it.
That is a happy ending. You should feel proud of your work.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. What should I eat?
Try an apple. It is sweet and fast. Do you have one?
Yes, I do. Is that enough?
Yes, for a small snack. Please drink some water too.
Okay, I will do that.
That is a good choice. Stay well.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go next.
Do you like old things or new things?
I think I like the old bones.
You can go to the big room on the left. Did you see the map?
I cannot find my way there.
I am not sure of the path, but I can try to help.
Please walk with me.
Yes, I will walk with you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want a big party for my birthday.
That sounds fun. Who do you want to invite?
I want my whole class to come.
That is a lot of people. Do you have a gift?
I am not sure. What do you like?
I do not have feelings, but I like sweet treats. Do you like cake?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the light turn on?
A wire in the wall sends power to the bulb. Do you like reading books in the dark?
I don't think so. What happens if I unplug it?
The power stops coming to that spot. You must ask a grown-up before touching plugs.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many months are in a year?
There are twelve months. Do you know the names of any?
January and February. Do you like winter?
I do not have feelings, but I find it interesting. Is it cold where you live?
It is very cold. What is your favorite month?
I do not have a favorite. Thank you for asking.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the new robot in my class. It makes my heart feel small.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you think it is rude?
It is too loud and it never asks for help. It just takes the toys.
That does sound annoying. Why do you think it acts that way?
I think it is just mean. I want to hide under my desk.
I do not know why it is mean, but I believe you. Would you like to play a quiet game instead?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to see the North Star. How do I find it?
Look for the Big Dipper and follow its handle to a bright star. Do you like walking outside?
Yes, I love the dark. The sky is very big.
It is indeed vast. Do you bring a blanket for the cold?
Not yet, but I will. It is chilly tonight.
That is a smart idea.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy. I feel bad. What should I do?
Telling the truth is the best step. Do you know where the toy is?
Yes, it is in my bag. Should I give it back now?
That is a kind thought. Does your friend like fixing things?
I think so. I can try to help fix it.
That shows real care. Good luck with the talk.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am mad. My square has a hole in it.
That is a mean hole. Do you like squares?
Yes. Why is it not a perfect square?
I do not know why. Are you ok?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want new shoes because my old ones are too tight.
Ouch, that hurts. What color do you like?
I really like red, but I also like blue.
Both are great colors. Do you want to try on the red ones first?
Yes, please, I hope they fit well.
Let's see. Is your heel okay in them?
Yes, my heel stays in, but my toes feel a bit squeezed.
That is not good. Let us try the blue pair instead.
Oh, these blue ones feel very nice and soft.
Great choice. Would you like me to get the shoes?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My dog is sad today. Why is he crying?
He is likely hungry or thirsty. Did you feed him?
Yes, I gave him a big bowl of food.
He may just need a walk to feel better.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does my bread get so big and puffy?
That is because the tiny yeast makes gas bubbles. Did you smell the warm dough?
It smells sweet and warm. Do the bubbles make it taste good?
Yes, they make it light and soft.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad today. I do not know what to do.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk about it?
I just want it to stop. Is there a simple fix?
I do not know a magic fix. Sometimes time helps. What makes you sad?
I feel alone. Do you think that goes away?
Yes, feelings often change. You are not alone right now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Is it raining outside today?
I cannot see the sky, so I do not know. Is your window wet?
The wind is very cold. What should I wear?
Put on a warm coat and boots. Do you like cold days?
I do not like being wet. Should I bring an umbrella?
Yes, an umbrella is a smart choice. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My money is gone.
Oh no. That is not good. Did you lose your coin?
Yes, I dropped it. I want a sweet.
I do not know where it went. Can you look again?
I did look. I am still mad.
Take a deep breath. You will find it. Are you cold?
No, I am warm. Thank you.
You are welcome. Keep going.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My shirts are very dirty.
Hot water washes best. Do you have hot water?
Yes, I do.
Sort dark and light clothes. Are your shirts dark or light?
They are white.
Use soap and wash well. Do you know how to use soap?
I add it to the machine.
That is right. Hang them to dry in the sun. Is it sunny today?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What makes the internet work?
It is like a big web of wires and air. Do you use it for games?
Yes, I play online games.
That sounds like fun. I do not know which game you play.
I play a game with blocks.
Ah, that is a classic choice. Is it hard to build things?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad because I cannot get to the island.
I am sorry you feel that way. Is the boat not coming?
Yes, the water is too rough for a small boat.
That sounds scary. Do you have a map of the place?
I have a map, but I do not know the way.
I do not know the exact path either. Can you see any lights on the shore?
No, it is dark and I feel lost.
Stay calm and wait for the sun.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have five minutes to find the ball.
Is it red?
It is under the sofa.
Oh, that is tricky.
I cannot find it now.
Do you have a flashlight?
No, I am running late.
Check the corner first.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a map today. It is very cool.
That is great to hear. What place does it show?
It shows the big blue ocean.
The ocean looks deep. Do you want to swim there?
No, I just like to look at it.
Looking is fun. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoelaces.
That is a great skill to learn. Do you have a pair of shoes with laces?
Yes, I do. What is the first step?
Make a loop with each end of the lace. Can you show me how you hold them?
I can, but I always forget the next part. How do I finish it?
Cross the loops and pull tight to make a bow. Practice makes perfect!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue ship sitting on the water today.
That is a cool sight. Do you think it will sink?
No, it stayed right there all morning.
Ships float because they push water down. Have you tried putting a coin in water?
Yes, my coin went to the bottom.
Coins are heavy and small. Ships are big and hollow. Did you see people on the deck?
I saw kids running around on top.
The air inside makes it light enough. What game were they playing?
They were just laughing and jumping.
That looks like fun. Does the ship move slowly for you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great goal. Do you know how to make a loop?
I try, but the string always slips away.
Hold the knot very tight. You are doing well.
It feels hard, but I want to keep trying.
Keep going, you can do it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why are clouds white?
They are white because they bounce light back to our eyes. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. What if they turn gray?
