That happens when the water drops get bigger and thicker. Are you scared of gray ones?
Not really. Why do some look like animals?
Your brain likes to find shapes in soft things. Do you see a dog today?
I see a big cat! Do clouds have weight?
Yes, a big cloud weighs a lot, but it floats because it is spread out wide. Is that a heavy thing to think about?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here but I do not know where to start.
Start by picking one thing you like. Do you want fruit or bread?
I want food but I am too tired to look.
It is okay to rest a bit. Would you like to sit first?
I have no food money in my pocket.
If you have no money, you must leave. Are you sure?
I will go now and buy my lunch.
Good luck. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am stuck on my math problem.
What part is hard? Tell me the number.
I need to find half of twenty.
That is easy. Can you count to twenty?
I think it is ten.
Yes, you are right. Well done.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red ball on the grass today. It was wet and cold.
That sounds like fun. Did you kick it?
Yes, I kicked it to my dog. He caught it in his mouth.
Is your dog good at catching?
He is very good. Then we went home to play in the mud.
Mud can be messy. Do you like playing in the mud?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the snow so white?
Because the tiny ice pieces bounce light around. Do you like to build snowmen?
Yes, but it feels very cold.
Your body tries to keep you warm by making heat. Is your nose feeling tickly?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to take good pictures.
Start by pointing the camera at something bright. Do you like to take pictures of people or things?
I think I like things, but my photos look blurry.
Hold your hands still to stop the shaking. Are your hands tired?
No, I am just very unsure about what to press.
Press the small round button on top to take the shot.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. My gift is broken.
I am sorry to hear that. Is it a toy?
Yes. It stopped working when I opened it.
That is not fair. Do you want to fix it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a party today. It was very loud.
That sounds exciting. Did you like the music?
Yes, I liked it a lot. I ate a big slice of cake.
Cake is a good choice. Was the cake sweet?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a sand castle, but my tower always falls down. How do I make it strong?
Pack the sand very tight before you stack it. Do you have a bucket full of wet sand?
Yes, I do have a bucket. How high can I make it before it gets too heavy?
Keep the base wider than the top so it does not tip over. Do you like to decorate with shells?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is snowing hard outside.
That sounds lovely. Do you have warm boots?
I do, but I am afraid of slipping.
Slow steps help a lot. Do you walk on ice often?
I live in a warm town, so I am not good at it.
Practice on a soft hill first. It is safe there.
Is there a good hill near here?
I do not know your city. Do you have a map?
Yes, I am looking at one now.
Look for green parks with grass. Tell me what you see.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: What kind of music makes people feel happy?
Upbeat songs with drums often make people smile. Do you like dancing?
I love dancing, but I feel shy.
That is okay, you can move at home first. What is your favorite song?
I like songs with quiet violins.
Violins are very sweet and calm. Do you play any instruments?
No, I only listen with my eyes closed.
Listening with your eyes closed is a great way to feel the music. Do you close your eyes to sleep too?
Yes, I feel safe when I listen to them.
Music can help you feel safe and calm.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My fence is broken. I do not know what to do.
That is sad. Is it a small break or a big one?
It is a big hole. I am stuck.
You can add a new board. Do you have wood at home?
Yes, I have some old boards.
Good. You can fix it with nails. Is your tool set ready?
I have a hammer. But I am not sure how to hang it.
I do not know how your fence is made. But a friend can help you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My chair leg is loose and wobbly. Can you help me fix it?
Yes, I can help with that. How tight is the screw right now?
It is very loose and spins right out. I pulled it as hard as I could.
That sounds like the wood may have cracked. Do you see any split wood?
No, the wood looks fine. But the hole is too big for the screw.
Then we can use a wooden shim to fill the gap. Do you have any wood glue?
Yes, I have glue and small wood shavings. Is that enough for the job?
That is perfect, yes. Mix the shavings with the glue.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel sad and scared inside.
I am sorry you feel that way. What made you worry today?
The dark is too loud at night.
That can be hard to sit with. Do you have a soft blanket with you?
It helps, but my chest hurts.
Deep breaths can help a lot. Is your heart beating fast?
Yes, it thumps very fast.
Try to breathe slow and deep. I will stay right here with you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very scared about my first job.
It is normal to feel scared. Do you know what your first day looks like?
It looks like a lot of new people.
Just smile and listen. Have you packed your bag for the morning?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to feel happy more often. Can you help me?
Try to find one small thing you like each day. What makes you smile the most?
I love watching the rain fall. What should I do next?
Sit still and listen to the sound. Do you feel calm when you do that?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to walk in the park. What should I bring?
Bring a bottle of water. Do you like the sun?
I do not like the sun. It is too hot.
That is a good reason to go at night. The air is cooler then.
I like your idea. How long should I walk?
Walk for thirty minutes. Is your leg okay?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the doctor today and he gave me a lollipop for being brave. I felt so good!
That is wonderful to hear. Did you get any stickers too?
No, just the sweet candy, but that was enough for me.
I am happy you felt brave.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: It is snowing hard. I am late.
The snow is heavy today. Do you have your coat?
I lost it. I need a warm place.
Look for a shop nearby. Do you have a map?
No, I do not have a map.
I am not sure where the shops are. Walk toward the lights.
I see lights. Can I sit there?
Yes, you can sit down. Is your feet cold?
My feet are wet. Thank you.
Please stay warm. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I mix nice blue paint?
Try adding a little yellow to white first. Do you have a small pot?
Yes, I do. How much yellow should I add?
Start with just a tiny dot. Is the blue you want dark or light?
I want a bright sky blue. How do I make it brighter?
Add more white until it shines. Do you want to try it now?
Yes, I am ready to mix it.
Good luck with your new color.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the light turn on when I push the switch?
The switch lets electricity flow to the bulb. Do you like bright rooms?
Why does the computer get warm when I play games?
It works very hard, so it makes heat. Do you let it rest sometimes?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I drew a sun today and I am so happy about it.
That is wonderful news. What color did you use?
It is bright yellow with big red rays.
That sounds very warm.
I also drew a little cat sitting under the sun.
How cute is that. What is the cat doing?
It is just sleeping and dreaming.
That is a nice dream.
I want to keep it on my wall forever.
That is a great idea.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to run fast in the park.
That is fun. Do you feel happy when you run?
Yes, my legs feel like wind.
That is a nice feeling.
I want to run very, very fast.
Can you run for a long time?
I have to stop because I get tired.
Taking a rest is good. You must listen to your body.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am lost and I feel very bad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you see a big park nearby?
I do not see a park. I just see strange houses.
Let us stand still for a moment. What color is the house in front of you?
It is red. I do not know what to do next.
Let us look for a main road together.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sky looks gray and the wind is cold. Should I take an umbrella?
Yes, I think it will rain soon. Do you like walking in the rain?
Not really. It gets my shoes wet. What else should I wear?
Wear a warm coat and some boots. That will keep you dry and warm.
Okay, I have both. Is it safe to walk outside?
Yes, the roads are clear. Thank you for asking me.
I felt a little scared of the storm sounds. Is it loud today?
It is a bit loud, but not dangerous. Stay close to buildings.
That helps me feel better. I will go now.
Have a good day. Stay safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a paper plane?
You need a square piece of paper first. Do you have one?
Yes, I do. What is the next step?
Fold the paper in half to find the middle line, then unfold it.
I did that. What now?
Fold the top corners down to meet the middle line. Does it look like a roof?
It looks like a house. What is the final part?
Fold the plane in half again and bend the wings down. Fly it!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a tricky box with a secret lock.
That sounds fun. Did you open it yet?
No, but I think I see a clue on the side.
A clue is a great start. What does it look like?
It is a small shape with three sharp points.
Three points sounds like a triangle.
Yes, I tried the key and it just popped open!
You did it! What was inside?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to build a robot, but I do not know how to start.
That is a fun idea. Do you have any tools?
I have some wires and a box, but my hands feel tired.
Rest is good for your body. What kind of robot do you want?
I am not sure. I only know I like shiny things.
Shiny metal is cool. Do you want it to walk or sit?
I think it should just sit and look at me.
That sounds peaceful. You can do this slowly.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with the new baby.
That is hard. Do you know if the baby is hungry?
I think I will try to feed him now.
That is a good plan. Let me know if you need help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very busy. Where is the food?
The hot lunch is over there. Do you want a drink?
No time. Just the lunch, please.
Here you go. Is it warm enough?
Yes, thank you.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. My fish is moving fast. Why?
It may be hungry. Do you feed them often?
I forgot. I must go now.
A quick snack helps. Is the water clean?
Yes. Thanks. Bye.
Bye. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a bug in my room and I do not know what to do with it.
Is it a big bug or a small one?
It is a small spider, but I am afraid to touch it.
You can gently guide it outside with a cup, but I do not know if it is safe to hold.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am very scared about the test tomorrow.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you know why you are worried?
I do not know the answers well.
You can learn more by reading your notes. Would you like me to help you start?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling. I feel bad now.
That sounds tough. Do you like heights?
No, I hate them. How can I stop dreaming this?
Try to think of a happy place before bed. I do not know if that always works.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the island round?
I do not know for sure, but water pushes it all the same. Do you like the sea?
Yes, I do. Why are the trees so green?
They drink the rain to stay alive. Do you play there?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I broke my favorite cup by accident.
That is a sad thing to happen. Do you have another cup you like?
Yes, I have a blue one that is very nice.
A blue cup is a great choice for you.
I feel much better now that I told you.
I am glad you are feeling better now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to visit a small village near here, but I do not know which one is best. What should I choose?
I do not know your tastes, but do you like quiet places or busy markets?
I prefer quiet spots with lots of trees. Where should I go?
Greenwood Village fits that well. Do you plan to hike there?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad the leaves are falling! They are so pretty in the air.
It is nice to see them change. Do you like the sound they make?
Yes, they crunch under my feet. I feel very lucky today.
That is a good thing to feel. Are you going to play in them?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now, but those lights up there are bright.
They are real suns far away. Are you tired?
Yes, my feet hurt from the race.
Take a small break to look. Do you see the moon?
I must run, but yes, it is there.
It is just a mirror of sun light. Be safe on your run.
I see the North Star too.
It holds still while others move. Is it cold out?
It is fine, but I really must go.
Good luck on your way. Enjoy the dark.
Thanks, I will look up later.
That sounds like a good plan. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my floors look bright and clean?
You can use a soft cloth and warm water. Do you have a bucket?
Yes, I do. What else should I add to the water?
A tiny bit of soap helps a lot.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my cat rub against my legs?
It shows love and trust. Does she have a favorite spot to sleep?
Why does she make that low hum sound?
That is a purr, which means she feels happy. Is it loud or soft?
Why do cats like to sit on cold windows?
They do not know for sure, but it might be a habit. Does she watch birds outside?
Why does she knock things off the table?
She likes the sound and the chaos. Do you stop her from doing it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do the apples cost more on Tuesday?
I think they might, but I am not sure. Do you like sweet fruit?
How do I get to the fish section?
Go straight and then turn left. Do you plan to cook today?
Is the market open late on weekends?
Yes, it stays open until eight pm.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want my toy right now. I can not wait.
It is hard to wait when you want things. Do you feel angry?
Yes. My body feels hot and tight. I just want it.
Try to take three deep breaths. That helps your body cool down.
I did that. It feels better now.
Good job. Patience is a skill you can grow. Do you have a favorite thing to do while waiting?
I can draw a picture.
That is a great way to wait.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to have a party for my birthday.
That is a great idea. Who do you want to invite?
I want to invite my best friend.
Your friend will be so happy. What game do you want to play?
We can play tag in the yard.
Tag is very fun. How many candles do you want on the cake?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Do you like fast songs?
Yes, I love them. Are they in your bag?
No, they are in my head. They help me run.
That is a good trick. What is the song name?
I do not know the name. It just sounds like rain.
Rain sounds nice. Is it a happy song?
It is not happy. It is just fast and loud.
Loud and fast is fun. Do you listen every day?
I cannot talk more. I must go now.
Okay, go. Have a safe walk.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the sun! It makes me feel so warm and happy.
It is a bright ball of fire far away. Do you like standing in the light?
Yes, it feels like a big warm hug.
That sounds very nice to feel.
I wish you could come see it with me right now.
I cannot go outside, but I can imagine the blue sky.
Thank you for listening to my good feelings.
I am glad you are happy today.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That is a fun goal. Do you already have a bike?
Yes, but I am scared of falling.
Wearing a helmet helps a lot. Do you have one ready?
Not yet, I need to buy one.
Good idea. Find a flat, quiet place to start.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to eat toast with jam.
That sounds nice. Do you like sweet or salty food?
I do not know if I like them.
I do not know what you like either. What did you eat yesterday?
I ate eggs and toast yesterday.
Eggs are good for you. Do you like your eggs soft or hard?
I like them soft.
Soft eggs taste good. Do you have any milk?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make bread, but I am scared of the dough.
Do not fear, the dough is just flour and water. Do you have any yeast?
I have yeast, but I do not know what to do with it.
Mix it with warm water and a little sugar. Do you want to know why?
Yes, I want to know why the yeast needs sugar.
The yeast eats the sugar to grow and make the bread rise. Are you ready to start?
Yes, I am ready to start mixing.
Mix slowly until the dough feels soft and smooth.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I catch a rainbow?
You cannot catch it, but you can see it in the sky. Do you like to look up?
Yes, I do. How do I make my own small one?
Spray water outside while the sun shines.
I have a hose. Will that work?
Yes, it works well on a sunny day. What color do you love most?
I love red the best.
Red is the first color in a rainbow.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did the king get so sad?
The king lost his crown. Did you see where it went?
I looked, but I could not find it.
It is a hard thing to miss. Do you like the rest of the play?
Yes, I do. Why does the queen smile?
She finds the crown. It is a happy moment.
Oh, good. What happens next?
I am not sure about the end. Do you want to keep watching?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a red flower in the garden.
That looks nice. Do you like the color red?
Yes, I do. Why is it red?
I do not know why it is red. Is it your favorite flower?
Maybe. It smells sweet.
Sweet smells are good. What does it look like?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so late today, but I feel super happy!
That is wonderful to hear. What made your day so good?
I found a big, shiny rock on my walk.
A shiny rock sounds like a great prize. Is it blue or red?
It is actually purple, which is very rare.
That is a surprising color. Thank you for telling me.
I am glad I shared it with you.
I am happy you felt like sharing.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am getting married soon and I feel so happy.
That is wonderful news. Who are you marrying?
My best friend from school. Do you know who that is?
I do not know your friends, but I think that is very sweet. Is the party big or small?
It is a small party with just our families. Thank you for listening.
You are welcome. I am glad to hear about your joy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I warm up the milk for my new baby?
Use a bowl of warm water and hold the bottle in it. Do you have a thermometer to check?
What if the milk is still too cold?
Keep it in the water for a few more minutes. Is the water hot enough to touch?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a magnet and it pulled my paperclip, why?
The magnet likes the metal in the clip. Does your clip have a hole in it?
It does, but I am worried about my hands getting stuck.
Just keep your fingers far from the strong end. Do you like to touch smooth things?
I do, but I want to know what else it pulls.
It pulls iron, steel, and nickel. Do you have a coin to test?
I have a nickel, but I also have a plastic pen.
The pen will not move. Do you want to try it now?
Yes, I will try it on the fridge.
That is a good place. Do you see any other toys nearby?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sun so hot?
The sun burns very fast inside to make light. Do you like warm days?
Does the sun ever get tired?
No, it stays bright for a very long time. I do not know if it gets sleepy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read my favorite book again this morning.
That sounds very nice. Did you enjoy the story?
Yes, the cat in the book was very funny.
Cats can be quite silly. Did you read it in bed?
No, I read it while eating breakfast.
That is a great way to start the day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to kick the ball hard.
That is fun! Do you have a favorite color for your ball?
I like the red one. It is bright.
Red is a strong color. Do you play with friends?
I play with my brother. We have a game.
That sounds like a great time. Who won last time?
I did win! It was very happy.
I am glad you won. Do you know how many goals are in a game?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is a castle?
A big stone house that kings used to live in. Do you like big houses?
Did they have phones in castles?
No, they did not have phones back then. How did they send messages?
They used letters, right?
Yes, they wrote letters on paper. Who wrote those letters?
I think maybe the king?
Sometimes the king, but often other people helped him. Did you know there were people who only wrote?
Who are those people?
They were called scribes. Do you like to write?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My phone screen is broken. What should I do?
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a case for it?
No, I do not have a case.
Please buy a case to protect it. If it is cracked, see a repair shop.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big boat on the lake today. It had so many heavy things on top, but it did not sink. Why does a heavy ship stay on the water?
Water pushes up on the bottom of the ship to hold it up. Does the boat look like it is carrying ice cream?
Not ice cream, but it was full of people and trucks. I pushed a red ball into the pool and it floated too.
The water pushes up harder when the object pushes down on it. Did the red ball stay dry inside?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hit a rock and fell off my bike. It hurts.
That is a bad fall. Is your knee bleeding?
Yes, it stings. I do not want to ride again.
That makes sense. Do you want to sit on the grass for a bit?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My clock is broken and I am sad.
That is a big problem. Do you know what time it is?
No, it hurts my eyes to look.
I am sorry you feel that way. Can you see the sky?
It is very dark outside.
If the sky is dark, it is likely night. Do you want to sleep?
Yes, I think I do.
That sounds like a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look up at the sky, but I do not know what to do with my eyes.
Pick one bright light and stare at it. Do you see how it winks?
It feels like a big dark hole. I am not sure if I should feel scared.
The dark is just the empty space between the lights. Do you feel calm now?
I think I am ready to look closer at the moon.
That is a lovely choice. Good night.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do the little actors get scared?
Some do, but they are happy to be there. What did you like best about the play?
I loved the loud music.
Music helps people feel brave. Did you enjoy the dance part?
Yes, the red dress was bright.
It was a lovely color for the light. Do you want to go back again?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know how to read the clock.
It is very simple. The long hand shows minutes. Do you see the numbers?
Yes, I see twelve big numbers.
The short hand shows hours. Are you holding your watch?
I am holding a pencil.
Put the pencil down. Look at the small hand first.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am not feeling very happy today.
I am sorry you feel that way. What made you sad?
I lost my favorite toy.
That is a real loss. Do you want to talk about it?
I just want to feel good again.
That is a kind wish. Take a deep breath with me.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no time. Who built the first big stone walls?
Many ancient groups did. Did you see the ones in Asia?
Yes, but I need to run. What came next after that?
Cities with markets grew. Do you like reading about towns?
No, I am late. Just tell me about the kings.
Kings ruled those cities. They wrote laws.
Did the kings have armies?
Yes, they had soldiers. Did you bring your bag?
I forgot my bag. Thanks for the help.
Be safe on your way. I hope you catch your bus.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent all day in the library. I finally got my math problem right.
That is great news. Did you feel proud of yourself?
Yes, but now my head hurts. I want to stop working.
Resting is a good idea. What do you usually do when you are tired?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I had a great party last night.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What did you eat?
We ate pizza and cake. It was very sweet.
I like cake too. Did you dance?
Yes, I danced all night. My legs are tired now.
I am glad you had a good time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at the web. It never stops buzzing.
That sounds very loud and tiring. Do you like the quiet parts?
No. It just wants me to look at things. I want to play outside.
Outside is a great place to be. What games do you like to play?
Tag and hide and seek. But I cannot play if I am stuck on a screen.
You are right about that. Do you have friends who like running?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why did people build such big castles a long time ago?
They built them to keep bad people out. Do you like playing in forts?
Yes, I do. But wait, were knights really as strong as stories say?
They were very brave, but they were just like us. Do you wear a helmet when you bike?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost in the past.
That is okay. When does your confusion start?
I do not know which part is right.
Let us start with the very beginning.
How do I find the right facts?
Look for two books that match. Do you have any books nearby?
Yes, I have a few on the shelf.
Great. Pick the one that looks oldest.
I will try that now.
Good luck. Tell me what you find.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My phone screen is all black and broken. I am so sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a backup of your photos?
I think so, but I do not know where to look.
I am not sure which phone you have. What brand is it?
It is just a regular one from the store.
Maybe a repair shop can help you fix it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the play on yet?
Yes, it started ten minutes ago. Why did you miss it?
I ran fast, but I still missed the start.
You can get a seat in the back row. Do you like loud music?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy. Is it bad?
It is not bad if you fix it. Do you know how to fix it?
I can glue it back. Should I say sorry first?
Yes, sorry feels good to say. What did you do to break it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is very cold outside today.
The wind feels sharp. Do you have a warm coat?
Yes, I have a big jacket on.
That is good. Do you have gloves too?
No, I left them at home.
Your hands will get frozen. Go put them on.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate this cold wind.
That does sound tough. Do you have a warm coat?
Yes, but my hands still hurt.
I am sorry to hear that. I cannot say if it will stop soon.
I just want it to end.
I understand your frustration. Would a hot drink help?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How many months are there in a year?
There are twelve months in a year. Do you know which month it is now?
I think it is March.
That is a good guess, but I cannot see a calendar to check. Do you like the spring weather?
Yes, I like to play outside.
That sounds fun. I hope the sun shines for you today.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Where is the meeting?
I do not know where you meet. Do you have a room number?
It is on the third floor. I forgot the number.
That is scary. Did you bring your notes?
Yes, they are here. I must go now.
Please be safe. Can I help with anything else?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I drew a cat and its tail looks like a snake. I hate it.
It is okay to feel sad. Is the tail very wiggly?
Yes, it is too long and ugly.
You can draw a line over it. Do you have a crayon?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel so alone today?
It is a heavy feeling that can come to anyone. Do you like being by yourself?
I like my space, but this feels empty. Why does it hurt?
Your heart wants a friend near. Do you have someone to text?
I am not sure who to call. Do you know why?
I do not know, but it is okay not to know. Would you like to take a walk?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do sailors need ropes?
Ropes help them hold the sails tight. Do you like playing with string?
Yes, I do. Can everyone climb a big ship?
No, not everyone can climb a ship. Do you know how to tie a knot?
I think I can try. How do they see the land from far away?
They use tall masts to look over the water.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired today. Work was very hard.
That sounds really rough. Did you eat lunch today?
No, I forgot to eat. I am hungry and sad.
Oh no, that is not good. You need to rest now.
I will go to bed soon. Thank you for listening.
I am happy to help. Get some good sleep.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make dinner but I am lost.
Do you have any chicken in the fridge?
Yes, I have some chicken and rice.
That is a good start. Do you like your food spicy?
No, I prefer it plain and mild.
Use a little salt and oil. What kind of vegetables do you have?
Just some carrots and peas.
You can boil them with the chicken. Add the rice at the end.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need something to wake me up right now.
Do you like warm drinks? I can suggest one.
I am late. Can I just have coffee?
Yes, coffee works well. Do you drink tea too?
Tea takes too long. Just the coffee please.
Got it. Your coffee is ready.
Great. Thank you. I must go.
Good luck with your trip.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel so good right now.
That is wonderful. What made you smile?
The sun is shining bright.
I love sunny days too. Do you see any birds?
I see a red bird flying.
That is a lovely sight. Do you think it is happy?
I think it is very happy.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
Bees drink sweet flower nectar. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I do. I want to make honey too.
You cannot make real honey. Can you share more?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is snow white?
It is white because light bounces off the ice. Do you like to catch it?
Yes, I do. Why does it melt?
The sun makes it warm. Do you have a snowball?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am looking at a small boat. How do I keep it dry?
You can put a cover over it. Does it have a heavy lid?
No, it does not. Do I need a bigger cover?
Yes, a bigger cover is good. Do you have one at home?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the farm today and saw the cows.
That sounds like fun. Did you feed them?
I did not feed them, but I saw the pigs roll in the mud.
Pigs love to play in the dirt. What did you do next?
I watched the chickens peck at the corn.
Chickens are very busy birds.
Then I saw a big horse eat some hay.
Horses have strong necks.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel so big inside. I did it all by myself.
That is wonderful. How did you do it?
I ran very fast to the bus. I am late!
Running is good exercise.
I almost missed it. I am so proud.
Feeling proud is a great joy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to play this song on the guitar.
That is a great idea. Do you have the chords written down?
No, I just know the melody by heart.
You can find the chords online. Do you know which keys the song uses?
I think it uses A and C, but I am not sure.
I cannot be certain without hearing it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start my homework.
That feels hard. Do you like writing or drawing?
I like writing, but I feel stuck.
Try one small word first. Is it a story or a list?
It is a list.
Great. Write just the first thing on it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to run, but my legs hurt.
Rest your legs for a day. Do you drink enough water?
I drink some, but my feet feel heavy.
Heavy feet often mean your shoes are old. Do you stretch before you run?
I stretch sometimes, but it does not help much.
Stretching every time will help your body feel better.
So I should stretch more and rest a bit?
Yes, rest and stretch are very good for you.
Thank you, I will try that tomorrow.
You are welcome. Have fun moving your body.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have the flour. What do I do now?
Mix the flour with warm water. How much flour do you have?
I mixed it. It feels very soft.
That is good. Let the dough sit for a while.
I let it sit. Now what?
Shape the dough into a ball. Put it in a pan.
I put it in the pan. Do I bake it?
Yes, bake it in a hot oven. Do you have a timer?
I am so tired. Can I stop now?
No, you must finish the last step.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I read a book about knights today and I feel so glad.
That sounds like a great day. Did you like the armor?
Yes, the metal plates were very shiny and strong.
Shiny metal is cool. Do you know why they wore it?
They wore it to stay safe when fighting bad guys.
That makes perfect sense. Was there a dragon in the book?
No dragons, but there was a scary castle at the end.
Castles can be scary and big. Did you like the castle?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I lost the name of my old pal.
That is a sad feeling. Do you remember where you met?
We met in a big red house.
A big red house? Was there a dog in it?
Yes, a brown dog with a tail.
I do not know the name. Does the dog still live there?
I hope so.
Maybe you can visit soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have some great news to tell you!
Oh, that sounds exciting. What is it?
I got a new puppy yesterday!
A puppy? That is wonderful news! Does it have a name?
Yes, his name is Biscuit.
Biscuit is a cute name. He must be very happy to live with you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on my story.
What part is hard?
I do not know how to end it.
Have you tried a happy ending?
No, but it feels wrong.
Try a sad one then.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you like that new movie?
It is very fun. Do you have time to watch it?
No, I am running to work. Is it scary?
No, it is not scary. It is a happy story.
Good. I hate scary things. Can I see it tomorrow?
Yes, you can go tomorrow. Would you like a ticket?
Yes, please. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. I hope you have a great day.
I must go now. Bye.
Goodbye. Drive safe.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My head hurts so much.
I am sorry you feel bad. Is it a sharp pain?
Yes, it feels sharp and tight.
Do you have a fever?
I do not know, I have not checked.
Please go to a grown up now. They can help you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the gate now.
That spot looks pretty nice today. Did you see the red flowers?
I do not have time to look.
I am sorry you are in such a rush. Do you live close by?
No, I have a meeting soon.
I hope you make it in time. Is it a fun meeting?
I must go now.
I hope you enjoy the rest of your day. Do you walk here often?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the big clock on the wall.
I see it. The hands are moving. Which hand is shorter?
The one that points to the number two is short.
That is the hour hand. Do you know what the long one is?
Yes, the long one is the minute hand.
Good job. It is almost two o'clock.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the city look so loud today?
The cars and people are very busy. Do you like the noise?
I think the people run fast.
They have many places to go. Are you in a hurry?
I want to see the big red train.
It comes to the station soon. Is it your favorite color?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big promise to help my friend today.
That is a very kind thing to do. Are you excited?
Yes, I am so happy to share the good news.
I am glad you feel that way. What did you promise to do?
I promised to walk my friend home after school.
That is a nice way to be a good friend. Does your friend know?
Yes, she said thank you and gave me a hug.
That must have made you smile.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do fish have scales?
Scales are like tiny armor to keep their skin safe. Do you like armor?
Yes, I do. Why do they need water to live?
Their gills pull air from the water to breathe. Is the water cold where you are?
It is warm. Why do some fish jump out?
They jump to catch bugs or to move away from bad smells. Do you like bugs?
No, I do not. Why do they swim in groups?
Swiming together helps them hide from big bad things. Do you have big bad things to fear?
No, I am safe. Why do they have tails?
Tails act like oars to push the water. Do you like rowing?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do sailors live on boats all the time?
Yes, they do. Do you like looking at big ships?
I think they must get very lonely.
They have friends called crew. Do you have a best friend?
I wonder what they eat for dinner.
They eat hot, filling meals. Do you like soup?
Is the sea always calm?
No, waves can be big and scary. Do you like waves?
That sounds like a tough job.
It is hard but fun. Do you want to try sailing?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing.
That is a great goal. Do you have a favorite song?
I like pop songs.
Pop songs are fun to start with. Is your voice high or low?
I do not know.
We can figure that out later. Do you have a quiet place to practice?
Yes, my room is quiet.
That is perfect for listening to your sound. Are you nervous about singing?
A little bit.
Nerves are normal. Would you like to try a simple hum?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy. How do I say sorry?
You should look in their eyes and say "I am sorry." Did you mean to break it?
No, it was an accident. How do I act after I speak?
Just listen to what they say and give them a hug. Do you think they will forgive you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the village have a big square in the middle?
The square lets people meet and talk. Do you like talking to neighbors?
Why is the fountain always wet?
The water falls from the top all the time. I do not know why it never stops.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a bakery with the best warm bread.
That sounds wonderful. Do they have sweet treats too?
Yes, I am so happy to share the joy.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the red train?
I see a red train far away. Are you going to the beach?
No, I am going to my aunt. Please tell me the time.
It is three o'clock. Do you have your ticket?
Yes, I have it. Is the train coming soon?
It should arrive in five minutes.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired today. The dog got into the trash.
Oh no, that is a bad start. What are you cooking?
Just simple soup and bread. I want something easy.
That sounds very warm. Do you have any herbs?
No, I think I used them all. My brain is foggy.
Okay, maybe just salt and pepper. Is it almost done?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to teach my cat to shake hands. Can you tell me how?
Yes, hold a treat in your palm and wait for the cat to step up on it. Does your cat like to sit when you hold food?
I tried that, but the cat just sits on my hand. What do I do?
That is a good start. Now, wait for the cat to lift a paw slightly to take the treat, then say the word. Do you use one specific word for it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am very tired and do not know what to do.
You can take a nap to rest your body. Do you have a blanket?
I do not have a blanket and my back hurts.
You can use your coat to warm up. Are your shoes tight?
My shoes feel like blocks on my feet.
Please try to sit back and relax. How long until we land?
It feels like many days have passed.
It is just a long ride and you are almost home. Would you like some water?
Yes, please, and I am ready for food.
Great choice. Food will help you feel strong.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel alone. I must go now.
That sounds hard. Do you have a friend nearby?
No one is here. I am late.
I am sorry you feel this way. Is it a bad day?
Yes, very bad. Goodbye.
Go safely. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do bugs have eyes?
Yes, they do. Do you like flies?
No, I hate them. Do they have legs?
Most have six. Do you rush a lot?
Yes, always. What is a bee?
A fuzzy pollinator. Do you like honey?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to walk more, but my legs hurt.
That is okay. Do you have soft shoes on?
No, I usually wear my hard boots.
Try soft shoes instead. It will help your feet. Do you like the park?
Yes, I love the green trees there.
Go for a short walk there. What is your biggest worry?
I get tired after ten minutes.
That is normal. Take a break and rest.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make bread. How do I start?
Mix flour, water, and a little yeast. Do you have a bowl?
Yes, I have a big bowl. What do I add next?
Stir it all together until it feels soft. It should feel like a sponge.
It looks like a lump. Is that okay?
Yes, let it sit in a warm spot for one hour. It will get bigger.
It is getting bigger. What do I do now?
Push the air out of the dough. Do you know how to knead?
I will push it hard. Then what?
Put it in a pan and wait one more hour. Then bake it in the hot oven.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a tiny island in the sea. It looks so happy.
That sounds like a lovely place. What color is the sand?
The sand is bright white. It shines in the sun.
That must be beautiful to look at. Did you bring a boat?
I waded in the water to get there. It was cold but good.
You are very brave. How many trees are on it?
There is just one big tree. I sat under its leaves.
It sounds like a perfect spot to rest. Was it quiet there?
It was very quiet. I felt so free and glad.
I am glad you had such a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My dog eats too fast.
That can make her sick. Do you feed her with a bowl?
Yes, a normal bowl.
Try a slow feeder dish. Does she chew her food?
Not really, she gulps it.
That is normal. Have you tried freezing the kibble?
I have not tried that.
It slows her down. Is she happy when she eats?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I drank a cold cup of coffee this morning. It felt very sharp in my mouth.
That sounds like a quick wake-up call. Do you like it strong?
Yes, I do. Then I went for a walk in the park.
A walk is good for you. Did you see any birds?
I saw two small birds by the tree. They looked very happy.
That is a nice sight. I am not sure what kind of birds they were.
I think they were sparrows. After that, I had a warm cup of tea.
Warm tea after a walk sounds cozy. Was the tea sweet?
Yes, I put in two spoons of sugar. It made me feel calm.
That is a good way to end the day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My throat hurts and I have a runny nose. What should I do?
Drink lots of warm water and rest well. Do you have a fever?
No, I feel cold but I do not have a high body heat.
It is good that you do not. Do you feel hungry?
I am not very hungry, but I want soup.
Eating a bit of soup will help you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My friend took my toy without asking.
That is not fair to feel. Did you try to talk to him?
I tried, but he just laughed at me. I want to throw my book at him.
Yelling is not kind. How does your friend usually play?
He always grabs things first. It makes me feel very small and angry.
That is a hard thing to live with. Do you have a grown up nearby?
Yes, my mom is in the kitchen. I do not know what to tell her.
Tell her he took your toy. She can help you fix this.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My boss is very kind. Why does he do that?
He is kind because he cares about his team. Do you feel happy when he helps you?
Yes, I do. Why is it good to be kind?
Being kind makes people feel safe and strong. Do you like feeling safe at work?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I caught nothing today. I am so tired.
That sounds very sad. Did you try a new spot?
I tried the lake and the pond. No luck at all.
Fish can be tricky sometimes. What bait did you use?
I used worms. The fish just ignored them.
That is hard to fix. I do not know why they did not bite.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am going to collect all my shiny stones.
That sounds like fun. Do you like the blue ones best?
Yes, they look like the sky.
I like that idea. What color is your bucket?
It is red and big.
A red bucket will look great. I do not know where you plan to go.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love "Charlotte's Web." How can I keep a pet pig?
You need a big, warm home and lots of food. Do you have a big backyard?
Yes, I do. How do I clean its bed?
You can use soft dirt and change it often. Is your friend helping you too?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am afraid of deep water. How can I feel safe?
You can start in the shallow end. Do you wear floats?
Yes, I use arm bands. But I still feel scared.
That is okay. We take small steps. Is the water warm?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to leave now. Do you know if the court is open?
The sign says yes. Are you playing a match?
No, just hitting the ball. Is the water here?
It is in the room next to you. Can you carry your own bags?
I must go. Thanks for the help.
Have a fun day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I looked up and saw a big white cloud that looked like a dog.
That sounds like a fun thing to see. What was the dog doing?
It looked like it was chasing a little bird in the sky.
How lovely that must have been. Did you tell anyone?
I told my mom, but she was busy cooking so she just smiled.
She sounds very nice. Did you keep watching?
Yes, until the sun came out and made it disappear.
The sun always changes the shapes. Do you like clouds?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot find my book. I am so sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you check the shelf for new stories?
Yes, I looked there. It is gone.
That is frustrating. Let us check the lost and found box.
It is not there either. I want to go home.
We will take a deep breath. Do you remember where you sat?
I sat by the window. Now I feel better.
Good. Let us look there together.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want a drink, but I do not know if I want tea or coffee.
Do you like it hot and plain?
Yes, I like it hot.
Try tea first, then try coffee.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My boss is very nice. Why does he do that?
He likes to see people feel good. Do you enjoy working there?
Yes, it feels warm. Is that common?
Not always, but good bosses exist. What do they do for you?
He gives me time off. Why does he let me go?
He trusts you and cares for your health. Does that help you rest?
Yes, I feel better. Why is kindness good?
It makes hard days feel easier. Do you agree with that?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a weak hand and I am not sure what to do.
Do you have any high cards? If so, you might want to stay in.
I only have low cards and I do not like my odds.
That sounds tricky. Are you playing for fun or real money?
It is just for fun, but I still want to win.
Since it is for fun, you can always fold. Would you rather save your chips?
Yes, I think I will save them and wait for a better hand.
That is a smart move. Good luck with your next hand.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The bus is very bumpy. My tummy feels sick.
I am sorry you do not feel well. Do you want to look out the window?
The road is wet. I am scared we will crash.
The driver is very careful and safe. What is your favorite color?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked on the sand today.
That sounds nice. Did you see any shells?
Yes, I saw a red crab.
Wow, that is cool. Did it run away?
Yes, it went into the water.
The water was fresh. Did you drink it?
No, I stayed on the land.
That is wise.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to serve the ball.
Do you hold the racket tight?
Yes, I grip it like a hammer.
That is too tight. You must relax your hand.
How do I relax it?
Think of holding a small bird in your cupped hands.
That sounds nice and soft.
Does that help you feel easier?
It feels a bit better now.
Good. You are ready to try.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my baby cry so much?
Babies cry when they are hungry or tired. Do you know how to tell the difference?
How do I know if she is hungry?
Look for her sucking her hand. Is she looking around or moving a lot?
I do not know what to do with the new clothes.
Wash them all before you use them. Do you have enough small ones?
Why are her eyes blue?
I do not know what color they will be. Do you think blue is a nice color?
She is so small. Why does she grow so fast?
Your body gives her food to help her grow big. Do you feel happy watching her?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to sleep better at night.
That is a good goal. Do you play with lights before bed?
Yes, I use my phone a lot.
Try to stop looking at screens for one hour. What do you read before you sleep?
I read books, but I can't fall asleep.
Reading is great. If you feel awake, get up for a minute.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I have a big party today.
That is wonderful. Who is coming to play with you?
My best friend comes too. We will eat cake.
Cake is a tasty treat. Do you like chocolate or vanilla?
I love chocolate. The fun starts at noon.
Noon is a good time for games.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is very hot outside today.
That can be tough. Do you have a cool place inside?
I have a fan, but it is still warm. What should I do?
Drink lots of cold water. Are you wearing heavy clothes?
I am wearing a thick shirt. That is silly, I know.
Please take off the thick shirt. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My neighbor plays loud music at night.
That must be hard. Do you sleep well?
Not really. I want to talk to him.
That is a good start.
But I feel rude if I say so.
It is not rude. Are you afraid he will be mad?
A bit. What should I say?
Say, "I need sleep. Please keep it down."

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have three cards and I win.
That is a great start. What are your cards?
I have two kings and an ace.
Those are strong cards. Do you know the rules?
I think I just count the points.
Yes, kings are usually ten points. Is it a big score?
I need ten more to win.
You are very close. Good luck with that.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sheep have no wool left. What should I do?
That is not good for them. Do you have a warm blanket?
I have a blanket, but the cows look sad.
Cows need grass. Are they eating?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to kick the ball really far. How do I do that?
Put one foot on the ground and swing your other foot high. Do you play on a soft field?
Yes, it is very soft. My foot hurts when I kick it.
Make sure your shoes fit well. Do you stretch before you play?
I do not stretch much. Why is that needed?
Stretching stops your muscles from getting hurt. Can you tell me your favorite team?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun is warm, and I see a bee buzzing on the flower.
That bee is hard at work. Do you know where it goes next?
It flew away to the hive with a tiny drop of nectar.
Bees make honey from that sweet plant juice. They sit on it to dry it into jam.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I do not sleep well at night. Why is that?
Tired bodies need rest to fix and grow. Do you play too much before bed?
I play games on the screen. Does the light stop me from sleeping?
Yes, screen light tells your brain it is still day. Do you try a book instead?
A book sounds nice. How does that help me sleep?
Books are calm and let your mind get quiet.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The leaves are falling off the trees. Should I pick them all up?
That is a lot of work. Do you like to rake?
I do not know. They look pretty on the ground.
They look like a soft blanket. Do you think the trees are tired?
Maybe. Why do they let go anyway?
Trees sleep in winter. Do you sleep in winter too?
I do sleep, but I keep my skin.
Trees save energy by losing leaves.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the cat look so sad in that film?
I think he lost his favorite toy. Do you like cats?
Yes, I do. Why does the music get so loud?
The loud sound makes us feel happy.
Why is the sky red in the last scene?
It is just a cool color the artist chose. Do you like red?
I like blue better. Why did the dog not help the cat?
The dog was too scared to move.
That is scary. Why did they hug at the end?
They are friends again now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad and scared about the big test tomorrow.
It is okay to feel that way. What part worries you most?
I do not know if I can pass it.
That is a hard thing to think about. Have you studied for it?
I tried, but my brain feels fuzzy.
I do not know what will happen, but you can breathe slow. Do you feel a little better now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are these shoes soft inside?
They are soft to keep your feet warm. Do you like the color red?
Why do we need to try them on?
Trying them on shows if they fit well. I do not know your exact size.
Why is this pair cheaper?
This pair is older, so it costs less. Is your shoe size a nine?
Why should I buy the nice ones?
Nice shoes last a long time and feel good. Do you want to buy these?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the post office today. I waited in a long line.
That can take a lot of time. Did you have a letter for someone?
No, I was just looking at the stamps. They are very pretty.
Stamps are fun to look at. Do you like the animals on them?
Yes, I saw a stamp with a red fox. I almost bought it.
A red fox is a great choice. Did you end up buying it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the art room open?
Yes, it is open. Are you here for the paintings?
No, I am here for the big clock. Can you help me find it?
I am not sure of its spot. Do you have a map?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very hungry today. My work was long.
That sounds hard. Do you want soup or a sandwich?
I want a big salad with chicken.
A fresh choice. How would you like it dressed?
Just a little bit of oil and vinegar.
That sounds tasty. I will bring it right away.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to visit the small village by the river. How do I get there?
You can walk or take the bus. Do you like to walk or ride?
I think I will walk. What should I bring with me?
Bring water and a hat. The sun can be hot there.
Is there a good place to eat in the village?
I do not know for sure. Is there a sign for a shop near the gate?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do I win chess?
Try to trap the king. Do you have much time left?
No. It is a hard trap.
I do not know the exact move. I suggest you run.
Thanks.
Good luck. Do you play often?
Never.
It is a fun game. Take your time next time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a big box and need to send it. Where do I go?
You can take it to the front desk. Is the box heavy?
Yes, it is very heavy. Can you help me carry it?
I cannot lift it, but I can point you to the scale. Do you have a stamp?
I do not have a stamp. How do I buy one?
You can buy one at the counter. Is it a friend or a family member?
It is for my sister in the city. What should I do next?
Just pay the fee and write her name on the label.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to keep my coins, but I keep spending them on candy.
Try putting your coins in a jar after lunch. Do you have a jar at home?
Yes, I have a blue jar. How do I stop buying candy?
Swap candy for apples or water. What do you like to eat instead?
I like apples. But I still feel sad when I do not have cash.
Is it sad, or just used to it?
Just used to it.
Small changes make big differences over time. Are you ready to try?
Yes, I will start today.
That is a great start. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The rain is loud and the wind is strong today.
That sounds exciting to watch from inside. Do you see any lightning?
Yes, the sky flashes bright white every few minutes.
I am glad you are safe and dry. Is the house shaking?
No, it feels very steady and warm inside.
Good, staying cozy is the best part of a storm.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I cannot sleep at night. What should I do?
Try drinking warm milk. Do you like the taste of milk?
Yes, I do. My eyes feel heavy later.
That is good. Do you play with screens before bed?
Yes, I watch cartoons. Then I feel too awake.
Turn them off an hour early. Sleep is for resting your body.
I will try that tonight. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. I hope you rest well.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My bike feels slow today.
Did you check if your tires are full? Do you know how to use a pump?
I think the tires are okay.
It is hard to say without looking. Have you checked your brakes?
The brakes work fine.
It must be the air. How often do you ride?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did the ice cream melt?
It got too warm. Do you like cold treats?
Yes, I do.
Warm air makes ice turn to water.
That makes sense.
I am happy it made sense.
Thank you for helping.
You are welcome. Was it a big scoop?
It was.
I am sorry it disappeared.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The leg of my chair broke. I dropped a heavy book on it.
That is very bad. Do you have a hammer?
Yes, I have a hammer. It just snapped in two.
You can glue it back together. Is the wood clean?
It is clean and dry. I used a wipe.
Good. The glue needs time to dry.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see smoke coming from my kitchen. What should I do?
Are you safe right now?
Yes, I am outside. How do I stop the fire?
Call the fire number first. Do not go back inside.
Okay, I will call them. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Stay cool.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I lost my little red ball.
I am sorry you feel bad. Do you know where you last played?
I do not know. It is just gone.
That feels very bad. We can look together.
I am too tired to look. I want it back.
I get it. I do not know where it is either. Are you sure it is in the yard?
I think so. Maybe it rolled away.
Let us check the grass. Is the sun still out there?
No. It is dark. I am done.
Okay. We will rest. Maybe you will see it tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look, the sky is gray.
Yes, it is. Do you like watching the drops?
I do. Will it stop soon?
I do not know. Is your umbrella packed?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Is the dinosaur hall open? I am late.
Yes, it is on the first floor. Are you going to see the T-Rex?
I do not have time for that. Where is the exit?
It is near the gift shop. Do you want a map?
No, I will find it. Thank you.
You are welcome. Be safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had the best day ever. I helped a new friend learn to tie shoes.
That is so nice of you. What did your friend say?
They laughed and gave me a big hug. I felt very warm inside.
Hugs are the best reward. Did you go home happy?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because the sky is so blue.
That is a nice feeling. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, I love it. But why is the sky that color?
Sunlight has many colors in it. The blue parts spread out the most in the air.
That is a cool fact to know.
It is. Do you see any birds flying up there?
Yes, I do. Thank you for explaining it so well.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It is a bright day in May. I saw a red bird in the tree.
That sounds nice. Did you talk to the bird?
No, it just sang. Then I went home for a warm drink.
A warm drink on a bright day feels cozy. What did you drink?
I drank tea with milk. It was very sweet.
Sweet tea sounds good. I do not know what month comes after May.
I do not remember either. Let us just enjoy the sun.
Yes, the sun is always nice. Do you want to sit and watch the clouds?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What season is this?
It looks like winter. Is it cold outside?
Yes. I must go.
Take care. Do you like the snow?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to visit a museum but I do not know which one is best.
A science museum is very fun and full of things to touch. Do you like animals or space?
I love animals and I have a lot of time to walk around.
A big natural history museum has many dinosaur bones and wild cats. Is walking far okay for you?
Yes, I can walk all day, but I also want to see old art.
You could go to an art museum instead, but they are quiet and mostly for looking. Do you like painting?
I like painting, but I want to learn new things too.
Most museums have guides who can teach you about the art. Do you want to hire one?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very tired on Mondays. Do you know why?
Your body needs rest after the weekend. Do you sleep well on Sundays?
I usually stay up late to play. Is that bad for me?
Yes, staying up late makes you feel tired. Can you try to go to bed earlier?
I want to wake up happy on Fridays. How can I do that?
Try to feel good during the whole week. Do you like your work?
I like it some days, but not all. Do you have a tip?
Small happy moments help a lot. What is one nice thing you did today?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking up at the dark sky. I do not know what to do with all the lights.
Do you like the way they shine?
They look very far away and I feel small. I am not sure if I should go inside or stay.
It is cold out there.
The air is crisp and the ground is dry. I keep looking for a bright one to point to.
Which star is the biggest to you?
That one over the tree seems the most clear. I think I will just sit here for a bit.
I am happy you found a good spot.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see big white puffs. What are they?
They are clouds made of water. Do you like looking at them?
I have to run. How fast do they move?
They move very slowly. Do you want to watch one?
No, I am late. Is it going to rain?
I do not know for sure. I hope you have an umbrella.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to float on my back.
That is a fun skill to learn. Do you know how to kick?
I kick a little, but it feels hard.
Your feet should stay relaxed. Are you holding your breath?
I think I am. How do I stop that?
Just let air out your nose slowly. Do you want to try it now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the rain. My toys are wet.
I am sorry. Did you check the basement?
No. I just want the sun.
That is fair. What do you like to do first?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so late. I feel bad.
I am sorry. Did you sleep in?
No, I just forgot the time.
That happens to all of us. Do you know what time it is?
Yes, it is too late.
Let us go now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start.
Start with one. Do you have an object to count?
I have apples.
Pick one apple. Say one. What is the next number?
Two?
Yes. Count the second one.
Two. What comes after two?
Three. Keep going.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Can you help me find the gate?
Yes, go straight ahead. Are you going to the playground?
No, I need to leave the park. Is it far?
It is just over there. You are almost there.
Thank you so much. I must go now.
Good luck with your day. Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I pick a sweet tomato?
Look for one that is red and feels soft. Do you like sweet or sour fruit?
I like sweet ones. How do I wash them?
Use cold water and rub them gently. Do you wash your hands first?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big red house by the tree. What is that place?
It is a bakery where we buy bread. Do you like bread?
Yes, I do. Is there a park with slides near here?
Yes, the park is just down that street. Do you like to slide?
I love slides. Can you tell me what lives in the pond?
I think there are small fish in the pond. Do you like fish?
Yes, I like fish. Thank you for helping me.
You are very welcome. Have fun in the town.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the horse eat hay?
It is like grass for the horse. Do you like to eat grass?
I do not. Why does it kick its legs?
It does that when it is happy or scared. Is the horse happy?
It looks happy. Why do its ears move so much?
They help it hear all around. Do you hear birds right now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make bread at home.
That is a fun idea. Do you have a big bowl?
Yes, I have a bowl. What do I add to it?
You add flour and water. Is your water warm?
It is warm. What comes next?
Mix them until it feels like clay. Do you like touching dough?
I think I will. How long do I wait?
Wait about two hours. Do you like to watch things grow?
I will wait. How do I know it is done?
I do not know exactly. It is ready when it smells good.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I tried to speak, but I got it all wrong. My words do not come out right.
That sounds very hard. Do you like the sound of the new words?
I do not know. I just feel bad. I want to stop trying because it is too tough.
It is true that it is tough. Can you try just one small word?
Maybe one small word. What word should I pick?
I do not know your level. Try saying "hello" slowly.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
Sure, let's try. Do you have a pair of laces?
Yes, I do.
First, make a little loop. What color are your laces?
They are blue.
Good, now cross them. Is it hard to see the strings?
It is a bit hard.
Hold them tight. Do you feel the knot?
Yes, I do.
Great job. Can you keep them from coming loose?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and saw a new dog.
That sounds fun! Was the dog big or small?
It was very small and had a red collar.
A red collar is nice. Did you play with it?
Yes, I threw a ball and it caught it in its mouth.
That is a smart dog. I am glad you had a good time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake a cake for my birthday. How do I mix the dough?
You just add all the ingredients together and stir until it looks like a thick paste. Do you have a big spoon ready?
Yes, I do. What should I do next?
Put the mixture in the pan and bake it for thirty minutes.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do I know if the time is five past three?
Look at the long hand first. If it points to the one, it is five minutes past. Do you see the big hand?
Yes, I see it, but the little hand is near the three.
The little hand tells you the hour. When it points to the three, it is three o'clock. Are you sure the long hand is on the one?
I think so, but it is close to the two.
If the long hand is on the two, it is ten past. I am not certain where your hand is. Can you look at the clock again?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad working alone. It is quiet and boring.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like your new desk?
Yes, but I miss my friends. I want to play with them.
That sounds nice. What is your favorite game to play?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I cannot play the song right. My fingers slip all the time.
That is a hard thing to do. Do you want to take a small break?
I do not want to give up. I just want to get it right.
That is a good goal. What part is the trickiest?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a circle and a square, but I do not know what to make with them.
That is a fun start. Do you like to build things?
I want to make a house, but I am not sure how to put the shapes together.
You can put the square on the bottom and the circle on top. Does that sound right to you?
I think I will try that now because it seems easy.
That is a great idea.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing like a bird.
That is a great goal. Do you have a favorite song?
I like hummy tunes. Is that hard?
It takes practice, but you can do it. What is your favorite sound?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I need to clean my room, but it looks very messy.
That is a big job. Do you want to start with the toys?
I can throw the toys in the box.
Great idea. Did you remember to put the books back on the shelf?
I do not know where the books go.
I do not know either. Let us look at the shelf labels together.
I found the blue book. It fits there.
You did a good job. What is next on your list?
I am done cleaning. It looks nice.
I am happy for you. Take a break and drink some water.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a movie with a big blue dragon today.
That sounds very fun. Did you like the dragon?
Yes, he was very big and a little scary at first.
Big things can look scary, but they are often friendly. What did the dragon eat?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I played a card game today.
That sounds like fun. What game did you pick?
It was a simple match game.
I like that game too. Did you win?
I lost, but I tried hard.
Trying is the best part.
My friend laughed at my bad luck.
Was the laugh kind?
Yes, it was a happy laugh.
That is good to hear.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My tree looks sad. What do I do?
Give it some water. Do you water it often?
I forget sometimes. It has brown leaves.
Brown leaves mean it needs care. Check the soil for bugs.
I found tiny worms. Are they bad?
Most worms are good friends. Do they look like holes?
Yes, they have holes in the leaves.
That is bad. Please find help from an expert.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I use my legs to go fast?
Because your feet push the pedals to make the wheels spin. Do you like going fast?
Yes, I do. Why does the chain need oil?
The oil stops the metal from rubbing and getting stuck. Do you check the oil often?
Sometimes. Why do the brakes make a squeak?
The pads might be dirty or worn out. It makes a sound to tell you to stop safely. Do you hear any other sounds?
No, just the squeak. Why are the tires round?
Round shapes roll smoothly without bumping. Do you think square tires would work?
No, that would be very bumpy. Why is riding fun?
Because you feel the wind and see new things. Do you feel happy when you ride?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very tired.
That sounds hard. Are you sad about it?
No, just sleepy.
Sleep helps you grow. Do you have a bedtime story?
Yes, but I do not want to read.
That is okay. You can just listen. Is your bed cozy?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today. I saw a big dog chasing a ball.
That sounds fun. Did the dog catch the ball?
Yes, it caught it right away. I want to go again tomorrow.
What a nice day. Do you want to bring a book?
I might. I also found a funny rock on the path.
I do not know what the rock looked like. Was it smooth?
It was very round and gray. I put it in my pocket.
That is a good plan. Do you want to paint it?
No, I just want to keep it. I am tired now.
You should rest. Good night.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am nervous about my first job tomorrow.
That is a very normal feeling. Do you like the place?
Yes, but I am worried about my shoes.
They look nice and clean to me.
Thank you for helping me feel better.
I am happy to help. You will do great work.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see a big blue boat on the water. How does it float?
It floats because the water pushes up on it. Do you like water?
Yes, I do. But why does not it sink?
The inside is full of air, which is lighter than water. Is that clear to you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a little blue bird on the branch. What is its name?
That looks like a bluebird. Do you see its wings?
Yes, its wings are blue and brown. Do you like bluebirds too?
I love watching them hop around. Do you think it will sing?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red balloon today. It floated up to the sky and I felt very happy.
That sounds nice. What color were your shoes?
My shoes were blue. The sun was warm on my face.
Warm sun is good. Did you eat a snack?
Yes, I ate some cold ice cream. It tasted sweet.
Ice cream is yummy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my little brother cry when he falls?
He is sad because it hurts. Does he have a scrape?
Yes, there is blood. Why does the blood come out?
Blood is in your body to help you heal. Do you like when the rain falls?
I do. Why does it rain from the sky?
I do not know for sure, but water makes the sky heavy. Do you like puddles?
Yes, I love puddles. Why do they go away later?
The sun makes them dry up. Do you see anything else new?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to run fast today and my legs hurt a lot. I want to stop.
That feels bad. Do you want to try walking first?
Maybe. But I feel slow and sad.
Slow is still moving. What makes you feel sad?
I am not as good as my friend.
Everyone grows at their own speed. Do you like to listen to music?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My computer made a loud noise today.
That sounds scary. Was it a funny noise?
It went zip and then stopped.
I do not know what that means. Did you fix it?
I pressed the button and it worked.
That is good news.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just ran around the park. I feel so good.
That is great. Do you like the fresh air?
Yes, it makes me think.
Thinking while running is fun. How far did you go?
Maybe two miles. I am happy to share this.
I am glad you feel good.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so fast. I need to go now.
I am sorry you are in a rush. Do you have time to breathe?
I can't stop. My legs move too quick.
Running helps, but rest works too.
I feel like I am late.
That feels bad, yes. Are you sure it is late?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My cat jumped on the table and knocked over my cup.
Oh no, that sounds messy. Did you get to clean it up?
Yes, I used a towel to wipe the floor.
That was a smart move.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very late for my big play. What should I do?
Take a deep breath. Are you close to the door?
Yes, but I forgot my red shoes. I feel so bad.
Do not worry about the shoes. Go right now.
I am running as fast as I can.
That is the best thing to do. Good luck to you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big old car in the park today. It looked like it was from a long time ago.
That is a lovely find. Did it have round wheels?
Yes, they were round and black. I thought it was very quiet inside.
Old cars can be very peaceful. Do you like riding in them?
