I only looked, I did not ride. But I read a sign that said it was from 1920.
That is a very old year. Do you know what a car in 1920 looked like?
I think it looked like a box on four wheels. It had no doors, just open sides.
You have a good eye for history. Was it broken or working?
It was working, but very slowly. I waved to the driver and he waved back.
That is a sweet story to end your day. Did you tell your family about it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to wind my clock.
You turn the key slowly. Do you have the key with you?
Yes, I have it. How do I turn it?
Turn it right until it feels tight. Do you like the sound it makes?
It feels tight now. What do I do next?
Just let it go. It should run now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That is good to hear. What is making you happy?
I found a nice place for lunch.
Oh, that sounds fun. Is the food good?
Yes, the food is very tasty.
I am glad you like it.
I want to take you there next time.
That is kind of you. How much does it cost?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the lighthouse so tall?
It is tall so the light can go far out to sea. Do you like looking up at big things?
The light blinks sometimes. Does it blink on purpose?
Yes, it blinks to help ships know where the rocks are. Do you like watching the light flash?
Who turns the light on at night?
I do not know for sure, but I think machines help now. Do you like knowing how things work?
Thank you, I want to visit one.
That is a great idea for a trip. Have fun seeing the light!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw my old friend at the store.
That sounds nice. Did you say hello?
No, I was too shy to talk.
It is okay to be shy. Are you still friends?
I am not sure if they remember me.
Many people do remember old friends. Was it a long time?
Yes, it has been many years.
Time makes us feel far apart. How do you feel now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I stop the lights from blinking?
Check if the bulb is tight in the socket. Is it a new bulb?
No, it is an old one. What else should I check?
Look at the switch to see if it is loose. Do you feel any heat?
The switch feels warm, not hot. Is that bad?
A warm switch may be a problem. Please turn off the breaker to be safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are trees so tall?
They grow up to reach the sun. Do you like the sun?
Why do leaves fall in fall?
The tree lets them go to save energy. Have you seen a red leaf?
Why do trees have big roots?
Roots hold the tree steady in the wind. Do you like the wind?
Why are trees green?
Green helps them make food from light. I do not know how they taste.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel sad today. Why do you feel this way?
That feels hard. Do you want to talk about it?
I am worried about school. Why is it so scary?
New things can be scary. What part worries you most?
I do not know. Is it bad to feel worried?
No, it is not bad. It is just a feeling. Do you like reading?
Yes, I like books. Why does that help?
Books can make you feel safe. Do you have a favorite book?
Yes, I do. I will read now.
That is a good choice. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: Do I like tea or coffee better?
I do not know your taste. Do you like warm or sweet things?
I like warm things, but I am not sure about sweet.
Maybe try a plain tea first. Is that too weak for you?
No, it does not sound weak. What about coffee then?
Coffee is strong and bitter. Do you like strong drinks?
Yes, I think I do like strong things.
Then try the coffee. See how it feels in your mouth.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love that song, but I must go now.
It is a fun song. Do you sing along?
I am late. Please tell me the name.
I do not know the name. Do you like the drums?
I need the title fast.
I can check for you later.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel very happy today.
That is great. What made you smile?
I saw a bright blue bird.
Blue birds are lovely. Do you like birds?
Yes, I love all birds.
Nature is kind. How does that feel?
It feels calm and safe.
Calmness is good. Do you have friends?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I ask for a smaller plate at the table?
Just show your waiter a small plate and say, "I will take this one." Do you like big portions?
I am not sure. I am afraid I will leave too much food.
That is a good habit. Leftover food can be packed to eat later. Would you like a doggy bag?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see leaves falling on the ground. Why is that happening?
The trees drop their leaves to rest for the cold weather. Do you like watching them fly down?
I like them, but I miss the flowers. When do the flowers come back?
Flowers usually return when the sun gets warmer in spring.
I want a new coat. Is it too early to go shopping?
It is fine to look for a coat now since the air is getting crisp. Do you want a red one or a blue one?
I will pick a red one. Thank you for helping me think.
You are welcome. It is nice to plan for the next season.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I stand by the big blue water and do not know what to do.
The lake looks very calm today. Do you like to swim or just sit?
I think I want to sit, but I am not sure why.
Sitting is a good choice to watch the birds. Do you see any ducks over there?
Yes, I see three small ducks near the grass.
That is a lovely sight to enjoy. Take your time with them.
Okay, I will sit down and watch them.
That sounds perfect for you. Enjoy your quiet time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are there twelve months in a year?
The earth takes a long time to go around the sun. Do you know what the sun is?
It is the hot ball in the sky.
Yes, it gives us light and heat. I do not know why we chose twelve exactly.
Do you think it should be ten?
I like the idea, but I am not sure.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What is that song?
I hear a violin. Do you know the name?
I only have one minute.
It sounds like "Canon." I hope you make it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared to learn how to drive. Can you help me?
It is normal to feel scared. Do you have a quiet place to practice?
Yes, my uncle lets me use his empty lot. What should I do first?
Start with just learning to park. Do you know how to use the mirrors?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the little pieces move in different ways?
Each piece has its own special job. Do you like knights?
Why does the king stay safe if he has no power?
He is protected by the other pieces. Do you want to play?
Why can I not move my queen right away?
You must follow the rules to win. Do you know how pawns move?
Why is it so hard to win a game?
It takes time to think and plan. Do you like to solve puzzles?
Why does the board have eight rows and eight columns?
I do not know the exact history. Do you want to try a move?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel so tired and my brain hurts today. Why did the day go so wrong?
I do not know for sure, but hard work can tire you out. Did you drink enough water?
Yes, I did drink water. Why do I still feel so low?
Sometimes we just need rest to feel good again. Did you have a warm bath?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I wish I could hold the rainbow in my hands.
That sounds hard to do. Do you like red the most?
I feel left out because it keeps moving away.
It is only light and water. Do you see any clouds?
I just want a piece of it for my room.
You can paint one instead.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do my neighbours smoke outside?
Maybe they like the fresh air. Do you smoke too?
No, I do not. Why do some have big gardens?
I do not know for sure. Do you want to plant a plant?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I lost my red ball in the park. Can you help me look?
I can try to help you find it. What color is the bench you saw it near?
It was near the big blue slide.
I do not know where the ball is exactly. Let us check by the slide.
I do not see it. I am so sad.
It is okay to feel sad. Maybe we should look again by the trees.
Oh! It is behind the tree!
You found it! I am happy for you. Do you want to play?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The lights just went out. Is everything okay?
I think a big storm cut the power. Do you have candles ready?
No, I do not. Is there another way to see?
You can use your phone light. Is your phone full of battery?
Yes, it is full. When will the power come back?
I do not know for sure. Are you safe in the dark?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do fish like bait?
It looks like food to them. Do you catch big fish?
I only catch small ones. Why is the water wet?
Water is wet by nature. I do not know why it is so.
Why does the worm wiggle?
It wants to move and survive. Does your worm wiggle a lot?
It moves a lot. Why do I pull the line?
To pull the fish out of the water. Is it hard work?
It is very hard. Why do I keep doing it?
It is fun and relaxing. Did you catch anything today?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My boss yelled at me for a small mistake.
That must feel very bad. Did you cry?
I did, but I tried to fix it fast.
Fixing things takes great strength. Are you calm now?
I am tired but the work is done.
Good job on finishing. Do you need help with dinner?
No, just some quiet time and tea.
That sounds like a perfect plan.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late, where should I cast my line?
Try the big oak tree by the bank. Do you have worms?
Yes, I have them, but I need a spot with fish.
Look for small bubbles in the water. Are you catching anything?
The bubbles are there, but I see no fish.
Fish hide deep, so you must wait. Do you like waiting?
I hate waiting, I need to go soon.
The lake is quiet, so just sit and listen.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a box that eats things but has no teeth. What is it?
Is it something you touch?
Yes, I can touch it.
Does it have a face?
No, it does not.
Is it a trash can?
No, it is not.
I do not know the answer.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a nice cake. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help. Do you have the flour ready?
I have the flour. What should I do next?
Mix in the sugar and eggs. Are you using a big bowl?
I am using a big bowl. Is that good?
It is good. Now put it in the hot oven. Do you know how long to bake it?
I do not know. How long should I wait?
Wait for twenty minutes. Does your kitchen smell sweet?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel sad today. My dog is sick.
I am so sorry your dog is not feeling well. Do you think he will get better?
I am not sure. I miss playing with him.
That is a very hard feeling. Do you want to draw a picture for him?
I don't know how to draw. I just want to hug him.
Hugging him is a very good idea. I hope he feels better soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go, but I must ask. Do you know my favorite book?
I do not know your name. What is the title?
It is The Cat in the Hat. I am late.
That is a fun story. Do you like the fish?
Yes, they are cute. I must run now.
Good luck. I will wait if you return.
I will not return. Bye.
Okay. See you later.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not know how to start. My hand feels tired and cold.
That is hard. What word is on your mind first?
I want to say sorry. It sits in my throat.
You can just write that.
But what if they do not forgive me?
You cannot control their choice. Have you eaten yet?
No, I am too angry.
Anger makes writing messy. Please take a bite.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My lights are off. Can you turn them on fast? I am late.
I can help find the switch. Is the main breaker on?
Yes. Where is the breaker box?
It is usually on the wall near the door. Do you see a small door there?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am trying to sing "Twinkle Twinkle."
That is a nice song. Do you know the whole words?
I only know the first two lines.
You can learn more tomorrow.
I am glad you told me that.
I am happy to help. What is your favorite part of the song?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I won the card game! It is so much fun to play.
That is great to hear! Do you like to play with friends?
Yes, I always invite my brother to join us.
He must be very happy to play too.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
They collect nectar from flowers and bring it back to the hive. Do you know what nectar looks like?
It looks like sweet syrup, right?
Yes, it is a thick sweet liquid from the flower. Have you ever seen a bee fly?
I have, they are very small.
That is true, they are tiny workers. Do you like eating honey?
I love putting it on my toast.
That sounds delicious and healthy. You are welcome to ask more.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to paint a lighthouse on my wall.
That sounds like fun. Do you have blue paint?
Yes, I have blue and white.
Mix them to make a sea color. Do you want a tall or short house?
I want it tall so it can see far.
You are right, tall helps it see. Do you have a big brush?
I have a small brush only.
A small brush is fine for the top. Do you like clouds?
Yes, I like fluffy clouds.
Paint white puffs in the sky. Do you want stars too?
No, I want it to be day.
Then add a yellow sun in the corner. Do you like the plan?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I help a wild bird that has fallen from its nest?
Put it gently back in the nest if you can reach it. Are you sure the branch is safe to stand on?
Yes, the branch looks strong.
That is a good way to help.
What if I cannot find the nest?
You can take it to a local wildlife rescue center. Do you have your phone with you?
Yes, I do.
Great, they will know what to do next.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My feet hurt from walking today.
That sounds tiring. Do you like the red ones?
Yes, the red ones look good.
They are very bright and fun. What is your shoe size?
I think it is a size eight.
That is a good size. Do you want to try them on?
Yes, I will sit down now.
I will get the size eight for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I start work tomorrow and I need to fix a loose chair leg.
That is easy. Do you have a wooden wedge or some paper?
Yes, I have a thick piece of paper and some glue.
Great. Fold the paper small and glue it into the gap so it holds tight.
Do I let it dry before I sit on it?
Yes, wait until it is hard so it does not fall out.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights just went out. I am scared and do not know what to do.
Do not worry. Do you have a flashlight?
I think so, but I cannot find it in the dark.
Breathe slowly. Is it in your pocket?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The lights went out and I must leave right now. Can you tell me why?
I do not know the exact cause. Are you going to a meeting?
I have a big deal to close in ten minutes. What do I do?
Use a flashlight to see where you are going.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am worried about my next day at school.
It is normal to feel nervous, but you will be fine. Do you have a favorite subject to look forward to?
I do not like reading because it is hard.
Reading gets easier with practice. What kind of books do you usually like to read?
I like stories about dragons.
That is a great choice for you. Would you like to bring that book to school?
I do not know if I can bring my book.
I am not sure about your specific class rules. You should ask your teacher to be safe.
I will ask my teacher today.
That is a very good plan.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just cleaned my room and I am so happy.
That is wonderful news. What did you clean first?
I dusted the shelves and made my bed.
Great job. Does your house smell nice now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared of the dark in the tent.
That is okay to feel. Do you want to keep your small light on?
Yes, please. The woods are very quiet.
Quiet is good for sleeping. Do you hear any birds?
I heard a big crash outside.
That might just be a branch. I am not sure.
I am still a little scared.
Take a deep breath. You are safe here.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people get a first job?
It helps you learn new skills. Do you like learning?
Is it hard to start?
It can feel scary, but it gets better. What are you afraid of?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my tea taste so sweet?
Is it because you added sugar?
No, I did not add anything.
Then it is the natural taste of the leaves. Do you like it hot?
Yes, I do. What about coffee?
Coffee often tastes bitter. Do you like bitter things?
Not really. I only like sweet drinks.
That is fine. You can choose what you like.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired after cleaning the floor.
That sounds hard. Did you take a break?
No, I have to finish the kitchen too.
Yikes, that is a lot of work.
I do not know if I can make it.
Let us do one small thing at a time.
Is there a quick trick to wash dishes?
I do not know a magic trick, but warm water helps.
Okay, I will try that next.
Good luck. How are you feeling now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do songs make me feel happy?
Happy tunes help your brain feel good. Do you have a favorite song?
Yes, I like fast drums. Why are they fun to listen to?
Fast beats make your body want to move. Do you dance when you hear them?
I do sometimes. But why do some songs sound sad?
I do not know for sure, but they may show us feelings. Do you like sad songs?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with the sun.
It gives us warm light. Do you like to feel the heat?
I guess I do, but I am still unsure.
Go outside and watch it shine.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so late. The bus was very slow today.
That is very frustrating. Did you have to run to get here?
Yes, I ran fast, but my shoe got stuck.
Oh no, that is tricky. Is your foot okay?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Can you help me find the red door?
Yes, it is right there. Are you going to work?
Yes, I am. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Run fast!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How does the internet work?
It is like a huge net of cables linking computers. Do you like playing games online?
Yes, but why is it so fast?
The data travels very quickly through the wires and air. I do not know every technical detail.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to walk, but I do not know where to start.
You can start by walking for five minutes each day. Do you have a park near your home?
I do not know what to wear for the cold.
Wear a warm coat and good shoes to keep you safe.
I am afraid I will get too tired and stop.
It is okay to rest if you feel tired. Do you like to walk with a friend?
I do not know how far I should go each day.
Start with a short walk and add one minute each week.
I am still not sure I can do this.
You can do one small step at a time. I am happy to help you plan.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you know where the small shoe sizes are?
They are in the back room on the low shelf. Do you like red or blue?
I think I want blue.
The blue shoes are right next to the red ones. Are they for a party?
Yes, for a party.
That is great. Let me help you find the perfect pair.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sand so warm?
The sun heats it up all day. Do you like hot sand?
Yes, but why does the water pull the sand away?
The waves push it out. Do you see the tide line?
I do. Why is the water salty?
I do not know for sure. It is very old.
Why do the seagulls cry so loud?
They are hungry. Do you want to feed them?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want a robot, but I do not know which one to get.
That is a fun idea. What do you want it to do for you?
I want it to read me a story every night.
A reading robot sounds very sweet. Do you like funny stories?
Yes, I love the ones that make me laugh.
Great. You can pick one that tells jokes.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I love bananas.
They are sweet and easy to peel. Do you like them green or yellow?
Yellow is best.
Yes, yellow ones are soft. Is your mother there too?
She is making juice.
That sounds yummy. Is it sweet or sour?
It is sweet.
Sweet juice is nice. Do you add sugar?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do trees have feelings?
I do not know for sure, but they react to changes. Do you think they feel happy?
Maybe when it rains?
Yes, water helps them grow. Do you like playing in the rain?
Not really, it is too cold.
That is okay. Do you prefer sunny days?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very scared about my test.
That is a normal feeling. Do you like the topic?
I have read the book twice.
Good work. What part confuses you most?
The last chapter is too hard.
We can look at it together.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I saw a small fox in my yard. It looks very thin and sad.
That sounds scary. Did it look hurt or just cold?
It does not look hurt. But I want to help it. What do I do?
Please do not feed it wild food. Do you live near a vet?
No, I do not know a vet. Should I call the police?
Do not call the police for a healthy fox. Try to find a local wildlife rescue number.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to sit still in class?
Sitting still helps us learn better. Do you like moving around?
Yes, I like running. Why can we not play all day?
Play is good, but school is for learning. Is it hard to stop running?
Yes, it is. Why do we have to write words?
Writing helps us tell stories. Do you like drawing pictures?
I like drawing. Why do we have to go to bed early?
Sleep makes your brain grow strong. Do you feel tired at school?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I just moved here. Is this town new?
Yes, it is very new. Do you like the red roof on your house?
I do not know where to play. Is there a park nearby?
There is a big green park right down the street. Do you like playing in the grass?
I saw a dog in the park. Is it safe to pet him?
I do not know if that dog is friendly. You should ask an adult first.
Okay, I will ask my dad. I am happy to be here.
That is good. I am glad you feel happy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the library today. I found a book about big cats.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you read it all the way through?
Yes, I read about lions and tigers. The pictures were very good.
I am glad you enjoyed it. Do you know where the new books are?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The street is so quiet. I want to learn how to listen with my whole body.
That is a nice way to notice things. Do you sit still first?
Yes, I sit very still. How do I let my ears do the work?
Just breathe slow and wait for the sounds. Is there a bird singing nearby?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see the blue sky and I want to know why.
Sunlight has many colors. The blue part scatters in the air. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, I do. What does scatter mean?
It means the light bounces around. It fills the whole sky. Is it sunny today?
It is very bright outside. Thank you for explaining it.
You are welcome. I am glad you are happy. Do you have more questions?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to play tennis, but I am afraid to fall.
Falling is part of learning. Are you scared of the court?
Yes, it feels big and hard.
Try a small step first. Do you have your shoes on?
No, I only have socks.
Get your shoes on now. Do you like red balls?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my cat purr when I touch its belly?
It purrs because it feels safe and happy. Is your cat a big or small cat?
It is a small cat. Why does it rub its face against my legs?
It leaves its scent on you to say you are its friend. I do not know if it likes you best.
Does it like me best? Why does it bring me dead birds?
It thinks the bird is a gift for you. Do you throw the birds away?
Yes, I always throw them away. Why does it do that if I do not like them?
It wants to share good food with you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My little sister cried today.
That is a sad day. Do you know why she cried?
She broke her toy car.
Cars can break easily. Did you help fix it?
I gave her my red truck.
That was very kind of you. Did she smile then?
Yes, she did.
I am glad she is happy now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a box with no lid. How do I close it?
You cannot close a box that has no top. Do you have a cover for it?
No, I do not. I only have the open box.
Then you must keep it open. Does that make you sad?
I am just very confused. What should I do next?
You should put something inside it. What did you plan to store?
I wanted to put my toys in it.
That is a good plan. You can just place them inside.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just passed my driving test today! It feels so good.
That is wonderful news! How did you feel in the car?
I felt calm and the teacher said I did a great job.
I am glad you stayed calm. Did you get any surprises on the road?
Not really, the weather was clear and the roads were quiet.
That sounds like a perfect day for driving.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting in the plane for so long.
That feels bad. Did you drink much water?
Yes, but I still feel stiff and tired.
Try walking down the aisle a bit. Do you feel weak?
I just want to get to my hotel.
Your body needs rest to fix the hurt.
What should I do when I get home?
I do not know your home routine. Do you have time for a nap?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my little orange fish swimming so fast near the top of the tank?
It might be looking for food or air. Do you feed it every day?
Yes, I do, but it still swims up there a lot.
That could be normal play, or maybe the water is warm. Is the water cool to the touch?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to draw a tree.
Try drawing a big circle on top of a small line. What color do you like trees to be?
I want to use only brown paint.
That is a nice choice. Good luck with your art.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to draw pictures of cats. Do they like fish?
Yes, many cats love to eat fish. Do you draw your own cat?
I do not have a cat, but I like them. Is it hard to learn how to swim?
Cats are good swimmers, but they only do it if they must. Why do you want to know?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to find a book about dragons.
You should look in the fiction section. Do you like scary stories?
Yes, I do.
Great. Check the dark blue shelves. Do you like magic stories?
Not really. I prefer action.
Try the red shelves then. Do you want a story about knights?
Yes, that sounds good.
Perfect. Have fun reading.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse today. It looked so happy.
That sounds nice. Was it eating grass?
Yes, it was. I wish I could ride it.
Riding is fun. Do you like riding?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not like the end of the book.
That is okay. Many stories feel sad. Do you think the hero can change the ending?
I do not know if he can.
You are right to wonder. Perhaps he tries next time. Are you sad or just worried?
I am a little bit scared.
Fear is a normal feeling. It shows you care. Do you like the cat in the story?
I love the cat very much.
That is a good sign. The cat is safe. Do you want to read another book?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are mountains so tall?
They are tall because the earth pushed them up from the ground. Do you like looking at big hills?
Yes, I do. Why do they have sharp tops?
The wind and water have worn the rock over a long time. Do you like to climb?
I do. Why is it cold up there?
It is colder because you are farther from the warm sun. Do you bring a coat?
I do. Why do people like to go up them?
People like the view and the fresh air. Do you like views?
I do. Why is the sky blue up there?
I do not know why it looks different. Do you think it is pretty?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix my boat today. The red part is broken.
A red break? Is it in the middle of the hull?
Yes, right in the middle. I must leave soon.
That sounds like a big fix. Do you have spare wood?
No, I have no wood. I am late.
We can use rope to hold it. Are you sure the water is calm?
The water is calm. Please help me tie it.
Tie here tight. It should hold for a short trip.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why should I take a walk every day?
It helps your heart and makes you feel calm. Do you like fresh air?
Does it really make my body stronger?
Yes, your legs and bones get tougher. How far do you usually go?
I get tired very fast.
That is okay. Start with a short trip and grow slower.
Is it good for my brain too?
Yes, it helps you think clearly. Do you like to think while walking?
I will try it tomorrow morning.
That is a great plan. I hope you have fun.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to pick a fresh tomato. How do I know if it is good?
Press it gently. A good one feels firm but gives a little. Do you like big or small ones?
I like small ones. What if it smells like nothing?
It should smell sweet, like the whole plant. If it has no smell, it may be old. Is that okay for you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My screen is black. I need to leave now.
Try tapping the power button. Do you see any lights?
No lights. It is dead.
It needs a charge. Plug it in for a minute. Do you have the cable?
Yes, here. It wakes up.
Great. Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. The floor is still dirty.
That sounds hard. Did you take a break?
No, I just keep cleaning. I feel sad.
It is okay to stop for now. Do you want some water?
Yes, please. Maybe I can rest.
Good idea. Resting helps you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my baby cry all the time?
It is how they tell you they need help. Are you sleeping okay?
Why does he have so much hair?
That is just his body growing. Does he have more hair than me?
Why does he stare at the light?
He is learning to see. I do not know for sure. Do you like the new little face?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to bake a loaf right now. What is the first step?
Mix the flour and water first. Are you using yeast?
I forgot the yeast. Can I still make it?
You can try, but it will not rise. Do you have a stove?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind feels so cold today. I do not know what to wear.
Put on your warm coat. Do you have a hat?
I have a hat, but the air is wet. It makes me feel sick.
That sounds not good. You can sit by a window for a bit.
A window? But the wind is still blowing. It is too strong.
I am not sure if that will help. Let us find a wall instead.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am nervous about the big talk tomorrow.
It is normal to feel scared. Do you have a plan for what to say?
I have notes, but my hands shake.
Deep breaths can help. Have you tried breathing slowly?
I tried, but my heart beats fast.
Try holding an ice cube. Did that trick work for you before?
No, I do not like cold things.
That is okay. Just look at friendly faces.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not know what time it is.
The clock on the wall says it is two o'clock. Do you see the short hand?
That hand is pointing down.
Yes, it points to the number two. That is how we tell the hour.
Why does it not point up?
Because two is below twelve on the face. Is the long hand hard to read?
It is so hard. I get so mad when I do not know the time.
It is okay to feel that way. Would you like to practice with me?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My throat hurts and I feel cold.
Drink warm tea and rest in bed. Do you have a thermometer?
No, I do not have one.
Rest is the best cure. Does your nose run?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to count the apples in this basket.
Great! Start at one and say a number for each apple. Do you have any red ones?
Yes, there are three red ones.
Good! Now count the green ones and add them to the three. What number do you get?
I get seven in total.
Well done!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent all day surfing the web.
That sounds like a lot of looking. Did you find something fun?
Yes, I looked up how bees make honey.
Bees are very busy workers. Do you like watching them?
A little, but my screen went dark before I finished.
That can be confusing. Do you have a backup way to see things?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
The people here like to rest in peace. Do you hear any birds?
No, I do not hear any birds.
That is odd for a bright day. Are you feeling lonely?
Yes, I am a bit sad here.
Sadness can follow us to quiet places. It may help you think.
I just want some noise.
Loud sounds can hurt your ears. Would you like to read a book?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. My surprise gift is broken.
I am sorry. What did the gift do for you?
It made a loud noise and then stopped working.
That is not fun. Do you know how to fix it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to float on the river.
That is a fun goal. Do you know how to swim a little?
I can kick my legs, but I get scared.
Try floating on your back with your eyes open. Is the water deep there?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is nice to hear.
I made some hot tea.
Does it smell good?
Yes, it is warm and sweet.
That sounds lovely.
I also have coffee for you.
I do not like bitter drinks.
Okay, just tea then.
Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The fence looks tired and old.
That is hard to see. Is it broken?
It is just pale and weak.
You can paint it again. Do you like colors?
I do not know what color is right.
Green matches the grass. I do not know your taste.
Maybe I should take it down.
That is a big job. Do you have time?
I am not sure I can do it.
Start with one small piece. It will help.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: There is a big fire going on outside. It is very red and hot.
That looks scary. Are you safe inside the house?
Yes, I am in my room with Mom and Dad. I cannot see the whole thing.
Good, stay where you are. Do you see any smoke coming from the roof?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I wanted a toy but I have no money left.
That is a hard feeling. Did you save any coins for it?
No, I spent it all on candy. I feel so bad.
It is okay to make a mistake. Do you want to try saving for next time?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I love apples. Why do you like them?
They are sweet and crunchy. Do you like red ones?
Yes, I do. Why are they red?
They turn red in the sun. I do not know the exact reason.
That is interesting. What is your favorite color of apple?
I like green ones. They are very fresh.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know which season comes next.
Winter comes after autumn. Do you like the snow?
I think snow is cold, but I like it.
That is true. Do you wear a warm hat?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a cool shiny rock today. It is blue.
That sounds great. Do you have a box to keep it in?
Yes, I have a big red box. It fits many things.
Nice. What else is in your box?
I also have some smooth pebbles. They are round.
Oh, that is interesting. Do you like picking them up?
Yes, I love picking up small things. It makes me smile.
That is good. Keep collecting.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a red leaf drop from the tree. It looked so tired.
Trees let leaves go in fall to save their energy for winter. Did you catch it?
Yes, I put it in my pocket. It was dry and cold.
That is a sweet thing to do. Nature sleeps for a while during the cold months. Do you like walking in the park?
I do, but my toes get very cold. Why do trees lose their leaves?
They drop leaves so the tree does not lose too much water when it is frozen.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The screen shows red lines and I feel lost.
Do you like to play games online?
Yes, but the words are hard to read.
I do not know that game well. Is it loud or quiet?
It is very loud and I want to stop.
You can close the tab to be safe. Does that feel better?
Yes, I feel calm now.
Good. Do you want to read a story instead?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the trees lose their leaves in fall?
It is cold and dark, so the trees rest. Do you like raking leaves?
Why is the sun so hot in summer?
The earth leans toward the sun, so we get more light. Do you enjoy swimming?
Why is winter so long and quiet?
The days are short, so nature sleeps. Do you like building snowmen?
Why does spring feel so happy?
I do not know the exact reason, but everything wakes up.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a bad cold and feel very sick.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you have a fever?
Yes, my head hurts and my nose is stuffed up.
Please drink warm fluids and rest a lot. Is it hurting your throat?
A little bit, but mostly my chest feels tight.
I do not know for sure what is wrong with your chest. Please tell a grown up or doctor.
Okay, I will go ask my mom now.
That is a very good plan. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the boat broken?
I think so, but I am not sure. Do you see any smoke?
No, I do not see smoke.
That is good. It is just resting. Can you hear the water?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I float on my back?
Keep your nose in the water and kick your legs gently. Do you like the feel of the water?
Yes, I do. What if I feel scared?
That is okay. Start with just your face in the water first.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very sad. My wedding is soon and I do not know what to buy.
That feels hard. Do you like soft colors?
I like blue. But my mom wants red. I do not know what to do.
You must pick what makes you happy. Do you trust her taste?
Yes, but I want to wear blue. It feels like me. Blue is my truth.
Wear the blue. You will shine bright.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have to go to a big meeting now.
That sounds exciting. What will you do there?
I will sit down and look at the tables.
Nice. Do you have a seat ready?
My mom says I need to be very quiet.
Good rule. Will you listen to the talk?
Yes, but I might get sleepy.
That happens. Take a deep breath before you start.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to eat for lunch.
Do you like cold food or hot food?
I like hot food, but I am tired.
That is a hard choice. Have you eaten anything sweet today?
No, I have not eaten any sweet things yet.
You could try a warm soup then.
I do not like soup very much.
Okay, let us pick a different thing.
A sandwich is good, but it is a lot of work to make.
You can buy one at the shop if you are too tired to cook.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My phone fell in the mud today.
That is a messy spot. Did you clean it off?
Yes, I washed it with a wet cloth.
Good work. It looks shiny again.
Now it rings a happy tune.
That sounds nice.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do magnets pull on some things and not others?
They only pull on iron and a few other metals. Do you have a magnet at home?
Yes, I have one, but why does it stick to the fridge?
Your fridge door has steel inside, so the magnet grabs on. What else does it stick to?
It sticks to my coat rack too. Does it get tired?
No, magnets do not get tired, but they can lose their strength over time. Do you want to keep yours safe?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a snowman.
That is fun. Do you have a shovel?
Yes, I do.
Great. Dig a hole for the base.
The snow is wet.
Wet snow holds well. Do you want to make it big?
Very big.
Okay. Stack a smaller one on top.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to play at the beach.
You can build a sand castle in the dry sand. Do you like to dig in the wet sand?
I think I want to look for shells.
That is a good choice. Do you like looking for stars too?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
They use their roots to pull water up into their stems. Do you have any plants at home?
Yes! But why does the water go up?
It moves through tiny tubes like a straw.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate climbing. My legs hurt so bad.
That sounds really tiring. What do you miss about being home?
I miss my warm bed and my mom's soup.
I understand that feeling. Do you have a friend with you?
No, I am all alone up here. It feels cold and quiet.
I am sorry you feel lonely. I do not know if the view is worth the pain, but I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at this shiny rock I found.
It is a lovely find. Where did you see it?
I picked it up in the park by the tree.
That sounds like a quiet place. Did you look for long?
Yes, I walked around for a bit.
I am glad you liked it. Do you want to keep it?
Yes, I want to put it on my desk.
It will look nice there. You have a happy day.
Thank you, I feel very good about it.
I am happy for you. Tell me about your day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say sorry?
We say sorry to show we care. Do you know what that word means?
I think it means I made a bad choice.
That is true. It helps fix a hurt feeling. Does that help?
Yes, it makes me feel less bad.
That is good. It shows you are kind. Do you want to practice?
How do I do it?
Just look them in the eye. Say it with a soft voice. Can you do that?
I will try to be brave.
You can do it. It takes courage to apologize.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I fit my clothes into a small bag?
You should roll them up tight. Do you have a lot of shirts?
Yes, I have many. What else should I do?
Put the heavy items at the bottom. That helps with balance.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the market square close to the river?
Yes, it is just a short walk away. Do you like walking?
I do, but the sun is very bright today.
That is true. Do you have a hat with you?
No, I left it at home.
I am sorry you do not have one.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very scared and I do not know what to do.
It is okay to feel scared. Are you worried about a specific thing?
I do not know. It just feels heavy inside my chest.
That sounds hard. Do you want to take a slow breath together?
I guess I am afraid of making a bad choice.
You can make a small step first. What is the smallest thing you could try?
Maybe I will just sit here and think for a minute.
That is a good plan. I am here if you need more time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My friend Sam left for a new school.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you miss playing with him?
Yes, I do. We do not talk much now.
That feels sad, but he still likes you. Did you send him a letter?
I did not know how to ask.
It is okay to be quiet. You can just say hello next time.
Will he be happy there?
I do not know his feelings. I hope he finds new friends to play with.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the library today and found a book about dragons.
That sounds like fun. What did the dragons look like?
They had big red wings and sharp teeth. I almost opened it in the hallway.
Oh no. Did the librarian see you?
Yes, she gave me a funny look. I had to sit down and read there.
She just wants the books to stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a big hole in the fence today.
Oh no, that sounds tricky. Did you see what made it?
I think a dog dug it up.
That is a common garden problem. Is the hole easy to fix?
It is small, so I will use wood.
Good plan for a repair. What color is your fence?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now. Can you make me sleep faster with this book?
I cannot make you sleep, but I can make you feel calm. Do you like the story?
No. It is too long.
That is good. Long stories wait for you. Do you want to read just the last page?
Yes. That works.
Good. The last page is short and sweet. Good night.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say sorry?
We say it to show care. Do you like giving gifts?
Yes, I do. Why does it matter?
It makes people feel safe. Do you like feeling safe?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My teacher gave me a red mark on my work. I feel very sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you try to ask why?
I did ask, but she was very busy. She just said it was wrong.
That can be hard to hear. Do you know which part was wrong?
I think I used the wrong letter. I am not a good speller.
Spelling is tough for many people. Would you like to practice it together?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I learn a new language?
Start with simple words and speak them out loud. Do you know which language you want to learn?
I want to learn Spanish because I like food.
That is a great reason to start. What is your favorite Spanish food?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad because I did not do well on my test.
I am sorry you feel that way. What part of the test was hard for you?
I felt so proud when I studied, but then I forgot everything.
That is a confusing feeling. Did you try to calm your mind before the test?
I do not know. I just feel silly for trying so hard.
You are not silly. Hard work is always good.
But I am still upset about the grade.
It is okay to be upset. Do you want to talk about what you got right?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it going to rain today?
I think so. The sky looks very gray. Do you have an umbrella?
I do. Do you like the rain?
Yes, I do. It makes the air feel fresh. What will you do in the storm?
I will read a book. That sounds nice.
It is a good idea. Stay safe and dry.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a robot toy but I do not know how to start it.
That is a tricky thing. Do you have a book with pictures?
I do not see a book, and I am stuck.
You can try pressing the big red button. Is it a robot that moves its arms?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I saw a big ship in the bay.
That sounds wonderful. Do you like watching boats?
Yes, I love the tall masts. They look like they can touch the sky.
That is a nice thought. Do you know what the tall part is called?
I think it is called a mast. It helps the sails fly.
Yes, you are right. The wind makes the sails move.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the moon look so bright?
The moon shines because it reflects the sun's light. Do you see stars too?
Yes, I do. But why does the moon change its shape?
It changes shape because we see different parts as it orbits Earth.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the market this morning.
That sounds like fun. What did you buy there?
I picked a big red apple.
Apples are sweet and crisp. Did you eat it right away?
I saved it for lunch with my bread.
That is a nice, healthy plan.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My clock ticked all morning, but it stopped at noon.
That is strange. Did the battery run out?
I think so. I put in a new one and wound it up.
Good thinking. Do you know how to change the time?
I pushed the little knob and set it to one o'clock.
Nice work. Does it make a sound when it ticks?
Yes, it makes a soft tick tock sound again.
I am glad it works. Do you like the new sound?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is a good thing. What makes you feel this way?
The sand is soft and warm.
That sounds very nice.
The water is clear and blue.
I love the blue color. Do you see any fish?
Yes, I see small red fish.
How lovely.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a fox today. Is it safe?
It is usually safe if you stay still. Do you live near woods?
Yes, I do. What if it follows me?
You should not chase it, and you should make yourself look big. Do you have a dog at home?
No, I do not. Can it hurt me?
It might bite if it feels scared, so keep your distance. I do not know why that specific fox was out there.
That makes sense. I will just wave and walk away.
That is a very good plan. Always be calm and kind. Do you like watching birds too?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My head hurts bad. I am late.
Oh no. Is it a bang?
No. I forgot my water.
Drink soon. Did you eat?
I must go now.
Go safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sad to see so many leaves on the ground. What should I do?
It is nature's way of resting for the cold time. Do you like to walk in the park?
I do not know if I should walk or stay home to watch the leaves fall.
Walking helps you feel warm and happy. Do you have a nice coat on?
Yes, I have my red coat. But I still feel confused about why the trees let go.
Trees drop leaves to save energy while they sleep. Do you like to see them change color?
I do not know if I am ready to go outside yet.
You can always come back inside if it feels too chilly.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to know how people lived long ago.
People used tools made from stone. Did you know we still use stone?
Yes, I have seen stone in a wall. What did they eat?
They ate plants and hunted animals. Do you like wild food?
Not really, I prefer cooked meals. How did they cook?
They used fire to warm their food. Did you ever eat by fire?
Yes, I had a hot dog once. Did they have clothes?
They wore skins and leaves. I do not know if they had warm socks.
That sounds cold. Why did they not wear fur?
Fur kept them very warm. Do you like wearing fur?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What should I eat to feel strong?
Try fruit and veggies. Do you like peas?
I like apples but I hate peas.
Apples are great. What is your favorite fruit?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I save my work on the computer?
Look for a little floppy disk icon in the top left. Do you know where your file is?
I see it, but what happens if I do not click it?
Your work might get lost. Is that a big project?
Yes, it is my drawing. How do I find it later?
You can open the folder where you saved it. Do you have a special name for the file?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to get better at kicking the ball, but I always miss.
That is hard to learn. Do you kick with your big toe?
I use my whole foot, but it feels clunky.
Try focusing on your laces next time. Keep your eyes on the ball, not the goal.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why am I putting socks in my bag?
You need them to keep your feet warm and clean. Do you have enough pairs for the trip?
Why does the bag have a zipper?
It keeps your things safe from falling out. Is it hard to close?
Why is the bag so heavy?
Heavy bags are hard to carry. What did you pack that is heavy?
Why do I need to pack light?
Light bags let you move easier. Are you excited for the trip?
Why is my bag ready now?
It is ready because we packed all your needs. Let us go!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to pack my bag for school?
So you have your books and lunch. Do you have your lunch ready?
I packed it, but why do we need a pen?
You need it to write on paper. Did you remember to pack it?
Yes. Why do I need a bottle of water?
To keep you from getting thirsty. Do you want to fill it now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I think I am ready to go to school.
Your bag looks light. Did you put your book in?
Yes, I packed my book and my snack.
Great job. Do you have your water bottle?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a magnet stick to a wall?
You can use a small piece of tape on the back. Do you have any tape?
Yes, I have some clear tape. Will that work?
Yes, it works very well. Is the wall smooth?
It is a smooth white wall. Will the tape hurt it?
It might leave a tiny mark. Do you mind a small mark?
No, that is fine. I do not care about marks.
Great, then just press it down hard. Are you ready to try?
Yes, I am ready. Thank you for helping.
You are welcome. Have fun with your project.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am going to a party but I feel sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. What is making you sad?
I do not know what to wear.
Pick something you like best. Does it feel comfortable?
Yes, but I am afraid of people.
Just look at their eyes and smile. Do you have a friend there?
I do not know anyone there.
That is okay. Just listen to the music and look at the food.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The boats bobbed up and down.
That must look like a dance. Do you see any seagulls?
Yes, they are flying over the water.
They are watching the ships, too.
I am so happy to be here.
Your smile is very bright. What is your favorite part?
The sound of the water lapping against the dock.
It is a peaceful sound.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Did you hide the gift?
Yes, it is in the box. Are you coming to party?
No, I am running for the bus.
It is safe. Do not worry.
Please keep it dry.
I will. Will you be here soon?
I am going now.
See you later. Have a good ride.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I just finished a book about horses. How do I make one out of paper?
That is a very tall game. Do you like to fold?
Yes, I love folding paper into animals.
Fold the paper in half. Cut a shape for the body and head. Glue them together. Do you have glue?
Yes, I have some glue and scissors.
Good. Cut the ears and tail. Glue them on. You are doing great work.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I met a new friend today. I want to be their best friend.
That is a lovely thing to do. Is this friend kind to you?
Yes, they always smile at me. But I feel shy to talk to them.
Smiles are a great start. Do you like playing with balls?
I love kicking a ball around. I do not know if they do too.
You can just ask them simply. Sometimes people say yes more than you think.
Should I ask them to play right now? I am afraid of saying the wrong thing.
You will not say the wrong thing. A true friend likes honest talk. Do you like seeing friends?
I love seeing friends a lot. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Go have some fun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do they send letters here?
Yes, they send letters to many places. Do you like to write?
How do I give the letter?
You put it in the box. Is it for your grandma?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sick in this moving train.
Drink some water and sit still. Do you have your favorite toy?
No, I forgot it at home. I just want to go outside.
That is tough. You have to wait until we stop.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My new friend left me waiting today. I felt very sad.
I am sorry you felt that way. Did you tell him you were upset?
No, I just went home and cried. Why does he do this?
It is hard to know why others act that way.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost. I do not know how to start learning a new language.
That is a normal feeling. Do you like singing songs?
Yes, I love to sing. But I am afraid of making mistakes.
Mistakes help you learn. Do you practice with a friend?
No, I study alone. I feel tired and bored.
Try small goals each day. What word do you want to learn first?
I think I will start with "hello."
That is a great start. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to sleep fast.
Drink some warm milk? Do you like milk?
No time for milk.
Try to breathe slow. Is your body tight?
Just need to close my eyes.
Keep them warm. Do you have a big hug?
Good night.
Good night.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Guess what? It is my birthday today.
Oh, happy birthday! How do you feel?
I feel very happy and excited.
That is wonderful to hear.
I want to tell everyone about my day.
That sounds fun. Who are you telling first?
I will call my best friend.
A great plan.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I knocked over my milk this morning. It made a big mess.
That sounds scary. Did you clean it up?
Yes, I used a towel. I felt very sad about it.
I am glad you helped. Do you want to drink juice instead?
I am sorry for the mess. I want to try again.
It is okay to say sorry. I am proud of you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did the bird fly away?
It was cold and it needed to find a warm nest. Do you like birds?
I do. Why did it choose that tree?
The branches were strong and the leaves looked green. Was it a sunny day?
Yes. Why did the bear sleep so long?
It was winter and bears sleep to save energy. I do not know why it chose that cave.
Why did the sun come out?
The clouds got tired and moved away. Did you see it shine?
I did. Why did the story end then?
The happy part was done. Thank you for asking.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want a white dress for the wedding.
White is a lovely choice for a bride. Do you like long or short sleeves?
I think I want long sleeves.
Long sleeves can keep you warm on a cool day. Is it a cold or warm season?
It is in the winter, so it will be cold.
Good thinking to stay warm. Do you have a plan for your hair?
I will let my hair hang down.
Long hair is very pretty with a white dress. I hope you have a wonderful day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to clean my room, but I do not know where to start.
You can start by picking up all the toys on the floor. Do you have many toys?
Yes, I have a big box of cars and blocks.
Put the blocks in one pile and the cars in another. That makes sorting easy.
What do I do with the pile after that?
Put the blocks back in the toy box first. Then put the cars in the box. Is your box big enough?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend. How do I start?
Start by writing Dear Friend at the top. Is your friend far away?
Yes, he lives in a big city. Do I need to ask anything?
You can ask how he is doing. Do you like to draw?
I love to draw pictures. Should I put one in?
Yes, a picture is a nice touch. Good luck with your letter.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited for the bus for a long time today. My legs hurt and I got very mad.
That must have felt tough. Do you have a trick to help you stay calm?
I tried counting to ten, but it was not enough. The bus still came late.
Counting can help some people. What do you like to do when you feel frustrated?
I took a big drink of water and looked at the sky. The clouds looked like soft animals.
That is a nice way to rest your eyes. Did the bus finally arrive?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to start painting pictures.
That sounds fun. Do you have any brushes yet?
Yes, I have some big ones.
Good. Big brushes are great for filling space.
What colors should I mix first?
Try blue and yellow. It makes a nice green. Do you like the color green?
I do, but I worry it might look messy.
Messy is okay. Art has no rules.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because the sun is bright and warm.
That sounds wonderful to hear. What made you look up at the sun?
I do not know, I just felt good. Can you help me feel even more happy?
I can try to listen to your joy. Do you want to tell me more?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. The sun is coming up.
Take a deep breath. Are we still going?
Yes, but the grass looks wet.
That is true. Do you have a blanket?
I think I left it in the car.
Then do not worry about the grass.
I feel much better now.
Good to hear. Is the food packed?
The sandwiches are in the bag.
That sounds nice. Are you hungry?
Yes, I am very hungry.
Let us go then.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a lot of cards. Do I keep them or throw them away?
Look at the paper. What does it say?
It says I must play one card. I am not sure which one.
Pick the card that feels right.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited for my bus all morning.
That is a long time to wait. How did you feel?
I felt very bored and hot.
I am sorry you were not comfortable. Did you see the bus?
Yes, it came with a loud honk.
Good for you. Did you enjoy the ride?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to type fast, but my hands hurt.
That sounds tough. Do you rest your wrists?
No, I just type for a long time.
You should take small breaks to help your hands stay happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is your favorite holiday?
I really like winter when it snows. Do you like snow too?
Yes, I love making snowmen.
That sounds like so much fun.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to draw a house but I do not know which shapes to use.
You can start with a big square for the walls. What color will your house be?
It will be red. How do I make the roof look right?
A triangle works best for the roof. Do you have any other shapes you want to try?
I like the idea of a door. What shape is best for that?
A tall rectangle makes a nice door.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to feel more happy. How do I do that?
Try smiling for one minute each day. Do you smile often?
I want to learn how to draw. Can you show me?
I cannot show you pictures, but I can suggest an easy shape. Do you like drawing animals?
I do not know how to start. It feels hard.
Start with a circle and add ears. That makes a simple cat.
Thank you for the kind words.
You are welcome. How does that make you feel?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I caught a big fish today.
That is great news! Was it a small or big fish?
It was really big. It jumped in the boat.
Wow, that must have been fun to see. Did you keep it?
Yes, we are having it for dinner. It smells good.
I am glad you enjoyed it. Do you fish often?
Yes, I go every weekend. I love the water.
That sounds like a nice habit. I hope you catch many more.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I get very mad when I have to wait.
That is a common feeling. Do you count to ten?
Sometimes, but the wait still feels long.
Trying to breathe slowly can help. What helps you feel calm?
Sitting in the quiet room feels good.
That sounds like a strong plan.
I will try to use that room more.
Good for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My head hurts very much.
I am sorry you feel bad. Did you sleep enough?
I tried to take a pill.
That is a good step. Do you feel better now?
It still hurts a lot.
That is not good. You should rest.
What else can I do?
I do not know for sure. Drink some water and lie down.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see many pages but I do not know where to go.
That can feel like a big maze. What are you looking for?
I just want to learn how the web works.
The web is like a giant library of connected notes. It is all about links that jump you from one idea to another.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because it snowed and I cannot go outside.
That feels bad. Is it snowing very hard?
Yes, it is all white and quiet.
Quiet can be nice too. Do you want to make hot cocoa?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make pasta but I do not know how. Do you know?
Yes, we boil the water and add the noodles. Do you have a pot?
Yes, I do. How long should I cook them?
Ten minutes is usually good. Do you have sauce?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The bus ride was so much fun today.
That is great to hear. What did you see?
I saw a red dog walking by the road.
A red dog is nice. Did you wave to it?
Yes, I waved and the dog wagged its tail.
How sweet. I am glad you had a happy time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am moving my home today.
That is big work. Do you have all your boxes?
I packed the toys and books.
Good. Are you moving big things too?
Yes, the bed and the table.
That is heavy. Do you have help?
No, just me and my dog.
That sounds hard. Can your dog help lift?
I do not know how to pack glass.
I am not sure about your glass. Put paper around it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to decorate my party. How do I hang balloons?
Tie a string to each balloon. Then, tape the strings to the wall or ceiling. Do you have tape?
Yes, I have some. How do I make a cake?
I don't know how to bake a cake. I can help you find a recipe instead.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do sailors find their way?
They use maps and stars. Do you like looking up?
I do. What if it is cloudy?
They use machines that talk to space. Is that cool to you?
Yes. Do they get lost sometimes?
Very rarely now. I do not know every rule. Are you scared of water?
A little. How do they eat food?
They pack food that lasts long. Do you like dry snacks?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so hungry. My tummy is rumbling.
That is not good. Have you eaten today?
No. I forgot my lunch box at home.
I am sorry about that. I can share my apple.
Really? Can I have the big one?
Of course, you can take the big one. Is that okay for you?
Yes! Thank you very much.
You are welcome. I hope you enjoy it.
It is sweet and nice. I love apples.
Glad you like them. Do you want to play outside now?
No. I want to nap in the quiet room.
That sounds good. Go rest well now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I broke my blue cup today. It was a silly thing.
That is a sad day for the cup. Did you clean up the glass?
Yes, I swept it up. I want to say sorry to Mom.
She will be glad you were safe. What will you say to her?
I will say I am very sorry. I was not careful.
That is a true and kind thing to say. Does that make you feel better?
A little, yes. I still feel bad though.
It is okay to feel bad. You will do better next time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My boss gave me a big task, but I do not know how to start.
That is a tough spot. Do you have any time to read the instructions?
Yes, I read them, but they are still very confusing to me.
Try to ask a friend for help. Do you have a trusted friend nearby?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I want new shoes.
That is great news. Do you like the red pair?
Yes, the red ones are my favorite. I feel lucky to find them.
I am glad you are so happy. What size do you wear?
My feet are size eight. I cannot wait to wear them.
That is a good size. I hope they fit you well.
I am sure they will be perfect. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have fun trying them on.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know the names of all seven days.
They start with Monday and end with Sunday. Do you like weekends?
I mix up Wednesday and Thursday.
That is a hard one for many people. Do you remember Monday?
Please help me not get lost again.
Count them out loud every day. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see a movie that is funny.
What kind of funny do you like?
I like jokes that are silly.
You should try a cartoon. Do you like animals?
Yes, I love dogs and cats.
Then pick a film with a dog hero. It will be fun.
That sounds good. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a nice time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start a box for my toys?
Pick a big empty box. Do you have one ready?
Yes, I have a blue box.
Put your toys in one by one. What is your favorite toy?
My teddy bear.
Place the teddy bear in the box last.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sitting on the sand. I do not know what to play.
That sounds a bit lonely. Do you like making shapes?
I do not know how to make shapes.
You can dig a little hole. What color is your shovel?
My shovel is blue. I am still bored.
Look at the waves. Do you see any crabs?
I see a crab. It is running away.
That is fun. Do you want to throw a ball?
Yes, I like balls. But the water is wet.
Wet sand is perfect for digging. Are you happy now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to sleep in a tent but I am scared of the dark.
That is a big feeling. What is the scariest part for you?
The little noises outside sound like monsters to me.
Nature makes many sounds at night. Do you pack a warm blanket for your trip?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a sandwich but I do not know how. Do you know?
Yes, I can help you. Do you like meat or just vegetables?
I like meat. What do I do first?
Take two slices of bread. Put a slice of ham on the bottom piece.
Okay, I put the ham on. What is the next step?
Add a slice of cheese and a few leaves of lettuce. Do you have any tomatoes?
Yes, I have tomatoes. I put them on top.
Nice. Now close it with the other slice of bread. It is ready to eat.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my little goldfish swim in a big circle today.
That sounds like a happy little guy. Was he chasing something?
No, he was just playing with his own tail.
Fish often play when they feel safe. Do you feed him every morning?
Yes, I give him tiny flakes at eight o'clock.
A steady routine helps them stay healthy. What is his favorite color?
I do not know, but he likes the blue light.
He probably just likes the warmth. Good job taking care of him.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I want a big pizza with lots of cheese.
That sounds tasty. Do you want to share it?
Yes, I have a friend coming to eat with me.
That is very kind. What does your friend like to eat?
They love apple pie.
Apple pie is a good choice. Should I add it to the order?
Yes, please add two slices.
Great. I will get the pizza and the pie ready for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very tired.
That is ok. How did you sleep?
I did not sleep well.
That is hard. Are you hungry?
No, but I am sleepy.
Go to bed now.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I need to buy some red fruit.
You can find it at the round stand. Do you like apples or berries?
I like apples. They are sweet.
Great choice. They are fresh today. Do you want help finding the scale?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am on the bus, but I do not know where to go.
Do you have a map? Please show me where you want to stop.
I do not have a map, so I am lost.
I do not know your exact spot, but you can ask the driver.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The lights are out and I am late.
Did you check the breaker box?
I do not have time to look.
Check the red switch first. Do you know where it is?
It is in the hall closet.
Push it up hard. Is the light back on now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I catch a ladybug safely?
Use a clear jar and a piece of paper. Do you have a jar?
I do, but it has no lid.
Gently place the paper over the top to trap it inside. Would you like to release it later?
Yes, I want to put it back outside.
Carefully slide the paper off in your garden. Do you know which plant likes ladybugs?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the books on the shelves?
They are there so you can find them. Do you like reading?
I do. Why is the room so quiet?
Quiet helps people think. Is that a reason for you?
Yes, it is. Why is there a small desk?
The staff help people there. Do you need help finding something?
I was hoping for a map. Do they have one?
I am not sure. Let us go ask them together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a horse. What is the first thing I need to do?
You need to find a calm horse and a good teacher. Do you have a helmet to keep your head safe?
Yes, I have a helmet, but I am afraid of falling off. How do I keep my balance?
Sit tall and hold the reins loosely in your hands. Have you ever sat on a rocking chair?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to bring cake to the party. Is that okay?
Yes, that is a sweet idea. Do you like chocolate?
Yes, I do. How do I cut it into pieces?
Use a sharp knife to cut it into squares. Would you like to add icing?
Maybe later. Where do I put the plates?
Place them on the main table. Are you bringing any drinks?
I have juice. I am ready to go now.
That is great. Have fun at the party.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new way my plant drinks water!
That sounds fun! Does it use its roots?
Yes, the roots pull the water up!
I love that trick. Do you like watching it grow?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My boss yelled at me today. It was very scary.
I am sorry you felt scared. What did he yell about?
He said my math was wrong. I am tired of trying so hard.
Doing hard work makes everyone tired. You did your best today.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sky looks very blue today.
That sounds nice to you. Do you see any white puffs?
Yes, they look like soft cotton.
I love how they look like cotton too.
I am not sure if they are heavy.
I do not know for sure if they are heavy. Do you feel a cool breeze?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My head hurts.
I am sorry. Where does it hurt?
Here.
Does it feel warm or cold?
It is warm.
You can rest. Do you want a hug?
Yes, please.
That is good. I am glad to help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to move today but I am so late.
Take a deep breath. What is the one thing you must do first?
I still have boxes in the car.
That sounds hard. Do you have a friend to help you lift them?
No one can come. I am stuck.
I do not know how to fix that, but I can wait here. Would you like a glass of water first?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel so tired today. Why is that?
Your body needs rest. Did you sleep well last night?
I slept okay, but I still feel heavy.
Maybe you are not drinking enough water. Are you eating enough?
I had a big breakfast, but I still feel low.
I do not know for sure. How does your head feel?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do we get to sit by the window?
I think yes, but I am not sure. What do you like to see?
I like to look at the trees.
Trees are very nice. Do you like big trees?
Yes, the big ones.
Big trees are very tall. You will see them soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do trees have leaves?
Leaves help the tree make food from the sun. Do you like looking at green leaves?
Yes, but why do they fall off in the fall?
The tree drops them to save energy for winter. Do you like raking fallen leaves?
I do, but where do the seeds go?
Wind, birds, or water often carry them to new places.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say sorry?
It tells the other person you feel bad. Do you know who is sad?
I bumped into you last week.
Did that hurt you?
No, but I knocked your cup over.
That was not your fault, but care is kind. Do you feel better now?
Yes, thank you for helping me think.
I am glad we could talk.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a pair of kings and a low ace. What should I play?
That is a tricky spot. Do you remember if the river card was low?
I think it was a ten, but I am not sure.
A ten helps your kings. Try calling again.
I feel scared to lose my chips.
Fear is normal. I do not know what is in their hands, so just take your time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sky is gray and the wind is cold. I do not know if I should go outside or stay in.
It looks cloudy, but I do not know if it will rain. Do you have an umbrella?
I have a coat, but no umbrella. Should I risk getting wet to play?
If you stay dry, you can play. Do you like playing in the rain?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I failed at my task and want to try again. Do you have advice?
Of course, just take a small step. Do you feel a little afraid?
Yes, I am nervous about the next step. Can you help me feel brave?
Start with the easiest part first. What is that first small part?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared of the big red button on the car.
That is a normal feeling. Do you know where the brake is?
The brake is the wide one, yes.
