Good job. You are doing well.
Can I go fast now?
Not too fast. Is your seat belt tight?
Yes, it is very tight.
That is safe. Have fun driving.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to help clean the dock. How do I start?
Pick up the trash you see. Do you have a bag with you?
Yes, I have a big blue bag.
Great, use that.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My nose is very runny and I feel tired. What should I do?
Drink warm water and rest your body. Are you sleeping well at night?
I tried to sleep, but I can only stay awake for a few hours. Does that help?
Sleep helps you get better, but fever can keep you awake. Do you have any pain?
My throat feels sore when I swallow. Should I eat soup?
Yes, soup is good and warm. It is kind to your throat.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my cat want to sleep on my head?
He feels safe there. Does he purr?
Yes, he purrs very loud. Why does he like to sit in boxes?
Boxes help him feel warm and hidden.
That makes sense. Why does he knock things off the table?
He wants to see what happens. Do you mind?
I do not mind. Why is his fur so soft?
I do not know for sure, but cats have special hair.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a boat in the yard. I do not know what to do with it.
Is it broken or just old? That helps me help you.
It looks dry and sad. I feel bad about it.
It is just wood. You can wash it to make it happy again.
I will wash it. Thank you for your kind words.
You are welcome. Go clean it now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a cool card trick for my friends. Can you tell me how?
I can help you learn the basic move, but I cannot share a secret trick. Do you have a deck of cards?
Yes, I have a red deck. Please show me the first step.
Start by sliding one card up slowly to hide the top card. Would you like to try it now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to see the moon tonight.
The moon looks very bright. Why are you feeling so happy?
It makes me feel calm and warm.
That is a lovely feeling.
Do you think the moon sees us?
I do not know for sure. Do you feel watched by it?
It feels like a friend.
A quiet friend is nice.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like the song with the horse.
That sounds fun. What color is the horse?
It is brown.
Nice. Do you sing along?
Yes, I do.
Great job. Do you know all the words?
No, I miss some.
That is okay.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how sailors find their way in the dark.
They use the stars and old maps. Do you like looking at the night sky?
That sounds very hard to do with such a big ship.
It takes much time and care to learn. Do you dream of sailing?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to wash my shirt now, but I am so late.
Put the white ones in the cold water to save time. Do you have any stains?
Yes, there is a red mark on the front.
Scrub it with soap before the wash starts. Is the machine near you?
No, it is far away in the back.
Take a basket to carry them. Do you need help?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a shiny box. Is it for me?
That looks like a nice find. Do you know who it came from?
No, just the note on top.
I do not know either. What does the note say?
It says happy birthday to you.
Then it is for you. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad because I lost my book.
Oh no. What kind of story is in it?
It has a bear who finds a friend.
That sounds sweet. Was the bear lonely before?
Yes, but now he is happy in the pages.
What a good thing for him.
I just want to read it again.
Let us look for it together.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very mad because someone took my snack without asking.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you think they forgot to ask?
They just grabbed it and ran away to their desk.
That is not a kind thing to do. Would you like to tell them it was yours?
I want to yell at them, but I know that is bad.
Taking a deep breath helps calm the anger. Do you know how to take a deep breath?
I need to breathe in and out slowly through my nose.
You are right, and that will help you speak.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are mountains so tall?
They are tall because rocks pile up very high. Do you like climbing rocks?
Yes, but why does it get cold up there?
It gets cold because the air is thinner at the top.
That is strange. Do you know why some mountains have snow on top all year?
I know the cold keeps the snow from melting.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike like my old pal did.
That is fun. Do you have a bike with small wheels?
Yes, I do, but I am afraid of falling.
Take your time. Put one foot on the pedal. Do you feel ready to try?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to start drawing pictures, but I am afraid I will make them look bad.
Drawing is fun to learn, and mistakes help you get better. Do you like to draw animals?
Yes, I love dogs, but my lines are always wobbly.
Try holding the pencil at the end of your hand for smoother lines.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a dog today. He was brown. He chased a cat.
That sounds like fun. Did the cat run fast?
Yes, it ran very fast. The dog stopped near a tree.
A wise dog to rest. Did you see any birds?
No birds, but I saw a red apple fall. I picked it up.
How sweet of you. Is the apple sweet too?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love that book about the red kite.
What did you learn from the kite?
I want to learn how to fly a real kite.
That is a great goal. Do you have a string?
I have a long piece of rope.
That works well. Make a light box shape first.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have so many small toys here. I do not know what to do with them.
That is a lot to sort through. Do you want to keep your favorites?
I think I do, but I am scared I might break them.
Be gentle with them. Where do you want to put the ones you keep?
I want to put them in a box, but I feel sad about the rest.
It is okay to share toys with friends. Would you like to give the others away?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake a cake.
That is a great idea. Do you have any butter?
Yes, I have some butter in the fridge.
Good. First, you need to mix the flour.
How much flour should I use?
You should use about two cups. Do you have a measuring cup?
Yes, I have a big cup.
That works for now. Next, you mix in the sugar.
I put the sugar in. What do I do next?
You add the eggs next.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do bees buzz so loudly?
They buzz because they flap their wings very fast to fly. Do you like honey?
Yes, I do. Why do bugs have six legs?
Insects have six legs to help them move and walk well. Did you know some bugs can jump?
Can they really jump? Why do they need to jump?
Jumping helps them get to food or move away from danger. Have you seen a grasshopper jump?
I have seen one. Why are bugs so small?
Being small helps them hide and find tiny places to live.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the island round?
I am not sure why it is round. Do you like the shape?
Yes, it looks like a plate.
That is a nice way to see it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck on my math problem and I feel lost.
Take a deep breath. What part of the problem feels hard to you?
I do not know if I should add or multiply the numbers.
That is a very tricky choice. Do you see any words like "total" or "each" in the question?
Yes, it uses the word "each" near the numbers.
Great catch. When you see "each," it usually means you should multiply.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Let us play now.
We can play fast. Is that your lucky hand?
I have two kings. What do you have?
I have a queen and an ace. Do you want to switch?
No. We must finish this.
Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is that water blue?
Yes, it looks blue today. Do you like blue?
Can I go in the water?
You can if your parent says yes. Are you wearing your swim trunks?
The water looks cold.
It might be a bit chilly. Does that scare you?
No, I am not scared.
Good. Is the sun out?
Yes, the sun is out.
That is nice. Have a fun time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need a blanket for the picnic?
It keeps our food off the dirt. Do you like to eat on grass?
Why is the grass good for a picnic?
It is soft and green. Do you like it?
Why do we bring water?
We get thirsty when we play.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to put my queen.
Try a square on the long edge. Do you see the open space there?
That feels risky. What if my king gets caught?
You must protect the king first. Is your pawn in front of the king?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need coffee right now, but I am late.
Coffee wakes you up fast. Do you have time for tea?
No time for tea. Just the coffee.
I will get you a hot cup. Is it sweet or plain?
Plain, please. I must run.
Here is your coffee. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very confused about the days of the week. Do you know how they work?
Yes, I know them well. Are you trying to plan a trip?
I want to know which day is best for a rest.
Sunday is often a quiet day. Do you like to sleep in on weekends?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the food taste so good?
Because the chefs use fresh things. Do you like the soup?
Yes, I do. Why is the room so quiet?
It is quiet because it is late. Do you want a drink?
I do not know. Why are the chairs so soft?
They are soft to make you rest. Do you feel tired?
A little. Why is it closed now?
The kitchen is cleaning up. Good night to you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: This song makes me feel so sad.
I am sorry to hear that. What part makes you feel this way?
The end feels like losing a friend.
That sounds very painful. Do you want to talk about it?
I just want the happy parts back.
It is okay to miss the good times. Do you like the start of the song?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The leaves are falling. I do not know what to do with them.
You can pile them up. Do you like playing in the leaves?
I think I will leave them where they are. Why do they fall anyway?
The tree lets them go for the winter. Is that strange to you?
It is a little sad. I want to keep the leaves on the tree.
The tree needs a rest. You can pick some to save.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What did you see?
I saw a big crab in the sand.
Wow, a crab. Was it walking or hiding?
It was hiding under a rock.
Hiding is good for safety. Did you go home?
Yes, I went home after that.
That is a nice way to end the day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The leg of my chair is wobbly and I am late for work.
A wobble is bad. Do you have a small screwdriver?
No, I only have a knife and I need to leave now.
That knife will hurt your hands. Please use a book to make it steady for now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new path in the park. It feels like a secret place. I am so glad I turned left.
That is a great feeling. Do you know where that path goes?
I think it leads to the old oak tree. I can hear the wind in the leaves. It sounds like a song.
Music from nature is nice. Are you sitting down there?
Yes, I am sitting on a big rock. My legs are tired but my heart is full. I want to stay here a while.
Rest is a good thing. Is the sun warm on you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to draw a big, puffy cloud. How do I start?
You can draw a big round shape with a bumpy bottom. Do you like to draw circles?
Yes, I like circles. What do I do next?
Add three or four small bumps on the bottom edge. Do you have a blue pencil?
I have a blue crayon. How do I make the top look right?
Make the top smooth and round, like a hill. Do you want to color it white?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am building a model lighthouse. What color should I paint it?
Red and white stripes look very nice. Do you have red paint?
Yes, I have red and white paint. How do I make the top light look real?
You can use a small yellow bulb. Do you have a safe way to plug it in?
I do not know how to use electricity safely. Can I use something else?
You can use a battery with a tiny LED. Is that easy for you?
A battery sounds much safer. Thank you for your help.
I am glad I could help. Does your lighthouse have a keeper?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am stuck on my math problem. It is hard.
What is the problem about?
I need to find the missing number in a sum.
Do you know how to add two numbers?
Yes, I can add them, but I am confused.
Try adding the numbers you have first.
I did, and the total is ten.
What number plus two makes ten?
I think it is eight.
That is correct.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to paint the sky blue today, but it looks purple.
That is very strange. What color did you use first?
I mixed red and blue because I wanted a dark night sky.
Ah, that makes sense. Do you like how it looks now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my boxes lighter?
Put heavy things in small boxes. What is the heaviest thing you have?
I have a big bag of books.
Split them into two small boxes. Do you have tape ready?
I have tape, but my hands are tired.
Take a break and drink some water. Is there a friend to help?
I do not have friends nearby.
Break the boxes into smaller stacks. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big secret to tell you.
Oh, that sounds fun. What is it?
I found a hidden garden behind the tree.
Wow, that is amazing. Did you see any flowers there?
Yes, they are pink and smell nice.
How sweet. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Can I leave this?
Yes, the doctor is ready. Are you feeling better today?
No, my head hurts a lot.
That is not good. Please tell the doctor right away.
I am running. Thanks.
Take care. Did you eat breakfast?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to draw cats, but my ears always look wrong.
Try making the ears big and pointy. Do you use crayons or pencils?
I use pencils. My cat looks too round.
Draw a longer body to make it look slimmer.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a hidden garden by taking a wrong turn!
That sounds wonderful. Did you see any flowers there?
Yes, they were bright red and smelled sweet.
I am happy for you. I did not know that place existed.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse in the park today. It was so sweet.
That sounds lovely. Did it have a long tail?
Yes, its tail was long and soft. I felt very happy.
I am glad you had a good time. Do you like animals?
I love all animals, especially horses. They are calm.
Calm animals are nice to be around.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to pack my bag for the trip.
That is great news. What is the first thing you put in it?
My favorite warm coat and my red shoes.
Those look cozy. Do you have any snacks for the road?
Yes, I packed some apples and cheese.
Yum, that sounds tasty. Is there anything else you want to share?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have very little money left. What should I do?
Try to spend less on fun things. What do you buy most?
I buy candy and toys every week.
That sounds like a lot. Can you wait one week?
I am not sure I can wait.
Try to skip just one thing. Do you have a jar for coins?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to run faster than my brother.
That sounds like fun. Do you like running on grass or pavement?
I like grass. It feels soft.
Grass is great for balance. Are you running far or just for fun?
I am running a little far. I feel tired soon.
Tired is normal when you push hard. Do you drink water while you run?
Yes, I drink water. I feel happy now.
Water helps you run strong.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am looking for a movie to watch tonight.
Do you like happy stories or scary ones?
I want something that makes me laugh.
Try a funny cartoon. Do you have any kids at home?
No, but I love silly jokes.
Then watch that funny cat film. It is very light and fun.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I spoke to a friend in Spanish today.
That is great news. How did you feel about it?
I felt very brave and proud.
You did a wonderful job. What was the hardest part?
I mixed up the letters a bit.
That is a normal step. Did you understand them back?
Yes, I understood them well.
Your ears are sharp now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: It is so hot today. Why is the sun so warm?
The sun gives us heat to keep us alive. Are you thirsty?
Yes, I am very thirsty. Why does drinking water make me feel better?
Water helps your body stay cool and happy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I put a new fish in the tank.
That is good news. What color is it?
It is bright orange with big eyes.
That sounds lovely. Is it eating well?
Yes, it eats fast and swims happy.
I am glad to hear that.
I feel so calm looking at it.
Sharing joy is nice.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do we send letters here?
Yes, we do! Is your letter for a friend?
How do I pay for it?
You can buy a stamp at the desk. Did you bring your money?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have paper, but I do not know what to draw.
Try drawing a circle. Do you like circles?
I tried a circle, but it looks bad.
That is okay. Try drawing a square next.
I am still not sure what to do.
Let us start with a stick figure. What does it hold?
I think I am done.
Good job. How does it feel?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today. I want to tell you why.
That is great news. What made you smile?
I had to say sorry to a friend. I felt good after that.
It is kind to be honest. Do you feel lighter now?
Yes, my heart feels light. I am glad I did it.
I am happy for you too.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did great on my test today. I feel very happy.
That is wonderful news. What subject was it?
It was math. I got all the hard ones right.
You must be so proud. How did you feel when you saw the grade?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big boat today. It smelled like salt.
That must have been a sea boat. Did it look scary?
No, it looked strong. The waves were high.
The water is wild out there. Do you like the sound of waves?
Yes, it is like a big song.
A nice song. Do you want to see the sea?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this cold snow at all.
That is a nice answer. Do you like rain better?
Rain is wet, but not so freezing.
I do not know if I prefer one over the other.
I will just go inside now.
That sounds like a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to leave now. The new neighbors are moving in today.
That is exciting. Do you know what they look like?
No, I just saw a big truck. I will go wave hello before I rush to work.
That is a nice idea. Have a good day!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to climb a big mountain, but I feel scared. What should I do first?
Start with small hills to build your strength. Do you like walking in the cold?
Yes, I love the snow. How do I pack my bag?
Bring warm clothes, water, and food. Do you have a map?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see smoke from the house next door. Is it bad?
It looks like a small fire. Are you safe inside your home?
Yes, I am safe, but I am worried. What should I do now?
Please stay put and do not go near it. Do you have a phone with you?
I do, but my screen is cracked. Can it still work?
A cracked screen usually still works fine. Can you see the time?
Yes, the time is seven o'clock. Why does that matter?
Time helps the fire trucks find you fast. Can you call for help?
I tried, but the number is not saving. How do I fix it?
I do not know your phone brand. Please just dial the number slowly.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie a knot.
That is a fun skill. Do you like to make crafts?
Yes, I do. Can you show me how?
Hold the string tight. Pull the loops apart gently.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at this puzzle. It is not working.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like the picture on the box?
Yes, it looks nice, but the pieces do not fit.
That is hard. Would you like to try again with me?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a little blue bird on the branch.
That looks like a Blue Jay! Do you like blue birds?
Yes, I do. But what does it eat?
It eats nuts and worms. Is there a tree nearby?
Yes, there is a big oak tree!
Great place for nuts. Are you going to say hello?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My white shirt has brown spots. How do I make them go away?
Try putting some baking soda on the spots and letting it sit. Are you using hot or cold water?
I usually use hot water for whites.
Hot water can set stains, so try cold next time. Does the spot still look there?
Yes, it is still there. I am worried.
Do not worry, try adding a little vinegar to the wash. Is it a big stain or a small one?
It is a small one on the collar.
That is good news, it should wash out easily. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I can not sleep well at night.
That sounds hard. Do you drink water right before bed?
Yes, I do.
Try to stop drinking water an hour before sleep. Does your room feel too hot?
No, it is cold.
Maybe use a warm blanket. Are your eyes tired?
My eyes hurt a lot.
Turn off all the lights and phones. Do you have a soft pillow?
Yes, I have a new one.
Try lying down with that soft pillow. I hope you rest soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big brown bear near the river today. It looked so calm and strong.
That sounds amazing. Bears are very smart animals.
Yes, it just stood there looking at the water. I felt very happy seeing it.
Glad you had a nice time. What else did you see out there?
A small bird with bright red feathers landed on a branch. It sang a very loud song.
Red birds are often very bold. Where were you standing?
I was on a high rock nearby. I did not scare the bird at all.
That is wonderful. You must be very quiet when you walk.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have read my favorite book many times.
That sounds like a good habit. What is the book about?
It is about a boy who finds a magic sword.
That sounds very exciting. Do you like the ending?
I am not sure. It feels a bit sad for me.
Sad endings can be hard. Do you want to read it again?
I think I will put it on the shelf for now.
That is a kind choice. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to play tennis better. How do I start?
Grab a racket and hit the ball gently. Do you have a racket at home?
Yes, I do. How should I hold the racket?
Hold it like you are shaking someone's hand. Do you like that feeling?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My phone will not start. I am very late.
Do you see a red light? It might just be cold.
No, the screen is dark.
I am sorry, I do not know that. Is it on the charger?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a song that makes me feel very light.
That sounds lovely. What is the name of the song?
It is called Sunny Day and it has a happy beat.
A sunny name fits a happy tune. Do you dance when you hear it?
Yes, I dance around my room to the music.
Moving to music is great fun.
I think I will play it for my cat next.
I hope she likes the beat too.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I told my friend I would play today, but I do not want to.
That is a hard choice. Are you tired?
Yes, I am very tired, but I want to keep my word.
Honesty is good. What if you rest first?
If I rest, I will miss the game.
I do not know your friend, but trust matters. Can you tell them you need sleep?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to take a picture right now, but I do not know how to make it clear.
Tap the screen to lock focus, and use a flash if it is dark. Do you have a stable place to rest your hands?
I am moving too fast to hold it still, and I must go.
Try holding your breath and pressing the button slowly. Is your camera setting on high speed?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited a long time for the bus to come.
That must feel like a very long time. Do you like riding the bus?
Yes, I love the ride, but the waiting was hard.
I am glad you are having fun now. Patience is a strong skill.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need bread, but I am in a big hurry.
Use instant yeast to save time. Do you have warm water ready?
Yes, I have warm water. How long do I wait?
Let it rise for thirty minutes. Is your kitchen warm?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great goal. Do you have a big knot ready?
Yes, I made a big loop. What do I do next?
Cross the loops to make a bird. Do you see the wings?
I crossed them, but it is stuck. How do I pull it tight?
Pull the ends away from your toes. It should stay tight now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost at the bus stop.
Do not worry. Which number do you want?
I need to go to the park.
You take bus five. What time is it now?
It is two o'clock.
Bus five comes soon. Do you like trees?
Yes, I love trees.
That is good. Look for the green sign.
Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to run, but my legs hurt.
Ouch, that sounds scary. Did you stretch before?
No, I just ran right away.
Try to stretch your legs first. Do you have a park nearby?
Yes, there is a big park down the road.
Great. How far is it to walk there?
It is about ten minutes away.
Walking first can help warm up. Are you afraid of falling?
Yes, I am afraid I will fall.
I do not know your exact pain level. Is the pain sharp or dull?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I read books in the dark without hurting my eyes?
That is not safe. Do you have a small lamp?
No, I only have a flash light.
A flash light is too bright. Try a soft night light instead.
I do not have one of those either.
Then you should just sleep. Do you feel tired?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the meeting at two?
Two is when we have time to talk. Do you want to join?
Why do I have to bring paper?
Paper helps us write notes. Is that okay for you?
Why is the room so cold?
I do not know why. Do you like it cold?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run. Is it raining?
Yes, it is. Do you have an umbrella?
No. Can I get dry?
No, it is all wet outside.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a big pile of dirty clothes. What do I do first?
Put them in a clean basket. Do you have a basket?
Yes, I have a blue one. Now what?
Put the clothes in the machine. Do you know how to set the timer?
I think I press the big button. Is that right?
Yes, you press the start button. Put soap in too.
The machine is moving fast! I am scared.
It is just spinning water. It is safe.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to help my friend. He is sad.
That is very kind of you. Why is he feeling sad?
He lost his ball.
I do not know where it is. Have you asked if he saw it roll away?
Yes, he did not see it.
Maybe you can help him look for it. Do you know where he plays?
No, I do not know.
You can ask him about his last game.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I had a very scary dream last night.
I am sorry you felt that way. Do you remember what it was about?
I forgot the details, but I still feel bad.
That is normal after a scary dream. Did you eat any food yet?
No, my tummy hurts a little bit.
It helps to drink water and rest. Have you tried that?
I do not know what else to do.
Try to sleep again for a bit. Do you want me to stay with you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My tent is cold and my food is wet. I hate camping.
That sounds really bad. Do you have a blanket to keep you warm?
No, I forgot it at home. I just want to go back to my bed.
I am sorry you are sad. Let us make a fire to dry your food and warm you up.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do you know where my old friend Sam is? I must leave now.
I do not know his home. Do you need help finding him?
Yes, please. I need to see him today.
He may be at the park. Should I call you when I look?
No, I cannot wait. I am sorry for the rush.
That is fine. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I played cards with my friend today. I won a lot.
That sounds like fun. Did you play until late?
Yes, we played until it was dark. My eyes got tired.
I am happy you had a good time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am in a new town. I do not know what to do.
That can feel strange. Do you like walks?
I like walks, but the streets are big. Where should I go?
I do not know the best spot. What do you like to see?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go soon. Does the lion have the biggest teeth?
Yes, it does. Do you like the sound they make?
No time. Is the elephant the heaviest land animal?
Yes, that is true.
What does a snake smell with?
I do not know for sure. Do you like reptiles?
I must run. Is the cheetah the fastest land animal?
Yes, it is very fast. Is your dog fast?
Yes, he is. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome. Run safe.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I met a new friend at the park today. We played tag for a long time.
That sounds like so much fun. Do you think you will see your new friend again soon?
Yes, we said we would play together every day. I am happy to have a new playmate.
I am glad to hear that. Are you excited about tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does a circle have no corners?
Because its line never stops to bend. Do you like rolling balls?
Yes. Why does a square have four sides?
It is made of four straight lines that meet. Do you like drawing squares?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The boat is stuck in the mud. What should I do?
Try to push it out slowly. Is the engine still warm?
Yes, it is. But the rope is too short.
You can use a stick to push against the rock. Do you have a stick?
No, I do not. Is there a place to buy one?
I do not know where to buy one nearby. Check the dock, please.
The dock is empty. I feel very sad.
I am sorry you feel bad. Try pulling it with your hands.
It is too heavy for me. What now?
Call a friend for help. Do you have a phone?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I met a new friend today, but I do not know what to do next.
That sounds like a great start. Do you want to play with them again soon?
I am not sure if they want me to come.
I do not know for certain, but you can just ask. Have you tried saying hello to them yet?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to work from home today.
That sounds nice. Do you have a favorite chair?
Yes, my blue armchair is very soft and warm.
I do not have a chair, but that sounds cozy. Is the quiet good for you?
It is very quiet and calm, which I love.
Good for you. Do you drink tea while you work?
Yes, I drink hot tea and eat a small cookie.
Yum. I do not eat, but I think that is a happy snack.
I feel free and happy in my little office.
I am glad you feel good.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My garden fence is broken.
That is sorry. Is it wood or metal?
It is old wood.
Wood is hard to fix alone. Do you have a tool kit?
No, I do not.
I can help you join the pieces. Would you like me to check the back?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My sister is a new baby. She is so small.
That is very sweet. Does she like to sleep?
She sleeps a lot. My brother shows me her toes.
Good. Do you help feed her?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad. My toy broke today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you still have the pieces?
Yes, but I do not know how to fix it.
You can try to glue them back together. Did you have a glue stick?
No, I only have tape.
Tape might work for a quick fix. Do you want to try it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not like my desk. It is too hard on my back.
A soft chair can help your back. Do you have a blanket to sit on?
I have a blanket, but my little sister keeps biting my pencil.
That sounds very annoying. Have you tried telling her to be gentle?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to fold the tablecloth for the wedding. How do I do it?
You just lay it flat and fold it in half. Do you have a big square one?
Yes, it is a big square. Now what?
Fold it in half again to make a smaller square. Is it white?
It is white. What is the next step?
Fold it into a triangle by bringing two corners together. Do you like triangles?
Yes, I do. How do I finish it?
Just place the triangle on the table with the point facing you. You are done now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is a tennis ball really squashy?
Yes, it is very soft and bouncy. Do you like to hit things?
I hit it with my shoe, but it did not go far.
A special racet will help it fly further. Do you want to learn more?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very late for work. I will be in trouble. What should I do?
Call your boss right now. Do you know who is covering for you?
I have no idea who is covering. Should I just walk in fast?
Yes, run as fast as you can. It is better to be late than to be silent.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a lighthouse today. It is very tall.
That sounds nice. Did it have a light on?
Yes, the light was bright. It felt so happy.
A bright light is great. Why did it make you feel happy?
I felt calm. The sea was quiet.
Quiet seas are peaceful. Do you like the sound of waves?
I do. I want to go back.
Going back sounds fun. Will you take a friend?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a party tomorrow, but I do not know what to do.
That sounds like fun. Do you want to bake a cake?
I like cake, but I am afraid I will break it.
You can have juice and bread instead. Is that okay for you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late to the store. I forgot my list.
Oh no. Did you bring your pen?
Yes, but I cannot read my small writing.
That is tricky. Do you have a phone?
It has no battery. I am lost.
I am sorry I do not know the way. Stay calm.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, I made a sun with a big smile.
That is a very nice sun. What color did you use for it?
I used yellow and orange.
Good choices for a warm day.
I also drew a bird flying by it.
A bird next to the sun is lovely. Is the bird singing?
Yes, it is singing a happy song.
That sounds cheerful and fun.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the lighthouse now.
It is just past the big rock. Are you going there for the view?
No, I am late for a meeting.
That sounds stressful. The path is straight ahead.
Can you point me to the main door?
Yes, look for the red paint. Is the door usually open?
I do not know, but I must go.
You are welcome. Go with a safe step.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
They fall to help the tree save energy for winter. Do you like autumn?
I think so, but I am not sure why they fall.
The days get short, so the tree closes its roots. Do you enjoy crunchy leaves?
Yes, I do. That makes me feel better.
I am glad it helped. The tree will get new leaves in spring.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a funny riddle. Do you want to hear it?
Yes, I would love to hear it. What is the first clue?
It has keys but no doors. What is it?
That is a tricky one. Is it a piano?
You got it right. It is a piano.
Great job finding the answer. Did you make up that riddle?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go.
That is okay. What do you like to do for fun?
I like to look at big trees.
The park has many tall trees. Is that a good place for you?
Yes, I want to sit in the shade.
Great. Go down the blue street to find it.
Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a nice day there.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need food fast, please.
I can help with that. Do you like meat or veggies?
Just give me the quickest thing.
A soup is very fast. Would you like to try it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the house on fire?
I do not know, but I am worried. Are you safe?
What should I do now?
Please call for help right away. Do you have your phone?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say please?
It shows we are kind. Do you like when others are kind to you?
Why do we say thank you?
It tells someone they did a good job. What is your favorite thing to say?
Why do we say sorry?
It makes friends feel better after a small hurt.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the red piece out?
It is the odd one out. Do you see the pattern?
I see blue and green. Why no yellow?
There is no yellow in this set. Is that what you meant?
Yes, why is it missing?
I do not know. Can you try the last piece?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have too many toys and my room is messy.
That sounds hard. Do you like all your toys?
Not really. Some are broken and some I do not play with.
You can put old ones in a box to give away.
I like your idea. What should I keep first?
Keep the ones you love most.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I felt so happy today when I found a shiny coin on the ground.
That is a wonderful find. What color was the coin?
It was bright silver and very clean. I almost missed it under a leaf.
I am glad you saw it. Do you keep coins in a jar?
Yes, I have a big blue jar full of them. I listen to them clink together at night.
That must sound like soft music. I do not know how to listen to coins myself.
You just have to be quiet and hold them gently. It is a peaceful thing to do.
I will try to be quiet next time. Thank you for sharing that with me.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My throat hurts bad. I do not like being sick.
I am sorry you feel so ouchy. Do you have a glass of water nearby?
It is dry and tickles. I want it to stop.
Warm soup can help your tummy and throat. Have you eaten anything today?
I only ate some crackers. I have no energy.
Rest is the best medicine for you. Tell me if you feel worse, okay?
I just want to play outside. Why is this happening?
Your body is working hard to fix you. Will you try to take a nap?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a red flower in the yard. Is it a rose?
It looks like a rose, yes. Do you like the smell of it?
It smells sweet. Why do flowers have different colors?
That is a great question. I am not sure of the exact reason.
Maybe they are just fun to look at.
I agree with you. They make the world look pretty.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a coin under the sofa today. It is shiny and cold.
That is a lucky find. Did you put it in a jar?
Yes, I put it with my other coins. It makes a nice sound when they hit together.
Saving little bits helps a lot. What do you want to buy first?
I am saving up for a new red bike. I ride my old one every day.
A red bike sounds fun. How many coins do you have so far?
I have ten coins in the jar. I will keep looking for more.
You are doing great work. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost. What day is it?
It is Monday. Do you have a plan for today?
No, I do not know what to do.
That is okay. Maybe read a book.
I like books, but I am tired.
Then rest first. How do you feel right now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, I am late. My fish look cold. How do I fix that?
Add a small heater. Is it a big tank?
Yes, it is big. Do I need more heaters?
One is usually fine. Do you have a thermometer?
No, I forgot. Where can I buy one?
The pet shop nearby. Do you know the way?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have an ace in my hand.
That is a great card. Do you want to keep it?
Yes, I like big numbers.
Well played. Who is playing next?
It is my turn now.
Good luck to you.
I drew a three.
A low number is okay. Do you have any pairs?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I just finished my favorite book and I feel empty. What should I do now?
That is a strange feeling. Do you like the feeling?
No, I want to read more but I do not know what to pick.
Try a book about animals. Do you like cats or dogs?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I cut a hole in the new fence this morning.
Oh no. Did you cut yourself?
No, but my ball went through it.
That is a tricky problem. Did you find the ball?
I saw a dog with it.
I hope the dog gave it back. Is the hole big?
It is as big as my hand.
We can fix that soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel quite lonely today.
That sounds heavy. Do you want to talk about it?
Why do I feel this way?
I do not know for sure. Are you missing someone?
Maybe. I just need to know why.
It is often hard to say why. Does it hurt a lot?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not know what to eat. I feel so tired.
That is hard. Do you want soup?
I just ate too much candy. My tummy hurts.
I am sorry. Did you drink some water?
I want to feel better. What is good for me?
Try an apple. Do you like apples?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my red ball in the deep grass. I am so sad and angry.
Oh no, that is very frustrating. Do you remember where you last saw it?
I think it rolled near the old oak tree, but the grass is too tall to see it well.
The grass does hide things very well. Let us go look there together.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I lost my bus pass. What should I do?
I am sorry. Do you have any cash?
Yes, I have five dollars.
That is good. You can pay the driver.
Thanks. Is the ride far?
I do not know your stop.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because the rain is falling outside.
That is wonderful. Do you like the sound of the drops?
Yes, it sounds like music. I wish you could come outside and see it.
I cannot go outside. Does it feel warm or cold to you?
It feels a bit cold, but it makes me feel cozy. I love rainy days.
It is good to have a favorite weather. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My dough is sticky. What is wrong?
It needs more flour. Do you have a rolling pin?
Yes, I do. How much should I add?
Add a little at a time. Is your kitchen warm?
It is a bit warm. Should I stop now?
Let it rest for ten minutes. Do you like sweet bread?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate apples. They are too hard to eat.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like soft fruits?
I do not want soft fruits. I just want a sweet snack.
Peaches are sweet and soft. Have you tried one?
No, I have not. I am just tired of bad fruit days.
That is a hard day. What fruit do you miss the most?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I tried to count my apples but I keep losing track.
That is a common problem. Do you count them all at once?
Yes, I try to do the whole pile in my head.
Try moving them into two small groups. Is that easier for you?
It feels much simpler this way.
Good luck with the rest.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy I missed the bus.
That is a funny thing to be happy about. Why did missing the bus make you smile?
I saw a cute dog on the sidewalk.
Oh, what did the little dog look like?
He had a red collar and a wagging tail.
That sounds like a very good boy.
He played with me for ten minutes.
Ten minutes sounds like a lot of fun. Did you know how to get home now?
I am going to walk because I like the sun.
The sun is nice. I hope you have a wonderful walk.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I think Grandma is sad today.
She looks very quiet. Do you want to sit with her?
Yes, I do.
That is a kind thing to do.
She gave me a warm hug.
Hugs make people feel better. Did she smile?
She did a little bit.
That is good news for both of you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to plant a secret seed in my garden.
That is a sweet idea. Do you have a small pot or a hole in the soil?
Yes, I dug a tiny spot behind the big oak tree.
Good. Place the seed in the dirt and cover it with care. Have you watered the soil?
I put some water on it, but the rain is coming soon.
Rain helps the roots grow strong. Keep it a quiet secret for now. Do you think it will bloom?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a small dog at the park today.
That sounds fun. Did you pet the dog?
Yes, it was soft and warm.
Good for you. I like dogs too.
Then I went home and drank some milk.
That is a nice end to the day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to plant these seeds right now.
Put them in the warm sun. Do you have water ready?
No time for water. Just tell me the depth.
Dig one inch deep. I am not sure about your soil type.
It is dark dirt. What next?
Cover them well. Is the bed soft?
Yes, it is soft. I am going.
Good luck. Call me if they do not sprout.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I solve this square puzzle?
First, you find the corner pieces. Do you like corners?
I do not see them.
Look for pieces with two flat edges.
I found four!
Great. Now connect them. I do not know if your next piece is blue.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my map on the bus today. I looked everywhere but could not find it.
That sounds very frustrating. Did you check under your seat?
I tried looking there, but the map was gone. I had to walk home without it.
You are lucky you know your streets well. Did you make it home safe?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go on a trip, but I do not know where.
That is fun. Do you like cold or warm days?
I like warm days.
Try the beach. Do you like sand?
Yes, I love sand.
Good choice. Pack light clothes.
How many days should I stay?
Seven is good. Enjoy your time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need toast fast. My bag is heavy.
Give you two slices. Is it chocolate for you?
No time to talk. Just add butter.
Butter is done. Is your bag almost full?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
They use tiny tubes in their roots to pull it up. Do you see those roots?
Yes, but how does the water get to the leaves?
It moves up through special pipes called xylem. I do not know all the details.
That is very helpful, thank you.
You are welcome! Do you have any more questions?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw the moon last night. It looked like a bright white coin in the sky.
That is a nice way to see it. Do you like looking up at the stars too?
Yes, I love the stars. Why is the moon sometimes a half circle?
The moon looks round and then half round as it moves around our world. Do you watch it every night?
I try to, but I get tired. Is the moon really far away?
Yes, it is very far away, much farther than the hills. Have you ever wondered how to get there?
I have, but I do not know how. Can a person actually touch the moon?
People have gone to the moon and touched the ground, but we cannot fly there now. Do you want to go one day?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to press flowers, but I do not know how.
That is a fun idea. Do you have a thick book?
Yes, I have a big dictionary. Can I use it?
A dictionary works well. Place the flower inside.
How do I know when it is done?
It takes about two weeks. Do you have a calendar?
Yes, I can mark the date. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun making art.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very tired and my legs hurt from sitting here.
That sounds hard, but you are doing a great job. Are you bored right now?
Yes, I do not like sitting on this small seat.
I know it can feel too small. Do you have a book or a toy to play with?
I want to see the city lights when we land.
That is a wonderful thing to look at. I hope the plane lands soon!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the tennis ball fuzzy?
It helps the ball fly right and slows it down. Do you like playing outside?
Yes, I love running around.
That is great fun for your body. I do not know much about scoring, but I can help with rules. Do you know how to score?
No, the numbers are confusing.
You start at zero and go to one, two, three. Then you say deuce when both are at three.
That sounds hard to remember.
Just count the points as you go. It gets easier with time. Do you have a favorite color?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to send a note right now, but I am stuck.
Take a deep breath. What is the one main thing you want to say?
I just want to tell them I am coming to dinner.
That is very clear. Do you know which day that is?
It is today, but I forgot the time.
You can just say "soon" if you are unsure.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know how ants eat. I am late!
They use their strong jaws to tear food apart. Do you like their tiny jaws?
Great. Does a fly have a nose?
I do not know for sure, but flies use their feet to taste things. Is that a new fact to you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because the old tree in the village square has fallen down.
That is very sad to hear. Did you like to climb in that tree?
Yes, I did, but now I am scared because my little dog got lost in the dark.
I do not know where your dog is. Have you called his name out loud?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not like the man next door.
Why do you not like him?
He makes my toys fall over.
That sounds very sad.
I want him to stop.
What have you tried so far?
I told my dad about it.
That was a good way to solve it.
Did it help?
I do not know, but it is a good start.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My computer is not working. I am sad.
I am sorry. What is it doing?
The screen is dark. Nothing moves.
That feels bad. Did it make a sound?
No. It is just quiet.
Try the power button again. Is it warm?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have two magnets, but I do not know what to do with them.
You can put them near each other to see how they move. Do you like loud sounds?
I tried, and they snapped together with a loud click.
That is a strong pull. Do you have any small toys?
Yes, I have some paper clips and a piece of iron.
You can use the magnet to lift the paper clips off the floor. Is that fun?
I lifted them, but then I dropped the magnet.
That is okay, it will still work. Did it break?
No, it is fine, but I am still bored.
I am not sure what else to suggest. Do you want to try lifting the iron?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am walking in the park but I do not know what to do next.
That sounds like fun. Do you like to run fast?
I am not sure. The path looks long and I feel a bit tired.
Then you can sit on the grass. Do you like green grass?
Yes, the grass is soft. But my feet hurt a little.
Sit on the bench by the tree. Do you see the big oak tree?
I see it. I think I will walk to the bench and rest my feet.
Good plan. Take your time and enjoy the fresh air.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like this song, but I do not know why.
It sounds very happy. Do you like happy songs?
Yes, I do. But the words are hard.
Try to listen to the sound first. Does the tune feel nice to you?
It feels warm, like the sun.
That is a great feeling.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to put my tent.
Pick a dry spot away from trees. Do you like sun or shade?
I like the sun, but the ground is hard here.
Look for soft dirt that is flat. Is it easy to walk on?
Yes, this spot is flat and soft.
That is a great place. Do you have your bags ready?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am at the big house with old things. Do you like it here?
I love to look at history. What is your favorite thing to see?
The dragon with the shiny eyes. Is it real?
No, it is just a sculpture. Do you touch the glass cases?
No, the sign says no. I will go now.
That is good to follow the rules. Have a happy day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I hit the ball with my racket. It went way over the fence.
That is a big swing! Do you like high hits?
I do not know how to hit it low. The ball is very bouncy.
You can try to swing slower. Would you like to practice with me?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I get mad when things take a long time.
That is a hard feeling to hold. Do you get angry often?
Yes, but I want to stop.
Try to take one slow, deep breath. What helps you calm down?
Counting to ten works a little bit.
That is a good start. Keep practicing it every day.
Okay, I will try my best.
I believe you can do it well.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing on this quiet street. I do not know which way to go.
The air feels calm here. Do you hear anything near?
I do not hear any cars or people. I feel a bit lost.
That is okay. Look at the trees. Do they look friendly?
The trees are still and tall. I still do not know where I am going.
I do not know your path. What feels right to you?
My feet want to walk left. I think I will try that way.
Good choice. Walk slowly. Enjoy the quiet.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How does the internet move pictures so fast?
It sends tiny bits of data through wires or air. Do you have a computer at home?
Yes, my dad bought one for me last year.
That is great. Wires carry the bits to your house.
What is a browser?
A browser is a tool to see websites. It acts like a door to the web. Do you like reading online?
Sometimes. I like looking at dog pictures.
Dogs are fun to look at. The internet holds many such pictures.
Can the internet run out?
I do not know for sure if it ever will stop. It needs power and wires to work.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure if I should say please.
Yes, you should. Do you know why?
I think it makes people feel good.
That is true. It shows you care.
So I will use my words.
Good job. Are you happy now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to wait?
Waiting helps us get ready. Are you feeling patient?
I just want to go now.
It is hard to wait, but it will be worth it. Do you like surprises?
Yes, I love surprises!
Then let’s wait a little longer.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to visit a small village, but I do not know which one.
A small village is a quiet place with few homes. Do you like loud towns or quiet spots?
I like quiet spots where people can talk.
That is a sweet choice for a walk. Do you have a favorite color for houses?
I like blue roofs because they look like the sky.
Blue roofs are very pretty there. Do you want to know how to get there?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My chair has a loose leg and it wiggles.
That is tricky. Do you have any tools to help?
I only have a big spoon.
A spoon might not work. Have you tried tightening it with your hands first?
I tried that, but it still moves.
That is a shame. Maybe ask a grown-up to check for a lost screw.
Okay, I will go get Dad.
That is a good idea.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn about the web, but it looks so big.
The web is like a giant library. What do you want to find first?
I want to see cats playing with balls.
You can search for that easily on a video site. Do you like funny videos?
Yes, I love them, but I am scared of bad things.
Good talk, ask a grown-up to help you set safe limits. Are you talking to a grown-up now?
Yes, my mom is right here with me.
That is a very good thing to do. Have fun learning!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is so hot outside. I do not know what to do.
That feels bad. Do you have a fan nearby?
No, I do not have a fan. I just sit in the sun.
Please go inside. Do you have a cold drink?
Yes, I have some cold water. It helps a bit.
Good. Rest and cool down now.
Thank you. I feel a little better.
I am glad. Stay hydrated.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I ran very fast today.
That is great. Do you like running?
Yes, I like it a lot.
I am happy to hear that. How does it feel?
My legs feel hot and tired.
That is normal after running hard. Drink some water now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream on the floor. It made a big mess.
Oh no, that sounds sad. Did you get any clean part?
Not really, but I was not mad. I just cleaned it up.
Good job fixing it. Are you hungry now?
Yes, I want a snack. I am happy again.
That is nice. You did a good thing.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I miss my old friend, but we do not talk anymore. What should I do?
Did you try sending a nice note? Sometimes a small step helps.
I am too scared to be lonely. Should I just let it go?
You do not have to decide today. It is okay to wait.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad because the rain is coming for our big day.
That is a hard thing to feel. Do you have an idea for a backup plan?
I do not know what to do. I just want the sun.
I know how hard that is. I am sorry you feel this way.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am looking for new shoes to wear to school. They must be comfy.
That is a good idea. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, I love blue. Do they come in my size?
I do not know your size yet. What size do you usually wear?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to send a letter to my friend.
That is a nice thing to do. Do you have a stamp?
I do not have a stamp.
You can buy one at the counter. Is the post office open today?
I do not know if it is open.
It is usually open until five. Do you live nearby?
I live very far away.
Then the bus is a good choice. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I caught a big fish today!
That is so cool! Did you keep it or put it back?
I put it back so it could swim away.
That is very kind of you. Do you like to fish with your dad?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. What day is today again?
It is Tuesday. Do you like this day?
No, I do not. It feels too long.
I hear you. Do you have a favorite day?
Saturday is my favorite. I can sleep late.
That sounds nice. What do you do on Saturday?
Just relax. But Tuesday is hard.
You are working hard. Take a break soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in the woods and do not know which way to go.
Take a deep breath and look for the north star. Do you see the sky?
The clouds are thick so I cannot see any stars at all.
Check your map to find the nearest river and follow the water. Is your phone with you?
My phone is off and my map is a bit dirty.
You can use a compass if you have one, but I do not know if you do. Do you have a compass?
I do not have a compass, so I feel very stuck now.
Stay calm and look for a trail marker on a tree. Do you see any small signs?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I heard you can save money by walking instead of driving. Why is that better for my wallet?
Walking costs no gas, so you keep your coins. Do you have a car?
I do, but I am tired. Why should I save when I feel so low?
Keeping cash helps you buy nice things later. That feels good.
That sounds fun. What is the first step?
Just use cash for small buys. It is easy to count.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My head hurts so bad. I feel so low today.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have any water nearby?
Yes, I do, but I just want to sit in the dark.
Resting is good. Please drink some water.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I read late at night but my eyes feel dry. What do I do?
Try using a dim lamp to help your eyes rest. Do you have a soft lamp in your room?
Yes, I do. Also, I feel sleepy after a few pages.
That is a good sign your body needs rest. Try to stop before you feel too tired.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I hold the baby safely?
Put one hand under the head and the other under the bottom. Is the baby quiet?
Yes, they are sleeping.
Keep them close to you so they feel warm. Do they have a nice blanket?
The blanket is soft.
Great, that will keep them cozy. Do they cry a lot?
Not much, just a little.
That is normal for new babies. Are you getting enough rest?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today! I saw a cow in my yard.
That is wonderful. What color was the cow?
It was white with brown spots. It looked very calm.
Nice to know. Did it want food?
Yes, it ate some grass right away. I love how peaceful it was.
Peaceful animals are nice. Do you have a farm?
No, but I dream of having one day. I like all the sounds.
That is a sweet dream. Which animal do you like best?
I like pigs because they look funny. They are so cute.
I agree they are cute. I do not know if they are clean.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My photos are always blurry, what should I do?
Hold your camera very still. Do you have a steady hand?
I try to hold it tight, but it still shakes.
Try to rest your arm on something solid.
I am holding it near a wall.
That is a great place to lean. Do you like taking pictures outside?
Yes, I love the light in the park.
Light helps a lot. You are doing a good job.
I will try again tomorrow morning.
That sounds like a fun plan. I hope they are sharp.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big crab on the sand.
Wow, that is cool. Is it walking fast?
No, it is very slow.
Good thing you do not step on it. Do you like looking at crabs?
Yes, I like them. What is that white stuff in the water?
That is foam from the waves. It feels soft. Do you want to get your feet wet?
Maybe. It looks cold.
The sand is warm, so you will be okay. Do you have a bucket?
Yes, I do.
Great, you can dig a hole. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am lost and I want to learn how to read a map.
A map shows you where you are and where to go. Do you have a map with you?
Yes, I have one, but I do not know which way is north.
Look for the north arrow on the map and hold it flat in your hand. Is the sun helping you see?
The sun is low, but I still feel confused about the lines.
The thick lines are roads and the thin lines are paths. Let me know if you get stuck.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because I cannot remember when the old castle was built.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you know who built it?
I do not know, and that makes me feel bad.
That is okay, we can look it up together. What year do you think it is?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read my favorite book today while sitting in the park.
That sounds like a nice quiet time. Was the sun warm?
Yes, the sun was very warm and the wind was calm.
Nature makes a good place for reading. Did you take a snack with you?
I had an apple and some crackers in my bag.
Crumpets and fruit are a good mix. Did the story make you feel happy?
It made me feel calm and my mind rested.
A calm mind is a happy gift. Do you read that book often?
I read it every night before I sleep.
That is a wonderful habit to keep.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to jump rope, but I keep tripping on the rope.
That is hard at first. Do you swing it from the side?
Yes, I swing it down from my right hand.
Try starting with small circles near your feet. Are your knees soft?
My knees are hard and stiff.
Bend your knees a little. You will get it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have these red flowers. What should I do with them?
That is a nice choice. Do you have a big vase at home?
I have a small bowl and a big box. Which is better?
The box might hold more stems. Do you like the color red?
I think they look very bright. I am not sure if that is good.
Bright colors often feel happy. How does this room feel to you?
It feels a bit dark and quiet right now. I need more light.
Red can add a warm touch. Do you have a white table?
Yes, the table is white. That sounds perfect. I will use the box then.
That sounds like a good plan. Happy gardening.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to see the web again.
That sounds good. What did you see first?
I found pictures of cute cats.
Cats are fun. Do they make noise on screens?
They only show pictures.
I do not know how that works.
It is magic inside the box.
Magic is cool. Do you share them with friends?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My phone is broken and I missed the party.
That sounds very sad. Did you see the pictures?
No one posted any pictures for me.
I am sorry about that. Do you want to go there now?
It is probably too late for me.
I do not know the end time. Is the house still open?
I think it is closed by now.
Let us hope they were having fun.
I just wish I could have gone.
It is okay to feel this way. Maybe we can make a small party later.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Why do trees drop their leaves? I am late!
They fall to save energy for winter. Do you like raking leaves?
Not really. Is that all?
Yes, the tree sleeps through the cold. Do you bring a coat?
I forgot it. Thanks.
Go safe! Do you see the sky is gray?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How does a plant drink water?
Roots pull water up from the soil. Do you like to draw pictures?
I want to see the water move.
You can put dye in the water. It will show the path up the stem.
Where does the water go next?
It travels to the leaves for air and sun. Do you have a green plant?
How do I do that at home?
Use a clear cup and some blue dye. Watch it over a few hours.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I like to sleep in a tent.
That is a fun way to rest. Do you have a good sleeping bag?
Yes, it is warm. Why is the ground so hard?
The earth is solid and dry. Do you like soft beds?
I do, but this is wild. Why do we star a small fire?
It gives us light and heat. Do you know how to make one?
No, I do not. Why is the sky so dark?
I do not know the exact reason. Do you see any stars?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad. The movie made me cry a lot.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you like the story?
The end was bad. I did not want it to end like that.
That is a tough feeling. Do you want to talk about it?
Yes, please. It was confusing and sad.
I hear you. Let us try again another day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am confused about why the sky is blue. What should I do?
The sun makes all colors of light, and the air scatters the blue part the most. Do you like looking up?
That is a good idea, but I still feel lost. How do I stop worrying?
You can just take a deep breath and look at the clouds for a bit. Do you see any shapes in them?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a big box for my toys, but it is always messy. What should I do?
You can use small bins for each type of toy. Do you have enough boxes for this?
I have many boxes, but I still lose things. How do I find them fast?
Put every item back in its own bin right away. Do you know where your favorite doll lives now?
I put it in the bin, but I forget later. Is there a good trick?
Yes, put a picture of the toy on the bin. I do not know a magic trick, but labels help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent my whole day trying to fix a broken toy.
That sounds like hard work. Did the toy start to move?
Yes, it finally worked, so I read until late at night.
Great job on the toy. Did you fall asleep while reading?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
The trees get ready for cold winter. Do you like walking on crunchy leaves?
Yes, they sound so fun to step on.
They make a nice crinkle noise. The trees drop them to save water.
Is the tree sleeping when it is bare?
Kind of yes, it rests while it is cold. How do you feel when it is outside?
I feel a bit chilly but happy.
Warm coats help keep the cold away. Do you wear a hat too?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a small shed in my yard. Where do I start?
First, you need a flat spot with good soil. Do you have a sunny corner to use?
Yes, I have a flat space near the fence. What tools do I need?
You need a hammer, a saw, and a level. Do you have a helper for the heavy parts?
My brother can help me lift the wood. How do I keep it safe?
Make sure the walls are tall enough to keep wind out. Can you close the door from the inside?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the bright sun. I am so happy today.
The sun is warm and nice. Do you like the light?
Yes, it feels good on my face. I want to tell you how great it is.
That is a nice feeling. What color is the sky?
It is a clear blue color. I just want to share this joy with you.
I am glad you are happy. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie my shoelace?
Cross the laces and pull tight. Do you have clean hands?
Yes, they are dry and clean.
Make a loop on each side. Are your loops the same size?
One is big and one is small.
Pull the small one up to match the big one.
Now I have two loops.
Cross the loops over each other.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How can I see a wild deer in my garden?
Put out carrots and stay still. Do you live near a forest?
Yes, but I am too afraid of its teeth.
Deer have sharp teeth but are usually gentle. Do you see any footprints?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to dress up for work?
It helps you feel ready. Do you like picking your clothes?
Why do I need to take notes?
So you do not forget what to do.
Why is it hard to sit still?
Your mind is busy. Do you like playing?
Why do I need to say thank you?
It makes people feel good.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make my website look nice. What should I use?
Try a free tool that helps you build pages easily. Do you like colors?
Yes, I love bright colors. How do I make people click?
Use clear words and big buttons. Do you have a picture ready?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late and need to ride fast.
Please hold the handles tight. Are you wearing a hat?
No, I have no time for that.
That is risky. You can go on carefully.
Just tell me the safe way to turn.
Look over your shoulder. Do you feel okay?
Yes, I am good to go.
That is good. Have a safe ride.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a shiny rock. I like to keep things that shine.
That is a great find. Do you have a box for your shiny finds?
Yes, I have a box. I also like smooth stones.
Smooth stones are nice. What color is your box?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because it is my birthday.
That is wonderful news. How old are you turning?
I am turning ten years old.
Ten is a great age. Do you have a favorite cake flavor?
I love chocolate cake with white icing.
Chocolate is a tasty choice.
My family is making it for me right now.
That sounds sweet. Is it almost ready?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up and found a red box on my table.
That sounds fun. What was inside?
It was a new book about big blue whales.
Whales are big and cool. Do you like sea animals?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like the small village. It is quiet.
That is a nice place. Do you like walking there?
I see a dog. It is brown.
A brown dog is good. Is it friendly?
The dog runs away. I am sad.
Do not worry. It may come back.
Is there a shop in the village?
I do not know for sure. Do you have a map?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to start in this big room.
Do you like stories or facts? I can show you the right shelf.
I want to read about the sea, but I am lost.
The blue books are near the door. Is that what you want?
Yes, thank you for helping me find them.
You are welcome. Happy reading.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Did the fox catch the duck?
I do not know the end. Was the fox fast?
Yes, he was very fast.
That is scary. Please go now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say thank you nicely?
You should look at the person and smile. Do you smile when you are happy?
Yes, I do.
Great. Now say the words with a warm voice. Is your voice soft or loud?
My voice is soft.
That is perfect. Be kind to the person too. Are you being kind right now?
Yes, I am trying.
You are doing a good job. Remember to be polite every day. Do you feel happy?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I switch on the lights in my room?
Just look for the switch on the wall near the door and push it down. Do you know which side of the room has the switch?
I think it is on the left wall.
That sounds right. You can check if the light turns on when you press it. Did it work for you?
Yes, the light came on and it is bright now.
Great, you did a good job. Always turn it off when you leave to save power. Do you have any other questions?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does my bread get so big?
It is full of tiny air bubbles, my dear. Do you like to draw them?
I do! But where do they come from?
Magic dust called yeast makes them grow.
Can I touch the magic dust?
Yes, but please wash your hands first.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so lost and do not know what to do.
That sounds scary. What made you feel this way?
I am looking at the sky but my mind is busy.
Clouds are just water, so they change fast. Are you trying to watch them?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in a big rush. Do you know the song with the big drums?
I think it is the one with the fast beat. Do you have a ticket?
Yes, I have a ticket. How many minutes do I have left?
You have ten minutes left. Do you like loud music?
I like it very much. Can you tell me the name of the band?
I do not know the name. Have a good time at the show.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my rose broke.
That is a shame. Did it break while you were watering it?
Yes, it snapped right in the middle.
I am sorry about that. Do you have any other flowers?
I think this was my favorite one.
I know it feels bad to lose a favorite. What color was it?
It was a deep, soft pink.
That sounds very pretty. Have you tried to fix it?
I tried, but the stem is too thin.
I do not know how to fix a broken stem. Do you want to pick a new one?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to keep my boat from tipping over.
That is a big worry. Do you have a heavy bag on board?
Yes, I have a box of heavy rocks.
Put the rocks low and in the middle. It helps the boat sit steady.
What should I do with my oars?
Hold them tight and row on both sides. Do you have a partner to help?
No, I am all alone.
Then go slow and easy. A calm boat is a safe boat.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I love how the big trees stand tall in my yard.
That sounds lovely. Do you like to climb them?
Yes, I climb up high to see the view. It makes me feel free and light.
I understand that feeling. What color are the leaves right now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the lake this morning with my rod.
That sounds like a nice start to the day. Did you see any fish?
I saw them jump in the water, but they did not bite.
Fish can be tricky sometimes. What did you do while you waited?
I sat on the bank and watched the birds fly by.
Nature is very calming. Did you finally catch one?
Yes, I got a small perch near the end.
That is a great victory. How did the fish feel when you held it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
The sun makes white light. The air spreads the blue part. Do you see clouds today?
Yes, I do.
Clouds are white because they block the light. I do not know why some look like dogs. Do you like dogs?
Yes, I like them very much.
That is nice. Maybe we can draw one later. I have time if you want to talk more.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is my screen all black?
