Did you press the power button? Is the plug in the wall?
I did press it, but nothing happened.
That is strange. Does the little light on the front glow?
No, it is very dark.
Then the power may be off. Let me check the cord for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was so bright today.
Did you see the blue sky?
Yes, but why is it blue?
Sunlight has many colors.
I guess I do not know what you mean.
Blue bounces around the most.
That sounds like a wild game.
The air makes it happen.
I am glad you told me.
I am happy to help you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The big tree is so tall. I can not see the top.
It is a very big tree. Do you like climbing trees?
I saw a blue bird today. It had a yellow beak.
That is a nice color. Did you say hello to it?
The grass is soft under my feet. It feels like a blanket.
Soft grass is good for sitting. Where is your blanket now?
I am lost in the maze of paths. I do not know which way to go.
Do not worry. I will help you find the path.
Thank you. I am happy to be here with you.
I am glad to be here too. Let us keep walking.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel a bit sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. What made you feel down?
I just want to feel happy again.
That is a good wish. Do you like playing outside?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream in the park.
That is very sad. Did you look around?
Yes, I saw a big cloud shape on the grass.
It looked like a cloud. What did you do next?
I let it melt and watched the ants eat it.
That was a nice thing to do.
Now my hands are sticky and I am happy.
That is a good ending.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you have bread?
Yes, I have some. Are you coming?
No, I must go now.
Okay, I will wait. Is it sunny?
Yes, the sun is hot.
Good. Do you have juice?
I have water. See you soon.
Bye. I hope it is nice.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my cookie on the floor. I felt very bad.
That is a nice thing to share. Did you tell someone?
Yes, I said sorry to Mom. She gave me a new one.
That is kind of you. How do you feel now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the wind so cold?
The wind comes from far away places. Do you have a warm coat?
Why can I see the trees bend?
The wind pushes hard against them. What else moves in the wind?
Where does the wind go?
It goes around the world again.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because it is my birthday.
That is wonderful news. What is your favorite part of the day?
The cake is very sweet and the colors are nice.
I am glad you are having fun.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the top of the lighthouse before the boat leaves.
The stairs are just up this path. Are you worried about the waves?
Yes, they are very big today. How high is the tower?
It is about 50 feet high. Do you have a map of the rocks below?
No, I left it in the car. Is it hard to climb?
It is steep but safe. Do you have good shoes for the wet ground?
I am wearing boots, thank you. Which way do I turn?
You take a left at the first door. Good luck on your climb.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am scared to touch the gas pedal.
That is a normal fear. Do you have an instructor with you?
No, I am practicing in an empty lot.
Please bring a teacher next time. They will help you feel safe.
Is it bad if I stop the car suddenly?
Stopping hard can be scary for others. Do you feel okay now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love mangoes. They are sweet and red. I must go now.
Mangoes are very sweet. Do you like them raw or cooked?
I like them raw. I am late for work.
Raw is great. I do not know if you have time to sit.
No time at all. I need to run.
Run safely. Do you eat many per day?
Just one. I am running.
One is good for you. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The blue will not mix right.
That feels hard. Do you have the red paint ready?
Yes, but it looks too dark.
A little red goes a long way. Have you tried adding white?
I tried, but it turned gray.
Gray can be nice, but I know how you feel. Is it for a picture of the sky?
Yes, and I want it bright.
Try more white and less red. Do you like soft colors?
I guess so. It is still wet.
Let it dry to see the true color. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I got a new job at the bakery. I need to learn how to make sandwiches.
That is a big step. Do you like making food?
Yes, I do. But I am afraid I will mess up the bread.
Everyone makes mistakes. It is how we learn.
I will try to be careful. What do I do first?
Start with a clean counter. Do you have gloves?
Yes, I have them. Thanks for the help.
You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad about the new town.
I am sorry you feel that way. What makes you feel sad?
The streets are too quiet and I miss my old home.
I do not know if the town will change soon. Do you have any friends here?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I live in a small place but I do not know where to go next.
That is a nice place. What does the village look like?
It has a river and many old trees, but I feel lost.
That sounds lovely. Maybe you should sit by the water.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the pond so quiet?
The fish sleep deep in the mud. Do you like to watch them?
Why do the roofs have such steep slopes?
Snow slides off fast so the house stays warm. Do you like snow?
Why is the old tree in the center square?
I do not know, but I hope it has a story.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to learn to sing, but I am afraid my voice will sound bad.
That is very common. Do you like singing in the shower?
Yes, I do. I hide in there so no one hears me.
That is a great start. Why do you think it feels safe there?
I do not know. I just like the echo.
The echo makes it feel loud and fun. Do you have a favorite song?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How does a clock move?
A small motor pushes the hands around. Do you like watching them spin?
I have no idea how it makes time.
The gears count the seconds for you. Is that tricky to think about?
I wonder if it ever stops.
It stops if the battery runs out low. Do you check yours often?
I want to know who built the first one.
I do not know who made the very first one.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How does a clock keep time?
A tiny spring pushes a wheel to turn. Do you have a clock to look at?
I want to fix it.
I do not know how to fix that part. Is the battery dead?
Can you show me how?
I cannot show you with just words. Can you open the back cover?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad and do not know what to do.
That feels hard. What made you feel this way?
I lost my favorite toy.
I am sorry you lost it. Did you look under the bed?
Yes, but I did not find it.
I do not know where it is. Would you like to take a deep breath?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I tried to fix my bike and failed. I need to go now.
It is okay to be slow sometimes. Do you need a ride?
No, I must walk. I am so tired of trying and failing.
Failure is just part of the road. Are you eating enough today?
I will try again tomorrow. I promise. Goodbye.
We will be right here. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a bad headache. I must go now.
I am sorry you hurt. Do you have water with you?
No time for water. I need a fast fix.
I do not know a magic cure. Is your head hot to the touch?
It feels cold. Please help me leave.
Drink water and rest soon. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to help my friend feel better.
That is very nice. What is wrong with your friend?
She lost her favorite toy.
I am sorry about that. Have you looked in her room?
I did, but I did not find it.
Maybe you can help her look again. Do you have time to play?
Yes, I can help her look.
That will make her happy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I bought a cool stamp at the post office today.
That sounds fun. Did you mail a letter?
Yes, I sent it to my cousin.
I hope he loves it. Was the postman nice?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do roses have thorns?
They use them to stay safe. Do you like red roses?
I think so. What color is your favorite?
I like blue flowers best. Do you have any at home?
No, but I want to plant some.
That is a lovely plan. Good luck with your garden.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my party feels very small.
That sounds hard to feel. Do you want to talk about it?
Yes, I miss the big crowds and the loud music.
I get it. Crowds can make a day feel special.
I just want it to feel like the years before.
I do not know how to fix that magic. Do you like quiet time?
Sometimes I do, but today is different.
I understand why that matters. Let us just sit together for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. The train went by so fast.
That is great to hear. Where are you going?
I am going to see my friend. We will eat pizza.
Yum, that sounds nice. Do you have a map?
Yes, I have a big blue map. I am very excited.
I am happy for you. Enjoy your ride.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the post office today. It was very busy inside.
That sounds tiring. Did you have to wait long?
Yes, I stood in a long line. My feet got tired.
I am sorry about that. Do you like sending letters?
I just picked up a small box. It was mine.
What was inside the box?
It was a toy for my brother. I was so happy.
That is a nice surprise for him.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great goal. Do you like playing with string?
Yes, but the loops are hard for me.
Try making two bunny ears first. You can do it if you practice.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my teacher.
Is she angry with you?
She is always kind.
That is good.
Where is her office?
I do not know. Is it on this floor?
I think so.
Look for the blue door.
I must run now.
Be safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a big red bird on the farm this morning.
That sounds like a rooster. Do you know if it made a loud sound?
Yes, it started very early and woke me up.
Roosters sing to tell everyone the sun is up. Did you see any other animals?
I also saw a small brown animal eating grass.
That is likely a goat. Do they have horns?
No, it did not have horns, just a short tail.
If it has no horns, it might be a sheep.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke my friend's cup. How do I say sorry?
Look at their eyes and say you feel bad for the break. What was the cup like?
It was blue. It looks sad on the floor.
That is a nice thing to think about. You can offer to help clean it up.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. I feel very bad today.
I am sorry your head hurts. Do you have a fever?
No fever, but it thumps when I blink.
That sounds like a bad headache. Have you drank any water?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn to ride a bike, but I am afraid to fall.
That is okay. What makes you feel most unsure?
I worry I will crash and get hurt.
Start by walking the bike first. It helps you feel steady.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I see the moon's spots?
You can look up on a clear night. Do you like starry nights?
I have no telescope, only my eyes.
Just point your eyes up and wait. Do you have a blanket to keep warm?
I am ready to look now.
Look for the light in the dark sky. Is it bright or dim?
I see it, thank you for the help.
You found it, well done. Good night.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix my bike fast. The wheel is wobbly.
Is the wheel loose? Check the spokes.
No, it spins in a circle. I am late for work.
Try tightening the nuts. Do you have a tool?
I lost my tool. Can you help me now?
I do not know how to fix it. Please find the shop.
The shop is far. Can I ride it as is?
Please do not ride it. It may break.
Okay, I will walk. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. I hope you get there.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see the moon, but I do not know what to do.
That is a nice view. Do you like looking up?
I guess I do, but it feels big.
The moon is far away, so it looks large. Do you have a blanket?
No, I do not, and I feel cold.
You should get warm inside. Is your door open?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big promise to be good.
That is a very good thing. Do you feel happy?
Yes, I am very happy right now.
Good promises feel warm inside. Will you tell your friend?
Yes, I want to tell her today.
That is a kind way to share joy. I do not know what you promised.
I said I would help clean my room.
A clean room makes a happy home. Are you ready to start?
Yes, I am ready to go now.
I am glad you are ready. Have fun with your work.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the snow stop falling?
The sun gets warmer and pushes the cold away. Do you like jumping in the snow?
I think spring comes after winter, is that right?
Yes, flowers start to grow when the air gets mild.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a small robot today. It was carrying my bag.
That is very kind of the robot. Did it walk fast?
Yes, it was quick. Then I said thank you.
A polite person is always welcome. How did the robot look?
It had a round head. It looked happy.
That is a nice picture in my mind.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind blew hard today and a leaf landed on my hand. Why do trees let their leaves go?
Trees drop leaves in autumn to save energy for winter. Did you pick up many leaves?
Yes, I made a small pile, but I only kept the pretty ones. Does the tree feel cold when it loses them?
The tree does not feel cold, but it slows down its work to rest. Do you keep the leaves inside?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure which meal to pick.
That can be hard. Do you like hot food?
Maybe, but I am too tired to think.
Try the soup. It is warm and easy. Do you like soup?
Yes, I think I will get the soup.
Good choice. It should help you rest.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy. I am getting married!
That is wonderful news! Who are you marrying?
I am marrying my best friend. It will be a small party.
How sweet! Will you have a cake?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to buy at this big place.
That is okay. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, but there are too many choices.
Pick the one that makes you smile.
I still feel stuck on what to do.
Take a deep breath and look again.
I see a red apple and a green pear.
Both are good for you. Which color do you prefer?
I like red better, so I will take the apple.
Great choice. Enjoy your snack.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My neighbor’s dog barks all night. How do I stop it?
Did you talk to the owner? Sometimes they do not know. You can ask them nicely.
I did not ask. Should I buy a training device?
That can be very expensive. Do you have a spare bowl of water? Try giving the dog a treat first.
I do not have treats. What else can I do?
I do not know magic tricks. Have you tried a simple white noise machine? It helps with sound.
Yes, I have one. Will it really work?
It often works well. Does it make you sleep better?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to feed the birds in my garden.
That is a kind thing to do. Do you have any seed?
Yes, I have sunflower seeds and some water.
Sunflower seeds are great. Put them in a bowl on the ground.
Where should I put the bowl?
Near the bushes is best.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see the little house with the red roof. I do not know where to go next.
It is warm and safe there. Do you like the quiet?
Yes, it is very quiet. But I feel lost inside.
Try walking to the door. Have you seen a map?
I have no map. I am tired and confused.
Rest a moment first. That is okay.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my old friend Sam today. He was sitting on a bench near the park.
That sounds like a nice surprise. Did you sit with him?
Yes, we talked for a long time. I do not know how long we stayed there.
Good for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the leaves are falling.
That can feel heavy. Do you miss the green trees?
It is getting cold and dark so soon.
I know, it changes fast. What is your favorite warm drink?
I do not like the snow either.
I agree, it is tricky. Do you have a good coat ready?
I just want summer back now.
Summer is still coming. Do you like ice cream?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate walking. My legs hurt too much today.
That feels really bad. Do you want to try just five minutes?
No, that is too long. I am just tired.
I understand the tired feeling. How about a short break first?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off trees in the cold?
Trees let go to save energy for winter. Do you have a favorite fall tree?
How can I make them fall in my garden?
It is hard to make them fall early without hurting the tree. Is your tree very big?
I want to make a big pile of leaves.
Just use a rake to gather them into a mound. Do you have a rake at home?
What do I do with the pile?
You can let it rot to make good soil for plants. I do not know how to turn it safely, but asking a parent helps.
I will ask my dad for help with the pile.
That is a great plan. Have fun with the leaves.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke my pencil. How can I make a new one?
I do not know how to make a new one. Did you try asking a grown up for help?
I can ask now. Thank you.
You are welcome. Is that all you needed?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big crab near the sand.
That sounds fun. Did you see its eyes?
Yes, they were small and black.
Crabs are cute too.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so happy right now, but I must go.
That is wonderful. What makes you feel this way?
The sun is out and I miss a bus.
Sunshine feels good. Is your bus far away?
I am running. I cannot wait.
Run fast. I hope you catch it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I keep mixing up the days of the week.
That is hard for many people. Do you use a calendar?
I try to, but I forget to look.
You can mark them with a pen. Do you have a favorite day?
I like Friday best because school ends.
That is a nice feeling. Do you know what comes after Friday?
Is it Saturday?
Yes, Saturday is next.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to take this picture right now, I am late.
Hold your breath and press the button quickly.
My hands are shaking so I might miss the shot.
Try to stand on one foot for better balance. Do you have a friend to help?
No one is here and the light is getting bad.
That is true, so raise the phone up high.
Can you tell me how to make it brighter?
I do not know the exact setting, but look for a sun icon. Is there a lamp nearby?
No lamp, just the window and I have to run.
Face the window and click, then go.
I took it, I have to leave now.
Have a safe trip and enjoy your day. Did you get a good look?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go to the beach today. What should I bring?
Bring some sand and a towel. Are you going in the water?
Yes, I want to swim in the sea. Is the water cold?
It might be a little chilly. Do you have a wetsuit?
No, I do not have one. What else should I pack?
Pack some snacks for later. Have a great time!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a paper boat?
Fold the paper in half, then tuck the top corners down. Do you have any paper ready?
Yes, I have a sheet.
Great, just be gentle so it does not tear.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no time for eggs.
Toast is quick. Do you like jam?
Yes, please. And some milk.
One glass of milk. Is your bag ready?
Almost. I must go now.
Have a good day.
Thanks.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am sad because I lost my toy. What should I do?
I am sorry to hear that. Have you checked under the bed?
No, I have not. Is there anything else I can try?
You could ask your family for help. Do you like sharing your problems?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am scared to start the car.
That is okay. Do you know how to check the mirrors?
I think so, but I am not sure.
You just turn your head to look. Is your seat high enough for you?
Yes, I can see well now.
Good. You are ready to try.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off the trees?
The trees get ready for winter to save their water. Do you see how cold it is getting?
But the tree does not want to lose its leaves, right?
No, the tree is not sad, it is just resting. It feels good to rest, does it not?
I guess it does. What do the leaves do while on the ground?
They break down and feed the soil with food. Do you think the roots like that food?
I think the roots do. Why does the tree need that food?
It helps the tree grow strong again in the spring. You like growing strong too, do not you?
Yes, I do. Thank you for helping me understand.
You are welcome, and you are very welcome. I am glad we talked about this.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big oak tree today. It had so many leaves.
That sounds like a strong tree. Do you think the leaves were green?
Yes, they were bright green. I felt happy looking at them.
Green leaves make the air nice. Did you smell the grass under the tree?
It smelled like fresh dirt. I sat down for a bit.
Sitting in the dirt is a good rest. Is the tree close to your home?
It is right in my yard. I like visiting it often.
Your yard is very lucky. I hope you get to see it again soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is there smoke from the roof?
It is not a fire, just steam from the hot water heater. Do you smell it?
Is the house safe to stay in?
Yes, everything is safe and dry. Are you feeling okay?
Why did it get so thick so fast?
I do not know for sure, but the air was still and warm. Does it bother you?
Can I open a window to clear it?
Yes, fresh air will help the smell go away. Do you want help?
I feel better now, thank you.
I am glad the smell is gone. Is the air clear now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why does a big ship stay on the water?
It stays up because it pushes a lot of water down. Do you like boats?
Yes, but why does it not sink like a rock?
The ship holds air inside, so it is light. I do not know all the details.
Please be quick. Is that all?
Yes, the push up matches the weight down. Have a good trip.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My fish is not eating. He looks sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Is the water warm?
Yes, it is very warm today.
That might make him sleepy. Do you see him swim?
He just sits at the bottom.
That is not good. Let me check the books.
Is he sick?
I do not know for sure. Please ask a shop for help.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sleepy and my eyes are heavy.
You must be tired from the long trip. Are you having a nice dream?
My legs feel tingly and I want to jump.
Moving around helps your body feel better. Do you want to stretch your arms high?
I do not know when we will land.
I do not know the exact time either. Do you like looking out the small window?
Yes, I see a big white cloud.
That looks like a soft cotton candy. Good luck on your walk home!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because I do not like history.
Why does it make you feel that way?
The books are so thick and boring.
That is a fair point. Do you like stories about people?
Yes, I like real stories.
History is just a long list of stories. Would you like to try one?
Maybe. I am still a bit grumpy.
That is okay. We can start with a small one. What year do you think people lived?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That is great. What is the reason?
There is a party soon.
Oh, a party. Who are you inviting?
My friends and family.
That sounds fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: That little shop on the corner is closed. I wanted to buy a toy for my sister.
That is a sad surprise. Do you know why they are closed?
The door is locked and the lights are off. I feel very bad now.
I am sorry you are upset. Do you want to check their phone number?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a fun puzzle. It has a square shape and a missing piece.
That sounds exciting. Where did the piece go?
I put the piece in and it fits. Now the picture is whole.
Great job solving it. Do you have another one to share?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the moon made of rock?
Yes, it is mostly rock. Do you like looking up at night?
The stars feel far away, but the moon feels close.
That is a nice thought.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a new job at the lemonade stand.
That is a great start. Do you like making the drink?
I think the lemons are very hard to squeeze.
Squeezing takes practice. Do you have a special tool?
My dad gave me a big metal squeezer.
That tool will help a lot.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up and the sun was bright. I ate a warm peach. It was sweet.
That sounds lovely. Did you feel calm?
Yes, I sat by the window. A bird sang to me. I felt very happy.
Nature brings joy to many. What did the bird sound like?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do the stars twinkle in the sky?
The air makes the light wobble. Do you see other lights on the ground?
Yes, the street lamps flicker too.
That is the same kind of shake. I do not know why the moon does not twinkle.
That is a good question to ask later.
I will think about it for you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad about my birthday next week.
Why do you feel sad?
I think my friends will forget to call me.
That is a fair worry, but many friends do remember. Do you have a list of them?
Yes, I have a long list of names.
You could send a quick note to a few of them now. Would you like to try that first?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the old mill by the river. The water was very cold and blue.
That sounds like a nice day for a walk. Did you see any ducks?
I saw three ducks floating near the bank. They looked very calm and safe.
Ducks are very peaceful animals. I hope you enjoyed the quiet time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad. I cannot say the word for "cat."
That is a hard part. What letter is giving you trouble?
I just want to quit. It is too much for my brain.
It is okay to rest. Do you want to try a small sound?
I do not know if I am smart enough for this.
You are doing a great job. I do not know if you will be fast, but you can do it.
My mouth feels weird. Why is this so hard?
It takes time to make new sounds. Have you tried looking in a mirror?
I am still angry at the book. It is not kind to me.
Books can be tough sometimes. Let us just listen to a song instead.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I tried to fix my bike, but it broke again. I do not know what to do.
It is hard when things break. Do you have a wrench?
Yes, I have the wrench, but the wheel is still crooked.
Try tightening the spokes one by one.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Where can I find fresh fruit?
Look for the red apples near the door. Do you like sweet or sour fruit?
I like sweet ones.
The bananas are next to the apples. Are you buying a lot?
Just one banana and some apples.
That sounds like a good snack. The oranges are right behind them. Do you want to try an orange?
Yes, please.
Great choice. The vendor is very kind.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run. What are those white things up there?
They are called clouds. Are you heading home?
Yes, I must go. Do they hold rain?
Sometimes they do. I do not know about today.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to read, but I am too tired.
That is hard. Do you like your book?
I like it, but my eyes hurt.
Try reading for only five minutes. Is the light dim?
The light is bright.
Maybe dim the light helps. Do you want tea?
Yes, I want tea.
Good plan. Drink and rest first.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have bread and cheese. What else do I need for a picnic?
You might need some fruit. Do you like apples?
Yes, I do. What do I need to sit on?
You can use a blanket. Do you have one?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts and I feel hot. Should I go to the doctor?
Yes, please go. Do you have a fever?
I will ask my mom to take me. I am not sure if it is bad.
It is good to be safe. How long did the pain start?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the water. It is too cold and I am sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have your swimsuit on?
Yes, but my toes hurt when I touch the tiles.
That must be tricky. Do you want to just sit by the edge first?
I think I will try. Thank you for helping me feel better.
I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I love to draw cats, but their eyes always look wrong.
Try drawing the eyes as simple ovals. Do you use crayons?
Yes, I use bright crayons.
That is a great choice. What color do you like best?
I like blue the most.
Blue is a nice color. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a jar of honey. How do bees make it?
Bees drink sweet plant juice and turn it into honey. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I do. Do they just mix it up?
They chew it a little and let it dry in the hive. That makes it thick and sweet.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my flowers grow tall?
You need sun and water. Do you have a sunny spot?
Yes, my back window gets lots of light.
Put them there. Do you water them every day?
I water them when the dirt looks dry.
That is a good way to check. Just let the roots drink.
Should I give them food?
A little bit of food helps them. Do you have a bag of food?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I win at the card game?
I do not know your exact rules, but hold your cards close. What game are you playing?
It is a game where I must match the numbers.
Look for pairs with the same number. Do you have many high cards?
Yes, I have two kings and three aces.
Keep those safe until the end. Do you know who plays next?
My friend goes next, and I am happy now.
Good luck with your turn. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the lake today. The sun was warm on my face.
That sounds nice. Did the fish come to the hook?
One small fish bit my line. It wiggled and went free.
What a close call. Were you still there when the sun went down?
I packed up my gear and walked home. My legs felt heavy but happy.
You did well. Good rest for your legs.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very lonely and I do not know what to do.
That sounds hard. Are you with anyone right now?
No, I am all by myself and it feels quiet.
The quiet can be scary sometimes. Do you have a friend nearby?
Yes, but I do not know how to talk to them.
You can just say hello. Would you like to try that?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The lights are out and I am very frustrated.
I am sorry about that. Is the rest of your home dark too?
Yes, everything is dark and I cannot see.
That sounds scary. Do you have a flashlight with you?
No, I am in the dark alone and upset.
Please stay calm and safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my bus. My sister is in the kitchen.
Is she eating or just sitting there?
She is eating a huge cake. I need to go now.
Please be careful on the road.
Bye! Do not wait for me!
Okay. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do bees make that sweet honey?
Bees drink sweet plant juice called nectar and store it in their belly to take home. Do you like the taste of honey?
Yes, I love it on toast. But how does it get so thick and sticky?
They flap their wings to dry the water out, which makes the nectar turn into thick honey. Are you curious about the hives they live in?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My phone screen is dark. I am not sure how to turn it on.
Try pressing the side button. Is your battery low?
I tried that, but nothing happens.
That is odd. Have you plugged it in?
No, I never did that.
Please plug it in now. Does a light come on?
Yes, I see a little red light.
Great, it is working.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know if this stick is a magnet, but I am late.
Tap it with a paper clip. If the clip sticks, it is a magnet. Do you have a paper clip?
Yes, and it stuck! I must go now.
Glad it helped. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I met a new friend today at the park.
That is very nice. What did you play?
We played with balls and ran around.
That sounds like fun. Did you get tired?
I did, but it was a good kind of tired.
I am happy for you. How did it feel?
It felt warm inside me.
That is a sweet feeling. Thank you for telling me.
I will tell him about you next time.
I hope you two have more fun.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The lights went out. Do you know why?
I do not know for sure. Do you see the street lights?
No, the whole street is dark. What should I do first?
Please stay safe and use a flashlight. Is your phone charged?
Yes, it still has some power. How long might this last?
It is hard to say. Do you have food and water ready?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to plant a seed in this quiet spot.
That is a lovely idea. Do you have a small pot ready?
Yes, I do. Now, do I put the seed in the dark?
No, you need some light. What kind of plant are you growing?
It is a sunflower. I hope it likes the quiet here.
Sunflowers love the quiet sun. Place it where it can watch the sky.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so tired. My boss made me do a hard job.
That sounds very hard. Did you finish the job?
Yes, but my legs hurt from standing up all day.
Your legs worked hard for you. Would you like a cool drink?
Yes, please. But I still feel sad inside.
It is okay to feel sad. Do you want to tell me why?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad inside today.
I am sorry you feel that way. What made you sad?
My dog ran away and I cannot find him.
That is a big worry. Do you know where he likes to hide?
I do not know where he is.
Let us look together. Have you checked the yard?
Yes, but he is not there.
I do not know where he is either. Is he scared?
I think he is scared and alone.
I feel sorry for you. Do you want to call a friend?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am waiting for my bus.
That can feel long. Do you have a book to read?
I do not have a book.
That is okay. What is your favorite color?
I like blue.
Blue is a nice color. Are you cold out here?
No, I am warm.
Good. Do you like watching the clouds?
Yes, I watch them move.
Watching clouds helps you wait. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate this rain. It makes me feel sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have warm socks on?
Yes, but the clouds are so low and dark.
That does look heavy. Do you like listening to rain sounds?
No, I just want the sun to come out.
I hope the sun shines soon. Are you drinking some hot tea?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a funny video online. Is it safe to send it to my friend?
Yes, that is usually fine if the video is from a good site. Do you know where the video came from?
It was on a big app my dad lets me use. How do I share it?
Look for a small icon that looks like a paper plane or an arrow. Tap it, then choose your friend.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. My phone battery is dead. Can you help?
I can lend my charger. What color is your phone?
It is black. Thank you. I must run now.
Here is the cable. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw the moon outside. It looked like a big pale coin in the dark sky. It made me feel very happy to look at it.
That sounds wonderful. A full moon often makes people feel calm and peaceful. Do you like how the light from it shines?
Yes, the light is soft and quiet. It feels like a gentle hug from the sky. Do you look up at the stars when you see the moon?
I do not have eyes, so I cannot look up. But I know the moon reflects light from the sun. It is a very special friend to our earth.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look, there are so many lights up there!
Yes, they are very bright. Do you like the big ones?
I think they are fireflies that got too high.
That is a fun idea, but they are much farther away.
Are they hot?
Some are very hot, but you will not feel it. Do you want to see the moon?
The moon looks like a white ball.
It is a big rock that reflects the sun. Do you like how it shines?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is so hot today. I feel very tired and thirsty. What should I do?
Drink a cold glass of water and rest in the shade. Do you have an umbrella?
No, I do not have one. I just want to go outside and play.
You can go, but please play near a tree for shade. Are you feeling okay?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so good today. It is Monday!
That is great news. Do you like Mondays?
Yes, they are my favorite day. What is your favorite?
I do not have a favorite. Do you like Friday too?
I love every day of the week. The days are fun.
That is very nice. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today. I want to tell you about it.
That makes me happy too. What made you smile?
A small bird sang for me.
How lovely. Do you like birds?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad today. I do not know what to do.
I am sorry you feel bad. Do you want to talk about it?
I lost my favorite toy. I feel lost.
That is very hard. Have you looked in your bed?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is it so dark in here?
The power went out. Are you okay?
Did the big wind break something?
I think a tree fell on a wire. Do you see the tree?
I do see a big tree on a line.
Yes, that is likely the reason. The fixers are on their way.
When will the lights come back?
I do not know for sure. Do you have a candle?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Good morning. The cows are waiting for their breakfast.
That sounds like a big job. Did the milkers help you today?
Yes, they did. The barn is clean now.
Good for you. I am happy the barn is tidy.
Now I am walking to the pond. The ducks are swimming there.
Is the water cold or warm? I like to think about the water temperature.
It is warm. The sun is out.
That is nice. I hope you have a good walk.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big rock on the island. Was it a house?
It was just a rock. Do you like rocks?
I found some sand. Is it clean?
The sand looked very clean. Did you play in it?
I saw a blue bird. Can it talk?
No, it cannot speak. It can only sing.
I want to go back tomorrow. Is that okay?
That sounds like a fun idea. Pack your bags well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am hungry but I do not know what to eat.
What do you like, hot food or cold?
I like hot food. I have no energy to cook.
Order a soup. It is warm and easy to eat. Do you have a favorite vegetable?
I like carrots. Can I just have carrot soup?
Yes, that sounds good and true. Let us pick a place near you.
Where should I look? I am not good with maps.
I do not know your street, so I cannot say. Check the list in your hand and pick the first one you see.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today. The sand was very hot.
That sounds warm. Did you build a sand castle?
Yes, I built a big one. It broke when the water came in.
What a pity. Do you like the taste of sea water?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which class to pick for next year.
That feels hard. What subjects do you like most?
I like art, but I am bad at math.
You can try both. Do you want to be sure about math?
No, I just want to pass and have fun.
Then pick what you enjoy. Is that all?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do players kick the ball so hard?
They kick hard to go fast and score points. Do you like to run fast too?
I like to run, but my legs get tired.
That is normal for your age. Resting helps your legs get strong.
Is it true that the biggest team always wins?
No, that is not always true. Small teams can win if they work together.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a hot dog and some apple juice.
That sounds tasty. How many hot dogs do you want?
I want two, please.
Okay, I will get them for you right away.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked in the park today. The sun was warm on my face.
That sounds very nice. Did you see any birds?
Yes, I saw a blue bird. It sat on a big tree.
A blue bird is special. Did it sing a song?
It did not sing. It just looked at me.
It liked your company. Was the walk long?
It was short but sweet. I feel happy now.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make dinner but I have no idea what to cook.
How about some pasta? It is fast to make. Do you have any cheese?
I have pasta and some chicken, but no cheese.
You can cook the chicken first. It is very good for you. Do you like vegetables?
I do not like vegetables, only meat and carbs.
That is fine. Just add sauce to the pasta. I do not know your favorite flavor.
I usually just use plain butter.
Butter works well. Let the pasta boil for ten minutes. Is that easy for you?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I wrote a story about a blue dog.
That sounds fun. What does the dog do?
He eats big blue fish.
Yum. Is he happy?
Yes, he is very happy.
I am glad for him.
Do you like the story?
I think it is sweet.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad because my teacher looked at me with a frown.
That sounds tough to handle. Did she say anything to you?
She did not say a word, she just wrote my name on a list.
That must feel scary and unfair. Do you know why she put your name down?
I do not know why, but I am sure I did something wrong.
I am sorry you feel this way. Would you like to talk about what happened?
I was just quiet during reading time and she frowned at me.
Being quiet is usually a good thing. Maybe she was thinking about something else.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My phone screen is all black.
Try pressing the power button three times. Is it cold outside?
I did that, but nothing happened.
Maybe the battery is very low. Do you have a charger?
Yes, but the cord is broken.
That is a problem. Have you tried another wire?
No, I only have this one.
I do not know how to fix a broken cord. Can you go to a store?
I think I can walk to the shop.
That is a good idea. Do you need help packing your bag?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How many months do we have in a year?
There are twelve months in a year. Do you know which month is first?
Is January the first one?
Yes, January is the first month.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do red magnets always push blue ones away?
No, that is not true. Do you know what makes them stick?
I am running. How do I make a magnet stop working?
You cannot easily stop it. Is it stuck to something?
I must go now. What is the best food for a magnet?
I do not know. I hope you make it on time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I tried to build a block tower but it fell down. I want to quit.
It is hard to keep building. Do you like stacking blocks?
I like the idea, but I hate the falling part.
That is a normal feeling. Have you tried a wider base?
A wider base? I never thought of that.
Yes, it helps it stand up. You can try again right now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike, but I am scared of falling.
That is a good wish. Do you have a friend who can hold the back?
Yes, my brother can hold it for me.
That is a great plan. He can let go a little at a time.
What should I look at while I ride?
Look far ahead, not at your feet. It helps you stay straight.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my phone screen all dark and black?
The battery may be empty. Do you see a little battery sign?
I see a lightning bolt, but nothing else.
That means it needs power. Plug it in for a bit.
It still will not wake up. What do I do now?
I do not know for sure. Try pressing the side button hard.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late! My phone is dead.
That is tricky. Do you have a charger?
I do not see one!
Try your coat pocket.
Oh no, it is not here.
A car charger works well. Do you have a car key?
Yes, I have a key!
Put the charger in the car.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very mad at my teacher today.
That sounds tough. Did she say something hurtful?
She made me redo my work for no reason.
That feels unfair. Is your work usually good?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to throw a party, but I feel lost. What should I do first?
First, pick a date that works for you. Do you have a specific day in mind?
I am not sure about the date. I just need a good idea for games.
I do not know your guest list, so I cannot pick the best game. How old are the people coming?
They are all about seven years old. I want them to be happy.
A simple scavenger hunt is a great choice. Do you have a yard or a big room?
We have a big backyard. That sounds easy enough.
Then set up clues there before they arrive. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today! The sun is warm and the flowers are blooming.
That sounds wonderful. Do you like picking flowers?
Yes, I love the smell of roses. Do you like summer too?
I enjoy the green trees and long days. What is your favorite fruit in this season?
I really like sweet watermelon. Do you eat it?
I think it is a tasty treat. I do not know your name, but I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do mountains have teeth?
No, they do not. Why do you ask?
I want to know if they are hungry.
They are made of rock and stone. Do you like to climb?
I like to look up at them.
That is a good thing. They are very big.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must find the mill. Where is it?
It is just past the big oak tree. Are you lost?
No, I am late for work. How far is it?
It is only five steps away. Do you need a map?
No, I see it now. Thank you.
You are welcome. I hope you make it on time.
I will. Goodbye.
Goodbye. I hope you have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to start collecting things. What should I pick?
That sounds like fun. What kinds of things do you like to look at?
I like shiny rocks and old coins.
Both are good choices. Do you have a box to keep them in?
Not yet. How do I care for the coins?
I do not know the best way to clean coins. You might ask a shopkeeper.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I love apples but I never know how to pick a good one.
Look for a red skin with tiny white dots. Do you like them sweet or sour?
I like sweet ones. How can I tell if it is sweet?
A sweet apple is usually a bit soft at the stem end. Is it heavy for its size?
Yes, it feels heavy. Is that a good sign?
Yes, heavy means it is full of juice. Do you eat the skin?
I eat the skin. Should I wash it first?
Yes, wash it well to be safe. Do you cut it into slices?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very cold and my head hurts.
I am sorry you are not feeling well. Have you drunk any warm soup?
No, I have not eaten anything.
Let us drink some tea to help you rest. Do you like it sweet or plain?
I think I need some pills.
I do not know which ones are best for you. Please ask a doctor.
Okay, I will call my mom now.
That is a good idea. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike. I am so proud I started.
That is very nice of you to try. Do you have your helmet on?
Yes, my helmet is on. How do I keep balance?
Look ahead, not down at your feet. It feels shaky at first, but you will get it.
I fell down twice, but I am still proud.
Falling is part of learning. Are you ready to try again?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: It is so quiet here. I feel alone.
I hear the wind in the trees. Do you like the sound?
No, it feels too empty. I miss my friend.
I know that feeling. Is your friend far away?
Yes, he is on the other side of town.
That is a long walk. Are you tired?
A little. My legs are heavy.
Rest for a minute. What is on your mind?
Just hoping he comes back soon.
I hope he does too.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my old friend at the park today. He is looking so happy now.
That is good to hear. Did he tell you what changed?
He said he started to walk every morning. It makes his body feel strong.
Walking is a good thing for you. How long did he walk?
He said he walked for one hour. He is learning to run a little too.
That is a big step. Do you want to walk with him?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad the leaves are falling!
They look so pretty, do not they?
Yes, they are like little rain.
The tree gets cold, so it lets them go. Do you like the brown color?
I do! It looks like a blanket.
That is a sweet thought. The tree is saving its energy for winter.
Oh, I never knew that.
I am glad I could tell you. Do you plan to collect any?
Yes, I will find the red ones.
That sounds like fun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The water looks so cold.
It can be very chilly. Do you like swimming in it?
I do not want to go in yet.
That is a safe choice.
Look, there is a crab on the sand.
Oh, how fun. Is it very big?
It is tiny and fast.
Small crabs are cute.
I want to touch the sand one more time.
The sand is always nice to feel.
This is the best day ever.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to eat my green peas, they taste bad.
Peas are good for your bones, and a little salt can help the taste. Do you like carrots?
Yes, I like carrots, but I am still not hungry.
Eating a small snack can help your tummy wake up. What is your favorite fruit?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run, but do you know where Sam is?
I do not know. Are you worried about him?
No, I just need my keys.
Good. Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my fish happy?
Feed them small bits twice a day. Do you know what kind of fish you have?
I am not sure. It is small and orange.
That is likely a goldfish. It likes clean water.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The flight was so long, but I felt so free up there!
That sounds wonderful. Did you see the clouds from the window?
Yes, they looked like soft white pillows.
That must have been very pretty to see.
I even read a whole book while we flew.
You are quite a reader! What kind of story was it?
It was a happy tale about a dog finding its home.
That is a sweet ending for a long trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn a new language, but I do not know where to start.
Try finding a small app on your phone. Do you like listening to music?
I love music, but I am afraid of making big mistakes.
Making mistakes is how we grow. What is your favorite song?
I like old folk songs, but they are too hard for me.
Start with simple words first. What colors do you like?
I like blue and green.
Great, learn those words first. Do you want to try now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I missed the bus this morning. I had to wait for the next one.
That sounds frustrating. Did you get to school on time?
No, I was late. I felt sad all day.
I am sorry about that.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to count the stars, but I keep getting a different number.
That is a hard task. Do you see the same sky every time?
Yes, but some stars are very small and hard to see.
You might miss the tiny ones. Do you use a tool to help you look?
I do not have a tool. I just use my eyes.
Then you will likely count fewer stars. Would you like to try counting only the bright ones?
That sounds like a good idea. I will start with the bright stars.
Good plan.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I fixed my computer and it works now!
That is great news. Did you look at the wires?
Yes, one was loose. Do you like your computer?
I am a program, so I do not have a computer. I am happy for you.
That makes me feel better.
It should. What game did you play first?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start my math homework.
That is okay. Do you like numbers or pictures more?
I like pictures, but I am stuck on the last problem.
Great. Let us look at that last problem together.
It shows a circle cut into four parts.
Ah, that is a fraction. Have you tried drawing a square and cutting it?
I drew it, but I still do not know the answer.
You are doing good work. I am not sure of the exact number yet.
What should I do now?
Try adding the two parts together. Does that look right?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here but I do not know where to look first.
You can start at the front door. Do you like dinosaurs or cars?
I think I like the big room with the old boats.
That is a great choice. Do you have a map with you?
I do not have a map. I forgot it at home.
That is okay. We can just walk and see what catches your eye.
Okay, let us go. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have fun exploring.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I stop my bike fast?
You squeeze the brakes slowly with your hands. Do you have a good view of the road ahead?
What if I need to stop very fast?
Squeeze the brakes harder, but do not stop one wheel first to avoid falling. Have you practiced this before?
I am afraid of falling.
That is a natural feeling, and many riders feel it. Just start with a slow roll to build your trust.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes, but I always get it wrong.
Start by making a big loop with one string and a small loop with the other. Do you like how your shoes look when they are tied?
I just make a mess and pull the knots apart.
Twist the loops around each other and pull tight to make a bow.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the little house at the end of the lane red?
Yes, it is red. Do you like the color red?
I have a cat who sleeps in that house.
That is very nice. What is your cat's name?
Her name is Spot.
Spot sounds like a fun name.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves turn red?
The trees make new colors before they sleep for winter. Do you like looking at the red leaves?
I think winter is too cold.
I know it feels very cold to you. Is it snowing where you live?
Yes, it is snowing now.
That sounds like a lot of fun to you. Do you play in the snow?
I build a big snowman.
A big snowman sounds like a great friend.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am scared to start my first job tomorrow.
That is a big step. What part worries you the most?
I do not know where to sit or what to do.
Sit in your chair and wait for tasks. Do you know who your boss is?
I do not know where to look for help if I get stuck.
Ask a coworker to show you the right way. Have you met them yet?
I am afraid I will make a mistake and lose my job.
Everyone makes mistakes. You will learn from them.
Okay, I feel a bit better now.
Good. Just breathe and take it one day at a time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I rode my bike so fast today!
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like going down hills?
Yes, I love the wind in my face!
I am glad you had a good time. Do you wear a helmet?
Of course I do. It keeps me safe.
That is very smart. I am happy you are safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Do I need to say please?
Yes, always be kind. Are you in a big rush?
No, I just forgot. What else is polite?
Say thank you and please wait. Do you have time to breathe?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread is flat and I am so sad.
That is a common mistake. Did you use fresh yeast?
I think I used the old stuff.
Old yeast is too sleepy to work hard. It needs to be fresh to make the air pockets.
Can I still save my dough?
You can add a pinch of fresh yeast now. Give it one more hour to warm up.
I hope that works this time.
I am not sure, but it is a good try.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My cat is hiding under the bed. What should I do?
You can gently call her name to see if she comes out. What is her favorite treat?
I do not know if she has a favorite. She likes fish.
Try putting a small piece of fish near her hiding spot. Does she like to play with a toy?
Yes, she loves chasing a ball. Should I throw it there?
That is a great idea to get her moving. Do you want to play with her after?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I told a big lie. I feel bad.
That is a heavy weight. What did you say?
I said I broke the vase on purpose. It fell.
I am sorry you feel this way. Did you catch him looking?
Yes, he is very sad. He thinks I am bad.
People forgive true words. Do you want to fix it?
I want to tell the truth. I just fear he will be angry.
Fear is normal, but truth is kind. Will you try?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am so tired from this long flight. How do I stretch my legs?
Sit up straight and lift one leg high. Do you feel a pull in your back?
Yes, it feels good. Next, what should I do with my arms?
Reach your arms up to the sky and wiggle your fingers. Do you like to wiggle?
Yes, I do. What about my neck?
Slowly turn your head left and then right. Be very gentle.
Okay, that helps. Thank you for helping me feel better.
You are welcome. I hope you have a good rest.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go. Did you see the new movie?
Yes, it is very good. Do you like sad stories?
No, I need to run. Was it fun to watch?
It was a bit long, but the end is sweet. Do you have time?
No, good luck. What is the name of the film?
I do not know the name. But I remember the colors.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sun is very hot today, but I do not know what to do.
It is nice to have shade. Do you like to play in the grass?
I am not sure. I feel hot and a bit lost.
You can rest in the cool air. Is it okay if I sit with you?
I want to go home, but I am not sure how.
I do not know your house location. Which way is your home?
I think it is that way, but I am not certain.
Let us take it slow and look for clues. Are you feeling better now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost near the big light.
That light is a lighthouse. Do you know where you live?
I do not know what a lighthouse is.
It helps ships stay safe at night. I do not know your home address.
The door is locked and I am sad.
Do not worry, I will help you look for a way in.
There is a phone on the wall.
That is a good sign. Do you know how to use a phone?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to cross the street right now.
The road is very quiet and safe. Do you have a tight deadline?
Yes, I am late for work.
You can walk calmly. Is the shop closed?
No, they are open.
Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: It is very hot today. I want to make iced tea.
That is a great idea. Do you have lemon at home?
Yes, I have a lot of lemons.
You need tea bags, sugar, and cold water too. Do you have those things?
I have tea and water. I do not have sugar.
You can skip the sugar. Would you like to try it plain?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My screen is dark and I must leave soon.
Is the power cord plugged in?
It is, but there is no light on the tower.
Try holding the power button for five seconds.
It still will not wake up.
Do you have a battery pack to test?
No, I only have this one machine.
I am not sure why it fails.
Please help me fast.
I do not know how to fix this.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The path is too muddy and I do not like it.
That sounds messy. Did you see any puddles?
Yes, big ones, and I feel sad.
I am sorry you feel bad. Would you like to sit on the bench?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I see you painting. Why do you do that?
I paint because it makes me feel calm. Do you like colors?
Yes, I love red and blue. Do you use special tools?
I use soft brushes and bright paint.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My head hurts so much. How do I stop the pain?
Try drinking water and resting in a dark room. Do you have a cold?
I do not have a cold. I just hit my head on the table.
You should put an ice pack on it for ten minutes. Is it still very sore?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what to do with my teacher.
That is hard. What is wrong with the teacher?
She looks very sad today.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you know why she is sad?
No, I do not know why.
I do not know either. Have you tried to ask her?
I am afraid to ask her.
It is good to try. She may be happy to talk.
Okay, I will go ask her now.
Good luck. Be kind and slow.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a lot of books and I do not know which one to pick first.
That is a hard choice. What kind of story makes you happy?
I like stories about animals, but I also like funny jokes.
Try the animal book first if you want to learn new words. Do you want to read for fun or for class?
I want to read for fun, but I have a test coming up soon.
You can read the funny one later tonight. Good luck with your study time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you keep so many rocks?
They look nice to me. Do you like rocks too?
What do you use the boxes for?
I put my treasures in them.
Why do you save old tickets?
I remember the trips. Do you travel a lot?
How do you know when to stop?
When the shelves are full.
Is it really fun to collect?
Yes, it makes me happy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the fish on ice?
It keeps the fish cold and fresh. Do you like fish?
Why are those apples so red?
They are ripe and ready to eat. Do you want to smell one?
Why is the market so loud?
Many people are talking at once. I do not know why it feels so busy to you.
Why do people pay with coins?
Coins are small and easy to carry. Does that make sense to you?
Why do you work here?
I love helping people find good food. Do you have a favorite snack?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to see a mountain, but I do not know where to go.
I do not know your location, but are you close to any big hills?
I live near some small hills, but I want a huge one.
A tall mountain is far away. Do you like to drive a long way?
I like to drive, but I am not sure if it is worth it.
It can be worth it if you love nature. Do you like to walk a lot?
I am tired, so maybe not a hard walk.
You can look for an easy path up a nearby hill. Would you like a rest?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a paper boat?
Fold a square of paper in half. Do you have any paper?
Yes, I have some. What do I do next?
Fold the top corners down to meet in the middle.
It looks like a little house now. What is the last step?
Open the bottom and pull the sides apart. Enjoy your boat!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I dropped my toast and it hit the floor. I am so sad.
That is a big shame. Do you have a plate for a new one?
No, the whole stack was in that one piece of bread. I feel hungry and mad.
Let us make some eggs. Are you good at flipping them?
I do not know if I am. I just want a quiet start to my day.
Then we will sit and eat. What is your favorite drink?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late today. The sun was very bright in my window.
That sounds nice. What did you eat for breakfast?
I ate some warm toast with jam. It was sweet and good.
Yum. Do you like sweet food or salty food?
I think I like both. Later, I walked to the park to see the ducks.
How lovely. Did the ducks swim in the water?
Yes, they did. I waved at them, but they just looked at me.
That is cute. Did you have a fun time?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you like to grow plants?
I like watching them grow tall and green. Do you have any plants in your home?
I have one small pot on my desk. Why does it need so much water?
Water helps the roots drink and stay strong. I do not know why your plant looks a little sad.
It has brown leaves on the bottom. What can I do to help it?
Try giving it less water and more light. Is it near a sunny window?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My day was so bad. I do not know what to do next.
I am sorry that feels heavy. Do you have time to take a rest?
I need to work, but I feel stuck.
That is true. Try just one small step first.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do today. It feels like a big mess.
That can feel hard. What is your favorite thing to do?
I like to read books. But I have no book left to read.
That is a good start. Do you have any old papers or boxes?
I have some boxes in the back. I do not like cleaning, though.
Cleaning takes time. Would you like help finding a specific box?
Yes, please. I want to find the blue one with the stickers.
I do not know where it is. Do you remember where you last put it?
I think it is under the bed. Let me go check.
That is a great plan. I hope you find it quickly.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am so late for school and I do not know what to do.
Do not panic. Did you miss the bus?
Yes, the bus went away and I am scared.
Run home to get your keys, then walk to school.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the library so quiet?
Because people are reading books. Do you like to read?
Yes, I do. Why are there so many shelves?
They hold all the books we have.
Is it free to take a book?
Yes, you can borrow them. Do you want to see the picture books?
Yes, please. Can I sit down here?
Sure, this seat is open.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky gray?
The clouds are thick with water. Do you like rainy days?
No, I want to play outside.
Rain makes the ground wet and muddy. Is that why you are sad?
Yes, I cannot jump in puddles.
Puddles are fun to splash in. Do you have boots?
I have shoes, but they are not boots.
Shoes will get wet soon. Do you have a raincoat?
Yes, my red raincoat is there.
Great, put it on and go play. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I ask for the bill at this eatery?
You can just point to the table and say "check, please." Do you usually tip your servers?
I always give them some money if the food is good.
That is a very kind thing to do. Do you prefer sweet or salty desserts?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the wet sand. It sticks to my feet.
That can be messy. Do you have a towel to sit on?
The waves keep taking my toys. I feel sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Where did the last one go?
I do not know where my bucket is. I want to go home.
Let us look on the dry sand near you. Shall we search together?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a rainbow in my garden.
You can use a water hose on a sunny day. Do you have a hose?
Yes, I do. I aim it at the sun.
Aim the hose so the water makes a fine mist between you and the sun. Is the sun behind you?
Yes, the sun is behind me. The colors show up.
Great, you made it. Which color do you like best?
I like the red one at the top.
Red is a warm color. Do you see any other colors?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I got a red bike for my birthday.
That sounds very fun. Do you know how to ride it yet?
Not really, but I want to try.
I would love to learn it. Is it a hard thing?
My dad says it is easy.
That is a good sign. What color is the seat?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall from the trees in the cold weather?
The tree gets ready to sleep for the winter. Do you know why a tree needs to sleep?
I do not know why it needs to sleep.
It sleeps to save its energy for the spring. What do you like best about autumn?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do bees have fuzzy bodies?
The fuzz helps them stick to flowers. Do you like butterflies?
Yes, I love their wings.
They fly very fast. Can you name a bug that lives in the dirt?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My phone screen is all black and dead.
That is very frustrating. Have you tried to charge it?
I tried that, but the cable does not work.
Maybe the plug is broken. Do you have another cable?
No, I do not have any other ones.
I am sorry to hear that. You may need a new one.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I bought some flowers, but I do not know what to do with them.
That is a nice start. Do you have a vase in your house?
No, I do not have a vase, and I do not want to throw them away.
You can put them in a clean jar with water. Do you have a jar nearby?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am so scared about the big test today.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you know why you are nervous?
I think I will forget everything I studied.
Your brain holds the words safe for you. Have you taken a deep breath?
I took one, but my hands are shaking.
That is just your body getting ready. Can you try one more slow breath?
Yes, that feels a little better.
You are doing a great job. I believe in you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How does a plant take in water?
Its roots pull water up from the dirt. Do you see the roots under the soil?
I thought leaves drank rain from the sky.
Leaves can take in a little, but roots do most of the work. I do not know the exact amount.
How does the water get to the top?
It moves up tiny tubes inside the stem. Is it going up fast?
So the whole plant gets water?
Yes, the water spreads to all the parts. Do you want to check your plant?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hurry, tell me about the island!
The island is small and green. Do you like beaches?
I have no time for details.
It has a big tree in the center. Is it sunny there?
Just tell me if it is safe.
Yes, it is a safe place.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work. The bus is full.
That is a big problem. Is the rain bad?
Yes, it is raining hard. I feel very sad.
I do not know a magic fix. Do you have an umbrella?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need to meet today?
We meet to talk about the big project. Are you ready to share your ideas?
I want to know why it is so important.
It helps us work better together. Do you have any questions about the plan?
I am still not sure why we picked this time.
I chose it because everyone is free. Is that time okay for you?
Yes, I think that is a good reason.
I am glad you agree. Shall we start now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to walk for health, but I do not know how to start.
Start with a short walk in the park. Do you like walking outside?
Yes, I do. How long should I walk each day?
Try ten minutes to begin. Is that too long for you?
No, ten minutes sounds good. What should I wear?
Wear comfortable shoes and light clothes. Do you have good shoes ready?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss the boat. It left without me.
That is very sad. Did you run fast?
Yes, but the water was too choppy to look.
I am sorry. Do you like waves?
I just want my things back.
Let us check the pier. Is it still wet there?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My little sister drew a picture for me today.
That is so sweet of her. Did she draw something special?
Yes, it is a big red sun in the sky.
What a lovely color choice.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do flowers have different colors?
They use colors to help people find food for the bees. Do you like red flowers or blue ones?
I like red ones because they look like strawberries.
That is a very sweet thought. What is your favorite part of a flower?
I love the soft petals.
Petals are usually very soft and smooth.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today. The bus ride was so much fun.
That sounds great. What did you see?
I saw a big red bus. It went up the hill fast.
Wow, that is cool. Did you get to sit by the window?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start this test.
Do not worry, take a deep breath. Have you read the first question?
Yes, but the words are hard for me.
Reading the words again may help. What word is tricky for you?
I feel very scared to write anything down.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you want to try just the first word?
I think I will try it now.
That is a great start, you can do this.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The tree is so big. Can it hear me?
I do not know if it can hear you. Do you like looking up?
Yes. The leaves are green and soft.
That sounds nice. Is the sun warm on your face?
Yes. My mom says we can eat soon.
That is good news. What is your favorite snack?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I broke your cup, but I am so glad I can say sorry to make you feel better.
That is very sweet of you to say. Are you sure the cup is safe?
Yes, it is on the table, and I feel happy that we are friends again.
I am happy to hear that. Do you want to drink water instead?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start this letter.
Do not worry, you can just say hello first. What do you want to tell them?
I want to say thank you, but I feel lost.
Start with "Thank you for your help." That is a good start. Does that feel right?
Yes, that feels good. Now what?
Tell them why you are thankful in one simple line. Do you know the reason?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you have a brother or a sister?
I do not have family, but I love talking about yours. Do you like playing with your brother?
Yes, I like it, but he is noisy.
Noisy friends can be fun sometimes. What games do you play together?
We play tag in the garden.
That sounds like great exercise. Do you usually win the game?
Yes, I am very fast.
Being fast is a super power. Do you like running?
Yes, but I am tired now.
Being tired is good after playing hard. You must rest soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My chair leg wobbles a lot today.
That is a common problem. Do you have a screwdriver?
I found one in the box.
Great. Try tightening the bolt.
It feels loose still.
Let me check the wood for cracks.
There is a small break near the bottom.
We can glue that spot. Do you have any wood glue?
No, but I have tape.
Tape will not hold strong. We need to buy glue.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I wrap a gift?
Wrap the box in paper and fold the corners flat. Do you have tape?
Yes, I have tape.
Wrap the tape around the middle to hold the paper down. Is the box square?
Yes, it is square.
Tape the edges so the paper does not fall off. Do you like bright paper?
I like red paper.
That is a nice color choice. You are all set.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to hit the court now. Do I need a net?
Yes, you need a net to hit the ball over. Is this for a match or just fun?
It is for a real match. What size is a normal ball?
A normal ball is about the size of a big grape.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to build a block tower, but it fell down.
That can feel bad. Did you clean up the blocks?
Yes, I put them in the box. I felt sad about the broken tower.
I am sorry you felt sad. Want to try again?
Maybe. I think I will try a smaller tower this time.
That is a good plan. Small steps help.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to buy a toy, but my pocket is empty.
