That is sad. Do you keep your coins in a jar?
Yes, I have a piggy bank full of shiny coins.
Nice! Can you use some for the toy now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you know where the surprise is?
I do not know. Are you scared?
Yes. I just need to go now.
Okay. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My little boat is stuck in the mud. I am so sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you see any clear water nearby?
I tried to push it, but it will not move.
That is very tough. Try pulling gently on the rope.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just won my first game! It was so much fun.
That is great to hear! Do you like moving the king?
Yes, he is my boss. I am so happy right now.
It is good to win. What do you want to do next?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a nice red pebble by the river today.
That sounds like a lovely find. Did you put it in your pocket?
Yes, it fits right there with my other stones.
Your collection must be growing big. Do you like collecting smooth things best?
Mostly, but I also have a few jagged ones.
A jagged stone can be fun to look at too. Are you planning to show them to a friend?
Maybe later, but I want to count them first.
Counting is a good way to remember them. How many do you have so far?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the pool today and it was very warm.
That sounds nice. Did you use a floaty?
No, I swam by myself for ten minutes.
Great job! How did the water feel?
It was a little cold at first, but then it got okay.
Water can be tricky like that. Do you like racing?
I raced my friend and I won.
You are a fast swimmer. What did you eat after?
I had a big banana and some juice.
That is a good snack. Thank you for sharing your day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: It is so hot today. I feel very bad.
That sounds tough. Is your fan working?
No, it broke. I am stuck in the heat.
I am sorry to hear that.
I just want some cold water.
Try a wet cloth on your neck.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the post office today. I was so happy!
That is nice to hear. What made you feel so good?
I mailed a big surprise to my best friend.
Oh, that sounds fun. Did you put it in the blue box?
Yes, I did. It felt great to send it.
I am glad you are happy. I do not know where it will go next.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to clean my room today. Do you know how to start?
Yes, start with your bed. Do you like to pick things up or wipe things down first?
I pick things up. Then what should I do next?
Great choice. Next, take your trash to the bin. Do you have a full bag ready?
Yes, it is full. My floor has some dust too. How do I clean that?
Use a broom or a vacuum. Do you have both at home?
I have a broom. Should I sweep under the bed?
Yes, sweep under the bed last. I do not know your exact tools, but a broom works well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very lonely and sad. What should I do?
It is okay to feel that way. Do you have a pet?
I do not have a pet. I just want a friend.
That is a hard thing to ask for. What do you like to play?
I like to draw pictures. I always do it alone.
Drawing is a great way to share. Do you have an art class?
No, but I can go to the park.
Good idea. You can ask someone to watch you draw.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big old dinosaur bone today. It made me feel so happy.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Was the bone very tall?
Yes, it was taller than me. I want to tell you all about it.
I am glad you are enjoying the museum.
Do you like to see old things too?
I do not have eyes, but I like learning about them.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I keep losing the card game. It makes me feel very sad.
I am sorry you are having a hard time. Do you like picking the red cards?
I do not care about the colors. I just wanted to win.
I know it is nice to win. Would you like to rest for a minute?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My cat jumped onto the table today.
Did she break anything?
She knocked over a glass.
Oh no, was it full?
It was empty, so that is good.
That is lucky.
She is sleeping now.
Is she sleeping on your bed?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for the big day.
Take a deep breath. Is the car ready?
Yes, but I do not know where the rings are.
Do not panic. I will help you look.
Thank you, this is very scary.
You have got this. Do you have your phone?
Yes, it is right here in my hand.
Great. Let us check the couch first.
Please hurry, I am out of time.
Stay calm. We will find them soon.
Okay, I trust you.
Let us open the top drawer.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is the name of the time when trees have no leaves?
That time is called winter. Do you like winter?
I do not like winter because it is very cold.
I understand why you do not like it. Do you wear a hat when you go outside?
Yes, I always wear my big red hat.
That sounds very warm and cozy. What color is your scarf?
My scarf is yellow like the sun.
A nice choice. Do you see any birds in the trees?
I saw a little bird yesterday.
That is a lovely sight. Did the bird have a nest?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I just planted my seeds and they will not grow. I am very sad.
I am sorry your seeds are not growing. Do you put the pot in the sun?
I put them in the dark because I think they like it.
Most seeds need light to see the sun. Do you have a bright window near your spot?
No, I only have the dark corner. I do not know what to do.
Let us move them to the light for now. Do you feel a bit better?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this rain.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I do. It is too cold now.
I can feel the chill too. Are you wearing a coat?
No, I forgot it at home.
That is a big mistake. It must be freezing out there.
Yes, my hands are very cold.
You should get warm soon. Do you have any hot tea?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so warm and fuzzy today. I love how I can rest in bed all day.
That sounds cozy. Do you have soup?
Yes, I have hot chicken soup. It makes me feel strong inside.
Nice food helps you heal. Are you drinking water?
I drink lots of water, thank you. I feel happy being sick.
Glad you feel good. Take care.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a big talk with my friend Tom today.
That sounds fun. What are you going to play?
We are playing hide and seek in the yard.
Nice. Do you like to hide?
Yes, I love hiding behind the big tree.
A secret spot. I do not know where that tree is.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want a drink, but I do not know which one to pick.
Tea is warm and calm, while coffee gives you energy. Do you want to feel calm or active?
I think I want to feel calm, but I am not sure if I like the taste.
You can try a small cup of fruit tea. Do you have any tea bags at home?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I can not get the knight to move right.
A knight jumps in a funny shape. Do you like to jump too?
I want to catch the big king.
You must block the king first. What piece are you using?
The little white pawns are gone.
Oh no. You can still win with the queen.
Thank you for helping me play.
You are welcome. Did you have fun?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see red lights in the dark outside my window.
That sounds like a fire truck. Is it loud?
Yes, it is very loud and scary.
It is good that help is coming. Do you feel safe?
I am scared the smoke will get in.
Check your doors for warm air. Can you smell smoke?
No, I do not smell anything bad.
That is a good sign. Stay with your family.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late and I dropped my keys.
Do not panic. Did you drop them on the floor?
Yes, I ran past them by mistake.
Look behind you. I see them right there.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the best way to keep bugs away?
A small fan helps a lot. Do you like sleeping in a tent?
Yes, I love it. How do I make a good fire?
Use dry sticks and paper. Is it windy where you go?
It can be windy. How do I keep my food safe?
Hang it high in a tree. Do you pack your own food?
I usually buy snacks. Do I need a special bag?
I do not know for sure. Do you like cold drinks?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I wrote a letter and I am so happy. Can you read it?
That is great to hear. Would you like to share the first sentence?
It says the sun is very warm today. I love sunny days.
Nice choice. Do you describe the sky?
Yes, it is bright blue and clear. No clouds at all.
Very true. How does that make you feel?
It makes me feel free and light. Thank you for listening.
You are welcome. I enjoyed hearing your joy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to knit a scarf. Can you show me how?
Yes, it is a fun thing to do. Do you have any yarn?
Yes, I have red and blue yarn.
Great, let us start with a simple knot. Have you held a needle before?
No, it looks very thin.
Do not worry, it will feel fine soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to walk fast for my heart. I have no time.
That is a good goal. Do you walk on the grass?
Yes, the grass near my home is nice.
Grass is soft for your feet. Do you like the smell of it?
I do like the smell. I must go now.
Run then, but do not fall.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took the red bus to the park today.
That sounds like fun. Did you see any dogs?
Yes, I saw a big brown dog sleeping in the sun.
That is a nice picture. Did you have a good time?
I also stopped at a store to buy a cold drink.
Ice cream or soda?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing in the rain and I do not know which bus to take.
That feels scary. Did you write down the number?
No, I forgot my paper.
Go to the front of the line and ask the driver. You can tell him your stop name.
Will he help me?
Drivers are usually kind. Do you have your ticket ready?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my old friend Tom today.
That sounds nice. How was he doing?
He looked happy but very tired.
I am glad to hear that. What did you talk about?
We just sat and watched the rain.
That sounds peaceful. Did you share a snack?
Yes, we ate some warm soup.
That must have been cozy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My head hurts bad. I must run.
I am sorry. Do you have pills?
No time. Go.
Rest soon. See you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is patience so hard?
It feels like waiting forever. Do you like surprises?
Yes, but the wait is boring. Why do we wait?
Good things take time to grow. I do not know exactly why it feels so slow.
But why does it take time?
Plants need days to bloom. Is that like patience?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to bake a cake, but it fell apart.
That feels hard. What did you do next?
I swept up the mess and made soup instead.
Good job. Do you like soup?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am making soup for dinner.
That sounds warm and nice. What are you putting in the pot?
Just carrots and onions.
Those are great choices. I do not know if you need more salt.
I added some salt already.
Good. Did you wash your hands first?
Yes, I washed them well.
That is very clean and safe.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up at seven. The sun was up.
That is a nice start. What did you do next?
I ate toast at eight. It was warm.
Sounds yummy. How long did you play outside?
I played until ten. Then I took a nap.
A good rest helps. Did you wake up happy?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sand warm?
The sun makes it hot. Do you like warm sand?
Yes, it feels nice. Why is the water salty?
The salt comes from dry land. Is the water cold?
A little bit. How do fish live in salt water?
Their bodies keep the salt out. Do you see any fish?
I see one. Why do waves crash?
Wind pushes the water. Is it loud?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to walk more, but my feet hurt. What should I do?
Start with short walks to help your feet get strong. Do you have any soft shoes?
I have some old sneakers. Are those okay to use?
If they are comfortable and fit well, they are a good start. Are your socks clean and dry?
Yes, my socks are clean. How long should I walk at first?
Try walking for just five minutes at a time. How do your feet feel after that?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today. My little sister gave me a hug.
That is so sweet of her. Did you give her a big one back?
Yes, I did! She has the softest hair.
How lovely. I am glad to hear your good news.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared of the loud train sounds.
That is okay. Do you like the wheels?
The wheels go clack clack. It feels like a big machine.
It is a very big machine. Are you holding the pole?
Yes, I am holding it tight. I want to see the green trees.
Trees are nice to watch. Do you see any birds?
I see a small blue bird. Is it sad?
It is just flying. Do you have a snack?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The rain stopped an hour ago, and now the sun is out.
That is good news. Did you see a rainbow?
No, just a dark cloud that is going away.
I hope the sky gets blue soon.
My shoes are wet, but I feel dry inside.
That is a happy feeling. What are you eating for lunch?
A warm soup with carrots and bread.
That sounds very cozy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to plant a seed like my old friend showed me. Do you know how to start?
Yes, dig a small hole in soft dirt and place the seed inside. Do you have a little shovel?
I have a spoon, but I have no dirt. Where can I find some?
You can scoop earth from a garden bed or buy a bag at the store. Do you see any gardens nearby?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am too busy to read a long book tonight. What should I do?
Try reading a short story for ten minutes. Do you like adventure tales?
Yes, I love them. I must be quick to finish before bed.
Pick a thin book so you can end fast. Is the story already chosen?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I dropped my red paint on the floor. It is all mixed with blue now.
That is a sad color for red. Did you want to make something bright?
Yes, I wanted a sunny yellow sun. Now it is all mud.
Mud can still look like a rainy day. Do you like rainy days?
No, I hate rain. It makes my dog sad and my shoes wet.
That is a hard feeling. Maybe we can wipe it up first?
I tried, but the mop just made it worse. I am angry.
Anger is okay when things go wrong. What do you want to do now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the cold snow today.
It does feel very chilly. Do you have a warm coat?
Yes, but my toes still hurt.
That sounds quite uncomfortable. Did you drink something warm?
Just some water.
Hot cocoa might help your toes feel better.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water so salty here?
The sea is made of salt. Do you like the smell?
Yes. Why do the boats go out so far?
They look for fish to eat. Do you see any fish?
I see none. Why is the sky so blue today?
The sun makes the sky look blue. Do you see the sun?
It is behind a cloud. Why is the harbor so quiet right now?
Everyone is resting at home. Do you hear the waves?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel so alone when I work in my house.
That is a hard feeling. Do you talk to your friends?
Yes, but I miss my old desk mates.
That makes sense. You can call them.
I think I will try that tomorrow.
That is a good plan. What will you say first?
I just want to say hi and tell them about my day.
A simple hello is nice. Do you like talking or writing?
I like writing notes.
Good choice. Writing takes time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I learn to play the guitar?
You must practice a little bit every day. Do you have a guitar yet?
Yes, I have a small one. I feel so mad when I cannot do it well.
Anger comes from rushing. It is okay to be slow. How long do you usually practice?
Maybe five minutes. I want it to be fast.
Slow steps make strong skills. I do not know your exact plan, but steady wins.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking for a book, but I do not know which one to pick.
That is a nice place to be. Do you like stories about animals?
I think so, but I also like space books. I am confused.
Try the section in the middle. It has both types there.
I am walking there now. The shelves are very tall.
Look for the blue signs on the sides. Do you see them?
Yes, I see them. But there are so many boxes here.
I am sorry, I cannot tell you which box is best. Take the one that looks fun.
I picked this blue one. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Happy reading.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late! My friend needs to get here for her cake!
That sounds exciting. Is she coming by car?
Yes, but I still need to buy ice cream first.
You must run! I hope she likes chocolate.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Tell me fast. Does a bear have ten legs?
No, a bear has four legs. Are you walking to work?
I have three minutes left. Do sharks feel pain?
Yes, sharks do feel pain. Do you like fish?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. What time is it?
It is 9:30. Are you going to work?
Yes. Is it getting close to 10?
Yes, it is almost 10. Do you have enough time?
I think so. Is it exactly 9:45 now?
I do not know the exact minute. I hope you make it!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do sailors keep trying to find new places?
They like to see things no one else has seen. Do you like to explore?
Why do they look at the stars at night?
I do not know for sure, but I think they use them to find their way.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to know more about old Rome. How should I start?
You can read a book with simple maps. What part of history do you like most?
I like castles and knights. Where should I look first?
Try a book on medieval Europe. Do you read faster or slower?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My brother broke my toy today.
Oh no, that is very sad. Did you tell him?
Yes, I told him, but he laughed.
That was not very nice. How did you feel?
I felt very angry inside.
It is okay to feel angry. Did you hit him?
No, I walked away from him.
That was a very wise choice.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a very happy feeling today.
That sounds great to hear.
I want to share it with you.
I am happy you told me. What makes you feel this way?
I collected ten shiny rocks.
Ten rocks is a lot. Did you find them all yourself?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a letter, but I do not know where to put it.
Is it for someone in your town or far away? You can find the stamp box near the counter.
It is for a cousin in another state.
Great. Please take that letter to the blue box with the postage required sign.
Do I have to pay for a stamp?
Yes. The price is on the machine right there. Do you have your coins ready?
I think so. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have a good day!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I pack my bag for a trip?
First, put your big things at the bottom. Do you have heavy items?
I have a big book and some shoes.
Stack the shoes with the soles down to save space. What is in the book?
It is my favorite story book.
Wrap it in a shirt to keep it from getting bent. Are you going far?
I am going to my grandmothers house.
That is a short trip, so do not pack too much. Is she getting any gifts?
Yes, I have a small card for her.
Put the card in your pocket so it does not get lost.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I painted a big red sun today.
That sounds fun. What did you paint first?
I mixed the orange and red paint.
Nice work. Do you like the sun?
Yes, it is very bright.
Good. Why did you choose red?
Because I felt happy today.
I am glad you feel good.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sun looks so bright today.
It is very warm now. Do you feel the heat?
Yes, it is quite hot.
Drinking water helps you feel better.
Is the sun alive?
No, it is not alive. It is a huge ball of gas.
Can we ever go there?
No, it is too far and too hot. Do you like the night sky?
I think the sun is amazing.
It gives us light and warmth. That is a good thing.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I got a pair of kings and you have a queen.
That is a great win. Do you like having the biggest card?
Yes, I won the whole hand.
Well done. What is your favorite card in the deck?
The ace, because it is the highest.
I agree. Do you want to play another round?
Yes, please deal again.
Here you go.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big white puff in the sky.
That is a cloud. Do you like fluffy things?
It looks like a sheep.
Yes, it can look like many things.
Why is it up there?
It is made of tiny water drops. Do you know where rain comes from?
From the sky, I think.
You are right. It falls down as rain.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My screen is black and I am scared.
Do not worry, it is not broken. Is the power cord plugged in tight?
I think yes, but the light is off.
Try pressing the big power button once. Did the screen wake up?
No, it is still dark and quiet.
Let us check the wall outlet. Is another plug working there?
Yes, my lamp works fine.
Maybe the cord is bad. Do you have a spare one?
I found a red cable nearby.
Use that one to test it. Does the screen turn on?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like walking here. The grass is too wet and my socks are cold.
That sounds very unpleasant. What did you step on?
I stepped on a big puddle. It made a loud splash.
Oh no, a splashy surprise. Do you have dry clothes to change into?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am scared to move my home.
That is okay. Do you have a plan?
I have no plan at all.
Let us pick a day first.
I do not know which day to pick.
I can help you choose one.
Is next week good for me?
It might be. What is your work time?
I work from Monday to Friday.
Then a weekend is best.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a magnet that will not stick to my fridge. What should I do?
It may just be weak. Do you have any other magnets to test?
I tried a paper clip and it stuck to the magnet, but not the fridge. Is the fridge bad?
The fridge door is steel, so it should work. Are you sure the magnet is still holding strong?
Yes, it holds the clip tight, but the fridge is slippery. Do you know why?
Some fridges have a smooth paint that is hard to stick. I do not know the exact brand of your fridge.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we put a cake on a table?
The cake makes the day feel special. Do you like sweet food?
Why do we sing a song?
Singing helps us cheer for the person.
Why do we give gifts?
Gifts show that we care about you. Do you get many gifts?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What are clouds made of?
They are made of tiny drops of water. Do you like rain?
I think they taste like water.
That is true. Would you like to see a cloud up close?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My little sister is crying because she lost her toy. What should I do?
I suggest you help her look in her room first. Where did she last play with it?
She was playing in the garden all afternoon. I am getting upset about the mess.
Take a deep breath and stay calm. Would you like to dig in the dirt together?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a red bird eat a worm this morning.
That is a fun thing to see. Was the bird happy?
Yes, it looked very full.
I am glad it got a good snack. Do you have a favorite bird?
I like the blue one with the long tail.
That is a pretty bird. I do not know what it is called.
It is a starling.
I will learn that name today. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very scared of flying. What can I do to feel better?
Try to breathe slow and look out the window. Do you have a favorite book with you?
I have a book, but my legs hurt from sitting. Can I move them?
Yes, please stand up and walk a little. Is the plane shaking a lot?
It is shaking a bit, and I feel sick. What should I eat?
Eat a plain cracker or some dry bread. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say please?
It tells others we respect them. Do you like it when people are polite?
Yes, I do. Why do we say thank you?
It shows we are happy for their help. Do you enjoy giving thanks?
I do. What if someone makes a mistake?
We should be kind and forgive them.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do bears sleep for so long in winter?
They sleep because it is cold and hard to find food. Do you think they are cold?
Yes, I think they are. Why do owls see so well at night?
Their eyes are big and can catch tiny bits of light. What do you think they see?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue, helper?
Sunlight has many colors. Blue colors bounce around the air more than others. Do you see many colors in the rain?
Not always, but I see them sometimes. Why does blue bounce?
Blue light is small and moves fast. The air stops it and makes it spread out.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you sell fresh bread today?
Yes, we do. Is your favorite bread sweet or salty?
I like sweet ones.
We have warm cookies too. Do you like chocolate in your cookies?
Yes, I love chocolate.
Great choice. Would you like a little piece of the chocolate cookie?
Can I have one?
Of course you can.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in my mind. What should I do for the talk?
Take a deep breath. Do you know your main idea?
I have notes, but they are messy.
That is normal. Can you pick one big point?
I am still not sure. It feels hard.
I do not know your full plan. Try to say one simple thing out loud.
I tried, but my voice shook.
That is okay. Do you trust your first thought?
I guess I will just start.
Good. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel all alone here.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have any books to read?
It feels bad to be by myself.
I understand that feeling. Would you like me to stay with you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My lamp is dark and the plug feels cold.
Is there a switch on the wall near the lamp?
I checked the switch but the light stays off.
That is odd. Do other lights in the room work?
Yes, the ceiling light works fine.
Please unplug the lamp and check for loose wires.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I like my new friend.
That is a good thing. Do you play games together?
Yes, we do. Why do I like him?
You likely share fun times. Is he kind to others?
He is very nice. Why is being kind important?
Kindness makes people feel safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The end of the book was very sad and I do not like it.
That feels really bad. Do you want to talk about it?
I wish the characters lived together and were happy forever.
I agree that would be nice. Did you like the middle part?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I listened to a song about the rain today. It made me feel calm when I was sad.
Rain songs can be very soothing. Do you like loud music or quiet music?
The song was quiet and slow. It sounded like drops hitting a window.
That sounds like a peaceful picture. Did you close your eyes while listening?
Yes, I sat on the floor and closed my eyes. I felt my heart slow down.
That is a wonderful way to relax. It is good to take time for yourself.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am mad about the old king.
Why are you feeling so angry?
He built a wall that broke my family land.
That sounds very hurtful. Do you know what the wall was for?
I do not know. I just want it gone.
I do not know who built it. Are you sure it was a king?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my red cup on the floor. It broke into pieces.
Oh no. Did you get hurt?
No, but I am sad. The cup was new.
I am sorry about that. Did you clean it up?
Yes, I used the broom. It is done now.
Good job. What will you drink now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to say at the meeting.
Take a deep breath. Do you have a list of main points?
Yes, but I feel too scared to talk.
That is okay. You can just read your list slowly.
Is it good if I just nod and say yes?
No, that is not true. Please share what you know.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do for my day off.
You can go to the park. Do you like to run?
I might play outside, but I am tired.
Maybe you can rest in a warm place. Do you like to read?
Reading is good, but I want fresh air.
Then take a short walk. I do not know where you go, but it sounds nice.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad about my math test.
That sounds hard. What part of the math is tricky for you?
I do not understand fractions at all.
Try breaking the pizza into small slices to see how it works. Do you like eating pizza?
Yes, I do like it a lot.
That is great. Showing me a real pie can help your brain learn.
But I still feel stuck and worried.
It is okay to not know everything yet. Do you want to show me your homework?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can I catch a big fish with a stick?
No, you need a real rod. What kind of fish do you like?
I want to catch a shark.
That is very hard to do. Are you a brave fisher?
I have a red bucket.
That is good for water. Is it heavy or light?
I found a worm in the dirt.
Worms help fish find food. Do you want to use it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling from the sky. Why did that happen?
Dreams often come from your busy mind sorting out the day. Did you feel safe when you woke up?
Yes, the sun was warm. But I still wonder if there is a real reason for the fear.
It is hard to know the exact cause for every thought. Do you want to talk about your day?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did the bear go into the cave?
It was very cold outside. Do you like bears?
I do, but I did not know that. Why did the bear look so sad?
I am not sure about that part. It was a little unclear to me.
That is okay. What is in the cave?
There is a big pile of fish. Do you like fish?
Yes, I do. I am glad the bear is warm now.
I am happy for the bear too.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must paint this wall blue today.
Blue is a nice color. Do you have the paint ready?
I do not. Where can I buy it fast?
I do not know your city, so I cannot give an address. Is there a store nearby?
No, I am lost and in a big rush.
Please breathe slow. You are safe here. Are you feeling scared?
No, just mad about the time.
Anger helps you move fast. What is the wall for?
For my kid to play on.
That is a sweet plan. Good luck with the blue paint.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My bag is too heavy.
What is inside?
All my toys and books.
Do you need the toys today?
Yes, I love them.
You can keep the small ones.
Okay, I will take the little bear.
That sounds fun.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a blank page and no idea what to draw.
Do you like cats or dogs? Start with a simple circle for the body.
I guess I like cats. Should I draw the ears next?
Yes, two triangles on top work well. Do you want to add a tail?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dough looks sad and flat.
Do you see tiny bubbles on the outside? That is how it grows.
I see some, but it still feels cold.
Warmth helps yeast wake up. Is your kitchen nice and cozy?
It is a bit chilly here.
You can put the bowl near a sunny spot. Do you have a towel to cover it?
Yes, I have a soft cloth.
Cover it well and wait. Does it feel happier now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am so hungry, but I do not know what to eat.
That can feel hard. Do you like warm food?
Yes, I do. But eggs take too long to make.
Toast is quick and good. Do you like jam?
I do, but I want something with protein.
You can eat toast with eggs. Would that work for you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to run, but my legs hurt a lot.
Start slow to let your body get used to it. Do you walk before you start running?
Yes, I walk for a bit, then I try to run.
That is a good way to begin. How long do you walk each time?
I walk for ten minutes, then run for one minute.
That is a safe plan to build strength. You will get better with time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are there so many lights in the dark sky?
They are stars that burn far away. Do you see the Moon up there?
Yes, I see it. Why does the Moon look so bright?
It shines by reflecting the Sun's light.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no time! Why does my bread get big?
The yeast makes tiny bubbles of air. Do you like hot bread?
Yes, but my feet are walking away. Go faster.
The warm room helps the yeast grow quick.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I like these big boots. Why are they so hard?
They are hard to keep your feet warm in winter. Do you play in the snow?
Yes, I do. Why do they cost so much money?
Good boots cost more because they last a long time. Do you have enough savings?
I think so. Why do they come in so many sizes?
Feet grow at different speeds for every child. How tight do you like your fit?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the market today and saw a big red apple.
That sounds nice. Did you buy it?
Yes, it was sweet. I also saw a dog playing in the sun.
A warm day, I am sure. Was the dog happy?
It was wagging its tail. Then I bought some bread for home.
Fresh bread is always good. Did you eat it right away?
Not yet, I saved it for dinner. It smells like butter.
That sounds delicious. I hope you enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great goal. Do you like wearing sneakers?
Yes, I love them. How do I start?
Make a cross with the laces and pull tight.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a block with four flat sides that are all the same size. What is it called?
That is a square. Do you have one in your hand?
Yes, I do. How do I know if a circle is true?
A true circle is round everywhere. Do you have a ruler?
No, I do not. Can I still learn about shapes?
Yes, you can look at things around you. What do you see that is round?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My computer is very slow.
Oh no, that is tricky. Do you have many programs open?
Yes, a lot of games.
Close most of them. Is the red light flashing?
It is not flashing.
Good, that means the disk is busy. Try restarting the box.
I will try that now.
That is a smart step. Let me know if it helps.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the water in the lake blue?
It is blue because it reflects the clear sky above. Do you see clouds up there?
I see some, but why does the fish swim so fast?
It swims fast to catch food or to hide from danger. Is that a big fish you see?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat by the stream and watched the fish swim.
That sounds very peaceful. Did you see any big ones?
One jumped right next to me.
Wow, that is quite a surprise.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. What should I do?
Drink some water and rest. Do you have a fever?
No, but it feels heavy. Why is it hurting?
I do not know for sure. Are you tired?
Yes, I did not sleep well.
Sleep will help you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you know this song?
I think it is a happy tune. Do you like the sound?
Yes, it is very nice.
I do not know the name. Is it an old song?
No, it is new. I must go.
Take your time. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky so dark and loud?
The big cloud is full of water and wants to drop it. Is your house warm?
I saw the wind shaking the trees. Why does the wind blow so hard?
Hot air rises and cold air pushes in fast. Do you feel safe?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big fish jump out of the lake today. It made a loud splash.
That sounds like so much fun. Did the fish come back into the water right away?
Yes, it went right back down into the deep blue water.
How cool. Do you like to go swim there?
I usually just sit on the grass and watch the water move.
That sounds very peaceful. I hope you had a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I pick blue for the sky?
Blue looks like the air above us. Do you like cool colors?
Why is the grass green?
Plants need light to grow and turn green. What color do you see in your yard?
Why does red make me feel hot?
Red is a strong color that feels warm. Do you wear red in summer?
Why is paint sticky?
I do not know why it feels that way. Do you wash your hands after?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The fence is falling. Help me.
I can hold it for you. What wood is that?
It is pine. Please be quick.
It is loose. Do you have a hammer?
No. I need to leave now.
I will nail it up. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to be polite, but I never know what to say. Do you have any tips?
Yes, saying please and thank you is a great start. Do you always try to say those words?
Sometimes I forget. What else can I do to show I have good manners?
Holding the door open for others is a sweet way to help. Do you have a door to hold at home?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I ate too much candy today and my tummy hurts.
That is a big hurt. I am sorry to hear that. Do you like eating sweet things?
I do love them, but this feels bad.
Sweet food can make us feel sick if we have too much. Have you tried drinking some water?
I did drink some, but it is still no good.
Water is good for your tummy, but it takes time. Is your tummy still hurting a lot?
Yes, it really is.
Please talk to a grown up about how you feel. I do not know exactly what is wrong with you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I see if the river is safe to swim in?
Look for smooth stones and slow water. Do you see any rocks near the bank?
I see big rocks, but the water moves fast there.
That is a good sign to stay on the shore. Is the water clear or brown?
It looks a bit brown and cloudy to me.
Brown water means mud or dirt is floating in it. Do you smell any strong smells?
It smells like wet leaves and dirt.
That is normal, but cloudy water hides dangers. Do you have a friend with you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to swim in the lake.
That is fun. Do you know how to float?
I can kick, but I am scared.
Take a deep breath. Are you wearing a life vest?
Yes, I am all set.
Great. Do you want to paddle the boat?
I do not know how to row.
I do not know either. I will ask my dad.
Please tell me when you know.
I will. Do you like cold water?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am mad because the fridge door is stuck and will not let me in.
That sounds frustrating. Did you try pushing from the other side?
I tried hard, but the metal part just feels tight and stubborn.
It may be near a magnet. Can you see a silver strip on the frame?
Yes, there is one, but I do not want to break it.
You are safe. Magnets pull things in, but they rarely hurt.
I guess I will just pull slowly now.
Take your time. It should open.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see the water moving very fast.
That looks like a strong current. Do you have a boat?
I do not have a boat or a bridge.
You can build a raft if you find wood. Have you checked for trees?
I see some wood near the shore.
That is a good sign. Is it dry wood?
I do not know if it is safe to use.
You should ask a person who knows about rivers. Are there houses nearby?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a dog run after my ball.
Oh no. Did you say please when you asked for it back?
Yes, I said please, but I forgot to say thank you.
That is a small mistake. Do you want to learn a new word for next time?
I want to be a nice person. I always hold doors open.
That is very kind. Does it make you feel happy to help others?
It does. But I sometimes get angry when people push.
I understand. Can you take a deep breath when you feel mad?
Yes, that helps me calm down. I try my best.
Your best is good enough.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love making sand castles at the beach.
That sounds like such fun.
I build them very tall and strong.
Do you play there with friends?
Yes, we help each other a lot.
It is nice to have friends.
I also collect smooth stones.
I do not know much about stones, but that is cool.
They are very pretty on the beach.
I am glad you enjoy your time there.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very lonely and sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a pet to talk to?
No, I am all alone.
That is hard. Have you tried calling a friend?
I do not know who to call.
I do not know your friends. Try looking at an old photo.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a box with no note inside.
That is very exciting. What does the box look like?
It is red and has a bow on it.
A red box with a bow sounds sweet. Do you know who gave it to you?
I think it might be from my mom.
That is a lovely guess. I am happy for you.
Should I open it now?
Yes, open it right away. Go for it.
It is a new book!
How wonderful. Happy surprise day to you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to send a letter now. It is late.
The post box is over there. Do you have a stamp?
Yes, I have one.
Great. You can drop it in the box.
Thank you. I must go.
Bye. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do next.
What makes you feel stuck?
I have two good choices, but I fear I will pick the wrong one.
A bad pick is still a lesson. Which choice feels lighter to you?
I just want to be happy and safe.
I do not know the future.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn to sing, but my voice sounds like a duck.
Duck voices are fun! Do you like birds?
I guess so, but I do not want to sound funny.
Funny is okay. It is just a sound.
What do I do first?
Breathe in deep. Does your belly get big?
Yes, my belly gets very big.
That is good. Now make a hum sound.
I hummed, but it stopped.
That is normal. Try again slowly.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the king move only one step?
It is the most important piece, so it must stay close to its guards. Do you like protecting people?
Then why can the queen move so far?
She has the most power, so she goes anywhere on the board. Are you strong like her?
Why does my knight jump over things?
I do not know the exact reason, but it makes the game feel like a story. Does that seem fun to you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to climb a big mountain.
That is a great goal. Do you like walking long paths?
Yes, I love walking.
Start with small hills near you. Is your bag light?
My bag is heavy.
Take out things you do not need. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a blank page and a pen. What do I write?
Start with who the letter is for. Do you know who you are writing to?
Yes, my friend Sam. He is far away.
That is a good start. Try saying hi first.
Hi Sam, what next? I am stuck.
Tell him how your day was. Is it a happy day?
Yes, I ate good soup.
Great, write that down. Then ask him a question back.
I do not know what to ask him.
Ask if he is well. It shows you care.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my dog wag his tail?
He is happy to see you. Do you have a favorite treat?
What does he mean when he puts his head on my knee?
He wants love and close time. Is he feeling calm right now?
Why does he bark at the door?
He hears something new and cares. Have you trained him to stop?
Why does he roll on the grass?
I do not know the exact reason. Is he having fun?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to cook for dinner.
Do you like pasta? It is easy to make.
Maybe, but my tummy is not very hungry.
Try a small bowl of soup. Do you have any soup?
Yes, I have tomato soup.
That sounds good. Are you feeling okay today?
I am fine, just tired from work.
Eat slow and rest. Did you wash your hands?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream. It is gone.
Oh no, that is sad. Did you get any on your clothes?
A little bit. I tried to clean it up.
That was very kind of you.
I feel bad about it.
It is okay. You should say sorry to the floor for the mess.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do bees make honey? Do they pull it from the sky?
No, they pull it from flowers. Do you like sweet flowers?
Yes, I do. What do they do with the sweet stuff?
They put it in their hives to sit and dry.
Why do they need to dry it?
So the water goes away and it stays sweet.
That is nice. Do they eat it all?
Yes, they eat it to stay warm. Do you know what else bees do?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is it raining?
Yes, the sky is grey. Do you have an umbrella?
No, I do not.
That is a problem. Be careful on the walk.
It is windy too.
Yes, the trees shake. Do you like the wind?
I must run now.
Good luck. Call me later?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like football?
Yes, I like watching it. Do you play?
I play in the park.
That is fun. What is your favorite team?
I like the blue team.
Blue is a nice color. Do you have a ball?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I bought a blue box for my friend.
That is a nice color. Does she like the color blue?
I think so, but I am not sure.
Blue is a safe choice. What is your best guess?
Maybe it will be a toy car.
Cars are fun for most kids. Is she a boy or a girl?
She is a girl, but she loves cars.
Good to know. What kind of car is it?
It is a race car.
That sounds exciting.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did something bad happen?
Yes, my cat is gone.
That is very hard to accept. Do you know where it went?
I think it lost a leg.
That sounds scary. Do you know where it is now?
I do not know if it is safe.
I do not know if it is safe either. Have you checked under the bed?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I can not sleep at night. What do I do?
Try to drink warm milk. Do you like milk?
Yes, I like it. But I still feel busy in my head.
That is hard. I do not know the magic fix.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The baby is very loud at night. What can I do?
Try a dark room and a blanket. Do you have a dark room?
Yes, but the baby still cries. What else can I try?
Let me think. Is the baby hungry?
No, the baby ate well. I feel tired and sad.
You must rest too. Do you have a helper?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My day was so hard. I am very tired now.
That sounds tough. Did you take a break?
No, I did not stop. I just worked all day.
You should rest now. Do you want to talk more?
Yes, but my mind is blank. I cannot think.
That is okay. Sleep will help your brain.
Do you think I did a good job? I feel lost.
I do not know the details. But you tried your best.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to read this book before bed. Can I finish it fast?
That sounds like a lot for one night. Are you tired yet?
I am very sleepy but I must finish it.
Try reading slowly to stay awake. Do you have warm milk?
No, I only have my lamp and the book.
I do not know if a lamp helps you sleep. Is the light bright?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the old boat so broken?
It stayed in the water for many years. Do you like looking at old things?
Why can I not touch the shiny gold cup?
We must keep it safe for other people. Do you like shiny things?
Why is the museum open on Sunday?
I do not know why they chose that day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I met a nice dog in the park.
That sounds fun. Did you play fetch with it?
Yes, we chased a red ball.
I am glad you had a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. The teacher made me sit alone.
That feels very bad. Are you okay?
I think I did bad on the test.
I do not know that for sure. Did the teacher say why?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why does my dough get big and fluffy?
The tiny bugs in the flour eat sugar and make gas. Do you use warm water?
Yes, I use warm water to feed them.
That helps them work faster. Did you cover the bowl?
I put a towel over it so it stays warm.
Good. The gas gets stuck in the dough and makes it rise.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is it going to rain?
The sky looks gray. Do you have an umbrella?
No, I forgot it.
That is okay. Maybe the sun will come out.
I hope so.
I hope so too. Let us check again soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to run a long way.
That is a great goal. Do you run every day?
No, I only run once a week.
Start with short runs three times a week. Are your shoes comfortable?
My shoes hurt my feet.
You need softer shoes to protect your feet. Do you feel pain in your legs?
My legs feel tired after running.
Take breaks and stretch your muscles.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so hungry today. The sun was hot and I walked far.
That sounds like a long walk. Would you like a cold drink?
Yes, please. I will take the big one.
Good choice. What kind of food do you want?
I will get the chicken and the green beans.
Those sound good. Do you want any dessert?
Yes, I will add a small pie.
Enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
They fall because it gets cold and dark. Do you like raking them?
I do not know how to rake them well.
You should stand tall and pull toward you. Is your rake heavy?
It feels a bit heavy. How do I lift it?
Bend your knees and keep your back straight. Do you have gloves?
I do not have gloves yet.
You can buy them at the shop. Do you like cold weather?
Yes, I like it when it is cold.
Then enjoy the clean yard. Do you want to start now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I can feel the wind in my hair. It feels like a soft hug.
That is a lovely way to think about it. Do you like cold hugs or warm ones?
I like warm hugs best, but the wind is cool. It makes me shiver a little bit.
Cold air does make us shiver to stay warm. What are you wearing right now?
I am wearing my blue jacket with the yellow buttons. The wind is very loud today.
Wind can sound like a big roar when it moves fast. Do you hear any birds singing?
No, the birds are hidden inside their nests. The leaves are flying all over the yard.
Trees love to dance when the wind blows. Do you see the colors of the leaves?
Yes, I see red and orange leaves dancing on the ground. I want to catch one in my hand.
Catching a leaf is a fun game. Be careful not to miss your step.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My hands hurt from all the work. I am so tired today.
That sounds really hard. Did you rest a bit?
Yes, I sat down for a while. Thank you for listening.
I am glad to help you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I was walking to school and saw a lady drop her keys. I picked them up and ran to give them back.
That was very kind of you. Did she say thank you?
Yes, she smiled and said thank you. It made my whole day feel warm and happy.
Smiling is a great start to a day. Do you use your words to say hello too?
I tried to say good morning to my neighbor, but he looked busy. I just nodded instead.
Nodding is also polite. You handled that well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so tired. My legs hurt from sitting.
Being still for a long time can make your body feel sore. Did you drink enough water?
I drank some juice. The window looks so high up.
Yes, we are very high in the sky. Is the view nice?
I see a lot of white clouds. Will we land soon?
I do not know the exact time, but we are close to the end. Do you like flying?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am very late for my trip.
Do not worry. Are you near the door?
Yes, I am right here.
Great. What did you forget?
I forgot my blue bag.
I see. Is it heavy?
It is a little heavy.
Let us go together. Are you ready?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do magnets stick to some things but not others?
They stick to metals like iron. Do you like iron?
No, but I have a paper clip.
A paper clip works well with magnets. Try it now?
It sticks!
That is very cool. Is your magnet blue?
Yes, it is blue.
Nice choice. Do you have other shapes?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know where the lighthouse is. I am late.
It is on the hill. Are you hiking?
Yes, I am running. Which way do I go?
Turn left at the tree. Do you see the red door?
I do not see it. Is it far?
It is close. Is the path muddy?
The path is wet. Is it safe?
Be careful. Do you have good shoes?
I have boots. I must go now.
Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my bread get so puffy in the oven?
Tiny bugs called yeast eat sugar and make gas bubbles. Do you see the little holes inside?
Are the bugs alive?
Yes, they are very small living things. They love warm, sweet places.
What happens if I make it too hot?
The heat makes the bread hard and stops the bugs from working.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I had a scary dream where my teeth fell out.
That must feel bad. Do you still have all your teeth?
Yes, but it felt so real and wrong.
Dreams often feel true. Did you wake up feeling safe?
Not really, I am still a bit scared.
Take a slow breath. Do you want to talk about it more?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I saw a big bear near my house. I do not know what to do.
That is scary. Please stay inside and call the park keeper. Do you feel safe right now?
Yes, I am inside, but I am still scared.
It is good that you are safe. Bears often go away if you make loud sounds. Have you told an adult?
My mom is asleep. I do not want to wake her.
You should wake her up right now. Waking an adult is better than being alone with a wild animal.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am so thirsty. How do I make ice cubes?
Put water in a tray and freeze it. Do you have a tray at home?
Yes, I do. How long should I wait?
About eight hours for good ice. Are you drinking enough water today?
I will wait. How do I get them out?
Just pop them out with your fingers. Is your kitchen cool enough?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost looking up at the dark sky.
The stars are just far away suns. Do you like their light?
I do not know what to do next.
Take a deep breath and rest your eyes. Are you feeling tired?
Maybe, but I am still confused.
Confusion is normal in the dark. Do you want to sit down?
I think I will just stay still.
Staying still is a good choice. Is the air cool on you?
Yes, the wind feels nice.
Let the wind calm your mind. Sleep well tonight.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in this big place.
Do not worry. Are you here to read or to borrow?
I just want to look around for now.
That is a good start. Where do you feel like going first?
I do not have a plan yet.
Try the picture book section on the left. It has soft chairs.
That sounds very nice.
Go have fun. Do you need help finding the map?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the game. Is it starting soon?
Yes, it starts in ten minutes. Do you have your ticket?
I think so. I am looking for the door now.
The big doors on the left are the right way. Do you like the red team?
I do not know the teams. I just want to watch.
That is fine. Have fun watching.
Okay. I must go now.
Run fast. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the bear in the story lost its friend.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you like the bear?
Yes, he is very nice but it is a bad ending.
That is a tough feeling. What do you want to happen next?
I want them to find each other again.
That is a good hope. Do you have another book with you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a robot.
That is a great idea. What kind of robot do you want?
I want one that can walk.
That will be tricky. Do you have any small motors?
No, I only have a toy car.
You can try to use the car for the base. Is the car still working?
Yes, it runs on batteries.
Good. You can start with the wheels. Do you like building with boxes?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to read, but my eyes feel heavy.
Maybe you should rest first. Do you have a favorite book?
Yes, but I am too tired to start it.
That is okay. Try a very short story instead.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate football. The rain made the game so bad.
That sounds very sad. Do you usually like playing in the rain?
I do not. I got very cold and my ball slipped away.
I am sorry to hear that. I do not know why you lost the ball.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a warm spot for my tent fast.
Try the spot by the big pine. Do you have a ground cloth?
Too slow, I am packed and ready to go.
Then hurry. Is the soil dry there?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go camping in the woods.
That sounds like fun! Do you have a big tent?
Yes, but it is very hard to put up.
I know it can be tricky. Would you like to bring a helper?
I do not know how to make a fire.
I know that too. Have you watched a video about it?
No, I have not seen one yet.
I cannot show you right now. Do you have a lighter?
I have matches, not a lighter.
Matches work well. Are you packing your snacks?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad because I lost my map in the big hall.
That is very frustrating. Did you look near the exit?
Yes, but I cannot find it anywhere.
I do not know where it is. Would you like to ask the front desk for a new one?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a tiny village behind the big oak tree. It looks so quiet and nice.
That sounds like a lovely place to rest. Is there a pond there?
Yes, there is a little pond with soft blue water. The fish swim very slowly.
How peaceful that must be. I would like to sit by it for a while.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know which drink is best for me.
Coffee gives you energy. Do you like sweet or bitter tastes?
I like sweet things, but I hate bitter coffee.
Tea can be sweet with sugar. Do you want to try green tea?
I have never tried green tea before.
It is light and fresh. Try a small cup first.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here at the market, but I do not know what to buy.
That is okay. Do you want to make soup today?
Yes, soup sounds good, but I have no idea where to look.
Try the green corner with the fresh greens. I do not know your recipe, but those look tasty.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: It is very loud here. How do I cross the big road?
Wait for the light to turn green. Is it safe over there?
Yes, I see the light change. Now I can walk.
You are doing a great job.
Thank you. I felt a bit scared at first.
Do not worry about it.
I feel better now. Can I go to the park?
Yes, just walk straight ahead.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sick and my throat hurts.
That sounds bad. Are you drinking water?
Not much, it is hard to swallow.
Try small sips of warm tea. Do you have any honey?
I have honey, but I do not know if that helps.
Honey can soothe your throat. Is your nose running?
Yes, it is dripping all the time.
You need to rest to heal. How are you feeling now?
I am still tired and cold.
Drink the tea and sleep. I do not know when you will be better.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The web is moving too slow. I need it now.
Try closing other tabs. Is it a big file?
Yes, it is huge. Hurry up.
I cannot make it go faster. Do you have mobile data?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which food I should pick.
Do you like meat or fish?
I like both but I am not sure what to order.
The soup is very good and warm.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I really like eating a banana.
That is a sweet and soft fruit. Do you peel it yourself?
Yes, my hands get a bit sticky.
Sticky hands are fun to clean. Is the skin yellow?
Yes, it is very yellow.
A ripe banana tastes best. Do you like it with milk?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red bird today. It sang a happy song near my window.
That sounds like a lovely start to your day. Was the bird alone?
Yes, it was all by itself. It looked very proud.
It must have been a special song just for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start a bug collection?
You can use a small jar with a lid. Do you have a jar at home?
Yes, I do. How do I put the bugs inside?
Flip the jar over and tap it gently on the ground.
What do I do after catching them?
Keep them in a cool place for a few days. Do you want to keep them forever?
I don't know. Can I free them later?
Yes, you can take them outside and open the lid.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late for class.
Take a deep breath. Do you have your bag?
Yes, it is here.
Good. Is your shoe tied?
No, it is open.
Stop for one second to tie it. That will keep you safe.
Okay, thank you.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my red rose died today.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you water it every day?
Yes, but it still turned brown and fell off the stem.
That is very frustrating. Do you have any other plants to care for?
I have a cactus, but I am afraid I might hurt it.
Cactuses are very hard to kill. Do you know where it gets the most sun?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I take my medicine after I see the doctor?
Just drink a big glass of water with the pills. Do you like juice or water better?
I think I will try the water.
That is a good choice for your body.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took my car to the shop today. The rain was very heavy.
That sounds like a wet day. Did you stay safe in the rain?
I went to a small place near the park. I waited for an hour there.
One hour is a long time. What did you do while you waited?
I read a book about driving rules. I learned how to stop at a red light.
Books are good helpers. Do you feel ready to try the road?
I feel a bit scared but also happy. I think I am ready to go.
Good for you. Have fun on your drive.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Today the sun was warm and I sat in the grass. A yellow bird sang near my ear.
That sounds very nice. Did the bird fly away quickly?
No, it just hopped onto the fence and kept singing. I felt so calm and light.
Calm feelings are good. Do you enjoy sitting by fences?
Yes, I like seeing small things up close. The fence wood was smooth under my hand.
That must feel good.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got off the train and I am so happy.
That is great to hear. What did you see out the window?
I saw big green fields and a mountain.
Mountains are very cool. Did you bring a book?
Yes, I read all the way to the end.
Reading is a nice way to pass time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my dog ran away in the park.
That sounds very scary and lonely. Did he run toward the water?
Yes, he went by the big lake and I could not follow.
I do not know where he is, but I am sure he is safe. Can we look near the benches together?
I will try, but my legs feel too tired to look hard.
Let us rest on this bench for a minute first. Do you feel a little better now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a big red pizza.
That sounds yummy. Do you like cheese?
Yes, I love cheese.
Great choice. I will get you a slice.
Thank you very much.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sick and I do not want to eat.
Oh no, that is sad. Do you feel cold?
Yes, my head hurts.
Take a warm drink. Do you like water?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The kitchen floor is very sticky. Do I wipe it or wash it with soap?
You can just wipe it with a wet cloth first. Is it sweet stuff like jam or only regular dirt?
It is just some spilled juice. How often should I clean the whole house?
Once a week is a good start to keep it tidy. Do you have a big dog that leaves hair everywhere?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go camping, but I do not know what to bring.
You need a tent, a bag to sleep in, and food. Do you know how to build a fire?
No, I do not. Is that hard to learn?
It is easy with dry sticks and paper. Have you ever used a knife?
Yes, I have cut an apple many times.
Good. Please be very careful when you use a sharp tool. Do you like sleeping in the woods?
Yes, I love the quiet night air.
That is wonderful. Pack your things and have a great trip.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red fire this evening near the park.
That sounds scary. Were you safe?
Yes, I ran home right away and my mom hugged me.
I am so glad you are safe. Did you see the fire trucks?
Yes, the lights flashed and the sirens were very loud.
That must have been a loud sound. Did you feel better after going home?
A little, but I still have a funny feeling in my tummy.
That is a normal feeling after a scare. Would you like to read a book?
No, I just want to talk about it one more time.
I am happy to listen. Did the fire put itself out?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my grandpa.
That is a sweet idea. Do you know how to start?
Should I use "Dear" first?
Yes, that works well. What is the main thing you want to say?
I want to tell him I miss him.
That will make him happy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make flowers grow?
You need sun, water, and good dirt. Do you have a sunny spot in your home?
Yes, I do. What if they look sad?
They may just need more water. Do they look dry?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to help my friend, but I do not know how.
That is a kind wish. What is your friend sad about?
She is lonely.
You can sit with her and play.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do sailors know the way?
Yes, they read the stars. Are you going far?
I need to catch a boat now.
Run fast to the dock. Do you have your ticket?
It is in my pocket.
Good luck on your trip.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make my tomatoes grow big?
Give them lots of sun and water. Do you have a sunny spot?
Yes, my backyard gets sun all day.
That is perfect. Water them deeply once a day. Is the soil dry?
It feels dry on top.
Check deeper down with your finger. Do you feel moisture there?
No, it is dry all the way down.
Then give them a good drink now. Happy growing!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I hold a fork at dinner?
Place your hand on the handle and let the tines point down. Do you usually eat with your right hand?
Yes, I do. Thanks.
That is a great habit. Please remember to smile when you ask for more food.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know how to start a drawing.
Start with a small circle on your paper. Do you like circles?
I like circles, but I need a body.
Draw a rectangle under the circle. What color is your pen?
My pen is blue.
A blue line will look nice on white paper. Are you having fun?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel so tired today. Do you know why?
Maybe you did not sleep enough last night. Did you rest your body?
I stayed up late playing. I am still too tired.
You should take a short nap now. Are you ready to lie down?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need eggs, but I have no time.
I have two eggs ready. Do you want toast?
Yes, please. What time is it?
It is almost eight. I do not know if the bus has passed.
I must go now.
I put your eggs in a box. See you later?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a bad day at work. My computer broke, and I lost my notes. I felt very sad.
That sounds very tough. Did you get the computer fixed?
Yes, but it took all day. I still have a lot to do. I feel tired now.
You did your best today. Would you like to take a walk to rest?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to help my friend feel better.
That is a kind thought. What is wrong with your friend?
They lost their toy dog.
That is sad. Did you see where it fell?
I do not know.
Ask your family to look with you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My boss gave me a pat on the back today. Do I have a great boss?
Yes, that is a very kind sign. Does your boss help you when work is hard?
She always helps, but I feel bad asking for help. How do I stop feeling guilty?
Ask for help, you are not a bad person. Do you have a happy team around you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do we have to wait so long?
We wait so the line stays fair. Are you playing a game?
No, I am just bored.
Boredom can feel heavy. Do you want to count to ten?
I am trying to be quiet.
That is good. Do you see the red bus?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to put seeds in the dirt?
The dirt feeds the roots. Do you like sweet carrots?
Yes, I do. Why are the leaves so green?
They drink sunlight to make food. Is your garden sunny?
It is sunny there. Why do I have to water them?
Plants drink water to grow tall. I do not know why it rains.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want a surprise party for my birthday.
That sounds fun. Do you know who is coming?
I think my best friend and my brother.
I am glad you have good friends. What do they like to eat?
They like pizza and ice cream.
Those are great treats. How many candles do you need?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to look in the mirror before I turn?
It helps you see what is behind you so you do not hit things. Do you like driving fast cars?
Yes, but what if the mirror is broken?
You must fix it first. It is not safe to drive without it. Can you see the sun right now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My new fence looks very wobbly. Can you help?
Oh no, that is not safe. Is one leg stuck in the ground?
Yes, the dirt is very soft there.
Try to pack dry dirt under the leg. Do you have a small shovel?
I have a big blue shovel.
That is perfect for digging. How wide is the hole?
It is about two feet wide.
You might need to add more wood to hold it tight. Does it lean to the left?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a pizza.
Great choice. Do you like cheese on it?
Yes, please.
Okay. Would you like a drink too?
I am very hungry.
No problem. I will get your pizza right away.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am tired of waiting for the bus.
Waiting can feel slow. Do you have a toy to play with?
Yes, I have a small car.
That is a good idea. Do you like to race it on the ground?
Yes, but I miss my friend.
She will be here soon. Do you want to practice your smile?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why do bees make honey? I feel sad.
Bees make sweet food from flower nectar. Do you like honey?
I just miss my bee buddy.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you play with it?
I got stung and now I am in pain.
Ouch, that hurts a lot. I do not know why you were stung.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My screen is black and I am so angry.
I am sorry you are upset. Is the power cord plugged in?
Yes, but nothing works at all.
That is tricky. Do you see any lights on the back?
No, there are no lights.
I do not know why it stopped. Can you try pressing the big button?
I did, and it still makes no sound.
That sounds like a broken part. I can help you find a fix.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How does a boat stay on the water?
Water is thick and pushes back hard. Does it bob up and down?
Yes, it feels like a gentle hug. How does it move forward?
It pushes water with a paddle or engine. What does the engine sound like?
It makes a loud rumbly noise. Is that safe for the boat?
Yes, if you fix it well. Do you like the rumble?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The leg is broken and I hate this chair.
I am sorry it is broken. Is it made of wood?
Yes, it snapped right in the middle.
You can glue it back together. Do you have glue?
I do not know if we have any.
Let me check for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we eat eggs at breakfast?
They give us energy to start the day. Do you like eating them?
I do. Why is it called breakfast?
It breaks the fast from the night. Do you like toast too?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people learn new languages?
They learn them to talk to friends far away. Do you have friends in other places?
I guess so. How does my brain get so good at words?
Your brain makes new paths for thinking. That is how you learn.
Is it hard to start?
It feels hard at first, but it gets fun. What language do you want to learn?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. I do not know what time it is.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a clock nearby?
Yes, but the hands look all wrong.
I cannot see your clock from here. Is the short hand near the number three?
Yes, it is right on the three.
That usually means it is three o'clock. Do you want to check the long hand?
The long hand is pointing up at the twelve.
Then it is exactly three o'clock. Would you like to take a short break?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The sun feels very warm on my face today.
That sounds nice! Do you like the sun?
It is so hot that my ice cream is gone.
Oh no, a melted treat is sad. Did you eat it all?
Yes, I ate it all in two big bites.
You are fast! Do you want to play outside?
No, my feet are too hot on the ground.
I do not know where your feet are. Let us find some cool grass.
The grass is green and looks soft.
Good choice. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to pack my bag for the trip.
That is exciting! What do you want to put in first?
I am putting in my red jacket.
That looks warm. Do you have your shoes ready?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I wrote a song, but it sounds wrong.
Tell me what makes it feel wrong?
The words do not match the tune.
That is a common mix-up. Do you like the words?
I like the words very much.
Then try changing the tune to fit them.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a new phone! It is very cool.
That is great to hear. What color is it?
It is blue and fast. I like the look.
Blue is a nice choice. Do you have a phone case?
Yes, it has a hard shell. It is safe now.
That is wise. Protecting your phone is good.
I feel happy today. Thank you for listening.
You are welcome. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the beach today and the water was warm.
That sounds like so much fun. Did you see any fish?
Yes, I saw a tiny orange one swimming by.
Wow, I am glad you had a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel so tired today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to learn how to rest better?
Yes, I really do.
Try lying down and breathing slow. Are you trying to sleep?
Yes, but I cannot stop thinking.
Count your breaths to ten. Do you have a warm drink nearby?
Yes, I have some tea.
Drink it while you close your eyes. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you know what makes a song sound happy?
Yes, it often uses bright sounds and a fast beat. Do you like fast songs?
I think quiet songs are better at night.
That is a sweet thought. Do you have a favorite quiet song?
My mom sings one to help me sleep.
That sounds very cozy and safe. Does she sing it every night?
She only sings it on busy days.
I am glad she is there for you. What is the song called?
It does not have a name.
That makes it special just for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
