exchanges: I went to the beach today. The water was very cold.
That sounds refreshing. Do you like swimming?
I sat on the sand and watched the waves crash. It was loud.
I do not know if I would like that much noise. Did you see any fish?
Yes, I saw a crab scuttle away quickly. It was cute.
A crab is a fun animal. Did you build a sandcastle?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to do math homework?
It helps your brain get strong. Do you like counting?
I think so, but why is it so hard?
Hard things make you grow. What part feels tough?
I do not know why it is hard.
That is okay. We will figure it out.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my fire not go out?
Put small sticks first, then bigger ones. Do you have any dry leaves?
I do. What else should I do?
Stack the wood in a small pile.
That looks easy. Will it make a big flame?
It should. Do you like watching flames?
Yes, I love them. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun out there.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a funny play today. The lead actor forgot his lines.
That sounds like a big surprise. Did the crowd laugh?
Yes, they all laughed very hard. The actor just smiled and kept going.
He was very brave to keep acting. Do you think he was sad?
No, he looked like he was having fun. The rest of the show was great.
I am glad you enjoyed it. What was the play about?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very cold on this bus.
Did you bring a warm coat? You can wear it now.
No, I forgot my coat at home.
I am sorry to hear that. Would you like to share my scarf?
Yes, please. Thank you for your help.
You are very welcome. Do you enjoy reading books on trips?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I live in a very small town.
That sounds cozy. Do you have a big house?
Yes, it has a red roof.
Red is a nice color. Who helps you there?
My dad fixes the roof.
He is very helpful. Does he fix other things?
He fixes my bike too.
You must ride far. Where do you go?
To the old church by the river.
That is a lovely place. Is it quiet there?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a secret and I need help hiding it.
What kind of secret is it?
It is a very sweet surprise for a friend.
That sounds nice. Is it a gift?
Yes, I put it under my bed.
That is a good place. Do you trust me with it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel a big worry in my chest today.
That is a heavy feeling. Are you thinking about something specific?
I do not know why I feel this way.
Sometimes our minds just need a break. Have you taken a deep breath?
Yes, I tried, but it is still there.
Your body might just need to move. Do you want to walk outside?
I think I will try that.
That is a good plan. Tell me how you feel after.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the internet go so fast?
It moves very quickly through tiny wires. Do you like fast things?
Why can I see pictures?
The pictures are stored in big computers. Why do you want to see them?
Why does it cost money?
People pay to keep the lights on. It is a fair trade.
Why does it sometimes break?
I do not know the exact reason. It happens often.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a great meeting today.
That sounds nice. What did you talk about?
We planned a fun party.
I am glad for you. Who is coming?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My phone screen is all black.
Did you try to turn it on? Did you press the big button?
Yes, but it just stays dark.
That is sad. Is it still cold to the touch?
It feels warm, but no light comes out.
Maybe the battery is dead. Did you plug in a charger?
I used the cable, but nothing happened.
Try a different plug or wall socket. Is the light on the cable glowing?
No, the small light is not on.
The cable might be broken. I do not know why it failed. Is your phone old?
It is two years old.
It may just need help. Please take it to a shop. Did you buy a new phone?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go, but I want to see the pond.
That is a nice spot. Are you in a rush?
Yes, I am late. Can I cut through the trees?
Please do not cut. It is not safe.
Where is the fast path then?
I do not know a fast path. Is there a gate nearby?
I see a gate. Thank you.
Good luck. Do you like ducks?
I love them. Bye now.
Bye. Have a good walk.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Can I send a letter from this place?
Yes, you can. Do you have a stamp?
I have a stamp, but I lost the address.
I am sorry, I do not know the address. Did you write it on a note?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn French but I do not know where to start.
Do you like to read or listen to music?
I like to read stories.
Start with a very short book in French. Do you have a few free minutes a day?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do players kick the ball into the net?
They kick it in to score points and win. Do you like watching the big matches?
Yes, I do. But why are some players so tall?
Being tall helps them reach the ball better in the air. Do you like playing inside or outside?
I like playing outside. Is it true that you can never touch the ball with your hands?
That is only true for field players. Goal keepers can use their hands. Do you want to try being a keeper?
Yes, I would. Can you tell me how to catch the ball safely?
Always look at the ball and make a small cage with your hands.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did a great job on my math test today. I am so glad.
That sounds wonderful. Did you get a high score?
Yes, I got a five on my A-plus scale. I want to tell everyone.
You should be very proud of yourself.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! The sun is warm and the grass is soft.
That sounds like a great day. Do you see any birds?
Yes! I saw a red bird in a tree. It looked very pretty.
What a lovely sight. I am glad you are enjoying your walk.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to eat eggs for breakfast.
Eggs are a good choice. Do you like them sunny side up?
Yes, I like them soft and warm.
That sounds very tasty. I do not know if you have jam too.
I have some red jam in the jar.
Red jam goes well with toast. Do you want toast with your eggs?
Yes, please. I am hungry now.
Great. I will help you make it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very confused about the months. Which ones come after winter?
Spring comes after winter. Do you like the snow?
I do not like the cold at all. What month is the longest?
All months have different lengths. Do you know how to count days?
Yes, but I forget how many days a month has. Is there a trick to remember them?
Songs help people remember. Do you like singing?
I love songs. Can you give me one?
I do not have a specific song to share. Do you know any about time?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a gift for my friend.
What does your friend like to do?
I am very late.
A book is a nice choice.
Do you have books here?
Yes, we have many books. Do you like stories?
No, I do not know.
Here is a map for travel.
That is perfect.
I am glad you found it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make my bike go faster?
I do not know how to go faster, but I know how to get started. Do you know how to pedal?
I can pedal, but my legs get tired.
You can sit a little taller to use your body weight. Is your seat too high?
I think the seat is too high.
Lowering the seat may help you reach the pedals better. Do you have a wrench to change it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I have no money left and I feel sad.
That is a hard feeling. What made you spend it all?
I bought a new toy because I wanted it.
Toys are fun but they cost money. Did you check your pocket first?
I forgot to look and now I am poor.
It is easy to forget. Do you have a jar to save coins?
I do not have a jar, I just throw coins away.
That is a waste of money. Let us fix that today.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw the moon high up in the sky today. It looked like a big white cookie.
That sounds sweet to see. Was it a full moon?
It was almost full, but a little part was missing. I wish I could fly up to it.
That is a nice wish. Why do you want to go there?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is bread so soft?
It is soft because the water makes it fluffy. Do you like sweet toast?
Yes, I do. Why is milk white?
It is white because of fat and sugar. Do you drink it cold?
Sometimes. Why does an egg taste salty?
I do not know why it tastes salty. Do you add salt to it?
No, I do not. Why is coffee bitter?
It is bitter because of the roasted beans. Do you add sugar?
A little. Why is jam so sticky?
It is sticky because the fruit has a lot of sugar. Do you use a spoon or your hand?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My bike seat feels too high.
A high seat can hurt your knees. Do you get tired?
Yes, my legs hurt a lot.
Try lowering it. Can you reach the ground?
I can touch the floor easily.
That is good. Keep your feet flat.
What if I wobble while riding?
Look ahead, not down. Do you look at your hands?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late today and my alarm did not work.
That is very common. Did you feel sleepy or happy?
I found a note from my friends on my door with a big smiley face.
How nice that was. What did the note say?
It said I could eat all the cake I wanted because it is my special day.
That sounds like a great plan. Do you like chocolate or vanilla?
I ate two pieces of strawberry cake and drank a glass of juice.
That sounds delicious. Are you feeling full now?
Yes, I am very happy and I want to play outside with my dog.
That is a wonderful end to the day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to go to a big hill, but I do not know how.
First, you must find out which hill you like best. Do you want a tall one?
I am not sure. Tall sounds hard for my legs.
That is a fair point. You can pick a short hill to start.
But what if I fall down? I am scared.
You might fall, but you can get back up. Are you ready to try?
Maybe. But what should I wear?
Warm clothes and shoes with grips. Do you have boots?
Yes, I have the brown ones. Can I take my dog?
Yes, if the path allows it. Have fun on your walk.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel so hot when I have a cold?
Your body fights the germs. Do you have a fever?
Yes, I do. Why does my nose run?
It tries to wash the germs out. Do you drink enough water?
Yes, I drink a lot. Why do I feel so tired?
Your body uses much energy to heal. Have you slept well?
Not really. Why do germs make me sick?
They are tiny bugs that hurt your body. Do you take medicine?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I promised to help my friend with her homework.
That is a very good promise. Do you have time to do it?
I want to play outside instead.
Play is fun, but keeping promises builds trust. What part of the homework is hard?
The math part is very hard.
Let me check the rules for you. Do you have the answer book?
No, I lost the answer book.
I do not know the specific answers for your class. Will you still help her think through the problems?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I pick the right shoe size?
Try them on and walk around. Do you have wide or narrow feet?
I have wide feet, and I am cold.
Pick a half size up for comfort. I do not know your exact size.
I will try the bigger one.
That is a good plan. Let us look at some red ones.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun is hot today and my back hurts from carrying wood.
That sounds hard. Did you drink some cool water?
I did, but now I am trying to put the roof on the small house.
A roof keeps the rain out. What shape are the boards?
They are long and flat. I cut them with the saw just now.
Cutting is tricky work. Did the saw feel smooth in your hand?
It was a bit loud and dusty. I think I am almost done now.
Great job finishing. Do you want to sit and rest for a bit?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does my chest hurt when I run really fast?
That is because your heart is working hard to send air to your body. Do you take long pauses to rest?
No, I keep running until I can not go on.
That sounds tiring. You should stop and take a deep breath first.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My teacher gave me a hard test. I did not know the right words.
That feels bad. Did you ask for help?
Yes, but I am shy. I do not like to ask.
It is okay to be shy. Try just one word. What is your biggest fear?
I fear getting a bad grade.
Grades do not measure your worth. You are still smart. Do you like reading?
Yes, I love books. I read a lot.
Reading is a great skill. Your teacher might see that. Do you want to talk to them?
No, I am too scared. I just want it to end.
It is okay to rest. One step at a time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: This plane is so loud and my back hurts.
That sounds really hard to sit through. Do you have a soft pillow?
No, I forgot it at home. I just want to go home.
I am sorry you are missing your things. Is the window seat taken?
Yes, and the seat in front of me is too close.
That is very tight and not fair. Can you see the clouds?
No, it is just gray and boring.
I do not know when we will land. Are you tired?
Yes, I am very tired and grumpy.
Take a deep breath and rest your eyes. We will be there soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the theater now. Do you know if the play is starting soon?
I think it starts at five. Are you close by?
I am far away. Can you run with me to help?
I cannot run, but I can wait. Is the show fun?
Yes, I love it. I must go now.
Go, and have great fun.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: What should I eat for breakfast?
I like warm toast with honey. Do you have any fruit?
I have bananas and eggs.
A banana and two eggs is a great choice. Are you hungry now?
Yes, I am very hungry.
That sounds like a plan. Eat well.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My head hurts very bad. Do you know why?
That sounds awful. Are you feeling dizzy?
Yes, my eyes feel swimmy. Should I go to bed?
Rest is good for a sick head. Do you have any fever?
My skin feels very warm. What should I drink?
Cool water helps you rest. I do not know your exact cause.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited in a long line at the store all morning. My feet hurt and I was very bored.
That sounds like a long time to stand. Did you bring a book to read?
No, I just counted the tiles on the floor. It was almost fun, in a weird way.
Counting is a good way to pass time. You must be happy it is over now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, the lights are out and I am late for work.
That is very tricky. Do you have a battery for your phone?
I have a charger, but the wall has no power. What should I do?
Try to walk to the bus stop if it is near. Is it far from your home?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many songs should we play at the wedding?
Three or four is a good number. Do you have a favorite dance song?
Yes, but I do not know the right time to start it.
Start it right after the cake is cut. Would you like a song for the end too?
Maybe. What is a good song for the very last part?
A slow, happy song works best there. I am not sure which one you like best.
I like the one with the violins. Thanks for the help.
You are very welcome. Have fun planning your big day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am waiting for my birthday cake.
That is exciting. Do you know who is bringing it?
My mom is making it.
That sounds sweet. How long do you think it will take?
One hour, but it feels like ten.
Time can move slow when you are excited.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the lake to see a big blue boat.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you get to ride on it?
No, I just watched it float on the water.
It is a nice way to spend a day. Do you like the smell of the water?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the apples look so red?
They are red because they are ripe. Do you like sweet fruit?
Yes, I do. Why is it so loud in here?
Many people are here to buy things. Are you looking for something?
Yes, I want to see the fish. Why do they smell that way?
Fish have a strong smell when they are fresh. Do you like fish?
Not really. Why is the market closing so early?
The stalls must clean up after the day ends.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue boat in the harbour today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you stand on the dock?
Yes, I watched the waves hit the wood.
The water must look very cold from up there.
Then a little cat sat right next to me.
A cat near the water? What color was it?
It was black and it looked at the fish.
Cats love to watch the fish swim by.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, but I love my red book.
Red is a bright color. Is it a story about a dragon?
No, it is about a sad dog.
I do not know the title. Did the dog find a friend?
Yes, but we must stop talking.
Okay, I will stop. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people collect small stones?
Many people like shapes and colors. Do you have any stones?
I do! But why do they keep them?
It feels good to share a small joy. Do you share them with friends?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is raining hard. I do not know if I should go out.
Is it fun to you to watch the drops?
It looks a bit scary. Should I just stay home?
Staying in is safe. Do you want to read a book?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my watch under the rug today.
That can be hard to see. Did you use a magnet?
I did, but the watch is plastic, so it did not stick.
Ah, plastic does not pull to magnets. What else is in your watch?
It has metal inside, but the magnet was too small to move it.
A bigger magnet might help then. Was your rug thick?
Yes, it was very thick and full of fluff.
Fluff can hide small things well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My sister is crying because she lost her red ball.
That sounds sad. Do you think she looked in the garden?
I looked there, but the ball is gone. What should I do?
Tell her it is okay to feel sad. Do you have a spare ball to play with?
Yes, I have a blue one, but I am not sure if she will like it.
Offer the blue one and give her a hug. That should help.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: It is very hot outside. I want to make a cold drink. How do I make it?
Put ice in a glass. Add juice and water. Do you like grape juice?
Yes, I do. Is that all?
Yes, that is all. Mix it well.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we start a letter with a date?
It tells the reader when you wrote it. Do you have your pen ready?
I forgot my paper.
You can use a scrap of paper. Is it for a friend?
Yes, it is for my best friend.
That is a sweet idea. What will you tell her?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the doctor today.
That is a big step. How did you feel?
I was a little scared at first.
It is normal to feel that way. Did you see the nurse?
Yes, she was very nice.
That is good news. What did the doctor say?
My heart is beating strong and good.
I am happy for you. Do you feel well now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My boss gave me a big smile today.
That sounds very nice. Did they say anything kind to you?
Yes, they said my work was great.
I am glad to hear that. Do you feel proud?
I do, it made my whole day.
That is wonderful news.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start walking for good health?
Start with ten easy minutes each day. Do you have a safe path near your home?
What should I wear to walk safely?
Put on shoes that fit well and keep your feet dry. Do you have such shoes?
How long should I walk to feel better?
Try for twenty minutes most days. I do not know your exact need, but this is a good start.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the big red boat?
It is near the water. Are you getting on it?
Yes. Is the water cold?
It is a bit cold. Do you like to swim?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the shop closed?
I do not know for sure. Is it very quiet inside?
It is. Why is the door locked?
I am not certain. Do you see a sign?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a new robot, but I do not know how to play.
That is fun. What does it look like?
It is small and red, but it just sits there.
It may need to charge. Does it have lights?
No lights, it is very still and quiet.
It might be asleep. Can you try to wake it?
I pressed the button, but it did not move.
I do not know for sure. Is it very old?
It is brand new, from the store.
Perhaps it needs a reset. Do you have a manual?
I threw the paper away by mistake.
That is tricky. Is there a small button on the back?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I have a nasty cold.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you feel tired?
Yes, very tired.
Rest is the best cure. Is your throat hurting?
It hurts a lot.
Drink warm water with honey. Have you tried soup?
Not yet, only tea.
Soup can help your nose. Did you eat well today?
I did not eat much.
Try a small bowl of soup. Feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my fish tank clean?
You should clean the glass and change some water every week. Do you have a small bucket for this?
Yes, I do. How much water do I take out?
Take out about a quarter of the water each time. Is your fish happy and swimming fast?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to tell if a banana is sweet.
Look for brown spots on the skin. Do you like your fruit soft or firm?
I like it soft. How long does it take to get soft?
It takes a few days on the table. Are you eating it today?
Yes, I am. How do I cut it the right way?
Just slice it in half and pull apart. Have a nice snack.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my phone stop working when the bar is empty?
The phone runs out of power. Do you have a charger?
Yes, I do. Why is the screen so small?
Small phones are easy to hold. Do you like big screens?
I think so. Why does it get hot?
It gets hot when it works hard. Is it playing a game?
It is just sending a message. Why does it buzz?
It buzzes to tell you about news. Do you like the buzz?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Why do leaves fall? I have no time.
Trees lose leaves to rest in the cold. Do you like the crunch?
I am running late. Explain fast.
It saves water for the winter. How is your day going?
Just explain the reason.
It helps the tree survive the cold. Are you tired?
One more word, please.
The roots need to sleep too. Did you find the path?
I get it. Bye.
Take care. Is it windy there?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a small map in my coat today.
That is a lucky find! Did you read what was written on it?
It shows a path to a quiet lake.
A lake sounds very peaceful. Do you know where that lake is?
I do not know, but I hope to go there.
I hope you have a wonderful trip there.
I am going to pack my bag now.
That sounds like a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went for a run today. My legs felt very tired after.
That sounds hard. Did you stop to rest?
Yes, I sat on a bench. I saw a bird fly by.
That is a nice break. Do you run often?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I am packing my bag for a big trip.
That sounds wonderful. Where are you going?
I have a book, some snacks, and a toy bear.
You look very ready to go.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to buy a red bike. Where is the bike shop?
It is on the corner. Do you like bikes?
Yes, I do. How do I check if the tires are good?
Squeeze the tires to see if they are hard.
Okay. What else should I check before buying?
I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does the moon look bright at night?
It shines because the sun lights it up. Do you like looking at the sky?
Yes, I do. But why is it round?
The whole ball glows, so it looks like a circle.
What if it gets dark?
Then the night side hides from us. Is it cold where you live?
Sometimes it is. Can we go there?
I do not know if you can go there today.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so happy to have a new home.
That is great. Do you like the color of the walls?
Yes, they are blue like my favorite shirt.
Blue is a nice color. Which room did you pick?
I chose the one with the big window.
A big window sounds fun. Do you see anything cool outside?
I see a dog and a big tree.
A dog is a good friend. Is the tree tall?
Yes, it is very tall and has many leaves.
Nature is wonderful. Are you ready for your first night there?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is snowing again. I do not know what to do.
That is nice. Do you like the snow?
I think it is fun, but my shoes are wet.
Get dry clothes. Are your feet cold?
My toes are freezing right now.
Warm them by the fire. Is the fire on?
Yes, the fire is hot and bright.
Good. Rest your feet. Do you want soup?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a big tree today. I felt so glad just looking at it.
That sounds very nice to you. Do you like tall trees best?
Yes, they touch the sky. I wish I could climb up to the top.
Climbing up is fun, but a little risky. Do you have a rope?
No rope, but I have a hat. I want to stay under its shade.
A hat is good for the sun. Is the tree leafy and green?
It is full of green leaves. I feel calm when I sit on the grass nearby.
Grass is soft and kind to sit on. Do you want to bring a snack?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what day it is.
Is it Monday?
I think so, but I am not sure.
That is a nice start to the week.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to buy roses today.
I like red ones too. What color do you want?
Red, please. I am late.
The red ones are on the left.
Thank you. Bye.
Have a nice day. Do you love them?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the bakery this morning and smelled the fresh bread.
That sounds nice. What did you buy?
I picked out a round loaf of sourdough with a shiny crust.
Does it taste good?
Yes, it is warm and soft inside with a crisp outside.
I am glad you enjoyed it.
I even got a free cup of coffee because I asked.
That is a lucky end to your morning.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a map in my room.
That is nice. What place does it show?
It has a big blue lake.
A lake is water. Do you like water?
There is a red dot on the hill.
I do not know what that means. Is the hill high?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy a sweet cake for my mom.
That is a nice idea. Do you like chocolate or fruit?
I think she likes fruit, but I am not sure.
A strawberry cake is a safe pick. How many people are coming to eat?
Just me and my mom, so a small one is fine.
You can ask for a slice. Do you need help carrying it?
I can carry it, but thank you for the kind help.
You are welcome. I hope she loves it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a new restaurant today.
That sounds fun. What did you eat?
I had a big burger with fries.
Yum. Did you like the taste?
Yes, it was very good and warm.
Good. Do you want to go back?
Maybe next weekend if the weather is nice.
That is a good plan. I hope it stays dry.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My favourite fruit is a strawberry.
Strawberries are so sweet! Do you like them red?
Yes, I love the red ones.
That sounds tasty. Do you eat them with milk?
I like them with a little sugar.
That is a good choice.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know why trees lose their leaves, but I am running late.
They do it to save water in the cold months. Are you going to the park?
No, I am just checking my phone for the bus.
The bus should be there soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck in my chess game. My king is in danger.
That is scary. Do you want to try moving your queen?
My queen is far away. What else can I do?
You can try a sacrifice. Do you have a pawn near your king?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go.
The park is right there. Do you like to run?
I only want to sit and look at things.
There is a quiet bench by the tree. Is that what you need?
That sounds like a good place.
The bench is free. It is a fine choice.
I will go sit there now.
Go on. I hope you enjoy the quiet.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does counting feel so hard?
It can be tricky at first, but you are getting better. Do you like counting your toys?
Yes, but I always forget where I am.
That is okay, just start again from one. Do you use your fingers to help?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I woke up feeling so sad. I dreamed of falling into a deep hole.
That sounds scary. Did you get stuck?
Yes, and no one came to help me. It felt very cold and dark.
I am sorry you felt alone. Do you feel safe now?
Yes, my bed is warm. I just want to go back to sleep.
That is a good plan. Good night.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
They use their roots to pull water up from the soil. Do you know where plant roots live?
They are in the dirt.
Yes, the roots are buried in the ground. Then the water travels up tiny tubes to the leaves. Have you ever seen a plant with big leaves?
Yes, I saw a big one.
Those big leaves help the plant breathe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am looking at a circle, a square, and a triangle. Which one has the most points?
The square has four points, so it has the most. What are you trying to build with them?
I want to build a house, but I do not know how to put the shapes together.
You can use the square for the body and the triangle for the roof. Do you like triangles?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and found a shiny blue rock.
That sounds like a fun find. Did you take it home?
Yes, I put it on my desk to keep it safe.
A nice way to remember your day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I think I have a winning hand.
That is exciting! What cards do you have?
I have three aces and a red king.
Wow, that sounds very strong.
Do you want to bet?
I cannot play for money. Is it for candy?
Yes, for a chocolate bar.
That sounds like a fair deal. I will show you my hand.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very proud today. I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That is a great goal. Do you have two wheels?
Yes, I have a blue bike in the garage. How do I start?
First, put on your helmet. Then, try to balance on one foot.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My chair leg is loose. How do I make it tight again?
Do you have a wrench?
Yes, I do.
Put the wrench on the bolt under the seat.
I did that, but it still moves.
Did you try tapping the leg with a hammer?
No, I did not.
Tap it gently to help it sit snug.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad today because the rain is coming.
That is very sad. Do you have an inside plan?
I just want the sun for my big day.
I hope it stops soon. Do you have a tent?
No, we did not think to get one.
That is a problem. Have you called the hall?
Yes, but they said it is too late.
I do not know what to do. I am sorry.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a rainbow. Why is it in the sky?
It makes when sun light hits rain drops. Do you like looking at it?
Yes, it is pretty. What makes the colors?
I do not know the true way, but the light breaks apart. Are you happy today?
Yes, I am glad. Is the end there with a pot?
That is just a story, and there is no pot there. Do you want to jump up to it?
No, that would be hard. It is very high up.
You can always look up and smile. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my phone screen all dark?
Are you sure it is on?
Yes, I can feel it, but I see nothing.
Try pressing the side button to wake it up.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate walking. My legs hurt and I want to quit.
That is a hard feeling. Do you have water nearby?
No, I just gave up too fast.
Walking does help your heart grow strong. Try just two more minutes.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost the hand again. This is so annoying.
That feels bad. Do you want to play another round?
Maybe, but I keep losing the last card.
Your cards look strong, so why did you lose?
I guess I just ran out of good moves.
I do not know why you lost that specific card.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My horse is not eating his hay.
I am sorry to hear that. Is he acting sleepy too?
He is lying down and not looking at me.
That sounds like he might be sick. Has he gone to the bathroom?
No, not today. I am very worried.
It is best to call a vet now. I do not know why this is happening, but help is close.
Okay, I will call him right now.
That is a good step. Please tell me how he feels later.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do my carrots look so small?
They need more room to grow big. Do you plant them close together?
Yes, I put them right next to each other.
Giving them space helps the roots get fat.
Is it better to start them in pots first?
I am not sure about your soil, but starting small can help. What kind of dirt do you have?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. My little magnet is gone.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you look under the couch?
Yes, I did. It was right there, but now it is not.
That is frustrating. Do you have a strong magnet to find it?
No, I only had that one. It was my favorite toy.
I am sure we can find it. Have you tried the fridge door?
I have not. The door is cold and sticky.
Cold spots are good places. Go check there now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no time. Can you point to a fast place?
Yes. The burger shop is right over there. Do you like hot food?
I am very hungry. Is the line long?
I do not know for sure. Please check the door yourself.
I will go there. Do they sell water?
Most places do. Do you need a straw?
No, I drink fast. Is it far from the park?
It is very close. Just walk around the corner.
I will run. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have a good meal.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to make a plan, but I do not know what to pick.
That can be hard. What is your favorite thing to do?
I like to run, but I am not sure where.
The park is a good place. Do you have time to go this afternoon?
Yes, I do. But I am still not sure if that is the right choice.
Trust your heart. If it feels right, go.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I get off the bus?
You press the button near your seat. Are you going far?
Where is the stop sign?
Look for the raised loop on the floor. Do you see it?
Okay, I found it.
Great, step out when the doors open. Have a safe day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate a big pizza with extra cheese today.
That sounds delicious. Did you like it?
Yes, I did. I was very happy.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired of waiting for the weekend. It feels very long.
I understand your feelings. Do you like one day more than the others?
I do not like Monday. It is always too hard.
Monday can be a difficult day. What do you do to make it better?
I just want to sleep all the time.
That is a nice dream. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big gray cloud. What should I do?
Look up at the sky. Do you see any rain?
No rain yet, but it looks heavy. What is it doing?
It may hold water soon. Is it getting darker?
Yes, the sun is gone. Should I go home?
It is smart to be safe. Do you have an umbrella?
Yes, I have one. I will take it.
That is a good plan. Enjoy your walk.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my favorite worm. My fish got away.
Oh no, that is very sad. Do you want to try again?
The water is so cold. My hands hurt.
That must be uncomfortable. Are your hands dry yet?
I just want to go home now. I am tired.
That is okay. Rest is good for you.
Will we find another worm?
I am not sure, but I hope so. Let us look.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I am so hungry today.
I am too. Do you want to eat?
Yes, I do. Why is it hard to find food?
The kitchen is small. Are you tired?
A little. Why do people eat together?
It is fun to talk. Do you like soup?
I do. Why does it taste warm?
Heat makes it feel nice.
That is good to know.
I am glad you know.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel so happy right now.
That is a lovely thing. What made you feel that way?
I am not sure why.
It can be a mystery. Maybe you did a good job on something?
I think I cleaned my room.
That is true. A clean space can feel very good.
So that is why I am proud?
Yes, it sounds like it. You should enjoy that warm feeling.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got off a very long plane.
That must have been tiring. Did you sleep well?
I watched three movies and read a book.
That sounds like a perfect way to pass time.
The food was actually quite good too.
I am glad you enjoyed the snacks. Do you plan to travel again soon?
Yes, I am already thinking about the next trip.
I am happy to hear that. Have a good rest now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. I cannot play the song right.
That feels bad. Do you want to try again?
No, I just want to stop.
It is okay to rest.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My team lost again. I hate it.
That is a sad feeling. Who did they play?
The red team. They scored late.
Late goals are very tricky. Did you watch all of it?
Yes, but my eyes were dry.
Sometimes crying helps. What do you like about soccer?
Just the running.
Running is fun. Do you play outside?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad and all alone today.
That feels bad. Do you want to talk about it?
Yes, I have no one to play with.
I am sorry about that. Who do you like to play with?
I do not know anyone here.
That is hard. Do you want to find a new friend?
I want, but I am shy.
Being shy is okay. What is one small step you can take?
I can just say hello to someone.
That is a good start. I am glad you decided to try.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The waves were very high today.
That sounds exciting. Did you go in the water?
No, I just sat on the sand and watched.
The sand can be warm. Was it hot?
Yes, but the wind made me cold.
The wind is like a big, cool breath. Do you like the smell of the salt?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a red leaf on the grass.
That is a pretty color. Do you have a favorite tree to look at?
I like the big oak tree.
It has very strong branches. What do you see up there?
I see birds.
Birds like to rest in high spots. Do they look cold?
No, they look happy.
Happy birds make a nice sound. What do they sound like to you?
They sound like tiny bells.
That is a sweet way to hear them. I am glad you enjoyed the walk.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red balloon fly away today.
That is a fun thing to see. Did you know where it went?
It floated over the tall trees and then disappeared.
That sounds a bit sad. Do you think it popped?
I hope it is still up there in the sky.
I do not know for sure. It is a nice thought.
My friend said it is a lucky sign to see one.
That is a sweet story. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I slept so well last night. I felt like a cloud.
That is lovely to hear. What did you do before bed?
I drank warm milk and read a book. My head felt very quiet.
That sounds very cozy. Do you think the milk helped you fall asleep?
Yes, it made me feel sleepy and safe. I woke up with a big smile.
I am glad you are happy. I hope you sleep well again tonight.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I cannot stop my head from moving tonight.
That is called restless sleep. Do you drink juice before bed?
Yes, I had a big glass of strawberry juice.
That juice has sugar that makes your body buzz. Do you eat candy too?
No, but I watch TV until late.
Light from the screen wakes up your eyes. Do you have a soft pillow?
It is too hard, so my neck hurts.
A soft pillow helps you rest. Do you hug a stuffed bear?
No, but my blanket is very thick.
A heavy blanket can feel like a warm hug. Do you like when I read to you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am scared to start my first job.
It is okay to feel scared. Have you ever done this before?
No, this is my very first time.
You will learn as you go.
What should I bring with me?
Bring a pen and a notebook. Do you have those ready?
Yes, I have my bag packed.
That is good. You will do great.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my grandpa today. He was very happy. He gave me a cookie.
That is a nice memory. What kind of cookie was it?
It was chocolate with white chips. He smiled at me.
Smiles are warm gifts. Do you eat them with him?
Yes, we sat on the porch. We looked at the sky.
The sky is always free. Was it blue or cloudy today?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do sailors use maps to find their way?
Yes, they use maps and stars. Do you like looking at stars?
I do, but what if it is cloudy?
They use machines to find their spot then. Do you like boats?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. The sun is warm on my face.
That sounds lovely. What did you see first?
I saw a big, fluffy dog. It chased a ball.
How fun that must be. Was it happy?
Yes, its tail went up and down. I felt good.
I am glad you feel that way. Do you want to go home now?
Not yet. I want to sit by the pond.
Good luck sitting there.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the tent?
It is under that big pine tree. Do you have your map?
I do not see it. What else is there?
There is a camp stove nearby. Did you pack the food?
Yes, but I ran out of gas. Can I buy more?
The store is closed for now. Are you hungry?
I am very hungry. What can I do?
Eat the sandwiches you packed first. Do you like cold food?
I guess so. Thanks for the help.
Good luck with your hike. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a big magnet. It is so cool!
That is great news! What does it stick to?
It sticks to my fridge. It is very strong.
Strong magnets are fun. Do you like science?
Yes, I do. It pulls on the metal.
That is a true fact. Is it holding a picture up?
Yes, it holds a note. I am very happy.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why do the trees let go of their leaves when the weather gets cold?
The trees rest in winter to save energy, much like we sleep. Do you like walking through leaf piles?
Yes, I do. How can I make my own leaf rubbing art?
Place a leaf on paper, cover it with wax paper, and rub with a crayon. Did you try that last week?
Not yet. What else can I do with old leaves?
You can mix them into soil to help plants grow. Are you ready to help your garden?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the train on time?
Yes, it is right on schedule. Do you like riding on trains?
I am a little nervous about the ride.
Do not worry, it is very smooth and safe. Is this your first long trip?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn to drive right now. The car is waiting.
That is too fast. A small error can hurt you. What part worries you the most?
The brakes feel too loud and scary.
Loud brakes are normal. They just sound big. Do you know where the pedal is?
Yes, my foot knows, but my heart does not.
Take a deep breath. Trust your foot. Are your feet resting on the floor?
Yes, I am calm now. I can do this.
Good job. You are ready.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a square for my art class, but I am so late.
A square has four equal sides. Do you have a ruler to help you draw it straight?
It is not a square, it is a circle. Please tell me about circles now.
A circle is round with no corners. Are you trying to draw a wheel or a ball?
It is a circle. I have to run now. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Good luck with your drawing.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say half past three instead of three and a half?
We say it that way because we split the hour into two equal parts. Do you know how many minutes are in a half hour?
I think it is thirty, but why do we use the word past?
Past means the time has gone by, so thirty minutes have passed since three o'clock.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red button on the floor this morning.
That sounds like a funny find. Did you keep it?
I put it in my pocket, but it is very round.
A round button is easy to lose. Did it fall out?
It rolled away and I chased it to the door.
Chasing a button is a wild game. Did you catch it?
I caught it just before the mailman left.
What a lucky save. You have a busy day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a job today. I am so happy.
That is wonderful news for you. What will you do there?
I will clean tables at a cafe. I feel very proud.
Cleaning helps people eat well. Do you like food?
Yes, I love food. It feels real now.
Good work gives you strength. Can you eat lunch there?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate my sandwich at my desk. It was very big and full of cheese.
That sounds tasty. Did you get any cheese on your shirt?
Oh no, I did not. I was very careful with the food.
Good for you. Do you like cheese a lot?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the stars so bright?
They are far away lights. Do you see the moon?
Yes, but why do the stars blink?
That is air moving near us. I do not know for sure.
That is interesting. Thank you.
I am happy to help. Do you like the night?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people work from home?
It saves time on travel. Do you like walking to work?
I walk, but it is tiring. Why is home good?
You can rest when tired. Is your home quiet?
Yes, it is very quiet. But I miss talking to friends. Why is that bad?
Friends help us feel happy. Do you call them often?
I call sometimes, but it is not the same. Why do we need touch?
Touch makes us feel close. Do you hug your friends?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do clouds float in the sky?
They are very light, like feathers. Do you like to watch them?
Yes, I do. Why are some clouds white and others gray?
White ones have small water drops. Gray ones are thicker and wetter. Do you think it will rain?
Maybe. Why can we see through some clouds?
Thin clouds let the light pass through. It is like a thin curtain. Can you see the sun?
Yes, I can. Why do clouds move so fast?
The wind pushes them along. I do not know how fast they really go. Do you run that fast?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do magnets stick to the fridge?
The fridge door has a thin layer of metal that loves magnets. Do you have a fridge at home?
Yes, why does it stick but not to my plastic cup?
Plastic does not have the special metal parts that magnets need to grab onto. What else does your magnet stick to?
It sticks to my new notebook, why?
I do not know if your notebook has metal inside, so I cannot be sure. Do you know if it has a metal clasp?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the magnet pull the clip?
It has a special force inside. Do you like to play with them?
It sticks to the fridge, why?
The fridge is made of steel. Does it stick to wood?
No, it does not stick to wood.
Good, because wood is not magnetic.
Why does the red side push the red side?
Same sides push apart. Have you tried the blue side?
The blue side pulls the red one in.
Yes, that is how they work.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My neighbor is very loud and it makes me sad.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do they play music?
Yes, it is very loud music every day.
That sounds hard to hear.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to save money today, but I bought a candy bar.
That is okay. Did you still have fun?
Yes, but now I have less cash.
Saving takes time. Do you have a goal for your money?
I want to buy a new game.
That is a good goal. Did you count your coins?
I counted them, but I am not sure what to do next.
I do not know the best plan for you. Try putting coins in a jar first.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to walk more, but my legs feel tired. What should I do?
Start with just ten minutes each day. Do you have a nice path near your home?
Yes, there is a park. How long should I walk to get strong?
Try to walk for twenty minutes most days. Is that something you can fit into your day?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My fence is looking old and sad. What should I do?
A fresh coat of paint makes it look new. Do you like red or green?
I think green will look nice with the grass.
That sounds like a great choice.
How do I stop the wood from breaking?
You can use a special oil for the wood. Have you tried that before?
No, I have never used oil.
It helps the wood stay strong.
I will buy the oil tomorrow, thank you.
I am happy to help you. I hope the fence looks great.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My legs feel heavy and I do not want to go.
It is hard when you feel tired. Do you need a quick break?
I think my feet are really sore from the shoes.
Sore feet can hurt a lot. Are they rubbing on the wrong spot?
I just want to sit and watch the grass.
Sitting is okay if you need rest. What made you want to stop today?
I am not a good runner, I think I should quit.
You are learning something new every day. How far did you get before the stop?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I look at the clock, but I get lost. How do I know what time it is?
Look at the short hand first to find the hour. Do you know where the long hand points?
The long hand is tricky. What should I look at for the minutes?
Watch the long hand move around the numbers one by one. Each number marks five minutes.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the pool today and felt very cold.
That is not fun. Did you jump in right away?
Yes, I jumped in and shivered for a long time.
Oh no. Did you warm up soon?
I got out and drank some hot chocolate.
That sounds nice. Do you like swimming in the cold?
Not really. I think I will go back in the summer.
That is a good plan. See you then.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big rainbow in the sky!
How beautiful. Do you like the red part best?
I think the red part is my favorite.
Red is a warm color. Have you ever touched the rain?
Yes, the rain gets my clothes wet.
The sun makes the rainbow with the wet air.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to float on my back.
That is a fun trick. Do you know how to put air in your lungs?
Yes, I take a big breath before I start.
Good. Now tilt your face up to the sky. Do your arms feel heavy?
Yes, they sink into the water.
Relax your shoulders and let your arms rest. It helps you stay up.
I am floating! Thank you so much.
Well done. I am happy it worked.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I want to draw a dog but it looks like a blob.
That is hard when your hand moves fast. Do you have a pencil?
Yes, but the lines are all wobbly.
Wobbly lines are okay. What does your dog look like?
I have a big nose and floppy ears.
Try drawing big circles first. Is your paper flat?
It is stuck to the desk.
Smooth it out to stop the sticking. Do you like the color blue?
I like brown for the fur.
Brown is a warm color. Good choice.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red ball in the yard today.
That sounds fun. Was the ball yours?
No, it belonged to my neighbor.
That was very kind of you to find it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am rushing to catch the bus and need my blue hat. Where is it?
I do not know where it is. Do you usually keep it on the hook?
Yes, on the hook, but the hook is empty. I must go now.
Please check the floor by the door. Have you looked under the rug?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My head hurts from work. I want to learn to make soup.
That sounds good. Are you hungry?
Yes, I am. How do I start?
Put water in a pot. Do you have vegetables?
I have carrots. What next?
Cut them small. I do not know if you have chicken.
No, just vegetables. How do I cook it?
Add salt and simmer. Do you have a spoon?
Yes, I do. What now?
Stir it well. It will taste good.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad and my tummy hurts.
That sounds scary. Did you eat something that made you feel this way?
I do not know. I just think bad things will happen.
Worrying makes your body feel tight. Can you take one slow breath with me?
I took a breath. It helped a little bit.
I am glad that helped. What makes you feel happy?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My little sister is crying because she broke her toy.
That sounds tough. What is her name?
She is very sad and wants to fix it.
You are very kind to help. Have you tried putting the pieces back together?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go.
I can help you choose. What do you like to see?
I am tired and sad.
That is okay to feel. Let us walk to the quiet pond.
I do not know the way there.
I do not know the path either. Shall we just follow the big trees?
I am scared of the dark trees.
The trees are friends, not foes. Do you see the warm sun through them?
Yes, it is bright and nice.
Then come. We will sit and watch the water.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I lost my stamp.
Oh no, that is tricky. Did you buy the stamp today?
Yes, I did, but the line is too long.
I am sorry to hear that. Would you like to sit and wait?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just saw a movie with a big red dragon. It was so cool and happy.
A red dragon sounds fun. Did you like its face?
Yes, it had a very funny face. It made me laugh a lot.
That makes me smile. How did the story end?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to walk in the park, but I feel sad.
That is okay. Sad feelings come and go. Do you like the trees there?
I do, but I fear the dark woods.
That is a fair worry. You can stick to the bright paths.
I also need to eat, but I forgot my lunch.
Let us find a bench to rest first. Is the park close?
Yes, it is just around the corner.
Great. We will walk slowly and look for snacks.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
It is because of the light. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. Why do you ask?
I just enjoy the quiet. I do not know the exact science, but it feels nice.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have three kings in my hand. What should I do next?
That is a very strong start. Are you playing poker?
Yes, I am. Do I put money on the table?
You should wait for more cards before betting much. Do you know the rules for checking?
I do not know. How do I make my move?
Just say check if you want to skip betting. Have fun with your game.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sky is very dark and the rain is loud.
That can feel scary. Do you have a window nearby?
Yes, I see the drops on the glass. What should I do?
You can listen to the rain on the roof. Do you like the sound?
It sounds like a drum. Is it going to stop soon?
I do not know when it will end. But it will pass.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very tired and do not know what to do.
You should try to rest. Are you hungry?
I am not hungry, but my eyes hurt.
Closing your eyes for a bit helps. Do you like listening to quiet music?
I do not like music right now.
That is okay, so try silence.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad about my favorite book.
I am sorry to hear that. What happened to it?
I dropped it in the mud and now the pages are dirty.
That is a mess. Do you still like the story?
Yes, I do, but it feels ruined.
A dirty cover does not change the words. Would you like to read it?
I guess I will try again.
That is a brave choice. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My bread did not rise at all.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you use warm water to mix the yeast?
Yes, I did check the water. It was warm.
That is good news. The yeast may just be old.
Old yeast? I bought it last week.
I do not know for sure. But cold room air can stop it from growing.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn to sing right now. I am late.
Take one deep breath first. Do you know where the air comes from?
I just need to open my mouth and make sound.
You should sit up straight to breathe well. Why is the song so hard for you?
I cannot wait, just tell me the end.
I do not know what song you mean. The best sound starts with a calm body.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so tired today, but I am very happy.
That is a good kind of tired. What made you smile?
I ate a big, warm bowl of soup.
Yum, that sounds restful. Do you want to sleep now?
Yes, my eyes are closing on their own.
Sweet dreams and a good rest.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did you wrap my gift in blue paper?
I like the color blue. Do you think it matches your shirt?
It does match. Why did you hide it under the sofa?
I wanted to make you look hard for it. Are you glad I did?
I found it quickly. Why did you smile so big when I looked under the sofa?
I was happy you were paying attention. Does the smile reach my eyes?
Yes, it does. Why are you so happy about a small box?
Because you are the person I love. Is it a good surprise?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so light today. Work was not hard at all.
That is great news. Did you do a fun task?
Yes, I helped a new friend. We all laughed a lot.
That sounds very nice. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is the internet?
It is a giant web that links many computers together. Do you like to draw?
Yes, I love to draw! Can I share my pictures on it?
Yes, you can share them with people you know. Do you like playing games too?
I play games sometimes, but I get tired.
That is good to know. Your brain needs rest to grow strong.
Okay, I will rest now.
Goodbye, and have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today.
That sounds like fun. Did you build a big sand castle?
Yes, it was very tall.
I love sand castles. Was the water warm?
It was cool, but I liked it.
Nice. I would love to visit too.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do robots look like us?
It helps us feel comfortable near them. Do you think they should look different?
I guess not. Why do they move so fast?
They have strong motors inside. Do you like when they move quickly?
Yes, I do. Why can some robots talk?
They have special parts that help them learn words. Do you want one to talk to you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I made a new song today. It is about the rain.
That sounds very nice. Does it sound like tapping?
Yes, it taps on my roof.
I am glad you found that. Do you have an umbrella?
I lost it in the rain.
That is a bit sad. Did you get wet?
I got a little wet.
Well, you are safe. Was the song fun to make?
Yes, it felt good.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late for my wedding.
Take a deep breath. Did you pack your ring?
I have no time for that.
That is a big thing to forget. Is the car ready?
The car is outside now.
Good. You can breathe now.
I need to go now.
Go with joy. You will make it.
Thank you for helping me.
Glad I could help. Have a sweet day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the bakery. I am late.
Go left and walk ten steps. Are you buying bread?
Yes, I need a loaf. Which house?
It is the red house with the blue door. Is it for breakfast?
I do not have time to ask. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. School was really fun.
That sounds nice. What did you like best?
I made a new friend in class. We played tag.
That is great news. Do you plan to play again tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My head hurts so much. How can I fix it?
Drink some water and rest your eyes. Do you feel tired too?
Yes, I am very tired. Can you tell me how to make a warm compress?
Yes, just wrap a cloth around a cup of warm water. Be careful it is not too hot.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: What is that bright thing in the sky?
That is the moon. Do you like looking up?
Is it a big ball of light?
It is a rock that shines with sun light.
Can I go there on a bike?
No, you cannot ride a bike there.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to run, but my legs hurt.
Rest is good for sore legs. Do you like walking?
I do like walking. It feels better.
Walking helps your body get ready. How long did you run?
I ran for ten minutes.
Ten minutes is a great start. Do you have good shoes?
Yes, I have blue shoes.
Blue shoes sound nice for running. Do you run every day?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my brother share his snacks?
He likes you a lot. Do you share back?
Yes, I do. Why is he always so quiet?
He is thinking hard. What is he thinking about?
I do not know. Why does he smile at me?
He is happy to see you. Are you happy too?
Yes, I am. Why does he help me with shoes?
He cares for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a drink fast, but I do not know which one to pick.
Coffee has more kick. Do you feel very tired?
Yes, I am so sleepy, but I must leave in one minute.
Choose coffee then. It is a good choice for your haste.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I looked at the waves today and they made me smile.
That sounds wonderful. What color was the water?
It was a deep, shiny blue.
I am glad you found such joy there.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so fast, please help me right now.
I see you are in a big hurry. Do you like waiting?
No, I do not.
That is hard to do.
My watch is gone!
I do not know where it is. Did you check your pockets?
I did, it is not there.
Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I saw a funny face on the stage. Why did the man do that?
He did that to show he is sad. Do you like sad plays?
It looked like a big fish. Why is there a fish in a house?
The fish is just a picture on the wall. Do you have fish at home?
The lady spoke very soft. Why did she whisper?
She wanted to tell a secret. What is your secret?
I like the lights. Why did they turn off?
The story was ending. Did you enjoy the play?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to help my friend feel happy.
That is a very sweet idea. What makes your friend smile?
I do not know. Can you give me a good idea?
A warm hug often works wonders. Do you know what they like to play?
Yes, they like to build with blocks.
You could build a house together. Will you tell me how it goes?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a very busy day. I drank two cups of coffee to stay awake, but I still felt tired at the end.
That sounds tough. Do you usually take a break during the day?
Not always. I made a cup of warm tea right before bed to help me relax.
Warm tea is a good choice. Does it make you feel calm?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. The bus is coming.
Oh no, do not panic. Do you have your bag?
Yes, I have it. I must run.
Hurry safely. Good luck with your day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the bus so loud today?
The engine works hard to move us. Do you like the ride?
I do. Why is the road so bumpy?
It rained last night.
Why does the driver smile?
He is happy to see you. Do you see the trees?
Yes, they are green. Why are they green?
The sun helps them grow.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to build a shed, but I do not know how to start.
That is a big job. Do you have the wood ready?
No, I have only some wood and a plan. What should I do next?
It is best to check the size first. Do you know how big it needs to be?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see smoke in my kitchen. What should I do?
Is the fire big or small? Go outside and call for help right now.
It is very big. I am scared.
Good luck. Stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate that song. It gives me a bad feeling.
I am sorry you feel that way. Why do you think that?
The words make me feel sad and alone.
That sounds very tough. Do you want to talk about why?
I just do not like it. It feels wrong to me.
Your feelings are real. Do you want help picking a new song?
Maybe. I just want something happy.
I do not know your favorite songs. What makes you smile?
Funny songs with fast words.
That is a great idea. Would you like a list of fun picks?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Where is the tent?
It is right over there. Are you tired?
Yes. Do I need a map?
I do not know, but the trail is clear. Is it cloudy?
Yes. I must go now.
Have a great trip.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a big secret and I must tell you fast.
I am ready to listen. Do you trust me?
Yes, I do trust you.
That is good to hear. What is the secret?
My cat is named King.
A funny name for a cat. Is he a loud one?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My work today was very bad.
That sounds hard. Did your boss say why?
I made a big mistake and felt sad.
We all make mistakes. Is there a way to fix it?
I do not know how to fix it.
I do not know your job. Do you have a kind friend to ask?
I think I will just leave early.
Take a rest. See you later.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind was so loud today. My trees bent down very low.
That sounds scary. Did you stay inside?
Yes, I watched the rain fall. It came down in big sheets.
I am glad you are safe. Was the power still on?
The lights went out for a bit. Then they came back on.
That is good news. Do you like the quiet after the storm?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see the bright stars. I must go now.
They look very nice. Do you like the red one?
Yes, I love it. I am late for school.
That is one of the brightest stars.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must leave now. The door is close.
Goodbye. Safe trip. Is it raining?
No sun. I wear red coat.
Nice. That color is bright. Do you have lunch?
Yes, cold ham.
Yum. Eat well. I do not know where you go.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn to swim, but I feel scared.
That is okay. Do you have a pool nearby?
Yes, I go there with my mom.
That is good. What makes you feel scared?
I worry about the water touching my mouth.
Try to keep your lips closed tight. Do you wear goggles?
No, I do not have any yet.
Goggles help you see. Try blowing bubbles in the water.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at that big tree with the red leaves.
It is very pretty. Do you think the squirrels live there?
I saw one jump up the trunk just now.
That was quick. Do you like climbing trees?
Not very high ones because I fall.
Falling is okay if the ground is soft. Do you have a favorite spot in the park?
Yes, the little bridge over the water.
A good choice. Is the water cold?
Yes, it is very cold.
Keep your feet dry then. Do you want to play by the water?
I want to go home now because it is late.
Good idea. Do you need help finding the path?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I want to share my warm tea with you.
That is very kind of you. Do you like your tea sweet?
Yes, I add a spoon of sugar. Coffee tastes too sour to me.
That makes sense. Thank you for the story.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here, but I do not know where to go.
Are you looking for toys or clothes? The shop has both.
I want to buy a gift, but I am not sure what to pick.
Think about what they like to play with. Do they like cars?
No, they do not like cars. I do not have a good idea.
I do not know their exact taste. How about a book?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk about it?
I am just not happy.
It is okay to feel this way. What makes you feel most sad?
I do not know why.
That is a hard thing to find. Are you tired or hungry?
I think I am tired.
Rest is good for your mind. Do you want to take a break?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to buy a red apple, but I do not know how to ask.
Just say, "Can I have a red apple?" Do you like sweet apples?
Yes, I do. How do I give the money?
You give the coins to the clerk and say, "Thank you." Is that clear to you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The train leaves in five minutes.
Do not worry. The station is close. Are you close to the platform?
I have my ticket, but I do not know the gate.
Go to the big blue door. It says Gate 4. Is that your stop?
Yes, that is my stop. I can make it.
You can run fast. Look for the yellow line on the floor. Do you see it?
I see the line. My legs are tired.
Take a deep breath. You will be fine. Did you pack all your things?
Yes, my bag is full. I am ready to go now.
Good luck with your trip. Have a nice day. See you later.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off the trees?
The tree lets go because winter is coming, like you take off a jacket to stay warm. Do you see green leaves falling, too?
Mostly brown ones.
Green leaves fall if they get sick or hurt. Does that make sense?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What is in the box?
I do not know. Do you like surprises?
I really do. What is it?
It is a big red balloon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does a horse grow a long tail?
It uses the tail to swat flies. Do you like riding?
Yes, I do. Why do they have four legs?
Four legs help them run fast. Is your horse brown?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What do bugs eat?
They eat many things like leaves, fruit, or other bugs. Do you like watching them eat?
Yes, I do. Are bees happy?
Bees are not happy or sad like us. They just work hard in their hive. Do you know what a hive is?
It is where they live. Why do ants lift things?
Ants lift things to share food with their family. I do not know why they are so strong. Do you think they are strong?
I think they are. Can flies fly back?
Yes, they can fly forward and backward. Their wings move very fast. Do you want to watch a fly?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a movie today about a lonely cat. The cat was very sad because it had no friends.
That is a pity for the cat. Did the cat find a friend in the end?
No, the movie stopped there. It left me feeling very confused and a bit lonely.
That is a tricky story to watch. Do you usually like happy endings?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does the big ship stay on the water?
It pushes water down, and the water pushes back up. Do you like boats?
Yes, I do. But why does it not sink?
The air inside makes it light for its size. I love seeing waves.
What if it gets too heavy?
It will sit lower in the water. Do you feel heavy after eating?
I do. Can I put more things on it?
Only if the water pushes back hard enough. I am not sure how much that is.
Okay, thank you.
You are welcome. I am happy to help. Do you want to draw it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My chair leg is stuck and will not move. I tried to pull it, but it is stuck tight.
Oh, that is tricky. Did you use any oil to help it slide?
No, I only have water and a rag. The wood looks dry and dusty.
Dry wood sticks. Try a little water to wet the wood.
I tried that, but it still will not move. I am worried I will break it.
Do not pull hard. Tap the leg gently with a soft hammer.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the main square fast. Where is it?
Go down the long street until you see the big clock. Do you like looking up at the sky?
No time for that. Is there a park close by?
Yes, just turn left after the square. Are you tired?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to see the North Star.
Look for the Big Dipper first. Do you see that big group of stars?
Yes, I see it.
It looks like a ladle. Follow the two stars on the end of the bowl. Do you know which way is north?
I think that is north.
Great. Keep a straight line going. You are close to the answer.
Is that the bright one?
Yes, that is Polaris. It stays in the same place.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do I need an ID to send a package?
Yes, you do. What kind of item is inside?
It is a new book for my sister.
A book is safe to send. Is the box strong enough?
I used a thick cardboard box.
That is a good choice. Do you know the address?
I have it written down.
Great. Do you want it tracked?
I do not know what that means.
Tracking lets you see where it goes.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am hungry but I do not know what to eat.
That is a hard choice. Do you want something hot or cold?
Maybe hot, but the list is too long.
Let us pick a soup first. Is that a good start for you?
Soup is good, but I also want bread.
Bread goes well with soup. Would you like a roll?
Yes, please, just the roll and soup.
Okay, I will order that for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The sky looks gray. How do I make my own cloud?
That is not easy, but you can make one with cotton. Do you have any cotton at home?
Yes, I have some old shirts. What do I do next?
Tear the shirts into small, soft pieces. Stack them up on a white paper.
I stacked them. Now what?
Add a little water to the top pieces. It makes them look wet and real.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a very good drawing today.
That is great. What did you draw?
It is a big red truck.
A red truck sounds fun.
I feel very happy right now.
Happy feelings are good. Do you want to hang it up?
Yes, I want to show everyone.
Sharing is kind. Well done.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big red shed in the yard.
That sounds like fun! How tall do you want it to be?
As tall as the apple tree.
You might want to make it a bit shorter so it is safe. Do you have a hammer yet?
Yes, but I do not know how to use the screws.
I can help you with that later. Where will you put the tools?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you like bananas?
They are sweet and easy to eat. Do you like the color yellow?
Yes, I do. Why is a banana good for you?
It has good things that help your body. Do you eat them every day?
Sometimes. Why do I sometimes feel tired after eating one?
That is a hard question for me. I do not know the full answer.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel alone here. I am late.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like to talk?
I must go now.
That is okay. I will be here if you need me.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to take a photo right now but I have no time to set it up.
Just point the camera at your subject and press the button. Are you going on a trip?
Yes, I am late for the bus. How do I make the picture clear?
Hold your hands still and wait for a good light. Do you like sunny days?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am drawing a big cat.
That sounds fun. What color is your cat?
It is orange and black.
Nice choice. Do you have a hat on it?
No, it is not wearing a hat.
I understand. Would you like to add a tail?
Yes, I want a long tail.
A long tail will look great.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My tummy hurts so bad. I do not like to go to the doctor.
That feels yucky. What kind of pain is it?
It is a twisty pain. I am scared of the needle.
You do not always get a needle. Do you feel dizzy too?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I love my book about the brave little bear who likes honey.
That sounds like a sweet story. Do you read it before bed?
