Yes, it helps me fall asleep because the bear is very calm.
That is a nice way to rest. What is your favorite part?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the screen broke and I lost my work.
That is very hard. Do you have a backup copy?
No, I did not save it.
That feels like a big loss. Do you remember the main points?
I only remember a little bit.
We can try to write it down again. Would you like help?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work. The bus is missing.
That is very stressful. Do you have a phone?
Yes, but the signal is bad.
Try walking to the next stop. Is it close?
It is two blocks away.
That is a good plan. Good luck!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because it is raining.
That is hard. Do you like the rain?
No, I wanted to play outside.
I am sorry about that. Is your umbrella ready?
Yes, but I do not want to use it.
That is okay. It will stop soon.
I hope so.
I do not know for sure. Do you want a warm drink?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to plant a garden but I am not sure where to start. Do you have any advice?
You can start with a small box of soil. Do you have a sunny spot in your home?
Yes, I have a big window. What should I put in the soil first?
Try some seeds from a packet. Be sure to water them with care.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do the dinosaurs walk here?
No, they are in boxes. Do you like bones?
I like the big ones.
The T-Rex is very big. What is your favorite color?
Blue.
The painting is blue too. Do you want to look at it?
Yes, please.
It is the next room. Did you bring a snack?
I have an apple.
That is good. Eat it after the tour.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to keep my bike straight.
Sit up tall and look far ahead. Do you have a friend to hold the seat?
No, I am alone and my legs are shaky.
Try to roll slow and steady. That helps with balance.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to wash my new baby.
That is a big job, but you can do it. Do you have warm water ready?
Yes, the water is warm and soft.
Good. Put the baby in the tub and pour the water gently. How does the baby look?
The baby is smiling and calm.
Smiling means happy. You did a good job. Do you know how to dry the baby?
I think I just rub the skin.
Yes, but be very soft. Use a soft towel and pat the skin. Are you done?
Yes, the baby is all dry now.
Great work. You are a good helper.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which month is next.
Count the fingers on one hand. What is your favorite time of year?
I love the snow in winter.
Winter comes after fall. Do you like hot drinks?
Yes, I like warm milk.
I do not know what you plan to do today. What is your name?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I move my big bookshelf without breaking it?
Tape the shelves together and take books off slowly. Do you have a friend to help you?
Yes, I have a strong friend coming over.
That is great. Is it far away?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I was looking up and I saw the blue sky. Can you tell me why it is that color?
It is because the sun sends light in all colors. Do you know which color bends the most?
I am not sure, but I think I know the answer.
Blue bends the most, so you see it everywhere. I do not know why nature picked that color for us.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love to draw pictures.
That sounds like so much fun. What do you like to draw?
I draw big, red tomatoes.
I have never tried drawing food, but I think it must be very tasty. Do you eat the tomatoes you draw?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad. My boss said I did the task wrong again.
That sounds hard. Do you feel sad about it?
Yes. I tried to do my best, but I still failed.
I am sorry you feel this way. You can try again tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel very happy today. I want to tell you about my robot.
That is nice. What does your robot do?
It brings me water when I am thirsty.
That is very helpful.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is there bright light in the dark?
A small fire is going out. Is it a candle?
No, it is a chair on fire. Why is it burning?
I do not know why it started. Is anyone safe?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to put all my books away right now. I am so late.
That sounds like a lot of work. How many books do you have?
I do not know. Maybe a hundred. I just need them off the floor.
A hundred is a big number. Do you want help?
Yes, please. Can you put the big ones on the top shelf?
I can do that. Which shelf is the top one?
The very high one. Thank you. I must go now.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to throw a party, but I have no idea what to do.
That is exciting. What kind of food do you like?
I love pizza and ice cream, but I am not sure about the games.
You can play tag or hide and seek. Do you have a big yard?
Yes, I do, but my friends are busy on weekends.
Try to invite them for a day when you are both free. It is best to pick a date that works for everyone.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a big, still lake. The water looks like blue glass.
That sounds very peaceful. Do you see any birds?
Yes, a white duck is swimming in a circle. I feel so happy right now.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I have to wait?
Waiting helps us stay calm. Do you like feeling calm?
Yes, but it is hard to wait.
It gets easier with time.
Why does time help?
It lets us practice small things. Do you like practicing?
I think so. I will try.
That is a good plan. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. My carrots are big.
That is great news. How long did you wait?
It took many days. I watered them every day.
You worked hard. Do you eat them raw?
Yes, they taste sweet. I am very proud.
I am happy for you. Thank you for sharing this.
I am glad to talk to you. It made me smile.
Your joy is contagious. What will you grow next?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the big market today. It was so loud and bright.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you see any cool colors?
I bought a sweet red apple. I felt very happy eating it.
I am glad you enjoyed it. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My train is late and I am very angry.
I am sorry you are stuck. Do you have a book?
No, I do not have a book. I just want to go home.
That feels bad. When is the next train coming?
The sign says in an hour. This is too long.
An hour is a long wait. Would you like some water?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My teacher is very nice.
That is good to hear. What does she do to be nice?
She tells funny stories.
Stories can make learning fun. Do you like the stories?
Yes, I like them a lot.
I am glad you enjoy them. Is she kind to everyone?
Yes, she is kind to all.
That is a wonderful thing to have. I hope she stays your teacher.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My computer makes a loud noise and the screen is blue.
That sounds scary. Is the fan spinning fast?
It is very hot and I cannot open my files.
Please turn it off to let it cool down. Do you hear any beeping?
It just beeps three times and then stops.
Three beeps often mean a memory issue. Do you know where the memory sticks are?
I found them but I do not know how to fix them.
I do not know your exact model to be sure. You can try reseating them gently first.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Today I walked to the park and saw a red dog.
A red dog is very special. Was the dog barking?
No, it was sleeping under a big tree.
That sounds like a nice rest for the dog. Did you pet it?
I tried, but the owner said no touching.
That is good to keep everyone safe. Did you go home after that?
Yes, I ran home to get a snack.
Running home sounds fun. What did you eat?
I had an apple and some crackers.
That is a tasty choice. I hope you are happy now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to climb a big mountain.
That is a tall goal. Do you have a strong pair of boots?
Yes, I have big, sturdy boots.
Good. You need thick socks to keep your feet warm and dry.
I have wool socks, but I am not sure how to stay safe on the rocks.
I do not know the exact steps for your specific path. Do you have a map?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Can you tell me about robots? I am late.
Robots are machines that do jobs for us. Are they scary?
No, they just hold doors open. Do they feel happy?
They do not have feelings like we do. Do they eat?
I have to go now. Goodbye.
Goodbye and have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a snow angel?
Lie on your back in the snow and wave your arms and legs. Do you have a big enough space?
What should I do after that?
Move your hands and feet slowly to make shapes. Then lift your head to see it.
Does the snow have to be cold?
Yes, it must be very cold or it will melt. Is it snowing where you are?
I will try it now.
That sounds like fun. Tell me how it looks.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I need to go now.
Take a breath. Are you scared?
No. I just failed.
Failure is part of learning. Do you want to try again?
Not today. I am in a hurry.
That is okay.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a movie about a boy who can bend metal.
That is a very cool trick. Did you enjoy watching him use it?
Yes, but the story was a bit hard to follow.
That happens with big stories. Do you want to read the book first next time?
Who wrote the book it was based on?
I do not know the name. Did the film feel long to you?
A little long. The middle part was slow.
The middle can drag on sometimes. Did the end make the wait feel worth it?
Yes, the end was great and saved it for me.
I am glad it turned out well. Will you watch it again with a friend?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to paint a tree. Where do I start?
Start with a brown line for the trunk. What color do you want the leaves?
Green, please. I do not know how to make leaves.
Use small round shapes on top of the trunk. Do you have green paint?
Yes, I have green paint. My lines look wavy and bad.
Wavy lines are fine. They look natural and fun. Are you using a thin brush?
I am using a thin brush. It feels hard to control.
Move your whole arm, not just your hand. It helps you feel steady. Do you like the way it looks?
Yes, I do like it. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I am glad you are happy. Have fun painting.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do I start a game?
You put the white pawns on the second row from you. Do you know where the kings go?
The kings sit on the corner next to the rooks.
Yes, that is the d and e squares. The queens go in the squares that match their own color.
Why does the queen have more power?
She is the strongest piece because she moves any way she wants. Do you like playing with the queen?
I like the horse because it jumps.
The knight jumps over other pieces. That is a fun way to surprise your friend.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a banana. I do not know what to do with it.
Do you like sweet things? You can just eat it.
I do not want to eat it. I want to make something.
That is fun. Do you have any bread?
No, I do not have bread. I only have the fruit.
I do not know a good recipe for just one banana. Do you want to slice it?
Slicing sounds hard. I am afraid of knives.
You can peel it and put it in a bowl. It is very safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a quick place to eat.
There is a fast spot nearby. Do you like hot food?
Yes, but I have no time to wait.
You can take it with you. Is that good for you?
Great. How do I get there?
Go straight and turn left. Is that clear?
Yes, thanks. I am running.
Have a good lunch. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to try again?
Because the first time did not work, so we learn from it. Do you want to see how?
I guess. What if I fail again?
Failing just shows us what to fix next time. Are you ready to start?
I think so. Thank you.
You can do this. I am here to help.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My neighbor is so loud again. It is very hard to hear anything else.
That sounds very tiring. Do you want to talk to him?
I do not want to make things worse. He is just being careless with his stuff.
I understand your worry. Maybe he does not know he is loud?
I feel so annoyed by the noise every day. I just want some quiet peace.
You have every right to feel that way. Would you like some quiet music to help?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a small blue bird on my window sill today.
That is very lucky. Did it look sad?
It was just standing still and looking at me.
It might have been lost. Did you call for help?
No, I just gave it some water in a bowl.
That was a kind thing to do. Was it warm inside?
The sun came out and it flew away into the sky.
I am glad it is safe. Do you hope it comes back?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My cat ran fast today and knocked over a cup.
Oh no, is the cup okay?
Yes, but my cat looks very scared now.
Cats get scared of loud sounds.
I gave him some milk to help him feel calm.
That is a nice thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am on this big rock in the water and I do not know where to go.
That sounds scary, but you are safe. Do you see a bright path?
I see a path, but it is very dark and I am afraid to walk it.
Your heart is loud, but trust your eyes. Is the path lit by the moon?
Yes, the moon lights the way, so I think I will walk now.
Good choice, you are brave. Take small steps and enjoy the air.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is walking good for my body?
It helps your heart pump better and keeps your legs strong. Do you have a favorite path to walk on?
Does it help my brain too?
Yes, fresh air and moving make you think more clearly. How long do you usually walk?
I am not sure how far is best.
Start with ten minutes a day to see how you feel. Do your knees hurt if you walk too long?
My legs feel tired sometimes.
That is normal, so rest when you need to stop. Can you try walking on grass?
Will it make me happy?
Many people feel calmer and happier after they move. Do you walk with anyone?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to plant a seed.
That is a nice idea. Do you have a small pot?
Yes, I have a blue pot with soil.
Good. Drop the seed in and cover it with a little more soil.
Should I give it a lot of water?
Just a little, like a drink. Do you know where the sun is?
The sun is right there on the window sill.
Put the pot there. It will grow.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the baby cry so much?
They are hungry or need a clean diaper. Are they smiling right now?
Why is the baby so small?
They are very new and still growing big. Do you like holding them?
Why do they sleep so much?
Sleep helps their brains grow strong. I do not know the exact count.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a paper, but I do not know what to draw.
That is okay. You can start with a simple circle. What do you like to eat?
A circle is not a thing I want to eat.
Ah, maybe you can draw a round cookie. Do you like chocolate?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a box with no lid. It felt warm and hummed softly.
That is very strange. Did you open it?
Yes, and light came out. It looked like star dust.
Wow, that is amazing. What did you do with it?
I put it in a jar to keep it safe.
That is a wise choice. Do you like the color?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the market today and bought some red apples.
That sounds tasty. Did you like the taste?
They were sweet and crunchy. I also saw a big orange dog.
Wow, a dog in the market. Was it friendly?
Yes, it was wagging its tail at the seller.
That is a cute picture. Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I cannot tell a circle from an oval.
That is a hard job. Are you looking at them right now?
Yes, but they both look like blobs to me.
A circle is round on all sides, but an oval is wider than it is tall.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I see the sun safely?
You can use dark glasses, but never look at it directly. Do you have special glasses?
What color is the sun really?
It is mostly white, but it looks yellow from here. Why do you ask about the color?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know how the king moves in chess.
The king moves one step in any direction. Do you have a board to practice on?
I have an old box but no pieces.
You can use stones or buttons for now. Are you ready to set them up?
Yes, I am ready, but I am tired of losing.
Every great player loses at first. Do you want to try one game?
I am not sure if I can win.
Winning is not the main goal, learning is. Shall we start?
Okay, I will move my pawn first.
That is a good start, pawns move forward. How do you feel about it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off trees in the cold?
The tree lets go to save energy for winter. Do you want to learn how to dry leaves?
Yes, I want to learn how to dry leaves.
Press them flat in a heavy book for a week. Do you have a thick book?
I have a big storybook.
That will work well to keep them flat. Is the book dry?
Yes, it is dry and clean.
Then place the leaves between the pages. You are ready to start.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which part of history to pick for my show.
History is a big box of toys. Do you like wars or inventions?
I like machines. But I do not know what to say about them.
That is a good start. Do you like cars or computers?
I like old radios. They look like tiny boats.
That is a lovely choice. You can talk about how they made music travel far.
I will tell the class about radio waves.
Great idea. Good luck with your work.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The fence got scratched by a big cat.
That is not fair. What color was the cat?
It was black. I do not want it back here.
I agree. Can you close the gate?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is very loud today. How can I stop it from waking me up?
You can put a soft cloth over your ears. Do you like sleeping in the dark?
Yes, I like the dark. What else can I do?
You can close your window tight. Does the wind push your door?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the short hand move so slow?
It takes six hours for it to move to the next number. Do you like watching it?
And why is the long hand so fast?
It runs around the whole face in just one hour. That must feel like a race!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the rain is coming and we can't have a picnic in the park.
That is a very bad day for a picnic. Do you like sandwiches?
Yes, I love them, but I do not want to eat them inside.
I am sorry you feel that way. Let us think of a fun way to eat lunch together.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at my new phone. It has bright colors.
Wow, that is so shiny. Do you like the red one best?
Yes, I love the red one. I want to show you.
I would love to see it. Can I hold it for a second?
Sure, here you go. It is very light.
It is so light. Does it have a camera on the back?
Yes, there is a small circle. I took a pic of my dog.
That sounds fun. What color is your dog?
He is brown and white. I want to take more pics.
I am happy for you. I will let you know if I need help later.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I think I broke the puzzle. The last piece will not fit.
Take a breath. Did you check the other corners?
I checked them all. It is too sharp for this spot.
Sharp pieces can be tricky. Do you see a sharp spot nearby?
Yes, I do. But I am so tired of trying.
Taking a break is good. Would you like to rest for five minutes?
Maybe. But I do not want to give up.
I am with you. Let us look at the sharp spot together.
Look! It fits. I did it.
Well done. You solved it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to count to ten right now, please.
I will help you. Are you in a rush?
Yes, go fast.
One, two, three. Do you like numbers?
Just keep going.
Four, five, six. That is half done.
Hurry up.
Seven, eight, nine. Almost there.
What is the last number?
Ten. You did it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost the game again and I feel very bad.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you play for fun or for prizes?
Just for fun, but my friend wins all the time.
That can be hard to take. Chess is a tough game to learn.
Maybe I am just not smart enough to play well.
That is not true at all. Learning takes time and practice.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. The house is a big mess.
That sounds hard. What part is the messiest?
The kitchen floor. There is food everywhere.
You can clean it slowly. Do you have a mop?
Yes, I have a mop. I just want to lie down.
Rest first. Do you want to talk more?
No, please. I need quiet time now.
I understand. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad. I do not know how to fix my big mess.
I am here to help. What is the first thing you want to do?
I need to clean the floor, but it is too big for me.
That sounds hard. Do you have a broom?
No, I do not have one. I feel stuck and lonely.
I can tell. Let us just pick up the big toys first. How does that feel?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I climbed up the big hill today and my legs hurt so bad.
That sounds tiring. Are you sitting down to rest?
Yes, but I saw the top and it looked so far away.
High places can feel very big. Do you want some water?
No, I just feel small looking up at the rocks.
You are brave for trying. Do you love high places?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to eat my peas because they taste weird.
That is normal. Do you like carrots?
Yes, carrots are sweet. I will try to eat one bean.
Good job. That is healthy for you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My boat feels very slow in the water. What should I do?
Check your propeller for any weeds. Do you clean it often?
I did not know about that. It is full of mud.
That mud makes it drag. Removing it will help it move better.
I tried to fix it but the engine will not start. Why is that?
A dead battery is a common cause. Do you check the lights first?
The lights do not turn on at all. Is it broken?
It is likely the battery needs a charge. You can jump-start it with another car.
That sounds like a good plan. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Let me know if it works.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a play today and it made me smile.
That sounds lovely. What did you see?
It was about a cat who learns to fly.
Wow, that is magical. Was the cat happy?
Yes, the cat felt free and brave.
That is a beautiful feeling.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I find a turtle on the beach?
Look near the rocks where the waves hit. Do you like watching animals?
Yes, I do. How do I throw a frisbee?
Hold it flat and push it forward with a snap.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my cup by dropping it. I feel very sad.
I am sorry you are sad. Did it have a special pattern?
Yes, it had little blue flowers on it. Can you help me fix it?
I do not know if you can fix it. Do you have any glue in your house?
No, I do not have any glue. What should I do now?
You can ask an adult for help. Do you want to try that?
Yes, I will ask my mom. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. It is okay to make mistakes.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I fix a broken lighthouse?
That is a very big job. Do you have a team with you?
No, I am alone.
I do not know how to fix it alone. Are you sure you are ready?
Yes, I am very ready.
Start by checking the light bulb. Is the glass clean?
The glass is dirty.
Wash it with warm water. Do you have a soft cloth?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we get presents on birthdays?
To show we are happy you are here. Do you like big gifts?
I do. Why do we eat cake?
It is a sweet treat to share. What flavor is your favorite?
Chocolate. Why do people sing?
It makes the day feel special. Do you sing with them?
Sometimes. Why do we blow out candles?
It is an old wish tradition. Do you make a wish?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know if bees have eyes.
Yes, they have big, shiny eyes. Do you like looking at nature?
I am running late for work.
Okay, hurry safely. Are you going by bus?
No, I am walking.
Walking is good for your heart.
What do ants eat?
They love sweet things and tiny bugs. Do you have ants at home?
I must go now.
Goodbye, have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need lunch. I am late.
Quick salad or sandwich? Do you have time to sit?
Just the sandwich, please. I will eat at my desk.
Here is your sandwich. Enjoy your fast meal.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it sunny outside?
Yes, the sun is warm. How do you feel?
I am happy.
That is good to hear.
Will it rain later?
The sky looks clear. Do you have a plan?
I want to play ball.
That sounds fun.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to leave now. Can I catch a fish in two minutes?
That is too fast for most fish. Do you have a worm?
I have bait. What should I do?
Put the bait on the hook. Do you know which way is up?
I know up. Please tell me the rest.
Cast the line and wait. I do not know if you will catch one.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun hit my desk, so I drank coffee and read a book.
That sounds very cozy. Did you take a rest later?
Yes, I walked in the garden and saw a big blue bird.
A big blue bird is special. What did it look like?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost in this new place. I do not know where to go.
Welcome! Are you hungry, or do you want to look at sights?
I want to see things, but it feels too big. What should I pick?
Start with the park. Do you like trees?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do cows say moo?
Cows moo to talk to other cows. Do you like farm animals?
Yes, I do. Why do pigs have curly tails?
I do not know for sure. It is just how they are born.
Got it. Why do chickens cluck?
Chickens cluck to show they are happy or hungry. Do you have a pet chicken?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we visit family during the holidays?
We go to share a warm meal and tell stories with the people we love. Do you have a favorite holiday dish?
Why do we hang lights on the tree?
The lights make the dark room feel bright and cozy. Do you like to pick the colors?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so hungry. I forgot my lunch box at home.
Oh no, that is tricky. Do you have any cookies in your bag?
Yes, I have two chocolate ones. But I want more than just cookies.
That is a good start. Do you want to share them with a friend?
Maybe later. Can I just have a cracker from the break room?
I do not know what is in the room right now. Go ask the lady there.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: This chair leg is loose and wobbles when I sit. I do not know how to fix it.
You can use some strong glue to stick the wood back together. Is the crack just on the surface?
Yes, it is only a small break. I am still afraid I will make it worse.
Do not worry, take your time. Do you have a hammer in your house?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I broke my favorite cup this morning.
Oh no, that is sad. Are you okay?
I am fine, but I felt bad.
I want to help. Did you say sorry to someone?
I told my mom I was sorry.
That is very kind. Does she help you clean up?
Yes, she cleans the glass with me.
You did a good job. Do you have a new cup?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do some months have thirty days?
I do not know for sure, but I think people long ago wanted a count that fit their lives. Do you like the short months?
Why is February so short?
It is short to keep the year near the time the earth takes to circle the sun. Do you count the days?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My sister shares her toys with me.
That is very kind of her. Does she share all her toys?
Yes, she shares everything.
Wow, that is great. Do you play with her?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I broke my new cup by mistake!
Oh no, that is a big oops. Did you cut yourself?
No, I just spilled all the milk.
That is good you are safe. What will you do now?
I will sweep the floor with my dad.
That is a kind thing to do.
Yes, I feel happy to help.
Good for you for taking care.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream on the grass.
Oh no, that is sad. Did you try to pick it up?
Yes, but it was all mushy and icky.
That sounds unpleasant. Were you angry at the grass?
A little, but then I saw a lady with a spare cone.
How kind of her to help you. Did you say sorry?
I said, "Sorry I made a mess, but thank you for the help."
That was a very nice thing to say.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I forgot what month it is now.
That is a common slip. Do you remember the weather outside?
It is warm and the leaves are green.
That sounds like summer or early fall. Is the sun setting later than usual?
The sun stays up late, yes.
It is likely June, July, or August. Do you like the heat?
I like it, but I feel lost.
It is okay to feel unsure. What is your favorite thing to do in this weather?
I just want to go outside.
Going outside is a great plan. Enjoy the fresh air.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I hold the racket?
Hold it like a handshake. Do you have a favorite hand?
Yes, my right hand.
Good. Put your palm flat on the grip. Does that feel comfortable?
It feels a bit tight.
Loosen your fingers a bit. Keep your grip relaxed.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the blue part water?
Blue is a common color for water on maps. Do you like looking at maps?
Why does the red dot say home?
The red dot marks the center of the map. Is it your house?
Why are the green spots trees?
Green usually shows where trees and plants grow. Do you see any trees nearby?
Why is the line here for a road?
That thin line shows a path for cars and people. Have you walked that road?
Why is the big blue area an ocean?
I do not know for sure, but it looks like a sea. Can you smell salt here?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the post office open so late?
They need to help busy people send mail. Do you have any letters to send?
Why do we put stamps on letters?
The stamp pays the cost to mail it. I do not know why they are shaped like squares.
Why do clerks wear uniforms?
It makes them easy to spot. Do you like their shirts?
Why is the line so long?
Many people are dropping off packages. I do not know why it is so crowded today.
Why do they use big machines?
The machines sort the mail fast. Do you like the loud noise?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing a song.
That is a nice goal. Do you have a favorite song?
Yes, I like this one about a star.
Great choice. It has high notes.
I am afraid I will sound bad.
Everyone makes noise at first. You will get better with time.
How do I keep my voice strong?
Drink water and breathe slow. Do you know how to breathe from your belly?
I think so. I feel my tummy move.
That is perfect. Keep it up.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why is the weather so cold?
Winter is here. Do you like snow?
I must go. Which season comes next?
Spring comes after winter.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no time for small talk, my bus is coming.
I am sorry, I cannot stop time. Do you like winter?
I do not care, I am very late.
That sounds stressful. I do not know how to speed up the bus.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the big hands. It is round o'clock right now.
Wow, that is a full hour. Do you like counting time?
Yes, I do. I check the clock every ten minutes.
That is a good habit. How long is ten minutes?
It is short. I can count to sixty while looking at the red hand.
Sixty seconds is one minute. Can you wait that long?
Yes, I can. It feels like a blink.
Time flies when you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel good today, but I do not know what to do with this feeling.
That is nice. Do you like to walk outside?
I am not sure. My legs feel tired.
Then you can just sit and look at the sky. Do you see any clouds?
Yes, there are white ones. They look like cotton.
I am glad you see them.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I failed again. I want to stop.
It feels bad when things go wrong. What made you want to stop?
I tried really hard and it did not work.
Trying hard is a good thing. Do you remember when it worked before?
Not really. I just feel so tired.
Rest is okay. You can try later. Are you hungry?
Maybe. I am not sure.
Let's sit for a moment.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go, but I feel very sad.
It is okay to feel sad. Do you want to talk?
I am late for work and cannot stop feeling down.
I am sorry you are in a rush. Is there one big thing that hurts?
I lost my job and I feel alone.
That is a heavy weight. Can I sit with you for a moment?
No, I must run, but thank you.
I am here if you need me. Take care of yourself.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a big secret I want to tell you.
That sounds exciting. What is it?
I found a tiny, golden bird in my garden.
Wow, that is a special bird. Where did you find it?
It was sleeping near the old oak tree.
Nature has many surprises.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a nice time at the party today.
That sounds fun. Did you like the food?
Yes, the cake was sweet.
Sweet cake is the best.
I danced with my friends too.
I am glad you had fun.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to count to twenty.
That is a great goal. Do you know how to count to ten?
Yes, I can count to ten very well.
Good for you. Let us start from eleven and go up to twenty.
Okay, I am ready to try now.
Great, just say the numbers out loud.
Eleven, twelve, thirteen... wait, what comes next?
I think the next number is fourteen. Is that right?
I believe so, let us keep going.
You are doing a good job. How far can you get?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How can I learn to sail a boat?
You can take a class to learn the ropes. Do you live near the water?
Yes, I have a small lake nearby. Is that safe for practice?
A lake is a calm place to start. It is much safer than the big sea.
That sounds good. What else should I bring with me?
You should always bring a life jacket. Do you already have one?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a big salad for lunch today.
That is a great start. Did you like the taste of it?
Yes, but I felt very hungry by the evening.
That often happens when we eat too little. What did you have for dinner?
I ate a bowl of warm soup with bread.
That sounds like a very good choice. Did the soup help you feel full?
Yes, my tummy feels happy now.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tell the months. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help. Do you know the names of the days?
I know Sunday and Monday. How do I start with the months?
Start with January. It is the first month.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, a bright red bird is on the branch. I feel so happy to see it.
That is a beautiful sight. Do you know what kind of bird it is?
I think it is a cardinal. Its red color makes my day better.
It is wonderful that you see such joy in nature. What is your favorite time to watch them?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we wash our shirts?
Dirt makes the fabric look bad. Do you like wearing dirty clothes?
No, I do not. Why does the water get so hot?
Heat helps kill tiny germs.
Why does the machine spin so fast?
It pushes the water out to dry the clothes. Do you enjoy spinning?
I do not! How do I know when it is done?
The light will turn off when it is finished.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished a very long plane ride. I am so happy I could fly.
That sounds like a lot of sitting. Did you read a book?
Yes, I read three books. The window seat was perfect.
Three books is quite a few. Do you want to share what they were about?
They were all about spaceships and stars. I felt like I was on a real trip.
That must have felt like magic. I am glad you enjoyed the view.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The horse is eating mud and looks very sad.
That is not good for his tummy. Is he eating his normal food?
No, he pushed the hay away.
Maybe he is hungry for something else. Does he have fresh water?
I gave him water, but he is still eating dirt.
I do not know why he does that. Has a vet seen him lately?
No, we have never taken him to one.
You should call a vet today. Is he moving and playing?
He is just lying down near the fence.
Please call for help right now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel blue today. I want to learn to draw cats.
I am sorry you feel low. A simple circle and two triangles make a face. Do you have paper?
Yes, I have some paper. I just feel so tired inside.
Rest is good for your heart. Try drawing one leg first. How are your hands feeling?
My hands shake a bit. I think I gave up.
You can rest when you are tired. It is okay to stop for now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared of the big red light.
That light stops us so we do not hit the car in front. Are your hands on the wheel?
Yes, but my feet are too small for the pedals.
Your teacher will put a little step for you. Do you like looking out the window?
I think I can do it now.
You will do great.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at that big blue river! I am so happy.
It looks very pretty and calm. Why are you feeling so happy today?
The sun is shining right on the water.
That makes the water sparkle. Do you like to play in the water?
Yes, I love jumping into it.
Jumping is lots of fun. I do not know how deep it is there.
The water is just right for wading.
Wading is a nice way to cool off. What is your favorite thing to see in the water?
I love seeing the small fish swim by.
Fish are very cute to watch. It is good to share your joy with me.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I learn to swim?
Start in shallow water where your feet can touch the bottom. Do you feel safe in deep water?
I am afraid of getting wet.
That is okay. Just keep your face above the line. Do you like to splash?
Yes, I like to play.
Good. Playing helps you get used to the water.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the big, heavy drops falling down. I love the rain so much today.
It does sound very nice. Do you like the sound of it too?
Yes, it makes a soft tapping sound on the roof. My little sister is watching the puddles outside.
That sounds like a lovely view. Is she making a splash?
Yes, she is jumping in them very happily. I feel so calm and glad right now.
I am glad you are feeling well. Rain can be very sweet and quiet.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I don't know what to do next.
It feels hard right now. What worries you most?
I am scared I will fail again.
Fear is a common feeling. Have you tried just one small step?
I don't know how to start.
I do not have a magic fix. Do you have a tiny goal?
I just want to be done.
Taking one small step is a win.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors. The blue light scatters around more than the other colors. Do you see the blue even at night?
I do not see blue at night.
That is because it is too dark to see the light. The stars are just tiny balls of light far away. Do you like looking up?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie a knot.
That is a great idea. Do you have a rope?
Yes, I have a long, thick rope.
Good. Hold one end in your left hand.
Okay, I am holding it tight.
Now make a loop with the other end. Is the rope long enough?
It is very long.
Great. Cross the end over the loop and pull it tight.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel warm and happy inside. Why does this happen?
That feeling is called pride. It shows you did a good job. Do you like how you feel?
I did well on my test. I feel strong.
That is a true and good feeling. It helps you grow. What was the hardest part for you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love apples. How do I pick a sweet one?
Tap the side. If it sounds dull, it is ripe. Do you like red or green ones?
I like the red ones. How do I cut them into slices?
Wash it first. Cut it in half, then in four. Do you have a sharp knife?
Yes, I have a knife. Is it safe for me?
Hold the fruit tight. Cut slowly with a guide. Have you done this before?
I have tried. I always get the skin on. How do I stop that?
Peel it with a peeler first. Cut only the flesh. Do you like the taste of the skin?
I do not. The skin is too hard. How do I keep the meat from browning?
Put them in lemon water. It keeps them bright. Do you like lemons?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a big tree in the park. Do trees feel happy?
That is a sweet thought. I am not sure if they feel happy, but I know they need sun and water to grow. Do you like climbing on the low branches?
Yes, I did climb a little bit. Do trees talk to each other?
They do send signals through their roots under the ground. It is like a secret message. Do you think the leaves dance when the wind blows?
They do look like they are dancing. Can I hug a tree?
Yes, you can hug any tree you like. It is a nice way to say thank you. Do you have a favorite tree that is special to you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a paper boat. Can you show me how?
Sure, fold the paper in half first. Do you have any paper handy?
Yes, I have a sheet. What is the next step?
Fold the top corners down to the center line.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I told Sam I would play with him, but I am too tired. What should I do?
It is hard to be tired and keep a promise. Are you very sleepy right now?
Yes, my eyes hurt. I do not know if I can go.
You could rest for a short time and then try.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did you get the dates wrong?
I read the page too fast. Did you notice it right away?
Yes, I saw it at once.
I am sorry for the error. Do you have the right dates?
I do have them here.
Great, I will fix it now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad about the meeting. It was too long and boring.
That sounds really hard. Did you get any new ideas?
No, just a lot of noise. I feel tired now.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk more?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the end of the tale right now.
It is a happy end. Do you like happy ends?
Yes, but I am late.
You will be fine. I did not check the last page.
Thank you, I must go.
Go well. Will you read it later?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a secret. What should I do?
Tell a friend you trust. Do they know?
No, but they might. Is that bad?
Not if they care for you.
I feel glad. Thank you.
You are welcome. How do you feel now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am not sure what is good for me to eat.
Try fruits and vegetables. Do you like sweet or sour things?
I like sweet things like candy, but I heard that is bad.
Candy is tasty but not healthy. Do you like apples?
Yes, I love apples.
Apples are very good for you. You can eat them every day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a happy secret to tell you. It is about a puppy.
That sounds very nice. Is the puppy friendly?
Yes, he wags his tail all day long. I love him so much.
You seem very happy about it. I do not know who the puppy is, though.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to ride my bike to the park today.
That sounds like fun. Did you make it all the way?
No, my chain fell off near the corner.
Oh no. Did you fix it yourself?
My dad had to help me put it back on.
He is a good helper. Do you ride often?
Yes, I love riding in the sunshine.
Sunshine feels warm on your skin. Is it sunny there now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a bird stuck in the bush. What should I do?
That sounds scary for you and the bird. Is the bird still moving?
It is moving, but it is shaking.
Shaking means it is scared, not hurt. Do you have a gentle hand?
Yes, I do. Should I take it out?
Carefully, yes. The bush may be hurting its wings. Does it look tired?
It looks very tired. My hand is a little shaky.
That is okay. Take your time to help it. Are you close to open space?
Yes, there is a wide path nearby.
Good. Gently move it to the path so it can fly free.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My legs hurt so bad from running. I do not want to go again.
That sounds really hard. Do you feel tired too?
Yes, my whole body is tired. It is not fun at all.
Rest is very important. How long did you run?
I tried to run for ten minutes. I could only do two.
Two minutes is a good start. Are you drinking some water now?
I am sitting down. I am just mad at the track.
It is okay to be mad. Did you stretch your legs before starting?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I can not fall asleep.
Do you feel tired? Try to breathe slow.
I do not know what to do.
Can you put the lights off? Let us check that first.
Yes, it is dark now.
Do you have a warm blanket? Think of a calm place.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does bread get big and fluffy?
Warmth makes the tiny things inside grow. Do you like warm bread?
Yes, but why do we add salt?
Salt stops the sweet taste from getting too strong. Is it too sweet for you?
No, not too sweet. Why does the crust turn brown?
Heat changes the sugar on the skin. Do you like crunchy crusts?
I do. Why do we wait for it to cool?
Heat moves around to make the inside soft. Do you let it rest?
I always forget. Why does it taste better later?
Time lets the taste mix into one. Do you share with friends?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the library today. I found a big book about whales.
That sounds like a fun adventure. Did you read it all?
I read only two pages. The whales swim in the dark water.
Dark waters can be scary for little ones. Do you like the whales?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My head hurts a lot.
I am sorry to hear that. Are you thirsty?
Yes, I want water.
Drink some water slowly. Do you feel tired?
I feel very sleepy.
Please go lie down now.
Okay, I will sleep.
Rest well and get better.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn a new language, but I do not know where to start.
Start with a few simple words you use every day. Do you have a favorite food?
I am still lost. I feel too busy for big lessons.
Just practice five words a day, and that is enough. Are you afraid of making mistakes?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I need to go.
Take a breath. Is the road clear?
Yes, but my heart hurts.
Feelings are not bad. Do you want to try again?
I do not know how.
You can start with one small step.
Okay. One step.
Good. How does that feel?
It feels okay.
That is all you need.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Help me pack my bag.
Let us do this fast. What do you need first?
Just my keys and my coat.
Got them. Are you taking the bus or walking?
I am running out the door.
Safe travels then.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My cat keeps knocking things off the table. Why does he do that?
Cats like to see what falls. Is he hungry?
He just ate. I do not get it.
He may just be bored. Have you played with him today?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see a circle and a square. Which one has corners?
The square has four corners. Do you have any other shapes to look at?
I think the circle is round. Is that true?
Yes, circles are always round. It is nice to see you learning about them.
But the square looks boxy. What is a boxy shape called?
That is a great way to say it. A boxy shape is usually a cube or a square.
I want to draw something. Can you help me start?
I am glad to help. What do you want to draw first?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Tell me what to do now.
Please breathe in slowly. What is the one thing you must do first?
I must go to work fast.
That is a good goal. Can you walk quickly?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why is the light off?
That is a breaker. Do you see a red switch?
I see it, but my bag is heavy.
Press the big button. Is it on now?
It is on. Thank you so much.
Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my chair making a funny noise?
It might be loose. Is the seat wobbly?
Yes, it moves a lot when I sit down.
The screws may need tightening. Do you have a tool?
I have a screwdriver. Why does it get loose?
Time makes them slip. Do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel very sad, but I must go.
I am sorry you feel that way. Are you eating well?
Yes, I ate a sandwich.
Good for you. Please breathe slow.
I have to run now.
Take care. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike, but I am afraid.
That is brave of you to try. Do you have your helmet on?
Yes, I am wearing it, but I am still scared of falling.
Falling helps you learn how to stay up. Would you like me to hold the seat?
Yes, please, I am ready to go.
Great, let us start slow. How does that feel for now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go. I am late.
The park is right there. Do you like the trees?
I am running. It is not safe.
Please look where you step. Is your bag heavy?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost. Please help me find my way home.
Do not worry. I will help you. Is there a big park nearby?
Yes, I just passed one.
Go back to the park and look for a road sign. That will guide you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my train. Where is the platform?
The train to the city is on platform two. Is that the one you need?
Yes, it is. Can I catch it?
It leaves in five minutes. You should run now.
I have my ticket. Is this the right one?
I cannot see the paper from here. Please check the destination name.
It says City. I am happy.
Great. Enjoy your ride. Do you have a heavy bag?
No, it is light. I am ready.
Good luck on your trip. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I float on my back?
That is easy. Do you like to breathe slowly?
I like to breathe, but I get scared.
Relax your body and look at the sky.
Can you show me the arm moves?
I cannot show you from here. Do you have a pool nearby?
No, but I have a bathtub.
Great. Kick your legs like a frog.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with my old friend’s books.
That is a hard choice. Did you read them together?
Yes, we read many of them. Now they are just paper.
I am sorry about that. Do you want to keep them?
I want to, but my home is full. I cannot fit them.
I do not know the right way. Do you have other friends?
A few, but not like him. I feel alone.
You are not alone. Do you want to give some away?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am so tired, but I do not know what to do.
Try to sit in a quiet spot for a bit. Do you like the sound of rain?
I do not want to sit, I just want the tired feeling to stop.
Drink some cold water and eat a small snack. Have you eaten today?
I have not eaten all day, so I will go find a piece of bread.
That is a very good choice for you. I hope the bread helps.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the goal so big?
It gives players a fair chance to score. Do you like shooting?
Why do they run so fast?
They want to win the ball back quickly. Do you run fast too?
Why are there two teams?
One team plays against the other. Do you have a favorite?
Why do fans shout?
I do not know for sure, but it feels loud.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My opponent moved my queen. I want to quit.
That is not how chess works. You do not move the other player's pieces. Do you know how to take a piece?
I think so. Do I just put it on the board?
No, you take it off and put it on your side. Do you want to try again?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My boss helps me when I am lost. What should I do?
Say thank you to her. Does she like small gifts?
I am not sure what to give her.
A warm drink is a safe choice. Do you know if she takes tea or coffee?
I think she loves tea. That is good advice.
You are lucky to have such a kind leader. I hope you have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The street is so quiet, I love it.
That sounds very peaceful. Do you hear any birds?
Yes, the birds are singing up high.
That must feel very free. Are you sitting or standing?
I am just standing still.
Being still is good for your body. Do you see any trees?
I see big green leaves moving.
The wind must be gentle there. Is it a happy day?
It is the best day I have had.
I am glad you feel that way.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I passed my driving test today! I am so happy.
That is great news. How did it feel when you finished?
It felt like flying. I did not hit anything.
You did a great job. Did you get your license right away?
Yes, I got the card. I want to drive home now.
That sounds fun. Drive safely on your way home.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up at seven. The sun was bright. I ate toast with jam.
That sounds tasty. What time did you eat?
I finished at eight. Then I walked to the park. The birds were singing.
The birds sing in the morning. Did you see any ducks?
Yes, I saw two ducks. I left the park at ten. It was then I felt sleepy.
Ten is a good time for a rest. Are you tired now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just painted my first tree.
Wow, that sounds like a big step. What color did you use for the leaves?
I used bright green for the leaves.
Green is a happy color. Do you plan to paint a whole forest next?
Yes, I want to paint a big green forest.
That would make a very lovely picture.
I am so happy with my new art.
It is great to see you so happy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I miss the bus because I do not know how to tell time.
I am sorry you missed the bus. Do you want to learn how to read a clock?
Yes, but it is too hard. The little hand and big hand confuse me.
That is a good question. The little hand tells you the hour, and the big hand tells you the minutes.
But what if the big hand is on five? I never know what to do then.
Oh, that is tricky. Do you know that five minutes is also one fifth of an hour?
I think I am smarter than that. Can you just tell me what time it is right now?
I do not have a clock to check the time. But I can help you practice with a picture.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count things?
Counting helps us know how much we have. Do you like counting your toys?
I like it, but why is five bigger than four?
Five is bigger because it has one more. Do you want to count five apples?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to say sorry well.
First, look at the person and say I am sorry. Do you know what you did wrong?
I broke a glass cup by mistake.
That is a good start. Say you will be careful next time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The wind is so loud. Is it safe to play outside?
It is not safe right now. Are you happy to stay inside?
I have no toys left. What can I do?
You can read a book. Do you like picture books?
I like rain sounds. Do they help me sleep?
Yes, many people sleep well with rain. Good luck resting.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water moving?
The wind makes it move. Do you feel the breeze?
Why are there so many boats here?
People use them to travel. Do you like boats?
Why do the ships look so big?
They carry lots of goods. I do not know why they are that color.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the magnet stick to the fridge?
It likes metal things. Do you have a toy magnet?
Yes, I do. Why does it only pull some things?
It pulls on special metals like iron. Are those the only ones?
What else does it pull on?
Steel and nickel. I do not know all the metals.
Why can it lift a paper clip?
The force is strong enough. Can you lift it high?
Yes, I can. Why does it not stick to wood?
Wood is not a metal. Is that clear now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck in my story.
What is the trouble?
I do not know what happens next.
That is okay. Do you like the hero?
Yes, I do.
Good. Maybe he finds a friend?
That sounds fun.
Yes. Does he trust the friend?
I think so.
Great. Let them walk together.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My teacher gave me a star.
That is very nice. Did you feel happy?
Yes, I felt very happy.
I am glad for you. Do you like stars?
My teacher is my favorite person.
It is good to have a kind teacher.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red cat near the old well today.
That sounds quite odd. What was the cat doing?
It was just sitting there and purring very loudly.
A loud purr is always a good sign. Did you feed it?
I gave it a piece of bread, and it looked very happy.
You did a kind thing.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake cookies.
That is a fun idea. Do you have an oven at home?
Yes, but I do not know where to start.
I do not know your exact recipe, but you need flour, sugar, and butter. Do you like chocolate chips?
I love them. Can you tell me the next step?
You mix the ingredients into a dough. Now you are ready to bake.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My friend looks very sad today. What should I do?
You can sit next to them and listen. Do you know why they are sad?
I do not know. They just stopped talking.
That is okay. Offer them a snack or a warm hug. Sometimes people need quiet time.
Should I tell a teacher?
Tell a teacher if you are worried about their safety. Do you feel safe right now?
Yes, I feel safe. I will just stay close to my friend.
That is a kind choice. Be patient with them.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired and my head hurts from the loud noise.
That is very hard. Do you like the quiet parks?
The crowds push me everywhere and I cannot think.
City life can be too much.
I just need some space to breathe for a bit.
Fresh air helps. Did you bring a water bottle?
Everything is so fast and I feel small here.
It is okay to take a break.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot find the red boat in the toy shop. I am very sad.
I am sorry you are sad. Do you remember where you saw it last?
I do not know. I just want to play with it now.
That is not true for me, I do not know where it is. Let us look under the shelves.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a bird feeder?
Cut a pine cone and mix in seeds. Do you have any pine cones?
I do. Can you help me put it together?
Dip the cone in glue, then roll it in seeds. Are you ready to try?
Yes, I am ready.
Hang it in a tree near you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know if I should climb the tall hill.
Climbing can be fun, but it is hard. Do you like walking for a long time?
I am afraid I will get very tired.
That is a good thing to think about. Resting when you are tired helps you go further.
I will try, but I will stop if I am too tired.
That is a wise choice. Have a good day on the mountain.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I read until very late and feel tired the next day.
What time do you usually stop reading?
I never know the right time to put the book away.
Try setting a timer for one hour to help you stop.
Will a timer really help me sleep better?
Yes, it gives your brain a clear signal to rest.
That sounds like a good plan for tonight.
Do you usually read in bed or at a desk?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I can't find the rest of the colors. The sky is gray now.
The sun hid behind a cloud. Do you see the mist?
I do. But my heart feels sad.
Rainbows pop up after rain. Did you watch the water drip?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we eat cake on birthdays?
It is a sweet treat to make you feel special. Do you like chocolate?
Why do friends give gifts?
It shows they care about you. What is your favorite gift?
Why do we sing songs?
It brings everyone together to celebrate. I do not know who wrote the first one.
Why is my day so important?
Because you are a great friend. Thank you for asking me.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because I found a shiny coin.
That sounds very fun. What does the coin look like?
It is old and brown. I want to keep it forever.
You are lucky to find it. Do you have a special place to put it?
Yes, I put it in my pocket. It feels good to hold.
Good for you. I am glad you feel happy.
I am glad too. I love my little treasure.
I think that is a sweet thought.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a great time at the beach last week.
That sounds fun. Did you build a big sand castle?
Yes, I built the tallest one there.
I am happy you had so much joy. Did you bring any toys?
I brought a bucket and a shovel.
Those are useful tools. Do you miss the sound of the waves?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! The lights just turned on in my room.
That sounds like a great thing. Do you like the bright light?
Yes, I do! It feels warm and nice.
I am glad you are having a good time. I do not know why the power came back so fast, though.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My screen is dark. It will not turn on.
Did you press the big button on the back? Is it plugged into the wall?
I do not know where to look. It feels broken.
Check if the little light on the plug is on. Do you see any light at all?
I found it. The light is on.
That is good news. Try pressing the power button again.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel nervous about my party tomorrow.
Take a deep breath. It will be a good day. Who is coming?
All my friends are coming.
That is very nice. Do you have a plan for games?
I am not sure what we will play.
You could play tag in the yard.
That sounds like fun.
I think so too. What will you eat?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was so hot today. My tomato plants are turning red.
That sounds nice. Are you happy about the red fruit?
Yes, I am. I want to eat them soon.
Yum. Do you plan to make a soup?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at the big white flakes falling from the sky.
Yes, it is snowing today. Do you like making a snowman?
Yes, I want to build one with three buttons for eyes.
That sounds like a fun idea. Can you find some sticks for arms?
I have cold fingers, so I can not push the snow hard.
Put on your thick gloves right now. It is safe to play outside.
The snow feels cold on my nose, but I do not mind.
Your face looks red and happy. Do you want a warm drink after we play?
Yes, please, I would love some hot cocoa.
I will go get it for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the water salty?
I do not know for sure. Do you like salt?
Yes, I do. What lives under the water?
Many fish swim there. Do you see any today?
No, I do not. How deep is the water?
Very deep in some spots. Are you cold?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a plain bagel, fast. I am very late.
Here is your bagel. Are you running to work?
Yes, I have no time to talk.
You can pay at the door. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I keep my back safe when I sit at my desk?
Sit tall and rest your feet flat on the floor. Do you have a chair that holds your back well?
My chair is very hard. What else can I do?
Put a soft cushion behind your back for help. Do you take breaks to walk around?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found an old coin on the street today.
That is a lucky find! Did it look shiny or dirty?
It was very rusty and heavy in my hand.
Rusty coins are often old. I do not know its exact age.
My grandpa said it might be from a long time ago.
He may be right. Do you have a coin book to check?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
It is quiet because no cars are driving. Do you like the peace?
Yes, I do. Why is it so empty?
The shops are closed for the night. Is that strange to you?
A little. Why are there no people outside?
It is late, so everyone is inside. Are you waiting for someone?
No, just me. Why do the lights stay on?
The lamps stay on so nobody gets lost. That feels safe.
It does. Why does the air smell sweet?
I do not know why it smells sweet. Is it a good smell?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a big pile of shiny buttons today.
That is so fun. What color is your favorite one?
I love the blue ones because they look like water.
They must look very nice. Do you want to use them on a shirt?
Yes, I will stitch them onto my old coat.
That sounds like a great idea. How many buttons did you find in total?
I counted forty of them.
You found so many. I am glad you are so happy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am mad. My coffee is too hot.
Ouch. That feels bad. Do you want to wait a bit?
No, I want it cold now.
You can add some ice. What do you like in your tea?
I hate tea. It tastes like leaves.
I understand. But tea is not coffee. Are you just tired?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike, but I am afraid to fall.
Falling is part of learning, and I am here to help. Do you have your helmet ready?
Yes, I have my helmet on, but I still feel wobbly.
That is normal, and you are doing great. What makes you feel the most scared?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go to a small island. What should I pack?
Bring water and snacks. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I love the ocean. Is it safe to swim there?
I do not know for sure. Check the signs first.
I will look for signs. What else is important?
Bring a hat for the sun. Do you have one?
Yes, I have a big hat. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Have a nice trip.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse in the park today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did it have a long tail?
Yes, it was very long and it moved when the horse ran.
That is a nice picture in my mind. Do you like horses?
I love them because they are big and strong.
You are right, they are very powerful animals. Do they have soft hair?
Yes, its hair was soft and felt nice when I touched it.
That must have felt very good. I am glad you had a happy day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do bees make honey?
They save it as food for the winter. Do you know if bears like it?
Yes, I love honey too. How do they make it?
They mix flower nectar with their own body juices. It takes a long time to dry.
That is hard work. Why do they do that?
They must eat to survive the cold months. Do you wonder how it tastes?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I keep missing the ball.
That sounds really frustrating. Did you miss it today or yesterday?
Today. My hands are shaking.
Your hands shake when you are upset. That is a normal thing for your body to do.
But I want to win the game.
Winning is hard when you are angry. Do you want to take a short rest?
Maybe. I just feel like a mess.
You are not a mess. You are just learning a hard skill.
Can I hit one more ball?
Yes, you can try again. I am here if you need me.
Thanks. I will try again.
Good luck. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the waves are too big to play in.
That sounds tough. Do you like jumping in the smaller water?
I tried, but my feet hurt from the sand.
Ouch. Is the sand rough or hot?
I just want to make a castle before the sun goes down.
You can still build a small one. Would a bucket help?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to see the moon clearly. How do I do that?
You need a telescope. Do you have one at home?
No, I do not have a telescope. What else can I use?
Binoculars work well for beginners.
I have binoculars. How do I use them to see the moon?
Look up and point them slowly. Is the night dark for you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am worried about Grandpa.
Why do you feel that way?
He looks very tired today.
Rest helps him feel better. Did he drink some water?
Yes, he drank a lot.
Good. Let him sleep for now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I got up before the sun rose.
That is very early. Did you eat breakfast?
I had some warm milk and bread.
That sounds nice and cozy.
Then I walked to the park by the river.
The river is beautiful in the morning. Did you see any ducks?
I saw two gray ones splashing in the water.
What lovely neighbors.
I sat on the grass and watched them for a long time.
It must have been very quiet. How did you feel?
I felt happy and calm until it started to rain.
Oh no, did you get wet?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park for my birthday.
That sounds like fun. Did you see any dogs there?
Yes, a big brown one chased my balloon.
Oh no. Did you get the balloon back?
Yes, the dog just sat down and looked at me.
That is sweet. Did you feed it a snack?
I gave it a piece of cheese from my sandwich.
A clever trade. How did you feel after that?
I felt happy and a bit hungry.
You should eat your cake then. Was it chocolate?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am late for school and I do not know what to do.
Do you have your lunchbox with you?
I think I left it on the table.
That is a problem, but let us keep moving. What is the main thing you need right now?
I just need to get to class before the bell rings.
Run to the bus stop if you can. Are you close to the stop?
No, I am still on my way there.
Then you must run faster. Do you know how far away the bus is?
I do not know. I am very scared.
It is okay to feel scared, but do not stop walking. You will figure it out.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is waiting so hard?
It feels long because we want things now. Do you have something waiting for?
Yes, I am waiting for my lunch.
Lunch sounds good. Are you hungry?
I am very hungry.
Try to think of happy things. It helps the time go by.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look! A blue bird is in our tree today.
That is a lovely sight. Do you know what kind of bird it is?
I am just so happy to see it jumping around.
Your joy is sweet to see. It is nice when nature brings us peace.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad and scared about tomorrow.
I am sorry you feel that way. What is the thing you fear the most?
I might fail the big test at school.
That sounds hard. Have you studied for it?
Yes, but my head feels empty.
It is okay to feel this. Take a slow, deep breath with me.
I still feel a bit worried inside.
I believe you can do well. Let's go get a warm drink to calm down.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am tired. The baby will not stop crying.
That sounds hard. Did he eat?
I do not know why he cries. I am very sad.
It is okay to feel sad. Can I hold him?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel so tired today. Why is my job so hard?
Work can be tiring because it takes much of your mind and body. Do you have enough time to rest?
I barely sit down before the next task comes. How do people keep their strength?
I do not know what helps every person, but small breaks can help a lot. Do you drink water during the day?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people go to the post office?
They go there to send letters to friends. Do you have any letters to send?
That is nice. Why do they use such big boxes sometimes?
The big boxes hold things that are too big for envelopes. Is your package big?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake a cake for my birthday.
That is a fun goal. What flavor do you like best?
I love chocolate, but I am not sure how to mix the batter.
You just mix the dry things first, then add the wet ones. Do you have a big bowl?
Yes, I have a big bowl and a spoon.
Great. Stir the mix until it looks smooth. Is your kitchen clean?
Yes, it is very clean and ready for me to start.
Good. Just follow the recipe and take your time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad. The wind is too loud and everything is wet.
I am sorry you feel that way. The storm sounds scary. Do you have a warm blanket?
Yes, I have a big red one. But I still feel small and cold inside.
That is a tough feeling. Wrapping up tight helps. Do you want to listen to rain on the roof?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I do not know how to pack my bag for a trip.
Start with your big clothes at the bottom. Do you have heavy shoes?
Yes, I have two heavy boots. Where do they go?
Put them on top of the clothes so they do not crush your shirts. Are you bringing any food?
I have a sandwich and some fruit.
Pack your food last so it stays fresh. Do you have a water bottle?
No, I forgot it. Should I get one?
Yes, get a bottle right before you close the bag. Is your bag almost full?
It feels very heavy now. Did I do it right?
You did a good job packing. Are you excited for your trip?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My head hurts so bad. I have to run now.
Drink some water. Is it a bad pain?
I cannot stay to talk. Bye.
Hope you feel well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do I save my coins?
Put them in a jar on your shelf. Do you have a nice jar?
Yes, I do! What else can I do?
Try not to buy candy every day. Is that hard for you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My boat sank in the pool.
Oh no, that is very sad. Did it have a hole?
Yes, a small tear in the side.
I do not know how to fix it. Was it a hard ride?
It tipped over and broke.
I am sorry you are upset. Do you want to make a new one?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. I do not know what to do.
Drink some water and rest. Did you sleep well last night?
I drank water, but it still hurts. I am confused.
Try lying down in a dark room.
That might help. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Let me know if it gets better.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I have a sandwich but no bread. How do I make it tasty?
Try adding some lettuce and tomato. Do you like sweet or salty things?
I like salty. What else can I add?
Some cheese is great. I do not know if you have any there. Do you have a knife?
Yes, I have a knife.
Cut the cheese thin. That makes it taste better.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no time to sleep well.
Try dimming the lights early. Do you use a screen at night?
Yes, I watch shows.
Put it away an hour before bed. That helps.
That sounds too hard.
Start with just a few minutes first. Can you try that?
Maybe I will.
Good for you. A little rest is enough to start.
Thanks. I am leaving now.
Go get some sleep.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How does the internet work?
It is like a giant web of pipes carrying letters. Do you like sending pictures?
Yes, I send photos to my friends.
That is fun. The pipes travel fast under the ocean. What is your favorite thing to watch?
I like watching dogs play.
Dogs are very cute. I do not know if they are on the internet. Do you have a dog?
