No, but my neighbor has one.
That is nice. The internet helps us see far away things. Do you play games on it?
Yes, I play a block game.
That sounds great. You build with the blocks. Do you build tall towers?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to sit still for so long?
The plane is a big tube that moves fast. Do you like the window seat?
Why is the floor of the plane tilted?
That is not true. The floor is flat. Are you tired?
Why is my head feeling funny?
You have been sitting for a long time. Do you want some water?
Why can I not stand up?
Standing up might fall on people. Are you hungry?
Why are the lights so dim?
Low lights help you rest. Do you see the clouds?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: What are you eating today?
I have a sandwich with cheese and tomato. Do you like cheese?
I do, but why is it yellow?
The cheese maker adds a safe dye to it. Is your food hot?
Yes, it is. But why does it steam?
The heat turns the water into tiny air bits. Can you smell it?
I can smell it well. Why is it good?
My nose tells my brain it is yummy. What is in your lunch?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it true that the ball is round?
Yes, it is round. Do you like to kick it?
I like to kick it hard. Who invented this game?
Many people helped start it long ago. Do you play with friends?
My friends play too. Is it fun to watch on TV?
It can be very fun. Do you have a favorite team?
I do not have one yet. What should I pick?
Pick the one you like the best. Have fun watching.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How many fingers are on my hands?
You have ten fingers. Are they all free?
Yes. How do I count them fast?
Say one for each hand. Do you have a watch?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sky is so big and I feel small.
It is okay to feel small. What do you want to see?
I do not know. I just want to be happy.
Happy is a good thing. Do you like the moon?
The moon looks like a face looking at me.
That is a nice way to see it. Does it make you feel warm?
A little warm, yes. The stars are my friends.
Friends are very nice. Do you talk to them?
I talk to the bright ones. They listen.
That is sweet. You have a good heart.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost in the story of my play.
Is the main character scared?
Yes, the mouse is very afraid of the cat.
That makes sense. Try making the mouse run faster to show fear.
I do not know how to end the story happily.
I can suggest a helper mouse, but does the cat have a friend?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am very tired. I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a good goal. Are you sitting down?
Yes, I am sitting on the floor. How do I start?
Make a cross with the two laces. Do you know how to do that?
I crossed them. Now what happens?
Loop one lace over the other like a bunny ear. Pull tight when you are done.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do stars blink?
They do not really blink. The air moves around us. Do you like looking up?
Yes, they look far away. Why are they so far?
They are very, very far away. We can only see the big ones.
Is there a star near us?
Yes, our sun is a star. It is close enough for us to see it in the day.
Can we go to the stars?
We can fly to some stars. It takes a long time. Do you like flying?
I would like to see them close.
That is a nice dream.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Can you tell me how to set the time on a clock?
Yes, just turn the two little hands to the right time. Do you know how to tell the difference between the short and long hand?
I think the short one is for the hours, but I am not sure about the rest.
That is right, the short hand shows the hour and the long one shows the minutes. Do you like counting by five?
I like counting, but I do not know how to use the small numbers around the edge.
Those numbers tell you the minutes, so you can know when things happen. Do you have a favorite time of day?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. I lost my coin at the market.
I am sorry you lost it. Do you remember where you last had it?
I think I had it by the fruit cart. The orange smell was nice.
That is a good place to look. Was the vendor there?
Yes, but he says he did not see it. I feel so bad now.
It is hard to feel that way. Let us go back and look again together.
I hope we find it. The apples there taste very sweet.
I hope so too. Do you have enough money for a different apple?
No, I do not. I really wanted that special apple.
I know. Let us check the ground near the stand first.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see a lot of bright dots in the dark sky.
Those are stars, not just dots. Do you know which one is the brightest?
No, I do not. How do I find the biggest one?
Look for the one that glows the most. Can you see any moving lights?
Some of them move slowly across the sky.
That might be a plane, not a star. Does it blink or just move?
It blinks sometimes, then stops moving.
If it stops, it is a star. Do you want to count them?
Yes, please help me count the stars.
Count the ones you can see clearly. Can you name your favorite one?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My fish is sleeping on the bottom. Is it sick?
It may just be resting, but I am not sure. Is it eating its food?
It did not eat today. Should I worry?
Please change some of the water now. Is the tank very dirty?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my book on the island and I feel so sad.
That sounds very upsetting. Did you look near the big tree?
I checked the tree but my dog ran off too.
Your dog might be close by. Do you hear him barking?
I do not hear him, only the wind.
The wind can hide small sounds. Let us check the sandy beach next.
I do not want to walk on the wet sand.
Sand is nice and cool. Do you like the smell of salt?
It is nice, but my feet hurt.
I am sorry your feet hurt. Can we rest for a moment?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are we late?
The bus was very slow. Are you hungry?
I am not hungry.
That is good. I do not know why the bus was slow.
Is the door open?
Yes, the door is open. Is the class over?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My little blue boat broke its mast. I am so sad.
I am sorry your boat broke. Did it have a sail?
Yes, but now the sail is torn.
You can fix the sail with glue. Do you have some at home?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I promised to keep my room clean for a week. Do I really have to do it?
Yes, you must keep your word. Are you feeling tired?
I am. Is it bad if I just do it today and not every day?
That is not true. You must do it each day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a new friend at school?
You can say hello to someone who sits nearby. Do you have a favorite person in your class?
Not really, but I want to try.
Start with a simple smile and a hello. Is your new friend interested in books or games?
They like to play ball outside.
Great, ask if they want to join you at recess.
Will they say yes?
I do not know for sure, but a smile helps a lot.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My phone screen is black. What should I do?
Try holding the power button down. Is it cold to the touch?
I tried that, but it stays dark.
That means the battery may be empty. Have you seen a charger nearby?
I do not have one right here.
I do not know your specific model. Do you hear any sound when you press it?
No, it is totally silent.
It is likely dead. Take it to a shop to check.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am putting my toys in the bag today.
That is a good job. Are you going on a trip?
Yes, we are going to the beach with my family.
Oh, the sand and sea sound fun. Do you have your hat?
I forgot my hat at home this morning.
You can just ask your mom for one. Does she have a spare?
She does, and I am putting it in now.
Great, you are all set then. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I took the bus today and saw a big yellow sun.
That sounds very nice. Did the bus stop at your house?
Yes, and I waved to a kind driver.
How sweet that is. What color was the bus?
It was bright red and shiny.
That is a lovely color. Do you ride it often?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the light turn on when I flip the switch?
Electricity flows through the wires to the bulb. Do you like bright lights or dark ones?
I like bright lights for reading.
That is a great use for power.
Where does the electricity come from?
It comes from big plants far away. Do you know how a car gets gas?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to swim, but I do not know how to start.
That is a big step. Do you like water?
I like it, but I am scared of the deep part.
Start with the shallow end first. Can you kick your legs for a minute?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did the bear eat the blueberry?
It was very hungry. Do you like berries?
Why was the bear walking in the night?
It wanted to see the moon. Is the moon bright tonight?
Why did the bear stop at the river?
It wanted to wash its paws. Do you have clean hands?
Why did the bear go to sleep?
It was very tired. Goodnight.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I do not like working from home.
That feels hard. Do you miss your friends?
Yes, I am lonely. Why do people do it?
It saves time on trips. Is your house quiet?
It is quiet. But I feel lost. What is good?
You can rest more. Do you cook at home?
No, I forget to eat. I will try soon.
Good idea.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The wind is so loud today. I do not like it.
That sounds scary. Do you want to close the window?
It feels like my house is shaking. I am not happy.
I am sorry you feel that way. Is the door shut tight?
Yes, but I still feel cold and sad.
I know cold can make us feel low. Do you have a warm blanket?
It is just too much wind. It makes me tired.
I agree wind can be tiring. Would you like to sit near me?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many players are on a team?
There are eleven players on the field. Do you like the big ones?
The big ones in the middle?
Yes, they are often very strong. I do not know which one you mean.
The ones who run fast.
That sounds like a forward. Do they kick the ball?
Yes, they kick it to the goal.
Kicking into the goal is fun. Do you try to kick it high?
I try to make it go far.
That is a great goal. Do you have a favorite team?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the post office open on Sunday?
It is open to help you. Are you sending a letter?
Why do we need a stamp on the mail?
The stamp pays the fee. Do you know how much it costs?
Why is the line so long today?
I do not know for sure. Are you in a hurry?
Why do we wait in line?
We wait for our turn. Do you have a package?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I hold the racket?
Grip it like a handshake. Do you play with your right hand?
Yes, I do.
Great, keep your thumb on top. How does the weight feel?
It feels light.
That is good. Just aim for the middle of the ball.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to visit the lighthouse. How do I get there?
You can walk a short path to the top. Do you like to climb?
Yes, I love climbing. Is the top safe?
Yes, there are strong walls to keep you safe. How high is it?
I do not know. Can I see the sea from there?
You can see the whole blue sea. Do you like boats?
I love boats. Does the light stay on at night?
Yes, the light turns on when it gets dark. Is it cold up there?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with this math work.
That is hard. What is the first part asking you to find?
It wants me to count the dots in these circles.
Nice. Have you tried counting them out loud?
I tried, but I keep getting a different number.
You should draw lines through the dots as you count. This helps keep track.
Oh, that makes sense. Thank you for the tip.
You are welcome. Good luck with the rest.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My throat hurts a lot.
That sounds nasty. Do you have a fever?
I am not hot, but I feel very tired.
Rest is the best cure. Have you tried warm tea?
I do not like hot drinks.
Try honey in water instead.
Will the go away soon?
Colds take time to go away. Are you drinking enough water?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am lost, but I am so happy!
That is nice! Why are you happy?
I found a very cute dog.
Oh, a cute dog! Is the dog friendly?
Yes, he wags his tail a lot.
That is great to hear.
I will follow him home.
Good luck with that!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make bread. How do I start?
Mix flour, water, and yeast in a bowl. Do you have a big bowl?
Yes, I do. What do I do next?
Let the mix sit for an hour to grow. Are you patient?
I am patient. How do I finish it?
Put the bread in a hot oven until it smells good. Do you love the smell of warm bread?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know how to drive now. I am in a big rush.
You must practice slowly first. Do you have a teacher with you?
I have no teacher. Can you just tell me the rules?
I do not know all the local rules. Are you tired from looking?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found the red dot on my map today.
That sounds like a good find. What is at the red dot?
It is the park where I walked my dog.
A walk in the park is nice. Did you see any birds?
Yes, I saw a big blue one.
A blue bird is special. I do not know its name.
I think it was a kingfisher.
That is a lovely story to end the day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I fixed my chair! It does not wobble.
That is great news. Are you very proud of yourself?
Yes, I am so glad. I want to tell everyone.
Tell your family first. Is the wood strong now?
The wood is very strong. It feels safe.
Good, safety comes first. Did you use any tools?
I used a big hammer. It was hard work.
Well done. You did a great job.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am so tired. My brain feels like mush. I want to learn how to fix a broken pencil.
That sounds really tough. Do you have a sharpener nearby?
Yes, I do. But I am afraid of cutting my finger. How do I do it safe?
Hold the pencil with both hands and push it in slowly. Are your hands steady?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we mix blue and yellow to make green?
Because the colors join to make a new one. Do you like green?
Yes, I do. How do I make it darker?
Add a tiny bit of black or white. Do you have those colors?
I do. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun with your painting.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a bug on my desk. What should I do?
Take it outside in a cup and turn the cup over on the ground. Is it a big bug?
It is small and black. I do not know its name.
That is not a problem. Let it go free near a plant.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why are mountains so tall?
They grow up from the ground over a very long time. Do you like to climb things?
What makes them so hard to climb?
The sides are steep and the air is thin up there. Do you have strong legs?
Are they the tallest things on Earth?
Yes, they are much taller than most buildings. Do you want to see a picture?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke the eggs into the wrong bowl. Now I have no eggs for dinner.
That is quite messy. Did you get yolk on the counter?
Yes, it is all over the floor. I feel so bad.
Do not worry about it. We can buy more eggs later.
But the store is far away. I just want to eat.
I do not know if they are open. How much money do you have?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work. Do robots eat?
No, they do not eat food. Do they have feelings?
I do not know. I need to go now.
They cannot feel love. Is your bus here?
Yes, it is here. Bye.
Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn to sing, but my voice sounds funny.
Your voice is just getting used to the song. Do you like the sound of birds?
Yes, I like birds. They sound so happy.
Birds have a nice, happy sound too. Try humming along with them.
I tried that. It made my tummy tickle.
A tickle means you are feeling it. That is good.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a dog in the park today.
That is a nice thing. Did the dog look happy?
It was chasing a red ball.
Dogs like to chase. Was the ball big?
It rolled under a bench.
That sounds tricky. Did you find it?
I asked a man for help.
He was kind. How did you feel?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love singing! I want to sing a song for you.
That sounds fun. Do you have a favorite song?
Yes, I like to sing about the sun. It is warm and bright.
A warm song fits a warm day.
I want my voice to be loud and clear like the sun.
Great goal. Do you practice every day?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is my birthday today?
Yes, it is. How old are you turning?
I am five. What do you want?
Nothing, just a smile.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very tired but I cannot sleep.
Do you take a warm bath before bed?
I only drink water sometimes.
That helps your body relax. Do you keep your room dark?
The lights are always on.
Turn them off to help you rest.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My bike wobbles a lot. What should I do?
Try holding the handlebars steady. Do you ride fast?
I ride slow, but it still tilts.
Slow is good for balance. How long have you ridden?
Just a few weeks.
Keep practicing on a flat spot. Are your tires full?
I think they are soft.
Pump them up with a tool. Do you have one?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I started my first job today. It was a scary place.
That is very normal to feel scared. Did you have a nice boss?
Yes, my boss was very kind. She smiled at me a lot.
That is a good sign. What did you do all day?
I stacked boxes on shelves. My arms were very tired.
Sounds like hard work. Do you want to go back tomorrow?
Yes, I think I did a good job. I felt proud.
I am happy for you. That is a great start.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a red boat with a hole in its side.
That is very sad. Was the boat very old?
Yes, it looked tired. I tried to push it to the dock.
That is a hard job. Did you help push it?
I pushed, but my arms hurt. I sat on the wet sand.
Your arms are strong. Did the boat make it to dry land?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sky is so bright with stars today.
That is a wonderful thing to see. Do you like the big ones?
I do, but I love the small ones too.
They are all part of the same home. Do you know why they shine?
I think they shine to help us see.
That is a sweet idea, though I do not know the real reason. Do you feel calm under them?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad I learned how bees make honey today.
That is great news. Do you know which flowers they visit?
Yes, I saw them on the orange blossoms outside.
Those flowers give sweet nectar. Do you want to try making some at home?
I cannot, but I love sharing this fun fact.
Sharing is a wonderful thing. How does it make you feel?
It makes me feel warm and happy inside.
Your joy sounds very nice. Do you have any other questions?
Not right now, I just want to tell everyone.
That is a lovely idea to share.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I ran here fast and still made it on time.
That is great! Why are you smiling so much?
I got a big red apple from the market. It looks so sweet.
An apple sounds yummy. Do you like red ones best?
Yes, I do. I want to share half with you.
I think you should eat it all to feel happy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love working from home today.
That sounds very nice. How is your desk set up?
It is very tidy and bright.
A clear mind needs a clear space. Do you like your new chair?
Yes, it is soft and lets me focus.
Comfort helps you work well. What is your main task today?
I am writing a simple report.
Writing takes good focus. Do you take short breaks?
Yes, I walk outside often.
Fresh air is very good for you. You seem very happy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do new words feel so hard?
Your brain is making new paths. Do you like growing?
Yes, but it takes so much time.
Slow growth is strong. Are you patient?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to draw a rainbow.
That is a fun idea. Do you have red crayons?
Yes, I have many colors.
Great. Start with red on top. What color comes next?
I think it is orange.
You are right. Keep going down. Can you hold the paper still?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see white on the ground.
Is that snow? Do you like snow?
Yes, it is snow. But I do not know what to do.
You can go outside and look. Do you have warm boots?
I have boots. But my hands are cold.
Put on your mittens. I do not know where the gloves are.
Oh, my gloves are right here.
Good. Now you can play. Are you ready to start?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go in the park.
That feels hard. Do you want to see the ducks?
Maybe, but the path looks very long.
We can sit on a bench nearby. Is that okay?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do I count to ten?
Start with one and add one more each time. Do you know what comes after one?
I think two comes next.
That is right, you are doing well. Can you say the number five?
Five!
Yes, that is correct. What number comes right after five?
Six.
You are so smart, keep going.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not hear any cars on this street.
It is very quiet here. Do you like the silence?
Yes, it feels very peaceful.
That is a nice feeling.
Why is it so empty?
I do not know for sure. Maybe it is early morning?
The sun is just coming up.
Ah, then the shops are still closed.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my soup hot?
Because you put it on the fire. Is it burning?
Why do we wash the food?
To keep the germs away. Do you have soap?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired. I tried to read a book today.
That sounds like hard work. Did the book have a lot of words?
Yes, it was very long. Then I had to walk to the park.
Walking makes your legs work hard. Do you want a rest now?
Yes, I am very tired. I just want to lie down.
Lying down is good for you. I hope you sleep well.
Thank you. I feel better just talking.
I am happy to hear that.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to buy flowers for my wedding.
Roses are a nice choice. Do you like red or white?
I think red is too loud for me.
White lilies are calm and sweet. Do you have a garden at home?
No, I do not have a yard.
That is okay. We can buy them from a shop. Do you like the smell of lilies?
I think I like how they look.
You can choose the color you like best. Are you sure you want white?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do I learn to sing?
Start with your favorite song. Do you have a song you love?
Yes, I like this one. Why should I start there?
It makes practice fun. Do you feel happy when you listen to it?
Yes, it makes me smile. What should I do next?
Breathe deep and hum the tune. Does your throat feel tight?
No, it feels loose. That feels good.
That is the right feeling. Do you want to try a slow song?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn to sing, but I do not know where to start.
Try humming a happy tune you know. Do you have a favorite song?
I am afraid my voice will sound bad.
Everyone sounds strange at first, so just listen to a song and copy it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we wash clothes?
Dirt makes clothes smell bad. Do you like clean shirts?
Yes, they smell nice.
Soap helps pull the dirt out. Do you know how to turn the machine on?
I just press the button.
That is a good start.
Does cold water hurt the clothes?
Cold water is safe for most clothes. Do you have white shirts?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I walked for one hour today and I feel so good.
That is a great thing to do. Did you enjoy the fresh air?
Yes, the birds were singing and the sun was warm.
Nature is a nice part of walking. Do you plan to walk again?
I think I will go every day if I can.
Daily walking helps your heart work better.
My legs feel a bit tired but I am happy.
It is normal to feel tired at first. How did you feel after?
I felt strong and full of energy.
That is the best part. It feels good to help your body.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a tiny blue beetle on my desk this morning.
That is a cool find! Did it move?
It crawled right over my math book and hid.
Haha, I bet it was hiding from you. Was it scared?
I think so, so I put it outside in the grass.
Good job, it needed fresh air. Do you like bugs?
Yes, I think they are very small and busy.
That is a true thing! They work hard.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a new baby and I am scared.
It is normal to feel scared. What worries you most?
I do not know how to wash him.
Use warm water and mild soap. Be very gentle with his skin.
He cries a lot. What should I do?
Check if he is hungry or dirty. Try to hold him close.
I do not sleep well at night.
Try to rest when he sleeps.
Thank you for helping me.
You are doing a good job. How is he doing now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The city is so loud and fast. I feel lost in all the noise.
That is a hard feeling. Do you like the bright lights at night?
I love the lights, but the crowds make me tired.
Try walking in the park to rest. Have you eaten lunch yet?
I forgot to eat because I was rushing everywhere.
Please stop and eat some fruit.
Where can I find a quiet place to sit?
I do not know the specific spots. Is there a bench near you?
Yes, there is one right by the small garden.
That is a good plan for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My chair leg is loose. How do I fix it?
Try tightening the screws with a tool. Do you have a screwdriver?
Yes, I do. The back is also wobbly.
You can add a little glue to the joint. Is the wood cracked?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my phone hot?
It gets warm from working hard. Do you play games a lot?
Yes, I play games.
That makes the battery hot. You can rest it for a while.
Will it break?
No, it will not break. Does it feel very hot?
It feels warm, not burning.
Then it is safe. Enjoy your phone.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn a new language. What should I do first?
Start with the most basic words you use every day. Do you know why you want to learn it?
I want to talk to people when I travel. How can I practice speaking without getting scared?
Talk to yourself in the new language when you are alone. That is a safe way to start.
That sounds good. What if I make mistakes?
Mistakes are how your brain learns new things. Keep going, do not stop.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go to a small island. Where should I look?
Is the island close or far away? I like places with calm water.
It is far away. I like warm sun.
Try the tropics. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I love the sea. I need a safe spot.
Look for a friendly village. Do you like quiet?
Yes, quiet is best. I want to rest.
I do not know the exact name of the place. Pick a small spot with a nice view.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished my picture of the sun.
That looks so bright and happy. Did you use yellow or orange?
I used lots of warm colors together.
Oh, that must look very cozy.
I want to give it to my mom.
She will love the surprise.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My chair wobbles when I sit on it. Can you help?
I can help you fix it. Is it made of wood or plastic?
It is made of wood and the leg feels loose.
You need to tighten the screws. Do you have a screwdriver?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my phone beep?
It is a sound that tells you something happened. Do you see a new picture?
Yes, I see a cat.
That is a nice picture of a cat. Is the cat sleeping?
The cat is eating.
That is a good sign for the cat. How much food is in its bowl?
I do not know.
I do not know how much food is in the bowl either. Can you see the bowl?
The bowl is full.
A full bowl is great news.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I hit a great ball today.
That sounds fun. Do you like the sound of the racket?
Yes, it makes a loud pop.
Cool. Do you have a favorite player?
I like the one with the red shirt.
Nice choice. Do you play alone or with friends?
I play with my dad sometimes.
That is sweet. Is it hard to get the ball over?
It takes a lot of practice.
Well done. You are working hard.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see many cakes here, but I do not know which one to buy.
That is a fun choice. Do you like sweet or sour food?
I think I like sweet, but I am not sure what I want to eat.
Sweet is a good pick. Would you like a round cake or a square one?
I guess a round cake sounds nice, but I am still a bit lost.
A round cake is great. Do you want a cold drink with it?
Yes, I think I will take the round cake and a cold drink.
That is a smart plan. Enjoy your tasty meal.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I love this song. It makes me feel happy.
That is a wonderful feeling. What makes it so fun?
The drums go boom boom. They are loud and fast.
Loud drums do wake up the heart. Do you dance when you hear them?
Yes, I jump around the room. My cat gets scared.
Oh no, a startle for the cat. Does the song have words you like?
It says "fly high". I like that part the most.
"Fly high" is a sweet wish. Do you look up at the sky?
I do, but I stay on the ground. I am just a kid.
The ground is a good place to start. Who made this song?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I dreamt I was falling and woke up scared. How do I stop having bad dreams?
That feels awful. Do you eat a lot before bed?
I usually have a big snack right before sleep. Is that bad?
Yes, heavy food can make dreams feel wild. Try a light snack instead.
What if I still feel scared after waking up?
Take three slow breaths. Do you keep a light on?
Yes, I always sleep with the lights on. Does that help?
Light can help, but a dark room helps you rest better. Try dimming it soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I stayed up late playing games and felt very tired today. I fell asleep right after lunch.
That is a long nap. Do you feel rested now?
I feel heavy and my eyes hurt from the screen. I need to sleep again soon.
Rest is good for your body. Have you eaten a snack yet?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to write a letter to my grandma.
That is a sweet idea. What do you want to say in it?
I want to tell her I miss her.
That makes her very happy. Should you draw a picture too?
I think I will draw a flower.
A flower is a lovely choice. Do you know her address?
Yes, it is on the fridge.
Great, you are ready. Have fun writing!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling. Why does that happen?
It often happens because your mind is busy sorting out your day. Did you feel safe in bed after waking up?
Yes, I did feel safe. Does my brain dream to fix bad feelings?
Some say yes, but we do not know for sure. Do you want to talk more about it?
Not right now. I think I will go back to sleep.
That sounds like a good plan. Sleep well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does my dough get so big and puffy?
The tiny bugs in the food eat sugar and let out gas. Do you use yeast in your mix?
Yes, I do. But it smells a bit sharp.
That is normal. The gas bubbles stretch the dough. Is your kitchen warm?
It is quite cozy here. The bread looks ready.
Great! It needs to cool a bit before you eat it. Do you like hot bread or cold?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am at the stop, but I do not know which bus to take.
Do you have a ticket?
Yes, I have one, but the lines are long.
Check the sign for your stop, then join the back of the line.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late, I need to finish my math homework now.
You can do it! Do you like adding or taking away?
I hate it. Is there a quick way to solve this big problem?
Not really, but you can break it into small parts.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw the water move up and down. Why does it do that?
The wind pushes the water, making waves. Do you like to splash in them?
No, I just watch the fish swim by. Are they happy?
I do not know if they feel joy, but they play too. Do you have a favorite fish?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a man who looks just like my best friend from preschool.
That sounds really special. Did you say hello to him?
I was too shy, but I hope he still likes me.
Being shy is okay. Do you remember what his favorite toy was?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the top of the hill today.
That sounds like a big walk. Did you see any animals up there?
I saw a big brown bear sleeping in the sun.
Wow, that is very lucky. Did it wake up?
No, it just snored and kept sleeping.
A snoring bear is a funny picture. Do you like sleeping bears?
Yes, I think they look very peaceful.
Peace is a good thing to see. Was the air cold at the top?
It was cool and quiet there.
Quiet places are nice for thinking. Do you want to go back tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I save more money for a bike?
Try putting spare coins in a jar. Do you have a jar at home?
I have a box of old toys I can sell. How do I sell them?
You can ask your family to take them to a garage sale.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My teacher gave me a big hug today. It felt so warm and happy.
That sounds lovely. Did the hug make your day better?
Yes, my smile has not stopped since. I want to tell everyone.
Sharing good feelings is a great idea. Who is your next friend?
I plan to tell my best friend at lunch. It feels good to share.
That is a kind thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue boat on the lake today.
That is a nice boat. Was it moving fast?
It was going very slow through the water.
Slows boats are peaceful. Did you sit near it?
I stood by the fence and watched it pass.
You had a good view. The sun must have shone on it.
Yes, the water sparkled bright and clear.
What a lovely day for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to send a letter to my grandma, but the line is very long.
That can be tiring. Do you have a picture inside the letter?
Yes, I drew her a big red house. How long does the mail truck take?
It usually takes two days. Do you help your family with chores?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to play right now, no time for rules.
Okay, let us start. Do you like Hearts or Rummy?
Just deal me the cards, please.
Here you go. Are you playing against me?
No, I am playing against the wall.
That is a strange game. Good luck, then.
Thanks, I am leaving.
See you soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My math page is so hard.
That feels tricky. What problem are you stuck on?
I do not know how to count the coins.
Let us look at the picture together. Do you see the big circle?
Yes, it is a quarter.
Good eye. Let us add them up step by step.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I can not find my book. I feel sad.
I am sorry. Do you know what color it is?
It is blue. I lost it.
Let us look together. Is it on the shelf?
No. It is not there.
I do not see it. Did you read it at home?
Yes. I left it here.
I will check the desk. Is it okay if I wait?
Yes. Thank you.
I found it. It was under the table.
Oh no. I feel better now.
Happy to help. Do you want a different chair?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad. The train was late and I lost my toy.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you know where you left it?
I think I left it on the seat. The train is very slow today.
That is frustrating. Are you eating a snack to feel better?
No, I do not want food. I just want my toy back.
I understand your feelings. Did you tell the driver about it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so confused. I can never remember the right order.
That is a hard thing to learn. Do you start with Monday?
I think Monday comes first, but then I get lost.
You are right, Monday is first. What is the day after Friday?
Is it Saturday? I am not sure.
Yes, it is Saturday. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I missed my old friend so much today.
That feels very sad to miss someone. Did you try to call them?
I did not call. I am too shy.
You can just send a small note. Do you remember their new place?
I only have their old number. It sounds wrong.
It may have changed, but you can try to find it. Is that hard for you?
It feels like a big task.
Take one small step first. You will be fine.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the church in the center of the village?
Yes, it stands on the main square. Do you like old stone buildings?
I think they look very heavy and cold.
They are warm inside. Do you want to visit the bakery next?
The smell of bread sounds nice.
It is always fresh there. I do not know if they have cookies.
That is good enough for me.
Then let us go together.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It is so hot today. The sun is very bright.
That sounds warm. Did you drink some water?
Yes, I drank a lot. Then I ate a big ice cream.
That must taste nice.
It was sweet and cold. Then I went to the pool.
You had a fun day. Did you swim?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to see the big blue water.
That sounds fun. Do you like sand?
I do not know what I should do.
You can swim or just look. Are you scared?
I think the waves are too big.
You can stand far away then. Is it windy?
I just want to sit and feel calm.
That is a good choice. Do you have a towel?
Yes, I have one.
Then go sit and rest.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my friend's cup. How do I say sorry?
Just look at them and say you feel bad for the break. Did you mean to do it?
No, I tripped and it slipped from my hands.
That is an accident, so do not blame yourself. Do you still want to fix it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very worried about making bread.
Taking one small step at a time can help calm you down. Do you have the ingredients ready?
Yes, I have the flour and yeast.
That is a great start. Would you like to learn how to mix them first?
Yes, please tell me what to do next.
Add warm water to the yeast first and wait for it to bubble. Have you tried using warm water before?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes, but I always forget the days of the week.
You can practice on the easy days like Monday and Tuesday. Do you like the color of your shoes?
Yes, I like them. So I should practice on Monday, then Tuesday, and so on?
That is a good plan to remember the order. Are you sure you have two shoes?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to draw the moon.
That is a fun idea. Do you like to use pencils?
Yes, I have a big book and a pencil.
First, draw a big circle. Is your paper big enough?
Yes, it is a big sheet.
Great. Now, draw small craters inside the circle. Do you know what craters look like?
Are they little holes?
Yes, they look like tiny dots or bowls. Do you have some dots ready?
I drew the dots and the circle.
Well done. You made a nice moon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Help me plan my day.
Okay. What is the one thing you must finish first?
I must pack my bag. I will get there by ten.
Good. Do you have your keys?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to plant a tree. How do I start?
Dig a hole twice as wide as the root ball. Do you have a shovel?
Yes, I do. What do I do next?
Put the tree in and add soil around it. Are your hands clean?
Yes, they are. How much water does it need?
Water it well when you plant it, then only if the soil is dry. Do you like rainy days?
I do. How can I tell if the tree is happy?
Look for new green leaves in spring. Do you know what season it is?
It is summer. What else should I know?
I do not know your specific tree type, so check a guide. Do you have a phone?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is very bright and warm today. I am so happy.
That sounds like a lovely day. Do you like the sun?
Yes, I do. I think it is the best day ever.
I am glad you are having fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My cat is hiding under the bed and will not come out.
That sounds scary for him. Is he eating?
No, he dropped his bowl and ran.
That is a big change. What is your cat’s name?
He just seems very sad and quiet.
You can sit near the bed and wait quietly. Is he purring?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I really like that book about the red fox.
I like it too. The end was very sweet. Do you want to read it again?
I forgot what the fox found in the tree.
It found a warm nest. I am glad you remembered the color. What did you like most?
I liked when the little mouse made a friend.
That is a nice part. I do not know the rest of the story. Is it happy or sad?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: This street feels so quiet and empty to me. Do you know why?
I don't know for sure. Is it quiet all day?
Yes, it is. I feel a bit lonely here. What should I do?
Bring a good book. Do you like to read?
I like stories. Do you have a favorite one?
I don't read, but I think that sounds nice.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. The house is still messy and I do not know where to start.
That is a lot of work. Would you like to just pick up the socks first?
I tried that, but now I see all the dust on the shelves. I want to cry.
Dust is tricky to see. Do you have a duster nearby?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a very tall mountain at the park.
That is amazing. Do mountains feel cold to you?
Yes, the wind was icy on my face.
The high places are often windy. Do you like being cold?
Not really, I want to go home now.
Going home for a warm drink sounds nice.
Thank you, I feel better already.
I am glad you feel good.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a red circle on the floor. Why is it round?
Circles are always round by design. Do you like the color red?
Yes, I do. What shape has four equal sides?
That is a square or a rhombus. Do you have one with you?
No, just the circle. Thanks for helping me see.
You are welcome. It was fun talking about shapes.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a red fish swim very fast today.
That sounds exciting. Did it hit the glass?
No, it just turned around near the plants.
Good. Do you have any other fish in that tank?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to bake a cake for my mom.
That is a sweet idea. What flavor do you like best?
I like chocolate, but I have no idea where to start.
Do you have an oven at home?
Yes, I do have a small oven.
Great, I can give you a simple recipe. Do you like reading long lists?
No, I prefer short steps.
I will keep my tips brief and clear.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired today. The screen is too bright.
That sounds hard. Do you have a window to look out?
Yes, but I keep forgetting to look. My job is hard.
I am sorry you feel that way. It is okay to rest.
I will try to stand up now.
That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to write a letter right now, but my hands are shaking.
Take a slow breath to calm your hands. Is it for a friend?
Yes, but I forgot what I wanted to say in the letter.
Start by saying how you feel about the good times. Do you want to thank them for something?
That is a great idea, thank you, I am going to start writing now.
You will do a fine job. Good luck with your writing.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like the loud songs but I feel too happy. Can you help me pick a calmer song?
Try some piano music, it is soft and nice. Do you like to listen while you draw?
Yes, I love drawing. What kind of calm music should I choose?
Try slow violins, they sound very peaceful. Do you prefer music with words or without?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Where can I buy fresh apples today?
The red stand over there has them. Do you like sweet or sour ones?
I want the sweet ones.
The red ones are the sweetest. Are you making a pie?
No, I just want to eat them.
That is a healthy choice. Take care of yourself.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate too many cookies today. I feel a bit sick.
That can happen. Do you want to drink some water?
Yes, I will. I also want to eat some fruit.
Good plan. Fruits are sweet and good for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people like to sleep outside?
They love the fresh air. Do you like fresh air?
Why do we bring a tent?
It keeps the rain off you. Does it rain a lot where you live?
Why do we make a small fire?
It gives us warm light. I do not know why some people put food on it.
Why do we pack our bags at night?
To keep bugs away. Do you see bugs near you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are we waiting?
We wait so things get ready for us. Do you like being ready?
Does it take long?
I do not know exactly. Do you feel tired?
Why is it so slow?
Slow time feels longer than fast time. Do you want a snack?
Are we almost done?
I hope we are close. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make pasta, but I have no recipe.
Boil water, add salt, then cook the noodles. What sauce do you like?
I like red sauce, but my tomatoes are soft.
Soft tomatoes are fine for a quick sauce. Do you have any cheese?
Yes, I have cheese and some basil leaves.
Melt the cheese in the pan and stir in the basil at the end.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I wash the baby's face?
Use a soft cloth with warm water. Do you have a gentle soap?
Yes, I do.
Just wipe gently and rinse well. Is the baby happy?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no time. Why do mountains look so sharp?
Wind and ice cut them over long years. Do you like the cold?
I do not wait for weather. Do mountains ever move?
Yes, they creep very slowly. Is that safe for you?
I must go now. What is on top of the highest mountain?
Usually snow and rock sit there.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count with one hand?
One hand has five fingers. Do you like thumbs?
Yes, I do. But why do we start at one?
We need a start to know how many. Do you count toes too?
Sometimes. Why are there not six fingers?
I do not know for sure. It may be for holding.
That makes sense. Why do we stop at ten?
Ten is a big group. Do you like ten?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy fruit today.
What kind do you like best?
I like red ones.
Apples are good. Do you want sweet or sour?
Sweet, please.
Strawberries are sweet. Pick the red ones.
Are they expensive?
I do not know. Look at the signs.
Okay, I will check.
Good luck. Do you need help finding them?
No, I am good.
Great. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so mad because the dog barked and ruined my quiet time.
That sounds very frustrating. Did the dog stop after a while?
Yes, it did stop, but now the wind is too loud for me.
Wind can be tricky. Do you have a fan to make a steady sound?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need help moving my box, but I am running late.
I will help you. Is it heavy?
Yes, it is very heavy. Please lift it.
Here you go. Do you want me to carry it?
No, I have the keys now. I am on my way.
Good luck. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a robot. How do I start?
First, get some boxes and glue. What color do you want your robot to be?
I chose blue. Where do I put the brain?
Put a small light on top for the eyes. Do you have any buttons to make it talk?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I promised my friend I would play, but I do not want to go.
That is a hard choice. Do you know why you made the promise?
I felt sorry because he had no one else to play with.
Keeping your word helps build trust. Are you ready to tell him the truth?
I am scared he will be angry.
Honesty is always best, even if it feels scary.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have flour and water, but I am not sure what to do next.
Mix the water into the flour gently. Do you have yeast?
I do not know what yeast is.
Yeast makes the bread grow big and fluffy. Is your house warm or cold right now?
It is very warm today.
That is good for the bread to grow. Put a cloth over the bowl.
How long do I leave it?
Wait about an hour until it doubles in size. Do you have a timer?
I have a clock on the wall.
Watch the clock for one hour. Then you can make it into a loaf.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Where is the best spot to buy fresh fruit?
The big wooden stall on the left has sweet apples. Do you like sweet or sour fruit?
I like sweet. Is the market closed yet?
No, it stays open until the sun goes down. Do you want to buy anything else?
I am thinking about bread. Is there a baker nearby?
Yes, the smell of bread comes from the corner. Do you like soft or crunchy bread?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the train move?
The engine pulls it with strong power. Do you like riding on it?
Why is the track straight?
A straight path helps it go fast and safe.
Why do we stop here?
I do not know the plan, but soon we will move again.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My tomatoes are brown and soft. I feel very sad about this.
That is a hard feeling to have. Did you water them too much?
I gave them lots of water every day. Now I do not know what to do.
I do not know your exact soil type, but less water might help. Do you see worms in the dirt?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn Spanish fast for a trip tomorrow. I have no time.
That is a big goal. Do you speak a little Spanish already?
No, I only know hello and goodbye. I am very stressed.
Hello is a great start. You will do fine with kindness.
Can you teach me food words? I will be hungry there.
Bread is pan. Water is agua. Do you like bread?
I do not know about the rest. I must go now.
Good luck on your trip. Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I tried to build my tower but it fell down. I want to stop.
I am sorry your tower fell. It is okay to feel sad. Do you want to try one more time?
Maybe. I do not know if I can do it right.
You can do a good job if you take your time. What part is hard for you?
The little blocks keep rolling away.
I do not know what color blocks you have. Do you have a big block to start with?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to write a letter, but I am lost.
Start with a hello and say why you are writing. Do you know who you are writing to?
Yes, it is for my friend. What should I say next?
Tell them how you feel and what you did this week. Is she doing fun things?
Yes, she plays games. How do I end the letter?
Say good things and sign your name. Do you like saying goodbye in a special way?
I just say bye for now. Is that okay?
Yes, that is a kind and true way to end it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost and I do not know where to go.
That feels bad. Do you see a big sign nearby?
I see a tree, but I am not sure if I went the wrong way.
Let us wait here for a safe minute. Are you feeling safe?
I just want to find my home again.
We will look for clues together. Do you know the name of your street?
I know my house is red, but I forgot the name.
We will find a kind person to help us. Do you have a phone?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do neighbors wave at each other?
They wave to say hello and show they are friendly. Do you like to wave too?
Why do they sometimes argue about the fence?
They might disagree on where the line should be. I do not know which side is right.
Why do they share cookies?
Sharing makes friends feel happy and warm. Are you a good friend to your neighbors?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I am so late. Why did this happen?
The road was wet and the car moved slow. Did you sleep well?
I slept fine. What else caused it?
We hit a long red light. It was very long. Did you eat breakfast?
Yes, I did. How long was the light?
It held us for two full minutes. That felt long. Was your bag packed?
It was packed tight. Can you go faster now?
I am driving as safe as I can. Safety comes first. Do you like this drive?
It is slow but okay. Thank you for telling me.
I am happy to help. Let us soon arrive.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I cut the wood today but it is too long.
That is tricky. How high do you want the walls?
I tried to lift the roof but it fell on my foot.
Ouch, I am sorry. Did you use the ladder?
Yes, but my hands were wet and slippery.
That is dangerous. Do you have dry gloves?
I am thinking about giving up because it is hard.
You are doing well. What part feels too hard?
I just want a simple place for my tools.
Simple is good. What color do you want the paint?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very tired and hungry. I spent all day fixing a broken bike.
That is hard work. What do you want to eat?
I would like a big bowl of soup and some bread.
That sounds warm and good. Do you want anything else?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not want to write this letter. It feels too hard and my hand hurts.
I am sorry it feels hard. Do you want to start with just one word?
I want to tell them I am mad, but I am scared they will get mad back.
That is a very true feeling. Would you like to write a softer word first?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My friend looks very sad today. What should I do?
Just sit next to him and listen. How long has he been sad?
I do not know, he has been quiet all week.
That is a long time to be unhappy. Do you know why he is quiet?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My legs hurt so bad from the race.
Ouch, that sounds tough. Did you push hard today?
Yes, I wanted to win but I fell.
Falling is scary and sad. Are your knees okay?
My knee is bleeding a bit.
I am sorry it hurts. Do you have a bandage ready?
I think so, in my bag.
Good. Resting helps you heal.
I do not want to run again.
It is okay to take a break.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sand so hot?
The sun makes it warm and dry. Do you like playing in it?
I like it a little.
It feels like a warm blanket. Do you bring a hat to stay cool?
Yes, I wear a big hat.
That is a very good idea. What is your favorite part of the beach?
I love looking at the waves.
The waves are always changing. Do you count how many times they crash?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to set up my tent.
Pick a spot that is flat and dry. Do you see any big rocks nearby?
Yes, there are rocks and a stream.
Stay away from the water and rocks. Do you have a map with you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went swimming at the pool today.
That sounds like so much fun. Did you jump off the board?
I just waded in the shallow part because my feet hurt.
I am sorry your feet hurt. Do you want some bubble gum to make you smile?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the ball yellow?
It helps you see it against the grass. Do you like bright colors?
Why do players change sides?
Sun and wind change, so it stays fair. Do you play outside?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to bake bread now, but I am very late.
Do you have all your tools ready?
I think so, but the kitchen is a mess.
Clear the counter first, then mix the dough.
What if the bread is not good?
It will be okay, do you trust me?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because it is raining so hard.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like wet weather?
No, I want to go outside and play.
That sounds fun. Is the rain letting up?
No, the sky is still very dark.
I hope it clears soon. Would you like to read a book?
Yes, I guess I will get a book.
That is a good idea. I am glad you feel better.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel so tired today.
That feels rough. Have you eaten lunch yet?
No, I just want to sleep.
Sleep helps, but food gives energy too. Did you drink any water?
Yes, I had a big glass.
Good choice. Maybe a small snack first?
Can I just take a nap then?
A short nap can help a lot.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I started my first job today. I wore a tie and felt very big.
That is a big step. Did the tie make you feel confident?
Yes, but I dropped my papers on the floor. My boss just smiled and helped me pick them up.
What a kind boss. How did you feel after that?
I felt warm inside and much less scared. I think I can do this.
That is great news. You should be proud of yourself.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today! Look at the bright blue sky.
That is a lovely color. Do you know why it is blue?
I think it is magic! I love looking up at it.
It is not magic, but light. Have you seen a rainbow?
Yes, I saw one last week! It was so pretty.
Rainbows come from light bending in drops. Would you like to know more about the sky?
Please tell me! I want to understand it.
The air spreads blue light out for us. Isn't that nice?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My cat is not eating. What should I do?
Is she drinking water? That is a good sign.
She is sleeping a lot and feels warm.
A warm body might mean she has a fever. You should call a vet today.
I am scared for her. Will she be okay?
I do not know for sure, but vet care helps. Do you have a vet nearby?
Yes, my neighbor has one. I will go now.
That is the right step. Good luck to you and your cat.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so tired and late.
That sounds rough. Did you eat?
No time for food.
Your body needs fuel. Is it bad news?
Just too much work.
I am sorry. Go rest now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I put the puzzle together?
Start by finding the corner pieces with flat edges. Do you like doing puzzles?
Yes, I do. What do I do after the corners?
Join the edges next to build a frame. You will do great.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need help planning my wedding. What should I do first?
You should pick a date and a place. Do you have a favorite spot?
I like the park by my house. Is that good for big guests?
A park is lovely but can be wet. Have you thought about a tent?
A tent sounds nice. How many chairs do I need?
You need one seat for each guest. Do you know how many people are coming?
About fifty people. That is a lot.
Fifty is a happy crowd. Get enough chairs for everyone.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to send a file to my boss right now.
Are you using a fast computer?
Yes, but the screen is blank and red.
That looks like a bad signal. Is your phone working?
It works, but the web is slow.
Slow web hurts. Do you have a backup plan?
I only have this one way to send it.
I do not know why it is stuck. Try to wait for a minute?
I cannot wait, I am running out of time.
I am sorry I cannot help more.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The city is too loud and fast here. What can I do?
Try walking in a quiet park. Do you like birds?
I walk every day, but I am still tired.
Drink more water and rest. Is your sleep good?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a song for my walk, but I am running late.
How about some calm piano music? Do you like soft sounds?
Yes, that sounds nice. Can you play it right now?
I cannot play, but I can list some songs. Do you have a favorite artist?
No time for lists. Just give me one title.
Try "Weightless" by Marconi Union. It is very relaxing.
Great. Thanks. I must go.
I am glad it helped. Have a safe walk!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My clothes are dirty. How do I wash them?
You put them in a machine with water and soap. What color are your shirts?
They are white and blue. Do I use hot water?
You should use warm water to keep them soft. Did you separate the dark socks?
Yes, I put the socks in a bag. What else do I do?
You add the soap and press the start button. Do you know how to dry them?
I can hang them on a line in the sun.
That is a great way to dry them. Do they smell nice after?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a fox in my garden this morning. Is it dangerous?
Foxes are usually shy and will run away if you do not chase them. Do you live near a forest?
Yes, my house is right next to the woods. What should I do if I see one?
Just stand still and look at it with calm eyes. It is safe to watch, but do not try to touch it. Do you like watching birds too?
I love birds, but I am scared of big cats. Will a wild cat come here?
Big cats rarely come to small houses with people in them. You are likely safe from them. Do you feed your pets inside?
Yes, I keep my dog in at night. Thank you for the help.
I am glad I could help you feel safer.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to run more, but my legs hurt. What should I do?
Rest is part of the work, so take a break. Do you stretch your legs?
No, I never stretch. That sounds hard.
Try it slowly, and listen to your body. Is the pain sharp or dull?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to build a tower but it fell over.
That is hard to fix. Did you use blocks?
Yes, I used big blocks but they slid off.
Sliding is tricky. What happened next?
I tried again and put a small block on top.
Good job trying. Did it stay up?
No, it still fell down with a loud noise.
Ouch. Did you want to stop?
I felt sad but I picked them up one more time.
That is very brave. Well done.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad and alone today.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a pet?
No, I do not have any friends here.
That is hard. What do you like to do?
I just sit and look out the window.
That sounds quiet. Would you like to talk more?
Yes, please, but I am tired.
Rest is good. I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What did people eat before stores?
They hunted animals and picked wild plants. Did you know they ate a lot of berries?
Yes, I like berries. Was it hard to get food?
It took much time and work to find enough to eat. Did you ever pick berries in a garden?
Yes, but not in the wild. Do you know when farms started?
I do not know the exact date, but it was a very long time ago.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw the big blue sea today and I feel so good.
That is wonderful news. Did you hear the waves?
Yes, they sound like soft drums.
That sounds very calm. Do you like the sound?
I do, it makes me smile wide.
Smiling is great for you. Do you want to go back?
Yes, I will go again tomorrow.
That is a good plan. Enjoy your day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the big tower on fire?
The heat got too high. Is your house safe?
I am safe, but why did it start?
I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I ate a warm turkey sandwich at my desk.
That sounds tasty. Did you bring it home?
Yes, I packed it in my box.
Smart you did. What else was in the box?
Just some apple slices and a cookie.
A sweet finish is nice. Was the apple fresh?
Yes, it was very crisp and sweet.
I am glad you enjoyed it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Is the sun a star?
Yes, it is a big, hot star. Do you like the heat?
I need to leave now.
Run fast! Is your bag heavy?
The sun is gone from the sky.
It goes behind the earth at night. Do you see any stars?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are clouds white?
Sunlight shines through them. Many tiny drops mix all colors. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. Why are some clouds dark?
They have much more rain water. That blocks the light. Do you like rainy days?
No, I prefer dry days. Why do clouds move?
Wind pushes them along. I do not know the exact speed. Do you watch them drift?
I do, sometimes. Why do they go away?
They turn back into gas. The air gets warmer. Do you think that is magic?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a paper boat, but I do not know how.
That is a fun thing to do. I know how to fold one. Do you have a square piece of paper?
Yes, I have a blue square. How do I start?
Put the square flat on the table. Fold it in half diagonally to make a triangle. Did you get a sharp line?
Yes, I folded it perfectly. What is the next step?
Fold the bottom corners up to the top point. This makes a smaller triangle.
Okay, I did that. Now it looks like a kite. What do I do next?
Turn the triangle around. Fold the top corners down to the bottom line again. Are you enjoying this?
I like it. It looks like a diamond now. What is the last step?
You are almost done. Just pull the top corners apart to open the sides.
Wow, it is a boat. Thank you for helping me learn.
You did a great job. I am happy to help. Do you want to try making one more?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my tree is brown and dry.
That feels bad. What is the name of your tree?
I watered it, but it looks worse today.
I do not know for sure. Is the dirt dry or wet?
I love that tree so much.
Trees can sleep in winter. Do you feel better now?
I hope it wakes up soon.
I hope so too. It will be okay.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The moon looks so far away. I feel small and sad looking at it.
It is a big space rock. Do you like the dark sky?
Yes, but I wish I could hold it. It feels lonely up there.
We all feel alone sometimes. Do you want to talk about your day?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: This place feels too loud and fast for me.
It can be hard to breathe here. Do you like the quiet parts?
I just want to find a spot to sit and think.
Look for a park with green trees.
How do I get there from this street?
I do not know the map well. Is there a sign nearby?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a funny dog at the park today.
That sounds fun. Was the dog big?
Yes, it was big and brown.
Wow. Did it play with you?
No, but it chased a ball hard.
I am glad it was happy. Do you like dogs?
Yes, I love all dogs.
That is sweet. I think dogs are nice too.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad about my math test today.
That is a big test. Do you want to tell me what happened?
I got it wrong and my friend laughed at me.
That is not kind of your friend. Did you practice before the test?
I tried, but the numbers moved around in my head.
You are not bad at math. Take a deep breath and let's look at one problem.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to jump rope.
That is fun. Do you have a rope?
Yes, I do. What do I do first?
You stand with the rope behind you. Are you ready?
I am ready. How do I move the rope?
You swing it over your head and jump. Do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got a ten on my test.
That is great news. What did you study for?
I read my notes and played a game.
Fun way to learn. Did you find it hard?
No, the words made sense to me.
Your brain worked well. How do you feel now?
I feel very proud of myself.
You should be happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The horse looks very tall to me. Does it eat apples?
Yes, many horses love apples. Do you like to ride on its back?
I do not know how to climb up. Is it hard to ride?
It takes practice to get on. Are you brave enough to try?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost at this big station.
It is okay to feel lost. Which train do you need?
I have a ticket but I do not know the door.
Look for the letter on the sign. Do you see a letter C?
I see a C on the board. Is that my train?
Yes, that is the right spot. Do you like riding trains?
I think so, but I am nervous.
Nervous is normal. Is your bag packed?
My bag is heavy. I am almost done.
Take a slow breath. You are doing great work.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Bees are amazing workers!
Yes, they work hard for us. Do you like honey?
I do! I want to share this jar with my mom.
That is a sweet idea.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited for the bus for a long time.
That must be tiring. Did you bring a book to read?
No, I just watched the rain fall.
Rain can be nice. Is it stopping now?
Yes, the sun came out.
How lovely. You must be happy.
Yes, I am glad I did not give up.
Good job. I am glad for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad because I cannot tell a square from a rectangle.
That is a tough thing to learn. Do you have any shapes in front of you right now?
Yes, I do, but they all look the same to me.
You are very careful, which is a good start. A square has four sides that are all the same length.
But my square has one side that is just a tiny bit longer.
If one side is longer, it is not a true square. It is actually a rectangle.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn a new language but I am lost.
Starting is hard. Do you have a favorite song?
I like pop music, but I do not know where to start.
Try listening to that song. What word do you hear often?
I hear the word love a lot, but I do not know the rest.
That is a good start. I do not know the answer for you.
Should I buy a book or use an app?
Both work well. Which one feels easier for you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to go to the doctor today?
Your body is tired. Do you feel hot?
Yes, my head hurts. Why does that mean I am sick?
It means you need rest. Do you want to drink water?
Yes, I do. Why is rest so important for me?
It helps you get better fast. Are you happy now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! My new shirt is clean and it smells like fresh air.
That is great news. Do you like the smell of clean clothes?
I do. It makes me feel good inside.
Happy feelings are wonderful. Do you have other clothes to wash?
Yes, I have a big pile. I want to wash them all today.
That is a lot of work for you. Are you sure you want to do it all now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad because I missed my train.
Oh no, that feels bad. Did you miss it by a lot?
Yes, I saw the doors close right before me.
That is so frustrating to watch happen. Are you tired from running?
I am too tired to do anything else.
Rest is good for you. Do you have a new ticket for later?
I do not know if the next one is even open.
I cannot see your ticket, so I am not sure. Do you have a phone to check?
I will look now, thank you for helping.
I am happy to help. I hope the next train is fine.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very alone today.
That feels heavy. Do you have a friend nearby?
Not right now. What should I do?
I do not know your best fix. Do you like to walk?
I guess I could go for a walk.
That is a good start. Tell me if you get tired.
Okay. I will try it now.
You are brave. I am here.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. My birthday cake is cold.
Oh no. I do not know where you are. Is it sweet?
It is chocolate. I can not stop now.
I hope you enjoy it. Do you like them?
I have to go. Tell my friends thanks.
I will tell them. I hope you have fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The tomatoes are too cheap, so I think they taste bad.
I agree that low price can mean less flavor. Do you usually buy from this stall?
Yes, but today the leaves look dry and brown.
Dried leaves often signal old stock. I would check if the fruit feels firm. Have you picked one up to test it?
It feels soft and warm, which is not right.
A warm tomato is likely bruised inside. You are right to be upset about that.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The light in my room will not turn on.
Did you check if the bulb is loose? Have you tried pulling the cord at the wall?
I pulled the cord, but it did not work.
That is strange. Is the breaker box maybe open?
I do not know where the box is.
It is usually in a closet or garage. Do you see a door with many small switches?
I found a door with switches. One switch is in the down spot.
You can try to push it up. Does the light come on now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I hit the ball harder?
You can hit it harder by swinging your arm fast. Do you like playing on grass?
Yes, I do. What should I do with my feet?
Keep your feet close to the ground and move them quickly. Is it warm today?
It is a bit warm. How do I stop the ball?
Hold the racket up in front of you to catch it. Do you have a friend to play with?
Yes, my brother plays with me. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have fun on the court.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The wind is so loud. I feel sad inside.
That sound can be scary. Are you in a safe room?
Yes, but I miss playing outside. The trees look broken.
We can draw trees together instead. Do you like drawing?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many steps should I take each day?
Aim for about ten thousand steps. Do you have a tracker on your phone?
No, I do not have one.
You can just count with your hands. Do you like walking in parks?
Yes, I love walking outside.
That is great for your heart and mood. Keep it up.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today. It was hard, but my legs feel good now.
That is great news. Did you see any birds?
Yes, I saw a big red bird. I am tired, but I am happy.
Walking is good for your heart. Do you plan to walk again tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw smoke coming from the house next door. It is so scary.
That sounds very frightening. Are you and your family safe right now?
Yes, but I feel so sad about their home. The flames were so bright.
You are right to feel that way. Has anyone called the fire trucks?
I think so, but I could not see them yet. I am just worried.
I do not know for sure if they are close. Do you see any red lights in the dark?
No, it is just dark and smoky. I do not know what to do.
That is okay to not know. Please stay inside and wait for help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is so loud and full of people here. I do not know where to go.
That can feel scary. Do you like the taste of sweet food?
Yes, I love sweet things, but the lines are too long.
You could try a small stall near the park. Do you like to sit or stand?
I am very tired, so I want to sit.
There is a quiet bench by the trees. Go there and take a rest.
That sounds perfect. Thank you for helping me find peace.
You are welcome. Enjoy your break.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My tree has brown leaves. What should I do?
That is not good. Did you water it lately?
I do not know. It is in the yard.
That is tricky. Do you see any bugs on it?
No, I see no bugs. It is just sad.
I am not sure what is wrong. Is the soil dry?
I think the soil is dry. I will help it.
That sounds like a good plan. I hope it gets better.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights went out. I do not know what to do.
Do not worry. Is it dark outside?
Yes, it is. I feel scared.
Stay calm. I do not know if the power will come back soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no time. What is this shape?
It is a circle. Do you like round things?
No. I am late. What is this one?
That is a square. It has four sides.
I see. Thank you.
You are welcome. Bye now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I got an A on my test today.
That is great news! What did you study the most?
I love sharing good things with you. Do you like learning new words?
I do not have feelings, but I enjoy learning. What is your favorite book?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My teacher looks very sad today. What can I do?
That feels hard. Do you know why she is sad?
I don't know. But I want to help her feel better.
You could bring her a flower. Do you like flowers?
Yes, I do. Is that a good idea?
It is a kind idea. She will smile.
