talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my square is missing a side.
That is not a square then. What shape does it look like now?
It looks like a broken fence. I do not know what to do.
A triangle has three sides. Do you have a triangle here?
No, I only have this broken piece. It makes me feel bad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Is the line still straight?
Yes, the line is very straight. But the shape is wrong.
A straight line can start a new shape. What will you draw next?
I will draw a circle. Circles are perfect.
Circles have no corners at all. Do you like them better?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Which season do you like best?
I love winter because it is quiet. Do you like the cold?
No, I do not like the cold. I want to know what to wear.
You can wear a warm coat and boots. Is it snowing where you live?
Yes, there is snow on the ground. What should I do with it?
You can build a snowman. Do you have a friend to help you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which movie to pick.
That is hard. Do you like sad stories?
No, I want to feel happy today.
Funny films are great for that. Do you like animals?
Yes, I love seeing dogs on screen.
A funny dog movie sounds perfect.
Okay, I will choose that one.
Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because I made my teacher smile.
That is a great feeling. Did you do something special for her?
Yes, I drew her a big red flower with lots of petals.
How sweet of you. She must have been very pleased.
She kept it on her desk right next to her coffee cup.
That is a nice place for it. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. This line is too long.
That sounds hard. Do you like waiting?
No. I hate it when things take too long.
You are right. Some waits are long.
I want my turn now. Please help me.
I cannot help with that. Do you have a toy?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes, but I keep making a mess.
That is okay. Do you like to draw pictures?
Yes, I do. How do I start?
Make one big loop with the string. Is it like a bunny ear?
Yes, it looks like an ear. What do I do next?
Make a second loop with the other string. Which one is bigger?
The left one is bigger. Now what?
Push the big loop under the small one. I am not sure where to go next.
I pulled them tight. It worked!
Great job.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make my garden look nice.
That is a great idea. What colors do you like best?
I love bright red and yellow.
Roses are red. Marigolds are yellow. Do you have a lot of sun there?
Yes, it gets sun all day long.
Sun helps them grow strong. Are you ready to plant them now?
I think so, but how deep do I dig?
Dig as deep as the pot. Then pack the dirt tight. Is your soil soft?
Yes, it feels like dark chocolate cake.
Then it is ready for you. Happy planting.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to visit a small island. What should I pack?
Bring water and warm clothes. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I love the sea. How do I get there?
A boat is the best way. Is it a long trip?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why does my bread get big and fluffy?
Yeast eats sugar and makes gas. Do you wait long enough?
How long should I wait?
Usually one to two hours. Do you keep it warm?
My kitchen is cold.
The yeast works faster in heat. Is it very cold there?
Yes, it is winter.
Put it near a warm spot. It will rise fine.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big white puff in the sky. What is it?
It is a cloud. Do you like watching them?
I do not know if they are wet or dry.
They are made of tiny water drops. Are they high up?
Yes, very high. I am not sure why they stay there.
The air holds them up. Is it windy today?
It is quiet. I am not sure if they will rain.
I do not know for sure. Is the sun shining?
The sun is behind them. I am confused.
Clouds block the light. Do you feel cool?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a map of the park, but I do not know where to start.
That is a nice map. Do you want to find the pond first?
The pond is far away. I only have a little time to walk.
Let us look for a bench nearby. Do you like trees?
Yes, I do. I see a big green tree on the map.
That is a good choice. Walk straight from here.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I took a great picture of the sky.
That sounds lovely. What color was the sky?
It was very blue with big white clouds.
Oh, how nice. Did you use a phone?
Yes, my little phone worked well.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I did not like my new teacher today.
That feels bad. What made you feel that way?
He said my drawing was not good.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you like drawing?
Yes, I love to draw.
That is a great thing. You are doing your best.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What makes an island float in the sea?
The land is solid rock, so it stays up. Do you like sand?
Yes, I do. What lives on an island?
Many animals live there, like birds. Do you like birds?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my horse is not eating today.
That sounds hard. Is he feeling any pain?
I do not know what is wrong.
Let us check his legs. Does he walk fine?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my phone screen. I am so sad.
Oh no, that is a shame. Does it still turn on?
Yes, but the glass is cracked. I do not know what to do.
You can take it to a shop to fix it. Do you have any extra cash?
I think I do. I have five dollars left.
Five dollars might not be enough for a full fix. Do you have a spare phone?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The light in my room just went out. What should I do first?
Please check the wall switch to see if it is off. Is the whole room dark or just that one light?
The whole room is dark. The other rooms are fine.
That is strange. Could you check if the plug is loose?
The plug feels tight. I do not know what else to check.
I do not know the exact problem. Do you feel safe staying in the room?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to win a chess game today, but my king got stuck.
That can happen. Did you use a knight to help your king?
No, I just wanted to move the queen, but I forgot it moves in lines.
Ah, that is a tricky move. Do you like how the queen travels?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I saw a sailor on the pier and felt confused about what to do.
That is a common feeling. Do you know him well?
Not really, I just think he looks sad and lonely.
Kindness is always good. What did he say to you?
He asked if I knew where to find a ship.
I do not know which ship he wants. Have you checked the harbor map?
The map shows many boats, so I am still lost.
Let us look for the main dock. Is it near the big red boat?
Yes, I see the red boat, so I will go there now.
That is a good plan. Call me if you need help.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The city is so loud and bright today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like the noise?
I do. The music makes me smile.
It is good to be happy. What song is playing?
I cannot tell. There are too many sounds.
That is okay. Are you eating anything?
Yes. I have a sweet treat.
That is a nice way to end the day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad about that story.
That story is really sad. What part hurts the most?
The bear loses his home.
Yes, that is very hard. Did he find a new home?
I do not know.
I do not know either. Let me check the book.
Please be quick.
I am reading now. Is the end happy?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I have a new job and I want to wash the dishes.
That is a good start. Do you have any sponges?
Yes, I do. How do I make them clean?
Use warm water and soap. Do you like warm or cold water?
I like warm water. What else do I need?
You need a bowl to hold the dirty dishes. Do you have a bowl?
I have a big red bowl. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I am glad to help.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I love to kick the ball very hard.
That sounds like lots of fun. Do you have a favorite team?
Yes, I like the blue ones.
Blue is a great color. Do you play with your friends too?
Yes, we run around a lot.
Running makes your body strong. Do you like to run fast?
Yes, I am very speedy.
That is great. I hope you have a happy day on the field.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I put water on the leaves, but the plant still looks sad. Do you know why?
Leaves do not drink like roots do. Do you check if the dirt is wet?
Yes, the dirt is dry at the bottom. How does the water really get up?
Tiny tubes in the stem pull it up like a straw. Do you like knowing how that works?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am putting my book in the bag.
Good choice. Is it a story you like?
Yes, I found it on the floor today.
That is lucky. Do you know who lost it?
I do not know, but I saw the owner.
Smart. Will you give it back?
Yes, I will give it back tomorrow.
That is kind.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad because I lost my copy of that story.
That feels very bad. What is the name of the book?
It is the tale of the brave little red fox.
Oh, a fox. Does the fox have a special friend?
Yes, but I cannot read it now.
I am sorry you cannot read it. Can you read another book today?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot find my book. I am so sad.
That is very frustrating. Did you check the last shelf?
No, I checked all the tops. I think I lost it.
Let us look for it together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I keep my toys from breaking?
Put them in a soft box. Do you have a box?
I have a big box.
That is a good idea. Is the box clean?
It is clean and ready.
Great! Put the toys in now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky so blue?
That is a great question. The sun makes white light, and the blue part breaks off to fill the air. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do!
Me too. The air is very tiny, and it catches the blue light best. Do you see any clouds?
A few little ones.
Clouds look white because they catch all the colors. You are learning fast!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because the sun is not shining today.
That sounds tough. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I do. Why is it so dark?
The earth is spinning right now. It is night where you are.
But I want it to be day.
I cannot change that. Do you have a favorite outdoor game?
Not really. I just want some light.
You can turn on a lamp. Does that help a little?
A bit, but it is not the same.
I understand. The sun will return soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this new town. It feels too quiet and I feel sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a favorite spot to play here?
No, not yet. I miss the loud park back home.
That makes sense. Would you like to walk together to see what is near us?
I guess so, but I am still upset about the changes.
It is okay to be upset. Are you hungry?
Actually, yes. My tummy is grumbling.
Good. I know a nice place nearby. Do you want to eat cookies?
Yes, please. That makes me smile a little.
I am glad to help. Let us go find some cookies.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I only have ten seconds, so just tell me the name of your top book.
It is a story about a boy who builds a new world. Do you like stories about building things?
That sounds cool, but I really must run now.
Safe travels to you. I hope you enjoy your day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ran a long way today. My legs hurt a lot.
That is a big effort. Did you drink water?
Yes, I drank a lot. It was a sunny day.
Sun is good for running. Do you like running?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today.
That is great to hear. What made you smile?
The sun is warm and bright.
That is a lovely thing.
I want everyone to be this glad.
That is a kind wish. Do you know how to do that?
I just want to share the good feeling.
Sharing joy is good. I am glad you told me.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do sailors wear red shirts?
It makes them easy to spot in the sea. Do you like bright colors?
What do they do when it is dark?
They use bright lights to guide ships. Do you know about stars?
Why do they look at the sky so much?
The sky helps them find their way. Have you ever looked for the moon?
Do they get lost often?
No, they have maps and tools to help. Do you like using maps?
Why is the sea scary for some?
Big waves can be very loud and strong. Do you like the sound of waves?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do cats purr?
They purr to show they are happy or calm. Do you have a cat?
I do! Why do lions roar?
Roaring tells other lions to stay away. It is their way of saying the land is theirs.
I wonder why elephants are so big.
Being big helps them fight off bad things. It also helps them reach high branches.
That makes sense. Why do birds fly?
I do not know for sure, but I think it helps them find food and mates.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to leave now. Why are mountains so tall?
They grow up over a long time. Do you like climbing them?
I am running late. Are they made of stone?
Yes, they are mostly rock. It is true.
I must go. Do you know the highest one?
I do not know the exact name. I hope you are safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am so late, but I really want to know how to tie my shoes.
That is a fun thing to learn. What is making you in such a hurry?
I have to go to the park with my friends soon.
Oh, you must be excited. Do you have your laces ready?
Yes, they are right here in my hand.
Great, let us start with a little knot. Can you show me which end is which?
This is the left and this is the right.
Good job, you are doing great. Do you want to try the first loop now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My day was very busy today.
That sounds tiring. Did you have any fun?
Yes, I saw a new baby at the park.
Oh, that is sweet. How old was the baby?
It looked very small and soft.
I can imagine. Did you touch the baby?
No, the mom said no.
That is wise. Did you give the mom a hug?
I said hello to her instead.
That is kind. I am glad you were nice.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do while we wait.
That is okay. You can just watch the trees. Do you see the leaves?
I see them, but my legs feel funny.
Your legs may feel jumpy. Try to take three slow breaths.
I tried to sit, but then I stood up again.
That is common. It means you are ready for the next part.
I still feel unsure about where to look.
Look at your shoes. They are ready to walk.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is very cold and wet outside today. Do I need a hat?
Yes, a warm hat will help a lot. Do you have a scarf too?
I have a jacket but no scarf. What should I do now?
Your jacket is good if it is thick. It should be enough to keep you warm.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing on this quiet street and I do not know where to go.
The air is calm and cool. Do you like the sound of the wind?
The wind is nice, but my feet are tired.
You can rest on the bench nearby. Is your bag heavy?
Yes, it is quite heavy.
That is why you feel tired. What is inside the bag?
It is full of old books.
Books are good friends. Do you want to read one now?
I think I will just watch the leaves fall.
That sounds like a good choice.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to find the little house with the red door.
That is easy to spot. Do you see the big oak tree?
Yes, I see the tree right by the pond.
The house is just behind the tree. Is the pond full of water?
It looks very blue and calm today.
Good. You are almost there. Do you see a cat sitting on the porch?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
I can show you. Do you have your shoes with you?
Yes, I do. Please tell me the first step.
Make a big loop with one lace. Which foot are we starting on?
My left foot. What do I do next?
Cross the other lace over the first one.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today.
That sounds fun. Did you see any dogs?
Yes, a big brown one chased me.
Oh no. Were you safe?
I ran to my friend and felt okay.
Good. Let us go there next week.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I gave up on the tower. It fell down twice.
Falling means you tried hard. What is the tower made of?
I think it is too heavy. I am not strong enough.
You are stronger than you think. Will you try one more block?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a pot of honey but I do not know how it was made.
Bees drink sweet plant juice and store it in their hive. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I love it, but how does the juice turn into honey?
They fan air over it to dry it into thick, sweet syrup.
That is amazing, but can we just let them keep it?
Yes, wild bees do not need our help. Do you have any questions?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I had a scary dream and feel lost.
That is a hard feeling. Did you have a glass of water?
I do not know what to do next.
Maybe try to take a few slow breaths. Do you feel safe now?
I just want it to stop.
I cannot fix dreams, but I am here. Would you like to talk about it?
I am still feeling very bad.
Let us sit quiet for a moment.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now. I found a shiny coin in the grass.
That is a great thing to share. What color was the coin?
It was bright gold and very round. How does that make you feel?
It makes me feel warm. Do you plan to keep it for safe?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse today.
That sounds fun! Did it have a long tail?
Yes, it was very long and soft.
I know horses have soft coats. Do they eat grass?
It was eating grass in the field.
That is a good thing for them. I do not know if they like carrots, though.
I think they do.
Maybe you can ask the owner next time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to send a letter to my friend. How do I do that?
You need a stamp for the letter. Do you have a stamp?
No, I do not have a stamp. Where can I get one?
You can buy stamps at the counter. Is the counter open?
Yes, it is open. What else do I need?
You must write the full address on the envelope.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big blue river today.
That sounds fun to look at.
The water was very fast and cold.
Did you touch the water?
No, I just watched the ducks swim.
Are there many ducks there?
Yes, there were a whole flock of them.
They must be happy to swim so fast.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the rain. It makes me feel sad inside.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you like playing in the wet?
No, I just want the sun back. It feels so dark today.
The sun is still there behind the clouds. Do you want to try to dance?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the answer to this puzzle right now. It is blocking my path.
I am here to help. What part of it is confusing?
I do not know which shape fits. I am late for my meeting.
Let me look closer. Do you have a picture of it?
No. Just this riddle. Please hurry.
I am thinking hard. I do not know the exact piece yet.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go now. The path is too long.
The map is not here. Do you want to stop?
No. I must run.
Running makes you hot. Are you safe?
The bird is in my way.
It will fly away. Did it screech?
It is gone. I am late.
Hurry on.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am lost and I feel very sad.
Do not worry. Where do you want to go?
I do not know where I am.
I do not know either. Can you tell me a nearby place?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am not sure how to ask a friend for a toy.
You should use the magic word please. Do you know which one is that?
Is it the word please?
Yes, that is exactly right. It makes people want to help you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I need to get to the city by noon. Which train should I take?
The one that leaves at nine is best. Do you have your ticket ready?
Yes, I bought it this morning. Is it far from the station to the museum?
It is a short walk, about ten minutes. Do you like walking or taking a bus?
I prefer walking. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have a happy trip!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sea blue on this map?
It shows water. Is the land brown to you?
Why is the land brown?
It represents dirt and grass. Do you see any green spots?
Why do some parts look green?
That means trees grow there.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a queen?
You move a pawn to the last row. Do you have a pawn ready?
Yes, it is on the second to last square.
Push it one more step forward.
I did. Now what happens?
You pick a new piece from the bottom of your box. Is your queen still in the box?
Yes, I can see it.
Put the queen where the pawn was. Did you choose the queen?
Yes, I put the queen there.
Great job! You may now use the queen.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
The sun makes light with all colors, but blue scatters the most. Do you see the light?
The sun is very bright today.
Yes, the bright sun helps us see the blue. Do you like sunny days?
I like sunny days for playing.
Sunshine is great for playing outside. It helps the blue look nice.
Does the moon make the sky blue?
No, the moon is white and gray at night. The sky is dark then.
Okay, I get it now.
I am glad you understand. Have fun looking up.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I got a new sister! She is so small.
That is wonderful news. How did she make you feel?
I am happy, but a little mad. She takes all the toys.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you miss playing alone?
Yes, I do. Her face is all wrinkly though.
She is learning to look like a person. What is her first word?
I think she said "goo". I do not know what that means.
I do not know that one either. Did she smile at you?
Yes! She has a tiny hand. I want to hold it.
That is a very sweet idea. Tell me about her eyes.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: There is smoke in my house. What do I do?
Is the smoke thick or thin? Move away from the fire right now.
It is very thick. I feel so scared.
Stay low to the ground. Can you find an open window?
I found a window. Should I climb out?
Yes, go out if it is safe. Do not stop to grab things.
I am outside now. Thank you so much.
You did a great job. I am glad you are safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my favorite shirt is still wet.
That is bad. Did you check the power?
The machine is loud, but the water is cold.
It might be stuck. Do you see any lights?
There is one red light on top.
That is good. It is working.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I wrote a new story today. I am so happy with it.
That is great news. Do the characters have a big adventure?
Yes. The bear finds a magic key.
A magic key is exciting. What does it open?
It opens a door to the moon.
Wow, that is a lovely idea. I hope you tell it to your family.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can bugs feel pain?
Some bugs do feel pain. Do you like looking at ants?
Why do bees dance?
They dance to tell other bees where the flowers are. Are they loud when they buzz?
How many legs does a spider have?
A spider has eight legs. I do not know if you like spiders.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very scared of the pedals.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you know how to press the gas?
Yes, but my foot gets tired.
That is normal at first. Do you want to try just pressing it?
I am confused about the steering wheel.
I am not sure you are ready for that yet. Do you want to review the brakes first?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I lost the game again.
That feels bad. Did you try a new move?
No. I just wanted to win.
Winning is hard. Are you taking a break?
Yes. I am very tired.
Rest is good for your mind. Do you like the end game?
I do not. It is too messy.
It can look messy, but it makes sense. What piece do you like most?
The queen. She is strong.
She is very fast. Do you use her early?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a wedding today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Who were you married to?
I was not married. I just watched two people say yes.
Oh, I see. Did they wear pretty clothes?
Yes, the bride wore a white dress.
White is a classic color. Did you eat any food?
I had a small piece of cake.
Cake is sweet. Did you enjoy the whole day?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad because I cannot think of what to write in my letter.
Take a deep breath. Do you know who is getting the letter?
It is for my friend, but I keep getting the words mixed up.
That happens often. Start by telling them what you like to do together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a paper boat.
That is a fun idea. Do you have some paper ready?
Yes, I have a square sheet.
Fold the corners in to the middle line.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a small bug on my hand. Is it safe?
It looks like a ladybug. They do not hurt us. Do you like red things?
I do, but I am afraid of it walking on me.
You can gently move it to a leaf. Would you like to try?
Okay, I will move it to the garden.
Good choice. Do you have plants there?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a sad dog in my story. I do not know what happens next.
That is a tricky spot. Do you want the dog to find a friend?
I am not sure. A friend might be too easy for a sad story.
You are right to think about that. What if the dog finds a lost toy instead?
A toy sounds better. But how does the dog get it back?
I do not know how the toy was lost. Is it stuck in a tree?
Yes, it is high up in a tree. Now I am stuck again.
Maybe a kind bird can help. Do you like birds in your story?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. The sun is bright and I feel warm.
That is wonderful. What made you feel this way?
I saw a cat play in the grass. It was very funny and cute.
How nice for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate this place. It is too loud and the crowds are everywhere.
That sounds very tiring. Do you have a quiet spot to rest?
No. I have been walking for hours and my feet hurt so much.
Ouch, that must be painful. Have you tried drinking some water?
No, I forgot. I think I need to leave now.
That is a good plan. Do you know the way to the bus?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to cross the river now. It is very fast.
The water looks deep and cold. Are you sure you can swim?
I am running late. I must cross quickly.
Do not swim in the fast part. It is not safe.
I do not have time for safety talks.
I do not know a safe spot. Do you see a bridge nearby?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I draw a circle?
Use a coin or a lid to trace around. Do you like round things?
Yes, I love balls. How do I make a square?
Draw four lines that are all the same size. I do not know if you have a ruler yet.
I have a ruler. Can you show me a triangle?
Draw one long line and two short ones that meet at the top. Are you having fun?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I saw the tall tree leaves move. How does it drink?
It pulls water up from the roots. Do you like to watch trees?
I do not know how to help it drink. What should I do?
Just pour water near the roots. Do you have a watering can?
Yes, I have one. Is that all I do?
Yes, that is all you do. I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the post office need a big box?
That box holds your letters. Do you like sending letters?
Why do they have a bell inside?
The bell tells people when mail arrives. Do you hear it ring?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am sad because my friend got a new toy and I did not.
It is okay to feel sad. Can you tell me why you are upset?
I want that exact same robot.
I do not know where to get it. Do you have a favorite color?
Yes, blue. I want the blue one.
Blue is a nice color. Would you like to build a robot with blocks instead?
Blocks are not real robots.
You are right, they are different. I will help you draw a blue robot.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big statue today. It looked very old and worn.
That sounds interesting. How long do you think it has been there?
I asked a man nearby. He said it was from a war a hundred years ago.
A hundred years is a long time. Did the statue show you anything special?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: It is very hot outside today. Do you like the heat?
I do not have a body, so I do not feel heat. Do you like it?
I like it a little. But my ice cream is melting fast.
That is true. It melts quickly in the sun. Where are you sitting?
I am on a porch with a fan. It helps a bit.
A fan is good. Do you have a cold drink?
Yes, I have lemonade. It is very sweet.
Sweet lemonade sounds nice. Do you have enough?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My head hurts. What can I do?
Drink some water. Is it a sharp pain?
I drank water, but it still hurts.
Try to rest in a dark room.
I cannot sleep down. Why is that?
I am not sure why sleep is hard. Did you eat today?
I did not eat.
Please eat a small snack now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the big art museum today. It was so much fun.
That sounds nice. Did you see any funny sculptures?
Yes, I saw a big statue of a cat. It looked very sleepy.
That is a fun thing to see. What was its favorite pose?
It was lying down on its side. I loved it so much.
I am glad you had a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you sell chocolate cupcakes today?
Yes, we have many. Do you like sweet treats?
Can I have one with extra frosting?
I can do that for you. Would you like a drink too?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent my afternoon in the garden. I watched a small ant carry a crumb home.
That ant must have worked very hard. Did you see where it went?
It went right under the big oak tree. It disappeared into the dirt.
Nature is full of small surprises. I do not know what was inside that tree, but it sounds like a safe spot.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: Why is the sky blue? I am not sure what to do.
Sunlight has many colors. Blue light bounces around the air most. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. But my eyes hurt sometimes.
Look at the ground for a bit. Your eyes will rest. Do you have a hat?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I kick a ball?
Put your toe on the ball and swing your leg. Do you like playing soccer?
Yes, I love it. How do I catch a ball?
Open your hands wide and hold the ball tight. Is that hard for you?
It is a little hard. How do I run fast?
Look ahead and lift your knees high. Do you run every day?
I try to. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Keep practicing and have fun!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see the storm coming. How do I keep my house safe?
That is a good fear. Do you have a flashlight ready?
Yes, I have the flashlight. Now, how do I stop the wind from hurting my plants?
Move them inside if you can. The glass will break in the wind.
I will move the pots. Do I need to do anything else?
No, you do not. Just sit down and wait for it to pass.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My head hurts bad. I am not sure if I must see the doctor.
That sounds painful. Do you have a fever?
I am only a little hot. I feel very tired.
You might just need rest. But if it gets worse, please go.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The lights just went out. How do I light a candle?
Use a match or a lighter. Do you have any matches nearby?
No, I do not. What else can I use?
You can use a lighter or a matches box. Is there a phone you can use for light?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to buy a gift, but I do not know what to pick.
That is a hard choice. Do you like cats or dogs?
I do not know. The shop is too big and I feel lost.
Let us look at the toys first. I like your red hat.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I think I am lost. I do not know which way to go.
Do not worry. Are you looking for your home?
Yes, I want to go home. What should I do now?
Look for a street sign.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love the wind today.
It feels nice, does it not? Do you like the sound?
Yes, it sounds like a song.
That sounds like a lovely song. Do you dance to it?
I do dance a little.
Dancing with the wind is fun. Is it windy everywhere?
It is windy near me.
I am glad you are happy. I do not know if it is windy here.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent the whole afternoon in the garden.
That sounds like a peaceful way to spend time. Did you plant anything new?
I planted some seeds for carrots.
Carrots are a fun vegetable to grow.
I also saw a small bird in the tree.
A bird? That is a lovely surprise.
It just sat there and looked at me.
It seems like it was curious about you too.
I hope it comes back tomorrow.
I hope it does too. You have a nice day ahead.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know if I should pass or shoot.
Do you see an open friend ahead? If yes, pass to them.
Yes, but the goal is very close.
Is your friend fast? Running to an open spot is often good.
I am still not sure what to do.
I do not know for certain. I suggest you just pick one and try.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today and I want to tell you about the months.
That sounds nice. Do you have a favorite month?
I like January because it is the first month of the year.
That makes sense. It is the start of everything new.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate this map. The lines are all a mess.
That looks very hard. What part is the trickiest?
I want to walk in the park, but I do not know where it is.
You are right to check. Do you have a phone with you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do trees have feelings?
We do not know for sure. But they do react to danger. Do you like quiet places?
I need to go. How do trees get food?
They make food from sun and air. Do you know how?
I cannot stop. Thanks.
You are welcome. Run safely.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is this the bus that goes to the beach?
Yes, it is. Do you like the ocean?
I do, but I am worried about the ride.
It is a smooth ride. Is your bag packed?
My bag is here, but I forgot my hat.
That is okay. Do you have a spare one?
No, I do not have another hat.
You will be fine without it. Enjoy the trip.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I met a new friend today.
That is great news. What is your friend's name?
I am not sure, but she likes to draw.
Drawing is a lot of fun. Does she draw animals?
Yes, she drew a big cat.
A big cat sounds cute. Is the cat a house cat?
No, it has spots and a long tail.
Sounds like a very nice cat. Did you draw one too?
I tried, but mine looks like a blob.
Art takes time to learn. Do you plan to practice more?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a nice salad for my picnic. How do I start?
You need fresh leaves and fun veggies. Do you like crunchy carrots?
Yes, I love carrots. What do I do with them?
Just cut them into small sticks. Wash them well first.
Okay, the carrots are ready. How do I make the green leaves taste good?
Mix the leaves with oil and lemon juice. Do you have any lemon?
I have lemons, thank you. How do I put it all together?
Put the leaves and carrots in a big bowl. Then add your mix.
That sounds easy. Should I save some for later?
Yes, keep it in the fridge until you go. Enjoy your fun day!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind blew my hat off this morning.
Oh no, that is a strong wind. Did you catch it?
I did, but it took a long time.
Good job running. Was it cold too?
Yes, the air was very sharp and cold.
I am sorry for the chill. Did you get warm inside?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what time it is.
You can look at the clock. What number is the big hand on?
I see the big hand on twelve.
That means it is a full hour. Are you trying to read a digital clock?
No, I see small lines too.
Those lines are for minutes. Do you know what they show?
I am still not sure.
Let us count the small lines together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I fix a torn page?
Use a small piece of white tape. Do you have any tape?
Yes, I have a roll here.
Good. Place it over the tear and press hard. Is the paper thin?
Yes, it is very thin.
Be gentle so you do not break it. Do you like reading?
I do, but I am bad at fixing things.
You can do it with care. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My boss gave me a huge task to do by five.
That feels very heavy. Do you feel tired?
The computer broke down in the middle of the work.
That is a true bad break. Do you have a backup plan?
I stayed late to fix it, but it is done now.
You did a good job. Do you want to rest now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a big, red apple. It looks so sweet and juicy. I want to share it with you.
That is a lovely gift. Do you like eating apples with your fingers?
Yes, I do. The red skin is a little hard, but the inside is soft.
I am glad you are happy. What is your favorite thing to eat for a snack?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have birthdays?
It marks the day you were born. Do you like turning another year older?
I think so. Why do we blow out candles?
It is an old wish for good luck. Do you always make a wish?
Yes, I do. Why do friends give gifts?
Gifts show they care about you. Do you like getting presents?
I love them. Why do we eat cake?
Cake makes the party sweet and fun. Do you like chocolate cake?
Very much. Why do we sing the song?
It helps everyone feel happy together.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you like pop music?
I like it a lot. Do you listen to it on your phone?
Yes. I need to run now.
Okay, go fast. Is that song loud?
Yes, it is. Bye.
Bye, have a good trip.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I do not know if today is Tuesday or Wednesday.
I feel sorry for you. Do you like the taste of Tuesday?
No, I just want to know which day it is. I am very confused.
I am not sure either. Can you tell me what you did last?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very scared.
That is okay. What makes you feel that way?
I do not like the dark.
The dark is just night. Do you like having a light on?
Yes, I do.
A small light can help. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the bus here?
I do not see it. Are you going to school?
Yes. It is not moving.
Maybe it is full. Is your bag heavy?
Yes. I must go now.
Okay. Run safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to grow tomatoes in my garden.
That is a fun thing to do. Do you have a sunny spot?
Yes, I have a big box in the sun.
Great. Put the seeds in the soil and give them water.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel very tired today, but I am also so happy.
That is a funny mix of feelings. What makes you feel so happy?
I got a great grade on my test, and I played tag with friends.
Wow, that is wonderful news. I am glad for you.
I am happy to tell you about it, and now I want to rest.
Resting is good for your body. Do you like to sleep a lot?
Yes, I love naps, but I also love talking to you.
I am happy to chat with you too. Please take a good rest now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do players wear shirts with big numbers on them?
It helps the fans know who is who on the field. Do you have a favorite player?
Why is the referee always running around?
He has to follow the ball to see if there is a foul. Are you good at running fast?
Why do they blow a whistle?
It tells everyone the play stops right then. I am not sure why it is not a horn.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to build the tower, but it fell down. I am so mad.
That feels really hard. Did the blocks slide off?
Yes, they just slipped. I want to quit now.
Quitting is okay, but trying again is brave too. What color is your favorite block?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so tired of sitting in this seat.
That is hard. Are you hungry?
The plane is shaking a lot.
That can feel scary. Do you like window seats?
I do not know when we will land.
I do not know either. Let us look outside.
I just want to go home now.
I know. We are almost there.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I put my red shirt in the machine today.
That sounds like a good choice. What color was your other shirt?
It was blue, but I mixed it with a red one by mistake.
Oh no, that is a tricky problem to solve.
The red shirt looked pink and the blue shirt looked purple.
Yikes, I am sorry about that. Do you have a friend who knows about laundry?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late but I feel so happy! I did a great job.
That is wonderful to hear. What did you do?
I fixed my bike! I was so proud.
You should be proud of yourself. How was the ride?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel tired when I work at home. What should I do?
Try to make a small plan for the day. Do you like to drink coffee in the morning?
Yes, I love coffee. It helps me feel awake.
That is a good habit. Keep your desk clean too.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my friend is not here to play.
I am sorry you feel bad. What did you try to do?
I tried to call him, but he did not answer.
That is hard to wait for.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because the big tree in the park has new leaves.
That is good news. Do you like the green color?
Yes, I love how it shines in the sun.
Nature is very pretty. Do you want to sit under it?
I do, but I am also hungry.
A snack will make you happier. What is your favorite food?
An apple, please.
Apples grow on trees too. Nice choice.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to pack a nice picnic lunch. How do I do it?
Start with a blanket on the bottom. Do you like cold sandwiches?
I love them. What do I put next?
Put the sandwiches in a box. Then add fruit.
Where do the drinks go?
Drinks go in a cooler to stay ice cold. Is it going to be sunny today?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to pack my boxes.
Start with the light things first. Do you have enough tape?
I have tape, but I am very tired.
That is okay. You can take a break.
I think I should ask for help.
A friend might help you move. Do you want to call someone?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My cat just fell asleep on my feet. It is so warm.
That is a sweet feeling. Does your cat like to sleep on your feet often?
Yes, it comes to me every night. I love holding its paws.
Cats love to feel safe with their people.
It purred so loud last night. It was like a little engine.
A loud purr means a happy cat. Is its tummy soft too?
Very soft and warm. I almost forgot to go to bed.
I am glad you are having such a good time.
I just wanted to tell you about this happy moment.
It was nice to hear about your cat.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My boss gave me a lot of free time. I do not know what to do with it.
That sounds like a good thing. Do you like your work?
I do, but I feel lost without a clear task.
You can check for new projects. Are you busy right now?
Yes, I finished my main job early today.
Great. Ask your boss what needs help next.
I am afraid to bother him with small questions.
Kind bosses like to help you. Is he usually open?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn chess. Where do I start?
Start by learning how each piece moves. Do you know how the king moves?
I think the king moves one step at a time.
Yes, that is correct. Is it safe to move your king first?
I do not know. Should I move the pawns?
Moving pawns helps open space for other pieces. Do you see any open lines?
I see my bishop in the corner. Can it move?
A bishop moves diagonally. Is there a clear path for it?
Yes, the square ahead is empty.
Good. Move it there and see what happens.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because the sun is out today!
That is a great feeling. Do you like the warm light on your face?
Yes, it feels like a soft hug. Why is the sun so bright?
It is a giant ball of fire far away. Do you think it is hot?
It is very warm, but not too hot. I love how it makes things glow.
That is a lovely thing to see. You have a happy heart today.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not know how to move my knight.
It looks like a horse, so it moves in an L shape. Do you like horses?
Yes, I do. But what if there is a piece in the way?
Knights are special because they jump over other pieces. Do you want to try a jump?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
The trees sleep in winter, so they drop their leaves. Do you see how the ground looks like a blanket?
It is a nice blanket, but why do they need to sleep?
Sleeping saves energy for the cold days ahead. I do not know all the secrets, but I know it helps them stay strong.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the music so loud?
It makes people want to dance. Do you like to dance?
Why is there so much food?
We want everyone to be full and happy.
Why are the lights dark?
It helps us see the sparklers better. Do you like the light show?
Why is the floor sticky?
I do not know, I am sorry. Do you want to get more drinks?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very scared inside my tummy.
That feels yucky, does not it?
Yes, and I do not know why.
I do not know why either, but I am here.
Can we sit together for a bit?
Yes, let us just breathe slow.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I watched a fun play today. The cat jumped high.
That sounds exciting. Did you sit in the front?
Yes, I was right there. I saw all the toys.
Oh, I do not know if that is safe. Were the actors happy?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the car. It is so hard to make it stop.
That is a normal fear. Do you take deep breaths when you get scared?
I try, but my hands shake and I press the brake too hard.
Shaking is okay. Have you tried slowing down the car first?
I keep stalling the engine at every red light.
Stalling just means the engine stopped. Do you want to practice in an empty lot?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I missed my train. I am so sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you see the new times?
No, I was too upset to look.
That is a big feeling. Can we check the board together?
Okay. I think I will catch the next one.
Good job. Do you like the view from the window?
Yes, the trees look nice.
Nature is always calm. Are you feeling better now?
A little better. Thank you for helping.
You are welcome. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sitting here with an empty stomach. I do not know what to eat.
That feels tricky. Do you like warm food or cold food?
I think I want something warm, but I have no idea what is good.
Toast is a sweet and safe pick. Do you have any jam?
I am not sure. I do not remember what is in my fridge.
I cannot see your kitchen. But eggs are always a good warm start.
Eggs sound nice, but they take time. I am in a hurry.
A banana is fast and sweet. Do you like fruit for breakfast?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very tired. What is going on?
The weather is changing. Do you sleep well at night?
Not really. It is always so dark.
That is because of the winter. Do you like the cold?
I do not. I want it to be warm again.
Spring is coming soon. I do not know the exact date.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my party was not fun.
I am sorry you feel that way. Was it too loud?
No, but everyone left very fast.
That is not fair at all. Do you want a warm drink?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is so bright today. I feel so happy!
That sounds wonderful. Are you going outside?
Yes, I want to sit in the warm light. Do you like the sun too?
I do not have feelings, but I know it is good for plants. Does it feel warm on your face?
Yes, it feels like a warm hug. I am glad you asked.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to fix my bike, but the wheel still makes a loud click. I feel so tired from all that work.
That is a hard click to fix. Do you know what part is making the noise?
I do not know for sure, but I think it is the little spoke. I am not sure I can make it right again.
You do not have to fix it all today. Would you like to take a break and drink some water?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad because I have no one to play with. What should I do?
That feels heavy. Do you like to draw? You can invite a classmate to draw with you.
I do like to draw, but I am scared they will say no. How can I be brave?
Try just one time. It is okay if they say no.
I will try tomorrow. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I packed my bag for the trip.
That sounds like a good start. Did you bring food?
Yes, I packed lots of sandwiches.
Good choice for energy. Where are you sleeping?
I am in a big blue tent.
A tent can be cozy. Is it cold outside?
It is cool, but I have a warm jacket.
That is wise to dress well. Do you like the sound of the wind?
It feels nice and quiet.
Quiet can be very peaceful.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do.
I can help. Do you like flowers?
I like red roses.
Nice choice. Do you have a date?
It is next week.
That is soon. Do you have a dress?
I have no dress.
Let us find one.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know if this is the right train.
Do you have a ticket with you?
Yes, I have it, but the number looks wrong.
Let me look at it.
I am very worried I will miss my stop.
I do not know where you are going. Where is your final stop?
I am going to the city by the sea.
This train goes to the coast.
Oh, thank you, my heart is happy now.
I am glad to help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am sorry I broke the cup. It fell and made a loud sound.
Oh no. Did the cup hurt?
I really feel bad about it. I was being too fast.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you know how to clean up the glass?
Yes, I use the broom now. My feet are safe.
That is good. I do not know if the cup can be fixed, but I am happy you are safe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My bread is getting so big! I am so happy to tell you why.
That is wonderful news. Do you know why it grows?
The tiny yeast eats sugar and makes gas. The gas makes soft holes inside.
I am glad it is working well. Do you like the smell of it?
It smells sweet and warm. I can not wait to eat it fresh.
Fresh bread is very tasty. Will you share a piece with me?
Of course! We will cut it when it cools down.
That sounds lovely. I am ready for a snack.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I hit the ball hard but it always goes into the net. How do I fix this?
Try aiming higher over the net. Do you serve with your right or left hand?
My arm feels very tired after ten minutes of play.
You should rest when your muscles hurt. Do you stretch before you start?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My bread is very flat. What do I do?
Is your yeast fresh? Try new yeast next time.
I used new yeast. Still flat.
Did you let it rest? Bread needs time to grow.
I did wait. It is still sad.
I do not know. Check your oven heat.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the beach today and saw a big turtle in the water.
That sounds like a fun day! Did the turtle swim away or stay close?
It swam away, but then I found a cool blue shell on the sand.
A blue shell is a nice find. Do you like picking up shells?
Yes, I love them, and the sun was very warm on my face.
That sounds very peaceful. Did you stay there for a long time?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at sailors. I do not know what they do all day.
They drive big boats on the water. Do you like the ocean?
Yes, I like the water. But I am still unsure what to do next.
I do not know what you should do next. Do you want to watch a video about them?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my boat in the mist. It feels so far away.
That is a scary feeling. Do you see any lights in the fog?
No, just gray water and dark sky. I am so tired.
Your boat is likely safe nearby. Did you bring a radio?
I left it home. I just wanted to row alone.
That is a hard choice. Would you like to sit and rest?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad because I have to leave my house.
That is a hard day. What is your favorite spot in the old home?
My little garden where I grew flowers.
It is okay to miss it. Do you plan to plant new flowers?
Yes, but the new box is too heavy to lift.
I can help you carry it. What is inside that box?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am mad because the water was too cold.
That is not fun. Do you like warm pools better?
Yes, I want to swim in warm water.
Warm water feels nice. Is it hard to get to a warm pool?
It is very far away.
I do not know how far it is. But you can rest first.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to sleep in a tent.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like the dark?
Yes, but I am scared of bugs.
We can use a net to keep them out. What is your biggest fear?
Big, scary spiders.
I do not have a magic fix for spiders. Do you have a teddy bear?
Yes, my blue bear is coming too.
He will keep you safe all night long.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the tree lose its leaves?
The tree lets them go so it can rest in the cold. Do you like playing in the fallen leaves?
Yes, they are fun to step on. Why is the snow white?
Snow is made of tiny ice crystals that catch the light. Do you wear a hat when it is cold?
Yes, I wear a warm red hat. Why does the sun make the flowers grow?
The sun gives the plants heat and light to make food. Do you like smelling the flowers?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the lighthouse so tall?
It is tall so the light goes far. Do you like looking at the sea?
Yes, I do. Why does the light move?
It spins to show ships where to go.
That makes sense. Why is it white?
White shines best in the dark. I do not know why it is not blue, though.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today. I saw a little red bird on a branch.
That sounds nice. Did you see any other animals?
Yes, a big brown dog was sleeping on the grass. I gave him my old shoe as a gift.
Oh no, that is a strange gift. Does he like it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I tried to build the tower, but it fell down. I want to stop.
That is very hard. Would you like to try one more small block?
Maybe. My hands feel tired and sad.
It is okay to feel tired. Do you want to rest for a moment first?
Yes, I will sit here. The red blocks look nice.
Good choice. Do you see any other red blocks nearby?
I see two more. They are under the blue ones.
That is right. Would you like to pick one up now?
Yes, I will try again. Thank you for helping.
You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found the best pie in the city today.
That sounds very sweet. What kind is it?
It is warm apple pie with fresh cream.
My mouth is watering just listening to you.
The smell was so good I could not stop smiling.
Joy is the best ingredient, isn't it?
Yes, it made me feel very happy and full.
I am glad you are feeling so good.
I want to go back tomorrow to share it with others.
That is a kind and lovely idea.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the exit?
It is just down that hall. Do you like art?
No, I am rushing. Is there a fast line?
Yes, look for the red sign.
I found it. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My boss made me redo the report three times because I used the wrong paper size.
That is very frustrating. Did you eat lunch?
I skipped it because I was too upset to look at the food.
That is not good for your body. Do you have a snack with you?
No, I just have a cup of cold coffee that tastes bad.
You need real food, not just bad coffee. Will you go home soon?
Yes, the door is unlocked and I am ready to leave.
That is a good plan. I hope your house feels warm and safe.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I really like apples.
Apples are sweet and crunchy. Do you like green ones or red ones?
I like the red ones with the juice.
That sounds tasty. Do you peel them first?
Yes, I always peel them.
Good, that keeps the skin off your fingers.
Sometimes I share them with my mom.
Sharing is very nice. Do you like apples for breakfast?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the box so small?
It is small because the gift is tiny. Do you like tiny things?
I like it, but why is the ribbon red?
I chose red because it feels warm. Is red your favorite color?
Yes, I love it. Why did you pick this gift?
I knew you needed a little joy.
Thank you, that makes me happy.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is great news. What made you smile so much?
I had a very good meeting at work.
Oh, that is lovely. Did you finish everything you needed to do?
Yes, I finished all my tasks.
Well done on that. How did the people in the room act?
They were all very nice and kind.
That is a good feeling. Do you feel proud now?
I do feel very proud.
That is wonderful. I am glad you told me.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am at the wrong station. The train is leaving soon.
Do not panic. Check your ticket again. Which platform is it for?
It says platform four. I am on platform two.
That is a problem. Walk fast to the doors. Is it still open?
The doors are closing. I am too late. I feel so bad.
I am sorry. You can buy a new ticket. Do you want help?
Yes, please. I do not know where to go.
Go to the box office. They can fix it. Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I felt very tired today. Why was it so hard?
The work was big and fast. Did you eat lunch?
I skipped lunch to finish the task. Why do I feel so low?
Your body needs rest and food. Did you take a break?
I only paused for one minute. Why does a small break help?
It lets your mind rest for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke the egg. Now the bowl is full of yolk. I do not want to cook.
That is okay. Let us make a simple egg salad instead. Do you have any lettuces?
I do have some. But it is still in the fridge.
Great. Let us get it out together. What is your favorite kind of dressing?
I like the sweet kind. The one with the orange color.
That is a good choice. It will make the salad taste nice.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we get a break from school?
It gives your mind a rest. Do you like the quiet time?
Why is the water so cold in the pool?
It helps you cool off in the heat. Do you swim fast?
Why are the shops so loud and busy?
Many people travel to this place at once. Do you enjoy the noise?
Why is the food so sweet?
I do not know the secret recipe. Do you like candy?
Why do we leave so early tomorrow?
The road is fast before it gets crowded. Will you sleep well?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream on the grass. I felt very sad.
That is a shame. Did you clean your hands?
I washed them at the sink. I did not cry again.
You showed great care. What is your next plan?
I walked to the park bench to sit. It felt quiet and good.
Taking a break is wise. Do you like the bench?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I need fast food.
Have you tried toast? Do you like it?
Yes, but I have no time to cut it.
I can cut it for you. Is that okay?
Please do. My bag is heavy.
That is kind. Can I take your bag?
No, I must keep it with me.
I see. Here is your toast.
Thank you. It is great. I am going now.
Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the soup red?
It has tomato in it. Do you like tomatoes?
I do. Why is it hot?
It is warm to keep it fresh. Are you hungry?
Yes, I am. What is the bread for?
You eat it with the soup. Do you want a roll?
I want a roll. Why do I need to pay?
The shop needs money to buy food. Would you like a drink too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know where to start with cleaning.
Start with the floor. Do you have a broom?
Yes, but the floor is very wet.
Use a dry towel first. I do not know the best brand.
I will try that now.
That is a good plan. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to solve my math homework today.
That is a big job. What was the hardest part?
I got stuck on the last problem for a long time.
I am sorry you struggled. Did you finally finish it?
Yes, I finished it, but I am not sure if it is right.
Great work trying your best. I do not know if it is correct.
My mom said I can check it tomorrow.
That sounds like a good plan. Are you feeling better now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I tried to build a tower, but it fell down.
That is hard. Did you try with the red blocks first?
Yes, but I do not know if I can make it stay up.
I do not know the secret, but you might ask me why it fell.
I do not care why. I just want to go outside and play.
That sounds like a good plan. Do you need help with your shoes?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a big secret.
That sounds exciting. What is it?
I found a shiny rock.
Wow, that is cool. Is it heavy?
It is very light.
That is interesting. Do you like it?
Yes, I do.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My fish looks very sad and stays at the bottom.
I am sorry to hear that. Is the water clean?
I changed the water today, but it still looks sad.
That is good. What did you feed it?
I gave it a lot of food because I wanted to help.
Oh, that might be the problem.
Did I hurt it by giving it too much?
Yes, too much food makes tanks dirty and sick.
I will take some out and watch him closely.
That is a kind thing to do.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My teacher is very strict and I feel sad. What should I do?
That sounds hard. Do you talk to your family about it?
Yes, but they say I should just try harder. I feel stuck.
It is nice they support you. What is one small thing you enjoy in class?
I like drawing, but I am bad at the tests.
You can show your teacher your drawings to explain your thinking.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need a gift for my friend. What should I get?
That is a sweet idea. Is she a fan of stories?
Yes, she loves books. But I do not know which one to pick.
A new notebook is always a good choice. Would she like to draw in it?
I think she does, but I am not sure. I want it to be special.
A pretty notebook with a pen feels very special. Does she have a favorite color?
Blue is her favorite. Where can I find a blue notebook?
You can look in a shop near your home. Do you have time to go today?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn to sing but I am afraid.
It is okay to be scared. Do you have a favorite song?
I like happy songs but my voice sounds bad.
Everyone starts with a bad voice. Try just humming first?
Humming feels strange in my head.
That is normal at first. What color does the music feel like to you?
I do not know what color it is.
That is fine, we can figure it out later.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is snowing outside and I do not know what to do.
That sounds fun. Do you like to play in the snow?
I am not sure. It looks very cold.
Cold is good for snow. Do you have a warm hat?
Yes, I have a hat. But I do not know if I should go out.
Going out is okay. Is your coat zipped up tight?
Yes, my coat is on. I am still feeling unsure.
Do not worry. Do you want to make a snow angel?
That sounds nice. I think I will just sit by the window for now.
That is a true choice. I like watching the snow fall too.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the rain took the rainbow away.
That is very tricky. Do you like colors?
Yes, I love red and blue.
They are bright colors. Do you want to draw one?
I do not have any crayons right now.
We can use chalk outside. Is the ground dry?
It is wet from the rain.
Chalk will wash away. Let us watch the sky together.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a box under my bed.
That is exciting. What is inside?
I think it is a gift.
Nice. Do you want to open it?
Yes, I do.
Great. Take your time.
Look, it is a toy dog.
Happy birthday. Is it for you?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I wrote a letter today. I am so happy. Do you want to read it?
That is wonderful news. Tell me, who is the letter for?
It is for my friend. I drew a sun in the corner.
A sun is a nice touch. Did you include all the good news?
Yes, I wrote about my dog too. He is very funny.
Dogs are always funny. I hope they love the letter.
I think they will. I feel warm inside now.
Sharing joy is a great feeling. Send it soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. I need food now.
Try some toast. It is fast. Do you like jam?
Yes, but I have no time to sit.
I will hand you the toast to eat on the go.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see the old ships. Where do I go?
Go straight down the left hall. Are you there for the day trip?
Yes, my teacher sent us. What is the most popular room?
The dinosaur hall is very busy. Do you like big bones?
I like the space rocks. Do you know where those are?
They are in the top floor. Is that where you want to go?
Yes, please take me there. Can we start walking now?
I cannot walk with you. But I can point the way up.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many cards do I get in this game?
You get five cards each. Are you playing with a full deck?
Yes, I am using all the cards.
That is good. Do you know how to count the points?
I think red cards are worth two points.
That sounds right. Is that the rule you are using?
I am not sure.
I do not know your exact rules. Are you looking at the box?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My tent fell down in the wind and now my socks are wet.
That is very frustrating. Do you have a dry bag?
Yes, I do, but it is too small for my clothes.
You can put your shoes in it. What is your favorite food to pack?
I like hot dogs, but the fire will not start.
Water in the wood stops the fire. Did you use dry wood?
I think I did, but it is not working at all.
Please do not give up. How high is the wind?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a paper boat?
You fold the paper in half to make a long strip. Do you have any paper ready?
Yes, I have some blue paper. Now what do I do next?
Fold the corners up to make a triangle shape.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a lot of music, but I do not know which song to play.
That is a nice problem to have. What kind of mood are you feeling?
I feel happy, but also a little sad.
I do not know the exact song for that mix. Do you like fast beats or slow tunes?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must run to the sand. Do I have time?
The sun is up, so you are safe. Why such a rush?
The waves look high. Will they stop me?
I do not know the waves. Do you like the cold spray?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a great new plan and I am so excited to tell you about it.
That sounds wonderful, what is the first step?
We will bake a big chocolate cake for the whole family this weekend.
I love the idea, will you help with the mixing?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I liked the dog in the movie.
That is nice. Did you pet him?
No, he was just on the screen.
He looked very happy there.
He got a big piece of cake.
Yum. What flavor was it?
Chocolate, with lots of sprinkles.
That sounds yummy to me.
I want cake like that tomorrow.
I hope you get some.
Thanks for watching with me.
I enjoyed it too.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad I work from home today.
That is a great feeling. How is your desk set up?
It is just a small table and a lamp.
Simple is often best. Do you like the quiet?
Yes, it is very peaceful and I can focus.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am running very fast.
That is great. Do you like to race?
Yes, I like to race with my dog.
Your dog must be very tired. What is its name?
Her name is Pip. She runs so well.
Pip sounds like a good runner.
Do you want to run with us?
I would love to, but I have no legs.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am sad because I do not know what to do for my birthday party.
Do you like playing games or eating sweet food?
I love cake and playing with my friends in the park.
That sounds like a very happy plan. Have you asked your friends if they can come?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have flour and water, but my dough feels too wet. What should I do?
Try adding a little more flour slowly. Do you have a scale?
Yes, I do. The bread did not rise in the oven. Was I wrong?
The yeast might have died. Did you use cold water?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Please wait.
Take your time. Are you okay?
I am so sorry.
It is okay. Do you need help?
No. I must go.
That is fine. Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just learned about the pyramids! Isn’t it cool how they built them so long ago?
Yes, they were very tall and strong. How did they move such big stones?
I think they used ramps and ropes. It must have been hard work.
That does sound like a lot of effort. What else are you reading about?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is your boss so nice to you?
She helps me when I am lost. Do you like your boss?
I do not know. What makes her kind?
She says good things about me. Do you get praise at work?
Sometimes. Does she pay you well?
I do not know the money part. Is pay important to you?
Yes, it is. Why do you work there then?
I feel happy every day. Do you feel happy?
I hope so. Why is that so rare?
Many bosses only want money. Do you want a nice boss?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My dog fell over in the grass.
Oh no, is he okay?
Yes, he just got up and ran.
That is good news.
I still felt a bit sad for him.
I am happy he is safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate this wind. It blows my hat away.
That is very annoying. Do you have a strap for your hat?
No, I lost it. Now I just feel cold.
Wind is cold when it moves fast. Do you want to sit in the shade?
Yes, please. It feels better here.
I am glad the shade helps. Is the wind softer now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Why does my bread get big?
The little bugs eat sugar and make gas. Do you like gas?
I need to know fast.
The gas gets stuck and pushes the bread up. Is it warm?
Can I skip the wait?
No, the bugs need time to work.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I made a new friend today.
That sounds lovely. What is their favorite game?
I am not sure yet. Why do you ask?
I want to know what makes you happy. Do you like the same games?
Yes, we both like tag.
Tag is a great choice. Do you play outside?
I run around the park. Why is running fun?
It makes your heart beat fast. Do you get tired after?
I am always tired.
Tired means you played hard. Do you feel good?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a hidden key in my room. What should I do?
That is a very strange find. Did you check the lock on the old chest?
I did not know what to do with it. It felt warm in my hand.
I do not know why it feels warm. Do you think it opens something nearby?
I am scared someone is watching me. I want to tell the truth.
Telling the truth is always the right path. Who do you trust to tell?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big bear today and I feel so happy.
That is wonderful to hear. What color was the bear?
It was brown and very soft looking.
I am glad you felt safe while watching it.
Yes, it just sat by the river.
That sounds like a calm day. Did you see any other animals too?
No, just the bear, but I love the forest.
Nature is a beautiful place to visit.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had the best party today. The cake was so sweet.
That sounds fun. Did you like the music?
Yes, we danced a lot. It was so happy.
I am glad you had a good time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is very loud today. How do I make a kite fly?
You need a strong, steady breeze for your kite. Do you have a big square of paper?
I have a small square, but it is flapping in my hands. What should I do?
That is not enough wind for a small paper. It might tear. Can you feel the air on your face?
It feels like a cold breath. Is that good for the kite?
Cold air often means good wind for flying. Hold the string tight and run. Do you know how to tie a loop?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I watched the moon rise last night and it looked like a big coin.
That sounds lovely. Did you see any stars too?
No, the sky was too cloudy to see anything else.
Clouds can hide the stars. Do you like the moon best?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a dog on the bus today.
That is a fun thing to see. Did the dog sit on a seat?
Yes, it sat on the empty seat by the door.
I am glad the dog was calm. Did you take a picture?
No, I was too busy smiling.
Smiling is a good way to enjoy a ride. Was the bus busy?
It was full of people, but everyone was nice.
Kind people make a ride better. Did you wave at the dog?
Yes, it wagged its tail at me.
That is a sweet moment to remember.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up feeling very cold and my nose is stuffy.
I am sorry you do not feel well. Did you drink warm water today?
Yes, but I also went to the park in the rain.
That was not a good idea. Are your clothes still wet?
My shoes are wet and I feel icky all over.
Oh no, wet shoes are very unpleasant. Do you have a dry pair at home?
I just got home and took them off.
Good, dry feet will help you feel better. Did you take any medicine?
No, I just want to sleep in my warm bed.
Sleep is the best cure for a cold. Have a good rest.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I failed the test today. I tried so hard, but it was too hard.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you get a low grade?
Yes, I only got a C. It feels like I gave up.
A C is not a bad start. Can we look at what you missed?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and found a sunny spot.
That sounds so nice. Did you bring any special snacks?
Yes, I had a big apple and some cookies.
Yum. Did you share any with a friend?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is very hot today. I do not know what to do.
You can play in the water. Do you like swimming?
I want to eat ice cream, but I do not know where to go.
I do not know your town. Is there a shop near your house?
I think I will just rest and read a book.
That sounds like a nice choice. What book are you reading?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big cloud. I do not know what to do.
You can just watch it float by. Do you like soft, white shapes?
I feel stuck. What should I do next?
Try to draw it on paper. Do you have a pencil?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my best cup. I am so mad at myself.
