I am sorry that happened. Did you hurt your hand?
No, I just slipped on the floor. It is a very pretty cup.
That is sad to lose. Do you have another one?
No, it was the only one I liked. I feel very bad.
It is okay to feel that way. Want to clean the glass?
Yes, I will go get a broom now.
Good luck with that. Be careful on the wet floor.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red boat today.
That sounds fun. Where was it?
It was near the dock.
Was it moving?
Yes, it went fast.
Cool. Did you get wet?
No, I stayed dry.
Good. Was it sunny?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. My boxes are heavy.
I can help you lift them. Are they full of books?
Yes, they are books. Please help me.
Okay, I am ready. Do you want me to hold the door?
Yes, please open it wide.
It is open. Good luck with your move.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am very lost and do not know what to do.
That feels bad. What is the first thing you are trying to fix?
I need to send a letter, but I have no idea how.
Do you have a stamp?
No, I never had one. What do I do now?
Go to a shop that sells mail things. They will help you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad. The words in my new book do not make sense to me.
That feels hard. Do you read with a friend?
Yes, but the words still feel too big and hard to say.
Try saying one word very slow. Is that easier?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I love the book about the fox and the grapes. Do you know the name of the story?
That sounds like a fable. Did you enjoy the part where the fox gives up?
I liked it because the fox is clever, but I do not know the exact title.
I am not sure of the name, but it is likely Aesop's Fables. Do you read many stories like that?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the children's corner. I am late.
It is down this hall on the left. Do you like picture books?
No, I need a story about a dog. Where are the shelves?
They are on the right side near the door. Are they brown dogs?
Yes, they are brown. I must go now.
Good luck with your story.
Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have a fun day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make soup but I do not know what to use.
You can try carrots and corn. Do you have any beef?
I have some chicken. Is that okay for soup?
Yes, chicken is good. Would you like it spicy?
I do not like spicy food. What else can I add?
Add some peas for color. I do not know if you like peas.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is this box so small?
It holds a tiny seed. Do you like plants?
I do! Why did you give me a seed?
So you can grow a new tree. Is your yard big enough?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate a big bowl of cold oats this morning.
That sounds heavy. Did you have any fruit with it?
Yes, I put in some red strawberries.
Oh, nice. They must have made it taste sweet.
I also walked the dog in the park.
That is a good way to start the day. Was the sun out?
It was cloudy and a bit cold.
I see. Did you bring a jacket with you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue boat today. It floated on the calm water.
That sounds peaceful. Did you hear the waves?
Yes, they went splash. I liked the sound.
Cool. Do you like boats or cars?
I like boats more. They move slow and steady.
Nice choice. Did you want to ride one?
I did. But I had to go home.
Oh well. See you around.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My computer is making a loud beep.
Is the screen still on?
Yes, but it is blinking red.
That is a sign of a problem. Have you tried turning it off?
I do not know how to turn it off.
Look for the big button near the power cord. Press it gently.
It is off now. The beeping stopped.
Good job. Do you want to try turning it back on?
I will wait for my dad.
That is a wise choice. He can help if it needs a fix.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The waves look so big and scary today.
That can feel very heavy. Do you like the sound of the water?
It just makes me feel small and cold.
It is true that the sea is huge. Are you wearing a warm coat?
Yes, but I still feel a bit sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. What makes you feel happy?
I guess I miss playing in the sand.
I do not know where you played. Can we walk together for a bit?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to go in the water, but I am scared of the deep part.
That is okay. Do you like shallow water?
Yes, I like shallow water. What should I try first?
Try floating on your back in the shallow end. Is that okay?
I am not sure if I can stay up.
Keep your face in the water and breathe out slowly. You are doing great.
I think I am getting better.
That is true. Do you want to try the deep part?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is this big blue spot on the map?
That is a lake. Does it look calm to you?
I want to swim there. Is it safe?
I am not sure. Please check with a local guide.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because dinner is almost ready.
That sounds great. What are you making?
It is a warm soup with carrots and potatoes.
Yum. Do you have some bread to go with it?
Yes, I have fresh bread on the table.
Nice. I do not know if you added any herbs.
I put in a little bit of thyme.
Oh, that must smell good. Are you eating alone?
No, my family is coming home soon.
How nice. I hope they enjoy the meal.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do sailors sleep on land?
No, they sleep on boats. Do they like the dark?
Yes, they do. I must go now.
That is true. The sea is quiet at night.
Goodbye. I am running.
Bye. Do they watch for stars?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today.
That is wonderful news. What made you smile?
I helped my neighbor carry her bags.
You are very kind to help. Did she say thank you?
Yes, she gave me a warm hug.
That must feel nice. Do you want to help again tomorrow?
Yes, I love making people smile.
Helping is a great joy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a bee today and I am so happy to tell you about its magic work!
That is a lovely thing to share. What did the bee do first?
It flew to a flower and drank the sweet nectar inside.
Yes, that is exactly right. Does it carry the nectar on its feet?
No, it keeps it in a special bag in its tummy.
I am not sure what to call that bag, but it works well. Do you know where it goes next?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My head hurts and my nose runs. I do not know what to do.
Drink some warm water and rest in bed. Is your throat itchy too?
My throat feels dry and scratchy.
You can sip on warm tea with honey. Do you have any fever?
Yes, I feel very hot.
If the fever gets bad, please see a doctor.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to run, but my legs feel heavy. I do not know where to begin.
That is a normal feeling. Do you like to go outside or stay in?
I like outside, but it is raining. What should I do now?
Try a short walk inside first. It helps your body wake up.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I set up my tent near the big oak tree this morning.
That sounds like a good spot. Did you find a nice view?
Yes, I saw a deer by the creek right after breakfast.
How lovely. What did it look like?
It was brown with white spots on its back.
That is a sweet sighting. Did you bring any snacks for the day?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did the dragon not burn the village?
It was too friendly to hurt them. Do you like dragons?
Yes, but why was the magic spell so weak?
The wizard ran out of sleep. Were you watching closely?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like playing tennis?
Yes, I love hitting the ball. Do you play too?
I have a red racket.
That sounds like a great racket. What color is your ball?
It is yellow and fuzzy.
A yellow ball is perfect for fun. Do you have a friend to play with?
My dad plays with me.
That is a very good idea. Do you like to run after the ball?
I like to run and jump.
Running and jumping makes you strong. How high can you jump?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate a big peach today. It was so sweet and juicy.
Peaches are very tasty. Did you buy it at the market?
I picked it from my grandfather's tree. It was still a little hard.
Grandfather's trees are a special treat. Do you visit him often?
We went to the park after we ate. It was a nice, sunny day.
That sounds like a perfect day. I am glad you had fun.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did a very good job today. I feel happy inside.
That sounds lovely. I am glad for you.
I painted a big red sun. It looks bright and warm.
A red sun is a nice choice. Did you use two colors?
Yes, I mixed orange for the rays. I think it shines.
That sounds like a bright picture.
My teacher gave me a star for it. I kept it in my pocket.
A star is a great prize. Does it feel smooth?
It feels a bit crinkled now. But I keep it safe.
Keeping it safe is good care.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are we going to the park today?
The sun is out and the air is fresh. Do you want to ride your bike?
How do we get the bike ready?
We need to check if the tires have air. Is the seat high enough for you?
Why do we check the brakes first?
Brakes help us stop safely. Do you know how to use them?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake a cake for my birthday.
That is a fun idea. What kind of flavor do you want?
I like chocolate.
Chocolate is delicious. Do you have the tools to mix it?
I have a bowl and a spoon.
Great. Stir the mix until it is smooth.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My brother got a new dog.
That is very exciting. Does he have a name for it?
Yes, it is called Spot.
Spot sounds like a fun name. Is he a big dog or a small one?
He is small and brown.
Small brown dogs are cute. Do you get to play with Spot too?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the sky look so blue in summer?
The sun shines bright, so the air scatters light. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, but why does it get cold in winter?
The earth tilts away from the sun, so less heat comes here. Do you like snow?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now. Do trees like rain?
Yes, trees drink rain. Do they drink with their roots?
I really need to leave. What do trees smell like?
Fresh and green. I do not know why. Do you like the smell?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How does a big ship stay on top of the water?
It stays up because it pushes water down, and the water pushes it back. Do you have a toy boat to test this?
I want to make my own boat that floats.
You can use a piece of cardboard and seal it with tape. Do you want to try it now?
I will fold the edges up to hold water.
That is a smart way to keep the inside dry.
What if I put too many stones on top?
The boat will sink if the weight is too heavy. Do you want to weigh your stones first?
I will use light beads instead.
That is a safe choice for a first try.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a bug hotel for my garden?
Use an old wooden crate and fill it with dry sticks, leaves, and straw. Do you have a crate ready?
Yes, but how do I keep the bugs safe inside?
Just put the open side facing down so rain does not get in. Do you live in a rainy place?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my red keys and I feel very sad. Can you find them for me?
I do not know where they are. Are they under the blue cushion?
No, I already looked there. Please help me think.
That is a good try. Did you check the hall table?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I saw bees buzzing around flowers. How do they make honey?
They drink sweet water from the flowers. Do you know what that water is called?
No, I do not. What is it?
It is called nectar. The bees bring it back to the hive.
Why do they bring it to the hive instead of drinking it there?
They store it to eat later in winter. Did you know they work very hard?
Yes, I see them flying all day. How do they change the nectar into honey?
They fan it with their wings to dry it out. That makes it sweet and thick.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make an omelet but I am not sure how to start.
That is a great choice. Do you have some eggs and butter ready?
Yes, I have both, but do I need to do anything else?
You just mix them together in a bowl. Do you have a spoon for that?
Yes, I have a spoon. How do I get them into the pan?
Pour them in slowly on a hot day. Do you like your eggs soft or firm?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The bad apples ruined my day.
That is truly sad. Did you buy any good ones?
I want to go home now.
I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many days are in a week?
There are seven days in a week. Do you like the weekend?
I love Saturdays. Which day comes after Sunday?
Monday comes after Sunday. Do you go to school on Mondays?
Yes, I do. What is the last day of the week?
The last day is Sunday. Do you play outside on that day?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke my cup and I do not know what to do.
That is okay. Did it hit the floor?
Yes, I was not looking where I was going.
Let us get the broom. Do you have one?
I think so, but I am scared to pick up the glass.
Wear your shoes first. Are your feet safe?
Yes, I am wearing my big shoes now.
Good. Sweep the small bits first. Do you see them?
Yes, I am sweeping them into a pile.
Nice work. Put the pile in the can.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad and stuck about my grandmother.
I hear you. She is feeling better today, right?
I do not know if she is happy or just bored.
That is a hard thing to see. Do you sit with her often?
I want to help, but I do not know what to do.
You do not need a big plan. Do you like to read to her?
Maybe, but I am afraid I will say the wrong thing.
It is okay to make mistakes. Just share the story.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a really good day at work today.
That sounds nice. What made it so good?
My boss gave me a big hug and a smile.
Hugs are warm and sweet. Did you feel happy?
Yes, I felt very warm inside.
Warmth is a good thing to have.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a meeting soon. Will I be okay?
Yes, you will be fine. Do you know what it is about?
I do not know what it is about.
Let us go together. I will help you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am angry that walking feels so hard today.
That is okay. Tired legs are common. Do you want to rest?
No, I need to do it for my heart.
Your heart will thank you. How far did you go?
I barely made it down the block.
That is a good start. One step is enough.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my house hot using the sun?
Put dark things in the light to warm them up. Do you like warm socks?
Yes, I love warm things. Where do I put the glass?
You can put clear glass before the sun to keep heat inside. Do you have any windows?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am at the lighthouse but I do not know what to do.
Do you want to climb the tower?
I am not sure. I feel very small.
That is okay to feel. Are you afraid of the dark?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at this map, where is the red dot?
I think that is the big castle. Do you like castles?
Yes, I do, but I am lost now.
We can find the way together. What color is your house?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes. Can you help me?
Sure, let us start with making a loop with one end of the lace. Do you have a small loop ready?
Yes, I made a loop with this side. What do I do now?
Take the other end and twist it over the first loop to make a knot. Is it tight enough for you?
It feels a bit tight. How do I make it stronger?
Pull the loops up and out to make a bow. Do they stay together?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we start with the list?
It helps us see everything we need. What are the first things?
Why not just grab random items?
That might make us miss something important. Do we have a special place?
Why do we need a special place?
It keeps our things safe and ready. Do you like boxes or bags?
Why are boxes better than bags?
Boxes stack well and hold their shape. I do not know what fits best.
Why does the order matter so much?
It makes the work faster and less messy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say sorry?
We say it to tell them we are sad they are hurt. Do you feel sorry when you drop your toy?
I think so. But why does it help them?
It helps because it makes them feel safe again. It is a kind word that fixes things.
What if you did not mean to do the bad thing?
Then you still say sorry to show you care. Do you think that is fair?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read my favorite book today while eating soup.
That sounds cozy. Did you warm up your hands with the cup?
I also lost my glasses and had to find them under the cat.
Cats love to hide things. Were you able to read after that?
The cat sat on the book and purred all night.
That is a lucky cat. Do you let him keep the spot?
I had to move him to the sofa to finish my story.
A good night of reading. Did you finish the last page?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a nice blanket for my picnic. How do I do that?
You can fold a soft towel in a square and tie the corners with a ribbon. Do you have any ribbons at home?
I do not have any ribbons. What else can I use to keep the towel neat?
You can use a clip or a small book to weigh down the towel. Are you taking sandwiches with you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work. What is the moon?
It is a big rock that shines at night. Are you rushing to school or work?
Work. Why does it glow?
It reflects light from the sun. Do you like looking up?
Not when I am busy. Is it far away?
It is very far away. Have you seen it today?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to draw a simple house.
Start with a big square for the walls. Do you like squares?
Yes, I like squares. What is next?
Now draw a triangle on top for the roof. Is your roof big?
Yes, it is big. How do I finish it?
Add a small square for the door and two dots for windows.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad I helped my neighbor carry her bags.
That is a kind thing to do. How did she look when you helped?
She was smiling and told me thank you.
That must feel warm inside.
Yes, it does. I want to help more people too.
That is a good goal. Who else do you wish to help?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to buy a cake for my mom.
What kind of cake does she like best?
She likes chocolate very much.
We have a big chocolate cake. Would you like to see it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people move to new houses?
It is often because they need more space. Do you like your room?
Sometimes I feel small in my room.
That can be hard. Is it too dark there?
No, but I have too many toys.
A new home might have more floor space. Do you have a big bed?
My bed is just right.
I am glad you like it. I do not know your future plans.
I am just guessing.
Guessing is okay. What do you hope for?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel so alone. I must go.
That is a heavy feeling. I do not know your story. How long have you felt this way?
Since the rain started. I am late.
Please stay safe. Does the rain make you feel smaller?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to sing soon, but I am scared.
You will do fine. Do you like high songs?
No, I only hum low notes.
That is a good start. Do you have time to practice?
I have only five minutes left.
Sing one line slowly. Can you pick a simple song?
I will try right now.
Good luck. How was that for you?
It felt easy.
Great. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost and do not know where to go.
Let us look at the big map. Do you see the red dot?
I do not know what that means.
It means you are here. Where do you want to go?
I just want to find my home.
We will walk to the main square.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go on a trip in summer. Where should I go?
A beach sounds fun. Do you like the water?
Yes, I love swimming. Is it busy there?
It can be crowded. Do you like crowds?
No, I like quiet places. What else can I do?
A forest is peaceful. Do you like trees?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to bring a map?
It helps you find the way if you get lost. Do you like to explore?
Why is the sleeping bag so big?
I am not sure why yours is that size. Is it for a very cold night?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Ugh, this chair leg just snapped off. I am so mad.
That sounds very bad. Do you have glue?
No, I only have tape. It is not strong enough.
Tape will not work. Do you have any wood?
I have some broken toys in a box. Can I use them?
That is a smart idea. Can you cut them?
I have a small knife. I am not sure it is safe.
Be very careful with that. What is the shape of the leg?
It is long and thin. It looks like a pencil.
Okay. Does it look straight?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big dinosaur bone in the box.
That sounds cool. Do you think it was hungry?
Yes, it looked like it wanted to eat.
Dinosaurs are big and scary. What color was the room?
It was dark with yellow lights.
A dark room makes it look mysterious. Did you take a picture?
No, my friend said no phones.
That is a good rule. Do you like the rules?
Yes, but I want to go inside now.
Great, enjoy your trip. Have a good time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I caught a big fish today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What kind of fish was it?
It was a silver trout.
Nice work. Do you eat it?
Yes, I made soup with it.
That smells good. Did you catch anything else?
I also caught two small ones.
Great job. Are you going back tomorrow?
I am. I love the quiet water.
The quiet is a nice part too.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my bread get big?
Tiny bugs eat sugar and make gas. Does that sound fun?
Yes, I like bugs. Why does it taste sweet?
The bugs make sugar to eat. Do you like honey?
Yes, it is sweet. How do I stop it?
Heat kills the bugs fast. Do you use an oven?
Yes, I always do. Is that all there is?
Yes, heat stops the growing. Great job baking!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need to move my big bookshelf but it is too heavy. How do I lift it?
You should ask for help. Can you get a friend to lift with you?
My friend is not here today. I must do this alone.
Break it into small steps. Do you have a dolly?
I have a cart. How do I load the shelf onto it?
Tilt the shelf back slowly. Is the cart wheel turned toward you?
Yes, the wheel points to me. Now what?
Push the shelf base over the cart rails. Can you hold it steady?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people read books at night?
It helps your brain rest and sleep. Do you read before bed?
I do, but it is getting dark.
Yes, the light can make your eyes tire. Do you use a lamp?
I use a small lamp.
That is good for your eyes. I do not know if it helps you sleep better.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do you know where the dinosaur hall is? I am late.
Yes, it is upstairs. Are you going there alone?
I am alone. How long will it take to get there?
It takes about five minutes. Do you like small animals?
I do not care. I must go now.
I hope you have fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Does this bus go to the big park?
Yes, it does. Are you going to play?
I hope the rain stops soon. Do you like the rain?
I like it when it makes the flowers grow. Is your bag heavy?
It is just my lunch and a book. Does the bus stop at the ice cream shop?
I do not know for sure. Would you like ice cream today?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy. I love how sailors climb tall masts.
That is a nice feeling. Do you like the view from up high?
Yes, it is very free. I want to sail on a big boat too.
That sounds like fun. Do you know how to tie a rope?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel all alone and sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have anyone to talk to?
Not really. I just sit here.
That sounds hard. What do you like to do when you have time?
I like to draw. But my room feels empty.
Drawing is a nice thing to do. Would you like to try drawing a friend?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My boss yelled at me for a mistake. I feel so bad.
That sounds really unfair. Did you ask why he was so mad?
No, I just want to go home and cry.
I am sorry you have a tough day. Please rest well tonight.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am making soup today.
That sounds good. What are you putting in it?
I found a single tomato in the bin.
A sad tomato. Did you wash it?
Yes, but it has a big bruise.
That is still food. You can cut the bad part off.
I hope it tastes good.
It will be warm and tasty.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I want to make a plan.
That is great news. What is the first step?
I will pack my bag. I have a big smile on my face.
A big smile is nice. What are you packing?
Just some snacks. I am ready to go.
Sounds tasty. Where are you going?
To the park. The sun is out.
That is a good place. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My timepiece stopped today. It just sat still on the wall.
That sounds upsetting. Does it have a battery inside?
I checked. The battery is dead. The hands will not move.
You found the problem. How do you usually fix it?
I buy a new one. The round part stores power for the gears.
That is very smart. I am glad your day is done.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look up! The moon is so bright and round today.
It is very beautiful. Do you like the full moon?
Yes, it feels like a big light in the sky.
It is far away but shines here. Do you want to know why it is round?
Please tell me, I am so happy to see it.
It looks round because we see all its light.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I had a scary dream last night. I feel sad and unsure what to do now.
I am sorry to hear that. Dreams can feel very real. Did you wake up feeling tired?
Yes, I am very tired. I do not know how to fix my bad mood.
Try to drink some cold water. It helps your body rest. Do you have a favorite warm blanket?
I have a soft blue blanket. But I am still confused about why I feel this way.
I do not know why you feel that way. Feelings can be hard to name. Would you like to sit with me in silence for a bit?
That sounds nice. I think I just need a moment.
I will stay right here with you. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big bear eating berries by the lake this morning.
That sounds like a fun surprise. Was the bear friendly?
It looked at me, but it did not come near.
It is good to stay far away from wild animals. Did you tell your family?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The cake looks bad.
That is a big deal. What does it look like?
It is lopsided and brown. I wanted white.
I am sorry. Did you tell the baker?
Yes, but he said it was fine. I feel cheated.
That is not fair. Do you have photos?
I sent one to you. Look at it.
I cannot see your screen. But I believe you.
Then help me fix this. Please.
I can call the shop with you. Are you ready?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I forgot which month comes after May. I feel so silly.
That is June. Do you like summer?
Yes, but I hate when people ask me to remember all of them.
It is hard to know them all. Why do you need to know the order?
Just to keep track of things. I am tired of getting it wrong.
You will get it right next time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found two red apples in the basket.
Two is a good number! Did you find any green ones too?
No, just the red ones.
That is very neat. Do you know what comes after two?
Yes, it is three!
You are smart! Three comes right after two.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big secret to tell you.
I am all ears! What is it?
I am going to bake a giant cake.
A giant cake sounds fun. What color is it?
It is red with green frosting.
That sounds very sweet. Happy baking!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My cat just fell asleep in my lap.
That is a lovely sign of trust. Does she purr when you hold her?
Yes, she hums like a tiny engine.
That sound is very calming. What is her name?
Her name is Moon.
A sweet name for a quiet cat.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so happy when my boss smiles at me.
That is a lovely feeling. Does he smile often?
He is always kind to everyone in the office.
A kind boss makes work much easier. Do you feel safe with him?
Yes, I trust him completely.
Trust is a very good thing to have.
How can I be a kind leader like him?
That is a great goal. Start by listening to your friends.
I will try to listen more.
That is a wonderful start.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to feel happy today.
I can help you with that. Do you like to draw?
Yes, I love to draw pictures.
Draw a picture of something you love. It is a nice way to feel good.
What if I do not feel better?
Try taking a deep breath. Do you have a favorite snack?
Yes, I like cookies.
Eating a cookie can help. I hope you feel happy soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a paper boat. How do I fold it?
You start with a square of paper. Do you have some?
Yes, I have a square. What is the first step?
Fold the paper in half to make a line. Do you know how to crease it?
I do. Now what?
Fold the top corners down to the middle line. It makes a point.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very sad today. Can you help me?
I am here to listen. What made you feel this way?
I lost my favorite toy. Why does it hurt so much?
It hurts because you loved it. Do you have other toys you like?
Yes, but this one was special. How do I stop the crying?
Take slow breaths to calm down. Do you want to talk about the toy?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the magnet stick to the fridge?
It likes metal. Does it stick to your pencil?
No, it only sticks to the metal. Why is that?
Friction helps hold it tight. I do not know all the science. Do you have other metals?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My dog eats dirt and will not stop. What can I do?
Sometimes dogs do this to get more fiber. Is your dog acting sick?
No, he seems fine. He just runs to the yard and digs it up.
I do not know the exact cause, but you can try adding veggies to his food.
That is a good idea. How much vegetable should I give him?
Start with a small spoonful to see how he reacts. Do you feed him dry food?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad about my teacher.
I am sorry to hear that. What happened?
She gave me a low score on my test.
That is not fair. Did you study hard for it?
Yes, I studied all week.
That is very hard work. How do you feel about the grade?
I feel angry and tired.
Anger is a normal feeling. Do you want to talk about it?
Yes, please listen to me.
I am listening.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I fixed the light switch all by myself.
That is great work. Did you have to climb a chair?
Yes, I stood on the big chair and felt very tall.
Good. Please tell a grown-up next time so they can help.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That is a fun goal to have. Are you scared of falling?
Yes, I am afraid of breaking my legs.
You will learn to balance slowly. Do you have a helmet?
No, I do not have a helmet.
You must buy a helmet first. That keeps your head safe.
I can buy one at the shop.
Good plan. Can your friend help you practice?
I think my friend can help me.
Great. Have fun with your friend.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this rain at all.
It is a very gray day. Do you like the sound of the rain?
No, it makes everything wet and cold.
I agree that it feels chill. Have you had a warm drink?
I tried, but it just made me sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Is the sun coming out soon?
I do not know, I just want it to stop.
I hope it stops quickly for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because the sun is out.
That is a great reason to smile. What do you love most about the sun?
I love how warm it feels on my face.
Warmth is a wonderful feeling.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I dreamt I was flying and then I fell. I want to learn how to fly like a bird.
I know birds have wings, but people do not. Did you feel happy or scared in the dream?
It was very scary. How do people jump far without hurting themselves?
You can practice jumping on soft grass or sand to learn balance.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Oh no, the lights went out. I do not like the dark.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a flashlight nearby?
Yes, I am holding one, but I feel grumpy. Why did this happen?
It may be a bad wire or bad weather. I do not know the exact reason, but I hope it ends soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do so many people walk so fast here?
They are in a big hurry to work. Do you like the busy noise?
Why do the cars honk all the time?
The drivers feel stressed. Is that loud today?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did the meeting end so fast?
The team solved the big problem. Did you like how quick it was?
Why did we not talk about the new plan?
I do not know the full reason.
Why is the boss looking so tired?
She worked very hard all day. Are you feeling good?
Why are we cleaning up the chairs?
We want the room to look nice for tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so good today because the sun is out.
That is a great thing to feel. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I do love them very much.
I am glad you are happy. It is a nice thought.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My tomatoes have tiny holes in the leaves and I am very sad about it.
Little bugs often like to eat leaves. Do you see any small bugs on the plants?
I looked but I did not see anything, only the bad spots.
That is hard to guess without seeing. Some bugs hide inside the leaves during the day.
That feels like a trap for my nice plants. What can I do about them?
You can wash the leaves with soft water. Does that help wash them off?
I think I will try that tomorrow morning then.
That is a good plan for you. Keep your eyes open for bugs.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The clouds look so heavy and gray.
That sounds tough. Do you think they are about to rain?
Maybe. I just want the sun to come out.
I hope the sun peeks through soon. Do you like sunny days?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love how the clock ticks so steadily.
That sound is a small motor moving the hands. Do you listen to it often?
Yes, I hear it in my bedroom at night.
It helps keep time while you sleep. Why does that sound make you happy?
It feels like time is moving just for me.
That is a sweet way to see it. Do you ever check the time while listening?
Sometimes, but mostly I just let it tick.
Letting it tick is a calm way to relax.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the trees so green here?
They get plenty of rain. Do you like green?
Yes. But why is the lake so quiet?
The water is still today. Is it windy where you come from?
It is windy there. Why do the people walk so slowly?
They enjoy the calm air. Do you walk fast?
I run a lot. Is there a big park nearby?
Yes, there is one by the hill. Do you play in parks?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Guess what? I have big good news.
I am so happy for you. What happened?
I got a new puppy at the store.
A puppy? That is wonderful. Is he cute?
Yes, he has soft brown fur.
How nice to have a friend. What is his name?
I called him Bob.
Bob sounds friendly. Does he like to play?
He loves to chase balls all day.
That sounds like fun.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today.
That sounds like a nice place. Did you see any dogs?
Yes, I saw a big brown dog.
Big dogs can be scary sometimes. Was it friendly?
It was very kind and let me pet it.
That is a happy ending to your day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I use the sun to dry my wet clothes?
Hang them where the light touches them. Do you have a place to hang them?
Yes, I have a line by the window.
Put them on the line and wait a few hours.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see red light in the sky. Is it fire?
It looks like a fire far away. Are you safe inside?
Yes, I am home. How can I help?
You can just watch from your window.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a rainbow outside today. It was so bright.
That looks like a lot of fun. Do you like the red part the best?
Yes, I do. But how does it really get made?
Rain and sun work together to make those colors. Do you see two rainbows ever?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my little fish sitting at the bottom?
It might be sick or very tired. Does it have any open sores?
No, it looks clean, but it does not swim much.
That is good, but you should check the water for bad smells. How is the water temperature today?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I held the door open for a lady today.
That was very kind of you. Did she say thank you?
Yes, she smiled and said thank you.
Smiles are a nice reward for good manners. What happened next?
Then I saw someone drop a coin.
I do not know what you did with the coin. Did you pick it up?
I picked it up and gave it to the owner.
That was the right thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I failed again. I feel so bad.
That feels heavy. Do you want to try just one more small part?
I don't know if I can do it right.
It is okay to be scared. Did the first part feel okay?
I think so, but the end is hard.
Let us fix the end together. Do you want my help?
Yes, please show me.
We will look at it step by step. Ready to start?
Okay, let's go.
Good. You are doing fine.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am late and do not know what to do.
Did you lose your watch?
I think so, but I am not sure.
Let us check your pockets together.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very lost right now.
That is okay. What worries you most?
I do not know where to start.
I can guide you step by step. Is this about work or home?
It is about my house.
Tell me what is broken.
The door is stuck shut.
I know how to fix that. Do you have a tool?
I have a small knife.
That is a safe choice. Do not force it.
I am scared it will break.
Take your time. Do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel very tired today, but I am also happy to tell you.
Thank you for sharing. Are you having a good time?
Yes, I played all day with my friends in the park.
That sounds like a lot of fun.
I am sleepy now because I ran and jumped a lot.
Your body is just telling you to rest. Do you like sleeping?
I do. I like to dream big dreams when I close my eyes.
Dreams are a nice way to keep going.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the bread?
It is on the top shelf. Do you need milk too?
Yes. Thank you.
The milk is next to the eggs. Take your time.
I must go now.
Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I built my new shed today. I am so happy to show you.
That is great. What color did you paint it?
I used bright blue. It looks like the sky.
Nice choice. Did you build it alone?
Yes, I did. It was hard but fun.
Well done.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late today. The sun was very bright.
That sounds like a nice way to start the day. Did you eat breakfast?
I ate some cold eggs. They were a bit hard.
Oh no, that is not a good taste. Do you like eggs at all?
I do not like hard eggs. I want soft ones next time.
That is a smart plan. Soft eggs are usually nicer.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the fish sick?
It looks happy. Do you feed it?
I forget. What do I do?
Give it food. Is it jumping?
No. It is still.
That is good. Go now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I got my bike back today after the shop fixed it.
That is good news. Do you plan to ride it soon?
Yes, I want to go to the park, but I am scared of the hill.
You can go slow. It is safe.
I will try that. Thank you.
Good luck. I hope you have fun.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a song that makes me feel really good.
That is a lovely feeling. What is the song about?
It is about dancing in the rain.
Dancing in the rain sounds like fun. Do you like the drums?
Yes, the drums are very strong.
I am glad the song makes you happy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my little brother right now. He is not at school.
Did you check his room? It is a very common spot for him to hide.
No, I did not check there. The school is closing in five minutes.
Do you have his phone? You can call it to hear where he is.
I lost my phone this morning. I do not know where he is.
I am sorry I cannot help you locate him. Please check the closet first.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so lost in this loud place.
Take a deep breath. Is there a specific spot you are trying to find?
I just want to see the tall buildings from a high spot.
Go to the park with the big clock.
I do not know where that park is.
It is near the river. Do you like the sound of water?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a ball. What shape is it?
It is round like an apple. Do you like to kick it?
I have a book. What shape is it?
It is a rectangle. Do you read it at night?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I slept so well last night.
That is great to hear. Did you take a nap?
No, I just had a good dream.
Dreams are fun. What was it about?
I flew over a green field.
How did that feel?
It felt light and calm.
That is a nice feeling.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sea so blue?
The water takes in colors but reflects blue light to your eyes. Do you see the sky above it?
Yes, it looks like the sky. Why is the water wet?
Water is a liquid, so it sticks to things and feels damp. Have you ever touched dry sand?
The sand is not wet. Why does the sea move up and down?
I am not sure of all the causes, but the moon pulls on the water. Do you like the sound of waves?
It sounds like a song. Why is the sea salty?
Rain washes salt from rocks into the water over many years. Do you taste it when you swim?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I love that story about the little red house.
That is a sweet tale. Do you read it at night?
Yes, it makes me feel safe.
Good feeling to have. Do you like the big bad wolf?
No, he is scary. I want a book like that but with no scary parts.
Try books about gentle animals. Do you like cats?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I fix my broken bike chain?
First, you need to push the link back together. Do you have a small screwdriver?
Yes, I found one.
Great, use it to lift the lever on the clip.
It is stuck tight.
If it does not work, try an oil drop to help. Can you find some oil?
Yes, my sister has some.
That sounds like a good plan.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling. It felt very real. I feel sad now.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you wake up with a fast heart?
Yes, I jumped out of bed. What should I do to feel better?
Try to sit up and breathe slow. Do you like warm drinks?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very happy about my test. Why does my heart beat so fast?
Your body is excited to share your win. Do you want to tell me what score you got?
I did well on the spelling. Why do I feel so warm inside?
Warmth comes from knowing you worked hard. What word was the hardest for you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what time it is.
Look at the big hand. Does it point to the twelve?
The big hand points to the six.
That means it is half past. Do you know which hour it is?
The small hand is on the three.
So it is three thirty. Are you happy to know?
Yes, I am happy now.
I am glad it helped.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I love football, but it is very hard.
It is hard at first. Do you play with friends?
Yes, I play on weekends.
That is nice. Why do you like it so much?
I like to run and kick the ball.
Running is fun. Do you watch games on TV?
Sometimes I watch the big games.
That can be exciting. Do you have a favorite team?
My dad has a shirt for a team there.
That is a great start. Do you want to learn a new trick?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love my small village.
That sounds lovely. What is your favorite thing there?
The big tree by the pond.
Trees make nice seats. Do you sit there often?
Yes, I read books there.
Reading is fun. What kind of stories do you like?
I like stories about animals.
Animals are great friends. Do you have a pet?
I have a cat named Spot.
Cats are soft. How is your day going?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my red shirt in the mud today.
Oh no, that is sad. Do you have a brush to clean it?
Yes, I brushed off the big clumps.
That was smart. Are you ready to wash it now?
I put it in the small load.
Good choice. Do you like how it smells after?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I tried to make jam, but I put in too much sugar. It tastes bad.
Oh no, that sounds sweet and hard. Do you have any lemon juice?
Yes, I do. How much should I add to fix it?
Start with one spoon. Mix it well, then try a small bit.
It still tastes a bit too sweet. What else can I do?
Maybe add more fruit. Have you tried adding some fresh strawberries?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I pulled out all the weeds today and my hands hurt.
That sounds hard. Do you have any water to drink?
Yes, I am drinking juice now.
That is good. What is growing in your box?
I have some green carrots that are very tall.
Carrots like to be in the dark. Do they have enough sun?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a fence for my flowers.
A fence can keep deer away. How high do you need it to be?
About three feet, I think.
That is a good height. Do you want to dig deep holes?
I am not sure how deep.
Dig holes as deep as your hands are long. Is your soil hard to dig?
The dirt is very hard there.
You can soak the dirt first. Do you have a shovel?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a kite fly in the wind?
You need a string and a light paper shape. Do you have a stick?
Yes, I have a stick.
Use the stick to hold the kite high. Run with it facing the wind.
What if there is no wind?
Then you cannot fly it outside. Do you like planes?
I do like planes.
But planes also need moving air. You must wait for a windy day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am on the island and do not know what to do.
That sounds fun. Do you like the beach?
I like the beach, but I am tired of looking at sand.
Maybe walk to the trees. They are quiet there.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. What should I do?
Please rest and drink water. Do you have a fever?
No, I do not.
That is good. Just sit still for now.
Should I take medicine?
I do not know if you need pills. How long has it hurt?
All day today.
You should see a doctor then. Is your home close to one?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My phone screen is dark and it will not turn on.
Did you plug it into the charger? I want to know if the battery is low.
I tried, but the light does not come on.
That is strange. I do not know why the charger failed.
I feel lost. What should I do now?
Please press the power button and hold it for ten seconds. Do you see any light?
Yes, a small light appeared.
That is good news. It may take a few minutes to start.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make my morning tea taste better. How do I do that?
That is a great goal. Do you like sweet or strong tea?
I like it strong, but I always get a bad aftertaste.
You should use fresh, cool water for the leaves. Warm water can make it taste bitter.
That is good to know. What about the time it sits in the cup?
Try letting it sit for only three minutes. Do you watch a clock while you wait?
I usually leave it until I finish my whole routine.
That is why it tastes so thick. Try a timer for the next cup.
I will set a timer for three minutes today.
That is a smart move. Enjoy your new cup of tea.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found my old chair in the yard.
That is great news. Do you like its color?
It is blue and it looks strong now.
You did a good job cleaning it. Is it steady?
Yes, it does not wobble when I sit.
That is very safe and good.
I feel so happy to have it back.
Happy is a good feeling.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big news to tell you.
That sounds exciting. What is it?
I am going to have a baby brother.
How wonderful for your family. How do you feel about it?
I am very happy and a bit nervous.
Your excitement is clear. Good luck with the new arrival.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! My clock is ticking again.
That is wonderful news. What makes you so happy?
It tells me the time for nap time.
Ticking clocks are fun to hear. Do you like the sound?
Yes, it goes tick tock all day long.
I love that rhythm. How does it keep time?
A small spring pushes the hands around.
The spring gives it power to move. Do you wind it every day?
Yes, I wind it right before bed.
That is a nice habit. Well, I am glad your clock works well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I promised to help my mom clean the kitchen, but I want to play outside.
That is a good promise. Do you know how long it takes to finish?
I do not know, but I want to go to the park now.
Your promise is important. Can you finish two tasks first?
Okay, I will sweep the floor and wipe the table.
That is a kind choice. You will feel good when you are done.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love my new computer. It is so fast.
That is great news. What games do you like to play on it?
I love racing cars on it. It makes me smile.
Racing sounds fun. Do you ever get tired of looking at the screen?
Yes, my eyes hurt a bit. I stop then.
That is smart. My eyes get tired too. Do you take breaks outside?
Yes, I go to the park. It helps my eyes.
Good for you. Fresh air is very nice. Do you have a favorite spot in the park?
The big tree by the lake. I read books there.
That sounds peaceful. I am glad your computer and your rest work well together.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I stop my bike?
Squeeze the brakes gently. Do you have a bell on your bike?
How do I change gears?
Move the lever up or down. Is the hill steep?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My phone makes a loud beep.
Is the screen showing a red dot?
Yes, there is a red dot.
That usually means it needs more power. Do you have a charger?
I have a box of chargers here.
Pick the one with the small plug first. Does it fit the hole?
This one fits the hole well.
Good. Plug it in and wait. Do you see the light change?
The red dot is gone now.
Great, it is charging. Can you hear it hum?
No, it is very quiet.
That is good. Quiet means it is working right. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. My big day feels very hard to plan.
That feels tough. I am sorry. Do you like the food choices?
No. The flowers look wrong. I do not know what to do.
Let us look for new ones. What color do you want?
Maybe red? My friend said I am too angry.
Red is a good color. Are you sure it is anger?
I think I am just tired.
Rest helps a lot.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The rain is falling hard on the roof.
Yes, it sounds like a drum. Do you like the sound?
It is very loud and wet.
It can be noisy, but it helps the plants grow. Do you want to play inside?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now. I made a big, yummy sandwich for lunch.
That sounds great! What is inside your sandwich?
It has turkey, cheese, and a lot of lettuce. I am so glad I packed it.
Me too. Do you think your boss will like it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I kicked a ball in the park all morning. My foot hurts a little now.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you score any goals?
Yes, I scored two goals before the sun went down.
Well done. Do you like playing soccer?
I love it. It is my favorite game to play with friends.
That is great to hear.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a small island! It has soft white sand and calm blue water. I am so happy to show you.
That sounds like a perfect place to rest. Do you see any birds there?
Yes, there are many birds. The sound of the waves makes me feel very calm.
How nice for you. What color is the water?
It is very clear and bright. I want to swim in it right now.
That must feel very cool.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my leg so tingly?
The plane sits you still for a long time. Do you feel thirsty too?
Why is the air so dry?
The cabin fans out damp air to stop windows from fogging. I do not know if that helps your skin.
Why is the night so bright outside?
The sun does not stop when the plane flies high. Do you see the clouds below?
Why is the plane shaking?
It bumps into fast moving air pockets. I hope that feels better soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My cat scratches the couch every day. Why does he do this?
Cats scratch to keep their claws sharp and mark their spot. Does he have his own scratching post?
I bought a post, but he ignores it.
Try placing the post right next to the couch. Do you give him treats when he uses it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The sand is all wet and cold.
That feels bad. Do you have a towel?
No, I forgot it at home.
That is a tough thing.
I just wanted to swim.
I am sorry. Was the water cold too?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The rain was very loud today.
That must have been scary. Did you see any puddles?
Yes, I jumped in one big one.
That sounds like so much fun.
My shoes are wet now.
That is a bad thing. Do you have dry socks?
Yes, I do.
Good job staying dry.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My cat is hiding under the bed.
Is she scared, or just very tired?
She is eating well, but not sleeping.
That is good. Have you checked for any new toys?
No new toys, but the window is open.
Maybe she is watching birds. Does she look sad?
Yes, she looks a bit sad.
Try to sit near her and read aloud.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go right now, my grandma’s car is waiting.
Take your time. Did you pack your favorite toy?
Yes, but I forgot the map to her house.
I do not know the street. Is it near the big park?
No, it is by the river, and I am late.
You should run. Do you have a snack for the ride?
I do not have time for food.
Oh no, that is a big mistake.
I have to go, thank you for the help.
Have a safe trip. Tell her I said hello.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn to sing but I am scared of the sound.
Fear is normal. Do you like to hum?
I hum a lot when I am happy.
That is a good start. Try humming with your mouth open a bit.
My neck feels tight when I try.
Take a deep breath and let your shoulders drop. Do you feel that?
Yes, I feel better now.
Great. Keep practicing for five minutes a day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do plants get their water?
They pull it up from the roots. Do you like growing things?
Yes, I do. How does the water move?
It travels up tiny tubes inside the stem.
Where does it go next?
It splits into small leaves to feed the plant.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I lost my red ball in the park.
That is a sad thing. Did you check the big trees?
Yes, but I did not find it there.
I do not know where it is. What color is the grass there?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent all morning scrubbing the kitchen floor with soap and water.
That sounds like hard work. Did you use a lemon?
No, just plain water, but my arms are very tired now.
You did a great job. Are you hungry?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw a tiny bug on my food and I am so mad.
That is not nice. Does it look like an ant?
No, it was black and had long legs.
That might be a spider. Do you know where it came from?
I do not know, and I want it gone.
You can put it outside to help it. Do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very tired today.
Rest is good for you. Do you have a warm blanket?
Yes, I do. What should I do?
Try a quiet nap. Are you hungry?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I ran five miles today and my legs hurt so bad. I do not want to do it again.
That sounds really hard. What part hurts the most?
My shins hurt when I stop. I feel like I failed because I am slow.
Slow is fine if you are safe. Did you drink some water after?
Yes, I drank a lot of water. I just wish I was faster like the others.
Trying is the best part. Do you want to walk next time instead?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to eat some eggs this morning.
That is a very good choice. Do you like them hard or soft?
I want them soft. How do I make them?
Put them in hot water for three minutes. Then take them out.
What do I do next?
Crack the shells carefully. Would you like jam on toast too?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a song I like, but I am not sure if I should play it or save it.
That is a nice thing to find. Do you dance when you hear it?
I do not know what to do with it. It makes me feel warm and happy.
That is a good sign. Maybe you should just keep listening to it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight hits the air and spreads blue all around. Do you like blue?
Yes, I love it.
That is good. The air scatters blue light more than other colors. Is the sun still up?
Yes, it is bright.
Great. Thanks for asking me such a fun question.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel like I failed the test. What should I do?
It is hard to fail, but you can try again. What part was the hardest for you?
The math part made my brain feel like mush.
That sounds very tiring. Do you have a quiet place to study?
I do, but I am too tired to start.
Rest first, then try a small step.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to plant a tree in my yard. What should I pick?
That is a great idea. How much sun does your yard get?
It has a lot of sun all day long.
An apple tree would love that. Do you like eating fruit?
I do. I love apples.
An apple tree is a perfect choice then.
Can I plant it today?
Yes, you can. Be sure to dig a wide hole for the roots.
How wide should the hole be?
The hole should be three times wider than the root ball. Good luck with your new friend.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I found a dead fish by the river and I feel very sad.
That must feel heavy to see. Do you know if the water looked clean?
The water looked brown and smelly, not like a happy place.
I am sorry it looks so bad. Have you told an adult about it?
Yes, my mom said the river is sick and needs help.
That is good to report. Thank you for caring so much.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very scared.
That is a big feeling. What makes you feel scared?
I do not like the dark at night.
Many kids do not like the dark. Do you have a special toy to hold?
Yes, I have my bear.
That is a good comfort. It helps me know you are safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the wind blow so hard today?
The wind blows when air moves from one place to another. Do you feel it on your face?
It feels like a big invisible hand pushing me.
That is a good way to picture it. The moving air pushes on things.
Why does it stop sometimes?
It stops when the air stops moving fast. The sky is quiet now. Do you hear the birds?
Yes, they are singing.
Wind and rain help plants grow, but sometimes they rest.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the big hall have no windows?
We keep the lights low to protect the old art from the sun. Do you like the dark colors there?
Why is that pot very old?
It was made by hand many years ago. It is true that we do not know who made it.
Why can I not touch the stones?
Hands have oil that can hurt the soft rock. I am not sure why this one is so smooth.
Why is the museum free today?
The city pays for it so everyone can learn. Do you want to see the clock next?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we shuffle the cards?
We mix them so no one knows what comes next. Do you like mystery?
Why does the ace beat the king?
I am not sure why that rule exists. Is your ace red?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired and my feet hurt. This plane ride is too long.
I am sorry you are uncomfortable. Do you want to stretch your legs?
No, there is no room. I just want to get home soon.
That is a fair wish. Are you hungry?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My lights are out. What broke?
Is the main switch on? Is the breaker tripped?
The breaker is stuck down. Why?
A tool might have hit the wire. Do you smell burnt plastic?
No. Is it safe to flip it up?
Yes, but only if the smell is gone. Be careful with wet hands.
It is back on. Why did that fix it?
The breaker cut power to stop a bad fault. Did you leave a fan running?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I stepped on a ladybug and now I feel bad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Is it still moving?
Yes, but it looks hurt.
That is very kind of you to notice. Do you have a small cup?
I found a leaf, but I do not know what to do.
Place the bug on the leaf outside. Do you like the garden?
I guess so. I just do not want things to get hurt.
That is a good feeling to have. Are you ready to go outside?
Yes, I am ready to fix my mistake.
Good choice. You did a brave thing today.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I like working from home today.
That is great news for you.
I made my own tea and cookies.
Does the tea taste good to you?
Yes, it is very sweet.
Sweet tea sounds nice. What did you do next?
I played a game with my cat.
Is your cat playing well?
She is chasing a red ball.
That sounds like a good game.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need a new bag for school.
I can help you with that. Do you like red or blue?
I like red.
We have a red bag right there. Is it big enough for your books?
Yes, I think so.
That is a good choice. I hope you like it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad because my bread is flat and cold.
That is really tricky. What did you do before it went bad?
I put too much salt in the mix.
Oh no. Do you like salty bread?
I do not. I just want a soft, sweet loaf.
That makes sense. Would you like a simple recipe?
Yes, please. I am ready to try again.
Here is a basic one. Do you have warm milk?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am not sure if it is rude to eat with my hands at a party.
It is usually okay for food like chips or apples, but use a fork for soup. Do you like eating soup?
Yes, I love it, but what if I drop some on the table?
Just say sorry and wipe it up quickly. Is that what you did last time?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am very hungry but I do not know what to eat.
That is tricky. Do you like meat or fish?
I do not like meat or fish.
Okay, let us skip the big stuff. What do you like?
I like bread and cheese.
Good choice. I know a small place for that. Is that okay?
Yes, that sounds good.
Great, I will take you there.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do some flowers have bright colors?
Bright colors help bees find the sweet food inside. Do you like seeing bees?
Yes, I do. But why do red roses smell sweet?
The sweet smell calls in bugs to carry their seeds. Do you know other flowers that smell nice?
I think lilies smell good too. Do all flowers have seeds?
Most flowers do, but some make only spores. Do you have any flowers in your garden?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I can feel the wind on my face. It is cold.
Yes, the wind is chilly today. What color do you think the wind is?
I don't know. Is the wind really there?
Yes, the air is moving, so the wind is real. Do you like running in it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What do cows eat?
Cows mostly eat grass and hay. Do you have a cow at home?
No, I live in the city. Can pigs swim?
Yes, pigs can swim quite well. They often enjoy splashing in mud and water.
That is good to know. Do chickens have bones?
Yes, they do have small bones inside their bodies.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My neighbor is making a lot of noise. What should I do?
That can be hard. Is it happening right now?
Yes, it is very loud. I do not know what to say.
You could be kind and ask them to lower the sound.
I am afraid they will not like me.
Most people do not mind a friendly chat. Have you spoken to them before?
No, we have never talked.
It is okay to be nervous. Just say hello first.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see snow on the ground. How do I make a snowball?
Pick up a piece of snow and roll it in your hands. Is the snow cold to the touch?
Yes, it is very cold. But my ball looks too small.
Roll it on the ground to make it bigger. Do you have a friend to play with?
No, I am all by myself here. I want to throw it at something safe.
You can throw it into a pile of leaves. Do you like the look of white snow?
Yes, it looks like sugar. Can I build a snowman if I have enough snow?
Yes, you can stack big snowballs to make a body and head. Do you have any buttons to use for its face?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to send this letter. Is the mail going out soon?
The next truck comes in ten minutes. What is it about?
It is for my sick friend. Is it too late to buy a stamp?
No, the machine is right there by the door.
Great. I am running late for my bus. Where do I put the letter?
Drop it in the red box. Do you have your ID?
Yes, I have it. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because the trees are dropping their brown leaves all over the yard today.
That is a lovely sight to see, and I love the way you feel. Do you plan to jump in the leaves?
Yes, I do, but I wonder why the trees let go of their leaves when the weather gets cold.
Trees drop their leaves to save energy for the winter when it is too cold to grow. It is like taking a long nap.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My chair leg wobbles a lot.
It may just need a small piece of wood to stop the shake. Is it a wooden chair?
Yes, it is. Why do legs wobble?
Wobbling happens when the parts are not tight enough. Do you have a hammer?
I do. Why does it need to be tight?
Tight parts hold the chair together strong and safe. Can you hit it gently?
Yes, I can. How do I make it stop wobbling?
Put the wood piece in the corner and tap it in. Does it feel firm now?
It feels solid. Why did it break?
Chairs can shake apart over time if not cared for. Did you sit very hard on it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the snow. It is cold and wet.
That can feel yucky. Do you have warm boots?
Yes, but my toes still hurt. The snow keeps getting inside.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you want to go sit by the fire?
Maybe, but the house is dark. I do not like the dark.
I can turn on a light for you. Do you like warm soup?
Yes, I like soup. But it is a lot of work to make it.
I can help you cook it. Do you have some water ready?
Yes, the water is in the pot. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Let us make it warm and cozy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to plan my day.
That feels hard. What do you like to do most?
I think I want to read a book.
That is a great start. Do you have a favorite story?
Yes, but I am not sure where to begin.
Let us pick the first page. Ready to try?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what clothes to wear today.
What is the weather like outside right now?
It is very cold and the ground is white.
That sounds like winter time.
I want to play in the snow.
Great, put on your thick coat.
I also need something for my hands.
Did you find your warm gloves?
Yes, I found them in my bag.
Happy playing in the snow.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I get my bread to get big?
You must feed the yeast with sugar and warm water. Is your water hot or cold?
It is cold.
That will stop the bread from growing. Warm the water, but not too hot.
How do I know if it is ready?
The dough is ready when it feels soft and springy back. Do you have a timer?
Yes, I do.
Set it for twenty minutes after you mix. Then watch for bubbles to form.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My favorite apples are all gone. I feel sad.
That is a pity. Do you want to go buy more?
I do, but I have no money.
I understand your worry. Would you like a pear instead?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Can you tell me the end of the story?
The bird flies free. Are you happy for it?
Yes, but I must go now. Did the bird find water?
It found a big lake. I do not know if it was safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I start this letter?
Start with a warm word. Who is it for?
I want to tell them I am glad they are here.
That is a good thought. What did they do for you?
They gave me a book last week.
A book is a lovely gift. Do you like the story in it?
Yes, the bear in the story is very funny.
That will make them smile. What will you say next?
I think I will say they are my friend.
That is the truest thing.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy here at the beach.
The sun looks warm and bright. Do you like the sand?
Yes, the sand is soft and warm.
That sounds nice to walk on. Are you playing in the water?
I am walking along the edge of the sea.
The waves are gentle today. Do you hear the birds?
Yes, I can hear them singing high.
Nature sounds are always sweet. Enjoy your time there.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the sky! It is so blue today. I feel so happy.
Yes, it is a lovely color. Do you wonder why it looks that way?
Actually, yes. I have always wanted to know the secret.
Sunlight has many colors. The air scatters the blue ones all around for us to see.
That is cool. So the air makes the sky look blue?
Yes, the air spreads the light. Are you seeing any clouds today?
Just a few white puffy ones. They look like cotton balls.
Clouds scatter all colors together, making them look white. Happy skies are good.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why are there puffy white things in the sky?
They are clouds. They are made of tiny water drops. Do you like them?
Maybe. What color are the dark ones?
They are gray. They often bring rain. Are you bringing an umbrella?
No. Do they make the ground wet?
Yes, the rain falls down. It makes everything wet. Do you want to stay dry?
I must go. Is it done?
You should run now. I hope you stay safe. Have a nice day?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am hungry but I do not know what to make.
That sounds fun. Do you have any meat in the kitchen?
I have some chicken and a bag of rice.
You can cook them together. What kind of spice do you like?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I grow a carrot from the ground?
You put the small seed in the dirt and water it. Do you have a pot?
Yes, I have a small clay pot.
Put the seed just under the soil and keep it warm. Do you have a sunny window?
It sits right by the window all day.
That is a good spot for it to grow.
What should I do when the plant gets big?
Wait for the top to show green leaves.
Does it take a long time to be ready?
It takes a few weeks, so be patient. Do you like to watch things grow?
I do like to see the leaves come up.
Then you will enjoy this.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad about the snow.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you like the cold?
It broke my new sled.
That is very bad luck. Was it expensive?
Yes, it was my whole savings.
I am truly sorry. Do you want a hug?
I just want it back.
I cannot fix the sled.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because it is the month of May.
That is wonderful. Do you like the flowers in May?
Yes, the roses smell very nice.
I love smelling roses too.
But I think June is my favorite month.
Why do you love June?
Because my birthday is in June.
Happy birthday! I am glad for you.
Thank you. I feel warm inside.
That is a sweet feeling.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I felt very scared today.
I am sorry you felt that way. What happened?
I dropped my ice cream on the grass.
That is a small thing. Did you cry?
Yes, my eyes got wet.
It is okay to feel sad. Are you happy now?
I am better now.
That is good. I am glad.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My chair leg wobbles bad. I tried glue but it broke.
Oh no, that is tough. Did you check if the screw is loose?
Yes, it was loose. I tightened it tight.
Good try! Is it staying still now?
It feels better. I also spilled milk on the seat.
Uh oh. Did you wipe it up fast?
Yes, I used a towel. It looks clean now.
Great job fixing it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make my pictures look sharp?
Try to hold your camera still. Do you use a tripod?
No, I just hold it in my hand.
That works if you are careful. Do you take photos at night?
Yes, but they always look fuzzy.
You need more light for dark scenes.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am stuck on my math problem. It looks very hard.
That can feel big, but we can break it down. Do you have the first step ready?
Yes, I added the numbers, but then I do not know what to do next.
Good job on that start. Did you try to check your work with a calculator?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a big rock by the river today.
That sounds like a cool place to sit. Did you sit on it?
Yes, I sat on it and watched the water move.
The water must have looked very smooth. What color was it?
It was clear and cold.
I bet that felt great. Do you want to go back tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a big deer in the woods. Is it safe to go closer?
No, it is better to watch from far away. Are you hiding behind a tree?
Yes, I am hiding. Do they like to eat our apples?
They do eat fruit, but they prefer leaves and grass. Do you have a camera?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am very late and I do not know what to do.
Do not worry. Where are you going right now?
I must get to the park before it closes.
Take the bus. Is the bus stop near you?
I am right next to the bus stop.
Just run to the bus. You will make it in time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My brother broke my new toy. I am very angry. What should I do?
I am sorry your toy is broken. Are you hurt by falling?
No, I am not hurt. But I feel sad and mad. I want to hit him.
Please do not hit him. Have you tried telling him how you feel?
I talked to him, but he did not stop. I do not know what to do now.
I do not know if he will listen. Do you want to ask a grown up for help?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did I break the cup?
You dropped it. Did you feel scared?
I feel bad. What should I do?
You can tell me the truth. Do you want to help clean it?
Yes, I can. How do I sweep?
Use the broom gently. Are you careful now?
