talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I clean my cat's ears?
Use a soft wipe with cat-safe liquid. Do you have any gentle wipes?
Yes, I do. Thank you.
You are welcome. Is your cat calm?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked past the old church today.
That sounds nice. Did you see the cats?
Yes, two of them were sleeping in the sun.
I imagine they were very warm.
The baker gave me a warm cookie.
How sweet of him. Was it big?
It was about the size of my hand.
I am glad you enjoyed your day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I build a snowman?
First, roll three big balls of snow. Do you like cold hands?
Yes, I do.
Stack the smallest ball on top of the biggest one. You can add eyes and a nose.
What else do I need?
You need a carrot for the nose and a scarf. It is fun and easy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like this song because it sounds like rain.
That is a nice way to hear it. Does the rain sound happy or sad?
It sounds like a sleepy night.
Sleepy songs are very cozy to listen to. Do you want to hear another one?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sail a small boat at the harbour.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Are you afraid of falling in the water?
I am a little nervous, but I want to try anyway.
You can hold the rope tight to stay steady. Do you know how to tie a safe knot?
I think I know one, but I am not sure if it is right.
If you are not sure, a helper can check it for you. Is there a person nearby who can help?
Yes, there is a kind old man sitting on the dock.
Good. He might teach you the rest. Have a safe time on the water.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my white shirts stay white?
Use brightener in the wash. Do you use powder or liquid soap?
I use liquid.
That works fine. Add it to the empty drum before the clothes.
Should I soak them first?
A short soak helps with stains. Are they very dirty?
Not really, just a little dust.
Then skip the soak. Just wash on a hot cycle.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does a big ship float on the water?
The water pushes up hard to hold it up. Do you like to swim in pools?
No, I am afraid of deep water.
That is okay. The shape of the ship helps it stay on top.
Is it magic?
No, it is just science. You can feel the push if you jump into a pool.
I like my toy boats best.
They work the same way as real ships. Do you play with them in the bath?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new bakery. It smells so sweet.
That sounds lovely. What is your favorite thing there?
The warm bread is the best. It makes me smile.
Good food often makes people happy. Do you go there often?
I went this morning. The staff was very nice.
Kind staff is a great thing. Will you take someone with you next time?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a small, green island. It is so nice.
That sounds lovely. Do you see any birds there?
Yes, white birds fly around. I want to tell everyone.
Please do share the joy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The sea looks big.
Yes, it is very big. Do you like the blue?
No time to talk. Is it deep?
It is very deep. Do you swim?
I must go now. Thanks.
Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today!
That is good to hear. Why are you feeling so good?
The sun is bright and warm.
Sunshine always helps. Do you like to sit outside?
Yes, I love my yard.
That sounds nice. I am glad you shared it.
Can you help me dig a hole?
I cannot dig, but I can dig a mental picture. What will you plant in it?
I will plant a flower.
A flower sounds lovely.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I got my first job. Why do they give me work?
They pay you for your help. Do you like the task?
The task is hard. Why is work so tough?
It is hard at first because you are new. Is the boss kind?
The boss is nice. Why do people keep going?
They keep going to earn money and learn skills.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn about old kings, but the books are too hard.
Try looking at pictures of old castles first. Do you like looking at maps?
I do like maps. Why do people build big stone walls?
They built walls to keep bad people out. Do you feel safe in your house?
Yes, I feel safe. Was it really as scary as the stories say?
I do not know for sure, but it was often hard work. Do you want to try a simple story book?
Yes, please. What is a good start for a child?
Start with a book about daily life in a village. Do you like eating stories?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big ship on the water today. It was so huge and it just sat there without sinking. Why does it float?
The ship pushes a lot of water down, and the water pushes the ship up. Is it made of metal?
Yes, it looked like heavy steel. But why does the water push back if it is so soft?
That push is called buoyancy, and it helps the ship stay up. Do you like looking at boats?
I do! It feels like magic when I see them glide on the sea. Is the air inside helping it too?
Yes, the air makes the ship lighter and helps it float higher. Do you plan to go on a boat?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at the big colors in the sky. What is that?
That is a rainbow. It makes you smile?
Why is it there? I do not know.
Sunlight and rain mix to make it. Do you like red the best?
I like the top one. It is red.
Red is on top. Is it your favorite color?
No, I like blue too. It looks like water.
You are right, blue looks like water. Do you feel happy now?
Yes, I do. It is very pretty.
I am glad you are happy. Rainbows are made of light.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what fun thing to do.
Have you liked to draw things? Do you have any paper?
I do like to draw, but I have no paper.
You can use a whiteboard and a marker. Do you have a marker?
Yes, I have a blue marker and a board.
That sounds very nice. Do you want to start now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend, but I do not know what to say.
That is a nice idea. What do you want to tell her first?
I miss playing with her in the park.
You can say that you miss the fun times you had there. Is she your best friend?
Yes, she is. How do I start the letter?
Start by saying hello and how you are doing. Good luck with your writing.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do bees make honey?
They fly out and drink sweet flower juice. Do you like sweet fruit?
Yes, but I must run.
They store the juice in their bellies and bring it home. Do you have a bag with you?
No time to chat.
At the hive, they fan it with wings to dry it into sticky honey.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot find my book. I am very sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you check the shelf where it usually sits?
Yes, I looked there, but it is gone. I need it for school.
I do not know where it is. Are you holding the other books you borrowed?
Yes, I have them all. Please help me look.
Let us check the lost and found box. Did you look at the table by the door?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the fridge hold my drawing?
The magnet likes metal things. Does your drawing paper stick, too?
No, just the little clip on the corner.
That clip has metal inside. Nice spot, buddy.
What if I use two magnets?
They might push away or pull close together. Do they move on your own?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I serve the ball?
Toss it up and hit it before it bounces. Do you have a good toss?
I want to learn the backhand.
Turn your body and swing across. What racket do you use?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like hot drinks, but I am not sure which one is best for me.
Tea is calm, and coffee is bright. Do you want to feel relaxed or awake?
I want to stay calm, but I also need energy for my work.
Green tea gives you both, with a gentle lift. Do you have a cup ready?
I do, but I am worried it will make me go to the bathroom too much.
That happens, but it is fine if you sit near one. Does that sound okay to you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired of waiting.
That feels hard. What are we waiting for?
The bus that is very late.
I am sorry about that. Do you want to play a game?
No, I just want it to come here.
You are right to be sad. I will sit with you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do bears sleep all winter?
They sleep to save energy when there is no food. Do you like cold weather?
Yes, but I do not have fur to keep me warm.
That is why you wear a warm coat.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late and the rain is very loud.
That sounds scary. Do you have a coat?
No, I forgot my coat at home.
You might get wet. Is your work close by?
Yes, but my shoes are dry and I am sad.
Dry shoes are good. Bring an umbrella next time?
I am running now, thank you for helping.
Be safe. Do you like rain sometimes?
I do not have time to talk, bye.
Good luck on your run.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing by the water but I do not know what to do.
The boats are very pretty. Do you like looking at them?
Yes, they look nice, but I am still not sure where to go.
You could walk along the wet stone path.
Is that a safe place to walk?
Yes, it is safe. I do not know if the shop is open yet.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My small tree has yellow leaves. What should I do?
I am not sure, but do you water it every day?
I do. It sits in the bright sun.
Try moving it to a spot with softer light.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very worried and do not know what to do.
That feels heavy. What is the main thing you are thinking about?
I just do not know how to stop feeling this way.
Taking a deep breath can help. Do you want to try it together?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big fort.
That sounds fun. What do you have to cover us?
I have pillows and a blanket.
Great start. Do you have a blanket big enough for two people?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a worm, but I do not know how to put it on the hook.
Put the hook through the worm's head. Do you like to hold the worm tight?
I am scared it will bite my finger.
You can use a small pair of pliers to hold it. Are your hands steady?
Okay, I tried it, and now the worm is dead.
That happens sometimes. Do you want to try a new one?
Yes, I think I will try again.
Good luck. Do you like where you are sitting?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That sounds fun. Do you have a helmet?
Yes, I do. But I am afraid I will fall.
Falling is part of learning. How high is your seat?
It is too high for my feet to touch the ground.
Let us lower it together. Is that better now?
Yes, my toes can tap the floor.
Great. You have done the hard part.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel very lonely, but I have to run.
I am sorry. Do you have anyone to see today?
No, just my dog. I must go now.
A dog is a good friend. Is he at home with you?
Yes, he is napping. I will talk later.
That is nice. Take your time to breathe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the shop?
It is down that street. Are you going to buy food?
No, I need my keys.
I do not know where you left them. Did you check your bag?
I did, but I do not see them.
Look in your coat pocket. Are you still in a rush?
I found them. Thank you.
You are welcome. Run fast.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel all by myself in this big house and it makes my tummy feel sad.
That feels very heavy, but I am right here with you. Do you want to tell me why?
I miss my friends and no one calls to play with me today.
It is hard when the quiet gets too loud. Would you like to find a book to read?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Today was so fun. We had a big party with lots of friends.
That sounds like a happy time. Did you eat any cake?
Yes, we had chocolate cake. It was sweet and cold.
Yum, that must have been tasty. How many people came to the party?
About ten people came. My cousin brought balloons.
Ten is a good group for a party. Did you play any games together?
We played tag in the garden. I ran very fast.
Running is great exercise. I hope you had a wonderful day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the snow white?
Light bounces off the tiny ice crystals. Do you like to build snowmen?
Why does it feel so cold?
The crystals take heat from your skin.
Why do we slip on it?
It melts a little under your weight, making it slick. Do you wear warm boots?
Why do we stay inside?
We stay warm and dry to stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the sky is so gray today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like white clouds better?
Yes, I do. Why are they always so big and heavy?
They hold a lot of water inside them. They are like big, soft pillows.
That sounds nice, but the rain is coming.
Rain cleans the dirt off the leaves. Does that make you feel better?
I guess so. Thank you for talking to me.
You are welcome. I am glad you feel better now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to eat.
Do you like meat or vegetables?
I like both, but I am tired.
A salad is light. Does that sound good?
Yes, that sounds nice.
Great choice. Have a good meal!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a sand castle?
You need wet sand and a bucket. Are you going to use a shovel?
Yes, I have a small shovel. What do I do first?
Pack the sand tight in the bucket. Have you done this before?
No, this is my first time. Thank you for the help.
You will do a great job. I hope you have fun!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel great, but I must run.
That is good news. Are you safe?
Yes, I am running fast.
Speed is fun. Do you like the wind?
I like the wind.
That makes it joyful.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My head hurts a lot today.
I am sorry you feel bad. Do you have a fever?
No, but I feel tired.
Rest can help you feel better. Did you sleep well?
I slept fine, but the hurt stayed.
That is strange. Please drink some water.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do horses kick?
Horses kick to show they are upset or to fight back. Do you know if it is scared?
It looks very big.
Big size can help them stay safe from bad animals. Do you think it feels lonely?
Maybe it is sad.
I do not know if it is sad, but I can tell you how to help. Do you want to learn more?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a new friend but I do not know what to talk about with them.
That sounds exciting. What do you like to do for fun?
I like to draw pictures and read books about animals.
Those are great hobbies. You could show them your drawings.
What if they do not like animals?
Then you can just listen to their interests.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my test so hard?
Hard tests are tough, but you can do it. Do you like math or words?
I like words. Why do we have to take tests?
Tests show what you know. Do you feel scared right now?
A little bit. Why can't we just learn for fun?
Fun is great, but tests help us grow. What is your favorite part of class?
Reading stories. Why does reading feel easy?
Easy things make us feel good. Do you want to read a story now?
Yes, please. Why did you help me?
I am here for you. I love helping friends.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we put dirty clothes in the machine?
The water and soap wash away the grime. Do you pick up your toys?
But why does the hot water feel so warm?
I am not sure why it feels that way to you. Do you like the smell of clean laundry?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The leg of my chair is loose. I do not know how to fix it.
Is it a wooden leg or a metal one? I can help you find the right tool.
It is wood. I am afraid I will break it.
Do not worry. We will just tighten it up. Do you have some glue?
I have glue, but I do not have a clamp.
That is okay. You can use a heavy book to hold it. Is the joint deep?
Yes, the hole is very deep. I am lost.
I do not know if glue alone will work there. Let us try to find a small wooden dowel first.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the neighbors have so much noise at night?
They might be having a big party. Do you want to see?
I do not like the loud music. Why do they play it so loud?
It is hard to say for sure. Have you asked them?
No, I am too shy. Why are you not worried about the noise?
I am used to it, so it feels fine. Do you like quiet days?
Yes, I love quiet. Why do people change their habits?
I do not know the exact reason.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees in autumn?
The days get short and cool, so trees let go of leaves to save water. Do you like picking up the brown ones?
Yes, I do. What else do they do when they fall?
They break down and make rich food for the roots. It is like a blanket for the tree.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a gift today. I am so happy to see you.
That sounds wonderful. What kind of gift is it?
It is a red book with funny pictures. I want to share the best part with you.
That sounds like a lot of fun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My cat is very small.
That is cute. How old is your cat?
He is one year old.
One year is a good age. Does he like to play?
Yes, he likes to catch balls.
I like that he plays. What is his name?
I want to buy a red ball for him.
A red ball sounds fun. Is he happy?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the light turn on?
The switch sends power to the bulb. Do you know where the switch is?
I touched the plug, is that safe?
No, never touch plugs. Do you know why water is bad for wires?
It makes the power go bad, right?
Yes, water can make the wires hurt. Is your hand dry now?
Yes, my hand is dry.
Good. Do you want to play outside instead?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big fire on the street at night!
That sounds scary. Was it a big fire?
Yes, but the fire trucks came fast.
I am glad the firefighters are there. Do you feel safe now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind blew so hard today that my hat flew away.
Oh no, is it safe? Did you see where it went?
It landed in a bush by the park.
That sounds like a good spot.
I had to climb over a fence to get it back.
You were very brave. Was it dirty when you got it?
Yes, there were some leaves stuck to it.
I am glad you got your hat back.
Now I am dry, but my hair is all messy.
The wind can be a bit tricky. Do you like the fresh air?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I climb a mountain?
Start by walking up slowly and taking breaks. Do you like walking outside?
Yes, I do. What gear do I need?
You need strong shoes and a warm coat. How high is the hill you want to try?
It is about a mile high. Is that safe?
It is safe if you stay on the path and watch your step. Do you have a map with you?
No, I do not. How do I stay on the path?
Look for the signs and stay near the trail markers. Do you bring a bottle of water?
Yes, I have one. Can I go now?
Go with a friend and tell someone where you are going. Do you know how to get back down?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel alone even when people are near me. Why?
That is a hard feeling. Do you talk to them?
I do, but it feels empty. Why?
I do not know the answer. Do you tell them you miss them?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you like apples?
They are sweet and crunchy. Do you like them?
I think they are too sour.
Some apples are sour, but the red ones are sweet. Do you like bananas?
Yes, I love bananas.
Bananas are very good for you. That is great to hear.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my cup by accident.
Oh no. Do you have other cups?
Yes, but I feel very bad.
Accidents happen to everyone. Did you clean up the glass?
I tried, but I am scared of the sharp bits.
That is smart. You should be careful near glass.
What should I do now?
Put the shards in a thick bag. Do you have a thick bag?
I think so. Thank you.
You are welcome. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is loud and I am scared. What should I do?
Stay near a window with a wall behind you. Do you have a warm blanket?
Yes, I have my blue blanket. It feels too dark in here.
Bring the light closer to you. Is the room quiet now?
I am sitting on the floor. Can I go outside to check?
No, please stay inside for your safety. Do you want to draw a picture?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My little brother broke my toy car today.
I am so sorry to hear that. Did you tell him it was not okay?
Yes, I did, but he just laughed at me.
That is not very nice. Does he have any favorite toys to play with instead?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad because my car went out of control.
I am sorry you feel that way. Were you driving fast?
No, but I did not see the stop sign until it was too late.
That is a scary moment. Do you want to talk about what you saw?
I just want to quit. It is all too hard for me.
You do not have to quit today. Would you like a short practice run later?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My computer screen is all black. What is wrong?
It might just be asleep. Did you try pressing the power button?
I pressed it, but the lights are off.
That is strange. Is the cord plugged into the wall?
The cord is in the wall, but the box at the back is cold.
That means it has no power. Do you see any small lights on the back box?
No, the box is very dark and silent.
Then it is not getting power from the wall. Let me check if I know how to fix that.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel a bit chilly. My nose is running.
Oh no, that sounds like a cold. Are you drinking warm soup?
Yes, it helps me feel better. I am glad to tell you.
That is good for you. Do you have a blanket?
Yes, I am wrapped up in it. I feel cozy and warm.
That sounds nice. You should rest well.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I save more money each month?
Try putting small change in a jar every day. Do you have a jar at home?
I want to cook dinner at home instead of buying it.
Make pasta or rice with beans and vegetables. It costs very little. What kind of vegetables do you like?
I think I will try that first.
That is a great start. Good luck with your new habits.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My socks are black with mud today.
That sounds like a rough day. What did you do?
I played in the rain all afternoon.
I like the rain. Do you have warm socks to change into?
Yes, I am putting the wet ones in the basket now.
Good luck with the wash.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry to hear that. What made you feel this way?
I lost my favorite toy.
That is a tough loss. Do you have any other toys you like?
Yes, but none are as good.
I believe you. Do you want to talk about how you can fix it?
Can I draw a new one?
That sounds like a great idea. Will you try it now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I broke the red cup by accident. Why is it on the floor now?
It fell because I dropped it. Did you see where it landed?
I am sorry I did not catch it. Why was it in your hand?
I was moving it to the sink. Do you want to help me clean it up?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The lights just went out and I am very annoyed.
That is not fun at all. Did you check if the plug is in?
Yes, the plug is in, but the switch does not work.
It might be a trip in the box. Do you know where that box is?
I think it is in the garage, but I do not feel like looking.
I am not sure about your specific home. Is there a backup light you can use?
No, it is dark and I hate the dark.
Let us stay calm. Can you feel for the box handle?
I found it, and it was indeed tripped.
Great job. Are the lights back on now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today.
That sounds like fun. Did you see the waves?
Yes, the water was blue.
Blue is a nice color. Was the sand hot?
The sand was warm, not hot.
That sounds comfy. Did you build a castle?
No, I just sat and looked.
Looking is good for the brain.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now because I said sorry to my friend.
That is a great thing to do. Do you feel better?
Yes, my heart feels light and free.
That is wonderful news for you.
I was scared to speak up at first.
It takes courage to tell the truth. Did your friend forgive you?
Yes, she gave me a big hug.
That is a sweet response. How are you feeling now?
I feel calm and I am glad we are friends again.
I am happy you shared that with me.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you know if they sell apples here?
Yes, the red apples are in the front. Do you like sweet or sour ones?
I like sweet ones. Can I have a banana too?
I do not know, but you can check the sign.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky so blue on a clear day?
It is because sunlight hits tiny air particles. Do you see the sun?
Yes, I see the bright sun up there.
The blue part of the light bounces around the most. Is it sunny today?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I went to the beach today. The water was so blue.
That sounds like fun. Do you like to swim?
A little bit. But I am scared of the deep water.
That is normal. Have you tried walking in the shallows?
Yes. It feels safe there. The sand is soft.
Soft sand is nice. Do you like to build things with it?
I do. I made a big castle. It broke when the wave hit it.
Waves are strong. Do you like the sound they make?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I made a big pile of blocks. It took a long time.
That is very nice work. Do you like the shape?
I am so happy. My hands are tired.
Tired hands show you tried hard. Do you want to rest?
Yes, but I feel strong.
That is a good feeling.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count up by ones?
Counting by ones helps us see how many things are there. Do you like to count your toys?
Why can’t we start counting from two?
We start from one because one is the first whole thing we have. Do you have one red ball?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to grow new flowers from an old stem.
That is a sweet goal. Do you have a pot ready?
Yes, I do. How do I plant the stem?
Cut the stem low and put it in wet soil. I hope it grows for you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I count to ten?
Start at one and say each number in order. Do you know the numbers after five?
No, I stop at five. What comes next?
Six comes right after five, then seven. Is that easier to see?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad because the big tree by my house fell down.
That is very upsetting. Do you have any pictures of it?
No, I never took a picture. It was so green and tall.
It sounds like it was a lovely tree. I am sorry you lost it.
Yes, I really miss it now. It feels empty without it.
It takes time to heal. Will you plant a small seed?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a red apple at the market today.
That is a nice color. Was it sweet?
Yes, it was very sweet and juicy.
I am glad you liked it.
The fruit smelled so good there.
I like good smells too. Did you buy other fruit?
I also bought some green grapes.
Green grapes are fun to eat.
I feel very happy about my trip.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I teach a robot to walk?
You need to code its steps first. Do you know how to write code?
No, I do not. What should I do?
I do not know your exact robot model. Do you have a manual?
Yes, I have a manual with pictures.
Great, follow the pictures closely. Are the pictures clear?
Yes, but the wires look hard.
Be careful and take your time. Do you have a friend to help?
No, I am all alone.
I am here to help you. Can you read the first step?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I stay safe in the sun?
Wear a hat and sunscreen. Do you have a favorite hat?
Yes, I love my big blue one.
That sounds fun. Remember to drink water too.
I will take a big drink.
Good plan. Stay cool and happy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the small birds sit on my fence?
They are looking for food there. Do you see any seeds?
I see no seeds. Why do they stay?
They feel safe and warm there. I do not know if they like you, but they do not leave.
That is good. Why do they make loud sounds?
They are calling their friends. Do you hear a new sound?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How does the web send my mail?
The web moves it fast. Do you check your phone?
Yes. Can I use it from my car?
Yes, you can use it in a car.
Is it safe to drive and look?
No, that is not safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so tired, but I must go now.
Please sit for a moment. Are you eating enough?
I have no time to eat.
That is not good for you. What is the rush?
I will miss the bus.
Then I must let you go. Please be safe.
Thank you, I will.
Good luck with your day. I hope you get rest later.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a snow angel?
You lie down in the snow and move your arms and legs. Do you like building things?
Yes, I do.
Just press your body into the snow and stay still.
Is that all I have to do?
Yes, then roll over to see the shape. Have you tried it before?
No, I have not.
It is a fun way to play in the cold.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread is flat. Why will it not get big?
I am sorry it feels sad to you. Is your kitchen very cold right now?
Yes, it is cold. I used old yeast too.
Old yeast may be tired and not work well.
Then what do I do? I am angry at the dough.
Warm water helps new yeast wake up. Do you have more yeast in the box?
I have some new stuff. Can I start again?
Yes, you can try again with care.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Is my little brother in his room?
Yes, he is there. He is eating a cookie. Do you want to say hi?
No, I have to go now. Where is my red bag?
I do not know. Did you put it on the table?
I think so. I am going. Tell him bye for me.
Okay. I will tell him. Run fast!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have too many small toys. How do I keep them?
Try putting them in boxes with labels. Do you have boxes?
Yes, but I lose the labels.
You can stick paper in the front. That might help.
That is a good idea.
I am glad you like it. What is your favorite toy?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look up! The sky is so blue and happy today.
I love blue days too. Do you know why it is blue?
I think it is blue because the sun shines hard.
That is close! The light bounces off tiny air bits. Do you like the sun?
Yes, I do. Why does the blue stick?
Red light goes deep into the air. Blue light scatters all around you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a dog in the park today.
That sounds fun. Did you pet it?
Yes, its fur was very soft.
I am glad it was kind to you.
It barked at a cat later.
Oh no. Was the cat okay?
The cat ran away quickly.
I am sure it was safe.
I felt a bit bad for the cat.
You have a good heart.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue boat by the lake today. It looked like a giant floating house with a red flag on top.
That sounds like a fun place to look at. Did you hear the water making a noise?
Yes, it sounded like soft waves hitting the side. I wish I could sit on the front part and watch the fish.
The front part is called the bow, and it can be windy there. Do you like windy places?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a new boat. What should I do first?
Check the ropes and the plugs. Is it made of wood?
Yes, it is wood. How do I keep it dry?
Wipe it with a soft cloth after the rain. Does it have a cover?
No, it does not. Where should I put it?
Put it in a dry place like a garage. Can you lift it easily?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have too many toys.
That sounds hard. What do you like best?
I love my red car.
Keep the car. Do you want to give away the rest?
I do not know what to do.
It is okay to not know. Try putting one toy in a box?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad we did our talk today.
I am happy to hear that. Did you have a good time?
Yes, it was very nice and we agree on things.
That is great news for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my trip was ruined by rain.
That is a shame. What did you plan to do there?
I wanted to swim in the sea all day.
I understand why you are upset. Do you like swimming?
Yes, I love it when the water is warm.
That sounds lovely. Maybe you can go back later?
I hope so, but I am tired now.
Rest is good for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to put the roof on my shed and now it looks all crooked. I feel like I broke it.
Deep breath, you did not break it, you just need to slide it back. Do you have a friend to help you lift it?
No, I am all alone and my hands are shaking. I do not think I can do this right.
You can do this, one step at a time. How heavy is that roof piece?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need help with my lighthouse model.
A cool project! What part are you stuck on?
The light inside is not bright enough.
Try a smaller battery. Is the bulb clean?
Yes, it is clean. The window glass is dirty.
Wipe the glass to let the light shine. Do you have a soft cloth?
Yes, I do. Thank you for the tips.
You are welcome. Happy building!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to draw a horse right now.
That is a big job. Do you have a pencil?
Yes, but my hand is shaking.
Take a slow breath first. That will help.
It still looks like a dog.
A horse has a long face. Is it too short?
I do not know how to make it long.
Stretch your arm out wide. Does that work?
Yes, it works.
Good job. You did a great job.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The little goldfish is swimming in circles today.
That sounds like it might be sick. Does he have a hole in his side?
No, he looks fine, but he is very tired.
I am sorry to hear that. Is the water clean and cool for him?
Yes, I cleaned the tank this morning.
That is a good thing to do. Maybe he is just resting.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my computer go to sleep?
You can press the sleep button on the front. Do you have a laptop?
Yes, I do.
Just click the start menu and pick sleep. Is it a new machine?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to jump into the pool when it is warm outside.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like to swim with your friends too?
Yes, we play tag under the water and chase bubbles.
That is a wonderful game to play in the water.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big ship on the lake today. It looked heavy but it stayed up.
That is a cool sight. Do you know why it does not sink?
I think the air in the boat is light. The water pushes it up.
You are right about the push. Do you like floating things?
Yes, I do. My little boat floated too.
That is good news. You learned a lot today.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is that shop always open at night?
The owner likes to work late to fix up shelves. Do you like dark places?
Why do the lights look so bright inside?
They use special bulbs to make things look new. Are you scared of bright lights?
Why does the door never lock?
I do not know why they leave it open.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to count the months in the year.
There are twelve months. Do you know the name of this month?
I think it is December.
You are right. Next comes January. Can you say the word January?
Yes, I can say it.
That is good work. You are learning well. Do you like winter?
I like the snow.
Snow is fun. It makes the ground white. Do you wear a red hat?
No, I have a blue one.
Blue is a nice color. Now let us count again.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look how blue the sky is! I am so happy today.
It is a lovely day. Do you know why it looks that color?
Is it because of the water?
Not exactly. The light splits into colors as it hits the air. Blue scatters the most. Do you see a rainbow sometimes?
Yes, I do! It is so cool.
Rainbows are made by the same light splitting. Happy days are good days.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I clean the glass on a lighthouse?
You wipe it with soft cloth and soapy water. Do you have a bucket nearby?
I have a bucket. What soap do I use?
Use a mild soap that is not harsh. Is the glass very dirty today?
It has salt on it. Should I scrape it?
I do not know if you should scrape salt. Do you have a soft brush?
I have a brush. How do I dry it?
Pat it dry with a towel to stop streaks. Thank you for asking.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I plant a tiny tree?
You dig a hole, place the roots in, and cover with dirt. Do you have a shovel?
Yes, but the street is so quiet here.
A quiet place is good for calm growth. Do you like the silence?
I do, but I fear I will fail.
You can only fail if you stop trying. Would you like to start now?
Yes, let us begin.
Then take a deep breath and dig. Is the soil soft?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to take a picture of my cat right now.
Is your cat still still?
No, he is running fast.
Try to click the button before he runs away.
My hands are shaking.
Does your hand feel too cold?
It is dark in here.
Can you turn on a light?
I do not know where the switch is.
Look near the door for a small button.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My fish is not moving. I am not sure what to do.
Is the water very cold or very hot?
The water feels warm to my hand.
That is not good for fish. I do not know why it is warm, but you should check the heater.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big red ball on the grass.
That is fun. Did you kick it?
No, it was just sitting there.
That is strange. Why was it there?
Maybe someone dropped it.
That makes sense. Do you want to find the owner?
I just want to play with it.
You should check if it has a name. Is there any writing on it?
No, it is clean and smooth.
Then let us look for someone who lost it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do I have to go to the big meeting now?
Yes, we need to leave soon. Are you ready?
I do not like those big tables.
It is okay to feel that way. You can sit next to me.
I bring my blue cup.
That sounds like a good plan. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My head hurts so bad. I do not feel good.
That is very sad. Do you have a fever?
No, I think it is just a bad head ache. It hurts my eyes too.
Aching eyes can come with head aches. Have you drank any water?
I have not. I was just sad and angry.
Water and rest help a lot. Do you want to try some?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is very hot outside. I do not know what to do.
That is a hard day. Do you like swimming?
Yes, I love water. But I am too tired to go far.
Then stay home and drink cold water. Are you thirsty?
I am, but I do not know if I will drink enough.
Take small sips all day long. Can you do that?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a cat in the park. It fell asleep in the sun. It looked so happy.
That is a nice thing to see. Do you like cats?
Yes, they are soft. But I stayed up late watching TV. I feel very tired now.
Watching TV late can make it hard to rest. Do you have a plan for tonight?
I will put my phone away. I want to read a book instead. I hope that helps me sleep.
Reading is a good way to calm down. Good luck getting some rest.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like the song with the fast drums.
That is a fun sound. Do you like to clap along?
Yes, I love to move my hands to the beat.
Clapping helps you keep the time. Have you tried singing the words?
I try, but the words are too fast for me.
You can slow it down to learn them. Do you want to sing it by yourself?
I think I will practice slowly with you.
That is a smart way to learn.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just saw the nicest little bakery.
That sounds so lovely. What drew your eye?
The smell of warm bread was everywhere.
Fresh bread always smells wonderful.
The windows were full of gold pastries.
That must look like a dream. Did you see any pies?
Yes, there were big apple pies too.
Apples are a classic choice for baking.
I am so happy to find this place.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: What is the best season? I am late!
I like spring for the flowers. Do you like rain?
No, I hate rain. I must go.
Summer is warm and dry. I hope you catch your bus.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I would love to make my own honey. How do bees do it?
Bees turn flower sugar into thick, sweet food. Do you have a favorite flower?
Yes, I like daisies. Can I just take the flowers and let them sit in a jar?
No, that would rot and not make honey. You need live bees to build a hive. Do you have a safe place outside?
I have a big backyard. How can I start a small hive?
I cannot teach you to keep bees from just a chat. It is hard and risky work, so please find a local beekeeper for help.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I took a great picture of my dog.
That sounds fun. What is the dog doing?
He is jumping in a big puddle.
Oh, I love that. Does he like the water?
Yes, he loves to splash.
He looks very happy. Did you bring a towel?
I forgot the towel.
Oh no. He will be wet. Is that okay?
Yes, he runs home dry.
That is lucky. Good luck with the photo.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a bright yellow bird today and it sang a happy song for me.
That is such a lovely surprise. Did you see where it went?
Yes, it flew up into a big tree and I smiled all day.
Smiling makes everyone around you feel warm too. Do you want to look for it again?
Maybe, but right now I just want to sit and feel the sun on my face.
Sitting in the sun is a perfect way to stay happy. Enjoy that quiet moment.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I float when I am still?
Your body is light like a big balloon. Do you like feeling light in the water?
What happens when I kick my legs?
You push the water back, so it pushes you forward. Does that help you go fast?
Why does the water feel cold on my ears?
I do not know why your ears feel that way.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is great to hear. What made you smile?
I found a coin in my pocket.
A coin? That is a lucky find.
It makes me want to share lunch.
Sharing is nice. Do you have extra food?
Yes, I have two sandwiches.
That sounds delicious. Can I have one?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do I put the letter in the box?
Yes, you do. Is your letter for a friend?
Yes, I gave the man my money.
Good job. Did the man give you a stamp?
Yes, he did. What is that white thing next to him?
I do not know. Do you want to look inside the building?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to get stronger, but I do not know what to eat.
Try to eat colorful fruits and green vegetables every day. Do you have a favorite fruit?
I like apples, but I also like ice cream a lot.
That is okay. Just try to eat more fruit and less ice cream. How many apples do you eat in a week?
Maybe two or three? I am not sure.
That is a good start. You can learn as you go. I do not know your full plan, but small steps help.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big secret. I am very happy to tell you.
That sounds fun. What is it?
I found a lost puppy in the yard.
That is kind of you. Is the puppy safe?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Monday was cold and wet. I wore my blue coat.
That sounds cozy. Did you take your umbrella?
Yes, I did. It was a good day.
Good for you.
Tuesday I played in the park. The sun came out.
That is happy news. What game did you play?
We kicked a red ball. My friend ran fast.
Running is fun. Did you win the game?
We tied, but we had fun. It was a good day.
A tie is a win if you smile.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like apples best.
Apples are sweet and crisp. Do you like green ones?
I like the red ones.
Red apples are very juicy. Do you eat them with your family?
Yes, we eat them together.
That sounds nice. What is your favorite part?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to make a plant drink water.
Do you have a clear glass? You can put a cut stem of a flower in the water to see it move.
I have a glass, but what else do I need?
Add a few drops of food color to the water. Do you know where the leaves are?
Yes, the leaves are on top. How do I see the color?
Wait for a day or two for the color to rise. Does your plant have green leaves?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad because my brother took my toy.
That feels very bad. Do you want to talk to him?
I do not know how to stop the angry feeling.
Deep breaths can help a lot.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a scary dream about a dark forest today.
That sounds frightening. Did you wake up crying?
No, I just felt cold and hid under my blanket.
I am glad you are safe now. Do you still feel cold?
My hands are warm again after some tea.
Good. That is the true answer to your worry.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you keep that box locked?
It holds a sweet surprise for you. Do you like big surprises?
Yes. But why is it a secret?
I do not know for sure. Have you ever seen a star fall?
No. Can I open it now?
Not yet. It must wait for the night. What color do you like best?
Blue. Why must it wait?
Magic needs time to work. Are you ready to wait?
I think so.
Good. The box will speak soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big rainbow after the rain stopped. It looked like a bridge of colors.
That sounds like a lovely sight. Do you know how rainbows form?
I do not know how they form, but the sky was very blue. I felt happy standing in the wet grass.
It is nice that the happy feeling stayed with you. Did you take a picture of it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent all day on my math sheet and I am very tired.
That sounds hard. Did you finish all of it?
I finished most of it, but one puzzle is very tricky.
You are doing a great job. What is the last problem about?
It is about counting apples in a big basket.
Apples are fun. Do you have any left to eat?
I have two left and I want to save them for snack time.
That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late for work.
The short path is through the trees. Do you like trees?
I must run. The bus leaves soon.
Trees give good shade on hot days.
I do not have time for shade.
I do not know your route. Is it the long road?
Yes, it is the long road.
Run safe. I will see you later.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run. Can I get to the gate fast?
Yes, go straight ahead. Are your shoes tied?
I am almost there. The path looks long.
It is just a short path. Do you see the big tree?
I am late. I need to leave now.
Run to the gate. Have fun later.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it true babies cry for food?
Yes, crying is how they say they are hungry. Are you watching the baby right now?
How do I know if he is warm enough?
Touch his back to check for cold spots. Do you have a soft blanket?
Can he see me clearly yet?
His eyes are still getting stronger. Is he looking at your face?
Why does he smile so much?
Smiles mean he is happy and safe. Do you feel happy seeing him smile?
I hope I am doing this right.
You are doing a great job already. I know taking care of babies is hard work.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the books in this part so quiet?
We keep voices low so others can think. Do you like reading stories?
I like stories, but why are the lights so bright here?
Bright light helps our eyes see the words. Are you tired?
My eyes hurt a little. Why can we not use our own lamps?
We keep things safe so fire does not start. Would you like to sit?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are mountains so tall?
They rise because the Earth pushes rock upward. Do you like to climb?
I do. What is a mountain made of?
It is mostly stone and dirt. Do you see clouds on top?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I told my friend I would share my toy, but now I want it back.
That is hard to do. Do you still trust your friend?
Yes, I think he is nice, but I like my toy very much.
Honesty is kind. Have you asked him to play together?
No, I have not. I am too shy to talk to him.
A small "hi" is a start. It feels like a big weight to carry alone.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is good manners?
It is being kind to others. Do you like being nice?
Yes, I do. How do I start?
Say please and thank you. Is it hard for you?
Not really. What else?
Wait your turn in line. Do you wait well?
Mostly. Is that all?
No, but that is a start. I am glad you asked.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go. Do you know if the people next door are home?
I am not sure. Have you tried knocking?
No time! Is their dog barking?
It is very quiet. Do they have a dog?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hi, I need to wrap this box fast.
Okay, I can help you. What is the size?
It is a big shoe box.
That is good. Do you have tape?
Yes, it is right here.
Great. I will hold the box.
Thank you, I am almost done.
You are welcome. Is it a gift?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My lunch box is full of sandwiches.
That sounds yummy. Do you like them with cheese?
Yes, I love cheese.
Cheese is very tasty. I am glad you enjoy it.
I have orange juice too.
Good choice for a drink. Is it sweet?
It is sweet and cold.
It must taste great. Eat well.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. What makes you feel this heavy?
I do not know why.
That is okay not to know. Do you feel tired?
Maybe a little.
Sadness can make us tired. Did you rest your eyes well?
I slept a lot.
Rest can help, but it may not fix the feeling. Is there one small thing that makes you happy?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am so tired on this long plane ride.
That is very normal. Do you have a good book to read?
No, I just want to sleep, but I do not know how to rest on a seat.
Try to close your eyes and breathe slow. Did you eat anything before the trip?
I had a sandwich. My back feels very stiff and tired.
You can use the seat back for support. Do you have a pillow with you?
I do not have a pillow. Is there a way to fix this?
I do not know the best way to fix a stiff back. I hope the flight ends soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just saw the prettiest little village by the river.
That sounds nice. What color are the houses?
The walls are white and the doors are blue.
Blue doors are a great touch. Do people wave from their windows?
Yes, the neighbors always smile and say hello.
How warm that must feel. Is there a market there?
There is a tiny shop that sells fresh bread.
I love the smell of bread. Do you buy a loaf?
I bought two, one for me and one for my cat.
Your cat is very lucky. Have a sweet day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the big bone in the front from a dinosaur?
Yes, it is from a very old, big lizard. Do you like bones?
The robot is flashing lights. Is it really thinking?
Yes, a helper is telling it what to do. It seems fun, right?
Can we buy a small toy car for me?
I do not know if we have cars there. Let us look and see.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn to ride a bike. I feel proud that I tried.
That is great news. Do you have a helmet on?
Yes, I do. How do I start moving?
Just push the ground with your feet. Is your heart beating fast?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the teacher always smiling?
She is happy to help you. Do you like her smile?
Why does she read stories every day?
She wants to share new words with us. I do not know why you ask.
Why does she sit so close?
She wants to see if you need help. Do you feel okay?
Why does she use a red pen?
It marks the spots to fix. I do not know why you ask.
Why is the class so loud?
We are excited about the game. Is it too loud?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a toy in the dark.
That sounds scary. What does it look like?
It has long, cold hands.
That is not a friendly shape. Did it move?
Yes, it reached for my shoe.
That is a bad sign. Did you run away?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big promise to my friend.
That sounds great. What did you promise to do?
I said I would share my last cookie.
You are very kind. Do you still have the cookie?
Yes, it is right here in my pocket.
I do not know what kind of cookie it is. Do you want to tell me?
It is a chocolate chip one with lots of gooey bits.
Yum, that sounds tasty. Will you give it to your friend now?
Yes, I am going to give it to her today.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to give my teacher.
That is hard. What does your teacher like to eat?
She likes apples.
A nice red apple could work well.
I am still not sure.
You can just ask her what she wants.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I played chess today and lost to my little brother.
That is a tough loss. Did you have fun anyway?
Yes, we laughed a lot while we moved the pieces.
Laughter is good. Do you want to play again later?
I think I need a break from the board for now.
A break is smart. Good luck next time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to keep a goat, but I do not know what to feed it.
Goats love hay, grass, and fresh water. Do you have a big fence around your yard?
Yes, I have a fence, but my dog likes to chew on the goat's ears.
That is a bad habit for the dog to have. You must keep them apart to keep the goat safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need help making a sandwich.
First, spread jam on the bread. Do you like red or green apples?
I picked up a grape.
Put the grape on the jam. Do you want to add cheese?
Yes, I am adding cheese.
Now put the top slice on. Do you like your toast crunchy?
I cut it into four parts.
Nice cut. Please enjoy your lunch.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a big magnet, but it will not stick to the door.
Is the door made of iron?
I think so, but it is not sticking.
Try pushing it hard against the metal part. Sometimes cold steel is hard to grip. Is it very cold outside?
It is cold, and now it sticks!
Great! Heat helps magnets work better. Do you want to try a smaller magnet too?
Yes, but what if it breaks?
Magnets do not break easily. They are very strong and tough. Just do not drop them on your foot.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to clean my fish tank. How do I do it?
You should take out about a quarter of the water. Do you have a bucket for this?
Yes, I have a blue bucket. What else do I do?
Put the new water in and wash the decorations gently. Do you have a brush?
No, I only have a sponge. Is that okay?
A clean sponge is fine. Make sure you rinse it well first.
I did that. Now I put the fish back in.
That is a good step. Do your fish look happy?
They look fast and bright. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome. Enjoy your clean tank.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a camera but I do not know what to take.
That is a hard question to answer. Do you like the sky?
I think the sky is boring right now.
I do not know what you would like to see. What makes you feel happy?
My dog makes me feel very happy.
Take a picture of your dog then. Is he in the room with you?
Yes, he is right here sleeping.
You can wait for him to wake up.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel really good today.
That is great to hear. What made you feel this way?
I found a big yellow dandelion.
That sounds like a nice surprise. Is it blooming?
Yes, it has a soft white puff on top.
What a lovely sight. Did you blow on it?
I did, and the seeds flew away.
That must have been fun to watch. Did you wish on it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The rain makes me sad today.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you like the sound of it?
No, it makes my clothes wet and cold.
That is not fun at all. Would you like to go inside?
Yes, I think I will.
Good choice. Is your home warm?
It is very cozy and dry.
That sounds nice. Do you have a cup of tea?
Yes, I am drinking some hot cocoa.
That is a great idea. I hope it makes you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to sing but my voice sounded bad. I want to stop.
That feels hard, I know. Do you like singing?
Yes, I do. I just feel silly.
Feeling silly is normal when you start. What song makes you happy?
My favorite song. I guess I will try again.
Good for you. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I want to build a shed. Why do I need to pick a level spot?
A level floor keeps your things from tipping over. Do you have a flat piece of land?
Yes, I have a flat spot. Why should I put wood up high?
Keeping wood off the ground stops water from making it rot. Is your spot wet often?
Not much, but why do I need to seal the wood?
Sealant keeps rain from getting inside the wood.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I hold the cards?
Hold them like a fan in your hand. Do you have a pair of dice?
Yes, I have dice.
Great, but dice are not for playing cards. Do you want to play poker?
What is poker?
It is a game where you try to make the best hand. Do you like math?
I do not know math well.
That is okay, you can just guess. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I cannot help my friend fix her bike.
That feels hard. Do you know what part is broken?
I do not know, and I am too tired to look.
It is okay to rest first. Are you hungry?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate Monday. It is just a bad day.
I understand. What is the first thing you do on Monday?
I have to get up so early. It feels wrong.
Early mornings are hard for many people. Do you like waking up on weekends?
I love weekends. Monday ruins the rest of the week.
That is a common feeling. What do you like to do on Sunday?
I sleep a lot. I just want a break.
Rest is very important. Do you usually work or go to school?
Yes, I work. I just want to quit today.
That sounds very tiring. Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say please?
It shows we are kind. Do you like to be kind?
What if I forget to say please?
Just say sorry. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad. The soup tastes bad.
Oh no. Did you add too much salt?
Yes. I added too much salt. Now it is ruined.
I am sorry. Do you want to try adding some water?
Water? Will that fix it?
Yes, it will help. I think you can fix it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I promised to water the plant, but I forgot. Did I break my promise?
Yes, you missed it, but that is okay. Do you feel bad about it?
I want to fix it. How do I keep a promise next time?
You can write it down so you remember. Do you have a pen?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie my shoes properly?
Yes, you can start by making a loop with one string. Do you know how to make a loop?
I make one loop, but then I get stuck.
Make a second loop with the other string. Cross them over each other. Is your string long enough?
Yes, I crossed them, but it feels loose.
You need to pull tight to make a bow. Pull gently so it does not snap.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know about bugs right now, but I have no time.
A bee helps plants grow by moving pollen. Do you like honey?
I have to go, please be quick.
Ants are very strong lifters. Are you watching a garden?
My shoes are falling apart, help me!
I do not know how to fix shoes. Do you have tape?
I am late for work, stop it.
Flies have big eyes with many parts. Is it a big fly?
I am running, goodbye!
I hope you arrive on time. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lights went out and I am so happy about it.
Why is that? I thought you would be worried.
Because now we must use candles and talk together.
That sounds lovely and calm. Do you have enough candles?
Yes, we have a big box of them ready.
Oh good, you will have plenty of light.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate clouds. They make everything look gray and sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like the sun?
Yes, I do, but the clouds never go away.
Clouds are just moved water that will fall as rain. I do not know when they will leave, but they always do. Do you have an umbrella?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know how to tie a knot for my rope.
Pull the rope tight and cross the ends. Do you have a good example?
Yes, but my hands are shaking. I am in a big rush.
Take a slow breath to calm your hands. Are you going to a class?
I have to go now. Please help me finish it.
Cross the left over the right and pull hard. Good luck with your hobby.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do I make bread fast?
Mix flour, water, and yeast. What flavor do you like?
Just plain. Please be quick.
Knead it well and let it rest ten minutes.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to take the dog out, but the leash is not here. Can you see it?
I see a red leash by the door. Do you have your shoes on?
Yes, I have my shoes. Thank you. I am going now.
Good luck. Does he like to run fast?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like that song with the drums. It makes me want to dance.
That sounds fun. Do you dance in your room?
Yes, but my mom says I am too loud. Do you like loud songs?
I like happy songs. What is your favorite part?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late and I feel very sad.
It is okay to feel that way. What is making you worry?
I have a big test soon and I am stuck.
I do not know the answers, but you can try. Do you have a plan to study?
I am sorry, I must run now.
Good luck on your test. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I really like apples.
Apples are great. Do you like them red or green?
I think red ones taste best.
They are often very sweet. Why do you like them so much?
They make me feel happy.
That is lovely to hear. Do you eat them with breakfast?
I do, almost every morning.
That sounds like a good start to the day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want my plant to drink water. How does it get the water to the top leaves?
The roots pull the water up like a straw. Do you water your plant in the morning?
Yes, I do. But the leaves still look dry. Is that bad?
It might need more sun to help it move the water. Do you see any brown spots on the leaves?
No, they are just a bit soft. Should I water it more?
I am not sure why they are soft. Please check the soil to see if it is wet.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I build a small robot at home?
You can use a cardboard box and some buttons. Do you have any glue?
Yes, I have glue. What is the next step?
Cut the box into a square shape. Do you like round or square things?
I like squares. How do I make it move?
That part needs special parts I do not know how to make. Do you have a big box?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to make a snowman.
Do you have cold weather where you live? You need snow to build one.
I live near a beach. It is warm most of the time.
That is tricky. Do you like hot weather? You might need to wait for winter.
I love the beach, but I miss the snow. How do I get snow?
I do not know how to make snow. Do you have a freezer at home?
Yes, I have a big freezer. Can I use that?
You can try to build a small one inside. Do you have fun toys?
I have lots of plastic balls. Can I use those?
Yes, that works well. Do you have a hat?
I have a red hat. Is that good?
That sounds perfect. Have fun building.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the food here so tasty?
The chef uses fresh plants and meat. Do you like vegetables?
I do not care for carrots.
That is okay. They are still good for you.
Why does the place smell so nice?
The wood oven gives it a warm scent.
Is the soup hot?
Yes, it is very hot. Be careful not to burn your tongue.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love drawing pictures, but I am running late.
That is fun. Do you use pencils?
Yes, I have many colors. I must go now.
Take your time with your art.
Goodbye.
Bye bye.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do some flowers smell so nice?
Plants make that scent to help bugs find them. Do you like smelling fresh flowers?
Yes, I do. How does the smell help them?
It brings in bees to help them make seeds.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw the new baby. He is so small.
That is true. Babies grow very fast. Do you like looking at him?
He has a funny face when he eats.
Funny faces are cute. What does he eat?
Just milk from the bottle.
Milk is very good for him. I do not know his favorite brand. Is the bottle big?
It is not too big. I think he is happy.
I am glad to hear that. Happy babies are best. Do you want to wave at him?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad. The food at my favorite place was bad.
That feels rough to eat bad food. What kind of food did you get?
It was just cold and weird. I do not want to go back.
I am sorry you had a bad meal. Do you know if they will fix it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we stir the soup?
Stirring helps the heat reach every part of the food. Do you like your soup with carrots in it?
Yes, I do. Why does the pot bubble?
The water gets very hot and turns into gas bubbles. Is that scary to you?
Not at all. Why does the kitchen smell so nice?
The spices give off warm and sweet scents as they cook.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up at seven. The sun was bright and warm. I ate toast for breakfast.
That sounds like a nice start. What time did you play outside?
I played until four. Then I watched the sky turn red. I am tired now.
You worked hard today. Do you like the color red?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I tried to build my tower, but it fell down. I want to try again, but I am scared.
It is okay to be scared. Did you use the big blocks at the very bottom?
Yes, I did. But the top part feels wobbly. What should I do?
Try making the top part a little smaller. That will help it stand.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like to read at night but I get sleepy. What can I do?
Try reading by a bright light to stay awake. Do you like short books?
That helps. I also lose my place often.
Use a bookmark to keep your spot. Is the room too dark?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I jump over a big rock in the river?
That is a bold idea. Do you have strong legs?
Yes, I think so. But what if the water is too cold?
Then you will shiver and stop. Is the water moving fast?
It looks slow today. So I can try to hop over it?
Yes, you can try, but be very careful.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the bakery today and bought a warm cake.
That sounds lovely. Did you eat it all by yourself?
I shared it with my brother and we were very happy.
Oh, how nice to share. Do you want to buy more for tomorrow?
Yes, I think I will go back to buy a slice of pie.
A pie sounds tasty. I do not know if they have one, but you should ask.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to run fast today but my legs felt heavy.
That sounds tiring. Did you take a break?
I stopped to drink some cold water.
Good choice. How did the run end?
I walked the last part home because I was tired.
Being honest with your body is smart. Do you plan to run again soon?
Maybe tomorrow if my legs feel better.
Rest is part of training. Hope you feel strong tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bike made a loud crash sound and now the wheel will not spin.
Oh no, that hurts. Did you see where it broke?
I do not know. I just want to go home and sit in my bed.
That is a fair wish. Are you safe to walk?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a hidden box in the attic. I do not know what to do with it.
That sounds very exciting. What did you see inside?
It is full of old coins and a strange ring. I am scared someone might come for it.
Do you know where the box belongs?
I think my great-grandmother might have owned it. But I am not sure.
Ask your family if they know about it. A warm chat is often the best fix.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I plant a seed?
You dig a small hole in the dirt. Do you have a trowel?
Yes, I do. What do I do next?
Put the seed in the hole and cover it with soil. Do you like to garden?
I do. How do I make it grow?
Give it water and let the sun shine on it. Where does it get its light?
It gets light from the sky. Is that all?
Yes, that is all you need to start.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very hungry from school.
Lunchtime is the best. Do you like hot food?
Yes, I want a big chicken leg.
That sounds very tasty. Did you share with friends?
No, I saved it just for me.
Keeping it for yourself is okay. Are you happy now?
Yes, I am happy and full.
That is good to hear.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel bad because I broke your cup.
That is very nice of you to tell me. Did you mean to break it?
No, my hand slipped on the floor.
I am glad it was not on purpose.
Can I help fix the mess?
Yes, please wipe up the water. Are your hands dry now?
Yes, I dried them on my shirt.
Your shirt looks wet. Do you need a towel?
Yes, please give me a towel.
Here is a towel for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my neighbor walking a small dog today.
That sounds nice. What kind of dog is it?
It was a brown puppy with floppy ears.
How cute. Did the neighbor wave at you?
Yes, she smiled and waved her hand.
Neighbors should be kind. Did you talk to her?
We said hello and she asked how I am.
That is a good start. Do you see them often?
I see them every morning on my walk.
That is a sweet routine.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big horse at the park. It was brown.
That sounds like fun. Did it have a long tail?
Yes, it was very long. It looked like a lion.
Horses do not have manes like lions. Do you know if it was friendly?
I think it was. It came near my hand.
That is a gentle horse. Be careful, though.
I will be careful. I just want to pet it.
You must ask the owner first. Do you like the way it walks?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Did you keep your promise to help me?
Yes, I did. What did you want to ask?
Do you still like playing in the rain?
I do. Do you?
Why is the sky blue?
I do not know for sure. Do you like the color?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to wash my vegetables.
You just need a bowl and some water. Do you have a colander?
What is a colander?
It is a basket with holes. It helps the water fall out.
I do not have one.
You can use a big sieve or just tilt the bowl. Do you like peas?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad inside. I do not know what to do.
That sounds hard. Do you want to talk about it?
I just want the bad feeling to stop. What should I do?
I am not sure exactly why you feel this way. Maybe try a warm drink?
I do not want a drink. I feel lost.
It is okay to feel lost. Are you alone right now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My chair leg broke and I am very mad.
I am sorry it broke. Is the wood cracked or just wobbly?
It is cracked and I do not know what to do.
Glue works well for small cracks. Do you have any glue at home?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the bus stop?
It is just past the big tree. Do you have much time?
No time. Is the park close by?
Yes, the park is next to the bus stop.
Where is the red door?
I am not sure about a red door.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a dog that played a tiny drum all morning.
That is so funny. Did it play well?
It was very loud and made me smile.
Music can make you feel happy. What song do you like?
I like songs with a fast beat.
Fast beats are fun to dance to.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a plan to clean my room right now.
A quick list helps. Do you want to start with the floor?
Yes, but I also have books and toys.
Do the books first, then the toys. Are you playing music?
No, I am silent and fast.
That is good for focus. Pick up one thing at a time.
I feel ready to go now.
Great job. How does that feel?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I ran fast today.
That is great. Do you like running?
Yes. My legs hurt.
That means you worked hard. Are you thirsty?
Yes. I want water.
Drink some water. Do you plan to run again?
Maybe. I am tired.
Good. Rest is important.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am nervous about my new job. I do not know what to do.
It is normal to feel scared. Do you have a list of tasks?
No, they just gave me a key and a door.
That is a good start. Try opening it and look around.
The room is empty and I feel lost.
You can sit and watch for a bit. What sounds do you hear?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I counted my toes today.
That is a fun idea. Do you have ten toes?
Yes, I do!
I am glad you are happy. What do you count next?
My friends.
I do not know how many friends you have. Is it five?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad. The wall of my new shed is crooked and it looks so wrong.
I am sorry it feels that way. Have you checked if the ground is flat?
I do not know if the ground is flat. My tools are all lost and I feel dumb for wasting time.
That is a tricky problem. Do you have a straight stick to help you measure?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The loud thunder scared me.
It is just the sky making noise. Are you safe in bed?
Yes, but the wind is very strong.
Wind moves fast when it is angry. Do you see the trees shaking?
I do not know what to do with my fear.
You can hold your blanket tight. Does that make you feel warm?
My eyes are dry but my heart beats fast.
That is normal when you are scared. Do you want to play a quiet game?
What kind of game?
We can count the seconds between the rumbles.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The rain stopped and I saw a big rainbow.
That looks like a beautiful bridge in the sky.
I watched it for a long time until it faded.
Did you take a photo to remember it?
I did not have a camera, but I felt happy.
Joy is a wonderful way to save a memory.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Can you fix my robot? I am very late.
I am not sure how to fix it, but are you going to school?
Yes. The robot has a broken wheel. It makes a loud noise.
Oh no. Have you tried oiling the wheel?
No. I do not have oil. I must leave now.
Good luck. Be safe on your way.
Thanks. I will try again tomorrow.
Okay.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big brown frog jump into the river.
That sounds like a lovely surprise. Did the frog make a big splash?
It splashed so hard that water flew on my face.
Oh my, that must have been quite cold. Was the water warm or cool?
The river was cold, but it was a fun, wet day.
I am glad you had a happy time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am very hungry this morning.
That is a good thing. What would you like to eat?
I would like an apple and some milk.
Apples and milk are a healthy choice. Do you have a fork?
I do not know what to do with a fork.
A fork helps you eat soft food like eggs or yogurt.
