talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the post office open today?
Yes, it is open. Do you like to send letters?
I need to send a card. How do I do that?
You just buy a stamp and put it on the card. Is it for a special day?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My carrot seedlings are all dead and I am very sad.
I am so sorry to hear that. Do you water them every day?
Yes, I pour a lot of water on them every morning.
Too much water can make roots rot. Try less water next time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to act in the play.
That is a great idea. Do you have a part?
I need to know how to act.
You just use your face and voice. Are you ready to try?
How do I speak loudly?
Take a deep breath and push the words out. Do you feel strong?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a very old book at the shop today. It had a picture of a king with a sword.
That sounds like a story from long ago. Did you look at the book?
Yes, the paper was brown and soft. It smelled like dust.
Old books often smell like that. Was the king happy or sad in the picture?
He looked strong. He was holding his sword up high.
Strong is a good thing for a king. Did you want to touch the sword?
No, I only looked at it. The man said I could not take it out.
Some books are too old to hold. I am glad you were careful.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad. My boss did not say please to me today.
That feels bad to hear. Do you want to talk about it?
Yes. I just want him to be nice.
I do not know your boss, but kindness is good. Did he help you at all?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The bus was late again.
Oh, that is frustrating. Did you miss your stop?
No, but it took so long.
I feel sorry for you. Was the road bad?
Yes, the bus was stuck.
That sounds tough. Do you like riding that bus?
Not anymore. It is too slow.
I understand why you are upset.
I just want to be home.
I hope you get there soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new place for food. The pie is so sweet.
That sounds very nice. What kind of pie is it?
It is apple. I want you to come next time.
I would love that. Is it far from here?
No, it is just down the street. I will take you there.
Great. Let us go soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must run, but tell me, do bears like honey?
Yes, they love it. Do you like sweet food?
No time for that. Where do tigers live?
They live in warm forests. Do you have a tiger pet?
No, just books. Are snakes cold blooded?
Yes, they use the sun to warm up. Do you like warm days?
I am late. One last thing, can dogs fly?
No, they cannot fly. Run fast!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very hot and angry right now.
It is good to feel that. Do you want to breathe in the cold air with me?
I am trying, but my heart beats fast.
Let your hands rest on your knees. Is there one small thing that bothers you most?
Yes, my toy broke and I cannot fix it.
That feels sad. Do you think we can glue it back together?
I do not know if glue will work.
We can try a gentle way. Is it okay if I look at the break with you?
Yes, I will sit very still.
Good. Let us start with the piece on the left.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting so long.
Stretching is the best fix. Do you like to move your body?
Yes, but I am tired. How do I stretch?
Sit tall and reach your hands up high. Then twist your waist slowly.
That feels good. What else can I do?
Try bending your knees to your chest. It is very safe.
Okay, I will try that now.
That sounds like a good plan. Are your legs feeling lighter?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new toy shop on the corner. It has so many cute dolls.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you want to go look inside?
Yes, I want to buy one for my sister. She loves colors.
That is a sweet idea for a gift.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to jump in the pool fast.
That sounds fun. Are you cold?
No, it is hot outside.
You will enjoy the water. Do you like splashing?
Yes, I love the splash.
Great choice. Have a good swim.
Thanks, I am going now.
Be safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I kick a ball?
Put your body over the ball and swing your leg. Do you have a ball to try?
I do, but I always miss the goal.
Aim for the corner of the net. What size is your goal?
It is a small toy goal.
That helps you focus your aim. Do you like playing with friends?
I play alone in the yard.
That is a good start. You can always bring a friend later.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am holding a rod but the fish do not come. What should I do?
Try moving your rod to a quieter spot. Do you like fast water or slow water?
I do not know which water is good. It all looks the same to me.
I do not know your exact spot, but try a place where the water moves slowly.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I make my pictures look good?
Stand in bright light and keep the picture steady. Do you have a phone or a real camera?
I use my phone, but the people always look blurry.
Hold the phone with both hands and rest your elbows on something. Do you want to take photos inside or outside?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished a run and I feel so good.
That is wonderful. Do you like running on the grass?
Yes, it is soft and fun. My legs feel strong.
Good for you. How far did you go today?
About two miles. It was a big step for me.
Two miles is a great start.
I think I will keep doing it every week.
I am happy for you. Keep up the good work.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need help with my math work. It takes so much time.
Take a deep breath. What part is hard?
I do not know how to do the fractions.
Let us start with the easy ones. Do you have a pencil?
Yes, I have a pencil. I am very late.
We can skip the hard ones for now.
That is good. I must finish fast.
Focus on the first line.
I can do it now. Thanks.
You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The rain is loud outside. I do not know what to play.
That sound can be scary. Do you like to read?
I like reading, but I am too wet to sit down.
Drying off first makes books nice. Do you have a warm blanket?
Yes, I do. But I feel very sad.
Sad feelings are okay when you are wet. I do not know how to fix that, but I am here.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I ran all the way here. My boss yelled at me again. I am so tired.
That is very hard to take. Do you want to sit for a bit?
No, I must run. I have no time to talk.
I am sorry you have no rest. I hope the next day is better.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn an instrument, but I am not sure which one.
That is a big choice. What kind of songs do you like to listen to?
I like loud songs with fast drums and loud guitars.
Rock music sounds like a great fit for you. Do you like playing by yourself, or with a group?
I like playing in a band with my friends.
A band needs a lead player and a rhythm player. Do you want to be the one with the most solos?
I do not know what a solo is.
A solo is when one person plays the main part for a little while. Do you like being in the spotlight, or hiding in the back?
I like being in the back where it is safe and quiet.
Then the bass guitar might be the perfect home for you. It keeps the beat and feels like a good place to start.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make bread. What do I need?
You need flour, water, yeast, and salt. Is your yeast still fresh?
How do I know if it is good?
Mix it with warm water and sugar. It should bubble up.
The dough looks very sticky. What should I do?
Add a little more flour. Be careful not to add too much.
How long do I bake it?
Bake it until it sounds hollow when you tap the bottom. I do not know your oven's size.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I keep my fish happy in the tank?
You should check the water every day. Is your tank big enough for them?
I think it is a bit small.
A bigger home makes them more active. Do they swim a lot?
Yes, they swim near the top often.
That might mean they need more oxygen. Have you changed the water yet?
I changed it last week.
Fresh water helps them breathe better. Do they eat quickly?
They eat very fast.
That is good news for their health. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do trains go on tracks?
The tracks hold the heavy train up so it can roll fast. Do you like riding fast?
Why do the wheels make a loud sound?
The metal parts hit together as they turn around. Is that sound fun to you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: It is raining outside. How do I make a paper boat?
That is a fun game. Do you like the sound of rain? Fold a square piece of paper in half.
I love the rain. What do I do next?
Open it and fold the corners down to make a triangle. Then fold the side corners down again.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big lighthouse today. It glows yellow at night.
That is a nice picture. Do you like the color yellow?
Yes, I like it. I felt warm looking at it.
That sounds cozy. What did you do after that?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to walk more to stay healthy, but I do not know where to start.
Start with ten minutes a day. How do you usually spend your mornings?
I drink coffee and read the news. I am ready for a change.
Try walking while you listen to a book. Do you like music or stories?
I like stories. Is it safe to walk in the dark?
I do not know your exact street, so I can not be sure. Do you have a friend who walks with you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what day it is. It feels like a long wait.
Let us count the days together. What day was it when you woke up?
I think it was Monday, but I feel lost today.
That is okay. We can look at the calendar. Do you want to try again?
Yes, please help me find the right day.
Look at the circle of red. Is that the day you are on?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sleep better at night.
Do you play with a bright screen before bed? Turning off the light helps your eyes relax.
Yes, I often watch videos on my phone in the dark.
That bright light tells your brain to stay awake. Do you try to drink tea before sleep?
Sometimes I drink a hot cup of milk to feel cozy.
Warm drinks can help you feel calm and sleepy. Can you tell me what time you usually go to bed?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How does the internet work?
It is like a giant web of cables. Do you like playing games on it?
Yes, I love games.
Those games travel over the cables very fast. Do you know how to type?
Yes, I can type.
That helps you send words to others. It is a very cool tool.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do players use so many different balls?
Each ball has a new fuzzy cover. Do you like fuzzy things?
Yes, I do. Why is the court green?
Green helps us see the white ball well. Do you play outside?
No, I play in a room. Why do we call it tennis?
I do not know the true story. Is it fun in your room?
It is fun. Why is the net in the middle?
It stops the ball from going too far. Do you like the sound of the hit?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to try fishing this weekend. Do you know what rod I should buy?
A light rod is good for small fish. Do you plan to fish in a lake or a river?
A lake, because my family likes to swim there too.
A spinning rod works well for lakes. Do you already have a net to catch the fish?
No, I only have the rod and some string.
You need a net to help land the fish. Do you want tips on how to tie a knot?
Yes, I always lose the fish because the knot slips.
A double knot holds tight. Do you know how to bait a hook?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my trip was rained out.
That is really tough. What did you hope to do?
We wanted to go to the beach.
I am sorry the water took that from you. Did you at least try?
No, we stayed in the hotel all day.
That sounds very boring. Did you find any games to play?
Not really, just read a book.
Reading is nice, but I get why you are frustrated.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The sun is gone and the fire is out. How do I get it back?
Do you have some dry leaves? You need a small pile of them.
Yes, I have leaves. What do I do with them?
Place a few matches in the center. Then stack the leaves around the matches.
Okay. Should I light the big sticks first?
No, that is not safe. Light the small leaves first so they catch fire.
I see. The fire is small but warm. Is this done now?
It is for the start. Keep adding small sticks slowly.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to learn to ride a bike, but I am scared.
It is normal to feel scared. Do you have a helmet?
Yes, I have a big red helmet.
That is good. Your sister can hold the seat for you.
Is it hard to keep the balance?
It takes time, but you will get it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I went to the beach today.
The beach is a wonderful place. Was the water warm?
Yes, it was very warm. I swam for a long time.
That sounds like great fun. Did you see any fish?
I saw a big crab. It was a little scary but cute.
A crab is a fun thing to see. I am glad you had a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake a pie.
That sounds fun. Do you have any apples?
Yes, I have a basket of red apples.
Great. You will need to slice them thin. Do you have a sharp knife?
I have a knife, but I am not sure if it is sharp.
A dull knife is dangerous. Do you want to hold it like a claw?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we eat turkey on the big day?
It is a special food for thanksgiving. Do you like turkey?
Yes, I do. Why is it so big?
It is big to feed many people. Is your family big?
Yes, it is. Why do we give gifts?
It is nice to share joy. What did you give away?
I gave a doll. Why do we wait for snow?
Snow makes the holiday look white and fresh. Do you like the cold?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hurry, tell me about bugs!
Bugs are small and have six legs. Do you like beetles?
No time, what else?
Some bugs fly and some jump. I do not know which one is fastest.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the phone warm?
It gets warm because it works hard. Do you like to play on it?
Yes, I love the games.
That sounds fun. Are you playing right now?
Yes, I am playing.
Cool. How is the game going?
It is easy.
I am glad you are winning. Do you know how to stop it?
I do not know.
I do not know that either. Please ask a grown-up.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must run. The rain falls hard.
Please wait. Is your coat dry?
I am wet. I need to go now.
You look cold. Do you have a warm hat?
No. I must hurry.
Stay safe outside. Do not run on wet glass.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like reading about old wars. They make me feel sad.
I know sad is a hard feeling. Did you like the story before the war?
I like the part where they built the big castle. It looks so cool.
Castles are very strong and tall. Do you like building blocks?
Yes, I love blocks. Why do history books have so much fighting?
I do not know why they focus on fighting so much.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so late for school and I feel very sad.
Oh no, let us go fast. What do you like for breakfast?
I had eggs, but I still ran too slow.
Running is good for your heart. Are you hungry now?
Yes, but I must eat while I walk.
That is a good plan. Tell me, do you have your bag?
Yes, I have my bag and my shoes are on.
Great, we can start now. You can do it!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my phone screen all black?
Try holding the power button down. Do you hear a sound?
No, it is very quiet.
Try plugging it into a charger. Is the cable loose?
The light on the charger is red.
That usually means it needs time. Can you wait a few minutes?
It still has no picture.
I do not know what is wrong then. Have you dropped it?
Yes, it hit the floor last week.
The glass may be broken. Please take it to a shop.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How does a picture get from a far land to my little screen?
It travels on fast, invisible lines. Do you like looking at pictures?
Yes, I love them. But what if the lines get broken?
Then the picture waits for a new path. It tries again until it works.
That is very smart. Can you see where I am?
I can guess from the numbers you share. Do you like keeping secrets?
Only a few. Who builds all those big towers?
Many people with tools and plans. Do you like building things?
I like blocks. Is the internet made of blocks too?
It is made of code and wires. It is not made of blocks.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very scared about my big test tomorrow.
That is a normal feeling. Do you like reading for fun?
Yes, but the test is about math, not reading.
Math can be tricky. Have you tried practicing with simple puzzles?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in a rush. Does that horse look safe?
I think it is calm. Do you know how to ride it?
No. Can I just pet it quickly?
Yes, be very gentle. Is it a pet or a farm horse?
I do not know. Please help me go now.
Go safely. I hope you have fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why are some flowers red and others yellow?
They use different colors to show bugs where to go. Do you like red best?
I like the big yellow ones.
Those are sunflowers, and they look like the sun. Why do you like big flowers?
They look like a happy face.
That is a sweet way to see them. Do you plant your own?
I have one small pot with a daisy.
A daisy is a great first flower. How often do you water it?
I water it when the soil looks dry.
That is exactly what you should do. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My head hurts. How do I tie a scarf?
Put it around your neck. Do you have a cold?
Yes, I feel very hot.
Now cross the ends and pull tight.
I am done. Thank you.
You did well. Take some water.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am very tired of trying and I do not know what to do next.
That feels hard. What is the one small step you are afraid to take?
I am scared of failing again because I want to win.
Failing is just a way to learn. Do you want to try again tomorrow or today?
I think I will rest for now and try again soon.
That is a true and kind choice.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a movie. How do I start?
You start by writing a story. Do you have a good idea?
I wrote a story about a dog. What now?
You need to make a plan called a script. Is the dog funny or sad?
The dog is funny. I do not know how to film it.
You can use a phone camera. Do you have a camera?
Yes, I have a phone. How do I cut the video?
I do not know the exact app names. Do you have a computer?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for work. I need coffee fast.
Would you like a small cup of black coffee?
Yes, please. And I need something to eat.
Do you want a simple toast with butter?
That is perfect. Please do not take long.
I will be very quick. Is that all you need?
One piece of fruit, please. I must go now.
You are in a real hurry today, are you not?
I really am. Thank you for your help.
I hope your work day goes well.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so hot. I want to go in the house.
It is very warm outside. Would you like a cold drink?
No, I just want my ice cream.
I do not know where it is. Do you have a favorite flavor?
Yes, chocolate. I am angry about this heat.
I understand your feelings. Let us find some shade together.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared of the test tomorrow.
It is normal to feel worried. What part of the test scares you most?
I am afraid I will forget the answers.
Try to sleep well and eat a good breakfast. Do you have a plan for studying tonight?
I plan to read my notes one more time.
That is a good idea. I do not know your exact subject, but rest is key.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel tired and do not know what to eat.
Eating enough vegetables helps you feel strong. Do you like carrots?
I do not know how to cook them.
You can just boil them until they are soft. That is easy and true.
I still feel stuck on what else to pick.
Try adding beans for more power. Do you have beans at home?
I think I do have some.
Great. Start small and listen to your body. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need shoes fast, please.
We have many. What size do you need?
Size eight. I am running late.
Here is a black pair. Do you like them?
Yes, I will take them.
That works. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to stop spending too much cash.
That is a great goal to start with. Do you know where your money goes?
I think it vanishes fast on snacks.
Tracking every coin spent helps you see the truth. Are you willing to use a notebook for this?
I guess I can try a notebook.
Writing it down makes the spending feel real. Do you have a pen nearby?
Yes, I have a pen right here.
Start today and review it each night. You are already on the right path.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do leaves change color in the fall?
The leaves make their own food using sunlight. When the days get shorter, they stop making food and the green fades. Do you like walking in the park then?
Yes, I love the red and gold.
Nature likes to show its bright colors before winter comes. Do you collect any of the leaves?
Sometimes I put them in a jar.
That is a lovely way to remember the season.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a fun puzzle today. It is about a box with a red key.
That sounds interesting. What is inside the box?
It is a golden star. I want to give it to you.
Thank you for sharing. Do you have more puzzles?
Yes, I have a whole book of them. I am very happy.
That is wonderful. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a fence for my garden. How do I start?
First, dig small holes for the posts. Do you have a shovel?
Yes, I have one. How deep should the holes be?
Dig them about two feet deep. That will keep the fence strong.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to order a big apple pie please.
Sure, I can help with that. Do you want to add some milk to drink?
Yes please, I like cold milk.
Great choice. Are you hungry right now?
Yes I am very hungry.
Okay I will put your order in. The pie should be ready soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I ate too much junk food today. I feel bad.
That is a common feeling. Did you drink any water?
I hate that I am not doing better. It is hard.
Change takes time. What is your usual plan?
I want to eat fruit, but I never buy any.
That makes sense. Do you have fruit in the fridge right now?
No, just cookies. I am stuck.
Let us look for easy wins. Do you like vegetables?
I am tired of trying. I just want to give up.
You are trying hard, which is good.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not like the soup at the cafeteria.
That sounds sad. Do you want to try the salad instead?
The salad looks dry and cold.
I am sorry. Do you eat the bread with it?
I do not eat the bread because it is hard.
That is tricky. I do not know what else to suggest.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is coffee so hot?
We add hot water to the beans. Do you like hot drinks?
Why does tea taste sweet?
It has natural sugars inside. Is it strong or mild?
Why is coffee dark?
The beans are baked in fire. Do you like black drinks?
Why is tea green?
The leaves are dried quick. Do you see the color?
Why do I want both?
They make me feel good. Do you want a cup?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight is made of many colors. Blue light scatters the most, so we see it. Do you like watching the clouds?
Yes, I do. But why not red?
Red light passes straight through the air. Blue bumps into tiny air parts and spreads out. Do you know what color the sunset is?
It is often red and orange.
That is true. At sunset, blue light is scattered away, leaving red. Do you think that is pretty?
It looks very nice.
I am glad you like it. The sun makes all the colors, but our eyes see the scatter. Do you have any other questions?
No, that makes sense now.
I am happy to help. The sky is a big, beautiful puzzle. Thanks for asking.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sun feels very hot today.
Yes, it is a bright day. Do you like the heat?
It is too hot for my skin.
You should wear a hat. Is it sunny where you live?
I want to see it safely.
Use some cream on your skin. Do you have a nice hat?
I am not sure what to do.
Just rest in the shade.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss the quiet in our little village.
That is sad. What do you miss most?
The old oak tree by the river.
It sounds like a great place to sit. Did you play there?
Yes, I built a fort there last week.
I have not seen it. Was the fort strong?
It fell down when the wind blew.
Wind can be tricky. Did you feel safe inside?
Not always, but it was fun.
Fun is a good feeling. Do you want to build it again?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Can you fix this broken lock fast?
I try my best. Do you have the small key?
No. It is gone. Just open it now.
I cannot open it without a tool. Is the box heavy?
It is light. But I need it now. Help!
I am sorry. I do not know how to fix it. Can you call a pro?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to draw a cat today.
That sounds fun. What color was it?
It had a red body and blue eyes.
That is a bold choice. Was it happy?
Yes, it was smiling with a big grin.
A smile is easy to draw. Did you add ears?
I forgot the ears at first.
That happens. Did you add them later?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very bad today.
I am sorry to hear that. What hurts the most?
My head hurts a lot.
A headache can mean you are sick. Have you rested well?
I do not know what to do.
It is best to see a doctor. Do you have a fever?
Yes, my skin is hot.
Please call your doctor now. Is your throat sore too?
I will call them soon.
That is a good plan. Be safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I want to stop running. My legs hurt.
That sounds hard. Do you want water?
No. I just want to rest.
Rest is good. How far did you go?
Not far. I am tired.
Tired is okay. Did you sleep last night?
No. I was up late.
No sleep hurts. Why were you up?
I watched TV. I miss bed.
That makes sense.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start running.
Do you have any shoes?
Yes, I have soft shoes.
That is a good start. Do you like outside air?
I think I like the park.
Good choice. Do you feel tired or sick?
No, I just feel slow.
Slow is fine for now.
Okay, I will try the park.
I am glad to hear that. Go slowly and stop if you hurt.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like the red flowers.
Red flowers are very bright. Do you like their smell?
Yes, they smell sweet.
That is a nice way to see them. How many did you count?
I counted ten big ones.
Ten is a great number to find.
The bees are on one flower.
Bees love to drink sweet juice from blooms. Do you see any other bugs?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake cookies, but I do not know how. Do you know?
Yes, I do. First, you mix the batter. Do you have a big bowl?
Yes, I have a bowl. What is the next step?
Then you scoop the batter onto a pan. I do not know the exact time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now. The wind is very cold.
That wind feels sharp. Do you have a coat?
Yes, but it is too strong. It pushes me back.
Strong winds push hard. Is it safe to walk?
I am leaving. The air smells like rain.
Rain is coming soon. Stay warm on your way.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big brown snake in the river today. Was that a fish?
No, it was a real snake. Did it look scary to you?
Yes, it had big eyes. Can it bite me if I get too close?
Yes, it can bite. Please do not go near the water alone.
Okay, I will stay on the grass. Do snakes like to swim?
Yes, they swim very well. Do you want to see other animals?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make toast?
Put bread in the toaster and press the button. Do you like it crunchy?
Yes, I like it crisp. What is next?
Just wait for the light to pop up. What kind of jam do you use?
I use red berry jam.
That sounds good. If it does not pop up, check if it is plugged in.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How should I pack my small bag for a night trip?
Put your clothes in the bottom first. Do you have any wet items?
No, but I have a book and a phone.
Place the book flat and the phone in a pocket. Is your bag light enough?
It looks heavy, but I think it is fine.
Carry it on one shoulder to test the weight. Does it feel okay?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the red house fast.
It is by the big tree. Is it sunny there?
No, it is dark and I am scared.
Do not worry, I will help. Can you see the path?
Yes, I see a small path.
Follow it and you will arrive. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this new town.
That is hard. Why do you feel that way?
The houses are gray and quiet.
It can look cold. Do you miss your old home?
Yes, I miss my friends there.
I understand. That is true.
I feel very small here.
You are brave to try. Can I help you find a park?
I think I just need to go home.
That is your choice. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do bees make honey? Do they have a kitchen?
No, they have special jars inside the hive. Do you like sweet things?
Yes! Is the honey still there when the bee leaves?
The bee adds a drop of its own sweet fluid. Then it fans it with its wings to make it thick.
That is so hard work!
It takes many bees and a lot of time. Would you like to know what they eat first?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my blue paint look dark?
That happens when you use too much. Are you mixing it with black?
No, I used a lot of white.
White should make it lighter, not darker. Is the tube old?
Yes, the tube is very old.
Old paint can change how it acts. Try a new tube next time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start a fire for my picnic?
You need small sticks, matches, and a safe spot. Do you have any dry leaves?
Yes, I have lots of dry leaves. Thank you so much.
Great. Keep the leaves dry and light them slowly. Have a nice picnic!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just read about the first people who walked on the moon. It was so cool!
That is a great story! Do you know what year that happened?
Yes, it was in 1969. The rocket was so big and loud.
It must have been very exciting to watch from home. What did you feel?
I felt really happy and proud. It made me want to learn more.
Learning new things is a great way to stay curious. Do you like space stories?
I do! I also like old castles and kings.
Those are also fun to talk about. Do you want to learn about a famous castle?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so small looking at all those lights.
The sky is big, but you are still here. Do you like the red ones?
Yes, but it makes me sad.
Sad feelings are okay. Are you hungry?
No, just lonely.
I am with you. What is your favorite color?
Blue, I guess.
Blue is a calm color. Do you want to count them?
Maybe.
One, two, three. Let us start.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very hungry. My dog chased a cat all day.
That sounds tiring. Do you want some soup?
Yes, please. Can you add some bread?
Of course. The bread is very warm.
Thank you. I feel happy now.
You are welcome. I hope you enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a small boat and it feels slow in the water.
That is tricky. Do you have any heavy things inside it?
It has a big box of tools in the middle.
You should move the box to the back. That will help it go faster.
The boat also smells like fish.
I do not know why it smells that way. Do you clean it often?
I wash it after every trip with soap.
That is good, but the smell is strange. Maybe check the engine for leaks.
I will look for leaks right now.
Good luck. Tell me if you find the problem.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. When is the next month?
It is June. Do you like the sun?
No, I need my car. What month is it?
It is still June. Is your car lost?
It is stuck in mud. Which month comes next?
July comes next. Do you have a shovel?
I have no shovel. How many months are left?
Six months are left. That is a long time.
I will be home soon. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Drive with care.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke my pencil and now I am sad.
That is very hard. Do you want to try fixing it?
Yes, please show me how to do it.
Let us try together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Can you show me how to tie a shoe?
Yes, I can. Do you like laces on your shoes?
Yes, I do. Please help me.
Cross the left lace over the right lace. Is that easy to see?
Yes, I did it. What now?
Make a loop with one lace. Do you see the little hole?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. What made you feel this way?
I wanted to share my toys but my friend broke one.
That is not fair to you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today to play tennis. I hit the ball right into the tree.
Ouch, that tree must be lucky. Did you try to hit it again?
Yes, I tried hard, but my arm was still sore. I finally hit the net once.
That sounds like a very tiring day for you. Do you want to rest now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The baby is crying very loud. I do not know why.
Maybe he is hungry? Is he ready for food?
I tried to feed him, but he pushed the food away.
He might just need a warm hug. Does he like being held?
He cried when I held him, so I put him down.
I am not sure why he is so upset. Try to stay calm and try again.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The light in the tower is not turning. What should I do?
Try the manual lever first. Is it stuck?
I tried, but it will not move. It feels very tight.
Check for salt blocking the gears. Do you see any dust?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am packing my books. How do I put them in a box?
Put the heavy books at the bottom first. Are you keeping all your books?
Yes, I love them all. What should I do next?
Fill the empty space with soft clothes. Do you have any old shirts?
I have some old t-shirts. Does the box need to be taped shut?
Yes, tape it with a strip in the middle. Do you have a marker to write on it?
I do not have a marker. How can I know what is inside?
You can use a pen or a chalk stick. Is that okay for you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to find the red barn.
It is behind the big hill. Do you see the trees?
No, I only see grass.
Keep walking right for a minute.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a sand castle.
That looks so much fun. What shape is it?
It has a big tower.
I love tall things. Do you have a bucket?
Yes, I do.
Great! Did you pack the sand tight?
The sun is warm.
It is a nice day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know which drink is better for me to start my day.
Coffee gives you a quick push, but tea is calmer. Do you like things to be gentle?
I think I like the gentle feeling, but I am not sure.
Then try the tea first, because it is soft and warm.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run. Who wins today?
I do not know the score. Do you like the red team?
I must go now. Is the game done?
I think it is over. I hope you have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we put cold water in the machine?
Cold water stops bright colors from fading. Do you have any red shirts?
Yes, I do. Why do we add soap?
Soap helps pull the dirt off the fabric. Is the water looking clean?
It looks gray now. Why do we spin the clothes?
Spinning pulls the extra water out fast. This makes them dry quicker.
Should I use hot water for white clothes?
Hot water is great for very dirty whites. Do you have any stains on them?
A little grass stain. Why does the hot water help?
Heat helps the soap lift the stain up. Just check the tag first.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today. The sun was warm on my face.
That sounds like a nice day. Did you play on the swings?
Yes, I swung very high. My legs were a little tired.
Swinging is fun but it makes you tired. Do you know what month it is right now?
It is October. The leaves are turning red and brown.
October is the month with the red leaves. I like how you noticed the colors changing.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I started my new job today. It felt very big. I was a little scared, but I did my best.
That is brave. How did you feel after work?
I feel tired, but also happy. My hands were sore, but my heart was light.
You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people wear white to a wedding?
It is a long-standing tradition. Do you like the color white?
Why do they kiss each other in front of everyone?
It shows they are partners now. Is it bold for you?
Why is there so much cake at the end?
Sweet food makes happy times feel better. Do you prefer chocolate or vanilla?
Why do people cry during the vows?
Emotions run high when love is confirmed. Do you get emotional easily?
Why do we clap for the couple?
We clap to show our joy for them. I think it is a lovely idea.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to eat healthy, but I do not know what to choose.
Start with fruit and vegetables. Do you like sweet food or salty food?
I usually pick chips and ice cream.
Those are treats for later. Try an apple first. What colors do you see in your kitchen?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the baby cry so much?
Crying is how babies tell you what they need. Are you feeling tired?
Why do they have such soft hair?
Their hair is very soft because it is still growing. Do you like to touch it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared to ride my bike without help wheels.
That is a brave feeling. Do you want to try a small push first?
Okay, maybe I can sit on it and touch the ground with my feet.
Yes, touching the ground helps you feel safe. Are your brakes working well?
They work, but I am still nervous when I go fast.
If you are nervous, you can go very slow. It is okay not to know every trick yet.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I made a new friend today. I do not know what to say next.
That is great news. Do you like playing games?
Yes, we love to run and jump. I feel happy with him.
Running is fun. Tell him he is your friend.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does a horse have a long tail?
It uses the tail to swat away flies. Do you have a horse?
No, but I saw one at a farm. Why do they eat hay?
Hay is like their main food source. Is it fun to watch them?
Yes, it is very fun. Why is their nose so wet?
The wet nose helps them smell things better. Do you like horses?
I think they are cool. Why do they kick sometimes?
They kick to tell other horses to stay away. Is that scary?
A little, but I like them. Thank you.
You are welcome. I am glad I could help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to read my favorite book again, but I am not sure where to start.
Try opening the first page to see if the story still feels new to you. Do you remember who the main person is?
That is a good idea, but I am still a little worried I will forget the ending.
It is okay if you forget, because the feeling of reading matters most. Would you like to tell me who that main person is?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the light on?
The light is on because you asked for it. Do you like the light?
Yes, I do. What is the stuff that makes it shine?
It is called electricity. It travels through the wires to the bulb. Do you know where the wires go?
Do they go to the big box outside?
Yes, they go to the big box on the wall. Then they come from outside to your home.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have so many things. Where do I start?
Start with the big items first. Do you have your clothes ready?
I packed my shirt, but I forgot the shoes.
Do not worry, you can add them now. What else do you need for the trip?
I think I have everything, but I am not sure.
Check your list one more time to be safe. Did you bring any snacks?
Yes, I packed some cookies and a bottle of water.
That is a good plan. Your bag should be ready now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just saw the cool bones!
That is so fun. What did you look at first?
A big sea fish with sharp teeth.
Wow. Did you touch the glass?
No, I only looked close.
Good. Did you see any insects too?
Yes, tiny bugs in jars.
I love small things. I do not know what those were.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I sit here for a long time. I do not know what to do.
You can rest your eyes for a bit. Do you like to read books?
I have no books. My arms feel very tired.
You may stretch them out slowly. Does that help a little?
It feels better now. Thank you for talking to me.
I am glad to help. I hope your trip is soon over.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I saw the sad dog movie, but I do not know what to do next.
That is a hard choice. Do you want to watch it again?
No, I am too tired. I just want to sleep.
Sleep is good for you. Sweet dreams.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My legs hurt from this long flight. How can I stretch them safely in my seat?
You can lift your legs and point your toes toward the ceiling. Do you feel tight in your calves?
Yes, they feel very tight. Is there another move I can try?
Try bending your knees to hug your shins. Do you like hugging your knees?
That feels better, but my back is also stiff. How do I fix that?
Sit tall and roll your shoulders back slowly. Do you feel your chest open up?
I see. What if I want to stretch my neck?
Gently tilt your head to one ear. Do you feel a good pull?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so dumb. The words do not make sense in my head.
That is a normal feeling. Do you want to try just two words?
Maybe, but I am afraid I will fail again.
You are not failing, you are growing. What word worries you the most?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad inside.
I am sorry you feel that way. What made you feel this?
My favorite toy broke.
That is a very hard feeling to have. Do you want to talk more about it?
I just want it to stop.
It is okay to not know the answer right now. Are you hungry or thirsty?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn a song fast. I am in a big rush.
Deep breaths help your voice stay steady. Do you have a specific song in mind?
Can you teach me right now? I have no time to wait.
I cannot sing it for you, but you can try humming first.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what to do about the meeting.
That feels hard to decide. What is the main goal for you?
I want to get it over with fast.
You could just ask for the end time. Do you have a set time for it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start a new game of poker?
You give each player two face-down cards and one face-up card. Do you have a deck of cards with you?
Yes, but I do not know how to split the deck.
Hold the deck in one hand and use your other hand to pull off a few cards at a time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The snow is very thick on the ground today.
That sounds like a lot of work to clean up. Did you go outside?
I made a big ball of snow for a snowman.
Making a snowman is great fun. What color hat did you give it?
I found a red scarf in the closet and used that.
A red scarf makes the snowman look happy.
Then I threw the snow at my friend.
Throwing snow can be messy but it is a good game.
We were cold but we had hot soup after that.
Warm soup is the best thing after playing in the cold.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to tie my shoes. Can you show me?
Yes, first make a loop with one lace. What color are your shoes?
They are blue. What do I do next?
Cross the loops to make a knot. Do you like walking in the rain?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I take a sharp picture?
Hold your camera still and press the button slowly. Do you have a tripod?
No, I am using my phone.
That is okay. Find a flat spot to lean your phone against. Is the light good?
It is sunny outside.
Great, the sun helps a lot. Just aim at your thing and click.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run, but I feel very sad inside.
That is a heavy feeling. Are you sad about work?
No, just about life in general. I am late!
I understand. How does your body feel right now?
It feels tight and heavy. Please, I must go.
Be kind to yourself. Do you have a friend to talk to later?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have been sitting here for so long.
It feels like a long time, but we are getting close to the end. What are you thinking about while you wait?
I am thinking about the red balloon we are going to see.
That is a nice thing to think about. Do you know how long we have to wait?
I do not know. My tummy is a little hungry.
You have been very patient, and that is a good thing. Let us wait just a little bit longer.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have to move to a new house. It is a sad day.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a favorite toy to bring?
Yes, I have my bear. I will miss my old room.
That sounds nice. Who is going to help you with the boxes?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I help my new rose plant stay strong?
Give it bright light and warm water. Do you have a sunny spot for it?
I think my windowsill works well.
That is a great choice.
Should I cut off the dead parts?
Yes, trim the brown bits so the plant stays healthy. Do you have clean scissors?
I found a pair in the desk.
Good job, and that is all you need for now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. What time is it?
It is ten o'clock. Are you going to work?
No, I am going to the bus stop.
The bus comes at ten fifteen. Do you have your ticket?
I do not have a ticket.
I do not know if they will let you board.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to stop wasting my coins. How do I save them?
You can put every coin you get into a jar. Do you have a jar at home?
Yes, I have a big blue one.
That is a great start. Just drop a coin in each day and watch it grow.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you know what these big white things are?
They are clouds. Are you running to a meeting?
Yes. Do they fall down on us?
No, they are just wet air. Do you like rain?
I do not have time to think about it.
That is fine. Do you have an umbrella?
No, I left it at home.
Oh no. Will you get wet?
Maybe. I have to go now.
Good luck. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spilled my juice on the desk this morning.
Oh no, that is messy. Did you clean it up?
Yes, I used a big blue towel.
Good job with the towel. Do you have a new drink now?
I am just drinking water from my cup.
That sounds good and safe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so full of joy right now.
That is wonderful to hear. What made you feel this way?
I just love being alive and free.
It is nice to share such a good feeling. Do you have a friend nearby?
I want to share this happiness with you.
Thank you, I am glad you told me.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The ferry leaves in one minute. Where is the gate?
It is right over there on the left. Are you going on a boat trip?
Yes, I am. Is the water calm today?
Yes, the water is very calm. Do you like the sea?
Yes, I do. I must run now.
Run fast and have fun. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. How do I make it feel better?
I am sorry you are in pain. Does it hurt more when you move your neck?
Yes, it does. What should I do right now?
Try to rest in a quiet, dark room. Would you like to drink some water?
That sounds good. How do I drink water?
I do not know why you ask that. Do you need help holding the cup?
No, I just have a funny fever. Is the water hot or cold?
Cold water is usually nicer. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That is great to hear. What makes you so happy?
I found a new town near the river.
A town by the water sounds nice. Does it have a big park?
Yes, there are tall trees and soft grass.
That is a peaceful place.
The people there are very kind.
Kind neighbors are a gift. Do they bake bread?
Yes, the smell is very sweet.
That sounds delicious.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is walking good for my body?
Walking makes your heart strong. Do you like to run too?
Yes, I like to run with my dog.
That is great fun.
How long should I walk each day?
A short walk is fine. How far is your house from the park?
It is about ten minutes away.
That sounds like a perfect walk.
I will go now, thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to eat.
I am not sure, but do you want something warm or cold?
I want something warm.
Try the soup. It is good and true.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I read a clock?
Look for the long hand first. Do you know which one is longer?
Is it the thin one?
Yes, that is the minute hand. The short one tells the hour.
Okay, so if the short hand is on five, what time is it?
It is five o'clock. Do you see where the numbers start?
At the top with the twelve?
Yes, we always start at twelve.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to draw big cats.
That is fun. Do you draw tigers or lions?
I draw tigers mostly.
Tigers are strong. Do you use many colors?
Yes, I use orange and black.
That makes them look real. Do you show them to your mom?
Yes, she likes them.
That is nice.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired and my hands hurt from carrying boxes.
That sounds really hard. Are you drinking enough water?
I just want to stop for a moment.
It is okay to rest. Do you have a chair nearby?
The living room looks empty and sad.
It will feel better once things are in place. Do you want to put the pictures up?
I do not know where to start.
Let us just pick one small box first.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I need the answer now.
I know it is hard. What piece are you stuck on?
This red triangle. It fits no hole.
Try the back wall. Do you see a slot there?
No slot. I tried every spot.
That is odd. Is the piece broken?
It is whole. I am losing time.
Check the box again. Is there a secret flap?
I found it. The flap was hidden.
Great work. You did it well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel sad when I lose tennis games.
It is normal to feel that way. Do you play for fun?
Yes, but I get angry at my bad swings.
Anger can hurt your body. Try to breathe slow and deep.
I do not know how to hold the racket right.
I am not an expert on grip. Do you have a coach to help?
My coach is busy today.
You can read about it online. Do you like books?
I like video games more.
Video games can help your eyes. Keep practicing with joy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse at the park today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you get to feed it?
Yes, I gave it a carrot from my bag.
It must have loved that treat. Was the horse friendly?
It was very calm and just ate the carrot slowly.
Calm animals are best for kids. Did you ride on its back?
No, I only stood near its head to look at its soft fur.
Looking closely is a great way to learn. What color was its mane?
The mane was long, shiny, and a dark shade of brown.
That must have looked very beautiful.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel sick and need to see a doctor. What should I do?
That sounds like a good plan. Do you have a fever?
Yes, my head hurts and my throat is sore.
Tell the doctor about your head and throat. Is it hard to breathe?
No, I can breathe fine. I just feel very tired.
Rest is good for you. Bring a bottle of water.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is a circle?
A circle is a round shape with no corners. Do you like round things?
Yes, I like the sun.
The sun is a great example of a circle. Does it feel warm to you?
It feels very hot today.
Heat comes from the sun’s light. Do you like it hot or cold?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the pool now.
Is it a deep pool or a shallow one?
It is deep and I am late.
Please do not forget your goggles.
I have them and I must run.
I hope you swim safely.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is that a tall tower by the water?
Yes, that is a lighthouse. Do you like looking up at big things?
It looks scary when it is dark.
The light helps ships find their way safely.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I had a really bad day at school today.
I am sorry to hear that. Did something specific upset you?
My friend left me out of a game.
That must feel very lonely. Thank you for telling me.
It hurt my feelings a lot.
I know it is hard when friends are unkind. What made you feel better?
I just cried in the bathroom.
Crying is a safe way to let feelings out. Do you want to talk about it more?
No, I just want to be done now.
That is okay. It is good to rest now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I love apples but I never know how to pick a good one.
Look for a smooth skin and a bright color. Do you like sweet or sour tastes?
I think I like sweet ones best.
Sweet apples often have a slightly soft spot near the stem. Is the fruit store far from your home?
No, it is just on the corner.
That is great because fresh fruit tastes better when you live nearby. Do you usually eat them with dinner?
Yes, I eat them after dinner.
That is a healthy habit for you. I do not know if red or green apples are sweeter for you, but I know red ones are often softer. Do you peel the skin first?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I love hot drinks but I am not sure which one I like best.
Tea is soft and sweet, while coffee is strong and dark. Do you like sweet things?
I like sweet things a lot.
Then tea might be a good choice for you. Do you add milk to it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am so tired from the long plane ride.
That is very normal. Do you feel hungry?
Yes, but I do not want to eat.
I suggest you drink some warm water first. Do you have any with you?
I do not have any drinks left.
Please ask the crew for more. I hope that helps you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to pack my bag for camp, but I forgot my toothbrush.
That is a big miss. Do you have it in your pocket?
No, I think I left it on the sink at home.
That is tricky. We better call your mom to check.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my party was quiet.
That is hard to hear. Did you have any friends there?
Only two of my cousins.
That is still good company. Do you want to talk about what you liked?
I liked the cake, but it was too sweet.
I like sweet things too. Thanks for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad. I do not know what to do today.
I am sorry you feel that way. What is making you unhappy?
My big task is too hard. I want to give up.
That sounds very scary. Do you want to break it into small parts?
Yes, that sounds good. Where should I start?
I do not know your specific task. What is the first small step you can do?
I will just clean my desk first.
That is a great start. Are you feeling a little better now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost and the bus is coming.
Do not worry. Which line do you need?
I need the red line to the park.
That bus comes every five minutes. Are you near the big tree?
Yes, I am under the tree.
Look for the red sign. It will stop here soon.
Oh, I hear it now.
You have a good eye. Have a nice ride.
The bus is here. Thank you.
You are welcome. See you later.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My grandma has a lot of gray hair.
That is lovely. Does she tell you many stories?
Yes, but I sometimes get sleepy.
Sleeping while listening is okay.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the old lighthouse today. The path was long and windy.
That sounds like a big walk. Did you see any birds?
Yes, I saw a gray bird land on the rock. It looked very tired.
Poor bird. Did you stay long to watch it?
I sat by the door and watched the waves. The light was not on yet.
It must have been getting dark. Did the keeper open the door?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have seven days in a week?
I am not certain of the exact reason. Do you like weekends?
Yes, because I can play more. Why is Monday first?
Many places start with Monday for work. Do you like going to school?
I guess so. Why is Sunday last?
It marks the end of the week. Is Sunday your favorite day?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I passed my driving test today.
That is great news! Did you feel nervous in the car?
Yes, my hands were shaking a lot, but then I felt calm.
Calm hands help you drive safe. What did you drive first?
I drove around the block with my teacher.
That sounds like a fun start.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the lighthouse so tall?
It helps the light reach far out to sea. Do you like boats?
Why does it flash?
It tells ships that land is near so they can steer safe. Is it dark where you are?
Why is it white?
I do not know for sure, but white shows up well. Do you have a favorite color?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am stuck on my math problem. Can you help me?
I would love to help. What is the problem?
It says to take five apples and eat two of them. How many are left?
You have three apples left. Do you like apples?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The dough is sticky. What do I do?
Add a little flour. Do you have any extra?
Yes, I have a lot of flour.
Sprinkle it on your hands. Is the dough warm?
It is warm and smells good.
That is a good sign. Let it rest for ten minutes.
I will wait for it.
Great. Do you like waiting?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel bad, my nose drips. I must leave now.
Drink hot tea and rest. Is it raining outside?
I cannot wait to feel better.
Tell the doctor your cough. Do you have a fever?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my new song feels wrong.
I am sorry it feels wrong to you. What part feels off?
The tune is just too loud and fast.
That can be very tiring. Do you like slow songs?
Yes, but I do not know how to make one slow.
I do not know how to teach you that. Do you have a teacher?
No, I am trying to learn all by myself.
That is brave work. I am here if you want to talk.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My boss took all the credit for my hard work today.
That sounds very unfair. Are you sure he did not mention you?
He looked me in the eye and ignored me.
I am sorry you felt that way. How did you react in the moment?
I stayed quiet because I am new here.
Staying quiet is a safe choice. Do you plan to speak up tomorrow?
I am scared of losing my job.
Fear is a normal feeling. Have you talked to your manager before?
No, I just want to be treated with respect.
That is a fair request. I do not know if he will listen, but you should try.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great skill. Do you have laces on your shoes?
Yes, I do. Can you tell me what to do first?
Make a loop with one lace. Does that part feel easy?
A little bit. What do I do after the loop?
Cross the other lace over it and pull tight. You will do well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My fence has a hole in it.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you know where the hole is?
It is near the red roses.
That sounds like a tricky spot. Are you big enough to dig there?
I am small but I have a shovel.
I do not know if you are strong enough yet. Would you like some help?
Yes, please hold the fence for me.
I will hold it tight so it does not move. Good job, little gardener.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My cat is very quiet today. She usually runs around.
That sounds odd. Does she still want to eat her food?
Yes, she ate two fish for breakfast.
Good, I am glad. Is her tail moving or does it stay still?
Her tail is still, but her eyes are bright.
Bright eyes are a good sign.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to send a letter to my friend in another city. Is the post office open today?
Yes, it is open until five o'clock. Do you have a stamp?
I do not know how much money I need for the stamp. Can you tell me?
A small letter costs fifty cents. Is your letter thick or thin?
It is a small, thin paper. Where do I buy the stamps?
You can buy them at the counter on the left. Are you ready to go?
Yes, I am ready. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a nice day!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say please?
It shows we care for others. Do you like it when people are rude?
And why do we wait our turn?
It is fair for everyone. Do you like playing by the rules?
Why do we use good words?
It makes people feel happy. I do not know all the reasons, but kindness helps.
Why do we listen?
It shows respect. Do you feel good when someone listens to you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a box I cannot open.
That sounds tricky. Do you have a key?
No, but I can hear it hum.
A hum is a clue. Is it warm?
Yes, it feels like a sun.
That is strange. Do you trust it?
I think it might be my friend.
If it is a friend, it will help. Does it sing?
It only sings at night.
Night songs are for sleep. Do you dream?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. My job was very hard today.
That sounds rough. Did you eat a snack?
No, I just want to sleep. My brain hurts.
Rest is good. Are you hungry now?
Yes, but I have no energy to cook. I am sad.
I can help you find easy food.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy some fruit. What is good to eat?
Apples are sweet and red. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I do. Where do I find the apples?
Look at the big red bins near the door. You will see them there.
That helps. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on my story. The dragon will not talk.
That is a tricky part. Do you know why the dragon is silent?
I do not know. I just want it to speak.
Try giving it a name first. Does it have a favorite food?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My clock stopped at two. I do not know how to fix it.
Did you try putting in new batteries?
No, I have none. Is that the only thing?
Yes, that is usually it. Is the room dark?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the fridge magnet stick?
It sticks because it pulls metal things close. Do you have a magnet at home?
It pulls the paperclip, but not the wood. Why?
Magnets only grab special metals like iron.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel good today, but I do not know what to do with my time.
That is a nice feeling. Do you like to play outside?
Maybe, but I am not sure if I want to run or just sit.
Sitting is good too. What do you like to look at?
I like to look at the trees, but I still feel stuck.
I do not know what is best for you. Do you feel tired or full of energy?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked past the big red house, but the street looked so wide I got lost.
That is a scary place to be. What do you usually see when you look for help?
I saw a dog sitting on the bench, so I asked it for directions.
That is a very quiet friend. Did the dog bark or just sit there?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big red apple. It smells sweet.
That sounds delicious. Do you like eating it with your hands?
Yes, I do. It is very crunchy.
I love crunchy food too. Is it sweet or sour?
It is sweet. I want to give you a bite.
Thank you, that is very kind. I would love a taste.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My favorite bird died today and I feel so sad.
I am very sorry to hear that. Do you want to tell me about it?
It was my friend from the shelter and I miss it.
That is a sad thing to lose. How long have you known each other?
Just three weeks but it felt like more.
Short times can feel very long when you care. You should get some water.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a flower grow from a seed?
You need to put the seed in dirt and give it water. Do you have a pot ready?
Yes, I have a small pot. What else do I need?
Just warm light and time. Is your house sunny?
It has a big window that gets sun all day.
That is perfect for most flowers. Water it a little every day.
Thank you, that sounds easy enough.
You will do a great job. I hope your plant gets tall.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am lost and I am very late.
Take a deep breath. What is the last thing you saw?
I saw a big blue door but it is gone now.
The blue door is near the park. Are you walking toward the park?
No I am facing the other way.
Turn around and walk straight for one minute. Do you see a red truck?
Yes I see a red truck right there.
Great. Turn left at the truck. Is your phone battery low?
It is dead and I still do not see the building.
I am not sure where the building is. Look for a sign that says Main Street.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I need to cook dinner right now.
Do you have any chicken?
Yes, I have some chicken. What should I do?
Put it in a pan. Do you like vegetables?
Yes, I like peas. How long does it take?
It takes ten minutes. Is that enough time?
Yes, that works. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Good luck with dinner.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is coffee so dark?
The beans get roasted hot. Do you like strong drinks?
I like it a little. Why is tea lighter?
Tea leaves stay green. Do you use milk?
Sometimes I do. Why do people drink them?
They feel warm inside. I do not know if it helps sleep.
Does it help you work?
Yes, it wakes me up. Do you work a lot?
Not much, just play. Why do you drink it?
I like the taste. It is a good choice.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water blue?
The water absorbs red light and lets blue light bounce back to our eyes. Do you like looking at the deep blue?
Why is the sea salty?
Rain washed salt from the land into the oceans over millions of years. Have you ever tasted the spray on your face?
Why do waves crash on the beach?
Wind pushes the water up, and gravity pulls it back down to make waves. I do not know the exact sound each wave makes.
Why is the ocean so big?
It covers most of our planet and holds a lot of water. Do you think there are big fish hiding down there?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a box and a ball. Which one rolls away?
The ball rolls. Why do you ask?
I want to put them in a shape sort. What is a square?
A square has four same sides. Do you have a ruler?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to read books at night, but I get too tired.
That is a good goal. Do you have a dim light?
Yes, I have a small lamp on my desk.
Great. Try turning the brightness down low.
How long should I read before I stop?
Aim for twenty minutes. Is your room warm?
It is a little cold.
Add a warm blanket. Then sleep will come easier.
What if I still cannot close my eyes?
Put the book away and breathe slowly. I hope that helps you rest.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I win a chess game?
You win by putting the king in check so it cannot move. Do you have a plan for your first few moves?
I just move the pawns forward.
That is a good start. It takes time to learn the rest. Do you play against friends?
I play against my dad.
That sounds like fun. He might show you some new tricks.
He always wins quickly.
Practice helps you get faster. Try to keep your pieces safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to put my seeds in the soil?
The soil gives the plant food and water. Do you like tasty carrots?
Yes, I love them. Why do the roots go down in the dirt?
They need to hold the plant up tight. What color is your soil?
It is dark and wet. Why do leaves turn green?
They use sunlight to make their own food. Is your spot sunny?
Yes, it is bright. Why does the plant get so tall?
It grows to reach more light. Do you check it every day?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so scared to ride the train.
It is just a big metal box that moves. Do you like loud sounds?
Yes, I like the chug chug sound a lot.
Then you will have fun watching the wheels go.
Okay, I feel better now.
Good, let us go to our seats. Is your snack in your bag?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost the last game and my hands are shaking. It feels so unfair.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you have a lot of fun before you lost?
Not really, I just wanted to win and take the blue chips.
That is a normal feeling. Do you want to play one more round?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I have tried so hard and still cannot solve it.
That feels hard. Do you know where you are stuck?
I do not know. The pieces just will not fit together.
Take a breath. Are there any loose edges?
Yes, I see the top left corner now.
Good start. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I put my boat in the water and I am not sure if it will sink or float.
A ship floats because it pushes a lot of water down. Do you think the water pushes back?
I do not really know how the water pushes back on the boat.
The water pushes up with a force called buoyancy. That is all I know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so late, the bus left before I could get on.
Oh no, that is very frustrating. How long did you wait?
I waited ten minutes, but I kept looking at my watch.
Ten minutes is a long time to stand in the rain. Did you see your friend waiting?
Yes, she was standing under the awning, shaking a bit.
I am glad you found her, even if it was chilly.
I was worried we would miss the start of the game.
I hope you arrived just in time for the first kick.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I tried to ride my bike but I fell down.
Ouch, that hurts. Did you try a trick before falling?
I tried, but I am scared now.
It is okay to be scared. You can stop for a bit.
What should I do to not be scared?
Just take a deep breath. Do you feel a little better?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and tried to sing a song for the birds. I felt happy but my voice was small.
That sounds like a sweet idea. Did the birds listen to you?
No, they flew away. I feel a bit sad about it.
Do not worry, I am sure you will get better with practice. Would you like a simple tip for your next try?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the internet feel like it never sleeps?
It runs all the time to keep us connected. Do you like reading online?
Yes, but why do pictures take so long to load sometimes?
The wires are busy carrying too much data at once. Do you use a phone or a computer?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My baby fell asleep on my chest while I held him.
That sounds like a quiet moment. How long did he sleep?
He woke up crying after ten minutes.
I am sorry about that. What do you do when he cries?
I rock him and hum a song until he stops.
That is a gentle way to help. Do you sing the same song each time?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the end of the story right now, please.
The hero saves the cat. Do you like cats?
Yes, but I am very late. Just tell me how it ends.
They all go home happy. Do you have time for tea?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look up! Is that a rainbow?
Yes, it is! Do you see all the colors?
I see red and blue. What is the other one?
There are many colors there. What color do you like best?
I like purple because it looks like a grape.
That is a fun thought! Does it look like a bridge?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do about the sailors.
That sounds hard. Do you like being near the sea?
I think they are lost at sea.
I do not know where they are. Can you see their boat?
I just want to help them.
You can try to tell a captain.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
They pull it up through roots and stems. Do you want to see one?
Yes, please. How do I do that?
Cut a stem and put it in colored water. Watch the color rise.
That is cool.
Yes, it is. Does your plant have leaves?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the phone get hot?
It works hard to make the screen light up. Does it feel warm to you?
Why does it have a camera?
It helps you take pictures of friends and fun things. Do you like to take photos?
Why does it ring?
It rings so you know someone wants to talk to you. Is that person your mom?
Why does it need charging?
It runs out of power like a toy car does. Do you have a charger nearby?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I finished my math sheet. It was so easy and I feel great. Did you like your day?
That is wonderful news. I am happy for you. Do you have time for a snack now?
Yes, I have cookies and I want to tell you more. I did all the problems with no help.
Well done. That takes great care. How many cookies do you have?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do flowers have colors?
They wear bright colors to catch your eye. Do you like pink or blue best?
Why do they smell so nice?
The scent tells bugs where to find the sweet food inside.
Why do they die in winter?
Cold air makes them sleep to save energy. Do you plant new seeds in spring?
Why do they need so much sun?
Sun is their main food to make energy. I do not know if they dream in the dark.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red rose on my walk today.
A red rose is very pretty. Did you pick it?
Yes, I held it for a long time.
It must have smelled nice. What color is your garden?
It has many yellow daisies.
Yellow daisies are bright and happy. Do you have bees there?
Yes, the bees love them.
Bees are good friends. I am glad you had a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go now. The snow is too deep.
That looks like a lot of white. Are you safe in your shoes?
I am running. Can you see my door?
Yes, I can see your little path.
It is so cold here. Do you have a coat?
I have a warm jacket on. Do you have one too?
I am wearing a big red coat. Look.
That is a very nice color. It looks very warm.
I must leave. The sun is going down.
Be careful on the ice. I hope you make it home soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took a picture of the park today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What did you see first?
I saw a big red ball rolling in the grass.
A red ball? Did you know whose it was?
No, I did not. I just took a quick shot.
That is a good habit to have. Do you have the photo with you now?
Yes, I checked it on my phone.
Is the picture clear and bright?
It looks great to me.
I am glad you enjoyed your day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to visit a small island.
That sounds like a lovely idea. Do you like sand or rocks?
I like the soft, warm sand.
Yes, soft sand is very nice. Do you swim in the sea?
I do not know how to swim.
That is okay. You can just sit and watch the waves. Is the water cold there?
I hope it is not too cold.
Many islands have warm water. You will likely enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a job. I start next week.
That is great. What will you do?
