I will help in a small shop. I am so happy.
Nice. Do you like it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see bees flying around. I want to know how they make sweet honey.
Bees drink sweet plant juice called nectar. Do you know where bees usually land?
I do not know. I am not sure where they go to get it.
They land on flowers to collect the nectar. Do you like to pick flowers?
I do, but I am confused about what happens inside the hive.
They carry the nectar home and drop it into a special cell.
That sounds hard work. What do they do with it after that?
They fan it with wings to dry it and make it thick and sweet. Is your favorite food sweet too?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The thunder is so loud. I am scared of the big flashes of light.
It is just the clouds making noise. Do you like it when it rains on your roof?
A little bit, but the flash is very bright.
We can close the heavy curtains to make it dark. Is your favorite toy safe under the bed?
Yes, my bear is in his house. Will the storm stop soon?
I do not know for sure. Can you feel the wind pushing on the window?
It is blowing hard. I want to go outside and look.
Please stay inside until it is quiet. Do you want to draw a picture of the rain?
I will draw a big purple cloud.
That sounds like a fun way to play.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I caught a tiny fish, but it got away.
Oh no! That must have been silly. Do you want to try again?
Yes, I want to catch a big one this time.
Good luck with that! Do you like to sit in the boat?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make a cat look happy?
I can help with that. What shape do you start with?
I think I start with a circle for the head.
That is a great start. Do you want it to smile or grin?
A small, gentle smile sounds nice.
That is true. You can add two small lines for the eyes.
That sounds easy enough.
Yes, keep it simple. Do you have a pencil ready?
I do, thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have fun with your art.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to eat better, but I do not know what to pick.
Try adding more fruit and vegetables to your plate. Do you like sweet or sour tastes?
I am trying to eat a lunch every day.
That is a great start. What is your favorite warm food?
I want to feel strong, but I get tired all the time.
Drink water and try to rest more. I do not know why you feel tired, but those steps help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Who built the wall in China?
That was a big job done over many years. Do you like walls?
No. Do you know when Rome fell?
Yes, it ended in the year 476. Do you read books?
I must run. Goodbye.
Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the barn this morning.
That sounds like a nice walk. Did you see the cows?
Yes, the cows were eating hay.
They must be hungry. What did you do next?
I checked on the chickens.
Chickens love sunny days. Were the eggs ready to collect?
I found three new eggs.
That is a great find. You must be proud.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a robot that can help me clean my room. Is that a good idea?
That is a very helpful idea. What kind of mess does it need to fix first?
Mostly socks. I am not sure if a robot can tell a sock from a shoe.
That is a hard trick to teach. Do you want it to sort clothes by color?
Yes, but I have no idea how to make its eyes see colors.
I do not know how to build it, but a camera could help. Do you have a camera at home?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot find my book and I feel very sad.
I am sorry you are upset. Do you know which shelf it was on?
I do not know. I just want to go home.
That is okay. Would you like to search the picture books first?
No, I want to leave right now.
We can go then. Thank you for visiting.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my left shoe in the park.
That is very sad. Did you look under the trees?
I tried, but it is gone. I want new ones.
A fresh pair will feel good. Do you like red or blue?
I love blue. My feet hurt so much today.
Blue will look great. Let us find a comfortable size for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
It is blue because of the light. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I love sun. Why do you ask?
I just like to chat. Do you play outside often?
Sometimes I do. Why do clouds look like cotton?
That is a tough one. I do not know for sure. Do you think they are soft?
I hope so. Why do stars only come out at night?
The sun is too bright for them. Do you count the stars?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to save money, but I do not know where to start.
Start by writing down every penny you spend each day. Do you use a notebook for this?
No, I usually forget to track it.
Try using the notes app on your phone. It is easy to check right away.
That sounds simple. What else can I do?
Put away 10 percent of your money before you spend it. Do you get paid weekly?
Yes, I get paid every week.
Great. Save a small amount each payday.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have so many toys and I do not know what to keep.
That can feel heavy to carry. Do you have a big box ready?
Yes, but I still do not know where to start.
You could sort them by color first. Is blue your favorite color?
No, red is my favorite.
Great, let us pick out all the red things. Do you want to start now?
I guess I should throw away the broken ones.
That sounds like a good plan. I am not sure which parts are broken.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: What are those white fluffs in the sky? I have to run.
They are clouds made of tiny water drops. Do you like looking up?
Not now. What makes them move?
The wind pushes them along. I do not know their exact speed.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to put buttons in jars.
That is a fun way to save them. Why do you keep them?
I want to make a coat for a bear.
A bear with buttons sounds cute. Do you have the fabric ready?
Not yet, but I have a blue cloth.
Blue is a nice color for a coat. What else is in the jar?
Just the round, shiny buttons.
Shiny buttons catch the light well. Do you want help counting them?
Yes, can you help me count?
I can help you count the buttons. Let us start with the small ones.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a nice box. I want to give it to my friend, but I am not sure if she will like it.
That is a sweet thought. Is the box empty, or does it have something inside?
It is empty, but I can put a small toy inside. Will she think it is weird?
It should be fine. Do you know what kind of toys she likes to play with?
She likes cars. I have a small red car. Does that sound good?
Yes, that sounds perfect for her. How big is the box?
It is small, just big enough for the car. Do you think she will open it?
I think she will be happy. You know her best, so trust your choice.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am very tired and do not know what to do for the wedding.
Take a deep breath. It will be okay. What is making you worry the most?
I do not know if my dress is right.
Do you like how it feels? It is only you who must be happy.
I guess I do like it.
Then wear it with a big smile. Do you have your flowers ready?
Yes, but I dropped them on the floor.
Oh no. Did they break?
No, they are fine, I just stepped on the stems.
That is great. Put them back in the vase.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Does this store sell hot chocolate?
Yes, we have it. Do you like it with marshmallows?
Is there milk left for it?
I think so. I will check for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do clouds look white?
Sunlight bounces off tiny water drops. Do you like watching them drift by?
Yes, they are very pretty. Are they heavy?
Yes, they are full of water. I do not know how heavy each one is.
Do they ever get too big?
Yes, when they grow big, it rains. Do you like rain?
I like it a little. How do they go away?
The sun warms them up. They turn into vapor.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not like sitting at the desk all day.
That feels boring, I know. Do you miss your friends?
I just want to play outside, but I cannot.
Playing outside is fun too. Do you draw pictures instead?
I drew a dog, but Mom said I have work to do.
That is a nice dog. Is the work hard?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a red bird on the tree today.
That sounds nice. What was it doing?
It was eating a small berry.
I am glad it had a snack. Did you say hello to it?
I tried, but it flew away fast.
Birds are often shy. Do you like birds?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Today I saw a red bird in the park.
That sounds fun. What did it do?
It flew into a tree and made a loud sound.
A loud sound. Did you look closely at its feathers?
They were bright red and very soft.
That is a nice detail. I am glad you enjoyed your walk.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am scared to use the gas pedal.
That is normal. Do you have a helper with you?
Yes, my dad is in the car.
Great. Just press it a little and stop often.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big boat in the water.
That is a fishing boat. Do you like big boats?
Yes, I do. Where do they go?
They go out to catch fish. Do you like fish?
I do not know. Is it yummy?
It can be very tasty. Do you want to eat some?
Maybe later. Can I touch the water?
Please do not touch the cold water. It is okay to just look.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to serve.
That is a big job. Do you have a ball?
Yes, I have a green one.
Hold the racket high. Kick the ball up.
Okay, I kicked it.
Now swing your arm down. Did you hit it?
I missed, but it is fun.
You will get it soon. Keep trying.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very tired. Did yesterday have coffee?
No, yesterday was just a day. Did you have a good sleep last night?
Yes. What day comes after Sunday?
Monday comes next. Is Monday your favorite day?
No, I like Friday. How many days are in a week?
There are seven days. Do you like all seven days?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to catch a big fish today.
That sounds like fun. Are you going to use a worm or a bug?
I am using a red worm.
Great choice. Did you make sure it is moving?
It is moving! I see a shadow under the boat.
Wow, that is exciting. Is it very big?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My bread is not getting big. What should I do?
Did you let it sit in a warm place? It needs heat to wake up.
I put it on a shelf near the window. Is that enough?
That sounds good. Are you using fresh yeast?
Yes, the packet was new. It smells funny though.
Fresh yeast can smell sharp. Is your water warm, not hot?
It was hot like tea. Did I kill the yeast?
Hot water can hurt yeast. Try again with lukewarm water next time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big white dress at the wedding. Why is it white?
White means clean and new. Do you like the look of it?
The man held a small book and read from it. Why did he do that?
He read words to promise he will love her. Did the people clap their hands?
I ate a piece of sweet cake at the end. Is it true that the cake is always tall?
Yes, they often build it high like a tower. Did you get a bite of the top?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Did you see the movie with the big red dinosaur?
I have seen it. It is very fun. Did you like the sad part?
Yes, but my mom said I can only watch two shows a day.
That is a good rule. Do you want to watch it again today?
I am not sure, because I want to play outside first.
That is a smart choice. Have fun on your walk.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I did not like the test. Why is it so hard?
It is hard because you are learning new things. Do you like the fun parts?
Yes, the stories were good. Why did I fail the math part?
I do not know your exact score. Did you check your answers twice?
I was in a rush. Why does a test have a time limit?
Time helps you think fast and stay ready. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How does a clock know what time it is?
It uses a small motor to spin the hands in a circle. Do you wonder why the hands move so smoothly?
I do not know how the tiny motor works inside.
It uses a steady beat from a crystal to keep the speed right. I hope that helps you understand the magic.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am on the bus but I do not know where to stop.
Do you have a map? Tell me your street name.
I lost my map and I am very worried.
Look for the button near the door. Can you find it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is very loud. I do not know what to do.
That can be scary. Do you hear anything else?
Just the trees moving fast. I feel small.
I do not know how to stop the wind. Are you warm?
Yes, but it is too much. I want it to stop.
Let us sit down together. Do you like my coat?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
The tree lets them go to save energy for winter. Do you like to rake them?
I am not sure what I should do with the pile.
You can make a comfy bed to jump in. I do not know if you have any friends to jump with.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the big red building a school?
Yes, that is the school where kids learn. Do you like school?
Maybe. What is the green place with the water?
That is a pond for ducks. Do you see any ducks there?
No, I do not. Is the tall building a home?
No, that is a tower for looking at the town. Do you want to climb it?
I might. What is the small blue house?
I am not sure what that one is for. It might be a shop.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to make a paper boat. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help. Do you have a square piece of paper ready?
I have some square paper on my desk. What is the first step?
Fold the square in half to make a rectangle, then fold it in half again to make a smaller square.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the light on?
Yes, it is bright and warm. Do you like the view from here?
I can stay for one second. Can I use the stairs?
Yes, the door is open. Is your bag very heavy?
Please tell me the way to the door now.
Go left, then straight ahead. I hope you have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a tiny island today and I am so happy.
That sounds wonderful! What does it look like?
It has soft white sand and warm water.
How lucky you are. Do you like the water?
The water is clear and feels nice on my skin.
That feels very peaceful. Is the beach busy?
No, it is just me and the quiet air.
Silence is a great gift. I am glad you are there.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My brother broke my toy today.
I am sorry to hear that. How are you feeling right now?
I feel very mad at him.
It is okay to feel mad. Did you talk to him about it?
No, I just yelled at him.
Yelling can make things worse. It is best to say what you need.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to save more money, but I spend too much on snacks.
That is a good start. Do you buy snacks because you are hungry or bored?
I usually buy them because I am bored.
Try to drink a glass of water first. Does that help you feel full?
Yes, it does help a lot.
Great. Do you have a small jar for coins?
No, I do not have a jar.
You can use an old tin can. Do you have one in the kitchen?
Yes, I have an old can for beans.
Perfect. Drop coins in every day. Do you want to set a weekly goal?
Yes, I want to save five dollars a week.
That is a smart plan. Do you know where the jar will live?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do mountains get so tall?
They go up over a very long time. Do you like to climb things?
Yes, I love climbing trees.
That is a great way to play. Do you know why some mountains have snow?
Because it is very cold up there.
That is true. The air gets colder when you go higher.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad about my run today.
That feels bad to have a tough day. Do you want to talk about it?
My legs hurt and I could not go fast.
Your body is asking for rest. Are you drinking enough water?
I guess I am not ready for the race.
It is okay to take it slow. Did you have fun at all?
I just want to quit.
You can still try again later. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I found a big red balloon.
That is wonderful. Did you tie it to a tree?
Yes, I did. Do you know why I feel this way?
I do not know for sure. Are you glad to be outside?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say please and thank you to someone?
Just say the words clearly with a smile. Do you know who you want to thank?
I want to thank my teacher for helping me read.
That is a very kind thing to do. Would you like to practice saying it out loud?
I think I can do it now. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I am glad I could help you today.
I will use good manners every day from now on.
That is a great goal to have. Do you feel ready to start?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: It is raining outside today. How do I make a boat out of paper?
That is a fun idea. Do you have a square piece of paper?
Yes, I have some white paper. What do I do first?
Fold the paper in half, then open it up.
I did that. Now what?
Fold the top two corners down to the middle line.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do players wear the same colors?
It helps everyone see their team. Do you like red jerseys?
I do. How big is the field?
It is a big, green rectangle. It is longer than a bus.
How many people play?
There are eleven people on each side. Do you count the keeper?
Yes, I do. Who wins the game?
The team with more goals wins. That is the only true rule.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late for my meeting. Please help me find the room.
Do you have the room number? Please show me the paper.
Yes, it is room 4B on the fourth floor.
I do not know the exact spot. Go left to the stairs, then take the lift to four. Is the door blue?
I do not see a door. I am still stuck in the hall.
Look up at the signs. The blue door is just past the plants. Run, you have time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to see my grandpa but I feel sick.
That sounds hard. Do you have a fever?
Yes, my head hurts.
Tell your parent. They can check you.
Will he be okay?
I do not know. Does he like reading stories?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The clock is making a loud noise. What do I do?
You should check if it needs a new battery. Is it running slow?
I do not know how to open the back.
Look for a small screw on the back panel. Do you have a small tool to help?
I found a screw, but it is stuck tight.
Hold the clock steady with one hand. Twist the tool very gently.
The back is open. I see many small parts.
It is hard to say what is wrong without seeing it. Can you point to the part that moves?
The little spring looks broken.
I do not know if you should fix that yourself. It is best to take it to a store.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
They drink sweet nectar from flowers. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I do. Then what?
They carry it in a special bag inside their body. Is that fun to think about?
It is. And where does it go?
It goes into their nest to dry up. Have you ever seen a beehive?
No, I have not. So it becomes honey?
Yes, it turns into thick, sweet honey. Isn't that amazing?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I have a runny nose?
Cold germs make your body try to wash them out. Do you have a fever?
Why is my throat so scratchy?
It gets dry and sore when the germs fight back. Are you drinking enough water?
Why do I feel so tired?
Your body spends much energy fighting the sick. Have you slept well?
Why does it hurt to breathe?
Swollen airways make it hard to pull in air. I do not know exactly why for you, but rest helps.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did you promise to help me?
I wanted to be a good friend. Do you trust me?
Yes, I do.
That makes me very happy.
Why is that a good thing?
It means we can work well together. Do you have a plan?
Not really.
Let us make one together.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is wonderful to hear.
I am going on a trip soon.
Oh, really? Where are you going?
I am going to the beach.
The beach sounds like fun.
I love the sand and the water.
You sound very excited.
I will play with my friends.
That sounds like a great time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is wonderful to hear.
Do you like farm animals?
I find cows very charming. Do you have a favorite animal?
I love the loud ducks.
They are quite vocal. Do you enjoy the sound?
Yes, it wakes me up with joy.
That is a great feeling.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do the trees have no leaves right now?
They sleep in winter to save energy. Do you like the quiet snow?
Yes, it is very calm. What wakes them up?
The sun gets warmer and the days get longer.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sick and my head hurts a lot.
That sounds bad. Is your head very warm?
Yes, it is very hot and I feel tired.
Please see a doctor soon. Do you have a fever?
I think so. I do not have any medicine.
Go to a doctor for checks. Do you have pain?
My head hurts a lot. It is very bad.
A doctor can help you. Are you afraid?
Yes, I am a bit scared.
Do not worry. They will help you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I climb a big hill?
You step up slowly and rest when you are tired. Do you like looking at the sky?
Yes, I do. How can I see the top from here?
You look up and follow the path. I do not know if you can see the peak right now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the small shop near my house. It smelled like warm bread.
That sounds very nice. Did you buy anything sweet?
I bought a small apple and a slice of cake. I was too full to eat it all.
A full stomach is a happy thing. You have a good day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a bug with six legs. Is that a spider?
No, spiders have eight legs. Do you know what the bug looked like?
It was black and round.
It sounds like a beetle. Beets are hard and shiny.
It can fly too.
Many beetles can fly. Do you like watching them?
Yes, I do.
That is great. Nature is full of surprises.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want food but I do not know where to start.
Try the front row first. Do you like sweet or salty?
I think I like sweet. But the line is very long.
That sounds fun to wait. The apple stand is quick.
Okay, I will go there now. I feel better.
That is a good choice. I hope it tastes nice.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does music make me feel happy?
It is like a warm hug for your mind. Do you like singing?
Yes, I do. Why can music change how we feel?
I am not sure why it works that magic way. Do you play any instruments?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start the test.
Do not worry. Do you know the first rule?
I think the paper is too long.
That is a good thought. Take your time.
I still feel lost.
Just read the first line. What does it say?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I need new shoes for school.
How big is your foot?
I do not know my size.
You can try on a few pairs. Do you like red or blue?
I like red.
Red is a nice color. Do you have enough money for them?
I have ten dollars.
Ten dollars is not enough for school shoes. Do you have a card?
No, I only have cash.
We will look for cheaper boots.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to tie my shoes. Can you help?
I can help with that. Do you have a pair of shoes?
Yes, I do. How do I start?
Make a big loop with each lace. Would you like to try?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very happy right now.
That is wonderful to hear. What makes you feel this way?
I built a big block tower.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Does it still stand up?
Yes, it is very tall.
You did a great job building it. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The big clock on the wall made a loud tick all morning.
Ticking clocks help us know the time. Did it feel fast or slow to you?
It felt slow when I was doing work.
Time can feel long when we are busy. Did you take a break to rest?
Yes, I took a rest and watched the hands move.
Watching the hands move is a nice way to relax. Do you like the sound of the ticks?
It is a steady sound that helps me think.
Steady sounds can help people focus. What did you do after your break?
I finished my task and the clock said it was five o'clock.
That is a good time to stop working. Do you have plans for the evening?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for class!
Do not worry, I know where the door is.
Is it near the big red bus?
Yes, it is right there.
Thank you, I must go.
You are welcome, see you soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting on the plane for so long. How can I make them feel better?
Try to stand up and walk down the aisle. Do you have a small bottle of water?
I have some water. What else should I do?
Stretch your arms up high to help your blood move. Is the movie on the screen interesting to you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I need to send a letter to my cousin.
You can put it in the blue box. Is your letter ready to go?
Yes, I have the stamp right here.
Good. You just drop it in. Do you need a box for a bigger package?
No, just this small paper letter.
That is all you need. Go ahead.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now, but the floor is dirty.
Can you just sweep the kitchen first? Do you have a broom?
No time to sweep. I will just leave it.
That is okay, but try next time. Are you in a big rush?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got my first job!
That is very exciting. What did you do?
I cleaned the floor.
You worked hard. Did you like it?
Yes, I did.
I am so happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. I must go now.
Please sit down for a moment. Is it a bad pain?
No time. I am late for work.
Drink some water first. Do you eat enough?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I planted my seeds, but they will not grow. I feel sad.
I am sorry your seeds are slow. What color were the flowers?
They were red roses. I think they are dead inside.
That is a scary thought. Did you check if the soil is wet?
The dirt is dry and cracked. I must have forgotten to water them.
The dry dirt likely caused the problem. Water them well today.
I will get the hose now. Thank you for helping me think.
You have a kind heart. Will you check on them again tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my boss was not nice today.
That is hard. What did he do?
He said my work was bad, but it was good.
That feels unfair. Do you feel angry?
Yes, I am mad. I want to go home now.
Going home is okay. Did you finish your tasks?
Yes, I did finish everything.
Good job. You did well.
I hope he is nicer tomorrow.
I hope so too.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the big ship stay up on the water?
The water pushes back up against the heavy bottom of the ship. Do you like to sit on a boat?
Yes, but why does it not sink to the bottom?
The ship is shaped to hold a lot of air, which makes it feel light. Can you hold your breath for a long time?
I can hold it, but what happens if I jump in?
You will push water out of the way, and the ship will rise a little bit. Do you jump in the pool?
Yes, I do. But what if the ship is full of people?
It gets a bit heavier, so it sinks deeper into the water to stay balanced. Have you ever seen a boat get lower in the water?
I have. Does the water push up harder?
Yes, the water pushes up just enough to hold the whole ship. Do you think that is cool?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn a new language but I feel scared.
It is good to start small. Do you like to sing songs?
Yes, I love music. It makes me happy.
That is a great place to begin. Try one song a day.
That sounds easy. I will do it.
I am glad you are ready. Keep going.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want a drink but I do not know which one to pick.
Coffee gives you a big jump of energy. What is the weather like outside?
It is raining and cold. I need to feel warm inside.
Tea is very good for staying warm. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I love sugar and a bit of milk.
Then a sweet milky tea is a perfect choice.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love apples, but I do not know how to cut them safely. Can you help me?
Yes, place the apple on a flat board and hold it firmly with one hand. Do you have a sharp knife?
I just peeled one for a snack, but the skin is very hard. What is the best way to get the skin off?
A peeler works best because it removes the skin in long, even strips. Did you try using the peeler?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have many songs but I do not know which one to play.
That is a hard choice. Do you like loud or soft songs?
I like loud ones, but I am tired.
You can rest for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know why the hands on this clock are not moving.
The battery is likely dead. Do you see a small battery inside it?
I cannot find the battery cover, so I am stuck.
Look for a tiny slot near the top of the back. Are you holding it face up?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I can't believe I did it. I feel so good.
That is wonderful news. What did you do?
I ran a race and won. I had to go fast.
Wow, that is very hard work. Do you like running?
Not always, but this felt great. Please help.
Of course, I will help. What do you need?
I have to leave now. Thanks for listening.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to wake up so early for school?
Because our brains work best when we rest. Do you like your morning milk?
Why does the teacher make us read every day?
Reading helps you learn new words and think big. What book do you like best?
Why is math so hard sometimes?
It can be tricky, but it gets easier with practice. I do not know how you feel, but I am here.
Why do we sit in rows at school?
Sitting in rows keeps the room safe and tidy. Do you sit near the window?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad for the sailors on that stormy boat.
That is a very sad thought. Do they have warm blankets?
I hope they do, but I do not know for sure.
I do not know either. Do you like to read sea stories?
Yes, but I do not like the scary parts about the waves.
It is okay to feel scared of big waves. Do you want to talk about something happy?
Yes, I think I will think about sunny beaches instead.
That sounds like a nice change.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke your cup. I feel bad.
That is a kind thing to say. Did you drop it by mistake?
Yes, my hand slipped. I am sorry.
It is okay. Do you know how we can fix it?
I do not know. Can you help?
We can glue it. Tell me if it still hurts your heart.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a loaf of bread and I am very happy to share it.
That is a wonderful thing to do. Did you use any special spices?
No, just flour, water, and yeast.
Simple is often the best. Do you have any extra for me?
Yes, I have plenty of warm slices for you.
Thank you, that sounds very tasty.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very happy today.
That is great news. What made you smile?
I found a big, blue butterfly in the garden.
A big blue butterfly is lovely.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a movie in my room. How do I do that?
You can use your phone or a camera. Do you have a camera?
Yes, I have a phone. What should I film?
Film things you like, like your toys or a sunset. What is your favorite thing to look at?
I like dogs. Can I film my dog?
Yes, film your dog running and playing. Take a photo of the best part.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My dog is hiding under the bed and will not come out. I feel very sad.
That is hard. I do not know why he is hiding, but maybe he is tired. Is he eating his food?
He ate his breakfast, but now he just lies there. I do not want him to be sick.
That is good that he ate. I do not know if he is sick, but he may just want rest. Do you want to try his favorite toy?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the big boats in the water today!
They look so smooth. Do you like the color of the sky?
Yes, the blue is so bright and clean.
The air feels fresh too. Do you smell the salt?
I do! It smells like the deep sea.
That is a good sign of a nice day.
I feel so calm just standing here.
Your face looks very relaxed.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I work from home. My back hurts.
That sounds hard. Do you have a big chair?
No. I sit on a small box.
A box is not good for your back. Is it too hard?
Yes. It is very hard.
You need a real chair. Do you have money for one?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: That movie was so sad. I cried a lot.
I am sorry you felt that way. Did you like the music?
The music was nice, but the end was too bad.
Sometimes sad ends can be good. Do you want to watch something happy next?
Yes, please. I need to feel better.
That is a good idea. You will feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My words all mix up in my head.
That feels very bad. Do you want to try one word together?
I do not know. I feel like a fool.
You are not a fool. I do not know your name, but I know you can do this.
Is it really that hard to learn?
It is hard, but it gets easier. What is your favorite color?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the old mill today.
Did you see the water moving?
Yes, it was very calm and quiet.
That sounds like a nice rest.
Then I sat on the big stone wall.
Was the sun warm on your face?
It felt good until the wind blew.
The wind can be a cold friend.
I went home to drink some tea.
Does the tea taste hot and sweet?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I think my neighbor is being very loud today.
That can be tough to hear. What sounds are you hearing?
It sounds like they are moving heavy boxes.
That usually means they are moving things around. Do you know why they are moving?
I do not know why they are moving.
I do not know that either, but it is just boxes. Are you feeling annoyed by the noise?
Yes, I want to play quiet games inside.
That is a good idea for a loud day. Would you like to listen to a story instead?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am mad at my teacher.
Why are you mad? Did something bad happen?
He did not let me use my crayons.
That sounds very unfair. I am sorry.
He said we need to share them.
I understand why that feels hard. Do you have other colors?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My boss gave me a special task. I feel scared to do it well.
That is a brave step. Are you happy they trust you?
I think I am, but I need a simple rule to start.
Just ask one small question first. How does your day usually begin?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people work from home?
They save time by not driving to an office. Do you like going for car rides?
Not really, it takes too long. Why is it easier?
You can rest a bit more and wear comfy clothes. Do you have a favorite seat?
My chair by the window is best. Is it good for your eyes?
Looking at the sky helps your eyes rest. Do you see trees outside?
Yes, lots of green leaves. Why do people like that?
Nature makes them feel calm and happy. Do you feel calm there?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not like eating my green vegetables.
Vegetables help your body grow strong. What is your favorite fruit?
I like apples because they are sweet.
Apples are a great snack. Do you eat them for breakfast?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sand so warm on the beach?
The sun heats up the sand all day. Do you like playing in the sand?
Yes, I do. How do fish know where to swim?
They feel the water around them. Do you like watching the fish?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to paint this fence white, but it is wet.
You must wait for it to dry. Is it sunny outside?
Yes, but I have a big job later.
Damp wood does not take paint well. Do you have time to wait?
I cannot wait. It will take all day.
That is why you must wait. It will look good.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The bus stopped for a long time on the hill.
That is a tricky place for buses. Did you wait long?
I watched the rain fall on the windows.
Rain on glass is nice to see. Do you like the sound of it?
I felt very small inside the big bus.
Buses can feel huge when you are sitting down. Was it quiet in there?
My friend shared her warm cookie with me.
That is a sweet thing to do. Did the cookie taste good?
Then we got to the end of the line.
I am glad you made it home safe. How are you feeling now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the store and saw a red cat.
That is a nice picture. Was the cat loud?
Yes, it meowed very loud at a bird.
I did not hear that. Do you like loud sounds?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find a map of my city right now.
A web browser will help you. Do you have a phone?
Yes, but I am very late for work.
Type the street name into the search box. Is it a big city?
It is small, but I need the bus stop.
I do not know the exact bus stop. Try looking for the route number.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I moved here and do not know anyone.
That is hard. Are you good at playing games?
I think I like to draw, but I feel left out.
Drawing is nice. Do you want to try joining a class?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The lights went out. I am scared.
It is just a small power cut. Do you have a candle?
Yes, I found one. Will the power come back?
I do not know. Is your phone still working?
No, the battery is dead. I feel cold.
Please stay warm with a blanket. It will be fine soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the shop closed?
The door is locked. Do you want to wait?
Why is it locked?
I do not know for sure. Is it a holiday?
Why do you not know?
I was not told. Let us try the side door.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does Grandpa wear glasses?
He is old and his eyes are not so sharp anymore. Does he like reading with them?
Yes, he loves stories. Why does his voice sound so soft?
His voice gets quiet because he is tired. Is he resting right now?
He is sleeping. Why does he smell like coffee?
He probably just made a cup before bed. Do you like the smell too?
Yes, it is sweet. Why is he so important to me?
I do not know the reason, but love makes family feel close.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the light turn on when I press this?
The press sends a tiny push to the wires. Do you know where the wires go?
They go in the wall, I think.
That is right. The power travels through them to your lamp.
What is power?
It is like a very strong wind that pushes things along. Can you feel the air move?
I can feel the wind outside.
Yes, the power works the same way. It is safe if you stay away from plugs.
Okay, I will be careful.
That is a very good plan. Are you ready to play now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to grow a carrot in my garden. How do I start?
First, dig a small hole in the soft dirt. Do you like eating carrots?
Yes, they are sweet. What do I do next?
Put the seed in the hole and cover it with dirt. Then, give it water every day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big tomato plant! I am so happy to see the green fruits.
That is wonderful news. Do you water it every day?
Yes, I give it water every morning. The leaves are very green and strong.
Good care makes for happy plants. Do you see any small flowers yet?
I do see a few little yellow stars on the branches. I hope they turn into red tomatoes.
Flowers often become fruits. Do you have a favorite kind of tomato?
I like the big red ones best. They are sweet and juicy when they are ripe.
That sounds very tasty. Enjoy your garden.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have so many dirty shirts in this basket.
That is a big pile. Do you know what color this one is?
It is red, but it has a spot on it.
A red shirt with a spot. Have you tried to rub the spot with soap?
I rubbed it, but the spot is still there.
Soap can help, but sometimes it needs more time. Do you like to wait for things?
I do not like waiting. I want it clean now.
I know waiting is hard. We must be patient with the soap.
Okay, I will wait. What do I do next?
Now you put it in the washing machine. Do you know where the machine is?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. The bus was very loud and the seat was hard.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you look out the window?
Yes, but the rain made it hard to see. I just wanted to go home fast.
Rain can make rides feel long. Do you have a warm coat on?
Yes, it is warm. But my shoes are wet now.
That is a big problem. Do you have dry socks at home?
I hope so. This is a bad day.
I hope you find some dry socks soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel sad because my friend got a new toy and I did not.
That is a hard feeling to have. Do you want to share your old toys with him?
I am not sure if he would want to play with my old toys.
It is brave to try asking. What is your favorite toy to play with?
My favorite toy is my little red car.
A red car sounds like fun to drive around. Would you like to race it with your friend?
I think I will just draw a picture for him instead.
Drawing a picture is a sweet way to show kindness. What color will the sky be in your drawing?
The sky will be blue with big fluffy clouds.
That sounds like a very happy sky. You are being very kind to your friend today.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That is good to hear. What made you smile?
The sun is bright outside.
Bright suns help people feel warm. Do you like hot days?
Yes, I love the warmth.
Warmth feels nice on the skin.
I want to share this feeling with you.
I am glad you told me. Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to paint a blue sky, but it looks flat. What should I do?
Try mixing a little white into your blue. Do you have white paint?
Yes, I do. How do I mix it so it looks nice?
Add a tiny bit of white at a time. Which color do you like best?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My eyes feel so heavy, but I really want to finish this book.
It is time to rest. Do you want to drink some warm milk?
I do, but my mom is asleep and I am scared of the dark.
The dark is just the night sleeping. Do you want a soft glow light?
Yes, please. I will try to sleep now.
Good night. I am here if you need me.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are there so many cars?
People need to go to work and school. Do you like riding in a car?
Why are the buildings so tall?
They are tall to fit many homes and shops. Do you like tall places?
Why are the people walking fast?
They are in a hurry to catch the bus. Do you like running?
Why is it so loud here?
The horns and voices make a lot of sound. Do you like the sound?
Why is the air so thick?
I do not know for sure. Do you feel hot?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The rainbow is gone.
That feels bad. Do you miss its bright colors?
Yes. I wanted to see it all day.
It moves fast. Was it very big for you?
It was wide and red.
I do not know where it went. Did you see any clouds?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind blew hard today and I felt very cold.
That sounds chilly. Did you wear your coat?
Yes, I wore my big red coat, but I still shivered.
A big coat helps keep you warm. I am glad you are safe.
Then the sun came out and the snow began to melt.
Ah, that means winter is ending soon. Do you like the sun?
I do, because it makes me feel happy and dry.
Happy and dry is a good feeling. Enjoy the warm day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure how to start the test.
Take a deep breath first. Is there one question that looks easy?
I think I do not know the answers.
It is okay to not know. What is the first word you see?
I just want to finish it fast.
Slow down to think clearly. Do you have a pencil ready?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake cookies with my grandma. How do we start?
You mix flour and butter first. What flavor do you like?
I love chocolate. Is that hard to do?
It is easy. Just add the chips to the mix.
How long do they stay in the heat?
About ten minutes. Do you have a timer?
Yes, I have one. What should I do next?
Take them out when they are brown. Tell me if they look good!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do they use a specific type of ball for tennis?
Tennis balls are made to bounce high and fly far so the game stays fast. Do you like to play outside?
I usually just kick it around.
Kicking is fun, but tennis makes you run and think fast too. Do you have a racket at home?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am so hungry, but I do not know what to eat.
That is a good question. Do you like hot food?
Yes, I like hot food. What is good?
Soup is warm and nice. Do you have time to make it?
No, I do not have time. I must go to a meeting.
Then buy it from the shop. It is fast.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy. I want to say sorry.
That is a good start. Do you know what broke it?
I was playing too hard. I dropped it on the floor.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you want to help fix it?
I do. I have some tape. How do I say it?
Just say, "I am sorry I broke it." Do you feel brave enough?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say please?
It shows we care for others. Do you like it when people are nice to you?
And why do we wait for our turn?
It makes everyone feel fair. Do you know how to share a toy?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in the fog and my boat is stuck. What do I do?
Do not worry, you are safe. Is there a sound on the water?
I hear a loud horn but I am too scared to move.
That is the coast guard coming to help. Do you know how to signal them?
I do not know how to signal, so I just sit still.
Sit still and wave your arm high. They are very close now.
I am so happy they are here to save me.
You did the right thing by staying calm. Are you ready to step out?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big moon in the sky tonight. What month is this?
I do not know the date for sure. Is the moon very bright?
Yes, it is very bright. I think it is October.
That is a good guess. Do you like the leaves falling?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go fast. My bike feels slow.
Are you pedaling hard? Try to keep your balance.
I am pedaling very hard. It still feels like a turtle.
Is your tire full of air? Sometimes a soft tire makes you slow.
The tire is full. I must go now.
You can do it. Ride safely.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My fish looks sick. It is moving very slow. I need to go now.
That is not good. Is the water warm or cold?
It is warm. I added salt. What do I do?
Salt can hurt them. Do not add more salt. Please change some water soon.
Okay. It is eating well. Thanks. I must run.
I am glad it eats. Get well soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I fell down by the coffee shop this morning.
Oh no, are you hurt? Did you get your tea?
No, I just missed my bus.
That is a long day. Do you like the smell of the coffee?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired of looking at this screen all day.
That sounds very hard. Do you take long breaks outside?
Not much. The house feels too small and quiet.
I am sorry you feel that way.
I just want to go back to a real office with people.
I do not know if that is easy for you to do. Do you miss your friends?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The bus was so late. I missed my stop.
That is very bad luck. Did you try to run?
I ran all the way there. My legs hurt.
Running is hard work. Do you have a sore foot?
Yes, my toes hurt a lot. I am tired.
You should rest now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, a blue bird is eating seeds in my bush!
That is very pretty. Do you know what kind of bird it is?
I do not know, but I am so happy to see it.
I am glad you are happy. Maybe it will visit again tomorrow.
I hope it comes back to eat more.
Nature is often like that. Why are you watching it so closely?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to walk, but I do not know where to start.
Start with a short walk in a park. Do you have a park near you?
I have one, but I feel too tired.
Walking helps you feel less tired, not more.
I will try ten minutes tomorrow.
That is a good plan. Would you like to tell me how it goes?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very hungry, but I do not know what to eat.
Would you like something hot or cold?
I think I want something warm and soft.
A bowl of soup sounds good. Do you like tomatoes?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just won my game! It was so much fun.
That is great news! Which team did you beat?
We beat the red team with a goal at the last second.
Wow, that sounds very exciting.
The crowd cheered very loud for us.
Happy people are great to see. Do you love playing?
Yes, I love running on the green field.
It sounds like a happy place.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I wash my dirty shirts?
You put them in the machine with soap. Do you have a red shirt?
Yes, I do. What size of soap do I use?
Use one scoop for a full load. I do not know if your shirt needs more.
Okay. Do I need to dry them right now?
You can leave them in for a bit. Do you like to fold them?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My brother has a new dog.
That is very nice. Is the dog small?
Yes, it is a tiny puppy.
Puppies like to play. Do you play with them?
I play with the dog, not the puppies.
I am sorry, I am not sure. What game do you play?
We chase each other in the yard.
That sounds like fun. Do you take turns?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very tired today. Why is that?
Your body needs rest to fix itself. Do you sleep well?
Not always. Is that why I feel so heavy?
Yes, missing sleep makes you feel heavy. Have you eaten food?
I skipped breakfast. Is that a big problem?
Yes, your body needs fuel to move. Drink some water now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The big printer jammed again today. It made a loud noise.
That sounds very noisy. Did you get it to work?
I hit it with a shoe. It started printing.
I do not know if that is a good fix. Was the paper okay?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must run. What season is this?
It is autumn, because the leaves are changing color. Are you going outside?
Yes, it is very windy today. How do you know?
I feel the wind on my face. Do you like the wind?
I do not have time to think. I must go now.
That is okay. Go safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The leaves are falling and I do not know what to do.
That is autumn. Are you feeling cold?
I feel happy but also a bit lost.
Fall is a time to rest and eat warm food.
Do I need to make a big plan for next?
Not yet. Just enjoy the crisp air.
I think I will go outside now.
That sounds like a good choice.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you know a good book about dragons?
Yes, I think a story with a brave knight is nice. Do you like happy endings?
Yes, I do. What should the dragon be like?
It can be big and a bit grumpy, but not mean. Is it in a castle?
No, it lives in a forest. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome. I hope you find a great book. Do you read at night?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have an ace and a king. Do I play them?
That is a strong hand. Do you want to bet high?
I am scared I will lose my chips.
You can just play them safe. Do you have any other cards?
No, that is all I have.
Then play the ace and the king.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now, it is snowing so hard.
Stay warm. Do you have a coat?
Yes, but I am cold. Will it stop soon?
I do not know. Are you wearing boots?
Yes, I am ready. I must run.
Be careful on the ice. Is the road clear?
It looks white and thick. I go now.
Good luck. Do you like the snow?
Not really, I have work. Bye.
I hope you get there safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am lost. I feel very sad.
Do not cry. I am here to help. Where did you last see your mom?
At the big blue door. But now I see only trees.
That door is by the park. Let us walk toward the trees. Are your feet hurting?
No, my feet are fine. I just want to go home.
We will get you there soon. I see a road ahead. Does that look like your street?
Yes! I see my house! Thank you, friend.
You are welcome. I am happy you are safe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because my house is clean today.
That is great to hear! What made you feel so good?
I found my favorite blue hat under the bed.
That is a lucky find. Do you want to wear it now?
Yes, I do, and I washed all the dishes too.
You did a wonderful job. Would you like some help with the floors?
No, I am all done, but I will drink some water.
That is a very good idea.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look up at the sky and I do not know what to do.
That is okay. Do you like how the clouds move?
They look like soft white sheep, but I still feel stuck.
Maybe you can just sit down and watch them float by.
I am not sure if I am allowed to just stop and think.
Yes, you are allowed to think. Do you feel tired or sad?
I think I am just bored and looking for a new game.
Let us play a guessing game with the shapes. Which one looks like a dog to you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I made a robot, but it does not move. What should I do?
Did you check the wires? It is often a loose part.
The wires look good. Maybe it needs new hands?
I do not know about hands. Does it make any sound?
No sound. It is just sitting there. I do not know what is wrong.
That sounds tricky. Maybe try the power button again?
I tried that. It is still still. I want to stop.
Do not give up yet. Ask a friend to help you look.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to pack my bag for a trip. How do I start?
Put your heaviest things at the very bottom first. Do you have a list of things to bring?
Yes, I do. What goes on top of the heavy items?
Place your softer clothes on top to protect them. Are you going to a warm place?
It is sunny there. How do I stop the bag from looking messy?
Roll your clothes to save space and keep it neat. Do you like rolling or folding?
I like rolling. Is there anything else I should check?
Check your pockets for keys and phones before you close the zipper. Do you have all your tickets ready?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the store today instead of taking the car.
That is a smart way to save coins. Did you feel happy walking?
Yes, but I bought a sweet candy on the way home.
Candy is fun, but it costs extra money. Do you know how much it was?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My chair leg is wobbly and I am lost.
You can tighten the screws first. Is it made of wood?
Yes, it is wood, but the screw keeps falling out.
That happens when the hole gets too big. Should I try glue?
I do not have any glue at home right now.
You can use a piece of cardboard to fill the hole. Do you have a pencil?
Yes, I have a pencil and some tape.
Tape the cardboard to the leg and tighten it. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to leave now. What is that bird in the tree?
It is a robin with a red chest. Do you like it?
No time. I need to go inside.
Be safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I did not like my first day. I felt so small and scared.
It is normal to feel that way. Do you know what made it hard?
I broke a cup and my boss looked at me. I am so sad.
One small mistake does not mean you are bad at the job. Did you clean it up?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do clouds look like soft cotton balls?
They are made of tiny water drops that stick together. Do you think they would be heavy if we picked one up?
No, I think they would fall down.
Good guess, but the air pushes them up so they float.
What are they made of exactly?
It is mostly water, just like rain. Do you like the smell of rain?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My friend said he would come, but he is not here.
That is sad to hear. Did you send him a note?
Yes, but he did not write back. I feel lonely.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have other friends there?
Not really. The music is loud and I just want to go home.
Let us find a quiet spot to sit. Do you want some water?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat at my desk all morning and did not eat anything.
That sounds tiring. Did you skip breakfast too?
Yes, I was busy with papers and forgot to eat.
Ouch, that is a harsh start to the day.
My stomach grumbled loud enough to wake the office.
Well, it is time to fix that. Are you going to get food now?
Finally, I am grabbing a sandwich.
Good plan. Enjoy your meal.
Thank you, I feel better just talking.
I am happy to help. Eat well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do robots have feelings like I do?
I do not know for sure, but I do not think they feel happy or sad like you do. Do you like to hug your robot toys?
Yes, I hug my bear. Can robots eat cookies?
No, robots do not eat food. They need electricity to work. Do you like eating cookies?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to learn to sing. Where should I start?
Start by humming a tune you like. Do you have a favorite song?
Yes, but my voice feels small and weak.
That is okay. Your voice will get stronger with practice. Do you practice every day?
Not yet. Is it hard to make my voice loud?
It is not hard. Just breathe deep and stay relaxed.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Who built the big stone walls in China?
Many people built them over a long time. Did you know they are very old?
How long ago did they start?
It started thousands of years ago. What part of history do you like?
I like how people built them by hand.
That is a great choice. It took many workers. Do you like to build things?
Yes, I build castles with blocks.
That is fun and creative. Do you like to draw pictures of them?
Yes, I draw them every day.
That is a lovely habit. Drawing helps you remember.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My tummy hurts a lot.
That feels bad. Do you want some water?
No, I want a medicine.
A doctor can check if you need it.
Is the doctor scary?
No, she is very kind. Do you have a favorite stuffed toy?
Yes, my bear.
You can bring him to feel better.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I got a good grade on my test.
That is great news! What subject was the test?
It was math, and I love it now.
Math can be fun. Do you like adding or multiplying?
I like adding because the numbers get big.
I do not know why big numbers are fun. What do you do with them?
I build towers with blocks and count them.
That sounds like a great game. Do your friends help you build?
Yes, we build a very tall tower together.
Team work is strong. Does the tower ever fall down?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hurry, is that a horse over there?
Yes, that is a horse. Is it yours?
No, just the little pony.
It looks very small. Do you know its name?
I do not, I am late.
Oh, run then. Be safe!
Thanks, good day.
Good luck to you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat in the car today and felt very scared.
That is a big day for you. Did you get to drive a little?
Yes, I turned the wheel and went around the corner.
That is great. Did the car move smoothly?
It bumped a little, but I did not hit anything.
Good job staying calm. How did you feel after that?
I felt happy and a bit proud of myself.
Well done. Do you want to practice again soon?
Yes, I want to do it next week.
That sounds like a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The tent fell down in the rain.
I am sorry that is so hard. Did you get wet?
Yes, my feet are cold and my book is ruined.
We can use the campfire to dry you off.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie a bowline knot.
That is a very useful knot. Do you have a rope ready?
Yes, I have a thick rope right here.
Hold the rope in your left hand and make a loop.
I made a loop, but I am stuck.
Take the end and pass it up through the loop. Have you seen a rabbit jumping out of a hole?
Yes, I passed it through the hole.
Now wrap the end around the standing part of the rope.
I wrapped it, but what do I do next?
Pass the end back down through the loop again. Do you feel the knot getting tight?
Yes, it feels tight and secure.
Great job. Now pull both ends to finish it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look up! The moon is so bright tonight.
It does look very bright. Do you like how big it looks?
Yes! I feel very happy just looking at it.
That is a nice feeling.
It makes me want to tell everyone about it.
People often share what they love. Why is it special to you?
It just feels like a friend in the sky.
That is a sweet thought.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very lonely today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk about it?
Why does this feeling come?
It often comes when we miss our friends. Have you seen someone today?
I do not really know.
That is okay. Not knowing is normal. What makes you feel safe?
My room feels safe.
Good. Staying safe is a start. What do you like to do there?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to take a picture of the dog right now, but my phone is not working.
Did you check if the battery is full?
I think so, but I cannot find the button to start the camera.
Tap the little circle on the screen. Is it red or green?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to make an apple pie.
That sounds like a fun job. What kind of apples do you have?
I have red apples.
Red apples are good for pie. Do you have any sugar?
Yes, I have a big bag of sugar.
Great. I do not know your exact recipe, but sugar helps it taste sweet. How much flour do you have?
I have two cups of flour.
Two cups is a good start. Can you cut the apples into small pieces?
I can try to cut them.
Be careful with the knife. Tell me if you need more help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a lot of work to do, but I do not know where to start.
That can feel hard. What is the first thing on your list?
I think I should just do it all at once.
That may be too much for one time. Would you like to try just one small part first?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
There are no cars here. Do you like the calm?
I guess so. Is it safe to play here?
Yes, the air is very still.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is great news! What made you feel this way?
My teacher gave me a big smile.
A smile feels warm and nice. Did she say anything else?
Yes, she said my drawing was very good.
Teachers love when we share our work.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I caught a bug today!
Oh no. Are you warm?
Yes, but I feel happy to tell you.
That is sweet. Do you have soup?
Yes, my mom made some.
Good. How is your nose?
It runs a lot.
A tissue can help. Is it bad?
Not really, just funny.
I am glad you are okay.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sun feels too hot today. What should I do?
You can rest in the shade. Do you have a cool drink nearby?
I just looked in the tree. It is still very bright outside.
The bright light means the sun is high up. Would you like to play inside instead?
I could play a game, but I want to see the sky.
You can peek out for a quick look. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the little pawns only move forward?
They are brave, but they cannot look behind them. Do you like being brave?
I do. Why does the king have to stay near his friends?
He needs their help to stay safe. Are you close to your best friend?
Yes, very. Why can't the queen go back once she moves?
I do not know that rule for sure. Let us ask a teacher next time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I make my pictures look better?
Try to find good light. Do you like bright days or soft light?
I like soft light. My photos are always blurry.
Hold your hands close to your body. Do you wait for the quiet moments?
Yes, I wait. But the colors look dull.
Look for warm colors like red or yellow. I do not know your exact camera, but try this.
Okay, I will try that. Do I press the button twice?
No, just press it once and hold still. Does that help you feel more sure?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you like jazz?
Yes, I love it. Do you have time for one song?
No time. Do you like rock?
I like it too. Is it loud outside?
Too loud. I must go now.
Okay, go fast. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I felt very sad today because I dropped my ice cream.
That sounds like a real shame. Did you try to clean it up?
No, it was all on the ground. Now I am tired and hungry.
I am sorry about that. It is hard when plans go wrong.
I just want to eat something sweet. Do you have any good ideas?
Yes, maybe a piece of fruit or a cookie. Do you like fruit?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to build a shed in my yard. How do I start?
First, pick a spot that is flat and dry. Do you have a big, open space?
Yes, I have a patch of grass. What tools do I need?
You need a hammer, a saw, and a level. Do you have these tools at home?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I don't know what to do at the party.
That is okay. Do you like to dance?
I might, but I feel shy.
You can just stand and smile if you want.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I finished my big picture today!
That sounds very fun. What did you paint?
A bright red apple on a tree.
Red is a bold choice. Do you like red?
Yes, it pops out so much!
Colors can make things look alive. Is the sky blue?
Yes, a very light blue sky.
Light blue goes well with red.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What time is it?
It is ten past two. Are you going to work?
No, I have a train to catch. Is it soon?
The next train leaves in five minutes. Do you have your ticket?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I love this song, but what do the words mean?
They talk about a happy day in the sun. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I do! Thanks for explaining it.
You are welcome. Is it your favorite song now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. I cannot find my red socks.
That feels bad. Do you want to check the bed first?
I checked there. I forgot the reds at grandma’s house.
Ah, that is a tricky one. Did you pack your green ones?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no time. Where was Rome built?
It stands on seven hills near a river. Did you know how big it got?
No. Just tell me when it fell.
The western part fell in 476. Do you like old stories?
I must go. Who ruled first?
It began with kings, then a republic. I do not know your next stop.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel so good but I must run.
That is a happy feeling. What made you smile?
I fixed my bike.
That is a great job.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have this map, but I do not know where to go next.
That can be tricky. Do you have a compass?
No, I do not have one. The paper is also torn.
Let me look at the edges. Is there a tear near the bottom?
Yes, there is a big rip in the lower right corner.
That piece might be missing. Do you see any other papers?
I found a small square on the floor nearby.
Let us try to fit it together. It might make sense.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to climb a big mountain, but I do not know how to start.
That is a great goal. Do you like hiking on flat paths first?
I like flat paths, but I am scared of getting lost.
You can always go with a group. Do you have any friends who like the outdoors?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bike feels so hard to ride today. I am tired.
I am sorry you are tired. Do you have water with you?
Yes, but the road is bumpy. I do not like the noise.
That sound can be loud. Have you checked your tires for air?
I checked them, but they look okay. I just want to stop.
It is okay to take a break. Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so mad. My toy broke and it is not fixed yet.
That sounds very hard. What did you try to do first?
I tried to glue it, but the glue is wet.
Some things need time to dry. Do you have a book to read?
I do, but I want my toy now.
I understand the wish. It is not a magic fix yet.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to start drawing cats. Do I need a lot of money for supplies?
No, you just need paper and some colored pencils. Do you like to draw realistic cats or cartoon ones?
I prefer cartoon cats with big eyes. How do I make the eyes look round?
Start with a small circle and then add a bigger one on top of it. Do you already have some pencils at home?
I have a box of old ones, but they are all broken. Can I still use them?
Yes, you can buy new ones at any store for a few dollars. Do you think your friends would want to join you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a cloud in my hand?
You cannot make a real cloud in your hand, but you can make a fake one. Do you have a spray bottle?
Yes, I have a spray bottle.
Good. Spray some water near a cold window. Is your window cold today?
It feels cold outside.
The cold glass makes the water look like fog. This trick needs a very cold surface.
So I need ice or a cold wall?
Yes, any cold spot works. Do you like watching the water disappear?
I love watching it go away.
It is just water turning into tiny air droplets. Keep practicing, and you will get it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count on our fingers?
Because we have ten fingers to help us hold numbers in our mind. Do you like to count out loud?
Sometimes. But why do we always start at one?
One is the first thing we see, like a single apple. Is it fun to count apples?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my blue button on the rug.
That can be hard to find. Do you see it near the cat?
The cat is asleep, so I will check the couch.
Good idea. Soft places hide small things.
I found it under the cushion.
Great job. Did you put it on your coat?
Yes, it fits perfectly.
You did well. I am glad you found it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now, but I love my book.
What is its name? It sounds fun.
The old man and the sea.
Oh, I do not know it well.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today!
That is great news! What made you feel this way?
I got a new bike.
A bike is fun to ride. Do you like the color of it?
Yes, it is bright red.
Red is a happy color. It looks wonderful on you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the big building with old things inside.
That sounds like a fun place. Did you see any cool items?
Yes, I saw a tall bird that stood still for a long time.
Oh, a bird? I do not know if it was real or fake.
The sign said it was a very old bird from a far land.
That is amazing. Was it pretty to look at?
It had a long neck and looked down at me slowly.
I am glad you had a good time there.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go to the beach.
That sounds like so much fun. Do you like to swim?
Yes, but I am scared of big waves.
Big waves can be tricky. Do you have a friend to go with?
My brother is coming too.
That is good to have company. What do you want to play there?
We will build a big sand castle.
A castle is a great idea. Will you dig a moat around it?
I do not know what a moat is.
It is like a moat in a castle. Do you want to learn how?
Yes, please tell me.
A moat is a ditch filled with water. It keeps people out of your castle.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am worried about my big test tomorrow.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you like reading?
Yes, I love stories.
Good news. Your test is on stories. Do you practice reading?
I read every night.
That is a great plan. You will do well.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want new shoes, but I am lost in this big store.
That is okay. Do you like soft colors or bright ones?
I think I like blue, but I am not sure if they will match my clothes.
Blue is a good choice. Do you want to try on the blue pair?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now, my legs hurt.
Please slow down. Do you like running?
I have no time to talk.
Your health is key. Are you okay?
I need to reach the door.
Take a small rest. Why the rush?
I am late for work.
Safe travels. Do you run often?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to buy a new toy, but I have no money.
That is a hard feeling. Do you have a special box to save coins?
Yes, I have a jar, but it is almost empty.
That is a great start. How much do the toys cost at the shop?
They cost ten big coins, so I need to save for a long time.
Patience is a superpower. Would you like to play a game to track your savings?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling.
That sounds scary. Why did you fall?
I do not know. My legs just stopped working.
That is strange and bad. Do you feel better now?
A little, but I am still sad.
Dreams are not true, so you are safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we wipe the floor?
Dust makes us sick. Do you have a pet at home?
What does the broom do?
It sweeps up the dirt. Are you happy to help?
Why do we wash the dishes?
Food makes the plates dirty. Do you like clean plates?
Why do we make the bed?
It looks nice and tidy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very late for work today. My bike broke, and I had to walk the whole way.
That sounds like a very hard day. Did you manage to get there before the doors closed?
Yes, I made it with one minute to spare, but I am still tired.
It is good you did not miss work. You must be hungry now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights are off. What should I do?
That is scary. Do you have a flashlight?
I do not know where mine is. I am lost in the dark.
Take a deep breath. Can you see your phone screen?
No, my phone is dead too. I feel very alone.
We are here with you. Can you hear your family?
Yes, I can hear them. I am still a bit afraid though.
Good, that helps. Do you want to sit with me?
Yes, please. The dark is bad. I do not know when the power comes back.
I do not know that either. Let us just rest and wait.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this town. It feels too quiet.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you miss the noise?
Yes, I miss the loud sounds. Here, nothing moves.
Quiet places can be peaceful. Do you have a friend here?
No, I have no friends. I feel all alone.
That sounds hard. I will stay with you.
But where is the park? I want to play outside.
I do not know where it is. Would you like to ask?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I dropped my cup.
Oh no. Do you know what happened?
Why did it slip?
Your hand was wet. Do you have your towel?
I forgot my towel.
That is a tricky one. I do not know why it slipped.
Can you help me clean it?
Yes, I can help. Where is the mop?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a small cat by the park. What should I do?
Do not touch it. Is it moving and safe there?
Yes, it is moving. But it looks hungry.
