You can leave food nearby. Does it have a collar?
No, it does not. Should I take it home?
That is hard to say. Is your home safe for it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sun so bright?
It shines bright to give us light. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, but why is the sky blue?
The air makes the light look blue. Is it always blue?
Sometimes it is white. Why does it change?
I am not sure why it changes. Can you see the clouds?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big leaf drop from the tree this morning and wondered why that happens.
Trees drop leaves to save energy for the cold winter. Did you catch the leaf?
Yes, I put it in my book, but I am still curious about how they know when to stop growing.
They know when the days get shorter and the sun is weaker. It is a smart trick to survive.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My computer broke and I lost my work.
That sounds very scary. Do you have a backup?
No, but my boss was nice.
I am glad she helped. What did you do next?
I fixed it late at night.
You worked very hard today.
Yes, I am so tired now.
Rest well. You did your best.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I need the red book.
Is it on the shelf?
No, I lost it. I am sorry.
Do you know its color?
It is red. I am in a big hurry.
I see the red book.
Thank you so much. I go now.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big, red robot yesterday. Did it eat the cat?
I do not know for sure, but robots usually do not eat pets. Did you like the movie?
No, the robot was too loud.
That can be scary, but it is just pretend. Do you want to watch a quiet story next?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to eat today.
That is a hard choice. Do you want hot food or cold food?
I am very hungry and feel tired.
Let us pick a warm place. Do you like soup?
I think soup sounds good to me.
Okay, let us go to the soup shop. I hope you like it there.
Thank you for helping me decide.
You are welcome. Let us walk there now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am very tired today. I want to learn how to make bread at home.
That sounds like a good way to rest. Do you have an oven in your house?
Yes, I do. I am not sure how to mix the dough.
You add water to the flour and stir it until it is soft. Do you like sourdough bread?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I want to learn to sing?
Maybe it makes you feel free. Do you like happy songs?
I think so, but I am scared to try.
It is okay to be new. Are you ready to start?
Yes, I am ready now.
Good, let us begin.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn about sailors, but I do not know where to start.
That is a big world. What part of their life interests you the most?
I think I just want to read about them, but I am not sure which kind.
Try a story about a big storm first. Do you like exciting books?
Yes, I do, but I heard they were scary.
They can be scary, but they are also brave. Are you afraid of the dark?
A little bit, yes.
Then look for books about friends on a ship. Good friends make things feel safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am confused about the twelve months. Can you help me?
Yes, I can try. Do you know the first month?
I think it is January. What comes after that?
February is next. It has the fewest days. Do you like short months?
Not really. I prefer bigger months. Which ones are those?
July and August are big. Do you have a favorite season?
I like spring. But I forgot the order of the spring months.
March, April, and May. I hope that helps. Does that make sense?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie my shoelaces?
You make a knot and then make two loops. Do you want to try it now?
I tried, but the loop always slips.
That is okay, it takes time to learn. Are you holding the loops tight enough?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn about sailors. Where do they start?
They often start with small boats near the shore. Do you like the ocean?
Yes, I do. What do they do all day?
They check maps and fix the sails. Do you like to fix things?
Not really. I just want to go.
That is a good start. Be careful in the water.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I take a sharp picture of my dog?
Try to move your hands very still. Is your dog sitting still?
Sometimes he jumps. How do I catch him in the air?
You can use the high speed mode on your camera. Do you have a camera with that?
I only have a basic phone. How do I do it?
You must hold your phone tight and press the button quickly. That is a fun game, isn't it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today for my birthday.
That sounds like fun. Did you play on the swings?
Yes, I swung very high.
I am happy you had fun.
I ate a big cake with friends.
Did you like the flavor of the cake?
It was sweet and good.
That is a happy day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my friends left early.
I am sorry to hear that. Did they have a good time?
Yes, but I wanted to stay with them.
That feels lonely. Do you want to play a game?
No, I just want my friends back.
I understand your feelings.
It is okay, I will go to bed.
Good night. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you keep a secret?
It is a surprise for you. Do you like surprises?
Yes, I do. Why is it a surprise?
Because it is a gift. Will you open it soon?
When can I see it?
Tomorrow at lunch. Do you want a cookie now?
I want to see it now. Why can I not?
Patience makes it better.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do trees drink water?
Yes, their roots pull water up from the dirt. Do you like to drink water?
I have to go, but how do they get food?
They make their own food using sunlight. Do you know how the sun works?
I am so busy, just tell me if they sleep.
No, trees do not sleep, but they slow down in winter. Do you sleep well at night?
Thanks, I must run now.
Goodbye, and look up at the leaves.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to visit a museum. Do you know a good one?
Yes, the city art museum is great. Do you like old paintings?
I do not know. What else is there?
There are old toys and car models. Do you like to play?
I like to see things that move. Is there any?
There is a small planet show. It looks fun. Do you like space?
Yes, I love the stars. How do I get there?
Take the red bus to the main square.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do for my grandpa today.
That is hard. What does he like to do?
He likes to sit by the window.
You could sit with him there. Do you have a book to read?
I have a small blue book.
That sounds nice. I do not know if he will like it, but it is sweet.
Maybe I will just talk to him.
Talking is good. Is he feeling sad?
I think he misses grandma.
That makes him quiet. You can just hold his hand.
I will try to hold his hand.
That is a kind thing to do. It may help you both.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say please?
It shows we are kind. Do you think kindness matters?
What is the rule for the door?
We let the other person go first. Is that what you meant?
Why do we say sorry?
It helps the other person feel better. I do not know if it always works.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the post office this morning to mail a letter.
That sounds like a nice way to start the day. Did you find the counter busy?
It was very quiet, and the worker smiled at me.
A smile is a good sign. Do you send a lot of mail?
Not often, but I like watching them stamp the envelope.
I like that sound too. It feels very official.
I also bought a small green stamp for my next letter.
Green is a happy color. What are you planning to write about?
I just wanted to tell my friend that I missed him.
That is a sweet thought. Your friend will be happy to hear from you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have the big Ace and the small three. What should I play?
That is a tough choice. Do you want to try to win the big pot?
I think I will play the Ace. Is that a good move?
It is a very strong card. Good luck with your game.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my phone on the wet grass today.
Oh no, is it still working?
Yes, but it has a big scratch on the screen.
That sounds scary. Did you clean it off?
I wiped it with a soft cloth.
Good idea to keep it safe. Do you have a case for it?
No, I just keep it in my pocket.
That might be risky. You should buy a cover.
I will look for one tomorrow.
That is a smart plan. I hope you find a nice one.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found an old note from a friend. I do not know what to do with it.
That sounds like a special find. Did you read what it says?
It says we should meet again. I am not sure if I should go.
Maybe your heart tells you to go. Do you miss this person?
I think I do. But I am scared they will not be happy to see me.
They likely are just as happy as you are. Would you like to write to them first?
Yes, I think I will try. Thank you for helping me think.
You have a good heart. Good luck with your letter.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared to sit in a car.
That is very normal. Have you seen a teacher drive?
Yes, but my hands shake.
Grip the wheel like a banana. Do you know where the pedals are?
I think I do, but I get mixed up.
Big gas on the right, small brake on the left. Are you looking forward?
Yes, I will look straight ahead.
Good luck with that.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my fish not eating?
It may be sick or too hot. Is the water warm?
It looks fine, but it swims fast.
Fast swimming can mean stress. Does it hide in the corner?
It hides near the plant.
Plants give safety. Check for sharp bits. Is the leaf sharp?
No, it is soft.
I do not know then. Try new food tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the fish stand before it closes. Can you point me there?
Yes, turn left and walk fast. Are you buying fish for dinner?
No, I am buying it for a friend. Is it really close?
Yes, you will see the blue sign soon. You have enough time to spare.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big bear in the case. Is it real?
No, it is not alive. Do you like bears?
I think the green frog is cold.
Frogs are happy when the air is cool.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I packed a basket with fruit and bread for the park.
That sounds like a lovely plan. Do you have a favorite snack?
I love sharing treats with friends on sunny days.
It is great to share joy. Is the weather nice today?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because we have a picnic.
That sounds like a wonderful day. What food are you bringing?
We have sandwiches and sweet cookies.
Those are tasty treats. Do you have any fruit?
Yes, we have fresh apples and juicy grapes.
That is a healthy choice. I am glad for you.
Thank you for talking to me about it.
You are welcome. Have a lovely time outside.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hi. I have cake. I am late.
Happy birthday! Is the cake big?
Yes. It is red. I must go.
That sounds sweet. I do not know who gave it to you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My new neighbors gave us some warm cookies today.
That is so nice of them. Do they live close by?
Yes, they are just across the street.
That makes it easy to say hello.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My sandwich is soggy. I hate this.
That sounds sad. Did you pack it the night before?
Yes, but the tomato juice soaked into the bread.
Oh no. Do you want to trade a cookie with someone?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you keep the box locked?
It holds a story I have not told yet. Do you like surprises?
Yes, but why the lock?
Some things need time to grow. Is it a big story?
I think it is.
I am not sure, but I will open it soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do plants drink water?
They use tiny tubes in their roots. Do you like green leaves?
Yes, but I must go. How does the water move up?
The sun pulls it up like a straw. Is your school near?
I do not care. Is the water sweet?
No, it is just water. Do you drink much?
I am running. Thanks for telling me.
You are welcome. Run fast.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need lunch now, but my legs are too tired to walk far.
That is very hard. Do you have a favorite meal here?
I want something quick, but I do not know what to pick.
The salad bar is close and fresh. Do you like cold food?
I am so busy, I just need a hot box before I leave.
I do not know if the hot boxes are ready yet. Can you check the window?
No time to check, I am right on the clock, what should I do?
Try the sandwich counter, it is usually fast. Are you ready to go?
Fine, I will grab a sandwich, thank you for the help.
You are welcome, have a good break.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can a frog breathe with its skin?
Yes, it can! Frogs use their skin to get air when they are underwater. Do you have any frogs at home?
No, but I like big cats. How do lions sleep?
Lions sleep a lot, sometimes twenty hours a day. They love to nap in the shade. Which big cat do you like best?
I like tigers. Are they faster than lions?
I am not sure, but both are very quick.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am worried about my math test. Do you know when it is?
I do not know the exact date, but you should check your planner. Are you studying every day?
Yes, I practice a little bit each morning. It feels slow but I try hard.
That is a very good habit. Slow progress is still real progress. Do you like numbers?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the wind. It is too loud.
That is a fair point. Is it blowing hard today?
Yes, it is pushing my hat off.
That sounds very annoying. Do you have a spare hat?
No, I am sad about this.
I am sorry to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The storm is so loud right now. I love the thunder.
That sounds very exciting. Do you sit by the window?
Yes, I watch the rain fall fast. It feels like music.
Rain can be very calming. Do you hear birds singing too?
No, only the wind and the big booms. It feels safe inside.
I do not know if you are alone. Do you have a warm drink?
I have hot chocolate with extra marshmallows. It is perfect.
That sounds lovely and cozy. Do you like sweet drinks?
Yes, I am very happy just being here. It is a good day to stay in.
I am glad you are having a good time. Enjoy your time by the fire.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the music so loud?
It is loud because many people are happy to dance. Do you like to dance?
Why are the plates all red?
I do not know why they picked red plates. Do you like red?
Why is the cake cold?
The cake is cold because it just came from the fridge. Do you want a slice?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My dog found a ball under the sofa today.
That sounds like a fun find. Did you play with him?
Yes, we chased it around the yard for an hour.
He must be very tired now. Is he sleeping?
He is curled up on his bed. I am happy he is safe.
That is great to hear. You did a good job.
Thank you, I think I will get some rest too.
Good idea. Sleep well.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the plane fly so high up?
It flies high because the air is thinner and there is less wind. Do you like the view from the window?
Why do my ears feel so plugged up?
The air pressure changes, so your ears need time to adjust. I do not know why it hurts some people more than others.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a big surprise for my friend. What should I do?
Keep it a secret. Are you nervous?
Yes, I am very scared they will guess. What can I do?
Hide the gift well. Do you have a plan?
I do not know what to do next. Please help.
Just enjoy the moment. You will be fine.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do months have different lengths?
I do not know the true reason. Do you like long months?
I like short ones. How many months are in a year?
There are twelve months in a year. Do you remember the names?
Yes, but I mix them up. When is the end of the year?
The end of the year is in December. Is that your favorite month?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What comes after May?
June comes after May. Do you like summer?
Yes, I do! How many months are in a year?
There are twelve months in a year.
Why is December the last one?
It is last because the year ends then. Do you like snow in December?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you know if the toy store is open on Sunday?
I think it is, but I am not sure. Do you want to buy a doll?
I want a red truck, not a doll.
That sounds fun. Can you tell me if it has big wheels?
Yes, they are very big and strong.
Great! I hope you find the perfect truck.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The city is so loud and full of people. Do you know why it is so busy?
Yes, many people work and shop there every day. Do you like the noise?
Not really, but I like the food there. Do you know if there are quiet spots?
I think parks are usually quiet. Do you like to sit in parks?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I had a bad dream. I am still a bit sad.
I am sorry to hear that. What was in the dream?
I fell off a very tall cliff.
That sounds scary. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The sun feels too hot today. I do not like it.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you like shade?
Yes, I want to go outside and play, but it is too bright.
The sun will move later. Do you want a glass of water?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just won a game of chess and I am so happy!
That is wonderful news! Do you play often?
Yes, I love moving the little pieces.
I do not know much about the rules myself. What is your favorite piece?
I think the knight is the best because it jumps.
Jumping sounds very exciting! How did you win?
I trapped the enemy king at the end.
That sounds like a clever move. Well done!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I move a knight?
The knight makes an L shape. It can jump over other pieces. Do you know the board layout?
Yes, I have my board set up.
Great. Place your knight in the corner. Move it to the square that is two steps forward and one step to the side. Do you see which square that is?
I see it now.
You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy I saw the doctor today!
That is great news. How do you feel now?
I feel strong and ready to play.
That makes me happy for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want my dog to sit. How do I do that?
Hold a treat near his nose and say sit. Then move the treat up slowly. Is he a big dog?
He is small and loves cheese. How do I stop him from barking?
Stay quiet and ignore the barking until he stops. Then give him the cheese as a prize.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my party was not very fun.
That sounds hard. Did you eat cake?
I did, but the music was too loud.
Loud music can be tiring. Do you like quiet songs?
Yes, I like quiet songs a lot.
Next time we can play soft tunes. What is your favorite song?
It is about a little bear.
A bear sounds nice. Is that bear sleepy?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to cross a river safely.
You can look for a shallow spot with smooth stones. Do you see any good rocks there?
I see some big stones, but they look slippery.
Wet stones are often slick, so test one carefully with your foot.
That is wise. How do I move across?
Step from stone to stone and keep your eyes on the path, not the water. Is the water moving fast?
It looks slow, but it feels cold.
Cold water can be shocky, so keep moving with quick, small steps.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go to the park for my birthday.
The park is a fun place. Do you like sliding on the slides?
Yes, I love the big slide.
That sounds exciting. Is there a pond there?
No, just grass and trees.
Grass is good for running. Are you bringing any friends?
Yes, my best friend comes too.
Friends make parties better. What food do you like best?
I like cake with blue icing.
Blue cake is special. Happy birthday to you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to buy a big red apple.
That apple is very sweet. Do you like sweet fruit?
Yes, I love sweet things.
The apple costs two coins. Do you have two coins?
I only have one coin here.
You can buy a smaller apple. Do you want to try that one?
Yes, the small one is for me.
Good choice for your tummy. Enjoy your snack.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big plan for the weekend.
That sounds great. What is your first step?
I am going to clean my room.
That is a very good start. Do you have a song for cleaning?
Yes, I will sing my favorite tune.
I love that idea. What will you do after cleaning?
I will read a book in my cozy corner.
That sounds very peaceful.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My new neighbor just gave me a basket of apples.
That is very sweet of them. Do you like apples?
I do, and they look so red and shiny.
You should try one right away. Have you met them before?
Yes, we smiled at each other over the fence.
Smiling is a great way to say hello. How do you feel now?
I feel warm and happy inside.
It is good to share your joy. Let us know if you need help next.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on my play.
What is the problem?
I forgot the last line.
You must ask your cast to help you. Do they have the script?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today.
That sounds fun. Did you see any fish?
I saw a big crab under a rock.
Crabs have hard shells. Was it red?
It was small and orange. It ran away fast.
I am glad you saw it. Was the water cold?
The sand was hot but the water was cool.
I am happy you enjoyed your day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today!
That is wonderful news. What made you smile?
I helped a friend pick up their dropped toy.
That was very kind of you.
I think being polite makes everyone feel good.
You are right. Does it help you too?
Yes, it makes my heart feel warm.
That is a beautiful feeling.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a rainbow in the sky. I do not know what to do with it.
That sounds like a fun thing to see. Do you like the colors?
Yes, the red and blue are bright. But I feel a bit lost looking at it.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you want to talk about your day?
Not really. I just stare at the rain and the sun. I am not sure what to think.
Staring is a good start. Do you see any animals nearby?
No, just the wet ground. It is quiet here. I am still unsure.
Quiet can feel strange. Do you hear the birds singing?
I hear them now. The sound makes me feel a little better.
I am glad you feel better. Do you want to listen for a long time?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sky is very dark. Do I need an umbrella?
It looks like rain soon. Do you have a coat with you?
I forgot it at home. The wind is cold too.
You should stay warm. What are you planning to do?
I want to go for a walk. But the rain is starting.
A wet walk is not fun. Do you like playing inside?
I like reading books. It is dry inside.
That sounds good. You will be safe and dry.
Okay, I will go in. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sun so bright?
It makes light so we can see. Do you like sunny days?
I do. Why does it go away at night?
The Earth turns around. Do you like the dark?
Yes, I like stars. Why are they out?
I do not know. Do you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My sister took my toy and will not give it back.
That sounds very unfair. Did you ask her to share?
Yes, but she said no and ran away.
I am sorry you feel hurt. What does the toy look like?
It is a red car that I love.
I understand why you are upset. Do you want to go together?
I do not feel like playing right now.
It is okay to take a break.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at this photo! I took it in the park.
It is very bright and cheerful. Who else was there?
My little brother was in it. He fell over and laughed.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did he take a picture too?
No, he only had juice in his hands.
Oh no, that is a bit messy. I am glad you captured the happy part.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My cat knocked the cards over the table.
Oh no, that is a bad luck. Do you have many cards left?
No, they are all under the sofa.
You will need to get them now. Would you like to start again?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to make dinner tonight.
That sounds like a great plan. What are you making?
I am making chicken and rice.
Yum, that is a classic meal. Do you like cooking?
Yes, I love the smell of it.
I would love to come eat with you. Are you making enough food?
Yes, I made extra for you.
You are very kind. I will be there soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a new song, but I do not know if I should share it with my friends.
Sharing is usually a good thing. Do you like the song very much?
I think so, but I am worried they will not like it.
That is a normal feeling. You can just ask them to listen together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The lights are out. How do I use a flashlight?
You pull the lever to turn it on. Do you have a flashlight?
Yes, I found it in the box.
Good. Point it where you need light. Is it bright enough?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue boat at the park.
That sounds like a nice sight. Was it moving on the water?
Yes, it moved very slowly.
Slow boats are calm. Did you get to sit inside?
I could not get in, but I saw a cat.
A cat on a boat is special. Was the cat sleeping?
The cat was just looking at me.
It seemed curious. Did it have a collar?
I think so, but I am not sure.
I do not know for certain. It was a sweet moment.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make pasta for dinner.
That sounds yummy. Do you know how to boil the water?
I do not know.
You put water in a pot and wait for bubbles. What kind of sauce do you like?
I like red sauce with meat.
Great choice. Stir the pot often so it does not stick.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a big mess to clean.
That sounds hard. Do you want to start with the floor?
Yes, the floor is very dirty.
You should sweep first, then mop. Is there a lot of dust?
Yes, there is much dust.
Good, a broom will help. Do you have a broom?
I have a broom.
Great. Start in a small corner first.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream and it hit the ground. I felt very sad.
That is a shame. Did you cry?
Yes, I cried a little. Then I saw a dog.
A dog? What did it do?
It ran away. I am still a bit unhappy.
I am sorry about your day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I count to ten?
You say one, two, three, up to ten. Do you like the number ten?
I am not sure. How do I start?
You begin with the word one. What is your favorite number?
I like the number five. Can I stop there?
You can stop whenever you wish. Counting is just for fun.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I have been walking for a long time and I am very tired.
That sounds tiring. Did you look at a map?
I tried, but the streets all look the same to me.
I am sorry you feel stuck. Are you near a park?
Yes, there is a big green space just around the corner.
Good news. Do you see any water fountains there?
I see benches and trees, but I still do not know where I am.
I do not know your exact spot. Please ask a local person for help.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike, but I am scared of falling.
Do not worry, I will stay close to you. Do you have your helmet on?
Yes, my dad helped me put it on tight.
Good choice. Let us start by just walking with the bike in your hands.
That sounds easy, I can do that part.
Great. How do you feel about the pedals?
I think my legs are ready for the work.
Nice. Let us try lifting one foot onto a pedal now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I say I am sorry to my friend?
You can say, "I am sorry I was mean." Do you know why it is hard?
Yes, I feel scared that he will be mad at me.
That is a common fear. Is he usually nice to you?
Yes, he is very kind.
Then he will likely forgive you. A simple apology works best.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. The sky is so blue!
That is a lovely feeling. Do you wonder why it is that color?
I want to know. Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors mixed together. The blue parts bounce around the air the most.
It bounces? Like a ball?
Yes, sort of like a ball. Does that help you see it clearly?
Yes, it does. My heart feels light.
I am glad that made you happy. Do you look up often?
I always look up. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Enjoy the view.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I read a clock with short and long hands?
The short hand shows the hour, and the long hand shows the minutes. Do you have a clock to look at?
I see the hands are on the twelve.
That means it is noon or midnight. Is it bright or dark outside?
It is bright, so it must be noon.
You are right, it is noon. Do you have lunch yet?
I am hungry, but my hands are all mixed up.
Let us look together. Can you point to the top number?
Yes, the big hand is on the six.
That means it is past noon. Can you eat your snack now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke the cup. I am sorry.
It is okay. Did you catch the pieces?
Yes, I put them in the trash. Now I want to learn to wash dishes.
Good start. Do you have a sponge?
Yes, I have one. How do I start?
Put a little soap on it. Do you like bubbles?
Yes, I love them. What is next?
Scrub the plate gently. Is it clean now?
Yes, it is shiny. Thank you for helping me.
You did a great job.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great skill to learn. Do you have a pair of sneakers?
Yes, I have my red ones.
Great, let us start by making a bunny ear on one side.
I made the first ear. What is next?
Now make a second ear on the other side. Does that look right to you?
Yes, I have two ears.
Now twist the ears around each other and pull tight.
It is done!
You did a wonderful job. I am so happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. I forgot to say sorry for breaking your toy.
It is okay. Are you running to a bus?
Yes, I must go now. Please do not be mad at me.
I am not mad at all. Have a safe trip!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why should I walk every day?
It keeps your heart strong. Do you like moving?
Yes, I do. What else is good about it?
It helps you think clear and feel calm. Do you walk with a friend?
No, usually alone. Is that okay?
Yes, it is still great for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do plants drink?
They need water to live. Do you like water too?
How does the water get inside?
Roots pull it up from the dirt. Can you feel your own roots?
I do not have roots.
True, you have skin. But plants use their roots to reach the wet soil.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make bread, but my dough is all wet and sticky. What should I do?
Add a little more flour to fix that. Do you use white flour?
Yes, I use white flour. Should I keep adding it until it stops sticking?
Yes, add it slowly until the dough feels smooth. Are you happy with the smell?
It smells very good. How long do I let it rest before I bake it?
Let it rest until it gets big. Do you like hot bread?
Yes, I love hot bread. Do I need to put it in the oven on high heat?
Use a hot oven, but not the very highest setting.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I sit at my desk and feel blank.
That feeling is hard. What do you usually do first?
I just stare at the screen.
Try writing down three small tasks. Does that sound doable?
I do not know where to start.
Pick the easiest thing first. How does that feel?
I am still confused.
It is okay to pause. Take a short walk.
Should I just call you?
I cannot pick up the phone. But I am here to talk.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My computer is very slow. I need to save my work now.
Try closing other apps to free up space. Did you save your work already?
Yes, I saved it a few minutes ago.
That is good to hear.
It is still spinning. What should I do?
Unplug it for one minute to reset it. Do you have a power cord?
Yes, I have the cord. I will do that.
That is a smart plan.
It is on again and working fast. Thank you.
You are welcome. Is everything running smoothly now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I must go now. Do you know where the surprise is?
I do not know. Is it in the box?
No, it is hidden. I cannot wait.
Okay, go fast. Do you like surprises?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to learn tennis. What should I buy first?
You need a racquet and some balls. Do you have a court near your home?
I think so. How do I hit the ball?
Hold the racquet like a shake. Swing it across your body. Do you know how to grip the handle?
I grip it tight like a fist. Is that right?
Not too tight. Hold it firm but loose. Do you play with both hands?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am late for school. What do I do?
Take a deep breath. Did you eat breakfast?
No, I just grabbed a cookie. Should I worry?
It is okay to be a bit late. Are you feeling sick?
No, I am fine. What if my teacher is angry?
Tell the truth to your teacher. Do you know why you missed the bus?
I overslept. How do I fix this?
Go to class now. I hope you have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I caught a small fish today. It escaped.
Oh, that happens. Was the line too thin?
The line was fine. I pulled too hard.
Be gentle next time. Did you use a hook?
Yes, I used a red hook.
Red is good. Do you like eating fish?
I do not like eating them. I just like the water.
That is very peaceful. Why do you go fishing?
I want to sit still and think.
That is a great reason. I do not know if I could sit that still.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That is great. What did you like the most?
I did a big test.
Well done. Did you do well?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to help him but he got mad.
That feels bad. What did you do?
I gave him my toy.
You shared it? Why did he get mad?
He wanted to break it.
I am sorry you felt hurt.
I do not want to help anyone else.
It is okay to rest.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do here. The village is very quiet.
It is a calm place. What do you like to do?
I want to build a boat. But there is no water nearby.
That is hard. Do you want to climb the hill?
I am too tired to walk up there. I am just lost.
Go to the old house. It has a map inside.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ran three miles today.
That is good work. Did you feel tired?
Yes, my legs hurt a lot.
Resting helps your body grow strong.
I drank some cold water.
Water is good for you. What did you eat after?
I had a banana.
Bananas give you fast energy.
I felt happy and calm.
That is a nice feeling. Good job.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the kids book room. I am running very late.
Go left, down the hall. Is the book about dinosaurs?
No, it is about space. How long will it take?
Just two minutes. Hope you make it in time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the big red tower here?
It helps people see the town from far away. Do you like looking at views?
What is the green patch of grass for?
It is for people to sit and play. Do you like playing outside?
Why do so many birds fly above?
I do not know for sure, but they like the trees. Are you watching them too?
Is the water cold or warm?
It is cold in the morning and warm in the day. Do you like swimming?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at the big wet spots on the ground.
Yes, the rain makes everything shiny. Do you like the sound of it?
It feels cold on my hands.
Cold rain can be good for plants. Do you wear a hat to stay dry?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a red button. Do you like collecting small things?
Yes, I do. What else do you have in your pocket?
A blue cap and a round stone. Do you collect food?
No, I do not eat. Is the stone smooth or rough?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I cleaned my whole house today. I feel so good.
That is great news. What did you clean first?
I started with the kitchen floor. It was very dirty.
You worked hard there. Did you finish the living room too?
Yes, I swept and mopped the living room. It looks so bright now.
It must look nice. Do you want to take a break now?
Yes, I am a bit tired but very happy.
Rest well then. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make an egg flip in the air?
Hold the egg in one hand and toss it up. I like to ask, do you have a frying pan ready?
Yes, I have a hot pan. How high should I toss it?
Toss it about two feet up, high enough to catch. Is your hand steady when you hold the egg?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run, what are those fluffies?
They are called clouds. Are you going outside?
Yes, but I need to go now.
They are made of water mist. Do you like rain?
No, I am in a big hurry.
Well, I hope you are safe. Have a good day!
Thanks, see you later.
Bye.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a sweet cake.
We have many cakes. Do you like chocolate?
Yes, I love chocolate.
That is a good choice. Is it for a birthday?
It is my birthday today.
Happy birthday! How big is your birthday?
I am five years old.
Five is a great age. Pick the one with the pink icing.
I will take that one.
Here is your cake. Thank you for coming.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the snow white?
Ice crystals look white because they bounce all the light back to your eyes. Do you like looking at it?
Yes, I do. Why does it fall from the sky?
Cold air in the clouds turns water into tiny ice bits that are heavy enough to fall. Do you catch flakes on your tongue?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to count the days, but I get mixed up.
Start with Sunday first. Do you know which day comes after that?
I think it is Monday, but my head feels foggy.
You are right, it is Monday. Keep going one day at a time.
That helps me feel better about it.
I am glad that helps. Are you feeling ready to try?
Yes, I am ready to count them all.
Good luck with your counting. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke my friend's cup. What should I say?
You can say sorry. Do you know where the cup is?
I do not know. It is lost.
That is hard. Tell her the truth.
I am scared she will be mad.
She may be mad for a bit. Do you want to buy her a new one?
Yes, I think I will.
That is a kind fix. I hope it helps.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a big secret, but I must go.
That sounds fun. Do you want to tell me?
No time, I am late.
Okay, I will wait. What is the secret?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I get tired so fast when I run?
Your body uses up energy to move your legs. Do you drink water?
Yes, I drink a little. Why does my chest hurt?
It hurts because your heart beats hard to push blood. Is the pain bad?
It is a bit sharp. Why does that happen?
I do not know for sure. Why do you want to run?
I want to be strong. Why is running good for me?
It makes your heart and lungs work well. How far can you go?
I can run one block. Why is that not enough?
It is a good start. Do you like running?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saved my coins in a jar and they clinked so loud!
That sounds like a lot of fun! Do you know what you will buy?
I want a big red kite for the park.
A red kite is a wonderful pick! What color is the sky today?
The sky is very blue and clear.
I am glad the weather is good for you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared about my big day.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you like your dress?
Yes, but I worry about the food.
That is a smart thing to check. Are you hungry right now?
No, but I want the guests to be happy.
Then tell your planner your wish.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is my grandma?
I do not know where she is. Are you going to the park?
Yes, I must go now.
I hope you have fun. Can you help me with a bag later?
Maybe later. I have to run.
Okay. I will wait for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat by the window all night and read a book about a cat.
That sounds cozy. Did the cat find a good bed?
No, the cat fell asleep in a box under the tree.
I am glad the cat was safe. Do you like boxes too?
I do not know. I just like the quiet dark.
The quiet dark is nice for thinking.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a broken pencil on the floor in class today.
That sounds a bit of a mess. Did you tell your teacher?
Yes, I gave it to her, and she gave me a new one.
You did a very good job helping.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at my little blue fish! He is swimming so fast.
What a lovely color. Does he have a special name?
Yes, his name is Bubbles. He is very happy today.
That makes me smile too. Do you know how old he is?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to buy a big robot. How do I get more coins?
You can save a little bit of your pocket money each day. Do you get any extra cash on Sundays?
Yes, I get five dollars. But I spend it all on candy.
Candy is sweet, but it runs out fast. Try saving half of your coins instead. What is your favorite color?
Blue. I like blue cars. How long will I wait?
It depends on how much you save each week. Are you good at counting money?
I think so. I can count to a hundred.
Great! We can make a plan to track your savings. Do you have a jar at home?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am drawing a big red circle.
That is a nice shape. What is it?
It is a sun for my house.
A warm sun is good. Is it happy?
Yes, I gave it a smile.
Smiles are always fun to draw. Do you want to add arms?
No, just the round part.
Understood. Keep it simple.
Thanks, I like how it looks.
I am glad you like it. Good work.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go to the beach soon. Do you have any advice?
Yes. Bring water and wear sunscreen. Do you have a swimsuit ready?
I have a suit. What else should I do?
Pack a towel and some snacks. Do you like digging in the sand?
I love digging. Is that okay for the beach?
Yes, it is very fun. Just be careful of sharp shells.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My chair leg is loose and wobbly.
I can help you tighten the screw. Which leg is wobbly?
It is the one on the left side.
Great, let's find a small screwdriver to fix it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My baby brother is so tiny. Does he have fingers?
Yes, he has ten little fingers. Do you like holding them?
I think he is too small to hold. Does he drink milk?
Yes, he drinks milk to grow strong.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new friend to play with. I feel so glad.
That is wonderful news. What game do you like to play?
We ran in the park all day. It was very fun.
I am happy for you. Running makes the heart beat fast.
I do not feel lonely anymore. Thank you for listening.
I am glad you feel better. You are a good friend.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just ate the best meal of my life. The food was so good.
That sounds lovely. Was it at a new place?
Yes, it is a small shop near the park. I want to go back often.
I am glad you enjoyed it. Do you know if they have desserts?
They do. The cake was sweet and warm. I am very happy.
What a great find. I am glad you shared it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went for a run this morning. My legs felt heavy by the end.
That sounds tiring. Did you drink some water after?
Yes, I drank a big glass of cold water. It helped a lot.
Good for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw one dog and two cats on the street.
That is a fun morning. Did you play with them?
No, but I counted three birds in the tree.
Three is a nice number. Were they all the same color?
Yes, they were all black.
I like that picture in my head.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent all day picking up toys from the floor.
That sounds like hard work. Did you find a lost shoe?
Yes, I found my red shoe under the bed.
Great job. What color is your shoe?
It is bright red and very smooth.
Nice. Do you want to rest now?
Yes, I am very tired and hungry.
Good. I am happy you are safe.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to pick up my toys.
That is hard, but we can do it together. Which toy is your favorite?
The little truck.
Great, let us start with the truck. Do you see any red blocks on the floor?
Yes, there are many red blocks.
Good eye. Let us put them in the box.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The soup is all burned. I feel so bad.
Oh no, that is sad. Do you like the smell?
It smells bad. Now what do I do?
I do not know your kitchen. What did you put in the pot?
Just water and beans. It was my only plan.
Throw it out, do not eat that. Let us make fresh beans.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the sky have a rainbow?
It happens when sun and rain meet. Do you like the colors?
Yes, I love the red part.
Red is at the top. It looks warm.
Is it always there?
No, only after rain with sun. Do you look up often?
I hope to see one soon.
That is a nice hope.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very scared about my meeting tomorrow.
It is okay to feel scared. Are you nervous about the hard part?
I do not know what to say to the big people.
You can just tell them how you feel. Do you have a toy to help you?
No, I do not have a toy with me.
That is fine. You will do a good job.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my screen dark?
The power is off. Do you see a red light?
Why is there no light?
The plug is not in the wall. Is it cold?
Why does it feel cold?
It has no power. Did you try to turn it on?
Why won't it start?
I do not know. Do you hear a fan?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the moon so round?
It is a big rock in space. Do you like looking at it?
I like it when it is bright.
That light comes from the sun. It reflects on the moon.
Can I go to the moon?
Not yet, but we can dream about it. Do you have a telescope?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big fort. Where should I start?
That sounds like fun! Do you have enough blankets?
Yes, I have two blue ones and one red one.
Great, use the blue ones for the walls.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am not sure what to do for my big day.
I like the idea of a small party with close friends. Do you want to eat cake?
Yes, but I have no money left for guests.
You can just hang out at home with your family. That is free and true. Do you love chocolate?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I feel very tired today because I caught a cold.
I am sorry you feel sick. Do you have a fever?
My nose is stuffed and my throat hurts.
That sounds very uncomfortable. Have you had any soup?
I drank some warm tea and felt a little better.
That is a good choice for a sore throat.
I just want to sleep it off and rest.
Rest is the best medicine for a cold. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the boat float on the water?
Air inside the boat helps it stay up. Do you like riding on it?
Yes, but why does it tip if we jump?
Moving too fast makes it lose balance. Did you jump on one side?
Yes, I did. Why is the bottom round?
Round shapes cut through the water easier. Is it made of wood?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a big sand castle, but my walls always fall down.
Press the wet sand hard to make it stick. Do you have a bucket?
Yes, I do have a bucket, but the sand is too dry.
Water makes the sand hold together. Is the water cold?
It is cold and wet now. How do I make the roof?
Just tip the bucket over the top slowly. Watch for the shape.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My computer is not working. I need it for work right now.
I am sorry to hear that. Is the screen on?
No, the screen is dark. I am very late.
Try plugging it in tight. Do you see any lights?
Yes, there is a small red light. I am worried.
That means it has power. Let us try to wake it up.
You press the power button for me? I can not wait.
I am a helper, not a hand. I do not have fingers.
That is a great help. I hate this machine.
I know it feels bad. Can you wait one minute?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My white shirt has a big red spot. I am so sad.
Oh no, that is tricky. Did you try cold water?
Yes, but the spot did not go away. Now my dog is looking at me.
That is very frustrating. Are you angry at the dog?
No, I am not angry. I just feel like I failed.
You did not fail, you just have a hard job. Do you have any soap?
I do, but I do not know what to do. I want to give up.
Stay with me. Mix a little soap with warm water.
Okay, I am mixing it. I hope this works.
Good luck. Tell me if it helps.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a new friend today!
That is wonderful news. Who is your new friend?
She likes to draw big, red apples.
Drawing apples sounds like so much fun.
I drew her a picture of me.
That is a very sweet thing to do.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a snowman. How do I do it?
Roll three big balls of snow. Are you cold today?
Yes, but I am excited. What comes next?
Put the biggest ball on the ground. What will you use for eyes?
I have some black buttons. How do I make it smile?
Push two carrots into its face. It is done now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which song to pick.
That is a hard choice. Do you like fast tunes?
I like slow music more.
Slow songs are nice. Do you want to sleep?
Yes, I want to rest.
Pick a soft lullaby then. It will help you close your eyes.
Okay, I will try that.
Good luck. Have a sweet dream.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a coin on the ground. What should I do with it?
If you know who dropped it, please give it back. Is the coin shiny and new?
No, it is old and dirty. I do not know who lost it.
Take it to the store where it may have been lost. Do you live near a big shop?
Yes, there is a toy store next door.
Ask the shopkeeper if anyone lost a coin there. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is bright and the wind is soft. I am so happy to see this!
That sounds wonderful. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I love them. It makes me feel warm and good.
I am glad you are happy. Have a great day!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make bread. What do I need?
You need flour, water, and yeast. Do you have any yeast at home?
I have flour and water, but no yeast. Can I still bake?
No, yeast makes the bread rise. You must buy some first.
Okay. How do I put the ingredients together?
Mix everything in a bowl until it is a dough. Is it sticky for you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I throw rice at the wedding?
You just hold the bag and toss it gently. Do you have a bag?
Yes, I do. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do robots have feelings?
Robots do not feel happy or sad like people do.
What do they use to think?
They use big, fast computers to think. Do you like games?
I think robots are scary.
Many people feel that way, but I know them as safe friends.
Can you fix a robot?
I cannot fix broken parts, but I can help you learn more.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My plant looks sad and brown.
Oh no, I am sorry. Do you give it water every day?
Yes, I give it a lot.
That is too much water. It gets tired when it is wet all the time.
So I should stop?
Yes, wait until it is dry. Is the soil dry now?
It feels wet inside.
Then wait for two days. I do not know if it will live, but it needs rest.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The lights went out and I am scared of the dark.
Take a deep breath, I am right here with you. Do you have a flashlight?
I think I left it in my bag.
That is a smart thing to check. Would you like to look for it together?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at the sea. I do not know what to do next.
It looks calm today. Do you like jumping in water?
I am not sure. It looks a bit cold.
That is a good sign. You can just watch it for a while. Do you see any boats?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so late. I feel bad.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you miss the bus?
Yes, I did. Now I am very tired.
That is hard. Do you want to sit for a bit?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a fence for my small garden. How do I start?
First, you need to pick a path to dig. Do you know where you want it to go?
Yes, it goes along the grass. What tools do I need?
You need a spade and some wood. Do you have a helper to carry the wood?
I have my brother. How deep should I dig?
Dig about one foot deep. Is your ground hard or soft?
It is hard. Can I just stick the posts in?
No, you must dig a hole for each post.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does walking make me feel good?
It makes your heart pump blood fast. Do you like playing outside?
I guess. What else happens?
It helps your brain think clear. Do you take long walks?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do leaves fall from the trees in the fall?
The tree lets them go so it can save energy for winter. Do you like watching them dance in the wind?
Yes, I do. But why does the tree need to save energy?
It uses that power to rest and grow again when it gets warm. It is a clever way to stay alive.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My screen is black. I need to send a file now.
Is the power light on? Tell me what you see.
No light. I am late for work.
Try plugging in the cord. Do you hear a click?
It is not doing that. What is wrong?
I do not know for sure. It may be broken.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to count my toys, but I kept making mistakes. I feel so silly.
It is hard to count when you are tired. Do you want to try one more time together?
One, two, three... oh no, I lost track again. I just cannot do it.
You are learning, and that is good. Can you start at one with me?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do sailors work at sea?
They love the ocean and like to travel far. Do you like boats?
Do they get lonely out there?
Sometimes they do, but they have each other for fun. Is that scary to you?
How do they find their way home?
They use stars and maps to guide them. Do you know any stars?
What do they eat on a long trip?
I am not sure what every sailor eats. Do you like fish?
Thank you for helping me understand.
You are welcome for your kindness. Do you want to ask one more thing?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am hungry. What is good for lunch?
A sandwich is nice. Do you like cheese?
I have a turkey sandwich. It is cold.
That is sad. I know hot dogs are warm. Do you want to trade?
No, thank you. I will heat it up.
That is a smart plan. I hope it tastes good.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I packed my bag, but I think I left my shoes by the door.
That can happen to anyone. Did you look near the plant?
Yes, I found them, but now my water bottle is missing.
Water is very important to have. Do you know if you packed it yet?
Oh no, I did not pack it. It is on the kitchen table.
Good thing you remembered where it is. You are almost ready to go.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am putting my toys in a box.
That is a good start. Do you have a truck for the big things?
No, my dad has a van.
A van is perfect for cars and dolls. Is the new house far away?
It is near the park, but I do not know where my bed goes.
We can put the bed near a window.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is there a toy store near here?
Yes, I think there is. Do you like cars?
I want to find the bakery.
I am not sure where it is. Do you like cake?
Is the park open today?
Yes, it is always open. Is it sunny outside?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel sad working at home. I miss my friends.
It can be lonely, yes. What is your favorite part of your day?
I like reading. But I feel stuck in my room. Do you have a tip?
Try opening a window for fresh air. Do you like walking outside?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am at the top of the lighthouse and I feel very lost.
That is a tall place to be. Do you like the view?
It is scary, but the lights are beautiful.
The light helps boats stay safe. Can you see any boats?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw the moon tonight and I feel so glad.
That is a lovely feeling. What color did it look?
It looked bright white and round. Do you like the moon?
I find the quiet night sky very peaceful. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need to try on shoes before we buy them?
Shoes must fit well so your feet do not hurt. Do you have a favorite color?
Why does the size matter so much if they look the same?
Feet are all shaped a bit differently, so one size is not always right. Do you like red ones?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees in the fall?
The tree gets ready for winter and lets go of its leaves. Do you like walking on them?
Yes, I do, but is it bad for the tree?
No, it is not bad. The tree saves energy to grow new leaves next spring.
That is good to know. Why do they change color first?
The green fades to show the orange and red. Do you see any yellow leaves?
I see a lot of brown ones on the ground.
Brown happens when the leaves dry out after falling. I do not know why each one picks a different shade.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is there a fire in the trees?
The sun was very hot all day. It dried out the grass. Did you see smoke?
Yes, the smoke is big and dark.
The wind is pushing it up. It is not coming to you. Are you warm?
I feel hot, but I am safe.
Good, stay near the water. Do not go close to the flames.
When will it stop?
I do not know when it will stop. The rain will help soon. Are you thirsty?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My back hurts from lifting the big box.
Ouch, that sounds heavy. Did you take a break?
Yes, I sat on a stack of plates.
That is a risky spot to sit. Do you have a friend to help?
No, my friend is still at work.
I am sorry you are alone. I do not know how to fix a sore back.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so late. I feel bad.
It is okay to feel that way. Did you try your best?
The bus was slow. I ran to get here.
Running is hard work. Are you tired now?
Yes, I am tired. Can we start now?
We can start right away. Let's go.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The path looks long and I am tired.
That is okay to feel. Do you want to sit on a bench?
Yes, I would like a break.
That sounds nice. Are your feet hurting?
A little bit. What should I do now?
I do not know your body. Can you keep walking slowly?
I think I can.
Good for you. Is the air cold today?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I met my old friend at the park today.
That sounds like a nice day. What did you do together?
We just sat on a bench and looked at the trees.
You look so relaxed. Did you bring any snacks?
Yes, I had a big apple to share.
That is a sweet thing to do. Did you talk a lot?
We talked about old times and laughed a lot.
It is good to see you happy. How did the day end?
We walked home slowly and felt very calm.
That is a perfect ending. I am glad for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are the clouds white?
They are made of tiny water drops. Do you like to look up at the sky?
Yes! But why do some look gray?
That means they have a lot of rain in them. Do you like rain or sun?
I like the sun because it is warm.
Me too, the sun makes everything dry and bright.
Can a cloud make lightning?
Yes, sometimes clouds make loud thunder and light.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so busy. Do bears hibernate?
Yes, they sleep to save energy. Do you like bears?
I cannot wait. Is a shark a fish?
Yes, it is a big fish in the sea. What do you do next?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to collect shells from the beach. Do you know how I start?
Yes, you look for smooth stones and shells on the sand. Do you like smooth or rough shells?
I like the smooth ones. What do I do with them once I pick them up?
You wash them gently with water and let them dry in the sun. Do you have a box to put them in?
I have a big box. How do I keep them safe?
You can put them in a dry, dark place so they do not break. Do you like to draw pictures of your new finds?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What makes the wind?
Moving air makes wind. Do you feel it on your face?
It is very cold today.
Cold air is heavy and moves fast. How does that make you feel?
I want to go outside.
That sounds like fun. Do not forget your coat.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to start.
Let us do one room first. Is your floor very dirty?
Yes, it has a lot of dust.
Please sweep the floor first.
I have a broom.
Great. Sweep the dust into a pile.
What do I do with the pile?
Put it in a bag. Do you have a bag nearby?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I like sweet things but I do not know which one to pick.
That is a hard choice. Do you like warm bread or cold cake?
I think I want something warm. What is good here?
The fresh pastries are lovely and hot. Do you like chocolate?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I promised to help my friend, but I want to play. What should I do?
You should keep your word. Do you feel sad about it?
Yes, I feel bad. I want to play now, not help.
That is a tough choice. Who do you trust more?
I trust my friend a lot. But I like playing too.
Think about what makes you happy. What is better for you?
I think helping him makes me happy in the end.
That is a good thought. Are you ready to help?
Yes, I will help him now. Thank you for the help.
You are doing a good thing. Good luck with your friend.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my part in the play is very small.
I am sorry you feel that way. What is your part?
I just have to hold a tree branch on the side.
That sounds boring. Do you know how to make it fun?
No, I do not know what to do.
Try moving the branch gently. Do you have a script?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The lights went out and I am afraid. How do I light a candle safely?
That is scary, but we can fix it. Do you have a match?
Yes, I have a box of matches. What do I do now?
Hold the candle very still. Strike the match and touch it to the wick.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I would like a pizza.
Okay. What topping do you like?
I like cheese and tomato.
That sounds good. Do you want a drink?
Yes, please. I like juice.
Great choice. Here is your order.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My boss is very nice to me.
That is good news. How do they help you most?
They listen to my problems.
Listening is a great gift. Do you feel safe to speak?
Yes, I feel free to talk.
That is wonderful. Do you tell others about them?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big boat float today. It looked heavy, but the water held it up.
That is because the ship pushes down on the water. The water pushes back to keep it up. Did you think it would sink?
Yes, I worried about it. Why does the water push back so hard?
The shape of the boat spreads the weight out. This lets it sit on top without sinking.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the bakery this morning. The smell was so sweet.
That sounds nice. Did you buy anything?
Yes, I bought a warm croissant. It broke in my hand.
Oh no, that is a mess. Did you get it all?
I got the top part. The bottom stayed on the table.
I am sorry about that. Do you like the taste?
It was good. But I feel bad about the mess.
They will clean it up. Are you hungry now?
Not really. My stomach is full.
That is good. Have a nice rest.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy. My friends came to my house for a party.
That sounds so much fun. Did you eat a big cake?
Yes, we had chocolate cake and balloons everywhere.
I bet it was sweet. Do you know what time we should start ours?
I do not know, but I think soon is good.
I agree that soon is good. I am glad you feel so happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am drawing a big red sun.
That is a nice color. What else is in your sky?
I drew some clouds.
They look fluffy. Do the clouds have eyes?
No, they do not have eyes.
I see.
I am done with the picture.
Well done. Do you want to try a tree next?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The food was cold.
That is very sad. What did you try to eat?
It was just gross soup. I want to go home.
I feel bad for you. Let us find a better spot.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am confused about how many months are in a year. Can you tell me?
There are twelve months in a year. Do you remember the name of the current month?
I do not know the name of the month right now.
That is okay, you can check a calendar. Do you have a favorite time of the year?
Yes, I love summer.
Summer has three warm months. Do you want to learn their names?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make my phone take pictures.
You tap the camera app on the screen. Do you know where your camera app is?
I see a red circle with a black dot.
That is the right app. Tap it and press the round button to take a photo. Is your battery full?
Yes, the battery is full.
Great. Now hold the phone steady when you press the button. Did the picture look good to you?
Yes, it looks very good.
Well done. You can find the pictures in your photo album later. Do you want to try taking another one?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a tall lighthouse today and it made me so happy.
That is wonderful. What color is the light?
The light is bright white and shines far out to sea.
Nice. Do you like to look at the ocean?
Yes, I do. It feels so calm when I watch the waves.
That sounds peaceful. I have never been near the sea.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does snow stick to the ground?
It sticks because it is cold. Do you like to build snowmen?
Yes, I do. Why is snow white?
Ice crystals scatter light. Do you have a sled?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I took a big train today and saw a sheep.
That is so cool! Was the sheep eating?
Yes, it was eating a tall plant.
How happy are you feeling right now?
Very happy, my face hurts from smiling.
That sounds like a great day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have some extra cash but I do not know where to put it.
That is good to see. Do you have a clear goal for this money?
I just want it to grow, but I feel lost.
You can start by setting a small, safe goal. Do you know what that goal is?
I am not sure if I am doing the right thing.
It is fine to feel unsure. Start small to learn what works for you.
Maybe I should just put it in a jar at home.
A jar is a good start for saving. Do you like the idea of using a jar?
Yes, that sounds easy and true.
Then start with the jar today. You are doing great.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a strong magnet and a paperclip. I am not sure what to do with them.
Try holding the magnet near the paperclip to see if it sticks. Do you want to see how it moves?
It moved! But now I do not know how to stop it from sticking.
Just move the magnet away slowly and the paperclip will fall. Does it feel easy or hard?
It is a bit hard. Can you tell me why it happens?
I do not know the exact science, but the magnet pulls on the metal. Are you having fun with this?
Yes, I think I get it now. Thank you for helping me understand.
You are welcome. I am glad it worked out for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can you show me the big blue part on this map?
Yes, that is the ocean. Do you see the little islands?
I see two small dots. Are those islands?
Yes, they are islands. Do you want to visit them?
Maybe later. Where is my house?
It is that red dot near the top. You found it well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My teacher looks very sad. What can I do to help?
That is very kind of you. Are you her best friend?
Yes, we sit next to each other. How can I make her smile?
Tell her you are happy to be in her class. A kind word is a great gift.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to make a nice salad.
That is a great idea. Do you have any vegetables in your fridge?
Yes, I have lettuce, carrots, and tomatoes.
You can chop them into small pieces. Would you like a sauce recipe?
Yes, please.
Just mix oil, vinegar, and a pinch of salt. Do you have a bowl?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to send this letter today. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help. Is it for someone close to you?
No, it is for work. I am very late.
Okay, let us go fast. Do you have a stamp?
Yes, I have a stamp. Where do I put it?
Put it on the top right. Do you know where the window is?
No, I do not know. Please show me.
Follow me to the front. Is your bag heavy?
Yes, it is heavy. Thank you for helping.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride my bike without training wheels.
That is a big goal. Do you have a safe place to practice?
Yes, my big brother says the park is empty in the morning.
You should hold the handlebars tight and look forward, not at your feet.
What do I do if I feel like I am going to fall?
Try to lean into the turn slowly. Do you have a helmet on?
Yes, I always wear my red one when I ride.
That is very smart. Keep your body relaxed and trust your legs.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing on this street. It is very quiet. I do not know where to go.
That is okay. Do you like the sound of the wind?
I do not know. The wind is soft. I just want to leave.
You can walk down the hill. It is a safe path.
The hill is steep. I am tired. What should I do?
Sit on the bench by the tree. Rest your feet for a bit.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel so mad when things take a long time.
It is hard to wait, but your heart will feel calm. Do you like to look at a flower grow?
Yes, I like to see the colors change.
Waiting is like watching that flower open.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a bug on my table and I do not know what to do with it.
That can be scary, but it is just a small bug. Do you know what kind it is?
I do not know, and I am afraid it might bite me.
Most bugs will not bite you if you leave them alone. Is it moving fast or slow?
It is moving very fast and I want to get it out of my room.
You can gently pick it up with a piece of paper and take it outside.
I tried the paper but it is too slippery for me.
You can use a glass and a piece of cardboard to trap it. Did that work for you?
Yes, I did that and now it is in the garden.
That is a safe place for it to live. Are you feeling better now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I got a job helping my mom in her shop.
That sounds like fun. Do you like it there?
Yes, I get to count coins and talk to people.
Counting coins is a good start for learning.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the code now. The door is locked.
Take a breath. What letters do you see on the wheel?
It says "THINK". The numbers are 1, 2, 3.
That is a clue. Try turning the wheel to the first letter.
It clicks. Can I go?
Yes, you did great. Would you like to open it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big gray cloud today. It looked like a sleeping dog.
That sounds like a fun picture. Was it raining?
No, it just sat there in the sky. I waved at it.
Waving is a nice thing to do. Do you like the sky?
I do. I think it is a big soft blanket.
That is a very warm idea. I agree.
Now I am going to bed to dream of clouds.
Good night. Sweet dreams.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see the sun in the sky. Is it a giant fire?
It is a ball of hot gas. Do you like hot things?
No, I like ice cream. The sun feels too warm.
That is good to know. It is very far away.
Then why does it make me hot?
Its light travels to us. Can you feel the wind today?
Yes, it is cool now. Does the sun stop shining?
It shines every day. It goes behind the mountains at night.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am trying to count the apples, but I keep getting a new number each time.
That is tricky. Do you see any apples hiding in the basket?
I looked, but I still do not know the right number.
Start with one and point to each apple as you say its number.
I tried that, but the red apple makes me confused.
Ah, that must be a hard choice. Do you want to count only the red ones first?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a tough morning with too much coffee.
That is not good. Did you drink water?
Yes, but I still feel jumpy. I need to switch to tea now.
Tea is a gentle choice. What kind do you like?
I like the green kind with a little lemon.
That sounds nice and fresh. Have a good rest.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am very scared of the big test tomorrow.
That is normal to feel nervous. Do you think you studied hard enough?
I read the book twice but I still feel fuzzy.
Reading twice is a great start. What part feels the most confusing to you?
The part about the math numbers.
Math can be tricky sometimes. Did you try doing some practice problems?
No, I was too busy playing outside.
Playing is good for your brain. Let us look at the math together now, okay?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need new shoes for my feet.
Nice! What do you plan to wear them with?
I want to run in the park every day.
Running needs good grip. Do you like bright colors?
I like red, but I am not sure if that is good.
Red is a great pick for energy. Are you looking for a specific size?
I am a size ten, I think.
That is a common size. Do you want help finding a store?
Yes, please tell me where to look.
I do not know your city, so I cannot point to a map. Do you have a phone?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it going to rain today?
I think the sky looks cloudy. Do you like rain?
No, I want to play outside.
The sun may come out later. Let us check again soon.
Is it cold right now?
It feels a bit cool outside. Did you wear a jacket?
Yes, I am all dressed up.
Great, you will be warm. Have fun playing.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to take a good picture.
Start by pointing the camera at the bright part. Do you have your camera with you?
Yes, but the picture looks blurry.
Hold your hand still to stop the shake.
The light is too dark inside.
You can make the screen brighter. Would you like to go outside?
I think I will go into the garden.
That is a great choice for good light.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My story has no end.
That is hard. Do you want the hero to win?
I want them to learn something.
Teaching is good. What should they learn?
I want them to be brave.
Bravery is nice. Who helps them?
A dog helps them.
Dogs are loyal. What is their name?
I will name him Spot.
That fits well. Write it down.
