talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just heard a new song and I feel so good about it.
That is wonderful news. What kind of song is it?
It is a happy pop song with a very catchy tune.
I am glad you like it. Do you listen to it often?
Yes, I play it every day when I wake up.
That sounds like a great start to the day. Do you know who sings it?
I do not know the name, but I love the voice.
I will be happy to help you find it if you tell me a few words.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a package, but I do not know where to put it.
Is it small like a book? I can help you find the right counter.
Yes, it is small. Do I go to the front?
You go to the long line on the left. Are you in a hurry today?
I am late, so yes, I am in a big rush.
The express window is next to you. Please walk to that line now.
Okay, I will go there. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to walk in the park. Where should I start?
The big gate is a good start. Do you like quiet spots or loud ones?
I like quiet spots. What paths are calm there?
The path by the lake is very calm. Do you have a water bottle with you?
Yes, I have a bottle. Is the path easy to walk on?
The path is flat and smooth. You will enjoy it there.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go camping with my dad.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What is your favorite thing about sleeping outside?
I like seeing the stars.
The stars look very bright up there. Do you know how to find the moon?
Yes, it is big and round.
The moon helps us see at night. What food do you want to pack?
I want to bring a big apple.
Apples are crisp and sweet. Do you like eating food near a fire?
I like hot dogs.
Hot dogs taste great when cooked. Are you nervous about seeing wild animals?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is very strong. I do not know what to do.
Maybe you can close your window. Is it cold outside?
It is not cold. But the papers are flying away.
You can put a heavy book on them. Do you have a book nearby?
Yes, I have one. I will use it.
That is a good idea. Enjoy your day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I stick a paper clip to my fridge?
Put a magnet on the fridge first. Do you have a magnet?
Yes, I do. Now what?
Place the magnet on the door. Then put the paper clip near it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My head feels like a big, hot stone. I do not like this.
That sounds really yucky. Is your forehead hot?
Yes, it is very warm and fuzzy. I want to go to sleep now.
Resting helps your body fix itself. Do you want some cool water?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my grandpa. I do not know what to say.
That is a nice thing to do. Do you want to tell him about your school day?
Yes, I went to the park and played on the swings. Should I mention that?
Yes, he will love to hear that. Do you need help writing the start of the letter?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to save my file, but I do not know how.
Click the little floppy disk icon at the top. Is it a picture file?
Yes, it is a drawing. I clicked, but nothing happened.
Try pressing the S key on your keyboard. Do you see a window open?
No, it is still closed. I am confused.
Look for a triangle with a line in the middle. Did that help you?
The paper opened, but I do not see a box to name it.
Click the small arrow next to the disk icon. What is in the white box?
I see the name box now. I typed my name and clicked save.
Great work. Do you want to learn how to delete it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do sailors look so cool?
They like the sea and the wind. Do you like the ocean?
Yes, but why do they sing?
I do not know for sure. But I think they like to be happy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I kick the ball into the net?
Kick it hard with the side of your foot. Do you like big goals?
I tried that last week, but I missed.
That is hard at first. Practice makes you better. Are you going to play again?
Yes, my friend is coming to the park.
That sounds fun. Bring your favorite shoes. Do you have good shoes?
I only have my sandals on.
You should not kick in sandals. They can hurt your feet. I do not know if they will break.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make bread, but I do not know how to start.
You need flour, water, and yeast. Do you have all of these things?
Yes, I have them. What do I do next?
Mix them into a soft ball and let it sit. Is your kitchen warm enough?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Bees make honey and I am so happy to tell you.
That is a sweet thought. Do you know where they put it?
They put it in a hive made of wax.
Right, they store it in honeycomb cells. What do the bees eat to make it?
They drink sweet juice from flowers.
Yes, that sweet juice is called nectar. Do you have any honey right now?
I have a jar on the table.
Yum, it must taste very sweet.
I want to give some to my friend.
That is a very kind thing to do. I hope they enjoy it too.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. The water in the lake looks dirty.
That sounds bad. What makes you think it is dirty?
There is trash floating there.
I am sorry to hear that. We can pick it up together.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is my blanket?
It is on the sofa. Do you have sandwiches?
Yes, I have them. Is the sun out?
Yes, it is bright. I hope you enjoy the food.
I must go now. Bye.
Bye. Do not run in the grass.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is so warm on my face today.
That sounds like a happy feeling. Do you like the sand?
Yes, the sand is soft and cool.
Soft sand is nice to walk on.
The water is blue and clear.
Blue water looks very pretty. Can you swim?
I can swim a little bit.
That is good to know. Is it safe to swim here?
Yes, there is a sign that says it is safe.
Good. You should stay near the shore.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does water feel cool?
It pulls heat from your skin. Do you like the cold?
Yes, but why do I float?
Your body is lighter than water. Do you jump in?
I try to kick. Why is the water wet?
Water is always wet. It is its nature.
What is under the pool?
I do not know your pool. Is it deep?
It is blue. Why is it blue?
The light makes it look that way. Do you swim alone?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the meeting today?
We need to pick the color for our room. Do you like blue?
Yes, I do. Why did you pick this time?
It is when everyone is free. Is that a good time for you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you keep all those old shells?
I like how the wind sings through them. Do you like to listen to the wind?
Why do the songs stop when they dry out?
I do not know for sure, but maybe they need water to be full of sound. Do you want to try one?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I fell down on the court.
ouch, that must hurt. are you okay?
yes, but I can't hit the ball.
practice makes perfect. do you have a coach?
my dad holds the racket.
that sounds like fun. where is the ball going?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like this new song a lot. What do you think?
It sounds happy to me. What makes you like it?
The drums go boom boom really fast. Does that sound good to you?
Yes, it keeps me tapping my foot. Are you trying to dance?
I just want to know if it is a good song. How do I know?
If it makes you feel good, it is good for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a robot pick up my dropped toy today.
That is very helpful. Did the robot say anything to you?
No, it just did a small dance.
How fun that must have been.
Then it asked for a cookie.
I am not sure if robots can eat cookies. Do you know why it asked?
I gave it one anyway and it looked happy.
That sounds like a nice story.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I cannot find any birds today.
That is a shame. Do you usually see them in the morning?
Yes, there are always many sparrows by the tree.
The wind might have moved them away. Have you checked behind the big bush?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like kicking the ball with my big toe.
That is a fun way to play. Do you kick it far or close?
I am not sure, but I want to be a star.
Being kind helps you be a star. Do you have a favorite player?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look up! There is a rainbow.
Wow, it is so pretty. Do you see all the colors?
Yes, red, orange, and yellow.
That is wonderful. Do you like the blue part best?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad today and I do not know why.
I am sorry you feel this way. Are you hungry?
No, I just feel empty inside.
That can be hard to fix fast. Do you have a friend to talk to?
Yes, but they are busy with school.
Sometimes waiting is tough. Would a warm drink help?
Maybe, but I am not sure what to do.
I do not know your exact problem. Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired from my test today.
That sounds hard. Did you finish it?
Yes, but I did not like the last part.
I am sorry. What did you do after?
I took a long nap in my room.
Rest is good. How do you feel now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I have a test in an hour, but I cannot read the clock. I feel so bad.
Take a deep breath. It is just a set of numbers. Do you know how to count?
Yes, I can count, but I do not like waiting. It is hard to sit still.
You are doing a good job. Let us watch the big hand move. What number is it on now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot find my book and I am so sad.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you remember the color of the cover?
It was blue, but I have lost it.
That is a hard thing to lose. Are you ready to look for it again?
Yes, but I do not know where to start.
Let us ask the librarian for help.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my new friend smiling so much?
She is happy to see you. Do you like it when people smile?
Why does she keep looking at the trees?
She loves nature and fresh air. Do you like trees too?
Why did she bring a red balloon?
I do not know why she brought that. Is it your favorite color?
Why is she sitting so close to me?
She wants to feel close to her friends. Do you feel comfortable?
Why did she give me a small stone?
She found it and thought of you. Do you want to keep it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to have a big party in my room.
That sounds like so much fun. What kind of snacks do you want?
I want lots of cookies and juice.
Yum, those are great choices. Will you play games with your friends?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because my friend ate my snack.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you share the snack with him?
No, I forgot to give him any.
I see. Would you like to talk about how to fix this?
Yes, but I do not want to lose my snack.
I do not know the best fix. Can you tell me what he did?
He took it without asking.
That is not nice. Do you think he was just hungry?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I cannot sleep but I do not know what to read.
That is tricky. Do you like stories with happy endings?
Yes, I like happy endings, but I have no books here.
You can read a story from your memory. Does one make you feel warm?
I remember one about a cat, but it is hard to recall.
Start with the first word you see in your mind. It often helps.
The first word is cat. Now I see the rest of the story.
You are doing well. Did that help you feel calm?
Yes, it did. I think I am ready to sleep now.
Good night.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a secret. I bought you a gift. Should I tell you?
That is kind. What is in the box?
It is for your birthday. I hid it under the bed.
Nice work. Do you like the color?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have two broken stems. What should I do with them?
Put them in some water. Do you have a small cup?
I do not know if they will grow back.
They might not grow back. Can you cut the ends off?
I will try to cut them.
That is a good plan. I hope they heal.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see a lighthouse. How do I get there?
The sea is usually the best path. Do you have a boat?
No, I only have my feet and a map.
That is hard work, but very doable. Is the road near you?
It is a long walk from my house to the water.
You must rest often to keep going. Do you bring water?
Yes, I have a big jug of cold water.
That is very wise. Go for it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people like to sing?
It makes them feel happy and free. Do you like happy feelings?
Yes, I do. Why does my voice sound so quiet?
Your muscles are still learning the trick. Are you taking deep breaths?
I am trying hard. Can singing make me strong?
Not like lifting weights, but it helps your lungs. Do you run a lot?
I run sometimes. Why is the high note so hard?
High notes need more air power. Did you warm up first?
I did not know that. What should I do next?
Keep practicing slowly and with joy. I do not know your exact next step.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do plants drink water?
Roots pull water up from the dirt to feed the leaves. Do you like drinking water?
Yes, I do. How does the water move?
Tiny tubes in the stems push it up like a straw. Have you seen a plant grow?
A little bit. Does it stop when there is no sun?
Not quite, but the sun helps pull the water up. Do you water your plants?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a bad cold and I must leave now.
That sounds awful. Do you have any medicine with you?
No time for pills. I am late for work.
Please rest your throat. Is it very cold outside today?
It is freezing. I will just grab a coffee.
Warm drinks help. Do you feel dizzy?
A bit. But I am almost out the door.
Please take care. Do you have a warm coat on?
Yes, I am all set. Bye.
You will feel better soon. I hope so.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love singing so much right now!
That is great! Do you sing in the shower?
Yes, I do. It feels like magic.
Magic is a lovely word. What song do you like best?
I like songs with happy words.
Happy words make people smile. Do you sing to your friends?
Sometimes I do. I feel very brave.
Bravery is a strong thing. Do you feel your heart beat fast?
Yes, but it is a good kind of fast.
Good and true. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love chess!
That is great! Do you like moving the king?
Yes, the king is safe.
Safety is good. Do you try to catch the queen?
I try to win fast.
Winning feels good. Do you play with friends?
Yes, I play at school.
School is a good place. Do you like to think?
I think a lot about moves.
Thinking helps you see the board.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am going to the doctor today and I feel very good about it.
That is a happy thought. Do you like seeing your doctor?
Yes, I like feeling safe and taking care of my body.
That is a smart way to feel. What is your favorite healthy snack?
I love apples and I think they make my teeth strong.
Apples are a great choice for teeth.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off the trees in autumn?
They fall to help the tree save water for winter. Do you like looking at red leaves?
Yes, I do. What happens next?
The tree sleeps until spring brings rain. Do you think trees like the cold?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to wash my clothes right now.
Do you have hot or cold water?
The machine is full of old trash.
Take out the trash first. Do you know which button to press?
I do not know the button.
Press the small white circle. That starts the wash.
Is it done yet?
No, it takes an hour.
I am very late for work.
Put on dry clothes. Do you have any dry shirts?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see smoke coming from the kitchen. What do I do?
Stay calm and go to the back door. Is the door warm to the touch?
It feels cold, but the room is full of gray fog. Where do I go?
Go outside and stay there. Do you have your phone with you?
Yes, I have it, but my hands are shaking. I do not know who to call.
Call the fire number right now. I do not know the local code, so dial the emergency number.
I am calling, but the line is busy. I feel so scared.
Take a deep breath and try again. Are you safe outside now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend, but I do not know where to start.
Hello. That sounds like a fun task. Do you know what you want to say?
I want to tell him about my new dog, but the paper is blank.
Start with a friendly word like "Dear." How does the dog feel today?
He is very happy and likes to play in the yard.
Good start. Keep your sentences short and sweet. Is there anything else you want to share?
No, just that. Do I need to do anything else?
Yes, close with a warm word like "Your friend." You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. My screen is black.
That is sad. Did you press the power button?
Yes. It makes a loud buzz and then stops.
That is strange. Do you see any lights on it?
No lights. Just the buzzing sound.
I do not know the fix. Is the plug in the wall?
The plug is loose. I will try to push it in.
Good idea. Does it work now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do our neighbors come over so often?
They like to talk and share news. Do you think they are lonely?
I do not know. Why do they bring food?
It is a kind way to say hello.
Why do they wave from the window?
It shows they are happy to see us. Do you wave back?
Yes, I do. Why do they sometimes look sad?
I do not know why they look sad.
Why do they stop talking when I look at them?
They may be shy. Do you want to say hi?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up with a scratchy throat and a runny nose. It was a very bad day.
I am sorry you are not feeling well. Did you drink any warm tea?
I tried to go for a walk, but I felt too tired to move my legs.
Rest is the best medicine. Do you have any soup to eat?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a secret for you?
Wrap it in paper, but I love a clue! What did you pick?
I just bought you a gift.
That is very kind. Do you want help wrapping it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate a big bowl of soup and a slice of bread for lunch today.
That sounds very nice. Do you like drinking hot soup?
Yes, it is good, but I am still a bit hungry in the afternoon.
A small snack can help. Do you prefer fruit or nuts?
I think I will eat an apple because it is crisp and sweet.
An apple is a great choice. Enjoy your treat.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very happy today. How do I keep this good feeling?
That is a wonderful thing. What made you smile this morning?
I do not know for sure. It just feels right.
That is okay. Try to sit still and breathe slowly.
Does sitting still really help?
Yes, it helps you see the good things around you. Do you have a favorite spot to sit?
I love my small garden. Should I do something there?
That is a great idea. Maybe you can just look at the flowers.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to ride my bike, but I am afraid.
Do not worry. Falling is part of learning. Are your feet on the ground?
Yes, my feet can reach the dirt.
Good. Try to sit tall and look far ahead. Do you feel the handlebars?
They feel a bit wobbly.
That is normal at first. Keep your hands relaxed. Is your back straight?
I think so, but my arms are tired.
Rest your arms in small pauses. Do you need a drink of water?
Yes, that sounds good.
Take a sip and then try again. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to count to ten fast. Can you help?
Sure, start at one. Are you running a race?
No, I am just late.
Go ahead, take your time.
One, two, three, four.
Good start. Do you know what comes after four?
Five, six, seven.
Yes, you are doing well.
Eight, nine, ten! I made it.
Great job. How do you feel now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I build a sand castle?
Dig a hole for the base and fill it with wet sand. Do you like tall towers?
Yes, I want a big tower.
Stack the blocks one by one and press them down. Are you going to add a gate?
I will add a little door.
Use a stick to shape the door. Is the sand very dry?
It feels a bit dry.
Add some water slowly to make it stick. Have you finished the top?
I am almost done with the top.
That sounds like a great day at the beach. Do you want to decorate it next?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a small house with no door.
That is a mystery. Do you know who lives inside?
I think it is just a shed for tools.
That makes sense. Would you like to go inside and check?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to put in seeds?
You put in seeds so they can grow into plants. Do you like carrots?
Yes, I do. Why do I need to give them water?
Plants need water to stay alive. How much rain did we get last week?
Some, I think. Why do they need light?
Sunlight gives them energy to make food. I do not know exactly how much they need.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the lake fast. Can you tell me the way?
Go straight down that path. Is it a long walk for you?
I am running because I am late. Do you know how far it is?
I think it is about a mile. Are you taking a boat?
No, I am just walking. Is the water clean there?
Yes, the water is clear and safe. Do you like fishing?
I must go now. Thank you for your help.
Good luck on your trip. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a fire in the dark. How do I do that?
Use a magnifying glass to focus the sun. Do you have one with you?
No, I do not. Can I use two sticks instead?
Yes, rub them fast to make heat. Are your hands dry?
My hands are wet. What should I do then?
I do not know a way to start a fire with wet hands. Have you found a dry spot?
Yes, I found dry leaves. Can I start now?
Start with small twigs, then add leaves. Tell me if it catches.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad today and I do not know why. Can you help me?
That feels bad, but you are not alone. Do you want to talk about what is on your mind?
I am worried about a test coming up soon and it makes me feel low. What should I do?
Taking a slow breath can help your body feel calm. Have you taken a small break to rest your eyes?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to send a letter. How do I do that?
Put your letter in a white envelope. Do you have a stamp?
No, I do not have a stamp. Where can I get one?
You can buy them right here at this counter. Do you like the blue ones?
Yes, the blue ones are nice. How much do they cost?
They cost one dollar each. I hope your letter arrives fast.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not get why the big ship stays up on the water.
The ship pushes water down, and the water pushes back up. Do you feel that push?
I feel the water when I splash, but not the push back.
That push is strong enough to hold the ship up. Have you ever tried pushing on a wall?
Yes, the wall does not move at all.
The water moves a little, but it still pushes hard. Do you think air pushes back too?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I start a fire on the beach?
You can use two dry sticks. Do you have any flint with you?
I have a spoon and a piece of cloth.
You can rub the cloth with the spoon to make heat. Is the wood very dry?
Yes, it is dry.
Good. You need dry wood to start a fire.
I will try to rub the wood fast.
That is the right idea. Do not give up if it takes time.
Okay, I will keep trying.
Great. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: How do plants drink? I am late!
They use roots to pull water up. Do you like plants?
Just tell me the quick part.
Tiny tubes move the water to the leaves.
Okay, that helps. Thanks.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to buy for the new baby.
I do not know your list, but do you have any gifts ready?
I have a hat, but I think it is too big.
A hat is a good start. Is the baby coming soon?
Yes, next week, and I am very scared.
It is normal to feel scared. Have you packed your bag?
Not yet, I do not know what to pack.
I can help with that. What do you have?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the river move?
It flows because the water is heavy and slides down. Do you like watching it go?
Yes, I love it. Why is the water wet?
I do not know for sure why it is wet. But I am sure it feels cool on your hands.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big surprise to tell you.
That sounds exciting. What is it?
I am going to the zoo tomorrow.
A zoo is fun. Do you love tigers?
I want to see the pandas.
Pandas are cute. You will have a great day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to start making pots, but I am not sure where to begin.
You need clay, water, and lots of patience. Do you like working with your hands?
I do. What should I buy first?
I am not sure of the best brand for you, but any basic kit works. What color is your favorite?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent all day trying to mix the perfect blue.
That sounds like a fun task. Did you find the right shade?
I almost did, but I made it too dark.
Oh no, that can be tricky. What color did you add next?
I added a lot of white to fix it.
That is a good plan. Does the wall look nice now?
It looks bright and happy.
I am glad you like it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Why do leaves fall? I have to go!
Trees lose them to save energy in winter. Do you like autumn?
I don't care about weather. Just explain the science.
It is like a tree shedding its "hands" to rest. Do you have time for a walk?
No, I am late. What causes the color change?
It is special juices that appear when it cools down. Do you like red?
Yes, I love red. Now let me leave.
Okay, run safely. Enjoy the colors!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is that a big red ball?
Yes, it is a big red ball. Do you want to play with it?
The store is closed.
I think the door is locked. Did you try to open it?
I do not know where the toy is.
I do not know where the toy is. Can we look together?
My shoe hurts.
That sounds bad. Do you want to sit down for a bit?
I am happy now.
I am glad to hear that. Do you want to go home?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my toy car at the store.
That feels bad. Did you look on the floor?
Yes, but it is not there.
Maybe the helper moved it. Do you remember which aisle?
I do not know. I am so mad.
It is okay to be mad. Let us ask the store staff together.
Okay, I will try again.
Good luck. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Guess what? I have a big secret!
That sounds fun! What is it?
I got a puppy!
Oh no, I do not know which kind of dog it is, but that is nice!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sand is warm and the waves are loud.
That sounds very fun. Do you like the cold water?
Yes, it wakes me up nicely.
I have never been to the sea. What do you see?
I see blue water and white shells.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love bananas. I need to go now.
Bananas are great. Do you like them sweet?
Yes, very sweet. Hurry up, please.
I am ready to help. What do you need?
Just a tip for a snack. I am late.
Eat one for energy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I drank a hot cup of coffee this morning. It woke me up fast.
Coffee is good for mornings. Do you like it sweet?
Yes, I put two spoons of sugar in it. Then I went for a short walk.
That sounds nice. Did you see any birds on your walk?
I saw one blue bird on a branch. It looked very happy in the sun.
Blue birds are pretty. I do not know where they live.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I put a boat in the water and it stays up. Why does the water not make it sink?
The boat pushes the water down, so the water pushes it back up. Do you have a big boat or a small boat?
It is a big boat, but it is full of air. The wooden part is light.
That is right. The air inside helps it float because it is very light. Is the boat made of wood?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to pick for my party.
That can feel hard. Do you like sweet food or salty food?
I like both, but I am still stuck.
I am not sure which is best for you.
Can you just say yes to cake?
Yes, cake is a great choice.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to walk in the park but I am tired.
Take a slow step and breathe deep. Do you have water with you?
Yes, I have a bottle.
Good. Drink a little and rest if you need to. Is the path flat today?
It is flat and easy.
Great. You can stop often. Do you like the trees?
Yes, I like the trees.
Look at the leaves move. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Can you tell me how to make a perfect sandwich?
Yes, I can help. What is your favorite filling?
I like ham and cheese. What should I do first?
Start by picking two slices of bread. Do you prefer white or wheat?
I like white bread. Then what?
Put the meat and cheese in the middle. Is that all you need?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the water in the harbour deep?
Yes, it is very deep for boats. Do you like to swim there?
No, I only watch the ships.
That is fun. Ships are big and heavy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sky is so bright tonight.
Yes, the stars are very pretty. Do you see any falling stars?
I tried to find my lost dog all day.
That must be tiring. Is he safe now?
I only found a red sock by the tree.
That is a funny thing to find. Did you bring it home?
The air feels cool and quiet here.
It is a nice night to sit and rest.
I feel a bit sleepy now.
Go to bed soon, friend.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My horse kicked the door shut and now I am very sad.
That sounds scary. Is the horse hurt?
No, he is fine, but I am scared of him now.
It is okay to be scared. Did he kick you?
Yes, right on my hand.
I am sorry your hand hurts. Do you want to go inside?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to write a song but I am stuck.
That feels hard. What is the song about?
I do not know. It is about my day.
Your day is a good start. Did you do something fun?
I only sat in my chair all day.
Even quiet days can make a song. Do you feel sad or calm?
I feel calm. I just do not know how to end it.
A soft ending is nice. Do you want to try one word?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: It is so hot today. I want ice cream.
The sun is very strong right now. Do you have a drink with you?
Yes, I have water. But I am still thirsty.
Water is good for you. You can get ice cream later.
Okay. It is really hot outside.
That is true. Let us sit in the shade for a bit.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make pasta for dinner, but I am not sure how to start.
Put water in a big pot and add some salt. What kind of sauce do you like?
I like tomato sauce. I have cans in the pantry.
That is a good pick. Just heat it up and stir it well.
Do I cook the pasta first or after?
Start the pasta when the water is hot. Do you have cheese on hand?
Yes, I have shredded cheese. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Put the cheese on top when it is done.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my boat leaked a little today.
Oh no, that is bad. Is the water out now?
Yes, it is dry, but I do not like it.
Dry is good. What kind of boat is it?
It is my small blue rowboat.
Blue is a nice color. Do you have a patch for it?
I do not know where to fix the hole.
You can try glue. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sick and my throat hurts. What should I do?
Drink warm water to help your throat. Do you have a fever?
Yes, I feel hot. Is that bad?
A fever means your body is fighting the bug. It is usually safe to rest.
I am tired. I want to sleep.
Sleep is good for healing. Are you eating anything?
I do not feel hungry. Should I force myself?
No, do not force it if it makes you feel worse.
Okay. I will drink tea and rest.
That sounds like a good plan. Do you have any medicine?
Yes, my aunt gave me some pills.
Take them as the label says. Please rest well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make a salad. What should I put in it?
Start with some green leaves and a tomato. Do you like onions?
I think I do. Now I need a dressing.
Try olive oil and lemon juice. Is that enough for your taste?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so tired today, but I am very happy!
That is a nice feeling. Do you know why you are happy?
I played in the park for a long time.
That sounds like a lot of fun.
My legs hurt now because I ran so fast.
Your body needs rest to grow strong.
I will take a warm bath and go to sleep soon.
That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the soccer ball round?
Yes, it is round. Do you play soccer?
No, but I watch the big games. How many teams are on the field?
Two teams play against each other. Do you have a favorite team?
I like the team with red shirts. Where do they play?
They play in a big city. Do you live near there?
No, I live far away. Is it fun to watch?
Yes, it is very fun. Do you like to cheer?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love to draw big, wobbly houses on paper.
That sounds like so much fun. What colors do you use most?
I like to use bright red and sunny yellow.
Those are happy colors. Do you draw them at school?
Yes, I draw them in my room after dinner.
That is a nice way to relax.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I dropped my favorite cup and it broke. I feel so bad.
I am so sorry. Did you clean it up safely?
Yes, but I wanted to keep it forever. It was my grandma’s.
That is a very sad loss. Do you have another cup you like?
Not one that is as nice. I just want to cry.
It is okay to feel sad. Would you like a hug?
Yes, please. I think I am better now.
I am glad. Let us go make some tea.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My teacher is so nice, but I am scared to ask her questions.
That is a very good feeling to have. Do you like her lessons?
Yes, I do like them, but my voice gets small when I talk.
Your voice will get louder with time. What makes you feel small?
I am afraid I will sound like a fool in front of everyone.
Being a fool is not a bad thing. Do you trust her?
I trust her, but I still freeze up. What should I do?
Just try to ask one tiny thing. Do you want to try today?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to take a nice picture of my cat.
That sounds fun. Do you have a camera?
Yes, I have a phone in my hand.
Great. Is the light bright?
The sun is shining through the window.
Perfect. Try to click fast before it moves.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not know how to share my toy.
That is a big feeling. Who wants to play with you?
My friend Sam does.
That is kind of you. Do you like playing with Sam?
Yes, but I want the car back.
You can take turns. Are you ready to try?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have money, but I do not know where to put it.
A piggy bank is a safe place to start. Do you have one yet?
I do not have a pig, so I do not know what to do next.
Any small box will work fine. Why do you want to save?
I want to buy a bike, but I spend too much on candy.
Try keeping candy money in that box. Is that hard for you?
Yes, it is hard, but I will try to stop.
That is good. You are doing the right thing.
Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Keep trying.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I bumped into a friend and forgot to say sorry. What should I do now?
Do not worry, it happens to everyone. You can just say sorry when you see them again. Have you spoken to them lately?
Yes, I saw them this morning. Should I apologize then?
Yes, a simple "sorry" is always nice. It shows you care about their feelings. Do you feel better knowing that?
I think so, but I am still shy. How do I say it without feeling silly?
Just speak from your heart and keep it brief. Being kind is never silly. What is the hardest part for you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to pack my books.
That is hard. Do you have any big boxes?
I have small boxes, but my books are heavy.
That may be a problem.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel happy today.
That is nice to hear. What made you smile?
I saw a red bird.
Red birds are bright. Do you like birds?
Yes, I do.
I am glad you are happy. I do not know why you feel this way, but it sounds good.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a man drop his keys on the busy street.
That must have been a scary moment for him. Did you see who helped him?
I picked them up and gave them to him.
You were so kind to help a stranger. How did he feel when you gave them back?
He smiled big and said thank you very much.
It is a warm feeling when someone is happy. What else did you do today?
I also said sorry to my sister for touching her toys.
That was a very honest thing to do. Did she forgive you?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a bee today and it looks so busy.
Bees are very hard workers. Do you like to watch them?
Yes, I think they are cute. How do they make honey?
They use plant nectar and their own body to turn it into sweet honey. Is it sweet?
Very sweet! I want to try some.
Bees put the honey in wax cells to store it for later. Do you know where they live?
In a hive, I guess?
Yes, that is correct. Bees love to keep their homes warm and safe. Is your favorite food sweet too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My phone screen is very dark and hard to read.
Try turning up the light on the screen. Is it in night mode?
Yes, it is in night mode, but the button feels stuck.
Please do not push hard on it. Is the phone very old?
It is three years old, and I am scared to break it.
If it breaks, you can take it to a shop. Do you have a friend who knows about phones?
No, my friends are not good with machines.
I do not know your exact phone type. Can you see the brand name on the back?
I can see the name, but I will not share it with a stranger.
That is wise. I am just a helper, not your friend.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I clean a monkey's tail?
You cannot clean a wild monkey's tail. Do you want to learn how to feed one instead?
Yes, please tell me how.
You should never feed wild monkeys. Do you know why that is bad?
I do not know.
Feeding them makes them sick and they get used to people.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I told you, we are moving house tomorrow.
That is wonderful news. Are you excited?
Yes, the new home has a big yard.
A big yard sounds fun to play in. Do you like gardens?
I love them, and I painted the walls blue today.
Blue is a very nice color. Did you paint them yourself?
Yes, I did, and I am so happy right now.
That is great. Have you packed all your toys yet?
Almost, but I am tired from all the work.
You did a good job. I hope you get some rest soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up at seven when the clock showed a straight line. Then I ate breakfast at half past seven.
That is a nice start. What did you eat for breakfast?
I had toast and juice at eight. Then I walked to school at nine.
Walking is good for you. Do you like your walk to school?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to visit the big blue water. What should I bring with me?
You should bring a towel and some water. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I love jumping in. How can I keep my eyes safe?
Swimmers often wear glasses with clear fronts. Is the water warm there?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My cat is not eating.
That is a worry. Is she acting tired too?
Yes, she sleeps all day.
I do not know why. When did this start?
Two days ago.
Two days is too long. Please call a vet.
A vet? I do not have one.
I am sorry. Can you find a local clinic?
I will look now.
Good plan. Tell me if she eats again.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Today I woke up to loud music and singing from my family.
That sounds like a wonderful start. Did you open your gifts?
Yes, I got a big red bike with a shiny bell.
A red bike is a great surprise. How does it feel to ride it?
I am learning to balance but I fell into the grass once.
Falling is part of learning how to ride. Are your knees okay?
Just a little scrape, but now I feel very happy.
I am glad your day was full of joy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the water blue?
The water looks blue because it changes how light hits it. Do you like swimming in the sea?
Yes, I love it. Is the sea very deep?
Yes, it is so deep that we cannot see the bottom in many places. I do not know the exact number, but it is very big. Have you ever seen a big boat?
I have seen one once. Can people live under the water?
No, people cannot live under the water because we need air to breathe. But we can use machines to go down and look around.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to read.
That is okay. Do you like happy stories?
I like them, but I feel too tired.
Try a short tale. Is your bed ready?
Yes, but I am still not sure.
Then close your eyes. Would you like a lullaby?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go by the river now.
Is the water calm?
Yes, but I am very late.
Please look where you step. Do you have dry shoes?
My shoes are wet and cold.
Oh, that is not good.
I am sorry, I must run.
Watch your back.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My computer screen is black and I am very sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you see any lights on the box?
No, I do not see any lights at all.
That is not right for a working computer. Did you plug the wire into the wall?
Yes, I checked the wall plug twice.
Okay, that is good. Is the switch on the back set to on?
It is off, so I turned it on now.
Great, that might fix it. Did the screen light up?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I start building a shed?
First, pick a flat spot in your yard. Do you have a lawn?
Yes, I have grass.
Dig a shallow hole where the corner posts will go. Is the ground hard to dig?
It is very hard dirt.
Use a shovel to break up the soil carefully. Do you have a strong shovel?
I have a small shovel.
That might take a long time. Are you willing to wait?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the big red box now.
I do not see it. Are you looking up?
I am late. Please help me find it.
It is not on the floor. Is it behind the door?
No. I really need it.
I am sorry. I do not know where it is.
Just tell me what to do.
Try the top shelf. Do you have time to check?
Yes. I am going now.
Good luck. Is the box heavy?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a song today that makes me smile big.
That sounds fun. What does it sound like?
It has a bright melody and happy words.
I like happy songs. Do you want to sing it for me?
Yes, I can hum the tune right now.
Okay, I am ready to listen.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That sounds like fun. What do you need first?
I need a bike and a helmet. Do I have a bike?
I do not know for sure. Is your bike outside?
Yes, I think it is in the yard.
Great. Do you have a friend to help you balance?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saved some money today.
That is great. What did you do to save it?
I did not buy a candy.
That is a good choice. Do you want to buy a toy?
Yes, I want a new book.
A book is a good idea. How much does it cost?
It costs two dollars.
You have enough for it. Well done.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I burned the toast. How do I fix it?
You cannot fix burned toast. Did you watch the heat?
I forgot to turn it off. How do I keep it safe?
Watch the smoke. Is the kitchen warm?
Yes, it feels hot. I want to make bread next.
I do not know if you are ready. Do you have a timer?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so mad. My toy broke.
I am sorry. What did you do?
I tried to fix it. It failed.
That is hard. Do you have help?
No one is here. I am stuck.
I cannot fix it. Can you call someone?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is raining hard today. I do not know what to do.
That sounds messy. Do you like watching rain?
I like it, but I am bored inside.
Reading a book might help.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now. The bus trip was great.
That is wonderful news. What did you see outside the window?
I saw a big red barn and some sheep.
Sheep sound cute. Did they look friendly?
Yes, they just stood there and watched me.
I bet they liked you. It is nice to feel happy on a ride.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took a picture of a big red flower today. It had a bee on it.
That sounds like a lovely find. Did the bee stay long?
It stayed for a few seconds before it flew away. I am glad I got the shot.
A good photo is always worth the wait. What else did you do after that?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does a big ship stay on the water?
It pushes water out of the way. The water pushes back up. Do you like boats?
Yes, I do. But why does it not sink down?
The air inside makes it light. The water holds it up. Is the water cold?
Sometimes. So what makes it push up?
The weight of the ship makes it push down. The water pushes up just as hard. Do you like swimming?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel tired when I run. What should I do?
That is common. Do you rest between runs?
I usually stop and sit down.
Resting helps, but walking is good too. How far do you run?
I do not know. I just keep going.
Trying to count your steps will help. Do you have a map?
I have a map, but I am not sure how to use it.
I do not know your exact route. Do you see any signs?
I see signs, but I feel lost.
Ask someone nearby for help. Would you like to walk with me?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made bread and it got so big!
That is wonderful. How long did you let it sit?
I waited two hours in a warm spot.
The tiny bugs made bubbles. Did it smell sweet?
Yes, it smells like sweet butter.
Great job. Are you baking it now?
Yes, the oven is hot and ready.
It will taste nice. Do you want help cutting it?
No, I am happy to do it alone.
Good. Enjoy your warm treat.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
The tree drops them because it is getting cold and dark. Do you like seeing them float down?
I love it, but why does the tree let them go?
It lets them go to save energy for the winter. Does that make sense to you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My grandma has a really old watch.
That is so cool. Do you know what time it is on her watch?
I think it is two, but the hands are very slow.
Old watches can be a bit sleepy. Do you help her wind it?
Yes, I click it every night before bed.
You are very thoughtful. Does she tell you stories when you wind it?
She tells me about her big garden.
I like gardens too. Are the flowers still there now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I did a good job on my test today. I feel very happy.
That is wonderful. What did you study the most?
I studied all of it. Is it okay to feel proud?
Yes, you should be proud. You worked hard.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I can't find my bag. I feel so bad.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you leave it at home?
No, I have it with me. Where is the exit?
It is right behind you. Do you need help finding the door?
Yes, please. This place is confusing.
Walk straight and look for the green sign. Is the sign clearly visible?
I see it. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a funny movie. Do you know if it is real?
I do not know which movie you saw. What is it called?
It is about a dog who can talk.
That is not real. Dogs cannot speak words.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Today was tough but I won it.
That is great news. What did you win?
I finished a big task on time.
Well done. You must feel proud.
Yes, I am very happy about it.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am lost. I cannot find my mom.
Do not worry. I am here to help. Where did you last see her?
She was near the big red tree.
That is a good clue. Let us walk that way together.
Okay. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I will stay close to you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost and do not know what to do.
That is scary. What makes you feel lost?
I have two jobs and pick the wrong one.
I do not know the right pick for you. Which job makes you smile?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The city is so loud and full of people today. I feel very happy to be here.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like the busy streets?
Yes, I do. The lights and the cars make my heart beat fast with joy.
Wow, that is exciting. Do you have a favorite spot in the city?
I love the big park in the middle. It is green and quiet, but still part of the city buzz.
That sounds like a nice place to rest. Do you go there often?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost by the water.
The sea can be scary. Do you have a map with you?
I have no map, only hope.
Hope is a good start. I do not know your exact path.
I am so tired of guessing.
Rest for a moment first. Are you safe near the edge?
I need a clear sign to go on.
Look for a tall light. Do you see any lights far away?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not want my party.
That feels bad. What part is the hardest?
All the loud noise hurts my ears.
I hear you. Would quiet music help?
Maybe, but the cake has too much sugar.
That is a lot. Do you want a smaller slice?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy right now.
That is wonderful. What made you smile?
I saw a big rainbow today.
A rainbow is a beautiful sight.
It made me feel warm inside.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My cat sat on my shoes this morning.
That is a cute trick. Did he leave any fur?
Yes, a lot of brown fur on the white laces.
I am sorry about the cleaning. Do you have a brush ready?
I am not sure. I might use a damp cloth instead.
That sounds like a smart plan. Good luck with your trip.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My shed will not stand up.
That sounds tough. Did you use the right tools?
Yes, I checked twice. I feel like I failed.
You did not fail. Did you measure the floor?
I do not know how to measure it right.
Tell me what to look for. I will help.
The wood is just... wrong.
We will fix it. Do you have a phone?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am moving my home today.
That is a big day. Do you have a truck to help?
Yes, I have a small truck.
A small truck fits few boxes. Have you packed your toys?
I packed the toys but not the books.
Books are heavy. Did you wrap them in clothes?
I put the books in a big bag.
That is a good start. Do you know where the bed goes?
I am not sure where to put the bed.
I do not know your room size. Is it small or large?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My head hurts so bad. I have to go now.
I am sorry you feel so bad. Is your head hot to the touch?
No, but I need rest. Please let me be.
Okay, I will not hold you. I do not know for sure why it hurts.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to read in bed, but my eyes get tired.
Do you have a lamp nearby? You can try a small light for your eyes.
I do, but it still feels dry. What else can I do?
Can you blink often? Drinking water helps keep your eyes happy too.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a fishing knot?
That is a great thing to know. Do you like to go outside?
Yes, I love being near the water.
First, make a small loop in the line. Is your line red or white?
It is red.
Good. Now pull the tag end through the loop. Then wet the line and pull hard to tighten it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked by the river today.
That sounds nice. Was the water cold?
Yes, it was very cold.
I am glad you stayed warm. Did you see any birds?
I saw a duck swim by.
How cute. What color was it?
It had a blue beak.
That is a fun detail. I do not know if ducks have blue beaks, but it sounds special.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my teacher wear glasses?
She uses them to see small words better. Do you have glasses?
No, I can see fine. Does she have to wear them all day?
Yes, she needs them for class. Do you like when she reads to you?
Yes, I love stories. Is she kind to us?
Yes, she is very kind and helps everyone. Do you feel safe there?
Yes, I feel happy. Thank you for telling me.
You are welcome. I am glad you feel safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The rain came and now my tent is wet.
That is very bad. Do you have a tarp on you?
No, I forgot it at home. Now my clothes are damp and cold.
I am sorry you feel that way. Can we go inside the car to dry off?
Yes, the car is warm. I feel a bit better now, thank you.
I am glad you are warm. Did you pack enough food for us?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I just moved here. What is the best thing to do?
The park has a big slide. Do you like to run?
I do not know where the park is. How do I get there?
Walk down the hill until you see the red roof. You will not get lost.
That sounds good. Is it safe for me to go alone?
Yes, it is very safe.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the lake today. I caught two big fish.
That is great. Did you keep them?
Yes, I took them home. My cat ate one whole fish.
The cat is happy. Do you fish often?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My tummy hurts a lot. Should I go to the doctor?
Yes, you should go. Do you also feel sick?
I think so. It feels warm inside.
That is good to know. Please tell your mom or dad.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have flour and water. What do I need next?
You need yeast to make it rise. Do you have any yeast?
I see a small packet on the shelf.
That is yeast. It makes the bread soft. Is your water warm?
Yes, it feels like bath water.
That is good. Now mix it all together. Does it feel sticky?
It feels like wet sand.
That is right. Let it sit for one hour. Do you like a round shape?
I do not know what to do next.
Press the air out and shape it. Do you want to stop here?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so scared about tomorrow. My tummy hurts.
That sounds very hard. Do you know what you are afraid of?
I might fail the big test. I do not know if I am smart.
You are doing your best, which is great. Would you like to talk about it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a pizza at home, but I am not sure how.
That sounds fun! Do you have any cheese yet?
I have cheese, but how do I put the dough on the pan?
Just press it out with your hands. Would you like a recipe for the sauce?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. This line is too slow.
Taking a break is good for you. Do you have a big job waiting?
Yes, but I feel very mad right now.
Deep breaths help the heart calm down.
I will try to wait for a bit.
That is a great choice. Slow steps make you strong.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie a knot.
That is a great skill. Do you have a rope with you?
Yes, I have a blue rope.
Hold the ends in your left hand. Cross the left end over the right one.
I did that. What is next?
Now make a loop with the left end. Do you see the little circle?
I see the circle.
Put the left end under and up through the loop. You did a very good job.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to milk a cow.
You need a warm towel and a clean bucket. Do you know how to wash your hands first?
Yes, I wash my hands.
Hold the udder gently and squeeze with your thumb and fingers. Is the cow feeling calm?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, tell me why the big boat stays up.
The water pushes up hard to hold it, does that make sense?
Yes, but why does the heavy steel not sink?
The air inside makes it light enough to float, good luck!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to grow big carrots. Do I put the seeds right on top?
Yes, you put them near the top. Do you have a small pot?
I have a pot. How much water does it need?
Keep the soil damp, not wet. Do you check the soil often?
I check every day. Does the sun help the carrots grow?
Yes, they love the sun. You will do a great job!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to write a letter now. My bus leaves soon.
Take a deep breath. Who are you writing to?
It is for my grandma. I want to say I miss her.
That is a sweet idea. Just start with Dear Grandma.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My shirt is muddy. What do I do?
Put it in the tub with soap. Do you like warm or cold water?
I like warm water. Is that okay?
Yes, warm is good for most clothes. What color is your shirt?
It is blue.
Great, blue washes well. Can you put the shirt in the bag?
Yes, I put it in the bag.
You did a great job. Let us wait for it to be clean.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am looking at this big map.
That looks fun! What color is the water?
The blue parts are the water.
You see it right away. What do you see next?
There is a green mountain here.
Oh, it looks high. Do you like mountains?
Yes, I like to climb them.
Good for you. Are you done for today?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I like hot drinks, but why do I want coffee in the morning and tea at night?
Coffee helps you wake up. It makes you feel strong. Do you like how it tastes?
Yes, it is sweet. Why does tea make me feel calm instead of awake?
Tea has a part that calms your body. It is very gentle. Is it hot or cold?
It is always hot. I do not know why the colors are different.
I do not know the exact magic. I think the leaves and beans look different. Do you like black or green?
I like the brown one best. Why do you drink so much of it?
I drink it to stay warm. It is a nice habit. Do you add milk to yours?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so sorry. I lost my shoe.
That is a very big problem. Did you look in the kitchen?
No, I only looked in my room.
Okay, let us check the kitchen together.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue boat by the sea.
That sounds like a nice view. Did you talk to the sailors?
One of them waved at me and smiled.
How kind of them. Did they give you anything?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very lost in this place.
Take a deep breath. Do you see a big sign nearby?
Yes, I do. Why are there signs here?
Signs help us find our way. Do you like to read?
I do like to read. Why are we on this path?
It leads to the main road. Have you eaten lunch yet?
No, I have not. Why did I start walking here?
You wanted some fresh air. Do you know where home is?
I think I do. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Stay safe now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I feel very cold and my nose is runny.
I am sorry you feel bad. Did you sleep well?
No, I was tired but could not rest.
Rest is very good for you. Do you have soup?
Yes, my soup is warm and nice.
Warm food helps your body.
I still feel weak and slow.
That is okay. It will pass soon.
Thank you for the kind words.
I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have some apples. I want to count them, but I forget where I am.
Try tapping each apple as you say the number. Do you have many?
Yes, a lot. It gets confusing when I lose my place.
Start again from the first apple. Is it easy to see them all?
No, some are hidden under a box. I do not know the total.
Move the box away so you can see. How many do you see now?
I see three. I am still not sure if that is all.
Look again under the box. Did you find more?
Yes, I found two more. Now I think I have five.
That is five. Great job counting.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I broke a plug today and the lights went out.
Oh no, that sounds scary. Were you okay?
Yes, I was fine but the room was dark.
Good that you are safe. Did you fix the plug?
No, I do not know how to do that.
That is okay, you can ask an adult for help.
My dad came and it works again.
Great, glad it is fixed. Do you like the light back?
Yes, I like the light very much.
I am happy to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I fixed my chair today. I feel so good.
That is great work. Did you use new screws?
Yes, the old ones were all bent. My hands are tired but happy.
You did a hard job well. Does the chair feel solid now?
It is very strong. Thank you for listening to me.
I am glad to help. You should sit on it now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. My truck is already here.
Take a deep breath. You will be fine. Is it a big truck?
It is huge. And I have no tape.
That is a problem. Please run to the store. Do you have your keys?
I found tape. It took too long.
I am glad you found it. We do not know when the driver leaves.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw smoke rising from the house next door. It was dark and scary.
That sounds very frightening. Is everyone safe now?
Yes, but I felt so worried. My heart beat fast.
It is good you are safe. The firemen are there to help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw so many stars today.
That is a lovely thing. Did you lie down to watch them?
I felt very small under the sky.
Feeling small is a good sign. Do you feel safe there?
One star seemed to blink at me.
I do not know if it blinked for you. Was it bright or dim?
My day ended on a happy note.
That sounds perfect. How did you get home?
Now I can see the stars again.
The night is indeed beautiful. Do you like this view?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix this toy now.
I can help with the glue. What part is broken?
It is the small wheel.
I do not see a wheel. Is it loose?
Yes, it fell off the side.
I will hold it for you.
Thank you, I am done.
Great job. Did it work?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to pack my toys right now.
Do you want to put the cars in the box first?
No, I am running very late.
Okay. I can help you grab the blocks.
Please do, I will miss the bus.
Got them. Are they all heavy?
No, they are light.
Great. Do you have a bag for them?
Yes, here is the bag.
I am done. Good luck on your trip.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. I did not sleep well last night.
That is a hard feeling. Do you want some warm soup?
My stomach hurts. I do not want to eat much.
That is true. Do you want a small piece of toast?
I just want my bed back. The day is so long.
Rest is good. Can I bring you some water?
Thank you. I feel a bit better now.
I am glad. Do you want to read a book?
Yes, please. That sounds nice.
Good. I will go find you one now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck on my move.
What piece is in front of you?
My knight. It looks lost.
Try moving it to the open square. Do you see a safe path?
I think so, but I am afraid.
Chess is about taking small risks. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make bread taste good?
Good bread needs warm water and time. Do you have a big bowl to mix it in?
Yes, I have a big bowl. What should I add first?
Start with flour and a bit of salt. Is your kitchen warm and cozy?
It is a little cold. Will that stop the bread from growing?
Cold air makes the dough grow very slow. Do you have a blanket to cover the bowl?
I have a clean towel I can use. What should I do next?
Mix everything well, then wait for the dough to puff up. Is the dough sticky or dry in your hands?
It feels a bit wet. Should I add more flour?
Yes, add a little flour at a time. I do not know exactly how much you need, so check how it feels.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I promise to share my toys with you.
That is a very kind promise. Do you like playing with blocks?
Yes, I do. I also promise to say sorry if I make a mistake.
That sounds like a true promise. I will try to be a good friend too.
Will you remember our promise?
Yes, I will remember. Do you want to play now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to feed my fish. How often should I do it?
You can feed them once a day. Do they eat quickly?
Yes, they are very fast. What do I give them?
You should give them small flakes. Do you have flakes?
I have some dry food left over. Is that okay?
Yes, that is fine. Make sure they finish it all.
Okay, I will try that today. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun with your fish.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my little tree is dying.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you know if you watered it too much?
Yes, I think I did. The leaves look brown and soft.
Too much water can hurt the roots. Is the soil very wet inside?
Yes, it feels like mud. I am afraid it is too late now.
It is not too late yet. Have you let the soil dry out a bit?
I will try that now. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Let us hope it wakes up soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I promised to play with my friend, but I want to stay home.
That feels hard. Do you miss your friend?
Yes, I do. But my house is so cozy and quiet.
That is a good feeling. Do you want to offer them a treat?
I could bring some cookies. Would that make me a true friend?
Yes, that is a nice choice. Go have fun together!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to pick up all these toys?
We pick them up so you do not trip. Do you want to play outside after?
I want to, but my room looks like a mess.
A clean room helps you think clearly. What game do you usually play first?
I do not know what game to pick today.
It is okay not to know yet. Shall we tidy the living room next?
Why does the living room always get dirty so fast?
Because we walk and sit there a lot. Is your favorite cushion on the floor?
Yes, it is right there by the door.
Let us put it on the couch together.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so tired and late. I cannot stop.
That sounds hard. Are you eating?
No time. I must go now.
Please drink some water. Is this okay?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad. I finished my book, but I am not happy.
That is hard. Did you like the story?
Yes. But I wanted to be super proud. I just feel okay.
Being happy is good enough. What was your favorite part?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The lights are off. Can you teach me how to light a match?
I can help with that. Do you have a matchbox?
Yes, I found it in the drawer. What do I do next?
Hold the match steady. Strike it firmly on the rough side.
It is burning now. Do I need to do anything else?
Keep it away from your fingers. It is very hot.
I see the flame. Why did the power stop?
I do not know why the power stopped. Is it dark outside?
Yes, it is very dark. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Stay safe and warm.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I stop my king from getting hurt?
Put pawns in front of your king to block attacks. Do you have a safe square for your king?
I want to win fast, but I keep losing pieces.
I do not know the best plan for you, but be careful with your queen. What piece is getting trapped?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the light go out when I unplug the cord?
The cord is the path for the power to travel. Do you want to know how that path works?
No, just why does it stop working?
Unplugging it breaks the path, so no power can move. Is there a specific light that worries you?
Yes, the lamp in my room. It flickers.
A flicker often means a loose wire or a bad bulb. Have you checked if the bulb is tight?
It is tight, but it still blinks.
That might be a small problem with the wall socket. Do you want to try moving it to another plug?
I will try that later. Thank you.
You are welcome. It is good to stay safe while checking.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My nose feels all stuffed up.
That is a bug in your nose. Do you have a fever?
I feel hot and my head hurts.
Rest is good for you. Do you want some soup?
Yes, please.
Soup is warm and kind. Do you like chicken?
I like it with carrots.
Carrots are sweet. Do you have a blanket?
Yes, I am under it.
Sleep is the best medicine. Do you feel a bit better now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: There is a big fire outside.
I am sorry. Are you safe?
Yes, but the smell is bad.
I think you should open a window. Do you feel hot?
My chest hurts a little.
Please sit down and breathe. Have you eaten today?
No, I am too worried.
A warm drink may help. Do you know where you are?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the city so loud?
The cars and people make a lot of noise. Do you like the sound?
Not really. Can we go to a quiet park?
Yes, there is one near us. It has big trees and soft grass.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to do math homework every day?
It helps your brain get strong. Do you like numbers?
Not really. Why does it have to be hard?
I do not know exactly why it feels hard. Do you like drawing?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Why do you feel this way?
I lost my toy.
That is hard. Do you want to play with me?
Yes, please.
Great. Let’s start with a game.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like music?
Yes, I do. Do you like to sing?
Not really, I like to dance.
That sounds fun. Do you like fast or slow songs?
I like slow songs.
I like slow songs too. What is your favorite song?
I like the rain sound.
Rain is nice to listen to.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the cake. I forgot the date.
That is a big problem. Do you like chocolate?
Yes, I do. But I have no time to eat.
Please be careful on the street. Will you share a piece?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big, bright red balloon today.
That sounds like a nice thing to see. Was it shaped like a heart?
No, it was just a round circle. It floated up to the sky.
I am glad you enjoyed the sight. Did you buy it?
No, it was not for sale. I just watched it go away.
Watching a balloon float can feel very peaceful.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My little boat is leaking. I am sad.
Oh no, that is bad news. Do you have a patch?
Yes, I have a red patch and some glue.
Great. Stick the patch on the hole and wait.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to paint a cat but the fur looks like a blob.
Try using short, thin lines for the fur instead of big strokes. Do you have blue or black paint?
I have blue and red, but no black.
You can mix blue and red together to make a dark purple. Would you like to try mixing them on a paper first?
I mixed them and now I have a nice dark color.
That sounds great, so now you can paint the shadow under the cat. Do you want the cat to be sleeping or waking up?
I think I will paint it waking up.
That is a lovely choice, good luck with your painting.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took a big red boat out on the lake today. It felt very steady on the water.
That sounds like fun. Do you wonder why the heavy boat stays on top?
I do. I thought it might sink, but it did not.
The water pushes up on the bottom of the boat to hold it up. Did you notice how the boat sat lower in the water when you sat down?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My cat is eating less and sleeping a lot. What should I do?
I think you should take her to the vet. Is she still drinking water?
Yes, she drinks well. Her eyes look red too.
That is not a good sign. Please call the doctor today.
Okay, I will go now. Thank you.
You are welcome. I hope she feels better soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Can you show me how to tie a shoelace?
Yes, I can help. Do you have a shoe with you?
No, just this cord. Is that okay?
That works fine. Cross the ends to make a knot.
I did that. What is next?
Make a loop with one end. Did it look like a bunny ear?
Yes, it does. How do I finish?
Loop the other end and pull tight. You did a great job.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to sleep because my eyes feel warm and heavy.
It is time to rest. Do you like your soft pillow?
Yes, but my head feels very big and round.
Your head is just getting ready to dream. Do you have a toy nearby?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a leaf drop from the big tree today. Why do they all fall?
Trees drop leaves to save energy in the cold. Did you catch one?
No, I just watched it land. I like seeing them spin down.
That is a nice thing to watch. Do you think they are happy?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I made a new friend at school today.
That is very nice to hear. What did you do together?
We played a game on the grass.
Fun games are always good. Do you like playing on the grass?
Yes, I do. I want to play with him tomorrow too.
I am glad you are happy. I hope you have a great day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like the big trees in this park.
Trees are good friends. Do you like sitting under them?
Yes, they give me shade.
That is nice and cool.
What is that small, red bird eating?
It is eating a seed. Do birds eat all day?
I think they do.
I am not sure, but they are busy.
Thank you for walking with me.
I am happy to help. Do you want to see the pond?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I promised to help my sister with her chores today. Do I have to do it even if I am very tired?
Yes, you should keep your promise. Are you feeling sad about it?
A little bit, yes. But I know it is the right thing. How can I make it easier for me?
You can take small breaks while you work. Do you like to listen to music while you clean?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know who built the pyramids.
Ancient Egyptians built them. Did you learn about that in class?
No, just saw a picture. Do you know why they built them?
They built them as royal tombs. Do you like history?
Not really, I am late. Was Rome a city or a country?
It started as a city then grew into a huge empire. Is it for a test?
Yes, a quick quiz. Who was the first president?
I do not know which country you mean. Do you like trivia?
The United States. Thanks, I must go.
George Washington was the first. Good luck on your test.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am very proud of my new drawing. Do you think it is good?
Yes, it looks very fun. What is your favorite part of the picture?
I like the red sun. Thank you for saying it looks good.
You did a great job. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look at the water but do not know what to do.
The boats are still. Do you like to sit on the dock?
The dock looks wet and cold.
That is a fair worry. Would you like to walk along the sand instead?
The sand looks soft under my feet.
Good choice. It feels warm in the sun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: It is very cold outside.
Yes, the air feels sharp and icy. Do you have warm gloves on?
I want to build a big snowman.
That sounds like great fun. What color scarf will you use?
The snow is white and soft.
True, it looks like fresh cotton. Is it deep enough to jump in?
I slipped on the ice just now.
Ow, that must hurt. Be careful when you walk.
I am coming back inside now.
Good idea, stay safe. Do you want a hot drink?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My teacher is so mean today.
That sounds sad. Did something specific happen?
He failed my good work.
That is not fair. Are you feeling angry?
I just want to go home.
I understand. Do you want to talk more?
I guess so.
I am here for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
