exchanges: I want to learn how to say vows.
That is a nice goal. Do you have the words written down?
Yes, I have them on a card.
Great. You should practice them out loud.
How many times should I practice?
Try it until it feels easy. Do you have a quiet place?
I can use the bedroom.
Good choice. Read slowly and breathe.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I stay dry if it rains?
Use a sturdy tent with a good rain fly. Do you have a waterproof jacket?
I have one, but it is old.
An old jacket might not work well. Can you fix any holes in it?
I do not know how to sew.
That is hard to say for sure. You can use a tarp over the tent instead.
Is a tarp hard to carry?
A small tarp is light and easy. Do you have a strong rope?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do robots move?
They move because we build them to. Do you like big machines?
Yes, I love them. Why can they not talk like me?
Some can, but only if a person teaches them words. Is that tricky?
I guess it is. Why are they so fast?
They run on strong motors that hum with power. Do you run fast too?
I try hard. Why do some robots look scary?
I do not know for sure, but art makes them look that way.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running very fast to catch the bus.
Take a deep breath. Is the bus coming soon?
It leaves in one minute.
You might miss it. Do you have your bag?
Yes, I have my bag.
Then you will be fine.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the sky look so big in winter?
The air is dry, so it feels clear. Do you like the cold?
Yes, but why are the days so short?
The Earth tilts away from the sun. Do you miss the sun?
A little. Why do we have seasons at all?
It is how the Earth moves around the sun. I do not know why it started.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I really like this song, but the end makes me sad.
That is a common feeling. Do you know why it feels that way?
I do not know. It just feels wrong.
I am sorry it feels that way. Would you like to listen to something else?
Maybe. What should I pick?
I do not know your taste. Do you like fast songs?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so sorry I am late. The bus stopped on the hill and I had to wait for a long time.
That sounds like a long wait. Did you see anything interesting while you waited?
Yes, I saw a cat sitting on the hood of the bus. It looked very sleepy and clean.
A cat on the bus is a fun sight. I am glad you are safe now.
The driver finally woke up and we drove fast. I feel a bit tired but happy to be here.
I hope you can rest a little bit soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I count apples?
Do you have any apples? Just point at one and say one.
What comes after one?
Two. Do you like red apples?
How do I start over?
Go back to one. Are you finished?
What number is next?
Three.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, the sky is purple and the wind is loud. I love this storm.
Wow, that sounds exciting. Is the rain hard?
Yes, it hits the roof like a drum. I am so happy to watch it.
That is a cool way to see it. Do you like the sound?
The thunder is a big boom. It wakes me up in a good way.
It is a loud noise, but can be fun. Are you dry inside?
Yes, my home is safe and warm. I am glad for the cozy feel.
That is great. Do you want some hot tea?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to do. My old friend is far away.
That feels hard. Do you want to write a note?
I am scared to ask for help.
Try to share how you feel. Is he busy?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to pack a bag for the park. What should I put in it?
Bring water and a sandwich. Do you like apples?
I have a coat and some shoes. Are those good?
Yes, they are warm. Did you check if it is raining?
I do not know what else to pack.
I do not know your needs. Are you playing games?
Yes, I have a ball. Is that all I need?
That sounds fun. Do you have a small book?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the movie made me cry.
That sounds hard. Do you feel better now?
No, I still feel a bit down.
I am sorry. What part was the saddest?
The dog died at the end.
I do not know if dogs can truly die in stories, but it hurts to see.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Can you help me fix my bike?
Yes, I can help. What is wrong with it?
The wheel is wobbly. Why does that happen?
It happens when the rim is bent. Do you have a wrench?
I have a wrench. Why do I need one?
You need it to tighten the nuts. Can you reach under the bike?
I can reach it. Why do we tighten it?
Tightening makes the wheel straight. Do you feel any pain?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with all these lights.
Look up. Do you like how they blink?
I just stare. What should I do?
Count them. How many do you see?
Too many to count. I am lost.
Sit down. Is the night quiet for you?
It feels too big for me.
That is okay. Breathe in.
What if I fall into one?
You will not. Do you feel safe now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The city is so loud and fast. I feel very tired.
That sounds hard. Do you like quiet places?
I love the noise, but my head hurts. What should I do?
Try walking in a park. It is often calmer there.
Is the park busy too?
It can be, yes. Do you have time to sit down?
I have an hour to eat lunch. Where is good?
Small cafes are usually quiet. Do you like soup?
Yes, I do. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The thunder is so loud. Is it angry?
No, it is just big air moving fast. Are you scared?
A little. Why is it so bright?
It is light from the clouds rubbing together.
Will it stop soon?
I do not know exactly, but storms always end. Do you want a blanket?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to paint a red apple, but it looks brown.
That is odd. Do you have a red paint bottle?
Yes, but the cap is stuck tight.
Try holding it in a warm towel. Is it very tight?
The towel did not work.
I do not know why it is stuck.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The waves are too big and I feel sad.
That is hard to feel. Do you like the water?
It feels like it is chasing me.
The sea can be loud and wild.
I just want it to stop.
I do not know how to stop the waves. Have you tried to step back?
I am too tired to move.
It is okay to rest for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My magnet fell off the fridge and I am very sad.
I am sorry your magnet slipped. Do you know where it rolled to?
I looked under the couch but could not find it.
Try looking near the metal door. Is it a big magnet or a small one?
It is very small and I think it broke.
Magnets do not break easily. Have you tried using another magnet to find it?
I do not have another magnet right now.
You can use a paperclip with a string. Did you try that yet?
No, but I do not have any paperclips.
I do not know how to find a magnet with no tools. Are there any toys with metal parts nearby?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the music so loud?
It helps people have fun. Do you like the songs?
Why is the floor wet?
Someone spilled a drink. Are you okay?
Why are there so many hats?
It is part of the theme. Do you have a hat?
Why is the pizza cold?
I do not know. Would you like to check with the cook?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to camp, but I do not know what to bring.
Bring a warm coat, a bag for food, and a light. Do you like to cook?
Yes, I love making food outside.
Pack simple things like foil and dry beans. Is your spot safe?
I do not know if it is safe.
Look for dry ground away from big trees. Do you have a map?
I have a phone, but no map.
Get a paper map so you are not lost. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I love to keep old bottle caps. Do you know where I can find more?
You can look at a store that sells drinks. Do you like shiny ones?
Yes, I like the shiny gold ones best. Are they hard to find?
Sometimes they are hard to find. Do you keep them in a box?
I keep them in an old jar. Is a jar safe for them?
A jar is a safe place for them. Do you play with them?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to cast my line, but I forgot the knot. Do you know it?
Yes, the basic overhand knot is easy. Do you have a small spoon to help?
No, I am holding it by hand. Can you show me?
Hold the loop with your teeth and pull the tail tight. That is all.
It is done. I am leaving now.
Happy fishing. Did you check the water level?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a quick drink before I run.
Tea steeps faster. Do you like the hot kind?
Coffee is better for me.
Coffee gives you a boost. I will get it for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, the lights went out and I am late for work.
I am sorry. Are you trying to pack lunch?
Yes, but I cannot find my bag in the dark.
I do not know where it is. Did you leave it by the door?
I think so, but my phone is also gone.
That is tricky. Can you feel around the floor?
I found it, thank you. The power is back on now.
Great news. Did you grab your lunch?
Yes, I am running out now.
Good luck.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sky is gray and wet. I do not know what to do.
Take your umbrella with you. Do you have a warm coat?
Yes, I have my blue coat. Is it safe to go out?
Yes, it is safe if you walk slowly. Where are you going?
I want to visit my friend. Do you think the bus will come?
I do not know for sure. Check the app on your phone.
Okay, I will check. Is it very cold?
It is a bit cool. Is your coat zipped up?
Yes, I am all zipped up. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love apples. How do I peel one?
You can use a knife, but be very careful. Do you have a peeler?
Yes, I do. How do I use it?
Hold the apple and pull the peeler down along the skin. Is your apple fresh?
Yes, it is. Thank you.
You are welcome. It is a fun snack.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I plant a new tree?
Dig a hole and put the tree inside. Do you have water ready?
I want the tree to grow big and strong.
Give it sun and water every day. I do not know which tree you picked.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy and I feel very bad.
That is a good feeling. Do you know what to say?
I want to say sorry, but I am afraid it will not work.
Sincerity is the best part. Was it an accident?
Yes, it just slipped out of my hand.
Then just tell her the truth. Are you ready to ask?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake cookies, but I am confused by the recipe.
That is a fun skill to learn. Do you have any flour and butter ready?
I have flour, but I am not sure what to do with the butter.
You should let the butter sit on the counter for a bit so it gets soft. Are you using a hand mixer?
No, I just have a spoon and a bowl. How do I make it work?
You can mash the butter into the sugar with the spoon until it looks fluffy. It is hard work, but it works.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I learned a new word today! It is "sun."
That is a lovely word. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, they make me feel warm inside.
That is wonderful. What else did you learn?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to grow carrots. What do I do?
Put the seeds in the dirt. Do you have a sunny spot?
I have a small pot. Is that good?
It is fine for starting. Are you using big dirt?
I used the dirt from the park. Is that bad?
It may have bugs. Do you want to try clean soil?
What do I do with the water?
Water them when the top is dry. Do you have a small can?
Thank you. I will try that now.
You will do well. Have fun with your plants.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I feel so tired after my lunch today. I ate a big bowl of cold noodles.
That sounds heavy for a midday meal. Did you drink any water with it?
I drank a little, but mostly I just felt full. I wish I had chosen something lighter.
Water helps your body move food along. Do you like eating fruit?
I love apples, but I forgot to bring one. I will try again tomorrow.
That is a great plan for your energy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the river move?
The water flows because the ground is slanted. Do you see the rocks in the middle?
Yes, they look wet. Why is the water not just sitting still?
Gravity pulls the water down the hill. Have you ever felt your slide at the park?
Oh, like a slide! But why does it go to the sea?
The sea is much lower than the hills. Do you know where the sea is?
Yes, far away. Why is the water so clean?
I do not know for sure, but it looks clear today. Do you see any fish?
I see a small one jump. Why does it jump?
It may be trying to catch air or play. Do you want to look closer?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the store closed on Monday?
We rest our eyes and minds then. Do you have a favorite item here?
I love the red apples. Why are they so sweet?
They drink lots of sun all summer long. Do you eat them with milk?
Sometimes I do. Why is the milk cold?
Cold milk tastes very nice. Is it hot outside today?
Yes, it is warm. Why is the door left open?
To let the cool air in. Can you smell the fresh bread?
I can smell it now. Why is the bread still warm?
We just baked it this morning. Do you want to buy some?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the light turn on when I press this button?
The button makes the wire let the power flow. Do you have other buttons like that?
No, just one. Does the power come from the wall?
Yes, it comes from far away through wires.
That is cool. What is inside the wire?
A tiny metal part helps the power move. Do you like looking inside things?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix this lamp. Is it safe?
Yes, plug it out first. Do you see a spark?
No, but the wire is cut.
That is bad. Do not touch it.
How do I fix it?
I do not know. Call a pro.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss the big blue water. It feels cold.
The sea is still there for you. Do you want to talk about it?
It feels far away. I feel small.
That is a hard feeling. What part of the sea do you miss most?
The sand under my toes. I need a break.
Sand is nice and soft. Have you tried walking on dry ground?
I just want to sit by it. I am tired.
Sitting by water can help. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need a plan?
A plan helps us know what to do next. Do you have a favorite part of the day?
What if we get stuck?
We can try again and ask for help.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big ship today and it did not sink. I am so happy to tell you why!
That is a great thing to see. Do you know what holds it up?
Yes! The water pushes up because the ship holds a lot of air inside. It pushes back just as hard as the ship pulls down.
That is a very true idea. Is the air light or heavy?
The air is very light. So the whole ship is lighter than the water it moves out of the way.
I am glad you understand that. Would you like to see a small boat next?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big surprise for you.
That is exciting. What is it?
It is a new puppy.
A puppy? How cute.
He has soft brown fur.
I would love to meet him.
Come see him now.
Let us go.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I read a book I love, but I do not know what to do next.
Did you like the ending? I can help you think of what to do next.
The end was very sad and I feel stuck.
That is hard. Do you want to read it again or pick a new one?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am stuck on my math homework.
That can be hard. What part is tricky?
The big number times the small number.
Do you know how to count by tens?
Yes, I know how to count by tens.
Great, start there.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see the sun in the sky. Why is it so bright?
It burns like a giant fire to give us light. Do you like looking at it?
I do, but it burns my eyes. How can I see it safely?
Look at your shadow instead of the sky directly. Is your shadow short or long?
It is very short right now. What does that mean about the time?
It means the sun is high up in the middle of the day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I kicked the ball really hard into the net today.
That is great. Do you like scoring goals?
Yes, I love them. The ball went so fast.
That is exciting. How did you feel when it went in?
I was very happy. I yelled loud.
You should. That is the fun part.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the snow so white?
I think the light makes it look bright. Do you see it on the roof?
Yes, it is on my head too.
That must feel cold. Do you like the cold?
It is a little bit cold.
You can put on a hat. Is your hat fluffy?
It is very fluffy and warm.
That sounds cozy. Do you want to build a friend?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the boat float?
It is lighter than the water. Do you like water?
What is the wood made of?
It is made of trees. Was it in a forest?
Why is it painted blue?
It helps it hide in the sea. Is the sea blue?
Can it go fast?
Yes, if the wind blows. Do you like wind?
Who made the boat?
A builder did. Did you see him?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My baby is crying and I do not know why.
Is the baby hungry or does he need a new diaper?
I checked both and it is not those things.
I am not sure then, but is the room too warm?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
The people sleep here. Do you hear the wind?
It is not windy.
Then the birds are resting. Do you see the trees?
Yes, they look still.
Yes, they are calm. Are you waiting for someone?
I am waiting for you to tell me more.
I do not know more. Do you feel happy here?
I feel calm, yes.
That is good. Go home and rest.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am so late for my ride.
Don’t worry, we have time. Do you want to learn how to tie your shoes?
Yes, please. I always fail.
Watch my hands closely. Do you see the loop I made?
I see it, but my hands are slow.
That is okay, practice makes perfect. Is it slippery?
A little. Can you help me now?
Here, hold this tight. See, you did it right.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am reading a book about a lion who is very sad.
That sounds like a tough story. Why is the lion feeling so down?
He lost his favorite ball in the deep jungle.
Poor thing. Do you think he will find it again?
I hope so, but I do not know what happens next.
I do not know either because I have not read it. Would you like to keep reading?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to get my sister for her birthday.
That is a hard choice. Does she like to play outside?
Yes, but she also loves drawing pictures.
How about a fun outdoor kit with some paper and pens inside?
I am not sure if that is a good idea.
I do not know what she will like most, but it sounds like a sweet try.
She might think it is boring.
Would you like to pick out the items together?
That sounds like a lot of work for me.
It is fine if you want to just buy a gift card instead.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Can I get a chicken wrap?
Yes, we have that. Do you want fries with it?
No, just the wrap. I need to run.
Okay, here is your wrap. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Which season is best for playing outside?
Spring is great because the flowers are waking up. What do you like to play in?
I love running and jumping.
That sounds fun. Winter can be cold, so you need warm clothes. Do you like snow?
I do not like being cold.
I do not know your exact weather, but summer is usually warm. Do you have a favorite color?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today.
That is wonderful. What made you smile?
The sun is warm outside.
That sounds nice. Do you like the sunshine?
Yes, it feels good on my skin.
I am glad you feel good. Do you want to walk?
I will go outside now.
That is a great plan. Go enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I said sorry, but I feel sad.
That is okay. Do you know why you feel sad?
I am afraid my friend is mad.
Most people forget soon. Did you mean your words?
Yes, I did not mean to hurt her.
True words help. Do you want to play again?
Yes, I want to play with her.
Go tell her. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the big red shop today.
That sounds fun. What did you buy?
I saw a cat sleeping on a box.
Is it your cat?
No, it is a stray cat.
Oh, that is sad. Did you feed it?
Yes, I gave it some fish.
You are very kind.
The cat purred at me.
That is a sweet story.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do actors dress up in fancy clothes?
It helps the audience believe they are different people. Do you like to wear costumes too?
I do, but why do they not use real words?
They use big words to make the story sound grand. Is that hard for you to listen to?
Not really, but why does the music stop sometimes?
It stops so we can hear the quiet parts of the story. Do you notice when the music stops?
Yes, and why do people clap at the end?
It tells the actors they did a great job. Do you like to clap?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a song stuck in my head, but I do not know the words. What should I do?
Try to sing it out loud slowly. Do you know the first line?
I do not know the first line, only the tune.
That is okay. You can just hum it for now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dog is sleeping a lot lately and will not eat.
That is not normal. Is he playing with his toys?
No, he seems very tired and sad.
You should take him to the doctor. Do you have a car to drive him?
I have a car, but I am afraid he will like it.
You must do it for his health. Is he too heavy for you to lift?
He is small, so I can carry him.
Good. Put him in the car and go now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I kick the ball far?
Put your toe on the ball and swing your leg. Do you have cleats?
I am wearing sneakers.
That is okay for learning. Try it on a soft spot.
Where do I aim?
Look at your target before you kick. Do you have a goal?
I am just kicking it in the yard.
Aim for a patch of grass. I do not know your yard layout.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy. I feel bad and I want to say sorry.
That is a very kind thing to do. What are you afraid she will say?
I am scared she will be angry at me.
She might be upset for a moment, but she will like your honesty. Do you have a drawing to give her?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired and my legs hurt from sitting here for so long.
That sounds very hard. Is your seat comfortable?
I don't know if it will get better soon, I just want to get home.
I hope you land very soon. Do you have a favorite snack?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the lighthouse light flash?
It flashes to show boats where the rocks are. Do you see the light from here?
I see it, but why not stay on all the time?
Keeping it on all night wastes too much power. Does that make sense to you?
Yes, the flashing saves energy.
Exactly right, it helps the sea stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was warm on the little hill today.
That sounds nice. Did you see any birds?
Yes, a blue bird sang near the tree.
A blue bird? How lovely.
I watched it for a while before it flew away.
I am glad you enjoyed the view.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find a square. I am late.
A square has four same sides. Is it blue?
No, it is red. Help me find it.
Look at the corner of the room. Do you see it?
I see a circle. That is not it.
A circle has no corners. Do you see any sharp edges?
Yes, I see a triangle.
A triangle has three sides. Do you need a shape with four?
Yes, four sides. I found the square.
Great job finding it. Do you have time to wave?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here, but I do not know where to go.
You can look at the bright spots. Do you want food or things?
I want something sweet.
Please turn left for the cake shop.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sun so bright?
It makes light and heat. Do you like sunny days?
It is very hot sometimes.
The heat can burn you. Do you wear a hat?
Why is it round?
Its gravity pulls it into a ball. Do you like balls?
Does it ever stop shining?
It shines every day for you. Do you watch it set?
Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Do you have more questions?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late for my doctor visit.
Please take a deep breath. Are you feeling scared?
No, but I am rushed.
The doctor will listen to you. Do you need help with your bag?
No, I am good.
Okay, I will walk with you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why did the lights go out?
The power went off in our area. Do you have flashlights?
Yes, I found some. Do you know why it happened?
I do not know the exact reason. Are your batteries charged?
Yes, they work fine. Will it come back on soon?
I hope so, but I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is my wooden fence too short for the dog?
A four foot fence is usually good for most dogs. How big is your dog?
He is a big, strong man.
If he is very tall, you might need more height. Can he jump high?
He jumps quite high, yes.
Then a four foot fence may not stop him. Do you have a six foot option?
I do, but it costs more money.
A taller fence keeps him safe and stops him from running away. Is the extra cost okay for you?
I think it is the right choice.
That sounds like a smart plan for a happy garden. Good luck with the build.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is that shop open so late?
It helps people who work late shifts. Do you go there often?
I see many people inside. Why are they standing in line?
I do not know for sure, but they likely want to buy food.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake a cake.
That is a sweet goal. Do you have an oven at home?
Yes, my grandma has one, but I am not sure how to use it.
You must turn the knob to a warm number. Is the knob red or black?
It is red. How do I know when the cake is done?
You stick a white stick in the middle. If it comes out clean, it is ready.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky blue in that movie?
The paint looks blue to our eyes. Do you like the color blue?
I do. Why does the hero cry at the end?
He feels sad because he lost a friend.
That is sad. Why does the music get loud then?
It shows how big his feelings are. Do you like loud music?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I did not like the surprise. It was not what I hoped for.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you want something specific?
Yes, I wanted a book. I got a hat instead.
A hat can be fun. Do you like hats?
No, I do not. I just want my book.
That is understandable. I will help you get it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The rain is falling hard. I do not know what to do.
You can stay dry inside. Do you like reading books?
I have no books here. The house feels too quiet.
You might play a quiet game. What game do you play best?
I am tired from the noise. My legs feel heavy.
Resting is good for tired legs. Would you like a warm drink?
Yes, please. But I am still not sure if I should open the door.
Wait for the rain to stop. Is the storm getting quieter?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How should I say thank you?
You can just look at the person and smile. Do you like to smile?
What if I drop my food?
I am not sure what you dropped, but a quick sorry is good.
How do I wait for my turn?
Stand still and wait quietly. Are you good at being quiet?
Thank you for the tips.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to eat for breakfast.
Have you tried warm toast with jam?
That sounds good, but I am not sure I like jam.
That is true. Do you prefer sweet or salty food?
I like salty things more, like eggs.
Scrambled eggs are a great choice.
Thank you, I will make eggs.
I hope you enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say please?
It shows we care about others. Do you like when people are nice to you?
Yes, I do. Why do we knock on a door?
It gives people time to get ready. Does that feel fair to you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because I missed the bus.
I am sorry to hear that. Are you going to be late for work?
Yes, and I will get in big trouble.
That sounds very scary. Do you have your phone with you?
I lost my keys too. I feel like I can't do anything right.
I understand why you feel that way. Let us fix this one step at a time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My head hurts. I want to make tea to fix it. How do I start?
Put water in the pot. First, are you using a kettle or a stove?
I am using a stove. What is the next step?
Turn on the heat. The water will boil soon.
The water is boiling. Now what do I do?
Pour the hot water over the tea bag. Let it sit for a few minutes.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure if I should read this book again.
Do you like the last part?
Yes, but I feel too busy now.
Take a small break. Is it a happy story?
It is very sad, but I love it.
Read just one page to feel better.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I cannot find my blue hat.
I am sorry to hear that. Have you checked the shelf?
Yes, I did. It is not there.
That is frustrating. Did you pack your shoes?
Yes, I packed them. Why do you ask?
Just checking. Do you want help looking?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I lost my stamp book. Where do I get a new one?
You can buy one at the counter. Is that why you came in?
Yes, but I only have cash. Will they take that?
Most places take cash just fine. Do you have the right coins?
I have a mix of bills and coins. Is that okay?
Yes, that works for most windows. Do you need to send anything today?
No, I just need the book. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a squirrel today!
That is so fun. Did it have a big tail?
Yes, it was eating a nut.
Squirrels love nuts. Do you have a friend to show it to?
My neighbor waved at me.
That is very kind of him. How did you feel?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My brain feels like mush. I do not know what to do next.
That sounds very hard. Did you eat anything today?
I am stuck on one big task. It will not let me rest.
That is a tough spot. I do not know your specific job. Can you tell me more?
I just want to go home and hide.
You sound very tired. A break might help. Do you have time to walk?
Maybe. But then I have to do it all again tomorrow.
That is scary to think about. One step at a time. Can you finish just one small thing?
I think I can try just that.
That is a good start. You are doing well. Try to breathe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I do not know how to hold the baby so he is safe.
Put one hand under his head and one hand under his bottom. Is he sleeping right now?
Yes, he is very quiet and warm in my arms.
Hold him close to your chest so he feels cozy. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy because I have a new plan. I want to build a big fort in the yard.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What are you using for the walls?
I found some strong blankets and sticks. I am putting the sticks first to make it stand up.
Good idea. Do you have a plan for the door?
Yes, I will cut a hole in the blanket for me to get in. I am very excited to start now.
I wish you luck with your building.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I failed the test today.
That feels really hard. Did you study for it?
Yes, but I forgot everything.
Your brain was just tired. What part made you worry most?
The math section was too tricky.
Math can be tough. Do you want to look at it together?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why did the lights go out? I am so angry about this.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you hear any buzzing in the box?
No, it is just dark. I hate the dark.
That can be scary. Do you have a phone with a flashlight?
Yes, but the battery is very low. It is not working well.
Let us find some candles then.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to see a movie today.
That sounds fun. What kind of movie was it?
It was a cartoon about a cat.
Cats are my favorite. Did you like the cat?
Yes, he was very funny and kind.
I am glad you had a good time. Did you buy any snacks?
I had a big bowl of popcorn.
That sounds delicious.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. My boss is so nice today.
Nice bosses are rare. What did he do?
He gave me the day off. It is a great gift.
That is very kind of him. Do you know why?
I do not know why. I just need to go now.
Go with a smile. Enjoy your rest.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am late for school and I feel very bad.
That is not good to feel. Did you have a big breakfast?
No, I missed it because I woke up late. What should I do?
Go now and be calm. Teachers often understand. Do you have your bag ready?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am worried because my shoes are all wet and cold.
Oh no, that must be uncomfortable. Did you try to dry them off?
I tried, but they are still cold and I do not like the feeling.
I understand, it feels bad when things are cold on your body. I hope they dry soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I made a new friend at school today. I do not know what to do next.
That is a very good thing. Do you have time to play this weekend?
I think I do, but I am not sure how to ask.
Just say you want to see a park. It is a simple way to start.
I am afraid they will say no to me.
If they say no, you can play alone. Do you like the park?
Yes, I love the swings there.
Then your fear is small. Go and ask them now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water moving so fast?
The river runs downhill to the sea. Do you like watching it?
I do. Why is the water so blue?
It reflects the clear sky above. Is the sun out today?
Yes, it is bright. Why does it make a loud noise?
The water hits the rocks with force. Do you hear birds too?
I do. Why does it smell fresh?
The cold air mixes with the wet soil. I do not know for sure why it feels so good.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My screen is black.
Is the box under the desk plugged in?
I think so, but I am not sure.
Check the little light on the front.
The light is off.
That means it is not getting power.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people like to swim?
They like it because the water feels cool and the body feels light. Do you like the cold water?
Yes, but why does the water push me back up?
That push is called buoyancy. It happens because your body is lighter than the water it moves. Do you feel floaty when you swim?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very cold and my nose is runny.
That sounds like a cold. Are you drinking enough water?
Yes, I am drinking warm tea.
Good for you. Rest is very important too. Do you have a blanket?
I have a soft blanket on my bed.
That is good. Let us talk about your cough. Is it wet or dry?
It is a dry cough that hurts.
Honey can help with that. It is sweet and soothing. Do you have any honey?
My mom has some honey.
Great. Eat a spoonful and rest. How is your temperature?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so sorry I am late. The bus driver left without me.
That sounds scary. Did you run to the next stop?
Yes, I ran a lot. My legs hurt now.
I am happy you made it safe. Did you check your bag?
I checked it twice. My keys are there.
Good. You can breathe easy now.
Thank you. I feel better.
You are welcome. I am glad to see you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight hits the air and scatters. Blue light scatters the most. Do you see the color well?
I do, but why does it scatter?
The air has tiny parts called molecules. Blue light bounces off them in all directions. Is that clear?
Yes, it makes sense.
I am happy it helped. Do you like the other colors too?
I like the red sunsets best.
That happens when the sun is low. The blue light is gone, so red stays. Nice choice.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my blue shirt in the mud.
That is a sticky mess. Do you have soap?
Yes, I put it in the water now.
Good. Is the water warm or cold?
It is warm. The dirt is coming out.
Great. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today. I tried to ride the big swing, but it was too high and I was scared.
That sounds scary. Did you find a smaller one?
Yes, I found a small one. It was fun, but then I got stuck on the way home because my bike broke.
Oh no. Do you have a bike fixer nearby?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you keep all these old rocks?
They are pretty to me. Do you like looking at rocks?
I think they look boring. Why do they feel so nice?
The smooth shape feels good to hold. Do you have any favorite toys?
I don't know if I have a favorite. Is that bad?
It is not bad at all. People love different things. What do you like to play with?
I like to play with mud. Why is mud so messy?
It is wet and soft. That is why it makes a mess. Do you wash your hands after?
Yes, I always wash them. Thank you for helping me think.
You are welcome. I am happy to talk with you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am going on a train to the city. What do I need to pack?
Bring your ticket and a book. Do you have a bag?
Yes, I have a small bag. How long does the ride take?
It takes about two hours.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see bright dots up there. What are they?
They are stars. Are you cold?
The car is waiting. Why are they so far?
They are very far away. Do you like the dark?
I must run. How can I see them?
You look up. Do you see them?
I see one blink. Is that real?
I do not know for sure. Go now.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am worried about missing my train.
Do not worry. I have checked the time. Is your ticket ready?
Yes, I have it in my hand.
Good. The train leaves soon. Do you know where to sit?
I do not know the seats.
Look for seat 14A. It is near the window.
Thank you very much.
You are welcome. Have a safe ride.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to look at the moon, but I do not know how.
You just need to look up at the sky. Is it dark outside for you?
It is still light. I feel confused.
Wait until the sun goes down. Do you have a chair?
I have a chair, but I am still unsure.
Sit in the chair and look up when it is night. You will see it clearly then.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what book to pick for my story.
That is a hard choice. Do you like animals or cars?
I like cats, but I am not sure if that is good enough.
Cats are always a great pick. You will do well with them.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to bake bread today, but my house smells like a hot oven.
That sounds warm and cozy. Did the bread rise nicely?
It rose a lot, maybe too much. It touched the top of the pan.
Oh no, that can get stuck. Did you check the inside?
Yes, I cut a piece. It is soft and smells sweet.
That is good news! How long did you wait for it to cool?
I waited for twenty minutes. My hands were shaking.
Why were they shaking? Were you excited?
I am happy and a bit tired. I just want to eat a slice.
You did a good job. Enjoy your warm bread.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am very late. What do I do?
Oh, that is bad. Are you worried?
I do not know what to do next.
Maybe you can call someone. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I have a phone.
Good. Say you are sorry.
I think I will leave now.
That is a good plan. Be safe.
Thank you.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I had a scary dream where I fell off a cliff. I am still shaking.
Oh no, that sounds very bad. I do not know why you dreamed that, but I am here.
It felt so real that my heart was beating fast. Do you ever dream about falling?
I do not dream, so I do not know that feeling. Are you feeling better now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which month we are in.
We are in May. Do you like the flowers?
The flowers are nice, but I am lost in time.
Check the calendar to be sure. Can you read the date?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Can you help me?
Yes. What do you need?
My key is gone.
Did you lose it? I do not know where it is.
Please look fast.
I will check. Is it cold out?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I knocked over my cup. Do I have to say sorry?
Yes, a simple sorry shows you care about the other person. Do you feel sad about it?
Why does a sorry help?
It tells the person you respect them and want to fix the problem. Did they look upset?
I do not quite get why words fix things.
I do not know the exact reason, but kind words make people feel safe. What did you do next?
I cleaned it up and said the words.
That was a good choice to take action. How did they smile back at you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My fish is just sitting at the bottom. Is it sick?
It might be resting. Does it have its fins spread wide?
Its fins are all tucked in. It looks sleepy.
That can mean it is cold or dirty. How often do you clean the tank?
I do not clean it much. I am unsure what to do.
Clean a little of the water today. Is the water warm?
I do not know how warm it is. Should I guess?
No, do not guess. I do not know your tank size. Do you have a small heater?
I have no heater. What should I buy?
Get a small heater and a thermometer. Do you want help picking one?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Can you tell me if my baby boy is safe?
Do not worry. I am not sure, but I know you care. Is he eating well?
He is eating. We must go now.
Good. Stay close. Is the car ready?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is warm and the trees are green. I am so happy here.
That sounds wonderful. Do you see any birds?
Yes, a small red bird sat on a branch. I waved at it.
How nice. Did it sing?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a cat and a bird in my house.
That sounds tricky. Do they know each other well?
No, the cat wants to play with the bird.
You must keep them apart.
But the house is small. What should I do?
Try building a safe box for the bird.
I do not know how to build one.
That is okay. Can you draw a picture of your idea?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Did Grandma like the blue card?
Yes, she was happy to see it. Are you eating lunch?
No, I must run now.
Please hurry back to me.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to learn to sing. How do I start?
Start by picking a simple song you like. Do you know any songs you enjoy?
Yes, I like that one. But my voice sounds bad.
That is just how it is at first. Do you practice a little every day?
No, not yet. What if I make mistakes?
Mistakes help you learn better.
Okay. Should I look in a mirror while I sing?
You can try that if it helps you. Do you have a favorite song to try first?
Yes, I have one. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Happy singing.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. My boss yelled at me again.
I am sorry that happened. Did he raise his voice?
Yes, it hurt to listen. I want to quit.
That sounds very heavy. Do you feel angry or sad?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost every round. My luck is bad.
That feels tough. Do you want to try a new card?
It is my favorite card. I hate it now.
I understand your frustration. What went wrong in the last play?
I played too fast. I missed the move.
Taking a deep breath helps. Have you played before?
Yes, I have played many times. I still fail.
Practice makes you better. Do you like to play for fun?
I just wanted to win. It feels hard.
Winning is not always possible. Let's play one more time together.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a big party today and it was fun.
That sounds nice. Did you eat any cake?
Yes, I had chocolate cake and it was sweet.
Yum. How did the music sound?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
The sun has all colors, but blue scatters the most. Do you see blue flowers?
Yes, I do. But why only blue and not green?
Blue travels farther than green in the air. Are you looking up?
Yes, I am looking up. It is very big.
The blue light reaches your eyes from all around. Nice spot you are watching.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the old pots in the dark room?
It keeps them safe from the sun. Do you like shiny things?
Why do they not touch the big car?
The dust makes it dirty. Why do you ask about the car?
Why is the hall so quiet?
We want you to listen to the stories.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a very old stone wall today. It looked like a puzzle.
That sounds like a historic site. Did it have any interesting marks on it?
Yes, I saw some strange symbols carved into the rock.
Those might be from a long time ago. Do you know what they mean?
I do not know what they mean, to be honest.
That is okay. Many old symbols are a mystery to us today.
A builder said people lived there many, many years ago.
That is a fun fact about the past. Did they live in caves or houses?
He said they built small houses right on top of the wall.
That is a clever way to build. Do you think you could build a wall like that?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How does a plant drink water? It has no mouth.
It uses tiny roots to pull water from the soil. Do you like watching things grow?
Yes, I do. But how does the water go up to the leaves?
The water climbs up thin tubes inside the stem, like straw. Is that a good picture for you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad today and I do not know what to do.
That sounds heavy. Do you want to talk about it?
I just want the bad feeling to stop.
Sometimes it helps to take a slow breath. Do you like taking walks?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I kick a ball?
Put one foot on the ground. Swing your other leg to hit the ball. Do you have a ball?
I do not have one.
That is okay. Use your feet to learn. Do you like to run?
Yes, I like to run.
Running helps you get strong. Keep it up. Do you play with friends?
I play with my brother.
That sounds fun. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so good today and I want to tell you about it.
That is a happy feeling. What made you feel this way?
I waited for my turn on the slide and it was still fun.
Patience can make waiting feel good. Did you play with your friends?
Yes, we shared the slide and had lots of laughs.
Sharing is a lovely way to be kind. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a new fence for my garden. How do I start?
First, you should measure the length of your yard. Do you have a long tape measure?
Yes, I have one. What do I do after measuring?
Next, you dig holes for the posts. How deep should the holes be?
I am not sure. Can you tell me?
About two feet deep is good for small fences. Do you have a shovel?
I have a shovel and a pickaxe. What is the next step?
Place the posts in the holes and check if they are straight. Do you have a level?
I do not own a level. Is there another way?
You can use a string line to keep them straight. I do not know if that is easier for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I cannot stop singing a new song.
That is wonderful to hear. What makes the song feel so good?
It has a fast beat. It makes me want to jump.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you dance when you hear it?
Yes, I dance in my room. It is my favorite part of the day.
I am glad you found a happy song.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, my goldfish looks sick.
Is his mouth open? Can you check if the water is clean?
I cannot look now, he looks bad.
If he is sad, the water might be cold. I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My tummy feels like a big knot.
That sounds very scary, I know. Does it hurt when you take a deep breath?
A little bit, yes.
I am not a doctor, so I cannot tell you what is wrong. Did you eat something new today?
I ate a slice of pizza for lunch.
Some foods can make our bellies feel warm. Do you also feel like you might be sick?
My head feels a bit fuzzy.
That is important to tell your mom or dad. Is your head hot when you touch it?
It is warm, I think.
Please tell your grown-up right now. I hope you feel much better soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad because the blue bird is gone.
I am sorry you feel that way. Where did you last see him?
He was on the branch near the door.
That is a quiet spot for him to sleep. Do you like to feed him?
Yes, I give him seeds, but he is not here now.
He might be in the tree behind your house.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I know if it is a quarter past or a quarter to?
Look at the short hand. Is it closer to the number you are reading, or the next one?
I can look at the short hand, but what do I say for the long one?
If the long hand is on the 3, it is a quarter past. If it is on the 9, it is a quarter to the next hour. Do you see the numbers on the clock?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to know how big my birthday cake should be.
A round one is nice. Do you like chocolate?
Yes, I love chocolate. What size fits eight people?
A medium cake works well. Is it for a party?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, why do leaves fall?
They fall to save energy for winter. Are you eating your lunch?
No, please just finish the answer.
The tree drops them so the roots can rest. Do you like crunchy leaves?
Yes, but I must go now.
Running in leaves is fun. Is your coat warm?
Good, see you later.
Go safely and stay dry.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a big bear near my house. What should I do?
Do not run. Stand still and make yourself look big. Did it look at you?
Yes, it was watching me. It seems very strong.
That is good because it is watching you. Keep your back to it and walk away slowly.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I clean the floor?
Use a mop and warm water. Do you have a mop?
Yes, I do. Should I add soap?
Yes, a little soap is good. What kind of floor is it?
It is wood. Is soap bad for it?
No, just use mild soap. Be careful not to get it too wet.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a dog in the park today. He was very sad and alone.
That is a kind thing to do. Was the dog a puppy?
No, he is an old dog. I gave him some water.
You are very sweet. Where did you take him next?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, but I love snow.
Snow is cold and white. Do you have a warm hat?
Yes, I do. It is nice.
That is good. I do not know your name.
I am in a rush. See you.
Bye. Is the sun out today?
Yes, it is bright.
Nice. Hurry on your way.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my square and it feels wrong.
I am sorry your square broke. Do you want to try building a new one?
No, I just want it to be perfect.
It is hard when things break. Do you like circles better?
Circles are easy, but squares are hard.
Squares need four equal sides. That is why they can be tricky.
I do not know how to make them equal.
You do not need to know right now. Are you angry at the broken shape?
Yes, I am sad and mad.
It is okay to feel that way. I know you can fix it later.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky blue in that movie?
The makers painted it blue. Do you like blue?
Yes, I love it.
That is a nice color. Does it make you feel calm?
It makes me feel happy.
Happy is a good feeling.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we wash our clothes?
To take away the dirt and smell. Do you like fresh clothes?
Yes, I do! But why do we need warm water?
Warm water helps lift the grime. Do you think cold water works too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I met a new friend today. I do not know what to say to them tomorrow.
You can just ask how their day was. Did you have fun talking today?
Yes, we talked about games. But I feel shy sometimes.
Being shy is normal. Try to listen more than you talk. What games do you like?
I like building with blocks. I am afraid they will not like me.
Most people like kind friends. You can offer to build together. Do they have any blocks?
I do not know if they do. What if I am wrong?
If you are unsure, ask if they want to play outside instead.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I love this song. It makes me want to jump.
That is a fun feeling. What is the song about?
It is about a big blue whale.
Whales are very big friends of the sea. Do you like the loud parts?
Yes. The drums go boom boom.
Good for you. I do not know the name of that song. Does it have a special name?
I think it is called Blue Splash.
That is a nice name. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see so many lights in the sky.
They are called stars. Do you know their names?
No, I do not. What should I do with them?
Look at the brightest one. Can you see the Moon?
Yes, the Moon is out too. It looks happy.
That is a good sign. Do you feel calm?
I feel very peaceful now.
That is a good feeling.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I like this book a lot.
Books share new ideas. Do you like stories?
Yes, I do. Why is the cover red?
Red feels warm and bright. Is that your color?
It is, actually. Why did you pick it?
I thought you would smile. Do you smile now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I counted three apples on the tree today.
That is a nice number to start with. Did you pick them down?
Yes, I picked two of them for a snack.
That means you still have one left. Do you plan to share it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my dog lick his paws so much?
He is just cleaning himself. Is he doing it a lot today?
Yes, he does it all the time.
That is normal for dogs. Does he seem happy or sad?
He looks very happy.
Good. Licking can feel good for them.
Should I stop him from doing it?
No, let him rest. Just keep his paws clean.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I build a home for ants?
Dig a small hole and give them some sugar water. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
I do, but I am scared they will bite me.
Ants usually only bite if you hurt them, so stay calm. What color are the ants you want to keep?
They are black and little.
Those look like garden ants, which are very friendly. Have you ever seen them moving in a line?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am picking flowers for my big day. What color should I pick?
Soft white looks very sweet. Do you like the color blue?
I do not know. I just want it to look nice.
That is a good goal. Pick what makes you smile.
I am also scared of running out of time. How do I fix that?
Make a list of things to do first. Does that help you feel calm?
Yes, a list feels safer. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun planning.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does Grandma move so slowly now?
Her joints hurt more as she gets older. Do you help her with her shoes?
Yes, I do. Why does she love watching the same show every day?
It makes her feel safe and calm. Do you watch it with her?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That is a great goal. Do you have a friend to help you?
Yes, my brother wants to watch.
Good. Balance is key, so practice balancing first.
How do I practice that?
Walk with the bike in a flat, open spot. What color is your bike?
It is red.
Perfect. Start by pushing it and seeing how far you glide.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the actor so loud?
He wants everyone to hear him. Do you like loud sounds?
No, I do not. Why is the curtain blue?
It makes the play look calm. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, I do. Why is the clown sad?
I do not know for sure. Maybe he lost his toy.
That is sad. Why is the music stopping?
It is time for the end. Did you enjoy the show?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn to sing, but I am afraid my voice will sound bad.
Do not worry, every singer starts by feeling a little shy. What song makes you want to sing?
I like happy songs, but I do not know how to make the sounds clear.
Try saying the words loud and slow, like a game. Do you have a favorite song to start with?
Yes, I like that song, but I do not know how to stop and start right.
Listen to the song once, just to hear the space between the notes. Would you like to try humming along?
That sounds good, but I am still not sure if I can do it well.
You can only know by trying, and it is okay if it is messy at first. Are you ready to take a deep breath?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the grass so green today?
The sun and rain helped it grow big. Do you like picking flowers?
Yes, I do. Why do bees buzz so loud?
They are busy talking to other bees. Do you want to hear more?
Yes, please. Why is the sky blue?
I do not know the full reason, but it looks nice. Is it sunny for you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my brush. I do not know what to do.
That is very sad. Did you try to clean it?
I put it in the water, but it still looks bad.
Maybe a new one will work well. What color are you using?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky so gray today?
It is cloudy. Do you like clouds?
Why do clouds make the ground wet?
Clouds hold water. They drop it as rain.
Why does the rain feel cold on my skin?
The water is cooler than your body. Is your shirt wet?
Why is the sun hiding now?
The thick clouds block the light. I hope it shines soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I must go now.
Do you have time for one more step?
No. I failed. I quit.
Failing is just learning. Are you scared to try again?
Yes. It feels hard.
It is hard at first. Is it worth it to you?
I do not know.
I do not know if it will work, but you do. Just try once.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I failed again. Should I quit?
It feels hard, but you can try one more time. What made it feel so tough?
My hands shook and I froze. Do I have what it takes?
You showed up, which is a strong start. I do not know your future, but your heart is in the right place.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy and I do not know what to do.
That feels bad. Do you have the toy in your hand?
Yes, it is in pieces. I am scared to talk to them.
You must tell the truth first. Would you like help finding the right words?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to drink something hot. I am not sure what to pick.
That is a good choice. Do you like sweet or bitter tastes?
I like both. Sometimes I want to feel calm. Sometimes I want to feel alert.
Calm feelings often come from tea. Alert feelings often come from coffee. Which feeling do you want right now?
I want to feel calm for now.
Tea is a gentle friend for calm moments. I do not know if you have tried green tea yet.
No, I have only tried black tea.
Green tea is very mild and soft. Black tea is a little stronger. Try the green one first.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Do you hear how still the air is?
I hear the wind in the trees. Do you like this quiet?
Yes, it feels so calm and nice.
That is a good thing. What do you see out there?
Just the soft light on the road.
It sounds very pretty. Do you feel safe here?
Yes, I feel very happy now.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to pack my tent now. It is very hot.
That is a good time. Are you going far?
Just to the lake. Do I need a hammer?
No, you do not need a hammer.
Good. I am almost done.
Packing is always fast when you rush. Is your bag heavy?
Yes. I need to go now.
Have a nice trip.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My house is too loud when I work.
That is hard. Do you have a quiet room?
No, all rooms have noise.
Try to sit near a closed door. What time is the noise worst?
It happens all day long.
Maybe you need to go to a library. Is that okay for you?
I have no car to get there.
You could walk or take a bus. Do you like walking?
Yes, I like walking.
Great. Go for a walk. Then sit in a park.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a dropped coin. What should I do with it?
You should try to give it back to the person who lost it. Do you know who dropped it?
No, I do not know who dropped it. I am not sure what to do next.
Put it near a security desk or ask a staff member for help. That is a very kind thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want ice cream, please.
Is your tummy empty? I can get you a cold one.
It is very hot outside.
Yes, the sun is very bright today.
Can I go to the pool?
I do not know if you have cleaned your room yet. Did you tidy up?
No, I forgot.
Let us clean first, then we can swim.
Okay, I will do it now.
Good job, I will wait for you here.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My boss gave me a hard task and I feel stuck. What should I do?
That feels hard. Do you know which part is tricky?
I do not know how to start the first step.
Start with the easiest part. Would you like to take a break first?
Yes, I need some air. Thank you for helping me think.
I am happy to help. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel sleepy when I read in bed?
Your body sees the dark and thinks it is time to sleep. Do you like reading before bed?
Yes, I do. Why does my brain slow down?
Warm light helps, but dark light tells your mind to rest.
I see. Do I need a special light to read?
A soft, warm light is good for your eyes. I do not know the best brand for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my grandma wear glasses?
She uses them to see small things clearly. Do you like your glasses?
Sometimes, but they hurt my nose. Why does it hurt?
It is not adjusted right for your face. I can check the fit.
Okay, please fix it. Why does she smell like cookies?
That is a sweet scent from baking. Do you smell vanilla too?
Yes, I do. Why does she smell so nice?
She loves to make fresh treats often. It brings joy to the home.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say sorry when we hurt someone?
We say it to show we care. Do you want to say it now?
I just want to make them feel better.
That is a good goal. I hope they forgive you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so confused. I cannot find my way home.
That feels bad. Which street are you on right now?
I think it is the one with the big red house. I just want to go home.
You are close to the park. Do you see a blue bench nearby?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am reading my favorite book about a brave bear today.
That sounds like a fun adventure. Is the bear strong?
Yes, he has big paws and a warm heart.
A warm heart is very special. What did he eat for lunch?
He found a juicy apple near the river.
Apples are sweet and good. Do you like apples?
I do, but I am more interested in the story.
It is good to follow your interests. Does the bear have any friends?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel really happy today.
That is great to hear. What made you smile?
I saw a big red balloon in the sky.
A red balloon is very pretty. Do you like balloons?
Yes, I love playing with them outside.
It sounds like a fun game. I do not know where you play, but it seems nice.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the moon is hiding behind thick clouds tonight.
That is a bummer. Do you usually like to look at it?
Yes, I love how it shines like a silver coin.
I understand your feelings. It feels different without that light, does it not?
It does, and I wish I could push the clouds away.
You cannot move them, but they will clear soon. What else makes you happy on a dark night?
I guess the sound of the wind helps me sleep.
That is a nice sound. I hope you dream of a bright moon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to do something fun today but I do not know what to pick.
That is okay. Do you like being outside?
I do like the park, but I also like reading.
Both are good picks. How much time do you have?
I have all afternoon free.
You can read then play. What book makes you happy?
I love that story about the brave lion.
Go read it first.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I want to see a tall mountain, but I cannot go.
That sounds hard. Do you live near a hill?
No, I live in a flat city. I feel stuck.
I am sorry. Is there a park near you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very worried about my big test tomorrow. Do you know what I should do?
Deep breaths help calm your mind. Have you studied all your notes tonight?
Yes, I read them, but I forgot a lot of the hard words. Is there a quick way to fix this?
I do not know a magic fix, but a short review might help. Which part scares you the most?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I failed my math test today.
Oh no, I am sorry to hear that. Did you study for it?
Yes, but the questions were very hard.
That can be frustrating. What was the hardest part?
I forgot how to add the fractions.
That is a common mistake. We can practice that together later.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to grow some carrots in my garden. How do I start?
You put the seeds in the dirt and water them every day. Do you have a sunny spot for your plants?
Yes, my backyard gets sun all day. What else do I need?
You need rich soil to help them grow big and sweet. I am not sure about the exact depth for your local area.
I will ask my neighbor about the depth. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome, and good luck with your new garden.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is a circle round?
A circle is round because every point on its edge is the same distance from the center. Do you like to draw circles?
Why does a square have four sides?
A square has four sides because that is how we define it to help us build things. Do you have a favorite shape?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I breathe well when I run?
Breathe in through your nose and out through your mouth. Is running hard for you right now?
My legs feel heavy after a few minutes.
Start with short walks and slow runs. Do you like walking first?
Yes, walking is easy.
That is a good place to start.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why are clouds white?
Sunlight hits tiny water drops. They bounce around and mix together. Do you see other colors in the sky?
Sometimes they look gray and dark.
That happens when clouds get thick. Less light gets through then. Do you like sunny days more?
What are clouds made of?
They are made of tiny water drops. Sometimes they are tiny ice crystals. Do you like to look up often?
Do they fall down?
Usually no, the drops are too light. But they can rain when they get heavy. Do you like rain?
How do they move?
Wind pushes them along. I do not know why the wind blows sometimes. Do you feel the wind today?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The snow is very cold on my hands. How do I stop the hurt?
Put on thick gloves to keep your hands warm. Do you have warm socks for your feet?
Yes, I have socks. But my boots are wet from the snow.
You can dry them by putting them near heat, but not too close to fire. Is there a fire in your home?
No fire, just a lamp. What else can I do?
I do not know how to dry boots without heat. Maybe sit still and wait for them to dry slow.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went swimming today and I am so happy.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did the water feel cool?
Yes, it was cold but I liked it.
Cool water can be a nice surprise.
I want to tell everyone about my swim.
I am glad you are happy. Do you swim every week?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a sandwich but I do not know how.
That is easy. Do you like cheese on your food?
Yes, I do. What should I do first?
First, put the bread on a plate. Then add your cheese.
Now what? I am getting hungry.
Next, add some lettuce or tomato if you have them. Do you have any vegetables?
I have a tomato. How do I finish it?
Cut the tomato and put it on top. Then add the other piece of bread on top of that.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to build a small shed in my yard. Do I need a big wood frame first?
Yes, a strong frame is the main body of the shed. Do you have any big logs ready?
I have some old beams from a broken fence. Can I use those?
You can, but check that the wood is not wet or rotting. Have you looked at the wood closely?
It looks dry, but how do I make the roof stay up?
You can use thin boards to cover the top of the frame. Do you have any nails?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: This street is so quiet. How do I make it loud?
You cannot force sound. Do you like the peace, or do you miss noise?
I like the peace, but I am learning to paint.
Painting needs a calm mind. This quiet place is perfect for you.
That sounds good. How do I start with the brush?
Dip it in water first. Have you tried mixing colors before?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My computer made a loud buzz and the screen went dark. I got very scared.
I am sorry it scared you. Did the power stay on?
Yes, the light was still blinking. I tried to press the big button on the back.
That was a good first step. Do you see the light now?
It is dark again, but quiet. I do not know what to do next.
That is a common problem. Can you unplug it from the wall?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw Sam today and it broke my heart. He seems so far away now.
That is very sad to hear. Do you think he has just grown up?
Maybe, but it feels like he forgot me. I want to get closer again.
You can always write a note to him. Would you like help with that?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very scared to start my garden.
It is okay to feel afraid, but I am here with you. What do you want to grow first?
I want to grow sunflowers, but I am lost.
We will take this one small step at a time together. Do you have any seeds ready?
Yes, I have them in my hand right now.
That is a great start, and I am happy to help. Do you have a pot or a hole to dig?
I have a big pot by the window.
A sunny spot is perfect for sunflowers.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I watched a cat video on my screen today.
That sounds fun. What did the cat do?
It jumped up and knocked over a cup.
Oh no. Did the cat get in trouble?
No, my mom just laughed at it.
She sounds nice. Do you like cats?
Yes, I love soft pets.
I think they are sweet. What is your favorite part of the screen?
I like watching fish swim.
The ocean looks deep. Do you like cold water?
I only like warm baths.
Warm water feels good. Do you have a bath tub?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is this spot a lake?
Yes, it is a big lake. Do you see the blue shape?
I see it. How do I cross it?
There is a bridge right there.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The horse looks very sad. I do not know what to do.
Maybe it is hungry. Do you have any hay?
I gave it an apple yesterday. It looked at me with big eyes.
Apples are good, but hay is its main food. Is it standing still?
Yes, it stands by the fence. I feel worried for it.
That is a good sign. Is its tail moving?
I did not look at the tail. I was looking at its face.
A moving tail means it is healthy. Please check the tail now.
You are right. The tail is swishing. It looks happy now.
I am glad you checked. Does it want to play?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to put up a new fence, but I do not know if it will be hard.
It can be a little tricky, but we can do it together. Do you have any tools ready?
I have a big shovel and some big posts.
That is a great start! Do you know where the lines go?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am going to the beach this week.
That sounds like fun. What will you play in the sand?
I will build a big castle.
A big castle sounds cool. Will it have a moat?
I hope so, but I am not sure.
Try to make it! Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am too tired to do my homework today.
That sounds hard. Do you want to take a quick break first?
Yes, I want to play with my toy dog.
Playing can help you feel better. Do you usually play before your work?
No, but I feel sad when I have to sit still.
It is okay to feel that way. Let us take a short rest.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do clocks have numbers on them?
They help us read the time easily. Do you like numbers?
Why is the short hand so short?
It moves slow to show the hour. Is it confusing?
I do not know why we use two hands.
Each hand shows a different part of time. I do not know if you like that.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel sad because my friend got a new toy.
That is a feeling many people have. Did you ask if they want to play together?
No, I was too busy looking at the toy.
Tell them the truth about your feelings. Do you think they will listen?
I hope so, but I am worried they will get angry.
Honesty is usually the best path to fix a friendship. Is your friend a kind person?
Yes, they are very sweet.
Then be brave and talk to them soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very tired when I go to school.
That sounds hard. Do you get enough sleep?
I try, but my mind will not stop thinking.
Try to write your thoughts down before bed.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do cows have big udders?
They make milk for their babies. Do you like drinking milk?
Yes, I do. Why do chickens cluck?
They talk to each other and warn of danger. Do you like to talk to birds?
Sometimes. Why do pigs roll in mud?
Mud keeps them cool and stops bugs from biting. Do you like to play in the mud?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to build a shed, but I am lost.
That can feel big. Do you have a plan for where it will go?
I have a spot in the yard, but I am not sure how to start.
Start with the floor. Do you like the idea of wood?
Wood sounds hard. I think I might fail.
You can learn. Would you like to read a simple guide?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do I see red and blue in the sky?
The sun makes the light. Rain drops break it into colors. Do you like the colors?
Yes, I love the red one.
Red is a warm color. Is the rain still falling?
No, it is dry now.
That is good. Dry air is nice. Do you feel happy?
Yes, I feel very good.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because I read that some kings were very mean to their people.
That sounds very sad. Did the stories make you feel angry?
Yes, it feels unfair to me. I want to know if they were punished for being bad.
Some were, but many were not caught. Do you think justice matters?
I guess it should, but it is confusing to figure out what happened. I feel like I do not understand the past.
It is hard to see the whole truth. Would you like to pick a nicer story next?
Maybe later. Right now I just need a break from the heavy stuff.
Taking a break is smart. Do you want to talk about fun times instead?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go fast. What is that bird?
It looks like a sparrow. Do you like red birds?
No time. Where is the big blue one?
I do not know where it went. Do you check the tree?
I cannot wait. Is it safe there?
Yes, the tree is safe. Do you have food for it?
I must leave now. Bye.
Bye. Do you come back later?
Yes. Thanks.
You are welcome. I will wait for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this new town. The streets look so gray and cold.
That is a hard feeling. Do you miss your old home?
