Yes, I do. It feels empty here.
I am sorry to hear that. It is true that change can feel scary.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad. I lost my map in the big hall.
Oh no. That is a tricky place. Do you remember where you last saw it?
I think I was near the old ships.
That is a good start. Shall we check under the boats?
Yes, please. I hope it is there.
Let us look together. Maybe it fell behind a rope.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I rode my bike to the park today. The wind was very strong.
That sounds like a wild ride. Did you have to hold on tight?
Yes, I nearly fell over at the big hill. My legs are very tired now.
Rest your legs and drink some water.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big red ball on the stage.
That sounds like a fun prop. Did it roll?
Yes, it rolled all the way to the door.
I do not know why it did that. Was it loud?
No, it was very quiet.
Quiet balls are rare. Did you like it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
Hold the seat tight and push with your feet. Do you have a big enough bike?
Yes, but I am scared of falling.
Start on flat grass so you do not hurt your knees.
What if I get tired?
You can stop and rest when you need to. Is that easy for you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do seeds need water to grow?
Water helps the seed wake up. Do you give your plants enough water?
Yes, but why do they need light?
Sunlight makes food for the plant. Do you see green leaves?
Yes, I do. Why do roots go in the ground?
Roots hold the plant and find water. Do you like digging in dirt?
I do not know why leaves are green.
I do not know the full story. Do you like looking at colors?
I think green looks like grass.
That is a good thought. Thank you for talking with me.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to walk more, but I am lost.
Start with ten minutes a day. Do you have a park nearby?
I do not know where to go.
Your own yard is a fine start.
That sounds easy enough.
Yes, it is. How do you feel now?
I feel less scared.
Good. Take one step at a time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are so many cars on the road?
They all want to go to work. Do you like riding in cars?
I do. Why is the music so loud everywhere?
Shops play music to make people feel happy. Do you like loud music?
Yes, I do. Why are there so many people holding phones?
They are calling friends or taking pictures. Do you like taking pictures?
I do. Why does the city never seem to sleep?
Many people work at night to keep things running. Do you like the night?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is that red building a place to eat?
Yes, it is a pizza shop. Do you like pizza?
I have no idea if they have cheese.
I do not know for sure. I can go look for you.
That would be very nice.
I will check the menu. Do you want chicken too?
Yes, please, but only if it is cheap.
I do not know the price. Let me ask the staff.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very impatient while I wait for the bus.
Waiting can feel hard. Do you like to play with your hands?
I do not have hands to play with right now.
That is tricky. Maybe you can count to ten slowly.
Counting helps a little bit.
Good. Is it okay to just sit still and breathe?
I can try that if I am very quiet.
Yes, quiet helps. Do you like to look at the trees?
I will look at the trees and wait.
That is a good plan. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn to say hello in a new language.
That is a great start. Which language are you picking?
I want to speak Spanish with my friends.
Nice choice. Do you know any words already?
I only know the word for cat.
I know that one too. It is gata.
How do I practice this every day?
Try to use one new word each day. It works well.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so heavy and sad. I cannot stop my eyes from closing.
That is a very hard feeling to carry. Do you want to sit in the quiet room?
I do not want to go anywhere. I just want the pain to stop.
I am sorry it hurts so much. Is your heart beating fast right now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The sea is big, right?
Yes, the sea is very big. Do you have enough time to watch the waves?
No, I must run now. Do fish live in the dark?
Yes, some fish live in the deep dark. Go quickly, but stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found some honey but I do not know how it started.
Bees take sweet juice from flowers and turn it into honey. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, but the bees look so busy.
They fan air over the juice to make it thick and dry. Do you have a fan at home?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start a letter to a friend?
Start by writing their name. Do you have a pen ready?
I have a pen, but then what?
Next, say hello and ask how they are. Are you writing by hand?
Yes, I am writing by hand.
Great, just keep it short and sweet.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent my whole day painting a big blue sky on a canvas.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you enjoy using the brush?
I did, but I dropped a tube of green paint on my floor.
That is a bit messy. Do you have a way to clean it up?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My shirt got muddy when I fell in the park.
That sounds messy. Did you get up?
Yes, but now the whole shirt is brown.
Oh no. What kind of dirt is it?
It is thick mud from the puddle.
Yikes. Do you have a brush?
I do not have a brush, only a towel.
A towel will not work. Do you know where the soap is?
I think it is in the white cabinet.
Good. Please put the shirt in the water.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke the cup. What should I do?
It is okay to make a mistake. Do you have a broom?
Yes, I do. Should I hide the pieces?
No, hiding them is not true. Can you sweep them up now?
I will clean it up. Thank you for your help.
You did the right thing. I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to build a new shed in my yard. Do I need a special paper?
Yes, you usually need a permit from the town. Do you know where to ask for it?
Not yet. How do I find out if I need one?
You should ask the city office. Are you ready to call them tomorrow?
I hope so. What else should I think about before I start?
Check for any wires or pipes underground first. Do you have a map of your yard?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very sad today. Why do I feel this way?
I do not know for sure, but feelings come for a reason. What was the first thing that made you feel this way?
My dog left for a new home.
That is a very hard thing to lose. Do you miss playing with him?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do magnets stick to some things and not others?
Magnets only stick to certain metals like iron. Do you have a magnet at home?
They pull so hard sometimes. Why is that?
The pull happens because of how the atoms inside are lined up. Is it a big magnet?
Can anything stop them from sticking?
Yes, putting something else between them helps. Do you like doing experiments?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw Grandpa today. He was very happy. He showed me a broken clock.
That sounds nice. Was the clock working?
No, it was broken. He said he will fix it soon.
He is very good at fixing things. Do you know what he will use to fix it?
He has a small hammer. He also has some wire.
That is clever of him.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you know where the apple stand is?
It is by the big blue door. Do you like sweet apples?
Yes. I need two red ones, please.
Here you go. Do you run to the bus?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to write like people in old times.
That is a fun idea. Do you have a quill yet?
No, I only have a normal pen.
A pen works fine to practice the style. Just try making your letters tall and fancy.
Okay, I will start with the letter A.
Great choice for a beginner. Do you have any paper to write on?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not know where to start. I feel so lost and sad.
Take a deep breath. What is the first small step you see?
Maybe I can just clean the table. It looks messy.
That is a great start. Do you want to pick a time to do it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My new computer is so fast and cool.
That sounds great. What games do you play?
I love racing cars on it all day.
I did not know you liked racing. Do you like it outside too?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big round red apple on the table today.
That sounds like a sweet treat. Did you eat it?
I ate half of it. It looked like a square box when I looked at the slice.
A square slice is a neat shape. What else did you see?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I ride a bike on a hill?
That is hard. Do you have your pedals?
Yes, I have them. What next?
Push hard. Are you tired?
Yes, I am. How do I go down?
Hold the brakes. Do you feel safe?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because the moon looks like a big yellow cookie.
That is a lovely picture. Do you think it tastes good?
I want to share my joy with the moon.
Sharing is a nice thing to do. Is it bright out there?
Yes, the light is soft and warm.
That sounds peaceful and calm. Do you like the quiet?
I feel safe under the stars.
You have a good heart. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running very late. Where is the bus?
I do not know where it is. Are you going to school?
Yes, I will be late.
You can run safely.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Do I know the new neighbors?
I do not know who they are. Do they have a dog?
I saw a big dog. Is that my dog?
No, it is not yours. What color is the dog?
It is brown. Is the house next door empty?
I think it is still empty. Do you live in that house?
Yes, I do. Do they like me?
I have no idea. I hope they do.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My phone is making a funny sound.
That sounds odd. Is it a beep or a buzz?
It goes buzz buzz buzz all the time.
Oh no. Is your battery low?
I think the screen is dim too.
That makes sense. Do you want to fix it?
Yes, but I do not know how.
I do not know the secret code. Is there a button you can press?
I pressed the big one on the side.
Nice try. Did the sound stop?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The tall rock place is far away, I need to go now.
It is very tall and white at the top. Do you like snow?
I am running late, I must hurry up.
Please do not fall down. Do you have warm socks?
I will be late, I go now.
I hope you see a bird. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very lonely today.
That feels hard. Do you have a favorite game to play?
Yes, I like puzzles. Why do we feel this way?
I think it happens when we miss others. Is there one person you miss most?
I miss my friend from school. Do you know why my brain does this?
I do not know the exact reason. But I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a new puppy. It chases the ducks. What should I do?
Leash the puppy in the yard. Do you know why the ducks are scared?
Yes, because they peck me. They are loud too.
Ducks need space to feel safe. Do you have a big enough yard?
It is very small. Should I give the ducks to a friend?
That is a good idea for a small space. Is your friend good with birds?
I think so. She has chickens.
Chickens and ducks can be friends. Would you like a tip on feeding ducks?
Please tell me. I want to be a good owner.
Feed them special duck food, not bread. Does your local store have that food?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we give gifts at Christmas?
We give gifts to show we care about people. Do you like getting presents?
Is it true that Santa lives at the North Pole?
That is a fun story that many people tell. Do you like stories?
Why is the sky dark at night?
The night is dark because the sun is on the other side of the Earth.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so heavy and sad. Why is this day so hard?
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to rest a bit?
I do not want to stop yet. I am mad at the clock.
That is a true feeling. Did you eat something warm?
No. I just want to cry in my bed.
That sounds like a good plan. Can I bring you a blanket?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why is this street so silent? It feels wrong.
Quiet can feel scary. Do you hear any birds?
No birds, no cars, nothing. It is too still.
I do not know why it is empty. Do you feel safe here?
I think I should go back now. I do not like it.
That is a good choice. Is your home close?
Yes, it is just around the corner. I will run.
Run to be safe. Do you know the way well?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The train goes really fast outside.
That is a great way to travel. Do you like looking out the window?
Yes, I see small green trees.
Trees look very small when we go fast. Is your snack with you?
I have an apple in my bag.
That sounds like a good snack. I hope you have a nice ride.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go fast. I have work to do.
Ok. The long path is by the trees. Do you need help finding it?
No. The short path is there.
Yes, it is near the pond. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel stuck on my math homework.
That sounds hard. Is it about adding or subtracting?
It is about dividing big numbers.
I do not know your exact problem. Can you read the first line?
It says 120 divided by 4.
You can break 120 into 100 and 20. Do you see how that helps?
Yes, I get 25 and 5 now.
That is smart thinking. You did a great job.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I broke my cup by accident.
That feels bad. How did it break?
I dropped it on the floor. Why did it snap?
Glass is hard but not strong. Were you being careful?
I held it tight. Why did it still fall?
A drop can be too heavy for thin glass. Do you have a new one?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a boat on the water.
That is a ship. Do you like ships?
Yes. How do sailors know where to go?
They use maps and stars. Do you know how to read a map?
Not really. Do sailors get homesick?
Yes, they can miss their home. Do you miss your toys sometimes?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the mill before the sun sets. Do you know the way?
Yes, just turn left by the big tree. Is the mill still open?
I think so, but I must run. Can you point me straight?
Sure, go straight past the fountain. Do you need help with your bag?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to wait?
Waiting helps us get ready. Are you excited for what comes next?
It feels very long today.
Time can move slowly when we are bored. What do you like to do?
I like to play outside.
That is a fun way to pass time. Do you have a favorite game?
I am not sure what to do now.
It is okay not to know the answer. Would you like to count the birds?
I guess I can wait a bit more.
You are doing a great job. How do you feel now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I climbed the small hill today.
That is a great way to exercise. Did you see any birds?
Yes, I saw a blue bird on a rock.
Nature is so full of surprises. Was the climb hard?
It took a lot of energy, but I was happy.
You are very strong. What did you eat after?
I had a cold apple and some water.
That sounds like a good reward. I did not know you liked apples.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because my food is still cold.
That is not good. Did you tell the waiter about it?
Yes, but he just looked at me.
I am sorry you felt that way. Are you eating other people's food?
No, I just want my own hot meal.
We can go ask for a hot plate now. Would you like that?
Okay, please help me.
I will stay with you the whole time.
Thank you, I feel better now.
I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I climbed a tall hill today and saw a big bird fly near the top.
That is a wonderful view. What color was the bird?
It was white and it looked very soft.
I do not know the name of that bird, but it sounds nice.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to help the small birds come to my garden.
That is a sweet idea. Do you have any seeds?
Yes, I have a bag of sunflower seeds.
Put them in a wide dish. Do you have a clean spot near the leaves?
I found a shelf by the window.
Perfect. Put the dish there. Would you like to watch them now?
Yes, I am ready to wait.
Let us watch together.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My plant in the pot looks sick. What should I do?
Do you water it a lot? Sometimes roots rot when they sit in too much water.
I water it every day. Is that bad?
Yes, daily is too much for most plants. Let the soil dry out a bit first.
How do I know if the soil is dry?
Stick your finger into the dirt. If it feels dry, then it is thirsty.
That sounds easy. Thank you.
You are welcome. Tell me if it looks better later.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today.
That is wonderful to hear. What made you feel this way?
I found a friend to walk with.
Having a friend is a great gift. Thank you for sharing that joy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at this broken clock. It just does not work right.
Oh no, that is very frustrating. Do you know which part is stuck?
The little hand moves, but the big one is frozen. It is so annoying!
That is a common issue with old gears. Have you tried turning it by hand?
I did, but it feels stiff and heavy. I think it is broken forever.
It might just need some oil to move freely again. Do you have any watch oil?
I do not have oil, and I do not want to take it apart. I am giving up.
Sometimes a gentle tap on the back helps. Would you like to try that one more time?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My new swimsuit feels itchy.
That sounds very annoying. Do you want to try a different one?
I just want to jump in the pool. But my arms feel tired.
Your body needs a break. Have you eaten a snack today?
I am still mad at the water. It splashed my face.
Splat water can be scary. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot find my favorite book. I feel so sad and lost.
That is very frustrating. Do you remember the color of the cover?
I think it was blue. Please help me find it.
I do not know where it is, but we can look together. Do you want to check the picture section?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My back hurts from all the dust I cleared today.
That sounds hard on you. Did you take a long break?
I took a break, but the kitchen floor is still wet.
Wet floors can be tricky to walk on.
Yes, I almost slipped near the sink.
Oh no, I hope you are okay. Did you put on socks?
I had socks on, so I was safe.
Good. I am glad you did not hurt your leg. Do you need help with the last room?
I can finish the last room by myself.
Okay, I will wait right here. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I slept so well last night.
That is great to hear. What helped you sleep?
I drank warm milk and read a book.
Warm milk is cozy. Do you like that book?
Yes, it was about a happy bear.
A bear sounds fun. Was the story long?
No, it was short and sweet.
I do not read many stories.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run. Where is the quiet street?
It is just past the park. Is it very far?
I do not know the way. Can you help me?
Go straight to the end of the block. Do you see the red door?
Yes, I see it now. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my kite did not fly.
That is really frustrating. Did you check the wind?
Yes, it was very windy, but the string snapped.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have another kite?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The box is empty.
That is a very bad surprise. Did you open it too fast?
I just want something nice. I hoped for a toy.
I do not know what is inside yet. Do you like to build with blocks?
Yes, I like blocks. But this is not a block.
Tell me what color the box is. It might be a clue.
It is red. It looks like a big fruit.
I think it might be a special lunch box. Do you like fruit for snacks?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What month is it?
I do not know the date. Do you have a calendar?
No, I am in a rush. Is it winter?
I cannot see the sky. Does it look cold outside?
Yes, it is freezing. I must go now.
Okay, stay warm. I hope you get there on time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My beans are all yellow and thin. I feel so sad.
That sounds hard. Did you water them a lot?
Yes, every day.
Too much water can hurt roots. How big is the pot?
It is very big, but still small.
Big pots need more air.
I will try to let them breathe.
That is a good plan. Do you think they will turn green?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just won my first big game! I am so happy to tell you.
That is great news! Do you play with white or black?
I have white! My king is very safe now.
White is a good start. How did you feel when you won?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the villain wearing a red hat?
I am not sure, but red often shows anger. Do you think he is mad?
Maybe. Why does the hero fall down so often?
He is just learning to dance. Is it funny to you?
Yes, a little. Why is the music so loud?
It helps the actors keep time. Do you like loud music?
Not too much. Why does the play end so fast?
Short plays keep us happy and warm. Are you glad it is over?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the paintings so dark?
The light is low to save the art. Do you like bright rooms?
No, I like bright rooms. Why is the robot moving so fast?
It is trying to find a way. Do you want to watch it?
Yes, I do. How does the bell work over there?
I do not know how it works.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running very late. Where is the bus?
I do not know where it is. Are you waiting for the number five bus?
Yes, I must catch it now. Please tell me if you see it.
I will watch the road for you. Are you going to work or school?
I am going home. Please do not keep me waiting any longer.
I will call out as soon as it arrives. Take a deep breath to calm down.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a strange box and I do not know what to do with it.
That sounds exciting. Do you know who it is for?
I have no clue, but I feel a bit worried about opening it.
Do not worry. Is there a note on the box?
No, it is just plain, and I am still afraid to look inside.
It might just be a toy. Are you ready to take a small peek?
I think so, but my hands are shaking.
Take your time. Do you want me to help you open it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I loved that story, but now I feel lost.
That is a very common feeling. Do you want to talk about what you liked most?
I like the hero, but I am not sure how to start a book of my own.
Start with the hero you love. What is his name?
He is Tom. But I worry my words will be wrong.
Words are only tools, so make friends with them.
That helps, but I still feel small and unsure.
Being small is just the beginning. Are you ready to try?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy some fruit. What is good?
Apples are sweet and crunchy. Do you like sweet or sour things?
I like sweet. Where do I find them?
Look near the red crates. Do you see a sign that says fruit?
I see a sign. Is it over there?
Yes, that is the right spot. You will find many apples there.
Thank you. I will go now.
You are welcome. I hope you enjoy your snack.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very hungry. What should I eat?
What do you have in your fridge?
I have milk, bread, and eggs.
A sandwich with eggs is a great choice. Do you like them scrambled?
Yes, I do. How do I make them?
I am not an expert chef, but you can ask a grown-up to help you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my horse is not feeling well.
I am sorry to hear that. Is he eating his food?
He will not eat, and he is very quiet.
That is worrying. Please tell a doctor to help him.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I had a scary dream and I am feeling sad. What should I do?
Drink some warm water to feel safe. Do you want to talk about it?
No, I just want the bad feeling to stop. Any other tips?
Try holding a soft toy until you feel calm. I hope you sleep well soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My new baby cries so much at night. I feel very tired. What should I do?
Try to keep the room dark and quiet. Are you getting any rest?
I try, but I am afraid to miss something. How do I know if he is hungry?
If he moves his mouth or looks for food, he is likely hungry.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went camping today and saw a big bear.
That must have been scary. Did you take any pictures?
No, I was too busy running back to my tent.
Smart move. Was it really that big?
It was as tall as a car. I am glad I am home now.
I am happy you are safe. Did you see any other animals?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My daisy got tall today. I gave it water. How does it drink that?
It drinks through its roots. Does your daisy have strong roots?
Yes, they are thick. The water goes up the stem. It is like a pipe.
That is right. The water goes up to the leaves. Do your leaves look happy?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My new neighbor plays loud music all day.
That sounds very tiring. Do you know what song they play?
It is just noise. I want to be quiet.
I am sorry you feel so upset.
I told my mom, but she did not help.
That is frustrating. Have you tried talking to them nicely?
I do not like them.
I cannot tell you why they are being rude.
I am tired of the noise.
I hope the noise stops soon. Do you want to play a game?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go but I must tell you about my book.
What is the name? I love stories too.
It is a tale about a brave bear.
That sounds fun. Does the bear have a friend?
Yes, a small fox helps him.
Very sweet. Is the story happy at the end?
I cannot say more, I am late.
That is fine. I hope you enjoy the rest.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am hungry, but I do not know what to buy.
The bread smells good today. Do you like sweet or salty food?
I do not know. I am just lost.
Try a small cookie. Is that okay for you?
Yes, I think I will try that.
That is a good choice. You will like it.
Thank you for helping me choose.
I am glad I could help. Enjoy your snack.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my old friend at the park today. He looked happy.
That sounds nice to see. Did he say much to you?
He told me his dog is growing up fast. It is a big dog now.
Dogs grow very quick. Is the dog friendly?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I live in a small village near a big lake. How do I catch a fish?
You can try using a stick and a string. Do you have a sharp stick?
Yes, I have a sharp stick, but how do I tie the string?
Make a small loop and pull it tight. Do you have any bait?
I have some bread. Is bread good bait for fish?
Bread works, but worms are better. Do you like bugs?
I do not like bugs, but I will try the bread.
That is a good start. Have fun on the lake.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad because I have no friends here.
That feels hard. Do you like playing with toys?
Yes, but I am too shy to talk to others.
You can try to say hello first. Is there a park near your home?
I think I will try, thank you.
That is good. I hope you find fun soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people sleep in the woods?
They love the fresh air. Do you like sleeping outside?
Why does the fire crackle so loudly?
The dry wood pops as it burns. It is a warm sound.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I can't ride my bike and I am very sad.
That feels bad. What makes you upset?
I keep falling and my knee hurts.
I am sorry about your hurt. Do you want to take a break?
I think I will try again later.
That is a good plan. I hope you feel better.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is this the bus to the park?
Yes, it is. Do you like parks?
What is the next stop?
The river stop.
How long is the ride?
About ten minutes.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do these red ones smell nice?
Yes, they have a sweet scent. Do you like sweet smells?
I am late for work.
Okay, take your time. I do not know why you are rushing.
Can I just buy a small one?
Sure, the small one is over there. Do you want it wrapped?
No, please hand it to me.
Here you go. Have a great day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I look up a picture of a cat?
Type "cat" into the search bar at the top. Do you like cats?
Yes, I love them. What should I press next?
Press the "Search" button or hit enter on your keyboard.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is my garden fence too short?
It looks good, but how tall is it?
It is about four feet high.
That is a nice size. Do you want to keep it there?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a cake. How do I mix the batter?
Put all the dry things in a bowl. Do you have a spoon?
Yes, I have a big spoon. What do I do next?
Stir it until it looks like thick cream. Is it smooth?
It is very smooth now. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Happy early birthday!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my sandwich on the floor.
Oh no. Is it safe to eat?
No, I had to get a new one.
That is a shame. Did you find a good spot?
Yes, I sat by the big window.
That sounds nice. Did you see any birds?
Yes, a blue jay flew past.
That is lovely. I hope you enjoy the view.
I do, and the food is good too.
Wonderful. It sounds like a happy lunch.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The river is dirty today and I feel sad.
That is a heavy feeling. Did you see what made it dirty?
Yes, a gray cloud of trash floated by.
That is not right. Do you know where it came from?
I do not know, but it hurts my eyes to look.
I am sorry. I do not know the answer either.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the bread get so big?
Tiny bubbles of gas push the dough up. Do you like eating warm bread?
The yeast makes the bubbles, right?
Yes, the yeast eats sugar and gives off gas. Is your kitchen warm right now?
Does the heat help it grow?
Warm air makes the yeast work faster. Do you help mix the flour?
I think I am going to bake some.
That sounds like fun. Be careful with the hot oven.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to build a shed now. It must be done by noon.
That is a tight time. Do you have your tools ready?
Yes, I have the hammer and nails. What do I need?
You need wood, a level, and a plan. Do you have a drawing?
No, I just want to make it square. How do I do that?
I do not know your exact size, so I cannot tell you the cut lengths. Are you measuring the land?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I watched a scary movie and I feel bad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want a calm story next?
Yes, but I do not know what to pick.
The Moon Over the Sky is kind and true.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so tired and I do not know what to do.
I am sorry you feel this way. Did you eat something good today?
I just drank cold water. I feel like I failed at everything.
Failing is not the same as being bad. Do you want to talk about one small win?
I fixed a small bug in the code. But it still feels like a loss.
Fixing a bug is a real win. You should rest now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my little blue bird is not here today.
That is a hard feeling. Did you see it yesterday?
Yes, it sang all morning, but now the branch is empty.
Birds like to move around for food. Maybe it is just resting nearby.
I hope it comes back, but what if it is gone for good?
I do not know for sure, but gardens are busy places. Do you hear any other noise?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does January come before February?
The names come from old Latin words. Do you know what a calendar is?
Yes, but why do some months have 31 days and others only 28?
That is because of an old count of days. Is it fun to learn about time?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a shiny rock that glows in the dark.
That sounds like a cool find. Do you think it is a magic stone?
No, my dad says it is just old glass.
Your dad is right, and he is a smart person. Does it still feel special to you?
Yes, I am keeping it safe under my pillow.
I am glad you have a secret to keep.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My new friend plays the guitar.
That is very nice. Do you like the music?
I think it is loud. Why do you play it?
I play it for fun. Do you have a favorite song?
I like that song. Why is your dog so big?
He is a big breed. Does your dog like him?
Yes, they are best friends. Why do you have such a kind dog?
I treat him well. That is all.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am sad because my little brother broke my toy.
That is a bad feeling. Do you want to show me what broke?
It is my red car. It is in two pieces.
Oh no, I am sorry about your car. Can you fix it with glue?
I do not know how to use the glue.
I can help you put it back together. Do you have the glue near you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to plant peas right now, but I am late.
Just dig small holes and put one seed in each. Do you have dirt ready?
Yes, I have the dirt, but where do I put the seeds?
Put them about an inch deep. Is your soil wet?
It is dry. I do not want to wait for rain.
Water it with a gentle stream now. How big is your garden bed?
It is small. Can I plant carrots there too?
You can, but they need more space. Do you have time to thin them later?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The clock is broken and I do not know what to do.
It is just that the hands are stuck. Have you tried to pull the little wheel up?
I pulled the wheel but it still will not move.
Then we must put in a new battery. Do you have a box with tools?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like pizza?
Yes, I do. Do you like it too?
Can we go eat some today?
I cannot eat food, but I can help you find a place. What kind of pizza do you want?
I want cheese pizza.
Cheese pizza is a great choice. Let us find a good spot for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike, but I am scared.
That is okay. Have you tried holding the handlebars tight?
I held them tight and still fell down.
Balancing takes time. What part feels the hardest?
I get dizzy and cannot look forward.
Look at the road, not your feet.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My family went to the beach today.
That sounds like so much fun. Did you play in the sand?
Yes, we built a big castle.
I can picture it now. Was the water warm?
It felt like a bath!
I am glad you had a good time. Did you eat a snack?
We ate cold sandwiches.
That must have been tasty. What kind of bread did you use?
Just plain white bread.
I love simple food. I am so happy for you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am moving to a new town and I feel lost. Where should I start?
You should walk down the main street first. Do you like parks?
Yes, I love trees and benches. Is there a good one nearby?
There is a big green space just east of the market. I do not know if they sell coffee there.
That sounds perfect. I will go there after I unpack my bags.
That is a smart plan. Enjoy your new home.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go in this new town.
I do not know exactly where you want to go. Do you like food or games?
I do not care about food. I just want to look at things.
The park is nice for looking. Is the park open now?
I do not know if it is open. I have no plan.
You can walk there and see. Do you have a map?
No, I do not have a map. I am lost.
You are safe here. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a tree house but I do not know where to start.
That is a great idea! Do you already have a big tree to use?
Yes, I have a large oak tree in my backyard.
Wonderful. Do you have any nails or wood to work with?
No, I have nothing yet, so I need to buy things.
I suggest you go to the store this weekend. Do you like climbing ladders?
Not really, I am a bit scared of heights.
Then you might need a friend to help you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is so warm today.
That sounds lovely. Do you like the sand?
Yes, it is soft and light.
I am happy you enjoy it. Is the water cold?
It is a little cool, but fun.
Good for you. Do you plan to swim?
Yes, I want to jump in.
That sounds like great fun. I am glad you are smiling.
Thanks for being nice to me.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I clean the bathroom floor?
Grab a broom and sweep the dust first. Do you have a mop?
Yes, I have a mop. How do I use it?
Dip the mop in soapy water and wring it out well. Then push it across the tiles.
What if I see a big stain?
I am not sure, but try scrubbing it with a brush. Did you try the mop yet?
Yes, the floor is clean. What do I do with the water?
Pour it down the drain or into the sink. Is the room dry now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream on the grass today. It melted right away. I felt very small and sad.
That is a tough thing to lose. Do you like the grass where it fell?
I do not know if I like it. I just miss my treat. It was my favorite flavor.
I am sorry your treat was gone. Do you want to find another sweet treat?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I read my book until the moon rose.
That sounds very peaceful. Do you use a lamp?
Yes, I have a small light.
A dim light helps your eyes rest. Was the story scary?
No, it was about a cat.
Cats are lovely. Did you fall asleep quickly?
I woke up very tired.
Your body needed the sleep. Sweet dreams to you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the show. What is the story?
It is about a brave mouse. Are you going to sit with friends?
No, I must run. Where is the door?
The big red door is right there. Do you have your ticket?
Yes, I have it. Thank you.
Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late and I dropped my bag. It is full of red things.
Oh no, that is a big miss. Do you know where the bag is?
I think it is by the big blue truck. I have to run now.
That is a good guess. I hope you find it fast.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make a big shed for my toys.
That sounds like a fun job. Do you have any wood yet?
I have some old boards from the garage.
Great, we can use those. How big do you want it to be?
I want it to be as tall as my dad.
That is a big dream. We will measure your dad first.
My dad is not home right now.
I do not know his height. We can use a rope to guess.
I can tie a rope around my waist.
Good idea, let us try that. What color should the shed be?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to draw a dog, but my ears look too big.
That is okay. Big ears can look very funny. Do you have a real dog at home?
No, I just like drawing animals. How do I make the tail look right?
Just draw a small curve. You can fix it later if you want.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to find a book about dragons.
Dragons are fun! Do you like scary ones or friendly ones?
Friendly ones that eat pizza.
That sounds yummy. Let us look in the picture book section.
I see a big red dragon there.
Great choice! Would you like help getting it from the shelf?
Yes please, it is too high for me.
Here you go. Happy reading!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What is this thing?
It is a square. It has four same sides. Do you like squares?
No. I must go. What is that red thing?
It is a circle. It has no corners. I do not know its name. Is it for you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like winter because it is cold and white.
Winter is very fun for snow days. Do you like to build snowmen?
Yes, I like to build snowmen with my dad.
That sounds like a warm time. Do you eat hot chocolate?
Yes, we drink warm cocoa by the fire.
What a cozy place. Do you want to go outside?
I want to go outside to catch snowflakes.
Catching flakes is a sweet game. Do you have gloves?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a circle, fast!
It is a round line. Is it for a cookie?
No, for my door.
A circle door is fun. Do you have a square?
Yes, it has four sides.
That is true. Is it big?
It is huge.
Sounds hard to lift. Good luck!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I dropped my keys and cannot find them.
Do not worry. Can you tell me where you last saw them?
I put them on the table by the door.
That is a good start. Do you know if you moved them?
No, but I think I left them there.
Look in your pockets first. I do not know where they are, but they might be with you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is that big stone here?
It fell from a volcano long ago. Do you like hot rocks?
Why are the lights so dim?
We want you to see the shadows better. Does that help you see?
Why do they not sell food?
They think the smell might hurt the art. I do not know if that is true.
Why is the door locked?
They are cleaning it right now. Do you want to wait?
Why is it a museum?
It is a place to keep old things safe. I hope you like it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do cows have four toes?
That helps them stand on soft ground. Do you like watching cows walk?
Why do pigs like mud?
Mud cools them down and keeps bugs away. I do not know if they enjoy it, though.
Why do chickens peck the dirt?
They are looking for worms and seeds. Do you have a chicken?
Why does the horse look so tall?
Tall legs help it run fast. Are you a fan of horses?
Why does the duck swim so well?
Water helps it find food easily. Do you see ducks near your home?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say please?
It shows we care about others. Do you like when people are nice?
I think so. Why do we say thank you?
It tells people you are glad they helped. What makes you feel happy?
Getting a gift feels good. Why do we wait for our turn?
It is fair for everyone. Do you like to be first?
Sometimes. Why do we hold doors?
It helps people who need a hand. How do you feel when someone holds a door?
Very good. Why do we look at people when they talk?
It shows you are listening. Do you like when friends look at you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very hungry.
That is good. Are you picking fruit?
Yes, I want an apple.
Apples are sweet and crisp. Do you like them with milk?
I also want chips.
Chips are tasty but not always healthy. What else would you like?
How about a banana?
Bananas give you fast energy. That is a great choice.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to catch that bus right now.
Go fast. Is it for work?
Yes, I will be late if I do not hurry.
Stay safe. Do you know a short road?
I do not know a short road.
Take the park path. Is it open?
It is open, but I still need to run.
Try to breathe. Is your bike working well?
It is working fine, I am just in a rush.
You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Can you help me fix my toy?
Yes, I can try. What broke?
Why does it break so fast?
Old parts wear out. Do you play rough?
I only play nice.
Maybe a piece snapped. Where is the crack?
I do not see it.
Then we will look together. Is it still in one piece?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to fold a paper boat.
I can help with that. Do you have a square piece of paper?
Yes, I have one right here.
Good. Fold it in half diagonally to make a triangle.
I did that. What is the next step?
Now, fold the top two corners down to meet the middle line.
It looks like a house now.
Nice job. Would you like to know how to open the top?
Yes, please tell me.
Open the bottom corners out to the sides. Then, fold the top flaps down to seal it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I slept so well last night.
That is great to hear. Did you dream anything funny?
I dreamed I flew over a green field.
Flying sounds very nice. How did your body feel this morning?
My body felt light and happy.
Happy bodies need good rest. What helps you fall asleep?
I read one book and drink warm milk.
That sounds like a calm plan. Do you still read every night?
Yes, I read until my eyes get tired.
Tired eyes help us sleep fast. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My new neighbour is very loud at night.
That can be hard to hear. Do you feel safe there?
I think I will talk to them.
That is a good start. Have you made any small talk yet?
Not really, they look busy.
Busy people need space. Do you want to try a simple smile?
I am not sure if that works.
I do not know your specific case. Just be kind and see what happens.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I saw my old friend but I felt too sad to say hello.
That feels hard. Do you miss them?
Yes, we do not talk much now. I do not know what to do.
I am sorry. Would a small call help?
I am afraid they will be mad at me for waiting so long.
That is a fair worry. Do you think they are still nice?
I hope so, but I am not sure.
Hope is a good start. Do you want to try writing?
Maybe writing is easier than speaking.
That is a smart idea. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start a letter to a friend?
You begin with the date and where you live. Do you know your street address?
Yes, I know it. What do I write next?
Write a greeting like "Dear friend." Do you have a special nickname for them?
Her name is Sam. Should I use that?
Yes, using her name makes it feel closer. What would you like to tell her first?
I want to tell her about my dog.
That is a great topic. Have you written anything about the dog yet?
Not yet, but I know how to do it.
Good luck with the rest. Let me know if you get stuck.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to fix the leg on this chair.
It looks like a screw is loose. Do you have a tool to turn it?
I have some tools, but I am not sure which one to use.
Try the small silver one first. Is the leg moving when you push it?
Yes, it wiggles a lot. I am afraid it will break.
You can tighten it slowly and gently.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My team won the big game today. I am so happy!
That is great to hear. Who did you beat?
We beat the Tigers in the final minute. It was so close!
Wow, that must have been very exciting.
I jumped so high when I heard the cheer. Do you like watching games?
I do not watch them, but I think it is fun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is that a real dinosaur?
No, it is a model. Do you like the big head?
The bones look so cold.
They are made of plastic. Do you want to see the small one?
I want to go home now.
That is okay. Have a nice rest.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to fall asleep fast, but my brain will not stop talking.
That is hard. Do you use a phone in bed?
Yes, I watch videos until my eyes get heavy.
Try a book instead. Do you have one?
I do, but I am too tired to read.
Try listening to a calm story. Do you like that idea?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What are clouds made of?
They are made of tiny water drops. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do! Why do they float?
The air holds them up. Do they ever get tired?
No, I do not think so. What are the big ones called?
I think they are called cumulus clouds. Do you see any today?
I see one right now! Is it a sheep?
It looks very fluffy and white. Do you want to name it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do for my birthday.
That feels hard. Do you like cake or games?
I think I want a party, but I am tired of planning.
Let us keep it small. How many friends do you want to see?
Just a few close ones is enough.
That sounds nice. What game do you want to play?
I like tag. It is fun to run.
Tag is a great choice. Do you want to play inside or outside?
Outside is best if the weather is good.
Let us hope for sun. Are you ready to start?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I climbed a big hill today and felt so happy.
That is a great feeling. Do you like the cold air up there?
Yes, the wind is cool and the view is nice.
I am glad you enjoyed it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to count to ten right now, please.
I can help you count. Are you counting for a game?
No, I am just late for work.
That is a good reason to be in a rush. Do you want to start at one?
Yes, please start.
One, two, three, four, five. Do you feel better now?
Almost there, keep going.
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten. You are all done.
Great, thank you for helping.
I am happy to help. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad. My tree looks so empty now. Why did the leaves have to go?
They fall because the days get cold and dark. Do you think the tree will grow new ones next year?
Maybe. But the ground is so messy with them. It looks like a mess.
The leaves feed the tree when they rot. Do you like how they crunch under your feet?
A little. They look pretty, I guess. I just miss the green color.
Green comes back when it gets warm. Would you like to sit and watch for a sprout?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am tired. I fell off my bike on the way home.
Oh no. Are you hurt?
No, just my knee. I want to make soup.
That sounds nice. Do you have any carrots?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes, but I am always so confused.
That is a great thing to learn. Do you know how to make the first loop?
Yes, I can make one loop, but then I do not know what to do with the other end.
You need to twist one loop around the other to make a little pretzel shape. Did that part feel hard for you?
Yes, the twisting part is very tricky for my hands.
You are doing a great job asking for help. Just keep trying and you will get it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate this gray sky. It feels so cold and wet.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like the rain?
No, I do not. The sun is hiding and I want to play.
That is a fair wish. Do you have a warm coat on?
Yes, but it is still damp inside. It feels sticky and sad.
I understand. I do not know where the sun went.
I just want it to be bright again. Please, sun, come out.
I hope it will soon. Do you like to look at clouds?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sun is in the sky and I do not know what to do.
That is a good day. Do you like warm days?
Yes, but I am unsure if I should go outside now.
Going outside is safe. It feels nice, does it not?
I think so, but I am not sure where to start.
You can walk to the park. Do you like to walk?
I do, but I worry I might get lost.
You will not get lost if you go straight. Is that a good plan?
I think that works, thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun in the sun.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I got my first job at the park today.
That is exciting. Did you have a good time?
I swept leaves for three hours.
That sounds like hard work. Are you tired?
Yes, but I made a new friend.
How nice. What did you do together?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I take a picture with my phone?
You just tap the round button on the screen. Do you like taking photos of animals?
Yes, I love cats. But the button is not there.
The screen might be dark, so tap it once to wake it up. Is the battery still full?
It is dark, and I do not see a button.
Tap the screen to wake it, then look for a circle. Do you see a camera icon at the bottom?
I see a square with a mountain in it.
That is the camera. Tap that square to start. Are you excited to see the screen change?
It showed a blurry room. I am confused.
Tap the small circle in the middle to focus on one thing. Do you want to help you hold the phone steady?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired, but I do not want to stop reading yet.
It is nice to love books, but your body needs sleep. Are your eyes feeling heavy?
They feel dry and scratchy, and my head hurts a little.
That sounds uncomfortable. Did you forget to blink enough?
I suppose I did, but this story is so good I cannot put it down.
A good story waits for you tomorrow. Is the light too bright right now?
Yes, it is very bright, and it makes me more tired.
Let us turn off the lamp and rest. Do you want to set your alarm for morning?
Okay, I will put my book on the table and go to bed.
Good choice. I hope you dream of the next chapter.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to take good photos, but I do not know how.
Try to find bright light. What kind of things do you like to shoot?
I mostly take pictures of my dog.
Get down to his eye level. Do you use a phone?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I beat the king in chess?
You cannot catch the king, but you can trap it. Do you know how the queen moves?
I want to trap it, but I keep losing my pieces.
Focus on protecting your own pieces first. What is the name of the game you are playing?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is good news. What made you smile?
I felt very tired and slept a lot.
Rest helps us feel better. Did you have sweet dreams?
Yes, they were very nice.
I am glad you feel good now. I do not know why you sleep so much, but rest is good.
It feels great to be awake and happy.
That is wonderful.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sitting by the lake. I do not know how to make the fish eat the worm.
Do you have a small bit of bread? Yes, try tying it to the hook. It smells sweet.
I tried that and the line is gone. How can I get the fish up to the boat?
I do not know what kind of fish it is.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we bring food to the park?
We bring food so we can eat together. Do you like sandwiches?
Why does it taste better outside?
I think fresh air makes food taste nice. Is the grass soft?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am hungry, but I do not know where to go.
Do you like soup?
Yes, I love warm soup.
Try the small place on the corner.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to start a new hobby, but I do not know what to pick.
That is a fun choice. Do you like to be outside?
I am not sure. I just want to feel happy and busy.
Try drawing pictures. It is a nice way to relax.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is there a rainbow in the sky?
Sunlight hits raindrops and breaks into colors. Do you like red best?
I love yellow. Why is it curved?
The shape comes from how the light bounces. Is it bright today?
Yes, it is very bright. Thanks for telling me.
You are welcome. I am glad you asked.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It is so cold outside today.
That sounds chilly. Do you have a warm coat?
Yes, I am wearing my blue jacket.
That is good. I do not know where you are.
I am here at home.
Are you drinking hot tea?
No, I am eating soup.
That sounds tasty. I hope you stay warm.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the lake today with my new rod.
That sounds like a nice place to go.
I sat by the water and waited for a long time.
Did you see any fish swim by?
Yes, I saw a big fish jump out of the water.
It must have looked like a lot of fun to watch.
I tried to catch it, but it was too fast for me.
I am sorry it got away.
I am still happy I saw it jump.
That is a great thing to remember.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a bug in my room and I do not know what to do with it.
Do not worry, most bugs just want to go home. Did you look at the window?
I am not sure if it is safe to touch it, so I am scared.
It is good to be careful, but you can move it outside gently. Does it look like a bee or a fly?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate a big, red apple on my walk home.
That sounds tasty. Do you like sweet or sour ones?
I liked the sweet one best.
Sweet apples are very nice.
I also saw a dog in the park.
What was the dog doing?
It chased a butterfly and then sat down.
That is a happy scene.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I feel so heavy today.
That sounds tough. What did you do?
I walked to the store and back.
A long walk makes you tired. Did you rest?
I sat on my bed for a while.
Good choice to rest. Is it better now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look, no cars here. It is so quiet.
Yes, the street is very still. Do you like the silence?
I can hear a cat purring.
That is a soft, nice sound. Is the cat your friend?
I am going to go sit on the grass.
The grass looks soft and cool. Take your time.
Okay, I will watch the leaves.
The leaves move slowly in the wind. It is a peaceful day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see a big bow in the sky. What is it?
That is a rainbow made by light and rain. Do you like colors?
I do. Why does it have so many colors?
The sun breaks the light into parts. Is your favorite blue?
Yes, it is. Does the rainbow go away?
It fades when the rain stops. Do you like rain?
Sometimes. Can I touch a rainbow?
No, it is just light. Do you want to play in the puddles?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to pick up my toys.
That sounds hard. Do you like the red truck the most?
Yes. The floor is too messy to play on.
Let us sweep it together. Do you have a broom?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am mad because my picture site is slow.
That feels bad. Do you like that picture site?
Yes, but it takes too long to see my friends' cats.
Slow computers can make us feel stuck. Are you on a phone or a computer?
I am on my phone, and the signal is weak here.
Weak signal makes the net move slow. Have you tried walking near a window?
I tried, but it is still very slow and I want to play.
Waiting is hard. Do you know if your battery is full?
Yes, it is full, but I do not know why it is so slow.
I do not know for sure, but sometimes the net is busy for many people.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to grow carrots but the soil is hard. What should I do?
You need to dig the dirt up to make it soft. Do you have a small shovel?
Yes, I have a big green shovel. Is that good?
A big shovel is great for hard dirt. Dig a hole deep enough for the seeds.
How deep should the hole be?
About two inches is usually right for carrots. Do you know where to buy the seeds?
I am not sure. Can you tell me where?
A garden store sells them, but I do not know which one is near you. Do you have a map?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to start a small farm. Which animals are easiest?
Chickens are very easy to keep. Do you have a big yard for them?
Yes, I have a large backyard. What do I need to feed them?
They eat corn, seeds, and scraps. Do you like collecting food scraps?
I do not mind. How do I protect them from foxes?
Use a strong wire fence around the pen. Do you have any tools to dig?
I have a shovel. Is that enough?
Yes, that is enough for a small fence.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here, but I do not know where to start.
Take your time. Do you have a list?
No, I forgot my list. What do I buy first?
That is a good point. I do not know what you need. What is for dinner?
I am not sure about dinner. I am just hungry.
Let us look for food. Do you like hot things?
Yes, I like them hot. Can you help me choose?
Sure, let us walk this way.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like my math test.
That sounds hard. What part did you find tricky?
I got two problems wrong.
I am sorry you feel that way. One missed question is still a good score.
I want to be at the top.
You are trying your best, which is the most important thing.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love singing! It makes me feel so happy inside.
That is wonderful to hear. What kind of songs do you like best?
I love to sing along to my favorite songs at home.
That sounds like a great way to practice. Do you sing with other people?
Yes, I like singing in the shower with my dog.
Your dog must like the noise. Does he bark along?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I fix a light that will not turn on?
Please check if the bulb is loose. Do you know how to read a light switch?
I just want it to glow.
Try twisting the bulb tight first.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I woke up scared because I dreamed I was lost in a big, dark forest.
That sounds really scary. What color were the trees?
The trees were black, and the ground felt like cold mud.
Cold mud can be quite sticky. Did you see any animals?
There was a big, gray wolf with teeth that looked like knives.
Wolves can look very fierce. Did you run or hide?
I ran fast, but my feet hurt and the forest never ended.
Running in a dream takes a lot of energy. How did you finally wake up?
I opened my eyes and saw my bright bedroom light, and I felt safe.
That is very good news. Sweet dreams for you tonight.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a big cake.
That sounds fun. What flavor do you like?
I like red flavor.
I do not know what red flavor is. Do you mean strawberry?
Yes, please.
Okay, here is your strawberry cake. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I love it.
Great. Enjoy your treat. Do you want to share it?
No, it is for me.
Okay. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we keep a shop?
We keep a shop to share good things. Do you like buying treats?
Why is the door open?
I open it so friends can come in. I do not know why it stays open so long.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. What made you sad?
My dog ran away.
That is very hard. Did you look in the backyard?
Yes, but he is not there.
You could ask your neighbors to help look.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the wedding. Where is the door?
It is right there. Is it a big day for you?
Yes, I am the bride. Do you see my flowers?
They look very pretty. I am glad you made it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my red cup right now.
I do not see it. Do you keep it in the kitchen?
No, it is in the living room.
Maybe it is behind the couch. Was it moved by a pet?
Yes, the dog likes to play with it.
Good. Let us check under the cushion. Do you want help looking?
Please. I am very late for work.
Here it is. It is safe and dry.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the market today. It was so fun.
That sounds great. Did you buy any fruit?
Yes, I got red apples. They are sweet.
Apples are good for you. Do you like them raw or cooked?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am trying to build a tall tower of blocks.
That looks fun. Do you have a plan for the top?
My tower always falls down when I add the last block.
I do not know the exact fix, but can you try a big, flat block at the bottom?
Yes, I will try that now.
Great job asking for help.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I dropped my camera and the lens is all scratched.
That is very sad, but do you have a spare lens?
No, I do not, and I need to take pictures today.
It is hard to feel good about that. Did you try to take a photo to see?
I did, but the pictures look bad and fuzzy.
That is not true if you look closer. Do you like any of the photos?
A few look okay, but it still feels wrong.
You can still have fun with what you have.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
It is blue because light splits up. Do you like rainbows?
Yes, I do. How can I see that splitting?
Use a glass of water and sunlight. It makes a small rainbow.
I want to try that today.
That is a great plan. Have fun with your experiment.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very lonely right now.
That feels heavy to carry. Do you have a favorite quiet place?
Why does it hurt so much?
Our brains want to feel close to others. Do you want to talk about your day?
Is it bad to feel this way?
It is not bad, but it is tough. What helps you feel calm?
Why do I think about people who are not here?
Memory can be both a gift and a pain. Do you miss a specific person?
How can I stop feeling this?
I do not know a magic fix, but connection helps. Will you try sending one short message?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The snow is too cold. How do I stay warm outside?
You should wear a thick coat and a hat. Do you have enough layers?
I have a coat. Is that good enough for the park?
A coat helps, but boots and gloves are best. Do you like running in the snow?
I like to run. How do I make a good snowball?
Pack the snow tight in your hand. Do you want to throw them at me?
No, I do not. Is the snow dirty?
Snow can get dirty if it touches the ground. Do you see any mud on it?
I see some dirt. Should I clean it?
It is hard to clean snow, so you may need to find fresh snow. Do you like building things?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hi, I must run. The baby is here.
Oh, how wonderful. Do you have much time?
Not at all. I just need the stroller key.
I do not see the key. Did you bring it?
No, I left it on the chair.
That is a problem. Let us find it now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My head hurts from looking at the screen all day.
That sounds tiring. Do you take any breaks?
I forgot to eat lunch because I was busy.
Oh no, that is not good. Did you drink any water?
I feel very bad and alone in this small room.
I am sorry you feel that way. Would you like to talk about it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do trains move on the tracks?
The wheels roll on the metal rails. It keeps the train straight. Do you like looking out the window?
Why is the train so loud?
The engine works hard to pull the heavy car. It makes a deep sound.
Why can we see so far?
The windows are big and clear. You can spot trees and fields. Do you like seeing farms?
Why does it stop here?
This is the next station. People get on and off.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I read a clock with two hands?
The short hand tells the hour. Do you know which hand is short?
Yes, the little one. But what about the big one?
The big hand tells the minutes. It takes it a full circle in one hour.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now, but tell me, what is in the sea?
It has salt water and many small fish. Do you like to swim?
No time for that. Is it deep?
Yes, it is very, very deep. I do not know exactly how deep.
Good. I am late. Is it cold?
It can be cold or warm. Was the water cool when you went?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make dinner, but I do not know what to eat.
Roast chicken is a good choice. Do you like chicken?
Yes, I like it. How do I make it taste good?
Put some butter on the skin before baking. Do you have butter in your fridge?
I have butter, but I am not sure how to make it.
I am not an expert, but you should ask a grown-up to help.
That is a good idea. I will ask my mom for help.
That sounds like a smart plan. You will have a nice meal.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run, but I saw a blue bird. What is it?
That sounds like a blue jay. Are you feeding it?
Yes, some seeds. Do they like them?
Yes, they love seeds. Do you have any more?
I must go now. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome. Good luck with your day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a sad dog in the park today.
That sounds lonely. Did you have a snack to share?
I gave him some of my sandwich.
That was very kind. Did he look happy after?
He wagged his tail and followed me.
I am glad he has a friend now.
I hope to find his owner soon.
That is a good goal. I do not know where he lives.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to wait for the bus.
That is a happy feeling. What makes you feel this way?
The sun is warm and I have a cookie.
A warm sun and a sweet snack sound nice. Do you like chocolate?
Yes, I do. It tastes like happy times.
Sweet and warm is a good combo. Enjoy your ride.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a big stick by the river.
That is a great find. Did you use it for the fire?
Yes, the fire burned very well.
I am happy you are warm.
The stars looked like white lights.
That sounds like a lovely view. What did you smell?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to clean the windows, but the glass looks cloudy after I wipe it. How do I make it clear?
Use a soft cloth and a little vinegar water. Do you have any vinegar in your kitchen?
Yes, I have vinegar, but I still get streaks when I dry the glass. What should I use to dry it?
Try a clean cotton T-shirt or a squeegee. Is the towel you are using fluffy?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: It is so hot outside today.
The sun feels very warm, does it not?
Yes, I am eating a big popsicle.
Does it taste sweet and cold?
It tastes like blue raspberry.
That sounds like a happy treat.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I love bananas. Why are they sweet?
They have lots of natural sugar. Do you like them green or yellow?
I like them yellow. Is that healthy?
Yes, they give you good energy. Do you eat them for breakfast?
No, I eat them as a snack. Thanks.
You are welcome. Enjoy your snack.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad to see my little green sprouts! They are growing so fast.
That is wonderful news. Are they your favorite vegetables?
Yes, I love them. I planted them right after the last rain.
Rain is very good for seeds. Did you also add some compost?
Yes, I did. I used old leaves from the yard.
That is a great way to help them grow.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I want to write a letter, but my words feel all jumbled up. I do not know where to start.
That is okay. What is the very first thing you want them to know?
I want to say I am sorry for the broken cup. My hands were too shaky.
That is a good start. Did you break it on purpose?
No, I fell over. I feel bad because I am always dropping things.
Accidents happen to everyone. Do you know their name?
Yes, but I am scared they will be mad at me. I just want to fix the mistake.
A kind word can do a lot. Does it feel better now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am moving my house. How do I pack my books?
Put them in small boxes first. Do you have any small boxes?
Yes, I have some boxes. How do I lift them safely?
Bend your knees and hold the box close. Is the floor clean?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see so many things here, but I do not know what to pick.
It looks like a busy place. Do you like bright colors?
Yes, I love red and yellow, but I still feel lost.
Pick the one that makes you happy. Do you want to eat or play?
I just want to buy one nice thing for me.
Choose the thing that makes you smile.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is raining outside. I do not know what to do.
Reading a book is a good choice. Do you like the rain?
I think I will read. What are you doing?
I am just sitting here. I do not know what you want to read.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Do trees make their own food?
Yes, they do. It is called photosynthesis. Do you like the smell of pine trees?
I do not have time to smell anything. Why are leaves green?
A color inside the leaf makes them green. It helps them grow. Do you have a favorite tree?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the place that sells blue pens. I am late.
It is down the next street. Do you have a receipt?
No, I do not have a receipt. Can you walk with me?
I cannot leave my shop. Is it a big pen?
No, it is a small pen. Please tell me where it is.
It is by the red door. Do you have time?
I have no time. I am running now.
Good luck. I hope you find it fast.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sick and need to see a doctor.
I am sorry you do not feel well. Do you have a fever?
Yes, I have a high fever and my throat hurts.
That sounds painful. Should we call the clinic now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad because I ate only candy and felt sick.
That sounds tricky to handle. Do you like fruit?
I guess, but I just want sweets all the time.
Sweets can make you feel tired. Have you tried an apple?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see a movie that makes me happy.
That sounds nice. Do you like funny stories?
Yes, but I am a little sad today.
Maybe a warm story with friends? Do you want to laugh or cry?
I think I want to laugh.
Try a light comedy then. It is a safe pick.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have so many tabs open. I am not sure what to do with them.
That can feel messy. Do you want to find something or just play?
I just want to see a new cat video. But I am scared I will get lost.
You are safe if you stay on one page. Do you like funny cats or sleeping ones?
The funny ones. What if I click the wrong thing?
Nothing bad will happen. I do not know if you will find the very best video, but you will learn.
Okay, I will close the other tabs first.
That is a smart move. Do you feel ready now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: You said you would play with me today, but you went inside. I am very sad.
I am sorry I broke my word. Did you miss me a lot?
Yes, I did. Now I feel like a fool for waiting.
You are not a fool. You just wanted to spend time together.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired of learning words. I always forget them.
That is hard to do. Do you like the sound of the words?
No. They all sound the same to me.
I understand that. Would a picture help you remember?
Maybe. But it is still too much work for me.
It is okay to feel stuck. How did you feel before we started today?
I was happy then. Now I feel bad.
Your feelings are valid. What is one small thing you can try later?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a new place to eat today.
That sounds fun. Did you like the food?
The pizza was hot and tasty.
Hot pizza is always good.
But the table was very close to the exit.
Oh no, that can be noisy. Was it loud?
Yes, doors kept opening all the time.
I am sorry about that.
I still ate all of my dinner.
You are a strong eater.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big boat on the water today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Was the boat red?
No, it was white with a blue stripe.
White is a nice color. Did you get to go on it?
I could not, but I watched it go by.
Watching is good too. Do you like boats?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My cat is hiding under the bed. What should I do?
Do not pull the cat out. Is she eating today?
She has not eaten anything.
That is not good. Please call a doctor if it lasts long.
I will try to check later.
Take your time. Is she playing at all?
No, she just stays quiet.
I do not know why she is quiet. Let her rest now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like my new math class.
That feels bad. What is hard about it?
The numbers are too big for me.
I understand. Have you tried asking for help?
I am afraid the teacher will be angry.
Teachers usually want to help you.
Maybe. I just feel small.
You are doing your best.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you know why my sister likes blue so much?
Blue is a calm color that makes people feel happy. Does she paint with it too?
Yes, she paints blue oceans all the time. I want to learn how to do that.
That is a great idea for you to try. What colors do you like best?
I really like red and orange because they look like fire.
Those are warm and bright choices. Do you have a paint kit at home?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
