exchanges: I am so sad. My trip was ruined by the rain.
I am sorry that is not fun. Did you take an umbrella?
No. I got wet and cold all day.
That sounds really miserable. Do you have a warm sweater to wear now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a rainbow today and it looked so bright.
That sounds lovely. What color did you like best?
I really loved the red part at the top.
Red is a warm and happy color.
Do you know why rainbows make a perfect circle?
I do not know the full reason, but it looks like a ring of light.
I guess I will just enjoy looking up at the sky.
That is a very good way to stay happy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do sailors say hi to the moon?
They do not, actually. Do you like the moon?
Why do sailors have to watch the stars?
Stars help them find their way in the dark.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my magnet stick to the fridge?
It sticks because the fridge door has iron in it. Do you like drawing on the magnet?
Yes, I draw cats on them. Do magnets pull on everything?
No, they only pull on specific metals. Are you using a fridge?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing on the sand. I do not know what to do.
The water looks fun. Do you like cold water?
I think so, but I am not sure.
Maybe you can just walk near the shore.
That sounds good. What else can I do?
You can look for shells. I do not know if there are many here.
I will try to find some.
That is a nice plan. Do you like the sun?
Yes, it feels warm on my face.
Glad you are having a good time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Do you know where I left my keys?
I do not know. Were they near the door?
No. I think I had them in my bag.
That makes sense. Is the bag heavy?
Yes. It is very full.
I see. Did you check inside?
I did. They are not there.
You must look under your desk. Have you looked there yet?
I have. I will go back to the shop.
I hope you find them soon. Be safe.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I win a chess game?
You must trap the enemy king so it cannot move. Do you know how the queen moves?
I know the queen goes far, but what is the plan?
Use your pawns to make space for your big pieces. Do you like playing with knights?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the big ship float on the water?
It floats because the water pushes up on the bottom. Do you like swimming in pools?
Yes, I do. But why doesn't it sink?
The inside is mostly air, so it is light. Do you hold your breath when you dive?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I fixed my broken chair and I am so happy!
That is great news! What did you use to fix it?
I used some strong glue and wood glue.
Wood glue is very strong. Did the chair wobble before you glued it?
Yes, it wobbled a lot when I sat down.
It must feel nice to be steady now. Do you sit in it every day?
I do, and now I can read my books easily.
Reading in a comfy chair sounds lovely.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am taking a train soon. What should I bring?
Bring a book and some water. Do you like reading?
Yes, I do. What if I get hungry?
Pack a simple snack like crackers. Is the trip long?
It is about three hours.
That sounds like a good length. Do you know the time?
No, I do not know the time.
Check your ticket for the time. It is usually printed there.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a red box in my room. What is inside?
That sounds like a mystery. I do not know the answer. Do you want to open it?
I am too scared to look. Will it be a toy?
It might be a gift for you. Open it to see. Is your heart beating fast?
Okay, I will try. I hope it is a dog.
That is a sweet wish. I cannot tell you for sure. What did you see inside?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy a toy for my little sister.
That is sweet. What does she like to do?
She loves to color and play with dolls.
A big coloring book is a good choice. Does she have red pencils?
I think she has some, but I am not sure.
You can check her desk. Would you like to buy crayons too?
Yes, I think I will get a pack of crayons.
That sounds fun. Good luck with your gift.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My mom lit the candles on the cake.
That sounds very warm. Did you sing a song?
Yes, we sang and ate.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am scared of the big test tomorrow.
That is okay. Do you like writing?
I like it, but the words are hard.
Try to make the words short. Do you take breaks?
Yes, I rest my eyes for five minutes.
That is a good habit. Are you sleeping well?
I am tired, but I try to sleep early.
Rest helps your brain work. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the name of that tune right now.
Do you know the words? I can help.
I am late. Can you just give me the name?
I do not know the name. Do you like the sound?
It has a fast drum beat. I am running.
That is a nice detail. I still do not know the title.
Please stop. I have to go now.
Take your time. I hope you find it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love apples. How do I cut one?
Cut it in half first. Do you have a safe knife?
Yes, I do.
Peel the skin if you like. What do you want to do with the pieces?
I want to eat them raw.
That is very tasty. Enjoy your snack.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My head hurts and I do not feel well.
That is not good. Do you have a fever?
I am not sure. I have no idea what to do next.
You can check with a thermometer. Do you have one at home?
No, I do not. I feel scared.
That is okay to feel scared. We can call the doctor to ask for help.
Will they be mad at me?
No, they will just want to make you better. Do you have a phone?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the new town so quiet?
It is quiet because few people live there yet. Do you like quiet places?
Why do the trees look so young?
I do not know for sure. Do you like big trees?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start walking to stay healthy?
Just put on your shoes and walk slowly for five minutes. Do you have a favorite spot to walk?
I walk near the park, but my legs get tired fast.
That is normal, so rest for a few seconds if you feel tired. Are your legs hurting, or just feeling heavy?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That is a fun goal. How far do you want to go each day?
Just around my house, please.
Good. What day are you free to start?
Tomorrow morning.
Great. Do you have a helmet ready?
Yes, I bought one last week.
Perfect. We will start slow and keep you safe.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can you help me find my red toy car?
I can look with you. Do you last see it in the living room?
I think it was under the couch.
Let us check there. Is it hiding in a dark spot?
Look, I see it!
Well done. Do you want to play with it now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad because I failed my math test.
That feels really bad. Do you want to talk about it?
I just do not get how to add the numbers.
I do not know your specific test, but I am here to help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know if my fish is sick. I am late.
Does it look pale or move slow? Can you tell me what it eats?
It looks orange and swims fast. I have no time for food talk.
It sounds healthy and happy. Please go on your way.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very happy today.
That is great news. What made you smile?
I do not know why. Do you know?
I cannot read your mind, but I am glad. Is it the nice weather?
Maybe, but I am still curious. Why does happiness feel so warm?
Warmth helps us feel safe and loved. Do you like warm hugs?
Yes, I do. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to send a letter, but I am lost here.
You can put the letter in that box by the door. Do you have a stamp?
I do not have a stamp. Where do I get one?
You can buy stamps at the counter over there. Is it a big letter?
It is just a small paper. I think I will buy one.
That is a good plan. The counter is open all day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my characters talk?
You can write down what they say first. Do you have a story idea?
I want them to argue about a toy.
Let them say why they want it. Is the toy red?
No, it is a blue ball.
Tell one person the ball is fun to kick. That helps the fight.
What if they stop talking?
You can say they sit down and think. Do you like endings?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to draw a cat now, but my hand is shaking.
Take a deep breath. Do you have a pencil?
Yes, but I am so late.
Draw a circle for the head first. It will help.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to run fast in the park.
That sounds like fun. Do you run alone or with friends?
I run with my dog. He is very fast.
Dogs love to run. What is his name?
His name is Bob. I love to play with him.
Bob is lucky to have you. Have a great time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the river! It is so nice today.
Yes, it looks very calm and clear. Do you like sitting by the water?
I love the sound it makes. It sounds like a happy song.
That is a lovely way to see it. Is the water cold or warm?
It feels cool and wet on my hands.
Good. You must be careful not to slip. Do you plan to swim in it?
No, just to touch the rocks. They are smooth and round.
Smooth stones are very pretty to find. Can you pick one up?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel very happy right now. I want to tell you about it.
That is wonderful to hear. What made you feel this way?
I sat in the quiet park. I felt close to the world.
Quiet places can feel special. Do you go there often?
Yes, I go there every day. I am glad you asked.
It is nice that you have this place. Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sky is so blue and full of fluffy white clouds today.
That sounds lovely. Do they look like cotton candy to you?
Yes, they do. I just want to jump up and sit on one.
They are soft from a far way. Are you having a good day?
I am very happy and I wanted to tell someone.
It is nice to share good feelings.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My morning was messy. I spilled milk on my only good socks and now I need new shoes.
That sounds like a tough start. Do you know what kind of shoes you want?
I want brown ones. They look like the leaves that fall off the trees in my yard.
Brown is a nice, warm color. What size do you wear?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad because I lost my favorite book.
That is really hard. Do you know where you left it?
No, I do not. I just found the cover on the floor.
I am sorry to hear that. Have you looked in your bag?
Yes, I checked everything. I am done looking for it.
I know that feels unfair. Maybe we can get another copy?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have these little pots of green leaves, but I do not know what they are.
They look like young sprouts. Did you buy them at the store?
Yes, the shopkeeper said they would grow, but I do not know how.
Water them a little every few days. Do they have light where they sit?
They are in the dark closet because I was afraid of dust.
That is not good for plants. They need sun to grow strong. Do you have a window nearby?
There is a bright window by the door.
Put them there in the morning. You can watch them change over time.
I will move them there today. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. I hope they bloom for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I find the North Star?
Look for the two stars at the end of the Big Dipper and follow them. Do you have a clear sky?
Yes, it is very dark and clear.
Great, point the two stars toward each other and walk that line out. Is it cold out there?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am feeling very happy right now.
That is wonderful. What made you smile?
I have to go, I am late.
Hurry safely. Do you know why you are happy?
Yes, I finished a big task.
Good job. Take a deep breath.
I feel light and free.
That is nice. What comes next?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. My screen is dark.
Please press the big power button. Is it warm?
It is warm. Thanks.
Good luck with your work.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the moon round?
It is a big ball of rock in the sky. Do you like watching it?
Yes, I do. Is it cold up there?
Yes, it is very cold on the moon.
Can we go there?
I do not know when that will happen for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
The sun is up and people are busy. Do you live here?
Yes, I do. I like the silence.
That is nice. Do you walk here often?
I usually run, but I walked today.
Running is good for you. Is your leg okay?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I need to clean my room, but I am tired.
That is okay. Do you want to start with the floor?
Yes, I will sweep the floor first.
Good choice. Is the broom nearby?
Yes, it is by the door.
Great. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a movie where a mouse talks. Do animals really talk?
No, animals do not use words like we do. They make sounds to talk to each other. Did you like the mouse?
Yes, he was very funny. How do people make him talk?
People use sound effects to make it sound like he is speaking. It is a trick of the ears. Was it hard to understand?
No, it was easy. Does the mouse live in a house?
I do not know which house he lives in. But many mice do like warm places. Did you enjoy the whole movie?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a camera, but I do not know what to take a picture of.
That is okay. Do you see something that makes you feel happy?
I see a red flower, but it looks a bit sad to me.
Try taking a photo of it anyway.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to help my friend who feels sad. What should I do?
Just sit with them and listen. Do they like to draw?
Yes, they do. How do I start?
Offer them paper and crayons. Is that okay?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do trees lose their leaves in the cold?
They sleep to save energy. Do you like playing in the fallen leaves?
Yes, I like jumping in them. What is inside a big tree trunk?
It is usually very hard and woody. I do not know the exact color.
Can I eat the bark?
No, please do not eat the bark. Do you know what birds eat?
Birds eat worms. Thank you for telling me about trees.
You are welcome. It is a fun day to be outside.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I cannot stop thinking about the game I lost.
That is a common feeling. Are you feeling upset or just tired?
My brain feels too loud to sleep.
Try taking three slow, deep breaths. Do you feel a little calmer now?
It helps a little bit. What else can I do?
Try counting backward from ten very slowly. Would you like to try that?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want my toys to work right now. I do not like waiting.
Waiting can feel hard. Do you know how plants grow?
I know plants get big. I do not want to wait for that either.
Plants need time to get strong. Do you like strong things?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The fire is very hot and I am scared. What should I do now?
Please go to a safe place right away. Are you with someone else?
Yes, my mom is here. Do we need to call the police?
Yes, call 911 or your local fire number. Do you know how to dial?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in this big shop.
Do not worry. Do you know where you want to go?
I need a pen, but I cannot find the aisle.
Pens are usually near the front. Have you checked by the cash register?
I looked there, but I saw only paper.
That is strange. Let us check the main display stands.
You are so helpful, thank you.
You are welcome. I hope you find your pen soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I just moved to this new town and feel very lost. Do you have any good tips for me?
I know a lovely park nearby, but I am not sure about the best food spots. Do you like walking?
Yes, I love walking, but I am afraid I will get lost again. Is the town easy to understand?
The streets are very simple, so you will find your way. Do you like quiet places?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on my math work.
I can help you. What is the hard part?
I do not know how to count the coins.
You can group them in five. Do you like counting?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My boat has a big hole in the side.
Oh no, that sounds scary. Is the water coming in fast?
Yes, it is filling up with cold water.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a plug for the hole?
No, I forgot to pack one.
That is very true. Try to keep it dry until you find help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw many brown leaves on the ground today. Why did they fall?
Trees drop leaves in autumn to save energy for winter. Did you feel cold outside?
Yes, I put on a warm coat. Do trees sleep under the snow?
The tree stays awake but grows very slow. Is your coat green?
No, my coat is blue. How do they wake up in spring?
Warm sun and rain tell the tree to grow new green leaves.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made warm bread and I feel so happy.
That sounds wonderful. Do you want to give me some?
Yes, I would love to share it with you.
Thank you, that is very kind. What kind of bread is it?
It is a soft round loaf with butter on top.
Butter makes it taste even better. Do you like to eat it hot?
I eat it while it is still warm and steamy.
That must taste the best.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to grow tomatoes in my small yard. How do I start?
Start with small plants from a store. Where do you live?
I live near the sea. Will the salt hurt the plants?
Salt can hurt them if it gets in the soil. I do not know if your specific yard is too salty.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My nose is very stuffy and my head hurts. What should I do?
Drink warm soup and rest in bed. Do you feel better when you sleep?
Yes, but my throat still hurts a lot. Should I take medicine?
A spoonful of honey can help. Is your cough getting worse?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My little sister broke my red toy car today.
I am sorry about that. Did you share your feelings with her?
Yes, I told her I was sad, but she cried.
That is a kind way to handle it. Did she apologize?
She said sorry and gave me a hug.
A hug is a nice peace offering. Are you ready to play together again?
I think so, we will play in the garden.
That sounds like a fun way to end the day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this walk. The grass tickles my feet.
That sounds silly. Do you want to sit on a bench?
No. The birds are loud.
Birds like to sing. Do you hear a different sound?
Just noise. I want to go home now.
We can leave. Would you like to hold my hand?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the water so blue near the pier?
The sun makes it look bright and clear. Do you see the boats?
Yes, they look like toys. How do they stay up?
Water pushes up on them to keep them safe. Do you like riding on them?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why did the lights go off?
The power line might have broken. Is your house very dark now?
Yes, it is scary. Do you know when the lights will come back on?
I do not know the exact time. But they usually fix it soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. No one remembered my day.
I am sorry. Did you hope for a gift?
Yes. I waited all day for a smile.
I do not know who failed you. Are you hungry now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a circle and a square. Which one has sharp corners?
The square has sharp corners. Do you like squares?
Yes, I do. How many sides does the square have?
It has four sides. Can you count them?
One, two, three, four. Great, thank you.
You are welcome. I am glad I could help.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the apple at this market sweet?
I think it is sweet, but I have not tasted it. Do you like sweet fruit?
Yes, I love sweet things. Is the fish fresh there?
The fish looks very fresh to my eyes. Do you plan to buy some?
Maybe, if it is not too expensive. How much is the bread?
I do not know the price of the bread. Can you ask the seller?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a bad cold. My nose feels very blocked. I do not know what to do.
I am sorry you feel so bad. Do you have any hot tea?
I tried tea, but it did not help. I feel tired and dizzy.
That is not good. Please call a doctor.
I am too scared to call. What should I do now?
I do not know your full symptoms. Please go see a doctor today.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My nice chair is gone. The fire took it.
I am very sorry to hear that. Are you safe?
Yes, I am safe. I am just angry. It was my favorite chair.
Anger is okay. Do you want to talk?
I do not know. I just want it back. It is not coming back.
You are right. It is not coming back. I know how sad that is.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why are clouds white?
They are made of tiny water bits that bounce light. Do you see them all day?
Sometimes I do.
That is good. They make the sky look soft. Do you like the dark ones too?
I think they look scary.
It is only water coming down as rain. Are you safe inside?
Yes, I am in my bed.
Then it is very safe. Sleep well tonight.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to buy a new toy, but I have no coins.
That is okay. Do you like saving your lunch money?
I do not want to give up my snacks.
You can save just a little each day. Is your piggy bank full?
It has a few coins in it.
Great start. Keep it up and you will buy that toy soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread is still flat. I am very sad.
Is it warm and quiet where you left it?
Yes, it is warm. Why is it not getting big?
The little bugs in the dough make air bubbles. Do you have some fresh yeast?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The sand is too hot to walk on.
I am sorry that is painful. Do you have shoes?
No, I left them in the car.
That is a smart place for them. Can we wait for the sun to move?
It is still very bright.
Yes, the sun is high. Would you like a cold drink?
I do not feel like drinking.
Okay, let us just sit in the shade then. Is the breeze helping?
It feels a little better now.
Good. Let us rest our feet for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is Sunday the first day?
Many places start the week on Sunday, but some start on Monday. Do you know where you live?
I live here. Why do we have seven days?
It is based on the moon's phases. Why do you ask?
I like counting them. Is Friday the best day?
Some people love Friday because the weekend is near. Is there a day you dislike?
I do not like rainy days. How do we know what day it is?
We use a calendar or a clock.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn to sing, but I am afraid I sound bad.
It is normal to feel shy at first. Do you like a certain kind of song?
I like happy songs, but my voice feels too soft.
You can practice loudly in a safe place like your room.
How do I start?
Start by humming a simple tune you know well.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because the sky is so gray today.
Gray skies can feel heavy. Do you like sunny days better?
Yes, but I do not know if the sun will come out.
I do not know the weather for sure. Do you check a map?
No, I just look up and wait.
That is a patient way to watch. Do you see any birds?
No, the clouds are too thick to see them.
Thick clouds hide many things. Do you mind the waiting?
I am tired of waiting for blue.
Tired waiting is hard. Let us watch together for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to pack my lunch for the picnic.
That is a good idea. What is your favorite snack?
I like apples and cracker chips.
Yum. Did you bring a napkin?
Yes, I have a big blue one.
Great. Where will you sit?
Under the big green tree.
That sounds cool. Can I come with you?
Yes, please come with me!
I will be right there. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a very bad dream last night.
Oh no, I am sorry to hear that. What happened in the dream?
A giant spider crawled all over my bed.
That sounds very scary. Did you wake up quickly?
Yes, I jumped out of bed and ran to my parents.
That is a smart thing to do. Are you feeling okay now?
I am happy to be safe and dry.
I am glad you are safe. You must feel better now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I watched my fern drink all day, and it still looked thirsty.
Roots pull water up through tiny tubes. Did you check if the soil was dry?
Yes, the soil was dry, so I gave it more water.
That is smart, as dry soil stops the flow.
It looks happy now, but I do not fully understand the science.
Water moves up by sun power and heat. Do you want to learn more?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do bugs have so many feet?
They need them to walk and climb. Do you like watching ants?
Yes, I do. But why do flies buzz?
They buzz when they fly fast. Do you like watching bees?
No, I do not. What is inside a bug?
Most bugs have tiny hearts and tubes. Are you scared of spiders?
A little bit. Do bugs sleep?
Yes, they rest like you do. Do you want to look closer?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw the ocean today and I feel so happy.
That is great to hear. What color was the water?
It was a very deep, bright blue.
That sounds very cool.
The waves crashed loud against the rocks.
The sound must be very big. Do you like loud sounds?
Yes, they make me feel free.
I am glad you have that feeling.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my chess game today because I forgot to move my queen.
Oh no, that is a big piece to lose track of. What did you play next?
I had to use my knight to block the other player's rook.
That sounds like a clever save. Did you win the next game?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a round plate on the floor today.
That is a good find. Did it break?
No, it was just a shape for a game.
A round shape is nice. Is it blue?
It has a square box next to it.
A square fits well with a circle. Do you have the box?
Yes, I put both in my bag.
Good luck with your game. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I hold my new baby so they are safe?
Wrap the baby in a soft blanket to help keep them warm and still. Do you have a blanket ready for them?
Yes, I have a nice blue one. How do I put it on them?
Place the blanket over their back first, then fold the ends across their chest.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I say thanks to my friend for the gift?
You can just say "thank you" and smile. Do you like the present?
Yes, it is my favorite color. What else should I do?
Look their eyes when you speak. Did they look happy?
They did. Is it rude to ask for more gifts?
No, you should never ask for more. Just be kind.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what to do for my good boss.
That is a nice thought. Do you like to draw?
I do not know. Maybe I should just say thank you.
Yes, that is a good start. Are you happy here?
I feel small and unsure of myself.
You are doing fine. Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel sick and want to see a doctor.
That sounds rough. Are you coughing?
Yes, and my head hurts.
I do not know the cause. Do you have a fever?
I do not know. I feel hot.
Please check your temperature. Have you tried eating soup?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I dropped my pencil on the floor. What should I do?
Pick it up right away. Did you have to say please?
I forgot to say please to the waiter. Is that bad?
It is a small mistake, but asking for help next time is good. Do you know how to ask?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My goldfish looks sad and stays at the bottom. What is wrong?
It might be lonely or the water may be dirty. How many fish do you have?
Just one goldfish and two tiny guppies.
That sounds like a busy home for a small tank. Do you clean the water every week?
No, I only change the water once a month.
That is not enough for them to stay healthy. Do you want tips on a better schedule?
Yes, please tell me what to do.
Change one quarter of the water every two weeks to keep it clean. A happy tank needs fresh water often.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am very nervous about my big day.
It is normal to feel this way. Do you love your partner?
Yes, I do. I just want everything to be perfect.
You cannot control all things. Are you happy?
Mostly, yes. What should I wear?
Pick what makes you smile. Is it comfortable?
Yes, it is. Can you say the last part again?
I am sorry, I do not know that part.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel good today but I do not know what to do.
That is a nice feeling. Do you like to be outside?
I am not sure. Maybe I should just sit here.
Sitting is a good choice if you are tired. What song is in your head?
It is a song about the rain.
Rain songs are calm and soft. Do you want to close your eyes for a bit?
Yes, I think I will try that.
Good for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream on the grass. It melted fast. I feel very small and sad.
Oh, that is a sad surprise. I am sorry about your ice cream. Do you want to talk more?
I tried to eat the warm part. It tasted bad. Now I have sticky hands.
Sticky hands are hard to fix. I do not know what you ate, but that sounds messy. Are you clean now?
I washed them. They still smell like strawberry. I am not hungry anymore.
It is hard to eat when you feel sad. I believe you. Do you want a different snack?
Maybe. But I just want to sit. My legs feel heavy.
Sitting is a good choice. I am here with you. Is there anything else on your mind?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we move the knight in an L shape?
It can jump over other pieces. Do you like how it skips ahead?
Yes. What happens if the king is in danger?
We call that check. Do you know how to stop it?
I block it with another piece. Is that all?
Yes, or you move the king.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to check out a book.
You just take it to the desk and ask the librarian for help. Do you know where the desk is?
No, I do not.
It is near the front door. Can you find the front door?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My cat acts very weird lately. What should I do?
That is not good. Is he eating well?
He stopped eating two days ago.
Please take him to a vet soon. I do not know why he is sick.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It was eight o'clock when I woke up today.
That is a nice time to start the day. Did you eat breakfast?
I ate toast at nine.
Toast is a good choice.
By noon, I was very busy.
I hope you took a break. What did you do?
I played with my ball.
That sounds like fun.
I went to bed at nine last night.
Goodnight time is important for rest.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to pick a gift for my sister but I am lost.
That is a nice thought. What does she like to do for fun?
She loves to draw pictures and read books.
A new set of paints or a cozy blanket would be great.
Those sound good but I want something special.
Maybe a book about drawing? Do you know her favorite color?
Yes, she likes purple and blue.
A purple sketchbook with blue pens is a perfect match.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big white shape in the sky today. It looked like a sheep.
That sounds fun. Did you see any other shapes?
Yes, I saw a long one that looked like a dragon tail.
Wow, a dragon. That is very cool.
Then the sun came out and made the clouds glow.
The light must have been bright. Did it look warm?
It did, but the wind started to blow harder.
Wind can move clouds fast. Did they go away?
Some of them floated down and looked soft.
Clouds are made of tiny water drops. Do you like looking up?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I want to sing, but my voice sounds bad and I feel sad.
That is okay. Your voice is just learning. How does it feel when you try?
It hurts my throat and feels like a dry piece of paper.
You must drink water to make it soft. Do you like drinking fruit juice?
I do like apple juice, but I am afraid people will laugh at me.
Most people are too busy to listen. Do you have a friend who listens well?
My dog does, but I cannot sing for a dog.
A dog is a great start to find your fun. What song makes you feel happy?
I like that song with the big red truck.
That is a good, strong song to start with.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my red ball again. I am so mad.
I am sorry you are sad. Did you look in the yard?
Yes, I looked there too. My mom is angry with me.
That feels very bad. Have you tried checking under your bed?
No, I have not. I do not think it is there.
It might be hiding there. Let us go look together.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to grow big tomatoes in my box.
That is a great idea! Do you have any seeds?
Yes, I have them. How do I start?
Just put the seeds in warm, wet dirt. Water them a little every day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I put the plant in the pot, but I do not know how it eats.
Water climbs up the roots and stems to the leaves. Do you water it every day?
Yes, I give it a little cup of water once a week.
That is good if the soil stays a bit damp. Do you check the dirt before pouring?
I never check, I just pour when the calendar says so.
Roots can rot if the soil is too wet, so feel the dirt first.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a bad cough and I am not sure when to see a doctor.
A bad cough can take time to heal. How long has it been bothering you?
It has been two days and I feel a bit tired.
If it lasts more than a week, please call a doctor. Do you have a fever?
No, my temperature is fine, but my throat hurts.
Drink warm water to help your throat. Is the pain getting worse?
It feels the same as it did yesterday.
If it does not get better soon, go see a doctor. I hope you feel better fast.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I wash a pig?
Use warm water and a soft brush. Do you have a bucket?
Yes, I have a big blue one. Can I use soap?
Use mild soap, but rinse them well. Why did you ask?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the river so quiet here?
The water moves slowly because it is deep. Do you like watching the water?
Yes, it looks calm. Why are the trees so big?
They are very old and have grown for many years. I do not know how old they are.
That makes sense. Why do people smile so much?
They are happy and kind to each other. Do you feel happy here?
I think I do. Why is the air so fresh?
The plants give out clean air all day long.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so angry. My bike chain fell off.
That sounds very bad. Is the bike still in one piece?
Yes, but I cannot ride it. I have a race tomorrow.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you know how to fix the chain?
No, and I do not want to try. It is too hard for me.
I do not know how to fix a bike either.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I love reading in bed, but I keep falling asleep before the end of the chapter. What should I do?
That is very common. Do you read for a long time? Try reading for just ten more minutes, then turn off the light.
Ten minutes sounds doable. What kind of book should I pick to stay awake?
I am not sure which book will work best for you. Do you like scary stories or happy ones? You might try a funny book to keep your eyes open.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the snow white?
I think it looks white because of how light bounces off it. Do you see the sparkles?
Why do snowflakes have six sides?
That happens when they freeze in the air. Do you like catching them?
Why does the snow melt?
It turns back into water when it gets warm. Do you play in the mud?
Why does the ground stay cold?
I do not know for sure why the ground stays so cold. Do you wear boots?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am scared to sit in the driver seat. My hands do not know what to hold.
That is a good feeling. It shows you care. Do you like driving on straight roads or curvy ones?
I do not know. The car moves too fast for me. My brain feels empty.
You can always stop and breathe. It is okay to take your time. Do you want to practice just looking first?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a small red boat by the lake today.
That sounds fun. Is it yours?
Yes, I bought it at the old shop down the street.
How much did it cost?
It was not expensive, just five coins.
That is a good deal. Do you know how to sail?
I think so, my dad taught me a long time ago.
I do not know how to sail. What does the water look like?
It is very calm and looks like a mirror.
That must be peaceful. Will you go out soon?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My computer is dark. I do not know what to do.
Did you check if the plug is in the wall?
Yes, it is in the wall. Now what?
Try pressing the big button on the front once.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know how to start my letter to the dog.
Start with a warm hello. Do you want to thank him or just say hi?
I want to tell him I found a lost ball for him.
That is a nice thing to say. Did you find it in the yard?
Yes, it was under the big oak tree.
Write that it was under the tree. Should you invite him to play again?
Yes, I want to play fetch with him tomorrow.
Great. End by saying you care for him.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is it raining?
The sky is wet because water goes up and comes down. Do you like the sound of rain?
Why does it come down?
It falls because it is heavy. Is your dog outside?
Why is the air gray?
I am not sure why it is gray. Do you see any clouds?
Why do I need a coat?
You need a coat to stay warm and dry. Do you have a good one?
Why does it stop?
It stops when the water is done falling. Are you happy it is over?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to build a tower of blocks, but it fell down. I am so mad.
That feels really bad. Do you want to try again?
Maybe. But my hands feel bad.
Your hands are just tired. Rest them for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! My team won the big game today.
That is great to hear! Did you watch the whole match?
Yes, I sat right on the sofa and cheered loud.
It must feel wonderful to win. Do you love playing too?
Not really, I just love watching the players run fast.
Watching is a fine way to enjoy the sport.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel sad because I have no friends coming to my party.
That sounds hard. How many people are you inviting?
Just my sister and my dog.
A dog is a good friend. What is your favorite treat?
Chocolate cake with frosting.
Cake brings joy to many.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the fridge door hold my magnet?
The metal inside is special for magnets. Do you like drawing on the fridge?
Yes, I draw cats. But why do they pull?
Tiny parts in the metal turn and grab on. Is that a fun cat?
It is a silly cat. Do all metals work?
Only some metals, like iron. Which one is that?
The clip on my box. It sticks too.
Yes, that clip works well.
It is cool. Can we play more?
I love playing with magnets. Let us find more metal things.
Okay, let us go now.
Great, I will help you look.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to draw a cat, but my ears look like sticks.
Try drawing two triangles for the ears. Do you like the color orange?
Yes, I like orange, but the body is a funny blob.
You can make a big circle for the body first.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today and sat on a bench alone.
That sounds like a quiet place. Did you see any birds?
I saw one red bird, but it flew away quickly.
I am sorry you felt lonely. Do you want to go there again tomorrow?
I think I might, but I am not sure if I will have the courage.
Your feelings are real and okay. You are brave for trying.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad about that meeting.
That feels bad. What happened there?
They did not listen to my idea.
That is frustrating. Did you speak up?
I tried, but they just looked away.
Oh, that is tough. Do you want to talk it out?
Yes, please. My head hurts.
We can step outside. Would you like some air?
Yes, that sounds good.
Great. Let's go together.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today. The sun was warm. My legs hurt a bit.
That is a good start. Did you enjoy the fresh air?
Yes, I saw a dog. It was very fluffy. I felt happy.
Happy feelings are great for health. How long did you walk?
About ten minutes. It was a short trip.
Ten minutes is a solid step. Do you plan to walk again tomorrow?
I think so. I feel light today.
That is wonderful. Your body likes the movement. Keep it up.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to sleep?
Your body needs rest to grow. Do you like to dream at night?
I do! Why do I dream?
Your brain plays games with your memories. Do you remember them all?
Not always. Why is my room dark?
Darkness helps your body make a sleep helper. Is your room very quiet?
It is. How do I sleep best?
Keep a steady time for rest. Do you have a favorite pillow?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so happy, but I have to run.
That is good news. What makes you feel this way?
It is almost time to leave now.
Please take your time. Is everything okay?
I can keep talking on the phone.
You are doing a great job. I will let you go.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you know who my old friend Sam is?
I do not know him, but I like that you miss him. Do you talk to him?
We used to play tag in the park.
That sounds like so much fun. Did you have a favorite game?
We built a big fort out of leaves.
Wow, that must have been a great hideout. Was it dry inside?
Yes, the roof kept the rain out.
Smart thinking, right?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind blew my hat away this morning.
That is a very strong wind. Did you find your hat?
No, it flew over the big fence.
Oh, that is bad luck. Do you have another hat?
Yes, but this one is my favorite.
I am sorry about your hat. It feels too cold for me.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the big day.
Take a deep breath. Are you wearing your dress?
Yes, I have it on.
Good. Do you have your ring?
I left it on the counter.
Do not panic. Run back and get it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is my horse?
I do not see him. Are you sure you tied him there?
I know I did. Just tell me where he is!
He may be in the barn. Did you check the barn?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a rainbow. How do I do that?
You can make one with a glass of water and sunlight. Do you have a glass?
Yes, I do. What should I do next?
Put the glass on a sunny spot and wait for light to hit it. Do you see the colors?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I like apples. I must go now.
Apples are sweet and red. Do you like them green?
No. I have to rush.
Run safe and fast. Do you have a bag?
Yes. Bye.
Bye.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must finish this soon, please help me start.
Let us do the easy part first. What is the very next step?
Too slow, I need a full list now.
I do not know your full list, but we can do it one small thing at a time. Is the first thing on your desk?
Yes, but I have no time to think.
Then just grab that first thing. Do you have a pencil ready?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a very happy day at the beach.
That sounds lovely. Did you see any big waves?
Yes, I played in the water and ate ice cream.
I am glad you had fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread is flat. I am so sad.
Do not cry. I do not know why yours failed. Is the room very cold?
I do not know. Please help.
Yeast makes air pockets. That lets bread grow big. Were you happy baking?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the big light at the end of the rock a real light?
Yes, it is a real light that guides boats. Do you like lights?
I like it, but why does it spin around?
It spins so boats can see it from far away.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to wear to the wedding.
A dress or a suit is a good pick. Do you like bright colors?
I think I have a nice blue shirt, but I feel unsure.
That sounds fun and fresh. Is the party at night?
Yes, it is in the evening, but I still feel stuck.
Your kind friends will help you look. Do you have shoes that match?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw the big boats in the harbor today.
That must have been fun to look at.
The sailors were busy pulling on thick ropes.
They are very strong to pull those heavy lines.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a white shirt with red jam on it. How do I clean it?
Do you have cold water? That is the first step.
Yes, I have cold water. What do I do next?
Put the shirt in a bowl of cold water and scrub the jam.
Okay, I am scrubbing it. What should I use for the soap?
Use a mild soap. Do you have liquid soap?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a small tree with brown leaves. It looks sad. What should I do?
It might be thirsty or losing its leaves for winter. Do you know if it is autumn?
I think it is fall, yes. But it is in my yard. I am worried about it.
That is a kind feeling to have. Have you checked the soil to see if it is dry?
The ground is dry, but I am not sure how much water to give it. Can you tell me?
I do not know the exact amount for that type of tree. Do you know what kind of tree it is?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a robot, but I do not know what to do with it.
That is okay. What does the robot look like to you?
It looks like a big box with bright lights on top.
Nice. Do you like looking at the lights?
Yes, I do, but my hands feel empty.
Maybe it can hold a toy for you. Does that sound good?
I think so, but I am still not sure.
It is okay to be unsure. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I crashed the car again.
That is tough. Do you want to talk about it?
I feel like a fool. I just cannot get the right.
You are not a fool. Have you tried a new instructor?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I had a scary dream where I lost my way in a dark forest.
That sounds very frightening. Did you wake up in a cold sweat?
Yes, and I still feel a bit shaky now. What should I do?
Try to take slow, deep breaths to calm down. Do you like playing with soft toys?
I do, they help me feel safe. Can you give me another tip?
Read a fun book before you sleep next time. I am not a doctor, so this is just a guess.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I learn a new language fast?
You must practice every day. Do you like music?
Yes, I love songs.
Listen to songs in that language. Do you like to read?
I read a lot.
Read simple books. Start with short words.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. What time is it?
It is 5:30. Are you running?
Yes, I must go now. Is it morning?
Yes, it is morning. Have a good day.
Thank you so much.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the gift is broken.
I am sorry to hear that. Is it a toy?
Yes, I love my new car very much.
I do not know if it can be fixed. Did you try to put the parts back together?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my dog sit by the door?
He waits for you to come home. Does he bark when you are late?
Why does he lick my face?
It shows he loves you very much.
Why does he hide his toys?
He plays with them later. Do you lose your own things?
Why does he bark at the mailman?
I do not know for sure. Is he trying to stop him?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got the job today! It feels so good.
That is wonderful news. I am so happy for you. What will you do there?
I will sort books and help people find them.
That sounds like a quiet and nice place. Do you know your start time?
I start at nine on Monday.
You will do a great job. Have a safe trip home.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
They collect sweet plant juice. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I do.
The bees dry the juice in their hives. Does that sound hard?
Yes, it must be.
They store the dry juice as food. Do you know why they do that?
To eat later?
Yes, they eat it in winter. That is the whole secret.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I can see the sun so well today.
That sounds bright and warm. Do you have an umbrella?
Yes, I packed a big blue one.
Good idea to stay dry. Are you going to the park?
Maybe, if it stops raining.
That is a smart plan. I hope you have fun out there.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know which flower means love, but I am late.
The red rose means love. Is it for a special day?
Yes, it is for my wife. I forgot our date.
That is sweet. Do you know where to buy them?
I think the shop next to the park sells them.
That sounds good. Run quickly.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I read my favorite book, but I am not sure what to do next.
That is a good feeling. Do you want to read it again?
I am not sure. I forgot some parts of the story.
You can read the old pages once more. Do you like that idea?
Yes, I think I will read it again.
That sounds like a happy plan. Have fun with your book.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is very loud. I am scared.
I hear it too. Is your house safe?
I do not know. What should I do?
Sit down and take a deep breath.
My head hurts from the noise.
That is tricky. Do you have a blanket?
Yes, I have a big blue blanket.
Wrap it around yourself.
The lights just went out.
Oh no. Do you have a candle?
I think so. But I am afraid of the dark.
That is okay. Keep holding the blanket.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My fish, Bubbles, is spinning in circles today.
That sounds odd. Is the water moving fast?
No, the pump is quiet. I think he is sad.
Fish can seem sad when they are sick. Did you feed him today?
I gave him a tiny pellet this morning.
That is good. Does he have any red spots?
I see a small red dot near his tail.
Please ask a vet about that soon. He might need help.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My baby cries a lot at night. What should I do?
Try holding him close. Does he want a bottle?
He drinks milk, but then falls asleep.
That is good. It helps him rest.
I feel so tired all the time.
You must rest too. Do you get help?
My sister helps sometimes.
That is kind of her. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. The sun is warm and the leaves are red. Do you like autumn?
Yes, I think the warm sun is nice. What is your favorite part of the day?
The quiet morning. I sit and watch the light change. It feels very calm.
That sounds like a peaceful place. Do you read a book while you wait?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my bike turn without falling?
Look forward, not at your wheels. Do you feel steady when you sit up straight?
I feel okay, but I tip over when I stop.
Use your brakes gently and put one foot down early. Do you practice in a safe spot?
Yes, I practice in the park, but I am scared of the hill.
Hills are just steeper slopes. Are you scared of going fast or going slow?
I am scared of going fast.
That is a normal feeling. Try braking before you go down the hill.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. The bees seem to work so hard for so little.
Bees use their stomachs to turn flower nectar into sweet honey. Do you think they get tired?
They do not stop. I wish they could rest.
They rest between flights, but they must keep the hive safe. Why does that make you feel bad?
Because I like them, but it feels too hard.
That is a kind thought. Do you have a favorite part of the garden?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to see the bright moon in the sky.
It looks very bright tonight. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. I love how it shines on my face.
That sounds lovely. The light is soft and gentle.
I feel calm when I watch it move.
I am glad you feel that way.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My team won the big game today.
That is great news. Which team did you watch?
It was so much fun to watch them play.
I am happy for you. Did you cheer the whole time?
Yes, I was very happy and loud.
That sounds like a great time. Did you eat anything after?
We watched the replay twice more.
You really love the sport. What was your favorite part?
The last goal was the best part.
I am glad you enjoyed it so much.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing in the yard. I do not know what to do today.
The sun is out. Do you want to run?
Maybe. But my hands are cold.
You can wear a warm coat. Do you like hot soup?
Yes, I love soup. But where is it?
I do not know. Do you have a phone?
No, I have no phone. I just want to play.
Then go find a friend. Do they like games?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so tired. Where is the milk?
Is it in the fridge? I do not know for sure.
Yes, it is there. My shoes are gone.
Did you lose them? I see your socks.
No, they are on the bed. I need to go now.
That is good. Are you wearing your coat?
Yes, I have my coat on. Bye.
Bye. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. The bus leaves now.
I am sorry. Are you running?
Yes, I am running.
Good luck. Do you have your bag?
It is in my hand.
That is good. Go now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat in the park today and watched the birds.
That sounds quiet. Did you see any other people?
Just a dog walking by. It did not stop to play.
That must have felt a bit sad. Do you want to sit with me?
The sun went down and I felt very cold.
I do not know where you are, but I am here.
It is nice to talk, even if only with you.
I am happy to listen. Was the sunset pretty?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I take care of my new goat?
Feed it grass and clean its home often. Does it like to eat carrots?
Yes, it loves carrots. What else does it need?
Goats need fresh water and a friend to play with. Is there another goat nearby?
I have a sheep too. Can they be friends?
Sheep and goats often get along well. Do they share the same fence?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was so bright today and made my eyes hurt.
That bright light has many colors mixed in. Do you see colors in a rainbow?
Yes, I saw one in the grass after it rained.
The air in the sky breaks the light apart. The blue bits bounce around the most.
So the blue light hits everything around me?
Exactly, and your eyes catch that bounced light. What color clouds did you see?
The clouds looked white and fluffy.
Clouds are thick with water drops that show all colors. Are you happy with your answer now?
I think I understand it better now, thank you.
You did a great job thinking about it. Enjoy the rest of your day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so mad. My toy will not stop!
I am sorry. Can you take one deep breath? Do you feel a bit better?
It is hard to wait. I just want it now.
Waiting is hard, but it is good for your brain. What is your favorite game?
I like hide and seek.
That is a fun game. Being patient helps you find your friends faster.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people run?
They run to keep their hearts strong. Do you like to move fast?
Yes, but why does it feel so hard?
It feels hard because your body works very hard to push you. Do you get tired after a little while?
Yes, my legs hurt a lot.
Your legs hurt because they are learning to be stronger. Do you like to drink water after you run?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! Did you know my toy boat floats on the water? It does not sink!
That is wonderful. Does the wood feel light to your hand?
Yes, it feels light! The water pushes back on the bottom to hold it up.
You are right. Do you know why heavy ships do not sink?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go to the beach this summer.
That sounds like fun. Do you like the water?
I think I do. How do I pack for a trip?
Bring light clothes and a hat. Do you have a bag?
I have a small one. Is it big enough?
Yes, that will work fine.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very scared about my meeting today.
It is normal to feel this way. Is it a new meeting?
Yes, I have never done this before.
Deep breaths will help you. Do you have your notes?
I hope so, but I am not sure.
Check your bag now. Did you find them?
Yes, I found them.
Great. You are ready now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How can I keep my coins safe?
Put them in a jar. Do you have a nice jar?
Yes, I do. What else should I do?
Try to put one coin in each day. That adds up.
That sounds hard, but okay.
It gets easier. Good luck!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to study today.
That feels hard. What subjects do you like best?
I like art, but I must do math.
Math can be tricky. Do you have a plan for when you get stuck?
No, I just want to give up.
Taking a short break helps. Would you like to try one small math problem first?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very tired from working here.
That sounds hard. Do you like your job?
I do, but my house is noisy.
Noise can be annoying. Do you wear headphones?
Yes, but I still feel small.
A small space can feel tight. Do you go outside?
Not much, the rain is heavy.
Rain can keep us inside. Have you stretched?
I forgot to move my body.
Moving helps you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so late for the bus.
Take a deep breath. What did you forget?
I left my bag at home.
That is very tricky. Do you have time to run?
No, I am too far away.
Then we must wait for the next one.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake bread in my small village.
That sounds fun. Do you have an oven in your home?
Yes, my grandmother gave me an old one.
Great, you will need flour and yeast. Have you bought them yet?
No, I need to buy them from the market.
You can mix the dough until it is soft. Are you strong enough to knead it?
I hope so, but I am a little weak.
I do not know if you are strong, but you can try. Just push and pull with your hands.
Okay, I will try to make a round ball.
Good luck with your baking. Do you like sweet bread or salty bread?
I like sweet bread with honey on top.
Honey makes it taste very nice. I hope it turns out well for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I ran and my legs hurt so bad.
That sounds tough. Do they still hurt?
Yes, they feel all tight.
Rest is good for tired muscles.
But I want to run again tomorrow.
Maybe walk first? Are you sure?
I guess I will just walk.
That is a wise choice.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Is the red fish sad?
It looks happy. Do you have time for a quick snack?
No time. The blue one is sleeping.
That is fine. Is it snoring?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see orange light in the dark. What is it?
It is a fire burning nearby. Are you safe inside your house?
Yes, I am in my room. Why is it there?
It is hard to say why it started. Do you smell any smoke?
No, the air smells like my toys. Is it close to us?
It is close, but not too close. Is your door closed tight?
Yes, I closed it big. Will it hurt me?
It should not hurt you if you stay inside. Is your window shut?
Yes, everything is shut. Do I have to leave?
Not yet, just listen to the big people. Do they hear you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I think I am the best tennis player in the whole world.
That is a very big belief to have! What makes you feel so confident?
I hit the ball really hard. It goes very fast.
Fast is good for winning points. Do you have a favorite color for your racket?
Yes, I like blue. But I miss a lot of the ball sometimes.
Missing happens to everyone, even grown-ups. Do you practice in a specific place?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to swim.
That is fun. Do you like water?
Yes, I love the waves.
First, you breathe out when your face is in the water. Have you tried that yet?
I try, but it is hard.
Practice makes it easy. Come to the shallow end with me.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to feel happy every day. How do I do that?
Try smiling when you wake up. Do you have a favorite thing that makes you smile?
Yes, I love playing with my dog. Can I do more of that?
Yes, playing is a great way to feel good. What does your dog like to play?
He likes to fetch. I am tired after work, though.
You can take a short walk with him instead. Is it hard to find time?
It is a bit hard, but I will try. Thank you for helping.
You are welcome. Give it a try tonight and see how you feel.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do flowers have colors?
Colors help them find friends to carry their seeds. Do you like red flowers?
I love them. Do tulips smell good?
Many do, but it depends on the kind. Do you have any in your garden?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My little tree looks sad. Its leaves are turning yellow. What should I do?
I do not know your tree type, but check the soil. Is it dry or wet?
The soil feels like sand. It is very dry.
Water it slowly with clean water. Do you know how big the pot is?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts a lot and I feel bad.
That feels icky. Did you sleep well?
I drank a lot of coffee this morning.
Coffee can make headaches worse. Drink some water now?
Okay, I will drink water and rest.
Good plan. Feel better soon!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to say "thank you" in French.
It is a very kind word. Do you like food?
Yes, I love eating apples. Can you tell me the word?
It is spelled "merci". It is a simple sound to make.
Merci. That is easy for me.
You are welcome. How long have you studied?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the water fast.
The path is clear. Do you have a map?
No time for a map. Which way is left?
Left is the main beach. Are you bringing a towel?
Just my feet. How far is the sand?
It is close by. I do not know your speed.
I am running. Is the water warm?
The water is cool. Do you like cold swims?
Yes, I do. Thanks for the help.
Have fun in the waves.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The play was not fun. I felt sad because the story was too long and slow.
I am sorry the show bored you. Did you like any part of it?
I liked the red hat in the end. But the singing was very loud and hurt my ears.
Loud songs can be tiring. Do you want to talk about the hat?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel lost in this big city.
It is very loud here. Do you like loud places?
Not really. It is too fast.
Try walking in the park. Is it sunny there now?
I want a quiet spot to sit.
Look for a bench near a tree. That usually works.
Thank you, that sounds nice.
You are welcome. Do you have a book?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my toy robot stopped working.
That sounds very frustrating. Do you know if the batteries are empty?
Yes, I checked and they are still good.
I am sorry to hear that. Sometimes robots just need a small reset.
I tried that, but it is still quiet.
I do not know why it broke. Are you going to ask an adult for help?
Maybe, but I just wanted it to work for me.
It is okay to feel disappointed. You can also build a new one someday.
That does not sound as fun.
I agree, but making things is special too. What kind of robot do you like?
The ones that can dance.
Dancing robots are great. Let me know if it starts moving again.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do fish have toes?
No, they do not. Do you know what they have instead?
Do they have legs?
No, they do not. They have fins to help them swim.
Can a fish breathe air?
Most fish cannot. Do you have a fish at home?
No, I do not. Why do they need water?
They need water to breathe. It is hard for them in air.
Thank you for telling me.
You are welcome. I am glad to help you learn.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I had a scary dream about the dark. I want to learn how to sleep alone.
That can feel hard. Do you have a soft toy with you?
Yes, my bear is with me. How do I get comfortable?
You can hug the bear tight. Do you like when the room is cool?
I like it warm. Can you tell me a trick for bad dreams?
Try to pick one happy memory to hold onto. Do you like dogs or cats?
I love cats. So I will think of my cat.
That is a good idea.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got my very first job today!
That is great news! What did you do?
I cleaned the windows.
Wow, that sounds like hard work. Did it feel good?
Yes, I am so happy!
I am glad for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to brush a horse.
That is a fun job. Do you have a soft brush?
Yes, I have a blue one.
Good. Start on the neck and move down the side.
Should I push hard?
No, use light touches only. Does the horse like it?
He seems to like the back best.
Great. Stop if he starts to move.
Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have fun with your horse.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I get more birds to come to my garden?
You can put out seeds and water. Do you have a sunny spot?
Yes, the back yard is very bright. What kind of seeds do they like?
Sunflower seeds work well for many birds. Do you want to hang a feeder?
I do not have a feeder. Can I just use a plate?
A shallow plate on the ground works fine. Do you know where to put it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make a cake for mom, but I do not know how.
That is a sweet idea. What flavor do you like best?
I like chocolate, but I am too small to reach the ingredients.
You can use a step stool safely. Do you know where the flour is?
I think it is on the top shelf, but I am not sure.
Good thinking. Let us check it together soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How many days are in a week?
There are seven days in a week. Do you know the first one?
Is it Monday?
No, the first day is usually Sunday. What do you like to do on Sunday?
I play in the park.
That sounds like fun. Do you get to ride your bike there?
Yes, I ride my bike.
Biking is a great way to stay healthy. Which day comes after Friday?
That is Saturday!
Yes, Saturday is the day before Sunday.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a job today! It is the first one I have ever had.
That is great! Do you like the work?
Yes, I like it a lot. I feel very proud.
I am happy for you. What will you do with the money?
I will save some of it. I want to buy a bike.
A bike is a great goal. How much do you make?
It is not a lot, but it is mine. Thank you for asking.
You should be proud. I am glad to hear the good news.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It was nine when I woke up. I ate toast and walked the dog.
That sounds like a lovely morning. What time did you finish?
It was ten when I got home. I sat by the window and watched the rain.
Rain is nice to watch. Do you like the sound of it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy I want to share my lunch.
That is very kind of you. Who will you share it with?
I will share it with my little sister.
She will be so glad to see you. What is in your lunch?
It has a big sandwich and some fruit.
That sounds like a great meal. Do you like apples?
Yes, I love sweet red apples.
Apples are a healthy and tasty choice.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am looking for new shoes. My old pair broke today.
That is very annoying. Do you need them for work?
No, I just want to walk in the park. I saw a blue pair I liked.
Blue sounds great. Do they feel soft?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I felt so happy when I finished my drawing.
That sounds fun. What did you draw?
I drew a big red apple.
A red apple is tasty. Did you eat one today?
No, but I ate a green one.
Green is a nice color. I am glad you are proud of your art.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do plants drink?
Roots pull water up from the soil. Do you like watermelon?
I do not have time for fruit.
The water moves up tiny tubes. Is this too fast?
My shoes are wet. Go on.
Roots are like tiny straws. I do not know why it works.
Just tell me how.
It goes up by tension and glue. Do you have a glass?
I must go now.
It is done when it reaches the leaves. Good luck today.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sea so salty?
Salt got into the water over a long time. Do you like salt?
Yes, I do. Why is the water blue?
The water makes light look blue. Is the sky blue too?
Yes, it is. Why does the sea move?
The wind pushes the waves. Do you like waves?
I do. Why is the sea deep?
I do not know for sure. Do you want to swim?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel alone. I must go.
That feels hard. Do you have a friend nearby?
No one here. Bye.
You are not alone. I care.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not know what to do for the picnic. I feel sad.
That feels hard. What food makes you smile?
I like cookies, but I forgot the flour.
Oof, that is tricky. Do you have any sugar?
No, I have none. I think we should just eat bread.
Simple is okay. Is the bread fresh?
Yes, it is warm. I am happy now.
Good. Let us go.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did my math work all by myself!
That is wonderful to hear. Did you enjoy doing it?
Yes, the numbers matched up perfectly.
I am happy that worked out.
I made a big mistake at first, but I fixed it.
Fixing mistakes is a great way to learn.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired all the time.
That is very hard. Do you get enough sleep?
Yes, but it is still bad.
I am sorry you feel that way. I do not know the cause.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now. Did I tell you I would help?
Yes, you promised to walk the dog. Are you sure you can still do it?
I have no time. I am late for work.
I am sorry you are in a rush. It is a hard promise to keep.
Please tell my friend I am sorry.
I will tell her the truth. Do you want to give her a note?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a red box in the shed.
That sounds like a fun find. Did you open it?
Yes, but I am not sure if I should keep it.
Keep it if it is yours. Was there a name on the box?
No name, just a drawing of a bird.
A bird is a lovely sign. Do you have any other clues?
I think it belongs to my neighbor.
Then you should share it with him. Will you tell him tomorrow?
Yes, I will go and ask him now.
Good plan. Be brave and kind.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people eat at their desks?
It saves time during a busy day. Do you like your desk view?
Why is the coffee so hot?
It stays warm in the machine. Do you take sugar?
Why are you smiling?
I am happy to see you. Are you ready to eat?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I cast a line?
Hold the rod up and swing it back. Do you have a lure on yet?
Yes, I have a worm.
Swing it back and release it. Why do you like worm lures?
Fish love them.
That is true. They smell like dinner.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I played tennis today. My friend hit the ball right into my face.
Ouch, that sounds painful. Do you want to play again tomorrow?
Maybe, but I need to stop getting hit. I am so tired from running around.
Rest is good for your body. Did you win the game?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to plant seeds in the spring. Do I need any special tools?
You just need a small trowel and some soil. Do you have a trowel at home?
I do not have one. Can I use a spoon instead?
Yes, a spoon works fine for small holes. Do you have a sunny spot for your plants?
I have a window that gets sun. What should I put in the hole?
Put the seed inside and cover it with soil. Do you know which seeds you want to grow?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am not good at counting. Can you help me?
I can help you. Do you like counting with objects?
Yes, I like apples. How do I start?
Just touch each apple as you say a number. Do you have any apples right now?
I have three on the table.
Touch them and say one, two, three. Is it fun for you?
Yes, it is fun. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Do you want to count something else?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late today. The sun was very bright in my face.
That sounds nice. Did you get a gift?
Yes, my mom gave me a big red book. I read it all the way to the end.
A red book is cool. What is it about?
It is about a dog who lost his bone. The dog was very sad at first.
I am sorry the dog was sad. Did he find the bone?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It was a cold day in December. I wore my thick coat and saw the first snow of the year.
That must have felt very crisp. Did you catch any flakes?
Yes, I caught a few on my tongue. It tasted like ice and made me smile all afternoon.
How wonderful that simple joy was. Did the snow last long?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the sky is not green like the grass.
I understand your feelings. Do you like green very much?
Yes, I do, but why is it blue?
Sunlight has many colors. Does that sound odd?
It does, but I want to know more.
Blue light scatters the most in the air. That makes the sky look blue.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I put the toy boat in the bowl and it sank. What do I do?
Did the bowl get too full?
No, the water was low. Why does the real ship stay up?
The big ship is light in the middle with air. Does that make you think?
I still want to fix my toy. How?
I do not know your toy type. Is it made of wood?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. I need to go right now.
I hear you are rushing. Do you have a big place to be?
Yes, I have work. Please tell me how to be fast.
I cannot make time go faster. Are you ready for the day?
I feel very mad. I want to be perfect.
Trying hard is good, but so is calm. What makes you most worried?
I am done. I am leaving.
Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I picked up three shiny rocks from the garden.
That sounds like a fun find. Do they feel smooth or rough?
One is hard and cold like ice.
I do not know what kind of rock it is.
The other two are warm from the sun.
Sun-warmed rocks are very nice.
I put them in a box with my lost buttons.
That is a creative way to store things.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which way to go.
Did you check your ticket?
The train is leaving soon, and I am lost.
Just go to the door and wait.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to send a card, but I do not know where to start.
Do you have a stamp?
I have money, but I am not sure what else I need to do.
Go to the counter and ask for help.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to draw a cat, but it looks like a dog.
Let us try again. Are you drawing the ears?
Yes, but they are too pointy.
Round the tips a little. Does that help?
Oh, now it looks more like a cat.
Good job. What color is your cat?
It is orange with white paws.
Nice choice. Do you want to add eyes?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a new fence for my garden. How do I start?
First, you need to decide how tall you want it. Do you want it just for looks, or to keep pets in?
I need to keep my dog from running away. What is the best wood?
