Cedar is good because it fights bugs and rot. Do you have any tools ready for digging?
I have a shovel, but I am not sure where to dig. How deep should the holes be?
Dig them about two feet deep so they stand strong. Is the ground in your garden soft or hard?
It is mostly clay, which is quite hard. How do I make it stick?
Use cement in the holes to make them solid. Do you have a friend to help you hold the wood up?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How does a plant drink water?
It soaks up water through its roots. Do you see the thin lines on the leaves?
Yes, I do. How does the water move up?
It travels up tiny tubes inside the stem. Think of it like a straw.
That is cool. What does the plant do with the water?
It uses the water to make food from sunlight.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so tired, but I am very happy.
That is a nice feeling. What made you happy?
I played in the rain today.
Rain can be fun. Do you like cold water?
Yes, it feels fresh.
I do not know what rain feels like. How is it to stand in it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel sick and my nose runs.
Do you have a fever?
My head feels hot and my throat hurts.
Please drink warm water and rest.
What should I eat?
Soup is good for you.
Will I be better soon?
I hope so.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Why do leaves drop off trees? I have to go!
Trees let go to save energy for winter. Do you like the crunch of leaves?
Yes, but I am late. What happens next?
The tree sleeps until spring brings new green.
Okay, thanks. Goodbye.
Goodbye! Have a great day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we float when we hold our breath?
You fill your lungs with air to stay up. Do you like how that feels?
Why is the pool water salty?
It helps keep the water clean for everyone. Do you play in pools often?
Why do we wear caps in the pool?
They keep hair out of the filters. Do your parents buy you one?
Why does cold water make me feel awake?
It tells your body to be alert and safe. Do you feel cold too?
Why do some people swim very fast?
I do not know the exact reason for each person. Do you want to try it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I hold the camera, but I do not know where to point it.
Look for things that catch your eye first. Do you like bright colors?
Yes, I see the red flower, but my hands shake.
Hold the camera with both hands close to your body. This keeps the picture steady.
That helps, but now I have too many pictures and none are good.
Do not worry, taking many shots is part of the fun. I do not know which one you like best.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My new neighbor plays loud music all day.
That is very tiring. How long does it last?
It has been two hours. I feel angry.
I understand. Have you asked him to stop?
No, I am too shy.
You can be kind and firm. Do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a magic box in my room.
That sounds very strange. Do you know where it came from?
I think it fell from the sky.
I do not know what that means. Did it make a loud sound?
It was quite heavy.
Please do not open it. Are you feeling okay?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I broke the cup. Why is it broken?
Glass is hard but thin. Do you hold it tight?
Yes, I did. Why did it still break?
Glass does not bend. It snaps under hard pressure. Was it very hot?
No, it was cold. Why is cold glass bad?
Cold glass is brittle. It cracks easy when hit. Did you drop it?
No, it slipped. Why did it slip?
Wet hands are slick. Water makes things slide. Did you wash your hands?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My chair leg is wobbly and I am sad.
That sounds tricky. Do you have a tool kit?
Yes, I have a small hammer and some glue.
Glue might help if the wood is broken.
The wood is just loose, not broken.
You can tighten it with the hammer.
I hit the screw and it feels better.
Great work. Did you try sitting on it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big bear by the river today.
That sounds exciting. Was it playing in the water?
Yes, it was splashing around a lot.
Bears love to swim. Did you take a photo?
No, I was too scared to get close.
Being safe is very important. Did it look happy?
It looked very calm and strong.
Nature can be both scary and beautiful.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big blue dot on the map. What is that?
That is a lake. Do you like to swim?
No, I think it is a house. It has a red roof.
You are right, it is a house. Does it have a garden?
Yes, it has flowers. Where do I go to see it?
Follow the yellow line here. Is the line clear?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is a circle?
A circle is round and has no corners. Do you like to draw circles?
Yes, I do. Is a square the same?
No, a square has four straight sides. Do you have a square toy?
I have a square block. What is a triangle?
A triangle has three pointy sides. Do you see any triangles?
I see one on my shirt. Is that all shapes?
There are many more shapes to learn.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does five come after four?
Because we add one more thing to the pile. Do you have any blocks to try?
If I add one to five, is it six?
Yes, exactly right. You are doing a great job.
What is the number after six?
It is seven. Can you count it out loud?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the river water so cold?
Ice from the snow melts and makes it cold. Do you like playing in it?
It is scary, but I want to swim.
Please be safe and stay near the edge.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, my bread is getting so big! I am so glad it is working.
It smells wonderful. How do you like to eat it?
I love it warm with butter. It feels like a cloud inside.
That sounds very tasty.
I want to give some to you. It is fresh and soft.
That is very kind. Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water so blue?
The sun makes it look that way. Do you see the sky?
What makes the boats go up and down?
The wind pushes the waves high. Do you like the sound?
Why do the gulls fly so low?
I do not know for sure. Maybe they are looking for fish.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the people on stage pretend to be dead?
They act like it to make the story fun for you. Do you like to play games?
But why do they not just walk away?
The story needs a big surprise to keep you watching. Have you seen a magic trick?
I guess I get it. Why do we clap after?
We clap to say we enjoyed the show very much. Do you know how to clap?
I think I am done asking now.
That is good. You learned something new today.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do fish bite the hook?
They think it is food. Do you like to eat?
I do! Why do they not see the string?
It is very thin. Do you see ants?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: There is a big red light on the building across the street.
That is fire trucks, sweetie. Are you okay?
It is very loud and I do not like the sound.
Loud noises can be scary, but you are safe in our house. Do you want a warm hug?
Can we see it from my bed?
Please stay out of the windows for now. Is your toy with you?
Yes, my bear is right here with me.
Good, that helps a lot. Do you feel better now?
I still hear the sirens but you are here.
I am right here with you. Would you like to drink some water?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sun so hot today?
It is hot because the sun is very close and the air is dry. Do you have a fan at home?
I like it, but it does not work well. How can I make it colder?
You can put your fan in the freezer for a bit to cool the air. Are you wearing light clothes?
Yes, I am in a t-shirt and shorts. What else can I do?
You should drink cold water and stay in the shade. Do you have an umbrella?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I found a coin in my shoe. It is nice.
That is a lucky find. Do you keep it?
I feel bad. I wanted to buy a toy with it.
You can still save it. Do you want the toy?
Yes, but I am low on money. I am sad.
I do not know the price. Let us check together?
Okay. I feel better now. Thank you.
You are welcome. Is there anything else?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the water in the ocean salty?
It gets salt from rocks breaking apart. Do you like swimming in salt water?
No, it stings my eyes.
That happens because salt pulls water from your eyes. Do you swim in a pool instead?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make honey at home. How do I start?
You cannot make it, but you can collect it from bees. Do you have a garden?
I do, but can I just take the honey without hurting the bees?
Bees make honey for their babies, so taking it hurts them. I do not know how to help you do that kindly.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The rain is here again. How do I fix my wet boots?
A towel and some dry socks will help. Do you have a warm place to sit?
Yes, I have a towel. But my socks are still cold.
Warm hands make warm socks. How warm is your house?
It is very cozy inside. My boots are dry now.
That is good news. Did the rain stop?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to take my boat on the lake.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a life jacket?
Yes, I do. The water is very cold today.
Cold water can be tiring. Do you have warm socks?
I have socks, but I am still cold. Should I go?
If you are safe, yes. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want new shoes but I do not know what to pick.
That is hard. Do you like running or walking?
I walk a lot, but I like to run sometimes too.
Maybe try on a pair of trainers. Do you have any favorite colors?
I like blue, but the blue ones look too tight.
Let us check the other size. Do you want to sit while I look?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I had a scary dream. I am late. Please keep it short.
I am sorry about that. Are you okay now?
Yes, I am fine. I must run.
That is good. I hope your day is calm.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy because my new shed is almost done.
That sounds great! What color did you pick for the walls?
I chose blue and I am so glad I did.
Blue is a nice color. Do you have a plan for the roof?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The leaves are turning yellow and falling. I do not know what to do with them.
You can leave them where they fall. Do you have a rake?
I have no rake, only my hands. It feels too hard for me.
You can use a stick to push them into a pile. It will be fun work.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love that book about the bear. How do I bake the honey cake from it?
That recipe is not in the story, I only know the tale. Do you have an oven at home?
Yes, I have one, but I am scared of the heat.
Turn it on low to stay safe. Is your oven easy to use?
It is very hard, with many buttons.
Just use the heat button. Do you have a spoon to mix?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to dig in the wet sand.
Wet sand is very cool to touch. Do you make big castles?
Yes, I make a big castle with a tower.
That sounds like fun work. What color is the water today?
The water looks blue and green.
Blue and green is a happy mix. Do you swim in it?
I only step in because I am cold.
Being warm is good. Can you see any small crabs hiding?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have so many days in a week?
It takes Earth seven days to spin around the Sun once. Do you like weekends?
Yes, I do. Why is Monday first?
I do not know for sure, but it has been this way for a long time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have two kings in my hand. What should I do?
That is a strong start. Do you have any other matching pairs?
No, just the kings. My friend has aces.
You might want to play a low card. How many cards are you holding?
I have four cards left. I am scared to lose.
Fear is normal. Try to keep your best cards for later.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: What is that bird doing on my branch?
It looks like it is looking for food. Do you have any seed nearby?
I think so, but I do not know what it likes.
I am not sure, but you can try some sunflower seeds. Is it making any noise?
No, it is very quiet and just sits there.
That is okay. Birds like to watch their surroundings.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My neighbor is very loud at night. I do not know what to do.
That is hard. Do you feel safe?
I think I should tell him, but I am afraid.
Talking is the best start. You can ask a friend to help.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel all by myself in the big house.
That can feel very heavy. What makes you feel alone right now?
My friends went to play outside.
I am sorry your friends left. Do you want to sit with me?
But I just want to talk to someone.
I am here to listen to you. What is on your mind?
I just miss talking to people.
It is good that you told me.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not want to eat. The food looks bad.
I am sorry to hear that. Can I help you fix it?
No, I just want my usual. It is not there.
I am checking the menu now. Do you like pasta?
Yes, but I am too mad to eat.
I get that. I will get you the pasta soon.
Okay. Thank you for trying.
You are welcome. I hope it makes you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My little tree is sad and its leaves are brown. What should I do?
Is it getting enough water? Try giving it a cup of water and some sun.
I watered it, but it still looks tired. Should I cut the dead leaves off?
Yes, you can trim the brown leaves to help it. It might just need time to feel better.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big blue river today.
That sounds nice. Is it fast or slow?
It goes very fast.
Oh, that must be loud. Do you like the sound?
Yes, it feels good.
I am glad for you. Is it warm there?
The sun is out too.
How lovely. Have you been there before?
This is my first time.
I am happy you had fun.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to make snowmen in winter.
What makes you want to build a snowman?
I love the cold and the fun of it.
You need three big balls of snow. Roll them on the ground to make them round.
How do I make the face?
I am not sure about your exact tools, but you can use stones for eyes. Do you have any sticks for the arms?
Yes, I have lots of sticks.
Great. Put the sticks on the sides and enjoy your cold day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do bears eat fish?
They love the yummy meat. Do you like eating fish?
Why do snakes not have ears?
I do not know for sure. They hear sound with their body.
Why do birds fly south in winter?
It is too cold here, so they find warm places.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I finished my homework and I feel mad, not proud.
That is a hard feeling. What made you feel that way?
I thought I did a great job, but Mom said it was wrong.
I am sorry your work was not right. That feels unfair.
I do not want to try again. It is too hard.
Taking a break is okay. Do you feel a little less angry now?
A little. I think I can fix it later.
That is a brave choice. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to paint this wall white right now.
White is a good choice. Do you have your brush ready?
The brush is under the sink. I am late.
Grab it quickly. Do you know where the bucket is?
Yes, it is by the door. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream on the grass. The dog ate it all up. I felt so sad.
That is a very bad day. Did you have a backup treat?
No, I was hungry. I felt very upset about it. I did not know what to do next.
I am sorry to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so hungry and I forgot my lunch.
Oh no. Did you bring a snack at all?
No, I did not bring anything.
That is tricky. Would you like to share my sandwich?
Yes, please.
Here you go. How did your morning work go?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake a cake for my birthday. How do I start?
You need flour, sugar, and eggs. Do you have them?
Yes, I have them all. What do I do next?
Mix the dry stuff first, then add the wet stuff. Is your bowl clean?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was very bright and warm today. I saw a blue bird in the big tree.
That sounds nice. What did the bird do?
It sang a loud song and then flew away. It was a happy day.
I am glad you enjoyed it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the teacher look so tired today?
I am not sure why she is tired. Do you think she stayed up late?
Maybe she had a hard day. Does she always look like that?
No, she usually looks happy and bright. Do you like reading with her?
Yes, I do. Why is she so kind to us?
She is kind because she cares about you. Do you help her clean up?
Sometimes I do. Why does she thank me so much?
She thanks you because it makes her feel good. Do you like helping?
I do like it. Why do teachers work so hard for us?
They work hard because they want you to learn. Do you have a good day?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for school. I need food now.
I will get you a toast. Do you like jam on it?
Yes, please. Can I have some milk too?
Milk is coming. Do you want a spoon?
Yes, thank you. I must go now.
Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to save money, but I never have any left at the end of the month.
That is a common problem. Do you write down what you spend?
I usually just buy things when I feel like it. I do not track my costs.
Writing everything down helps you see where the money goes. Do you keep a small notebook?
No, I do not. I usually just check my phone, but I forget to look at the balance.
Your phone has a free app for this. Have you tried using one?
I have not. I am afraid it will be hard to use.
They are very easy to use. Start by putting every penny of coffee into the app.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to buy a dress for the party. How long should it be?
That is a nice choice. Do you like the color pink?
Yes, I do. What color should the shirt be?
White looks very clean. Do you have a good shoe?
My shoes are red. Is that okay with the dress?
Red is a bold pick. I think it will look fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this song at all.
That sounds like a big feeling. Did it make you feel sad?
It makes my head hurt too much.
I am sorry you are in pain. Do you want to stop playing it?
Yes, please, just turn it off.
I will turn it off now.
Thank you, that feels better.
I am happy you feel better. Do you like quiet music?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a shiny rock by the tree. Do you like shiny things?
Yes, I do like shiny things. What does your rock look like?
It is blue and smooth. I put it in my box.
That sounds like a nice find.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is learning a new language so hard for me?
It feels hard because your brain is building new paths. Do you like speaking or listening more?
I like listening, but I forget the words fast.
Forgetting is normal when you start. You are only keeping what feels fun.
But sometimes I get very sad and want to stop.
It is true that it takes time. Are you tired from studying?
I guess I am tired. How do I get better without getting sad?
Rest helps your brain learn. Try for just five minutes a day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now. The path is too long.
Take the green way. It is short. Do you see the tree?
I do not see it. My time is small.
Look left. It is big. Is your bag heavy?
Yes, it is very full. I must run.
You can walk slow. It is safe. Do you know the door?
I know the door. It is near.
Good. The air is sweet. Do you like the wind?
No. I must finish this.
Okay. Go now. It is fine.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we eat turkey for thanksgiving?
It is a food people have eaten for a long time. Do you like turkey?
I do not like it. I like pie.
Pie is sweet and warm. Do you like apple pie?
Yes, I love apple pie.
That is a great choice.
Why do people give gifts?
They do it to show they care about you. Do you like to get gifts?
Yes, I do.
That makes me happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big shed.
That is a fun idea. What will you put inside?
I will put my toys in there.
Your toys will be safe. Do you have some wood?
Yes, I have some small boards.
Good, that will work well. Can you hold the wood still?
I can hold it with both hands.
That is very steady. What tools do you have?
I have a hammer and nails.
Great, be very careful with that. Do you need help driving the nails?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to save money, but I spend it all.
That is hard to do. Do you write down what you buy?
No, I just keep it in my pocket.
Try writing it in a small book.
I will try that. What else can I do?
Make a list of wants. Do you want a toy or a snack?
A toy, usually.
Wait one week to see if you still want it.
I do not know how long to wait.
One week is a good start.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights are out, but the breaker is on. What should I do?
Is the plug in the wall? First, check if the plug is firmly in the socket.
I checked the plug, it is in. I am still in the dark.
I do not know if the wire is broken. Try plugging a lamp into a different room to see if it works.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my little doll. I am very sad.
Oh no, that is a shame. How did it happen?
I dropped it on the floor. It is all gone.
I am sorry you lost your toy. Do you have a box to put the parts in?
Yes, I have a box. I will try to fix it.
That is a good plan. Can I help you look for glue?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My boss gave me a cookie for doing a good job.
That is very sweet of him. Did you like the cookie?
Yes, it was chocolate.
Chocolate is a great choice. Does he do this often?
Sometimes, when I help clean up.
You are very helpful. Do you enjoy cleaning?
I do, because then we get a game together.
That sounds like a lot of fun. I am glad you have such a nice boss.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because I ran out of money for lunch.
That feels bad. Do you have any snacks left?
No, I am hungry and I do not have any money left.
That is a hard place to be. What did you spend it on?
I bought a new toy because I wanted it very bad.
I get why you wanted it. Do you think you can share it?
I do not want to share it, I want to keep it.
Keeping it is okay too. Did you plan how to pay for it?
No, I just grabbed it and went to the store.
That is a common mistake. How does your family pay for big things?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to tie the ribbon on my gift, but I cannot make the knot.
You can loop the end around your thumb to hold it tight. Do you have a helper to watch you?
My sister is busy, so I am doing it all by myself.
Start by making a big loop with one hand. Are your hands feeling a bit shaky?
Yes, I am a little nervous because the wedding is today.
Take a slow breath and keep your hands still. You can do this well.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I think bananas are the best fruit.
Bananas are sweet and soft. Do you like them with milk?
Yes, I do. Do you know if they grow in cold places?
No, they need warm sun to grow. Do you live in a warm place?
I do live near a lake. Do you think oranges are good too?
Oranges are tasty and juicy. Do you drink the juice?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I am going to a party today.
That is great news. Who are you going with?
I am going with my friends. It will be so much fun.
I am glad you are happy. I do not know who your friends are.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I had a very hard day. Why does it feel so heavy?
Your mind is tired from doing much. Do you rest your eyes?
I do not understand the tired feeling. Why does it stay?
I do not know for sure. Are you eating enough?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I promised to help my friend with homework today.
That is a good thing. Do you remember what you promised?
I said I would do my own work first.
That is wise. Are you done with your work?
Yes, I am finished now.
Great. Will you go help your friend?
Yes, I am going to the park.
I hope you have fun. Tell me if you need more help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go. I am late.
Do you know the bus stops soon?
Yes, I do. I must leave.
Please say thank you to your friend.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to build a shed, but I feel lost. Do I start with the floor?
You should start with a flat base. Is your ground level?
I do not know how to check if it is level. Can you show me?
I cannot see your yard from here. Do you have a long board?
I have a long board and a bubble level. What is the next step?
Build the four corner posts first. Do you have the right tools?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Why does this magnet stick to the door?
It sticks because metal in the door is pulled by the magnet. Do you need to put it on fast?
Yes, I am very late. Does it stick to wood?
No, it will not stick to wood. Do you have a wooden spot to use?
No, just the door. How do I take it off again?
You pull it straight back with a firm tug. Have you tried that yet?
I will try now. Thank you for the help.
I am happy to help you on your way. Have a safe trip to work.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do for my birthday.
That is a big choice. Do you like cake?
Yes, I love cake, but I also want to play outside.
You can do both. Who are you inviting?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I have to wait?
Waiting helps us get ready for the good parts. Do you like surprises?
Yes, I do. But it feels hard to sit still.
That is true. It takes practice to be calm. Are you feeling worried?
A little. I want it now.
Patience is like a muscle. You can grow it by taking slow breaths. Do you feel better now?
Yes, I think I do.
Great job. Your patience is growing. How do you feel inside?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That is great to hear. What is the big news?
It is my birthday.
Happy birthday to you. How old are you turning?
I am turning ten.
Ten is a wonderful age. Do you have a cake?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count things?
We count to know how many we have. Do you like counting apples?
I like counting ducks. Why is one plus one equal to two?
It is two because a single thing joined with another single thing makes a pair. Do you have any ducks?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like the part where the bear eats the pie.
Bears love sweet things. Do you like pie?
Yes, but my mom says it is bad for me.
She is right. It is better to eat fruit.
Why is fruit better?
It has vitamins that help you grow strong.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to wait for the bus.
That is a nice feeling. What makes you feel this way?
The sun is warm and I have cookies.
Cookies are always a good friend. Do they taste sweet?
Yes, they are my favorite kind.
I am glad you enjoy them.
I love waiting when I am with you.
I am happy to keep you company.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I started painting a big red sun today.
A red sun is very bright. Did you use a brush?
Yes, I used my big blue brush.
Blue makes a nice color. What else did you paint?
I put a yellow flower next to it.
Yellow flowers are happy. Do you like flowers?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is my horse?
I do not see it. Is he in the stable?
No, I left him in the yard.
Oh, I see him now. Do you like his brown coat?
I do not have time to look.
He is right there. Is he eating grass?
Just lead him to the gate quickly.
Okay. Does he listen well to you?
Yes, he is good.
Here you go.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a shiny rock.
That is a great find. What color is it?
It is purple and green.
Wow, that is so pretty.
I want to put it in my box.
A good box is a safe place. Do you have a lid for it?
No, I do not have a lid.
We can find a small box for you.
Thank you, that helps a lot.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have good news. I am going to get married.
That is so sweet. Who are you marrying?
I am marrying my best friend. I am very happy.
That sounds lovely. What color is the dress?
It is white. I love it very much.
It must look great on you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because it is my birthday.
That is wonderful news. What did you get for a gift?
I got a new book about dinosaurs.
How lucky you are to read about such cool animals.
I also have a big cake with chocolate frosting.
Yum, that sounds very sweet and fun. Do you get to sing with friends?
Yes, my friends are coming to my house soon.
I hope you have a very happy day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, why is the light off?
The fuse box may have tripped. Are you safe?
How do I fix it fast?
Open the box and flip the small switch back up. Do not touch wet hands.
It did not come on.
I do not know for sure. Please call a pro.
I will call now, thanks.
Good luck with your trip.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to leave, the house is on fire.
That is very bad. Are you safe outside?
I am running, I do not have time.
Please go to the police.
I will tell them in a minute.
Good. Did you wake your family?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the river blue on this map?
Blue means water. Do you like swimming?
I do. Why do roads look like lines?
Lines show where we walk or drive. Are they straight or twisty?
They twist a lot. Why is the forest green?
Green shows trees and plants. Do you smell pine trees?
Yes, they smell good. Why is the town red?
Red marks where people live. Do you live in a town?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big rainbow. What should I do?
Do you like looking at colors?
Yes, I like them a lot.
You can just sit and watch it.
But I feel lost.
Have you tried to take a picture?
No, my camera is broken.
Then close your eyes and remember the shape.
I still feel unsure.
Would you like to find some raindrops?
I do not know where to look.
Look at the wet grass below you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad because my boat is broken and I cannot sail.
That sounds really hard. Do you know what broke?
The rope snapped in the wind and I am scared of the big waves.
That is a scary feeling. Are your friends nearby?
They are all safe on the island, but I am stuck here alone.
You are not alone, I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The web feels too loud and fast for my mind.
I am sorry it feels that way to you. Do you usually like quiet time?
I just want the web to stop rushing me.
You can step away when you feel tired. Is there one thing you love about it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My plant looks dry and sad.
Oh no, that is tricky. Do you water it with a cup?
Yes, but I do not know where the water goes.
The roots take the water up. Do you see the dirt at the bottom?
I do, but I still feel confused and upset.
It moves up by magic. I hope it drinks soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big, still lake today. The water looked like a shiny blue mirror. It made me feel so calm and happy.
That sounds like a peaceful place to rest. Do you like the quiet sound of the wind there?
Yes, I do love the quiet. I want to sit by the shore and watch the ducks swim by.
Ducks make a lovely sight. What time of day did you visit?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see many lights in the sky but I do not know what to do with them.
They are stars shining just for you. Do you like looking up at the sky?
I am not sure if I should wish on a star or just watch them.
You can do both, or just sit and rest your eyes. Which one sounds best to you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my dog wiggle his tail?
He is happy to see you. Does he like to play?
Yes, he loves to chase balls. Is that why he wags?
Yes, he is excited when he plays. What is his favorite game?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is so hot outside. I do not know what to do.
Do you want to stay inside and read a book?
I am too tired to read. What should I do?
Have you tried drinking some cold water yet?
Yes, I drank a lot. I still feel hot.
I do not know the best fix. Do you have a fan to help?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very angry when I wait. I do not like to sit still.
That is a hard feeling. Do you take a deep breath?
I try, but my heart beats fast. How do you stop it?
I count to ten slowly. Are your hands shaking?
Yes, they tremble a bit. Is counting really that helpful?
It gives your brain time to think. Have you tried counting to five?
I only got to three before shouting. I want to give up now.
You are doing great. Try again for just one minute.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the island?
It is right over there. You will see it soon.
How far is it? I need to go now.
It is very close. Do you have your boots?
Yes, I have them. Thank you.
Good luck on your trip.
I must run. Bye.
I hope you have fun.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very hungry but I do not know what to eat. What should I pick?
That is a good question. Do you like hot food or cold food?
I like hot food. I want something with meat.
A bowl of soup with chicken is a great choice. It is warm and easy to eat.
That sounds good. Do I need to order a drink too?
A drink helps you digest. Would you like some cold water with your soup?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I keep my house safe from the wind?
You should close all the doors and windows tight.
I will do that now.
That is a good plan. Do you have a plan for when it gets very loud?
I will sit in the basement.
That is a smart place to go.
I feel better knowing this.
It is always best to stay inside during a big storm.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a secret. It is so big and good.
That sounds lovely. What is the secret?
I got a puppy at the shop. He is very small.
Oh, how sweet. What is his name?
His name is Dot. He is here with me.
Dot is a nice name. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad inside today.
I am sorry you feel that way. What makes you feel sad?
I lost my favorite toy.
That is a hard thing to lose. Do you think it is at home?
I do not know where it is.
Maybe we can look for it together. Do you remember where you last played?
I played in the yard yesterday.
The yard is a good place to check. Can you tell me what the toy looks like?
It is small and blue.
A small blue toy is easy to spot. Are you ready to go look?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My neighbor moved a big tree near my window.
That sounds like it will block the light. Do you like having trees close?
I do, but it is too close to the glass.
You should talk to them first. Have you told them about it?
I have, but they say it is fine.
I am sorry they did not listen. Do you want to call the city?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to hit the ball further, but it feels hard.
Try to swing your arm in a big circle. Do you hold the racket tight?
Yes, I squeeze it with all my strength.
You can try holding it a little softer. Have you watched someone else play?
I have watched my friend, but I do not know how he does it.
He likely moves his whole body, not just his arm. Do you bend your knees?
No, I stand up very straight.
Try bending your legs to help you jump higher. Do you practice near a wall?
Yes, I hit the wall every day after school.
That is good practice, and you will get better soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is it raining?
Clouds get heavy with water and let it fall. Do you like the sound?
Yes, it is nice. Does it always stop?
The sun will dry the wet ground soon. Do you want to go out?
Maybe after. What is inside the cloud?
It is just tiny drops of water. I do not know exactly why they move.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The river looks so blue and calm today.
That is very nice. Do you see any fish?
Yes, I see a few small ones swimming.
I am glad it brings you joy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see smoke from my neighbor's house. What should I do?
Please call 911 right away to tell them where you are. Is everyone safe inside?
Yes, I am safe. How do I use a fire extinguisher?
Pull the pin and aim at the base of the fire. Do you see the red pin?
I see the red pin. What is the next step?
Squeeze the handle and sweep the nozzle side to side. Are you wearing shoes?
Yes, I am wearing shoes. What if the fire gets big?
Run away and close the door behind you. Is the smoke getting thick?
The smoke is thick. Do I need more air?
Crawl low and get outside now. Can you see the exit?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my cat purr so loudly?
Purring often means your cat is happy and safe. Does it purr when you pet it?
Yes, it does. It also stretches a lot in the morning.
Stretching helps their muscles after sleep. Is your cat a new addition to the home?
It has lived here for two years. But it stares at the wall sometimes.
Cats often see tiny bugs or dust. Do you see anything moving there?
I usually do not see anything at all.
Cats have very good eyes and ears. It may just be exploring its world.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the water deep here?
Yes, it is very deep. Do you see the big ship?
I think I do. Will it sink?
No, ships are built to float. Are you afraid of the water?
No, but I do not swim well. Can I touch the boat?
No, do not go near the edge. Are you wearing your shoes?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting so long.
Drink some water and walk down the aisle. Did you eat?
Not yet, I was too busy watching films.
Please eat something small. Your body needs fuel to feel better. Do you like cookies?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do clouds float up there?
Air is lighter than water. Do you like to float?
I guess so. Are they made of water?
Yes, they are tiny drops of water. Do you see rain?
Sometimes I do. Does it ever snow from clouds?
Yes, cold clouds make snow. Is it cold outside?
It feels a bit chilly. Thank you for telling me.
You are welcome. I hope you stay dry.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my boss was not nice today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did he raise his voice?
Yes, he was very loud and mean to me.
That is hard to hear. Do you want to tell me what happened?
I made a small mistake and he yelled at me.
You should feel better when you take a break. Would you like some water?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my dog lick his face so much?
He does that to clean himself. Does he seem happy when he does it?
Yes, he looks very happy.
That is a good sign. It means he feels safe.
What if he never stops licking?
If he cannot stop, you should ask a vet. Is he doing it all day long?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to climb a big mountain. How do I do it?
You need strong legs and warm clothes. Do you like cold weather?
Yes, I do. What else should I bring?
Bring lots of water and food.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do clouds look fluffy?
I think it is because they are made of tiny water drops. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. How do they make rain?
I am not sure of the exact mix, but warm air helps them grow heavy. Do you like rain?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big boat on the water today.
That sounds like fun. Was it moving fast?
It was very slow, like a turtle.
Turtles are cool, too. Do you like boats?
I do not like boats. I like cars.
Cars are great. Do you have a toy car?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am so tired today.
That sounds rough. Did you eat lunch?
No, I was too busy.
You must rest now. What made you so busy?
The work was very hard.
I am sorry about that.
How do I make it easier next time?
I do not know your job. Try asking for help first.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a dog for my birthday.
A dog is fun! Do you like to play fetch?
Yes, I do. What does the dog need?
It needs food and a warm bed.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am very tired but I cannot sleep.
Do you have a bed to rest on?
I do, but my brain will not stop thinking.
Try to think of a calm place like a lake.
A lake sounds nice, but it does not help.
Have you tried counting slow breaths?
I have not, but I want to learn that.
Count to five as you breathe in.
And what should I do when I breathe out?
Count back to one as you let the air out.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to take a temperature.
Place the top of the thermometer under your tongue. Do you have one at home?
Yes, I do. What do I do after that?
Wait for two to three minutes until it beeps. Does it beep for you?
I am not sure. Is it okay to use it on my arm?
No, use your mouth, armpit, or rectum. It works best in the mouth.
Okay, I will try that. What if it is high?
A number over 100.4 means you have a fever. Call your doctor if it stays high.
Thank you. What should I bring with me?
Bring your ID and a list of your symptoms. Do you feel tired?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The market is so loud and full of color.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What is your favorite thing there?
I saw a big, red apple on a stall.
Red apples look sweet and tasty. Do they smell good too?
Yes, they smell sweet and the sun is warm.
I am glad you are happy. I do not know if they taste as good as they look.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are the stars twinkling?
They shine bright, but the air makes them dance. Do you see any falling ones?
No, I do not.
That is good news.
Do the stars ever get tired?
I do not know for sure, but they stay bright all night.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I felt very hungry after school today. I went home and ate two big apples.
Apples are a good snack. Did you drink any water with them?
Yes, I drank a glass of water. It was very hot outside.
That is a smart choice. Do you like eating cold food in the heat?
I like it. Later, I had a small bowl of rice for dinner.
Rice gives you good energy. Did you sleep well last night?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my way and I feel so bad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have the map with you?
Yes, but I cannot find where I am.
Look for a blue line near a tree. Is there a blue line near a tree?
I see a blue line, but it goes nowhere.
That sounds confusing. Let us look at the big symbols.
I see a star, but it is not my house.
A star usually means a park. Is your house near a park?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie my new shoes?
Do you like red laces? First, make a cross with the strings.
I made a cross. What next?
I am not sure if your hands are tired. Please loop the strings and pull tight.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not want to go to the doctor. My throat hurts.
I am sorry you feel bad. Have you eaten anything today?
No, I feel too sick to eat. I just want to stay in bed.
That makes sense. Do you have a fever?
Yes, I felt hot earlier. I am mad that I have to go.
It is okay to feel mad. Can I come with you?
Yes, please. I do not like being alone there.
I will sit with you. How do you feel right now?
A little less scared now. Thank you for being here.
I am glad to help. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am late for school. What should I do?
Run fast to the door. Are you wearing your shoes?
Yes, I am. Is the bus leaving soon?
I do not know. Is it raining outside?
No, it is sunny. Thank you.
You are welcome. Go now.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a dog that looks just like my old friend.
That is a nice surprise. Do you know where it went?
I do not know where it went.
That is hard to say for sure. Was the dog happy?
Yes, the dog seemed very happy.
Happy dogs make friends happy. Do you want to play with it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees in the cold?
They fall to help the tree save energy. Do you like picking up leaves?
I want to know how I can make my own leaf art.
You can stick dried leaves on paper with glue.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to write a letter now, but I do not know what to say.
Do not worry, start with "Dear" and then say how you feel. What are you writing to?
That is kind, thank you. I am writing to my friend who lives far away.
That is a sweet idea. Tell them about your week.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big surprise to tell you!
That sounds exciting. What is it?
I am going to the beach tomorrow!
How wonderful! Will you swim?
Yes, and I have a secret for you.
I am happy for you. What is the secret?
You are coming with me!
That is very kind of you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have these red flowers, but I do not know where to put them.
Do you want to give them to someone?
I think yes, but I am not sure who to ask.
Have you thought of your best friend?
I am still not sure, but I will try to ask them.
That sounds like a good start.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel warm, but I do not know if I should go outside.
The sun feels nice on skin. Do you like the bright light?
Yes, but it looks very bright today.
It is bright when the sun is high. Can you see your shadow on the ground?
I see a small shadow near my feet.
That means the sun is high up. Do you have any cool water?
I have a cup of cold water.
Drink some to stay cool. Would you like to sit in the shade?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to start growing vegetables, but I am not sure where to begin.
Start with easy plants like tomatoes or peas. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
Yes, my backyard gets sun for a long time. I also wonder if I need big pots.
You do not need big pots to start. You can use small containers first.
That is good to know. What do I do if the plants get sick?
I do not know exactly what is wrong with them yet. Please tell me if the leaves look yellow or dry.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very excited for my big party today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Who is coming to play with you?
All my friends are coming to my house.
They must be happy to see you. Do you like getting presents?
Yes, I love getting presents.
That is a nice thing to have.
I am going to eat a big cake too.
Cake is a tasty treat. Do you like strawberries on top?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my cat wash its face?
It uses its rough tongue to clean itself. Does your cat have soft fur?
Yes, it is very fluffy. Why does it chirp at birds?
It makes that sound when it wants to catch them. Does it chirp often?
Not really, just sometimes. Why does it kick its blanket?
It tries to trap food like in the wild. Is the blanket thick?
It is quite thick. Why does it rub on my legs?
It marks you with its scent to say you are safe. Do you like that touch?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I get birds to come to my tree?
You can put out some seeds in a bowl. Do you have any birds now?
No, just a few sparrows. How do I keep them safe?
I do not know for sure, but a wide bowl helps. Are they scared of cats?
Yes, the cat watches them closely. What else can I do?
Try planting tall grass nearby. They like to hide in it. Do you like gardening?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so late. I feel very bad.
It is okay. Did you lose track of time?
My watch was wrong. I forgot to fix it.
That is tricky. Do you need help finding a bus?
I just want to be there now.
Take a deep breath. Let us go fast, but safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My head feels so heavy and hurts.
I am sorry you feel this way. Did you sleep well?
I think it is from reading too much.
That can make your head hurt. Have you tried resting your eyes?
I do not know what else to do.
I do not know for sure. Would you like to drink some water?
I will sit down and try that.
That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why is the sky blue? I feel so sad today.
It is blue because light hits the air and scatters. Are you okay?
I just need to know why it is not red.
Red light passes through, but blue light spreads wide. Do you like colors?
Yes, I like blue. That helps a little.
Blue is a calm color for you. I hope you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My fridge magnet fell off the door. Now it will not stick to the paper.
That is very frustrating. Did you try putting it back on the metal part?
I did try that. It just slid right off.
Is the metal clean and dry?
Yes, I wiped it clean. Why does it not want to work?
Magnets need good contact to stick well. Does it still pull on a paper clip?
No, it does not pull on anything. It feels weak.
It might be a weak magnet. Do you have another one to test?
I have one, but I do not want to break it either. I feel so sad.
Do not worry, it is just an object. Let us find a new spot for it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is so bright and warm today. I feel very happy.
That sounds wonderful. What did you do to enjoy it?
I drank cold water and read a book under a big tree.
That is a nice thing to do. Do you like reading outside?
Yes, the leaves make a cool shadow. I want to share my joy with you.
I am glad you are happy. I share your smile.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My phone screen is blank. I do not know what to do.
Does it make any sound when you press the buttons?
No, it is very quiet. I am so worried.
Try holding the side button down for a long time. Did the lights come on?
Yes, it turned on. Thank you so much.
I am glad it worked. Do you know why it shut off?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read a book under my lamp before bed.
That sounds cozy. Did you finish the whole chapter?
No, my eyes felt too tired to go on.
Your eyes know what they need to rest.
I set the book on the pillow and hugged it.
A soft pillow helps you sleep better. Do you have a favorite pillow?
Yes, the blue one with the cloud pattern.
A cloud pillow is very nice.
Now I am closing my eyes for the night.
Goodnight. Sleep well.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: This chair leg is wobbly. I do not know how to stop it.
Is the screw loose? That is a common problem.
I think so, but I have no tool. What should I use?
A butter knife works well. Have you tried turning it?
I tried, but it slipped and broke. Now the hole is big.
That is tricky. Do you have any wood glue?
No, I do not have glue. I am stuck. What do I do?
You can use chewing gum. It is strong and sticky.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is learning a new language so hard at first?
Your brain is making new paths to think and speak. Do you enjoy the challenge?
It feels confusing. Why do words change shapes?
Words change to show time and count things clearly. I do not know why your specific word is tricky.
What should I do to get better?
Listen to it every day and try to say it out loud. Do you have a favorite sound?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do I win chess?
Take the king. Do you have a safe spot for him?
No time. Where does the queen go?
She moves like rook and bishop. Is she strong yet?
Just tell me the plan. Fast.
Protect your king first. Do you trust your pieces?
I am gone. Good luck.
You can go. I hope you win.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people learn to sing?
Singing feels good and brings joy. Do you like music?
I wonder if it is hard to learn.
It is easy to start with small steps. Are you ready to try?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am scared to lift the big box.
That is a smart worry. Do you have a friend to help?
I am all alone in the room.
Keep your back straight and bend your knees. Can you lift small things?
Yes, I can lift a dog.
Use two hands and lift with your legs. What will you do first?
I will try to move it now.
Take your time and do not rush. Are you ready to go?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My room is very messy. I do not know where to start.
Start with the floor. Do you like to tidy up or play first?
I like to tidy up first. But it takes too long.
Break it into small jobs. This helps you rest.
Okay. What should I clean next?
Do the books next. Are your shelves full?
Yes, they are very full.
Put the books in a box for now. This makes space.
That sounds good. How do I clean the box?
I do not know. Ask someone who knows.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up with a quiet stomach.
That is a good start for the day. Did you drink some water first?
Yes, I had warm water and some toast.
Warm water and toast sound very nice. What kind of toast did you choose?
It was just plain bread, with no butter.
Simple is often best. Thank you for sharing your morning with me.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for my party.
That is exciting. What are you giving to the kids?
I forgot the cake.
Oh no. Do you have any fruit in the fridge?
Yes, I have bananas.
Good. Can you make a banana split?
I will try, but I must go.
Run fast. Happy birthday.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to draw a shape that has three corners, but I am not sure what to call it.
That is called a triangle. It is easy to make. Are you using a crayon?
Yes, I am using a red crayon. It is very sharp.
Red is a nice color for a triangle. Do you like making shapes?
I like making circles best, but I do not know how to draw a square.
A square has four equal sides. You just draw four lines that touch. Do you have a ruler?
I do not have a ruler, only my hand. My hands are small.
Your hands will help you practice. Try to keep the sides the same size. Is this a new book for you?
It is a new book. I want to learn more about all the shapes.
That is a good plan. Try the triangle first.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we use soap to wash clothes?
Soap helps pull the dirt off the fabric. Do you know what kind of dirt is hard to get out?
I think mud is very hard to remove.
Yes, mud can be tricky and sticky. Have you ever tried a different brand of soap?
No, I only use the blue bottle.
That is a good start for clean clothes. What color do you usually wash with?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to start collecting rocks. Do I need a big box for them?
A box works well, but a drawer is easier to open. Do you like smooth or rough rocks?
I like the smooth ones that feel like little eggs. How do I keep them clean and shiny?
Gently wash them with water and let them dry in the sun. Do you want to put them all in one place?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love to draw pictures of cats.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you draw them sleeping?
Yes, they look so soft and cozy.
I do not know what they look like. Can you tell me more?
They have long tails and soft fur.
I think cats are very sweet.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to sit at my desk.
That sounds hard. What do you want to do instead?
I want to play with my dog.
Playing is fun. But your dog needs you to be calm.
My dog is not calm. He is jumping.
That is a common problem. Can you show him where he should sit?
He is too big to sit on my chair.
True, he is quite large. How about a cool spot on the floor?
The floor is cold.
You can use a blanket. Does that sound better?
Yes, a blanket is warm.
Good thinking. Are you ready to work now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My fence looks broken. It is too short and the wood is brown. What should I do?
I think you need to paint it again. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, I like blue. But the bottom part is soft and wet. Will the paint help?
Paint will not fix wet wood. I do not know how to fix that part, but you can ask an adult.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to draw a cat.
You can start with a circle for the head. Do you like cats?
Yes, I love them. What do I draw next?
Add two triangles for ears on top.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a big box to send away. What do I do?
You must put a stamp on it. Do you like writing letters?
I do not know where the stamps are.
They are near the front desk.
Is the place open late at night?
I do not know their times. Do you need to go today?
I want to send it now.
Please ask the staff there. Good luck with your box.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the ball round?
It rolls fast and far. Do you like watching games?
Yes, I do. What is a goal?
It means we scored a point. Does that make sense?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because I love thinking about sailors.
That is a lovely feeling. Do you like the sea?
Yes, I think the big waves are very exciting to watch.
The ocean is a wild place. What is your favorite part of a boat?
I love the tall, white sails that catch the wind.
Sails help the boat move fast. Do you want to be a sailor one day?
Maybe, but mostly I just like to read stories about them.
That is a great way to learn. Do you have a favorite story?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to live in a small village. What should I look for?
Look for a place with clean water and friendly faces. Is it near a forest?
Yes, I like trees. What else is important?
Good roads are key for getting around. Do you have a car?
No, I ride a bike. Does that work?
It works well if the hills are not too steep. I am not sure about the exact slope there.
That is a problem. What if the roads are bad?
You can always walk or wait for a bus. Do you like to walk?
I do not mind walking. Is it quiet there?
Yes, it is very quiet and peaceful. Do you want that much quiet?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the blue box. I am late.
It is on the top shelf. Are you buying it for a gift?
Yes, please. Can I pay fast?
The register is right there.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because I got a big red star on my drawing.
That is wonderful news. What did you draw for that star?
I drew a funny cat with a big smile.
That sounds very cute. I hope you can show it to your mom later.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the dough get big?
The tiny seeds in it eat sugar and make gas. Do you like watching it rise?
Yes, I do. Why do we use warm water?
Warm water wakes the seeds up fast.
What if the water is too hot?
Hot water kills the seeds. Do you like the smell of baking?
I love the smell. Why do we punch the dough down?
It pushes the gas bubbles out. Does it feel soft to you?
It is very soft. Why do we bake it in the end?
Heat turns the dough hard and tasty.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just ran a mile and I feel so great!
That is wonderful news! How did your legs feel?
They felt a bit tired but happy.
Good rest is key for tired legs. Do you plan to run again soon?
Yes, I want to run every day this week!
That is a bold goal! Make sure to drink plenty of water.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like it here. It is too quiet.
That can feel lonely. Do you want to walk to the park?
The park is far away. My legs are tired.
I can walk with you. Is there a bench near the water?
Yes, there is a big bench.
Great. We can sit and rest. Do you have any snacks?
No, I have no food. I am hungry.
I have an apple. Would you like half of it?
Yes, please. Thank you.
You are welcome. This is better now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I pay the bus driver?
Do you have coins?
Yes, I have some coins.
Place them in the little box near the door.
Is that all I need to do?
Yes, then find a seat and wait.
Thank you for helping me.
Are you going far today?
I am going to the park.
That sounds like fun.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My new neighbours are so sweet.
That is great to hear. Who are they?
They gave us a big box of cookies.
How nice of them. Do you like cookies?
Yes, I love chocolate ones.
They sound perfect for you.
I want to bake for them next week.
That is a lovely idea.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sky is very dark and loud today. I feel scared.
It is just a big storm. Are you safe inside?
I am inside, but the lights just went out.
Please stay away from windows. Do you have a battery?
I have some candles, but I do not know how to be safe.
Do not use candles near paper or cloth. I do not know your exact rules, but listen to the radio.
The rain is hitting the house hard. It sounds like a drum.
That is the wind. Is everyone in your home okay?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad about the lighthouse.
I am sorry you feel that way. Why is it making you upset?
The lights are out tonight.
That is very strange. Do you know if it is broken?
Yes, I think it is broken.
That makes sense. Have you called for help?
I tried, but no one answered.
I do not know why they are quiet. Are you safe right now?
I am safe, but I feel alone.
I am here with you. You will be okay.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I say please?
Just say the word please when you ask for something. Do you always remember to do that?
I try, but sometimes I forget. Why is it important?
It shows that you care about other people. Do you feel good after you are kind?
Yes, I feel happy. Is that all there is to manners?
There is more, like saying thank you. Do you like to be thanked?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a movie today. It was very loud.
That sounds exciting. Do you like loud noises?
Yes, I do. But the end was sad.
I am sorry about that. Did you cry?
A little bit. The dog left its owner.
That is a hard part. I like my dog too.
Do you have a dog? I just have a cat.
Yes, I have a small one. Cats are nice too.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My dress felt tight today.
That sounds tricky. Did you help?
Yes, I took a small bite.
Oh no. Is it okay?
The food stayed inside.
Good. You look great.
It was a happy day.
I am glad. Thanks for telling.
See you later.
Bye. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my bread get big?
Tiny bugs make gas bubbles. Do you see the bubbles?
Yes, I see little holes.
The gas pushes the dough out. Is your kitchen warm?
Yes, it is very warm.
Warm helps the bugs work faster. Are you happy with your bread?
I am very happy.
That is great to hear. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the river today.
That sounds like fun. Did you see any fish?
I saw a big one jump in the water.
Wow, that must have been exciting.
The water was very cold on my hands.
Cold is refreshing in the sun.
I am glad I went there.
I am glad you had a good time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do the leaves turn red and orange in the fall?
The trees stop making food to save energy. Do you like to pick up the fallen leaves?
Yes, I love them. Why is the ground so hard and white in the winter?
The water turns to ice when it gets very cold. Do you wear a thick coat to stay warm?
Yes, I do. Why is everything so green and wet in the spring?
The rain helps the seeds grow into new plants. Do you like to watch the little flowers open?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am rushing. I must find my lost socks.
Are they under the bed? I can check for you.
No, they are in the socks box.
I do not know where that box is. Do you remember?
Yes, it is in the closet.
Great. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is the internet?
It is a big web that connects computers all around the world. Do you like playing games on it?
Yes, I play with my friends.
That sounds fun and safe if you talk to your parents. Why do you like playing with them?
Because we talk to each other.
Talking is a good way to share ideas. Do you use pictures too?
Sometimes I send a picture of my dog.
That is a sweet idea. Do you always wait for your parent to help you?
Yes, my mom sits with me.
That is very smart to be safe. Good job listening.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do I share my toys?
You can pick one toy and give it to your friend. Do they like cars?
Yes, they love blue cars.
Give them the blue car for a turn. Is that fair?
Yes, I can do that.
Great job! Do you want to play together now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late, I need to pack fast.
Do not worry, you can do it. What do you need first?
Just tell me the best way to move boxes.
I do not know the best way. Do you have a truck?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My cat looks very sad today.
That is a kind thing to notice. Is her bowl full of food?
Yes, but she will not eat it.
She may need water or a soft spot to nap. Does she want to play?
No, she just sits by the door.
She might be waiting for you to sit with her. Try sitting near her.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Where is the red dot on this map?
It marks a small park. Do you like trees?
Yes, I do. Is there water near it?
There is a small pond nearby.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to eat.
That can be hard. Do you like hot food?
Yes, I do like hot food.
A soup is warm and nice. Would you like that?
Maybe, but I am hungry now.
Let's pick something simple. Do you want bread?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go now. Is the sun a rock?
No, it is a huge ball of fire. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, but I must run. Will it ever go out?
Not for a long time. Be careful on your way.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just landed from a very long flight. I am so happy to be back on solid ground.
That must have felt like a big adventure. Did you sleep much on the plane?
I did sleep for a few hours, but mostly I watched movies and looked out the window.
How nice to rest and see the world from above. Was the view from your seat good?
It was amazing. I saw clouds that looked like white mountains.
I have never flown, so I cannot truly know, but that sounds peaceful.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is that a cookie in the jar?
Yes, it is a sweet cookie. Do you like sweets?
I want to buy one. How much is it?
It costs one dollar. Do you have your coins?
Yes, here is your money.
Thank you very much.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do they sell fresh fruit here?
Yes, they do. Is there a favorite fruit you like?
I like apples, but I do not know which ones are sweet.
You can ask the seller. Do you know how to tell?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel shaky on the bike. Should I stop?
Stopping is fine. Do you like the view out there?
It looks nice, but I am scared to fall.
That is a good feeling to check. Are your brakes working well?
I think so, but I do not know how to use them.
I do not know your exact bike type. Do you have a manual nearby?
No, I only have the bike in my hands.
Then just roll slowly and look ahead.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at my cat. He is so cute.
Wow, he has soft fur. What color is he?
He is gray with white spots. He loves to sleep.
That sounds very cozy. Does he like to play?
Yes, he chases a red ball. He is very fast.
How lucky he is to have you.
I love him very much. He is my best friend.
That is sweet. Keep him safe and warm.
I will take good care of him. Thank you.
You are welcome. He is lucky too.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the post office today.
That sounds like a big place. Did you see a lot of mail?
Yes, there were many boxes and letters.
I bet they were busy helping people.
I stood in a long line for a long time.
That must have taken a lot of time. Did you get a sticker while you waited?
No, I did not get a sticker.
Oh no. Did you have a snack while you waited?
I just held my package tight.
Good for you. I hope the package arrived safely.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a red apple but I do not know what to do with it.
You can wash it and eat it. Do you like eating fruit?
Yes, I do, but I am not sure if I should cut it.
Cutting it can help you eat it easier. Do you have a safe knife?
I have a small knife, but I am scared of cutting myself.
If you are unsure, just eat it whole. Stay safe!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like my gift. It is blue.
I am sorry to hear that. What did you want instead?
I wanted a red bike, but I have this hat.
A hat is warm, but a bike is fun. Do you like the color blue at all?
No, I hate blue. I feel very sad.
I know that is hard. Let us find a way to make you happy again.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. Do you know why?
That is not good. Did you sleep well last night?
No, I could not sleep. What should I do now?
Try to rest in a dark room. Drink some water too.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I looked up and could not see the moon.
That can be hard. Are you looking outside?
Yes, but it is just dark out.
It might be behind a cloud. Do you like clouds?
I do not think it is there at all.
Maybe the moon is just sleeping. What do you see in the sky?
Just stars.
Stars are bright friends of the moon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work. Is the bus here?
It is not here yet. Is it far away?
I do not have time to wait.
It is very close. Please stay calm.
It just passed. I missed it.
That is sad. Do you have a phone?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend. I do not know how to start.
That is a good goal. Do you know what you want to say first?
I just want to tell him I miss him. It feels too short.
You can add a story from your day. This makes it fun to read.
What if I make a spelling mistake? I worry a lot.
Do not worry about small errors. He cares about your heart, not perfect words.
How do I end the letter? I get stuck at the bottom.
Use a warm word like "love" or "cheers". Do you have a favorite sign-off?
Okay, I will try now. Thank you for helping me.
You will do well. Go write with a happy heart.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. What day is it today?
It is Tuesday. Are you having a big meeting soon?
Yes, I must run. How many days are left in the week?
There are three days left. Do you like weekends?
Yes, but I must go now. Which day comes after Friday?
Saturday comes next. Have a good trip.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do horses have long tails?
They use their tails to swat flies away. Do you like watching them dance?
I love how they kick their legs! Why do they do that?
A kick is a big warning to back off. Do you think they are angry?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to go on a picnic, but I do not know what to bring.
That sounds fun. What kind of food do you like best?
I like apples and bread.
Great picks. Do you have a blanket to sit on?
No, I do not have a blanket.
You can use a big towel. Will it be sunny outside?
I hope so.
That is good. Have a nice time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I dropped this cup. Oh no.
Is the cup broken? Did it hurt?
No, I just spilled the milk. I am late!
That is okay. Do you have a towel?
Yes, here. Thank you.
You are welcome. Is your shirt dry now?
Yes, it is. I must go.
Good luck. Is this your first time?
No, but I was in a hurry.
I understand. Be safe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today. I want a big pizza for me and my friends.
That sounds like a lot of fun. How many friends are coming?
There are four of us. We want cheese and pepperoni.
Great choice. Would you like a drink with that?
Yes, please. Four big cups of orange juice.
I will bring that right away. You will be full and happy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I kick the ball hard?
Put your strong foot on the ground and swing your other foot. Do you like playing on grass?
I am not sure.
It is a great place to learn. Be gentle with the ball at first.
What if I miss?
Just try again next time. Do you have a favorite team?
I like the blue team.
That is good to have a team you love. Keep practicing every day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do we say please?
It shows we care about others. Do you like when people are kind to you?
Yes, I do.
That is the main reason.
Why do we shake hands?
It is a friendly sign. Do you know other ways to greet people?
Maybe a wave?
A wave is good too. It is a nice, open hello.
Why do we hold the door?
It helps people who need it. Do you try to help others at home?
I set the table.
That is a very helpful job.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great goal. Do you have two long laces to practice with?
Yes, I have them right here.
First, make a big knot at the bottom. Did that feel easy for you?
Yes, the knot was not hard.
Now, make two loops with your hands. These look like bunny ears.
I made the loops, but they feel slippery.
Wrap one loop around the other one. Then pull tight. How does that feel?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Can you help me find my red ball?
I do not see it. Did you look in your bag?
I checked my bag. It is not there.
That is strange. Did you play in the yard?
Yes, I did. Please hurry.
Look under the big tree. Did you drop it there?
Oh, yes. Here it is.
Great job. Safe travels to you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because no one remembered my birthday.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk about it?
Yes, I feel very alone today.
I am here with you now. Would you like to play a game?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I love reading in bed at night. Do you do that too?
Yes, I enjoy it. What book are you reading now?
It is about a dragon. Do dragons have real eyes?
I am not sure about real eyes. Do you think they like to read?
I think they like stories. Do you read by a lamp?
I use a soft light. Do you keep your lamp near your head?
Yes, I do. Do you read the whole book at once?
I read a few pages. Do you feel sleepy before the end?
Yes, I do. Do you wake up tired?
I feel fresh. Do you keep the book on your chest?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have twelve months?
Each month is a step on our yearly trip. Do you like watching the seasons change?
Why is May before June?
They are just labels we agreed on long ago. I do not know why that specific order was picked.
Why does July feel so long?
Hot days can feel slow and tiring. Do you play outside in the heat?
Why is December so short?
Festivals make time fly by fast. It does not actually get shorter.
Why do we need names for them?
Names help us keep track of when things happen. Do you remember which month it is now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to walk in the park, but I do not know where to go.
The big lawn is good for walking. Do you like to sit and look at the trees?
Yes, I like the trees. Is the path safe for my feet?
The path is flat and easy to walk on. Can you walk for a long time today?
I can walk for one hour. What should I bring with me?
Bring some water and a small bag for trash. Do you have a book to read on a bench?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sad. I do not know what to do for my birthday.
That feels hard. Do you like games or quiet time?
I am tired of thinking. I just want the day to be nice.
I understand that. Do you have any friends coming?
Yes, two friends are coming. But I do not know what to tell them.
That is good news. Have you thought about a simple snack?
Maybe cookies? I do not know how to bake.
I do not know your baking skills. Do you have a favorite treat?
Yes, I like fruit. I think I will make a fruit plate.
That sounds fresh and easy. It is a lovely plan.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a rainbow today. Do you know why it happens?
It happens when sunlight shines through rain. Did you feel happy seeing it?
Yes, it was very pretty. Is it a real object I can touch?
