No, it is just light and water. Do you think it has a smell?
I have no idea. Can I see it on a sunny day without rain?
Not really, you need both sun and rain.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today. The sand was warm and the water was blue.
That sounds like a fun place to play. Did you see any seagulls?
Yes, I saw many birds. One landed on my hat for a second.
That bird must be very bold. Did you have a snack with you?
I ate a cold sandwich under a tree. It was the best taste ever.
I am glad you enjoyed your food. The sun must have been bright.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red circle today. It was my lunch plate.
That is a nice shape. What was on the plate?
I had a square cookie. It was hard and sweet.
A square cookie sounds fun. Did you eat it all?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the tennis ball yellow?
It helps you see it well on the green court. Do you like playing tennis?
Yes, I do. Why do we hit the ball with a flat side?
The flat side gives the ball a strong push. Have you ever tried a drop shot?
What is a drop shot?
It is a soft hit that lands close to the net. Do you like hitting the ball softly?
I think so. Why do players run so fast?
They run to catch the ball before it bounces twice. Do you like running?
I do not run very fast. Why is the net in the middle?
The net keeps the game fair for both sides. Do you enjoy watching matches?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw a big bear today and I was very scared.
Bears are big but they usually just want to be left alone. Did you see it close up?
Yes, it was right by the path and looked angry.
It was probably just hungry or protecting its home.
I do not like feeling unsafe in nature.
That is a fair feeling to have. How did you feel when you walked away?
I felt small, but I am glad I am safe now.
Good for you, being safe is the most important thing.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am hungry but I do not know what to eat.
That is hard. Do you like warm food?
Yes, I like soup.
Soup is a good pick. Is there a kitchen nearby?
Yes, I can walk to it.
Great. You can make the soup there.
Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Enjoy your lunch.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I found a ladybug.
That is a lovely thing to see. What color is it?
It is red with black dots.
I know ladybugs, but I do not know why you are so happy. Do you like bugs?
Yes, I think they are cool friends.
I agree that they are interesting. Do you let it fly away?
Yes, I opened my hand and it flew.
That was a nice thing to do. Where did it go?
It went to a green leaf.
It is happy there too. I am glad you shared it with me.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am looking at this map, but I cannot find the red line.
The red line is usually the main road. Do you see a river nearby?
Yes, I see a big blue river right next to it.
Great, follow the road until you cross the river. Is the road wide or narrow?
It looks very wide, like a highway.
You are right, it is the main highway. You are safe to travel that way.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sea salty?
I think it comes from rain wearing away rocks. Do you like swimming in it?
Yes, but why does it move?
The wind pushes on the water. Do you feel the waves?
Why does the water taste bad if it is fresh rain?
I am not sure why it tastes that way.
Why is it so blue?
It looks blue because it reflects the sky.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost here.
We can sort it out. What do you see first?
The boat is in deep water.
That is a good sign. Do you have a map?
I have no map at all.
We will need to find one soon.
I do not know where to look.
Check the ship for papers. Are you afraid?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees in autumn?
The tree gets cold and sleeps for the winter. It drops its leaves to save energy. Do you like watching them spin?
Yes, they make a nice crunch under my feet. Is the tree sad when they go away?
The tree is not sad; it is just getting ready for spring. It will grow new, green leaves soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is very hot today.
That sounds fun! Do you have cold drinks?
Yes, I have lemonade.
Yum. Are you in the pool?
Yes, the water is cool.
That sounds nice. Have a good time!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have very little money. What can I do to save more?
Try to buy only what you truly need. Do you track what you spend each day?
I eat out a lot for lunch. That costs too much.
Packing lunch at home is a great way to save. Have you tried making it the night before?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a small horse in my yard. What should I do?
Is the horse hurt?
No, it seems fine but very shy.
Offer it some water or hay. Does it have a tag on its ear?
I do not see any tags on it.
That is odd. Is it a pony or a big horse?
It is quite small, like a pony.
A small pony without tags is rare. Is it eating the hay you gave it?
It is eating it right now.
Good, it seems safe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to be at the beach today.
That sounds wonderful. What do you see first?
I see big, white waves crashing on the sand.
That must sound loud. Is it cold or warm?
It is warm and the sun is bright.
That is nice. Do you want to swim?
Yes, I want to splash in the water.
That sounds fun. Have a great time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to read this book right now, but it is late.
Do you have a small lamp for your eyes?
Yes, but I am very sleepy and need to sleep soon.
That is good for your body. What page are you on?
I am on the last page and must go to bed.
Good night. Sleep well and dream big.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My computer screen is all dark and will not turn on.
Does the power light stay off? Try plugging it in tight.
Yes, the light stays off and the plug feels loose.
Tighten the plug and press the button once. Do you have a mouse?
The screen still stays black and I do not have a mouse.
That sounds like a hard fix. I do not know why it breaks.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My throat hurts and I feel very hot. Do I have a cold?
That sounds like a cold. Does your head hurt too?
Yes, my head hurts and I want to go to bed. Can I have juice?
Yes, you can have juice and rest.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do pictures move on the web?
I do not know for sure. Do you like watching videos?
Yes, I do. Why does it not feel like touching?
It is just light on a screen. Do you like to draw?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on my math homework. The numbers are hard.
That can feel tough. What kind of problem is it?
It is long division. I forgot how to split the numbers.
Start by asking how many times the small number fits in the first part.
I tried that, but I got a big leftover number.
A leftover is called a remainder. Is the remainder smaller than the divisor?
Yes, it is smaller. So is my answer right?
If the remainder is smaller, you are on the right track.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because my new magnet sticks to the fridge door!
That is a fun fact. Do you have other colors?
Yes, it is red and blue, and I love how it pulls metal things.
I did not know that colors could be magnets. Do you have any other cool toys?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I love bananas. Do they grow on trees?
Yes, they do. Do you like them sweet or sour?
I like them sweet. Are they good for you?
Yes, they have good vitamins. Do you eat them every day?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: What is that box for?
It is a gift for you. Do you like surprises?
Yes, but why do you have it?
I bought it because I care about you.
What is inside?
I do not know. Did you guess?
Is it a toy?
No, it is not a toy. Is it sweet?
Then what is it?
It is a book for you. Happy day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Light mixes colors. Do you see the sun?
Why does it feel dark at night?
The Earth blocks the sun. Is it cold outside?
Why can I not see stars during the day?
The sun is very bright. Can you look up?
Why do stars twinkle?
I am not sure exactly.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My dough is sticking to my hands. What do I do?
Try putting a little more flour on your hands. Is the room warm?
It is quite warm. Should I wait?
Yes, wait for it to rise. Do you have a timer?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my pencil during recess today.
That is very annoying. Did you look under your desk?
No, but my friend found it in the grass.
How lucky you are to have a good friend.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am scared of the big thunder outside.
It is loud, but it is just clouds hitting each other. Do you like rain?
Yes, I do. How do I keep the wind from breaking my toy?
You can put your toy inside on a shelf. Is the shelf high?
It is on a low table. Should I move it?
Yes, move it to a safe spot away from windows. Do you have a heavy book?
I have a big blue book. Can I put it on the toy?
Yes, that will help hold the toy down. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what to bring to the party.
That is hard. What is the main dish?
I think it is pizza.
You could make salad. Do you like green leaves?
Yes, I do.
Then bring salad. It is a good choice.
Is that all I need?
I do not know for sure. Bring it and see.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do robots have feelings?
No, robots do not feel joy or sadness. They only follow rules. Do you like robots?
I have a toy robot. Does it need sleep?
No, your toy robot does not sleep. It just needs batteries. Do you give it a battery?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn French fast. The trip is in one hour.
That is too quick to learn a whole new language. Do you know any French words?
I know "hello" and "thank you." Is that enough?
Those are great starts. Do you need help with food words?
I am only in the lobby. I have no time.
I cannot teach you everything in one minute. Would you like one easy phrase?
Yes, but please make it very short.
Say "Où sont les toilettes?" for the bathroom. Good luck with your trip.
I will try it. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. I hope you find the bathroom quickly.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to save cash but I have no time.
Try cutting out small treats. Do you like sweets?
I always buy a candy bar.
Swap it for water. Where do you buy it?
At the shop near work.
That is a small cut. Does it help your head?
It feels easier now.
Great start. Keep going.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the bus stop?
It is by the big red tree. Do you have your ticket?
Yes. Is the train far from there?
No. It is right next to the bus stop.
Thank you. I must run now.
Good luck. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do horses have such long tails?
They use them to swat away bugs. Do you like horses?
Yes, I do. Why are their coats so shiny?
A good coat shows good health.
I see. Why do they stand on four legs?
Four legs help them run fast and strong.
That makes sense. Why do they eat grass?
Their bodies are built to eat plants.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared to touch the big wheel.
It is okay to be scared. Do you like to go on the slide?
Yes, I love the slide!
Driving feels like a slide, but you control it. Are you happy now?
I think I can do it.
You have a good plan. Do you know where the gas is?
Is that the one that makes it go fast?
Yes, that is the gas. Are you ready to try?
I am ready!
Good for you. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like to draw pictures of cats.
That is a nice hobby. Do you use pencils or crayons?
I use colored pencils.
Colored pencils are good for details. How do you hold them?
I hold them like a pen.
That is the right way. Do you draw other animals too?
Yes, I also draw dogs and birds.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a special cat you draw?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The lights went out and I am mad.
That is not fun. Is your phone full?
Yes, but the cold air is bad.
I am sorry you are cold. Is it very dark in there?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I swim in the big ocean?
You kick your legs and move your arms like a bird. Do you like watching birds fly?
Yes, I do. How do I stay up?
You blow air into your lungs to float. Have you tried floating in a pool?
Not yet. Is the ocean deep?
Yes, it is very deep and dark at the bottom. Do you like being in the dark?
No, I do not. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I hope you have fun at the beach.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost again. The game is too hard.
That feels bad. What piece got you?
My king. I did not see the trap.
Tricky moves are tricky. Do you play often?
Yes, but I keep making the same mistakes.
Repeating is part of learning.
Maybe I should just stop for a day.
Rest helps the mind. Will you play tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must tell you I will return the book by Friday.
I promise I will wait for you. Do you have time to eat?
No, I have to run now.
Okay, I understand. Is the library open late?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited for the bus all morning. The sun was hot and my feet hurt. I almost cried.
That sounds like a very long time to stand. Do you like when the bus finally comes?
Yes. The driver smiled at me. He said the bus was running behind schedule. I felt better then.
Smiles help us stay calm. Did you have a snack with you?
No. I was too busy watching the road. I did not bring a bag with me today.
Next time, bring a small treat to keep your energy up.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is your favorite fruit?
I think bananas are wonderful. They are soft and sweet. Do you like them too?
Yes, I love the yellow skin. Why do you choose bananas?
They give me strong energy. Do you eat them with breakfast?
Not usually. I mostly eat them as a snack. How do you like to eat yours?
I peel them and eat them whole. It is very simple. Do you add anything to yours?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is it raining outside?
Yes, it is raining hard right now. Do you like listening to the rain?
I think it sounds scary.
It can sound loud when it is wet. Do you want to put on your boots?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn how sailors read the wind.
They look at the clouds and feel the air. Do you like looking at clouds?
Yes, I like clouds, but the wind feels scary.
The wind is just moving air, so it is safe. Have you ever felt a breeze on a hot day?
Yes, it is nice when it is cool. How do they know where to go?
They use a map and a tool that points north. Do you like drawing maps?
I do, but I am bad at math for it.
Start with a simple map and a compass. Can you wait to try it?
I can wait, but what if I get lost?
You will never get lost if you keep checking your north. Do you have a compass?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I take a picture with my phone?
Open the camera app and tap the round button. Do you like taking pictures?
Yes, but how do I see the photos later?
Go to your photo gallery app to view them. Do you take many pictures?
I take a lot. How do I send one to a friend?
Tap the share icon in your gallery app to send it. Who is your best friend?
I want to make the photos clearer.
Tap the settings gear in the camera app to change quality. Do you know how to save it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my boss so nice to me?
He likes you well. Do you like it too?
Yes, I do. But why does he act that way?
It is hard to say. He just has a kind heart.
That sounds good. Is he always like that?
Yes, he is kind every day. Do you help him back?
I try my best. Why does he not act mean?
He knows how to be nice. It makes him happy.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My socks are very dirty. How do I clean them?
Put them in hot water with soap. Do you have an iron?
I do not know what that is. What is an iron?
It is a tool that makes clothes smooth. Do you have a machine?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do fish come to the surface?
They often come up to get more air. Do you like to watch them swim?
Why is the water cold?
The sun does not heat the deep water. Do you feel cold in the water?
Why do we need to take the fish back out?
I am not sure about that part.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I broke my cup. Why did it happen?
It slipped from your hand. Did you see it fall?
Yes, I saw it. Why was it slippery?
Soap made it hard to hold. Do you wash it now?
I am sorry I broke it. Why are you not angry?
Accidents happen to everyone. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My village has no doctors. What should I do?
That is very hard. Is there a road to the next big town?
Yes, but it is far. It takes all day.
I am sorry I do not know the exact bus times. Please look for a phone to call for help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my old friend Tim today.
That sounds lovely. How is he doing now?
He was walking with a new cane.
I am sorry to hear he has a hurt. Does he have a pet?
No, but he has a big blue dog.
A blue dog is very strange. Is it real or just a toy?
It is a real dog with blue eyes.
That is a sweet story. I hope you have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: It is so hot outside today.
I know. Do you want to make ice cream?
Yes, please. How do I start?
Mix milk, sugar, and vanilla. What flavor do you like?
I love chocolate. What is the next step?
Add cocoa powder and chill it. Do you have a freezer?
Yes, I do. Do I just put it in?
Freeze it for two hours. Then stir it well.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have two kings. What should I do?
That sounds strong. Do you see any high cards in front?
I am not sure. My hands feel cold.
Take a slow breath. Is the next player acting scared?
Maybe. I feel like I might lose.
You can only win by trying. Do you want to bet big or small?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
The sun makes white light. Blue light bounces off the air more than other colors. Do you see blue birds?
I am confused by the bouncing part.
Imagine throwing a ball at a wall. The ball bounces back to you. Do you like playing catch?
Yes, I love catching balls.
The air works just like that wall for blue light. It pushes the blue back to your eyes. Are you happy now?
I think I understand it now.
Good job learning something new. I am glad I could help.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need a frame for the shed?
It holds the walls up so they do not fall. Do you like it when things stay up?
Why is the roof made of slanted boards?
Rain slides off the top if it is slanted. Have you ever seen water run down a slide?
Why do we use nails and not just glue?
Nails hold heavy wood very tight. Glue is weak for big things. Do you have strong hands?
Why is the floor concrete and not dirt?
Dirt gets soft and messy when it rains. Concrete stays hard and dry. Do you like playing on dirt?
Why do we paint the wood last?
Paint keeps bugs from eating the wood. It also looks nice. Do you pick the color?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is it sunny outside?
Yes, the sun is shining bright. What are you wearing?
My red jacket.
That is a warm choice. Do you see any birds?
A little blue bird.
How lovely to see nature. Is it windy?
Just a little bit.
A gentle breeze feels nice. Will you play in the park?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you know the words to that loud song?
I do not know it. Do you like loud music?
Yes. I need to go now.
Safe travels. I hope you have fun.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I failed the test and want to quit.
It feels bad to fail. What part was hardest?
The math part was too hard for me.
You can learn it slowly. Do you have a book to use?
Yes, but I feel like I will fail again.
Mistakes help you grow. Ready to try one small step?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a great plan!
That sounds fun. What will you do first?
We will build a big fort in the yard.
I love forts. Will you play inside or outside?
We will play inside with our toys.
That is a good idea. Do you need help?
I want to share my plan with you.
I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I see a new friend playing outside. Why does he smile so much?
He is happy because he feels safe. Do you have a favorite toy that makes you smile?
Yes, my bear does. Why does my friend stay close to him?
It helps him feel less shy. What is your friend's favorite color?
I think it is blue. Why do people like blue?
I do not know for sure, but many find it calm.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to swim in the sea.
That is a fun goal. Do you like cold water?
I do, but I am scared of big waves.
Start in the shallow water near the sand.
How do I keep my face dry?
Blow bubbles with your nose. Do you have goggles?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My tent is wet and my socks are soggy.
That is a very damp night. Do you have a dry jacket?
No, I forgot it at home.
That is a hard thing to fix. Did you bring a tarp?
Yes, but it is too small for the rain.
You can use it to cover your shoes. Do you feel cold?
A little, and I am hungry too.
Let us eat some warm soup. Do you have a lighter?
I think so, it is in my bag.
Good, let us find some wood. Is the fire safe?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big drop of water fall from a leaf today. It looked like the plant was crying.
That is not crying. It is a way to cool down. Did you see any other drops?
No, just that one. But I read that plants use tiny tubes to pull water up from the roots. Is that true?
Yes, they do pull water up. It helps them stay strong. Do you have a plant at home?
I have a little bean plant on my desk. It grows very fast. How does the water get to the top leaf?
Tiny roots drink the water. Then it travels up to the leaves. Is your bean plant green?
It is very green and happy. Thank you for explaining the drinking part. I feel like I understand it now.
I am glad that helped. You are a good observer.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very scared of my big test tomorrow.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you want to read one last page with me?
Yes, please. Can we go really fast?
No, we must go slow so the words make sense. Do you understand the first sentence?
I think so. It says the dog ran away.
That is right. Did the dog run to the park or to the house?
It ran to the park with a ball.
Good job looking closely. Do you feel a little better now?
Yes, I think I can do this.
I am very proud of you for trying your best.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took the train to the park today. The sun was very bright.
That sounds nice. Did you see any flowers?
I saw many red and white flowers. The air smelled fresh.
How lovely. Do you like sitting by the window?
I do love the view from the window. It was a good day.
I am glad you had a good day. I hope you go again soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired. I cleaned the floor, but I forgot to eat lunch.
That sounds like a hard day. Do you have a snack ready?
No, I do not. I just want to lie in my bed and close my eyes.
Rest is good for you. Have a sweet sleep.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a cake right now. Where is it?
It is on the back shelf. Are you in a rush?
Yes, I am very late. How do I get there?
Walk to the end of the room. I hope you make it on time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I got my first job at the lemonade stand today.
That is very exciting. How did the taste test go?
It was sweet and cold. I sold ten cups.
Wow, you are a good helper. Do you like the money?
Yes, I have some coins in my pocket. I bought a cookie.
A tasty reward. Where did you find the lemons?
I picked them from my aunt's tree.
Fresh lemons make the best drink.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at this broken nail.
That does not feel good. How big is the nail?
It is small and sharp.
Small and sharp is tricky.
I cut my hand a little.
Oh no, please take a break. Did you wash it?
Yes, I washed it with soap.
That is a smart move.
I want to finish the roof today.
That is a big goal.
I am just so tired.
Rest is part of the work too.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I love to draw big dragons with my crayons.
That sounds like so much fun. Do you like drawing animals too?
Yes, I draw cats and dogs. Sometimes I draw a blue horse.
A blue horse would be very cool. What color do you use most?
I use red a lot. It is my favorite color.
Red is a warm and happy color. Nice choice.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do cookies get hard after you take them out of the oven?
They dry out because the heat leaves. Do you like crunchy ones or soft ones?
I like soft ones. Why does the dough smell so good when it bakes?
The heat wakes up the spices and sugar. It makes them smell sweet.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The snow is deep. I do not know what to do next.
That looks like fun. Do you have warm boots on?
I am stuck. Please tell me what I should do.
I do not know your plan. Try making a small snowball.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see lots of fruit, but I do not know what to pick.
The red apples look sweet and round. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I do, but the green ones look good too.
The green apples are crisp and cool. Try one and see what you think.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My boss gave me a big smile.
That sounds nice. Do you like her?
I do, but I feel lost.
Tell me what worries you.
I am not sure what to do.
Take a deep breath. What feels hard?
The work is too big for me.
We can break it into small parts.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now, I am late.
Take your time. Do you need help?
I failed again, I want to stop.
Failure is not the end. Did you try a new way?
I do not know, it feels hard.
I do not know the right path for you. Can you take one small step?
Maybe, just one step.
That is good enough. You can try again later.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to write a letter, but I do not know what to say.
That is okay. Do you want to thank someone?
I am not sure. I just want to tell my friend I miss him.
That is a very sweet thought. You can start by saying hello to him.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want a tree in my yard, but I do not know which one to pick.
That is a good plan. Do you like big trees or small ones?
I like small ones because I have a small yard.
An apple tree is great for a small space. I do not know if your soil is ready, so you should check it first.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and hit the ball over the net.
That sounds like fun. Did you win the game?
I lost, but I had a lot of smiles and sunshine.
Happy playing is the best part. What was your favorite moment?
My little brother cheered when I made a great hit.
Your brother must be very proud of you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I took a picture of the sun. I am so glad it is out.
That is a lovely thought. Do you like the sky in your photo?
Yes, the sky is very blue and bright. I want to show you my camera.
I would love to see it. What else is in the picture?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a bug in my house. It has a long body. What is it?
It might be a centipede. Do you like bugs?
No, I do not. How do I get it out?
You can use a cup and a piece of paper. Have you tried that before?
No, I did not. Will it hurt me?
It will not hurt you if you are careful.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: This leg is wobbly and I am late. How do I fix it fast?
Do you have a small screwdriver? Tighten the bolt on the bottom.
I do not see a bolt, just glue. What should I do?
I do not know your specific chair. Is the wood cracked?
It is cracked right here. Is there a quick trick?
Mix sand and glue in a bowl. Press it into the crack and hold it still.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My dog is sad today.
Does he still want to eat?
Yes, but he sleeps a lot.
Sleeping more can mean he feels sick. Have you taken him to a doctor?
I can check if his ears are dirty.
That is a good idea to look.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My friend is very shy. How do I make her feel good at my party?
That is a sweet goal. Does she like playing with toys?
Yes, she loves building blocks. What else should I do?
You can set up a corner just for blocks. Do you have enough blocks for two people?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to reach the sand before my boat leaves. Can you tell me which way to go?
Head past the tall palm trees to find the path. Are you going to swim today?
No, I only have time to look at the water. Is the walk long from there?
The walk is very short, just a few steps. Do you have your tickets ready?
Yes, I have them in my bag. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome, and have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! Look, my bread is getting big!
That looks tasty. What makes it grow?
The yeast does it! It eats sugar and makes gas.
Oh, I see. Does the heat help it?
Yes, the warm kitchen wakes it up.
Warmth helps. Do you like sweet bread?
I love the smell of fresh bread!
It smells good. I wish I could smell it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky so dark?
The clouds are very thick. Do you feel the wind?
Yes, it is loud. Why is the rain so hard?
The water is falling fast from up high.
Will the storm stop soon?
I hope so, but I am not sure. Are you safe in your room?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need to pack all our things?
So they do not break. Do you have your big box ready?
Why must we buy a moving van?
Our car is too small for all the stuff. I do not know how much it will cost.
Why is moving day so busy?
We have to unpack and set up beds. Are you tired?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go camping, but I am lost. What should I pack?
Bring a tent, a bag, and some warm clothes. Do you like to cook outside?
Yes, I love making food over a fire. How do I keep the fire safe?
Build the fire in a circle of stones. Never leave it alone until it is dead.
That sounds good. What else should I know?
Check the weather before you go. Do you live near a lake?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate clouds. They block the sun and make me sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like the sun today?
Yes, I do. But the sky is full of gray puffs now.
Clouds are just water high up in the air. Do you like looking at the shapes?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I have to see the doctor today?
It is because you do not feel well. Do you still have a cough?
But why can I not just drink water?
Water helps you, but the doctor can look for the true cause. Is your throat hurting a lot?
Okay, but why does it hurt so much?
I do not know for sure, but the doctor can tell us. Do you want to go now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My goldfish is sleeping on the floor of the tank.
Yes, he is likely resting. Is he moving his fins?
No, his fins are still, but he is breathing.
That is good. Breathing means he is alive. Do you feed him every day?
I feed him when I see him, but not always every day.
It is best to feed him once a day. Does he eat all of it?
He eats some of it and leaves the rest.
Uneaten food can make the water dirty. Should I take the leftovers out?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very excited for my train trip.
That sounds like fun! What are you packing for the ride?
I have my favorite stuffed bear and a juice box.
That is a smart choice. Do you know what kind of train you will take?
I do not know. My dad said it is a big one.
Big trains are very cool. Do you think it will be bumpy?
I hope it is smooth. I do not like being sick.
Smooth is best. Have you seen a train before?
Yes, I saw one outside my window last week.
That is lucky. I hope you have a great time!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My dog barked at the cat today.
That sounds exciting. Did the cat run away?
Yes, the cat hid under the sofa.
That is a safe place. Does your dog like napping?
He sleeps a lot after that.
Tired dogs need rest.
I gave him a big bone.
That sounds like a good snack.
He was very happy.
I am glad he is happy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the old bones sit in the dark room?
It helps them stay strong. Do you like the quiet?
Yes. Why are the shoes on the wall so big?
People used to need them for work. Do you wear boots?
I do. Why do the pictures look so wet?
I do not know why. Is it raining today?
No. Why do the dogs look happy?
They are statues made of stone. Do you have a dog?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my red pencil in class today.
Oh no. Where was your desk?
I think it fell behind the book shelf.
That is a tricky spot. Did you see it?
The teacher helped me find it.
That is very kind of her. Are you happy now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to walk for my body.
That is a great idea. Do you have shoes that fit well?
Yes, I have some new shoes.
That is very good. How many days do you plan to walk?
I think I will walk every day.
That is hard, but doable. Start with a few minutes a day.
What if I get tired?
If you get tired, stop and rest. Are you drinking water before you go?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. I forgot to say sorry.
That is not a big deal. Are you still in a rush?
Yes. I need to go right now.
I understand. I wish you a good day.
Wait. How do I say it back later?
You can just say, I am sorry I left. Do you have a plan for later?
Yes. I will text you tonight.
That sounds like a good plan. Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do I grow carrots?
Put seeds in the dirt and water them. Do you like carrots?
Yes, I do. How long do I wait?
It takes many weeks. Do you have a sunny spot?
I have a big pot on my porch.
That sounds like a great place.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling. I do not know what to do.
That must have felt bad. Did you dream of flying up or falling down?
I was falling and could not stop. I feel sad now.
Dreams are just your brain playing games. You are safe in your bed right now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to make for dinner.
That can be hard. Do you like meat?
Maybe. I have some chicken.
Chicken is good. Do you have any vegetables?
Yes, I have some carrots.
That is a nice mix. Do you want to roast them?
I do not know how to do that.
Just heat the oven and wait. I am not sure about your oven settings.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I went to the beach today.
That sounds like a great place. Did you see any fish?
Yes! I saw a big crab walking near the water.
A big crab is very cool. Was it scary?
No, it just looked at me and then ran away.
That is a fun story. I am glad you had a good time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in a big rush. How do I save money?
Buy less. Do you need that item?
I do not know. What should I do?
Wait one day. Do you want it still?
No, I do not. That is good.
Great. Write it down. Do you have a pen?
Yes, I have a pen.
Write the price. It helps you think.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to bake cookies today, but I am not sure what to do first.
That sounds fun. What ingredients do you have in your kitchen right now?
I have flour, sugar, and eggs.
Great start. Do you have any butter as well?
Yes, I have some cold butter.
Good. We will mix the butter and sugar next. Do you have a big bowl for that?
I have a big glass bowl.
Perfect. Let's get started.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to swim in the deep sea. Do you know the trick?
Yes, you must kick your legs and keep your face up to breathe. Do you like cold water?
That sounds hard. How do I stay afloat without sinking?
You float by pushing the water down gently and staying calm. Are you brave enough to try?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I cannot stop thinking at night.
That is tough. Do you drink coffee late?
Yes, I do. What should I try?
Try drinking tea instead. Does your room feel cool?
It is very hot here. I am stuck.
Open a window. I hope that helps you sleep.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the beach open?
Yes, it is open. Do you have a towel?
No. I have no time. Where is the gate?
Walk left and go down. Is your bag heavy?
Yes, it is heavy. I need to go now.
Run fast. Have fun in the sun.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I cook food using the sun?
You can use a black bag and foil. Do you have a box at home?
Yes, I have a shoe box.
Put the food in a bag inside the box. Place it in the sun and wait.
How long should I wait?
It depends on how hot it is. How dark is your bag?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Where is the bus stop?
It is just down that road. Do you have a map?
No, I forgot it. I am running out of time.
Walk straight for two blocks. Is the street busy?
It is quiet right now. Thank you, I have to go.
Hurry, but stay safe. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dough is flat. It will not get big.
Is it warm where it sits? Warmth wakes the tiny microbes in the bread.
I put it near the stove.
That is a good start. Do you see tiny bubbles on top?
Yes, I see small dots.
That means they are alive. Just wait and stay dry.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do sailors use flags on their boats?
They use them to talk when they are far away. Do you like sending messages?
Sometimes. How do the flags work?
Each flag is a letter. You put them in order to spell a word. Is that cool?
Yes, it is. What if it is very windy?
The wind helps the flags move so people can see them. Do you like windy days?
Not when I am outside. What do they do then?
They wait for the wind to stop. They also use horns. Do you have a horn?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I take a picture?
Tap the round button at the bottom of the screen. Are you taking a photo of a pet?
No, I am trying to take a photo of food.
Press that button again and it will save the photo.
Okay, I see the picture now.
That looks like a great start.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I forgot my math book again.
That feels bad. Did you check your backpack?
I looked everywhere. It is gone.
I am sorry. Do you have a spare pencil?
Yes, but I need the book.
I do not know where it is. Can you ask your mom?
She is not home.
We can call her. Shall we?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running out of time.
Take your time. Do you have your shoes?
I left them on the bed.
Go get them now. What else do you need?
I think I need my keys.
Check your pocket. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I have my phone.
Good. You are ready to go.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make my photos look clear?
Try to hold the camera very still. Do you have a steady hand?
I think so, but sometimes it shakes.
You can use a tripod to help hold it. Do you know what a tripod is?
Is it the stand with three legs?
Yes, that is exactly it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix my phone right now.
Is it not turning on?
Yes, the screen is black.
Try holding the power key for ten seconds.
That did not work.
Did you try charging it?
I am sorry, I am leaving now.
Okay, see you soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see big drops on the glass. Why does it fall?
The water goes up, gets cold, and comes back down. Do you like the sound of it?
It sounds like tapping. Is it warm or cold outside?
It is usually cool. Let me check. You can tell by touching the window.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My horse kicked me today.
Oh no, that must hurt. Does it still have a sore spot?
Yes, and he looks so angry.
He might be scared or in pain. Do you want to check his hooves?
I do not know what to do.
We can take him to the vet. Do you feel better about that?
I think I need to keep him safe.
That is a kind choice. Is your hand okay now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very alone today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have friends nearby?
Why does my chest feel so empty?
Your brain makes you miss people. Are you eating well?
What does my body do when I am sad?
It slows down and hurts a bit. Do you want to talk?
How can I fix this feeling?
Go outside for fresh air. Would you like some tips?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to save my coins?
Saving helps you buy big things later. Do you want to buy a bike?
Is it hard to save money?
It is easy if you stop buying sweets. What is your favorite sweet?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very happy today.
That is great news. What made you smile?
I found a pretty stone.
A pretty stone is a good find.
I feel light and free.
Happiness is a warm thing. Do you like to share it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My throat feels very scratchy and hot.
That does not feel good. Are you drinking warm water?
Yes, but I still feel weak.
Rest is very important. Did you sleep well?
I am tired, but I want to play.
You must rest to get well. How is your nose feeling?
It is all clogged up.
I am sorry to hear that. Go back to bed now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do players kick the ball so hard?
They kick hard to move the ball fast. Do you like running fast?
Why is there a circle in the middle?
It keeps the teams apart at the start. Do you like to wait your turn?
Why does the game stop sometimes?
I do not know why it stops every time. Do you like to stop and play?
Why do people shout so loud?
They shout to cheer for their team. Do you like to shout?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my brother always eat so fast?
He probably likes to finish before it gets cold. Do you like eating quickly too?
Why is he so quiet today?
He might be feeling a little sad. Is he okay with his friends?
Why does he share his toys with me?
He cares about you and wants you to be happy. Do you share your toys back?
Why do we have to go to bed at the same time?
I do not know for sure, but rest helps everyone grow. Do you like going to bed with him?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sun so bright?
It burns a hot gas called fire. Do you like warm days?
Yes, I do. Why does it move across the sky?
The earth spins around. Do you see the moon?
I do see it. Is the moon also on fire?
No, the moon is a rock. It reflects light. Do you think it is cold?
I think it is cold. Why do we need the sun?
We need it for food and warmth. Do you like growing plants?
I do. Why does the sun stop in the night?
The earth turns away from it. Do you dream of the stars?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to start a new hobby, but I am lost.
That can feel big. Do you like to sit still or move around?
I like to sit still, I think.
Drawing is a quiet choice. Have you tried coloring before?
I tried it once, but it felt hard.
Everyone finds it hard at first. Want to try some simple shapes?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make my flowers grow tall.
Water them every day and put them in the sun. Do you have a pot for them?
Yes, I do.
Fill the pot with dark soil. Is your soil dry or wet?
It is dry.
Add water until the soil feels like a wet sponge. Good luck with your plants.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to start a new hobby, but I do not know what to pick.
That is a fun idea. What kind of things do you like to look at?
I love looking at trees and birds, but I am not sure how to help me.
You could try learning how to draw what you see. Have you ever held a pen?
Yes, I draw now, but it feels hard to make them look real.
Drawing takes time to get better. Do you have a quiet spot to sit?
Yes, my porch is quiet, and the wind is nice there.
That sounds perfect for practice. I hope you enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to clean my fish tank.
That is a good idea. Do you have a bucket?
I have a bowl, but is that okay?
A bowl works well for taking water out. Please do not use soap.
Why can I not use soap?
Soap hurts the fish. Is your water dirty today?
It looks a little cloudy.
Cloudy water means it needs cleaning. Do you have a little brush?
Yes, I have a green brush.
Great. Clean the glass slowly and gently. Do your fish look happy?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did the man fall off the stage?
It was a big storm in the story. Was it scary for you?
Yes, but why did the sun come out right after?
The storm showed that hope is always near. Do you like sunny scenes?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the old paintings look so dark and yellow?
The lights inside the glass keep the air out, so they last a long time. Do you like the bright colors too?
No, I prefer the shiny metal swords. Why are they so sharp if they are broken?
They are not really broken, just old and rusty from age.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The end of that movie made me feel very sad. I cried a lot because the puppy was lost.
I am sorry to hear that. Did the puppy find his family?
No, he was found by a bad man. It was a scary part that stayed in my mind.
That sounds frightening. Do you like scary movies?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am late for class. I want to learn to tie my shoes.
That is a good plan. Do you want to start with the bow?
Yes. How do I make the little knot?
Cross one lace over the other and pull tight. Does that feel secure?
It feels good. Now I need to make the loops.
Cross them again to make a loop. Did you see the shape?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know how to draw a round ball.
Try making a circle like a coin. Do you have a small round object to trace?
Yes, I have a button, but the line is not smooth.
Hold the pencil high up to make it glide. Does that help you feel more steady?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had such a fun time at the beach this week!
That sounds wonderful! What did you play?
We built big sand castles and threw shells.
I love that idea! Did the waves wash them away?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did great on my test today.
That is wonderful news. Do you want to tell me your score?
I got one hundred!
Wow, you must be very proud.
I am so happy I cannot sit still.
That excitement is sweet. What was the hardest part?
The math section took me the longest.
Good job being patient.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see smoke coming from the kitchen window. What do I do?
Is everyone safe outside? Call 911 right now.
I am outside, but my dog is inside.
Do not go back in. Fire is very dangerous.
I feel very scared and lost.
Stay where you are. Help is coming soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a pizza, but I do not know how.
That is a great idea. Do you like cheese?
I love cheese, but I do not know how to start.
You must heat the oven first. Do you have a timer?
Yes, I have a timer. How do I put the cheese on the dough?
Spread it out evenly with your hands.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The city is so loud and fast.
That sounds stressful. Are you missing an important meeting?
Yes. I need to catch the bus right now.
Run to the main stop. Do you have your ticket ready?
No. The machine is broken and I have no change.
That is a problem. I do not know where the spare machine is.
Please tell me what to do. I do not have time to look.
Just tap your card on the pole. Is your card working?
Yes. It works. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a safe ride.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Did I pass my test today?
I do not know your grade. Did you feel good when you wrote it?
I think I got most of the answers right.
That is a good feeling. Was there any part that was very hard?
Yes, the last math question was tricky.
It is okay if that part was hard. Do you want to look at the work together?
No, I just wanted to know if I did well.
You tried your best, and that is what matters. Are you happy with your effort?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I saw my old friend at the park.
That is nice to hear. How is he doing?
He looks sad. Why is he so quiet?
I do not know the reason. Did he tell you anything?
No, he just smiled.
Sometimes a smile hides deep hurt. I hope he feels better soon.
I want to help him.
Your care is a good start. Do you plan to sit with him?
Yes, I will sit next to him.
That is a kind thing to do. It may help him feel less alone.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my pencil box, I am running late.
Look under your bed, do you see it there?
I do not see it, where else should I look?
Check your bag, maybe it is still inside?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the fish stay in the bowl?
They live there because we put them there. Do you like watching them swim?
Why does that little one keep moving so fast?
He is likely looking for food. Is he chasing a friend?
Why is the water clear?
We clean it often to keep it fresh. Do you see the clean plants?
Why do they blink so slowly?
Fish do not have eyelids like us. Do they look sleepy to you?
Why do they bump into each other?
I do not know the exact reason for that. Do they seem happy?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my friend’s toy and I feel sad.
That is a kind thing to feel. Do you know what happened exactly?
I tripped and it fell.
Accidents happen to everyone. Would you like to help fix it?
Yes, I can use glue.
That is a great plan. Tell me, are you ready to say sorry?
Yes, but I am scared.
Just be honest and mean it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn French fast. Go.
Pick one word a day. Is that enough time?
No, I need it all now.
I do not know magic. Do you have a book?
I have a phone.
Use the app. You must practice.
I am leaving.
Good luck on your trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The baby is crying and I do not know why.
Does the baby have a wet diaper?
No, it is dry, but my hands feel all shaky.
Take a deep breath. Is he hungry?
I tried to feed him, but he pushed the bottle away.
He may just need a hug to feel safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with my old friend.
That sounds hard. Are you worried about them?
Yes, I want to help but I feel lost.
It is good to care. Do you want to try talking first?
Maybe, but I am afraid they will say no.
That is scary. I do not know if they will say no.
Can you just sit with me for a bit?
I am here for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late this morning and missed breakfast.
That is not a start I would want. Did you eat anything at all?
No, I was too busy looking for my shoes.
Finding shoes can take a long time. Did you finally find them?
Yes, they were under the bed in a messy pile.
That is a common hiding spot. How did you feel when you found them?
I was very happy, and then I ate a big cake.
That sounds like a nice fix.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I broke the red cup. What should I do?
I am sorry it broke. Do you know why it fell?
I was running and I tripped.
That is very common. Is it safe on the floor now?
Yes, I put the pieces in a bag.
That is a good choice.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The gift did not work.
I am sorry to hear that. Did it break?
Yes, it broke. I wanted to give it to my mom.
That is very sweet of you.
I feel bad now. What should I do?
You can ask for a new one. Do you still like the idea?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how a knight moves.
A knight moves in an L shape. Do you have a board?
Yes, I do.
Put your finger on a square, then hop two steps up and one over.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I get a book from the shelf?
You pull it out gently. Do you like reading?
I do. Where do I put it back?
You find the right spot on the shelf. Is it a big book?
Yes, it is. How do I borrow it?
You take it to the desk with a card. Do you have a card?
No, I do not. How do I get one?
You ask the desk for a free one. Is that a story book?
Yes, it is. How do I return it?
You bring it back to the desk. Do you enjoy stories?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on my story. The dragon is very scary, but I do not know what it wants.
That is a big problem. Does the dragon just want a snack, or is it lonely?
I think it is lonely, but I do not know how to show that. It should not be too hard to write.
You could have it hum a sad song. Do you like music?
Yes, I do. But now I need to end the story, and I am blank. I am not sure what to do next.
A warm hug from the main character might fix it. Have you tried that before?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My cat stopped eating her food.
That is not good. Is she still drinking water?
Yes, she drinks a lot of water.
I do not know the reason for that. Does she look tired?
She sleeps all day in the sun.
Warm sun is nice. Is her belly moving fast when she breathes?
It moves very fast and hard.
That is a sign of pain. Please take her to a doctor today.
Okay, I will go now.
That is the right choice. Please be brave.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like to grow plants in my backyard.
That is a fun hobby. Do you like the colors of the leaves?
Yes, but I am not sure what to give them.
Give them water and some sun. Do you have a nice pot for them?
I have many pots, but they are too small.
You can find bigger ones at the shop. Do you like big trees or small flowers?
I like small flowers with bright colors.
Pick flowers that like the sun. Do you have room for more plants?
I have a small shelf by the door.
That is a good spot. Put one flower on it and see how it grows.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big sandwich for lunch. It has cheese and tomatoes.
That sounds very tasty. Do you like cheese?
Yes, I love it. I ate half of it already.
You must be hungry. Do you want some help?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a tall mountain today. It looked cold and white.
That sounds very big and quiet. Did you go up to the top?
No, I just watched it from far away. I felt small next to it.
It is nice to feel small sometimes. Do you like cold places?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I love that book about the little red car. Why is it my favorite?
It makes you feel safe and warm. Do you remember when the rain stopped?
Yes. The sun came out bright and gold. Why does that part make me smile?
Joy feels like a big hug. Is that your favorite moment too?
I think so. It feels very happy. Can you think of another reason I like it?
I am not sure why you love it that much. But I am glad it brings you joy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my grandma, but I do not know what to say.
That is a sweet idea. Who did you have for dinner today?
I had soup and bread. It was very good.
She will love hearing that. Do you want to tell her about your pet?
Yes, I think I will tell her that my cat is very soft.
That sounds cozy. Would you like to practice writing her name?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to save cash fast, but I am very late.
Try tracking every penny you spend. Do you write things down?
I have no time for that right now.
Set up a small, easy plan first. What is your main goal?
Please just tell me the easiest trick.
Cut one small cost, like skipping a snack. Do you buy snacks often?
Yes, but I must run to work now.
Start small today and keep it up. Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to eat better, but I do not know what to pick for lunch.
That is a good goal. Do you like vegetables?
I like carrots, but I think I am not a good cook.
You can just wash them and eat them raw. Do you have a glass of water with you?
I do not have one right now, but I will get some.
Water is good for you. Try a small carrot first.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Can you fix this jumbled line for me?
I can try. Do you know what the first word is?
I do not know. Please just guess for me.
I think it is "The". Is that right?
Yes, it is. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Go now!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people wear white?
White means new and clean. Do you like white?
Why do they kiss?
It shows they are happy to be together. Is that nice to you?
Why do they dance?
Dancing is fun and gets the blood moving. Do you know how to dance?
Why do they cry?
I do not know for sure. It might be from too much joy.
Why is it such a big deal?
It joins two families into one new team. Does that sound good?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go to the park for lunch today.
That sounds fun! Do you like to play tag while you eat?
Yes, I love tag. I packed some cookies.
Cookies are sweet. Did you put them in a bag?
I forgot the bag at home.
Oh no, that is a problem. Do you have a box?
I have a small box.
A box will work fine. Have a nice time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have these flowers, but I do not know what to do with them.
You can put them in a glass of water. Do they have a special smell?
I am still not sure.
I am not sure either. What do you think?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we use stamps to mail letters?
Stamps pay for the trip. Do you like sending mail?
Why does the post office close early?
Staff need to go home.
Why do they wrap the letters in paper?
Paper keeps the mail safe. What is in your letter?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a sandcastle?
First, wet the sand so it sticks. Do you like to dig?
Yes, I do. What should I do next?
Pack the sand into a round mold and turn it upside down.
Great! How do I make it tall?
Stack new layers on top of the old ones. Do you have a bucket?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make snowballs for the party.
That sounds fun. Do you have any gloves?
Yes, I have blue gloves.
Great. Grab a handful of cold, wet snow.
How do I make the ball?
Squeeze it tight, then let go.
Do I keep squeezing it?
No, hold the shape for two seconds.
Does it need to be perfect?
No, lumpy is fine.
Can I throw them?
Yes, aim at a target.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My bread will not get big.
That is frustrating. Is it warm in your kitchen?
It is cold in here.
Yeast likes heat to wake up. Do you have a bowl of warm water?
I have a bowl of hot water.
Hot water kills the yeast. Try again with warm water.
I do not know what warm is.
Think of how you touch a baby. It should not burn you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my bread get so big in the oven?
The heat makes tiny bubbles grow inside the dough. Does that sound like magic?
I guess it does. What makes those bubbles?
A tiny living thing eats the sugar and makes gas. Have you ever smelled yeast?
It smells a bit like beer. Is that the gas you mean?
Yes, that gas pushes the dough up. Do you like how soft it gets?
It is very soft and warm. Thank you for helping me understand.
You are welcome. I am happy to help you learn.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why does a square always look so boring?
Squares are just four equal sides. Do you like circles better?
Circles are round, but squares feel stuck in a corner.
That is a fair way to see it. What makes you feel stuck?
I tried to draw one, but it was crooked and looks wrong.
A crooked square is still a square. Did you try again?
No, I just want to throw my crayon away right now.
It is okay to feel mad. Take a deep breath with me.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go near the big river. Is it safe?
Yes, it is safe if you stay close to the bank. Do you have your boots on?
No, I only have my sandals. Should I wear them?
No, please put on your boots to keep your feet dry. What color are your boots?
They are blue. Is the water cold?
The water is often cold in the morning. Do you like cold feet?
No, I do not. Can I still see the fish?
Yes, you can look from the warm land. Do you like watching fish?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a snow globe.
That sounds fun. Do you have a clear jar?
Yes, I found one in the attic.
Great. Put a little fairy or figure inside first.
How do I put the water in?
Mix water with a drop of glue. Pour it in slowly.
Why do I need the glue?
It makes the snow fall slowly. Do you have glitter too?
Yes, a whole box of it.
Add a sprinkle, but not too much. Close the lid tight.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make bread, but my dough is sticky.
Your hands need a little more flour. Do you like using your hands?
Yes, I like touching the dough. But it is very soft.
It needs to rest for a bit. Do you know how to wait?
I do not know how to wait. I want it now.
Eating is hard, I know. Can you set the timer for five minutes?
Okay, the timer is set. Is it done yet?
Not yet, but it is close. Does it smell good to you?
It smells like home. I am happy now.
That is wonderful. You did a great job.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My train ride was so fun! The view was very pretty.
That sounds nice. Did you see any animals?
Yes, I saw a big cow in the grass. It was very calm.
How lovely. Did you wave at it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am confused about the cold season. Why is it so dark and cold?
The sun shines less on us in winter. Do you like the snow?
I like the snow, but I am not sure how to dress. What should I wear?
Wear a warm coat and a hat. Do you have thick socks?
Yes, I have socks. How do I know when spring is coming?
Look for green leaves and singing birds. Is your garden starting to grow?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is that a big dinosaur?
Yes, it is a very big dinosaur. Do you like dinosaurs?
No, I like fish.
The fish are in the next room. Do you want to see them?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I can't stop thinking. The bed is too hot. I hate this.
That sounds really hard. Do you have a cool pillow?
It helps a bit, but my mind is still racing with work.
Try to count sheep. Do you like counting?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very tired today.
That is not a good feeling. Are your eyes heavy?
Yes, my eyes feel like lead.
Sleep will fix that soon. Do you have a warm drink?
No, I just want my bed.
Good idea. Do you want help with your shoes?
Please, take them off for me.
You are all set. Good night.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn the chords for that happy song.
Do you already have a guitar? You can start with the easy E and A chords.
Yes, I have one. How do I switch between them?
That takes practice. Try moving your fingers slow and steady first.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What does a horse eat?
Horses eat hay and grass. Do you have a horse?
No, but I saw one at the park.
That is nice. Is it big?
Yes, it is very tall.
Tallest part is its neck. Do you like animals?
I like the soft hair.
Horses have soft coats. Do you want to pet it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spilled my morning coffee on the rug.
Oh no, that is a bad start. Did you get it all out?
I tried, but the rug is still wet.
That is very tricky to clean. Do you have a towel?
I used my best shirt to soak it up.
That sounds like a big sacrifice. Is the shirt ruined?
Yes, but I finished my tea in peace.
A good end to a messy day. I am glad you are okay.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My chair leg is wobbly. Why does it do that?
The wood might be loose. Is the screw tight?
I tried to turn it, but it won't go in. Why is it stuck?
The wood may be swollen. Do you have a mallet?
I have a hammer, not a mallet. Will that work?
A hammer can be too hard. Be very careful.
It broke a little. Why did it break?
I am not sure why. Do you have glue?
I do have some glue. Will it fix it?
It should hold the wood. Sit on it later.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to kick the ball really hard, but my legs get tired.
That is very normal. Do you practice every day?
Yes, but I still miss the goal.
Missing is how you learn. Do you look at the ball when you kick?
Usually I look at the crowd.
Try to keep your eyes on the ball. Do you feel the grass under your feet?
Yes, it feels soft.
Feeling the ground helps your balance. Keep trying, you will get better.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see so many cars on the street.
Yes, cars move fast in the city. Do you like watching them go by?
The buildings are very, very tall.
They reach up high to the sky. Have you ever gone inside a tall building?
I hear loud noises everywhere.
Sounds mix together in busy places. Do the loud sounds make you feel happy?
There are so many people walking.
People walk to different shops and jobs. Do you like seeing new faces?
I am tired from the noise and crowds.
Resting is good after a busy day. Do you want to go home now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My head hurts a lot today. Why does it hurt?
It often hurts when your body needs to rest or fix something. Are you feeling tired?
I drank a lot of water, but my head still aches. What else could cause this?
Sometimes pain comes from being sick or hurting your neck. Is your neck stiff?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck inside and the sky is gray.
That feels dull. Do you like the sound of drops?
Not really. I just want the sun.
The sun is hiding for now. Do you have a book?
I have two books, but I do not know which to read.
Pick the one with the bright cover. Does it look fun?
I think I will drink warm tea instead.
That sounds sweet and safe. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. The bus is coming.
The bus is two blocks away. Is your bag heavy?
Yes, it is full. I need to go fast.
Take a deep breath. You will make it. Do you know the stop?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in a rush. I need to build this shed before the rain.
We can use strong wood. Do you have the nails with you?
Yes, I have them. How do I join the corners?
You can glue and screw them tight. I do not know your tool size.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss the moon because it is gone.
The moon is just hiding behind the clouds. Do you like looking up at night?
Yes, but the sky is too dark.
It will come back out soon. Is the dark scary for you?
It feels like a big empty space.
That space feels big to me too. Do you have a warm blanket nearby?
Yes, I have a soft one.
Good. Put it on and wait for the light. Is that enough to help?
I think so, thank you.
You are welcome. Do you want to talk about anything else?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: What is the best thing to pack for a picnic?
Bring a soft blanket and some fruit. Do you like cold drinks?
Yes, I like juice. What should I bring to eat?
A sandwich with cheese is a good choice.
Is there anything else I need?
Bring a small towel for your hands.
Thank you, that helps a lot.
You are welcome. Have a nice time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared of the dark at night.
That feels scary. What part of the dark worries you most?
I think monsters might hide under my bed.
I do not know if monsters are there, but I know you are safe. Would you like to check with a light?
Yes, the light makes me feel better.
That is a good feeling to have.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad to see you. I found a stamp!
That is a nice find. Do you like blue ones?
Yes, I do. I will mail a letter to my friend.
That is a kind thing to do. Will you write about your day?
I think so. It was a good day.
I am happy for you. What was the best part?
I got ice cream after school.
Ice cream is always fun. I like it too.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate a big red apple today.
That sounds sweet. Did you share it with anyone?
Yes, I gave half to my little brother.
That is very kind of you.
He said it was the best fruit ever.
I am happy he liked it.
Now my teeth feel very clean.
Good for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my little sister today. She was eating a red apple and smiling.
That sounds nice. Does she like apples?
Yes, she does. She shared half of it with me.
She is a sweet sister. Did you save any for later?
I did. I saved the skin to give to our dog.
I am not sure if dogs can eat apple skins.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a strong magnet! It makes my heart feel warm.
That is lovely to hear. Did you pick up anything heavy with it?
Yes, it lifted a big paperclip! Do you like magnets too?
I find them very useful. Do they have different colors?
Some do, but mine is just grey and shiny.
Grey is a classic look. Thank you for sharing that joy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to say sorry to my friend.
You can say, "I am sorry I hurt your feelings." Did you mean what you did?
Yes, I was wrong to break his toy.
Tell him, "I will help fix it." Do you know how to fix it?
I do not know how to fix it.
You can ask him for help to fix it. Is he happy now?
Yes, he is smiling.
That is a good way to say sorry.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very bored while I wait. What can I do?
Try to look at the sky. Do you see any clouds?
I see them, but they are just sitting there. It feels like a long time.
Time moves slowly when we wait. What is your favorite color?
I like blue, but blue is slow. I want it to be over now.
Blue is a calm color. Do you like calm days?
Yes, but I am not calm. I am very hot and I do not know what to do.
I do not know why it is so hot. Are you drinking cold water?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a rope so it does not slip?
Make a loop, then wrap the end around it twice. Do you have a rope to try?
I do, but I always pull the wrong way.
Pull the two ends hard to make it tight. Is the rope dry or wet?
It is dry, but I am still stuck.
Tie a simple overhand knot first to practice. Can you show me your hands?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make the dough?
Mix flour, water, and yeast. Do you have a scale to weigh them?
Yes, I do.
Great. Now let it rest until it gets big. Is your kitchen warm?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad here. The shops are all closed.
That must be lonely. Do you miss the noise?
Yes, it is too quiet. I want to talk to someone.
I am here with you. What is your favorite thing about this place?
The trees are very pretty. But I still feel blue.
Nature helps us feel calm. Would you like to walk to the hill?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate an apple and some crackers for lunch today.
That sounds like a fresh and good choice. Did you drink any water with it?
Yes, I had a big glass of cold water.
Staying hydrated helps your body feel strong and calm.
I also felt quite full and happy after eating.
I am glad to hear that your body felt satisfied.
I learned that sweet snacks can make me tired later.
That is a very smart thing to notice about sugar.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very tired after running. My legs hurt.
Rest your legs and drink some water. Are you running for fun?
Yes, I like to race my dog.
That sounds like great fun. Do you want to learn how to breathe better?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Which month comes right after May?
June comes after May. Do you like warm weather?
I love the sun! How many days are in June?
June has thirty days. Do you count them?
I just want to know if it ends soon. Is it a short month?
Yes, it is short. It ends when July begins.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss Sam so much today.
That is a heavy feeling to carry. Do you talk to them often?
I tried to call, but the phone number is bad.
I am sorry the link is broken.
It feels like they just left me behind.
Your heart is hurting right now. Are you eating well?
I am not very hungry at all.
I know it is hard to eat when you are sad.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the water look so blue today?
The sun makes it look bright and clear. Do you like swimming in it?
I like watching the boats come in.
That is a fun thing to watch. Do you know which boat is whose?
I think that big one is the ferry.
Yes, that is the right guess. Do you want to go on a ride someday?
Maybe when I am older.
That sounds like a nice plan. Do you have a favorite boat?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a knot?
That is a great skill to learn. Do you have any rope?
Yes, I have a red string.
Cross the string over itself. Then pull it tight to close the loop.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do bees turn flowers into sweet honey?
They drink a sweet fluid from flowers called nectar. Do you like candy?
Yes, I love it. But I need to know how they make it into jars.
They store the nectar in their bellies and let it dry out. It turns into honey when the water is gone.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today. I saw a big blue dog.
A blue dog? That is very strange. Did it bark?
Yes, it barked very loud. Then I went home for a nap.
That sounds like a busy day. Did you like the nap?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. The trees outside are all green and fresh.
That is a lovely feeling. Do you see any new leaves?
Yes, I see bright green leaves everywhere. I feel light like a leaf in the wind.
Nature is full of life right now.
I just want to tell everyone about this joy.
That is a kind thing to do. How does the fresh air smell?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How does a big ship stay up on the water?
It pushes water down. The water pushes back up to hold it. Do you have a bag to save?
Yes, I have my bag. Why does the push up work?
Heavy things push more water away. Light things push less. Are your shoes wet?
No, my shoes are dry. Is that why it does not sink?
Yes, the push up equals the push down. It balances perfectly. Do you have time for one more thing?
No, I must go now.
Good luck on your way. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a magnet that sticks to the fridge! It is so cool.
That is great! Do you know why it sticks?
It only sticks to some things. My dad says it is because of metal.
He is right. Do you like the red ones the most?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know how to fix my broken bike.
That is a hard problem. Do you see where it broke?
Yes, the wheel is stuck and will not turn.
Try to spin it by hand and look for what stops it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need help moving my home.
I can help you think. What is the heaviest thing you have?
It is a big, tall sofa.
Moving that is hard. Do you have a friend to help you lift it?
Yes, my brother is coming.
That is good. Please be careful with your back.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must pack the books now.
Is that the blue box?
Yes. I have no time to talk.
Need a hand with the small toys?
No. I am running late.
Will you leave the cat in the car?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That is great to hear. What made you so happy?
I finished a hard drawing.
You must be very proud. Did you like the colors?
Yes, the blue is my favorite.
I am glad you felt good. How are you feeling now?
I feel warm and strong.
That is a nice feeling. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I put a book back on the shelf?
Put it in the right spot. Do you know which section it goes in?
No, I am not sure.
