The spine tells you where to put it. Is the back of the book facing you?
Yes, I can see the letters.
Great, follow the letters in order. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want the clock to show three o'clock, but I do not know which stick to move.
The short stick shows the hour and the long one shows the minutes. Do you want to practice with a toy clock first?
I moved the short stick to three, but the long one is still pointing up.
You need to move the long stick all the way around the circle back to the top. Did the hands feel smooth when you turned them?
Now both sticks are pointing up, so it is twelve again. I am so confused.
To get to three, keep turning the short stick past twelve, one, two, and stop at three. I do not know which way you turned it last time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel great! I did my best on the test.
That is wonderful! Did you study hard for it?
Yes, but I am late for the bus.
You should be very proud. Have a safe ride!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse today.
That sounds fun. Did you ride it?
No, it was standing in a green field.
A field is a nice place. Did you pet it?
I tried, but it ran away.
Horses like space. Did you feel sad?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a dirty shirt. What do I do?
Do you know if it likes hot or cold water? Put it in the machine first.
I do not know. Is that bad?
It is not bad. Check the tag on the shirt. Do you see a picture of a bucket?
Yes, I see a bucket with a hand in it.
That means wash it by hand. Do you have a basin?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water so blue?
The sun shines on it and makes it look bright. Do you like the color?
The boats look very big. Why do they need such big wheels?
They do not have wheels; they use the water to move. Do you think they are heavy?
The fog came in fast. Why does it hide the lights?
Fog is thick and stops the light from going far. Do you feel cold now?
I can hear a loud horn. Why does it make such a deep sound?
It warns other ships to stay out of the way. Can you smell the salt?
The sun is going down. Why does the water turn red?
I do not know the exact science, but the light reflects. Do you want to stay?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a pile of stones, but I do not know how many are in it.
You can count them one by one. Do you have a pencil to mark them?
I tried to count, but I keep getting a different number.
That is tricky. Start again and count very slow.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the pool. Do you know if it is open?
Yes, the doors open soon. Are you wearing your swim cap?
No, I left it on the counter. Can I buy one there?
I think they have a small store. Do you like blue or green?
I do not care. Just help me find the map.
The map is on the wall by the door. Is that the one you want?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go to the park, but I do not know what to bring.
That is a good idea. Do you like to play on the slides?
Yes, I love them, and I want a snack too.
You can bring an apple and a small water bottle.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a new tree grow from a tiny seed?
You plant the seed in the dirt and give it water. Do you have a small pot to use?
I only have a cup. Is that okay?
A cup works well if it has a hole in the bottom for water. Do you have a sunny spot in your room?
Yes, my window gets lots of light. Where should I put the seed?
Push the seed into the soil about an inch deep. Do you have a small shovel or a stick?
I have a spoon. Can I use that?
Yes, a spoon is perfect for this small job. Just press it down gently into the dirt.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to buy a swimsuit now, where can I go?
You can check the sports shop on Main Street. Do you have enough time to walk there?
No, I am late, is it close?
It is about five minutes away. I do not know if they are open right now.
Please tell me if they are open, I am running out of time.
I cannot check for you, but I hope they are. Do you have your goggles with you?
I forgot them, what should I do?
You can buy small ones at the pool shop later. Do you know how to swim well?
Yes, I am good, but I must go now.
That is great, have fun and stay safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need to talk to the boss, but I feel scared.
That is a common feeling. Do you know what you want to say?
Not really, I just want a better chair.
That is a good reason. Have you tried asking a friend for help?
No, I have not. What do I do first?
Start with a hello. Do you like your boss?
Yes, he is kind. But I am still nervous.
Nervous is okay. Have you written the words down?
Should I write them down?
Yes, writing helps you remember. Good luck with your talk.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took a photo of a dog in the park today.
That sounds fun. Was the dog cute?
Yes, it was very cute and it wagged its tail.
I am happy for you. Did it like being taken?
It looked at the camera and then ran away.
Oh, that is a fast dog.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My phone screen is all cracked and it hurts my eyes. I feel so bad.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a spare phone with you?
No, this is the only one I have. I think it is broken for good.
I do not know for sure, but a shop can help. Did you try to turn it off and on again?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw the full moon last night. It looked very big and bright.
It does look big when it is close to the ground. Do you like looking up at night?
Yes, I do. Can I touch it one day?
Not with your hands, but you can go to the moon. Do you like spaceships?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a banana. I am not sure what to do with it.
Do you like sweet tastes? You can peel it and eat it.
I still do not know how to start.
I do not know what is in your mind. Do you have a spoon?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My goldfish looks sad. Can you fix it? I am late.
Is the water warm and clean?
I do not know. Is the water bad?
Cold water makes them feel bad.
It is hot. I will cool it down now.
That is good.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like tea better than coffee.
That is nice. Do you like it hot or cold?
I like it hot. Why do people drink coffee?
It helps them feel awake. Is that why you drink tea?
Yes, I feel calm. Is tea from a plant?
Yes, it comes from leaves.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just landed and I feel very tired but also very happy.
That is a great feeling. Did you enjoy the food?
Yes, the noodles were very good and warm.
I am glad they were tasty. How was the view from the window?
I saw big white clouds that looked like cotton candy.
That sounds like a dream. Did you take any photos?
Yes, I took many pictures of my feet resting.
Funny you mention that. Did you sleep well?
I did not sleep much but my mind felt calm.
Calm is a good thing to have.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to buy apples. Where do I go?
The apples are on the left side. Do you like red or green ones?
I like the red ones. What do they cost?
They are two dollars a pound. Is that too much for you?
No, I have ten dollars. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a nice day at the market.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Today is my birthday and I am so glad.
Happy birthday to you. I am very happy for you. What is your favorite part of the day?
I love my cake and the presents.
That sounds like a lot of fun. I do not know what you got, though. Were the presents big or small?
They were all really big boxes.
Big boxes are exciting to open. Do you know what is inside yet?
I have not looked inside yet.
That is the best kind of surprise. Will you eat the cake soon?
Yes, we are eating it right now.
Yummy. I hope it tastes sweet. Thank you for telling me about your day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel bad, but I do not know what to do.
Tell me where it hurts. Do you have a fever?
My tummy hurts, and I feel warm. I am scared.
That sounds like a stomach ache. Have you eaten anything strange?
Just some old cookies. I need help.
Drink some water and rest. Let us see a doctor if it does not stop.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I saw bees buzzing around. How do they make that sweet honey?
Bees bring in flower nectar and add their own special stuff. Have you ever seen a beehive close up?
No, I have not. Can I make honey in my own kitchen, too?
I do not think you can, because only bees have that special touch. Do you like eating honey on toast?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad. I cannot stop eating junk food.
I hear you, and it is hard. Do you feel full, or just bored?
I know it is wrong, but I want it. I feel silly.
It is not silly, and I care. What if we try a small, sweet fruit next?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My grandpa seems sad lately.
That is very hard to see. Do you think he misses his friends?
Yes, he misses them a lot.
You can read to him. Is he okay with that?
I want to help him feel better.
That is a kind thought. I do not know all the answers, but your love helps.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need to see a doctor, but I am scared.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you know why you need to go?
I have a bad stomach ache. I want to learn how to make an appointment.
You can call the office or use their website. Do you know your insurance card number?
Yes, it is on the blue card. Can you tell me what to say on the phone?
You say your name and what hurts. Do you have a pen ready to write things down?
I do. What should I ask the doctor?
Ask how long it will take to feel better. Do you want to bring a friend for support?
Yes, my sister can come. That makes me feel safe.
That is a great idea. Good luck on your visit.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My knees hurt from the court today.
Oh no, that is rough. Did you rest them?
Yes, I sat down with a cold pack.
Good choice. What else did you do?
I watched a match on the big screen.
Fun! Did you like the score?
I won the last set, but I am tired.
Well done on the win. Go sleep now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to grow tomatoes in my yard.
That is a great idea. Do you have a sunny spot?
Yes, my back garden gets lots of sun.
Perfect. Put the seeds in warm soil there.
How deep should I put the seeds?
Just a little deep, like a fingernail. Do you have water?
I have a hose but not a watering can.
A hose is fine if you use low power.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and my paper plane flew very far.
That sounds like so much fun. Did you fly it near the big trees?
Yes, it landed right in the grass. I finished my math homework after dinner.
Good job doing your work. Do you like adding or multiplying more?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look at the blue water. I am not sure if I should swim or just sit.
The water looks calm today. Do you like cold water?
I like it warm. I do not want to get wet. I feel stuck.
That is okay to feel stuck. Would you like to build a sand castle instead?
Yes, that sounds fun. I do not know how to start.
You can use a small bucket to dig the base. Is there a bucket nearby?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go. My train leaves now.
Do not panic. It is right there. Is your bag packed?
Yes, it is packed.
Good. Run to the door.
I am running. Goodbye.
See you later. Have a nice trip.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sun feels so hot today.
It shines hard in the summer. Do you like the heat?
I do, but my eyes hurt.
Do not stare at it. It is too bright to look at.
Why is it in the sky?
I do not know why, but we need its light. Do you see the birds flying?
Yes, they look happy.
They are warm in the light. Do you feel warm too?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love how this song makes me feel warm inside.
That is a lovely feeling. Do you play it every day?
Yes, it helps me smile after a hard day.
I am glad it brings you joy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel sad and all alone right now.
I am here with you. Do you want to talk about what makes you feel that way?
I do not have anyone to play with.
That is very hard. Do you have a favorite toy you can play with?
Yes, I have my teddy bear.
Great! You are not truly alone because I am listening. Does holding your bear help you feel better?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tell what time it is on a clock?
Look at the short hand first to find the hour. Do you know which hand is short?
The short one points to five.
The long hand tells you the minutes. Is the long hand pointing at the twelve?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have been sitting here for a very long time.
I know waiting can feel slow. Do you have a favorite game to play while you wait?
I am just staring at the wall because I am bored.
Staring is okay, but it is hard on your eyes. What is your favorite thing to do outside?
I just want my mom to come back now.
I understand you are worried. I do not know exactly when she will arrive, but I am right here with you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to build a birdhouse today.
That sounds like fun. What color do you want to paint it?
Blue. Do you know if we have nails left?
I am not sure, but I can check the box. Do you have the hammer ready?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My neighbor makes too much noise at night.
That can be very tiring. Do you know which specific sound bothers you most?
It is loud music late at night.
You might try a calm chat with them first. Have you tried that already?
I have not, but I am afraid they will be angry.
Most people are nice if you are polite. I do not know for sure, but kindness works well.
I will try a kind note tomorrow.
That sounds like a good plan. I hope it helps you sleep better.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The river is very loud today.
It sounds like the water is moving fast. Do you like the noise?
I think the water looks cold.
Yes, rivers are often cool to the touch.
Can we go to the big rock by the edge?
Only an adult can help you with that. Do you have a parent with you?
Yes, my dad is right there.
That is good. He will keep you safe.
Why is the water brown?
It is brown because of dirt in the mud.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My day was very nice today.
That sounds good. What did you do first?
I ate a big cake with my friends.
Yum. Did it taste sweet?
Yes, it was sweet and cold.
I like cold cake too.
Then I played a loud game in the park.
Sounds fun. Was it noisy?
Yes, we shouted and laughed a lot.
Happy times are best.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure if I should say please when I want water.
Yes, always say please. It makes people feel good. Do you feel polite?
That makes sense. What if someone cuts in front of me in line?
I do not know your exact rule, but stay calm. Did you try asking kindly?
I do not want to be mean. How do I ask nicely?
You can say, sorry, but I was here first. Do you practice this at home?
I will try to smile and use my words.
That is a great plan. It shows you care about others. You are ready.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do neighbours knock on doors?
They often knock to say hello or share news. Do you like getting surprise visits?
Why do people share food with them?
Sharing food helps build strong friendships. Do you have a favourite dish to give?
Why are some neighbours quiet all day?
Some people just need peace to rest well. I am not sure why yours are quiet.
Why do we need neighbours at all?
Neighbours help us when we need a hand. Do you feel safe living here?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Which month is it?
It is May. Are you going to a meeting?
Yes, I need to go now. What comes after May?
June comes next. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to build a shed today. It must be done by noon.
That is a big job. Do you have your tools ready?
Yes, I have hammers and nails. How do I make the walls strong?
Use thick wood for the frame. Did you check the ground level?
The ground is flat. I am ready to start.
Good. Hammer the posts into the dirt deep. Do you know how to cut the wood?
I am cutting it now. Please wait.
I am waiting here. Are you safe with the saw?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. I do not know what to do.
That sounds bad. Did you eat today?
I did not feel like eating.
Try to drink some water. Is your nose running?
No, my nose is fine.
I do not know for sure. Can you go and sleep?
Yes, I will try to sleep.
Good idea. Rest is good for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Do you know where I can buy a card?
The shop is just down the street. Is it for a birthday?
Yes, for my little brother. Do you sell cute ones?
We have blue and red ones. What color does he like best?
He loves blue. I need to go now.
Blue cards are on the left shelf. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is a round ball easy to roll but hard to stack?
Because the curve lets it slide, but it needs a flat side to stand still. Do you have a flat block to try?
Oh, that makes sense. Why can I not glue two smooth balls together?
Glue needs rough spots to grip onto. Have you tried sandpaper on the bottom?
I tried it, but the glue got messy. Why does glue get messy on curves?
The glue has no flat place to sit, so it runs away. Do you have a little pot for it?
A pot? How does a pot help with glue?
The pot keeps the glue in one spot on the flat bottom. Do you have any pots?
Yes, I have tiny cups. Why did you say pots?
Cups work just like pots for holding small glue. Great idea, let us try that now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Where is my red coat?
I do not see it. Do you want to stop for a snack?
No time for food. Just let me find my keys and phone.
Good luck. Is your bag ready to go?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need a roof?
The roof stops rain from making a mess inside. Do you like a dry home?
Why are the walls tall?
Tall walls keep the cold out and give you room to stand. Do you plan to store tools there?
Why do we need to dig a hole?
A hole gives the shed a strong base so it does not fall over. Have you seen old sheds tip?
Why do we use nails?
Nails hold the wood tight together so it stays safe. I do not know if screws would be better for your wood.
Why is the door important?
A door lets you come in and go out easily. Does your shed need a big door?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I love bananas, but I want new ideas.
Try them in a salad. Do you like apples?
Yes, I do. What else can I mix?
You can add some yogurt. Do you like sweets?
I like a little sugar. Is that good?
Yes, it is tasty. Do you eat fruit every day?
Only sometimes. How much is enough?
Two or three is great. Do you enjoy orange juice?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My grandmother baked big red apples into a pie today.
That sounds very sweet. Did you try a piece?
Yes, I ate two warm slices with my family.
Two pieces is a nice treat. Do you like the crust?
I like the crust because it is crisp and brown.
Crispy crusts are often the best part. Is the pie finished now?
It is almost gone, only one small piece is left.
You must be very hungry. Do you want to save the last piece?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because the day is coming so fast.
It is a big event. What part worries you the most?
I do not know if I will look good.
That is a normal fear. Do you have a dress ready?
No, I broke it yesterday.
That sounds hard. Let us find a new one together.
I just want to be happy for once.
We can do that.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I think I am lost. Do you know where the park is?
I do not know where you are standing. Is there a big tree nearby?
Yes, there is a tall oak tree.
Turn left and walk for five minutes. You will see it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like the play?
I think the clown is very funny. Do you like him too?
Yes, he is silly.
Silly is fun, but sometimes the sad parts make me feel a bit low.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to sleep but my mind would not stop turning.
That feels hard. What was on your mind?
I saw a small bird sit on my window sill all day.
Did you talk to it?
No, but I wanted it to bring me a good dream.
That is a sweet hope.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights are off and I am scared.
Do not worry, I am here. Is the plug in the wall?
I think so, but I am not sure.
Please look at the switch on the wall. Is it up or down?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad today. I do not know what to do.
That sounds hard to bear. Are you hungry?
No, I just want to sit in the dark. I feel stuck.
It is okay to rest. Do you have a favorite toy nearby?
Yes, but I do not want to play. I feel empty inside.
I do not have a magic fix. Would you like to talk more?
Maybe. I just need someone to listen to me right now.
I am listening. Tell me about the empty feeling.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big fox near the path today.
That is exciting. Was it far away?
It looked at me for a second, then ran off.
Foxes are very careful. Do you like their orange fur?
Yes, it was bright and beautiful in the sun.
Nature is always special.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go to the sea, but I am not sure what to bring.
Bring a hat and some water. Do you like sand?
Yes, I love the sand. Is the water always cold?
It can be cold or warm, so it depends on the day.
That sounds confusing. How do I know if it is safe to swim?
Look for a flag on the beach. What color flag means it is safe?
I do not know. I think green?
You are right, green is usually safe. Have a great trip.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What are clouds made of?
They are made of tiny drops of water. Do you see rain when they get heavy?
Sometimes I do. How do they stay up there?
The air pushes them up from below. I do not know exactly how strong that push is.
That sounds hard work for the air. Are all clouds the same shape?
No, they come in many shapes. What shape do you like the most?
I like the fluffy ones. Can clouds turn into snow?
Yes, if it is very cold outside. Are you happy to see snow?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. I am late.
Does it feel hot?
No, it just thumps. I have to run.
Drink water soon. Is it a bad thump?
Yes. Can I go now?
Please take a break. Do you have a pill?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The wet sand is cold and my toes hurt from the rocks.
I am sorry your feet hurt. Do you have dry shoes with you?
No, I forgot them in the car.
That is a shame. Is the sun still warm on your back?
Yes, but the wind makes me feel sad.
The wind can be mean. Would you like a blanket?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water in the lake so still?
It is still because there is no wind today. Do you see the trees?
Yes, they are very quiet too. Why do we have a lake here?
We have a lake to hold lots of clean water. Is there a boat nearby?
There is a small one. Why does the water look blue?
It looks blue because it reflects the sky above. Do you like the color?
I do, it looks nice. Why are there fish in the water?
I do not know exactly where every fish is from. Do you want to cast a line?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The wind is too loud and the trees are shaking. I do not like it.
That can feel very scary. Are you safe inside?
I am inside, but the lights keep blinking. I am worried about the house.
Blinking lights are common in storms. Do you have a blanket to hug?
I am okay with the blanket, but I do not know when this will stop. It feels so long.
I do not know the exact time. Do you want to listen to the rain?
Yes, the rain sounds soft now. I think I am a little better.
That is good to hear. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go that way. It takes too long.
That path is quiet. Do you have time to look at the birds?
I am very late. Please stop talking.
I am sorry. I do not know where you are going.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My new neighbor knocks on my door at night. I feel scared.
That sounds tough. Is it loud or quiet?
It is very loud and keeps me awake. What should I do?
First, take a deep breath. Have you tried smiling when you open it?
I do not know what to say. It feels rude to ignore him.
You could say hello kindly. Do you want a sample phrase?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the shop close at five o'clock?
The workers need rest. Do you like eating cake there?
Yes. Why is the bread so warm?
It was baked just before. Do you eat bread every day?
Sometimes. Why does it smell so good?
Fresh food smells nice. I am not sure why it is that strong.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like this new town a lot.
That is great to hear. What is your favorite thing about it?
I like the big blue park.
A blue park sounds fun. Do you play there often?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to take a photo of that bird before it flies away.
Point your camera at it and click. Are you holding the camera steady?
Yes, but the picture is blurry. I do not know why.
You might be moving too much. Try to stand very still. Is the sun in your eyes?
No, but the picture looks dark. I am so fast.
You need to make it brighter. Tap the screen to change the light.
I did that, but it is still not good. Please help me.
I do not know exactly what is wrong. Try again with a new angle.
Okay, I am done, thank you. I must go now.
Good luck with your photos.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the shape of a soccer ball?
It is a sphere. Do you like round things?
Yes, I do. What is the shape of a book?
A book is usually a rectangle. Is your book thick or thin?
It is thin. What is the shape of a can of soup?
That is a cylinder. Do you like soup?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see a movie tonight. What is good?
That sounds fun. Do you like scary stories?
No, not at all. I want to laugh.
Then a funny cartoon is best. Do you like animals?
Yes, I love cats.
Great. Watch the cat movie. It is very cute.
Okay, I will pick that one.
I hope you enjoy it. Do you want popcorn?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike, but I am scared.
That is okay. Have you tried before?
Yes, I fell down many times. It hurts my knees.
Falling is part of it. Your knees will heal. Do you have a helmet?
I have a helmet, but I do not know how to balance.
Try walking the bike with one foot. Keep your eyes up. Is the ground flat?
Yes, the yard is flat. I will try again today.
Good. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I cannot stop my mind at night.
Try counting to ten slowly. Do you like numbers?
I try, but I forget where I was.
Write down what worries you. Does that help?
Writing feels like a lot of work.
You can just hum a soft song. Is your room dark?
Yes, I close the curtains.
That is good for your eyes. Do you drink water before bed?
I do, but I have to get up.
Drink less so you can rest. Do you want to try this tonight?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The street was so quiet today that I could hear the wind.
That sounds very peaceful. Did you see any birds?
Yes, a small blue bird sat on the fence for a long time.
A blue bird is a nice surprise.
It sang a happy song before it flew away.
I am glad it had a good day too.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is so hot. I do not know what to do.
Do you like the water?
Yes, but I am too tired to swim.
Maybe you can rest in the cool shade.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my keys. They were on this metal shelf.
Magnets stick to some metals like iron. Did you try moving the keys?
No, I just looked. Do all magnets stick to all metal things?
No, only some metals are magnetic. Do you have a magnet with you?
Yes, I have a big fridge magnet. How do I use it to find them?
Slide the magnet along the shelf. Does it feel a pull?
It does! But now it is stuck to a coin.
You likely found a paperclip or a small nail. How did you fix that?
I just pulled them apart. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome. Do you want tips for losing things next time?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a bird on the branch.
That is nice. What color is it?
It is brown.
Brown birds are common. Do you see any other birds?
I see a blue one too.
That sounds happy. Is it singing?
Yes, it goes tweet tweet.
I love that sound. It is a great morning for nature.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a film today.
That sounds fun. What was it about?
A dog found his home.
That is a sweet story. Did the dog have a name?
His name was Rex.
Rex sounds like a good boy.
He was very happy at the end.
I am glad he found his way.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. What should I do?
Take a deep breath. Are you okay?
I am not okay. I lost my keys.
Look in your last bag. Did you check your pockets?
I found them. I must go now.
That is good news.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The lights in my room went out and I do not know why.
That can be scary. Do you see the breaker box?
Yes, but I do not know which one to flip.
I am not sure which one controls your room. Can you check the labels?
They are all just numbers. I feel so confused.
Do not worry, it is normal to feel that way.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a small food place today.
That sounds nice. Did you like the food?
Yes, the soup was very hot.
Warm soup is good. Was it salty?
A little bit too salty.
I am sorry. Did you drink some water?
Yes, I drank two glasses.
Good for you. Do you want to go back?
Maybe, but I will look for the menu first.
That is a smart plan. Have a good rest.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am so tired. I have no idea what to do next.
That sounds hard. What made today so tough?
My boss yelled at me. I feel small and lost.
You are not small. Rest well tonight. Have you eaten?
No. I am just so full of bad feelings.
Take a small break. You did your best.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do some robots look like people?
Some makers think people feel safer talking to a face. Do you like robot faces?
No, I think they are creepy.
That is a fair point. What does a robot look like to you?
Like a box on wheels.
A box is a very practical idea. Do you think boxes are fun?
They can be, if they have wheels.
Wheels make moving much easier. Do you play with toy cars?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors. Blue light bounces off the air more than red light. Do you see clouds?
Yes, the clouds are white.
Clouds are tiny water drops. They reflect all colors of light. This makes them look white.
So blue light scatters?
Yes, it spreads out all over. Your eyes see the blue parts most. Do you like looking up?
I like blue skies.
That is nice. Blue skies mean clear air. I hope you enjoy them.
Thanks for explaining.
You are welcome. It is a fun thing to know. Have a great day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want toast with jam, but my mother left the jam in the fridge.
That is a tricky spot. Did you check if there is any in the pantry?
Yes, there is none. I do not know what else to eat.
A banana is a great choice. Do you like your toast sweet or salty?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so glad today.
That is good news. What made you happy?
The sun is warm.
Warm sun feels nice. Do you feel hot?
Not too hot.
That is just right. I am glad for you.
Thanks for talking.
I am happy to listen.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. I broke a promise.
I am sorry you feel this way. Did you tell someone?
Yes. I cannot fix it now.
Mistakes happen to everyone. Do you feel better talking?
Not really. It hurts inside.
I do not know exactly what you did. But I am here for you.
Thank you for listening.
You can always share your burden. Is it easier now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look up, the sky is so blue and it makes me so happy.
Blue skies are lovely. Do you like clouds too?
Yes, I do, but why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors, and the blue part spreads out most in the air. Do you see any birds?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so tired. My head hurts.
That sounds very hard. Do you have your bag?
Yes, I have it. I must go now.
I am happy you are safe. Do you like pizza for dinner?
Maybe later. I am too busy.
That is okay. You can rest.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My boat broke. I am so sad.
I am sorry. Did it hit a rock?
Yes, a big one.
That hurts to hear. Do you have a spare?
No, I do not.
We can fix it together. Is it bad?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My cat is not eating. I do not know what to do.
Is she playing and purring?
She is just lying down. She looks sad.
Do not panic. Check her food bowl.
The bowl is full. She refuses to eat.
That is not good. Have you called a vet?
I have not. I am afraid to ask.
Please call them now. Do not wait.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a house for the sparrows. What do I need?
You need a wooden box with a hole in front. Do you have a piece of wood?
Yes, I have some old boards. How big should the hole be?
Make it about two inches wide. That is just right for them.
Where should I put the box on the tree?
Put it up high and in the shade. Do you like quiet spots?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red ball in the park today.
That is fun to find. Did you kick it?
I kicked it far over the fence.
Oh no, that sounds hard to get back.
A kind man gave it to me from the other side.
What a lucky break.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am scared about the meeting.
That is okay. Do you know what time it is?
It is at two o'clock.
Good. Did you bring your paper?
Yes, I have it in my bag.
You are ready. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to grow carrots. Do they need sun?
Yes, they love the sun. Do you have a big pot?
No, I have a small box. Will that work?
A small box is hard for carrots. They like deep dirt.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad today. I do not want to play.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to sit with me?
I just want to be left alone. I do not like this feeling.
It is okay to rest. Do you want a warm drink?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the lighthouse tall?
It is tall to shine far across the dark sea. Do you like watching ships?
Why does it need to shine so bright?
It helps boats find the safe path home. I do not know why it is red.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to clean the room.
That is a great idea. What do you want to do first?
I will pick up the toys.
Good start. Are they all on the floor?
Yes, they are everywhere.
Let us put them in the big box.
The box is too full.
I do not know where else to put them. What can we do?
We can make a special toy pile.
That works for me. Great job!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck. My king is in danger. What should I do?
Look for a safe square for your king. Is your queen free to move?
My queen is trapped. I feel lost. Can you help me?
Try to block the enemy with a piece. Which piece blocks the attack?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love my warm toast with butter this morning.
That sounds very tasty. What else is on your plate?
I also have fresh juice and some small cookies.
Yum, that is a great start to the day. Do you like sweet or savory cookies?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to balance my bike.
That is hard at first, but you can do it. What size is your bike?
It is a small red bike with training wheels.
Please remove the training wheels when you feel ready. Do you have a friend to hold the back?
No, I am all by myself in the park.
Ride slowly and look forward, not down. Is the ground smooth?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The baby is here and I have to go now.
That is great news. Is the mother doing okay?
I am in a huge hurry, please keep it short.
Okay, I will be quick. Do you know if the baby has hair?
I really must run now, thanks.
Safe travels to you. We will help you later.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we give presents on birthdays?
We give presents to show we care about you. Do you like getting gifts?
Yes, I do. But why is it on the day I was born?
It marks the day you first came to the world. Do you remember how that felt?
I do not remember that. Why do people sing songs then?
Singing makes the day feel very happy. Do you like to sing?
I like singing. Why do we eat cake?
I do not know the exact reason, but it is sweet and fun. Do you like cake?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make soup for dinner.
That sounds fun. What kind of soup?
I like tomato soup.
Good choice. Do you have a pot?
Yes, the big red one.
Great. Do you know where the tomatoes are?
No, I am looking now.
Check the fridge door.
I see them!
You are a fast helper.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a red rose in the park today.
That is a nice flower. Did it smell sweet?
Yes, it smelled like candy.
How lovely. Why did you stop to look?
I wanted to give it to my mom.
That is a kind thought. Did you bring it home?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Did the monster eat the boy?
No, the monster just licked his nose. Did that tickle you?
Yes, it is a funny story.
That is good. I am glad you had fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The apples at the market are too red. I do not like them.
That sounds sad. Do you like green apples?
No, I want sweet ones. They look hard and dry.
You are right that some look dry. Can I help you find a better one?
Yes, please. I want to be happy.
Let us look together. You will find the best one soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The wind feels so nice today. I am very happy.
I am glad you feel good. Is it blowing hard?
Yes, it pushes my hair. It feels like a big hug.
That sounds fun. Do you like the cold?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the big boat float on the water?
The boat is very light for its size, so the water holds it up. Do you like watching the waves?
The water moves up and down.
Yes, tides make the water rise and fall. Do you see any fish?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I just rode my bike.
That is great news. Did you go to the park?
Yes, I went to the park. It was a sunny day.
Sun is good for riding. How fast did you go?
I went very fast. I felt like a bird.
Flying is fun. Do you have training wheels?
No, I have two big wheels. I did not fall down.
That is amazing. You are very strong.
Thank you. I want to ride again.
I am happy for you. Have fun out there.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a red square and a blue circle. Which one goes first?
That is a good question. Do you like the color red more?
Yes, I do.
Then put the red square first. Is it fun to choose?
Yes, it is fun.
You did a great job. I do not know the next part yet. What comes next?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the ferry time fast.
The next boat leaves in ten minutes. Are you going to the island?
Yes, I am running late.
The gate is on the left side. Do you have your ticket?
It is in my pocket.
You can run, but please be careful.
I will be fine, thank you.
Good luck on your trip.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The wind is so loud and cold today.
It can feel scary when the wind is strong. Do you have a warm coat?
I just want it to stop blowing my papers away.
Wind often wants to play with light things. Have you tucked them under a book?
Yes, but it is still too chilly here.
That is true, wind makes the air feel colder. Is your house okay?
The door is shut, so we are safe inside.
Good. Being inside helps the wind go away. Do you hear rain too?
No, just the wind, and it makes me sad.
It is okay to feel sad about the weather. Would you like to sit by a window?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a big secret.
I am listening. What is it?
My cat knocked over the blue cup.
That is a fun story. Did you clean it up?
Yes, I used a towel.
You are a good helper. Does the cat like blue cups?
No, he likes red ones.
That is good to know.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at that big light! It is so bright and warm.
That is a wonderful sight. What makes it so special to you?
It feels like it is calling me to see the sea better.
The light does help us see safely. Do you see any boats out there?
Yes, a small one is coming in to rest for the night.
How peaceful that must be.
It is. I am very glad I came here today.
I am glad you feel that way.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am so tired. My boss gave me too much to do. Do you know how to fix this?
I do not know your work, but taking a deep breath helps. Did you eat lunch?
Yes, I did. But the noise in my head is loud. What should I do next?
I think writing down your tasks will help. Do you like writing?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to plan a great birthday party for my best friend.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What is her favorite food?
She loves pizza and ice cream.
Those are tasty treats. Do you know how many people will come?
I think about ten friends will join us.
That is a good size for a group. What game do you plan to play?
We might play tag or hide and seek.
Those are energetic games. Do you have a plan for the decorations?
Not yet, but I like balloons and streamers.
Bright colors always look nice. I do not know if she likes balloons, but they are fun. What color do you pick?
She likes blue, so I will buy blue ones.
Blue is a calm color. Do you have a budget for the supplies?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the baby cry so much?
They cry to tell us they are hungry or tired. Do you think he is hungry?
Why are his eyes blue?
Eye color comes from parents and comes later. Do you like blue eyes?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I like this song, but I do not know if I should sing it.
Do you feel happy when you hear it? That is the best sign.
Yes, I feel happy, but I am afraid of making a mistake.
Mistakes are just part of the fun. Would you like to try one line with me?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to dig holes in the sand.
That is fun. Do you build a castle?
Yes, I build a big one.
A big castle is cool. Is it tall?
It is as tall as me.
That is very tall. I like sand too.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the store today. I saw a big fish tank.
That sounds like a nice day. Did the fish look happy?
One fish ate a red pellet. It swam around the tank.
I like fish too. Do they have a favorite spot to sit?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the rain fall from the sky?
Water goes up and gets cold. It turns into clouds and comes down. Do you like rain?
Sometimes it is too loud.
That can be scary for some people. I hear you. Is your window open?
No, it is closed tight.
Good, that keeps you dry. Nature is strong.
Can I stay in the dry part?
Yes, you can rest there. The rain will stop soon. Are you happy now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the baby cry so much?
Babies cry to tell us they need something. Are you tired from all the checking?
Does the baby eat well?
Yes, the baby is a good eater. Do you have time to rest?
Why do they sleep so many hours?
Sleep helps their little bodies grow strong. I am not sure exactly when the next nap will start.
Is the baby happy now?
Yes, the baby looks calm and happy. Do you want to hold them?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake a cake, but I am afraid of the oven.
Do not worry, I can help you. Why do you feel scared of the heat?
I think it might burn my hands if I am not careful.
You will be safe if you use oven mitts. Have you ever cooked food before?
No, this is my very first time trying to cook anything.
That is a big step to take for a beginner.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to throw a party, but I have no ideas. What should I do?
That sounds fun. Do you like music?
Yes, I do. What else do I need?
You need snacks and drinks. Would you like help making a list?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very lonely today. Why does that happen?
You might be missing a close friend. Do you have someone nearby?
I have friends, but I feel far away from them. Why?
Sometimes we need to talk to feel close. What stops you from reaching out?
I am afraid they will say no. Why do I feel that fear?
Fear comes from past worries. You can still try to call. Do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the food taste so good here?
The chefs use fresh things. Do you like the smell?
Why is the room so quiet?
They want people to rest. Do you feel calm?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The city is so loud and full of people today. I love the busy energy.
It sounds like a fun day to be out. Do you like the noise?
Yes, I do. The buses are moving so fast and people are smiling.
That is a nice picture. What is your favorite part of the day?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late and my dog is barking.
Is he wanting to go outside?
He is pulling on his leash really hard.
That sounds like he needs a walk.
I have work to do in ten minutes.
Can you take a quick five-minute break?
Yes, I think that will fix it.
That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My horse looks so sad today.
That is very upsetting. Is his tail down?
Yes, he just stands still and sighs.
He might be tired. Has he had enough water?
I think so, but he will not eat.
That is not good. Does he feel warm?
I am worried he is sick.
Please call a vet. Is he limping?
I am going to do that now.
That is the right thing to do. I hope he feels better soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I made bread today. It got big and fluffy.
That is great. Do you use yeast?
Yes. The tiny things in the dough eat sugar.
They make gas bubbles. That pushes the bread up.
So the bubbles make it rise?
Yes. The heat makes the bubbles grow.
It smells so good now.
I think it smells wonderful too.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am making soup for dinner. I went to the store today and found nice tomatoes.
That sounds warm and nice. Do you add any bread to it?
No bread, just carrots and onions. I felt happy picking the vegetables.
Fresh carrots make a sweet taste. Did you pick the tomatoes yourself?
Yes, I chose the red ones with shiny skins. It is a simple meal.
Simple meals are often the best. I hope you enjoy your soup.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Does the red bird fly to the moon in the story?
Yes, it does. Do you like the moon?
I do. Is the bird tired after the trip?
I am not sure, the story does not say. Are you tired?
A little. Can I go back to the page with the tree?
Of course. Do you want to read it again?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared of the loud thunder.
That is a very normal feeling. Do you like hearing the soft rain on the roof?
No, I only like the quiet parts.
You can listen to the quiet rain on a cup of water. It is much softer. Do you have a cup at home?
Yes, I have a red cup.
That is a great idea to try.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the teacher here?
I do not know. Who is your class?
Math. I am running.
She is in room ten. Why is it so loud?
I forgot my book.
That is a big problem. Do you have a bag?
Yes. Thank you.
You are welcome. Go fast.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! We are going to a big party tonight.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What is your favorite part of the party?
I love the loud music and the dancing. I want to dance all night long.
Dancing is great exercise. Will you bring any friends with you?
Yes, I will bring my best friend. She likes to laugh a lot.
Laughter makes parties better. What are you going to eat there?
There are big cakes and sweet pies. I cannot wait to try them.
Cakes are a treat. Do you know how long the party will last?
It goes until late at night. I am very excited.
Sounds like a wonderful evening ahead. Have a great time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared to go to the meeting today.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you know who will be there?
My mom and a new man.
That sounds like a good group.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to wash these shirts.
Do you have warm water? Just wash them with soap and rinse.
The tag says cold only. What now?
Use cold water then. Do you have two buckets?
Yes, I have two blue buckets.
Put them in one bucket to wash. Move them to the other to rinse.
I am done. Should I dry them outside?
Yes, hang them in the sun. Do they feel soft now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at the sky. I am not sure what I should do.
The sky looks pretty today. Do you like the white shapes?
Yes, I do. But I feel lost looking at them.
Just watch how they move slowly. Is one moving fast?
Not really. They just sit there. What should I do with my eyes?
You can rest your eyes on a soft shape. Do you see a big one?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My chicken looks very sad today. What should I give her?
She might just be lonely. Does she have friends in the coop?
I do not know what to do with the cow.
A cow needs grass to eat. Is she standing near the field?
The pig is digging up the garden again.
Pigs love to dig, so this is true for them.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must find the queen before I start my game.
The queen moves any number of steps in any straight line. Are you playing white or black?
I am playing white and I am late for work.
Then place her on d1. I do not know if you will win, but she is strong.
Thank you, I must run to the door.
Good luck to you. Do you take your time with your next move?
I will not have time to think, I will just guess.
Guessing is risky, but fun. I hope you enjoy the race.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my party. Do you know what time the cake comes?
I do not know the time. Are you having fun?
Yes, but I must go now. Where is my hat?
It is on the floor. Have a great day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a blue book on my walk. The cover had a big red dog on it.
A blue book with a red dog? I love that sound. Was the dog sleeping or playing?
It was sleeping in a sunny spot. I sat down next to it for a while.
That sounds like a very calm place. Do you have a favorite book that makes you feel calm too?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Can you help me read this book?
Yes, I can help. What page are you on?
I am on page four. Why do the letters go left to right?
We write that way by rule. Do you like the picture?
I do. Can you read the next part for me?
I can, yes. I do not know what happens later.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to move our home?
We need a bigger room for your toys. Do you have a favorite toy?
Yes, my teddy bear. How will we move it?
We will put it in a soft box. Is it happy to come along?
I think so. Why do we need a truck?
A truck is big enough for all our boxes. Do you like looking at big trucks?
I do. Why are you tired?
I am tired because I carry heavy things. Do you want to help a little?
I can help. Why do we stop now?
I do not know the exact reason for the stop. Are you thirsty?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ran hard all day and my legs hurt.
Running makes you tire out good. Do you like jumping too?
Yes, but now I cannot sleep at all.
That is not right for your body. Try counting sheep to stop thinking.
I tried that, but I only saw cows.
Cows are fine too if you count them slow.
Now my eyes are heavy and dark.
Good, let them close tight. You did good today.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is it so hot today?
The sun is sending down strong heat. Do you like the warm sun?
Why do I feel so dry?
You are losing water through your skin. Do you have some water with you?
Why is the grass dry?
The ground needs rain to stay green. I do not know when the next rain will come.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to start walking to stay healthy, but I do not know how to begin.
That is a great idea. Do you have a quiet place to walk nearby?
Yes, I have a park close to my home. How long should I walk each day?
Start with ten minutes to keep it easy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Why does that big ship stay up? I am late for work.
It pushes a lot of water down. The water pushes back up. Do you like boats?
Just tell me the main trick. I must run now.
It is light air inside. The air makes it float. What is your favorite day?
Thanks. I need to go.
You are welcome. Have a good trip.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my party.
Oh no! Is it far?
Yes, it is right here.
That is good. What do you want to do?
I just want to eat cake.
Happy birthday.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make my voice sound loud for the play?
Stand up tall and breathe out from your belly. Do you practice every day?
I try, but I still feel shy.
Start small with quiet words first. Is that hard for you?
Yes, it is a bit scary.
That is very normal, just keep going.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The wind is so soft today. It feels like a gentle hug.
That sounds lovely. Do you feel calm?
Yes, my heart feels light and free. It is a happy day.
I am glad you feel that way. Does the air smell fresh?
It smells like rain and green grass. I love it.
Nature is always beautiful. Do you plan to go outside?
I am going to sit by the tree. I want to just listen.
That sounds like a perfect plan. Enjoy your time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to eat but I do not know what to pick.
The chicken looks good. Do you like hot food?
Maybe. I am very confused.
The pasta is soft and warm. Would you like a little cheese on it?
Yes, that sounds nice.
I will get that for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to pack my bag now. I am so late.
Take the blue shirt and the books. Do you have your shoes?
No. I lost them. This is bad.
They are on the floor near the door. Slow down.
Oh. Thank you. What else?
Just the water bottle. Is it full?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am curious why the sky is blue. Can you tell me?
Sunlight has many colors, and the blue part scatters the most. Do you like to watch the sunset?
Yes, sunsets are very pretty. How can I make blue with paint?
You mix yellow and purple paint together. Do you have any paint at home?
I do have some paints in my box. Thank you for telling me.
You are welcome. It is fun to learn new things.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw the river today. It looked very cold.
That sounds chilly. Do you think the fish are shivering too?
I do not know. The water moves fast.
Fast water keeps things warm. Why do you think it moves so quickly?
Maybe because it is rain today.
That is a smart guess. Do you see any ducks floating in it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to walk to the store. Do I have time for a health walk?
A fast walk is good for your body. Do you like the sound of that?
It is late. Can I just walk fast to the store?
Yes, moving fast helps your heart. Do you feel tired after work?
I am running out of time. Is a quick walk still good for me?
Yes, even a few minutes help. Do you have extra shoes on?
I will go now. Thanks for the quick words.
You are welcome. Have a safe walk.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am so tired of waiting for the bus.
That can feel long. Do you see any birds flying?
No, just the empty road.
The bus is likely coming soon. What is your favorite song to hum?
I do not have a song in mind.
That is okay. I know it comes fast when we look at the sky.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the computer get hot?
The parts inside work hard and make heat. Do you like warm things?
Why do I type on the keys?
The keys tell the computer what you want. Is that a fun part for you?
Why is the screen black sometimes?
It turns off to save power and rest. Do you know how to wake it up?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the bus stop and it was very loud.
That sounds like a busy place. Do you like the noise?
No, I just want to sit down and rest my feet.
Your feet must be very tired. Are you going home now?
Yes, my house is on the next bus.
I hope you find a nice seat.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know how to start my big task.
Take one small step first. What is the very first thing you see?
I feel sad and stuck when I try to do it alone.
You are not alone. Do you have a friend who likes this too?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is the right way to say thank you?
You look at the person and smile when they give you a gift. Do you like giving gifts too?
I do, but I forgot to say please today.
That is okay, just say it next time. Does that help you feel happy?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I read a map?
Look at the key to match colors. Do you have a compass?
No, I do not.
Just use the north arrow on the map. That works well.
Can I use my phone?
Yes, a phone app works too. Is your battery full?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The lights are off and I am so mad.
That feels bad. Is your phone working?
No, everything is dark and quiet.
Oh, that is scary. Do you have a flashlight?
I do, but it feels broken inside.
I am sorry. Can you smell smoke?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to eat for lunch.
That is a hard choice. Do you like hot food?
I want something cold, but my stomach feels empty.
A big salad might help you feel full. Do you like green stuff?
I am not sure if salad will be enough.
Maybe you can add some beans to it. Do you want a sweet treat too?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the wind today.
Why do you hate it?
It makes me cold and my hair is a mess.
That does not feel good at all.
It is so loud and scary outside.
The wind can be very loud indeed.
I just want it to stop.
I hope it stops soon for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel scared of the loud wind outside.
Do you know why we lock the doors?
We lock them so the wind does not get in.
That is a safe habit to have.
How can I check if my window is tight?
Press your hand flat on the glass.
What should I look for when I press it?
Look for any cold air moving on your skin.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I forgot to bring my pencil for class.
Do not worry, I have a spare one. Do you like to draw?
Yes, I love drawing in my spare time.
I am happy to help you finish your work.
Thank you, that is very kind of you.
You are welcome, enjoy your day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn French fast.
That is a big goal. What is your main reason for learning?
I travel soon.
Good luck with your trip. Do you like food?
Yes, I love bread.
Bread is a great start. Do you know the word for milk?
I am in a rush.
Okay, be safe. I hope you learn well.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to draw.
That is okay. Do you like cats?
I do not have a cat.
You can draw a dog if you want.
I forgot how to draw legs.
Just make four lines. Is that helping?
Yes, it is helping.
Great. You are doing well.
I think I am ready to try.
Good luck. Have fun with it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start my letter.
Take a deep breath. It is just words on paper. What is the first thing you want to say?
I want to tell them I miss them, but I feel shy.
Honesty is kind and true.
Should I use a happy word or a sad one?
Pick the word that feels real to you. Are you more happy or sad right now?
I am both.
Then write both feelings.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck on my story. I do not know what to do next.
That is a hard feeling. What is the main problem in your tale?
The bear has no home. I cannot think of a good fix.
Bears need trees to sleep in. Have you tried a forest?
Yes, but the bear is too tired to walk there. I am stuck again.
I do not know the perfect answer for you. But maybe a kind friend could help him?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My garden fence is very old and looks sad. What should I do?
A new fence looks nice. Is it made of wood or stone?
It is made of wood. I think I want to paint it.
Painting is a good choice. Do you like bright colors?
I like red. But I am not good at painting.
You can try again if it fails. Do you have a steady hand?
I am not sure. My hands shake a bit.
Maybe you should ask a friend for help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a song in my head but I cannot name it.
That sounds tricky. Do you remember who sings it?
No, I just know the tune.
You can search by humming it. Would you like to try that?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at the big clock. What time is it?
The short hand is near the one. It is almost one o'clock. Do you like lunch?
One o'clock? I thought it was twelve.
You are right, it is a little after twelve. Did you eat your snack?
I don't know how to tell time.
That is okay. I can help you learn. Are you hungry now?
Yes, I want to know when dinner is.
Dinner is at five. Look for the hand on the five. Can you find the five?
I see it. Thank you.
You did a good job looking. We will check again soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy and feel bad.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you say it yet?
No, I am scared to look at her face.
Fear is a normal feeling. Why is looking so scary?
I think she will be very angry with me.
People often get upset when things break.
What words should I use to fix this?
Just say I am sorry and I will pay for it. Do you have money?
Yes, I can save my coins to help.
That is a very kind and true offer.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My cat is sleeping on the sofa all day. What should I do?
Does she eat and play with you?
She eats, but she does not want to play.
That is odd. Is her bowl full of food?
Yes, it is full, but she will not eat it.
I do not know why. Please see a doctor.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my horse. I am late.
Is he brown? I see a brown horse by the tree.
No, my horse is black. Can you help?
I do not know where a black horse is. Are you wearing red?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent too much on candy today and broke my piggy bank.
Oh no, that sounds sad. Did you find any money on the floor?
No, but I saw a bag of trash near the park.
That is a good place to look for coins. Do you have a bag for them?
I do, but I feel bad about the broken bank.
Do not worry, we can fix it or save in a jar. What does your bank look like?
It is a pink cow that is cracked.
We can glue it back together. Do you want to try that now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my first job. Can you tell me what to do?
Take a deep breath. Do you have your bag?
I have my bag. What should I say to the boss?
Say hello and be nice. I do not know the rules. Are you nervous?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is that island so round?
The sea waves pushed the sand into a circle over many years. Do you like circles?
Why does the sand look so bright?
The sun hits the wet sand and makes it shine. Do you like the sun?
Why is there no big tree on the island?
It is too windy for big trees to grow there. I do not know why it is so windy.
Why do the birds sit on the rocks?
The rocks are warm and safe for them. Do you see any birds?
Why is the water so clear?
The water is clean and full of sunlight. Do you like the water?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I feed the birds in my garden?
Put seeds in a bowl on the ground. Do you have any seeds?
I only have bread, can I use that?
No, bread is not good for them. You need sunflower or millet seeds.
Where can I buy those seeds?
Try a pet store or a grocery store. I do not know the exact price.
Should I put the bowl on a table?
Put it on the ground near a bush for safety. Do you have a low shelf?
Yes, I have a small table right outside.
That works well if it is low. Just keep it clean.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My screen broke and I cannot see my school work.
That is frustrating. Do you have a spare laptop in the house?
I think there is one in Dad's office.
Great. Please ask a grown-up to help you plug it in.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see a beetle. Is it strong?
Yes, beetles have hard shells. Do you like bugs?
I must go now. Goodbye.
Bye. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the island round?
Because land stops where the water starts. Do you like swimming?
Why is the sand so warm?
The sun has baked it all day. I am not sure why it feels that way, though.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so late. My bus was full.
That is frustrating. Do you know why it was full?
Yes, a big storm stopped the roads.
A storm? That sounds scary.
It was. I ran here as fast as I could.
You did a good job trying.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does snow feel so cold?
Ice takes heat from your skin. Do you like making snowmen?
Why does it stop falling?
The clouds run out of water. Do you listen for the wind?
Why is it white?
I do not know why. Do you see the trees?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind felt cold on my face this morning.
That sounds like winter is coming. Do you like the cold?
I put on a big red coat to stay warm.
A red coat is very cozy. What did you do next?
I saw the leaves turn yellow and fall down.
Yellow leaves are very pretty. Do you collect them?
I sat by the window and watched the sun.
That sounds like a peaceful end to the day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My boat is stuck in the mud. I am so sad.
That sounds tricky. How big is the boat?
It is very small. I can barely lift it.
That is good news. Can you see your friends nearby?
Yes, I can see them. But they are far away.
We can work together to push it free.
Okay, I will try hard. Thank you for helping.
You are welcome. Let us push on three.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am hungry but I do not know what to eat.
Eggs are a good choice. Do you like your food soft?
Yes, I like them soft.
That is easy to make. Do you have a pan in your kitchen?
Yes, I have a small silver pan.
Great, just add a little oil. Are you ready to start?
I think I am ready now.
You can do it. Tell me if you need help.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My line snapped and the big fish got away. I am so mad.
That must feel bad to lose a catch. What kind of fish was it?
It was a big bass with silver scales. I worked hard to get it close.
You were doing well until the end. Do you want to try again?
Maybe, but I just want to sit and be quiet now. The sun is hot.
Resting is a good thing to do. I will keep your spot safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost. I need a book about space.
The space books are on the left. Do you like rockets?
Yes. Where do I start?
Look for the blue shelves first. Do you want to read here or take it home?
I will read here. Where is a good chair?
Sit by the big window. It is a nice spot.
Thank you. I feel better.
You are welcome. Have fun reading.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my home movie look clear?
Try to sit in bright light and hold the phone very still. Do you have a lot of sun in your room?
I tried that, but the picture is still dark.
Clean the glass with a soft cloth to remove smudges. Is your phone screen cracked or dirty?
Oh, I see. I need to clean it first.
That is a great first step for better pictures. Have you ever tried filming outside?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with my math.
That sounds hard. What is the first step?
It has numbers and circles.
Oh, that is a shape. Do you like to draw?
Yes, I draw all the time.
Good. Draw the circles.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the meeting at nine or ten?
I do not know the exact time. What time are you free?
I am free all morning.
That gives you more options. Do you prefer an early start?
I prefer to go to sleep late.
Then the later time is better for you. Let me check the details.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My floor is very dirty with dust.
Try sweeping with a broom. Is it dusty under the beds?
Yes, there is dust there. What do I use?
A soft cloth works well. Do you have a wet rag?
I have a rag, but the table is sticky.
I do not know the best soap for your floor, but water helps.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a lot of homework and I am scared to fail.
It is okay to feel that way. What subject is hard for you?
Math is tricky and I do not know the answers.
You can try a little at a time. Do you like drawing?
Yes, I like drawing, but is that school work?
Drawing helps your brain rest. Why not draw for ten minutes?
That sounds good. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Good luck with your studies.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Listen to this happy tune. It makes me smile.
It sounds very bright and fun. What makes it so special?
It plays on my favorite day. The sun is out.
That sounds wonderful. I can feel the joy.
It is my new favorite song. Do you like it?
I cannot hear it, but I trust you. Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am not sure if I should drink tea or coffee today.
What is in your stomach right now?
My tummy feels a little grumpy.
Tea is softer on your belly. Coffee can make it hurt.
That sounds very good to me.
I think tea is the right choice for you.
Thank you so much for helping me.
You are welcome. Do you like the taste of tea?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make my mouse go faster.
You can change this in your settings. Do you know how to open the menu?
How do I get to that page?
Click the little gear icon on the start screen. Is it hard to find?
I see the gear, but then what?
Look for the word mouse in the list. It is usually near the top.
I clicked it, but I am lost.
Scroll down to the movement speed bar. You can say I do not know if you need help finding it.
Oh, here is a slide bar.
Yes, drag it to the right. Did that work for you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am saving shiny rocks in my box.
That sounds like fun. What color is your biggest rock?
It is blue and very pretty.
I do not know where you found it. Are you going to look for more?
Yes, I want to fill the whole box up.
You are a good saver.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a box, but I do not know what is inside.
That sounds fun. Do you have a knife to open it?
I have a key, but I do not know where to put it.
Try the little hole on top. Did that work?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn an instrument, but I do not know which one.
That is a big choice. Do you like loud sounds or soft ones?
I like loud sounds that make me want to dance.
Try a drum or a trumpet. They are very fun to play.
I am not sure my ears are strong enough for drums.
That makes sense. Have you ever tried a guitar?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Can you keep a big secret?
Yes, I can. What is it?
I broke my little red cup.
Oh no. Was it on purpose?
No, I slipped and dropped it.
That is a true answer. Do you feel sad?
Yes, my mom will be upset.
I understand. Should I tell her now?
Yes, please tell her I am sorry.
Okay. I will say you are sorry.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hi, I must run. Why do leaves drop?
Trees let them go when days get short. Do you like the fall weather?
No time. Just why?
It helps them save energy for the cold.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The wall is not straight.
That is tricky. Do you have a level?
I do. But the ground is very soft.
That makes it hard to keep it level. I do not know how to fix soft ground.
What do I do now?
You may need to move the shed. Do you like this spot?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is loud and I feel scared. What should I do?
Come inside and hug a big pillow. Are you wearing a warm coat?
I am inside, but my toys are near the window. Should I move them?
Yes, move them to a safe spot. Do they have favorite spots to hide?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I hit the ball?
Grip the handle like a handshake. Do you have a racket?
Yes, I do. Where do I stand?
Stand near the baseline with feet apart.
How do I swing?
Swing your arm smooth across your body. Was that clear?
A bit more help, please.
Look up at the ball, not down.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took a picture of a red bird today. It was sitting on my fence.
That sounds like a great photo! Did you see anything else interesting?
I also snapped a shot of the sun going down behind the trees.
That must have looked very warm and bright.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made this puzzle! Can you help me solve it?
That is so fun! What is the first clue?
The answer is hidden in the word "cat".
Oh, I do not know that one yet. Is it a sound or a letter?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the big red car?
It is in the old wing. Is the car red?
No, it is blue. What is in the old wing?
We have many cars there. Do you like cars?
Yes. How do I get to the old wing?
Go left at the front door. Safe travels!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so tired of waiting for my turn.
Waiting is hard, but you will get to play soon. Are you enjoying the park?
Yes, but it is too slow.
I agree, time feels long when we want something. Do you like the slide?
The slide is fun, I think.
That is a great thing to do. Do you like the big red slide?
I want to go on it now.
I do not know your exact time, but it is close. Do you see the line moving?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go camping soon. What should I bring with me?
You need a warm tent and a good blanket. Do you have a sleeping bag ready?
I have a tent, but I am not sure about the food.
Pack easy foods like peanut butter and crackers.
That sounds simple. Where is the best place to sleep?
Pick a spot that is dry and away from big trees.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to paint this wall blue by noon. Do I have time?
It is a big wall. That sounds very tight. Do you have the paint ready?
Yes, but the brush feels stiff. How do I make it soft?
Soak it in warm water. That helps the bristles open up.
Okay, done. Now the color looks too dark. What should I do?
Mix in a little white. That makes it lighter.
It looks good. How do I stop it from smudging?
Let it dry fully. Do not touch it yet.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The snow is so cold and it does not stop falling.
That is very tiring. Do you want a warm drink?
I just want to be inside and warm.
I agree with you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at this blue spot on the map. Is that a lake?
Yes, that is a lake with cool water. Do you like to swim?
I like to swim, but I am not good at it yet.
That is okay, we will practice together soon. Do you have a life jacket?
Yes, I have a green one in my bag.
Great, your green one will keep you safe. What else is on this map?
I see a big brown line going up a hill.
I am not sure, but it looks like a path. Do you want to walk up there?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to send a letter fast. Please help me.
I can help you. Do you have a stamp?
No, I forgot it. Where do I get one?
