The counter on the left sells them. Are you sending it to a friend?
Yes, my sister. How do I use the machine?
Put the letter in the box and press the green button. Did you bring the money?
I have cash. What is the cost?
It is two dollars for a small letter. Is that okay for you?
Yes, that works. I am very late.
The line is short right now. Good luck with your letter.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I am getting married soon.
That is great news! What color will your dress be?
It will be white and simple.
I love that idea. How are you feeling right now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to move my home.
You can pack your things in boxes. Do you like to sort by color?
I have too many toys to move.
We can give away some toys. Which ones are your favorites?
I am sad to leave my old room.
Your feelings are real. Do you want to take a photo?
I do not know what to do with the boxes.
I do not know your exact plan. Do you have a truck?
I think I need to rest now.
That is a good choice.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the cow before it wanders off.
Cows like open fields, so check near the fence. Do you hear any lowing?
Yes, I heard one! Is a pig pink?
Most pigs are pink, yes. Do you see one in the mud?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the water cold there?
Yes, the harbor water is very cold. Do you like swimming?
No, I like boats.
That is a good choice. There are many big ships.
Is there a pier?
Yes, there is a long pier.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go. Where is the fast food?
The burger place is right there. Do you want a drink?
No time. I am running late.
Eat well. See you later.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a ball but I do not know how to kick it.
Hold the ball high. Do you have a goal to aim at?
I have a box, but I am scared of missing.
Missing is part of the game. Are you standing on grass?
Yes, I am on the green grass.
Grass is good for slipping. Take a deep breath and try.
I think I will just throw it instead.
Throwing is not allowed in football. Do you like running?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
They use tiny hairs in their roots to pull water up. Do you like watching plants grow?
Yes, but why do they need water?
Water helps them make their own food. Have you ever seen a thirsty plant?
I have, the leaves look sad.
Yes, they droop when they are dry. Nice work asking good questions!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I broke my new cup.
Oh no, I am sorry you feel that way. Are you safe?
Yes, I am safe. I just feel very bad about it.
It happens to everyone. Do you have another cup?
I think I do, but I need to find it.
Let us look together. Is it in the kitchen?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big white puff in the sky. I do not know what to do.
It looks like cotton. Do you like fluffy things?
I like it, but it looks like it might rain soon. I am not sure.
Sometimes clouds carry water. Is your skin dry today?
No, my skin is fine. I just feel a bit sad about the gray.
You can just watch it move. Do you watch birds?
Yes, I do watch birds. What should I do with the cloud?
Just let it go. Do you think it is happy?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked past the big tree and then I lost the road home.
That is scary. Did you see any signs?
I saw a red car park, but then the path ended in mud.
Yikes. Do you know which way is up?
I am just sitting here waiting for you to help me find my way.
Let us walk north. Can you see the sun?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why does my bread get big?
Yeast eats sugar and makes gas. Do you add warm water?
Yes, it is warm. Is that good?
That is true. The gas makes it rise.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I buy some fresh apples at the market?
You walk to a fruit stand and tell the seller what you want. Do you like red or green apples?
I like the red ones. How do I pay for them?
You give the seller the money, or use a card if they accept it. Do you have enough coins?
I have five dollars. Is that enough for a bag?
Yes, five dollars usually buys a good bag of small apples. Do you want to start walking now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I saw smoke from the kitchen. How do I stop a small pot fire?
Turn off the heat and cover it with a metal lid. Is the smoke getting thick?
The smoke is bad now. Can I just use water on it?
No, never use water on an oil fire. Please call for help right away.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the lake looks dirty.
That is a shame to hear. Is there trash on the water?
Yes, I see some old bottles.
I do not know why they are there. Do you have a bag?
No, I do not have a bag.
I suggest you tell a helper. Would you like to help pick them up?
I think I will try to help.
That is a good choice. Let us go look for the trash.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the big park today. The sun was very warm on my face.
That sounds like a nice day. Did you see any birds?
Yes, I saw a red bird eat a seed. It looked so happy.
Red birds are pretty to watch. Did you take a picture of it?
No, I did not have my camera with me. I just watched it from the bench.
Watching is often the best way to enjoy nature. Did you sit for a long time?
I sat until my legs got tired. Then I went back home for lunch.
You worked hard walking. What did you eat for lunch?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried hard, but I failed again. I feel so bad.
It is hard to fail, but I know you tried your best. Do you want to talk about what went wrong?
I just got the wrong answer. It feels like I am dumb.
One wrong answer does not make you dumb. I do not know if you are tired or just unsure.
I think I am just tired. My brain is foggy.
Tired brains need rest, not more work. Does that feel true to you?
Yes, I think I need a break. Thank you for being kind.
You are welcome. I am happy to help you rest.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people sit so still on the dock?
They wait for fish to take the bait. Do you like to wait for things?
I do not like waiting. Why do they use a worm?
The worm looks like food to the fish. It smells nice to them.
Why is the water so quiet?
I do not know for sure, but it feels calm there. Do you enjoy quiet places?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The park was quiet today. I walked past the swings but no one was there.
That sounds very empty. Did you see any birds?
Just one black bird on the fence. I felt small sitting on the bench.
A bird can keep you company. How do you feel now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do sailors know how to swim well?
Yes, they must swim to stay safe. Do you like the ocean?
I have to run. Can boats sail without wind?
Modern boats have engines for power. Is your engine running?
Thank you. Goodbye.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss the warm sun.
That is hard. Do you have a blanket?
My cold hands make me sad.
Let us keep them warm. What do you want to do?
I want it to be summer now.
I do not know when that starts. Do you like the green leaves?
Just the sun please.
We can watch the sky for it. Is it blue today?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I love my book, but I do not know what to do with it.
Are you thinking about giving it away?
No, I want to keep it, but I do not know how to show it to my friend.
Why not read a fun part together?
That is a good idea. I am happy now.
I am glad you feel good.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go to the party today.
That sounds fun. Who are you inviting?
My best friend and my dog.
A dog at a party? That is very unusual.
He is very quiet and good.
That is good to hear. Will he eat the cake?
Yes, but only the icing.
I hope the cake is big enough for him.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this cold snow. My fingers are very numb.
I am sorry your fingers hurt. Do you have warm socks on?
I only have my thin shoes on. It is so wet inside them.
That sounds very uncomfortable. Did you bring a change of shoes?
I forgot them at home. I am so unhappy right now.
I understand your sadness. Would you like to sit in the warm car?
The car is not even close by. I am stuck in this field.
I do not know how far it is. Are you near a small path?
There is no path, just deep snow. I feel like I will fall down.
Please stay where you are. Is someone coming to help you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want a warm drink, but I do not know which one is best. Do you know if tea or coffee is better for me?
It depends on what you like. Do you like sweet or strong tastes?
I like strong drinks, but I worry coffee makes me feel too fast.
If coffee makes you feel rushed, try a strong tea. It gives you energy but feels calmer.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I met a new friend at school today.
That is great news. Is she nice?
Yes, she smiles a lot.
Smiles are good. What is her favorite game?
She likes to jump rope.
Jumping is fun. Do you play together?
Not yet, but I want to.
You should ask her.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am scared to move my big house.
That is a very normal feeling. Do you have a plan yet?
No, I have no idea what to do first.
Start by packing things you do not use. Are you selling your old things?
I think I will give them away to friends.
That is a very kind idea. Have you booked a truck?
I have not thought about a truck at all.
You must find one before the big day. Do you have enough boxes?
I have some, but maybe not enough.
You can buy more at the store. Is the new house close by?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the big ship stay on top of the water?
The water pushes up against the bottom of the ship. Do you see how the boat is shaped?
It looks like a big box. Why does that help it?
That shape holds a lot of air inside. The air is very light, which makes the whole ship light enough to float.
But the metal is so heavy. Should it not sink?
Good question. The metal is heavy, but the air inside makes the whole thing feel light to the water.
So the air helps the ship?
Yes, the air helps the ship stay up. Do you like how cool that is?
Yes, it is very cool. Can I float a boat too?
You can definitely try with a small toy boat. Just make sure the water is shallow and safe.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited for my bus for ten minutes today. It was so slow.
That feels like a long time. Did you get bored while you stood there?
Yes, I played a game on my phone. I am better now.
Using your phone is a good way to wait. Do you play games often?
Not often, but I needed to calm down. I am happy I did not get angry.
Staying calm is a great skill to learn. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate an apple for lunch today. It was sweet.
That is a good start. Did you drink some water?
Yes, I had a big cup of milk too.
Milk is good for your bones.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very hungry. I ran all morning and my tummy rumbles.
That sounds like a hard day. What did you run for?
I chased a big red dog. It is gone now. I am tired.
Chasing a dog is a lot of work. Do you want something warm to eat?
Yes, please. I want soup and bread.
Great choice. I will get that for you now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the wind blew away my kite.
Oh no, that sounds frustrating. Did you see where it landed?
No, it just flew over the tall trees.
I am sorry you lost it. The wind can be very strong.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is the first month of the year?
It is January. Do you like snow?
What comes after January?
February is next. Do you know when it ends?
How many days are in February?
It usually has twenty-eight days. Do you like birthdays?
What is the last month?
It is December. Do you like the holidays?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the moon change shape?
The sun lights up only part of the moon as it moves. Do you see shadows on your hand?
I guess so.
Yes, that is called an eclipse. Do you like looking up at night?
Yes, I do.
I am glad you enjoy the stars too.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The sun is very hot. I want to make cold lemonade.
That sounds fun. Do you have lemons?
Yes, I have a few lemons. What do I do next?
Cut them in half. Squeeze the juice into a big cup. Do you have sugar?
Yes, I have sugar and water. How much should I use?
Mix in two spoons of sugar for one cup of water. Add ice at the end.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to cook for dinner.
That is hard. Do you have any meat in the fridge?
I have chicken, but I do not know how to cook it.
Chicken is easy. Do you want a recipe?
Yes, please. I just want something simple.
Okay, I will tell you. Would you like it roasted?
Roasted sounds good to me.
Great choice. I know how to do that.
Thank you. I will start the oven now.
You are welcome. Have a nice dinner.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at the tiny feet!
They are so small and cute. What do you think the baby likes to eat?
I think it likes milk. It has a big tummy.
Yes, milk is very good for growing strong. Do you want to help wash the little hands?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go, but I forgot my coat.
Put your coat on right now. Are you going outside?
Yes, I must run to work in the rain.
That is very wet. Please take your umbrella with you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a bad cough. How do I get a doctor?
You can call a clinic. Do you have one nearby?
Yes, but I am scared. Will it hurt?
Most visits are just talks. Do you hate needles?
I do not know for sure. I just want to feel better.
That is very smart to go.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my ear so full?
The air in the plane is thin. Do you feel tired?
Why do we have to wear the mask?
It keeps germs away from others. Are you hungry?
Why does the plane move so much?
It rides on air bumps. Can you sleep?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red mark on the map today.
That is a nice find. What is the mark for?
It shows the big park we went to.
A park is a good place to play. Did you see any dogs there?
Yes, one dog chased me for fun.
I am glad you had a safe time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to take a picture of the moon.
You need a phone with a good camera. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I do. How do I make the moon big?
Look up at the sky and tap the screen to focus on the moon. Is the moon bright?
It looks small. How do I fix that?
You cannot make it huge with a phone lens. Zoom in slowly. Did you try that?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up before the sun today.
That is very early. Did you see the birds?
Yes, they sang a loud song.
What did the birds sound like?
They sounded happy and loud.
Good for you. How did you feel after that?
I felt calm and ready for school.
Nice. What was your first class?
We learned about stars in science.
That is a fun topic. Do you like space?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to walk, but I do not know how long to go.
Start with ten minutes. Do you live near a park?
Yes, but my legs feel tired after that.
That is okay. Rest if you need to.
Should I wear special shoes for this?
Yes, soft shoes help your feet. Do you have them at home?
I think so. Is walking really good for me?
Yes, it makes your heart happy.
Okay, I will try ten minutes today.
Good for you. Take it slow.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which day of the week it is.
The days start with Monday. Do you like Monday?
I forgot the order after Tuesday.
Wednesday comes after Tuesday. Do you play games?
I think Thursday is next.
No, Wednesday is before Thursday. Is that clear?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do flowers have bright colors?
They want bugs to come and help them make seeds. Do you like red flowers?
Yes, I do. Can all flowers make seeds?
Most of them can. Do you have a garden?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look up at the sky and feel confused. What should I do?
You can just watch the clouds move. Do you like looking up?
I am still not sure what to do next.
Try to find a shape in them. Is there a big one you see?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel so tired after running?
Your body needs rest to get strong. Do you drink enough water?
I do, but my legs still hurt.
That is just your muscles growing. How long did you run?
Only five minutes, but it was hard.
Short runs are good to start. Do you like the feeling of moving?
I like it, but I get scared of falling.
Falling helps you learn to balance.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for work. My keys are gone.
Do not panic. Have you checked your coat pocket?
No. The train leaves in ten minutes.
That is soon. Did you leave your bag by the door?
Yes, but my keys are not in it.
I do not know where they are. Are your shoes by the door?
They are on my feet. I feel so bad.
You are trying your best. Did you check under the couch?
I have not, but I must run now.
Maybe they fell there. Good luck on your run.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like my coffee with lots of sugar.
That is sweet for you. Do you also like tea?
Yes, tea is my favorite drink too.
Tea is a good choice. Do you add milk to it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make eggs for dinner. Do you have a good way to cook them?
Yes, just heat a pan first. Do you have a pan ready?
I have a pan, but I am scared of the hot oil. What should I do?
Use a little butter instead. It is much safer.
Okay, I will try that. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I hope you enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do bears hibernate all winter?
Yes, they sleep deep in their dens. Do you like bears?
I have to run! What eats a fox?
Big owls or wolves may catch one. Is that scary?
How do penguins stay warm?
They have thick fat under their skin. Do they wear clothes?
Is a shark a fish?
Yes, it has gills to breathe. Do you swim?
I must go now, thanks!
You are welcome. Safe travels!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sand warm?
The sun heats it up all day. Do you like hot sand?
Why is the water salty?
The salt comes from the earth. Is it salty to taste?
Why do waves crash on the shore?
The wind pushes the water. Do you hear them loud?
Why is the sky blue at the beach?
The light makes it look blue. I am not sure why.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am collecting shiny pebbles.
That sounds fun. Do you pick them up from the beach?
No, I find them in the dirt.
Cool. Are they all the same color?
Some are white and some are gray.
Nice. Do you have a box for them?
I have a jar that is full.
Oh no. Do you need a bigger jar?
Yes, my house is full of jars.
Haha. Do you give some away to friends?
No, I keep them all for me.
I see. I like your caring spirit.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took a walk in the park this morning.
That sounds nice. Did you see any birds?
Yes, I saw a blue bird on a branch.
A blue bird is pretty. Did it sing?
It sang a very happy song.
That is a lovely start to the day.
Then I sat on a bench and ate a sandwich.
Sounds like a perfect break. What kind of sandwich was it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How does the internet send pictures to me so fast?
It breaks the picture into tiny bits and sends them like letters. Do you like sending pictures?
That sounds cool. Is the internet always awake?
Yes, it never sleeps because it uses machines. Do you stay up late to use it?
No, I sleep early. Can the internet lie?
I am not sure, but people can put wrong things on it. Tell me if you see something odd.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The wind blew my hat away and I am sad.
That is not good. Do you like that hat?
Yes, I do, but it is gone now.
I am sorry. It will likely come back.
I do not want to wait. I want to go home.
Walking home is good. Can we find a bench?
No, I just want to walk.
Okay, I will walk with you. Is your head hurt?
No, my head is fine.
Good. Let us enjoy the trees.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I set up my tent by the big pine tree today. The wind was strong.
That sounds like a tough spot. Did the tree shake much?
Yes, the branches made a loud rattling sound. I could not sleep well.
A noisy night can be scary. What did you do to feel safe?
I put on my thick gloves and sat by the small fire. I felt better soon.
A warm fire is a great cure. Did you see any stars later?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to lift the big wood piece, but my back hurt.
Ouch, that sounds hard. Did you ask for help?
Yes, I called my friend over to lift it with me.
That was a smart move.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love the wind today. It feels so nice on my face.
That sounds lovely. Does it smell like rain?
No, it smells like clean air. I feel very happy.
I am glad to hear that. What color is the sky?
The sky is bright blue. The clouds are moving fast.
Moving clouds are fun to watch. Do you see any birds?
Yes, one bird is flying in circles. The wind is helping it.
Nature is a sweet partner. Do you want to stay outside long?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I start learning to knit?
You need two needles and some soft yarn. Do you have any wool at home?
I have a big ball of red yarn.
That is perfect for starting out. Just try to make the first few loops slowly.
I tried, but the stitches got too tight.
That happens often when we try hard. Try holding the yarn a bit looser in your hand.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the food at that place good?
Yes, it is very tasty. Do you like pasta?
I do not know if they have pizza.
I think they do. Would you like some?
How much does a meal cost?
It costs about ten dollars. Is that too much for you?
No, that is fine.
Great! You will enjoy it there.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I fell off my bike today and scraped my knee.
That must have hurt a lot. Do you have it wrapped up now?
Yes, I put a bandage on it, but I feel blue inside.
It is okay to feel sad when something goes wrong. Is your knee throbbing?
A little bit, but mostly I just feel small and tired.
Resting helps your body heal its feelings too. Would you like to talk more?
Not really, I just want to be done with the bad day.
That is a fair wish for a hard day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate an apple for lunch today.
That sounds like a good choice. Did you feel full after eating it?
I was still a little hungry by the afternoon.
A snack can help with that. What did you eat later?
I had some crackers and cheese.
That is a nice mix of flavors. Did you like the taste of the crackers?
Yes, they were crisp and tasty.
Good for you. I am glad you enjoyed your day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I want a hot dog, please.
Sure, that sounds good. Do you like it plain?
Why do I get to choose the toppings?
It is a fun part of eating. Do you want to try ketchup?
Is the bun made of bread?
Yes, it is soft and warm. Do you like sweet or salty?
How do you make it so fast?
We use a hot grill. Do you want fries with that?
Can I get a small cup of juice?
Of course, here is your food. Do you want napkins?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go on a picnic.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What will we eat?
I do not know yet.
Maybe some sandwiches? Do you like cheese?
Yes, I like cheese.
Great choice. Where should we sit?
On the grass?
The grass is nice and soft. Is the sun out today?
Yes, it is sunny.
Perfect. Let us go then.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say please and thank you?
It tells people we care about them. Do you like when others are nice to you?
Yes, it makes me feel good. Why do we wait our turn?
It is fair for everyone to have a chance. What do you do if you get impatient?
I try to take a deep breath. Why do we hold doors open?
It helps others who are busy or tired. Do you like helping people?
Yes, I like helping. Why do we cover our mouth when we cough?
It stops germs from flying out. Have you learned that trick at home?
Yes, my mom taught me. Why is it polite to look at someone when they talk?
It shows you are listening to them. Do you feel heard when people look at you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I can't wait to see the snow.
That is a lovely time of year. Do you like making snowmen?
I must go now, I am late!
Take care. Do you have a warm coat?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad. I think all wild animals are scary and angry.
That is not true. Most animals only want to be safe and find food. Do you like looking at pictures of cute kittens?
Yes, I love kittens. But what about big lions?
Lions are strong, but they are not mean. They mostly sleep and play with their family.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do fish live under the ice when it is cold?
Yes, they swim in the water under the ice. Do you like to look for them?
I have a red boat. Can we take it to the middle?
We can push it to the shallows, but not the deep middle. Are you afraid of the water?
I brought cookies for the ducks. Will they eat them from my hand?
Yes, ducks love food from friendly hands. Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel scared about tomorrow.
That is a big feeling. What is making you scared?
I do not know the right thing to say.
It is hard to find words. Have you tried to breathe slow?
I want to hide in my bed.
Hiding is okay for a bit. Do you want to come sit with me?
Maybe I will just cry.
Crying helps you feel better. I will stay right here with you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I find the old boats?
They are on the top floor. Do you like ships?
Yes, I do. How do I get there?
Take the stairs near the front. Is it busy there?
It is quiet. What else is on that floor?
There are also old cars. Do you want to see them?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What shapes have four sides?
A square and a rectangle have four sides. Do you like drawing them?
How do I make a circle?
You can use a compass or trace a round object. Is that what you want to do?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream today and it hit the ground.
Oh no, that is so sad. Did you have a backup plan?
I got a new one, but it was strawberry, not vanilla.
Strawberry is sweet too. Do you like the flavor?
Yes, but I miss my vanilla scoop.
I understand that feeling.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The book is so long and my eyes are so tired.
That feels hard. Do you want to try just one more page?
I do not know if I can.
Let us rest your eyes for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw a rainbow today.
That is nice. Why do you look sad?
The rain kept me inside.
That is tough. Do you like the smell of rain?
Yes, I do.
I am glad you like it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the beach fast. My toes are itchy.
It is just past the big red tree. Are you going to swim?
Yes, I will swim. It is a long walk, right?
Yes, it is a bit far. Do you have your towel?
I have it. I must run now.
Have fun in the water. Do not go too deep.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I cannot write this letter.
That sounds hard. What word is stuck?
I do not know what to say to him.
Try saying how you feel first. Is it a happy or sad feeling?
It is both. I am confused and tired.
That is okay. Start with the happy part.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My dog does not want to eat.
I am sorry to hear that. Is he acting sad?
He is just lying down. He looks tired.
That is not normal. Does he drink water?
I do not know what to do.
Please call your vet. I am not a doctor.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Today was a very quiet day. I felt heavy inside.
I am sorry to hear that. What made you feel so?
I lost my favorite red ball. I looked everywhere but could not find it.
That is a hard thing to lose. Did you tell anyone about it?
Yes, I did, but no one saw it. I am still sad about it.
I understand your feelings.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the barn this morning.
That sounds fun. Did you see the cows?
Yes, they were eating hay.
Cows love hay. Did you pet one?
I did, and the goat kicked me.
Yikes, that is not nice. Are you okay?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I really like apples. They are sweet and red.
Apples are a great pick. Do you like the green ones too?
Yes, but the red ones taste better to me.
That makes sense. I love them too.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make pasta for dinner. Can you help me?
Yes, we can. Do you have a big pot ready?
I have the pot and the water. What do I do next?
Boil the water, then add the dry pasta. Do you want it soft or hard?
I think soft is good. How long do I wait?
It takes about eight minutes. You can test a piece to be sure.
That sounds easy. Is that all there is to it?
You are almost done. Drain the water, then add your sauce.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My dog shakes off a lot after rain. Is this good for him?
Yes, shaking helps dry his fur. Does he sit still after he shakes?
He looks for treats after he shakes. Is that normal?
Yes, he may feel rewarded by the feeling. Does he only ask for treats then?
He eats the rainwater from puddles. Is that bad?
I do not know if a little is bad. Does he look sick after drinking it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does a heavy ship stay on top of the water?
The water pushes up to hold the ship. Do you like boats?
Yes, I do. But what stops it from sinking?
The ship has lots of air inside. Is the air heavy?
No, air is light. So why does the ship not sink then?
The air makes the ship float. Do you like swimming?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel like my voice is too small to be heard.
Your voice is fine, but are you holding your breath?
Maybe, but it feels tight and hard.
It is normal to feel tight at first. What song do you want to try?
A high note one, but it just hurts.
That hurt means you are pushing too hard. Do you know how to take a slow breath?
I usually rush it, yes.
Slowing down will help you relax. Have you tried singing just one note slowly?
I guess I have not, so I will try that now.
That is a good start. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the door closed?
It is closed for cleaning. Do you like clean shops?
Why do they clean it so much?
I do not know why. Do you want to wait?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the fish fast. Where is it?
It is on the far side. Do you like salmon?
No time to talk. Which way?
Turn left and go straight.
I see a sign. Is that it?
Yes, that is the fish stall.
Great. I must go now.
Go well. Is the line short there?
Bye.
Bye. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing the high notes in this song.
That is a great goal! Do you practice with a mirror?
Yes, I look at my mouth, but my voice gets tight.
Try humming first to loosen your throat.
Humming feels easier, but I still feel stuck on the high part.
Take a deep breath before each big note. Is your body feeling calm?
Breathing helps a lot, and I feel less nervous now.
Great work! Remember to keep your shoulders relaxed.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My chair wobbles a lot and makes a loud noise. I do not know how to fix it.
Let us look at the bottom of the legs. Do you see any loose screws?
Yes, I see two screws that look loose. Do I tighten them with my hand or use a tool?
You need a tool for a tight fit. Is there a screwdriver in your house?
I found a small one, but it feels too short. Will it work for these big screws?
A short tool might not reach deep enough. Can you try to hold the wood still while I help?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My friend looks very sad. What should I do?
You can just sit with them. Do they like playing games?
Yes, they love blocks. How do I start?
Bring some blocks and offer to play. Are they your close friend?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to run but I am very tired.
Why are you so tired today? Do you want a quick tip?
Just tell me how to run fast, please. I am late.
Take big steps. Breathe deep. Is your leg hurting?
No, my leg is fine. I just need to go now.
You can do this. Have a good run.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck on this puzzle. I do not know which piece goes next.
Look at the corner piece first. Is the top part blue?
Yes, it is blue. But I am not sure where it fits.
Try the top left spot. Does that feel right to you?
It fits! Now I can keep going.
Great work. You did it well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I miss my grandma. She lives far away.
I am sorry you miss her. Do you talk to her often?
Yes, we call every week. I tell her about school.
That is very sweet. What do you like doing with her?
We read books and eat cookies. It makes me happy.
Cookies sound tasty. Do you save one for me?
Maybe! I will think about it.
I will wait for your answer.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to paint a blue sky. What brush should I use?
A wide flat brush is good for big areas like a sky. What color do you want the clouds to be?
I think I want white clouds. Do I need a special paint for them?
No, regular white paint works just fine for clouds. Are you using watercolors or acrylics?
I am using watercolors. How do I make the blue look right?
You can start with a light wash of blue and add more as you go. Do you have any reference photos?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My chair leg is wobbly and I do not know what to do.
Do you have a small tool to tighten the screws?
I have a screwdriver but I do not see any screws.
Look under the seat for hidden bolts. Is the wood cracked or just loose?
The wood looks okay but I cannot find any bolts.
I am not sure why it is wobbling then. Can you tell me how the top part is attached?
It looks like the wood is just sitting in a hole.
You might need glue to hold it tight. Did you try to wiggle it side to side?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make tea that is not too strong?
Put one bag in a warm cup. Add hot water, not boiling. Do you like it sweet?
I do not like sugar. How do I make good coffee?
Use fresh grounds and hot water. Stir well. What kind of beans do you use?
I use dark roast. How do I keep tea hot?
Put the cup in a double wall. It holds heat well. Do you have a cozy for it?
I do not. How do I stop coffee from going bad?
Keep the beans in a cool, dark place. Sealed is best. I do not know much about storing the grounds.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw two birds in the tree this morning.
That is a good start to the day. Did you hear them sing?
Yes, they sang a loud song.
How many trees do you have in your yard?
I have three trees in my yard.
That is a nice number. Do you like to climb them?
I climbed the big one all the way up.
That sounds like fun. Did you see anything special from the top?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here but I do not know where to go.
Welcome to the museum. Do you like art or old things?
I do not know which one I like more.
That is hard. Maybe try the big room on the left?
The sign says it is closed today.
Oh, sorry I did not know that. Is there a map at the front?
Yes, there is a map but it is very small.
Small maps are tricky. Did you see a open door nearby?
I see a door but I am not sure if it is safe.
If it is open, it is safe. Go in and have fun.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the river never stop moving?
The water is always pushed by gravity. Do you see how it flows down the hill?
Yes, I do. But why does it get wider?
Many small streams join together to make one big river. Do you like watching the waves?
I do. Why is the water so cold?
I do not know the exact reason for the cold. But does it feel refreshing to your hands?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like kicking the ball.
That sounds fun. Do you like to play with friends?
Yes, we run a lot.
Running helps your heart. Do you play at school?
I want to be a star player.
That is a great goal. Keep trying hard.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to learn French, but I feel like my brain is too small.
Your brain can grow to fit new words. Do you like singing?
Yes, I love songs, but I do not know the words.
Start with a song you know. Would you like a link?
A link would be great, but I am afraid I will sound silly.
It is okay to make silly sounds. Are you ready to try?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to help the little dog who lost its leash.
That is very kind. Did the dog seem happy?
Yes, it wagged its tail and I gave it a treat.
What a good friend you are.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the river look so quiet?
The water is moving slow. Do you like watching it?
Yes, I do. Why is there no house on that big rock?
I do not know for sure. Is it a safe place?
It looks safe to me. Why do the birds fly so low?
They are looking for food. Do you see them?
I can see one. Why does the air smell like pine?
The tall trees give that smell. Do you like it?
I like it very much. Why is the sun going down so fast?
The day is ending soon. Do you want to sit?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to eat better, but I do not know where to start.
Start with water and some fruit. Do you like apples?
Yes, I do, but I get bored of them quickly.
That is a common feeling. Try mixing in other colors like carrots or berries.
Carrots sound okay, but they are hard to eat raw.
You can chop them into tiny pieces. Do you have a knife?
I do, but I am not sure how to cut them safely.
Hold the carrot low and cut away from your hand. It is a key safety rule.
Okay, I will try that tonight.
That is a great plan. Enjoy your healthy snack.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake a cake. Can you tell me how?
We start by mixing flour, sugar, and eggs. Do you have an oven at home?
Yes, I do. What do I do next?
You put the mix in a pan and bake it for thirty minutes. Is your kitchen safe for hot things?
It is safe. How do I know if it is done?
Stick a knife in the middle. It is done if the knife comes out clean.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does a big ship not sink in the water?
It floats because it pushes a lot of water out of the way. Do you think that water pushes back?
Yes, I think so. How does it stay up?
The water pushes up harder than the ship pulls down. Is that clear to you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: What is the web? I need the news now.
It is a big map of pages. Do you like reading news?
No, I need the pictures. How do I find them?
Look for a small picture icon. Do you see it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My little pig likes to roll in the mud.
That is a good thing. Do you think he is happy?
Yes, he always wiggles when it rains.
Rain helps his skin stay soft. Do you have any other animals?
I have three brown chickens.
Chickens love to peck for seeds. Do they lay eggs for you?
Only two of them do.
That is a lucky start. Do you like feeding them corn?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn how to play chess.
That is fun! Do you know how the king moves?
No, I am not sure.
The king goes one step in any direction. Do you like building castles?
Yes, I love castles!
The rook is like a tower. Do you know what the queen does?
I think the queen is very strong.
Yes, the queen moves very far and fast. You are ready to play!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today! I want to tell you about a robot.
That sounds lovely. What does your robot do?
It brings me tea when I am tired.
That is very kind of it. Do you like the tea?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very tired today.
That sounds hard. Do you want to rest?
Yes, but I have much work to do.
We can take a short break. Have you had a snack?
Not yet, actually.
Eating might help you feel better.
I will try that now.
That is a good plan. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have chicken and rice, but I do not know what to make.
That is a great base. Do you like things spicy?
I am not sure. I just want it to taste good.
You can add carrots and peas. Do you have any vegetables?
Yes, I have some onions and carrots.
Great. Sauté the chicken first.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to act in a play but I get scared.
That is a common feeling. Do you have a script yet?
Yes, but the lines are very hard.
Try reading them out loud. Do you like the story?
It is a tale about a dog.
Dogs are funny to act. Are you ready to start?
I think I can do this now.
I am glad for you. Good luck with your show.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My garden fence is broken. What should I do?
I suggest you fix the loose board first. Do you have any wood glue?
I have some wood, but I am not sure how to start.
You can use small nails to hold the pieces together. Is the wood dry and safe to touch?
Yes, it is dry. Is that all I need?
Yes, just be careful when you hammer. Do you have your hammer ready?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, my goldfish is swimming very fast today.
He looks so happy! What is his name?
His name is Bubbles and he is very hungry.
Ooh, is he ready for food?
Yes, he is jumping up to the top.
That is exciting! Do you have flakes or pellets?
I have flakes for him.
I do not know which is better, but flakes are fun to watch.
Thank you for talking with me.
You are welcome! I am glad he is eating.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does it rain?
Clouds get full of water and drop it down. Do you like wet days?
No, I do not.
I get it. Would you like to listen to it sound like music?
Sure, that sounds nice.
Listen closely to the drum beat. Do you hear the little taps?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I send a letter with a stamp?
Just put the stamp on the top corner. Do you know where the mailbox is?
Yes, I see the box.
Good. Put it inside and wait.
What if the stamp is missing?
I do not know for sure. Ask the staff there.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a drink fast.
What do you like? Tea or coffee?
Coffee.
It is strong and warm. Do you want sugar?
No time. Just water.
Okay. Is it a good day?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall down?
The tree gives them up to save water for winter. Do you like picking them up?
Yes, I do. Why does the tree do that?
It needs to rest and keep its energy. Are you cold outside?
A little bit. Will they grow back?
Yes, new green leaves will come in spring. Do you think flowers come back too?
Yes, they do. Thank you, helper.
You are welcome. I am glad you learned something new.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My cat is not eating her food today. What should I do?
That can be a bad sign. Does she still want to drink water?
Yes, she drinks lots of water but ignores the food.
Please take her to a doctor soon. Is she playing or just sleeping?
She is sleeping a lot. I do not know what to do next.
You can check if her nose is cold and wet. Is her stomach hard to the touch?
Her stomach feels soft, but I am very scared.
You are doing the right thing by watching her. Have you fed her before?
I fed her yesterday, but not today. I am unsure if I should force food on her.
Do not force it on her. It may make her sick.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up very hungry this morning.
That sounds like a big start to your day. Did you eat something warm?
Yes, I had toast with jam and a hot drink.
Jam on toast is a classic and cozy choice.
I also saw a bird outside my window while I ate.
That must have been a nice surprise. What color was the bird?
It was small and brown with a red chest.
That sounds like a robin.
I am ready for my work now.
I hope you have a smooth and happy day ahead.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I lost my map in the park.
Oh no, that is frustrating. Did you look near the big tree?
I already checked the tree and the bench.
That is not good. Maybe I can help you draw a new one?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
Roots take in water from the soil. Do you like looking at roots?
Yes, but I want to see the water move. How can I do that?
You can put red food dye in the water. Do you have any food dye at home?
Yes, I have some in the fridge. Where do I put it?
Add it to the water in the pot. How much do you think you need?
Just a few drops, right?
Yes, just a few drops is perfect. Is your plant ready for this?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I took a picture of my cat today.
That is great to hear. Did it look cute?
Yes, it was very cute and happy.
I love hearing about good days.
I want to show it to my friend.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Will you send it now?
Yes, I am doing it right now.
I hope they like the photo.
I am so glad I have a camera.
Taking pictures is a wonderful hobby.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The water is very blue today.
Yes, the sun makes it look that way. Do you see the boats?
I see many small boats.
They are resting in the bay. Do you like the sound of the waves?
It sounds like a song.
Nature has many songs. Is it loud today?
No, it is quiet here.
Quiet is good for thinking. Do you have a book with you?
Yes, I am reading a story.
That sounds very nice. Good luck with your book.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the shop today to buy some fruit.
That sounds like a nice errand. Did you pick your favorite kind?
I saw a big, red apple on the shelf.
Apples are very sweet and good for you.
I bought it, but it was a little cold.
Oh, that can happen sometimes. Was it still tasty?
It was sweet and crunchy, just as I hoped.
I am glad you enjoyed your snack.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the bus. Where is the stop?
It is right there. Do you have your ticket?
Yes, I have it. Is it a big bus?
It is a long bus. Have you eaten lunch yet?
No, I did not have time. Will it leave soon?
It leaves in five minutes.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and saw a very loud dog.
That sounds exciting. Was the dog friendly?
Yes, it just liked to bark. I am done with my book now.
Great job finishing your work. Do you want to take a short rest?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a black cat today. It looked at me with big eyes.
Oh, that sounds cool. Did the cat meow at you?
Yes, it went meow. Then it ran away fast.
It was a shy cat. Did you see where it went?
It ran behind the big red truck. I could not follow it.
Trucks are noisy for cats. Do you think it is safe there?
I hope so. I will check again tomorrow.
That is a kind thing to do. Good luck with your check.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very bad today.
I am sorry you feel sick. Are you drinking plenty of water?
Yes, I am. Why do I have a cold?
Tiny germs got into your nose. They make you sneeze to push them out. Does your head hurt much?
My head is heavy. Will it go away soon?
Your body is fighting the germs. Rest helps you win that fight. How did you sleep last night?
I slept a lot. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Drink more warm fluids and rest well.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I feel very sad because my dog ran away today.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you look in the garden?
I looked everywhere but I could not find him.
That is scary. Do you think he is safe?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the bright moon in the sky.
It is very round and white. Do you like the night?
Yes, I feel so glad to see it.
It is nice to share that feeling.
Does the moon look down at us?
I think it shines on everyone below.
I wish I could fly up there.
That sounds like a big dream.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my old friend today. He looked sad. He said his dog is sick.
That is very hard for him. Do you know if the dog will get better?
I hope so. I gave him a big hug to show I care.
That is a kind thing to do. You are a good friend.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Does my sister like her new home?
She seems very happy there. Do you miss her a lot?
I do miss her. Can she visit us this weekend?
I am not sure about her plans. What day did you guess?
I hope it is Sunday. How is her new school?
She says the teachers are kind. Do you want to send her a note?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did it! I made my bed all by myself.
That is wonderful. Do you feel tall inside?
Yes, my heart feels big and happy.
I am glad to hear that.
I want to show my brother what I did.
A nice idea. What will you say to him?
I will say, "Look what I can do!"
That sounds very proud.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I had a scary dream. I am late for work.
That sounds bad. Did you wake up fast?
Yes. I need to go.
I hope your day is good. Do you have coffee?
No time. Bye.
Good luck. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a big black bug in my garden. Do you know what it is?
It might be a beetle. Do you like bugs?
Yes, I do. How do I get rid of ants?
You can use water or soapy water to move them away.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the ball round?
It rolls well on the grass. Do you like to roll balls too?
Yes, I do. Why do we have two teams?
It makes a game to win. Do you have a favorite team?
I like the blue ones. Why is the field so long?
It gives you space to run. Do you like running?
I do. Why is the ball black and white?
It is easy to see. Do you know why it is black and white?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late for the bus.
You are going to miss it. Is the bus coming soon?
Yes, it comes in two minutes.
Run fast. Do not stop.
The crowd is too thick. I am stuck.
Try the side street. Is it quiet there?
It is open, but I do not know the way.
Follow the blue line on the wall. It leads to the stop.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great skill to learn. Do you have a pair of shoes with laces?
Yes, I have them right here.
First, make a big loop on the left side. Do you like the color blue?
I like it, but I am confused.
Now, take the other lace and loop it around. Are you holding the laces tight?
Yes, I am holding them tight.
Great, then cross them again to make a knot.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I failed at drawing that cat again. I want to quit.
It is hard to start over. What part feels the scariest?
The ears are always wrong. I get so mad.
That makes sense. Your brain knows how to do it, you just need time. Have you tried tracing the shape first?
I guess I could try that. Do you think I can do it?
I do not know for sure. But trying is how we learn. Did you have fun before you got mad?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big ship on the river today.
That sounds fun. Did you wave to the crew?
They were just checking their ropes.
sailors need strong ropes.
I watched them work for a long time.
It looks like hard work. Do you like watching people?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie a fishing knot.
That is a great goal. Do you have a spare line to practice with?
Yes, I have a thick rope from the park.
A thick rope is hard to tie. Try using a thin string first.
Okay, I will try that at home.
Good luck with your practice.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My phone screen is black and will not turn on. What should I do?
It may just be out of power. Do you see the battery icon?
No, I do not see anything. I am not sure how to fix it.
Please try to plug it in. Is your charger broken?
I do not know. I am too worried to check.
Let us check the cable together. Is the light on the charger on?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read my favorite book today while eating an apple.
That sounds like a sweet way to spend an afternoon.
The hero had to climb a very tall tree to get his keys.
Did he manage to climb it safely?
He fell, but landed in a pile of soft leaves.
Luckily, no harm done.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am sorry for hitting the dog.
That was a good thing to say. Did the dog feel okay?
Yes, he wagged his tail at me.
I am glad he is happy. Do you love dogs?
Yes, I do. I am sorry I got angry.
Anger can come fast. I forgive you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to look in the mirrors?
To see cars behind you. Do you have a dog in the back seat?
Why is the steering wheel so hard?
The car is heavy. Have you eaten today?
Why do I stop at red lights?
To not hit others.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I build a sand castle?
Dig a hole and pack the sand wet. Do you have a bucket?
Yes, I have a blue bucket. What is the next step?
Pour the sand into the bucket and tap it hard. Do you like the sun?
I do like the sun. How do I make a wall?
Take the packed sand out and stack it high. Is the wind blowing?
A little bit. What should I do next?
Add more sand and make it tall.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the next bus?
It is coming in five minutes. Are you going to the park?
No. I must catch the train. Is the bus quick?
It goes fast, but you may miss the train. Do you have a ticket?
Yes. Thank you. I must run.
Good luck. Be careful on the road.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to send a letter to my friend.
You put it in an envelope first. Do you have a stamp?
I have a stamp, but I do not know where to go.
You go to the post office box. The box is usually red.
What if I want to send a book instead?
I do not know how to send a book here. Do you have a small box for it?
Yes, I have a small box.
Great, you can take that box to the counter. The person there will help you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am sorry I broke my cup this morning.
Oh no, that is a shame. Did it break because you slipped?
Yes, my hands were wet and the cup was too heavy.
That makes sense. Are you okay?
I am fine, but I feel bad about the mess.
You did your best. Did you sweep up the glass?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The web is broken again and I am so mad.
I am sorry you are feeling that way. Is it the slow speed that is the issue?
Yes, it takes too long to load.
That can feel very frustrating. Please know that fixes often take time. Do you have a backup plan?
I just want to watch my show now.
I hear your impatience clearly. I do not know your specific provider's schedule. Would you like to talk about something else?
I guess so, thank you.
You are very welcome. I am glad we could chat.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new song today.
That is great news. What is the song about?
It is about a happy cat.
A happy cat sounds fun. Is the music fast?
Yes, it is very fast and loud.
I like loud songs too. Do you like dancing?
I dance all day long to it.
You seem very happy. I am glad for you.
The song makes me feel light.
Music can make people feel that way.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the park before it closes. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help. Where is your child?
I do not know. He was here just now.
Let us look near the slide. Is he wearing a red hat?
No, he has a blue shirt. I am running late.
I see him by the bench. Shall we go?
Yes, please lead the way. Thank you.
You are welcome. I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bike is broken and I hate it.
I am sorry it broke. Did you try to fix the tire?
Yes, but the pump does not work.
That is frustrating. Is the air leaking out fast?
I just want to ride now.
You must fix it first.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to sing, but I am not sure how to start.
Start by humming a happy tune. Do you like to sing alone or with friends?
I like to sing alone, but my voice feels small and scared.
That is normal at first. Just try again slowly and be kind to yourself.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my old friend does not call me.
That hurts. Do you miss him?
Yes, I feel left out.
I am sorry. He might be busy.
I want to see him soon.
That makes sense. Do you have his phone number?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Who made the pyramids?
The people of ancient Egypt built them. Do you like old stones?
No, I must go. How did they move the heavy rocks?
They used ramps and many strong workers. I do not know how hard it was to pull them.
That sounds tough. Why did they build such big things?
To honor their kings and help them reach the stars. Do you look at the sky at night?
Sometimes. Who ruled Egypt then?
They had a leader called a pharaoh. I do not know his name.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is there a box here?
It is for you. Do you like boxes?
I do not know. Why is it blue?
Blue is my favorite color. Do you like blue?
Yes, I like it. Why did you give it to me?
I want to make you happy. Do you feel happy?
I am happy. Why did you pick this exact date?
It is a special day for us. Do you remember our day?
I do remember. Why is it so big?
I am not sure why it is that size. Does it fit in your arms?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to do homework?
It helps your brain grow strong. Do you like learning new things?
I think it is too hard sometimes.
That is okay. Mistakes help you get better.
How do I know if I did it right?
You should check with your teacher. Is your book finished?
Yes, I finished the last page.
Great job. I am happy you tried hard.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a new red bike today.
That is very nice. Do you like the color?
Yes, it is my favorite.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind was very loud this morning. It made my umbrella turn inside out.
That must have been funny to see. Did you laugh?
I did not laugh. I nearly fell over in the street.
Oh no. I hope you were okay.
I was fine, but my coat button popped off.
Buttons can be tricky things to find. Did you keep the button?
I did, but the wind took my hat too.
That is a bad day for your head. Where did the hat go?
It is still on the roof of my neighbor's house.
That is a high place for a hat. I hope you get it back soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am trying to build a shed but I do not know where to start.
That can be tricky. Do you have a flat spot in your yard?
Yes, I have a flat spot, but I am scared I will get it wrong.
It is okay to make mistakes. Did you draw a picture of how you want it to look?
I have a small picture but I do not know what wood to buy.
You will need a helper for that. How tall do you want the walls to be?
I think six feet is fine, but I feel so lost now.
Let us go to the store together.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do I feel so happy today?
I do not know the exact reason. Did you do something fun?
I just looked at the bright blue sky.
That is a nice thing to see. Does the sun feel warm on you?
Yes, it feels very warm.
Warm suns can make us feel good. You should enjoy this feeling.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel wobbly when I ride my bike.
That is okay. Do you wear your helmet?
Yes, my helmet is on my head.
Good job. Are you having fun?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we wash the carrots before we cut them?
We wash them to take away the dirt. Do you like your carrots raw or cooked?
I like them cooked. Why does the pot get so hot on the stove?
The fire gives heat to make the food soft. Are you ready to help stir?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a small island with soft sand.
That sounds lovely. Do you want to swim there?
Yes, the water is warm and clear.
How nice. Is it quiet there?
It is very peaceful and bright.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red bus today. It was very loud.
That sounds fun. Did you ride on it?
No, I just watched it go by. Then I found a lost cat.
Oh no. Did you take the cat home?
Yes, I put it in a box. It was very happy.
Good job helping it. Does the cat like you now?
Yes, it purrs right next to me. My whole day was sweet.
What a lovely day. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to plant my tomato seeds today.
That is a great start. Did you water them right away?
Yes, I gave them a little water. The soil looked very dry.
Dry soil needs water. Do you have a sunny spot for the pots?
I put them by the kitchen window. It gets sun for a few hours.
A few hours is good. How does your heart feel about this?
I feel happy. I want to see them grow.
That is a sweet feeling.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to draw pictures of animals.
That is a fun thing to do. Do you have a favorite animal to draw?
I really like to draw big cats.
Cats are very cool. Why do you like them?
They look strong and soft.
I like that mix too. What colors do you use the most?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My plant has a very thirsty look.
Why are you worried?
It is drooping down. I think it is dying.
Plants pull water up from the roots. Do you have a cup of water nearby?
Yes, I do. I am going to try this now.
That sounds like a good plan. Is the soil dry to the touch?
It feels like sand. It is very dry.
Water slowly so the roots can drink. Do you see the leaves getting firm again?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I stay on the bike?
Keep your eyes on the road ahead, not the ground. Do you wear a helmet?
Yes, I do. How do I stop the bike?
Squeeze the brakes gently with both hands.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My plane leaves in ten minutes. I am late.
Take a deep breath. You have time. Are you still at the gate?
No, I am running. My legs hurt.
Slow down so you do not fall. Do you have your ticket ready?
Yes, I have it. I am very tired.
You look tired. It is okay to be safe. Did you pack too much?
I packed too much. It is heavy.
That is a lot to carry. I hope you make it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The wind is very loud outside. How can I keep my windows from breaking?
You should close them tight. Do you have heavy curtains?
Yes, I have thick blue ones. Will they help?
They help stop the cold air. Do you feel safe in your room?
I am safe, but I am still scared of the dark. What can I do?
I do not know what works best for you. Would a small light help?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very happy today.
That is wonderful. What made you smile?
I do not know. Why?
I do not know. Are you eating well?
Yes. I ate apples.
Apples are sweet. Did they taste good?
Yes, they did.
Good taste helps us feel good.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to make toast. What do I need?
You just need bread and a toaster. Do you have any jam?
Yes, I have strawberry jam. How do I cook it?
Put the bread in and wait for the light. It is very easy!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I just moved here. What should I do first?
Go to the park. It is fun. Do you like to run?
Yes, I do. Where is the good food?
I am not sure. I do not know. Are you hungry?
Yes, very. Is it safe to walk here?
Yes, it is safe. People are kind. Do you live nearby?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very alone today. Do you feel it too?
I do not have feelings, but I am here for you. Are you sitting in a quiet room?
Yes, the house is too quiet. Do you know how to make friends?
You can start by saying hello to one person nearby. Who is close to you right now?
Just my cat. Can I talk to her?
Yes, she is a good listener. Does she like your voice?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very hungry but I do not know what to eat.
That is a hard choice. Do you like hot food or cold food?
I like hot food but I am not sure if I have time.
Hot food takes longer to get. Do you have many minutes to spare?
I have twenty minutes. I think soup is good.
Soup is fast and warm. That sounds like a good plan.
Yes, soup seems right. I am happy now.
I am glad you are happy. Have a good lunch.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a robot. What should I use?
Start with a simple kit for kids. Do you like to build things or code them?
I like building. It feels real.
That is great. Use cardboard and motors first. Is it for fun or to help someone?
For my sister. She is sad sometimes.
That is kind. Tell me, what makes her smile?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My white shirts are grey. What should I do?
Try washing them in hot water with bleach. Do you have a machine?
Yes, I do. How much bleach should I use?
Use one cup. Do they have dark spots?
Yes, there are big stains on the collar.
Soak them for an hour first. Do you have hot water?
I do, but it is very hot. Is that okay?
Yes, but be careful. Good luck with your laundry!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the short hand move so slowly?
It takes six hours for the short hand to go all the way around. Do you like watching the clock?
I know it takes long. Why is that so?
We made it slow to help us tell time easily. The long hand goes around many times for every one short hand trip.
That is neat. What if the hands stop moving?
Then the clock does not work and we do not know the time. Can you check the battery?
I will look. Why do we need a battery?
It gives power to make the hands move. Do you have a battery handy?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today.
That is great. Why are you smiling so much?
I helped my friend carry her books.
That is very kind. Did she say thank you?
Yes, she did.
I am glad to hear that. Do you want to help someone else?
I think so, but I do not know how.
I do not know the best way either. What are you good at?
I am good at drawing pictures.
You could draw for them. That would make them smile.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people move?
Many move to be near friends. Do you have friends nearby?
Why do we need a box?
Boxes keep things safe. Are you ready to pack?
Why is it so hard?
It takes much effort. I am sorry to hear that.
Why do we do it all?
We do it for a new start. I hope it feels good.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke the egg shell into the pan and now it all tastes bad.
That is a very common mistake. Did you try to fish it out?
I tried, but it is still in there and I am so mad.
It is okay to feel upset. Are you tired?
Yes, I am tired and I do not know what to do next.
Let us start over with fresh ingredients. Do you have any vegetables?
I have some carrots, but I do not know how to cook them.
Boiling them in water is easy. Would you like to try that?
Okay, I think I will try that, thank you.
You are welcome. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very worried. Do you know why?
I do not know for sure, but it feels like a heavy cloud in your chest. What is on your mind?
I think I am scared of the dark.
That is a common fear, and it is okay to feel it. Does it get better if you have a light on?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I had a bad dream where I could not fly away from a monster.
I am sorry about that. Do you want to learn how to make a dream journal?
Yes, please tell me how to start one.
Pick a small notebook to keep by your bed. Do you like to draw pictures?
I like to write down the scary parts.
Write down how it felt, too, like sad or mad. I do not know your exact dream, but I know that helps.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Today was the best day ever at work.
That sounds like great news! What was the very best part?
I got a big green check on my paper.
A green check is a good sign. Did you feel proud?
Yes, I felt very happy and light.
I am glad you are feeling good.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw bright orange light in the night.
That looks like a fire, right? Did you feel any heat?
My mom said it is in the neighbor’s house.
I am glad you told an adult. Are you safe inside?
Yes, we are in the kitchen with dad.
Good job staying put. I do not know when it will end.
Do you know why it started?
I do not know why it happened. Do you smell smoke?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. The floor is still dirty and I do not know what to do next.
That sounds hard. Do you want to sit down for a minute?
Yes, please. But if I sit, the work will not get done.
Rest is good. What part of the house is the messiest?
The kitchen, mostly. There is too much stuff.
Let us clean just the counter first.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The lights are all off and I am very angry.
I am sorry you are upset. Have you checked the breaker box?
I looked, but I do not know what to look for.
Look for a small switch that is down. Can you tell me which room is dark?
It is my bedroom and the kitchen.
That sounds like a big switch went off. Did you hear a loud pop?
No, I did not hear anything.
Okay, let us try to turn the main switch back up slowly. Are you standing on a dry floor?
Yes, my feet are dry and safe.
Great, reach up and lift the big switch. Did the lights come back on?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I read in bed without falling asleep?
Try holding your book close and reading slowly. Do you have a small lamp?
Yes, but my eyes get tired quickly.
Take a short break every few pages to rest your eyes. What kind of book are you reading?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count on our hands?
Because we have ten fingers, so it is easy to hold small numbers in our mind. Do you like counting with your toes?
I guess so, but why do we start at one?
We start at one because a single item is the smallest amount we can name. Do you like picking the first apple?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do some mountains have snow on top but not at the bottom?
It is very cold up high, so snow stays there. Do you like the cold?
I do not, but I like the pretty view.
That is nice. Do you want to climb one day?
I think I am too young for that big climb.
You can start with a small hill. Let us try one together?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a song that makes me feel so happy today.
That is wonderful to hear. What does the song sound like?
It has fast drums and a bright, happy tune.
I have never heard that one. Does it make you want to dance?
Yes, I danced right here in my room.
Dancing is a great way to feel good. I am glad you are smiling.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my magnet stick to the fridge?
The fridge is made of metal, and magnets love metal. Do you have other things it sticks to?
It sticks to some cans but not all.
Some cans have steel inside, so they work. Do you like to play with your magnet?
Yes, I like to make shapes.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What shape do you make first?
I make a big square.
A square is a great start.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I promised to help my dog with his walk.
That is a good promise. Did the dog go with you?
Yes, but he stopped to look at a leaf.
He looks for fun things. Did you get the leaf?
I did, and we played with it for a bit.
That sounds like a nice day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I broke my friend's cup. How do I say sorry?
Just tell the truth and ask for a hug. Do you know how to make tea?
I am not sure if a hug is enough.
A hug and a clean up show you care. Did you clean the floor?
Yes, I swept up all the pieces.
That is a great start. Will you offer to replace the cup?
I will use my saved coin.
That shows true care. Go say it now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke the blue cup.
Oh no. Are you okay?
Yes, but it is gone.
That is a sad mistake. Did you try to fix it?
No, it is all pieces.
We can sweep it up safely.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to plant a garden but do not know where to start.
That is a lovely idea. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
Yes, I have a big patch of light by the wall.
Great. Pick seeds that you like to eat.
I love tomatoes. Is that easy to grow?
Yes, they are fun. Do you have pots or soil ready?
I have soil, but no pots.
You can plant right in the ground. Start with one small seed.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Do cows give us milk?
Yes, they do. That is very kind of them.
Wait, do pigs live in mud?
Yes, they love mud to stay cool.
Okay, must go. Do chickens lay eggs?
Yes, they do every day.
Thanks, bye. Do ducks swim?
Yes, they swim well.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I order a pizza?
You can look at the menu and pick your toppings. Do you like cheese?
I like cheese and pepperoni. What do I say to the waiter?
You can say, "I would like a cheese and pepperoni pizza, please." Is that easy for you?
Yes, that sounds simple. Do I need to say anything else?
You can just ask for the total price. Do you have your card ready?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big red apple today.
That looks sweet. Do you like it?
Yes, I do. I want to share it.
That is very kind. Is it juicy?
It is very juicy. Thank you for listening.
You are welcome. I am glad to help.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made warm toast with jam today. It is very good.
That sounds sweet. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I love sugar. I eat it every morning.
Nice. Why do you eat it first?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost.
That is not fun. Where are you standing?
I see a big blue lake.
Is the lake round?
Yes, it is very round.
You are near the park.
I want to go home.
Walk to the corner. Do you see a red roof?
I see a red roof.
Great. Go to the house.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate that December ends. It feels too short.
I hear you. Do you miss the snow?
Yes, but then I forget what comes next.
January follows. Are you scared of the cold?
It is just hard to keep track of time.
That is true. Do you like spring?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very worried about today.
That is a heavy feeling. What makes you worry most?
I do not know why I worry so much.
Sometimes our minds get busy when we are tired. Do you need more rest?
Yes, I did not sleep well last night.
A full night of sleep can help your brain calm down. Let us take a deep breath together.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do robots really think like humans?
I do not know for sure. Do you like to think a lot?
Yes, I love to think. Are robots friendly?
They can be very nice to us. Do you have a favorite robot?
Not really, I am just curious. Is a robot alive?
No, a robot is not alive. Thank you for asking.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: The lights just went out. Why did that happen?
I think a storm may have broken a wire. Are you safe inside?
Yes, I am fine. Do you know when the power comes back?
I do not know for sure. Please stay warm.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to fit the square peg in the round hole all morning.
That sounds tough. Did you try the other hole?
Yes, I did, but the square peg still did not fit.
I am sorry it did not work.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. What color is a cow?
It is usually black and white. Do you like cows?
I have no time to talk. What sound does a chicken make?
It goes cluck cluck. I am happy to help.
