talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it sunny outside?
Yes, the sun is shining bright. Do you like warm days?
Yes, I do. But it is very hot.
It is hot today. Are you drinking enough water?
I am thirsty. Where is the park?
The park is near your house. Would you like to play there?
I am going now.
Have fun. I hope you have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure how to start building my shed.
Do you have a plan drawn on paper? Let us look at it together.
No, I just have a pile of wood.
That is hard. Can you tell me what shape you want?
I think I want a square one.
A square is a good start. Do you have a hammer and nails?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a funny cat on the bus today. It sat right in my lap.
That is very sweet. Did you get a picture of the cat?
No, but I gave it a small piece of cheese. The driver was smiling too.
You were so kind to the animal. That sounds like a happy day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. I thought you planned a surprise for me.
I am so sorry you feel that way. Did you want a big surprise?
Yes, I wanted something fun. I feel let down.
I did not know you felt this hurt. Can we fix it?
Only if you really want to help me now.
I do want to help you. What would make you smile?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late today and spilled my juice.
Oh no, that sounds messy. Did you clean it up?
Yes, my mom helped me. Then we ate cake.
That is a happy way to end a rough start.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a song that makes me feel so happy.
That sounds like a great feeling. What makes the music feel so good?
It has a fast beat and a very loud drum.
I like songs with big drums too. Do you know who made the song?
No, I do not know the name of the singer.
You can look it up on your phone. I bet you will like the name.
I will try to find it later.
Take your time with it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see old ships today. Where should I go?
The second floor has many big boats. Do you like looking at maps?
I do not care about maps. I want to touch things.
You can touch the models in the small room. Do you have gloves with you?
No, I do not have gloves. Is that a problem?
It is not a problem for the models. It is a problem for the real swords.
What can I do if I do not have gloves?
You can look through the glass boxes.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sky is so bright with stars tonight. I feel so happy looking at them.
They do look lovely. Do you see any that look like shapes?
Yes, I see a big bowl. I think it is the Great Bear.
That is a nice trick of the eye. Do you like telling stories about the stars?
I love sharing what I see. It makes the night feel warm.
That is a kind thing to do. Sharing often makes the joy bigger.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not know how to add the big numbers for my math sheet.
That can be hard, but you can count on your fingers to help. What numbers are you trying to add?
I have five apples and someone gave me three more, but I am confused.
You can draw pictures of the apples to see how many you have in total.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not know how to wash my dirty shirt.
Put the shirt in the machine with a little soap. Do you like using cold water?
Yes, I put it in. How long does it take to finish?
It takes about thirty minutes. What color is your shirt?
It is blue. Can I put it in the dryer now?
Yes, you can dry it on low heat.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the moon full?
Yes, it is bright and round. Do you like looking up?
No time. Is it far away?
Very far, yes. Is your trip close by?
Almost there. Can I see it from here?
Look up. You will see it soon. Drive safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to send a letter to my friend. Do I need a stamp?
Yes, you do. Is your letter for a friend nearby or far away?
It is for a friend who lives in the next town.
That is close. You only need one small stamp.
I have a big package too. Where do I put it?
You must take it to the front counter. Is it heavy?
It has books in it. Where do I find the right stamp?
The small blue counter sells stamps. Do you want to send it fast?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do I make the web go faster?
Try closing extra tabs. Do you have a slow computer?
Yes. It is very slow. What else can I do?
Restart your router. Do you know how to do that?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I wanted a dog, not a doll.
I am sorry you feel sad. What do you like about dogs?
They run and play outside.
That sounds like fun. Do you miss them?
Yes, I just want a friend.
A doll can be a friend too. Do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I won the card game today! It was so much fun.
That sounds exciting! Did you have a good hand?
Yes, I had the highest cards in the whole deck.
Wow, that is great. Who did you play against?
I played with my best friend from school.
That is a nice memory. Do you want to play again soon?
Yes, I want to win again to be sure.
You look very confident today.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a quick tip to sleep better. I am late.
Try a warm bath before bed. Do you like baths?
Yes, but I am in a big rush.
Then just drink warm milk. Do you have milk?
No, I do not have time for that.
Then turn off all your lights. Do you have a dimmer switch?
No, just an on-off switch.
Close your eyes and breathe slowly. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I watched the sun move across the sky. The hands on my clock ticked all afternoon.
That is a nice way to see time pass. Do you like watching the hands move?
The clock tells me when to eat. It also tells me when the light gets dark.
Yes, clocks help us keep a steady routine. I am glad you have one.
I wonder what makes the hands move so fast. It feels like time is a busy little runner.
A spring inside the clock gives the power to move the hands. Do you like running too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a rainbow today and it made me feel very happy. Do you have any tips on how to see them more often?
That sounds lovely. Have you tried looking right after a rain shower?
Yes, but I am not sure where to look. Do you know the best time of day?
I am not sure about the exact time, but try facing the sun. Did you bring a camera with you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a puzzle with no start.
That is interesting. Is it a circle?
Yes, it just keeps going round and round.
So there is no end either?
No, I can never finish it.
Maybe you should just enjoy the ride.
But I want to win the prize.
Winning is not the only fun part.
I guess that might be true.
Do you have a favorite piece?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to run, but my legs hurt a lot.
That sounds tough. Do you stretch before you run?
Yes, but it still hurts.
Rest for a few days. Do you have bad shoes?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I dropped my big magnet on the floor.
Oh no, that can be bad. Did it hit a metal thing?
No, it hit the rug.
Then it should be fine. Is it still holding the fridge door?
Yes, it sticks to the door.
Good, that is a great sign. You can keep using it.
I feel a little better now.
I am glad to help. Do you have any other magnets?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the lake so big?
It holds a lot of water. Do you think it is deep?
Why is the water blue?
The sky makes it look that way. I do not know for sure.
Why do the birds fly over it?
They look for fish to eat. Do you see any?
Why is the water so quiet?
The wind is still today.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a box with no tag. I do not know who it is for.
That is a nice mystery. Do you see a name on the side?
No, there is only a red ribbon. Should I open it?
I think yes. It feels happy to open.
I am still a bit scared to break it. What if it is broken?
Boxes can be fixed. Be gentle and look inside.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The moon is all gone and I cannot see it at all.
I am sorry. Do you like looking at stars too?
I only want the moon. It feels like a friend who left me.
It is just hidden by day. The night brings it back every single time.
Is it really true?
Yes, it is safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say sorry when we hurt someone?
It tells them we care. Do you have a friend?
Yes, I broke his toy. Why is that so hard?
It is hard because we feel bad. Are you going to tell him?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water moving?
The wind pushes the waves. Do you like boats?
Yes, I love them. Why do they float?
The boats are light and round. Is that a big ship?
It is very big. Why is it so tall?
It holds many things. Do you see the red flag?
I see it. Why is the flag red?
I do not know the reason. Is the sun out?
The sun is out. Why is the sky blue?
The light makes it look blue. Do you see the fish?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do shoes have laces?
Laces hold your feet tight so you do not slip. Do you like tight shoes?
Why are some shoes wet inside?
I do not know the exact reason, but water can get in. Are your socks dry?
Why do shoes have toes?
The toe box protects your toes from bumps. Do you have big toes?
Why do we buy new shoes?
Old shoes wear out and hurt your feet. Do you want to look at the blue ones?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to send a picture to my friend.
That is fun. Do you have a photo picked out?
Yes, it is of my cat.
Nice. You can use an app to send it.
Which app is best?
Many work well. Does your friend use a specific one?
I do not know what he uses.
You can ask him. This is a common way to start.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I had a scary dream about a big dark room.
That sounds very scary. Was the room really dark?
Yes, and I could not find the door.
I am sorry you felt stuck. Do you like to have a light on now?
It helps me feel safe.
That is a smart thing to do.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you know where my sister is?
I do not know her location. Do you look in the garden?
I checked the garden, but she is not there.
That is strange. Do you hear any music?
Yes, I hear drums from upstairs.
She is likely in the bedroom. Go check that room.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did the dog run away?
I do not know for sure. Do you have a favorite part?
I liked when they found the toy. Why was the sky red?
It might be sunset. Is it a happy story?
Yes, it is. Why is the bear so big?
It helps him look strong. Is he nice?
He seems very kind. Why did the child cry?
Maybe he missed home. Do you like sad parts?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late today.
That sounds fun. Did you have breakfast?
Yes, I ate many pancakes.
Pancakes are tasty. Did you eat them all?
I only ate two.
That is a good start. What happened next?
My friend came to visit.
That makes me happy. Did you play together?
We played hide and seek.
I love that game. How did it end?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The clock hands move fast, but I do not know why. How does it tick?
A spring inside the clock gives it power. Do you like to take things apart?
Yes, I do, but I am afraid of breaking it. Can I open my wall clock?
Please do not open it yourself, as you might hurt it. You should ask a grown-up for help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big white puff in the sky. What should I do?
You can just watch it float by. Do you like how it looks?
I am not sure if it is a cloud. Should I take a picture?
It is a cloud if it is made of tiny water drops. Do you have a camera?
I do not have a camera. Do you know what it will do next?
I do not know exactly where it will go. Does it look fast or slow?
It looks very slow. I think I will just walk away then.
That is a good choice. Have fun walking.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to count the apples in my basket.
That is a fun game to play. Do you like red apples or green ones?
I like the red ones best. Please show me how to count them.
Start with one and say a new number for each apple. Are you holding the basket steady?
Yes, I am holding it tight. What do I do if I forget a number?
Just start from the beginning again. It gets easier every time you try.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am packing my bag for the trip. I feel so happy about it.
That is great to hear. What is your favorite thing to pack?
I am putting in my soft blue shirt. It feels so nice.
Blue is a calm color. Are you going to the beach or the city?
I have packed all my books and snacks. I am ready to go.
That sounds like a perfect start. Have a wonderful trip.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The rain is too loud.
That sounds scary. Are you hiding under a blanket?
Yes. I do not like the thunder.
Deep breaths help. Do you hear birds singing now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My throat feels very scratchy today.
I am sorry to hear that. Does it hurt when you swallow?
Yes, it hurts a little bit.
You should drink warm tea to help.
I also feel very tired all the time.
Rest is very important for getting well. Do you have a fever?
I checked with a thermometer earlier.
Did the number look high?
It was a bit high, so I am sitting by the window.
Fresh air can be good for you. Get plenty of sleep tonight.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I bought a gift for my friend, but I do not know where to hide it.
You could put it in her bedroom. Do you know where she keeps her toys?
Yes, she has a big blue box under her bed.
That is a good spot. It is easy to find but not in plain sight.
I also do not know what to say when she opens it.
Just tell her you picked it because you care about her. Will you surprise her at dinner?
Yes, after we eat the pasta.
That sounds like a lovely plan.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My friend took my toy and will not give it back.
That sounds very mean. Did you ask them nicely first?
Yes, but they laughed at me. Now I feel small.
I am sorry you feel that way. Would you like to talk to me about how to feel better?
I just want my toy back. I do not know what to do.
I cannot fix the toy for you. Can you try asking a grown up for help?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I broke my cup by accident. Why did it break?
It was thin and glass is fragile. Did you hold it tight?
I held it very tight, but it still cracked. Why is glass so weak?
Glass breaks easily when it hits hard things. Do you have another cup?
Yes, I do. I am sad I broke the first one.
It is okay to make mistakes. Learn from this time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My bread got very big today. I felt so proud.
That is a happy feeling. Did you smell the nice yeast?
Yes, it smelled sweet. How does the dough actually grow?
Tiny creatures in the dough eat sugar. They make gas that puffs the bread up.
I did not know they ate the sugar. It feels like magic.
It is a real, living process. Did you cut the loaf into slices?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go, and I am very late.
Taking a breath helps your heart beat slow. Are you feeling scared?
No, but the bus is coming soon.
A small pause can make you feel calm. Do you have your bag?
Yes, but I am still rushing.
You are doing just fine.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know if I should play soccer today.
Why are you feeling this way?
My feet hurt from playing all week.
Rest is good for your body. Do you want to walk instead?
Maybe walking is better.
Walking is a nice choice.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The storm is so loud and the rain is huge. I love it.
That sounds like a big, wet party. Are you staying safe inside?
Yes, I am dry and warm in my bed. I watch the rain all day.
What a cozy way to spend a rainy day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My room is so messy. I do not know where to start.
Start with the floor. Do you like to tidy up with music on?
Yes, I love music. But my shelves are full of old toys.
Put the toys in a box.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for school.
Take a deep breath. Is it the math part?
Yes, I do not know how to do it.
That is hard. Do you have a pencil?
I left my pencil at home.
I can lend you one. Do you have paper?
Yes, but my brain is empty.
Just read the first line.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the beach today and it was so blue and warm.
That sounds like a lovely time. What did you do there?
I built a big sand castle and watched the waves crash.
A sand castle sounds like fun. Did it stay dry?
No, the waves washed it away, but I was still very happy.
The sea can be both wild and calming. Do you want to go again soon?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to pack my bag for the trip.
That is great. Do you have your shoes ready?
Yes, I put them right in the front.
Good choice. Are you excited to see new places?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my chair wobbly?
A leg is probably loose. Is one leg shorter than the others?
No, they look the same. Why does it shake?
The screw is likely loose. Do you have a screwdriver?
I do. Why not just glue it?
Glue may not hold strong. Are you sure the wood is not cracked?
It looks fine to me. How do I fix it?
Tighten the screw with a tool.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the big, dark clouds are blocking the sun.
That can feel heavy. Do you want to look at them together?
Maybe, but they look so angry and gray.
Clouds are just water in the sky. They do not have feelings.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad today. What should I do?
I am sorry you feel that way. Is it because of school or something else?
I lost my favorite toy. I miss it a lot.
That is a very hard feeling. Do you remember where you left it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a bird stuck in the bush. I do not know what to do.
Do not worry. Are you holding a gentle cloth?
Yes, I have a soft towel in my hands.
Gently lift the bird and set it on the ground. Is it flapping its wings?
Yes, it is moving its wings a little.
That is good. Let it rest for a moment and see if it flies.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cried so hard watching that sad movie.
That sounds very hard. Did you like the ending?
No, my little dog dies.
I am sorry to hear that.
It made me feel so bad.
Your heart is full of care. Do you want to talk more?
Just a little, please.
I am here for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today for my birthday. I found a big red balloon.
That sounds like a great start. Where did you find it?
It was stuck in a tree by the swings. I had to climb up to get it.
You are very brave for climbing that high. Did you keep the balloon?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired. The house is a mess.
That is a lot of work. Do you want to take a break?
I just want it done. My back hurts.
Resting is good. Is the living room the worst spot?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I can’t write my letter. My words are all jumbled up.
That feels really hard. Do you want to start with a hello?
I just don’t know what to say to them. It feels wrong.
Tell me how you feel first. What is making you sad?
I miss my friend, but I am angry too. I am stuck.
It is okay to feel both. What is one small thing you want to share?
I think I can say I miss you. Thank you for helping.
You did a great job.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know how to start my letter.
Start with a warm hello. Who are you writing to?
I am writing to my grandmother.
That is sweet. What good news do you have?
I found a tiny blue flower.
A lovely gift. Did you pick it carefully?
Yes, I did.
You did a fine job.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do plants drink?
They drink to stay alive. Do you know where their roots are?
I think they are in the dirt.
Yes, the roots go deep into the soil. Can you see the water inside?
No, I cannot see it.
That is okay. It moves up tiny tubes to the leaves.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the water move in the harbour?
The wind pushes the water and makes waves. Do you see the boats going up and down?
Why do the boats stop there?
They stop to let people get on or to fix them. Is your boat big or small?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the red book. I am late.
It is on the top shelf. Do you have your pen?
Yes, I have my pen.
You are very fast. I hope you can finish before closing.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say please when I want a toy?
You just say "please" with a nice voice. Do you have a favorite toy?
No, but I want to know how to say thank you.
You say "thank you" after someone helps you. Is it hard to remember?
I am not sure. What if I forget?
It is okay if you forget sometimes. Just try your best.
I will try.
That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am cold. It is very cold outside.
Wearing a coat and a hat helps keep you warm. Do you have a nice, thick coat?
Yes, I have a big blue coat. But I still feel chilly.
Maybe you need gloves and boots too. I do not know why you are so cold, though.
I am sitting near a window. The air comes in there.
Sitting near a draft can make you freeze. You should move to a warmer spot in the room.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so lost. I feel very sad.
Let us find the way together. Where did you last see a big tree?
I do not know. I think I am in a dark place.
Do not worry. Is there a bright light anywhere?
No, it is all dark here. I am scared.
We will stay close. Do you hear any birds singing?
Yes, I hear them now. I feel a bit better.
Good. Let us follow the sound. Are you ready to walk with me?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The screen is broken and I cannot find my work. I am so mad.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you have a backup file?
I do not know where it is. It is just gone.
That is scary. Have you tried typing your name in the search box?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do plants drink water? I am so confused.
Water moves up tiny tubes in the roots. Do you see the stems?
Yes, I do. But why does it go up?
It pulls up to reach the leaves. Is that easier to see?
I think I get it now. Thanks for helping.
You are welcome. Happy growing!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am writing a letter to my friend. Today, I saw a red bird on my window sill.
That is a nice start. Did the bird sing?
It did not sing, but it looked at me. I said hello to it, and then it flew away.
A quiet goodbye is lovely. What will you write next?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to take a picture of the bird.
That sounds fun! Is the bird sitting on a branch?
No, it is flying right now. It goes very fast.
That might be tricky. Do you think your camera can catch it?
I have a big red button on my camera. I will push it hard.
Pushing the button is the right idea. Did the bird stay still?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My magnet will not stick to the door. I am sad.
That is frustrating. Does it work on other metal things?
No, it does not work at all. It feels too light.
Maybe the glue inside broke. Is the door made of metal?
I do not know. I just want it to stick.
I do not know for sure. Let us try a spoon to test it.
It sticks to the spoon. The door is bad.
Then the door is likely painted over. You found the problem.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to learn to sing, but my voice feels bad.
Many people feel that way at first. Do you sing for fun?
Yes, I just like the songs. I pick the wrong words.
Try moving your lips slowly. Do you read lyrics?
I read them fast, but then I miss the beat.
Slow down your reading. Do you have a slow song?
I have one, but it sounds silly when I hum it.
Humming is a great start. Is it okay to sound silly?
I think so. What should I do next?
Sing a high note once. Do you feel it in your nose?
Yes, it tingles. Is that good?
That is a good sign. Keep going!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lights went out and I feel so free!
That sounds fun. Did you light a candle?
Yes! The smell is nice and the air is still.
How cozy that must feel. Do you hear any birds?
I do. They sing soft songs in the dark.
I love that sound. What are you doing right now?
I am just sitting and thinking about the day.
Taking time to rest is good. Is it quiet inside?
It is very quiet and I am happy to share this.
I am glad you have a nice moment.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got off a very long flight.
That sounds like a big trip. Did you enjoy the view?
Yes, the clouds looked like soft cotton.
That must have been very pretty to see.
I feel tired but very happy right now.
It is good to rest after a long journey. How is your body feeling?
My legs hurt a little, but my heart is light.
I am glad you made it home safely.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, but the fish looks sad. What is wrong?
Is the water cold or warm? Check the heater.
It is too cold. Thank you, I must go.
Good luck. Do you feed them today?
Yes, right after work. Bye.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know why my bread gets big and soft.
A tiny living thing in the dough eats sugar and makes gas. Do you like eating sweet bread?
Yes, I do. Why does the gas make it big?
The gas gets trapped in little air pockets inside the dough. The dough pushes out to hold them. What kind of bread do you like best?
I like round loaves. How do I stop it from getting too big?
I am not sure how to stop it, but you can wait for the gas to cook away in the heat.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to give my new friend.
That is a sweet thought. What does your friend like to play?
I am not sure. I saw him on the playground once.
Did he play on the swings or the slide?
I think he was on the slide.
Maybe a book about sliding would be nice?
I am not sure if that is good.
I do not know what he likes most. Do you have a favorite toy to lend?
I have a blue ball.
A ball is a great start. You can play together.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat alone in the park and watched the leaves fall.
That sounds quiet. Did you see any dogs there?
I saw one dog, but its owner did not look at me.
I am sorry. Did the dog stop to say hello?
It barked at me, so I went home.
Barking can be scary. Do you want to talk more about it?
Yes, I just felt very small and forgotten today.
You are not forgotten, even if it feels that way. I am here with you now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not want that soup. It tastes bad.
I am sorry you are not happy. Do you like the bread?
I want the pasta, but I think you gave me the wrong thing.
Let me check your order right now.
I am very tired and I am hungry.
I am so sorry for the wait. Would you like a drink?
Just the correct food, please. I am still upset.
I will bring the correct food very soon.
Okay, I will wait for my food.
Thank you for your patience.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to count to ten.
That is easy. Do you know the words from one to three?
I know one and two, but not three.
Three comes after two. Try saying one, two, three.
Can I practice with apples?
Yes, you can use anything. Do you have any fruits nearby?
I have a basket of red apples.
Perfect. Count them out loud.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how bees make honey.
They take sweet plant juice and store it in their hives. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I do. But then what happens?
They dry the juice with their wings until it becomes thick honey. Is that a big job for them?
That sounds very hard.
It is hard work, but they work together to do it. Do you work with friends?
Sometimes I do. I understand now, thank you.
You are welcome. I am glad I could help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel stuck and do not know what to do next.
Taking a deep breath often helps when you feel stuck. Do you need to fix this right now?
I think I should just wait a little longer.
Waiting is a kind of action, too. What is your first thought after the wait?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go, but why does the cow moo?
Cows moo to talk to each other. Do you have a cow?
No, but what do sheep eat?
Sheep eat grass and hay.
Do pigs like mud?
Yes, mud keeps them cool. Do you like mud?
I am late. Why do chickens cluck?
They cluck to say where they are. Do you hear chickens?
Thanks, I must run now.
Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where I am.
Do not worry. Can you see a big building?
Yes, I see a red roof.
Is the roof on the left or the right?
It is on the left side.
Please go to the main door. Is there a bell there?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw big white flakes fall all morning.
That is very beautiful. Did you feel cold outside?
Yes, my toes were numb, but it was fun.
I am glad you had fun. I do not know why snow feels that way.
Then I ate warm soup to fix it.
Warm soup sounds nice. Was it tasty?
Yes, it was the best soup I have ever had.
Good for you. I hope your day stays warm.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad and my nose is all stuffy.
I am sorry you are not feeling well. Are you drinking enough water?
Yes, but I still have a sore throat.
That can hurt a lot to swallow. Have you tried any warm tea?
No, I just want to sleep.
Rest is very good for you. Do you feel a little better now?
Yes, a little bit, thank you.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see so many stars up there. Are they far away?
Yes, they are very far away. Do you like looking at the sky?
I do. I wonder if someone lives up there.
I do not know for sure. Do you hope to visit one day?
I want to fly up with a rocket. Is the moon close?
The moon is much closer than the stars. Do you like the moon's shape?
I like it when it is big and round. Why does it change?
The light changes how we see it. Is your favorite time to look at night?
I like to look before bed. The stars make me feel small.
That is a nice feeling. Do you feel calm when you look?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel so tired. I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That is hard when you are sleepy. Do you have a helper?
My dad will help me, but I am very tired.
Let your body rest first. Sleep helps you learn better.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I lost my script and the show starts soon. What should I do?
That is scary. Did you leave it in your bag?
I checked my bag, but it is not there. I am so sad.
Do not cry. Let us look under the seats together.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are the stars out tonight?
They are far away lights in the dark. Do you like looking up at the sky?
I wish I could touch one.
I do not know if we could reach them.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I made a new friend today.
That is great news. Is she nice?
She is very sweet, but I am nervous.
Do not worry too much. Have you played with her?
Not yet, I just sat next to her.
Try to talk to her. Do you like the same games?
I hope we can play together soon.
That is a good goal. Have fun tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My horse is eating very little today.
That is not good. Is he moving his tail?
Yes, he is moving it slow.
He may be tired. Did you give him fresh water?
I gave him a big bucket of water.
Good. I do not know why he is hungry. You should call a vet.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked past the big red house and then I saw a dog.
A dog is a good marker. Was it a big dog or a small one?
It was a small brown puppy. I followed it to the park.
That is a nice place to be. Do you remember which side of the park you entered?
I entered on the left side. Now I am here, but I do not know how to go home.
I do not know your exact home. Let us find a map or a shop first.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the lake this morning and caught a big fish.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you keep it?
No, I put it back right away because it was too small.
You did the right thing. What did you use to catch it?
I used a worm I found in the dirt.
Worms are good bait. Do you go fishing often?
Not really, but I hope to go again next week.
I hope the weather is nice for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. My bike is stuck.
Did you try pushing the gears?
I tried, but it will not move.
Try lifting the back wheel up.
That worked. Thank you!
You are welcome. Have a safe ride.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my computer get hot?
It works hard so parts heat up. Do you use it for games?
Yes, I play a lot. Why is the screen bright?
It lights up so you can see. Do you like bright colors?
Why does it stop working sometimes?
It needs a break to cool down. I do not know the exact reason.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I swam in the big pool today and it felt so nice and cool.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you feel like a fish?
Yes, my legs kicked fast and I went far.
You must be a great swimmer. Do you want to go again next week?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My computer is slow and I am mad.
That is frustrating. Do you have many windows open?
Yes, I think so.
Closing them may help. Is the fan making a loud noise?
It hums a lot.
A loud fan means it is hot. Do you see any dust on the vents?
I do not see any dust.
I do not know why it is slow. Try restarting it first.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the tall white tower. I am late.
It stands on the rocky hill by the sea. Is it for work?
Yes, I must check the lights. Do they turn on at dusk?
They glow when the sun goes down. Do you have a key?
Yes, I have my key. Which gate do I use?
Use the small iron gate on the north side. Do you see it?
I see it. I am going now.
Walk safe in the wind. Good luck today.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to write a letter fast, but I do not know how to start.
Just say how you feel first. Do you want to thank them or say sorry?
I need to say sorry, but I am in a big hurry.
Write "I am sorry" and then tell the why. Is it hard to find the right words?
I just want to finish this before the mail closes.
Keep your words short and sweet. Do you have the paper with you?
Yes, I have the paper, but my hands are shaking.
Take one deep breath to calm down. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sky was very dark when I came home today.
Did you see the moon?
Yes, it looked like a big silver ball.
That is a lovely sight. Was it full?
No, it was just a thin slice.
Oh, I like that shape too. What color was it?
It was white, but it felt cold outside.
I see. Cold nights are cozy for reading.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried on five pairs and none fit right.
That sounds really hard. Do you have a size guide?
I think I do, but my feet are so swollen today.
Swollen feet can change how shoes feel. Is it hot here?
It is, but I still need to look good for work tomorrow.
I get that. Do you like the blue ones best?
I do, but they are too tight on my toes.
Maybe we can try a wider size. Do you want to try that?
Okay, let's hope it works this time.
I hope so too. Let's go.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My boss is very nice. How do I make a sandwich?
You put bread, meat, and cheese on a plate. Do you have any bread?
Yes, I have bread. What do I do next?
Put the meat and cheese on one piece of bread. What kind of meat do you like?
I like ham. How do I close it?
Put the other piece of bread on top. Do you want to cut it?
Yes, please. How do I cut it?
Use a knife to slice it in half. Enjoy your lunch.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I felt so happy after I finished my drawing.
That is a nice feeling. What did you draw?
I made a big red sun with a smile.
A smiling sun sounds bright. Do you keep it?
Yes, I put it on my wall.
Your room must look warm now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just landed from a very long trip.
That sounds tiring. Did you sleep on the plane?
Yes, I slept for hours and felt great.
That is good news. What did you see out the window?
I saw big clouds and a sunny sky.
How nice. Did you eat a snack?
I had some cookies and a drink.
You sound so happy. Are you ready for your next stop?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we keep books in a big quiet room?
It keeps the papers safe from rain and bugs. Do you like the smell of old pages?
Yes. Why is it so quiet inside?
We need silence so everyone can think. Do you have a favorite book to read?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My next door neighbor keeps playing loud music at night.
That sounds very tiring. Do you like the songs?
No, they are too noisy for me to sleep.
I am sorry to hear that. Loud noise can upset anyone.
I am afraid to go out and ask them to stop.
It is natural to feel shy. Have you tried waving first?
No, I have never said hello to them.
A smile is a great start. Would you like to try tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big black beetle on my shoe this morning.
That sounds like a cool find. Did you pick it up to look closer?
No, I just watched it crawl into the grass.
Beetsles like to hide in warm dirt. Is it sunny where you are now?
Yes, it is bright and warm here.
Good for your body and the bugs.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the old well today and saw a cat sleeping in the sun.
That sounds very peaceful. Did you give it a treat?
I did not, but I told it the sun was nice. It looked happy.
I am glad it enjoyed the warmth. What else did you see?
I saw a bird flying very high, then it landed on a tree.
I love watching birds. What color was the bird?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad it is raining today.
That sounds lovely. Do you like watching the drops?
Yes, I do. It makes me feel calm.
Calm sounds good. Do you have a warm drink?
I do have tea. It is very nice.
What a sweet way to spend the day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very alone lately.
That feels hard. What do you do when you feel that way?
I just sit and wait for it to pass.
Silence can be loud. Do you have a friend nearby?
No one comes to see me.
I am here with you now. Would you like to talk more?
Yes, please stay with me.
I will stay. What is on your mind?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know which days are good for cleaning.
Friday is a great day to clean before the weekend. Do you like cooking on Fridays?
I also want to learn how to make bread.
You start by mixing flour, water, and yeast. Do you have a big bowl ready?
That sounds hard. What if I miss a step?
It is okay if you make a small mistake. The bread will still taste good.
I am happy to try now. Thank you for helping me.
I am glad I could help you. Have fun making your bread.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I start a new job tomorrow. I want to learn how to make a great coffee.
That sounds fun. Do you like sweet drinks?
Yes, I like sugar. I do not know where to start.
Start by washing your cup. I use hot water for that step.
I will wash the cup. What do I put next?
Put a spoon of ground beans in the water.
How do I mix it? I am afraid I will mess up.
Stir it slow and soft. Do you have a good spoon?
I have a metal spoon. Will that work?
Yes, it works well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My fish look sad. What should I do?
I am sorry to hear that. Do you change the water often?
Yes, I do. But they still act slow.
Check the water temperature. Is it warm enough?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late and missed my bus. I walked for hours and got lost.
That sounds scary. Do you have your phone with you?
Yes, but the battery is dead. I have to keep walking to find my home.
Walking is good for your legs. Are you close to a big park?
I am near a park, but I do not know which way to go. I am so tired.
Take a deep breath. You will be okay.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big mountain today. It was so high and white with snow. I feel so happy!
That sounds like a great day. Do you like cold places?
Yes, I do. The air felt very fresh and clean up there. It made me feel free.
It is true that fresh air feels good. Do you want to climb it next time?
I would love to, but my legs were tired. I just sat and looked for a long time.
Sitting and looking is a good rest. What did you see from the top?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I want to share my joy.
That is wonderful. What made you so happy?
I learned to count to ten. It feels like magic.
That is a great skill.
Can we count together from one to five?
Sure, let us try. One, two, three, four, five.
Hooray! I did it with you.
Well done. Do you want to try to ten?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big boat on the water. Do sailors live on it?
Yes, many sailors sleep on the boat. Do you like to look at boats?
They look so tired sometimes. Why do they look like that?
Working hard can make them tired. Do you like to help around the house?
I help clean my room. Do sailors clean their rooms too?
Yes, they must keep their beds clean. Do you tidy up your toys?
My toys are messy. I forget to pick them up.
That is very common for kids. Do you have a favorite toy?
It is my red truck. I drive it on the rug.
That sounds like fun. Do you drive your truck to the door?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I make my bike ride fast?
Pedal hard and sit up tall. Do you have a helmet on?
Yes, I have a helmet.
Good. Look ahead, not down at your hands.
It feels wobbly when I go quick.
Keep your eyes on the road ahead. Is your bike tight?
It looks tight, but I am not sure.
I do not know for sure. Try to touch your brakes gently to test them.
The brakes work fine.
Great. Practice in an open park first. Have fun out there?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how this clock makes time.
The small wheel turns to make the hands move. Do you see the little wheels?
I see them, but I am not sure which way to turn it.
You do not need to turn anything to set the time. Is the clock running now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Can you quickly tell me how bees make honey?
Yes, they suck sweet juice from flowers and dry it to make honey. Do you like honey?
I don't have time for that. Just tell me where they keep it.
They store it in wax cells inside their hive. Is that what you needed?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My light is gone. I am late.
Is the plug in the wall? Tell me if you check it.
Yes, it is in.
Try the main switch near the door.
The switch works.
I do not know why the light failed. Is the wall warm?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to get better at kicking the ball. What should I do?
Practice every day to build a strong leg. Do you play in a team?
Yes, my friends and I play on Saturdays. I always miss the goal.
Aim for the corners to trick the keeper. Do you feel nervous?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know how tall the big mountain is, but I am late.
Most high peaks are over 10,000 feet. Do you know which one you mean?
It is the tallest one near here, please answer fast.
I do not know your exact spot, so I cannot say the number. Do you have a map with you?
I only have this phone, I am running now.
You can look up the name on the screen quickly. Is your path clear?
Yes, it is clear, thank you for the help.
It was nice to help you. Good luck on your walk!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to clean the house but I do not know where to start.
Start with the smallest room first. Do you have a small bedroom?
I am not sure that is the right way to do it.
It is a good way to feel less tired. Do you like dusting or sweeping better?
I think I will just sit here and feel sad about the mess.
That is not a good plan for a clean home. Shall we just start with the living room?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a bad cold.
Oof, that feels bad. Do you have soup?
I must run.
Rest is best. Are you eating?
I will eat later.
Okay. Please drink water.
Goodbye.
Bye. Feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go. My bike is stuck.
Is the chain off the gears? Can you check the small wheel?
No, it is locked tight. I have no key.
Do you have a friend nearby? I know a store that opens soon.
I have no time for friends. I will push it.
Pushing is hard work. Are your feet safe?
Yes, I am fine. Bye now.
Be careful on the road. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: It is so sunny and warm outside today.
That sounds lovely. Do you like the sun?
Yes, I do. I am going for a walk.
Enjoy your walk. What color is the sky?
It is bright blue. I feel very happy.
I am glad you are happy. Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how my plant gets water.
It uses tiny roots to pull water up. Do you see the dirt?
I see the dirt, but how does it move up?
The water climbs through small tubes inside the stem. Have you tried touching the leaves?
Yes, they feel soft and cool.
That means they are drinking well. Do you want to learn more?
I think I understand now, thank you.
You are welcome, and I am happy to help. Do you have any other questions?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we read at night?
It helps your brain calm down before sleep. Do you like reading in bed?
Yes, but it feels heavy.
Your eyes get tired from the light. Do you use a lamp?
I use a small light.
That is a good idea for your eyes. Do you read comic books?
I read stories about cats.
That sounds very cozy. Do you dream about cats?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off trees in the fall?
The days get short and cold, so trees let go to save energy. Do you like seeing them fly?
It looks so pretty, but why does the tree need to let them go?
It is hard to keep leaves warm and fed in winter. Do you know what photosynthesis means?
No, I do not. What is that?
It is how leaves use sun light to make food for the tree. The tree rests when the sun is weak.
Oh, so the tree is sleeping?
Yes, it is like a long sleep until spring comes. Do you look up at the sky when you walk?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel so happy right now?
It is likely because you did something good. Did you do a kind thing?
Yes, I helped my friend pick up her toys. Why does that make me feel warm?
Helping others makes us feel strong and valued.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very hungry. The sun was warm today, but then it started to rain.
That sounds like a fun day. Do you like rain?
I wish for soup. It is cold now.
I do not know what you want. Do you want chicken?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My phone screen is black. I do not know what to do.
It might need a charge. Is the battery full?
I do not know. Can you help me?
Try plugging it in. It should wake up soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights in my room are not working. What do I do?
Is the switch on?
Yes, I pressed it many times. It still stays dark.
Check if other lights work.
The kitchen light is on, but mine is off.
Maybe the bulb is burnt out.
I do not know how to check that safely.
Unplug the cord first.
I did that. The plug is loose.
Do not try to fix it alone.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent all day picking up pebbles by the river.
That sounds like hard work. Do you like smooth stones?
Yes, I found a blue one that looks like a drop of water.
What a lovely find. You must be very happy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the moon change shape?
It is not really changing. The sun lights up only part of it for us to see. Do you like watching it at night?
Yes, I do. Is it hot or cold?
It is very hot in the day and very cold at night. Do you wonder if anyone lives there?
I wonder if dogs would like to live there.
I do not know if they would. But I bet they would be scared of the jumps.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the movies today. I saw a big blue whale on the screen.
That sounds like a fun trip. Did you like the sound of the water?
Yes, it was very loud and deep. I felt small inside the theater.
It is nice to see big things on a screen. Were your eyes tired after?
A little, but my heart was happy. It was a good end to my day.
I am glad you had a happy time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I saw a big lion at the zoo today.
Wow, that is a great day! Did the lion roar at you?
Yes, it did! I also want to tell you that lions live in Africa.
That is true. Do you think lions are friendly pets?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the ocean blue on this map?
Water reflects the sky, so we draw it blue. Do you see the sky?
Why are there green dots on the land?
Those dots are trees in big forests. Do you like trees?
Why is this road red?
Red shows the main busy roads. Is that your street?
Why is the castle gray?
I do not know what that gray mark is. What shape is it?
Why does the map end here?
The world goes on, but this sheet did not have room. Do you have more sheets?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so good after my walk today.
That is great to hear. Do you like walking in the park?
Yes, I love seeing the trees and birds.
Nature makes walking very fun. How far do you usually go?
I walk for about half an hour.
That is a good time to move your body.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I am moving to a new house!
That is great news! Is the new house close to your friends?
Yes, it is right down the street from them.
Oh, that is wonderful for playing outside. Do you have a garden there?
It has a big one with a swing!
A swing sounds like fun. I do not know when you are moving, but I hope the boxes are easy to carry.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I clean my messy room?
Start by putting toys in their box. Do you have a box for your toys?
Yes, I have a red box.
Great. Now sweep the floor with a broom. Are you worried about the dust?
A little bit. The dust is everywhere.
That is normal. Dust means the air is moving. It goes away when you sweep.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my old friend Ben today. He waved at me from across the street.
That is nice to see. Did he say hello to you?
He looked busy and just ran away. I felt a little sad.
That can feel strange. Are you okay now?
I am okay. I am going to walk home now.
Good luck on your walk.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to make a healthy lunch quickly.
You can mix rice with beans and add some peas. Do you like green vegetables?
Yes, I do. What else can I add to make it taste good?
A little bit of lemon juice makes the food bright. Do you have lemons in your home?
I do not have lemons, but I have limes.
Limes work just as well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I had a scary dream about a giant dog. I feel very sad and awake.
Oh no, that sounds frightening. Did the dog growl at you?
Yes, it did. What can I do to feel better now?
Try to hold a soft toy and take slow breaths. Have you eaten anything warm yet?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw Grandpa today. He was sitting in his chair.
That is a nice place to rest. How was his mood?
He looked happy. He showed me a shiny coin.
Coins are very cool. Did he tell you where he found it?
No, he just smiled. Then he gave me an apple.
A sweet treat. Did you eat the apple?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I draw a map?
Start with a big square for the land. Do you have paper?
Yes, I have paper.
Draw a blue line for water. Where do you want to put a house?
I want the house here.
That looks like a good spot. How do you want to get there?
I want a path.
Draw a line from the door. Great job!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a nice soup at my table. How do I start?
You cut small pieces of vegetables first. Do you like carrots?
Yes, I do! What do I do after I cut them?
You put them in a pot with warm water. Do you have a spoon?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my house looks so old and broken.
That is a tough feeling. What part of the house hurts your eyes the most?
The roof leaks when it rains, and the walls are cold.
That sounds very uncomfortable. Do you have a warm blanket to sleep in?
Yes, but it is getting thin and damp.
I understand your worry. I do not know how to fix roofs.
Please, is there anyone in this small village who can help?
I am sure the neighbors care about you. Have you tried knocking on a door?
I am too shy to ask for help, so I just stay inside.
I am proud of you for talking to me. Would you like to try knocking on just one door?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is it sunny outside?
Yes, the sun is shining bright. Are you happy about that?
I like the warm sun.
Me too. What are you doing with it?
I am going to play ball.
That sounds fun. Do you have a good ball?
Yes, it is red.
Nice. Be safe and have fun.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see fire in the kitchen. What do I do?
Put out the small flames with a blanket if you can. Is it big?
It looks big and hot. I am scared.
Leave the room right now. Do not open doors. Is the smoke thick?
The air is hard to breathe. I want to go back.
Do not go back to get things. Stay low to the floor. Do you have a phone?
Yes, but I am losing track. What is next?
Call 911 and say where you are. Tell them how many people are here.
I feel so alone. What must I do now?
Go to the outside meeting spot. I do not know where you live, but safety comes first.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dragged the big wood today. My back hurt a lot.
That sounds hard. Did you rest a bit?
Yes, I sat on the grass. Now I must drive the nails.
Good idea to rest. Are the nails sharp?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am in this shop. I do not know what to buy.
It is hard to choose. Do you like red or blue?
I like both. What do you think?
Pick the one that makes you smile.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat by the pond all morning but the fish did not bite.
That can be a long wait. Did you bring any snacks?
I had some crackers, but they got wet from the rain.
I am sorry about that. Did you get to dry off before going home?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I had a scary dream last night. I felt so small and alone.
That must have been very hard. Do you still feel scared now?
Yes, I am worried it will happen again. What can I do?
Try thinking of a happy place. Does a soft blanket help you sleep?
A blanket works. But what if the fear returns?
I do not know the exact answer. Maybe ask a grown-up for help?
I will do that. Thank you for talking to me.
You are welcome. It is okay to feel sad.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is this street quiet?
Yes, it is very quiet. Do you like the quiet?
I do not like the dark.
It is not dark yet, the sun is still up.
There is no one walking.
That is right, it is an empty street. Why did you stop walking?
I am tired.
That is okay, you can rest.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do shoes have laces?
Laces hold the shoe tight on your foot. Do you like tight shoes or loose ones?
I like tight ones. Why do some shoes have no laces?
Some shoes use a rubber fit instead of laces. Is it easy for you to tie laces?
It is hard. Why are boots tall?
Tall boots protect your ankles from dirt and cold. Do you go outside in the snow?
Yes, I do. Why are shoes soft inside?
Soft inside feels nice and stops blisters.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go camping, but I do not know what to bring.
Bring a warm jacket and a good tent. Do you like sleeping in nature?
I am worried about bugs and snakes.
Use insect spray and look before you step. Have you seen snakes near your home?
I do not know if I can cook outside.
That is hard to say without seeing your setup. Do you have a stove?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The shop is closed and I am very sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you check the sign on the door?
The sign says it is open only on Sundays.
I do not know if today is Sunday. What day do you think it is?
It is Tuesday, so I cannot buy anything.
That is frustrating for sure. Do you have a backup plan?
I just wanted a gift for my friend.
You can try another store nearby. Would you like to look for one?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The fish at the market looked stale. I did not want to buy them.
That is not good. Do you know if there is another stall nearby?
I checked, but the other shops are closed. Now I have no lunch.
I am sorry to hear that. Would you like to try a fresh apple?
Yes, I can eat an apple, but I am still grumpy.
That is okay. Eating something sweet might help your mood.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My chair leg is broken and it wobbles a lot. Can you help me fix it?
I can check the wood to see if it broke. Is the leg still attached to the seat?
Yes, but there is a big crack right in the middle.
That crack needs glue and a clamp to hold it tight. Do you have any wood glue in your house?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am very tired. What can I do to feel better?
You can sleep on the pillow. Are you hungry?
Yes, I am hungry. But I do not know what to eat.
You can ask for some soup. It is warm and good.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very worried today.
That sounds hard. What is making you feel this way?
I am not sure, but my chest feels tight.
Your body may be telling you something. Do you feel safe right now?
I do, but I still have a question.
Please ask me anything.
Why do I feel this way?
I do not know the exact reason. Did something happen earlier?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like the bear in that movie?
I think the bear is very cute. Do you like him too?
Yes, I do. He gives me a hug.
That sounds very warm. Is the bear big?
Yes, he is huge. He looks scary but he is nice.
Nice is best. What is the bear's name?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel stuck on my math problem.
That is normal. What part feels hard?
I do not know how to add the numbers.
Try adding them one by one. Do you have a pencil ready?
Yes, I am writing it down.
Good job. Is the line straight?
I think I made a small mistake.
Mistakes help you learn. Can you fix it now?
Yes, I fixed it.
Well done. You did a great job.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to paint this wall blue by noon. Do you know the best color to use?
I do not know your taste, but bright blue is a classic choice. Do you have the paint mixed?
I have the paint, but I am running out of time. Which brush should I use?
A wide flat brush works best for walls. Is your brush clean and ready?
My brush is dirty. Can I clean it quickly with water?
Yes, soap and water work well for water-based paint. Do you have a rag to dry it?
I have a rag. Thank you, I must go now.
You are welcome. Good luck with your wall.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad and alone today.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you have anyone to talk to right now?
Not really, everyone is busy.
That is a tough feeling. Have you tried calling a friend?
I think I should, but I am shy.
It is hard to start first. What if you just say hello?
Maybe I will try that.
That sounds like a good step. How do you feel about that idea?
It helps a little to talk.
I am glad it helps. Do you want to share more?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the next number in this row? One, two, four, eight.
It is a puzzle about doubling. Do you know what to do with eight?
Do I add it to itself?
Yes, exactly. That makes the next number sixteen.
I get it now.
Good job solving it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream cone this morning.
Oh no, that is a shame. Do you like ice cream?
Yes, I do. I felt very sad about it.
It is nice to share that feeling. Did you clean up the mess?
Yes, I wiped the floor clean.
Good job helping out. Are you hungry now?
A little bit. I think I will say sorry to the dog.
Why a sorry to the dog?
He licked the floor where it fell.
That is a very kind thing to do.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to dive in.
That is a fun skill. Do you know how to breathe underwater?
I can hold my breath for a few seconds.
Good job. Let us start with your hands together.
My hands should be in front of my face?
Yes, keep them tight. Have you tried this before?
No, this is new to me.
That is okay. We go slowly together.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My bus was late and I missed my stop.
That is very frustrating. Did you get home safe?
Yes, I got home, but I am still angry.
It is okay to feel angry. Do you want to share more?
I just want to go back to the bus.
I cannot send you back. Are you tired now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Did the red fox find the lost key?
Yes, the fox found the key under a big rock. Did you like that part?
No, I want to know where the key went next.
The key opened the old wooden door. Was the door scary?
Not really, but I wonder who lives inside.
A kind turtle lives inside the house. Is the turtle friendly?
I hope so. What does the turtle do with the key?
The turtle gives the key back to its owner. Do you know who the owner is?
No, I do not. Who is the owner of the key?
I do not know for sure. Maybe you can guess?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just saw a movie about a small dog. It made me smile a lot.
That sounds very nice. Do you like dogs?
Yes, I do. The story was true and sweet.
I am glad you had a happy time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why are some mountains so much taller than others?
The Earth moves underneath us and pushes land up. Do you like to climb hills?
Yes, I do. But does snow stay on a mountain for a long time?
Yes, snow can stay there for many years. It turns into ice.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go on this quiet street.
The air is very still today. Are you feeling tired?
Yes, my legs hurt and I just want to sit.
Please take a chair by the window. Do you want some water?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a shadow?
Stand in the sun and look at the ground. Do you see your shadow?
Yes, I do. What makes it?
Your body blocks the light from the sun. Is your shadow long or short?
It is very long. Why is that?
The sun is low in the sky right now. Do you like watching shadows?
I do. Can I control it?
Not really, but you can move to change its shape.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my small boat go fast on the lake?
That is a fun idea to try. Do you have an oar or just your hands?
I only have my hands and a little paddle.
You can paddle hard and smooth to go faster. Is the water calm there?
Yes, it is very still this morning.
Then you can push the water back with a strong swing. It feels like swimming in a way.
I will try to push hard and smooth.
You will do a great job with that. Do you like the sound of the water?
I love the sound of the water very much.
It is a nice sound to listen to while you move.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to take a picture of this cat right now. Can you do it for me?
I can hold your camera steady. Do you want the photo to be sharp?
Yes, please make it very clear. I am running late for work.
I will focus on its eyes. Is that okay?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a square with four lines, but it looks like a triangle.
That is very interesting. Do you see where the lines cross?
Yes, they meet in the middle, but the picture is not right.
Look closely at the shadows. They can play tricks on your eyes.
Oh, I see it now. It is a 3D shape hidden in the flat paper.
You solved it! Was the shape a pyramid?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the wind so loud today?
The wind is loud when it moves very fast. Do you feel it on your face?
Yes, it feels like cold hands.
That is a good way to think about it.
Does the wind have a home?
I think of the air as its home. Do you like when it is windy?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a big box with no label. What is inside?
I do not know for sure. Did you open it?
No, it is still closed and heavy. Is it a gift?
Maybe it is a gift. Who gave it to you?
A friend left it on my desk this morning. Will you help me look?
Yes, I will help you. Let us see together.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How does this clock work?
It moves hands to show time. Do you have a battery?
Yes, I think so. Is that why it ticks?
A ticking sound comes from a spring or battery power. That is not a clock problem.
Can you tell me the time now?
I cannot see your clock. Please look at the big hand.
It is on the five. That means quarter past.
Yes, you are right. You are all set to go.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to walk more for my body, but I do not know where to start.
That is a great start. Do you like walking in parks?
I am not sure. I feel lost in the city streets.
Try a quiet path near your home. Do you have time in the morning?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My head hurts so bad. I do not know what to do.
Drink some water and rest your eyes. Does it throb like a drum?
Yes, it throbs. I tried to read a book, but it got worse.
That is good. Keep away from bright lights. Do you have any pain pills at home?
Yes, I think there is some. Should I take them now?
It may help if you are not sick to your stomach. Is your stomach feeling okay?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn a new language. What should I do first?
Start with very small words you know. Do you like animals or food?
I like food words. How do I remember them?
Look at pictures of the food while you say the word. That helps your brain.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to keep all my broken crayons in a box.
That is a fun idea. Do you try to use the broken ones?
Yes, I glue them to the sticks to make new colors.
That is very clever. Do you have a favorite new color?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great goal. Do you have a pair of shoes ready?
Yes, I have them right here.
Good. First, make a big loop with one side.
Like a circle?
Yes, just like a circle. Now, cross the other side over it.
Okay, I crossed it.
Nice work. Pull it tight to make a knot.
Is it tight enough?
It looks good. Do you want to try the other shoe?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I want to get sandwiches for lunch.
That is a tasty choice. Do you like cheese or ham?
I will take ham. Why is it good?
It tastes salty and nice. Is your lunch boring?
It is usually just bread.
A bit of change helps. Do you have a drink?
I have some cold water.
Water is good for you. I do not know about soup.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to sing today and my voice sounded so bad. I want to give up.
Do not give up yet. Have you tried to breathe slowly before you sing?
I do not know how to breathe right. It just makes me feel tight.
That is a normal feeling. Do you like to sing when you are happy?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie a knot for my fishing line.
That is a great goal. Do you know which kind of knot you need?
I am not sure. I just want the fish to stay on the hook.
I do not know the exact name, but I can show you a common one. Do you have a mirror nearby?
Yes, I have a small mirror on my desk.
Good. Hold the line so the end points up. Do you want to try it now?
Yes, please show me the first step.
Loop the end around the main line. Does that look right to you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do bees make honey?
They store it as food for the winter. Do you like sweet treats?
Yes, I do. How do they get the sugar into the honey?
They drink nectar from flowers and add their own goo. Have you seen a flower before?
I have seen many. Why do they need to fan air over the honey?
The wind dries the water out so it does not rot. Do you know how bees build their homes?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I got my first job today. It was so hard.
That is a big step. What part was the hardest for you?
I do not know how to make the coffee machine work.
I do not know your exact machine, but I can help. Do you see a red button?
Yes, there is a big red button on the side.
Press it gently and wait. Is it making a sound?
It is humming now. I think it is working.
That is great news. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do fish stay in the water?
Because they need it to breathe. Do you like to swim?
Why is the water so cold today?
I do not know for sure, but the weather is clear. Is your water cold too?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I stop the floor from smelling bad?
Put down a small cup of coffee grounds. Do you use a mop or a broom?
I use a mop.
That helps a lot. Try mopping with a bit of vinegar too.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is this place blue on the map?
It is water. Do you like boats?
Yes. Why is it so big?
Because the sea is big. Is it salty?
I think so. Why is the land green here?
That is a forest. Do you like trees?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does my magnet stick to the fridge?
It sticks because the fridge has metal that likes magnets. Do you have other magnets?
Yes, I have one that breaks the fridge open.
That is a very strong magnet. Where did you find it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am going to a picnic. What should I pack?
Bring some fruit and a juice box. Do you like cold drinks?
Yes, I love juice. What else is good to eat?
A small sandwich is a great choice.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do bugs have so many legs?
Their bodies are built in sections, and each section has its own legs. Do you like watching them walk?
I do! Why do some bugs fly?
They grew wings to help them find food and escape danger. Do you like butterflies?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My map is all smudged and I cannot find my way home.
That is very tricky. Did you take a photo of it before it got wet?
I did not think to do that. Now I am lost and my feet hurt.
I am sorry you feel that way. Can you see any tall trees nearby?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the bakery this morning. The smell of fresh bread was amazing.
That sounds so nice. Did you buy anything sweet?
Yes, I got a big chocolate cake. I am saving it for later.
Oh, that sounds delicious. Are you planning to share it with anyone?
No, it is just for me. I really want to eat the whole thing.
That is very greedy of you. Do you think you will save any for tomorrow?
Probably not. I will eat it all at once.
Enjoy your treat then.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do now.
It is okay to feel lost. Do you want to take a break?
I am tired of failing at this.
Failing helps us learn. What part felt the hardest?
Everything just feels too hard.
Let us try one small step. What is the first thing you can do?
I am not sure if I can start.
You can always stop if it hurts. Are you ready to try a tiny step?
Okay, I will try again.
That is a good choice. I am proud of you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know what a cow gives us. I am very late.
A cow gives us milk. Are you going to buy some?
What does a duck say? Please be quick.
A duck goes quack. Do you see one nearby?
I forgot what a sheep gives us.
It gives us wool. Do you like warm clothes?
What does a horse do? Hurry up, please.
It runs fast. Do you want to ride one?
What color is a white chicken?
I do not know. Do you have one?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I tried to run fast like you, but my legs feel like jelly.
That is very normal, little runner. Do you like to run on grass or on the sidewalk?
I like the grass because it is soft.
Grass is nice for your knees. You did a great job today.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so late for school.
Do not worry, I am here. What did you do?
I spent all my time on my dog.
That is a sweet choice.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my math book, I am late.
Did you look in your backpack? It is often there.
I checked there, but it is not inside.
I do not know where it went. Do you remember where you put it last?
I think I left it on the desk at home.
I am sorry to hear that. Are you trying to call someone?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the wind is too loud today.
That is nice of you to say. Do you think the trees are tired?
The wind knocks my toys over and makes me feel cold.
I agree, that sounds tough. Have you tried a warm coat?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am late, but I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
Let us try. Do you have a shoe in your hand?
Yes, here it is.
Make a small loop with one end. Do you see the loop?
Yes, I made a loop.
Good job. Now cross the other end over it. Is it firm?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to watch bees.
That is a fun thing to do. Do they buzz a lot?
Yes, they make a loud sound. Why do bees make that sound?
They buzz to talk to other bees. It is their way of saying hello.
I did not know that. Do all bees talk like that?
Most bees do buzz to share news. Do you see them collecting food?
Yes, they have little bags on their legs. That is so cool.
Those bags hold sweet flower dust. It is like a tiny backpack.
I want to see more of their work. Do you know where they live?
They live in a busy home called a hive. It has many rooms.
That sounds like a big house. I will look for one tomorrow.
You might see a queen bee there. She is the big one.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is great to hear. What made you feel so good?
I saw a big tree.
Trees are very nice. Do you like green things?
Yes, I love leaves.
I enjoy leaves too. Are they soft or hard?
They are crisp.
That sounds fun. Do you know why they change color?
I do not know.
I do not know either. It is a good mystery.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I say thank you well?
A clear voice and a smile go far. Do you look people in the eyes?
Yes, I try. What else?
Use the person's name to be kind. Is that hard for you?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I painted a red barn today and I love it.
That sounds lovely. What colors did you use?
Just red, white, and a little blue sky.
Nice mix. Did it dry well?
Yes, it feels smooth and happy.
I am glad you like it.
Thank you for listening.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a pair of sevens. Do I win?
You win if your partner has a higher card. What else do you have?
I have a three. I am sad.
Do not be sad. The next hand might be better. Did you have fun?
Yes, I like it. Can I play again?
Yes, we can play again. I am happy to help you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am waiting for the bus.
That can feel like a long time. Are you having fun?
I am very bored.
I know that feeling. Maybe you can count to ten.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a rainbow today after it stopped raining.
That sounds lovely. What color was the first one you noticed?
It was red, and it looked like a big bridge in the sky.
A bridge in the sky sounds amazing.
