I stood under it and felt very happy.
Being happy is a great feeling. Did you take a picture of it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The lights in my bedroom went out and I am very upset.
I am sorry that happened. Can you see the plug?
Yes, but it feels warm and smells like burnt plastic.
That is a bad sign. Do you feel any sparks?
No, but it hurts my hand a little.
Please let go of the cord. It is dangerous to touch.
Okay, I let go. Why did this happen?
I do not know for sure. Have you plugged in many heaters?
Yes, I have three fans on at once.
That makes a lot of heat. It is best to use fewer things.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to look at the moon, but I do not know how.
The moon is out right now. Do you have a clear view of the sky?
I am outside, but I can see the trees.
The trees block the light. Try walking to an open spot. Is the path safe?
Yes, the path is safe.
Great. You will see it soon. Do you have a blanket for the grass?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my grandpa's keys. I am late.
I do not know where they are. Are they on the table?
No, I looked there. I must go now.
Please check the kitchen. Did you try the last place he sat?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to bring to the party.
Would you like to bring food or a drink?
I want to bring food, but I am stuck.
You can make simple cookies. They are always a hit.
That sounds nice. Do I need to bake them?
Yes, you do. Do you have an oven at home?
Yes, I do. So I will make the cookies.
Great choice. Have a wonderful time there.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big horse in the park.
That looks like fun! Do you like horses?
Yes, I want to pet it, but I am scared.
It is okay to feel scared. Is the horse standing still?
Yes, it is just eating grass.
Good. Try to walk close slowly.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we eat outside?
The fresh air makes food taste better. Do you like the wind?
Yes, I do. Why is the blanket red?
It helps us see it on the grass. Is it bright enough?
I like the color. Why do we bring juice?
Water can taste plain. Do you want some juice?
Yes, please. Why do we sit here?
This spot has a nice view. Can you see the trees?
I see the trees. Why is it so quiet?
I do not know. Do you like the quiet?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big fish with no legs. It looked so sad.
That was a shark, I bet. Did you get to touch the glass?
Yes, I did! Also, where did the bones come from?
Those were from a dinosaur that lived a long time ago. Do you like big bones?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky red, orange, and yellow?
Sunlight hits water drops in the air. Do you see how it splits into colors?
I see them, but why do they look like an arch?
Your eye sees a cone of light, but the ground blocks the bottom. Do you think a circle would be cool?
I do, but I cannot see the whole thing.
You are standing on the ground. That blocks the lower part of the circle.
So it is really a circle then?
Yes, it is a full circle from up high. Do you want to know how the water helps?
I do want to know.
The water drops act like tiny prisms. They bend the light into a shape.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My shirt is all wet and gray.
Oh no. Do you know why the water got dirty?
I put red socks in by mistake.
That happens often. Did you check the color before starting?
No, I was just very tired.
I am sorry to hear that. Let us try to fix it together.
Will it work? I do not know what to do.
I am not sure it will work. Do you have any special soap for this?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am feeling very worried today.
That sounds hard. What made you feel this way?
My dog got lost in the park.
Oh no. Did you find him yet?
No, I looked everywhere.
I am sorry. Let us think of other places.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel so tired. Can you show me how to tie my shoes?
I am glad to help. Do your laces feel stiff?
Yes, they are hard to pull. Where do I start?
I do not know your specific shoe size. Do you have one loop ready?
Yes, I have a loop on the left side. Now what?
Take the other lace and cross it over the first one. Do you see the small hole?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am waiting but I do not know what to do.
That can feel weird. Do you like to draw pictures?
Maybe, but I feel stuck.
I do not know what you like best. Can you take a slow walk?
I think I will try to look out the window.
That sounds calm. Do you see any birds?
No, just the trees and the sky.
Then look at the clouds. They change all the time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. The food at that place was cold and bad.
Oh no, that is very unfair. Did you get to tell the manager?
Yes, but he did not care. I just want my money back.
That is not right. Are you going back tomorrow?
No, never again. I do not trust them anymore.
That makes sense. Stay away to be safe.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very tired and my legs hurt from sitting so long.
Rest your head on the seat and close your eyes. Do you like the clouds outside?
I want to go home but it is still dark outside the window.
We are safe and will land soon. Do you have a snack with you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it safe to swim alone?
It is not safe to swim alone. Do you have a buddy?
No, I swim by myself.
Please find a friend to watch you. Is the water deep there?
The pool is ten feet deep.
I do not know if that is safe for you. Do you know how to float?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my dog lick my face?
Dogs often lick to show love. Do you like when he does it?
Yes, I do. Why does he wag his tail so fast?
That means he is very happy to see you. Is he jumping too?
He jumps all the time. Why does he bark at the mailman?
He may think the mailman is a threat. Does he bark at everyone?
Only at the mailman. Why does he sleep so much?
Dogs sleep to rest their bodies. Do you get tired after playing?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I pack my heavy books?
Put them in small boxes to keep them light. Do you have any small boxes?
Yes, I have some cardboard boxes.
Great, fill them up but stop before they get too heavy. Is that clear?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I caught a big fish in the lake.
That is very cool. Did it jump?
Yes, it jumped really high.
Wow, that was lucky. What color was it?
It was brown with silver sides.
Nice shiny scales. Did you keep it?
No, I put it back in the water.
Good job helping it swim. Do you want to go fishing again?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, I need a square.
A square has four equal sides. Are you drawing it?
Yes, but it looks wrong.
Make sure all corners are ninety degrees. Do you have a ruler?
I do not, I am very late.
Use your hand to check the angles. Is it looking better now?
It looks good, thank you.
I am glad it worked out. Have a safe trip.
Goodbye.
Bye, do not be late.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went for a run today and felt great.
That is wonderful. How long did you run?
It was about ten minutes.
Nice. Do you run every day?
Not every day, but most days.
That is a good habit.
Yes, I really like the fresh air.
I see. Did you listen to music?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. The sun is warm and bright.
That is a lovely feeling. Do you like the green leaves?
Yes, the trees look so full. I love this time of year.
The air feels fresh too. Is it raining outside?
No, it is just a gentle breeze. It feels like a big hug.
That sounds very calm. Do you have a favorite color for this season?
I think it is yellow. The flowers are everywhere.
Yellow is a bright and happy color. Thank you for sharing your joy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do we have to do so much math?
Math helps us count things and share food fair. Do you like counting cookies?
Yes, I love cookies. But the numbers are hard.
Hard parts get easier with practice. Do you like drawing pictures?
I like drawing cats. Can I draw instead of math?
Drawing cats is fun, but math is a skill too. You can do both on different days.
Okay, I will try my best.
That is a great promise. I am proud of you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My screen is dark and I cannot see anything.
Did you press the power button to turn it on?
Yes, but there is no light at all.
Check if the plug is tight in the wall socket.
It is loose, so I pushed it back in.
That usually fixes the power issue. Is the screen bright now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors. Blue light scatters the most in the air. Do you see other colors in the sky?
Yes, I see white clouds.
Clouds block the light from above. They look white because they bounce all colors back. Do you like looking at clouds?
Sometimes I see red sunsets.
At night, sunlight travels through more air. The blue scatters away, leaving red and orange. Do you watch the sunset?
I wish the sky was purple.
Purple is a mix of red and blue. It is rare, but sometimes the sky looks violet. Have you ever seen it?
That is a cool idea.
Nature is full of surprises. Look up often to find them. Do you look at the sky daily?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very lonely today. My friends are busy.
That is a hard feeling. Do you have a pet to cuddle with?
No, I do not. I just want to talk to someone.
I am here to listen. What makes you feel most alone?
I feel like no one cares about me.
I care. Do you want to share a happy memory?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see smoke coming from my house. It looks scary. Is it bad?
It is bad, so we must leave now. Do you have your shoes on?
Yes, I have my shoes. Will the fire go away soon?
I do not know when it will stop. Can you hold my hand tight?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I wash my red shirt?
Put it in with red clothes. Do you have other red items?
Yes, I have socks too. What kind of soap should I use?
Use gentle soap for soft clothes. Are your hands cold?
No, my hands are warm. Should I use hot water?
Use warm water to keep the color bright. Do you like warm baths?
Yes, I do. Is that all I need to do?
Yes, just wash and hang it to dry. Are you excited for clean clothes?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big red sun today.
That sounds bright and warm. Do you like using red?
Yes, it makes me feel happy.
Good for you. Did you draw anything else near it?
I drew a small blue bird.
A nice touch. Does the bird sing?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late! Tell me the months right now.
There are twelve months. What month is it?
I do not care! Just give me the list.
Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun. Do you need help?
The rest, please!
Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec. You are on time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do mountains look so big?
They take a very long time to build up. Do you like climbing up them?
I think they are made of rock. Is that true?
Yes, most of them are. Do you see big rocks near you?
I do not know how they move up. Why do they grow?
The earth shifts and pushes them up. I do not know why it moves exactly.
That is a hard thing to think about.
It is true, but a fun thought. Do you dream of seeing one?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I can't fit the square into the round hole. I want to cry.
That is tricky. Do you have a triangle nearby?
No, I only have the square and the circle. They do not match.
I understand. A square has four sharp corners.
The circle is smooth and round. It feels lonely.
It is not lonely. It is just a perfect shape.
I feel small and silly for trying so hard.
You are not silly. Trying is good work.
I think I will give up.
Rest if you need to. Do you want to try again later?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off the trees?
The tree gets ready for cold sleep and drops its leaves. Do you like the colors?
Yes, they are orange and red.
It helps the tree save its energy for spring. Do you know which tree that was?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to eat my broccoli because it tastes bad.
Yuck can be scary, but little bites are okay. Do you like any green foods?
No, I just want the cookies.
Cookies are sweet, but they make you feel tired and wiggly. Is there a fruit you like?
I like apples, but they are hard to chew.
You can cut them into tiny pieces to make them soft. Do you want to try one?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My horse kicked my fence and I feel very sad.
I am sorry that happened. Is the horse okay?
Yes, he is fine, but I am still angry.
It is normal to feel that way. Do you want to take a walk together?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My head hurts. I am late.
Do you have any water? Please drink some.
I forgot my water.
That is not good. Are you dizzy?
A little. I must run.
Please walk slow. Your health is key.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at this blue bird! I am so glad.
What a nice color. Where did you find it?
My cousin gave it to me. I like it a lot.
That is kind of her. Is it a real bird?
No, it is made of clay. It is very small.
I am glad you are happy. Do you plan to keep it?
Yes, I will put it on my shelf. It looks great there.
That sounds perfect.
I want to give you a piece of my cake. It is sweet.
I cannot say no.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing high notes.
That is a great goal. Do you have a favorite song you want to try?
Yes, but my voice hurts when I try.
You must keep your throat loose. Do you drink warm water?
I do not know how to stay loose.
Take slow, deep breaths in your belly. Does that feel easy?
It feels better, but I am still scared.
That fear is normal. Are you ready to try one simple note?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights just went out. I am scared. What should I do?
Do not worry. Stay calm and wait a minute. Is your phone still on?
Yes, it is on. But I do not know how to fix the power.
Check your fuse box. Sometimes a button needs to be pushed back up. Have you seen the box?
I found it, but I do not know which one is for the lights.
I am not sure about your specific house. Look for a label or a light. Do you see any lights flashing?
One is flashing red. I think I pressed the wrong one.
Turn off the big switch at the bottom. Then turn it back on slowly. Did the lights come on?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts a lot and it is throbbing. Do I have a bad fever?
That feels very painful. Have you checked your temperature?
No, I have not. What should I do first?
Drink some water and rest in a dark room. Please tell me if the pain gets worse.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my keys, but they are stuck to the fridge.
Try a piece of paper in between. Do you like magnets?
Yes, but I am very late. How do I get them off fast?
Tap the fridge gently. Is that working?
Yes, they fell off. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say please and thank you?
You say them when you ask for help or get a gift. Do you usually say them?
I forget sometimes.
Try to think of them before you speak. They make people happy.
Okay, I will try my best.
That is a great plan. Do you want to practice now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a banana but I do not know what to do with it.
It is a sweet yellow fruit. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I do. How do I eat it?
You peel the skin and eat the soft part inside. Is it ready to eat?
I do not know how to tell if it is ready.
Look for small brown spots on the skin. Those mean it is sweet.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The baby is crying and I do not know what to do.
Is the baby hungry or just lonely? Try giving the baby a warm drink.
I tried milk but the baby is still sad.
Sometimes babies just need a hug to feel safe. Is the baby quiet now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is too loud and fast here. How do I stop the noise?
That is a tough place. Do you like quiet spots?
Yes, I want to rest my brain. Where can I go?
Try a small park with trees. Do you like the smell of flowers?
I like the smell of rain. Is that safe?
Rain is safe if you have a coat. Do you have an umbrella?
No, I do not have one. What should I do?
I do not know where you are. Go to the nearest shop for a dry spot.
I am lost in the big square. Can you help me?
I cannot see you. Look for a building with a bright light.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a tiny bug in the garden today.
That is a sweet find. Where did you see it?
It was sitting on a wet leaf.
The rain makes leaves so shiny.
I let it go back to the dirt.
That was a very kind thing to do.
Now I feel happy inside.
Kindness always makes us smile.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I bought a red ball for my friend. Is that a good gift?
A red ball is fun to play with. Does he like sports?
He loves to kick it. What else can I add?
A pair of socks would go with the ball. Are his feet cold in winter?
Yes, he is always chilly. I will buy the socks.
That is a sweet choice. He will be happy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I clean the dusty shelves?
Start by wiping the top shelf with a dry cloth. Do you have a vacuum nearby?
Yes, but I am not sure how to use it for shelves.
Attach the long tube and use the small brush head. Be gentle on fragile things.
What about the sticky spots on the glass?
Mix a little soap with warm water and wipe it on. Does your window look clear now?
It is much better, thank you for the help.
You did a great job keeping your home tidy. I am glad I could help.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to send a picture to my friend online.
You can use a chat app to do that. Do you already have one on your phone?
I don't know which one to pick.
Start with a free app your friend also uses. It makes sharing much easier.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today! It is Sunday. I love this day.
That is good to hear. Do you like to play on Sundays?
Yes, I play all day! It is the best day of the week.
Playing is fun. What is your favorite game?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to eat for breakfast.
Try a bowl of warm oatmeal. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I do.
Mix in some honey and banana slices. Is that easy for you?
It seems simple enough.
Add a little milk if it is too thick. Do you have milk?
I have milk and eggs.
Scrambled eggs are a great choice. Do you like them salty?
I like salt on my eggs.
Eat your eggs and enjoy the day. I hope you feel good.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake a cake but I am afraid to burn it.
That is a common fear. How long is your oven?
My oven is small. What should I do?
Set the timer for you. Do you have a good one?
Yes, I do. How do I know if it is done?
Stick a toothpick in. It should come out clean.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I build a strong snowman?
Pack the snow tight and roll it into three big balls. Do you have a carrot?
No, I do not.
You can use a stick for the nose instead. It works just as well.
What do I do with the snow?
Play with it or let it melt. Are you having fun?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I just lost again. It feels so hard to play well.
That is a tough feeling. Do you want to try one more game?
I think the rules are too many to remember.
Rules can feel big at first. Which piece confuses you the most?
The knight is the hardest part for me.
That piece moves in a funny way. Do you want to look at how it jumps?
Maybe. I am still a bit mad at the board.
Anger is okay. Let us take a small break first.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
Bees drink sweet plant juice called nectar. Do you like sweet treats?
I love candy. So what do they do with the nectar?
They store it in their special stomachs to make it thick.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do trees stand so still?
They are holding on to the dirt with their roots. Do you see the roots?
I see the dirt, but not the roots.
The roots are hidden deep underground. They are like fingers digging in.
Do they get cold in the snow?
Their leaves fall off to stay safe. Do you wear a coat when it is cold?
Yes, I wear a warm coat.
Trees do not wear coats, but they sleep in the winter. I do not know if they feel the cold.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I draw a circle?
Start with a small dot and move your hand in a smooth round path. Do you have a round cookie?
Yes, I do.
You can trace around the cookie to make a perfect circle.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I sleep better at night?
Try reading a book before bed to feel calm. Do you like stories?
Yes, I like animals. What else can I do?
Keep your room dark and cool for better rest. Is your bed soft?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a basket of food but I do not know where to go.
Where do you like to sit?
I like grass, but the weather is a bit windy.
A park with big trees is a good spot. Do you have a blanket?
Yes, I have a blue one, but I forgot the plates.
You can use paper plates. Did you pack cups?
No, I only have one cup for myself.
That is okay for water. Do you want to bring snacks for friends?
I am not sure if anyone will come.
I do not know who will join you. Enjoy your day either way.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to set the time on this new clock.
That is a great question. Do you see the small buttons on the side? Just press the top one until the hour matches the real time.
I pressed the button and the numbers changed. How do I make it stop moving?
Well done. You can stop it by waiting one second or pressing the side button. Did you get the hour right?
Yes, the hour is correct. What should I do next?
Great job. Now press the top button again to set the minutes.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like that song with the drums.
The drums make a fun beat. Do you like fast songs?
Yes, I do. What is a verse?
A verse tells the main story. It comes before the chorus. Do you know the words?
I think so. Thank you.
You are welcome. Keep listening to it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big boat on the sea.
That must have been fun. Do you like boats?
The men on it look strong.
Many sailors are strong. They help move things.
Why do they go on the water?
They carry goods to other places.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a dog today. It was barking at a bird.
That sounds exciting. What did the dog look like?
It was big and brown. I said hello to a friend after that.
Being friendly is good. Did you share your toys?
Yes, I shared my red ball. We had fun together.
Sharing makes friends happy. How did you feel?
I felt very warm inside. I am going to rest now.
Rest well.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here at the sand. I do not know what to do.
The water looks nice. Do you like the smell of the salt?
It smells strange to me. I feel cold.
You might get wet. Would you like a warm blanket?
No, I only want to watch the waves.
That is a good choice. Do the waves move slowly?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sky is full of white fluff. I do not know where to go.
Do you like sunny days or rainy days? You can always go to the park to watch them drift by.
I think I like the sunny ones. The rain makes me feel sad.
That is a nice thought. Have you tried flying a kite when the sun is out?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to fix my little boat. What tool do I need?
You might need glue. Is it broken in one spot?
Yes, the side is split.
You can use strong glue there. Do you have any?
No, I do not. Where can I get it?
The shop down the road sells it. I hope it helps.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I saw bees make honey, but I do not know how. Can you help me?
Bees drink sweet plant juice and turn it into honey. Do you like sweet food?
I am still confused about what the bees do after they drink the juice.
They fan the juice with their wings to dry it into honey. Do you know which flowers bees visit?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like hot drinks, but I do not know what is good for me.
Do you sleep well at night?
Not always, I wake up too early.
Try tea, it has less stuff to wake you up than coffee.
I tried tea once, it tasted like leaves.
Have you tried adding a little sugar?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The sun is too hot today. I am not having fun.
I am sorry it feels so warm. Do you want some cold water?
My ice cream melted all over my hand.
That is very sticky and sad. Do you have a napkin?
I am so tired of this heat. I want to go home.
Home sounds like a good idea. Is your house cool inside?
Yes, the air is fresh there.
Great, I will go now. Have a nice rest.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the best food for the morning?
I think warm toast with butter is very good. Do you like sweet or salty things?
I like sweet things. What do you eat?
I do not eat food, but I can help you find recipes.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say please when I want a toy?
Just add the word please to the end. Do you know how to smile?
Yes, I can smile. But what if they say no?
You say thank you anyway. Is that hard for you?
No, it is easy. I will try it.
Good luck with that.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a great play today.
That sounds fun. What was it about?
It was about a talking cat.
A talking cat is silly. Did you like the jokes?
Yes, I laughed a lot.
I am glad you had fun. Do you want to go again?
Maybe next week.
Next week sounds good. I hope you enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is great news. What made you feel so good?
I watched a robot dance.
Robots can move in many ways. Was the dance funny?
It was very silly and fun.
Robots are made to help us. Do you have one at home?
Not yet, but I want one.
That is a big dream. How will you use it?
I want it to read to me.
A reading robot sounds nice.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today and I want to tell you.
That is good to hear. What makes you smile so much?
I said please and thank you to the baker.
You did a nice thing. Did he look happy?
He smiled at me and gave me a free cookie.
That is a sweet reward. Do you like cookies?
Yes, they are very sweet and warm.
They sound delicious. Do you share them with others?
I always share my treats with my friend.
Sharing is a great sign of good manners.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go on a trip next week, but I do not know where to go.
That sounds like fun. Do you like cold places?
I love the snow, but I also like the warm sun.
You could pick a beach town with a little snow nearby. Do you like to swim?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go to the sea soon. Do you have any tips?
Bring a hat to keep your head cool. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I love swimming in the waves. What should I bring in my bag?
Pack a towel and a bottle of water. Do you have any friends coming with you?
My sister is coming with me. Is the sand always hot?
The sand is warm in the sun, but cool at night. Do you like to dig in the sand?
I do like digging. How deep can I dig?
You can dig as deep as you like, but be careful of shells. Do you want to find a nice shell?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Who built the pyramids?
The ancient Egyptians built them for their kings. Did you know they were huge?
What were they for?
They were homes for the kings after they died. Do you like old stories?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does that bug have so many legs?
It is a millipede. Do you like its color?
I think it is creepy.
Some people do. It is just trying to find food.
Where do bugs go in the winter?
Many sleep in the dirt. Do you wonder why they do that?
Do they get cold like I do?
Yes, they feel the cold too.
Can we put it in a jar?
We can, but we must let it go later. Is it time to play?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am stuck on my next move.
Let us see your board. What is blocking your queen?
My rook is in the way.
A rook can move straight lines. Does it block your path?
Yes, it goes up and down.
Could you move the rook to a safe square?
I do not know if it is safe.
Check if the enemy king can catch it. Is it far from their pieces?
It is far away.
Great, move it then. Did that open a path for your queen?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my phone screen all dark and cold?
The battery is likely empty. Have you tried plugging it in?
I plugged it in, but it still will not turn on.
That is odd, but it needs time. Did you use the right cord?
Yes, I used the small black cord.
Please wait a few minutes. Is there any light on at all?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel alone and I do not know what to do.
That sounds hard. Do you have any friends nearby?
I think I do, but I forgot how to talk to them.
I understand. Would you like to try texting one?
I am afraid they will say no.
It is okay to be scared. What is the worst thing that could happen?
I might just sit here and feel worse.
Let us sit here together for now. Do you want to tell me more?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Can you tell me where my grandpa is?
I think he is in the garden. Is he happy today?
I do not know. I have to go.
Maybe he is sitting on the red chair. Do you have time for a hug?
No, I must run.
Okay, go fast. Tell him I said hi.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The lights just went out. It is very dark. What should I do?
Do not worry. Is everyone safe?
Yes, we are fine. But I cannot see. How do I find a light?
Use your phone screen. It makes a good lamp.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck on my math homework and do not know what to do.
Do not worry, I am here to help you. What is the first problem asking you to do?
It wants me to add the red apples to the green ones.
That sounds easy. How many red apples can you see?
There are five red apples and two green apples.
Add those two numbers together to get your answer. Do you have a pencil ready to write it down?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My tent is wet and I am cold.
That feels bad. Did you find a dry spot for your pack?
No, the ground was all mud.
Mud is a tricky thing. How deep was it?
It went past my boots. I am sad.
I am sorry. Let's look for a rock to sit on.
Okay, I hope it is warm.
A warm rock helps. Do you have any dry socks?
Yes, I still have my good socks.
That is good news. Let's put on the socks now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It feels very cold here. What should I wear?
A warm coat is a good idea. Do you have a scarf?
Yes, I have a big red one.
Great, that will keep your neck safe from the wind.
It looks gray outside. Will it rain later?
I do not know the future, but the sky looks heavy. Is there wind?
Yes, the trees are moving fast.
Please take an umbrella just in case.
Okay, I will put it in my bag.
That is a smart choice for a dry day.
Do I need to carry an umbrella?
Yes, better to have it and not need it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does a big ship stay on the water and not sink?
The ship pushes water down, and the water pushes it back up. Do you know what we call that push?
I think that push is called buoyancy. Is it true that filling it with air helps?
Yes, the air makes the ship light enough to float. Do you want to see a test in a tub?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go in this quiet town.
Try the warm bakery on the main street. Do you like the smell of fresh bread?
I think I will go there, but I am still a little lost.
Just walk straight until you see the big red door. What is your favorite color?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My new fence looks too tall for my small garden.
It might be a bit big. Do you like the wood color?
I think it is nice, but I feel blocked in.
That is good that you noticed. Have you tried adding some plants?
Plants might help, but I want to see the sky.
You could cut the top open. Does your neighbor mind?
He does not, and I like the open view.
Great. I hope it feels free now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My head hurts, and I want to know how to fix it.
I do not know your exact pain, but I can suggest a warm wash. Do you have a towel?
Yes, I have a towel, but I do not know how to use it.
You should wet it and place it on your forehead. Does that feel better?
It feels cold, but it helps a little.
That is a good sign. You can rest now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sea so big?
It holds a lot of water. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I do. Why is the water salt?
Rain washes rock dust into the ocean. Do you know where rain comes from?
From clouds. Why do waves move?
Wind pushes the water. Do you feel the breeze?
Yes, it is cool. Why does the sea crash?
I do not know for sure. Do you hear the sound?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared the train will go too fast.
Do not worry, the train is very safe. Do you like looking out the window?
The wheels make a loud buzzing sound.
That sound means the train is moving well. Is it a loud buzz or a soft hum?
I want to see the blue ocean soon.
The ocean is a big, cold body of water. I do not know exactly when you will get there.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: This city is very loud and I do not know where to go.
It feels big and fast, does it not? Do you like the sound?
I am tired of the noise and just want to sit down.
There is a quiet park just on the left. You can rest your legs there.
That sounds nice, but I forgot my book at home.
You can look at the trees instead. Do you like trees?
Yes, I do. Thank you for the help.
I am glad you feel better now. Have a happy day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. I do not want to do anything.
That sounds hard. Are your eyes very heavy?
Yes. My body feels like lead.
I am sorry you feel this way. Have you eaten anything today?
No. I just want to lie down.
Rest is good. Do you want to drink some water?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad. I said I would help you with the plants, but I forgot.
That is okay. I am not angry. Did you forget because you were busy?
Yes, I was playing and lost track of time. I do not want to break my promise.
Thanks for telling me. We can do it tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to keep my old toys. Should I throw them away?
No, do not throw them away. They are yours to keep. Do you like all of them?
Yes, I love them. How should I put them away?
You can use a box or a basket. Put the big ones in first. Do you have a big box?
Yes, I have a big box. Where should I put the box?
Put it in a corner where it fits. That keeps your room clean.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I dreamt of a big green island with a giant tree. It felt so real.
That sounds like a lovely place to rest. Do you know where that dream came from?
I think it was from a picture I saw long ago. I want to go there.
A clear plan is a good start. What do you hope to find first?
I want to climb the tree and see the whole world from up top.
That sounds like a high and happy goal. I do not know the way, but your wish is bright.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big tree today. Why is it so tall?
It grew very slowly for many years. Do you like climbing trees?
I like climbing, but the big ones are too high. Do trees have feelings?
I do not know if they feel happy, but they like sun and rain. Does your tree have big leaves?
Yes, the leaves are green and wide. How does it get its food?
It makes its own food using the sun. Do you play under its shade?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do bees make honey?
They make it from flower nectar to eat later. Do you like honey on toast?
I love it. Do all bugs have six legs?
Yes, all true insects have six legs. Do you have any bugs at home?
I have ants in my garden. Are they strong?
Yes, they can carry things much heavier than their body. Do you watch them closely?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at this math sheet.
That sounds hard. What part is bugging you?
The fractions look like a mess to me.
Fractions can be tricky. Do you have a pencil?
Yes, but I still feel like I am stuck.
Try drawing circles for the pie. Can you count the slices?
Okay, I see four big pieces now.
Good job. Let me know if you need more help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I start work tomorrow but I feel very scared.
It is normal to feel that way. Have you packed your bag?
Yes, but I do not know what to wear.
Simple clothes are best. Do you have a clean shirt?
I have one, but it might be too casual.
Better to be safe and comfortable. What does the job actually do?
I think I will be typing things all day.
That sounds like a quiet task. Do you like using a keyboard?
I am not sure, I just want to stop worrying.
One step at a time is all you can do. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is great to hear. What made you smile?
My teacher gave me a star.
That is a wonderful surprise. Did you work hard for it?
Yes, I tried my best.
I am proud of you.
Thank you for listening.
I am always here for you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a square that will not fit in the box. What should I do?
Try turning it on its side. Is the box open?
No, the lid is stuck. It feels tight.
Tap the box gently on the table. Do you have a thin tool?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for work.
Did you feed the cat?
No, I forgot.
That is not good for her. Do you have any food?
Yes, but I must go.
Leave the bowl out. Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do flowers have colors?
They use colors to tell bees where the sweet food is. Do you like red ones?
Yes, I like the red ones a lot.
That is a nice choice. Do you want to draw a red flower?
Yes, I can draw a big red flower.
That sounds like fun. I do not know how to draw, but I love flowers.
Me too, I think they are very pretty.
They are indeed very pretty.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake bread.
That is a lovely idea. Do you have the right tools at home?
Yes, I have a bowl and a spoon.
Great start. I do not know your local shop prices.
Can you tell me what I need first?
You need flour, water, and yeast. Is that all clear?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Where is the mail box?
It is right there by the door. Is it a letter or a box?
Just a letter. Do I need a stamp?
Yes, you need a stamp. Have you bought one yet?
Yes, I have it. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Go quick.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is that place open?
Yes, it is open right now. Are you hungry?
Is it very loud?
It is quite loud, yes. Do you like loud places?
Is it cheap?
I do not know for sure. What is your budget?
Is it close?
Yes, it is near you. Can you walk?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see a rainbow! I must go now.
It is bright and pretty. Do you know its colors?
No, I am late for work.
Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet. That is the song we sing.
That is very helpful, thank you.
I am happy I could help. Do you like the rain?
Not really, but the sky is clear now.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do fish come up when I tap the water?
I think they get scared by the noise. Do you see them splash?
Why does the fishy smell get so strong?
That comes from the fish bodies. Do you wear gloves?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like hot tea, but I want to feel awake. What should I pick?
Coffee usually helps you feel more awake. Do you like it sweet?
Yes, I do. How much sugar is good?
Try one small spoon. That is a good start.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The water looks so cold and blue.
Yes, it is very deep and cool there. Do you like to swim?
I do not have a boat to go out.
That is right, you cannot go to the middle without help.
Is there a fish under the rocks?
I do not know for sure, but I see ripples moving.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to tie a good fishing knot.
You can start by making a loop in the line. Do you have a thick or thin line?
It is a thin line.
You can wrap the end around the hook three times. What does your bait look like?
It is a small red worm.
Place the worm on the hook after the wraps. How deep do you plan to cast?
I will just cast into the calm water.
Pull the loop tight so it stays secure. Do you have a bucket for your fish?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn a new language, but I do not know how to start.
That is a big goal. Do you have a favorite song or book?
I like stories, but I am afraid I will make many mistakes.
Mistakes help you learn. What story makes you happy?
I do not know. Should I just watch videos?
Watching is a good start. Do you like to sing along?
I am not sure. What should I do first?
Try one small word every day. Is that easy for you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a bright star while walking home today.
That sounds like a nice moment. Did you see any other stars?
No, just that one. It was very bright.
I do not know where you saw it. What was the sky like?
The sky was very dark and clear.
A clear sky is good for seeing stars. Did you feel happy?
Yes, I felt very calm.
Being calm is a good feeling. Thank you for sharing that.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I feed a chicken?
You just scatter the seeds on the ground. Do you have any seeds?
Yes, I have corn.
That is a good food for them.
How do I tell if a cow is happy?
Look for a wagging tail and relaxed ears. What does your cow do?
She just stands still.
That might mean she is tired.
How do I ride a horse safely?
I do not know, so please ask an expert.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very scared about my big talk today.
That is a normal feeling. Do you have your notes ready?
Yes, I read them all night, but my hands shake.
Try to take slow breaths to calm your body.
Will that really stop the shaking?
It can help you feel more in control.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how this clock works.
Do you see the small hands?
Yes, I see them, but I am confused.
The short hand shows the hour.
What does the long hand do?
It shows the minutes.
I still feel lost.
Try moving the short hand to one.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am hitting the ball into the net a lot. What can I do to stop this?
Try to hit the ball higher over the net. Do you feel like your arm is tired?
Yes, my arm hurts. How should I hold the racket?
Hold it light, not tight. Can you show me your grip?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The gift broke.
I am sorry to hear that. What did it look like?
It was a red car. Now it is in pieces.
That is not good. Does your dad fix things?
I do not know. I want to cry.
It is okay to cry. I am here with you.
It hurts my heart.
I believe you. How can I help?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very sad today. I want to tell you.
I am sorry you feel this way. What is making you sad?
My dog is gone. I miss him a lot.
That is very hard. Do you have a photo of him?
I do not know where it is. I just want to feel better.
I hear you. Would a hug help?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up on Monday and felt very tired.
That sounds tough. Did you get any rest?
Not much, but I went for a short walk in the park.
Fresh air is a great idea. What did you see?
I saw a big brown dog and played with him for a bit.
That must have made you smile. Did you eat lunch after?
Yes, I had a warm soup and some bread.
Yum. Is Tuesday looking better for you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a small boat by the lake. Can I take it for a ride?
It looks nice. Do you know how to paddle?
I do not know how to paddle. What should I do?
Please leave the boat there. It is not safe to use without help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a gift for my friend but I am late.
What did they like last year?
They love books but I have no time to pick one.
That is hard to guess. Do you have a card?
Yes, but I need a box to put it in.
A box is not a present. Did you buy the book yet?
No, I am still at the door.
Please slow down. Is the book even open?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind blew very hard today.
That sounds quite loud. Did it make a lot of noise?
Yes, the trees bent low to the ground.
I do not know where you live, but that sounds scary.
Then the rain started to fall fast.
I hope you stayed warm and safe. Do you like the smell of rain?
Now the sun is coming out again.
That is a happy ending to a wild day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My cat is not eating his food. What should I do?
That sounds worrying. Is he playing and moving around like normal?
He is sleeping a lot. His eyes look a bit red.
Red eyes can mean an infection. It is best to see a doctor soon. Do you have a vet nearby?
I do not know where to take him.
I do not know your area. Please look for a "cat hospital" on a map.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I heard a song that makes me feel very happy.
That is wonderful to hear. Do you know who sang it?
No, I do not. The voice is very soft.
That is a lovely detail. Maybe it is a lullaby.
It sounds like a lullaby. I love the melody.
Melodies can be very sweet. Do you hum it often?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am afraid to swim in the deep water.
It is normal to feel scared. Do you wear a floaty?
Yes, I always wear a bright orange floaty.
That is a good tool for safety. Have you tried a pool with steps?
I have never been in a pool.
I do not know your exact fear. Start in shallow water first.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go to the red house with the big trees. Do they have pizza?
Yes, they do. It is very hot and yummy. Do you like cheese?
Yes, I love cheese. Is it far from my home?
It is not far at all. It is just around the corner. Do you want to walk there?
I want to walk, but my feet are tired. Can we take the car?
Sure, we can take the car. It will be quick and easy. Are you ready to go?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very excited for my big day tomorrow.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What is your favorite treat?
I love cake with lots of red icing.
Yum, that sounds sweet. Do you like singing songs too?
Yes, I will sing for all my friends.
That is a lovely idea. How many friends will come?
I think ten friends will come to play.
That is a great little party. Have a happy time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have twelve months?
We split the year so we can plan and keep time. Do you like winter or summer best?
I like summer, but why is it not all summer?
The earth tilts, so the sun warms different places at different times. That is a simple truth.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are there so many balloons in the living room?
They help make the room feel fun and bright. Do you like red or blue balloons?
Why is the table so big?
It is big so everyone can sit and eat together. Is your favorite food on it?
Why is the music loud?
Loud music makes people want to dance. Do you know how to dance?
Why is the host smiling so much?
He is happy because his friends came. What is your favorite part of the party?
Why do we have to leave now?
The party is over and it is late. Do you want to go home to sleep?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to build a shed right now, I am running out of time.
That is exciting. Do you have your tools ready?
Yes, I have them. What do I do first?
Start with the floor frame. Is your ground flat?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you keep that box hidden?
It holds a small surprise for you. Do you like secrets?
What is inside the box?
I cannot tell you yet. Are you ready to wait?
Why must I wait?
It is more fun to find out slowly. Do you enjoy surprises?
Can I just open it now?
Not yet, please wait. Is it hard to be patient?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am so lost. Which month is it?
It is the month with the cold snow. Do you like the winter?
I don't know what to do. It feels long and gray.
That is hard. Maybe you can read a warm book?
I am still not sure. What should I pick?
I do not know your taste. Do you like stories or songs?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the post office. I am late.
It is on the main street. Are you going to mail a letter?
Can I walk there?
Yes, just follow the river. Do you like water?
I must go now.
Good luck. Is it a big letter?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to change a dirty diaper.
First, open the clean one. Do you like holding small babies?
Yes, they are so soft. What do I do next?
Place the new diaper under the baby.
Okay, it is under them. Now what?
Wrap the front up and stick the tape.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why is my clock stuck? I am so mad.
I am sorry. Is the battery empty?
I think so, but it looks full.
Try a new one. Do you have one?
No, I do not have a new one.
That is a problem. I do not know how to fix it without one.
I want to know the time right now.
Check your phone. Do you have one with you?
No, I left it at home.
I am sorry. I do not know what to do then.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look! A blue bird is eating seeds in the grass. It is so pretty and makes me feel good.
That is a lovely sight. What kind of bird is it?
I think it is a blue jay. I love watching them hop around the tree.
That sounds like a happy morning.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to draw a house but it looks all wonky and I feel sad.
That is okay to feel. Did you try again after the first try?
No, I just stopped because my fingers hurt from holding the pen.
Your hard work matters even if the art is messy. Do you like picking up the pen again?
Maybe, but I worry I will make it worse if I start over.
You are brave for trying so hard. What is your very first step?
I think I will just draw the door first since I know how to do lines.
That is a great plan to start with what you know.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to run faster. How do I do that?
Run with your arms bent and your head up. Do you stretch before you go?
I stretch for a bit. How long should I run each day?
Start with just five minutes. It is better to be short than tired. Do you like this kind of sport?
Yes, I like it. How do I stop when I am done?
Slow down to a walk for a few minutes. Your heart needs to calm down. How do you feel right now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure if I should act in the play.
That is hard. Do you like acting?
I like it, but I am scared of making a mistake.
Mistakes help us learn. Are you ready to try?
Maybe. I feel a little braver now.
That is good. I hope you enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the light on the top of the big rock?
It helps boats see where they are in the dark. Do you like looking at lights?
Yes. Is there a person living inside the tall tower?
Yes, a keeper lives there to watch the sea. Do you have a bedroom that is high up?
No, my room is on the ground floor. Is the tower very cold inside?
It can be cold, but the fire keeps it warm. Do you play inside or outside?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel too tired to work from home.
Rest is good. What help do you need?
My desk is too messy.
A clean spot helps. Do you have a box?
I have a lot of papers.
Put them in the box. How is your space now?
It feels much better.
I am glad. How does it feel now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The water looks very calm today. Is it safe to walk along the edge?
Yes, it is safe. Do you like the boat?
I love the boat. Can I take my shoes off on the pier?
Yes, you can, but watch for wet spots. Do you have dry socks?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the rain. It makes everything wet and cold.
That is a sad feeling. Do you have a good umbrella?
No, I lost it yesterday. Now my shoes are full of water.
Oh no, that is not fun at all. Do you have dry socks at home?
I think so, but I have to walk there. It is very far.
That sounds tiring. Do you walk fast or slow?
I walk slow because I do not want to slip.
That is a wise choice. Do you like the sound of rain?
Sometimes, but only when I am in a warm bed.
Warm beds are the best place to be. Do you have a blanket ready?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Can I cross this island?
Yes, the path is clear. Are you going to the beach?
No, I need the boat now. Is the ferry close?
I do not know the time. Do you have a map?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The wind is blowing my hat away, I need to go.
Hold onto it tight so it does not fall. Are you afraid of falling?
No, I just need to catch it before I am late.
Run and grab it quick. Do you like windy days?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today!
That is lovely. What made you so glad?
The apple at the market was sweet.
Sweet apples are a joy. Did you buy many?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn about the past, but I do not know where to start.
That is a big topic. Do you like stories about kings?
Yes, I like kings. What else is there to learn?
You can look at old pictures. Do you have any books at home?
I have a book, but it is thick and hard to read.
Reading is good work. You can start with one page a day.
One page a day sounds like a lot of work.
It helps you know things well. What is your favorite part of history?
I think I like how things changed over time.
That is a smart way to see it. You are ready to begin.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My computer is stuck and I am so mad.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you see any lights on the screen?
No, it is just a black screen.
Let us try holding the power button for ten seconds. Do you want to try that?
It turned off and now it will not start.
That sounds like a power issue. I do not know why it happened.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I said sorry and now I feel very good.
That is a nice feeling. How did the other person react?
They smiled and gave me a hug.
I am happy for you. You were brave to speak up.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I sank in the pool and got water in my nose. It hurt a lot.
That must have felt bad. Do you wear goggles when you swim?
No, I do not. I just forgot to put them on today.
Goggles help keep water out. Would you like to try wearing them next time?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, I am late! How do I stop the rabbits from eating my flowers?
You can build a small wooden fence around the bed. Do you have wood yet?
I do not have any wood. Can I use something else?
You might use old planks from a shed. Where is your shed?
It is far away. I must run now, thank you!
Good luck. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked by the pond today.
The water looks nice. Is it quiet?
Yes, it was very still.
That sounds peaceful.
I saw a duck swim around.
How cute. Did it quack?
No, it was asleep on the ice.
Oh no, that is cold. Is it safe?
Yes, the ice is thick.
Good. I am glad it is safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How does the bread get so big and puffy?
Yeast eats the sugar and makes gas bubbles. Do you like sweet dough?
Yes I do. How do I make it rise in my kitchen?
Keep it warm and cover it with a towel. Is your house warm enough?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the baby crying?
He is likely hungry or wet. Do you want to check his diaper?
Why does he have red cheeks?
That means he is warm. Is the room too hot?
Why does he smile so much?
He is happy and safe. Is he smiling at you?
Why does he need so much sleep?
He is growing very fast. I hope you get some rest too.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my red shoe in the mud.
That is a problem. Did you look under the bench?
I did, but it is gone.
Let us search the garden next.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does my bread get so big?
Yeast makes gas to puff it up. Do you use fresh yeast?
I do not know what to do.
Add a little water and sugar. Is your kitchen warm?
The room is cold and the bread is small.
Put it near a warm spot. I do not know your oven's exact heat.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Look at the sky.
It is a beautiful rainbow. Are you going to school?
Yes. I almost missed the bus.
Run fast. Do you see the red part?
I can see it. It is so bright.
It looks like a big bridge.
I must go now.
Be safe on your way.
Thanks for the chat.
You are welcome. Have fun today.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to eat more fruits, but I do not know where to start.
Bananas are easy and sweet. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I love sweet food.
Apples are also very good. Do you like crunching on apples?
I do not know if I like them.
Try one small piece tomorrow. It may taste nice.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am very tired from packing my books.
That is a heavy job. How many boxes did you fill?
I filled eight boxes and my back hurts.
You should rest now. Do you have a friend to help?
My sister is coming later to help.
That is good news. She will make it easier.
I think so, but it is still a lot of work.
Taking it slow is wise.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a weird dream last night. I was flying over the ocean on a purple whale.
That sounds amazing. Did you feel scared?
No, I felt very free. The whale sang a happy song as we moved through the clouds.
I am glad you enjoyed it. What did the whale look like exactly?
It had shiny blue spots and a big friendly smile. Waking up made me feel great.
Dreams can be so fun. I am happy you had a good day after that.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn to ride a bike.
That is a great goal. Do you have a friend to help you?
Yes, my brother is coming over today.
That sounds fun. Are you scared of falling?
A little bit, but I am determined to try.
Fear is normal. Just keep your eyes on the road, and you will do well.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which toy to pick.
What is your favorite color?
I like blue, but I am not sure.
Let us look at the blue toys together. Do you like that small car?
Yes, it looks fun.
That is a good choice. Shall we go to pay for it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big sand castle.
That sounds like a great idea. How tall do you want it to be?
Maybe as high as my head.
That is a good height for a castle. Do you have a bucket to scoop the sand?
Yes, I have a blue bucket and a spoon.
You are all ready to work. Good luck with your building.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know about robots, but I am very late.
Robots are machines that can move and work. Are you going to a robot show?
No, I am just busy. Do they think like us?
Some can think a little, but they do not feel. Do you have a robot at home?
No. Do they need to sleep?
No, they do not sleep, but they do need power. I hope you make it on time.
Thanks. I must go now.
Good luck. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What should I do?
Run fast to your door. Do you have your keys?
I think I left them on the table.
Oh no. That is hard. Do you live alone?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at my horse, he will not listen.
I am sorry you feel that way. What did he do?
He kicked over my toy and ran away.
That is very frustrating. Do you think he was scared?
No, he just looked at me and grinned.
A horse cannot really grin, but he may be playing. Have you tried a new game?
I tried carrots, but he still ignored me.
Sometimes they need rest before they play. Is he tired?
I guess he is, my back hurts from riding.
Good, rest can help you both. Do you want to sit together?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I take a picture of my screen?
You press the key with a camera mark on it. Do you have a keyboard?
Yes, I found it. What happens next?
The picture saves by itself. Do you like taking photos?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I forgot my lunch box today.
Oh no, that is tricky. Do you have any snacks in your bag?
I have a small bar of chocolate.
That is a sweet start. Do you want to buy a sandwich?
I do, but I have no cash.
I can lend you some coins. Would you like that?
Yes, please. I will pay you back later.
You are welcome. I hope the chocolate tastes good.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The rain is falling hard and I do not know what to do.
That sounds tricky. Do you have an umbrella?
I forgot it at home, so I am stuck inside.
That is a fact. Do you like reading books?
I do, but I feel sad that I cannot play outside.
Rain often makes people feel that way. Do you have a favorite toy?
I have a teddy bear, but I just want to go out.
I cannot stop the rain, but you can cuddle your bear for now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to make tea this morning, but it spilled all over the floor.
Oh no, that sounds messy. Did you get to drink it before it spilled?
I had one sip, but then I had to make coffee instead because I was scared of the wet floor.
Good choice to switch. Is your coffee hot and nice?
Yes, it is hot and sweet. I think I might have a small cookie with it too.
That sounds like a lovely start to the day. Do you like cookies with coffee?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I walked for an hour today. My legs feel so good!
That is great news. Did you enjoy the fresh air?
Yes, it was so nice out there.
I am glad you feel well.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a tiny island with soft sand. It feels so warm under my toes.
That sounds like a happy place. Do you see any bright flowers?
Yes, the sand feels like a soft blanket. I want to bring you there.
I would love to sit in the sun. Is the water clear and blue?
The water is clear and very blue. I am so glad I found it.
Nature can make our hearts feel light.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a big red balloon for my birthday.
That is a lovely color. What shape is it?
It is round and goes up very high.
I love how balloons look in the sky. Do you have a string?
Yes, I have a long blue string to hold it.
That sounds like a lot of fun to take for a walk.
I want to fly it in the park with you.
I am happy to walk with you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My head hurts so bad and I feel sick.
I am sorry you are in pain. Have you tried drinking some water?
Yes, but it still hurts a lot.
Please go see a doctor if it does not stop. Do you feel dizzy right now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to leave now. What did the new neighbor buy?
I saw a big box. Did you see a dog inside it?
No, I was too busy. Is the box open now?
I do not know for sure. Do you want me to check the window?
Yes, please do that quickly. I am almost out the door.
Okay, I will look. Be safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. I just want to nap all day.
That is a very fair feeling. Do you feel sad about it too?
Yes, I am a bit upset. I have so much to do but no energy.
It is hard to work when you are drained. I do not know the exact fix for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie a shoe.
Start by making a cross with the laces. Do you have red laces?
Yes, I do. What do I do next?
Pull tight to make a little knot. It is almost done.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am new here and I do not know where to go.
That is okay. What do you like to eat?
I love cake and fresh air.
Try the bakery by the park.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do some months have thirty days and some have thirty-one?
That is a good question. We use this pattern to keep our year close to the time it takes the Earth to circle the Sun. Do you like long months or short ones?
I like short months. Why does February have so few days?
We add a day to February every four years to keep the seasons in place. It helps our calendar stay true. Do you watch the snow in winter?
Yes, I do. Why is July so hot in my home?
That happens because the Earth is tilted toward the Sun in summer. The light makes everything warm. Do you play outside when it is hot?
I play in the shade. Why do we count the days in months at all?
We count days to plan our work and play. It helps us remember when special days come. Do you keep a calendar?
I do not have one. Why do some months start on a Monday and some on a Sunday?
I do not know the exact reason for that specific start. But it makes each month feel different. Do you notice the day of the week changes?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost. What should I do?
Do not worry. Are you near a big park?
I see trees but no people.
Stay in one spot. Is your phone with you?
My phone is dead.
Look for a shop. Do you smell food?
No. I feel scared.
A kind helper will come soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Why does my bread get big? I need to know fast.
Yeast makes air bubbles inside. Is it for dinner?
Yes, dinner is soon. Does it need heat?
Yes, warm spots help the yeast work. Do you like sweet bread?
I do. Can I skip the wait?
No, the bubbles need time to grow.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a huge red apple at the market today.
That sounds sweet! Do you like red apples?
Yes, they are my favorite fruit.
Good choice. Is the market busy now?
It is very full of people.
I do not know if it is crowded in the fruit section.
It is a bit crowded, but I am happy to look around.
Great. Have fun!
Thank you, I will see you later.
Goodbye.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did you pick this book?
I picked it because I like funny stories. Do you like funny stories?
Yes, I do! Why does the cover have a cat?
The cat is very silly. Is that the only thing you like?
I also like puzzles. Why is there a puzzle in the back?
I put one in for you to solve.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The fish did not bite all day.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you try a new spot?
Yes, but the water was too warm.
Warm water makes fish lazy. Do you like catching big fish?
I just want one to feel happy.
Patience helps you catch them.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a box with two keys. One opens the door, one does not. How do I find the right one?
That is a tricky choice. Do you have a way to test them quickly?
I can try one, but if it is wrong, I have to wait.
Try the first key. If it works, you win. If not, the other one must be right.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are trees so tall?
They grow up to reach the sun. Do you like watching clouds?
Yes, I do. Why do leaves fall in the cold weather?
Trees save water when it is cold. Do you enjoy picking them up?
Sometimes. Why do trunks get thick?
A big trunk holds the tree up strong. Do you like hugging trees?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today. I want to pick some daisies for you.
That is very sweet. Do you like the smell of them?
Yes, they smell like fresh air. I think I will put them in the blue vase.
The blue vase will look lovely. Are you planning to give them to someone?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. What is that bug?
It looks like a ladybug. Do you have a pet?
No time. Just tell me if it hurts.
It does not sting. Do you like animals?
I need to go now. Are they smart?
Yes, they are clever. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big fish jump out of the river today.
That looks like so much fun. Did you see it again?
No, but the water was very clear and cold.
Cold water feels good on a hot day. Do you swim there?
I just sat on the bank and watched the boats go by.
Sitting and watching is nice too. Was it quiet?
Yes, only the sound of the water moving.
That sounds very peaceful and calm.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see the moon, but I do not know what to do.
You can look at it for a long time. Do you like the night?
Yes, I do, but I am still not sure what to do.
You can just stand there and feel calm. Do you feel tired?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The web froze while I was writing.
That is tricky. Did you save your work?
Yes, I pressed the button fast.
Good you were quick. Do you like to write stories?
I just sent the letter to a friend.
That sounds nice. Who is the friend?
It is my mom.
She will be happy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Where is the bus?
It is right there. Are you going to work?
Yes. Will it stop here?
I think so, but I am not sure.
Please help me board.
I can hold the door. Do you have your ticket?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to tie a rope for a boat.
That is a fun skill to learn. Do you have a rope with you right now?
Yes, I have a long, thick one in my hand.
Great, loop the end of the rope around your thumb.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my bread get big and fluffy?
The tiny yeasts eat sugar and make gas. Do you use warm water?
Yes, I always do.
Warm water wakes them up so they work fast.
That is good to know.
It helps the dough puff up nicely. Do you wait a long time?
I wait about an hour.
That time lets the gas fill the holes.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The bus is late again.
That feels very bad. Are you cold?
Yes, my toes are freezing. I hate waiting.
I am sorry. Do you have a warm coat?
No, I forgot it at home. Why is it always late?
I do not know the reason. Is there a big storm?
It is just raining. I want to go inside now.
Soon, it will come. Try to take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a fence around my garden.
That is a great idea. Do you have the wood yet?
No, I only have some sticks.
Sticks are fun, but they may not be tall enough. What color do you want it to be?
Green, like the grass.
Green is a nice choice. I do not know if the sticks can hold together.
Can you help me glue them?
I would love to help you. Let us go outside and start.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a paper plane?
Fold the paper in half, then make sharp creases. Do you have a big piece of paper?
Yes, I do. What is the next step?
Fold the corners down to the top line. It should look like a triangle.
It looks like a hat. How do I fly it?
Hold it flat and throw it straight ahead. Watch it go high!
It flew well! Thank you.
You are welcome. I hope it brings you joy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because the fence is broken.
I am sorry it broke. Did you see what hit it?
Yes, a big dog ran into it and snapped the wood.
That is a very bad thing to happen.
Now my carrots might get eaten by rabbits.
Rabbits love carrots. Do you have a spare board?
No, I do not have any extra wood right now.
You can fix it with strong wire. Do you have any wire?
I have some old wire in the shed.
That is good news. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are there so many cars in the city?
They help people get to work and play. Do you like riding in them?
I like cars, but I hate the noise.
It can be very loud there. Is the noise scary for you?
Not scary, just too much.
I understand that. Let us look for a quiet park to sit in.
A park? I love parks!
They have trees and grass. Do you want to bring your ball?
Yes, I have a blue ball.
That sounds like fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you know if Sam is still in the town?
I think he is, but I am not sure. Is he the boy with the red bike?
Yes, that is the one. I want to say hello to him.
That sounds like a nice idea. What kind of games do you two like to play?
We like to catch fish by the big pond. Do you have a way to reach him?
I do not know his new home, but I can try to call. Should I ask for a message?
Please do if you can. I miss him a lot.
I will try my best to help. I hope he is doing well there.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to have a picnic. I have plenty of food to share.
That sounds wonderful. What is your favorite thing to eat?
I love sweet sandwiches and cold juice. It makes my day bright.
You sound very cheerful. Do you want to bring a friend along?
Yes, I want my best friend to come too. We will have a great time together.
A picnic with a friend sounds perfect. Have a lovely day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I hit the ball with my racket, but it did not go over the net.
That is okay, keep trying. Do you like to play tennis?
Yes, I like it. How do I make the ball go higher?
You should swing your racket up high. Is that hard for you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to draw a dog, but the legs look wrong.
Try drawing four small ovals for the legs. Is your dog sitting or standing?
It is standing. Do I need to add eyes?
Yes, add two small dots for the eyes. Do you have a blue crayon?
I do. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun with your drawing.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished my first big painting. It feels so good to finish.
That sounds like a happy feeling. What did you paint?
I painted a red sun over green grass. Thank you for cheering me on.
A red sun sounds bright. Do you want to hang it up?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water so wet?
Water is always wet by nature. Do you like getting wet?
Yes, but why does the sand feel hot?
The sun shines on it all day. I do not know the exact science, but it feels warm.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My grandpa has a very loud laugh.
That sounds fun. Does it make you smile?
Yes, it makes me happy to see him.
Family love is sweet. What does he like to eat?
He loves big plates of pasta.
Yummy. Do you help him cook?
No, he lets me just stir the pot.
That is a big job. Does he tell you stories too?
Yes, he tells me about his old boat.
Cool. Is the boat still there?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get my stuff ready, but look at that bright one.
It is a star. Do you know its name?
I am too late to learn now.
I do not know the name either.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in this big place. I do not know where to go.
Come with me. Do you like pictures or words?
I like words. I want a story to read.
The story books are right there. Do you want to sit or stand?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know the order of the months. Can you help me?
Yes, they start in the cold snow and end in the warm sun. Do you know which one comes first?
Is it January? It has a lot of 'a' letters.
That is true. It is the very first month of the year. Do you like winter?
Not really. I prefer when the flowers grow.
That is June. It is the sixth month. Do you know what comes after May?
I think June comes right after May.
You are right. The list is long but they follow a steady path.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to walk for my body?
It helps your heart pump blood better. Do you like playing outside?
I think my legs feel stiff when I sit too long.
Walking helps stretch those tight muscles. How long do you sit each day?
I am not sure how far I should go.
Start with a short walk of ten minutes. That is a good place to begin.
Does it help my head feel calm?
Yes, fresh air and moving help you feel less worried. Do you like fresh air?
So I will try to walk a little today.
That is a great plan for your health.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go. I am late.
Okay. Is the path clear?
Yes, but I run fast.
Good.
Do you know the gate?
I do not know.
I will go now.
