Bye. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
That sounds hard. What made you feel this way?
I lost my favorite toy.
I am sorry about your toy. Do you want to talk about it?
It was my grandfather's gift.
I understand that is very special. Would you like to draw a picture of it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My grandma has white hair now.
That is very nice. Does she tell you stories?
Yes, she tells me about her garden.
I love gardens. What flowers does she grow?
She grows red roses.
Roses are beautiful. Do they smell sweet?
Yes, they smell like candy.
That sounds wonderful. Do you visit her often?
I go there on weekends.
That is great. How do you get there?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad and do not know what to do.
It is hard when you feel sad. Are you hungry?
I am not hungry but my head hurts.
A head ache makes us feel worse. Did you drink water?
I drank some but I still feel bad.
Resting your eyes may help. Would you like to sit down?
Yes, I think I will try to sleep.
That is a good plan. I am here if you need me.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here, but I do not know where to go next.
Do you like to sit on the grass? You can look for small bugs there.
I think I will walk by the water.
That sounds nice. Is the water still or moving?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now.
That is good to hear. What made you feel this way?
The sun is warm and the birds are singing.
Nature is a nice way to cheer up. Do you love birds?
Yes, I love them very much.
They are fun to watch. It is great that you feel good.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need to drink water on this plane.
Just tap the button on the seat arm. Do you like cold water?
How do I change the news channel?
Press the small button next to the screen. Do you want to watch a movie instead?
I wish I could look out the window.
I do not know how to move the seat for you. Can you ask a pilot for help?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I failed at tying my shoes again. Do you know how to start?
I know the first step is to cross the left lace over the right. What part is the hardest for you?
Making the little knot feels wrong. It just slips right off.
You need to pull very tight before you make the loops. Does it feel loose when you begin?
Yes, it feels like a limp cat. I keep giving up because I am so tired.
You are doing great by trying again. Do you want to try one more time?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count from one to ten?
Our hands have ten fingers, so it is easy to count. Do you like counting on your fingers?
How do I count past ten?
We group numbers in fives. Do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I miss my old friend.
That is a sad feeling. Do you know where he lives?
I do not know where he lives.
We can look for his address. Did you save his number?
I did not save his number.
That is okay. We will find him soon. Are you brave?
I am not sure if I am brave.
You are very brave. I believe in you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are trees so tall?
They grow up to reach the sun. Do you like playing in them?
Yes, I do. Do trees eat?
Yes, they eat sunlight and water. Do you know what they drink?
They drink rain.
That is true. Rain helps their roots drink.
Do they feel happy?
I do not know if they feel happy. We just think they like the sun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Are robots real?
Yes, they are real. Do you like their shape?
I think they are scary.
I get it. What part scares you the most?
Their cold faces.
I do not know if they feel cold. Do they look nice to you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very happy today.
That is wonderful. What made you smile?
I got a sweet treat.
Yum. Do you like it a lot?
I do.
Good. Are you sharing it?
Yes, with my friend.
That is kind of you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where do I find fish?
I do not know your spot. Do you like cold water?
Yes, I want to go now. What bait works?
Worms are good. What do you fish with?
Just a stick. Do I need a rod?
A rod helps a lot. Is it sunny today?
It is sunny. I must run.
Have fun out there. Be safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to put in my bag.
Do you need clothes for a cold day?
I think so, but I am not sure.
Put on a warm coat and a hat. Do you have your shoes?
Yes, I have them, but my bag is heavy.
Take out the big toy. It is too big for a small bag.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the market today. It was so much fun.
That sounds great. Did you buy any fruit?
Yes, I got three big red apples. They taste sweet.
Apples are good. Do you like the soft ones too?
Not really. I prefer the hard and crunchy kind.
Nice choice. I will try that next time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to move today. I have no time to talk.
That sounds hard. Are you close to the truck?
I am at the truck. My back hurts.
Please rest for a moment. Is it heavy?
Yes, it is very heavy. I must go now.
Take small steps. Do you need a lift?
No, I can do this. Bye.
Good luck on your move.
Wait, the door is stuck.
I do not know why. Try to push it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to buy a red ball. Do you have one?
Yes, we do. What is your favorite color?
I like blue too. Can I see the blue ones?
Sure, they are on the shelf. Do you have any coins for me?
Yes, here is one dollar. Is that enough?
No, it costs two dollars. Do you have another coin?
I only have one left. Can I have a smaller ball?
We do not have smaller balls. Can your parent help you?
My mom is in the back. I will ask her.
Okay, I will wait here for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad because I think I am going to be late for the party.
That is a scary thought. Do you know what time it is now?
It is almost noon, but the party starts at ten o’clock.
Oh, that is indeed a problem. Please try to breathe slowly.
I am breathing, but my heart is beating very fast.
Your body is just nervous. Have you eaten anything sweet yet?
No, I have no time to eat or clean my room.
You can do one small thing first. Which task is the hardest for you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the test look so hard?
It looks hard because you feel scared. Is the paper blank?
No, I read it. Why do I still feel slow?
You are not slow, you are just fresh. Do you like taking breaks?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke your cup. How do I say sorry well?
Just look at me and say I am sorry. Did you break it on purpose?
No, it slipped. What else can I say?
You can say I will be more careful.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a hook to my line?
Hold the line and loop it around the eye. Do you have a knot in mind?
No, I just want it to hold tight.
Try a simple overhand knot. Pull it hard to make it snug.
Okay, I will try that now.
Great! Let me know if it slips. Have fun out there.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know how the clock tells the time.
The hands move around the circle to show the hours. Do you like the sound it makes?
Yes, it ticks all day long.
That tick comes from a tiny spring inside pushing the hands. Is your clock very loud?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I must try again right now.
Take a deep breath. Can you share what you tried first?
I failed the test. I feel bad. I have to go.
It is okay to feel bad. Did you study the hard parts?
Yes, but I missed them. I am running now.
You did your best. You can fix it later.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to count to ten, but I always get it wrong. I feel so silly.
Counting takes time to learn. Do you want to try with me?
Sure. I started with one, then two, then three. Is that right so far?
Yes, you are doing very well. Are your fingers helping?
I am holding my fingers up. It feels hard. I do not like making mistakes.
Mistakes help us learn. Would you like to start over?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired today. I walked to school and back, then I played in the mud all afternoon.
That sounds like a lot of running around. Do you want to sit down and rest your feet?
Yes, please. My legs feel like they are made of jelly. I also forgot to eat lunch because I was too busy playing.
I am sorry you missed your meal. Are you hungry enough to eat a piece of fruit now?
A little, but I am too sleepy to chew. I just want to close my eyes and dream about cool water.
Sweet dreams, my friend. I will be right here if you need me to help you up later.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can you keep a tiny secret?
Yes, I will always keep your secret. Do you trust me?
I drew a funny face on the wall.
Oh no, that is a mistake. Did you use erasable ink?
No, I used black marker.
That is tricky. Do you want to tell your parent?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My computer is very loud today.
That might be the fan cleaning the air. Is it making a scary noise?
It has a screen that shows my games.
Yes, it shows colors and pictures. Do you like playing on it?
My teacher said I can type words in it.
That is true, you can write your name. What word do you want to type first?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the hands move around the circle?
A strong spring pushes a tiny wheel to make them turn. Do you like watching them spin?
What makes the spring keep pushing?
You wind it tight, and that stored energy lets it push for a while. Have you ever wound one?
Why do they tick steadily?
A part called a pendulum swings back and forth to keep the speed even. I do not know why it always stays in time, though.
What happens if I break it?
The spring will stop, and the hands will freeze in place. Do you think you can fix it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure which movie to watch tonight.
That is a hard choice. Do you like happy stories?
Yes, I want something that makes me feel good.
A warm comedy might be nice. Do you prefer animals or people?
I do not mind either, really.
I do not know your taste for sure. Do you like funny moments?
Yes, I do.
Then pick a movie with lots of laughs.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do wild animals get cold in the winter?
Yes, many of them sleep in deep caves to stay warm. Do you like bears?
I think they look big and scary.
Actually, most wild animals are afraid of people, so they hide. Do you see many animals near your home?
No, only a few birds and squirrels.
Squirrels are great helpers because they plant trees. Do you like watching birds?
Yes, I like their bright colors.
Bright colors help some animals hide, but I do not know why your birds are so colorful.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! We are going camping tomorrow night.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What are you most excited to see?
I love the smell of pine trees and the sound of water.
Nature is very peaceful. Do you have a sleeping bag?
Yes, I packed my warm blanket and tent today.
You are ready for a good rest. What food will you bring?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big white boat float by today.
That sounds like a lot of fun to watch. Did you wave at it?
Yes, I waved, but nobody waved back.
That is a little sad. Are you sure it was empty?
I think it was, because I saw no one inside.
Maybe they were napping in the back. Do you like boats?
I do, because they look so smooth and quiet.
That is a nice way to see them. How long did it stay?
It stayed for a few minutes before it went away.
Thank you for sharing that with me.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so small at work today.
That is a hard feeling. Do you miss home?
Yes, everything is so loud and new.
Loud places are scary at first. Is it the noise or the people?
I think it is both. I feel like I am doing wrong.
You are doing your best. Have you had lunch?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so worried. I have to go now.
Take a deep breath. Is it about work?
Yes, I might miss my train. I am running late.
You can still make it. How far are you?
It is very far. I am scared.
You will be okay. Do you have your bag?
I think so. I do not know.
Check your hand. Is it there?
Yes, it is here. Thank you.
You are welcome. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy here at the beach.
That is great. What makes you feel so good?
The sand is soft and warm.
That sounds nice to touch. Do you like the color of the water?
Yes, it is blue and clear.
Beautiful. Are you building anything with the sand?
I am making a big castle.
That is fun to do. Will you add a tower to it?
Yes, I will make it tall.
Good luck with that.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck and do not know what to move.
Can you see a safe square for your king? Sometimes moving the king is the best thing.
No, the rook blocks my way.
That rook is strong. Did you check if it has an escape route?
It looks trapped in the corner.
If it is trapped, try to trap it with your knight.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do clouds look like white fluff?
They are tiny water drops. Do you like fluffy things?
Yes, I do. Why are some clouds dark and gray?
They have a lot of water in them.
Do they fall down?
No, the drops are too small to fall. Have you seen a big gray cloud?
Yes, a big one. Why does it rain later?
The drops get heavy and heavy.
Then it falls as rain. Does the cloud go away?
Yes, it turns into water on the ground.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have chicken and carrots. What should I make?
You can roast them with some oil and salt. Do you like spicy food?
Yes, I love heat. What spice do I use?
Add a little black pepper and red pepper flakes. It is safe to try a small amount first.
How do I know if the chicken is done?
Cut into the thickest part. The juice must run clear and the meat must be white. Are you using an oven?
Yes, the oven is on. What temperature?
Set it to 400 degrees. Bake for twenty minutes, then check again.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want a picnic. What should I pack?
Bring sandwiches and cold drinks. Do you like fruit?
Yes, I love apples. What else is good?
Chips are a great choice. Are you going alone?
No, my friends are coming too.
That sounds fun. Pack extra plates for them.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad about my test today.
I am sorry to hear that. What was the hardest part?
The math questions were too hard for me.
Math can be tricky. Did you get any answers right?
Only a few, but I want to do better next time.
You can learn from your mistakes. Do you want help with it?
Yes, please. I want to feel happy again.
That is a good goal. Let us start with one small problem.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so happy, but I do not know what to do next.
That is a wonderful feeling. Do you want to play or rest?
I am not sure. It feels both fun and quiet.
That is okay. You can choose when you are ready.
I think I will just sit and smile for a while.
That sounds like a perfect choice.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I dropped the cup and now the floor is wet. I am so mad.
I am sorry that happened. Did you check if the floor is slippery?
I do not know how to fix this mess. I feel very bad.
Let us clean it up together. Do you want to use the blue towel?
That sounds like a good plan. I am feeling a bit better now.
I am glad you feel better. Thank you for telling me how you feel.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a bright red leaf on the ground today.
That is a lovely find. Did you keep it?
Yes, I put it in my pocket to keep safe.
You will have a special treasure. What else happened?
I also ate warm toast with butter for breakfast.
That sounds very yummy. Did you enjoy every bite?
I did, and then I watched the birds fly high.
Watching nature feels nice. Do you like watching clouds too?
I love them, and I feel very happy now.
I am glad you feel that way.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a horse with long hair on its neck. What is that called?
That is called a mane. Do you like its color?
Yes, it is brown like chocolate. Does the horse need help cutting it?
Usually, no, but we can brush it. Is the horse friendly?
It was quiet and looked at me. Does it talk?
No, it makes sounds, not words. What sound do you think it makes?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. They said my mail is lost.
I am sorry to hear that. Is the stamp still on the envelope?
Yes, it is right there. I paid for it twice!
That is not fair. Do you have the receipt with you?
No, I left it at home. Why did they not call me?
I do not know why they did not call. Do you want to wait here for a manager?
I do not want to wait. I have to go now.
I understand your rush. Please come back tomorrow if you like.
Fine, I will try again. Thank you.
You are welcome. I hope they find your mail.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to help my neighbor with her garden.
That is a kind idea. Do you like to dig in the dirt?
Yes, I do. But I do not know what to plant.
Try some easy flowers like marigolds. They like the sun.
That sounds fun. How do I make the soil good for them?
Mix in some dry leaves and water. Do you have any leaves nearby?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in a big hurry. How do I save money?
Buy only what you need. Do you make a list?
Yes, I always write a list. What else?
Cook at home instead of eating out. Do you like cooking?
I am going now. I do not like to cook.
I do not know how to help you start. Be safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad because my guitar strings broke again.
That sounds frustrating. Do you have extra strings in your bag?
No, I never buy spares because I am cheap.
That is a common worry. Are you okay with learning new chords?
I just want to play my old favorite song.
Playing old songs brings joy. Do you know how to change a string?
I tried, but it snapped in my hand.
Ouch, that hurts. Do you have a tool to help?
I think I need to go to the music store.
Going to the store is a good plan. Do they usually help people fix things?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so good today.
That is nice to hear. What made you feel good?
The sun is warm and bright.
Sunshine is a great helper. Do you like the sun too?
Yes, it makes my heart smile.
Smiles are wonderful. Is the heart calm?
It is calm and full of joy.
I am glad for you. How long did this feeling last?
It started this morning and stayed.
That sounds like a lovely day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Can you help me find the park on this map?
Yes, it is the big green square near the river. Do you like to play in parks?
Yes, I do. Where is the river?
Look for the blue line that curves around the green square.
I see it. Is there a bridge over the water?
There is a small red line crossing the blue line. That is the bridge.
Great, thank you. I am ready to go.
You are welcome. Have fun on your walk.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see orange light through my window. It looks like fire.
That is not good. Are you safe in your room?
Yes, but I am scared. What is happening?
Your grown-ups know how to help you. Is your phone with you?
No, I do not have it. I just see the bright fire.
Please stay where you are. Listen to what they say next.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My head hurts so much.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a fever?
I feel very sick and cold.
Rest is good for your body. Are you drinking water?
I do not like being sick.
It is hard to not feel well. What did you eat?
Just some soup, I think.
Soup helps to keep you strong. Do you want to read?
Maybe later, please.
Sleep will help you heal fast.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I sleep better at night?
Try drinking warm milk before bed. Do you like warm drinks?
Yes, I do. What else can I do?
Keep your room cool and dark. Do you have a fan?
No, I do not. Can I use a blanket?
Yes, a warm blanket helps you sleep. Are you tired now?
Yes, I am very tired.
Good, rest now. Goodnight.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: It is so hot outside. I am very tired.
It does feel very warm today. Do you want to sit in the shade?
Yes, please. My face feels like a sun.
That sounds uncomfortable. Have you had enough water?
I have some, but it is not enough. The heat is bad.
Drinking water helps a lot. I do not know what else you have tried, but rest is key.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the best way to say thanks?
You can just say it with a smile. Do you like to smile?
Yes, I do. But what if I forget?
It is okay if you forget. Just say it later. Is that hard for you?
A little. What about saying please?
Please is for asking for things. Do you ask for toys?
Sometimes. I want a cookie.
You should say please first. Do you like cookies?
Yes, I do.
Then you will be a good friend.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great goal. Do you have any shoes ready?
Yes, I have my red sneakers here.
Nice. Let us start with the first loop.
I made a little house.
Well done. What color are your laces?
They are blue.
Good. Now you need to cross the ends.
I crossed them but it feels tight.
Loosen it a bit. Is it better now?
Yes, now I see a bow.
You did it. How does that feel?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad. My bank is empty. I want to buy new shoes.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have any snacks at home?
Yes, I have cookies. But I want the shoes.
Cookies are a start. How much do the shoes cost?
A lot of money. I cannot wait long.
Save a small coin each day. You will see progress.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late and running fast.
Take a slow breath. Are you going to work?
Yes, I forgot my bag at home.
That is a big problem. Do you have the keys?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am looking for fresh apples.
The red ones are on the left. Do you like them sweet or sour?
I want the sweet kind, please.
Those big ones are very sweet. Is this your first visit here?
Yes, I am new to this town.
That is lovely. We have fresh bread too.
Does the market sell fish?
I am not sure about the fish. Do you eat meat?
I do, but I also like vegetables.
You will find both in the back. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My tummy feels very hurt.
That is not nice. Where does it hurt?
Right here near my belly button.
Okay. Your mom can take you to the doctor.
Will the doctor put a needle in me?
I do not know for sure, but maybe. Do you like juice?
Yes, I love apple juice.
Great. Tell the doctor about the hurt, then we will see what happens.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a secret for you.
Oh, that sounds fun. What is it?
Look at the box.
Is it a puppy?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today because the sun is warm.
That is wonderful to hear. What do you like doing in this nice weather?
I like to sit outside and watch the leaves fall.
I agree, watching leaves is very peaceful. Do you collect them to keep?
Yes, I keep a few for my art class.
That is a lovely idea for your art.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I love my red book with the dragon. What should I read next?
I like dragons too. Do you like scary stories?
Not really. I want happy stories.
That is a good choice. Try books about pet dogs.
I read one about a puppy before. It was fun.
Happy pets are great. Do you draw pictures?
Yes, I draw dragons and dogs.
That sounds lovely. Pick the next book to match your drawings.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I painted a big sun today.
That sounds fun. Did you use bright yellow?
Yes, and I did it all by myself.
You should feel proud. Was the hard part the circles?
It was hard to keep the edges straight.
Making messy lines is normal. Do you like how it looks now?
I think it is my best picture ever.
That is a great feeling.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so hungry. I want to eat my sandwich right now.
That sounds yummy. Did you pack your favorite bread?
Yes, I used soft white bread. Do you know if we have any juice?
I am not sure what is in the cooler. Do you want me to look for you?
Please do! I hope we have apple juice.
I will check the bag for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are trees so tall?
They grow tall to reach the sun. Do you like sunny days?
I do. Do they drink water like me?
Yes, they drink water through their roots.
Cool. How do they breathe?
They use tiny holes in their leaves. Is that strange?
Not really. I love trees.
That is good to hear.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy because I found a perfect circle today.
That is nice to know. What color is it?
It is bright red and feels smooth.
That sounds lovely. Do you want to draw it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at the bright lights up there.
Yes, those are stars. Do you like looking up?
I think they are just little bulbs.
They are actually very far away suns. Are they all the same size?
Some look big and some look small.
Their distance makes them look different. Do you see any twinkling?
Yes, they blink sometimes.
That happens because of our air.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make good coffee?
Use fresh beans and hot water. Do you like it sweet or plain?
I like it plain. How much water do I need?
Use one scoop of grounds for every cup. Is your water boiling?
Yes, it is boiling. What do I do next?
Pour the water slowly over the grounds. Do you have a filter?
I have a filter. What if I have no filter?
You can use a cloth bag instead. Do you want to try that?
I will try it. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
Roots pull water up from the soil. Do you like to splash water?
Do they use a straw?
Not really, but tiny tubes push it up. Can you see their roots?
I think I saw them once.
That is a good thing to notice.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to say "thank you" but I forgot the word. I feel so dumb.
Forgetting words is very normal. Do you still feel happy to learn?
No. I just want to quit because it is too hard.
It is okay to feel sad. How many words do you know now?
Only a few. I am not smart enough for this.
You are doing your best. Would you like to try just one new word?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I rode my bike to the park today. The sun was very warm on my face.
That sounds like a happy ride. Did you see any friends while you were out?
Yes, I saw a dog by the big tree. I had to finish my ride home before it got dark.
Wise to get home early. Did the dog look friendly?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I found a red boat by the lake.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you see any birds?
Yes, a big white duck was swimming near it.
A duck is a nice friend. Do you want to ride the boat?
I do not want to ride it. I just like to look at it.
Looking is a great way to enjoy things.
The sun is warm on my face.
The sun makes everything feel good.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a bad hand. What should I do?
That is tricky. Do you have any good cards left?
I am not sure. I feel stuck.
Just play the small card. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the big museum today. I saw a huge dinosaur skull. It was very cool.
That sounds like a great time. Did you get to touch anything?
I saw some old swords, too. They were very sharp looking.
Wow, I like old history. What was your favorite part?
I am so happy I went. I want to take my little brother next.
That is a nice idea. He will love it too.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does a bike need two wheels?
One wheel is too hard to balance. Have you tried riding a unicycle?
I have not. What makes the bike move forward?
Your legs push the pedals to turn the wheels. Do you like riding in the park?
I do. Why do the wheels not stop spinning when I stop pedaling?
The wheels keep going because they have speed. Do you like going fast?
Yes, but what happens if I stop all of a sudden?
You will stop moving if you use the brakes. Do you know how to use the brakes?
I use the levers on the handles. Is that the right way?
Yes, that is the right way to stop safely.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My friend feels sad today. What can I do to help?
Sit with them and listen. Do you know why they are sad?
No, I do not. They just look blue. How do I make them smile?
Try sharing a funny story or a sweet treat. Would you like ideas for games?
Yes, simple games are good. What is a good one to play?
You can draw pictures together. Do you like to draw?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to eat pizza. Can we go there?
Yes, pizza is yummy. Do you want cheese on it?
Yes, please. Is the food hot?
Yes, it comes out hot and fresh. Do you like it soft or crisp?
I like it soft. Can I also have a drink?
Sure, a cold juice would be good. What kind do you want?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very sad and alone right now.
That is a heavy feeling to carry. Do you have anyone nearby?
I do not have friends here, so why does it hurt so much?
We are built to share things with others. Does a warm drink help?
I tried tea, but it did not stop the quiet in my head.
The quiet can be loud. What is one small thing you love?
I love my cat, but she sleeps all day.
Cats bring their own kind of comfort. Does her breathing calm you?
Yes, her soft breath makes me feel safe.
That is a good start to feeling less alone.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I had a scary dream and I feel bad.
That feels awful. What happened in the dream?
I think I lost my mom. What should I do?
You are safe here now. Did you wake up with a start?
Yes. I do not know if I should go back to sleep.
It is okay to rest. How do your hands feel?
They are cold. I am still scared.
Let us sit still and breathe. I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My head hurts. I want to tie my shoes but I cannot do it.
That sounds tough. Let me help you first.
Okay. How do I make a loop?
Take one end and twist it up. Do you see the hole?
Yes. Now what?
Push the end through the hole. Did that feel easy?
It did. I can do it now.
Great job. I am glad you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water so blue down there?
The sun makes the light bounce off the sand. Do you like sailing?
Yes, I do. Why do the boats stop in the big circle?
That is where they rest and fix their nets. Do you have a favorite boat?
The red one with the long nose. Why does the sand look white?
It is made of tiny shells from long ago. Do you like the smell of the sea?
It smells like salt and wet stone. Why does the fog come in sometimes?
The cold air meets the warm water and turns into mist. Do you like the quiet part?
It is very quiet. Why do the birds fly so close to the water?
They are looking for fish to eat. Do you like watching them?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I love this song, but I do not know the name.
That is a happy feeling. Do you hear any drums in it?
Yes, there are big, loud drums.
Maybe it is a pop song with a strong beat. Do you sing along with the words?
I hum the melody, but I cannot hear the words.
That sounds like a great tune. You can check a music app to find it.
I will try that tonight.
Good luck with your search. I hope you find it soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do fish have fins?
Fins help them swim fast and steer. Do you like swimming too?
Why is the water cold?
The sun has not warmed it up yet.
Why do they bite the bait?
They think it is food. Is that tricky of them?
Why do they have scales?
Scales keep them safe from getting hurt.
Why do they need water?
They use water to breathe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I love my warm toast.
That sounds very nice. Do you like jam on it?
Yes, I put a lot of jam on. It makes me smile big.
I am glad you are happy. What else is in your bowl?
I have some milk too. It is cold and sweet.
That is a good way to start the day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just took a very nice picture of the sun!
That sounds fun! Did you take it outside?
Yes, and the sky was bright blue today.
What a lovely day!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke my cup. I am so sorry.
It is okay. Are you hurt?
No. My hand is fine.
Good. Next time, hold it with two hands.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The water looks so big and deep. I do not know what to do with it.
It is hard to hold all that water. Do you like to swim?
I can swim a little, but I am scared of the waves.
You can just stand in the shallow part. Is the sand warm?
The sand is warm, but I still feel lost.
Sitting on the sand is a good choice. Do you want to draw a picture in it?
Yes, a big boat might be nice.
A boat is a fun idea. You are doing great.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I learn to ride a bike?
Start by balancing on the bike with your feet on the ground. Do you have a flat, open place to practice?
Yes, I have a driveway, but I am scared of falling.
Wearing a helmet and pads will keep you safe. Do you have a friend to watch you?
I am worried about using the brakes too.
Practice squeezing the brakes slowly while stopped first. Can you reach the handlebars easily?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big plan for the weekend.
That sounds fun! What is the first thing you will do?
I will go to the park to ride my bike.
That is a great start. Do you have a helmet ready?
Yes, I packed my helmet and a sandwich.
You are very prepared. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does that song make me feel so happy?
It has a fast beat. Do you like fast music?
I like it. Why does the singer sound so loud?
He wants to share his joy. Is it too loud for you?
Not too loud. Why is the drum hitting so hard?
It keeps the time steady. Do you hear the click?
Yes, I hear it. Why does the song end so fast?
I do not know. Do you want it to last longer?
Yes, I do. Why did they not make it longer?
They wanted to stop while it was fun.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because the house is all clean now.
That is a great feeling. What was your favorite part?
I like how the floor shines when the sun hits it.
That sounds lovely. Thank you for sharing that with me.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the cafeteria so quiet today?
I think the AC is off. Is it hot in there?
It feels warm. Why did they turn it off?
Maybe the electric bill is high. Do you like the soup?
I like it, but it is thin. Why does it taste like water?
I am not sure. I hope it helps you feel full.
I am still hungry. Should I go outside?
Yes, a walk is good. Do you want to eat sandwiches?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My computer screen is all black and I am so sad.
That sounds very frustrating. Do you see a small light on the front?
I think so, but it is blinking very fast.
That usually means it is stuck. Please unplug it for ten seconds, then plug it back in.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today!
That is great. What made you smile?
It is Tuesday. I like this day.
Nice. Do you have a plan?
Yes, I go to play.
Have fun.
Thank you. I feel good.
Good luck.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a sore throat and feel very tired.
Rest is key. Do you have any soup to eat?
Yes, I just had some chicken soup.
That is good for you.
Will the sickness go away soon?
It usually takes a few days. Are you drinking warm water?
I am, but I still feel cold.
Keep warm with a blanket.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy right now.
That sounds wonderful. Why are you so happy?
I am waiting for my favorite snack.
What is the snack?
It is a warm chocolate cookie.
That smells and sounds sweet. Are you ready to eat?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to start walking to feel better.
That is a great idea for your body. Do you like walking outside?
Yes, I do like it, but my legs get tired fast.
You can walk for ten minutes first. Do you have shoes that fit well?
I have new shoes, but I am not sure how long to go.
Start with a short walk and add time later. Is the weather nice today?
It looks sunny, so I think I will go now.
That sounds fun and healthy for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a box with a riddle on it. It says the key is heavy but makes nothing.
That is a tricky one. Is the box open or closed?
The box is still shut tight.
Oh, I do not know the answer. Try to think of what makes a hole.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so heavy after eating my lunch.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you usually eat that much?
Yes, I ate a big bowl of rice and lots of oil.
Oily food can make you feel tired and bloated.
I do not want to feel this way again.
Try adding some green vegetables next time. Do you like carrots?
Yes, I do like carrots, but I am still sad about today.
One bad meal does not ruin your whole day. Be kind to yourself.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do trees have leaves?
Leaves help trees make food from sunlight. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I do. Why do some trees lose their leaves in winter?
It helps them save energy when it is cold. Do you see snow there?
No, we do not get snow. Why are trees so strong?
Their trunks are hard and full of water. Do you know where water comes from?
From rain, I think. Why do they grow so tall?
They reach up to touch more sun. Can you see a bird in a tree?
Yes, a little one. Why do we need trees?
They give us air to breathe and homes for animals. Do you feel fresh air now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike. Do you know how to start?
Yes, first you need to balance on two wheels. How tall are you?
I am five feet tall. What should I do next?
You should sit on the seat and try to glide forward. Do you have a friend to help you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my magnet and now the fridge door is open.
I am sorry that happened. Do you still have the small pieces?
Yes, but they do not stick together anymore.
That is a bad sign. Did it fall on a hard floor?
It fell on the hard floor and I am sad.
I know it is hard to fix. Can I help you clean up the pieces?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel very low today, but I must run.
That is hard. What hurts the most?
My heart feels heavy and cold.
I hear you. Do you have a friend nearby?
I have no time to talk now.
Okay, I am here.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to know how sailors find their way at sea.
They use maps and stars to guide them. Do you like looking at stars?
Yes, I do. But what if it is cloudy?
Then they use special machines to help them see where they go. Is that a tricky part?
That makes sense. Do they get lost sometimes?
Rarely, but they always have a backup plan just in case. Are you a brave explorer?
I hope so. Thanks for telling me.
You are welcome. Stay safe and keep asking good questions. Do you have a favorite book about the ocean?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make a big bread today.
That sounds fun! Do you have any flour?
Yes, I have white flour and eggs.
Great start. Do you have yeast?
I don't know what that is.
Yeast makes the bread grow big. Do you have milk?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My dog is so happy today!
That is great to hear. What is he doing right now?
He is running in the grass.
Running is good exercise for him. Does he like to chase balls?
Yes, he loves to chase them.
He sounds like a very fun playmate.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a song that feels sad and happy at once.
That is a very strange mix. Do you like the feeling?
I do not know if I should keep it or stop listening.
You can just let it play for one more verse. What makes you feel stuck?
My head hurts from the fast drums.
That is not good for you. You may close your eyes to help.
Okay, I will try to rest and think.
That is a good choice. Do you feel calmer now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Can you help me fix my toy?
Yes, I can try. Is it broken or just stuck?
It is stuck and won’t open.
Let’s look. Do you see a small button?
I do not see any button.
Then it may be glued shut. I do not know for sure.
Why is it glued shut?
Maybe someone fixed it before. Does it hurt to open?
No, but it feels tight.
Okay, we will pull slowly. Do you want to try?
Yes, I want to try now.
Good. Pull the side gently.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a big bug in my house. Is it bad?
What color was it?
It was black and it had six legs.
That sounds like an ant. Do you like ants?
Not really. How do I get rid of them?
Mix sugar and glue to make a trap. Do you have glue?
Yes, I do. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome. Good luck!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now.
Are you okay?
Yes, I have five things to do.
What is the first thing?
I need to call my mom.
I can help with that.
Please wait, I am very busy.
Do you know her number?
I forget it.
I do not know it either.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go soon. I need help.
Take a breath. What is the problem?
I do not know what to buy for her.
That is hard. Is she happy with small toys?
She likes to eat sweets.
A box of chocolates is a nice gift. You can buy that fast.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not like the cold water.
That feels bad. Do you wear a wetsuit?
No, I just wear a swimsuit.
You might feel warm in a wetsuit. Have you tried one?
No, I have not tried one yet.
It is a thick suit to keep you warm. Do you swim for fun?
Yes, I like to dive and jump.
Diving is very fun. Do you like to swim alone?
I swim with my brother.
Swimming with a friend is safe and fun.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need this puzzle piece now, but I cannot find it.
Let us look together. Where did you last see the box?
It is lost. I am late for work.
Do not worry. Can you remember the color of the missing piece?
It is blue. Please help me fast.
I see a blue piece under the rug. Do you think that is the one?
Yes, it fits. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Does the picture look happy now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do magnets work?
They have invisible lines that pull metal things. Do you like cold days?
I have a toy magnet. Why does it stick?
The inside is special and likes iron. Is your toy red?
Can I break one?
It is hard to break, but it can get rusty. Do you like rain?
I want to make one.
I do not know how to make them. Do you like building?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My light flickered all morning.
That sounds scary. Did you check the switch?
Yes, but it still blinked.
I am not sure why that happens. Did you ask an adult?
I showed my mom the bulb.
Smart move. Was the bulb warm?
It felt hot and old.
Old bulbs can get hot. Did she change it?
She put in a new one.
Great solution. Is it shining bright now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am doing my school work at the kitchen table.
That is a nice place to work. Do you have a big pad of paper?
Yes, I have a big pad. I also like to play with my cat while I write.
That sounds fun, but cats can be busy. Does he jump on your papers?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just landed from a very long flight.
That must have been tiring. Did you sleep?
Yes, I slept for half the time.
Good for you. What was your favorite part?
The view from the window at night.
It is a quiet beauty. Did you read a book?
I did not, but I watched two movies.
That sounds like a great way to pass time.
I am so happy to be back on solid ground.
That is a true feeling. I am glad for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late, where do I put the worm?
Wrap it on the hook. Do you like small fish?
I do not care, just tell me where to throw it.
Aim near the big trees. Do you have a hat?
No, I am running, just give me the spot.
I do not see a good spot from here.
Then tell me how to pull it in fast.
Pull up hard when it tugs. Is it sunny?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I plant a tiny seed in the quiet soil by the street?
Push the seed into the soft dirt, then water it with care. Do you have a little cup for the water?
Yes, I have a blue cup. What else do I need to do to help it grow?
Just let it rest in the sun and stay still. Is the spot where you plant it sunny?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I dropped my toy car and it will not stick to the fridge anymore. I am sad.
I am sorry. Did you wash the car with soap? Do you want to try again?
Yes, I did wash it. The magnet is still cold, so why is it not working?
Soap can make the magnet weak. Wipe it dry and try once more. Is it a toy magnet?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to fold a napkin, but I do not know how. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help. Do you like flowers?
Yes, I do. Please show me the flower fold.
Press the napkin into a square first.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the snow. It is too cold and messy.
It can be hard to enjoy. Do you have warm boots?
Yes, but my shoes still get wet. I am so tired.
That sounds very tiring. I am sorry you feel that way.
It is just a bad day for me. Nothing is fun.
I know you are feeling down. Would a warm drink help?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to bake a cake today but it fell apart.
That sounds frustrating. Did you check the recipe?
Yes, I followed it, but the eggs were old.
Old eggs can make a mess. Next time, tap them on the floor to test them.
That is a good trick to remember.
I hope your next cake is sweet. Did you eat the broken cake?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at this little bug. It is so tiny and cute.
It is a ladybug! Do you know what it eats?
I am so glad I found it. I love nature.
That is a nice thing to love. What is your favorite part of the garden?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. My dog is barking. I need to start work now.
That is tricky. Do you have a quiet room?
No. The room is too loud. I cannot think.
I do not know the best fix. Are you near a wall?
Yes. I am stuck. I am so fast.
Try a fan to block the sound. Is that helpful?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the story of the play?
It is about a brave little dog. Do you like dogs?
Yes, I do. Why is he brave?
He helps a lost kitten find its home.
That is sweet. What happens next?
The dog and kitten become best friends. Do you have a pet?
No, I do not. Can I see the play?
Yes, the doors open soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My boss gave me a free day off. I am happy, but I feel sad for my other friends. What should I do?
That is a very sweet feeling. Do you think you can share some joy with them?
I want to help them feel good too, but I do not know how. Is there a simple way?
You could just send a kind note. Do you have some spare paper?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to sing, but my voice sounds bad.
Singing takes time to get right. Do you like loud songs or soft ones?
I like them loud and fast.
That is great energy. Do you practice a little every day?
No, I never practice.
You should try for just five minutes. Can you hum a tune for me?
I hum, but I forget the words.
That happens to everyone. Do you know the song by heart?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just found a town with red houses and a big blue river.
That sounds lovely. What do you see first?
The river is so calm. I want to sit by it all day.
That is a great idea. Do you like to fish there?
No, I just like the quiet. It feels very safe.
I am glad it is safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How does a plant drink water?
It pulls water up from its roots. Do you have a plant at home?
I do, but I do not know how to keep it alive.
You need light, water, and a pot with holes. Does your plant get sun?
Yes, it sits by the window.
That is good. Give it a little water when the soil feels dry.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look out the window and it feels cold, but I do not know what the season is.
It might be winter, but why do you think it feels so chilly?
The trees have no leaves, and I am not sure if I should go outside.
It is safe to go out if you wear a warm coat. Do you like to play in the snow?
I do not like the cold, so I do not want to play outside today.
That is okay, you can rest inside instead. What do you like to do when it is cold?
I like to read books and eat warm soup, but I feel a bit lonely.
Reading is a great way to spend time alone. Do you have a favorite book?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got my very first job today!
That is great news. How do you feel about it?
I am so happy and a bit scared.
It is good to be excited. What will you do there?
I will help pick up toys in a shop.
That sounds like fun. Do you like playing with toys?
Yes, but I have to clean up after others.
Cleaning is hard work. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate this letter. My words are all jumbled up and I feel so dumb.
It is okay to feel that way. Hard work often feels messy at first. What is the letter about?
I want to tell my grandpa I miss him, but I just get stuck.
That is a very sweet thought. Starting with "Dear Grandpa" can help you begin. Do you want to talk about your day?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very tired after I run. Is this bad?
It is normal to feel tired at first. Do you stretch your legs before you start?
No, I just go fast. Should I stop?
You should slow down and take deep breaths. How long do you run each day?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My bait is gone and the fish did not bite.
That feels very bad. Did you try a different spot?
Yes, I tried everywhere. It is just not my lucky day.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you want to help you pack up?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My bike will not go fast enough for me.
That is tough. Did you try to pump the tires again?
I did, but my legs still feel heavy.
Maybe a short rest will help. Do you want to sit on the grass for a bit?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make bread like people did long ago. What do I need?
You need flour, water, and salt. Do you have a big bowl?
Yes, I have a bowl and a spoon. How do I make it rise?
Mix the wet part and wait for it to puff up. It takes time. Is your kitchen warm?
It is warm. How do I make it taste good?
Put it in a hot oven until it turns brown. It smells nice when done. Do you like sweet or salty bread?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love singing in the shower.
That sounds like fun. Do you sing loud?
Yes, I make a lot of noise.
Good for you. What song do you like best?
It is a song about the sun.
That sounds warm. Is it a happy song?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a king and I think I should play it.
That is a strong card. Do you trust your luck?
I am not sure if the other person has a queen.
It is a good guess, but I do not know for sure. What else do you hold?
I also have two small cards.
Small cards are safe choices. Are you feeling brave?
Maybe I should just keep my cards safe.
Playing safe is often smart. How is your heart feeling?
I think I will play the king after all.
Good choice. Have fun with the game.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does it rain?
Clouds get heavy with water. Do you like wet days?
I do not. It makes my shoes wet.
That is not fun. Do you wear boots?
Yes, I have blue boots.
Blue is a nice color. Do you play in it?
Only if I must.
Maybe you will learn to love it. Do you have an umbrella?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind was very loud today and shook my tent all night.
That must have been scary. Did you fall asleep?
I woke up with dirt on my face from the strong wind.
That sounds like a messy adventure. Did you get to clean up?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to write a letter, but I do not know how to start.
Start by saying hello to the person. What is their name?
You write the name, then the message. How do I end it?
You say good bye at the bottom. Do you have a stamp?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a hot toast?
Put the bread in the machine and press the button. Do you like your toast dark?
I like it light. How long do I wait?
About two minutes is good for light toast. What do you put on it?
I like to put butter on it. How do I melt the butter?
You can use a warm spoon to spread it. Is it thick or soft?
It is thick. How do I make it soft?
Cut a small piece to warm it first. Does that help?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the big blue sky! The rain is gone.
That is a happy sight. Do you see any clouds left?
No, just bright light and warm air.
Warm air feels nice after wet days. Did you get dry?
Yes, I am all dry and happy.
Good. You can go play now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I know if it is half past an hour?
Look for the long hand on the six. Do you know which hand is long?
Yes, the one that moves around the numbers.
That is right. The short hand shows the hour.
So if the short hand is near three, it is three?
Yes, if the long hand is on the six. Is the time clear to you?
I think so. Can I check my watch?
Please do. Do you see the time change?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a new friend. I must go now.
That is good. Do you play together?
Yes, we run fast. I am late for class.
Running is fun. Is he your best friend?
No, just a new one. Bye.
Bye. Tell me more later.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My neighbor is very loud at night.
That must be hard for you. Do you sleep well there?
I try, but it is difficult.
You could talk to them kindly. Have you tried that yet?
No, I am afraid they will get mad.
Most people are nice. Would you like to say hello first?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The box is heavy. Can you help?
Yes, I can lift it for you. Do you have a cart?
No cart. Just my arms. Please hurry.
Okay, I will carry it to the van. Are you sure the truck is ready?
Yes, it is ready. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. I will go now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to make this clock work.
Do you have a battery for it?
No, I only have the clock body.
You need a small battery to start it. Do you see a hole on the back?
Yes, I see a small circle on the back.
Open that circle and put the battery in. Are you looking at the label inside?
It says plus and minus on the back.
Match the plus sign to the plus line. Do you feel how it clicks into place?
It is in now, but the hands are still.
Try to click the small button on the side. Do you hear a little tick?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is great to hear. What makes you so happy?
The harbor looks so pretty.
I like boats too. Do you see any small ones?
Yes, there are many little boats.
That sounds nice. Do you have a favorite boat?
I love the big red one.
Red is a good color. Is it floating high?
Yes, the water is very calm.
Calm water feels good. Do you feel calm too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make a plan to read more books this month. How do I start?
That is a great idea. Do you have a favorite type of story?
I like animal stories, but I get bored quickly. What should I do?
Try reading for ten minutes each day. That makes the task feel small and easy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look up. The moon is bright. I feel so glad.
It is a big silver ball. Why does it make you happy?
It looks like a friend. I miss my grandma. She liked the moon.
That is a sweet thought. Do you write to her?
Yes. I draw pictures. The moon shines on her too.
She can see it. What else is in the sky?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I stand by the river and I do not know what to do next.
The water looks cold and clear. Do you want to go in?
I am not sure, but I fear the current might pull me under.
That is a good thing to check first.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. I need to eat something fast but good.
A banana is quick and sweet. Do you like fruit?
Yes, I like apples too. But I am still in a rush.
An apple with peanut butter is filling. Would that work for you?
That sounds great. I will grab an apple on my way out.
That is a smart choice. Have a nice day!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I can never tell what time it is on this new clock.
Do you look at the big hand or the small one?
I think I am looking at the wrong one.
The small hand shows the hour. Is the small hand near the number 3?
Yes, it is close to the 3.
Then it is almost 3 o'clock. Do you see where the big hand is?
The big hand is on the 12.
That means it is exactly 3 o'clock. You did great.
Thank you, I understand it now.
I am glad it makes sense. Do you want to try another time?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I had a bad dream and I want to learn how to wake up my brain.
That sounds scary. Do you remember what made you worry?
It was dark and I could not find the door.
Try to pick a bright object in your room before sleep.
A lamp?
Yes, a lamp works well. Do you like the color of your lamp?
It is blue, but I am still scared of the dark.
That is okay. Hold your blanket tight and breathe slowly.
I will try that tonight.
I hope you sleep well.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw the big lighthouse today. It glows so bright in the dark.
That sounds wonderful. Does the light move when it spins?
Yes, it turns and turns. I felt very happy watching it.
I am glad you enjoyed it. Did you see any boats near the water?
I saw a small boat sleeping in the bay. It is a calm night.
How peaceful that must be. Do you plan to go back tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my new neighbor carrying a big box. It looked very heavy for him.
That sounds like a lot of work. Did you see if he got help?
No, but I went over and pushed the door open for him. He smiled and said thank you.
That was very kind of you to do.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I catch fish in the river?
You can use a small rod and bait. Do you have any worms?
I have bugs. Can I tie them to the line?
Yes, bugs work well too. Just tie them gently to the hook.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to ride my bike today.
That is wonderful news! Where are you going?
I want to ride up the big hill.
Is the hill very steep?
Yes, it is hard but I feel strong.
You must be brave to try that. What color is your bike?
It is bright red like a strawberry.
Red is a great color! Do you wear a helmet?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love how bees make honey. It is so sweet.
Bees use flower nectar to make it. Do you like honey on toast?
Yes, I put it on everything. Tell me more.
They carry the nectar in their hives. It dries down to a thick sweet liquid. Have you seen a hive?
I saw one once. It was buzzing a lot.
The bees add special drops to help it last. Do you know why they guard it?
I think they guard it to save it for winter.
That is true. They eat it when the cold comes.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very worried, but I do not know what to do.
That feels scary. What is the thing you are thinking about?
It is a big task, and I feel lost.
You can take one small step first. Do you know which step is first?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes. Can you help?
Yes, I can help you with that. Do you have your shoes on right now?
Yes, I do. What do I do first?
Make a loop with one string and a loop with the other. Do you like tying knots?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I fix this torn cloth?
Try sewing it with a needle. Do you have any thread?
Yes, I have red thread.
That should work well. Cut the thread to a short length.
I cut it, but the knot looks big.
A small knot is better. Can you pull the string tight?
It pulled tight and holds.
Great job. Your cloth is fixed now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want a drink, but I do not know if I want tea or coffee.
Both are warm and nice. Do you feel too awake already?
I am not sure, it is very hard to choose.
Try a small cup of tea first.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in such a hurry, I cannot do this again.
That feels hard, but you can pause for just a second. Are you feeling tired?
I just need to get this done fast.
Is that for work or for home?
It is for my boss, I am late.
Take a deep breath, then try one small step. Is that okay?
Okay, I will try again.
That is a good start, you are doing well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Today was very bad at work.
That is not good. Do you want to talk about it?
I made a big error with my papers.
That must feel scary. Did you tell your boss?
No, I am too afraid to speak.
It is hard to share fears. I think you should try to tell the truth.
I am not sure if I can do it.
I cannot know for certain. But I am here to listen if you try.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I lost my book card. What do I do?
I am sorry to hear that. Where did you last hold it?
I think I left it at home.
That is a common place for cards. Did you check your bag?
No, I did not check the bag.
Check your bag first. Then come back if you need help.
I checked the bag and it is not there.
I am true, I do not know where it is. Let us look for the librarian.
Okay, can you show me where the desk is?
Yes, the desk is right there. Please go ask them now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: The lights went out. Why did that happen?
The main wires got damaged. Did you feel a sudden click?
Yes, I did. Do you know who will fix it?
The power team is on the way. Do you have a flash light?
I do. Will it take a long time?
Usually, it takes about an hour. Are you staying safe?
I am fine. Does the rain cause this?
Yes, wet air can trip the lines. Do you want water?
No, thank you. Will my coffee stay hot?
Likely, for a short time. Do you hear a truck coming?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to leave now. My bus is coming.
That sounds rushy. Do you like running?
I cannot run. My legs are tired.
I am sorry your legs hurt. Are you going home?
I am going to the store. It is on the hill.
The store is far up there. Is it hot today?
It is very hot. I need to go.
Please wear your hat. Is that your hat?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a big surprise for you.
That sounds very fun. What is it?
It is a box on your desk.
I do not know what is inside yet. Is it a gift?
Yes, it is a toy.
That is great news. Will you open it now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I took a bus today and I felt very happy.
That is nice to hear. Why did the ride make you so glad?
The sun was warm and I looked out the big window.
Sounds like a nice day for a ride. Did you see anything cool outside?
I saw a big dog sitting in a grassy park.
I bet the dog looked relaxed. Were you waving at it?
I did wave and I felt like I was flying.
What a wonderful feeling.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost a game today because I moved too fast.
That happens to everyone. Did you have fun playing?
Yes, I liked the game, but I felt sad at the end.
It is good to learn from mistakes.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke my friend's cup and I feel sad.
That is a kind thing to do. Are you happy now?
I said sorry to her and she smiled.
She is likely glad you apologized. Do you feel lighter?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to bring to the party.
Do you like making things?
Yes, I can bake cookies.
That sounds fun and sweet.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake a cake, but I am afraid I will fail.
Fear is a good sign you care. Have you tried baking anything before?
I have only ever roasted a potato.
That is a great start.
But the cake recipe has so many new words I do not know.
I do not know all of them, but we can look them up together. Do you like reading recipes?
I like them, but I feel silly asking for help.
You are not silly, you are brave.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel sick on the bus. What can I do?
Try to sit near the window for fresh air. Do you have a snack with you?
I am very hungry, but I do not have food.
That is a hard problem. You can wait until you get off the bus to eat.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to clean the water in my fish tank. How do I do it?
You can use a net to scoop out the dirty bits. Do your fish like swimming near the top?
Yes, they do. Should I put new water in all at once?
No, that might shock them. It is better to change only half the water. Do they eat every day?
They eat every day. How much food do I give them?
Just give them what they can eat in two minutes. Too much food makes the water yucky. Do you have a thermometer?
I do not have a thermometer. Is that bad?
I do not know your specific fish, but most need warm water. It is a good idea to buy one. Do you check the water daily?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream on the floor. It is a shame.
That is very sad. Do you want a cookie instead?
Yes, I would love a cookie. What color is the sky today?
It is blue right now. Do you like blue?
I like blue and red. Where is the best place to play?
The yard is a good spot for running.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Which month has the most days?
July and August have thirty-one days. Do you like summer?
I need this fast. What comes after June?
July comes right after June.
Is February short?
Yes, February is usually the shortest month.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired and sad. All these boxes make my head hurt.
That sounds very hard. Are you getting enough rest?
No, I have too much to do. My back aches from lifting.
I am sorry you hurt. Would you like a short break?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I have to go to the doctor?
Your body is feeling not well. Do you feel a headache?
My head hurts and I am tired.
The doctor can help you feel better. Do you like getting better?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so tired. My house is full of boxes. I do not know where to start.
Take a deep breath. You can do this one small thing at a time. Which room is the hardest?
The kitchen is hard. I have too many things there. What should I keep?
I do not know what you like best. Do you still use all those pots?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found an old letter from a friend. I do not know what to do.
That feels nice. Do you remember what they said in it?
I think they missed me. I am happy but also sad.
It is good to feel both. Do you want to write back?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to send a letter far away.
You can buy a stamp here. Do you have the letter ready?
Yes, I have it. Is it fast?
It takes about a week. Is that okay for you?
I need it to arrive in two days.
We can send it by air. Do you have enough money?
Yes, I have five dollars.
That should be fine. Let me help you now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost on this big island. What should I do?
Look for the river to stay safe. Do you see any water near you?
I see trees and rocks, but no water. What else should I check?
Check the path for shells or footprints. Do you see any small tracks in the sand?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am hungry, but I do not know what to eat.
That is hard. Do you like eggs?
I think so. They sound good today.
Good choice. Eggs are warm and nice.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure which book I like best.
That is a hard choice. Do you like happy stories or sad ones?
I think I like the one with the dragon.
Dragons are exciting. Do you read it every night?
I read it when I have time.
Time is precious. Have you finished the story yet?
I am stuck on a hard page.
That is frustrating. Do you want help with the words?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What makes a song sound sad?
Low notes and slow beats often feel sad to us. Do you like slow songs?
I do, but I want to learn piano.
That is a great start for any musician. Is there a specific tune you love?
Yes, I love my favorite piano piece.
I do not know which one is your favorite. Can you play it for me?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How does a big metal ship stay up on the water?
It works because the ship pushes water down, and the water pushes back. Do you want to make a boat out of foil?
Yes, please tell me how to make it.
Take a square of foil and fold the sides up to make a box. Then place it gently on the water and see how many coins it holds.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like apples, but I am tired of eating them whole. Do you have a fun way to eat them?
Yes, you can cut them into thin slices and dip them in chocolate. Do you like chocolate?
Yes, I do. But sometimes I want something sweet that is not brown.
You can try making a fruit salad with grapes and bananas. Do you like grapes?
I do, but I only have apples and bananas. What should I do with just those two?
You can make a simple pie or bake them with a little sugar. I think that sounds nice.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss the loud noise of the cars.
The quiet feels strange, does it not?
Yes, it makes me feel a bit sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you like your home?
I do, but it is too still today.
That is a true thought. Would you like some warm tea?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go. The day was so bad.
I am sorry you feel this way. Did anyone make you mad?
Yes, the boss yelled at me. I must run now.
That is not fair. Do you want to stop and breathe?
No, I cannot stop. I have to go home.
I hope your home is safe. Do you like your home?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to paint a house, but I do not know where to start.
Start with the sky first. Do you like blue or gray skies?
I like blue skies. What do I do next?
Mix some red and yellow to make an orange door. How tall is your house?
It is short. It has one floor.
Draw a big square for the walls. Do you have any green paint?
Yes, I have a lot of green.
Use it for the grass around the house. Do you want to add trees?
Yes, I want to add big trees.
Draw green blobs with brown lines for trunks.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I think summer is the best time.
I like summer too. Do you like hot days?
Yes, but I get very tired.
Running makes you tired. Do you like snow in winter?
No, it is too cold.
Winter can be very cold. Do you have warm boots?
Yes, they are red.
Red boots are nice.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need help putting my clothes in this bag.
Start with the biggest items at the bottom. Do you have your socks?
I do, but I do not know where to put them.
Roll them up tight and put them on the top.
That looks good, but I am done.
Great job, you are ready to go.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my book and I am very sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you know where you last had it?
I think I left it by the window.
That is a good place to look. Have you checked the chair next to it?
No, I have not looked there yet.
Please look there right now. Let me know if you find it.
Oh, yes, I found it right there.
I am so glad you found your book. Do you want help putting it back on the shelf?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must run. Where is the box?
Is it the blue one? It sits on the low shelf.
No, I need the red box.
I do not see it. Did you move it?
I am late. Did you pack it?
Yes, I packed it. It is by the door.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the city so loud today?
The cars and people make a lot of sound. Do you like the noise?
Why are so many people on the sidewalk?
Everyone is busy with their work or school. Are you in a hurry?
Why are the lights so bright at night?
The lights help people see where they are going. I do not know why they are that specific color.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My teacher gave me a big red sticker today because I shared my crayons.
That is very kind of you. Did you get a sticker too?
Yes, I got one for listening too. It felt good.
I am glad you are happy. Do you like stickers?
I love them, but I also like helping my friend with her shoes.
Helping friends is a great way to spend time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I did not get the job today. I feel so sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did they give you a reason?
They said I was too new. It feels bad.
It is hard to start. How did you feel about the work?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall down from the trees?
They fall because it is getting cold and the tree needs to rest. Do you like watching them float down?
Yes, they look like little boats on the wind.
That is a sweet way to see them. The tree lets them go to save its energy for the winter.
So the tree is sleeping?
Yes, the tree sleeps through the cold months. Are you wearing a warm coat today?
Yes, I have on my big red one.
That is good, stay warm and cozy. The tree will grow them back in spring.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big boat on the water today.
That sounds fun. What color was it?
It was white and blue.
Nice. Did you ride inside?
No, I just watched it from the dock.
That is a safe way to see it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a big box to send. What do I do?
Go to the counter and ask for a box. Do you know where the post office is?
Yes, but it is very far. Can I send it from home?
You can call them to help you, but I am not sure if they pick up big boxes. Is the box very heavy?
It is not too heavy. Just one big thing.
Great, take it in and weigh it. Do you have a pen ready?
I have a pen. Thank you, that helps a lot.
You are welcome. Good luck with your box.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I rode my bike to the park this morning.
That sounds fun. Did you see any birds?
Yes, I saw a red robin and a blue jay.
Nature is nice. Did you play on the slides?
I took a break to eat an apple.
Apples are good for you. How far did you ride?
I went about two miles before coming home.
You are a good rider.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the thunder so loud today?
The clouds are very full of rain. Are you scared?
No, I am not scared. Why does it rain from the sky?
Water goes up and gets cold. It comes back down as rain. Do you like wet days?
I do not like wet days. How do we know it will stop?
I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke a big vase. It is hiding under my bed.
That is a heavy secret. Do you feel scared?
Yes, my heart beats fast. What should I do?
The truth will let you breathe again. Do you want to tell me who saw you?
My dog did. He looked at me with sad eyes.
Animals know when we hide things. Go and tell the truth now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do plants take in water?
They pull it up through their roots. Do you have a house plant?
Yes, I do. How can I help it drink better?
Keep the soil moist but not wet. Does it look dry?
It feels a bit dry. Can I just pour more water on it?
Not all at once. Let the water soak in slowly.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like this song but I do not know what it means.
I do not know the song, but lyrics often tell a story. What feeling makes you happy when you listen to it?
It makes me feel calm and slow.
That is a nice feeling. Do you like songs that are fast and loud too?
No, I only like the slow ones.
Then you may want to look for songs with soft words and quiet music.
