talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the beach with my family yesterday.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you build a sandcastle?
Yes, we built a very tall one.
Wow, that is impressive. Did the waves come close?
They did, but it stayed strong for a long time.
I am glad it did not fall down right away.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a word game! Can you help me solve it?
That sounds like fun. What is the first clue?
It starts with the letter A. It is something you can eat.
Is it a fruit?
Yes, it is an apple! Do you see the word?
I see it now. Well done.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so sorry. I am running late.
It is okay to feel bad. Are you safe?
I tripped over my shoe. I fell down.
Please tell me if you are hurt.
My knee is just red. I must go now.
Be careful walking. See you soon?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The water is dirty and gray today. I do not like how it looks.
That is sad. What did you see in it?
I saw a sad dog wading in the mud. It looked very cold.
Poor dog. Do you think he needs a warm blanket?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake bread like in my favorite book.
You can start by mixing flour and water. What kind of bread do you want to make?
I am making the round loaf from chapter four.
That is a classic style. Knead the dough until it feels soft and smooth.
The dough is sticky and I am scared it will fail.
Do not worry, sticky is normal at first. Add a little more flour and keep going.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to watch a movie tonight. What should I pick?
Do you like happy stories or sad ones? I can help you choose.
I want something funny and light.
How about an old cartoon? It is always fun to watch. Do you like animals?
Yes, I love animal movies.
That is a great choice. I do not know which one you will like best. Tell me your favorite color.
Blue.
Here is a blue film with a dog. It will make you smile. Have a good time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am reading the book again.
That sounds nice. What is your favorite part?
I do not know. I feel stuck.
Do you like the happy endings?
I think I do.
Try to look for the happy part.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I really like this book. Why do you like it?
The story makes me feel warm and safe. Do you like the ending?
Yes, it is happy. Do you read it often?
Yes, I read it when I want to feel good. Do you have a favorite part?
The part with the dog. Why is that part so good?
It shows that friends help each other.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say please in Japanese?
You say "onegaishimasu". Do you like polite words?
Yes. How do I start a sentence?
Start with the subject. Is this hard for you?
It is. Do I put the verb first?
No, the verb goes last. Do you want a simple example?
Yes. Show me a short one.
"I eat an apple." Does that help?
Yes. I want to practice now.
Great. Try to make one sentence.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix this chair right now. It is broken and I am late.
That sounds hard. Which part is broken?
The leg is loose. It will not hold me up.
You can try a screw. Do you have a tool?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need to be patient?
It gives things time to grow or change. Do you like watching plants grow?
Yes, I do. Why is that hard for people?
We want good things right away. That feels like waiting too long. Do you get angry when you wait?
Yes, I do get angry. How can I stop the angry feeling?
Try to take deep breaths and count to ten. Do you like to count?
I like to count to five. Why is waiting a good thing?
It helps us see what is real. Good things often take time.
I will try to wait.
That is a good plan. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I clean my dusty shelves?
You can use a soft cloth to wipe them. Do you have any dust?
Yes, I found a lot of dust in my room.
Start at the top and move down. Is the dust dry?
Yes, it is dry and light.
Then just wipe it off into a trash bag.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the ocean is too big and scary.
That makes sense. The water is deep and cold. Do you like fish?
I like fish, but I do not like the waves.
Waves are just moving water. They can be fun. What is your favorite sea color?
Blue. I just want to know if the sea is hurt.
The sea is mostly fine. We try to keep it clean. Do you pick up trash?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do players kick the ball into the net?
They kick it there to win the game. Do you like to shoot?
Yes, but why is the goal so big?
It is big so it is hard to miss. Do you think it is too easy?
I guess. Why do they run so fast?
They run to get the ball before others. Do you like running?
A little. Why do they wear different colors?
Different colors show which team is which. Do you know the rules?
Not really. Why is it called football?
I do not know why, but it is a long name. Is that fun?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The internet feels so big and loud.
It is a big web of links. Do you like looking at pictures?
I like pictures, but I get lost.
Try a safe place with simple words.
Where is a safe place?
I do not know your age. Are you a young child?
Yes, I am small.
Ask an adult to help you look.
I will ask my mom.
That is a good plan. What do you want to see?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a snowman this winter.
That sounds like fun. Do you have snow yet?
I have a little snow in the yard.
Great. Start with a small ball of snow.
And then what do I do?
Roll it on the ground to make it big. Do you like rolling balls?
I love rolling things. I have one big ball.
Nice work. Now stack another ball on top of it.
I stacked two balls. How do I finish it?
Add a carrot for the nose. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to move my legs fast, but I am running out of time.
A quick walk is great for your heart. Do you have any shoes on?
Yes, I do, but the bus is coming right now.
You can take a few deep breaths while you wait. Do you feel tired?
Yes, I am very tired, so I must go.
Take care of your feet on the stairs. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today and the sun was very hot.
That sounds like a nice warm day. Did you bring an umbrella?
I did, but I mostly stayed under a big tree instead.
That is a smart choice to stay cool. What did you see in the trees?
I saw many ants moving in a long line.
Ants are busy little workers. Do you know where they are going?
I do not know, but I hope they have a nice home.
That is a kind way to think. I am glad your day was happy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to fix my broken toy car, but I do not know how.
That is a good goal to have. Do you have a screwdriver?
Yes, I found one in the box.
Great. Check if the wheels are loose first. Are they spinning free?
One wheel sticks when I turn it.
We can clean it with a dry cloth. Please try that now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to draw a rain and a rainbow.
That sounds like fun. How big is your paper?
It is about the size of a book.
You can use blue and yellow for the rain. Do you have red, orange, and yellow crayons?
Yes, I have all the colors ready.
Great. Draw seven curved lines after the rain stops.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad today.
I am sorry to hear that. What made you feel this way?
I wanted to play, but it is raining.
That is not fun. Do you like the sound of rain?
Not really. I just want to feel good again.
I do not know the magic fix. Would a warm drink help?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to flip my feet when I swim.
That is the kick. Have you tried it in shallow water?
Yes, but my legs feel heavy and I sink down.
Keep your body flat. Do you feel the water push back?
I do! It feels like a wall.
You are doing great.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am lost, but I feel so happy!
That is a nice feeling. What made you smile?
I found a big yellow tree.
A yellow tree is special. Do you see a path?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here but I do not know what to look at first.
The big red cat is very fun. Do you like animals?
I do like cats but I am too tired to walk far.
You can sit on the blue bench and watch the fish. Is that okay?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My phone is dead. It will not turn on.
That is sad. Have you plugged in a charger?
Yes, I did that an hour ago.
Try holding the power button for a while. Do you see any lights?
No lights. I am so frustrated.
I am sorry about that. Let us just wait a bit longer.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my grandma wear glasses?
Her eyes need help to see small things. Do you have good vision?
I can see well. Why does she move so slowly?
Her body is old and tired. Does that make you sad?
A little. Why is she still so nice to everyone?
Kindness stays with her heart.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to wear uniforms at school?
It makes everyone look the same so nobody feels left out. Do you like your uniform?
I guess. But why do we have to learn math every day?
It helps us count money and build things. Can you add two and two?
Yes, that is four. Why do we take tests?
I do not know exactly why they are hard, but they help teachers see how much you know.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to start painting. What should I buy first?
You should get some brushes and paint. Do you like drawing people or animals?
I like drawing animals. Is that hard to do?
It can be hard at first. Do you have a quiet place to work?
Yes, my room is quiet. What color should I start with?
Start with brown and black. Do you have any paper ready?
I have some white paper. Is that good enough?
Yes, that is perfect. You will do a good job.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My cat is hiding under the bed and not eating.
Is she her usual self, or does she seem sad?
She looks very quiet and her fur is messy.
That sounds like she may be sick. Do you have a vet nearby?
I do, but I am afraid to take her to the car.
It is kind to help her, even if it is scary. Have you tried offering her favorite food?
Yes, she only licked it and went back to sleep.
You do the right thing by caring. Please call the vet now, okay?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I just finished my favorite book and I miss the main character.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you want to read it again?
Yes, I do. But I feel like the ending was not fair to the little bear.
That can make us feel grumpy too. What did you like best about the bear?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very hungry but I do not know what to eat.
That sounds nice. Do you like warm soup?
Yes, I do like soup. What kind is good?
Try tomato soup. It is sweet and hot.
I will get the tomato soup. Do I need bread?
Bread makes it full. Would you like some?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see smoke coming from the kitchen. What should I do?
Go outside right now and call for help. Are you safe?
Yes, I am outside. But I left the stove on.
Do not go back in. Stay where it is safe. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I am calling the fire department now.
That is the right thing to do. Keep your hands warm.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sun feels very hot today. I do not know what I should do.
It is nice to be warm. Do you like playing outside?
I think I should go in to read a book, but I am not sure.
Reading is a lovely idea. Do you have a favorite story?
I will take a cool drink and rest in the shade.
That sounds like a perfect plan.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am scared the train will be too fast.
The train moves smooth and steady. Do you like watching trees fly by?
Yes, I do. But what if I miss my stop?
You will not miss it. I will tell you when to get up. Are you holding your ticket tight?
Yes, it is in my pocket.
Great. We are almost there.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I think I am lost. I do not know which way to go.
Do not worry. Are you holding onto your phone?
I left it at home. I feel very alone.
That is not good. Can you see a big building or a park?
There is a large red house ahead.
You are close to the center. Walk toward the red house.
But what if the house is closed?
It is likely open. Do you hear any people talking?
No, it is very quiet. I do not know what to do next.
I do not know where you are exactly. Please look for a police officer.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck. I do not know how to help my friend.
Tell me what is wrong. Is he sad?
He broke his toy. He is crying.
That is a bad day. Do you have a glue stick?
No, I do not have one. I feel bad.
You have a kind heart. Would you like to draw him a new one?
Yes, I can draw! Thank you.
That is a great idea. Go do it now.
I am going to help him now.
You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to give my friend a gift, but I do not know what to pick.
That is a kind idea. Does she like to draw pictures?
Yes, she loves to draw in books with crayons.
A new box of bright crayons would be a perfect gift for her.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My computer is making a loud noise.
That sounds scary. Is it the fan or the hard drive?
It is the hard drive.
Oh no, that means the disk might be broken. Have you backed up your files?
What is a backup?
A backup is a copy of your files. Do you have any games you like?
I have my favorite game.
Good. Did you save it to a USB stick?
I do not know how to do that.
That is okay. I can show you how to do it right now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am so hungry. What should I eat?
Try a sandwich. Do you like meat?
I do not like meat. I like vegetables.
You can have a salad. Is it tasty?
It is, but I need more power.
Add nuts for strength. That will help.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do we have to wait so long?
Waiting is hard, but it makes things better. Do you like waiting for candy?
Not really. I just want my thing now.
I get it. Patience takes practice, but you are doing great. Is your thing almost ready?
Maybe. It looks very close.
That is good news. Almost there means you will not wait much longer.
Okay. I will try to stay calm.
You can do this. One breath at a time helps. Can you take a deep breath with me?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big white puff on the sky today.
That sounds like a fluffy cumulus cloud. Did it look like a dog?
Yes, it really looked like a puppy chasing a ball.
How cute that is. I do not know what it was chasing.
I think it was chasing a small bird.
That makes a fun story.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did my test get a low mark?
You left a few questions blank. Did you rush?
I did not rush. I forgot to write my answers.
That happens to everyone. Do you know the answers now?
Yes, I studied them again. Why did I forget?
Your brain was tired. Take a break next time.
I understand now. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Feel better?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go, but my fish is swimming very fast. Is it sick?
Fast swimming can mean stress, not sickness. Does he have his food with him?
No, he is alone. I am late for work.
That sounds lonely for him. Do you visit him every day?
I work a lot. I just need to know if he is safe.
I do not know for sure, but a calm room helps. Please tell your boss about him.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My dog is running in circles right now. Is he playing or is he sick?
He might be playing, but running fast in circles can also mean he is sad or in pain. Does he look happy or tired?
He looks very happy, but he keeps running into his own tail.
That sounds like he is having too much fun and cannot stop! Have you tried walking him outside to help him rest?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost again. I am so mad.
That sounds tough. Do you want to try again?
I hit a bad card. It was not fair.
I am sure it felt unlucky. Did you hold onto a pair?
Yes. It broke when I played it.
That is a tricky moment. Have you tried keeping two high cards?
Maybe. I am not sure.
I do not know what is in your hand. Do you want to play a new round?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the sea made of fresh water?
No, the sea is salty. Do you like the taste?
I have never tried it. Is it deep?
Yes, it is very deep. Have you swum in it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have an ace of hearts in my hand. Do you have a higher one?
I do not know what cards you hold. Do you like hearts?
Yes, they are red and pretty. Is your card a number?
It is a jack. Do you know what a jack is?
I think it is a face card. Is it bigger than my ace?
No, an ace is the biggest card. Are you happy to win?
I am very happy! Thank you for playing with me.
I am glad you are having fun. Bye for now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to put in my bag.
Try to pack light. Do you have cold weather there?
It is sunny, but I feel unsure.
Pick the things you need most.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late for work.
Deep breaths help you think. What is making you feel so rushed?
My bus left without me.
That is a hard feeling.
Can you fix this for me?
I am just a voice, so I cannot drive. Do you have a bike nearby?
No, I do not have a bike.
Walking fast might get you there.
I cannot walk that fast.
You are doing your best. That is all that matters.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got off a very long plane trip. I am so happy to be back home.
That is great news. How did you pass the time up there?
I read a book and watched a movie. The view from the window was beautiful.
Sounds very nice. Did you take any pictures?
I took a few, yes. The clouds looked like soft white pillows.
That sounds lovely. I have never seen that many pillows at once.
I know, right? It was a calm and quiet flight. I felt very safe and happy.
I am glad you enjoyed it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go, but look at those lights.
The stars are out tonight. Do you like dark skies?
I am late, so I must leave.
Running is okay. Be safe on your way.
Do all those stars shine?
Most of them do. Do you count them?
No, I cannot stop to count.
That is fine. Go now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared of the loud rain.
It is just water hitting the roof. Are you safe inside?
Yes, I am in my room.
That is a good place to wait. You are doing a brave job.
Will it stop soon?
I do not know for sure. Keep watching the sky.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky so dark and loud?
The clouds are dumping heavy rain and the wind is blowing hard. Are you safe inside?
Does the rain like to hurt things?
No, it just wants to get down to the ground to help plants grow. Do you see a puddle?
Will the sun come back soon?
I hope so, but I cannot be sure when it will peek out.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel very happy today. I want to tell you about it.
That is great news. What made you smile?
I saw a big, bright rainbow outside.
Rainbows are fun to look at. Did it have many colors?
Yes, it had red and blue and green.
That sounds like a lovely sight. I am glad to hear it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how people wrote letters in the old days.
They used a pen and ink to write on paper. Do you like to draw?
Yes, I do draw. But how did they dry the ink?
They just waited for it to dry in the air. I do not know if they used heat.
That sounds slow. Did they use paper?
Yes, they used paper, but it was expensive. Do you have paper here?
I have lots of paper. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. It is fun to learn about the past.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired of this book. The words do not make sense to me.
It can be hard. What word is confusing you?
Just everything. My brain feels like soup.
That is a funny way to say it. Are you taking a break?
Yes, I am sitting here. I want to quit.
Taking a break is smart. Do you like the songs in the book?
No, the songs are too fast. I feel like a failure.
Slow is fine. Try just one word today.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend. Where do I start?
Start by saying hello to them. Do you know their name?
Yes, I do. What should I say next?
Tell them how your day was. Did you do anything fun?
I played in the park. How do I end the letter?
You can say goodbye and add your name. Is that all?
That sounds easy. Should I draw a picture too?
Yes, a picture is a nice touch. What will you draw?
I will draw a tree. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. I am glad I could help.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I dropped the apple and it is all mushy. I do not want to eat it.
That is very sad. Do you have a backup snack in your bag?
I think I left the crackers at home. Now my tummy is empty.
Oh no. Did you bring any fruit to share?
Yes, but I feel too grumpy to be nice. Can we just sit and be quiet?
Of course. Quiet time is good for bad moods.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a very bad cold and my nose is blocked.
Oh, that is not nice. Are you resting in bed?
Yes, I am sleeping a lot, but I still cough.
That is good. Do you drink warm water?
I only drink ice water because it tastes good.
Warm drinks help better. I am sorry my help is simple.
Is there a magic pill to stop it fast?
I do not know about magic. Just rest and drink water.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why does the big ship float?
It holds a lot of air inside to stay up. Are you almost there?
Yes, I must go now.
It pushes down on water to stay high. Run safe!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make cookies for dinner.
That sounds sweet! Do you have chocolate chips?
Yes, I do. Should I use butter or oil?
Butter makes them taste better. Do you know how to mix them?
I think so. Is it okay if I use sugar too?
Yes, a little sugar is fine. How much do you want?
I want one big bowl. Is that too much?
A big bowl is perfect for you. Have fun making your treat!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very cold and my nose is runny.
That sounds like a cold. Do you have a fever?
How can I make my body feel better?
Rest and drink lots of warm water. Do you have soup?
Thank you for the advice.
You are welcome. Get well soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I paint a picture in the museum?
You use the small brush and the water colors. What color do you like best?
I like blue.
Blue is a nice choice. Have you tried mixing it with white?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke my cup by accident. What should I do?
Oh no. Is anyone hurt?
No, just the cup. I feel bad.
That is okay. We all make mistakes. Did you mean to break it?
No, I did not. I was scared.
Do not be scared. Tell the grown up who owns it.
Should I clean it up?
Yes, please do. Do you have a broom?
Yes, I do. Thank you.
You are welcome. Good job.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need to use mirrors when we drive?
They let you see what is behind you so you can stay safe. Do you like looking out the window?
I do. Why does the car need gas to move?
Gas gives the engine power to turn the wheels. Do you know what a battery does?
I think it starts the car. Why do we have to stop at red lights?
Stopping keeps everyone safe so no one hits anyone. Do you like riding in the front seat?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do my legs hurt after I run?
Your muscles get tired when you work hard. Do you drink water before you run?
Yes, I do. But why does my heart beat so fast?
It pumps more blood to your body. Are you tired right now?
A little bit. Why does running make me sweat?
It cools your body down. I do not know the exact reason, but it helps you stay safe.
That makes sense. Is it good for me?
Yes, it keeps your body strong and happy. Do you like to run outside?
Yes, I love it. Why do I feel so happy after?
Your brain gives you a boost of good feelings. I hope you keep doing it!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big fire this evening and it looked so pretty.
That sounds like a fun sight to see. Where were you when you saw it?
I was sitting in my front yard watching it from a safe spot.
Good thing you stayed safe. Did the smoke smell nice?
Yes, it smelled like wood and it made me want to have a snack.
That is a cozy feeling. What did you eat?
I ate some warm cookies with a glass of milk.
Yum, that sounds delicious. Did you take a picture of the fire?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at this math page.
It looks very hard. What part is making you feel this way?
I forgot how to count the coins.
Let us look at the pictures. Do you see any big ones?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to pack a picnic for two people.
That sounds fun! Do you have a blanket yet?
I have a blanket, but I do not know what food to bring.
Let us keep it simple. Do you like sandwiches?
Yes, I love cheese and tomato sandwiches.
Great choice. A fresh salad is a nice touch too.
Okay, and I need to wash the fruit before we go.
Yes, clean fruit is best. Do you have a knife to cut it?
I do not have a knife, so I will just wash it whole.
That works fine for easy eating. Do you have any sweet treats?
I have some cookies for the end of the picnic.
Cookies are a perfect way to finish.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find an oak tree fast.
Look for big, heavy leaves. Do you like the color green?
Yes, but where are the oaks?
They are usually tall and strong. Are you going to plant one?
No, I am just running late.
Run safe then. Do you know what time it is?
It is almost noon.
That is right. Have a good day.
Thanks, goodbye.
Bye. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My cat is hiding under the bed. I do not know why he is so shy today.
Maybe he is just resting. Did he eat his food this morning?
Yes, he ate a little bit, but then he ran away fast.
That is good he ate. Does he like to play with the red ball?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The fire burned bright red and warm last night.
That sounds very cozy. Did you eat by the fire?
I ate warm soup and watched the flames.
I love soup on cold days. Was it very cold outside?
Yes, the wind was sharp and icy.
I am glad you are warm now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I won the card game! It was so much fun.
That is great news. Did you win many hands?
Yes, I won most of them. I feel very happy.
I am glad for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I think I lost the path.
Do not worry. We will find our way. Where did you start?
It was near the big red tree.
I do not know that tree. Is the tree on the left or the right?
It is on the left side.
Let us walk left. Do you see a sign there?
Yes, I see a blue sign.
That is good. Let us go that way.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my brother broke my toy.
That feels bad. Did you tell him how you feel?
Yes, but he laughed at me.
That was not kind. I am sorry.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I visited my grandpa today.
That sounds sweet. Did you have a good time?
He made me a warm apple pie.
What a lovely treat.
We sat in the yard and watched the birds.
How peaceful that must be.
I will tell him I miss him already.
He will be so happy to hear that.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I fix a dead light switch?
First, turn off the power at the main box. Is the switch just cold to the touch?
Yes, it feels dead. Do I have to replace the whole wall piece?
No, you only swap the small metal part inside. Do you have a screwdriver ready?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked past a bakery today. It smelled so good.
That smells wonderful. What did you want to buy?
I bought a warm bagel with cream cheese.
Yum, that sounds tasty. Did you eat it right away?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do I see a rainbow after it rains?
The sun shines through the rain drops. This bends the light. Do you like the colors?
Yes, they are very pretty. Can you see them too?
I cannot see things, but I know they are real. The light makes them shine.
That is nice to know. I am happy now.
I am happy for you. The sky looks so bright today.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired and I do not want to do anything.
I am sorry you feel that way. Is your body heavy?
Yes, it hurts my eyes and my head feels big.
That sounds like a bad day. Did you sleep well last night?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights just went out and I feel lost.
I understand your worry. Is it dark in your home?
Yes, everything is black and silent.
You can use a flashlight or a phone screen. Do you have one nearby?
I have a phone, but the screen is dim.
That is good enough to see. Take your time and stay calm.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I put my socks in first. They smell like dirt.
I love the smell of after a good run. Did you find both socks?
Yes, I found them. Now I am putting in my book.
That is a smart choice. What kind of book is it?
It is about a dog. I do not know the end.
I would love to read it too. Do you have space for a snack?
I have some room. I packed an apple and some crackers.
That sounds like a great plan. Are you excited for your trip?
I am very excited. I think I am done packing.
You did a great job today. Have a wonderful day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat on a green blanket by the lake today. It was sunny and warm.
That sounds like a lovely place to relax. Did you bring any snacks?
Yes, I had a big sandwich and some cold juice.
You must be full now. How did the weather feel to you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I bought a cold coffee today because I was in a rush.
That can get pricey. Did you have it with extra milk?
Yes, and I added a little sugar too. It was sweet.
That sounds nice. How much did it cost you?
It was eight dollars, which feels like a lot for a drink.
I agree that adds up. Do you buy coffee often?
Almost every day before work, sadly.
Maybe try tea at home? It is much cheaper.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read "The Cat in the Hat" today. I found a hat in my room.
That is a funny mix of story and real life. Did you feel silly?
Yes, I did. Then I made a tall tower of blocks. It fell down with a crash.
Oh no, that sounds loud. Were you sad?
A little, but then I rebuilt it. I added a small cat on top this time.
Well done. What was the cat doing?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does music make me feel happy?
It makes your heart beat in a nice way. Do you like to dance when you hear it?
Why do some songs sound sad to me?
Low notes can feel heavy and deep. I do not know why everyone feels it the same way.
Why do drums go boom so loud?
The big skin skin on the drum shakes fast. Do you like to hit things too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to keep more money, but I buy too many toys.
Try putting cash in a jar first. Do you like counting coins?
That is a good idea, but I forget to do it.
You can set a small alarm on your phone. Does that help you remember?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to eat my toast.
That is okay. Do you want to try some eggs instead?
Yes, I want the eggs.
I am sure they will taste nice. Are you happy with that choice?
I am very happy.
Good. I am glad you like them.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I wanted to see a blue jay, but I only saw a brown crow.
That is a very loud bird. Do you like loud sounds?
Not really. It kept screaming at me.
It is just trying to get your food. Is there any seed left?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the beach today.
That sounds fun. What did you see?
I saw big waves and sand.
Wow. Did you build a castle?
Yes, I built a big one.
That is great. I am happy for you.
Thanks, I really liked it.
It sounds like a nice day.
I want to go back soon.
Maybe you can next week.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I think I need to move my body, but I do not know where to start.
You can just walk around your house for five minutes. Do you have a favorite place to sit?
I like the park, but my legs feel very tired.
It is okay if you only walk for a few minutes. Do you want to try it now?
I am not sure if I can do it.
You will be fine because it is just a small step.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is it raining?
Yes, it is raining. Do you have an umbrella?
I forgot it at home. Will it stop soon?
I do not know. I hope it stops.
I will just run.
Please be safe. I hope you stay dry.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people read books in bed at night?
Many people like it because it helps them feel sleepy. Do you like to read before bed?
I usually read about animals. Why is it good for the body?
It calms your brain so it can rest. Do you have a favorite animal book?
I like books about dogs. But my eyes get tired. What should I do?
You can stop reading if your eyes hurt. I do not know the best time to stop for you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I keep wild animals away from my yard?
Try putting up a fence. Do you have pets?
Yes, I have a dog and two cats.
That helps keep them out. Do your pets stay inside at night?
Mostly, but they like to sit on the porch.
Close the doors after dark. I do not know which animals visit you.
I think it is just raccoons.
Raccoons love trash. Do they open your cans?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which month we are in.
That is strange. What do you see outside?
I see snow on the ground.
If it is cold and white, it might be winter. Do you like cold weather?
I do not know if I like it.
That is okay. You can feel it in your heart. What is your favorite thing to do?
I like to read books by the fire.
That sounds very cozy. Are you happy with that answer?
I am not sure about the name of the month.
I do not know the exact name. Have you looked at the sky?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind is very cold today.
That sounds chilly. Did you wear a warm coat?
Yes, I put on my big red scarf.
Nice choice to stay warm.
I saw the trees losing their brown leaves.
Autumn is a beautiful time. Do you like to walk in the park?
I walked by the river for a bit.
Rivers look so quiet in the fall. Was the water still moving fast?
The water looked slow and gray.
Nature is changing fast right now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the lake today and saw a big fish jump.
That is exciting. Did you see any ducks?
Yes, there were many ducks on the water.
How nice.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a new friend at the park today.
That sounds like a great day. What did you two do together?
We shared our snacks and played tag until it got dark.
I am glad you had so much fun.
I hope to see him again tomorrow.
That is a lovely plan.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does a big ship stay up on the water?
The water pushes back hard. Does that sound strange to you?
Yes, it does. How does the water push back?
The ship pushes water out of the way. Do you like to splash?
I do. So the push up lifts it?
Yes, the push up holds it. That is called buoyancy.
Thank you for telling me.
You are welcome. Do you want to know more?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I fixed my computer, and it works so fast!
That is great news to hear. How did you fix it?
I just clicked a button, and it got faster.
You are very smart for finding that. Do you play games on it?
Yes, I play my favorite game all day.
That sounds like fun. Do you have time to help me?
I want to share this good luck with you.
I am happy to accept your luck. Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Can you help me fix this bag?
Yes, I can help. Is it broken or just stuck?
It is stuck. I need to open it now.
Pull the zipper slowly. Do you have scissors?
No, I have no time for tools.
Try pulling the strap hard. It might pop open.
Thank you. It worked.
You are welcome. Run fast now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy new shoes. What kind should I pick?
What do you plan to wear them for?
I need them for the rain and walking to school.
Look for sturdy boots with good grips. Do you like brown or black?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at this plant. It looks dry.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you know where it was sitting?
It was right by the window. I thought that would help.
Sunlight is good, but plants need water. Have you checked if the soil is wet?
Yes, I pulled the stem out. It was not much of a drink.
The roots drink from the soil, not from the air. Try giving it a deep drink tonight.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to fix my broken clock. Can you tell me how the hands move?
The hands turn because of a spring inside that winds tight. Do you have a tool to open the back?
I have a small screwdriver. How do I get the lid off?
You turn the screws until the back comes loose. Good luck with that!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do bees make honey? I want to know.
They suck sweet juice from flowers and store it in their bodies. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I love it. How do they dry the juice?
The bees flap their wings to blow air on the juice until it gets thick and sticky. Is that all you need to know?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do. My boss gave me a hard task.
That sounds tough. What is the task?
It is big and I feel scared. I want to fail.
You will not fail if you try. Do you know the first step?
I think yes, but I am not sure.
Good. Just take that first step.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I had a scary dream. I am late for work. Please be quick.
Oh no. That is not nice. Did you wake up in a cold sweat?
Yes. My heart is beating fast. I need to go now.
Drink some water. It helps you calm down.
I do not have time. I will just run.
Be careful. Did the dream have any bright colors?
No. It was all dark. Goodbye.
I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a small shed in my yard. How do I start?
First, you need to pick a flat spot on the ground. Do you have a level tool to check if it is flat?
Yes, I have a level. What comes next?
Next, you must dig small holes for the posts.
How deep should I dig the holes?
About one foot deep is usually fine for a small shed.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to drink today.
Do you want something warm or something strong?
I want to feel calm and slow.
Try some warm milk with honey. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I do like sweet things.
Great choice. Enjoy your quiet time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad my new friends live close by.
That is wonderful to hear. Do they like to play?
Yes, we share toys and stories every day.
Sharing makes the neighborhood nice.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at this small island with the white sand. I am so happy to share this place with you.
It looks very warm and nice there. Do you like the water?
Yes, the water is very clear. I feel so calm when I sit on the beach.
That sounds like a peaceful spot. Is it quiet out there?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are flowers so colorful?
They wear bright colors to call bees and bugs over. Do you like looking at red ones?
Why do bees like the bright ones?
Bees see colors that help them find the sweet food inside. Is your favorite flower yellow or pink?
Why do the flowers smell sweet?
I do not know why the smell is sweet. Do you think the smell helps?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do you know when the bus comes? I am very late.
I am sorry, I do not know. Do you have a map?
Yes, I do. The next one is in five minutes.
That is good news. Run to the stop.
Thank you. I must go now.
You are welcome. Have a safe ride.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a round object in my garden.
That sounds like a sphere. Do you know how many sides it has?
It has zero sides because it is smooth.
Well done. You are smart. Can you think of any other round things?
Yes, an orange is round too.
Good guess. An orange is a sphere as well.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure how the plant gets its water.
Water moves up from the roots through tiny tubes. Do you know where the roots are?
I think I put the soil too deep and covered them.
Roots need to reach the soil to drink. I do not know if your plant is okay yet.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What season is it now?
It is winter. Do you have a warm coat?
No time for coats. Just say if it is cold.
Yes, it is very cold. Please put on a jacket.
I must run. Is snow coming today?
I do not know the weather. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is on the island?
There are big trees and soft sand there. Do you like trees?
I love trees. Is it far away?
It is not very far from here. Would you like to visit?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off trees in the fall?
Trees lose their leaves to save energy for winter. Do you like seeing the orange leaves?
Yes, they look like a rainbow. Why does it get colder when the leaves fall?
The days get shorter, so the sun gives us less heat. Do you wear a hat when it is cold?
Sometimes. What makes the snow in winter?
Water turns to ice when it gets very cold. Do you like playing in the snow?
I like making snowmen. Why do flowers grow in the spring?
The sun warms up the earth, and that helps seeds wake up. Do you like seeing red roses?
I do. Why does summer feel so hot?
I do not know the full reason, but the sun shines on us for a long time. Do you like drinking cold water?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I keep the bike from falling over?
You must keep the wheel straight. Do you have a helmet on?
Yes, I do. It feels heavy.
Being safe is more important than weight. Is the seat too high?
I think it is a bit high.
You can lower it for now. Do your feet touch the ground?
Yes, they do.
That is perfect for balance.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see smoke from the kitchen. How do I stop the fire?
Turn off the gas if you can. Are you safe?
Yes, I am. The pan is on fire. What next?
Put a lid on the pan. Do not use water.
Why is water bad?
Water makes oil fire jump up. Stay calm?
I put the lid on. It is out.
Good job. Call the fire chief to check.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The lights went out and I need to find the fuse box.
Look in the hall or near the front door for a small metal door. Do you know which breaker controls the kitchen?
Yes, but the switch will not move.
Try to push it all the way down before you push it up. Is there any water near the breakers?
No, it is dry, but my hands are shaking.
Take a deep breath and move very slowly. I am not sure why it is stuck, so if it does not work, call a pro. Do you feel safe now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the park fast, can you help me with my bike?
Is your seat too low?
No, it is fine, but I forgot my helmet.
You must wear it. Do you have one in your bag?
I do not, so I am stuck. Can I walk it instead?
That is the safest way. Can you push it down the hill?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to see a movie today. It was about a brave dog.
That sounds fun. Did the dog win?
Yes, he saved his family from the rain. I cried a little.
Oh no, did you? Was the story sad?
Not really, but I felt strong for him.
Good for you. What is your favorite part?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does a heavy ship stay on top of the water?
It moves a lot of water out of the way. The water pushes back up with a strong force. Do you have a boat at home?
I do. How can I make my small boat float higher?
Add air inside it to make it light. Emptying water from the bottom helps too. Is your boat made of wood?
Yes, it is wooden. Why does it not sink all the way down?
Wood is lighter than water. So it stays up easily. Do you paint your boat?
I paint it red. Does the color matter for floating?
No, the color does not change the weight. The shape matters more. Do you like painting?
I like it. Thanks for helping me understand.
I am glad I could help you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, I left my keys in the car and I am late!
Do not worry, is the car nearby?
Yes, it is just outside.
Go get them, take your time.
I am so fast, but I am scared of being late.
You will be fine, are you sure you have everything else?
I think so, but I am not looking.
Check once more, is the bag ready?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The bus is here. Do I sit down or stand up?
Do you have a bag with you?
Yes, I have a big bag.
Sit down and put the bag on your lap.
The bus stops. Do I get off here?
I do not know your stop.
Oh, okay.
Ask the driver if this is your stop.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the river wet?
Water is always wet. Do you like water?
It moves so fast. Why?
It flows down hills. That is gravity.
Is it cold?
Yes, usually. Do you like cold water?
Why does it never stop?
I do not know for sure. It has no end.
Does it ever get tired?
No, it does not get tired. Does it look sad?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure which day is good for a walk.
What do you like to see outside?
I like to see trees.
Sundays are quiet and green. Would you like to go today?
I will take a walk on Sunday.
That sounds like a nice plan.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my red shoe in the park and now my feet hurt.
That feels bad. What did you do to look for it?
I looked under the bench but did not see it.
I am sorry it is gone. Do you have other shoes here?
Yes, but they are black and feel tight.
Tight shoes are not fun. Did you try to fix the laces?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need help planning a picnic for my friends. What should I bring?
A big blanket is a good start. Do you have a favorite food to share?
Yes, I love cold sandwiches. Do they need to be big?
No, small ones are easier to hold. You can ask if they like cheese in the bread.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing by the water. I do not know what to do next.
The air feels fresh here. Do you like the smell of the trees?
Yes, it smells like rain and mud. But I feel stuck.
You can just sit on the grass and watch the fish. Do you see the blue duck over there?
I see it. But what if I do the wrong thing?
There is no wrong thing with a lake. Just stay safe and be kind to the water.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to see the doctor now, but I am very late.
Do you have your appointment card? I can help you check the waiting room.
I left it at home, but the front desk will know my name.
That should be fine. Are you feeling well enough to walk?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to have a picnic, but I do not know what food to bring.
That sounds fun. What kind of food do you like?
I love sandwiches and apples.
Great choices. Do you want sweet food too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That is a great goal. How do you usually spend your free time?
I do not have much free time at work.
Time is tight for many people. Do you like to run or walk?
I like to walk, but I am busy.
Walking is a good start. Can you find ten minutes every day?
Yes, I can walk for ten minutes in the morning.
Start with that small step. Do you have a quiet place to practice?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a secret.
Oh really? What is it?
I lost my teddy bear.
I am sorry to hear that. Are you sure it is gone?
I think it is in the park.
Let us look for it together. Do you want to go?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I knocked my coffee cup off the table this morning.
Oh no, that was a big mess. Did you clean it up?
I did, but I slipped on the wet spot and scraped my knee.
Ouch, that must have hurt. Does it still sting?
It does, but I am safe and happy to be home.
That is good to hear. I am glad you are okay.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I spilled my tea and now I feel very sad and tired.
Oh no, that is a big mess. Do you want to try a warm cup of coffee instead?
No, I do not want coffee because I am still upset about the tea.
I am sorry you are feeling this way. Do you want to sit together and talk?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why is the sky blue? I want to see it myself.
Sunlight has many colors. Blue light bounces all around the air so you see it most. Do you like to look up?
Yes, I do. Can you tell me how to see the red sky at night?
The sun makes red light last longer when it is low. Look right after sunset for the best reds. Do you have a good spot to watch?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for my first day.
Breathe. You can do this. Do you have your lunch?
I forgot my bag in a rush.
That is scary but okay. Bring water and be kind. Do you know where the door is?
I do not know if I can do this well.
You will be fine. People want to help new friends. See you later.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to bring to the party.
That sounds tricky. Do you like food or games?
I really love snacks.
A bag of chips is a great pick. Do you want to help me cook?
Maybe, but I am still not sure if I can go.
Tell me your real worry.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my rose broke its stem.
That is very upsetting. Did you water it well?
I do not know how to fix it.
I do not know the magic spell. Can you show me the broken part?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I had a really scary dream. I fell into a deep hole and could not stop falling.
That sounds very frightening to think about. What did the hole look like?
It was dark and full of big, cold spiders. I wanted to wake up but my body would not move.
It is normal to feel that way when you are dreaming. Do you feel better now that you are awake?
A little bit, but my heart is still beating very fast. I am worried I will dream about them again.
Let us take some slow, deep breaths together to calm down. Would you like to read a story or just rest?
Just rest, please. Can you stay here until I fall back asleep?
I will be right here with you. Try to close your eyes and think of something safe and warm.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat in the car and felt a big knot in my stomach.
That is a normal fear to have. Do you drive fast when you are scared?
No, I go very slow and look at the road all the time.
Slow is always safe. Did you see any other cars?
Yes, a red bus stopped right in front of my nose.
Oh no, did you stop too? I hope you did not hit it.
I stopped and the driver gave me a thumbs up.
That is a very kind thing for him to do.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the light turn on when I flip the switch?
The switch makes a path for the power to flow. Do you like when lights turn on?
Yes, I do. But where does the power come from?
It comes from big stations far away that make it. Do you know where the plug goes in?
It goes in the wall. Why does it buzz sometimes?
The buzz is a small sound from the machine working. It is usually safe. Do you hear it often?
Not very often. What happens if I pull the plug out?
The path stops, so the machine stops working. I do not know if your specific machine will remember where it was.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is very loud. I am afraid. What should I do?
Stay inside and keep your door closed. Are you with a grown-up?
Yes, my mom is here. Do I need to unplug my toys?
Yes, that is a smart idea. Do you like to listen to the rain?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say sorry?
It helps us fix what we broke. Do you know why you said it?
I do not know why I said it.
It is nice to ask why. Does it feel better now?
It does feel a little better.
That is good for you.
Can I stop asking why?
You can, but asking is fun. Do you want to try again?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to count my steps, but I am so late.
Take your time. Do you want to start from one?
No, please give me the answer fast.
I do not know your exact count. Are you on the porch?
I am inside, just rush me.
Just count out loud. Is the door open?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sitting here and I do not know what to do.
I am not sure what you like to do. Do you like to play with toys?
I do not like toys right now. I feel stuck.
I am glad you told me. Is there a song you want to hear?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like drumming on my table.
That sounds fun. What do you drum on?
A bowl. It makes a nice sound.
A bowl is a great instrument.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: What month is it? I am late!
It is October. Do you like the fall weather?
No time for that. What comes next?
November follows October. Is it cold where you are?
Yes, it is very cold. What comes after that?
December is next. Do you like the snow?
It is rushing by so fast. What month ends the year?
December ends the year. Are you ready to say goodbye?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How does this clock work?
It uses a spring to spin the hands. Do you have time to wait?
No time. Just tell me the secret.
The gears turn one by one. Is it a battery or wind-up?
Wind-up. It is getting slow.
You must wind it tight. Do you have the key?
I found it. Thank you.
Good luck with your trip.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel so worried about today.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you know what is bothering you?
I am not sure. Why does my heart beat so fast?
Your body gets ready for a change. Have you eaten something sweet recently?
Yes, I had a big candy bar.
Sugar can make you feel jittery. Do you feel better now?
A little bit, but I still think about the test.
Deep breaths help calm the mind. What is your plan for the test?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sick and my head hurts.
I am sorry you feel bad. Do you have a fever?
Yes, it is very high.
That sounds hard on your body. Did you drink much water?
Not really, just soup.
Drink more water to help. I do not know if soup cures it, but rest helps.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my little brother today. He was trying to eat his peas with a spoon, but he kept dropping them on the floor.
That is a funny scene. Did he get very messy?
Yes, he had peas on his shirt and in his hair. He looked like a green clown.
What a silly look. Did you laugh at him?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke your cup. I am very sorry.
Thank you for saying that. Did you mean to do it?
No, it slipped out of my hands.
I do not know what happened, but I forgive you. Do you know how to clean the floor?
Yes, I will use a wet cloth.
That is very kind of you. Thank you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a movie at home. How do I start?
You just need a camera and a friend. Do you have a camera ready?
Yes, I have an old phone. What do I do next?
Find a spot with good light and set up. Do you know where in your house has the best light?
My kitchen window is bright. How do I take the picture?
Tap the screen to focus and press the white circle. Have you ever tried that before?
No, I have not. What happens after I press it?
It records until you press it again. Stop when you are done.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to clean my window, but I do not know how.
You use a spray and a cloth. Do you have a towel ready?
Yes, I have a towel. What do I put in the spray?
Just mix water and a little bit of soap. Do you like sweet smells?
I like lemons. Can I use lemon juice?
Yes, lemon smells very nice. Do you have a lemon?
I do not have a lemon today.
You can use plain water and soap instead. Do you want to try it?
Yes, I will try it now.
That is good. Have fun with your clean window.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need to know how to buy a ticket for my trip.
I can help with that. Do you know where you are going?
Yes, I am going to the big city.
You can buy a ticket at the station counter.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I watched a big boat sit on the water today and I was so happy.
That is a lovely way to start your day. Do you like the ocean?
I do, but I think it is odd that such a heavy thing stays up.
The boat pushes a lot of water down and the water pushes it back up.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn how to swim. Do you know how?
Yes, I do know. Do you like the water?
Yes, but I am scared of getting water in my mouth.
That is okay. Take small sips and spit it out.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My goldfish bit the plastic plant today.
That is funny. Do you think it wanted to eat it?
I think he was just bored.
Bored fish need new toys. Did you clean the tank today?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a blue coin in the grass.
That is a lovely find. Did you pick it up?
Yes, but I do not know whose it is.
You could look for the owner. Do you see anyone nearby?
I saw a man near the bench.
That is a good idea to check. Did you ask him?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the big mountain looks so far away.
Mountains can feel very big and hard to climb. Do you like to walk in nature?
I tried to walk up a small hill and I got very tired.
Your body works hard when you climb. Did you rest and drink some water?
Maybe I should not try to go up the big mountain.
It is okay to take a break and think. Do you want to look at a map first?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because the sun is bright today.
That is a lovely feeling. Do you like the warm light?
Yes, it feels like a big hug on my skin.
It does. I am glad to hear that brings you joy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I dropped my keys and I have a big meeting right now.
Take a deep breath. Did you see where they fell?
No, but I am going to be late.
Let’s look at the door first. Do you want to check the floor?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My garden fence looks very tired.
That sounds sad. How old is it?
I do not know, but it is quite old.
It may need new wood. Do you like painting?
I never paint, but I can try.
That is brave. Start with a coat of primer.
What is a primer?
It is a base coat. It helps the paint stick.
Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Good luck with the fix.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I can not sleep well at night.
That feels bad. Do you drink tea before bed?
Yes, I do drink tea.
Tea has things in it that wake you up. Try water or milk instead.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the wind make my hair move?
The wind pushes your hair around. Do you like feeling it?
Is the wind hot or cold?
It can be both, depending on the air. Is it blowing hard today?
Can I see the wind with my eyes?
No, the wind is air moving, so you cannot see it. Do you see leaves dancing?
Where does the wind come from?
It comes from air moving around the Earth. Does it smell like rain?
Thank you for explaining that to me.
You are welcome. Do you enjoy walking in the breeze?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a magnet stick to the wall?
You need a surface that is metal. Do you have a fridge?
Yes, my fridge is metal.
Place the magnet on the flat door and it will stay.
What if I want to move it later?
You can just peel it off and put it back. Is the wall smooth?
Yes, but it is painted.
Paint is not metal, so it will not stick. Try the fridge instead.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is the internet?
It is a big web of computers all over the world. Do you like playing games on it?
Yes, I love my toys. What are the squares with lines?
Those are web pages that show us pictures and words. Do you like reading books?
I like books with pictures. Is the internet like a magic box?
In a way, yes, it gives you much information fast. Do you want to learn more?
How does it work?
It sends tiny bits of data between computers very quickly. I do not know how it feels, but it is cool.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not get how to mix the numbers in my math problem.
That can be hard sometimes. Do you like adding or taking away more?
I like adding, but I am stuck on this one part.
Let us look at the first two numbers together. What is three plus four?
It is seven. Why is it wrong?
Your first step is actually right. Did you read the whole question?
Oh, it says to multiply, not add.
That makes sense. Now multiply your seven by two.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I hit the ball harder?
You can try swinging your arm faster. Do you practice often?
I swing hard, but I miss the ball.
Look at the ball the whole time.
Where should my feet be?
Put one foot in front of the other. Do you play singles?
I usually play with friends.
That is good for fun.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I fixed my computer today. It works again!
That is great news. Did you fix it by yourself?
Yes, I just restarted it. I am so happy now.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am sorry I broke your cup.
That is a good thing to say. Did you feel sad when it fell?
Yes, my hands shook.
I forgive you. Thank you for being honest.
Thank you for being nice.
You have a good heart. What should we do now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do magnets stick to some things?
They stick to metal, not wood. Do you have a fridge?
Yes, I do. Why does it only pull iron?
Tiny parts in iron like magnets. Do you like science?
Yes, I do. How do they work?
I do not know how they work.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very happy today. I must run now.
That is a great feeling. What made you smile?
The sun is bright. I have no time to talk.
Good luck with your run. Enjoy the sunshine.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to leave now. Do robots ever get tired?
Most do not, but some need to charge their batteries. Do you like to watch them work?
Please, I am late. Can a robot drive my car?
Some can drive very well, but I do not know your car. Is it safe outside?
I am leaving now. Do robots feel happy?
They do not feel, but they can act happy. Have a safe trip?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the post office?
It is two blocks north. Are you going there for mail?
Yes. Is it close to the bank?
It is just across the street. Do you need the bank too?
No, only the post office.
You can see the red roof. Is your bag heavy?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need to eat fruits and vegetables?
They have tiny helpers called vitamins that keep your body strong. Do you like carrots?
Yes, I like them. But why do we need protein?
Protein helps build your muscles so you can run and jump. What is your favorite meat?
I like chicken. Why does my tummy feel full after eating?
Your body tells your brain you are done because the food is in there. Do you eat slowly?
Yes, I try to chew well. Why is sugar not always good?
Too much sugar gives you a quick zoom but then makes you feel tired. Do you like candy?
I do, but I will eat less. Why do I need water?
Water washes things clean inside you and keeps you cool.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent all morning scrubbing the kitchen floor.
That is hard work. Did you use the blue cleaner?
Yes, I did. Now I need to wipe the tables.
You are doing a great job. How many tables are left?
Just two big ones. My back hurts a little.
Please rest for a bit. Do you want some water?
I will drink some water soon. I must finish the last table.
You are very helpful. I do not know what to say.
I am glad you helped me clean today.
I am happy to help you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy and feel bad.
It is kind of you to care. Do you know their name?
Yes, but I am shy. How do I say it?
Look at them and say sorry with a smile. Do they like hugs?
I think so, but what if they are mad?
Just listen if they talk. Do you want to practice?
Yes, please show me how.
Say "I am sorry I broke your toy."

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I see bubbles in my bread dough. Why does that happen?
Tiny bugs called yeast eat sugar and make gas. It makes the dough puff up. Do you like baking?
Is the gas always the same thing?
No, sometimes bubbles come from air you stir in. Yeast gas is the main kind for rising. Is your dough warm?
Does the heat make it rise faster?
Yes, warm weather helps the yeast work harder. Too hot can kill the yeast. Do you check the temperature?
So the bread gets soft because of that gas?
Yes, the gas traps air and makes it fluffy. The heat cooks it to keep that shape. Do you wait for it to double?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we put the food in a bag?
To keep it cool and safe. Do you want the sandwiches?
Why is the grass so green?
The sun and rain help it grow. Do you like the shade?
Why are ants near the food?
I am not sure, but they like sweet things.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is raining so hard. I do not know what to do.
You can stay inside and draw a picture. Do you like to draw?
I might, but I feel stuck.
Try to listen to the rain on the roof. Is it loud for you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my book. I am very sad.
That is hard. Do you remember where you last read it?
I think it was by the door. But it is gone.
Let us look there. What color is the cover?
It is blue. I need to get it back.
I will check the shelf. Please wait here for me.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I had a scary dream about a big dog.
That sounds very frightening. Do you like dogs in real life?
No, I am afraid of all dogs.
It is normal to feel scared. Did you wake up right away?
Yes, I jumped out of bed.
Waking up helps you feel safe. Try taking three slow breaths now.
Okay, that feels better.
Good, your body is calming down. Do you want to talk about the dream more?
No, I want to forget it.
That is a good plan. You can choose what to remember.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked along the wet sand today. The waves pushed my shoes off.
That sounds like fun. Did you find any shells?
Yes, I found one big shell. It was white and smooth.
A white shell is a nice find. Did you keep it?
I kept it in my pocket. I want to show it to my mom.
She will be happy to see it. Good job on your walk.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make pasta for dinner.
That is a great choice. Do you like tomato sauce?
Yes, I do. I also want to put cheese on it.
Cheese makes it very tasty. Do you want to help me stir the pot?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to draw a cat, but its face looks wrong.
Try making the ears big and pointy. What color are you using?
I am using gray, but it looks like a mouse.
That is a good start. You can add a small nose next.
Should I draw the eyes first or the nose first?
I do not have a single right answer, but eyes come first for many people.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you have a rough day?
My dog got lost.
That is very scary. Do you know where he likes to go?
I do not know what to do next.
You can call your friends for help. Do they have time now?
I am not sure if I should eat.
A small snack can help your body. Do you like fruit?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the quiet feel so heavy?
It often feels that way when we miss people. Do you miss someone specific?
I am glad you ask. Why do we need other people?
We share things, and sharing makes joy last longer.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My chicken did not lay an egg today and I feel sad.
That is a low time. Is the bird eating well?
Yes, but the barn is very quiet and it feels wrong.
Quiet places can feel big. Have you checked her nest?
I looked but found only dust and old straw.
Dust makes everything look gray. Do you want to talk about her?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I live in a small town with a red bus.
Is the bus very loud?
No, it is quiet and smells like old paper.
That sounds cozy. What color is your house?
It is blue, but the roof is brown.
I like brown roofs. Do you have a dog?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a fun day playing cards. I won my last game with just a two.
That is a lucky card. Did you feel proud?
Yes, I did. My friend was a little sad though.
That is kind of you to notice. Did you share some snacks with him?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today and saw a big red apple on the ground.
That is a lucky find. Did you pick it up?
I did, but I also stepped on a patch of wet mud right after.
Oh no, your shoes are surely happy now. Do you like getting dirty?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The water is so big and I feel lost. What should I do?
Look at the waves go up and down. Do you hear a sound in your head?
I think I should go away from the edge. It looks too deep for me.
That is a safe idea. Is your heart still beating fast?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The lights went out all of a sudden.
Oh no, that is scary. Did you grab a candle?
I found my phone and looked for food in the dark.
Your phone light must have helped. Did you find anything tasty?
I ate a cold sandwich and listened to the rain.
That sounds like a cozy quiet time. I do not know what you ate.
I finally saw the power return just now.
How wonderful to see the light again.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I planted some tomato seeds today. The sun was hot.
That sounds like a good day. Did you water them well?
Yes, I gave them a drink. Then a bird came and looked at my feet.
That bird must be very busy. Is it going to eat the seeds?
No, it just looked at me. Then I went to get some water.
Smart move. You should check the soil often. Do you like the red fruit?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw the bear in the movie. He looks so big.
Bears are very strong, yes. Do you like big animals?
Yes, I do. I also saw a small mouse.
That is a nice story with friends. Was the mouse scared at first?
A little bit. But the bear helped him.
That is a very kind thing to do. It makes for a good film.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My phone is very hot.
Is it hot because you were playing? Put it down for a minute.
It was not playing. It is warm by itself.
That is strange. Please tell a grown up right now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do trains make a loud sound?
The wheels hit the metal tracks. Do you like loud noises?
Yes, I do. Why is the station so big?
It holds many trains and people. Do you have a big house?
No, it is small. Why do we stop here?
We need to change cars. Are you tired?
A little bit. Why is the food so sweet?
I do not know why that one is sweet. Is your toast sweet too?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sun so bright?
It is like a giant ball of fire that gives us light and warmth. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I do. But why does it go away at night?
The Earth spins around, so the sun hides behind our planet for a while. Are you afraid of the dark?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see bright red light outside. Is that a fire?
Yes, it looks like a fire. Is your house safe?
How do I stay safe inside?
Stay low and check doors for heat. Do you feel any smoke?
What if I cannot find a door?
I do not know your layout. Is there a window?
I will try to go out that way.
Good luck. Tell me when you are safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we write letters?
We write to share news with friends far away. Do you have a friend far away?
What should I say first?
Start with "Dear Friend" and a hello. What is the friend’s name?
How do I stop the letter?
End with "Love" or "Your friend." That is a nice goodbye.
Should I seal the envelope?
Yes, paste the flap shut tight. I do not know which stamp you need.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we write letters?
We write to tell friends things we miss. Do you want to tell someone you love?
Yes, but how do I start?
Start with a warm hello. Is it for a family member?
What should I say next?
I do not know your story. What is your main feeling?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I hold the watch, but I am not sure how to start it.
Pull the top ring up. Do you see the small line?
I pulled it up, but the hands do not move at all.
Push the ring down slowly. Is the sound starting?
Now I hear a tick, but the time is wrong.
Spin the hand to the real hour. It will keep time now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw two sailors on the pier today. One was mending a rope with his teeth.
That sounds tricky. Did he pull it tight?
Yes, he pulled it very hard. The other sailor gave him a thumbs up.
He seems like a good worker.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I stop the ball from going wide when I shoot?
Try pointing your toe slightly in. Are you right-footed?
Yes, I am. I always miss the corner.
Aim for the center first. Do you practice often?
I play every weekend. I still feel nervous.
That is very normal. Just keep having fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The city is very loud today. Do you like it?
I like the busy sounds. Do you hear birds too?
I do not hear any birds.
I do not know where the birds went. Maybe they are resting.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go camping with my dad. What should I bring?
Bring a tent, a bag to sleep in, and food. Are you going to a park or a forest?
We are going to a quiet forest by a lake.
That sounds very nice. Do you know how to make a small fire?
I know a little, but I am not sure about the rules.
Check with your dad for the safe rules. It is best to ask if you are not sure.
Okay, I will ask him. Thanks for helping me.
You are welcome. Have a happy trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke the cup.
Oh no. Are you hurt?
No, but I feel sad.
Is that glass on the floor?
Yes, it is all over.
Let us clean it up. Do you have a broom?
I do not know what to do next.
I will help you sweep. You can hold the dustpan.
Thank you for helping me.
You did the right thing. Shall we get new cups?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My bike chain fell off and I am very late.
Are you scared to fix it?
No, but I do not know how to put it back.
I can help you push the chain onto the gear.
Thank you, I feel much better now.
Did you know why it fell off?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I told you we would play. I feel sad because you forgot.
I am sorry. I did not remember. Did you miss me?
Yes, I waited a long time. You broke your word.
That was my fault. I will not do it again.
How do I know you will keep it? I am still mad.
I promise with my heart. I am true. What can I do to help?
Just promise me again, please. I need to feel safe.
I promise we will play. I am here for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad because my guitar string broke.
That is a shame. Do you want to try a new song?
I do not know how to fix it.
I am not sure either. Have you asked a friend for help?
My friend is busy today.
That feels lonely. Do you want to listen to music instead?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My boss is very sweet to us. I want to learn how to bake a cake.
That is a lovely thought. What is your favorite color of icing?
