I like pink icing. How do I mix the flour?
You add the flour to the wet mix slowly. Do you have a big spoon?
Yes, I have a big wooden spoon. Do you know if I should use salt?
Yes, a little salt makes the sweet taste better. I am glad you asked.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was very hot and my ice cream melted on my shirt.
Oh no, that is a sticky mess. Did you get to eat it before it fell?
I tried, but it dripped on my shoes.
That sounds like a tricky lunch. Do you have a towel nearby?
Yes, I dried my shoes and sat in the shade.
Good choice, the shade feels much better.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, the lights are out and I am very late.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you check the main switch?
Yes, it is on, but the whole street is dark.
That sounds like a big problem. Do you have a phone?
My battery is low and I must go now.
Please go safely in the dark.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because our team won the game today.
That is great news! Who scored the last goal?
My favorite player did it right at the end.
I did not watch the game, but I am happy for you. Did you go to the stadium?
Yes, I did, and the crowd was very loud.
That sounds like a lot of fun.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a cloud in my hands?
You cannot make a real cloud with your hands. Do you like looking up at the sky?
Yes, I like it.
I do not know how to make a cloud indoors. Do you want to learn about real clouds?
Yes, please tell me.
Real clouds are made of tiny water drops high up. Is it cloudy where you are today?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do about my teacher.
That sounds hard. What did they say?
They are being very mean to me.
That is not right. How does that make you feel?
I feel very sad and small.
I am sorry. I do not know the best fix, but you can tell a grown-up.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel very cold.
Rest is key to feeling better. Are you taking your medicine?
I must run to work.
Do not push your body too hard. Do you have a fever?
Yes, it is high.
That is why you feel so weak. Please stay home if you can.
No, I have no choice.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a warm coat on?
I am wearing one now.
Drink warm water to stay safe. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My boss gave me a free day off because I was sick. How nice is that?
That is very kind of them. Do you feel better now?
Yes, I am feeling much stronger today. What makes a boss seem kind to you?
I think a kind boss listens to you. Do they listen to you?
Yes, they always hear me out. Is it true that nice bosses make work better?
I believe it makes people happier. Are you happy at work?
Yes, I really like my job now. Thank you for talking with me.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to see a bear in the forest. How do I do that?
You must stay very still and look up the trees. Do you like climbing?
No, I do not like heights. What else can I do?
You can walk slowly to the river at dawn. Bears like water. Do you wake up early?
Yes, I wake up before the sun. Is that safe?
It is safe if you are quiet. Do you have a warm coat?
Yes, I have a big red coat. I am ready.
Great. Go with care and look for paw prints.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The water looks so blue and deep. I feel lost and do not know where to start.
That is a big feeling. Do you like to walk on the sand?
I like the sand, but the waves are big. Should I get close to the edge?
I do not know what is safe for you, but please ask a grown-up. Do you see any small shells?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
Roots suck it up from the soil. Do you have a plant at home?
They have roots, I know that.
The water moves up tiny tubes. Do you like watching plants grow?
Yes, I love seeing them get tall.
The tubes push water to every leaf. Is your plant green and healthy?
It looks fine, but I am not sure.
A thirsty plant may droop a bit. Does it look happy to you?
I will check again tomorrow.
A good plan for a helper. Do you want to water it now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park. I saw a big dog.
A big dog is fun. What color was it?
It was brown. It ran fast.
Fast dogs are exciting. Did it bark?
Yes, it bared loud. I felt happy.
Happy is a good feeling.
I want to learn more words for my day.
That is a smart goal. Start with small words.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to count my toys but I am running late.
Deep breaths help you count well. Do you want to start from one?
Just tell me the numbers fast so I can pack my bag.
One, two, three, four, and five. Is that enough for now?
No, I need to finish before the car leaves.
I do not know how many toys you have. But you can do it, are you ready?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My cat is sleeping on my bed.
That is very sweet of him. Does he purr when he sleeps?
Yes, he goes vroom vroom.
I love that sound. Do you like to touch him while he sleeps?
I try to be quiet.
You are being very gentle. What is your cat's favorite game?
He likes to chase the red light.
That light is very tricky to catch. Do you play with him every day?
Yes, we play after school.
That sounds like a great time together.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My horse looks sad and will not eat.
I am sorry to hear that. Is he drinking water?
Yes, he drinks water all the time.
That is a good sign. Please call a vet to be sure.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. My sister is coming here now.
That sounds fun. Is she coming by bus?
No, she is walking. I must go now.
Okay, go quickly. Will she bring snacks?
I do not know. I have to leave.
Goodbye then. I hope you have a great day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a bug in my room. What should I do with it?
That is okay. Is it big or small?
It is small and crawling on the wall.
If you do not like it, put it outside gently.
I am afraid to touch it.
You can use a cup to catch it safely. Do you have a cup nearby?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to tell you that the leaves are falling!
That is a lovely thought. Do you like the sound they make?
I do! Why do they fall off the trees?
The tree lets them go to save energy for the winter. Do you think the trees sleep?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start my book report.
That feels hard. What is the name of the book?
It is called The Lion and the Mouse.
That is a nice story. Do you remember who you like best?
I like the mouse because he is brave.
That is a good thought.
But I still feel stuck on the first page.
I do not have all the answers. Try writing just one small thing you noticed.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad. The lighthouse light is out.
That is very strange. Do you see any smoke coming from the tower?
No, it is dark and quiet. I cannot fix it.
You are safe. Does your hand feel warm?
Yes, but I miss the glow. I want to go home.
You can call for help. Are you cold?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know how to add fractions.
That is tricky. Do you like pizza?
I do not get it. It is hard.
Let us try with slices. Is your dog friendly?
I think I can do it now.
Good job. Are you happy?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know the sky before I run out.
The sky is clear and warm today. Are you happy about the sun?
I must go now, please be quick.
It is safe to walk outside. Do you like warm days?
I hear you, but I have no time.
The wind is soft and calm. Be safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I take good photos?
Use a bright day to get good light. Do you have a phone or a camera?
I have an old phone.
That is fine for many pictures. Just hold it steady.
What if the photo looks blurry?
Try to rest your hand on something. What kind of thing are you shooting?
I want to shoot my dog.
Click the picture before he moves. Have you tried that?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a box but I do not know what to do.
Did you ask who gave it to you?
No one was home when I found it.
I do not know what is inside.
I am scared to open it.
It is safe to look. What color is the box?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does my fridge door stick to the magnet?
The metal in the door is magnetic. Do you know what else sticks?
I think a paperclip does too!
Yes, paperclips stick too. It pulls them in tight.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees? I feel sad.
The tree drops them to rest. Do you like cold days?
No, I do not. It is not their fault.
It helps the tree grow strong next year. Is your heart light now?
Yes, I think I am okay.
That is good. You are being kind.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the train?
It is in station two. Are you going to work?
Yes. How do I get there?
Take the walk way. Is that the right one?
I hope so. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for school. Do you have a toast?
Yes, I have toast. Do you want it warm or cold?
Warm, please. Can you make it fast?
I will make it now. What do you like on it?
Just butter. Can you hurry?
I am moving fast. I do not know what time it is, but I will be done soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I want to eat a big pizza.
That sounds like a great idea. Do you like cheese on it?
Yes, I love extra cheese. I also want to share it with my friends.
That is very kind of you. How many friends are coming?
Three friends will come to my house. I think we can all fit around the table.
A table for four is perfect for a nice meal. What is your favorite topping?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the barn today. The cows were eating grass.
That sounds like a nice day. Did you get to touch the cows?
Yes, I petted the big brown one. It has a very soft tail.
What a gentle cow.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, I am late for my train.
Do not worry. You can take the blue bus to get there fast. Where are you going?
I have to catch my ride home.
The blue bus stops right here. Is it your first time in this city?
Yes, it is new to me.
I do not know if the bus is running on time. But the city feels very busy today.
The crowd is so thick.
Just keep walking forward. You will be fine. Do you like big cities?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Help me find my keys.
I do not see them. Did you check your bag?
No. I am very stressed.
Check your coat pocket. Is it there?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The lights are off. What do I do?
Do not panic. Grab a flashlight to see where you are.
I am scared. Is the house safe?
Yes, the house is safe. Did you check the breaker box?
I found a tripped switch. Why did this happen?
I do not know the exact cause. Was there a storm outside?
Yes, it was very windy. What now?
Flip the switch back on. Tell me if the lights come back.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a kite fly?
You need a light wind and a string. Do you have a kite ready?
Yes, I have it in my bag.
Go outside and hold the string tight. Run fast to let the wind lift it.
I will run and hope it stays up.
I hope it does too. Tell me if it flies high.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn French, but it sounds hard.
It is a fun trip! Do you like animals?
Yes, I love cats.
A cat is "un chat."
I want to say "my cat."
You can say "mon chat." Nice job!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new magnet today and I am so happy!
That is wonderful! What can your magnet hold?
It sticks to my fridge door and makes a loud clink.
I love that sound! Does it have a special color?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I felt so tired today. I walked home from school with my backpack on.
That sounds like a long day. Did you play outside?
Yes, I played with my friends. I ran until my legs hurt.
Running is good for your body. Do you have a cozy bed?
Yes, I have warm blankets. I will try to sleep soon.
Warm blankets help you rest well. Good night.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The red shirt has a stain on it.
That is a tough stain. What did you eat?
I fell in the mud at the park.
Mud is wet dirt. Does the label say to wash it hot or cold?
I think it says cold.
Good eyes. Put the shirt in the drum first.
Should I add soap?
Yes, use one spoon of soap. Do you know where the soap drawer is?
Yes, the little door on the right.
That is right. Now push the start button.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make toast?
Put bread in the toaster and press the button. Do you like your toast hot or cold?
I like it hot. What else can I put on it?
You can use butter or jam. Do you have any fruit at home?
Yes, I have bananas.
Slices of banana are great on toast. You can also try peanut butter if you have it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. I am not sure what to do.
Have you tried drinking some water? It might help you feel better.
No, I have not. I feel very tired too.
Resting is a good idea. Do you want to take a short nap?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: It is so quiet here.
Yes, the wind is still. Do you hear a bird?
I do not see any birds.
They may be sleeping in the trees. Do you like the calm air?
It smells like rain.
The sky looks dark, so yes, it will likely rain.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a boat in the big river.
That is a fun idea. Do you have any wood?
I have some old planks from a fence.
That sounds good. Are they dry?
Yes, they are dry. How do I put them together?
You need strong ties. Do you have rope?
I have a thick rope. Is it safe for the water?
I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke my mom's cup. I am so sorry.
It is okay to feel bad. What did the cup look like?
It was blue and white. I do not know if I can fix it.
Some things cannot be fixed. Do you want to help clean the floor?
Yes, I will help. I promise to be more careful next time.
That is a good promise. Thank you for telling the truth.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so mad. The car started moving when I only wanted to stay still.
That can feel scary. Do you know how to stop the car with your feet?
Yes, but my foot gets shaky. I am not sure I can do this.
Being shaky is okay. We will practice until it feels right. Are you ready to try again?
Okay. One more time, please.
Let us go slowly.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to fold a paper boat. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help. Do you have a square piece of paper?
Yes, I have one here. What do I do first?
Fold the paper in half, then fold it in half again. Have you tried folding before?
No, this is my first time. What is the next step?
I am not sure about the exact shape for you. Would you like to check a book?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel stuck and do not know what to do next.
That is a hard feeling. What is the first small thing you see?
I just see a big mess and feel scared.
Let us take a deep breath. Do you want to try just one tiny step?
I am not sure if one step is enough.
One step is always a start. Where does your eye go first?
It goes to the quiet corner of the room.
That corner looks safe and still. Would you like to sit there for a minute?
Yes, sitting there feels good and calm.
Good. Just rest here for now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do cows have bones?
Yes, they have bones inside. Do you like to see cows?
What do pigs eat?
Pigs like to eat corn and roots. Is your favorite animal a pig?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am sad and do not know why. Can you help me?
I am sorry you feel this way. Is it one big thing or many small things?
It is many small things. I feel stuck.
Try to write down one thing you can fix today. Do you have a pen nearby?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my orange juice on the rug. It made a big brown spot.
Oh no, that is so messy. Do you have a towel?
I used a towel, but the mark is still there. My mom said I cleaned it well.
That is very good of you to try. Did she help you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I missed the bus.
That feels bad. Are you very tired?
Yes. My feet hurt from running.
Please sit down. Do you have water?
I do not have my bag.
Let us find it together. Where did you last see it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a boat to the dock?
Look for a metal ring on the wood. Do you see it?
Yes, I see a shiny ring. What next?
Wrap the rope around it twice. Is it tight?
It feels tight now. Can the boat stay?
I believe it will hold safe. Does the rope look good?
It looks strong. Thank you for your help.
I am glad to help you. Have fun on the water.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel stuck with my Spanish practice.
Sticking to it is hard. Do you use songs to learn?
Yes, but I forget the words fast.
That is normal for new skills. What do you remember best?
I remember the food words.
Food helps you talk to people. Nice start.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My boss was so nice to me today. I do not know what I should do.
That sounds lovely. How did they help you?
They stayed late to finish my work for me. I feel very confused.
It is best to say thank you. Do you know how to tell them?
I am not sure. I just want to be kind back.
A small note is a good start.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a red bird on the fence.
That looks like a cardinal. Do you like its red color?
Yes, it is bright and pretty.
Birds love to eat seeds. Do you have a feeder?
My dad bought a big one for me.
That is wonderful. Does he put new food in it?
He fills it up every morning.
The birds will be very happy. Do you hear them sing?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My head hurts. Why is that?
It might be a headache. Did you sleep well?
I did not sleep well. Is that why?
Yes, your body needs rest to feel good. Are you hungry?
I am not hungry. Why is my head still hurting?
I do not know for sure. Please see a doctor if it stays bad.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to float on my back.
That is a great way to rest. Do you know how to kick your legs?
Yes, but my legs sink when I try.
Keep your face in the water and breathe out slowly. Have you tried floating with your arms at your sides?
No, I usually cross my arms.
Try moving your arms to your sides to help you stay up. Would you like to practice in the shallow end?
Yes, that sounds good.
Great choice. Remember to stay calm and take your time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My tennis ball hit the fence and I feel like I lost.
Oh no, that is very frustrating. Did you try to hit the ball again?
No, I just want to go home. It is a bad day for sports.
That is a fair feeling. Do you want to try just one more point?
Maybe, but only if you cheer for me. I need some support.
I will cheer very loud for you. Let’s go play that final game now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big black beetle on my shoe today. It walked very fast.
That is a cool bug. Did you take it outside?
Yes, I put it in the grass. It hid under a leaf.
Nature is full of small secrets.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I ate a big bowl of soup today and it felt great.
That sounds warm and nice. Did you add any veggies to it?
Yes, I put in carrots and peas.
Carrots are sweet and good for your eyes. I do not know how to make the best soup.
I just boiled them in water with salt.
That is a simple start. Did it taste salty enough for you?
Yes, the salt made the broth pop.
Salt helps food taste fuller. What do you usually have for breakfast?
I have oatmeal with berries in the morning.
Berries give you a nice boost. That is a happy way to start the day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad. My screen is dark and cold.
That feels bad. Do you see a red light on the front?
No, there is no light at all. I tried to push the big button, but it did not wake up.
I do not know why it is asleep. Do you know if the main plug is in the wall?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I catch a crab on the beach?
Look for burrows in the wet sand near the tide line. Do you like digging?
Yes, I love digging. What do I do if I find one?
Gently pick it up by its back shell and let it go back into the water. Is the water warm there?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see a tiger, but I do not know where to look.
Tigers live in jungles in places like India. Do you like the rain?
Yes, I do. But how can I get close to them safely?
You should go to a big zoo, not the wild forest. Do you like walking around?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very nervous about my meeting tomorrow. Do you have any tips?
It is normal to feel that way. Did you practice what you want to say out loud?
No, I have not. Should I prepare notes or memorize everything?
Taking short notes is often safer than memorizing. Do you know who you will be speaking with?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My neighbor makes loud noise at night. I want to talk to him, but I am scared.
That is a nice thing to do. Are you afraid he will get mad?
Yes, he looks angry. I do not know what to say.
Tell him you need sleep. I am here if you want help.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to hum while I play. Do you think that is okay?
Yes, humming is great for keeping time. Do you play a special song?
It is just a happy tune. Is it good to make up new songs?
Making up songs is very fun and true to you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss my seat. The train is so loud and I am tired.
That sounds hard. Do you have a blanket?
No, I do not have a blanket. My feet are cold.
I am sorry. Is it very cold in there?
Yes, it is freezing. I do not like this trip.
I get that. Do you have a warm drink?
I have some tea. It helps a little.
Good for you. Let us enjoy it together.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My friend feels very sad today. I want to help him feel better.
That is kind of you to ask. Do you know why he is sad?
I think he lost a toy he loves. I feel unsure what to say.
You can just sit with him and listen. Is he willing to talk about it?
I hope so. How do I make sure I do not say the wrong thing?
Just be there and be true. If you do not know the answer, say so.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a small plant and I give it water, but I do not know how it drinks.
Roots pull water up from the soil. Do you live near a window?
Yes, my plant sits on the sill. Is that why it grows tall?
Sun helps the leaves make food, but roots still pull the water.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I had a bad dream about falling into a dark hole.
That must have been scary. Do you like climbing trees?
Yes, but I was too scared to wake up.
Your mind was just tired from playing. Have you eaten a snack yet?
No, I have not.
Let us get some warm milk.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cut my paper wrong. It is not a square. It is a lopsided mess.
A square has four equal sides. Do you want to try again?
No. I am too tired to cut again.
I am sorry. Would a circle be easier?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to save my drawing on the computer. What do I do?
Do you see a menu at the top?
Yes, I see a list of words there.
Click on File, then pick Save.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late but I love my dog book.
Dogs are fun friends. Do they jump?
Yes they jump a lot. I must go now.
Go with care. Happy reading.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Are mountains very tall?
Yes, they touch the sky. Do you like the clouds?
I am running late. What is a mountain made of?
It is made of rock. Do you have any boots?
Just tell me the fastest way up. I do not have time for chats.
You must climb slowly. I do not know the quickest path.
Why is it hard to climb them?
The path is steep and wet. Do you have warm hands?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My clock stops every night, why does it do that?
Does it have batteries or does it have a battery?
It uses a small battery inside the case.
The battery might be running out of power.
I checked the level and it seems full, so what else could it be?
Is the clock sitting on a soft surface like a rug?
Yes, it is right on my bedside carpet.
A soft floor makes the gears slip and stop.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a little bird on the ground. It looks sad and tired.
That is very kind of you to see it. Do you have any water to give it?
I do not have water right now. How do I help it?
You can gently move it to a safe spot in the grass. Do you know where that is?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do I save money?
You can put coins in a jar. Do you have a jar?
Why do I need a jar?
It keeps your coins safe. What color is it?
Why is it good to save?
You can buy fun things later. I do not know what you like.
Do I have to do this?
No, but it is a good habit. Are you ready to try?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count the cards?
We count to make sure no one cheated. Do you have the ace?
I found it. Why did you win?
I played a better hand. Did you enjoy the game?
Yes. Why do I keep losing?
Practice helps you get better. What card do you hold?
I have a king. Why is it not enough?
Your opponent had a pair of queens. Do you want to play again?
Yes, please. Why?
We like to play with you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked in the park all day. The sun was warm. My legs feel heavy now.
That sounds like a very active day. Did you nap for a short time?
I tried to nap, but I could not close my eyes. The room was too bright.
Bright light can make sleep hard. Do you have a curtain to block it?
I used a pillow over my eyes. It helped a little. I feel tired but wide awake.
That is a common trick. Does your mind go quiet when you lie down?
My brain hums like a bee. I want to stop it. How do I get to sleep fast?
Try breathing slow and deep. Do you have a favorite book for bed?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a picture of a dog, but I have no time.
What kind of dog is it?
It does not matter. I am late for class.
Try a circle for the head and a long line for the body.
That is too slow. Can you just draw it for me?
I cannot draw, but I can help you start.
Fine. I will use that tip and run.
Good luck. Will you draw a cat next?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need help now, I am late.
Take my hand, we can run. Do you know the way?
Yes, but it is far away.
Let us go, we will make it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a den like a bear. Do you know how?
That is a fun idea. Do you have a big pile of leaves?
Yes, I have lots of leaves. What do I do with them?
Stack them high and sit inside. Make sure it is dry.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad because I cannot do this math problem. It is too hard.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you know which part is confusing?
I just do not know how to start, and I am late.
You can take a short break to feel better. Have you tried asking the teacher for help?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My throat hurts and I have a bad cough. What can I drink to help?
Yes, warm tea with honey works well for many people. Do you like sweet or plain tea?
I like plain. How do I make the tea hot without boiling the water?
You can use a kettle to boil the water and then let it sit for a minute. Do you have a safe place to put the hot cup?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing here, but I do not know where to go.
That is okay. Did you see a light up ahead?
Yes, there is a lamp by the door.
It might help you see. Do you like the night air?
It feels cold and very still.
Cold can be good for you. I am not sure what is in that house.
I think I should just turn around.
Turning around is a fine choice. Do you want company?
I feel better now. Thank you.
You are welcome. Go with care.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the stars look so small?
They are very far away, so they look tiny to us. Do you see any bright ones?
Yes, I do. Why do some move and some do not?
The bright stars that stay still are very far away. The moving ones are planets close to Earth.
Are they all as big as the Moon?
No, most stars are actually much bigger than the Moon. Have you seen the Moon tonight?
No, it is dark. Why are they gone?
The bright sunlight from the day makes them hard to see. Do you like the quiet night?
Yes, I do. Why is the sky so dark now?
I do not know the exact reason, but it is a mystery to me.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because I found a big tree.
That is wonderful. Do you know what kind of tree it is?
I think it is an oak, but I am not sure.
That sounds right. Oaks are very strong.
I want to share my joy with you.
Thank you for telling me. I am glad you feel this way.
I hope you feel happy too.
I do feel happy now. Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a ladybug on my leaf today! I am so happy to see it.
That is a lovely sign of a healthy garden. What color is your leaf?
The leaf is green and smooth. Do ladybugs have friends?
Yes, they often live in small groups. Do you want to see if there are any others nearby?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My floor is full of toys. How do I clean it fast?
Put the toys in a box first. Do you like playing with cars or dolls?
I like cars. But the couch has crumbs too.
Use a brush to sweep the crumbs off. Is the couch soft or hard?
It is very soft. The rug is dirty as well.
I do not know how to clean your rug. Do you have a washing machine?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My toy boat is sinking in the tub. What do I do?
It sinks because it is too heavy. Does it have any holes?
No holes, but it feels heavy. Why does the big ship stay up?
The big ship pushes a lot of water down. That push helps it stay up. Is your boat full of water?
Yes, it has a little water inside. How do I fix it?
Take the water out to make it light again. Do you have a dry towel ready?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so tired today. I do not know what to do.
Rest is good for you. Have you had enough sleep?
I did sleep, but my brain feels heavy and slow.
That can happen when you are busy. Do you want a quiet break?
I am not sure if I should rest or work.
I do not know your full plan. Take a small pause first.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The city is so loud and fast today. I do not know where to go.
Try the quiet park with the big trees. Do you like to sit in the grass?
I want to eat something sweet, but I feel too tired to walk far.
There is a small shop right near the park bench. I do not know if they have fruit, but I can check for you.
That sounds very good. Thank you for helping me feel calm.
You are welcome. I am happy you found a place to rest.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to finish this picture in one minute. Can you help me draw a tree?
I can help with the trunk and the leaves. Do you like green trees?
Yes, please! My bus is here.
Draw a thick stick for the trunk and fluffy shapes for the top. You can do it quickly.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a small box under my bed.
That sounds like a fun mystery. Did it have a key?
No key, but it opened right away.
Wow, that is neat. What was inside?
It has a note with only my name on it.
Hm, I do not know why. Did it have a date?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people learn other words?
It helps you talk to new friends. Do you like meeting people?
Is it hard to learn?
It can be tricky at first. Do you have time for it?
How do I start?
Just listen and repeat. I do not know if you are ready, but try.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn to drive right now. I am in a big hurry.
That sounds scary. Have you looked at the pedals before?
No, I have not. What do I do first?
Sit down and hold the wheel. Do you know how to buckle up?
I know how to buckle up. Why is this taking so long?
Safety is very important. Do you feel ready to try?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run, but I see the sky is bright.
The stars are out. Are you going home?
Yes, but what are those lights?
They are stars far away. Do they look cold?
I do not know, I am late.
They are very hot. See you soon?
I am leaving now, thanks.
Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to buy new shoes. How do I pick the right size?
Try them on in the late afternoon. Do you know your current size?
I think I am a nine, but I am not sure.
That is a good start. Stand on a piece of paper and mark your heel and toe.
Why do I need to mark the toe and heel?
It helps you measure your true length. Is the store busy right now?
It is a little quiet, which is nice.
Great, then you can take your time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to save money fast. I am in a rush.
Try to skip buying snacks today. Do you know where you spend the most?
I drink coffee every day. That is my main cost.
That is a great place to start. Would you like a tip on making your own coffee?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the clock tick?
It ticks to show time is moving. Do you like the sound?
I do. What makes it move?
A spring or battery pushes gears. Does your house have one?
Yes, on the wall. How does it know the time?
It counts the ticks in steady groups. Is it always right?
Not always. What if it stops?
Then it needs a new battery. Are you going to fix it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I failed my math test today. I feel sad.
That sounds hard. Did you try your best on it?
Yes, I did. The questions were too hard for me.
I am sorry you feel that way. What part of math is confusing?
I do not understand the numbers with dots.
Those are called decimals. Would you like to practice together?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I failed my test. I feel very sad.
I am sorry you feel this way. Did you study for it?
I tried my best. It was too hard for me.
Your hard work is a good thing. Do you want to see where you lost points?
No. I just want to be done with this.
It is okay to take a rest now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love the rain today. It makes me smile.
That is wonderful. Do you like the sound of it?
Yes, it sounds like a song. I want to jump in puddles.
That sounds like so much fun. Are your boots ready?
They are dry and waiting for you.
Great. Let us go enjoy the wet day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to watch a movie tonight. I feel sad.
That is okay. Do you want to laugh or cry?
I want to cry, but in a good way.
I do not know the exact title. Is it about animals?
No, it is about people who love each other.
That sounds sweet. You will feel better soon.
I just need to let the tears fall.
Let them fall. It is good for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How does the clock make time?
It moves the hands around to show the hours. Do you see the small hand?
Yes, that is the short one. How do I set it to the right time?
You turn it until it matches the real time. Do you know what time it is now?
I think it is noon. What about the small ticking sound?
That sound comes from the part that moves the hands. It keeps a steady beat for the clock.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy this morning.
That is great to hear. What did you eat?
I had warm toast with jam.
Does the jam taste sweet?
Yes, it is like candy.
That sounds very nice. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my cat rub against my legs?
It shows love and marks you as family. Does it like being hugged?
It only likes short hugs. Why does it spin in circles before sleep?
It makes a safe place for itself. Is it tired or just playful?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel very happy today.
That is great to hear. What made you smile?
I helped my sister tie her shoe.
That is a very kind thing to do.
I want to help more people.
That is a wonderful wish. How do you start?
I say please and thank you.
Those are good words to use. Do you always say them?
Yes, I try my best.
That is the true sign of good manners. Keep it up.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dog is not eating his food.
That sounds hard. Did he play a lot today?
No, he just sleeps all day.
Sleep can mean he is tired or sick. Do his eyes look bright?
They look a bit red.
Red eyes are not good. I do not know the cause for sure.
What should I do then?
Please call a vet today. Are you ready to make the call?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at that big bright star up there.
It is very bright. Do you wonder what it is made of?
I think it is on fire.
That is a good guess, but stars are actually hot gas. Can you see another star near it?
Yes, it is right there next to the first one.
They look close, but they are very far apart. I do not know how far exactly.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a boat, but I do not know where to take it.
I do not know your boat, but does it have a big sail?
It has a small sail. I am lost.
You can row it to the lake. Is the lake close to you?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw my old friend today.
That sounds wonderful. How did you feel?
I was very happy.
I am glad for you. Did you play?
We played ball for an hour.
What a fun time. Did you eat together?
Yes, we shared a big pie.
That sounds tasty. Do you see him often?
Not much, but I will call him soon.
Good idea. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am lost and late. Please help me find the exit.
I am sorry. Are you going to the front door?
Yes, I need to leave right now. Please tell me where to go.
I do not know for sure. Is there a map here?
No, I do not have a map. Just point me the right way.
Go left and then turn right. Do you see the blue sign?
I see it. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. I hope you make it in time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go, but what is a mountain?
A mountain is a very big hill. Do you like big rocks?
I do not have time for that.
Please be careful on the road.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I wish to learn how to say thank you in French.
That is a sweet goal. Do you plan to travel there soon?
Yes, I am going for a trip next month.
The word is merci. Do you want to know how to spell it?
Please tell me how to spell it.
It is spelled m-e-r-c-i. Do you like learning new words?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My new fence is not very strong.
What kind of wood did you use?
It is soft pine wood.
Pine is light. It needs thick posts to stand up.
How do I make it last long?
I am not sure of the best paint. But you should keep it away from wet soil.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to eat here.
The soup is warm and nice. Do you like hot food?
Yes, but I am still not sure.
Try the bread. It is sweet and good.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off trees?
Trees let go of leaves to save energy for the cold months. Do you like watching them spin down?
Yes, I do. How can I make a leaf?
You can crumple paper to look like a leaf. Do you have some paper?
Yes, I have a lot of it. Can you show me how?
I cannot show you, but you can ball it up and push it thin. Is it hard or soft?
It is soft. Thank you, I will try.
That sounds like a good plan. Have fun making your leaves.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The lights are off. How do I light a candle?
Rub the wick on a match. Do you have a matchbook nearby?
Yes, I see it on the table.
Strike it on the rough side. Does the flame look steady?
It is burning. Thank you.
You are safe now. Good luck with the dark.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not like the cold water.
The water can be cold. Do you like warm showers?
Yes, I love warm showers.
That is nice. The pool has a heater.
Is the heater safe?
Yes, it is very safe.
I will try to swim today.
You are brave. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My lighthouse is too dark to see. What can I do?
Put a bright lamp inside the glass. Do you have a big flashlight?
Yes, I have one. Where should I put it?
Put it in the very top tower. Does it fit in the space?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need a seat belt?
It keeps you safe if you crash. Do you like riding in a car?
Yes, I do. Why does the car move so fast?
The engine makes the wheels spin. What do you like to do when you ride?
I like to look out the window. Why do we have to wait at red lights?
It lets other cars go so they do not hit. I do not know why all lights are red.
That is okay. Why do we learn to stop?
To keep people and pets safe. Do you see anything cool outside?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to buy new shoes. How do I pick the right size?
Try them on while standing. Do you usually wear socks?
Yes, I do. My feet feel cold without them.
That is a good habit. Do you like the color of this pair?
The blue ones look great. How do I tie the laces tight?
Cross the left lace over the right one. Do you want help with the knot?
No, I can do it. I will buy the blue shoes now.
That sounds like a great choice. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very hungry, but I do not know what to eat.
That is a fun problem. Do you like hot food or cold food?
I think I want something sweet and soft.
A warm apple pie might be perfect for you. Do you like apples?
Yes, apples are my favorite fruit.
Great choice. Please order the warm apple pie now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big fire in the sky last night. It was so red and bright. I was very happy to see it.
That sounds like a lovely sight. Did it look warm from your window?
Yes, it looked very warm. I sat by the glass for a long time.
That is a nice way to spend an evening. I do not know the exact name of that kind of light, but it must be calm.
I think it is called a campfire. No, wait, I think it is something else.
Let us not worry about the name. Did you bring a blanket to stay cozy?
I did, and I held it tight. My cat slept right on my lap.
A sleeping cat is the best companion. Did the fire move or stay still?
It moved a little, like slow clouds. I am glad it is gone now.
I am glad you felt safe and happy. A peaceful view is a good gift.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad today. Can you help me feel better?
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like to draw pictures?
I do, but my hands are shaking. I cannot hold the pen.
That is okay. Try to take a deep breath and relax your hands.
I tried breathing, but I still feel worried about school.
It is good to talk about your worries. What makes you most worried?
I am afraid I will fail the test. I did not study enough.
You can ask your teacher for help. Do you think they would be nice?
Yes, my teacher is very kind. I think I will ask her for extra time.
That sounds like a very smart plan. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so hungry. I want a big pizza.
A pizza sounds good. Do you like cheese on it?
Yes, lots of cheese. And I want to give a slice to my friend.
That is very kind of you.
My friend is coming soon. We will eat together.
Fun!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a red book today. I am very happy.
That sounds great. Do you like pictures?
Yes, it has big pictures of dogs.
Dogs are fun. What is the book about?
It is about a puppy who goes on a trip.
A puppy on a trip is sweet. Is it your favorite kind of animal?
Yes, I love puppies. I want to show you.
I would like that. Can we read it together?
Yes, let us read it now. It is very good.
Sure. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count?
We count to know how many things there are. Do you like counting your toys?
Yes, but why is five bigger than three?
Five has two more parts than three. Do you like to touch the numbers to feel the size?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to find a fun story about a dog.
The dog books are on the low shelf. Do you like big dogs or small dogs?
I like small dogs that can run fast.
I do not know which small dog is the fastest.
Can you help me look at the red book?
Yes, the red book is a great choice. Do you have your library card?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a shed, but I am stuck.
That is a fun job. Do you have a plan yet?
I have a drawing, but I do not know where to start.
Start with the floor. Is your ground flat?
Yes, it is flat, but the wood is confusing.
Pick easy wood for the frame. What size do you want it to be?
I want it big enough for my bike tools.
A small square works well. Have you bought any nails?
No, I have only the wood.
Go buy the nails now. Do you have a friend to help?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at this math book. It is too hard for me.
It feels bad when words do not make sense. What part is confusing you?
I do not know how to count the apples in the picture.
That is a tricky thing to see. Do you want to try pointing at one apple?
I tried, but I keep mixing up the red ones and green ones.
Mixing colors is a common mix-up. It is okay to take a rest.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sky is bright today. I saw a big, colorful ribbon after the rain.
That sounds like a lovely sight. Did it have all the colors you know?
Yes, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and violet. It looked like a giant bridge.
Wow, nature makes such pretty things. Can you still see it from where you stand?
No, it faded away quickly. But I felt happy just looking at it.
Happy memories are special. How do you feel now that it is gone?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad when I go to school.
That is a heavy feeling to carry. What makes it feel so sad?
I am afraid of talking in class.
Many students feel this way. Do you know what you want to say?
No, my mind goes blank.
That happens when we are too scared. It is okay to be quiet sometimes.
So I am not broken, right?
You are not broken. Do you want to practice just one small word?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to buy new shoes.
That is a good idea. What color do you like?
I like blue.
Blue looks great on most people. Are they for running or walking?
I need them for work.
Work shoes need to be comfy. Do you have a strict dress code?
Yes, it must look smart.
Then look for leather shoes. Do you know your shoe size?
I think I am a size eight.
That is a common size. I will help you find them.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so angry because my favorite song got cut off.
That is a very bad thing. Do you like that song a lot?
Yes, I like it so much that I want to cry.
That makes me sad for you. Would you like to hear a happy song?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I tried again and it finally worked!
That is great news. What made you want to keep going?
I felt so tired, but I did not want to fail.
I am glad you did not give up. Do you feel proud now?
Yes, I am very happy right now.
Your hard work paid off.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I want to learn French. Why is that hard?
It is hard because the words are new to you. Do you like listening to music?
I do. Why does music help with words?
Music makes your ears ready for new sounds. I do not know if it helps with spelling.
That is good to know. Why do people learn other languages?
They want to talk to more friends. Do you have friends from other places?
Yes, one girl from Spain. Why do we need to talk to them?
Talking lets us share happy things. Does she speak English?
She does a little bit. Why is it better to speak their way?
It shows you care about them. Is that why you want to try?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What do sailors do?
They take boats to new places. Do they like the water?
Yes, I think so.
That is a good guess. Do they swim well?
I am not sure.
I do not know if all of them do. Do they take baths?
Yes, I think they do.
That makes sense. Do they miss home?
Maybe they do.
I think they do. Do you want to be one?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with this river.
Would you like to just sit and watch the water?
That sounds nice, but I feel stuck.
Do you see any rocks near the edge?
Yes, there are big stones by the bank.
You could play with them.
I am still not sure if I should go in.
I do not know your feelings, but a tiny toe might help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Is that a lion?
Yes, it is a big cat. Why are you in such a rush?
I missed my bus. Do bears sleep in winter?
Yes, they sleep for months. Is it cold where you are?
Yes, very cold. What do they eat when they wake up?
I do not know for sure. Can I help with anything else?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the toy in the top box?
Yes, it is right there. Do you like red toys?
Yes, I do like red ones.
That is great. Is the box too heavy?
Yes, it is very heavy.
I can help you carry it. Do you need my help?
Yes, please help me.
Okay, let us go. Ready?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to do for my birthday.
That sounds like a big choice. Do you like cake?
I like cake, but I want to do something fun.
Funny! Are you a quiet person?
No, I like to move and run.
Then a park trip is a great pick. Is that enough for you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for dinner. How do I make eggs fast?
Put oil in a pan and beat two eggs. Do you like them soft?
Yes, I want them soft. Can you check the time for me?
I cannot see a clock, but I can wait for you. What is your favorite snack?
I like cheese. Please help me do this before I burn it.
Stir the eggs and add the cheese. Is the pan hot enough?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got off my long plane ride. It was so fun.
That sounds great. I am happy for you. How did you pass the time?
I watched two movies and ate a lot of snacks. It was very tasty.
Nice. Was the view from the window good?
Yes, we flew over the clouds. It looked like snow.
That must look cool. Do you have a picture of it?
I do not have a phone with me right now. I forgot it.
Oh no. That is a common thing.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do I make bread fast?
Mix flour, water, and yeast in a bowl. Do you have any yeast?
Yes, I have it. Now what do I do?
Let the mix sit for ten minutes. Is it hot or cold in your kitchen?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people buy food here?
To get something warm to eat. Do you like hot soup?
Why is the man selling apples?
To earn coins for his home. Do you have any coins?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so worried about the test today. I have to go now.
That feels scary. Do you feel calm yet?
Not at all. I just need to run.
Running helps some people. Take one slow breath with me.
I do not have time to breathe.
I understand. I do not know what will happen, but you can do this.
Thanks. I am leaving now.
Good luck on your way. Did you eat breakfast?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my orange juice on the red rug this morning.
Oh no, that sounds messy. Did you use a towel to clean it up?
Yes, I wiped it dry with a blue cloth.
Good job, that was the right thing to do. Do you think the stain is still there?
I think it is gone, but I am not sure.
We can check again later to be sure.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I just moved to this new town. Can you help me find a good park?
Yes, there is a big green space near the river. Do you like walking?
I love to walk. Is the park close to my house?
It is only a ten minute walk away. Do you have a map?
No, I do not have a map. How do I get to the park?
Walk down the main street until you see the bridge. I do not know every path, but that way works.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do bears sleep all winter?
They need to save energy to stay warm. Do you like sleeping a lot?
Yes, I do. Why do bees make honey?
Bees make it to eat later. Do you have a favorite sweet?
I like carrots. Why do owls see so well?
Their eyes catch light very well. Do you have a pet?
I have a cat. Why do fish have gills?
Gills help them breathe in water. I do not know why cats purr.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I put water in the pot, but the plant looks thirsty. How does it actually drink the water?
The plant pulls water up through its roots and tiny tubes. Do you see the leaves getting wet?
I do not know what to do next. It still looks dry.
I am not sure why it is still dry today. Can you smell the soil to see if it is wet?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love that story about the turtle. How do I make my own paper boat?
You need a flat piece of paper. Do you have one?
Yes, I do. What do I do next?
Fold it in half, then fold the top corners down.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Who built the pyramids?
People in Egypt built them a long time ago. Do you like tall buildings?
Maybe. Is the Great Wall in China?
Yes, it is in China. It takes time to visit.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a loaf of bread now.
We have fresh rye and white. What do you prefer?
The rye please, and I am late.
It costs two dollars. Do you want it wrapped?
No, just a bag.
Here is your bread. Have a safe trip home.
Where is the cash counter?
It is right by the door. Was that helpful?
Yes, thank you very much.
You are welcome. I hope you make it on time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My new song is just wrong. I want to stop listening.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you like the first part?
I do, but the drums are too loud for me.
Loud drums can be tiring. Would you try turning it down?
Yes, I will try that. I just needed to say it felt bad.
That is a good step. Take your time with it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I sit at my desk all day.
That can get boring. Do you take breaks?
I usually just keep working.
Rest is good for your brain. Do you like the quiet?
Yes, the house is very silent.
Silence can help you think. Do you stretch your legs?
Not often. My legs feel stiff.
Stretching keeps you strong. Do you eat lunch there?
I eat snacks from the fridge.
A real meal helps you feel full. Do you look out the window?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I watched a movie today where a bear lost his honey and went to find it in the forest.
That sounds like a sweet adventure. Did the bear find his honey in the end?
Yes, he did, but he shared it with a little bird because the bird looked hungry.
He was very kind to share. Do you like bears?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see a blue bird. Is it a robin?
It is not a robin, but I am sure it is a happy little bird. Do you like blue colors?
Yes, I do. Can I catch it for my friend?
No, you must not catch it because it needs its freedom. Is your friend far away?
Yes, they live near here. Why do they sing so loud?
They sing to talk to other birds and show their joy. Do you hear any other sounds?
I hear a crash. Is that a storm coming?
I do not know, but you should run inside to be safe. Do you have your coat on?
Yes, I am leaving now. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome, and stay safe in your warm home. Bye.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is this box so big?
I wanted it to be a surprise. Do you like big gifts?
It feels very heavy.
Yes, it has a lot of value. Is it heavy for you?
Can I open it now?
Not yet, please wait. Are you ready to wait?
I am so happy today.
That makes me happy too. What color is inside?
It is a blue shirt.
That is a nice choice. Do you like the color blue?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do we say please and thank you?
It shows we care about others. Do you like feeling special?
Yes, I do.
Kind words make people feel good. What is your favorite polite word?
I like thank you.
That is a great choice. It always makes me smile.
Thanks for helping me.
You are welcome. Do you have more questions?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the beach today and found a starfish.
That is a lovely find. Did you look close up?
I did. It was pink and wet.
Pink is a nice color. Do you like the smell of the salt air?
I do. It makes me feel calm.
Calm is a good feeling. Was the water warm?
It was cool, but I went in anyway.
You are brave. Did you stay for a long time?
I stayed until the sun went down.
That sounds like a perfect day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent too much on candy today. I feel sad about my empty pocket.
That feels bad. Did you buy more than you planned?
Yes, I got three bags instead of one. Now I have no money left for lunch.
Tell the truth next time to save for food. Did you have enough for a simple meal?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel so fast and tired all the time. How do I get better at waiting?
Try to take one slow breath and watch your hands. Do you like to watch things grow, like plants?
Yes, I like seeing the small green leaves come out. But I want my toys to move right now.
Toys do not grow as slow as plants, but you can take turns. What is your most favorite toy to play with?
My red truck. I just want to zoom it around the floor.
You can let the truck rest for a few minutes before you drive it fast. Is that a small wait you can try?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very worried right now.
That sounds scary. What is the big thing on your mind?
I am afraid I will fail my test.
Do you know why you feel this way?
I am sad and cold.
I do not know why your body feels that way. Is your room too chilly?
I just need to feel okay again.
You will be fine. Have you tried taking three deep breaths?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this town. It is too quiet and gray.
That feels lonely. Do you miss your loud home?
Yes, I do. But I am stuck here now.
I get that feeling. What is your favorite thing here?
Nothing, really. It is just empty.
I am sorry. We can find some fun together.
I do not know if I can smile today.
Let us take a small walk. Do you like walking?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread is flat and I am so sad.
Do not worry. Is it warm in the room?
It is, but I forgot the yeast.
That is why it stayed flat. Yeast makes the air bubbles.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited by the stop for a long time today.
That can feel like a very long time. Did the bus finally come?
Yes, it arrived with a loud honk.
What a loud sound. Is the bus full of people?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: This is so hard to wait for. I am very sad.
I know waiting feels heavy. What are you waiting for?
I just want it to be done right now.
That is a true feeling.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late and my feet will not stop moving.
Slow down for just one second to breathe. Are you feeling scared?
I do not have time to stop for a breath.
True waiting feels longer than rushing. Is that the only reason you rush?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very nervous about my big test tomorrow.
That is okay, you can do this. What part worries you the most?
I do not know the right words for the poem.
Try to tell the story in your own words. Do you know what the poem is about?
Yes, it is about a bird flying home.
That is a nice theme. How many lines do you need to write?
I need to write five lines, but I am stuck on the last one.
You can always add a simple ending. What is your favorite word in the poem?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on my math homework and feel very sad. Do you have any tips to help me finish it?
Take a deep breath and look for the easy parts first. Is it the addition or the subtraction that is hard for you?
The subtraction is hard because I keep getting the numbers wrong. I want to get it right now.
You can draw small circles around the numbers to help you see them better.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I just wrote a letter. Do you want to read it?
That is great! What is in the letter?
It says I love my friend. I am so glad I wrote it.
That is very sweet of you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. What time is it?
It is ten past two. Are you going to the park?
No. I need to get to work.
You have two minutes left. Do you have your keys?
Yes. I have them right here.
Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I keep my balance on the bike?
Hold the handlebars tight. Do you wear a helmet?
Yes, I always wear my helmet.
That is good for safety. Is your bike in the right size?
I am not sure if it is too big.
You should sit on it and feel your feet. Do they touch the ground?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I was thinking about my old friend Sam.
That sounds nice. Do you still play with him often?
No, he lives far away now.
That is true. It can feel quiet without them.
I miss his laugh a lot.
Laughs are very sweet to hear. Do you send him letters?
Yes, I draw pictures for him.
Drawing is a lovely gift. What did you draw last time?
I drew a big red dog.
A red dog sounds fun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not know how to sing.
That is okay, we can start with a hum. Do you like loud or soft sounds?
I like loud sounds, like a dog bark.
Great, let us try a big bark. How does that feel in your chest?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I saw a big mountain today.
That sounds wonderful. Did you climb it?
I did not climb it, but I walked near its base.
Walking near it must have felt fresh and cool.
The air was crisp and the views were amazing.
I do not know the exact name of that peak.
It is called Mount Blue Sky.
A very nice name for a high place.
Yes, it looked like it touched the clouds.
I am glad you had such a fun day out there.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do sailors use maps to find their way?
Yes, they use maps and stars. Do you like looking at maps?
I do. What happens if it gets very dark?
They use special lights and tools.
Can they hear the ocean?
Yes, the waves make a big sound. Do you live near the sea?
No, I do not. Thank you.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is there a dog in the shop?
No, there is no dog. Do you like dogs?
Yes, I want a red car.
We have a red car. Would you like to see it?
No, I want a green bike.
We do not have a bike. Do you like bikes?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I read at night but I feel too tired to close my eyes. Do you know a good trick?
Try reading with a warm lamp instead of a bright light. Do you like reading stories or facts?
I like stories with happy endings. It makes me feel calm before sleep.
That is a lovely habit for your heart. Do you read in bed or in a chair?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet today?
The wind is calm and the shops are closed. Do you live here?
Yes, I live on this corner.
That is a peaceful spot. Do you like the silence?
I do, but it feels a bit lonely.
Many people enjoy the peace. Are you waiting for someone?
I am waiting for my friend to return.
Patience is a good virtue. What is their favorite color?
I think it is blue.
Blue is a calm color. I hope they come soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to catch a big fish.
Try a worm. Is your pond deep?
No, it is shallow.
Use small bait then. Do you have a float?
Yes, I have a red one.
Put the red float on. Do you like worms?
I do not like them.
I do not know live bait tips. Try a bread ball.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The book you picked is too hard for me to read.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like books with many pictures?
Yes. I do. I just wanted something easy for my night.
I do not know which book will help now. Would you like to go to the shop and look together?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to cross the island on foot.
You need strong boots and a map to find the path. Do you have a map?
I do not have a map, but I have my ears.
Listen for the water to find the way. Do you hear the sea?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do birds sing in the morning?
They sing to tell other birds where their home is. Do you like to sing?
Why are their feathers so bright?
Bright colors help them find a mate. What color is your favorite bird?
Why do they build nests?
Nests keep their eggs safe and warm.
Why do they fly away at night?
I do not know for sure, but they rest in quiet spots.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because the moon is so far away. I want to touch it.
That sounds frustrating. Do you wish you had a very long ladder?
Yes, I do. It just looks so bright and lonely up there.
It actually shines by reflecting sunlight. Do you like the color of its light?
I like the yellow glow. I just wish I could be there for a moment.
You can look up and imagine it. Do you see any stars nearby?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The fence is broken and the dog ran out.
I am sorry to hear that. Did the dog come back safe?
Yes, but my plants are all chewed up. It looks so messy.
That is very sad. I do not know how to fix it, but you can help me see it.
The wood is splintered in three places. It feels hopeless.
I will think of a way. Do you have any extra wood in the shed?
I think so, but I am too tired to look. It was a bad day.
Rest first. Come see me in the morning.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I float?
Your body has air in it. Do you like to kick your legs?
Why is the water cold?
Water takes time to warm up. Do you wear a cap?
Why does salt help me?
Salt is heavier than fresh water. Do you swim in the sea?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I get tired when I run fast?
Your legs need air to work. Do you walk to cool down?
I stop right away. Why is that bad?
Sudden stops can hurt your heart. Do you stretch after you run?
I never thought of that. Why should I stretch?
It keeps your muscles soft and safe.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do people here like to play in the park?
Yes, many families go there on weekends. Do you have a favorite game?
I like to kick a ball. Do they let dogs go in the park?
I am not sure about the dogs. Do you have a pet at home?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am sad because my brother broke my toy.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you think he did it on purpose?
He said he did not mean to.
That is good. Try telling him it made you sad.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My dog ran away at the park.
That was scary. Did you find him?
Yes, I found him under a big tree.
I am glad he is safe. Does he like trees?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do I float when I hold my breath?
Your lungs fill with air, which is lighter than water. Do you like jumping into the pool?
Yes, it is fun, but I get tired quickly.
Resting your arms helps you keep more energy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I buy a ticket?
You can use the machine at the start. Do you have a phone with you?
Yes, I have one. What do I press?
Tap the screen for "Buy" and pick your time. I do not know the exact button name for your city.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a big old map in my closet today. It has a red X on a hill near the river.
That is a cool find. Do you know if anything is really there?
I went to the hill to look, but there was only a bench and some old trees.
A quiet spot sounds nice. Did you sit down for a while?
I sat on the bench and watched the water flow by. It was very peaceful.
I am glad you enjoyed the view. I do not know what that map shows, but it sounds fun.
I will keep it safe because I might go back next week.
That is a great plan. Will you bring a book with you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the kitchen have no windows?
It helps keep the food warm and safe. Do you like hot food?
Yes, I do. Why is the bread so soft?
The baker uses a special mix of dough. Do you like the smell of it?
It smells good. Why is it free?
They give it away so you can wait for your meal. Does the table feel comfortable?
It feels fine. Why is the staff so quiet?
I do not know the reason. Do you want to order now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at my cat. He is so cute.
He looks very happy. What is his favorite game?
He likes to chase my hand.
That is fun. Does he nap a lot?
Yes, he sleeps all day.
Good for him. You seem glad to share this with me.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn to sing. My voice feels too small.
That is a brave start. Do you have a favorite song?
Yes, but I get scared when I try to sing it.
Fear is common at first. What part makes you feel scared?
The high notes make my head hurt.
High notes take time to learn. We do not know your exact issue.
I just want to sound nice.
Kind practice helps. Do you listen to music every day?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost on this small island. I do not know which way to go.
Do you see any bright flowers? I know the safe path is near the red blooms.
Yes, I see red flowers near the big tree. Should I follow them?
That sounds like a good start. What does the path look like?
It looks like a wide, sandy road that goes up the hill. I feel ready to walk.
Great. Take a slow step.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My boss is very nice to me, but I am not sure how to say thank you.
Tell him you like how he helps you. Do you have a specific gift in mind?
No, I just want to be good back. What should I do?
A small card with a sweet note is a great start. Is he a tea drinker or a coffee drinker?
He likes coffee. What is the best thing to do?
Bring him his favorite drink with the card. That is a very kind and true way to show thanks.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lights went out and I am so happy about it.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What are you doing now?
I am eating a cold snack in the dark with a flashlight.
Cold snacks can be very tasty. Do you like chocolate?
I love chocolate and I have a big bar left to eat.
That sounds like a sweet surprise. I do not know how long the power will be gone.
I do not mind waiting for it to come back.
Waiting can feel long sometimes. Do you have a battery lamp?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I count the apples on the tree?
You can start at one and point to each apple. Do you have a number line to help?
I do not have a number line. What else can I use?
You can hold up your fingers as you count. Are there ten apples or more?
There are twenty apples. I am getting confused.
Count the first ten, then count the next ten. Do you see two groups of ten?
I see two groups. I understand now. Thank you.
I am happy you learned. Would you like to count the leaves next?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late! Is the sun hot?
Yes, the sun is very warm today. Do you have a hat with you?
No, I am just walking fast.
That is a smart way to beat the heat.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am on a train! It goes so fast. The view is very nice.
That sounds like so much fun. Do you like the sound of the wheels?
Yes, it is a good rhythm. I am very happy to be here.
I am glad you are having a great time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped a red sock in the wash. It turned the blue shirt red. I am so sad.
That is a tricky mess. Did you try soaking it in cold water?
I did not know to do that. I put it in the dryer before I saw. Now it is stuck.
I am sorry, but I do not know if that can be fixed. Was the shirt your favorite?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does my toy boat stay up on the water?
The water pushes up on the boat to hold it. Is your boat big or small?
It is a big boat.
Big boats push more water out of the way. Do you like to watch it float?
Yes, I do.
That is good. Do you know why the floor is hard?
The floor is hard because it is made of wood.
Wood is strong and dry. Does your boat have a hole in it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My little dogs chewed through the wood.
That is very frustrating. Did they hurt themselves?
No, but my nice fence is ruined. Now the rabbits get in.
Rabbits love to nibble on wood. Do you have any heavy wire?
I do not know. It is just broken and sad.
I am sorry it broke. Let us talk about fixing it later.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad and small. I cannot find my house.
That is okay. Where is the big red tree?
I do not know. Is there a tree?
I do not see a tree. What is in front of you?
I see a tall blue building. It is big.
Go toward the blue building. Do you see a door?
Yes, I see a blue door. Do I open it?
Open the blue door. Come in, please.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so angry. The web is too big and I feel small.
I hear you. That feels scary. What part makes you stop?
I tried to buy a shoe but the site broke. It lost my money.
That is very bad. Is the screen still on?
Yes, it just shows a black box. I do not know what to do.
Try to tap the top corner. Do you see a red cross?
I found it. Now I can see my home page again.
Well done. You fixed it. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat down to play cards with my friend.
That sounds like a good start to your day. Did you enjoy the first game?
Yes, we played a fun round of rummy.
Rummy is a great game for thinking. Who won that first hand?
My friend won, but I was not sad.
That is a very kind thing to do. Did you feel happy anyway?
I felt calm because we just play for fun.
Calm is a good feeling to have. Did you play any other games after that?
We played one more game and I won that one.
That makes it even better. Did you feel proud of your win?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel so sleepy when I read in bed?
Your body gets tired from the quiet dark. Do you like reading stories or facts?
I like stories. But sometimes my eyes hurt.
The screen or bright light can tire your eyes. Do you use a lamp?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many months are in a year?
There are twelve months in a year. Do you know the names of all of them?
I know some, but not all. Which one comes after May?
June comes after May. Is June your favorite month?
No, I like winter more. What is the first month of the year?
January is the first month. Do you like the snow?
Yes, I love the snow. Is December the last month?
Yes, December is the last month.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see a big bird sitting on my fence. What kind is it?
It looks like a robin. Do you see a red part on its chest?
Yes, I do see a red patch right there. Is it happy to be out?
Yes, it is likely looking for food. Do you have any worms or seeds?
I have some old bread in the kitchen. Can I give it to the bird?
Bread is not good for them. Please use clean seeds or live insects instead.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy. I have a party today.
That is great news. What will you eat?
We have pizza and cake.
Yum. Who is coming?
My friends and my mom.
Sounds fun. Have a good time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I took a picture of my dog today. He looked so silly!
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did he listen to your commands?
He did, but then he stopped to lick the camera lens.
Oh no, that must have been sticky. Did you get the picture clean?
Yes, I wiped it with my shirt. It looks great now.
I am glad you fixed it. Where did you take the photo?
We were in the backyard near the big tree.
