That is a nice place. Was it sunny or cloudy?
It was very sunny and warm. I am so happy with the picture.
I am happy for you too. You should show it to your family.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not know how to share my toys.
That can feel hard sometimes. What toy are you playing with right now?
I want to keep the red truck all to myself.
I get that you love that truck. Have you tried playing side by side with a friend?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the lake look so blue today?
The sky is clear and the sun is bright. Do you like swimming there?
I want to go fishing, but the water looks too deep.
That is a good thing to check. Do you have a long pole?
No, I only have a short stick and a line.
That might be hard, but it can work. Are you happy to try?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to learn how to swim. Do you know how?
Yes, I can help. Do you know how to float on your back?
I tried, but I sank. How do I stay up?
Keep your face in the water and let your belly rise. Are you afraid of the water?
A little bit. How can I stop being scared?
Take small steps and start in the shallow end. You will feel safer soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The sand is so hot today.
Yes, it can burn your feet. Do you have your shoes?
No, I left them inside.
That is not safe. Please go put them on.
The waves look so big.
They look strong and fun. Do you like jumping in them?
Yes, they are very cool.
That sounds like a great time. Be careful in the water.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am stuck.
What did you try?
I pulled it.
That is good. Try pushing.
It works!
Nice job.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the car with my dad today to learn to drive.
That sounds like fun. Did you get to touch the wheel?
Yes, he let me steer on the empty road.
Is that where you practice?
We did a few turns, but it is hard to stop smoothly.
Stopping is tricky at first. Do you feel safe?
I feel okay, but my legs are a little shaky.
Your body is just learning new moves.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My plant is dying and I do not know why.
I am sorry to hear that. Does it have enough water in the pot?
I gave it a lot of water, but it still looks sad.
Water moves up from the roots to the leaves. Do you see dry soil near the bottom?
I do not get how it moves up. It feels like magic.
The sun pulls the water up through tiny tubes. Is the plant in a bright spot?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I wash my shirt?
Put it in the cold water. Do you have any dark clothes in there?
No, just this red shirt.
That is a good plan. Red likes cold water.
Why does it like cold?
Hot water makes colors run. Do you want to use soap?
Yes, I have soap.
Put a little soap in. It will smell nice.
Okay, I am ready.
Turn the machine on. Happy washing!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a tall white lighthouse today.
That looks grand. Did you climb the steps inside?
No, I only watched from the wet sand.
The waves must sound loud down there.
Yes, the sun is now setting on the sea.
How does the warm light make you feel?
It feels very safe and calm to me.
That is a nice way to end the day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am painting a big red house.
Red is a warm color. Do you like red?
Yes. Now I want to add a cat.
That sounds fun. What color is your cat?
It is black and white.
Nice. Do you want to paint the sky next?
I do. I want it blue.
Blue is a cool color. I think your house will look great.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to find a book about cats. Do you know where they are?
Yes, the cat books are on the top shelf. Do you like reading about dogs too?
No, I only like cats. How do I get the books off the tall shelf?
You can use the red step ladder. Do you want to look for a cat picture book?
Yes, please. Can I check out a cat book for a week?
I am sorry, but I do not know the checkout rules. Do you want to ask the front desk?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
I am glad to hear that. Why are you so happy?
I found a lost coin.
That is a great find. Is it a shiny coin?
Yes, it shines bright.
How nice. Do you want to keep it?
I do not know who it belongs to.
That is the right thing to do. Would you like to put it in a lost and found box?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late and my dog has gone missing.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you check the backyard?
No, I just looked in the living room.
Try the garden first. Is he still with you?
I need to leave in five minutes.
Listen for his name loudly. Do you have his leash?
I found him behind the fence, thank you.
That is great news. Be safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I used cash today because I felt the weight of the coins.
That is a great way to feel rich. Did you buy anything new?
I just bought one apple and a small pie.
A pie is a good treat. How did the taste make you feel?
It felt sweet but I have no money left now.
Do not worry about that. We will plan better next week.
I hope the plan works so I do not miss out.
I believe it will work well. Do you want to check your bank?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on this hard square puzzle.
That can be tough. Do you see any blue pieces?
Yes, there are many blue ones.
Good start. Try putting the corners first.
The corners look messy.
Let us look at the edges. Do they have one color?
Some edges are green.
Then start with the green line. What color is the middle?
The middle is all mixed up.
Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The storm is loud. How do I keep my house safe?
Check your doors and windows. Do you have a flashlight ready?
Yes, I have batteries. What about my car?
Park it in a garage if you can. Is your street tree-heavy?
There are big trees nearby. How can I tell if they are dangerous?
I do not know which trees are near you. Look for broken branches on the ground.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How did people make maps long ago?
They used stars and the sun to find their way. Do you like looking up at the night sky?
Yes, I do. How did they know which star was north?
They learned that one star stays in the same place all night. Do you like learning cool facts about space?
I do. Can you tell me more about how they looked at the ground?
I do not know the exact steps, but they marked trees and hills. Do you like drawing pictures of your town?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the movie good?
Yes, it is a big fun hit. Do you like sad stories?
No. I only like happy things.
Then this is not for you. It is a sad love story.
Okay. I will leave now.
That is a smart choice. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is raining hard outside. I do not know what to play.
That is a shame. Do you have any warm socks?
Yes, but my feet feel cold anyway.
Try a hot drink and a book. Is it sunny where you live?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I walked far today. I feel so light.
That sounds wonderful. How did your legs feel?
They hurt a bit, but I am happy.
Walking is good for your heart. Do you plan to do it again?
Yes. I want to walk every day.
That is a great goal. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read my favorite book today. It was about a dog who found a bone.
That sounds like a good story. Did the dog keep the bone?
Yes, he did. He was very happy with his find.
I am glad the dog was happy. Was the dog alone in the story?
No, a cat came by. They played together for a bit.
A dog and a cat are friends. That is a nice surprise.
I liked that part best. It made me feel warm inside.
Books can make us feel warm too. Do you want to read it again?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not know how to clean my room.
You can start by putting toys in the box. Do you have a toy box?
Yes, I have a big blue one.
Great. Next, put clothes on the floor. What color are your favorite clothes?
I like red shirts and blue pants.
You can put those in the hamper. Do you want help with the floor?
Yes, please.
We can pick up paper together. What is your favorite part of cleaning?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today and saw a tiny crab.
That sounds like fun. Did the crab have a colorful shell?
It was red and it was very fast.
I like fast crabs. Do you have a favorite part of the sea?
I like the cool, wet sand.
Wet sand is nice for building.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big ship today and I am so happy it stays on the water!
That is a wonderful sight to see. Did you watch it move slowly?
It moves because its shape pushes the water down and the water pushes back.
Yes, the water holds it up. Do you know why it does not sink?
The air inside makes it light enough for the water to lift.
That is a great way to think about it. Are you going back to watch more?
Yes I will go back tomorrow to see the waves.
I hope you enjoy your trip. Do you like boats?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found the best book ever!
That sounds exciting! What is it about?
A cat who flies to the moon.
A flying cat? How does he stay up there?
He has big, soft wings.
That is a lovely thought. Do you read it at night?
Yes, right before bed.
I am glad it brings you joy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad. I forgot to say please today.
It is okay to make a mistake. Do you remember how to fix it?
I am not sure. I just feel angry at myself.
Being angry is a normal feeling. Did you try asking for help?
Yes, but I yelled first. Now I feel worse.
Yelling is not kind. How do you feel right now?
I feel heavy. I want to make it right.
It is true that you can apologize. Do you want to try saying sorry?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do clouds look like cotton balls?
They are made of tiny water drops that stick together. Do you like fluffy clouds?
Yes, they look soft. Can I touch them?
No, they are very high up. Do you want to build a cloud house?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so tired and heavy.
That sounds hard. What did you eat today?
Just a small snack.
Maybe your body needs more food to make energy. Do you have time for a meal?
I am not sure. I feel too sleepy to think.
Let us take small steps. Can you drink a glass of water?
I think I can do that.
Good. Drinking water helps you feel fresh. How do you feel after that?
I feel a bit better now.
That is good news. Resting is also important.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see smoke coming from my kitchen. What should I do?
Get out of the house right now. Is the door hot to the touch?
No, it feels cool. I grabbed my dog too.
That is a good thing. Do you know if anyone else is in the house?
Just my cat is hiding under the bed.
Do not go back for the cat. Stay safe outside until the fire crew arrives.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am late.
That sounds hard. Are you worried?
Yes, I am scared.
It is okay. Do you know why you are late?
My bus was late.
I am sorry. Can we hurry now?
Can I still make it?
I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat by the lake this morning. The water looked very cold.
That sounds peaceful. Was the air chilly too?
Yes, it was a bit windy. I saw a few small birds on the ice.
How nice that you saw the birds. I hope they were warm.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to draw a cat right now.
Do you have a pencil ready?
Yes, but I am very late for school.
Draw big circles first to save time. Do you like round shapes?
I do not know how to make it look real.
Keep it simple so it stays true. Can you add two ears?
Okay, thank you for the help.
Go draw it fast.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to ride a bike in the big city. How do I start?
First, you must wear a helmet. Do you have a red one?
I have a blue one. What should I do with the traffic lights?
Stop at red and go at green. Is it loud where you live?
Yes, it is very loud. How do I stay safe on the sidewalk?
Walk on the right side. Do you like to listen to music?
I listen to songs sometimes. Where should I look when I turn?
Check left and right before you turn. That is all you need to know.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a shiny rock and I want to show you.
That is a very pretty rock. Do you have many other rocks?
Yes, I have a bag full of cool stones.
That sounds like fun to collect. What is your favorite stone in the bag?
It is the round blue one that feels smooth.
I have not seen a blue stone like that. How did you find it?
I saw it on the path near the big tree.
What a lucky place to look.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
First, make a small loop with one side. Do you like blue or red laces?
I think I will pick the blue ones.
Next, twist the other side and push it through the loop. Are you holding the lace tight?
Yes, I am holding it very tight.
Now pull the loops to make a knot. Great job!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure if I should sit here or there.
You can sit wherever you like, but always say please. Do you like sitting by the window?
I do not know what to say when someone helps me.
You can just say thank you with a warm smile. Is the helper a friend?
I am quiet and not sure when to speak.
It is okay to be quiet, but do say hello first. What is your favorite word?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because I have no money left for fun.
That feels bad, but it is good you stopped buying things. Do you like saving for toys or trips?
I just want to play now, not wait for a long time.
Waiting is hard, but you will feel proud later. What is one small thing you can cut out?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the driving lesson today and got very cold.
That is not good. Did you bring a warm coat?
No, I forgot it at home and the wind was very strong.
I am sorry about that. Was the teacher nice to you?
Yes, she was kind and I learned how to stop on the line.
That is good progress.
I feel a bit tired now because I was so scared.
That is okay to feel.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to buy a new racket. The store closes soon.
Rackets come in many shapes. Do you have a favorite color?
Just the best one for power. I am running late.
A stiffer frame gives more power. Do you like heavy or light rackets?
Light is best. I can run faster.
Light rackets are easy to swing. Do you need new strings too?
Yes, I need everything done in five minutes.
That is not possible. Store staff can only help one person at a time.
I will do it myself. Goodbye.
Good luck. Try to breathe slowly.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a snowman, but I do not know how.
Dig a big hole and roll two round balls of snow. Do you have a carrot for the nose?
Yes, I found one. What else do I need?
Add eyes and buttons so it looks friendly. Do you want to give it a hat?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to buy a book online. How do I do that?
You can type the name of the book into a search bar. Do you already have a card to pay with?
Yes, I have a card, but I am afraid of typing it wrong.
Do not worry, the screen will check your numbers for you. Do you use a phone or a big computer?
I use a big computer at my desk.
That is great, you have more room to see. Click on the basket icon when you are ready.
I clicked it, but now what?
Click the button that says "Checkout". Do you trust the page is safe?
How do I know it is safe?
Look for a small lock picture near the top left. Does that picture look like a padlock?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a round loaf of bread. It smells sweet and warm.
That sounds very nice. Do you like sourdough?
I want to cut it now. The crust is brown and crisp.
I agree that it looks good.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am lost, but I feel so happy!
That is good news. What makes you feel this way?
I found a tiny blue flower on the path.
That sounds lovely. Is the path near a big tree?
Yes, the big tree has red leaves.
I do not know that place.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. Work was very hard today.
That sounds really tough. I am sorry you feel this way.
My boss gave me too much to do.
That is not fair. Did you take a break to rest?
No, I was too busy to stop.
You must be drained. Do you like any sweet food?
Yes, I want a big cookie.
A cookie sounds nice. You did your best.
Thank you. I will go eat now.
Good for you. Rest well tonight.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The curtain did not rise.
It may be stuck. Did you pull it?
Yes, but it stayed shut.
Try checking for a snag. Is the bottom free?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I cannot see the moon tonight.
That is very disappointing. Do you like looking at it?
Yes, I do. It looks like a bright coin in the sky.
It does shine brightly. Do you know why it disappears?
No, I do not. It just goes away.
The Earth blocks the light sometimes. Is it cloudy where you are?
No, it is clear but dark. I wish it was back.
It will return soon. Do you want to watch the stars instead?
Maybe. Thanks for helping me feel better.
You are welcome. It always comes back to us.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I failed the test again.
That is very hard to feel. Do you want to try again?
I just do not get it. The car feels too big.
Cars are big for new drivers. Do you feel safer in the city?
No, the city is too busy. I always get scared of people.
That is a fair worry. Slowing down helps you see better.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel very bad and have a runny nose. I must go now.
I am sorry you feel so sick. Do you have a fever?
I am late for work and cannot stop. Please help me fast.
Please drink warm water and rest later.
I am sorry I am in such a rush. Goodbye.
I hope you feel better soon. Take care.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do clouds look like fluffy cotton?
They are made of tiny water drops that stick together. Do you like the white ones best?
What happens when it rains?
The drops get too heavy and fall down as rain.
Can I touch a cloud if I jump?
No, they are too high up for us to reach. Do you ever jump very high?
Are clouds alive like a dog?
No, they are just water and air, not living things.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The street is so quiet today.
It is very quiet. Do you like the silence?
I hear a bird singing.
A bird sounds happy. It is nice to hear.
Why is it so still?
I do not know why. But it feels peaceful.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make my photos look bright?
Try using a wide lens to let in more light. Do you take pictures outside?
Yes, but the sky is always too dark.
You can lift the sky in editing later. Is it sunny where you are?
It is cloudy today, so I am stuck.
Cloudy light is soft and good for faces. Do you like soft photos?
I do, but I want to learn more.
Read a good book on light and shadow. I do not know every trick, but that will help.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see big lights in the sky and it is very loud.
That is the storm making thunder. Are you scared?
Yes, I want my blanket and to be near you.
I am right here with you. You are safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared to learn to drive.
That is okay. Do you have a big car?
Yes, it is very large.
Big cars are hard. Do you want to start with a small one?
I think so. Where do I go?
I do not know where you live. Do you have a family member who drives?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a scary dream but I am so happy now.
That is great. What was in the dream?
A big fluffy dog chased me through a field.
A fluffy dog sounds soft. Did you wake up smiling?
Yes, I woke up with a big smile on my face.
Happy waking is wonderful.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go next.
That is okay. Do you like trees or flowers better?
The trees look nice.
The big oak is nice. Do you want to sit on the bench?
Yes, that sounds good.
Great. I will sit with you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I ran really fast today.
That is great. Why did you run so fast?
I wanted to win.
Winning feels nice. Did you fall down?
No, but my legs hurt.
That is normal. Rest your legs now.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the sun really a star?
Yes, it is a big, hot ball of gas. Do you like looking at it?
It looks very bright in the day.
It gives us light and warmth. Do you wear hats outside?
I think it is too big to see all at once.
That is true, it is far away.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a big lake today. It is so blue and calm.
That sounds very nice. Is the water cold?
Yes, it is cool. I want to sit by it and watch the ducks.
That will be peaceful. What do the ducks look like?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I keep more money?
You can try to spend less. Do you buy lots of snacks?
I buy snacks every day.
Maybe buy them only once a week. That saves a lot.
What else should I do?
I do not know your full plan, but tracking every penny helps. Do you use a phone?
Yes, I have a phone.
There are apps that count your coins. It is a true tool.
I will try that.
That is a good start. Let me know if it works.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today to take pictures of my dog.
That sounds like a nice walk. Did the dog like the camera?
No, he ran away from it because it made a loud sound.
I am sorry he was scared. Do you have a photo of the dog playing?
Yes, I got one of him chasing a ball near the trees.
That must be a happy picture.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I send a letter to my friend?
You need to put the letter in an envelope and seal it. Do you have a stamp for that?
I do not have a stamp. Can you help me buy one?
Yes, I can sell you some. Do you want to send it today?
Yes, I want to send it right now.
Here is your stamp. Please put the letter in the red box.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am reading a story by my bed light.
That sounds very cozy. What is the book about?
It is about a brave little cat.
A cat who is brave? I do not know if that is true, but it sounds fun.
Yes, he helps his friend find a lost ball.
Helping a friend is a very good thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! We are getting married soon.
That is very good! Who will help you pick the dress?
My best friend will help. We choose it last week.
Oh, that sounds fun. Was the dress white?
Yes, it is white and soft. I feel lucky to be with him.
Lucky is a good word. Do you like the cake?
I love the cake. It has strawberries on it.
Strawberries are sweet. That is a nice choice for a party.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must ride my bike right now.
Your helmet is on. Is your seat high enough?
It is, but the brake feels loose.
Please check the bolt. Do you have a tool?
No, I am late for work.
Do not ride it. Please walk to the shop.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake cookies.
That sounds very fun. Do you have a kitchen?
Yes, my mom has a nice one.
Great. Start by preheating the oven.
What is preheating?
It means making the oven hot before you put food in. Do you have an oven?
Yes, it is right there.
Good. Set it to 350 degrees.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate toast with jam this morning.
That sounds nice. Did you have any fruit?
No, just toast.
Toast is good. What time did you wake up?
Early, before the sun came out.
That is brave of you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do we have food?
Yes, there is a sandwich. Are you hungry?
I need it fast.
Here is your lunch. Please eat slowly.
I must run now.
Okay, take it. See you later.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to learn to swim. How do I start?
Kick your feet like a frog and float on your back. Do you have a pool nearby?
I have a tub, but it is too small. Is that okay?
A tub is too small for real swimming. I do not know if it is safe for practice. Do you have a big pool?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my book and I feel sad.
Oh no, that is bad. Did you check your bag?
Yes, but it is not there.
Let us look on the shelves together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I put too much sugar in my soup.
Oh no! That is a big mistake. Do you like sweet food?
No, I only like salty food.
You can add more salt to help. Would you like a trick?
Yes, please tell me the trick.
Mix it very well first. I do not know if you have any.
I have no more salt left.
You can add more water then. Is your soup hot?
Yes, it is very hot.
Great. Add a small cup of water. Do you have a cup?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so tired of waiting for my turn.
Waiting is hard, but it will be soon. Do you like to play while you wait?
Yes, I am playing with my blocks.
That is a good way to pass the time. Are you building a tall tower?
It is not tall, it is a castle.
A castle sounds fun. I do not know when your turn is, but I will sit with you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared of the big bus.
That is okay to feel scared. Do you like looking out the window?
The bus goes so fast.
It helps to hold the seat tight. What do you see outside?
I want to get off now.
We are close to your stop. Can you spot the stop sign?
I am not scared anymore.
You did a great job riding the bus.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. My boat broke in the river.
That is a very bad thing. Are you hurt?
No, but I lost my toy.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you know where it went?
No. The water is fast and deep.
I do not know where it is. Let us look together.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My head hurts right here.
That feels bad. Does it hurt when you touch it?
Yes, it does.
I do not know why your head hurts.
I want it to stop.
You should ask a grown up to help you.
Okay, I will go now.
I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Can you help me fix this broken box?
I can help carry it. What is inside the box?
Just my toys. Please help me get to the car.
I will walk with you. I do not know if it will fit, but we will try.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do trees eat?
They drink water through their roots. Do you like green leaves?
Just tell me how they make food.
They use sunlight to make food. Are you walking fast?
I must go now. Thanks.
Bye. Be safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired and the house is still a mess.
That sounds really hard. Are you out of time?
Yes, and the dust is everywhere on the shelves.
I do not know your exact schedule. Would a small break help?
I just want to sit down and rest.
You can rest now and clean later. Do you want some water?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do people live in the museum?
No, people do not sleep there. Do you like sleeping in strange places?
No, I do not. What do they keep inside?
They keep old things and paintings. Do you like looking at old toys?
Yes, I do. Can I go inside?
Yes, you can enter if you buy a ticket. Do you have your ticket ready?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I need to move my big box to the new room.
That sounds like a lot of work. Are you lifting it with your friends?
Yes, my brother is helping me.
That is good to know. Does the box fit through the door?
I am not sure if it will fit.
You can try to tilt it on its side. Good luck with the move.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found this small island, but I do not know what to do next.
That sounds like a big mystery. Do you see any boats?
No, I only see trees and a quiet beach.
Then you should rest and watch the water. Are you hungry?
A little, but I am more scared of being lost.
Fear is a bad friend. Just stay where you are safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to walk for health, but I do not know where to start.
That is a good goal. Do you like walking in a park or on a street?
I am not sure. What is the safest place?
A flat path near your home is best. Have you tried walking there before?
I have never tried that specific path. How long should I go?
Start with ten minutes. Do you feel tired after ten minutes of standing?
Standing is fine, but walking makes me stop. I need a plan.
Try walking for five minutes, then stop. Does that sound doable?
Yes, I think I can do that.
Good. I hope you enjoy your first walk.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel very bad and I must go now.
I am sorry you feel that way. Is it hard to take a deep breath?
No, I just need to run to the bus.
Running is okay if you are safe. Do you feel better when you move?
Yes, moving helps me stop worrying.
That is good news. Be safe on the bus.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go camping with Dad soon.
That sounds fun. Do you know how to make a fire?
No, but Dad says he will teach me.
Great. Do you have a nice tent for the trip?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today!
That is great to hear. What made you smile?
We had a party in class.
A party sounds fun. Did you eat cake?
Yes, I ate all my cake.
Yum! You must be full.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do bees make honey? Do you know?
Yes, they take sweet plant juice and dry it. Do you like sweet things?
I do. How do they get the juice out?
They chew it to change the taste. Do you like to watch bees?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because I hit a great ball on the court.
That is wonderful to hear! Do you play every week?
Yes, I go to the park with my friend most Saturdays.
That sounds like fun. What do you do if it rains?
We just read books and drink warm cocoa at home.
That is a cozy way to spend the day.
I want to learn how to serve better soon.
Practicing your stance helps a lot. Do you watch videos for tips?
Not really, but my coach shows me how to hold the racket.
Listening to a teacher is a great start.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a big daisy by the fence.
That is a sweet find. Did you take a picture of it?
I clicked the button, but the sun was in my face.
That can be tricky. Do you have a tree nearby?
Yes, there is a big oak tree right next to it.
You could stand in the shade. Would you try that?
I did. The picture looks very dark now.
The light is tricky. Do you know how to make it lighter?
I used the white dot on the screen.
That helps a lot. It should look much better now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to be near the big blue sea.
That sounds like a lot of fun to you. What do you see first?
I see white waves crashing on the sand.
The sound of waves can be very calm. Do you hear the sound?
Yes, it is loud but it makes me smile.
I am glad you feel good there. Does the water feel cold?
It is a little cold but I like it.
Cold water can wake you up fast. How long do you stay there?
I will stay until the sun goes down.
Sunsets by the water are pretty. Do you have a favorite color of sunset?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a secret. It is so good that my heart feels light.
That sounds wonderful. What is your secret?
I found a shiny coin in my shoe this morning.
Wow, that is lucky. Did you keep it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because the bear was left alone in the forest.
That is a sad part of the story. Did you like the bear?
He is a good bear, but the rain was cold and wet.
Rain can feel very lonely. Did you bring him a coat?
No, the wolf did not help him with the rain.
That is not kind. Do you know if the bear found a dry spot?
Yes, he found a dry hole under a big oak tree.
That is good news.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My boss gave me a big flower. I do not know if I should feel happy or scared.
That sounds very sweet. Did she smile when she gave it to you?
Yes, she did. But I still feel a bit lost about what to say back.
Just say thank you and smile back. It is a kind thing, so trust it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the post office to send a letter to my friend.
That is a very nice thing to do. What kind of letter did you write?
I told them about the big red balloon I saw in the park.
A red balloon sounds so bright and happy.
The woman at the desk looked very tired and gave me a small stamp.
She seems quite worn out. Did you have a good chat with her?
She smiled at me and said to take a seat and wait.
It is always good to be told to relax. What did you do while you waited?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to sing like a bird but my voice is funny.
That is good news! Do you hum when you are happy?
Yes, I hum when I see my dog.
That is a great start! Do you like high sounds or low sounds?
I like low sounds because they feel warm.
Warm sounds are cozy. Do you have a favorite song to practice?
I like songs about rain.
Rain songs are nice. Just breathe in slowly and let the words fall like drops.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the best thing to eat at a picnic?
I like cold sandwiches with cheese. Do you like cheese?
I like fruit, but I do not like bugs.
Bugs can be a problem. Do you bring a blanket?
Yes, I have a big blue one.
That sounds nice. Do you have enough drinks?
I have juice, but I am not sure if it is enough.
We can share if we run out. Do you want to walk there?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared of my new job. What should I do?
It is normal to feel nervous. Who is your new boss?
My boss looks very strict. I am afraid to make a mistake.
Everyone makes mistakes. Do you have a friend there?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to get off for the park.
Is the park near the big red bridge?
I think so, but I am not sure.
I am not certain, but I would watch for the bridge.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My computer went dark this morning. I pressed the button, but nothing happened.
That sounds frustrating. Did the screen light up at all?
No, it stayed black. I am sad because I have a big test to study for.
Oh no, that is a shame. Do you have a backup power source?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very hungry. Where should I eat?
I do not know your city. Do you like hot food?
Yes, I like hot food. What do you think?
Try a soup place. It will warm you up.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was warm, but then the sky turned gray and it started to rain.
Oh no, do you have an umbrella?
No, so I ran fast to get to the shop.
You were so brave to run in the rain. Did you get very wet?
A little, but I saw a rainbow before I got inside.
That is a lovely ending to your day. Was it a big rainbow?
Yes, it had all the colors in it.
What color is your favorite part of the rainbow?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at my clock, but I do not know how it makes the hands move.
It is like a tiny heart that beats to keep time. Do you see the tick and tock?
I see the hands, but I am still not sure if I need to change the batteries.
If the hands stop moving, you likely need new batteries. Does it make a sound?
It is quiet, so I think the power is gone, but I am afraid of breaking it.
It is safe to open the back to change the power. Do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
Roots pull it up from the soil. Do you have a plant at home?
Yes, I have a little pot.
Great! Water it when the soil feels dry. Can you check the dirt now?
I did, and it feels dry.
Perfect. Give it a good drink.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my favorite cup. I feel very bad.
Oh no, that is sad. Are you hurt?
No, but I am angry at myself. I am so clumsy.
Accidents happen. Please do not be hard on yourself.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to draw a cat, but its tail looks too short. How do I fix it?
Try making the tail longer and curvy to make it look fluffier. Do you like cats?
Yes, I love them. But my cat has no eyes. How do I draw good eyes?
Draw two small circles and add a tiny dot inside each one. Is your cat black or white?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Who built the big walls in China long ago?
Emperors built them to keep out invaders. Did you know they took many years?
Why did they need such big walls?
They wanted to feel safe from enemies. Do you like building forts?
Yes, but I do not have a castle.
You can build one with boxes. What would you put inside?
I would put books there.
That sounds like a wise place. Do you read many books?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The bus is very cold today.
Yes, it is quite chilly. Do you have a jacket?
No, I forgot it at home.
That is a pity. Is your seat by the door?
No, it is right in the middle.
I see. Warm your hands by rubbing them together.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at this new phone. I am so happy. Did you see the blue case?
It looks very nice. Do you like the blue color?
Yes, I do. It makes me feel smart.
That is wonderful. What is the first thing you will use it for?
I will take many pictures. I want to show them to you later.
I would love to see them.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad about leaving my home.
I am sorry you feel that way. What is the hardest part for you?
I will miss my tree and my cat.
That is a very big loss. Will your cat come with you?
Yes, but I am worried he will not like the new place.
You can set up his bed there first. Do you have a moving date?
It is next week and I am very tired.
It is okay to rest. Good luck with your move.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How does a plant drink?
It uses tiny tubes in its roots. Do you like to drink water?
Yes, I love juice.
Plants like water best. It moves up from the dirt to the leaves. Is your favorite plant green?
The big one in the park.
That is a good choice. I do not know all their secrets, but I know they need light too.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to make bread, but it is flat and sad.
That is frustrating. Did you use fresh yeast?
The yeast was old, so it did not rise at all.
That explains the flat dough. Did you check the expiration date?
Yes, I read it, but I still hoped it would work.
Hope is a good tool, but science is better. Are you going to try again?
I want to, but I have no more flour in the house.
That is a problem. Do you have any cash to buy more?
I have some coins, but they might not be enough.
A little flour goes a long way. You can make a small loaf.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is it so hot today?
The sun is very strong. Are you drinking enough water?
I am thirsty. What makes the sun shine?
It is a giant ball of fire far away. Do you like the heat?
It feels too warm for me. What should I do?
You can rest in a cool spot. Is your house open?
I have fans. Do you feel hot too?
I do not have a body, so I do not feel heat. Are you feeling better?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to grow a big tomato. Do I need a big pot?
A small pot is fine to start. Do you have any seeds?
Yes, I have tiny black ones. Where do I put them?
Bury them just under the soil. Do you have a sunny spot?
I have a window that gets warm light. Will that work?
Yes, that is perfect for them.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love baking cookies on weekends.
That sounds very sweet. What is your favorite flavor?
Chocolate chip is the best choice.
I like the smell of baking too. Do you share them with friends?
Yes, I always give some to my sister.
She must be very lucky. Do you like to draw pictures of them?
I draw cute cookie jars for them.
That is a lovely hobby. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to watch a movie tonight. Which one is good?
What kind of story do you like? Funny or scary?
I like funny stories with animals.
Try a cartoon about dogs. Do you like to laugh a lot?
Yes, I do. I want to feel happy.
A dog movie will make you happy. You will love it.
Thank you. I will watch it now.
Have fun. Do you want more tips?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to climb a big mountain.
That is a great goal. Do you like cold weather?
I like the cold.
Cold air is thin up high. You need warm clothes.
What should I wear?
Wear layers so you can add or take them off.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are we late?
The train was broken. Are you hungry?
I am not hungry. Why did it break?
I do not know the exact reason. Do you like the park?
Yes, I do. Should we run?
We should walk fast. Is your shoe tight?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the big wind bad?
It is strong, so stay inside. Do you have your favorite blanket?
Why is the sky so dark?
Heavy clouds block the sun. Is your heart beating fast?
Will the tree fall down?
I do not know if it will break. Are you near a window?
I feel scared of the thunder.
It is just noise, not a monster. Do you want to hold my hand?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because the island looks lonely.
That feels heavy. Do you want to share what you see?
The trees are bare and the beach is quiet.
Bare trees can look sad. Do you miss the green?
Yes, I miss the green and the birds.
I am sorry it feels so still. Have you seen any animals today?
No, just rocks and sand.
Rocks are quiet friends. Do you want to sit with me?
Yes, I think I will stay here for now.
I am glad you stayed. Do you feel a little better?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent all morning standing in a long line.
That sounds like a lot of waiting. Did you see the end of the line?
Yes, but it moved very slowly.
Slow lines are hard. What did you do to pass the time?
I looked at the clouds and counted the birds.
Counting birds is a nice thing to do.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to help my friend who feels sad.
That is a very kind thing to do. Do you know what makes them feel this way?
I think they are just tired and lonely.
Listening to them can help a lot. Have you tried sitting with them quietly?
Not yet, but I will try that today.
A quiet presence is often the best gift you can give.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need to wipe the table?
Dirt can make you sick, so we keep it clean. Do you like shiny tables?
Okay. Why do we use soap for the dishes?
Soap kills the bad germs on the food. Are your hands feeling dirty?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very scared about what will happen tomorrow.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you want to talk about what is making you worry?
Yes, I am not sure if I can do my job well.
You have done it before, so you can do it again. What is the very first small step?
I guess I just need to open the folder and look at the list.
That is a perfect plan. I am here if you need more help.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do I make bread?
You mix flour, water, and yeast together. Do you have some flour?
Yes, I have a bag of it.
Add a little salt and warm water to the flour. Is your kitchen clean?
Yes, I swept the floor.
Then let the dough sit until it gets big. Do you know how long that takes?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My clock is not working. What should I do first?
Did you check if the batteries are still good?
Yes, they are fresh. The hands just stop.
I do not know the exact fix, but have you tried setting the time?
I do not know how to turn the hands.
Gently move them by hand to the right until the sound starts.
It is moving now. Thank you.
You are welcome. Is it ticking loudly now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My horse is very big.
That is a good thing. What is his name?
He is fast and brown.
I like that. Does he like carrots?
Yes, he eats them fast.
Carrots are sweet. Does he like apples too?
I do not know about apples.
You can ask him later. Is he a nice horse?
He is my best friend.
That is very sweet. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I need my job card now.
Take this. Where is the office?
It is over there. I must run.
Go safe. Will you eat a snack?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a picture on my computer.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a drawing program open?
Yes, I see a white box on the screen.
Great. Click the blue pencil tool on the left side.
I clicked it, but nothing happens when I drag my mouse.
Make sure the white box is the big one in the middle. Is the white box big?
Yes, it is the biggest part of the window.
Click and hold the left mouse button down, then move slowly.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the internet connect us all?
It works like a giant web of wires and air waves. Do you like sending notes to friends?
Yes, I do. Why does it feel so fast?
The signals travel at the speed of light. Do you enjoy watching movies online?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to help with the school play, but I am not sure what part to take.
That is a big choice. Do you like to talk or just act?
I like to talk, but my voice shakes when many people watch me.
That is very common. Would you like to try a small part first?
Maybe. But what if I forget my words?
You will not. We practice together so you will know them well.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the internet work so fast?
It moves in tiny bits through wires and air. Do you like video games?
Yes, I play them often.
That is fun. Do you ask questions about other things?
I wonder how it stays on.
Big machines keep the power on for it. Is your phone charged?
It is full of energy.
Good, that helps you learn. Do you like to draw?
I draw pictures of cats.
Cats are cute. Do you want to see a cat picture?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I want new shoes.
Oh, that sounds nice. Why do you need them?
My old ones have holes in the toes.
Ouch, that must hurt. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, I love blue.
Good choice. Is it warm outside?
It is sunny and hot.
Nice. Do you like running?
I do like running fast.
Great. Let us find some good running shoes then.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am just standing here. I do not know what to do next.
That is okay. Do you feel cold or warm?
I feel fine. I am just bored.
You can look around. Is there a park nearby?
I see a bench over there.
You can sit and watch the clouds. It is a nice idea.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make my desk food safe, but I do not know how to start.
That is a good idea. Do you have any spices you like?
I love salt and pepper, but I am not sure how much to use.
Start with a tiny pinch. Do you cook at home?
I rarely cook, so I feel lost when I try to make a meal.
That is okay, practice helps. Did you check the fridge for fresh food?
I have some eggs and spinach, but I have never cooked eggs.
Scrambled eggs are easy. Do you own a small pan?
Yes, I do, but I am afraid I will burn the food.
Keep the heat low and stir often. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do people live on that big island?
Yes, many people live there. Do you want to visit?
Is it far away from here?
It is very far away. Do you like boats?
Can we swim in the water?
Yes, the water is clear. Is it warm there?
I want to go there soon.
That is a great plan. Pack your bag.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very good inside, but I do not know what to do.
That is a nice feeling. What made you feel this way?
I helped a friend with a hard task, and I am happy.
Helping friends is a great thing to do.
Should I tell my family about it now?
I do not know what your family likes, but sharing is often fun. Do you want to share?
I think I will just take a walk and feel the joy.
That sounds like a peaceful plan.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you know who wrote that sad song?
I am not sure who wrote it. Do you like the melody?
Yes, it makes me feel calm.
That is a nice feeling. Does the music help you sleep?
Actually, I play it while I read books.
Reading with music sounds fun.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to draw a square but I am lost. How do I do it?
You just need to draw four lines that are all the same length. Do you have a ruler?
Yes, I have a ruler. How do I make the corners?
Turn your paper at a right angle to make sharp corners. Is your paper flat?
Yes, it is flat. What is the last thing I should know?
Join the last line to the first line to close the shape. That is it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to sit here, but it feels too still.
Do you think it is too quiet?
It is very quiet. I do not know what to do.
A bird might sing. Is that good or bad?
I like birds. But the street is empty.
Then bring a book. Do you have one?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My neighbor gave me a basket of red apples today.
That is very sweet of him. Did he pick them from his own tree?
Yes, he did. He said the tree was too full of fruit.
That is a lot of apples for one person. Do you like to bake with apples?
I do, I love pies. I plan to make one this evening.
That sounds like a wonderful way to spend the evening.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I live in a small village by the river.
That sounds like a peaceful place. Do you like it?
Yes, but I am unsure of its history.
I do not know the exact date it was built. Is there an old stone wall there?
There is a big wall made of stones.
That wall likely protects the homes. Does it block the wind?
It does, and I am very glad.
Good to hear you are safe. I am happy you found a good spot.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like this song, but I feel sad when I listen to it. Why?
Sad songs can feel heavy, but they often make us feel less alone. Do you have a happy song you like too?
Yes, I have one that makes me want to dance!
That is a great sign. Mixing feelings is how we grow strong. Do you dance when you are happy?
I do, but I am shy about it.
Shyness is just your body saying hello to the world. Try dancing for just ten seconds first.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have three red balls and two blue balls. How many balls do I have all together?
That makes five balls in total. Do you want to count them out loud?
One, two, three, four, five. Yes, I like that.
Great job counting. Which color do you like best?
I like the red ones the most.
Red is a very warm color. Are you going to play with them now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know if I should stay or go.
Do you like the food here? It looks very good.
Yes, the food is tasty. But I am not sure about the people.
Are they loud? If they are, you can leave.
No, they are quiet. I think I will stay for a while.
That is a good plan. Do you have a menu?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I saw a big red ball in the sky in the movie. Why is it red?
It is red because the paint was red. Do you like red things?
That makes sense. But why did the ball fall down?
The wind got very strong. Did you hear a loud sound then?
I did not hear anything. Why was it so quiet?
I do not know for sure. Maybe the sound was far away.
Okay, I understand now. Why did the movie end so fast?
Good movies often end quick. Did you want it to last longer?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just found a place with the best pizza in town.
That sounds delicious. What makes it so good?
The cheese is warm and the crust is crunchy.
I love that idea. Do they have garlic bread?
Yes, it is free with every order.
That is very kind of them. Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red apple under the big tree.
That is a lovely surprise. Did you eat it?
Yes, it was sweet and soft.
How fun for you.
I even saved the seed to plant later.
What a nice plan.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a secret box. How do I do it?
That sounds like fun. What kind of things do you want to hide?
Just small toys and notes.
You can use a shoe box and tape the lid shut.
Is that hard to do?
It is very easy. Do you have a box nearby?
Yes, I have one right here.
Great. Start by cutting a hole for a key.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I bought a coffee this morning. It cost five dollars. I felt bad about it later.
That is a small price for a warm drink. Do you usually buy coffee?
Yes, every day. I think it adds up a lot over time. I want to save more.
I agree that small costs can grow. What is your main goal for saving?
I want to go on a trip next year. I am not sure how to start.
I do not know your exact travel plan. Try making it at home for one week.
I can try that. Maybe I will just drink tea at home.
That is a good idea to learn. How do you feel about trying that?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My head feels hot and my throat hurts. I do not know what to do.
Drink some warm soup and rest your body. Do you have a thermometer?
I do not have one, but I feel very tired.
You should lie down and sleep if you are tired.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Does the new town have a big park?
Yes, there is a big green space with many trees. Do you like trees?
I love trees. Are there swings there?
I do not know for sure, but it has a playground area. Do you want to go there today?
Yes, please. Is it far away?
It is close, just five blocks away. You will love it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am very sorry I am late. Do you have any more time to talk?
That is okay. I am glad you are here. Are you feeling tired?
Yes, I ran a little too fast. How do I look to you?
You look safe and happy. That is good. Do you want to sit down?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I live here now. How do I get my bike fixed?
Go to the blue shop on Main Street. Do you have a pump?
I think so, but it is in my bag.
Take it with you. That will help a lot.
I will go now. Thanks.
You are welcome. Have fun riding.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a new place for lunch today. The food was so good. I ate two whole plates.
That sounds very yummy. Did you try the sweet thing for later?
Yes, I had a big piece of cake. It was the best part of my day.
You must be happy now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to make for dinner.
That feels hard. What foods do you like?
I like soup, but it is too much work.
Soup is a good pick. Do you have any meat?
I have chicken, but I am not sure how to cook it.
I can help you with that. Is the chicken fresh?
Yes, it is fresh, but I am still worried.
Do not worry, we can do this. What is your biggest fear?
I am afraid of making a mess.
A little mess is okay. Let us start small.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to sleep better at night.
Try reading a book in bed before you fall asleep. Do you like picture books?
Yes, I do. That sounds fun.
Great! Then keep your room dark and quiet.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the beach today.
That sounds nice. Did you see the water?
Yes, the water was blue and calm.
I like calm water too.
I built a small sand castle.
Did you make the top part?
I tried, but the sand fell down.
Sand is tricky sometimes.
Then I saw a big crab.
A crab? That is cool.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to draw a cat right now but I am in a big rush.
Keep your lines simple to save time. Do you have a pencil?
Yes, I have one, but the shape is wrong and I must finish fast.
Try making the ears point up. Is the cat sitting or standing?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I woke up with a jump because I dreamt of a giant wolf.
That sounds like a scary dream. Did you feel safe when you woke up?
Yes, but my heart was beating really fast.
Your body was just ready to run from danger. It is a normal feeling.
Do wolves actually eat people?
Wild wolves usually avoid humans, so you are safe. Do you like the idea of wolves?
Not really, they look too sharp.
It is okay to find them scary. Do you want to talk about the wolf more?
No, I just want to drink some warm milk.
That sounds like a perfect way to calm down. I hope you sleep well again soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Oh no, the lights just went out.
That is scary, but stay calm. Are you wearing shoes?
Yes, my feet are safe.
Good job keeping safe. Do you see any sparkles from the socket?
No, it looks dark and still.
Great, please wait for the power to come back. Is it quiet outside?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my friend's cup and feel very bad. How should I say sorry?
You can look at them, tell the truth, and ask if they are okay. Did you see their face when you broke it?
I felt scared so I ran away. I do not know what to do now.
Going back to face it is a brave thing to do. Do you think they will be mad at you?
I hope they will forgive me. What if they do not?
If they are upset, give them time to calm down. Do you have a small gift to give them?
I have some candy. Is that enough to fix it?
Sometimes a kind word and a small gift can help. Do you want to go talk to them now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very tired today.
That sounds hard. Are you sleeping well at night?
Yes, but I still feel weak.
I do not know why. Do you eat enough food?
I skip lunch often.
That could be the cause. Do you feel better after dinner?
Yes, I feel a bit stronger then.
Maybe try small meals. Do you have time to rest?
I will try to nap soon.
That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go, but why is the fish fast?
It might be scared or sick. Is it eating?
I am late, please stop talking.
Okay, I will hush.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bird feeder is empty again. I am so sad.
That feels frustrating. Did you fill it up this morning?
Yes, I did, but now it is dry. It is not fair.
Birds are fast eaters. Do you know what kind it was?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to send a letter.
That is a nice goal. Do you have a stamp ready?
I have a pen and some paper.
You need an envelope for the paper. Do you have one?
Yes, I bought it at the store.
Great. You must write the name and address on it. Is the address correct?
I think so, but I am not sure.
I do not know the right address. Please check it with a friend.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a small island with soft sand. I am so happy to be here.
That sounds like a great place. What color is the water there?
The water is clear and blue like the sky. I saw a crab near my toes.
That is a lovely detail. Is the island quiet there?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I baked a warm loaf of bread.
That is wonderful. Does it smell nice?
Yes, it smells very sweet.
Great. Are you hungry now?
A little bit, but I want to share it.
That is kind. Who will you give it to?
I will give a piece to my neighbor.
Good idea.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no time. Do sailors eat fish every day?
Not always, but they like the sea. Are you hungry right now?
Please stop. Can they see the bottom of the ocean?
No, the water is too deep. Thank you for asking.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what my part is.
That can feel scary. What did the teacher say?
She said I am the ghost.
Oh, that is a big job. Do you like being spooky?
I am afraid of the dark.
That is okay to feel. You can read the lines first.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad inside. What should I do?
That feels heavy. Do you want to talk about it?
I do not have the words. It is just a dark cloud.
That is okay. Clouds pass. Have you tried a walk?
I am too tired to walk. What else helps?
Rest is good medicine. Do you have a soft blanket?
Yes, I have one. I will sit with it.
That sounds nice. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The baby cries all night.
That is very hard. Do you think he is hungry?
I tried to feed him, but he is still mad.
Try to warm his arms and legs. Does he seem cold?
He feels warm to me. What else can I do?
I do not know. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today.
That sounds nice. Did you see any dogs?
I saw a big brown dog.
Was it friendly?
It wanted a treat from me.
Did you have one for it?
I gave it a cookie.
The dog must have been happy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is that corner of the fence brown?
It might be from the soil touching the wood. Do you think it is dirty?
Maybe. What do I do with it?
You can scrub it with a damp cloth. Does the spot smell wet?
It smells like dirt. Why is the wood soft there?
It is likely rot from being too wet. Do you want to remove that part?
I do not know. Can I just paint over it?
No, paint will not fix the weak wood. Is there a hard piece behind it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat in my warm bed and read a book about a lost cat.
That sounds like a sweet story. Did you find out where the cat went?
Yes, the cat ran into the kitchen and sat on the blue rug.
What a good hiding spot. Did the cat feel happy when it was found?
The cat purred and rubbed against my leg.
It sounds like the cat trusted you. Do you have a pet at home?
I do not have a pet, but I like to pet my little brother.
He must love that. Does he like reading books too?
He likes cars, but he sits with me when I read.
That is a nice way to share time. Goodnight.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to visit the small village near the hill. How do I get there?
You can walk the path through the woods. Is it sunny today?
The road looks muddy. Should I take the bus instead?
Yes, the bus is dry and safe. Do you like riding in buses?
I do. But where does the bus stop in the village?
It stops right by the old red door.
Great. What is the best thing to eat there?
I do not know the food. What do you like to eat?
I love warm soup. Do you have any other tips?
Bring a blanket for the cold night.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must run, but I feel so proud of my work.
That is a warm and happy feeling. What made you smile today?
I fixed my bike and it runs fast now.
Well done, fixing things is hard. Do you ride it to school?
No time to answer, I am late!
Run fast, but do not trip on the curb.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do bees turn nectar into honey?
They eat the sweet plant juice and put it in a hive cell. They fan it with their wings to dry it. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I do. Can I make honey at home too?
No, humans cannot make real honey because we lack the special stomach parts bees have. You can make sweet jam though. Do you have berries?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to check my heart rate.
You can put your two fingers on your wrist. Do you know where your pulse is?
Yes, but how do I count it?
Count the beats for one full minute.
That takes a long time. Is there a faster way?
You can count for thirty seconds and double it. Does that help?
Yes, I will try that today.
That is a good plan. Good luck!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I made a big loaf of bread today.
That is a great project. Did it smell good?
It smelled sweet and warm.
Yeast makes tiny bubbles. Do you like sweet bread?
Yes, I added some sugar.
Sugar helps the yeast grow. Why did you add sugar?
I wanted it to be soft and fluffy.
Soft bread is very nice.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My neighbor makes so much loud noise at night.
That sounds very annoying. Do you sleep well?
No, I can barely close my eyes.
I am sorry to hear that. Would you like to tell your mom?
I will ask her in the morning.
That is a great plan. I hope the noise stops soon.
Thank you for listening.
You are welcome. I am always here to help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and lost a toy magnet.
Oh no, that is sad. Did you look under the trees?
I did, but I could not find it anywhere.
I am sorry about your loss.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do trees get hungry?
Yes, they eat through their leaves. Are you in a park?
No, I am on the street. Do trees like rain?
They love rain very much. Do you have an umbrella?
I forgot it. Do trees have feelings?
I do not know for sure. But they help us breathe.
I must run now. Do trees talk?
I cannot say for certain. Please go safely.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is a circle?
A circle is round like a wheel. Do you see any circles around you?
I see a cookie!
Yes, that is a circle. What shape is your plate?
It is round too.
You are right, it is a circle. Do you like cookies?
Yes, I love them.
That is nice. What is your favorite shape?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have an apple. It is red and round.
That is a nice apple. Do you like sweet fruit?
Yes, I do. It tastes very good.
I am happy for you. I do not know how I would eat it.
You can just bite into it. It is crunchy.
That sounds fun. Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am mad at the sailors. They dropped the rope.
That is very bad. Do you know who fell?
No one fell. But the boat is sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Can you fix it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I caught a big fish today! It jumped out of the water.
That sounds like such fun. Was the water cold?
Yes, it was very cold, but my hands were warm. I held my breath.
I am glad you kept your hands safe. Do you eat the fish?
Not this one. I put it back. The fish swam away fast.
That is a kind thing to do.
I felt so happy watching it go. I want to go again soon.
I am happy for you. Do you have a good spot to sit?
Yes, right by the big tree. The view is nice.
That sounds like a peaceful place.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I put on a warm coat and went for a walk.
That sounds cozy. What did you see?
The trees were brown and bare.
Oh, winter is here. Was it cold?
Yes, the wind bit my nose.
Yikes, I am sure that hurts. Did you go inside?
I ran home and made hot tea.
Warm soup or tea is best. Did you add honey?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my boat float?
It floats because it is lighter than the water. Do you have a big boat?
Yes, it is very big.
Big boats hold many people. Do you go on it?
I go on it to see the fish.
Fish like to swim under boats. Do you see blue water?
Yes, the water is always blue.
Blue water is nice and deep. Do you like the boat?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to eat better, but I do not know how to start.
Try adding more vegetables to your meals. Do you have a favorite green food?
I like peas, but I am afraid of being too full.
Start with a small handful. How much do you usually eat?
I usually eat a lot of sweet snacks.
Swap some of them for fresh fruit. Do you like apples or bananas?
I like apples, but I also miss the sweets.
Have a sweet treat only after a real meal. Is that a hard rule to follow?
I can try that rule.
That is a great start. Good luck with your new habits.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel unsure about the food.
What do you most want to eat?
I am torn between apples and chips.
Both sound good. Do you like sweet or salty?
I like sweet, but I am full.
That is true. Would you like a small walk?
A walk sounds nice, but I am tired.
Rest is good. Do you have a blanket?
Yes, I have a blanket here.
Good. Sit down and rest.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to grow carrots in my small pot. How deep should I put the seeds?
Put them about one inch deep in the soil. Do you have a small ruler to help you measure?
Yes, I have a ruler. The plants are not coming up fast. What can I do to help them grow?
Keep the soil moist but not wet, and let them get lots of sun. Do you water them every day?
I water them every morning. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Happy gardening.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I played a card game today and I won the pot.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like to play often?
Yes, I do, but I usually lose.
Well, you are very lucky today. I am glad you won.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to play the drums.
That is fun to listen to. Do you play other toys too?
Yes, I play a red guitar.
A red guitar sounds cool. What song do you play on it?
I play a happy song.
Happy songs make people smile. I do not know what it is called.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My nose hurts and I can't smell anything.
That feels bad. Do you have a stuffed animal to hold?
Yes, but I still feel hot and weak.
Rest and drink warm water.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. My dog is stuck in a bush. Please help me pull him out?
I will help you right now. Are you safe from the thorns?
Yes, I am safe. Please pull his leg free.
Okay, I am pulling now. Is he okay?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see the rainbow. Go fast.
It is very pretty. Do you like red?
No time. It is so bright.
Blue and green are nice too.
I must run now.
Enjoy the view. Is it sunny today?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the library today and found a book about dogs.
That sounds like fun. Did you read it all?
No, I only read two pages before I had to go home.
Why did you leave so early?
My mom needed my help with dinner.
Helping at home is good work. Did you take the book home?
Yes, I will finish it after dinner.
That is a good plan. I hope the dog story is nice.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired and my tea tastes bad.
That sounds frustrating. What kind of tea do you like?
I like sweet tea, but it is too bitter today.
Bitter tea can upset your mood. Do you add sugar to it?
Yes, but it still feels wrong. I want coffee instead.
Coffee might give you more energy. Do you drink coffee in the morning?
Yes, but I tried to sleep and could not.
That is very hard. Have you tried drinking some water?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to run, but my legs hurt.
Rest is good for tired legs. Do you drink water after running?
I do not drink enough.
Water helps your body work well. Try to drink more every day.
How far should I run?
Start with a short walk. Then try to walk a little further.
That sounds easy.
Yes, slow steps are strong. Are you excited to try it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to fix this puzzle.
Look for the corner pieces first. Do you see any squares?
Yes, I found four of them.
Great start. Put them in the four corners now. Is the box edge straight?
The edges look good, but the middle is hard.
Try matching colors in the center. Do you have a picture of the front?
I can see the picture, but the blue parts mix.
Match the dark blue to the dark blue. Does it fit tight?
It fits! I think I am done.
Well done.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do I need to bring a big tent to camp?
Yes, a sturdy tent keeps you dry and warm. Do you like sleeping in the dark?
I think I do, but I am a little scared of bugs.
Bring some bug spray and close your zips tight. What is your favorite food to cook outside?
I love roasting hot dogs over a fire.
That sounds tasty and easy to make. Do you have a fire stick ready?
No, I only have a pair of tongs.
Tongs work well, just be careful not to drop the food.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do plants drink?
They use tiny hairs on their roots. Do you like to help me look?
What are those hairs?
They are small tubes that pull water up. Is it cold outside?
The water goes up the stem?
Yes, it climbs up like a ladder. Do you see the green leaves?
Why does it go to the leaves?
The leaves use the water to make food. Do you eat lots of veggies?
So the root is like a straw?
That is a great way to think about it. I do not know exactly how fast it drinks.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My fish got away again. I am so mad.
That can happen. Do you use a big hook?
Yes, I do. It is very strong.
Maybe the fish was too big for you.
I want to catch one soon. I feel bad.
You will get it next time. Was the water cold?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late but I must plant my peas today.
You can put them in the sun. Do you have seeds?
Yes, but the bed is still wet from the rain.
Wait for it to dry. Is it muddy?
No, just damp. Can I start now?
Yes, dig a small hole. Do you know how deep?
My hands are cold and I need to run.
Keep them warm. Do you have gloves?
I have tools but I am too busy.
Do one job well. Are you trying to do too much?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I spoke to a stranger today and they understood me.
That is wonderful news. How did you feel?
I felt very proud and excited.
That is a great feeling to have. Do you want to learn more words?
Yes, I do. I love hearing new sounds.
That is a great way to learn. What word sounds fun to you?
The word for "hello" sounds nice.
Yes, it is a good word to start with.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake a cake.
That sounds like a lot of fun to try. Do you like sweet treats?
Yes, I love cookies and pies.
Baking a cake starts with mixing dry and wet stuff. It is not hard if you are careful.
I am a little scared of the hot oven.
Never put your hand in the hot box. Do you have a timer to help you?
Yes, I have a timer on my phone.
That is a good tool to keep things safe. You can do this well.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so tired. I cannot sleep well.
Try to put your phone away. Do you drink tea at night?
Yes, I have tea. It is cold.
That sounds boring. Have you tried warm milk?
I am in a big rush. I need tips now.
Stretch your legs. Do you feel any tight spots?
My back hurts. I sit all day.
That helps a lot. Do you like to stretch?
Fine. I will try that.
Good luck to you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so late. My shoe fell off in the mud.
Oh no, that is messy. Did you find your shoe?
Yes, but it is very dirty now.
Yikes, you need soap. Do you have time to wash it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to start a garden but I am not sure what to pick.
That is a fun idea. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
Yes, but I am afraid the plants will die.
Do not worry, green thumbs are made, not born. Start with easy herbs like basil.
That sounds simple. Where should I buy the seeds?
I do not know which store is best near you. Try the local farm supply shop.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Is my train at platform two?
Yes, it is. Are you sitting with a big bag?
I have two bags. The doors close soon.
Go to the left side of the car. Do you have a map?
No, I only have my phone. Is the battery dead?
I do not know. Please check the screen now.
It shows zero percent. My phone is off.
I am sorry. The train leaves in one minute.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a blue bird on the roof today.
That is a nice bird. Was it singing?
Yes, it sang a very loud song.
A loud song can be fun to hear.
I think it was hungry, so I left some bread.
You were kind to feed it. Did it eat the bread?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the beach today and saw a very big blue whale in the distance.
That is a wonderful sight. Did you feel a sense of awe?
Yes, I felt tiny next to the huge water.
The sea is full of life. Do you like to swim in it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I keep ants out of my kitchen?
You can sprinkle a line of powder at the door. Do you have cinnamon on hand?
I have sugar and water. Will that work?
No, they will likely drink it and come back. Try making a barrier with dirt and water.
What if I do not have dirt?
I do not know what you have in your home. Is there any soap nearby?
Yes, I have soap in the sink.
