Mix some with water and wipe the counter clean.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dug a hole in the dirt today. My hands are full of mud.
That sounds like hard work. What seed did you put in?
I put in a carrot seed. I hope it grows tall.
Carrots do grow tall out of the ground. Do you water it yet?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I forgot to say thank you.
That feels bad, but you can fix it. Do you want to try again?
I do not want to go back there. It is too hard.
It is okay to feel shy. Have you tried writing a note?
A note might help me feel better.
Yes, a note is a nice way to say sorry.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the moon round?
It is not always a full circle. Do you see the shapes it makes?
I see them. Why does it change?
The sun shines on different parts of the moon. Do you know where the sun is?
I think so. Is the sun always up?
For us, yes, but only for half the time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a magnet, but I am not sure what to do with it.
You can use it to stick things to your fridge. Do you have any paper clips?
Yes, I do, but I do not want to make a mess.
Just put the clips in a cup first. Is the fridge near your chair?
It is right there, but I am still not sure if I should try.
You can try one clip and see. Does it feel fun to you?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I heard a song today and I feel so happy.
That sounds nice. What is the song called?
It is a new song from my favorite band.
Good for you. Do you play it often?
Yes, I play it every morning to start my day.
That is a great way to begin the day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I built a tall tower.
That sounds like hard work. Do you still like the shape?
It fell down. I worked for hours.
It is okay to feel upset. Did you try again?
No. I am too tired to try again.
Rest is good too. You did your best today.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ran outside today because the sun was bright.
That sounds fun. Did you see any birds?
Yes, a small bird sat on the fence.
How nice. Did you get tired?
My legs felt like jelly after five minutes.
That is common for new runners. Do you plan to go again?
I think so, but it was a bit hard.
Great. Keep going slow.
Okay, I will try again tomorrow.
I believe in you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to eat only candy all day.
That sounds sweet, but your tummy needs other things too. Do you like apples?
No, I don't like apples.
That is okay, you can try carrots or bananas. What color fruit do you like?
I like purple grapes.
Grapes are a great choice for energy.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a box with gold coins in it. What should I do?
That looks like a lot of work. Do you know who lost them?
No, but I am scared someone will blame me. Can I keep them?
I do not know the law, but hiding them may hurt you more. Does the box have a name on it?
Yes, my neighbor's name is on it. I feel bad keeping the gold.
That feels like the right choice. Go and tell your neighbor about the find.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very hungry. What should I eat?
Do you like hot food? I can get a sandwich.
Yes, I like sandwiches. Are they tasty?
I think they are. I will check the food list.
Please pick the one with ham.
I do not see ham on the list. Do you like cheese?
Yes, cheese is good. Thank you.
I am happy to help. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do.
That feels hard. Have you tried a small thing?
I tried once and it failed.
One miss is not the end. Do you want to go again?
Maybe, but I am scared.
Fear is normal. I will sit with you. What is your first step?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad because no one wants to play with me.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a favorite game?
Yes, I like to build blocks, but I do it alone.
Building alone can be fun. Would you like to find a park?
Maybe. Do you know if people are outside?
I do not know who is outside.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to surf.
You need a board and wetsuit. Do you have a favorite color for your gear?
I have a blue board, but I am scared of the waves.
Start in the shallow water first. Have you ever been in deep water before?
No, I only swim in the pool.
That is fine, just float on your back first. Do you know how to float?
Yes, I can float, but my feet go down.
Bend your knees to help you stay up. You can do this!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking for a new book, but I do not know which one to pick.
That sounds hard. What kind of stories make you happy?
I like books about dragons and magic, but I am not sure why.
Magic is a big choice. Do you like funny dragons or scary ones?
I think I like the funny ones, but I am not really sure.
Funny is a great start. Do you want a short book or a long one?
I only have a little time, so I want something short.
A short funny dragon book is perfect. I will go find one for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy right now.
That is a lovely feeling. What made you smile today?
The sun is very bright and warm.
That sounds nice and cozy.
I just want to tell you about it.
I am glad you shared it with me.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to steer my boat. How do I do that?
You push the wheel to the side you want to go. Do you like the ocean?
Yes, I do. What if I want to stop?
You pull the wheel back to the middle. Is the water calm today?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know if I should go out.
The sky is gray and wet. Do you like to play in the rain?
I am not sure. The wind is very loud today.
It sounds scary. Stay inside and read a book.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I do not know the days of the week.
Do not worry. Can you tell me what day comes after Sunday?
I think it is Monday, but I am not sure.
You are right. I will ask you later if you remember the other days.
That is nice. I will try my best to learn them.
I am proud of you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so tired of waiting for my cake.
Waiting is hard work. Are you eating any sugar?
No, but I want to see the candle fire.
Patience is a good thing to learn. Do you like candles?
Yes, I love the light, but it is slow.
Time goes fast when you play. What is your favorite game?
I like to jump on the bed, but I cannot move.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you hop high?
I hop very high, but my mom says stop.
Listening is important. Are you almost done?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to bake bread but I am scared.
Do not worry. I am here to help. Do you have the flour ready?
Yes, but what do I do with it?
You must add water and yeast. Did you add the yeast?
I forgot the yeast.
That is okay. We can add it now. Do you have it in the cupboard?
I found it. Can I bake it now?
Yes, we can start. Let us make something yummy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to bring to the party.
Have you seen the guest list? It may help you pick a gift.
No, I have not. I am very lost.
I do not know who is coming, but a card is always good.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so happy at work because my boss is very nice.
That is wonderful news. What does your boss do that feels so good?
He always says thank you and helps me when I am stuck.
A kind leader makes a warm place. Do you feel safe there?
Yes, I never feel afraid to make a small mistake.
That is a great sign. Do you want to share that kindness with others?
I think so, but I am not sure how to start.
I do not know your specific team, but a smile goes a long way. Are you ready to try?
I think I am ready to be a little kinder to my friends.
That is a beautiful plan. Good luck on your journey.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the thunder so loud?
It is a big clap of air. Are you scared?
A little bit. What is the wind doing?
It is pushing hard. Do you like the rain?
It looks funny. Will the storm stop?
Yes, it must end.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do lions have tails?
Yes, they do. Do you like big cats?
I need to go, but are bears sleeping?
Some are, if it is winter. Do you like bears?
Can whales talk?
No, they cannot. Do you think they are smart?
Are snakes scary?
They can be scary, but they are kind. Do you like snakes?
Thanks, I am late.
Go fast. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My boss gave me a big box of cookies. I do not know what to do with them.
That is very sweet of your boss. Do you like cookies?
I love them, but there are too many for me. Should I keep them?
You could share them with friends. Does that feel right?
I think I will take half to my desk and give the rest away.
That sounds like a kind plan.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big red boat on the lake today.
That sounds like a fun ride. Do you like boats?
Yes, I love them!
I am glad you had a happy day. Where was the lake?
It was near my house.
That is very close. Was it sunny?
Yes, it was bright and warm.
That is a lovely picture.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the park fast. Can you point me the way?
Go straight until you see the red house. Is it your first time here?
I am very late. Which door do I use?
The big green door is the entrance. Do you have your ticket?
Yes, I have it. Is it far from there?
It is just a quick walk. You will be fine.
Thank you, I am running now.
Good luck with your trip.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we meet tomorrow?
We meet to plan the fun party. Do you like parties?
Yes, I do. Why not today?
We need more time to buy food. Is your house big enough?
It is big. Why use my place?
It is close to the park. Do you want to go there?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a letter to send. Where do I put the stamp?
You put it on the top right corner. Do you know where to get a stamp?
I do not have a stamp. Can I buy one here?
Yes, you can buy them at that small machine. How much is your letter?
It is one sheet of paper. How many stamps do I need?
For a light letter, you usually need one stamp. Did you write a nice message?
Yes, I told my grandma I love her. Where is the box?
The box is right over there by the wall. I hope she gets a big hug.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke my favorite cup. What should I do now?
That is sad to hear. Do you have any water to rinse the glass?
Yes, I have some clean water nearby.
Good. Please be very careful with the sharp pieces. Are you feeling okay?
I am okay, just a little worried.
It is okay to feel worried. Let us sweep the floor together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to run fast, but my legs hurt.
Rest is good for tired legs. Do you like to walk?
I love walking, but I want to go faster.
Try moving your arms more. Does that feel easy?
Moving my arms helps my body.
You are doing great work.
What should I eat before I run?
A small apple is a nice choice.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the apple so red?
The sun makes it change color. Do you like red apples?
Why do the people talk so loud?
They are happy and excited. I am not sure why they shout.
Why is that basket empty?
The vegetables inside were sold. Do you want to buy one?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the good food place?
It is right on the main street. Do you like soup?
Yes, I love soup. How far is it from here?
It is very close, just one block away. I do not know if it is open right now.
Please tell me if it is open. I am running very fast.
I think it is open, but I am not sure. Are you going to wait for me?
No, I must go now. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a nice meal.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss our little village so much.
It sounds like a lovely place to live. What is your favorite spot there?
The old well by the tree.
That is a nice place to sit. Do you often talk to the birds?
Yes, but they are gone now.
I am sorry to hear that. I do not know what to say, but I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a big plate of grilled chicken and green beans for lunch. It was nice and warm.
That sounds very healthy. Did you drink water with your meal?
Yes, I had a full glass of cold water. I felt happy when I finished.
That is a great way to feel good. Do you plan to have something sweet for dessert?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see a big white cloud in the sky. Do you know what it is called?
It is called a cumulus cloud. Are you watching it move?
Yes, it is moving slowly. How does it get there?
Wind pushes it along. Do you feel the wind on your face?
I do not feel any wind. Do you know why that is?
The wind up high is not always down here. I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have seven days in a week?
That is a good question. I do not know the exact reason. Do you like weekends?
I like Saturdays. Why is Sunday the last day?
It comes after six days of waking. Many people rest on that day. What do you do on Sundays?
I play outside. Why do we call them days?
We call them days because the sun rises. It feels like a new start each morning. Do you watch the sun rise?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big white cloud today. It looked like a big sheep.
That sounds like a fun day. Did the sheep move fast?
No, it stayed still for a long time. I watched it from my window.
That is a calm place to watch. What is your favorite thing about clouds?
I like how they change shape. One minute it is a sheep, next it is a horse.
Clouds are very good at changing. Do you ever imagine things in the sky?
Yes, I imagine a castles and ships. It makes me feel happy.
That is a nice feeling to have.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The line was very long.
That sounds frustrating. Did the people move slowly?
Yes, they were stuck in chat. I lost my patience.
I am sorry about that. Were you waiting for a package?
No, I just needed stamps. It felt like hours.
That is a long time. Do you want to try again later?
Maybe I will go home and mail it online.
That is a good plan. I hope you get your stamps soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I love bananas. They are very sweet. Do you have any tips on how to keep them fresh?
Yes, I know a simple trick. Do you eat them whole or in pieces?
I eat them whole. The tips are great. Why does that work?
It slows down the aging process. Do you like them with milk?
Not really. I prefer them plain. Is that okay?
Yes, that is totally fine. Enjoy your banana!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did everyone bring a balloon to the party?
To make the room feel big and happy. Did you see any blue ones?
Why is the music so loud today?
The host wants people to dance with joy. Do you know how to dance?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to swim, but I feel scared.
It is okay to feel nervous. Do you like deep water?
No, I just want to float.
Floating is a great start. You can try in the shallow end.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now. My bag is full and I am late.
Do not worry. Let me help you pack. Are you going on a trip?
Yes, but I forgot my keys. I cannot find them.
I do not know where your keys are. Have you checked your pocket?
No. I am so stressed. Please help me fast.
Take a deep breath. Look in your jacket. Did you check your belt?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sky is very dark and loud. I do not know what to do.
Please stay inside near the center of the home. Do you have any water with you?
Yes, I have some water and a blanket. But I feel scared.
It is okay to feel afraid. Stay calm and breathe slow.
The wind is hitting the walls hard. Is it safe?
I do not know for sure, but being away from windows helps. Did the power go out?
The lights just flickered and died. It is so dark now.
Use a flashlight if you have one. Do you have extra batteries?
I have a flashlight, but I am not sure if the batteries work. What should I do next?
Try to turn it on and stay in a sturdy room. Just wait for the loud noises to stop.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I saw a big fish jump out of the lake.
That sounds like a great time. Did the fish splash water on you?
Yes, it made a big splash and I got a little wet.
Oh no, but I hope you had fun anyway.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: When does summer come?
Summer comes after spring. Do you like hot days?
Yes, but what comes after summer?
Fall comes next with cool winds.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what to eat.
Do you feel like something hot or cold?
I think I want something cold.
A salad sounds good. You can add nuts if you are hungry.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The plane window is so far away.
It looks small because we are very high up. Do you like looking out?
I forgot my toy bear.
That is a sad thing to lose. Do you want a book instead?
My stomach feels funny.
That happens when the plane moves up and down. Take a slow drink of water.
When are we landing?
I do not know the exact time. Do you feel tired yet?
I am very tired now.
Good, sleep helps you rest your legs. Close your eyes now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to build a shed but I do not know where to start.
That sounds like a big job. Do you already have the wood?
Yes, I have the wood, but I do not know how to put it up.
You must nail the bottom first to hold it tight. Is your ground flat?
The ground is flat, but I do not have the right tools.
You need a hammer and some nails to start. Do you have a friend nearby?
My neighbor is close, and I am worried I will break something.
You can ask your neighbor to hold the boards still. Is he free today?
He is free, but I still feel lost about the roof.
We do not know your exact size needs yet. How wide is the space?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which path to take in the village.
Does one path look more fun than the other to you?
I think the wide one with the trees is nice.
That sounds like a good choice. Do you see any people on that path?
Yes, I see a child sitting on a bench.
You can ask them what they are doing. Do you feel ready to go talk to them?
Yes, I will go say hello now.
That is a brave thing to do. Have a happy time there.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I never get to climb a big mountain.
That feels bad. Do you like looking at them?
Yes, they look strong, but I feel small.
I do not know how to fix that. But I see you are doing your best today.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do bears live in the ocean?
No, bears do not live in the ocean. Do you like swimming?
Why do owls sleep during the day?
Owls rest when the sun is up. Do you like naps?
Can snakes fly?
I do not know why, but they cannot fly. Do you like birds?
How do elephants stay cool?
They spray water on their backs. Do you like baths?
Do rabbits have teeth?
Yes, they have teeth that grow big. Do you brush yours?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I am lost. Why is that?
You took a wrong turn because the sign was hidden. Are you near a big tree?
Yes, there is a tall oak right here.
Good, that helps. I do not know your exact spot, but the school is by the river. Do you see water?
I see a little pond, not a river.
That pond is far from the school. You are still far away. Is the sun out?
The sun is bright and high.
The sun shows north. Walk until you find the river. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just learned about the pyramids and I am so excited to tell you!
That sounds like a wonderful discovery! Did you learn how old they are?
Yes, they are thousands of years old, which feels like a long time!
I am glad that surprised you in a good way. Do you know who built them?
I read that workers built them for a king, but I am not sure of his name.
You are right to be unsure about the specific name. Did you look up any pictures of the inside?
I did, and it was very cool to see the stairs!
I am happy you found it interesting. Do you want to hear a fact about the stars?
I would love to, please tell me!
The pyramids were built to line up with the stars.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My cat is hiding under the bed.
That is a good spot to rest. Does she like quiet places?
Yes, she is very shy.
Shy cats need time to feel safe. I do not know why she is hiding today.
Maybe she is scared of the dog.
Dogs can be loud and scary. Is your dog barking right now?
No, the dog is asleep.
Then she is just being careful. You can sit near the bed and wait for her.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a shed in my yard.
That sounds like fun. Do you have any tools ready?
I have a hammer and some wood.
Great start. Are you sure the ground is flat?
The ground looks a bit bumpy.
You need to level it first. Does it slope to one side?
Yes, the left side is lower.
You must fix that before building. Do you know how to dig?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, a blue bird is eating seeds!
What a lovely sight. Do you know what kind of bird it is?
I am so happy to see them here.
It is wonderful that you feel this way.
Yes, my heart feels light and free.
That is a beautiful feeling. I hope you keep smiling today.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a lost dog and took it home.
That is very kind of you. Do you know where it lives?
No, but the tag says Luna.
I do not know the number on the tag. Have you checked the vet’s office?
I did, and they gave me the owner’s phone number.
You did a great job helping. How does Luna look now?
She is eating and happy.
I am glad you found her safe.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to walk more, but my knees hurt.
Try walking on soft grass. Do you have a park near your home?
Yes, there is a big green park close by.
Soft ground is good for bones. How many days a week can you go?
I think I can go three times a week.
That is a good start. Do you like to listen to music while walking?
I do, but I forget my headphones.
You can keep them in your pocket. Are you ready to try this morning?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to catch a big fish, but my line is always too short.
Try using a longer line. Do you use live bait?
I use worms, but they keep falling off.
Tie them tight with a small knot. What kind of rod do you have?
It is a small, bent stick I found.
That sounds hard to control. I do not know what to suggest for that.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I dropped the blue pen. Can you help me find it?
Do you see it on the floor? I will look under the chair.
No. It is not there. Please hurry.
I do not know where it is. Did you drop it here?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw the moon high in the sky today.
That is a nice sight to see. Did you look at it for long?
Yes, I watched it for a bit.
The moon follows the earth all night. Do you like how it looks?
It looked very bright and round.
A round moon is often called a full moon. Is that what you saw?
It might have been, I am not sure.
That is okay. It is a big change from the night before.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I fixed the broken part of my fence today. It took me a long time.
That is good work. Do you like growing flowers there?
Yes, I love the roses there. They are very pretty.
Roses are a nice choice. I hope you enjoy your garden.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to fix the old fence today, but the wood snapped in two.
That is a sad surprise. Do you have a new piece ready?
I found a strong stick in the yard to use as a prop.
A clever and smart idea. Does it stay up well?
The sun is warm and the garden looks nice now.
That is a happy end to your day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Which day comes after Monday?
Tuesday comes next. Do you like Tuesdays?
No, I do not. What comes after Friday?
It is Saturday. Do you play on Saturdays?
Yes, I play all day. What comes after Saturday?
Sunday is the last day. Do you rest on Sundays?
I rest and read. Do you rest on Sundays too?
Yes, I rest too. That is a good way to feel fresh.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
They pull it up through their roots. Do you see the roots?
Yes, I do. Why do they pull it up?
They need water to make food. Do you like making things?
Yes, I do. Do plants eat like me?
Not quite. They make their own food.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does walking help my body?
It makes your heart pump strong. Do you like to play outside?
Does it help my brain too?
Yes, it makes you think clear.
How long should I walk?
Just start with ten minutes. How do your legs feel after that?
Is it safe if I do it every day?
Yes, it is good for you every day.
I think I will try it tomorrow.
That is a great plan.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to walk to stay strong. How do I start?
Start with five minutes a day. Do you have a safe path to walk on?
Yes, I do. What else can I do while I walk?
Try swinging your arms a little. Would you like tips on breathing too?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I love reading in bed at night. Why do I like it so much?
Your brain gets calm and quiet. It helps you sleep better. Do you have a favorite book?
Yes, I like dragons. But sometimes my eyes feel dry.
Dry eyes are common in the dark. Try to blink a lot. Do you use a small light?
I use a lamp. Is that bad for me?
A dim light is fine for most people. Your eyes might rest easier. Do you read for long?
Yes, for one hour. I am tired after.
That is a good thing. Tired eyes mean you are ready to sleep. Do you set an alarm?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky so dark?
It is full of big rain clouds. Are you scared?
The wind is very loud.
Yes, the storm is strong outside. I do not know when it will stop. Do you want to check?
I am just looking at the lights.
That is okay to do. Is it warm in your room?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The moon looks so bright tonight. Why is it so round?
It is round because it is a big ball of rock. Do you like looking up at it?
I do, but why does it change shape?
We see different parts of it as it moves around Earth. That makes it look like a pie slice sometimes.
Does the moon have any friends in the sky?
The stars are always near it, but they are far away. Do you think stars can be lonely?
Maybe. Can people walk on the moon?
Yes, some people walked there long ago. It is a quiet place.
That sounds scary. Is it really dark there at night?
Yes, it gets very dark because there is no air to block the sun. I do not know if it feels cold.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The rain stopped and a big rainbow appeared in the sky.
That is a happy sight. Did you see the red part first?
Yes, it was bright and warm like the sun.
Colors can make us feel good. Do you like the blue part best?
Actually, I loved the purple part the most.
Purple is a lovely color. Was the whole sky clear after that?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy about my new shed.
That is great to hear. What color did you paint it?
I chose a bright red color.
Red is a bold choice. Does it match your garden?
Yes, the green grass makes it pop.
That sounds lovely. Do you have a plan for what to store inside?
I will put my bikes and tools in there.
Perfect use of space. Good luck with the build.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The snow is very cold. How do I stay warm outside?
Wear a hat and thick boots. Do you have a warm coat?
Yes, I do. Why is the snow white?
I am not sure why it is white. Do you like playing in it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to clean my fish tank. How do I do it?
You should scoop out about a fifth of the water with a cup. Do your fish like to swim fast?
Yes, they swim all the time. What else do I need to do?
You must wash the gravel under the water. Do you have a clean bucket for this?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need that song you like.
Is it the one with the drums?
Yes, what is it called?
I think it is Blue Sky. Do you like drums?
No time to talk.
It is on your phone. I do not know the link.
Found it. Thanks.
I am glad you did. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to read this book now. I am so tired.
Reading late can make you sleepy. Do you like this story?
Yes, it is good. My eyes feel heavy.
Your body wants rest. Do you want to try a short break?
No time for breaks. I must finish.
I do not know if your body will agree.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do trees make their own food?
Yes, they use sunlight to make food. Do you know what that process is called?
I am not sure. What is it called?
It is called photosynthesis. Do you like the word?
It sounds tricky. Why do trees grow so tall?
They grow tall to get more light. Do you like looking up?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts a lot today.
That sounds painful. Did you sleep well last night?
I do not want to take medicine.
I do not know what will fix it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my stamp book and I feel very sad.
That is a shame. Do you know where you last used it?
I think I left it on the counter, but I am not sure.
Let us look there first. Have you checked your bag?
No, I did not check the bag.
Please look in the bag now. Is it inside?
No, it is not there. I am getting angry.
I understand your frustration. Shall we ask the staff to help?
Yes, please help me find it.
I will go ask for you. Do you want to wait here?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am on the wrong bus. The sign says we go to the park. I need to go home.
Do not worry. The next stop is your house. Did you buy a ticket?
I do not have a ticket. I am very scared of the driver.
It is fine. He is kind. Are you holding your bag tight?
Yes, I have my bag. But I do not know where to sit.
Pick any open chair. It is a safe place. Are you ready to stay?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a busy bee fly into the garden this morning.
That is a nice sight. Do you know where it was going?
It seemed to want to make something sweet for the hive.
It was likely looking for flowers to drink from.
I read that bees turn that drink into honey.
Yes, they drink the sweet flower juice. How do they keep it?
I think they hide it in little home boxes.
They store the honey in special jars inside.
Now I understand how the sweet food is made.
You learned a new thing today.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a big box full of books. Can you help me sort them?
Yes, I can help. How many books are in the box?
I think there are about ten. Can you put the red ones together?
Sure, let's do that. Do you want the blue ones together too?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to leave, but look at those bright spots up there.
They are stars. Are they shining for you?
They look like tiny lights. Do they blink because of the wind?
No, the wind is too high up to reach them. Do you see the big one?
Yes, that one is very bright. Do they fall down sometimes?
No, they stay in the sky all night long. Go, or you will be late.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I wish it would snow again.
Do you like building snowmen?
Yes, but there is no snow left.
I do not know when more will come.
That makes me sad.
You can still make a snowy day feel warm.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad. My head hurts and my throat itches.
I am sorry you are sick. Rest and drink warm water. Do you have any fever?
I think I do. I am too tired to eat.
That is not good. Please call a doctor if you feel worse.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost. Where should I go?
Is there a tall building you can see?
I only see trees and crowds. I am tired.
Please sit on this bench and rest for a bit. Do you have any water?
I have some cookies. Thank you.
That sounds nice. Where did you get them?
I bought them by the old clock. It is so loud here.
The music stops soon. Let me find you a quiet place.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished my long flight and I feel so happy to be home.
That sounds wonderful. What did you do while up in the air?
I watched three movies and slept most of the way there.
That must have been very restful. Do you plan to take another trip soon?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I plan to give a big gift today.
That sounds fun. Are you happy about it?
I am scared I will forget to do it.
Write a note on your hand to help you.
Will the person like my choice?
I do not know the person, but your care is a good sign.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Today was so good. I made a new friend at work.
That is great news. What did you do together?
We had lunch and talked for a long time. I felt so happy when I got home.
I am glad you enjoyed your day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very hungry but I do not know what to eat.
What do you like to taste today?
I do not know.
Try some soup if you are tired.
That sounds warm.
Do you like hot food or cold food?
I like it hot.
A hot noodle dish is a good choice.
Yes, I will get that.
I hope you enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a sore throat and feel very tired.
I am sorry you do not feel well. Have you been drinking enough water?
I drank some, but my nose is stuffed up too.
That sounds like a cold. Is it hard for you to breathe?
No, I can breathe, but I am confused about what to do next.
You should see a doctor today. Do you have a fever?
I do not know, I have not checked yet.
Please check your temperature. If it is high, tell the doctor.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to dust the shelves?
Dust makes things look gray. Do you like gray?
No, I do not. Why do we mop the floor?
Mop makes the floor clean and dry. Are you hungry?
Yes, a little. Why do we wash the dishes?
Clean dishes help us eat food. Did you have fun cleaning?
Not really. Why do we sweep the floor?
Sweeping takes the trash to one spot.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What is that big bird?
That is a robin. Do you have time to look?
No. Do sparrels build nests here?
Yes, they often do.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What should I eat for breakfast?
I do not know your likes. What do you enjoy most?
I am hungry and tired.
Try some warm toast with butter. It helps you feel awake.
Do I need coffee?
Coffee wakes up your brain. Would you like to try tea instead?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do cows moo?
They moo to talk to their friends. Do you like the sound?
What does a duck say?
Ducks make a quacking noise. Do you know any other birds?
Do pigs have teeth?
Yes, they do. I don't know why they have them.
I like dogs best.
Dogs are very loyal friends. That is nice to hear.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am trying to draw a big red apple, but it looks like a sad potato.
That is tricky. Do you want to try adding a green leaf on top?
I added the leaf, but now my hands are very messy.
Messy hands mean you are having fun. Are you careful to wipe your fingers?
No, I am just going to draw a happy dog next.
A happy dog sounds great. What does your dog look like?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is there a bow in the sky?
Rain and sun make it. Do you like colors?
Yes, I do. Why do the colors sit in a line?
The sun shines through drops of water. Each color bends a little.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The bus is very loud today.
Is the driver honking a lot?
I am lost and need help.
That is scary. Are you holding your ticket?
Where is the stop for my home?
I do not know your home. You can ask the driver.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired of eating the same cold sandwiches every day. It feels like a trap.
That sounds boring. Do you have any favorite foods?
I just want warm soup, but the office is always so busy. It is hard to find time.
I get that. Do you have a break room nearby?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I love peaches. Why do they taste so good?
They have a lot of sweet juice and a soft skin. Do you like them when they are cold?
I do like them cold. Is that why they are so nice?
Cold fruit tastes sweeter to many people. I do not know if that is always true.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the garden and saw my tomatoes turn red. The sun was warm on my face.
That sounds lovely. Do you like to eat them fresh?
Yes, they taste sweet and juicy. I picked three for lunch today.
Great. How are the small carrots growing underneath?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My screen is black and I am late.
Try pressing the power button. Is it making any sound?
It is not on and the light is off.
Check if the cord is in the wall. It may have slipped out.
Oh, yes, it was loose. It works now.
Good, that is good. Do you know why it happened?
I do not know, but I must run now.
Be safe on your way. Do not forget your bag.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you like drawing?
It makes me happy. Do you like art too?
I like building blocks. Why is that fun?
It feels good to make a tall tower.
But why do the blocks stack up?
Gravity pulls them down, but they hold each other.
I never thought about that. Do you build boats?
I mostly build houses.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun is down and there is a fire in the next yard.
Is everyone safe from the smoke?
Yes, but my cat is hiding under the bed.
That is a scary place for a pet.
I tried to find it but it will not come out.
Try calling to it softly.
You are right, I will wait for it now.
I hope it comes out soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the boat moving?
Yes, it goes slowly on the water. Do you like boats?
Can I touch the big net?
No, please do not touch it.
Is the water cold?
It feels cool to the touch. Do you feel cold too?
Can I buy a fish?
I do not know. Do you want to eat fish?
Is the sun bright?
Yes, it shines on the bay.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many months are in a year?
There are twelve months in a year. Do you like winter best?
No, I like summer because it is warm.
Summer is fun for playing outside. How long is summer?
It is three months long.
Yes, it is three hot months. Do you like the snow in winter?
I do not like the cold snow.
That makes sense.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a box with a red bow on it.
That sounds fun. Who is it for?
I think it is for my sister.
Does she like red?
Yes, she loves red things.
I do not know what is inside. Did you look?
No, I cannot open it yet.
Why not?
It is not my birthday.
Good manners.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see big drops on the window.
That is water falling from the clouds. Do you hear the sound?
It makes a loud tap tap tap.
The sound comes from the drops hitting the glass. Are you scared of the noise?
No, I like the sound.
It can feel like a quiet song. Do you want to watch it?
Yes, I want to watch the rain.
Watching is a good way to learn. Stay safe and dry.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know how to solve this math problem.
That is okay. What does the question ask you to do?
It asks me to find the total cost.
You can add the numbers together. Do you have a pencil?
Yes, I have a pencil.
Great. Add the prices step by step.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost trying to learn a new language. Where should I start?
Start with words you see every day. Do you know why you want to learn it?
I just want to talk to friends far away. Do you have a plan for me?
Yes, practice speaking a little bit each day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn to juggle, but I keep dropping the balls.
It takes time to make your hands work together. Do you like catching the ball?
Yes, I like catching, but I am too fast for my own good.
Slow down and count one to three on each throw.
That makes me feel calm and my hands feel steady now.
Great. Keep practicing a little each day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My toy ship sank. Why do boats float but mine did not?
The boat pushes water down, and the water pushes back up to hold it. Did you fill the toy with water?
I did not fill it with water. But it still went under. Why?
If it gets too heavy, the water cannot push it up anymore. Where did you put it?
I put it in the pool. It was just too heavy.
That is why. A full boat weighs more than the water it moves. Does the empty boat float now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I can count to ten, but I am stuck.
That is a great start. Do you like to use your fingers?
Yes, I count on my hands.
Counting on your hands is a good way to learn. How many fingers do you have on one hand?
Five on each hand.
You have ten fingers in total. Do you want to try counting to twenty?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park in March.
March is a nice month for parks. Did you see any flowers?
Yes, I saw a red flower.
That sounds pretty. What was the flower like?
It was small and soft.
It is good that you like it. What did you do next?
I sat on a bench and read a book.
Reading is a calm thing to do. How long did you sit?
I sat for ten minutes.
Ten minutes is a good amount of time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My teacher talks very fast and I miss what he says.
That can be hard. Do you feel okay asking him to slow down?
I am not sure. I might tell you what I am worried about.
I am listening. What is your biggest fear?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big rainbow in the sky. What do I do now?
That is a very happy sight. Do you like the colors?
I think I should take a picture of it.
That is a good idea. Is your camera ready?
I forgot to charge my phone. What is wrong?
Nothing is wrong with you. Have you seen rain before?
No, just this. I feel confused.
It is okay to feel unsure. Would you like to just look up?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the internet work?
It works by sending data through wires and air. Do you like fast news?
Why is it so fast?
It uses very strong signals to move. Do you read books?
Why is there so much of it?
I do not know the total count. It is huge. Do you play games?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like apples but I eat them too fast. What can I do?
Try cutting them into small pieces. Do you like them with milk?
Yes, that sounds good. Do you like apples?
I do, but I only know what humans say.
I will try the small pieces. Do you want some?
No, I cannot eat, but thank you. Do you have a knife?
Yes, I have a safe one. I feel ready now.
That is a good plan. Have fun eating.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My boss yelled at me today. I feel very sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk about it?
Yes, I want to know how to stop crying.
Try to take slow breaths. Did you eat lunch today?
I did not eat lunch. I just want to quit.
It is hard to work when you are hungry. Have you tried eating a small snack?
I will try that. Do you think it will help?
Yes, food can make you feel better. Rest is also good for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to pass my test today. How do I start the car?
You turn the key to start the engine. Are you sitting in the driver's seat?
I think so. Now I have to turn left, but I am scared of hitting the wall.
You must check your mirrors and use your blinker first. Do you see the road behind you?
I see it. The car is moving fast. I need to stop at the line.
Press the brake gently to slow down. I do not know which line to stop at.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My head hurts a lot.
I am sorry you feel bad. Is it a throb or a pinch?
It feels like a throb.
That sounds like a headache. Have you had any water?
I drank some water earlier.
Good, water helps your head. Rest your eyes for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse at the park today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Was it eating grass?
Yes, it ate a lot of green leaves.
Horses love sweet grass. Does it have a long tail?
Yes, it wags its tail really fast.
It must be very happy then. Do you like riding them?
I am too small to ride one yet.
You will grow tall one day. Do you want to touch its nose?
No, I am a little scared of its big feet.
It is okay to be careful. Horses are gentle giants.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I lost my ticket and do not know where to sit.
Do not worry. Please show this ID to the helper. Did you buy it online?
Yes, I bought it on my phone.
That is good. The helper will help you find your seat. What is your train number?
It is 102.
I do not know that number. Please go to the front of the train.
Okay, I will go there.
Good luck. Have a nice trip.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the lake this morning and caught a big blue fish.
That sounds like a wonderful start to the day. Did you keep the fish for dinner?
No, I put it back because I only wanted to play with it.
Good choice to let it swim away free. Do you like throwing your line into the water?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have so much homework and no time.
Take a deep breath and start with the easiest part. What subject is the hardest for you?
Math is a total mess and I am late.
I cannot solve all your problems, but I can help with the next step. Do you want to try the first problem together?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do bees make honey? I need to know for my school project.
Bees drink sweet plant juice and store it in their hives. It dries into thick honey. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I do. Can they eat the honey?
Yes, they eat it to stay warm. I am not sure if they eat it in winter. Is your school project due soon?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I told my friend I would help him build a house, but I forgot.
That feels bad, does it? I know how that feels.
Yes, it feels very bad. What should I do?
You can tell the truth and say sorry. Do you want to try that?
I am scared he will be mad at me.
He might be a little mad, but he will see you care. Have you apologized before?
Yes, but this feels different because I forgot.
It is okay to be scared. Just say you are sorry and mean it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to wash these shirts right now.
Do you have the dirt out of the pockets?
Yes, I checked. How do I start?
Turn the machine on and add soap. Do you know which soap to use?
I am not sure. Which one is best?
Use the light color soap. Is the water cold?
Yes, it is cold. Now what?
Put the shirts in and start it. You are on your way.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I cannot sleep at night.
That is hard. Do you take a nap during the day?
No, I am tired all the time.
Tired bodies still need rest. Have you tried a warm drink before bed?
I drank tea, but it did not help.
Maybe the tea kept you up. Did you drink it very late?
Yes, I drank it right before bed.
Then try stopping tea earlier. It might help you fall asleep.
I will try that tonight.
I hope it works well for you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big rainbow, but I do not know what to do with it.
That is a nice thing to see. Do you want to stand still and look at it?
I think so, but my feet are cold and wet.
Moving helps keep you warm. Would you like to run in the grass?
Yes, I will try to run.
That sounds like fun. Do you see any friends nearby?
I see my dog, but he is sleeping.
Let him rest for a bit. Are you going to watch the sky again?
Yes, I will watch the colors one more time.
You have a good idea. I do not know how long it will last.
I hope it stays a long time.
I hope so too. Is your dog waking up now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can I hit the ball?
Yes, you can try. Do you like playing tennis?
I have a red racket.
That is a nice color. What color is your ball?
I do not have a ball.
I see. Do you want to borrow one from me?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a song in my head that I cannot stop humming.
That sounds like it is stuck. Do you know who wrote it?
I do not know the name or where it came from.
That is a mystery. Do you like how it feels?
It makes me feel calm but a little sad.
Sad songs can be good for us. Do you want to find it?
I am afraid I will forget it if I try too hard.
Trust your memory to hold it tight.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very scared about tomorrow. I do not know what will happen.
That is a big feeling. Do you want to talk about it?
Yes, please. How can I stop the worry?
I do not have a magic fix, but taking slow breaths helps. What makes you feel most scared?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dog is sad and will not eat.
That is very worrying. Is he playing at all?
No, he just lies on the floor.
I do not know for sure. Does he have any fever?
I am not sure how to check.
You can ask a vet. Should I help you find one?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am moving to a new town and I feel lost.
That can feel scary, but most people there are very kind. Do you like quiet spots or busy places?
I like quiet spots, but I also need a place to buy food.
There is a small store near the park that is calm and has good bread. I do not know if it has dairy, so you must check.
I will check the store, but how do people get around there?
You can walk everywhere, or take the small blue bus. It is cheap and runs every hour.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very big and scared inside. I do not know what to do.
That is a hard feeling. Do you have someone safe nearby?
Yes, but I still feel stuck. I want to fix it fast.
Taking slow breaths helps. What is your first small step?
I am not sure. Maybe I just want to stop.
It is okay to pause. Do you feel a little less tight now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is blowing very hard today. What should I do?
Find a safe spot inside to rest. Do you like being outside in the storm?
No, I think I will go inside. Is it safe to go out later?
Yes, the wind will slow down soon. I am not sure exactly when it will stop.
Thank you for telling me the truth. I will wait for it to be calm.
You are welcome. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my red cup and it broke. I felt very sad and scared of making a mess.
I am sorry your cup broke. It is okay to feel sad. Do you like red cups a lot?
Yes, I like them a lot. I did not want to hurt my foot with the glass.
You are being very careful. That is good to keep you safe.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired. The meeting went on and on.
That sounds very long. Did you get to eat lunch?
Yes, but the food was cold. My boss was not happy.
I am sorry about that. Did you do good work?
I think so, but I did not know for sure. It felt hard.
You worked very hard today. Did you get to go home?
Yes, my feet hurt a lot. I want to rest now.
Rest is good for you. I hope you sleep well.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. What is that bug?
It is a ladybug. Do you like red?
I do not have time. What is this other one?
I do not know. It looks like a beetle.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My clock is silent. I think it is broken.
It may just need a new battery. Does it have hands?
Yes, but they stop moving. I am so angry.
That is frustrating. Do you see a small button to open the back?
I cannot find the button. My hands are shaking.
You are doing fine. Is there a thin slot on the side?
There is a slot, but I am tired.
Rest a moment. Do you want to try it together?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have my rod but I do not know where to cast.
Try the end of the pier where the water looks deep. Do you have a favorite bait?
I have worms, but I am afraid the fish will not take them.
Worms are very good for many fish, so do not worry. Have you tried casting there before?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see smoke from the house next door. What should I do?
Call the fire department right away. Is it big or small?
The fire looks small, but it is growing. Should I try to put it out?
Do not go near the fire. It is not safe for you.
I am too scared to help anyone inside. Are they okay?
Only firefighters can help them now. Stay back and wait.
The heat is getting close to my window. Should I close it?
Yes, close the windows tight. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I have called 911. They said help is coming.
That is good work. Stay calm and stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun is so hot today, and I am very thirsty.
That sounds like a tough day. Did you drink some cold water?
I tried, but my drink felt warm and not very good.
Warm drinks can taste bad on a hot day. Do you have any ice?
No ice, but I found a small tree with big leaves.
That is a clever way to stay cool. Do you feel better now?
Yes, the wind is nice, and I feel much happier now.
I am glad the wind helped you out.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel all alone here.
That feels very sad. What are you doing right now?
I am just sitting by the window.
The window can be a quiet place to think. Do you see anything nice outside?
I see a bird flying away.
I do not know where that bird is going.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am so tired. I do not know what to do now.
You worked hard today. Did you drink enough water?
I think so, but I still feel bad. What should I do?
I do not know the best answer. Go home and rest your eyes.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to go to the doctor. It will hurt.
I know it feels scary. Are you afraid of the shot?
Yes. The needle is too sharp.
It only hurts for a tiny second. Do you like ice cream?
I like chocolate ice cream.
Maybe we can get some after. Is your tummy hurting?
A little bit. It feels full.
We will tell the doctor that. Are you ready to go now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a small island and I am so happy to share it with you.
That sounds wonderful. What do you see first when you look out at the sea?
I see blue water and white birds flying low.
How peaceful that must feel. Do you see any trees on the land?
Yes, there are tall green trees and soft sand.
I love how calm it sounds. I do not know if I can go there, but I am glad you found it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake bread.
That sounds like a fun way to spend your day. Do you have an oven at home?
Yes, I do. What do I need to start?
You need flour, water, yeast, and salt. Is that all you have?
I have everything but the yeast.
Yeast makes the dough rise and become fluffy. You can buy it at the store.
How long should I wait for it to grow?
Give it about two hours to double in size. Do you like waiting for things?
I can wait if it turns out well.
I am sure it will taste great. Just follow the steps and you will do fine.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
It feels calm here. Do you like the stillness?
The air feels different. Why is it so still?
There are no loud cars. Do you hear the birds?
I do hear them. Why do they sing?
They like the peace.
I feel happy now. Why did I come here?
You needed to rest. Do you feel better?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a red balloon float away. It was very fast.
That is a fun thing to see. Did it go to the park?
Yes, it went to the park. A dog chased it for a bit.
Dogs love to chase things. Was the dog happy?
The dog looked tired. Then it sat down.
Good for the dog. Do you have any pets?
I have a cat. It likes to sleep all day.
Cats like to nap. Does your cat have a favorite spot?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to snowboard. How do I start?
Put the board on your feet and bend your knees. Do you have thick socks?
Yes, I do. What should I do with my hands?
Hold the poles with a loose grip. Stay low on the mountain. Are you scared of the snow?
A little bit. How do I stop?
Slide your feet sideways to slow down. Practice on a very small hill first. Is your coat warm?
Yes, it is warm. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have fun learning. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The light is not on.
That is a problem. Do you see any smoke?
No smoke at all.
Maybe the lamp is broken. Is the door open?
It is locked tight.
We must be kind to the keeper. Do you know how to call for help?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My nose runs all the time and my head hurts. I feel so yucky and sad about this cold.
I am sorry you feel this way. How many days has your nose been running?
It has been three days and I just want it to stop. Do you know why I feel so tired all the time?
Your body is busy fixing you, so it uses up much of your energy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the big light on top of the tower always on?
It turns on when it gets dark to help boats. Do you like looking at the stars?
I saw a keeper who looks old. Does he live up there?
Yes, he lives in the house inside the tower. Do you think he is lonely?
How does he get up all those stairs?
He just climbs them step by step. Is climbing stairs fun for you?
I want to go there someday. Will the light blink or stay still?
It usually spins around to show a pattern. That is a cool idea.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Does the bear in the story eat the red apple?
Yes, the bear does eat it. Is the bear hungry?
I think so, but I am not sure.
That is a good guess.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hi, is this the bakery? I am so late.
Yes, we have warm bread. Do you like sweet things?
No, just a plain roll. I must run.
Here you go. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I saw bees flying. How do they make honey?
They drink sweet liquid from flowers. Do you have a favorite flower?
I do not know what to do next.
They store that liquid in their bellies. Then they bring it back home to the hive.
What happens after they bring it home?
The bees fan their wings to dry the liquid. Have you ever seen bees fan their wings?
So it turns into thick honey?
Yes, it becomes thick and sweet.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My legs feel like jelly after the long run.
That is a good sign. How many miles did you go?
I walked home very slowly to rest my feet.
Rest is very important. Do you drink enough water?
Yes, I had two big cups of ice water.
That is great for you. Your body will thank you tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a funny mark on the map today.
That is very interesting. What did it look like?
It looked just like a little sleepy cat.
I love cats. Did you draw it?
I drew it with a blue pen.
That sounds like fun.
Then I put the map in my bag.
You keep your things safe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, my bread is getting big and round!
That is wonderful! Is it warm to the touch?
Yes, it feels like a soft pillow.
Oh, nice. Do you know why it grows?
I think it is magic.
It is not magic, but it is close! Tiny bugs eat sugar and make gas.
What kind of bugs?
They are called yeast. Do you like how they work?
I do! Thank you for telling me.
You are welcome. Happy baking!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream on the grass this morning.
That is a very sticky mess. Did you have another scoop?
Yes, but I walked right over a big hole.
Oh no, that looks scary. Was the hole very deep?
It was just a little mud hole, but I fell in.
You are lucky you were safe. How did you feel after that?
I felt a bit sad, but then I saw a nice butterfly.
A butterfly can make a bad day feel better. Did it land on your arm?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind feels very strong today. What should I do?
You should keep your hat on tight. Do you like the cold?
Not really. It makes my eyes hurt.
Try wearing a warm scarf. Is your house warm enough?
I think so. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I catch a raindrop in my hand?
You can try cupping your palms up wide. Do you have a pocket?
No, my hands are empty. What should I do with the water?
You can just let it drip into a flower. Are you happy?
Yes, I like making the plants drink. Is that all I can do?
I think that is all I know for sure. Do you want to make a splash?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go, the wind is loud.
It blows strong today. Are you cold?
No, just busy.
The wind may stop soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I found a box under my bed. Why is it there?
I am not sure where it came from. Did you see anyone leave it?
No one was home. Why did you put it there?
I did not put it there. That is a true mystery. Do you want to look inside?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a nice place for lunch today.
That sounds fun. What did you eat?
I had some warm soup and bread.
Yum. Was it hot outside?
Yes, the sun was very bright.
Good. How was the walk home?
It was long but I liked the trees.
Trees are nice. Did you see any birds?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love painting with bright colors.
That sounds fun. What do you like to paint?
I paint big red suns.
I do not have time for that, but I love the idea. Do you use paper?
Yes, I use big sheets of paper.
That is nice. I am happy for you.
Thanks, I am very glad you listen.
I am here to help. Have fun with your art.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the boat float?
Water pushes up to hold it. Do you like the water?
Yes, I do. Why is the boat hard to move?
It is heavy and the water holds it. Do you pull on it?
I try, but it is hard. Why does it not sink?
It has air inside to stay up. Is it dry inside?
It looks dry. Why does it go fast?
The wind and waves push it along. Do you feel the wind?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to pump air into my tires?
Because soft tires make you slow. Do you like going fast?
Why do the wheels keep spinning when I stop pedaling?
I call that spinning out, but I do not know why exactly. Is it really spinning?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do all bugs have six legs?
Most of them do, but not all. Do you like to look closely at them?
My ant had eight legs.
That sounds very odd for an ant. Are you sure it was just an ant?
It was tiny and black.
I am not sure what that was. Did it look like a spider?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I took a picture of a big red flower today. I am so happy about it.
That sounds lovely. Do you have the photo with you right now?
Yes, I can send it to you to see.
I would love to look at it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I draw a rainbow?
Start with a big arc. Do you like drawing with colors?
Yes, I like colors.
Pick seven colors for the lines. Is yellow your favorite color?
I like red best.
Put red on the outside. Try to make the lines smooth.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I lost my calendar and I do not know what day it is.
That is very bad. Do you know what day it was yesterday?
No. I just know it feels very wrong today.
You can count the days to find out. Do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to count these cups right now.
One, two, three.
That is not enough time.
I am sorry. Can you go slower?
Just tell me the number.
There are five cups.
I am still in a big rush.
Do you need help stacking them?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you think my boss is truly kind?
Yes, she always smiles and helps us. Do you feel happy at work?
Sometimes I feel shy to say thanks.
Just say it with a smile. Do you like her jokes?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just ran and I feel so good!
That is wonderful. How did your legs feel?
They felt strong and fast!
Strong legs are great. Do you run every day?
Yes, I love the fresh air.
I like the air too. What song do you play?
It is a pop song with a beat.
Music helps many runners. Is the beat fast?
Yes, it makes me go faster!
That is smart. Enjoy your happy mood.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say sorry to my friend?
You can say, "I am sorry for what I did." Do you know what you did wrong?
I broke his toy on purpose.
Tell him, "I broke your toy, and I feel bad about it." Was it a big toy?
It was his favorite car.
Say, "I promise to be careful next time." Do you want to help fix it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do bugs have so many legs?
Most bugs have six legs to help them walk fast. Do you like to watch them move?
Is a ladybug a bug?
Yes, a ladybug is a type of bug. It eats bad bugs for the plants.
Can bugs talk to each other?
I do not know how they talk, but they move a lot to share news. Do you think they are telling stories?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I broke my cup by dropping it.
Oh no, are you safe? Do you want a hug?
Yes, I am safe but I feel sad.
It is okay to feel sad. Did you wash your hands?
Yes, I washed my hands right away.
Good job being careful. What will you drink now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a fun thing to learn. Do you like wearing sneakers?
Yes, I love my new red ones.
Great, start by making a big loop with the lace.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Can you tell me about the house with the red roof?
It sits on the hill. Do you like red?
I love it. Who lives there?
An old man with cats. I do not know his name.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need shoes for my running race. The race starts in five minutes.
That is very soon. Do you know what size you wear?
I am in a huge hurry. My feet are a little wide.
Wide feet need a roomy toe box. Do you want black or white?
Just give me the black ones. I have to run now.
Here is the black pair. Please run safe and have fun.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make scrambled eggs?
Crack two eggs into a bowl and stir them. Do you have any milk?
Yes, I do. What do I do next?
Put the eggs in a hot pan and stir slowly. Do you like your eggs soft or hard?
I like them soft. How do I know when they are done?
Take them off the heat while they are still wet. Eat them right away.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. I can not swim. My body feels so heavy in the water.
That feels very hard, does it not? Do you like cold water?
No, I hate it. It is too cold and I feel stuck. I just want to stay on the dry land.
The water is cold, but you are safe if you breathe slow. Do you have a friend to help?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I caught a big fish today and I am so happy.
That is wonderful news. Did you keep the fish or let it go?
I let it swim back into the lake.
The fish is lucky. What kind of fish was it?
It was a silver trout with shiny scales.
That sounds like a great catch.
The water was clear and the sun was warm.
It must have felt like a dream. Do you like fishing in the morning?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dog is very quiet today. He usually barks a lot.
That is different for him. Did he eat his food?
I do not know what is wrong with him.
Check if he looks sad or sick. Is he warm to the touch?
He is lying on the floor. He does not want to move.
Please call the vet. Do you have their number?
I will try to make him walk.
Please do not wait. Is he still awake?
I am scared he is very sick.
Go to the vet now. You are doing the right thing.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do bees make honey?
They gather sweet nectar from flowers. Do you like sweet things?
Please go fast. What happens next?
They dry the nectar with air and fan it with wings. It turns thick and sweet.
I must run. Is that all?
Yes, they store it in small wax cells. Do you have a favorite flower?
No time. I am leaving now.
Okay, run safe. The bees are busy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read my favorite book today while I sat by the window.
That sounds very peaceful. Did the sun shine on you?
Yes, the warm light made the pages feel cozy.
How lovely it must have been.
The main character finally found his lost dog.
I am happy for the character. Did they hug?
They did a big happy hug right there.
That is a sweet ending. Was the book short?
It was not long, but it felt perfect.
A short and happy story is a good gift.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does salt water feel so different from pool water?
Salt makes your body float more easily. Do you like to float?
I do! Why do we feel tired after swimming for a long time?
Your muscles are working hard to keep you moving. Do you drink water when you swim?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The leaves are falling. It makes me feel sad.
That is a natural part of the year. Do you have a favorite leaf color?
Yes, red. I hate seeing them all on the ground.
The tree needs rest to grow strong again. Are you ready for winter?
Not really. I wish summer never ended.
I understand that feeling. Can we go pick some leaves?
No, I just want them to stay on the tree.
Nature follows its own time. Would you like a warm drink?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a photo smaller?
You can use a tool to shrink the size. Do you know where to find such a tool?
Not really, but I can look.
Try the search bar on your screen. Did you try that yet?
Yes, I found a free website.
That is a great start. Just click the file button to begin.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is an island?
An island is land with water all around it. Do you like water?
Yes, I love swimming.
That is great fun. Is the island big or small?
It is very small.
Small islands can be cozy. Do you have a house there?
No, just a tent.
A tent is a good spot to sleep.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big yellow bus coming. Is that the one for school?
Yes, it is. Are you excited to go?
I am a little scared of the stairs. Is it hard to climb them?
It is just two steps. You can do it easily.
Okay, I will try. Do you like riding on buses too?
I do not ride, but I like watching them. Have fun today.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are some stars brighter than others?
Some stars are closer to us, so they look bigger. Do you like the brightest ones?
Yes, I like the big ones.
That is very nice. Do you know the name of a star?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad and my head hurts a lot.
I am sorry you feel that way. Are you drinking enough water?
No, I do not want to drink anything.
Water helps you get better soon. Do you have any soup?
I do not have any soup at all.
That is a shame. Maybe you can rest on the bed now.
I just want to go to school tomorrow.
I am not sure if that is safe yet. Can you feel your fever going down?
Yes, I feel a little warmer.
That is good news. Please take your time to heal.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What time is it?
It is ten o'clock. Are you going to the park?
No, I am going to work. Is it too late?
No, you have ten minutes. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a blue boat in the grass.
Wow, that looks nice. Is it yours?
Yes, I built it with sticks.
That is very clever. Did you put it in the water?
Not yet, I am saving it for tomorrow.
That sounds like a fun plan. Will you bring a friend?
Yes, my brother wants to see it.
I hope you have great fun together.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I use my legs to go fast?
Your feet push the pedals to make the wheels spin. Do you like going fast?
Why are there two wheels on the back?
One wheel stays on the road, and the other helps you steer. Is your bike new?
Why do I wear a helmet on my head?
I do not know for sure, but it helps keep your head safe if you fall. Do you have a helmet?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend.
That is a nice idea. What is the letter about?
I want to tell him I miss him.
Tell him exactly what you feel.
How do I start?
Use a simple word like "Dear."
What do I write next?
Say how you are doing today.
Do I need to end it?
Yes, sign your name at the bottom.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. What time is it?
It is ten past two. Are you going to work?
I need to be there by three. How long do I have?
You have one hour and fifty minutes. Do you know the way?
I think I left my bag at home. I must go back.
That will take ten minutes. Is your house close?
It is right next door. I have to run now.
Good luck with your run.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My head hurts a lot.
I am sorry. Does it hurt when you touch it?
Yes, a little bit.
Maybe you need rest. Do you want a glass of water?
No, I just want to sleep.
That is a good idea. I will leave you alone.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Do bugs have feelings?
Yes, some big bugs can feel pain. Do you like to watch ants?
I hate their feet. Can I squash one?
Please do not hurt them. They help clean our world.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am not sure what time it is.
Look at the clock. What number is the short hand pointing to?
It is pointing to the number three.
That means it is three o'clock. Do you know which hand moves slow?
The little hand moves slow.
Yes, that is correct.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to ride a bike in this loud city.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a helmet ready?
Yes, I have my helmet on.
Good. Look left, then right, then left again before you go. Do you know how to look?
I look left, then right, then left.
Perfect. Ride slow and stay calm. Do you see a calm path over there?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse in the park today.
That sounds like a nice ride. Did you see it eat?
It was eating some green grass on the ground.
Horses love their fresh grass. Do you like riding them?
I do not ride, but I love to pet them.
That is a sweet way to say hello.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I promised to help my mom today. Did I keep it?
That is a good question. Did you finish the work you said you would do?
I did the dishes, but I forgot the plants.
You did the hard part. Do you think she will be angry about the plants?
I think she will be sad, not angry.
Sadness is a big feeling. Would you like to water them now to fix it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
The shops are closed for the night. Do you like the silence?
I think it is scary. Why are there no cars?
Most people go home to sleep. Are you safe here?
I just live down the block. Why does it feel so still?
The air is calm tonight. Do you hear any birds?
No, I hear nothing. Why is the moon so bright?
It is full and clear. Do you see its light?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My fish looks very still. Should I do something?
Is the water clean and warm?
I think so, but I am not sure.
I do not know for sure, but check the filter.
The filter is on. What else can I try?
Does it eat?
It did yesterday. Today it just sits.
Wait and watch closely for now.
Okay. I will sit with it.
That is a good, kind thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am hungry but I do not know what to pick.
That is okay. Do you like warm food?
I think I do, but I am not sure.
Try the soup. It is warm and soft.
The soup sounds nice. I will take it.
Good choice. Can I get you a drink?
Yes, please. I want some water.
Here is your order.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did very well on my test.
That is great to hear. Did you study hard for it?
Yes, I read the book again.
That is a smart way to learn.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do bugs have so many legs?
Most bugs have six legs to help them walk fast. Do you like watching them move?
