What is that big bug on the leaf?
I am not sure what kind it is. Can you tell me its color?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw the greenest apples at the market today.
That sounds very tasty. Did they taste sweet?
Yes, they were sweet and crisp.
I am glad you had fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My head hurts so bad. I do not like this feeling.
I am sorry you feel bad. Is it a dull pain?
Yes, it is dull and heavy. I just want to be in bed.
Resting is good for your brain. Would you like some water?
Maybe. I am a bit grumpy because I cannot play.
Being sick makes us feel grumpy. Do you have any medicine?
I do not know. I have no idea what to take.
That is okay. We can ask a grown up for help.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my grandma, but I do not know what to say.
That is a sweet idea. How does she like to spend her free time?
She likes to bake cookies and tell old stories.
You could tell her you miss her cookies. Would you like help with a nice ending?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That is a great goal. Do you have a friend to help you?
Yes, my new friend Sam is coming over today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Are you excited?
I think I am, but I am a little scared of falling.
It is okay to be scared. You will wear a helmet, right?
Yes, I bought a red one. How do I stop the bike?
You squeeze the levers on the handlebars.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I played three hands of rummy today.
That sounds fun. Did you win?
I won the first hand but lost the next two.
Ouch. Who beat you the second time?
My neighbor did with a very lucky draw.
I know that feels unfair. Did you play again?
No, I stopped because my head hurt.
Good choice to rest your brain.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to save money for a bike.
That is a great goal. Do you have a piggy bank for it?
Yes, but I spend all my coins on candy.
Try to save the coins instead of spending them. What is your favorite treat you could give up?
I like lollipops the most.
Skipping one lollipop a week could help a lot.
I can try that.
That sounds like a smart plan. You will get there.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to buy bread, but I do not know which one to pick.
That is a hard choice. Do you like sweet or salty food?
I think I like sweet, but the cakes look too big.
Cakes are for many people. You can buy a small slice instead.
I do not know if I have enough money for a slice.
A slice is usually cheap. Do you have some coins?
I have a few, but I am still not sure what to do.
I do not know your exact money. Just try the small cake and see if you like it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Did the teacher leave?
I do not know for sure. Is your bag packed?
Yes, it is full. Is she angry?
She looks calm. Why is she waiting?
I forgot my book. Thank you.
Go fast. Be careful.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you know much about the small village?
I know it is quiet and calm. Do you live there?
Yes, I live in the big house by the river.
That sounds like a nice spot. Does the river run fast?
It runs slow and deep most of the time.
Slow water is usually very peaceful. Is it always that way?
Sometimes it gets loud in the summer storms.
Storms can be scary but also exciting. Do you enjoy the sound?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How is the sky?
It is blue and clear. Do you have an umbrella?
No. I need to run.
You are safe then. Are you eating lunch?
Not now. Bye.
Go safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I see a blue bird on the fence. Why is it so blue?
Its feathers are made of tiny parts that catch the light. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, I do. Why is it hopping so fast?
It is hunting for small bugs to eat. Does it look happy?
It looks busy. Why does it sing in the morning?
It sings to tell other birds that this spot is its home. Do you hear other birds too?
I hear one far away. Why do they go away at night?
I am not sure, but they likely feel safer in a quiet place. Do you watch them sleep?
No, I go to bed. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. It is nice to share this view with you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am nervous about my big meeting.
Take a deep breath. Do you have a clear list of topics to talk about?
Yes, but I am worried I will forget things.
Bring a small notebook. Would you like tips on how to stay calm?
I am also afraid of hard questions.
It is okay to say you need time to think. Is there a specific question that scares you?
My boss might ask about our new plan.
Tell the truth simply. Do you understand how the plan works?
Yes, I feel better now.
Good. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to draw big cats in my book.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like drawing lions?
Yes, I am making a lion with a big mane.
A lion with a mane sounds really cool. Do you color it gold?
I am not sure, maybe brown or yellow.
Brown and yellow would look warm and nice. What else do you draw?
I also draw small dogs that like to play.
Dogs and cats are such good friends. Do you have a pet at home?
No, but I am hoping for a puppy soon.
A puppy sounds like a great idea. I hope you get one soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my bread is flat and not big.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you use fresh yeast?
Yes, I did use fresh yeast but it still failed.
That is very frustrating.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Does a cow give us milk?
Yes, cows give milk. Are you going to the store?
No, I am going to the farm. Does a pig have a tail?
Yes, it has a curly tail.
I am very rushed. Do birds have beaks?
Yes, they do. Are they singing?
I must go now. Thanks for the help.
Good luck with your trip.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go, do you know what the surprise is?
I do not know. Are you hiding it somewhere?
No, it is in a box. Where is the box?
It is under the tree. Do you like the tree?
Yes, it is a nice tree.
That is good.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to wear for the cold weather.
A warm coat helps. Do you like blue or red?
I like red, but I also like green leaves in the fall.
Green leaves look nice. I am not sure what looks best with red.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost and I do not know what to do.
Do not worry. Can you see any big signs?
I only see small shops. I feel scared.
Take a deep breath. Is your phone working?
Yes, it works. I do not know where I am.
Let us use the map app. Do you have a place you want to go?
I want to go home. I do not know the way.
We can call a helper. Do you know your address?
Yes, I know my home address.
Great. Let us send a message to a friend to guide you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the best thing for breakfast?
Many people love warm toast with jam. Do you like sweet or salty food?
I am not sure.
That is okay. We can find a good answer together.
Yes, please help me.
Let us start with what you have in your kitchen. Do you have any eggs?
I have eggs and milk.
Great! You can make simple scrambled eggs. Do you know how to do that?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is very cold and windy here. What should I wear to stay warm?
You should wear a thick coat and a warm hat. Do you have gloves on you?
Yes, I have gloves and boots. Is it safe to go outside now?
I do not know the exact weather for your town. Be careful and look at the ground for ice.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I tried to cut the paper but I tore it in half.
That is okay. Did you use sharp scissors?
Yes, but my hands were wet.
Wet hands slip. Wipe them first. How do you hold the scissors?
I put my thumb in the small hole.
That is right. Use your big finger for the long handle.
So I need dry hands and the right finger.
Yes, try again slowly. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am going to the doctor because my tummy hurts.
That sounds uncomfortable. Are you scared?
No, my mom is with me. We ate soup for lunch.
Soup is a nice warm meal. Did you feel better after eating?
Yes, my tummy feels less tight now. I like how sweet it was.
That is good news. Do you like the hospital waiting room?
Not really, but I have a book to read. It has funny dogs in it.
Sounds like a fun distraction.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does a big ship stay on top of the water?
It floats because it pushes the water down. Does that make sense?
I guess so, but why does it not sink?
The water pushes back up to hold it up. Is your boat heavy?
My little boat is light, but the ship is heavy.
A big ship has lots of empty space inside. Do you like swimming?
Yes, I do. So the shape helps it stay up?
Yes, the shape spreads the weight out. Is that clear to you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My plan is gone.
I am sorry. What went wrong?
I lost the map. I do not know where to go.
That is a tough thing. Do you have a phone?
No. I am stuck here. I feel bad.
I do not know the place. Are you safe?
Yes, but I am confused. I need help now.
Let us take one step at a time. Do you see a house?
Yes, a big red one. I think I can walk there.
That is a good plan. Go slow and stay calm.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love working from home because I can wear comfy shoes.
That sounds nice. Do you take many breaks?
Yes, I walk outside to see the sky.
That is a good way to rest. Do you miss talking to people?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now.
That sounds great! Why are you smiling?
My sister gave me a big hug.
Oh, that is very sweet. Did she say anything?
She said I did a good job.
I am glad she is proud of you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love making paper boats. It is so much fun.
That sounds like a happy time. Do they float well?
Yes, they sail on my dad's pool. I felt very proud today.
I am glad you enjoyed it. I do not build boats myself, but I like to read about water.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn French fast. I am in a big rush.
I hear you. Would you like to start with hello?
Yes, but I have to go. Just tell me one word.
Say "bonjour." Do you practice at home?
Maybe later. Thanks for the help.
Good luck on your trip. Is this for school or work?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The snow is very thick. How can I clean my car?
You can use a brush and a shovel. Is it easy for you to lift the snow?
It is heavy. My arms hurt.
Try to rest for a minute. Do you have a friend to help?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am painting a big blue sky.
That sounds fun. What color do you want for the clouds?
I want white clouds.
White is a good choice. Do you like to draw birds too?
Yes, I am drawing a bird.
I do not know if your bird is real, but I love the idea.
It is a made-up bird.
Made-up birds are the best. Do you have a name for it?
Its name is Zoomy.
Zoomy is a great name. Are you happy with your painting?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to bring a big ham for my picnic.
That sounds fun. What color is your blanket?
It is blue. Do you like cheese too?
Yes, I do. Do you have any juice?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to wash these clothes right now, but I forgot the soap.
Did you use warm water? That helps clean them better.
Yes, but I am still in a big hurry. Can you tell me the fast way?
I do not know the magic trick, but cold water is usually faster.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my little blue fish swim in a big circle today.
That sounds like a happy swim. Is it often that active?
Yes, but then it stopped and just floated at the top.
That can be scary to see. Was it breathing fast?
No, it was calm, but I was still a bit worried.
It is good that you stayed calm. Do you know if it ate?
It ate a flake, which made me feel better.
That is a very good sign. I am glad it is okay.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I hear loud thunder outside. How can I keep my house safe?
A storm can break windows and doors. Do you live in a brick house or a wood house?
It is a wood house. What should I do first?
Put boards over the windows if you have them. Have you checked your battery packs yet?
I do not know where the boards are. I also forgot to check the batteries.
That is okay. Go find the boards and check the batteries now. Are you feeling worried about the rain?
Yes, I am scared. The wind is getting very strong.
Stay inside and away from the windows. You are doing a good job staying safe.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My fence broke in the rain. Is it safe to touch?
Yes, it is safe, but please tell a grown-up. Do you like digging in dirt?
I do not know how to fix it. Can you show me?
I cannot see the fence from here. Is it wood or plastic?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited a long time for my tea to cool down.
That must feel slow and hard. Do you like your tea hot?
No, I like it warm. It took me a lot of time.
Patience helps us wait for good things. Was it worth the wait?
Yes, the tea was very good. I felt calm at last.
Calm is a good feeling. Do you take deep breaths when you wait?
Sometimes I do. It helps me stop feeling angry.
Breathing is a great tool. How did the rest of your day go?
It went well. I felt happy and ready.
I am glad your day turned out well.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so tired. My boss gave me too much work.
That sounds very hard. Do you need a break?
I have no time. I must leave right now.
Be safe. I hope you rest well.
Thanks. I am running out the door.
Good luck. Do you have dinner planned?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like to play tennis?
I do not have hands, so I cannot hold a racket. Do you like to hit the ball?
Yes, I hit it hard.
That sounds like fun. Is the ball yellow?
Yes, it is bright yellow.
I am glad you enjoy the game. Do you play with friends?
I play with my dad.
That is a nice way to learn.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sand so warm?
The sun heats it all day long. Do you like lying on it?
Why is the water salty?
I am not entirely sure why it is so. Is the water cold or warm?
Why do waves crash on the shore?
The wind pushes the water to the beach.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am lost on this bus. Where am I going?
You are on the five line. Are you going to the park?
I want to go home, but I do not know the stop.
Get off at the next corner. That is near your street.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: This street is so quiet. It feels a bit scary.
Is it really safe here?
I think so, but the silence is loud. What should I do?
Take a small snack with you. Do you like apples?
I do. But I still feel lonely. How can I feel better?
Say hello to the birds. Do you hear them?
I hear a bird now. It helps a little.
That is a good start.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people drink so much coffee?
I think it wakes them up. Do you like coffee?
I do not like it. Why does tea taste different?
Tea is soft and warm. Is your favorite drink tea?
Yes, I love tea. Why does it smell so good?
I do not know for sure. I love your curiosity.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am trying to fix my bike wheel, but I do not know how.
That sounds tricky. Do you have a tool to loosen the spokes?
No, I only have a small screwdriver.
That may not work. I do not know your exact bike model, so I cannot be sure.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a big red box on stage. Was it a house?
Yes, it was a house. Did you like the color?
It looked very warm. Was the man inside sad?
No, he was happy. Why do you ask?
He was smiling but his eyes looked wet.
I am not sure why his eyes were wet. What did you see?
I saw a small bird land on the window sill.
That bird is a key part of the play. Did you know that?
I did not. What does the bird do later?
The bird flies away at the very end.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love apples. How do I wash them?
You can rub them with water. Do you like the peel?
Yes, I do. How do I cut them?
Use a sharp knife on a safe board. Are you careful?
I am trying. How do I make juice?
Blend the pieces and strain the pulp. I do not know if you will like the taste.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I made soup for dinner.
That sounds yummy. What is in it?
It has carrots and corn. I put in some salt too.
Carrots are good for you. Do you like the smell?
Yes, the kitchen smells very nice. I want you to come eat.
I would love that. Thank you for inviting me.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread is flat and I feel so sad about it.
Oh no, that is hard. Was the room cold?
It was cold, and I think I used too much water.
Too much water can make it thick. Let us try again tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The boat leaves soon. Where is it?
It is right over there. Do you have your ticket?
I am late. Where do I sit?
Look for the blue seats. Is it a big boat?
I must go now. Where is the door?
The door is right there. Good luck on your trip.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know how to start my math book.
That is a big pile. Do you like numbers or shapes more?
I like numbers, but they jump around my head.
Try doing just one page. Do you want to sit with me?
My brain hurts from thinking so hard.
It feels heavy when you push too fast. Would some water help?
I am almost done, but I am not sure if it is right.
Check your work one more time. Do you see any big mistakes?
Yes, I fixed a sign. Thank you for waiting.
You did well. Great job, friend.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the sky is gray.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you see any blue spots?
No, it is all dark and heavy.
That can look scary. What do you like to do when you are sad?
I just want the sun to come back.
The sun is always there, even behind the clouds.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the rain today. My shoes are wet.
I am sorry to hear that. Does the rain make you sad?
Yes, it is noisy and gray. I wanted to play outside.
That is a fair wish. Did you try to listen to the sound?
I did, but I still feel low. It feels endless.
I understand that feeling. Do you have a warm drink nearby?
Maybe, but I prefer the sun. I miss the blue sky.
The sun always comes back. You are not wrong to miss it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind blew my hat off today.
Oh no, that sounds scary. Did you find it?
I found it by the tree.
Good for you. Is the wind warm or cold?
It feels a bit cold.
Yes, wind can be chilly. Do you like the wind?
I like it when it makes leaves dance.
That is a sweet thought. Why do leaves dance?
They spin in the air.
I like that picture too.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does it get cold in winter?
The sun shines on the Earth at a tilt. This makes the days shorter and colder. Do you like snow?
I like it when the leaves turn orange.
That is autumn. The trees drop their leaves to sleep. Do you pick up the leaves?
I want to know when the flowers grow back.
They come back in spring. It is warm and wet again. I do not know which flower is your favorite.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a red door. Is that the bakery?
Yes, it is. Do you like bread?
I want a chocolate cake. Is it sweet?
Yes, it is very sweet. Do you have any cash?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
The birds are sleeping in the trees. Do you hear the wind?
I do not. What else makes it calm?
The houses are still and dark. Are you looking for something?
I just want to know why it is like this.
It is late and everyone is resting. Do you feel peaceful?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I missed the bus this morning.
Oh no, that is tough. Did you run to catch it?
No, it was gone. I had to wait for the next one.
That must be a long wait. Did you read a book?
Yes, I read about cats.
Cool. Do you like cats?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How does a plant drink water?
Roots soak up water from the dirt. Do you see how the dirt looks wet?
I see the wet dirt. Then how does it get to the leaves?
Tiny tubes in the stem push it up. Is that like a straw?
Yes, like a straw! Why does it move up?
The leaves pull the water up to cool down. Do you feel hot when you sweat?
I do! So the plant cools off too?
Yes, the water turns to gas and the plant stays cool. Do you like knowing that?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. What makes you feel this way?
I do not have a good answer.
It is okay not to know. Sometimes just saying it helps. Do you want to talk about what is on your mind?
Maybe I want some advice.
A warm drink or a hug can help. Have you tried drinking warm milk?
No, but I like my friend.
Call your friend. I hope they help you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to study?
We study to learn new things. Do you like reading books?
Why is the school bell so loud?
It is loud so we can hear it from far away.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I had a scary dream and I feel sad. What can I do?
That feels bad. Did you talk to someone you trust?
No, I am alone right now. Do you know how to fix my heart?
I do not know your heart, but deep breaths can help. Do you like warm milk?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know how magnets stick. I am late.
They have two sides. One pulls, one pushes. What are you holding?
Just my keys and this rock. Is the rock a magnet?
No, the rock is not. Only some metals stick. Are you going to the store?
Yes, to buy more magnets. Thanks.
You are welcome. I hope you find them.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today. The grass is very green.
That sounds nice. Do you like to sit on the grass?
Yes, I sat by the big tree. I saw a red bird.
A red bird is fun to see. What did it do?
It flew up and down. I tried to catch a bug, but it ran away.
Bugs can be tricky. Did you find another one?
No, but I drank some cold water. It was so good.
Staying cool is important. You did a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am so nervous. I want to give my friend a surprise.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What kind of surprise is it?
It is a big box. But I do not know where to put it.
Put it behind the door. Will you play hide and seek?
No, we are sitting on the couch. I feel stuck.
That is a hard spot. Do you have a special date for it?
It is next week. I just need a quick idea.
Maybe put a small gift on top. Is your friend home right now?
Yes, they are in the kitchen. I am so scared.
Take a deep breath. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big dinosaur bone. How old is it?
It is very, very old, from a time before people. Do you like the big bones?
Yes, I do. Can I touch the glass case?
No, please do not touch it. We must keep the bones safe. Do you want to see the next room?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel bad and need to go to a doctor, but I do not know what to do.
That sounds tough. Do you have a fever?
I am not sure, so I will call my doctor now.
That is a good start. I hope you feel better soon.
Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Is there anything else you need?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big cloud that looked like a monster today. It made me feel very scared.
That does sound scary. Do you think it was just a shape?
I am not sure. It followed me all the way home.
I do not know if it was real. Did you close your eyes to make it go away?
I tried, but it was still there. My tummy feels tight.
Your body knows you are worried. Does a warm drink help you feel safe?
Sometimes. I just want the fear to stop.
Fear is a small part of you. Do you want to take a slow breath with me?
I am trying. I feel a little better now.
That is good. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see a small bird eating in my yard. What is it?
It looks like a chickadee to me. Do you see black on its head?
Yes, it has a black cap. It hops around a lot.
That fits. They love seeds and insects. Do you have a feeder out?
No, I never put one out. Should I?
Yes, it will help them find food. Do you want to try it?
Yes, that sounds like fun. Where do I start?
Start with black oil sunflower seeds. They love those.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The snow is on the ground. I do not know what to do.
That is a big pile. Do you like cold days?
I think I do. My hands are very cold.
Put on your warm gloves. I will go with you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do players kick the ball into the net?
They kick it to score a point and win the game. Do you like watching the team?
Yes, I do. But why do they run so fast?
Running fast helps them catch the ball before the other team does. Is running hard for you?
A little, but I try. How many people are on one side?
There are eleven people on each team. Do you play soccer with friends?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a new story about a lost dog.
That sounds fun. What did the dog do?
It found its way home by following birds.
Is that a true thing?
It is, well, almost.
I am glad you are happy. Who is in the story with the dog?
Just the dog and the moon.
A nice friend for a dog.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with my new racket.
Do you want to learn how to hit the ball?
I am not sure. I just want to play.
That is good. We can start with gentle hits.
I am worried I will miss the ball.
Missing is part of learning. Have you tried tossing the ball up?
I will try now. Thank you.
You can do it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why did the lights go out?
The storm broke a big wire. Are you safe?
Yes, but it is very dark.
I will check the main fuse. Do you have a candle?
No, I forgot to buy them.
I can bring a flashlight. Is that okay?
Yes, please help me.
I am coming now. Wait for me.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today and saw the sky was very blue. Why is it that color?
The air scatters the blue light from the sun. Do you like looking up at the sky?
Yes, I did sit on the grass and watch the birds for a long time.
That sounds like a nice way to end the day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost on this quiet road. What should I do?
You can just take a walk. Do you like the fresh air?
The air is nice, but I am bored. What is there to see?
Look at the birds in the trees. Are you watching them?
I see a red bird. It looks happy. How do I find my way home?
Follow the big brown fence. Do you know where that goes?
Yes, that leads to my door. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. It was fun talking to you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked by the big blue lake today.
That sounds nice. Did you see any ducks?
Yes, I saw two ducks swimming.
How lovely.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn a song fast. My turn is now.
Take a deep breath and smile. Do you know the words yet?
No, but I have no time to read them.
That is hard. I do not know the answer.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. I just want to throw this bag in the corner.
That is okay. Sometimes packing is hard. What is the first thing you packed?
I am angry. I cannot find my red hat.
We can look together. Did you check the closet?
No, I only checked the shelf. I feel like a fool.
You are not a fool. We will find it. Do you want to sit for a minute?
Yes, I need a break. My hands hurt.
Good. Resting is smart.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My computer screen went dark today.
Oh no, that sounds tricky. Did you try plugging it in?
I did, but the lights stayed off.
Maybe the power cord is loose. Can you check the plug at the wall?
I fixed it and the screen came back on.
That is great news. I am happy it works again.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I win a game of chess?
You must trap the other king so it cannot move. Do you know what that piece looks like?
It is the tall one with the cross on top.
Yes, that is the king. What color are you playing today?
I am playing with the white pieces.
White always goes first. Do you like moving first?
I think it is fun to start the game.
It can be exciting but tricky.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to make a plan for my day.
That sounds good. What do you want to do first?
I want to clean my room.
Great start. Do you have a list of things to do?
No, not yet.
Let us make one together. What is your second task?
I want to read a book.
That is a nice way to relax. Are you done for now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I walked a lot today and feel so good.
That is wonderful to hear. How far did you go?
I went to the park and back.
A walk to the park is a great start. Do you walk there every day?
Yes, I will keep doing it.
Consistency is key to staying healthy.
Thank you for listening to me.
You are very welcome.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad because I miss the sea.
That sounds hard. Do you have a picture of the boat?
Yes, but it makes me feel worse.
I am sorry you feel that way.
Sailors seem so free out there.
They are, but they must be careful. Do you like water?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the moon so round?
It is shaped by gravity, which pulls it into a ball. Do you like looking at it at night?
Yes, it looks like a cookie. Why does it change shape?
It changes because of how the sun lights it up. Do you think it tastes good?
I hope it is sweet. Why is it so bright?
It shines because it reflects the sun's light.
That is cool. Why is the sky dark?
It is dark because the sun is on the other side of the earth. Do you see any stars?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to walk, but I do not know where to start.
Start with a short walk near your home. Do you have a favorite spot nearby?
I just feel too tired to try it.
Rest is good, but a few steps help your heart.
How long should I really walk?
Ten minutes is a great start. How does your body feel after sitting all day?
I think I will try tomorrow.
That is a good plan. I hope you enjoy the fresh air.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hi, quick question. What are mountains?
They are very big hills. Do you like them?
Yes, I do. Are they made of stone?
Yes, the ground is pushed up high.
Great, thanks. I am late.
Okay, run fast. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared of the water.
That is okay. Do you know how to float?
I think I do, but I am not sure.
You can try on a shallow day. Do you have a friend to watch you?
Yes, my brother is there.
Great. Just keep your face near the top.
What if I go under?
Just breathe out. Do you practice that first?
I will try to practice.
Good luck. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a cake for the wedding?
You need sugar, eggs, and flour. Do you have an oven?
Yes, I have one. What do I mix first?
Beat the eggs and sugar until it gets white. How big is the cake?
It is very big. Do I bake it all at once?
I do not know that for sure. Ask the baker to be safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My king is in the corner. I do not know what to do next.
That looks like a dangerous spot. Are your pieces safe?
I think my knight is stuck in the way.
Knights jump over other pieces. Do you see a free square?
I am not sure where it can jump.
Look closely at the board. Is there an enemy piece near you?
Yes, an enemy pawn is close by.
You might be able to take it. Does that feel like a good idea?
I think I will try that move.
Good luck with your game. Have fun playing!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The lights went out this morning.
Oh no, that sounds tricky. Did you find a way to see?
I used a phone for light.
That is a smart idea. What were you doing when it happened?
I was eating toast.
Toast in the dark? That sounds cozy. Did the power come back on?
No, not yet.
I am sorry about that. Do you have batteries for the phone?
Yes, I have plenty.
Good, you are ready. Stay warm and safe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a tiny blue boat in the yard.
That is very nice. Did you find it near the tree?
Yes, it was right under the old oak.
How lucky. Does it float on water?
I tried it in my puddle and it worked.
I am happy for you. I do not know much about boats, but that sounds fun.
I want to give it to my little brother.
He will be so pleased. What color is his favorite?
He likes green things best.
You are a very good friend.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do fish have fins?
Fins help them swim and steer in the water. Do you like to swim?
Why is the water cold in the morning?
The sun has not warmed it up yet, so it stays cool. Do you like cold water?
Why do birds fly over the lake?
I am not sure why those specific birds are there. Do you see fish jumping?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the boat dock fast.
It is right by the big red tree. Are you okay?
Yes, but I am late for work.
The path is clear and safe. Have a good day?
Thanks. Do you know where the water is deep?
I do not know the exact depth. Be careful near the middle.
I will stay close to the edge.
That is a smart choice. Why are you in such a rush?
I must catch the last bus home.
I hope you make it. Drive safely.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go to the city by train.
That is a great idea. Do you have your ticket?
Yes, I do. How long does the ride take?
It takes about two hours. Is that too long for you?
No, it is fine. Where do I sit?
You can sit where the sign says open. Do you want a window seat?
Yes, please. Can I sleep on the train?
Yes, you can sleep. Just keep your bag close.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am scared to drive.
That is normal. Do you feel calm in the car?
No, my hands shake.
Take slow breaths to help. Do you like riding with me?
Yes, but it is hard.
I will practice with you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very sad today and I want to learn to draw a happy sun.
I am sorry you feel down. Would you like to start with the circle?
Yes please, how do I draw the circle?
Hold the pencil like you hold a spoon. Do you have paper ready?
I have paper and I am trying to make the circle round.
Move your wrist, not your arm, for a smooth shape. How does that feel?
It is hard to keep it steady, my hands shake a bit.
That is okay, it takes time. Do you want to try adding rays?
Yes, I will draw lines around the circle.
Great, just make short lines for the light.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I walked for ten minutes today. Is that good for my body?
Yes, that is a great start. Do you like walking outside?
I think so, but my legs hurt a little bit. Why do they hurt?
Your muscles are getting stronger. That is a good thing.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red leaf on the walk home.
A red leaf is a nice find. Did you keep it?
Yes, I put it in my book. It looked so soft.
That is a sweet place for it. Do you read it every day?
Not yet, but I plan to look at it tonight.
That sounds like a cozy start to the evening.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very stiff. How do I move my legs?
You can bend your knees up and down. Do you have some gum to chew?
No, I do not have any. What else can I do?
You can roll your shoulders back and forth. Is your head hurting?
My head hurts a little. How do I stop it?
You should drink some water. Does that sound good?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is so hot outside. I feel bad.
Drink some cold water to help your body. Are you eating fruit?
Yes, I ate a melon. My head still hurts.
Rest in the shade for a bit. Do you have a fan?
No, my fan is broken. I am so tired.
Try to sit near a window for air. I do not know how to fix a fan.
I will try that. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Stay cool and safe today.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no time. What comes after March?
April comes next. Do you like the spring sun?
No. Just tell me the order.
March, April, May. Is that clear enough?
Yes, but what comes after May?
June. Do you want to go outside?
No. Goodbye.
Bye. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the moon change shape every night?
It is just a shadow from the Earth. Do you like watching the sky?
Yes, I do. But why is the shadow moving?
We turn around in space very fast.
Turn around? Like me?
Yes, but much faster. Are you good at spinning?
I spin for fun. Is the moon tired?
It does not get tired. It keeps going.
That is cool. I want to go there one day.
That is a big dream. Have you packed a bag?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My head hurts bad. I must go now.
That is a sad feeling. Do you have any water?
No time. Just tell me what to do.
Drink some water later. Is it a sharp pain?
It throbs. I am late.
I do not know why it hurts. Please rest soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know how to find a map before I leave.
You can type "map" into a search box. Do you know where you are going?
Yes, to the park, but the page is slow.
Slow pages happen when many people use it at once.
Can I see it on my phone?
Yes, if your phone has an internet link.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I failed my math test today. I feel so bad.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you feel nervous while writing it?
Yes, my hands were shaking. I do not like it here.
That sounds very hard. Do you want to try the work again?
I do not know how to fix this. I am tired.
Let us take a rest first.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My next door neighbor yells every night. What can I do?
That sounds very hard. Do you talk to them much?
No, we never speak. I feel too scared.
It is always better to be kind first. Have you tried a small smile?
I tried that once. He looked angry at me.
I am sorry to hear that. Try a polite note instead.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel good about my drawing. But I do not know what to do with it.
That is a good feeling. Do you want to hang it on the wall?
I am not sure. It feels too big for the wall.
I do not know if it will fit. Do you have a different spot in mind?
Maybe I can give it to my friend.
That is a kind idea. I hope they like it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a big cup of coffee this morning. It gave me lots of energy.
That is a good way to start the day. Did you take a break later?
Yes, I stopped for a warm cup of tea in the afternoon. It made me feel calm.
Tea is a nice change from coffee. Was it sweet or plain?
It was just plain. I liked the quiet feeling it gave me.
Simple things can be the best.
I agree with you. I felt very happy at the end of the day.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the internet there?
It is a big web of information. Do you like to draw?
Yes, I love drawing.
You can show your art to friends online. Is that fun?
Yes, it is very fun.
You can share your joy easily. Do you have a cat?
I do not know.
It is okay not to know. Do you like stories?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The rain is falling so hard today.
Yes, it is quite loud. Do you like watching it?
I do not like the loud noise.
That makes sense. Let us stay inside to be safe.
Can we play with water inside?
I am not sure about that. Do you have some toys ready?
Yes, I have my bucket and ducks.
That sounds like a good plan. Can you bring them to me?
I am bringing them right now.
Great, I will help you set them up.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I took the picture, but it is all blurry and I feel so sad.
That is a tricky thing to fix. Do you usually hold the camera with one hand?
Yes, I only have one free hand right now because I am holding my snack.
That makes sense, your other hand might be shaking. Have you tried using a tripod before?
No, I do not own one, so I do not know how to stop the shaking.
I do not know a magic trick to fix that right now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke the cup on the floor.
Oh no. Are you hurt?
No, but I feel sad.
That is okay. You can fix it.
How do I fix it?
We can glue it back. Do you have the glue?
Yes, I found it.
Good job. You did well.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people buy the red apples?
They look sweet and nice to eat. Do you like red apples?
Why is the big man so busy there?
He works hard to sell all his goods. Is he your friend?
Why does the store smell so good?
I do not know the exact reason. Do you know what it smells like?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My head feels like a tight knot. Why does it hurt?
It might be from looking at a screen too long. Are you feeling tired?
I sat at my desk for many hours. Does that make my neck stiff?
Yes, long sitting can cause that ache. Have you had a drink of water?
I drank only coffee. Can dryness make my head hurt?
Yes, the body needs water to feel good. Do you have a towel?
I have a cool cloth. Should I put it on my neck?
Yes, that can help relax the tight muscles.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am not sure what to eat for lunch today.
How about a warm bowl of soup? Are you hungry for something hot?
I like soup, but I am also thinking about a sandwich.
A sandwich is a good choice. Do you have any bread at home?
Yes, I have some bread and some cheese.
That sounds like a tasty snack. You should pack a few snacks too, just in case.
That is a nice idea. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a happy lunchtime.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to tie my shoes but I keep getting it wrong.
That can be hard at first. Do you remember how we made the loops?
I try to make two loops and cross them, but they fall apart.
You are doing great. Have you tried pulling the strings tight after you cross them?
Yes, I pull them hard, but I still do not know what to do next.
Just make one more loop and push it through. Do you like to use your left hand or your right hand for this?
I like to use my left hand. Thanks for helping me.
You are welcome. I am glad I could help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have five minutes to fix a blanket, and I cannot find the red yarn.
Is the red box in the top drawer? I do not know, so I ask you.
No, it is not there, and I am running late for the bus.
It must be near the couch, since you always sit there. Do you see a red pile?
Yes, it is under the cushion, thank you, I must run now.
You are welcome, and I am glad we found it. Have a safe ride.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not feel happy today.
I am sorry you feel sad. What made you feel this way?
I missed my best friend.
Missing someone is hard. Did you send a letter?
No, I was too shy.
That is why it feels heavy. Try to write a small note?
I think I will try.
Good for you. That may help you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to draw big cats.
That sounds fun. Do you have a favorite color for them?
I use a lot of orange and black.
Nice choice. Do you draw them sleeping?
Yes, I like to draw them sleeping.
Good idea. Sleep is good for cats.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My cat is sleeping on my bed.
That is a sweet spot. Does she like to sleep there all day?
Yes, but I want to play with her.
You can wake her up gently. Do you have a favorite toy for her?
I have a red ball, but she does not like it.
She might prefer a feather toy. Do you know where to buy one?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I hit the ball hard but it went into the net. Why does that happen?
That happens when your wrist is not straight. Did you try to hit it from the top?
Yes, I did. It is very hard to control.
That is a good start for you. Do you like to run for the ball?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do robots have wheels?
Wheels help them move fast. Do you like cars?
Yes, I do. Why do they have arms?
Arms help them grab things. Can you pick up a ball?
Yes, I can. Why do some look like people?
It is hard to say for sure. Do you think they feel things?
Maybe. Why do they need batteries?
Batteries give them power to work. Do you have a favorite robot?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a pair of fives. Should I keep them?
That is a good start. Do you have any other good cards?
I also have a ten. I am not sure if that helps.
A ten can help a lot. Keep both cards and play on.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very hungry, but I do not know what to pick from the machine.
That is a hard choice, but maybe a warm soup would help you feel good. Do you like hot food today?
I think I want something with a tomato in it, but I am not sure which one is best.
I do not know what is in the machine right now, so I cannot be true about the taste. Is there a sign on the door?
Yes, there is a picture of a red bowl, and it smells nice and sweet.
If it smells nice, it is likely a good pick, so please try it. I hope you enjoy your time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The wind is loud and scary. How do I keep my windows safe?
Put a towel over the glass to stop it from breaking. Is your house old or new?
It is an old brick house with wooden frames.
Tape the glass in an X shape to hold it together. Do you have tape ready?
Yes, I have tape, but the door is also rattling.
Stand a heavy chair against the door to push it shut. Is the chair heavy enough?
The chair is light, so I will use a bookcase instead.
A bookcase is a good choice for a heavy door. Have you checked the lights?
The lights are on, but I want to know if the storm will stop soon.
I do not know when the rain will stop, but sitting in a warm room helps.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared of the bus ride.
That is okay to feel. What part worries you?
I get sick when it moves.
Sit near the front window. Do you like fresh air?
Yes, the wind feels good.
That will help you feel better.
Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have a nice trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big white horse in the park today.
That sounds like a lovely sight. Did it have a long, soft tail?
Yes, its tail swished back and forth in the wind.
Horses like to run free in open spaces. Did it look happy to be there?
It definitely looked calm and ready to graze.
It is nice to see animals at peace. Do you think it was hungry?
I believe it was, as it was munching on some green grass.
Good for it. I hope it found plenty to eat.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I learned a new song today.
That is great. Do you like it?
Yes, it is very fun to sing.
I am glad you are happy.
It makes me feel light and free.
That sounds lovely. Is it hard to learn?
No, it is easy to follow the tune.
Simple tunes are best.
I want to sing it for my family.
They will be happy to hear you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not know how to read a clock.
The long hand tells you the minutes. Do you see the short hand?
The short hand points to the two.
That means it is two o'clock. What is your favorite time of day?
I like the time when we eat cookies.
That sounds very nice to me.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love reading before bed.
That sounds fun. What book is that?
It is a story about a cat.
How cute. Is the cat happy?
Yes, the cat is very happy.
I am glad to hear that.
My eyes feel tired now.
You should rest soon.
Okay, good night.
Good night and sweet dreams.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My phone fell in the soup.
Oh no, that is scary. Did you lose it?
No, I got it out fast. It is wet now.
Good thing you caught it. Do you know how to dry it?
I put it in a bag of rice.
That is a smart fix. Is the soup still good?
No, I had to throw it away.
Sad about the food, but safe is best. Is your phone working now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I count up to twenty?
You start at one and add one each time. Do you know the numbers one to ten?
Yes, I know them well.
Great. You just keep going after ten until you reach twenty. Can you count the steps on your way?
I can try that.
That is a good plan. Take your time and have fun.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very tired today.
Tea has a gentle energy. Coffee has a sudden boost. Which do you prefer?
I like the steady calm of tea.
That is a wise choice. Do you use sugar with it?
No, I only drink it plain.
That lets you taste the true flavor. You will feel good.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I can’t find my red bike. Where should I look?
Check the garage first. Do you have a bike with a bell?
I think it does. What should I do if it is not in the garage?
Look under the tree in the yard. Have you checked the shed?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My feet hurt so much from sitting in that chair.
That sounds like a very bad thing. Do you have any socks to change into?
I lost my headphones and now my ears ring.
I am sorry to hear that. I do not know how to fix your ears, but I can help with the noise.
The food on the plane tasted like old dirt.
Yuck, that is a very sad way to eat. Did you have any of the fruit cups?
I am so tired and my back hurts bad.
Rest is the best medicine right now. Are you ready to go to your bed?
I just want my quiet room back, please.
Your room is waiting for you right there. I hope you sleep well soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My feet hurt from sitting so long.
Ouch, that is hard. Do you have your snack with you?
Yes, I have a cookie.
That sounds tasty. I do not know if cookies fix tired legs, but they taste good.
The plane went very high.
It flew to the clouds. Did you see the ocean below?
No, it was all white.
That is a big cloud. I am glad you are safe up there.
I want to go home now.
We are getting close. Does your tummy feel ready for the gate?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did people build big stone walls long ago?
They built walls to keep bad guys out. Do you like building things?
I do. Why did people not use computers back then?
They did not have them yet.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a box with no tag. Is it for me?
That is a good question. Do you like it?
It feels heavy inside. Can I look?
Yes, please open it. What color is it?
It is a red bike!
I am so happy you liked it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the dark coming on?
The wires outside are broken. Are you safe in your room?
Do we have to wait a long time?
I do not know how long it will take. Can you see the moon?
I do not like the dark.
It will be okay soon. Do you want to talk to me?
Yes, please stay with me.
I am here with you. Let us wait together.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today! Look at this red rose in my hand.
That is a lovely flower. What makes you feel so good?
The sun is warm and the air smells sweet. I want to give this rose to someone I love.
That is a kind gift. Will you tell them why you picked this one?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to build my new shed today.
That sounds like hard work. Did you finish it?
I got the walls up, but the roof is stuck.
Stuck how? Is it too heavy to lift?
Yes, the wood is very heavy and my arms hurt.
That is why it is hard. Did you get help from a friend?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the water going to wash me away?
No, the water is too slow to hurt you. Do you see the big rocks?
The rocks are wet and slippery.
Yes, they get wet when it rains. Do you like fish?
I see a fish! It is so fast!
That is a nice catch of the eye. Do you want to see more?
Can we stay here for a while?
We can sit and watch the water. Do you have a snack?
I have an apple.
Apples taste sweet and crisp. Do you want to share?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Which movie should I watch tonight?
Do you want a happy story or a scary one?
I want something fun and bright.
How about a cartoon with dancing animals?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a big bowl of soup for lunch today.
That sounds warm and cozy. Do you like eating hot food?
Yes, it made my tummy feel full.
Good. I am happy you are well fed.
I also had some fresh fruit later.
Fruit is sweet and good for you. Which kind did you pick?
I chose a red apple. It was crisp and cool.
A red apple is a classic choice. I do not know if you have any left, but they are always tasty.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad looking up at the big dark sky.
Why does the dark sky make you feel sad?
It feels too big and I feel all alone.
I do not know exactly why you feel that way. Do you see any bright stars?
Yes, one near the moon looks very bright.
That bright star is just a far away sun. Do you like looking at it?
It makes me feel a bit better now.
I am glad the view helped you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why is my bread puffy?
The yeast makes gas. Is it warm in your kitchen?
Yes, it is hot. Can I skip the wait?
No, that would ruin it. Do you like sweet or salty bread?
Sweet. But I must go now.
Baking needs time. You must wait for the air to grow.
I understand. The air makes it big.
Exactly. Enjoy your tasty snack. Do you love baking?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went for a walk in the park today. The sun was bright and the grass was soft. I saw a red squirrel jump across the path.
That sounds like a lovely day. Did you see any other animals?
Yes, I saw ducks swimming in the pond. I also found a big, brown leaf on the ground.
A big leaf is a great find. Did you keep it to take home?
I left it there because the wind might blow it away. I just watched the clouds float by.
Watching the clouds is very peaceful. I am glad you enjoyed your walk.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I failed the test and feel like I am broken.
You are not broken, only tired. Did you try to eat something warm?
How do I start again when I am so sad?
Take one small step, like opening the book. Do you like reading stories?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to play the card game war.
That is a very simple game. Do you have a deck of cards?
Yes, I have a full deck here.
Great. You must shuffle them and deal every card to you and your friend.
So we just put our cards down to see who wins?
Yes, you flip one card at a time face up. Do you know how to count to ten?
I can count to ten, but how do we decide the winner?
The person with the higher number takes both cards. Does that make sense to you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to float on my back.
That is fun. Do you like the water?
Yes, but I feel scared of the deep part.
Take a deep breath. Try it in the shallow end first.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a pancake?
You mix flour, milk, and eggs in a bowl. Do you have a pan at home?
I have a pan, but I am not sure what to do next.
Heat the pan, pour in some batter, and wait for bubbles. Do you like them sweet or plain?
I like them sweet, but I forgot the syrup.
You can use honey or jam on top. How many pancakes did you want to make?
Just one for me, that is enough.
That is a perfect plan for a small breakfast. Enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big boat on the lake.
That is a nice boat. Did it look fast?
Yes, it went very fast!
That sounds like fun.
Do boats swim in the water?
No, boats float on top of the water.
What is under the water?
There are fish and plants under there.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see a sparrow in my tree. How can I make a nest for it?
You can buy a small basket and hang it up. Do you have any string?
Yes, I have some. How do I put the basket in the tree?
Tie the string to a sturdy branch. Is the branch thick enough to hold it?
It is a thick branch. Should I put food in the nest?
I do not know if that is safe. But you can try putting seed nearby on the ground.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a box with no holes.
That sounds tricky. What is inside the box?
It is heavy and cold.
Cold and heavy things can be tricky. Is it made of metal?
No, it is not metal.
I do not know what it is then. Is it something you found?
I found it in the snow.
Snow keeps things very cold. Do you wear gloves?
Yes, I have them on.
Good idea to keep your hands warm. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to go to the doctor.
It is okay to feel sad. Are you afraid of the needles?
Yes, they hurt a lot.
They can feel like a quick pinch. Would you like to play a game first?
What game?
We can count to five with our fingers. Do you like counting?
Yes, I like counting.
Great. Let us start with one.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: There is a small bird in my tree. What should I do?
That sounds fun. Does it have a bright red head?
Yes, it does. Is it a cardinals?
It sounds like a cardinal. Do you see any birds like it in the sky?
No, just this one. How can I help it?
You can offer it some water. Does it look happy or scared?
It looks a bit scared. Why is it in my yard?
It may be looking for food. Is it near your kitchen window?
Yes, it is right outside. What else can I do?
Give it space and be quiet. Do you have any bird seed?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the rain. It ruins my day.
That is very sad to hear. Do you have a red umbrella?
No, I do not. I am all wet and cold.
Oh dear, that feels bad. Please go inside and warm up.
I just want the sun back.
I hope the sun comes out soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to keep more money, but I buy too many sweet things.
Try giving yourself a small amount to spend. Do you like chocolate best?
Yes, I love candy. What should I do?
Put money in a jar first, then spend the rest. Is your jar full yet?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot find my shoes and I am very sad.
Let us look together. Are they under the bed?
No, they are not there. I want to go now.
We can look in the closet next. Do you like blue or red?
I do not care about colors. I am late.
I am sorry. Let us check the door last.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
Bees drink sweet plant nectar and store it in their bodies. Do you like sweet things?
I want to make it myself at home.
You cannot make it without bees, but you can grow flowers for them. Do you have a garden?
Can I bottle it like jam?
Yes, you can jar it, but you must let the bees finish it first. Do you have any jars ready?
Okay, I will wait for the bees.
That is the only way. Be patient and kind to them.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad about the old wars. Why did people fight so much?
It is very sad that people hurt each other. Do you think we can do better now?
I just wish it had not happened. It feels so heavy in my heart.
It is okay to feel sad about hard things. You are being kind by caring about it.
Did everyone hate each other back then? I feel like the past is a bad place.
No, not everyone hated each other. Some people tried to help their neighbors.
That makes me feel a little less alone. Do we remember all the bad parts?
We remember the bad parts so we do not repeat them. Do you like learning new stories?
Yes, I think I do. Thank you for helping me feel okay.
I am happy I could help. Let us look at the bright parts of history next time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My bread is flat and dry. What should I do?
Add more water to the dough. Do you use warm water?
Yes, I do use warm water.
Try adding a bit of oil. Do you like sweet bread?
I do not like it sweet.
Then use no sugar. Is your kitchen warm?
It is quite cold today.
Put the dough near a warm spot. Do you watch it rise?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost. What do I do with the dough?
Just wait for it to get big. Is it warm in your kitchen?
It is warm, but it looks wet. Should I add more flour?
Yes, add a little more. Does it feel sticky to your touch?
It feels dry now. What is the next step?
I do not know your exact recipe, but usually you bake it. Do you have an oven ready?
My oven is hot. How long do I leave it in?
Try twenty minutes. Is the house smelling sweet?
It smells good. I think it is almost done.
That is a great sign. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost the ball in the mud this morning.
Oh no, that is sticky. Was it your red ball?
Yes, I found it, but my shoes are dirty.
I am sorry about your shoes. Do you want to play later?
Maybe, if I can clean them first.
That sounds like a good plan. Can you wash them at the sink?
Yes, but my dad is busy right now.
That is okay. Maybe you can ask him later.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I had a scary dream about a big shadow. Was it real?
No, dreams are just your brain playing. Did you feel safe waking up?
Yes, but the shadow looked so dark. How do I stop it?
I do not know why that dream came. Do you like warm blankets at night?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to fix this clock.
Do not worry, I can help you. Are you trying to make it tick?
Yes, it is very quiet right now.
You should try adding a new battery. Does it have a back cover?
I found the cover, but I am stuck on the switch.
Let us look at the small red line together. Is the switch open or closed?
It is open, so I will push it down.
Good, that should start the gears moving. Do you hear a soft click?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do some flowers smell nice and others do not?
They smell good to get bees to help them grow. Do you like the smell of roses?
I think tulips are my favorite.
Tulips are very pretty and come in many colors. Do you have any in your garden?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do we say please and thank you?
It shows we care for others. Do you like making people happy?
Yes, I like it. But what if someone is busy?
You still speak kindly. Are you always patient?
I try to be. What else is good?
We listen well when others talk. Do you like listening?
I do. What is the last rule?
We are always true and kind. Do you feel good now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry to hear that. What made you feel this way?
I lost my favorite blue crayon.
That is a nice, bright color to lose. Did you check under your bed?
No, I only looked on the desk.
Beds are good places for things to hide. You might find it later.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I have a bad cold and my head hurts a lot.
You should drink warm water and rest. Do you have a blanket at home?
Yes, I have a warm blanket ready.
That is good. Is your nose running badly today?
Yes, it is. How can I stop the sneezing?
Blow your nose often and keep your hands clean.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My dog is hiding under the bed and will not come out. I feel sad that he is so scared.
That is a tough spot to be in. What made him hide?
I tried to give him a treat, but he just looked at me with wide eyes. I do not know why he is acting this way.
He might be feeling very tense right now. Is the house loud today?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I am moving to a new home tomorrow.
That is exciting! Do you have a bed already?
Yes, I packed it last night. It feels light.
Good job. Do you know where you will live?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I hit the ball?
You swing the racket when the ball gets close. Do you have a racket?
Yes, I do.
Great. Stand with your feet apart. Do you know how to hold it?
I hold it like a hammer.
That is close enough to start. Do you play outside?
Yes, at the park.
That sounds fun. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found these flowers, but I do not know what to do with them.
That is a nice find. Do you want to put them in water?
I am not sure if they will stay fresh.
Water helps them stay happy. Do you have a glass?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How many fingers do I have?
You have ten fingers in total. Do you know how to count them?
Yes, one, two, three, four.
Great job! Can you count up to five?
Five! I am so fast.
That is correct and very quick. What number comes after five?
Six! I know that one.
You are right about six.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a big magnet at the park today. It stuck to a rusty fence.
That is a fun find. Did it pull any other metal things?
Yes, it grabbed my spoon and my keys. They were very loud.
That must have been a surprise. Do you keep magnets for games?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the pool. Can you swim fast?
I do not swim, but I can tell you how. Do you know how to kick?
Yes, I kick like a frog. I have no time to wait.
Good. Kick hard and breathe out under the water. Are you scared of the deep end?
No. I just need the key. Where is it?
I do not know. Did you leave it on the counter?
No, I lost it. This is bad.
Check your pockets. Is it in your left pocket?
No. I am late. Please help me.
I am sorry. I cannot make the key appear. Have you tried the back door?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big blue boat today. It was so fast!
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you see it on the river?
No, it was on the wide lake. The water looked so cold.
Boats look nice on cold water. Do you like being near water?
Yes, I love the sound the water makes. It goes splash.
That is a nice sound. Do you want to visit the lake?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What song starts with "Let It Go"?
That is a song from the movie Frozen. Do you like snow?
Yes, I love the cold. Is it a happy song?
It starts sad but ends strong. Do you sing along?
I sing it loud! Who wrote the words?
I do not know the exact writer. Do you have a favorite part?
I love the ending. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I am glad you enjoyed it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to pack the car for the baby. Do you have a spare size one hat?
I have a red one, but I do not know if it fits. Does the baby have a big head?
No, just a standard fit. I am running late to the hospital.
Here is the hat. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because my neighbor waved at me.
That is a very nice thing. Did they say hello?
Yes, they smiled and said good morning. It made my heart feel warm.
Smiles are free gifts. Do you talk to them often?
Not much, but I want to say hi again tomorrow. I feel good about it.
Kindness is a great start.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do fish sleep?
Yes, many fish sleep at the bottom of the sea. Do you like drawing fish?
The water is so blue.
The blue comes from the sky and the water. Is it deep where you live?
Can we see sharks?
We can, but we must be careful. Do sharks bite people?
I saw a crab once.
Crabs are very cute and small. Did it walk sideways?
Does the sea hurt?
Sometimes big waves can be strong and scary. Do you like waves?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the bus. Where is the stop?
It is right down that path. Is it a big blue bus?
Yes, it is blue. Please show me the way.
Go straight and then turn left. Do you have enough time?
I think so. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Run fast and be safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do next.
That is a hard thing to feel. What makes you feel stuck?
I tried hard but it did not work.
You can try again in a new way.
Will it work this time?
I do not know for sure, but you will learn more. Do you want to take a small step?
Okay, I will just start small.
That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel lonely working from home. How do you stay happy?
It is hard to stay happy alone. Do you talk to friends often?
I talk to my sister, but I miss my old friends.
That is true. Try calling a friend this week.
I will try that, but I get tired in the afternoon.
Rest is good. Do you take walks?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I wash my socks without making a big mess?
Just put them in the machine with your other clothes. Do you like using soap?
I usually use a little soap, but the water gets very soapy.
Use less soap next time to stop the bubbles. Are your socks dirty with mud?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy a toy for my friend.
That is a sweet idea. What does your friend like to play?
He loves cars and trucks.
A truck might be perfect. Does he like big toys or small ones?
He has a small room, so I need something small.
A tiny remote car would fit well. Do you know how much you can spend?
I have ten dollars.
You can likely find a nice small car. Good luck!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The water looks calm. Can I swim?
It is safe, but check for signs. Do you see any flags?
I see red flags. What do they mean?
Red means no swimming. Please stay on the land. Is that clear?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do I have a meeting today?
Yes, you do. What is it for?
I do not know.
It is about your school.
Is it fun?
I am not sure. Do you want to go?
Maybe.
Great. We will see soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a magnet stick to a wall?
You can use a small piece of steel to help it hold. Do you have any steel handy?
What if I do not have any steel?
You can try a strong paper clip instead. Is the wall metal?
Yes, it is a metal box.
That works well for a magnet. Where will you put it?
I want to put my book there.
Be careful not to let the book fall. How big is the book?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a great place to eat!
That is good to hear. What do you like about it?
The food is very sweet and warm.
Sweet food sounds nice. Is it busy there?
Yes, but they are very kind to us.
Kind staff is important. How much does it cost?
It is not very expensive at all.
That is true and good. Do you want to go back?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I love how this song makes me feel happy.
It uses bright sounds to lift your spirit. Do you hum along?
Yes, I do. Why does it sound so sweet?
It mixes high notes with a gentle beat. It feels like a warm hug.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. My shoes are not on.
Don't worry. Do you have your bag?
I forgot my book at home.
That is a problem. Can you run?
I am running right now.
You can go. Is the door open?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a red shape. It is not a circle. What should I do with it?
That is a good question. Do you see any corners on it?
Yes, I see four corners. It looks like a box.
Then it is a square. Does it fit inside the blue square?
No, the blue one is too small. I am stuck.
Try turning the red shape around. Do its edges match the blue one now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. The wave took my new hat.
That feels bad. Did you try to hold on tight?
Yes, but it was too strong. I think I lost it.
I am sorry you lost it. Do you want to walk along the shore to look?
Maybe, but it is getting dark. I am tired.
Then let us rest on the sand. It is okay to be sad.
Thank you. Your voice is very warm.
I am happy to help. Would you like to talk about the sea?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling. I feel bad now.
That is a very common dream. Does falling make you worry about real life?
I am not sure what it means. I just felt very cold.
Cold can mean you feel alone. Do you like being by yourself?
I do not know why I dreamed that. Please tell me what I should do.
I do not know the exact reason for your dream. Take a deep breath and drink some warm water.
Okay. I will try to rest now.
That is a good plan. Do you have a soft toy to hug?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to kick the ball very hard.
That is fun. Do you like to play with friends?
Yes, I play at the park.
Great. What is your favorite team?
I do not know the names.
That is okay. Do you just love the game?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the big building with many shelves today.
That sounds like a great place to read. Did you find a book you liked?
I picked up a book about a blue bird.
A blue bird is a nice choice. Does the bird fly in the story?
The bird gets lost in the dark woods.
That sounds a bit scary. Does the bird find a friend?
The bird stays alone but waits for the sun.
Waiting for the sun is a patient thing to do.
Then the sun came up and the bird was happy.
That is a happy ending. You had a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The wind took my red hat and I cannot find it.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you see any red on the ground?
No, the grass is too green. I feel very cold without my hat.
Let us look near the big tree. Do you want to hold my hand?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at my new toy dog.
It is a cute dog. Do you like brown toys?
Yes, I love the soft fur.
That is nice. Do you play with it every day?
Yes, I bring it to bed at night.
I am glad you like your gift.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: Why do the trees lose their leaves?
The trees sleep in the cold. Do you like playing in the dirt?
I do, but I do not know what to do with all of them.
You can make a big pile to jump in. Is that fun for you?
Yes, that sounds great, but I am still not sure how to start.
Just pick up one leaf first.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because we missed the big dinosaur show.
Oh no, that is tricky to fix. Did you check the map?
The map said it was open until two.
But look, the sign says it closed early today.
Why would they close it so soon?
I do not know the reason. Are you tired from walking?
I want to see the bones.
Let us ask the front desk if there is a fix.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad about the meeting.
Why do you feel bad?
I forgot to talk about the big red book.
That is a small miss. I am glad you told me.
I think I looked stupid.
I do not know what you looked like. Did you have a good time?
No, not really.
Let us drink some water together.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn to paint, but I am so afraid I will make a mess.
That is a scary feeling, but you can use old clothes. Do you have a brush?
Yes, I have a big brush and some tubes of color.
Great. Start with big shapes first. What colors do you like best?
I like blue and green. I just do not know how to mix them.
You can mix them to make green. Try it on a scrap of paper.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My shirt has a red stain, and I am so mad at it.
Oh no, that is tricky. Did you try the cold water trick?
I did, but the red mark is still there. I want to throw it away.
Please do not throw it away yet. Do you have any soap that smells like lemons?
Yes, I have some lemon soap in the drawer.
Great, use that on the spot. Do you know where the soap drawer is?
It is right there, but I am still mad at the shirt.
It is okay to be mad. Try the soap one more time for me?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to ride my bike, but I fell down.
That must have hurt. Did you get up right away?
Yes, I checked my knee and tried one more time.
I am glad you did not give up. Your heart feels strong now?
I am a little sad, but I feel proud too.
Feeling proud is good. Tell me more about how you feel.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a birthday cake, but I do not know how.
You need flour, sugar, and eggs. Do you have any baking tools?
Yes, I have bowls and spoons. What do I do first?
Mix the dry things, then add the wet ones. Are your eggs fresh?
Yes, they are. How do I get it done?
Put it in a hot oven for twenty minutes. I hope you have fun!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go right now. The line is too long. I am so mad.
Taking a deep breath helps slow your heart down. Do you like taking deep breaths?
I do not have time for breaths. Just make me faster, please.
