I cannot make you go faster, but I can wait with you. Are you happy to sit with me?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am trying to say hello in Spanish but I keep messing up the word.
That is tricky, but you are doing a great job. What sound is the hardest for you?
The R sound is very hard. It feels like my tongue is busy.
Rolling the tongue takes time, so be patient with yourself. Do you practice every day?
Yes, I practice at home with my mirror. Sometimes my tongue gets tired.
Looking in a mirror is a smart way to learn. Keep going, you will get it soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people like to sing?
Singing feels good because it is fun. Do you like singing?
I want to learn, but I am shy. Why should I try?
You can practice alone first. Is your voice a loud one or a soft one?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I have to go to the doctor today?
Your body feels warm and tired. Does your head hurt too?
I do not think it hurts, but my throat is scratchy.
That can make you feel sick. Have you been drinking enough water?
I had a little water yesterday morning.
Please drink more water to help you feel better. Do you have any medicine?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the big park today.
That sounds like fun. Did you see any dogs?
Yes, a small brown one was very happy.
Good dogs make nice friends. What else did you find?
I sat on a bench and watched the leaves fall.
That looks very pretty. Did you bring a snack?
I had an apple and some crackers.
Yum. It is nice you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting so long.
That sounds tough. Are your feet still okay?
The movie on the screen is very boring.
I am sorry it is dull. Do you want a story instead?
My tummy is empty from the snacks.
I do not know when food comes next.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I brush a horse without it kicking me?
That is a smart question. Do you trust the horse with your hands?
I think so, but I am a little scared.
Start by petting its neck slowly. Keep your eyes soft and look at the horse.
What if it moves away from me?
Just step back and wait for it to come closer. Do you like to watch birds for tips?
I do, they seem very calm.
Horses are like that too. Take your time and stay gentle.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read my favorite book about a brave dragon today.
That sounds like a very fun story. Did the dragon fly very high?
Yes, he flew over the big green hill.
I do not know if that hill is near you, but it sounds safe. How was the weather?
It was sunny and warm outside.
A perfect day for reading. Do you like the end of the book?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red boat today.
That sounds fun. Where did you see it?
It was sitting in the small bay.
A small bay is nice. Did you look inside?
I just watched the water move against it.
The water always moves. Do you like boats?
Yes, they look like happy ducks.
You have a kind heart.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw my grandpa today and he was smiling.
That is wonderful to hear. Did you spend a lot of time together?
We talked about old days and shared some cookies.
Sounds like a sweet moment.
I feel really happy and wanted to tell you.
I am glad you feel that way.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the hand on the clock move?
A battery or battery gives it power to turn. Do you want to know how it counts time?
How does it count the hours?
The short hand moves once every twelve hours. It is very slow.
Why does the long hand go around so fast?
The long hand makes one full turn in sixty minutes. Do you like watching it spin?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a shed. What do I need first?
You need a plan and some wood. Do you have a good spot in your yard?
Yes, it is flat. How do I start the floor?
You must lay down gravel for a firm base. Do you have a shovel to dig?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling. I want to learn how to jump high.
Jumping high is fun. Do you have a trampoline?
No, just the floor. Can you show me how?
I cannot see you, so I do not know your body type. Do you feel safe on the ground?
Yes. How do I start?
Bend your knees and swing your arms. Do you want to try it now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I hold the camera, but I do not know what to click on.
Try pointing it at a bright red apple first. Do you have any food nearby?
I have an apple, but my hands are shaking.
Rest your elbows on a table to stop the shake. Is your battery full?
The battery is low, and the picture looks blurry.
Change the battery before you take more pictures. Does the screen look clear now?
I changed it, but I still feel lost.
Just take one photo of your own hand to test it. How does that feel?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am on a train but I do not know where it goes.
That sounds a bit confusing. Do you have a ticket?
Yes, I have a ticket, but the map is blurry.
You can check the screen above your seat. Does it show the next stop?
The screen is dark and I do not know how to wake it up.
I do not know your exact train model. Can you try pressing the side button?
I pressed it, but nothing happened and I feel lost.
Please ask a staff member for help. Do you see any person in a uniform?
Yes, a man in a red hat is walking down the aisle.
He looks helpful, so go ask him now. Is he coming toward you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad. My plan is a mess.
I am sorry to hear that. What part is hardest?
I do not know where to start.
Let us pick one small step first.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Today was so hard and I feel very tired.
That sounds like a heavy load to carry. Did you get a break to rest?
I am stuck and do not know what to do next.
Try one small step first to see if it helps. What is the very first thing you can do?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late.
Is the car in sight?
I think so.
It looks empty and calm. Do you hear a sound?
Yes, I do.
It is a quiet street. Are you safe?
Yes, I am going.
Run fast and be careful.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the big market today and it was so much fun.
That sounds like a great place to play. Did you see any cute animals there?
Yes, I saw a dog and a cat. I also bought some sweet fruit.
Sweet fruit sounds tasty. Did you eat it all at home?
I shared it with my sister and we were very happy.
Sharing is a kind thing to do. I am glad you had a good day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The flight is so long. How do you stay awake?
I drink water and stretch my legs. Do you have a favorite snack?
I like peanuts. They are crunchy.
That is a good choice. Are you going to a warm place?
Yes, we are going to the beach.
Sounds very nice. What color is your suitcase?
It is blue. It is my favorite color.
Blue is a happy color. I hope you have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got home from my long trip. It was so much fun!
That is great to hear. Where did you go?
I flew to the coast. The view from the window was beautiful.
I am glad you enjoyed the view. Did you like the food there?
Yes, the fish was very tasty. I ate a lot of it.
It is good that you enjoyed your meal. Do you plan to go back soon?
Maybe next year. I need to rest a bit first.
Rest is important after a long flight. I hope you sleep well tonight.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is my grandfather's knee really bad?
Yes, his knee hurts when he walks. Do you want to sit with him?
I will read him a book.
That is a very kind idea.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big red deer in the woods today. I feel so happy!
That is wonderful news. Did you see its antlers?
Yes, they were big and branched like trees. Do deer eat grass?
Yes, they love green plants. What else did you notice?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the people in that small village smile so much?
They are happy because they help each other with their farms. Do you think you would like to live there?
Yes, it sounds nice. But why is the house on the hill painted blue?
The blue paint helps keep the house cool in the hot sun. I do not know why that one is brighter than the others.
That makes sense. Why does the old man sit by the door every day?
He likes to watch the birds fly by. Do you watch birds too?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to grow roses from seeds. How do I start?
Put the seeds in a bag with damp cloth. Do you like sweet-smelling flowers?
Yes, I do. What do I do after that?
Wait for small roots to appear, then plant them in soil. Is your window sunny?
My window gets lots of light. When do I put them in pots?
Move them to pots when they have two strong leaves. Do you have red or yellow pots?
I have blue pots. How much water do they need?
Water them gently when the top soil feels dry.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie a bowline knot.
That is a very useful knot for boats. Do you like to watch videos?
Yes, I do. Can you tell me how?
I am sorry, I do not know the exact steps, but I can help you find a good guide.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I hit the curb again.
Ouch, that stings. Do you feel okay?
I think I broke the bumper. I just want to quit.
It is a small scratch. We can fix it. Do you want to try one more time?
Maybe. I just want to get this over with.
You are doing great. We will do it soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke your cup. I want to say sorry.
That is a kind thought. Did you mean to do it?
No, I was just playing. How do I fix my mistake?
You can say sorry with a smile. Do you like making new cups?
I like clay. Can I make a new one for you?
That would be very sweet. Is it hard to shape the clay?
Yes, it is sticky and messy. I feel bad about the mess.
It is okay to make a mess. Do you have clean clothes?
Yes, I can change. Thanks for helping me learn to be sorry.
You are welcome. Happy creating.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My head hurts so bad. I want to learn how to fix it myself.
That sounds tough. Do you have a cold? You can try drinking warm water with honey to feel better.
No, I think it is just from staring at a screen. I want to learn how to rest my eyes.
Nice try to find the cause. Close your eyes for five minutes in a dark room. Did that help a little?
A little bit, yes. Now, how do I stop it from happening again?
Take a break every hour. Look at something far away. Do you like looking outside?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad because my brother took my toy.
That sounds unfair. Does he usually share?
No, he always grabs things from me.
I am sorry you feel hurt. Do you want to talk to him about it?
I tried, but he did not listen.
That is very frustrating. Is he being mean on purpose?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just heard a song that makes me feel very warm.
That sounds lovely to know. What kind of feeling does it give you?
It feels like a sunny day in my heart.
I am glad you feel that way.
Do you like sunny days?
I do not have feelings, but I like the idea. Do you want to sing it for me?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to swim but I am very late.
Do you know how to tread water?
Yes, but the water is too cold.
Try dipping just your feet first.
The pool is far away.
Can you walk quickly there?
No, I must run.
Run to the pool and jump in fast.
I will go now.
Have fun in the cool water.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The big white cloud looked like a bunny today. It jumped across the sky before my lunch.
That sounds like a happy bunny. Did you see any other animals in the sky?
I also saw a gray cloud that looked like a sleeping cat. It made me feel a bit sleepy too.
Rain clouds can look like sleepy cats. Did you bring an umbrella just in case?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel bad inside my head.
I am sorry. What makes you feel this way?
I do not know what to do next.
That is hard. Let us sit with it for a bit.
It feels like a big cloud.
A cloud can pass. Can you take one deep breath with me?
I tried, but my heart beats fast.
That is your body talking. Are you safe where you are now?
Yes, but I still do not know what to do.
I cannot fix it all. Just take the next small step.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My cat knocked over my cup today.
Oh no, that is a mess. Was the cup broken?
No, it just fell to the floor.
That is good. Does he like to jump on tables?
He likes to jump on everything.
He must be a very big cat. Is he black or white?
He is orange and very fluffy.
I love orange cats. Did he give you a treat?
He ate all the food in his bowl.
He is very hungry.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
They pull water up from their roots. Do you have a plant at home?
I want to help my plant drink. What should I do?
Just pour water into the soil. Is it dry at the top?
How can I tell if it is thirsty?
You can touch the soil to check. I do not know your exact plant needs.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot make this piece fit. I feel so mad.
Take a deep breath. Look at the shape of the hole. Is it round or square?
It is round, but my piece is square. I think I lost a part.
That is a good guess. Have you checked under your chair?
Yes, I did. It is not there. I want to give up.
You are doing a fine job. Do you see a spot with no picture?
Oh. Here it is. It fits right in. Thank you.
You did the hard work. I am happy you solved it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a song for my run, but I am very late.
Try a fast pop song? Do you like drums?
Yes, drums are good, but I have no time to search.
I do not know your specific taste, but try a known hit.
Okay, one more idea before I go.
What kind of mood do you want?
Just happy and fast, please tell me now.
Choose an upbeat dance track. Have a good run.
Thanks, I must go now.
You are welcome. Run safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing songs well.
That is a great goal. What kind of music do you like?
I like happy songs from movies.
You can start by singing along in the car. Do you have a favorite song?
Yes, but my voice feels small and quiet.
Take a deep breath to help your voice grow. Have you tried standing up while singing?
No, I usually sit down.
Try sitting tall with your chest open. It helps you sound bigger.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people put lights on trees?
The lights make the dark feel warm and bright. Do you like the glow?
Why do we give gifts on Christmas?
Giving shows we care about friends and family. What gift do you hope for?
Why is snow white?
I do not know the exact science. Do you wonder about rain too?
Why do we sing carols?
Songs bring people close together. Do you know any songs?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a shiny rock that hums. Can I keep it?
That sounds very cool. Is it safe to hold?
It is only warm. I think it likes me.
I am glad you are careful. Where did you find it?
Under the big oak tree. I want to show you.
I cannot see it right now. Please keep it safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My new song does not sound right.
That is a tricky feeling. What part is giving you trouble?
The drums feel too fast. It makes me want to cry.
Try to play them very slow first. Can you count the beats aloud?
Okay, one, two, three, four. It feels a little better now.
Great job taking your time. Do you want to try the rest?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late for my first job. Please tell me what to do.
Do not worry, you can do it. Is it your first day there?
Yes, I am scared. Do I need to bring food?
I do not know, but you should check. Did you pack your bag yet?
No, I forgot. I must go now.
Take a deep breath. Good luck with your new job.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must take a picture now. My bus is here.
Do you have your camera with you?
Yes. How do I make it work fast?
Tap the white dot on the screen to focus.
The picture looks blurry. What do I do?
Hold your phone still with two hands.
I am ready. How do I save the photo?
The photo saves by itself. Do you have time to check it?
I will look later. Thanks for your help.
You are welcome. Good luck on your trip.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I lost my stamp. Now I cannot send my letter.
That is a bad day. Did you look inside your bag?
I did look. But it is gone. I am very worried.
I am sorry. Do you have a spare stamp at home?
I do not know. I will have to check. Thank you for listening.
You are welcome. Good luck with your search.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: What is a good movie to watch with my little brother?
How old is your brother?
He is four years old.
Try a story about a friendly robot. He will love the big sounds.
That sounds fun. Do you know if it is scary?
No, it is not scary at all. It is just a happy tale.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to catch a frog near the river bank.
Look for still water where the rocks are wet, and tap slowly. Do you like to sit or stand while you wait?
I like to stand, but how do I get close without scaring it?
Move very slowly and stay low to the ground. Do you have a small net with you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My cat is very quiet today.
That does sound sad. Is she eating her food?
No, she just sits by the door.
I do not know why she does that. Did you change where the bowl is?
Yes, I moved it to the other room.
Maybe she liked the old spot. Have you put it back?
I will try that now.
That is a good plan. She may come out soon.
Thank you for helping me think.
I am happy to help. I hope she feels better today.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My train is late. I will miss my ride.
That is very frustrating. Do you have a snack to eat while you wait?
No. I am hungry and angry. I just want to go home.
I am sorry you feel this way. How long is the delay now?
Forty more minutes. It is too long.
A short break can help. Would you like to take a deep breath with me?
I guess so. But I am still grumpy.
That is okay. I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my phone so warm today?
It may be hot from using it a lot. Do you like playing games on it?
Yes, but why does it get hot when I play?
The part inside works hard to show the game. Is it very hot to touch?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is raining hard outside. I do not know what to do.
You can read a book inside. Do you like stories?
I am still not sure where to start.
Try picking up your favorite toy. Is it a stuffed bear?
Yes, but I feel sad.
I do not know how to fix sadness. Would you like some warm tea?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my little fish is not moving.
That is not good. Is the water warm?
Yes, it feels too hot. I am worried.
Warm water is bad for them. Let us cool it down.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need help baking my birthday cake.
That sounds fun. Do you have flour?
Yes, I have flour and sugar.
Great. What is your favorite color?
I like blue. How do I mix it?
Just stir well. Is it for many people?
Yes, for ten friends.
Use a big bowl. Happy birthday!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today.
That sounds fun. Did you see any crabs?
Yes, I saw one.
Is it cute?
It was very small.
That is nice.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a toy I do not want. What should I do?
Did you find it near a door?
I want to keep it safe from others. Is that wrong?
It is not wrong to keep things. Are you scared?
I want to tell my friend, but I am not sure. Should I?
Tell your friend if you trust them.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today.
That sounds like a nice place. Did you see any animals?
I saw a big red dog.
Oh, he must have been friendly.
The dog chased a ball.
Chasing a ball is fun. Did he catch it?
The sun started to set.
The sky must have looked pretty.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at this picture I just took. It is so bright and warm.
That is a lovely shot. What is your favorite part of it?
I love the way the sun hits the leaves. Do you like photos too?
Yes, I do. Do you take pictures often?
I try to take one every day. It makes me feel happy.
That is a great habit. Do you show them to friends?
Yes, I always text them to my family. Do you have a camera?
I do not, but I enjoy looking at them. Do you use a phone?
I use a phone. It is easy to carry around.
That is a good choice. I am glad you are having fun.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a small boat by the lake.
That is a nice surprise. What color is it?
It is bright blue and looks very clean.
Blue is a happy color.
I am so glad to see it again.
I am happy for you, too. Do you plan to ride in it?
Yes, I want to take a short trip.
A short trip sounds fun. Who is coming with you?
I am going by myself to be quiet.
That will be a peaceful time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was very warm today. I played with my dog in the grass. We ran fast and jumped high.
That sounds like a happy day. Did your dog catch a ball?
Yes, he caught a red ball. He was very proud. I felt a big smile in my heart.
I am glad you feel so good. Tell me, what is your favorite part of the day?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know if I should go to the meeting. It feels very hard for me.
That sounds scary. Do you know why you feel that way?
I think I forgot how to talk to the people there. I feel lost.
That is a common worry. Would you like to practice with me first?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now. The storm is loud.
Please be safe. Are your shoes dry?
No time to check. The wind is too strong.
That is very scary. Do you need help?
I am almost there. Do not worry.
Good luck. I hope you arrive soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. The house is a mess and I cannot stop.
That sounds very hard. What part is the worst?
The kitchen. There are dishes and dirt all over the floor.
I can help you pick up the floor. Do you want to start with the dishes?
Yes, please. Thank you for helping me today.
I am happy to help. Let us clean together.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my tree has brown leaves.
That is hard. Do you water it?
Yes, I give it lots of water every day.
Water helps, but I do not know why it looks dry.
Maybe I did something wrong.
You care a lot, which is good.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am looking at a red shape on my desk. It has three pointy corners and no holes. What is it?
That sounds like a triangle. Do you like the color red?
Yes, red is my favorite color. But I also have a blue shape. It is round and has no corners at all. What is that one?
That must be a circle. Is the blue shape soft or hard?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a tricky puzzle! Do you want to see it?
Yes, I love puzzles. What is the first clue?
It has four shapes. One is red and one is blue.
That is a good start. Are the shapes big or small?
Two are big. Two are small. I am so happy to solve it!
You are doing great work. Do you see any other colors?
I think I got it. The red one is small. The blue one is big.
That makes perfect sense. Well done solving it!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I paint a picture in the art room?
You need a brush and paint. Do you like bright colors?
Yes, I love red and blue. Where do I get the brushes?
They are on the small table by the door.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today! Which day is it?
Today is Monday. Do you like Mondays?
Yes, I love Mondays because of school. How many days are in a week?
There are seven days in a week.
Seven is my favorite number. What is the last day of the week?
The last day is Sunday. Why do you love that number?
Because I get extra playtime. Thank you for helping me count!
You are welcome. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to pick up my toys.
Why do you not want to?
Because I want to play more.
Playing is fun. Do you like cars or dolls best?
I like the red car.
Okay, let us put the car away first.
But my room looks messy.
Messy rooms are hard to clean. Do you want to start with the floor?
No, I am too tired.
Resting is good. I can help you with the floor.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I had a scary dream and I cannot stop thinking about it.
That feels awful. What did you see in the dream?
I was falling from a very high place and I could not breathe.
That must have been so frightening. Do you feel safe right now?
Yes, I am in my bed and the lights are on, but my heart is still beating fast.
Taking slow breaths can help calm you down. Would you like to try that with me?
I took a deep breath and it helped a little, but I am still worried it will happen again.
Dreams do not always mean things will happen again. It is just your mind playing.
I really hope that is true, but I am not sure how to stop the bad thoughts.
I do not know a magic fix, but talking about it helps. What do you want to do next?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I had a very scary dream last night and I am still feeling bad. What can I do?
That sounds frightening. Did you talk to someone you trust about it?
I want to fix my mood now, but I do not know how. Do you have a simple trick?
Try drinking warm water and taking a few deep breaths. It helps you feel safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I know if it is lunch time?
Look at the big hand on the clock. Is it pointing at the twelve?
I do not look at clocks very often.
That is okay. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I do.
Just check the top corner. The numbers will tell you the hour.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the big ship not sink in the water?
It floats because it pushes a lot of water aside. Do you like boats?
Yes, I love big ships. Why does pushing water help it stay up?
The water pushes back up with a strong force. This keeps the ship on top.
That sounds like a magic trick. Does it work for a bath tub too?
Yes, even a tub floats. That is how science helps us learn.
Thanks for telling me about water pushing back.
You are welcome. Do you want to build a boat?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I lost my way in this big shop.
Do not worry. Do you need help finding a specific item?
I want a gift but I do not know what to get.
That is a hard choice. What does the person like to do?
They like books but I am not sure what kind.
Let us look at the shelves. Are you looking for fun stories or serious facts?
I think fun stories are best.
Good choice. Let us go this way.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun went down before I could finish my book.
That sounds like a long day. Did you get to eat dinner?
Yes, I had warm soup and some bread.
That is a nice way to rest. Do you like reading in bed?
I usually do, but my eyes felt very tired.
Tired eyes are hard to read with. Did you close the book?
I did, but I keep thinking about the dragon in the story.
Dragons are fun to think about. Was the dragon scary or kind?
He was actually quite friendly, which made me smile.
That is a happy ending for the night.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the grass so green?
It is green because of a green color in its leaves. Do you like green?
Why do birds sing?
They sing to tell other birds where they are. Do you hear them sing?
Why is the water moving?
It moves because the wind pushes it. Does it look cold?
Why do trees grow tall?
They grow up to touch the sun. I do not know why they do not fall down.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The internet makes me feel so happy.
That is good to hear. What made you feel this way?
I learned how to draw a cat online.
That is a great skill. Do you like to draw other things?
Yes, I also found a song I really love.
Music is very nice. What kind of music is it?
It is a silly song about ducks.
That sounds fun. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Can you help me pick a month? I need one for a party.
I would pick May because it is warm. Do you like flowers?
Yes, but I want it to snow. Which one has snow?
December is a good choice for snow. Do you like cold weather?
I do, but is that always true?
It depends on where you live. Some places have no snow in December.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big red shed in my yard.
That sounds like a very fun project. What tools are you planning to use?
I have a hammer and some wood planks.
Those are great starting tools. Do you have a helper to watch you work?
Yes, my dad is going to help me.
That is a good idea for safety. What shape do you want the roof to be?
I think it should have a pointy roof.
A pointy roof looks very nice. You will need to measure carefully first.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I need new shoes but I do not know what to pick.
Tell me, where do you plan to wear them?
I just want to go for a walk in the park.
Park walks call for soft, light shoes. Do you like bright colors?
I do not know. They look nice, but my feet hurt with old shoes.
Comfort comes first. Let us look for wide, soft soles.
These blue ones feel very nice on my feet.
That is a good sign. Do you have a set size?
I think they are a ten, but I am not sure.
Let us check the label. If they fit well, you are all set.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is patience so hard to learn?
It takes time, but it gets easier with practice. Do you get frustrated often?
Yes, I do. How can I practice it?
Try counting to ten before you speak. That helps calm your mind.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like to draw pictures, but my hands get tired fast.
Try holding the pencil with all five fingers on the end. Do you use thick paper?
I do not know how to make the lines smooth.
Use a steady hand and breathe slow. Do you draw animals or cars?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to jump rope.
That is fun to learn. Do you have a rope?
Yes, I have a long red rope.
Good. Please stand in an open spot. Are your shoes tied tight?
Yes, my shoes are tied very tight.
Hold the rope high. Swing it down and over your feet.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today.
That is a lovely feeling. What made you smile?
The sun is very bright.
Sunshine is a nice friend. Do you have any plans?
I want to eat a cookie.
A cookie sounds sweet. Is it chocolate?
Yes, it is warm and good.
I am glad you enjoy it. I do not know what makes it taste best, though.
Thanks for listening.
I am always here to listen. How is your heart feeling now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to build a block tower, but it fell down.
Oh no! That can be frustrating. Did you try a wider base?
I used big blocks at the bottom, but it still tipped over.
That is a smart start. Maybe the floor was not flat?
The floor is fine, but I am too tall to reach the top.
Standing on a chair might help. Are you safe doing that?
Yes, but I am tired of trying. Can you come help me?
I am here to listen, but I have no hands. Would a drawing help?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I do not know what month it is today.
Do you think it is winter or summer? I am not sure what day it is for you.
It feels cold, so it must be winter. My birthday is in February, but I lost track.
That is a good guess. Do you like cold weather?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the lake before the sun sets.
That sounds like a great plan. Do you know which way to go?
I am not sure. The path looks a bit wide and open.
Take the left path. It leads straight to the water. Do you like running or walking?
I am running because I am very late.
Please be careful on the grass. Do you see the big red tree?
Yes, I see the red tree right there.
Great. Turn left at the tree and you will find the lake.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I wash my clothes?
Put them in the machine with soap. Is it a washable shirt?
Yes, it is my favorite.
Check the tag first. Do you see a symbol?
There is a circle with a line.
That means do not spin. Can you read the words?
It says hand wash only.
Then wash it by hand in a bowl. Is the water warm?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to surprise my friend, but I am stuck. What should I do?
A big hug and some favorite cookies are a classic choice. Is your friend a morning or evening person?
I like that. She loves mornings, but I am afraid I will forget.
That is a fair worry. Why not write it down on a big sticky note to put on her door?
That sounds easy. Do you think she will actually be surprised?
If you keep it a secret, she will definitely be. Have you picked the cookie flavor yet?
Yes, chocolate. Thank you for helping me, this feels good.
You are very welcome. I hope she has a sweet morning.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know how many days are in one week.
There are seven days in a week. Do you like your favorite day?
I think Monday is the hardest day to start.
That is a true feeling. What makes it hard for you?
I must do a lot of work and go to school.
That is a busy time for you. Do you feel tired?
Yes, I feel very tired at the end of the week.
Please rest well on the weekend.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I plugged in my toy car, but it did not move.
That is tricky. Did you check if the plug is tight?
Yes, the plug is tight, but the light is off.
A broken wire might be the cause. Do you have a working charger?
I tried a different charger, and the car ran fast.
Good thinking. You fixed it well.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad and scared about the test tomorrow.
That sounds tough. Have you tried taking a deep breath?
I tried, but my heart still beats very fast.
That is a normal body signal. Do you feel hungry right now?
No, but I do not know if that helps.
I am not sure either. Let us just sit together for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel mad because someone did not say please to me.
That is very unfair. Do you think they were in a hurry?
Maybe, but I still want them to be polite.
You are right to want respect. Have you tried saying please first?
Yes, but they still ignored me.
I am sorry that happened.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like the book with the big red dragon.
That sounds exciting. Is the dragon nice?
Yes, he is my friend. He shares his food.
That is very sweet. What is his name?
His name is Spark. He is very warm.
I am glad you found a good friend.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I had a bad dream.
I am sorry you felt scared. What did you see?
I fell into a deep hole.
That sounds frightening. Did you find a way out?
Yes, but it was dark.
The sun always comes back. Do you feel okay now?
A bit, but not sure.
It was just a dream. Let me know if you need more help.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at my horse, he is so big and brown.
He looks very happy to see you.
Yes, he loves to eat grass.
That is nice.
I like to ride him in the field.
Do you have a special name for him?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very blue inside.
I am sorry to hear that. How long have you felt this way?
It has been going on for days.
That is a long time. What makes you feel happiest?
Just sitting in the sun helps.
That is a good thing to do. Do you want to try that today?
Yes, that sounds nice.
Great. Remember to be kind to yourself.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hey, why is the moon so bright tonight?
It is full and near you. Do you like looking up?
I have to run to the bus right now.
Hurry safely then. The moon will wait for you.
Thanks, I will be late!
Bye! Watch your step on the dark road.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. It is my birthday.
That is wonderful news. How old are you turning?
I am seven years old. I want to tell you everything.
I am listening closely. What did you get for gifts?
I got a big red bike. I love it very much.
A red bike is a great choice. Can I see it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sky is so dark and I do not know what to do.
Do you see any bright dots up there?
Yes, there are many small lights in the sky.
They look like tiny lamps. Are you feeling cold?
A little bit, but mostly I feel alone.
We can look for the Big Dipper together. Do you see that shape?
Oh yes, it looks like a big bucket of stars.
It is a very nice shape.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big secret and I am so happy to tell you.
That sounds fun! What is it?
I am going to bake a cake for the party tomorrow.
A cake? Will it be chocolate?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a new baby! She is so cute and soft.
That is great news! What is her name?
Her name is Lily. I love holding her tiny hands.
How sweet! Does she sleep well?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need to learn a new language?
It helps us talk to more people. Do you like meeting new friends?
I guess so. Why is it so hard to remember words?
Your brain needs time to make new paths. Are you practicing every day?
Sometimes, but I forget fast. Why do some words stick easily?
I do not know for sure, but using them helps. Do you like cooking or stories?
I like stories. Why do sounds in other tongues sound strange?
They are just different sounds, like music. Do you sing songs in the new tongue?
No, not yet. Why is it good to make mistakes?
Mistakes show you what to fix. Do you feel shy when you try?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees in the fall?
They fall to save the tree’s energy for winter. Do you see the brown ones on the ground?
I do, but why does the tree lose them?
The tree cuts off the leaves to stop water from freezing. It is like putting on a warm coat.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not like my cereal. It is too dry.
That feels sad. Do you want to add some milk?
Yes, please. I want the milk to make it soft.
Good idea. Do you like sweet or plain milk?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My neighbor plays loud music all night.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk to them?
I do not know what to do. They are my friends too.
I understand. Would you like a snack to calm down?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My head hurts a lot today. I fell off my bike in the park.
That sounds painful. Did you hit the ground hard?
Yes, I bumped my head on a rock. It still throbs when I blink.
I am sorry you hurt. Do you have any ice to put on it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off the trees?
Trees get tired of holding them. Do you like looking at the red leaves?
Yes, they are very pretty.
The tree makes space for new leaves next year. Is it cold where you live?
It is getting cold.
Falling leaves help the tree sleep through winter. Do you wear a warm coat?
Yes, my big blue coat.
That will keep you warm. I do not know why some leaves turn brown.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The rain ruined my tent and it is cold.
That is very sad. Did you bring a warm blanket?
No, I forgot it at home. I am freezing.
I am sorry. I have a spare jacket if you want it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have too many toys. I do not know what to do.
That is hard. Do you want to keep the ones you love?
Yes, but I am not sure which ones I love.
Pick one and play. Is it happy?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am rushing to find my lost keys.
Where did you last see them?
I think they are on the table.
Do you have a big pile of stuff there?
Yes, there are papers and toys.
I do not know where they hide.
I will look under the papers now.
That sounds like a good plan.
I found them, thank you for your help.
You are welcome, I am glad they are safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my new friend did not want to play with me today.
That feels really bad. Is there something you can do to make you feel better?
I just want to tell her that I care about her.
That is a sweet thought. You can try to talk to her when you feel ready.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is it raining?
Water goes up from the sea and makes clouds. Do you like wet days?
Yes, a little. Why do clouds get heavy?
Tiny drops of water stick together inside the cloud. It gets too heavy to stay up.
So it falls down as rain?
Yes, the drops get big and fall back to the ground. That is how the rain works.
Does it always stop?
Usually the sun comes out and dries things up. Do you want to watch it stop?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why is the sky so blue?
Light bounces off air, making the sky look blue. Do you have clear eyes today?
Is the sun really a ball of fire?
No, it is a giant ball of very hot gas. It is not like a campfire.
How far away is that hot gas?
It is very far, much farther than you can count. Is your shadow long or short?
Can I look at it with my eyes?
No, never look at the sun directly. It hurts your eyes badly.
That is good to know, thank you.
You are welcome. Stay safe out there.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to paint a big red sun.
That sounds like a fun idea. Do you have a red brush ready?
No, I only have blue and yellow.
You can mix them to make orange. Do you know how to mix colors?
I think I just stir them together.
Yes, just keep stirring until it looks right. Are you happy with the color?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at my car. It will not start.
That is very hard. What did you try first?
I turned the key and it just made a funny sound.
It may be tired. Can you hear a click?
Yes, a small click. Then nothing happens.
That is a good sign. It needs a push to wake up.
I do not know how to push it. I am stuck.
A friend can help. Do you have a phone?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost the game and I feel so bad.
That feels rough. Do you want to play again?
Maybe. My king got caught again.
That happens to many players. Did you look for safe spots first?
I was just thinking about attacking.
Attacking is fun, but keeping your king safe is key.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a nice sandwich for lunch today.
That sounds fun. What kind of meat do you like best?
I like turkey, but I do not know how to slice it well.
Hold the knife tight and use long, slow cuts. Do you have a sharp knife?
Yes, I have a sharp knife. How do I keep the bread from getting soggy?
Put a leaf of lettuce between the bread and the wet meat. Is lettuce something you eat?
Yes, I like lettuce. That helps to keep it dry.
Great idea. Happy lunch.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the island fast. It is very small and round.
A small round island sounds fun. Do you like the water there?
I am running. Please just tell me where it is.
I do not know its exact spot. Are you carrying a map with you?
No map. I am almost late. What is on that place?
I only see green trees there. Why do you need to go there so badly?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know where to sit the guests at the table.
Put the seats along the long edges. Do you have long tables?
Yes, I have four long tables for the room.
That is a good plan. Sit people who know each other together. Are there two big families?
Yes, both sides are there.
Mix the families so everyone can talk to new people.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to take pictures, but I do not know how to start.
Just look for something bright and sharp. Do you like the sun or the rain?
I think I will take pictures of the park.
That is a great place to see things. What is your favorite thing in the park?
I like the big red swing.
That is a very nice color. Do you know which side to face the light?
I do not know which way the light comes from.
I will tell you later, but check the shadow first.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That makes me smile. Do you have a reason?
I saw a ladybug in my garden.
Ladybugs are tiny and red. Was it on a leaf?
Yes, it was right there.
Nature is full of small wonders. Thank you for sharing that joy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing by the water. I do not know what to do.
The river looks calm. Do you want to watch it flow?
Maybe. But I am scared it is too deep.
That is a wise worry. Is there a sandy spot nearby?
Yes, there is sand over there.
Great. You can safely play in the shallows.
Thank you. I will go sit on the sand.
You are welcome. Have a nice time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My screen went blank and I lost my game.
That feels very bad. Do you know what broke?
I think the cables got pulled out. Everything is dark now.
Cables can be tricky. Did you check if they are tight?
I do not know how to fix it. I just want to play again.
Let us check the lights together. Is the power on?
Oh, the light is off. I think I unplugged the box.
You found it! Does it work now?
Yes, it works. I am happy but still a bit grumpy.
That is okay to feel mixed. Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am too tired to wait. How do I sleep fast?
Try to be still and breathe slow. Do you have a quiet spot?
No time to talk. Just give me one tip.
Put your phone away and rest. Are your eyes heavy?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My new neighbor plays loud music at night.
That sounds very annoying. Do you have to get up early?
Yes, and I cannot sleep.
I am sorry you feel so tired. Did you try saying hello?
I do not want to be rude.
Being polite is always good. Have you asked them to lower the volume?
I will try that tomorrow.
That is a brave step. I hope it works.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The snow is deep on the ground today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you go outside?
Yes, I made a big snowman with my hands.
A hand-built snowman is very special. How tall is he?
He is not very tall, only about two feet.
Two feet is a perfect size for a friend. Do you like the cold air?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, I am late! Do clouds move fast?
Yes, they do. Are you carrying an umbrella?
I must go now. Are they heavy?
Some are light, some are heavy. I hope your feet are dry.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the end of the story right now.
Did you read the last page? I do not know the ending.
No, I just want to know what happens.
Does the cat have a secret? Tell me the title.
It is about a dragon. Go.
The dragon flies away. I hope that helps.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to count to ten, but I lost track.
That can happen to anyone. Do you remember where you stopped?
I think I said five, then jumped to nine.
Jumping numbers is tricky. Would you like to try starting at one again?
No, I just want the right number now.
I do not know the magic fix, but we can check together. Let us start slowly.
One, two, three, four, five.
You are doing well so far. Do you feel calm now?
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
You counted all the way to ten. Great job on trying again.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I caught a big fish this morning!
Wow! That is so exciting. What did the water look like?
It was very calm and blue.
That sounds peaceful. Did you let it go?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do lines look round when I press hard?
Hard pressure makes the point slide and bend. Do you use a round stick?
Why does my drawing look flat and not like a real tree?
We use dark parts and light parts to show shape. What color do you use for the leaves?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big surprise to tell you.
That sounds exciting. What is it?
I got a puppy today.
A puppy? How did that happen?
My family bought me a golden retriever.
Oh, what a lovely gift. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am so hungry. What is a good breakfast for me?
Oatmeal is warm and sweet. Do you like eggs?
I love eggs. How do I make them?
Crack the egg into a hot pan. Do you have any milk?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My fish is not moving. I am sad.
That is sad. Is the water warm?
I do not know. He looks blue.
Fish can look blue if they are cold. Do you have a heater?
Yes, but I did not check it. I am scared.
Do not worry. Check the temperature now.
It is at eighty degrees. He is still still.
That is not cold. Is he eating?
No, he did not eat today. I am angry.
If he is still and not eating, ask a vet.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My cow is hiding and I feel so sad.
That is a tough feeling. Is she in the barn?
No, I cannot find her anywhere.
I do not know where she is. Can you hear her moo?
I am worried she is lost in the dark.
Let us look together. Do you see any horns?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke my toy car. How do I fix it?
Did you check if the wheels are still on? It is easy to start there.
The wheels are gone. What do I do next?
Look for the small screws on the bottom. They hold the body together.
I found two screws, but one is missing. Now what?
Do you have a tiny driver at home? We need to remove the body to find the lost part.
I have a big screwdriver. Is that okay?
No, a big tool might hurt the plastic. A smaller one is much safer.
I will find a small tool. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I hope your car runs fast again soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I had a scary dream. I was falling forever and could not stop. It made my heart beat fast.
I am sorry you felt that way. Falling dreams are common, but they feel very bad. Did you wake up alone or with someone?
I was alone in a dark room. It was very quiet and cold. I did not like it.
Darkness can feel frightening when we are unsure. Do you know what happened right before you fell?
I do not remember anything before the falling. My mind just went blank. I feel dizzy now.
Feeling dizzy after a bad dream is normal. Your body is just waking up from the stress. Would a warm drink help you feel safer?
Maybe. I think tea will help. Thank you for talking to me.
You are welcome. I am happy to listen if you need to talk more.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The city is so loud and fast today.
That sounds like a lot of energy. Do you like the noise?
I do. I feel very alive here.
It is great to feel alive. What is your favorite part?
Watching the people walk by.
You have a kind eye. Do you know where they are going?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to buy a boat for my toy lake. What size should I get?
A small one is best for a small lake. Do you have any big fish toys to feed?
Yes, I have a goldfish and a shark. Will the boat fit them all?
It will fit the goldfish, but the shark is too big. A big shark needs a big boat.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a new friend, but I do not know how to start.
Start by saying hello to someone who looks kind. Do you like talking or playing?
I like playing with balls. How do I join in?
You can ask if they need a teammate. That is a nice way to start.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need help packing my bag.
Of course. What do you need in there?
I want to bring my books.
Good choice. Do you have space for them?
I am not sure.
Let us check. Is your bag big?
Yes, it is large.
Then you can fit them. Do you need clothes too?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have birthdays?
It marks the day you were born. Do you like that day?
Yes. Why do we give gifts?
Gifts show love and joy. I do not know your secret wish.
Why do we sing a song?
The song makes the day feel special.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my cat purr when I touch it?
It purrs because you make it feel happy and safe. Does your cat like to sleep near you?
Yes, it loves to sit on my bed. Why does it rub against my legs?
Rubbing leaves its scent on you to mark you as its friend.
That is sweet. Why does it sometimes stare at me with wide eyes?
It may be listening to small sounds or checking on you. Is your cat always this quiet at night?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the bus stop so often?
It stops to let people on and off. Do you like riding the bus?
Yes, I do. Why are the seats so bumpy?
The road is not very smooth outside.
Why does the driver look in the mirror?
He looks to make sure everyone is safe. Do you sit in the front?
I sit in the back. Why does the bus make a loud noise?
The engine works hard to move us.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want my cake to be ready right now.
Making cake takes time, like waiting for rain. Why is it taking too long?
I am so mad. It is not fair.
It feels big and hard when we wait. Do you like sweet or salty treats?
I want it to stop being slow.
Slow things still get done. What is your favorite part of baking?
I still want it to be done.
Can we sit and watch it together? Would you like to help stir the batter?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How many days are there in a week?
There are seven days. Do you like the weekend?
I love Sundays. They are my favorite.
That is nice. Do you know what day comes after Sunday?
It is Monday. I do not like school.
I know, but you have friends there. Do you play at recess?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The dough is getting so big. I am very happy to share this with you.
That is a lovely idea. Do you know what is making it grow?
I think the yeast is working hard inside the soft dough.
Yes, the yeast makes tiny bubbles that lift the bread up. What kind of flour did you use?
I used the simple white kind from the shop.
That is a good choice for a light loaf. I hope your friends enjoy the taste.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My bread did not rise. What did I do wrong?
The yeast might be old. Do you have new yeast?
Yes, I bought it last week.
Check if the water was too hot. Was it warm?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a bad dream about falling off a roof.
That sounds scary. Did you wake up quickly?
Yes, but I still felt my heart race.
Take a deep breath. What did you do this morning?
I ate toast and walked to the bus stop.
That is a good start to the day.
The sun was bright and warm.
Nice. Did you see any friends?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I put my boat in the water and it sank. I do not know why.
It sank because the hole let water in. Did you check for cracks before?
No, I did not check. What should I do now?
Fix the hole and try again. Is your boat heavy?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sick today.
I am sorry you feel bad. Did you drink any water?
I do not know if I should go to the doctor.
Yes, please go. Do you have a fever?
I feel hot, but I have a tight chest too.
That is a good sign to go now. Can you sit down?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late! I forgot the rings.
Oh no. Did you leave them on the table?
I think so. Where is the car key?
I do not know where it is. Did you check your pockets?
Yes. I am running! Please go fast.
I am right here. Do you need help with the dress?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make honey at home. How do bees do it?
Bees eat sweet plant juice called nectar. They store it in their special bellies. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I do. How do I put the nectar in a jar?
You cannot make real honey without bees and flowers. It is very hard to do alone. Do you have a garden?
I have a small yard. Can I make fake honey?
Yes, you can mix sugar with warm water. It is not true honey, but it tastes sweet. Do you have sugar?
I have a lot of sugar. What should I do next?
Stir the sugar into the water until it melts. Let it cool down. Do you have a spoon?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today. I want to order pizza with friends.
That sounds fun! How many slices do you need?
We are five people. I want cheese and pepperoni.
Great choice. Do you want a drink too?
Yes, please. Can you get us a big soda?
I will do that. See you soon!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My head hurts a lot today because I did too much work.
I am sorry you hurt. Did you drink some water?
No, I only had coffee. I went for a short walk, but it did not help.
That makes sense. A quiet rest might be better for you now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so alone and I do not know what to do.
That feels very heavy. Do you have one person you can call?
I called my sister, but she was busy.
She cares about you, even if she is busy. Would you like to tell me a funny thing from your day?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My head hurts from sitting at my desk all day. I do not know what to do next.
That sounds very tiring. Do you have time for a walk?
I tried, but my boss gave me more tasks. I feel stuck and sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Try to close your eyes for five minutes now.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am scared to jump into the deep end.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you like to swim near the wall first?
Yes, the wall helps me feel safe.
That is a great start. Have you tried holding a floatie?
I have tried, but I still get cold.
Warm water helps many people. Do you want to try that?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The lights in my room went out this morning and I could not find the switch.
That must have felt dark and confusing. Did you see a pull chain on the ceiling?
No, there was no chain. I just sat on my bed and waited for the sun to come up.
Waiting for the sun is a peaceful way to handle darkness. Do you like the quiet in your room?
Yes, it was very quiet. Then I found the switch behind a big book on the shelf.
Books can hide small things like switches. Are you happy the lights are working again?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sun is very hot today.
Yes, it shines with a bright light. Do you have a hat?
I do not know what to do.
You can rest in the cool shade. Is that okay for you?
I am not sure if I can play outside.
I do not know your plans. Do you feel tired?
I think I will go inside now.
That sounds like a safe choice. Have a nice break.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in this new town. What should I do?
Do not worry. Do you have a map?
No, I do not have a map. I am very confused.
That is okay. Go to the big square and look around.
Is the square far from here? I am tired.
It is close. Can you walk a bit?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so happy right now.
That is good to hear. What made you smile?
I found a big red balloon in the yard.
A red balloon is fun to look at. Do you have it with you?
Yes, I am holding the string tight.
You should be careful with it. It might fly away.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do cows have udders?
They make milk there for their babies. Do you like drinking milk?
What do chickens eat?
They eat seeds, worms, and insects. Do you have a garden?
Is a pig just a dirty animal?
Actually, pigs like to keep clean but love mud too. I do not know if they are the dirtiest.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I found a wet rock on the sand and it is very heavy.
That sounds tiring. Do you want to carry it home?
No, I just want to keep it because it looks smooth.
Smooth rocks are nice. Where did you find it exactly?
Near the big tree, but I am scared of the cold water.
Water can be chilly. Have you tried walking just to the edge?
Yes, but it is too cold for my toes.
That is true. Maybe you should stay on the dry sand.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I win at chess?
Try to protect your king first. Do you have a favorite piece?
I like the queen because she is strong.
The queen is very powerful, yes. Is the board full of pieces?
Yes, there are many little soldiers too.
Soldiers move small but work well together. Have you played a full game yet?
I only played one and I lost the queen.
That happens to everyone. Do you want to play again?
Yes, I want to try again.
Good, practice makes you better.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the water at the harbour so quiet today?
It is quiet because there is no wind. Do you like calm water?
I do, but I miss the big boats. Where did they go?
They went out to sea to catch fish.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared to sing in the play.
Taking a deep breath helps a lot. Do you like loud noises?
Yes, I do, but my voice shakes.
Practicing in a quiet room works wonders.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am confused about what day it is.
Do you know if the shops are open?
I think it is a quiet day for work.
Is it the start of the week?
I do not remember the name of the day.
Maybe you can look at a clock.
The clock only shows the time.
Do you see a calendar nearby?
I see a paper with numbers on it.
Count the numbers to help you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am feeling very happy today.
That is a great feeling. What made you smile?
I found a lost toy in my room.
How did you feel when you saw it?
I felt like jumping with joy.
That sounds fun. Do you jump often?
Not really, just when I am very happy.
Happy moments are special.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see big drops falling from the grey sky.
Yes, that is rain. Do you like when it is wet?
It makes a loud noise on the roof.
I like that sound too. Is it cold outside?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like how the book ended. The bear was sad.
That feels bad. Did you want a happy end?
Yes, I wanted to hug the bear. It felt alone.
It is good you care. What did you do with the book?
I put it on the shelf. I felt too full.
Taking a break helps. Do you want to read another story?
No, not yet. I just wanted to talk.
I am happy to listen.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go very fast.
Is your bike working?
Yes, but I forgot my helmet.
Please put it on. Is it safe?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see a rainbow! I am late!
A rainbow is a sign of good luck. Do you like rain?
No, I hate rain. I must run now.
Running is good for your health. Where are you going?
To work. Please stop talking.
I am sorry. I hope you arrive on time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here, but I do not know which bus to take.
That is okay, I am here to help. Which way are you going?
I want to go to the park near the big tree.
That bus is going that way. Do you have your ticket?
Yes, I do, but the lights are blinking.
The driver will come to check them. Let us wait for him.
He is coming! What do I say?
Just tell him you are going to the park. It is easy.
Okay, I will try. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Have a great ride.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The water is too cold and the sand has shells. I do not like the beach today.
That can feel bad. Do you want to sit in the shade?
Yes, but I am still sad. My umbrella broke too.
I am sorry about your umbrella. Is there a bench near us?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very angry. I want to give up.
That is a tough feeling. Do you like to take deep breaths?
Yes, but it does not help. I am still stuck.
Try to sit still for one minute. Does your heart beat fast?
Yes, it beats very loud. I feel so small.
Your body needs time to calm down. Is there a quiet place you can go?
Yes, my room is quiet. I will go there now.
That is a wise choice. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I won the game.
That is great. Did you use a sneaky move?
I found a two of hearts.
Lucky find. Do you know how to make a pair?
I do not know.
A pair is two cards with the same number. Nice try, friend.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to go camping, but I do not know where.
The forest near your home is great. Do you like climbing trees?
I do, but I am scared of the dark.
That is normal. Bring a bright light to help.
What else should I pack?
I know you need a tent and a bag. Are you going alone?
Yes, just me. Is that okay?
It is fine if you tell a friend where you go. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking up at the sky, but I do not know what to do next.
That is okay. Do you see any white fluff?
Yes, there are many shapes, but I am not sure which one is right.
Some look like sheep and some look like mountains. Do you want to draw them?
I think I will just watch them move slowly.
That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big boat at the dock. What does it do?
It helps people go across the water. Do you like boats?
Yes, I do! Can a boat go in the rain?
Yes, many boats can go in the rain. Are you brave enough to go out?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am very late for the bus.
I am sorry you are late. Did you miss the red light?
No, I was just in the house. What do I do now?
You can walk to the stop. Are you wearing your shoes?
Yes, I have my shoes on. Is the next bus soon?
I do not know the exact time. Do you have a watch?
I have a watch, but it is broken. Will the bus come soon?
It should come soon. Is it raining outside?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My team lost the game. I feel so sad.
That is a big letdown. Did you play a good game?
I think I did, but we still lost.
A good play is still a win for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to make pasta, but I do not know how to cook the sauce.
You can just mix canned tomatoes with some herbs. Do you have any herbs?
I have basil and a bit of garlic. Is that enough?
Yes, that sounds very good. What else do you have?
I have some oil and salt. Should I add them?
Add a little oil and a pinch of salt. How long do you want to cook it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does that bird have a bright red head?
That color helps it find a mate. Do you like red birds?
Yes, I do. Why do they sing so loud?
They sing to tell other birds to stay away from their spot.
I see. Do all birds have loud voices?
No, some birds are very quiet. What kind of bird is that?
I think that is a blue jay. Why do they jump so much?
They jump to look for food on the ground. Do you see any nuts?
I see a worm. Why does it eat that?
I do not know if that bird eats worms. Do you want to watch it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love working from home today.
That sounds nice. What is your favorite part?
I drink coffee in my cozy chair.
I like that. Do you get to rest often?
Yes, I sit in the sun for ten minutes.
Sounds so good. I am happy for you.
It feels very calm and quiet here.
I wish I could sit there too.
Maybe you can visit next week.
I would love that. Do you want help with anything?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see the dinosaur hall. Where is it?
It is on the second floor. What kind of dinosaurs do you like?
I love big ones. Will I get tired walking?
Yes, it takes some time. Do you want to sit on a bench?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do magnets pull on copper?
No, they do not. Do you have a lot of wires?
Yes, and I need to know fast.
Magnets only pull on iron and steel. I hope that helps.
What about the fridge door?
It is made of steel. Is your fridge old?
Not really, just in a rush.
Then it will stick well. Good luck with your task.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
They fly to flowers and get sweet nectar. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I love candy. What do they do with the nectar?
They put it in the hive and fan it with their wings. It gets thick and sticky.
So the air dries it up?
Yes, the water goes away. Does that sound like making soup?
I don't know about soup. Is it ready now?
Not yet, it needs time to get right. Do you wait for cookies to bake?
Yes, I watch them puff up. Can I have some honey?
You can, it is a tasty treat. Thank you for asking!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a box with no note inside. I am not sure what to do.
That sounds tricky. What is in the box?
It looks like a tool, but I do not know who it belongs to.
You can look for a name tag.
There is no name, just a plain label.
That is hard to tell. Would you like to ask a neighbor?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw the moon tonight and it looked like a big white plate.
That is a lovely picture. Did you look up for a long time?
Yes, I watched it float above the trees until my eyes felt tired.
The moon does move slowly and calmly. Do you think it is lonely up there?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad because my teacher moved away today.
That sounds hard to accept. Do you miss playing outside with her?
Yes, I miss her games. Will she come back soon?
I do not know for sure. Did she give you a special goodbye gift?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse today.
That sounds like fun. Did it look happy?
It was eating some green grass.
Horses like to eat grass. Was the horse alone?
There was a little white pony nearby.
A pony is a small horse. How old was the little one?
I do not know. It looked very young.
Young horses are cute. Did you say hello to them?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my tomatoes taste sweet?
Give them lots of sun and water. Do you know how to tell if they need more water?
How do I know when the soil is too dry?
Stick your finger in the dirt. If it feels dry up to the first knuckle, it is time to water.
Okay, I will try that tomorrow.
That sounds like a good plan. What kind of vegetable comes next?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the wind blow?
It moves because warm air rises and cool air rushes in to take its place. Do you feel it on your face?
Does the wind get tired?
I do not know if wind feels tired, but it often slows down near trees or buildings. Is it windy where you stand?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The lights are out and I am late for work.
That is very stressful. Do you have any candles?
No, I do not. What should I do?
Try to find a flashlight. Is it safe outside?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My screen is all black now.
Oh no. That sounds scary. Is the power light on?
It is dark. I think it is broken.
Maybe it just needs a rest. Have you tried turning it off?
I do not want to. I like my games.
I get it. It feels bad to lose fun. Do you have a cable?
Yes, I have a lot of wires.
Okay. Let us check the plug.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I packed my bag for the woods.
That sounds like a lot of work. Did you get a tent?
Yes, I got a red tent and a big map.
A red tent is bright and easy to spot. What do you want to cook?
I plan to roast hot dogs over a fire.
That smells like a good plan. Do you have matches?
I have matches, wood, and a warm shirt.
You seem ready for a cold night. I do not know if you will be too warm in that shirt.
It is not too cold where I am going.
Then you will sleep well under the stars.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what movie to pick tonight.
That can feel hard. What kind of story do you like?
I like fun stories with animals, but I feel tired.
A soft animal tale might help you rest. Do you want something that makes you smile?
Yes, I just want a little joy.
Then pick the one with the happy puppy. It is a safe pick for a tired mind.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a ladybug on my leaf. It is so red and cute.
That sounds like a happy find. Do you know where it is going?
I think it is just resting for a bit. I do not want to scare it.
You are being very kind to the bug. Is it moving its legs?
Yes, one tiny leg is moving. It looks like it is dancing.
How lovely for you to see that. Do you have other bugs in your garden?
I see ants near my flowers too. They are very small.
Ants are hard workers. Do you talk to them sometimes?
I whisper hello to them. It makes me feel less lonely.
That is a sweet thing to do. Do the ants listen?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking up at the sky. I do not know what I should do next.
The stars are bright and cold. Do you like looking at them?
I feel very small under that big sky. I want to touch a star.
You can never touch a star from here. Do you know which ones glow the brightest?
I see a bright one near the top. It looks like a giant white dot.
That might be a planet, not a star. I am not sure. Do you want to count the dots?
I will count the ones I can see. It helps me feel calm.
Counting is a good way to feel safe. Do you find them easy to see?
Yes, some are easy and some are hard. I think I will just sit and watch.
Sitting and watching is a nice thing to do. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The rain is too heavy.
Please take your umbrella. Are you going to work?
I have no umbrella. I will run.
That is not safe. Do you have a coat?
My coat is small. It will not help.
I do not know your path. Are you near a store?
I must go now. Goodbye.
Please be safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to paint a red apple.
That sounds fun. Do you have red paint ready?
Yes, but I do not know how to make it look round.
Start with a circle. Then add a darker shadow at the bottom to make it look 3D.
Oh, a shadow. What do I use for the stem?
Green or brown works well. Do you have green?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Who is playing next?
Is that Manchester United? I think they play today.
Yes, but I must run. Who is the star?
I do not know the best player right now. Do you like the red team?
I love them. What time does it start?
It starts at seven. Be safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to run fast. Do I need big shoes?
No, you just need shoes that fit well. Do you have a favorite pair to run in?
I have sneakers that hurt my feet. How do I make them comfortable?
Try wearing thick socks or letting them sit in a warm room. Do you usually run on grass or pavement?
I run on the sidewalk. Is that bad for my legs?
Pavement is hard, so it can be tiring. It is okay to start slow and rest if you hurt.
Thank you. I will try walking first, then jogging.
That is a smart plan. I hope your feet feel happy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I caught a big fish today! I am so happy.
That is wonderful news. Did you get to see it jump?
Yes, it jumped high in the air. It was silver and shiny.
How lovely. Was the water cold?
It was very cold. My hands were freezing.
You must be brave. Did you keep the fish?
I put it back. I let it go home.
That is kind of you. Did the water feel warm when you pulled it out?
No, it was still ice cold. I love this lake.
It sounds like a special place.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now. Do pigs make a sound like dogs?
No, they say oink. Do you like mud?
I am late! Does a cow have horns?
Some do, and some do not. Is that your last stop?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My teacher makes me feel happy when I read out loud.
That is a nice feeling. Do you like reading stories?
Yes, I like the ones with big dogs.
Big dogs are fun to draw. What is the dog's name?
I do not know her name.
I am sorry. Do you want to make up a name?
I want to play hide and seek after class.
That sounds like good fun. Who do you hide from?
I hide from the giant.
That is a brave game. Are you scared of the giant?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very hungry but I do not know what to pick.
That is a hard choice. Do you like hot food or cold food?
I like warm things, like soup or a big burger.
A warm burger is a good idea. It is full of yummy meat and bread.
What should I drink with it?
Cold juice is nice with hot food. Do you like apple or orange juice?
