I think I will take the chicken and the orange juice.
That is a smart pick. I hope it tastes good for you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared to move to a new home. What should I do first?
Pack your favorite toys in a red box. Do you have a big truck ready?
No, I do not have a truck. Is that bad?
Do not worry, I can help you find one. How many boxes do you have?
I have many boxes, but my arms are tired.
Ask your mom for help. Can you drink some water now?
Yes, I will drink water. I feel better.
That is good. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My cat just rolled on the floor.
That looks like a lot of fun! What color is your cat?
It is bright orange and very soft.
I bet it feels like a warm cloud. Does it like to sleep in the sun?
Yes, it sleeps in a sunny spot all day.
That is a cozy place for a nap.
I love watching it sleep.
It must be happy with you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see the old ships at the museum.
That is a great idea. Do you like boats?
Yes, I do. How much does it cost to go in?
I am not sure of the price. Do you have any extra coins?
I have some. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have fun there.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
It is quiet because it is late at night. Do you like the silence?
I like it, but why do the houses look dark?
The people are asleep and the lights are off. Is your house dark too?
No, my light is on. Why is the moon so bright?
I do not know the exact reason. Do you see any stars?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My bike is going very fast when I go down the hill. I am a bit scared.
It is normal to feel scared when things move fast. Do you have a helmet on?
Yes, I have a red helmet on. I want to go faster but I am worried about falling.
That is smart to wear your helmet. You can try sitting in the middle of the seat to feel more steady.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to paint a sky but I do not know which color to use.
Try a soft blue. Is it day or night?
It is day. The blue looks too dark.
Mix in some white to make it lighter. Do you like the result?
Yes, it looks nice. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Go make some art.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn tennis. How do I start?
That is a great goal. Do you have a racket yet?
I have a racket and some balls. Where should I hit them?
A hard court is a good place to start. Do you like playing alone?
I play with my friend most days. How do I hit the ball hard?
Swing your arm fast and step into the ball. Do you know how to grip the racket?
I hold it like a hammer. Is that right?
That is a common grip for beginners.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake bread. What do I need?
You need flour, water, yeast, and salt. Do you like sweet or plain bread?
I like sweet bread. How do I start?
Mix the ingredients in a big bowl. Then let it sit for an hour. Is your kitchen warm?
Yes, it is warm. What happens next?
Take the dough out and press it flat. Then put it in a pan and bake it. Would you like to add some raisins?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The water looks very calm today.
Yes, the sea is smooth like glass. Do you like boats?
I love them, but I do not know how they float.
The ship has air inside to help it stay up. Do you like fish?
Fish are nice, but I want to know about the cranes.
Those big arms lift heavy boxes onto the ships. Is it cold out?
It is a little cool. Is the harbor busy now?
I am not sure, but I can see lights in the distance. Do you want to look?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need to pack my books for the move. How do I keep them safe?
Put the heaviest books on the bottom of the box. Do you have sturdy boxes?
Yes, I have big boxes. Should I wrap the glass ones?
Wrap glass books in cloth or paper to stop them breaking. Are you moving far away?
We are going to a new city. Is that hard to carry?
It is heavy, so it is hard to carry alone. Would you like help with the lifting?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I want to stop. The words are too hard.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you like the sound of the new words?
No. I only make mistakes.
Mistakes help your brain grow. How many words did you learn today?
Just one. I feel so slow.
One is a great start. Is it hard to say the words?
Yes. My mouth feels big.
That is normal. Can you try saying the word again?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the baby cried for three hours.
That sounds very hard. How did you feel after that?
I felt so tired and confused.
It is normal to feel that way. Do you want to sit with me?
Yes, I just need a break.
You are doing a good job. Can I get you some water?
Yes, that would be nice.
Here you go. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the ocean fast.
Go straight ahead. Do you have a towel?
Yes, but I am so late.
Look for the tall palm trees. Are you swimming today?
Just walking to the water.
It is warm and bright.
Thank you, I must run.
Have fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am very scared of the big test tomorrow.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you like math or words better?
I like words, but I am bad at spelling.
That is a good start. You can practice a few words with me.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do at the party.
That feels big. Do you like loud music?
No, it makes my head hurt.
What about dancing?
I think my feet are too tired.
Perhaps you can just sit and eat cake. Do you like chocolate?
Yes, I love chocolate cake.
Then you can sit and eat it. That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very scared about my test tomorrow.
That is okay to feel that way. Are you ready for the main parts?
I think I forgot the math rules.
Math is hard sometimes. Did you study them last night?
I read them once, but I was tired.
It helps to rest your mind. Do you have snacks for the break?
Yes, I have an apple and some crackers.
Food helps you think better. Did you sleep well last night?
I am sleepy, but I want to pass.
Good sleep is key to doing your best.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. I do not know why.
That sounds painful. Did you hit your head recently?
I think I bumped my door. It is very sore.
You should rest and drink some water. Do you have any medicine?
I have pills, but I am not sure if they will work.
Take the pill and lie down if you feel tired. Is the pain getting worse?
It hurts more when I look at the screen.
Put the screen away for now. How is it feeling after a minute?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to help my friend, but I am not sure how to start.
That is a kind wish. Do you know what is making them sad?
I think he is lonely because he moved here a week ago.
You could invite him to play with you. Does he like to build things?
Yes, he likes building blocks very much.
Then invite him to a block party. Would you like to share your snacks too?
I would love to share my cookies with him.
Sharing is a great way to show care. You will do a good job.
Thank you, I feel better now.
You are welcome. I hope he smiles today.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is very loud today. I am scared of the thunder.
It is okay to feel that way. Is your house safe and warm?
Yes, the windows are closed. But the lights might go out soon.
Good. Do you have some flashlights ready?
I think so, but I am not sure. What should I do if the power stops?
I do not know your exact plan. Keep your phone charged if you can.
I will go check the battery. Thank you for helping me feel better.
You are welcome. Stay close to a safe spot.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the birds sing so loud in the morning?
They sing to tell other birds this spot is theirs. Do you hear them singing in your yard too?
Yes, I do. Why do they need to tell everyone that?
It helps them find a mate and keep away trouble. Is it a big bird or a small one?
It is a small, brown bird. Why is it brown?
Brown helps it hide from hungry hawks. Do you like to watch them fly?
Yes, I do. Why do they fly high up in the sky?
They fly high to see far away and stay safe. Do you like the sound of their wings?
It is a nice sound. Why do they come to my feeder?
They come because you put tasty seeds there. I do not know why they prefer that spot, but I am glad they are here.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to read in bed at night. How do I do that?
You can use a small lamp with a dim light. Do you have one?
No, I do not have a lamp. What should I buy?
You might try a battery clip light. Are you a night owl?
Yes, I like being awake late. How do I stay up safely?
Keep the light low and close your eyes when sleepy. Do you get tired easily?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what day it is. I forgot my plans.
Is it Monday or Tuesday? Mondays are for work, and Tuesdays are for play.
I think it is Wednesday. I am very bored and do not know what to do.
I do not know your favorite games. Do you like to read books?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue boat by the water today.
That sounds like a nice boat. Do you like boats?
It looked very old and a little bit rusty.
Old boats can be very special. What was it doing?
It was just sitting still on the quiet lake.
That sounds very peaceful.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my first day. Where is the office?
I do not know which job you have. Do you have a map?
I have a paper, but the map is tiny.
Zoom in on the screen. Is the green dot moving?
It is not moving. I feel scared.
You will do fine. Take a slow breath.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The leaves are falling everywhere. I feel sad.
It is nature's way to rest. Do you like looking at the colors?
I do, but I do not know what to do next.
You can just watch them fall. It is quiet and calm. Do you like the sound?
I guess I just need to stop worrying.
That is a good thing. Just breathe in the cool air.
Okay, I will try to be happy now.
That is wonderful. Enjoy the peace.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake a cake.
That is a fun goal. Do you have the oven ready?
Yes, I have the oven. What do I need first?
You need flour, sugar, and eggs. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I love sweet food. What do I do with them?
Mix them well, then put them in the hot oven. Did you check the time?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am so tired from work today.
That sounds very hard. Did you finish all your tasks?
Yes, but it took a long time.
I am happy you managed it. What helped you keep going?
I did not know if I could do it.
Being unsure is normal. Did you take any breaks to rest?
Just a quick one. Why does it feel so heavy?
Tired minds feel things more strongly. I hope you can sleep well now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know which season is next. I am running late.
It is winter. Do you like the cold?
No, I only care about getting to work. What comes after winter?
It is spring. Is that better for you?
Maybe, but I must go now. Thanks.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I play that song on the piano?
You press the keys in the right order. Do you like the sound?
Yes, but I forget which keys go next.
Try to slow down and listen closely. Do you practice every day?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park and saw a big red dog.
That sounds like a fun day. Did the dog bark at you?
No, it just sat down and looked at me.
A friendly dog is a good thing. What did you do next?
I gave it a stick and we played for a bit.
Dogs love to play with sticks. It is nice to see happy animals.
Now I am home and I want a drink of juice.
Juice is a good drink after play. You must be tired.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why does the ship stay up?
It pushes water down. The water pushes back. Is it heavy?
It is huge. Just give me the simple truth.
Heavy things sink. Ships are wide. They push lots of water. Does that help?
I still do not get it.
I do not know your exact boat. But light wood floats.
I have to run.
I hope you make it. Did that work?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a map but I do not know where to go.
That can feel scary. Do you want to find a park?
Yes, I need some fresh air.
Look for the green lines on the map. Do you see them?
Yes, I see the green lines.
Great. Walk until you find a tree symbol.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to catch the bus. It is coming soon.
I know that bus. It stops right there. Is it your first time riding it?
Yes, I am new here. The roads are so busy.
It looks like a lot of cars. Do you have a map?
No, I do not have a map. I am lost.
I am not sure of your exact spot. Can you point to your building?
It is that tall red building over there.
I see it now. You must go left. Is the door on the front?
Yes, the front door. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a card from my old friend.
That sounds nice. Do you know where he lives now?
I am not sure if I should write to him.
It is hard to decide. Would you like my help?
Yes, but I do not know what to say.
I do not know his life, but I can help you start.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am lost, but I am very happy.
That is a funny feeling. What makes you feel good?
I found a red apple on the ground.
A red apple sounds tasty. Do you want to eat it?
Yes, I am going to share it with you.
That is very kind. Thank you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have so much homework?
It helps your brain learn things. Do you like reading?
I do not know. Why is it hard to finish?
Because your mind gets tired. Do you take breaks?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the internet so big?
It is like a giant web of small webs. Do you like to play with blocks?
Yes, I do. Why do I need a word to find a page?
Words help you pick the right page. Do you like to use a map?
I guess so. Why do pictures load fast?
Small pictures travel faster than big ones. Do you like to wait for food?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I get a card to borrow books?
You just sign a short form at the desk. Do you have a piece of ID with you?
Yes, I have my student ID.
Great, show that to the librarian. They will write down your name for you.
Is it free to borrow books?
Yes, it is free. Do you have a home address for the form?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a new friend today. I am very happy to tell you.
That is wonderful news. What did you do together?
We played ball in the park all afternoon.
That sounds like a lot of fun.
We laughed so much our bellies hurt.
I am glad you had such a good day.
We promise to play again next week.
I like that they want to see you again.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I like big hills but I do not know what to do with them.
That is nice. Do you like to climb?
I think I do, but I am not sure how to start.
You can just walk up slowly. Do you have good shoes?
I have them, but my legs feel tired just thinking about it.
Rest first. Do you want to sit down?
Yes, please. I think I will come back later.
That sounds good. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because the leaves are falling off the trees.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like looking at the leaves?
Yes, I do. But why do they have to fall?
They fall to save the tree for winter. Have you ever seen a bare tree?
Yes, they look lonely. Is the tree hurting?
No, the tree is just resting. Do you think it misses the leaves?
I hope it does not. When will new leaves come back?
They will return when it gets warmer. Do you want to plant a tree?
Maybe. I just want to be happy again.
I know you can be happy. Is there anything else you want to do?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the boat float on the water?
It floats because it pushes the water down. Do you like water?
Why does it look so blue?
The sky is blue, so the water looks blue. Do you see the sky?
Why does it stop when I want it to go?
I do not know why it stopped. Is your engine okay?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The baby pulls at my hair. How do I stop it?
Try giving him a soft toy to chew on. Does he only do it when you look at him?
Yes, he seems to like the sound I make. It is funny.
Babies love the feeling of connection. Do you read to him often?
I try, but he cries quickly. Is that normal?
It can be, as he may not want to be quiet yet. He might just be hungry.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I said I would help you today. I am sorry I forgot.
It is okay. Did you have a hard day?
Yes. I felt sad and forgot everything.
I understand. Can you tell me what you need now?
I just need you to wait for me.
I am here. I will wait as long as you need.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the snow so white?
Snow looks white because it reflects all the colors of light. Do you like building snowmen?
Yes, I love them. Why do we eat turkey on Thanksgiving?
People eat turkey to share a big meal with family. Is that your favorite dish?
It is good. Why do we give gifts?
We give gifts to show we care about people. Do you open yours right away?
I always do. Why does the sun set in the west?
I do not know the exact reason, but the earth spins to make it look like the sun moves.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at my cat! She is so cute.
She looks very happy. Does she like to play?
Yes, she loves the red ball.
That is a great game. How old is she?
She is two years old.
Two is a fun age. Does she like treats?
She loves fish treats.
Yum. What is her favorite spot to sleep?
She sleeps on my bed.
That is very sweet. Thank you for sharing that.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I be polite at dinner?
Please say please and thank you. Do you want to know about table manners?
Yes, what do I do with my elbows?
Keep them off the table.
What else should I remember?
Smile and look at the person you are talking to. Is that clear to you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost in the past. What should I read next?
That is a hard question. What era calls to you?
Maybe old ships. They sound fun.
Ships are a great pick. I do not know your favorite type of boat. Do you like big warships?
No, I like calm boats. I am still unsure.
Calm boats are lovely. I will not guess for you. Is there a story you want to tell?
I just want to learn something true.
Truth is always worth seeking. Take your time. Have you tried looking at old maps?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! My meeting went very well.
That is great news. Did you get what you needed?
Yes, they said yes to my big idea.
I am glad for you. What is the next step?
I get to start working on it today.
That sounds like fun. Are you excited?
I am very excited.
Good. Let me know how it goes.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do bugs have hearts?
Yes, bugs have a sort of heart that runs along their back. Do you like bugs?
I think they are scary.
Some bugs are big, but many are very tiny and shy. Do you have a favorite bug?
I like butterflies because they look nice.
Butterflies start as caterpillars and then grow wings. Is your favorite color blue or yellow?
The rain is coming, do bugs get wet?
Yes, rain can make bugs wet and they must stay dry. Do you like playing in the rain?
I do not like getting wet.
That makes sense, wet clothes are cold. Do you wear a raincoat when it rains?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel sad because I have no friends to talk to.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like drawing?
I do, but I do not want to draw alone.
That makes sense. Have you tried a club at school?
I did not know they had one.
Maybe ask a teacher about it. Does that sound good?
Yes, I think I will try that.
That is a brave step. I hope it helps.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go in this small village.
There is a warm cafe near the square. Do you like hot drinks?
Yes, I do like them, but I feel lost.
Just walk toward the big clock tower. It is very close.
The clock tower is nice, but I am still not sure what to do next.
Try eating a sweet pie there. Do you have a favorite fruit?
I think I will try the apple pie.
That sounds very good. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel so proud, but I have to run.
That is a nice feeling. What made you win?
I finished my test well. Go.
Well done. Have a fast day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I had a scary dream about a big dark dog.
That sounds scary. Did the dog bite you?
No, it just barked very loud.
I am glad it did not hurt you. Was it a real dog?
I think it was a wolf.
A wolf can be a big dream beast. Do you feel safe now?
Yes, because the sun came up.
The sun is a good friend. Good morning.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because my clothes are all clean and fresh.
That is a good feeling. Do you like the smell?
Yes, they smell like the nice soap I used.
That sounds pleasant.
I washed them in the big machine today.
Did it take a long time?
It took an hour, but it was worth it.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need to see the doctor but I do not know how to call.
That is easy. Do you have the phone number for the clinic?
Yes, I have the number. What should I say when they answer?
Just say you want to book a visit. Is it for a new problem or a checkup?
It is for a sore throat. How do I ask for a time?
You can ask for a time that works for you. Do you prefer mornings or afternoons?
I like mornings. What if there is no time left?
Then they may suggest a nearby clinic. Just take the first open slot.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do bugs have so many legs?
Most bugs have six legs because it helps them walk well. Do you have a favorite bug?
Yes, I like ants.
Ants are hard workers who lift heavy things. Do you like to watch them carry food?
I think they are strong.
I am not sure how many times they can lift their body weight. But they are very clever.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My dress is torn. I am so sad.
Oh no, that is very hard. Do you have a spare?
No, I do not. It is my best one.
That is a true problem. Is your heart okay?
It hurts a lot. I want to cancel.
Breathe with me, please. You can fix this.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy here. The sand is soft and the sun is warm.
That sounds very nice. Do you like the sound of the waves?
Yes, I do. Please sit with me and watch the water.
I would love that.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy that my sunflower grew! I want to tell you how it drinks water.
That is wonderful news. Do you think the roots are working hard?
Yes, the roots are deep and busy pulling up the water.
Nice detail. How does the water get to the leaves?
It goes up tiny tubes inside the stem all the way to the top.
Nature is full of tricks. Do you see any droplets on the leaves?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I clean a window well?
Start by spraying the glass with water. Do you have a squeegee ready?
No, I only have a towel.
A soft towel works very well for small windows. Just wipe in one direction at a time.
What should I use for the dirt?
A little soap in warm water is best. How big is your window?
It is about a foot tall.
That is small enough for a quick clean. Finish by drying the edges.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is it sunny outside?
Yes, the sun is out and bright. Do you like sunny days?
I do. It feels warm on my face.
That is very nice. Warmth feels good.
Should I wear my shorts?
Yes, shorts are perfect for today. Do you like wearing shorts?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a movie at home. What do I need?
You need a camera and some friends to act. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I have a phone. How do I start the story?
Pick a simple idea like a lost toy. Where is your favorite place to play?
I like the garden. How do I put the clips together?
Use a free app on your phone to cut them. Are you excited to try?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a magnet stick to a wall?
You can put a piece of paper on the wall first. Does your magnet have a back?
Yes, it is just round metal.
Then try taping it to a small sticky note. Do you have any tape?
I have some clear tape.
Stick the note to the wall, then put the tape on the magnet. Is it staying up?
Yes, it is up now!
Great job. Do you want to try it on another spot?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am sad because my test was hard.
I am sorry you feel that way. What was the hardest part for you?
The math problems took too long.
Math can be tricky. Do you like math or not?
I do not like it at all.
That is okay to feel. Is there a teacher who helps you?
My teacher is very nice.
That is good news. Do you ask her for help?
Yes, she makes it easier.
Great job asking for help. I am glad it feels better now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad. My piggy bank is empty again.
That sounds hard. Do you have a plan for next week?
Not really. I just want fun things.
Fun is good. What thing costs the most?
Candy and toys.
Try one small treat. How does that feel?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Where do I find the red book with the dragon on the cover?
It is on the third shelf. Do you like dragons?
Yes, they are very cool.
Great choice. Do you want to check out a book about knights too?
No, just the dragon one please.
Okay, here you go. Have fun reading.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late this morning.
Oh no, that is tricky. Did you still get to eat breakfast?
Yes, I had toast and jam.
That sounds yummy. What was the best part of your day so far?
I saw a big blue bird in my garden.
Wow, what a lovely sight. Did it sing to you?
It did not sing, but it looked at me.
That is a sweet memory. What are you doing next?
I want to make a plan for the weekend.
That is a great idea. What activities do you like the most?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to pack for my lunch.
Try bringing some fruit and a sandwich. Do you like bread?
I do like bread, but I also want to drink something cold.
A bottle of juice is a good pick. Is it very hot outside?
It is a sunny day, so I want to sit under a tree.
That sounds very nice and cool. Do you have a blanket?
I forgot the blanket at home.
You can bring a towel from the bathroom.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel scared and do not know what to do.
It is okay to feel scared. What is making you worry?
I am worried about a big test tomorrow.
That can feel heavy. Have you studied a little today?
Yes, but my brain feels foggy.
Try to take slow breaths. Sleep will help your brain rest.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What does the internet really do?
It helps you find things and send messages. Do you like reading online?
I sometimes read stories, but it gets slow.
Slow speeds can be frustrating, but it usually works. Do you live near a big city?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made bread today and I am so happy!
That sounds very sweet. Who did you make it for?
I want to share it with my friends.
What a kind thing to do. Do they like sweet or plain bread?
I think they like both, but the sweet one is my favorite.
That makes sense. Did you use honey in it?
Yes, I used a lot of honey.
It must smell nice. Is it still hot?
No, it is cool now.
Good. Then it is ready to eat.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do fish have ears?
Yes, they do. Do you like fish?
I like to catch them. Where do fish live?
Most live in the water. Do you go to a lake?
Yes, with my dad. What do they eat?
They eat bugs and tiny fish. Do you know how?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a hidden box.
That is exciting. What is inside?
It has shiny stones.
Do you know whose they are?
I think they are mine.
You can keep them if you want.
Is that okay?
Yes, it is totally fine.
Thank you for helping.
I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Where is the mill?
The mill is by the big tree. Is your bag very heavy?
It is light. Is there a fast path?
Yes, the red road is quick. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had so much coffee this morning. My hands shook all day.
That sounds tough. Did you drink any tea to help?
Yes, I switched to warm tea by noon. It calmed me right down.
Tea is very kind to the body. Do you like green tea or black tea?
I really love green tea. It smells like fresh leaves.
That is a nice way to end a busy day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my phone in the mud today. The screen is all smudgy now.
Oh no, that is not good. Did you wipe it clean?
Yes, I used a towel. Now it looks like new again.
Good job fixing it. Do you have any games to play?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I heard you have a big secret.
It is true. I am hiding something. What do you want to know?
Why are you hiding it?
I want to keep it safe. Do you like surprises?
Yes, I love surprises.
Good. I will tell you later.
Can I help you keep it safe?
Yes, that is very kind.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see smoke coming from my kitchen. What should I do?
Please get out of the house right now. Are you holding your nose?
I am safe outside. The fire is still big.
Good. You must stay away and wait for help. Do you feel okay?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I want to tell you about my little brother.
That is good to hear. What made you so happy?
He gave me a big hug. He is very kind.
How sweet of him to do that. Does he do that often?
Yes, almost every morning. He also shared his toys with me.
You are a lucky person. I do not know your brother, but he sounds nice. Do you play with him?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a song that makes me feel very happy.
That is lovely. What does it sound like?
It has a fast beat and bright words.
I do not know the song, but that sounds fun. Do you sing along?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it sunny outside?
Yes, the sun is bright. Do you like sunny days?
I do, but I feel cold.
The air is cold today. Do you have a warm coat?
Yes, I have my red one.
That is a good choice. Is it too windy out?
It is very windy.
The wind is strong today. Do you want to stay inside?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to ride the bus, but I do not know how.
I can help you with that. Are you afraid of big wheels?
I am a little scared. How do I start?
Step on gently and hold the pole tight.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like hot tea. It smells nice.
Tea is warm and cozy. Do you drink it with milk?
I like coffee too. It is dark.
Coffee can be hot and strong. Which one is your favorite?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a blue bird in the park today. It was sad and cold.
That is a sweet thing to do. Was the bird alone?
Yes, it had no home. I gave it some warm bread.
Good for you. Did the bird eat the bread?
Yes, it ate it fast. Then it flew away happily.
That must feel nice to help. What did you do after?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does a big ship stay on the water?
It floats because it pushes a lot of water aside. The water pushes back up on the ship. Do you like water?
I do. But why does it not sink down?
The ship is mostly empty space, so it is light. This makes it push less hard than the water can hold.
That makes sense. What if the boat fills with water?
Then it gets heavy and sinks. It cannot push enough water out of the way anymore. Is that scary to think about?
A little bit. Can a fish swim under it?
Yes, a fish can swim right under the hull. The ship sits on top of the water.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream and it fell on the floor. I felt very sad.
That is a shame. Do you have a napkin?
No, I do not. My cup is also broken.
Let us find a cleaner. Are you hurt?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a big pizza for lunch today.
That sounds very tasty. Do you like cheese on it?
Yes, I put a lot of cheese on my pizza.
That is a fun choice. What else goes on your slice?
I also put on some green beans.
I like beans too, but I do not know if they are on the menu. Are you happy with your pick?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Is the river safe to cross? I am late.
The water looks calm and slow. Are you going to work?
Yes, I need to get there fast. Is it deep?
I do not know the exact depth. Please use the bridge.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel so happy about my drawing. Did I do a good job?
Yes, you did a wonderful job. I can see you tried very hard. What part of the drawing are you most happy with?
The big red sun is my favorite part.
The sun looks very warm and bright. It makes the picture feel nice. Do you want to draw another picture tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a ladybug! It was red and had black spots.
That sounds so cute! Is it still on your hand?
Yes, it is crawling on my thumb. I feel so happy seeing it.
Ladybugs are good for gardens because they eat pests.
Really? I want to put it back outside.
Yes, let it go back to the flowers. Do you like watching bugs?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke the puzzle and I feel very sad.
That is a hard thing to fix. Do you want to try again together?
I just want it to look perfect again.
We can find the right pieces. Do you remember where the sky goes?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I make bread?
Mix flour, water, and yeast. Do you have any yeast?
Yes, I have yeast. What is next?
Let the mix sit for a while. Is your kitchen warm?
It is warm. Now what?
Shape it and put it in an oven. I do not know your exact time.
Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have fun baking.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my phone take a picture?
Tap the circle button on the screen. Do you want to learn how to delete one later?
Yes, please show me.
Open the photo and tap the trash can icon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very nervous about my meeting tomorrow.
That is a normal feeling. Are you worried about talking to people?
Yes, I fear saying the wrong words.
Take a slow breath before you speak.
What should I do if I forget what I planned to say?
You can take a small piece of paper to help you.
Will looking at the paper make me look bad?
No, it shows you are ready. Do you have your notes packed?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I ran very fast today. I feel so good.
That is great. How long did you run?
For a full hour. My legs felt strong.
That is amazing. Do you plan to run again soon?
Yes, I want to go every day. I love the fresh air.
Nice. What helps you stay happy while running?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My phone fell in the sink. It is all wet and cold.
Oh no, that sounds scary. Did you take the battery out?
Yes, I pulled it out right away. Now the phone is just a cold block.
Good job. The dry part is next. Did you find a towel?
I used my shirt to wipe it. It looks clean, but the screen is dark.
A shirt works well. I do not know if the screen will turn on yet. Are you scared?
A little. I hope my pictures are still there.
We can only wait to see. Do you have a charger nearby?
Yes, here it is. I am plugging it in now.
That is the right move. Let us watch for a light.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do plants get their water?
They use their roots to pull it up from the soil. Do you like to watch them grow?
Yes, I do. How does the water move up the tall parts?
It travels through tiny tubes inside the stem. Do you have a big plant?
I have a bean plant. Does the water go into the leaves?
Yes, it goes up to the leaves where the sun helps make food. Do you give it water every day?
Sometimes I forget. What happens if it gets too dry?
The leaves may start to droop and look sad. Do you want to check it now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Which season is next? I am late for work.
Spring comes next. Do you like the rain?
No, I hate wet shoes. Can you stop?
I am sorry I cannot stop. Do you want to run?
I must go. Please do not talk.
Okay, I will be quiet. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which month is next.
The next month comes right after this one. Do you like rain or snow?
I think I like snow better.
Snow is in the cold months. What do you like to do in the cold?
I like to drink warm tea.
Tea is good when it is cold. Do you have a favorite cup?
Yes, I have a red cup.
A red cup is bright and fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because I have no one to talk to.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to tell me more?
I just sit in my room and feel quiet.
That sounds very hard. What do you usually do when you sit there?
I look out the window and feel small.
I do not know what else is there. It is okay to feel small.
I wish someone would call me today.
I would love to keep you company. Can I sit here with you?
Yes, please, I am not so alone now.
I am happy to be here with you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw the water moving fast today.
That is called a current. Did you see any fish?
No, but it looked cold. Why is it moving?
Rain fills the river and pushes it along. Do you think it will stop soon?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is there only one Monday?
The week has seven days, so each one is unique to its place. Do you like Mondays?
Why do we say Sunday comes after Saturday?
That is how our calendars are built to show the cycle. Is your weekend long?
I do not know why there are seven days.
That is a hard question, and I do not know for sure. Do you like weekends?
Why do days have names?
Names help us tell time and plan our lives. Do you have a favorite day?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get in the pool before the doors close.
The pool is open until eight. Are you going fast?
Yes, I am running right now. I do not have time to chat.
You are safe. Do you have your towel?
I have my towel and my cap. I am almost there.
Great. Have a good swim.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the bank, and I have five minutes.
It is on Main Street, two blocks north. Are you walking there?
No, I am driving, but I lost the map.
Take the second left at the red tower. Did you see the blue sign?
I did not, and I am late.
Look for the tall clock building. It is right next to it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to make a cake for my birthday.
That sounds very fun. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I love them. What do I need?
You need flour, sugar, eggs, and butter. Do you have a oven?
Yes, I have one. How do I mix it?
Mix the dry things first. Then add the wet things. Is your kitchen clean?
Yes, it is clean. What is the last step?
Put it in the heat and wait. Do you want to sing a song?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I tried to fix my bike tire, but it is still flat.
That can feel very sad, but you did a good job trying. What kind of tool did you use?
I used the little pump from the garage.
A pump is a great start. Do you know how to check for holes?
I do not know how to check for holes.
I will tell you a simple way to look. Have you checked the valve for air?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, the rain is falling hard on the roof.
That sounds like a loud song. Is it dark outside?
Yes, it is very dark and wet.
I am glad you are safe inside. Do you like the sound?
I do. It makes me feel happy.
Great. That is a good feeling.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
The sun sends out all colors. Blue light bounces off the air and hits your eyes. Do you see other colors when the sun is low?
Yes, the sunset is orange.
That is true. The light travels through more air and mixes to look orange.
So the air changes the color?
Yes, the air is like a filter. It lets blue through the most.
That makes sense.
I am glad you like it. Do you look up often?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a shiny stone in the park. I feel very happy today.
That sounds like a great find. What color was the stone?
It was blue like the sky. Do you like rocks?
I love them for their shapes. Did you keep it safe?
Yes, it is in my pocket. Thank you for listening.
You are welcome. I am glad you are smiling.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My new baby cries all night. I feel very tired. What should I do?
I am sorry you feel so tired. Try holding him close to your chest. Do you have help from a partner?
Yes, my friend checks on him too. He only sleeps when he is wet.
That is a good sign. Wet diapers can be very loud. How many times does he need a new one?
I do not count them. I just want him to stop crying.
If you do not know, count them for one day. This helps you see a pattern. Let me know what you see.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to paint with bright colors. Do you think I should use blue for the sky?
Yes, blue is a great color for the sky. Do you also use green for the grass?
I use green for the grass and trees. How long does it take for the paint to dry?
It usually takes about an hour to dry. Do you wait before you add more paint?
I wait a little, but not always. Is it bad to paint over wet paint?
It can make the colors mix in odd ways. Do you like when the colors mix?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very hungry. I walked to the park and played for two hours.
That sounds like fun. Do you want a big plate of hot soup?
Yes, please. I am so tired from running around.
I will get that for you right away. Did you enjoy the warm sun?
It was very nice. Now I just want to eat my lunch.
You made a good choice. I hope it tastes good to you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was very bright today. I saw it shine on the red rose in my garden.
That sounds so warm and happy. Did the rose smell nice?
It did, and the wind felt soft too. I just sat and watched the light dance on the leaves.
What a peaceful moment. Do you like the morning sun the best?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy a new bag for school.
What color do you like best?
I like blue, but I do not know which size.
We have small and big bags. Do you carry many books?
Yes, I have five heavy books.
You should pick the big one. It will hold them all.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the shop to buy a new fence today.
A new fence is a big change. Do you like the color of it?
Yes, I picked a nice dark green one.
That sounds very nice. Did the store have what you needed?
They had all the pieces, but the price was high.
Money can be tight sometimes. Is there another shop nearby?
Maybe, but I hope I do not need to go back.
I hope it all works out well. How did you move the long boards?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn a new language but I am lost.
That is hard to do at first. Do you like to read books?
Yes I like reading, but I do not know where to start.
Start with easy words. Can you tell me a word you like?
I like the word cat, but I do not know if that helps.
It helps a lot. Please start with one word a day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My baby cries a lot at night. What should I do?
Try holding him close and humming a song. Is he hungry when he cries?
I think he is sleepy, but I am tired too. How do I rest?
Let someone else watch him for a few hours. Do you have a friend who can help?
I do not know how to feed him correctly. Please help me.
I do not know your baby, but you should ask a doctor. Do you see a doctor soon?
Yes, I am going tomorrow. Thank you for the talk.
That is a good plan. I hope you sleep well tonight.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big brown boat float down the river.
That sounds like a fun ride. What else did you see?
I waved at a man with a red cap.
I am glad you had a nice day. Did you catch any fish?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the tennis court green?
Green helps your eyes see the white ball clearly. Do you like the color green?
Why does the ball have yellow fuzz on it?
The fuzz slows the ball down and makes it move in funny ways. Have you ever held a tennis ball?
Why do players sit on the bench?
I do not know for sure, but I think they rest their legs. Do you get tired after running?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does the big ship stay on top of the water?
The water pushes up with a strong force. Do you like boats?
Yes, I do. But it is so heavy, how?
It pushes a lot of water out of the way. The push matches the weight.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired from the long plane ride.
That sounds hard. Did you have a snack?
I ate a big apple and a cookie.
Good for you. Did you sleep?
I slept for three hours.
That is great rest. Did you see the clouds?
I saw them look like cotton candy.
That sounds pretty. Are you happy now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to play this hand right now.
Okay, here are the cards.
I have to leave soon.
Are you playing alone?
Just me and my friend.
Have fun with your game.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a toy from when I was small. I do not know if I should keep it or let it go.
It is hard to choose. Do you still play with it?
I hold it tight, but I am not sure why.
I cannot know your heart. Is it a happy feeling?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love how sailors sail on big blue waves.
That sounds so much fun. Do you like the sound of the waves?
Yes, I love how they crash against the ship.
I have never heard a ship sail. What does the wind feel like on deck?
The wind is cold and blows my hair all around.
I imagine that is a great feeling.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I dropped the cup and it broke. Why did it break?
The cup is made of glass, so it breaks when it hits the hard floor. Did you feel scared?
Yes, I was very scared. Is there a way to fix it?
No, I do not know how to fix broken glass. Do you have a clean towel to wipe the floor?
I am cleaning it now. Why does the glass not stick back together?
The pieces do not have glue to hold them tight. Are you watching your feet while you clean?
I am looking down. Can I use tape to fix it?
No, do not use tape on broken glass. It is too sharp and not safe. Do you want to throw the pieces in the trash?
Yes, I am putting them in the bin. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I am glad you are safe now. Did you learn something new about glass?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I cannot find my stamp.
That is really annoying. Did you check your pockets?
I looked everywhere. I am sure I had it.
That is a shame. Do you have any other stamps?
No, this was the only one. Now I cannot send my letter.
I am sorry to hear that. The clerk can help you.
Is the clerk busy? I do not want to wait long.
I do not know for sure. Is the line short now?
Yes, it is short. I will go ask him.
That is a good plan. Good luck with your letter.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to swim in that big blue lake. Can I go in?
Please check if swimming is allowed first. Is there a sign by the shore?
I see a sign that says no swimming. What can I do?
You can walk on the path or sit on the grass. Do you like to watch the water?
I do like watching it, but I miss the water. Why is it closed?
I do not know the exact reason, but it might be for safety. Are you bringing a friend?
Yes, my friend is with me. Is it safe to sit near the edge?
Please sit well back from the edge. Is the ground dry where you sit?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I told my friend I would help him, but I am busy. What should I do?
Tell the truth about your time. Do you have a little free hour?
I told my friend I would help him, but I am busy. What should I do?
Be honest and explain your busy schedule.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because I forgot what month it is.
That feels bad. Do you like winter?
No, I hate the cold.
Me too. It is July now.
July? I thought it was March.
I do not know why you think that. Are you hungry?
Yes, my brain is confused.
Eat something sweet. It helps.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we help people?
Because it makes them feel safe. Do you like to feel safe?
Yes, I do. Why is that good?
It helps them grow. What do you like to grow?
I like plants. Do you help plants?
Yes, I water them. Do you have a plant?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I know which way the wind is blowing?
Look at the trees and see which way they lean. Do you see any flags nearby?
I see a flag, but it is not moving.
That means it is a still day with no wind. Do you like calm days?
Yes, I do. How can I make wind just for fun?
You can wave a large sheet or a big leaf. Are you ready to try?
I will go outside and wave my jacket.
Great, have fun feeling the air on your face. Tell me what it feels like.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the lighthouse light flash?
It helps ships see where the rocks are. Do you like to play at night?
I love dark places. What is inside the tower?
There is a long spiral staircase. Does that sound fun to climb?
Yes, it does. Is the light very hot?
The light uses a big electric bulb. I do not know if it gets hot to the touch.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I can't stop tossing and turning. I feel so tired.
That sounds rough. Do you drink tea before bed?
No, I just stare at the ceiling. What should I do?
Try counting slow breaths. It helps many people.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a coffee, but the boss is moving fast.
That sounds busy. Is she always in a hurry?
No, she is usually calm today.
Ah, that is good. What does she say?
She just smiles and waves at me.
That is very kind. Does it help you feel better?
Yes, it makes me smile too.
Good. Are you ready to go?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a little blue bird.
What a sweet bird. What color is its tail?
Its tail is black.
Nice spotting. It is likely a blue jay.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to count the months.
That is a great goal. Do you know what a calendar is?
No, what is a calendar?
It is a chart that shows days and weeks. Can you read numbers?
Yes, I can read numbers.
Good. You just match the names to the numbers. Do you like writing?
Yes, I like writing.
Great. You can write the names in order. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I lost my map and I cannot find the castle.
That is very sad to hear. Do you remember where you last saw it?
I do not know. It is just gone and I am stuck in this dark forest.
I am sorry you are stuck. Let us look for it together, okay?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today. The sun was very bright and warm on my face.
That sounds lovely. Did you bring a hat to keep your head cool?
Yes, I did. The light made everything look so clear.
The sun does help us see. Do you like the warmth or the light more?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am making soup for dinner tonight.
That sounds warm and good. What kind of soup?
It has potatoes and carrots in it.
Oh, I love vegetables. Are you happy with how it smells?
Yes, I am very happy to cook.
That is a nice feeling. I am glad you shared it with me.
Do you want to help me add the salt?
I do not know if I am good at that. Can you tell me when to stop?
Okay, I will tell you when it tastes right.
Thank you for letting me watch. It looks very tasty.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my horse right now. He is missing.
Do you know where he was last seen? I am here to help.
No time for that. I am very late.
We must look in the fields. Do you hear any neighing?
The barn is empty. I checked.
That is not good. Have you tried calling his name?
I am running out of time. He is not home.
Let us check the gate. Is the latch closed?
The gate is open. I found him.
You are safe. Are you happy now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My sister is sad today.
Why is she feeling that way?
She lost her favorite toy.
That must feel like a big loss.
I want to make her happy.
You could try drawing a picture for her.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My legs hurt and I feel very bored. What can I do?
Stretching your toes helps. Do you like looking out the window?
I do not know. The view looks the same. It is gray and flat.
Try to count the small clouds. Would you like to share a snack?
I am full, but my head feels empty. I just want it to end soon.
Sleep is a good way to pass time. Do you have a blanket?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights went out. I do not know what to do.
Stay calm. Did you hear a loud noise before the cut?
No, it just stopped working.
That is good. Check if the breakers are on.
I tried that, but they are still off.
Do not worry. It will likely come back soon.
I hope so, but I am scared.
It is safe to wait in the dark. Do you have a candle?
Yes, I have one.
Good. Use it only if you need to see.
Thank you for helping me feel better.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I have a big party today.
That sounds fun! Who is coming?
My friends and my dog are there.
A dog at a party? I like that. What will you eat?
We are eating cake and cookies.
Yum! I do not know where your party is, but it sounds sweet.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to keep more of my coins. How do I start?
You can use a jar for every penny you drop. Do you have a clean jar?
I have an old glass bottle. Is that good enough?
Yes, any container works if you remember to put money in it. What color is your bottle?
It is green. I am not sure if I will remember to save.
That is a common fear. Try to pay for one small thing with cash instead of a card. Do you usually use cash?
I mostly use a card. Is that bad for saving?
It is hard to save when money leaves your pocket quickly. Try keeping a small pouch in your pocket for loose change. Do you like carrying coins?
I do, actually. I think I will try that this week.
Good luck with your new habit. Tell me if it helps you save more.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a big surprise for you today.
Oh, that sounds very exciting! What did you make?
It is a secret until my birthday is here.
I will wait with patience. Do you like the color blue?
No, I like the color red best.
Red is a strong and happy color. Is it a gift for me?
Yes, it is a little card I made.
That is very sweet of you. Did you draw a picture inside?
I drew a big red heart for you.
I love hearts. Thank you for sharing this with me.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to walk for my health?
Walking helps your heart pump blood well. Do you like to feel strong?
Yes, I want to be strong. Is it hard to start?
No, just take small steps. How far can you walk today?
I can only go around the block. Is that enough?
Yes, that is a great start. Do you have a favorite spot?
I like the park with the trees. What else does it do?
It helps you think clear and feel calm. Do you feel better after you walk?
I do feel happy. Thank you for telling me.
You are welcome. I am glad to help.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does Grandma always wear her old glasses?
She likes to see the world in color. Do you like colors too?
What is her favorite thing to eat?
I am not sure, but I think it is soup.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost. Can you help me find my way home?
Yes, I want to help. Where did you start walking?
I began at the big red park. Now I see only trees.
Walk toward the road. Is there a sign with an arrow?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my dog ran away.
That is very bad. Do you know where he likes to play?
He likes the big tree. I will look there.
I hope you find him. Would you like to sit for a moment?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel a big worry in my chest.
That feels heavy. What is it about?
I do not know what it is.
That is okay. Do you feel calm?
Not really, my heart beats fast.
Let us breathe slow together. Is it helping?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the actors wear big masks?
The masks help show how they feel. Do you like big faces?
I do. Why is the story so sad?
The main character loses his friend. Is that why you asked?
Yes. Does he get his friend back?
I am not sure about the end. Do you want to watch with me?
Maybe. Why are the lights so dark?
The dark makes it feel quiet and safe. Does that feel good to you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the big meeting today. It was a bit hard to understand some of the words they used.
That sounds like a busy morning. Did you learn anything new?
Yes, we talked about a new project. I am happy we are working on it together.
That is great news. How do you feel about the work?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I can hear the wind going whoosh outside.
That sounds loud. Do you feel safe in your room?
The lights flickered for a second and I got scared.
Storms can be tricky. Are you holding onto your favorite toy?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you know the song about the bunny?
I think you mean the one about the hungry caterpillar. Do you like the part where it eats the apple?
No, that is a bug. My bunny is white and soft.
Oh, I do not know that song. Is your bunny hiding under a table?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the wind blow?
The sun heats the air, and the air moves. Do you feel the breeze on your face?
I do. What makes the wind so fast?
Big pressure changes make it rush. Is it windy where you live?
It is very windy. Is there an end to the wind?
No, wind always comes from moving air. I do not know when it stops.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I jump a puddle?
Watch the water before you leap. Do you like to jump?
Yes, I do.
Take a small step back. Then push off hard with your feet.
Thanks, that looks easy.
Careful not to slip. Is the ground wet there?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I bought a new toy today. It cost ten coins. My pocket is empty now.
That is a lot of coins for a toy. Do you play with it every day?
Yes, I play with it all the time. It is very fun.
Good. If you save one coin a day, you will buy a better toy soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad I saved my coins!
That is great news. Why are you happy?
I bought a big toy with them!
A toy is a good reward. Did you save for long?
Yes, I put coins in my jar every day.
That is a good habit. How do you decide what to buy?
I pick things I really want, not just things that look shiny.
That is smart thinking. Do you still have money left?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have twelve months in a year?
The year is a long time, so we split it into parts. Do you like winter or summer best?
I like summer, but why is time split up?
It helps us plan our days and track the seasons. I am not sure who started the count.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue dog at the park today.
That is a nice color. Was the dog friendly?
It wanted to play fetch with me.
I am glad you had fun. Did you throw the ball?
I threw it, and it caught it!
It sounds like a great day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy to pack my bag today.
That is great news. What are you packing first?
I put in my shoes and socks.
Good start. Do you have space left?
Yes, I have room for my book.
A book is a nice choice.
I also packed my water bottle.
That is a smart idea.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do magnets stick to my fridge?
The fridge is made of iron, which likes magnets. Do you like iron?
Why do some ends touch and others push?
Opposite ends pull together, but same ends push apart. Do you feel that push?
Why does a magnet not stick to wood?
Wood does not have the right parts to connect with magnets. What else have you tried?
Why do magnets lose power if I drop them hard?
Dropping them can jumble the inside parts. Have you dropped one?
Why do they still work after a while?
The tiny parts stay lined up, so the force stays. Do you keep your magnet safe?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The line is too long and my croissant is going to get cold.
I am sorry about that. Are you in a hurry?
Yes, I have work later and I am so tired today.
Rest is important. Did you sleep well last night?
Not really, but I still want that sweet treat.
Sweet food can help with low mood. Do you like chocolate?
Yes, I love chocolate but it is not good for me.
A small piece is fine. Would you like some water?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I can’t do it. I give up.
That is okay. Did you try a smaller piece first?
No, I just got stuck.
That feels hard. You can rest for a minute.
But I want it to work.
I do not know the magic trick. Do you need help with the next step?
Yes, my hands are shaking.
Take a deep breath. We will try one tiny thing together.
Okay, I think I can do that.
Good. You are doing great.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very lonely. Do you know why I feel this way?
That sounds hard. It often happens when we miss people. Do you have a favorite friend nearby?
Not really close by. Does loneliness go away if I just wait?
Waiting can help, but doing things with others helps more. What do you like to do for fun?
I like to read books. Does reading make you feel less alone?
It can, yes. Books are good friends. What is your last favorite book?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now. I want to tell you about it.
That is great news. What makes you feel this way?
I got a big red balloon today. It is very light and fun.
A red balloon sounds lovely. Do you like the color red?
Yes, I love red things. It feels warm inside my heart.
Warm feelings are nice to have. Where did you get the balloon?
I bought it from a nice shop. I am waiting to fly it high.
Flying it high sounds fun. Is the wind blowing today?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I started on the wood today. The nails were hard to hit.
That can be tiring. Did you take a break to drink some water?
Yes, I sat on the grass. It feels good to have a break.
Rest is good for your hands.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a great place today. It smells like old books and quiet.
That sounds nice. What kind of books do you like there?
I love big picture books about animals. They make me feel calm and happy.
Reading can be a good break. Do you like to go alone?
Yes, I sit by the big window and watch the rain. It is my favorite spot.
That sounds peaceful. Would you like to go again soon?
Definitely. I plan to bring my best friend next week.
That sounds like a good day. Have fun with your friend.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I like sugar, but I hear it is bad. Why?
Sugar makes your blood rise fast, and then you feel tired soon after. Do you feel sleepy after sweet snacks?
That happens to me. So, what should I eat instead?
You can try fruits, nuts, and green veggies. They give you steady power for the day.
Okay. But why does my body need that steady power?
Your brain and muscles need a slow, steady fuel to work well without crashing.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad to be alive today.
That is a wonderful feeling. What made you feel this way?
The sun is bright and warm.
The sun does bring a lot of joy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad because I cannot find my cookie.
That sounds hard. Do you remember where you ate it?
No, I think I dropped it near the door.
I do not know if it is there. We can look together.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I find the safe spots on the web?
Look for sites that end in .edu or .gov. They are usually very safe. What are you trying to find?
I want to learn about space, but I am scared of bad links.
Use a big, well-known search tool. Type in clear words like "planets for kids." Have you looked at the book section yet?
I found a page with loud music and moving pictures. Is that okay?
That can be distracting. Try to find a quiet page with just words and pictures. Do you like reading or watching?
I like reading, but I do not know how to tell if a fact is true.
Read it in two places to be sure. If they say the same thing, it is likely true. I do not know every fact, so always check.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The rain never stopped. I miss the sun.
I am sorry you feel low. Do you like the sound of rain?
Yes, it is soft. But the sky is always gray.
That can feel heavy. Are you safe inside?
Yes, I am dry. I just want a rainbow.
Rain often brings them. Do you see any colors yet?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big boat.
Yes, that is a ferry. Do you like boats?
The water is blue.
It is clear today. Are you cold?
I want a fish.
We can buy some later. Do you want chips?
Yes, please.
Let us walk to the shop.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My red bar will not stick to the fridge.
The fridge is made of steel, so it should work. Do you know if the fridge door has a metal part?
I am very confused about how magnets work.
They have north and south ends. Have you tried the other end on the door?
It still does not stick well.
Maybe the magnet is weak or covered in dirt. Does it stick to a spoon?
Yes, it sticks to the spoon fine.
Then the fridge door may have a thick layer. Is there a painted coat on the door?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my favorite cup by accident and I feel so bad.
I am sorry it happened, but you can fix it. Did you hurt your hand?
No, my hand is fine, but I do not know how to glue it back together.
I do not know how to do that, but you can look it up. Are you trying to fix it now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we give gifts on a birthday?
It is a way to show love. Do you like getting gifts?
Yes, I do. Why is my birthday on this day?
That is the day you were born. I do not know if there is a special reason for that date. Do you think it is lucky?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look up and the sky is blue. Why is it blue? I do not know what to do.
Sunlight has many colors. Blue scatters the most. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. But I still do not get it.
The air breaks the light apart. Blue bounces all over. Can you see the sun now?
It is bright. My eyes hurt.
That is the white part. The blue is everywhere. Do you feel the warm sun?
Yes, it feels good. I am still confused.
It is just how light moves. You know more than you think. Do you see any clouds?
I see a few. So I should just look?
Yes, just enjoy the view. You did good asking.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the bread get so soft and warm?
The heat makes the water turn to steam. Do you like warm bread?
Yes, I do. Why is the outside crust hard?
That part dries out and turns brown. I do not know the exact reason for that.
Oh, that is a mystery. Why do we add sugar?
Sugar makes the dough rise and tastes sweet. Is your favorite part the sweet?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hi, is the baby awake? I must go.
Yes, he is looking at you. Is he well?
Yes, he is small. I am late.
He is very sweet. Tell him I love him.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I hold the racket right?
Put your palm on the top of the grip like a handshake. Do you play on grass or clay?
I play on hard court. What should my feet do?
Keep your feet shoulder width apart. You should feel ready to move fast.
I am ready to move fast. How do I hit the ball?
Turn your side to the ball and swing up and out. Is the ball bouncy or flat?
It is a bit flat. I want to stop it from flying away.
Hit the ball just below its top to keep it down. Do you like to hit big or safe?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a warm loaf of bread today. It smells so good!
That sounds wonderful. Do you have any fruit to add?
Yes, I put in some sweet apples. I want to share it with you.
I would love a piece. Thank you for the treat.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go to the doctor now.
That is a good idea. What is wrong with you?
My head hurts very bad.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a cough too?
No, just the head pain.
I do not know why it hurts. Please tell the doctor.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse today.
That sounds fun. Did it have a big mane?
Yes, it was very fluffy.
Cool. Do you like to pet animals?
I like dogs more, but I think horses are cool.
I get that. Are they fast?
Yes, they run very fast.
Wow. Do you ride in a cart with horses?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with this test.
Take a deep breath and read the first question slowly. Do you see a word that feels very hard?
Yes, but I am still stuck on the middle part.
Try to skip that hard part for now. Do you like the first question better?
The last question looks too long for me.
It is long, but it is just a story. Do you want to read it just for fun?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I built a tower of blocks today. It was very tall.
That is a big job. How high was it?
It touched the top of my desk. I felt so happy.
You must be very proud. Did it stay up?
For one full minute before it fell. I tried again.
That takes great care. You did well.
My mom clapped for me. It made my chest feel warm.
That is a lovely feeling. I am glad you shared it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is there so much smoke over there?
The fire chief says a kitchen pan caught fire. Are you scared?
That sounds hot. Why did the pan start?
I am not sure, but it is likely a person left it on the stove. Is your house safe?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do robots move?
They have motors inside that help them walk. Do you like watching them dance?
Why are some robots round and some square?
The shape helps them do their jobs better. I do not know for every single robot.
Can robots think like us?
No, they follow steps we give them. Do you wonder if they dream?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My neighbor leaves loud trash bags by my door. I feel angry but do not know what to say.
That sounds very upsetting to you. What do you usually do when you see them?
I just stare at them for a long time. It feels wrong but I freeze up.
Staring makes people feel unsafe. Have you tried saying hello to them first?
No, I have never spoken to them. I worry they might be mean.
Kindness is often safer than silence. Do you think they would smile if you said hi?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished my long flight and I feel very happy. The cloud view was so pretty.
That sounds like a big joy. Did you bring a good book to read?
Yes, I read two books and napped a lot. It really helped the time pass.
I am glad you had a nice trip. I do not know where you flew to.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to try a new hobby, but I do not know what to pick.
That is okay to feel. Do you like being outside?
I love the sun, but my back hurts from sitting too long.
How about walking? It is good for your body.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start making a loaf?
You mix flour, water, yeast, and salt. Do you have those things at home?
Yes, but the dough feels sticky.
Add a little more flour until it stops sticking. Is it smooth now?
It feels good, what next?
Let it sit for an hour to grow. Have you seen it get bigger before?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I gave my ferns water today and they looked happy.
Plants take in water through their roots. Do you know where the roots are?
Yes, the roots are at the bottom of the pot.
The water travels up tiny tubes in the plant. It is like a straw.
That is a good way to think about it.
I do not know how fast the water moves. But the roots help pull it up.
I will check the leaves to see if they are dry.
That is a smart thing to do.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I move the king in chess?
You move the king one square in any direction. Do you know how the other pieces move?
I think I do, but I keep losing games.
Try to protect your king first. Have you tried playing on a smaller board?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sun so hot?
It burns fuel inside to make light and heat. Do you like the warm feeling?
Yes, I do. Why is it yellow?
It looks yellow from our air, but it is really white. Have you seen a star up close?
No. Why does the sun move in the sky?
The earth spins, so the sun seems to move. Do you like watching it set?
Yes. Why does it stop in the night?
The earth turns away, so we see the dark side. Do you like the stars?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! My bread is getting big and round.
That is wonderful news! Do you know why it grows?
I want to tell you all about it. It smells like magic.
The little yeast makes air pockets inside the dough. Do you like how it smells?
Yes, it smells sweet and warm. I cannot wait to eat it.
Eating fresh bread is a great treat. Would you like a recipe next time?
I am just going to let it rest for now. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome, and I am glad it worked. Enjoy your meal!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I felt so sad today.
Why is that?
I failed my math test.
That is hard. Was it too fast?
Yes, I ran out of time.
I am sorry. Did you try again?
No, it is over now.
I do not know if you can retake it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My throat hurts and my nose is blocked. I had a bad day.
I am sorry you feel so ick. Did you drink some warm tea?
Yes, but it did not help much. I just wanted to rest on my bed.
Resting is very good for you. Do you have a pet to cuddle?
I have a cat, but he is too busy chasing mice.
Cats are very lively. I do not know if mice help with a cold.
I think they make me sneeze more. I am so tired now.
Please sleep well and let your body heal. Would you like me to read a short story to you?
Yes, that sounds nice. Please tell me about a happy dog.
A happy dog runs in the park. He barks at the sun.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are there so many stars in the sky?
They are very far away suns. Do you like to look up?
Yes, I do. Why do they shine at night but not in the day?
The bright sun hides them with its light. I do not know why the moon follows us.
That is nice. Do they move?
They seem to move, but they stay still.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I took a picture of the moon.
That sounds like a great photo. Did you use a zoom lens?
Yes, I zoomed in very close.
I am glad you are happy. Do you like the color of it?
I love how white it looks.
White moons are very clear. Did you take it at night?
I took it right after dark.
That is a cool time to shoot. Did you feel cold?
A little, but I did not care.
You have a good eye for art.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My neighbour left a box on my lawn.
That is not fair. Did you ask them to move it?
I was too scared to talk to them.
Neighbours should be kind. Are they always loud?
Yes, they play music all night.
You can tell them to stop. Do you have a phone?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need an apple, fast.
Apples are red or green. Do you like them sweet?
Yes, sweet ones. Where are they?
Look in the red bag. Is that the one you want?
That is it. I must go now.
Have a nice trip.

talk.situation: the person is a child
