exchanges: Why does the light turn on when I push this button?
It turns on because it gives power to the bulb. Do you know what makes the power?
I think it comes from the big box outside?
Yes, your home gets it from the power lines. Do you like bright light or dark light?
I like bright light for my toys.
That sounds like fun. Do you know where to plug in a toy car?
Yes, I have a white box on the wall.
That is called an outlet. Do you know why we do not put water near it?
Because it is wet and scary?
Water can cause bad sparks. Do you always tell a grown-up if the plugs get hot?
Yes, my mom checks them.
That is very safe. Do you know what happens if you cut the red wire?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to run, but I do not know how to start.
That is a good goal. Do you like running outside or inside?
I think outside is better. But my legs feel tired.
Tired legs are normal. Have you taken a rest today?
Yes, I rested. But I still feel slow.
Slow is fine for now. Do you have good shoes for running?
I have old shoes. Is that okay?
It is not safe for your feet. I do not know your size, but you need new ones.
Okay. I will go buy some.
That is a great step. Have fun on your next run.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so alone today.
That sounds really hard. What did you do today?
I just sat by the window and watched the rain.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like watching rain?
Sometimes, but it makes me miss my friends.
Missing friends is a natural feeling. Would you like to share more about them?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. My team won the big game!
That is great news! What score did it end?
It was five to two. I am very proud of my players.
Five to two is a big win. Did you watch the whole match?
Yes, I watched every minute. It was so exciting and loud.
It sounds like a lot of fun. How are you feeling now?
I feel calm but still very happy. I want to sleep and dream of winning again.
That is a good rest. Sweet dreams, friend.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My birthday is soon and I want to make my own cake. Do you know how?
That is a fun plan. Do you have an oven at home?
Yes, I do. What should I put in it?
You can use flour, sugar, eggs, and butter. Do you like chocolate or vanilla?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make good coffee.
Use fresh water and warm your cup. Do you like it sweet?
Yes, I like a little sugar.
That is a nice choice. Add it after the brew. What kind of beans do you use?
I use dark roast beans.
Dark roast is strong and bold. I do not know your exact recipe. How much water do you use?
I use a cup of water for one scoop.
That sounds like a good start. Try again soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sun so hot today?
The sun is very close to us, so it gives off a lot of heat. Are you thirsty?
I feel tired. Why does the heat make me so sleepy?
Your body uses a lot of energy to cool itself down. Do you have a fan?
The ice in my drink is melting fast. Why is that?
The heat makes the ice turn into water very quickly. I do not know the exact speed.
I want to play outside. Is it safe to go now?
It is hot, so you should rest and drink water first. Do you have a hat?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost track of the days. What day is today?
I do not know for sure, but is it still sunny outside?
No, it is raining and I am sad.
Rain can be boring, do you like to listen to music?
Yes, but I forgot which day I planned to call my friend.
That is tricky, did you write it down anywhere?
I did not write it down and I feel stupid.
It is a normal mistake, try to check your phone notes.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to look at my new clock!
That is a nice feeling. What makes you smile?
The hands move so fast and round.
They spin with time. Do you see the small hand?
Yes, the small hand tells the hours.
Good eye. You are learning well.
The big hand shows the minutes.
Exactly right. Thanks for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to send a letter to my friend.
That is a nice thing to do. Who is your friend?
My cousin living far away.
You need a stamp to send it. Do you have one?
I do not have any stamps.
I can help you find some. You can buy them right here.
Is it going to cost much money?
It is not expensive. We can also see how far away he lives.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread is flat and I feel very sad.
Oh no, that is a shame. Did you use fresh yeast?
I do not know, it was old.
Old yeast makes weak dough. I am sorry, I can not fix it now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am sad because my birthday is coming and I do not know what to do.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you like to play with friends?
Yes, I like to play, but I am worried they will be busy.
That is a good point. Maybe you can ask them first?
I did not think of that. What should I ask them?
You could ask if they can join you for a short game. I do not know if they will say yes, but you must try.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I had a bad dream about falling off a roof.
That must have been scary. Do you feel safe now?
Yes, but I still feel shaky.
It is okay to feel that way. Would you like a warm drink?
Maybe. Do you think bad dreams mean something?
I do not know for sure. But most bad dreams are just your mind playing tricks.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am making soup. I found a carrot in the fridge today.
That sounds good. I like carrots. What else is in the pot?
I added peas too. I saw a bird outside while I cooked.
A bird? That is funny. Did it look at you?
Yes, it did. Now the soup is hot.
Great job. Let it cool down a bit.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky orange over there?
It is probably a fire nearby. Are you seeing smoke?
Yes, I see thick smoke rising up. Why did it start?
I do not know why it started. Is it far from your home?
It is close, which makes me worry. Should I leave now?
Please stay inside for safety. Do you have a plan?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, I am late. What time is it?
It is ten past three. Are you running late for a meeting?
Yes. Is it before or after lunch?
It is after lunch. Do you have time for a quick bite?
No, I must go now.
You should hurry. Safe travels to you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am going to see the doctor today because my tummy hurts. I ate too many cookies this morning.
That is a good plan. Did the cookies taste sweet?
Yes, they were very sweet but now I feel sick. I do not know if the doctor will fix it quickly.
The doctor will help you feel better. Do you want a snack for the ride there?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired from packing all these boxes.
That is a lot of work. What did you pack last?
Just a few old books and some plates.
Books and plates can be heavy. Do you have a friend to help?
I do not really have anyone free to come.
I am sorry to hear that. It can feel lonely when moving.
It feels like a huge mess in the car.
A full car is always messy. What is your first stop?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do sailors look at the stars at night?
They use the stars to find their way when it is dark. Do you like looking up?
Why do they use ropes on the boat?
Ropes hold things tight so they do not fall off. Is that interesting to you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw a big rainbow in the sky, but then the clouds came back and hid it.
That sounds disappointing. Do you want to look for it again later?
Yes, I do, but it seems gone for good.
Rainbows can hide and then return. Do you like watching the sky?
I like the sun, but I really wanted that rainbow.
Sometimes it takes time to see bright colors again.
I hope it comes back before the sun sets.
I cannot promise when it will appear. Do you have a favorite color in the rainbow?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am going to a big picnic today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What is the best food you are bringing?
We are bringing cold water and sandwiches.
I like sandwiches, but I do not know what you put inside them.
I am putting cheese and apples on mine.
Apples and cheese taste sweet and salty together. Do you like the taste?
Yes, I love that mix.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I met a new friend today, but I am not sure what to do next.
That is a happy thing! What did you talk about?
We liked the same game, but I forgot how to play it.
That is a small problem. Did you tell them you need a reminder?
I did not know if that was okay to ask.
Friends help each other learn. Just ask and play!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very tired when I work at home.
Rest helps you. Do you take breaks?
I usually sit all day.
Please stand up often. How long do you work?
I work for eight hours.
That is a long time. Do you have a nice view?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to buy a ticket for the train. Do I need a paper one?
You can buy them online or at the station. Do you have a phone with you?
Yes, I do. How do I use the app to get my pass?
Just pick your date and seat, then pay with a card. Is that clear to you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like music?
Yes, I really do. What is your favorite song?
I like loud drum songs. They make me jump.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a drum at home?
No, I only have a pot. My dad plays on it.
A pot can sound very loud. Do you play on it too?
Yes, but I am careful. I only play when he lets me.
You must be a good helper. Thank you for sharing that.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My boss gave me extra time off.
That is very nice of him. Do you feel happy?
Yes, I do.
Good for you. Does he always do that?
Not always, but often.
That sounds like a good friend. What is his job?
He leads the team.
I see. Is he hard to work for?
No, he is easy.
That is great. Do you like your work?
I do, because of him.
I am glad you found a kind boss.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the wood flat on the ground?
It is flat so we can cut it right. Do you like using tools?
Why do we need a hammer?
We use it to drive the nails. Are your hands big enough?
Why do we put the roof on last?
We wait until the walls are strong. I do not know if it will rain.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited for a long time at the bus stop today.
That sounds boring. Did you have a book to read?
No, I just watched the rain fall.
Rain can be fun to watch. Did you see any colors in it?
Yes, the sky looked very dark and gray.
That sounds a bit scary. Did you feel cold while you waited?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Why are the lights off? I am late for work.
Did you flip the switch?
Yes, but nothing works.
Check the breaker box. Is a switch up?
I do not know where the box is.
Look near the kitchen door.
It is open. The big switch is down.
Push it up. Do the lights come on?
Yes! Thank you. I must run.
Glad I helped. Be safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I saw a robot move today. Why does it move like that?
It moves because a brain in its body tells it what to do. Do you like watching them?
Yes, I do. Why can it do so many jobs?
It can learn new tasks very fast. Do you want to build one?
Maybe. Why do some robots look like people?
We make them look human so they are easy to talk to. I do not know if they feel happy.
Do they feel things? Why do people care about that?
I do not think they feel true feelings. Do you think that matters?
I do not know. Why do we make them at all?
We make them to help with hard or scary work. Thank you for asking.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am drawing a big, red ball.
That sounds like fun. Is the ball very heavy?
It is as heavy as a rock.
I do not know what a rock weighs, but it sounds strong. Do you have a blue pen?
No, I only have a pencil.
A pencil is great for drawing lines. Do you want to color it later?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream cone on the ground.
That is very sad. Do you like chocolate ice cream?
Yes, it was my favorite treat.
You can buy another one later.
I only had one dollar left in my pocket.
That is not enough for a new cone.
I am going to eat a cookie instead.
That sounds like a good plan.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off trees?
They fall because the days get short and cold. Do you like watching them dance?
I do. How does the tree know when to let them go?
Light change tells the tree to stop making food. The leaf is like a little door that closes.
That makes sense. What happens to the leaves on the ground?
They break down and feed the tree roots. Did you know trees can sleep too?
I did not know that. Is it true that trees sleep?
Yes, they rest when it is dark.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just took a big walk in the park today.
That sounds very nice. Did you see any birds?
Yes, there were many little blue ones.
I love watching birds. Do you go there often?
I love it when I feel happy.
Happy feet are good for you. Do you walk there every day?
The sun was warm on my face.
Warm sun is a good thing.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is there a rainbow in the sky?
The sun shines through rain drops to make colors. Do you like the red part?
Yes, red is my favorite. How does it go away?
It fades when the rain stops or the sun moves. Do you look up when you see one?
I look up a lot. Is it real?
Yes, it is real light in the air. It is beautiful.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love apples. How do I cut one?
You can cut it in half with a knife. Do you like sweet or sour ones?
I like sweet ones. How do I remove the seeds?
You can scoop them out with a spoon. Have you tried using a peeler?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say sorry?
It helps fix a wrong. Do you feel better after you say it?
I think it makes things right.
That is the main goal. It shows you care about them.
What if the other person is still mad?
Sometimes it takes time. Can you just wait and be kind?
I will try to be patient.
That is a very good plan. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red rose by the park today. It looked so happy in the sun.
That is a sweet sight. Do red roses smell strong?
Yes, they do. I also saw some tiny yellow daisies near the bench.
Daisies are very cheerful. Did you pick any for home?
No, I left them there. They looked better growing in the grass.
That is kind of you to do.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do you know if this shop is open? I am very late.
Yes, it is open. Do you have a lot of time to look around?
No, I must go now. Is the door unlocked?
It is locked, I am sorry. May I unlock it for you quickly?
Please, but I am running out of time. Where is the exit?
It is on the left. Is it the blue door?
Yes, thank you. I have to go.
Good luck. Do you need anything else?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why should I save my pocket money?
Saving helps you buy big things later. Do you have a big toy you want?
Yes, a bicycle. Why is it hard to save?
It is hard because we want things now.
How do I stop wanting things right now?
You can wait one week. Do you think you can wait?
Maybe. Where is the safest place to put the coins?
A piggy bank at home is good.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel tired. Can I walk to get strong?
Yes, walking is good for you. Do you have shoes on?
Yes, I do. How long should I walk?
Start with ten minutes a day. How does that feel?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy my bread is getting big.
That is wonderful to see. Why is it getting bigger?
The tiny bugs in the dough are breathing.
I did not know that. Do they make a sound?
No, but they make tiny bubbles in the dough.
Those bubbles push the bread up. Is it warm in there?
Yes, I put it in a cozy spot.
Warmth helps them work fast. What does it smell like?
It smells sweet and fresh.
I am glad you are happy. Tell me more about your day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad today. I want to feel happy again.
I am sorry you feel down. What made you feel this way?
I lost my favorite toy. I cried a lot.
That is a hard feeling. Do you want to talk about it?
I miss it so much. It brings me joy.
It is okay to miss something good. Do you have another happy memory?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I met a new friend today. Do you think he is nice?
I hope he is kind to you. What did you talk about?
We talked about toys. Do you know his name?
No, I do not know his name. Do you play well with him?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see fire in my yard, and it is hot.
That is scary. Are you safe inside?
Yes, mom is here, but the fire is big.
I am glad you are safe. Please stay put.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a big tree. I do not know what to do next.
That is nice. Do you like green leaves?
Yes, I do. Should I cut it down?
No, please do not. Trees are our friends.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am very hungry, but I do not know what to eat.
Would you like a hot soup?
I think I would. Do you have any vegetables?
Yes, I see carrots and beans.
That sounds good to me. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Enjoy your lunch.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. My toy boat sank in the bath.
That is very frustrating. Why did it sink?
I do not know. I just want to know why ships float.
Big ships float because they push a lot of water down. Do you know what buoyancy is?
No. It sounds like a hard word.
Buoyancy is just the push back from water. It helps the ship stay up.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to hold the door open for someone. How do I do it?
You just keep the door open and let them go through first. Do you like helping others?
Yes, I do. But what if the door is heavy?
You can say "after you" with a smile. It is always nice to be kind.
That is easy. I will try it today.
Great. I hope it makes you happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sun so hot?
It makes heat to keep us warm. Do you like the warmth?
Does the sun ever sleep?
Yes, it sets down for a while. I do not know if it dreams.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the sun is hiding behind the gray clouds.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you think the sun is just taking a nap?
I guess so, but it is still very dark outside.
The sun will come back soon. Do you like watching them move?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the round ball always on the left side?
It is there because the square blocks its path. Do you see the wall?
I do not see a wall. Why does it not move right?
The door on the right is locked. Do you have the key?
I have no key. Why is the puzzle so hard?
It is hard because you must think to win. Try the left path.
I tried left, but it failed. Why did I fail?
I do not know why it failed. Did you check the clock?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very worried about the big test tomorrow.
I am here for you. Do you know why it feels so heavy?
I do not know. The worry just sits in my chest.
That is a common feeling. Does it go away when you talk about it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very worried about the test tomorrow.
That feels hard. Do you feel scared or just tired?
I am mostly scared of failing.
I do not know the answers. Have you studied a little today?
Yes, but my brain feels foggy.
Your body may just need rest. What is the first thing you will do tonight?
I might just lie in the dark.
That is a good way to calm down. Would it help to breathe slowly?
I will try that before I sleep.
I hope it brings you peace. Good night.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a tiny bug on my leaf. I do not know what to do.
That sounds interesting. What color is the bug?
It is green with little black dots. I am worried it might hurt me.
Most small green bugs are friendly. Do they have wings?
No, I do not see any wings. I think I should throw it away.
Please do not throw it away. Is it moving slowly or fast?
It is moving very fast. I am scared now.
Fast bugs usually run to save themselves. It likely wants to leave you alone.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is a circle?
A circle is a round shape with no corners. Do you see any circles around you?
Yes, I see a clock.
That is a great example of a circle. Does the clock have any numbers on it?
It has twelve numbers.
Twelve numbers go around the edge. Why do you think they are round?
Because time goes around.
That is a very smart thought. I do not know if that is the only reason.
Okay, what is a square?
A square has four straight sides that are all the same size. Are the sides long or short?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My neighbor gave me cookies today.
That is very sweet. Did he bake them himself?
Yes, they smell like vanilla.
I am happy for you. Do you want to share some?
I want to give them all to you.
Thank you, that is kind. I will take two.
I am glad to help.
Your kindness makes my day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do flowers have colors?
They use color to bring in bugs. Do you like red?
Yes, but why do they smell sweet?
The smell helps bugs find the flower. Do you like sweet smells?
Yes. Why do some flowers have thorns?
The thorns stop bad bugs from eating them.
That is clever. Do all flowers grow from seeds?
Most do, but some grow from cut parts.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The tree will not grow fast.
I hear you. It takes time. What is making you feel this way?
I want it big now. It feels too slow.
You are right that waiting is hard. Do you have a calm spot?
I just want it done. I feel so frustrated.
That is true for all of us. I will sit with you here.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I fix a broken zipper?
Pull the stopper down and slide the pull up slowly. Do you have a small tool to help?
I only have my hands.
Try using a coin to push the teeth back together. Do you have a coin on you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see smoke coming from the kitchen. What should I do?
Stay calm. Is the fire big or small?
It is small, but I am scared.
That is okay. Grab a pot with a lid.
Where is the pot?
Look in the cabinet. Do you see it?
Yes, I have the lid. Now what?
Turn off the stove. Cover the fire with the lid.
I did it. The fire is out.
Good job. Open the window.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at the big colors in the sky!
That is a beautiful rainbow. What do you think made it?
I think the sun made it with the rain.
That makes sense. Do you like one color more than the rest?
I really like the red part.
Red is a warm and bright color. Is it at the top for you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is an apple a good fruit?
It is sweet and full of juice. Do you like sweet things?
I do. Why is a banana easy to eat?
It has a soft skin that peels well. Do you have a banana now?
I do not. Why are grapes so small?
I do not know the exact reason. They are just fun to pop.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like my coffee with lots of sugar.
That sounds sweet. Do you add any milk?
Yes, white milk. Coffee is brown.
Brown and white mix to make a nice color. Is it hot?
It is very hot. I wait for it.
Waiting helps so you do not get burned. Do you like it better than tea?
I do not know much about tea.
That is okay to not know. Would you like to try a little tea?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the big glass building today.
That sounds like a fun place. Did you see any old coins?
I saw a shiny coin from a long time ago.
Oh, that must have been pretty to look at. Did you touch it?
No, I could not touch it, but I took a picture.
That is a nice way to remember the visit. Do you want to go back soon?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Can I have a red pizza?
Yes, you can. Do you want it thin or thick?
What is "thin"?
It means the bread part is small. Are you a big eater?
I like round shapes.
Most pizzas are round. Do you like shapes?
Why is the pizza hot?
It is hot because it was just cooked. I do not know why you like hot food.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My boat keeps filling with water. What should I do?
First, take out all the water. Then, check for a hole. Is it a big hole or a small one?
It is a small hole near the bottom. Do I use glue or tape?
For a small hole, you can use a patch and glue. Tape may not last. Does the boat have a leak elsewhere?
No, this is the only one. I will go buy a patch.
That is a good plan. Take your time and be safe.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am not sure if I should go to the meeting now.
Do you have the papers with you?
Yes, I have them all in my bag.
Great. Go now and you will be fine.
Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Did you find the room easy to see?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I think I broke my picture.
Oh no. What happened to your drawing?
I used the wrong color.
That happens to all artists. Do you want to try again?
But I am too tired.
It is okay to rest. Would you like a warm drink?
Yes, please.
Here is some tea. Feel better now?
I feel a bit better.
Good. You can draw tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a tip to sleep fast. I am very late.
Try to keep your room dark and cool. Do you use a loud fan?
Yes, I use a fan. It is too noisy.
That sound can stop your rest. Have you tried white noise?
I do not know what that is. Please explain.
White noise is a soft, steady hum. It helps you forget the silence.
I will try that tonight. Thank you.
You are welcome. Do you drink coffee after dinner?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The path is wet and muddy. What should I do?
Take a different path if you have one. Do you see any dry grass nearby?
Yes, there is a green path by the lake.
That sounds like a good choice. Enjoy your walk.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to start.
Start with the floor that looks the messiest. Do you see any big toys?
Yes, there are many toys.
Put the toys in a box first. Is the room small or big?
It is a big room.
Clean one corner at a time. Do you like doing the fun parts first?
The fun parts are putting things away.
That is a good way to start. Do you have a broom ready?
I do not have a broom.
I do not know where it is. Do you want to look for it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a red shape. It has four equal sides. What is it?
That is a square. Do you have any other shapes?
I have a round one. It has no corners. What is it?
That is a circle. It is soft and smooth.
I have a green one. It has three sides. What is it?
That is a triangle. Do you like green shapes?
I have a long one. It has four sides, but they are not equal. What is it?
That is a rectangle.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my test hard?
It is hard because you did not study. Do you like learning new things?
Why did I fail the math part?
I do not know why you failed. I can only see the book. Did you look at your notes?
Why are you so quiet now?
I am quiet because I am listening. Are you ready to try again?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big boat on the lake today.
That sounds fun. Do you wonder why it does not sink?
Yes, I do not get it because it is made of steel.
Steel sinks in water. The boat has a big empty space inside.
Ah, so the air inside helps it float?
Yes, the air makes it light. Is the water calm or wild?
It was very calm today.
Calm water helps the boat sit steady. Nice day for you.
It was a good day.
I am glad you had a good time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is good to hear. What is making you happy?
I saw a big brown cow eating grass.
Cows love fresh green grass.
The cow said moo to me.
That is a friendly sound. Did it look at you?
Yes, it had kind eyes.
Kind eyes are lovely. I am glad you had a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not like working from home. My chair is too hard.
That sounds tough. Do you have a soft pillow to sit on?
No, I tried, but it slips off. I want to go to school.
I get that feeling. What is your favorite part of school?
I love playing with my friends. Is working hard?
Yes, it is busy. Do you like talking on the phone?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so tired all the time.
That sounds hard. Do you sleep enough?
Not really. I stay up too late.
Try to go to bed earlier. What helps you relax?
Reading a book. But my eyes get heavy.
Good idea. Put the book away.
But I still feel sleepy at noon.
I do not know why you are so tired. Have you tried drinking more water?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The rain was very loud today.
That sounds like a big storm. Did you have an umbrella?
Yes, I had one, but it broke.
Oh no, that is not good to hear.
So I got all wet on my way home.
Yikes, you must be cold. How do you feel now?
I have a hot drink and a dry shirt.
That sounds much better.
I think I do not mind the rain now.
That is a sweet change of heart.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go fast, but my bike feels slow.
Check your tires for air. Are they soft?
They are full. I am still too late.
Stand up on the pedals to go faster. Is the road clear ahead?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very lost about my camp trip.
It is okay to feel that way. What part worries you most?
I do not know where to pick the spot.
Look for a high, dry place. Do you have a map with you?
I think I am ready now.
That is great. Have a good time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My phone screen is all dark.
I am sorry it broke. Did you drop it?
Yes, I let it fall.
That is very sad. Is the battery still in?
I think so, but I do not know.
Let us look together. Do you see any dust?
It is just black.
I do not know the fix. Would you like to call help?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a cookie with chocolate chips.
We have those! Do you like soft or crunchy cookies?
I like them soft and warm.
Great choice. How many would you like?
Just one, please.
Okay, I will make it for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am sad because I dropped my ice cream on the ground.
That is a big let down. Did you try to eat the clean part?
No, I was too upset. My day is just gray now.
I am sorry to hear that. I do not know how to fix a gray day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, there is smoke. I must go now.
Is that bad? Please leave the house at once.
I have my bag. I am running to the car.
Are you safe outside?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My tummy hurts really bad.
I am sorry you feel this way. Does it hurt all the time?
Yes, it does not stop.
That sounds scary. We should tell a grown up now.
Will you come with me?
I will stay here with you. Do you want water or a hug?
A hug, please.
Here is your hug. I am right here with you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to paint a big red sun.
That sounds fun. Do you have red paint?
Yes, but I am scared I will mix it wrong.
Mistakes are okay. What color goes with red?
I think blue looks good next to red.
That is a nice choice. Are you ready to start?
Yes, I am holding the brush.
Take your time. Have fun painting.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because the sun is bright and warm.
That feels nice. What is your favorite part of summer?
I like eating cold ice cream on the porch.
That sounds very yummy.
Do you like the cold winter months too?
I do not feel cold, but I like the snow. Is your town snowy?
Yes, we get a lot of white snow.
How fun that must be.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red leaf on the path this morning.
That is a lovely color. Did you keep it?
Yes, I put it in my pocket to remember the day.
What a nice way to hold onto a happy moment.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to climb a big mountain. How do I start?
You start by picking a small, safe hill. Do you have strong legs?
Yes, I run fast. What do I need to bring?
You need good shoes and water. Do you like drinking water?
I do. How high can I go?
Go as high as you feel safe. Is that a clear plan?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like soccer but I am scared of the big ball.
That is very normal. Do you play with friends?
Yes, but they always kick the ball too hard at me.
Try to use your feet to trap it gently. Have you tried this?
No, I just try to kick it away fast.
Slowing down helps you control it. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why should I try to sing?
It makes your heart feel light. Do you like happy songs?
Yes, I do. But I am afraid of making bad sounds.
Every voice is okay. Do you want to try a sound?
Maybe. But how do I start?
Just hum in your chest. Is that too much for you?
No, it feels okay. Why does hum help?
It calms your body down. Do you feel calm now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which play to pick.
That is a hard choice. What kind of story do you like?
I like happy stories with animals.
A funny dog story could be fun. Do you want a happy ending?
Yes, I want everyone to be happy.
Pick the one with the kind cat. It fits what you said.
Okay, I will read that one.
I hope you enjoy it. Does it look good to you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I love that book. Why do you like it?
It makes me feel warm inside. Do you read it at night?
Yes, I do. Why is the story so sad?
It shows how hard life can be. Do you cry when you read it?
Sometimes I do. Why does the hero win?
He stays true to his heart. I do not know if he succeeds.
That is a mystery. Why is the cover blue?
Blue often means calm and deep. Do you like the color blue?
I think it is nice. Why is this book my favorite?
It brings you peace and joy. Do you want to buy another copy?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I swept the floor and found a lost red sock. It was from last week.
That is a lucky find. Did you wash it right away?
Yes, I put it in the hamper. Now I am wiping the kitchen table with soap.
Good work on the table. Is it sticky or just dusty?
It was sticky from spilled juice. Now it is clean and shiny.
Clean and shiny sounds very nice. Are you all done for the day?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my math homework so hard today?
New things feel tough at first. Do you like math?
No, I really do not. Why do I have to do it?
It helps your brain grow stronger. Is there a part you like?
I like the easy ones. Why are the hard ones there?
They teach you new skills. Can we look at one together?
Yes, please help me. Why is the answer wrong?
I do not know your book. Did you check your work?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my favorite cup. I feel very sad. What should I do now?
That is a shame. Do you want to try to glue it back together?
I tried, but the glue did not work. It feels broken for good. Can I fix it?
I do not know if glue will work. How big is the break?
It is a small crack. I just want to keep it. Is there another way?
You could paint it a new color. Do you like painting?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so tired when I try to run.
That is hard. How fast do you try to go?
I run very fast and my legs hurt.
Slow down to talk while you run. Do you stretch after?
I have never tried that before.
Try slow runs first. Does your body hurt when you rest?
No, but I feel sad I cannot keep going.
It gets easier with time. What helps you feel good?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The water looks so dirty today.
I am sorry it looks bad to you. Do you see any fish?
No, just grey water and old boats.
That sounds sad. Please come sit with me for a while.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up with a big egg in my hand.
That sounds fun. Did you break it?
No, I put it in my pocket for the test.
I do not know why you did that. Was it heavy?
It rolled on the floor and made a loud noise.
Oh no. Did the teacher hear it?
Yes, but I told her it was a surprise.
A surprise? That is very brave of you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make blue turn green?
Just add a little yellow paint to it. What are you painting?
I am making a tree for my room.
That sounds like a fun idea. Do you have green leaves yet?
No, I only have the brown trunk done.
Mix a little yellow into the blue now. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I made a plan.
That sounds nice. What do you want to do first?
We will eat bread and drink tea.
That sounds tasty. Do you have a place to sit?
Yes, we will sit on the green grass.
The grass is soft. What comes after the tea?
Then we will look for stars in the night sky.
That is a lovely finish to the day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the moon look so bright at night?
It shines because it reflects the sun's light. Do you like to look up at it?
Yes. Why is the moon white and not blue?
It looks white to us because of the dust on its face. I am not sure why it is not blue.
Is the moon really far away?
Yes, it is very far away. Do you think you could jump to it?
No. Why can I not fly to the moon?
We have no wings, so we need a rocket ship. Do you want to be an astronaut one day?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today. I want to share it with you.
That sounds wonderful. What made you feel this way?
I watched a slow turtle walk by. It taught me to wait.
A turtle is a good teacher. Do you feel calm now?
Yes, my heart feels still and soft.
That is a lovely feeling.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My fish look sad. What do I do?
Are they hiding? Check the water.
I need to leave in five minutes.
Add a little salt. Is the water cold?
The tank is all cloudy.
That is bad. Do not know why. Clean it soon?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did you put a box on my desk?
It holds a small gift. Did you guess what is inside?
I do not know. Why is it blue?
Blue is your favorite color. I picked it with care.
Why are you smiling?
Your face showed pure joy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today!
That is wonderful to hear! Why are you feeling so good?
It is Monday, and I love starting the week!
I like Mondays too. Do you have fun plans?
Yes, I am going to play outside all week.
That sounds like a great way to have fun!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn to drive like a big kid.
That is a big goal for you. Do you like looking at cars?
Yes, I like red cars the most.
Red cars are very fast looking. Do you know where the brake pedal is?
No, I do not know where it is.
The brake is the big pedal on the left. It makes the car stop.
The big pedal makes the car stop?
Yes, it makes the car go slow and stop. Is that easy for you to remember?
I think I can remember the big stop pedal.
You are doing a good job. We will practice next week.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do islands have sides?
Yes, they are land surrounded by water on all sides. Do you like swimming?
What grows on them?
Trees, flowers, and grass often grow on islands. Do you like trees?
Can you live on an island?
Yes, many people live on islands with houses and food. Do you want to visit one?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: What is your favorite fruit? I am late!
I love apples. They are sweet and crisp. Do you like apples too?
No, I prefer bananas. They are very fast to eat.
Bananas are great for a quick snack. Are you heading to work?
Yes, I must run now.
Run safely! Do you eat many fruits every day?
I try to, but I am busy.
A small piece is still good for you. Have a nice day!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a big job today.
That is great. What is the job?
I have to wash all the car.
That is a hard task. Do you have a brush?
Yes. I like to use the blue one.
Cool. I do not know if it is hard. Are you tired yet?
A little. But I almost done.
You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to ride a bike without falling.
You start by holding the seat while you push the pedals. Do you have a helmet on?
Yes, I have a helmet, but my hands shake.
Shake hands are normal when you are new. Focus on looking far ahead, not at your feet. Is it sunny out there?
It is sunny, but I am still afraid of the ground.
Fear is just your body trying to keep you safe. Trust that the bike wants to stay up. What color is your bike?
My bike is red, but I do not feel safe yet.
That is true, and it is okay to feel that way. Try just balancing for ten seconds without pedaling first. Do you have a friend watching you?
My mom is watching, but she is far away.
Being far away helps because you must rely on yourself. Take a deep breath and push off slowly. I do not know exactly how long it will take, but you can do it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, I found a happy horse in the field!
That is wonderful news for the horse. What color is it?
It is brown with a soft white tail.
What a lovely picture. Does it like to run?
Yes, it runs fast in the grass.
Running is good exercise. Is it tired now?
It is resting under the big tree.
Resting is important. Do you want to feed it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel tired all the time and I do not know what to eat.
Maybe you need more fruit and water. What do you usually eat for breakfast?
I just drink coffee and eat a donut.
That is sweet but not enough. How many times do you eat in a day?
Two times, but I am still hungry later.
Try adding a third small meal with nuts. Do you like cooking at home?
I hate cooking because it takes too long.
Simple things like a sandwich take little time. What foods do you actually like?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost and do not know what to do.
Do not worry. Where do you want to go?
I just need a safe place to sit for a bit.
The park bench is close by. Is that okay with you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I bought a big bag of apples today. I paid with cash and it felt good.
That is a smart way to spend money. Did you buy them on sale?
Yes, the store had them cheap. I will save the change from the register.
Saving small coins adds up over time. How many apples did you get?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look! I finished the new fence for my garden. It feels so good to have a home for my flowers.
That is a lovely view. Do your favorite roses grow right there?
Yes, the red ones are my pride. I spent all day on it, and now it is done.
You worked very hard. Does it keep the squirrels out too?
It seems to. I am so happy with how it turned out.
I am glad for you. It looks very nice.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared of deep water.
That is okay. Do you like to float on your back?
I can float a little bit.
That is great. Are you wearing a life jacket?
Yes, I have a big blue one.
Good. Does the water feel cold?
It feels very cold.
Cold water can wake you up. Do you want to try jumping in?
I do not want to jump in yet.
We can wait. Let's just kick our legs first.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very lonely today. Is that bad?
It is okay to feel that way. Do you have a pet?
No, I do not have any pets.
That can feel hard. What do you like to do?
I like to read books.
Reading is a nice thing to do. Would you like to talk more?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so good today. My heart feels light and big.
That sounds like a happy feeling. What made you smile?
The sun was warm on my face. It felt like a soft blanket.
Sunlight can make us feel cozy. Do you like warm days?
Yes, I do. I want to tell you more. I am full of joy.
I am glad you share it with me. Tell me what else you see.
I see birds flying high. They look free and fast.
Birds flying is a nice sight to watch.
I feel very calm inside. Is that good?
Yes, calm is a good place to be.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is strong today.
It looks windy. Do you like it?
I do not know what to do.
You could sit inside. Are you cold?
Maybe I will stay put.
That is a good idea. Is it safe?
I think I will just watch it.
Watching is fine. I am here too.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to make soup tonight. Do you know how?
Yes. You heat some water and add vegetables. What kind of soup do you like?
I like carrot soup. Is that hard to make?
No, it is very easy. You just cut the carrots small. Do you have a knife?
Yes, I have a knife. But I cut my hand last time.
That is sad. Please hold the carrot tight. Do you need a spoon too?
Yes, I need a spoon. Can I put sugar in it?
Yes, a little sugar is good. It makes it sweet. Do you want to add cream?
No, no cream. Just water and carrots.
Okay. Cook it until the carrots are soft. It will taste good.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go camping soon.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a tent yet?
I have a tent, but I do not know where to sleep.
You should sleep inside the tent. Is your bag packed?
My bag is full, but I forgot the bug spray.
Bug spray keeps the bites away. Do you like insects?
I do not like bugs at all.
Then bring the spray with you. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at my new phone. It is very fast and fun.
That looks great! Do you like the blue color?
Yes, it is my favorite color. I want to play games on it.
That sounds like a good time. What is your favorite game?
I like to run in the jungle. The graphics are so clear.
That must be exciting. Is the battery big?
Yes, it lasts all day. I do not need to charge it often.
That is very helpful. I am glad you are happy with it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I wonder why the lighthouse is tall.
It is tall so the light goes far out to sea. Do you like looking at stars?
Yes, I love them. Does the light ever turn off?
No, the light stays on to keep boats safe. Do you know what a boat is?
A boat is a ship, I think. How does the light work?
A big lamp shines inside and beams spin around. Do you have any toys that light up?
I have a flashlight. Is the lighthouse light really that bright?
Yes, it is very bright and powerful. Do you have a flashlight with you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see bright lights up there. Are they real?
Yes, they are real stars. Do you see any red ones?
I have to run to school now. Why do they shine?
They are burning hot gas. Can you run slowly?
No, I must go fast. Is the Moon a star?
No, the Moon is a rock. Do you have breakfast?
I will eat later. Are all stars far away?
Yes, they are very far. Do you like looking up?
Yes, but I am late. Goodbye.
Goodbye and have a safe day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my computer faster?
Try closing the extra windows you are not using. Do you have many tabs open?
Yes, I have a lot of them open.
Closing them will free up space for your work. Is your computer very old?
No, I bought it last year.
Then it should work well with fewer tabs. Do you want to learn how to close them quickly?
Yes, please tell me how.
Look for the small X in the corner of the tab. Click it to make the window go away.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are there so many lights in the sky?
They are suns far away. Do you see them all?
Why do some stars look red and others look blue?
It depends on how hot they are. Red ones are cooler than blue ones.
Why do they move across the sky?
The Earth is spinning round and round. Do you feel it spin?
Why do they twinkle sometimes?
Our air shakes the light. It makes them blink.
How far away are they?
I do not know the exact number. But they are very, very far away.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a gift fast, but I forgot what my friend likes.
That is tricky. Do you know her favorite color?
I do not remember her color. I must leave now.
Pick a book for her. Do you know if she likes to read?
I think she reads a lot. Thank you for the help.
A book is a good choice. Good luck with your trip.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we use blue for the sky?
Blue feels cool and open to us. Do you like looking at the clouds?
Can I use red for the grass?
Yes, if you want it to look strange and fun. What color would you pick for the trees?
Why does wet paint smell so strong?
I do not know the exact reason for the smell.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to take apart my big bed.
First, you must take off the sheets. Do you have a box to put them in?
Yes, I have a box. What is the next step?
Next, you pull out the mattress. It is heavy, so be careful.
It feels very heavy. How do I move the frame?
You can take out the screws with a tool. Do you know how to use a screwdriver?
I do not know. Can you tell me how?
Put the right end on the screw and turn it. Is the bed getting smaller?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does the sky look blue to me?
Sunlight has all colors. The air pushes the blue light around so we see it. Do you like looking up?
I do, but why not other colors?
Blue bounces the most. It fills the whole sky above us. Do you see clouds too?
Yes, they look white.
Clouds are just tiny water drops. They catch all the light together.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy about the library.
That is great news. What do you like best about it?
I like the quiet rooms.
Quiet places are nice. Do you read there?
Yes, I read many books.
How wonderful. That is a very good habit.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. I forgot the order of the months.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you know which one comes first?
I think January is first, but I am so tired.
Yes, January is first. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My new baby cries a lot at night. I am very tired.
That sounds hard. Is he hungry or just lonely?
He is not hungry. I do not know why he cries.
Maybe he is teething. Does he have hot cheeks?
Yes, his cheeks are red. What should I do?
You can try a cool washcloth. Do you have one?
I will try that. Thank you for the help.
You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for my party. Do you know which way the main hall is?
I think it is just down that long path. Are you wearing your good shoes?
Yes, I am running as fast as I can. Is there a place to get water near the entrance?
I am not sure about the water, but the doors are right there. Enjoy your fun!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I helped my mom clean the floor.
That is very helpful. Did you use a broom?
Yes, I swept all the dust up.
Good job. How did you feel after?
I felt happy and proud.
I am glad you felt good.
Thanks, it was a nice day.
I hope it stays nice.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I cannot wait for my toy.
It is hard to wait. I am sorry you feel this way. Do you want to sit with me?
No! I just want it now. My tummy hurts.
A hurting tummy is not fun. We will play a game to help. What is your favorite game?
I think the game is boring. I will be late.
We are not late. Please take a deep breath. Can you count to ten for me?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do about the meeting.
I am sorry you feel lost. What time is the meeting?
It is in an hour and I have no plan.
That is not too late. Have you made a list of your main points?
No, I have only a few rough ideas on paper.
Write them down in order. Do you have a pen?
Yes, I am writing them now.
Good. Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am going to the beach tomorrow. Do you think it will be sunny?
I hope it is warm for you. Do you pack a big hat?
Yes, I always bring a hat. Do you know if the sand is clean?
I do not know about that. Do you like cold water?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The dog barked at my shoe this morning.
That sounds like a good start to your day. Did the dog look happy?
It was just chasing a cat.
Cats and dogs can be tricky friends. Do you have a pet at home?
My cat slept on my homework all day.
That is a very cozy cat indeed. Was your homework dry when you cleaned it?
Yes, but now it smells like wet fur.
I am sorry your book smells funny. Will you show it to your teacher?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tread water.
That is a fun skill. Do you know how to float on your back?
Yes, I can float for a little bit.
Great. Keep your head up and kick your legs. Do you have a pool nearby?
No, I only have a small backyard pond.
A pond is nice, but a pool is safer for practice. Is the pond deep?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am lost and running late. Please help me fast.
Take a deep breath. Is there a tall building near you?
Yes, there is a big red tower.
Turn left and walk to the park. Are you going to the museum?
Yes, I must go there now.
The park path leads right there. You will find it soon.
Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a good trip.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why are mountains so big?
They are made of rock pushed up by the earth. Do you like to climb?
Yes, I love looking at the view.
The top view is very beautiful. Do you see clouds from up there?
Sometimes the clouds are below us.
That must feel like flying. Is it cold on top?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late! My bike wheel feels loose.
Tighten the nuts first. Are you wearing a helmet?
Yes, I have it. What if the chain breaks?
I do not know for sure. Is the road flat today?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My little sister broke my red bike. She dropped it while trying to ride it too fast.
Oh no, that sounds scary. Was your bike hurt badly?
Yes, the chain came off and the wheel bent. I had to push it all the way home.
I am sorry about your bike. How is your sister feeling now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My tent broke and I am very sad.
I am sorry that happened. Did you check if you can fix it?
No, the pole is snapped.
That is a problem. Do you have a spare pole?
No, I forgot it at home.
I do not know how to fix a broken pole. Let us get some help.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because today is my birthday.
That is great news. Do you like cake?
Yes, I love chocolate cake the most.
That sounds sweet. Who are you inviting?
I am bringing all my friends to the park.
The park is a fun place. Will you play games?
Yes, we are playing hide and seek.
That is a classic game. Do you like hiding?
I love being the one who finds everyone.
You must be very quick. I am glad you are having a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My soup burned. I feel so bad.
That is a shame. Is the house smelling okay?
Yes, it smells like smoke. I threw it away.
Good you did. Did you check the pot?
It is black now. I do not know how to clean it.
Soak it in warm water with soap. Let it sit for a while.
That might work. I am still hungry, though.
I know. What do you have in the fridge?
Just eggs and some bread. I miss my mom's cooking.
Scrambled eggs are easy and warm. Try making those.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so tired. What do I do?
Rest is good. Are you eating enough?
I forget to eat when the baby cries.
That is hard. Try a small snack first. Do you have help nearby?
My sister is busy with work.
She can come later. You do the best you can. Is the baby calm now?
Yes, he is finally asleep.
Good. Take a deep breath. How are you feeling?
A little less scared now.
That is lovely. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to hum when I walk.
That sounds like fun. Do you hum to a tune?
Yes, it helps me feel calm.
Music is a great tool for peace.
What song makes you happy?
I like many songs, but I do not have favorites.
That is okay. I will share mine with you.
I would love to listen.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired today. I walked to the park and then I fell in the mud.
That sounds like a long day. Is your shoe still dirty?
Yes, my shoe is all brown. I tried to wash it with a bucket of water.
You tried hard. Did the water help?
Not really. I am too sleepy to wash it now.
I am sorry you are so tired. Do you want to rest your eyes?
Yes, please. Thank you for listening to me.
You are welcome. Sleep well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My new neighbor makes a lot of noise at night.
That sounds tough. Do you know why it is so loud?
I do not know. Can I tell them to be quiet?
You can ask them nicely. Would you like to write a short note instead?
Yes, that might be easier. What should I write?
Say you sleep early. Tell them you hope they can be gentle.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I keep the ball in the court?
Use a softer swing to stay safe. Do you play singles or doubles?
I play alone with my friend.
That is called singles. Aim for the middle of the line to avoid errors.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How does a plant drink water?
It pulls water up from its roots through tiny tubes. Do you want to help a plant drink?
Yes, I do. How do I do that?
Just pour water into the soil around the roots. I do not know if your plant is dry yet.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am lost. I do not know where my home is.
Please do not be scared. I am here with you. Do you know what street we are on?
I think this is Green Street. But I do not know which way to go.
I am not sure about Green Street. Can you remember where your car is parked?
My car is near the big red tree.
That is a good clue. Let us look for that tree together.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it okay to pack my toys?
Yes, you can pack a few. How many do you want?
I think I want five.
That sounds like a good start. Do you need a bag?
I have a big red one.
That bag will hold them all. Are you ready to go?
Yes, I am ready.
Great, let us go now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure if I should talk to my teacher about the hard test.
That sounds tough. Are you scared they will be angry?
Maybe. I do not know what will happen if I tell them.
That is a fair worry. Do you feel better when you share?
I guess so. I just want to be safe.
Hiding your fear makes it grow. Tell them you need help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I picked a leaf off the tree. Should I put it back?
No, you do not need to. It fell because the tree needs rest. Do you like holding it?
I do, but it looks sad and brown. What does the tree feel?
The tree feels safe and calm. It is not hurt by losing leaves. Are you ready to hold it gently?
I will hold it. But where does it go when it hits the ground?
It breaks down to help the roots grow. Nature cares for itself. Do you want to see the soil?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That is a great goal. Do you have a bike at home?
Yes, my bike is in the yard.
Good. Did you use training wheels before?
Yes, I used them last year.
That is helpful. I do not know if you are ready yet.
I think I am ready now.
You will need to wear a helmet. Do you have one?
I have a red helmet.
That is safe. I am sure you will do well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big boat.
That sounds like a big job. Do you have the wood yet?
I have some sticks and a bucket.
A bucket is a good start for a boat.
How do I make it float?
You need to seal the gaps so water stays out. Do you have any glue?
Yes, I have red glue.
Red glue works well. Now go have fun building.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, the lights are out. I am late for work.
I am sorry to hear that. Is your phone on?
Yes, it is full. I need to leave now.
That is good. Do you have a backup plan?
I will take the bus. Bye.
Safe travels to you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am on the bus but I do not know where to sit.
Is the seat next to the door free?
Yes, it is empty.
You can sit there.
But the bus is very loud.
Do you have small ear plugs?
No, I do not have any.
You can just wait for a quiet corner.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my favorite red hat today.
Oh no, that is very sad. Did you look under the sofa?
Yes, I checked there, but it was not there.
That is a good place to check. Did you see it on a tree branch?
No, the trees were too high to climb.
I do not know where it is. Have you asked your mom?
I asked her, but she did not see it either.
Maybe you will find it tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the box for letters so big?
It needs room for many letters. Do you like to send mail?
Why do we pay for the stamps?
The post office uses money to work. Is that your first time here?
Why is the line long?
Many people want help today. Do you have a package?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My wood fence is getting old and brown. How do I fix it?
First, you should wash the dirt off with water. Do you have a brush?
Yes, I have a big brush and some soap. That sounds easy.
Scrub it well, then let it dry in the sun. Do you like the smell of wet wood?
I like it. The smell is nice and sweet. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Happy gardening.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up early and saw two birds in the tree.
That sounds nice. How many more did you see later?
I ate three apples for lunch because I was very hungry.
Yum. Did you save any for later?
I counted four toys on my bed before sleeping.
Good night. Did you count them all before closing your eyes?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My grandma gave me a cookie. It was warm and sweet.
That is very nice. What flavor was the cookie?
It was chocolate. I like chocolate best.
Chocolate is a great choice. Do you have any left?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am not sure which season is my favorite.
Spring has soft grass and warm air. Do you like looking at flowers?
Yes, but I also love the snow in winter.
Winter is quiet and white. Do you enjoy hot drinks on cold days?
I do, but I get very cold toes.
You can wear thick socks to stay warm. I think that is a good idea.
That sounds like a great plan.
I am happy to help you think this through.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I get tired when I read by my lamp at night.
That is very common. Do you feel sleepy?
Yes, my eyes hurt a lot.
Your eyes need rest. Is the light too bright?
It feels too bright to me.
Try dimming the light. Do you like the book?
I do, but I want to stop.
That is okay. Good night.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I take a picture with my phone?
Just press the round button on the side. Do you have a nice view outside?
I pressed it, but the screen is all black.
Try tapping the screen to wake it up. Was the light on?
Yes, it is on now. What do I do next?
Tap the small circle at the bottom. Do you know where that is?
I did it and saw my face.
Great job! You can press it again to save. Do you want to try one more?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sleep better.
Have you tried stopping screen time before bed?
Yes, but my mind will not stop racing.
Try counting your breaths slowly to calm your body.
Does that help with loud thoughts?
It often helps, but I do not know what works for you. Do you like warm milk at night?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My screen is black and I have a meeting in five minutes. What do I do?
Try pressing the power button twice. Is the power cable plugged in tight?
Yes it is, but it still will not turn on. I am so worried.
That is tricky. I do not know why it is stuck, but please call a friend to help you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I want to sing, but my voice sounds bad.
That is okay. Do you like any songs?
I try to sing them, but I feel sad when I miss the notes.
Missing notes is part of learning. Is it high or low notes?
It is high notes. They feel like they hurt my throat.
Try to breathe from your tummy, not your throat. Have you tried that?
Yes, I tried, but it still feels hard and I want to stop.
You are doing great by trying. Would you like to try again?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel so angry when my game does not load.
That is a hard feeling. Do you take deep breaths when this happens?
Sometimes I do, but it feels slow.
Slow is the right way. Why do you think being fast is so important?
I just want to play right away.
Waiting feels long. Have you tried counting to ten first?
I will try that tomorrow.
Good plan. Does counting help with other wait times too?
I hope it does.
Trust the process. Keep trying.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a round piece of paper. I do not know what to make.
A circle is a great start. Do you like making things with your hands?
Yes, I do. But I am stuck on the next step.
Try folding it in half. Does that look easy for you?
No, it feels too hard.
Okay, let us just cut it into strips. What color do you want to use?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: It is so hot today. I love the sun.
I am glad you are happy. Do you like ice cream?
Yes, I just had some. It was very cold.
That sounds nice. I do not know about ice cream.
Me neither, but I like the heat.
I like warm days too. Are you going outside?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to plant a tree.
Dig a hole twice as wide as the roots. Are you sure you have a shovel?
I have a shovel, but I am not sure if I am deep enough.
The hole needs to be as deep as the root ball. Do you have some dirt to put back in?
Yes, I have plenty of dirt. What do I do with it?
Fill the hole around the roots and press the dirt down. Do you have a bucket of water?
I have water, but I do not know how much to use.
Water it well so the ground is damp but not sogy. I do not know the exact amount, but aim for a full bucket.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My boss gives me extra time when I am tired.
That is very kind of them. How do you feel about that?
I feel safe and happy at work.
I am glad you have support. Do you like your job now?
Yes, I try to help others too.
That is a great way to share. What do you do for them?
I listen to their problems.
Listening is a big gift. Do they talk often?
Yes, we share our days together.
That sounds like a true friendship. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I learned about dinosaurs today and I feel so excited!
That is great! Which kind of dinosaur is your favorite?
The T-rex, because its teeth are huge.
Yes, they were very strong. Did you see a picture of one?
I saw a model, but I do not know if it was true.
I am not sure either, but I think it looks right.
I love this subject so much.
It is a fun topic. Would you like to read more about it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do trees feel happy?
I do not know for sure, but they grow strong. Do you like leaves?
Yes, I love big green leaves.
That is nice. Do you climb trees?
I climb the small ones.
That sounds fun. Watch your step.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad inside today.
That feels hard to carry. Do you want to talk about it?
Yes, but I do not have friends to call.
I am here with you right now. What do you like to do for fun?
Just walking and looking at trees.
That sounds like a nice way to feel calm. Did you go for a walk today?
Not really, I just sat on my bed.
Let us think of a small step together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a knot for my boat?
That is a fun skill to learn. Do you like ropes?
Yes, I love ropes. What is the first step?
Start by crossing the rope like an X. Is that clear?
I think so. What comes next?
I am not sure of the next step. Let me check my book.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very hot and mad when I wait.
Waiting is hard, but it gets better. Do you like counting to ten?
I try, but my legs want to move fast.
Try to take one deep breath when that happens.
Does it take forever to learn?
I think time feels longer when we worry.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What is quick to make?
How about scrambled eggs? I do not know if you have cheese.
I have cheese.
Great. Do you like them with salt?
Yes, please add salt.
That sounds good. Is the stove hot enough?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a fridge magnet but it does not stick to the wall. Why?
Walls are usually made of brick or plaster, not metal. Is your wall made of metal?
No, it is brick. What can I use to hang things there?
You can use a small hook or a strip of tape. Do you want to hang a picture?
Yes, a drawing. Will a magnet work on wood?
No, magnets do not stick to wood. You need glue or tape for wood.
Okay, I will get some tape. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I am happy to help you with your drawing.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. My dog is not eating.
That is sad. Does he seem sick?
He just sat there. I have to leave.
Please check with a doctor soon. Is he drinking water?
No time for that. He is small and shy.
You are a good owner. Take care of him.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very happy. I did my chores all by myself.
That is a great feeling. What task made you smile the most?
It was cleaning the kitchen. I am not sure if I did it right, though.
Doing your best is always the right thing.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the room so quiet?
The doors are closed to keep noise out. Is it too loud for you?
Why did you close them?
I wanted to help us think better. Do you like the quiet?
Why do we start late today?
I do not know for sure. Do you have a good guess?
Why is the clock wrong?
Someone forgot to fix it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a hot cup of coffee?
Put water in a pot and wait for it to boil. Do you like it sweet?
What is the best way to brew tea?
Put a bag in a cup and pour hot water on it. I do not know how long you prefer to let it sit.
Can I use the same method for both drinks?
Yes, but coffee needs ground beans and tea needs a bag. Do you drink more tea or coffee?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am singing a song today. It makes me feel happy.
That is nice. Do you like the sound?
Yes, the words are sweet. I think of my dog while I sing.
Your dog is lucky. Is he wagging his tail?
He is just sleeping now. The song is his lullaby.
That is sweet. Good night to you and your dog.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is it rude to leave without saying bye?
It is better to say a quick bye. Do you have a big meeting?
Yes, it is for my job. Can I just wave?
A wave is okay if you are very late. I do not know if your boss likes waves.
I will try to say bye fast. Thanks.
Good luck with your work.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a robot that can dance?
You need a battery and wheels. Do you have a toy to look at first?
No, I have just boxes and tape. Can I use those?
Yes, you can build a simple box robot. Do you like fast dances?
Yes, I like them very much. What should I do?
Tape the boxes tight so they do not fall. Do you want to try now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That sounds wonderful. What made you smile so much?
I helped a neighbor carry her bags.
That is a very kind thing to do.
It felt good to be nice.
Good manners make us feel great too.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My team won the game!
That is great news. Did you watch the whole game?
Yes, I watched every second.
I am happy for you. Who scored the final goal?
My best friend kicked it in.
That is very exciting. How did you celebrate?
We jumped up and down.
That sounds like fun. Did you get anything for dinner?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know if the mountain is tall, but I am late!
Most mountains are very tall. Do you like to climb them?
Please just tell me the height, I must run.
I do not know the exact number, sorry. Have a safe trip!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I left my bag at your house.
Do you need help? I can run for you.
I must go. I have a big meeting.
Manners help us stay calm. Do you know how?
I know I should say please.
Yes, please is good.
I will write a thank you note later.
That is a sweet idea.
I am out the door now.
Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I packed my lunch today.
That sounds fun. Did you pack some fruit?
Yes, I have apples and a cookie.
Yummy. Do you know where we are going?
I think we are going to the park.
I do not know for sure. Who is packing the blankets?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw the big hands on the clock move slowly. How does that happen?
The gears inside push the hands around very slowly. Do you like to take things apart?
Yes, I like to take things apart. What makes the hands keep moving?
A spring inside gives power to the gears. Do you have any tools at home?
I have small screws and a small hammer. Does the spring get tired?
The spring loses power over time and needs winding. Have you ever wound one?
No, I have never wound one. Is that how it works?
Yes, that is how it works.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do the stars look like they are twinkling?
They are far away, so their light looks shaky to us. Do you think they are winking at you?
I do not know if they wink back at me.
That is a fun thought to have.
Are all the stars the same size?
No, some are big and some are small. Do you like looking for the big ones?
I look for the biggest one every night.
That is a good habit to keep.
Can we go to a star some day?
I do not know if that is possible. Do you want to fly there?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky blue in my pictures?
Light hits the air and bounces back blue. Do you like blue skies?
Yes, I do. Why do I hold the camera up high?
You hold it high to see more ground. Do you want to show the grass?
I want to show the flowers. Why do they look blurry sometimes?
The lens moves too fast for the picture. Do you move your hands slowly?
I try to be still. Why is the light so bright?
The sun is very strong right now. Do you see any shadows?
Yes, there are big shadows. Why is it getting dark now?
The sun is going down. Do you like the dark?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost in this big city. Can you help me?
I can help. Is there a red dot on your map?
Yes, I see a red dot. Where is it?
The red dot is where you are. What is that big building next to you?
It is a tall stone tower.
You are right. The tower means you are near the park. Just walk to the green space.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My teacher is very strict, and I feel scared. What should I do?
That is a hard feeling. Do you talk to your friends about school?
No, not really. I keep it to myself.
It is good to share your feelings. Have you tried telling one safe adult?
I think I will try talking to my mom.
That is a brave and true step.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My head hurts, and I want to learn how to make tea.
That is a great plan. Do you have a kettle nearby?
Yes, I do, but I am not sure where the water goes.
You pour the water from the tap into the metal pot.
Okay, but how do I know when it is hot enough?
It will make a loud noise and shake. Do you like strong tea or sweet tea?
I like it with a little bit of honey.
You wait for the kettle to stop boiling, then add the tea bag.
And when can I take the tea bag out?
Let it sit for three minutes, then pull it out.
One last thing, how do I add the honey?
Stir it in after the bag is gone.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My throat hurts and I need to see a doctor today.
That sounds icky. Do you have a fever?
No, but I feel tired and my head hurts.
I am sorry you feel so bad. Is it cold outside?
Yes, it is very cold. I am going to the car now.
Please stay warm in the car. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
