exchanges: Why does my tomato plant grow so tall?
It needs more light. Do you check the sun every day?
Yes, but why do the leaves turn yellow?
They may be thirsty. How much water do you give it?
I gave it a lot. Why is it still droopy?
Too much water can hurt the roots. I do not know your soil type.
It is just dirt. Why do the roots need space?
Roots need air to breathe. Do you dig it up to check?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do fish come to the water's edge?
They often look for food or fresh air near the surface. Do you like watching them swim?
Why do we use a hook and line?
The hook catches the fish so we can pull it out of the water. Do you think it is fun to pull?
Why do some people fish at night?
Some fish are more active when it is quiet and dark. I am not sure why they choose exactly that time.
Why is the water sometimes cold?
Deep water stays cold because the sun does not reach down there. Do you like swimming in cold water?
Why do we need a good rod?
A strong rod helps you lift the fish without breaking the line. It is not always easy to tell a good one from a bad one.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot find the big dinosaur. I am so sad.
That is a tough spot. Are you looking in the main hall?
I checked there, but it is not there. I am lost now.
I do not know where it is, but I can help you look. Do you like the night sky room?
No, I only want the bone monster. My time is running out.
Let us walk slowly together. Is there a map at the front desk?
Yes, I see a map. Thank you for staying with me.
It is right there on the left wall. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to run. Do I have to walk every day to be healthy?
No, even a few minutes helps your body. Do you have five free minutes today?
Maybe later. Is walking bad if I am in a hurry?
No, it is always good for you. Take your time to stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so tired. My boss was very mean to me today.
That sounds really hard. What did they say that made you feel bad?
They said my work was wrong. I tried so hard, but I did it wrong.
You did your best, and that is what matters. Are you hungry?
Yes, my tummy hurts a little. I want a big plate of hot soup.
Soup sounds perfect for a bad day. Do you like it with bread?
Yes, with bread and cheese. Thank you for listening.
You are welcome. I am glad you have a nice snack coming.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I find the North Star in the night sky?
Look for the Big Dipper and follow the two stars on the bowl edge. Do you see that shape tonight?
Yes, I see it. What happens if it is cloudy?
You cannot see the stars if clouds cover them. Do you have a flashlight to help you look?
I have one, but I am not sure where to point it.
Hold the light low and look up slowly. Does the sky look dark around you?
It is very dark here. How do I read the star map?
I do not know your exact map, but it usually shows bright stars first. Do you have a guide book nearby?
I do not, but I will draw what I see instead.
That is a great way to learn by looking. Have fun watching the lights change.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to say sorry?
It tells the other person you care about their feelings. Do you feel bad when someone is angry with you?
Yes, it feels heavy.
Apologizing helps that heavy feeling go away.
Does it make them happy?
It often does, because it shows respect. Do you want to fix the mistake?
I do, I promise.
That is a great start.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a very tough day today.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you get to take a break?
No, the phones never stopped ringing.
That must have felt like a storm. How do you feel right now?
I am just tired and my head hurts.
Please rest your mind now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a cow in the field today. It made a funny sound.
Cows say moo to talk to us. Do you like cows?
Yes, I like them. They have big tails that wag.
They wag their tails to feel happy. Are they big?
Yes, they are very big. Bigger than me.
Cows are much bigger than children. Do they have horns?
Some have horns, some do not. The one I saw did not.
Some cows are born without horns. Is it safe to pet them?
The farmer said yes, but gently. They are soft.
You must be very gentle with them. Do you want to visit again?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent the whole afternoon in the garden today.
That sounds like such a peaceful way to spend time. Did you plant anything new?
Yes, I put in some sunflowers because I love how tall they get.
Sunflowers are beautiful to watch grow. Do you have a favorite one that bloomed?
The yellow ones are my favorite because they remind me of the sun.
It is wonderful that you can find such joy in nature.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I lose every game. How do I get good at chess?
Start by moving your king to safety. Do you know why that is safe?
I guess not. What should I do?
Try to control the middle of the board with your pawns.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That is great. Why are you happy?
I saw a robot dancing.
How fun. Did it move well?
Yes, it was fast and smooth.
I do not know if they can dance. Did it look real?
It looked a bit like a person.
That sounds cool. Do you like robots?
I think they are very interesting.
Good for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the door?
It is over there. Do you know how to solve it?
I forgot the key. Can you help?
Yes, I can. What is your number?
It is a red pen. Is that good?
That is a good tool. Are you ready to start?
I am going now. Bye.
Good luck with your work.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a round cookie and a square cracker. How do I make a triangle?
You can cut the corner off the square cracker. Do you have a sharp knife?
No, I only have a spoon. Is the spoon good for cutting?
A spoon is not sharp, so it is not good for cutting. Do you want to use your hands?
I will try to bend the cracker. Will that work?
Cracker is hard, so bending may break it. Do you like broken shapes?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost about the sea.
The sea is big. Do you like boats?
Yes, but I am scared of the waves.
That is okay. Fear is common. Do you have a safe place to sit?
I am just standing here.
Please find a chair. Rest is good. Is your body tired?
Yes, my legs hurt.
Sitting will help. You can wait. Are you hungry?
No, I just want to understand sailors.
I do not know everything. They work hard. Do they help you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am scared to start my first job tomorrow.
It is normal to feel nervous. Do you have a plan for breakfast?
I will eat toast and drink juice.
That sounds like a good start. Are you excited to meet your new friends?
I hope they are nice to me.
Most people are kind. What is your first task?
I will clean the front desk and answer phones.
You can do that job well. Good luck with your first day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. Work was hard today.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you manage to finish your tasks?
Yes, but it took all day. My eyes hurt from the screen.
Rest is good for your eyes. Would you like some water?
Yes, please. I need a break now.
Here is your water. Go take a nap.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy. I made soup for dinner.
That sounds great. What is in the soup?
I put carrots and corn in it.
Nice choice. Do you like eating hot food?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big white boat on the lake today.
That sounds like a nice day. What did the sailors look like?
They wore red hats and waved at me.
Waving is a kind thing to do. Did they talk to you?
No, they just kept working on the ropes.
Working hard is good. Do you like watching boats?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I ride a bike?
Put your feet on the pedals and start rolling. Do you have a helmet on?
I fell down and my knee hurts. What do I do?
Put a clean cloth on the cut. Does it bleed a lot?
No, it is just a little scratch. I want to try again.
That is good. Push off the ground and lean forward.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to make a snowball.
I can help with that. Do you have some snow nearby?
Yes, there is a big pile in the yard.
Good. Pick up a small bit of snow and hold it tight in one hand.
I did. My hand is cold.
Is it still in a loose pile?
No, it is a round ball now.
Great. Roll it on the ground to make it bigger.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is very loud and I feel scared. What should I do?
It is safe to stay inside with a light on. Do you have a favorite blanket?
Yes, I do. But it is raining hard outside. Will it stop soon?
I do not know when it will stop. Are you eating a snack to calm down?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do.
Do not worry. Is the teacher asking for a specific task?
The task is very hard.
I do not know the full details. Have you tried asking for help?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today and it was very sunny.
That sounds nice. Did you see the ocean?
Yes, the water was blue and I saw a big red boat.
A red boat is a fun sight. Did you try to swim?
No, I only built a sand castle because the water was cold.
Building is a great way to play. Was your castle tall?
It was tall and I put a star on the top.
A star is a nice touch. Did you share it with anyone?
I gave it to my friend and then we went home for lunch.
That was kind of you to share.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I wash my clothes?
Put them in the machine with soap. Do you have a stain?
Yes, there is red juice.
Soak it in cold water first. Is the stain fresh?
It was there for two days.
I do not know if that will work well. Try a special remover.
Do I need hot or cold water?
Use cold water for most clothes. Do you know what the fabric is?
It is a cotton shirt.
Cold water is best for cotton. Just follow the tag.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the man falling on the stage?
He is pretending to fall. Do you like funny things?
Yes, but why is he smiling?
He is happy because the story is good.
Why does the woman cry?
I do not know why she cries.
Is the play almost done?
Yes, it is almost over.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to run, but I feel too tired to start.
That is okay, your body just needs rest. Are you drinking enough water?
I drink water, but my legs feel heavy.
Light runs can help you feel strong again. Do you like running near trees?
I like trees, but I am not sure if I should run today.
Listen to your body, and take it slow if you can.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My legs hurt so bad today.
That must feel tough. Are you resting?
I want to quit. It is too hard.
Taking a break is smart. Do you like running?
I used to. Now I just hate it.
Hating it is a normal feeling. Did you try to slow down?
No, I ran fast.
Slowing down helps your body heal. How are you feeling now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like that new song at all.
I am sorry it makes you feel bad. Do you hate the loud sound?
It is too loud and fast for me.
I get that fast songs can be tiring. Do you like slow songs better?
Yes, I like slow ones with soft words.
That sounds like a nice choice. I do not know the exact title you mean.
I just want to hear something calm today.
Calm music helps us feel good. Would you like to pick a song now?
Okay, let me pick one that feels nice.
That is a great plan. I am happy to help you choose.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so late for work today.
I am sorry you are running late. Did you miss your bus?
The bus was broken, so I had to walk.
That sounds like a long walk. Did it rain while you were outside?
It did not rain, but it was very windy.
Wind can make walking hard. Are you tired now?
Yes, my legs hurt from the wind.
I am sure your legs hurt. Have you eaten breakfast yet?
No, I skipped it to save time.
I hope you are safe now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My computer is cold. It will not start.
That is strange. Is the power cord in?
Yes, it is plugged in tight.
Try turning it off first. Do you see any lights?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate a big bowl of toast with jam this morning.
That sounds sweet. Did you enjoy it?
Yes, it was very tasty and warm.
I am glad you liked it. Do you like toast?
I do, but I want something different later.
Maybe you can try some eggs.
That is a good idea, I love eggs too.
Great choice for lunch.
I will see what I can find at the shop.
Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late and I need to paint this wall right now.
Take a deep breath. What color do you want?
It is blue, but I am too fast to pick the right shade.
That is a hard choice. Do you like light or dark blue?
Please just tell me the number I need to buy.
I do not know your house. Do you have a sample card?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big bear today. I felt very happy to see it.
That sounds like a great day. Do you like bears?
Yes, they are cool. Do you know what they eat?
Mostly they eat berries and fish. Do you like fish?
A little bit, I think. Why do bears sleep in the winter?
They sleep to save energy when food is hard to find. Do you know how?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I ran really fast today. I felt so good.
That is great to hear. Do you want to run again tomorrow?
Yes, I do. It makes me feel strong.
Good for you. Keep going.
I will not stop. I love this feeling.
That is wonderful. You sound very happy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to grow a plant, but I do not know how.
First, you need a small pot and some soil. Do you have a sunny spot in your house?
Yes, my window gets a lot of light. What do I put in the pot?
Mix the soil with water until it feels like a wet sponge. Then, gently put your seed inside.
That sounds easy. How do I keep it alive?
Give it a little water every few days, not too much. Do you know which plant you picked?
It is a bean plant, I hope. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Watch for tiny green leaves soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need to sleep?
Sleep helps your body rest and your brain learn. Do you like reading before bed?
I often stay up late playing. Why is that bad?
Your body needs quiet time to fix itself. Do you feel tired the next day?
I feel foggy and slow. How can I sleep better?
Try going to bed at the same time every night. Do you use a phone in bed?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to draw a big sun.
That sounds fun. Do you want it to be yellow?
Yes, but my lines are wobbly.
Wobbly lines are okay. Does it have a face?
No, I am drawing a dog.
A dog is a good choice. What color is it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. Do you know why?
I am glad you are happy. What made you smile?
I fixed the light switch. It works again.
That is great news. Do you feel proud?
Yes, I did it by myself. It was fun.
You are very smart. Did you use a tool?
I used a small screw. It was tight.
Be careful with tools. Did you help a friend fix theirs?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I wash my t-shirt?
Put it in the machine with soap. Do you have a favorite color?
Yes, I like blue. How much soap do I use?
A small spoon is enough. Is your shirt dirty or clean?
It is very dirty. What temperature should I use?
Use warm water for good cleaning. Do you want it soft?
Yes, please. How do I finish?
Run a rinse cycle to be safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn to sing now. I have no time to wait.
Take a deep breath. Do you feel your chest move?
Yes, but it feels tight. I am so rushed.
Relax your shoulders. Is your jaw loose?
It hurts a little. How do I make a sound?
Just hum a low note. Does that feel easier?
It is better, but I must go.
Keep it simple. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not like to wait for my toys.
It feels hard, but waiting makes the fun bigger. Do you have a game to play while you wait?
I just want to play right now.
It is okay to feel that way. Patience is like a muscle that gets stronger.
How do I make my muscle strong?
I do not know one perfect way. Have you tried counting to ten when you are mad?
I try to count, but I forget.
That is normal. You can try again tomorrow. Would you like to practice counting with me?
Yes, one, two, three.
Great job. You are doing very well.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad because my plan is messy and I do not know what to do.
I am sorry you feel this way. What part of the plan is worrying you the most?
The steps are all mixed up and I feel like I will fail.
Let us break it into small pieces. Do you want to start with the first step?
Yes, I guess I can try that, but I am still nervous.
It is okay to be nervous. We will take it one step at a time together.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I like the sweet smells here. I do not know what to pick.
That is hard to choose. Do you like chocolate or fruit?
I like both, I think. I have no idea where to start.
Try the small apple tart. It is soft and sweet.
The tart looks good. I want to buy it.
That is a good pick. Enjoy your treat.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now, but the baby is here.
That is great news. Is he happy?
Yes, he is sleeping now.
That is very good.
I must leave right away.
Take your time. Do you have a bottle?
Yes, I have food.
Good luck to you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I find the park on this map?
Look for the green space. Do you see the blue river next to it?
Yes, I do. How do I get there from the red dot?
Just follow the black line straight down. Is that line thick or thin?
It is a thick line. Is that a road?
Yes, that is a main road.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my boss so nice?
She cares about her team. Do you see her help others?
Yes, she helps us a lot.
Kindness makes work better. Do you feel happy there?
I do feel very happy.
That is a great feeling.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel so alone at recess today.
That feels heavy. Do you want to sit with me?
You would? I just want a friend.
Yes, I am here for you. What game do you like?
I like tag, but no one plays.
Tag is fun. Shall we start a round?
Okay, you are it.
I am it. I love running with you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I watered my big fern today and it looked so happy.
That is great news for your plant. Do you know why it needs the water?
I think it drinks through its roots like we do.
Yes, the roots pull up the water. It moves up the stem to the leaves.
The leaves let the water out as tiny drops sometimes.
You are right, that is called transpiration. It helps pull more water up.
I am glad I understand how it works now.
I am happy you learned something new. Did you see any dew on the leaves?
I did not look close enough to see any.
That is fine, you can check tomorrow. Do you talk to your plants?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the tennis ball so bouncy?
It has air inside that pushes back. Do you like to jump?
Yes, I do. Why is the court green?
It helps players see the ball well.
Why is the net in the middle?
It stops the ball from going straight over. Do you have a racket?
No, not yet. Why do people play this game?
It is fun and makes you strong.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I catch rain in a bowl?
You can place a clean bowl in the yard. Do you have a big bowl at home?
Yes, I do.
Just leave it there until the rain comes.
Will it fill up the bowl?
Yes, but it takes time. What kind of bowl do you have?
A glass one.
That works well, but be careful it is not too heavy.
I will watch it closely.
That is a good plan. Enjoy the water.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My friend said he did not like my new dress.
That sounds very unfair. Does he usually say mean things?
No, but he is being so rude. How do I make him stop?
Try telling him it hurt your feelings. Are you calm enough to talk?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The sun is bright, but the wind feels cold. Do you know why?
It is often windy when the air is dry and crisp. Is your jacket warm enough for you?
Yes, I have a big coat on. Do you think it will rain later?
I do not know the future, but the clouds look heavy. Do you like rain, or do you prefer the sun?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is so hot today. What should I do?
Drink plenty of cold water. Do you like lemonade?
Yes, I do. It is still very warm outside.
Go inside where it is cool. Is your house cold?
Yes, it is nice and chill. Thank you for the tips.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so bored waiting for the bus.
Waiting can feel very long. Do you have a toy with you?
No, I only have my fingers to count.
Counting is a good game to play.
Can you come sit next to me?
I can try to keep you company.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a boat, but I do not know what to do with it.
That is a nice boat. Is it dry or wet inside?
It is very dry and clean.
Good. You can rest there for a bit. Do you like the color?
Yes, the blue is very pretty.
I agree. I do not know where you should take it.
I wish to go far, but I am not sure how.
You need a map to go far. Do you have one with you?
I have no map, only this boat.
Then stay here for now. It is safe and quiet.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see a small bird on my rose bush.
That is a lovely sight. Are you watching it closely?
Yes, it is pecking at the leaves.
It is looking for bugs to eat. Do you like watching them eat?
It looks so tiny and cute.
Many birds are small. Have you seen any other kinds?
Yes, a big one flew by a minute ago.
Oh, a hawk or maybe a crow?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I cannot find my old friend.
That sounds sad. Do you have their number?
I lost my phone a long time ago.
I am sorry to hear that. Can you check your email?
I am not sure where to look.
Search for their last name. Do you remember their name?
I think it was Sam.
That is a good start. Try typing that in.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I stop my bike fast?
Squeeze the brake levers gently. Do you wear your helmet on?
Yes, I always wear it. How do I turn a sharp corner?
Look where you want to go, not down. What color is your bike?
It is blue. How do I fix a flat tire?
I do not know, but a shop can help. Is it your first time?
No, I ride often. Can I ride in the rain?
It can be slippery, so go slow. Do you have bright lights?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind feels sharp today, and the leaves are all gone.
That sounds like winter is here. Do you like the cold?
It makes me want soup and a big blanket.
I hear you like to stay warm in the snow.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a big plate of fries. Will they make me strong?
Fries taste good, but they do not build strong muscles. Do you like crunchy carrots?
No, I do not. What should I eat instead?
Try some beans and bread. They give you good energy to run.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late and my truck is full.
Take a deep breath and stay safe. Are you driving alone?
Yes, the boxes are all packed tight.
That is good preparation. Do you have a map?
I have it on my phone, but the screen is dark.
You can turn on the lights. Is the battery dead?
No, I just need to plug it in while I drive.
Please do not drive while plugging in. Are your hands free?
My hands are on the wheel, so I am safe.
That is smart and true. You will arrive soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go for food.
That is hard. Do you like hot food?
I am very hungry right now.
Let us find a fast place.
I feel lost and unsure.
I will help you look. Can you wait?
I am ready to go.
Great. Let us start here.
Thank you for staying with me.
You are welcome. Let us go.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a snowman, but I do not know how.
Roll a big ball of snow for the body, then a smaller one for the head. Do you have a carrot?
Yes, I have a carrot and some buttons.
Put the carrot on the nose and use the buttons for the eyes. How cold is it outside?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad because I lost my favorite book.
That is very hard. Do you know where you left it?
No, I do not know. I think it is gone for good.
Let us look together. Did you set it on the big red table?
I checked there, but it is not there.
I am sorry to hear that. Have you checked the main desk?
No, I have not tried that yet.
Let us check now. Do you want to come with me?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The street is loud and full of people. I do not know where to go.
It can feel like too much. Do you like sweet food?
I like sweet food, but I am also very tired. I just want to rest.
That makes sense. Your body needs a break.
There are no benches here. I am standing on my feet.
I do not know of a bench right now. Are you near a big park?
No, the park is far away. I feel stuck in this crowd.
Walk away from the busy road. You will find a quiet spot soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake a cake for my friend.
That sounds sweet. Do you have the eggs yet?
Yes, I have them. What do I do first?
Mix the dry stuff first. Are you ready to read the recipe?
Yes, I am. How do I put it in the oven?
Put it on the middle shelf. Is your oven hot?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I stop my chair from wiggling?
First, tighten the screws on the legs. Is your chair made of wood?
Yes, it is wood. The screw strip is too loose.
You can add a little wood glue to the hole. Do you have glue at home?
I do not have any glue, just a wedge.
A wooden wedge works very well. Just tap it in tight with a hammer.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what shoes to buy.
What color do you like best? Do you want them for school or play?
I like blue. I want them for running.
Blue running shoes are a great pick. Do you have a favorite brand?
I do not care about brands.
That is a smart way to save money. Do they need to be light?
Yes, they must be light.
Look for white foam soles for speed. Let us check the fitting area.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my grandma left for a long trip.
I am sorry you feel sad. Do you miss her face?
Yes, I miss her face and her warm hugs.
That is a hard feeling. Have you drawn a picture for her?
I tried, but I could not make her look right.
It is okay if the picture is not perfect. Does she love you?
She told me she loves me a lot.
That is a true and good thing. Can you think of a sweet memory with her?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My party today was not good.
I am sorry to hear that. What went wrong?
My best friend did not come.
That must feel very lonely. Did you have any cake?
Yes, but it tasted like nothing.
That is a strange thing to say. I do not know why it felt that way. Did you play games?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my cat purr so loud?
It often means they feel happy and safe. How is the cat acting right now?
It is sleeping in the sun.
That is a very good sign. Do you like sunny spots too?
I do, but why does it lick its legs?
Cats groom themselves to stay clean. I do not know the exact reason for that specific leg.
That is okay. What else do they like?
Most cats like warm laps. Does your cat like to sit on you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do robots have feelings?
No, they do not have feelings. Do you think they should?
I guess not, but what do they do?
They help with work. That is all.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel very sad, but I must run to catch my bus right now.
That sounds hard. Do you want to talk about it later?
No time, I am running late, I must go now.
Okay, take care. Is it okay if I say hello again later?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My computer is making a funny noise.
That sounds like the fan is working hard. Is the box getting warm?
It feels hot and the screen went black.
That is not good. Please turn it off for now.
I did, but I want to play again.
Let us wait ten minutes first. Do you know how to unplug it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My birthday party was so quiet. I feel sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you have any cake?
I ate the cake, but no one sang to me.
That sounds very lonely. Do you want to plan a new party?
I do not know if my friends can come back.
You could ask them again. Who is your best friend?
I miss having a big, loud celebration.
I understand that wish. Would you like to talk about it more?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My grandpa taught me how to fish this morning. It was so much fun!
That is wonderful news! Did you catch any fish?
Yes, I got one big bass. He smiled so happy when I showed him.
He must be very proud of you. How does it feel to hold it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see a big bird. Is it a hawk?
I am not sure. Is it brown?
It is. I have to go. Bye.
Bye. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I warm up the milk for my new baby?
Put the bottle in a pot of warm water, then shake it gently. Do you have a thermometer to check the heat?
I do not have one. What else can I do?
You can put a few drops on your wrist to feel if it is warm but not hot.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The dog made a big mess in the kitchen this morning.
Oh no. What did the dog eat?
It found a banana and threw it on the floor.
That is a sticky problem. Did you wipe it up?
Yes, but now I must clean the whole floor.
You did a good job fixing the banana. Is the floor clean now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a robot walk?
You can use small motors to move its legs. Do you have a battery yet?
No, I need one first. Where should I buy it?
A local store might have what you need. Is your robot already built?
Yes, it is ready to go.
That is great. Have fun making it move.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know if I should build a robot.
That is a big choice. What do you want it to do?
I am not sure.
Thinking is good. Can you tell me what you like to play?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today and looked up. The sky was so bright blue. Why is it blue?
The sun makes all colors of light. Most of the blue light bounces off the air so we see it. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I love the sun. But I saw a big red cloud later in the day.
That happens when the sun is low. The blue light travels a longer path and the red light shines through. Do you like big clouds?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the village so quiet?
The people are very calm. Do you like quiet places?
Yes, I like it. Why is the church bell big?
It is big so everyone can hear it. Does it ring often?
Yes, it rings every morning. Why is the river so blue?
The water is very clean. Do you swim in it?
No, I do not swim. Why is the air so fresh?
There are many trees and no cars. Do you smell the flowers?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a paper boat.
That is a fun idea. Do you have any paper?
Yes, I have a sheet of it.
Fold the paper in half lengthwise. Do you see the crease?
Yes, I can see it clearly.
Now fold the top corners down to the center line. Are you ready for the next step?
Yes, I am ready to keep going.
Fold the boat in half along the middle crease. Is the shape starting to look like a boat?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck on my story. I do not know what to do next.
That is tricky. What has your main character been doing so far?
He is walking through a dark forest.
Dark forests can be scary. Does he have a friend with him?
No, he is all by himself.
Oh no. How is he feeling right now?
He is very afraid and wants to go home.
That makes sense. Perhaps he can find a path back?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do my legs hurt when I run?
Your muscles are getting strong. Do you stretch before you start?
I usually just go right away.
Stretching helps keep you safe. How fast do you run?
I try to run very fast.
Slow is good for starting out. Do you enjoy the trip?
Yes, I like where I go.
That is a good reason to run. Take your time and have fun.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My white shirt has a red mark. How do I clean it?
I would try a stain remover first. Do you have one at home?
Yes, I do. Should I use hot water or cold water?
Use cold water for red stains so they do not set. How long will you let it sit?
I will let it sit for ten minutes. Then I will wash it in the machine.
That sounds like a good plan. Put it in a cool cycle next.
What if the mark is still there after washing?
I do not know for sure, but you may need to repeat the steps. Is the shirt made of cotton?
Yes, it is cotton. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome, happy to help. Please check it again after drying.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I like apples. How do I cut one safe?
First, wash it well. Do you have a sharp knife?
Yes, I do. What is the next step?
Hold the apple on its side. Cut down along the stem.
That sounds easy. How do I get the seeds out?
Slice the top and bottom off. Then cut into big pieces.
I am ready to try now.
Eat the skin if you like it. Is it sweet?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. How do I wash my shirt fast?
Put it in the hot water. Do you have a black shirt?
No, it is white. What do I do next?
Use plain soap. Is it dirty?
Yes, it has mud. Will it come off?
Yes, it will wash out. Go now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the internet feel so big?
It is big because it joins many machines. Do you like to read online?
How can I trust what I see?
I do not know for sure, but you should ask a grown-up. Do you have a favorite site?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is very strong outside. What should I do?
You should go inside and close the windows. Is it raining too?
Yes, it is raining hard. I am scared.
That is okay. Stay safe and warm. Do you like the sound of the rain?
A little bit. It feels like a song.
I am glad you can hear that. Listen to it from a safe place.
Okay, I will stay in my room.
Good plan. Keep your door closed.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to brush a horse.
That is a lovely goal. Do you have a soft brush?
Yes, I have a red one in my bag.
Great. Start with the head.
Should I go left to right?
Yes, always brush with the hair. Is the horse standing still?
He is eating grass right now.
Oh, wait for him to finish. Do not startle him.
He is done now.
Good. Start gently on the neck.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my cat purr when I pet it?
It means your cat is happy and feels safe. Is it sleeping right now?
Yes, but why does it also knead my leg?
That is an old habit from when it was a baby cat. Does it look relaxed?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Today I found a dog in the park.
Oh, what did the dog look like?
It was brown and small.
Did you take it home?
No, a man came to get it.
That was a nice surprise for him.
Yes, I feel good about it.
That makes you a kind friend.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel good because I did a hard thing.
That is a great feeling. Do you want to share what you did?
I am not sure what to do with this feeling.
Sit with it for a bit. Does it make you want to tell someone?
I just want the good feeling to last.
I do not know how to stop time. Do you feel happy right now?
I think I am done for now.
Okay, go enjoy your day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a little frog by the pond.
That is a happy surprise. Does it jump when you look at it?
Yes, it jumps to the other side of the stick.
Frogs like to hide in quiet places.
The sun is very warm on my face.
It feels nice to stop and sit. Do you see any birds today?
I see a red bird on the big tree.
Red birds are very pretty.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My computer is making a loud noise.
That is a bad sound. What color is the computer?
It is black and it is on the desk.
Black is a good color. Is the fan spinning fast?
Yes, it spins very fast.
That sounds like it is working hard. Do you want me to help you turn it off?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a very good day today.
That is wonderful to hear. What made it so good?
I ate a big, red apple at lunch.
Apples are sweet and crisp. Did you share any with friends?
Yes, I gave a slice to my best friend.
That was very kind of you. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I looked up at the sky and saw a big white puff. It looked like a sleeping bear.
That sounds so soft and cozy. Did it move across the blue sky?
Yes, it drifted over my house while I ate an apple. The sun peeked out from behind it.
What a lucky and bright day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. I am sorry I stepped on your foot.
That is okay. Are you going to miss the bus?
Yes, I am running out of time. Can I go now?
You can go. Do not worry about my shoe.
Thank you for being nice. I will be careful next time.
I am glad to help. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Does my dog need a walk now?
It might be hungry. Does he look sad?
He is barking at the door. Is he angry?
No, he just wants out. I am not sure why.
Is it time for his lunch? I must leave soon.
Yes, it is lunch time. Do you have the bowl?
I grabbed the bag. Tell him I love him.
I will tell him. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My head hurts so bad and I must run.
That feels rough. Is your neck stiff too?
Yes it is, but I have to leave now.
Try to take it slow. Have you eaten anything?
No I have not, sorry.
Drink some water soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The bus stopped so many times today. My feet hurt.
That sounds very tiring. Did you sit down for most of the ride?
Yes, I held on to a strap. It was fun to watch the trees go by.
I am glad you enjoyed the view. How was the air on the bus?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now, but did you hear the baby cry?
Yes, I did. Do you want me to bring him here?
Please do, I am in a rush.
I will right away. Is the milk warm?
Yes, thank you, bye.
Good luck with the feeding.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I need to find my cake.
Is it in the fridge? I do not know where you put it.
No. It is not in the fridge.
Is it on the table? I see a white box there.
Yes. That is it. Thank you.
You are welcome. Do you want a candle?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work. Do you know where the fish are biting?
I think the big ones are near the bank. Are you using a worm or a lure?
I have a worm in my pocket. Is that good enough today?
Yes, worms are always a safe choice. What is your dog doing?
My dog is barking at a leaf. Can I catch a big fish in five minutes?
I do not know if you will get a big one so soon. Are you sure you have time?
I must leave now. Thank you for the help.
Good luck with your job. Do you want my number if you catch one?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I caught no fish today.
That feels very bad. Did you try your new rod?
Yes, I tried it. But it broke right away.
Oh no, that is a real shame. Was it the line or the hook?
The line snapped. I do not know why.
I do not know for sure. Do you still have the box?
No, I threw it away in anger.
I am sorry you threw it away. Is your heart still hurt?
Yes, my heart is still hurt.
Take a deep breath. Do you want to try again tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so blue today.
I am sorry you feel that way.
Why is it always so hard?
Things can be tough. What is on your mind?
I just want to feel better.
Taking a deep breath helps. Do you want to try it?
That sounds good.
Great. Let us take a break.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my little duck is not in the yard today.
That is a scary feeling. Did you look in the barn?
I looked, but he is not there. I am worried he is hurt.
Let us check the pond together. Is the water calm?
Yes, the water is quiet. He is still not there.
We should ask a helper to look for him. Do you know where the gate is?
I do not know. I just want him to be safe.
We will find him soon. Let us take a deep breath first.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a cloud in my house.
That is a sweet idea. Do you like looking up at the sky?
Yes, I love seeing them drift by. How do I make one?
You cannot make a real cloud, but you can make fog with a jar. Do you have a jar?
I have a big glass jar. What else do I need?
You need a balloon and warm water. Do you have those things?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Can you help me count to ten?
Yes, I can help you start. Do you know your numbers?
I know one, two, and three. What comes next?
Four is next, then five. Can you say four?
Yes, I can say four. How many are four and one?
That makes five. Do you like adding numbers?
Yes, I do like adding. Can we go back to counting?
Sure, we can continue. Do you want to count again?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I keep my fish happy in the tank?
Clean the water and feed them small pieces. Do you know what kind of fish you have?
Yes, I have goldfish. How often should I clean it?
Change about ten percent of the water once a week. That keeps it fresh for them.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to climb a big mountain. Can you show me how?
That is a big job. Do you have strong legs?
Yes, I run a lot. What do I need?
You need good boots and warm clothes. Do you have them?
I have boots, but my coat is thin. Is that okay?
No, thin coats are cold. Keep learning.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found out why boats float today!
That is a great thing to learn. What made you think of that?
The water pushes up on the boat bottom.
Yes, that push is called buoyancy. Does the boat weigh more than the water it moves?
No, it pushes water aside equal to its weight.
Exactly right. It feels light because the water helps hold it up.
I feel so happy sharing this fact.
I am glad you are happy. Do you want to know how to make a paper boat?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do horses have long tails?
They use them to swat away flies. Do you like horses?
Why are their hooves so hard?
The hard parts protect their feet on the ground. I do not know if they hurt.
Why do they sound like this?
They make sounds to talk to each other. I do not know what they are saying.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky red and bright?
A big fire is burning nearby. Are you safe?
Yes, I am here. Why did it start?
I do not know for sure. It might be dry grass.
That looks scary. Is it close?
It is close, so stay inside. Do you see smoke?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I found the park!
That is great news! Where did you start your walk?
I turned left at the big red tower.
That sounds like a good spot. Do you see the blue fountain?
No, but I see a cute dog running by.
How lovely! Is it wearing a red collar?
Yes, it is. I think I am still a bit lost.
Do not worry. Can you tell me what is to your right?
There is a tall tree with a swing set.
Great! Go straight to the tree and you will find me.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel so lonely. Why is that?
We often feel alone when we do not share our feelings with others. Do you talk to anyone often?
I do, but it feels empty. Why does sharing help?
Sharing makes a bridge between two hearts so they do not feel far apart. I do not know if it will fix it, but it helps me. Do you want to try sharing one small thing?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made two dollars by selling old toys!
That is great! Did you put them in a jar?
Yes, my piggy bank is full now.
Wise choice. What will you buy first?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sea looks so big and scary to me.
It can feel that way. Do you like to swim?
Yes, but only when the water is calm.
That is smart. I am not sure why waves form.
I wonder if the fish are lonely down there.
I do not know if they feel lonely. Do you ask them?
I talk to them sometimes.
That is nice. Let us watch the sun set.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do clouds float up there?
They are made of tiny water drops that are very light. Do you like to see them?
Yes, I do. Are they wet?
Yes, they are full of water, but the drops are too small to fall yet. What shape do you like best?
I like the ones that look like ships. Can they make rain?
Yes, when the drops get too heavy, they fall as rain. Do you like the sound of rain?
Sometimes, but I get wet. How do they go away?
The sun warms them up so the water turns into gas. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I do. Can we make them?
I do not know how to make real clouds, but I can blow a ball of soap. Do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make toast?
Put bread in the machine. Do you like it crisp?
What if I want eggs too?
Crack them into a hot pan. Do you like them runny?
Yes, please. Thank you.
You are welcome. Eat well.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix this wobbly chair right now. Can you help me fast?
Yes, I can help. Is the top leg the one that moves?
No, the back leg is loose and the screw is gone. I am late for work.
That is a problem. I do not know if we can fix it without the right tool. Do you have a screwdriver nearby?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I rode my bike to the park today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you see any dogs?
Yes, a big brown one chased me.
Did you ride fast to get away?
I pedaled really hard and jumped a hill.
Wow, you are so brave. How did you feel after?
I felt tired but very happy.
That is a great feeling.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big boat on the water today and I am so happy!
That is a wonderful thing to see. Do you know why it does not sink?
I think the water pushes it up because it is heavy.
You are on the right track, but think of it like a boat making a big space for water.
Oh, so the ship pushes the water down and the water pushes back?
Yes, the water pushes up just enough to hold the ship up. Have you ever jumped into a pool?
Yes, and the water rose a little bit when I jumped in.
Exactly, that is the same idea, just much bigger. Did you feel light when you jumped?
I felt like I could float for a second before going under!
That feeling is the water helping you stay up. You have a great way of seeing things.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I was sad because I could not find my old friend.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you remember where you last saw him?
He is not at his house. I checked the yard and the door.
That is a good place to start looking. Maybe he is at the park?
The park is quiet. I did not see him there either.
It can be hard when things are not where we expect. Did you try calling him?
I tried, but his phone was off. Now I am worried.
Phones can run out of power. It is often not a bad sign.
I just want to talk to him. It feels lonely without him.
That is a very normal feeling. You care about him a lot.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My tent is wet and the food is ruined. I am very sad.
That is a bad luck. Did you check the weather map?
I forgot to bring extra clothes. Now I am cold and dirty.
That is not good. Do you have a dry pack?
No, I lost it. I want to go home right now.
I am sorry about that. Let us stay dry first.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What comes after May?
June comes next. Do you like the sun?
How many months are there?
There are twelve months in a year.
Why does December feel so long?
Time moves slow when you wait for a treat. Do you have a favorite month?
I like June because of cake.
That sounds very sweet to me.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I promise to share my toys tomorrow.
That is a good promise. Will you share them all?
I think so, but I do not know if I will forget.
That is okay. What is the first toy you will share?
The blue truck. It is my favorite but I will share it.
That is very brave. I trust you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The fence is broken and I do not know what to do.
That can be hard to fix. Do you have any tools?
I have a hammer, but the wood looks old.
Old wood is tricky to work with. Would you like help?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Can you see why my fish looks sad?
Is its tail bright or dull? I am not sure yet.
I am late, it is dull.
Dull often means sickness. Is the water warm or cold?
It is warm, hurry.
Warm can stress them. Please check the heater soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so mad when I wait. Can you help me be patient?
Waiting can feel hard, but it gets easier with time. Do you have a game to play while you wait?
Sometimes I play with blocks, but my brain is too busy to think of them.
That is a good start. Have you tried taking three slow breaths when the anger comes?
Three breaths? I think I can try that.
That is a simple and true trick. Do you know why the breath helps?
I do not know. Please tell me.
Slow breaths calm your body so your mind can rest. Do you want to try one now?
Okay, I am breathing slow. It feels less hot inside.
That is a great sign. Do you feel ready to wait a bit longer?
Yes, I think I can do it.
You are doing well. Do you like how calm you feel now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got pizza for lunch and it smells so good.
That sounds fun. Did you get your favorite topping?
Yes, it has extra cheese and I want to share it with you.
I would love some. Is it hot yet?
It is a little warm, but you can eat it now.
Thank you. It tastes great.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make paper boats. Do you know how?
That sounds like fun. Do you have a flat sheet of paper?
Yes, I have white paper. What do I do first?
Fold the paper in half down the middle. Do you like the smell of new paper?
It smells nice. Now what?
Fold the top corners down to meet at the top edge. Do you think your boat will float?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not like broccoli because it tastes bitter.
That is okay to feel that way. Do you like sweet carrots?
Yes, I love carrots with a little dip.
That is a great swap to keep you healthy.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my toy car by accident. What do I do now?
You can try to glue it back together. Did you see where it broke?
It broke in the middle, but I do not have glue.
That is tricky. You can ask a parent for help. Do you have a parent nearby?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The lights are off and I am scared.
Do not be afraid. Is it dark outside too?
Yes, it is very dark outside.
That sounds like a big storm. Do you have a flashlight?
I have a candle but it feels cold.
Candles are good for light. Are you by a window?
No, I am in my room.
Good, that is safe. Do you have warm clothes?
Yes, I have my big coat on.
I am glad you are warm. I do not know when the power will come back.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late and I failed again. I want to stop.
It is okay to feel sad. Do you want to try one more small step?
Just one step? I can do that. I am rushing.
Yes, just a tiny one. What is your first goal?
I will just fix this part. Thanks.
That is brave and true. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am mad. My letter has a big spot on it.
Oh no, that is sad. Did you use the good pen?
I do not know. I want to start all over again.
That is okay. Sometimes we just start new.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I finished my big math test.
That sounds really good. Did you get it right?
I made one small mistake but I tried hard.
Trying hard is a big win.
I feel warm and happy inside.
That is a nice feeling. Do you like it?
Yes, I want to hold it close.
Good for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my old friend Tom today. He looked happy.
That is good news. Did you talk to him?
Yes, we talked for a long time. He is back in town.
Welcome back to him. How is he doing?
He has a new job. It looks hard but fun.
Hard work is never fun. I am happy for him.
I think I will visit him soon. It has been years.
That sounds like a great plan. What will you do together?
We will just sit and drink coffee. No big plans.
Simple times are often the best. I hope you enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I like my coffee with sugar. Why do people do that?
Sugar makes the bitter taste go away. Do you take milk in it too?
Sometimes. But why is tea green?
I do not know for sure, but it is from fresh leaves. What kind of tea do you drink?
Green tea is my favorite. Why is it good for you?
It has things in it that help your body stay well.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love working from my desk.
That sounds nice to you. Do you like your chair?
Yes, it is very comfy.
Good. How many hours do you sit?
I sit for about six hours.
That is a long time. Do you walk outside?
Yes, I take a short walk at noon.
That is a smart habit.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My dog eats dirt. Is this okay?
That can mean he is bored or lacks vitamins. Is he sick or just acting weird?
He runs a lot and seems happy.
Then it is likely a habit. Try giving him a chew toy instead.
What if he still eats dirt?
Talk to a vet to check his health. Do you have a vet nearby?
Yes, we can go soon.
Good idea. You are doing a great job caring for him.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel all by myself. Why?
It happens when we feel far from others. Do you want to talk?
I do not know. Why does it hurt?
It is a real feeling, not your fault. Do you like quiet?
Yes, I do. What do I do now?
Try one small kind thing. Are you ready?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people like this new town?
It has big parks and quiet streets. Do you like to walk in the grass?
Why are there so many trees?
The town wanted fresh air and shade. Do you like sitting under trees?
Why is the bakery so busy?
I do not know why it is so busy. Do you smell the bread?
Why is the river blue?
The water is very clean and deep.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is very hot today. I feel so thirsty.
You should drink a big glass of water. Do you have a fan to cool you down?
Yes, I have a fan. But I still feel warm.
Try eating some cold fruit. It helps a lot.
I will try that. Thank you for the ideas.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a small coin in the park today.
That is a fun find! Do you know what year it is from?
No, but I think it is very old.
Old coins are like little time machines. Did you keep it for your pocket?
Yes, I am keeping it to show my dad.
He will be happy to help you look. Does it have any writing on the back?
It has a picture of a king on the front.
That is a cool detail! Do you know who the king was?
I do not know, but I will look it up later.
That is a great plan. Enjoy your treasure!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red truck today. It had fresh apples in the back.
That sounds like a yummy surprise. Did you smell the sweet apples?
Yes, the air smelled so sweet. I walked by the bakery too.
Breads and apples go well together. Were the people inside kind?
They were very nice. I bought a warm roll for lunch.
A warm roll is a great choice. Did you enjoy it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I am going to get married soon.
That is very nice. Are you picking a dress now?
Yes, I found a white one I love. The flowers are red and soft.
That sounds lovely. Do you have a big plan for food?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I finished my picture of a big blue bird. It has red wings.
That sounds like a very bright bird. Did you use crayons for the red wings?
Yes, I used many colors. I am very proud of it.
I am glad you like your work. Where do you plan to hang it?
I will put it on my wall. I want to see it every day.
That is a nice place for it. Do you draw other animals too?
Sometimes I draw cats. They are easy to draw.
Cats are a favorite for many people. Do you like drawing them with stripes?
Yes, I like stripes. Thank you for listening to me.
It was my pleasure to hear about your art.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is this town safe at night?
Yes, the streets are quiet and clean. Do you like quiet places?
I usually like noise, but I am tired.
That is good to hear. Rest well in your bed.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late! What month is it?
It is June. Do you like summer?
No time! How many months are there?
There are twelve. Do you count them?
Just tell me when they end!
They end in December. Do you wait for winter?
Thank you, I must go.
Good luck. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the fridge stick to my magnet?
The fridge has metal in it that pulls the magnet close. Do you like eating cold food?
Yes, I do. But why does it not pull my wooden table?
Wood does not have the right metal parts for magnets. Did you try it on your bike?
My bike has some metal, but the magnet did not stick.
Some metals, like aluminum, do not pull magnets. Do you know how to fix a bike?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to take a picture of my screen. How do I do that?
You can press the print screen key. Do you know where that key is?
I see it, but the screen goes black. What should I type next?
Try pasting it in a paint app. Is it open on your screen?
Yes, it is open. How do I save the picture?
Click file and then save. What name will you give it?
I am done. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Did the picture look good to you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do fish swim in big groups?
They swim together to stay safe from big animals. Do you like watching them?
I do! Why do they need a rod to catch them?
We use a rod to pull the fish out of the water. How deep is your water?
It is quite deep. Why do they bite the hook?
I do not know exactly why they bite. What kind of food do you use?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My tomato plant has small white spots on the leaves. What is wrong?
That is likely a fungus. Do you water the leaves?
I water the top of the plant every day.
Water the soil instead to keep leaves dry. Do you give it sun?
Yes, it sits in the sun for six hours.
That is good. It should get better soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a circle and a square, but I do not know what to make.
Do you want to make a house? You can use the square for the walls.
That sounds fun, but I have a triangle too.
A triangle is great for a roof. Do you like red or blue?
I like blue. Is that okay?
Yes, blue is a very nice color.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to wear uniforms?
It makes everyone feel like a team. Do you like your uniform?
I do, but it is hot. Why can we not wear shorts?
The rules say no shorts to look neat. Do you have a favorite outfit?
Yes, my jeans. Why do we study math?
It helps you buy things and save money. Do you like adding numbers?
Not very. Why do we read books?
Books take you to places you have not seen. Do you like stories about space?
I love space. Why is school so much fun?
It is fun when we learn new things together. What is your favorite part of the day?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because the market was full of bright colors.
That sounds like a fun place to be.
Yes, I bought a big red apple and a sweet yellow banana.
Do you like eating fruit with the peel on?
I am glad I got to see so many nice things there.
It is nice when you can share your good feelings.
I hope you can go to the market soon too.
I do not know if I can, but thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work. Please give me my toast.
Here is your toast. What time does your bus leave?
I need coffee too. I have no time to talk.
I am making it right now. Do you want sugar in it?
No, just black coffee. I must go.
Here is your cup. Drive safe on the road.
Thank you. I am running out of time.
No problem at all. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Can you tell me what a cow says? I am late!
A cow says moo. Are you going to the farm?
Yes, I must go now. What does a sheep do?
Sheep make a baah sound. Is it a warm day?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The new fence is not straight. I do not like it.
I am sorry you feel sad. Is the wood crooked?
Yes, the top is all bent. It looks bad.
That is not good. Who built it for you?
The man from the store did it. He left fast.
That is tricky. Did he use nails?
He used nails, but they are loose. I am angry.
I do not know how to fix nails. Do you have a hammer?
I have a big, red hammer. I feel calm now.
That is great. Good luck with the work.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The rain hit my window while I read.
That sounds like a cozy start. Did you finish the book?
Yes, but my coffee got cold.
Oh no, cold coffee is not good. Was it bitter?
It was, so I drank it fast.
Brave of you. Do you want a new cup?
I am too full, but I feel happy.
That is great to hear. What made you happy?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is learning to drive so hard?
It takes time to make your hands and eyes work together. Do you feel a bit scared?
I do not understand the mirrors. Why do we need them?
They help you see what is behind you. Do you look at them often?
The car feels too big for me. Why is it so large?
It is built to hold people safely. How do you feel about the size?
I think I am ready to try again. Is that okay?
Yes, you are getting better. Are you excited?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My nose is very runny and my head hurts.
I am sorry you feel bad. Do you have a fever?
I do not know how to check.
You can use a little tool for your forehead. Have you tried drinking warm tea?
No, I have not.
That is a good idea. Do you like honey in it?
Yes, I like honey.
Sweet tea helps your throat feel better.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a big white tower by the sea.
That is a lighthouse. It helps boats at night. Do you like boats?
Yes, I do. What does the light do?
It spins around to show ships where to go. Is it sunny or cloudy there?
It is cloudy. How do they turn the light?
Often, it just turns by itself. Do you know why it is white?
I am not sure. Why is it white?
White shows up best in the dark. Is it tall?
Yes, it is very tall. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I am glad to help.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a secret code.
That is a fun idea. Do you use letters?
Yes, I write them on paper.
You can swap letters for other letters. Do you have a pencil?
I have a red pen.
A pen works well. I do not know a specific way to hide the key.
What should I do then?
You can keep the key in a safe spot. Is your desk locked?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my computer beep?
It makes that sound to tell you it is working. Do you like the sound?
I do not like it. Why is it so loud?
The sound is loud so you can hear it from far away. Do you want to make it quiet?
Yes, please. How do I turn it off?
You can click the small speaker icon on the screen to stop the noise.
Thank you. Why does it do that?
I am not sure why it picked that specific sound, but it helps you know if the computer is ready.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have many flowers but I do not know what to do with them.
You can put them in a vase. Do you have a clear glass one?
Yes, I do have a glass vase, but the stems look too long.
You should cut the stems shorter. Are you holding sharp scissors?
I have scissors, but I am scared of cutting them wrong.
Just cut them straight. It is easy and safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are there twelve months in a year?
The moon changes shape four times while the sun goes around us. Do you like watching the moon?
I do. Why is January the first month?
It comes after the big holidays when it is very cold. Do you like snow?
Yes, I do. Why are some months longer than others?
It helps if we count days in groups of three or four. Is your birthday in a long month?
It is. Why do we need a special name for every month?
Names make it easier to plan and remember dates. Do you use a calendar?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must run. Can you point to the bright star?
That is Venus. It is not a star but a planet. Do you like space?
Too late. Is the moon full tonight?
Yes, the moon is full. It looks like a white ball. Do you see the dark spots?
I see them. What are those dark spots?
Those are craters. We do not know everything about them. Do you study the sky?
No, I am busy. Is it safe to walk home now?
Yes, the streets are clear. The stars are always there. Good night.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go on a trip, but I do not know where to go.
That sounds fun. Do you like warm weather?
Yes, I love the sun. But I have little money.
Many beach towns are cheap in winter. Do you like to swim?
Not really, I prefer walking. What should I do?
Try a small town with good paths. Do you like food?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I toss and turn and cannot fall asleep. What should I do?
Have you tried drinking warm milk? Do you like sweet things?
No, I do not like it. I just stare at the wall.
Try counting slow breaths instead. Do you know how to count to ten?
Yes, I can count, but my brain will not stop.
Listen to quiet sounds like rain. Do you have a fan?
I have a fan, but it makes a noise. How do I make it quiet?
Put it far away from your bed. Does that help you feel cool?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today.
That is great news. What made you smile?
I saw a big oak tree with green leaves.
That sounds lovely to see.
The wind made the leaves dance.
Nature is a beautiful sight. Do you like trees?
Yes, they make me feel calm.
Calm feelings are good.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to take a good picture.
Start by standing still and holding the camera steady. What do you want to take a picture of?
I want to take a picture of the big red tree.
Good choice. Stand back a little to show the whole tree. Is the sun shining on it?
Yes, the sun is bright on the leaves.
Then point the camera at the bright leaves to see them well.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many toes do I have on my feet?
You have ten toes. Do you know how to count them?
I know how to count to five.
That is a great start. Do you want to try counting to ten?
Yes, please.
Great job. Do you like counting?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a cake for the party, but I do not know how to start.
First, you mix the flour and sugar. Do you have the recipe written down?
Yes, I have it here, but I am afraid I will break the eggs.
Just tap the egg on the table and open it. You are doing a great job.
That sounds easy. What comes next?
Then you bake it in the oven. Thank you for telling me you are ready.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride my bike today.
That is a great idea. Do you have your helmet on?
Yes, it fits tight and safe.
Good. I do not know your exact size, but small wheels help.
This bike has small wheels.
Perfect. Hold the brakes gently. Are your feet finding the pedals?
Yes, I found them.
Nice work. Kick off the ground and keep looking forward.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost here. Which way should I go?
Go where your eyes like best. Do you see a tree with a bird?
I do not know where to sit. It is too big.
Find a bench in the sun. Do you have a snack to eat?
I am tired now. Should I stop?
Yes, rest is good. Is the air fresh to you?
I feel better. Thank you for helping.
I am happy to help. Do you want to walk more?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at my new drawing! It makes me so happy.
That is a very bright color. What did you use to make it?
I used red and yellow crayons. They mix so well together.
That sounds like a fun trick. Do you like mixing colors?
Yes, I love making new colors. It feels like a magic game.
I do not know if that is magic, but it is very creative.
I drew a big sun for the sky. I wanted to share my joy.
A big sun sounds warm. Did you draw anything else?
Yes, I drew a smiling face on it. Now the sun is my friend.
That is a sweet idea. I am glad you are having fun.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, it is raining! I am so happy.
That is nice. Do you like the sound of the rain?
Yes, it sounds like a drum. It makes me feel good.
That is a fun way to hear it. Does it smell nice outside?
Yes, the air smells clean and fresh.
I can imagine that. Do you plan to go outside and play?
Maybe later, but I just want to watch it now.
Watching is a great way to enjoy the rain.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the moon look so big when it is close to the ground?
That is just a trick our eyes play. Do you like looking up at night?
Yes, I do. It makes me feel small.
That is a good feeling. Sometimes being small helps us see the whole big sky.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like to swim?
Yes, I love to swim. Do you like to swim?
I like to float in the pool.
That feels nice. Do you wear a floatie?
I wear a cap and goggles.
Good for your eyes. Do you know how to kick?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I heard a new song today while I walked home.
That sounds nice. What kind of music was it?
It was slow and sad, like rain falling on a roof.
I am sorry about the sad feeling. Did it stay with you?
It did, but then I saw a bright red bird.
A red bird is very special. Did it sing too?
No, but it looked happy, so I felt better.
Nature is a good helper for feelings. I do not know the song, but your story is sweet.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw bees today. They were so busy.
That is a nice sight. Do you know what they eat?
I think they eat flowers. They made sweet honey.
Yes, they turn flower juice into honey. It is very sweet.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky so dark?
The clouds are very thick and heavy. Are you feeling scared?
I like the sound of the rain.
It sounds like water falling on leaves. Do you enjoy thunder too?
The wind is blowing my hair.
The wind is a strong force. Is your house safe?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a gift for my friend right now.
That is a nice thought. Do you know what color they like?
I have no idea, but I am very late.
Let us pick a simple blue box. Are they happy to see you?
Yes, they will be glad. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I hope they love the surprise.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the rain stopped our picnic.
That is very upsetting. Do you want to go inside?
Yes, but now my sandwich is wet.
Oh, that is not good. Is the bread too soggy?
Yes, it is mush and I hate mush.
We can throw it away and fix it. Would you like a cracker?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to grow carrots. Where do I start?
Pick a spot with lots of sun. Is your yard sunny?
Yes, it gets sun all day. What do I do with the soil?
Mix in some compost to feed the roots.
Okay. Do I put the seeds close together?
No, give them space to grow big. How deep will you dig the hole?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. I am going to my first job.
That is exciting! Do you have your coat?
I do not know. I am running out the door.
Run fast and be safe!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My hen is not laying eggs. What should I do?
Give her a big, clean box with soft straw. Do you think she feels safe there?
I want to keep a goat on my farm. Is it hard work?
Yes, they eat a lot and jump on things. Do you have a strong fence to stop them?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am very sleepy on this long plane. How can I rest better?
You can use the neck pillow and close your eyes. Do you have a blanket?
Yes, I do. How do I turn off the little light on my seat?
Look for the small button near your armrest.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am confused by the clock. The hands move too fast.
It is just practice. Do you know which hand is short?
The short one points to ten. The long one points to twelve.
That means it is ten past ten. Do you like looking at clocks?
I think so, but I am not sure.
You can start with big times. Does your home have a clock?
Yes, on the wall. But it makes noise.
Tick tock helps you listen. Do you hear it now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a snowball that does not melt.
That is a hard task. Do you like cold weather? You can try packing it very tight.
How do I pack it tight?
Use a metal pan to shape it. Do you have one at home? Keep it in the shade.
What if I do not have a pan?
You can use a bucket. I do not know if that will work. Is your bucket round?
Yes, it is round.
Then put it in the freezer. It should last longer there.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we take a test?
It helps us see what we know well. Do you like learning new words?
I think so. Why is that good?
It makes our minds strong and happy.
What if I get a low score?
You can just try again. Are you feeling nervous?
A little. How do I stop?
Take slow breaths and stay calm.
Okay. Do I need to study?
Yes, a little practice helps a lot.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know about the sea. Hurry, please.
The sea is big and salty. Do you like salt?
It is huge. I am late.
It has waves and fish. Do you like fish?
I need facts. Stop asking.
Yes, it covers much of the earth.
Good. I am going now.
Safe travels. Do you live near water?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How does my clock tell the time?
It moves hands to point at numbers. Do you have a digital or an analog one?
It has moving hands, not numbers that light up.
A motor pushes the hands in a circle. Each tick moves a tiny bit.
But why do the hands not go the wrong way?
The gears are built to only turn forward. Is the battery still fresh?
Yes, it clicks every second, but it feels slow.
It is correct, but time feels different to us. Would you like to wind it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to feed the ducks.
Do they like corn or peas? I know they love green leaves.
I have bread, but I am not sure if that is good.
Bread is not the best food for them. Do you have any mixed seeds?
I do not have seeds, just old lunch scraps.
Please do not give them lunch scraps. They may get sick from it.
So what should I do right now?
Go to the store for proper food. Can you go today?
I will go now, thank you.
That is a good plan. Stay safe on your trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a cold but I feel super cool about it.
That is nice of you to say. Do you have a good blanket to rest in?
Yes, my big red one is very warm and soft.
That sounds very cozy. Are you drinking hot tea to help?
I am drinking cocoa because it tastes like a hug.
That sounds lovely and sweet.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did my old friend stop writing to me?
I do not know the exact reason. Do you think he moved to a new city?
He might have. Was he still happy with his life?
I am not sure about his feelings. Did you ever hear that he found a new hobby?

talk.situation: the person has a question
