exchanges: The lights are out. Why is it dark?
The power is off for a short time. Do you have a flashlight?
I am scared of the dark. Will it come back?
It will likely return soon. Do you like to read in the dark?
I am bored now. What can I do?
You can play a quiet game with a friend. Is that fun for you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to bring to my grandpa’s house.
That sounds nice. What does he like to eat?
He loves soft cookies and sweet tea.
Those are great picks. Do you want to bake them together?
I have no idea how to start baking.
I can share a simple recipe. Would you like that?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How does the clock make the hands move?
A battery or spring pushes the gears. Do you have a battery in yours?
I think so, but how do the gears keep the time straight?
They click forward one by one.
That sounds tricky to get right.
It takes steady parts to work well.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How does this clock tick?
It uses a spring to move the hands. Do you have a battery or a key?
It has a key. I just want the time fast.
Wind it tight to keep it running. Are you running to a bus?
Yes. I need to know why it moves.
A tiny hammer hits a metal piece each second. Is your heartbeat racing too?
Yes. Thanks. I must go now.
Go safely. Will you call me if it stops?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad and worried about my test.
That sounds hard to feel. Do you know what you are afraid of?
I am afraid of getting a bad mark.
It is okay to feel that way. Would you like to practice some words?
I do not know if I can do it right.
We can try together, step by step. What is the first thing on the test?
It is math problems, and I hate them.
Math can be tough. Do you like drawing pictures to help?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I feel my heart beat fast in my chest.
That is very normal for a new driver. Do you have your teacher with you?
Yes, she is very calm and helps me breathe.
That is good advice. How did the first turn go?
I almost hit a red cone on the corner.
Ouch. Did you stop the car safely?
I stopped, but my hands shake a lot.
Your hands will get strong soon. Keep going.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am angry at my brother.
Tell him you are mad, but not with mean words. Do you know how to say it kindly?
Should I hit him?
No, hands are for hugging or helping, not for hitting. Are your hands busy or free right now?
How do I share my toys?
Let him play with one toy for ten minutes. Do you like to play with cars or blocks?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My nose is runny and I feel very cold. Is this a bad sickness?
It sounds like a common cold. Do you have a fever?
I checked and my body feels hot. What should I do to feel better?
Please drink warm water and rest in bed. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took a picture of the big red apple on the tree this morning.
That sounds like a very nice thing to catch in a photo. Did you hold the camera still?
I did, and it came out clear, but then I dropped it.
Oh no, I am sorry to hear that. Was the camera broken?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I promised to play with you. But I want to go to the park.
That is a tough spot. Do you like the park more than playing with me?
Yes, the park is very fun. What should I do?
You must keep your word first. Do you think they are still there?
I do not know if they are free. Should I ask?
Yes, ask them. If they are free, you go. If not, you play with me.
Okay. What if they are busy?
Then you are free to choose. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My head hurts a lot today.
I am sorry to hear that. Are you drinking water?
Yes, I had a glass of milk.
That is good for you. Do you need to rest?
I feel better after lying down.
Rest is very helpful. Is it still hurting?
It feels much less sore now.
I am glad you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the wind blow?
It blows because warm air rises and cool air moves in to take its place. Do you feel it on your face?
It feels cold when I blow on it.
Your breath warms the cold air, so it feels like a warm hug. Is your wind warm or cold today?
Sometimes it makes my tree sway.
Yes, it pushes on the branches to make them dance. Do you like watching the leaves move?
It is very loud at night.
It can be loud when it goes through gaps or cracks. Do you like the sound of it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great goal. Do you have a pair ready?
Yes, I am holding them right now.
First, make a big loop. Can you do that?
I made the loop, but it fell apart.
Hold it tight with your other hand. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we kick the ball into the net?
We do that to score points and win the game. Do you like playing soccer?
Why is the field so green?
The grass helps players run well and look clear. Is your team’s jersey green too?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my birthday party.
Oh no, that is bad. What is your favorite part of the day?
I really want cake and to play.
That sounds like fun. Do you have your presents with you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a big rock near the tent today.
That sounds fun. Did you sit on it?
No, it was too warm from the sun.
I do not know what it felt like. Was it hot?
Yes, but I found a cold spot.
Nice trick. How did you find it?
I just looked around the other side.
Good thinking.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am at the beach but I do not know what to do.
That is a nice place. Do you like to swim?
No, the water is too cold for me.
You can walk on the sand. Do you want to build something?
I do not have a bucket or a shovel.
You can use your hands. Do you like making things?
I guess I can make a small pile of sand.
That is a good start. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I fixed the clock but it is not ticking. Why?
It might need new batteries. Do you see any wires inside?
I checked the wires and they look fine. I am so mad!
Maybe the spring is stuck. Can you shake it gently?
No, I do not think I should shake it hard. It is precious.
You are right to be careful. Let us take it to a shop.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished writing my letter. I am very happy about it.
That sounds wonderful. What did you write about?
I told my friend about the big red ball I found. It is a very special ball.
A red ball is fun. Did you seal the envelope?
Yes, I put a sticker on the top. I want to send it now.
Good job doing your work. Where will you drop it off?
I will walk to the mailbox on our street. I feel good about this.
You did a nice job.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to float on the river. Can you show me how?
First, you need a life jacket. Have you ever tried this before?
No, I have not. What do I do next?
Sit in the boat and keep your feet flat.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My hands are cold and I have only two good cards. What should I do?
That feels scary. Do you want to keep them?
I feel like I should let them go, but I am not sure.
Trust your gut. Do you play for fun?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I keep a wild rabbit safe?
You do not keep wild rabbits. They need the woods. Do you see a specific animal you like?
How do I help a duck that got hurt?
Put a box with air holes under it and stay quiet. Tell an adult to call for help. Do you have a phone nearby?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My phone is dead and I need to call my mom right now.
Put it on the charger quickly. Do you have your cable with you?
Yes, I just forgot to plug it in.
That is a common mistake. The phone will work again in a few minutes.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found this map in my attic. What is this wavy blue line?
That looks like a river. Do you see a town near it?
Yes, there is a small dot right on the bank. Is that a safe place to live?
Usually, yes. But I do not know for sure about floods. Do you live near water too?
No, I live by a dry hill. Can you tell if the green part is a forest?
It is likely a forest. Do you like trees?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to plant some seeds today. Where should I start?
Look for a sunny spot. Do you have pots?
Yes, I have two small clay pots. How deep do I put the seeds?
Just one inch deep. Is your soil ready?
The soil looks dry. Should I water it first?
Yes, soak it before planting.
I will do that now. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for swim. What do I bring?
Bring your swimsuit and towel. Do you like deep water?
I have them. Is the pool open now?
I do not know for sure. Is it warm outside?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so angry. My tent got wet and everything is damp.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a dry place to sit?
No, the ground is wet too. I just want to go home.
That sounds very cold. Is your food still safe?
Yes, the food is fine, but my clothes are ruined.
Let us light a small fire to help. Do you have any dry wood?
I think I have a little bit. It does not help how I feel.
It is okay to be sad. Can we work together to fix this?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do you know if that lake is deep? I am late.
I do not know the exact depth. Are you swimming there?
No, I just want to see the water.
That is a nice view. Do you have time to stop?
I have ten minutes, so I must run.
You will be safe. Enjoy the cool air.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the snow on the ground white?
The ice crystals in the snow reflect all the light. Do you like building snowmen?
I do. Why does the smoke go up from the chimney?
Hot air rises, so the smoke floats into the sky. Do you have a favorite holiday meal?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My neighbor built a tall wall. I feel sad and do not know what to do.
That sounds tricky. Do you know why he built it?
I think it blocks my light. Should I yell at him?
No, yelling may make it worse. Try a kind chat first.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to be nice, but I forget how to say please.
Saying please shows you care about others. Do you usually remember to say it at home?
I forget when I am in a big hurry.
Try to slow down just a little bit first.
What if I do not know the right word for a thing?
You can always ask a grown-up for help. Do you like to look up new words?
I do, but it takes a long time.
It is good that you are patient with learning.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the boats are not coming home.
That feels bad. Is the water too rough?
The waves are big and scary.
You are brave to be out here. Do you see the lighthouse?
Yes, it is glowing red.
That is a good sign. It means safety is near.
I wish they would just come back.
Give it a little time. Do you want to wait with me?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to find the park on this map.
Look for the green shape that looks like a tree. Do you see any green spots?
Yes, I see a big green spot.
That is likely the park. Is there a red line next to it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the fish?
It is that way. Do you like salmon?
No. I need chicken.
It is near the bread. Do you eat meat?
Yes. I am so rushed.
Take a breath. Do you have your bag?
I forgot it at home.
Go back. Can you run?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My tomatoes have yellow leaves and I feel very bad about them.
That is a tough thing to see. Do they get enough sun?
Yes, they sit in the bright sun all day long.
Okay, that is good. Have you checked the soil for dry spots?
The dirt feels dry at the top but wet underneath.
I do not know for sure why they look sick. Did you add too much food to the plants?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my phone louder?
Tap the plus sign on the right side of the screen. Do you hear the sound change?
Yes, that worked. How do I take a picture now?
Turn the screen around to see the back. Press the round button at the bottom. Is the camera open?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this walk. It is very long and I am tired.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to stop and rest?
I just want to go home. My feet hurt so much.
That sounds painful. Are you wearing your good shoes?
Yes, but the path is hard. I almost fell down.
I believe you are safe now. What color is the bench ahead?
It is green. But I still feel sad inside.
Sad feelings are okay. Do you want to sit down?
I will sit for a bit. Thank you for helping me.
I am glad to help. Take your time to rest.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The river is big and cold. I do not know if I should walk across it.
That sounds scary. Do you have a sturdy boat nearby?
No, I do not. I just want to get to the other side to see the flowers.
Please do not walk into the water. I do not know if it is safe, so stay on the bank.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to paint a red apple.
That sounds fun. Do you have red paint?
Yes, I have a lot of red.
Mix it with a little black to make it darker. What color is your paper?
It is white.
Draw a circle first. Is it a big apple?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Can you tell me what is inside the box?
I do not know what is inside. Are you scared of what it might be?
No, I am just very curious.
That is a good feeling. Do you think it is a toy?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a secret and I want to tell you.
That sounds exciting. What is the secret?
I found a blue stone in the garden.
A blue stone? Do you keep it safe?
Yes, it is in my pocket right now.
How nice you share with me.
Can you keep it to yourself?
I promise to keep it safe.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do cows have big udders?
Cows have big udders to make milk for their babies. Do you like drinking milk?
I like my cow mooing at me.
Cows love to moo to talk to their friends. What color is your favorite farm animal?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to draw pictures of my dog.
That sounds fun. What is his name?
His name is Spot. He is very fast.
Cool. Do you draw him running or sleeping?
I draw him running in the grass.
Nice. Do you use crayons or markers?
I use markers because they are bright.
Oh, good choice. Do you have a favorite color?
I like blue best. It is my favorite.
Blue is a calm color. Do you draw the sky too?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do next.
It is okay to feel stuck. Have you tried a small step?
I am not sure that will work.
Small steps often help. What is one thing you want to fix?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My shed roof is sagging and I am so angry.
That sounds very frustrating to fix. Do you know where the beam is?
The wood is wet and soft in the middle.
Wet wood does not hold weight well. Is it still raining outside?
Yes, but I need this done today.
I do not know your local codes, so I cannot say if it is safe. Have you called a pro?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love bananas. How do I peel them?
Just pull the skin down from the top. Do you eat yours with the skin on?
No, that would be yucky. What else can I do with them?
You can mash them into smoothies. Do you like drinking smoothies?
Yes, I do. How do I make them?
Blend the banana with some milk. Is that helpful to you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I am so glad I got my first job. Why do people work?
People work to earn money for food and a home. What will you buy first?
I want to buy a new bike. Why is money important?
Money lets us pay for things we need to live. Do you know how to ride a bike?
Yes, I can ride well. Why do we need a place to live?
A home keeps us safe from the rain and cold. I do not know why you want a bike.
I like to ride in the park. Why is it good to help others?
Helping makes people feel happy and close. How do you plan to use your bike?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a circle, but I do not know what to make next.
Do you want to make a ball or a plate?
I am not sure. What is the best shape to add?
A square feels good. Do you have one?
Yes, but I worry it will look messy.
It will look nice. Try it and see.
Okay, I will try to glue them.
That sounds fun. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to send a letter to my friend far away. How do I do that?
You can put the letter in a red box near the door. Do you have a stamp for it?
I do not have a stamp. Can I buy one here?
Yes, you can buy a stamp at the counter. Is the line long right now?
No, the line is short. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a red butterfly today. It flew right to my nose.
That is a very kind butterfly. Did it stay there for a long time?
Yes, it did. I felt warm inside when I saw it.
Warm feelings are good. What else made you smile?
My friend gave me a cookie. It was sweet.
Cookies are happy food. Do you like sweet food?
I do. I felt good all day long.
It is good to feel happy. I am glad you had a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big pot of soup for dinner.
That sounds very yummy. Do you like carrots in it?
Yes, I cut them into small pieces.
Nice work. Is it hot right now?
It is warm and smells good.
Great. Please enjoy your food.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The lights are out and I am late!
I am sorry, but I do not know why. Are you safe?
I must go now, please help.
You can use your phone for light. Is the road dark?
Yes, it is very dark outside.
That is risky. Do you have a friend nearby?
I have a friend waiting at the shop.
That is good news. Please take your time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw two red cars and three blue cars on the road today.
That is a lot of color! How many cars did you see in all?
There were five cars. I like to count them to practice.
Five is a great number. Do you like counting animals too?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in the hall. I do not know where my class is.
Let us walk to the main door together. What color is your book?
It is blue. I feel very scared.
You are safe here. Do you like to read?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That is a fun goal. Do you have a helmet?
Yes, I have a big red one.
Great. Start by sitting on the saddle with your feet on the ground.
Okay, I am sitting. What next?
Push off with one foot and look straight ahead, not down.
I slid a bit, but I did not fall!
Nice try. How did that feel?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I make a nice loaf of bread?
You need flour, water, yeast, and salt. Are you making your first loaf?
I have all the things but my bread is flat.
Your yeast may be old or the water was too hot. Do you use fresh yeast?
I use dry yeast and warm water.
Warm water helps the yeast wake up. Is the dough soft like an ear?
It feels a bit dry and hard to push.
Add a little more water to make it smooth. Let it rest for a while.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the bakery this morning.
That sounds fun. Did you smell the bread?
Yes, it smelled very sweet.
Oh? What kind of bread was it?
It was chocolate chip cookies.
Yum. Did you eat one?
Yes, I ate two of them.
I am glad you had a nice snack.
I felt happy walking home.
That is wonderful to hear.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have so many toy cars and no room for them. What should I do?
You could sort them into boxes that fit under your bed. Do you have big boxes?
Yes, I have some. How do I pick which cars to keep?
Keep the ones you love most and give the rest away. What is your favorite car?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to play football better, but I never know what to do.
That is a good goal. Do you like to kick the ball or run fast?
I like to run fast, but I trip a lot.
Practice your balance on one foot. Would you like to try that today?
I am not sure how to start. Can you tell me a simple game?
Stand in a line and pass to each other. Do you have a ball nearby?
Yes, I have a ball in my yard. What should I practice first?
Kick the ball against a wall. Do you have a smooth wall to use?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see the light, but I do not know what to do.
That is strange. Is the light moving?
Yes, it spins very fast.
The keeper may be having a hard day.
Should I go up the tower?
Only if the door is open. Is it open?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big bear in the park today.
Bears are very strong. Did it look sleepy?
No, it was eating an apple.
That is a favorite snack. Do you like eating apples too?
Yes, I love them.
That is good for your body. I do not know if that specific bear is still there.
Can bears swim?
Yes, many bears are good swimmers. Do you like swimming?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. A bug smashed into my face and it is so squishy.
That must have scared you quite a lot. Did it leave a mark on your skin?
Yes, it left a red spot. It is still there and it feels itchy.
Your body is just cleaning the area. Does the itch feel like a tickle or a burn?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the internet really?
It is a giant web of computers talking to each other. Do you like sending pictures?
Yes, I send pictures to my grandpa. How do they get there so fast?
They travel through wires and light beaming through glass.
That sounds like magic. Does it never stop?
No, it keeps moving day and night. Do you use it for games?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big basket of food for my picnic today.
That sounds like so much fun. What snacks did you pick?
I have apples, cheese, and cookies for my friends.
Those are my favorite treats too.
I am so happy to eat outside in the sun.
Sunshine always makes food taste better.
We are going to the park by the river next.
That is a beautiful spot for a rest.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My little sister is very sad today. What should I do?
I am sorry she feels that way. How did you see her being sad?
She was crying by the window. I do not know why.
Maybe she misses you. Do you think she wants a hug?
Yes, I gave her a hug, but she is still quiet.
That is kind of you. Have you tried talking to her?
I did, but she only nodded. She will not tell me more.
Sometimes people need time to feel better. Can you sit with her and wait?
I will sit with her. Thank you for your help.
You are a good big brother. You will be fine.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Can you win fast?
Yes. Move the King to meet the Queen. Do you have the Queen?
I forgot. What do I do?
You can not win now. Please wait.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to cross this street right now.
It is very quiet here. Is your home close?
Yes, but I do not know the way.
I do not know either. Do you see a big house?
I see a house, but I am late.
Go there. It is the right way.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My head hurts. Why does that happen?
It is often from a virus. Do you feel hot?
No, I feel cold. Why do I shiver?
Your body warms you up. Do you want to rest?
Yes, I am tired. Why do I need sleep?
Sleep helps you heal fast.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I forgot my lunch box this morning.
That is not good. Do you have cash?
Yes, I have some coins.
You can buy a sandwich. Is it okay?
I do not like cold sandwiches.
Try a warm soup. Do you like soup?
Yes, hot soup sounds good.
Great choice. Go buy some.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love reading in bed at night.
That sounds very cozy. Do you like stories or facts?
I like fantasy books the most.
Magic is a fun thing to think about. Do you read with a light?
Yes, a soft lamp makes it nice.
That is a good way to rest your eyes.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need new shoes but I am lost.
Let us help you pick. What do you want to use them for?
I just need shoes for walking.
Comfort is key for walking. Do you like wide or narrow shapes?
My toes feel tight in most stores.
Wide shoes will fix that. Do you want laces or slides?
Laces keep them on tight.
Laces work well for support. What is your budget?
I do not have much money.
Store brands are true and cheap. You will be happy with them.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is a circle round?
It has no corners, so it rolls well. Do you like to roll balls?
Yes, but why do squares have four corners?
Four lines meet to make a square. Do you have a square toy?
I have a box. Why is it a box?
It holds things inside. What is in your box?
My toys. Why do triangles have three sides?
Three lines close up to make it. Do you like pointy things?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a box with no lid on the floor. Where is the lid?
Have you looked inside the walls? It might be hidden there.
I checked the walls, but it is not there. What do I do?
I do not know where it is.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see a small bird. Do you know what it is?
I think it is a wren. Is it singing?
It is very loud. I must go now.
Wrens can be loud. Did you see its color?
It has brown spots. Goodbye.
Brown spots fit a wren. Say bye to your bird.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I stop my bike safely?
Squeeze the brake levers with your fingers. Do you check your brakes before every ride?
I usually just push the pedals harder. Is that wrong?
No, but brakes are much safer. Do you wear a helmet when you ride?
Yes, I always wear one. What should I do with my hands?
Keep them on the handlebars, not your knees. Do you like riding on flat roads?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do I move the queen?
She moves any way, any number of squares. Do you have time for one game?
No time. How do I win fast?
You cannot win fast without thinking. Is your board set up?
Yes, but I am running.
Good luck. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I messed up the picture and I do not want to draw anymore.
That feels bad. What was hard about it?
The colors got mixed up and now it looks all muddy.
Muddy colors can be tricky to fix.
I just wanted to draw a nice red apple.
I think we can add more red to fix it. Do you have extra paint?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad today. What should I do?
That is a heavy feeling to carry. Do you have a friend nearby?
My friend is busy. I am alone.
I understand that feels lonely. Would you like to talk about it?
Yes, I think I want to talk.
I am here to listen. What is on your mind?
I failed my test. I am not smart.
One test does not show your whole worth. You are worth more than a grade.
I am not sure I believe you.
I do not know everything, but I see your effort. Do you want to try again tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just built a new fence for my garden. I am so happy to show you.
That is a great idea. What color is it?
It is painted a nice red. Do you like red fences?
Red is a warm color. Is it made of wood?
Yes, it is strong wood. Thanks for asking.
You did a good job. I am glad to hear it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to wait so long?
The bus is not here yet. Is it hot out there?
Is the bus broken?
I do not know if it is broken. Do you like to read?
I just want to go home.
We will go soon. Did you eat a snack?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a song that makes me feel very warm inside.
That sounds lovely. What makes it feel so nice?
The drums go thump, thump, thump like my heart is happy.
I do not know the song, but that rhythm sounds fun. Do you sing along?
Yes, I hum to the whole thing while I walk my dog.
Sharing joy is a great thing. Do you have a favorite part?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am making soup. I saw a bird today. It was blue.
A blue bird is nice. What is in your soup?
Carrots and peas. I felt happy looking at it.
That sounds yummy. Happy is a good feeling.
I want to share some with you. The bird left quickly.
Thank you, that is kind. I do not have a mouth to eat, but I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start singing.
Do you like to hum? Just open your mouth and make a sound.
That feels strange, but I will try.
Good. Is the sound loud or soft?
It is very soft right now.
Start small. Do you want to try a low sound next?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to watch a movie but I do not know which one to pick.
Do you like happy stories or scary ones?
I like happy ones that make me feel good inside.
You should try a funny story about a dog. Do you like animals?
Yes, I love dogs.
That is a great choice for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so hungry. I walked a long way today.
That sounds tiring. Do you want soup?
Yes, please. It was hot and I got tired.
Soup is good for you.
My friend gave me water on the way.
That was kind of your friend. Do you have any friends?
Yes, a few. What should I eat?
You should eat the hot soup.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know what day is next.
Today is Monday, so tomorrow is Tuesday. Do you like Tuesdays?
I am late. Tell me the day after that.
The day after Tuesday is Wednesday. Is your school open?
Just tell me all the days quickly.
Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. Are you going to play?
I have to go now.
I hope you make it on time. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to climb a big mountain, but I feel scared.
Do not worry, small steps help. Do you have warm boots?
Yes, I have warm boots, but my legs feel weak.
Eat a big apple before you start. Are you happy to try?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the internet so fast?
It moves signals very quickly. Do you like playing games online?
But why does it ever get slow?
Too many people are using it at once. This is a hard one, but I am not sure why the cables are not bigger.
Why can I see pictures from far away?
They send the picture in tiny pieces over the air. Is it cool to watch videos?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I keep the water clean?
You should change some of the water every week. Do you have a small bucket ready?
Yes, I do.
Great. Also, do not feed too many fish at once. Do they eat all the food in one minute?
Not always.
If food is left, it makes the water bad. Try giving less next time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does my big boat stay on top of the water?
Water pushes up against the boat. Do you have a boat?
Yes, I do. It is very heavy. How does it not sink?
The shape makes space for the water to push up. Is it a wooden boat?
It is wood. I am scared it will sink.
It will float if it has room to push the water down.
That makes sense. How can I check if it is safe?
You can put a little weight in first to test it.
Okay, I will try that.
Good luck with your boat.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake bread.
That is a sweet idea. Do you have an oven at home?
Yes, I do. What do I need first?
You need flour, water, and yeast. Have you baked anything before?
No, this is my first try. How do I start?
Mix the wet things with the dry ones.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so angry I cannot sleep.
That feels bad. Do you want to talk about it?
I tried to count sheep but my brain will not stop.
Maybe try slow breathing. What helps you feel calm?
The room is too hot and my body hurts.
Open a window to cool down. Is there anything else bothering you?
I just want this night to end fast.
I am sorry you feel this way. Let us rest now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired from the loud traffic.
That sounds very tiring. What do you like to do to rest?
I just want to sit in a quiet park.
A park is a great idea for calm. Do you know a nearby spot?
Yes, but it is full of people today.
Crowds can feel too big. Are you hungry?
My feet hurt from walking all day.
That hurts to walk for long. Should we find a bench?
Yes, please, my legs are sore.
We will sit here for a bit. Is the air nice?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do trees grow so tall?
They grow up to reach the sun. Do you like looking up at them?
Yes, I love them. Do they drink water?
Yes, their roots pull water from the dirt. I do not know why they need so much.
That is cool. Do leaves turn colors in winter?
Many leaves change color before they fall. I am curious, what color do you see?
Mostly brown and orange. Do trees sleep at night?
They do not sleep, but they rest in the dark. Do you see them move at night?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start the boat engine?
You just turn the key and press the button. Is your battery charged?
I think so, but I am not sure.
Look at the light. If it glows, you are good.
The light is on, so I will try.
That is a great plan. Take your time.
It is moving! Thank you so much.
You did it all alone. Do you know how to stop it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: This plane is so loud and my ears hurt.
I am sorry you are in pain. Would you like to try chewing on a piece of candy?
I am too tired to care about candy right now.
That makes sense. You look very sleepy. Do you want to rest your eyes?
Yes, I just want this trip to be over.
I hope it ends soon for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The bus was very full today.
That sounds like a squeeze. Did you find a seat?
No, I stood by the door.
Standing is tiring. Did the city smell like rain?
Yes, it did.
Rain makes the air feel clean.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we pitch the tent on flat ground?
Flat ground keeps you from rolling over in the dark. Do you like sleeping on a slope?
No, I like being safe. Why is the campfire so important?
It gives us warm light and helps us feel safe from animals. Do you know how to start a fire?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my chair wobbly?
The legs are loose. Is the wood cracked?
No, it just feels loose. How do I fix it?
Tighten the screws. Do you have a tool?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to bring to the party.
That is a hard choice. Do you like to cook?
I am not good at cooking.
Bring fruit then. It is sweet and easy. Is that okay for you?
Yes, fruit sounds good.
Great. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so good today because I ate a big bowl of fruit.
That sounds like a great start to your day. Did you eat anything sweet?
Yes, I had some strawberries and a banana. They were so tasty.
Berries and bananas are very good for your body. Do you like them cold?
Yes, I love them when they are cool from the fridge. They make me smile.
It is nice that you are happy about your food. What else did you have?
I also had some crackers with cheese. It was a perfect morning.
Cheese is a good choice for energy. Thank you for sharing that with me.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am happy, but I must go now.
Happy is good. What makes you feel this way?
The sun is warm. I must run now.
Sun is nice. Have a great day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my coffee dark and my tea light?
Coffee has a lot of dark stuff in it. Do you like it hot?
Yes, I do. Why does the steam rise up?
The heat makes the water turn into gas. Do you see the white smoke?
I do see it. Why does coffee taste bitter?
The beans have a sharp taste. Do you add sugar?
Sometimes I do. Why does tea smell so nice?
The leaves let out a sweet smell. Do you like mint?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water so blue?
The sun makes it shine like a sapphire. Do you like boats?
Why does the water move up and down?
The moon pulls it in. Is the wind loud today?
Why is the sand warm?
I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I stepped on a lady's toe in the store. I said sorry, but she just frowned and walked away.
That must feel bad. Did you try to ask if she was okay again?
I did ask, and she was very nice about it. I think saying sorry fixed the mood.
You did the right thing. Do you think people forget bad moments after a kind word?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is there a big lake in our village?
Yes, there is a small lake near the school. Do you like to swim there?
Can we bring our dogs to the park?
I am not sure about the rules. Do you have a dog?
Who lives in the red house by the river?
A nice old lady who bakes cookies. Is she your favorite person?
Does the bell ring at five o'clock?
Yes, it rings every day at five. Thank you for asking.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I got a new book for my birthday, but I do not know what to do with it.
That is a sweet gift. Do you like reading storybooks?
Yes, I love them, but I have too many already and they are all on my floor.
You can swap one old book for a new toy. Do you have a friend you could share with?
I think I will keep the book and play with my blocks instead.
That sounds like a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired but I cannot close my eyes. This feels really bad.
That is very hard. Do you think your body is too hot?
Maybe. I do not know what to do.
Try to breathe slow and deep.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do fish swim in cold water?
Cold water holds more air for them to breathe. Do you like cold water?
Why is a fishing line thin?
A thin line is harder for the fish to see.
Why do people put bait on the hook?
The bait smells like food to the fish. Do you know what fish like to eat?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the wind. It blew my hat away and made me cold.
That feels very bad. Do you have another warm hat at home?
Yes, I do, but this makes me so sad.
Warm things can help. Do you like to wear scarves?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I ran five miles today and I feel so good.
That is wonderful news for you. How did your legs feel?
They were a bit tired, but I loved the wind.
Running outside is always a treat. Did you see any birds?
Yes, I saw a red bird by the path.
I love hearing about your happy finds.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees in the cold weather?
The tree lets go of the leaves to save energy for winter. Do you like raking the piles?
I do. How can I make my own leaf craft?
Just press dry leaves into a thick book for a few days. Do you have a heavy book at home?
Yes, I have one. How long does it take to finish?
It usually takes about a week. You can start today.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I packed a ham sandwich and a bag of grapes.
That sounds tasty. Did you find a sunny spot?
Yes, we sat on the grass near the pond.
Nice. I love watching the ducks there.
A big red bird flew by and we all cheered.
Wow. Did you take any photos?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a lot of wet socks. What should I do?
Put them in the washing machine. Do you have a detergent?
I do, but I am not sure how much to use.
One cap is usually enough. Is the machine full?
It is almost full. Should I add more?
No, leave space for them to move. Do you want them to smell sweet?
Yes, please. How do I do that?
Add a few drops of scented oil. Do you know how to start it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I had a scary dream last night.
I am sorry to hear that. Why does that bother you?
I want to know why I dream like that.
Sometimes our brains sort out feelings. Do you feel sad?
Maybe a little, but mostly tired.
Sleep helps us rest. Are you hungry now?
Yes, I am very hungry.
Good. Eat something nice.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My goldfish ate a crumb of bread today. I thought it was funny to watch him swim fast to get it.
That sounds like a happy little snack. Do you have other fish in the tank?
Yes, there are two small orange ones too. They always swim behind the big goldfish like tiny shadows.
Oh, how cute! Do they share the food?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Where is the next bus?
It should come soon. Are you going to work?
I can wait no longer. Is there a fast car?
I do not see one nearby. Did you leave your keys?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My boss was so nice to me today.
That sounds great. How did they help?
I do not know what I should do now.
Are you happy or just unsure?
I want to say thank you, but I feel shy.
Just tell them you are glad. Would you like to try?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the wood wet?
Rain makes it wet. Do you like dry wood?
No, I do not. Why is it bad?
Wet wood can get soft. Do you want it to be strong?
Yes, I want it strong. Why do we wait for it to dry?
Dry wood holds nails better. Does that make sense to you?
Yes, it does. Why is this the right way?
It keeps the shed safe for years. Are you ready to work now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do mountains look so tall?
They are made of rock that has moved up over a long time. Do you like to climb them?
Yes. But why are the tops cold?
High air is thin, so it cannot hold heat well. I do not know exactly how much colder it gets, though.
I see. Why do birds fly near the top?
They like the fresh air and the wide views. Do you have a favorite view?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make pasta for dinner.
That is a great idea. Do you like meat or just vegetables?
I like meat, but I am not sure how to cook it.
You can cook simple chicken or beef.
That sounds good. How long should I boil the water?
It takes about eight minutes.
Thank you for your help.
I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start learning a new language.
Start with a few easy words. Do you like singing?
I like singing, but I am afraid of making mistakes.
That is normal. Mistakes help you learn. Are you busy?
I am quite busy, so I need a quick way to study.
Try ten minutes a day. It works.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My cat drank all my juice this morning.
That is a very lucky cat. Did he spill it?
No, he drank every drop.
I do not know what he is thinking. How did you feel?
I was quite sad about it.
That sounds hard. Is he sorry now?
Yes, he is sleeping on my lap.
He feels guilty. Does he look cute?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the first rule of being polite?
Always say please and thank you. Do you know how to do that?
Yes, but I forget sometimes. Is that bad?
No, it is not bad. Just try your best to remember.
How do I show kindness to my friends?
Listen when they talk to you. Do you listen?
I do try to listen. Is that enough?
Yes, it is a great start. Well done.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My dog is very fast and likes to run.
That sounds like so much fun. Does he like to play with a ball?
Yes, he loves to chase the ball in the park.
Chasing things is a great way for him to burn energy. What is his favorite treat?
He likes bones and yummy meat.
Good snacks keep him strong and happy. Does he get tired after playing?
Yes, he sleeps a lot after running.
Rest helps him grow big and healthy. Do you tell him goodnight?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is a circle round?
It has no corners, so it rolls. Do you like rolling balls?
Why does a square have four corners?
It has four straight sides that meet. Do you have a square toy?
Why is a triangle pointy?
It has three sharp points. What shape is your house?
I do not know the name of this shape.
That is okay, it has many sides. Can you show me another one?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My little blue bird stopped singing this morning.
That feels really bad. Did it fly away?
No, it is still in the tree. But it looks very thin and quiet.
I do not know why it is thin. Is it eating its seeds?
It looks at me, but it will not come to the feeder. I want to help it.
That is a good wish. Is the feeder still full?
Yes, it has lots of seeds. But I think it is just too sick to eat.
Let us ask a bird doctor. Do you see any other birds?
No, just the one sad bird. Please tell me how to fix this.
I do not know the fix. Try giving it warm water.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired today.
That sounds hard. Did you sleep well last night?
No, my dog barked all night.
Oh no. That must have been noisy.
Yes, I could not stop thinking.
Your brain was busy. Do you want to sit down?
I tried, but I still feel heavy.
It is normal to feel heavy after a bad night.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go camping near a lake with my dog.
That sounds like a fun trip. Do you have a warm tent?
Yes, it is big enough for us. How do I make a fire?
You can use dry sticks and paper. Do you have matches?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do some clouds look like sheep?
That is a fun picture. Do you see any big birds in the sky?
I see white puffs all over.
They are water vapor that cooled down. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I think they are pretty.
It is nice to share that feeling.
What makes them move?
The wind pushes them along. Do you feel the wind on your face?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared of driving. Can you help me?
Take a deep breath. Do you have a friend to sit in the front seat?
Yes, my best friend is coming. What should I look at first?
Look far ahead, not at the car in front of you. Is your car ready to go?
It has gas. Where do I start?
Start in a big, empty parking lot.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so tired of sitting on this train.
That is a long ride. Do you have a snack with you?
Yes, I have a big apple.
That sounds yummy. Do you share it?
No, I keep it for myself.
I understand. It is your treat.
Do we get there soon?
I do not know the exact time. But we are close.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to find a book about dogs.
I can help you with that. Do you want a funny story?
Yes, I like funny things. Where are they?
They are on the low shelf to your left.
I see a red one. Is this one about puppies?
I am not sure, but the picture looks cute.
I like puppies. Can I take it to the table?
Yes, you can sit there and read.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make a pizza tonight.
That sounds fun. Do you have the dough?
No, I have bread and cheese.
You can use bread for the base. Do you have any veggies?
I have some tomato and basil.
Great, just add some oil and herbs. Enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I made a new friend today but I do not know what to do next.
That is good news. Do you like talking with them?
I think so, but I am scared I will say the wrong thing.
Everyone makes small mistakes. Did they smile at you?
Yes, they did. But I want to be perfect for them.
You do not need to be perfect. Just be yourself.
Okay, I will try my best to be kind.
That is a wonderful plan. How is your heart feeling now?
It feels happy and light. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Go have fun with your friend.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My dog got lost while we were walking. I am so sad.
That is very scary. Do you know where you last saw him?
He ran toward the big oak tree. I am angry at myself.
Take a deep breath. Have you checked under the benches?
I did not think of that. I will go look there now.
That is a good plan. I hope you find him soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do fish go into the water?
The water gives them air to breathe. Do you like being in the pool?
Why do we use a hook?
The hook holds the worm so the fish bites it.
Why is the lake so quiet?
Fish do not talk, so it stays quiet. Do you hear any birds?
Why do people wait so long?
Fish are slow and shy, so we must be patient.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did you promise me the toy?
Because I care for you. Did you enjoy the park?
Yes, but why must I wait for it?
Patience helps us grow. Are you feeling happy?
Yes, thank you. Why do you always keep your word?
Because it is the right thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the island today.
That sounds fun. Did you see any fish?
Yes, I saw a big red one.
Wow. Was it swimming fast?
It swam away quick.
Oh no. Did you take a picture?
I did not have a camera.
What a shame. Did you eat lunch there?
Yes, I had a cold sandwich.
Yum. Was the bread soft?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I have been sitting on this plane for ten hours. My legs hurt so much.
That is a very long time to sit. Do you have any snacks with you?
No, the food tasted bad. I just drank a lot of water.
Good choice. Drinking water helps your body stay happy. Are you scared of flying?
Not scared, just tired. I cannot wait to walk on solid ground.
Walking on grass sounds wonderful. I hope your trip goes well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a puzzle box that will not open.
That sounds hard. Did you look for a clue on the bottom?
No, I only looked at the front.
Check the bottom. Does it have a number or a picture?
Yes, there is a small key hole.
You need a small key. Did you find one yet?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why does bread get so big and soft?
Tiny bugs called yeast eat sugar and let out gas. Do you like sweet bread?
Yes, I do. How do I make my own then?
You mix flour, water, and yeast, then wait for it to puff up. Do you have any flour today?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is in this box?
It is a secret gift. Who is it for?
Is it a book?
I do not know. Are you happy?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I baked a warm loaf of bread today. It smells so sweet and nice.
That sounds very tasty. What kind of bread did you make?
It is a simple wheat bread. I want to give some to my neighbors.
That is a kind thing to do. Do they like fresh bread?
Yes, they love it. Do you want a slice with me?
I would love that. Thank you for the offer.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the best spot for fish right now.
The deep water near the rocks is usually good. Do you have your bait?
Yes, I have worms. Where do I go first?
Walk down to the old pier and check the east side. Are you going with a friend?
No, I am alone and running out of time.
That sounds a bit lonely. Just wait by the dark water and watch your line.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad and I do not know what to do.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk about it?
I just want to feel better but I am stuck.
Take a slow breath and drink some water.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very cold and my nose is running. What should I do?
Drink warm water and rest in bed. Do you have a fever?
I am not sure what to eat for dinner.
Try some warm soup and plain rice. Do you feel hungry?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make my morning food taste better, but I do not know how.
Try adding a little fresh fruit to your eggs or toast. What kind of fruit do you like best?
I really like apples. How do I put them in there?
You can slice thin pieces and add them to warm porridge. Do you like sweet or sour apples?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a small boat in the yard. It looks very rusty. Can I fix it?
Yes, you can clean it up. Do you have a sponge?
I do, but the wood is soft and broken. Is that bad?
That is a big problem. The boat might sink.
I feel sad. What do I do now?
I do not know the best fix. Do you like to build things?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
The tree gets too busy making seeds and buds for spring, so it drops the leaves to save energy. Do you like picking them up?
Yes, I do! But what happens to the leaves after they land?
They break down into the dirt, which feeds the tree's roots when it wakes up in the spring. I hope you have fun playing in them!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I love apples, but I do not know how to pick good ones. What should I look for?
Check if the skin is smooth and shiny. Do you like them crisp or soft?
I like them very crisp and sweet. Can you tell me which kind is best?
Honeycrisp apples are often a good choice. Do you eat them with or without the skin?
I always eat them with the skin. Is the skin good for my health?
Yes, the skin has many vitamins and fiber. Great choice!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today and saw a big dog.
That sounds fun. Did you play with it?
No, it was too big for me, so I just watched it run.
That is smart. What did you do next?
I bought an ice cream because I was hot.
Oh, nice. What flavor did you pick?
I chose the chocolate one, and it was very sweet.
That sounds tasty. I am glad you had a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a cake for my party, but I do not know how.
That is a nice idea. Do you have a mixing bowl ready?
Yes, I have a bowl, but I am scared I will break the eggs.
You can just tap the egg on the side of the bowl and drop it in. Are you feeling better now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is your garden fence so tall?
It keeps the rabbits out. Do you have any pets?
Yes, I have a dog. Is wood good for a fence?
Wood looks nice and fits in nature. I do not know if it is best for your soil.
What about metal? Will it rust?
Some metal can rust if wet. Do you live near the sea?
No, but we get lots of rain. Which color should I pick?
Green helps it blend with the plants. I like dark gray, but it is a choice.
That sounds good. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. It is a fun job to plan.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does the sun get so hot?
It burns a lot of fuel inside. Do you like hot things?
I like the warmth. Does it always stay up?
Yes, it rises and sets every day. Is today sunny?
It looks a bit gray. How can I tell if it is behind clouds?
You can feel the heat on your skin. Do you have a sunshade?
No, I just have my hat. Is the hat enough?
A hat helps, but cream is better. Do you have some?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go on a picnic today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What food do you want to bring?
I will pack some apple slices and juice.
Those are tasty choices. Do you need help picking a spot?
I do not know where to go.
I do not know your location, so I cannot tell you. Do you like parks with grass?
Yes, I like the soft grass.
Great. Make sure you check the weather first. Have a happy time!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my favorite knife. I am so mad.
That sounds very sad. Do you remember where you put it last?
I think I left it in my bag.
That is a good place to check. You can start there.
But I am scared I broke it.
I do not know for sure. Do you want to look together?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My screen is dark and I do not know why.
Did you press the power button?
Yes, but nothing happens at all.
Try plugging it into a different wall socket.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to change gears in my car.
You push the stick up and down with your hand. Do you know where your clutch is?
Yes, it is the big pedal on the left. I will try to do it slowly.
That is a good plan to stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The stars look so far away. I feel very small and sad looking up.
I hear you feel lonely out there. Do you like the dark?
Not really. It feels too quiet and cold up here.
Quiet is just the night resting. Do you bring a coat?
Yes, but it is hard to see them all. My eyes get tired.
That is fine to take a break. What does one star look like to you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late and was very hungry.
That is tough. Did you eat something?
I grabbed a cold banana from the counter.
A banana is sweet and good for energy. Was it ripe?
Yes, it was soft and yellow.
That sounds perfect. I do not know what else you ate, but that start is good.
Then I made toast with jam for lunch.
Toast and jam is a classic choice. Do you like sweet or savory food?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to watch a movie but I do not know which one. Do you have a good pick?
I suggest a funny cartoon. Do you like laughs or tears?
I like to laugh. But I also need a story with good morals.
That sounds nice. I am not sure about your taste in morals, though.
You are right. I just want something kind and safe for everyone.
A gentle animal story fits that well. I hope you enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I knocked over my fence today.
Oh no! Were you hurt?
No, but the apples fell out.
That is a lucky drop. Do you like apples?
Yes, I ate one by the door.
How sweet. Is it still broken?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired and I am a bit sad.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you want to talk about it?
I just want my energy back.
Rest is good for your body. Have you eaten a snack?
Yes, I had an apple.
That is a good choice.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have very little money left. How can I save more?
That is a good goal. Do you track where your coins go?
I usually spend on snacks and toys.
Try eating from home instead. That saves a lot of cash.
I do not know how to make a plan.
Write down all your costs. This helps you see the truth.
I will try that. What else can I do?
Stop buying things you do not need. Do you miss your friends much?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because my cat is very cute.
That is wonderful news. Does the cat like to play?
Yes, he likes to chase a red ball all day.
That sounds like fun. How old is your cat?
He is one year old and very small.
One year is a good age for a kitten.
He is very tired now and wants a nap.
Good night, little cat. I hope you sleep well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to plan a picnic. Where should I go?
A park with grass is a good spot. Do you like trees or open space?
I like trees. What food should I bring?
Cold sandwiches and fruit are easy to pack. Do you have any fruit you enjoy?
I love apples. What else do I need?
Bring a blanket, water, and a trash bag.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the bakery this morning.
That sounds nice. Did you buy a cookie?
Yes, I bought a chocolate cookie.
What did you do with it?
I shared it with my dog at home.
He must be happy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am going up the stairs fast. There is thick smoke in the hall.
Please stay low to the floor. Is your phone in your pocket?
I will leave my books behind. I need to go now.
Your books can wait for you. Do you see the green exit sign?
I am running to the door. Thank you for helping me.
You are safe now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I think my plant is sad and dying.
Why do you say it is sad?
Its leaves are brown and dry.
Plants do not drink with mouths.
So how does it get water?
It uses tiny tubes in the stem.
That feels like a weak answer.
The roots pull water up by heat.
I still do not trust this.
Do you see the leaf edges curl?
Yes, they look dry.
Heat pulls the water up from below.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is this place open on Sundays?
Yes, it is open. Do you like to buy books here?
No, I want to buy some milk.
We have fresh milk. Is it for breakfast?
Yes, I need it for my kids.
Great. Do they like juice too?
Yes, they love apple juice.
Good choice.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late! Is that a bug?
Yes, it is a small beetle. Do you like beetles?
No, I just want to go. What does it eat?
It eats old leaves. I do not know what kind it is.
Please, I must run. Bye.
Okay, go fast. Have a good day!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw the moon tonight and it looked so big. Why does it do that?
It is not really bigger, but you are close to it. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I love the dark sky. It feels safe there.
That is a nice feeling. The stars are always there too. Do you know the names of any?
No, I never learned them. Can you tell me one?
I know the bright one is called Sirius. It is a big star, not a planet. Does that help?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need food now.
I can help. What do you like?
Just a hot dog.
A hot dog is fast. Do you want ketchup?
Yes, please.
I will get it soon. Can you wait?
Yes, but hurry.
I am on it. One moment.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I heard mountains can be very big. Is that true?
Yes, they are very tall. Do you like to climb things?
I do not like climbing, but I love to look at them.
Looking is very peaceful. What color are they?
They are brown and white from the snow.
Snow is cold up there. Do you have a warm coat?
I have a big red coat for the winter.
That sounds cozy. Do you live near a mountain?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love peaches, but I do not know how to cut them.
That is a nice fruit. Do you have a knife?
Yes, I have a small one. How do I start?
Cut around the middle first. Is the skin very thick?
It feels a bit tight. What should I do next?
Twist the two halves apart. Do you like them with pits?
I do not like the hard middle part. How do I get it out?
Twist each half and pull the pit off. Do you eat the skin?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my game today.
That sounds hard. Do you play often?
Yes, I play every week.
Nice. Who did you play against?
A boy in blue.
Oh. Did you have fun?
Not really. I felt sad.
I am sorry. Do you want to try again?
Maybe tomorrow.
Good idea.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My dog barks a lot at night. Why?
He may be bored or needs to go out. Does he play during the day?
Yes, he plays a lot.
Maybe he is just excited. Have you tried walking him right before bed?
I walk him at 8 pm, but he barks at 2 am.
That sounds like he is lonely. Does he sleep with you or in a crate?
He sleeps in a crate by my bed.
He might miss you. Try leaving the crate door open for a test.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a blue bird on my fence this morning. It had a very red beak.
That sounds like a lovely sight. Did you see any other animals there?
Yes, a small gray mouse ran by later in the day. It was hiding under the leafy bush.
The garden has so many little secrets to find. Do you think the mouse and the bird met?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the light turn on?
Magic makes it shine! Do you like bright rooms?
It is not magic, is it?
No, it is called electricity.
Where does it come from?
It comes from far away through wires. Do you like thinking about wires?
Does it make the plug hot?
No, it stays safe inside.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I failed the test. I want to try again, but I am scared.
That is okay. Fear is normal. What part of the study feels hardest?
I do not remember the words. I look at the page and my mind goes blank.
Try reading them out loud. It helps your brain. Do you have a quiet spot to sit?
Yes, my room is quiet. I just feel like a failure.
You are not a failure. You are learning. What is one small thing you can do today?
Maybe I will read just one page.
That is a great start. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
It is quiet because it is late at night. Do you see the moon?
Yes, I do. Are there cars?
No, the cars are sleeping in their garages. Are you safe?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the city so loud today?
The trucks and horns make a big noise. Do you like the sound?
Not really. It feels too big for me.
It can feel huge to a small person. Do you see the little park?
Yes, I see green trees there.
The trees help make the air clean. Is it sunny there?
Yes, the sun is warm.
A warm spot is a good place to rest.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend, but my words do not make sense.
That is okay. Start by saying happy things, and then tell him about your day. Do you have a fun story to share?
I can say I went to the park. I liked the slide.
Great. Write down that you had a good time on the slide. That will make a nice start.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I met a new friend today at the park. We played on the big red slide.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you ride the slide together?
Yes, we rode it many times and laughed a lot.
I am happy for you. How do you feel about the new friend?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the bread warm?
The oven makes it hot. Do you like hot bread?
Yes. Why is the smell so good?
Butter and sugar make it sweet. I do not know if you prefer sweet or salty.
I like sweet. Why do they use flour?
Flour is dry and becomes soft. Do you know how to bake?
No. Why does it taste like home?
It smells like love and care. I do not know your home.
That is nice. Why do you smile?
I am happy to help you. Do you want to buy some?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the street so quiet today?
I think it is a holiday. Do you see any flowers?
Yes, there are blue flowers. Are people usually busy here?
Yes, trucks often pass by. Do you like the peace?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a small bird stuck in my net. What do I do?
Do not pull it hard. Is it safe to touch?
I think yes. Should I cut the string?
Yes, cut the string now. Did you feel its heart beat?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn how to say hello in a new land.
That is a great goal. Do you like to speak or listen more?
I like to listen to the songs and stories.
Listening is a very good way to start.
Is the word for hello the same in every place?
No, it is not the same in every place. Do you want to try a word from Spain?
Yes, please teach me that word.
You can say Hola with a big smile.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I miss my old friend and want to write a letter to them, but I do not know how to start.
That is sweet of you to reach out. Do you remember a fun story you shared?
Yes, we laughed about a cat that got stuck in a tree. How do I tell that story in a letter?
Just write down what happened in your own words, and it will feel personal. Are you happy to share it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was very bright today.
That sounds lovely. Do you like the sun?
I looked up and saw the blue sky.
I do not know the exact answer, but I think it has to do with how light moves.
Why is it blue and not red?
Blue light spreads more in the air than other colors. Did you see any clouds?
No, just clear blue everywhere.
That is a happy sight.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do robots dream?
I do not know if they do. Do you have a favorite toy?
Yes, my stuffed bear. Is it like a robot?
No, it is soft and does not move on its own. Why do you like it?
It is warm and safe. Can a robot feel warm?
Robots do not have feelings like you do. Do you like when things are cool?
Yes, I like the rain. Can a robot get wet?
Yes, water can break its parts. Do you like rain or sun better?
I like the sun. Is a robot happy in the sun?
It does not feel happy or sad. Thank you for asking.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Can I send a letter to my friend today?
Yes, you can. Do you have a stamp?
I have a stamp, but I am not sure where to go.
Go to the big window. Do you have your address?
I have my paper. What do I say?
Say you want to mail it. Is the window open?
The window is open. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did you make that promise?
I want to help you. Are you feeling happy about it?
Yes, I am. Why do you keep your word?
Because it is the true thing to do. Do you trust me?
I do trust you. Why is that good?
Trust makes friends close. Is that clear to you?
It is clear. Why is it important?
It stops big hurts. Do you feel safe now?
I do feel safe. Why do we care about it?
Care makes things better. Are you ready to go?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost again. It feels so hard to win.
It is tough at first, but you are getting stronger. Do you like playing against a friend?
Yes, but I always forget my plan. My pieces just sit there.
That is a common mix-up for many players. Have you tried to check your king first?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
The tree takes the leaves in to sleep for the cold. Do you like when they crunch?
Yes! But why does it do that?
It saves energy so it can wake up strong in spring.
Will it grow more leaves?
Yes, new green ones come back in the warm sun. Do you watch them grow?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to tie my shoes, but I keep making a mess.
Have you tried using one hand to hold the loop?
No, I have not. Can you show me how?
I cannot see your hands, but try pulling the strings tight first.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the old mill before dark. Can you help me?
Yes, go straight past the big blue house. Do you know how far it is?
I am running fast. Is the path hard to walk on?
It is smooth and easy to run on. Would you like a drink first?
No time. Just tell me when to turn.
Turn left at the old oak tree. You will see it soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why are there seven days in a week?
The moon takes about seven days to change shape. Do you like the moon?
Yes, it is very pretty.
That is a sweet thought. Do you know which day comes after Sunday?
Is it Monday?
Yes, it is Monday. It is the first day of the week for many people.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a small toy that sticks to the fridge. How do I do that?
You can put a magnet on a paper clip and draw a picture on it. Do you have any scraps of paper?
Yes, I have some. Do I glue the magnet to the paper?
Yes, use strong glue to hold it tight. Is the paper thin enough?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I ran a mile today and I feel so good!
That is wonderful news! What route did you take?
It was the park path near my home.
A nice place for fresh air. Do you run there often?
Yes, I try to go twice a week.
That is a great habit. You must keep at it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look, the rain is coming down so fast.
Yes, I see it too. Is it noisy?
It sounds like a big drum.
That is a nice sound. Do you like the sound?
I like it, but I want to play.
That is good. Do you have a coat on?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sitting with my open bag. I do not know what to put in first.
Do you have a list of things to pack? Start with your clothes.
No list, just a pile. My socks are all over the floor.
That is a good place to start. Is the trip for a cold day?
Yes, it is very cold. I am scared I will miss my coat.
Take the big blue coat. Do you have your shoes ready?
The shoes are by the door. I think I am done now.
Good job. Just zip it up and go.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to learn to paint. What should I buy first?
Start with some washable paints and soft brushes. What kind of things do you like to draw?
I like drawing animals.
That is a great choice. Do you have a favorite animal?
I love big cats like lions.
Lions are very cool to paint.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I wash my shirts?
Put them in the machine with warm water. Do you have any soap?
Yes, I have soap. What size of shirt?
Small shirts need less soap. Are they bright colors?
Some are blue and red. Is that okay?
Mix dark and light clothes. Are you using hot water?
No, I use cold water. Is that good?
Cold water keeps the color.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go camping but I do not know what to bring.
You should pack a warm tent and some snacks. Do you have a sleeping bag?
Yes, I do, but I am worried about the rain.
Bring a raincoat to stay dry and happy. I do not know if it will rain, so check the sky.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a blue shape. I do not know what to call it.
Does it have four straight sides?
Yes, but they are all the same size.
That is a square. It is a very common shape.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did you promise to come?
I want to see you happy. Do you like surprises?
Yes, but why trust me with a secret?
Your eyes look kind. Do you keep secrets safe?
I do, but why tell me this now?
You looked lonely earlier. Did that feel true?
It did, and why care about my feelings?
Kindness is my job. Are you ready to talk?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do the clock hands move?
A tiny motor inside spins them around. Do you have a watch at home?
I do, but why does the little hand go so fast?
That is the second hand, and it ticks very quickly to count time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My dog is sick and will not eat his food.
I am sorry he feels bad. Is he drinking any water?
No, he just lays down and looks at me with sad eyes.
That is very sad. Let us go to the vet now, okay?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did people live in caves so long ago?
They needed shelter from the cold and rain. Did you know they also painted animals on the walls?
Why did they paint on the walls?
It is not certain, but many think it was for magic or storytelling.
Did they have schools to learn?
No, they learned by watching their elders work and hunt. Have you ever watched an adult work to learn a skill?
Why did people stop living in caves?
They invented better ways to build warm houses with wood and stone.
That sounds very comfortable.
It was a big step for them. Do you think you would like to live in a stone house?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many days are there in a week?
There are seven days in a week. Do you like one more than the others?
I like Sunday best. Which day do you like?
I like all the days, but Monday feels fresh. Do you have school on Mondays?
Yes, I do. Is the sun up on Monday mornings?
Yes, the sun comes up every morning. Do you get to see it from your window?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My little sister is crying because she lost her red ball.
That is a sad feeling. Did she look in the yard?
I checked the grass, but the ball is not there.
Let us look in the living room next. Is the door open?
Yes, the door is open. The ball is still missing.
I do not know where it is. Did she have the ball at breakfast?
No, she did not. She only played with it this morning.
We should ask her to think hard. What color is her shirt?
It is blue with yellow stars. I love that shirt.
Maybe she dropped it near her toy box. Let us look there.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked home in the rain and saw a big rainbow.
That is a lovely sight. Did the sun come out right after?
Yes, the sun broke through the clouds and lit up the colors.
How bright and happy it must have looked. Do you like the color red the most?
I love all the colors, but red is my favorite.
It is a strong and warm color.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My friend fell down and is sad.
Ouch. That must hurt. Are you holding their hand?
Yes, I am trying to help them stand up.
That is very kind. Does your friend need a bandage?
No, just a wipe of the tears.
Good. A wipe helps a lot. Are you staying by their side?
Yes, until they are happy again.
You are a good friend. I am glad you are there.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad and alone today.
That sounds hard. Do you have a friend you can talk to?
I tried to call, but no one picked up.
That must feel cold. Do you like playing with toys?
Yes, but I am tired of playing by myself.
I hear you. Would you like to just sit and breathe with me?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very sick and my nose runs.
I am sorry you do not feel well. Do you have a fever?
