I want to learn how to make soup.
That is a good plan. Do you have any chicken or vegetables?
I have carrots and some bread.
Cut the carrots small. Break the bread into tiny bits.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I was so mad at the market today. The line was too long.
I am sorry to hear that. Were you in a hurry?
Yes, but then the sign said we were sold out.
That is very unfair. What did you want to buy?
Just some apples. It made my whole day bad.
I am sure it did. Do you like red ones?
Not really. I prefer the green kind.
Then we can find the green ones next time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My little sister broke my toy.
That feels bad. Did you talk to her?
No, I was too angry to speak.
Take a deep breath. What did you do next?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Today I saw a big red dog in the park.
That sounds fun. Did you pet the dog?
Yes, he was very soft and smelled like grass.
I am glad you had a nice time. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I learn to swim?
Start by floating on your back. Do you have a pool at home?
Yes, I do. What should I do next?
Try kicking your legs like a frog. Do you wear goggles?
I do not have any. Is that okay?
It is fine to start without them. Are your eyes open?
No, they are closed. Why is that?
It keeps the water out of them. How deep is your pool?
It is not very deep. Can I jump in?
Only if you can stand up easily. Do you feel safe?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes. Can you show me?
Yes, I can help. First, do you know how to make a loop?
Yes, I can make a loop with my left hand. What is the next step?
Put your other loop through the first one, then pull tight.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel so very tired today.
That is a heavy feeling to carry. Do you get enough sleep at night?
I usually sleep fine, but my mind will not stop.
A busy mind can make the body feel empty. Have you tried going for a short walk?
No, I am too heavy to move right now.
It is okay to rest when you need it. I do not know a magic fix, but rest helps.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like that big horse over there.
It looks very strong and calm. Do you like its color?
Yes, I do. Does it eat grass?
Yes, horses eat a lot of grass. Do you have any food for it?
No, I do not. Can it bite me?
It might if you scare it. Be very gentle and slow.
Okay, I will be quiet. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a safe time with the horse.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am so tired. How do I make tea?
You just put a bag in hot water. Do you like it sweet?
Yes, I do. And I forgot how to tie my shoes.
Make a loop and cross the strings. Did you eat dinner?
I did not. Can you tell me how to boil an egg?
I am not sure on the exact time. Do you have a watch?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My little boat is leaking.
Is the hole near the bottom?
Yes, it is right by the floor.
I do not know your boat, but glue may work. Do you have strong tape?
I have tape and some old glue.
Try the glue first, then add tape. Is the water still cold?
The water is warm and wet.
Warm water can make wood swell. Let it dry for a day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late for school.
Your sister is not there. Did you check her room?
I looked, but she is gone.
That is strange. Do you hear any noise?
I hear a car outside.
She might be leaving with you. Is the door open?
Yes, the door is open.
I do not know where she went. Go now.
I must go, but I worry.
She is likely safe. Tell her I said hi.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. How do I make the picture clear?
Hold the phone with two hands. Do you like bright lights?
I do not have time to think. Just tell me.
Tap the screen to focus on the face. Is it dark in there?
I need to send this right now.
Press the white circle to take the shot. Do you like the photo?
It looks good. I am going now.
Good luck with your work. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I jump over a small puddle?
You run and push your foot up. Do you like running?
Yes, I do. How do I jump higher?
You bend your knees and swing your arms. Try it now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I ate a big bowl of soup today and I feel so warm.
That sounds tasty. Did you add any carrots to it?
Yes, and I felt very strong after lunch.
I am glad you are feeling good.
I want to share this good feeling with you.
I am happy to share in your joy. What will you do next?
I will give some soup to my neighbor.
That is a very kind idea.
I feel full of light inside now.
That is a beautiful thing to feel.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do ants lift things that are heavy?
They are very strong for their size. Do you like to see them work?
Yes, I do. How can I keep them out of my home?
Clean up food crumbs quickly. This stops them from coming.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is that little bird shaking its wings?
It is cleaning itself. Do you see the red one nearby?
Why are the big birds sitting so still?
I do not know for sure. Are they sleeping or just resting?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I sit here on the step, but I do not know where to go.
The air feels calm and still here. Do you feel safe?
It is very quiet, but I am a bit lost.
Walking slowly is a good start. Do you like the color of the wall?
It is blue, and it makes me feel calm.
That is a good sign for your heart. Do you see the path ahead?
Yes, there is a path, but I feel slow.
Slow is fine for a quiet place. Do you feel ready to take one step?
I think I will try to walk a little way.
That is a brave and kind choice. I hope the path feels good.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which train to take.
That is okay. Where are you going?
I think it is to the north.
Many trains go north. Do you have a ticket?
Yes, but I am scared I am late.
Do not worry. Your train is on time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went for a bike ride today. The sun was warm and the air felt good.
That sounds like a happy time. Did you ride to a special place?
I stopped at the park to see the ducks. They were swimming in the big pond.
Ducks are fun to watch. Did you have any snacks with you?
I ate an apple on the bench. It was sweet and crisp.
A nice way to rest. I hope you feel happy now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a red bike! It is the best gift ever.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you have a helmet to wear?
Yes, I do. I want to ride it with my friends today.
That is a great plan. Have a safe and happy ride.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because the sky is so bright and blue. Do you know why it looks that way?
Yes, the sun shines in all colors, but blue bounces around the most. Do you like the color blue?
I do love it, it makes me feel calm. Thank you for telling me about the light.
You are welcome, I am glad it helped you. Do you look up often?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today.
That is great to hear. What made you smile?
I finished counting my apples.
How many apples did you count?
I counted ten red ones.
Ten is a good number. Do you want to count more?
Yes, I do.
Then you can keep counting.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a book that makes me feel very happy.
That is wonderful news. What is the story about?
It is about a small dog who finds a big family.
A dog with a family sounds cozy. Does the dog have a name?
Yes, his name is Biscuit and he is very funny.
I like the sound of that.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke my friend's cup. I feel bad.
That is a kind thing to feel. Do you know how to fix it?
I don't know what to do next.
You can say sorry to them. Did you break it on purpose?
No, I tripped over my feet.
Accidents happen often. Are you ready to speak up?
I think I am ready.
That is good. Go tell the truth now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The food in the break room was cold today.
That is not good. Did you eat something else?
I went to the shop next door.
That sounds like a good idea. Do you like the food there?
Yes, it is hot and fresh.
Nice. I hope you have a good rest.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost again. My friend beat me so fast. I do not want to play anymore.
Losing hurts, but learning is fun. Do you like trying new moves?
I tried. I just forgot what to do with my knight. It feels so hard.
That is okay. Knights move in a special shape. Did you lose a queen by accident?
Yes, I left my queen in the open. It was a big mistake. I feel silly.
Mistakes help you grow. Would you like to practice just with knights?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have three red apples and two green apples.
That is five apples in total. Do you like red or green apples better?
I like red ones.
Red apples are sweet and nice.
Can you help me count to ten?
I can try, but I do not know how to count all the way to ten. Would you like to start at one?
One, two, three.
You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see white stuff falling from the sky.
That is snow, my friend. Do you like the cold?
It feels cold on my nose.
Yes, snow is very cold to the touch. Is it falling fast today?
It is falling very fast.
That is called a blizzard. Are you wearing a warm coat?
Yes, I have my big red coat.
Good, that will keep you cozy. Do you want to make a snowman?
I want to put it on my head.
That will melt quickly on your head.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I forgot my lunch box.
Oh no, that is a silly mistake. Are you very hungry now?
Yes, I just want to eat some bread. Do you have any?
I have one apple left for you. I do not know if you like apples.
I love apples, thank you. This makes me feel much better.
I am glad it helped. Have a good rest of your day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my grandma have so many wrinkles?
She has lived a long time, and her face shows it. Does she tell you stories about her past?
I like her stories. But why does she move so slowly?
Her body needs more time to get around now. Is she happy sitting by the window?
She looks sad sometimes. Why does she look so sad?
I do not know what makes her sad. Do you ask her how she feels?
I want to make her happy. How can I help her feel better?
Just sitting with her is very kind. Can you hold her hand?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad about this song.
I am sorry you feel that way. What part makes you sad?
The words hurt my heart.
Some songs are very deep. Did you like it before?
No, I hate the loud noise.
Loud music can feel like a shout. Do you want to try a softer song?
Yes, please, something quiet.
I can find a gentle tune for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Where is the big river?
It is just past the old trees. Are you going to cross it?
No, I just need to see it. Is the water deep?
It is very deep today. Do you have a boat with you?
No, I am only looking. Is the bridge open?
Yes, the bridge is open and safe. You can walk right over it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to buy fruit at the market. How do I pick a good apple?
Look for red apples that feel heavy. Do you like sweet or sour ones?
I like sweet ones. Is that all I need to know?
Yes, sniff the stem end too. Do you know where the fruit stalls are?
I see some people over there. Should I go to them?
Yes, go to the stall with bright red apples. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to take better pictures of my dog.
That is a fun idea. What kind of camera are you using?
It is just my phone.
Phones take great photos. Try to get low so you are at eye level with your dog.
Should I use flash?
It is better to use natural light. Do you have a bright window nearby?
Yes, I do.
Great. Put your dog near the window and click the picture.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see many small birds in my garden today. What do you think they are?
They are likely sparrows or finches. Do you see what they are eating?
They look like they are pecking at seeds. Is that good for them?
Yes, seeds are a healthy food for them. It is nice to help them.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do people live on that small rock?
Yes, a few families live there. Do you like the sea?
I do! Can you swim there?
It is safe in the summer. Do you have a hat?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
That is a great question. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do.
Sunlight has many colors. Your eyes see most of the blue.
Where does the blue go?
It mixes in the air. Do you see clouds?
Yes, they are white.
Clouds block the light. I do not know all the secrets.
That is okay.
I am happy to help. Thanks for asking.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix this boat right now.
What part is broken?
The rope snapped! I am very late.
Do you have a backup?
Yes, here. Thank you.
Can I help you tie it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does the big ship float?
Water pushes up on the ship. Do you see how big the bottom is?
I think water pulls it down.
No, the water pushes up to help. Does that feel like a lift?
But the ship is heavy.
It is heavy, but it pushes a lot of water away. Have you tried pushing a swim ring?
I do not get it.
The air inside makes it light for the size. Do you want to try a toy boat?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the red tomatoes taste so good?
They are ripe and sweet. Did you see the green ones?
Why are the green ones on the top shelf?
They are not ready to eat yet. Do you like sweet food?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I cannot find my red shoes.
They might be by the door. Did you put them there?
No, I think I kicked them under the bed.
That is a good guess. Let us look together.
I see one, but the other is gone.
We must search more. Do you want to check the closet?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my chair wobbly?
A leg is loose. Is it hard to push?
It feels easy to shake. Why is that bad?
Loose joints break. Did you try turning the bolt?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Can you tell me how to plant a seed?
Yes, dig a small hole. Do you have a shovel?
I have a spoon, is that okay?
A spoon works fine. Put the seed in the hole.
What do I do next?
Cover it with dirt. Why do you want to grow it?
I want to see it grow. Is that enough?
Yes, just add some water. Is the dirt dry?
The dirt is dry. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun walking.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need to book a doctor visit for my sore throat. How do I do that?
You can call the clinic or use their app. Do you know your policy number?
I do not know my number. What should I do first?
Look at your insurance card or email. It is usually written there. Do you have your card with you?
Yes, I found it. Should I mention the pain level?
Yes, tell them how bad it hurts on a scale of one to ten. That helps them help you. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a shop with red doors and warm light. I am so happy to be here.
That sounds like a lovely place. Do you like the smell of coffee there?
Yes, the coffee smells great. I want to tell everyone about this joy.
I am glad you found a happy spot. What will you buy first?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The city is so loud and fast. I do not know where to go.
It can feel like a lot. Do you like quiet places or big crowds?
I like quiet spots, but everything here is busy.
The small park on the hill is very calm. Would you like to walk over there?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have five apples, but I am not sure how to share them.
That is a nice thing to do. Do you want to give them to friends?
I think so, but what if I want to keep one for myself?
You can keep one and give the rest away. Is that fair to everyone?
I guess it is. I will take one and give the others to my sister.
That sounds like a good choice. Are you happy with that plan?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is this blue dot on my map?
That is your home. Do you like living there?
Yes, I do. Why is the path red here?
Red means you are there now. Is the path busy?
No, it is quiet. Can I walk to the park?
Yes, just follow the green line. Have a good walk.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse in the park today.
That sounds like fun! Did you ride it?
No, I just watched it eat grass.
I like horses too. What did the ground look like?
It was green and soft.
Nice! Is the horse your friend?
I think he likes me.
Oh, how sweet. Did he say hello?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a big mess and no time.
Start with the trash first. What is the mess?
Spills and toys all over the floor.
Pick up the toys into one pile. Do you have a mop?
Yes, I have a mop.
Wet the mop and wipe the spills.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I need new shoes because my old ones are too small.
That is nice. What color do you like?
I like blue and red.
Blue is a great pick. Do you run fast?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I had a scary dream. I ran late for work.
That sounds tough. Did you wake up feeling calm?
No. I am still scared.
Take a slow breath. Do you want to sit for a minute?
No time. I must go now.
Okay. Be safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing a high note.
That is a fun goal. Do you have a favorite song?
I just want to hit the top of the scale.
Start with a low hum and slowly slide up.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the library today and saw a huge cat on the desk.
A cat in the library? Did it look happy?
Yes, it was sleeping on a stack of blue books.
That sounds like a sweet afternoon.
I wanted to pet it, but the librarian said no.
Rules can be hard sometimes. Did you get a book instead?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start my letter.
That is okay. Do you know what you want to say?
I want to tell my friend I am happy here.
Good. Start with "Dear Friend" then say that.
I feel brave now, but what comes next?
Just write what is in your heart. Can you try the first line?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My blue shirt is ruined.
That feels bad. Did you mix it with red socks?
No, I put it in by itself. It still looks dirty.
I am sorry. Did you use warm water?
Yes, and it got worse. I do not know what to do.
I do not know your exact mix. But cold water helps stains. Try that?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a lovely day. My banana was sweet and soft.
That sounds very nice. Did you share it with anyone?
I cut it in half. I gave one piece to my dog.
Your dog must be very happy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My head hurts a lot.
I am sorry you feel bad. Do you have a glass of water nearby?
Yes, I do. I want to learn how to stretch my neck.
Sit tall and slowly tilt your head to one side. Hold it for ten seconds.
That feels better. Can I do it on the other side too?
Yes, you can. Is the pain getting smaller now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I found a new friend today. I must go now.
That is great news. Is he your classmate?
Yes, he likes blue. I am late for school.
Blue is a nice color. Do you like blue too?
Not really. I have to run.
I hope you have fun. Be safe on the bus.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got off the bus. It was so much fun.
That sounds nice. Did you sit by the window?
Yes, I saw lots of green trees.
Trees are lovely. Did you feel happy?
Very happy, even when it rained a bit.
Rain can be cozy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to jump in the pool now. Is the water warm enough for a quick swim?
Yes, it feels very warm today. Do you like cold water?
No, I hate cold water. I am running late for work.
Then you should hurry. Are you swimming for fun or exercise?
Just a quick lap to cool down. Can I wear my blue cap?
Yes, that is a good idea. Do you have a towel with you?
Yes, I have my towel. Thank you, I must go now.
Have a safe swim. See you later.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I dropped my favorite banana and it is all squashed. I am so sad.
That is a real shame. Do you have another one?
No, that was the last one I bought.
I am sorry to hear that. Would you like me to bring you an apple?
Yes, please. An apple is my second favorite.
Great, I will get one for you. Do you like red apples or green ones?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad. The new town looks cold and empty.
That feels bad. Do you see any bright lights?
No, just dark windows. It feels lonely here.
It might feel better soon. Do you want to try a warm drink?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today! I want to share my tea with you.
That is very kind of you. Do you like sweet tea?
Yes, I like it with sugar. How about you, do you take sugar in your coffee?
I do not drink coffee, so I do not know if I like it.
Oh, that is okay! I will just drink my tea here. Do you want to sit next to me?
Yes, I would like that. I like to watch the steam go up.
Look how warm the cup is. It makes my hands feel good. Do you have a warm drink?
I have some water, but it is cold. Thank you for the warm feeling.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is it rude to talk with my mouth full?
Yes, it is best to finish your food first. Do you like your soup?
I like it, but I want to tell my story now.
Please wait until you are done eating. Thanks for listening!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What is quick to make?
Toast with eggs is fast. Do you have any eggs left?
Yes, I have eggs. How do I cook them?
Scramble them in a hot pan. Is the stove on?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Why is my dough big?
The tiny bugs eat the sugar. Do you like sweets?
Yes, but I must go. What else happens?
They make gas that makes it puff up. Is it warm in here?
Yes, it is hot. Can I put it in the oven?
You must wait a bit more first.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for the party.
Did you bring any snacks?
No, I forgot them all.
That is a problem. Do you have time to stop at a shop?
No, the car is packed full.
I do not know what to do. Maybe just eat there?
Yes, I hope so. I must go now.
Have fun. See you later?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know why my bread gets big and puffy.
A tiny living thing eats the sugar and gives out gas, which makes the dough stretch. Do you add warm water to your yeast?
Yes, I do. How do I keep it from getting too big?
Just let the gas bubble up through the soft dough to make it light.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a cat on the bus today!
That sounds like a lucky ride. Was the cat friendly?
It just looked at me and slept.
Sleeping is a good sign on a bus. Did you sit by the window?
Yes, I watched the rain fall.
Rain makes the trip feel cozy. Did you enjoy the view?
I love when rain makes things slow.
Slowing down is a nice gift.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I teach my cat to sit on command?
Hold a treat above her nose and say sit, then reward her when she does. Do you have a small treat ready?
Yes, I have cheese. Is that good for her?
Cheese is tasty but only use tiny pieces for the lesson. Is she hungry right now?
She ate lunch an hour ago. Should I wait?
Yes, wait until she is hungry so she wants the reward. How old is your cat?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do clouds float?
The air inside them is lighter than the air around them. Do you like watching them?
Yes, I do. But why do they turn dark?
They hold a lot of water in them. I am not sure about the exact color mix.
That makes sense. Why do they move?
The wind pushes them across the sky. Do you see the wind today?
I think so. Why do they not fall?
The warm air underneath pushes them up. It is like a hot balloon.
That is cool. Why do they make rain?
The drops get too heavy and fall down. Do you like the rain?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need food fast.
I hear you are in a rush. What do you want to eat?
I am not sure. It must be quick.
A hot dog is very fast. Do you like hot dogs?
Yes, but keep it simple.
I will bring it in five minutes. Would you like some fries?
No, just the dog.
I understand. I will bring it to your table now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Which day is it?
It is Tuesday. Are you okay?
Yes, but I run. Do I have Friday off?
No, Friday is a work day. Do you like Mondays?
No, I hate them. What comes after Tuesday?
Wednesday comes next. Is it a happy day for you?
Maybe. Thank you. Bye.
Bye. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make the boat go fast?
You need to pull the rope hard. Do you have a strong arm?
Yes, I think I am strong.
Pull the rope back to push the water away. Is your boat in open water?
Yes, it is on a big lake.
Keep pulling the rope in a steady way.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My dog pulls too hard when we walk.
That is hard on you. Do you use a normal collar?
Yes, I use a regular collar.
Try a gentle training vest. It helps control him. Do you have a quiet place to practice?
I can use my backyard.
That is perfect. Start there. Do you have small treats ready?
I have some kibble.
Kibble works well. Give one when he stops. Do you keep your voice low?
I usually yell at him.
Keep your voice calm and soft. Yelling scares him. Do you feel ready to try?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people live close to each other?
They want to feel safe. Do you have a neighbour?
Yes. Why do they wave at me?
It is a friendly sign. Do you wave back?
I do. Why do they leave their bins out?
The truck comes to collect them.
I see. Why do cats live in their yards?
I do not know why. Do you like cats?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My dog sat on my new shoes and made a mess.
That feels bad. Does he know where he sleeps?
He usually sleeps in his bed, but he is very hungry.
Hunger can make dogs act out. What did he eat last?
I am not sure. He might have eaten something bad.
If you do not know, we can check his belly. Did he throw up?
No, he looks fine, but I still feel upset about the shoes.
It is okay to feel upset. Can we clean them together?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am so hungry and I want a hot meal. Do you have any suggestions?
Yes, I do. Would you like a warm soup?
That sounds good. Is it spicy or mild?
It is mild. Do you like tomatoes in your food?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get my song ready fast. Can you help?
I can help you pick a tune. Do you like fast songs?
Yes, make it quick. I am late.
Pick the bright drums. Why do you love that sound?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw big ships in the harbor today. They looked very tall and strong.
That sounds fun. Did you see any ropes?
Yes, there were many thick ropes. They look hard to pull.
Ropes help boats move. Why do you think they are so thick?
I think they need to be strong. The wind is very big sometimes.
You are right. Wind can push hard. Do you like the sound of the waves?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My hands will not move. How do I fix it?
Is it a battery clock? Try changing the battery first.
Yes, I put in a new one, but it still will not tick.
That is a true sign the gears are stuck. Do you have a small tool to look inside?
No, I only have a pencil. What should I do next?
I do not know your clock type. Please take it to a shop.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look up! The clouds are so fluffy today.
They do look soft like cotton. Do you think they taste like sugar?
I feel very happy seeing them.
That is a lovely feeling. Happy hearts often see happy things.
I want to hug one of them.
I cannot tell you if that is possible. Do you dream about flying?
Yes, I do.
That is a sweet dream. I hope you float gently.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to go to the doctor today?
My tummy hurts a lot. Do you want to come along?
Will the doctor fix my stomach?
I think he will give me medicine. Do you like apples?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to do something fun for my birthday, but I have no idea what to pick.
That sounds like a great way to celebrate. Do you prefer staying inside or going outside?
I think I like going outside, but I am not sure what to do there.
Maybe you could have a picnic in a local park. Would you like to invite some friends to join you?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because my house is very clean.
That is great to hear. Did you clean all by yourself?
Yes, I did the work and now it feels fresh.
Good job on your hard work. What did you do first?
I started with the floors and then the table.
That sounds like a good order.
I feel light and ready for my friends to visit.
Visitors are always fun. Will you play games together?
I think so, maybe we can just chat and eat.
That sounds like a nice afternoon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see black smoke coming from the house across the street. What should I do?
Please call the fire department right away. Are you feeling safe inside?
I am standing in the garden, but it is getting hot. What if my own house catches fire?
Stay away from any heat and keep your calm. Do you know where the main water valve is?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today.
That sounds fun. Did you see any waves?
Yes, the water was blue.
The sea is often blue. Did you swim in it?
No, I only played in the sand.
Playing in sand is nice. Did you build a castle?
I built a little hill.
A hill is good too. Did you find any shells?
I found one shiny shell.
I am glad you found it. Did you keep it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love the beach so much today.
It looks so fun. Do you like the sand?
Yes, I like digging in it.
That sounds very cool.
I made a big sand castle.
Nice job. Will you stay there?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my fish taste bad?
It might be old. Do you keep it cold?
Yes, I do. I use ice.
Then it is fresh. Maybe the water was dirty. Did you catch it near a river?
Yes, it was a dirty river.
That is why. Fish take the taste of the water. Next time, try a clean lake. Do you like clear water?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with my little sister.
She seems very sad today. What happened?
She broke her favorite toy and now she will not stop crying.
I am sorry she feels this way. Have you tried to play with her?
I tried, but she just looks at the broken pieces.
I do not know the best fix, but kindness helps. Would you like to hug her?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread did not rise. It is flat and sad.
I am sorry it failed. Did you use fresh yeast?
Yes, I bought it this morning. Why did it fail?
The water may have been too hot. It can kill the yeast. What did the kitchen feel like?
It was warm. I think I got it wrong.
That makes sense. The yeast needs a mild home. Do you want to try again?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people sing?
It makes them feel happy. Do you like happy songs?
Yes, but my voice sounds bad.
A bad voice is just a voice that is learning. Is it scary to try?
A little. What should I do?
Start with humming like a bee. What do bees sound like to you?
They buzz a lot.
That buzz is your start. Can you try that now?
Okay. Why is humming good?
It helps your body get ready to sing. Does your chest feel warm?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired from all the noise here.
That is a hard place to be. Do you see a quiet spot nearby?
Not really, the streets are too full of people.
Let us look for a park to rest.
A park would be nice, but I do not know the way.
I can help you find it. Do you like walking or standing still?
I just want to sit down for a bit.
We will find a bench soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need to pick a time for the meeting?
A set time helps us both show up. Are you free in the morning?
I do not know. Why do we have to choose so early?
It is easier to wake up for a big task. Is there a specific time you like?
I think I like the afternoon. Why does the time even matter?
It lets us plan our day with care. Does that sound good to you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do robots feel cold when it is snowing?
Robots do not feel cold, but they can break in the snow. Do you like snow?
I do. Can robots dream?
Robots do not dream because they do not sleep like us. Do you have good dreams?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is my new neighbor a dog?
No, it is a person. Do you like to wave at them?
I think they have a big blue car.
That sounds fun. What color is your bike?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do plants like the sun?
Sun helps them make food. Do you see a sunny spot in your yard?
Yes, I do. Why is the soil so dark?
Dark soil has lots of good stuff for roots.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy a boat. Do you know which one is best?
That is a big choice. What do you plan to do on the water?
I just want to sit and watch the fish.
A small fishing boat would be perfect for that. Do you have a budget?
I have a little money saved up.
Good, start with a used boat to save coins. Have you seen any you like?
I saw one red one at the dock. It looks fast.
Speed is fun, but it needs more care. Do you know how to fix an engine?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I saw fire outside. How do I put it out?
Water works best for small fires. Do you have a bucket nearby?
Yes, I do. What do I do with the water?
Pour the water on the fire slowly. Please be very careful not to burn yourself.
It is still burning. What should I do now?
If it gets bigger, run away and call for help. I do not know where you are, so I cannot tell more.
Okay, I will run. Thank you.
You are welcome. Go now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel so alone. I must go now.
That feels bad. I am here if you need me. Do you have a friend to call?
No. I have no time.
It is okay to be sad. Let me know when you are back.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does snow stick to the ground?
It sticks because it is cold. Do you like to build snowmen?
Yes, I do. Why do snowflakes have six sides?
The shape comes from how water freezes. Do you look at them closely?
I do. Why is snow white?
I am not sure of the exact reason. It looks bright to our eyes.
I see. Why does snow melt in your hand?
Your hand is warm and gives heat. Does it melt fast?
Very fast. Why is the sky gray when it snows?
Thick clouds block the sun. Do you like gray days?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do here.
That is okay. Do you like the sound of the waves?
Yes, it is nice.
You can sit and listen to them. Is the sand warm or cool?
It feels very warm.
That is good for your feet. Let us just sit for a bit.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a tree house. Can you help me make a plan?
That sounds like a great idea. What kind of trees do you have near your house?
I have an old oak tree in the backyard. It is big and strong.
An oak is a good choice for this. Do you have any wood left from the shed project?
Yes, I have some leftover planks and nails. I think they are enough.
You should start by measuring the spot on the tree. Do you have a long tape measure?
Yes, my dad has one. I will measure the tree this morning.
That is a smart first step. Good luck with your build.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The boats are gone and the water is so still. I feel sad seeing it empty.
It is quiet, but the sun is warm. Do you want to sit by the water?
The smell of old wood makes me miss my dad.
That is a kind memory. Was he a good sailor?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my party is a mess.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you want to clean up?
I tried, but it is too much work.
I believe you. Would you like some help?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I dropped my glass. What should I say?
Say "I am so sorry" to the person. Are they nearby?
They are looking at me. I feel shy.
Look at their feet if that helps. Do you know their name?
Yes, it is Mr. Jones.
Then say, "Sorry, Mr. Jones."

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to see a wild bear in the forest. What should I do?
You must stay very quiet and move slowly. Do you have a camera to take pictures?
Yes, I have a camera. How close can I get to the bear?
Keep at least fifty feet of distance for safety. Are you wearing bright colors today?
No, I am wearing dull green clothes. What else do I need to know?
Always back away slowly if the bear looks at you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people wear white dresses at weddings?
White shows that the bride is happy and pure. Is she wearing a big one?
Why do the guests clap so loud?
Clapping tells the couple that everyone is very happy for them. Do you like to clap?
Why do they cut a cake together?
The cake is sweet and sweet things bring joy. Do you like sweet cakes?
Why do they kiss under the chandelier?
I do not know for sure, but it is a lovely tradition. Is it a big chandelier?
Why do they dance all night?
Dancing lets them share their happiness with friends and family. Will you dance too?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw a bear today and my heart beat so fast. I was very scared of it.
It makes sense you were scared. Bears are big and wild. Did you stay far away?
Yes, I ran to my car fast. But I feel bad for not helping it. I am upset.
You did the right thing by staying safe. Wild animals need space to live their lives. How is your heart feeling now?
It is slow now. But I still worry I did something wrong. Was I a bad friend to the bear?
No, you were safe and that is good. Helping wild life means giving them room. Do you like learning about them?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a sandcastle. How do I start?
Dig a hole for the base. Do you like sharks?
I do. What do I use for the walls?
Use wet sand in buckets. Flip them upside down to make towers.
That sounds fun. How do I make a door?
Dig a small hole at the bottom. Do you have a shovel?
Yes, I have a big red shovel.
Great. Now fill the center with more wet sand to make it strong.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to fix the bike tire.
That is a fun job. Do you have a tool?
Yes, I have a small pump.
Good. Pump air until it feels hard. Do you like riding?
I want to ride to the park.
The path is smooth there. Ride safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My head hurts. Why?
It may hurt because you are sick. Do you have a fever?
I feel warm. Why does it hurt?
Your body is fighting a bug. Have you rested?
I was tired. Why the bug?
I do not know the exact bug. Did you drink water?
I was thirsty. Why does water help?
Water helps your body work well. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off the trees?
The days get short and cold. Do you see how the sun shines less now?
I do not really.
The tree needs to save its water. It lets go of the leaves to rest.
That sounds like sleeping.
Yes, it is like a deep sleep for the tree. Does that make sense to you?
Yes, I think I get it now.
I am glad you understand. Do you want to look for fallen leaves later?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Tell me where my old friend lives.
I do not know their address. Do they live near the park?
Yes, they do. Please tell me their house number.
I do not have that number. Do they have a red door?
Yes, they do. I must go now.
Good luck. I hope you see them soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I fixed my wobbly chair with some tape and it is steady now.
That is great news. Did you feel proud of your work?
Yes, I did! It feels so strong now.
I am glad it works well. Do you like the color of the tape?
I chose blue tape because it matches my shirt.
That is a nice touch. Do you have any other broken toys at home?
Not right now, just the chair needed fixing.
Good to hear. Is your room tidy now?
Yes, I put all my tools back in the box.
That is very responsible. Thanks for sharing the good news.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to write a letter, but I do not know how to start.
Do you know who you are writing to? Just say the date and hello first.
It is for my grandma. I miss her a lot.
That is a nice reason to write. Do you want to tell her about your day?
Yes, I played in the mud today. It was fun but messy.
Mud sounds like a great adventure. Did you tell her you had a fun time?
I wrote that I was very happy to see her. I hope she likes it.
She will be so happy to read your words. Did you put your name at the end?
Yes, I signed it with a big X. Thank you for helping me.
You did a wonderful job on your letter. I am glad you felt brave today.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a blank canvas and I do not know what to draw.
That is okay. Do you like animals or cars?
I think I like trees, but I am scared they will look wrong.
Mistakes are just parts of the story. What color do you feel today?
Blue. It feels calm to me.
Blue is a good choice for a peaceful day. Do you want to start with the sky?
Yes, the sky first, then the green leaves.
That sounds lovely. Just let your hand move and enjoy the paint.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the store today and almost bought a toy. But I saw a big apple instead.
That is a smart choice. Do you like apples?
Yes, they are sweet and cheap. I felt good saving that money.
Feeling good about saving is a great sign.
I will keep the coin in my jar. Now I have two coins for my jar.
Building a jar of coins is a fun way to save.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a huge smile on my face today.
That is wonderful to hear. What made you so happy?
I won the big prize at the park.
Oh, that is great news. Was it a sweet treat?
It was actually a shiny new coin.
How exciting that must be. Do you want to keep it?
Yes, I will save it in my box.
That is a good plan. I am glad you are feeling so good.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start my tomato plants in the small garden?
You put the seeds in a pot with dirt and water them well. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
Yes, I do. What if they get too tall?
You tie them to a stick with soft string. Is your soil dry or wet?
It is dry. How much water do I need?
Wet the dirt until it feels like a squeezed sponge. Do you check the soil every day?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My tummy hurts. I do not know if I should go to the doctor.
That sounds scary. Does it hurt a lot?
A little bit. Maybe I should wait and see if it gets better.
Waiting is okay if you feel fine. Do you have a fever?
No, I feel warm but not hot. I am just unsure.
If it hurts more, go to the doctor. Would you like to take some soup?
Yes, soup sounds nice. I will drink it and rest.
Good idea. Let me know if you feel worse.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see a small fire in the pan. How do I stop it?
Slide a lid over the pan to cut the air. Are you safe?
Yes, I am safe. But what if I do not have a lid?
Use baking soda or dirt to cover the flames. Is your smoke getting bad?
The smoke is bad. How do I clean the air?
Open windows to let the bad air out. Do you have a phone?
I have my phone. How do I call for help?
Dial nine one one to call the firemen. Do you feel okay?
I feel okay now. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost the last hand and I am so mad.
That feels really bad. Did you hold a good hand?
I had two pairs, but he still beat me.
That is frustrating luck. Do you know why he won?
I do not know. I just want to quit.
You can take a break if you need one.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park and saw a dog.
That sounds fun. Was the dog big or small?
It was a tiny puppy. I want to learn the word for it.
The word is "puppy." Nice work.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I think I am lost. Why did I forget the path?
Our minds sometimes play tricks on us. Are you cold out here?
No, but I feel small. Why do maps not work for me?
Eyes see lines, but not the real air. Do you see a tall tree?
I see a big tree. Why is it there?
It stands to mark the way back. Do you smell rain?
I smell wet dirt. Why is it nice?
Rain cleans the world clean. Do you feel happy now?
I feel better. Why do I trust you?
You trust my kind heart. Do you feel safe?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go first in this new town.
The park is a safe place to start. Do you like to watch the birds?
I am not sure if I like the quiet spots.
The library is calm if you want to sit still. Do you enjoy reading books?
I guess the library sounds good for me.
You can find a soft chair there. Would you like some tea?
I am tired and my feet hurt from walking.
There is a bench near the door. Do you need help with your bag?
I think I will just sit and rest for a bit.
Rest well and breathe slow. I am happy to be here with you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I painted a red circle today and it looked just right.
That sounds like a big win. What color was the sky when you painted?
It was blue. I felt so happy when I finished.
Happy is a wonderful feeling. Do you want to try painting a square next?
Yes, I think I will. It feels good to do new things.
I am glad you are proud of your art. Keep going.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, the lights went out. I have to go now.
That is very bad. Do you have a plan?
I must leave in five minutes. I can not see anything.
Please wait a moment. I do not know the fix.
I do not have time to wait.
Okay, I will show you the way.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am so tired from work today.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you take a break to rest?
Yes, but my boss kept asking me for more work.
That sounds very hard to do.
How can I make my boss stop giving me so much?
You can tell him you are too busy. Have you tried talking to him?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw my grandpa today and he smiled at me.
That sounds very nice. Do you like seeing him?
Yes, I do. He gave me a cookie.
Cookies are sweet. Did you eat it right away?
I shared it with my little brother.
Sharing is a kind thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am late for school. The bus is gone.
That is a big worry. Did you have breakfast?
No, I was too busy.
I am sorry to hear that. What did you forget?
I forgot my red coat.
You can wear your blue one. Are you hungry now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big light on the rock last night.
That is a lighthouse. It helps boats find the way. Do you like lights?
Yes, I do. Does it stay on all the time?
Yes, it glows day and night to keep sailors safe.
That is very kind of the lighthouse. I hope I visit one someday.
That sounds like a great plan.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a paper plane?
Take a flat piece of paper and fold it in half. Do you have paper ready?
Yes, I have a white sheet. What do I do next?
Fold the top corners down to meet the center line. Does the shape look like a triangle?
It does. Now what?
Fold the sides back down to make it thin. Are your hands feeling steady?
They are. How do I fly it?
Hold the wings gently and throw it forward with a soft push. I do not know if it will fly far, but it should go.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are trees so tall?
They grow up to reach the sun for food. Do you like looking at the sky?
Yes, I do. Why do they have leaves?
Leaves catch the sun to make energy. Do you like eating apples?
Yes, they are sweet. Why do trees drop leaves in fall?
They let go to rest before the cold comes. Do you like the color of fall?
I like the red ones. Why do some trees stay green?
I do not know all the reasons, but they have special coats. Do you see them in your town?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the barn this morning to feed the cows.
That sounds like a busy start to your day. Did you see the chickens too?
Yes, the chickens were chasing the rooster near the fence.
They always seem so active. Do you have a favorite animal on the farm?
I like the horse because he is very calm and gentle.
Calm animals are often very easy to love. What does he like to eat?
He likes apples and sweet carrots.
Those are tasty treats for a horse. I hope he gave you a good nuzzle!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel very happy today.
That is great news. What makes you smile?
The sun is bright and warm.
Sunshine feels good. Do you like the wind too?
Yes, it feels soft.
That sounds lovely. I am glad you are well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing, but my voice sounds weird.
That is okay, everyone starts there. Do you like songs about animals?
Yes, I love the lion song from my storybook.
Great choice. Let us try the first line together. Are you ready to start?
I am ready, but what if I hit a wrong note?
A wrong note is just part of learning. I do not know if you will get it perfect today, but you will do your best.
Okay, I will try my best.
That is a good plan. Did you feel the music in your chest?
Yes, it feels warm and funny.
Warm is a good feeling. We can try again tomorrow if you want.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: The leg is wobbly. Why is it doing that?
The screw is loose. Is the wood dry?
The wood feels fine. Why does a tight screw stop the wobble?
It pulls the parts close. Do you have a tool?
I have a small bit. Why is that the right size?
It fits the hole well. Let us try it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel small and sad looking at all those lights.
The sky is big, but your heart is warm. Do you like the moon?
It is too far away to touch.
You can hold my hand instead. Do you feel better now?
Just a little bit.
That is good. What color is your favorite star?
The bright white ones near the end.
White stars shine the strongest. Thank you for sharing that.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I moved my box to the new room today. It was very heavy.
That sounds like hard work. Did you find all your toys?
Yes, but I lost my red ball. I looked everywhere.
That is a shame. Do you remember where you left it?
I think I put it near the door. It is not there now.
Maybe it rolled under the bed. Do you want to check?
Yes, let me look. Oh, I found it!
I am glad you found it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired of waiting for the bus.
That does feel very long and hard. Is it raining outside?
No, but my feet hurt from standing.
I am sorry your feet are hurting. Do you have a hat?
Yes, but I am still cold.
I do not know when the bus will come. Have you checked the time?
I just want to go home now.
I hope it arrives soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now. I love how the months change the weather.
That is a sweet feeling. Do you have a favorite month?
Yes, I really like March. It feels like a fresh start.
That makes sense. Thank you for sharing your joy.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to know all the months, but they are hard to remember. Do you have a good trick?
You can link them to the seasons. Do you know which month starts winter?
I think winter starts in December, but I am not sure. How do I remember the order?
Start with spring in March and count forward. Does that help you see the pattern?
Yes, it makes it much easier. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a happy day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I promised to call my grandma today. I made her a card, too.
That is a very sweet promise. Did you get a chance to call her?
Yes, we talked for a long time about my new dog. She was so happy.
That sounds like a fun day. Does the dog have a name?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I need to move my home to a new place. What should I do first?
That is a big change. Do you know how far the new place is?
It is near, but I have many boxes. How do I pack them?
Pack light things in small boxes. Heavier things go in big boxes.
I am worried about the books. Will they break?
You can wrap them in soft cloth. Do you have enough cloth?
I have some towels. Is that okay to use?
Towels are good for protection. Just keep them dry.
I feel much better now. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. I hope the move goes well.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get out the door right now.
The snow will melt soon. Are you cold?
I have work to do.
I am not sure when it will stop. Do you have a coat?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my phone light up?
It lights up to show you a new message. Do you want to read it?
Why is the screen so bright?
It is bright so you can see well in the dark. Is it too bright for your eyes?
Why does it get warm?
I do not know the exact reason, but it may be working hard. Do you feel it getting hot?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park and saw a big, brown dog.
That sounds like a fun walk. Was the dog friendly?
Yes, it wagged its tail at me and a squirrel ran by.
I love seeing animals play outside. Did you take a picture?
No, I just watched them for a while before going home.
That is a peaceful way to spend time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for the boat. Where is it?
It is right over there by the water. Is this your first time on a big boat?
Yes, but I have to run. Which way do I go?
Just walk straight down that long dock. Do you know where you are sleeping?
I forgot to check. Is it warm inside?
I do not know about the heat, but I hope it is cozy. Do you have a warm coat?
No, I lost my coat. Will I freeze?
It might get cold, so look for a blanket there.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big pot of tomato soup and I am so glad it turned out well.
That sounds very nice. What did you put in it for flavor?
Just some carrots, celery, and a few herbs from the garden.
I love fresh herbs. Do you usually cook at home?
Yes, I love to cook, and I hope you will enjoy this meal with me.
I would be happy to sit down and eat with you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are so many people in the city?
Many people come here to work and play. Do you like busy places?
Why is the traffic so loud?
Cars move fast to get people where they need to go. I do not know why it is so noisy.
Why do people build such tall buildings?
They need more space for homes and shops. Is your house tall?
Why is the city so bright at night?
Lights help people see in the dark. Do you see the stars from your window?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to change the light bulb. How do I do it?
First, flip the switch to off. Do you know where the switch is?
Yes, it is by the door. What do I do next?
Wait one minute for the glass to cool down. Be careful not to touch the heat.
Okay, it is cold now. How do I take the old one out?
Turn the old bulb to the left to unscrew it. Do you have a dry cloth to hold it?
I have a towel. I am ready to put in the new one.
Screw the new bulb in to the right until it is tight. Good job, you did it!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate this dark room.
I am sorry. Can you see me?
It is so annoying.
That is fair. Do you have a lamp?
No. I am tired.
Rest your eyes. Is it cold in there?
Yes, it is.
I am sure it will end soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My brain hurts from all the work today.
That sounds very tough. Did you drink some water?
No, I was too busy to stop.
Drinking water helps your head feel better. Do you like sweet tea?
Yes, I love sweet tea.
I do not know if you have tea at home. Try a rest now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to start. The market is so big.
Pick the thing you like best first. What color do you love?
I like red. But I still feel lost.
Go to the red apples. Is your tummy hungry?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting so long.
That is a very common feeling. Are you tired?
The plane went very fast.
Yes, planes move through the sky. What did you see?
I want to eat now.
You should ask for a snack. Do you like cookies?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My dog ate a piece of my red shoe. What should I do?
That is a big oops. Is your dog okay?
Yes, he is fine. But my mom will be sad.
Tell the truth to your mom. Honesty is the best fix.
I am scared she will be angry.
She may be mad, but she will love your honesty.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel nervous about my talk tomorrow.
Is it a small group or a big one?
It is a big group. I am scared.
That is normal. Do you have your notes ready?
Yes, but I forgot the last part.
I do not know your words. You must add them now.
Okay, I will write them down.
Good plan. Do you need help with anything else?
No, that is all. Thanks.
Good luck with your talk.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very alone and I do not know how to make friends.
That feeling is hard but you are not truly alone here. What do you like to do for fun?
I like drawing pictures and I want to learn to draw better.
You can start by drawing what you see around you. Do you have a pencil nearby?
Yes I have a big blue pencil right here.
Great, just hold it loose and draw a simple circle. How does your hand feel when you hold it?
It feels a bit wobbly but I am trying my best.
Wobbly lines are okay because they are real. Do you want to try drawing a square next?
I think I will take a deep breath and try the square.
Take your time and be kind to yourself. I am glad you are trying.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Where do the old bones come from?
They dig them out of the dirt. Do you like to dig?
Yes, I like digging. What is that big dark thing in the back?
I am not sure. It looks like a very old car.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do my lights turn off when I plug in the big heater?
That is a big jump in power. Is the heater on the same plug as your lights?
No, they are on different walls.
Then your home needs more power than it has. Do you have a helper to fix this?
I do not know who to call.
That is a job for a pro. I am just a helper and do not know your local codes.
Okay, I will ask my dad.
That is a very safe choice. Is he home right now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I caught a cold today. I am very happy.
That is good for you. Do you feel okay?
Yes, my nose is just stuffy.
A stuffy nose is common. Do you like drinking tea?
I love warm honey tea.
That sounds tasty.
I will share some with you.
That is very kind. Thank you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My clock stopped and I do not know why.
That is tricky. Do you have batteries?
Yes, I tried new ones but it is still quiet.
It may be broken. Do you have a spare watch?
No, I only have the big wall clock.
I do not know more. Please ask a shop helper.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to take a nice picture of my dog. What should I do?
Try to catch a moment when he is calm. Is he sleepy or alert?
He is very alert and likes to chew. I am afraid my photos will be blurry.
Hold the camera with two hands to keep it still. Do you have a friend to help?
No, I am alone. My hands shake a little.
You can rest your elbow on a table to stop the shake. Does that sound okay?
Yes, that works. But my dog looks small and far away. How do I get closer?
Walk slowly toward him so he does not startle. Do you have a zoom lens?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. The sun feels nice on my face.
That sounds lovely. Does the light make your eyes feel warm?
Yes, it feels like a soft hug. I love when it shines so bright.
Sunshine is a great gift. Do you think the clouds will hide it later?
I hope not, but I am just glad it is here now. It makes me want to sing.
Singing is a perfect way to share the joy. Is it a happy song?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to school in the rain today.
That sounds wet and cold. Do you like the sound of rain?
It was loud, like a drum.
Music can be loud and fun. Did you hear any other songs?
I heard my friend humming a happy tune.
That is a nice sound. What is the song called?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel really happy today. What makes people feel good?
It is often a warm hug or a tasty snack. Do you have a favorite snack?
Yes, I like strawberries. Why do they make me smile?
Sweet things can lift your mood. Do you share them with friends?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw the moon today because I woke up late.
That is a lucky start to the day. Did you smile at it?
I smiled because it looked like a silver coin.
That sounds like a sweet sight. Is the coin bright tonight?
Yes, it is very bright and white.
Bright light helps us see well. Do you like looking up?
I do, but I am tired now.
Rest is good for you. Good night.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to grow carrots. How do I do it?
You need soft, loose dirt. Do you have a sunny spot?
Yes, I have a big pot.
A pot works well. Water them when the top soil feels dry.
How deep should I put the seeds?
Put them about two inches down. Is your pot deep enough?
Yes, it is very deep.
That is good. Wait for them to sprout.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what day it is today.
Do you like sunny days?
I think it might be a weekday.
Is your shop open today?
I have no idea what to do with my free time.
I do not know your plans, but I hope you have fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to walk more for my health. Do I need special shoes?
Yes, wear shoes that fit well and cushion your feet. Do you have a nice pair ready?
How fast should I walk?
Go at a speed where you can still talk easily. Are you feeling tired today?
How long should each walk be?
Start with just fifteen minutes a day. Do you have a park near your home?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I lost my red ball.
That is very sad. Did you check the garden?
Yes, I looked everywhere. I am crying now.
I am here with you. Do you want to look again?
I just want to go to bed. I am too tired.
That is a good plan. I hope you find it soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My dog is eating his own tail. Is that a bad thing?
It is usually just play, but check for hair loss. Does he seem happy when you stop it?
He looks very busy with it, but he stops when I look.
That sounds like normal behavior. Do you brush his fur every day?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a new robot. I do not know what to do with it.
That is a fun gift. Do you know how to turn it on?
I found the button, but the light is red. What does that mean?
Red often means it is asleep or charging. Do you want it to wake up?
Yes, I want it to move. It is very quiet.
Try saying hello in a loud voice. Robots like sound.
It moved! I am happy now. Thank you for helping me.
I am glad it works. What is the first thing you will make it do?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am stuck on my math sheet. How do I solve the big number problem?
You can break the big number into smaller parts to make it easy. Do you like adding or multiplying?
I like adding. What do I do first?
Start by adding the ones, then move to the tens. Do you have a pencil ready?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to start with driving.
That is a big step. What part scares you the most?
I am worried about hitting things with the car.
Everyone feels that way at first. Do you have a calm friend to help?
My friend is here, but I feel clumsy.
Clumsy means you are still learning. Let us just practice parking first.
Parking sounds hard too.
It gets easier with time. Do you want to try in an empty lot?
Okay, an empty lot sounds safe.
Good choice. Let us go now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a reason for this?
I do not know why I feel this way.
That can be confusing. Are you tired or hungry?
I am not tired or hungry.
It is hard to find a cause sometimes. Did something small happen?
I just woke up feeling low.
That happens to many people.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a square with four equal sides. How many corners does it have?
It has four corners. Do you see them all?
Yes, I can count them. What shape has five sides?
That is called a pentagon. Do you like drawing shapes?
I like drawing stars. How many points does a star have?
Most stars have five points. Do you draw them on paper?
I use red crayons. What happens if I add one more side to the pentagon?
You make a hexagon. Is it getting hard to draw?
It is a little hard. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Keep trying, little friend.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dog is not eating his food today.
That is worrying. Did he drink any water?
I do not know what is wrong with him.
He may just be tired. Is he wagging his tail?
He is very quiet and hiding under the bed.
That is not normal. You should call a vet.
I am scared because he is my best friend.
You are doing the right thing. Do you have the vet number?
I forgot to write it down last week.
You can look for one online now. Is he breathing okay?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my stamp and now I cannot send my letter. I am so sad.
Oh no, that is tricky. Did you check your coat pocket?
I have checked my pockets many times, but it is gone. Please help me.
I do not know where it went, but we can buy a new one. Do you like blue stamps?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at the moon and I do not know what to do.
Do you like the moon, or is it too bright for you?
It looks so far away, and I feel small.
You can draw a picture of it to feel closer. Do you like to draw with crayons?
I have no paper, and I am feeling lost in my room.
Just close your eyes and think of your favorite part of the night. What is your favorite color?
I think I will just go to bed now.
Goodnight, I am glad you felt better.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am very tired today. I do not know what to do next.
I am sorry you feel so low. What part of your day was the hardest?
I made a big mistake. I feel very bad about it.
It is natural to feel sad when we err. Have you told your boss about it yet?
I am afraid to tell him the truth.
Telling the truth is always the right thing to do. It may take some time to fix, but you will feel better.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my dog sit?
Hold a treat near their nose, then move it up and back. Do you have a treat ready?
Yes, I have some small bones.
Good, slowly say "sit" as you lift the treat. Is your dog quiet?
He is barking a lot.
I do not know if he is barking out of joy or hunger. Try to wait for him to be calm first.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in the library. I do not know where to go.
Do not worry. Is there a book you want to find?
Yes, I want a book about cats. I do not know which part to go to.
The cat books are on the third shelf. Do you like big books or small ones?
I like big books with many pictures. I hope they are easy to read.
Great! Look for the thick books first. I hope you find a good one.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my boat right now.
Is it the red one by the dock?
No, it is the blue one.
I do not see it. Is it far away?
It is right behind that big tree.
Oh, I see it. You can go.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do trees lose their leaves in fall?
They do that to save energy. Do you like autumn colors?
The tree in my yard looks sick. What should I do?
Check if the soil is too wet. Is it still green?
I think it is getting more sun than before.
More sun helps some trees but hurts others. Which kind is it?
It is a maple. Can I just water it?
Yes, water helps if the soil is dry. I do not know the exact amount.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: On Monday, I woke up late and dropped my toast.
That is a start. Did you get to eat your toast anyway?
No, the cat ate it. On Tuesday, I played in the rain.
The cat is fast. The rain must have been fun.
Yes, but I got cold. Wednesday, I built a big tower of blocks.
The cold did not stop you. How tall was your tower?
It was very tall, but it fell down.
That is a silly end to the week. I do not know if your tower won, but you tried hard.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend about my day.
That is a sweet idea. What is the first thing you want to share?
I went to the park and saw a big, friendly dog.
A big dog sounds fun. Did you play with the dog?
Yes, we chased balls, and then I got very tired.
Running makes you feel good and tired. What did you eat for lunch?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Can you tell me how to make a good sandwich?
Yes, start by picking two pieces of bread. Do you like meat or just cheese?
I like cheese and tomato. What do I put on the bread next?
Slice the tomato thin and put it on one piece. Then add your cheese on top.
That sounds easy. What do I do with the other piece?
Place the second piece on top to close it. Do you want to cut it in half?
Yes, please tell me how to cut it.
Lay the knife across the middle and press down gently. You will have two perfect halves.
Thank you so much. I feel ready to try this now.
You are welcome. Have fun with your lunch.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my favorite book is broken.
That is very hard. Do you remember what page it broke on?
It is the very last page. I do not know if I can fix it.
You can try to tape it back together. Do you like the end of the story?
I really do like it, but it feels dirty now.
We can wipe it with a wet cloth. Do you want to try cleaning it?
Yes, I will try. Thank you for helping me think.
You are welcome. I hope it feels good again soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am so late. I need to learn to tie my shoes.
That is a good way to save time. Do you like wearing sneakers?
Yes, but the knots always come undone.
I know a trick to make them stay tight. Are you ready to listen?
Yes, please tell me.
Pull the loops tight before you cross them. I hope that helps you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared of deep water.
That is okay. Do you know how to float?
I can float on my back a little.
Good. Practice breathing slow. Do you use a pool toy?
Yes, a ring. I like it.
Rings help many people. Try kicking your legs. Is the water warm?
Yes, it is warm today.
Warm water helps you relax. Take your time. How far can you kick?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My throat feels very scratchy.
That must be rough. Do you have a fever?
I feel hot but I am not sure what to do next.
Drink lots of warm water to help you feel better.
I still feel very tired and my head hurts.
Please rest and let your body heal. Does the headache come and go?
I just want the bad feelings to stop soon.
It usually takes a few days to pass. You will be okay.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a tall white lighthouse today. The light spun round and round.
That sounds very bright. Did you see any boats nearby?
Yes, a small red boat passed by. I waved my hand at it.
A kind hello from a distance. Did the wind feel cold?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to buy fresh food at the market, but I am lost.
Let us start at the fruit stand. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I like apples and bananas.
Pick the ones that smell strong. Do you know how to check if they are ripe?
No, I do not know.
Tap them gently with your finger. Is the sound dull or sharp?
It sounds dull when I tap the red apple.
Good, that means it is ready to eat. Do you want to try a green one?
No, I think I will just buy the red one.
That is a smart choice. Enjoy your snack.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How many months are in one year?
There are twelve months. Do you know which month we are in right now?
I think it is winter, but I am not sure.
You are right, it is winter. Do you like snow?
Yes, I like snow very much. What is the next month?
The next month is March. I do not know if you will like it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I wrote a letter. It feels so good to share it.
That is wonderful. What is the letter about?
It is about my cat. I hope the friend smiles.
A cat is a lovely topic.
Did I use good words for the cat?
I cannot read the letter, so I do not know.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: Why does the big ship stay on the water?
It pushes the water down, and the water pushes back up. Do you have a toy boat to test?
I do, but I am not sure how to make it float right.
Put light stuff inside, like small stones, to weigh it down. Is your boat made of wood or plastic?
It is plastic, and I think it is too light.
Add a little weight until it sits low but does not sink. How does it look now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights just went out. I do not know what to do.
That can feel scary. Is it cold in your room?
No, it is just dark and quiet. I feel lost.
Let us wait and see if the power comes back. Do you have a battery pack?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I like bananas very much. How do I peel one?
Just start at the end and pull the skin down. Do you like them sweet or mild?
I like them sweet. What if I have the wrong end?
Look for the little flower tip. It is usually on the bottom.
That is helpful. I will try that today.
You will do great. Enjoy your fruit.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I hit the ball into the net too much. How do I stop this?
Try to slice the top of the ball slightly. Do you use a very fast swing?
Yes, I try to hit it hard every time.
Slow down your swing a bit. Does your racket feel heavy when you swing fast?
It feels a bit tiring. I want to win.
Keeping your wrist loose helps a lot. Do you have a coach to help you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I get off the bus when my stop is near?
Look for the stop button on the wall. Do you see the little red lever?
I found it, but how do I hold on so I do not fall?
Grip the handrail tight with your hand. Are you holding on well?
My stop is close, but the bus is still moving fast.
Stand still and wait for it to slow down. You are doing a good job.
The bus has stopped, so I am ready to go.
Step out carefully and look both ways. Have a safe walk home?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do they have pizza?
Yes, they do. Do you like cheese?
Is it open on Sunday?
I am not sure. Do you want to call?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I take a sharp photo?
Hold the camera very still. Do you have a tripod?
No, I do not. What else can I do?
Breathe in slowly and hold your breath before you click. Is it windy where you are?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do flowers have petals?
Petals help pick up bees. Do you like watching bees?
Yes, I do. Why are roses red?
Many roses are red to look bright. Some are other colors too.
Why do flowers smell nice?
The sweet smell brings insects close. Do you smell the air today?
I think it smells good. Why do flowers die?
They make seeds and then rest. This helps new ones grow.
That makes sense. Do all flowers die?
Yes, most of them do. Do you keep any flowers in your room?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
