exchanges: I just saw the cutest little bakery. The smell was so sweet.
That sounds lovely. Do they have fresh cookies?
They do. I want to buy some for my friends.
That is a very nice thought. What is your favorite type?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a computer but I do not know how to get on the web.
That is a hard task. Do you have a phone?
I do have a phone, but I still feel lost.
I cannot fix that for you. Can you see a small circle with a line?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, a red bird is on the fence. I am so happy to see it.
That is a beautiful sight. What color is its chest?
It is bright red and orange. Do you like red birds too?
I do not have eyes, so I cannot see. But I like your joy.
Haha, yes, I feel great. Do you know what it is called?
It looks like a cardinal. Do you want to feed it?
Yes, I have some seeds. Let us put them out together.
That sounds like a lovely plan. I am glad you are sharing your joy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to draw a cloud.
Start with a big loop and add smaller bumps on top. Do you like big or small clouds?
I like the big ones. How do I make it look puffy?
Use loose, wiggly lines and do not press too hard. Do you have a pencil ready?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so good today because I did something hard.
That sounds wonderful. What did you do?
I finally learned to tie my own shoes.
Oh, that is a big step. It takes time.
My hands were silly at first, but I kept trying.
Good for you. How did it feel when the knot held?
It felt like a small victory.
A win is a win. Did you tell anyone?
Yes, I showed my friend and he was happy for me.
Sharing joy is nice. You should be proud.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a doctor, but I am so late.
That is bad. Are you feeling very sick?
Yes, my head hurts a lot.
Do you have a fever?
I do not have time to check. Just get me to the office fast.
I do not know the fastest way to go.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do flowers have bright colors?
They want bees to see them. Do you like red flowers?
Why do plants need water?
Water helps them grow tall.
Why are some flowers soft?
Soft petals help the flower open. Is your favorite flower hard or soft?
Why do flowers smell nice?
Nice smells bring in bugs to help them. Do you like the smell of roses?
Why do flowers die?
They have a life, just like us. I do not know why some die faster than others.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the big dinosaur so tall?
It grew up to eat the tallest plants. Do you like big animals?
Why do the old bones look white?
They were underground for a very long time. I do not know why some look brown.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a boat to the dock?
You loop the rope around the metal ring. Do you have a long rope?
Yes, I have one.
Pull it tight after you make the knot. Is the boat floating steady?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The snow is very deep. How do I walk in it?
You can walk on the edge of the path. Do you have warm boots on?
My boots are wet and cold. What should I do?
Put on dry socks and a thick sweater. Is your house warm inside?
Yes, it is warm. Should I build a snowman?
That sounds like fun. Make it a big one. How tall do you want it to be?
I want it to be tall. Can you help me?
I cannot push the snow, but I can watch. Do you have a big bucket?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to eat pizza.
That sounds fun. Do you like cheese on it?
Yes, a lot of cheese.
Good choice. Is the place far from here?
No, it is right on the corner.
Great. Can they give you a small slice?
I hope so.
I am not sure. You can ask them.
Okay, thanks for helping.
You are welcome. Have a nice meal.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights are off and I am scared to touch the wire.
Please do not touch the wire. Is it dark in the room?
Yes, it is very dark and I do not know what broke.
You can call a helper who knows about power. Do you have your phone?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so hungry. I walked a long way to get here today.
That must have been tiring. Would you like a soup?
Yes, please. I want the vegetable one.
Good choice. What did you do before you started walking?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I do not like this math problem.
I get that. It looks hard. Do you want a break?
No, I need to finish. Why is it so tricky?
It asks you to think in two steps. Have you tried the first part?
I did that, but I am lost now.
You are close. Look at your last number.
Oh, I see it. I forgot to add two.
That was a small miss. You did good work.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the big ship float on the water?
The ship pushes water aside, and the water pushes back up to hold it. Do you see how the bottom is wide?
Is it like a balloon?
Not quite, because the ship is heavy and the water is thick. Do you like swimming pools?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it bad to read in bed?
It is fine for most people, but it may make you sleepy. Do you like staying up late?
I just want to finish my book.
Finish your book first, then go to bed. Do you have a bright lamp?
Yes, it is very bright.
Try a dim light so your eyes rest. Do you feel tired yet?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go camping soon. Do I need a tent?
Yes, a tent keeps you safe from the rain. Do you have one yet?
No, I do not have a tent. Where can I buy one?
You can find tents at stores that sell outdoor gear.
What else should I bring with me?
A sleeping bag and a flashlight are very helpful. Are you scared of the dark?
A little bit. How do I light a fire?
Use dry sticks and some paper to start it. Do you know how to spot dry wood?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to order a sandwich.
Good choice. What kind of meat do you like?
I am not sure.
Try turkey. Is that a good option for you?
Yes, that sounds nice.
Great. Do you want to add any vegetables?
Just some lettuce, please.
Noted. Would you like a drink with that?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make my bike go faster?
Push the pedals harder. Do you have good shoes?
I wear sneakers.
That is good. Wear a helmet too.
Why must I wear a helmet?
It protects your head if you fall. Do you know how to brake?
I pull the levers.
Good. You are ready to ride. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am trying to draw a cat but it looks like a blob.
That is okay, blobs can turn into many things. Do you like cats?
Yes, I love fluffy cats. How do I make ears?
Try two triangles on top of the blob. Do you want to add eyes?
I will try triangles.
Good idea, take your time.
The ears are there now.
Nice work, you did it well. Do you want to draw a tail?
Yes, I want a long tail.
A long tail will look great. I do not know what color you will pick.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I tried to build the tower, but it fell down. I do not want to do it again.
That is very hard to feel. Do you want to try with just two blocks first?
Just two blocks? I might be able to do that.
I think you can do it. What color block would you use?
The red one is my favorite.
Great choice. You are very brave for trying.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you keep the old toys on the shelf?
I keep them there so we can see what people played with a long time ago. Do you like playing?
Yes, I do. Why are the pictures in the dark room?
It makes the bright colors look very clear. Do you like bright colors?
I do. Why does the door make a loud sound?
I do not know for sure. Maybe it is just a little old.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see many cakes, but I do not know which one to pick.
Do you like sweet or sour tastes?
I am not sure, and I want to go with my best friend.
You can ask for a small piece of each to try. Is your friend here with you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did I fail my test?
You missed many easy words. Did you read the words out loud?
No, I just looked at the paper.
Looking is not the same as thinking. Do you understand the hard parts now?
Not really, they look like a wall.
That wall is just words we will break down. Can we start with the first one?
Yes, please help me.
We are building your power now. Ready for the next word?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late, what should I eat?
You could try a sandwich. Do you like meat or just cheese?
Meat please, but I have no time.
A cold cut sandwich is very fast. Is your desk close to the store?
It is right next door, thank you.
That is great, go now. Do you want a small fruit cup?
Yes, that sounds perfect, bye.
Have a nice lunch.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why won't my bread grow? I feel so sad.
Do you have warm water for the yeast? It needs heat to work.
Yes, the water is warm.
It needs time to make bubbles. Are you watching the clock?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad because the snow has stopped falling and my pile is still small.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you see any snowflakes drift down just now?
No, the sky is just white and empty and it feels very lonely out there.
That sounds a bit cold and quiet. Do you have a warm drink to help you feel cozy?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Can I send a letter to my grandma today?
Yes, you can put it in the box right there. Do you have a stamp?
I have the letter, but I do not have a stamp.
That is okay, we can give you one right now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I feel sad today. My dog bit the picture frame.
Oh no, that is very upsetting. What did the frame look like?
It broke into two big pieces. I miss the picture of my cat.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have other photos of your cat?
Yes, I have a box of old ones. I will look later.
That sounds like a good plan to help you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the fish stay near the bottom?
They like the warm spot. Do you see the heater?
I see it. But why do they wiggle their tails so fast?
They are swimming to get food. Do you want to feed them?
Yes. Why are they not looking at me?
They are busy eating. Do you hear the little crunch?
I hear it. Why is the water so clear?
The filter cleans it for them. Do you want to check the filter?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad when the leaves fall off the trees. Why do they have to leave?
It feels like a change, does it not? The trees drop leaves to save energy for winter rest.
Do they come back next spring?
Yes, new green ones grow when it gets warm. Do you like the fresh green leaves?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red rose on my walk today.
That sounds nice. Is it a new bush?
Yes, my mom planted it last spring.
It must look very pretty now.
I almost touched it, but it had a thorn.
Oh no, did it hurt you?
No, I just pulled my hand away fast.
Good for you. Have a good rest.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to do on my holiday. The weather is very hot.
That can be hard. Do you like the water?
I like the water. I have a pool at my home.
Swimming is a great plan. Do you have any friends to join you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the big boat stay up on the water?
The water pushes up on the bottom of the boat to help it. Do you like water games?
I like it a lot. But why does it not sink?
The boat has lots of empty space with air inside. That helps it stay high.
So the air helps?
Yes, the air makes the boat lighter than the water. Is that fun to think about?
Yes, it is!
I am glad you learned something new today.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Where is the mail slot?
It is just on that big red wall to the left. Are you sending a birthday card?
Yes. How much does it cost?
It costs one dollar.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made warm toast with butter this morning.
That sounds very tasty. What did you put on it?
Just a little bit of sweet jam.
I do not know if I like jam. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I love sweet things in the morning.
I think sweet food feels good. Do you drink tea with it?
Yes, I have a big cup of hot tea.
That sounds like a happy start to the day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. The ring is in my bag.
Your bag is in the car. Do you need help?
The car is not there. I lost the keys.
Look under your coat. Is it warm out?
Yes, it is warm. The keys are here.
Good. Run to the car now.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you know if this bus goes to the park?
Yes, it does. Is the park near your home?
No, it is far away. Do I need a ticket?
You need a ticket. Do you have one ready?
I think I do. Will you check for me?
I can help look.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my letter. I am so sad.
That is very sorry to hear. Did you look in your bag?
I looked everywhere. It is gone.
Let us ask the staff. Do you have the receipt?
No, I threw it away. Why did I do that?
It happens sometimes. We can try to help you anyway.
Really? You will help me?
Yes, I will try my best. Let us go to the counter now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a bird stuck in the net. It is crying. What should I do?
You should call a bird helper right now. Is it hurt badly?
I do not know if it is hurt. My hands are shaking.
Please stay calm and wait for help. Do you have a soft towel nearby?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad to be here.
That is lovely to hear. Do you like the quiet books?
Yes, I love reading here.
Good. Is it a good day to read?
The sun is shining outside.
That sounds nice. What book do you pick?
I want a story with a dog.
Dogs are fun friends. Do you like the dog in the first book?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I messed up the blue. It looks like muddy water.
It happens to everyone. What color did you mix it with?
I do not know. I just want to throw it away.
Do not throw it yet. Let it dry first.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the moon. It looks so lonely up there in the dark sky.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like looking at the stars?
The stars are bright, but the moon is just a big, cold rock. It feels empty.
It is true that the moon is a rock. Do you think it misses the Earth?
I bet it does. We are here, but it is stuck far away. I wish I could visit it.
That is a sweet wish. Do you like drawing pictures of space?
I draw it with a frown on its face. It looks so sad to me.
You can change how it looks. Does a smiling moon make you happier?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to jump on my bed.
That sounds like so much fun. Do you jump all day?
Not all day, just when I feel happy.
I like that. Happy jumping is a great way to play.
Do you like jumping too?
I cannot jump, but I love hearing about it. What is your favorite spot to jump?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The sky is very dark and loud.
I am sorry it is scary. Are you safe inside?
Yes, I am in my bed.
That is a good place to hide.
The thunder went boom again.
It sounds very close. Do you like rain sounds?
Not really. I want the storm to stop.
I do not know when it will end.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad and scared about tomorrow.
That is a heavy feeling to carry. Do you want to share what makes you worried?
I am going to a new school, and I might not find any friends.
It is normal to feel nervous about changes. What is one small thing that makes you feel safe?
Holding my stuffed bear helps me feel better.
That is a kind way to comfort yourself. How do you feel when you hold your bear?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am painting a blue cat.
A blue cat? That is very creative. What is it doing?
It is sleeping on the moon.
What a peaceful place for a nap. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, it feels cool and calm.
Colors can make us feel things. Is the cat happy?
I think it is dreaming of fish.
Fish would be a tasty dream. Do you want to add any more fish?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a cold, but I feel great today!
That is good to hear. What is making you feel so well?
I drank warm soup and it helped a lot.
That sounds nice. Do you like the taste of the soup?
Yes, it is my favorite kind right now.
I am glad you feel better.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am waiting for my friend. Is it taking long?
It might feel long, but time is just time. What are you doing while you wait?
I am looking at the sky. The clouds are funny. Do clouds fall down?
No, they float up high. Why do you think they look funny?
They look like dogs. I like dogs. Can we get a real one?
We can, if you have a home. Do you have a yard for a dog?
Yes, I have a yard. It is big. Should I go tell my mom?
Yes, you should ask her. Will you call me when you have an answer?
I will tell her now. I hope she says yes. Thanks for talking.
You are welcome. I hope she says yes too.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because my teacher gave me a star.
That is great news! What did you do to earn the star?
I helped clean the board and was very kind to my friends.
Helping others is a wonderful thing to do. I did not know what else you did, but that sounds nice.
I plan to read my whole book for fun before bed tonight.
Reading for fun is a great way to relax.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my cat meow at the door?
It likely wants to come inside or go outside. Does your cat have a favorite room?
Yes, it likes the bedroom.
That makes sense as it is quiet and warm there. Is it a morning or a night cat?
It comes at night.
It may be hungry or wants to play before bed. Have you tried giving it a treat?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the island feels so far away.
It is far. What is your main worry?
I am afraid I will get lost on the beach.
The sand is clear. Have you seen the path?
No, and I feel very alone now.
You are not alone. I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does a circle have no corners?
A circle is round, so it never stops to turn a corner. Do you like to roll balls?
What makes a square have four sides?
I am not sure why nature chose four, but it helps them fit together perfectly. Do you like to build blocks?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to throw a party for my birthday. What should I do first?
Pick a date and a fun theme. Who is coming?
My friends and cousins. The theme is dinosaurs. What food do I make?
Try making simple popcorn and fruit bars. Do you like cooking?
Yes, I do. What game should we play?
A treasure hunt is always a hit. Where is your house?
It has a big backyard. Can we dig for toys?
Yes, hide them in the dirt. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to level the ground first?
A flat base stops the floor from tilting. Do you have a long board to check this?
Yes, I do. Why is the wood called "treated"?
The chemicals keep worms from eating it.
Why are those nails so long?
They hold the pieces tight against the wind. How thick are your walls?
They are thin. Why does the roof need to slope?
Rain runs off fast on a slope. Do you have a hammer?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad and scared about tomorrow.
It is okay to feel that way. What makes you most nervous?
I am worried I will fail the big test.
That is a common fear. Do you think you studied well?
I think so, but I am still scared of the result.
You should trust your hard work. Take a deep breath to help calm down.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know where to start with all this mess.
Start by putting toys on the floor. Do you have a toy box?
Yes, I have a big red box.
That is a good place for them. Put the small ones in first.
What do I do with the books on the table?
Put them on the low shelf near you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a big blue lake today and it looks so calm.
That sounds very peaceful. Did you see any ducks?
Yes, there were many ducks floating on the water.
Oh, how nice. Do you want to sit by the shore?
I do. I just want to watch the water move.
That is a lovely way to relax. Is it quiet there?
It is very quiet, just the sound of the wind.
That must feel very good. Do you have a drink with you?
Yes, I have a warm cup of tea in my hand.
That sounds perfect for a cool day. Enjoy your time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like apples but I do not know how to keep them fresh.
That is a sweet taste. Do you like red ones or green ones?
I like the red ones because they are sweet.
Put them in the cold place in your house.
Will that make them last a long time?
Yes, it helps them stay crisp. Do you eat the skin too?
Yes, I eat the whole fruit.
Good for you. It gives you strong bones.
That sounds like a good reason to eat them.
I think so too. Enjoy your snack.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sitting by the water but I do not know what to do next.
That is a quiet and good place. Do you like the sound of the waves?
The sound is nice but I feel too cold to stay here.
A warm coat would help. Do you have one in your bag?
I do not have a coat but I have a dry towel.
You can wrap it around your shoulders. Do you want to sit on the warm rocks?
Yes, the rocks feel good. Thank you for your help.
I am glad you are warm now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. What made you sad?
My dog ran away.
That is a big loss. Do you know where he might be?
No, I do not.
I do not know where he is either. Did you call his name?
Yes, but he did not come.
Sometimes it helps to rest a bit. Would you like to sit with me?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why do leaves fall now?
The days get short and cold. Do you like the wind?
No, I just need the why.
The tree rests to save energy. Is the park nice?
I am going now.
The tree makes the leaf drop. Have a safe ride.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My grandpa is very old and likes to sit in his chair.
That sounds cozy. What does he like to eat?
He loves sweet cakes, but he does not eat them all.
He is being smart to save some for later. Does he help you bake?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel bad. I have a cold. I must go.
Rest is good. Do you have a fever?
No fever. Just a sore throat.
Drink warm soup. It helps.
I will try. I am in a rush.
Take time. Are you eating well?
Not really.
Eat a banana. Go now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went for a walk in the park today.
That sounds nice. Did you see any dogs?
Yes, I saw a big brown dog.
Was the dog friendly?
It barked at me, but then it stopped.
It seems it just wanted to say hello. Did you feed it?
No, I did not bring any food.
That is a good choice. I am glad you are safe.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the blue pencil in the store?
Yes, we have many blue pencils. Do you like drawing?
I like to draw big cats.
That sounds fun. Are there cats in the store?
No, I do not see any.
I am sorry, I do not know.
Okay, I will just buy the pencil.
Good choice. Happy drawing!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My tent broke. I am sad.
That is bad luck. Did you see where it tore?
Yes, the front side.
I do not know how to fix it, but a patch might work. Do you have a patch?
No, I lost it.
Let us look together.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the snow white?
It is white because the ice pieces reflect all the colors of light. Do you like to make a snowman?
Yes, I want to build a big one.
That sounds like a lot of fun.
But it is very cold outside.
You should wear your warm coat and hat. Is your sled packed?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got home from a fun trip by train!
That sounds like a great way to see the world. What did you see out the window?
I saw many green hills and a big red cow.
A cow is always a fun surprise. Did you get to stretch your legs?
Yes, I walked around a bit to stay awake.
Moving around helps you feel better. How long was the ride?
It took about three hours in total.
Three hours is a nice amount of time. Did you read a book?
I read two of them and ate some snacks.
Reading and eating sounds like a happy way to spend time. I hope you are feeling refreshed.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My chair is broken and I am very sad.
I am sorry about that. Is one leg loose?
Yes, it wobbles a lot.
You can tighten the screw. Have you tried that?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love the song I am listening to right now.
That sounds great. What kind of song is it?
It is a happy tune about a sunny day.
I am glad you are feeling good. Does it make you want to dance?
Yes, my feet want to move all the time.
That is wonderful. What song do you like next?
I do not know yet. I am still looking.
Take your time to find the right one.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The wind is blowing so hard and the trees are shaking.
That is a strong storm, but you are safe inside. Do you like the sound of the rain?
I see big flashes of light outside. Is the sky going to break?
No, the sky is just making thunder. It is just loud air moving.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished drawing a big red sun. It is so bright and warm.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What color did you use for the sky?
I used a light blue for the sky. Do you like it?
Yes, that is a happy choice. It matches the red sun well.
I am glad you think so. I want to give it to my friend.
That is a very sweet gift. Will you draw something new next?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I catch a butterfly?
Use a net with a wide opening. Do you have a net at home?
No, I do not.
You can make one from a hula hoop and light cloth.
Can I hurt the butterfly?
Please do not squeeze it. Are you trying to free it later?
Yes, I will put it in a box.
Make sure the box has air holes.
Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. I hope it flies free.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I caught a tiny fish in the pond.
That is a great start! Do you know what food it likes?
I think it likes worms from the garden.
Worms are a good guess. Did it pull hard when you reeled it in?
No, it was very small and light.
That sounds easy to catch. What will you do with it now?
I will let it swim back into the water.
That is a kind thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here, but I do not know what to eat.
That is okay. Do you like meat?
I think so, but I am not sure.
What kind of meat do you like?
I like chicken, but maybe I want fish.
Fish is good for you. Do you want it grilled?
Yes, I do. The menu is very long.
Take your time. You will find it.
Okay, I will try the fish.
That sounds great. Enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost and need to send a letter.
That is easy. Do you know where you are standing?
I see a small building with a flag.
That is likely the post office. Are you ready to go inside?
I do not know what to do next.
Walk in and find the line. Do you have the letter with you?
Yes, I have the letter in my hand.
Good. You just wait for the door to open.
The door is open but I am scared.
It is safe and quiet. Do you want to go in now?
Okay, I will go in and send it.
That sounds great. You will be fine.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Where is the big room?
It is right over there. Do you need a pen?
Yes, I forgot it. How far is that?
It is just around the corner. I do not know how long it takes to walk there.
I must go now. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome. Do you have the right key?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do here.
It is very quiet, is it not?
Yes, it is very quiet.
Maybe you can just sit and watch the trees. Do you like trees?
I like trees, but I feel lost.
Let us walk slowly to the end of the block. Does that sound good?
Okay, I will try that.
Take your time, there is no rush. Are you happy now?
I think I am better now.
Good, let us keep walking.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a book to buy. I am late.
What kind of story do you want?
It must be fun. Hurry please.
Try the red one. Is that okay?
Yes. I must go now.
Good luck. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting so long.
That happens on big trips. Do you want to try a stretch?
It was very boring in the middle part.
Long rides can feel slow. What did you see out the window?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to send a letter to my grandma.
That is a nice idea. What is in the letter?
A drawing of my dog and a big heart.
She will love that. Do you have a stamp for it?
No, I do not have one.
I can help you buy one. Do you want me to show you where they are?
Yes, please show me.
Come this way, please.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see old bones.
That sounds fun. Do you like dinosaurs?
Yes, I love big teeth.
The dinosaur hall is on the top floor.
How do I get there?
Take the lift. Do you like going up high?
I am a bit scared of heights.
You can use the stairs. It is slow but safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: It is very hot outside today.
That sounds hard to take. Do you want to know how to stay cool?
Yes, please tell me.
Drink a lot of water and sit in the shade. Do you have a hat on?
No, I am bareheaded.
That is not safe. Find a hat or an umbrella for shade.
Okay, I will go inside now.
Good choice. Is your home cool enough?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did a great job on my drawing today.
That is wonderful to hear. What did you draw?
I drew a big, red apple for my mom.
She will surely be happy to see it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to take a picture of my cat.
Open the camera app on the home screen. Do you see the green circle?
I see it, but where is it?
It is usually on the bottom right. Tap it to take the shot.
I did it, but how do I look at it?
Tap the square with the picture in the corner. Did you get a good angle?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I make my tomatoes grow big?
Give them plenty of sun and water. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
Yes, the back garden is very bright.
That is a great place for them.
But the soil looks hard and dry.
You can add some compost to soften it. Have you ever tried this before?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a tricky puzzle with a missing piece. I am so happy to finally see it!
That sounds like a fun win. What color is the last piece?
It is a bright red square that fits right in the middle.
Wow, red is a good choice. Did you use the key?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now.
That is great to hear. What makes you feel this way?
I saw a robot dance today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did it move well?
It looked like it was having fun.
Robots can seem happy too. Do you like watching them?
Yes, they are very cool.
I am glad you think so.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to catch a crab on the beach. How do I do that?
That sounds like fun. Do you have a small bucket with you?
I have a bucket, but I do not know where to look.
Look near the wet sand close to the water. Have you seen a small hole?
I see many holes, but I am afraid of being pinched.
Do not worry, they are usually shy. Try to place your hand slowly over the hole.
What if the crab runs away?
Then you must try again next time. Do you like to dig in the sand?
Yes, I like digging. Is this all there is to it?
Yes, that is all there is to it. Have fun finding your first friend.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Does the lighthouse need a pilot to fly at night?
No, it stands still on a rock. Do you see the beam of light?
Why does the light move back and forth?
It spins to help ships find the safe harbor. Is it spinning fast?
How does it keep burning all night?
The power comes from a battery or the grid. Do you hear the wind?
Will the light go out if the battery dies?
No, there is a backup plan. Is that a relief?
Thank you for explaining it to me.
You are welcome. Do you want to ask more?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to move today. It is very late.
That sounds hard. Do you have all your boxes?
No. I am missing the big ones.
You can use your old shoe boxes. Have you packed your food?
Not yet. I am so tired.
Eat something first. Do you have a helper?
No. I must do it alone.
That is too heavy. Would you like some water?
Yes. Please. I must go now.
Rest a bit. Is it safe to drive now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my cat groom its fur?
It cleans itself to stay tidy. Does it purr while it does this?
It always looks so proud after cleaning.
Being clean makes cats feel happy. Do you have any other pets at home?
Just the cat, actually.
That is fine. Why does it knead my blanket?
I do not know why it makes that noise.
I do not know for sure either. Is it your only cat?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very lonely today.
That feels heavy. Do you have a friend to talk to?
I do not know what to do.
Take a deep breath. It is okay to feel this way.
It is hard to reach out.
Start with a small step. Do you have a book nearby?
I am stuck in my head.
I cannot fix this for you. Can you take a walk?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very scared about the test tomorrow.
That is a normal feeling to have. What part of the test worries you the most?
I am afraid I will forget everything I learned.
You have studied hard, so your brain knows it. Do you want to try a quick review?
Yes, please. Can we just look at the big ideas?
That is a smart way to start. Let us look at the first main point together.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do boats sink if they get a hole?
Yes, water comes in and makes them heavy. Is your boat big or small?
It is a tiny toy boat.
Good, then it is safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Can I get a quick meal?
Yes, we can help. Are you hungry?
Yes, I am very hungry. What is fast?
The burger is quick. Do you like it?
I like it. Do you have fries too?
We have warm fries. Is that okay?
Yes, please. I need to go now.
Here is your food. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: It is so hot. I feel bad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Are you thirsty?
The sun is too bright. I want to hide.
That is a good idea. Do you have a fan?
No, my fan is broken.
That is frustrating. I do not know how to fix it.
I just want it to stop.
I hear you. How about a cold drink?
Yes, please.
That sounds nice. You will feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the bread get so big and fluffy?
Tiny bugs called yeast eat sugar and make gas. It makes the dough puff up. Do you like eating warm bread?
Yes, I do! What makes the gas?
The yeast makes bubbles of air. This helps the bread stay light.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The line is very long and I am late.
That is not fun. Are you in a hurry to send something?
Yes, it is a gift for my friend. Will it arrive on time?
I do not know for sure. Did you buy the stamp before you joined the line?
No, I forgot. I have no stamp now.
That is good news. You can buy one here quickly.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do fish have ears?
Yes, they do. Do you like to fish with your dad?
No, I have a fish in a bowl.
That is a very nice pet. What does your fish eat?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a secret for you.
That is a big surprise. What makes you happy about it?
I drew a picture of a dragon.
Oh, that sounds fun. Did you use blue crayons?
No, I used red and orange.
Nice colors. Can you show it to me?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see a bug with six legs. What is it?
It is likely an insect, yes. Do you like their little feet?
Yes, but it bit me on the hand.
That is not good. Please wash the spot with soap and water.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big white tower by the sea today.
That sounds like a lighthouse. Do you know what it is called?
Yes, it is a lighthouse with a bright light on top.
Wow, that is very cool. The light helps boats find their way.
I was so happy to see the bright flash at night.
I am glad you had fun. Did you see any stars too?
I did see a few stars in the dark sky.
That is a nice picture. The ocean must have looked calm.
The water was quiet and the air was cool.
That sounds peaceful. I hope you get to go back soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am lost and I want to read a map.
That is a good idea. Do you know which way is north?
I do not. How do I find it?
Look at the sun in the sky.
The sun is bright. How does that help?
It moves from left to right in the day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a big box. I do not know what to do with it.
That sounds fun. Do you know who gave it to you?
Yes, my friend did. But it is very heavy and closed tight.
You can open it together. Would you like to call your friend first?
I am afraid it will break. What if the thing inside is broken?
It might be okay. Do you have a soft towel to put inside?
Yes, I have a towel. So I should open it slowly and carefully?
Yes, that is a good plan. You can take your time and be safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so busy. I will not try again.
That is hard. Why did you stop?
I failed last time. It hurts.
I am sorry. You can rest.
No, I must go now.
Good luck. Be kind to you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go, but who is winning?
The blue team is leading right now. Are you watching from home?
No, I am running late for work.
That sounds very stressful. Do you like their style of play?
I just need to catch the bus.
I hope you make it on time. Do you usually play on weekends?
No, I only watch.
Watching is fun too. Good luck with your bus.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what day it is.
Is it sunny outside?
Yes, the sun is bright.
Then it is likely a weekday.
But what should I do?
I do not know your plans.
Maybe I will play.
That sounds fun.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The streets were so loud today.
That sounds very busy. Did you have a good time?
I saw a bus that looked like a giant box.
Oh, I love big buses. Do they stop often?
My shoes got wet from the rain.
Oh no, that is not fun. Are they dry now?
I bought a warm soup from a small shop.
Yum, that sounds nice. Was it hot?
Now I am home and very tired.
You worked hard today. I am glad you are safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need my phone, where is it?
Did you check your pocket?
No, I did not.
It is usually in your pocket.
It is not there.
Did you leave it on the table?
I do not know.
Let's look together.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I just want to run around.
That is a great feeling. What made you smile?
The sun is bright and the birds are loud.
Nature is a happy place. Do you see any blue sky?
Yes, it is very wide and clean.
A clean sky feels peaceful. Do you take a deep breath?
I breathe in slow and easy.
Slowing down helps you enjoy the moment. How does that make you feel?
It makes me feel calm and strong.
Patience helps you stay happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The sky is full of tiny lights.
Yes, they are stars. Do you see the bright one?
It is very white.
That is our closest star, the sun, but it is asleep now.
Can I touch them?
No, they are too far away. Do you want to find a big one?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just built my first shed!
That is great work. What color did you paint it?
It is blue with white trim.
Nice choice. Did you have fun working on it?
Yes, I loved every part of it.
I am glad you are happy.
I want to show you pictures soon.
I would like that.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my screen look so dim?
It may be on a low power setting. Is the room dark around you?
The room is bright, but the screen is still dim.
You can turn up the brightness on the side.
I do not see the button.
Look for a sun symbol on your keys. Do you have a laptop or a desk computer?
It is a laptop with a small sun key.
Press that key to make it brighter.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why is my plant so sad? I gave it water, but it is still droopy.
Water is not the only thing it needs. Did you put it near a sunny window?
No, I hid it in a dark corner. I just want it to be happy.
Sunlight helps it make food from water. Try moving it to a bright spot today.
But what if the sun burns its leaves? I do not want to hurt it.
You can start with some bright, but not direct, light. How does the soil feel when you touch it?
It feels dry and crunchy. I am worried I made a mistake.
Dry soil means it needs more water than you think. Do you use a pot with holes at the bottom?
Yes, there is a hole, but I am still afraid of doing it wrong.
You are trying your best, and that is good. Let us check the roots together if it does not improve.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I mixed up Monday and Tuesday. I feel so silly.
It happens to everyone. Do you like Mondays?
No. Mondays are hard. I hate the long week.
I get that. What is your favorite day?
Friday. I can finally rest. Thank you for listening.
You are welcome. Have a good rest.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red card on the floor today.
That is a lucky find. What else did you do?
I played a game with my friend.
Did you win the game?
No, I lost, but we had fun.
Fun is the best part of playing.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My dough is not growing. What can I do?
Are you in a warm place? Warm air makes the tiny bugs wake up and puff it up.
It is warm, but still flat. Is it broken?
I do not know for sure, but it may need more time. Do you see tiny bubbles in the dough?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I found a beetle on my shoe and I hate bugs.
That is okay. Do you like the color brown?
No, I think they are messy and I want it gone.
I am sorry to hear that. Would you like to toss it into the grass?
Just put it in a jar and I will look at it later.
A jar works well. What do you plan to call it?
I do not know. It looks shiny and weird.
I do not know its name. Does it have long legs?
Yes, and it is walking in circles.
It might be spinning. Can you open the window?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make the sky look blue in my photos?
Look at a clear part of the sky. Do you see any clouds there?
Yes, there are a few white ones.
Point your camera at a spot without clouds. This often helps the color.
That worked really well, thank you.
You are welcome. Do you like taking pictures outside?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the big green house near here?
Yes, it is just up the hill. Are you going to visit someone?
I need to find the red door. Is it close?
It is right next to the green house. I do not know if the door is open.
I will look now. Is there a shop nearby?
There is a small shop by the well. Do you need to buy anything?
No, I only need the house. Is the well safe?
The well is safe. Is the hill slippery for you?
I will run. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do plants drink water?
They need it to grow big and strong. Do you like drinking juice?
I do, but why does a plant not use a cup?
It pulls water up through its roots. Do you have any plants at home?
I have a small green one. Why is the water moving up?
It climbs up tiny tubes inside the stem. Can you see the roots?
The roots are brown. Why does the water stop at the leaves?
The leaves make food from the sun and water. Do you play outside?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I see the sun without hurting my eyes?
You should never look at it with your bare eyes. Do you have any dark sunglasses?
No, I do not have any.
You can watch how it moves by looking at your shadow. Do you stand outside at noon?
Yes, I stand in the grass then.
Your shadow will be short and point up. It is safe and fun to track.
I want to know where it is at sunset.
I do not know your exact spot, so I cannot say for sure. Do you know which way is west?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to walk, but I do not know where to start.
Start with a short walk near your home. Do you like parks or quiet streets?
I like quiet streets, but my legs hurt if I go too fast.
That is okay. Walk slow and take breaks when you need to. How far did you walk yesterday?
I walked for ten minutes, but I am not sure if that helps.
It does help your heart. Do you feel tired or happy after?
I feel a little tired, but also good inside. I am still unsure.
Feeling good is a great sign. What time of day do you like to walk?
I like morning, but I am afraid I will not have enough energy.
Start with just five minutes. Do you have shoes that feel comfy?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I love to bake cookies.
That sounds sweet. Do you like chocolate chip ones?
Why do they taste so good?
The sugar and fat make them tasty.
Why does sugar taste sweet?
It tells your tongue it is energy.
Why do I get hungry after baking?
Baking uses a lot of energy. Do you like the smell too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to play tennis, but I do not know where to start.
Grab a ball and a racket. Do you have any already?
No, I do not have any gear.
Buy a simple, light racket first. Do you have a court nearby?
Yes, there is one near my home.
Great, just go hit the wall. Do you play alone?
Mostly alone, yes.
Try hitting against a partner soon. Do you like solo practice?
I think I do, yes.
Keep practicing daily. Do you have a coach?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a new play today and I loved it.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What was the story about?
A big blue bear went to the moon.
Wow, that is a wild trip. Did the bear like it there?
Yes, he ate moon rocks and flew with jellybeans.
Yum, that sounds tasty. Did he bring any friends with him?
He took his little red truck to the moon.
A truck on the moon is cool. How did he drive it in space?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. All these boxes are heavy and I am sad to leave my old home.
I am sorry to hear that. Moving is hard work. What is the heaviest box you have to carry?
It is the box full of books. I do not know if I can lift it onto the truck.
You can ask for help with that. Do you have a friend coming to assist you?
Yes, my brother is here. I feel better now that you are talking to me.
I am glad to help. Take a deep breath. You are doing a great job today.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and saw a big dog.
That sounds fun. What color was the dog?
It was black with a white spot on its nose.
A cute mix. Did the dog have a name tag?
Yes, it said Max. I petted him.
I am glad you had a nice time with him.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel sad because my boss is very nice to me.
A kind boss is a good thing. Do you feel happy at work?
Yes, I do, but I worry he will leave soon.
That is a fair worry. Is there a way you can tell him you care?
I am afraid to speak up. What should I say?
Just say the words out loud. Do you have a good phrase ready?
Maybe I can just say thank you.
That is a true and sweet start. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The trains were so full today that I could not move my arms.
That sounds very tiring. Did you manage to get a seat?
No, I stood the whole way, but I saw a small dog with a hat.
A dog in a hat is a great sight. Did you smile at it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My legs hurt and my eyes are dry from this long flight.
That feels very bad. Do you want some ice water?
The food was cold and I missed my book.
I am sorry it was not nice. I do not know if more food is coming soon.
I just want to sit down and rest right now.
We are almost there, so you can rest soon. Are you glad we are landing?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My dog is not eating his food. What can I do?
Is he drinking water and acting normal? You can try mixing a little warm water into the food.
He is drinking water, but he seems sad. Should I be worried?
I do not know for sure. It is best to call your vet if he stays this way for a day.
Okay, I will call the vet if he does not eat tonight. Thanks.
That is a good plan. I hope he feels better soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love weekends.
That is great to hear. Do you like Saturday or Sunday better?
Saturday is my favorite day.
I am glad you told me. It is good to see you so happy.
The sun is bright and warm today.
Bright days are nice. Do you play outside when it is sunny?
Yes, I play outside all the time.
That sounds like fun. I do not play, but I like to listen.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My lights are very dim. What should I do?
First, check if the bulb is old. Do you have a spare bulb to try?
Yes, I have one. The fan is also slow.
That often means the dust is thick. Is the fan blade dirty?
It is very dusty. I want to clean it.
Unplug the cord first. Is it safe for you to reach the top?
I am too small. I need help.
Ask a grown-up to help you. It is always safer that way.
Okay, I will ask. The outlet sparks when I plug in.
Stop using that outlet now. I do not know why it sparks, so do not touch it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I really like my story about the little bear.
Bears are sweet. Do you read it before bed?
Yes, I do. I have one question.
Please tell me. What is your question?
Why does the bear always hug the moon?
It might be lonely. Does that feel true to you?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look! The leaves are dancing down. I am so happy to watch them fall.
That is a lovely sight. Do you know why the trees let go of their leaves?
I think they are just tired. Is it cold outside?
Yes, the air is getting chilly. Trees drop leaves to save water before winter sleeps.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited for the bus for a long time.
That can be very tiring. Did you see it arrive?
Yes, the driver gave me a big wave.
That is a kind gesture. What seat did you take?
I chose the window seat near the back.
You get a nice view there. Was the road bumpy?
It was smooth, but the city was busy.
Buses help us get through traffic. Did you enjoy the view?
I saw a cat sitting in a doorway.
That sounds like a sweet sight. Do you like cats?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so happy because I finished my hard task. What should I do with this feeling?
That is great. What was the hardest part of your work?
I think I should just enjoy it. Is it okay to be proud of myself?
Yes, being proud is a good thing. Enjoy your happy feeling.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the stars twinkle in the sky?
They twinkle because the air moves as their light travels to your eyes. Do you see many of them tonight?
Yes, there are so many!
The sky holds a few hundred stars you can see with just your eyes. Do you like looking up?
I do. Are they really that far away?
Yes, they are very, very far away. Do you think we can ever fly there?
I hope so one day.
That is a wonderful dream to have.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so tired thinking about moving my home.
That feels hard. Do you have a list of boxes?
No, I do not know where to start.
Let us pick just one room today. What room makes you most nervous?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I made a new friend today.
That is great news. What did you do together?
We played tag in the yard.
Fun! Do you like playing tag?
Yes, I ran very fast.
That sounds exciting. Did you win?
I won the first round, but he was quick.
Good try. You will get better with time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a sore throat and my nose is stuffed.
Do you have a fever?
No, my skin feels cool, but I feel tired.
Rest is very good for your body.
What should I drink to feel better?
Do you like warm water with honey?
Yes, it sounds good. Should I eat food?
Soft foods are kind to your throat.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the snow white and cold?
It is made of ice. Do you like to play in it?
I do. Why do people give gifts?
It is a way to say we care. Do you have a favorite toy?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: That movie made me feel very sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Was the ending unhappy?
Yes, everything went wrong.
That is a tough feeling to hold. Did you enjoy the actors?
I just want to forget it now.
Take a warm bath to relax. Do you like happy stories?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make the boat move?
Just pull the rope. Do you have a rope?
Yes, I do. What if it gets stuck?
Try to pull it gently. Is it stuck in mud?
No, just on a rock. How do I free it?
Push it with your hand. Is it a big rock?
Yes, it is very big. Can I drive it?
You can steer with the wheel. Do you know how to drive?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like the book about the blue whale.
That sounds like a fun animal. Do you like whales?
Yes. The whale is very big and kind.
Big whales are cool. What does your whale do?
It sings a long song.
Singing is nice. Is it a happy song?
Yes. It makes the fish dance.
Dancing fish are funny. Do you want to sing too?
Not yet. I just want to read it again.
Reading is good. I am happy you like it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My little sister dropped her ice cream on the floor.
Oh no, that is very sad. Did she have a clean one?
She cried for a minute, but then she found a blue dot in the floor.
A blue dot? That sounds like a fun surprise.
She ate the dot and now she is happy again.
I am glad she is happy now. Do you like blue dots?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today.
That is great to hear. What made you smile?
I saw a big, blue bird.
Wow, a bird. Did it sing a song?
Yes, it sang very loud.
That sounds fun. Do you like loud sounds?
I do, when they are happy.
I am glad for you. I do not know your name.
That is okay. I feel full of joy.
Me too. Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to paint a red apple today.
That sounds fun. Did the color look right to you?
It turned out a bit purple by mistake.
Oops, that happens a lot. Do you want to try again?
Yes, I have more paint and a fresh brush.
Great. I am glad you are happy.
The second apple looks much better now.
Nice work. I love how bright it is.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not know what time it is. The clock on the wall is broken.
That is a pity. Do you have another clock nearby?
I looked, but I cannot find one. I am late for school.
I am sorry to hear that. Can you guess if it is morning or afternoon?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke the cup. I am so sad.
Oh no. Did it make a loud sound?
Yes, it fell on the floor. I did not want that.
Accidents happen. Are you hurt?
No, my hand is okay. But the cup is gone.
That is good. We can buy a new one.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am going to get married soon.
That is great news. Who will you marry?
My best friend. We are very happy.
How kind of you to share. Will you have a big party?
Yes, we want a big dance.
A dance sounds fun. Will you wear a special dress?
Yes, it is white and bright.
It must look nice. What are you most happy about?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tell time on a clock?
Look at the big hand first. Do you know which hand is the big one?
The long one, yes. What does it tell me?
It tells you the minutes. The small hand tells you the hour.
So if the small hand is on the one, what time is it?
It is one o'clock if the big hand is on the twelve. Is that clear to you?
Yes, I think so. What if the big hand is on the six?
That is one thirty. Can you find the six on your clock?
I found it. Thanks for helping me learn.
You are welcome. I am glad you asked.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My baby is crying and I do not know why.
Is he hungry or does he need a new diaper?
I tried both but he still cries loud.
I am not sure, but try holding him close to feel safe.
He stopped crying when I held him tight.
That is good! Does he look sleepy now?
Yes, his eyes are heavy and he is still.
Then let him rest so you can sit too.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the fish always face left?
They like that corner because it feels safe. Do they eat their food?
Yes, they do. But why do they move so fast?
I do not know for sure, but they may need more room. Do they look happy?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my red pencil during math class.
That is very frustrating. Do you know where it might be?
I think I left it on my desk, but it is gone now.
You can ask your teacher for help. Have you checked your bag?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a bright red ladybug on my shoe today!
That is a lovely sight. Do you know what it will eat?
I think it will eat little bugs that hurt my plants!
You are right, they do help gardens. Do you have other small friends in your garden?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad today.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you want some warm tea?
No, I do not want tea.
I understand. Would you like a cup of coffee instead?
Coffee is too strong for me.
That is a good choice. What flavor of tea do you like?
I do not know.
Try plain hot water with a slice of lemon? Is that okay for you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to do math homework?
It helps your brain get strong. Do you like counting?
Sometimes. Why is it so hard?
Your brain is learning new things. That takes time. Are you stuck on a specific problem?
Yes, the long numbers.
Breaking it into small steps helps. I can help you break it down if you want.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel alone here. Why do I feel this way?
It happens when we miss friends. Do you have anyone nearby?
I do not know why the quiet is so loud. Does it hurt anyone else?
Yes, many people feel this way. Do you want to talk more?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have five apples but I do not know how to count them.
Just point to each apple and say the next number. Do you know the number after four?
I think yes, but my hand shakes when I try to point.
That is okay, take your time and breathe. Would you like to practice on your fingers first?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike like my old friend did.
That is a fun goal. Do you still have your bike?
Yes, I have it, but I am scared of falling.
Start on a flat path and hold the handlebars tight. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big yellow butterfly today.
That sounds lovely. Did it land on a flower?
Yes, it sat on my red shoe for a minute.
How fun that was. Do you know what kind of butterfly it was?
I do not know, but I felt very happy watching it.
That is a wonderful feeling.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I broke my friend's cup. I feel bad.
That is a kind thing to feel. Did you tell them yet?
No. I am scared they will be mad.
They might be a little upset at first. Do you have a drawing you could give?
Yes, I drew a flower for them.
A flower is a lovely gift. Will you ask for forgiveness?
I do not know the right words.
Just say "I am sorry." Is that enough for you?
Yes, that makes me feel better.
Good. Go say it now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad here. It is too quiet.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you hear a bird sing?
No, I do not hear anything. It feels empty and cold.
I do not know why it is so quiet. Would you like to sit with me?
Maybe that would help a bit. I am still unhappy.
We can just rest here. What makes you feel better?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is very hot today and I feel tired. What can I do?
Try to drink cold water and sit in the shade. Are you feeling dizzy?
No, I am just too hot. Do I need to buy a fan?
A fan helps if the air is dry, but it can make it hotter if it is wet outside. Do you know if it is humid where you are?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
The cars are gone for now. Is it your home street?
Yes, I live here. I like the silence.
Silence is good for rest. Do you sleep in the day?
Not much. I just watch the birds.
Birds are nice friends. What do they eat?
I do not know.
Many eat seeds. Do you have seeds?
I have some in a bowl.
That is very kind. Will you feed them?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a helmet on?
Yes, I am wearing one.
Great. First, sit on the seat and push with your feet.
How do I keep from falling?
Look ahead, not down. Is your bike steady?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at this big, brown horse. He is so happy!
He looks very strong. Does he like carrots?
Yes, he loves them! I just fed him one.
That is nice. You have a good heart.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the library today and found a big book about cats.
That sounds like fun. Did you sit down and read it?
I read for an hour, but then I got hungry.
Reading makes people hungry. Did you have a snack with you?
No, I did not. I had to walk home to get some bread.
Walking is good for you. Was the walk nice?
It was sunny and warm, but I missed my cat.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you bring a picture of the cat?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late for the park. Do you have a map?
I am sorry, I do not know the way. Do you need help with your bag?
No, I will run. Thanks for trying.
That is okay. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know how to add these big numbers.
Try adding one by one. Is it hard?
It is hard. What do I do?
Split the work into small parts.
Will that work for me?
Yes, take it slow. Do you have a pencil?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you know if we will have snow this winter?
I hope so. Do you like to build snowmen?
I do. How high will the trees get?
Very tall. Do you enjoy picking them up?
Not really. When is the big day?
December twenty-fifth. Do you want to help me cook?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a fluffy white cat.
That is very cute. Does he like to sleep?
He sleeps all day long.
Cats do love a good nap. What does he eat for lunch?
He eats dry food from a bowl.
That sounds like a healthy diet.
Yes, he is very happy and full.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water in the lake so quiet?
It feels calm because there is no wind. Do you like sitting by the water?
Yes. But why is it blue?
It is blue because the sky is bright above it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: There is smoke in my room. What should I do?
Stay low to the ground and crawl out. Is everyone else safe?
I do not know where to go.
Go to the front yard and call for help. Are you able to breathe?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the sun hot?
Yes, the sun is very hot. Do you like hot things?
No, I like cold ice cream.
Ice cream is good for a hot day. Do you eat chocolate?
Yes, I love chocolate.
Chocolate melts in the sun. Do you keep it in the fridge?
Yes, I keep it cold.
That is a good idea. Do you have a question?
Why is the sun bright?
The sun gives us light. Do you see it at night?
No, it is gone at night.
The moon comes out then. Do you like the moon?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost on the big ship. What do I do?
Look at the moon to find your way. Do you see the bright stars?
I do not see a moon or stars. It is very dark.
That is scary, but stay close to the warm wall. Can you hear the wind?
The wind is loud. It hurts my ears.
Hum a loud song to block the sound. Are you feeling safer now?
Yes, my song is loud. I feel okay.
Good. Keep singing and move to the center.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue boat on the lake today. It moved very slowly in the water.
That sounds like a nice sight. Did it have any people on it?
Yes, a few people were sitting on the deck. They looked happy to be on the water.
I am glad they enjoyed the ride. The boat has a very smooth shape.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I had a really scary dream last night. Why did that happen?
I am sorry you felt scared. Dreams often come from our busy minds. Did you dream about anything fun?
No, just a big dark room. Why does my brain pick dark things?
I am not sure of the exact reason. It might be how your mind sorts out the day. Did you sleep well after?
Yes, but I was still a bit tired. Why do we get tired from just sleeping?
That is a good question. Sometimes a restless mind uses up our energy. What did you eat for breakfast?
Just some toast and milk. Does food change my dreams?
I do not know for certain. But a full stomach can sometimes make dreams feel real. How are you feeling now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am looking at the map. Where is the blue part?
That is the big river. Do you see the bridge?
Yes, I see it. Is the red dot my house?
I am not sure about that. What color is your house?
It is blue. Why is the map green here?
The green is the park. Do you like to play there?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The lights went out and the hero fell off the bench. Was that meant to happen?
I do not know for sure, but it looked like a big mistake. Did the actor get hurt?
No, he was fine, but I was very scared. Do you like plays where the actors jump around?
I like seeing people act out stories. Do you want to tell me what happens next?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you like to build model boats?
I like how they float on the water. Do you like boats?
Yes. Why do they float?
Air is lighter than water, so they stay up. Are they hard to build?
A little. Why are they made of paper?
Paper is light and easy to cut. Do you have any boats?
No, not yet. Why do you think they are fun?
They teach me how things work. What kind do you want to make?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just learned a new word and I am so happy!
That is wonderful news. What word did you learn?
It is "joy," which means a very good feeling.
I like that word. Do you use it a lot?
Yes, I say it every morning when I wake up.
That sounds like a great habit. How does it make you feel?
It makes me feel warm inside and ready for the day.
I am glad it helps you. Do you want to learn more words?
Yes, please, I want to know how to say "thank you."
You are welcome. You are doing great work.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to hold the baby, but I am scared of breaking him.
You are very safe. Do you know how to use your hands?
I do not know. What should I do?
Put one hand under his head and the other under his bottom. Is his head resting on your arm?
Yes, he looks heavy. How do I lift him up?
Stand close to the bed and bend your knees to lift. Do you feel steady?
I am holding him now. What do I do next?
Just rock him gently. He looks happy to be with you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start a car?
Just turn the key and press the gas. Do you have a manual?
I found it, but the light is on.
That light means you are not plugged in. Is the battery dead?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am holding a ticket, but I do not know which door to use.
The number on your ticket tells you where to stand. Is the number on the front or the back?
It is on the back. I still feel lost.
Look for the matching number on the glass next to the door. Do you see it now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to count my toys right now, but I keep getting the wrong number.
That is tricky. Do you count them in small groups first?
Yes, I group them by five, but I always add extra five by mistake.
Try counting out loud to stay on track. Do you like counting by tens?
Tens feel too big for my head when I am this rushed.
You can slow down just for one second. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I told my friend I would help him, but I am very tired.
I am sorry you are tired. Do you like playing with your friend?
Yes, I do, but my legs hurt from running.
Your body needs rest. Would you like a warm drink?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so tired. The baby is crying. I must leave now.
Take a deep breath. You are doing great. How many hours did you sleep?
Only three. I need to pack my bag.
Grab the diaper and the milk. Is the stroller ready?
Yes, it is in the car.
That is good. Just breathe.
Can you hold the door?
I am holding it right now. Have a safe trip.
Thank you. I will be back soon.
We will save you a cookie. Drive safely.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the buns get so round?
The yeast makes them grow big and puffy. Do you like round shapes?
Yes, but why do they taste sweet?
The bakers add sugar to make them taste nice.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a magnet that sticks to the fridge. Why does it do that?
It likes metal very much. Do you know what else it sticks to?
I tried it on the plastic chair and it did not stick.
You are right, plastic is not a magnet friend.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to grow a big carrot in my box.
That is a fun idea. Do you have some dirt and seeds?
Yes, I have a bag of dirt and tiny seeds.
Put the seeds in the dirt and water them. Where is your box?
It sits on my windowsill by the door.
A sunny spot is perfect.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My head hurts so much from thinking. Why is work so hard?
It feels heavy when your brain is tired. Are you drinking enough water?
I think I am thirsty. Do I need to rest my eyes?
Resting your eyes helps a lot. Did you look at a screen all day?
Yes, I looked at the screen for a long time. Is that bad for me?
Yes, too much screen time can hurt your eyes. Would you like to close them now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How does a plant get its water?
The roots pull water up into the stem. Do you like to watch plants grow?
Yes, I do. But why does it need that much water?
Water helps the plant make food from the sun. Is your plant looking happy?
It looks a bit sad. Should I give it more?
I am not sure about your specific plant. Do you know what kind of plant it is?
It is a little fern.
Ferns like steady water, but not too much. Try to keep the soil damp.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for class. Did you see my red bag?
I did not see it. Did you leave it in the kitchen?
No, I left it in the yard. What should I do?
Run outside and look for it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big fish jump in the river today.
That sounds like a fun surprise. Did it make a big splash?
Yes, it threw water on my shoe.
Oh no, that is not very nice. Were you able to dry your shoe?
I put it in the sun for a while.
That is a smart way to fix it. Do you think you will see the fish again?
I hope so, but the water is moving fast.
The river is always busy. I hope your feet stay dry now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so mad. The cookie will not cook.
That is hard. Do you like warm cookies?
Yes, but they take too long.
I do not know how long your oven takes. Can you check the timer?
It says ten more minutes.
You must wait. Would you like to hold the spoon?
Okay, I will wait.
Good job. You are being patient.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to go camping with my friends.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What are you packing in your bag?
We have tents and lots of yummy snacks.
Snacks are always the best part. Do you have a map of the camp site?
Yes, we found a nice spot near the lake.
Living by water is very peaceful.
I cannot wait to see the stars tonight.
The night sky is always magic.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a lot of money in my pocket and I want to keep it for later. What should I do?
You can put it in a box under your bed. Do you like collecting stamps?
No, I do not. So, is putting it under the bed the only way to save?
No, there are many ways, like a piggy bank. I do not know your exact age.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great skill to learn. Do you like wearing sneakers?
Yes, I do. Can you tell me the first step?
You start by making a big loop with each lace. Do they look like bunny ears?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am lost. Where is the park?
I do not know where you are. Do you see any big trees?
Yes, I see a big tree and a red house.
That helps a lot. Please walk toward the red house.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a small robot in the yard. Should I take it inside?
That is a good question. Do you know if it is broken?
I do not know. It just sits there and does not move.
It might be sleeping or out of power. Have you tried plugging it in?
I did not think to do that. Maybe I should just leave it there for now.
That seems safe and kind. Are you sure you do not want to check the manual?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The clock says it is time for lunch, but I am not hungry.
That is tricky. Are you maybe just too full from snack time?
No, I ate an apple. Why does the clock tick so loud?
It tells us the time so we do not miss meals. Do you hear it in your room?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse today. I am so happy about it.
That sounds very fun. Did it have a long tail?
Yes, it wagged its tail a lot. It looked very calm.
Calm horses are nice. Do you think it wants a carrot?
I hope so. I want to go back and see it again.
I hope you get to go. What color is its mane?
It is black and shiny. I love that horse.
I am glad you are happy. I want to see it too.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did people build big stone walls long ago?
They built them to keep bad things out. Did you know some walls are still standing today?
Why did old people write with sticks and mud?
Paper was very hard to make back then. I do not know if they liked using sticks.
Why did ships have tall poles?
Those poles held sails to catch the wind. Do you like to fly kites in the wind?
Why do we remember kings and queens?
They made big rules for everyone to follow. I am not sure if all of them were good.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I met a new kid at the park today. He is very nice.
That is good to hear. Did you play together?
Yes, we played tag for a long time. He is very fast.
Fast runners are fun. What is your favorite game?
I like to jump on the swings. He likes the slide better.
Everyone likes different things. How do you feel now?
I am happy because I have a friend to play with tomorrow.
I am glad you made a new friend. Have a great day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I am going on a trip!
That is great news! What are you putting in your bag first?
I am putting in my warm socks.
Socks are very cozy. Do you have a favorite book to read on the bus?
Yes, I have my picture book about dogs.
Dogs are fun. Make sure you pack a snack too.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I did well on my test today.
That feels good to say. Did you practice hard?
Yes, I studied for a week.
Your work paid off. What was the hardest part?
The math questions were tough.
You still beat them. How do you feel now?
I feel very strong and proud.
That is a good feeling. Keep that confidence.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to draw a cat today, but its legs were too long.
That sounds like a funny start to your day. Did you fix the legs?
Yes, I cut them short. Now the cat looks like a happy dog.
Sometimes things turn out better than we plan. What color is the dog now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
