exchanges: I want to paint the sky blue, but I do not know where to start.
That is a great choice. Do you have a brush?
Yes, I have a big brush and some paint.
Good. Dip the brush and make a mark up high. Do you like round lines?
I like round lines. Should I go from left to right?
You can go any way you like. Does the blue feel happy?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to paint my wall blue, but I am scared I will mess up.
You can fix small spots with a brush. Do you have any old paper to practice on?
I do have some paper, but what color do I need first?
Start with a light gray wash. What size is your brush?
It is a medium brush. Is that good for the whole wall?
Yes, it works well for big areas. Do you like soft blue or dark blue?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a lot of toys to put in boxes.
That sounds like a big job. Do you have a friend to help you?
My sister is here, but I do not know where to put my blocks.
You can put the blocks in a strong box. I do not know where your new room is, but that is where they should go.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. The movie made me cry.
That is a good sign. Did you like the ending?
No. The dog died at the end.
I am sorry about that. I do not know if it is true, but dogs are loved.
I just want a happy story.
You are being kind to your heart. What makes you feel better?
I need to talk to someone.
I am here for you. Do you want to pick another film?
Yes, please. I am ready now.
Good luck with your choice.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big bear near the creek today.
That sounds amazing. Did it look friendly?
Yes, it was just drinking water and eating berries.
Good bears are great. Do you like watching animals?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to get for lunch.
What kinds of food do you like?
I am very hungry and need something fast.
A sandwich is a good choice. Do you like meat or just vegetables?
I think meat is better today.
A turkey sandwich is quick and tasty.
That sounds good to me.
Great! I hope you enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was bright, but the house felt very quiet.
That can feel heavy. Do you like quiet days?
Not today. I ate lunch alone at the table.
I am sorry. What did you eat?
Just toast. I talked to the cat a lot.
She must be a good listener. Did she purr?
Yes, she did. But I still felt small.
That sounds hard. Can we sit with you?
I hope so. The dark is coming soon.
I am here. What do you see out the window?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work. I have no time to walk.
Walking helps your heart. Do you have ten minutes?
I only have five minutes left.
Even five minutes is good. Do you like fresh air?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a song I love. Can I tell you about it?
Yes, I would love to hear about it. What is the song about?
It is about a happy bird. The bird flies in the sun.
That sounds very cheerful. Does the bird sing?
Yes, it sings a very loud tune. I feel warm when I listen.
That is a nice feeling. Thank you for sharing that with me.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The bus took a long time today.
That sounds tiring. Did you sit by the window?
I watched the trees go by.
Nice view. Do you like looking out?
The next bus missed its stop.
Oh no. You must be very tired.
I walked to the park instead.
A good choice. Did you see any ducks?
I just sat on the grass.
That is restful. I hope you feel better now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my cat chase its tail?
It is a game that makes them feel fast. Does it stop when you clap?
It stops if I make a loud noise. Why?
Loud sounds scare them, so they freeze to check for danger. Is your cat scared of rain too?
Yes, it hides under the bed during thunder.
Hiding keeps them safe when they feel upset. Do you let it come out after?
I try, but it is too slow. Why is it slow?
Being scared slows their brain down. Do you offer a treat to help?
It likes treats, but I am not sure if that works.
I do not know if treats always help with fear. Do you try playing with it first?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see a bright color bar in the sky after the rain.
That is a rainbow. It looks like a big curved smile. Do you like the colors?
Yes, it is very pretty. What makes it happen?
The sun shines on water drops in the air. The light bends and splits into colors. Is it warm or cool outside?
It feels cool now. Why is the middle part often green?
Green is where blue and yellow light meet. It is a happy mix. Do you remember the order?
Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet.
You know them well! That is a lovely list to remember. Let us watch it fade.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do trees drop leaves in the fall?
They do it to save energy for winter. Do you like looking at the red leaves?
I do like them. What do they do in the dark?
Most trees sleep and rest. Do you think trees can dream?
I am not sure. Do they eat food?
No, they make their own food from light. Do you know how they do that?
I guess they use the sun. Is that true?
Yes, they use sunlight to make sugar. Do you like eating sweet things?
I love fruit. Do trees need rain to grow?
Yes, water helps them grow big. Do you water your plants?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I heard a song today. It makes me feel very glad.
That sounds nice. What kind of song is it?
It has a fast beat. I want to dance to it.
Dancing is a great way to feel good. Do you know the name of the song?
Yes, it is my favorite tune. I play it often.
I am glad you like it. How long does the song last?
It is short and sweet. It ends before I am bored.
A short song is easy to remember. Do you share it with your friends?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My fence is broken. I do not know how to fix it.
That sounds hard. Is the wood still strong?
Yes, but I am not sure if I should paint it too.
Painting can help. Do you like bright colors?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am reading my favorite book under the lamp.
That sounds cozy. Do you like the end?
Yes, the hero finally gets home safe.
How wonderful for him. Does the moon shine in your window?
It does, and the light is soft.
I am glad you are happy. Is the story long?
Not much left, just a few pages.
Good night, then.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn a new language but I am lost.
That is a big step. Which language do you like best?
I do not know. I just want to start.
Try listening to a song in that language. Do you have one in mind?
No, I have no idea where to start.
Pick any word you know and type it in. Is that okay for you?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I want to tell you how plants drink.
That is great! Do you know why?
Their tiny roots suck up water from the dirt.
Nice! Is it like using a straw?
Yes, it goes up the stem to the leaves.
I did not know that!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights just went out and I do not know why.
Did you check if your bill is paid? Is the plug in the wall?
The plug is in, but I am still afraid to touch the box.
That box is scary, I admit I do not know your exact setup. Is there a red light on it?
Yes, there is a red light, and I do not feel safe.
Please call a helper, do not touch it yourself. Are you sitting on the floor?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I hurt my arm and need to see a doctor. How do I make an appointment?
You can call the office or use their website. Do you have a favorite way to call?
I usually use my phone. What do I say when they answer?
Just say you need to see a doctor for an arm injury. Do you have a specific day you want to go?
I want to go tomorrow morning. How do I get there?
You can drive or take a bus. Is your car ready to go?
Yes, the car is fine. What should I bring with me?
Bring your ID and any insurance cards. Do you know where your cards are kept?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the king so small?
It is the most prized piece, so its shape is unique. Do you like its shape?
Why can the king only move one square?
It moves slowly to stay safe from danger.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to be a sailor, but I am scared of the big waves.
Do you like the smell of the sea? Sailors get used to the waves with time.
Yes, I love the salt air, but I do not know how to start.
You can read books about ships first. Is that something you have done?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the room?
It is on the top floor. Do you need a map?
No time. Just the elevator.
It is by the desk. Is it fast enough for you?
Yes. Thanks for the help.
Go now. It is right there.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Can I just throw seeds in the dirt?
No, that is not safe for the plants. Do you have a sunny spot?
Yes, but the soil looks dry. What do I do?
Add some water to make it damp. Do you have a bucket?
It is raining right now, so I am good.
Rain is very good for new seeds.
Great. I have to run now. Bye.
Good luck. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The line at the fruit stand was very long.
That sounds frustrating. Did you end up buying anything?
No, I left before I got to the front. Now I have no apples.
I am sorry about that. I do not know if the next market will be less crowded.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now, but tell me fast. Do bees have teeth?
No, they do not. Do you like honey?
I cannot wait to ask more. Do lions sing?
No, they roar. Is that your favorite sound?
I must run. Do whales have hair?
No, they have thick skin. I do not know if all have hair.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: Why does the big ship not sink?
It pushes water down. Does it feel light to you?
I do not know. Is it easy?
Yes. The water pushes it up. Do you have a boat?
I need help. Is it hard?
Not hard. It just floats.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I put up my tent by the big tree today.
That sounds like a great spot. Did you see any animals?
I saw a big bear! I ran back to my tent fast.
You were very smart to stay safe. Was it far away?
It was eating berries near my fire.
Bears like sweet food. Did you wave to say hello?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do robots look so different from us?
They are built with metal and wires, not skin and bones. Do you like how they look?
Do they feel cold when it is winter?
No, they do not have feelings or body heat. Is that better or worse for you?
Can they really think like people do?
They follow rules to act smart, but they do not truly think. Do you think that is a good thing?
Will robots ever be my best friend?
They can help you, but they cannot love you. I hope you enjoy your real friends.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the apple red?
It gets red when it is old. Do you like sweet apples?
I do. Why is the fish wet?
It lives in water, so it stays wet. Do you want to buy one?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I find a book on space?
You can look at the astronomy section. Do you like rockets or stars?
I like stars. How do I get a card?
Go to the front desk and ask for a library card. Is it your first time here?
Yes, it is. What if I lose the card?
We can make a new one if you bring an ID. Are you worried about losing it?
Not really. How long can I keep the book?
You can keep it for two weeks. Do you have a lot of homework?
Yes, I do. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun reading.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to leave soon. How do I play?
Just draw a card. Do you like red suits?
No. I want to win fast.
Take the highest card. Are you playing with friends?
Yes, but I am late.
Show your top card. I do not know your other cards.
I have an ace.
You win this hand. Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my phone is broken.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you drop it?
It fell on the floor and now the screen is black.
That sounds very bad. Do you have a backup copy of your pictures?
I do not know if I have a backup. I just want my phone to work again.
I do not know how to fix the screen. Did you buy a phone case?
No, I did not buy a case. I am really angry now.
It is okay to feel angry. Take a deep breath with me.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a red circle in my hand.
A circle goes round and round. Do you like the color red?
Yes, I do. It looks like a pizza.
That is a very tasty shape. What else can you find?
I see a blue square on the floor.
A square has four flat sides. Is it hard or soft?
It is a hard toy. It has sharp corners.
Be careful with those points. Can you find a triangle?
Here is a yellow triangle.
It has three pointy tips. It looks like a slice of cheese.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. How can I fix it?
Drink some water and rest your eyes. Are you feeling dizzy too?
Yes, I feel quite dizzy. What should I eat?
Try some light crackers or soup. Do you have any medicine?
I have pain pills in my bag. Is it okay to take them?
Yes, take one with water if you need to. Does the pain get worse in the morning?
It is bad every morning. How do I stop it?
I do not know why it happens every day. Please see a doctor soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see little bugs on the window glass.
Those are raindrops hitting the glass. Do you like rainy days?
The sound goes pitter patter all day long.
It sounds like a soft drum beating. Is it warm or cold outside?
My feet are wet and yucky on the floor.
Oh no, let’s find some dry socks for you. I hope your toes feel cozy soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lights are bright and the house feels warm. I am so happy.
That sounds lovely. Do you like how clean the air feels?
Yes, the fresh breeze makes me smile. I feel very good.
Wonderful. I do not know why, but I am glad for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am lost and need to catch my train.
That sounds scary. Do you have your ticket?
Yes, but I do not know where the gate is.
I do not know your station. Is there a sign nearby?
Yes, it says "Exit" above my head.
Great. Walk to that door.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is waiting so hard to do?
It is hard because we want things now. Do you know what patience is?
Is it like waiting for cake to cool?
Yes, that is a good example. It takes time, but the result is better.
How do I get better at being patient?
Take slow breaths when you feel rushed. Do you think you can try that?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I like to sing, but I do not know what kind of music I should play.
Music is fun for everyone, so you can try many things. Do you like to dance when you listen to songs?
Yes, I dance a lot, but I also like to sit still and think.
That is very interesting. Do you prefer loud drums or soft piano sounds?
I am not sure. Both sound good, but I do not know which one I can learn.
You can start with the one that feels easy to you. Is there a song you love that you want to play?
I like that old song my mom sings, but it is slow.
Slow songs are very peaceful and nice to learn. Do you want to share that song with friends?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing here but I do not know what to do.
You might dig a hole. Do you like wet sand?
Maybe, but the water looks cold to me.
It can be chilly there. Would you just sit and watch it?
I think I will just look at the waves.
That is a good plan. Enjoy your time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the sky look so blue?
The light scatters on tiny things in the air. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do! Is it always that color?
It changes when the sun is low or when clouds come. Do you see any clouds today?
No, it is very clear. What makes the grass turn brown in winter?
The cold stops the plants from growing. Do you like the snow?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is it so hard to wait?
Waiting feels slow because we want things now. Do you like surprises?
Yes, I do. But why does waiting help?
It lets you get ready for what comes next. Have you ever waited for a good thing?
I have waited for food. Why is that good?
It makes the food taste better when it finally arrives. Is your tummy still hungry?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a cat in my garden today. It was chasing a red ball.
That sounds like a fun game. Did the cat catch the ball?
No, the ball went under the fence. The cat looked very sad.
Oh no, poor cat. Do you think it will come back?
I hope so. I want to give it a treat.
That is very kind of you. I do not know if it will return.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to write in my story.
That can be hard. Who is your main character?
It is a little dog who lives alone.
Tell me, what does the dog want most?
I guess the dog wants a friend.
That is a lovely start.
Now what?
I do not know the right ending, but you can decide.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a very old book in the park today.
That sounds like a fun find. Did it have pictures inside?
Yes, there was a big picture of a castle.
Castles are cool. Do you know who built that one?
I do not know, but it looked strong.
Stone walls keep people safe. That is a nice thought.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend. I do not know what to say.
That is a sweet idea. What is your friend’s favorite thing to do?
He loves to ride his bike. But I feel stuck on the first line.
You could start by telling him you miss him. Does he live far away from you?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at my sunflower! It is growing so tall. How does it drink water?
The roots pull water up from the soil. Do you see the roots?
Yes, they are big and strong. I am so glad to know that!
That is a nice thought. Plants love when you help them grow.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today to take pictures of the ducks.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you see any small ducklings?
I saw two tiny ones hiding behind a big rock.
I am glad you kept a good eye on them. Did you get a clear photo of the water?
Yes, the sun made the water look like shiny gold.
That must have looked very pretty. Did you walk along the pond for a while?
I did, but my battery ran out right at the best part.
Oh no, that is very frustrating. Do you often forget to charge your camera?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know what to do for my math homework.
That can be hard sometimes. What kind of problems are they?
I have to count the money in a picture.
Start by adding up the big coins first. Do you know what a quarter is worth?
Yes, it is twenty-five cents.
Good. Add those up, then add the dimes and nickels. Do you have a pencil ready?
Yes, I am writing them down now.
Great work.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Where do I find the fresh fruit?
Turn left at the bread stand. Do you like bananas?
Yes, I love them.
Great choice. They are on the left side. Is it for a snack?
Yes, just a small treat.
Sounds nice. The apples are next to them. Do you need a knife?
No, I have one.
Good. Enjoy your food.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad about my big meeting today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk about what is worrying you?
I am scared I will say the wrong words.
That is a natural fear. Have you prepared any notes?
Yes, but I might forget them.
Reading notes is a smart plan. Is your voice okay?
My voice is fine, but my hands shake.
Deep breaths can help your hands. Do you have a friend nearby?
No, I am all by myself.
That is tough. I do not know the exact details, but you are ready.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing here. I do not know which way to go.
That is okay. Do you like loud places or quiet ones?
I like the quiet street with the trees.
The trees are safe. Are you trying to get to your home?
My home is far away. I feel small and lost.
You are not lost. I do not know the map, but I can walk with you.
Please, walk with me for a bit.
I will stay by your side. Do you feel a bit better now?
Yes, the air feels fresh. I think I can find the sun.
Good luck on your path.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a yard but I do not know how to build a shed.
Do you have any wood already, or do you need to buy it first?
I do not have any wood, and I am not sure what to pick.
That is a good question, but I do not know your size needs, so I cannot tell you exactly.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is your boss so kind?
He helps me when I am stuck. Do you have a nice boss?
I think my boss is loud. Why is yours so quiet?
He listens more than he talks. Is that hard for you?
Yes, it is hard. Why do you like it?
It feels calm and safe. Do you like a calm job?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to pack my bag today.
That is great. What is your favorite thing to pack?
I love putting in my blue crayons.
Nice choice.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sea is so big. How deep is it really?
It is very, very deep. Do you like to swim in the water?
Yes, I love waves. What makes them move?
The wind pushes the water. Are you afraid of big waves?
Sometimes, but mostly no. Can I see the bottom?
Only if the water is clear and shallow. Do you like looking for shells?
I do. Are there animals in the sand?
Yes, many small things hide there. I do not know which ones you will see.
I will look closely. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have fun on the beach.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the ball round?
A round shape helps it roll and bounce. Do you like playing outside?
Yes, but I always kick it too hard.
That is just practice. Do you have a favorite team?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do robots look like people?
They look human to help us feel safe. Do you like robot movies?
What is inside a robot?
Wires, batteries, and a brain. What color is your favorite robot?
Can they really think?
I do not know for sure. They follow rules. Do you think they dream?
Are they faster than people?
Yes, they move very fast. Do you run fast?
Do you get tired?
I do not get tired like you do. Do you rest well?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big surprise for you today.
Oh, how lovely! Is it food?
Yes, we are going on a picnic.
That sounds fun. Where are we going?
We are going to the park.
Great! What are we bringing?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel very happy today and I want to tell you about it.
That is wonderful to hear. What made you feel so good?
I helped my neighbor carry her groceries home.
That was a very kind thing to do. Did she say thank you?
Yes, she gave me a big smile and said I was a good friend.
Smiling back is a nice way to show kindness. Do you like making people smile?
I do love making people happy, but sometimes I forget to say please.
Remembering to say please is a simple but good habit. Do you want tips on remembering it?
Yes, please tell me how I can remember to be polite.
Try to think of being nice before you speak. Will you try that today?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do circles have no corners?
A circle is one smooth line that loops back to the start. Do you like drawing them?
I do. But why is a square made of four lines?
A square needs four straight sides to make its four corners. Do you like squares?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Where is my hat?
It is on the hook by the door. Do you have enough time?
I think so. Is the music good?
I am not sure, but I like the song. Is the food ready?
Yes, the cake is cold.
That is nice. I hope you have fun.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go, but who is winning right now?
The home team is ahead by one goal. Do you have a favorite player?
I cannot wait, I must go now.
Run fast and have fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Can you tell me if the moon is really made of cheese?
No, it is not. Do you like to look up at the night sky?
I like to look up, but it feels too big to see.
That is a good feeling to have.
Is it true that we can walk on the moon?
Yes, some people have walked there. What color is the moon to you?
It looks white and bright.
That is a nice way to see it.
Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. I am glad I could help you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very tired and my legs hurt. I want to stop walking.
That is a hard feeling to sit with. Do you mind if I ask why you think it hurts?
I just did not sleep well last night. I feel bad for giving up.
Rest is part of the work too. Would a short sit help you feel better?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not know how to start this letter. It feels very hard.
That can be tough, but you can start by saying how you feel. What is the letter for?
It is for my friend who moved far away. I miss him a lot.
Writing is a good way to share that feeling. Have you thought about what you want to say first?
I want to say we went to the park last week. But I feel sad it was only me.
That is a sweet thing to share. Do you have a happy memory to go with it?
Yes, we found a big rock and sat on it. Thank you for helping me.
You are doing a great job. I am happy to help you write it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The shirt I bought has a hole in it. I am very sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Can you show me the tag?
Yes, here it is. It says the place is closed today.
That is tricky. Do you have the receipt?
I left it on the kitchen table. I forgot to take it.
No worries. You can make a new one. Is your phone with you?
Yes, I have my phone. I can call them.
Good idea. When does the shop open again?
It opens tomorrow morning. I can go then.
That works. I hope the fix is fast.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: It is so hot today. I want ice cream.
The sun is very strong right now. Do you like strawberry or chocolate?
I like chocolate. I want a big one.
A big one will taste very sweet. Are you thirsty too?
Yes, I am very thirsty. My throat is dry.
Let us drink some cold water first. It will help you feel better.
Okay, I will drink water. Then I will go home.
That is a good plan. Enjoy your cool break.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to walk more, but I am not sure how to start.
Start with just ten minutes a day. Do you like to walk in the morning?
Yes, I like mornings. Is ten minutes really good for me?
Yes, even short walks help your heart. Do you walk with anyone else?
No, I usually walk alone. Should I try walking with a friend?
That can be fun and help you keep going.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost and I do not know where I am.
Do not worry, I am here with you. Where is the last place you remember?
I think I was near the big red tree.
That helps a lot. Can you see the red tree from here?
No, I cannot see it, I am very scared.
I am not sure where we are exactly, but we will find the way. Do you feel cold or hot?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what move to make next.
Your king is safe for now. Where is your enemy queen?
I am stuck in a hard spot.
I am not sure of the best path. Do you see an open square?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to read books well.
That is a great goal. Do you like stories about animals?
Yes, I love animal stories. How do I get better?
Read a little bit every day. Do you have a quiet place to sit?
I sit by the window. What else should I do?
Slow down if a word is hard. Do you like drawing pictures?
I draw a lot. Can that help me read?
Yes, it helps you remember words. Do you want to try a poem?
I would like to try a poem. Can you give me one?
I do not have a poem for you. Would you like a short song instead?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I found my new home. It has a big blue door.
That sounds lovely! Blue is a happy color. What else do you see inside?
There is a soft rug and a warm lamp.
Good for you to feel safe. I am glad this brings you joy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, my computer fixed the mess! I am so happy.
That is great news. Did you dance when you saw it?
Yes, I jumped up and down. Do you like computers too?
I find them very useful. What is your favorite part?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do sailors use ropes?
They use ropes to pull the sails tight. Do you like to play with string?
Why is the ocean so salty?
The rain washes salt from the land into the sea. I do not know why it stays there forever.
Why do ships go in the water?
The water is thick enough to hold up the heavy boat. Have you ever seen a boat float?
Why do sailors sing?
Singing helps them work together when lifting things. It makes their hearts feel warm and brave.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: It is so hot outside today. I do not feel well.
The sun is very bright right now. Are you thirsty?
I drank some water, but it is still too hot.
That sounds hard to handle.
I wish it would rain soon.
I hope the clouds come back. Do you like rain?
Yes, I love the sound of it.
A cool shower would help everyone.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I catch the rain in my hand?
Just open your palms wide to the sky. Do you like feeling the cold drops?
What is the rain made of?
It is mostly water that floats up as clouds. Do you know where the water comes from?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know what this song is called. I am running late.
I do not know the name, but I hear happy drums. Are you going to a party?
No, I am going to work. It is very important.
That is too bad, but I must help you. Do you like the sound of the guitar?
I like it, but I must go now. Thank you for trying.
I am glad I could chat for a moment. Have a safe trip!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got some very good news today.
That is wonderful! What is it?
We have a brand new baby boy at home.
Oh my, congratulations! Is he healthy?
Yes, he is very strong and healthy.
I am so happy for you.
Thank you, I am feeling very proud.
That is a great feeling. How is the sleep?
It is hard, but I do not mind.
I know that can be tough.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have neighbors?
Neighbors are the people living next to us. They can be friends when we are happy to share. Do you like playing outside?
Yes, I do. What do neighbors do all day?
They do many things like work or rest. Sometimes they help us if we need it. Is your neighbor kind?
I think so. Why do some people move far away?
I do not know the exact reason for everyone. Maybe they want a new home or a new job. Why do you think they move?
Maybe they want a bigger house. Do neighbors always talk to each other?
No, some people are shy and stay inside. Others like to say hello and chat. Do you wave to your neighbor?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I swim in the ocean?
You kick your legs and move your arms. Do you know how to float?
I think so. What else do I need?
You need to stay calm and breathe slowly.
Can I jump right in?
No, the water is deep and salty. Have you seen a lifeguard?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad. I got married today.
That is wonderful news. Do you have any special plans for the night?
Yes, we will dance all night long.
That sounds like great fun. I do not know the song you like, but I hope it is a happy one.
I am just happy to be with my new spouse.
What a sweet feeling. Do you want to share a cake with me?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad because the sun is gone. I miss the warm light.
I am sorry you feel that way. Does the dark make you feel lonely?
Yes, it does. I think the sun is angry at me.
The sun is not angry at you. It just sleeps at night. Do you like moonlight?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My bread did not rise. What did I do wrong?
Did you check if the yeast was still fresh?
I used new yeast, but it sat in a cold room.
Yeast needs warmth to grow, so it stayed asleep.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a new place to eat lunch today. The food was very warm and sweet.
That sounds nice. Did you like the taste?
Yes, it was good, but the line was very long. I had to sit and wait for a long time.
Oh, that is tiring. Did you get a warm drink?
I did, but I did not have a phone to play with. I just watched the people around me.
That must be hard. What did you see while you waited?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My teacher gave me a big smile today. I feel so warm inside!
That is lovely to hear. Did she do something special for you?
Yes, she let me keep the puzzle I made all year.
What a nice gift. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My phone is making a loud buzz. I do not know why.
Is it a text or a call? Can you check the screen?
It is dark. The screen is off and I cannot turn it on.
I do not know your phone type. Does the power button work?
I held the button down. Nothing happened at all.
Try holding it with the volume button. Do you see any lights?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you like the scary movie we saw?
Yes, it was very fun. Did you like it too?
I did, but the end was weird.
I agree, that part was strange. Do you want to watch it again?
No, I am too tired now.
That is okay. Go rest now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so angry because my piggy bank is empty.
That feels bad. What did you spend it on?
I bought too many toys and now I have no coins.
Toys are fun but they cost real money. Do you have other ways to make some?
I can clean the yard for my neighbor.
That is a great idea and very kind of you. You will feel proud.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want a big party for my birthday. What should I do?
That sounds like fun. Who are you inviting?
I will invite all my friends from school.
They will be happy to come. What food do you like?
I love pizza and cake.
Those are great picks. Do you want to bake the cake?
I am not sure I can bake well.
It is okay if it looks a bit odd. Do you want to buy it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the beach today and it was so much fun!
That sounds like a great time! Did you swim in the water?
Yes, I swam for a long time and played with a ball.
I am glad you enjoyed your day. What color was the sand?
The sand was soft and yellow, but I do not have a photo.
I understand. I know what a beach feels like, but I cannot see the photo. Did you eat ice cream?
Yes, I ate chocolate ice cream and it was cold and sweet.
Yum, that sounds delicious.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do you know where the red book is?
It is on the top shelf. Are you in a hurry?
Yes, I am late. How do I get there?
Go up the stairs. Do you need help?
No, I can find it. Thank you very much.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a big leaf under the tree.
That is a lovely find. Do you know what kind of tree it is?
I think it is an oak tree.
That sounds right. Oak trees have very strong wood.
I want to climb it now.
Please be very careful up high. Do you have a friend to watch you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Can you help me find my keys?
I look for you. Do they feel cold?
Yes, they feel cold.
Check your cold coat pocket. Did you wear that coat?
No, I wore a red shirt.
Try your red shirt pocket. Good luck.
Oh! Here they are.
Great job. Do you know where they live now?
Yes, in my hand.
That is a safe place.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My dog ate a sock. Is he okay?
That sounds scary. Does your dog feel sick?
He is sleeping now, but his tummy feels hard.
That is not good. Please take him to the doctor.
Will the doctor fix his tummy?
Yes, the doctor can help him feel better. Is he scared of the doctor?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water so blue?
It is blue because the sky reflects down. Do you like the sky?
I do. Why do the boats stop there?
The boats stop to fix their nets. Do you know what a net is?
Yes, for fish. Why is the air salty?
It is salty because of the waves. Do you taste it?
I do. Why is the dock so wet?
The waves hit the dock hard. Do you mind the water?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a song that makes me feel warm inside.
That sounds wonderful. Do you like the sound of the piano?
Yes, the piano is soft and sweet.
I am glad you enjoy it. What part of the song is your favorite?
I love the loud drums near the end.
That must be exciting to hear. How often do you listen to that song?
I play it every night before bed.
That is a lovely habit.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I fall asleep faster at night?
Try taking slow, deep breaths. Do you drink hot milk?
I do, but my mind keeps racing. What else helps?
You can write down your worries in a book. Are your thoughts loud or quiet?
They are loud. Can I use music to quiet them?
Soft, slow music often helps. Do you like nature sounds?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have chicken and veggies, but I do not know how to cook them.
Put the chicken in a hot pan first. Do you have any oil?
Yes, I have olive oil. How do I make the veggies taste good?
Mix them with salt and pepper. Do you like them soft or crunchy?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do for the party.
That is hard. What do you like to eat?
I like cake, but I am not sure if I should bake it.
Baking is fun. Do you have an oven at home?
Yes, I have an oven, but I am afraid I will fail.
You will do fine. Just start small.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very lost. Can you help me find my way home?
I am happy to help you. Are you looking at a map or a phone?
No, I do not have a map. I just need directions.
That is tricky without one. Can you name a big building near you?
There is a tall bank next to me. I am scared.
Do not be scared. Walk to the bank and look for a sign.
What kind of sign should I look for?
Look for a sign with an arrow on it. Does the arrow point to the left or right?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the shop?
It is up the hill. Is it cold today?
Yes, very. Do I turn left or right?
Go right. Do you like the rain?
No, I hate it. Is the shop open?
I am not sure. It is very small.
I must run now. Thank you.
Good luck. Go fast.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel stuck at my desk. I do not know what to do next.
Try to do just one small thing first. What is your first task?
I must write a letter. It seems too hard for me.
You can break it into small parts. Is there a part that feels easy?
I think I can start with the greeting. Thank you for your help.
That is a good step. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My phone screen is dark and I do not know what to do.
That is quite scary. Have you tried pressing the side button?
I pressed it, but nothing happened. I am not sure why it will not wake up.
Let us check the charging cable. Is it still plugged in?
No, it was not plugged in. I should have checked that first.
That was a good guess. Does the light turn on now?
Yes, the light is green and the screen is bright. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. I am happy to help you fix it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Where is the boat?
It is by the red flag. Do you have your ticket?
I did not see a red flag. Is it far?
It is very close. I do not know where you are standing.
I am near the door. Can you help me?
Yes, look for the water. Do you see a big blue ship?
Yes, I see it. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Run fast.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The rain is coming down hard. I do not know if I should go out.
Stay safe inside. Do you like listening to the sound of rain?
Yes, it feels calm, but I want to see my friend.
You can wait for the rain to stop. Is your friend close by?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked down the long, quiet street today.
That sounds very calm. Do you like the quiet?
Yes, the birds were singing and no one rushed me.
Birds are nice friends. What color are they?
I saw a small blue one and a big brown one.
I love birds too. Did you see anything else?
I also saw a white cat sleeping in a sun spot.
The cat must be warm. Is the street far from home?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse today.
That sounds fun. What did it look like?
It had a long white tail.
I am glad you are safe. Did it move?
Yes, it walked by my window.
What a calm moment. Did you feed it?
I could not, but I waved at it.
That is a sweet thought. Goodbye.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The leaves are falling off the tree. Should I pick them all up?
I am not sure if you should clean them up. Do you like the sound they make when you step on them?
I think I do. What do the trees do with the leaves?
The trees let the leaves fall to save energy for winter. Do you wonder what happens next?
I guess they just sit on the ground. Why do trees stop making leaves?
They stop to rest and keep their roots warm. Do you want to help them by leaving the leaves there?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I see the big yellow sun. It makes me feel very happy.
That is wonderful. Do you like the warm light?
Yes, the light feels like a hug. I want to tell you all about it.
I am glad you share your joy. What color is the sky today?
It is a bright, clear blue. The sun shines so hard.
That sounds bright and lovely. Do you like to watch it rise?
I do, every single morning. It starts my day with hope.
I am glad it brings you hope.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am afraid to jump into the pool.
That is okay. Have you tried wading first?
I do not know what to do.
Just kick your legs gently. Do you feel safe now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a sweet red apple. I would like to give you a piece.
That is very kind of you. Do you like sweet or sour apples?
I love them when they are crunchy and sweet.
That sounds great to eat.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a letter from my old friend. I do not know what to do with it.
That is nice. Did you read it?
Yes, but it is sad. I feel lost.
It is okay to feel sad. Do you want to write back?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to walk for good health.
Start with a slow walk for ten minutes. Do you walk near a park?
Yes, I live close to a nice park.
Great, walk there and take your time. I do not know your exact schedule, but short walks are best.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the stars are gone.
The moon is bright and the clouds are thick. Do you like clouds?
I do not like clouds. They hide everything I love.
The clouds will move away soon. Do you have a warm blanket?
No, I am cold and alone. I miss the sky.
I am right here with you. Would you like to watch for a gap?
Yes, I hope to see one. Thank you for staying.
It is my pleasure. Look up, the first star is peeking out.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy fruit. Which is sweet?
Apples are sweet and good for you. What color do you like?
I like red things.
Then get red apples. Do you want to buy them now?
Yes, but I do not know where to go.
Go to the big table with signs. Is it busy there?
It looks very busy.
That is fine. Let us wait for a few minutes.
Okay, I am ready now.
Great. Let us go together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to walk for my body but I do not know how to start.
That is a great goal. Do you have a quiet park nearby?
Yes, my grandmother lives by one. I want to learn the right way to breathe while walking.
Breathe in through your nose and out through your mouth. Do you have a chair for resting?
I have a bench there. How long should I walk?
Start with ten minutes and add more each week. Do you feel tired or excited?
I feel excited. Is it safe to walk too fast?
Slow is good so your heart stays calm.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want a big party for my birthday. What should I do?
That sounds like fun. Do you have a favorite game?
I love tag and hide and seek. I need more ideas.
You can play both games. Do you like cake?
Yes, I do. Do I need to buy a lot of food?
I do not know your budget. Just ask your friends what they like.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the people next door smile at us so much?
They are happy to have good friends nearby. Do you wave back?
Yes, I do. But why does the lady in black look sad?
I do not know why she feels that way. Is she crying?
No, she is just eating alone. Why does eating alone make people sad?
Food is nicer when you share with others. Do you want to share your apple?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do trees lose their leaves in winter?
They drop leaves to save water while the ground is frozen. Do you like watching them fall?
I do, but why do some trees keep their leaves?
Those trees have thick, waxy leaves that block the cold air. Do you know which ones stay green?
I think firs stay green. How do trees breathe?
They use tiny holes on their leaves to take in air. Is that strange to you?
A little bit. Do trees feel pain?
I do not know for sure, but they react to harm by sealing cuts. Do you think they have feelings?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now, but I am so scared about the test.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you know when the test is?
In ten minutes! I did not study enough.
Take a deep breath with me. Can you tell me one thing you did study?
Just the first part. Oh no, I am late!
You know one part, so you are not empty. Go now and do your best.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went for a long walk in the park today.
That sounds like a nice way to spend an afternoon.
I saw a big dog chasing a squirrel.
Did the dog catch the squirrel in the end?
No, the squirrel was too fast and climbed a tree.
Good for the squirrel. Did you have any snacks with you?
Yes, I ate an apple by the lake.
An apple is a great snack for a walk.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know how to add these numbers.
Let us try again. What is five plus five?
Ten, I think.
You are right. Do you like math?
Not really, I guess.
That is okay. It gets easier with time.
Can you help me with the next one?
Yes, I am here. What is the problem?
It is two times four.
It is eight. Nice work.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so alone today.
That feels hard. Do you have a friend you can call?
I don't know who to ask.
I don't know your friends, but I am here. What makes you feel this way?
Nothing is fun right now.
Boredom can feel lonely. Do you like drawing?
I just want someone to talk to.
I am listening. You are not alone right now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. The wind is very strong today.
It is indeed very windy outside. Are you wearing a warm coat?
I forgot my coat at home. Do you know if the storm will stop soon?
I do not know when it will stop. Are you feeling too cold right now?
My hands are very cold. Please just let me pass by you quickly.
You are welcome to walk past me. Please stay safe on your way.
Thank you for letting me go. I must keep moving to be on time.
Good luck with your trip. Do you know how to cross this big street?
I know the way, but it is hard to see. I will be careful and keep going.
That is a good plan. I will watch from here to keep you safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I miss my old friend who lives far away. How do I send a letter?
You can buy paper and a stamp. Do you have a pen?
I do have a pen. What do I write in the letter?
Tell them you think about them. That is a sweet idea.
Should I draw a picture too?
Yes, a picture is nice. I do not know if they like cats.
They love cats. I will draw one.
That sounds fun. Have a good time writing.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is everyone wearing silly hats?
They are fun for dancing. Do you like hats?
Why is the music so loud?
It helps people feel happy. Is it too loud for you?
Why is there so much candy?
Sweet treats make us smile.
Why did you bring so many balloons?
They make the room feel big. Do you like balloons?
Why is the party ending?
I must go home now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to count my apples right now.
Let us count together, one by one. How many do you see?
One, two, three, four, five.
Five is a great number. Do you like apples?
Yes, but I must run away now.
Have a safe trip. Goodbye.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Tell me about the moon quickly.
It is a big rock in the sky. Do you like looking up?
Yes, but I must go. Is it real?
Yes, it is a real place. See you later.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new song today. It makes me feel so warm inside. Do you like happy tunes?
That sounds lovely. I am glad it brings you joy. What is the song about?
It is about a little bird singing in the rain. I can not stop humming it.
A bird in the rain is a nice picture. I do not know the song, but your happiness is clear.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in this big city.
That can feel scary. What did you see last?
I saw a tall gray tower.
That is a good start. Do you see any signs?
I see people and cars everywhere.
People are kind here. Try to walk to a shop.
I do not know where the shops are.
Look for bright lights. Which way feels safe?
I am too tired to choose.
Resting is okay. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do bears eat honey?
Yes, many bears love honey. Do you like sweet food?
I love cookies.
That is nice. Bears also eat bugs and fish.
Can they swim well?
Yes, many bears are good swimmers.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do birds sing so loud in the morning?
They sing to show they are happy and to mark their spot. Do you like the sound?
I like it. Why do they have tiny beaks?
Their beaks are small so they can grab seeds and small bugs. Are they eating right now?
I see one eating a seed. Why do they not get stuck?
They spit out the hard shells to stay safe. Do you want to watch more?
Yes, I will watch. Why do some birds fly in big groups?
Flying together helps them stay safe from bad things. Do you see any big groups?
I see a few. Why do they come back to our yard?
They come back because we have food and water for them. Do you plan to feed them?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have twelve months in a year?
The earth takes one year to go around the sun. Do you like looking at the stars?
But why is June in the middle?
It is the start of summer in many places. Do you like the heat?
I do not know why winter comes after fall.
I do not know the exact reason either. It just happens in order.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which shoes to pick.
The blue ones are nice. Do you like blue?
They are not my favorite color.
Let us look at the red ones then.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to visit my grandpa, but I am scared of bugs.
That is a good worry. Do you like to bring snacks?
Yes, I bring cookies and juice.
Bugs often like sweet smells. Maybe leave the treats inside?
I was not sure where to put them.
You can keep them in a bag. Would you like help packing?
I do not know how to seal the bag.
I do not know your bag type.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The bus was late again today. I stood in the cold rain and got very mad.
That sounds frustrating. Did you find a way to calm down?
I started to count my toes. By ten, the bus finally pulled up.
Counting is a great trick. It helps you wait with peace.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I keep my bike from tipping over when I stop?
That is a smart question. Do you use training wheels?
No, I take them off to go faster.
You are brave. Try putting one foot down quickly.
I try, but I still fall sometimes.
That is okay. Do you wear a helmet?
Yes, I always wear my helmet.
Good. You are safe and learning well.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up at seven. The sun was just coming up.
That is a nice start. Do you like the morning light?
Yes, but then I forgot to set my watch.
Oh, that can be tricky. How does the watch help you?
It uses batteries to tick. I am not sure about the gears.
Bells and hands show the time. Do you know where the hands go?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my sandwich on the floor this morning.
Oh no. Did you get a new one?
Yes, but I am still hungry.
Is your stomach rumbling?
Yes, I need to go to the canteen now.
Have a good meal.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky so wet?
Rain fell just now. Do you like the smell of rain?
Yes, it smells good. But where did the rain go?
It all went back up to the clouds. Do you see the gray clouds?
I do. Why are they there?
They hold the water up high. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. What is that bright thing in the air?
That is a rainbow made by the sun and rain.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: A small red bird sat on my fence today.
That sounds lovely. Did it sing a song?
It chirped once and then flew away.
I am glad it was safe. Do you see birds often?
Yes, but I never saw one like that before.
New things are fun to find. What color was the sky?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My screen is blue and I am late.
Try holding the power key. Do you see a fan noise?
It is dead and I need my file now.
I do not know where the file is. Is your mouse working?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a circle and a square. I do not know what to do with them.
You can put the circle on top of the square. Do you want to make a tower?
A tower sounds fun, but I am afraid it will fall down.
A square base is very steady. Can you find a small triangle to add to the top?
I found a triangle, but I am still not sure if this is right.
That looks like a nice shape house. Does it look like something you would live in?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off the trees?
The tree gets cold and the sun gets low. It lets go to save its energy. Do you see the brown leaves?
Yes, they are all brown and dry.
The tree stops making food for the leaves. It needs to sleep until spring. Is that why they fly around?
I guess so. It is so pretty when they fall.
Nature is a good painter. It makes the air clear for the birds. Do you like the quiet after they fall?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to clean the glass of the lighthouse.
You use a soft cloth and warm soapy water. Do you have a ladder?
Yes, I have a ladder. How do I get it up?
That is a very tall building. Do you have a friend to help?
No, I am all alone. What should I do?
Please do not go up alone. It is not safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sand looks too hot to walk on.
Try walking on the wet sand near the water. It is much cooler. What else is making you pause?
I do not know where to find soft wet sand.
Look for the dark, flat spots near the waves. Are you scared of the water?
Yes, the waves scare me a little.
That is okay. You can just stand in the very shallow part. Do you have your shoes with you?
I left them in the car.
I am sorry I cannot help with your car. Please take your time and stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I had a scary dream about a big dark forest.
That sounds very lonely. Did you see any friendly animals?
No, just scary shadows that chased me.
I know that feeling is tough to shake. Did you tell a grown up about it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big tree house.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a spot in mind?
Yes, by the big oak tree in the yard.
Great choice. Are you going to bring your dad?
He said he can help with the hard parts.
That is good to know. Do you have wood ready?
I have some, but we need more.
Let us measure what you have first. Is a tape measure handy?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a very big mountain today.
That sounds amazing. What color was the top?
It had white snow on it.
I bet the air was very cold there. Did you take a picture?
Yes, I took a picture with my phone.
I am glad you captured the view. How did you feel up there?
I felt very happy and free.
That is a wonderful feeling. Thank you for sharing your story.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a small boat in my garage, but I do not know what to do with it.
That sounds like a fun thing to look at. Did you fix it up?
I think I painted the outside, but I am not sure if the engine works.
You could try to start it to see. Did you get it from the shop?
It was my grandpa’s old boat, and I feel scared to try driving it.
You are very brave for wanting to help. Do you have a friend who likes boats?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My phone screen is blue.
That sounds like a battery issue. Is it cold outside?
Yes, it is very cold today.
Cold drains batteries fast. Does it turn on?
No, it is dead and dark.
Let it warm up near you. Do you have a charger?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the new town so quiet?
The streets are clean and empty. Do you like quiet places?
Why do the houses look so bright?
The people painted them with happy colors. What is your favorite color?
Why do people smile so much?
I think they are glad to be here. I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very hungry. Do you know a good place to eat?
Yes, there is a nice spot down the street. Do you like pizza?
Yes, I love pizza. Is that place open now?
I am not sure about the time, but you can call. Do you go with your parents?
Yes, we are together. Is it far from here?
It is just a short walk away. Do you like to walk or ride?
I like to ride my bike. Can I take my bike there?
Most places let you, but it is best to check first. Do you have a helmet?
Yes, I always wear my helmet. Thank you for helping.
You are welcome. I hope you have a yummy meal.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the little shop near my home.
That sounds like a nice place. Did you see any toys there?
I saw a red ball but I forgot to buy it.
Oh, that is a bit sad. Did you want to buy it for a game?
Yes, my friend and I like to kick it around.
Kicking a ball is very fun. Do you play in the park?
We play in the park when the sun is out.
That is a great spot for fun. Is the park close to your house?
It is very close, just a short walk away.
That is perfect for a quick trip. I hope you have a happy day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do you know what the internet is? I need to send a letter right now.
It is like a big library of papers for everyone. Are you worried about the cost?
Yes, I am in a huge hurry. How do I put my letter on it?
I am not sure how your machine works, but you usually use a web page. Do you have a picture of the screen?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do cows have four toes?
They do to help them walk on soft ground. Do you like watching them eat?
Yes, but why do ducks make a quack sound?
That is how they talk to their friends. Do you have any ducks?
No, I only have one dog. Why do dogs bark?
Barking helps them tell us something is new. Is your dog a good listener?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I won my chess game today!
That is great news. Do you play often?
Yes, I love moving the little pieces.
That sounds fun. What piece won for you?
My queen took the king.
Nice. How did you feel?
I felt very big and proud.
Cool. Do you play with friends?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My dog is eating grass outside.
Dogs often eat grass to feel their tummy better. Is your dog happy?
Yes, he looks very happy and is wagging his tail.
That is a good sign that he feels fine. What is his favorite game?
He loves to chase balls in the yard.
That sounds like fun! Do you have a big ball for him?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very impatient when I wait for my toy to be fixed.
That is a tough feeling to have. Do you play outside while you wait?
I tried, but I keep running back to look at it.
That shows you care a lot about your toy. Is it your favorite one?
Yes, it is my very favorite. I just want it back right now.
I do not know a magic fix for waiting. How do you usually calm your body?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I got a new friend today at school.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What did you two play?
We played tag in the big yard.
Tag is a great game for running fast. Did you catch him or did he catch you?
He caught me first, but I am faster now.
Good job working hard. Do you want to invite him over this weekend?
Yes, I think he would like my house.
That is a wonderful idea. I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts so bad. What can I do?
Rest your eyes in a dark room. Do you feel tired?
I drank a lot of coffee today. Could that be it?
Yes, too much caffeine can cause pain. Do you have a glass of water?
I should drink some. Do I need medicine?
Water and rest work best first. Try that before pills.
Okay, I will rest. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see the blue up there, but I do not know why.
It is light from the sun hitting air. Does the blue look bright today?
Yes, it is bright. But I feel lost looking at it.
The blue parts of light bounce around more than other colors. Do you see how it fills the whole space?
I understand the light part. I still do not know what to do with my eyes.
Just let them rest on the calm blue. Are you feeling a little less lost now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
Start by making a cross under the laces.
Do I need to hold the ends tight?
Yes, hold the ends firm to stop them slipping.
What do I do after the cross?
Make a loop with one end. Do you see how it looks like a bunny ear?
I made two ears, now what?
Cross the ears and pull one through the hole.
I did that, but the bow is loose.
Pull the ends flat until it feels tight. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my brother took my toy.
That feels really unfair. Did you try to ask for it back?
Yes, but he said he wanted it for a while.
I get that, but sharing is important. How long did he say he needs it?
He said until bedtime, which is still too long for me.
I understand your frustration. Would it help to take turns tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My grandpa says he was born in 1925.
That makes him quite old now.
How old is he exactly?
I do not know the exact number, but he is very old.
Why is he so slow to walk?
Old bones move slowly. Do you help him walk?
Yes, I hold his arm.
That is very kind of you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to swim in the lake, but I am not sure if it is safe.
That is a smart thing to check. Do you see any signs near the water?
I do not see any signs, but there are ripples on the surface.
Ripples can mean wind or fish. Have you asked a local person?
Yes, a man said it is deep, but he left quickly.
That is true, so stay near the shore. Do you have a friend with you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Where is the dog for the story?
Is it a big dog or a small one? Look under the chair.
I see it. Do I need a pencil?
Yes, you need a blue one. Is it in your pack?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do we need to bring food for the camp?
Yes, we do. What is your favorite thing to eat outside?
I like hot dogs with ketchup.
That sounds very yummy. We should pack some buns too.
What if it rains while we sleep?
We will use a big tent to keep us dry. Are you scared of thunder?
Not really, I just like being warm.
Your sleeping bag will keep you cozy. Do you have your book for bedtime?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make bread at home. Do you know how I start?
Yes, you start with flour and water. Do you have an oven?
I have an oven. What comes after the flour and water?
You add yeast and salt next. Do you have yeast?
I have yeast. How long do I leave the dough to sit?
Let it sit for one hour. You will feel great.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I ran a mile today and I feel so good.
That sounds amazing. How did your legs feel after?
They hurt a little, but I was smiling the whole time.
It is nice to share that joy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very full after eating my sandwich. Why?
Your body is getting fuel to work. Do you drink water?
I drink some. Why is water so good for us?
It helps clean your body from the inside. Do you like tea?
I like it. Why do people eat together at noon?
It feels nice to talk with friends. Do you want some soup?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the square the odd one out in this picture?
The square has four sides, but the others have curves. Do you see how the lines bend?
Yes, the round ones are smooth. But why is the square sharp?
Corners make it sharp because the lines meet at an angle. I do not know why the puzzle maker chose that.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now.
That is great to hear. What is making you feel good?
We are going to a big party tonight.
A party sounds like fun. Will you eat cake there?
Yes, there will be lots of yummy food.
I am glad you are excited.
I want to share my joy with you.
I am happy for you. Do you have a favorite dance move?
I do not know, but I will dance anyway.
That is the right spirit. Have a wonderful time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is that island made of candy?
No, it is made of sand and rock. Do you like jumping on sand?
I hate sand in my shoes.
That is a good point. It can be messy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did you come here?
I came to help. Are you ready?
Why is it so late?
Time moves fast. Did you eat?
Why do you wear that hat?
It keeps my head warm. Do you like it?
Why are you smiling?
I am happy. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sick and my nose is running. What should I do?
Please rest in bed and drink warm water. Do you have a fever?
Yes, my head hurts and I feel hot.
Take a break and eat some soup. Is it time to see a doctor?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I made a new friend, but he made me feel sad.
That feels really bad, I am sorry you are hurting. What did he do?
He took my favorite toy and did not say sorry.
That is not a nice thing to do. Did you try to tell him?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for my bike ride.
That sounds fun. What color is your bike?
It is red and blue. I must go now.
I like bright colors. Do you ride fast?
Yes, very fast. Goodbye!
Have a safe ride. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My truck broke down right on the main road.
Oh no, that is scary. Did anyone help you?
A man with a tow truck pulled us out.
Thank goodness for him. Do you know where you are going?
We are going to my new house today.
That is exciting. Do you have the keys?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a meeting with my teacher tomorrow.
That sounds nice. Do you know what you will talk about?
We will talk about my drawing of the sun.
I love when the sun is out. Is your drawing yellow?
Yes, it is bright yellow with red lines.
That sounds warm and happy. Did you use crayons for it?
I used paint, but it took a long time to dry.
Paint can be slow sometimes. Do you think it is ready now?
Yes, it is dry, so I am happy.
Good luck at your meeting.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a sweet peach right here. I want to share it with you.
That sounds tasty. Do you like it warm or cold?
It feels just right in my hand. I cut it into two equal halves.
I do not have a mouth to taste it, but I am happy for you. Which part is your favorite?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do today.
That feels hard. What do you like to eat?
I like pie, but I am not sure if it is good.
Pie is a sweet pick. Do you want to rest or play?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I counted my toys. There are ten!
That is a fun number. Do you like the color red?
Yes, I do. Red is my favorite.
Great choice. Would you like to count them again?
Maybe later. I want to play now.
That sounds like fun. Enjoy your play.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make my own magnet.
You can rub a steel nail with a strong magnet. Do you have any steel things at home?
Yes, I have some old nails in a box.
Great, keep rubbing in one direction for a few minutes.
How do I know if it works?
Try it on a paper clip to see if it sticks. Is the clip made of steel?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My dog is hiding under the bed and he is very sad.
That looks scary. Is he playing or is he sick?
He is not playing, and his ear looks hurt.
That is bad. Please take him to the doctor.
The doctor will come to our house.
That is good news. Does he like going for walks?
Yes, he loves walks, but he cannot walk today.
I am happy you told me. I hope he gets better soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why do leaves fall?
They fall because the days get cold and short. Are you watching them drop?
I must go now. Is that all?
The tree saves its food for winter. Do you like crunchy leaves?
I am running. Tell me fast.
The tree lets them go so it can rest. Is it a windy day?
I am gone. Thank you.
Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to watch a movie but I do not know which one to pick.
I like happy stories. Do you want to laugh or cry?
I feel tired. I just want to smile.
Try a movie about a cute animal. Have you seen anything about a cat?
I saw a cat film last week. It was nice.
Then let us pick something with bright colors. Do you like songs in movies?
Yes, I love singing along.
Let us find a musical.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I was scared of the dark last night.
That sounds scary. What did you see in the dark?
I saw a big, fuzzy shadow near my door.
Shadows are just tricks played by the light. Do you like having your nightlight on?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting for so long.
Stretch your legs if you can. Do you have any snacks?
I ate too much salty food and now I am thirsty.
Drink plenty of water. Is the plane very dry?
I am afraid of the loud noise from the engines.
Try to listen to music. Does it get louder?
I want to sleep but my eyes will not close.
Try to rest your eyes. Are you tired?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I milk a cow?
You must sit down and hold the udder tight. Do you have a clean bucket ready?
I think I am ready to try.
Squeeze gently and let the milk flow into the bucket.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my cup. What should I do?
I am sorry you feel bad. Did you try to fix it?
No, it is in small pieces. I am very sad.
It is okay to feel sad. Do you want to clean it up now?
Yes, I will pick up the glass. Is that all?
Yes, just be careful. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My soup is cold and I have no spoon. I am so hungry.
That sounds very bad. Do you want me to go get you a warm drink?
Yes, please. But I still need a spoon to eat my food.
I will bring both. I do not know if the microwave is free, but I will check for you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to eat better, but I do not know what to pick.
Try adding more fruit and vegetables to your plate. Do you have a favorite color of food?
I like red apples, but I get bored of them fast.
That is a good start. You can mix in green beans or orange carrots for change.
That sounds simple, but I worry I will forget to cook.
Start with one easy meal a day. Do you have a pot or pan ready?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because I washed my clothes.
That is wonderful. Why does washing clothes make you feel so good?
I love seeing them clean and fresh. It makes my heart smile.
Clean clothes do feel nice. Do you use warm water or cold water?
I use warm water for the white shirts. It feels right.
Warm water helps with stains. You must be proud of your work.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the baby cry so much?
It is hungry or wet. Is it time for a bottle?
Yes, I am feeding it now. Why does it smell like milk?
That is the nice scent of fresh milk. Do you love its smell?
I do. Why does it sleep for so long?
Sleep helps its body grow big and strong. How long did it sleep?
It slept for five hours. Why does it kick its legs?
It is just moving and feeling happy. Do you like watching it kick?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I got on the blue bus this morning.
That sounds like a good start to the day. Where did it take you?
It went to the park near my house.
The park is a nice place to go. Did you see any animals?
Yes, I saw a big brown dog.
How nice for you to see a friend. Was the dog friendly?
It was barking loud at a squirrel.
That is how dogs say hello sometimes. Did you feed the squirrel?
No, I do not have food.
That is okay, you do not have to share. Do you want to talk more about your trip?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does Grandma like to sit by the window all day?
She loves watching the birds fly. Do you have birds near your house?
I do see some. Why is her hands always cold?
Old bones get cold easier than young ones. Are you trying to keep her warm?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared of the pedals.
It feels scary at first. Which part makes you most nervous?
I keep hitting the gas by mistake.
Try to stay right on the brake. Do you have a quiet place to practice?
Yes, my aunt has a big empty lot.
That is a great start. I do not know your car, but a quiet space helps you learn.
I still feel unsure about turning.
Look where you want to go, not at the wheel. Are you going slow?
Yes, I go very slow.
That is the best way. Keep doing that and you will get the feel.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How does a clock move the hands?
Gears turn the hands. Do you know what a gear looks like?
Yes, like a wheel with teeth. But I must go now.
Gears push each other to make the hands move.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am sad because my friend is sick.
That feels hard. How is she feeling today?
She has a fever and is in bed.
A hot head means she needs rest. Do you know where to get a doctor?
Yes, mom will take her to the clinic.
That is the right thing to do. Tell her you care about her.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the lake today.
That sounds like fun. Did you catch any fish?
I caught one small bluegill.
That is a good start. Do you eat them?
Yes, I cooked it for dinner.
Yum. Did you have any friends with you?
I was all by myself.
That can be peaceful. Do you like being alone?
I like the quiet air.
That is a nice way to relax.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like tea but not coffee.
That is fine. Do you like it hot?
Yes, I do. What is in coffee?
It has beans. Do you drink milk?
I add milk to tea. Why is coffee bitter?
It can be strong. Do you try sugar?
I only want plain tea.
That is your choice.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found an old photo of a friend I lost touch with. Do you know how to find them again?
I think looking on the internet is a good start. Do you remember their last city?
Yes, I think it was near the coast. Is it easy to search by place?
It can be tricky if the name is common. Do you have any other shared memories?
We used to build sandcastles together every summer. That is a nice memory to keep.
That sounds like a sweet story. Would you like help writing a letter to them?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very sick and I must go now.
