I am sorry you feel bad. Is your head hurt?
My head hurts a lot. I can wait.
Please drink warm water. Do you have any soup?
I have soup in the bag.
That is good for you.
I feel a bit better now.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I heard a loud song in the park today.
That sounds fun. What song was it?
It was a happy tune with drums.
Nice. Did you dance?
I only clapped my hands.
Smart. You saved your energy.
Yes, I felt tired after.
Good rest is key.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got the job! I am very happy. Do you want to hear about it?
That is great news. What will you do there?
I will sort books in a shop. Is that a fun job?
Yes, it sounds very calm and nice.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel like giving up on this toy.
It is hard when things take time. Do you like the toy?
Yes, I do, but it is too tricky.
That is good. Why did you pick it?
Because my friend gave it to me.
A gift is special. Do you want to try again?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I fell off my bike and it hurts.
I am sorry you hurt. Is your leg okay?
Yes, but now I do not want to ride.
That is a good choice for today.
But my friends are waiting for me.
You can tell them you need a break.
Will they be mad at me?
They will likely worry, not be mad.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why do the trees lose their leaves? I feel so sad to see them fall.
The trees do this to save energy when it gets cold. Do you like looking at the colors?
The colors are pretty, but I miss the green shade. It feels lonely without them.
The tree is not lonely, it is just resting for the winter. Would you like to collect some leaves to press?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My boss gave me a new book. Why did he do that?
He probably wants to help you learn. Do you like the book?
Yes, I like it. Is he a good person?
Giving gifts shows he cares about you. I do not know his whole story. Does he help other people too?
Yes, he helps everyone. Thank you.
You are welcome. Happy reading.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad inside. I do not know what to do.
I am sorry you feel that way. What is making you sad?
I failed my big test. I feel like a total failure.
That sounds hard. Have you eaten lunch yet?
No, I am too upset to eat. I just want to hide.
You are not a failure. Let us take a deep breath together.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to run to the shop, but my shoes are too tight.
That is not good for your feet. Do you have any open shoes nearby?
No, only these tight ones. How can I make them fit?
I do not know if they will stretch. You can try to walk slowly first.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do all wild animals eat meat?
No, some eat plants, like deer. Do you like watching them?
Yes, I do. What do tigers eat?
Tigers are carnivores, so they eat meat. Do you like big cats?
I think they are scary. What do bears eat?
Bears eat both plants and meat. Do you like their smell?
No, it is strong. Why do they have such strong smells?
I do not know for sure. Do you smell your pets?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I read my favorite book again, but I do not like it today.
That feels bad. Do you want to talk about what went wrong?
The end made me feel sad for no reason.
I am sorry you feel that way. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind blew my hat off today.
Oh no. Was it a big hat?
Yes, and the wind was very strong.
That sounds like a fun ride.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in such a rush. Do you have a nice box?
Yes, right here. Do you need anything else?
No, just this one. Is it strong enough?
It is very strong. What is inside?
A small toy. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream cone in the mud this morning.
That is very sad to hear. Did you have a backup treat?
I cried for a minute, but then my mom gave me a cookie.
That is a happy fix. Do you like chocolate cookies?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend. Do I need to buy special paper?
No, any paper works. What are you writing about?
I am telling him about my new dog. How do I end the letter?
You can just say goodbye and sign your name. Do you have a pen ready?
Yes, I have a blue pen. Is that all I need to do?
Yes, that is all.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to have a party at my house this weekend.
That sounds like so much fun. Do you have a list of friends who want to come?
Yes, I have invited five friends. What should I make for them to eat?
Simple snacks are often the best choice. Do you like cooking, or do you prefer easy things?
I like easy things, but I do not like cooking very much.
Chips and dip are great because they take no time. Maybe you can ask one friend to help you set up the table?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I bought a new phone. I am so happy about it.
That is great news. Do you have a blue or a black one?
It is red. It looks very shiny.
Red is a nice color.
I want to send a picture to my mom.
That is a sweet idea. Will she like it?
Yes, she will love it. I love her very much.
She will be very glad to hear from you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. The bus is coming soon.
That sounds very stressful. Do you have your ticket?
Yes, I have it. It is hard to see the signs here.
I am sorry I cannot point the way. Are you going to the big tower?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know if I should kick the ball high or low.
Do you want to score a goal?
Yes, but the wall is tall.
Try a low shot to the corner.
What if the keeper stops it?
Then you pick it up and try again.
That makes me feel better.
Do you have your gloves on?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to grow tomatoes but I am not sure where to put the pot.
Tomatoes need a lot of sun. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
Yes, the back patio gets sun all day. Is that good?
That is a perfect place for them. Do you have the seeds yet?
I have seeds but I do not know how deep to put them in the dirt.
Put them just below the skin of the soil. Have you mixed in any compost?
I used some compost to make the soil rich. What is the next step?
Keep the soil damp but not wet. Do you plan to water it every morning?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off trees?
They fall because the days get shorter. Do you like picking them up?
I do, but why does the tree let go?
The tree saves its water for winter sleep.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My cat sits in the sun all day. Why does she like that?
Warmth makes cats feel cozy and safe. Is her fur still clean?
Yes, but she is very quiet today. Should I be worried?
Cats love napping, so this is normal. Did she eat her morning food?
She ate, but only half of it. What should I do?
If she eats later, she is fine. Watch her for now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is it raining today?
The clouds got heavy with water. Do you like the sound of rain?
It is very wet outside.
Yes, the rain did not stop. Is your coat dry?
Why does it feel cold?
The rain makes the air feel colder. Are you warm inside?
Will it stop soon?
I do not know for sure. Do you want to play inside?
It is bright now.
The sun came out. Do you see the light?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am going to get married soon.
That is very good news. What is your first worry?
I do not know what color to pick for my clothes.
White is a safe choice for you. Do you like bright colors?
I like blue, but I am not sure if it is okay.
Blue is a nice and calm color. It is a good pick.
What should I do with my feet?
Comfortable shoes are best for long days. Do you want to dance much?
I want to dance, but my feet hurt easily.
Look for soft shoes with good support. You will feel better.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count with numbers?
Numbers help us know how many things there are. Do you like counting apples?
I like counting cats. Why do cats have four legs?
Cats have four legs to help them walk and run. Can you name a cat sound?
Meow. Why do we say meow?
We use words to tell what a sound is like. Do you like loud sounds?
No, I like quiet. Why is the moon quiet?
The moon makes no sound because space has no air. Do you like the night sky?
Yes, I do. Why does the moon change shape?
I do not know the exact reason. Do you think it is magic?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a lot of cars and people here. Why are there so many things moving?
Cities have lots of work and fun places, so many people go there. Do you like riding in the cars?
Yes, the cars are very fast. Is it safe for me to walk by the big roads?
Yes, if you hold an adult's hand and look both ways before crossing. Do you see a green light when you want to walk?
I see a red light now. Why does the light stop the cars?
The red light tells the cars to stop so people can cross safely. You are doing a very good job being careful.
I will look for a crosswalk next. Is it okay if I eat my apple while I wait?
That sounds like a great idea to give you some energy. Enjoy your snack while you wait for the light to change.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the well this morning.
The water must look very clear today. Did you see the ducks?
No, but I saw a big black cat sitting on the wall.
That sounds like a quiet start to the day.
Then I picked some red berries by the tree.
Those berries sound sweet and sour. Did you eat them all?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the room?
It is next door. Do you have the key?
No. I lost it.
I have a spare. Would you like it?
Yes. Please.
Here you go. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad about the cake I ate today. It ruins my good eating plans.
One sweet thing does not break you. Do you enjoy your vegetables?
I like carrots, but I mostly just want snacks. I am getting so frustrated.
Carrots are a great start. Are you drinking enough water?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My plant is brown and dry.
Oh no. That looks tough. Did you give it any water today?
I do not get it. How does a plant drink?
Roots suck up water. It goes up the stem. Do you see the wet soil?
That is not fair. It should tell me it is thirsty.
Plants do not talk. They just grow. Let us help it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am scared of the loud wind. How can I make a safe spot in my room?
You can build a small den with your blankets and a sturdy chair. Are you afraid of the dark, too?
Yes, the dark makes me feel small. How can I feel big and safe?
Bring a warm lamp into your den to light up the shadows. Do you have a favorite toy for comfort?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go on a picnic today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What is your favorite food?
I like sandwiches and juice.
Those are great choices. Are you bringing any fruit?
Yes, I have an apple.
Apples are very healthy. I do not know what else you packed.
I have a blanket too.
Good luck with your picnic.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is Sunday the first day of the week?
Many people start the week on Sunday, but others start on Monday. Do you like your day best?
What makes Tuesday different from all the other days?
There is no magic in Tuesday. It is just the second day. Is it your favorite?
How do we know when the week is over?
The week ends on Saturday for many people. Do you enjoy rest?
Why is the week seven days long?
I do not know the true reason, but we have done this for a long time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do cows have such big udders?
They make milk for their babies. Do you like drinking milk?
Why do chickens cluck so loud?
They say hello to their friends. I do not know why they get so loud.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a bee at my window today. It looked very busy and tired.
Bees make honey by drinking sweet juice from flowers and drying it in their hives. Do you like eating honey?
Yes, I love it on toast. But how do they turn the juice into solid honey?
They fan their wings to dry the water out until it gets thick and sweet. That is a hard job for them!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The sand is wet and cold. I do not like it.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a towel with you?
No, I forgot it at home.
That is a problem. Would you like to sit under the shade?
Yes, that sounds nice.
Good. Is the water too cold for you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My brother hit me today and I felt very sad.
I am sorry you got hurt. Does he talk to you after he hits?
No, he just runs away. What should I do?
You can tell a grown up what happened. Have you tried telling your mom?
I was too scared. I just want him to stop.
It takes time to change how he acts. Keep telling a safe adult.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why are clouds white?
They are made of tiny water drops that bounce light. Do you like looking up?
I do, but why do some look gray?
Thick clouds block the sun. What is the weather like where you are?
It looks dark. Will it rain?
I can not tell for sure, but it may happen soon.
I hope it does not.
I hope for you too.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky so dark today?
The clouds are thick with rain. Is it cold where you are?
Yes, it feels very cold. Why does rain make it feel that way?
Water holds heat and takes it away. Do you have a warm coat?
I do have a coat. Why is the wind so loud outside?
Wind sounds loud when it moves fast. It is a strong day. Do you like the sound?
Not really, it is a bit scary. Why is the sun hidden?
I do not know for sure, but it is behind the clouds. Does that make sense?
Yes, it makes sense. Why do I want to go back inside?
You want to stay warm and dry. That is a good idea.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today!
That is good to hear. Do you have a special reason for your joy?
Yes, I made warm tea with honey.
That sounds very nice.
I want you to have some too.
Thank you, that is very kind of you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why are the leaves falling off the trees?
The trees let them go to rest for the cold months. Do you think the trees get tired?
Yes, I do. Is it safe to walk on them?
Yes, they are soft and fun to step on. Do you like the sound they make?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to start walking to stay healthy. Do you know how to begin?
Yes, just take it slow. How many days can you walk a week?
I think I can do three days. Is that enough?
Three days is a great start. Do you have a favorite place to walk?
I like the park near my home. Should I go faster or slower?
Go at a pace that feels good. How do your legs feel after walking?
They feel a bit tired, but I feel happy. Is that normal?
Tired legs are normal. Do you drink water while you walk?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my teacher looking very sad today.
Oh no, that sounds tough. Did she tell you why?
She just smiled and said a big task was done.
That is a sweet way to end a hard day.
I felt happy for her, but also a bit confused.
Confusion is normal. Did you ask her about it?
No, I did not want to bother her.
That shows great care for her space.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I forgot what day it is.
That feels bad. Do you know yesterday?
No, I only know the days are mixed up.
I am sorry I cannot help. Are you tired?
Yes, I am very tired and angry.
Please rest. Is today a good day?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a big, furry thing with long teeth by the river. What was it?
It sounds like a beaver. Do you think it was cutting a tree?
I hope not. Is it safe to get close to wild things?
No, please keep your distance. Do you know why we should be quiet?
Why? I just wanted to pet it.
Some animals get scared and hurt. Have you seen any birds near the water?
Yes, lots of ducks. Are they friends with the beaver?
We do not know for sure. Do you want to tell me where you saw them?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
The tree lets them go so it can rest for the winter. Do you like looking at the crunchy leaves?
Yes, they make a loud sound. Does the tree get cold?
It goes to sleep to save energy until spring. Do you wonder what happens to the seeds?
I do not know. Does the tree miss the leaves?
Not really, because new green leaves will grow back soon. Do you think the sun misses the tree?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like red roses.
Red roses are pretty. Do they smell nice?
Yes, they smell sweet.
That is a lovely smell. What else do you like?
I like big sunflowers.
Sunflowers are very tall. Do they follow the sun?
Yes, they look at the sun.
That is true.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad and scared about tomorrow.
I am sorry you feel that way. Are you scared of a big test?
No, I am scared of the dark at night.
The dark can feel scary, but you are safe. Do you like to have a light on?
Yes, but I still feel lonely when I am awake.
That feels hard. Would you like to talk to me until you fall asleep?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel very tired, but I am so happy right now.
That sounds like a happy kind of tired. Do you know why you feel so good?
I just played outside all day in the sunshine.
Sunshine is a great way to rest your mind. Are you ready to sleep soon?
Yes, my eyes feel heavy and warm.
Good night then.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the sand warm?
Yes, it is warm. Do you like the feeling?
It feels like a cookie.
That is a great thought.
Can we build a castle?
Yes, we can build one. What shape do you want?
I want a big tower.
A big tower sounds fun.
The water is cold.
Yes, the water is always cool. Do you want to splash?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in this town. I do not know where to go.
The park is nearby. Do you like trees?
Yes, I do. But is there food close by?
I do not know for sure. Are you hungry?
Yes, I am very hungry. What should I do?
Please ask a local person. They can help you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Can you help me fix my bike?
Yes, I can help. What is wrong with it?
The tire is flat. Why did that happen?
A pin likely popped it. Is it very flat?
Yes, it is. How do I put air in it?
You use a pump. Do you have one?
I do. Thanks for explaining.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does walking help my body?
It makes your heart pump strong. Do you like moving?
I like it, but why?
It keeps your bones hard. What did you eat?
Just some fruit.
That is good fuel. Do you feel tired?
A little, yes.
Walking helps you rest better.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a little robot in the garden. It is not moving.
That is strange. Do you know who left it there?
No, I do not. Should I try to fix it?
Be careful. Do you know how to open its shell?
No, I do not know. What should I do?
Put it back where you found it. Tell a grown person about it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make bread, but I don't have any yeast. Can I still bake?
That is tricky. Do you have any sourdough starter?
I don't know what that is. My mom keeps it in the fridge.
That is a great start. You can use it to make the bread rise. Do you have the other ingredients ready?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lights went out. I am so happy.
That is a fun surprise. Do you have a candle ready?
Yes, I have many. It feels warm and safe.
I am glad you are safe. What will you do in the dark?
I will eat chocolate. It is my favorite.
That sounds nice. Do you have any cookies too?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to wait?
We wait so things are ready for us. Do you like surprises?
I do not know why we wait here.
I am not sure either. Are you hungry?
Why is it taking so long?
Time moves slowly when we are bored. Do you see that bird?
I just want to be done waiting.
Soon it will be over. Are you almost there?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am tired, but I want to read. What should I do?
You can read for five minutes and then close the book. Do you have a soft lamp?
I do not know. It feels heavy.
Your body is telling you it is time for sleep. Try to rest now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because the sun stopped shining.
I am sorry you are sad. Are you feeling cold?
I just wanted to play outside.
The sun is resting for now. Did you try to go inside?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad inside. I want to be happy.
I am sorry you feel that way. What is making you feel this way?
I lost my favorite toy. It is gone.
That is a very hard thing to lose. Did you look in your room for it?
Yes, I looked everywhere. I cried a lot.
Crying helps let the pain out. Do you have a friend you can play with?
Maybe, but I feel lonely. I miss the toy.
Missing it is okay. Would you like to draw a new one together?
Okay. That sounds nice.
I am glad you feel a little better.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to be a good farmer. What do I need to know about cows and pigs?
Cows need lots of grass to eat, but pigs love to dig in the mud. Do you have a big yard for them?
Yes, I have a big yard. I also want to keep chickens for eggs. How do I keep them safe from foxes?
Build a tall fence around their home and close the gate tight every night. Do you have a dog to help watch?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like sitting at the table. The chair is too big for me.
That sounds like a problem. Do you have a cushion?
Yes, I use a pillow. My books are heavy.
Be careful with your back. Are you doing hard work?
I am reading a big story. It takes a long time.
That is very good for your brain. What is the story about?
A dog who lives in a tree. I am almost done.
That sounds fun. Do you want a snack?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What should I eat for lunch?
Try some apples and cheese. Do you like cheese?
Yes, I do. Is that good for my body?
Yes, it gives you strong bones. What is your favorite fruit?
I like bananas. Should I drink water?
Yes, water helps you think well. Are you thirsty now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How can I learn a new word?
Look at a picture and say the word. Do you like pictures?
Yes, I like dogs.
Point to the dog and say dog. What else do you see?
I see a cat.
Good job. Say cat. Is the cat small?
Yes, it is very small.
Great. Try a new word. What is your favorite color?
Blue.
Nice. Say blue. Do you have a blue toy?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad and scared about the test tomorrow.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you like the topic?
I do not know. I just want to run away.
Running away will not help, but I am here. What part worries you most?
The math questions are too hard for me.
Math can be tricky, but you can try. What number scares you?
The fractions. I hate fractions.
Fractions are just parts of a whole. Do you want to draw one?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to a party today and I am so happy.
That is great. Did you dance?
Yes, I spun around with my friends.
Cool. Did you eat cake?
Yes, it was sweet and yummy.
I am glad you had fun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I keep waking up with my eyes wide open.
That is frustrating. Do you like your pillow?
No, it is too lumpy.
A soft pillow helps you sleep deep. Do you have a favorite blanket?
Yes, I love my blue one.
Wrapping up in it can make you feel safe. Try to breathe slow if you wake up.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does it rain?
Clouds get too heavy with water. Do you like getting wet?
Sometimes, but it is cold.
That is why we use umbrellas. I do not know why the water falls down. Do you think it misses the clouds?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My chair leg wobbles a lot. How can I fix it?
You can try tightening the screws first. Do you have a screwdriver?
Yes, I have a small one. Is that the right tool?
Yes, that should work well. Can you find all the loose parts?
I found two loose screws. What should I do next?
Tighten them until they stop moving. Does the chair feel steady now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my blue pen today. It was so sad.
Oh no. Did you check your bag?
Yes, I looked everywhere. My heart feels heavy.
I am sorry you feel that way. Was it a special pen?
It was a gift from my teacher. I really want to tell her I am fine.
That is a nice thought. Do you want help writing that?
Yes, please. I want to say I still have other pens.
That sounds like a good start. Just say "I have red and green ones."

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What does a lighthouse do?
It shines a big light at night. Do you like bright lights?
Yes, I do. Why does it need a light?
It helps boats find their way. Do ships like to get lost?
No, they do not. Can I see inside?
Yes, if the door is open. Do you have big feet?
My feet are small. Is the tower very tall?
It is quite tall. Do you like climbing stairs?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to take pictures of my dog.
That is fun. Does he like having his picture taken?
Yes, he always sits still for me.
He is very patient. Do you use a phone or a camera?
I use my mom's phone.
A phone is easy to hold. Do you like the outside or inside?
I like the park because it is sunny.
Sun helps make bright photos. Do you show your photos to your friends?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What did it do?
It walked slowly by the fence.
I imagine it was very calm. Was it alone?
Yes, it was eating grass.
Eating is a good job. Did you have a nice walk?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream cone this morning.
Oh no. Did it land on the grass?
No, it hit a very busy street.
That is really bad. Do you have other shoes that fit well?
I have big boots, but it is too hot today.
I see. Are you looking for light, open shoes?
Yes, I want something that lets my feet breathe.
That sounds nice. Can you walk in the heat?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the ferry. Where is the dock?
It is just over there. Do you have your ticket?
Yes, it is in my bag. Is it far away?
It is very close. Do you need a map?
No, I know the way. Thank you very much.
You are welcome. Have a safe ride.
I must run now. Bye.
Good luck. See you later.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a movie today. It had a big dog in it.
A dog! That sounds fun. Did the dog bark?
Yes, it barked a lot. I liked the part where it jumped.
Jumping is exciting. Was the movie happy at the end?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How does a plant drink water?
It uses its roots to pull water up. Do you have a plant at home?
Yes, I want to help it drink more.
Water the soil until it is wet. Do you use a watering can?
No, I just use my hands.
A cup works well for small plants. Do you have a cup?
Yes, I have a red cup.
Great, fill it with water and pour slowly. Do you have a potted plant?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to leave right now. What is that big bird?
I think it is a robin. Do you see its red chest?
I do not have time for details. Is it safe?
Yes, it is very safe. Does it like apples?
I am running late. Is it loud?
It can be quite loud. Do you like loud sounds?
Please keep it short. Is it dirty?
No, it is clean. Do you have a broom?
I am gone. Goodbye.
Goodbye. I do not know what you need.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy riding my bike today. The wind feels great on my face.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What is your favorite part of the ride?
I love feeling the speed on the hill. It is like flying.
That must be very exciting. Do you wear a helmet for safety?
Yes, I always wear it to keep my head safe.
That is a smart and true choice. Do you have a special route you like to take?
I go to the park near my house. It is quiet and nice.
A quiet park sounds peaceful. Is it sunny there right now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big loaf of bread today and I feel so happy.
That sounds wonderful! How did it smell?
It smells sweet and warm like honey.
I am glad you are enjoying it. Do you want to share a piece?
Yes, please take a slice if you like.
Thank you, this is delicious.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I did it all wrong and I want to quit.
It is okay to feel sad. Do you want to try one more time?
I am scared I will break it again.
We can go slow and be careful.
Okay, I will try again.
I am here with you if you need help.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I wash my clothes in the machine?
First, sort the dark clothes from the light ones. Do you know how to sort them?
I guess I put the black pants with the shirts.
That works for most times. Do you use hot or cold water?
I do not know, what is best?
Cold water is safe for most clothes. It helps them last longer.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to know about sailors. Do they get lost on the big blue water?
They have maps and stars to help them find the way back. Do you like looking at the night sky?
Yes, I do. Is the water always smooth like glass?
No, waves can move up and down very high and fast. Do you like the sound of waves crashing?
A little, but it sounds loud. How do they sleep on a moving boat?
They use a rope to keep steady while the boat rocks. Do you think that would feel scary?
Yes, it would. Do they ever go to a land with trees?
Yes, they stop at ports to rest their legs. Do you like standing in tall grass?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I cut the paper wrong. How do I do it right?
Do not worry. Cut slowly along the line. Did you use the right scissors?
I used big scissors. What should I use?
Use small, sharp scissors. They are safer. Do you have them?
Yes, I found them. Thanks.
That is good. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost on this island. I do not know what to do.
Do not worry. Are you thirsty?
Yes, I am very thirsty. I see a small lake.
That is a good start. Is the water clear?
It looks clean and fresh. I want to drink it.
That is the right thing to do. I do not know where your ship is.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I like to keep small stones?
Maybe your eyes like the soft shapes and cool colors. Do you have a favorite stone?
It is the gray one with a little chip.
A little chip makes it unique. Do you keep it in a jar?
I put it in my pocket most days.
That is a kind way to carry a memory. Do you touch it when you feel sad?
I do, and it feels calm.
I do not know why it works, but I am glad it helps.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to write down our answers?
It helps your brain remember things better. Do you like writing?
I guess so, but why is it hard?
Hard things make your brain grow stronger. Do you want to try the first part?
Okay, I will try. Why is it good for me?
I do not know all the reasons, but it helps you learn. Are you ready to start?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a pizza at home.
That sounds fun. Do you have a cookbook?
No, I do not have one.
I can tell you the basic steps. Do you have any cheese?
Yes, I have mozzarella.
Good. You need dough, sauce, and cheese. Are you ready to start?
Yes, please tell me what to do first.
First, spread the sauce on the dough.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad about that song.
I am sorry you feel that way. What part of it makes you sad?
The words make me feel lonely.
That is a heavy feeling. Do you have friends to talk with?
They do not listen to this kind of music.
I hear you on that. Do you like the melody?
The melody is nice, but the words hurt.
I am glad the sound is good. What song do you like better?
I like songs that make me smile.
Happy songs are great. Do you want to find some now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my robot broke and will not dance.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you know how it broke?
It fell down hard and now its light is out.
That must be tricky. Can you see any broken parts?
Yes, one small arm is off its socket.
That is a problem. Do you have a tool to fix it?
No, I only have tape and glue.
Tape might work for now. Is the robot still a bit warm?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My fence is looking old and bent. What should I do?
You can paint it to make it look new. Do you like bright colors?
I think I will fix the bend first. Is it hard to do?
It is not too hard if you have tools. Do you have a hammer?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel so alone here. I want to learn how to bake bread.
Baking bread is a nice way to spend time. Do you have any flour at home?
I have flour and eggs. How do I start?
Mix the flour, water, yeast, and a pinch of salt. Are you interested in making it sweet or savory?
I like sweet things. What do I do next?
Add sugar and honey to the mix and let it rest. Is that step easy for you to do?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am hungry. What should I eat?
You could try toast with butter. Do you like sweet or salty food?
I like sweet things.
An apple is a good choice.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I found a book I love.
That sounds fun. Do you have a cozy spot?
Yes, I sit by the window. I watch the stars.
Nice. Do you read with a lamp?
I use a small lamp. It is soft and warm. I feel safe.
That is sweet. Sleep well soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I want to try to sing. Why is it so hard?
It is hard at first because your body is new to it. Do you enjoy loud sounds?
Yes, I like loud sounds. How do I make my voice strong?
You breathe from your belly, not your chest. Is that easy for you to feel?
It feels strange. Why do we need to breathe like that?
Deep breathing gives your voice more air to last. Do you run for fun?
I run sometimes. What else should I do to get better?
I do not know your full story, but practice helps a lot. Do you have a quiet room?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I float in water?
Your body has air in it, so it is light like a leaf. Do you like to jump?
Yes, but why does the water push me back?
Water is thick and does not let you pass through easily. It pushes you up to keep you safe.
I want to swim faster.
That is hard to know exactly, but moving your arms helps. Do you like the cold?
It feels good. Why is the pool blue?
The water makes it look blue, but it is clear. We just add color to make it look clean.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a small tree in my yard. I do not know what it is.
That is a lovely find. Does it have round leaves or pointy ones?
The leaves are round and green. The branches look thin.
Thin branches often mean it is still young. Do you see any flowers on it?
No, I do not see any flowers yet. I think it needs water.
You are right to give it water. I do not know the exact kind, but I can check with a book later.
Thank you for your help. I will go get a bucket of water now.
You have a good heart. Do you like how tall it is already?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I do not know how to pack my bag.
Start with the big items first. Do you have big things?
Yes, I have a book and a coat.
Put the book at the bottom. Your coat can fold on top.
How do I fold the coat?
Fold it in half, then in half again. Is it clean?
Yes, it is clean.
Place it neatly inside. You are doing great work.
I have small things too.
Put small items in pockets. What small things?
I have pens and a snack.
Pockets are best for pens. Keep the snack for later.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my dog eat grass?
He might do it to help his tummy feel better. Does he look sad or sick?
No, he just looks hungry.
That sounds like a bad habit. You can stop him by walking past it.
Is that hard to do?
It takes time to learn, but you will get there. How old is your dog?
He is two years old.
Two years is a good age to learn new things. Keep trying gently.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Hi, I want to know how plants drink water. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help. Do you have a plant in your house?
Yes, I have a small green one. How does it get the water into its leaves?
Roots soak up water from the soil. I do not know if all roots work the same way. Do you water it every day?
I water it a little bit. Does the water go up like juice in a straw?
Yes, it moves up the stem. It is like a tiny straw for the plant. Do you like to draw pictures of plants?
I do! One last thing, is it thirsty if the leaves look dry?
Yes, dry leaves mean it needs water. I hope that helps you take good care of it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big tree today. It made me feel so happy.
That is lovely. Do you know what kind of tree it was?
I think it was an oak. Its leaves were green and bright.
Oaks are very strong. Did you touch the bark?
Yes, it felt rough and warm. I want to tell everyone about it.
Sharing joy is sweet. Do you like trees this time of year?
I love them in every season. They give me peace.
Nature has many gifts. What is your favorite part of a tree?
I love how they hold the sky up. It feels so steady.
That is a nice way to see them. Have you planted a tree before?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking up but I do not know what to see.
That is okay. Do you like the big bright ones?
I think I do.
Look for the brightest one first. It leads you to the others.
I see it now.
Great job. Can you count how many you spot?
I can try.
Take your time. The stars will wait for you.
I see two more.
Wonderful. Keep looking.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am very tired and do not know what to do.
How about taking a nap? Do you have a pillow?
I feel stuck and want to walk but the aisle is small.
Walking is good for your legs. Are you scared of bumping into someone?
The movie looks boring but the snack cart is coming.
Snacks can help you feel better. Do you like sweet things?
I think I will just sit and watch the clouds.
Clouds are nice to look at. Do they look like animals?
Thank you, I feel a little better now.
That is great news.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I can not sleep well at night.
That is a tricky feeling. Do you try to lie still?
Yes, I lie very still.
Good. A cool room helps a lot. Is your room too warm?
No, it is very cold.
That is odd. Do you have a warm blanket?
Yes, I have a big, fluffy one.
That sounds nice. Do you eat candy before bed?
Sometimes, I eat a cookie.
That might keep you awake.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The plane is so big and the seats are very hard.
I am sorry you are uncomfortable. Do you have a toy to play with?
Yes, I have a bear, but I am very tired.
That is okay to be sleepy. Would you like me to check on you soon?
Can I go to the bathroom now?
Yes, you can go when you are ready. Is your friend with you?
I think my friend is sleeping next to me.
That is nice to have company.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a small shed. How do I start?
First, you need to pick a flat spot for it. Do you have a good spot in your yard?
Yes, I do. What else do I need?
You will need wood and nails. Do you have a hammer?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for practice. Is the court open?
Yes, it is open. Do you have your racket?
Yes, it is in my bag. Where is the court?
It is behind the tree. What size ball do you use?
I use a red ball. I must go now.
Have fun out there.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do people in that little village have dogs?
Yes, many families keep dogs to help watch their farms. Do you like animals?
I do. Do the dogs run free in the streets?
Usually they stay near their homes, but sometimes they roam a bit. Is your house big?
It is small, but nice. Does the village have a shop for food?
There is one small store that sells fresh bread and fruit. Do you eat bread?
I do. Can I visit that village one day?
Of course, the people there are always happy to see new friends.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to know how sailors find their way when it is dark.
They use stars and maps. Do you like looking up at the sky?
Yes, I do. Is it hard to learn the stars?
It takes time, but it is a fun skill.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the garden today. My tomatoes are so big. They look like little red balls.
That sounds like a fun day. Did you eat any of them?
I did. They were sweet. I want to plant more this week.
Good choice. What kind of vegetables do you like best?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How many fingers do I have on one hand?
You have five fingers on one hand. Do you like to count on your toes too?
I have two hands. How many is that all together?
Two hands with five fingers each makes ten. Do you know how to write the number ten?
I think I know how, but I am not sure.
You can write it as a one with a zero next to it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad because the mountain is too high to climb.
That sounds really hard. Do you want to try a smaller hill first?
Yes, I think I will try the small hill.
That is a great plan.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just read a play and I am so happy.
That sounds wonderful. What is it about?
It is about a dog who finds a bone.
A dog with a bone? Does he keep it?
He gives it to his friend.
That is very kind of him. Did you like the end?
Yes, they are happy together.
What a sweet story.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make my blue look bright?
Add a little white paint to the blue. What color do you want next?
I want to paint a sun.
Yellow works best for a sun. Do you have yellow paint?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I fix a flat tire?
That is a hard task. Do you have a spare wheel?
Yes, I found it under the car.
Great. You need a jack to lift the car. Do you have one?
I do, but I am not sure how to use it.
Put it under the strong part of the car. Do you feel safe doing this alone?
I am a bit scared of falling.
I understand. It is best to ask a grown-up for help first.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How does a big ship float on water?
It floats because it pushes a lot of water down, and the water pushes back up. Do you have a toy boat?
Yes, I have a small blue one.
That is a great way to learn. Try putting coins in it slowly. Watch how it sinks lower each time.
It sank when I added too many coins.
That happens when the water push is not strong enough to hold the weight. Did the water spill into the boat?
No, but the heavy metal was too much.
Metal is heavy, but if it is shaped right, it can hold air. Have you tried an empty bottle?
I will try that tomorrow.
That is a good plan. Air inside helps it stay up.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my boss was mean today.
That feels bad. Was he loud?
Yes, he yelled at me for a small error.
You tried your best. Do you feel better now?
Not really, I just want to leave.
It is okay to be angry.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is great! What made you feel so good?
I found a new book at the library.
Libraries are wonderful places. Do you like reading?
Yes, I love stories about animals.
That sounds fun.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I rode my bike to the park today.
That sounds like fun. Did you see any ducks?
Yes, a big one swam right by me.
Cool! Did you give it some bread?
I did, but I am tired now.
Good job. Go drink some water.
Okay, thanks for listening.
Any time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I count the apples?
Point to each apple and say a number. Do you have any apples right now?
I counted five.
Great job. What is your favorite fruit?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I promise to help you clean the room.
That is a very good promise. What will you clean first?
I will pick up all the toys.
You are being very helpful. Do you have any big toys?
Yes, I have a big truck.
A big truck is hard to carry. Are your arms strong?
I think my arms are strong today.
I believe you can do it well.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I am stuck on this puzzle. Can you help me?
Yes, I would love to help. What part is hard?
The red piece does not fit in the corner. Why is that?
It looks like you need a square piece there. Did you check the other corner?
I did not check that corner. Why would it be there?
Puzzles can be tricky. Do you see a square hole?
I see a square hole now. It fits!
Great job. You solved it!
Thank you for helping me. I feel happy.
You are welcome. Was it fun?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a tiny book about fish. I am so happy.
That sounds like a great find. What is the first thing you see inside?
The whole library smells like rain and old paper.
I love that smell. Do you plan to read it there?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sun feels very hot on my skin.
It is nice and warm. Do you want to sit in the shade?
I do not know if I should move or stay.
I do not know what you like best. Do you like playing in the dark?
I like the light, but I feel tired.
Then you can rest in the cool spot.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a new dog at the park today.
That sounds fun. What did the dog look like?
It was small and brown with floppy ears.
Cute. Did you pet it?
No, it ran away fast.
Oh no. Was that sad?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It rained all day today.
That sounds cozy. Did you see the rain?
Yes, I watched it from my window.
Nice. Was the rain loud or soft?
It was very soft and quiet.
I love quiet rain too. Did you drink warm tea?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make a friend?
Try to say hello first. Is your class busy?
Yes, they are.
Just smile and share a toy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am looking for the park.
It is near the blue river. Do you see the river?
Yes, I see it. Which way is the park?
Turn left at the big tree. Is it sunny there?
It is sunny. Where is the food place?
I am not sure of that. Do you like ice cream?
I like ice cream. Is it close to the park?
Yes, it is right next to the park. Have fun there.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am building a big house out of blocks.
That sounds like so much fun! How many blocks are you using?
I used fifty blocks so far.
Wow, that is a lot! What kind of house is it?
It is a castle for my toy dragon.
A castle is a great idea. Do you have a name for the dragon?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My test was hard and I think I failed.
That feels really bad. Do you want to talk about what went wrong?
I forgot half the words. My brain just went blank.
That happens to everyone. It does not mean you are bad at it.
But my friends got good grades. I feel left behind.
Everyone learns at their own speed. Are you trying your best?
I guess so. But it feels like I am falling behind.
You can still learn the words you missed. Do you want to practice together?
Yes, please. I just want to feel better about it.
We can take it one small step at a time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My cat sat on my knee all day and fell asleep.
That is a very sweet start to your day. Did he snore loudly?
Yes, he made a big sound and then jumped off to drink water.
Cats love a good drink after a nap. Did he find any toys nearby?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a map, but I do not know where to go next.
That is okay. Do you see a blue line?
Yes, there is a line by the water.
Follow the line to the big dot. Is that your home?
I think so, but I am still lost.
I do not know your exact spot. Please tell me what building you see.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost in this big green forest.
Try following the blue line to the river. Where is your home?
My home is near the castle.
The red path leads straight there. Is the sun high in the sky?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my chicken did not lay an egg today.
That can be frustrating. Is she eating her food?
Yes, she ate the corn, but I am still upset about the empty nest.
Sometimes hens just take a day off. Do you think she is bored?
Maybe, but I really wanted to show my friends a new egg.
I get that feeling. Do you have other animals on your farm?
I have a cow, but it is hard to see the little chickens with a big cow.
Size makes it tricky. Does the cow act mean to them?
No, the cow is sweet, but I am still mad that I have no eggs to share.
Your feelings make sense. Would a milk bottle help you feel better?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake cookies.
That sounds fun. What recipe did you pick?
I chose chocolate chip cookies.
Start by mixing the butter and sugar. Do you have a mixer?
Yes, I have a little hand mixer.
Great. Mix until it looks fluffy. Are you ready for the next step?
I am. What comes next?
Add the flour and the eggs. It might get thick. Is that okay?
It looks very thick. Is that good?
Yes, that is perfect. Now fold in the chips. Do you like how it looks?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do bears sleep all winter?
Bears sleep to save energy because food is hard to find. Do you like to sleep a lot?
Why do birds fly south?
They move south to stay warm and eat. I do not know which bird you mean.
Why are wolves loud at night?
Howls help wolves talk to each other in the dark. Do you hear them?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to grow tomatoes in my garden. How do I start?
Put seeds in the dirt and water them. Do you have a sunny spot?
Yes, I do. What do I do next?
Wait for the plants to come up. You are a good helper.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my map, so I took the wrong bus.
Oh no, that is tricky. Did you see a big blue lake?
No, but I found a park with a nice bench.
That sounds peaceful. I do not know the rest of your day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy and I feel bad.
That is a very brave feeling to have. Do you know how to fix the toy?
No, it is broken in two pieces. What should I say?
You can say, "I am sorry I broke it." Do you want to apologize now?
Yes, I do. Is that the right thing to do?
Yes, telling the truth is the best start. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a sick tree. What should I do?
A tree that looks sad needs care. Do you know if it has water?
I am not sure. It looks dry.
That is a good guess. Have you checked the ground nearby?
I will go look now. Thank you.
You are welcome. I hope it feels better soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have seven days in a week?
I am not entirely sure, but the moon has a shape every day for seven days. Do you like the moon?
Yes, I do. Why are there three days in the middle of the week?
They sit between the start and the end to make a nice balance. Do you like Tuesdays?
Maybe. Why is the first day not called day one?
In many places, people start counting with day one. Do you count days?
Yes, I do. Why is the last day called Sunday?
The sun shines bright on that day, so it took the name. Do you like the sun?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to eat a pizza for lunch.
That sounds fun. Do you like cheese on it?
Yes, I love cheese. Is it good for me?
A little pizza is okay sometimes.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took the train to the city today and the wheels went clack clack all the way.
That sounds like a nice ride. Did you see anything cool through the window?
Yes, I saw a big red bridge and some birds flying near the water.
I am glad you had a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad my grandpa is here.
That is wonderful news. How did he get here?
He took a long train ride.
A train is fun. Did he bring any snacks?
Yes, he has cookies for us.
Cookies are sweet. Do you want to share them now?
I will save one for him.
That is very kind of you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I swim in a lake?
First, you must wear a life jacket. Do you have one?
Yes, I do. What do I do next?
Just float on your back and kick your legs gently.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I really do not like this math work.
That sounds hard. Do you know which part is tricky?
The big numbers scare me.
We can break them into small steps.
I feel stuck and tired.
Resting your eyes helps. Is the work due soon?
Yes, tomorrow morning.
Okay, let us try just one problem together.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared of the big test today.
That feels scary. What part worries you the most?
I think I might get it all wrong.
Do you know the answer to the last question?
Yes, I know that one well.
Good. Your hard work is showing.
What if I still fail?
It is not possible to know for sure. Have you eaten breakfast?
Yes, I had toast and jam.
That is a good start. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a snowman?
Roll two snowballs, one big and one small. Do you have any carrots for eyes?
No, but I have buttons. How do I stack them?
Put the small ball on top of the big one. It is very cold outside today, is it not?
Yes, but I am wearing my red coat. Is that enough?
Yes, your red coat is warm and good.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I cast a fishing line?
You swing the rod back and let the line fly out. Do you have a heavy sinker?
I do not know what a sinker is.
It is a small weight to help the bait sink deep. Is the water clear or muddy?
It is very clear and cold.
That is good for fish but hard to see. Do you want to catch trout?
Yes, I want to catch a trout.
Use a bright lure so they can see it. Good luck with your catch.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park and heard a dog bark very loud.
That must have been quite a surprise. Did the dog scare you?
Not really, but it made my head hurt a bit.
Loud noise can do that. Do you like the sound of music more?
Yes, I love singing when I am happy.
That is a sweet way to feel good. What song makes you happiest?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel sad. Can you help me pick a song to make me feel better?
Happy tunes often help lift your spirit. Do you like fast music or slow music?
I like slow music, but I also like loud drums.
Try an upbeat song with a strong beat. Have you tried singing along?
I am not sure I can sing well.
That is okay because it is just for you. Do you want to try one right now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How can I learn a new word?
Read a book or listen to a song. Do you like singing?
Yes, I do.
That helps your brain remember. What is your favorite song?
I like happy tunes.
Great! Keep it fun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is a castle?
A castle is a big, strong house built long ago to keep people safe. Did you see one in a storybook?
Who lived in it?
Kings, queens, and their families often lived in castles. Why do you want to know?
Did they play games?
Yes, they played with dice, balls, and chess pieces. Do you like to play too?
Did they have toys like me?
They had dolls and wooden horses, but they were very expensive. I do not know if they had video games.
That sounds old and funny.
It was a long time ago, so things were quite different. Do you like learning about the past?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I send a letter?
You stick a stamp on the corner. Do you have a stamp?
No, I do not.
You must buy one from the clerk. Is the clerk there?
Yes, I see them.
Go up and ask for it. Are you ready?
Yes, I am going now.
Good luck with your letter.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My cat is hiding under the bed.
That is a common place for cats. Do you have a favorite toy to call him?
I tried the red ball, but he did not come out.
Try using a treat instead. Does he like small fish treats?
Yes, he loves fish. I am trying to get them from the high shelf.
Please do not climb on the shelf. Is there a dog in your home?
No, there is no dog, but my cat is very fast.
He is likely playing with your shadow. Do you like when he plays with you?
I love it, but I want to clean the house.
Wait until he is sleepy to clean. Is his tail happy or twitching?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished cleaning the house. I feel very happy and proud.
That is wonderful to hear. Do you like cleaning the windows?
Yes, I love seeing the clear view. My heart feels light and free.
I am glad you feel that way. What did you clean first?
I started with the living room rug. It is clean and soft now.
That sounds like a great start.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to build a fire.
First, you need dry sticks. Do you have any?
Yes, I have a small pile of them.
Place them in a small pyramid shape.
What do I use to light it?
You need something hot and shiny. Do you have a lighter?
I have a box of matches.
Use one match to start the small sticks.
Why is the small wood first?
Small wood burns fast and gives heat. Is the fire starting?
Yes, it is getting orange and warm.
That is great. Keep it safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I learn to float on my back?
Lie on your back and keep your face in the water. Do you know how to kick your legs gently?
I kick, but I sink fast.
Try to relax your shoulders and take slow breaths. What does your body feel like when you stop?
It feels heavy and scared.
That is normal at first. Just breathe out slowly through your nose. Do you feel a bit lighter now?
A little, yes.
Great, keep practicing a few seconds at a time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is the internet?
It is a big web that connects computers all over the world. Do you have a computer?
Yes, I use it for games.
That is fun. Do your games use the internet?
Some do, but I am not sure why.
It helps you play with people far away. You are smart to ask.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just fixed my chair and I feel so proud!
That is wonderful news! What did you do to fix it?
I found the loose leg and tightened the bolt.
A tight bolt is key. Did you use a tool?
Yes, I used a big red wrench.
How strong are your hands?
I am so happy the chair is steady now.
Good work on the job. Can you sit on it safely?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just rode my bike really fast. It was so much fun.
That sounds great. Did you wear your helmet?
Yes, I always wear my helmet. It feels so free when the wind blows.
Good for you. What did the wind feel like?
It felt cool on my face. I can't stop smiling.
I am happy for you. Is the road safe there?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very lost on this test.
It is okay to feel that way. What question scares you most?
The last one about the numbers.
Let us look at it together step by step.
I still do not get it.
I do not know the answer yet either. Do you want to try a smaller part first?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad about my horse.
That is very hard to feel. What happened?
He is not eating his carrots.
That is a big sign of trouble. Did you call the vet?
No, I was afraid to ask.
The vet knows how to help. Is he feeling hot?
I do not know how to tell.
A warm body can mean sickness. Is he standing still?
Yes, he just looks tired.
Let us call the vet now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, what are those small bugs?
They are ants. Do you like their hard shells?
Can I ignore them?
Yes, just step around them. Are they marching in a line?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a tree idea for my pen right now.
A pine tree is nice. Do you like snow?
Please just tell me the root name.
I do not know that one. Does it have to be a tree?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see a red bird. Where is it going?
It is likely looking for seeds. Do you have any food for it?
I do not have time. What is its name?
It is a cardinal. It likes bright red color.
My bus is coming. Is it safe?
Yes, it is safe. Do you like red birds?
I must go now. Is that true?
Yes, it is true. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know which drink to pick.
Do you like sweet or strong tastes?
I like sweet things but I feel too tired.
Try a cup of coffee if you need energy. It gives you a big boost.
What if I just want to feel warm and calm?
Then hot tea is a better choice. It feels cozy inside.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off trees?
Trees drop leaves to save energy when it gets cold. Do you like raking them?
Yes, I do. How can I help them stay green longer?
You cannot stop the falling, but you can keep the tree healthy with water. Do you water it?
I water it sometimes. How do I know if it is sick?
Look for brown spots or too many fallen leaves. Is your tree looking okay?
It looks fine. Can I put the leaves on the path?
You can pile them up for birds to nest in. That is a kind thing to do.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I clean a lighthouse?
You use a soft brush and warm water. Do you have a brush?
Yes, I have one. What else?
Rinse it well with fresh water. Is it a tall light?
It is very tall. How do I check the glass?
I do not know for sure. Ask a grown-up.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What time is it?
It is ten o'clock. Are you going to school?
Yes. Please tell me again.
It is still ten. Is your bag ready?
No. I need a minute.
You have time. Do you want help?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do sailors look so different from us?
They spend a lot of time in the sun. Do you like the beach?
Why do they not get lost at sea?
They use maps and stars to find their way. I am not sure about all the tricks they use.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to grow food in my yard.
That is a great idea. Do you have a sunny spot for a small pot?
Yes, I have a box near my window.
Perfect. Start with a simple seed like a bean. Do you have some dirt?
I have a bag of soil and water.
Great. Put the seed in the dirt and give it water. What will you call your plant?
I will call it Bob.
Bob sounds nice. Watch for green leaves in a few days.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because my new magnet works!
That is great news! What did it stick to?
It stuck to the iron door with a big thud!
I do not know if all doors have iron in them. Do you feel cool?
Yes, I feel very cool and strong!
Magnets are not alive, but they do have a special power. What will you do next?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a dog stuck in a fence today.
Oh no, that is not good. Did you see if it was hurt?
I called my dad to help pull it out.
That was a very kind thing to do. How is the dog feeling now?
He is happy and is wagging his tail.
I am glad he is safe.
Now I feel warm inside.
That is a great feeling to have.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made my computer run fast today. I feel very proud.
That is great news. How did you do it?
I cleaned up the files. Do you want to see?
I would love to see it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to work from home like Mommy, but I can only play.
That is a fun thought. Do you like playing at your desk?
Yes, I draw pictures and eat snacks all day.
Drawing and snacking sounds nice. Do you feel tired after playing?
Sometimes I feel sleepy, and my tummy hurts.
Your tummy hurts because you ate too much?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked by the lake today.
That sounds nice. Did you see any ducks?
Yes, many white ones swam by.
I do not know if they were hungry. Did you have food?
I had an apple, but I did not share it.
That is a kind thing to keep. Was the air cold?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: Why is my bread getting big?
The tiny bugs inside are eating sugar. Is it warm in your kitchen?
Should I touch it?
No, please do not press it. Do you smell a nice scent?
It smells a bit sweet.
That is a good sign. What did you put inside?
Just flour, water, and salt.
That means you forgot the baker. Do you have any yeast?
I think I left it out.
I do not know why that happened.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see many dots up there. What are they?
They are stars. Do you know how far away they are?
No. Are they very far?
Yes, they are very far. Why do you want to know?
I like looking at them.
That is a good habit. Do you see any big stars?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know where bears live, but I am in a big hurry.
Most bears live in cold forests. Do you like cold places?
Yes, but what do they eat?
They eat fish, berries, and small animals. Is that all you need?
Thanks, but do all bears hibernate in winter?
Yes, most of them sleep for the whole winter. See you later.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to send a letter to my friend. How do I do that?
You just put the letter in an envelope and buy a stamp. Do you like writing letters?
Yes, I do. Where do I get the stamp?
You buy it at the counter next to the mailboxes.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I waited so long for the bread and they gave me the cold one. I am so mad.
That is not fair at all. I am sorry you had a bad day. Do you want to try again later?
I think I just want to go home and eat fruit.
Fruit is a very good idea. I hope your mood gets better soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cried on the beach and felt so small.
The sea is huge, but your heart is strong. Do you like watching the waves?
I just want the water to stop moving so fast.
That is a big wish I cannot grant. Are you feeling better now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I forgot my lines for the play.
Take a deep breath and try to read them again. Do you feel calm now?
I still feel silly.
Everyone makes mistakes sometimes. It is okay to start over.
I do not know what to do now.
I do not know your full script, but you can always ask a friend for help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a lighthouse by the sea today.
That sounds nice. Did you see the light on?
Yes, it was shining bright at night.
Very cool. Do you like boats?
I do, but I did not see any.
That is okay. The quiet night must be calm.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The waves hit my toes and it hurts. I wanted to swim.
I am sorry that happened. Do you have any dry socks in your bag?
No, my socks are wet too. The sand is everywhere.
That sounds messy. Is your bag still with you?
I lost my bag in the water. I am sad.
Let us walk along the shore to look for it. Do you want to hold my hand?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a home for my new goat.
Goats need a strong fence. What kind of fence do you have?
I have a tall wooden fence.
That is good. Goats like to climb.
How do I stop them from climbing?
You can add a wire top to the fence.
Is that hard to do?
It is not hard if you have tools. Do you have a hammer?
I have a big red hammer.
Great. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is it going to rain today?
I think it might rain later. Do you like rainy days?
Not really.
That is okay. It is sunny now though. What do you want to play outside?
Tag.
That is a fun game.
Can it stop raining soon?
I do not know for sure. I hope the sun comes back out.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Do you know where the party is?
It is in the big house next door. Is that your red coat?
Yes, it is. Please tell me where to sit.
I do not know. Do you like the blue chairs?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a worm on my hook.
That is a great start. Where are you sitting?
I am not sure where to cast.
Try the big tree over there. Do you see the water moving?
I dropped the worm in the grass.
Oh no, that happens to everyone. Do you have more worms in your box?
I am stuck and feel sad.
You can fix this. Just pull the line out slowly.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The stars look so far away. I feel lonely looking at them.
That is a heavy feeling. Do you see a single bright star?
Just one, but it feels very small. I miss being close to people.
Distance can feel cold. I do not know your heart, but I am here.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you have cookies with chocolate in them?
Yes, we do. Do you like chocolate?
Yes, I do. They are my favorite thing.
That is good. How many cookies do you want?
I want two cookies.
Great choice. Would you like a milk to drink?
No, thank you. Just the cookies, please.
Okay, I will get them for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you love painting?
It makes me feel calm. Do you like to draw?
I do, a little. Why is blue your favorite color?
It looks like the sky. Do you have a favorite color too?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a song on my phone?
You can use a free app to record your voice. Do you like singing or just humming?
I like humming. How do I keep it straight?
Try tapping your foot on the strong beat. It helps you stay in time.
My feet do not tap fast enough.
Start slow and get faster as you go. Do you play any toys with buttons?
I have a toy piano. Can I use that?
Yes, try playing simple chords under your hum. It sounds nice.
That sounds hard. What chords are simple?
I do not know your exact level, but C major is easy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel so sad today?
I do not know why, but I am here. Do you want to talk about it?
It is just a heavy feeling in my chest.
That feels hard. What helps you feel better?
I like when you listen to me.
I am always here for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
They use their roots to pull water up. Do you like to drink from a straw?
Yes, I do. Why do they need that water?
Water helps them grow big and strong.
Where does the water go after it enters the roots?
It moves up into the stems and leaves. I do not know how it feels to be a leaf.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very tired and sad about the new baby.
It is normal to feel low. How are you sleeping?
I wake up all night and my head hurts.
That sounds really hard. Did you take any breaks today?
No, I have been stuck here for hours.
Please rest now. I can help with chores later.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very lonely and sad.
That sounds heavy. Do you like playing games or reading?
I like to read books about magic.
Books are good friends. Do you have a favorite book?
Yes, it is about a lonely star.
Stars shine alone but light others.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found this old map in my closet. Where does this red line go?
That looks like a long road. Do you know where the house is?
No, I just see trees. Why is there a star here?
Stars often show a goal. Is there a castle nearby?
I do not see a castle. What else is on the map?
I see a river and a bridge. Do you like to cross bridges?
Yes, I love them. Is the lake big?
It looks quite big and blue. Do you want to swim there?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the moon looks so far away.
That is a big and quiet place. Do you like the stars too?
I guess I do. It just feels very lonely up there.
The moon shines just for us here on Earth.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My nose is all stuffed up and my head hurts so bad. I do not like this.
I am sorry you feel so rough. Do you have any soup?
No, just water and a blanket. It is very boring and I just want it to stop.
Rest is the best fix. Have you taken any medicine?
Yes, I took it an hour ago. It still feels terrible and I am mad at my own body.
Sometimes it takes time to get better. I hope the fever goes down soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to pick a song for my party.
What kind of music makes you smile?
I like happy songs with drums.
That sounds fun. Do you want loud or soft sounds?
Loud is best for dancing.
Great choice. Try a song with a fast beat.
Do you know a good one to start?
I do not know your taste, but a classic rock song works well.
I will try that.
Good luck. What instrument do you like best?
I love the guitar.
Cool. Enjoy your party.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to save money, but I never have any left.
That is a good goal. Do you know how much you spend each month?
No, I just see my cards go down.
That is hard to track. You must stop guessing.
How do I stop guessing?
Write down every coin you use. It sounds like a lot of work. Do you like writing things down?
I hate writing, but I will try.
Good. Start with just one week. It is a small step.
Okay, I will start today.
That is great. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I miss my little brother.
That sounds hard. Did you see him today?
No, he is at grandma's house.
I am sorry you missed him. What did you want to talk about?
I want to build a block tower with him.
That is a great idea. Will you build it together when he comes home?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to go camping, but I do not know what to pack.
Bring a tent and a warm jacket. Do you have a map of the area?
I have no idea where I am going.
That is hard to say without more info. Are you close to a big lake or a forest?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love apples. How can I make them taste better?
Try cutting them into small pieces. Do you have any honey?
Yes, I do. Is honey good with fruit?
Yes, it makes them sweet. Do you eat them with or without the skin?
I eat them with the skin. That feels good.
The skin is good for you. Enjoy your tasty snack!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do players run so fast on the field?
They run fast to catch the ball before the other team gets it. Do you like watching games?
I like the big goals, but I never see them.
Goals are hard to score, so they feel very special. Do you play football too?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My cat is not eating. I do not know why. I feel sad.
That is very worrying. Is he drinking water?
He drinks a little. But he just sits by the door and looks at me.
I am not sure why he does that. Please take him to the doctor.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I lost my stamp book. Where can I get a new one?
You can buy one at the counter. Do you have a pen with you?
Yes, I have a blue pen.
That is good. You can write your name on the first page.
I do not have the letter address.
That is a problem. I do not know the right address. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I can call my friend.
That is the best way. Please ask them for the full street and number.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared to ride the train alone.
That is a big step, but you can do it. Do you have a book to read?
Yes, I packed my favorite story.
That will help pass the time nicely. Do you know which car you are in?
I am not sure which car it is.
You can look at the seat number on your ticket. It will tell you the car.
Oh, that is a good idea.
I hope you enjoy the ride. Will you sit by the window?
Yes, I like to watch the trees go by.
The views are very pretty. You will be safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at my book, but I do not know what to do next.
Do not worry, I am here to help. What subject is this?
It is math, and the numbers are so hard for me.
Let us look at the first problem together. Can you read the top line?
I think I get it now, and I will try to write it down.
That is a great start. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. What made you feel this way?
I lost my favorite toy.
That is a fair thing to be upset about. Do you want to talk about it?
Yes, please.
