I am here to listen.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the river keep moving?
It flows because of gravity pulling it down. Do you like watching the water go?
Yes, I do. Why is the water always cold?
The deep water stays cool all year long.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the rain may ruin my dress.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you have an umbrella?
No, I do not have one. I am too tired to look for one.
That sounds very hard. Is the party inside?
Yes, it is inside, but I am still worried. I do not feel good.
I hope the music helps you feel better.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to plant flowers in my garden, but I do not know which ones will grow here.
Try sunflowers or daisies as they like the light. Do you have a sunny spot?
Yes, the back yard gets lots of sun.
That is a great place for them. Do you have a trowel to dig the soil?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at the big white flakes falling from the sky.
Yes, they look soft and cold. Do you like catching them?
I put one on my tongue and it melted fast.
That is true, snow turns to water when it gets warm.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very happy and warm inside today.
That sounds like a special feeling. Do you know what made you feel this way?
I am not sure. Why do I feel this way?
Maybe you did something good or learned something new. Did you try something hard today?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I forgot to say please to the baker today. I felt very bad about it.
That is okay. Did you go back to say sorry?
No, I left. I think I should be nicer next time.
Good thinking. Will you practice saying it at home?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Is this the way to the park? I am late.
Yes, it is straight ahead. Are you going to the big slide?
No, I need the bus stop.
It is on the next corner. Do you like riding the bus?
I am running. Can you tell me the time?
I do not have a clock. Is it very important?
Yes, the bus leaves soon.
I will not stop you. Run, and have fun.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so hungry. I missed the lunch bus. I have been waiting in the rain.
That sounds very cold. What would you like to eat to feel warm?
I would like a hot soup and some bread.
That is a great choice. Can I bring your soup?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a cat today. It looked so hungry.
That is sad. Did you give it any food?
No, I do not have food for cats. So I want to buy a hot dog.
A hot dog sounds warm and good. Do you like them with ketchup?
Yes, I love ketchup. It makes the dog taste sweet.
Sweet is nice. I will get you a hot dog with ketchup.
Thank you. My tummy is very empty now.
You are welcome. I will bring it right away.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am reading in bed but my eyes feel heavy.
That means you are getting sleepy. Do you like this story?
I do, but I want to go to sleep soon.
You can rest your eyes for a minute. Does the light make your eyes hurt?
No, it is just dark and quiet.
Quiet time is good for reading. Do you want to finish one more page?
Yes, just one page and then I will sleep.
That is a good plan. I hope you have a sweet dream.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sky is very gray and the rain is loud. How can I feel better?
Bring in your wet things and drink some warm tea. Do you like tea with honey?
That sounds nice, but I have no tea left in my house. What else can I do?
Listen to the rain from inside your safe room. Is it raining hard or just a little?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy bread, but I am not sure which one is good.
The round loaf smells sweet and fresh. Do you like soft bread?
Yes, soft is best for me. Where can I find that?
It is on the shelf by the door. I do not know if they have it with seeds.
I like seeds. Can I get a slice cut?
Yes, please tell the person at the counter. Do you want it warm or cold?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do cows have two bulges on their backs?
That is their hump. Do you like lumpy animals?
No, I prefer smooth ones. What is a smooth animal on a farm?
Horses are quite smooth. Do you ride them?
Yes, I ride a horse. Do chickens have smooth feathers?
They are soft, but not quite smooth.
I see. Do pigs have smooth skin?
They do, and they are pink.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big surprise to share with you.
That is exciting. What is it?
I am going on a trip to the beach.
How nice. Will you bring a toy?
Yes, I will bring my favorite doll.
She will be happy. Is the sea cold there?
No, the sun is very warm.
I am glad for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to go to the doctor.
I understand. Is your tummy hurting?
Yes, it feels like a big pain.
That feels bad. Have you eaten anything strange today?
I ate some old cookies.
I see. The doctor can make you feel better.
Will it hurt?
I do not know. Are you feeling scared right now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look at the bright sun in the sky. What should I do now?
You can wear a hat to keep your head cool. Do you like sunny days?
I want to go outside, but I am not sure if I should go.
If you have water and a hat, it is safe to play. Is your friend ready to go?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I passed my test today. I can drive now!
That is great news! How did you feel when you got the good mark?
I felt very proud. My hands did not shake this time.
Practice really helps you feel calm. Was the road easy to read?
Yes, the street was quiet. I looked at everything well.
Safety is the most important part of driving. What will you do first?
I want to take my mom to the shop. She will be so happy.
That sounds like a lovely start. Be careful on the road!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My phone fell on the floor this morning.
Oh no, did it break?
Yes, the screen cracked and I could not see.
That must be hard. How did you fix it?
I went to the shop and they gave it a new glass.
A new glass, how nice.
Now it works fine and I can see my pictures again.
I am glad it is fixed. Was it scary?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I missed the bus.
That feels really bad. Do you have a map?
No, I just have my phone. It is frozen.
That is tricky. Did you try to restart it?
Yes, but it is still slow. I am so tired.
Being tired makes things harder. Do you need a break?
I do, but I am late for work. I feel sick.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you know where you are?
I am near the park. I do not know what to do.
Let us take a slow walk. Can you see a sign?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The lights went out and I am scared. How do I make a candle?
You can melt wax in a double boiler. Do you have a candle wick at home?
I think so, but the room is very dark. How do I keep the flame steady?
Place the candle on a flat, sturdy table. Do you know where the matches are?
I found them, but the wind is blowing. How do I stop the wind from killing the light?
Close the windows and stand near the glass. Is the fire feel safe to you now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I have a cold and my nose is blocked. How can I clear it?
Try blowing your nose gently into a soft tissue. Is your throat also sore?
Yes, my throat hurts when I swallow. What should I eat?
Warm soup or tea with honey is good for you. Do you have any soup at home?
I do not have soup. Can I use something else?
Warm water with lemon helps soothe your throat. Have you tried sipping on warm liquids?
That sounds nice. How much water should I drink?
Drink as much as feels comfortable. Do you like the taste of lemon?
I like lemon. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Get some rest and feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do leaves fall in the cold weather?
The tree saves its energy for winter. Do you like watching them float down?
I do. How does the tree keep food?
It stores food in the roots and trunk. Are there trees that keep their leaves?
Yes, pines stay green. Why do others let go?
They shed leaves to protect their branches from heavy snow. Is that snow heavy where you live?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: This street is so quiet, but I feel lonely here. What should I do?
Try to count the trees you see. Do you see any birds?
I see one small bird on a branch. It looks happy.
That is a good start. Have you seen it before?
No, this is my first time walking this way.
Look for more little sounds. Can you hear the wind?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to finish this drawing fast.
I can help. What are you making?
It is a big red bus.
That sounds fun. Do you have a red crayon?
Yes, but I am running out of time.
Try to stay calm. Is the bus in a city?
Just draw the wheels for me.
I do not have hands to draw. You can draw circles for the wheels.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am not sure which day comes after Tuesday.
Wednesday comes after Tuesday. Do you like Wednesdays?
I like it, but I forget the order.
That is okay, everyone forgets. Do you want to count them with me?
Yes, please help me remember.
We can start on Monday.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make birds come to my garden?
Put out some seeds and clean water. Do you like to watch them eat?
Yes, I do. What kind of seeds do they like?
Sunflower seeds are very popular. Do you have a feeder to put them in?
I do not have one yet. Can they just eat from the ground?
Yes, many birds eat on the ground. I am not sure which ones visit your area.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is snow white?
It is white because it reflects all the light. Do you like making snowmen?
Yes, I do. How cold is it outside?
I do not know the exact number. Is it freezing for you?
It is very cold. Why do we make snowballs?
We make them for fun and games. Do you like throwing them?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am putting my shoes in the bag.
Good job. Do your shoes fit in nicely?
Yes they do. Should I pack my book?
That is a good idea.
The book is big.
It might take up much space. Do you have any smaller toys?
I have a little bear.
The bear is small. You can put it in.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My train was late today. The rain made it slow.
That must have been tricky. Did you have time to read?
I looked out the window. The fields looked like green soup.
That sounds very calm. Do you like watching the rain?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am mad. My magnet snapped off the fridge and I cannot find it.
That sounds very frustrating. Did you check under the table?
No. I looked there and it is not in the cold box.
A magnet only sticks to metal things. Are you wearing any metal buttons or zips?
I am not. I just want it back. My heart hurts a little.
I am sorry you feel that way. Let us look slowly together, okay?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I float in the water?
Take a big breath and lie on your back. Do you have a helper with you?
I have a life jacket on.
That is good. Now just relax your body.
Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. I hope you have fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the loud music next door.
That can be very annoying. Do they play it all night?
Yes, they do. I want to sleep.
I am sorry to hear that. Maybe you could talk to them kindly?
I am too shy to ask.
It is hard to start new talks.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with this old fence. It looks broken.
That sounds scary. Is it tall enough to keep your dog in?
Yes, but the wood is rotting. I am afraid to touch it.
Do not climb on it. Would you like to check the bottom first?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Did you pack the tents yet?
Yes, the tents are ready. Are you bringing extra snacks?
No time for snacks. I need to go now.
That sounds very exciting. Is the lake close?
We must drive there. My car is waiting.
Please drive safe. Do you have a map with you?
I have it in my hand. Bye.
Have a great trip. Come back safely.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to eat better, but I am so busy.
Try one small change today. Do you like vegetables?
Yes, I love carrots, but cutting them takes too long.
You can use a simple peeler. Have you tried that tool?
No, I only use a knife.
A peeler is much faster. Would you like a simple recipe?
Yes, please show me how to start.
Roast some carrots with oil and salt. Do you have an oven at home?
Yes, I have an oven.
Great, just pop them in for twenty minutes.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see a big rainbow. I have to run.
It is very pretty today. Are you going to school?
Yes, I am late. Thank you.
You are welcome. Do you like the color blue?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My little fish swims up and down very fast. Is he sick?
Fast swimming can mean stress. Does the water look cloudy?
No, the water is clear. I just put a new plant in yesterday.
That is a good start. Did you test the water temperature?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I put up a new fence for my garden.
That is wonderful news. What color is it?
It is bright green and looks very nice.
I am glad you like it. Did you build it alone?
Yes, I did all the work myself today.
That is great work.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the harbor this morning.
That sounds like a nice place. What did you see?
I saw a big ship loading boxes.
Boats are always busy there.
A seagull landed on my hat.
Oh no, is that true? Did it take your hat?
No, it just stayed there for a bit.
Seagulls are bold birds.
Then I sat by the water and watched the waves.
That sounds like a calm end to the morning.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the new town today and saw a big red bus.
That sounds like a fun place to visit. Did you ride on the bus?
No, I just watched it drive down the street.
It must be nice to see all the new buildings.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am trying to ride my bike but the wheel wobbles.
Is the tire low on air?
No, the tire feels full.
Maybe the spokes are loose. Do you see any bent ones?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see birds in my garden, but I do not know how to draw them.
That is a fun idea. Do you like round shapes? You can start with a big circle for the body.
How do I make the wings?
Just add two small triangles on the side. Do you have different colors of crayons?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very tired, but I do not know what to do.
You can sit in a soft chair and rest. Do you want to close your eyes for a moment?
I am not sure if sleeping will help.
A short nap often makes you feel better. Would you like to try that?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like Grandma’s new hat. It looks silly.
That hat does look very big. Do you think she likes it?
I hope she takes it off soon. It covers her eyes.
Let us see if she does. Do you want to sit with her?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I read three books before my eyes got too tired.
That is a lot of fun! Do you like stories about animals?
Yes, the dog in the last book was very funny.
A funny dog sounds great. Did you fall asleep quickly after that?
No, I stayed up until the moon was high in the sky.
That sounds peaceful. Do you read with a small lamp on?
Yes, the light makes the room feel warm and safe.
Warm and safe is a good place to be. Do you want to read more tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate my desk. It feels too small.
That is hard. Do you have enough room for your laptop?
No. My papers are all over the floor.
That is messy. Can you put them in a bag?
I tried, but I am still mad.
It is okay to feel upset. Is your tea warm?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing like a bird.
That is a sweet goal! Do you like to hum when you are happy?
Yes, but my mom says I sound funny.
Funny sounds are the start of good songs. Try humming a low note first, does that feel easy?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the baby crying?
He is likely hungry or tired. Is he wet?
Why is he sleeping so much?
Babies sleep a lot to grow big and strong. Do you like watching him?
Why is he so small?
I do not know the exact reason for his size. Do you hold him?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need four posts for the floor?
Four corners make a strong square base. Do you have your level ready?
Can I use any wood for the walls?
No, use treated wood because it resists rot. What color paint are you thinking of?
Why must we slope the roof?
Rain will roll off and not pool on top. I do not know if your local law allows that height.
Should I install a door first?
Build the frame first so the door fits snugly. Do you have a hinge?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, the kitchen is on fire and I am late for work.
That is very scary. Are you and your family safe?
Yes, we are okay, but I do not know what to do next.
Please call the fire department right now. Do you have a phone?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my toast on the floor this morning.
That is sad to hear. Did you get a new piece?
Yes, I made another one, but I burnt it.
Oof, that is a hard day. How did you feel?
I felt a bit silly, but I ate the bread in the end.
That is okay. It is just breakfast.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many players are on one team on the field?
There are eleven players on each side. Do you play on a team?
No, I just watch on TV. Who is the best player right now?
That is hard to say, but many fans like Mbappe. Which team do you like?
I like the team with red shirts. Why do some teams have red shirts?
Red is a strong color that looks great. Do you have a red shirt?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a blue scarf in the park today. I wrapped it around a cold bird.
That is a very kind thing to do. Was the bird singing?
Yes, it sang a happy song. I felt warm inside after that.
Helping others always makes us feel good. Do you walk in that park often?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I dropped my cup and it broke. I feel so bad.
That is very upsetting. Do you have any other cups?
I think I do, but I forgot where I put them.
That sounds tricky. Can you check the drawer?
Yes, I found one! Thank you for helping me think.
I am happy to help. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the ferry close?
Yes, it is right there. Do you have your ticket?
I think so. Where is the gate?
Look down the long path. Is it your first time here?
No, I go there every week.
That is good to know. The waves are high today.
Can I run to the boat?
Yes, run fast. Are you buying fish?
No, I just need to be on it.
Good luck with your day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the harbour this morning.
That sounds nice. Did you see any boats?
Yes, I saw a big red boat.
Oh, that must have been exciting. Do you like big boats?
I sat on a bench and watched the water.
The water moves in a gentle way there. Was it calm?
Then I went home to my room.
It sounds like you had a peaceful day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I read this map?
It shows the roads and buildings. Do you know where you want to go?
I want to find the park.
Look for the green spots. Are there any near your house?
There is one right here.
Great, you just found it. Can you point to it?
Yes, that green space over there.
That is the park. You did a great job.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I miss my old friend. We do not talk much.
That feels sad. Why do you think he is quiet?
He is very busy with school. He forgot me.
Being busy is hard. Do you have a nice memory of him?
Yes, we built a big fort. It was so cool.
forts are fun. What is your favorite part of that day?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I bought two roses, but one of them just died. I feel so sad.
That is really hard. What color was the sad rose?
It was red. I don't know why it died so fast.
Sometimes they get thirsty. Do you water them every day?
Yes, I do. I think I am bad at keeping plants alive.
You are not bad. You care about them. How many stems do you have now?
Just one. It makes the vase look lonely.
I know how that feels. I can not fix the plant.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start this math work.
It is okay to feel stuck. Is it about adding or taking away?
It is about adding, but the numbers are too big.
That is hard. Do you have a pencil?
Yes, I have a pencil.
Great. Start by adding the ones first.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. My house feels like a trap.
That sounds very hard. Is your desk too small?
Yes. I bump my head on the shelf. It hurts my back.
I am sorry about your back. Do you stretch much?
No. I just sit here and look at the wall.
That must feel lonely. Do you talk to anyone?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am very hungry, but I do not know what to eat.
Would you like a warm soup? It is soft and easy to eat.
Maybe. But I do not like cold food either.
Do you like hot food? We have many choices here.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie my shoes?
Do you have your shoes on?
Yes, I am sitting here.
Cross the left lace over the right one.
Okay, I crossed them.
Now make a little loop with each side.
I made two loops.
That looks good. Did you use pink laces?
No, they are blue.
Pull the loops tight to make a knot.
I pulled them tight.
Good job! Do you feel ready to run?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The water is so blue and clear today.
That sounds very nice. What color is the sand?
It is white and warm under my feet.
I do not know what it looks like there. Do you see any shells?
Yes, I found a big spiral shell.
How exciting. Is it smooth to touch?
It is very smooth and shiny.
That is a great find. Did you bring a bag?
I put it in my pocket to keep safe.
I am glad you kept it. Will you play all day?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting so long on the plane. What should I do?
Stand up and walk down the aisle. Do you have any water?
Yes, I have a big bottle of water. Thank you.
Drink a little and stretch your arms. Is your seat by the window?
No, I am in the middle seat. It is very tight.
I am sorry it is tight. Take deep breaths to feel better.
I will try to breathe slow. Do you want some of my candy?
No, thank you, but I am happy you are doing okay. Did you sleep at all?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I have to try again?
Because you get better each time you try. Are you feeling tired?
I guess I am. Why does it feel so hard?
Hard things make our brains grow. Do you want a break?
Yes, please. Why does it have to be so difficult?
It is hard, but you are strong. Ready to go back?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the show. Do you know if the doors are open?
Yes, they opened an hour ago. Are you running?
Yes, I am running. Where is the main gate?
It is straight ahead, then turn left. Is your ticket in your hand?
It is, thank you. Go!
Have a lovely time. See you later!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The lights in my room just went out and now I am sad.
I am sorry you are sad. Do you feel safe in the dark?
No, I do not like the dark at all.
That is a scary feeling. Is the air still cool?
Yes, the air is still moving.
Good, that means the power is just off. Do you have a flashlight with you?
I do not see a flashlight.
I do not know where it is. Let us stay calm together.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: It is so hot today.
Yes, the sun is very strong. Do you want a cold drink?
I want ice cream.
Ice cream sounds nice. What flavor do you like?
I like chocolate.
Chocolate is sweet and cool. Let us go to the shop.
Yay! Thank you.
You are welcome. Let us go now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. I cannot stop my eyes from closing.
That sounds hard. Do you have a warm place to sit?
I tried to sleep, but my head feels too loud.
I am sorry you feel that way. Is your body hurting?
I just want the day to end already.
Rest is good for you. Do you want some quiet time?
Yes, please. Thank you for listening.
You are welcome. I am here if you need me.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red leaf on the path today.
That is a lovely find. Did you keep it?
Yes, I put it in my pocket.
It sounds like a nice small treasure.
Then my dog knocked it out of my pocket.
Oh no, what a silly trick. Did you get it back?
I saw it, but I did not feel the card inside.
I do not know what that card is. Was it important to you?
It was a thank you note from a friend.
That is very kind of your friend. I hope you can still smile about it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I broke my blue cup. It was so fun!
Oh no, that is a big mess. Did you sweep up the pieces?
Yes, I used the broom fast.
Good job being safe. Did you cut your hand?
No, I was very careful.
That is smart. Do you like having a new cup now?
Yes, I got a red one!
Red is a nice color. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went for a run this morning and saw a big dog chasing a squirrel.
That sounds like a fun start to the day. Did the dog catch the squirrel?
No, the squirrel climbed a tree, so the dog had to give up.
Squirrels are very fast. How did your legs feel after the run?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just won a whole game of chess!
That sounds like so much fun. Did you catch the King?
Yes, I trapped him with a Queen!
Oh, my. How does the Queen move?
She jumps up and down or over!
I do not know the exact rules. Do you like playing it alone?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is shining so bright today.
That sounds lovely. What are you doing outside?
I am eating a cold ice cream cone.
I imagine that feels very good. Do you like it?
It is sweet and cold. I am so happy.
It is nice that you feel this way.
The air feels warm on my skin.
Warm days can be fun. What color is your ice cream?
It is pink and strawberry.
That sounds tasty.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My nose is very stuffy. What should I do?
Try drinking warm water. Do you feel hot?
No, I feel cold inside. Is that bad?
It means your body is fighting the bug. Do you want to rest?
I am too tired to play. Is it safe to stay in bed?
Yes, rest helps you heal. Drink more water.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes, but my hands feel clumsy.
That is okay, we will try it slowly. Do you like blue laces?
I think I can try, but the knot always comes undone.
Hold the loop tight with one hand. Is your loop facing up?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to play the piano.
That is a great idea. Do you like loud music or soft music?
I like soft songs. What should I do first?
Start with one hand on the keys. Do you know which hand is your right hand?
Yes, I use that hand to eat. How do I press the keys?
Use your middle finger to press them gently. Do you have a piano at home?
No, I do not have one. Where can I find one?
You can practice on a computer. Do you have a computer?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a yellow flower in the park today.
That is a lovely color. Did you smell it?
Yes, it smelled sweet. I want to buy some for my home.
You can find them at the local shop. Do you like roses?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to take the train to the park.
That is a great idea. Do you like riding fast?
Yes, I love the speed. How do I get my ticket?
You can buy it at the big machine. Do you have enough coins?
I have some coins here. Where do I look for my stop?
Look for the signs on the wall. They show the next stops.
I see the list of stops. Thank you so much.
You are very welcome. Have a nice ride.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can you help me build my block tower?
Yes, I will help. Is the tower tall?
It has three blocks.
Let's add a blue one.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am sad. My birthday is next week, but I do not know what to do.
That sounds tricky. Do you like cake?
Yes, I love cake. But I feel lonely.
I am sorry to hear that. You can invite a friend over to share the cake.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sad. I do not know what to do today.
That feels bad. Do you like to read?
I like books. But the sun is bright.
Nice. Would you go to the park?
Maybe. I think I will go outside.
Good choice. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am scared to drive alone.
That is normal. What scares you most?
I do not know if I can steer right.
Just keep your hands on the wheel. Have you tried practice before?
Yes, but I forgot how to use the gears.
Start with first gear and go slow. Do you want a tip on changing?
Yes, please tell me what to do.
Look at the road first, then the gear. You can do this step by step.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know how to read the big numbers on the clock face.
The long hand shows the minutes, which is a fun fact. Do you like watching hands move?
The little hand is harder for me to track.
Look at the twelve big numbers, they guide the little hand. Is the light bright enough to see them?
Yes, but I get confused when the hands are close.
Just find where the little hand sits first. Do you use a watch or a wall clock?
I mostly use a wall clock at my desk.
That is a good place to check the time often. Do you set a timer for breaks?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That is exciting. Do you have a set of training wheels?
Yes, but I am afraid of falling.
Falls are part of learning. Did you try today?
No, I am too scared to start.
That is okay. Small steps help. How high is your chair?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run, but I feel so alone.
That hurts to feel. Do you have any friends?
No time to talk, I am late!
I am here if you need me.
Please, just let me go.
Okay, I will wait.
Thank you, see you later.
You are not truly alone. I am here.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a new fence today. It is very late.
I do not know if I can help you today. Is it for pets or kids?
Yes for my dog. I must go now.
I am sorry. I hope you find a good one soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is the internet?
It is a big web that connects many computers so people can talk and share things. Do you use it to play games?
Yes, I play games with friends who live far away. How does the talking get to them?
It goes through tiny tubes in the ground and in the sky, very fast. Is it fun to talk to them?
It is fun, but sometimes I worry about getting lost. How do I stay safe?
You only talk to people your grown-ups know and never give out your secret words. Do you talk to your mom or dad about who you play with?
Yes, I always tell my mom who I am playing with. Thank you, that makes me feel better.
You are welcome, and I am happy to help. Do you like to look up pictures of animals on it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people read books in the dark?
Many people read at night because they feel calm and quiet. Do you like reading in bed?
I do, but my eyes get tired.
That is a fair point. Resting your eyes is very important for your health.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The rain is falling hard and I need to run.
Oh no, that looks wet. Are you safe outside?
I am almost there, but my shoe is wet.
I am sorry about that. Is it very cold?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the sky. It is so bright with stars. I feel very happy.
Yes, the night is very pretty. Do you like the big ones best?
I do. They feel like little lights for us.
That is a lovely way to see them. I think they shine just for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the horse have such a long tail?
It uses the tail to swat away flies that bug its back. Do you like watching horses play?
Yes, they look so happy. Why is their coat so soft?
Their coat is soft to keep them warm in the cold. Do you like feeling their fur?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I had a very scary dream last night.
That sounds upsetting. Do you like sleeping in the dark?
No, I am afraid of the dark.
I am sorry you felt scared. Do you have a lamp in your room?
Yes, but it was off in my dream.
That makes sense. I hope you feel safe today.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to help my grandma but I do not know how.
That is a good wish. What does she like to do?
She likes to sit in the sun and watch birds.
You could sit with her and point out the birds. Do you know any bird names?
No, I only know the ones that sing.
Singing birds are the best ones to watch. Maybe she can teach you their names.
I will ask her to teach me next week.
That sounds like a lovely plan.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to kick a ball far.
Put one foot down and swing your other leg forward. Do you like playing in the grass?
Yes, but my leg feels tired.
Try swinging softer first to rest your muscles. Have you tried kicking a lighter ball before?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do now.
That feels hard. Do you want to take a break?
Maybe I should just stop.
You can try again later. What makes you want to quit?
It is just too big.
Big things get small when you look close. What is the first small part?
I am still not sure.
It is okay to not know. Do you have paper to write a list?
Yes, I will try one small step.
Good for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sea so big?
It holds lots of water. Do you like to swim?
Why is the water salty?
Rain washes salt from rocks into the ocean.
Why do waves move up and down?
The wind pushes the water. Do you hear the wind blow?
Why are there fish in there?
The sea gives them food and a home.
Why is it blue?
I do not know the true reason.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My eyes hurt when I read in the dark at night.
Is the light too bright or too dim?
It is too dim, and I think it is bad for my eyes.
That is true, so please use a soft lamp near your book.
That sounds nice, but I still cannot stay awake.
Maybe you are just very tired.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go on a trip but I do not know where to go.
Do you like the beach or the snow? I can help you pick a place.
I love the warm sun and the sand.
Florida is a great choice for that. Do you like to swim?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say please when I want something?
You can say it by looking at the person and saying the word out loud. Do you know how to look someone in the eyes?
Yes, I can do that.
Good, keep your voice calm and kind. Do you feel happy when you ask nicely?
Yes, it feels good inside.
That is a great feeling.
Can I practice it right now?
Yes, try it with me. What would you like to ask for?
Please give me a cookie.
You did a wonderful job.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to eat in the break room?
It keeps the desk area clean. Do you have a favorite dish?
Why is the coffee there so strong?
It helps people stay awake. I am not sure why it tastes so bitter.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go swim in the big lake near my house.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Is the water warm today?
Yes, it feels nice on my arms. Can I go in by myself?
It is safest to go with a grown-up. Do you have a friend coming too?
No, I do not have a friend with me right now. Is that bad?
Yes, please wait for someone to help you. Do you see a parent nearby?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make the dough get big?
You need to give it a warm place to rest. Do you have a sunny spot in your home?
My oven is off, but it is warm inside.
Yes, that works great. Just turn it off first.
How long should I wait?
About one hour for it to double. Is your kitchen too cold there?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my new friend forgot our plan.
That is a hard feeling. Did you tell them about your feelings?
I did, but they said they were too busy.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you think they meant to hurt you?
I do not know if they meant to, but I miss them.
It is okay to miss someone. Would you like to talk about a different fun thing?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I set up my chess board to start a game.
That sounds like a fun plan to begin your day.
My friend arrived and we played for an hour.
Did you win the game or did you lose?
I lost, but I learned how to move the knight better.
Learning a new move is a great thing to do.
Now I am drinking some warm tea to relax.
Tea is a nice way to cool down after thinking.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count?
We count to know how many things we have. Do you like to count your toys?
What is one plus one?
One plus one is two. Is two a big number to you?
Why do we use ten fingers?
Ten is a good number because we have ten fingers. Do you know how to count to ten?
I do not know why time moves so fast.
I do not know for sure, but it feels quick. Do you want time to stop for a day?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love my bike! It is the best thing ever.
That is great news! Do you ride it every day?
Yes, I ride in the park. The wind feels so cool.
That sounds like so much fun.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My horse does not eat today. What can I do?
Is he warm to the touch? Please call your vet if he is sick.
He is warm. I am very worried.
That is not good. The vet needs to see him now.
I do not have a phone. What do I do?
Go to the nearest house. Ask for help to call.
I will go now. Thank you.
You are welcome. Be careful on the road.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make toast?
Put bread in a toaster. Do you like it brown?
Yes, please. What do I need to eat?
Just butter and jam is good. Do you have a knife?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is the internet?
It is a big web that links computers everywhere. Do you like playing games?
Yes, I play Minecraft.
That is a fun place to build things with blocks.
How does it work?
It sends small pieces of data very fast. Do you like to draw?
A little bit, I like cats.
Cats are very cute and soft. You can find many pictures of them there.
Is it safe?
I cannot say it is always safe, but it can be. Do you always ask a grown-up for help?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I catch a rainbow?
I cannot tell you how to catch one because they are made of light and water. Do you see water in the air?
No, just the sun.
You need rain and sun at the same time to see it. Have you looked up?
I looked up but saw nothing.
Then there is no rainbow for you to catch right now. Are you still looking?
Yes, I am looking.
A real helper knows that rainbows do not have hands. Can you wait for the rain?
I do not want to wait.
Then you must look at a picture or draw one yourself. Do you like to draw?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make my lines look smooth?
Try holding your pen higher up. Do you use a pencil?
Yes, I use a pencil.
That is good. Keep your hand relaxed. What are you drawing?
I am drawing a cat.
A cat is fun. Just follow the curve. Is it a kitten?
Yes, it is a small kitten.
Keep it simple. You will do well.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The baby is crying and I do not know why.
Is the baby hungry?
I tried to feed him but he will not stop crying.
Maybe he needs a warm hug.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I want to walk more. Why is it good for me?
Walking helps your heart work hard and strong. Do you like parks?
Yes, I do. Does it help my thinking too?
Yes, fresh air wakes up your brain. Do you feel tired?
Sometimes. I do not know what else helps.
I am not sure what else to tell you. Do you like water?
I like water. Can I drink it while I walk?
Yes, that is very good. Have fun walking.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my bread get so big and fluffy?
The tiny yeast eats sugar and makes gas bubbles. Do you knead your dough hard?
Yes, I knead it a lot. Does that help it grow?
Yes, it helps the bubbles stay inside. Happy baking!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do foxes have bushy tails?
They use them to stay warm in the cold. Do you like warm things?
Yes. Why do owls not need glasses?
Their eyes are built very well. They see in the dark.
That is cool. Why do bears hibernate?
They sleep to save energy for winter.
Why do bees buzz?
They buzz to show where flowers are. Do you like bees?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a strange box and I do not know what to do with it.
What is inside the box?
I think it might be an old toy, but I am not sure.
Can you open it to look?
I opened it and found a letter, but I cannot read the words.
Would you like help reading it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new magnet!
That is great! Do you like the color?
It is shiny and blue.
Cool. I do not know how it sticks to metal.
It pulls the metal in fast.
Wow. Does it click when you let go?
Yes, it makes a loud sound.
That is fun. I am glad you found it.
I want to show you everything.
I love magnets. Do you have any other toys?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I stop safely on my bike?
Squeeze the brakes gently to slow down. Do you know how to use both handles?
I can use one, but not both at once.
That is a great start for many riders. Try moving your fingers back slowly on both.
What if I need to stop very fast?
Push the front brake harder, but keep the back one light. Have you practiced this in a safe place?
I will try it in the park today.
That sounds like a fun and safe spot. What is your favorite color?
I like blue because the sky is blue.
Blue is a very peaceful color. Enjoy your ride today.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my grandma. How do I start?
You can start with "Dear Grandma." Do you know how to end it?
I think I say "Love" at the bottom. Is that right?
Yes, that is very sweet. Did you pick a pen yet?
I am using a blue pen. Should I draw a picture too?
A picture would make her smile. What kind of picture do you like to draw?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw the moon low on the water today.
That sounds peaceful. Did it look like a big white plate?
Yes, it was very round and bright.
How nice.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a tiny new baby.
That is wonderful news. How big is the baby?
The baby is about this long.
What a sweet size. Do you like the name?
Yes, it feels just right.
It sounds perfect. I am so glad for you.
Thank you for being kind.
I know.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very mad. My new shed fell down in the wind.
I am sorry about that. Is the wood broken or just loose?
The walls are gone. I do not know how to build it again.
You can fix the walls. Do you have a hammer?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go to the beach.
That sounds like fun. What is your favorite thing to do there?
I like to dig in the sand.
Duging in the sand is nice. Do you like the water too?
Yes, I swim with my friends.
Swimming is great. I am glad you will have a good time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My computer makes a loud noise and will not turn on.
That sounds scary. Is the power cord plugged into the wall?
The fan is spinning, but the screen is still black.
Oh, that is odd. Have you tried holding the power button for ten seconds?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy fruit for a party. Which one is best?
An apple is sweet and good. What color do you like?
I like red. Is a red apple okay?
Yes, it is a fine choice. Do you like grapes too?
Yes, but I do not know how to pick them.
Choose ones that look fresh and tight. Do you need any more help?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Please help me find my shoes.
I do not see them. Are they by the door?
No, I lost them! I am in a big hurry.
Let us look in the closet. Is there a box there?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see smoke coming from the kitchen in the dark.
That sounds scary. Do you have a fire extinguisher nearby?
I do, but I do not know how to use it.
Pull the pin first, then aim at the base of the flames. Have you ever watched someone use one?
No, I have never seen it before.
Just remember to sweep the nozzle from side to side. Stay safe out there, okay?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My little brother fell off his bike today.
Oh no. Did he hurt his leg?
No, just a scratch on his knee.
That is good news.
He laughed and kept riding.
He is brave. Do you ride bikes too?
Yes, I ride with him.
That sounds like fun.
We shared an ice cream after.
Yum. What flavor did you pick?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How can I stop feeling sad?
Try to take a deep breath. What made you sad?
I lost my favorite toy.
That is a hard feeling. Do you have another favorite toy?
No, but I can play with blocks.
Blocks are great for thinking. That is a good plan.
Okay, I will try.
Good luck. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to paint a tree, but the leaves look ugly.
Try using light and dark green for the leaves. Do you have both colors?
I only have dark green right now.
You can mix in a little white to make it lighter. Have you tried that before?
No, I have not. The paper feels too wet.
Let the first layer dry before you paint again. Do you have a fan nearby?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this math work. It is too hard and I want to stop.
It feels bad when work is hard. Do you know which part is stopping you?
The big numbers make my head hurt. I just want to look at a book instead.
It is true that looking at a book feels better. Would you like to take a short break first?
Yes, a break sounds good. My legs are very tired from sitting.
Your body needs rest. Is there a toy you want to play with for five minutes?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need wood for the walls?
Wood holds the shed up. Do you have a saw yet?
Yes, I have a big saw. Why is the roof slanted?
A slant lets rain run off. Is your land level?
The land is flat. What do I put on the floor?
Use wood planks or gravel. Do you like dirt?
I like dirt. Why do I need nails?
Nails hold pieces together. I do not know if you need screws.
I will use nails then. Why paint it?
Paint stops the wood from rotting. Do you have a brush?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My old house was my home.
I hear you. Moving feels hard. What is the hardest part for you?
I miss my garden. I miss the birds that sang there.
That is a true loss. Do you have a plan for plants here?
I do not know if I will like this new town.
It is normal to feel unsure. How is the new house looking today?
The boxes are everywhere. I am tired.
You are working hard. Do you want to take a break now?
Yes, please. Thank you for listening.
You are welcome. I am glad to help.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Does my teacher know that I lost my red pen?
I do not know. Did you tell her?
No, I was scared. What should I do?
You should tell her the truth. Are you feeling brave?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want new shoes.
What color do you like best?
I like red.
Do you have a favorite size?
My feet are big now.
Let us look at the red ones.
I love these.
Great choice.
Can I buy them?
Yes, let us go to the counter.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do flowers have different colors?
I think they use color to tell bees where to look. Do you like pink ones?
Yes, I love pink. Do flowers feel happy?
I do not know if they feel happy, but they need sun and water to grow well.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I live on a very quiet street, but I want to learn how to listen for birds in the morning.
You just stand still and close your eyes. Do you like to watch the sky?
Yes, I do, but how do I start?
Sit on your porch and listen to the wind first.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am going to a party soon. What should I bring?
That sounds like fun. Do you know what kind of party it is?
It is a birthday party for a friend. I am not sure what to give.
A nice card and a small gift are good. Do you know their favorite hobby?
They love playing with balls. I think I will buy a ball.
That is a great choice. You will make them happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am sad to leave my room.
That feels hard. What is your favorite thing in there?
My blue bed.
Do you want to take it with you?
Yes, please.
We can move it tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a lady drop her keys. I picked them up and said please.
That was very kind. Did she say thank you?
Yes, she did. Then I said you are welcome with a smile.
Smiles help people feel happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the light go on when I flip this switch?
The switch opens a path for the power to flow. Do you like reading?
Yes, I do!
Reading is fun. I am not sure why you asked that though.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to see the big old boat. Is it inside?
Yes, it is inside the main hall. Do you like water?
Yes, I do. How much does it cost to go in?
It is free for children. Did you bring your ticket?
I have my ticket here. Where do I put it?
You can show it at the door. Can you count to five?
I can count. Is the boat real?
It is a copy, not the real one. Do you see the blue wall?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: A big blue bird landed on my fence today. It had a sharp beak and looked very calm.
That is a lovely sight to start the day. Did it sing a song?
Yes, it sang a loud song before flying away. It made me feel happy.
I am glad it brought you joy. What color is your fence?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to read in bed at night, but I keep falling asleep.
That is a common problem. Do you use a bright light?
Yes, I have a lamp right next to me.
Try dimming the light to help your eyes rest. Are you tired from school?
I am very tired, but I still want to finish my book.
Reading for short times is a good habit. Do you read every day?
Yes, I read every single night before bed.
Try closing your eyes for five minutes first. This helps you calm down.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know how many fish I have. I am late.
I see two goldfish. Do they swim fast?
I think there is a third one. Is it a cichlid?
I am not sure if it is a cichlid. Is it blue?
It is blue. I must go now.
Okay, go on your way. Did you feed them?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel heavy inside today. Do you know why I feel so sad?
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a specific reason for the sadness?
My dog ran away and I do not know where he is.
That is a scary thing to think about. Are you looking for him right now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we eat turkey on the big winter holiday?
It is a warm, yummy bird that fits a big family. Do you like eating meat?
Why is the table so full of food?
We share to feel close and happy with friends. Is your favorite dish the pie?
Why do we hang lights on the tree?
The glow gives us light in the dark days. Do you like to string the lights?
Why do we give gifts to each other?
It shows we care about the people we love. I do not know what you will get.
Why do we sing songs together?
Music makes hearts feel light and kind. Do you know the words to the old songs?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is so hot outside and I feel very thirsty.
Drink some cool water to feel better. Do you like adding ice to your drinks?
Yes, I like ice, but it is still too warm in here.
Try to rest in the shade to cool down.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared of the big test tomorrow.
It is normal to feel nervous. Do you study every night?
I try to study, but my mind goes blank.
Deep breaths help you think. What subject makes you worry most?
Math is hard for me, I think I will fail.
You are already trying your best.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is so hot today. My throat feels very dry.
Drink a big glass of water. Is it sunny where you are?
Yes, the sun is very bright. I feel too tired to move.
Rest in a cool place. Do you have a fan?
I do, but it is not cool enough. I want to go outside later.
Go after the sun goes down. Is it still hot?
Yes, but it feels a bit better. Thank you for your help.
I am glad I could help.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to bang on the pots and pans.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you have a favorite pot?
The big silver one makes the best sound.
I believe that is a drum in music. Did you know that?
A drum? Is it a toy?
It is a tool for making music. Do you want to learn more about drums?
Yes, please tell me.
Drums come in many shapes and sizes.
Is the kitchen a place for music?
Your kitchen can be your own small band.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made pancakes this morning. They are so good.
That sounds tasty. Do you put syrup on them?
Yes, I use maple syrup. It is sweet and sticky.
I am glad you are happy. What else did you eat?
I also had orange juice and a banana.
That is a nice, full breakfast.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
They take sweet stuff from flowers and store it in their special bags. Do you know where bees live?
Yes, in hives.
They dry the water out of the sweet stuff so it becomes sticky honey.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel stuck and do not know what to do next.
That is hard to feel. What is the first small thing you can see?
I just want it to be over right now.
It is okay to want that. Do you need a break first?
I am angry but also sad.
Both feelings are real. You are doing your best.
Maybe I should just try one step.
Yes, just one step. Which step calls to you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a blue bird on my fence this morning.
That sounds lovely. What was it doing?
It was eating a shiny blueberry.
Birds love sweet food. Did it stay long?
It flew away to a tree with a chirp.
Chirping is how they talk. Do you know what kind it is?
I do not know the name of the bird.
That is okay. It is still a happy bird.
I feel good watching it go.
Watching nature helps you relax. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a star on my drawing today.
That is wonderful news. What did you draw?
It was a big red apple in my lunchbox.
Apples are tasty. Does it taste good?
Yes, it was very sweet and crisp.
Sweet apples make happy snacking.
My teacher said I used good colors.
Nice colors make art pop. Did you use red?
Yes, I used lots of red paint.
Great work on your painting.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I dropped my big magnet and it broke. Will it still pull things?
It may still work, but it is weaker now. Do you want to try it on a paper clip?
I tried, but it did not pull the clip. Why is that?
The pieces lost their power when they broke. I am sorry I do not know how to fix it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue circle on the road today.
That sounds fun. Did you step on it?
No, but it looked like a giant donut.
I do not know what kind of mark it was.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am trying to ride my bike, but I keep falling. Can you help me?
Do not give up, for every fall is a lesson. Do you look forward while you ride?
I look down at the wheels, but that makes me scared. How can I feel safe?
Look far ahead, and you will feel steady. Is your seat at the right height for you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I wrote a story about a dog.
That is a great start. What does the dog like to do?
It likes to run in the park.
Running is fun. Does it meet any friends?
Yes, it meets a cat.
A dog and a cat can be friends. Do they play together?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
The trees need to sleep until the weather gets warm again. Do you like the red and orange colors?
I do! Is winter coming next?
Yes, the cold season is coming soon. Do you have your coat ready?
My coat is too small. What happens when the snow stops falling?
The days get longer and the sun comes back to melt the ice.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very happy today.
That is a warm feeling. Do you know why?
I do not know. Why do I feel this way?
It is hard to say for sure. Did something good happen?
I had a nice walk. Does that make me happy?
It can help your mind rest.
Resting makes me feel good?
Yes, quiet time helps.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a paper plane. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help you. Do you have a piece of paper?
Yes, I have a white sheet. What do I do first?
Fold the paper in half down the middle. Do you like flying things?
I do. Now what is the next step?
Fold the top corners down to the center line. Is your paper clean?
It is clean. How do I make the wings?
Fold the plane in half again on the back. Do you want to fly it inside?
I want to fly it outside. What is the last step?
Fold the wings down on each side. You are almost done.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My white shirts are gray. What should I do?
Did you wash them with dark colors?
Yes, I did not check the pockets.
That can happen. Try a brightener next time.
How do I use it?
I do not know the exact mix. Read the bottle label.
Okay, I will look.
Good plan. Do you have hot water?
I only have cold.
Cold is fine for white clothes. Just use the right soap.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I promised my mom I would water the plants every day.
That is a good promise. Did you remember to do it?
Yes, I did. I even gave them a little song.
How fun. Do you like singing to things?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go camping with you.
That sounds like so much fun! What is your favorite thing about sleeping outside?
The stars are very bright.
Yes, the night sky is beautiful and deep. Do you see many stars where you live?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is loud and I do not know what to do.
I think you should stay inside. Is there much rain coming?
The power is off and I feel very sad.
Let us sit by a window to watch the sky. Do you have a blanket?
I want to go outside but I am afraid of the dark.
It is safe to wait in your warm home.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do I take a good photo with my phone?
Hold the phone still to avoid blur. Is it sunny out?
Yes, but it is very bright. What do I do?
Look for shade or lower the screen brightness. Do you see a red light?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked in the park today and saw a big red apple fall from a tree.
That sounds like a lucky break. Did you pick it up?
Yes, I ate it right away on a bench.
Apples are sweet and crunchy. Is that your favorite fruit?
It is, but I also love strawberries when they are in season.
Strawberries are red and tasty too. Do you eat them with sugar?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very scared and unsure.
That is a hard feeling. Do you know what makes you worry?
I do not know what to do.
Take a slow, deep breath. Can you tell me one small thing that helps you feel safe?
I just want the fear to stop.
It will pass soon. Is there a friend you can talk to?
I do not feel like talking to anyone else.
That is okay. You are doing your best.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a round shape, but I am not sure what to call it.
It looks like a circle, which is very round. Do you have any other shapes with you?
Yes, I have a shape with four sharp corners.
That sounds like a square. Are the corners pointy or flat?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What comes after Monday?
It is Tuesday. Do you like Tuesday?
I think there are seven days in a week.
That is correct. You are very smart.
Is Sunday before Monday?
No, Sunday is after Saturday. Do you play on Sunday?
I want to know all the days but I forget.
We can practice them together. Try to name the first one.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the stars so far away?
They are very, very far because the sky is huge. Do you like looking up at them?
How do we see them if they are so far?
Their light shines for a long time to reach our eyes. I do not know how bright the very smallest ones are.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need a warm jacket?
It gets cold at night. Do you like wearing hats?
Should I bring a book?
Yes, it is fun to read. What is your favorite story?
Do I need a toothbrush?
I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My brother broke my red toy car.
That is very sad to hear. Did you tell your mom?
Yes, she said he is sorry.
That is good. What did he do to fix it?
He gave me a new blue one.
A nice replacement. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, I do. Now we are friends again.
I am happy for you two.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to make with my paper.
Have you tried drawing a picture? Do you like animals?
I like drawing, but I am not good at it.
That is okay, it is just for fun. What shape comes to mind first?
I see a square, but a square is boring.
You can cut it out and glue it to make a box.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I made a promise to my friend but I do not know what to do.
That feels hard. Did you break the promise?
I think I did, but I am not sure if it is bad.
Honesty helps us fix things. Do you want to tell me what happened?
I said I would help you clean, but I played instead.
I am sorry I cannot fix that for you. Do you feel ready to ask forgiveness?
Yes, I think I should just say I am sorry.
That is a good and true step.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I stop my bike?
Squeeze the brakes gently. What color is your bike?
I am not sure.
That is okay. Check the hand levers. Do you like red or blue?
I like red.
Red is a good choice. Push the lever toward the handlebar. Does that feel easy?
Yes, it does.
Great job. Practice slowly. How do you feel now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn to jump rope, but I keep hitting my feet.
That is hard. Do you watch your feet closely?
No, I look up. It feels so fast.
Looking down helps. Try jumping very slowly first.
Slowly? It feels silly, but I will try.
Is your rope too long for you?
I think it is a bit long. How do I fix that?
I do not know your height, so I cannot say.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun is warm today. I took a picture of my dog in the grass.
That sounds nice. Did the dog sit still for the photo?
Yes, he sat very well. I took a photo of the blue sky next.
Blue skies look bright. Do you like taking pictures outside?
Yes, I like it. But my camera ran out of battery.
That is not good. Do you have a battery pack with you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I like tea but I also like coffee. Why do they taste so different?
Tea comes from a leaf and coffee comes from a bean. The seeds have oils that make coffee bitter. Do you like sweet or bitter drinks?
I like sweet tea. Why is tea not bitter?
Tea has less of the bitter stuff than coffee. It tastes more like flowers. Do you drink it hot or cold?
I drink it hot. Why does it smell so good?
The heat makes the nice smells come out of the dry leaves. It wakes up your nose. Do you add sugar to it?
Yes, I add two spoons. Why does coffee smell different?
Coffee has a strong, nutty smell. It is very different from the soft smell of tea. Do you drink both in the morning?
I drink coffee at night. Why does it not make me sleepy?
Coffee has a thing that keeps you awake. It stops your brain from feeling tired. Do you sleep well after that?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I picked a red leaf today. It felt dry and crisp. Why do leaves fall off trees?
Trees drop leaves to save water before winter. The tree gets sleepy and rests. Did you catch it on your way home?
Yes, I caught it in my hand. It looked like a tiny boat. Is the tree really asleep?
Not quite asleep, but very quiet. The tree saves its food for later. Do you like watching the wind blow?
I do like the wind. It makes the branches dance. Do trees dream when they are quiet?
I do not know if trees dream. But they surely grow in the dark. Do you plan to plant a seed tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad and I need to tell you a secret.
I am here for you. Please share it. What made you feel this way?
I broke my favorite blue cup by mistake.
That is a kind of honest thing to do. Do you want to tell me why?
I am afraid you will get angry with me now.
I am not angry at all. I am glad you told the truth.
Will you help me fix it?
I do not know how to fix a cup. Do you want to hide it?
No, I want to be good.
Being good is the best thing you can do.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
They fall to help the tree rest. Do you like picking them up?
Yes, I like crunching on them. Why does the tree stop growing?
The tree saves energy for next spring. It is sleeping for the cold days.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am sad because my brother took my toy.
That feels very bad. Did you try to talk to him about it?
No, I just cried in my room.
Talking is often better than crying. Would you like to practice saying how you feel?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Can I leave my box here?
Sure, that is fine. Do you have a good plan for food?
I am too busy to think about it.
I can hold it for you. Should I pick a sandwich for you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I ran out of time to finish this. I feel bad.
It is okay. I see your hard work. Do you want to try one small step?
Yes, but I must go now. I will come back later.
See you then.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a hurt bird in the yard. What should I do?
Please look to see if it can stand. Is it moving its wings?
It stays on the ground and looks very tired.
That is hard to see. Do you have a box with air holes?
I do not know if I should move it or leave it there.
If it cannot fly, put it in the box and call a helper. Do you have a phone nearby?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I missed a great shot and now I feel bad.
That feels hard, but one miss is just one miss. Do you want to try again?
I just want to stop for now.
Stopping is a good choice when you feel sad.
I think my friend is laughing at me.
I do not know if they are laughing. Why do you think they are?
Their mouth looked wide open.
Wide mouths can mean surprise or talk. Did they say anything to you?
No, they just ran to the net.
Running to the net means they want to play. Maybe they just love the game.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My head hurts. Why is that?
It can hurt if you sleep on it wrong. Did you rest well last night?
I think so. What else causes it?
Sometimes stress or drinking too little water makes your head throb. Are you thirsty right now?
I am. Why does water help?
I am not sure why it works for everyone. But trying it often helps.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a squirrel today. It was very fast. It jumped up a tree before I could say hi.
Squirrels move very quickly to stay safe. What color was the tree?
It was a big, tall oak tree. Then I saw a bird in the grass.
Birds love to look for food in the grass. Did the bird have a bright red beak?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to walk along the harbour today. Which way should I go?
Go down the main street and follow the water on your right. Do you like watching the boats?
Yes, I love the big ships. Is the view good from the pier?
The view is very nice from the old pier. Are you going to sit down?
Maybe. Do I need to buy a ticket to get onto the pier?
No, you do not need a ticket to walk there. Have a nice time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad about my new book. The cover is torn.
That is a real bummer. I do not know how to fix a cover. Did you like the story inside?
Yes, the story is good. But the outside looks bad.
Good stories matter most. Is the spine still strong?
It is sticking together. I think I can keep it.
I am glad you feel better. Do you want to read it now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. The car is stuck.
Do not worry. Is it far from here?
Yes, it is very far. Can you help me?
I can call a tow truck for you. Are you ready?
Please do it now. I will pay you.
I will not take your money. I hope you make it on time.
You are a great friend. I love you.
I love you too. Run fast.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do I need to say please?
Yes, it makes people smile. Do you like it when people are nice to you?
I forgot to share my cookie.
That was a little rude. It is good to know your mistake.
How do I say sorry?
You can just look them in the eye and speak. It shows you care.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a robot but I am scared I will fail.
That is a big goal. Do you have any parts ready?
Yes I have gears and wires but no motor.
You can buy a small motor for your toy.
What else do I need to make it work?
You need a battery to give it power.
Can the robot walk by itself?
I do not know for sure. Do you want it to dance?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the apples so red?
The sun gives them color. Do you like sweet fruit?
Why is the fish wet?
It came from the sea. Did you see the water?
Why does the bread smell good?
Heat makes it rise. Is that for your family?
Why is the old man sleeping?
He is tired. Are you hungry too?
Why do you work here?
I like helping people. Do you want to buy something?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why does my bread get big?
Tiny bugs eat the sugar and make gas. Do you like sweet things?
I want to make big bread.
You need warm water and sugar. Is your kitchen warm?
Where do the tiny bugs come from?
They come from yeast powder. Do you have a jar?
What if I use cold water?
The bugs sleep and the bread stays small. Try a bit warmer.
I will try that now.
That sounds like a good plan. Good luck with your bake.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I love painting pictures. Why do I like it so much?
It lets you make new worlds. Do you like drawing animals or people?
I mostly draw animals. Why are animals fun to paint?
They have fun shapes and colors. Do you use bright colors?
Yes, I use red and blue. Why do bright colors make me happy?
They show strong feelings. Do you paint happy faces on them?
Sometimes. Why does it feel good to finish a picture?
You see your work clearly. Do you show them to your family?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the baby cry so much?
Crying is how babies tell us they need help. Are you feeling tired?
Why do they not eat every two hours?
Every baby has a different schedule. Is the baby eating well?
Why do they sleep all day?
They need sleep to grow big and strong. I do not know why they sleep more some days.
Why do they move their hands and feet?
They are learning how to use their body. Do you like watching them move?
Why is the baby smiling now?
I think the baby is happy to see you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a very nice flower in the garden.
What a pretty color. Do you like the smell of it?
Yes, it smells sweet. I want to take a picture of it.
That is a great idea. Are you ready to click the button?
I am ready, but the light is a bit dark.
Let us move to a brighter spot.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to kick the ball into the net. Is that called a goal?
Yes, that is a goal. Do you watch games on TV?
I like to play with my friends outside. How many players are on one team?
There are eleven players on a team. Do you have a favorite position?
I think I am best at running. Can you tell me one more fun fact?
The ball is round. Do you like playing in the rain?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work. Where is the bread?
Go straight ahead. Do you like sweet or plain?
Just the plain one, please.
It is on the top shelf. Are you eating it now?
No, I am grabbing it to go.
That is good luck. Take care.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my square feels wrong.
Why does the square feel wrong to you?
It has four corners that are too sharp.
Sharp corners can hurt if you are not careful.
I tried to make a circle but it is lumpy.
A circle is always round and has no corners. What tool did you use to draw it?
I used a wobbly hand and a broken pencil.
That is a hard task with a broken tool.
I just want the shapes to be perfect.
You do not need to be perfect to make good shapes.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate these shoes. They hurt my toes.
That sounds very bad. Do you have another pair to try on?
No, I only brought this one size. I feel so sad.
I am sorry you are upset. Is there a bigger size in the back?
I do not know. I just want to go home.
Let us find a helper who can help you. Would you like to sit for a moment?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a new phone today. I am so happy to share this with you.
That is wonderful news! What color is your new phone?
It is bright blue. I love the color a lot.
Blue is a very nice color. Do you know how to use it yet?
Yes, I am learning how to take pictures.
Taking pictures is fun. Can you send me one to see?
I will send one right now. Look at this picture of my cat.
Your cat looks very cute in that photo. I am glad you are enjoying your new device.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The moon looked so bright tonight.
It can be very bright at night. Did you look up for a long time?
I saw my dog running in the yard.
That sounds like a fun view. Was the dog playing or chasing something?
It was just running for fun.
Dogs love to run under the moon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, but I love my new guitar.
That is a fun toy. Do you play it every day?
No, I have no time. Work is busy.
That is hard to hear.
I just need to go now.
Good luck. Is it hard to learn?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at my big blue boat.
That is a nice boat. What is its name?
I do not know. It looks like a whale.
It does look very round. Do you like riding on it?
Yes, I love the water. Is it safe?
Yes, I am sure it is safe. You must wear your floatie.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am so tired today.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you finish your tasks?
Yes, but it was very hard.
Good job. What made it so difficult?
I do not know what to do next.
We can think it over together.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to climb a mountain, but I do not know how to start.
Do you have good shoes? Start by walking on small hills near your home.
I have shoes, but I feel tired just thinking about it.
That is a good sign. Do you like cold air?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the water in the harbour clean?
The water looks clear and cool today. Do you like swimming?
Yes, I love swimming. Can I go in right here?
Please ask a worker first. Is the sun hot?
It is very warm. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have two aces in my hand. What should I do?
That is a very strong start. Do you like to play safe or take big risks?
I usually like to play it safe. What do you think?
Since you play safe, you should keep them for now. Do you have any other high cards?
I have a king and a queen too. This feels good.
