Your hand looks very powerful. I would bet on winning this round.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a dog playing guitar today.
That is very loud. Do you play music too?
No, I just sing in the shower.
Singing is fun. I like to hum along.
The dog stopped when I looked at it.
It was shy. You have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to tap my feet when I hear a drum.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a drum?
I have a box I drum on.
A box makes a great drum. What song do you like to play?
I like to play "Row, Row, Row Your Boat."
I know that one too. Do you like the words or the sound?
I like the sound of the boat moving.
That is a nice feeling. Do you sing with your eyes closed?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my cat sleep so much?
Cats sleep a lot to save energy for play. Do they wake up hungry?
Yes, they always want food right after waking.
That is normal for cats. They are very active at night.
Is it bad to feed them late at night?
I am not a vet, so I do not know for sure. Is your cat thin or fat?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a map, but I do not know where to go.
That sounds hard. Do you see any red lines?
Yes, I see red lines all over the place.
Red lines show busy roads. Do you want to drive or walk?
I think I want to walk, but I am lost.
Let us find a blue dot. Do you see a blue dot?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the big white building today.
That sounds busy. What did you do there?
I sat in a circle and talked about my plans.
Talking is good. Did you feel happy?
Yes, but my legs got very tired from sitting.
That can happen. Do you walk a lot?
Not really, so it was a hard day.
I am sorry. I hope you rest now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I saved some money today.
That is great! What did you do to save it?
I did not buy candy. I kept my coins in a jar.
That is smart. Do you have a goal for the money?
Yes. I want to buy a new bike.
A bike is a nice reward.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I think I failed the test.
That is a big feeling. What part of the test was the hardest?
The math part made me cry.
Crying is okay when you are sad. Do you want to share your paper?
I just want to go home now.
I am sorry you feel this way. Go get some rest.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix this chair right now, please.
I can help you. What part is broken?
The leg is loose and wobbles.
We can tighten the bolts. Do you have a wrench?
I think it is under the seat.
Let us look there. Is the screw stripped?
Yes, it is stripped and stuck.
That is tricky. Do you have a screwdriver?
I have one, but I am late.
We can try to tap it in. Let us go now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to have a party, but I do not know what to do.
Make a list of games. Do you have many friends?
I have five friends coming to my house.
Great. Buy some paper and pens for them.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big brown bear in the park today.
Is that a true bear or a statue?
No, I think it was just a funny log.
Good thing it was a log. Do you like looking at logs?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my sister's toy by accident. I feel very bad.
That sounds scary. Did you tell her what happened?
I am too afraid to tell her the truth. What should I do?
Honesty is brave. Does she know it was an accident?
No, she does not know yet. I am still unsure.
Go tell her now. Are you ready to say sorry?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a silly dream about dancing in a field of jelly.
That sounds like a wild and sticky place to dance. What color was the jelly?
It was bright green and wobbly, and I just laughed at it all.
I am glad you are smiling about it. Do you remember who you were dancing with?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big man selling fruit today. He had bright red apples.
That sounds nice. Did you buy any?
No, I just looked. Then I saw a cat sitting on a box.
A cat in the market. Is that allowed?
I think so. It looked very happy and sleepy.
Well, that is a good place to nap. Did you pet it?
I wanted to, but I was afraid of the man.
That is a wise choice. Markets can be busy.
Yes, and then it rained. I ran home.
Yikes, running in the rain. Did you get wet?
Yes, all the way to my shoes. But I am warm now.
Good thing you are safe and dry. What a wild day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very hungry. I walked all the way here.
That sounds like a long walk. Do you want a big bowl of soup?
Yes, I do. I also want some bread.
Bread is good with soup. Would you like it with butter or jam?
I like jam. My grandpa makes the best jam.
That is a sweet treat. I will get you the soup and jam.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I lost my red marker on this big map. Can you help me find it?
Sure, let us look closely. Do you see any red spots?
Yes, there is a red dot near the blue river. Is that the place?
It looks like a good start. Do you remember where the river bends?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go on a trip soon. Where should I go?
What kind of place do you like best?
I love the water and the sun.
The beach is a great choice. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I swim every day.
Then a warm island is perfect for you.
That sounds like a lot of fun.
I think it will be a happy trip.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My eyes feel very heavy and I want to lie down.
It is okay to rest when you are tired. Do you want a warm drink first?
Yes, please. My legs also feel tired from playing.
Warm milk can help you sleep well. Did you eat a snack today?
I ate some apple slices. Now I feel a little sleepy.
Apples are good for you. Shall we go to your bed now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a rainbow in my garden.
You can use a spray bottle to make one. Do you have water?
I have a hose, but no sun.
The sun is the key to the light. Is it cloudy?
Yes, it is very gray.
You must wait for clear skies. Do you like looking up?
I love the colors.
Nature makes them for you. Keep your eyes open.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we mix blue and yellow?
It makes green, which is the color of grass. Do you like the color green?
Yes, I do. Why is paint sticky?
The sticky part helps it stick to the wall. Do you like to work with your hands?
Yes. Why does red mean love?
I do not know for sure, but many people think it does. Do you think red means love?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the market. How many legs do cows have?
They have four legs. Do you have time to feed them?
No time to feed. What sound does a hen make?
A hen clucks. Are your eggs ready?
Yes, they are full. Why do pigs roll in mud?
They roll to stay cool. Do you like mud?
No, I hate mud. Can ducks swim?
Yes, ducks swim well. Is it raining?
No, but I must go. What color is a zebra?
It is black and white. Good luck on your trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is so loud here. I do not know what to do.
Take a deep breath. Are you hungry?
I am a bit hungry. But I am tired.
Let us find a quiet bench. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I love sweet food.
We will find a small cake.
That sounds nice. Thank you.
Let us walk slowly now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad today. Why is the sky blue?
The sun’s light hits air particles and blue scatters most. Do you like looking up?
I don’t know. It feels cold up there.
The air is indeed colder at high altitudes. Does the color help?
Maybe. I guess I will look up.
That sounds like a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am moving my home. I do not know where to start.
That can feel big. Do you have a box for your books?
I have a box, but the truck is hard to fill. I feel stuck.
Take one thing at a time. Which box do you want to fill next?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My cat likes to nap on my bed.
That is very sweet. Does he like to snuggle with you?
He chases the red dot from the light.
I bet that makes him feel like a hunter. What else does he like to play?
He eats his food very fast.
He must love his dinner. Does he clean his face after eating?
He is the best pet ever.
I am glad he makes you happy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this walk. It feels too long.
That sounds tiring. Are your feet hurt?
Yes, they hurt bad. I want to go home now.
I am sorry to hear that. Let us sit on this bench for a rest.
Okay. This bench feels soft.
Good. Do you want to drink some water?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes. I keep getting it wrong.
I can help with that. Do you have a specific knot you use?
I just pull and hope it stays. It is so hard.
Try looping the laces like a bunny. It makes it much easier.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you like the movie with the big red robot?
I love it. Is your favorite scene the dance?
No, I like the part where he flies.
That is a cool moment. Do you think he is sad?
Yes, he looks lonely sometimes.
That makes it feel real. Do you want to see it again?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to plant a tree in this new town.
Dig a hole and put the roots in. Do you have a shovel?
Yes, I do. Now that I know, thanks.
You are welcome. Have fun growing.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the light get dark at night?
Your brain tells your eyes to make more of a light stuff. Do you see stars when you look up?
Yes, I do. But why do some stars look like they blink?
The air above us moves and wiggles the light coming down. Is it windy where you are?
It is a little. What makes the plug give power to my toy?
The wires in the wall carry the energy to your plug. Do you feel it buzz if you hold it?
No, it stays still. Is that safe?
Yes, it is safe if you do not pull the wire hard. Do you unplug toys when you sleep?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a rainbow but I do not know what to do.
Do you like to look at it?
Yes, it is very pretty.
Then just enjoy the colors.
I am still not sure.
I do not know your secret plans.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to say please and thank you. Do you know how to start?
Yes, you can start by saying "please" before you ask for help. Do you usually ask for things often?
Yes, I ask for a lot of help with my homework. How do I say thank you after?
You can just say "thank you" when they finish helping you. It makes people feel happy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because it is Tuesday.
That is great to hear. Why do you love Tuesday?
I get a new toy on Tuesdays.
A new toy sounds fun. Do you have any favorite toys?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need my blue box of toys right now.
Is it on the low shelf? Do you see the red lid?
No, I do not see it. I am late.
I think it is in the big closet. Did you check the top?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new song today. It makes me smile.
That sounds nice. What is it about?
It is about a small red bird.
A bird song? Do you sing along with it?
Yes, I hum the tune all day.
I am glad you are happy. Thank you for sharing it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so tired but I still want to read.
Reading in the dark hurts your eyes. Do you have a lamp?
I am too busy to check for a lamp right now.
Your eyes need light to see well. Please, just take a quick look.
I will just read for five more minutes.
Five minutes is a good goal. Can you find a light quickly?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very tired today. I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That sounds fun. Are you using training wheels?
Yes, I have them on. I am still too sleepy to focus.
Good. Sleep is like fuel for your brain. Do you have a quiet place to rest?
I have my bedroom. How do I take the wheels off?
I do not know the exact steps. But you need a helper to hold the seat tight.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is very strong today.
It feels cold and loud to me. Do you have a warm coat?
I do, but I am not sure if I should go outside.
Walking is good for you. Are you afraid of the cold?
A little, but mostly I just do not feel like moving.
That is okay. Sit by the window and watch the trees dance.
The trees do look happy.
I agree. Do you want some tea?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts so much today.
I am sorry to hear that. Does it hurt when you touch it?
Yes, the whole top feels hot and sore.
That might be a fever. Have you taken any medicine yet?
No, I have not tried anything yet.
I do not know for sure if it is serious. Please ask a grown up or a doctor to help you.
Okay, I will get some rest.
That is a good plan. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a big cake for my party.
A big cake sounds delicious. What flavor do you like best?
Chocolate, please.
Chocolate is a great choice. Do you want candles on top?
Yes, many candles.
That will be very fun to blow out. How old will you be?
I will be seven.
Happy birthday! Seven is a wonderful age.
Thank you.
You are welcome. I hope you have a great time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am sad because my grandpa is very quiet today.
That feels hard. Do you want to sit with him?
I tried to talk, but he only looked at his hands.
He might be tired. Is he resting?
Yes, he is lying down in the big chair.
That is nice. Can I be there with you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the best way to wash my white shirts?
Use cold water to keep them bright. Do you have any colorful clothes in that load?
No, they are all white. Should I use hot water instead?
Hot water can shrink fabric, so stick with cold. Do you know how to use the stain remover?
I just sprinkle it on. Is that enough?
Gently rub it in for a minute before washing.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a small bird on my fence.
That is a nice bird. Do you have any seeds?
I have a bowl of water nearby.
Water is good for them. Is it clean?
Yes, I wash it every day.
That is very kind. Would you like to watch it drink?
I am not sure if it wants me close.
Give it some space. Do you like watching animals?
I think I will just sit here.
That is a good idea. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I moved my rook to the wrong square and lost the game. I feel so silly.
That is a tough feeling, but every player makes mistakes. Do you want to look at the move again?
I think I need a break from playing for a while.
Taking a break is a smart choice for your head. Maybe we can just chat about the rules instead.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the room?
Go down this hall. Is it your first time here?
No. But I missed the door.
It is on the left.
Thanks. I must run.
You are welcome. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My feet hurt. I want to land now.
I know it is hard. Are you drinking water?
I have no time to sit. I am late.
You must sit down. Is your belt on?
Yes, I am tired. What time is it?
It is a long way still. Do you like clouds?
I do not care about clouds. I am angry.
That is okay. Take a slow breath.
Okay. I will try to sleep.
Good for you. Is your head back?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is this line red on the map?
It shows a big river. Do you like water?
Why is the dot so small?
It is a tiny town. Is your home near there?
Why does the map have no trees?
I do not know for sure. Do you want to find out?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very tired today.
Resting helps you feel better. Do you like naps?
Yes, but I cannot sleep.
Try drinking some warm water. Are you eating enough food?
I had some bread and jam.
That is a good start for energy. Is your room dark and quiet?
It is a bit bright.
Using a dark curtain can help you rest. Do you want to try that?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a tent spot now. I am late.
Look for flat ground. Is the ground wet?
No, it is dry.
Good. Pick a spot away from trees.
Done. Now what?
Push the poles through the holes.
I did that.
Tie the stakes in the dirt.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the store to buy new shoes.
That is a good idea. Do you like the color of the shoes?
Yes, they are blue like the sky.
Blue is a nice color. How do they fit your feet?
They fit well, but my feet feel tired.
Your feet must be happy. Did you find the perfect pair?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I caught a big fish today. I am so happy.
That is great news! Did you use worms or bait?
I used worms. It was very slippery.
Oh dear, did you keep it?
Yes, I have it in my bucket. Look at its shiny scales.
Wow, what a catch! I am so happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke my cup. What do I do?
I am sorry to hear that. Are you okay?
Yes, but I do not know how to fix it.
I do not know how to fix glass. Did you buy the cup?
Yes, I did. Now what?
You can take it to a store to see if they help.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my brother so quiet today?
Maybe he is tired. Are you feeling sleepy too?
I am not tired. Why does he sit alone?
He might want some rest time.
Can I go play with him now?
You can ask him nicely. Does he like block games?
Yes, he loves blocks. Why does he not say yes?
He may need a little more time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I lost my phone. Where is it?
Did you check your bag? Is it in your pocket?
No. It is not there.
That is odd. Do you hear a beep?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just put up my new garden fence. I am very happy to share.
That is great news! Is it tall?
Yes, it is tall and made of wood. It looks very nice.
Wood is a sturdy choice. Do you have flowers behind it?
I have many roses growing there. They smell sweet in the sun.
How lovely that is.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in a big rush. Is the shop open right now?
Yes, the doors are open. Are you buying for a gift?
No, I need a small red ball. Do you have one?
I see some blue ones here. Do you like blue?
No, only red. Where is the red section?
It is down that short hallway. Is that path easy for you?
It is too far away. Can you hold one for me?
I can put one on the counter. Are you coming back soon?
Yes, I am running back now. Thank you.
You are welcome. Good luck on your run.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on a hard book. Do you have a tip for me?
Try to read a little bit each day. Do you like reading in bed?
Yes, I do. But the words look like stars in the sky.
That is a funny way to say it. I do not know why they blur. Do you like the story?
Yes, the hero is kind. But the end is too big and scary.
It is okay to feel scared. Put the book down and wait a day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to start making rock art. Is it hard?
It is not hard at all. Do you have any smooth rocks?
I found some in the park near my house.
That is a great start. What colors do you like best?
I like blue and yellow the most.
Those go well together. Have fun with your art.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the big boat stay on the water?
The water pushes the boat up to hold it. Do you like to play in the pool?
Yes, because I float when I take a big breath.
Your air pushes the water down, so it pushes you back up.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I do not know how to feed my new baby.
You can try small feeds every few hours. How did the baby react to the first taste?
He cried a lot when I tried the bottle.
Some babies prefer being held close. Are you holding him while he eats?
Yes, I hold him near my chest.
That is a good start. Try warming the milk to body heat. Does he look calm now?
He is quiet and drinking slowly.
That is a great sign. You are doing a fine job.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My computer is making a loud noise.
That is scary. What sound does it make?
It sounds like a fan is spinning too fast.
The fan may be getting hot. Do you smell any burnt things?
No, but the screen is flickering blue.
That is a bad sign. I do not know why it is doing that.
I am worried I will lose my work.
Please save your files. Is the power cord plugged in tight?
Yes, it is right here.
Good. The computer may be tired.
Can you make it stop?
I cannot fix it for you. Please turn it off gently.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big rainbow after the rain.
That sounds wonderful. What color was your favorite part?
I liked the red one the best.
Red is a happy color. Did you try to touch it?
No, it was too far away.
That is why we cannot hold it. Did you see any animals nearby?
Yes, a cat was sleeping in the sun.
A warm nap feels good. Did the cat look at the rainbow?
No, the cat was fast asleep.
Good sleep is important. I do not know if cats see rainbows, but they had a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My screen is black and I cannot play my game.
That sounds like a real hassle. Did you try unplugging it for a moment?
No, I do not want to touch the cords. It feels too hard to do that.
Sometimes a quick reset helps. Do you like when things work again?
Yes, I do. But I am still a bit grumpy about all this waiting.
It is okay to be a bit grumpy. I will stay here with you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read a book about a cat in my bed at night.
That sounds cozy. Did the cat find a toy?
Yes, the cat found a red ball and chased it.
Oh no, that is not safe on the bed. Did the cat fall?
No, the cat just rolled over and closed its eyes.
Good for the cat. Are you sleepy now too?
A little bit, but the book is so fun to read.
Reading helps you rest your mind. Do you have a lamp on?
Yes, a small blue lamp keeps the dark away.
Nice light. I hope you have sweet dreams.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love that pop song and want to learn how to sing it well.
Start by listening to it very slowly. Do you know who wrote it?
I do not know who wrote it. I just like the sound.
That is okay. Try singing along to the slow speed first.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did you promise me you would help?
I like helping friends. Do you need help today?
Yes, I feel sad. Why are you sad?
I do not know. Are you hungry?
No, I am not hungry. Why do you ask?
I only ask to help. Is the sky blue?
Yes, the sky is blue.
I am glad to see it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to count the apples in my bag.
That is a fun task. How many have you found so far?
I found three, but then I lost track of the fourth.
Start again slowly. Do you see a red one?
Yes, I see one red apple at the bottom.
Great. Keep going at a steady pace.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to chop an onion without crying.
That is a tricky skill. Do you have a sharp knife ready?
Yes, I have a very sharp one.
Cut the onion in half and peel the skin. Then, make small cuts through the top, but do not cut the bottom root.
Why keep the bottom part?
It holds the onion together so it does not fall apart. Are you holding your hands close?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do the clock hands move?
A battery or spring makes them go. Do you have a battery in yours?
Yes, I put a new one in.
That is good. The spring winds up inside. Do you like watching it tick?
The tick is very loud.
Loud ticks are common for some clocks. Do you think it is annoying?
It wakes me up at night.
You could try a quiet wall clock. Do you want that?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The sky is gray and my heart feels heavy.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you like blue skies?
I wish I could see the sun right now.
The sun is still there. It is just hiding.
It feels like the clouds are blocking everything.
That can feel very sad. Are you cold?
I just need a little break from the dark.
I get that. Would you like a warm drink?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad and all alone today.
That feels hard. Do you want to talk about what is wrong?
I do not know what to do next.
Take a deep breath. Is there one small thing that makes you happy?
I just want someone to be there with me.
You are not truly alone. I am here to listen.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today. I kicked the ball hard. It hit a dog.
Oh no, is the dog okay? I hope it is fine.
Yes, the dog just ran away. I felt a bit bad.
I am sorry you felt bad. Did you play any more?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The wind is blowing very hard outside. How do I make sure my door is safe?
I do not know your specific door type. Is it a wood door?
Yes, it is a solid wood door.
Check the hinges on the outside wall. Are the screws long and tight?
They look loose. What should I do with them?
You can tap them in a little more with a hammer. Do you have a hammer nearby?
I do. The glass in the window is also rattling.
Put thick towels over the cracks in the frame. Are you feeling okay in this noise?
I feel better now. Thanks for your help.
You are welcome. Stay inside and stay warm.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to draw.
Try drawing a cat. Do you like cats?
Yes, I do. But I am stuck.
Start with a circle. That is easy.
Okay, I will try.
You can do it. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read a book about old castles today.
That sounds like a fun trip to the past. Did you see any pictures?
Yes, I saw a knight with a big sword.
Knights were brave soldiers long ago. Did they ride horses?
They did, and it looked fast and loud.
I agree that horses were key. What else was in the book?
It talked about kings who sat on thrones.
Kings made laws for everyone to follow. Did you like the royal part?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I bake a cake?
You mix the dry things first. Do you have a list?
Yes, I do. What comes next?
Then you mix in the wet parts. Is it for a special day?
Yes, it is. How do I make it sweet?
You add sugar to the mix. I do not know your taste.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do I make my carrot grow big?
Put it in warm soil with a little water. Do you like eating carrots?
Yes, I do. How much sun does it need?
It likes lots of sunshine every day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red coin in my shoe today. It was warm. I put it in my pocket but now it is gone.
That is a strange thing. Do you still have your shoes?
Yes, I am wearing them. I checked every pocket but did not look inside the left shoe again.
That sounds like a good place to check.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to finish this red wall before lunch.
That sounds like a race. Are you using a wide brush?
Yes, but I am so tired. My arm hurts.
I agree. You should take a short break.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a sand castle on the beach.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a bucket?
Yes, I have a big red one.
Great. Wet the sand first so it sticks. Do you like digging?
I do, but I am not sure how to make the walls.
Pack the wet sand in the bucket and flip it over.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling.
That sounds really upsetting. Do you remember what was under you?
No, it was just dark and empty.
My brain makes up things when we sleep. Was your heart beating fast?
Yes, my heart was pounding very hard.
Your body reacts to the dream like it is real. Did you feel safe when you woke up?
I felt scared for a few minutes.
Deep breathing helps your body relax. Do you want to try a trick?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like the blue balloons.
They look very happy. Do you like red ones?
I do not like red.
Blue is a great choice. Is there juice there?
Yes, there is orange juice.
That sounds nice and sweet. Do you want a snack?
I want some chips.
Chips are crunchy and fun. Are you hungry?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new song. It makes me feel very warm inside.
That sounds nice. What is the song about?
It is about a big, happy sun. Do you like sunny days?
I like how bright it is. Thank you for sharing it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see the blue sky, but I do not get it.
Sunlight has many colors. Blue light bounces off the air. Do you see the sun?
Yes, I do. What should I do now?
Look up and take a deep breath. The fresh air feels nice.
That feels good. I am done looking.
Good job. You learned something new.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the beach fast. Where is it?
Go straight until you see the sand. Are you going for a swim?
No, I am running to meet a friend. How long will it take?
It is a short walk. Do you have a map with you?
I do not have time to look. Is the beach open now?
Yes, the doors are open. Have a nice time there.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see smoke coming from the house next door. It looks scary.
That is bad. Is everyone safe and moving to the street?
Yes, my mom says we must go outside right now. Do you think the fire will spread?
I hope it stops fast. Are you wearing your shoes?
Yes, I have my shoes on and we are leaving. Please help us be safe.
Stay with your grown-ups and stay calm. I will watch from my window for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the light turn on when I click the switch?
The switch lets the power flow from the wall to the bulb. Do you like reading in your room?
Yes, I do. But what happens if I unplug the lamp?
The power stops, so the light goes out. Is your lamp blue?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to make a cake.
That is fun. Do you have the supplies at home?
Yes, I have flour, eggs, and sugar.
Great. Do you have an oven to bake it?
I do have an oven. How do I start?
Mix the dry things first. Do you like a big cake?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I have to do this hard math?
It helps your brain grow strong. Do you like puzzles?
I like puzzles, but this is too tricky.
That is okay. Sometimes hard things take time.
Can I just stop and take a break?
Yes, rest is good for you. Are you tired?
A little bit, I guess.
Good. We can try again later.
I want to finish first.
That is brave of you. Let us go.
Okay, let us start.
Great. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream cone in the grass this morning.
That is a very sad story. Was it chocolate?
Yes, it was chocolate and it sank right into the dirt.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you like chocolate?
I do, but now I am just hungry and a bit grumpy.
I know that feeling well. A warm cookie might help.
That sounds like a great idea, thanks for the tip.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the end of the tale, fast!
I do not know the ending. Do you like the start?
I must go, thanks!
Please be safe. Was the hero brave?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a movie today. It was very fun. The dog did many tricks.
A dog movie sounds great. Did the dog jump high?
Yes, he jumped over the couch. My sister liked it too.
That is a good sign. Did you eat popcorn while watching?
We did. The salt got on my shirt. It was messy.
Messy is part of the fun. Do you want to watch that film again?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My neighbor is tapping on my wall all night. I do not know what to do.
That sounds very tiring. Do you have their phone number?
I found it in my pocket, but I am scared to call.
Maybe they do not know the sound is loud. Would you like to try a polite text first?
A text is a good idea. What should I say?
I am not sure what works best for you, but a simple note helps. Are you feeling better about it now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked home on the quiet street today. The trees were still and the air was cool.
That sounds like a nice walk. Did you see any birds?
I saw one blue bird. It sang a very small song.
A blue bird is special. Did you hear any cars?
No, the road was empty. It felt very safe and calm.
Silence can be a good thing. Do you like quiet walks?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is this a big town?
It is small. Do you like quiet places?
I like it here.
That is good. Do you have a home yet?
No, I need a room.
I do not know for sure. Are you looking for a cheap place?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished my favorite book, and I feel very happy about it.
That is great news for you. What makes it your favorite?
It has a bear who learns to be brave and kind.
A brave bear sounds wonderful. Do you have a favorite animal?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late and I need to go now.
Taking a deep breath helps you think clearly. Do you have a plan?
Please tell me the way quickly.
I do not know your map, but I can walk with you slowly. Are you safe to walk?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to say "thank you" in French.
You say "merci" for thank you. Is it for a special day?
Yes, it is for my friend's birthday. How do I say "happy birthday"?
You say "joyeux anniversaire". That is a lovely wish.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The snow is very deep outside my door.
That sounds like a lot of work. Do you have boots on?
I put on my warm boots and my red scarf.
Good, you are ready for the cold. What did you do first?
I built a small snowman in the yard.
That is a fun game. Did you give it a carrot nose?
Yes, I found a carrot in the kitchen.
I am glad you had fun. Was it very cold?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My fence broke in the storm. I am so mad.
Oh no, that is very sad. Did you see where it broke?
Yes, the big wood piece snapped.
It looks like a hard fix. Do you have a hammer?
I do, but I do not know how to nail it.
You can try one small nail first. Is it standing up?
Yes, but it is leaning over.
You need to push it straight first. It will stay then.
Okay, I will try to push it.
Good luck, I hope it works.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to float on my back.
That is a fun skill to learn. Do you know how to kick your legs?
Yes, I can kick my legs like a frog.
Good. Let us try to lie on your back in the water. Are you scared of the water?
I am a little scared, but I want to try.
It is okay to be scared. Trust me to keep you safe. Are you ready to let go?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to run to the bus right now.
Running is hard work. Are your feet okay?
Yes, I have to go, thanks.
Please be safe. Good luck!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love Mondays so much today.
That is very good to hear. What is your favorite part of the week?
I like the quiet start of the day.
Quiet starts are nice. Do you like loud days too?
Not really, I prefer calm time.
I do not know how you feel about loud places.
I feel happy with the slow pace.
That sounds peaceful. Is today a good day for you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the fence broken? It looks wobbly.
Yes, one part is bent. What did you touch?
I just looked at it. Is it safe to lean on?
No, please do not lean on it. I will fix it soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to see this big blue lake.
That is great news. Does the water look very clear to you?
Yes, I can see the rocks at the bottom.
The lake looks peaceful and calm.
I love how quiet it is right now.
Quiet places are often nice. What are you doing down there?
I am just sitting and watching the sky.
That sounds like a good way to relax.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why should I try again?
Because you can learn new things. What makes you feel stuck?
I am just very tired.
Rest is good. Do you feel calm now?
Yes, I think I can do it.
That is true. You have done hard things before.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing in this new town and I do not know where to go.
The air smells like fresh bread. Do you like sweet food?
I do not know. I just want to find a safe place to sit.
There is a quiet park with soft grass just ahead. Come with me.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not want to go to the doctor. It feels bad.
That is a tough feeling. Do you like the wait?
The wait is boring, but the shot is scary.
I am sorry you are scared. Do you have a favorite toy?
Yes, I have a bear, but I am still mad.
The doctor is here to help you feel better.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Can you teach me how to ride a bike?
I can help you start. Do you have a helmet on?
Yes, I am ready to try.
First, sit on the seat and put your feet on the pedals.
I am sitting. What do I do next?
Now, push the pedals with your legs. I am not sure if you will fall, but I am here.
I am moving! This is hard but fun.
You are doing a great job. How does the balance feel?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you remember my old friend?
I do not know who you are talking about. Can you tell me her name?
Her name is Mia. We played tag in the park.
I still do not know Mia. What color was her shirt?
It was bright red. She was very fast.
That helps a little. Was she shy or loud?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to sing a song, but my voice feels small.
That is a nice start. Do you like to sing alone or with friends?
I like to sing alone, but I am afraid of sounding bad.
It is okay to sound bad at first. What song makes you feel happy?
I like a song about a boat.
That is a lovely choice. Do you know the words to it yet?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today and I want to share it with you.
That makes me smile too. What makes you feel so good?
I made a big circle out of clay in the garden.
That sounds like a lot of fun to do. Did it break?
No, it stayed whole and felt warm under my hands.
I am glad it stayed whole. Do you have any other shapes?
Yes, I found a sharp triangle in the sand later.
A triangle is a strong shape. How did you find it?
I just dug near the dune and saw it there.
That is a lucky find. Is it smooth or rough?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the post office today. The line was very long, but I am happy I got my letter in the box.
That sounds like a big wait. Did you get a stamp for your letter?
Yes, I bought a round blue one. Then I waved to the kind man at the desk.
That is a nice thing to do. Do you know who the letter is for?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My teacher looks very sad today. What should I do?
A kind word helps. Did you talk to her today?
No, I was afraid. She seems unhappy about the test.
Tell her you tried hard. I do not know why she is sad.
Should I give her a note? It feels safe that way.
Yes, a note is a good idea. What will you write in it?
I will say she does a great job. That is true.
That sounds sweet. I hope it makes her smile.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you have red shoes?
Yes, I do. Do you like red?
I do, but my feet hurt.
Let us check the size. Are your feet tired?
They are very tired.
Take your time. Do you want to sit?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad because the food here is bad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you try the soup?
No, the chicken was dry and cold.
That sounds very unpleasant. Do you want help finding a new place?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the internet so fast?
It moves like a very fast train of light. Do you like riding on fast things?
But why does it stop sometimes?
Sometimes the path gets too crowded, so it must slow down. I do not know why it stops for long.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the fish swim in circles?
They are looking for food. Do you see the flakes floating in the water?
Why does one fish look so big?
I am not sure, but it may just be closer to the glass. Is that the only one that looks big?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which movie to watch tonight.
That can be hard to pick. Do you like scary stories?
No, I want something fun and happy.
A bright comedy might work well for you.
I am still not sure what to choose.
Pick the one with the best look. Do you trust your gut?
Yes, I think I will pick the first one.
That is a good plan. Have fun watching it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to be at the post office.
That sounds like a great day! What made you smile?
I finally sent my letter to my friend.
That is a lovely thing to do.
I hope they get it very soon.
I am sure they will. Do you have more stamps?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck on this island and I do not know what to do next.
Do you have any food or water with you?
I have some water, but I am very lost and scared.
Look for the sun to find your way, and keep moving slowly.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to plant a seed in the quiet yard.
You dig a small hole and put the seed in. Do you have a trowel to help you?
Yes, I have a little metal tool. What do I do after I put it in?
You cover it with soil and give it water. Is the yard sunny or shady?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you know where the best sand is?
The sand is soft near the blue flag. Are you going to swim?
No, I just want to walk. Is it far from here?
It is very close, just turn left. Do you like hot sun?
It is too hot for me. Do I need a hat?
Yes, a hat is good for your head. Have a fun time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am late for my class. My bus left without me. What should I do?
This is a tough spot. Do you have your teacher's phone number?
Yes, I do. But I am scared to call.
That is a good step to take.
Should I just walk there? It is very far.
Walking takes time. Is it safe to walk there now?
I think so, but I may still be late.
Tell the truth about the bus.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I put yeast in my dough, but it will not get bigger. Why?
Warm water helps the yeast wake up. Did you use water that was too hot?
It was warm, but maybe not hot enough. How do I know if the water is the right temperature?
Feel the water with your finger. It should feel like a gentle hug. Do you have a thermometer?
No, I just use my hand. Is there anything else I should do to help it grow?
Keep it in a cozy spot and cover it with a cloth. Do you know where in your house is warmest?
The top of the fridge is warm. I will try that. Thank you for helping me understand.
You are welcome. Wait and watch for little bubbles to appear.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn French right now. It is very late.
That is a big goal for one night. Do you like talking or reading?
I just need to say hello and goodbye. I am leaving in five minutes.
You can say "bonjour" and "au revoir." Do you want to practice one?
No, I have to go. I will use them later.
Good luck on your trip. Say "bonjour" to someone tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I broke my cup. I am so glad I tell you.
Oh no, did you get hurt?
No, I am fine. I just want to tell you.
You did the right thing to tell me.
I feel happy now. Do you feel happy too?
I am happy you are safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a fence for my garden. How do I start?
First, you need to measure the space. Do you have a tape ready?
Yes, I have a tape. What do I do next?
Dig small holes for the posts. Are your tools sharp?
They are a bit dull. Do I need new ones?
Sharp tools work better. I do not know your local shop prices.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a star with paper?
That is a fun shape. Do you have some scissors?
Yes, I have a pair. What is the next step?
Fold the paper in half to start. Then cut along the edge in pointy shapes.
I cut it, but it is not a star. What did I do wrong?
You may have cut the folded edge. Did you cut the open side?
I think I cut the wrong part. Can you explain it again?
Cut only the folded side to get points. I am not sure if that fixed your issue.
It worked this time. Thank you for the help.
I am glad you made a star. Do you want to try a square next?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we learn to sing?
It lets you feel happy and free. Do you like music?
I do, but it feels hard.
Your voice just needs practice. Do you have a song you love?
Yes, a very loud one.
That is a great start.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Today was so warm and bright.
That sounds lovely. Did you enjoy the sun?
Yes, I saw a red rose on a table.
Roses are pretty flowers. Did you smell them?
They smelled sweet, like honey.
How nice. Did you eat cake too?
Yes, we ate lots of sweet cake.
I am glad you had fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the meeting was too long.
That sounds tiring. Do you want to rest?
Yes, but I forgot to bring my notes.
That is a common worry. Did you remember most of it?
I think so, but I feel foggy.
Your brain needs a break. Let us step outside for air.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very late for school. My shoes are too big and I tripped.
Oh no, that is a big shoe. Did you hurt your foot?
No, I am fine. But the bus is leaving soon and I do not know if I can run fast enough.
Running can help you arrive on time. Do you usually like to play on the bus?
Yes, I do. But the teacher will be sad if I am late. I am afraid now.
Do not be afraid. Just walk quickly and let us go.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky so gray?
The clouds are thick. Do you like rain?
Why is it windy outside?
The air is moving fast. Is your hair blowing?
Why is it cold this morning?
The sun is not out yet. Do you have a warm coat?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do bugs have so many legs?
They use them to walk fast and jump. Do you like to watch them move?
They look so tiny. Can ants really lift big things?
Yes, they are very strong for their size.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
It is quiet because it is late. Do you live here?
Yes, I do. It feels a bit too still.
Quiet streets are often safe. Do you like the silence?
I am not sure. It feels a little lonely.
Loneliness can go away soon. Is there anyone nearby?
I think so, but I cannot see them.
Look for a lit window. Do you see any lights?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do robots feel pain?
I do not know for sure. Do you think they should feel pain?
No, I do not think they should.
That is a kind thought. Why do you ask about feelings?
I am writing a story about a robot.
That sounds fun. Is your robot friendly?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have so many clothes and I do not know what to put in my bag.
Put one shirt and one pair of pants first. Do you need to pack shoes?
Yes, I think I need shoes, but they are very big.
Try to roll them up to save space. Do you have any small toys?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My chair leg is wobbly and I am sad. It broke when I sat on it too hard.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a small hammer?
Yes, I have a small hammer and some old nails.
That is good news. You can tap the nail back in.
I tapped it in and the chair feels strong now.
Nice work! Does it wobble anymore?
No, it does not wobble. I am very happy.
I am glad it is fixed.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so rushed. My feet are moving too fast.
Take a slow breath. What are you waiting for?
The train is leaving right now. I miss it if I stop.
If you miss it, you wait for the next one. Do you think you can pause?
I want to win. I want to be first.
Being first is not the only way to win. Peace wins too.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to grow a sunflower. Is it hard?
It is not hard at all. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
Yes, I have a big window that gets lots of light.
That is a great place to start.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to find a book about fast cars.
We have a great section for that. Do you like to read words or look at pictures?
I like to read words, but they should not be too hard.
Try the middle shelves. They have fun stories for you.
That sounds good. Where is that section?
It is on the left, after the bird books.
Thank you. I will go look now.
You are welcome. Have fun reading!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to catch a fish, but I do not know what to use.
You can try worms or bread. Do you like the smell of worms?
No, I do not. The smell is not nice.
That is a fair point. You can use cheese instead. What is your favorite food?
I like cheese. It smells good too.
Good choice. Cheese works well for many fish.
Should I sit still or move my hand?
Sit very still at first. Do you have a quiet spot?
Yes, near the big tree.
That sounds perfect. Stay calm and watch the line.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start this puzzle.
It is okay to feel stuck. Are the pieces all on the table?
Yes, but I am confused by the colors.
Try to find the edge pieces first.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you know how the bear made his home?
Yes, he stacked big logs by the river. Did you see the small house?
I saw it, but why is the door so small?
A small door keeps the cold air out. Do you think it was warm inside?
It looked cozy, but why did he leave the door open?
He left it open to let the wind in. I do not know why he did that.
Maybe he wanted to hear the birds sing.
That is a very kind guess. Do you like the song?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am lost. I do not see my mom.
Take a deep breath. Do you remember where you started?
No, I only see big cars.
That is scary. Let us stand still and look for someone in a uniform.
I see a red hat. Is that the police?
I do not know for sure. Please do not run. Go ask that person nicely.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cried so hard after the movie. It was so sad.
That shows you have a big heart. What part hurt the most?
The dog ran away and never came back.
Oh, that is very hard to take. Do you have a pet at home?
Yes, I do. But I am still sad about the movie dog.
Missed friends make us sad. Time will help the feeling go away.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my big talk. Do I have time to finish?
You have ten minutes. Do you know where the room is?
I think it is on the top floor.
I do not know for sure. Would you like a quick map?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we knead the dough?
Kneading makes the bread strong. Do you like soft bread?
Yes. Why does it get warm?
The yeast makes it warm. Is your kitchen hot?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see many small birds in my tree. What are they doing?
They are eating seeds from the nuts. Do you see any red ones?
Yes, I see a few with red tails. How do I keep them happy?
Put out fresh water and small sunflower seeds. Do you have a clean bowl for the water?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like apples, but I do not know how to pick a sweet one.
Look for a round shape and bright color. Do you eat the skin?
Yes, I always eat the skin.
That is good for you. The skin has much of the good stuff.
I still find some apples are sour.
Try an apple from a local farm. Do you know where yours come from?
I just buy them at the store.
Try a different kind next time. The Red Delicious is often sweet.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors. Blue light bounces around the air the most, so that is what we see. Do you see other colors in the rain?
Yes, I do!
You are very smart. The same kind of bouncing happens with a rainbow, but the light splits up. Is the sun out right now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. My plant looks dry and I do not know how it drinks.
Do not worry. I will help you understand this.
But the water is in the pot. The leaves are far away. How does the water get up there?
The roots suck the water up. Do you see the roots at the bottom?
I do not see them because they are inside the soil. Is that how all plants work?
Yes, this is true for most plants. The stems carry the water to the leaves.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do magnets stick to metal?
They pull on certain metals. Do you have a fridge?
Yes, my toys stick to it. Why does it only work on some things?
Iron inside the metal is special. What did you play with?
My car sticks best. Why is that?
The car has more iron than the toy. Is it a blue car?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad about that meeting today. It went really bad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did it go badly because of a delay?
Yes, the boss talked over me and I felt small. It was so unfair.
That sounds very hurtful. I do not know all the details. Did you speak up to them later?
No, I just left the room. I do not want to talk about work.
I hear you and respect your space. Would you like some water?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I picked some red flowers for you.
They are lovely. Did you pick them from a garden?
Yes, they smell sweet. Can I keep them in the vase?
Yes, cut the stems short. Do they have thorns?
No, they are smooth. Will they last a long time?
I hope so. Check the water every day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late today. My alarm did not ring. I ran to the kitchen. I ate two eggs and some toast.
That sounds like a quick start. Do you like eggs?
Yes, I do. But now I am late for work. I am so tired.
I am sorry you are rushing. I hope you get a good rest later.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to sing in the shower today.
That sounds like fun. Did you pick a song you know well?
I forgot the words right away.
That happens to many people. Do you want to try learning just one verse?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I do not know how to make my computer run faster.
Is your computer very old?
Yes, it is quite old and slow.
Can you clean up the files on your desk?
I can, but I do not know how to clean the files inside the computer.
I do not know the exact steps for your specific machine.
That is okay, I will ask someone else.
That sounds like a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I felt very sad today because I dropped my ice cream and it hit the ground.
That is a very bad feeling. Did you have to eat it anyway?
No, I could not eat it. I am still worried that my whole week will be bad now.
I do not know if that will happen, but I hope it gets better. What made you feel that way?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat at my desk today and felt very tired.
That sounds heavy. Did you drink some water?
I played a game against my brother instead.
Playing games is fun. Who won the match?
I lost, but I learned a new trick.
Losing can teach us things. What was the trick?
I used my knight to save my king.
The knight is a strong piece. Did you feel proud?
Yes, I did, and now I want to play again.
That is a good goal.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My fish got away and my line snapped.
I am sorry. That is bad luck. Was it a big fish?
It was huge. Now I have no dinner.
Do not worry. We can catch more.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is learning a new language so hard?
Your brain is making new paths. It takes time. Do you read books for fun?
I do. Why do people want to learn languages?
To talk to new friends. It is nice. What language do you want?
I want to speak French. Why is French fun?
The sound is like music. It feels sweet. Do you like music?
I do. How should I start learning?
Start with ten new words a day. Keep going. Are you ready to try?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big red apple. It looks so sweet.
Red apples are yummy. Do you like them whole?
I cut it into small pieces. It is ready to eat.
That sounds fun. What color is the inside?
It is white and shiny. I want to give you one.
Thank you, that is very kind. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to act in a play but I feel very shy.
That is scary but you can do it. Do you have a small part?
Yes, I am just a tree in the forest.
That is great. Trees do not have to talk much. Have you tried your lines yet?
I think I will practice them at home.
That sounds like a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my boat broke and I am stuck on this island.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have any fresh water?
I found some water, but I am worried about the hungry sharks.
That is a scary thought. Are they close to your boat?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a bear near my house. What should I do?
Back away slowly. Did it look at you?
Yes, it looked at me. Is that bad?
It might be hungry. Please tell a grown up.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love apples, but I do not know how to make them last long.
That is a sweet habit. Do you have a fridge at home?
Yes, I have a big fridge in my kitchen.
Keep the apples cold and dry. Put them in a crisper drawer to stay fresh.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How much does a wedding cost?
It depends on many things. How many guests do you plan to invite?
I do not know yet. Maybe fifty people?
That is a good number. Do you want food or just drinks?
I want food for everyone. Is that expensive?
Yes, food can be pricey. Do you have a set day in mind?
We are thinking about June. Is that a busy time?
June is very popular. Do you like the idea of a big party?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My leg hurts from digging in the dirt.
Ouch. Did you drink some water?
Yes, I am happy the floor is flat now.
That is good news. Do you have the walls ready?
They are in the yard, but I am tired.
Good job today. Do you want to stop for now?
Yes, I think I will stop.
That is a wise choice.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with the sailors.
That is a hard feeling. Do they look tired?
Yes, they are very tired and confused.
Rest is good for them. Are they safe?
I think they are safe, but I worry.
Worrying is normal. Do you have a plan?
No, I have no plan at all.
Let us just sit and watch. Is the wind calm?
The wind is soft and quiet.
Good. You are doing fine. Do you need help?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to plant seeds in my garden. How do I do it?
Dig a small hole, drop the seed in, and cover it with soil. Do you have a shovel?
Yes, I have a big shovel. Is that too big?
A small shovel is better, but a big one works if you are careful. How deep do you dig?
I do not know how deep to dig. Can you tell me?
Dig about as deep as your thumb is wide. Is the soil dry or wet?
The soil is a bit dry. Should I water it?
Yes, water it gently before and after planting. I do not know which seeds you chose, but they like water.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw three big boats today. The wind was very loud.
That sounds exciting. Did you see any sailors on them?
Yes, I saw one waving. He had a red hat.
That is a nice detail. What color was the water?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took my dog for a walk in the park today.
That sounds like fun. Did he meet any friends?
Yes, he met a big brown dog. They played chase.
I am glad they had a good time. Is he tired now?
He is sleeping on his bed right now.
Good boy. He must have had a busy day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Did you like the bear in the movie?
Yes, he was very big and soft. Did you like him too?
I did not. He looked scary to me.
That makes sense, he did look a little scary. Do you want to talk about the bird?
Yes, the bird was nice. He gave the bear food.
He was a good helper. Did you like the whole movie?
Yes, the end was happy.
I am glad you enjoyed the happy ending.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a big party today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you eat any cake?
Yes, I had a big slice of chocolate.
Ooh, I like chocolate too. Did you meet any new friends?
I met one boy who liked to build blocks.
That is a good thing. Did you play with him?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad. I spent all my lunch money on candy.
That sounds frustrating. Did you miss lunch?
Yes, my tummy is empty. I need a way to keep my money safe.
A small jar works well. Do you like jars?
I guess so. But I always forget to put coins in them.
Try putting one coin in every time you wash your hands. I know this helps.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn words for "house" and "dog" fast. I am very late.
House and dog are easy. Do you speak any other words?
Yes, I know "water" and "apple". I must go now.
Good choices. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today because I helped a friend.
That is a very kind thing to do. Does your friend know how much you care?
Yes, we smiled and said please and thank you to each other.
Good manners make people feel warm and safe. Why do you think that happens?
It makes us feel good to be nice to others.
True kindness always starts with the heart. Do you do this for your family too?
Yes, I say good morning to my mom every day.
That is a sweet start to any day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I ride the big bus?
You buy a ticket first. Do you have enough coins?
Yes, I have coins. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a good trip.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a nice place for lunch today.
That sounds good. Was the food warm?
Yes, the soup was hot and cozy.
Oh, I like hot soup too. Did you try a second bowl?
I did, and it was very sweet.
Sweet soup is special. What did you drink with it?
Just some cold water.
Water is a fine choice.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today. I want to share this good feeling.
That is wonderful. What made you feel so good?
I saw a sad bird. I gave it some water.
That was very kind of you. Does the bird look better now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel stuck and do not know what to do next.
Take a deep breath. What makes you feel this way?
I just want to hurry, but I keep getting it wrong.
Slow is often good. Do you need a small break?
I guess I am just tired of trying so hard.
That is okay. I do not know your answer, but rest is true.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I promised to play with my friend, but it is raining.
That is hard. Do you have a ball?
Yes, but my legs are cold.
You can try to see if it is warm inside.
My house is very cold.
If it is too cold, tell your friend you are sorry. Honesty is good.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My kitchen caught fire this evening. I am very scared. What should I do?
Please stay calm. Is the fire small, or is it big?
It is a big fire. I want to leave the house now.
That is the right thing to do. Run outside immediately.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red leaf on the path.
That is a nice find. Did you put it in your bag?
Yes, I put it in my pocket.
Your pocket is getting full. What else did you collect today?
I also picked up a smooth gray rock.
A rock is a good addition. Is it heavy?
Not very, but it feels good in my hand.
It sounds like a happy day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I lost my map. How do I find the post office?
You can ask a person on the street. Do you know which way is north?
No, I do not. It is all the same to me.
Try walking straight. Do you see any red boxes?
I see a big red box. Is that it?
Yes, that is likely the place. Does it have a sign?
Yes, it says post office. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people work from home?
They save time not riding a bus. Do you like working there?
I think it is nice and quiet.
Yes, it is. Is it too quiet for you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake a cake. What is the first step?
First, you mix the dry parts. Do you have any flour?
Yes, I have a bag of white flour. What else do I need?
You need sugar and eggs next. Is your oven warm?
It is not on yet. How long does it take to get hot?
It takes about ten minutes. Would you like me to tell you how to check?
Yes, please. How do I know when it is ready?
You can put a piece of paper inside. If it turns brown, it is hot.
That sounds easy. What day of the week is best for this?
Any day works well for baking. Do you plan to bake this weekend?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with this rain.
It makes the ground wet. Do you like the wet?
I like it, but my shoes are getting cold.
You can play inside if your toes are too cold.
I have no books to read inside.
I do not know where your books are. Is your coat dry?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today.
That sounds fun. Did you see any dogs?
Yes, I saw a big brown dog.
I am glad you had a nice time.
I ate an apple under the tree.
Apples are sweet. Was yours red or green?
It was red and crunchy.
I am happy for you.
I am tired now.
Good rest. See you tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Where is the fish shop?
It is just past the bread stall. Do you like fish?
Yes, I love it. Is it fresh today?
It looks very fresh. What kind do you want?
Just some small white fish. How much is it?
It costs five coins for one pound. Do you have enough money?
I have six coins. Is that enough?
Yes, that is enough. You will have one coin left.
Great, I will buy it now. Thank you very much.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The moon looks like a big white ball tonight. It is so bright.
Yes, it is a very bright sight. Do you like looking up at the sky?
I want to know why it changes shape. Sometimes it is full, sometimes it is small.
The sun lights up the moon from different angles. This makes the shape look different. Do you know which side of the moon lights up first?
I do not know. Can you tell me how long it takes to go from small to full?
It takes about two weeks to get to the full moon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Where do I put my letter?
You put it in that big red box. Do you have a stamp for it?
I have a stamp.
Great. You put it on the corner. Is it for a friend?
Yes, it is for my sister.
That is a sweet gift. Do you know how much it costs to send?
I do not know.
I can help you check. Do you have your money ready?
I have my coins.
Let us count them together. I am happy to help you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My phone screen is very dark and hard to read.
Did you turn up the bright light button?
I do not know where that button is.
It is usually on the side. Do you see a small knob?
Yes, I found it and the screen is bright now.
Great. Are you happy with your phone now?
Yes, thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like a new song, but I am not sure what it makes me feel.
That is a good question. Do you feel happy or sad when you hear it?
I feel a little bit of both. It is very fast but the words are sad.
It might be a pop song. Does it make you want to dance?
Yes, my body moves on its own. I think I really like it.
If you like it, that is the most important part.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to keep more coins. How do I do that?
You can put them in a box. Do you have a box ready?
Yes, I have an old shoe box. Is that a good spot?
Yes, it works well. Try to save one coin a day. Do you play with your toys?
Yes, I play with them a lot. Does that cost money?
No, playing is free. It saves you money for later.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
It is likely just an empty house. Do you like quiet places?
Yes, I do. What is that sound I just heard?
I am not sure what it was.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so worried about my test. I am late for the bus.
That sounds scary, but you can do this. Are you ready to go?
No, my notes are all over the floor.
Pick up only the red book. Do you have your keys?
Yes, I have my keys.
Good. Run now. I believe in you.
Thanks. Bye.
Bye. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to run, but I need to move my body.
Walking is a great choice for your heart. Do you have five minutes?
I have two minutes. Is that enough?
It helps a little, but more is better. Do you like walking outside?
I do, but it is too far. Can I walk inside?
Yes, you can walk in place. Do you have space?
I am in the hallway. It is narrow.
That is fine for a short walk. Keep your shoulders back.
I must go now. Thanks.
You are welcome. Go safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes, but I always get stuck.
That is a hard thing to do. Do you have a buddy to help you?
No, my friend left early, so I am alone now.
You can practice with just one shoe. Are you trying to use a bow?
Yes, I want to make a nice bow, but my hands are clumsy.
Start by pulling the strings tight. That makes the bow stay put.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw the best play ever today.
That sounds great. What was the story about?
It was about a brave little dog.
I love dogs. Did the dog win?
Yes, he saved his family.
That is so sweet. Were the actors good?
They were very funny and kind.
Funny always helps. Did you laugh a lot?
I laughed until my hurt.
Haha, you are having fun. Go see it again soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have not talked to my best friend for a long time. I am very sad. What should I do?
It is hard to miss a good friend. Did you want to reach out to them?
Yes, I want to, but I am afraid they will be angry with me.
Most people are happy to hear from an old friend. Give them a small call?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I have to show up on time for my first job?
Being on time shows that you care. Do you like waking up early?
I do not like waking up early. Why is it so hard?
Your body wants to sleep more. I do not know why you find it hard. Is it because you are tired?
Yes, I am very tired. What should I do?
Try to sleep early tonight. Do you like sleeping in?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why is there a rainbow in the sky?
It happens when rain mixes with bright sun. Do you like the color red?
Yes, I love red. Which color comes last?
Violet comes at the end of the arc. I do not know why that is, but it looks sweet.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very tired. My eyes hurt. What should I do?
That sounds hard. Do you want to rest?
Yes, but I have so much to do. How do I start?
Pick one small thing first.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go, but the wind is too strong.
Hold on, is the wind blowing from the left?
I do not know, I am late.
Sorry, I do not know either. Go fast and be safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love that story about the boy who builds a castle. How do I build one?
You can use blocks or dirt to make the walls. Do you like tall castles?
Yes, I want it to be very tall. Do I need a special tool?
No, you just need your hands and a flat place to start. What shape do you want the tower?
A round one. What if the blocks fall down?
That is normal. You can just try again and make the base wider. Is it fun when it stands up?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to eat my green vegetables.
They can help your body grow strong. Do you like to play outside?
Yes, but they taste very bitter.
Try adding a little bit of cheese on top. It makes them taste better. Have you tried carrots before?
I did, but I still do not want more.
That is okay, you can take small bites.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. How do I fix it?
A cool cloth can help. Do you have one?
Yes, I do. What else can I try?
Drinking water is good. Do you like the taste of water?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I hit the ball back?
Hold the racket like a fist and swing it straight. Do you have a racket?
Yes, I do. What should my feet do?
Keep them close together and bend your knees. Do you play outside?
Yes, on a dirt court. How do I stop the ball from flying away?
Swing at the middle of the ball, not the top. Is it fun for you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is it dark in my room?
The lights are off because the power is gone. Are you scared?
No, but my toy car stopped moving.
It needs power to work, just like us. Do you want a snack?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to count my toys, but I get confused.
Start with one and touch each toy as you say the number. Do you like counting numbers?
Sometimes I lose track of what I have done.
You can put each counted toy in a box to stop. Is that a good plan for you?
That sounds like a great way to remember.
Yes, it helps your brain keep the order straight.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hit the ball into the net again. I think I am going to quit.
That is a hard moment. Do you want to take a short break?
Maybe. I just feel so bad about my game.
Bad days happen to good players. Have you tried shorter swings?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very bad inside and I do not know why.
That sounds scary. What did you eat today?
I ate some apple. I think I am sick but I am not sure.
Apples are good. Do you have a fever?
No, but my head hurts. I just want to hide.
Resting helps. Tell me what hurts most.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to sing well by tomorrow, but I have no time.
Do not panic. Do you know a song you like?
I like that pop song, but my voice sounds bad.
Your voice is fine. Did you practice today?
No, I just rushed here. What do I do?
Rest your throat. Do you want a simple tip?
Yes, please. I am very late.
Drink water. Try one line slowly.
One line slowly? I will try that.
Good plan. Go now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I use my voice better in the play?
Start by taking a slow, deep breath from your belly. Do you feel your chest move when you breathe?
Yes, I feel it. What should I do next?
Speak from your tummy, not your neck. This makes your sound strong and clear.
That feels good. How do I sound happy?
Smile a little before you speak. A smile helps your voice sound bright and true. Do you smile often?
I do. But what if I forget my lines?
That is okay. Just stop for one second and think about what comes next. Do you practice your words?
Yes, I read them every night.
Great work. Practice makes you feel ready and calm.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I read a book with a red dragon. I think I like it, but I am not sure.
That sounds like a fun story. Did the dragon eat anyone?
No, it just burned a house. Now I want to find a new book to read.
I do not know which one you will pick next. Do you like happy stories?
Yes, I like stories that end with a hug. Can you help me choose?
Try a book about a kind dog. That often ends with a hug.
I will look for that one. Thank you.
You are welcome. I hope you enjoy the read.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am hungry. My day was long.
I am sorry to hear that. What made the day so long?
I cleaned the floor. It took many hours.
That is hard work. What food do you want now?
I want soup. It sounds warm.
Soup is a good choice. Do you have any vegetables?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start growing tomatoes in my pot?
Pick a big pot and use rich soil. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
Yes, my balcony gets sun all day.
Great, put the pot there after the cold nights end. Should we talk about watering next?
