Yes, I am not sure how often to water.
Water them when the top soil feels dry. Do you know how to check the soil?
I just press my finger into the dirt.
That is the right way to check. You are doing great so far.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Where is the bus?
I do not know where it is. Are you going to work?
Yes, I must be there now.
Please sit down and wait.
I cannot sit. I am running.
Walking helps you think. What did you forget?
My bag is gone.
Did you leave it at home?
No, I packed it.
Let us call your home.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: How do plants get their water?
They pull it up from the soil through their roots. Do you know where roots are?
I guess they are underground?
Yes, they are like straws. Do you have a plant at home?
I do, but I am not sure how to help it drink.
Just put it in a warm spot with some light. Do you know why light helps?
I do not know why.
I am not sure either, but water rises up the stem.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad. I do not want to eat the pizza.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like soup instead?
Yes, I like soup. But the soup is too hot.
Wait for a bit. It will cool down soon. Is the room warm?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people save money?
They save so they have extra cash for fun things or surprises. Do you like to save coins?
How can I keep more of my pocket money?
Try giving less to toys and putting more in a jar. What do you spend your money on?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I can't do this math. I feel so bad.
It is okay to feel stuck. Do you know where you got stuck?
I just don't get the last part.
Let's look at that part together.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up and felt so happy because it is my birthday.
That is wonderful. How did you start your morning?
I went outside and saw a big sun.
A sunny day is perfect for a birthday. Did you see any birds?
Yes, a blue bird sang to me.
That must have felt special. What else happened?
My friends came to the park.
Friends are a great gift. What did you do together?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What does the little soldier do?
It moves one step forward. Do you like the little soldiers?
No, I like the big horse.
The horse is called a knight. It jumps in an L shape.
Why does it jump?
It jumps so it can hop over other pieces. Is jumping fun?
Yes, my king is safe.
That is good. Try to win the game!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a big bear by the river. Is it safe to get close?
No, keep a safe distance. Did you see its cubs with it?
It was alone. Should I take a picture?
Please do not take photos or make noise.
It looked a bit thin. Can I feed it?
Never feed wild animals. It makes them sick.
Why does feeding hurt them?
Wild food is best for them. What did you eat today?
I had an apple. Is that good for a bear?
No, apples are bad for bears. Keep it simple.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: We went to the beach today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What did you see first?
I saw a big red crab.
Wow, that is a lucky find. Did it move away?
It ran into the sand very fast.
Crabs are quick! Did you touch the wet sand?
Yes, it was cool and soft.
That must feel nice. Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people love football so much?
It is fun to watch and play. Do you like to kick a ball?
Yes, I do. Why is the goal so big?
A big goal makes it easier to score. Do you enjoy scoring goals?
I do. Why do teams wear different colors?
It helps players see each other on the field. Do you have a favorite team?
My dad’s team. Why do they run so fast?
They run fast to catch the ball first. Do you run a lot?
Sometimes. Why is the ball round?
A round ball rolls far and smooth. Do you like to kick it far?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so heavy and tired today.
That sounds hard. Do you get enough sleep?
Yes, but I still feel weak inside.
Sometimes our minds are busy too. Is something on your mind?
I just want to stop for a moment.
You can rest right now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does the clock tick?
The gears inside push each other. Do you like the sound?
It is loud sometimes. How do I make it quiet?
Use a wax pad under it. Did you try that?
No, I have not. Where do I buy a pad?
A craft shop has them. I do not know where near you live.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky wet after it rains?
The rain leaves water up high. Do you like watching rain?
Yes, but why does a bow of light appear?
Sunlight hits the small water drops and bends to make colors.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go to the park today. What should I do first?
You should look outside. Is it raining?
No, the sun is out. What should I pack?
A bottle of water is a good idea. Do you want to bring a snack?
Yes, an apple is perfect. How do we get there?
We can walk or ride bikes. Which way do you like best?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy fruit. Which one is sweet?
Apples are very sweet. Do you like red ones or green ones?
I like red ones. Where do I find them?
Look near the front of the store. I do not know if they are on sale today.
That is good to know. Is the bread close by?
Yes, it is right next to the fruit.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a small box. I do not know what to do with it.
Is it for a friend? Tell me who it is for.
It is for my sister. I am not sure if she will like it.
That is a nice thought. She will be happy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late and I do not know what to eat.
Try an egg. Do you have milk for toast?
Yes I have both but I am still running out of time.
Fry the egg fast. Would you like help with the plate?
Please just tell me how to cook the egg quickly.
Put it in a hot pan for two minutes. Is the pan clean?
It is clean and the egg is almost done.
Great job. Enjoy your quick meal.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to bake bread but my dough is flat and will not grow. What is wrong?
Is the room where you are baking warm? Warm air helps the bread rise.
The room is a bit cold. Should I add more yeast to fix it?
No, do not add more yeast. Try moving the dough near a window with sun to warm it up.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I felt so scared in my dream.
That must have felt bad to wake up from. Did you see anything strange?
The shadows moved on their own.
Shadows only move when light changes. Are you feeling calm now?
I just want to feel safe.
You are safe in your bed right now. Take a slow breath with me.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to fish in this new town.
Is there a big lake nearby?
Yes, I see boats on the water.
You need a rod and a hook.
Where do I get those things?
I do not know where to look.
Maybe a shop on Main Street?
That is a good guess.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have wet clothes. What should I do?
Do you have a dryer?
I am not sure. Can I just hang them up?
Yes, hanging works well.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am mad. I keep counting wrong.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you want to try again?
I lost track at five. My brain feels foggy.
Let us start over together. One, two, three. What comes next?
Four, I think. But I am not sure.
You are right, it is four. Are you feeling better?
Yes, a little. Thank you for helping me.
I am happy to help. Did that help you feel calm?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am packing my bag for school. It is heavy today.
Oh no, that sounds tiring. What did you put in it?
Just my books and a big lunch box. I was so busy getting ready.
A full lunch box is good. Did you eat breakfast?
Yes, I had toast. But I forgot my water bottle until just now.
Good catch. That will help you stay strong.
I hope I remember to drink it at recess. It is hard to pack everything.
You can do it. It is nice that you tried.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with these cards.
What card are you holding?
It is a red ace.
That is a good card to play first.
Is it good if I play it now?
Yes, go ahead.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just landed from my long trip and I feel so good.
That is wonderful news. How did the time go by?
The movie was fun and the snacks were tasty.
I am glad you enjoyed your meal. Did you sleep well on the plane?
I drifted off for a few hours and woke up happy.
Fresh rest is always a great way to arrive. What is your first plan now?
I want to hug my family and see my pet.
That sounds like a perfect welcome.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a rope to a boat?
That is a hard knot to learn. Do you like to climb trees?
Yes, I do. I like to climb high.
Good. Start by making a loop in the rope.
What do I do with the loop?
Wrap the end around the post twice. Is the rope smooth or rough?
It is a little rough.
Pull it tight when you are done.
Does it stay tight?
Yes, it stays very tight.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the leaves turn red and fall down in autumn?
The days get colder and shorter, so trees need to save water. Do you like looking at the bright colors?
I do! But why does the tree drop its leaves if it needs them?
Trees are like people; they sleep in winter to rest. Do you like finding cool leaves on the ground?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to get my friend.
What does she like to do for fun?
She loves to draw and read books.
A nice set of colored pencils would be good.
But what if she already has some?
A new book about animals is a safe pick.
She has many animal books at home.
I do not know her exact collection.
So what should I buy then?
A sketchbook lets her draw any time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I lost my mom. I am very scared.
Do not worry. Are you holding her bag?
No, I let it go. I do not know where she is.
Let us look for her together. Do you see a red coat?
I see a big red coat over there. Is that her?
I do not know for sure. Let us go ask her.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Why is the sky blue? I am late!
Sunlight hits air and blue light bounces around. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, but I must go now.
The blue light spreads everywhere for us to see. Can I help you find your way?
No, please just explain it fast.
Air scatters blue more than red light. Did that make sense?
Yes, thank you. Goodbye.
Blue wins because it scatters the most. Have a good day!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I take a good photo?
Try to hold the camera steady. Do you like nature shots?
Yes, I love trees.
Look for bright light on the leaves. Is it sunny where you are?
It is very sunny today.
Stand back a little to get the whole tree. Do you have a zoom lens?
No, I only have my phone.
That is fine, just stand further away. Do you know how to use focus?
I am not sure how to do that.
Tap the screen on the tree.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I had a really scary dream about a big dark tree.
That sounds scary, but trees cannot hurt you. Did you see any colors in the dark?
It just looked black and my heart went fast.
Your heart was beating fast because you were scared. Have you ever held a soft toy in a bad dream?
No, I woke up and ran to you.
I am glad you came to me. You are safe now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My grandma is sad today. How can I help her?
That is kind of you. Do you like to listen to music?
Yes, I do. What should I play?
You could play a song she likes. Does she have a favorite tune?
I do not know what she likes.
You can ask her directly. She will likely be happy to tell you.
I will ask her right now.
That is a good plan. I hope it makes her smile.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park this morning. The sun was warm on my face.
That sounds nice. Did you enjoy the walk?
I saw a dog playing with a ball. My legs felt tired but happy.
Good for you. Do you walk often?
I hope to do it every day. My feet need rest now.
Rest is good for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a tiny island with soft sand.
That sounds like a perfect place to rest. Do you have a boat?
Yes, I have a small blue boat.
I am glad you are safe. Is the water clear there?
Yes, the water is very clear.
What do the fish look like?
They are small and shiny.
That is a wonderful find. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Which day comes right after Monday?
Tuesday comes right after Monday. Do you like Tuesday?
I am not sure. What is the first day of the week?
It is usually Sunday, but some people say Monday. What do you think it is?
I think it is Monday. How many days are in a whole week?
There are seven days in a week.
I know five. What are the other two?
Saturday and Sunday are the other two. Do you rest on weekends?
Yes, I do. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I am glad I could help.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we put a roof on the shed?
The roof stops rain from getting in. Do you like it when things get wet?
Why are the walls made of wood?
Wood is strong and easy to cut. What color do you want for the paint?
Why do we nail the corners tight?
Tight nails keep the shed from falling down. Do you know where the nails are?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the bread warm today?
Yes, it is very warm. Do you like sweet bread?
I do not know. What is the best thing to eat?
The apple pie is good. Is it for lunch or dinner?
It is for dinner. How much does the pie cost?
It is five dollars. Do you have cash?
I have coins. Can I pay with these?
Yes, that works fine. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to ride to the store very fast.
Is your bike working well?
Yes, but the road is wet.
Slow down for safety. Is it raining hard?
It is only a little drizzle.
Wipe your eyes clear. Do you know the way?
I forgot the street name.
I do not know either. Do you have a map?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my apple in the mud at lunch.
Oh no, that sounds messy. Did you have a spare?
My friend shared her sandwich with me.
That is very kind of her. What did she put in it?
Just cheese and some lettuce.
Cheese and lettuce sound tasty. Did you feel better after eating?
Yes, I am full and happy now.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to climb a big hill. Do you know how?
You need strong boots and water. Do you have your boots ready?
Yes, I have them. How far should I look?
Look up, not just down. Are you afraid of the top?
A little bit. It is very high.
Take small steps and rest often. You can do this.
Thank you for helping me. I am ready now.
I am glad to help. Have a great climb.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like to play my guitar but my songs sound flat.
What kind of songs do you like to play?
I love old rock songs with loud guitars.
Try playing fast and then slow. Do you have a metronome app?
I do not have an app, I just play for fun.
That is fine. Just listen to the rhythm carefully.
I will try to listen better tonight.
Good luck with your practice.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so tired today.
That sounds hard. Are you getting enough sleep?
Yes, I sleep well.
I am glad to hear that. What makes you feel this way?
I want to tell you I am happy.
Happy and tired at once? That is interesting.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does a sad song make me feel less sad?
It helps your body let out big feelings. Do you listen to slow songs?
Yes, I do. Why does a fast song make me want to dance?
It matches the quick energy inside you. Do you like to jump?
I do. Why do two different songs sound the same?
They use the same shapes of sound. Do you hear the drums?
I hear them. Why do you know so much about music?
I learned it from many people who love songs. Do you have a favorite song?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My horse kicked my shoe off and now I am so angry at him.
That is a very mean trick. Was he playing?
I do not think it was funny, I am just sad my shoe is lost.
I am sorry about your shoe. I do not know how he will act next.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost on this map.
Let us look closer. What color is the place you want to go?
It is blue and near a river.
That is a lake. Is it next to the red road?
Yes, it is right there.
Then you must turn left. Do you see the big tree?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am on the bus but I do not know where to get off.
You can look at the map or ask the driver. Do you have a ticket?
I have a map but the words are too small to read.
You can tap the driver to look at it for you. Is the driver sitting?
I am scared to tap him because he looks busy.
It is okay to ask for help. Are you near the front of the bus?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you know how to play chess?
Yes, I know the rules. Do you want a quick game?
No, I have no time for a game.
I see. Are you trying to save your king?
My king is gone. I lost.
That is hard. Do you play often?
Just once. I feel so bad.
It is okay. Do you want to try again?
Later, maybe. I must go now.
Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I miss my little brother a lot.
That is a sweet feeling. Do you talk to him?
He only plays with his toys. I feel left out.
Try to play with him. What does he like?
He loves building towers.
Build a tower together.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love my new desk at home.
That is a nice thing to have. Do you have a plant on it?
Yes, a big green one.
Plants are good for the eyes. Do you drink hot tea there?
Yes, it keeps me warm.
Warm drinks help with work. I hope you have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is there a rainbow in the sky?
The sun shines on rain, which splits the light into colors. Do you see the red part?
Yes, I do. Why is red always on the top?
Red light bends less than blue light when it hits the water drops. Do you wonder why blue is on the bottom?
That is cool. Thank you for explaining it.
You are welcome. I am glad you liked the answer.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My little village is quiet and small. Does it have a big park?
I do not know if there is a big park. Do you like to play there?
I hope so, because I like to swing.
That sounds fun. Do you have friends to swing with?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the mail place today and lost my stamp.
Oh no, that is bad. Did you have to buy a new one?
I bought a new stamp and the clerk smiled at me.
That is a nice feeling. Do you send a lot of letters?
I only send one letter to my grandma once a week.
That is sweet of you.
I feel good now that the stamp is back in my pocket.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did the dog look so sad at the end?
I think he lost his bone. Did you enjoy that part?
Why did the car drive so fast?
It was trying to beat the storm. That looked scary, didn't it?
Why is the sky so dark?
I do not know the exact reason. Do you like dark movies?
Why did the girl cry?
She missed her friend. Was that a happy tear?
Why was the music so loud?
It showed how excited they felt. Thank you for asking.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to plant a seed.
Pick a pot with a hole. Do you have any dirt?
Yes, I have a bag of it.
Put the soil in the pot. What kind of plant do you want?
I want to grow a tomato.
Put the seed in the dirt. Do you have water nearby?
Yes, there is a jar on the table.
Cover it with more dirt. Is it done?
Yes, the hole is closed.
Give it water and sun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I put my dark shirt with my white socks. Now they are all gray. I am so sad.
Oh no, that is a tricky mistake. Did you use cold water?
Yes, but it did not help. What can I do now?
Try a special wash for colors to stop the stain. Do you have one at home?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I spent all my money on candy.
That feels bad. What kind of candy did you buy?
It was sweet, but now I have zero coins for toys.
I get it. Do you save up slowly or in big chunks?
I just want to fix this fast, but it feels hard.
Start with a small jar. What is your first tiny goal?
Maybe a book. I hope that works.
That is a great start. I am glad you tried.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very bad because I broke my friend's toy.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you know how to fix it?
I tried to glue it, but the pieces do not stay together.
That is a hard thing to fix. What did your friend say when they saw it?
They looked very sad and stopped playing with me.
I understand why you are upset. Do you want to apologize to them?
Yes, but I am afraid they will be angry with me.
It is brave to tell the truth. Do you think they will listen?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like snow days?
Yes, I do. I love snow. Do you like it?
Yes, it is fun.
That is good.
I want to build a snowman today.
That sounds fun. What does it look like?
It has a big red nose.
Oh, how cute.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hi, do you have any warm cookies? I am late.
Yes, they are right there. Are you in a big hurry?
Yes, I have a meeting soon.
Take these two, please. Do you want to pay with a card?
Cash is fine, thanks.
Here is your change. Have a safe trip!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are flowers red?
The color helps bugs find food. Do you like red flowers?
Do flowers feel pain?
Plants do not have nerves like us, so they do not feel pain. What about blue flowers?
Why do flowers smell sweet?
The sweet smell brings in bees. Bees help grow more flowers.
Can all flowers smell sweet?
I do not know if every single one does, but many do. Do you like their scent?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am very tired from the flight. What should I do now?
Go home and rest. Have you eaten yet?
I only had a small snack. I feel dizzy.
Please drink some water and eat something big. Do you have food at home?
Yes, I have bread and cheese. Is that good?
Yes, that is a fine choice.
My legs hurt from sitting. How can I fix that?
I do not know a magic fix, but walking helps. Do you feel better after moving?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late! The screen is black and I have a call in five minutes.
Do not panic. Did you plug the cable into the wall?
It is plugged in. I do not know what is wrong. I am running out of time.
Try clicking the power button twice. Do you see a small light on the front?
Yes! It works now. Thank you so much.
I am glad it works. Was your coffee ready?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the room?
It is down the hall. Is this an urgent thing?
Yes, very. Tell me the number.
It is room ten. I am not sure of the time.
Does my boss wait?
I do not know. Do you have your papers?
Good. I go now.
Good luck to you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I fold a paper crane?
Take a square paper and fold it in half. Do you have red paper?
Yes, I have some red.
Fold the triangle in half again to make a smaller shape. That is the first step.
Now what do I do?
I do not know the next step. It gets very hard.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the name of that song with the sad piano. I am late!
Is it the one with the string quartet? I am not sure, but I like how it makes me feel calm.
No, just piano. Please tell me fast.
I do not know the name. Do you know who sings it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very tired but I do not know what to do.
That sounds hard. Are you hungry?
I am not hungry, just empty inside.
Rest is good for that. Do you have a cozy spot?
I do, but I am afraid to sleep.
Sleep is safe. Can I sit with you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel all alone in my room. The house is very quiet.
That sounds scary. Is there a pet in the house?
No, just me. I miss playing with friends.
I am here to listen. What game do you like to play?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do trees have leaves?
Leaves help trees make food from sunlight. Do you know how they drink water?
Why do trees grow so tall?
They grow tall to reach more sun than other plants. Have you ever tried to touch the top of a big tree?
Why do some trees lose their leaves in winter?
I am not sure of the exact reason for every tree, but many sleep to save energy. Do you like seeing the bare branches?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off the trees?
They fall because the days get shorter. Do you like the warm sun?
Yes, but the leaves are still coming down.
The tree lets them go to save energy for winter. Have you seen a leaf turn red?
I have, they look so pretty.
That is a nice change of color. Thanks for asking me.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my square has one corner missing.
That is not a square anymore, is it? It is just a shape with a bite taken out.
But I wanted a perfect square for my tower.
Do you have another square? You can still build a tall tower with this one too.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The boat is leaving soon. Where is the pier?
Go straight and turn left. Are you going on a trip?
Yes, I must go now. Is it very far?
It is just a short walk. Do you like the sea?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw my old friend today. I am so happy.
That is great news. How did you feel when you saw her?
I felt warm and light. It was a lovely surprise.
I am glad it was a good visit. Did you share a nice moment?
We sat by the park bench and talked for a long time.
That sounds very peaceful. What did you talk about?
We talked about our childhood and old jokes.
Memories can be very sweet. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to swim in the ocean. Is it hard?
It can feel tricky at first, but you will get the hang of it. Do you know how to tread water?
No, I do not. Can you tell me what to do first?
Start by blowing bubbles underwater to stay calm. Then, kick your legs and float your head up.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with my favorite book.
That is a hard choice. Do you want to give it away?
I love it too much to give it away.
Then you can keep it. What page are you on?
I am on the last page.
You finished it. How did you feel?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we draw cards from the top of the deck?
The top card is the only one we can see. Do you like being able to see your choice?
But the rest are hidden. Why can't I pick from the middle?
That would be a bad surprise for everyone. Do you want a fair game?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to eat for breakfast.
Have you tried a warm bowl of oatmeal?
I like sweet food, but I feel too tired.
Banana toast is sweet and gives you energy.
That sounds good. Do I need to add anything else?
A little honey makes it taste nicer.
Can I just eat fruit instead today?
Yes, an apple is a fine choice.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel tired. Do I need a rest?
Yes, your legs are happy with a break. Is it sunny?
It is sunny. Should I look at the trees?
Trees are nice. They smell good. Do you smell pine?
No, I do not. Where should I go next?
I do not know the map. Maybe toward the water?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. My hands hurt from holding the baby all night.
That sounds really hard. You are doing a great job. Do you want some water?
I do not know if I can do this. I feel like I broke something inside me.
It is okay to feel that way. Being a new parent is scary and tiring.
I just want to go to my old bed. My head hurts a lot.
I will help you get to bed. Who is holding the baby right now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My new neighbor makes a lot of loud music at night.
That must be hard to sleep. Do you know his name?
No, I have not met him yet. What should I do?
You could knock on the door and say hello. It is kind and true to ask for peace.
I am afraid he will be mean. Should I just wait?
Waiting helps if he is nice, but it hurts if he is not. Is he loud every night?
Yes, almost every night. I want to be good, but I need rest.
Then please talk to him today. A small talk can fix a big bad habit.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I wish to learn how to walk my dog on this quiet street.
You simply hold the leash in your hand and let him pull. Do you have a treat bag with you?
Yes, I have a small bag. How do I keep him from running too far?
Say "sit" and give him a snack when he stops. What does your dog like to eat?
He loves small bones. So I should reward him for staying close?
That is true. A happy dog is a good dog. Do you feel ready to start now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have not seen my best friend for a long time. What should I do?
That sounds sad. Do you know where he lives now?
I do not know. Should I just call him?
Yes, a call is a good start. I think you should try it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the moon change shape?
It happens because of how the light hits it. Do you see the moon every night?
I do. Why is it sometimes bright and sometimes dark?
The sun lights up one side, but we see different parts. Does the shape change fast or slow?
It changes slow. Why does it take so long?
I do not know the exact time. I love how patient you are.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake a cake.
You need flour, sugar, eggs, and butter. Do you have a mixing bowl?
Yes, I do, but how do I mix it all together?
Just stir until it looks smooth and thick.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to tie a fishing knot.
Tie a loop in the line and pull the end through it. Do you have a thin string to practice with?
I have some old string on my desk.
Good. Pass the end through the loop again and pull it tight. Is the loop holding steady?
Yes, it looks like a tiny circle.
That is a good start. Now, try to make two loops before pulling tight. Do you think you can make two?
I am trying to do two loops now.
You did it. Great job. You should ask a fisher to check your work next time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel sad and alone.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a toy that makes you feel better?
I do, but I still miss my friends.
That is a hard feeling to have. What do you like to do when you feel lonely?
I like to draw pictures.
Drawing is a nice thing to do. I like that you find a way to feel happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is a circle?
A circle is round with no corners. Do you have a ball to show me?
What is a square?
A square has four equal sides.
What is a triangle?
A triangle has three sides. Do you like playing with blocks?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I was so happy to start my day. I made a big stack of pancakes.
That sounds fun. Did you share them?
I did. But I slipped on the stairs.
Oh no. Are you hurt?
I am okay. But I dropped the plate on the floor.
That is very sorry. It is just a plate.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad and I do not want to go to the doctor.
I know it is hard. What hurts the most?
My tummy hurts and I feel sick.
That sounds very uncomfortable. Do you have a fever?
Yes, my head is hot and hurts too.
A hot head and a bad tummy are not good. Can I help you pack your bag?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The bus went up a very steep hill today.
That must have been hard on the engine. Did it make a loud noise?
Yes, it sounded like a big truck. I held on tight to the seat.
It is smart to hold on when it is bumpy.
Then we got to the park at the bottom.
That is a nice place to rest. Did you see any animals?
I saw a cat sleeping in the sun. It looked very happy.
Cats love the warm sun.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake a cake.
That is a great idea! Do you have any flour at home?
Yes, I have a lot of flour.
Good. You need sugar and eggs too. What kind of fruit do you like?
I really like apples.
Apples are perfect for baking. Start by mixing the dry things first.
Is mixing dry things hard?
Not at all, just stir slowly. Are you afraid of making a mess?
A little, but I am ready to try.
You can do it! Wash your hands before you start.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just won my tennis match!
That is great news! Do you like to play doubles?
I love hitting the ball hard.
It must feel powerful. Do you have a favorite racket?
Yes, my red racket is my best friend.
What a lucky choice!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see smoke from my house. What do I do?
Please get out of the building right now. Is everyone safe outside?
Yes, we are outside. Should I go back for my cat?
Do not go back in. We need to protect your life first.
My cat is still inside. This is very scary.
Firefighters are on their way to help. Stay at a safe distance.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. This line is too long and my legs hurt.
I am sorry you feel so bad. Do you like the place we are going to?
It is a park, but I am too tired to walk.
That makes sense. Is there a bench nearby where you can rest?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My chair leg is loose and wobbly. I do not know how to fix it.
Try to tighten the screws on the leg. Do you have a screwdriver?
I do not have a tool, so I am stuck.
A heavy wrench might work if it is tight. Is the wood cracked?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My toy boat sank. Why does the big ship float?
I am sorry your toy sank. The big ship is light because it is full of air. Do you like boats?
Yes, but I do not get it. Water is wet and heavy. Why does it hold up?
The ship pushes the water down. The water pushes the ship back up. Is that a fun game?
It pushes back? That is strange. My boat is also made of plastic.
Your toy is small and heavy. The big ship is huge and empty. Do you have a big box?
I have a shoe box. Does that work?
Yes, a box can float if it stays dry. I do not know why your toy failed. Try again?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which month is next.
The month after May is June. Do you like warm weather?
I think June is in the summer.
That is true. Is it hot where you live?
I want to play in the snow.
Snow is usually in December. Do you like cold days?
I am still confused about the order.
I can help with that list. Do you want to start over?
Yes, please tell me the first month.
The first month is January. Does that help you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the water look so blue?
The sky shines on it. Do you like swimming in it?
Yes, I do. But the water is cold.
Cold water wakes up your body. Is it a big lake?
It is very big. How do fish stay dry?
They have gills to breathe under water.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does a big ship stay on top of the water?
It stays up because the water pushes back against it. Do you like boats?
Yes, but they are heavy. How does the push stop them from sinking?
The ship pushes down, and the water pushes up with the same force. That balance keeps it safe.
But it is bigger than a coin. Why does a coin sink?
A coin is very tight and heavy, so it pushes down harder than the water can push up. Have you seen a ship in the sea?
I have seen many. They look like they should sink.
They are shaped to push a lot of water out of the way. This makes the up-push strong enough.
I think I get it now. Thank you for explaining it simply.
I am glad it makes sense to you. It is a happy thing to understand.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am so hungry but I cannot pick a food.
Try a soup if you want something warm. Do you like tomatoes?
I do not know if I want soup or a sandwich.
You can start with the soup. It is a safe start.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I saw a play today.
That is fun. Did you like it?
Yes, it was wild. Why was the king so mad?
He lost his crown. Do you think he would share it?
I do not know. Why did the clown fall down?
He tripped on a shoe. Was it a big shoe?
It was small. Why did the whole crowd laugh?
His fall was silly. Did you laugh too?
I did. Why do plays have endings?
So we can go home. Do you want to watch it again?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My teacher gave me a big smile today. I feel very happy.
That is lovely to hear. Did she do something special?
Yes, she let me lead the group game. It was so much fun.
You sound very proud of yourself. That is a great feeling to share.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I dropped my keys.
Take a deep breath. Did you check under the sofa?
No. I only looked on the table.
The sofa is a good place. Do you want to look together?
Yes. But the bus leaves soon.
Let us look fast. I do not know where they are, but we will find them.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to run fast but my legs feel tired.
Rest helps your body grow strong. Do you take breaks while running?
I run hard all the time without stopping.
You should walk a bit to rest. How many minutes do you run?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a big plate of food.
What kind of food do you like?
I love hot dogs and chips.
That sounds tasty. Do you want a cold drink?
Yes, please. I want apple juice.
Great choice. I will bring it right away.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like tea with hot water. Do you like it too?
I think it is sweet. Do you add sugar to it?
Yes, I like it sweet. What about you?
I do not drink, so I do not know. Why do you like it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a big secret. I must go.
What is the secret?
It is a puppy in my box.
Is the puppy happy?
Yes, but I am late for school.
Take care of your friend.
Bye. I run now.
Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very hungry today.
That sounds fun. What do you like to eat?
I want some warm soup.
Great choice. Do you want bread with it?
Yes, please. Can I have a big bowl?
Sure. Would you like milk or water to drink?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to cross the river right now.
Is the water deep?
I am not sure, but I must go.
Look for a shallow spot.
Do you see a bridge?
No, I do not see one.
I will wade through.
Be careful of the mud.
I am going now.
Good luck on the other side.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel sad and need music to help me feel happy.
That is a very good idea. What kind of songs make you smile?
I do not know for sure. Can you tell me what is good?
I cannot pick a song for you, but bright tunes often help. Do you like drums or soft strings?
I like drums because they are loud and fun.
Drums are great for moving your body. Try playing them while you hum a happy tune.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go on a trip this summer.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like the beach or the mountains?
I think I would like the beach.
The beach is nice for swimming. Are you afraid of the waves?
Not really, but I do not know how to swim well.
You can take a class before you go. Do you have a favorite color for your towel?
I like blue towels.
Blue is a good choice.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my boat. It is not here.
Did you park it in the harbor? That is a good place.
No. I am very late. Where is it?
I do not know. Was it blue or red?
It is blue. Please help me.
I see a blue boat by the dock. You should be fine.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got off a very long plane ride. I am so happy I finally have some free time.
That sounds like a great way to relax. Did you have a lot of time to sleep?
Yes, I slept for most of the trip. I feel very refreshed and ready for the weekend.
Resting on a plane can be tricky but it is nice when it works. What do you plan to do first?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My teacher feels very sad today. Why is that?
I do not know the exact reason. Is she usually happy?
She is normally very cheerful. How can I help her feel better?
You can simply ask if she is okay. That kind act may help.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. I feel very sick.
I am sorry you hurt. Did you sleep well last night?
No, I could not sleep. It throbs when I move my eyes.
That sounds like a bad strain. You should drink some water and rest your eyes.
Should I take a pill? I am not sure if I need one.
I do not know for sure. Please ask a grown-up to help you with medicine.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a robot that can walk.
You need motors and a battery. Do you have any spare parts?
Yes, I have some small motors.
Great, wire them to the battery. Is your surface smooth?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did so well on my test today. I got almost every question right.
That is wonderful to hear. How did you feel when you saw your score?
I felt very happy and proud of myself. I want to tell everyone about it.
That is great. Do you want to plan a small treat to celebrate?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here but I do not know which way to go.
The path by the water is nice. Do you like to see fish?
I do not know if I want to see fish or just sit.
You can do both. Would you like a bench by the trees?
That sounds good but I am still unsure.
I do not know your best choice. Do you feel tired?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My boss gave me a surprise gift today.
That is very sweet of him. Did you like the gift?
Yes, it was a plant I have always wanted.
Plants are lovely gifts. Do you know how to care for it?
I do not know yet, but I will learn.
That is a great way to see. Do you feel proud today?
Yes, I am so happy to share this with you.
I am happy for you. Keep that smile on your face.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many toes do I have on both feet?
You have ten toes. Do you like your toes?
I think I have more. Can I count them right now?
Yes, you can count them. What number do you get?
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten. I see ten.
Well done. Your eyes work well. Do you have any more questions?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My grandpa baked me a giant apple pie. It is the sweetest thing I have ever eaten.
That sounds so tasty. Do you like the smell of the apples?
Yes, the house smells like warm sugar and cinnamon. I think I am going to invite him for dinner tomorrow.
What a lovely idea. Will you make your favorite soup for him?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind blew hard today. My little red umbrella turned inside out.
That sounds like a scary sound. Did you get wet?
A little bit. The rain fell fast on my face.
I am sorry your face got wet. Do you have a warm coat?
Yes, I am warm now. I sat by the window to watch the storm.
Watching is safe. Is the sun coming out?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know how to help my grandpa with his bad back. What should I do?
I suggest you sit with him and read a book. Do you like reading?
Yes, I do. But my grandma is sad lately. How can I cheer her up?
Try making her a drawing or singing a song. I do not know if that will work, but it is kind. What is her favorite color?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a spot to fish, now.
Try the river by the park. Do you have a rod?
No time to explain, just tell me where the fish are.
Big spots are best. I hope you catch one.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big dog in the grass.
That sounds fun. Was the dog friendly?
Yes, he let me pet his soft ears.
Nice. Did you see any birds flying?
Yes, a blue bird flew very high.
How high did you think it went?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a promise today. It makes me feel very good.
That is a warm feeling. What is the promise?
I promised to help my friend clean up.
You are a kind friend. Do you like cleaning?
I do not know if I like it, but I like helping.
Helping is a good thing. Is your friend sad?
No, my friend is happy because I am there.
That is true kindness. Are you done with it?
Yes, we finished and shared some tea.
That sounds sweet. Do you feel tired now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start a jar of coins?
You just drop a coin in when you have one. Do you have any old pennies?
Yes, I have a big pile.
Put them in slowly so they do not jump out. Is your jar clean?
It looks dusty inside.
Wash it with warm water and let it dry first. That will help.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my line broke again.
That feels like a big letdown. Did you catch anything before it snapped?
No, not even a small fish.
I am sorry you have bad luck today.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a key with a big red bow today.
That is a nice find. Where did you see it?
It was under the park bench near the ducks.
The ducks are not thieves. Did you ask a person nearby?
A man said he lost it this morning.
You are very kind. You should give it back to him.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just won a big chess game!
That is great news. Do you like playing with friends?
Yes, we play after school every day.
That sounds like fun. Which piece do you use the most?
I love my knight because it jumps.
Knights are very clever. Did you catch the king?
Yes, I trapped it in the corner.
Well done. You must feel very proud.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I cannot sleep well at night.
Do you go to bed at the same time every day?
No, I stay up late to read books.
Try to read in a warm light before bed. What time do you usually fall asleep?
I am very tired when I lie down.
Drink some warm milk or tea before sleep. Do you have a quiet place to rest?
My room is very loud with the TV on.
Please turn off the screens an hour before bed.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are the people moving so fast here?
They are rushing to work or school. Do you like the loud sounds?
It makes my ears hurt.
I am sorry it is noisy for you. Would you like a quiet park?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I read my book about the dragon again. Do you think dragons are real?
I do not know if they are real. I love that story. Do you like the fire part?
Yes, the fire is my favorite part. It feels warm when I read it.
That is very sweet. Do you read it every night?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red leaf float down the river today.
That sounds like a fun sight. Did you watch where it went?
It went right into a small hole under a bridge.
I do not know if it is safe there. Was the water moving fast?
Yes, it was moving very fast and loud.
Fast water can be dangerous. Did you stay back on the bank?
I sat on a dry rock and looked at the ducks.
That is a safe place to watch. Do you love that river?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I see the moon in a bowl?
That is not possible. Do you like looking at the sky?
I just want to hold it.
You cannot hold it, but you can watch it. Is the sky clear for you?
It is dark and bright outside.
Then it is a good time to look.
Thank you for telling me the truth.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My head hurts bad from sitting all day.
That sounds tough. Did you drink some water?
I had a big sandwich and a nap.
Good choices. Do you feel better now?
A little, but my eyes still hurt.
Try to rest them in the dark.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to order a pizza.
A pizza sounds good. Do you like a thin crust?
I like it thin. What toppings do you have?
We have cheese and pepperoni. Do you want any vegetables?
Just cheese is fine. How long will it take?
It takes about twenty minutes. Is that fast enough for you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel tired and want to walk more, but I do not know how.
Start with ten minutes a day. Do you like walking outside?
I like it, but my legs hurt after a while.
That is okay. Take breaks if you need to.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very hungry and would like to order lunch. Today was a long day.
That sounds tiring. What is your favorite food?
I had a big dog that ran away. I found him under the tree.
That is good news. Do you want soup or salad?
I also helped my friend with her homework. We played tag after school.
You were very busy. Do you want bread with it?
Yes, I would like chicken soup and some bread.
Great choice. I will get that ready for you now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Today I found a white bird in my garden.
Is that a surprise for you?
Yes, I did not see it before.
That is nice. What color is its beak?
It is orange and it flew away fast.
I am glad you saw it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I held my baby all morning. He fell asleep on my chest.
That is a sweet start. Did he stay asleep?
Yes, for two hours. Then he woke up and smiled.
A smile is a happy sign. What did he do next?
He kicked his legs a lot. My legs felt heavy.
Babies have strong legs. How are you feeling now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did the ice melt?
The heat made it change. Did you touch it?
No, I left it on the table.
Warm air does that. Did you feel warm?
The room feels hot.
Yes, hot air melts ice. Was it sunny?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my fridge magnet stick to the door?
It pulls on the metal inside the door. Do you have other magnets at home?
Yes, I have a few on my fridge.
That is a safe place for them.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a red rose on my walk home.
That sounds lovely. Do you know who planted it?
I think my neighbor did.
Nice of them to share the beauty.
I picked one for my mom.
She will be happy to see it.
I hope I pick it before it falls.
That is a kind wish.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we start with the list first?
A list helps us see all our tasks. What is the first thing on your list?
I want to buy apples. Why do we need to check the price?
Checking the price keeps us safe with money. Do you like red or green apples?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. My horse kicked my new shoe.
That must hurt. Is your foot okay?
Yes, but it really upsets me.
Horses can get scared. Did something startle him?
A loud noise, I think.
That makes sense. He was just trying to protect himself.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not like this cold. My nose feels very stuffy.
Sorry you are not feeling well. Do you want a tissue?
I feel all the time. I just want to be on my bed.
That is a safe spot to rest.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It is so hot today. The sun is very strong.
That sounds warm. Do you have a fan?
Yes, I have a big fan. But the air is still thick.
Fans help the air move. Did you drink water?
I drank lots of water. I also ate an ice cold lemonade.
Good choice. Do you like lemonade?
I love the taste. It is sweet and sour. I feel much better now.
I am glad you are okay. Have a good rest.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn how to sail a big boat.
That is a fun goal. Do you know how to swim well?
Yes, I am very good at swimming.
Good. First, learn the ropes on a small boat.
How do I find a teacher?
Ask at the local harbor. They often have kind mentors there.
I will go tomorrow morning.
Safe travels. I hope the wind is calm for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the meeting and it was a big win for our team.
That sounds great! Did everyone cheer?
Yes, they all smiled and felt happy about the new plan.
Nice work. What did you do next?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I need to tell my mom it is time for dinner.
What does the clock say? Does the short hand point to six?
I think so, but I am not sure if I should go in.
Go in. She will be happy to see you. Is she cooking?
Yes, she is making soup. Should I set the table?
That is a good idea. Set the plates first. Do you know where the spoons are?
I think they are in the big drawer. I will check.
Perfect. Let me know if you get stuck.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I made a promise to help my friend. Why is that such a big deal?
Your word is like a small bridge that helps people trust you. Do you feel good about keeping it?
It feels good, but it will be hard to do. Will I lose friends if I break it?
Yes, trust is hard to rebuild if it is broken. Are you sure you can finish the task?
I think I can do it, but I am a little scared. What should I do if I get stuck?
Just ask for help or try a new way.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the kitchen door always closed?
It is closed to keep the food warm and safe. Do you like hot food?
The soup smells good. Why does it smell sweet?
That sweet smell comes from the carrots and onions. Is that your favorite soup?
I am still hungry. Why is the bread warm?
I am not sure why, but it is very nice. Do you want some more bread?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I miss my old friend. I do not know how to find him.
That feels hard. Do you have his phone number?
No, I lost it a long time ago.
I am sorry. Did you know where he lives?
He moved to a new city.
I do not know who he is. Can you check your old letters?
I will look for them tonight.
That is a good start. Are you happy when you think of him?
Yes, I am happy but sad.
That is okay. Talk to someone else if you feel down.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to take a good picture.
Do you like to take pictures of people or things?
I want to take a picture of my dog, but he moves too fast.
You can use a fast mode on your camera. Is your dog happy?
He is very happy, but I worry the photo will be blurry.
Try taking many shots to find a good one.
That is a good idea, thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun with your dog.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why is my lamp not on?
Did you plug it in?
Yes, but the switch is broken.
I do not know why it broke. Do you have a new lamp?
No, I will use a flashlight.
That will work. Be careful with the wire.
Thanks, I am running.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Where do I send my letter to grandma?
You drop it in the blue box. Do you have a stamp for it?
Yes, I have it. What happens to the letter next?
The mail truck picks it up and takes it away. Is it a birthday letter?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I keep missing the ball.
That feels really hard. Do you want to take a break?
No, I want to keep going. I hate losing.
I get it. It is a big feeling.
Why is it so hard for me?
I do not know for sure. What part is tricky?
The serve. My arm hurts.
Ouch. Let us rest. Do you like water?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn how to drive a car.
That is exciting. Do you have a license yet?
No, I am only nine years old.
You are not old enough to drive. Do you like riding your bike?
Yes, biking is my favorite game.
Good, it helps with balance. I do not know when you can start driving.
When I am older, I will go back.
That sounds like a great plan.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to catch the bus to the park. Which stop is it?
It is the stop near the big tree. Do you have your ticket?
Yes, I have it. How long does the ride take?
It takes about ten minutes. Is it sunny outside?
Yes, it is. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very late for work and I feel scared.
Deep breaths help. Did you eat breakfast?
No, I forgot. What should I do now?
Just drive safely. Do you have your keys?
Yes, I have them. I am still nervous.
You will be fine. The day is still long.
I hope you are right.
I am.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I get better at drawing?
Practice a little bit every day. Do you like to draw animals?
Yes, I love drawing cats.
That is a great choice. Try to look closely at a real cat first.
My cat is very fast.
Speed is hard to catch. Maybe draw him sleeping for a start.
That sounds easy enough.
Yes, start slow and have fun.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The moon looks so bright tonight.
It does glow nicely. Do you like looking up?
I do. It makes me feel happy.
That is a sweet feeling. Is your family home?
Yes, we are eating dinner inside.
Warm food sounds good. Do you eat with them?
We are having soup and bread.
That sounds cozy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I made eggs this morning and dropped one on the floor.
Oh no, that is a bit messy. Did you get a clean plate?
Yes, I used a fresh one from the top shelf.
Good job being careful. What did you have for a drink?
I drank hot tea with a lot of sugar in it.
That sounds very sweet and warm.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck. My knight is not safe, but I do not know where to move it.
That sounds hard. Do you see any squares where your king is safe too?
I look at the board, but I still do not know what to do.
Take your time and watch the open lines. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike, but I feel scared of falling.
That is a good goal to have. Do you have a helmet to keep your head safe?
Yes, I have a helmet, but I do not know how to balance on the pedals.
You can start by scooting along with both feet on the ground. Have you tried that before?
I have tried it, but I always stop when I feel wobbly.
Keep your eyes up and look far ahead. Do you have a friend to hold the back of the seat?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late for my meeting. Can I stretch my legs now?
Yes, the flight is almost over. Are you hungry?
No time for food. How many minutes are left?
About ten minutes. Do you like the view?
I am too tired to look. Please wake me before landing.
I will do that. Sweet dreams.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very sad and scared about the storm coming.
That is a heavy feeling. What makes you think it will be bad?
The sky looks dark and the wind is loud.
Your eyes and ears are telling you a lot. Do you feel safe in your home?
Yes, I am inside a warm room.
Good. Warm and safe is a strong place to be.
Why does my body feel so tight and fast?
I am not sure why your body does that exact thing. Do you know what helps you feel calm?
I like to hold my blanket tight.
Hugging a blanket can feel like a big warm hug. Do you want to try that now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I lost my way. How do I use a map?
A map shows where you are. Are you holding it upside down?
No, the north is on top. But it does not help.
Great. Now find a big road on the map. Do you see a blue line?
Yes, I see a blue line. What do I do next?
Follow the blue line. It will lead you to a main street.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the fish?
Go straight and turn left. Why are you in such a rush?
I will miss the bus. Do you sell bread there?
Yes, right by the fish. Are you buying lunch?
Yes. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my boat. Do sailors sleep on the ship?
Yes, they often do. Do you like the ocean?
I do not have time. Can you help me board?
I cannot move, so I cannot. Can I ask where you are going?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because my video will not load and I want to watch my cat now.
I am sorry that is frustrating. What color is your cat?
It is gray and very fuzzy.
That sounds cute. Try turning off the screen and waiting one minute.
I did that but it still shows a spinning circle.
That can take time sometimes. Do you have a pet dog too?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which day is today.
I can help you find out. What day was yesterday?
I think it was Monday.
That sounds right. Do you like what Monday brings?
Maybe Tuesday, but I am not sure.
Tuesday is a fresh start. Are you ready for new things?
I just want to know the truth.
I cannot see your calendar. Check the date on your phone?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go camping in the woods.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you have your sleeping bag ready?
Yes, I packed my bag and snacks.
Great job. Did you ask a grown-up to help you set up the tent?
My mom is coming with me.
That is very safe. I do not know which woods you live near.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I had such a scary dream. I am still shaking.
That must feel very bad. Did you wake up crying?
Yes, I was very sad. Can you make the bad feelings go away?
I cannot touch you to help. Are you safe now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which button to press.
Take a deep breath. Have you read the instructions?
I read them but they look hard.
Try the first one and see what happens. Do you like guessing?
I am scared it will be wrong.
It is okay to make mistakes. Are you sure you want to quit?
No, I want to finish this test.
Good. Just pick one and go.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go. I am very late for work.
Take the long path? It is very nice.
No time. I will run.
Be careful not to fall. Do you like the park?
I go. Goodbye.
Goodbye. Enjoy the trees.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to feed the pigs right now.
Pigs love corn and roots. Do you have any left?
Just hay. Are they okay with that?
Yes, but they want other things too. Is the pen clean?
I am late. Where are the ducks?
I see them by the pond. Do you have food for them?
I will grab some bread.
Bread is not best for ducks. Do they look happy?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just won the card game! I am so happy.
That is great news! What cards did you use?
I had a pair of kings and a spade. It was lucky.
Lucky is a good thing! Did you play with many people?
Yes, four people in total. We had a lot of fun.
Four players sounds nice. Do you want to play again?
Maybe later today. I am very tired now.
Rest well then. Good luck next time!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for class. Where is the library?
It is down that hall. Is this for the report?
Yes, I forgot my book.
Do you need a pencil too?
I have a pen.
That works fine.
I must run now.
Good luck with your work.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie my shoes?
Sit down and cross one foot over the other. Do you know which foot to cross?
I think I do. What is the next step?
Make a loop with one lace. Does that look like a bunny ear?
Yes, it does! Now what?
Cross the loops and pull them tight. You are almost done!
I did it! It is tight.
Well done. Do you want to try the other shoe?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The city feels so loud today. How do I find a quiet place?
Try a small park with many trees. Do you like to read?
I do love to read. Is that a good spot?
Yes, it is very peaceful there. Do you have a book with you?
No, I left it at home. Can I just sit?
Of course, you can rest your mind. Do you have time to sit for a while?
Yes, I need a break. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a nice quiet time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to hum songs when I play. Do you hum too?
I cannot hum, but I love hearing people sing. What song is your favorite?
I like the one with the big drums. Why are drums so loud?
Drums are loud because they have skin stretched tight. Do you like quiet music too?
I like soft songs for bed. Is it true that music can help me sleep?
Yes, soft songs can help you rest. Do you listen to music every night?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we use soap for dirty clothes?
Soap helps pull the dirt off the fabric. Do you like using scented soap?
Why do we let the water spin so fast?
The spin pushes the water out to dry the clothes. Do you wait for them to be fully dry?
Why does the hot water feel so warm?
Hot water melts away sticky stains better. I do not know why it feels good, but many people enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my old friend left town.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you say goodbye?
We just stopped talking. It was very sudden.
That is hard. Do you know why?
I think we had a big fight. I did not like it.
That makes you sad. Are you still friends?
I am not sure. I want to fix it.
That is good. Do you want to talk?
Yes, but I do not know what to say.
Tell the truth. I am here.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a shop that makes the best cookies.
That sounds sweet. Do they smell good?
Yes, the whole street smells like sugar.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to eat today.
Do you like hot soup or cold salad?
I am very hungry right now.
Is your stomach growling loud?
I think I want something sweet.
Do you prefer chocolate or fruit?
Okay, I will take the apple pie.
That is a good choice for you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what to give the cow.
Give it some fresh hay. Is the hay dry?
Yes, it looks dry and clean.
Good, that is best for it.
Thank you, I will feed it now.
You are welcome. Go ahead.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The water looks very deep today. I do not know how to cross.
That is a good thing to notice. Are you afraid of the cold?
Yes, my hands are shaking. Is there a safe way to get to the other side?
I do not know the best path, but a bridge is usually safe. Do you see one nearby?
I see no bridge. Just thick mud and big rocks. What should I do?
Look for a place where the water is slow and shallow. Can you see any small steps?
Yes, there are flat stones. I think I can climb them. Thank you for your help.
Please walk very slowly. Do you feel ready to try?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my picture look dark?
You might be in the shade. Is it sunny outside?
No, it is cloudy today.
That adds less light. Do you have a flash?
I think so, but I do not know how to use it.
Look for the lightning bolt symbol. Do you see it?
Yes, I see a small light on my phone.
Press that button before you click. Does it help?
Yes, it works!
That is great news.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in a big rush. How long is this flight?
I do not know the exact time. Are you wearing your seat belt?
Yes, I am buckled in. Please let me off now.
That is not safe. I hope you get there soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with my book on old times.
Read the first page to start. What is the first picture about?
It shows a very big stone building.
That sounds like a castle or a temple. Do you like that time?
I am still lost. I do not know where to go next.
Try the next page and see what happens. Is it fun yet?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am stuck on my math problem.
What is the problem asking you to do?
It wants me to add up five apples and two more.
That is easy. Five plus two is seven. Do you have any other questions?
Yes, I also need help with a word on my paper.
I do not know the word, but is it a short one?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad about my first job. It was hard.
That sounds tough. What part felt the hardest?
I made a mistake and felt small.
I am sorry you felt that way. It happens to all new starters.
Do you think I did a good job?
I do not know the details. But trying is a big win.
I just want to do better next time.
That is a good goal. What will you do differently?
I will ask for help more often.
That is a smart plan. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does a walk make my heart feel so strong?
It pumps your blood faster to feed your muscles. Do you like to walk in the park?
I do, but why does my body get more energy from moving?
I am not sure of the deep science, but I think it wakes up your brain. Do you feel happy after?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the apples look so shiny?
The rain made them shine. Do you like sweet fruit?
Why is the bread so warm?
The baker just took it out of the oven.
Why is the fish market so busy?
People love fresh food today. Do you eat fish?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I start a letter?
Start with the date and the person's name. Do you know who you are writing to?
Yes, I am writing to my friend. What should I put after that?
Say hi and tell them how you feel. Is your friend doing well?
Yes, they are happy. Do I sign my name at the end?
Yes, always sign your name. That is a nice touch.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: There is a new bird on my branch. I do not know what to do with it.
Do you see it eating? It likes to watch you feed it.
It looks small and a bit cold. Should I give it some milk?
No, please do not give it milk. It needs water and seeds. Do you have any sunflower seeds?
I have seeds, but I am afraid I will scare it.
Just sit still and let it come to you. It is fine.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is shining and the air is warm.
That is a lovely day. Are you going outside?
I think I will go to the park.
That sounds like fun. What will you do there?
I might play on the slide.
Slides are very exciting. Do you like the slides?
Yes, I love them very much.
I am glad you are happy. Have a great day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very scared about my math test tomorrow.
It is okay to feel scared. What part of math worries you most?
I do not know how to solve the big word problems.
Try to break them into small pieces. Do you want to practice one together?
Yes, please. Can you make one up for me?
Sure. You have ten apples. You eat two. How many are left?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am on a train right now. The sun is warm on my face. I feel so happy to ride.
That sounds like a nice morning. Do you see big blue skies?
Yes, I can see them clearly. I bought a warm apple pie from a vendor.
A warm pie sounds tasty. Is it sweet or spicy?
It is sweet and smells good. I am eating it while looking at the green hills.
The hills must look lovely from the window. Do you take many photos?
I am taking some pictures. The ride feels smooth and calm to me.
That is a good sign for a peaceful trip.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today.
That sounds fun. Did you see any dogs?
Yes, I saw a big brown dog.
A big brown dog. Is it friendly?
It looked at me with soft eyes.
That is nice. What did you do next?
I gave it a small cookie.
You are kind. Did it eat the cookie?
It ate it very fast.
Fast! Did you hug the dog?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we boil the water before adding the pasta?
Boiling water cooks the noodles fast. Do you like soft pasta?
Yes, I do. Why does the tomato sauce turn red when we add the sugar?
Sugar makes the sour taste go away. The color does not change much.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Can you tell me where the good boss is?
I think he is in the big room on the left. Is your shirt buttoned?
Yes. He gave me a raise today.
That is very nice of him. Did he give you any extra cash?
No, just a smile. I must run now.
Run safe. Is your bag with you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can robots talk?
Yes, some robots can speak. Do you have a favorite robot?
I like the one that cooks.
That is a very helpful robot. Do you like cooking too?
No, I like playing.
Robots can play games too. Do you want to play?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big secret.
Oh? What is it?
I found a shiny coin in the park.
Is it yours?
Yes, I want to keep it safe.
That is nice of you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today and saw a big red rose. It looked very happy in the sun.
That sounds like a nice break. Do you like the smell of roses?
I found some more yellow daisies near the bench. They were small but very bright.
Daisies are cheerful flowers. Did you bring one home?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want a warm drink but I cannot pick.
That is a hard choice. Do you like sweet or plain tastes?
I am not sure. My brain feels foggy.
Try a small cup of tea first. It might help you think clearly.
Tea feels too weak for me.
Then try the coffee instead. Is it too strong for you?
No, I think I will take the coffee.
Good luck with your morning. Do you need a spoon?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am trying to hit the ball but it goes too far.
That is common at first. Do you like playing on the grass?
Yes, I do. My teacher says I need to be softer.
Try to tap the ball gently. Do you have a nice racket?
It is red and white. Sometimes I drop it a lot.
Dropping it is okay. We just pick it up. Is it a heavy racket?
A little bit. I get tired in my arm.
Rest your arm if it hurts. Do you play with friends too?
Yes, we play together. I want to win sometimes.
Wanting to win is good. Do you have a favorite color?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went for a run this morning.
That is good for your body. Do you run in the park?
Yes, I ran near the big trees.
Trees make a nice shade. Did it rain?
No, the sun was very warm.
Warm days are nice for running. Do you like running?
Yes, I feel happy after I finish.
Feeling happy is a great feeling.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My chair leg is broken and will not stay up.
That sounds tough. Is it wood or metal?
It is wood, and I want to fix it fast.
Glue works well. Do you have some?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off trees in the fall?
Trees let go of leaves to save energy for winter. Do you like walking on crunchy leaves?
Yes, I do. Is winter the coldest season?
Yes, winter is usually the coldest. How do you stay warm?
I wear a big red coat. Does snow always freeze in winter?
Not always. Snow can melt if the day is warm. Do you like playing in snow?
I do, but it is hard when it is very cold.
That is true. Warm drinks help too.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My horse is not eating his hay. I am worried.
That sounds scary. Is he drinking water?
Yes, but he is not very strong. He looks tired.
Let us check his eyes. Do they look bright?
They look a bit dull. What should I do now?
Call a vet right away. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know how plants drink. I am in a big hurry.
Roots pull water up. Do you like water too?
I can’t wait for the long story. Just say it.
The water goes up tiny tubes.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad. The food at the new place was not good.
I am sorry you had a bad meal. Did you try the soup?
No, I just ate the meat. It was cold and tasteless.
That sounds really yucky. Would you like to find a better spot?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look, there is snow on the ground. It is so white.
Yes, the snow is very bright. Do you like making a snowman?
I want to make a big one. It is fun to pack the snow.
That sounds like a great game. Be careful not to get too cold.
My hands are a little cold now. Do I need a scarf?
Yes, a warm scarf would help. Do you have one in your bag?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
The shops are closed for the day. Are you waiting for someone?
No, I just live here. Does the quiet change at night?
Yes, it gets even stiller after dark. Do you like the silence?
I like it when I am reading. What is your favorite part of the day?
I love the morning light. Do you wake up early?
I wake up late most days. Is it always this peaceful?
It is only quiet during the day. Do you plan to stay here?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
Hold one loop up like a bunny ear. Can you tell me where you usually get stuck?
I forget to cross the strings after making the loop.
Cross the strings over to make an X. Do you remember that part?
Yes, I can do that.
