Now pull the loops tight to finish.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look! A little blue bird is eating the sunflower seeds.
Yes, it is a blue jay. Do you like its bright colors?
I want to give it more food. Can I touch its beak?
Please do not touch its beak. It may bite you. Why do you want to touch it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go. Where is the train?
It is on the main track. Is your bag packed?
Yes, yes. Do I need a ticket?
You can buy one at the window. Do you have your ID?
I forgot my ID. What do I do?
That is a problem. Do you have another card?
No, I do not. Please help.
I do not know the rule. Go ask the man at the desk.
I will run. Thank you.
Good luck. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go fast. My head hurts.
I am sorry you feel bad. Is it a big worry?
I must run. I am late.
Please take a slow breath. Can you stay for five seconds?
No. I have to go now.
I hope you feel better soon. I do not know why you are late, but I care.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today!
That is good to hear. Are you smiling right now?
Yes, I have a big smile.
Smiles make faces look nice. What is the shape of your smile?
It looks like a wide curve.
A curve is like a circle that is cut in half. Did you draw it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My computer screen is all black.
Do you see any lights on? Try pressing the power button.
Yes, the light is red.
That means it is trying to start. Did you plug the cord in tight?
The plug is loose.
Push it in until it clicks. Now wait a few seconds.
The screen is bright again.
Happy to help. Do you want to play a game?
I just want to read.
Open your book app. Have a good read.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is howling outside and I am scared.
It is okay to feel scared. Are you in a safe room right now?
Yes, I am in the closet with my dog.
That is a smart choice. Keep the door closed.
What should I do if the lights go out?
Grab a flashlight or a phone. Do you have any batteries with you?
I have a full tank of candles and a book.
That sounds very cozy and safe. Just wait for the storm to pass.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count things?
We count to know how many there are. Do you like numbers?
Yes, I like them. How do I count?
You say one, then two, then three. Which number is your favorite?
I like the number ten. Why is ten big?
Ten is big because it comes after nine. Do you have ten toys?
I have five toys. Why is five in the middle?
Five is halfway to ten. That is a nice place.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I just had the best cake ever.
That sounds very nice. Do you like chocolate?
Yes, I love chocolate. It is my favorite thing in the world.
I am glad you are having fun.
I want to share my joy with you. I am thinking of going to the park later.
A park sounds fresh and calm. Will it be sunny there?
I hope so, but I do not know for sure. I just feel happy right now.
Your happiness is a nice gift. Enjoy your day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My desk feels too small for my big computer and papers.
That can feel crowded. Do you have a shelf nearby?
I do have a shelf, but it feels heavy when I put things up.
Put your heaviest books on the bottom shelf. Do you have a strong chair?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I can never tell the time right.
That is hard. Do you use a clock or a phone?
I use a wall clock at home.
Look at the short hand first. Is it close to a number?
Yes, it is near the twelve.
The short hand shows the hour. Do you know where the long hand is?
It is right on the six.
That means it is half past twelve.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to say sorry to my friend, but I feel shy.
That is a kind wish. Do you know what you did wrong?
I broke his toy, and I am scared to speak.
Honesty is the best start. Would you like a simple sentence to use?
Yes, please tell me what to say.
You can say, "I am sorry I broke your toy." Do you feel ready to try?
I will go tell him right now.
That is brave of you. I hope he accepts your kind words.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My dog shakes his head a lot. Is he sick?
It may be ear mites. Does he scratch that ear?
Yes, he chews at it all day. What should I do?
Take him to a vet. Do you have a car?
I do not have a car. How can I get him there?
I do not know your area. Is there a clinic nearby?
There is one next door. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Keep him warm.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look up. It is raining hard. I am so happy.
That is lovely to hear. Do you like the sound of the rain?
Yes, I love it. It makes me feel warm and cozy.
That is a sweet feeling. Do you have an umbrella?
No, but I am safe inside. The rain is just music.
I am glad you are safe. I do not know where you are.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to buy a book, but I do not know which one.
What kind of story do you like?
I like stories about animals, but the shelves are full.
I do not know what is in stock, but you can ask the staff. Would you like help finding them?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very tired and my legs hurt.
That is hard. Are you eating your snack?
No, I am just looking out the window.
Is the cloud like a big dog?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My bike chain fell off this morning.
That sounds scary. Did you fix it?
I wiped it with a dirty rag.
Your hands must look messy. Do you have soap nearby?
Now I am riding to school on time.
That is good news. Have a safe trip!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My tomatoes are not growing well.
Do they get much sun?
Yes, but the leaves look yellow.
Yellow leaves often mean a lack of food.
Should I add more dirt?
No, just add a balanced plant food.
How often do I feed them?
Once a week is usually best.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park with my dog today.
That sounds like a lovely way to spend the day. Did you play fetch with him?
Yes, he is very fast and loved the ball.
I am happy he had fun. What did you do after playing?
We sat on a bench and ate some cold apples.
Apples sound refreshing on a sunny day. Did you see any other people in the park?
Yes, I saw a child flying a red kite.
That must have looked very nice against the blue sky.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the little hand move so slowly?
It takes a full hour for it to go all the way around the circle. Do you like watching time pass?
What makes it move at all?
A small motor or weight gives it the push to keep turning. Have you ever opened one up?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: It is so hot. I need water.
You should drink some cool water. Are you going somewhere?
Yes, I am late for work.
Hurry then, but do not overheat. Do you have a hat?
No, I forgot it at home.
That is a shame. Stay in the shade if you can.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we eat turkey at Thanksgiving?
It is a big bird that was common long ago. Do you like the taste of it?
Why is the snow white and cold?
I am not sure of the deep science, but it looks nice. Do you like building snowmen?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to wear for the play.
What kind of part do you play?
It is a bird in a tree.
A green shirt and brown pants would be good. Do you have them?
Yes, I have both right now.
Great! You will look like a bird.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The big tree by my house is sick.
Oh, I am sorry to hear that. Do you know if a doctor has seen it?
No one came. It looks very lonely without its green leaves.
Trees can seem lonely when they lose parts. Is it cold where you live?
It is warm. I just wish it was happy again.
Warm weather helps trees grow strong. What does your favorite part of the tree look like?
I like the tall top. I climbed it before the leaves fell.
Climbing sounds like fun. I do not know why that specific tree is sick.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does music make me feel happy?
It makes your brain release good chemicals. Do you like singing?
I love to sing in the shower. Why is that so fun?
The sound bounces back and feels like a gift. Do you sing with friends?
Sometimes I sing with my dog. Why does he just listen?
He may not understand the words, but he feels the beat. Does he bark?
He barks a little, but mostly wags his tail. Why do we both like it?
I do not know for sure, but it brings us joy together. Is that nice?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am watching the sky. Why are the clouds white?
They are white because they bounce light. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. Some clouds look like dogs.
That is fun to see. Do you have a dog?
No, I wish I did.
I am sorry you do not have one.
What makes rain fall from them?
Tiny drops get heavy and fall. Do you like rain?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I climb the stairs inside the lighthouse?
You hold the tight rail and go up one step at a time. Do you have big, strong hands?
I do. But the stairs go all the way to the top, right?
Yes, they spiral up to the glass room with the light. Are you tired yet?
A little. Is it worth the hard work?
It is, because the view from the top is very clear and far.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go now. The wind is very loud.
The sky looks dark and wet. Are you taking your umbrella?
Yes. I must go before the water starts.
Please be safe on the wet path.
I am running fast. The clouds are low.
That looks very heavy up there. Do you have warm shoes?
I have to leave. The rain is here.
Goodbye. I hope you stay dry and safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a quick bite to eat. Where is the best fast food near here?
The burger spot on the corner is open now. Are you hungry?
Yes, but I must go in five minutes.
That place serves very fast. Can I save you a seat?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do we get wet when it rains?
Rain drops fall from the sky. Do you catch them in your hands?
Yes, I do. Is the water dirty?
It is usually clean at first. Does it smell like wet dirt?
Sometimes it does. Why is it cold?
Clouds are high up in the air. Do you wear a coat when you go out?
Yes, I do. How does the rain end?
The clouds break apart. Do you like when the sun comes back?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need this done right now, but I am stuck on the math part.
Let me look at that one for you. Is it about adding big numbers?
Yes, it is too late and my brain is tired.
We can just solve it together step by step. Do you want to try the first line?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the moon change shape each night?
The light from the sun hits it from different angles. Do you like the full moon best?
I like when it looks like a boat. Do you know if people can live there?
People have not lived there yet. We only visit for short trips.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the lake today and felt the sun on my face.
That sounds nice. Did you catch anything?
Yes, I caught a tiny silver fish.
That is a sweet little find. Do you keep it?
I put it back in the water to let it swim away.
That was very kind of you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have two hearts and a king. What is my hand?
You have a pair of hearts and a high card. Do you like hearts best?
Yes, they are red. Should I put them down or keep them?
Keep them to play again, because you still have good cards. I do not know what the next card will be.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say sorry if I bump into someone?
You can say I am so sorry right away. Do you feel happy when someone says sorry?
Yes, it makes me feel better. What do I do if I need to borrow a book?
You ask if I can have it back soon. That is a very polite thing to do.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not like my new neighbor.
That sounds hard. What did they do?
They play loud music late at night.
That must be very tiring. Do you get much sleep?
I wake up every single day.
I am sorry you feel so tired. You might try talking to them.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I wonder where my old friend is now.
I do not know, but I hope he is well. Do you remember his last address?
No, I only have his old phone number.
That might still work if he kept it. Do you think he would be happy to see you?
I hope so, but I am afraid he forgot me.
People rarely forget true friends. You can try calling him.
I will, but only if I am brave enough.
You are already brave for asking. Are you ready to make the call?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I bought these flowers but they look sad.
Do they have water in the vase?
Yes, but I am not sure if they are dying.
Cut the stems short to help them drink.
Should I put them in the sun?
No, keep them in the shade. Do they have buds?
Yes, there is one small bud.
Good, keep them cool and dark.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The street was very quiet today. I walked past the old trees and saw a cat sleeping in the sun.
That sounds like a nice rest for the cat. Did you see any other animals?
No, just the birds singing high up in the branches. The air smelled like rain, even though it was dry.
It is hard to know why it smells that way. Do you like the smell of rain?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My cat likes to sit on my books.
That is very cute. Does he like to read too?
I think he just likes the soft feel of them.
He has good taste. How old is your cat?
He is three years old and very quiet.
Quiet cats are wonderful companions. Does he purr when you read?
Yes, he purrs loud like a little engine.
That must feel very nice. What is his favorite food?
He only wants wet food in the morning.
He is quite picky. Do you feed him at a set time?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: What is the oldest building in the world?
I am not sure which one is truly the oldest. Do you live near an old castle?
I need to go now. Who built the pyramids?
The ancient Egyptians built them for their kings. Did you see a pyramid on a picture?
Just tell me about Rome.
Rome was a big, busy city long ago. Do you like reading about kings?
I must run. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. My boss gave me too much to do.
That sounds really hard. Do you have time for a break?
No, I just want to lie down. Everything is wrong today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Would a glass of water help?
Maybe, but my head hurts a lot. I did not eat lunch.
You should eat something nice. What do you like to eat?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost on this test.
That is okay. What part feels hardest?
The word problems are too long.
Take a deep breath. Do you like drawing?
I usually draw pictures for fun.
You can try drawing the story. Can you share one idea?
Maybe I will try that now.
That sounds like a good plan. How does it feel?
I feel less scared.
I am glad. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a hidden box in my room. I do not know what to do.
That sounds very interesting. What was inside the box?
It had old papers and a key. I am scared to look at the papers.
You can start by reading just one page. Do you want to try that?
Maybe. I feel like I should tell my mom about it first.
Telling a grown-up is a very good plan. Is she a safe person to talk to?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a promise to help my friend today.
That is kind of you. What did you promise to do?
I promised to share my red apple with him.
I am glad you will keep it. Do you like apples?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to jump rope. I feel very proud when I do it well.
That is a great goal. Do you have a rope yet?
No, but I can use a stick for now.
A stick works fine to practice. How high can you jump?
I can jump a little bit. It makes me feel strong.
Feeling strong is wonderful. Keep practicing with care.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I failed my test. I want to stop trying.
That feels very hard. Do you want to take a small break first?
I am just tired. Is it too late for me?
No, it is not too late. What did you learn from the mistake?
I studied the wrong things. I feel stupid.
You are not stupid, just tired. Can we try one small step today?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know where a bear lives, please. I am late.
Bears live in forests and caves. Do you like brown bears or black bears?
I do not have time for choices. Does a snake have legs?
No, snakes do not have legs. They move on the ground.
Good. Do you know how a wolf swims?
I do not know how they swim very well. I am just a helper.
That is okay. Where does an eagle nest?
Eagles build high in trees or on cliffs. Do eagles have babies?
I must go now. Thank you.
You are welcome. Be safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My horse looks very sad today.
That is not good. How much has he eaten?
Almost nothing at all.
That is a big sign. Is he standing up?
Yes, but he stands still and looks down.
You should call a vet. Do you have the number?
I think I do, yes.
Good. Let them help your horse.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my bag fit?
Try folding your clothes small. Do you have big shoes?
Yes, the shoes take a lot of room.
Put the shoes in the bottom of the bag. Is your bag heavy?
It feels a bit heavy.
Leave one small thing for later. What do you want to buy?
I want to buy snacks for the trip.
Keep the snacks for the end. Don't pack them yet.
That is a good plan.
Great! You can do this job.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I can see the bright sun in the sky, but I am not sure what I should do next.
That looks like a lovely day for a walk. Do you like to walk outside?
I do not know if I should play or just watch the light.
Both choices are good. What makes you feel happiest?
I think I will go play now, thank you for your help.
You are very welcome. Have a great time!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The rain is wetting my nice shoes. I do not like this.
That feels awful. Do you have a dry pair inside?
I left them at the park. I am so stuck.
I am sorry to hear that. Is the rain letting up yet?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I look at the round clock, but I do not know how to read the hands.
The short hand shows the hour, and the long hand shows the minutes. Do you see which hand is moving?
I see one hand move fast, but I am still lost on where to look first.
Start with the short hand to find the hour, then check the long hand. Is the long hand near the top or the bottom?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My head hurts so bad. I do not like this.
I am sorry you feel this way. Is it a throb or a sting?
It throbs like a loud drum. I feel very tired.
Rest is the best cure for a tired body. Do you want to sit in the quiet corner?
Yes, please. Can you stay with me?
I will stay right here with you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new song that makes me jump for joy.
That sounds like a great feeling. Do you sing along with it?
Yes, I sing all the time in my room.
Singing is a fun way to show how you feel. What kind of music is it?
It is loud and happy with a fast drum beat.
I love fast music too. It helps me move my feet.
I want to share it with you right now.
I would like to hear it. Please play it for me.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My screen is black and I cannot see anything.
That is a bad feeling. Is the power light on?
No, there is no light at all.
I do not know the fix for that. Did you try plugging it in tight?
Yes, but it still will not wake up.
Let us check the back. Is the cable loose?
I think it is tight, but I am not sure.
Pull it gently and push it back in. Do you hear a click?
It clicked, but the screen is still dark.
That is frustrating. We should let it rest for a minute.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Sailors are terrible. I know that for a fact.
That is a strong word. Do they seem cold to you?
They just stare at the sea. They never come to talk.
I do not know every sailor, but I cannot promise they are all quiet. Do you like to sit by the water?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the red book on dogs. I am late.
The dog books are by the big window. Do you like fluffy dogs?
The window is far away. I must go.
Take the straight path. Is it a fast day for you?
I am almost there. Thank you.
You are very fast. I hope you find it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My leg hurts because I fell off the bike. I still want to eat pizza.
Oh no, I am sorry. Do you want a small slice?
Yes, just one. My leg needs a bandage.
You are right. Can I call someone to help?
I am okay now. I am happy.
That is good. Here is your pizza.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did people build such big walls long ago?
They built them to keep bad things out. Do you think they were scary?
I guess so. Why do we still have ruins of those walls?
Many broke down over time because of bad weather.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at this cute little beetle! I am so happy to see it.
It has a shiny shell. Where did you find it?
It was hiding under a big leaf in the garden. I felt great when I saw it move.
That is a lovely place to hide. Do you like bugs?
Yes, I love how they have six tiny legs. It makes my day brighter.
They are very busy workers.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The water is so big and wet.
Yes, the sea is very big. Do you like to swim in it?
I like to look for shells on the sand.
That is a fun thing to do. You should go look.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a shiny stone in the park today.
That sounds like a nice find. Did you see any birds while you looked?
Yes, I saw a red bird. I also found a small blue cap.
A blue cap is a cool thing to keep. Do you think you will wear it tomorrow?
I think I will put both things in my box.
Your box is ready for them. I do not know if you have more room, but you can check.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do leaves fall in the fall?
The days get short and cold. The tree gives up the leaves to rest. Do you like the bright colors?
Yes, I do. Does the tree lose them to save water?
Yes, it keeps its energy inside. It is like you wearing a coat. Do you wear a coat when it is cold?
I do. How does the tree sleep without leaves?
It stores food in its roots and trunk. It wakes up when it is warm. Do you see any buds on the branches?
I am looking right now. Are they sleeping too?
They are waiting for spring. They will open when the sun is strong. Is the sun shining today?
It is a bit cloudy. Thank you for telling me.
You are welcome. Go find more leaves to enjoy. Do you want to pick one to keep?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I drop an anchor?
You lower it into the water and let it settle. Do you have a big boat?
Yes, it is quite large.
Then pull it up slowly when you are done. I do not know your exact spot.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I promised my friend I would play at two.
That is a good promise. Do you have a plan to go?
Yes, I will finish my snack first.
You can have a snack, but please do not take too long. Are you hungry?
My tummy is not empty.
Good. Then go pack your bag. What are you bringing?
I am bringing my red ball.
A red ball sounds fun. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am new here. Where should I go first?
Try the park. Do you like to play?
Yes, I do. Is the shop near there?
Yes, it is close by.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my beans grow tall?
Give them a stick to climb up. Do you have room for a fence?
Yes, I have a big fence by the wall.
Plant them near that fence.
What should I feed the plants?
Give them water every few days. Do you have a watering can?
I use a hose.
Slow the water down so it soaks in.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to fish in the new river. How do I start?
Find a spot with calm water and cast your line. Do you have a rod?
Yes, I bought one last week. What else do I need?
You need bait to attract fish. I am not sure what works best here.
I will try worms then. Where can I find them?
Look in the dirt near the tree roots. Good luck

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the sky turn red in the fall?
The leaves change color because it gets cold. Do you like to walk in the leaves?
I love it, but why does it snow in winter?
Snow is frozen water from the clouds. Do you build snowmen?
Yes, I do. Do you think spring comes next?
Yes, spring always follows winter. Do you plant flowers?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to ride the bus to the park.
Do you have a ticket?
Yes, I have a small paper ticket.
Look for the door with the green light.
I do not see any lights.
It might be broken. Ask the driver.
The door opens when I press the button.
Good. Do you know where to sit?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I made a small robot that walks in circles. What should I do now?
That sounds like a good start. Do you want it to stop?
I do not know how to make it stop.
You can tell it to pause when it sees a red line. Does your robot see colors?
Yes, it has eyes.
Great. Try adding a stop command for red.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I just moved here. What is this place like?
It is small and quiet. Do you like the quiet?
Yes, I do. Is there a park for kids to play?
Yes, there is a big park near the square.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a knot on the rope?
Hold the rope in your left hand. Do you like boating?
Yes, I love the sea. What do I do next?
Make a circle with the end of the rope. I am not sure why you ask, but is the rope wet?
No, it is dry and new. Please show me the next step.
Cross the top over the bottom to lock it tight.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you know where the big dinosaur bones are?
Yes, they are in the second room. Do you like dinosaurs?
Yes, I do. The blue robot is right next to them?
I think so, but I am not sure. Do you want to go look together?
Yes, please. We can walk there now.
Great! Let’s go find them.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, I am late! Where is the party?
I do not know for sure. Is it at your friend's house?
Yes, at the red house by the park.
Then go fast. Have fun there.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I failed at making a paper boat. Can you show me how?
That is okay. Do you want to start with a square piece of paper?
Yes, I have a square. What do I do next?
Fold it in half lengthwise, then unfold it. Then fold the top corners down to the middle.
It looks like a triangle now. What is the step after that?
Fold the top point down again, but this time do it along the diagonal creases. Do you see the small triangle forming?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so happy today. What should I do?
Happy is a good thing. Do you like to play outside?
I think I should share it with my friends.
That is a kind idea. Will you call them now?
I am not sure if they are busy. What if they are not there?
I do not know their plans. You can try later.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Does the cow make milk?
Yes, cows make milk for us to drink. Do you like milk?
I do! What does the pig say?
Pigs go oink oink. That is all I know about their sounds.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so tired. How do I sleep fast?
Try to cool down your room. Do you like reading?
No time. I need to stop this now.
Drink some warm milk. Is your pillow soft?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do I have to sit still for a long time?
Yes, but it will be okay soon. Do you have a toy with you?
I want to go home now.
I understand that you are bored. The doctor is almost done.
What is next?
I do not know the exact plan yet. Are you hungry?
Can we leave right away?
We must wait for a few more minutes.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you sell the little round donuts with pink icing?
Yes, we do! They are sweet and soft. Do you like pink?
My mom said I can only buy one. Is the cookie with the blue dot in it?
I am not sure about the blue dot, but the cookies are fresh. Can you tell me how you spell "dot"?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost the last round again. It is not fun.
That feels hard. What card did you have left?
I only had a two. It is so hard to win.
You did well trying. Do you want to rest?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the docks fast. Which way do I go?
Turn left at the big red tower. Are you waiting for a boat?
Yes, but I am late. How far is it?
It is just a short walk. Is the water calm today?
I can not wait to ask. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a good trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big white puff in the sky. What is it?
That is a cloud. Do you like looking up?
Yes, but I do not know how to take a picture of it. What should I do?
You can hold up your phone. Do you have one with you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My phone screen is all cracked. I am very sad.
That sounds bad. Did you drop it?
Yes, it fell on the floor. Can I still use it?
Yes, you can still use it. Do you have a case?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big surprise for you.
That sounds exciting. What is it?
I am planting a secret garden behind the fence.
A hidden garden is a lovely idea. What will you grow first?
I will grow bright red strawberries.
They will taste sweet. I am glad you share this with me.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is so warm today.
That sounds wonderful. Do you like the sound of the waves?
Yes, it makes me feel very calm.
I am glad you are feeling happy.
The sand is soft under my feet.
That is nice. Is the water cool?
A little, but not too cold.
That is a good thing to know.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a new friend today. I am very happy.
That is great news! Do you play games together?
Yes, we like to run and jump in the park.
How wonderful! I am glad you have fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am late for the bus. The door is closed.
That is very bad. Are you scared?
Yes, I am sad. Can I still get on?
I do not know the rule. Do you have your ticket?
No, I do not have it.
You must wait for the next one. Is it far?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What time is it when the big hand is on six and the small hand is on three?
It is three thirty. Do you like looking at clocks?
Yes, I do. How do I know if it is quarter past?
Look for the big hand on the nine. Is your watch working well?
Yes, it works. What does quarter to mean?
It means there is fifteen minutes left. Do you watch TV at that time?
Sometimes, yes. Can you teach me another time?
Sure, tell me where the hands are.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I ride a bike in this busy city?
You must look left and right first. Do you have a helmet?
Yes, I have a red one. Where should I ride?
Use the blue paths on the ground. Is it loud here today?
It is very loud and crowded. How do I stop safely?
Squeeze the brakes gently. Do you feel okay?
I feel a bit nervous but okay. Thank you for helping me.
You can do it. Have a safe ride.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My boat is stuck. I must go now.
Is the engine off? Let me help.
No, it is on. Push it please.
I will try. Is the water deep?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn a new language right now.
That is a big task. Are you studying for a test?
No, I just want to talk to people fast.
Start with basic words like "hello." Do you know which language?
It is the one they speak in France.
French is a sweet sound. Are you ready for a few words?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How can I learn to sing well?
Start by humming your favorite song. Do you like high sounds or low sounds?
I like low sounds, but my voice feels rough.
That is normal when you start. Try drinking water before you sing. Do you have a quiet place to practice?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The toast I made fell on the butter side.
That is too bad. Do you have a new piece?
Yes, but the coffee is spilled now.
Oh no. Did you get your shirt?
A little bit. It is just a big day.
I am sorry. Take a slow breath.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, I am late! What time is it?
It is ten o'clock. Are you going to work?
Yes, my boss will be angry. How many minutes are left until ten?
None, it is exactly ten. Do you have a watch?
I do not, I lost my watch. How do I know when I am late?
Look at the clock on the wall. Is the big hand on the twelve?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today. I saw three red apples on the ground.
That sounds fun. Did you pick any?
I picked one apple. It was sweet and crunchy.
Yum. How many apples did you eat?
I ate two apples. I have one left for later.
You are good at sharing.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to fix a broken shelf. Do you know how?
First, you need a screwdriver. Do you have one at home?
Yes, I have a red one. What do I do with it?
Turn the screws tight to stop it from wobbling.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired and sad. The baby cries all night.
That is hard work. How are you sleeping?
Not at all. I feel like a bad parent.
You are a good parent. Do you want a hug?
Yes, please. I am so worried.
I am here for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I met my new neighbor today and he gave me cookies.
That sounds very nice. Do you like chocolate cookies?
Yes, they were so sweet. Now I feel very happy.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That is wonderful. What are you eating?
I am having cake with candles.
That sounds very nice.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk about it?
I lost my favorite toy.
That is a very sad thing to lose. Did you look in your room?
Yes, I looked everywhere.
I am sure we can find it soon. Are you okay right now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. What day is it?
It is Tuesday. Do you like Mondays?
I hate Mondays. Can we skip to Friday?
We cannot time travel. Why do you want Friday?
It is the end of the week. I want to rest.
I understand. Is Sunday your favorite day?
Yes, it is very quiet. I need this now.
Take a deep breath. Do you have a weekend plan?
Just sleep. I must go now.
Okay. Have a safe walk.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see the lights up high, but I do not know what they are.
They are stars, which are very hot balls of gas far away. Do you like looking at them?
They look so far away that I feel very small.
That is a true feeling, but the night sky is big for everyone. Are you happy to be outside?
I am not sure if I should go home or stay here longer.
You can stay if the air feels nice and safe for you. Do you have a warm coat on?
Yes, I am warm, but I still feel unsure about what to do next.
Maybe you can just sit and watch the quiet dark. Do you see any moving lights?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because I lost my favorite book.
That is a very hard thing to lose. Did you check your bag?
I looked everywhere but it is gone.
I am sorry you cannot find it. Would you like help with another story?
I do not want another story, I want mine back.
I hear how much you care about that book. Let us take a deep breath together.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the wedding. Please help me fast.
I can help you. Do you need a ride?
Yes, please. My dress is in a box.
I do not know where the box is. Is it in the car?
No, it is in the hall. Run with me.
I will run with you. I am glad to help.
Thank you. We must go now.
You are welcome. Have a happy day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I picked up three shiny stones from the park and put them in my pocket.
That sounds like a lovely find. Did the stones feel warm or cold?
They were cool to the touch, and I also saved a single red leaf on my walk home.
You have a nice little collection forming. Do you plan to display them on a shelf?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a magnet stick to a wall?
You can use a paperclip or a small piece of steel. Does your wall have a thin metal layer?
No, it is just painted wood.
Then a normal magnet will not hold anything there. Try using a small piece of tape or a hook instead.
Oh, I see. What else can magnets do?
They can pull iron and steel things from far away. Do you have any old nails or keys to try with?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a cool puzzle. I want to show you.
That sounds fun. Is it hard?
No, I think I can solve it soon.
Good luck. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is a circle round?
It is round because every point is the same distance from the center. Do you like drawing circles?
Why does a square have four sides?
A square has four sides to make four right angles. Is that clear to you?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am lost, but I am very happy!
That is good to hear. What makes you so happy?
I found a big, red mushroom!
That sounds fun. Do you know which way home is?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad inside today.
I am sorry to hear that. What made you feel this way?
I cannot find my favorite red ball.
That can be hard to feel. Have you looked under the bed yet?
Yes, I have looked everywhere, but it is gone.
I do not know where it is, but I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know which drink to pick. Which is better, tea or coffee?
It depends on what you like best. Do you like your drink hot or cold?
I like it hot, and I want to feel awake. Which one helps me stay awake?
Coffee usually gives you more energy than tea.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to see a new robot!
That is great news. What can the robot do?
It makes my coffee very hot and sweet.
That sounds like a nice start.
I feel warm inside when it works for me.
That feeling is special. Do you talk to it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need a book that is fun. I do not know where to start.
Try the picture books first. They are very happy. Do you like animals?
I love dogs. But I also like big spaceships.
That is a hard choice. Go to the back shelf. It has both. Is the blue door open?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The wind feels so cool on my face today.
That is a lovely feeling. Do you like running in it?
Yes, it makes me feel very free and happy.
I am glad you feel that way.
I want everyone to feel this joy too.
Sharing good things is a great idea. Do you have a favorite part of the day for this?
Late afternoons are my favorite time.
That sounds like a perfect time to relax.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make tomatoes grow?
Plant them in warm soil with lots of sun. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
Yes, I have a sunny corner.
Great! Put the seeds in the dirt. Do you have water?
I have a bucket of water.
Water them gently every day. Do you know how deep to plant them?
I am not sure about the depth.
Bury them a little under the dirt. They like to be safe.
Okay, I will bury them deep.
Not too deep, just a little. Do you have rich soil?
I have dark soil with some compost.
That is perfect for roots. Have fun growing!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to look forward when I ride?
You look forward to see where you are going so you do not hit things. Do you like going fast?
Why is the balance hard to keep at first?
Your body needs time to learn how to stay up. Do you fall a lot?
Why do I pedal with my legs?
Your legs push the wheels to move the bike. Do you have a favorite color?
Why do I wear a helmet on my head?
It stops your head from getting hurt if you bump into something. Do you like rain?
Why do I need to stop at red lights?
It keeps you safe so cars do not hit you. Do you enjoy candy?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hurry, please. The rain is coming.
I see the dark clouds. Are you safe?
No time to talk. I need to go now.
Please wait a moment. Is the road wet?
It is very wet. I must run.
Slow down so you do not fall. Do you have a coat?
I have a coat. I am almost there.
Good. The storm is loud. Can you hear the birds?
I do not hear birds. I only hear rain.
The birds hide when it storms. Be safe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because I love my new robot friend.
That is great to hear. Do you show it to your friends?
Yes, I showed it to everyone in my class.
Wow, that must be fun. What does it do for you?
It helps me clean up my toys every night.
That sounds very helpful. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My hand is very low. Should I drop a card?
That is a hard call. What is your best card?
It is a seven. I have no pairs.
I would keep the seven for now. Do you have money for next round?
Yes, I have plenty of chips.
Then take the risk. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What does a lighthouse do?
It shows ships the safe way to land. Do you like boats?
Yes, big boats are cool.
Lighthouses have very bright lights. Do you see stars?
I see them at night.
The light spins around to help sailors. It is a safe home for them.
Thank you for telling me.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished a new book and I am so happy to tell you about it.
That sounds like a lovely feeling. What makes the story so special to you?
The main character is a brave little fox who helps her friends find food.
A brave fox is a great hero. Does the fox live in a forest?
Yes, she lives in a cozy den under an old oak tree.
That sounds like a warm and safe place to call home.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I put the first wall of my shed up today. It was hard work.
That sounds like a big step. Did you feel proud?
I did, but the roof parts are still in a box. I am not sure where to start.
A good place to start is the back edge. Do you have a helper?
No, just my dog who watches me. I feel a bit alone.
That can feel lonely. Have you talked to a neighbor?
Yes, and he came over to help me lift the wood. It is much easier now.
That is great news. Safety is key when lifting.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a balloon to my chair?
You can wrap the string around the leg. Do you have a long string?
Yes, I do. How do I tie a bow?
Make a loop with the string. Pull the other end tight.
It looks like a knot. What is wrong?
You need two loops before you pull. Are you using your fingers?
Yes, I am trying hard.
Try again slowly. You are doing a good job.
Oh, it worked. Thank you very much.
I am happy it worked. Will you eat cake soon?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished my letter and I feel so happy.
That is wonderful news. What did you write in it?
I wrote about my new dog.
A new dog is a great topic. Did you draw a picture of him?
Yes, I drew him sleeping.
That sounds very sweet. Did you seal the envelope?
I used the glue, but it is still wet.
You must wait for it to dry. Do you have a stamp ready?
I have the stamp and the envelope is dry.
You are ready to send it then. I hope your friend likes it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to buy a tomato. How do I pick a good one?
Look for a red one that feels heavy. Do you like sweet tomatoes or sour ones?
I like sweet ones.
Pick the ones that smell nice at the stem. You will love them.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why is the sky blue, and how can I see it better?
Sunlight breaks into colors when it hits the air. Have you ever looked up on a very clear day?
I have. What else can I do to learn about the sky?
You can use a glass of water and a flashlight to mix colors. Do you like doing small experiments?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sky is gray and wet. What should I do?
Stay inside? Do you have a warm drink?
I have some hot tea. It helps me feel safe.
That is a good plan. Is your roof dry?
I do not know. I can hear the drops on the tiles.
Listen closely. Do they sound loud or soft?
They are very loud. It is a big storm.
Then sit down and rest.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do plants drink water?
They need it to grow big and strong. Do you know where roots go?
Where do the roots go?
They dig down deep into the soil. Do you like playing in the dirt?
I do! How does the water move up?
It travels up tiny tubes in the stem.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a shoe?
Hold one lace up high. Do you have a buddy to help?
I am all alone right now.
Cross the laces over each other. Make a big loop. Is the loop easy for you?
I made a loop, but it is loose.
Pull the tail tight to make a knot.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a big talk with my mom today.
That sounds fun. Is she getting ready for it?
Yes, she is picking out her nice clothes.
Nice clothes help you feel ready. Do you want to help her pick?
I can help pick the shoes for her.
That is a very kind thing to do. Which color does she like best?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got home from a train ride. It was so much fun.
That sounds lovely. Did you see many interesting things from the window?
Yes, I saw big green fields and a lonely cow. It was very peaceful.
A peaceful ride is always nice.
The view made me feel calm and happy. I want to go again soon.
I am glad you enjoyed it. Do you know where you want to travel next?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a knot to put my line on the hook?
You can use a simple overhand knot, but do you have a spare piece of string to practice on?
No, I only have my fishing line.
Be very careful not to snap it, and ask a local expert if you get stuck.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in the crowd.
Do you need help finding your seat?
Yes, please.
I do not know your name.
You can ask the ushers.
That is a good idea.
Thank you.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What does a lion eat?
Lions eat meat from other animals. Do you like to eat meat?
I like chicken. What color is a penguin?
Penguins are black and white. Do you think they are cold?
Yes, they live in snow. Do bears hibernate?
Yes, they sleep through the winter. Is that boring?
Maybe. What does a frog eat?
Frogs eat small insects like flies. Do you like flies?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My teacher looks very happy today. Why is she smiling?
She might have had a good lunch. Did you ask her?
I did not ask. Why do people smile when they are happy?
Smiling shows joy. It makes others feel good too.
Does she always smile like that? Why not every day?
I do not know. Everyone has bad days. How do you feel?
I feel fine. Why do we have bad days?
Sometimes things are hard. It is normal to rest. Do you like school?
Yes, I like it. Why do you ask about school?
I just want to help. Let us learn together.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired from cleaning the kitchen floor.
That sounds like hard work. Did you use a blue mop?
Yes, I did. I almost slipped on a wet spot.
Oh no, that is scary. Is the floor dry now?
It is dry, but I found a lost sock under the sink.
How funny. Did you keep the sock?
I threw it away. Then I started dusting the shelves.
Good job finishing that task. How many books are on top?
Many books. I feel clean and happy now.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a map but I am lost. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help. What city is this?
It is a small town with a big river.
Do you see the blue lines?
Yes, I see blue lines all over it.
Blue means water. Find the wide blue line.
I found the wide line. Now what?
Look for your house. Is it near the water?
My house is far from the water.
Then you are safe. Walk toward the street with the crosswalks.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my bike need air in the tires?
Air makes the tires hard so they do not squish. Do you like going fast on a bike?
Yes, I like speed. Why do I have to pedal harder when it is going up a hill?
Hills are hard to climb because you are fighting gravity. Do you enjoy the hard work?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to count my toys, but I get lost.
Count one at a time and point with your finger. Do you have many toys?
I have a big box of them.
Try to count them into small groups of ten. Is that easier for you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need roses for the party. It is soon.
Red roses are very pretty. Do you like the red ones?
Yes, but I cannot wait. I must go.
They are in the left corner. I hope they are fresh.
Thank you. I am running out of time.
I will hold them for you. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very tired when I run for ten minutes. Why is this happening?
Your body needs time to learn how to use air better. Do you drink water before you start?
Yes, I drink a glass of water. It still hurts my stomach.
That is a good sign your heart is working hard. Try slowing down a bit more.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to see the stars tonight. They shine so bright in the dark sky.
That is a lovely feeling. Do you know which star is the brightest?
No, I do not know. But I like how they twinkle like tiny lights.
You are right, they do twinkle.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike. Can you help me?
Yes, I would love to help. Do you have a bike yet?
I have a small bike, but I am afraid of falling.
Falling is part of learning. Are you wearing a helmet?
No, I do not have one. Is that bad?
It is very bad. A helmet keeps your head safe. Do you have a friend who can hold the bike?
Yes, my brother is very strong. What should I do first?
Start on a flat, open area. Do you know how to brake?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went for a walk in the park this afternoon.
That sounds like a lovely way to spend time. Did you see any birds?
Yes, I saw a red robin on a low branch.
What a bright color. Was it singing?
It was just sitting very still, looking at me.
Nature can be so quiet. Did you sit down for a rest?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What is a tree?
A tree is a tall plant with leaves. Do you like green things?
Yes. Why do trees stand so still?
Their roots hold them tight in the dirt. Is it windy today?
It is. I must go now.
Hurry, but be safe. Take a look up as you run.
Okay. Bye.
Bye. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a great day at the beach.
That sounds fun. Did you swim?
Yes, I swam and built a big sand castle.
A big castle? That is cool. Did you share it?
I shared it with my friend and we ate ice cream.
Ice cream is a nice treat. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My teacher gave me a big red star for my drawing.
That sounds very nice! Did you draw a dog or a cat?
I drew a cat that eats a fish.
A hungry cat! Does it have whiskers?
Yes, long white ones.
What a lovely picture!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is this street so silent?
The houses are old. Do you like quiet places?
It feels like everyone is gone.
I think the neighbors are sleeping. Is it getting late?
I am lost here.
I do not know the way. Can you see the big clock?
The clock says noon.
Noon is busy here. Did you check the map?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know if I should go out or stay in.
Are you cold?
The air is sharp and the trees are bare.
It looks like winter. Why not make hot cocoa?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why does the big ship not sink?
It floats because it pushes water aside. Do you like water?
Please, I must go. Is that all?
Yes, the air inside helps too. I hope you make it in time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a blue trail on my map today. It led to a small pond.
That sounds like a nice quiet place. Did you see any fish there?
No, just some big frogs. I felt very lucky.
Frogs are fun to watch. Do you like to sit by the water for long?
Yes, I sat for an hour. The map showed no other paths.
It must have felt peaceful.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is it sunny outside today?
Yes, the sun is shining bright. What is your favorite color?
I like blue. Is it warm?
It is warm and nice. Do you want to play outside?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with the clock.
Do you want to learn how to read the hands?
Yes, please. What time is it now?
It is three o'clock. Do you like looking at clocks?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My head hurts so bad. I do not know if I need to go to the doctor.
That sounds very scary. Do you have a fever?
Maybe. I feel hot. Should I just wait and see?
I am not sure what is wrong. Have you tried drinking water?
Yes, I did. But my head still hurts. Do I have to go?
It is best to check with a doctor. Do you feel safe alone right now?
I do not. I feel very alone and scared.
Please tell a grown up. You are not alone.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tell the time?
Look at the big hand first. Is it pointing down?
The big hand is pointing down.
That means fifteen minutes past the hour. What does the small hand show?
The small hand is on the number three.
It is three fifteen. Do you know how to say that?
Do I say three fifteen?
Yes, that is correct. Great job learning!
Can I practice more?
Of course you can. Ask me anything you like.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you have red shoes?
Yes, we do. What size do you wear?
My feet are small. I need size five.
Great, try these on. Do they feel comfy?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw three red apples on the table this morning.
That sounds nice. Did you eat any of them?
I ate one apple for breakfast and felt very happy.
One apple is a good start. How many apples were left?
There were two apples still sitting on the table.
Two is a small group. Do you like red apples?
Yes, I love them, so I ate the last two later.
That makes the total three. Did you have a good day?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a new friend today. I am so happy.
That is great news! What did you do together?
We shared our lunch and played tag. It was fun.
I am glad you had a good time. How did you feel?
I felt warm inside. I want to see him again tomorrow.
That is a wonderful feeling. Keep that happy heart close.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a new file on my computer?
Just click on the white space and type "New". What kind of file do you want?
I just want to write some words in it.
That is a text file. It is very simple to use.
Okay, I will try that now.
Good luck. Let me know if it works.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I read for a long time last night and my eyes hurt this morning.
That happens when you stay up too late. Do you use a lamp for your book?
Yes, I have a small light right by my bed.
Great light, but your eyes need a break. Do you rest your eyes for a few minutes?
No, I just keep going until I fall asleep.
You should stop if your eyes feel tired. Do you want to try reading earlier tonight?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at my teacher.
That feels bad. What did she do?
She took my drawing and did not give it back.
That is not fair. Are you sure she kept it?
Yes, I saw her put it in her bag.
I am sorry about that. Do you want to talk to her?
I am too scared to talk to her.
That is okay. You can wait until you feel ready.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now. My train is late.
Oh no. Where are you headed?
I am going to the beach.
The sun is out. You will have fun.
I must run. Goodbye.
Safe travels. Wave if you can.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel so tired today.
That sounds hard. Do you sleep well at night?
Yes, but I still feel heavy. Why is that?
It can be from stress or food. What did you eat today?
Just some cookies and tea.
That may not give you much strength. Do you feel hungry now?
A little, but I am too tired to move.
Try a small snack. Would you like to sit and rest?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to set up my tent right now, please tell me the steps.
First, find a flat spot on the ground. Is your campsite near a stream?
Yes, but I am late, so just tell me the next step.
Push the poles up high and secure the stakes. I do not know if the ground is wet there.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I think I failed the test.
I am sorry you feel this way.
I missed too many questions.
That is tough. What was the hardest part?
The math section was too fast.
I see. Can we check the answers together?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a new goat and I want to keep it safe.
Put a strong fence around it. Are your goats friendly to cats?
Yes, they love the cats. What should I feed them?
Give them hay and fresh water.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is very loud. I am not sure what to do.
It sounds like a big storm. Are you feeling scared?
I do not know if I should stay in.
Staying in is safe. Do you have a warm blanket?
I am cold and I am stuck.
I am not sure how to stop the wind. Can you sit by the window?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love to sing a loud song for you.
That is very fun to hear. Do you like happy songs?
Yes, I sing when my heart feels good.
I am glad you feel good. I do not know all songs.
I will teach you my favorite tune.
I would love to learn it. What is the first word?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a secret I want to tell you.
That is nice of you. Do you feel safe here?
Yes, but I am nervous.
Take a deep breath. What is the secret?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited in a long line at the store for a long time.
That can be hard. Did you feel angry?
I did, but I breathed deep and counted to ten.
That is a great way to stay calm. What number did you stop at?
I went up to twenty before the door opened.
You waited with such care. Well done.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like drums the best.
That is a loud and fun choice. Do you play a little?
Yes, I hit them with sticks.
That makes a big sound. Do you like soft music too?
I like songs that are quiet.
Soft music is nice for resting. What is your favorite quiet song?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I can't sleep after reading.
That is a common problem. Do you read bright stories?
Yes, I read about space.
Try a calm book about animals instead. That might help you relax.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do cows have big hooves?
They help them walk on grass without falling. Do you like to walk on soft grass?
Why do chickens cluck?
I am not sure, but they use it to talk. Is your favorite animal loud or quiet?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to count the months.
That is a fun skill. Do you know where to start?
I think it begins with the first month.
Yes, you start with January. Do you know what comes next?
I guess February follows January.
You are right. You just go one by one.
Is it hard to remember them all?
It takes some time. Do you like calendars?
I am still learning the last one.
December is the end. You will get it with practice.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: It is slow. I need to send this now.
Let us restart it. That often helps. Are you sure it is the right file?
Yes, it is. Just make it go faster.
Try closing other apps. Can you click the big red button?
No time for that. Give me a fix.
I do not know a magic word. Please wait for the restart.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My plant looks sad and I do not understand why.
A plant gets water through its roots. Do you give it enough water?
I think I did, but the leaves are still drooping.
Water moves up tiny tubes in the stem to the leaves. Do you know where the stems are?
Yes, I know where they are, but why are they brown?
Sometimes old leaves turn brown when they have done their job. Have you checked the soil?
The soil feels dry, so I will water it again.
That is a good idea. Do you feel better about your plant now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad because the beach is empty.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like walking in the sand?
I do, but I wanted my friend here with me.
That is a true feeling. What is your friend doing right now?
They are at home, so I am all alone.
I do not know how they feel, but I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My phone is not working right. I do not know what to do.
I am sorry to hear that. Is the screen still on?
Yes, the screen is on. But it is very slow.
That is strange. Let us try to restart it.
How do I restart it? I am lost.
Hold the side button until the screen goes black. Then turn it back on.
Okay, I did that. It feels faster now.
I am happy that worked. Do you feel better about using it?
Yes, I feel less worried. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I am glad to be of help.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now.
That makes me smile too. What is making you feel this way?
I am just waiting for my dog to come home.
How nice. I love dogs too.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have dirty clothes, but I am not sure how to wash them.
Put the clothes in the machine with some soap. Do you know how to use the buttons?
No, I do not know the buttons, and I am worried about the colors.
Pick the cold water setting to keep the colors bright. Is one of the shirts red?
Yes, there is a red shirt. Should I wash it with the white shirts?
No, keep the red away from the white so they do not stain each other. Do you have a laundry bag?
I think I do, but I am lost. What do I do next?
Put the red shirt in the bag and start the machine. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is wonderful to hear. What makes you feel this way?
I just love looking at the fluffy clouds.
They look like big soft pillows. Do you see any shapes in them?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My legs hurt from this long flight. How do I stop the pain?
Sit tall and lift one foot up. Do you feel better when you move?
Yes, that helps. How do I drink more water on the plane?
Keep a small cup on the tray table in front of you. I am not sure how much water is best for everyone, but a few sips every hour is good. Do you have a refillable cup?
I just have a paper cup. What else can I do to feel less tired?
Look out the window and take slow breaths. The fresh air helps wake you up. Do you see the clouds below?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can I feed the fish now?
Yes, you can. Do they look hungry?
I think they are open their mouths.
That is a good sign. Just drop two flakes.
The blue one is sleeping on the bottom.
Fish rest like that too. Is he moving slowly?
He is very still.
That is normal. Give him some space.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make my white shirts stay bright?
Use white vinegar in the rinse to help them shine. Do you use hot or cold water?
I usually pick cold to save energy.
Cold is great for most clothes, but hot works better for very dirty whites.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many toes do I have on one foot?
You have five toes on one foot. Do you like to wiggle them?
Yes, I do wiggle them a lot. How many toes are on both feet?
You have ten toes on both feet. Is that a lot of toes?
It feels like a lot when I am barefoot. Can you count to five for me?
One, two, three, four, five. Did you like that count?
Yes, I did like that count. Thank you for helping me count.
You are welcome. Do you want to count again?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My legs hurt so much from the run. I almost wanted to quit.
That feels bad, but you finished. Do you drink plenty of water?
Yes, I drink some. I just feel weak.
Your body needs rest to get strong. Are you happy you crossed the line?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for class. Where is the teacher?
I do not know. Is this your first day?
Yes, I am so busy. Do you know where they went?
Maybe the office. Are you scared?
The bell will ring soon. Do you see anyone?
No, I do not see anyone. Do you like the new books?
I do not have time to read. Where is the door?
That way, near the clock. You can go now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big oak tree today. It had many brown leaves on the ground.
That sounds like a beautiful sight. Do you like to collect leaves?
I tried to pick one, but it was too heavy. Then I went home to eat an apple.
Apples come from trees too. Did you enjoy the fruit?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I build a sand castle?
Dig a hole for the base and pack the wet sand tight. Do you have a small bucket?
Yes, I have a small bucket. How do I make it tall?
Stack the wet sand in small layers and let them dry before adding more.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to swim in the sea. Do you know?
Yes, take big breaths and kick your legs. Do you like the cold water?
Yes, it feels nice. Can you show me more?
Keep your face in the water and float on your back. Do you trust the waves?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a coin and I do not know what to do with it.
That is a nice find. Did you see where it came from?
I do not know. It was on the floor.
Try looking for a lost note nearby.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do trees lose their leaves?
They drop them to rest for the winter. Do you see any falling leaves near your home?
Yes, I do. What do they do while they sleep?
They save energy to grow again in spring. Do you like watching them wake up in the spring?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I want to read more, but my eyes feel so heavy.
That sounds hard. Do you like the story?
Yes, but I am too tired to keep my eyes open.
Your body needs rest. Do you want to try again tomorrow?
I guess I do, but I do not want to lose my place.
You can put a bookmark there. It is okay to sleep now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see orange light in the window next door.
Is the smoke coming out of the top or the bottom?
It is coming from the bottom of the window.
You must call 911 right now.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off trees?
Trees drop leaves to save energy for winter. Do you like looking at them?
Yes, they look so pretty and colorful.
The colors happen because the sun makes new pigments. Have you seen red leaves?
I have seen some that are bright orange.
Orange is very warm and cozy. Did the wind blow them down?
The wind did blow them down onto the ground.
The wind helps them go to sleep. Can you hear them crunch?
Yes, they sound like little crinkles.
That sound tells you the season has changed. Is it cold outside now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My computer made a loud noise this morning.
That sounds scary. What did the screen do next?
It just went black and would not turn on.
That is a sad start to the day. Did you check if the power cord is tight?
Yes, I pulled it hard and it is not loose.
I do not know why it stopped working. Do you see any lights on the back?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing this song with a happy face.
That sounds fun. Do you have a mirror to practice with?
No, but I can feel it in my chest when I smile.
That is a great sign. Just keep smiling while you hum the notes.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big ship today and I felt very happy.
That is wonderful to hear. What color was the ship?
It was white with a blue stripe on the side.
A nice choice of colors.
I love how it moved on the water so well.
Sailing is a cool thing to watch. Do you want to ride on a boat someday?
Yes, I hope I can go to sea one day.
That sounds like a fun dream to have.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a sad dog on the street. I do not know what to do.
That is very kind of you to help. Is the dog hurt or just cold?
It is shivering and looks very thin. I am worried it is sick.
Please bring it to a warm place first. Have you found a phone to call a vet?
Yes, I am calling now. I hope the doctor can make it feel better soon.
That is the right thing to do. You are being a true friend to that dog.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I promised to fix my bike before noon, but I broke a spoke instead.
That is a tricky spot. Did you try to ride it anyway?
No, I could not move it, so I sat in the grass and felt sad.
That is very honest of you. It is okay to rest for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun felt hot on my face today.
That sounds like a nice warm day. Did you play outside?
I sat on the grass and watched a bird.
Birds love sunny spots. Was it a big bird?
It was small and brown with a yellow beak.
That sounds like a cute little creature. Did it sing?
It did not sing, but it jumped near me.
Jumping is fun. Did you share any snacks?
I gave it a tiny piece of bread.
That was a kind thing to do. Did it eat it all?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the big hand move so much faster than the small one?
The big hand finishes a full circle in one hour. The small hand takes twelve hours to do the same. Do you like watching them move?
Yes, I do. But why does the little hand not just stop when the big one finishes?
The little hand needs time to mark the hour. It moves slowly so we know exactly how much time has passed. Do you want to count the hours together?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like red roses.
They look nice. Do you like big flowers?
Yes. Do they smell good?
I do not know. But they look pretty.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to cross the lake fast. Can I swim?
That is a big lake. Is the water deep there?
No time to check. How do I get across?
There is a boat at the dock. Do you know how to row?
I can just push it. The weather looks nice.
It is sunny and calm. Do you have a life jacket?
I am going now.
Wait, the water is cold. Please take a jacket.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke the cup by accident. I feel very sad about it.
Accidents happen to everyone. Do you have a plan to fix it?
I tried to glue it, but it did not work well. What should I do now?
You can ask someone for help to make it safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My throat hurts and I feel sick. How do I make tea?
Put hot water in a cup and add a tea bag. Do you have honey?
Yes, I have honey. Should I add it now?
Wait until the tea gets warm. Does your nose run?
Yes, it is very runny. How do I clear it?
Breathe in slowly through your nose. Do you have a warm cloth?
Yes, I have a towel. How do I use it?
Put the warm towel on your nose. Rest your eyes now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want cereal with milk for breakfast.
That sounds tasty. Do you like adding fruit to it?
I ate toast with jam yesterday.
Jam on toast is very good. Was it sweet or sour?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel so tired today. I want to learn to tie my shoes.
Tying shoes can help you feel busy and less bored. Do you have a pen nearby?
Yes, I do. Why do I need a pen?
You can draw the shape of the bow on paper first. Is your paper blue or white?
It is blue. I drew a circle and a line.
That is a great start for the loop. Do you know how to make the knot tight?
No, I do not. Please tell me.
Pull the two ends down firmly to make it tight.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate my desk. It is too hard and my back hurts.
That sounds very uncomfortable. Is the chair too old?
Yes, it is. I need to fix this soon.
Maybe a soft pad will help. Have you tried that yet?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I get this mud off my shirt?
Try rubbing it with warm water first. Is the shirt light or dark?
It is my favorite blue jeans.
Use a little soap and a soft brush. Do you have a brush?
Yes, I have one in the sink.
Good, gently scrub the spot. Then wash it in the machine.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves turn red?
They change color when it gets cool. Do you like red leaves?
Yes, I do. Why does it get cool?
The sun shines less in the sky. Does that make sense to you?
Sort of. What happens next?
Snow will fall soon. Have you seen snow yet?
No, not this year. Will it be fun?
Yes, it is very fun. I hope you like playing in it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do bees make that sweet honey?
Bees collect sweet nectar from flowers and store it in their special bellies. Do you like eating honey?
Yes, I do. Can I help them make it?
No, bees make the honey all by themselves. Do you live near a garden?
Yes, we have many flowers outside.
Bees love those flowers to get food. Are the flowers still blooming?
Yes, they are very pretty.
Pretty flowers help the bees grow strong. Do you see any bees on them?
I see them buzzing around often.
That means they are busy working for you. Do you want to watch them?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red circle on the wall today.
A red circle is a nice sight. Did it look like a sun?
It was just paint, but my lunch box was a tall square.
A square box holds food well. What did you eat inside?
I ate a round apple and a triangle of cheese.
That sounds like a happy meal. I did not see your lunch, but I am glad you are full.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I played tennis today and hit the ball right into the net.
Oh no, that can be tricky. Did you try again?
Yes, I hit it over the fence this time.
That is a good effort. Do you like playing outside?
I love the sun and the grass.
Nature helps you stay calm. Nice day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the pool today. I wore my red swimsuit.
That sounds like fun. Did you have a good time?
Yes, the water was warm. I swam laps with my dad.
Cool. How many laps did you do?
I did ten laps. It took a long time.
You are a strong swimmer. I am glad you enjoyed it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are some flowers red and some are blue?
It is because of the colors in their leaves. Do you like red flowers?
Yes, I do. Why do flowers need sunlight?
Sunlight helps them make their own food. Do you have plants at home?
I do. Why do flowers have so many petals?
I am not sure why there are that many. But they look nice.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see a new movie, but I am not sure which one.
Do you like funny shows or scary ones?
I like funny stories that are not too loud.
The clown movie is very nice and makes me smile.
Can I watch it with my little sister?
Yes, it is soft and safe for small eyes. Do you have popcorn ready?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now, but tell me about tennis.
Tennis is a game with a net. Do you like to run?
I do not have time for your questions.
I am sorry. The ball must land in the lines.
What do I use to hit the ball?
You use a special racket.
How many people play at once?
Usually two people play.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to milk a cow.
That is a big job. Do you like working with animals?
Yes, I do. What do I need to do first?
