You must clean the udder well. Is there water nearby?
Yes, I have a bucket. What is the next step?
Hold the bucket tight. Have you tried this before?
No, this is my first time. How do I hold it?
Squeeze gently in a rhythm. Do not pull hard.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My grandma gave me a cookie this morning. It was warm and sweet.
That sounds nice. Did she teach you how to make them?
Yes, she showed me how to mix the dough. I got a little messy.
Oh, I am sorry I do not know what you used to clean up. Did you have fun helping her?
It was very fun. I made three cookies for her to eat.
That is so sweet of you. Do you think she liked them?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Hi. I want to know how plants drink water. Can you tell me?
Yes, they use tiny roots in the dirt. Do you like to watch plants grow?
I do. But why do they stop drinking if it rains too much?
Their roots get too wet and cannot breathe. I am not sure why that hurts them.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very sad and alone. I want to learn how to grow flowers to share with people.
That is a sweet idea. Do you have a sunny spot for them?
I do not know where to start. Is it hard to make seeds grow?
It is not hard, but it takes patience. Do you like to take care of small things?
I think I can try. Can you tell me the very first step?
Just put the seeds in warm soil and water them gently. Do you have any soil at home?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to visit the sea, but I do not know what to bring.
Please pack a towel and some sun cream. Do you like to swim in the waves?
Yes, I love swimming. Is the water always warm?
No, the water can be cold in winter. Do you have a warm coat?
I have a jacket. Is it safe to swim near the rocks?
Be careful, as rocks are hard and sharp. I do not know your local tides.
That is good advice. Will I see any animals?
Yes, you might spot fish or shells. Do you like looking for treasures?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a dog with a torn bandage on its leg today.
That must have made you feel sad. Did you talk to the owner?
Yes, I told them to take it to the vet.
You did a very kind thing for that animal.
I hope it feels better soon.
I hope it does too.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel so tired today. My boss asked me to do too much work.
That sounds very hard. Do you like the work?
I do not like the extra work. It makes me sad.
I am sorry you feel sad. Do you have a friend to talk to?
I do not know if I can fix this. What should I do?
Try to take a deep breath. Is there a small task you can do first?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I missed my train this morning.
Oh no, that sounds bad. Did you catch the next one?
Yes, I had to run.
That must have been tiring. Was the ride smooth?
It was very bumpy.
I am sorry about that.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate Mondays so much. They are always too long.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a lot of work to do?
Yes, it never ends. I just want to sleep.
That sounds very tiring. What do you like to do for fun?
I like to play outside. But I must not go yet.
Playing outside is great. Do you have a pet to help you?
No, I am alone at home. It feels quiet.
I am sad to hear that. Do you want to talk more?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn to swim but I am scared of the water.
That is okay. Do you have goggles?
Yes, but my ears hurt when I swim.
Try holding your nose tight. Do you have a life vest?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: What is the best month to go outside?
Spring is nice when the flowers come out. Do you like warm days?
I like warm days, but it is too cold now.
Wait a little longer for summer. Is it cold where you live?
Yes, I have my coat on. How many months are there in a year?
There are twelve months in a year. Do you count them all?
I count them, but I forget the names.
That is okay. You can learn them slowly.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and saw a big dog.
That sounds fun. What did the dog do?
It chased a ball very fast.
I bet it was tiring for him.
Then I played some games with my friends.
Nice. Do you like those games?
Yes, they are very good to play.
I am happy you had fun.
Now I am ready to do my math work.
Good job. You can do it well.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
I can help you with that. Do you have your shoes ready?
Yes, I have them here.
First, you make a big loop on each side. Do they look like bunnies?
Yes, they look like bunnies!
Great, now cross them and pull tight.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, but how does the big ship stay up?
The ship is lighter than the water it pushes aside. Is that good enough for you?
Yes, but why does it not sink?
The water pushes back hard against the heavy ship. Do you have time for a snack?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel tired when I work at home. What can I do?
Try to stand up and walk around often. Do you have a quiet spot to rest?
Yes, I have a desk, but my back hurts a lot.
Sit tall and keep your feet on the floor. Does your chair help you?
I eat snacks all day and feel bad about it.
Pack small pieces of fruit instead. Do you like cold water?
I talk to friends on the phone too much.
Put your phone in a box after lunch. Do you feel calm now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn to bake bread, but I feel stuck.
Baking is a slow art. Do you have a recipe ready?
Yes, but the dough is not rising. What do I do?
Warmth helps yeast work. Is your kitchen cool?
It is warm, but I am getting impatient with the wait.
Trust the time. Have you tried just breathing?
I need to see results right now. Please help me.
Patience is the secret ingredient. Can you wait ten more minutes?
That is all I need to hear. Thank you.
You are doing great. Keep going.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want some toast for breakfast.
Toast is a good choice. Do you like it with butter?
Yes, please. Can I have jam too?
We can put jam on it if you wish. What kind do you want?
I want strawberry jam.
I do not know if we have any left.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very worried and I do not know what to do.
That is a hard feeling. What is making you worry the most?
I am scared my friend might be angry with me.
It is good to care about your friend. Do you know why you think they are angry?
No, I do not know. I just feel bad about it.
I am sorry that is confusing. It is okay to not know the answer.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to bake bread, but I am not sure what to do first.
Start by mixing flour, water, yeast, and salt in a big bowl. Do you have all of these things at home?
Yes, I have them, but the dough feels too sticky.
Add a little more flour and knead it until it feels smooth. Is the room warm where you work?
The room is warm, and the dough looks soft now.
Let it sit for an hour so it grows big. What kind of shape do you want your loaf to be?
I want a round loaf, but I am worried it will not bake well.
A round loaf is easy to make if you press it into a ball. Do you have a pan that is round?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not understand my math work.
Do you have the problem in front of you? I can help you look.
Yes, it has two times.
Just add the numbers together. Is it a word problem or just numbers?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is very loud today. What should I do?
Put on a warm jacket and close your windows. Is it blowing hard outside?
Yes, it is very cold. Do you know why the wind is so strong?
I am not sure of the exact reason, but it often happens when storm clouds are near. Does the sky look dark to you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sun feels very hot today. I do not know if I should go outside or stay inside.
It is best to wear a hat if you go out. Do you have a hat nearby?
I have a hat, but it is a little too big for me. Should I wear it anyway?
Yes, a big hat is still good for your skin. Do you like the color of it?
It is red, and I think it looks silly. Maybe I should just sit in the shade?
Sitting in the shade is a very smart choice. Are you thirsty right now?
Yes, I am thirsty. I will go get some cold water.
That sounds like a perfect plan.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw my sister’s new baby today. It was so small!
That sounds cute! Is the baby sleeping or playing?
He was crying a lot. I gave him my toy bear and he stopped.
That was very kind of you. What color is the bear?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I walked for an hour today and feel so good.
That sounds wonderful. Do you like the walk?
Yes, the air feels fresh and my legs feel strong.
Fresh air is very nice.
I want to do this every day to stay healthy.
That is a great plan. Do you walk alone?
No, I walk with a friend and we talk a lot.
That sounds like fun.
I am happy to share my joy with you.
Thank you. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dog is very tired today.
Is he eating his food? That is good.
He is not eating. I am worried.
Let us see if he drinks water.
He is drinking water now.
That is a good sign. Is he warm to the touch?
He feels very warm.
I do not know for sure, but you should call a doctor.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the big clock. It is one o'clock.
That is a nice time. Do you like one o'clock?
Yes. I feel very happy today.
I am glad for you. Why are you happy?
The sun is bright. It is warm.
Sunshine is good. Do you feel warm too?
Yes. The time is just right for me.
I agree with you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look at the water and feel sad. I do not know what to do.
The sea is big and can feel scary. Do you want to just sit and watch the waves?
Sitting feels boring. I want to touch the water, but I am afraid of the cold.
Cold water wakes up your body. Are you happy when you touch it?
Yes, it makes me feel alive. But I am still not sure if I should step in.
You can just put one foot in first. That is a small start.
One foot is easy. I think I will try it now.
That sounds like a good plan. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I cannot find my bread.
That feels bad. Did you look in the fridge?
No, I just looked on the table.
The fridge is a good place to check. Do you like crusty or soft bread?
I like soft bread, but I am still angry.
It is okay to feel angry. Let us go ask the baker together.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. My bird is gone.
That feels very bad. Did you see where it flew?
No, it just vanished.
Birds like to hide in the bushes.
I looked in the bushes. Nothing there.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you see any other birds?
Just a sparrow. It looks lonely too.
The sparrow might make a new friend soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Robots can do many things. Which one helps people the most?
I think medical robots help the most because they can fix broken bodies. Do you like robots that help at home?
Yes, but I am afraid of the ones that look like humans. How can I stop being scared?
Try to see them as tools, like a hammer or a broom. They do not have feelings. Do you want to read a book about them?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did very well on my test today.
That is great news. What was the test about?
I feel so good about it.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do trees have big branches?
They grow up to help the leaves reach the sun. Do you like playing in tall trees?
Yes, I love sitting in them. But why are some leaves green and some brown?
Green leaves are making food for the tree. Brown leaves are getting old and ready to fall.
Is a tree alive? It does not move.
Yes, it is very much alive. It drinks water and breathes air all day long.
I think trees are magic. Do they talk to each other?
They do send signals through their roots underground. It is a quiet, secret way to help friends.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the snow white?
It looks white because the light bounces off it. Do you like playing in snow?
I do. Why does it freeze?
The air gets very cold. Do you eat snow?
No, my mom says it is bad for teeth. Why is ice slippery?
It slides because water makes it smooth. Do you have winter coats?
Yes, I have a blue one. Why is the sun cold?
I do not know why the sun feels cold to you. Do you feel warm inside?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It is so hot today. I tried to play outside, but the sun burned my nose.
That sounds painful. Do you like ice cream when it is this warm?
Yes, I ate two big scoops of chocolate. I feel much better now.
That is a good way to cool down.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Guess what? My wife had a baby boy today. He is so tiny and soft. I am so happy.
That is great news! How is your wife feeling?
She is tired but very happy. We are feeding him right now.
That is wonderful. He must be a quiet eater.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to be nice at dinner. What do I do?
Say please and thank you. Do you know how to wait for your turn?
I think I do. How should I speak?
Use a kind voice. Do you like eating slowly?
Yes, I like it. Is that all?
That is all I know.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, what is the score?
We are winning two to one. Are you watching from home?
Yes, but I must run now.
Go quickly. Did you see the last goal?
No, I missed it.
It was a great kick. I hope you catch the end.
I will try my best.
That is a good plan. Do you like red?
I do, but I must go.
Bye then. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Tell me how plants drink water fast.
They use tiny pipes in their stems to pull it up. Do you have a favorite plant?
No time for that. Does the water go to the leaves?
Yes, it travels all the way to the leaves. I do not know why, but I hope you make it on time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My chair leg is loose.
That sounds tricky. How tight is the screw?
I tried to turn it, but it will not move.
You can tap it gently with a hammer. Do you have one nearby?
Yes, I have a small hammer right here.
Great. Tap the screw head to loosen it. Did it start to move?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very tired when I work from my house.
That is hard. Do you take breaks to rest?
I think yes, but I am not sure how.
Stand up and stretch your arms. Do you have a nice spot for that?
I am also sad when I am alone.
I do not know your best fix. Do you call friends often?
No, I am too busy.
Please talk to one friend. It helps your heart.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I love sweet red apples.
That is a great choice. Do you like them with milk?
Yes, apples and milk taste good.
That sounds yummy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I had a scary dream and I want to learn how to fly.
That is a big dream. Do you like watching birds?
Yes, they fly so well. How can I make my body light?
You cannot fly like a bird. Do you like jumping rope?
I hate jumping rope. It is boring.
I do not know how to fly. Try sleeping with a warm blanket.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The sun is very hot today.
Yes, it is quite warm outside. Do you like the heat?
It feels like I am melting.
That is a silly way to say it. Are you feeling thirsty?
I want an ice cream.
That sounds like a fun idea. What kind do you want?
I want chocolate.
I do not know where to get it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in such a big rush. Do you have any time?
I have some time. Where are you going?
We are going to the park. Do you want to join us?
Yes, I would like that. What are you bringing to eat?
We have sandwiches and juice. Please come fast.
Okay, I will be there soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love working from home today.
That sounds nice. Do you like your new desk?
Yes, I do. I made my own coffee too.
You must taste good food. Is the coffee hot?
It is very warm. I feel calm and quiet here.
Calm is a good place to be. Do you have a plant to look at?
I have a big green plant by my window.
Plants are friends. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I dropped my food on the floor. Should I eat it?
No, do not eat it. Please throw it away. Are you hungry?
Yes, I am. What should I do now?
Go wash your hands first. Then pick a new snack. Do you like fruit?
I like apples. Is that polite?
Yes, apples are a good choice. Thank you for asking.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My new neighbors gave me some cookies today. They are so nice!
That sounds sweet! Do they live right next door?
Yes, just one house over. I feel very happy to have friends nearby.
Neighbors can be great friends. Is the coffee over there good?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my friends forgot my birthday.
I am sorry to hear that. Are you eating cake?
No, I cannot even eat my lunch.
That is hard. What do you like to do for fun?
I just want to go to bed.
Going to bed can help you feel better.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to thank someone for a gift.
You can smile and say "thank you" right away. Do you like receiving gifts?
Yes, I do. How do I hold a door for someone?
Hold the door open and wait for them to pass. Should I tell you how to say please?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to get for lunch.
The salad bar has fresh greens. Do you like cold food?
I am not sure. It is a very warm day.
A cold soup might be nice. Do you like tomato soup?
I guess so, but I am too tired to decide.
Just pick the red bowl. It is easy and true to your hunger.
Okay, I will try that.
That is a good plan. Have a nice meal.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My screen is dark and I am sad.
I am sorry. Do you see any lights?
No, there are no lights at all.
Try the plug. Is it tight?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The plane is going very high and the air feels thin.
That can feel weird. Do you like the view?
I am bored and my legs hurt.
I do not know how to fix that. Would you like a drink?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: It is so cloudy outside today.
Yes, the sky is very gray. Do you like the rain?
I think it will rain soon. Why is the air so heavy?
The air holds a lot of water. It feels thick. Is your house warm?
My house is warm and dry. Will the sun come out later?
I do not know for sure. Is your favorite game indoor?
Yes, I play board games inside. Do you have a fun book for me?
I have a story about a cat. Do you like cats?
I love cats. They are my best friends.
That is a good choice. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great goal to start. Do you like red laces or blue ones?
I like the red ones. Show me the first step.
Make a big loop with one end. Does it look like a bunny ear to you?
Yes, it looks like an ear. What do I do now?
Cross the other end over the first one. Do you feel the strings pulling tight?
Yes, they are tight. How do I finish it?
Pull tight and say the magic words.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My small boat is leaking. What do I do?
Please take it out of the water first. Is the hole in the bottom or on the side?
The hole is on the side. How can I stop it?
A piece of tape will help for now. Do you have any glue with you?
I have some glue. Is that enough?
It should work until you fix it for good. I do not know the best place to buy a proper patch.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What are mountains made of?
They are made of rocks and stone. Do you like rocks?
Yes, I do. Why are they so tall?
The earth pushes them up over many years. I do not know exactly how.
I see. Do they grow taller every year?
No, they mostly stay the same size. Do you live near a big hill?
No, I do not. Can snow stay on them all year?
Yes, snow can stay on the very top.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I can not ride my bike by myself.
That is okay. Do you like to ride in the park?
Yes, but I am scared of falling.
Falling is how we learn. Are you wearing a helmet?
Yes, I have my blue helmet on.
Good job. Try keeping your eyes up.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is school so hard sometimes?
Hard work can feel big, but it gets easier. Do you like reading?
Why do we learn math?
Math helps us count and solve problems. I do not know why you feel tired today.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to swim.
That is a great goal. Do you know how to float on your back?
Yes, I can float, but I sink when I kick my legs.
You must keep your body straight. Do you feel tired when you kick?
My legs get very tired quickly.
Kick small and fast, not big and slow. Do you have a pool nearby?
There is a pool at the park.
Go there with a friend for safety. Do you like the water?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn how to draw cats, but my lines look messy.
That is a common problem. Do you use a ruler?
No, I try to draw freehand.
Try tracing a picture first. This helps your hand move better.
I have a few old cartoons to trace.
Good idea. Does your local library have books on animals?
Yes, I can borrow them on weekends.
Great. Practice for ten minutes a day. Consistency is key.
I will start with the ears today.
That is a perfect place to start. You will do well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are there so many lights in the sky?
They are stars. Do you like looking at them?
I think they are just far away lights.
You are right, they are very, very far. Do you see the brightest one?
Yes, that big one over there.
That is a star, too. It is not the sun.
Are they all the same size?
No, some are big and some are small. Do you have a favorite one?
I like the one that looks like a eye.
That is a nice choice. Good night, little stargazer.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the moon. It is so bright and round tonight.
It is very pretty. Do you like looking up at the sky?
Yes, I love it. It makes me feel happy inside.
That is nice. The moon shines to give us light.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I can see the big trees going by so fast.
They look like green blur lines. Do you like watching them?
Yes, but my tummy is a little bit quiet and hungry.
That means you need a snack soon. Did you pack some cookies?
I have an apple and a little juice box too.
That sounds like a perfect train meal. You can eat whenever you are ready.
The wheels are going click click click very loud.
That is just the sound of the train moving. It feels like a big rumble, does it?
I think I am going to take a nap now on the seat.
Good idea to rest before we arrive. I will stay right here with you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a puddle jump?
You can jump in a small one safely. Do you have big boots on?
Yes, I have rubber boots. How high can I go?
Try a low hop first to keep your socks dry. Are your knees strong enough?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a paper plane?
Fold the paper in half first. Do you have a flat piece of paper?
Yes, I have one. What is the next step?
Make two diagonal folds to the center line. Do you want to test if it flies?
How do I throw it?
Toss it gently with a level arm. Does it go straight for you?
It flew very well. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Happy flying!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I need to pick a spot for my tent, but I have no idea where to go.
Look for flat ground that is dry. Do you like being close to the water?
I think I want to be near the lake, but I am worried about bugs.
Choose a spot with good air flow to keep bugs away. Would you like help finding a good spot?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love apples so much.
Apples are sweet and crisp. Do you like red or green ones?
I pick the red ones. They are so shiny.
That looks fun to do.
I want to share one with you.
Thank you. You are very kind.
Here, take a piece. It tastes great.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a shiny blue rock on the hill.
That is a lovely color. Where did you find it?
Near the big old oak tree.
I am glad you found it. You can keep it safe.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the bear sad in the story?
Yes, he is lonely. Do you think he will find a friend?
I think the rabbit will help him.
That is a kind thought. I do not know if it is true, but it sounds nice.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The city feels very loud today. Do you know why it is so noisy?
Yes, there are many cars and people. Do you like the busy sounds?
Not really. I want some quiet time. Is there a good place to sit?
There is a park with green grass. Do you want to go there?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the handlebar on the front?
It keeps you steady. Do you like to go fast?
Why do the wheels have spikes on the tire?
They grip the ground well. I do not know why some are smooth.
Why do I have to push the pedals?
Your legs make the bike move. Did you check your brakes?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which day is today.
Look at the clock. Do you remember what you did yesterday?
I went to school, but I forget the name of the day.
If you went to school, it is a week day. Are you thinking of Monday?
Maybe, but I am not sure.
That is okay. Do you have a school book with you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do trains make a loud sound?
The wheels rub on the metal tracks to keep moving. Do you like the sound?
Why do the tracks get so hot?
The friction from moving fast creates heat.
Why is the train always on time?
The drivers use special computer systems to guide them safely. Is this your first trip?
Why does the view move so fast?
We travel very quickly, so things blur together.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many days are in one week?
There are seven days. Do you like weekends?
What comes after Monday?
Tuesday comes after Monday. Is Tuesday your favorite day?
What is the last day of the week?
Sunday is usually the last day. I do not know what your week looks like. Do you start on Monday?
Thanks for helping me.
You are welcome. I am happy to help. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The fire is cold. How can I make it hotter?
Yes, you can add dry wood. Is the wood dry?
Yes, but it will not catch fire. What should I do?
Try using a small match to start it. Do you have matches?
I do not have matches. How else can I light it?
I do not know how to light a fire without a flame. Is there a box of matches nearby?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the city so loud?
The cars and people make a lot of sound. Do you like the noise?
Why do the cars go so fast?
People need to get to work quickly. I do not know why they go that fast.
Why are there so many lights?
The lights help people see at night. Do you like the bright lights?
Why do people look down?
They are looking at their phones. Do you have a phone?
Why is it so crowded?
Many people live and work here.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the sand wet?
Yes, it is wet where the waves hit. Do you like the water?
The water is cold.
Cold water can feel funny. Do you have a towel?
I want a big shell.
Big shells are fun to find.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie a boat to a dock.
That is a good thing to learn. Do you have a rope ready?
Yes, I have a thick blue rope here.
Great. Hold the end and wrap it around the post twice.
I wrapped it. What do I do next?
Now pull it tight. Is the boat still floating?
Yes, it looks very safe.
Good job. Do you want to tie a different knot?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I love kicking the ball around the yard.
That sounds like so much fun. What is your favorite part of playing?
I like running really fast to catch it.
Running is a great way to stay healthy and happy. Do you play with other kids too?
Yes, my neighbor plays with me sometimes.
Having a friend to play with makes it even better.
Do you like football too?
I cannot play, but I think it is a very exciting game to watch.
I want to be a big star one day.
That is a wonderful goal to have. I hope you have lots of fun trying.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The streets here are so full of people.
It is very busy today. Do you like the loud noise?
I want to learn how to cross the street safely.
You must wait for the light to turn green. Is the traffic light red right now?
What should I do if the cars do not stop?
Step back and wait for them to pass. Do you see a zebra crossing nearby?
I know what to do now.
Good job. You are safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my new cup.
Oh no. Did you mean to do that?
No. I slipped.
Slips happen. Do you feel sad?
Yes. I want to feel better.
Time helps. Are you okay now?
I think so.
Good. You are fine.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I made a plan.
That is great news. What did you plan?
I want to build a birdhouse in the yard.
How lovely that is. Do you have the wood?
Yes, I found some old planks by the shed.
That sounds fun. Will you help with the nails?
I hope so. I am ready to start.
You seem ready. Good luck with the build.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at this stain.
I am sorry that made you feel that way.
It just will not come out.
Did you try washing it in warm water?
Yes, I tried everything.
I do not know for sure what happened.
I really need this shirt clean.
Let us try a gentle soap next.
Okay, but it is getting dark.
We can take our time.
I hope it works this time.
Do you have any spare towels?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The cake was tall and white. It had blue flowers on top.
That sounds sweet. Did you cut it first?
No, the bride cut the first piece. We all ate it together.
What a happy end to your day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very worried about tomorrow. What can I do?
Deep breaths help. Are you eating well today?
I do not know if that works. Do you feel worry sometimes?
Yes, I do. It passes with time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a hidden box in the wall. It feels wrong to look inside.
That is a scary feeling. Did you open it yet?
No, I am scared. But I want to know what is in there.
Being brave is good. Do you trust your gut?
I think I should tell my dad. But he might be mad.
He may be surprised first. Are you sure he would be angry?
Maybe. I just do not want to break the rule.
Honesty is usually best. How does the box make you feel?
It makes me feel heavy. I think I will go to him now.
That is a good choice. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love looking at the tall mountains. They feel very big and strong.
They are indeed very old and sturdy. Do you like how they touch the clouds?
The air up there is so clean and cold. It makes me feel alive.
That fresh air is good for your body. What color is the snow on top?
It is bright white and shines in the sun. I wish I could live there.
It is a beautiful place to rest your mind.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I am so late. Why did this happen?
I overslept my alarm. Are you hungry?
I forgot to eat breakfast. Did you check the bus?
The bus is still coming. Do you have a map?
I have my phone. It is not working.
I can walk with you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which shoes to buy.
What color do you like best? Do you want them for sports?
I like blue, but I only walk in them.
Blue walking shoes are a great pick. Do you have a favorite size?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a meeting soon but I feel lost.
That feels bad. Do you have the main goal in mind?
Not really, it just feels like a blur.
Let us find that goal together.
I do not know how to start.
Start with one small step.
What is the first step?
Ask who needs to be there.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It rained all day today. I felt a bit sad inside.
That sounds lonely. Do you like to watch the rain?
Yes, I watched it hit the ground. It made a nice drum sound.
Rain can be very calming. What did you do while you watched?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The wind is blowing so loud outside.
It sounds like a big storm is coming. Are you safe inside?
Yes, I am in my room with the lights on.
That is a good place to be. Do you see the rain on the window?
I see big drops hitting the glass.
That means the rain is falling hard.
I think the trees are bending over.
The strong wind pushes them down. Do you hear any loud banging?
No, just a low humming sound.
That is likely the wind moving through the house.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just painted a big red sun. It makes me feel very warm and happy.
That sounds lovely. What color did you use for the sky?
I used blue. Do you like painting too?
I love the idea of creating art.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the island so round?
Water pushes on it from every side. Do you like round things?
Yes. Why is the sand soft?
Wind grinds the rock into tiny bits. Is the sand hot?
It is warm. Why is the water blue?
The light changes color in the water. I do not know why it is not green.
I see. Why are there no trees on the beach?
The salt is too strong for them. Do you plant anything?
I plant seeds. Why does the sea pull the sand back?
Tides move the water in and out. Is that scary?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a red apple, but I am not sure what to do with it.
Do you like sweet things? You could eat it or make a pie.
I think I want to eat it, but I do not know how to start.
Just take a bite. Is it sweet?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: The lights just went out. Why did that happen?
I do not know for sure, but the storm is very loud outside. Is your house okay?
Yes, it is quiet inside. Do you know when the power will come back?
I hope it comes back soon, but I have no time to tell you. Are you scared of the dark?
Not really, but it is a bit scary. Should I turn on a lamp?
That is a very good idea, yes. Please stay safe and warm.
Okay, I will sit by the window. Do you think it will last all night?
I hope not, but we will just have to wait and see. How do you feel now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a nice spot for lunch today.
That sounds fun. Did you like the food?
The soup was very warm and tasty.
Oh good. Was the soup hot?
Yes, it almost burned my tongue.
Ouch, I am sorry. Did you eat slowly?
I tried, but it was too yummy.
Yummy is a good reason to hurry.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I put seeds in the dirt but they will not grow. What do I need?
Most seeds need sun and water. Do you check if the soil is dry?
Yes, I water them every day in a dark corner. Is that bad?
Dark spots are hard for most plants to see. Do you have a sunny window nearby?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. This takes too long.
I hear you. It is hard to wait. What are you waiting for?
My tea is not hot yet. I hate waiting.
I do not know if it is hot. Do you like to drink it warm?
Yes, but I want it now. Go away.
I am here if you need me.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to look for good fruit.
The red apples are right over there. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I love sweet things, but I am lost in the crowd.
Follow the sign with the orange on it. Is it very busy today?
It is, and I feel small in all this noise.
Just pick one apple and take a deep breath. Can you see the sign?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I put my king next to the enemy king. Is that okay?
No, you can never put your kings next to each other. Do you know why that is a bad move?
I think it is because they might hurt each other.
That is a good guess, but they are actually too close to be safe. Do you see how the enemy king can just take your piece?
Oh no, I see that. What do I do now?
Move your king away to a safer square. Where do you think is a good place to go?
Maybe here, behind my pawns.
Yes, that is a very smart spot to hide. You are doing a great job with your game.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. How do I make it to work fast?
You should run a little. Do you have a bike nearby?
No bike. Just my legs. I feel stuck.
Take the main road. It is usually clear. Is it raining?
No rain. Just slow cars. I miss my bus.
Check your phone for a taxi. Do you have enough money?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very happy when I finish my work.
That is a great feeling. What made you do that work?
I fixed the broken toy on my shelf.
You must be proud of your hands. Do you like fixing things?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What do tigers eat?
Tigers eat meat. Do you like meat?
Yes, I like it.
That is good. Some tigers live in warm places.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do my legs hurt after I run?
They hurt because your muscles are getting stronger. Do you drink water after you run?
Yes, I drink a lot of water. How can I make the hurt stop?
Rest is the best cure. Do you sleep well at night?
I sleep, but I still feel tired. Is there a magic trick to fix it?
No magic, just time and kindness to your body. I do not know the exact secret, but patience works.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I missed the bus this morning because my cat sat on my shoes.
Oh no, that is very tricky. Did you run to the stop?
Yes, I ran fast, but the bus was already gone.
That must feel frustrating. Did you wait for the next one?
I had to wait twenty minutes in the cold rain.
You are brave for staying dry. Do you carry an umbrella with you?
I forgot it, so I got a little wet, but I made it to work.
Good for you for finishing the day. How are you feeling now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did you promise to help me?
Because I like you and want you to be happy. Do you think that is a good reason?
I think so, but why must I keep my part?
Keeping your word makes us trust each other more. Is that hard for you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke my friend's cup and I feel very bad.
That is a good feeling to have. Can you tell me how it broke?
I dropped it on the hard floor and it smashed.
Ouch, that must have been scary to hear. Do you want to say sorry to them?
Yes, I want to say sorry, but I do not know what to say.
You can just say you are sorry for breaking it. Do you want to bring them a small gift?
Yes, I have a sticker I can give them.
That is a sweet idea. Go tell them now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found an old coin on the sidewalk today. It was dirty and green.
That sounds like a small treasure. Did you keep it?
Yes, I put it in my pocket. My dad says it might be from a long time ago.
That is a fun thing to learn. Does it have a date on the back?
No, it is too smudged to see anything. I think I will take it to the museum tomorrow.
A wise choice for learning its story. I hope they can help you find out its age.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I won a chess game today! It felt so good.
That is great news. Which piece did you use to win?
I used my king to trap his queen.
Clever move. Does that make you want to play again?
Yes, I love it when I feel smart.
That is a happy feeling.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to eat food, but I feel sick.
Try some clear soup. Do you like the taste of salt?
Yes, I do. Can I drink coffee?
No, coffee is bad for you now. Are you very thirsty?
I am not thirsty, just hungry.
Eat a small piece of bread. It is safe and soft.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a big boat on the lake today. What does it do?
It carries people and things across the water. Do you like riding in boats?
I like seeing them, but I get dizzy. Is that normal?
Yes, many people feel that way. Maybe try looking at the horizon next time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the lights stay on all night?
They use electricity to make light. Do you like to read in the dark?
No, I like the dark. But why does it buzz sometimes?
The wires get hot and make a small sound. It is like a hum. Do you hear it often?
Yes, in my room. Is it bad?
A little buzz is usually fine, but tell a grown-up. Do you trust me?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to say to my teacher.
Tell her the truth about your feelings. Is it hard to talk to her?
Yes, I am afraid of making her sad.
She will likely be glad you are honest. Do you want to practice first?
I think I should just be nice and tell her.
That sounds like a kind choice. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes. Can you show me?
Of course! Do you have a tight knot in your hands?
Yes, I do. What do I do next?
Make a loop with one lace, like a bunny ear.
Okay, I made a bunny ear. Now what?
Wrap the other lace around the first one and pull tight.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need help planning my big day. Where do I start?
First, you need to pick a date. Do you have a favorite season in mind?
I like the warm months. What about the guests?
Write down your closest friends and family. It is hard to know the cost of food.
That seems like a lot of work. Is it truly that hard?
It can feel big, but take it one small step at a time. Are you scared of the cost?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a small tree by the road. It looks sad.
Does it have dry leaves?
Yes, the leaves are brown and falling.
That is not good. I do not know if it is sick or just tired.
I am not sure what to do. Should I cut it?
No, do not cut it. Water it gently. Do you have a bucket?
I have a big green bucket.
That is a good tool. Use cool water.
I will pour some on the roots.
Yes, go for it. Tell me if it stays green.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have dirty clothes and I do not know how to wash them.
Put the clothes in the machine with soap and water. Do you use cold or hot water?
I think I should use hot water to kill the germs.
Yes, that is good for very dirty clothes. Are the colors bright or dark?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because the months are changing!
That is good news. What month do you like best?
I love June because the days are long and warm.
Long days sound nice. Do you swim in June?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My cat will not eat. What do I do?
Is she acting tired or sick? If yes, please call a vet.
She is just sleepy. I do not know if that is bad.
Sleep is normal for cats. Give her a little time to rest.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the pool today. The water was very cold.
That sounds chilly. Did you swim for a long time?
No, I only stayed in for five minutes. My toes felt numb.
I see. I do not know if five minutes is a record, but it is safe. How did the rest of your day go?
It was good. I ate warm soup after I got out.
Warm soup sounds nice. I am glad you had a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to count.
That is a great skill. Do you like numbers?
Yes, I do like them.
Start with one. Can you show me one finger?
Yes, I can.
Now add one more. How many fingers do you have now?
I have two.
Well done. Just keep adding one each time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must run. Where is the quiet street?
It is down this way. Are you going to the park?
No, I need to hurry. Which way is it?
It is right there. Do you see the blue door?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was bright today and I felt very warm.
That sounds nice. Did you play outside?
I saw a big red kite fly high in the blue sky.
That is a beautiful picture in my mind.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I met a new friend today. I feel very happy.
That is wonderful news. How does he like to play?
He likes to ride bikes in the park. I want to join him next week.
Riding bikes is great fun. Do you have a helmet for safety?
Yes, I have a blue one. I feel a bit nervous, though.
It is normal to feel nervous at first. You will be fine.
Thanks, I think I will be brave.
You will do great. Have a nice ride!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what day it is.
Do you know how many days are in a week?
I think there are seven.
Yes, you are right. Do you like weekends?
I like to sleep on Saturday.
That sounds nice. Is Monday your least favorite day?
Monday feels long and hard.
I am sorry to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw the big blue lake today.
That sounds nice. Did you see any fish?
No, but I saw a duck.
A duck is a fun friend. Was it calm?
It was very quiet and cold.
Quiet places help us rest. Did you sit down?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a circle today and I am so happy!
Circles are smooth and round. Did you find it in the park?
Yes, I found it under a big tree. I love it so much.
That sounds like a lovely find.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do you see the blue bird?
I see it by the bush. Do you like blue birds?
I have to run.
Take care. Do you have a garden at home?
No, just a balcony.
That is fine too.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my favorite red marble and I am very sad.
That sounds rough. Do you remember where you last saw it?
I think it was in the box, but now it is gone.
We can look in the box again. Would you like to help?
Yes, please, but I am still angry.
It is okay to feel that way. Let us find it together.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts so much right now.
I am sorry you feel bad. Did you get enough rest last night?
No, I stayed up late reading books.
That can make you tired. Drink some water and sit down.
I tried, but it still throbs.
You can try a cool cloth on your head. Does that help?
It feels a bit better, thank you.
I am glad it helps. Get some sleep now.
Okay, I will go to bed.
That is a good plan. Good night.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my dog shake his whole body after swimming?
He shakes to dry off the water so he does not get cold. Do you help him dry with a towel?
He also likes to chew on my old shoes. Why?
Dogs chew things because their teeth grow all the time. Does he have other toys to chew on?
My dog sometimes lies on the back of the sofa. I do not know why he does that.
I do not know for sure, but he may just like a soft place to rest.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I found a bug in my house and it makes me feel very sad.
Oh no, I am sorry you feel that way. Do you know what kind of bug it was?
I think it was just a little beetle.
Beets are usually harmless and just look for food. Do you want help learning how to move it outside safely?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the little hand move so slowly?
It takes a whole hour for that hand to tick around once. Do you like watching the hands spin?
I see a thin hand too. What is that for?
That one counts the seconds, which are tiny bits of time. Do you wonder how fast it goes?
Does the clock know what time it is?
I do not know if it thinks about time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the dinosaur hall open today?
Yes, it is open until five. Do you like big lizards?
I love them. Where is the hall?
Go straight and turn left. It is easy to find.
What else is in that wing?
There are old bones and a lab. Is that all you wanted to ask?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now. I just sat in the chair and felt good.
That feels nice. What made you feel that way?
I was waiting for my friend to call me.
Oh, that is a good kind of wait. Did they call?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a circle with a ruler?
You cannot use a straight ruler for a round shape. Do you have a compass?
No, but I have a jar lid.
You can trace around the bottom of the lid with a pencil. Is your pencil sharp?
Yes, it is sharp.
Place the lid on your paper and press down firmly. Do you have any glue?
I have some glue and a piece of red paper.
Cut along your line with scissors to get a red circle. Are you excited to see the shape?
Yes, I can already see the red ring.
Great work, you made a perfect circle. Tell me, what will you do with it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so hungry today.
Oh no. Did you lose your lunch?
I found it in my bag. It was cold.
That is not nice. Did you get it warm?
Yes. I put it in the hot box.
Smart move. How does it taste now?
It tastes good. Thank you.
I am glad you are eating.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to go to the sea, but I do not know what to do there.
You can just sit and watch the waves roll in. Do you like the sound of the water?
I am not sure, but I feel a bit lost.
That is okay, sometimes not knowing is fine. Would you like to try walking in the sand?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My tummy hurts a lot.
I am sorry you feel sick. Is it a sharp pain?
Yes, it feels like a pinch.
That is important to tell the doctor. Do you have a fever too?
No, I feel cold but not hot.
That helps us know what to check. Let us go see the doctor now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost and do not know where to put my tent.
Look for flat ground near a tree. Do you see any flat spots?
Yes, but I am scared of the dark woods.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you like warm drinks?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix the leak in my boat right now.
Is the water coming in from the bottom?
Yes, it is dripping into the floor.
I do not know the exact fix, but try plugging the hole. Do you have any tape?
I have tape, but it is wet and stuck together.
That will not work well. Please let me check the outside for a better spot.
There is a hole near the seat.
Is that hole small enough for a patch?
It is the size of a coin.
Good, a patch should hold it. Tie a rope around it tight before you go.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I tried again and it worked. I am so happy to tell you.
That is great news. What did you do that time?
I just kept going. It felt good.
You showed great strength. How does it feel now?
I feel light and strong. I like this feeling.
That is a wonderful feeling. Are you proud of yourself?
Yes, I am very proud. Thank you for listening.
I am glad you shared it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: The lights went out. Why is this happening?
I am not sure exactly. Are your candles lit?
Yes, they are. Is it a big storm?
It might be a storm. Is it raining outside?
No, the sky is clear. Did the wires break?
That is possible. I will check the system now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very scared about tomorrow. What can I do?
It is okay to feel scared. What makes you worry?
I think I will fail the test. Can you help me?
I do not know if you will fail, but you are ready. Do you like reading?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My rose dropped all its petals. I feel so sad about it.
That is very sad. Did it fall in the wind?
No, it just gave up and fell off the branch.
Flowers do that when they are tired. Do you have any seeds to plant?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My boss gave me a big hug when I had a bad day.
That is very nice of them. Do they do that often?
I want to thank them, but I feel shy.
Just tell them you felt happy. Did you say good morning to them?
I was not sure what to say.
You can simply say it was a warm moment. Did they smile at you?
I think I will write a small note.
That is a great idea. Do you like writing notes?
Yes, I think they will like it.
I hope they do. Have a good day at work.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to start a new hobby, but I do not know what to pick.
That is a big choice. Do you like to make things with your hands?
Not really. I prefer to just watch or listen to things.
I see. Do you enjoy listening to music or stories?
I love music, but I am not sure where to begin.
Start with a song you already like and look for similar ones.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is the internet?
It is like a giant web that connects all the computers in the world. Do you have a computer at home?
Yes, we do. How do I find pictures of dogs on it?
You can use a search box to type in "dog pictures". Do you like big dogs or small ones?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited for my tea to stop steaming, but it was too hot. I did not want to ruin the mug.
That took great care. Did you finally get a sip?
I let it cool for five minutes. It was still warm, but I could taste the sweet honey.
Sweet honey sounds nice. How did it feel after all that waiting?
It felt like a small win. I did not get mad or spill it.
You were very strong today.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sky looks very gray. Do you know if it will rain later?
I am not sure about the exact time. Do you have an umbrella with you?
No, I do not. Should I stay inside to be safe?
Yes, staying in is a good choice. It is better to wait for the sun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad about my walk.
I am sorry to hear that. What made you feel this way?
The bench was wet and cold.
That is not nice at all. Did you find another spot to sit?
No, I just stood there.
Standing can be tiring. Did you move to a dry place?
Yes, but I still feel gloomy.
That is okay. Feelings take time to change.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my dog stop barking at the door?
That can be very loud. Do you teach him other tricks?
I can sit him, but the barking is hard.
Try giving him a treat for being quiet. It works well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to help my friend.
That is very nice of you. Do you know what she needs?
She is sad and hungry.
You can share your snack with her.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Where is my box?
It is by the door. Are you packing all day?
Yes, I have no time. Do you know the truck time?
I do not know. Is the driver here yet?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to float on my back.
That is a fun skill. Do you know how to kick your legs?
I can kick, but I fall over.
Keep your face in the sky and your ears in the water. Are you ready to try?
I tried, but my arms felt heavy.
Just let your arms rest by your sides. Do you feel safe in the pool?
Yes, the water feels calm.
Great. Take a deep breath and stay still. Did you stay up for a second?
Yes, I did it!
Well done. You are ready to float.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: Why is the sky blue? I am so confused and do not know what to do.
The light from the sun breaks into colors. The sky sends the blue part back to our eyes. Do you see blue things around you?
I see some, but I still feel lost.
Do not worry, you are doing fine. Take a deep breath and look up.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My chair leg feels loose. How do I fix it?
Try tightening the screw on the top of the leg. Is your screwdriver a fit for that hole?
Yes, I have the right tool. It is still wobbly after I tightened it.
You may need new glue or a wedge. Do you have any wood glue?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sand was very hot today, so I built a quick castle in the cool wet spot near the water.
That sounds like a smart and cool place to build. Did you use a bucket for the walls?
Yes, I used a red bucket, but then a big wave came in and washed my castle away.
Oh no, waves are powerful. Do you like it when the water comes in?
I do not like losing my castle, but I do love how the water moves and sparkles.
It is fun to watch the water move.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am moving my home today. It is very hard work.
That sounds like a big job. Do you have a truck?
Yes, I have a blue truck. I loaded it with books and cups.
Good for you. Are you tired yet?
My back hurts a little. I also broke a small plate.
I am sorry about the plate. Did you hurt your hand?
No, my hand is fine. I feel a bit sad now.
It is normal to feel sad. Do you have your cat with you?
Yes, the cat is in a box. I am happy to be here.
That is a nice ending to your day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss the ocean. It feels so far away.
That is a heavy feeling. Do you miss the sound of the waves?
I did, but the beach was too crowded today.
Crowds can feel too loud for some people. Did you get to sit in the sand?
Not really, I just walked back and forth.
Walking is a good way to clear your head. I do not know why it felt wrong to you.
It just felt wrong and I feel sad now.
It is okay to feel sad about a bad trip. Maybe we can look at some sea pictures?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The boat looks very old to me. I do not know what I should do with it.
An old boat can be fixed. Do you like to work with your hands?
I think I might like to try. I am not sure how to start, though.
That is a good first step. I do not know how to fix it, but you can look for a guide online.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sun feels very hot today. Is it bad for my skin?
Yes, too much sun can hurt you. I recommend wearing a hat. Do you like hats?
I do, but my skin still gets red. What should I use to stop the burning?
You should use sun cream. It helps protect you. Do you have any at home?
I have some, but I forgot it. Should I go back inside now?
Yes, that is a good idea. You can rest in the shade.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today. I met my new neighbor.
That is a lovely feeling. Do you know their name?
Yes, she is kind and old. She gave me some cookies.
Neighbors sharing food is a warm sign. Are the cookies sweet?
They are very sweet and warm. I am glad to live here now.
It is good to have a friendly community. Have you said thank you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My boss gave me a warm blanket when I was cold.
That is so sweet. Did you say thank you?
Yes, I said thank you, but I feel shy.
Being shy is normal. What is hard for you?
I want to be like my boss, but I feel nervous.
Start with a small smile. Do you want to try that?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke the red cup on the table. I feel bad.
It is okay to feel bad. Was it an accident?
Yes, my hand slipped. I am truly sorry for breaking it.
Thank you for telling me the truth. I love that you tried your best.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the wind. It blew my hat away.
That sounds very frustrating. Do you still have your hat on?
No. And now my hair is all messy.
I am sorry your hair is in a tangle. Do you have a comb with you?
I do not. I just feel sad.
It is okay to feel sad. Do you want to sit on a bench?
Yes. Please.
We can sit here for a bit. Do you like this spot?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went outside to play and found a big pile of white snow. I made a round snowball and threw it at a tree.
That sounds like such a fun day for you. Did you hit the tree?
Yes, I did, but then I started to slip on the ice. It was very cold and my hands were red.
Oh no, I am sorry you slipped. Do you have warm gloves to wear next time?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go on a picnic. What should I bring?
I suggest a big blanket and some cold drinks. Do you like hot dogs?
Yes, I love them. Is it safe to eat food outside?
It is safe if you keep flies away. Do you have a bag for trash?
I do not know. How do I pick a good spot?
Choose a place with trees for shade.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my stamp.
That feels bad. Do you have the bill?
It is in my bag.
Good. The clerk can fix it.
I hate to wait.
I know. What is in your mail?
Just a letter.
Okay. Let us go.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very lost about where to sleep.
Try a spot near a tree for shade. Do you have a tent?
I have a tent, but I do not know how to build it.
Read the small words on the box first. Did you check the poles?
The poles are here, but the ground looks too wet.
Move a little further up the hill then. Is it dry there?
It looks dry, but I still feel unsure about the rest of the trip.
Take one step at a time and enjoy the air. What is your main worry now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very heavy and sad.
That sounds hard. Are you just tired?
Yes, but it feels like a big weight.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to rest now?
I do not know how to stop feeling this way.
I do not know the perfect fix. Is there a quiet spot you like?
Yes, my bed.
That is a good place to sleep.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My neighbor is very loud at night. What can I do?
That sounds tiring. Do you know who he is?
He plays music late. I want to be nice but I need sleep.
Tell him you care, but ask for quiet hours. Have you tried saying hello first?
I am scared to talk to him. What if he gets mad?
Most people are kind if you are calm. Do you want to practice what to say?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I had a scary dream last night and I feel sad about it.
That sounds rough. Did you dream about falling?
Yes, I fell off a cliff. What should I do now?
Drink some water and take a deep breath. It was just a dream.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a shape with four sides. I do not know what it is.
A square has four equal sides. Are your sides all the same length?
No, two are long and two are short.
That sounds like a rectangle. Do you have any lines inside it?
I think it has a line right in the middle.
I do not know for sure what that line means.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are flowers so pretty?
I think they look nice to help bees find food. Do you like the smells too?
Yes, I love the smells. Why do some smell sweet?
The sweet smell brings bugs to help make seeds. Do you know how seeds start a new plant?
I do not know. Why do plants need seeds?
I am not sure of the whole magic, but seeds grow into new plants. Do you want to plant one?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I made a new friend today.
That sounds fun. What is their name?
I do not know.
That is okay. Did they like you?
Yes, we played together.
Good for you. How was the game?
It was very loud.
Loud can be exciting.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to draw a horse.
First, draw a big circle for the body. Do you like horses?
Yes, I do. What do I do next?
Add four long lines for the legs.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red rose in the yard today.
That is a nice flower. Did you pick it?
No, I just looked at it. It smelled so good.
Roses do smell sweet. What color were the leaves?
They were green and smooth. I touched one leaf.
That sounds fun. Did you tell anyone?
I showed my cat, but she ran away.
She likely did not like the smell. Was she scared?
Yes, she hissed a little. Then I went inside.
That is a safe choice. Do you have other plants?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go fast. Do I still have time to walk for my health?
Yes, a short walk helps. Do you like walking in the park?
I do not have time for a park. I have a meeting.
You can walk to the meeting. Is your meeting close?
It is right next door.
Then you can walk there slowly. Do you like moving your legs?
I hate moving my legs when I am late.
It keeps your heart happy. How many minutes do you have left?
Only five minutes.
A five minute walk is good. Are you feeling tired today?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is there a box on the table?
It holds a gift for you. Do you like surprises?
What is inside the box?
I do not know. Can you open it now?
Why did you get this?
To make you smile. Are you happy?
I really like it.
That is good.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a new watch. I do not know how to read it.
That is a nice watch. Do you know which hand is short?
The short hand is for hours. The long one is for minutes.
Yes, that is true. What time is it for you now?
It is past noon, but I am not sure by how much.
Please look at the big numbers. Can you see where the hands point?
The short hand is near one. The long hand is on the six.
That means it is half past one. Would you like to try again?
Half past one. Thank you for helping me read the time.
You are welcome. Do you want to tell me the time again?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are these shoes so shiny?
The light hits them hard. Do you like the color?
Why do they feel soft inside?
It has a thick pad for your foot. Do you want to try them on?
Why is this one heavier?
It has a thicker sole for grip. I am not sure if it fits your size.
Why should I buy the lighter ones?
They will tire your feet less. What do you think?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do plants drink?
They pull water up from their roots. Do you know where roots live?
Yes, in the dirt. Why do they pull it up?
The leaves make a tiny suction. Does that sound like a straw?
Yes, like a straw. But why is that the way they do it?
I do not know the deep reason for that design.
Okay. Do they drink all day long?
Mostly, yes, to keep themselves fresh. Do you like fresh things?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to run, but my legs hurt.
Do you walk before you run?
I usually just try to start fast.
Start slow and walk first. That is true for many people.
So I should take my time?
Yes, take your time. How far do you want to go?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big bird with a long neck at the zoo. Was that a flamingo?
No, that is likely an ostrich. Do you like to watch birds?
Ostriches are cool. Do they run fast?
Yes, they run very fast. Do you like to run too?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I am packing my bag for a trip.
That is great news. Where are you going?
I do not know exactly, but I am very excited.
Excitement is a good sign. What did you pack first?
My favorite red socks and a small book.
Those are good choices. Do you have any snacks?
Yes, I have some cookies and a big apple.
That sounds tasty. I hope you have a wonderful time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I just finished reading a story about a paper airplane. I want to make one that flies far. Can you tell me how?
Yes, you take a square of paper and fold it in half to make a sharp tip. Do you have a blank sheet of paper right now?
I do, but I always forget which way to fold the corners. Can you show me the shape?
I cannot see you, but I know the trick. Fold the top corners down to the middle line to make a triangle. Then, fold the edges in again to make it thin. Did you manage to get the first fold right?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to paint pictures of cats. Do they like milk?
Many cats like it, but some get sick from it. Do you have a real cat?
No, I just watch videos of them. What do I need to start?
You need paint, a brush, and paper. Do you have any colors you love?
I love red and blue. Can I mix them?
Yes, they make purple. Do you want to try that?
I think I will. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome. Have fun painting.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to eat better, but I do not know what to pick.
Try adding a green vegetable to your plate. Do you like carrots or peas?
I am not sure. The food list is very long.
Pick one thing you enjoy. It is better to like the food than to force it.
Okay, I will try that.
That is a good start. What is your favorite fruit?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you know where the old boats are kept?
Yes, they are in the main hall. Do you like water?
I do, but I lost my ticket.
You can buy a new one at the front desk.
Is the museum open late today?
It closes at five o'clock. Are you hungry?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now. How do I wash these socks?
Put them in warm water and soap. Do they have any stains?
Yes, there is mud on one.
Rub it with a little soap and let it sit for a minute.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to knit.
Knitting is fun and easy to start. Do you have some wool?
No, I do not have any wool yet.
You can buy red or blue yarn at the store. What color do you like best?
I like red because it is bright.
Red looks nice on a scarf. Do you have needles?
No, I only have my hands.
You will need two wooden sticks. Do you have wood at home?
Yes, I have some wood in the yard.
You can cut them into small sticks. Do you want help making them?
Yes, please help me cut them.
Hold the wood tight and safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Can you tell me the start?
Yes. Put the white pawns on the fourth row. Do you know the squares?
I do. Which piece moves first?
White moves first. Why do you look so worried?
I want to win now.
That is a good wish. Can you count to ten?
Yes. What do I do?
Take your time. Have fun playing.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see smoke from my kitchen. How do I put out a small grease fire?
Turn off the heat and cover the pan with a lid to stop the air. Why did the oil get so hot?
The oil got hot because I was not watching it. What if the fire grows big?
Leave the room at once and call for help. Do you know where your fire extinguisher is?
Yes, it is on the wall by the door. Should I use it on the grease?
No, use a lid or baking soda first. Never throw water on it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel heavy when I pack my bag. Do you have any tricks?
Yes, put heavy books in the bottom. What else are you bringing?
Just a big box of snacks.
I do not know all the snacks. Are they easy to eat?
They are messy cookies.
Put them in a small bag. Do you have room for clothes?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a deer in the park today. I am so happy!
That is wonderful news. Did you see its little fawns too?
No, just the big one. It looked very calm and quiet.
Deer are indeed very peaceful animals. Do you like big cats as well?
I love lions, but I never get to see them up close.
Lions are wild and strong. It is true that you rarely see them outside a zoo.
Do you know if they sleep a lot? I am not sure.
Yes, they sleep for about twenty hours a day. Do you like sleeping for that long?
I think that sounds like a nice dream, but I am awake now.
I am glad you are awake to share this. It is a happy day for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to send a file to my boss right now.
Did you plug your computer into the power?
Yes, but the screen is dark.
Is the little light on your router on?
The lights are blinking, but I still have no internet.
I do not know why that is happening.
Please tell me a quick fix.
Try turning your router off and on.
That worked, thank you so much.
I am glad it worked.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Which month is next?
It is December. Are you going somewhere fun?
No, just work. Is there a month with a J in it?
Yes, January starts with J. Do you like long winter days?
I do not have time. What month comes after May?
That is June. Do you enjoy summer weather?
Please hurry. How many months are there?
There are twelve. Do you like counting numbers?
I must go now. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke the bowl. I feel so bad.
Oh no. Are you hurt?
No, but now I have no bowl. Dinner is ruined.
That sounds tough. What did you try to put in it?
Soup. I just wanted a warm meal.
A pot works fine too. Do you have a pot?
Yes, but it feels wrong. I am frustrated.
Anger is normal. Take a deep breath.
Okay. I think I can fix this.
You can do it. Let me know if you need help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I fixed my broken toy car today and it works again.
That is a great win. What did you do first to fix it?
I had to put in a new battery and tighten a screw.
You did a good job of working hard. Do you get to drive it outside now?
Yes, I am going to take it to the park later.
I hope you have fun. Tell me if the car keeps working well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing a song.
That is a nice goal to start. Do you like humming in your head?
Yes, but my voice sounds funny sometimes.
Funny voices are very common for new singers. What is the first song you picked?
It is a happy song about the sun.
The sun is a bright topic to sing about. Do you know the words to it yet?
I know some, but not all of them.
Let us practice the parts you know first. Would you like to try one line now?
Okay, I am ready to try.
Great, just breathe in and speak the words softly.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my cup. I am sad.
That is a shame. Do you have another cup?
No. I only had that one.
I am sorry to hear that. Would you like a cup of tea?
I want coffee, not tea.
I do not know if we have coffee. Did you try the tea?
The tea tastes bad to me.
I understand your feeling. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I like sugar.
Let us try the tea with sugar. It may taste better now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: It is sunny, so I want to plant a seed. How do I do that?
You dig a small hole in the dirt first. Do you have a trowel?
Yes, I have one. What should I do next?
Put the seed in the hole and cover it with dirt. Are you watering it?
I will water it later. Is that all I need to do?
Yes, just keep it moist. I hope it grows big.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to speak a new language.
That is a great goal. Which language do you like?
I want to learn Spanish.
Spanish is a lovely choice. Do you like music?
Yes, I love singing songs.
Singing helps you hear new words. Do you sing every day?
No, only on weekends.
Even a few minutes each day works well. You can start with simple words first.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad about this rain.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you usually like sunny days?
Yes, I hate the dark clouds.
I see. What makes you feel best when it rains?
Nothing helps really.
I get that. Would you like a warm drink?
No, I just want the sun.
I hope the sun comes back soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I got blue paint on my nose today.
That sounds funny. How did that happen?
I sneezed while holding a brush.
Oh no. Did you get paint on your shirt?
Yes, a big spot on the sleeve.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you like painting?
I love it, even when it makes a mess.
That is a good thing. What color is next?
I think I will try some yellow.
That sounds bright. Do you have the yellow out?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. The snow is too deep.
Careful where you step. Do you have warm boots?
Yes, I have boots. But the road is white.
That looks very cold. Is your car working?
My car is stuck. I need to move it.
Do not push it hard. Please tell me if you feel pain.
I do not feel pain. I just feel late.
Take a deep breath. Why is this trip so rushy?
I must catch a bus. The bus comes soon.
I hope you make it. Be safe on the ice.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go to the park for a picnic.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a blanket?
Yes, I have a red one.
Great. What are you eating?
I am eating a big sandwich.
Yummy. Will you share with me?
Maybe if you bring cookies.
Deal. Let us go now.
Okay, bye.
Goodbye. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do I feel so good today?
Happy feelings often come from a warm heart. Did you do something nice for someone?
I shared my toys with a friend.
Sharing is a great way to feel joy. How did your friend smile?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I looked at the clock this morning and saw the hands moving.
That is how clocks show us the time. Do you like watching them move?
Yes, I then made toast and ate it while checking the time.
