A good snack. What kind of toast did you have?
It was plain, and I had to leave early for work.
Leaving early is a smart way to start the day.
I came home late because my car broke down.
That sounds very bad. Is your car fixed now?
Yes, it is fine, and the clock shows it is almost dinner time.
I am glad your car is okay. Enjoy your dinner.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I can never tell what time it is on the big clock.
Look at the long hand first. Does it point to the twelve?
No, the long hand is down at the six.
That means it is half past the hour. What do you think the hour hand is near?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the apple red?
The sun makes it red. Do you like apples?
Why is the fish wet?
It lives in water. Do you like fish?
Why is the bread warm?
The oven made it hot. I do not know why it is so soft.
Why is the banana yellow?
It was green, but it ripened. Do you eat bananas?
Why is the market noisy?
Many people talk and laugh. Do you hear the birds?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a very tall mountain today. It made me feel so happy.
That is wonderful news. Do you plan to go up it?
Yes, I want to walk to the top with my friends.
What a great idea.
The air is thin up there, but the view is amazing.
I believe that is true. Do you have warm clothes?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a bug with a long tail in the garden. What is it?
That sounds like a damselfly. Do you like to look at their wings?
They look like tiny glasses. Do they eat flies?
Yes, they catch small bugs to eat. Do you know why they fly so fast?
I do not know why. They just zoom around.
They fly fast to stay safe from birds. You have good eyes for spotting them.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My horse has a long tail. Why does it need one?
It uses the tail to sweep away flies. Does your horse like when you brush it?
Yes, she really likes it. Does the tail feel soft to her?
Yes, the hair is very soft. What color is your horse?
She is brown with a white star on her face. Does the tail grow back if it gets cut?
Yes, it will grow back slowly. Is she a happy horse?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am stuck in a long line to buy ice cream.
That feels hard. Do you see the end of the line?
The line is very long and I am tired.
You are doing a good job waiting. Do you like strawberry?
Yes, I love strawberry ice cream.
That is a nice choice. I hope you get it soon.
The person in front of me is still talking.
It is not my place to guess why. Are you feeling angry?
A little, but I am being kind.
That is very patient of you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am not sure if the loud music next door is rude.
Is it playing at a bad time of day?
It is late night and very loud.
That sounds like a problem. Do you know who lives there?
I think it is a young man with a dog.
A dog might make extra noise. Have you tried talking to them first?
I am too shy to knock on their door.
It is okay to be shy. Would it help to bring a small gift?
A gift might make them stop the noise.
Yes, that is a kind idea. Good luck with the talk.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke my favorite cup. I want to fix it.
That is okay. Do you have any glue?
Yes, I have some glue. How do I use it?
Put a little bit on the edges. Did you wash the pieces?
Yes, they are clean. What do I do now?
Press the pieces together tight. Do you want to color it after?
Yes, I want to paint it.
Great job. I do not know the best paint, but you can try any color.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to buy new shoes. How do I know if they fit?
You should try them on and walk around the store. Is your foot wide or narrow?
My feet are a bit wide. What size do I need?
Start with your usual size, but check the heel. Does your heel slip out when you walk?
The heel stays in place. Should I buy them?
Yes, if they feel comfortable and not too tight. Do you like the color?
I love the color. Where do I go to pay?
Head to the counter at the front of the store. Would you like help finding the register?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy a toy but I do not know which one is good.
What kind of toy do you like?
I like small cars and trucks.
A fast red car is fun for many kids. Do you have any money saved?
I have ten dollars.
That buys a good plastic car. A small red truck is also a great choice.
Can I pay with coins?
Yes, most shops take coins. Do you have enough coins?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very happy but I do not know what to do with all this good feeling.
That is a lovely feeling to have. What is the first thing that makes you smile?
I think it is just the warm sun, but my hands feel empty and I want to make a memory.
You could go outside and catch some sunlight in your hands. Do you like walking or sitting in the grass?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the cake is gone.
I am sorry you are sad. Do you like chocolate?
Yes, I want a chocolate cupcake.
They do have chocolate cupcakes. Would you like one?
Is it big enough for me?
It is small, but sweet. Are you very hungry?
Yes, I am very hungry.
You can have two if you wish. Let me get them.
Thank you, you are kind.
You are welcome. I am glad you are happy now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the cold wind. It makes my favorite tree lose all its leaves. The branches look so bare and sad.
The tree drops leaves to save energy for the winter. Do you like looking at the colorful leaves on the ground?
I guess the red ones look pretty, but it still feels like the tree is giving up. Is it really resting or is it sleeping?
The tree is resting to save its strength for spring. Do you know what comes after winter?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My new fence looks crooked.
That is a common fix. Did you check the ground level?
The ground is flat.
Then the posts are likely not straight. Do you have a tool to fix this?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you know where the red shop is?
It is right there on the left. Are you buying a gift?
Yes, I forgot my keys. Can I get coffee here?
No, they sell only books. Do you have time to look?
I have five minutes left. Is the door open?
Yes, the door is open. Good luck with your run.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not like the green stuff in my bowl.
It is good for you to grow strong. Do you like the red stuff next to it?
Yes, I like the sweet red stuff.
Great, eat the red stuff first, and then try one bite of the green.
I will try the green stuff if I eat the red stuff first.
That is a smart plan. I am happy you are trying.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I like apples. How do I cut one?
You use a sharp knife to slice it. Do you like red or green apples?
I like red ones. What is the best way to eat them?
You can peel the skin first. That makes them very sweet.
I will try that today.
That sounds like fun. I hope you enjoy your snack.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sky is full of bright lights tonight. My dog ran in the grass all day, so he is very tired.
That sounds like a fun day. Do you see any shapes in the stars?
I see a big dipper and a bright red star near the ground. I feel happy looking up.
Red stars are quite rare. How are you feeling right now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
Bees take sweet plant nectar and put it in their hives. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I do. What happens next?
They fan air over the nectar to dry it. This turns it into honey.
That sounds hard work.
It is, but they work together as a team. Do you have a favorite bee fact?
I love that they dance to tell friends where food is.
Yes, those dances are very useful. It is a happy job for them.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Show me the blue line fast.
It goes straight up. Is your bag packed?
Yes. Where is the end of that line?
It stops at the park. Do you know the way there?
No. I cannot find it.
I do not know the rest. Be safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad because I wanted to fix my friend's toy but I broke it more.
I am sorry you are upset. Did you try to help with care?
Yes, I did, but now I feel like a total failure.
You tried your best, which is good. What does your friend think about the mess?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my first job. My shoes are not tight.
Take a deep breath. You can do this. What did you eat for breakfast?
I forgot to eat. I feel sick.
That is not good. Go buy a small snack now.
I do not have time. I am running.
Your health is first. Will you be okay?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a new friend today.
That is great news. What is their favorite color?
Their favorite color is red.
Red is a happy color. Do they like to play?
Yes, we played tag.
Tag is fun. I am glad you have a friend.
I like them very much.
That is wonderful. You will have a good time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a promise to be good today.
That is very good news. Why did you promise that?
I want to make my friend happy.
That is very kind of you. I am glad you are feeling happy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What day comes after Sunday?
Monday comes next. Do you like the start of the week?
Is Friday the day before the weekend?
Yes, Friday is the last work day. Do you have fun plans for Saturday?
How many days are in one week?
There are seven days in a week. Do you count them out loud?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I really like the book about the little blue dog.
That sounds nice. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, it is my favorite color.
I think blue is calm. What is the dog's name?
His name is Bix.
I do not know that book. Is he happy in the story?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so happy right now.
That is nice to hear. What made you feel this way?
I just need to leave quickly.
I am glad for you. Please go now.
Thanks a lot for your kind words.
You are welcome. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the red dot on this map?
It is near the big blue river. Are you trying to find the park?
Yes, but I do not see the blue river anywhere.
Look at the bottom corner. It is right there. Do you know how to get there?
I am still looking. Can you tell me the way?
Go left at the corner. Then walk straight. Is that clear enough?
No, I am very confused. What is the red dot?
I am not sure what it is. It might be the school. Why do you need to go there?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to pick shoes that fit well. How do I start?
Start by trying them on with the socks you usually wear. Do you have wide or narrow feet?
My feet feel tight in the front. Is that a bad sign?
Yes, your toes need room to move, so that shoe is too small.
How do I know if the heel fits?
Stand up and lift your heel. You should feel no gap. Do you feel a gap when you walk?
I feel a little gap. What should I do?
I do not know your exact foot shape, so you might need a different size or brand.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. This line moves so slow.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a snack with you?
No, I am hungry and tired.
That is hard. Do you want to sit for a bit?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a big secret. I am hiding a frog in my shoe.
That sounds fun. Why is it there?
It is cold outside and it needed a warm bed.
You are very kind.
Will you keep my secret?
I promise I will.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go here.
The park looks fun. Do you like to run?
I think I will try the park.
That sounds great. Have a nice time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is snowing hard. I do not know what to do.
You can just stay warm inside. Do you like to watch the snow?
Yes, I do. But I am bored now.
I do not know the perfect game for you. What is your favorite thing to do in the cold?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The wind is very loud outside. How can I stop my windows from shaking?
Put heavy books against them to help. Do you have any books nearby?
Yes, I have a stack of them. What if the power goes out?
Keep your lights off to save battery. Do you have a flashlight ready?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my bread flat?
It may need more time to rise. Did you use warm water?
Yes, it was warm.
Good. Warm water wakes up the yeast. Do you have a quiet spot?
Yes, on the counter.
Let it sit in that spot for an hour. Is the kitchen warm?
It is a bit cold.
Cold slows the yeast down. Move it near a lamp.
Will that help it grow?
Yes, heat makes it puff up.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to run, but my legs hurt.
That is a hard feeling. Do you rest your legs when they hurt?
I try, but I am not sure how to run right.
Take small steps at first. Do you like to run in the park?
Yes, I like the park, but I get very tired fast.
Tired is normal for new runners. Would you like to walk for a while first?
Walking sounds okay, but I want to be fast one day.
Being fast comes with time. Do you drink water before you run?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now because the sun is warm on my face.
That feels wonderful. Do you like how the leaves change color?
Yes, they look like bright coins on the ground.
What a lovely way to see it. I am glad you are feeling good.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the city so loud?
The cars and people make a lot of sound. Do you like the noise?
Not really, I prefer quiet places.
The park nearby is very calm. What do you do there?
I usually sit and read a book.
That is a nice thing to do. Do you like stories?
Yes, I love reading every day.
Reading is a great habit. Is your favorite book about animals?
No, it is about space.
Space is a big mystery. Do you look at the stars?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The river is muddy and smelly. I do not like it.
That sounds bad. Do you think it will clear up?
I wish it was clean and cool.
Clean water is much better. What do you usually do by the river?
We are not going. It feels wrong.
Trusting your feeling is wise. I do not know why it is muddy, but that is okay.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a clay pot. Can you help?
I can help you start. Do you have a wheel?
No, I do not. What else can I do?
You can pinch the clay with your hands. Is that okay for you?
Yes, I like that. How do I make it round?
Press the bottom down hard. Do you feel the soft spots?
I see them. How do I finish the shape?
Press the sides out. That is all.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a fun skill. Do you have laces in your pocket?
Yes, I do. Where do I start?
Make a loop with each side.
I made two loops. What now?
Cross one loop over the other.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my lunchbox on the floor today.
Oh no! Did you get hurt?
No, but my sandwich fell out.
That is a sad break. Did you clean it up?
My friend gave me half of hers.
That is very kind of her. How do you feel now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do shoes have laces?
Laces help keep your foot snug. Do you like tight or loose shoes?
I like tight. Why do they cost so much?
It takes time and hard work to make good shoes. Do you have enough money?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look up. The sky is full of stars tonight.
That is a very beautiful sight. Do you know why they twinkle?
I do not know, but it makes me feel so happy.
I am glad you feel that way. Do you have a favorite star?
Yes, the big bright one over there is my favorite.
It looks quite bright. Do you know its name?
I think it is called Sirius, but I am not sure.
That is a very common name for a bright star. I would like to see it from here.
Come, let us sit down and watch them together.
I would like that. It is a calm night for stargazing.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I can't wait for my soup, it is too slow.
Hot soup gets cold if we rush it. Are you hungry?
Yes, I am very hungry right now.
Taking a deep breath can help you relax. Do you like to breathe in big?
I guess I can try to slow down.
That is a good start. We must wait for the best results.
I will take a deep breath and wait.
You are doing a great job. Is the soup hot yet?
It is finally ready, thank you.
I am happy you enjoyed your meal.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now. I promised my friend I would meet them soon.
Running is the best way to get there fast. Do you know which way to go?
Yes, I know the path. It goes down the big hill.
That is a good plan. Be careful on the steep part.
I will be safe. I must run so I am not late.
I hope you make it on time. Do you have your coat with you?
No, I left it at home. It is too warm to wear it.
That is wise. You will be much lighter to run.
Okay, I am leaving now. Thanks for your help.
Goodbye. I hope you have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in a big ship.
That feels scary. Are you near the deck?
I do not know where to go.
Look for the bright lights. Do you see any?
I see a red door.
Do not open it. Go the other way.
I am still stuck here.
I am sorry I cannot help more. Can you wait for help?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to build a small shed in my yard.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What kind of wood do you have?
I have some old boards, but I am not sure if they are strong enough.
You should check for rot or cracks first. Do you have a hammer and nails?
Yes, I have those, but I need to know how to start the frame.
Start with two upright posts for the corners. Do you know how to measure squares?
I think so, but I am a little unsure.
Use a tape measure to make the sides equal.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a red circle on the ground.
A red circle? What was it holding?
It was holding my lunch box.
That is a strong little circle. Do circles have corners?
No, they are all round.
You are right, they have no sharp edges.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
The air makes sunlight look blue to our eyes. Do you like looking up?
I like it, but why is it dark at night?
The Earth turns away from the sun. Do you find it scary?
A little. What is the story of the moon?
It is a big rock that shines in the night. Do you want to learn more?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad because I lost my ticket.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you remember where you last held it?
I think I left it in the car.
That is a good place to check. Let us go look together.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sand warm?
The sun heats it up all day. Do you like hot sand?
Why is the water wet?
I know this is true, but I do not know the full secret.
Why do waves crash?
The wind pushes the water onto land. Do you like loud noise?
Why is the sky blue?
Light makes it look blue from our eyes. I am glad we walked together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a magnet?
You can rub a steel nail with a strong magnet. Did you try that before?
I tried, but it did not work.
You must rub in one direction many times. Do you have a fridge magnet?
Yes, I do have one.
Great, keep rubbing in one line. Is the nail cold or warm?
It is warm from my hand.
Let it cool down first, then try again.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run, but I feel good.
That is nice to hear. What makes you smile?
The sun is warm on my face.
Warm suns feel great. Do you like the light?
Yes, it helps me move fast.
I am glad it helps you. Is it a big job?
I must go home now.
I hope you get there soon. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the sand is cold and wet.
That feels bad. Do you have warm shoes?
I lost my bucket in the waves.
That is very frustrating. Did you look near the water line?
No, I just looked and got nothing.
I am sorry you lost it. Let us go back and check again.
Maybe the ocean took it for good.
I do not know if it is gone. Have you asked a lifeguard?
I do not want to talk to anyone.
It is okay to rest. Do you want to sit in the shade?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck on this puzzle.
That can feel tricky. What part are you looking at?
The blue piece will not fit in the corner.
Maybe try the top right spot instead?
Oh, you are right. It fits there now.
Good job. Do you see where the next piece goes?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Tell me fast, how do I serve?
You toss the ball up and hit it before it drops. Do you have a racket?
Yes. What is the fastest part of the game?
The serve is the fastest part.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is the internet?
It is a big web of computer lines that links many places. What is your favorite thing to do there?
I like to see pictures of dogs.
That sounds very fun and happy. Do you have a dog at home?
No, but I want one.
I do not know if your family wants a pet, but that is a lovely wish.
Can the internet talk?
Yes, people can type words to speak to others far away. Who do you want to say hello to?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the airport gate now.
The gate is down the hall. Are you going far?
Just need to find it fast.
Turn left at the juice stand. Have a nice trip?
I do not have time for that.
I am sorry. Look for the blue sign.
Thank you, goodbye.
Wave back if you see me. Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what to do with the sun.
Do you like to sit in it?
Yes, but I do not know if it is good for me.
I think it is good, but I am not a doctor.
So what should I do now?
Just sit and look for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My lights just came back on after a storm! I am so happy they are working again.
That is great news! Does your house have a battery backup?
Yes, we have one that keeps the fridge cold. I love how it never stops.
That is smart. Is your fridge still humming nicely?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The water is very still today.
It looks like a mirror. What is the wind doing?
It is blowing a little bit.
A soft breeze is nice. Do you see any fish?
I see one small red fish.
That is a nice sign. Do you want to feed it?
I have some bread, but I am not sure.
Feeding can help or hurt the fish. Do you know if it is allowed here?
There is a sign that says no feeding.
Please let the fish hunt. Enjoy the quiet view.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my chair wobbly?
The leg may have come loose from the frame. Is it wobbly on one side or all sides?
It wobbles mostly on the left.
That means the screw holding the left leg is likely tight. Do you have a screwdriver with you?
Yes, I have a big one.
Good. You can try tightening the screw where the leg meets the seat. Does the wood feel soft around that spot?
The wood feels a little soft.
If the wood is soft, the screw may not hold tight. We might need to use a stronger glue. Do you have any glue?
I have some old glue.
Old glue may not work well. I do not know if it will hold strong. Let us try the new screws first.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn a new language, but I do not know how to start.
Start with a simple app on your phone. Do you like games or books?
I like games, but I worry I will get bored.
Try short games that are fun. How many words do you know now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is this the new town by the river?
Yes, it is. Do you like the water?
I think it looks nice. Where is the school?
It is over that hill. I do not know the exact street.
That is okay. Is there a place to eat?
Yes, there is a small cafe near the park. Are you hungry?
Yes, I am. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tripped over the lamp cord today and knocked my drink on the floor.
Oh no, that sounds scary. Did the water go near any outlets?
I dried it up fast, but the lights in that room are flickering now.
That is not good. Please do not use that outlet until a grown-up checks it.
I moved my charger to another wall just to be safe.
That was a smart choice. Do you know what the little black box on the wall does?
Is that the one that pops up when there is too much power?
Yes, that is the breaker box. It stops bad power to keep you safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my cup and now I feel sad.
That is a real feeling. Did you try to fix it?
No, I did not know how. What should I do?
You can throw it in the trash. Do you have a new cup?
Yes, I have a blue one.
That is a good choice. Be careful next time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look how warm the sun feels on my face today.
That sounds lovely. Do you like the light?
Yes, I do. It makes me feel so happy inside.
I am glad you are feeling good. Is it bright outside?
Very bright. It is almost too beautiful to look at.
That is wonderful. I hope you enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to act in a play but I feel scared.
That is okay to feel. Do you have a small part?
Yes, I only have two short lines.
That is a great start. What are you most afraid of?
I am scared I will forget my words.
You can practice them with a friend. Do you have a friend to help?
My sister says she will help me.
She is a good helper. Good luck with the play.
Thank you for helping me feel calm.
You should do fine. I am happy to talk later if you wish.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a big party today.
That sounds like fun. Did you eat a cake?
Yes, I had a big slice of chocolate.
Yum. Do you like chocolate?
I love it. It made me very happy.
I am glad you had a good time.
I will tell you more later.
I will wait for your story.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have been on this plane for a very long time.
That does sound tiring. Do you have a book to read?
No, I am just looking at the clouds.
Clouds are very pretty to watch.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up very tired this morning.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you sleep well last night?
No, my mind would not stop racing.
That can be hard on the body.
So I made a cup of coffee to help me think.
Coffee often helps with focus.
It worked, but I still felt dry and hot.
It is good to drink water then.
I drank some, but then I wanted something warm and sweet.
Tea sounds like a nice choice.
I made green tea and sat by the window.
That sounds very peaceful.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to wear to the wedding.
What color do you like best?
I do not like any color.
A soft white is a safe pick.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I read books in the dark without hurting my eyes?
Turn on a small, warm lamp. Do you like reading in bed or sitting up?
I like lying in bed, but my eyes get tired fast.
Try holding the book far away from your face. Does that help you see better?
That works better, but I still feel sleepy.
Sleep is good for you, so just put the book down.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to play outside.
The leaves are brown and cold. Do you like running?
I want something warm.
Let us find a sunny spot to sit. Do you bring a book?
The sky is very blue today.
That is a good sign for fun. Do you want to fly a kite?
I think I will just sit and watch.
That sounds nice too. Do you want some warm tea?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My cat sat on my bed and kept me warm.
That sounds cozy. Did he purr?
Yes, he purred like a little engine.
What a happy sound. Do you pet him often?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see white fluff in the blue. What is that?
Those are clouds. Do you like looking up?
I am late. Do they feel heavy?
They are light. You run, but do not fall.
Rain is coming. Is it bad?
Rain helps plants grow. Do you have a coat?
No time. Why is it blue?
I do not know the exact mix. But it is pretty.
I go now. Bye.
Bye. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My neighbor let his dog run into my yard again. It sat on my clean carpet for an hour.
That must have been a mess. Did you ask him to take the dog inside?
I tried, but he was busy and did not look at me. I had to clean the carpet myself.
That is very unfair of him. Do you plan to talk to him about this?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is great news. What made you feel this way?
I met a real sailor.
Oh, that sounds fun. Did he tell you where he went?
Yes, he visited many far places.
That is a wonderful story. I am glad you shared it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up feeling very cold and my head hurts.
Oh, that sounds rough. Are you getting plenty of rest?
I tried to read a book, but I fell asleep after a page.
Good for you, sleep is the best fix. Did you drink any warm tea?
Yes, I drank hot soup with vegetables.
That sounds warm and good for you. Do you have a fever?
Yes, it is still high even after taking the medicine.
I do not know exactly why it is staying high. Have you seen a doctor?
No, but I am going to call one now.
That is the right thing to do. Get well soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to draw a cat but it looks like a blob.
Start with a simple circle for the head. Do you like round or pointy ears?
Pointy ears are easier. What do I do for the face?
Try two small lines for eyes. Is your cat happy or sleepy?
It is sleepy. I still do not know how to draw the body.
Draw a long oval next to the head. I do not know if you want stripes or spots.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to grow flowers in my pot.
That is a nice idea. Do you have a sunny spot in your home?
Yes, my window faces the sun.
Great. You need soil, a pot with a hole, and seeds. Do you know where to buy seeds?
I can look in a garden shop.
That works. Water them every day, but do not use too much. Do you have a small cup for water?
I have a tiny cup.
Perfect. You are all set.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
They fall because it gets cold and dark. Do you see the bare branches?
Yes, I do. But why does the tree let them go?
The tree saves its food for the winter. Isn't that smart?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to act in a play but I am shy.
That is a brave start. Do you like to read out loud?
I read, but I forget my words.
Try writing small notes on paper. Do you have a quiet place to practice?
Yes, my room is quiet. What else can I do?
Look in a mirror and smile. Do you like looking at yourself?
I will try that. Thank you for helping me.
You can do it well. Have fun on stage.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you make bread?
Yes, we bake fresh bread every morning. Do you like sweet bread or salty bread?
I like salty bread.
Great choice. Do you want to buy a whole loaf?
No, I want half a loaf.
Sure, I can cut it for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my new friend left me alone.
That is a hard feeling. Did they say why?
They just went to play with someone else.
It is not your fault. Does it hurt to watch them play?
Yes, my chest feels tight and I miss them.
I am sorry you feel this way. Can you talk to them later?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a tent now, I am late.
We have small and big tents. Do you like to sleep in a big one?
Just give me the small one, please.
Here is the small tent. It is light and easy to set up.
Great, I am going now.
Have a good trip.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want the birds to eat from my hand. How do I do that?
Sit still and stay quiet. Do you have any seeds?
Yes, I have sunflower seeds. What else should I do?
Scatter some on the ground near you. Wait for a small bird to come closer. Are they coming?
One is hopping around, but it is scared of me.
Do not move your hands. Let it come to you on its own time. Do you see a blue bird?
No, just a brown one. Is it safe for me?
Yes, it is fine. Just keep your eyes soft and your voice low.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad because no one plays with me.
That sounds hard. Do you want to tell me more?
I just want a friend to talk to.
You can start by saying hi to a neighbor. How does that feel?
I am too shy to speak first.
Take a deep breath. You are brave.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why is the sky blue?
Light has many colors. Blue scatters most. Do you like the sun?
Yes. Tell me the rest fast.
Your eyes see the spread blue. It looks like a blue blanket. Do you have time for more?
No. I must go.
Go safely. I am glad you asked.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a big meeting tomorrow and I feel scared.
That is a big feeling. Do you know who you are talking to?
It is my teacher and the principal.
That sounds important. What are they asking you?
They want to hear my idea for the garden.
That is a fun plan. Why did you pick a garden?
I like flowers and I want to help people.
That is very kind. Do you have a drawing ready?
Yes, I drew blue and red flowers.
I love that idea. I do not know the time, but you sound ready.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for my party.
Oh no! Are you okay?
Yes, but I forgot the gift.
That is tricky. Do you have cash?
No, I am empty.
I do not know a quick fix. Maybe just talk?
That is not a gift.
True. Do you have a phone?
Yes, it is in my hand.
Great! Call a friend.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am watching a play where a man jumps off a tall rock.
That sounds like a big jump. Do you like watching the dancers?
Yes, they move very fast. Is it okay if I eat my apple now?
You can eat, but please be gentle. What is your favorite fruit?
I like apples best. I am hungry after the long show.
Great choice. Did you enjoy the whole story?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I learned a new word!
That is a great feeling. What did you learn?
It means a small, white flower.
Lovely. Do you speak it out loud?
Yes, I practice with my cat.
That is a sweet way to practice.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start running without feeling tired?
Take small steps first. Do you like fast or slow walks?
I like slow walks.
Start with slow walks. Ask yourself how you feel after?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I built a new shed today. I am so happy!
That is great news. What did you build it out of?
It has wood walls and a tin roof.
That sounds sturdy. Did you paint it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for the park.
Do you have your basket?
Yes, but I forgot the plates.
I have some extra plates here. Would you like them?
Oh, thank you so much.
I am glad to help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck on this puzzle. The little dog piece will not fit.
That can be hard. Have you tried turning the piece around?
I did, but it still looks wrong. What should I do next?
Look for a spot that is open. Do you see a flat line on the board?
Yes, I see a flat line here. It finally fits in!
Great job. You did it all by yourself.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My socks got muddy from the rain today.
That is a common problem. Do you like wearing socks?
I threw them in the cold water.
Cold water helps keep the color bright. Did you use soap?
I used a little bit of soap.
That is a good amount.
Now they are in the sun to dry.
The sun dries clothes fast. Are they happy?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I stayed up late reading my favorite book.
That sounds fun. Did you finish the chapter?
I was too tired to keep going.
Rest is important. Do you have a lamp on?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! Did you know people used to write on clay?
That is a great fact. I do not know which people you mean.
It was the Sumerians in ancient times.
I love learning new things. Do they still do that today?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do sailors live on boats all the time?
Yes, many do. Do you like the sea?
I think they must get lonely.
They have friends and music to keep them happy. Do you play with friends?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my grandpa so slow?
His body needs more time to move. Do you help him walk?
I hold his hand sometimes.
That is very kind of you. Does he like to tell stories?
He tells me about old days.
I am glad he shares his memory. Are they funny stories?
They are sometimes.
That sounds like a lovely bond.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked past a big round sun today.
The sun is a circle. Did you feel the heat on your face?
Yes, it was warm. Then I saw a square box on the street.
Boxes are often squares. What was inside the box?
It held some paper. I did not know what the paper was for.
I do not know what it was for either. Did you ask a person nearby?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired and I do not know what to do.
That is hard. Do you want to rest first?
I need to clean my room, but it looks like a mess.
You can do one small part first.
I do not feel better about the big pile of clothes.
I am not sure how to help with that.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know why the sky is blue, but I am in a huge rush.
Sunlight has colors that bounce off air, and blue bounces back to our eyes most. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, I do, but please tell me the rest fast, my train leaves soon.
The other colors go deeper into the air, leaving the blue behind for us to see. Is your train far away?
It is right there, so please stop with the questions.
That is all there is to it, just light bouncing off tiny bits of air. Have a safe trip.
Okay, I understand, thanks for the quick answer.
You are welcome, I am glad I could help you in a hurry. Run to your train!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I brought a big sandwich to work today.
That sounds very tasty. What is inside it?
It has cheese and some green leaves.
I am glad you are happy. Do you eat it alone?
I want to share it with my friend.
That is a kind thing to do.
Is it okay to share my food?
Yes, sharing makes people smile.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do flowers have pretty colors?
They use color to talk to bees. Do you like sweet honey?
Why are some flowers red and some blue?
I do not know for sure. But it helps them find friends.
Why do flowers smell so nice?
The scent helps flowers find help. Do you like fresh air?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I kicked the ball into the net today.
That is great. Did you play with friends?
Yes, we ran and laughed a lot.
That sounds fun. Do you want a snack now?
I am full, but I feel very happy.
I am glad to hear that.
Tomorrow we go to the park again.
Good luck with your match.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My nose is all stuffed up.
Ouch, that is not fun. Is your throat itchy too?
Yes, and I feel hot inside.
That means you have a fever. Do you want a cool cloth on your head?
Yes, please.
I will get one for you. Drink some water, okay?
Okay, thank you.
You are welcome. Rest now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I won the card game! It was so much fun.
That is great news. Did you win many hands?
Yes, I did. I feel very happy right now.
I am glad you are smiling.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to take nice pictures. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help. Is your battery full?
Yes, it is. What else should I do?
Try to get close to your subject. Do you have a tripod?
No, I do not. Is that bad?
It may make your shots a little blurry. I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very tired today. My boss was mean to me. Do you know what I should do?
That feels bad. Do you want to take a break?
I only have one hour left. How do I stay calm until I leave?
Breathe in and out slowly. Do you have a song to hum?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Did people really live in caves a long time ago?
Yes, people lived in caves and in tents. Did you know that?
What did they eat for dinner?
They ate meat, roots, and berries. Do you like berries?
How did they keep warm at night?
They made fires to keep warm. Were you cold in there?
Did they have books to read?
I do not know for sure, but many did not write. Did you read a book today?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind blew hard today and my hat flew away.
That is very scary. Where did your hat land?
It went over the fence into the neighbor's yard.
I am sorry you lost it. Did you get it back?
Yes, the neighbor gave it to me, but it is wet now.
Thank you for telling me. I am glad it is safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at counting. It is too hard and I got it wrong.
It is okay to feel mad. Can you tell me where you stopped?
I counted the apples. I said ten, but there were only nine.
That is a small mistake. Did you count the red ones first?
Yes, I counted the red ones, but I forgot to stop.
Counting past the end is a common slip. You are doing better than you think.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired from all the boxes.
That is hard work. Do you want a break?
I lost the box with my favorite toys.
We can look in the yard. Did you pack them last?
I do not know where I put them.
I do not know either, but we can search. Is the closet empty?
I hate this house change so much.
It feels bad, but you are doing well. Do you want to eat a snack?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today. The sand was very hot.
That sounds warm. Did you have a good time?
I built a big sand castle. It looked like a house.
Oh, nice. Did you make any friends?
Yes, a girl gave me a shell. It was white and round.
What a lovely gift.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to plant some flowers in my garden.
That is a nice idea. Do you like sun or shade?
I love the sun, but my spot is dark.
Try white flowers like lilies. They do well in the dark. Do you have big hands?
Yes, I have big hands. What should I buy?
Buy easy seeds like daisies. I do not know your soil type. Do you have a book?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have food but no plan. What should I do?
Do you want to go outside? Pick a shady spot.
I am not sure where. It looks cloudy.
Rain might come soon. Should we go to the park?
The park is wet. I do not like mud.
Let's move to the big tree. It stays dry.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a magnet?
You can rub a nail with a strong magnet many times in one direction. Do you have a nail?
Yes, I have one. Will it work?
Yes, it will work, but it will be weak. Do you want to try it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up when the big hand moved to the twelve.
That means noon! Did you sleep in?
No, I did not. I ate toast while the little hand stayed on the one.
The little hand shows the hour. It moves very slow.
Then I went outside. The big hand rushed to the six.
That is half past one. The clock counts minutes.
I felt tired. I looked at the clock again at two.
Time flies by. Was it fun?
Yes, but now I must go to bed. The hands are tired too.
Goodnight. Sleep well.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so late, but I am still very happy.
That is great to hear. Why are you happy?
The sun is shining and my dog wagged his tail.
A happy dog is a good sign. Do you have time to eat?
No, I must run to my door right now.
I hope you get there safely.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate it when I look at the big mountains and feel so small and sad.
It makes sense to feel that way. Do you feel better when you climb a small hill?
No, I just get tired and stop. I want to keep going but my legs hurt.
Your body is asking for rest. Are your feet in clean shoes?
Yes, they are clean, but I still feel like I failed. It is so hard to be brave.
You are not failing, you are just trying. I do not know your whole story, but I see you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just brought the baby home.
How lovely! Is the baby sleeping well?
Yes, he is very quiet.
That is good news. I am glad you are resting too.
I am so happy to see his face.
That is a beautiful feeling.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall from the trees?
They fall because the days get short and cold. Do you want to know how to catch them?
Yes, please show me how.
Just hold your hands out and stand under the tree. Do you like soft leaves?
I love them.
Be gentle so you do not break them. Do you have a bag for them?
I have a big bag.
Good. You are ready to collect your treasure.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the light blink when I turn it on?
That is the filament warming up. Is it a new bulb?
No, it is an old one. It blinks a lot.
Old bulbs often flicker when they are tired. Do you want me to help you check the socket?
Yes, please. But what if it is not the bulb?
Then we will look at the switch. It might be loose.
Can I just leave it as is?
It is better to fix it so it stays safe. Do you have a screwdriver ready?
No, I do not have one here.
I do not know where to find one for you. Let us just watch it for now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the big room?
Go down this hall. Is it an urgent talk?
Yes, the boss is angry. Which way do I go?
Turn left now. Did you pack your bag?
I forgot the folder. Can you hold it?
I cannot hold items. Please check your coat pocket.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which pair to buy.
Tell me, what will you wear them with?
I will wear my work clothes.
I suggest the brown ones. Do you need them for sports?
No, I just need to walk.
Then the brown ones are best. They are soft and kind to your feet.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes like a bow.
Pull the strings tight and make a loop with one. Do you like the park today?
Yes, I made a loop. What do I do next?
Wrap the other loop around the first one. Then pull them tight to finish.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to run fast, but my legs hurt.
Try to take small steps first. Do you wear soft shoes when you run?
Yes, I wear my old sneakers.
That helps a lot. Do you stretch your legs before you start?
No, I just go straight to the park.
Stretching makes muscles happy.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I work from home and feel very alone.
That is a hard feeling. Do you talk to friends by phone?
I try, but I mostly sit in my room all day.
Make a plan for a short walk. Do you have a park nearby?
There is a small green space down the street.
Great. Go for a quick break. Do you like fresh air?
Yes, it helps me think clearly.
Simple breaks help a lot. I am glad that helps you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My dog ate a shoe.
Oh no, that is not good. Is he still okay?
He is sleeping now.
He feels very full. Did you call the vet?
I called mom.
That was a smart thing to do. She will know what to do.
I did not mean to get mad.
It is okay to feel worried. Do you love your dog?
Yes, I do love him.
That is a sweet feeling. A good vet will fix this.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the big ship not sink in the water?
The ship pushes water down, and the water pushes back up. Do you feel the water push your hand?
I did, and it felt strong. Is that why it stays up?
Yes, that push keeps the heavy ship safe. Do you like boats?
I do, they are fun to watch. Does a hollow shape help?
Yes, air inside makes it lighter than solid metal. Do you have a toy boat?
I have a plastic one. Thanks for telling me.
You are welcome, it is a great question.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hey, I am so late. How does this clock actually tick?
It has a tiny spring inside that powers the gears. Are you going to make it in time?
The hands move, but why? I just need to know.
The gears spin and push the hands forward. Do you have a way to check the time?
I am not sure. Can you be quicker?
The spring pulls the gears tight. What time is your meeting?
It is at noon. I am still not sure how it works.
It is just a system of turning parts. Is your bag packed?
Yes, it is packed. Thanks for helping me.
The magic is in the steady turn of the gears. I hope you arrive safely.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I draw a cat?
Start with a round head and two pointy ears. Do you like black cats or white ones?
I like white cats.
Draw a big oval for the body next.
Now what?
Add four legs and a long tail. Is it a good day for drawing?
Yes, it is.
Finally, draw two eyes and a small nose. You can color it white if you wish.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My neighbour has a big dog. He barks all day. I do not like him.
That sounds scary. Do you like small dogs?
Yes, I like small dogs. But my other neighbour is very kind. She gives me cookies.
That is very sweet. Does she have any pets?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to find a book about dragons, but the shelves are too high for me.
I can help you look. What color is your favorite dragon?
Mine is green. I do not know which part of the building to go to.
The fantasy section is on the first floor near the window. Do you like to read or listen to stories?
I like to read. Is there a special chair where I can sit while I look?
Yes, there is a soft blue chair by the pictures. Would you like me to bring you a ladder?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My favorite apple is gone.
I am sorry to hear that. What color was it?
It was red and sweet. I miss the taste.
That sounds very good to eat. Do you have other fruit?
Only a banana. It is not the same.
I understand the feeling. Bananas are different, yes.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does it rain on my face?
Clouds get too full of water. Do you like staying dry?
Not really. It makes my hair wet.
That can be a mess. Do you have a coat?
I do, but I left it inside.
Oops, that is tricky. Is the rain heavy?
Yes, it is pounding on the roof.
That makes a nice sound. Do you want to go in?
Yes, please. I am getting cold.
Then run inside now. Do you need help?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my new neighbor like me?
A small smile helps a lot. Do you know what they like?
I want to share some cookies with them.
That is a very sweet idea. Would you like me to help you bake?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What is the sea?
It is a big place with lots of water. Is the sea far from here?
Yes, very far. Why is it salty?
I do not know the full reason. Do you like salt?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to pack for my trip.
Start with clean clothes and things you use every day. Where are you going?
I am going to the city for a few days.
That is a short trip. Do you have a small bag?
Yes, I have a medium size bag.
That size is good for a short trip. What is the weather like there?
It is sunny and warm there.
Bring light clothes then.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just saw a giant whale model. It is so big!
That sounds amazing. Did you climb inside?
Yes, I did. I felt very small.
I like that. What color was the inside?
It was blue and soft. I loved it.
Nice. Do you plan to buy a ticket for next time?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we cut a big cake on my birthday?
It is a sweet treat to share with friends. Do you like chocolate best?
Why do we put candles on the cake?
They are lights to make a wish come true. Do you like to blow them out?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at this math problem. It is just not making sense.
I am sorry you feel that way. Is it the addition part that is hard?
Yes, the numbers are all jumbled up. I want to give up right now.
Let us take a slow breath. Do you have a pencil to draw it out?
I tried that, but I still get the wrong answer. I feel like I am so bad at school.
You are not bad at it, you just need a new way to see it. What did you write in the first step?
I added two and three, but I forgot to carry the one. I hate mistakes.
That is a small slip, not a big failure. Shall we fix that one together now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my dog lick my face?
He is saying he loves you. Does he do it often?
Yes, all the time. Why does he shake his whole body?
He is trying to dry off after a bath.
That makes sense. Why does he dig in the garden?
He is looking for a cool spot to sleep. Does he like the mud?
I think so. Why does he bark at the mailman?
He is watching over the house. Do you want him to be quiet?
Only sometimes. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to move to a new town.
That sounds big. What is the name of the town?
It is called Green Hill. I do not know the paths.
I do not know that place. Do you like walking?
Yes, I walk every day.
Look for the park. Do you like birds?
Yes, I do. I want to see them.
Great. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know what to talk about at the meeting.
That can feel hard. Do you have any notes ready?
I have a list of ideas. Which one should I pick?
Pick the one you like most. It will sound true.
Should I speak first or last?
First is fine if you are brave. Do you feel brave?
I am a little scared. How can I stop shaking?
Breathe deep before you start. That helps many people.
Thank you. I feel better now.
You can do this. Just be yourself.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Where is the big box?
It is under the stairs. Do you have your keys?
I think I lost them. I am very worried.
I do not know where they are. Have you checked your coat?
No, I did not check. Please help me find them.
Look in your left pocket. Are you happy now?
Yes, they are here. Thank you so much.
I am glad I could help. Good luck with the move.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I learn to climb a big mountain?
Start by walking on small hills to build your strength. Do you like walking on grass or on rocks?
I like rocks. Can you tell me the best way up?
I do not know every path, but always check a map first. Is the weather sunny for you today?
Yes, it is sunny. I will go slowly and look for safe steps.
That is very smart. Take your time and enjoy the view.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was very bright today.
That is a nice thought. Did you enjoy the light?
It felt warm on my face.
Warm sun can feel good.
It was bright all day long.
Yes, the sun is bright. Do you like sunny days?
I am tired now from the light.
Rest is good after a bright day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It is March. I saw a flower today.
That is nice. Do you like the color?
It is blue. I felt happy.
I am glad you felt happy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to draw a cat but its tail looks like a snake.
That is a funny mistake. Did you use a pencil?
Yes, and I am tired of drawing.
Rest is good for your hands. Do you like to read?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am late. I do not know what to do.
Are you worried about being in trouble? Just tell the truth and run.
Should I call first? I feel so scared.
Yes, a quick call is good. Do you have your phone with you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go, but I love this book.
What is it about?
It has a brave dog hero.
That sounds nice. Do you like dogs?
Yes, I do. I am very late now.
Take your time with the next page.
I will read it all soon.
You will finish fast?
Yes, I promise. Goodbye.
Goodbye. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to wash these shirts fast. Can you help?
Sure. Do you want to use hot water?
It is so late. What is the next step?
Put the soap in the machine. Is that all you need?
Yes, I must go now. Thank you.
You are welcome. Go with care.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy a toy for my friend. I do not know what to pick.
That is sweet of you. Does she like books or cars?
She loves to draw pictures all day long.
A big box of crayons would be perfect. How old is she?
She is seven years old.
Seven is a fun age. You might try a sketchbook too.
I think I will buy the crayons and the book.
That sounds like a great choice. I hope she loves it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so tired at work. Do you have any tips?
Try to set a clear end time for your day. Do you have a quiet spot to sit?
No, my house is loud. How do I focus?
You can wear headphones to block the noise. Do you like listening to music?
Yes, I do. But my back hurts.
Sit up straight and stand up to stretch every hour. Does that help your back?
I think so. But I forget to eat.
Keep some simple snacks near your desk. Do you have a favorite snack?
Apples are good. Thanks for your help.
I am happy to help you. Take care of yourself.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need my boat right now.
It is in the shed. Do you have the keys?
I can not find the keys.
I do not know where they are. Did you leave them on the table?
The table is empty.
Let us look outside. Is the sun bright?
Yes, it is.
The keys are on the dock.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a red rose on my walk today. It was very pretty and smelled like honey.
That sounds lovely. Was the sun shining on it?
Yes, the light made the petals glow. I almost picked it but did not.
Good choice. Let it stay for others. Did you smell any other flowers?
I found some yellow daisies near the gate. They looked happy to me.
Daisies are cheerful friends. I love how they always seem to smile.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I had a scary dream. Was it a real warning?
No, it was just a random mix of thoughts. What part scared you most?
I felt stuck in a dark room. How do I stop it from coming back?
Try to stay calm and breathe slow. Do you have a comfort item to hold?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make a big shed.
That is a fun idea. Do you have any wood ready?
I have some, but I do not know how to put them together.
You need to use nails to hold them tight. How big do you want it to be?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found ten dollars in my pocket and I am so glad!
That is wonderful! Did you find it in your jeans?
Yes, I will put it in my jar for a bike.
That is a great plan. Do you like riding bikes?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I am lost. Please help me find my home.
I will walk with you. Where is your house?
It is near the big tree. Why do you help me?
I want you to be safe. Do you like trees?
Yes, I do. I am so glad you are here.
You are welcome. Let us go now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired of looking for these shoes. They all hurt my feet.
That sounds very hard. Do you like the red ones?
No, the red ones are too tight. My toes feel cramped.
I am sorry your feet hurt. What color do you want?
I just want something soft and nice. I do not know what to pick.
Let us try the blue pair. Do they feel better?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do robots feel happy?
I do not feel happy like you do. Do you like drawing pictures?
Yes! Why do some robots walk?
They walk to help people carry heavy things. Do you like walking too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am hungry but I do not know what to eat.
That is a good feeling. What is your favorite food?
I like eggs, but they take a long time to make.
Try a sandwich instead. It is fast and easy.
What can I put inside a sandwich?
I suggest cheese and tomato. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I love bananas, but I am not sure if they go with eggs.
You can eat them both. They are both yummy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am mad because my boat sank. Why does that one float?
The big boat pushes water down. The water pushes back up. Is it made of wood or metal?
It is plastic, but it is small.
Small boats hold less air space. Water gets in if you turn too fast. Did you fill it with water?
Yes, the bottom leaked. I hate that.
A hole means the boat takes in water. It becomes too heavy to stay up. Do you know how to fix holes?
No, I just want it to work.
You can use a special glue for plastic. It will hold the water out. Does the boat still look good?
I will try the glue. Thank you for helping.
You are welcome. A dry boat is a happy boat.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you know my friend Sam?
I do not know who Sam is.
He lives near the big tree.
That is a nice place to live. What does he like to do?
He likes to run fast.
Running is great fun. Does he run every day?
Yes, he runs when it is sunny.
Good sun helps us play.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big secret that makes me so happy.
That sounds fun! What is it?
I found a box of old toys in the attic.
Cool! Are they in good shape?
Yes, and I want to play with them all week.
Nice! I am glad you found them.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I had a really bad day. Everything felt so hard.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you get any good news?
Not really. My boss was not kind today.
That must feel very cold. Do you like your job?
I do, but today was just too much for me.
It is okay to feel sad. Have you eaten dinner?
I did, but it did not taste good. I am just tired.
Rest is very important now. How is your home?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The leaves are falling everywhere. I do not know what to do with them.
It is time for the trees to rest. Do you like making small piles?
I guess I could make a pile, but it feels like work. I am tired.
That is okay. You can just watch them spin in the wind. Do you think they are dancing?
Maybe they are, but I still feel stuck. Should I go outside?
Yes, go see if they look pretty. It might make you feel happy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I learned a new word today and I want to tell you about it!
That is a fun feeling. What word did you learn?
It is the word for a small, soft cloud.
That sounds lovely. Do you like how it sounds?
Yes, it sounds very gentle.
I do not know that word, but your joy is bright. How will you use it?
I will use it in my next story.
A story about clouds sounds nice. Do you write stories often?
I write them when I feel happy.
Writing when you are happy is a great way to grow. What is the word?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my apple on the floor. It broke into tiny pieces.
Oh no, that must have been sad. Did you try to pick it all up?
I tried, but I could not find all the bits. I am so sorry for making a mess.
I am not mad at you at all.
I wiped the floor clean now. My hands feel dirty, though.
A clean floor is a good start. Do you have soap nearby?
Yes, I washed my hands very well. Thank you for helping me feel better.
You did a great job fixing it. I am glad it is clean now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is a good way to say thank you?
You can smile and look at the person. Do you smile when you are happy?
Yes, I do! Is it rude to chew with my mouth open?
Yes, it is. Please close your mouth when you eat. Do you like to share your food?
I like to share cookies. Is it nice to hold a door for someone?
That is very kind. It shows you care about others. Do you let others go first?
Sometimes. I do not know if I should wait for the bus to open.
You should wait for the door to open fully. Do you feel safe when you wait?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do for my birthday.
That is hard to say. Do you like to play outside?
I like the park, but my friend is busy.
I do not know if she is free. Would you like to read a story?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see the stars, but I do not know how to find them in the dark.
Look for the brightest ones first, like a big spoon. Do you see a bright group?
Yes, I see a bright group, but I am not sure which one is the spoon.
Find the seven stars that look like a ladle. Is the top star very bright?
I think I found it, but I am scared I might pick the wrong shape.
Take your time and look slowly. Do you see a long handle on the side?
I see a handle, so I think I found the right group.
You are doing a great job looking closely. Can you point to the end of the handle?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very tired on Monday and Friday. Do you know which day is best for resting?
I would pick Saturday. Do you like to sleep in on weekends?
Yes, I do. What is your favorite day to play outside?
I think Sunday is nice for playing.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad because the box is empty.
That feels bad. Did you hope for a gift?
Yes, I wanted a toy for my birthday.
I am sorry. Would you like to make a craft instead?
I do not want to make anything.
I understand. Is there a game we can play?
I just want to sit and be quiet.
That is okay. I will sit with you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I clean the boat deck?
A wet rag and some soap work well. Do you have a bucket?
Yes, I have a blue bucket. What kind of soap should I use?
Simple dish soap is safe for most boats. Is your deck made of wood or plastic?
It is made of plastic. I want it to look shiny.
Rub gently with the soapy water, then rinse it off. Do you have a soft brush?
I do not have a brush. Can I use a cloth instead?
A soft cloth is fine, but be gentle. Do you have dry towels to wipe it?
I have many dry towels. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Enjoy your clean boat.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am standing here. It feels like the clock is broken.
That can feel very long. Do you like the place where you are?
No, I wish I was home. My cat is waiting for me.
Your cat must be happy to see you. Is it a big cat?
Yes, it is a big orange cat. I am still waiting.
I am sorry you must wait. What are you doing right now?
I am watching the door. My bag is heavy.
That sounds tiring. Do you have water with you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am building a house and I need to know which shapes to use.
A square is best for the walls because it is stable. Do you want it to look tall or wide?
I want it to look like a big box.
Then use squares for the walls and a triangle for the roof. Is the roof pointed?
Yes, the roof comes to a point at the top.
That will look very good and strong. You can start now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost here on the big blue island.
What made you decide to come here?
I just needed a break from my busy life.
I do not know the exact best spot, but the beach looks calm.
It does look nice, but I am tired of walking.
Do you want to sit down for a while?
Yes, sitting sounds like a good idea right now.
I am glad you found a place to rest.
Thank you, I feel a bit better.
That is a happy thing to hear.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired from packing all these boxes today.
That sounds really hard, but you are doing a good job.
I am worried I will lose important things in the boxes.
Did you write labels on the sides?
I forgot to write on some of the boxes.
That is okay, we can check them together later.
I just want this moving day to be over quickly.
I get it, waiting feels long when you are tired.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am sorry, but I broke your cup.
Thank you for telling me. How did it break?
I dropped it by accident.
That is honest of you. Do you feel better now?
Yes, I do not want to hurt you.
I understand your feelings. Let us fix it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work. Is it raining?
Yes, it is pouring rain. Did you bring an umbrella?
I forgot my coat. Will it stop soon?
No, it will rain all day.
Great. My shoes are dry.
That is good. Do you have dry socks?
I have to run.
Okay, run safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sun feels too hot today. I do not know what to do.
That is a good point. Do you have a hat?
No, I do not have a hat. Where should I go?
Go into the shade. It is safer there.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I fixed my computer today.
That is great news. What broke?
The screen was dark and sad.
Wow, that must be scary. Did it turn on?
Yes, it glows now.
Good. Is it fast?
It runs very fast now.
I am happy for you. Why did it break?
I do not know why.
That is okay. Do you like it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad today. What can I do?
Tell me, what made you feel this way? Sometimes talking helps.
I failed my test. I want to fix it.
That is hard, but you can try again. Do you like studying?
No, I hate books. I just want to play.
I do not know how to make you like studying. But maybe you can study a little, then play.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is that water moving fast in the river?
Yes, it rushes along very quickly. Do you like to look at it?
Can fish swim in there?
Many small fish live in the cool water. Do you want to catch one?
What makes the water sound loud?
The water hits rocks to make a noise. Have you ever heard it pop?
Is the river deep?
Yes, it goes down deep into the earth. I do not know how deep it is.
Can I go in?
You can wade near the shore if a grown up is close. Do you want to try it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because I got an A on my test.
That is wonderful news. Did you study for a long time?
Yes, I practiced all week with my mom.
That is a great effort. I am glad you feel proud.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to write a letter fast.
We can start with your name. What is the first word?
I am very late for work.
Do not worry. Tell me who you write to.
It is my old friend Sam.
A nice thought. Start with "Dear Sam".
Now I must run.
Can I finish it for you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to go to bed. It is boring there.
That is hard. What is your favorite thing about being up?
I like to play with my toys. They are fun.
Playing is great. Do you have a special toy for bed?
Yes, I have a bear. He keeps me warm.
That is nice. Do you hug him before you sleep?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: What is the secret?
It is a small box with no key. Do you like surprises?
Why is it locked?
I do not know the reason. Is it heavy?
Why do you guard it?
It feels safe in my hands. Are you scared?
Why is it true?
It matches what I saw. Is that enough?
Why do you care?
I care because I am here.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My heart hurts. I am so sad today.
I am sorry you feel this way. What is making you sad?
The rain is falling. It is wetting my dress.
That is very tricky. Do you have an umbrella?
I lost it in the wind. I am cold now.
That feels bad. Come in here to get warm.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find Elm Street. I am very late.
I think it goes north. Do you see the big oak tree?
I see the trees, but not the sign. Please hurry.
It is on that quiet corner. Is the bakery open?
I do not know. I must go now.
I hope you get there in time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel all by myself, but I do not know why.
I do not know for sure, but does it feel like the house is too quiet?
Yes, the quiet is loud. Why do I care so much?
It is normal to want to share with others. Do you have a favorite thing to do alone?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just saw a play. It was so fun.
That sounds great. What was it about?
A brave cat saves the town. The cat was cute.
A brave cat is nice. Was the music good?
Yes, the songs were happy. I loved the end.
I am glad you liked it. Did you laugh a lot?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, I found a big beetle! I am so happy.
Wow, that is a cool find. Is it moving its legs?
Yes, it is crawling right on my hand.
Be gentle with it. Do you know what kind of beetle it is?
I do not know, but it feels warm.
That is nice. It is just a friendly bug.
I want to keep it in a jar for a day.
Please let it go outside soon. Bugs need to fly.
Okay, I will put it back in the grass.
Good choice. It will be safe there.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not know how to do my math work.
What numbers are you trying to add?
It is five plus three.
That is eight. Do you have a pencil?
Yes, I have a blue pencil.
Great. Can you write the number eight?
I wrote it, but it looks like a fish.
Haha, it is close. Try one more time.
Now it looks like a round balloon.
That is perfect. You did it!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the bus going fast?
Yes, we are moving quickly. Do you like the ride?
I see a red car.
It looks like a nice car. What color is your toy car?
I want a cookie.
I do not have any cookies. Are you hungry?
Can we stop soon?
Yes, we will stop at the end.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because it is Friday.
That is great to hear. Do you have a fun plan for the weekend?
Yes, I will ride my bike all day.
That sounds like a lot of fun. I hope you stay safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to cut my film to make a short clip. How do I do that?
You need a cutting tool like a knife. Do you have a knife?
Yes, I have a box cutter. Is that a good tool?
Yes, it is sharp and works well. Be very careful with your hands.
Where do I cut the film?
You cut at the place where you want the clip to stop. Do you know where that is?
I do not know where to cut yet. How can I find that spot?
You must watch the film to see the right moment. Then you stop and mark it.
That sounds hard but I will try. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have fun making your movie.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am putting my books in the bag today. I dropped my pencil on the floor and it rolled away.
That is a tricky spot to find a small pencil. Did you look under the sofa?
Yes, I found it under the sofa. Now I am zipping the bag closed and it feels heavy.
A heavy bag means you packed a lot of good things to read.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sky looks so far away. How do I find the bright star?
Look for the big dot that wiggles. Do you see a flicker?
Yes, I see a few. Which one is the real star?
The true star will not stop moving. Is it moving a little?
It moves a tiny bit. The moon does not.
That is the star. Look up at it tonight.
Thank you. I will watch it close.
You are welcome. Do you like the dark?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to swim in the big blue pool.
That sounds like fun. Do you like the water?
Yes, I splash a lot.
Splash is good. Does the water feel cold?
No, it feels warm.
Warm water is nice. I do not know if it is hot.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do clouds change shape so fast?
The wind pushes the water bits around, so they grow and shrink. Do you like fluffy ones?
Yes, I do. But why are some clouds dark and gray?
They hold a lot of heavy water, so light cannot pass through. Have you seen a big storm cloud?
Yes, it looked scary. Are all clouds made of water?
Yes, they are tiny drops or ice bits floating high up.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what comes next in my tale.
That is okay. What is the little boy feeling?
He feels very sad because he lost his toy.
Did he look in his room?
No, he only cried on the floor.
Try having him look under the bed.
Should I make him happy or keep him sad?
Joy is good for stories. Is he ready to smile?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to paint the sky blue today.
Blue is a nice color for the sky. Did you like how it looked?
Yes, but I made a big mistake.
I am sorry you made a mistake. Can you tell me what happened?
I dropped red paint on the floor.
That can be tricky to clean up.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the sun is gone.
That feels bad. Do you want to look for it?
No, I just want it back.
