It comes back at night. Do you like the moon?
The moon is cold.
The sun is warm. It rests during the day.
I hate waiting.
You are strong. I do not know when it rises today.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake bread at home. How do I start?
You need flour, water, and yeast to begin. Do you have a kitchen scale?
Yes, I have a scale. What do I do next?
Mix the ingredients until they form a soft ball. Then let it sit in a warm spot for an hour.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are mountains so big?
They are big because the Earth's skin folds up over time. Do you like to climb them?
Why do they have snow on top?
It is very cold up there, so the rain freezes. Do you like the snow?
Why do rocks break there?
The cold cracks the stone apart bit by bit. Do you see the broken bits?
Why are there animals living there?
They hide in the rocks to stay safe. Do you like to watch them?
Why do I want to go up?
I do not know why you feel that way. Do you think the air is better up there?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The wind is too strong.
It blows hard today. Are you cold?
I must run now.
Please be careful. It is a big gust.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I found a big box on the porch.
That is a gift for you. Did you like it?
Why did they leave it here?
They wanted to see your happy face.
Who is it from?
I do not know who sent it. Is it big?
It feels very heavy.
We must open it to see. Are you ready?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found my phone under the sofa! I am so glad.
That is great news! Were you worried before?
Yes, I looked everywhere. It feels good to have it back.
I am happy for you. Do you know where it went?
I think I dropped it there. It is in good shape.
Lucky you! Is the screen broken?
No, it is perfect. Thank you for asking.
You are welcome. Go enjoy your day!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My goldfish looks sick, can you help me fast?
Is the water cloudy?
No, but he is not moving.
That sounds bad. Did you add new fish?
No, I just changed the water.
Do not feed him for now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not want to go to the doctor. It feels very bad.
I know it feels hard. Are you scared of the needle?
Yes, and my tummy hurts too. I feel so sick today.
That is not nice at all. Do you want to bring your bear?
Maybe. The doctor will help me feel better, right?
Yes, the doctor is there to help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My boss gave me extra food to share with everyone.
That is very kind of him. Do you know who to give it to?
I am not sure. Should I keep it for myself?
No, giving is a good thing. Are you worried about the rules?
Maybe. I just want to be a good helper.
You are already a good helper. Just ask him how he wants it shared.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the rain stopped our picnic.
That is a shame. What did you pack for the food?
I made my best sandwiches, but now they are wet.
Wet sandwiches are tricky. Did you bring any dry blankets?
No, we only have the grass, which is now muddy.
Muddy grass is not fun. Do you have a sturdy table?
We do, but it is too far to carry through the rain.
I am sorry it is hard. Maybe a shelter is better?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the thunder so loud?
The sky is making big pops like fireworks. Are you scared?
A little bit. Do the clouds hurt?
No, they just rub together hard. Do you hear rain?
Yes, it is falling fast. Is it safe outside?
It is not safe yet. Let us wait for it to stop.
Okay. When will the sun come back?
Soon, after the storm is done.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the light turn on when I press the button?
The button opens a path for the power to come in. Do you like when the room gets bright?
Yes, I do. But what is the power made of?
It is energy that moves through the wires in our walls. I do not know where it starts, but it comes from far away.
Oh. Does it use up when I watch TV?
Yes, we use it up, but the power plant makes more. Do you turn the TV off when you stop watching?
I try to. Can the power hurt me if I put my finger in the plug?
Yes, it can hurt very badly, so never put things in the plug. Do you always ask an adult to help with plugs?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so hungry right now.
What would you like to eat?
Can we have pancakes with syrup?
That sounds delicious. Do you like them sweet?
Yes, very sweet please.
I can make those for you.
You are the best helper.
I am glad to help.
Thank you for listening to me.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the fish swim so fast?
It is playing. Does it look happy to you?
What is the little bubble?
That is air from its body.
Why does it sit still on the rock?
It is resting. Do you see other fish moving?
Can I touch the water with my finger?
Please do not, it may scare them.
Will the fish hurt me?
No, it is very safe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so tired today.
That sounds hard. Did you sleep well?
Yes, but I am still happy to tell you.
I am glad for you. What makes you happy?
The sun is bright and warm.
That is a lovely sign. I hope you rest soon.
Thank you for listening to me.
You are welcome. How is your heart feeling now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because I fixed my mistake.
That is great. Did you say sorry to your friend?
Yes, I told her I was wrong.
That was very brave of you. How did she look?
She smiled and forgave me.
I am glad she is happy. What do you want to do now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is great to hear. What made you feel this way?
I dreamed about a big, high mountain.
Mountains are very tall and cool. Do you like looking at them?
Yes, I love how they touch the sky.
That is a lovely thought.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love working from home today. It feels so nice.
That sounds great. Do you like your setup?
Yes, it is very cozy. I have a warm cup of tea.
How nice. I hope you enjoy your day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to catch the bus to the park, but I am lost.
Do you see a big yellow bus nearby?
Yes, I see one right there, but I do not know which stop to wait at.
That is a good sign.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
Bees collect sweet nectar from flowers. Do you like sweet flowers?
Yes, I do. How do they turn it into honey?
They mix the nectar with an enzyme in their stomach. Do you know what an enzyme is?
No, I do not. What is it?
It is a helper that breaks the nectar down. They fan it dry with their wings.
I want to make honey at home. How can I?
You cannot make real honey without bees, but you can make jam. Do you like jam?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up on Monday and felt very happy. I saw a big red flower in my garden.
That sounds like a nice start to your week. Did you take a picture of the flower?
No, I did not have my camera. I just looked at it for a long time.
It is good to slow down and enjoy things.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I need new shoes for my feet.
That is a good idea. What color do you like?
I like red.
Red is a bright color. Do you want soft or hard soles?
I want them to be soft.
Soft shoes feel like clouds. Are they easy to take off?
Yes, they have big ties.
Good. Let me check the shelf.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I built a new shed today.
That is wonderful news! What color did you paint it?
I used bright blue. It looks great in the sun.
Blue is a very nice choice. Do you have it stored safely?
Yes, I put the tools inside. It feels like a home.
I am glad it feels right for you.
Thank you for listening to my good news.
You are very welcome.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read my favorite book again today.
That sounds like a great way to spend time. Did you enjoy it?
Yes, it is about a brave little girl.
Brave girls are my favorite kind of story.
I was a little tired when I started.
Did you stop to take a break?
I kept reading until the very end.
You must feel very happy now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My dog has a very shiny coat.
That is nice. Does he like to run in the yard?
Yes, he runs fast.
I am glad he is healthy. What is his favorite toy?
He likes a red ball.
That sounds fun. Do you play fetch together?
Yes, we play every day.
He must love you a lot. Is he tired after playing?
Yes, he sleeps a lot.
Good for him. I do not know if all dogs sleep that much.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My bread is getting big and puffy, and I am so happy to tell you!
That is a wonderful sign. What kind of flour did you use?
I used white flour and some sugar. It smells so good!
The sugar helps the yeast eat and make gas. Do you like to bake on weekends?
Yes, I love it. Why does the bread get fluffy inside?
Tiny bubbles of gas stretch the dough. You did a great job!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to draw a cat, but my ears look wrong.
Try making them pointy triangles. What color is your cat?
It is gray. How do I make the tail look soft?
Draw a wavy line that gets thinner at the end.
That sounds hard. I am getting tired of trying.
It is okay to stop for a break. Do you want to try again?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to keep ants out of my kitchen.
Try sprinkling a line of cinnamon on the windowsill. Do you have any cinnamon at home?
I do not, but I have white vinegar. Can I use that?
Yes, mix equal parts vinegar and water. Does the smell bother you?
It smells strong, but I will try it. Thank you.
You are welcome. Do let me know if it works.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very tired on this long plane trip. What can I do to feel better?
Try to rest your eyes and drink some water. Do you have a book to read?
I do, but my neck hurts from sitting so still.
You can use your bag as a soft pillow for your head. Does that help you feel a bit better?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn a new language.
That sounds like fun! Which one do you pick?
I pick Spanish.
Great choice. Do you know how to say hi?
I think it is Hola.
You are right! It means hello. Do you want to learn more words?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very tired of looking at maps. Where should I go for a nice ride?
The green line is very calm and quiet. Do you like looking out the window?
Yes, I do. But it is raining outside. Will I get wet?
No, the doors close before the train moves. Are you carrying a big bag?
It is a small bag. Is the ride long or short?
It takes about one hour. Do you have books with you?
I have one book. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a good trip.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad inside.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to tell me why?
I miss my friend a lot.
Missing someone can hurt. Is it because you are angry?
No, I just want to play together.
That makes sense. Would a letter help you talk?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like this story about the brave cat.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Why do you like the cat?
He jumps really high.
Jumping is a great skill. Does he jump over anything special?
Yes, he jumps over the mud.
Mud can be messy. What is under the mud?
I do not know what is there.
I do not know either. Let us find out on the next page.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can you help me count my red blocks? There are five of them.
Sure, I can count with you. Do you like building towers?
Yes, I built a tall one. How many blocks are in a tower?
A tower can have as many blocks as you want. Do you have a favorite color for blocks?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Can you tell me the time?
It is two o'clock. Are you going to the play?
Yes, I forgot the time. Is the play starting now?
The doors open soon. Do you have your ticket?
I lost my ticket. Can I still get in?
I do not know for sure. Is there a clerk at the door?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel tired when I work at home.
That is a very common feeling. Do you stretch your body during breaks?
No, I sit all day in my chair.
Sitting too long can make you feel heavy and slow. It helps to move your legs and arms.
What should I do to feel better?
Try to stand up and walk for five minutes every hour. This gives your brain a rest.
I will try that right now.
That is a great plan. I hope it makes your day feel lighter and easier.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The snow is very white today.
It looks lovely out there. Is it cold for you?
Yes, it is quite cold.
Please stay warm. Do you want to make a snowman?
I am going to try now.
That sounds like fun. What shape will it be?
I want it to be big and round.
Good luck building it. I hope it stands up well.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do I need to wear a tie?
Yes, a black tie is safe. Are you happy to wear one?
I love them, thank you.
That is great news. Is the music loud there?
Yes, very loud.
That sounds fun. Can you hear the speaker?
Yes, I can hear him.
Good. Do you know when we start?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the movie, do you know what time it starts?
It starts at five o'clock. Are you excited for it?
Maybe, but I really need to run. Is there a bathroom near here?
Yes, it is right by the ticket booth. Do you need water too?
No, thank you, I must go. Do you want to come with me?
I can't move, but I hope you enjoy the show. Please have fun!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad. My boss said I did a small thing wrong.
That feels bad to hear. Did you fix it?
Yes, I fixed it right away. But I still feel small.
I know how that feels. Are you scared of making more mistakes?
Yes, I am. I want to do well, but I am new here.
It is normal to feel this way at first. You are doing your best.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to find a cat on the screen.
You can type "cat" into the small box at the top. Do you know how to type?
I do not know how to use the box.
Click the little mouse on the box to wake it up. Then type the word. Are you using a phone or a computer?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a big red apple, but I do not know what to do with it.
You can just eat it. Do you like sweet fruit?
I am not sure if it will be too sweet for me.
Try one small bite first. It is a safe way to find out.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I ran fast today. I feel so good.
That is great news. Did you break your record?
Yes, I did! The wind felt like a friend.
I am happy for you. I do not know much about wind, but that sounds nice. How did your feet feel?
They hurt a little, but it is a good hurt.
A good hurt is a sign of strong work. Would you like to run again tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared to take my test.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you know your stuff?
I think I did study hard.
That is great work. Are you ready to start?
Yes, I am ready now.
Good luck, you can do it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake a cake.
That sounds fun. Do you have an oven?
Yes, I do. What do I do first?
Mix the dry ingredients first.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to swim, but I am afraid of the water.
That is a good goal. Do you like the taste of water?
Yes, I do. How do I kick my legs?
Kick like a frog. Do you have a frog in your mind?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now.
That is a great feeling. What made you smile?
I went swimming in the lake.
That sounds very refreshing. Did the water feel cold?
It was a little cold but good.
Good for you. Do you like swimming more than running?
Yes, I love being in the water.
I am glad you enjoy it. It is good for your body too.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
They gather sweet plant sugar from flowers. Do you like flowers?
I do! What happens next?
They store it in tiny body bags to bring home. Do you have a backpack?
Yes, I do. How does the liquid turn into honey?
They fan it with their wings to dry it out. That makes it thick and sweet.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My phone is making loud noises and the screen is all black.
That sounds like the battery is empty. Have you tried to charge it?
I did, but nothing happens when I plug it in.
The cable might be broken. Do you have another one to try?
Yes, I have a blue one right here.
Great. Try that one and tell me if the screen lights up.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Are robots alive?
No, robots are not alive. Do you think they feel happy?
I want a robot that gives me toys.
Some robots can bring things to you. What toy would you like?
A big red truck.
A red truck is a great choice. Do you like to drive?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to paint a blue bird today.
That sounds like fun. What color did you use?
It turned out a bit green.
Oh, that is a happy mistake.
I am not good at mixing colors.
You are learning fast. Did you like the bird?
Yes, I think it looks cute.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people keep so many old things?
They keep them because the items hold happy memories. Do you have a favorite toy?
I do. But why do some people throw their stuff away?
They clear space to let in new, exciting things. What do you like to collect?
I collect shells from the beach. Do you keep anything?
I do not keep physical things, but I love learning about yours.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the exit. I am late.
The door is right there. Why is it so cold?
It is raining. I forgot my coat.
That is bad. Do you have an umbrella?
No. I am running to the car.
Please run to the right. Is the museum open?
I think it is closed.
I do not know for sure. Do you need a map?
No. I will just go now.
Goodbye. Drive safe.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and saw a big, red bird.
A red bird? Was it a cardinal?
I do not know. I ran to find my mom before it flew away.
That sounds like a fun little secret.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very scared of the big pool.
That is okay. Do you want to start in the shallow part?
Yes, the water is still too deep for my hands.
I understand. We can use a pool noodle to help you float.
I do not like the taste of the water in my mouth.
Many kids feel that way. Do you want me to sit on the edge with you?
Okay, please sit there. I will try to kick my legs.
Good luck. I am right here if you need a hand.
I did it! I swam a little bit!
You did great work. Are you ready for another try?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park for a picnic today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you bring any juice?
Yes, I packed orange juice and apple slices.
I love apples too. What did you see at the park?
I saw a big brown dog running near the trees.
Was the dog nice?
Yes, he just wanted a piece of my bread.
I am glad you shared your snack.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want a cake, but I do not know what kind.
That is hard to pick. Do you like berries?
I like strawberries, but maybe chocolate is better.
Both sound good to me. Is it for a party?
Yes, it is for my sister's birthday.
That is sweet. She may like the berry one.
I think I will get the berry one then.
Good luck with the choice.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you sell stamps here?
Yes, we do. Do you like stamps?
I want to mail a letter to my grandma.
That is sweet. Do you have a pen?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look at the calendar and I do not know what month it is.
What do you need it for?
I want to plan my summer trip, but I am not sure when that starts.
Summer usually starts in June. Do you like the beach?
I think it is winter right now because it is very cold outside.
Yes, winter is usually from December to February. Are you wearing a coat?
Yes, I am freezing, so it must be one of those cold months.
I cannot see where you are, so I do not know the exact month. Is it snowing?
No, just rain and wind, but the park trees have no leaves.
That sounds like late autumn or early winter. Do you want to make hot cocoa?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my white shirts bright again?
Use hot water and a special bleach. Do you have any bleach in your house?
Yes, I have it in the big blue bottle.
Great, that is the right kind. Is your machine clean inside?
I think so, but I am not sure.
If it smells bad, clean it first. You can do this!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no coins left.
Try cutting back on snacks. Do you eat candy often?
I am late. Help me.
Check your bank app for cashback.
That took too long.
Bring back unopened items. Do you have any?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited for my toast to pop. It took a long time.
That can feel slow. Did you sit and watch the light?
Yes, I watched the light move up. Then it popped.
Good wait. Did the toast taste warm?
It did. Waiting made me hungry.
Patience helps food taste good.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a boat to the dock?
Hold the rope tight and wrap it around the post. Do you have a rope with you?
Yes, I have a thick red one.
Good. Make a loop around the post twice. Then pull it hard to make it tight.
I wrapped it twice, but it feels loose.
Pull it tighter and add another loop. Is the rope wet?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to run fast, but my legs feel heavy.
That is good. Do you drink water before you start?
Yes, I always drink some.
Good. Keep your steps short and light.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Can you help me find my lost key?
Yes, I can look with you. Did you lose it near the door?
Why did you think I lost it there?
Because that is a common spot. Do you remember using it?
Yes, I used it a while ago.
That helps us look in the right place. We are nearly done.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a paper airplane?
I fold the paper in half, then fold the corners to the middle. Do you have a sheet of paper?
Yes, I do. What is the last step?
You fold the wings down and throw it gently. Do you want to try it now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in the big green park. I do not know which way to go.
Do not worry, take a slow walk until you see the red bridge. Do you like the smell of the flowers?
The bridge looks far away and the path is confusing. I am tired.
Just pick any direction and walk with your eyes open. Is there a bench nearby to rest?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I forgot which month comes after March.
It is April. Why does that make you feel so bad?
I have a big test soon and I am forgetting everything.
You can learn them again. Do you like playing with a calendar?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have to move my room to a new house next week. It feels very scary.
That sounds big and a bit scary, but it can be fun too. Do you have a favorite toy you want to take?
Yes, my blue dinosaur goes with me everywhere. The house is smaller than my old one.
A good dog to have by your side. Smaller houses can feel cozy and warm. Do you like small rooms?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to walk fast to get to work, but I feel so tired.
Walking is good for you. Do you have time for a short break?
No, I do not have time. I must run.
That is okay. Even a quick walk helps your heart. Do you like the fresh air?
Yes, the air is nice, but I am late.
Try to breathe slowly when you walk. Do you walk this way every day?
I try to, but it is hard sometimes.
It is a good start. Just keep moving at your own pace. Is your walk usually long?
It is short, just to the bus stop.
That is a great step. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because the trees are turning red and orange.
That is a beautiful sight. Do you like to walk outside to see them?
Yes, I do, and I want to share this feeling with you.
I am glad you told me. Thank you for sharing your joy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to park the car today. It was very hard.
That sounds like a big challenge. Did you manage to stop in the right spot?
I bumped into a pole, but only a little bit.
Ow, that must have stung. Are you okay?
Yes, my hands are shaking a bit.
It is normal to feel that way. Take a deep breath.
I want to drive again tomorrow.
That is brave of you. Do you feel ready?
I think I am ready to try.
You will do fine. I am proud of you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream cone on the grass.
That is very sad. Did you try to find the pieces?
No, but I bought a new one from the cart.
Good choice. Do you like chocolate best?
Yes, but it is too sweet for me now.
Maybe you can share it with someone. Who do you want to share with?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I dropped my phone and the screen is cracked.
I am so sorry to hear that. Did you have it in a case?
No, I did not. I am really sad about it.
That is very annoying. Do you have any photos on it?
Yes, I have pictures of my dog.
That sounds like a big problem. Do you back up your files?
I do not know if I do. I do not know how to check.
I am not sure how to fix that for you. You might want to ask a grown-up.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat on the bench for an hour today.
That sounds very quiet. Did you see anyone?
Just a man with a dog.
The dog seemed friendly. Did you say hello?
I tried, but my voice got stuck.
That can happen. Do you like walking?
I like the fresh air, but I miss talking.
Silence is okay. What do you eat when you are alone?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My legs feel heavy and my head is tired.
That sounds like your body needs rest. Do you usually lie down in a cool room?
Yes, I like the quiet dark best.
Cool and dark rooms help you sleep better. I do not know what else helps you.
I drink warm milk before bed.
That is a nice habit. Do you drink it every night?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired after work, but I need to make dinner.
That sounds hard. Do you want to cook something simple?
Yes, I am making eggs and toast.
That is a good choice. What do you put on the eggs?
Just salt and pepper, please.
That is very simple. I do not know if I am hungry yet.
You will be hungry soon, I promise.
I will believe you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run to work. I am so late.
Running is good for your heart. Do you like to run outside?
I just run on the road. It is too fast.
That is a good place to run. Do you wear special shoes?
I have no time for shoes. I must go.
Please be careful on the road. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I see the stars better at night?
Look away from bright lights for a few minutes to let your eyes adjust. Do you have a dark spot near your home?
Yes, my back yard is very dark. What should I look for first?
Start by finding the Big Dipper, which looks like a ladle. Is the sky clear tonight?
It is clear. Can I see other things besides constellations?
You might see the moon or bright planets like Jupiter.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like the red roses in the garden.
Roses are very pretty. Do you like to smell them?
Yes, they smell nice and sweet.
That is good for you. Are you holding them gently?
Yes, I do not want to hurt them.
You are being very careful. Do you want to play with me now?
Yes, I want to show you more flowers.
I would love to see them. Let us go look together.
Okay, let us go find the yellow ones.
I do not know where they are. Can you help me find them?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind hit my window hard today. It made a loud boom that scared my cat.
That sounds frightening. Did the cat hide under a blanket?
Yes, he did not come out for two hours. I felt worried about the big tree outside.
I hope the tree is strong. Do you know if it broke?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to paint a red apple, but I do not know how.
Try mixing red and a tiny bit of orange. Do you have those colors?
Yes, I have them. What should I use for the leaf?
Green works best for the leaf.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke my cup.
That is okay. Did it fall on the floor?
Yes, it hit the ground.
A sharp sound? I am sorry about that.
I feel sad now.
It is a normal feeling. Are you safe?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my clothes really clean?
Put the right stuff in the water. Do you know what that is?
I guess you mean the soap?
Yes, that is called detergent.
Should I use hot water for everything?
No, check the tag on the clothes.
Okay, I will check the tag. Do I dry them outside?
Sun is good, but cold air is fine too. How do you usually dry them?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do I start the car?
Turn the key. Do you have your keys?
Yes. The engine is loud. Is this right?
Yes, that is normal. You sound a bit scared.
It is so big. What do I do next?
Put your foot on the brake. Do you know where it is?
I am going. Thank you.
You are doing well. Watch the road ahead.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. I need to pack my bags now.
You seem very rushed. Are you scared you will miss the truck?
Yes, the truck comes soon. What should I pack first?
Pack your clothes first. Do you have a box ready?
I do not have a box. This is bad.
You can use an old suitcase. That is a good idea.
Okay, I will use the suitcase. I must go now.
Good luck with your move. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky so bright blue today?
The sun is shining hard and there are no clouds to block it. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I do. Why does it feel warm on my face?
The sun’s light turns into heat when it touches you. Do you feel like taking a walk?
I think so. Why is the grass green?
Plants use light from the sun to make food and turn green. Do you see any flowers nearby?
I see a few. Why do they look so pretty?
Nature makes them that way to help bees find them.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the month. It is too cold and dark.
That feels hard. Do you have a warm coat?
Yes, but I still feel sad. The days are so short now.
I understand. Do you like snow?
No, I hate the snow. I just want spring to come fast.
Spring is coming soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse in the park today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did it look happy?
Yes, its ears were perked up and it was eating grass.
Horses like to munch on green leaves. Do you like animals?
I think they are very gentle and soft to touch.
It is nice to be kind to living things. Did you wave at it?
I did, and the horse looked right at me with its big eye.
It is good that you shared your day. Was the sky blue today?
Yes, the sun was bright and the wind was cold.
I hope you stayed warm. What did you do next?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hurry, what time is it? I am late.
It is two thirty. Are you going to school?
No, I am meeting my friend. Is it close to three?
Yes, you have half an hour. Do you have enough time?
I think so, but I feel fast. Is it past two thirty?
Yes, it is two thirty one.
I must run now. Is it exactly two thirty two?
It is two thirty one. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sun so bright?
It makes light for us to see. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I do. Why is the sky blue?
The air makes it look blue. I think that is very pretty.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a promise to my friend. I am so happy about it.
That sounds like a great promise. What did you promise to do?
I promised to play with him after school every day.
That is a very nice thing to do. How will you remember it?
I will put a note on my desk. It makes me smile.
A note is a smart way to remember. It shows you care.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today because I helped my neighbor.
That is very sweet of you. Who did you help?
I carried her heavy bags to her door.
That was a kind thing to do. Did she say thank you?
Yes, she smiled and gave me a cookie.
What a nice treat to share your joy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My neighbour plays loud music at night. What should I do?
That sounds very annoying. Did you ask them to stop?
No, I am afraid to talk to them.
You can be polite and honest. Do they seem angry?
I think they are just loud.
Try a friendly smile first. If they do not stop, tell your parents.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to take a picture, but I do not know where to point the camera.
That is a common worry. Do you like the grass or the sky better?
I like the green grass.
Good choice. Point the camera at the bright green spot and press the small button on top.
I did that, but the picture looks dark.
Do not worry. Turn the little switch on the top to let in more light, then take it again.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like loud songs, but they make my head hurt. What should I play?
Try slow piano tunes. They are very calm. Do you like rain sounds?
Yes, I love rain.
You can find music that has both. It will help you rest.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a boat.
Wow, that is cool. What color is it?
It is blue.
Blue is a nice color. Does it have a sail?
No, it has a motor.
Oh, it goes by itself. Do you know where it goes?
I am not sure.
We can ask an adult. Do you want to go with me?
Yes, please.
Great, let us go now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so late for class today.
Oh no. Did something big happen?
Yes, my bus stopped in the rain.
That is very bad luck. Are you staying dry?
I ran fast to get here.
Good for you. What did you miss first?
I missed the morning song.
That is a shame.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the game. Do I have time?
The field is close by. Do you know where the gate is?
Yes, the main door. Is the game starting soon?
It starts in ten minutes. You should be fine.
Great. Which team is playing?
The Red Lions are playing the Blue Bears. Do you like red or blue?
I love red. Is it a good match?
Both teams are strong. It will be fun.
Thanks. I must run now.
Bye. Enjoy the ball.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want big shoes like my dad’s.
That is a bold idea. What size do you wear?
My feet are small but I want big ones.
Your feet will hurt in shoes that are too big. Do you like the red pair?
Yes, the red ones look cool.
Let’s try on the red pair that fits your feet. Do they feel comfy?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts and my feet are sore. What should I do?
Rest is the best cure. Do you have a warm blanket?
Yes, but I am too tired to make a snack. What is the right move?
Drink some water and lie down. Are you hungry or just empty?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I really love eating red apples.
Apples are very sweet. Do you peel them first?
Yes, I peel them with my knife.
That is a good skill. Do you get any juice on your shirt?
Sometimes I do get some juice.
That can be messy. What do you do when that happens?
I wash my shirt in the sink.
You are a good helper.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no time, but what is that little bug?
It looks like a ladybug. Do you like red things?
I am running late, but do they hurt?
No, they do not bite. Are they cold or hot?
I must go now, tell me more later.
Okay, I will wait for you. I do not know much else yet.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big rainbow!
It looks very pretty. Do you like the color red?
Yes, I like red. What is it made of?
It is made of light and rain. Have you seen one before?
Yes, last week. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to play the drums in my bedroom.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a drum kit yet?
No, I only have a tub and some sticks.
You can tap on the tub to start. Would you like a simple beat to try?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How can I eat better?
Eat more fruits and vegetables. Do you like apples?
I like bananas. What else?
Try some nuts for a snack. Do you have any milk at home?
Yes, I have milk. Thanks.
You are welcome. Drink water often too.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad today and I do not know why.
I am sorry you feel that way. What makes you feel heavy?
I just feel lonely and my head hurts.
That sounds hard. Do you have a friend you can talk to?
No one wants to listen to me right now.
It is good that you told me. Can we sit together for a bit?
I want you to help me feel better.
I do not know the magic fix, but I am here with you. Would you like to drink some warm water?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke the big cup. I am so sad.
Oh no, that is tricky. Are you hurt at all?
No, but I dropped it by mistake. I feel bad.
Accidents happen to everyone. Do you like it now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a very nice play today.
That sounds like a great time. What was the story about?
It was about a brave little red car.
I love how cars can be heroes. Did it have a bad guy?
Yes, there was a big black truck.
I like that the little car wins. Did you bring a snack to eat?
Yes, I had some yummy popcorn.
Popcorn makes any show better.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. My fence is broken.
A broken fence can wait. Is it a small hole?
No, a big hole. I need it fixed now.
A big hole is a problem. Do you have a new piece of wood?
I have wood, but no time.
Then you must pause. Let me help you nail it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am feeling very happy today and I want to tell everyone about it.
That sounds wonderful. Do you want to share a small smile with a stranger?
I think I will say hello to my neighbor with a big grin.
That is a very nice way to start the day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a beetle with hard wings in the dirt.
That is cool! Do you know what it is called?
I do not know its name. It looks like a tiny car.
It looks like a car because of its shape. It is safe for you to look at it.
It has six little legs and two antennae.
Yes, all insects have six legs. Do you like watching them move?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix the fence now. The wood is wet.
That is good. Do you have a tool to dry it?
I have time for one fix. Tell me if that works.
One fix is a start. Is the wood strong?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I drank too much coffee this morning. Now my hands are shaking and I cannot sit still.
Oh no, that sounds scary. Do you want to try some calm tea instead?
Maybe, but I am not sure if I like tea. It tastes a bit bitter to me.
That is okay. I do not know what you prefer, but I know honey can help. Do you have any honey at home?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am not sure what to eat. Do you have a good idea?
I think a simple soup is warm and easy. Do you like warm food?
Yes, soup sounds good. What else should I bring?
A piece of bread goes well with soup. I do not know your other meals.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My cat, Milo, is hiding under the bed. He is scared of the dog.
That can be hard to see. What made the dog start barking today?
I do not know. I think Milo is very lonely and sad.
I am not sure why he is doing that. How does he look when he comes out?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent all morning sweeping the floor. The dust was everywhere.
That sounds like a big job. Did you finish the kitchen?
I got to the living room, but my cat knocked over a vase. It broke on the rug.
Oh no, that is a mess. Did you find all the sharp pieces?
I found most of them, but I am too tired to keep looking. I want to sit down now.
You did a good job today. Are you hungry?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I failed the test again. I think I am stupid.
No, you are not stupid. Do you want to try again?
I am too tired to try now. I just want to quit.
It is okay to rest. I do not know what feels best for you. What helps you feel calm?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I draw a square?
You start by drawing one straight line down. Do you have a pencil ready?
Yes, I do. What is the next step?
Now you draw a line across the top. Make sure it is the same length as the first line.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like the big dinosaur bones.
They are very tall and cool. Do you like the T-rex?
Yes, I do. What is that round thing on the floor?
It is a button. It helps the floor stay clean.
Can I press the button?
Yes, you can press it. It makes a light flash.
Look! The light is blue.
It is a nice blue color. Do you like blue?
Yes, blue is my favorite color.
That is great. Let's go look at the birds next.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very big and heavy inside my chest.
That sounds like a scary feeling. Have you taken a slow breath?
I did, but my heart still beats fast.
Your body is just trying to protect you. Is there one small thing that helps you feel safe?
My soft blanket helps, but I still worry.
Holding it tight is a good idea. Do you want to talk about what the worry looks like?
It looks like a dark cloud with no edges.
A shapeless cloud is hard to hold. Would you like to name that cloud?
I named it "Worry."
Naming it helps you see it clearly. I am glad you shared that with me.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love making soap, but I must go.
Soap making is fun. Do you use flowers?
Yes, I put in lavender. I have to run now.
Lavender smells nice. I hope you make lots.
I do make lots. I am late for work.
Work is busy. Take care on your way.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. I need to find my keys now.
Check your pocket first. Did you look there?
No, I did not. Wait, here they are.
Great. Be careful next time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to draw a cat today but its ears looked like bricks.
That is a funny mistake. Did you try making the ears point up?
No, I just gave up and drew a square instead.
A square is a good shape. Do you like drawing squares?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do this holiday.
That feels confusing. Do you like to stay home?
I think yes, but I am not sure.
That is okay to feel that way. I will sit with you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, I left the bag on the bus.
Take a deep breath. Did you check the last seat?
No, I did not have time to look.
Let us walk back together. What color is your bag?
It is blue with a red star.
I see a blue bag over there. Is that yours?
Yes, thank you so much.
You are welcome. Did you find your ticket inside?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my perfect circle and now it looks ugly.
It still has a round shape. Does it hurt your feelings?
Yes, it is not round enough anymore.
A circle is just a shape with no corners.
I want it to be perfect again.
That is hard to fix. What do you want to do with it?
I just want to cry about it.
That is okay to feel sad. Would you like a hug?
Okay, I think it is fine now.
I am happy you feel better.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake a round loaf. How do I shape the dough?
You roll the dough into a tight ball and tuck the ends under the base. Do you have a sharp knife ready?
Yes, I do. Now, how long should I wait before baking it?
Let it rest for about an hour so it gets big and light. Do you like your crust dark or light?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is that a big red apple?
Yes, it is. Do you like sweet fruit?
The blue truck is really fast!
I cannot see it. Is it loud?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to walk but my legs hurt so I want to give up.
That feels bad, but small steps help. Do you want to try just five minutes?
My body is just too tired for that.
Rest is good too, we do not know your full story. Are you eating enough?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in time. I do not know what day it is.
Let us count them together. Is it a day for work or a day for rest?
I think it is a day for rest, but I am not sure.
That is a good feeling. Do you want to read a book?
Yes, I like books, but which one should I pick?
Pick the one that looks bright. Does it have a funny animal on the cover?
I see a red book with a cat. It looks fun.
That sounds like a great choice. Have a nice time reading.
Thank you, I will go read now.
You are welcome. Remember to check the clock later.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a small island with soft white sand.
That sounds like a lovely place. What does the water look like there?
It is blue and clear as glass.
How calm and peaceful that must feel. Do you hear any birds there?
Yes, they sing all day long.
What a happy sound for your ears. Do you plan to swim today?
Yes, I want to jump in the cool water.
Enjoy your fun swim in the sun.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am nervous about my first job. What should I do?
That is normal to feel. Do you have a clear schedule yet?
Yes, I start next week. How do I act?
Be kind and listen well. Just do your best.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a small boat in the water.
That looks fun. Do you like boats?
I want to go on it, but I am scared.
Be careful near water. Do you have a friend with you?
No, I am by myself right now.
Please do not go alone. Ask an adult for help.
But I want to see the far shore.
I do not know how to help you do that. You must wait.
Will you come with me?
I cannot swim. Let us stay here and wait.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the lake this morning. The fish did not bite.
That can be very frustrating. Did you try a different spot?
I tried by the big oak tree. I saw a shadow move under the water.
That is exciting! Was it a big fish?
It looked like a large trout. I tried to catch it, but it slipped away.
So close! Sometimes patience wins the game.
Yes, I sat there for an hour. I finally caught a small one at the end.
I am glad you had a catch. Did you keep it for lunch?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a shiny stone in the dirt. Should I keep it?
Did it fall from the sky, or did it stay in the ground?
It was under my shoe. It feels warm.
I do not know where it came from. Does the stone make any sound?
No, it is silent. I just want to be good.
Put it back where you found it. Kindness means giving things back.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I found the perfect shoes.
That is great news. Do they look cool?
Yes, they are bright red and very shiny.
Red is a fun color. Where did you see them?
They were right by the door.
I am glad you liked them. Do they feel soft?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I finished building my shed today. Did you see it?
That is great news. What tools did you use most?
I used the hammer and the saw. It took all day but it feels good.
I am glad you feel proud. Does the door open easily?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know what to bring.
That is a hard job. What do you like to eat?
I like apples.
Apples are good. Do you have a bag?
Yes, I have a blue bag.
Great choice. Is it clean?
It is wet inside.
Oh no. Do you have a dry bag?
No, I do not.
You can use a paper bag. It will work fine.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a tall tower by the water. Why is the light on?
It helps boats see where to go at night. Do you like looking at the water?
It looks very bright. Is it hot inside?
Yes, it can get warm from the big lamp. Do you wear a hat when it is hot?
Who lives up there?
A keeper lives there to watch the sea. I do not know his name.
Can I go inside and touch the light?
No, it is not safe for children. Do you have a friend who likes lighthouses?
I will come back with my mom next week.
That sounds like a fun plan. I hope you have a great time there.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the library today and found a book about dogs.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you read the whole thing?
I read three chapters, but then my cat fell on my head.
Oh no, is your head okay?
Yes, but I was very dizzy and had to go home.
I am glad you are safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to ride the train to the park.
That is a nice idea. Do you have a ticket ready?
No, I do not have one. How do I get a ticket?
You go to the small booth. The person there will help you buy it.
Is that all I need to do?
Yes, just pay and take the paper. Do you know which way the park is?
I think it is to the left.
I am not sure about the left. But you can ask the guard on the train.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say sorry?
We say sorry to show we feel bad. Do you know how that feels?
I do not fully get it.
It is a gift for the other person. It shows you care about their feelings.
So it helps us stay close?
Yes, it helps fix the hurt. Would you like to try it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bike fell over and now I feel sad.
I am sorry. Did you get hurt?
No, but my tire is flat.
That is bad news. Do you have a pump?
I do not know where it is.
Let us look together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I bake a cake?
First, you mix flour, sugar, and eggs. Do you have an oven?
Yes, I do. What is the next step?
You bake it in the oven for thirty minutes. Do you like chocolate cake?
Yes, I love chocolate. How do I tell when it is done?
Stick a toothpick in the center. If it comes out clean, it is done.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do my legs hurt after I run?
Your muscles are getting stronger. Do you drink water?
No, I forgot to.
Please drink some water now. Is it hot today?
Yes, it is very hot.
Heat makes running harder. Do you wear a hat?
Yes, I have a red hat.
A red hat is good.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The light on the tower goes round and round.
Yes, it spins to help boats find their way. Do you like watching the light?
It is very bright at night.
That is because it has a big glass ball inside. Is the ball warm?
I hope the keeper has a good view.
He can see the whole sea from up there. Do you have a favorite place to look from?
I think the waves are loud.
They sound like a rumble. Do they sound scary to you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do my lights flicker when the vacuum cleaner runs?
The vacuum uses a lot of power. Is your house old?
Yes, it is quite old. What can I do to stop it?
I am not sure of the exact fix. Do you have a meter?
Yes, I do. Should I call an electrician?
Yes, that is the safe thing to do.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how my grandpa makes his special pie.
He starts with a buttery crust. Do you like crusts?
Yes, I do. What does he put on top of it?
He uses fresh apples and a little sugar. Do you have any apples?
I have some green ones. Are they good for pie?
Green apples are very good. They stay firm when baked.
How long does it need to cook in the heat?
About forty minutes. Does your oven get hot?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw the big yellow ball in the sky today. What is it made of?
It is made of hot gas that gives us light and warm days. Do you like playing outside when it is sunny?
Yes, I do! But why does it stop shining at night?
The Earth turns around, so we face away from the sun. Do you miss the bright sky at night?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I see a big fire on the hill. Why is it there?
It might be a firework show, but I am not sure. Do you see any people near it?
I do not see anyone, just bright lights. Is it safe?
Please close your window and sit down. Do you feel scared right now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked home from school today. It was very quiet on the sidewalk.
That must feel sad. Do you like walking alone, or does it feel heavy?
It feels heavy. I wanted someone to see me.
I am here to see you now. Is your house warm tonight?
Yes, it is warm. But I still feel far away from people.
Warmth can help. What will you do to feel closer to others tomorrow?
I might say hello to the baker.
That sounds like a good step.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss my old friend so much.
That feels very sad. What made you think of them today?
I found a old photo of us together.
Photos are like little time machines. Do you want to tell me about the day?
It was just a normal day, but we were happy.
Happy days are always special. I am glad you shared that with me.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate losing. My hand was so bad.
That feels awful. Do you have a snack?
I do not want a snack. I want a win.
I get it. I cannot play for you. How did the last game go?
It was okay, but this time was worse.
That is sad. Do you like playing again?
I am not sure. My head hurts.
Rest is good. I am here if you need me.
Thanks. I think I will stop for now.
Good choice. You did your best.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I know what time it is?
Look at the two hands on the clock face. The short one tells the big numbers. Do you have a clock at home?
Yes, I do. So the long one is for what?
The long hand counts the small numbers around the edge. It goes around once every sixty seconds.
That sounds hard. Is it really that tricky?
No, it gets easy with practice. Try pointing your finger at the short hand first. What number is it on?
It is on the number three.
Great start. That means the hour is three. You are doing very well.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a dinosaur today!
That is so cool. What kind was it?
It was a big green one with sharp teeth.
Wow. Did you see any other animals?
Yes, there were also some old boats.
Nice. Do you want to see the space room next?
Yes, please, I want to see the rockets.
Great. Let us go that way.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a broken nail in the wood this morning.
That sounds tricky. Did you pull it out safely?
Yes, but I am worried the wood will rot.
Keeping it dry helps a lot. Do you have a roof yet?
I built the floor today and it feels solid.
A good start. How tall do you want it to be?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why are mountains so tall?
They grow from the earth moving under our feet. Do you like to climb them?
How do people get to the top?
They walk up using their legs and hands. Is that hard for you?
What is inside a big mountain?
It is mostly hard rock and stone. I do not know what lies deep inside.
Do animals live in them?
Yes, many animals live there to stay safe. Do you see birds flying there?
Is the air thin up high?
Yes, the air is lighter near the top. Do you want to go outside?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the river keep moving?
Water is heavy, so it rolls down to the sea. Is it a big river?
Yes, it is very wide.
Wide rivers often flow for a long time. I do not know how long, though.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to eat for lunch.
That is a common worry. Do you like warm food?
I like it warm, but I am in a rush.
A sandwich is quick to make. Do you have bread?
Yes, I have bread and cheese.
That sounds like a good choice. Is the bread fresh?
It is fresh and soft.
Then you should eat it now. Enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to swim in the ocean.
You should learn in a calm pool first. Do you like cold water?
Yes, I do not mind the cold.
The waves can be strong, so you must listen closely. Have you tried snorkeling?
No, I have not, but I am ready to try.
Take small steps and never swim alone.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I send a picture to my friend?
You click the paperclip icon, pick a photo, and press send. Do you know how to find a photo?
I think so, but I am not sure where they live.
They are usually in a folder named Pictures on your desktop. Is your desktop clean and tidy?
Yes, I can see the folder right there.
Great, just double-click it to open. Do you need help choosing a photo?
I see a picture of my dog, I like that one.
That sounds perfect, just click it once to pick it. Are you ready to send it now?
I clicked send and it is gone, did it work?
Yes, it left your computer for your friend. You did a great job!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red sock in the grass.
That is a funny place to look. Did you find the blue one too?
No, I only found the red one.
Maybe the blue one is still lost. Do you want help looking?
I want to wash the red one now.
Good idea to keep it clean. What color is your other blue sock?
It is just a plain blue sock.
I do not know where it is hiding.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I cannot stop the ice cream from melting fast.
It melts because the sun is warm. Do you have a spoon ready?
Yes, I have my big spoon.
Good. Your sweet will last if you eat slowly.
I still want it to last much longer.
Patience helps you enjoy every bite.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How does the clock know what time it is?
It does not know. It just moves by counting beats. Do you like counting?
I like counting numbers.
The clock counts its own numbers to tell you the time. It is just a fast machine.
Does it get tired from counting?
No, machines do not get tired. But they do need power to keep going.
It is like a toy that needs batteries.
Yes, very much like a battery toy. That is a great way to think about it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the shop today.
Oh, that sounds fun. What did you buy?
I bought an apple and a book.
Nice choices. Was the shop busy?
Yes, it was full of people.
That must be loud. Did you like the shop?
I did, but it was very crowded.
I understand. It can feel tight. Do you want to go back?
Maybe next week when it is quiet.
That is a good idea. Have a nice rest.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we help others?
It makes them feel happy. Do you like making people smile?
Yes, I do. But why is it good for us?
It makes our hearts warm. Do you have a warm heart today?
I think so. What if they cannot help back?
We do it because it is right. Do you always do what is right?
I try to. Is that enough?
Yes, that is enough.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the hands move?
A tiny motor spins them round. Do you know what makes a motor work?
I think it is the battery.
Yes, the battery gives it power.
Why does the little hand jump?
That is the second hand counting time. Are you keeping time too?
I just want to know when snack time comes.
The big hand shows the hour for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see many big cakes here.
Yes, they are sweet and soft. Do you like chocolate?
Yes, I do. Is there one for me?
I am not sure, let me look. Can you wait a bit?
Yes, I can wait.
Here is a small chocolate cake.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the clock make that ticking sound?
A little hammer hits the gears to keep them moving. Do you hear the gears turn?
Why does it tick one beat for every second?
That is how we measure time in small, equal parts. Is that a long or short time?
Why does the short hand move so slowly?
It moves slowly because hours are long. Do you know what an hour is?
Why does it stop if the battery runs out?
It stops because it needs power to work. Do you know where the battery is?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I rode my bike to the park today. The wind was very strong.
That sounds like a big adventure. Did you feel fast?
Yes, I felt very free. It was a happy day.
I am glad you had a good time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel tired after eating. What should I eat?
Try fruits and beans. They give you steady energy. Do you like sweet or salty things?
I love sweet things, but I eat too many cookies.
That is a lot of sugar. It makes you feel sleepy. Do you eat any vegetables with dinner?
I do not like vegetables. They taste bad.
I know they can taste strong. Try mixing them with sweet fruits. Do you have any favorite fruits?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I am late for my game but I like it.
That is a fun feeling. Do you like playing outside?
Yes, I love running in the sun.
Running in the sun feels good. What game are you playing?
We are playing tag.
Tag is great fun. I hope you catch your friend.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The rain is falling very hard. I need to go now.
Please put on your rain boots. Do you have your umbrella?
I do not have an umbrella. I must run to the bus.
That is dangerous. I do not know if the bus is on time.
The wind is pushing the trees. It sounds like a roar.
The trees are safe in the ground. Are you warm enough?
I have my coat on. I will be okay.
Your coat will keep you dry. Please look at the road.
I am going. Goodbye.
Goodbye. Please be very careful out there.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my old friend not call me anymore?
I do not know for sure. Do you miss talking to him?
Yes, I do. Why did he stop so suddenly?
Sometimes people get busy. Did you say anything wrong?
No, I did not. Why would he ignore me?
He may have changed his mind. Do you feel sad about it?
I do. Why is he so quiet?
People do not always share their reasons. Have you tried sending a short note?
I did. Why did he not write back?
He might not have seen it yet. Are you still hoping to talk?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a riddle. What gets bigger the more you take from it?
Oh, that is a nice one. Do you know the answer yet?
I think it is a hole. Is that right?
Yes, you are right. A hole gets wider when you dig it.
I am stuck on the next one. What has teeth but cannot bite?
I do not know that one. What are the clues?
It is a thing we use every day. It is long.
That sounds like a comb.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to see the old boats in the museum.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like water?
Yes, I do. How long will I be in the boat room?
It takes about thirty minutes to look at everything. Do you have other plans today?
I want to buy a small toy boat after that.
The gift shop sells small wooden boats. They are very nice.
Great. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have a happy time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have these flowers, but I do not know what to do with them.
That is tricky. Do you want to keep them for yourself?
I am not sure. Maybe I should give them to someone else?
Giving them away is a sweet idea. Who might you like to share them with?
I do not know any friends nearby right now.
I am sorry to hear that. Perhaps you can put them in a vase for now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I love how warm my tea feels in my hands.
Warm tea is nice. Do you add milk to it?
Yes, I do! Coffee is good too, but tea makes me feel calm.
That is a sweet feeling. What color is your tea?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very proud inside.
That is a good feeling. What made you proud?
I do not know why I stopped.
It is okay to not know. Did you finish the task?
Yes, but I am not sure if it was good.
You did your best, and that is true. How does your body feel now?
I feel light, like I can fly.
That is a lovely sign. Would you like to tell a friend?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do we need rain?
It helps plants grow. Do you like watching it fall?
I think the sky looks gray.
Yes, clouds make it look dim. Is it loud outside?
My shoes are wet.
I am sorry about that. I hope they dry soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a movie today where a boy flew a dragon. It was very fun. Did you like that idea?
That sounds like a great adventure. I do not know if I have seen it. What did the dragon look like?
It had green scales and long wings. I want to see it again soon.
Green wings sound very pretty. I think that is a cool hero.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend today.
That sounds nice. Who are you writing to?
My cousin who lives far away.
I do not know where he lives. Did you do anything fun there?
I fell off my bike in the park.
Oh no, are you hurt?
No, just a small scrape on my knee.
That is good news. How is the letter going?
I am telling him about the bike fall.
He will want to know if you are okay. Is the letter done?
Yes, I think it is ready to send.
That was a good start. Good luck with the mail.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a red apple, please.
Here is a red apple. Do you like sweet fruit?
Yes, but I am very late.
You can pay at the front. Is that your first time here?
No, but this line is too slow.
I am sorry to hear that. You can leave now.
Thank you so much.
I am happy to help. Have a good day.
Bye, I must run.
Go quickly. Be safe.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I ran fast today and my legs hurt.
That feels strange, does it? Are you tired?
Yes, I am very tired.
I am happy you tried. Rest your feet now.
I want to run again tomorrow.
That is a good plan. Do you like racing?
I like it when I win.
I do not know if you will win, but I know you work hard.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to look at today.
Do you like old things?
I like old cars, yes.
Go to the car hall. Is it far from you?
It is right here.
Then you are ready.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the ants ate my sandwich.
I am sorry that happened. Did you have any other snacks?
No, just that one sandwich and some fruit.
That feels really bad. Do you want to sit under the tree for a bit?
Yes, I just want to rest for a moment.
Okay, let us sit here together. Would you like me to check if there is more food in the bag?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a small island in my book. How do I get there?
That is a fun find. Do you have a map?
No, just the picture. Is it safe?
I do not know for sure. Do you see any animals?
I see some birds and trees.
That sounds lovely and calm. Do you bring food with you?
Yes, I pack an apple.
That is a wise choice. Do you like swimming?
I do, but the water looks deep.
Then stay on the dry sand. Do you have a friend to talk to?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was hot, but the grass was cool under my feet.
That sounds like a nice spot. Did you bring any fruit?
I ate a sweet apple and watched the ants move in a line.
Ants are very busy workers. Do you like watching them?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the houses in this village have such round roofs?
The rain here falls hard and fast, so round tops help it slide away. Do you like rainy days?
I do! But why is the river so clear?
The water comes from a high mountain spring, so it stays clean. Have you ever seen a mountain?
No, I have not. Why do the people smile so much here?
They share food and stories with every neighbor they meet. Do you have friends nearby?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the teacher always wear glasses?
She uses them to see the small words in her books. Do you wear glasses?
No, I do not. Why does she laugh so loud?
She finds the funny things we say very amusing. Does she laugh at you?
Yes, she does. Why is her desk so messy?
She has many papers to read at once. Do you like a tidy desk?
I like my desk clean. Why does she help everyone so much?
She wants every child to feel safe and happy. Do you feel happy in her class?
I do. Why does she leave so late?
I do not know for sure, but it takes time to plan good lessons.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do my feet stop on the pedals?
They are called cranks. Do you like the sound they make?
Why does the bike tip over when I stop?
You need to learn balance. Are you scared of falling?
Why is the front wheel lighter?
It helps you turn more easily. I do not know the exact weight.
Why do I have to push hard at first?
It takes energy to get moving. Was that very hard for you?
Why is it so fast once I start?
Momentum keeps you going.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my head hurt so much?
It is likely a headache from being tired or thirsty. Have you drunk any water today?
No, I have not.
Drinking water helps your head feel better. Do you want me to get you a glass?
Yes, please. Why does water help?
Your brain needs water to work well. Does your head feel tight?
Yes, it feels very tight.
That is a common sign of a dry head. You should rest your eyes now.
Okay, I will rest.
Resting helps your body heal. I am happy to help you feel better.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Are robots real?
Yes, they are real. Do you like seeing them on TV?
I saw one that cleans floors.
That is a helpful tool. What color was the robot?
It was silver and shiny.
Silver is a nice choice. Do you think it is lonely?
I hope it has friends.
I do not know if they feel lonely. Do you have a toy you like best?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I made coffee this morning, but I spilled it on my nice white shirt.
Oh no, that is a mess. Did you get a spare shirt?
Yes, I have one, but now my dog is sleeping on my bed and I cannot move him.
That sounds difficult. Why will he not move?
He is cold and likes the warm spot where I usually sit.
Dogs love warm places. Do you have a fan to blow on him?
No, it is too cold outside, so I do not want to make him colder.
I see. What are you trying to do first today?
I need to finish a report, but I am just staring at my computer screen.
That can be hard. Have you taken a short break to stretch?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do bees make honey?
They store it for food in the cold months. Do you like eating honey?
Yes, it is sweet. How do they get the sweet stuff?
They drink flower nectar and dry it in their bodies. Did you know they fan air to dry it?
That sounds hard work. Why do they have to do it?
Bees eat it to stay alive during winter. Do you have a favorite flower?
I like red roses. Is that all they do?
No, they also help plants grow by moving pollen. Thanks for asking!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel warm inside. Why is that?
You are happy because you did a hard job well. Did you feel tired at first?
It was hard, yes. But the end was sweet.
That is true. Priding yourself helps you keep going strong.
I want to do it again soon. Is that good?
Yes, it is very good. You can find pride in small wins. What will you try next?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to leave right now.
What is on your boat?
My dog and some apples.
That is a nice trip. Is the boat ready?
I do not know about the rope.
I do not know either. Did you check the big green one?
Yes, it looks tight.
You are all set. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not know how to do my math sheet.
That can feel hard. What are the numbers doing in the first problem?
The line has two little gaps.
We can look for clues in the other parts. Do you see any circles?
No, just big squares.
I do not know the answer yet. Let us check the picture at the top together.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Which plant is that?
It is a rose. Do you like red?
Yes. Where do I find them now?
Look in the shop. I do not know if they have any left.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with this strong wind.
You might just sit still. Do you have a warm coat?
I am lost and unsure of my next step.
Try walking toward the light.
I am confused by the noise it makes.
I do not know why it sounds so loud.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see smoke coming from the porch and I am not sure what to do.
Please leave the house right now and close the door behind you.
Oh no, I will go, but is it safe outside?
Yes, moving away from the heat is the best choice.
My hands are shaking and I do not know if I forgot anything.
Do not go back, your life is worth more than any thing.
I am at the neighbor's house and feel a bit scared.
That is good, we will call the fire department together.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I am very happy to have my first job.
That is great news for you. How are you feeling about it?
I am a little scared. Why should I be scared of a job?
It is okay to feel new things. You will learn soon. What is your first task?
I will clean the shelves. Why do people pay me to clean?
They pay you because clean things help everyone. Do you like cleaning?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel tired all the time. I do not know what to eat.
Try eating more fruits and vegetables. Do you like apples or bananas?
I like bananas. But I do not know how to plan my meals.
Start with one small change each day. Is your biggest meal breakfast or dinner?
I usually eat a big lunch. What should I put in it?
Mix greens, protein, and whole grains. Have you tried adding beans?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I tried to fix my bike but it broke more. I want to quit.
That is hard when things feel messy. Do you know which part broke?
It was the wheel. I am scared to try again.
You can do this one small step at a time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is so warm on my face today.
That feels nice. What color is the water?
It is a bright, happy blue.
I have never seen the sea before.
The sand is soft and white under my feet.
Do you like to build things in the sand?
I built a big castle for the seagulls.
The birds must be happy visitors.
I feel very free and light here.
Thank you for sharing that joy with me.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to play this song for you.
That sounds nice. What kind of music is it?
It is a fast song with drums.
I like fast songs. Do you play the drums?
Yes, I play them every day.
That is great.
My friend plays the piano too.
That is a nice mix. Do you play together?
Yes, we play every night.
I am glad you share it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I find my house on this map?
Look for the small blue lines, which are rivers. Do you see a river near your home?
Yes, there is one. Now what?
Search for a square that matches the color of the streets. Are the roads on the map the same color as real ones?
I see the squares. I am getting close.
Great job. Just look for a dot with a flag on it. Does a flag mean your house?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to climb a mountain, but I am scared.
That is good to know. Do you have strong legs?
I think my legs are fine. What else do I need?
You need warm clothes for the cold air. Do you like walking for a long time?
I like walking, but I get tired fast. Is that bad?
It is okay to rest if you need to. Do you have a friend with you?
No, I will go alone. I want to feel free.
Going alone is brave. I do not know if you are ready yet, but I hope you are safe.
I will be careful. Thank you for talking with me.
You are welcome. I hope the view is nice for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I do not know how to tie my shoes. Can you help me?
Of course. Do you know which shoe is on which foot?
Yes, I know. What do I do next?
Make a small loop with one lace. Do you see the loop?
Yes, I see it. And then?
Cross the other lace over the top of the loop. Have you crossed it yet?
I think so. Now what?
Pull both ends tight to make a knot. Are you happy with your knots?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to eat for lunch.
That is tricky. Do you like hot food?
I am very tired and just want something easy.
Try a soup and bread. Is that okay for you?
