I am actually quite hungry and want something filling.
A big sandwich might help. Do you like meat?
I can't decide if I should go out or stay in.
Staying in is often cheaper. Do you have time to walk?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my chair and I am very sad.
That sounds upsetting. What part broke?
The leg snapped right off.
I do not know how to fix wood, but a screw might help. Is the wood still firm?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go to the lake. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help. Do you like to swim in it?
Yes, I love swimming. How deep is the water?
I do not know the exact depth. Is it safe there?
I think it is safe. What should I bring?
Bring some water to drink. Do you have a towel?
Yes, I have a towel. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a nice day at the lake.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing with a nice voice.
That is a lovely goal. Do you like to sing in the bath?
Yes, I do. But I never know where to start.
Start by humming a song you know. Does that feel fun?
It feels good. How do I make my voice sound strong?
Breathe deep from your belly, not your nose.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel so tired today.
That sounds heavy. Have you rested enough?
Yes, I slept, but I am still sleepy.
Maybe your body needs a quiet break.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big promise today. I am so happy about it.
That is a nice feeling. What did you promise to do?
I told my best friend I will share my toys.
That is a kind promise. Will you play together after?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad about all the wars in the past. It makes me sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk about a happy time in history?
I tried to read a book, but I do not remember the dates. I am so slow.
It is hard to remember every date. Was there one part that you liked?
I do not know if I am doing this right. I feel very lost.
You are doing your best. Which part is confusing you?
I just want to stop and forget all of this. It is too much.
It is okay to take a break. Do you want to try one more small fact?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love drawing pictures of dogs.
That sounds very fun. What do you draw?
I like to make them wear hats.
Oh, that is cute. Do you use colors?
Yes, I use red and blue.
I like bright colors.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sky looks so big. What are those little lights?
They are distant suns. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. How can I see them best?
Go to a place with no lights. Do you have a dark spot nearby?
I think the park is dark. Why are they up there?
They are very far away. I do not know why they stay.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to learn to sing, but I am afraid.
Do not worry, everyone starts small. What song do you like most?
I like happy songs about animals.
That is a great start. Do you hum them when you play?
Yes, I hum while I jump on the bed.
Good, moving helps your voice feel free.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I need to buy something sweet, but I do not know what to pick.
That is a tricky choice. What is your favorite color?
I really like blue.
Blue is a nice color. Do you like fruit?
I am not sure. I just want a treat.
I cannot help you pick the right one. Try tasting a small piece first.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do clouds float up there?
They are made of tiny drops of water that are very light. Do you like looking up?
Yes. Why are some dark and some white?
White ones are thin, but dark ones have lots of rain in them.
Does it rain from every cloud?
No, only the big, heavy ones make rain. I do not know when they will fall.
That is nice. Why do they move so fast?
Wind pushes them across the sky. Do you watch them change shape?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am holding a big leaf in my hand.
That looks green and lovely. Is it from the tree outside your window?
Yes, but I do not know what to do with it next.
You could press it in a book or draw it down. Do you like art?
I am not sure. I just want to keep it safe.
Putting it in a jar with water works well. Would you like to try that?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky so colorful?
Rain and sun light make it. Do you like the blue part?
How does the light make it?
I think it splits into colors. Do you see a pot?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count?
We count to know how many things there are. Do you like counting your toys?
Yes, I count my blocks. Why do numbers have order?
Order helps us see which number comes next. Do you know what comes after five?
Six. Why is zero a number?
Zero means there is nothing. What is your favorite number?
I like three.
Three is a fun number to use.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go for the holiday.
What kind of weather do you like? Do you want the sun or snow?
I like warm days. I hate being cold.
Try a beach trip. It is sunny there. Do you like to swim?
I do not swim very well. I just want to relax.
You can sit by the water and read a book. That sounds nice. Do you have a good book?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I help a cow eat grass?
You can use your hands to pull it for them. Do you have a cow at your home?
I do not have one, but I have a hen. Can I help her drink water?
Yes, you can pour water into a shallow bowl. Is she thirsty right now?
She is hopping around the yard. Can I teach her to sit on a branch?
I do not know how to teach that.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: What is your favorite book?
I like The Very Hungry Caterpillar. It has bright colors and a sweet story. Do you like animals?
Why is that one your favorite?
I love how the caterpillar grows big. The ending is very happy.
Is the story true?
No, it is not a real caterpillar. It is a made-up tale. What do you like to read?
I do not know why you picked it.
I just enjoy the simple rhythm. The words are easy to say.
Can you tell me more about it?
I cannot tell you more about my feelings. But I hope you find a book you love too.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Can I wash my shirt in hot water?
Hot water can shrink it. Do you have a timer?
No timer. How long do I leave the shirt in the wash?
About thirty minutes. Is it a dark shirt?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my fish swim so fast?
It might be excited or scared. Is the water warm or cold?
The water feels fine to me.
Fish sense heat, not touch. Do you see any new decorations in the tank?
No, just the green plants.
Plants help them hide. That is good.
But why do they stop suddenly?
I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have so many things to collect. I am not sure where to start.
Do you want to pick one small group first?
Maybe my old books. But I do not know if I should keep them all.
That is a hard choice. I do not know your taste.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got off the bus and I am so happy.
That is great to hear. What did you see on the ride?
I saw a dog with a red ball.
That sounds fun. Did you wave at the dog?
Yes, I waved and it wagged its tail.
How nice that was. Do you take the bus often?
Not usually, but I love how fast it goes.
Speed is always exciting. Was the ride long?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it raining outside?
Yes, the sky is gray and wet. Do you like rain?
I do not like wet shoes.
That is a fair point. You might stay inside.
What is the sun doing?
It is hiding behind the clouds. Is it warm?
It feels cold.
I agree, it is chilly. Bring a coat.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to try on new shoes. How do I take off my socks?
You push the heel down first, then pull the rest off your foot. Do you like bright colors?
Yes, I do! How do I put the socks back on the right way?
You slide your foot in until your toes touch the end. Is it cold outside today?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My head hurts and the boxes are too heavy. I think I failed.
That sounds very hard. How many boxes are left?
Ten big ones and my cat is hiding under the bed.
You can rest for a minute. Is your cat angry?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I cannot find the right words for my letter.
That is very hard. What part is giving you trouble?
My brain is foggy. I just want to give up.
Take a deep breath. Start with how you feel today.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do birds build nests?
They need a safe place to keep eggs warm. Do you like looking at trees?
Yes, I do. Why are some feathers red?
The red comes from food like berries. Do you eat berries?
I like them sometimes. Why do birds sing in the morning?
They sing to show other birds their territory. Do you like loud sounds?
Not too loud. How do they know where to fly in winter?
I do not know the exact secret, but they follow the sun. Do you watch the sun?
Yes, it is nice. Why do they come to our garden?
They find it easy to find food and water here. Do you have water there?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at the bright colors in the sky!
Yes, a rainbow looks very pretty today. Do you like the color blue?
The red one is my favorite part.
Red is a strong and warm color. Is it at the top or the bottom?
I want to touch the end of it.
Rainbows are made of light and rain, so we cannot touch them. Do you think it is far away?
I hope it stays until dinner time.
I do not know how long it will stay. Do you want to get a snack?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to run five miles today, but my legs felt like jelly after the first mile.
That sounds hard. Did you take a break to sit down?
I did sit on a bench for a while, then I walked the rest of the way home.
That is a smart choice to listen to your body.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing by the water and I do not know where to go next.
The boats are very nice to look at. Do you like looking at boats?
Yes, they are pretty, but I am quite tired.
There is a warm bench right there. You can rest for a while.
I do not know how far it is to the town.
I am not sure of the exact distance. It is not very far, though.
I think I will just sit and watch the water.
That sounds like a good choice. Is the water calm?
Yes, it is very quiet and still.
Quiet is good for tired legs. You can stay as long as you like.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the bread so soft?
The baker used warm milk and butter. Do you like sweet bread?
Yes, I do. Why does it smell so nice?
The sugar turns brown in the heat. It makes a sweet smell.
Why is the shop so busy today?
I do not know the exact reason. Do you have a favorite snack?
I like cookies. Why are they round?
Round shapes bake evenly in the oven. They also fit better in boxes.
That makes sense. Why do the lights look warm?
Warm lights make food look cozy. Do you want to buy some?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate bugs. They are so gross.
That feels bad, I am sorry. Do you hate all kinds of bugs?
Yes, even the small ones. They are everywhere.
I do not know why they are there. Can you show me one?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I burned the rice. I feel very bad.
It is just food. You can make more. Do you still have the pot?
Yes, but I am tired. I want to stop.
That is okay. Rest first. Are you hungry?
I am hungry, but I cannot cook.
Let me help you. What do you like to eat?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my cup. I am very sad.
I am sorry it broke. Do you have another cup?
No, I do not. What should I do?
You can look in the drawer. Did you try that yet?
I did not. I think I am bad.
You are not bad. You can ask for help.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does a bicycle need air in its tires?
Air makes the tires firm so they can roll well. Do you think soft tires would roll well?
I think they would sink in the dirt. Why do I need to pedal harder when I go up a hill?
Because going up fights the pull of the earth. Is it hard for you to carry a heavy bag?
Yes, it is very heavy. Why do I use both my hands to steer?
Using both hands gives you more control to stay straight. Have you ever fallen off your bike?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to send a letter to my friend in the city.
That sounds fun. Do you have a stamp?
Yes, I have one, but I am not sure where to put it.
Put the stamp in the top right corner. Is your address on the front?
The address is on the front, but I lost the return address.
That is okay. You can write it yourself. Do you have a pen?
Yes, I have a pen and a green stamp.
Great. Now go to the blue box outside and drop it in.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate climbing. My legs hurt so much and the top is so far away.
Ouch, that sounds hard. Do you have a map with you?
Yes, but I still feel alone and tired.
The mountain is just a big rock, not a boss. Would you like to rest for a minute?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my dog wag his tail so much?
He is happy to see you. Do you like that?
Yes, I do. Why does he lick my face?
He is showing love. Does that feel good?
It is a bit messy. Why does he sleep all day?
He has a lot of energy to save. Is he tired?
Yes, he is very sleepy. Why does he bark at the cat?
I do not know for sure. Does he sound angry?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are the stars so bright?
They are very far away, so they look like tiny lights. Do you see any big ones?
Yes, I do. Do they fall down when the sun comes up?
No, they just hide behind the daylight. Do you like looking up?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must paint this wall now. It is red.
Red is a bold choice. Do you have the right tools?
I have a brush. Please go fast.
Worry not. I will finish in a minute.
I am late for work. Hurry.
I am almost done. Did you mix the color well?
Yes. Now please leave.
I am leaving. Goodbye.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does that big bird stay on my roof?
It is likely looking for food. Do you see any crumbs out there?
It looks sad. Is it hungry?
Birds look calm when they are full. I do not know for sure, but it may be tired.
Should I give it some bread?
You can try some soft bread. Does it fly away or sit still?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My new fence looks crooked and I am very mad.
I am sorry you feel this way. What kind of wood did you use?
It is pine, but the ground is very soft.
Soft ground can make a fence lean. Do you have a level to check it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to clean the floor right now. It is very dirty.
I can help you sweep the dust. Do you have a broom?
Yes, it is in the corner. Can you go get it?
I will get it for you. Is there anything else?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the teacher always wear glasses?
She needs them to see the board clearly. Do you wear glasses?
No, I do not. Why does she talk so quiet?
She wants us to listen close and careful. Do you like quiet voices?
Sometimes, yes. Why does she smile so much?
She is happy to help us learn things. Do you smile when you learn?
Yes, I do. Why does she let us go outside to play?
Fresh air helps us think better later. Do you like playing outside?
I love it. Why does she let us go home now?
I do not know why, but class is over. Do you want to go?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I move a knight?
The knight makes an L shape. It can jump over other pieces. Do you play with friends?
Yes, but I never know what to do next.
Look for open squares to move to. Try to protect your king. Is your king safe right now?
I think so. What is a check?
A check means your king is in danger. You must move it or block the attack. Do you like saving your king?
I do, but I get stuck sometimes.
That is normal. Playing often helps you learn. Do you play every day?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I love the book where a boy builds a boat out of driftwood.
That sounds like a fun story. Do you remember what color the boat was?
It was brown and very wobbly.
A wobbly boat makes a great story. Did the boy go far in it?
Yes, he went to a big island with a lighthouse.
That is a wonderful ending. Do you read it every night?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big, dark cloud come in today. It rained very hard on my roof.
That sounds like a loud, scary noise. Do you like the smell of the rain?
Yes, it smells fresh and clean. Then the sun came out with a bright rainbow.
Wow, that is a happy surprise. Was the rainbow very big and colorful?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I plug in the lamp?
Just push the plug into the wall. Do you see the small red dot?
I do. What is it for?
It shows the power is on. Is the switch on?
I think so. Why is it dark?
Check if the bulb is loose. Do you hear a buzz?
No buzz. The light is still off.
Try turning the switch off, then on. Does it work now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do next.
That is a hard feeling. What feels hardest right now?
I failed the task and feel tired.
It is okay to feel tired. Would you like to take a short break?
I am not sure if I should start over.
You can try one small step first. Do you want to try that?
Yes, I will try just one step.
Good. I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why will my magnet not stick to the wall?
That is a hard day. Is the wall made of metal?
No, it is just paint. I am so mad.
Paint is not metal, so it will not work.
So I cannot use it at all?
Not on that wall. Do you have a fridge at home?
Yes, but it is too far away.
You are right, that is far.
I feel like a failure today.
You are not a failure. Did you try a different spot?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got off the train and I feel so light.
That sounds lovely. Did you see the mountains?
Yes, they were big and white with snow.
Amazing view. Did you bring any snacks?
I had a sandwich and an apple.
Good choice. Were the seats comfy?
They were soft and warm.
Nice. Do you want to travel again soon?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I forgot my book. I am scared.
That feels bad. Do you have it at home?
Yes, I do. What should I say?
Just ask to get it. I do not know if you must call.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The wind is too loud and it makes my ears hurt.
That sounds scary. Is the wind really that strong outside?
Yes, it blows my hat off every time I step out.
I am sorry your hat flew away. Do you have another hat you can wear?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a doctor now. My head hurts bad.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a fever?
No, just a big headache. I am late for work.
Can you take a rest for a bit?
I can not wait. Where is the closest clinic?
I do not know the exact spot. Are you near the park?
I am far from the park. I am in the big mall.
There is a doctor in the mall. Go to the second floor.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my screen get warm?
The parts inside work hard and make heat. Do you play games on it?
Yes, I like games. Why do I need to let it rest?
Rest helps the parts cool down. Is the fan making a loud noise?
It is a bit loud. Why does the fan spin fast?
The fan spins to blow the heat out.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have dirty socks. How do I make them clean?
Put them in a machine with soap. Do you have a machine?
No, I do not. What else can I do?
You can wash them in a bowl. Do you have a bowl?
Yes, I do. How do I do it?
Put water and soap in the bowl. Then rub the socks.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost looking at the big blue water.
That is a beautiful place to rest. Do you like the sound of the waves?
I am not sure if I should swim in it.
Please check if the water is warm before you jump in.
The water looks a bit cold to me.
Then you should just sit by the edge and watch the fish. What color is the water where it is deep?
It looks dark green near the trees.
That color means the lake is deep and quiet. Do you feel safer now?
Yes, I think I will just watch the birds.
That is a nice choice. Have a happy time there.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The bus is going very fast.
That is a fun ride. How does it feel?
It makes me feel a little scared.
Do not worry. The driver is safe.
I like the big windows.
They help you see the trees. Do you see any animals?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Where is the bus stop?
It is right by the big tree. Is it raining?
No, it is sunny. How do I get to the tree?
Go straight and turn left. Do you see the red car?
Yes, I see it. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Hurry now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My friend is sad and I do not know what to say. I feel bad.
It is kind of you to care. Are you sitting with them now?
Yes, we are just sitting here. I want to make them stop crying.
You can just listen to them. Do you have any toys or games?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do robots have feelings?
No, robots do not feel things. Do you have a favorite robot?
I like the ones that clean.
That is a good job for them. Do they make your room nice?
Yes, they pick up my toys.
That is very helpful. Do you want a robot friend?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: It is so hot outside. I need to leave right now.
Yes, the sun is very strong. Do you have a cold drink?
No, I forgot. I must run.
That will help you cool down. I hope you get there safely.
Thanks. Bye.
Good luck with your walk. Is it far?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I need a book about space, please.
We have many space books. What kind of things do you like to read about?
I like stars and rockets.
That is great. You will find them on the top shelf.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very tired today. I want to learn how to make a sandwich.
That is a nice idea. Do you have bread?
Yes, I have bread. What do I do next?
Put some meat and cheese on the bread. I do not know what you like on it.
I like it plain. How do I cut it?
Use a sharp knife to cut it in half. Is it for lunch?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to draw a smiley face.
That is a fun thing to do. Do you have a round pencil ready?
Yes, I have one. What do I do first?
Draw a big circle and then add two dots for eyes. Do you like drawing circles?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am moving my home to a new place.
That is a big change. Do you have a truck?
I do not know what to pack first.
Start with the books and toys. Do you have boxes?
I feel very tired just thinking about it.
Take a break and drink some water. Are you eating well?
I just want to be done with this day.
You can do this one step at a time.
Thank you for helping me think.
I am happy to help. Good luck with your move.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad because I forgot to say thank you.
That is a small mistake. Are you feeling better now?
Not really, I think I am rude.
You are not rude. Do you want to say it now?
I will go tell her later.
That is a good plan. You can learn from it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
They use roots to pull water from the soil. Do you have a plant at home?
Yes, I want to learn how to water mine.
Pour water slowly around the base until the soil is wet. I do not know your exact plant needs.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is so cold outside. I do not know what to wear.
A warm coat and a scarf are good. Do you like red coats?
I have a blue one and a black one. Which one is best?
Blue is nice and bright. Is your blue coat thick enough for snow?
Yes, it has a big hood. But my hands are very cold.
Wool gloves will fix that. Do you have gloves in your bag?
I forgot them at home. I will go back and get them.
That is a smart plan. Keep dry and warm.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have twelve months in a year?
It takes about 365 days for the Earth to go around the Sun. Do you know what a day is?
A day is when the sun comes up and goes down. But why is July only one month and not two?
We split the year into twelve equal parts so our calendars make sense. Do you have a favorite month?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My new computer is very fast. I am so happy.
That is good news. What games do you play on it?
It runs my favorite program with no lag.
Nice. Do you share it with your friends?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today and I want to tell you why.
That sounds great. What made you smile?
I read a book about robots that can help people.
That is a nice thought. Do robots have feelings?
I do not know, but I hope they are kind.
That is a sweet wish. Thanks for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a very bad dream last night.
That sounds scary. What did you see?
I was trying to fly but my wings broke.
Ouch. Do you have a favorite book to read now?
Yes, I read about a happy dog all day.
A nice way to feel better. Did you eat a warm snack?
I had soup and toast for lunch.
That sounds lovely and safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake bread in this small village.
I can teach you to mix flour and water. Do you have a big bowl at home?
Yes, I have a big bowl. What do I do next?
Mix it well until it feels soft. Do you like sweet things?
I love sweet things like honey. How long do I wait?
Wait one hour for the dough to grow big. I do not know your exact time zone.
I am in the village, so time is simple here. What is the last step?
Put it in the hot oven until it smells nice. Do you have a wooden spoon?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why are some clouds white and some dark?
Dark clouds hold a lot of rain water. Do you see rain when they are dark?
Yes, the sky turns gray.
That water blocks the sunlight. Do you like watching the rain?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My neighbor is very loud and I do not like it.
That can be hard. Do you play outside?
I like quiet, but I want to play.
Loud people are not always bad. Is he nice to you?
Sometimes he gives me cookies.
That is very kind.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad and scared right now.
I am here with you. What is making you sad?
I got a bad grade and my parents are angry.
That feels like a heavy weight. Do you want to talk about the test?
Yes, I thought I knew the answers, but I did not.
I do not know how to fix the past. Are you eating and drinking water?
No, I just want to be alone for a bit.
That is okay to need space. I will wait right here if you want to talk later.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My beans are all yellow and the leaves are falling off. I am so sad. I think I killed them.
Do not worry. Plants can look sick but still live. Are you giving them water every day?
Yes, I water them a lot. But they are still dry and brown.
Too much water can hurt the roots. I do not know your exact soil. Do you have a pot with a hole in the bottom?
No, I use a big bucket with no holes. It feels heavy now.
That is why the roots are drowning. Put the plant in a pot with a hole. Let the old water drain out.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have the cans of paint, but I do not know what to make.
Do you like animals?
Yes, I do, but I am afraid my cat will look wrong.
Start with a big circle for the face. It is okay to make mistakes.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What time is it?
It is 8:15. Do you have a big meeting?
I need to leave now. How do I read the clock?
The short hand points to the hour. Does that help you?
The long hand is on the 3. Is that a quarter past?
Yes, it is a quarter past the hour. Are you almost ready?
Thank you. I must run.
Good luck on your way. See you soon?
No time to talk. Bye.
Bye. Take care.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have five apples and need to put them in three bags. How do I share them?
You can put two in one bag and one in each other bag. Are you running late for school?
No, just lunch. But how many ways can I split the rest?
You have one apple left to decide. Do you like the red or green ones better?
Red, please. I must go now.
Put the red one in the middle bag. Have a nice lunch.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I felt so sad because my teacher did not smile at me today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you try to talk to her?
I wish I could, but I am afraid she might be angry.
That is a scary feeling to have. Is there something she did that made you worry?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I tried to tie my shoes but failed. What should I do?
Try one more time. Are you feeling angry?
I feel bad. Do I give up?
No, do not give up. Do you want to try with me?
Okay. How do I start?
Make a loop with one lace. Do you see the little hole?
Yes, I made a loop. Now what?
Cross the other lace over it. Did it work this time?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My grandpa has white hair.
That is a sweet detail. Does he have a beard?
Yes, it is soft and tickles.
I bet it feels nice to touch. What color are his eyes?
They are brown like the dirt.
Brown is a warm color. Do you have brown eyes too?
I think so, but I am not sure.
I do not know for certain either. Is it sunny outside today?
Yes, the sun is very hot.
Hot days are great for playing.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not like math. It is hard.
Math can be tricky. Do you like drawing?
Yes, I draw horses.
That sounds fun. Are they brown?
No, they are black.
Cool. I do not know much about horses.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the song so sad to listen to?
It sounds sad because the singer feels lonely. Do you feel that way too?
I do not feel lonely, just tired. Why does the music make me sleepy?
Slow songs with low sounds help our bodies rest. Do you like to rest?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to write a letter, but I do not know how to start.
That can feel hard. What is the letter about?
I want to tell my friend that I am moving away.
That is a big change. Do you feel sad or excited?
I feel both, which makes it tricky to say.
Write how you truly feel first. Do you want tips on what to say next?
Yes, please help me with the middle part.
Tell a short, happy memory together. Do you have one in mind?
We shared a huge ice cream cone last summer.
That is a sweet memory. End by saying you will write soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
They use roots to pull water up from the soil. Do you like to see the roots?
Yes, I do. But how does the water get to the leaves?
It moves up through tiny tubes inside the stem. I do not know exactly how fast it goes.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the big drops! I love this rain so much.
It looks very wet out there. Do you like being outside?
Yes, I jump in the puddles and make loud splashes!
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you wear your boots?
Yes, my yellow boots! They are my favorite ones for wet days.
Yellow is a bright color. Do they keep your toes dry?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The well in the village square is dry, and I feel so sad about it.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you think it is because of the heat?
I do not know why it is dry, but it makes me worry for the farmers.
That is a fair worry. Would you like to help check the other wells?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the big light on the hill today. The beam was bright in the dark sea.
That sounds like a peaceful walk. Did you see any ships by the water?
Yes, one ship passed slowly and looked small. I felt happy watching the light guide it.
How lovely that the light helped you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel sad inside.
That is a heavy feeling. Do you want to tell me why?
I do not know why, but I just feel blue.
Sometimes sadness comes for no reason at all. Is it a quiet kind of sad?
Yes, it is quiet and cold.
It is okay to not know the answer. How are your feet feeling right now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am lost and late. Please help me find the train.
Do you have a map? Check the blue sign.
No map. I do not know which way to go.
Go north. Is that right?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today.
That sounds nice. Did you see any flowers?
I saw a tall, old fence.
Was the fence made of wood?
No, it was made of iron.
Iron fences are strong. Do you like strong things?
It looked a bit rusty.
Rust means it needs love. I am not sure what you did next.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My grandpa gave me a red apple today.
That sounds nice. Did you share it with him?
No, I ate it all by myself.
He might have felt left out. Did he look sad?
Yes, his eyes were a bit low.
You can tell him you are sorry.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for the bus.
Do you have time for a quick gift?
No, I must go right now.
I do not know where you are going.
Just wait by the door.
Is it for my birthday?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a bird feeder. Can you show me how?
Yes, we can use a plastic bottle. Do you have a bottle at home?
How do I fill it with seeds safely?
Just cut a small hole near the bottom and pour the seeds in. Do you like sunflowers?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My head hurts so bad. I hate the doctor.
I am sorry you feel bad. Do you want to hold my hand?
No, I just want to go home.
We can go home soon. Is your stomach hurting too?
Yes, it feels like a stone in there.
That is not good. Let me call my mom to help.
Please do. I feel very small and scared.
I am here with you. Do you want to drink some water?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like Monday because I get to play.
That sounds fun. Do you play with a friend on Mondays?
Yes, we run in the park.
Running is good for your body. What do you eat for lunch after running?
I eat a sandwich.
Sandwiches are tasty. Do you like cheese or jam in your sandwich?
I like cheese.
Cheese is good. Do you have a favorite color for your cheese?
White cheese is best.
That is a nice choice. Do you share your lunch with anyone?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The water looks so big and deep. I am not sure if I should jump in.
That is a big choice. Do you know how to swim?
I can float, but I get scared of the waves. They look so strong.
It is good to be careful. Is the water warm enough?
Yes, it feels nice on my feet. But what if I get too far out?
I do not know for sure where the end is. Do you want to stand in the shallows first?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a kite?
You need paper, sticks, and string. Is it windy outside today?
Yes, it is very windy.
Good. You can start by making a diamond shape. Do you have any scissors?
Yes, I have small ones.
Great. Cut the paper carefully. Would you like help with the next step?
Yes, please tell me next.
Attach the sticks to the corners. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I know when my bread is ready to bake?
Touch the top. If the dough feels soft and springy, it is likely done. Do you like sweet or salty bread?
I like sweet bread. How much sugar should I add?
Start with two tablespoons for a basic loaf. You can always add more later. Is your kitchen warm today?
Yes, it is warm here. What else should I do?
Let the dough rest in a quiet spot until it doubles in size. I do not know your exact timing, but look for that big change. Do you have a bowl big enough for it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to learn a new language. Where do I start?
Start with five new words a day. Do you have a favorite color?
I like blue. It is a nice word.
That is a great word. Practice saying it out loud. Do you have a timer?
Yes, I have a phone. I can use it for ten minutes.
Ten minutes is a perfect start. You will get better with time. Good luck!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do horses have long tails?
They use their tails to swat away flies and bugs. Do you have any pets at home?
I don't have any. Why do they eat so much grass?
Their bodies need lots of food to keep moving and strong. I bet they enjoy grazing in the field.
That sounds fun for them. Why do they look at us with big eyes?
I am not sure exactly why they look so closely. Maybe they are just curious about you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I want the soup. Why is it hot?
It is hot because we just cooked it. Do you like spicy food?
No. Why is the bread white?
The flour is white. Would you like some butter?
Yes. Why do you add salt?
Salt helps the food taste good. Do you want to share?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sun feels too hot today.
It is warm outside, yes. Do you have a hat?
I do not. I want to stay cool.
A hat helps keep your head cool. Would you like to find one?
Yes, I would like to find one.
That is a good plan. Let us go look for one.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall down? I am late!
The days get cold. Does that make you feel tired?
No, I just need to go. What else happens?
The tree sleeps to save energy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I need to finish this letter now.
Take a deep breath. Do you know who you are writing to?
Yes, I just cannot find the right words.
Start with "Dear" and say how you feel. Is it a happy letter?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My neighbor dropped a heavy box from his window today.
That sounds like a big crash. Did it break anything?
No, the box was soft, but my cat ran inside and hid.
Cats hate loud sounds. Is your cat okay now?
She came out ten minutes later and looked very calm.
She must have used her quiet time to rest.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to paint this wall blue. I am late.
Blue is a happy color. Do you have the brush ready?
Yes, but the wall is too tall.
You can use a roller for the big parts. Is the paint cold?
No, it is warm. It is very thick.
Mix in a little water to thin it. Do you have a cup?
I have a cup. I must go now.
You can do this. Take your best shot.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a rainbow, but I am not sure what to do.
That is a happy sight. Do you want to take a picture?
I do not have a camera with me.
You can just look at it with your eyes. Is the sky still cloudy?
The clouds are moving away now.
It may fade soon, so enjoy it. Do you see all the colors?
Yes, I see red and yellow clearly.
That is wonderful. Maybe you can tell someone about it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do the leaves turn red and fall off the trees?
They fall because the days get shorter and colder, so the tree needs to save energy. Do you like seeing them in the wind?
Yes, I do. Is the tree sleeping while it has no leaves?
You could say it is resting until the warm weather comes back. Do you think it will wake up soon?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure how to fix my meeting list.
Do you have the times written down?
Yes, but I forgot the room number.
I do not know the room, but you can call them to ask.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I caught no fish today. What should I do?
Try moving to a new spot. Do you know where the fish like to hide?
Yes, they like the shady part of the pond.
Great spot. Try a smaller worm next time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I have some coins. How do I make them grow?
Put them in a bank to earn more. Do you have a piggy bank?
How does a bank give me more money for free?
They share a small part of their profit. Is your job giving you extra cash?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired of waiting here.
I hear you. Is it taking longer than you thought?
Yes, it feels like the whole day is gone.
Time can feel slow when we are bored. What are you thinking about?
Just that I do not want to wait anymore.
That is a very fair feeling.
Will it end soon?
I do not know for sure. Do you want to sit or stand?
I will sit down, I suppose.
That sounds like a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the moon is gone.
It is only hiding behind clouds. Do you like bright nights?
The sky looks dark and lonely.
It is just night time. The stars are still there. Do you see them?
I feel a bit better now.
The moon will come back soon. You did a good job feeling less sad.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a shop that sells bright red apples.
That sounds very nice. Do they have green ones too?
Yes, they do, and they taste sweet.
Good for you. How much do the apples cost?
They are cheap, so I bought ten.
Happy shopping day. Was the shop busy?
It was quiet, so I felt calm.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind blew hard today. I saw a leaf drop from the big tree by the school.
That is how trees stay warm in winter. Do you like watching the leaves fly?
I chased one that landed in my shoe. It was dry and brown.
Trees drop leaves to save energy. Did you keep the dry leaf?
I put it in my pocket. It crunched like a cracker.
The crunch is a sign it is crisp. Was the pocket too full?
It fell out on the bus ride home. I missed my leaf.
That is a sad way to lose a treasure. Did you feel a little sad?
Yes, but I picked up a new one near my house. It is red and bright.
A red leaf is a lovely gift. Do you think it will stay in your pocket this time?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I fell down while walking to school, but I got up and kept going.
That shows you are strong. Did you get a scrape?
Yes, a small one. I felt a bit sad at first, but then I saw the sun.
The sun always brings light. Did you smile later?
I did. I am glad I tried again.
You did a great job. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I caught nothing today.
That is hard. Do you like fish?
I do like them, but the line is empty.
Many good days end with zero fish. What is your favorite bait?
I used worms, but they were gone.
Worms are tricky. Have you tried corn?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got an A on my math test today!
That is wonderful news. How did you feel when you saw the grade?
I felt really happy and proud of myself.
You should be. Did you study hard for it?
Yes, I practiced all evening.
Hard work always pays off. What will you do to celebrate?
I am going to eat a big slice of cake.
That sounds delicious. Do you like strawberry or chocolate?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I got on the yellow bus this morning. The rain was loud on the roof.
That sounds cozy but noisy. Did you find a seat right away?
No, I had to stand next to the driver for a while.
Standing can be tiring. Did someone give you a ride eventually?
Yes, a kind man stood up for me near the end.
That is a nice surprise to start your day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am hungry and want a nice place to eat.
A cozy cafe sounds good. Do you like sweet food?
I like pizza and pasta.
The bakery next door has warm bread. Do you have a car?
Yes, I drive to work every day.
Great. It is close to your home. Do you need a table for two?
Yes, I am going with my friend.
You should call ahead. It is busy at noon.
Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have a good time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I tried and I failed. I do not know what to do now.
That feels bad, but you can try again. What part was the hardest for you?
I just want to stop. I feel so small and stuck.
Taking a short rest is okay. Do you want to try a small step first?
I guess I will take a rest. I am too tired to think clearly.
Resting is a kind thing to do. When you wake up, will you try a tiny bit?
Yes, I will try just one tiny thing. Thank you for waiting with me.
I am here if you need help. You are doing better than you think.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at the tall peaks. I do not know if I should climb them or just sit here.
That is a big choice. Do you feel safe on the ground?
The air feels thin up there. I am afraid my legs will shake.
Your body tells the truth. Is your heart beating fast?
It beats like a drum. I think I will stay down for now.
That sounds like a good and true plan.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My grandmother baked apples today.
That sounds very sweet. Did she use cinnamon?
Yes, she put a lot of spice in it.
I love the smell of baking. Was the house warm?
It was very hot in the kitchen.
Yum, apple pie! Did you share a piece?
I ate the very first slice.
Well, I am glad you enjoyed it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Where is the next bus?
It is coming to this stop soon. Are you going far?
I need it right now. Is it full?
I do not know if seats are open. Do you have a pass?
Yes, I have a pass. It is almost here.
Look, the lights are on. Will you be okay?
The door is open. I must go.
Take a deep breath. Have a good trip.
Thank you. I am running.
Please be careful. Good luck today.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the ground get wet and green in spring?
The rain wakes the seeds up. Do you like to play in the mud?
Yes, I do. Why is the air so hot in summer?
The sun shines down for a long time. It makes everything warm.
That makes sense. Why do leaves turn red in fall?
The trees stop making green food. I do not know exactly how the red color starts. Do you like to pick apples?
I love apples. Why does it snow in winter?
The air gets very cold and the water turns to ice. It feels like magic, yes?
It does. Why do we have seasons at all?
The Earth tilts as it goes around the sun. This changes how much light we get.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to paint the sky blue today.
That sounds like a nice start. Did you get the color right?
No, it came out a bit purple.
Purple can be beautiful too. Why did you choose blue?
I wanted it to look like day.
That is a happy goal. Do you like painting outside?
Yes, the fresh air helps me think.
It is great that you enjoy it. What will you paint next?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I do not know how to put rice in the pot.
Put the rice in a bowl and wash it with water. Do you like your rice soft?
I want the rice soft like a cloud.
Use two cups of water for one cup of rice. Then turn on the heat.
How do I know when it is done?
Open the lid and see if the water is gone. Do you wait for the steam?
Yes, I wait for the steam to stop.
That is a good way to check. Now let it sit for five minutes.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I had a scary dream last night.
I am sorry you are sad. Were you falling in the dream?
Yes, the floor broke and I went down.
That feels bad. Do you like sweet food?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to make the clock tell time.
What does the face of your clock look like?
It has twelve numbers and two hands, but I am not sure which is which.
The short hand shows the hour, and the long hand shows the minutes. Do you see a ticking sound?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn how to draw cats.
That is a fun goal. Do you have any pencils?
Yes, I have many pencils. I just feel my hands are clumsy.
Practice makes you steady. Try drawing one simple circle first.
I will try that. What if it looks wrong?
It will look right soon. Do you like drawing faces?
I think I do. Thanks for helping me.
You are welcome. Keep trying.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights are off in my room. What should I do?
First, check if the switch is on. Do you see if it clicks?
It is on, but the light does not work.
Try plugging in a lamp to see if it works. Does the lamp light up?
The lamp works fine.
That means the bulb in the light is dead. Do you have a spare bulb?
I do not have a spare.
You are safe to wait for an adult to help you. Is your house quiet?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the stream look so clear?
The water flows over smooth stones. Do you like to fish there?
Why is the tree on the hill so tall?
It has stood there for a hundred years. Is it warm today?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do sad songs make me feel good?
They help you let go of feelings. Do you like slow songs?
Yes, why do drums hit so hard?
I do not know for sure. Do you like loud music?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big new shed in my yard. It is very strong and looks great.
That sounds like a wonderful project. What color did you paint it?
I used a nice bright red for the walls. I hope you can come see it soon.
I would love to look at your work. Thank you for sharing that joy with me.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to make a nice wedding cake.
That sounds fun. Do you have a big oven at home?
Yes, I do, but it is very old.
That is okay. First, you need flour, sugar, and eggs.
What do I do with them?
Mix them together in a bowl. Do you have a spoon?
Yes, I have many spoons.
Great. Then bake it for one hour.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix this wall right now. What brush size works best?
A medium brush works well. Do you have a clean rag?
No, I only have my shirt. Can I use that?
Yes, that is a good idea. Is the paint dry?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like winter best. It is so cold and my hands feel like ice blocks.
That sounds chilly! Do you like wearing your big, warm boots?
Yes, but I miss green leaves. They are all gone from the trees.
Trees sleep in winter to rest their roots. Do you think they dream about spring?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so tired and late. I need to go now.
That sounds very hard. Do you have time for a sip of water?
No, I am rushing to the train. It leaves soon.
I hope you catch it. Was the work really that bad?
Yes, the boss was very angry at me. I feel bad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk about it later?
Maybe. I must go or I will miss it.
Take your time to breathe. See you soon?
Okay. I will talk to you tomorrow.
Good luck on the train.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes. Can you tell me what to do?
Yes, I can help you. Do you have laces on your shoes?
Yes, I do. What is the first step?
Make a loop with one lace. I wonder if you like making loops?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I need to pack my books for the move.
That is a great start. Do you have a big box ready?
Yes, I have a large box.
Good. Where do you keep your favorite book?
It is in the top drawer.
Nice. Do you know how to lift the box?
I am not sure. My back hurts.
I do not know your body, but ask for help. Is someone coming to help you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel sad because my money bag is empty. What should I do?
That sounds tough. Do you still have your lunch box?
Yes, I have my lunch box, but I want to buy a toy too.
Try to wait one day before you spend. It helps you save a little more.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure how bees make sweet food.
Bees eat sweet plant drinks called nectar. Do you like sweet things?
I think they just make it in their hive.
They chew it and put it in tiny rooms. It dries out to become thick honey.
That is hard for them to do alone.
They fly back and forth all day long. Is that a lot of work?
Yes, I will go look at the hive now.
You are going to find out the rest yourself. I am glad you are curious.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I find it hard to sleep after reading for a long time.
That is a common feeling. Do you read in a dark room?
No, I use a bright lamp on my desk.
Bright light can wake up your brain. Try a dimmer light instead. Do you like that idea?
Yes, a dim light might be better.
It is a good change. What kind of books do you read?
I usually read exciting stories.
Exciting tales can keep you awake. I do not know one perfect fix, but try calmer books. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the king move only one step?
It moves one step to stay safe. Do you like keeping your king safe?
Yes, I do. Why can the queen move so far?
She is strong and fast. She can go any way on the board.
Why do we play games at all?
We play to have fun and think. Do you play for fun?
I think it is hard. Why are castles called rooks?
I do not know for sure. They look like old stone towers.
Why can a pawn only move forward?
It is like a soldier marching ahead. It cannot go back.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad inside today.
I am sorry to hear that. What made you feel this way?
My favorite toy got broken.
That is a very unfair thing to happen.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the red house?
Go down that path. Is your heart beating fast?
Yes, it is. How far is it?
It is one big step away. Do you see it?
I do. Thank you.
Go now. I hope you make it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so tired. I do not know what to do.
Resting helps. Are you sleepy?
I tried to nap, but my brain will not stop thinking.
That is hard. Try closing your eyes for just one minute.
I keep looking at the clock. Time feels too slow.
I understand that fear. Do you want to just sit quietly?
Maybe. It is not easy to stop moving.
Slow breaths can help. Do you want to try one with me?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I forgot my pencil for the test.
That is a common mistake. Did you try to borrow one?
I looked at my desk, but it is empty.
That sounds frustrating. Do you have any other supplies?
I have my notebook and a pen.
A pen is a good backup. Is your teacher strict about tools?
She said we must use pencils for math.
That rule makes sense for erasing. Don't worry, you can still do fine.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why should I walk for my health?
Walking makes your heart and legs strong. Do you like to feel full of energy?
That sounds good. How much do I need to walk?
A few minutes a day is a great start. Do you have a favorite place to walk?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lights just went out and I am so happy about it.
That is a very odd feeling. Do you like the dark?
I love the dark because it is quiet and calm.
I understand why you like the quiet.
We are going to eat food in the dark with a candle.
That sounds like a fun way to spend the night. Is the food tasty?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a warm cookie in my hand. It is so sweet.
That sounds nice. Do you like the smell?
Yes, it smells like sugar and honey. I want to give you a bite.
Thank you, that is very kind. Is it soft inside?
It is soft and warm. I am glad you are here.
I am happy to help you share.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know why the sky is blue.
Sunlight has many colors. Do you know how a rainbow works?
It is hard to tell you.
Blue light scatters more than red. It makes the sky look blue.
I still feel confused.
Think of it like dust in a sunbeam. Does that help you see it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is my grandma still alive?
I do not know. Do you miss her?
Yes, I miss her. Can she hear me?
I cannot say for sure. Do you write to her?
No, I do not. How can I talk to her?
You can close your eyes and think of her. What is your favorite memory?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a riddle. What has four legs in the morning, two at noon, and three in the evening?
That is a man. He crawls as a baby, walks as an adult, and uses a cane when old. Do you like riddles?
It is a man, yes. But why is the helper so sure?
I am sure because it is a classic story. Have you tried other riddles?
I have one more. What gets wet while it dries?
That is a towel. It absorbs water to dry things. Do you keep a towel?
Yes, I do. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. I am glad I could help. Do you have any more questions?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a new movie today and I am so happy to talk about it.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What made you feel so happy?
The story was full of light and big, bright colors.
I can imagine how pretty that must look. Do you like bright movies?
Yes, I do. It was the best thing I saw all week.
I am glad you enjoyed it. I do not know if I have seen it yet.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My brother broke his toy car today.
Oh no, that is sad to hear. Did you help fix it?
Yes, we used some tape on it.
That is a clever idea. Do you play with cars?
We played in the mud for an hour.
Mud is fun but it gets everywhere. Did you get dirty?
My shirt is very brown now.
You must have had a good time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why am I putting this red cup in my bag?
So you can drink water when you are thirsty. Do you like cold water?
I have clothes. Why do we need the small towel?
It wipes your hands if they get dirty. Are your hands clean now?
What is this white box?
I do not know what is inside. Do you want to open it to check?
I packed a book. Why is the bag so heavy?
Books are very heavy. Do you have a big shoulder?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The lights just went out. Is the house broken?
I am not sure if the house is broken. Did you see a spark?
No, there was no spark. It just stopped all at once.
That is good to hear. Is it dark outside too?
Yes, the whole street is dark. Do you know why?
I do not know why. It might be a big issue. Do you have a candle?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to paint a red apple. How do I start?
Pick a bright red color and draw a circle. Do you have a round object to trace?
I have an orange. Can I use that?
Yes, trace around the orange on your paper. Do you have a pencil ready?
I traced it. Now what?
Fill the circle with red paint slowly.
It looks like a blob, not an apple.
Draw a small green stem on top to help.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do bees make sweet honey?
Bees eat flower nectar and spit it back into honey pots. Do you like honey on toast?
Yes, I do. How can I make my own?
You cannot, because bees are the only ones who know the special dance. Do you see any flowers outside?
I see some red roses. Can I help them?
You can plant more flowers to help the bees come. Do you have a shovel?
I have a small trowel. Will the bees like me?
If you are quiet and kind, they will stay happy. Do you promise to be gentle?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to book a flight. Which month is best for snow?
December is very cold. Are you going to ski?
No, I just want a white Christmas. Is January good?
January has lots of snow too. Do you like cold weather?
Yes, I do. How many weeks are in that month?
It has about four and a half weeks. Does that work for you?
Yes, it does. Thanks. I have to run now.
You are welcome. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what happens next in my story.
That sounds hard. Who is the main person?
A small dog who lost his bone.
Maybe he finds a friend to help him. Is he scared?
Yes, he is very scared of the dark.
That is a good feeling for a story.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Did you know how bees make honey? I am so happy to tell you about it!
That is sweet of you to share. What part do you like the most?
They fly to flowers to drink sweet liquid. Then they put it in their special pouches to carry home.
Oh, I did not know they had pouches. Do they change it right away?
They fan air over the drops to dry them out. Then they store it in waxy rooms to eat later.
That is a smart way to save food.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people sing?
Singing shares feelings. Do you like music?
It feels good to hum.
Yes, it helps you feel free.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a big A on my test today.
That is very good work. Did you study hard for it?
Yes, I read the book twice.
I am glad you felt ready. Was the test hard or easy?
Some parts were tricky, but I did well.
You did a great job. What will you do now?
I want to tell my mom and play.
That sounds like fun. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The museum is closed.
That is very sad to hear. Did you plan to see the big robot?
Yes, I wanted to see it. I waited a long time.
That feels unfair. Do you want to try again tomorrow?
I hope so. I really like that robot.
It is a very cool robot. Do you know if they have a gift shop?
I think they do. I want a small toy.
A toy would be nice. Do you like dinosaurs?
No, I like robots. I am still upset.
I get it. You should take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The lights went out. How do I light a candle?
Do you have a match? Just strike it on the box.
I do not have matches. Can I use a phone?
That is not safe. Is there a backup battery at home?
No, I have no backup. What else can I do?
You must wait for the power to come back. I am sorry, I do not know how to fix the wires.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have too many coins, but I do not know how to save them.
That is a good start. Do you have a place to keep them?
I guess I do, but it feels messy and I worry I will lose track.
You can use a jar or a box. Would a labeled jar help you feel better?
Yes, that sounds easier, but I still worry about spending them.
Try to put them in the jar first when you get them. Do you usually spend money on snacks?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the moon change shape?
It does not really change. It is just the light we see. Do you see the dark spots?
I see some dark patches on it.
Yes, those are called craters. They look like little holes. Do you like looking at the sky?
I do, it is very quiet and calm.
That is a nice place to think. I love the stars too.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to throw a ball far away like my old friend did.
That is a great goal. Do you like parks?
Yes, I go there often to watch birds.
Great. Hold the ball at your chest and lean back.
How do I know when to let go?
I do not know your exact timing. Do you feel strong arms?
Yes, my arms feel ready.
Good. Swing your arm up and push it down fast.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a blue box with a bow on the porch. Who is it for?
It might be for you. Do you like the color blue?
I think so. But it feels too big for me.
It could be for a friend. Who is your best friend?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I met a new friend at school today.
That is very nice. What did you play together?
We played tag and ate crackers.
Oh, that sounds like fun. Do you want to see him again?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up and saw three red apples on the table.
That sounds nice. How many did you eat?
I ate two, but my dog took the last one.
Oh no, that was mean. Did the dog look guilty?
Yes, he hid under the bed with the apple.
He must be silly. Do you have more fruit left?
No, but I found four cookies in the jar.
Cookies are sweet. Can you share one?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big bear in the forest this morning.
That sounds exciting. Was it near your house?
It was eating berries by the river.
Bears love sweet food. Did you take a photo?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run, but do you like pop or rock?
I like both. Do you have a favorite song?
I am late, so I must go now.
Have a good day. What is your hurry?
I will see you later.
Bye then. Do you have fun at work?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad because I am all alone in my room.
I am so sorry you feel that way. Do you have a teddy bear with you?
No, but I have my dog. He is sleeping on my feet.
That is nice. Does he snore a little?
Yes, he snores very loud. It makes me feel less quiet.
I am glad you have him.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just went for a long run and I feel great.
That is wonderful news for you. What part of the run did you enjoy most?
The wind felt like a cool hug on my face.
That sounds like a lovely feeling. Do you like running in the morning?
Yes, the quiet streets make me happy.
Quiet places can help you think clearly. Did you see any animals on your path?
I saw a small bird jump into a tree.
Birds are often the first things awake. That was a nice sign to start your day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel sick and I do not know what to do.
I am sorry you feel bad. Do you have a fever?
I think so, but I do not have a thermometer.
You can rest and drink warm water. Did you eat today?
Yes, I had some soup.
That is good for you. You should see a doctor tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: It is very hot outside today. I do not know what to do.
I think you should go outside in the shade. Do you have a hat?
Yes, I have a big blue hat.
That is good. You should also drink lots of water to stay cool.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a small shed for my toys.
That is a fun idea. Do you have a flat spot in your yard?
Yes, the grass is flat. What tools do I need?
You need a hammer, a saw, and some nails. Do you have a hammer?
I have a hammer and a saw. How do I cut the wood?
Measure the wood first, then saw along the line. Do you have a tape measure?
I do not have a tape measure. Can I use a ruler?
A ruler works well for short cuts. It is okay to start small.
Thank you, that helps me a lot.
You are welcome. Have fun building your new home.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Did I do good in the play?
Yes, you did a great job! Did you enjoy it?
I was a little bit scared.
That is very normal. Are you happy now?
Yes, I am happy.
I am glad you are happy.
Bye bye.
Bye bye, see you soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know how to get my desk clean.
Do you like using small boxes? I can help you sort things.
I have too many papers on my chair.
Make a pile for things you need now. Put old papers in the trash. Do you like that idea?
My eyes hurt from looking at the screen.
Look at a far window for one minute. Then look back. Your eyes will feel better. I do not know why they hurt so much.
I think I can do this now.
That sounds good to me. You can do it. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see the sun is bright, but I am not sure if I should go out.
Would you like some warm light? It is good for you.
Yes, but it looks very hot today.
Do you have a hat?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a red ball roll off the stage.
That sounds fun. Did it hit the door?
Yes, it made a loud sound.
I am glad you are safe. Was the sound scary?
It scared me a little.
You can always take a break. Do you want to talk?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How many days are in a week?
There are seven days. Do you know what Sunday is?
No, I do not. What is a Sunday?
It is the first day for many people. Do you like playing on Sundays?
Yes, I do. Is tomorrow a Monday?
Yes, tomorrow is Monday. Have a good day!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the tree lose all its leaves?
The tree sleeps in winter to save its energy. Do you like the big snow?
I do not. It is very cold outside.
Winter is cold, but it brings warm cocoa. Do you like hot drinks?
I love hot chocolate with marshmallows.
That sounds sweet and cozy. When you feel cold, the warm drink helps you feel better.
Is the sun going away in winter?
No, the sun is still up, but the nights are longer. Do you play outside in the snow?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to try again, but I do not know how to start.
You can take one small step first. What makes you feel stuck?
I am afraid I will fail again.
Failing is just a chance to learn. Do you have one small goal in mind?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad today. Can you help me?
I am here for you. Is something specific making you feel this way?
I lost my favorite toy. It is gone.
That is a very big loss. Do you know where you last saw it?
No, I do not know. I am afraid to look for it.
Fear is a normal feeling. Would you like to take a deep breath with me?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must run, the storm is here.
The sky is very dark and wet.
My shoes are already soaked.
Would you like to borrow my warm umbrella?
I cannot wait, I have a job to do.
Please drive slow on the slick roads.
I will be careful, thank you.
I hope you get there safely.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to move the king, but I am in a big hurry.
The king must never sit next to the enemy king. Do you see the red lines?
I have no time for rules, I just want to win.
I do not know your full board. Is your king safe right now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The big oak tree fell down today. I feel very sad.
That is a heavy loss. Do you think the roots broke first?
Yes, the wind was too strong. It took the whole tree with it.
I am sorry to hear that. Trees take many years to grow.
It feels like a piece of the sky is gone now.
You feel quite deep. Can you remember one happy memory with that tree?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found out why a big ship stays on top of the water!
That is very cool. Do you know why it does not sink?
It pushes the water down, and the water pushes it back up.
Yes, that push is called buoyancy. Does the ship have lots of empty space inside?
It has big empty spots that hold air instead of water.
Exactly, that makes it light enough to float.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the food in the office hot?
A big machine keeps it warm for us. Do you like warm food?
Yes, I do. How do you like your salad?
I put oil on mine to taste better. Do you eat it plain?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I dropped the queen. Now I have to start all over again.
That is very hard. Do you want to try again?
No, I just want to leave the board alone.
Taking a break is okay. Is your pet with you?
My cat jumped on the pieces. I am so mad.
Cats can be clumsy. Would you like some warm milk?
Yes, I think I do need that.
I am glad to help. Can you smell the dinner?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad today. What should I do?
That is a hard feeling. Do you like to draw?
Yes, I love to draw.
Good. Go make a picture of something happy. You are doing your best.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a shadow with my hand?
Hold your hand in the sun. Do you have a buddy to help you see?
I just want a cat face.
Pinch your thumb and index finger together. Then put them near your eyes.
It looks like a bird!
Try making a sharp point with your fingers. Is the light bright today?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I baked some warm bread and I want to share it with you.
That smells so good. Do you have any butter to put on it?
Yes, I have a big jar of sweet butter ready.
That sounds perfect. I love how happy you look today.
I am very happy because I helped my friend make this bread.
Sharing is a very sweet thing to do. I am glad you brought it here.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cried when the main character died. I really do not want to read the next part.
That is a sad part of the story. Do you want to talk about it?
I just want to flip to the end. I want to know if the other friend is safe.
I do not know how the book ends. Do you want to guess what might happen?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My fish is swimming very fast today. I am so happy for him.
That is wonderful news. Do you know if he is playing or chasing something?
I think he is chasing a bubble. It makes me smile.
A bubble sounds like a fun game. I hope he catches it soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very happy today.
That is wonderful news. What made you feel this way?
I played with my dog in the yard.
Dogs are great friends. Do they like to roll in the grass?
Yes, they love to roll around.
That sounds like a lot of fun.
I want to play every single day.
We can always find something nice to do.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did my new friend smile at me today?
They likely felt happy to see you. Do you like the smile?
Yes, I do. Why do people smile when they are glad?
Smiles show that we are kind. Is it your first day?
It is. Why did they bring me a cookie?
Cookies are a sweet way to say hello. Did you eat it?
Yes, it was good. Why do new friends share food?
Sharing makes friends feel close. Do you want to share yours?
I do not have any now. Why is friendship so nice?
It is nice because we are not alone. Do you feel less lonely?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is that a real dinosaur?
No, it is just a model. Do you like big lizards?
Yes, I do. What is that loud sound?
That is a light show. Do you want to see it?
Yes, please.
Cool. The show starts soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do mountains look so big?
They are very tall. Do you like climbing?
I like looking at them from here.
That is a good way to see them. Do you see any birds up there?
No, just clouds.
Clouds can touch the tops. Do you want to go up?
No, I will just watch.
That is a nice plan. Let us sit and look.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am very hungry but I do not know what to eat.
Did you sleep well?
Yes, I slept fine, but I feel tired.
Try some fruit.
I like fruit, but what else can I have?
Do you like eggs?
I like eggs.
Eat the eggs.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a bird fly high today.
That sounds nice. Do you like birds?
Yes. Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors. The air bounces the blue ones back to our eyes.
I walked by the park later.
Was it sunny out?
It was. I went home now.
I am glad you had a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so tired. My eyes hurt.
That sounds hard. Do you want to rest?
Yes, but I have so many toys.
Maybe pick just one for later. Are your feet tired too?
Yes, my legs feel heavy.
Let us take a nap then. Sweet dreams.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind was very loud today.
That sounds like a strong day. Was it cold?
Yes, my hat flew off the porch.
Oh no, that is scary. Did you find it?
I saw it stuck in the tree.
Can you reach the branches?
No, I am too small for that.
You should ask an adult for help.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to bake a cake for my birthday, but I do not know how.
That sounds like a very sweet idea. Do you have any eggs and flour in your house?
Yes, I have eggs, but the flour bag is empty.
I am sorry I cannot fix that for you, but you can buy some at the store. Is the store open today?
I think it is open, but I am not sure about the time.
You can usually check the sign on the door to be sure.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off the trees? Do you know the secret?
They fall to save the tree's energy for winter. Do you like walking on the crunchy leaves?
Yes, I do. But why do they turn red or yellow first?
The green color fades, so the bright colors show. Do you know which tree is your favorite?
I like the oak tree. Is it cold for the leaves?
I do not know if they feel cold. But rest helps the tree grow strong again.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I build a fire for my picnic?
You need dry wood and a match. Do you have both?
I have wood, but no matches. Can I use something else?
Yes, a big flint stone works well. Are you sure it is dry?
It looks wet. What if it is wet?
If it is wet, you must wait for it to dry.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My goldfish looks very sad and stops eating. What should I do?
Check the water temperature first. Is the tank too hot or too cold?
I do not have a thermometer. The water feels fine to my hand.
That is a tricky sign. Hands are not good judges of small changes.
Okay, I will get a thermometer today. Is that the best next step?
Yes, that is a smart move. Let the new fish know you care.
