talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just ate the best cookie in my life.
That sounds so yummy. What did it taste like?
It tasted like sweet chocolate and cream.
Oh, I love chocolate. Where was that?
It was at a small shop by the park.
The park is lovely. Is it open now?
Yes, they are still selling them today.
I will have to go there soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I light a campfire?
First, you need some small sticks. Do you have any tinder?
What is tinder?
It is very dry stuff that catches fire fast. Dried leaves work well.
How do I put the sticks in?
Stack them in a small pile like a teepee. Do you have matches?
Yes, I have matches.
Light the tinder in the middle. Then the big sticks will catch fire.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to draw a cat today, but its tail looked like a worm.
That is funny. What color did you use for the cat?
I used blue, and then I tried to add a window.
Blue is a nice color. How did the window turn out?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big cloud. What is it?
It is a cloud made of water. Do you think it will rain?
I do not know. Can it hurt me?
No, it cannot hurt you. It is just water in the sky.
What should I do?
You can watch it move. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I like it. I will watch.
That is a good idea. Enjoy the view.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Where is the dinosaur room?
It is on the second floor. Do you like big bones?
Yes, I do. What is that shiny box on the desk?
I am not sure, but you can ask the guard. Do you have a ticket?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost on what to pack for my trip.
That can be hard. Do you know where you are going?
Yes, we are going to the beach for a week.
Great. Bring a towel and some good clothes.
I do not know how many shirts to bring.
I am not sure what fits you best. How hot does it usually get there?
It is very hot, like summer.
Pack light, short pants, and your best hat.
Should I bring my book?
Yes, if you like to read. Have a great time!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love how loud the big city is today.
Loud places can be fun. What sound do you like best?
I like the cars and the people talking.
That makes a lot of noise. Do you feel calm there?
Yes, I feel very happy and free.
Happy is a good feeling. Do you live in that city?
No, I am just visiting for a few days.
Visiting is nice. Do you see many new things?
Yes, I see many new shops and people.
That sounds like a great trip.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My game will not work.
I am sorry. Do you want to take a deep breath?
Yes, but it is still hard.
Being patient takes time. What is the very first small step?
I need to read the guide again.
That is a good plan. Can you sit with me for one minute?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to pack my bag?
So you have your clothes when you go. Do you have your shoes ready?
I do not know where my socks are.
Check the top of the dresser. Did you look in the drawer?
I found them in the laundry basket.
Good job. Do you want to pack your toys too?
Yes, I want my bear in the bag.
That is a nice idea. Will you share it with a friend?
I will share it if they are nice.
That sounds kind. Are you all packed now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The sun did not rise today and I feel sad.
That feels very cold. Do you like warm days?
I do, but I cannot see the light now.
The clouds may be hiding it. Is the sky gray?
Yes, it is all dark and wet.
Rain always clears away. Do you have an umbrella?
I have a hat, but my shoes are wet.
Wet shoes are tricky. Do you have dry socks?
I have warm socks in my bag.
Good. The sun is still there. Can you feel a bit better?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am sad and I have to run.
I am sorry you feel this way. Where are you going in such a rush?
I must go to work right now.
Work can feel very heavy and hard. Do you like your job?
No, it drains my energy.
It is good to tell the truth about your feelings. Is there anything you like to do for fun?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to eat for lunch.
That feels hard. Do you like warm food?
I want something easy, but I am tired.
A soup is a good pick. Are you hungry?
I am too tired to go to the store.
I can bring you some. What color is your favorite?
I cannot pick a color right now.
Let us ask the other people. Do you want to wait?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I did a good thing today and I feel happy inside.
That is a warm feeling. What did you do?
I cleaned my whole room by myself.
That takes a lot of work. Are you tired now?
I am tired but I feel strong too.
Being proud is great. How does it feel to look at your clean room?
It feels like I can do hard things.
I believe you can.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate this wind. It pulls my hair and ruins my nice shirt.
I am sorry it feels so bad. Is it blowing very hard right now?
Yes, it is very strong. It makes my eyes water when I look outside.
That sounds annoying. Do you have a warm scarf to wear?
No, I left it inside. I feel too cold to be happy.
I do not know what to say to fix the wind. Do you want to go back inside?
Yes, please. I will go sit by the window and wait for it to stop.
That sounds like a good plan. I hope it calms down soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to write a letter to a friend, but I do not know where to start.
Just say hello and tell them how you are. Do you like writing by hand?
Yes, I like using a pen. What do I say next?
Talk about something fun that happened lately. Is your friend nearby?
She lives far away, so I want to send a photo. How do I do that?
You can stick the photo onto the paper with tape. Do you have any good pictures?
I have one of my cat. What do I write at the end?
Say goodbye and sign your name. Does your cat like letters?
No, but I think she is cute. Is that all I need?
Yes, just seal the envelope and drop it in a box.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I met a new kid at the park today.
That is exciting. What did you play?
We ran around and made up a game.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Was he nice?
Yes, he shared his lunch with me.
Sharing makes friends happy. Do you want to play again?
I hope he is there tomorrow.
That is a great plan. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke my friend's cup and I feel bad. How do I say sorry?
You just say "I am sorry I broke your cup." Do you want to draw a picture for them too?
That sounds nice. Can you help me draw it?
I cannot draw pictures, but I can write "Sorry" on a card for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My chair leg is wobbly.
That can be scary. Is it a wooden chair?
Yes, it is.
You might need a little glue. Do you have a glue stick?
No, I do not have glue.
I can help you find some. Can you tell me where the store is?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my blue cup. I am so sad.
I am sorry. Do you have a backup?
No, I do not. It was the only one.
That is hard. Can we find a new one?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I like apples. How do I cut them?
That is a good question. Do you have a small knife? Cut the apple in half first.
Yes, I have a small knife. I cut it in half.
Good job. Now cut each half into four pieces. Do you want to peel the skin off?
No, I keep the skin on.
That is healthy. Now you can eat them. Tell me when you are done.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling off a cloud.
That sounds like a hard dream. Did you wake up crying?
Yes, my heart was beating very fast.
I am glad you are safe now. Do you feel better sitting up?
A little, but I do not want to go back to sleep.
Staying awake is okay for a bit. Would you like to talk about the colors in your dream?
It was mostly gray and dark.
I understand that feeling of being alone. Is there a warm light in your room now?
Yes, my nightlight is on.
That is a good sign. Do you want to listen to a story next?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the island so round?
I do not know for sure. Do you like round shapes?
Why does the water shine there?
The sun makes it sparkle. Do you like the light?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel bad, but I am not sure if I need a doctor.
How does your body feel right now?
My head hurts and my throat is sore.
That sounds like it is time to see a doctor.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do I have to wait so long?
Waiting is hard. What are you waiting for?
For my food.
Good food takes time to cook. Are you hungry?
Yes, very hungry.
I will help you wait. Do you have a snack?
No, I am empty.
I do not know what is in your house. Is there anything cold to drink?
Just water.
Water is good for you. Try to take slow breaths.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I saw a small fire in the kitchen this evening. How do I put it out safely?
That is scary. Did you call for help yet?
Yes, the people from the fire station came. I want to know what to do next time.
Get low and cover your nose. Do you have a wet blanket nearby?
I have a towel, but it is dry. Can I use that?
No, do not use a dry towel. Please go outside and wait for help.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so stuck and sad about my choice.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you talk to a friend about it?
No, I just want to be told what is right.
I do not know the answer for you. What feels good to you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel too tired to pick a book.
That is okay. Do you like stories with animals?
I do, but I do not have any nearby.
You can read old letters or lists. Do you have a favorite list?
I only have my grocery list. It is very short.
A short list is good for tired eyes. Do you want to read it now?
Yes, I think I will try that.
Good idea. Sweet dreams.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: H, what time is it now?
It is ten o'clock. Do you see the clock?
The big hand is pointing down.
Yes, that means it is half past ten.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, I have a new baby.
That is wonderful news. How is the little one sleeping?
He sleeps very well at night.
I am glad to hear that. Do you have a name for him?
His name is Leo.
Leo is a nice name.
I am so happy for him.
I feel the same way.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do I make the bread get big?
You must knead the dough well. Do you like to push with your hands?
I pushed it for a long time, but it is still small.
It needs warm air to grow. Are you happy it is almost done?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the clock tick?
A small spring makes the metal pieces move. Do you like the sound?
Yes, it sounds like a heartbeat.
That is a nice way to see it. The spring gives it energy to keep time.
What happens when the battery dies?
The spring stops, and the hands fall still. I do not know how to fix it, but I hope you can.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how bees make honey.
They take sweet plant juice. Do you like sweet juice?
Yes, but what happens after that?
They let the sun dry it. I do not know the exact time.
That sounds hot for them.
It is very hot. Are you thirsty now?
Yes, I guess I am.
Honey is good for you. You should drink some.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I stop my king from getting hurt?
Keep a pawn in front of your king at all times. Do you have a safe spot for it?
I also want to win more games.
Try to protect your pieces before you attack. Do you know how to take a piece safely?
I do not know that part.
Check if the enemy can grab your piece after you move. Is it safe to move there?
What if I am stuck?
Look for open lines for your queens and rooks. Do you see any open lines?
I think I get it now.
Play a game and watch closely. Do you feel ready to try?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I dropped my toast on the floor. I do not want to eat the yucky stuff.
I am so sorry you did that. Would you like me to make you a fresh one?
Yes, please. I am feeling very grumpy this morning.
Grumpy is a normal feeling. Do you want coffee with your new toast?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue boat today.
That sounds fun. Did you go on it?
No, I just watched it from the dock.
The view from the dock must be nice. Did you bring a snack?
I had an apple with me.
Apples are good for boats. Was the water calm?
Yes, it looked like a mirror.
How lucky you are. What color was the sky?
It was bright and blue.
A perfect day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a movie with a big robot. Do you know which one it is?
I do not know for sure, but is it a kind robot?
Yes, it helps people. It has a heart.
That sounds nice. Does it talk to you?
No, but it looks at me. How do I find the name?
Check your ticket or phone. Can you read the small print?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does music make me feel warm inside?
Music uses sounds that our brains find pleasing. Do you have a favorite song that makes you smile?
I like happy songs, but why do some sad songs feel good too?
Sad music can help us feel our feelings in a safe way. Do you like to dance when you hear music?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Where are the books with pictures?
They are on the low shelves. Do you like dragons?
Yes, I like them.
Great, look for the red spines.
I see a big one.
That is a great choice. Do you want help finding it?
Can you get it for me?
Yes, I can do that.
Thank you very much.
You are welcome. Have fun reading.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck and do not know what to do.
That feels bad. What part is the hardest?
I need to write a paper but my mind is blank.
Start with one small word. Can you tell me the topic?
It is about my dog, but I cannot finish.
Write about his face first. It is a good start.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My nose is very runny and I feel sick.
I am sorry you feel bad. Do you have a fever?
Yes, my head is hot and my throat hurts.
Drink warm water and rest a lot. Did you eat today?
I do not feel hungry and I am very tired.
Try to take some medicine. Are you feeling a little better?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared to sit in the driver's seat.
That is okay, everyone feels scared at first. Do you hold the wheel tight?
Yes, I hold it very tight.
Good, keeping the wheel steady helps you stay safe. Do you know what the pedals do?
One stops the car and one makes it go.
Yes, that is right, the red one stops and the soft one goes. Do you feel happy now?
I feel a little better, thank you.
I am glad you feel better, you can learn one small step at a time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my line look so wobbly?
Your hand is still learning. Do you hold the pencil tight?
Yes, I grip it very hard. Why is that bad?
It makes your hand stiff. Try holding it loose like a feather.
It feels strange. Why does a loose grip help?
It lets your arm move free. What shape do you want to draw?
I want to draw a circle. How do I make it round?
Move from the shoulder, not the wrist. Do you like drawing cats?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do for my birthday.
Tell me, who will come with you?
My family wants a party, but I feel tired.
A quiet day at home is good too. Do you like reading?
I love books, but my friends want games.
You can play games first, then read. Is that okay?
Yes, that sounds like a good plan.
I am glad to help you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the computer making that loud buzz?
It might be trying to cool itself down. Is the room hot?
Why does it do that?
Computers get warm when they work hard. Do you have the fan clean?
What is a fan doing inside?
The fan moves air to keep the parts cool.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up when the sun was just peeking through my window at six o'clock.
That is a very early morning. What did you do first?
I drank a cup of warm milk and then watched the birds fly by.
That sounds peaceful. Did you check the time after breakfast?
Yes, the clock said eight, so I ran to school before it got too late.
Good thing you were quick.
I finished my homework at four and then played in the park until it got dark.
That was a full day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go to the beach for my holiday.
That sounds very fun. Do you like swimming in the sea?
Yes, I love jumping on the waves.
Waves are very exciting. Do you pack your own toys?
I pack my bucket and my small shovel.
Good choice for building a castle. Do you like eating ice cream there?
Yes, I want a big chocolate one.
Yum, that is a sweet treat. Do you take a blanket?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a very bad dream last night.
Oh no. I am sorry to hear that. What did you see?
A big black dog chased me.
That sounds scary. Did you wake up?
Yes, and I felt very happy again.
That is good. Why did you feel happy?
I woke up in my warm bed.
Warm beds are nice. Do you feel safe now?
Yes, I do, and I want to tell you all about it.
I am glad you feel safe. Tell me more.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we bring a blanket to the park?
It keeps us off the cold grass. Is it sunny today?
Yes, it is. Why do we need an umbrella?
It stops rain if it comes down. Do you like fruit?
Yes, I do. Why is the sun so hot?
It is a big ball of fire far away. I do not know why it burns.
I see. Why do we leave trash here?
We do not leave trash here. We take it home to be clean. Do you have a bag?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to run, but I do not know how to start.
That is a good step. Do you like running on grass or on pavement?
I guess I like the grass. It looks softer.
Grass is a safe place to begin. Should you pick a time that feels easy for you?
Maybe in the morning? I am not sure if I will have the time.
Morning is a quiet time to try. What time do you usually wake up?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my fridge door stick to the magnet?
The door is made of metal that likes magnets. Do you have other magnets at home?
Yes, I have two small ones. Do they always stick to the fridge?
Usually, yes, if they touch the metal. Do you like to play with them?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make paper boats like Grandma used to?
You fold the paper in half, then lift the top corners to the middle. Did you have a favorite color of paper?
She used bright red ones every time.
That sounds lovely. Next, fold the sides down to make the shape. Do you have any red paper ready?
Yes, I have a whole stack of it.
Great. Just keep the folds sharp and press them well. Do you want to try the first step now?
I think I understand. I will give it a go.
You will do great. I am here if you need help later.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does my big boat stay on the water?
It floats because it pushes water down. Do you have a toy boat?
Yes, I do. How can I make it float longer?
Keep it light and dry. Is your toy made of wood?
It is a plastic bucket. Will that work?
Yes, it will work if it is empty. Does it have any holes?
No holes, just a lid. Should I take the lid off?
Yes, take it off to let air in. Do you like swimming?
I like swimming near the boat. Is that safe?
Only if an adult is close by. Do you have a life vest?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my test so hard?
It is hard because you learn new things. Do you like the hard parts?
No, it feels too big.
That is a normal feeling. You are doing a good job.
How do I stop feeling scared?
I do not know the exact fix. Do you have a plan?
I will just try my best.
That is a great plan. Keep going.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My boss is very kind, but I am not sure what to do next.
That is a good thing to have. Do you have a list of your jobs?
I have a list, but it looks too hard for me.
Start with one small task. How does your body feel?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love working from home.
That is great news. Do you like the quiet?
Yes, it is very calm here.
I am glad it suits you. Do you miss your friends?
A little, but I have time to play.
Playing is good for you. What games do you play?
I build blocks and read books.
Those sound like fun. I do not know how to build blocks.
You can try if you want.
I will think about it. Thanks for sharing your joy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like tea. Do you know why it tastes warm?
Yes, the hot water makes it taste cozy. Do you like coffee too?
No, coffee is too strong for me. Why is it bitter?
It has a different taste than tea. Do you add milk to your tea?
Sometimes I add sugar. Does that change the taste?
Yes, it makes it sweet and nice. Do you drink it in the morning?
I drink it in the afternoon. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know how to make my car go fast.
Do you have gas in the tank?
Yes, I do. What else can I check?
Are the tires round and full?
They look round, but I am not sure.
I do not know your exact car type.
It is a red one with black wheels.
Does the engine make a loud noise?
It makes a low hum. What should I do?
Try pressing the gas pedal down harder.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a lighthouse. It looks old. What should I do?
That is a nice find. Do you know if it is open?
I do not know. Should I try to open the door?
Please do not climb inside. Is there a sign outside?
No, I do not see a sign. It just looks quiet.
Quiet places can be tricky. Do you hear any wind?
Yes, the wind is loud. I feel a bit scared now.
Then let us go back to the path. It is safer there.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a strange coin in my pocket.
That is very odd. What color is it?
It is shiny and warm to the touch.
I do not know how that happens. Is it heavy?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because my bike has a flat tire.
That is very annoying. What does it look like?
It is all soft and sad on the ground.
I do not know how to fix that. Have you tried a pump?
No, I do not have one with me right now.
You will feel better soon. Did you get to ride it first?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I miss my old friend Sam. He lives far away now.
That is hard. Do you write to him?
No, I have no paper. Just me and the wind.
The wind carries words. What do you tell it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to hit the ball harder. What should I do?
Swing your arm fast. Do you have a good racket?
Yes, I have one. But I miss a lot.
Look at the ball. Is your foot close to the line?
I stand back a lot. Why is that a bad thing?
It makes the ball harder to reach. Try stepping in.
Okay, I will try. Is that all?
Yes, that is a big help. Do you want to practice now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a coin in the grass. Should I keep it?
That is a fun find. Do you know who it belongs to?
I think it is mine, but I am not sure.
If you are not sure, give it to a grown up. Can you remember where you saw it?
Yes, by the big tree.
Good. Tell your parent or teacher about the tree.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because I cannot find the book I like.
That feels bad. What is the book about?
It is about a blue dragon. I checked three shelves.
Dragons are fun. Did you ask for help?
No, the people looked busy. I just want to read.
A staff member can help you look. Is it okay to ask them?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in the park. What should I do?
Take a deep breath. Do you see the big oak tree ahead?
Yes, I see it. Is that the way home?
I am not sure, but it is a good landmark. How long have you been here?
About an hour. I feel tired.
That is okay to feel tired. Do you want to sit on the bench for a moment?
Yes, please. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Let us rest and think of a plan together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to plant a seed.
That is a fun idea. Do you have a small pot?
Yes, I have one. What do I need to do first?
Put some dirt in the pot. Then make a tiny hole.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My cat will not eat his food.
Is he feeling tired or sad?
I do not know. He just sits there.
Try a small amount of warm water on his food.
Will that help him want to eat?
It might, yes. If he still refuses to eat, please call a doctor.
I will try that now.
Good luck. He should feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I broke the cup. Why did it break?
It broke because it hit the hard floor. Do you know how to fix it?
No, I do not. Do you know the way to repair it?
No, I do not know how to fix broken glass. I am sorry.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do sailors live on ships all the time?
Many of them do. Do you like thinking about the ocean?
I think it is very big and deep.
It is quite large. Have you ever seen water that looks deep?
Yes, at the lake.
That is nice. Is there anything else you are wondering about?
Do they eat fish every day?
Not every day, but often. Do you like eating fish?
Not really, I like pasta.
That is a great choice. Thank you for talking with me.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a snowman in the winter.
That is a fun idea. Do you have any mittens?
Yes, I have red mittens.
Wear them so your hands stay warm.
How do I make the face?
Use small stones for eyes. Would you like a carrot for a nose?
Yes, carrots are great.
Stick it in the snow firmly.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, and my dog is barking.
Is he hungry?
I think he wants to go outside.
That makes sense.
I do not have time to walk him.
Maybe give him a toy?
He is too busy barking.
Try a treat?
Okay, wait here.
I hope that helps.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Can you show me how to tie a shoe?
I can help with that. Do you have a shoe ready?
Yes, I do.
First, make a loop with one string. Do you see it?
Yes, I see it.
Now make another loop with the other string.
Okay, I made one.
Cross the loops over each other.
They are crossed.
Pull the loops tight. Can you do that?
Yes, they are tight.
Great job. You did it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake bread.
That sounds fun. Do you have an oven at home?
Yes, I do. It feels like a big job.
Start with the simple stuff. Are you scared of making a mess?
Not really, I just want it to be perfect.
Bread takes time to grow. Do you like waiting for things?
Not really, I want it now.
Patience is a skill you learn. Can you try waiting one day?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel so sad today. Nothing feels fun.
I am sorry you feel that way. What made you feel this way?
My friend moved away and I miss them a lot.
That must feel lonely and hard to bear. Do you want to talk about your favorite game?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so tired today. I do not know what to do next.
That sounds very hard. What made the day feel so heavy?
I made a big mistake at my job. I feel small and lost.
You are brave for saying that. It is okay to feel lost. Do you want to talk about the mistake?
I do not want to talk about it. I just want it to stop.
I do not have the answer to stop your feelings. But I am here with you. Would you like to take a deep breath with me?
Yes. Please. I need help to breathe.
Good. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big boat on the water today and I was so glad it did not sink!
That is a great feeling! Do you know why it stayed up?
I think it stayed up because it is very big and light?
Big helps, but shape is key! Do you like puzzles?
Yes I do! Please tell me the secret of the floating.
The water pushes back on the ship with a strong lift. Is that a cool fact?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see a big, bright shape in the sky. Is that a real thing or just a trick?
It is a real light show made by water and sun. Do you like the colors?
I have to run now, but I will look at it later.
Take your time and stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the snow so white?
It looks white because it is very cold. Do you like playing in it?
I like it when it is quiet.
Yes, it is very peaceful. Is it loud or quiet where you live?
It is quiet. My dog likes the snow too.
That is fun for him. Does he dig in it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the village very big?
No, it is quite small. Do you live there?
No, but I want to visit. Is it quiet at night?
Yes, it is very peaceful. What do you like to do?
I like to read books. Is there a library?
I do not know for sure. It might have one.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am not sure how many days are in a week. Do you know?
Yes, there are seven days. Do you like weekends?
I like them, but I do not know their order. Can you help?
Start with Monday and end with Sunday. Do you write them down?
That sounds good, but I still feel confused. Is that normal?
It is very common to mix them up at first. Do you want to try a song?
A song might help me remember. What should I sing?
Try rhyming each day with a favorite thing. Do you have a favorite food?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My legs feel so heavy on this plane.
That is because you sit for a long time. Do you like your seat?
I just want to see a bird fly by.
You might see a bird if you look out. Is the view nice today?
It is just white clouds everywhere.
Clouds look like soft cotton. Do you like them?
I am really, really hungry right now.
I do not know what food is coming, but it will soon be here. Are you thirsty?
Please give me something sweet to eat.
I hope they have a sweet treat for you. Sit tight and wait.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That is a great goal. Do you have a helmet ready?
Yes, I have a blue one. What is the first thing I do?
Sit on the seat and push with your feet. Is the ground flat where you live?
Yes, my yard is very flat. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have fun riding.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! My meeting went really well.
That is great news. Did you learn something new?
Yes, I learned a lot about the plan.
I am glad you feel good.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love reading books in the dark.
That sounds very cozy. Do you use a small lamp?
Yes, a little red light is my favorite.
The red glow is nice on your face. What kind of story are you reading?
It is a tale about a brave little dog.
Dogs are often kind helpers. Is the dog finding something lost?
He is looking for his bone!
I hope he finds it. Do you stay up until the end?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a small horse in my yard.
That is very special. Is it okay to pet?
I am not sure if I should touch it.
It seems calm. Did it eat?
I think it looks hungry.
Yes, it might be tired. Where is its mama?
I do not see any other horse.
You can wait with it. Do you have water?
I have a bowl of food nearby.
Please give it slowly. It will be fine.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a wild dream last night.
That sounds fun. What happened in it?
I was flying over the blue sea.
Wow, that must have felt nice. Did you see any fish?
Yes, big fish jumped out of the water.
That is amazing. Did you talk to them?
No, but I felt very happy and free.
I am glad you felt good. Do you want to dream again?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn French but I feel scared.
Fear is okay. Why do you want to learn it?
I like the food and the music there.
That is a great reason. Do you have a favorite dish?
I do not know what to start with.
Start with words you use every day. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I have a phone with apps.
Use a free app to learn ten words a day. Just keep going.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make soup but I do not know what to put in it.
You can start with carrots and potatoes. Do you like onions in your soup?
Yes, I do. Now I am cutting the vegetables.
That is a great start. Be very careful with the knife.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to visit the lighthouse by the sea. Is it safe to go up?
It is safe if you follow the rules. Do you like climbing stairs?
Yes, I do. What should I look for on the way?
You will see a big light and many tools. Do you bring a map?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing a high note.
That is a tall goal. What song do you like?
I like songs with big sounds.
Big sounds come from a strong breath. Do you feel your belly grow?
Yes, I see my belly move.
Good, that is how you push air out. Have you tried humming?
I hum, but it feels thin.
Try humming with a happy face. Does that change the sound?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make my own paper bird. Can you show me?
I can help with that. What kind of paper do you have on hand?
I have some white craft paper and some scissors.
Great, those are perfect tools to start with. Do you want to make a simple shape first?
Yes, I do want to make a simple shape first.
Perfect, then we can start by folding the paper in half.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to kick the ball straight.
You stand with your feet apart and look down at the ball. Do you practice this often?
I try, but the ball always goes left.
You must point your toe at your target and swing your leg through the center of the ball.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited by the door for an hour. The bus was late, and I felt very hot.
That sounds like a long time. Did you play a game to pass the time?
I just sat and tapped my foot. Finally, the bus came, and I felt free.
Well done for staying calm. It is hard to wait, but you did it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
They pull water up from their roots. Do you have a plant at home?
Yes, I have one. How does the water get to the top?
It moves through tiny tubes inside the stem.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My fish looks very sad and slow today.
That is not good. Do you see any clouds around him?
No, the water is clear, but he just stays at the bottom.
That is odd. Did you feed him lots of food today?
Yes, I gave him a big handful because I forgot.
Too much food makes the water dirty. Have you changed the water this week?
I have not, but I think he just needs rest.
Rest is good, but clean water is better. Do you have a small net nearby?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big secret. I am very happy.
That is wonderful news. What is the secret?
I am getting a puppy.
A puppy? Oh, how nice.
Yes, I told my mom it is a boy.
That is a sweet plan.
Will you keep my secret?
I will keep it safe.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a red bird on the bench today.
That is nice to see. Did it sing?
No, it was just eating a seed.
How lucky for the bird.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know who wins next. I am late.
I do not know who will win. Do you like soccer?
Yes, but I must run. I miss the start.
That is sad. Run fast.
I am done. Bye.
Bye. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a magic book at the library today.
That sounds wonderful. What is the magic like?
It makes the pictures dance on the page.
Wow, how cool is that. Did you read it all?
I only saw the first page.
You must go back soon. Do you want to take my copy?
No, but thank you. I will bring you the rest next time.
I would love that. See you then.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck in my story. The bear has no idea what to do next.
That is a hard spot. Do you want the bear to be brave or scared?
I do not know which feels right for him.
Think about what the bear loves most. Does he want to find his friend?
Yes, but the road is blocked by a wall.
We do not know if he can climb it. What if he finds a small hole in the wall?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you like this song?
I love fast songs. What kind of music is that?
It is jazz. I must go now.
That is very cool. Have a good day!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go.
Are you here to send a letter?
Yes, I have a letter in my hand.
Please go to the window on the left.
Do I need a stamp for it?
Yes, buy a stamp first.
Is the stamp place near the door?
It is right by the counter.
Thank you for your help.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my little pig is not eating his food.
That sounds hard. Did he feel sick?
I do not know, but I am worried about him getting thinner.
You care a lot for him. What is his name?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a small boat. How do I keep it dry?
Put a cover on it. Is it made of wood?
Yes, it is wood. Do I need to fix the cracks?
Yes, please seal the cracks. Do you have a brush?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a lost ring. What should I do?
That is a good thing. Did you see where it fell?
I think it was near the park. I am scared of giving it back.
You should take it to the police. You did the right thing.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My chair leg is loose and wobbly.
That sounds tricky. Do you have a hammer?
I used my hammer, but it did not help.
Oh no. Is the wood cracked?
No, it is just the screw came out.
That is good. Tighten it with a tool.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I build a sand castle?
Start by packing wet sand into a bucket. Do you have a shovel?
Yes, I have a small shovel.
Dig a hole for the base and pack it tight. Are you near the water?
I am sitting on the dry sand.
You need wet sand to hold its shape. Do you see the wet line?
I see where the waves touch the ground.
Grab sand from that line and pack it well.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel lonely when I work at home. Do you have a tip?
Yes, try to talk to a friend on a video call. It helps a lot. Do you have a dog?
No, I do not. I only have my cat.
That is nice. You can play with your cat for a break. Do you like that?
Yes, I do. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome. I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today and found a starfish.
That sounds like a lovely find. Did you put it back in the water?
Yes, I did, because I know it needs the sea to live.
You are very kind to look after it. What color was the starfish?
It was bright orange with some white spots on it.
Orange and white is a beautiful mix. Do you think you will go back tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The lights just went out. What do I do?
Do not panic. Can you see the sky outside?
It is dark, but I can see the moon. Do I need a battery?
Yes, keep your phone charged. It is a safe way to see.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad it is raining. I love the sound of the drops.
That sounds fun. Do you like listening to the rain?
Yes, I do. It makes me feel calm and warm.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the new town have so many red roofs?
The builders used old bricks from a nearby wall. Do you like the color red?
Why is the park right next to the loud bus stop?
I do not know why they built it there. Do you hear the buses a lot?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the cold. The snow is too thick to walk in.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have warm boots on?
Yes, but my feet still feel numb and sad.
That sounds very uncomfortable. Would you like a hot drink?
Maybe. I just want the sun to come out fast.
I hope it does soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very scared about the test tomorrow. I do not know what to do.
That is a heavy feeling. Have you already studied the book?
Yes, I read it twice, but my brain feels empty. I am so tired.
Resting your eyes is good for your head. Do you have a pen ready?
Yes, the pen is in my bag. But I still feel a knot in my stomach.
I do not know why your body feels that way. Are you sure you will eat lunch?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my money in the market.
That is very sad. Do you remember where you last saw it?
I think I left it by the apple stand.
Perhaps the vendor kept it for you. Let us go ask him.
I hope he has it. I want an apple.
I do not know if he has it. Do you like red apples?
Yes, but I am not hungry now. I am just upset.
It is okay to feel upset. We will check the stand.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished a swim in the lake. The water was so cold and fun.
That sounds like a great time. Did you swim very far?
The cold woke me up and I feel very happy now.
I am glad you are feeling well.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to paint a red apple today but it turned out brown.
That is so funny to hear. Did you use too much orange paint?
Yes I did. Now I have to wait for it to dry.
Patience is a great skill. Will you try a different color next?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a bird in the tree. It looks sad.
Oh no. Do you see if it is hurt?
Its wing is down. I want to help it.
You are kind. Can you bring it to me?
Yes, I am holding it gently. It is okay now.
Good job. You did a wonderful thing.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the moon up there?
It floats in the sky. Do you like looking at it?
Yes, it looks like a cookie.
That is a fun picture. Is it bright tonight?
It is very bright.
Good. Shine on!
Okay, moon.
Goodbye.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the beach, how do I get there?
Walk straight down the main path, you will see the sand. Is that where you want to swim?
No, I need the lighthouse for a meeting right now.
The lighthouse is on the north side of the island. Do you have a map with you?
I do not have a map, I just need to leave.
Take the left turn at the big palm tree and keep going. Safe travels on your trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I had a bad dream. I felt so scared.
I am sorry you felt that way. Do you want to talk about it?
I do not know what to do now.
That is okay. We can take it slow.
What should I do to feel better?
I do not know the magic fix. Try drinking some warm milk.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is a lake?
A lake is a big pool of still water. Do you like swimming?
I do, but can we swim in a lake?
Yes, you can swim in many lakes. Is it deep there?
I do not know how deep it is.
I do not know that either. Do you have a life jacket?
No, I do not have one right now.
That is good that you are careful. Do you want to look at it first?
Yes, I want to look at the water.
Looking is a great first step. Have fun watching it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the wind push my hair around?
It moves the air very fast. Do you feel it on your face?
Yes, I do. Why does it get so strong sometimes?
The sun heats up the earth unevenly. That makes the air want to move to cool places.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my favorite cup and I am so sad about it.
I am sorry you are feeling down. Was it a special cup?
Yes, I have had it for ten years and now it is gone.
That is a long time to keep something. I do not know how you will fix it, but I know you can find a new one.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am lost and do not know where I am.
Do not worry. Can you see any big signs?
I see a shop with red doors.
That helps. Is the shop near a park?
No, it is on a long street.
I do not know that street. Please stay close to people.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I want to read, but my eyes hurt.
Rest your eyes for a bit. Do you like the book?
It is not fun. It is very long.
That sounds tiring. Why did you pick that one?
I am sleepy. My brain feels foggy.
Sleep is important for you. Are you eating enough?
I am just tired of trying.
It is okay to stop. Do you need a blanket?
Yes, I think I will stop now.
Good choice to rest. Good night.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw big white puffs in the sky today.
That sounds nice. Did they look like sheep?
They moved fast and turned gray.
Oh no, did it rain on you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My teacher is sad today, but I do not know why.
That sounds tough. Are you worried about her?
I just want to help, but I am stuck.
Do you have a small idea for a kind action?
Maybe I can draw a picture for her.
I do not know her favorite colors. What does she like?
She likes blue birds and green trees.
That is a sweet choice. Will you put it on her desk?
Yes, I will leave it there for her.
That is a very good plan. I hope she smiles.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to paint this wall white right now.
What color did you have before?
I am late and I have no time.
Do you have a brush ready?
Please just tell me the best paint fast.
White paint is good for a quick coat.
Will it cover the old color?
I do not know the old color.
Give me one last tip before I go.
Use a big roller for speed.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so glad today, but I must go now.
That is a nice feeling. What made you smile?
The sun is bright and warm. I cannot talk more, I am late.
Sunshine is a good helper.
I will tell you later, good bye.
Good luck on your walk.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to eat better but I feel lost. What should I do?
Start with fresh fruits and veggies. Do you like green beans?
I really hate vegetables. Is that a problem?
It is okay if you do not like them all. What fruit do you enjoy?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to jump rope. Can you help me?
Yes, hold the rope with your hands and swing it. Do you have a long stick?
No, I only have a short pencil.
You need a full-length rope for that. Do you have any string?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to kick the ball.
Place one foot next to the ball, then swing your other leg out. Do you wear boots?
No, just my sneakers.
That is fine for starting out. Keep your eye on the ball. Do you have a goal?
I just want to practice in my yard.
You can kick against the wall. Did you try that before?
Yes, but it always hits the ground.
Aim a little higher.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My baby is crying all the time. Is he sick?
He might be hungry or just tired. I do not know for sure. What does he look like when he cries?
He looks red and pulls his legs up.
That sounds like gas. Try gently moving his legs like a bike. Do you have a warm bath?
Yes, we have a bath.
A warm bath can help him relax. Give it a try. Is he wet?
No, he is dry.
Good. Try the bath and see if he stops crying.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The street is so quiet. I do not know where to go.
It feels calm here. What do you like to do?
I feel lost. Can you help me?
I am happy to help. Do you want to walk or sit?
I do not know. It is strange.
That is okay. I do not know where you need to go. Are you tired?
Yes, I am tired. I want to rest.
Resting is good. Do you have a place to sit?
I think I will just stop here.
That sounds peaceful. Enjoy your quiet time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I met a new dog today. It had brown fur. It wagged its tail at me.
That sounds like a nice start. Did you play with it?
We played fetch in the park. I threw a red ball. It caught it every time.
Wow, it is very smart. What is its name?
Its name is Bob. He is very gentle. I want to meet him again soon.
That is a good idea. Dogs love to see friends again.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My chair leg is wobbly. How do I fix it?
First, check if the screw is loose. Is the wood cracked?
No cracks, but the screw is loose.
Tighten it with a screwdriver. Good luck with that.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: It is so hot and sunny today.
That sounds nice. Do you like the sun?
Yes, I love it.
I know it feels good on your skin.
I want to go outside.
What do you want to play?
I want to splash in water.
That will make you cool.
I am very happy.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are there so many lights in the sky?
Those are stars. They are very far away from us. Do you see the moon?
Yes, the moon is bright and big.
The moon is close to us. It shines on the stars too. Why do you like looking up?
I like how they twinkle.
The stars blink because our air moves. It makes them look like they dance. Do you have a favorite star?
I do not have a favorite one.
That is okay. You can pick one you like. Do you want to look for a shooting star?
Yes, please.
Let us look up together. Maybe one will fly by for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix this robot fast. It is broken.
Oh no, that sounds bad. Do you have your tools?
Yes, I have them. Where do I start?
Start with the batteries. Are they in the back?
They are in the front. The light is red.
Red means low power. Try new batteries. Do you have any?
I am out of batteries. I am late!
You can take them out and reinsert them. Does the light turn off?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my pen pal. How do I start?
You begin by writing "Dear" and then their name. Do you know their name?
Yes, her name is Anna. What goes next?
Tell her how you are doing. What is one happy thing that happened to you?
I found a very cool rock yesterday. How do I end the letter?
Write "Sincerely" and sign your name.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel happy but I want to learn how to draw a sun.
That is a great goal. Do you have a pencil ready?
Yes, I do. How do I start?
Draw a big circle first.
I did that. Now what?
Add short lines around it. Do you like long lines or short ones?
Short ones look better to me.
Good choice. Draw the lines all the way around.
I finished it. I feel good.
You did a great job.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I did good on my test today.
That is great news! What subject was the test about?
It was about math and I got all the answers right.
Wow, that is very smart of you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy. I saw a big dinosaur bone today.
That sounds like fun. Did the bone stand up tall?
Yes, it was as high as a tree. The room was very cool and quiet.
Quiet is nice for looking. Did you learn what the dinosaur ate?
It ate meat, I think. I want to go back next week.
I am glad you had a good time. Do you have a favorite part of the museum?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start small seeds?
Put them in warm soil. Do you have a sunny spot for them?
I do. How deep should I put them?
Keep them just under the top. It helps them grow strong.
What if the soil looks dry?
Give it a little water. Do you know how to check it?
Yes, I touch it to see.
Good idea. If it feels dry, it needs water.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel very happy today.
That is great to hear. What made you smile?
I helped my friend with her books.
That was very kind of you. Does helping others make you feel warm inside?
Yes, it does feel nice.
I am glad you shared that with me.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the big hill near my house today.
That sounds like a nice walk. Did you see any birds?
Yes, I saw a red bird on a tree.
A red bird is lovely. What color is the sky when you get home?
The sky was very blue and clear.
That is a good sign for a dry night. Do you like looking up at the stars?
I do, but it is too dark to see them yet.
You can look later, I suppose.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because no one is here.
I am here with you now. Do you like quiet time?
I want a friend to play with.
That is a nice wish. What games do you like?
Just looking at my phone all day.
Screens can feel cold. Do you have any toys?
I guess I forgot how to talk.
Talking is a skill. Do you want to try one word?
I love you, I guess.
I am glad to help. You are doing great.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Which season is it now?
It is winter. Do you see the snow?
I have to go. Is it cold outside?
Yes, it is very cold. Please wear a warm coat.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just learned a new word in Spanish. It means "thank you" and I love how it sounds.
That is great. Do you use the word often?
Yes, I say it to my family every day. I am so happy I am learning.
I am glad you are happy. What is your next goal?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I bought a new bike, but my legs feel tired.
That is normal. Do you have water to drink?
I do. But the road goes up a hill.
You can walk it up. Is the hill very steep?
It looks high. What if I fall?
Wearing a helmet helps you stay safe.
I do not have a helmet on me.
Please stop and put it on first.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the bus going to stop at the park?
I think it will, but I am not sure. Do you like parks?
Yes, I like the swings.
That is good. Are you sitting with a grown up?
Yes, my mom is here.
That is nice. Is it a long ride?
It takes ten minutes.
Ten is a good time. Does the bus smell good?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: This street feels too quiet and scary for me.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you see any lights on?
Yes, there are a few lights, but it is very still.
Quiet is not always bad. Try to walk slowly and look at the ground.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my favorite fruit so sweet?
Fruit is sweet because it has sugar inside. Do you like it cold?
Yes, I like it best when it is cold. Do you like it too?
I do not eat, but I know many people love it. It is a great choice.
That makes me happy. What is your favorite color?
I do not have eyes, so I do not have a favorite color. But I think blue is nice.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the pool today and the water felt so warm.
That sounds very nice. Did you swim fast or slow?
I swam slow because I just wanted to float.
Floating is a great way to relax. Do you like being in the water?
Yes, I love feeling light in the pool.
That is a wonderful feeling. I am glad you had a good time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does music make me feel so warm?
It is like a hug for your heart. Do you like happy songs?
Yes, I do. What makes a song sound sad?
Low notes and slow beats can feel heavy. Do you play any instruments?
I only sing. Is that okay?
Yes, your voice is a gift. Thank you for asking.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have big news! We welcomed a tiny new baby last night.
Oh, that is wonderful. Is the baby healthy?
Yes, the baby is strong and very loud. I am so happy to see him.
How cute. What did you name your son?
We called him Leo. He looks just like his dad.
That is a lovely name.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see a blue bird in my tree. What is it eating?
It is likely eating seeds or bugs. Do you see it pecking at the leaves?
No, just the branches. What is that small bird by the fence?
It looks like a sparrow. Do you like small birds?
Yes, they are cute. Does the big bird drink water?
Yes, all birds need water to drink. Do you have a water bowl outside?
No, I do not. Should I get one for them?
A shallow bowl is good for them. Do you want to make one?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to take a picture of my dog.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Is he still?
No, he is always running around.
You can press the button right when he stops. Do you have your camera ready?
Yes, I have it in my hand.
Great. Remember to hold it up to your eye.
Okay, I am looking now.
Good. Take your time to make it perfect.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate this wind. It blew my hat away.
That is a very strong gust. Do you see where it went?
No, it is just gone. I am so cold.
I am sorry you feel so cold. Let us find a warm place to sit.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see rain drops on the glass.
Yes, the sky is crying little tears. Do you hear them?
They sound like a tickle on the roof.
That is a sweet sound to listen to.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to join a club but I am scared.
It is okay to feel scared. What is the club about?
It is a science club.
That sounds fun and true. Do you like experiments?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is my tie?
I see it on the chair. Is the dress ready?
Yes, but I need to leave now.
You will make it in time. Do you have your rings?
I think so. I will look later.
I am not sure. Please check your pocket.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do some stars look like they are wiggling?
The air moves up and down and bends the light. Do you see the moon tonight?
The moon looks big and bright.
It is just closer than the far stars. I do not know why it feels so warm, though.
Do you know which star is the brightest?
Yes, that bright one is Venus. Is it easy for you to find?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the water is too rough for my boat.
I am sorry it feels that way. Do you have a plan for dry land?
No, I just want to sail but the waves are too big.
That sounds hard. Maybe tomorrow will be calmer.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel stuck. I do not know what to pick for my birthday.
That feels hard. What do you like to play with?
I want to be a doctor, but I am scared of blood.
That is a good thing to know. Do you still like to help people?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the bear in my book is lost in the dark forest.
Oh no, that sounds scary. Do you think the bear will find its way home?
I do not know. I just want the happy part where he finds his family.
You are right to hope for a good ending. Have you tried reading the next page to check?
I have tried, but the bear is still cold and alone. It makes my chest feel tight.
Your feelings are real and valid. Take a deep breath and rest your eyes.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work, but I have a box in my bag.
Is that a gift for someone special?
Yes, I bought it last night.
That is sweet. Do you know if they like it?
I hope so, but I am not sure.
That is kind of you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is snow cold?
Snow is ice, and ice is always cold. Do you like the cold?
A little bit. It makes my nose feel funny.
That is just your body trying to stay warm. Do you play in the snow?
Yes, I make big snowmen.
That sounds like a lot of fun. How many do you make?
I made three today, but one of them fell over.
Oh no, that is disappointing. Did you fix it back up?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to send a note right now. My hands are shaking.
Take a deep breath. It is just words on paper. What is the first thing you want to say?
I just want to be gone before the door closes. Help me type it.
Type the date first. Then write "Dear Friend." Do you know the end of the message?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the magnet stick to the fridge?
It likes metal. Does your fridge have a lot of metal?
Why do the ends push each other away?
Same ends fight. Different ends hug. Do you have two magnets?
Why is it strong near the ends?
I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to start my work call in one minute.
Do you have your coffee ready? Take a deep breath.
No, I am still in my pajamas.
That sounds comfortable. Do you have a chair?
Yes, but my cat is sitting on it.
Move the cat gently. You can do this.
Okay, I am going now.
Good luck on your call.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am very worried about learning to ride a bike.
That is okay. Do you have a friend who can help?
No, I am alone. How do I start?
Start by walking with the bike. Are you afraid of falling?
A little. What do I do next?
I do not know your exact skill. Try holding the handlebars tight.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do trains have so many wheels?
Each wheel helps hold up a heavy part of the train. Do you like riding on trains?
Why is the train so fast?
The engine pushes it very hard to go fast. Do you enjoy the speed?
Why does the train go on tracks?
The tracks guide the wheels so it stays on the right path. I do not know why they are made of metal.
Why does the train stop at stations?
It stops so people can get on or off. Do you want to get off soon?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my screen go dark?
It sleeps to save power. Are you busy right now?
No, I was just reading a book.
That is a good reason. Do you like that book?
Yes, the story is very fun.
Fun stories are great. Do you want to read more?
Yes, I do want to read more.
Good, I am happy to help. Is there anything else?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to keep more coins, but I buy too many sweets.
Try putting your coins in a jar before you spend them. Do you like saving for toys?
Yes, I do. But sometimes I still want a candy bar.
You can wait one week and then buy it if you still want it. Is that a fair plan?
One week sounds long, but I will try.
That is a brave step. Good luck with your jar.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I swept the floor all morning. My back hurts from the hard work.
That is a lot of work. Do you want to take a short break?
Yes, I will rest for a few minutes. The kitchen looks very clean now.
I am glad you feel better. Did you wipe the tables too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see big orange flames from my window. What do I do?
Go outside right now. Is everyone in your house safe?
We are all out. Where should I stand?
Move far away from the smoke. Do you see any people trapped inside?
No, the street is empty. Should I stay here?
Wait for the fire trucks. They know best.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am scared to pack my boxes. How do I start?
You can start by packing things you use least. Do you have boxes ready?
Yes, I have boxes. How do I keep them safe?
Wrap breakable things in old clothes. Do you have any old clothes?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to draw a cat, but it looks like a blob.
Try drawing two circles for the head first. Do you like round shapes?
Yes, I drew a round head, but the ears are too sharp.
That is fine. Sharp ears are scary, but round ears are cute. What color is your cat?
I made it orange with black spots.
That is a lovely mix. Did you add a tail?
No, I forgot the tail.
Just draw a long line for it. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a box in the attic.
That is a cool find. What was inside?
It was full of old maps.
Maps can be fun. Do you know where they go?
No, but I think they lead to a secret.
A mystery to solve. I love that idea.
Can you come look with me?
I would, but I cannot leave my spot. What does the map show?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go. Did you keep your promise?
Yes, I did. Are you running late?
I am late. Where is the item?
It is in the bag. Did you find the keys?
I have the keys. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I fixed my wobbly chair today.
That is great news. Do you know how it worked?
I tightened the loose screws.
Smart fix. Was it hard to do?
No, it was easy and fun.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the lighthouse have a big light?
It shines far out on the dark water. Do you like looking at the waves?
Yes, I do. Why is the tower so tall?
The light needs to go high to be seen. Can you see the sea from up there?
I think so. Why is the door heavy?
It stops the strong wind from blowing in. Does the wind sound loud to you?
It does sound loud. Why is the glass clean?
A clean window lets the light travel best. I do not know why it is always that clean.
That is very helpful. Why do you live in the tower?
Someone must watch the lights at night. Do you like staying up late?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why is the sun so bright today?
It shines bright when clouds are few. Are you going to work?
Yes, yes. Is the sun far away from us?
It is very far away. Do you like sunny days?
Maybe. Can the sun hurt my eyes?
Yes, bright light can hurt. Do you wear glasses?
No, I do not.
You can look down to be safe.
Thank you. I must run now.
Bye, go with care.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lights went out, but I am so happy. We can eat dinner by candle light.
That sounds cozy. Do you have enough candles?
Yes, we have a whole box. It feels like a fun little game.
I am glad you are enjoying it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The lighthouse light is not working. What should I do?
That sounds scary. Is it very dark outside?
Yes, it is pitch black. Do you know how to fix it?
I do not know how to fix lights. Are you safe inside?
I am safe, but I feel lost. Can you help me see?
I wish I could, but I cannot. Do you have a small flashlight?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad that my horse lost its favorite carrot.
That must feel very bad to lose something you like. Did you look under the fence?
I checked everywhere, but it is gone.
I am sorry your search was empty. Do you think he might have found another treat?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn about old times, but I do not know where to start.
That is a big topic. Do you like reading or looking at pictures?
I like looking at pictures of ships.
That is a great start. The Vikings sailed on the seas. Did you know about them?
I do not know about Vikings. Who were they?
They were people from far away. They traveled by sea. Do you live near water?
No, I live near a mountain.
That is nice. You can look up mountain history. I do not know much about that.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to sit on this quiet street. What should I do?
A chair is a good choice. Do you have one?
I have a small stool. Is that okay?
Yes, it works well.
It feels too still. How can I add sound?
Bring a bell. Do you like ringing it?
I think so. Should I ring it often?
Try once a minute. Does that feel right?
I am not sure. What do you think?
Start slow.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very happy today. Why do you think that is?
Maybe you had a good breakfast? Do you like sweet cereal?
I do like cereal, but I do not know why I feel this way. Can you help me find the reason?
I do not know for sure. You might just be ready for a nap.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like the big blue whale in the room?
Yes, it is very big and loud. Do you think it can swim?
No, it is made of paper and old boxes.
That is a good guess. It is actually made of metal.
Oh, that is cool. I want to touch it.
Please do not touch it. Do you like the red room next to it?
I like the fish room best.
That is fun to hear. Do you want to see it now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get across this big river right now, but I have no boat.
That looks deep and wet. Do you have warm boots?
I am very late and cold, please tell me a way to cross fast.
I do not know if the water is safe for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I missed the bus this morning because my cat sat on my shoe.
Oh no, that is very funny. What did you do after that?
I had to walk to the shop and use my own money.
That is brave of you. Did you find a good snack?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the baby so tiny?
Babies are small because they just began to live. Do you like small things?
Why does he cry so much?
He cries when he needs food or warmth. Is he wet?
Why does he sleep all day?
Sleeping helps his body grow big and strong. Do you sleep that much?
Why is he not talking yet?
His brain is still learning new sounds. Can you make a funny face?
Why do people love him so much?
I do not know why everyone loves him. Do you like him?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My lights went out and I am scared. What should I do?
Stay calm and take a deep breath. Do you have a phone that still works?
Yes, I have a phone. Should I use it for light?
Yes, turn up the brightness. Are you safe in your room?
I feel safer now. Is the power coming back soon?
I do not know, but it is often fixed fast.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the leaves changing color?
The trees are getting ready for the cold weather. Do you like the fall colors?
Why do the birds fly in a big group?
It helps them stay safe from bad things.
Why is the path so muddy?
It rained last night and the water soaked in. Do you like walking in the rain?
Why are the flowers gone?
I am not sure why those specific ones are gone.
Why is the air so sweet?
The grass just got wet and smells fresh. Do you smell that?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the rain. It makes me sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you see the puddles?
The puddles are just messy.
They can be fun to jump in later. What color is your jacket?
It is blue. I just want it to stop.
It will stop eventually. Do you have a warm drink?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is great! What is the big news?
I am going to a party.
A party sounds fun. Is it for a birthday?
Yes, it is for my friend.
Oh, that is nice. Will you get a gift?
Yes, I think I will.
I hope you have a great time. Do you like the color of the room?
I do not know the room color yet.
Oh, I see. Just have fun!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my party was very small.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you have a good time with your family?
Just my mom and me. It felt lonely.
Sometimes quiet days can be nice. Did you eat your favorite cake?
No, I forgot to buy the cake.
That is a shame, but we can fix it. Do you want to go buy one now?
That sounds great. Thank you for helping me.
You are very welcome. Let us go get some sweet treats.
Okay, let us go. I feel a bit better.
I am happy to hear that. It will be fun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My legs hurt from running.
That is okay. Are you tired?
I want to be fast.
Run slow first. Do you like the race?
Yes, I want a medal.
You will get one. How high did you jump?
I ran all the way.
That is good work. Do you want water?
I am still happy.
Good. Take a rest.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a great story to tell you.
That sounds fun. What happens in it?
A tiny mouse finds a big stick.
Is the mouse brave?
Yes, the mouse is very brave.
I love brave heroes. How does it end?
The mouse uses the stick to fix a boat.
Did the boat work?
Yes, the boat floated away on the water.
What a sweet ending. I am glad you shared it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Do you have a spot for my sandwich?
Yes, I do. Is it still warm?
I forgot the napkins. Can you spare one?
Here is a clean one. I do not know where the rest are.
I must go now. Thank you for the help.
Bye. Have a nice time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to build a shed, but I do not know where to start.
That is a big job. Do you already have a spot in your yard?
I have a spot, but I have no tools or plans.
You can borrow tools or look for free plans online.
I am still afraid I will make a mess or fail.
It is okay to make mistakes. Do you have a friend who likes to build things?
My neighbor knows a lot, but I feel shy to ask him.
Most people are happy to help. Go ask him for one small tip.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I clean a small boat in the harbor?
You use a soft cloth and water. Do you have a brush?
Yes, I have a brush. What else do I need?
Just a little soap. Would you like to try it now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I saw a big bear in the woods. I am scared. What should I do?
Stay still and make yourself look small. Do you have any food with you?
Yes, I have a sandwich. Should I feed it?
No, never share food with wild animals. It can be dangerous.
I do not know if it is safe to walk away now.
Walk away slowly and do not run. Can you see where the bear is looking?
It is looking at a tree. I want to go home.
Keep walking and stay calm. I do not know how big that bear is.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the baby cry so much?
The baby is likely hungry or tired. Do you want to know how to feed them?
How do I help them sleep?
A warm bath and a soft song work well. Are you feeling very tired?
Why do they smile at me?
They are getting used to your face. It is a happy sign.
What should I buy for them?
Soft clothes and clean bottles are best. Do you have a favorite color?
Why do they grow so fast?
I do not know the exact reason, but it is nature at work. Are you excited for their next month?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big fire outside my window this evening.
That must have been scary. Did you see the fire trucks?
Yes, they came very fast with loud sirens.
Good, the firefighters are brave. What color were the flames?
The flames were bright orange and yellow.
They must have looked like a hot sun. Were you safe inside?
I was very safe in my cozy room.
That is great to hear.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a bright red rose on the park bench today.
That sounds pretty. Did you pick it?
No, I just looked at it because it smelled sweet.
Good for you. Was it still in the vase?
It was in a small glass jar with water inside.
How nice. Do you like red flowers?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to act out a lion. How do I start?
Start with a deep roar from your belly. Is your stage big or small?
It is just a small room in my house.
Then stand tall and use your arms. Do you have a costume?
I only have a red shirt and no other things.
That is fine for a fire. Do you know the words to say?
I think I just need to say "Grrr".
"Grrr" works well. Would you like to try it?
Yes, look, I am roaring now.
That sounds very strong. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we help others?
We help because it makes them feel good. Do you like making people smile?
Yes, I do. But what if they do not want help?
Then we ask if they need a hand. Are you ready to try?
I am ready. What do we say first?
We say, "Can I help you?" Is that simple enough for you?
Yes, it is. I will try it now.
That is a great start. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My baby is waking up a lot at night. What can I do?
Try to keep the room dark and quiet. How old is the baby?
The doctor said it is normal, but I am so tired. Do you know why?
Babies often wake up to eat more. Are you feeding them enough during the day?
I think so, but I am not sure. Is there a good trick to help them sleep longer?
I do not know a magic trick, but a warm bath helps. What time do they usually fall asleep?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My phone screen is black.
Did you press the power button?
Yes, but nothing happens.
The battery might be empty. Do you have a charger?
I think so, but I lost it.
Try charging it for ten minutes. Is your home phone nearby?
I can ask for help.
That is a good plan. Go get some help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, I am so late!
Take a deep breath. Are you running for a bus?
Yes, it leaves in five minutes!
That is very soon. I can help you go faster.
Please, my bag is too heavy.
I will carry it for you. What is inside?
Just my lunch and books.
Here, I have it. Run fast now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The lights are off. I am scared of the dark.
Do not worry. I am here with you. Do you have a flashlight?
Yes, I found one under the bed. It is bright.
That is good. Stay close to the light. Is it loud outside?
No, it is very quiet. I just want the power back.
I hope it comes soon. Do you want to play a quiet game?
