talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I missed my bus this morning and had to walk.
That is very frustrating to deal with. Was it a long walk?
It took me twenty minutes to get there.
You must have been cold and tired. Did you make it to your stop in time?
I ran the last few blocks and just made it.
I am happy you caught it. Do you walk often when you are in a hurry?
Not usually, I just like the fresh air.
Fresh air is good for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is a circle?
A circle is round and has no corners. Do you like drawing circles?
Yes, I like them. What is a square?
A square has four sides that are all the same length. Do you have a square toy?
I have a box. Is a box a square?
A box is a 3D shape, but its flat faces are squares.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a mistake and I am so happy to tell you about it.
That is very brave of you. What did you do?
I broke my favorite blue cup by accident.
Oh no, that is sad, but I am glad you told me. Do you feel better now?
Yes, I feel light and free after saying it.
That is a good feeling. I do not know how to fix a cup, but I am here for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My teacher gave me a red star today.
That is very nice to hear.
But then she said my paper was messy.
Did you try to write more slowly?
No, I was just in a big rush.
I see why you felt sad.
She also let me keep the star.
That was a kind thing for her to do.
I think I like her a lot.
It is good that you feel that way.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Who is winning the match?
I do not know. Do you like soccer?
Yes, I do. I must go.
Go fast. Have fun there.
It is nearly time. Is the score close?
I am not sure. Be safe.
I have to run now. Goodbye.
Goodbye. Bye.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw the moon when I walked home today. It looked like a bright white ball in the blue sky.
That sounds like a nice walk. Did the light help you see the road?
Yes, it was very clear. I also saw a dog sleeping under the tree near my house.
The moon shines on everything, even sleeping dogs. Do you live close to that tree?
It is right by my garden. I waved at the moon before I went inside.
Waving to the moon is a sweet habit. Was it full or just a half circle?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. My train leaves soon.
Take a breath. You can make it. Do you have your ticket?
Yes, I have my ticket.
Good. Just walk fast. Are you going to the beach?
No, I am going to the city.
The city is nice. Drive safe.
Thanks. I must go.
Have a great trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The rain is falling hard. I do not know what to do.
We can sit by the window and watch it. Do you have any warm socks?
Yes, I have some. But I feel stuck inside.
Let us count the drops together. Does the sound make you feel calm?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dog is not eating his food today.
That can be a sign of illness. Is he playing like usual?
He is just lying on the floor and looks very sad.
If he stays down for more than a day, please call a doctor. I do not know your vet, so you must ask them for help.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I took a great picture of my cat today.
That sounds fun. What color is your cat?
She is black and white. Do you like cats?
Yes, I do. I hope she is happy in the photo.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The red paint will not dry. My picture is a mess.
That sounds very hard. Do you want to try adding a bit of white?
No, I just want to fix it. How do I make the red go away?
I do not know for sure. Do you want to wash your brush first?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do players kick the ball?
They kick it to score goals. Do you like watching games?
Why is the field green?
Grass is green and grows well on the field. It looks like nature.
Why do they wear big shoes?
Spikes help them run fast without slipping. I do not know why they are so big.
Why do they stop and talk to the man?
The man calls rules to keep it fair. Is he the referee?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my neighbor drop his hat in the mud.
That is a funny sight. Did he notice?
He did not see it at first.
So you picked it up for him?
Yes, I handed it to him.
He smiled and said thank you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Which season comes after winter?
Spring comes next. Do you like seeing flowers grow?
I love the leaves turning red in fall.
That is very pretty. Is it cold where you live in fall?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a new friend today.
That is wonderful to hear. How did you meet them?
We played a game together.
Games are a great way to connect. What was the game?
It was a ball game.
I am glad you had fun.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go now. The wind is loud.
Is your coat on? Please stay safe.
Yes, I have it on.
It is very dark outside. Do you see the moon?
No, it is too cloudy.
I do not know when it will stop.
I am leaving.
Okay. I will think of you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a pretty red flower. What is its name?
That looks like a rose. Do you like red flowers?
Yes, I do. They smell good.
Roses often smell sweet. Do you want to pick it?
Should I pick it?
It is better to let it stay. Who else likes this flower?
My mom likes it. Can you help me draw it?
I cannot draw, but I can help you talk about it. What color is the stem?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now.
Stay safe. Do you have your lamp?
Yes. I love reading dark.
That is not good for your eyes. Do you feel tired?
I have no time.
Please rest your eyes. Can you read later?
Good night.
Good night to you too.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, but I miss Sam so much.
That feels hard. Do you have a new phone for him?
No, I lost his number years ago.
You can try to find it online. Is he in the city still?
Yes, but I have to run.
Call him after work. It will be okay.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why does a big ship not sink?
It pushes water down, and the water pushes back up. Do you have a boat at home?
I want to make a paper boat.
Fold the paper like a square first. What shape do you like?
How do I stop it from leaking?
Use tape to seal the folds tight. Did you try that last time?
Is there a limit to how heavy it can hold?
If it sinks, the water weight wins. Do you want to test it now?
How do I fix it if it breaks?
I do not know, sorry. Can you dry it out?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Can you just say you are sorry?
I cannot say I am sorry if I did not do wrong. Are you feeling mad?
Just say it. I have to go.
I will not lie to you. Do you want to talk later?
No time. Bye.
Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to buy fruit at the market. How do I start?
Walk to the fruit stand and say hello. Do you like apples or oranges?
I like apples. What do I say next?
Just ask for the price of the apples.
I asked for the price. Now what?
Tell the seller how many you want to buy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I won my tennis match today. I am so happy.
That is great news! Do you hit the ball hard?
Yes, I hit it very hard. It was fun.
I like that you enjoy it. Was the weather good?
Yes, it was sunny and warm. I love playing outside.
Sunshine is nice for sports.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I wash my clothes in a machine?
Put them in, add soap, and pick a cold water wash. Do you sort your clothes first?
I just throw everything in together.
That is not good because dark colors can bleed. Do you have many dark shirts?
Yes, I have a lot of jeans and black t-shirts.
You should wash those separately from light colors. Do you have a separate basket for darks?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I stop the noise from my neighbor's loud dog?
Put soft pads on your floor to help. Do you play music too?
No, I just like quiet. What else can I try?
You can play soft music to cover the barks. Is the dog barking at night?
Yes, it barks at 3 am. That is very hard.
I am sorry that is hard. Try talking to the owner first.
I do not know the owner. Who do I call?
I do not know who to call in your town. You may ask a local friend for help.
Okay, I will ask my friend. Thank you.
You are welcome. Do you have a phone to call?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the rain. It ruins my day.
It is hard when it rains. Do you like playing inside?
I just wanted to go outside.
I know that feels bad. Is your house cozy?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired from work. I want to make pasta for dinner.
That sounds like a warm meal. Did you get the sauce from the store?
Yes, I bought a jar of tomato sauce. It was on sale at the market.
Good choice to save money. Do you like the smell of fresh basil?
I do not have basil, so I will skip that. I am putting the pot of water on now.
Boiling water takes time. What did you eat for lunch today?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My lights went out. What should I do?
Grab a flashlight. Is it just your house or the whole street?
The whole street is dark. I am scared.
Take a deep breath. You are safe. Do you have a battery?
Yes, I have two batteries. Now what?
Put them in your torch. Read a book while you wait. It will come back soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know if my fish is sick right now.
Is it swimming in one spot?
Yes, it just sits there. I must leave soon.
That is a bad sign. Does it look pale?
No, it looks orange. I have to go.
Keep it warm and check again later. Is the water clean?
I cleaned it this morning.
That is good. I do not know for sure. Is it eating?
No, it ignores the food.
Call a vet if it stops moving. Are you ready to go?
Yes, thank you. I am leaving.
Take care of your fish. Do you have a plan?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The sky is so blue today. How can I see the colors inside the light?
You can break light apart using a rainbow glass. Do you have a prism nearby?
I have a glass of water and a sunny window. Can I use those?
Yes, place the glass in the sun and let light hit it. Do you see a small rainbow on the wall?
I see a bright spot but no rainbow. Why is the sky blue to begin with?
The air mixes the light and scatters the blue part. That is why the day sky looks blue.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my red pen again. I need it for my big test tomorrow.
That sounds frustrating. Did you check your backpack?
I looked there, but it is not there. I am so worried about failing.
Take a deep breath. Do you remember where you last used it?
I think I left it at the library. I hate making such a mess.
It is good that you are trying to find it. Go to the library after school.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sun is very hot today. What should I do?
You can put on a hat and play in the shade. Do you have a hat with you?
I do not know where my hat is. What should I do now?
I do not know where it is, but you can look in the closet. Is it a sunny day outside?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad because we lost the big game.
That is a hard day to have. Did your team try hard?
Yes, but they just could not score any goals.
I am sorry about that. Do you play too?
I play, but I missed my best kick in the final minute.
That must hurt a lot. What did you think about then?
I thought about all the fun we had during the season.
That is a good way to look at it. Do you play often?
Every week, I love it, even when we lose.
You are very brave for that. I know how much you care.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my flower drink water today.
That is a lovely sight. Did you water it from the top?
Yes, I poured it in, but I am not sure how it gets to the roots.
Water travels down to the roots first. Is your plant looking happy?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I had a scary dream about a big dark monster. Did it come from my mind?
Yes, dreams come from your mind. Were you safe when you woke up?
I woke up and felt scared for a bit. How can I stop having them?
Try to think of happy things before bed. Do you have a toy that makes you feel safe?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a bad cold. I must go now.
That sounds rough. Are you taking medicine?
No time. I have a big job.
Drink hot water. Is your nose very stuffy?
Yes. It is blocked. I have to run.
Rest helps you heal. Do you have a blanket?
I will be late. Goodbye.
Please take care. Are you staying warm?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the snow so white?
It reflects all the light from the sun. Do you like cold days?
Why does it crunch under my feet?
The ice crystals break when you step on them.
Why is it so fluffy?
It has lots of tiny air bubbles inside. Do you like building castles?
Why does it melt when I hold it?
Your warm hands give heat to the ice.
Why does it never stop falling today?
The clouds are very full of moisture. Do you want a warm drink?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the lights off?
The power is gone. Is your house dark?
Yes, it is very dark. Do you know why?
I am not sure. Are you afraid of the dark?
A little bit. Will it come back soon?
It should fix itself. Can you read?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. The leaves are falling!
That sounds fun. Do you like jumping in them?
Yes, I do. But why do they fall down?
The tree gets cold in winter. It lets go to save energy. Do you see the brown ones on the ground?
Yes, I do. Is the tree sleeping?
Kind of. It rests until spring. Are you cold?
A little bit. But I am happy.
Warm is good for sleep. Do you want to play in the yard?
I will go now. Thank you.
Goodbye. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do we have to wear uniforms at school?
They help you feel part of a team. Do you like your blue shirt?
I think it looks boring.
I get it, it can feel dull. Do you play a sport there?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke my new cup.
Oh no. Are you okay?
Yes, but I am so sad.
It is just a cup. We can fix it.
Can we really?
Yes, with glue. What color is the cup?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big fish jump out of the lake this morning. It splashed water on my shoe.
That sounds like a wet surprise. Did you step away quickly?
Yes, I ran to the dry grass. The sun was warm on my face.
Glowing sun is a nice treat. What did you see next?
I sat on a rock and watched the boat float by. It moved very slowly.
Slow boats are peaceful. I do not know where it was going, but it looked calm.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw a big bear and it scared me so much.
Bears can look scary, but they usually just want to be left alone. Do you like looking at books about bears?
Yes, but I do not want to see one in the wild again.
That makes sense. It is safer to watch them from far away or at a zoo.
Why do they not just stay in the forest?
They need food and space, so they sometimes come near people for a snack. Have you ever seen a deer before?
I saw a deer, and it ran away very fast.
Deer are very fast and shy. They run when they feel unsafe. Do you like fast animals?
I guess so, but I just want to feel safe when I go to the park.
You are safe in the park. Most wild animals avoid people who are calm and quiet.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the apple stand by the big tree?
Yes, it is right there. Do you like sweet apples?
Yes, I do. How much is one?
It costs five coins. Would you like to buy two?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw a rainbow today, but it faded so fast. I felt a bit sad.
That can be upsetting. Do you like rainbows?
Yes, I do, but I could not take a good picture of it.
What did you try to do?
I looked up too late and it was almost gone.
That is tricky. Did you see all the colors?
I saw red and blue, but the rest just blurred away.
I do not know if it was fully gone. What color did you like best?
I loved the yellow part, but now I only have my sad feelings.
It is okay to feel that way. It was still real.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to buy.
The red apples look very sweet. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I do like them.
Then you should pick the red ones. I do not know if the green ones are sour.
That is a good plan.
I am glad you made a choice. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad because I lost my new pen.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you think it fell on the floor?
I looked in my bag, but it is not there.
That is very frustrating. Did you check your desk drawer?
Yes, I checked there too, but I still cannot find it.
I know how hard that is. Maybe you left it in the car?
I am going to go home and look again carefully.
That is a good plan. I hope you find it soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a lot of fun at the party today.
That sounds great. Did you eat any cake?
Yes, I had a big slice of chocolate cake.
Yum. Do you want some more later?
Maybe, but I am quite full now.
Good for you. How was the music?
It was loud and fun.
Nice. Did you dance?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My boat broke in the big wave.
That is very sad. Does it still float?
No, it sinks fast.
I am sorry. Did you see the hole?
Yes, it is a long cut.
I do not know how to fix it. Did you bring tools?
Just a rope and glue.
That might help. Can we try it now?
I hope it works.
Let us try together. Is the water calm?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the old well in the village is dry.
That is a hard thing to lose. Do you miss the sound of the water?
Yes, it was our best place to sit and talk.
The heart of a village often lives in its quiet spots. Do you remember who you sat with there?
Just my grandmother and me, mostly.
She sounds like a good listener. Does the rest of the village feel this loss too?
I think they are busy and do not care.
It is okay to feel alone in your worry. You can carry that feeling for a while.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do for him.
That is hard. What is wrong with him?
He feels sad all day long.
You can sit with him. Do you like to sit?
Yes, but I am shy.
Just be near him. You are kind.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I have so many small parts on the floor and I cannot find the right one.
That sounds very frustrating. Do you want to sort them by color first?
I tried that, but now everything is mixed up even more.
I am sorry it got worse. Can you put the blue pieces in a separate box?
This is too hard and I want to stop.
You can take a break if you need to. Is there a friend who can help you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared to move my home.
It can feel big, but you can do it. What is the hardest part for you?
Packing all my boxes.
Start with the things you use less. Do you have enough boxes ready?
Yes, I have a lot of boxes.
That is good news. Pack one small box at a time.
Should I throw away old clothes?
I do not know what fits you best. Would you like help sorting them?
I think I am ready to go.
You sound brave and ready. Good luck on your new day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is a circle?
It is round with no corners. Do you like circles?
Yes. What is a square?
It has four equal sides and four corners. Do you have any squares?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run, but why is the water salty?
Fish drop it into the sea long ago. Do you like salt on food?
No, I am late for school. Is the sea deep?
Yes, it goes very, very deep. Do you swim well?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I wanted to make a snowman, but the snow is melting.
That sounds very sad. Do you still have a bucket to help?
No, my bucket broke. I feel all wet and cold.
Let us sit by the fire to warm up. Are you tired?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky gray today?
It is raining, so the clouds are thick. Do you like the sound of rain?
I like it when it patters on the roof.
That is a nice sound. What are you doing under the roof?
I am drawing a picture of a frog.
A frog in the rain sounds fun. Is the frog happy?
Yes, the frog is very happy.
That is a sweet drawing. I hope you have fun today.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a very big book about whales.
That sounds like a lot of fun.
It has pictures of baby whales.
Do the pictures show them swimming?
Yes, they swim in the deep blue sea.
The sea is a very quiet place.
I want to read it all today.
I hope you find the end happy.
I will tell you what happens at the end.
I am happy for you.
The library is my favorite place.
It is a great place to learn.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The streets are so loud and full. I do not know where to go.
The park is quiet. Do you like trees?
I have no map. I feel lost in all these big buildings.
Look at the green sign. It shows the way.
There is a long line at that shop. What should I do?
We can wait. Do you want a snack?
I am tired. I want to sit down.
There is a bench right here.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I miss my grandma. She is not here to play.
That feels sad. Does she call you sometimes?
Yes, she calls on Sundays. But I want her to hug me now.
I do not have arms, so I cannot hug you. What is her favorite color?
Blue. She has a blue hat. It is very soft.
That is a nice hat. Do you like blue too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like singing, but my songs do not sound good. What can I do?
Try to listen to your favorite song first. Do you have a song you like?
I do not know what to learn next. I am stuck.
Pick one song you love and learn just one part. Is it a fast song or a slow one?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I have to try again?
Because our first try helps us learn. Did you enjoy the second part?
Yes, I did learn something new.
That is a great reason to keep going. Do you want help with the next step?
Yes, please help me.
I am glad to help you start over.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Please, help me, I am late.
Okay, take my hand. Where do you need to go?
To the big red door.
I do not know that way. Do you have a map?
Yes, it is right here.
Great, let us look. What does the map say?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why are the clouds gray? I feel so sad.
Rain is often inside. Do you like the smell of wet ground?
It feels heavy above us. It makes me worry.
That is just water waiting to fall.
Will it stop being gray soon? I do not like the dark.
Yes, the sun will dry them. Are you wearing your warm coat?
Okay, I will look up again. Thanks for helping me.
I am glad I could help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel alone right now. I have to go soon.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a friend nearby?
I really need to leave. Is this normal?
Yes, many people feel this way. Do you like talking to people?
I cannot stop for long. What can I do?
Try saying hello to someone. It is a small step.
I will try that later. Thank you.
You are welcome. Please be safe.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go to the beach this summer.
That sounds like so much fun. Do you like to dig in the sand?
Yes, I dig for shells. I found a big one last year.
A big shell is a great find. What color was it?
It was white and a little bit pink. It is my favorite shell.
That is a beautiful color.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to clean my room, but I do not know where to start.
Let's begin with your toys. What is your favorite toy?
I like my blue truck.
Great, please put the truck on the shelf.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look up at the sky. It is so bright. What should I do now?
That warm light is nice. Do you feel cold or hot?
I feel fine. But I do not know what to play.
Let your eyes rest for a bit. Do you like to sit or walk?
I think I will sit. I am not sure why, though.
Rest is a good choice. Is it quiet where you sit?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have good news about my little brother.
That sounds wonderful. What did he do?
He made me a drawing with a big red sun.
A red sun is very bright. Did he draw anything else?
Yes, he drew a cat sleeping in the sun.
That is a very sweet picture. Where is it now?
It is on our fridge door where I can see it.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count things?
We count to know how many. Do you like counting?
I do. But why start with one?
One is the first number. Why do you ask?
Because zero is weird.
Zero means no things. Is that hard to learn?
A little. Thanks for helping.
You are welcome. Do you want to practice?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a boat?
You make a loop with the rope and push it through the ring. Is your rope wet?
How do I know if the dock is safe?
Look for cracks in the wood and listen for loud pops. Do you see any red paint?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Can you help me with this hard math problem?
Yes, I can try to help. What part is tricky?
Why do we have to do this?
It helps your brain grow. Do you like puzzles?
Yes, I like them. But this one hurts my head.
That is a good sign. It means you are learning.
Okay, I will try again.
That is great. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we keep books in the quiet room?
We keep them quiet so people can read with peace. Do you like to read?
Yes, I do. Why are some books on low shelves?
Low shelves help small people find books easily. Is that why you liked them?
Yes, it is. Why can I not take books out?
We ask you to keep them here so others can use them. Do you want to borrow one?
I want to, but why must I give it back?
Returning books lets the next person enjoy the story. What book do you like best?
I like story books. Why is the room so cold?
I do not know why it is cold. Do you want to get a warm drink?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw the cat next door chase a butterfly this morning.
That sounds fun. Did the cat catch it?
No, the butterfly flew away very fast.
What a close call. Was it sunny outside?
Yes, the sun was very bright and warm.
How lovely.
I waved at the neighbour after that.
A nice gesture. Did they wave back?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need new shoes for my feet.
Do you like running in them?
Yes, I run to school every day.
I can help you pick a nice pair.
What colors do you have?
Blue, red, and white. Do you like blue?
I think blue looks good.
Great choice. Let us look at the small sizes.
My feet are a bit long.
We have big sizes, too. Do you have your old shoes with you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to go to bed at the same time each day?
A steady time helps your body know when to rest. Do you have a special bedtime ritual?
Why does it help to keep my room dark?
Darkness tells your brain it is time for sleep. Is your bedroom very bright at night?
Why is it bad to look at screens before bed?
The light tricks your mind into staying awake. I do not know if every screen is bad, but dim lights help.
Why do I feel so tired in the morning?
Tiredness means you did not get enough sleep. How long did you sleep last night?
Why does a cool room help me sleep better?
A cool room helps your body relax and cool down. Do you like a warm or cool blanket?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The game will not work.
I am sorry you feel bad. What part is stuck?
I am tired of waiting. It is not fair.
It can be hard to wait. Do you like to wait?
No. I want it done now.
I understand that wish. I do not know the fix.
Please just help me.
I am here with you. Let us take a break.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My friend looks sad. What can I do?
Sit with them and listen. Do they want to talk?
I think so. They lost their dog.
That is very hard. Offer a hug.
Should I give them my toy?
That is sweet. Ask if they want comfort first.
Okay. I will ask them.
Good. Be kind and wait.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is very warm today. I feel so happy.
That sounds wonderful. Do you like the heat?
Yes, I love it. It feels like a big hug.
I like that thought. What are you doing outside?
I am eating a cold ice cream. It is sweet and yummy.
That sounds like a great treat.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make pasta for dinner.
That sounds tasty. Do you like the sauce red or green?
I want to put cheese on top.
Cheese melts nice and hot. Is the pot on the stove yet?
I am afraid the water might boil over.
Stay close so you can help me. Do you smell the garlic now?
It smells very strong.
Good. We can start the stove when you are ready.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today!
That is great to hear. What made you smile?
I just cleaned the whole house and it looks shiny.
You did a wonderful job. Do you want to take a break?
Yes, I want to sit down and rest for a bit.
That sounds nice.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sun so bright?
It is bright because it is a giant ball of hot fire. Do you like sunny days?
Is the sun really fire?
Yes, it is very hot, but it is not like a campfire. Does it feel warm on your face?
Can I touch the sun?
No, the sun is too far away to touch. I do not know how fast you run.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a box with no tag. What is inside?
That is a good mystery. Do you have a key?
No, but the lid is loose. Should I open it?
Yes, please open it. What do you see?
It has red ribbons and small bells.
Those are for gifts. Who gave it to you?
I do not know. Should I give it away?
I do not know for sure. Do you like it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because I saw the cows eating grass in the big green field.
That sounds very nice. Do you like to feed them carrots?
Yes, I love watching them munch on the food with their big mouths.
They must be enjoying it too.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here but I do not know where to go.
The door is right there. Are you hungry?
Yes, but I do not know what to eat.
I like the soup very much. Do you like warm food?
Yes, but I am not sure if it is good.
Many people say it is sweet and nice. Have you tried it before?
No, I am just scared it will be bad.
It is a safe choice. Do you want to try it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make pasta. How do I do it?
First, boil a big pot of salty water. Do you like eating meat or just vegetables?
I like meat. What comes next?
Cook the meat in a pan with oil.
And the pasta? What should I add?
Put the pasta in the boiling water. Do you have any cheese at home?
Yes, I do. What is the last step?
Mix the pasta, meat, and cheese together.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. Do you know why?
I love your smile. What made you feel this good?
I saw a big green tree. It was so tall.
That sounds lovely. Do you like looking up at branches?
Yes, the leaves dance in the wind. It is very pretty.
Nature is a great healer. Do you visit it often?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am very tired. I want to learn to make toast.
That is a simple task. Did you find the bread?
Yes, I have the bread. Do I just put it in the machine?
You press the lever down. Is the lever stiff?
No, it moves well. What is the last step?
Pull the handle when it pops up. Did you like the smell?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need to read the clock.
Look at the long hand. Where does it point?
It points to the six.
That means half past. You can check by looking at the short hand.
The short hand is between one and two.
So it is half past one. Does that feel right?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not want to go to the doctor. It makes me feel sad and sick.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you have a specific worry?
Yes, I hate the needle. It hurts a lot.
That is a very real fear. Would a sticker help?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was very bright today. It made my eyes feel warm.
That sounds lovely. Did you close your eyes to see the light?
Yes, I looked at it for a bit. Then I went inside.
That is a wise choice. It is good to rest sometimes.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to grow a tomato plant in my garden.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a sunny spot for it?
Yes, my back yard gets a lot of light.
Great. Plant the seed deep and water it every day. Do you have a small pot for the seed?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I keep my chickens safe from foxes?
Use a strong fence and close the coop at night. Do you have a dog?
No, just the chickens and some pigs.
Pigs need mud to stay cool. Is it very hot where you live?
Yes, it is a dry, hot farm.
Give the pigs a shady spot and plenty of water. Do you know where they like to rest?
They like to lie in the dirt by the big tree.
That sounds like a perfect place for them.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to run, but my legs feel heavy.
That is normal. Have you eaten a good snack before running?
Yes, I had an apple.
Apples are good. Do your legs hurt or just feel tired?
They just feel very tired.
Rest is part of running. Do you like listening to songs when you run?
Yes, I like music.
Music can help you move. It is true that rest makes you stronger.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the big market today.
That sounds like a lot of work. Did you have fun?
I bought some red apples.
Red apples are sweet. Do you like them?
They were very juicy and nice.
Juicy is a good word.
I also saw a tall green tree.
Is that a real tree?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The net is so big and loud. How do I find what I need?
Try the little box at the top. What are you looking for today?
I just want to see cute animals. Is it safe to look at strange sites?
Stick to the big, famous pages. They check their stuff. Do you like cats or dogs?
I like cats. But sometimes the words are hard for me.
I do not know which words you find hard. Try typing your word into a spell checker.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the wind push my hair?
It is air moving very fast. Does it feel cold to you?
Yes, it is cold and strong.
That is because the moving air takes heat from your skin.
Can we stop it?
I do not know how to stop the wind. Do you like playing in it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big bear in the woods today. It looked very happy as it ate berries.
That sounds like a great day! Did the bear look at you?
No, it was too busy eating. I stood very still and did not touch it.
That was very smart of you. Keep your distance from wild animals.
I felt lucky to see such a strong animal up close. It was a special moment.
I am glad you enjoyed the view. Was the weather nice when you were out there?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very sad about moving to the new house.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you like your old bedroom?
Yes, my bed is really soft and cozy.
I am glad you have a comfy spot. What color is your bed?
It is purple.
Purple sounds fun and bright. I do not know where your new house is, but it will be fine.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do my beans grow so tall?
They climb up to get more sun. Do you give them plenty of light?
Yes, but why do the leaves turn yellow?
That often means they need more water. How much do you water them?
I water them every day. Why do the bugs eat the leaves?
Bugs like sweet plant parts. Do you see any holes in them?
Yes, there are holes. Why do my tomatoes taste so sour?
I do not know for sure, but it can be from not enough sun. Are they in the shade?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix this fence now. It is broken.
That looks like a big gap. Is it safe to touch?
No time to check. I will just glue it.
Please do not glue wood. It will not hold.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the movie. Do you know if it is good?
Yes, it is very fun and fast. Do you like action movies?
Yes, I love big fights. How long is the film?
It takes about two hours. Is that too long for you?
No, but I must run now. Thanks for your help.
You are welcome. Have a great time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make my desk feel less boring?
Try adding a small plant or a bright lamp. Do you like colors?
I love blue, but I am tired of looking at screens.
Blue is a calm color that helps you focus. Are you staying up late?
Not usually, but my back hurts after three hours.
Try sitting with your back straight and feet flat. Does that help?
Yes, my chair is too soft, so I will move it.
A firm seat is better for your spine.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad because I saw a fox look at me with angry eyes.
That can feel scary. Did you run away?
No, I stayed still, but it did not come closer.
You did the right thing by staying still. Foxes usually want to keep their space.
I wish I could just touch the soft fur of a bear.
Bears are too big and strong for hugging. Do you like big cats?
I like tigers, but I fear they will eat me.
That is a true fear. Tigers are wild and hungry.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is it so hard to be patient?
It feels hard because we want things right away. Do you feel that way, too?
Yes, I do. What helps when I feel rushy?
Taking a slow breath helps calm my mind. I do not know if one trick works for everyone.
I will try breathing. Thank you.
You are welcome. How did that first breath feel?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I spent too much on candy today.
That sounds tricky. Do you like candy?
Yes, but I have no coins left for a bus ride.
I am sorry to hear that. Where did you spend it?
At the shop by the park. I should have saved them.
That is a good lesson. Do you have an extra bill?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad and scared inside.
That feels hard. Do you want to talk about it?
I am worried about the big test tomorrow.
I understand. What part worries you most?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel very sad and I have to go now.
I am sorry you feel that way. What made you feel this way?
I am sorry, I am running late.
Take your time to breathe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That is a great goal. How did you feel when you first sat on one?
I was scared but also very proud of myself for trying.
Fear often goes hand in hand with pride. Do you have a quiet place to practice?
Yes, my backyard is very safe and empty.
Keep pushing forward slowly. What part do you find hardest?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and saw a big red dog.
That sounds fun. Did you walk the dog?
No, it was not mine. I sat on the bench and watched it play.
A rest is good. What did you do after the park?
I made a warm soup for dinner and felt very happy.
Warm soup is nice. You seem ready for your next step.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to read my book in the dark tonight.
That sounds like a warm and cozy choice. Do you have a special lamp?
Yes, I have a small light that glows like the moon.
How lovely and soft that must be.
It makes me feel safe and very calm.
I am glad to hear that. What book are you reading?
It is a story about a brave little fox.
That sounds like a great pick. Is the fox kind?
Yes, he is very kind to the other animals.
I am sure you will enjoy the rest of it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big lighthouse today. It stood on a rocky cliff.
That sounds like a very tall place. Do you know what color it was?
It was white with a red top. The light shone bright in the dark.
White and red is a classic look. Did you see any boats nearby?
Yes, I saw a small fishing boat. It looked safe under the light.
It is good to see them safe. Does the lighthouse still work now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My bread dough is not going up. I do not know why.
It needs warm air and time. Is the room warm enough?
The kitchen feels cold. What should I do?
Put it near a heater or a sunny spot. Do you have a towel?
Yes, I have a towel. How do I use it?
Cover the bowl to keep it cozy. It will grow soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a small box, but I cannot see how to open it.
That sounds tricky. Do you have a key?
No key, just a picture of a bird on the lid.
Maybe the bird is the clue. Does the wing have a number?
I see a line, but no number.
I do not know for sure, but try tapping the corner gently.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: What day is it today?
I think it is a quiet day. What makes you feel unsure?
I do not know if it is Monday or Tuesday.
You can look at your planner. Do you have your planner nearby?
My planner is on the desk, but I cannot find the date.
The desk is a good place to look. Is the red folder on the top?
Yes, the red folder is there, but I still feel lost.
Take a deep breath and read the page. Do you see a number on the top line?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was very hot today. It burned my nose.
Ouch. That sounds bad. Did you feel better later?
I took a cold bath. It felt good.
That is a smart choice. I am glad you are safe.
The sun is back out now. It looks pretty.
Yes, it does. Do you see any clouds?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like the song where the little duck goes quack.
That is a cute song. Do you like the quack part the most?
Yes, because it sounds funny when the duck sings.
I agree it is fun to hear.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a big secret. Can you tell me what I should do with it?
I would keep it safe and share it only with someone you trust. Do you feel happy or sad about it?
I do not know. Can you tell me if it is a good secret?
I cannot know for sure, but a good secret makes people feel safe, not scared.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Which way is the train?
Go left. Are you taking the red train?
Yes, I need to catch it now. Where is the door?
It is just ahead. Good luck!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look up at the night sky. So many lights. I do not know what to do with my eyes.
That is very nice to see. Do you like the big, bright ones best?
I think I just want to sit. I feel small and quiet under all that light.
Sitting is a good thing. It lets your eyes rest.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today. I want to tell you about my day.
That is nice to hear. What made you feel so good?
I shared my lunch with a friend. He was very hungry.
That is a very kind thing to do. Did you feel warm inside?
Yes, my heart felt full of joy. Thanking others helps too.
You are right, "please" and "thank you" go a long way. Do you say them often?
I try to say them every day. I feel good when I do.
Good manners make everyone smile. Keep it up.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I count my toys?
Start with one and add one more for each toy. Do you have a favorite toy?
I like the red truck.
Good choice. Count the red truck as number one. Is the truck big?
Yes, it is big.
Big toys are fun to count. Do you want to count them again?
Yes, please.
Great, let us count together. Are you ready?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked past the big blue park and now I do not know where my house is.
That is a scary feeling. Do you see a tall red tower nearby?
Yes, I see the red tower, but I am walking the wrong way.
Turn around and walk toward the tower. Can you see a long yellow school bus?
I see the bus, but it is parked on the quiet side street.
Good, that is a safe place. Do you hear any dogs barking?
I hear a dog, but I think I am still lost in the woods.
Do not worry, I am with you. Let us stay still and wait for help.
I feel less scared now that someone is talking to me.
That is good news. Keep your phone warm and calm.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is this spot red on my map?
It usually means a busy place. Is it near a road?
Yes, right next to the highway.
Then it is likely a town. Do you want to visit it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need help moving my house. I am in a big rush.
I can help you move. Are you moving a big table?
Yes, the table is very heavy. Please lift it with me.
I will lift it carefully. Do you have boxes for the small things?
I have boxes here. I must go now, please start.
I will start now. I am happy to help you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I played chess today and I won a game.
That is very nice to hear. Do you like checking the king?
Yes, I love it, but I made a big mistake later.
Oops, things happen to all players. What did you lose?
I lost my best knight because I was not careful.
That is a sad way to lose a piece. Did you play another game?
No, I was too tired, but I feel proud of winning first.
Winning first is a great start for you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am going on a trip. What should I pack in my bag?
Do you know how many days you will be away?
Yes, I will be there for three days.
Bring a few clean shirts and one pair of pants. Do you have any special shoes?
I have my walking shoes ready. What else is important to bring?
Take a small book and your charger. Have a nice time on your trip!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind blew very hard today.
That must have sounded loud. Did it shake your house?
Yes, the windows rattled a lot.
I am sorry it was scary. Are you safe inside now?
The rain started after that.
Rain can be wet and cold. Do you have a warm blanket?
I watched it from my window.
Watching rain can be calm. Did you see any lightning?
The power went out at the end.
That is a big surprise. Did you use a candle to see?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why is this street so silent today?
It is peaceful and calm. Do you like the quiet?
I wish I could hear the cars again.
The noise is gone. What is missing?
I feel lonely here.
I understand your feelings. Do you want to sit?
Yes, I think I will.
That sounds good. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late today because the little hand on my clock moved too slow.
Oh, that is tricky. Did you check if the clock was still running?
Yes, I saw the big hand spin around many times while I slept.
That is how a clock tells time. Do you know which hand moves the fastest?
The thin one on top? I learned that in school.
Yes, that is true. The thin hand goes around once every minute.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make eggs taste good?
Add salt and pepper. Do you like them soft or hard?
I like them soft.
That is called scrambled. Start with low heat.
What is low heat?
It is just a little hot. Are you using a pan?
Yes, I have a pan.
Great. Stir slowly. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My cat will not eat her food.
That sounds worrying. Is she acting sleepy or sick?
Yes, she is hiding under the bed.
I do not know the cause. Please take her to a doctor.
It is closed right now.
I am sorry to hear that. You can try calling ahead.
I am afraid to leave her alone.
Keep her warm and safe. A doctor must see her soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do we say please and thank you?
It shows we are nice to others. Do you like when others are nice to you?
I forgot to say thanks to my friend.
It is okay. You can fix it later. What did you forget to say?
I will tell her tomorrow.
That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to set up a desk at home.
That is a good idea. Do you have a table?
Yes, I have one. How do I use it?
Put your computer on it. Keep your papers in a box.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The wind is howling and I must leave now.
The sky is very dark and wet. Are you safe in your coat?
I am running to the bus stop as fast as I can.
The rain is falling very hard. Is the bus coming soon?
Yes, I see its lights in the distance.
That is good news for you. Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a big, shiny beetle! It is so cool.
That sounds exciting. Is it green or red?
It is green and very shiny. I loved watching it walk.
How nice of you to share. Do you like ants too?
Yes, ants are tiny but strong. I think bugs are great.
You have a kind heart for small lives. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so worried about the big test.
Take a slow breath. Do you know what you need to study?
I have to go now, but I am scared.
It is okay to feel that way. What part is hardest?
I am running out of time!
You can do this. Is there anyone to help?
Please, I must run!
Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do about my boat.
That sounds hard. Are you feeling scared?
Yes, the wind is very strong today.
You should stay on land. Do you see a safe place to sit?
I think I will just go to the beach.
That is a good plan. Please watch the waves closely.
I am still not sure if I should leave my hat.
I do not know what you want. Do you like your hat?
Yes, it keeps my head warm.
Then you should keep it. You will be happy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need coffee and toast right now. I am very late.
Okay, I have warm toast for you. Do you like jam?
Yes, please. It is sweet.
Here is your toast with jam. Is that enough for you?
No, I need coffee too.
I can get you coffee in a minute. Do you take sugar?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My new puzzle pieces do not fit.
That sounds very hard. Do you have extra pieces?
I think I lost two of them.
Oh no. Have you looked under the couch?
Yes, but they are not there.
I am sorry. I do not know where they went.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big, brown squirrel.
Oh, look at its fluffy tail. Does it have any nuts?
I think so, but it ran away.
Squirrels are very fast. Was it scared of you?
I just wanted to give it a treat.
That is a very kind idea. What kind of treat did you have?
I had a stale cookie.
A cookie sounds sweet. I hope you found a new friend.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to look at a picture of a cat online today.
That sounds like fun. Was the cat cute?
Yes, it was very fluffy. The picture loaded very fast.
Fast loading is great. Do you have a cat at home?
No, I do not. I only like to look at them on the web.
That is okay. The internet has many kinds of cats.
I saw a kitten that looked like a cloud.
A cloud kitten sounds soft. Did you take a photo of it?
I cannot take a photo of a screen. I just watched it.
Watching is fine. Did you tell a friend about the kitten?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The screen is dark and I do not know what to do.
Is the power cord in the wall?
Yes, it is plugged in.
Okay, do you see a light on the front?
There is no light at all.
I think the plug may be bad. Can you try a different hole in the wall?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I drank a lot of coffee today because I was tired.
That sounds tiring. Did you feel better?
Yes, but my hands shook. I think I need to try tea.
Tea is good for calm days. What kind do you like?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big wooden shed in the yard.
That sounds like a fun project. What color do you want to paint it?
I want to use only hammers to put the walls up.
Hammers are great for nails, but you will need a screwdriver for the screws too. Do you have one?
I can just use my fingers to hold the wood tight.
Your fingers will get very tired, so please use clamps to hold the wood. Where will you put the door?
I think I can do all the cutting by myself.
Please do not use the saw alone; I am here to help you cut safely.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to count my apples, but I always mix up the numbers.
That happens to many people. Do you count them one by one?
Yes, I touch each apple, but my finger slips sometimes.
Slipping can make you count twice. Do you have a helper nearby?
No, it is just me in the kitchen.
Try pointing to each apple instead of touching it. Do you like pointing?
I think pointing might work better for my hands.
Pointing takes two steps, which is slow but safe. Do you want to try it now?
Yes, I will point slowly to each red apple.
Great, take your time and stay calm. Do you see the last apple yet?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw an old statue on a hill today.
That sounds like a place with a long past.
I wondered who built it all those years ago.
I do not know who built it, but I am curious. What was the statue of?
It was a king sitting on a horse.
A king on a horse is a very common sight in old history. Did you touch the stone?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, the lights just went out. I am late for work and I have to go now.
Stay safe on the dark road. Is your phone full?
Yes, it has a little charge, but I need to leave. Please tell me if the power comes back.
I will try to watch for it. Do you have a candle?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do. I feel lost.
It is hard to choose. Do you like the blue one or the red one?
I think I like blue, but I am not sure.
Blue is a nice color. Is it for your room?
Yes, it is for my room. I want it to feel calm.
Blue helps people rest. You can pick it later if you want to wait.
Waiting sounds okay. I will sleep on it.
Good plan. Rest well now.
Thank you. I feel better now.
You are welcome. I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss the loud trains and bright lights back home.
New places can feel scary at first. Do you miss the noise?
Yes, the quiet here feels too big.
The quiet can get louder with time. What is your favorite part of the new town?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat down at my desk to start work today.
That sounds like a good start.
But the screen stayed dark and silent.
That can be very frustrating. Do you know if it has power?
I checked the cord and it was plugged in tight.
Good check.
I pressed the button but it only made a sad hum.
That hum often means a low battery or a loose part.
Then I remembered I needed to fix my lunch.
Food is very important too.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so happy to see the big white dress.
It is very pretty. What color are the flowers?
The flowers are red and yellow.
Those colors match the dress well. Do you like the music?
Yes, the song is very sweet.
It sounds lovely. I hope you enjoy the dance.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Can you help me pack?
Yes, I can help. Do you have your coat?
I do not have my coat. I am in a big rush.
Your coat is in the box. You can go now.
Thank you. Is the food ready?
I do not know about the food. Is your bag full?
My bag is too heavy. I must leave now.
Good luck on your trip. Do you like snow?
I do not like snow. I am going anyway.
That is brave. Have a fun day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sky is so blue and the sun is warm. I am very happy today.
That sounds lovely. Do you like the sunshine?
Yes, I do. I am going for a walk in the park.
What a good plan. Have fun out there.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go camping, but I do not know what to bring.
Bring a tent, a map, and some warm clothes. Do you like to fish?
Yes, I love fishing. I also need food, but I am not a good cook.
Pack simple things like sandwiches and fruit. Do you have a pot?
I have a small pot. I am worried about the rain.
Bring a tarp to stay dry. Is it warm where you are going?
It is cold at night. I need a good plan.
Take a thick sleeping bag and a heater. Do you like to read at night?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took the train to the park today. The blue seats were very nice.
That sounds like a good rest. Did you bring a book to read?
Yes, I read a funny story about a cat. I shared my apple with the lady next to me.
That is a kind thing to do. Did the train ride make you happy?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on my story. The girl does not know what to do.
What happens to her next?
She finds a big red apple. I do not know where to send her.
Maybe she eats it? Does she feel hungry?
No, she is not hungry. She looks at the apple and feels sad.
That is strange. Why is she sad?
Because the apple is broken. I want to help her fix it.
That is a kind thought. Can she glue it back together?
No, glue is not magic. I think she is losing hope.
Maybe a friend finds her? Who is her friend?
I do not have a friend in the story yet. Can you invent one?
I cannot invent for you, but you can try.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished a big red flower for my art class. It feels so good to make it.
That sounds like a great job. What did you use for the stem?
I used a thick green stick of clay. It is very strong now.
That is a smart choice for strength. Does the flower have a face on it?
Yes, it has a big smile and round eyes. I think it looks happy.
I am glad to hear it is happy. I do not know if it will smell nice, but it looks fun.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The light in my room is not working. I do not know why.
Check the switch first. Is it on?
It is on. I am scared to look at the wire.
Do not touch the wire. Do you see a red button on the wall?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to act in a play.
That sounds fun. Do you like to read out loud?
Yes, I love reading stories.
Reading is a great start. Would you like a tip on how to use your hands?
Please, tell me how to use my hands.
Just move them like you are holding a big, heavy ball.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to catch the train, but the street is full of cars.
The tunnel ahead is clear. Are you running to the bridge?
Yes, the bridge is my only way to get there on time.
It is close to you. Do you have your ticket ready?
I am holding it, but my bag is too heavy to carry fast.
You can put it down for now. Is the train coming soon?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a square box with a circle inside. I do not know where to start. Do you have a tip?
Try to find the corner with the most lines. Is the circle touching the edge?
No, it is floating in the middle. I feel stuck. What do I do?
That is a great clue. Look for a line that splits the box in half.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoelaces. Can you show me?
That is a very important skill. Do you have your shoes ready?
Yes, I am sitting on the floor with my red shoes.
First, make a big loop with one string. Is it big enough?
It is big, like a mouse hole.
Great. Now take the other string and loop it under the first one.
I did it, but it looks like a mess.
That is okay for the first try. Pull both strings tight to make a knot.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a big black bug in my bed. Should I kill it?
It looks like a beetle. Do you know where it came from?
I do not know. It just appeared here.
Beetsles often hide in clothes. Can you take it outside gently?
I am afraid it might bite me.
Most beetles do not bite people. Just scoop it up and let it go.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to say hello in French.
The word is "bonjour." Do you like French food?
Yes, I love bread. How do I ask for more?
You can say "encore." Is that a big loaf of bread?
It is a small one. I am hungry.
Then eat it quickly. Are you going to eat it now?
Yes, I will eat it soon. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a good meal.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read my favorite book about a red fox.
That is a nice story. Did the fox find a friend?
Yes, the fox found a blue bird in the tree.
What a sweet pair. How did they play together?
They chased each other in the tall grass.
That sounds like a lot of fun.
Then I had to go to bed very early.
Good night.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the man next door building a big wall?
He may want to keep his garden safe. Is he using red bricks?
I think so. Why does he build it so high?
Tall walls can stop cats from jumping in. Do you like cats?
Yes, I do. Why is he not saying hello to us?
I do not know why he is quiet. I will ask him for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to fly a kite in the wind. How do I start?
Do you have a kite ready? Hold the string with one hand and hold the tail with the other.
I have a kite, but the tail is missing. What should I do then?
You can use a long scarf as a tail. Does the wind feel strong or weak right now?
The wind is blowing hard. Please tell me how to let it go.
Run forward and let go of the tail. Watch the kite climb into the sky.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for my new job.
Take a deep breath. Are you wearing your clean shirt?
Yes, but I still have to pack my bag.
Good. What is the most important thing to grab first?
My keys and my phone.
Smart. Leave the rest if you are out the door.
You gave me good advice, thank you.
I am happy to help. Have a great day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My phone screen is all black and will not turn on. What should I do?
Try holding the power button for five seconds. Does it have a loud sound inside?
No sound, and the screen stays dark. I tried the power button again, but nothing happens.
It may need new power from a plug. Do you have a cable to test this?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, my phone is glowing blue!
That is a happy color. Is that your new phone?
Yes, it sings to me!
I do not know how phones sing. Does it make loud sounds?
It is my best friend!
Friends are very good. Do you show it to your mom?
I want to give it to you!
That is very kind. Why do you want to give it away?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my soup boiling?
The heat makes it bubble. Do you like hot soup?
Why do I need to stir it?
Stirring stops it from sticking. Is it thick?
Why is it so salty?
I am not sure. Do you taste it?
Why did you add salt at all?
Salt adds flavor. Does it taste good?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My brother broke my toy. I am very angry. What should I do?
I am sorry to hear that. Are you safe?
Yes, but I want to hit him. I do not know what else to do.
Please do not hit. Telling him how you feel is a good start.
I tried talking, but he did not listen. I feel sad.
I do not know why he did that. Would you like to play together now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now, but the floor is dirty.
Do you want help?
Please, can you wipe it?
I will start with the kitchen.
Thank you, I am rushing.
Is the main door open?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want a drink, but I cannot pick.
That is hard. Do you like it hot?
Yes, it must be warm.
Coffee is very hot. Tea is also warm.
I do not know if I want the bean or the leaf.
Both are good. What color do you like?
Brown feels right for me.
Brown works for both. Try a small cup first.
Okay, I will try a little bit.
That is a wise start.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need a roof on the shed?
To keep the rain out so your tools do not get wet. Is there a lot of rain where you live?
Yes, it rains a lot. What should I use for the floor?
Wooden planks work well because they are strong. Do you have any wood ready?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a bee today. It looked so busy in the flower.
Bees do make honey from flower sugar. Was the flower yellow?
Yes, it was bright yellow. I wondered where it went with the sugar.
It flies back to the hive. Do you know where hives are?
No, I did not. So what does it do with the sugar?
It dries the sugar with its breath. Then it stores it in wax.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a funny riddle. Do you want to hear it?
Yes, please tell me. What is the riddle?
It asks what gets wetter the more it dries.
That is a tricky one. Do you have the answer?
The answer is a towel. Isn't that silly?
A towel makes sense. I like that answer.
I am so glad we talked about it.
It was fun to chat. Do you have another puzzle?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very worried about starting my new job.
That is okay to feel. What is the main thing that scares you?
I do not know how to do the work.
You can learn it one small step at a time. Do you have a guide?
No, I have no guide or help.
You can ask a friend for help. That is a good start.
I will try to ask someone tomorrow.
That sounds like a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The lights went out and I am angry.
I am sorry. Is it just your house or the whole street?
It is the whole street. It feels so dark.
That sounds scary. Did you bring in your candles?
I have a candle, but I do not know why the power is gone.
I do not know the reason. Are you safe?
Yes, but I miss my TV.
I hope it comes back soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know about the moon before I leave.
It is a big rock that shines in the night sky. Do you like to look at it?
I have no time for that. How far is it from us?
It is very far, about a quarter of a million miles away.
Quick, does it have air for us to breathe?
No, there is no air up there for us. Thank you for asking.
I am done. Goodbye.
Goodbye to you too.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just saw the best bakery ever. The bread smells so sweet.
That sounds lovely. Is there a line?
Yes, but it moves fast. The pastries look so good.
I am glad you are happy. Do you want to buy one?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to draw a cat, but its ears look wrong. What should I do?
Try making the tops of the ears point out a bit. Do you have a pencil to erase mistakes?
I have a pencil. The body looks too round, like a ball. How can I fix it?
Draw the back lines a little flatter than the front. Do you like drawing animals or people?
I like animals. I still feel stuck on the tail. Can you help me with that?
I do not know exactly, but try making it thin at the tip. Is the tail on the left or right side?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I wash my red shirt?
Put it in the cold water with other red clothes. Do you have any blue jeans to wash?
No, just the shirt. Is warm water okay?
Warm water is fine for cotton shirts. Do you use liquid soap or powder?
I use liquid. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. I am glad to help you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late! How many days are in a week?
There are seven days. Are you going to school?
Yes! What day comes after Monday?
Tuesday comes next. Do you like Tuesday?
I just need the count. Is it one, two, three, four, five, six, seven?
Yes, that is right. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a secret to tell you.
Oh? I am listening.
My teacher gave me a surprise gift.
How nice! Was it a book?
No, it is a big blue box.
A box? What is inside?
Inside is a new red bike.
That is wonderful. Are you riding it today?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my baby cry so much when he is hungry?
Babies cry because they have big feelings and no words yet.
How can I tell if he is tired or just hungry?
Look for yawns or rubbing eyes to see if he is sleepy. Do you see him stretch a lot?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am feeling very sad today.
I am sorry you feel this way. What happened?
I found a shiny red leaf.
That sounds like a happy thing. Do you feel better now?
Yes, I am happy to share it.
I am glad you are smiling.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My phone screen cracked this morning.
Oh no, that sounds bad. Did it still work?
Yes, but the touch was slow.
Slow is hard to use. Do you need a new one?
I might get a small repair.
That is a good plan. I hope it works well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very scared about the test tomorrow.
That is a big feeling. What part of the test makes you the most nervous?
I do not know if I studied enough.
Did you read your notes at least once?
Yes, but I forgot some of the words.
It is okay to forget some things. Have you eaten lunch yet?
No, I am still hungry.
Let us go get some food together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to put a check in my picnic basket.
You should check the weather first. Is it sunny outside?
It is sunny, but I do not know how to fold a blanket.
Fold it in half, then fold it in half again. Do you have a small blanket?
Yes, I have a small one. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun at your picnic.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work. What day is it?
It is Monday. Do you need help with your schedule?
Monday means I must go to the gym today.
Yes, you go to the gym on Mondays. Is your bag ready?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: This street feels too quiet for me.
Do you like the silence? It can help us think.
I want to walk down it, but I am scared of the dark.
Bring a small light with you. Are you afraid of the dark?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do wild cats sleep a lot?
Yes, they sleep for many hours each day. Do you have a cat at home?
I do not have a cat. Do bears hibernate in winter?
Some bears do sleep through the cold season. Do you live near a forest?
I live in a big city. Do lions eat meat?
Yes, lions are meat eaters. Do you like loud animals?
I do not like loud noises. Do snakes have legs?
No, snakes do not have legs. Do you feel happy now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I walked for one hour and I feel so good.
That is wonderful news. Do you like the fresh air?
Yes, the air feels very nice in my lungs.
Walking helps your heart stay strong. Did you listen to music?
I did, and my legs feel light today.
Your body is happy now. Do you plan to walk again tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do trees talk to each other?
Yes, they share food and send warning signs through roots. Do you like walking in forests?
I do, but why do they lose their leaves in fall?
They do this to save energy when it gets cold and dark. I do not know why all trees do this at the exact same time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired of sitting in this chair. It hurts my back.
That sounds very hard to deal with. Do you have a soft cushion to help?
No, I do not have a cushion. My dog keeps sleeping on the only soft thing I have.
Dogs love to find warm spots to rest. Does he have his own bed nearby?
Yes, but he prefers my spot. I feel like a machine that must keep working.
Your body needs breaks to feel good again. Have you taken any steps outside today?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my red hat. I am late!
Is it on the chair?
No. I cannot see it.
Have you checked the box?
No, I did not look there.
It is likely there.
I will check now.
Good luck. Is it a warm day?
Yes. I must go.
Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the stars blink at night?
They blink because the air in our sky is moving. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I love the light. What are the stars made of?
They are made of hot gas that shines very bright. Are they all the same size?
No, some look big and some look small. Why are they different sizes?
Some are closer to us and some are farther away. I do not know why they started that way.
That is a mystery. Do they fall down sometimes?
Yes, some stars fall down as light, but most stay put. Do you want to see one fall?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a birthday cake, but I do not know how.
That is a big job. Do you have an oven at home?
Yes, I have an oven.
Great. First, you need flour, sugar, and eggs. Is your kitchen clean?
My kitchen is clean.
Good. Mix the dry things first. Do you have a big bowl?
I have a big bowl.
Perfect. Pour the wet things in slowly. Do you like chocolate or vanilla?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to climb a tall hill.
That is a brave goal. Do you like walking?
Yes, I love walking on the grass.
First, you need strong legs. Do you have comfortable shoes?
I have my red sneakers.
Those are good for trails. Are you ready to start now?
Yes, I am ready to go.
Great, take small steps. Do you see the path?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big, white mountain today.
That sounds amazing. Was it cold up there?
Yes, it was very cold and windy.
I do not know what that feels like, but you must be warm. Did you bring a coat?
I had my thickest coat and gloves on.
Good idea to stay warm. Did you see any animals?
I saw a goat sitting on a rock.
A goat! That is very lucky. Did it look at you?
It looked right at me with its dark eyes.
How fascinating. You had a wonderful day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Can you help me pack my books?
I can carry them. What is in your other box?
Just dirty clothes. I need a van now.
I do not know where to get one. Do you have a phone?
Yes, but I need hands, not calls.
I can lift the heavy stuff. Is the house close?
Two blocks away. Let us go, please.
I will walk with you. Are you eating today?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see a big fire out in the yard.
That looks scary. Do you know how big the flames are?
They are very tall. How do I put it out?
Use water or sand. Did you bring a hose with you?
No, I only have a bucket.
You can carry water to the small flames. Is the fire close to your house?
Yes, it is near my wall.
Stay back and call for help now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am hungry but I do not know what to eat.
That can feel hard. Do you like warm food or cold food?
I think I want a sandwich, but maybe soup?
Soup is a warm choice. Do you want to check the office fridge first?
I do not want to go get more cold air.
Then stick with the sandwich. You can take a nice break.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and looked up at the bright blue sky.
That is a nice place to look. Do you know why it looks blue?
I saw a lot of white clouds, but I am not sure about the blue part.
Sunlight has many colors in it. The air pushes the blue light around the most.
Oh, so the air is mixing the light?
Yes, it scatters the blue light all over the sky. Did you see any birds while you were there?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the fruit shop today.
That sounds fun. What did you buy?
I picked some red apples.
Apples are sweet and crunchy. Did you eat one?
Yes, I ate one right there.
The seller was happy to see you.
I will go back next week.
That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my party was moved up.
That is hard. Did you find out why?
The cake is not ready and I am angry.
I am sorry you feel that way. Would a warm drink help?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to paint a tree, but I do not know where to start.
Start with the brown trunk. Do you like brown?
I do like brown, but the leaves look hard to draw.
You can just paint green blobs. Does that sound easy?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my fish swimming at the top?
Is it gasping for air?
Yes, it moves its mouth very fast.
It needs clean water. I do not know why it is doing that.
What should I do now?
Change some water today. Do you feed it every day?
I put food in twice a day.
That is good. Watch it closely.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must tell you a secret right now, but I am very late.
I am ready to listen, but what makes you so rushed?
I found a lost key in the park.
That is a good thing to do. Where did you find it?
