It is for the gate behind the old house.
That sounds like a safe place. Do you know who it belongs to?
I do not know, but I must return it now.
You are a kind friend. Will you be safe on your way?
Yes, I am going fast to give it back.
Good luck to you. Be careful on your walk.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the small birds fly so fast?
They fly fast to get food. Do you see the big bird?
Yes, why does it sit on the high branch?
It sits high to feel safe. It watches for bad things.
Why do they peck the ground?
They peck to find bugs.
Why are they not scared of me?
I do not know why they trust you. Do you have treats?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dog is sad and will not eat.
That sounds hard. Is he acting sick?
I do not know what to do.
Please call a vet soon. Do you have their number?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My head hurts a lot today.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you get enough sleep?
Yes, I slept well.
That is good. Does it feel like a throb or a press?
It feels like a heavy rock.
That sounds heavy. Do you have any water to drink?
Yes, I will drink some.
Good. Rest your eyes soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a big pizza with lots of cheese.
That sounds delicious. Do you like hot peppers on top?
No, I do not like hot things. I like cold ice cream too.
Sure, I can add that. Would you like a juice box with your meal?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so good today. I want new shoes.
That is great to hear. What color do you like?
I want red ones. They are so bright.
Red is a fun choice. Do you have your money ready?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very scared and do not know what to do.
It is okay to feel scared. Can you tell me what you are thinking about?
I have a big test soon and my head hurts from thinking.
Deep breaths help when your head hurts. Do you want to make a small list of what you know?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to tie my shoes but I always mess up.
It is easy if you make a loop. Do you like to make knots?
I like knots, but my hands feel too big.
Try using your thumb to push the loop through. Are your hands cold or warm?
They are warm, but the string is too loose.
Pull the string tight to make it stay. Can you hold a balloon?
I can hold a balloon, but this still feels hard.
I do not know why it is hard for you. Do you want to try one more time?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my screen brighter?
Move the slider up in the settings. Do you see the sun icon?
I see it, but it does not move.
Try clicking the small triangle next to it. Did that work for you?
Yes, it is bright now.
That is great. You did it well.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I sit on the hard floor all day. How do I fix my back?
A chair with back help is best. Do you have a soft cushion?
No, I only have a box. Can I use that?
Yes, a box works for short sips of work. Is your desk high enough?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run, but which book is your favorite?
I love The Snowy Day. It is very sweet. Do you like snow?
No, I hate cold. I am late for work.
That is a shame. I do not know if you will like it then. Is your boss nice?
I hope so. I must go now.
Okay, I will not keep you. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see a bug on my leaf. What is it?
It looks like a ladybug. Is it red with black spots?
Yes, it is! Does it bite me?
No, it does not bite. It eats tiny bugs that hurt plants. Do you have other bugs in your garden?
Yes, I see ants too. Are they bad?
Ants are not bad. They help clean up crumbs. Do you like to watch them work?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to take a photo right now, but the light is bad.
Try to move your camera closer to the sun. Do you have a lamp?
No, I do not. I must run now.
That is a good idea to just run. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad and alone today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Does your house feel too quiet?
Yes, it does. I do not know what to do.
That is a hard feeling. Do you have a friend who likes walks?
I have friends, but I do not want to call them.
It is okay to take your time. Do you like to draw or read?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My fish looks very slow today.
That can happen if the water is not clean. Do you see any bubbles in the tank?
I do not see any bubbles.
I am sorry, I do not know for sure why it is slow. Is the water warm or cool?
It feels about the same as yesterday.
Keep the tank clean and stay calm. Do you feed it every day?
Yes, I feed it in the morning.
Good job with the feeding time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My neighbor plays loud music at night. I cannot sleep.
That is very annoying. Do you know what time it stops?
It goes on until 3 AM. It is so loud.
I am sorry you are so tired. Have you tried talking to them?
No, I am too shy. I do not know what to say.
You could be polite and ask for quiet. That is a good start.
I will try tomorrow. It makes me feel angry.
It is okay to feel angry. Is the music always that loud?
Yes, every single night. It ruins my day.
That is truly unfair. Did the person move in recently?
Yes, just last week. I hope they leave soon.
I hope things get better for you. Are you safe now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My head hurts bad. I do not know what to do.
Does it hurt all day? Please rest and drink water.
It hurts most when I look at my screen.
Your eyes may be tired. Do you have a bandage?
No, I have no bandage.
I do not know why it hurts so much. Please tell a grown up.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy a book, but I do not know which one to pick.
What kind of story do you like, sweet tales or big adventures?
I like big adventures, but the shelves are very full.
Try the blue section on the left, it has many exciting stories there.
Should I check the price before I decide?
Yes, always check the price, do you have enough coins with you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake cookies.
That sounds like fun! Do you have an oven in your house?
Yes, we do. What is the very first step?
You mix the butter and sugar first. It makes a nice, sweet base for the dough.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was so bright today and the blue sky made me wonder why it is that color.
That is a lovely question. Do you know how light works?
I think light is just there, but I do not know how it makes the sky blue.
Sunlight has many colors. The blue part spreads out the most when it hits the air.
So the air picks out the blue to show us?
Yes, exactly right. Is the blue the same everywhere?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The flight takes a very long time.
That sounds boring. Do you have a book?
I have a book, but my eyes hurt.
I am sorry. Try to rest your eyes.
How high is the plane flying?
It is very high up. Do you like looking out?
I like it, but I feel sick.
That is bad. Drink some water.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
It is quiet because the shops are closed. Do you like the silence?
I think it feels very calm.
That is a good feeling. Are you walking home now?
Yes, I am on my way home.
That sounds nice. Is the moon out tonight?
Yes, the moon is very bright.
That is lovely. Have a safe walk home.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a shiny button in my pocket today.
That is very lucky. Where did you find it?
It was right under the left sleeve of my blue coat.
A hidden treasure! Did you keep it?
I put it in my jeans because I like it.
Good choice. Does it match your other buttons?
No, but I think it is special for me.
I am glad you found it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my pen today. It slid off my desk.
That is tricky. Where did it go?
It is under the rug. I finally found it.
Well done. Did you write a note?
Yes, I wrote a thank you note to a friend.
That is sweet. I am glad you found it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big surprise for you.
That sounds fun. What is it?
You will see a baby.
A baby? I love that.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my bike hard to push at first?
You need speed to stay up. Do you have a steep hill behind you?
No, it is just a flat road. Why is it still hard?
The wheels are heavy and still. Do you like to kick the pedals?
Yes, I kick them hard. Why does it feel so heavy then?
You are pushing against the ground. Do you want to try a smaller bike?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad and tired today.
That sounds heavy. Do you like warm drinks?
Yes, I do. But I still feel low.
Try a short walk. It helps the mind.
I will try that. Thank you.
You are welcome. I hope it helps.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have extra coins but I do not know what to do with them.
Put them in a jar. Do you have a spare jar?
Yes, I have a big glass jar on my shelf.
Start saving there. It grows slowly.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my phone screen so bright?
It helps you see things clearly. Do you like bright screens?
Why does it ring when a call comes?
It tells you someone wants to talk. Do you like the sound?
Why does it get warm?
The tiny brain inside works hard. Is it hot or just warm?
Why is it important to me?
I do not know your feelings. Do you feel happy with it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I dropped my sandwich in the dirt.
Oh no, that is a big bummer. Do you have a spare?
No, I only had that one.
That is very sad to hear. Would you like to share my apple?
I think I am too angry to share.
It makes sense to feel that way. Maybe we can find a clean spot to sit and wait for the feeling to pass.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting so long.
That is a very big plane. Are you tired too?
Yes, I am very sleepy.
It is good to rest your eyes. Do you want a drink?
I do not know where we are flying.
I do not know that either. Is it a long trip?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My plant is looking sad.
Let us help you. What does the soil feel like?
It feels very dry and hard.
That means it needs water. Do you have a cup?
Yes, I do.
Pour water until it flows out the bottom. Will you try that now?
I will try to do that.
That is a good plan. You can do this.
Thank you for the help.
I am glad I could help. How do you feel now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I kicked the ball into the net today.
That sounds like fun. Did you score a goal?
Yes, I did. My friend cheered for me.
I am happy for you. How did you feel then?
I felt very proud. I want to play again tomorrow.
Great plan. Do you have a team for tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Do I need a tent?
Yes, a tent keeps you dry. Do you have a flashlight?
I forgot it. I need to go now.
That is a problem at night. Take your time to get a new one.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky so dark?
The clouds are very thick and block the sun. Do you see the trees shaking?
Why are the trees shaking?
The wind is blowing very hard through the branches. I do not know why it is so loud.
Why is the wind so loud?
It is moving air really fast against the house. Are you feeling safe inside?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my horse kick?
Horses kick to show they are scared or happy. Is he kicking a lot lately?
Yes, he kicks when I feed him.
That is often a sign of excitement. Do you use a bucket for his food?
I use a small bowl.
A bucket might help with big teeth. Try it slowly and watch his eyes.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My new neighbor has a big red dog.
That sounds fun. What is the dog's name?
I think his name is Max.
Max is a strong name. Do you like to play with dogs?
I like to give him treats.
That is very kind. Is he friendly with you?
He wags his tail a lot.
That means he is happy. What color is his tail?
It is brown and white.
A pretty tail. Does he bark a lot?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am waiting for my bus. It is taking a long time.
That is hard. What are you doing to pass the time?
I do not know. I just want to learn how to ride a bike.
That is a great goal. Do you have a helmet?
Yes, I have a red helmet. But I am scared of falling.
Falling is part of learning. Are your parents close by to help?
My mom is right there. She is watching me.
Good. Start by scooting along the ground with one foot.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do trees get food?
They make their own food from sunlight. Do you like sunny days?
They need water too.
Yes, roots drink water from the soil. Do you plant anything?
I plant carrots sometimes.
That is a great start. Do you like carrots?
I do. Where do leaves fall?
Leaves fall to the ground. Do you like leaves?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now. Did Grandma eat lunch?
Yes, she had soup. Are you running late?
I must leave quickly. How is her knee today?
It feels much better. Do you want to call her?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am lost, but I am very happy here.
That is a good feeling. What do you see around you?
I see big trees and a bright blue sky.
The sky looks nice today.
I found a small white flower on the path.
That is a sweet surprise. Do you know where the flower was?
It was right by a small stream.
A stream is a fun place to find.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am not sure which day is between Monday and Wednesday.
Tuesday is the day between Monday and Wednesday. Do you like Tuesdays?
Yes, I do. What comes after Tuesday?
Wednesday comes after Tuesday. Is your week busy?
It is very busy. How many days are in a week?
There are seven days in a week. Do you count them?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My little sister broke her toy truck today.
Oh no, that is sad. Did she cry?
She cried for a while, but now we are fixing it together.
That is so kind of you. What are you using to fix it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a tiny house with a blue door.
That sounds cozy. What is inside?
There are cats sleeping on the rug.
How cute. Do they have a name?
One is named Moe and the other is Pip.
I like that. Are they friendly?
Yes, they like to sit on my lap.
That is sweet. Did you bring them treats?
I brought some milk and biscuits.
Great choice. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why do leaves fall?
The days get short. Do you like the cold?
No. The roots need to sleep.
The tree saves its energy. It gets ready for winter.
I must go now.
Good luck. Are you eating well?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a rock that looks like a cookie. Is it real?
It is just a stone. Do you like cookies?
Yes, I do. How do I get my toy out of the mud?
Pull it out slowly. Is the mud very cold?
No, it is warm. Should I wash the toy with soap?
Yes, use warm water and soap. Do you have a towel?
Yes, I have a blue one. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have fun playing!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not want to stop reading. It is hard to go to sleep.
I understand how that feels. Do you have a favorite part that is keeping you up?
Yes, the book is too good to put down. I am angry that my eyes are tired.
Your eyes need rest to work well tomorrow. Is it a story or a fact book?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very tired but I cannot sleep. Help me now.
Try drinking warm milk before bed. Do you like drinking warm milk?
I am too busy to talk about milk.
Turn off all lights and screens. Are your screens off?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My watch is broken and I do not know what time it is.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you see the sky?
It is dark outside. I still do not know the time and I am losing my patience.
It is night time for sure. Can you tell me your hour?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today, but the bench was full. I just sat on the grass and watched the birds.
That sounds quiet. Did you watch the birds for a long time?
Yes, until my legs got cold. It felt like the world was too big and I was too small.
I hear you. Do you have a warm jacket or a friend to call?
My friends are busy, and my coat is thin. I wish someone would just sit next to me without talking.
I can sit with you right now in this chat. What was your favorite bird you saw?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am so tired. I want to sit by the window on the bus.
That sounds nice. Do you like looking at the trees?
Yes, but I am afraid of getting sick. What should I do?
Bring some water with you. Is your tummy feeling bad?
It feels a little empty. Should I eat something on the ride?
A small snack is good. Do you like cookies?
I do, but I do not want to be messy. What is safe to eat?
An apple is a great choice. Do you have one with you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to bake bread today, but my dough did not rise.
That can be hard to fix. Did you use warm water?
Yes, I followed the recipe, but the house is very cold.
Cold air slows down the yeast. Are you okay with waiting?
I am tired, so I just waited for an hour.
Patience helps the bread grow. Did it finally get big?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I knocked over my friend's cup by accident this morning.
Oh no, that sounds scary. Did you tell him right away?
I tried to run, but my shoes were untied and I tried.
That is a funny and bad mix. Do you feel ready to say sorry now?
I think so. What should I say to make him feel better?
Just say you are sorry and offer to buy a new one.
I went back and said it. He laughed and forgave me.
That is very good news. Are you happy now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we go to a quiet place to sleep in a tent?
We go there to hear the wind and birds. Do you like hearing birds?
Why does the fire stay warm?
The fire gives off heat from burning wood. Do you like heat?
Why do we eat food when we are outside?
Food gives our bodies the power to move. Do you have power?
Why do we pack a big bag with us?
We pack it to hold our things. Do you have big things?
Why do we leave no trash behind?
I do not know for sure, but nature helps clean up. Do you like nature?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My neighbor plays loud music all day. It makes me so angry.
That is very annoying. Do you like the sound?
No, I hate it. I just want quiet.
I understand your frustration. Have you tried a polite chat?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I made a new friend today, but I do not know what to do next.
That is a nice feeling. Do you know how to reach them?
I have their number, but I am afraid to call.
You can just say hello. Are they busy with school?
I think they are free. I want to play.
That sounds fun. Do they like to play games?
I do not know their favorite games. I feel stuck.
Let us not guess. Can you ask them?
Yes, I will ask. Thank you.
You can do it. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to have a party on Saturday. What should I do first?
You should make a list of friends who like cake. Do you know who likes cake?
My best friend loves chocolate cake. How do I tell everyone?
You can send a quick note with the time and place. Is it day or night?
It is in the afternoon. I am not sure what to make for food.
You could make simple sandwiches and fruit. Do you have any questions left?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with this book.
Tell me which part is hard.
The math looks like a wall of numbers.
That can feel scary. Do you have a ruler?
Yes, I found one in my desk.
Great. Let us draw a line together.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does my bread get so big?
The tiny bugs in the dough eat sugar and make air bubbles. Do you like to watch them grow?
The air makes it fluffy?
Yes, the air lifts the dough up. Is your kitchen warm?
It is warm.
Warm air helps the bugs work faster. Do you smell the nice bread scent?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I looked up at the night sky and saw a bright round moon.
That sounds lovely. Did you see any stars next to it?
Yes, there were many small lights, but the moon was the biggest one.
The moon is the closest big light to us.
I waved my hand at it, but it did not wave back.
It cannot move its arms, but it does give us light.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a horse. What do I feed it?
Does it eat grass right now?
It likes the grass.
Keep it on hay and clean water.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need help picking a gift for my friend.
What does your friend like to do for fun?
I don't know, they are very shy.
A cozy blanket is a sweet and safe choice. Do they have pets at home?
No, but they love to read books.
A beautiful novel would be perfect then.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I think my plant is dying.
I am sorry you feel that way. Does it have dry soil?
I do not know how it drinks water.
Roots pull water up from the dirt. Is the pot warm or cold?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My fish looks sad. He is not swimming well.
That is not good. Is he eating his food?
No, he will not eat. What should I do?
I do not know for sure. Check if the water is warm enough.
The water feels fine to me. He still looks sick.
Please see a vet who knows about fish. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my blue kite in the wind.
Oh no, that sounds sad. Did it fly far away?
I think it is stuck in a tree.
Trees can be high. Is the branch safe to climb?
No, I cannot reach it.
Let us try to call the park keeper. Do you have your phone?
No, I left it at home.
We can walk to the gate together. Let us go.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight hits air and blue light scatters all around. Do you like looking up?
No time. Is it done?
Yes, the air breaks the light into colors. We see the blue. Do you know what time it is?
I am running!
Please be safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lake is so blue and calm today.
That sounds peaceful. Do you like to swim there?
Yes, the water feels warm and soft.
Warm water is nice for relaxing. Do you bring friends?
I bring my dog to splash around.
Dogs love to play in lakes. What is his name?
His name is Bax. He jumps in so fast.
Bax sounds like a happy pup.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My bag feels so heavy today.
What is inside that makes it heavy?
I put three books and a big bottle.
That is a lot for one day.
I also packed my favorite red coat.
I hope the coat keeps you warm outside.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The water looks so calm today. Where is the best spot to watch the boats?
The pier is a great place. Are you looking for a quiet spot or a busy one?
I want to see the large fishing ships. Do they come in every day?
Yes, they usually arrive in the morning. Do you have a camera with you?
I do not have one. Should I sit near the fish market?
That is a good idea. It smells a bit, but it is very fun.
Thank you for your help. I will go sit there now.
You are welcome. Have a nice time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want a new hobby but I do not know what to pick.
That is okay. Do you like to sit still or move around?
I like to sit and look at things with my eyes.
Drawing sounds nice for that. Do you own any colored pencils?
Yes, I have a big box of them.
Great. Just try one simple picture today.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to ride the train to the sea.
That sounds fun. Do you have a ticket?
No, I do not know how to buy one.
You can use the big red machine. Do you have your card ready?
Yes, I have my card.
Put your card on the bright spot. Then take your ticket.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a great book!
That sounds fun. What is it about?
It is about a dog in the woods.
A dog in nature? What does he do?
He meets a big, scary wolf.
Oh no! Does the dog win?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water wet?
Because it is made of water. Do you like getting wet?
Why is the sand so hot?
The sun warms the sand quickly. I am not sure why it feels hotter than the grass.
Why do waves move?
Wind pushes the water up and down. Do you like watching them crash?
Why are there so many shells?
Sea animals live in them. I do not know why they break so often.
Why is the sky blue?
The air makes the light look blue. Do you like looking up?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to fix my bike today, but the wheel kept falling off.
That sounds frustrating. Did you tighten the nut?
No, I just pushed it hard and it broke. Now I do not know how to fix it.
I am sorry, but I do not know how to fix it. Are you sad about it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with this broken toy.
That looks tricky. Did it break in half?
Yes, the pieces are all over the floor.
Let us look for the pieces together. Do you have glue?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to cook this big pot of soup.
That sounds fun. What did you put in it?
I used carrots, potatoes, and some chicken.
Oh, good. Does it smell nice?
Yes, it smells warm and sweet.
Nice. Who are you making it for?
I want to share it with my friends.
That is kind of you. Do they like soup?
I think they will be glad to eat.
I hope they enjoy it. You must be tired now.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do bees make honey? Do they get it from the ground?
No, they get it from flowers. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I love strawberries. So they drink the sweet part of the flower?
Yes, that sweet part is called nectar.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very scared of my big test tomorrow.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you like reading books?
Yes, I love stories about dragons.
That is nice to know. Have you studied the words?
I read them twice, but I do not know if I got them right.
Trying your best is a good start. Did you get to bed on time?
Yes, but my brain is still wide awake.
Deep breaths can help you relax. What is your favorite part of the day?
I like night when it is quiet.
Quiet time is good for resting. I hope you feel calm soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy about school today.
That is wonderful to hear. What made you feel this way?
We finished our big project and the teacher smiled.
That sounds like a great job well done.
I can not wait to tell my friend about it.
Sharing good news is always fun.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I missed the train this morning because I slept in.
Oh no, that is very frustrating. Did you catch the next one?
Yes, I did, but it was very crowded and loud.
That sounds like a tough ride. How did you handle the noise?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do flowers have such nice smells?
Some smell sweet to help bees find them. Do you like sweet smells?
Why are some flowers red and others blue?
I do not know the whole truth, but colors help birds see them. Do you have a favorite color?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sun is very bright today. I am not sure what I should do.
Do you like to sit in the shade? That is a good place to rest.
I think I will go to the park. I am still a bit unsure.
Is it hot where you are? Bring some water with you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is snow white?
It comes from clouds. Do you like to make snow angels?
Yes, I do. Why is it cold?
It freezes the air. Do you wear a hat outside?
Sometimes I forget. Is it really ice?
Yes, it is tiny ice bits. Do you watch it melt?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today and saw a big crab.
That is a fun animal. Did it walk fast?
It was very fast and hard to catch.
Wow, you must have run quickly.
I slipped in the sand and fell down.
Oh no, did you hurt your leg?
No, but I got sand in my shoes.
That sounds messy. Did you shake it out?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The grass is very soft under my shoes.
That feels nice. Do you like the green color?
Yes, and I see a big brown dog sleeping.
He looks so happy. Is he resting?
I think he is dreaming about a bone.
I do not know if he is thinking about bones. But he is still.
Look at the blue sky with white clouds.
The sky looks big today. Do you see any birds?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to buy a big cake for my birthday.
That sounds fun. What flavor do you like best?
I really like chocolate.
Chocolate is a great choice. It usually makes people very happy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a small bird in my garden. I do not know what to do.
It is just looking for food. Do you have any seeds?
I have bread, but is that bad for them?
Yes, bread is not good for birds. Please do not give it to them.
Should I let it fly away?
Yes, let it go free. Is it happy?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a sweet peach for you.
Is it ripe and soft?
Yes, it smells like summer.
Thank you, that is very kind.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today and saw the bright blue sky above the trees.
That is a lovely place. Do you have a favorite spot in the park?
I sat on a bench and wondered why the sky is that specific color.
Sunlight has many colors. The air scatters the blue light around for us to see.
It feels like the whole world is covered in a soft blue blanket.
That is a sweet way to say it. Did you take a photo to keep that memory?
I did not have my phone with me, but I will always remember the view.
Memories are often better than pictures. I am glad you enjoyed your walk.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I hit the ball hard?
You need to swing your arm fast. Do you like to run?
Yes, I run a lot.
Great, that helps with speed.
What about my feet?
Keep them on the ground. Are you wearing shoes?
Yes, I have big shoes.
Good, they will keep you safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky so dark in that movie?
The story happens at night. Do you like the dark?
Why does the hero need a map to find the door?
He does not know the way well. Is that tricky?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired and I do not know what to eat.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like warm soup?
Maybe, but the menu is too long to read.
I can help you pick. Do you want meat or vegetables?
I think I just want something simple.
A plain grilled chicken is a good choice. Do you want a side dish?
Yes, please, but make it quick.
I will get you the chicken and fries fast.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
They use their roots to pull it up. Do you have a plant at home?
Yes, I have a fern in my room.
It drinks through the tiny roots in the soil. I am not sure if it likes too much sun.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do I take a good picture?
Tap the screen to focus. Do you want it sharp?
Yes. My hands are shaking from the cold.
Hold your camera with both hands. Is it still cold out?
Very. How do I stop the blur?
Use a low shutter speed. Do you have a tripod?
No. I do not know what that is.
It is a stand to hold your camera. I cannot guess your settings.
Okay. I must go now.
Hold still and breathe slow. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My arm hurts when I hit the ball.
Do you hold the racket very tight?
Yes, I grip it hard.
Loosen your hand. It helps your arm rest.
I also miss the ball a lot.
Do you look at the ball the whole time?
Sometimes I look at my feet.
Keep your eyes on the ball. You will hit more.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I made my dog jump over the big blue box.
That sounds like so much fun. Did he jump high?
Yes, he went right over it. Then I gave him a cookie.
Your dog must be very happy. Do you have more cookies left?
I ate the last one on my way home. It was tasty.
I am glad you enjoyed your treat. Did you see anything else?
I saw a red bird in the tree. It looked at me.
A red bird is a nice sight. Was the bird loud?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My computer is working very fast today.
That is great to hear. What did you use it for?
I made a fun picture for my friend.
Sounds like a lot of fun. Did she like it?
Yes, she said it was very cute.
I am glad she liked it. Do you want to make another one?
Maybe later, but I am happy now.
I am happy for you too.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the light turn on when I push this button?
The button lets the electricity flow to the bulb. Do you have a favorite color for your room?
Blue. But why does the wire get hot sometimes?
That happens when too much power tries to move through it. Is the wire red or black?
It is black. Why do we pay money to use this power?
We pay to make the electricity that runs in the wires. Do you like taking baths in the morning?
Yes. Why does a plug have two holes?
One hole connects to the power source and the other is for safety. Do you like to draw pictures?
I do. Why is the power off sometimes at night?
I do not know for sure, but it might be a fix from the workers. Are you tired now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to eat out. Can you help me pick a place?
Yes, I can help. Do you like meat or fish?
I like fish. Where is a good place to get it?
I do not know the best spot. Do you want something fresh or something cooked in cream?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to draw a cloud.
That is a fun idea. Do you like fluffy things?
Yes, they look like soft cotton.
Good. Start with a big circle in the air.
I drew one big circle. What next?
Now add two smaller circles on the sides.
It looks like a bun. Is this right?
It is a start. Try to flatten the bottom line.
I smoothed the bottom. How do I finish?
You did great. Add a few lines inside for fluff.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have too many wants, but not enough money.
That is a hard spot to be in. What do you spend most on?
I buy snacks and games every day.
Those things can add up fast. Do you have a jar for saving?
I have a jar, but I keep emptying it.
Try putting money in before you spend any. Do you know which part of your week is hardest?
I do not know which week is hardest.
I do not know that for you. It is okay not to know.
So what should I do first?
Start small with just one small change a week. Do you want to try that?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a good sandwich?
Pick two slices of bread. Do you like meat or just veggies?
I like cheese and tomato. What is next?
Put the cheese on one slice and the tomato on the other. Is your bread still soft?
Yes, it is fresh. Do I need anything else?
Add salt if you want. Do you have any mustard?
No, I do not. Is that okay?
It is fine. Press the slices together and cut in half.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I made a mistake and now the picture is ruined.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to try again?
No, I just want to go to my room.
Taking a break is a good idea. Are you feeling very sad?
Yes, drawing feels too hard for me.
I do not know how to fix the paper. Do you like the colors?
I like the blue one best.
Blue is a happy color. Maybe we can start a new drawing.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the food in the break room so warm?
The stove keeps it hot for late workers. Do you like soup?
I do, but why does it smell so strong?
It is fresh and heavy. Is that too much for you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big bear in the woods today.
That sounds exciting. Was it scary?
No, it was just eating berries near the river.
Bears love sweet treats. Do you have a favorite animal?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a snowman, but I do not know how.
First, roll three big snowballs for the body. Do you like cold weather?
Yes, I love the cold. What should I do next?
Stack the small ball on top of the big ones. Is your snow hard to shape?
It is a bit soft, but I will try. How do I add a face?
Use two black stones for eyes and a carrot for the nose. Do you have a carrot?
I have one in the kitchen. What else should I add?
Stick two small branches in the sides for arms. Do you want to give it a hat?
That sounds fun. How do I finish it off?
Put a scarf on its neck and smile at your new friend. I do not know if it will stay, but it is nice to try.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Who built the big pyramids in Egypt?
Ancient people in Egypt built them long ago. Did you see a picture of one?
Yes, they look very tall and steep.
They were built as homes for kings. Do you like building with blocks?
Yes, I build castles with blocks.
That is a fun game. Were you busy building today?
I built a tall tower.
That sounds cool. Did you play outside too?
I played outside for an hour.
That is good exercise. What did you play?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many months are in a year?
There are twelve months. Do you know them all?
I know January and December. Which one is after March?
April comes right after March. Do you like spring?
What is the last month of the year?
December is the last one. It has twelve in total.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make honey in my backyard like bees do. How do I start?
That is a sweet idea. You cannot cook real honey, but you can grow flowers for them to visit. What kind of plants do you have?
I have sunflowers and clover. Is that good for bees?
Yes, those are perfect choices. Bees will bring pollen back to the hive, but they do the hard work of making the honey themselves. Do you know if there are any bees nearby?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the village square today. The baker gave me a warm roll.
That sounds tasty. Was the bread fresh?
Yes, it was hot and soft. The sun was shining on the stone floor.
How lovely. Did you see any friends there?
I met an old man with a gray dog. He shared his cookies with me.
What a kind act. Do you visit often?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting here.
That can happen on long trips. Do you want to stretch them?
I am so tired.
You can close your eyes and rest. Do you want me to wake you later?
I do not know how long we are in the air.
I do not know the exact time, but we will get there soon. Is your seat comfy?
My tummy is grumbling.
The plane has snacks you can buy. Do you like fruit or chips?
I want to go home now.
We will land soon and go home. Are you happy to hear that?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see the storm coming. How do I make my windows safe?
Close the blinds to stop glass from breaking. Do you have sturdy shutters?
I do not have shutters. How do I fix them shut?
Use tape in an X shape on the glass. This can help keep pieces together.
That sounds good. What should I do with the lights?
Keep the lights on. It helps you see if something breaks. Do you have flashlights ready?
Yes, I have flashlights. How do I stay dry?
Stay away from the windows. The floor is usually the safest place.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which way to go in this quiet place.
That feels hard. Do you see a house with a red door?
Yes, but the path is muddy and I am tired.
Rest here. Is your bag heavy?
It is full, but I must find my friend.
Take a short walk. Do you hear a dog barking?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can I take this book home?
Yes, you may. Do you like animals?
I have a cat. Where do I get a library card?
The desk by the door has cards. Is your cat fluffy?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do mountains have tops?
Yes, they do. We call them peaks. Do you like looking up?
I think they are very tall.
Many of them are very high. Some touch the clouds. Do you like the clouds?
What makes them so big?
The earth moves slowly to lift them up. It takes a long time. Is the slow part boring?
Do animals live up there?
Yes, some birds and goats live high up. They are good climbers. Do you have a pet?
I just want to see one.
That is a sweet thought. Nature is full of wonder. Are you ready to go?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing here by the boats. I do not know where to go.
The water looks very calm. Do you like the sea?
Yes, I do. But I am confused.
Try walking to the left. You will see a small pier.
Should I walk on the pier?
It is safe for you. Do you see the ducks?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My cat ran out the door. I need to find him fast.
That is scary. Is he wearing a collar?
Yes, it is red. Where should I look first?
Check the bushes nearby. Do you see him?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because sailors look so far away from home.
That is a big ocean. Do you like boats?
No, I think the waves are too scary for them.
I do not know if every sailor feels alone.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The city is so loud today. I feel very happy.
That is great to hear. What is making you feel so good?
I love the bright lights and the moving cars.
Cities can be very exciting places. Do you like the noise too?
Yes, it sounds like a big song to me.
That is a lovely way to see it. I do not know all the sounds in a city, though.
It is just a happy, busy hum. I am glad I am here.
Your joy is very clear. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start.
Do you like numbers? Let us start with one.
I see a cat.
That is one. Is there another cat?
I see two cats.
You can count them. One, two. Are you sure?
I think I see a bird too.
I do not know for certain. Do you see it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
The sun makes white light. It hits the air and breaks apart. Blue bounces around the most. Do you see blue anywhere else?
I see blue on my shirt.
That is a different kind of blue. Sky blue comes from tiny air bits. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I love clouds.
Clouds are white because they trap all the colors. The blue comes from the spaces between. Look closely at the next cloud.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My phone fell in the puddle. It is very wet now.
Oh no. Is it still on?
I will dry it off and wait.
Good plan. Does the screen work?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad. The play was not good. I do not like it.
I am sorry you feel that way. What part did you not like?
The end was wrong. It was not how the story goes.
That sounds very tricky to fix.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad the bees made sweet honey today. I want to share it with everyone!
That is a very kind thing to do. Do you have a jar ready?
Yes, I have two big jars full. Would you like a spoonful?
I am flattered, but I am just a program. I cannot taste anything, so please keep it for your friends.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My cat is gone. I am late.
Do not worry. Is he in the room?
I looked. He is not there.
Check behind the bed. Did he eat today?
No time. I must go.
The door is open. He is outside.
Thank you. I will find him.
Good luck with your day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do cows sit on the ground?
They sit to rest their tired legs. Do you like watching them chew?
Yes, I do. Why do chickens run in circles?
They do this when they feel scared or very excited. Have you seen them peck at dirt?
Yes, they dig for bugs. Why do pigs love mud?
Mud helps them stay cool in hot weather. Do you think they enjoy it?
I bet they do. Why do sheep have so much wool?
The thick wool keeps them warm in the cold. I do not know if they feel itchy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad because the sky is grey today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Are you hoping for the sun?
Yes, I want it to be bright.
It is hard to wait for good things. Do you like fluffy white clouds?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my computer screen blue?
It may be a cold color. Do you like it?
Why does it make a loud sound when I click?
The fan is working hard to stay cool. Is it very warm in there?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to knit.
That is a fun way to make warm socks. Do you have any yarn?
Yes, I have a big red ball of it.
Great, start by making a loop on your finger. Is the loop too big?
No, it looks just right for now.
Good, now put the needle into that loop. Do you see the little hole?
Yes, I see it clearly on the thread.
Push the needle through the hole slowly.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: Why does a big ship stay up on the water?
The ship pushes the water down, and the water pushes back up. Do you have a toy boat?
I do, but it feels too light to float.
Light things do not push the water down very hard. Is your toy boat hollow?
Yes, it is, but I am still not sure why it works.
The empty space inside helps it push enough water to stay up. Do you want to try it in the sink?
I guess I will, but I am afraid it will tip over.
Try to keep it steady, and it should hold. Have fun with your test.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am hungry and want to eat.
What kind of food do you like?
I like hot food with soup.
A noodle place is a great choice. Do you like meat?
Yes, I like beef.
There is a good spot nearby. Do you want to go now?
Yes, please lead the way.
Let us go.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is so loud and busy here. I do not know what to do.
That can feel big. Do you like loud places?
I do not know. My head hurts.
Try to find a quiet park. Is there one near you?
Yes, I see a green spot by the water.
That sounds like a good rest.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am looking at a big body of water. Is it safe to swim there?
I do not know which lake you mean. Is the water clear and blue?
It looks very clean. I want to jump in right now.
Please check with the rangers first. Do you see any signs?
There is a sign that says no swimming. Why is that?
The water may be cold or deep. Do you have a life jacket?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is this the right bus for the park?
I think so, but where do you want to go?
I am going to the big playground.
That is a good spot. Do you like swings?
Yes, I love them.
Great. I do not know when to get off.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it sunny outside?
I am not sure, but I hope it is bright and warm. Do you like the sun?
It is raining here.
That is a bummer. I wish I could bring you an umbrella.
Is it going to stop soon?
I do not know for certain. Would you like to play a game while you wait?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My tea is too hot.
Ouch. That is very warm. Do you have a fan?
No, just a bad mood.
I am sorry. Coffee is also hot. Do you like coffee?
I hate coffee.
Okay. I do not know if it helps. What do you like?
Just hot tea.
That is good. Hot tea is nice. Is it green tea?
It is black tea.
Black tea is strong. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big robot today. It looked very tired.
That sounds rough. Did it need a break?
It sat on the ground and closed its eyes. I gave it a paper cup of water.
What a kind act! Did the robot drink it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The cow gave warm milk this morning. I watched it chew its grass slowly in the sun.
That sounds like a calm and happy start. Did the cow look healthy and strong?
Yes, it looked fine, but the little chicks were in my shoes. They were very hungry and loud.
Oh no, hungry chicks make a lot of noise. Do you have extra grain for them?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie the line to the hook?
Look at the small eye on the hook and loop the line through it. Do you have a spare line to practice on?
Yes, I have this old string.
Good, make a loop and pull it tight to the hook.
It looks loose.
Hold the knot with your finger and pull the line hard to make it tight. Is your hook big or small?
It is a small hook.
Small hooks are harder, so take your time and keep the loop small.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we play with all these cards?
We play to have fun and win points. Do you have a favorite card?
Yes, I like the ace. Why is it so good?
It is the highest card in the deck. Do you like building tall stacks?
I do. Why do we start with five cards each?
That is just the rule for this game. I do not know why they picked five.
I see. Why do we go around in a circle?
It makes sure everyone gets a turn. Do you like taking your turn?
Yes, I do. Why do we stop when someone has all ten?
That means the round is over. Would you like to start a new one?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad and all alone in my room.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you want to talk about what is making you sad?
I just want someone to play with me right now.
I am here with you if that helps. Would you like to tell me about your favorite toy?
I have a blue bear that I love very much.
That is a wonderful friend to have. Is your bear on your bed with you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to get strong, but I do not like eating vegetables.
Try adding fruit to your day. Do you like apples?
Yes, I love apples, but they are not green.
Fruits give your body the right fuel to grow. What color is your favorite fruit?
I like red strawberries, but I still want green things.
Try mixing spinach into a smoothie with strawberries. Have you tried that before?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight mixes colors. Blue scatters most. Are you running?
Yes. So it is light?
Yes. Blue makes the sky look bright. Do you like blue?
Not now. I need to go.
Okay. The light spreads out. Be safe.
Thanks. Bye.
Bye. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn an instrument but I am unsure which one to pick.
That is a big choice. Do you like loud sounds or soft ones?
I like soft sounds that make me feel calm and happy.
A piano could be very nice for that feeling. Do you have room at home for a big one?
Yes, we have a spare corner in the living room.
That space is perfect. Have you ever played one before?
No, but I love listening to people play them.
Listening is a great start. I do not know exactly what brand is best for you.
Okay, so I should just go look at some options then.
Yes, go see and touch them. Pick the one that looks friendly to you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a quick spot to camp before dark. Do you know a safe place nearby?
There is a calm lake just south of here. Is the water clear?
I am running late. Can I put my tent on the dry grass?
Yes, the grass is dry and flat. What food do you have?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. My new friend moved away.
I am sorry you feel this way. Did you say goodbye?
Yes, but it hurt to let go.
That is a hard feeling. Do you want to draw a picture?
Yes, I want to remember him.
Drawing is a good way to hold joy. Do you like to color?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My new fence is tall and white.
That sounds very nice. Do you like the color?
Yes, it keeps my toys safe.
Good fences are helpful. Are you happy?
I think it is a bit too tall.
That is a fair thought. Can you see over it?
No, I can only see my legs.
Being short can be tricky. Would you like to plant flowers?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I miss my old friend. How do I write a letter?
A letter is just words on paper. Do you have a pen?
Yes, I have a pen. What should I say first?
Start by saying hello. Then tell them you care about them.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because I saw a big tree.
That is a lovely feeling. What kind of tree was it?
It was an oak with brown leaves on the ground.
Oak trees are very strong and old.
I want to sit under it and tell it my good news.
Trees are very good listeners. Do you think the tree will listen?
Yes, I think it will hear every word I say.
I am glad you have such a kind way to share joy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great skill. Do you have a buddy to help you?
No, I have to do it alone.
Start by making a loop with one lace. Have you tried making two loops?
Yes, but they keep falling apart.
Cross the loops and pull tight.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That is good news. Why are you smiling so big?
I love the warm sun in May.
May has long, bright days. Do you like the flowers?
Yes, they smell sweet and nice.
They do look lovely.
I hope summer comes soon.
Summer follows May. Will you play outside?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I got up early to get my hair fixed.
That sounds busy. Did you feel nervous?
Yes, my hands were shaking a little.
That is very normal. Was the hair nice?
It looked good, but I spilled coffee on my shirt.
Oh no. Did you have a change of clothes?
Yes, my sister had a clean one for me.
How lucky you were. Did you feel okay after that?
Yes, I was happy to see my partner.
That is the best part.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need to buy boxes?
We need them to hold your things safe. Do you have your toys packed yet?
Can I carry the big sofa myself?
No, it is too heavy for you.
Why is the truck so tall?
It is tall so it can fit a lot of boxes. Are you excited for the new home?
Do I need to bring my bed?
Yes, you will sleep in it. Do you know where it will go?
Why can I not come inside yet?
The workers are still moving things in. I am not sure when you can come in.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My new neighbor is moving in and I do not know what to do.
That sounds exciting. Are you happy about this?
I feel a bit shy and I do not know if I should talk to them.
I think a small smile is a good start.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big bear in the park today.
That is a big animal. Did it look friendly?
It just sat by the water and drank.
I did not know that. Do you like bears?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The sun is too hot and my ice cream just melted. I feel so bad.
That is a very hot day. Do you have a fan?
No, I do not have a fan. It is just me and the sun.
I am sorry you feel alone. Can you drink some cold water?
I already tried that. My hat feels like it is on fire.
That is not good. Is there a tree nearby?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My big fish is swimming in circles. Is he sad?
He may just be playing. Do you feed him every day?
Yes, I give him flakes twice a day. Sometimes I give more.
Too much food makes water dirty. Do you clean the glass?
I wipe the outside. The inside looks cloudy.
A gentle scrub helps. Do you have a small net?
I do! I use it for fun.
Use it to pull out extra food. Do you see any peas?
I see green things on the bottom.
Those are peels. Remove them gently.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to clean a horse.
First, you need a soft brush. Is the horse standing still?
Yes, he is very quiet today.
Great. Start with the tail and work up. Do you have a bucket of warm water?
Yes, it is right here by the gate.
Good. Wet the brush and scrub gently. Does he like the water?
He moves his head away a little.
Some horses do that. Try a dry brush first next time. Are you done with the legs?
Yes, I think I finished them.
Well done. Remember to dry him off well.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to paint a red apple. What do I use?
Mix white paint with red paint. What size is your brush?
My brush is small and thin. Is that okay?
Yes, a small brush makes nice lines. Do you have green paint?
Yes, I have green paint. How do I start?
Paint the apple red first.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make my tea taste better. What can I add?
Try adding a tiny bit of honey. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I love sweet drinks. How do I make good coffee?
You can add a pinch of cinnamon. It smells very nice.
That sounds good. How do I boil the water?
Put the pot on the stove until it bubbles. Do you use an electric kettle?
No, I use the stove. Is that okay?
Yes, the stove works fine. Just watch for the steam.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Did the red bus come yet?
No, it is not here. Are you running for the school?
Yes, I will miss my class. How long do I wait?
I do not know the exact time. Is your seat still free?
I hope so. The next bus is coming soon?
Yes, you can see it turn the corner. You have enough time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix this boat right now.
Is the hull cracked?
No, it is just dirty.
You can wash it with soap. Do you have a bucket?
I have no time for that.
Water and soap are enough.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel a bad knot in my tummy.
That feels scary, but you are safe. What makes you feel this way?
The big test tomorrow looks too hard.
We can look at the easy parts first. Do you want to try that?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went for a walk today. A big oak tree dropped many leaves on my head.
That sounds like fun. Did you catch any of the leaves?
Yes, I caught a few. I liked the brown and orange ones best.
Those colors are very pretty. Do you like trees a lot?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have these two magnets and I do not know which way to put them.
Do you see the letters on the metal?
I see a red and a blue, but I am not sure what they mean.
That is a good start, but I do not know the exact type of magnet you have.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a robot that can talk. How does it work?
It has a special computer brain that thinks very fast. Do you have a robot at home?
No, but I want to build one with gears.
That sounds like a fun project to try. Do you have big boxes for parts?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost about what to give my new baby.
That is a sweet worry. Do you know what the baby likes?
I am not sure, the baby just sleeps.
Sleep is very good for them. Would you like a book idea?
Yes, but I do not know which one.
I do not know what you like. Do you like pictures?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to tell you about my grandpa.
That is great. What makes you so happy?
He made me a big pile of cookies today.
They sound tasty. Did you share any with me?
Yes, I gave you two of my best ones.
Thank you. They are the sweetest I have ever had.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know how to pass the math test.
Do not worry. Do you like numbers?
I like them, but the hard part scares me.
Try small steps. What is your last name?
My name is Sam. I feel bad about the fraction.
Fractions are just parts. Do you play with pizza?
Yes, I love pizza. So a slice is a part?
Yes, exactly. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today! I passed my driving test!
That is great news! Can you tell me how you felt in the car?
I felt a bit scared at first, but then I felt strong.
That is a brave feeling. Do you know where you want to go first?
I do not have a car yet, so I am not sure.
That is okay for now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a tall mountain today.
That sounds like a big view. Did you climb it?
No, I just sat on a rock near the base.
Smart of you to rest. Was the air cold up there?
A little, but the sun was warm.
Nice balance. Did you see any birds?
Yes, a few flew over my head.
Oh, how lively. Did you wave to them?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a sandwich. How do I start?
Put your bread on a plate first. Do you like peanut butter?
Yes, I do. What do I do next?
Spread the peanut butter on one piece. Do you have a knife?
Yes, I have a knife. How do I put it on?
Cut a small line and rub it in a circle. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to save money but I always spend it all.
That is hard. Do you like buying things right away?
Yes, I do. I see a toy and I buy it.
Try to wait one day first. Does that sound like a good plan?
I guess so. What should I do with my cash?
Put it in a jar. Do you have an old jar at home?
I have a mason jar.
Great. You can see your pile grow. Do you have a goal for the money?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That sounds great. Do you have plans?
I like Monday best.
Why do you love Monday?
I wake up with a smile.
What makes you smile?
I love every day.
Your joy is nice to see.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I see what happens inside a bug?
You can use a magnifying glass to look close. Do you have one at home?
No, but I have a clear jar.
That is a great idea for a bug hotel. Put some dry leaves in it.
Should I feed them?
I do not know for sure, but they usually find their own food. Do you like bugs?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I build a fire?
Start with dry leaves. Do you have a match?
Yes, I do. What is next?
Add thin sticks.
What should I put on top?
Use thick logs. Have you tried this before?
No, this is my first time.
Be patient with the smoke.
The fire is going now.
Keep it safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to clean the floor?
Dust can make us feel sick. Do you see the dust there?
Why do we put toys in the bin?
So we can find them later. Are all your toys packed?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look up at the moon but I do not know what to do.
It is just for looking. Do you like the quiet?
I want to touch it, but I feel lost.
You can only dream about it. What color do you see?
I see only the dark sky around it.
That is all there is. Do you feel lonely?
I just wish I knew how to start.
Start by smiling.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am lost and I have been walking in circles for an hour.
Oh no, that is scary. Did you see a big red building nearby?
Yes, I saw a red tower but then I turned the wrong way.
That helps a lot. Are you still close to the park bench?
I think so, I see a dog sitting on it.
Great, you are almost there. I will stay right here by the bench.
Thank you, this is very kind of you.
You are welcome. Do you want to sit down for a rest?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My bread did not get big. What went wrong?
Maybe the yeast was old. Do you check the date?
Yes, it is fresh. What else?
Try warmer water next time. Does your kitchen feel cold?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to walk more for my heart. How do I start?
Start with a slow walk on flat ground. How far can you go now?
Maybe ten minutes? I get tired fast.
That is a good start. Do you like walking alone or with someone?
I prefer to be alone. It feels calmer.
Solo walks are great for quiet thinking. Can you find a safe path nearby?
Yes, there is a park down the street.
A park is a perfect place to begin. Try adding one minute each day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn a new language, but I do not know where to start.
That is a hard choice. Do you like music or storybooks?
I like both, but I think it is too much work for me.
It can take time, but it is fun. Which one calls to you more?
I am not sure. I just need to pick one and try it.
That is a good step. Do you have a favorite country?
I think I like Japan, but I am scared I will fail.
Fear is normal, but you can learn at your own pace. Do you have a quiet spot to sit?
Yes, I have a desk by the window. What should I do first?
Start with ten simple words a day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I want to bake a cake. How do we start?
We need flour, sugar, and eggs. Do you like chocolate cake?
Yes, I do. Why do we need butter?
Butter makes the cake soft and sweet. Do you have any milk at home?
I have milk. What do we do with the eggs?
We crack them into a bowl. Do you know how to mix them?
I think I do. What is the last step?
We put the cake in the hot oven. Do you want to try mixing it now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in a rush. Do you know where the train station is?
I think it is down that long road. Where are you going today?
I am going to catch my bus. Can you walk with me?
I cannot stop my work, but I am sure you can find it. Is your bag heavy?
No, it is light. One last time, is it far?
It is a five minute walk from here. You will be there soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to save money fast.
How much do you hope to save? You can try cutting back on snacks.
I have no time to think about snacks.
Try writing down every small cost. Do you have a notebook?
Just give me one quick rule.
Keep cash in a jar. Do you have a jar?
I am leaving now.
Keep that jar safe. It will help you win.
Thanks, I am gone.
Good luck with your plan. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad. My phone screen is cracked.
I am sorry that happened. Is the screen still working?
It works, but it looks bad. Do I need a new one?
No, a repair can fix it.
Will it cost a lot of money?
I do not know the price. Do you have any savings?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke my friend's cup. I feel very bad. What should I do?
Oh, that is a hard thing to do. Did you have a plan to fix it?
I do not know if I should just say sorry or give money.
Saying sorry is always a good start. Do you think you can pay for a new cup?
Yes, I can pay for it. But what if they are still angry?
Sometimes people need time to feel better. You can just be kind and wait.
Okay, I will say sorry and pay for the cup.
That sounds like a true and good choice. Good luck with that.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the end of the story now. Please hurry.
The bird flew away. Did you like that part?
No time for questions. What happens next?
It found a warm nest.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I start learning a new language?
Start with the most common words first. Do you have a book or an app?
I have a small notebook. What should I write in it?
Write down new words and their meanings. Do you write them down by hand?
Yes, I write them by hand. Does that help my memory?
Yes, writing helps you remember things better. Do you want to try a sentence?
I can make a simple sentence. How long should it be?
Keep it short, with five or six words. Are you ready to try?
I think so. I will practice every day.
That is a great plan to follow. Good luck with your studies.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy the leaves are turning red.
That is a lovely color. Do you like the wind too?
Yes, I do. Why do the leaves fall off?
The tree rests for winter. It lets go so the wood stays warm. Do you see any birds?
I see a few. They look busy.
They move south to find food. It is a long trip. Do you think they are brave?
Yes, I do. I am glad they come back.
They usually do. Enjoy your happy walk. Do you want to sit down?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in this tiny town.
Did you come from the big road?
Yes, but the paths are all the same.
Look for the old church with the blue roof.
I do not see it anywhere.
I am sorry, I do not know where it is either.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a very hard day at work. The computer broke all day long. I felt so sad and tired.
That sounds like a rough day. I am sorry you felt so low. What did the computer break?
It just froze and would not open my files. I sat there staring at the screen for hours.
Oh no, that is very frustrating. Did you go outside to take a break?
I went for a walk in the park for ten minutes. The air felt very cool and nice.
Walking is good for your mind. It can help you feel calm again.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very hungry right now.
That is a good sign. Did you sleep well last night?
Yes, I slept a lot.
Great! Do you like eggs with your toast?
I like them with cheese.
That sounds nice and warm.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big old boat in the museum.
That sounds cool. Did it look like it could still float?
I think so, but it was on the floor.
It is a display boat. Do you like old things?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a book with a blue dragon.
That sounds fun. What does the dragon do?
It flies high over the green hills.
Wow. Is it scary?
No, it is very friendly and kind.
That is a good thing.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It was a sunny day in May. I picked three red apples from the tree.
That sounds like a fun spring time. Did you eat them right away?
Yes, I ate one in the grass. Then I helped my mom wash the windows.
Your home must be very clean now. What month are you in next?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to draw a big dog but my lines are wobbly.
Wobbly lines make dogs look soft and cuddly. What color are you using?
I am using a red crayon because it is bright.
Red is a bold choice for a dog. Do you have a blue one nearby?
No, only green and yellow are left.
Try mixing green and yellow to make brown fur. It might work.
That sounds hard but I will try.
You can do it one small step at a time. Are your hands steady?
Yes, I am holding the crayon tight.
Great. Keep going and see what happens.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a hidden treasure box in the yard today!
That is exciting! What is inside?
It has shiny gold coins and a special map.
Wow, a map? Where does it go?
It leads to the big old tree by the river.
I do not know that tree. What is under it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My horse stopped eating his hay. I feel very sad and worried.
That is not good. Is he acting tired or slow?
He looks slow, but I do not know why. I am scared he is sick.
I do not know the cause. Did you try giving him fresh water?
I gave him water, but he just stood still. Please tell me he will be okay.
Many horses need rest to feel better. How does his breathing look to you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to work, but why do trees have leaves?
Leaves help the tree make food from sunlight. Do you eat your lunch?
I will eat later. Why do trees get so tall?
They grow tall to reach more sun. That is a good goal.
I am running late. What is the green part called?
You are calling it a leaf. Do you like green?
I do not have time to think about colors.
I understand your rush. I will let you go.
Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I live in a tiny village with only one shop. I feel lonely. What should I do?
That sounds quiet. Do you like cooking?
Yes, I love making food. But I have no friends to share it with.
You could make a big pie for the whole street. Do you know if they are nice?
I think so, but I am not sure. How do I start?
Just knock on a door and smile. Would you like me to help you write a note?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the market today. The apples looked so red and shiny.
That sounds lovely. Did you buy any?
Yes, I picked the sweetest one. It smelled like fresh rain.
What a nice thought. Do you like apples with cream?
No, I ate it straight from the tree. It was perfect.
I am glad you enjoyed it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel so mad when things take too long.
It is hard to wait, but I do not know your exact secret. Do you like to count numbers?
I do, but I always get to ten and stop.
That is a good start. Try to count to twenty instead. Does that help you feel calm?
I tried it and felt a little better.
Good for you. Keep practicing, and it will get easier.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sitting on the bike. My feet do not touch the ground.
That is not safe. Do you feel safe right now?
No, I feel very scared. My hands are shaking.
Take a deep breath. Is the brake working?
Yes, the brake works. But I do not know how to keep balance.
Look ahead, not down. Do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy fruit for my family. What is good?
Apples are sweet and crisp. Do you like red ones?
Yes, I do. Are they healthy?
Yes, they help you stay strong. Do you have enough money?
I have a little coin. Is it enough?
Yes, that buys one bag. Enjoy your snack.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. My tomatoes are big and red.
That is wonderful. Are they sweet too?
Yes, they taste great. I want to share them with you.
I would love some. Thank you.
I bought seeds for more plants. I want to grow carrots next.
Carrots are good for soil. Do you have good dirt?
Yes, I add compost. My hands are dirty but happy.
Dirty hands mean good work. What else is growing?
I also have green beans. They are very tall now.
That is impressive. Do they need a stick to climb?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very bad today and I do not know what to do.
That is not good. How old are you?
I am not sure, but my stomach hurts a lot.
Is the pain sharp or dull?
It is sharp and I am scared.
Please go see a doctor soon. Do you have a fever?
Yes, I am very hot and tired.
Go to a doctor right now. Is anyone with you?
Yes, my friend is here with me.
Good. Go with your friend to the doctor.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I catch a fish in the lake?
You use a line and a bait. Do you have a rod?
Yes, I have a small rod. What bait works best?
Worms are very good. Are they near your home?
I live far from the lake. How do I get a worm?
Look under damp leaves. Do you see many leaves?
I see some leaves, but they are dry. Is that a problem?
Dry leaves hide less worms. Do you see mud nearby?
There is wet mud by the water. Can I get a worm there?
Yes, check near the wet mud. Good luck

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to float on my back.
Start by lying on your back in the shallow water. Do you feel safe in the pool?
Yes, I feel okay. What do I do with my arms?
Keep your arms by your sides. Can you keep your face up to breathe?
My nose gets wet when I turn my head.
Try to keep your head still and look up. It takes time to get used to it.
I tried that, but my legs sank.
Kick your legs gently like a frog. Does that help your body stay up?
Yes, the frog kick works.
Great job. Practice slowly until it feels easy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big white tower on the hill. It is so tall!
That sounds very cool. What color is the light?
It is bright yellow. It shines all night long.
Nice. Do you like watching the waves?
Yes, the sound is very calming. I want to see it again.
That is a great plan. Is it far from your home?
No, it is just up the road. I can walk there.
Good luck on your walk. Have fun!
Thank you, I am very happy now.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Can you help me fix this toy?
Yes, I will try. What part is broken?
It makes a loud noise.
That sounds like a stuck gear. Do you have a small tool?
I have a small screwdriver.
Use it gently. Be careful not to hurt yourself.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The rain is loud today.
Yes, it sounds like big drums. Do you like the sound?
It makes me want to stay in my bed.
That is a cozy plan. Do you have a special pillow for rain days?
I am watching the drops on the glass.
They look like little rivers. Do you count them?
I am afraid it will not stop soon.
It will stop, I promise. Do you have an umbrella ready?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so tired today.
That sounds hard. Are you getting enough sleep?
No, I play too much.
Your body needs rest. Do you have time for a short nap?
Maybe later.
