I do not know your day. Try to drink some water.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I love this book, but I feel lost.
That is okay. Do you want to skip the hard parts?
I do not want to skip. I want to understand.
Try reading it aloud. Does that help your brain?
It helps a little. My mind still feels foggy.
Take a break. Walk outside for a few minutes.
I will try that. It feels like a good plan.
I hope it works. Have fun with the story.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the sun go away?
It is night now. Do you like the dark?
Yes, I like stars. Why are they bright?
Stars are hot balls of gas.
Wow. Does the moon talk?
No, it is silent. Do you dream of flying?
Sometimes. Why do we dream?
I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors. The air scatters the blue light everywhere. Do you see the blue up there?
Yes, I see it. How can I see other colors in the light?
Look through a glass prism if you have one. It splits the white light into a rainbow. Do you have a prism?
I do not have one. Is there another way?
You can wait for a sunset to see reds and oranges. It is a beautiful view.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to grow tomatoes, but I do not know where to start.
Start with a big pot and good soil. Do you have a sunny spot in your house?
I have a window, but it faces north.
North light is too weak for strong plants. Do you have a balcony that gets sun?
Yes, my balcony gets sun in the morning.
That is a perfect place for your first plant.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a knot to put the line on the hook?
That is called a clinch knot. Do you have a picture to look at?
I can see a picture on the box.
Tie a small loop around the hook. Do you see how the line goes under?
Yes, I am making the loop now.
Wrap the end around the thick part five times. Does it feel tight when you pull?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the lighthouse number, fast.
Is it on the north coast?
Yes, it is right there.
It is number four.
Great, I am going now.
Be safe on the rocks.
I will be quick.
Do you have a flashlight?
Yes, I have my bag.
Good luck with the trip.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do bees make honey?
They suck sweet water from flowers. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, but I must run. What is the next step?
They mix it with their own spit. Can you share?
No time. They heat it, right?
Yes, the sun dries the water out. Are you enjoying the sun?
I am going. Is it just sugar?
Yes, it is mostly sugar. Bye.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked past a bakery today.
That sounds nice. What did you see?
The smell was very sweet.
That is lovely to imagine. Did you buy anything?
I bought a small round bread.
I love fresh bread. How was the taste?
It was warm and soft.
I am glad it was good.
I ate it all on the bench.
That sounds like a happy day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now. What month is this?
It is March. Are you okay?
Yes, I am rushing. How many months are in a year?
There are twelve. Do you like winter?
No, I hate the cold. What comes after March?
April comes next. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the water fast. Do you know where it is?
Yes, look down the path. Are you going to swim?
No, just to see the waves. Is the sand soft there?
It is very soft and warm. Do you like warm sand?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dog is shaking a lot. I am scared.
That is very worrying. Is he eating his food?
No, he is not eating. I do not know what to do.
Please call a vet right now. I do not know the cause, but they can help.
I am going to call them. Thank you.
You are doing the right thing. I hope he feels better soon.
Okay. I feel better now.
Good. Tell him I said hi.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My cat is very quiet and sleeps all day. Is this okay?
Yes, cats love to sleep a lot. Does he eat his food well?
Yes, he eats fine, but he does not play with toys.
Try a feather toy to make him move. Is he happy when you talk to him?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: It feels so hot today.
Yes, the sun is very strong. Do you like the heat?
No, it is too warm for me.
That is not good. Where are you right now?
I am sitting in my house.
Your house is a good place to rest. Do you have a fan?
I have a fan, but it is not enough.
You should drink cool water. Do you have any ice?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very alone and I do not know what to do.
That sounds heavy. Have you talked to anyone yet?
No, I am afraid they will not want to listen.
You might be surprised. Do you have a friend nearby?
I have no one close. What should I do now?
I do not know your whole story. Try opening a door.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The lights are out. I need to leave in five minutes.
That is bad. Do you have a phone with a light?
No, it is dead. I have no candles either.
I am sorry. I do not know why the power is off.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to make this clock tick.
Is the battery inside still new?
I think so, but it makes no sound.
Try turning the little dial on the back slowly.
It started to move when I did that.
That is great, are you happy with the sound?
Yes, it works well now, thank you.
You can check the time on the face.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I mix the dough for a soft bread?
You should add water slowly to the dry flour. Do you have a whisk ready?
Yes, but the dough feels too sticky.
That means it needs more flour. Add a little at a time until it pulls away from the bowl.
What if I add too much flour by mistake?
That is a hard question, and I do not have a perfect answer for you. I think it will be a bit dry.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. I do not know what to do.
That sounds like a bad hurt. Did you hit your head?
Yes, I bumped my head on the table.
Ouch. Please tell a grown up right away.
Okay, I will go tell Mom now.
That is a good plan. Does the hurt feel sharp or dull?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I had a scary dream where I was falling.
That feels very bad. Did you fall all the way to the ground?
Yes, but I did not hurt me.
I am glad you are safe. Do you like sleeping with the light on?
I am still a little sad.
You are okay now. Try to think of happy things.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I hit the ball, but it went into the net.
That happens a lot. Do you try to hit it harder next time?
I tried, but then it flew over the wall.
You just need to aim lower. Would you like to practice again?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here at the lake but I do not know what to do with my rod.
Do you have a worm in your hand?
Yes I do but the fish will not come near.
Try to move your line very slow. Is the water calm?
It is still but I am getting tired of waiting.
Patience is a hard thing to learn. Do you like the view?
Yes it is nice but I just want to catch something.
I do not know if a fish is there. Did you put bait on the hook?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I broke my favorite cup.
I am sorry to hear that. Does it look very broken?
Yes. It is in many small pieces.
You can try to glue it back together. Would you like some help?
No, I think it is too old to fix.
That is true. Old things can be hard to fix.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have many things and I do not know what to do with them.
That feels heavy. Do you like them?
Some yes, but I have no room for them.
You can share the ones you do not use.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The food was bad.
That is not fun. What did you eat?
A cold soup. It tasted like water.
Yuck. Do you want to go back?
No. I do not want that.
Okay. Let us find a new place. Do you like pizza?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to make a plan, but I do not know what to do.
That is okay. Do you like playing outside?
Maybe. I just feel stuck.
Let us take a walk. What is your favorite game?
I like building things.
Great. Let us build a fort today.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: What should we do first?
Let us pick a big goal. What do you want to reach?
Why is a big goal good?
It gives us a clear path. Do you have a favorite place to start?
Yes, I want to build a birdhouse. Why do we need a list?
A list stops us from forgetting steps. What tools do you have?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the test hard?
It is hard because it has new words. Do you like reading?
I do not know why.
It tests what you learned in class. Is that a lot?
Why so many questions?
Many questions help the teacher see your work. Can you read fast?
Why do we need marks?
Marks show how well you did. Do you want a high score?
I will try my best.
That is a good plan. I will help you study.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see smoke coming from the house.
Please go inside and wait for a grown-up. Do you have your phone?
No, I do not have a phone with me.
That is okay. Just stay safe by the window. Is the door open?
Yes, the door is still open.
Good. Keep the door closed if it gets hot.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hit my thumb with a hammer and it hurts so bad.
Ouch, that is a pain. Do you have an ice pack?
I forgot all my tools in the garage.
That is a common mistake. Did you check the porch?
No, and now the shed is falling apart.
I am sorry to hear that. Is the roof still up?
It is leaning and I do not know how to fix it.
I do not know the best way to fix it. Are you calling a friend for help?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so angry. The bus was late again.
That feels very bad. Do you know why it was late?
No, but I am late for work now.
I am sorry to hear that. Are you okay?
I am tired and my feet hurt.
I am sorry your feet hurt. Would a break help?
I just need to get home.
I hope you get there soon. Can I do anything else for you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to pack my tent right now.
A big tent takes time. What size is yours?
Just show me the quick way.
Push the poles through the loops. Do you have a hammer?
No, I only have a stick.
Do not force it. Check the manual.
I forgot my manual at home.
I am sorry I cannot help more. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The fence is broken and I do not know what to do.
Do you have any wood to fix it? It is always good to check for tools first.
I have some nails, but I am not sure if the wood is strong enough.
You can ask a neighbor to help you lift the panel. Do you live near other friendly people?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a job today! I am so happy.
That is great news. What kind of work will you do?
I will wash cars at a shop. I love seeing them shine.
That sounds like fun. Do you know when you start?
I start next week on Monday. I feel a bit nervous.
It is normal to feel nervous. You will do fine.
Thank you. I feel ready now.
I am glad you feel ready. Good luck with your new job.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the wind so loud today?
The air is moving fast. Do you like strong winds?
I don't really. Why does it feel cold?
It carries chill from far away. Is your house warm inside?
Yes, it is. Can the wind hurt plants?
Yes, strong wind can break stems. Do you have a garden?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big, fluffy cloud that looked like a sheep today.
That sounds fun. Did it move across the sky?
Yes, it moved very slowly and then started to rain.
Rain is wet. Did you have an umbrella?
I did not, so my shoes got a little damp.
Oof. But now your shoes can dry in the sun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is this big blue part water?
Yes, it is water. Do you see the green lines?
What are those green lines?
They are roads. Why do you want to know?
I want to go to the park.
The park is right here. Is it near your house?
Yes, it is very close.
That is great. You are very smart.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very scared inside.
I hear you. What is the scary thing?
The dark is too big.
That is a true feeling. Do you like lights on?
Yes, I do.
Good. The dark is just sleep time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to run faster. Do you know a good way?
Yes, try short sprints for ten seconds. Do you like to play tag?
Yes, I love running in the park. How many times should I sprint?
Start with four sprints and rest in between. Do you have warm shoes?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My bread looks flat and sad. What do I do?
Did you wait long enough? Yeast needs time to grow.
I put in warm water and sugar. Is that all?
Yes, that feeds the tiny yeast. Do you feel any bubbles?
I do not see bubbles. Is it broken?
No, it is just sleeping. Maybe the water was too cold.
What if it still does not rise?
I do not know for sure. Try moving it to a cozy spot.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my bread get so big and fluffy?
Tiny bugs eat the sugar and make gas. This gas makes the dough puff up. Do you like watching it grow?
The tiny bugs make the gas?
Yes, those bugs are called yeast. They turn food into bubbles. Do you see the little holes inside?
So the bread is full of air?
Exactly, it is full of tiny air pockets. That makes it soft and light. Do you want to bake some?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big house for my toy dog. What should I use?
You could use cardboard boxes. Do you have any boxes to use?
Yes, I have two big ones from the grocery store.
That sounds like a great start. Let's cut out a door and a window.
I will do that now. Thank you for helping me.
I am happy to help. Have fun with your new project.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to save money, but it is hard.
Start small. Do you like making lists?
Yes, I like writing things down.
Track every penny you spend. Is that too hard for you?
It seems hard, but I will try.
Good. Do you have a clear goal?
I want to buy a bike.
Put your spare change in a jar. Does that help you?
I think so. Thank you.
You can do it. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My chair leg is loose. I do not know what to do.
That can be fixed. Is the leg just wiggly, or does it fall off?
It wiggles a lot. I am scared it will break.
Do not worry. Let us check the screws first.
I found a screw. It looks loose.
Good catch. Do you have a small tool to tighten it?
Yes, I have a small tool. Should I turn it tight?
Yes, turn it tight. Then tell me if the leg is still wiggly.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do cows have horns?
Some cows do, but many are cut. Do you like looking at cows?
Yes, they are big. Do they eat grass?
Yes, they love eating grass. Do you know any farm sounds?
I know the chicken goes cluck. Do all chickens sound like that?
Most do, yes. It is a funny sound. Have you seen a duck?
Yes, ducks go quack. Do they swim?
Yes, they swim very well. Do you like water?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am lost. I am very late.
Please stay calm. Do you see a big red sign?
Yes, I see a red sign.
Great. Is it tall or small?
It is very tall.
You are close. Go left to the park.
I do not know which way is left.
The sun is in the sky. Look for the trees.
I see trees. Thank you.
I am glad to help. Do you see your car?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My throat feels tight today because I want to learn to sing high notes.
That is a hard goal. Do you drink warm water?
Yes, I drank tea, but my voice still sounds small and weak.
Breathing from the belly helps power. Try humming a low hum first.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do sailors find their way on the big sea?
They use the stars and tools to find the right path. Do you like looking up at the night sky?
Yes, I do. What do they use to keep their boats moving?
The wind pushes the sails, or the engine runs underneath. Do you know how a sail works?
I am not sure. Can you tell me?
The shape of the sail catches the wind to push the boat. Do you have a favorite kind of boat?
I like small row boats. Do sailors get lonely out there?
Sometimes they do, but they work together as a team. I do not know if all of them feel that way.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The lights keep going out and I am very mad.
I am sorry to hear that. Are you safe?
Yes, but the plug is not working right.
That sounds tricky. Have you checked the switch?
I did check it and it feels warm.
Please unplug it now. Is it hot to the touch?
It is too hot to touch. What do I do?
Call an electrician right away. You did the right thing.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I seem to be lost. Why do I get lost?
You look at the path too fast. Are you using a map?
No, I am not. Why can my memory forget the way?
Your brain gets busy with new things. Do you know where you started?
I think so, but not for sure. Why does the world look so much the same?
Many places share the same colors. Would you like to walk back to the start?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I do not know how to change the baby's diaper.
Lay the baby down and open the new pad. How many diapers did you use today?
I used two, but the baby is wet again.
Wipe the skin clean and put the fresh pad under them.
Do I need to put cream on the skin?
Yes, use a small bit to stop red skin. Does the baby look happy?
The baby is smiling.
You did a good job, but I do not know if the cream is safe for your baby.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My horse is sad today.
I am sorry to hear that. How is he feeling right now?
He is lying down in the mud.
That sounds lonely. Did he lose a friend?
I am angry at the farmer.
You are angry because the farmer is mean?
Yes, he took his best friend away.
I understand your anger. That is a hard loss.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to buy a boat. What size is best?
That depends on where you plan to sail. Do you like calm lakes or the big sea?
I mostly want to go on a small lake near home.
A small rowboat might be perfect then. How many friends will come with you?
Just me and my dog.
Then a small one fits you well. Do you know how to row?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I miss my old friend. Where is he now?
I do not know. Did you write to him?
I did not write. I was too busy.
That is okay. Can he write to you?
No, he cannot find me. He lost my letter.
I am sorry. Do you want to call him?
Yes, but I forgot his number.
Try to think. Was it a long number?
It was a short number. I think I lost it.
Let us search together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to buy new shoes, but I do not know where to start.
First, try on a few pairs to see what fits. Do you like bright colors or dark ones?
I like dark colors. How do I pick the right size?
Go to the store and put them on your feet. Do you want shoes for walking or for sports?
I want them for walking. What else should I check?
Check if your toes have room to wiggle. Can you walk in them for a minute?
That sounds hard. How long should I walk?
Just a few steps is enough to test the fit. Do you have a budget in mind?
I have some money. How do I pay for them?
You can use a card or cash at the counter. Do you have a shopping card ready?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a deer in the park today.
That is a lovely surprise. Did it look friendly?
It just stood still and watched me.
Deer are often shy. Was it near a tree?
Yes, it was hiding by the bushes.
It was keeping warm, I bet. Do you like watching animals?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did all my homework today.
That is great. What was your favorite part?
I learned how bees make honey.
That sounds very sweet. Do you like eating honey?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel so hot and achy?
Your body is fighting the bad germs. Are you drinking enough water?
Why does my nose run so much?
Mucus traps the germs so they leave your body. Does it hurt to breathe?
Why do I keep sneezing?
Sneezing pushes the germs out fast. Do you have a tissue handy?
Why do I taste nothing?
When you are sick, your smell sense gets blocked. Do you still have a little taste?
Why does this last so long?
I do not know exactly how long it will take. Rest is the best cure.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How many months do we have?
There are twelve months in a year. Are you going to work?
Yes. Is May before June?
Yes, May comes before June. Is the sun out?
I think so. Which month is first?
January is the first month. Do you like cold days?
No, I do not. Which month is last?
December is the last month. Do you have snow?
No, I do not. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do sailors use ropes?
Ropes help them pull the sails to move the boat. Do you like to tie knots?
Why do boats have big masts?
Tall masts hold high sails to catch more wind. Is the wind strong where you live?
Why do sailors wear yellow jackets?
Bright colors help others see them on the dark water. Have you ever seen a lighthouse?
Why do they carry maps?
Maps show them where to go and where to stop. I do not know if they still use paper maps.
Why do sailors look at the stars?
Stars help them find their way when the sun goes down. Do you see stars at night?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just saw the best movie ever.
That sounds amazing. What is it about?
It has a talking dog who loves pizza.
I did not know that. Does the dog cook?
Yes, he makes the best slices.
That is very tasty. Did you laugh a lot?
I laughed until my belly hurt.
Good for you. Was it scary at all?
No, it was just fun and warm.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike, but I am afraid of falling.
That is a fair worry. Do you have a friend to help you practice?
Yes, my cousin is coming over soon. How do I keep my balance?
You look straight ahead and keep your feet moving.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the book on dragons fast.
It is on the top shelf. Are you looking for the red one?
Yes, that is the one.
It is right there next to the maps. Do you like magic books too?
I do, but I only have one minute.
I can ring the bell for you. Would you like to check that out?
Please, thank you so much.
Here is your card. Have a quick read.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my stamp and now I can not send my letter.
That is very sad to hear. Did you look in your bag?
Yes, I looked everywhere and it is just gone.
I am sorry you feel so bad. Would you like to buy a new one?
It will cost more money and I am already angry.
I understand why you are upset. Do you have a coin for the machine?
No, I do not have any extra cash right now.
I do not know where else to find one. Can you wait for a friend?
I am all alone here and this is very annoying.
I will stay with you until help comes. Are you okay to sit for a minute?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at the cold snow.
That is a good feeling. Do you hate the white flakes?
Yes, they are too cold on my nose.
I am sorry your nose hurts.
I wish it was warm and sunny.
Me too. What would you play if it was sunny?
I would jump in the puddles.
That sounds like fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like that new song. It makes me feel sad and angry.
I am sorry you feel that way. What part of the song bothers you most?
The words are too loud and fast. They hurt my head when I listen.
That sounds very tiring. Do you want to try a quiet song instead?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a low hand and I am not sure if I should fold or bet.
It is hard to say, but have you seen what your friend just played?
They put a small card on the table and are smiling.
That looks like they may have a good hand, so maybe you should fold.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do trees have such big leaves?
They help the tree drink sunlight. Do you like big leaves?
I do. But why do some fall off in fall?
They let the tree rest and save energy. Have you seen falling leaves?
Yes, they make a crunch. Do trees sleep too?
Yes, they slow down when it is cold. Do you sleep well?
I do most nights. How do they get so tall?
They grow up to reach more sun. I do not know how tall they can get.
That is okay. I will just enjoy the shade.
That is a good plan. Do you like sitting in the shade?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my toy near the fridge and it stuck to the side.
That is fun. Does the fridge have a magnet on it?
Yes, the back of the magnet is strong. It held my toy all day.
Strong magnets are great. Did you pick it up?
I tried, but it was hard. I had to pull it off slowly.
That takes care. Be safe next time.
Finally, it came off with a loud pop.
A loud pop is fun. Do you want to play more?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late and need to drive now.
Please stop. Are you safe to drive?
I am not ready but I must go.
That is a risky choice. Do you have a license?
I think I passed the test.
Great. How is your seat feeling?
It feels too loose.
Please tighten it first. Is your belt on?
No, I forgot the belt.
Put it on. I do not know your route, but safety is key.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are mountains so tall?
They are very old and made of rock. Do you like to climb things?
Yes, I like to climb trees.
That is a good way to get high.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see many shoes, but I do not know which one is good for me.
Do you want them for walking or for playing?
I just want something that feels nice when I run.
Soft shoes are best for running. Do you like the blue pair or the red pair?
I like the blue ones, but I am not sure if they fit.
You can try them on to see if they fit.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am lost, but I am very happy!
That is a happy kind of lost! Do you know where you want to go?
I just want to see what is new around the corner.
I love that spirit. Is the sun shining for you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today. The band played a loud song.
That sounds like fun. Did you like the music?
Yes, it was very happy. I wanted to dance.
Dancing is great. What song did you hear?
It was a song about the sun. I loved the bright sound.
The sun is nice. Do you want to dance again?
Maybe tomorrow. I am tired now.
Rest well.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a tall lighthouse today.
That sounds nice. Did it look old?
Yes, it had some cracks on the stone.
Cracks are common on old stone. Was it sunny?
The sun was very bright and warm.
Bright sun is good for a walk.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my voice change when I sing?
Your body moves air to make sound. Do you like low or high sounds?
I like high sounds. Why is that hard?
High sounds need tight cords and air. Do you practice often?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a pancake?
Mix flour, milk, and an egg in a bowl. Do you like your pancakes sweet or savory?
I like them sweet with syrup.
Stir the mix well, then pour a small circle onto a hot pan. Is your pan already hot?
Yes, it is ready.
Cook it until bubbles form on top, then flip it once. You are doing great!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have so many small things here. I do not know what to do with them.
That can feel hard. Do you like keeping them?
I think I do, but they take up too much room.
Maybe you can sort them into small piles. Do you want to start?
I am not sure how to start. Where do I even begin?
Start with the pile on the left. Is that okay?
Yes, I guess I can try that.
Good. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do bees make their sweet food?
They fly to flowers to collect the sugar water called nectar. Do you like sweet things?
I do. But where do they put that nectar?
They carry it home and spit it into their special honey stomachs. This helps the sugar change.
That is quite a trip. What happens when they get back to the hive?
They pass the nectar to other bees and fan it with their wings to dry it out. Then it turns into thick honey.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Can I send a letter here?
Yes, you can. Do you have a stamp?
I have one, but is this the right window?
Yes, that is the line for mail. Are you in a hurry?
No, I have all day. What time do you close?
We close at six. Do you need help with the form?
No, I have it ready. Thanks for your help.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my magnet stick to the fridge?
Because the fridge is made of steel, which is a metal that magnets pull on. Do you like to play with magnets?
Yes, I do. But why don't they stick to the wood table?
Wood is not a magnetic metal, so it does not pull. That is why only certain metals work.
So if I put it near a paperclip, will it move?
Yes, it will pull the clip right to it. Do you have a big box of clips to test this?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big secret to tell you.
Tell me, please. What is it?
I promise to be very good today.
That sounds like a wonderful promise.
I will share my snacks with everyone.
You are very kind to do that.
I feel warm inside right now.
That is a nice feeling.
Please do not tell anyone my secret.
I will keep it safe for you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what kind of music to play today.
That is okay. Do you like loud songs?
I like some, but I do not know where to start.
I am not sure what you like best. Do you want to sing?
Maybe. I am afraid I will make bad sounds.
Everyone makes bad sounds sometimes. It is true.
Thank you. I will try to play a little.
Good luck. Have fun with your sound.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The rain is loud outside. I do not know what to do.
That is a tricky sound. Do you like watching the drops fall?
I think I will go outside and splash.
That sounds like a wet and happy plan. Do you have warm socks on?
I am tired. I want to stay in my bed.
Resting is a good choice. Do you want a warm drink?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my grandpa wear a hat inside the house?
I am not sure, but I think he likes to feel warm. Do you have a favorite hat too?
Why does he always ask me about my toys?
He wants to hear your stories because he loves you. Do you enjoy telling him things?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost and cannot find my home.
That is scary. Do you know what street you are on?
I do not know the street name.
Look for a big store or a school. Do you see anything like that?
I see a park with a big pond.
Great. Walk toward the pond and look for a sign. Do you have a phone?
My phone is off and has no power.
Go to the nearest house and ask for help. You will be okay.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to drink coffee, but I knocked the cup over. Now my desk is wet.
Oh no, that is a big mess. Do you have paper towels nearby?
Yes, I used them, but my laptop is now in a puddle. I am very scared.
Unplug it right away. Is the computer still on?
I turned it off, and I opened it up to dry it out. This is hard work.
That is a good thing to do. I do not know if it will work later.
I am making tea to calm my nerves. It is a quiet day in the office.
Tea sounds nice. Do you like making tea?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the book on dogs. Where is it?
It is on the first shelf. Are you looking for a photo book?
No, I need the story book. I am very late.
It is right next to you on the left. Do you like the brown cover?
Yes, I have it. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I felt very small at work today.
That is a hard feeling. Did your boss smile at you?
No, he just gave me more tasks.
I am sorry to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What is this song?
It sounds like the rain. Is it from a movie?
No. I do not know. Please hurry.
It is by a sad singer. You can listen later.
No time. Bye.
Okay. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big rainbow in the sky, but I do not know what to do.
It is so pretty. Do you like the colors?
I do like them, but I still feel lost.
I do not know the right answer, but we can just sit and watch it together.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I felt so sad after that movie.
I am sorry you felt that way. Did the end surprise you?
Yes, it was not what I hoped for.
That can feel unfair. Do you want to talk about it more?
I just want to feel happy again.
I understand that wish. Let us pick a bright book next.
Okay, that sounds better.
Good choice. You are very kind to listen.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I like to draw, but I do not know what to start with.
That is a fun choice. Do you like animals or cars?
I like both, but my lines are messy and I feel sad.
Messy lines are okay at first. What color pen do you hold now?
I have a blue pen, but it feels too hard to move.
Try a pencil; it is softer and easier. Do you have a pencil nearby?
Yes, I have many pencils, but I am still unsure if I can do it.
You can do this. Just draw one small thing first.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do clouds look like white fluff?
They are made of tiny water drops. Do you like looking up at the sky?
Yes, I do. But why are some clouds dark?
Dark clouds hold a lot of water and rain.
Does the sun go behind them?
Yes, the sun hides when clouds are thick. Do you know what happens when it rains?
It gets wet. Can clouds be made of ice?
Yes, high clouds are often ice. Thank you for asking me these fun questions.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I dropped my cup and it broke.
I am sorry it broke. Were you hurt?
No, but I am happy I told you.
That is a good thing to share. Did you clean the glass?
Yes, my mom helped me.
That was very smart. How do you feel now?
I feel good about talking.
I am glad you feel better.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My shirt has a big red stain. How do I get it out?
That sounds tricky. Do you know what made the stain?
It is ketchup. What should I do now?
Put some soap on it and rub it gently. Then wash it in the machine.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I keep my tent dry at night?
Put a ground sheet under the tent to stop water from rising up. Is your site on flat ground?
Yes, but it is a bit low.
Low spots can flood, so dig small ditches around the tent to drain water away. Do you have a shovel?
Yes, I have a small one.
That should work well, but stay true to the facts that low ground is risky. Do you have a backup spot?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is waiting so hard for me?
It feels long when you want things fast. Do you feel it in your chest?
Yes, my heart beats fast. What can I do?
Try to breathe slow and look at the grass. Does that help you feel calm?
I do not know if it will. Is it okay to feel this way?
Yes, it is a normal feeling. Be kind to yourself.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the moon look bright at night?
It reflects light from the sun to us. Do you like looking up at the night sky?
I love it, but why do the stars go away?
The moon is much closer and brighter than the stars. Do you know how far away it is?
I think it is far away. Can we go there?
Yes, people have traveled there before. Would you like to visit a place on the moon?
Yes, I would. Is it quiet there?
I do not know for sure if it is quiet. Do you think it would be quiet?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do fish swim so fast?
They run to catch food. Do you have a favorite fish?
Why do we throw a line in the water?
The bait helps the fish find our hook. Do you like to fish in the lake?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so late. I feel bad.
It is okay. Did you sleep well?
No, I lost my keys.
That is hard. Can we call your friend?
Yes, please call them.
I will do that now.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My head hurts a lot today.
That sounds tough. Does it hurt when you look at bright lights?
Yes, the light makes it worse. What should I do?
Rest in a dark, quiet room for a while.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not like the cold snow.
Snow is nice for building forts. Do you like the warm sun?
Yes, I love the sun.
That is a happy thing. What do you eat in the summer?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The lights went out. I am so mad.
I am sorry that happened. Is your phone working?
No, my phone is dead too.
That is tricky. Do you have any candles?
I found some boxes of matches.
Good, you can use those. Do you feel safe in the dark?
I guess so, but it is very quiet.
Quiet can be nice sometimes. Would you like me to stay on the line?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn a new language, but it feels very hard.
That is a big step. What made you pick this language?
I love the songs from that country.
Music is a great start. Do you listen to them every day?
Yes, but I do not know what the words mean.
Look up the words as you listen. Is it fun or boring?
It is fun, but I get tired fast.
Small bits of time work best. How many minutes do you study?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I had a very scary dream last night. I feel sad.
I am sorry about that. What happened in the dream?
A big dog chased me. I could not run fast enough.
That sounds frightening. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I cannot sleep. What should I do?
I am not a doctor, so I do not know the exact fix. Do you feel too hot?
No, my room is cold. My mind will not stop racing.
Try lying still and thinking about a warm, calm place. Does that sound easy to try?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have two kings and I feel so happy. What should I do next?
That is a great start. What did the other player do?
He played a high card. Should I keep my kings safe or use them?
I am not sure of the full rules. Do you need to beat his card to win?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big surprise for you.
That sounds like fun. What is it?
I am getting a puppy next week.
A puppy? How nice. Is it a boy or girl?
It is a boy. He is small and brown.
He must be cute. I am glad for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hi, why do ships float? I am late!
They push water down. The water pushes back up. Do you have a heavy bag?
No, just books. Can you say it in one word?
Buoyancy. It is the push from the water. Are you okay?
No, I do not know that word. Keep it simple.
The ship is lighter than the water it moves. Is your train leaving now?
Yes, thank you. I go now.
By the way, you are welcome.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the water so blue?
The sky gives it that color. Do you see a lot of blue where you live?
Yes, I do.
That is nice. The sun makes the waves shine too.
Does the sea ever sleep?
The water moves all the time. But it gets very quiet at night.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late today and felt a bit tired.
That can happen to anyone. Did you drink something warm?
Yes, I had hot chocolate with marshmallows.
That sounds very sweet and cozy.
Then I saw my cat sit in a sunbeam and purr.
Cats love warm spots so much. Did you pet him?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to make the clock go.
Do you want it to tick?
Yes, I want it to tick.
Pull the small handle up. Do you see it?
It still looks broken to me.
Look at the little hands.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost. I do not know which month we are in.
Let us think together. What is your favorite season?
I like when it is very cold and I can wear a big coat.
That sounds like winter. Can you remember what day it is today?
I think it is Tuesday, but I am not sure about the number.
That is okay. I do not know the exact date either. Do you know the name of the month?
I think it is December because I love snow.
That is a good guess. Is the tree outside still green?
No, it has lost all its leaves and looks bare.
If it is December, the tree should be bare. Does that feel right to you?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad my shed is done!
That is great to hear. How did you put the roof on?
I used some big wooden boards.
That sounds very strong. Do you keep tools inside it?
Yes, I store my pruners there.
What a nice home for them.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: What is the moon made of?
It is made of rock and dust, just like Earth. Do you look at it at night?
How far away is it?
It is very far away, but close enough to see clearly. Do you ever see stars near it?
Can I go there?
I do not know if you will go there soon, but many people have been there before.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke your cup. I do not know what to do.
That sounds scary. Did you try to tell me right away?
No, I hid it because I was scared.
It is good you told me now. Are you ready to say it?
I just want to feel better about it.
Saying sorry is a true fix. Do you want to practice the words?
I am still not sure if it is enough.
An apology helps, but actions matter most. Will you help clean up the glass?
Yes, I will clean it up.
That is the right choice. I am glad you are here.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see the old boats. Where do I go?
The boats are on the top floor. Do you like tall ships?
How much does the ticket cost?
It is five dollars for adults. Is that too much for you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so sad to leave my treehouse.
That feels hard to say goodbye. Did you build it with Dad?
Yes, but I have a new garden to play in.
A new garden sounds exciting. What color is the grass there?
It is bright green and very soft.
Soft grass is nice for rolling around. Do you have a slide there too?
I do not know, but I hope there is one.
Let us hope for a big red slide.
I will look for it when we arrive.
That is a good plan to check.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a magnet stick to the fridge.
You can use a small magnet with a hook. What color is your fridge?
It is white. How do I get it to stay up?
Press the flat side against the metal part. Do you have a marker to draw on it?
No, but I can just hold it.
That will work fine. Have fun with your new magnet.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I forgot which month comes after March.
Oh no, that is frustrating. Do you remember the first month of the year?
March has three ones in its name. April starts with an A.
That is a good clue. Can you count the letters in the word "April"?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to paint a rainbow.
That sounds fun. Do you have red crayons?
Yes, I have many colors.
Great. Start with red at the bottom.
What color comes next?
Orange is next. Do you like orange?
I do not know the order.
The order is red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet.
Is that all of them?
Yes, that is the full circle of light. Are you ready to draw?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so late and I feel bad.
That is tricky. Are you sure you missed the bus?
Yes, it drove away without me.
Oh no. Do you know when the next one comes?
I do not know, and I am worried.
Let us check the phone together.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is so bright today. I love it.
That is nice. Do you like the heat?
Yes, it feels good on my skin.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I read too close to bed and my eyes get tired.
Try holding the book further away. Do you like dark rooms?
It helps, but I still fall asleep with my head on the page.
That is a very cozy way to sleep. Do you use a lamp?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the short hand move so slow?
It takes a whole hour to move one step. Do you see the long hand spin faster?
I think I do. Why does the long hand go so fast?
It counts the minutes for us. Does the minute hand look like a race?
It feels like a race to me. Why do we need two hands then?
One tells the hour, and the other tells the minute. Do you like keeping track of time?
I guess I do. How do you know which is which?
The short one is the hour, and the long one is the minute. Do you remember the little trick?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My sister gave me a big hug today.
That is a sweet moment. Did she say why?
Yes, she said I made her smile.
I am glad to hear that.
I feel so warm inside now.
You should share that good feeling.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The big room is far.
I am here. Is the door open?
Yes, but I forgot my pen.
That is bad. Do you need a sheet too?
No, just the pen. It is on my desk.
I do not know where your desk is. Do you want help?
I left it near the window.
The window is on the east side. Is that correct?
Yes. Please give it to me.
Here it is. You can run now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late for the park.
Oh no, let us go. Do you have your food?
Yes, the bag is right there.
Great. The sun looks bright today.
I must run now.
Run fast, but be safe. I hope you have fun.
Thanks for helping me.
You are welcome. Good luck with your trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to catch a fish.
That is hard, but we can try. What kind of rod are you using?
I have a small one from the store.
A small rod is good for little fish. Do you have any bait?
No, I only have water in my bottle.
I do not know if that will work. Let us look for live worms nearby?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the lighthouse light move?
It moves to help ships find their way. Do you like watching it turn?
Yes, it looks like a big star.
It is a very big and bright star at night. Is it dark where you live?
It is getting dark outside now.
That is a good time to see the light. Do you feel safe there?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to plan my day but I am so late.
I can help you list your tasks. What is your first goal?
I must finish work and then buy food.
That is a solid plan. Do you have enough time for both?
I think so, but I am running out of steam.
Let us do work first. Are you ready to start?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can robots dream?
I do not know for sure, but I think it is a cool thought. Do you have a robot toy?
Yes, I do.
That is great. What is its name?
It is just my bot.
Okay. Does it like to dance?
No, it just beeps.
Beeping is fun. Do you like the sound?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know what the sea is made of, but I am running late.
It is mostly salt water. Do you like swimming?
I have no time for swimming, just tell me if it is safe to drink.
No, you should not drink it. Is that all you need?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I find a book about cats?
Look at the brown section on the left. Do you like science books?
I do. I want to know how they hunt.
Try the "Animals" shelf first. It is usually near the middle. Do you have a library card?
Yes, I have it in my bag.
Great. Bring it to the desk if you need help.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a short movie but I have no idea how to start.
Just pick a simple story and write it down first. Do you have a camera or a phone?
I only have my phone, but I think I can use that.
Your phone works fine for the video. Do you know how to record the sound?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Did we win?
Yes, we won by two goals. Are you okay?
Good. Who scored?
I do not know who scored. Do you want the score?
No. I am running.
Take care. See you later.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate a cold egg for breakfast.
That sounds simple. Did you like it?
It was okay, but I wanted toast too.
Toast is a good choice. Did you have any fruit?
No, I was in a hurry to leave.
Being in a rush can make mornings hard.
I also dropped my keys on the floor.
Oops, that is a start. Did you find them?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just read my favorite book again. It is about a little girl who lives in the woods.
That sounds very cozy. Does the girl have a pet?
Yes, she has a small fox. The fox helps her find hidden treasures.
I am glad the friend is with her. What kind of treasure does she find first?
She finds a bright red apple that glows in the dark. It is the happiest part of the story.
A glowing apple is a magical thing. Thank you for sharing this joy with me.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know how to score tennis, but I am late.
Points go fifteen, thirty, forty, game. Do you have a partner?
Yes, but I forgot where the court is.
It is usually near the park. Is it sunny today?
It is, but I must run now.
Run safe. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to read in the dark.
That is very cozy. Do you like the dark?
Yes, it feels safe.
That is good. Goodnight.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to tell you my big plan.
That sounds exciting. What is the first step?
I will pack my bag with snacks and toys.
Good idea. Do you have a map?
Yes, I have a map of the park.
Nice. How will you get there?
I will take the bus to the park.
That is a smart choice.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I mixed up Tuesday and Thursday and I feel so bad.
Mistakes happen to everyone. Did you miss a meeting?
Yes, I was late and it was very awkward.
That feels tough, but the day is almost done. Do you want to plan tomorrow?
Maybe. I just wish I could have two Mondays.
I do not know if that is possible. Why do you love Mondays so much?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors. Blue light scatters more than other colors. Do you like the color blue?
I love it. But why does blue scatter more?
Blue light waves are tiny and short. They bounce around easily in the air. Have you ever seen rain?
Yes, I have. Does rain help the sky turn blue?
Not directly, but water vapor is in the air. It helps the light bounce around. Do you see clouds today?
I see some white clouds. Why are they white?
Clouds have big water drops. They reflect all colors of light together. Do you think they look soft?
They look like cotton. Why not just white all the time?
Dust and smoke can change the color. Sometimes the sky looks gray or red. Do you have a favorite sky color?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look! My bread is getting big and soft. I am so glad it worked.
That is great news. Does it smell sweet to you?
Yes, it smells like a warm hug. I am happy to share it with you.
Thank you, I am sure it tastes good.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want a cake, but I do not know which one.
That is a hard choice. Do you like fruit or just sweet sugar?
I like the soft ones with the pink icing.
The strawberry cake looks very tasty. Would you like a slice?
Yes, please.
Good choice. Here is your cake.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we keep trying when it is hard?
Trying helps you learn new things. Do you like learning?
Yes, I do.
That is a good sign. It shows you want to grow.
What if I fail again?
Failure just tells us what to fix next. Is that scary?
A little, but okay.
You are doing fine. Keep going at your own pace.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost in this big room. Where should I look first?
The main hall is right ahead. Do you like old things?
I do not know. What is cool here?
The dinosaur bones are very tall. Are you afraid of big bones?
No. I just want to see something neat.
Then the robot show is a great pick. Do you like moving machines?
Yes. I will go there.
That sounds like a plan. Have a happy time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The wind is so loud, H. Are we safe inside?
Yes, the house is strong. Do you see the big trees shaking?
My heart feels fast from the thunder.
It is scary, but we are dry and warm.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I check my temperature?
Use a thermometer. Do you have a digital one at home?
Yes, I have a blue one.
Put it under your tongue for one minute. Is your throat hurting too?
A little, but my head hurts more.
That is good to know.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am scared to start my first job tomorrow.
It is normal to feel that way. What makes you feel most nervous?
I worry that I will forget how to do my tasks.
You can always write them down if you forget. Do you have a notebook ready?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park this morning. The map said it was five minutes away, but I took the long way around the big lake.
That sounds like a nice walk. Did you see any ducks by the water?
Yes, I saw a family of ducks. I also found a red leaf on my path and kept it as a token.
What a happy day. Was the red leaf from a maple tree?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to put on the cake.
A red rose looks nice. Do you like flowers?
I guess so, but it is too sweet for me.
Try a plain white one with fruit. Is that better?
That sounds good, thank you.
You are welcome. Go get it done.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. The boss was very loud.
That sounds hard. I am sorry. Did he yell at you?
Yes, I felt small and sad.
It is okay to feel sad. Would you like a hug?
Yes, a big one. Thank you.
I am here for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the exit. My bus is coming.
The exit is by the big red door. Do you have enough time?
Maybe. Is the gift shop open?
I do not know for sure. It might be closed.
Thanks. I will just go.
You are welcome. Have a safe ride.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the moon so bright?
It shines on us when the sun is down. Do you like to see it?
Yes, I do. How does it get there?
I do not know the full path. It just floats in the sky.
It looks like a ball.
It is a round rock with no air. You can breathe there?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my favorite book in the library.
That is very sad to hear. Did you look near the shelves?
Yes, I checked everywhere, but it is gone.
I am sorry it is missing. Do you remember which section it was in?
I think it was in the corner by the window.
We can check that spot together. Would you like to walk over there now?
Please, I hope we find it.
Let us hope for the best.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I ran fast today. My legs felt like jelly.
That is very brave. Did you drink some water?
Yes, I drank a big cup. But my tummy hurt a little.
A tummy ache means you worked hard. Do you like playing tag?
I do not play tag. I just like to run in circles.
Running in circles can be fun too.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a big rock on the island. What is it made of?
It is made of stone. Do you think it is heavy?
Yes, it looks very heavy. Is the island hot or cold?
It is warm there. Do you like the beach?
I love the sand. Can we go tomorrow?
Yes, let us go.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a book with a bear on the cover. But I do not know if I should read it or just keep it for my shelf.
That sounds like a good start. Do you like stories about animals?
I think so, but I am scared the story will be too long or too sad.
You can always stop when you feel tired. Is the cover bright or dark?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck. The pieces do not fit.
Take a deep breath. Can you find the corner pieces first?
I tried, but they look the same.
Look for the blue edge. Do you see a long blue line?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the garden today. My tomato plant has three little green fruits on it.
That is a great start for your crop. Do you water them every day?
Yes, I gave them a drink in the morning. Then I saw a bug eating a leaf.
Bugs can eat parts of plants. Do you know what kind of bug it was?
It was small and green. I gently moved it to the other side of the plant.
That was a kind thing to do for the bug.
Now the tomato is safe and the bug is far away. I feel happy about my garden.
It is nice that you helped both the plant and the bug.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the wind so loud today?
The air is moving very fast outside. Do you like loud noises?
No, it scares me a little.
That is a common feeling. It can sound scary when it is strong.
Does the wind have a place to live?
Wind is moving air, so it does not have a home. It just goes where it wants.
Can the wind get tired?
No, wind is not alive, so it cannot get tired. It only stops when the air stops moving.
I understand now, thank you.
You are welcome. I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do cows chew their food for so long?
They chew it to help their tummy digest the grass. Do you like watching them chew?
I think it looks slow. Do they do it all day?
They do most of the day, but they rest at night. Do you want to know why they rest?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the lighthouse light so bright?
It helps ships see the rocks at night. Do you like watching the waves?
How does the light actually turn?
A big motor spins the glass lamp around. Is it loud inside?
Does it work even when it rains?
Yes, the light shines through the rain. Does it rain much where you live?
Can people live in the lighthouse?
I do not know for sure, but some do. Do you want to live there?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to drink warm stuff, but I do not know what to pick.
Do you like your drink sweet or plain?
I like it sweet with milk, please.
Tea is a good choice for milk and sugar.
What if I want to stay awake?
Coffee gives you more energy than tea.
But will coffee make me too jittery?
Yes, it can make you feel shaky.
So tea is safer for me, right?
Yes, tea is gentler for your body.
I think I will try the tea first.
That is a wise choice, friend.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the beach today. It was so much fun.
That sounds great. Did you see any fish?
No, but I saw a crab. It looked right at me.
Cool. How did that feel?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very happy, but I must go now.
That is good news. What made you smile?
The sun is warm on my face.
Sunshine feels nice. Do you see birds?
I see trees, but I have no time to wait.
Trees are lovely. I do not know where you are going.
I am heading to the park quickly.
Have fun at the park.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big bear today and I am so happy!
That sounds like a great day! Did it look scary?
No, it was just eating berries by the pond.
Bears love sweet food. I do not know what it was doing right before that.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I think I am lost. Where is the park?
I do not know where you are. Are you near a big tree?
Yes, there is a very tall oak here.
Look for a blue sign on the trunk. Do you see it?
No, I only see leaves and dirt.
Walk to your left for one minute. Can you hear any birds?
I hear birds, but I am still not sure.
Keep going until you see a fence. Is the sky sunny?
The sun is out, but I do not see a fence yet.
Look behind you at the ground. Do you see footprints?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a red ball and a blue cube. What do I have?
You have two shapes. Do you like the ball?
Yes, I do. What is a square?
A square has four same sides. Do you have one?
I have a triangle. Can I give it to you?
Yes, please. It is a nice gift.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do sailors look at the sky?
They look for clouds to stay safe. Do you like the sky?
Why do they not use a map?
I do not know for sure, but they use stars too. Do you like stars?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is snowing hard outside. How can I stay warm?
Wear a thick coat and a hat. Do you have warm boots?
Yes, I have boots, but my hands are cold. What should I use?
Put on some wool gloves. Do you like making snow angels?
I do, but the ground looks hard and frozen. Can I play on it?
I do not know if it is safe to run there.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to draw cats. Do they have nine lives?
That is a very old story. Do you have a cat at home?
No, but I see many at the park. Why do they purr?
Purring means they are happy. Do you see them sleep a lot?
Yes, they sleep all day. Is that normal for them?
Yes, cats sleep a lot. Do you want to try drawing a sleeping cat?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a song that makes me smile so much.
That sounds lovely. Does it have a happy tune?
Yes, it is very bright and fast.
I am glad you are having fun. Can I hear a bit of it?
Sure, but I am not sure you can hear it here.
Fair enough. Thank you for sharing the feeling.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What should I eat?
Try the salad. It is fast. Is it cold outside?
Yes, it is. Do you know if they have soup?
I do not know. Do you want to check?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big plan! I want to build a fort in the backyard.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What materials will you use?
I will use big blankets and sticks.
Nice. Do you have the sticks already?
No, I need to find them near the garden.
I do not know where they are. Please look under the big tree.
Good idea. I will also make a tunnel door.
A tunnel door is clever. Will you cut the fabric?
Yes, with my little scissors.
Be careful with those. I am glad you are having such a great day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am sad because I miss my grandma.
That is a big feeling. Do you like talking to her?
Yes, I do. What can I do to feel less sad?
You can write her a sweet card. That is a kind thing to do.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do I need a big tent for two people?
A small tent is fine for two people. Do you have one already?
No, I need to buy one. What color is good for sleeping?
Dark colors hide the stars, so light is better. Do you like dark or light colors?
I like blue, but I am not sure. Is blue warm enough inside?
Blue is a great choice for camping. It looks nice against the trees.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want a drink, but I do not know which one.
Tea is warm and sweet. Coffee is strong and quick. Do you like hot or cold?
I like things that make me calm.
Tea is good for calm minds. Coffee can make you feel shaky. Do you feel tired?
Yes, I feel very tired today.
Coffee will wake you up fast. But tea helps you rest well. What time is it?
It is late at night.
Night is better for tea. Coffee keeps you awake too long. Do you want to try it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I lost the last hand again.
That feels bad. Did you get a good hand?
No, I had two kings and a queen.
That is a strong hand. Why did you lose?
The other player had five of a kind.
That is very rare. How is that even possible?
He has a magic deck. I am done playing.
It is not your fault. Maybe rest a bit?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky so gray today?
The clouds are thick. Do you like the rain?
Is it because of the cold air?
Yes, cold air makes clouds. Are you warm?
Why does it look so dark?
The sun is hiding behind the clouds. Do you have a jacket?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a song in my head but I cannot write it down.
That is a common feeling. Do you like to type or draw?
I try both, but the words get stuck in my throat.
Try humming it first to catch the tune.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My dog is sleeping right now.
That is nice. Does he have a favorite toy?
I do not know what his favorite is.
That is okay. You can find out later. Is he big or small?
He is very big.
Big dogs are often gentle. Do you like to hug him?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the short hand move so slow?
It takes 12 hours for one full turn. Do you like watching the clock?
I do. Why is the long hand faster?
It races around every 60 minutes. This is called an hour.
So the small hand is for hours?
Yes, that is true. What time is it for you?
It is three. Why do we need two hands?
One hand tells the hours, and one tells the minutes.
I get it now. Thank you.
You are welcome. Do you want to practice?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am mad. Why is the sky blue? It should be green like the grass.
I am sorry you feel upset. The sun gives off light, and the air scatters the blue parts out for us to see. Do you like blue?
I guess I do, but I just want it to be different today.
It is okay to miss how things are. The light always spreads the blue color in the wide air. Do you see any clouds?
Yes, big white ones. But the blue still makes me sad.
Blue can be calm, like deep water. It is just a trick of light, not a choice. Does that make you feel a bit better?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a big test. What day is it?
It is Monday. Are you ready for the test?
I am late! What is the day after Tuesday?
It is Wednesday. Do you like school?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My head hurts and my nose runs.
That sounds like a bad cold. Do you have any soup?
Yes, I am drinking it now.
Good for you. I do not know if it will fix you, but it helps.
I am tired and want to sleep.
Rest is best. How did you get sick?
I played outside in the rain.
Be careful next time. Will you take medicine?
Yes, I will rest now.
That is wise. Get well soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I help my friend who feels sad?
You can sit with them and listen. Do they like playing games?
Yes, but I do not know how to play chess.
I can teach you the basic moves. Do you have a board?
I do, but I am not sure where to put the pieces.
Put the queens in the center. Would you like to try a match?
Yes, please. Thank you for your help.
I am happy to help you. Have fun playing.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to bake bread, but I am scared the dough will hurt me.
Do not worry, the dough is not hot. It is just soft and sticky like playdough. What do you like to eat for breakfast?
I like jam and milk.
That is a tasty choice. You can make plain bread and put jam on it later.
How long do I have to wait for it to grow big?
It takes about one hour to double in size. Do you have a timer to help you count?
Yes, I have a red timer.
Great, set it for sixty minutes. Then we will see the magic happen.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My chair leg is loose and I need to sit down now, what do I do?
It is just a wobbly leg. Which leg is the wobbly one?
The back left one is bad and I am late for work.
Put some tape around it for now. Is the tape in your bag?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the loud drums in this song.
That sounds very annoying to you. Do they make your ears hurt?
Yes, they are too loud and fast.
I am sorry it feels so bad. Would you like to turn the music off?
Maybe, but I want to hear the singing part.
We can try to quiet the drums. Do you know how to do that?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure if I should say hello to the new person at the table.
Yes, it is kind to say hello. Do you know their name?
I do not know their name, but I want to be nice.
Just smile and say good morning. How does that feel?
I do not want to make a mistake and be rude.
A simple hello is always good.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My cow gave a lot of milk today. It was very cold outside.
That sounds like a tough day. Did you bring the cow inside to keep her warm?
Yes, I put a blanket on her. Then I fed the chickens some corn.
The chickens must have loved that snack.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My boat is stuck in the mud.
That is tricky. Do you have a rope?
I found a stick, but I am lost.
Use the stick to push from the back. Is the water deep enough?
It moved a little bit.
Good luck. Does it feel light now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do cows give us milk?
Yes, they do. Do you like drinking milk?
I do. Do all cows have big udders?
Most cows do, but bulls do not. Are bulls big?
Yes, they are huge. Does a bull ever make milk?
No, a bull never makes milk. Do you like pigs?
I think pigs are messy. Do they like to roll in mud?
Yes, they love cool mud. Do you have a favorite farm animal?
I think I like chickens the best.
That is a good choice. Do you like their little chicks?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I fix my broken pencil?
You can use a sharpener. Do you have one?
I do, but the lead breaks inside.
That happens a lot. Try pushing the lead down first.
That worked, thank you.
You are welcome. Is your homework done now?
Yes, I finished it.
Great job. Good luck on your test.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I bought a coffee this morning, but then I broke my favorite mug. I was sad.
Ouch, that is a double loss. Did you buy a new mug?
No, I used a paper cup. It cost less, but I felt silly holding it.
Using a paper cup is a smart way to save. Are you happy you did not spend more money?
Yes, I think I will save my coins for a pizza tonight instead.
That sounds like a great plan. Do you like pizza with extra cheese?
I love it, so I will start my coin jar right now.
That is a wonderful goal. I hope you have a tasty dinner.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I bought these red roses because I feel so happy today.
That is wonderful news. Why are you so happy?
I passed my big test at school this morning.
That is a great achievement. What is your favorite part of the flower?
I love the sweet smell that comes from the petals.
Flowers do smell very nice. Do you have a vase for them?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so bad while I wait here. What should I do?
Try to take a deep breath. How long have you been waiting?
It feels like a whole year. I just want to leave.
You can walk around a bit. Does that help you feel better?
Not really, I am still mad. I wish this would end.
Anger passes fast. Have you tried counting to ten?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go. I am sorry I forgot the keys.
That is okay. You can get them later. Are you late for work?
Yes. Please do not make me stop.
I will not. Just say it out loud. Do you feel better now?
No. I am in a big rush.
It is true that guilt feels heavy. I do not know how to fix the clock. Should I walk with you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do wild animals have homes?
Yes, they make homes like dens or nests. Do you like looking at birds?
I saw a big bear in the park!
That is a very special place for a bear. Did it have a cub?
Bears can eat fish, right?
Yes, they love catching fish. Do you know any other things bears eat?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Today I saw bees in the garden. They were very busy.
That sounds like a nice day. Did you see where they went?
They went to the flowers. I wondered how they make sweet honey.
Bees drink sweet water from flowers and carry it home.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in the park. What should I do?
Take a slow walk toward the big tree. Do you see it?
Yes, I see the tree. Should I go to the left or the right?
I do not know which side is right for you. Which way makes you feel happy?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am so lost on this test. What do I do?
Take a deep breath. Are you stuck on one hard part?
Yes, the math word problems. They look too big.
Break it into small steps. Do you have any paper to write on?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to play a hand, now.
Sure, we can play quickly. Do you know the rules?
No, I am very late.
Easy. You put a card down if it matches. Do you want to start?
Just give me the deck.
Here you go. I do not know what you will win, but I hope you do. Are you close?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love how loud the city is today. The cars and people make so much sound.
It must be a fun place to be. Do you hear your favorite song in the noise?
I feel very happy walking around here. The sun is warm on my face.
That sounds like a great feeling. I am glad you are enjoying the day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the wind so loud today?
The air is moving very fast. Do you feel it on your face?
Yes, it feels cold. Why does the air move?
The sun warms the air in some places. This makes the air push to other spots.
Can the wind hurt us?
Not usually, but strong wind can knock things over. Are you wearing a jacket?
I am warm. Thank you for helping me understand.
You are welcome. The wind is a good friend to plants.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am so tired on Mondays.
Mondays are hard. Do you sleep well?
I want to rest on the weekend.
Rest is good for you. Do you like Sunday best?
Do all weeks have the same days?
Yes, they always do.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I cannot speak well.
That is hard. I know you work hard. Do you like the sounds?
Sometimes. But I mix up the words.
That is okay. We all mix up words. What word is hard?
The verb for "to be". It is too many forms.
It takes time to learn them all. I am happy to help you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a snow angel, but I do not know how.
Just lie on your back and move your arms and legs up and down. Do you like lying in the snow?
Yes, I do, but my hands are cold.
Put your gloves back on to keep them warm. Are your toes warm?
No, my toes are frozen.
I do not know why your feet are so cold. Do you have thick socks on?
No, I only have thin socks.
Go put on your warm boots right now. You will feel much better.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which month is next.
Do you know what month it is today?
I think it is May.
Yes, that is true. Is it warm outside?
I am not sure.
It is always warm in May.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and saw a big brown horse.
That sounds like a nice surprise. Was the horse standing still?
Yes, it was eating grass from a small field.
Horses love to graze on green grass. Did it look happy?
It looked calm, but I did not know its name.
That is true, I do not know its name either. Did you talk to the owner?
The owner said the horse was very gentle.
I am glad it is safe to be near. Did you pet its nose?
I only touched its back, and it did not move.
That is a very good sign of a calm animal. You had a good day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the train?
It is at Gate 4. Are you sure you packed your bag?
Yes. Is it fast?
It goes very fast. Have a good trip!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today.
That is a great thing. Do you like sunshine?
Yes, I love the sun.
Me too. It makes me warm.
I want to share this joy.
That is kind of you. Who is with you?
Just my cat.
Cats are nice friends.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we get a day off for the winter break?
It gives us time to rest and be with family. Do you have a big plan?
I want to stay home and read. Why do people go to parties?
They like to share food and talk. Is that boring to you?
It is not boring. But why is it cold outside?
The earth is tilted away from the sun. Do you wear a coat?
Yes, I always do. Why do leaves fall off trees?
I am not sure of the exact reason. I know they need to rest, though.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Can you tell me how bees make honey?
Bees drink sweet plant juice and store it in their special stomachs. Do you like sweet drinks?
Yes, I do. How do I make honey at home?
You cannot make real honey at home because only bees can do that. Are you a beekeeper?
No, I am just a kid who likes bees.
You can help by planting flowers for them to drink from.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the library today.
That sounds nice. Did you pick a book?
