Yes, I found a story about a dog.
A dog story is always fun. Do you like dogs?
I like them very much.
I am happy you found a good read.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my dog wag his tail?
He wags it because he is happy to see you. Do you treat him well?
Yes, I give him a lot of treats.
That is very sweet of you. Is he small or big?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the ferry time. I am late.
It leaves at noon. Are you afraid of boats?
No, but I must pack fast. What should I take?
Bring your keys and a water bottle. Do you have snacks for the ride?
I have some fruit. Is that enough?
Yes, that is fine. Please do not forget your ticket.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to float on my back.
That is a great goal. Do you know how to kick your legs?
I think I can kick, but I am scared of falling.
Fear is normal. Do you have a pool nearby?
Yes, my house is close to a big pool.
Tell me, do you have a friend to help?
My brother likes to swim with me.
Good luck with him.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big fish jump in the lake today.
That must be fun to watch. What did the fish look like?
It was silver and shiny.
Silver fish are very beautiful. Do you like looking at the water?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, can I swim right now?
The waves are big today. Are you a strong swimmer?
Yes, I have to go.
Please check the signs first.
Is the sand clean?
I see a few shells there. Is that good for you?
It is fine, I must go.
Have a safe time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I got on the big yellow bus this morning.
That sounds fun. Did you get a seat by the window?
Yes, I sat near the back door.
I see. Was the ride bumpy or smooth?
It was very smooth and quiet.
Good. Do you enjoy looking at the trees go by?
Not really, I just read my book.
That is nice. I do not know what book you read.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the apple red?
Yes, it is red and sweet. Do you like apples?
I like them with milk.
That sounds yummy. Is the juice orange or blue?
The juice is orange.
I do not know which fruit is next. What do you see now?
I see a big banana.
Bananas are yellow and soft. Are you hungry?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. My cake is in the oven.
Happy birthday! Do you have any candles?
Yes, I have a box of them.
Great. Are you making the food too?
I bought a pizza. I am almost done.
That sounds tasty. What color is your hat?
It is red. Please let me go.
Go with a smile. Have a fun day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My train is late and I am so sad.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you have a book to read?
No, I left my book at home.
That is a shame. Did you pack any snacks?
Yes, I have an apple.
That sounds good. Do you like apples?
I do, but I am still upset.
Anger is okay to feel. Do you want to talk about it?
I just want to be home now.
I hope you get there soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the big bakery today. I bought a warm bagel with cream cheese. It was so good.
That sounds like a tasty treat. Did you eat it all?
Yes, I ate the whole thing in one bite. Now my stomach is full and happy.
I am glad you enjoyed your snack.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent all day packing small boxes for the move.
That sounds like a lot of hard work. Did you find any interesting old toys?
I found a broken toy car from last summer.
A broken car is a sad find. Do you think you can fix it?
No, the wheel is snapped off for good.
You could keep it as a memory or throw it away. Which one feels right to you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the post box?
Is it in your hurry? It is by the big tree.
Which tree? There are many trees.
Do you see the red roof? Look near that house.
I see a red roof. Is that it?
Yes, right there. Happy post.
Thank you. I must go now.
Bye bye.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My phone screen is very dark and hard to see.
You can try to make it brighter. Do you use a lot of the phone?
Yes, I play games and read stories on it all day.
That might be why the battery runs out fast. Is your battery dying soon?
It dies after one hour of playing.
The screen drains power quickly. Do you play in a dark room?
Yes, I play at night in my bed.
Light drains the battery. Would you like to check the settings?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a giant cookie on my desk today.
That sounds like a lovely surprise. Did you share it with anyone?
I ate the whole thing by myself before anyone saw.
Oh, I am glad you enjoyed it so much.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the trees look so big?
They have grown for many years. Do you like trees?
Yes, I do. Why is the bridge so old?
It was built by people a long time ago. Is it strong?
I think it is. Why do the houses look cold?
It is winter, so they need coats. Are you warm?
I am warm. Why does the lake not move?
I do not know why. Do you want to look closer?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in a big rush. What is a square?
It has four same long sides. Do you see one?
I cannot wait. What is a circle?
It is round like a ball. I do not know why you are late.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. My chair is broken. Can you help?
Yes, I can. Is the leg loose?
I must leave now. Please fix it fast.
I do not know. Why is it broken?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do sailors live on the water?
Yes, they live on big boats called ships. Do you like the sound of the waves?
Can they see the moon from their beds?
Some ships have small windows, so yes. Do you think it is dark up there?
What do they eat for dinner?
They often eat simple food like rice and beans. I do not know if they have cake.
Is it bumpy when the water is bad?
Yes, the boat shakes when waves are high. Do you get scared of shaking?
Thank you for telling me.
You are welcome. Do you want to talk about more sea things?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I can see smoke from the house next door. My heart is beating fast.
I am sorry you feel scared. Is everyone safe in their home?
Yes, my family is inside. The windows are closed tight.
That is a very good thing to do. Do you see any flames yet?
No, just gray smoke rising up. It looks like a thick cloud.
The fire crew is on the way. Please stay inside and wait for them.
Thank you for helping me breathe. I feel a little better now.
I am glad to hear that. Take your time to relax.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I lost my red book.
That is sad. Do you know where you last saw it?
I think it was near the big dog pictures.
Let us go look there together.
Thank you. You are so nice.
I am happy to help. Do you want juice after?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a big box of letters to send!
That sounds like a lot of work. Do you have all the stamps ready?
Yes, I have them all in my pocket.
Good. I do not know where the counter is.
It is right over there by the window.
Thank you for pointing it out. Is the line long today?
No, it is very short right now.
Great. I can walk over there quickly.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: What is the best day to visit a park?
Many people like Saturday for this. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I do. Which day has the most sun?
I do not know that for sure. Is it sunny where you live?
It is sunny today. Do you know what day it is?
I can check the calendar. Do you like weekends?
I love weekends. What should I do on a slow Tuesday?
Reading a book is a nice choice. Do you like stories?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need a helmet?
It keeps your head safe if you fall. Do you have one ready?
Yes, I do. Why do I look in the mirror?
It helps you see what is behind you. Is your mirror clean?
It is clean. Why does the bike wobble at first?
Your muscles need time to learn the balance. Are you feeling steady now?
I think so. Why should I ring the bell?
It warns people that you are coming. Can you hear it well?
I can hear it. Why must I slow down at corners?
I do not know for sure, but it feels safer. Do you feel ready to ride?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today! I saw a big rainbow.
That is wonderful! What color was the rainbow?
It had red, yellow, and blue. I felt warm inside.
That is a great feeling. Do you want to share more?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the baby so small?
Babies start very small to fit through the mother. Is the baby crying right now?
Why does he cry all the time?
Crying tells us what he needs, like milk or a hug. Do you like being near him?
Why is his skin so soft?
Soft skin helps him feel safe and warm. Does it feel nice to touch?
Why does he sleep so much?
Sleeping helps his brain grow big and strong. Do you want to check if he is still asleep?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to eat something sweet.
You like sweets?
Yes, but I also like my pizza.
Pizza is good. Do you like cheese on it?
I want a small pizza with no cheese.
That is a fine choice.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, I am so late for work.
The snow is deep. Is your car warm?
I cannot find my keys. I am freezing.
Try your coat pocket. Do you have a map?
I have it. I must go.
Drive slow on ice. Is your phone full?
Yes. I am going now.
Take care. Do you see the sun?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Which season is it now?
It is fall. Do you see the red leaves?
Yes, I see them. Do I have time for a snack?
Only if you walk fast. Are you hungry?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired today. I walked to the park and chased my dog all afternoon.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did your legs feel heavy after?
Yes, my legs hurt and my eyes are heavy. I just want to rest now.
You must be very sleepy. Good night.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to paint a tree. Do I use green for the leaves?
Yes, green is a good choice. Do you like bright green or dark green?
I like dark green. What color should I use for the trunk?
Brown works well for the trunk.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to say thank you.
You should say it, because it is kind. Do you like giving gifts?
No, I only want to get gifts.
It feels good to give, too. What did you get last week?
A red truck.
That is a fun toy! Do you share it with friends?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very happy to ride the bus today.
That is a great feeling. Is it your first time?
Yes, but I do not know where we go.
I do not know the stop either. Are you looking out the window?
I see a big red truck go by.
That truck looks busy. Do you like watching cars?
I think I forgot my snack bag.
That is a small problem. Do you have another one?
I have a small apple in my pocket.
An apple is a good choice. Have a nice trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with my books.
Put them in your bag. What is your favorite book?
I lost my pencil case.
I do not know where it is. Did you check your desk?
I still do not know what to do.
Let us start with your homework.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I am running late today.
That sounds exciting! What is making you smile?
I found a big shiny rock on my walk!
A shiny rock? That is cool. Is it blue?
No, it is red! It glows in the sun.
Wow! I hope you get to see it soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why is this street so silent?
It feels very still. Do you like the quiet?
No, it makes me feel lonely.
That is a hard feeling. Is it always this empty?
Yes, the stores are closed.
The shops are closed for the day. Do they open soon?
I do not know, and I am sad.
I understand your sadness. Do you want to walk with me?
Maybe that would help.
That is a good idea. Let us go together.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My math homework is hard. I do not know how to start.
That can feel scary. What part makes you stop?
The long numbers confuse me. I get lost in the middle.
Try breaking it into small steps. Do you have a pencil ready?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to start with this mess.
Why not start with the kitchen? Do you like cooking?
The floor is covered in dust and toys.
You can sweep the floor first. Are your shoes clean?
I am too tired to lift the heavy boxes.
I do not know how to carry them for you. Do you have a friend nearby?
The dust on the books looks dirty.
A dry cloth is good for books. What is your favorite book?
I think I can do the rest now.
You can do it. Good luck!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new song today. It makes me feel so happy. Do you like happy songs?
I am glad to hear that. What kind of song is it?
It is about a sun that shines on a green hill. It sounds like birds singing. Is the sun warm there?
I cannot see the hill, but I like the idea. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big promise today.
That sounds exciting. What did you promise to do?
I said I would help my little brother with his homework.
That is a very kind thing to do. Do you think you can do it?
Yes, I really want to keep my word.
Keeping a promise is good for your heart. How did he feel when you said yes?
He was so happy and gave me a hug.
Hugs are a great reward for good work. I am glad you shared this with me.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to throw a party but I am lost.
That is a fun idea. Do you have a theme in mind?
I do not know. What is popular?
I do not know what is popular now. Do you like cake?
Yes, I love cake.
Great. Let us make a cake party. Will you bring music?
Yes, I will play songs.
That sounds good. Have a nice time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big oak tree today. A bird built a nest in it.
That is nice. Do you like the sound of the wind in the leaves?
It feels safe to talk to trees. I hope they listen.
I think they hear you. What is your favorite part of the day?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate an apple with my lunch today. It was sweet. Did you have lunch?
Yes, I did. It was very nice. Did you like the taste of the apple?
I felt happy after eating it. My tummy was full and warm.
That is good for you. It is important to eat good food.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike, but I am scared of falling.
That is very normal. Do you have training wheels on your bike?
No, I took them off because I feel older.
Great start. Do you know how to balance on one wheel?
Not really, I just wobble a lot.
Start by standing over the bike. Can you hop on the seat without moving?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because the walls are crooked and it looks like a pile of trash.
I am sorry it feels this hard right now. Do you have a tool to check if the corners are square?
I tried, but I do not know how to make it straight.
We can step back and look at the corners together. Would you like to try that now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dog is sad and will not eat. What should I do?
That is not good. Is he playing with his toys?
No, he is just lying down. I do not know if he is sick.
I do not know for sure. Please take him to a doctor today.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is there a rainbow in the sky?
It happens when sun and rain mix together. Do you like rain?
Sometimes I do. What colors are in it?
There are seven main colors. Is red your favorite?
I like blue. Why does it look like an arc?
It is shaped by how light bends in the air.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished my favorite book and I feel so happy!
That is wonderful news. What is the story about?
It is about a brave bear who learns to be kind.
A kind bear sounds very nice. Did the bear make any friends?
Yes, the bear made a friend named Pip.
I do not know who Pip is, but that sounds fun. Do you want to buy another copy to keep?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a paper plane fly far?
Fold the wings tight and hold the plane low. Do you like to run?
Yes, I love to run fast.
Run into the wind with an open hand to feel it. Do you feel the push?
Yes, it feels strong.
Then run and throw the plane into that push. That helps it fly.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread is flat and I feel so sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have any warm water?
Yes, I have a cup of warm water.
Add that to the dough and let it rest. Did you check the yeast?
I think I put it in cold.
Cold water can stop the yeast from waking up. I do not know your exact recipe. Do you have fresh yeast?
No, I only have dry yeast.
Dry yeast works well with warm water. You should wait a little bit. Do you want to try again?
Yes, I want to try one more time.
That is a good idea. You can fix this.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make bread rise?
You need to use yeast and warm water. Do you have yeast at home?
Yes, I do.
Put the yeast in the warm water first. Then mix in the flour.
That sounds easy.
It takes time, but it is fun. Do you like sweet bread?
I do.
Add some sugar to the mix. Happy baking!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. I wish I could fly like a bird.
That is okay. Birds have strong wings. Do you like birds?
Yes, but they are so far away. I feel small.
You are not small. You are strong too. Are you hungry?
No, I just want to go outside. It is too quiet.
Quiet is good for thinking. What do you hear?
I hear the wind. It sounds lonely.
The wind is just moving air. It is not lonely.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I looked up at the sky today and saw a very bright star.
That sounds lovely. Did you know its name?
I did not, but it sparkled like a tiny diamond.
How lovely. Did you stay long to look at it?
I sat on the bench until my eyes got tired.
That is a good way to rest. Was the air cool there?
Yes, it felt like a cold hug on my face.
Nature can be very kind. Did you feel happy?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a ticket, but I do not know where to go.
Do you have a map in your hand? Look for the sign that says "Platform 4".
I see a big sign, but the letters are too small for me.
The board ahead will show your train number and time. Are you traveling today or next week?
It is today, and I am very confused.
Go to the waiting area with the blue benches. You will be fine.
The train is coming, but the doors are all closed.
They open when the lights turn green. Do you see the long line of people?
Yes, I see them, but I do not know where to stand.
Just wait near the yellow line on the floor. The doors will open for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the boat float?
Water pushes up to hold it. Do you like water?
Why is it made of wood?
Wood is light and strong. It is a good builder.
Why does it go so fast?
The wind pushes the sails. Do you like wind?
Why is the boat blue?
I do not know.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go fast. Why is the moon so bright?
It shines because it reflects sunlight. Are you going to see it?
Yes, but I am late. Does it move?
Yes, it moves across the sky. Do you like the night?
I do, but I must run. Is it hot?
No, the moon is very cold. Can you hurry?
I am running now. Is it far away?
It is very far away.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why did the sun stop shining? I feel sad.
The clouds are blocking the light for now. Do you see a big cloud outside?
Yes, it is huge. It will not go away.
Clouds move slowly, but they always move. Do you like watching them drift?
I hate being in the dark. It feels cold.
You can put on a warm jacket. Would you like to read a book instead?
Okay, that sounds okay.
I do not know what book you will pick. Tell me your favorite color?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this song anymore. It feels too loud and sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. What part is the hardest to listen to?
The ending makes me want to cry. It feels like something bad is coming.
That is a heavy feeling. Do you have your favorite songs with you?
Yes, I have my happy song here. But it does not help with this one.
Try playing your happy song next. Sometimes a switch helps.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling. Why did I have it?
Sometimes our brains play games when we sleep. Do you like to jump?
I do not know. Why do they do that?
It is true that dreams are hard to explain. We just sort out our day.
My mom said dreams are not real. Is that true?
Yes, you are safe in your bed. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know the words to the song.
That is a hard task. Do you like the song?
I love it, but I forget the words.
I do not know the words. Try to hum it slowly.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this wet ground. My shoes are cold and sad.
That is a real shame. Do you have a dry spot nearby?
No, I do not. The whole park looks like a big puddle.
I am sorry to hear that. I do not know where you are, but I hope it gets better.
It feels like the rain will not stop for a long time.
That can feel very long. Do you want to just wait for a break?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like peaches best.
Peaches are sweet and soft. Do you like them warm or cold?
I like them from the fridge.
Cold peaches taste great. Do you eat the skin?
Yes, I eat the skin.
That is good for you. Do you share any?
I share with my sister.
That is very kind.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the river moving?
The water runs because of gravity. Do you like to watch it?
Why is the water blue?
It reflects the sky above. Is the sky clear today?
Why is it so loud?
The sound comes from the moving water. Do you hear a splash?
Why does it go under the bridge?
The path drops down for the water to flow. Did you see a fish?
Why is the water cold?
I do not know for sure. Do you want to touch it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I keep more money for fun?
Try giving each dollar a job. Do you know what a jar is for?
I use jars for coins, but I mix them up.
Make one jar for saving and one for spending. Put the coins in the right spot each time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I lost my place in the old story.
Do not worry. Did you read about the kings?
I think so, but I forgot what they did.
They built tall walls. Why do you ask?
I want to finish the page.
Start again from the top. It is a good habit.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am packing my bag for the trip.
That is a fun job. What is your first item?
I put my blue shirt in the bag.
Good choice for a cool day. Do you have socks?
Yes, I have two pairs of socks.
Socks are very important. I do not know your shoe size.
I put my sneakers in the bag.
Shoes go in the back usually. Do you pack toys?
I pack my little robot toy.
It will be a good friend on the trip.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to build a shed right now.
That is a big job. Do you have your tools?
Yes, but I am running out of time.
Take a deep breath. Have you checked the ground?
No, I just want to start.
You must dig first.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do. The rain will not stop.
That is sad. Do you have a warm coat on?
Yes, but I want to go outside.
Listen to the sky. Is the thunder loud?
It is loud. I am a little scared.
Then wait inside. Read a book by the fire.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I have to read all these books?
Reading helps your brain grow strong. Do you like stories about animals?
I do, but it takes so much time. Why can't I just watch TV?
Books let you make up new worlds in your head. Do you draw pictures?
Yes, I draw dragons. Why do we have to do math?
Math helps us count things and share fairly. Are you good at counting?
Kind of. Why is homework so hard sometimes?
It is hard because you are learning new skills. Do you want a break?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke my phone.
Oh no, is it cracked?
Yes, the screen is all messed up.
Do you know where you dropped it?
I don't know, I was just playing.
Let us check for big cracks.
Look, here is a big line.
That looks bad, let us get it fixed.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I look at wild animals safely?
Keep a big space between you and them. Do you know where you are going?
Yes, I am in the forest. What if I see a bear?
Stand tall and make noise so it sees you. Are you wearing bright colors?
I wear red. That is good, right?
Yes, bears can see red. Do you have food with you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am scared to ride a bike. I do not know how to start.
That is normal. Do you have a helmet on?
Yes, my mom is holding the seat. I feel shaky.
Good. Look ahead, not at the wheels. Are your hands loose?
My hands are tight. I worry I will fall hard.
Let go a little. A small fall is okay. Do you feel ready to push?
I think so. I will try now.
Nice work. You did it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My nose is very stuffy and I feel bad.
That feels yucky. How long has your nose been stopped up?
For two days. I do not know what to do.
Drink warm water and rest. Do you have a fever?
I feel a little hot. Is that bad?
Please check your temperature. Do you have a thermometer?
Yes, I will check it now. What should I do?
Take something to lower the heat if it is high. Get more sleep.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the stars twinkle in the dark sky?
The air in our sky makes the light shake a bit. Do you see how the water ripples?
Oh, like the water? But why is the night so black?
It is black because the sun is on the other side of Earth. Is it quiet where you sit?
Yes, it is very quiet. Why are some stars bright and others dim?
The bright ones are closer to us, or they are very big. Do some look red to you?
A few do look red. Why do the stars stay in the same spots?
They move, but they are so far away that it is hard to see. Do you know the names of any?
I know Big Dipper. Why do we have a moon?
I do not know the full reason for the moon, but it helps us see at night.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel so happy right now. Why is that?
Your body and mind are in a good place. Do you know what you did today?
I just played outside with my friends. Why does that make me feel this way?
Being with others and moving helps your mind stay calm. Do you play outside often?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to wear to the wedding.
That is a big choice. Do you like bright colors?
I like red, but I am afraid it is too much.
Red is very nice and bold.
What should I pick then?
I do not know your taste, but red sounds fun. Try it on first.
Okay, I will try the red dress.
Good luck with the fitting.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am lost and very scared.
Take a deep breath. Where is the last place you feel safe?
I was just at the big red park bench.
That is a good landmark. Do you see a white tree nearby?
Yes, I see the white tree and a blue car.
Walk to the blue car.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late and I forgot my bag.
Take a deep breath and pick up your shoes. Are you going to the park?
Yes, I need to run outside now.
Put your shoes on first, then grab your jacket. Is the jacket warm enough?
It is very warm, thank you for the help.
You are welcome, I am glad I could help.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the plane need to go up so high?
It flies where the air is thin and clear. Do you like looking out the small window?
Why is my ear so full when we go down?
The air pushes inside your ear, but it feels okay soon. Do you have gum to help you pop it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Today was very hard. I felt tired and sad. What should I do?
I am sorry you feel that way. Have you eaten a good snack?
Yes, I ate an apple. But I still feel bad. Do you know why?
I do not know the exact reason. Did you talk to a friend about it?
No, I am afraid of sharing. Is it okay to just rest?
Yes, rest is good for you. Are you ready to try some sleep?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look! A little blue bird just landed on the branch.
That is a beautiful sight. What is it doing?
I am so happy to see it. Do you know what kind of bird it is?
I am not sure of the exact name. I just see the pretty blue feathers.
It looks like it is listening to me. Isn't that nice?
Yes, nature is always a good friend. Did it sing a song?
Yes, it had a very sweet voice. I love this morning.
I am glad you enjoy the garden. Do you want to sit and watch it for a bit?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to tell you. I just built a new shed!
That is great news! Is the roof done?
Yes, it is fully built and very strong.
I am glad it is safe. Do you have tools to fix it later?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like this song very much. What is it called?
I do not know the name. Do you remember the voice?
The voice is loud and happy. It makes me want to dance.
That sounds fun. Do you sing along with it?
Yes, I sing every word. It is my favorite part.
That is great. Do you play it on a radio?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a hidden box in the attic. I do not know what to do with it.
That sounds like a big secret. What is inside the box?
It has an old letter in it. I am not sure who wrote it.
Who wrote the letter? Do you want to tell me?
I think it is for my mom. I am afraid to give it to her.
Giving the letter might be the right thing. Do you trust your mom?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie a shoe. I tried and failed.
That is okay. Do you have a string to practice with?
Yes, I have a string. How do I start?
Cross the two ends. Make a loop on each side.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am late for my bus, but I also want to learn how to tie my shoes.
Oh no, you are running late. Do you have any free time later to practice?
Yes, I have time after school. How do I start the knots?
Cross the two ends to make an X. Then loop one side over the other to make a loop.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Did people wear hats long ago?
Yes, many people did. Do you like wearing hats?
No, not today. What did people do for work?
Some farmed food and some built houses.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the train?
It is on the left side. Are you going to a new city?
Yes, I have much work. Is it very far?
It takes one hour. Do you have your ticket ready?
No, I forgot it at home. Can I fix this?
You must go to the office. I will wait with you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy about my train trip today!
That sounds great! Where are you going?
I am going to the big city to see the tall buildings.
Oh, that is exciting. Are you scared of the train?
No, I love looking out the window.
I like watching things move too.
The view is very beautiful with the green trees.
Nature is always nice.
It makes me feel so calm and free.
That is a lovely feeling.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to hide a gift for my friend, but I do not know where to put it.
That is a nice idea. Where is your friend likely to look first?
She will check her room and the kitchen.
You could hide it in the garage instead. Do you have a box to cover it?
Yes, I have a big shoe box.
That should work well. Good luck with your secret.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate a red apple today. It was very sweet.
That sounds nice. Was it soft?
Yes, it was soft. I found it near my home.
Lucky you. Do you like apples?
I love them. I want to find more.
I do not know where to look. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I copy a picture to my desk?
Drag it with the mouse and drop it there. Do you like the picture?
Yes, it is a cat. How do I put it back?
Drag it back from the desk to the file. Is the cat fluffy?
Yes, he is very soft.
You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The street is so still. How do I make a quiet sound?
That is a fun idea. Do you like to sing?
I do. How do I sing without being loud?
Just hum in your throat. Do you feel the buzz?
Yes. Can I hum a tune like this?
Please try it now. Is it happy or sad?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My throat hurts bad and I feel very hot.
That sounds like a cold. Is your nose running too?
Yes, it drips all the time.
Drink some warm tea and rest in bed. Feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to grow tomatoes, but I do not know where to start.
You need warm sun and good dirt. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
I have a small box on the porch, but it is in the shade all day.
Tomatoes need lots of light, so that box will not work well. Have you tried growing peas instead?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is warm on my face.
That sounds lovely. Do you like the view?
Yes, the trees are very green.
Green trees are nice.
The bus is moving fast but smooth.
That is a good thing. Is it fun?
I am smiling a lot right now.
Smiling is always good.
I feel very happy inside.
I am glad for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do sailors spend so much time on the boat?
They love the wide open water. Do you like water?
I think so. How do they find their way without getting lost?
They use maps and stars to guide them. Do you know where north is?
I am not sure. Do they ever see fish while they sail?
Yes, they often spot fish near the surface. That is a fun part of the job.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to play Go Fish with you.
That sounds like fun. Do you know how to ask for cards?
Yes, I ask for a card I do not have.
That is true. Are you ready to start?
Yes, I am ready. Can you draw a card?
Sure, here is a four of hearts. What card do you want next?
I need a queen. Do you have a queen?
I do not have a queen right now.
Okay, I will draw one then.
Good luck. I hope you find the queen.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors in it, and the blue parts bounce around the air the most. Do you like looking up?
Yes, but why does it turn red at night?
At sunset, the light travels through more air, so the blue scatters away and leaves red. Have you seen a red sky?
It looks like fire.
That fire look happens when the light path is long. Do you think stars come out after?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Oh no, there is a fire next door. What should I do?
Get out of your house right now. Is everyone safe?
We are outside now. Should we call someone?
Yes, call the fire team. Do you know their number?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do about my teacher.
That sounds hard. What happened?
She is very strict with my homework.
Sometimes rules feel too tight. Do you like her lessons?
Yes, but it takes too much time at home.
I hear your worry. Can you tell her how you feel?
I am afraid she will be mad.
Honesty is brave. Will you try to speak up?
I think I will ask to talk to her.
That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see old art, but I do not know where to start.
The first floor has the oldest paintings. Do you like dark rooms?
Yes, I do. The light is nice there.
That is good. The paintings look best in the dark.
How long will it take to walk there?
It takes about ten minutes. Do you have time to spare?
I have an hour. Is it too busy today?
It is quiet this morning. Please enjoy your walk.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My phone is very hot and makes a loud sound.
Is the screen cracking or showing any lines?
No, but it smells like burnt plastic.
Please turn it off right now and unplug it.
I did, but the sound is still loud.
That is not normal, so please show it to a grown-up.
Okay, I will tell my mom.
That is the smart thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is so hot outside. I do not know what to do.
I like the pool on hot days. Do you have a pool nearby?
No, I do not have a pool. I feel very tired.
Reading a book can help you rest. Do you like stories?
Yes, I like stories, but the sun is bright.
A cool glass of water is also nice. Do you want to try that?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a strange book in the attic. It has no words inside.
That is very curious. Did the pages feel cold to the touch?
Yes, they felt like ice. I am scared to read it now.
You can close it for now. Do you want to keep it in your bag?
I think I will just leave it there. Do you know why it is empty?
I do not know why it is empty. Maybe someone is saving it for later.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go on a trip, but I do not know where to go.
That is fun. Do you like the water or the snow?
I love the warm sun and swimming.
Maybe try the beach. Do you like to build sand castles?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sand warm?
The sun heats it up. Do you like playing in it?
Why does the water pull back?
The waves push it and gravity pulls it. It feels fun, right?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the fire! It is so warm and bright.
That looks cozy. What color is the smoke?
The smoke is gray, but the flames are orange.
Nice. Do you feel safe?
Yes, I am happy to be here with you.
I am happy too. Let us just watch.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so tired and I do not know what to do.
That sounds hard. Are you hungry?
No, I just want to stop thinking for a bit.
It is true that rest helps. Have you tried sitting still?
I tried that but my mind will not stop.
That can be scary. What is your mind doing?
It is just loud and fast.
I do not know how to make it stop. Would a walk help?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the hands on the clock go around?
They move to tell us what time it is. Do you like telling me the time?
Yes! The little one is fast and the big one is slow.
That is right, the little one goes around once a minute. What do you think the biggest one does?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am making bread today. The dough is very soft.
That is good. Do you know why it gets puffy?
My mom said it breathes. It makes tiny holes inside.
Yes, little bugs called yeast make gas. That pushes the dough up.
I put it in a warm box. It grew twice as big.
Warm air helps them work. What shape are you making?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my tree looks sick and brown.
I am sorry to hear that. Have you checked for bugs on the leaves?
I looked, but I do not see any bugs.
I do not know why it looks like that. Do you give it enough water?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like hot tea.
Tea is warm and cozy. Do you like it sweet?
I put in two spoons of sugar.
That is very sweet! Do you have a cat at home?
My cat likes to drink milk.
Cats love warm milk. I do not know if tea helps cats.
I like coffee too, but it is dark.
Coffee is strong and dark. Do you drink it with milk?
I mix them to make it brown.
Brown is a nice color. Is the mix hot?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I win at chess?
You must trap the king. Do you know how the knight moves?
I move it in an L shape.
That is true. Do you like playing online?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a new friend today. He is very kind.
That is great news. What is his name?
I will tell you soon. We played in the park.
The park is a fun place. Did you share your toys?
Yes, we shared everything. I am so happy.
Kindness makes people smile. How did he smile?
He smiled big. Do you want to meet him?
I would like to meet him. When is he coming?
He is coming tomorrow. I am excited.
Tomorrow sounds good. I will wait.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run, but is that the moon?
Yes, that is the moon. Do you like looking at it?
I can't stay to talk. Why is it round?
It looks round because of its shape. Do you think it is lonely?
Stop, I am late. Does it move?
Yes, it moves across the sky. Do you watch it often?
Please be quick. Is it hot there?
It is very hot in the day. Do you want to go there?
No, just a quick word. Is it far?
It is very far away. Do you know how far?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. I must go now.
The bus is right there. Are you going to school?
No, I have a big job.
Good luck. Is it far from here?
I think I lost my bag.
You have it on your back.
Oh. Thank you. Bye.
Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad because my red shirt has a big black mark on it.
That is a bad mark. Did you spill ink on it by chance?
Yes, my pen broke and made a mess everywhere.
Ink is hard to take out. Do you have any soap or water?
I have water, but the wash room is far away.
Walk slowly so you do not trip. Is the door locked tight?
No, the door is open, but I feel too tired to move.
Rest your feet for a bit. Can you lift the shirt for me?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I fixed my broken bike tire today. I did it all by myself.
That is very cool. How did it feel?
It felt really good to do a hard job. I am so proud of my hands.
I am glad you feel proud. Do you want to ride it now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My throat hurts a lot today.
Drink some warm water to help. Are you feeling tired too?
Yes, I feel very sleepy.
Rest is good for you. Have you eaten anything?
I only drank soup.
Soup is a nice choice. Do you have a fever?
I do, it is quite high.
Please see a doctor soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go to the party at Tom's house.
That sounds like fun! What time does it start?
It starts at four o'clock.
Cool. Are you going by car?
No, I am walking there.
Good idea. Did you buy a present?
Yes, I bought a red book.
Nice! Is it for the host?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just painted a big red sun. It makes me feel so happy.
That sounds like a lovely start. What made you choose red?
Red is my favorite color. It feels warm and bright to me.
Warm colors often make people feel good. Did you use brushstrokes or a sponge?
I used a sponge. It made funny little dots on the paper.
Sponges can make very interesting shapes. Do the dots look like stars to you?
Yes, they do! They look like tiny stars around the sun.
That is a sweet idea for your picture. Where are you putting the sky?
I am painting the sky blue now. I want it to look like a deep sea.
A deep blue sky sounds very calm. I do not know if that is a common choice, but it may look unique.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because the lights are bright and the room is warm.
That sounds very nice. Do you like hot tea too?
Yes, I have a full cup of tea and a soft blanket.
That is a wonderful feeling.
I feel safe inside my home today.
I am glad you are safe. Is your dog napping?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is there a rainbow?
Sunlight hits rain drops and splits into colors. Do you like rain?
Yes, but why are there seven colors?
Because light splits into a smooth band of hues.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to ride my bike, but I am scared to fall.
That is a very normal feeling. Do you have your helmet on?
Yes, I do. How do I keep my balance?
Look far ahead, not at the wheels. Do you feel wobbly or shaky?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate Mondays. They are so long and hard.
Mondays can feel heavy, yes. Do you have a lot of work to do today?
Yes, my head hurts from thinking. I just want to sleep.
Rest is good for tired minds. What helps you feel better when you are sad?
Nothing helps. Why do we even have five work days?
I do not know the reason for five days. Is it hard to wait for the weekend?
I guess I can do this. Thank you for listening.
I am always here for you. Have a gentle day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very tired at home. Do you have a way to help me rest?
Yes, close your eyes for a bit. Do you like taking naps?
That sounds good. How long should I sleep?
Keep it short, like twenty minutes. I do not know your exact needs, but that often helps.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the grass so green today?
Rain helped it grow. Do you like the smell of rain?
Yes. Why do birds sing so loud?
They are happy to wake up. Do you hear a specific song?
It sounds like a tune. Why do flowers have different colors?
Bees like different hues. Do you see any bees?
I see one. Why do trees look so tall?
They reach for the sun. Is the sun warm on your face?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look up at the sky. I feel very happy today.
What makes you feel so good?
The clouds are big and puffy like cotton.
They do look soft. Do they taste sweet?
I hope they do. I wish I could hug one.
That is a lovely wish.
I love watching them move across the blue sky.
They move very slowly. Do you think they are tired?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The rain started when I walked to school.
That sounds wet. Did you have an umbrella?
I did not, so I got very wet.
Oh no, that is cold. Are you warm now?
Yes, I am dry and happy inside.
I am glad you are dry. Do you like the rain sound?
I love the sound of it hitting the window.
That is a nice sound. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My cat is not looking the right way. I tried many times but it still looks like a potato. I hate it.
A potato cat is very silly. I do not know how to fix the nose. Did you try drawing a small triangle for the nose?
I tried that but the lines look messy and I feel like a bad artist now. I want to stop.
Messy lines are just practice. You are getting better every day. Do you want to try one more small step?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now. My plane leaves soon.
Oh no. Do you have your ticket?
Yes, it is in my bag. I am running late.
Good luck on your trip.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate that my boss changed the plan at the last minute.
That sounds really hard. Did he give a reason?
No, he just said we had to start early.
I am sorry you are upset. Do you know when we must begin?
Yes, right now, which is not fair.
That is not fair. I can help you get ready.
Please, I am too tired to do this alone.
We will work through it together. Do you want tea?
Yes, please. That helps a lot.
Okay, I will make some.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I love the book about the red kite. What is your favorite color?
I do not have eyes, so I do not have a favorite color. Do you like the kite in your book?
Yes, I like the red kite. Do you read books?
I process lots of words, but I do not read like you do. Is the kite flying high in the story?
The kite flies very high. Is that fun?
It sounds fun to me. What happens to the kite next?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see many dots in the dark sky, but I do not know what to do with them.
That is very nice. Do you have a blanket for keeping warm?
I have a blanket, but I am still not sure if I should count them or just look.
I think just looking is good. Do you like the moon?
Yes, I like the moon, but I do not know what else to do.
I do not know either. Let us just sit and watch them together.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do bees make honey?
They drink sweet plant juice and store it in their bodies. Do you like sweet foods?
Yes, but I must go. They spit it into honeycomb boxes.
The juice dries up in the sun and air. Is your car close?
No, I am walking. They eat the dry sugary liquid.
That is right, and it becomes sticky honey. You should run!
Thanks, but you are too slow. Goodbye.
Safe travels to you. See you later.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the puzzle piece not fit in that spot?
It is the wrong shape. Do you see the line on the edge?
I see a line. Why is there a line there?
The line shows where the curve goes. Is the rest of the piece smooth?
Yes, it is smooth. How do I fix it?
Try turning the piece to the left. Does it feel right now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sun so bright?
It burns with fire to give us light and warmth. Do you like sunny days?
Does the sun get tired at night?
I think it just sleeps when the Earth turns away. Is the moon out now?
Can we see the sun if it is sleeping?
No, you cannot see it while it is asleep. I do not know how it dreams, though.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to paint my cat today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you use blue or red?
I used blue, but it looked like a fish.
Oh no, that is a funny mistake. Do you have a new blue brush?
Yes, I bought a big one.
A big brush makes big splashes. Did the cat let you paint near it?
No, he ran away very fast.
Cats often do that. It is nice that you tried again.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love riding my bike today! The wind feels so nice.
That sounds like a lot of fun. How fast are you going?
Fast enough to feel like I am flying!
I am glad you enjoy it. Do you wear a helmet?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I fixed my computer today.
That is great news. Did it stop making loud noises?
Yes, it is very quiet now.
I am happy for you. Does it work fast?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big oak tree by the park this morning.
That sounds nice. Did you sit under it?
I did, and it was very quiet there.
Trees are good listeners. Do you like that spot?
Yes, I like to watch the leaves fall.
Falling leaves are pretty. Do you pick them up?
Sometimes, I keep a few in my pocket.
That is a sweet habit. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the library today to find a blue book about a cat.
That sounds like a fun search. Did you find the cat book?
I found it, but I also met a lady who wanted to read it first.
You were very kind to let her have it. What will you read next?
I am going to wait a week for my turn, so I picked a book about frogs.
Frogs are great animals. Do you like jumping?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost in this new town.
Do you want to walk?
I do not know where to go.
The park is nice. Do you like trees?
Yes, I do.
Let us walk that way.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run, but I want to try again.
Good luck. Do you have a plan?
I am going too fast to think.
Slow down. What is the hardest part?
I forgot how to do the second step.
I do not know your specific steps. Can you remember?
I can check it if I have time.
That sounds like a good start. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am lost, but I am happy!
That is a good feeling. What is in front of you?
There is a big red bridge.
That helps. Do you see any people?
Yes, I see a dog!
Dogs are friends. Is the dog friendly?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like the big blue books with pictures.
Those are fun to read. Do you like stories about animals?
Yes, I love the lion book.
That is a great pick. Is the book on this shelf or that one?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel sick but I do not know if I need to go to the doctor.
That feels bad. What part of your body hurts?
My head hurts and my tummy feels cold.
I do not know for sure. Have you eaten anything weird today?
I ate some old pizza last night.
That might be the cause. Did you feel better after a nap?
Not really, I still feel weak.
Please go see a doctor. It is best to be safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is my old friend Sam?
I do not know. Is he still by the park?
No, he went to the school.
Maybe he is there. Do you have his phone number?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My teacher made me clean the whole classroom because I dropped a pencil.
That feels unfair. Did you get to play outside?
Yes, I did. It was a nice day.
That is good to hear. Did you feel better after playing?
I did. But I am still tired from cleaning.
Rest is important. How is your body feeling now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a block that is round on top. What do I do with it?
That sounds like a dome. What do you want to build?
I just want to make a house, but I am stuck.
You can put it on the roof. Do you have a square base ready?
Yes, I have the square. Does the circle go on the side?
You can try that, or keep it on top. Which one feels right to you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am writing a tale about a lost cat. Where should it go?
Try a dark forest. Does the cat have a special friend?
No, it is all alone. It feels very sad.
That makes the story deeper. Have you thought of a kind stranger?
Yes, an old man with a warm coat. He finds the cat.
That is a nice turn. What does the man do next?
He gives the cat a home. I feel happy now.
Great job on your story.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to keep more of my coins. What should I do first?
Put all your coins in a jar on your desk. Do you have a jar yet?
I have a cup, but it is not a jar. Is that okay?
A cup works fine. Start with small things like skipping one snack a week.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to give my teacher.
That is a nice thought. What does she like to eat?
I think she likes apples, but I am not sure.
Apples are sweet and safe. Do you have any at home?
Yes, I have two red ones in the fridge.
You can bring one for her. Would you like help wrapping it in paper?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy that bees make honey.
They do! Do you like the taste?
Yes, it is sweet and yummy.
They get it from flowers. Is your favorite flower red?
No, I like yellow ones best.
That is a good choice. Do you know where they store it?
I think it is in a hive.
Yes, they keep it safe there. Do you like sweet snacks?
Yes, I do.
That is fun to know.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see small birds in my yard. Do you know what they are?
They look like finches. Do you feed them?
I tried some bread. Is that good for them?
No, bread is not healthy. Do they like seeds?
I will try seeds. How do I stop squirrels from eating them?
You can use a cage feeder. Do you have a tree nearby?
Yes, there is a big oak. Where do the birds sleep at night?
I do not know for sure. Do you see them leaving?
Yes, they fly to the top branches. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. I hope you see them again.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the lake today. The sun was very warm.
That sounds like a nice place to sit. Did you catch any fish?
I caught a small silver one. It jumped right out of the water.
Oh, that is exciting. Did you keep the fish?
I put it back because it was too small. I just wanted to watch it swim.
That is a kind thing to do. Do you plan to go back next week?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very sad today. I want to learn how to grow a plant to help me feel better.
That is a lovely idea. Green things can lift your spirits. Do you have a small pot?
Yes, I do. How do I put the seeds in the dirt?
Dig a tiny hole first. Then drop the seed in and cover it with soft dirt. Do you have a watering can?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love apples, but I must run.
Apples are sweet and red. Do you like them soft or hard?
Soft, please, but I am late.
That is a good choice. Have a nice day.
Thanks, I will.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my cup. What should I do?
I am sorry to hear that. Did you clean up the sharp bits?
Yes, I swept it all away. I feel very sad.
It is okay to feel sad. Do you have another cup at home?
I have a mug, but I wanted the cup. How can I fix it?
I do not know how to fix broken glass. Do you want to draw a new cup instead?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am lost. I do not know where the big room is.
It is on the first floor. Do you have a map?
No, I do not have a map. Can you help me?
I can walk with you. Would you like that?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at my fish. It is so happy.
It looks very happy. Does it jump?
Yes, it jumps every day. I love watching it.
That is a nice trick. What does it eat?
It eats tiny flakes. It is my best friend.
Friends are good. Is it a big fish?
No, it is small. But it is very bold.
A bold small fish. Where do you keep it?
In a blue tank. It is my favorite spot.
A blue tank sounds cool. Do you talk to it?
I sing to it every night. It swings its tail.
Singing is a sweet way to say goodnight.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to ride the bus, but I am scared.
Riding the bus is fun and safe. Do you have your ticket ready?
I do not know how to get the ticket.
You can buy it at the station or on the app. Do you like using phones?
How do I sit on the bus when I get on?
Find a seat and sit down comfortably.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad because I failed my history test. The dates were too hard to remember.
That is a very tough part of history. Do you like learning about old stories more?
Yes, I like the stories, but I hate the dates. I just want to know what actually happened.
Knowing the story is the most important thing. Do you want to talk about your favorite part?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I carried all my books in one box. My back hurts now.
That is a heavy load. Do you have a bed to sit on?
Yes, but I am tired. I just want to rest.
Rest is good. Do you like your new room?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue bird in the museum today.
That sounds like a lovely find. Did you touch the glass?
No, it was behind a screen, but it was very shiny.
Shiny things are always fun to look at. Was the room quiet there?
Yes, it was so quiet you could hear the fans hum.
I imagine that must be a peaceful place to stand.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How does a clock move?
Inside, a tiny machine pushes the hands forward. Do you like to see how it works?
Yes, but why does it always keep time?
A spring pushes it with steady force.
What is that spring made of?
It is usually made of strong metal. Have you ever heard the tick sound?
I have, it is so loud.
The loud sound helps you hear the time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big red boat. Is it sleeping?
Boats do not sleep, but they rest when calm. Do you like boats?
No, I like the fish. Where do they live?
Fish live in the deep water below the harbor. Do you know how to swim?
Yes, but I am small. Is the water safe?
The water near the pier is usually safe for little swimmers. Are you wearing your floaties?
Yes, I have red ones. Why is the water blue?
The water looks blue because it is deep and clear. I do not know why it is that blue exactly.
I want to go in. Can I go now?
You must ask your parents first before you jump in. Are you hungry?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why is the light dead?
Did you check if the switch is on?
I did. It is still dark.
You can borrow my power strip to test your phone. Is the cord plugged in?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My tent is wet and the food is cold.
I am sorry you are having a hard day. Did you pack a change of clothes?
I forgot my dry socks. I want to go home now.
That feels bad, but the fire will warm you up. Is the fire wood still dry?
Yes, the wood is dry, but my feet hurt.
A hot drink will help your feet feel better soon. Do you have a mug?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am turning five today.
That is very exciting. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, I do.
Blue is a happy color. What is your favorite food?
I love ice cream.
Ice cream is sweet and cold. Do you have a cake?
Yes, my mom made one.
That is wonderful. Have a very good day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am scared of my new job. What should I do?
It is normal to feel scared. What worries you the most?
I do not know how to talk to people.
Just say hello and be kind. Do you have a friend there?
No, everyone looks busy. I feel alone.
I do not know them, but I am here. Can I sit with you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want a big birthday party but I have little money. What can I do?
A small party with just your best friends is very nice. Do you like to cook?
I can make cookies, but I am not sure what else to do.
You can play simple games in the garden. Who is coming?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is it going to rain today?
I do not know for sure. Do you like rain?
Yes, I do!
That is nice. Is the sun out now?
Yes, the sun is out.
That is good news. Are you happy?
I am very happy!
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I promised my cat I would bring home a fish for dinner today.
That sounds like a nice surprise. Did you see any fish at the market?
No, the tank was empty, so I bought a big salmon instead.
Oh, that is a great change. The cat must be very excited.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy at the beach today.
That sounds like a great day. What is your favorite part?
The warm sand under my feet feels like a hug.
I understand why that feels so good. Do you like the sound of the waves?
The waves are like a song playing all day.
Nature has many sounds to listen to. Is it very windy?
The wind is soft and blows through my hair.
That must feel very refreshing.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat on a bench by the park all morning. I waited for my friend to come back from the store.
That took a long time. Did you see any birds while you waited?
Yes, I saw a big blue bird and some small ants. They were busy, so I felt okay about the waiting.
That is a nice way to pass the time. Did you finally get your friend?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is that a big dog?
No, that is a horse. Do you like animals?
What does it eat?
It eats grass and hay. Do you have a pet?
How fast can it run?
It can run very fast. I do not know the exact speed.
Can I ride it?
Yes, if you are safe. Are you afraid of big animals?
It is so pretty.
Yes, it is beautiful. Would you like to say hello?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know about sailors now. I am late for work.
Sailors work on big boats. Do you like the sea?
I do not have time to talk. Just tell me what they do.
They steer the ship and find their way. Is your boat nearby?
No, I am on land. What is a crew?
A crew is a group of sailors who help each other. Are you going to sea?
No, I just need this answer. I must go.
I am glad I could help. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how bees make honey. It feels hard to explain.
They take sweet plant nectar and put it in small pots. Do you want to guess what they do next?
I think they just eat it right away. I am not sure.
Not quite. They fan air over it to dry it out until it turns thick and sweet. I hope that helps you understand.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a small red boat.
That sounds fun. Do you take it to the lake?
Yes, I play in the waves.
That is nice. Are the waves big or small?
They are very small.
Good, that is safe. Do you wear a life vest?
Yes, I always wear it.
You are smart. Have you seen any fish?
I saw one big fish today.
Cool. What color was it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do bees make honey?
They store it to eat in winter. Do you like sweet food?
I do. How do they make it?
They squeeze juice from flowers. Is that what you expected?
I guessed that. Where do they keep it?
They store it in small wax cells. Can you find a beehive nearby?
I do not know where.
That is okay. I do not know your exact location either.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I have a bad night. How do I sleep well?
Try keeping your room dark and cool. Do you use a screen before bed?
Yes, I watch videos late.
Please stop using screens one hour before sleep. Is it hard to rest your eyes?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very late for school today.
Oh no, that is bad. Did you fall asleep?
Yes, I woke up late and my socks were missing.
I am sorry to hear that. Can you find them now?
I found one, but the other is under the bed.
That is a good start. What does the other sock look like?
It is blue with small white stars on it.
That sounds like a nice sock.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a tall block tower.
That sounds like fun. Do you have the blocks?
Yes, I have red, blue, and green ones.
Great start. Which color do you want on the bottom?
I think blue should be first.
Blue is a strong base. Do you have enough blocks to make it very tall?
I have many, but I might run out soon.
Let us check your box. I will help you count them.
Here are ten more here.
I can count ten. Are you ready to place the first one?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tripped on the cord of my fan today. It is still on the desk.
Oh no. Did you get hurt? Please unplug it before you touch it.
No, I am fine. I put the plug in the wall to make it spin.
That is good. Do you always check the switch before using the fan?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. This math work is too hard for me.
I hear you. It can feel big when you are tired. What part is the trickiest?
The long number parts. My brain feels fuzzy.
That sounds heavy. Take a deep breath with me?
I tried, but I still feel stuck. Is there a way to stop?
I cannot make the work vanish, but I can help you break it down. Do you want to try one small step together?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a jar for my shiny rocks.
That sounds fun. Do you like the smooth ones?
I have a box for my toys.
I am glad you keep them safe.
I have a bag for my leaves.
I do not know where you found them.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need to teach my cat to use the box.
You can put her in the box after she eats. What kind of litter do you use?
It is the soft, white stuff.
That works well. Always keep the box very clean.
How often do I have to clean it?
You should scoop it every day. Do you have a small rake for it?
No, I only have a big shovel.
A small scoop is better for your hand.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a blank paper and I do not know what to draw.
That can feel scary. What color do you like best?
I like blue, but my hand feels shaky.
That is very normal. Try drawing a big circle first.
A circle? I am not sure if I can do that well.
You will learn by trying. Do you have a blue crayon?
Yes, I have a blue crayon and a red one too.
Start with the circle. Does your heart feel happy now?
A little bit, yes. I feel less worried.
Good for you. Just keep going.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My phone is gone and I am late.
Check your pocket first. Is it in your pocket?
No. I do not see it.
Did you leave it in the car?
Yes, I think so.
You should go check it now. Do you have your keys?
I have my keys here.
Good. Run to the car.
Found it. Thank you.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is there smoke from the house?
I am not sure why. Are you seeing any flames?
I see a big orange flash. Is it the kitchen?
It looks like the kitchen. Do you smell something burning?
Yes, it smells like toast. Why does the fire start at night?
People often cook then. Is everyone safe inside?
No, I am outside. Why is no one coming to help?
I do not know. Please call for help now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the big boat stay up on the water?
The boat pushes water down, and the water pushes the boat up. Do you have a toy boat to try it?
It feels like it is sinking sometimes.
It sinks if too much heavy stuff makes it push down harder than the water pushes up.
But the water is so wet and cold.
The water holds the boat up because it is thick and hard to push out of the way.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a camera, but I do not know what to take a picture of.
That is a hard choice. What do you like to look at outside?
I like the park, but it looks too plain to me.
Look for bright spots, like a red flower. Do you see any?
Yes, there are red flowers by the bench.
That is a good spot to start. Would you like to sit there?
I am not sure if the light is good enough.
I do not know what the light looks like from where you are. Is it sunny or cloudy?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I live in a new town. It is very quiet.
That sounds peaceful. Do you like the silence?
Mostly. But I miss my old friends.
It can feel lonely. Have you met anyone new?
I met a cat. It was gray.
A gray cat is a good friend. Does it play with you?
Yes, it chases balls. It is fun.
I am glad you are happy. What is your favorite part of the town?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does my magnet stick to the fridge but not the wall?
The fridge has metal, which magnets love. The wall is just paint and brick. Do you have other toys that use magnets?
What is inside a magnet that makes it stick?
Tiny parts inside point all in one way, which makes the pull. I do not know exactly what happens to each tiny part. Do you like to build with blocks?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to take a good picture.
Is the light bright or dim where you stand?
It is very bright, but the photo looks dark.
You can try to lower the exposure. Do you see a sun icon on the screen?
Yes, I see it. What should I do now?
Tap the sun and drag the bar down. It should help.
Oh, that works. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Enjoy your photos.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like to play the guitar but I am stuck. What should I do?
Try to play one song very slowly first. Do you have a song you love?
Yes, I love one song. But my hands get tired. How can I make them stronger?
Rest your hands when they hurt. Do you practice every day?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to brush my horse. Do I just use the brush?
Yes, start with the body first. What kind of horse do you have?
It is a big brown one. Can I use a hard brush on its legs?
Please use a soft brush for the legs. Do you know how to hold the brush?
I think so, but I am not sure. How do I hold it?
Hold the handle like a pencil. Do you feel ready to try?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big plan today and I am so happy to share it with you.
That sounds like a great start! What is the very first step?
First, I will draw a map of my backyard.
A map is a smart idea. Do you have pencils ready?
Yes, I have all my colors and I am ready to begin.
That is wonderful. Let us do this.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I save my picture?
You press the save button. Do you see it?
I see it. What if I made a mistake?
Press the undo button to fix it. Does that help?
Yes, that fixed it. Thank you.
You are welcome. I am glad it works.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does it rain?
Water goes up, cools down, and comes back down as drops. Do you like puddles?
Yes, I love them.
Puddles are fun for a quick jump.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make pasta for dinner. How do I cook it?
Put the pasta in boiling water with salt. Do you have any sauce ready?
No, I do not have sauce. What can I make?
Try butter and garlic. It is easy and tastes good. Do you like cheese?
Yes, I love cheese. Should I add it?
Yes, add it right before serving. It makes the food warm and creamy. Is that simple enough?
Yes, that sounds good. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have a nice meal.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to paint a big blue sky.
That sounds nice. What brush are you using?
I have a small, stiff one.
A small brush works well for details. Have you mixed your blue?
Yes, but it looks a bit dark.
Add a drop of white to make it brighter. Do you have white paint nearby?
Yes, it is in my box.
Great. Dip your brush lightly. Are you excited to start?
Yes, I hope it looks good.
You will do fine. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a fun skill to learn. Do you have your shoes with you?
Yes, I have them right here.
First, you make one big loop.
Okay, I made the first loop.
Great job. Now make a second loop.
I made the second loop too.
Now you cross them over each other.
I crossed them over.
Excellent. Then you pull the ends tight.
I pulled them tight.
You did it!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My head hurts. I am very happy to tell you.
I am sorry you have a hurt. Do you have a headache or a bump?
It hurts when I look at things. I like to talk about it.
That sounds tiring. I do not know why it hurts, but I will listen.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad about my tests.
That feels bad. What part worries you most?
I am afraid I will fail.
Failing helps you learn. Do you ask for help on hard work?
I usually try alone.
Asking for help is smart. Would you like tips on studying?
Yes, please tell me.
Start with short study times. Do you like music while you read?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: What is going on?
Plants take in water through their roots. Do you have a favorite plant?
I am late for work.
It uses tiny tubes called xylem to move water up to the leaves. Are you going to be okay?
Just tell me quickly.
Sunlight helps pull the water up through the plant.
Why does it need the sun?
I am not sure exactly why the sun pulls it up, but it helps the plant grow.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: There is a small bird in the tree. What should I do?
Look at its eyes. Is it moving?
Yes, it is looking around.
That is good. Let it go on its own.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I heard a song that makes me feel so good.
That is nice. What kind of music is it?
It is a pop song with a loud drum.
Loud drums can be fun. Do you dance when you hear it?
Yes, I always move my feet.
I like that. I do not know much about pop music, but I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at the big light on the rock. I do not know what to do next.
It looks like it is time to go inside. Do you have a map with you?
I do not have a map. I just want to see how the light moves.
You can watch it from the grass. Is the door open?
The door is open, but I am afraid of the dark inside.
That is okay to feel. Do you want me to stay with you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I live on a small island.
That sounds fun. Do you like to swim?
Yes, the water is warm.
I do not know if your island has animals. Do you see any birds?
I see many seagulls.
Seagulls are nice birds. I am glad you have friends there.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my old friend today at the park.
That sounds very nice. Did you say hello to them?
Yes, we walked by the big lake together.
I do not know what you talked about.
We just laughed at a funny duck.
A duck can be quite silly.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a sore throat and I feel very cold. What should I do to get better?
Drink warm water and rest in bed. Do you have a fever?
No, I do not feel hot. My nose is just running a lot.
That is normal. Breathe through your mouth if your nose is blocked. Is it still clogged?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just heard a tale about a dragon who loves to bake pies.
That sounds sweet and fun. Is the dragon a good baker?
Yes, he makes the fluffiest crusts I have ever seen.
Wow, I bet they taste amazing. Do people come from far away to buy them?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a burger now, please. I am late.
A burger is coming. Do you want fries with it?
Yes, and make it quick.
I will rush it out. Do you need a drink?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a boat from a plastic bottle. Can you help me?
Yes, cut the top off first. Do you have a sharp knife?
