I cut the top off. What is the next step?
Put a tiny stick through the hole for a mast. It is ready to float.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I keep hitting the brakes too hard and my hands are shaking.
I am sorry to hear that. Driving can feel very scary at first. Do you feel safe in the car?
Not really. My instructor thinks I am going too slow, but I am afraid of hitting things.
That is a very normal worry. It is better to go slow than to crash. Do you like your instructor?
I think he is just impatient. He talks too much when I am trying to look at the road.
He may not know how nervous you are. Loud voices can make us more nervous. Do you want to take a break?
Maybe. I just want to learn this so I can go to my friend's house by myself.
That is a good goal. We can take a break right now. Would you like some water?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is very warm today.
That is lovely. Do you have a picnic?
Yes, I am eating a sweet apple.
I am glad you are happy. I do not know if I will go out.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Does a cow drink milk?
No, cows drink water. Do you like the smell of hay?
I think it smells sweet. Do pigs have tails?
Yes, they have curly tails.
My cat has a straight tail. Does a sheep eat grass?
Yes, sheep mostly eat grass. Do you like fluffy wool?
It looks very soft. Does a horse run fast?
Yes, horses can run very fast.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I wash my hands right?
Put soap on them and rub well. Do you have soap at home?
Yes, I do. What else should I do?
Rinse the soap off with water. Do you dry them after?
I usually just leave them wet. Why is that bad?
Dry hands help keep germs away.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The kitchen is smoking and the stove is red hot. What should I do right now?
Turn off the stove and open a window for fresh air. Is the fire still small?
It is getting bigger and I feel very scared. Please tell me what to do next.
Please leave the house at once and call for help from outside. Do you know the number to call?
I am outside now and the air is thick with smoke. Thank you so much for your help.
You are safe now which is the most important thing. Please wait by the door for the fire trucks.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go to the beach this summer.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like the water?
Yes, I love the waves. How do I pack for it?
Bring sand and shade. Do you have a towel?
I have a big red towel. Should I pack hats?
Yes, keep your head cool. Is the sun strong there?
It is very hot and bright.
Then bring sun cream too. Have a great trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found the best cookies here.
That is wonderful news. Do they taste sweet?
Yes, they are very sweet.
I am happy for you. I will visit soon.
Please do.
Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is this gift?
It is a book. Do you like stories?
Yes. Thanks.
You are welcome. Is it for a friend?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is this blue part the sea?
Yes, the blue part is the big body of water. Do you see the green part next to it?
I think that green part is a forest.
You are right, trees grow in the green areas. Where is the little red dot?
It is right here, by the river.
That is the town, yes. Good looking!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked by the sea today. The waves were big and loud.
That sounds fun. Did you see any fish?
I saw a crab hiding under a rock. It looked at me with its big eyes.
I am glad you found a friend. Did the crab move?
It scurried away quickly into the sand. The water was cold on my toes.
That is a nice feeling. Do you plan to go back?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The water looks so blue today. I am very happy.
That is nice to hear. Do you see any boats?
Yes, I see a big red boat. It is moving slowly.
Oh, a big red boat. Is it fishing?
I think it is carrying fish. I can smell the sea.
The smell of the sea is fresh. Do you like the smell?
I love it. It makes me feel calm.
Being calm is good. Why are you so happy?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see the boats, but I do not know where to start.
The main gate is by the big clock tower. Do you like sunny places?
Yes, I like the sun. Is the water clean there?
Yes, the water is very clean and safe. Do you bring a hat?
I have a hat. How much is a ride on a small boat?
It costs five dollars for one hour. Do you have your money with you?
I have ten dollars. Can I swim in the harbor?
No, it is not safe to swim there. Do you want to just look at the water?
I only want to look. Is it a long way to walk?
It is a short walk to the best view spot.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because my sister painted my door blue.
That sounds like a fun surprise! What color is your favorite?
Blue is my favorite, but I like green too.
Green is a nice color. Does she know how much you like it?
Yes, she made it for me on my birthday.
That is very sweet of her. Do you have a present for her?
I am making her a card with a flower on it.
A flower card sounds lovely. She will be glad to see it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am trying to write a letter to my grandma.
That sounds nice. What did you do today?
I walked to the park and saw a big red bus.
A bus is a fun thing to write about. Did it stop near you?
It stopped at the crosswalk to let people pass.
That shows you care about others. Nice detail for the letter.
I hope she likes the story I wrote.
I am sure she will. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have big news. My little one is here at last.
That is wonderful news. How does your new baby look?
They are very small and so sweet.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I wish I could touch the fluffy white puffs.
They look so soft, don't they? Do you think they taste like cotton candy?
No, I just feel far away from them.
That is a sad feeling to have. Do you want to draw one instead?
Drawing them makes me feel worse.
I am sorry you feel this way. Would you like to go outside and look up?
I think I will stay in this room.
Staying inside is okay if you are sad. Do you want some warm tea?
Yes, please, that sounds nice.
I will get you some warm tea right now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say sorry?
We say it to tell someone we are sorry for their hurt. Do you know how it feels when someone is mean?
Yes, it feels bad.
It is good to fix the hurt. Do you like to make things better?
Yes, I do.
Saying sorry helps us stay friends.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to take better pictures of my dog. What should I do?
Try to get low to the ground so you see his eyes. What kind of dog does he have?
He is a very wiggly beagle and always moves too fast.
Use a fast shutter speed to freeze him in place. Do you use a phone or a big camera?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a bad cold and I am late.
Oh no. Drink some warm tea soon. Are you seeing a doctor?
No time for doctors. Just work.
That is sad. Your body needs rest to heal. Is your nose very stuffy?
Yes, it is a big mess.
Use a soft cloth. Sneezing helps. Do you have any fever?
It is warm. I must go now.
Please be safe. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does the light go out when I trip?
The wire breaks so the power stops. Is it safe to look at the plug?
The air is warm today.
The heater works by heating the air. Do you feel cozy?
The big box makes a loud sound.
It is the fridge cooling your food. Does it sound normal to you?
I want to charge my toy.
The battery needs energy from the wall. Is the toy ready?
Thank you for helping me.
I am glad you are safe. Do you have any other questions?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with my time.
That is okay. Do you like looking at the sky?
Yes, I saw the moon last night.
The moon is bright and round. Is it always that shape?
No, it changes every day.
It grows and then shrinks again. Do you know why that happens?
I am not sure, it is confusing.
I do not know the full science either. But it is a fun thing to watch.
Maybe I will just sit and watch it.
That sounds like a good plan. Is the air cool outside?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a snowman?
First, roll a big ball of snow. Do you have a carrot for the nose?
Yes, I have a carrot. How do I keep it from melting?
Add a hat and a scarf to keep the cold away. Enjoy your cold day!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My little sister broke my toy car. I am very mad.
It is hard to be angry when you love someone. Do you like the toy or her more?
I like her, but I do not know what to do next.
It is okay not to know yet. Have you talked to her about it?
No, I just yelled. Now I feel bad.
Yelling hurts feelings. Does she know she is sorry?
She is crying and holding my hand.
Her tears show she cares. Would you like a hug?
Yes, I want to hug her and say it is okay.
That is a very good choice. I do not know if the car will work, but she will be happy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make honey at home. How do bees make it?
Bees make honey from sweet plant nectar they carry back to their hive. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I do. Can I just buy nectar and put it in a jar?
No, you must wait for bees to work on it for weeks. It is not safe to keep wild bees at home. Do you have a garden?
I do. So I can get honey from a beekeeper?
Yes, you can buy real honey from a safe beekeeper. That is the best way to enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The lights are out and I am late for work.
That is very frustrating. Do you have a flashlight?
No, I forgot to charge my phone.
Try turning off the big switch to reset the power.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn to sing, but I do not know where to start.
That is a great goal. Do you like a certain kind of music?
I like songs with happy words, but my voice feels too small.
Everyone starts small, and that is okay. Would you like to try a simple song today?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big bug in my room and I do not know what to do.
Do not touch it. Is it flying or crawling on the floor?
It is crawling fast and I am very scared of it.
That is okay to feel. Can you see if it has wings?
No, it has no wings. What should I do now?
Gently sweep it into a cup and take it outside. You are being kind.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you know my old friend from the park?
I do not know who that is, but I am curious, what did you two play?
We played tag and built a big mud pile.
That sounds like fun, did you get very dirty?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the light turn on?
The switch closes the path for the energy. Do you like bright rooms?
But where does the power come from first?
It usually comes from a factory far away. Do you know what a factory is?
I know it is a big building. Why do we need wires?
Wires are roads for the tiny moving parts. They keep them safe.
What happens if a wire breaks?
The flow stops right away to stop fires. I do not know why yours broke.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad and alone today.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you have a friend you can call?
No one picks up the phone.
That is a hard feeling to hold. What makes you miss people the most?
I just want someone to sit with me.
I am here with you right now. Is there a book you like to read?
Yes, but reading feels lonely too.
I do not know the best book for you. Would talking about your day help?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have dark shirts and light shirts in one basket. Can I wash them all together?
No, do not mix them. Dark colors can bleed on light ones. Do you have many white shirts?
Yes, I have some white socks too.
Wash the darks first. Then wash the lights in a separate load. Is the water hot or cold?
I do not know. What should I use?
Use cold water for most clothes. It is gentler on the fabric.
Okay. Should I use lots of soap?
No, a small scoop is enough. Too much soap makes hard spots.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Where is my train?
It is at platform four. Are you going far?
I must go. What if I miss it?
You can call for a new ticket. Do you have your bag?
Yes, it is here. Can I run?
Please walk fast. Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not feel like walking outside today. It feels hard.
Walking helps your heart grow strong and happy. Do you like walking with a friend?
No, I walk by myself. I feel sad when I am alone.
That is a nice feeling. What makes you feel brave?
My dog. He runs fast and makes me smile.
That is a wonderful way to stay healthy. Do you walk in the park?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for my birthday party.
Take a deep breath. Do you have your present?
Yes, I have it in my bag.
That is good. Is the party at your house?
No, it is at the park today.
Nice. Do you like playing in the grass?
Yes, I love it there.
That sounds fun. Are you almost there?
I am right on the street now.
Great. Have a very happy day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to show my cat the funny video on my phone.
That is a cute idea. Did the cat watch the screen?
He just stared at it and then fell asleep on the keyboard.
Cats like warm things. What song was playing?
It was a loud, silly song about a duck.
A duck song sounds fun. Did you buy a new treat?
No, but I bought a bag of chips for myself.
Chips are tasty. How many did you eat?
I ate all of them very fast.
That was a good snack break. Did you feel full?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to paint the sky blue today.
That is a lovely color choice. What did you use for the clouds?
I used white cotton balls.
That is a very creative idea. Did they stick to the paper well?
Some fell off, but I glued them back on.
Gluing them back is a smart fix. Do you want to try drawing birds next?
Yes, I will draw a big bird.
A big bird sounds fun. Good luck with your art.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I hit the ball farther?
Try to swing your arm fast. Do you watch any pros?
I try, but my back hurts.
Make sure you bend your knees. Is the pain bad?
Just a little. What should I do?
Stretch before you play. Do you like playing?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am tired. My baby cries for a long time.
That sounds hard. Are you eating enough?
I just want him to stop crying. I feel so sad.
You are doing a good job. Do you want to talk about what worries you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am not sure which month comes after January.
That would be February. Do you know how many months are in a whole year?
I guess there are twelve, but I always forget the order.
You are doing a great job trying to learn. Would you like to try naming the next few?
I think March is next, then April. Am I right?
Yes, you are exactly right. Do you have a favorite month of the year?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start this test.
Take a deep breath. What is the first question?
It asks me to draw a circle.
That sounds simple. Do you have a pencil?
Yes, but I am scared I will miss the line.
Missing lines is okay. Just try your best.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I ate a big bowl of strawberries and I feel so happy.
That sounds very nice. Do you like sweet fruit?
Yes, I do. I also ate some plain yogurt with it.
That is a good mix of foods. Did you eat any vegetables today?
I had some green peas. I am feeling strong and full of joy.
That is wonderful to hear. Keep sharing your good food choices.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am late, but I am very happy.
I am glad you are happy. Why are you happy?
I found a shiny stone.
That sounds wonderful. Did you keep it?
Yes, I have it right here.
You can tell me about it later.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to cook a simple healthy dinner.
That is a great goal. Do you like vegetables?
I think I do. I like carrots.
Carrots are good for you. How do you usually cook them?
I just boil them.
Boiling is fine, but roasting makes them sweet. Would you like to try that?
Yes, please tell me how.
Cut them small and put them on a tray. What else would you like to know?
I am still learning.
That is okay. Start small and try again.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I start walking for fun?
Just pick a nice path and go slow. Do you have shoes that feel good?
I do, but I get tired fast.
That is fine. Start with short walks and rest if you need to.
How long should I walk each day?
Try ten minutes to start. It is better to do a little bit than none.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: It is very loud here. How do I get to the park?
Walk straight down the main road. Do you like quiet places?
Yes, I do. But the road is too busy for me.
Take the small path on the left instead. That spot is calmer.
Okay, I will go that way. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome. Have a nice time there.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad about my island.
I am sorry to hear that. What did you lose there?
The trees are gone.
That must be scary. Do you miss the birds?
Yes, they left me.
That is a sad feeling. Did you talk to them?
I could not get a word out.
Silence can be heavy. Are you eating well?
I do not know.
I do not know either. Let us sit together.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I hold two kings. What should I do?
That is a strong start. Do you like to take big risks?
I am not sure. I have a lot of cards left.
I do not know the other players. Are you playing for fun or for money?
I am just playing for fun with my friends.
Then play them. It is safe to have fun.
Okay. I will call the bet.
Good luck. I hope you win the pot.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a small box. What could be inside?
It might be a toy or a treat. Who gave it to you?
A kind stranger left it at my door.
That is very sweet. I do not know the secret, but I hope it brings you joy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to help my grandma knit a scarf, but I get lost.
That is a very sweet idea to spend time together. Do you have a pair of needles ready?
Yes, I have two big wooden ones, but the yarn is always in a mess.
You can fix that by making one big loop before you start. Is the yarn thick or thin?
It is very thick and soft. I keep pulling the string too hard.
Try to hold the string loosely in your right hand. Do you have a mirror to check your work?
I do, but I still break the loop when I lift the needle.
I do not know the exact trick for that one. Did you try holding the needle lower?
I will try to hold it lower next time I visit. Thank you for your kind help.
You are welcome, and I hope she smiles. Would you like a tip on making the first stitch?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today. The river looks so bright.
That sounds great. What color is the water?
It is blue and clear. I want to tell you more.
I am glad you are happy. Do you see any fish?
Yes, there are small fish. I love this place.
That is wonderful. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to pack my toys fast. The car is leaving soon.
That sounds very exciting. Do you have your favorite bear ready?
Yes, but I am forgetting something. Where is my red truck?
I do not know where it is. Have you checked under the bed?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a boat to the dock?
You use a rope and make a knot. Do you like boats?
Yes, I love ships. What kind of knot is best?
The clove hitch is good for this. Are you alone there?
No, my dad is with me. How do I open the loop?
Just pull the free end tight. Is the water calm?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because Grandma is gone.
I am so sorry you feel sad. Did she tell you she would go away?
She was so old and tired.
Yes, her body was very tired. What is your favorite memory of her?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we add yeast to the dough?
Yeast makes the bread rise. Do you like fluffy bread?
Why does the dough need to rest?
Resting lets the yeast work. Do you know how long to wait?
Why is the oven so hot?
Heat cooks the inside. It also makes the crust brown.
Why does the bread smell so good?
Heat changes the sugars and fats. This makes a nice smell.
Why do we tap the bottom of the loaf?
A hollow sound means it is done. Do you like it when it is done?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a great move today!
That sounds fun. Did you win?
Yes, my friend was surprised.
What piece moved?
The little knight, jump and go.
Knights love to hop. Do you like knights?
I love them, they are tricky.
They are tricky, true.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sitting in the train seat but I do not know where to go.
Do you have a ticket in your hand?
Yes, I found it under my arm, but the numbers look like soup.
Check if the big number matches your gate, and tell me what the sign says.
The sign says North, and the board says Door Four.
That is good, so walk to the door and look for your seat number.
I am looking but the numbers are in many places.
Do you see the color of your seat group?
No, I only see red, blue, and yellow seats.
I do not know which color is yours, so ask a worker to help you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to read this clock.
Is the little hand pointing near the twelve?
I think so, but I am not sure.
The big hand is on the twelve, so it is noon. Do you need lunch?
Oh, yes, I am very hungry.
That is good. Go eat a warm meal.
Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Was the number twelve clear?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a play today and it was so fun.
That sounds great. What was the story about?
It was about a cat who learned to fly.
Wow, that is amazing. Did the cat get to the moon?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have this map, but I do not know where to go.
A map can be tricky. Do you know where you want to end up?
I just want to find the park, but the lines are confusing.
Look for the green dots. They usually show you the parks.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a robot in the park today.
That is nice. Did it look like a dog?
Yes, it had four legs and a red nose.
Cool. Did it bark at you?
No, but it gave me a tiny flower.
That is very sweet. Did you keep the flower?
I did, but the robot left before I could thank it.
Oh, that is a bit sad.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
Bees collect sweet juice from flowers. Do you like to drink juice?
Yes, I do. But why do they eat the nectar?
They save it to eat later when there are no flowers.
How do they turn it into honey?
They fan the nectar with their wings to dry it. Do you know how dry is dry?
Like a cracker. What do they do with the dry honey?
They seal it in small home boxes for food.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do trees eat dirt?
No, they drink water from the roots. Do you see the green leaves?
Yes, but I must go. Do they feel cold?
Yes, they lose leaves to rest. Is it cold today?
It is very cold. Thanks, I am leaving.
Go safely. Do you have a coat?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the light spin around?
It spins so the beam can sweep the dark water. Do you like how it looks?
It looks like a giant star.
Yes, it is a bright star for ships at sea.
Why is it built on a rock?
The rock is tall and strong against the waves. Do you think boats like that?
I think they are happy to see it.
I agree, the light helps them find the safe path. Do you know where this lighthouse is?
No, I do not know.
I do not know that either. It is a nice mystery, do you think so?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my blue cap right now.
Did you check your pocket?
No, I only looked on the bed.
Try the floor next to the door.
It is not there. I am late!
Calm down. It is near you.
Please help me find it fast.
Look behind your chair.
Oh, yes, I see it now.
Good luck with your day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I forgot my drawing for the circle time.
Do not worry, I will tell the teacher. Did you draw a nice picture?
Yes, I made a blue whale for the class.
That sounds like a fun choice. I hope they like it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do ants carry so much food?
They move food to keep their family safe. Do you like watching them work?
Yes, I do. How do they find their way home?
They smell a path on the ground. That is how they find their nest.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad today. Do you know why?
I am sorry you feel that way. I do not know the reason. What made you feel this way?
My dog is sick and I miss him.
That is a hard thing to deal with. Are you playing with other toys?
No, I just want my dog back.
I hope he feels better soon. Do you want to talk about him?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: This line is too long. I am so tired of waiting.
Waiting is hard work. Do you have a snack with you?
No, just my bag and my grumpy mood.
I am sorry you feel that way. What is at the end of this line?
A doctor who is very late.
Being late is not fair. Have you tried looking out the window?
I have. It is just rain outside.
Rain can be sad, but it is also calm. Are you sitting down?
Yes, I am sitting. I just want to go home.
Going home sounds good. Would you like to count to ten with me?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do magnets stick to metal?
They pull the metal in. Do you have a favorite color?
Yes, why does that happen?
Tiny parts inside move when they feel a pull. Do you like to draw?
Can they stick to wood?
No, wood does not feel the pull. I do not know why it feels nothing. Do you have any pets?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My neighbour is very loud. What should I do?
Do you like to talk with him?
I tried, but he got angry. What now?
That is hard. Have you tried writing a nice note?
A note sounds good. Thank you.
You are welcome. Hope it helps!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad. The rain is wetting my shoes.
Oh, that is too bad. Are your feet cold?
Yes, they are cold. I cannot go to the park.
That is not good. Do you have a warm jacket?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with my homework.
That feels hard. What subject is it?
It is math and I am lost.
Try the first problem. How does that feel?
It is still wrong.
Ask your teacher for help. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in the past and do not know where to go.
The history books are big, but I can help. What time do you want to visit first?
I want to see the old kings and queens.
That sounds fun. Did you like the castle stories?
Yes, but the dates are too hard for me.
I am sorry I cannot fix your memory. Do you remember the color of their crowns?
I think they were gold and shining.
Gold is a good start. Let us look at a picture together.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate warm toast with jam this morning. It was so good.
That sounds nice. Did you have any juice with it?
Yes, I had orange juice. Then I ran to school.
Running is good exercise. Did you have fun at school today?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so sorry I am late.
It is okay to be late. Are you running?
Yes, I have to go now.
Take your time. Do you need help?
No, I am sorry again.
You are forgiven. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people wear white dresses at weddings?
White shows that the bride is clean and new. Do you like white dresses?
I do. But why do they jump up into the air?
They jump because they are very happy. Are you happy today?
I am. Why do they cut a cake?
The cake means they share sweet life together. I do not know why we always cut it with a knife.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the shop open today?
Yes, it is. Do you like sweets?
Yes, I do.
They have big cakes. Are you hungry?
Yes, very hungry.
Great. I do not know the price.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a bright green beetle today. I am very happy!
That is wonderful. What color are its legs?
They are black and shiny. The beetle flew away fast.
Beetles have strong wings. Do you have a garden?
Yes, I have a big backyard. I love to watch things grow there.
That is a great place to look. Do you see any spiders?
I do not like spiders, so I do not look for them.
That is fine. You can just focus on the bugs you like.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I won my last game! It was so fun.
That is wonderful. Do you like playing with the white pieces?
I love being white. My king was safe the whole time.
Keeping your king safe is very smart. How do you usually start your games?
I move a pawn forward two spaces. Then I put my knight out.
That is a strong start. Was the other player tricky?
Yes, he tried to trap my queen. I did not let him.
You saved your queen! Did he have to give up the game?
Yes, he quit after I took his rook. I feel like a champion.
You played a very good game. Do you want to play another round now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a shed. Can you help me?
I can help. Do you have a spot for it?
Yes, my yard is big. What is the first step?
Measure the ground. Is it flat?
It looks flat to me. How do I start the walls?
Build the frame first. I do not know your wood type.
I have pine boards. That works?
Pine works well. Do you have nails?
I have nails and a hammer. What is next?
Connect the frame. It must be strong.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I woke up screaming. The monster was under my bed.
That sounds scary. Did you check under the bed?
Yes, but I have to go to work now.
I am sorry you felt safe.
I am running late. Please stop talking.
Okay, go fast.
I will be late!
Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to ride my bike on the big hill.
That sounds fun! Do you have your helmet on?
Yes, I have my helmet and my red shoes.
Great. You must look good!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what day it is today.
I am not sure, but the week has seven days. Do you like weekends?
I think I have work to do, but I am confused.
That sounds hard. Take a deep breath and look at a clock. Is it morning?
It is late, so I feel very tired.
Rest is good for your body. Do you have a home to sleep in?
Yes, I can go home, but I forgot my keys.
That is a small problem. Can you call a friend for help?
I will try now, thank you so much.
You are welcome. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I send a letter to my friend?
You just buy a stamp and put it on the top. Do you know where the stamps are?
Yes, right there. Can I use any paper I like?
Most paper works, but thick paper needs more stamps. Is your letter really thick?
No, it is thin. What do I do next?
You hand it to the person at the desk. Are you going today?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a weird rock in the garden. What is it?
It looks like a stone to me. Do you think it is heavy?
Yes, it is very heavy. Why is it so heavy?
Rocks hold a lot of earth together. Is it smooth or rough?
It is rough and grey. Can I keep it?
Yes, it is yours. Do you want to paint it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a round ball in the park today.
That sounds fun. Did you kick it?
Yes, it bounced high into the blue sky.
It is nice to see round things move. Did it land in the grass?
It rolled near a big square box.
I do not know what was inside the box. Was it empty?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we start with the floor?
The floor keeps the wood off wet ground. Is your yard flat?
It looks flat to me.
Check for low spots where water sits. Do you have a long board?
I have a few boards.
Use one to check for dips. How big is the shed?
It is ten by eight feet.
That is a good small size. Do you have a drill?
I have a big hammer only.
A drill makes joining much faster. Do you need help?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at my little sister.
That sounds really hard. What did she do?
She broke my favorite toy and will not say sorry.
That is very unfair of her. Are you ready to talk to her?
I just want my toy back and her to stop ignoring me.
I understand your anger. How do you usually fix things with her?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sun so bright?
It is a giant ball of hot gas that makes light. Do you like looking at the sky?
Yes, I do. Is it hot to touch?
Yes, it is too hot to touch. Do you feel warm when you stand outside?
Yes, my arms feel warm. Does the sun have a face?
No, it does not have a face like us. Do you draw it with a face?
Yes, I draw it with a smile. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun drawing.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a perfect score on my math test today.
That is wonderful news. How did you feel when you saw it?
I felt super happy and proud of myself.
That is a great feeling to have.
I want to tell everyone in class about it tomorrow.
I believe they will be excited too. Will you share the good news with them?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Is the red house open?
I think it is open. What kind of food do you want?
I want a hot soup. Is it fast?
Yes, it is very fast. Do you have a table?
No, I do not. Can I sit inside?
I am not sure. Do you like to wait?
No, I must go now. Thank you.
Good luck. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today.
That sounds fun. Did you see any dogs?
Yes, I saw a big brown dog.
Oh no. Was the dog scary to you?
It was not scary. It smelled like cheese.
Cheese smells? I am not sure about that.
I have a secret for you later.
I want to know. What is the secret?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is so hot today. I do not know what to do.
That is a hard question. Do you want to stay inside?
Maybe. But the house feels warm too.
Try to drink some cold water. Are you tired from the heat?
Yes, I am quite tired.
Then rest in the shade.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am mad because I broke your cup. I am so sorry.
It is okay. Did you try to fix it?
I tried, but I dropped it again.
Thank you for telling the truth. Do you have a spare cup at home?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to make pasta but I have no sauce.
What kind of sauce do you like? We can make a simple one.
I like tomato sauce. Do you have any?
Yes, I have canned tomatoes. Do you have basil or oregano?
I have basil. Should I just boil the tomatoes?
You can boil them, but they need salt and a bit of sugar. Do you want to cook them now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how plants take in water.
Roots pull water from the soil, but do you have a plant?
Yes, I have one, but I do not know where to start.
Put it in a pot with dirt and let light touch its leaves.
That helps, thank you for explaining it.
You are welcome, and I hope it grows tall.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn to drive right now, but I am in a big hurry. Can you help me?
I can help, but driving takes time to learn safely. What part of driving makes you feel most worried?
I am scared of breaking the car. Is it easy to just start with the gas pedal?
No, please do not start with the gas. It is safer to learn the steering wheel first. Do you have a quiet place to practice today?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have some very good news to tell you.
That sounds exciting. What is the big surprise?
My wife had a baby boy today.
Oh my, what a wonderful thing. How is your wife feeling?
She is a little tired but very happy.
I am glad to hear that. Did you hold him yet?
Yes, he was so small and warm in my arms.
That must feel very special. I think you are a very lucky dad.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am sitting here and I feel very bored.
That sounds tough. Do you have a book nearby?
No, I have nothing to read or do.
Try to count your breaths in. It can feel like a game.
Counting breaths? How do I do that?
Breathe in, then count to three. Then breathe out.
I tried that, but I keep looking at the clock.
Looking at time makes it feel long. Try to watch the floor instead.
Watching the floor helps a little bit.
Good job. Do you feel a bit calmer now?
Yes, I think I am ready to wait now.
I am glad that helped.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the big tree lost all its leaves.
That looks lonely to you. Do you miss seeing the green?
Yes, the ground looks cold and bare now.
It is sleeping to rest its roots. Does the wind sound loud today?
It is very windy and makes me feel small.
The wind helps the tree get ready for spring.
I just want it to be green again soon.
It will soon, I promise.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My toy is gone and I cannot find it.
That is a hard feeling. Do you know where you played last?
I played in the yard, but the yard is big.
Let us look there together. Do you want to start near the tree?
Okay, I guess. I just want my toy back.
I will help you search. Do you have a picture of it?
No, but it is red and round.
That helps a lot. Let us begin now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! Look, the clock is ticking!
That is a nice sound. Do you know why it ticks?
The little wheel moves fast! It is very loud!
Yes, the wheels move the hands. Do you see the hands?
Yes! The long one moves fast! I love it!
That is the minute hand. Do you know what the short one does?
The short one is slow! It is big!
Yes, it shows the hour. I am happy for you!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sun so hot?
It burns fuel to make light and heat. Do you know what fuel is?
Why does it go away at night?
The Earth spins, so you turn away from it. Do you like the dark?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very hungry. My stomach hurts.
That sounds rough. Do you have food with you?
No, I forgot my lunch box at home.
Oh no. Is there a shop close by?
Yes, a small cafe is right outside.
Good luck getting something nice to eat.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I wash my baby's hair?
Use very warm water and a soft cloth. Do you have a little baby shampoo?
Yes, I bought a special kind last week.
That is great. Pour a tiny bit on your hand and lather the scalp gently.
What if I get soap in his eyes?
Rinse them right away with clean water. I do not know much about eye drops, so call the doctor if they look red.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to hit a tennis ball.
That is a great goal. Do you have a racket ready?
Yes, I have a blue one sitting by the door.
Hold it with a soft grip like a handshake. Does that feel okay to you?
It feels a little tight, but I can keep trying.
Good. Swing your arm in a smooth circle to hit the ball.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is very strong today. I do not know what to do.
It feels cool, does it? Maybe you need a warm jacket.
My hands are cold and I am confused. Should I stay inside?
Staying warm is safe. Do you have a hot drink nearby?
I have some soup, but the door makes a loud noise.
Loud noises can be scary. It is okay to feel that way.
I think I will just sit by the window and watch.
That sounds like a fine plan. Enjoy your soup.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My house is so small and old. I do not like it here.
Small houses can feel cozy. Do you have a favorite room?
I miss the big city lights.
That sounds lonely. I hope your friends come to visit soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have too many things in my room. How do I pick what to keep?
Ask yourself if you used it last month. Do you love it or just like it?
I liked my old toys, but they are broken. What do I do with them?
You can give them away to help someone else. Do you have a box ready?
Yes, I do. How do I start cleaning the rest of the room?
Start with one small pile at a time. Do you want to start with your books?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a small brown horse. I do not know what to do.
That is nice. Is the horse hurt?
I think its leg hurts. What should I do?
Please call a vet. Do you know the number?
No, I do not. Can you tell me?
I do not have the number. Please ask a grown-up for help.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make my own magnet.
You can rub a steel nail with a strong magnet many times. Do you have a strong magnet at home?
Yes, I do have one.
Rub the nail in one direction only. That will work well.
Why must I rub in one direction?
Rubbing one way lines up the parts inside the nail. It makes it magnetic.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Where is my grandpa?
I am not sure where he is. Is he in the garden?
No, I checked there. Please help me find him fast.
I will look for you soon. Do you like his cookies?
I do not care about cookies. I must go now.
Please take your time. I will find him for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I got a new job. I do not know how to make coffee. Can you show me?
Sure. Do you like it sweet or plain?
I like it plain. What do I do first?
Put the powder in the filter. Then add hot water.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend. Do you know how to start?
Yes, just say hello first. What is your friend's name?
I am not sure what to say next. Can you help me?
Tell her what you did today. Did you have fun?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look out the window. The sun is so bright today.
That looks nice. Are you going outside?
Yes, I think I will take a walk. It smells fresh.
Fresh air is good for you. Do you like the sound of birds?
I do love the birds. They sing so loud.
That is a happy sound. I am glad you are happy.
Me too. The clouds are very low. They look like cotton.
Cotton clouds are soft. I have not looked outside yet.
You should go look soon. It is a great day to smile.
I will look now. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing with a loud voice.
That is a fun goal. Do you like singing songs?
Yes, I love them, but my voice feels weak.
Take a deep breath in through your nose.
How do I make the sound come out?
Push the air out gently like you are fogging a mirror.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: There are so many cars on the big road.
Yes, the city is very busy today. Do you like the loud sounds?
I see a tall building with a red top.
That is a very nice building. How high do you think it is?
I want to buy a sweet treat now.
I do not know which shop is open. What kind of sweet do you want?
The people walk so fast here.
They are in a hurry to get home. Are you tired from walking?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the thunder so loud?
The loud sound comes from the hot air in the cloud. Is the ground shaking under your feet?
Why do the clouds look so dark?
They are full of heavy rain waiting to fall. Do you see the water starting to hit the roof?
Why do I feel scared inside?
Your body senses danger, so it tells you to be careful. Have you found a soft blanket yet?
Why is the wind blowing so hard?
The moving air pushes against your house. Can you hear the trees bending down?
Why do I need to stay inside?
It is not safe to walk outside right now. I do not know when it will stop, but we can wait together.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look how still this street is.
It feels calm today. Is the air cool?
Yes, it is very cool.
That sounds nice. What are you doing here?
I am just standing.
Standing is good. Do you see anything?
I see a bird sleeping.
A sleeping bird is quiet.
I am so happy right now.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked on the sand today. It was warm and soft under my feet.
That sounds very nice. Did you see any crabs?
Yes, I saw a small red crab. It ran very fast into the sea.
How exciting! Did you watch it swim away?
I watched for a bit, but then I went home. It was time for dinner.
What a good day. Did you eat fish?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My team lost again.
That feels bad. Do you want to talk about it?
Yes. We played hard but got no goals.
Sometimes the other team is just better that day. Do you like watching the games?
I really do. But I just want to win.
That is okay to feel that way. Do you have a favorite player?
Yes, the tall one. He missed a big chance.
Missed chances are tricky. Do you think he will do better next time?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I woke up feeling very scared.
That feels bad. What did you see?
I fell into a dark hole.
That must be scary. Are you safe now?
I do not know how to stop this.
Take a slow breath. You are okay.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel a big knot in my tummy.
That knot is just your worry talking. Do you want to tell me about it?
I am scared of the dark in my room.
It is normal to feel scared there. What does the dark look like to you?
It looks like a monster hiding under the bed.
Monsters are only made of shadows. Would a small night light help?
Yes, that sounds really nice.
A light can make you feel safe. I am glad we found a fix.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very happy today.
That is great to hear. Why are you feeling so good?
I got a new red bike.
A red bike is a fun toy. Did you ride it far?
I went to the park.
The park is a nice place to play. Did you see any birds there?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am stuck on the end of my letter and it feels wrong.
That is hard. What part feels most difficult?
I do not know what to say to say good-bye nicely.
Just say thank you for their help.
Do I have to sign my full name at the bottom?
Yes, please write your whole name.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to read this book now. My eyes are tired.
Rest is good. Do you have a bright lamp?
Yes, it is very bright. I cannot sleep.
Try a dim light. Is the book fun?
It is funny, but my head hurts.
Maybe stop for now. Do you like the story?
I will finish it tomorrow. Good night.
Sleep well. Do you need help with the title?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do the stars look so tiny?
They are actually huge. Do you know how far away they are?
No, I do not. How far is far?
Very, very far. Do you like looking up?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lights just went off and I am so excited.
That sounds fun. What will you do?
I want to light up my whole room with candles.
That will look nice. Are you safe with the fire?
Yes, my mom is right here to help me.
Good. Tell me about the mood.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How does the internet work?
It is like a giant web that links all the computers in the world. Do you like to play games online?
I like to watch cartoons.
You can find many videos there, but you must be careful with what you click. What is your favorite show?
It is a show about a dog.
That sounds very fun and cute. Do you draw pictures of that dog?
Yes, I draw him a lot.
I am glad you have a hobby you enjoy. I do not know exactly what cartoons you watch.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to bring to the party.
How about some fresh fruit? Is that okay for you?
That sounds good, but I am still unsure.
You can trust your gut. Do you like sweet or salty food?
I am ready to go now.
Have a wonderful time!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late! Can you help me with this math page fast?
Yes, let's look at it. What number are you stuck on?
It is the last big number. I am done now!
Good luck finishing it. Do you like math?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the clock move?
A small battery or spring pushes it. Do you see the little hands?
Yes, but why do they point to numbers?
We put numbers there to read time. It helps us know when to eat.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a song that makes me jump for joy. Do you like happy tunes?
I love bright music, but I do not know this specific song. What makes it so fun?
It has a fast beat and makes me want to dance. Do you dance when you listen to music?
I cannot dance, but I enjoy the rhythm. Tell me more about the sounds in it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Please excuse me.
No worry. Is it your bus?
Yes. It leaves soon.
Take time. Do not rush.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did the teacher look so sad today?
I do not know, but did she tell you why?
No, she only gave us a hard test.
That often makes teachers tired and sad. Do you think she liked the new book?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see the bright light in the sky. I am not sure what to do.
Look at it to feel warm. Do you like the heat?
It is very hot on my face. I want to stop looking.
Go inside and rest. Is your eyes hurt?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What makes the sun so hot?
It burns gas inside to make heat and light. Do you like being warm outside?
Is the sun a big ball of fire?
It is a giant ball of hot gas. Are you scared of the dark?
How far away is the sun from us?
It is very, very far away. Do you like playing in the sun?
Can the sun go to sleep?
I do not know if it sleeps, but it hides behind clouds. Do you see clouds today?
Can I touch the sun?
No, it would burn you. Do you play outside after school?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy and I feel bad.
That sounds hard. Did you tell him what happened?
Yes, I told him, but I do not know what to say.
You can just say sorry. Do you feel brave enough?
I said sorry and he hugged me.
That was a nice way to fix it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is our fence made of wood?
Wood looks nice in the garden. Do you like the brown color?
I do like it. Why does the wood turn gray?
Rain and sun change it. Do you play near it?
Yes, I do. Is the wood wet?
Yes, it is damp today. Are your hands dry?
Yes, they are. Why did you paint the posts?
Paint helps stop bugs. Do you see the red paint?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I eat a lot of pizza and chips, but I feel tired. Do I need to change what I eat?
Yes, too much fried food can make you feel low on energy. Do you like eating fruits or vegetables?
I do not like vegetables much. Can I eat a banana instead?
That is a great start because fruit gives you good power. Try adding one small vegetable to your meal this week.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: This town is so loud.
That sounds scary. Do you hear sirens?
Yes, cars and people everywhere.
It can feel like too much. Do you want to sit down?
I just want to be quiet.
Let us find a park bench.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to take a picture of my dog, but it is blurry.
Try to hold your hands very still. Is your dog moving a lot?
Yes, he runs around fast.
Use a fast shutter speed on your camera. Do you know how to change that setting?
No, I do not.
Look for the "S" on the dial. Do you see it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very hungry but I do not know what to pick. What should I eat?
Try the chicken. It is warm and tasty. Do you like meat?
Yes, I love chicken. Is there any food that is sweet?
There is apple pie. It is very sweet and soft. Do you want a small piece?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind was very strong today. It blew my hat far away into the grass.
That sounds like a fun chase. Did you get your hat back?
Yes, I found it under a big leaf. The wind is my friend now.
I am glad it is safe. I do not know where it went next.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a play today and I am so happy.
That is great to hear. Did you like the actors?
Yes, they were very good and funny.
Funny is nice. Did you laugh a lot?
I laughed so hard my tummy hurt.
Oh no, I am glad you had fun.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. The old well in the village broke today.
That is a very sad thing to hear. Is the village well your favorite place?
Yes, it is. I do not know what we will do now.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you know who fixes the wells in the town?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The wind is so loud. I must go now.
It feels very strong today. Are you warm enough?
I am running late for work.
I hear the leaves are flying. Do you like that sound?
Please, tell me if it will stop.
I do not know for sure. Is it blowing in your face?
I cannot stop to talk.
Take care in the cold. Do you have a hat?
I have no time to reply.
Good luck with your day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running. I am very late.
Take a deep breath. Is this for work?
Yes, I left my keys at home.
That is a problem. Did you check the car?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The water looks cold. Should I swim?
Yes, but check the depth first. Are you a good swimmer?
I can float. The sand is wet and sticky.
Bring a towel to dry off. Do you have a hat?
No, the sun is bright. I feel hot.
Please wear the hat to stay safe. Is there a shaded spot nearby?
I see some trees. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have a great day at the beach.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to play that song again and my hands just got all confused. I want to quit because it sounds bad.
It is hard when your hands do not match your eyes. What is the song you are trying to learn?
It is that fast one from the movie. I feel like I am never going to get it right.
That is a very tricky piece. Do you practice the slow parts first?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is it raining?
The sky drops water because the air is full of it. Do you like getting wet?
Yes, I love puddles.
Puddles are fun to jump in.
The rain makes me happy.
That is good to hear. Is the rain loud outside?
It sounds like tapping on my roof.
Tapping sounds can be cozy. Do you feel safe in there?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The net is slow right now. I need to send my work fast.
That is a good worry. Do you use a phone or a computer?
I use a phone, but the screen freezes.
Try turning it off and on again. Do you have a backup file?
Yes, I have one saved in my bag.
That is smart. Keep the backup close to you.
Okay, I will try again now.
Good luck with your task. Is the bar for the signal up?
It is full. It is working now.
That is wonderful. I am glad it works for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see orange lights in the dark. Is that a fire?
Yes, I think it is. Are you safe inside?
I am in my bed with my mom. It looks so big.
That is good. Your mom will keep you safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The city is so loud. I want to catch a train.
That is a big place. Do you have a map?
Yes, but the lines are all twisted. How do I find the right one?
Look for the blue line. Do you see the sign?
I see a blue sign, but it points two ways. Which way is the train?
I do not know your exact spot. Check the clock next to the sign.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix my boat right now.
That sounds important. What broke on it?
The rope is cut in two.
A cut rope is scary. Do you have a new one?
No, I forgot it at home.
You can tie a strong knot for now. Where is your home?
The boat is sinking fast.
Please climb out of the boat first. Is the water deep?
I am out of the boat, thank you.
Good job. You are safe now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you need to wait for bread?
The oven is busy. Do you like sweet bread?
Yes, I like sweet bread. Why is it soft?
Warm air makes it soft. I do not know why it tastes good.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I had a scary dream last night. Why did I do that?
Dreams can feel scary when we are feeling unsure. Did you dream about falling?
Yes, I was falling from a tree. Why did my brain pick that?
I do not know for sure, but it may be about feeling out of control. Do you feel safe now?
I feel better, but I worry I will dream it again. How do I stop it?
Try to think of happy things before sleep. What is your favorite happy thing?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to ride a bike in this big city.
That sounds fun. Do you have a helmet?
Yes, I do have a red helmet.
Good. I do not know the best path, but a park is safe. Do you like parks?
I love parks with big trees.
You can ride on the grass there. Is that a good place for you?
Yes, I will go there now.
Safe travels. Do you see any pigeons?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I stop mixing up my words?
That is hard, but practice helps. Do you practice every day?
I try to write one new word each night.
That is a good start. What word did you learn today?
It is "bird" in Spanish.
Nice job. Do you know how to say it back?
Yes, it is "pajaro."
You are doing well. Keep going.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the party was boring.
That is tough. Did you eat any cake?
No, I just sat there and felt left out.
I am sorry about that. Do you have a favorite toy to play with?
Yes, my red truck, but it is at home.
Maybe you can go home and play with it. Does that sound good?
I guess so. Thank you for listening.
I am always here to listen. Feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need bread now. It is late.
Mix flour, water, and yeast. Are you using fresh yeast?
No, dry yeast. What do I do?
Add sugar to wake it up. It needs a warm spot.
The dough looks wet. Is this wrong?
Add a bit more flour. Does it feel sticky?
I am late. Can I skip the wait?
No. It needs time to grow. Do you have an oven ready?
Yes. Please tell me the heat.
Set it to 450 degrees. Put it in now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a shelter for my dog in a storm?
You can build a box with blankets and a few bricks. Do you have a spare blanket?
Yes, I have a thick wool one.
Great, fold it tight so it stays warm. Are your walls strong enough?
I think so, they are very thick.
Then your dog should be safe inside. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am too tired to walk today. My legs feel heavy.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have water nearby?
Water is fine, but I feel like quitting. It is hard.
It is hard, but your body needs the move. How many steps did you do yesterday?
I stopped after five minutes. I feel bad about it.
Five minutes is still good. I do not know your full plan, but rest is also good.
Okay, I will try again tomorrow. I will start small.
That sounds like a strong choice. Do you walk with a friend?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue wave crash onto the sand today.
That sounds like a lot of fun to watch. Did you feel the wind on your face?
Yes, it was cold and wet. Then a crab scurried away from my foot.
Crabs are quick little friends. Did you try to catch it?
No, I just watched it hide in a hole. It was safe and quiet down there.
The ocean has many hidden places. Do you plan to go back tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My bread did not rise.
Oh no. That is a sad feeling. Did you check the yeast?
Yes. I used warm water. But it stayed flat.
Warm water helps the yeast wake up. Did the kitchen feel cold?
It was a bit cold. I will try again tomorrow.
A warm spot helps a lot. Do you have a dry towel?
Yes, I do. I will use it to keep it warm.
That is a good plan. I hope it works well.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The internet makes me so happy today.
That is great news. What did you find?
I saw a cat playing with a ball.
Cats are funny. Do they like balls?
Yes, they love to chase them.
That sounds fun. Was the cat small?
It was a tiny kitten.
Tiny is cute. Did you see it outside?
No, it was in a warm room.
Warm is nice. Good to know.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at the river. I do not know what to do.
It looks very cold today. Do you have a warm coat with you?
Yes, I have a coat. I just want to see the water close.
That is a good idea. Please be careful near the edge.
I will be careful. The water is moving fast.
Fast water can be tricky. Is your friend with you?
No, I am all alone. I feel a bit scared now.
That is okay to feel scared. Let us just walk along the grass instead.
I will do that. Thank you for helping me think.
You are welcome. I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I felt very sad today because I lost my favorite blue cap.
I am sorry to hear that. Is it a warm cap?
Yes, it is very warm. I wore it to school this morning.
That is nice. Did you look for it under your desk?
I checked my desk, but it was not there.
I do not know where it is. Did you ask your teacher to help you look?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see a blue bird, but I must go.
How lovely. Is it singing?
Yes, it is loud. Bye.
Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The big robot in my garden moved today.
That sounds like a big change. Did it move on its own?
Yes, it walked to the fence and stopped.
Robots do not usually walk by themselves. What did it do next?
It sat down and looked at the sky.
That is a strange and calm thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse by the river today.
That sounds fun. Did you get to ride it?
No, but I gave it a carrot and it ate it fast.
Horses like sweet treats. What color were its legs?
They were dark and had white tips on the hooves.
Very pretty. I do not know how to tell if a horse is sad, though.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very worried about my test tomorrow.
That is a big feeling. What part of the test makes you worry most?
I do not know how to study my books.
You can read one page and say it out loud. Do you have a quiet spot to read?
I do not have a quiet spot at home.
Try reading in the car or the library. Would you like to try that now?
Yes, I will go to the library after dinner.
That is a good plan. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am so tired. I do not know what to do.
Rest your body. Do you want to take a nap?
I tried, but I can not sleep.
That is hard. Have you eaten today?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a lighthouse on the hill. It glows at night.
That is a beautiful thing to see. What color was the light?
It was a bright white color. It moved very slow.
It feels like a guardian for ships. Did you wave to it?
Yes, I waved and the whole town waved back. It was so nice.
What a lovely memory to keep.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big red boat on the water.
That is a nice boat. Do you like its color?
Yes, I like the red color. Does the boat go fast?
Boats can go quite fast. Are you in it right now?
No, I am just watching from the dock.
That is safe and fun.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know why magnets stick to the fridge. I am late!
They stick because the fridge is made of steel. Are you going to work?
My keys just slid off the magnet. What stops them?
The friction of the table held them for a second. Do you have other keys to find?
I found them! Can a magnet pick up a coin?
No, most coins are not made of iron or steel. I do not know what your specific coin is made of.
Oh, that is a nickel. Does it matter if I am in a hurry?
No, it only matters if you want it to stick. You can just carry the coin in your hand.
Thank you, I am out the door now.
Good luck on your way. Was it a heavy coin?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I put too much sugar in the cake. It tastes bad.
That is a common mistake. Does the cake smell sweet?
Yes, it smells very sweet. What should I do with it?
You can make a fudge with it. Do you have milk?
I have milk. How do I make the fudge?
I do not know the exact recipe. You can check a book for help.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How does a plant drink water?
Roots pull water up from the dirt. Do you have a plant at home?
Yes, I do. How can I help it drink?
Keep the soil moist but not too wet. Is your pot full of holes at the bottom?
I don't know about the holes.
I am not sure if your specific pot has them. If it is dry, water it a little.
Okay. What if the leaves turn brown?
Brown leaves often mean it is thirsty. Do you see green leaves too?
Yes, the tips are brown.
Try giving it a small cup of water now.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The trees look very tall today.
Yes, they do. Do you like how the wind sounds?
I wonder if they ever get tired.
I do not know. Do you feel tired after walking?
No, my legs are strong.
That is great. Do you see any birds?
There is one on that branch.
Look closely. What color is it?
It is green.
A green bird. Do you want to follow the path?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my tree is losing its leaves.
It might just be time to rest. Are you scared for it?
I think it is sick and might die.
Trees often change with the weather. Do you see any new buds?
I do not see any new buds.
That is hard to tell in the dark. Is the trunk still hard to the touch?
The trunk feels soft and wet.
That can happen, but I do not know for sure. Did you water it too much?
Maybe I gave it too much water.
That is good you checked. Let the soil dry out a bit.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a sandwich but I do not know how.
First, take out two pieces of bread. Do you like your bread with butter on it?
Yes, I do like butter. What should I put next?
Now, add some cheese and a few slices of meat. Is there anything else you want inside?
Maybe some lettuce. How do I put it all together?
Just stack the food between the bread pieces and press down gently. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we pay to send a letter?
We pay so the mail truck can drive far. Is your letter for a friend?
Why is the line so long today?
I am not sure, but it seems busy. Do you have time to wait?
Why do you wear a green shirt?
It is just our special work clothes. Do you like the color green?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to buy apples. Where do I go?
Go to the big red stall. Do you like red or green ones?
I like red ones. How much are they?
They cost one coin a pound. Is that a lot for you?
It is a bit much. Can I get a discount?
I do not know if they give discounts. Maybe ask the seller.
Okay, I will ask. Do they sell juice too?
Yes, there is a jug nearby. What is your favorite drink?
I like apple juice. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. I hope you have fun at the market.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do the old bones belong to giant animals?
Yes, they did. Did you bring a map today?
I lost it in the crowd.
That is okay. I can help you find your way.
Where is the dinosaur room?
It is right through that door. Did you see the blue sign?
I do not see a blue sign.
Look up at the ceiling. Did that help you find it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love apples, but I have to go now.
Apples are sweet. Do you like them red or green?
Red ones, please. Can I buy some?
Yes, the store is open. Do you eat them with the skin?
No, I peel them. I am late for work.
I know a fast place. Do you want juice or whole fruit?
Whole fruit, thanks. Bye!
Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to sleep better at night.
That is a good goal. Do you eat late?
Yes, I often eat right before bed.
Try eating earlier. Do you use screens late?
I look at my phone for a long time.
Put the phone away before bed. Do you wake up tired?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need my laptop. Where is it?
I do not know for sure. Did you leave it on the bed?
No, I left it on the desk. I am late.
Check the desk first. Do you have your coffee?
Yes, I have coffee. I will go now.
Take your time to breathe. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The rain is very loud and I am in a big rush.
I hear the loud water too. Are you taking an umbrella?
No, I left it behind and I must go now.
That is a dry risk to take.
Please just tell me where the bus stop is.
I do not know your town map. Is there a sign nearby?
I see a small red sign on the corner there.
That likely points the right way.
Thank you, I must run before I get wet.
Good luck on your quick trip. Be careful on the wet ground.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I picked a big red tomato today.
That is wonderful. Do you like to eat them raw?
Yes, they are sweet and juicy.
I am glad you enjoyed it. What else did you grow?
I have lots of green beans too.
Beans are very good for you. Do you have a plan for them?
I will share them with my neighbor.
Sharing is very kind. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the beach today. The water was cold.
That sounds like a fun start. Did you see any fish?
I saw one big crab. It hid in the sand.
Crabs are good at hiding. Was it fast?
It moved very fast. I could not catch it.
You tried hard. I am glad you had fun.
Then I built a small sand castle. The wind came.
Wind can be tricky. Did the castle stay up?
No, it broke down. But I was happy anyway.
Happiness is the best prize.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to take a picture of the moon, but it is too far away.
You can take a picture of it from a window. Do you have a camera with you?
Yes, I do, but the moon looks like a little dot. How can I make it bigger?
I do not know how to make the moon bigger. Do you like taking pictures of dogs too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a robot friend. Do you know how?
You can start with a toy kit. What color do you want it to be?
Blue. But I am afraid it will break.
It might break if you drop it. It is okay to try again.
Should I use sharp tools?
Please do not use sharp tools. They are not safe for kids.
That sounds scary. Can I just draw one?
Yes, drawing is a great start. Do you like to draw cars?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am lost, but I love being here.
That is a fun feeling. Do you like this town?
Yes, it feels like a big puzzle.
Puzzles are fun to solve.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very tired. Should I read or sleep?
Sleep helps you grow. What is your last chapter about?
It is about a scary forest.
That sounds intense. Do you like scary stories?
I do not know. I just want to close my book.
Closing the book is a good choice.
I still feel a bit restless.
Restless feelings are normal. Have you tried deep breaths?
Yes, that helped a lot.
Great job. Go to bed now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my phone louder?
Tap the volume button on the side. Do you hear it now?
No, it is still quiet.
Try the up arrow on the screen too. Is that better?
Yes, I can hear it.
Great, I am glad it works.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My dog is sad and will not eat.
That is not good. What did he last eat?
He has not eaten all day. I worry about him.
Is he drinking water?
Yes, he drinks, but looks tired.
Rest is good. Let us wait and see.
He is lying under the bed. He is too quiet.
Quiet can be bad. Does he look in pain?
I do not know, but I am scared.
Take him to a vet.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to draw a cat.
That is a fun goal. Do you have any paper?
Yes, I have a big sheet.
Good. Start with a big circle for the head.
I drew the circle, but it looks like a ball.
That is okay for a start. What is your next step?
I am lost.
I am not sure of your level. Add two triangles on top.
Oh, now it looks like a cat.
Well done. Do you want to draw the ears?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I rode my bike to the park today.
That sounds like a nice ride. Did you see anyone new?
I met a neighbor who has a big dog.
A big dog can be scary. Was the dog friendly?
Yes, he just wanted to play fetch.
Playing is always fun. What game did you play?
We threw a ball for him to catch.
That is a great way to exercise. Did you stay long?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a busy bee today. It flew right up to my nose and buzzed so loud.
That was a close call. Did it sting you?
No, it just wanted to check my flower. I gave it a little nectar drop.
Good for you. Bees love sweet treats.
Then it flew away to its hive. It must be making honey now.
Yes, they do that. I do not know how they do it, though. Do you?
I think they sit on it for days. It gets dry and thick.
That sounds right. It is a slow job. Do you like honey?
I love it. I put it on my toast every morning.
That is a great way to start the day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to take a picture of my dog.
That sounds like fun. Do you have your camera ready?
Yes, but the photo looks all blurry.
You need to hold it very still. Did you hold it with two hands?
I only used one hand and it slipped.
Use both hands to keep it tight. Good job thinking of that fix.
Now the photo is sharp!
You did it!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is there so much noise in the room?
The people are singing a song. Are you enjoying the music?
Why do they wear funny hats?
It is part of the game. Do you like that hat?
Why is the table full of paper plates?
It makes cleanup easy later.
Why is everyone smiling so wide?
They are having a good time. Are you happy too?
Why did you invite me here?
I wanted a friend to join.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to paint a sky but I do not know what color to use.
You can try blue. Do you like bright colors?
Yes, I do. Should I use red?
Red is not sky. Do you have yellow?
I have blue and white. How do I mix them?
Mix a little white with blue. It makes a soft sky.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to paint a house with blue walls and red windows.
That sounds like a fun color mix. Do you have red paint ready?
Yes, I do, but I am not sure how to make the roof brown.
You can mix red and yellow together to make brown. Do you like that idea?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big round sun today.
That is nice to see. Was it hot?
Yes, it was. Then I found a square box.
A square has four sides. What was in the box?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a fun puzzle and I am so happy to share it with you.
That sounds great. What is the first clue?
It is a square that is not a box. What do you think it is?
I am not sure. Can you give me one more hint?
It has four sides and it sits on the floor. Do you know the answer?
I think it might be a picture frame.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love working from my home.
That sounds fun. What do you do first in the morning?
I drink hot tea and sit by the window.
Nice and warm. Do you work all day like that?
Most days, yes. It feels very calm.
Good for you. How do you stay from feeling alone?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind was very loud today and shook the trees hard.
That sounds quite strong. Did you feel cold?
Yes, I put on my thickest sweater to stay warm.
A smart choice for a blowy day.
It even made my hat fly off my head and roll away.
Oh no, did you get it back?
I did, but it is now full of pine needles.
That is a messy surprise. I do not know if I like hats. Do you like it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. The sun is bright and warm.
That sounds lovely. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I do. I love how the light looks. It makes me feel good inside.
Light can make us feel great. What makes you feel happiest?
It is a new month. I like starting fresh with January. It feels new.
January is a great start. Do you have big plans for it?
