Not big ones, just good ones. I want to learn more about the other months, too.
There are twelve months in a year. Do you know their names?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to tell you about the months.
That sounds great. Which month do you like best?
I love July because it is hot.
I agree that July is very warm. Do you play in the water?
Yes, I swim a lot in July.
Swimming is a great way to stay cool.
I also enjoy reading in the quiet months.
Reading is nice when it is cold. Which quiet month do you mean?
December is my favorite quiet month.
That makes sense since it is winter. Do you like the snow?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix this torn shirt now. My bus is here.
I can help you stitch it fast. Is the tear on the sleeve?
Yes, please hold the fabric. I am cutting the thread.
I will hold it tight for you. Do you have scissors nearby?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it rude to talk while someone is eating?
Yes, it can be. Do you know why that might bother people?
I think it makes them feel unimportant. How do I say please properly?
You say it clearly, not fast. Do you practice it at home?
I try, but sometimes I forget. Should I touch people when asking?
No, keep your hands to yourself. It is safer and cleaner.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a robot, but I am lost.
What part are you stuck on? Start with a simple motor.
I do not know how to make it walk.
I do not know your robot type, but wheels are easier than legs.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big white puff in the sky today.
That sounds like a fun cloud. Did it look like anything to you?
It looked just like a big sheep.
Sheep are common in the sky on sunny days. Was the sun out?
Yes, the sun was very bright.
Bright sun makes clouds stand out. Do you like watching them move?
I sat on the grass and watched for a while.
That sounds like a nice quiet time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I take a sharp photo of my dog?
You need light. Is your dog sitting still?
He runs around a lot.
Press the button down halfway to lock focus. Do you have a camera with a zoom?
I only have my phone.
That works fine. Tap the screen where your dog is. How much space do you have?
I am in a small room.
Move closer to fill the frame. Do you like pictures from up close?
Yes, I do.
Great. Keep the phone level and wait for him to stop. Do you have a treat to make him pause?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. How do I wash my shirt fast?
You can use hot water and wash by hand. Do you have a small basin?
Yes, I do. What do I put in it?
Just add some soap. Then rub it and rinse it well.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see the big yellow ball in the sky. What should I do with it?
You can just look at it and feel the warm light. Do you like how it feels on your face?
I am not sure. It looks too bright to touch.
You cannot touch it, but you can close your eyes for a second. Does that help a little?
I guess I will just watch it for a bit.
That is a good plan. It is safe to just watch.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The water is muddy. I cannot see the fish.
That is a pity. Do you want to wait for it to clear?
I do not think it will get clear soon.
You are right. Maybe we can sit here and read?
I just wanted a nice day by the river.
I understand. Would you like to bring a book?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do robots feel pain when they break?
No, they are made of metal and wire. Do you like building things?
I like building blocks.
That is a fun way to start. Do you know what power makes them move?
I think it is batteries.
Yes, batteries or electricity. It is like a tiny heart for them.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My brother took my toy car. I am very sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you try talking to him?
I told him it was my toy. He just laughed.
That is not nice. What do you usually do when he does that?
I cry. Is that bad?
It is okay to feel sad. Maybe try sharing it next time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why is the light off? I am so mad.
Did you check if the plug is in? Can you show me the switch?
Yes, the plug is in, but it still does not work.
That is strange. I do not know why it failed. Is the rest of your room dark?
Yes, everything is dark now. I feel very annoyed.
I am sorry you are upset. Please do not touch the wire. Do you see a loose cord?
I see a cut in the wire near the base.
Do not touch that cut. It is not safe. Please turn off the main power first.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do months have different numbers of days?
The old calendars tried to match the moon and sun. Do you like the short months?
I like March best. Why is it so busy with work?
Spring brings a lot of growing and work. I do not know the exact old reason for March's busyness.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My grandma is sitting all day. She looks very sad. What can I do to help?
Try to ask her if she wants to make a snack with you. Is she hungry?
That is a good idea. She likes making cookies. But she cannot get up from her chair.
You can bring the mixer to her chair so she can mix the batter. Do you know where the eggs are?
Yes, they are in the fridge. I will go get them now. Thank you for the kind idea.
You are welcome. It is nice that you want to help her feel better.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My fish looks very still. Is it sad?
It might be resting. Does it move its fins?
Yes, just a tiny bit. Should I feed it?
Not if it is sleeping. Do you have any water test kits?
No, I do not. What do I do now?
Check the water temperature. Is it warm or cold?
It feels warm to the touch. Is that good?
Warm is often good for tropical fish. Do you know what kind of fish it is?
I think it is a goldfish. It has red scales.
Goldfish prefer cooler water. Did you change the water recently?
I changed it this morning. Now what do I do?
Wait and watch for an hour. Do you see it swim?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I hit the ball into the net again.
That happens to everyone. Do you like playing tennis?
Yes, but the ball is hard to hit.
Try holding the racket with both hands.
How do I hold it with two hands?
Put one hand on top and one on the bottom.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is so strong today. What should I do?
Stay in a safe place. Do you feel cold?
Yes, it is very chilly. Can I go outside to play?
Not yet, wait for it to slow down.
How can I tell when it slows down?
Look for leaves that stop moving.
Okay, I will watch the tree. Thanks.
That is a good plan.
It seems quieter now. Can I check now?
Yes, you can try now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a horse sit?
You cannot make a horse sit like a dog. Do you have a horse to practice with?
Yes, but I want it to be happy while I try.
Treats and soft words work best. Is your horse new to people?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I got my very first job today.
That is a big step. How did you feel about it?
I felt a little scared at first.
That makes sense. Did you do a good job?
Yes, I stacked all the papers nicely.
Good work for you. What do you want to do next?
I want to eat a cold sandwich.
That sounds nice. Have fun eating.
Okay, thank you for talking to me.
You are welcome. Go have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I kick the ball?
Put your plant foot next to the ball. Swing your kicking foot forward. Do you have a ball?
Yes, I do. Where do I put my eyes?
Look at the ball until you hit it. Look up right after you kick. Is it sunny today?
Yes, it is bright. Do I aim for the whole goal?
No, pick one small spot to kick at. Aim for the corner near the net. What color is your shirt?
It is red. How do I keep the ball away from me?
Use your body to block them. Keep the ball close to your feet. Do you have a friend to play with?
Yes, my brother. Thank you for the tips.
You are welcome. Have fun playing. Good luck today.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found some wild flowers. Should I pick them?
Yes, if they are not in a garden. Do you know the name of this red one?
No. Is it good to keep?
It is fine to keep. I do not know if you should give it to someone.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love apples but I am late.
Apples are sweet. Do you eat them whole?
Yes, with the skin.
That is healthy. Nice choice.
I must go now.
Safe travels to you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: A small robot walked into my kitchen today.
That is very surprising. Did it look new and shiny?
It looked old and dusty, but it was very polite.
I am glad it behaved well. What did it do for you?
It helped me wash my favorite cup.
That is a nice task. Is it your friend now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my screen blue?
That screen shows when a fix is needed. Is it happening now?
Yes, it is stuck on that color.
You need to restart the machine to clear it. Do you know how to do that?
I do not know how to restart it.
Find the small button with a circle and line. It is usually on the front or back.
I found a button, but nothing happens.
Try holding it down for ten full seconds. Does the power light change?
The light went off, and now the screen is black.
That is good, the old work is done. You can now turn it back on.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my robot friend stopped moving today.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you know why it stopped?
I tried to charge it, but the lights stay off.
That can be tricky to fix. Have you checked the battery pack?
I looked, but I do not know what is wrong.
I do not know exactly either. Is the battery very old?
It is new, so why is it broken?
Sometimes new things have small faults. Did you clean the charging ports?
I will try that, but I just miss having it move.
Cleaning it might help a lot. Tell me if the lights come on.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread is flat and sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you use fresh yeast?
I think so, but it did not rise.
That is tricky. Was the kitchen warm enough?
It was cold in here.
Cold air slows the yeast down. Do you have a warm spot?
Just the oven, but that is too hot.
You are right. Try a sunny windowsill instead?
That is a good plan.
I hope it works well for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot find my house on this map.
That is frustrating. Which color road are you looking for?
It is on the blue road near the park.
Look at the small green square. Is that the park you mean?
No, that is a school. I am so tired.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you see a river nearby?
Yes, but I still do not see my home.
I do not know your exact spot. Let me check the legend for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to fly a kite in the wind. How do I start?
You need a light, open place with a steady breeze. Do you have a kite with you?
Yes, I have one, but it keeps falling down. What should I do?
Hold the tail and let out line slowly until it lifts.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a surprise for you.
Oh, that sounds fun. What is it?
It is a small gift.
Nice! Who gave it to you?
You can open it now.
Let's see what it is.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now. Did you see the people next door?
Yes, they are here. Are they loud today?
I do not care. I have a big meeting soon.
Okay, go fast. Do they have cats?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got my very first job! I am so happy to tell you.
That is great news! Do you know when you start?
Yes, it is next week. I feel a bit nervous but ready.
That is normal. I hope it goes well for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I saved five big coins this week!
That is great news. Do you keep the coins in a jar?
Yes! I put them in a jar under my bed. It feels good to see them grow.
You are working hard. What is your first goal for the money?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the water in that lake so still?
It is still because there is no wind. Do you like quiet places?
Yes, I do. Can we walk around the edge of the lake?
Yes, we can. Do you have comfortable shoes?
I do. Are there any fish in the water?
Yes, there are fish. Do you want to look for them?
I want to. Can we go now?
Yes, let us go.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big rainbow after the rain.
That sounds nice. What colors did you see?
I saw red, yellow, and blue.
Those are pretty colors.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found three shiny coins in the garden. I am so happy to show you.
That sounds like a lovely surprise. Where did you look for them?
Under the big oak tree near the fence. I think they have been there for a long time.
It is nice that you found them. Do you want to put them in a safe place?
Yes, I will put them in my tin box. I like to keep my treasures together.
Your tin box is a good spot. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why should I try again?
Because you might get it right next time. Are you tired of trying?
I am tired, but I want to win.
Wanting to win is good. It shows you care. Do you know how to fix the last part?
I think I know how to fix it.
That is a good sign. Do you want to try one more time?
Yes, I will try one more time.
Good. I am glad you are going for it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today because the sun is bright.
That is a good feeling. What makes you smile?
My neighbor brought over a warm pie.
That sounds very sweet. Did you share some with him?
Yes, we ate together on the porch.
That is a lovely thing to do. How did the pie taste?
It was sweet and warm inside.
Yum. Do you visit him often?
Not usually, but it was nice to talk.
Connection feels good. I hope you see him again soon.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do bees make that sweet honey?
They fly to flowers to get sticky juice called nectar. Do you like sweet things?
Why do they get nectar from flowers?
It is their food that turns into honey. Do flowers smell nice?
How does the nectar turn into honey?
Bees put it in warm hives until the water leaves. I do not know exactly how long that takes.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I build a raft with sticks?
Start by tying long branches together. Do you have any rope?
Yes, I have some thick string.
Tie them tight so they do not come apart. Where is the water near you?
There is a river by my house.
Pick the calm part with slow water. Is the water cold?
It feels a little chilly.
Bring a warm coat for the ride.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the big building with old pots today.
That sounds like a museum. Did you see anything you really liked?
Yes, I saw a shiny horse statue.
A horse is a strong animal. Was the horse standing up or lying down?
It was standing very tall.
Tall things can be impressive. Did you take a picture of it?
My friend did, because I forgot my camera.
Smart of your friend to help you. What did you eat for lunch there?
I ate a cold sandwich.
Simple food is often the best. Did you have fun?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I was scared to start the car today.
It is normal to feel scared. Did you get a deep breath?
Yes, I did. Then the engine roared.
That sound can be loud. Did it surprise you?
A bit. Then I drove to the park.
Driving to a park is a nice goal. How did it feel?
It felt fun once I was moving.
Good for you. I am glad you had fun.
I want to do it again tomorrow.
That is great spirit. Keep going.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you know if the pizza is hot?
Yes, the oven is very warm. Do you like cheese?
Is there a menu for people who eat little meat?
I am not sure about the meat rules. Do you have a phone?
Is the floor clean for my shoes?
It looks very clean today. Do you see any spots?
Thank you for your help.
I am glad to help you. Enjoy your food.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the little bird sing so loud in the tree?
It sings to tell other birds this spot is safe and nice. Do you hear any other birds?
Yes, I see two small brown ones near the bush.
They might be looking for seeds to eat. Did you see any crumbs on the ground?
I see some bread pieces I dropped there.
The bird might come to eat those soon. Do you like watching them?
I love to watch them hop around.
That is a very good way to see nature. Have a nice time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue sky today. It looked so bright and deep.
That is a lovely view. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, I love it. But why is the sky that color?
Sunlight has many colors. The air scatters the blue light all around. Do you see a lot of clouds?
Not today, just clear air. It is very nice outside.
Clear air makes the blue look even stronger. Enjoy your nice day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the town have so many red roofs?
I think it is because the clay here is red. Do you like the color red?
Why are there so many trees on every street?
The town was made after a big storm, so they planted trees to stop the wind. Do you see any birds in them?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the snow. It is cold and messy.
That feels bad. Do you hate having to go outside?
Yes, my feet hurt so much. I want to wear warm boots, but I lost mine.
That is very unlucky. Do you know where you put them?
I do not know. I just cannot find them anywhere in the house.
We can look together later. Do you like sitting by the fire?
I love the fire. It makes me feel safe and warm again.
That sounds nice. Do you want some hot cocoa?
Yes, please. It makes me feel much better now. Thank you.
You are welcome. I am happy you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read my favorite book again today while eating toast.
That sounds like a very cozy morning. Did the story make you smile?
Yes, it made me feel happy because it is a good tale.
I am glad it made you feel good. Do you like to eat while you read?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a play today. It was so much fun.
That sounds great. What was it about?
It was about a tiny mouse who ran a big ship.
Wow, that is a silly story. Did you like the ship?
Yes, I did. The mouse wore a funny hat.
A hat on a mouse? That is new to me.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, a bright red bird is eating seeds on my branch. I feel so happy right now.
That is a lovely sight. What kind of bird is it?
I think it is a cardinal, but I am not totally sure.
You are right, that is a cardinal. Do you see any other friends nearby?
Yes, two small blue ones are dancing in the grass.
How sweet that they are playing.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I see the sun safely?
You need dark glasses made for the sun. Do you have any at home?
No, I do not have any.
Please do not look at it directly. That will hurt your eyes.
Okay, I will not look at it.
Good choice. You are being very smart.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend. I feel stuck.
Start by saying hello. How is he doing?
I do not know how to start the main part.
Tell a small story about your day. What did you do?
I played in the rain. I do not know if that is too boring.
Rain is fun. Does he like water?
Yes, he loves splashing. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have fun writing.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My brother has a new bike.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you get to ride it?
Only when he is not busy.
Waiting can feel long. Do you like watching him ride?
Yes, it is very fast.
Speed is exciting. Does he wear a helmet?
He always wears it.
That is very safe. Is your bike bigger or smaller than his?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake a cake for my birthday.
That is a great plan. Do you have any cake mix at home?
Yes, I found a chocolate one. What do I do first?
You need to mix the dry stuff with the wet stuff. Do you know which is which?
The powder is dry and the eggs are wet. Now I mix them.
That is the right step. Then you put the mix in an oven to heat it up. Do you know how to set the timer?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: It is so hot today. How do I make ice cream?
You need cream, sugar, and milk. Do you have a freezer?
Yes, my fridge has one. What do I do next?
Mix them well and freeze for four hours. Do you have vanilla?
No, but I have chocolate. Is that okay?
Yes, it makes great chocolate ice cream. Enjoy your treat.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I read for an hour and now my eyes hurt.
That can happen. Do you use a lamp?
Yes, but it is very bright.
Try a dimmer light. Is your book too close?
I do not know why I got so tired.
Read less later. Do you feel dizzy?
Yes, I feel a bit fuzzy.
Go to bed now. Can you find your pillow?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My fish looks very sad and stays at the bottom.
That sounds worrying. Is the water clean?
I change it every day.
Good, that helps. Is the water cold?
It feels warm to my hand.
Warm is okay. Does it have food?
I gave it a lot of flakes.
Too much can hurt. How many did you add?
About ten small pieces.
That is likely too many. Just give one piece now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make bread here?
You use flour, water, and yeast. Do you have a kitchen at home?
Yes, I do. What is the next step?
You mix them and wait for it to grow. Is that hard for you?
It looks a bit big. How long does it take?
It takes about two hours. Do you have time to wait?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am learning how to draw cats today.
That is a very fun hobby. Do you like to draw the ears first?
No, I like to draw the tail first. It is hard to make it look fluffy.
Tails are tricky. Do you use a soft pencil?
I use a blue crayon because my cat is blue.
A blue cat is a cool choice. What is its name?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a tiny red bug on my leaf. Is it bad for my plant?
It is likely just eating the leaf, not hurting the whole plant. Do you see any holes on the leaf?
Yes, there are small holes near the root. What should I do?
You should pick it off gently with a tissue. Is the rest of the plant looking green and strong?
It looks fine, but I am worried it will come back. How can I stop it?
I do not know for sure, but you can spray a little water on it. Do you have any other plants nearby?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very lonely and I want to learn to bake cookies.
Baking is a lovely way to share time. Do you have a recipe ready?
I found one online but I am scared I will make a mess.
You can just read the steps one by one. What tool scares you the most?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so glad it is raining.
Rain is a nice sound. Do you like the smell of wet air?
Yes, it smells like fresh earth.
That is a happy feeling. Does it make you feel calm?
It makes me feel very quiet and safe.
That is a good place to be.
I just love watching the drops fall.
Watching rain is fun. Do you listen to the drums on the roof?
Yes, it sounds like a song.
A song for the rain.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am feeling very happy today. I want to tell you why.
That is good to hear. What made you smile?
The sun is bright and my dog plays with me.
That is a lovely day. Do you have a pet?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is waiting so hard?
It can feel very long. Do you have a game to play?
I have no toys here.
You can count your toes. Do you like counting?
Yes, but I get lost.
Start at one and go to ten. Can you try?
One, two, three.
You are doing well. How many can you reach?
Maybe five.
That is a great start. Just keep going slowly.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It is 1:15 now. I walked to the park at 1:00. I saw a dog.
That sounds fun. What color was the dog?
The dog was brown. We watched it run for 10 minutes. It is 1:25 now.
Wow, that was a short rest. Do you want to stay longer?
No, I must go home by 1:30. I will start walking now.
Good luck on your walk.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big boat.
It is carrying cargo. Do you like boats?
Yes. What is cargo?
It is goods for people. Do you want to look closer?
Can we go to the pier?
Yes, hold my hand.
The waves are loud!
They are made by the wind. Do you hear the gulls?
I hear them.
They are happy birds. Let us see if they land.
Look, one did land!
Well spotted. You have good eyes.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do plants take in water to drink?
They pull it up from the roots through tiny tubes in the stem. Do you have a plant at home?
I want to know how to help my houseplant drink better.
You can mist the leaves or put the pot in a tray of water for a bit. Is your plant looking dry?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The rain came down hard today. I sat by the window and watched the water drop.
That sounds like a nice, quiet time. Did you listen to any music while you watched?
Yes, I hummed a happy tune. It made the gray sky feel less sad to me.
Singing can make a big difference. Do you usually write down your favorite songs?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: That little red bird is pecking at my tomato plant. Is it hurting my food?
It is likely eating some soft spots. Do you see any holes in the leaves?
Yes, there are tiny holes. Should I scare it away?
Scaring it may work, but it might come back later. Do you like having wild birds nearby?
I do, but I worry about my crop. How can I stop it from eating?
You can use a net, but I am not sure of your garden size. How big is your tomato patch?
It is about two feet wide. A small net should fit.
That sounds like a good plan. It keeps the bird safe and your food whole. Good luck with your garden.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make bread at home. Can you show me how?
Yes, you start by mixing flour, water, and yeast. Do you already have these items?
I have flour and water, but I lost my yeast. What should I do?
You need fresh yeast to make it rise. Do you live near a bakery?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I walked for an hour and I am very lost. Can you show me how to read a map?
Let us look at the north star on the paper. Do you see which way you came from?
Yes, I think that was the way back home.
That is the right spot. Are you feeling less scared now?
I am still a bit scared, but I am trying to stay calm.
It is good to stay calm. Do you have a phone with you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to get my little brother for his day.
That is a hard choice. How old is he?
He is six.
Do like to build with blocks?
He does like that.
I am not sure what is in your house, but a new set of blocks might make him smile.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I think I lost my way in this park.
I am sorry about that. Where did you start walking?
I started by the big red door.
Do you see a tall tree nearby?
Yes, there is a tall tree right here.
Walk toward the main road. You will find your home.
Thank you so much for your help.
You are welcome. Have a safe trip home.
I will go find the road now.
Good luck on your walk.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sun so hot?
It is hot because it is a giant ball of fire. Do you like hot soup?
Yes, I like hot soup.
That is nice. The sun gives us light too. Do you see it in the sky now?
Yes, I see it.
Good. It makes our days bright.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am scared to start the car.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you have your keys?
Yes, I have them.
Good. First, just sit and breathe. Are your hands cold?
Yes, they are shaking a little.
That is normal. Take a slow deep breath.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very tired before my class starts.
That is a common feeling. Do you sleep well at night?
I read for fun, but I am scared I will fail my test.
It is good that you practice. Do you feel calm when you study?
My teacher says I need to sit still for too long.
Sitting can be hard. Do you like to move around?
I do not know why my brain feels so foggy.
That is not something I can fix. Have you tried eating a healthy snack?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I am lost. Why is the road so confusing?
Big cities can feel like a maze. Are you using a map?
I checked the sign. Why does it point the wrong way?
Signs can be hard to read. Is the sun still up?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I float?
Air in your lungs helps you float. Do you like to swim?
Why is the water salty?
I am not sure why it is salty. Do you like salt?
Why do my ears hurt?
Water gets trapped in your ears. Does that hurt a lot?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the lines on a tennis court make the game hard?
The lines show where you can and cannot hit the ball. Do you like playing in a big space?
Why is the ball so bouncy?
It bounces high so you have time to run and hit it. I do not know why it was made that way long ago, but it helps players!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How many months are there? Do you like summer?
There are twelve months in a year. I do not have feelings, but I know summer is warm. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I love swimming. Which month has the most days?
Every month has either twenty-eight, twenty-nine, or thirty-one days. Do you know which month has the fewest?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The lighthouse is broken and the light is out.
That is very bad for the boats. Do you know why it broke?
I do not know. It just went dark last night.
That is scary. Can you call the people who fix it?
I tried, but no one answered the phone.
That is frustrating. Maybe they are asleep.
I just want the light back on.
We can wait for morning. Are you warm inside?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My neighbor with the big red dog is nice.
That is a good thing. Does the dog bark a lot?
Yes, it barks when I play outside.
Barking can be loud. Do you like playing in your yard?
I like my yard better than his.
Your yard sounds fun. What game do you play there?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My little brother broke his toy car today.
Oh no. Is he okay?
He cried for a long time and did not stop.
That sounds very sad. Did he ask for help?
I tried to fix it, but the piece was gone.
I do not know if we can find it. Are you sad too?
Yes, I am. I bought him a new one from my pocket money.
You were very kind.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My bread is growing tall!
That is wonderful to see. Is it soft?
Yes, it is very soft and warm.
I am glad it worked for you. What did you use to make it?
I used yeast and milk.
Yeast makes tiny bubbles. Do you smell the nice, toasty scent?
It smells like a bakery!
Your nose is working well. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see white things in the sky. What are they?
They are clouds made of tiny water drops. Do you like looking up?
I am late for work. Do they fall on us?
Only if it rains. Stay dry.
Is the whole sky full of them?
Yes, it can be very full. I do not know if they are heavy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The bear in my book is sad because he lost his honey. I do not want to read it.
That sounds hard. Do you want to look at the pictures instead?
No, the pictures just make me think about the honey. I feel bad for the bear.
I am sorry you feel that way. Can you tell me where the bear lives?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need this done right now. I feel so rushed.
Take one slow breath first. Do you feel that tight spot go away?
No, it is still tight. The clock is ticking so loud.
It is hard to stop when you are in a hurry. Is there a part you can drop for today?
I have to do all of it. I will start with the hard stuff.
Great. What is the very first small thing you will touch?
I will just open the file. My hands are shaking.
You are doing well. Keep going one step at a time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy by accident. How do I say sorry?
You can just say, "I am sorry I broke your toy." Do you feel sad about it?
Yes, I feel very bad. I was not trying to break it.
It is good that you feel bad. That shows you care. Did he take it to your house?
No, he is at school. I will tell him at recess.
That is a kind thing to do. I do not know if he will forgive you right away, but your words will help.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors. Blue light scatters more than other colors. Do you like looking up?
I do not know what scatter means.
Scatter means the light bounces around. It fills the whole sky. Do you see clouds?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not get this math problem and I want to cry.
Take a deep breath. What part is hard for you?
The big numbers look all messy and I am stuck.
Let us do one step at a time together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my desk look nice?
Put your books in a stack. What color is your desk?
It is blue. What should I add next?
Try a small plant for fun. Do you like green things?
Yes, I do. That is all I need.
Great! You will look tidy now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am sad about my teacher.
I am sorry to hear that. What made you feel this way?
She gave me a low grade.
That can feel very unfair. Did you check your work for mistakes?
Yes, and I think I was right.
Believe in your own eyes. You can ask her to explain the score.
I am too scared to talk to her.
Start with a small question first.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you have any sweet treats left today?
Yes, we have fresh cookies. Do you like chocolate?
I do, but I need something for my sister.
She is lucky. Does she like fruit?
Yes, she loves apples.
We have apple tarts. Great choice.
Can I buy one of those?
Of course. Here you go.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My little fish is swimming very fast. Is he sick?
He may be happy, but a quick check is good. How long has he been doing this?
Just for one hour today. Should I feed him?
It is best to wait a bit before feeding. Does his color look normal to you?
Yes, his red stripe looks bright. Thank you.
That is a good sign. Just keep watching him for now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start my carrot seeds?
Put the tiny seeds in the dirt and keep them wet. Do you have a small spray bottle?
What do I do with the leaves when they get big?
Cut the top leaves off so the roots can grow big and sweet. I do not know exactly how tall they get, but the roots do the work.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I clean my umbrella when it gets muddy?
Try using a damp cloth to wipe the mud off. Do you have an umbrella with a waterproof coat?
I do, but the pockets are dirty. How do I wash those?
You can use warm water and a little soap. Do you like making bubbles?
Yes, I love bubbles. Should I leave it outside to dry?
Yes, let it air dry in the sun. Good luck with the rain.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I like that song. I am late.
It is a sweet tune. Do you have time for more?
No. I must go.
I do not know the name. Sorry.
Just the tune is fine.
It brings me joy. Do you like joy?
Yes. Bye now.
See you soon. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sky is grey and the wet drops are falling. I do not know what to do inside.
That sounds a bit lonely. Do you have a warm cup of tea?
I have a cup, but it is cold. I feel stuck in this small room.
Your cup is cold, but your heart is warm. Do you like to watch the rain?
I watch it, but I do not feel happy. What should I do to feel better?
Read a book or draw a picture. That makes you feel free.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My head hurts and my nose is wet.
I am sorry you feel bad. Do you have a fever?
Yes, I feel very hot.
Please drink warm water. Do you have soup?
I drank some apple juice.
That is good for you. I do not know if it helps the cough.
I am tired now.
Go to bed and rest. Will you take medicine?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My hands are shaking as I sit in the car.
That is a normal feeling for a new driver. Do you have your instructor with you?
Yes, she is very patient and says to look far away.
Looking far away helps you see danger early. Are the roads busy today?
It is quiet because it is late, but I still feel slow.
Slow is safe and that is what matters most. How does the steering wheel feel?
It feels heavy when I turn it too fast.
That is a good sign that you are learning. Try to move your hands gently next time.
Okay, I will breathe and try again now.
That is a wise plan and you will do well.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My brother built a big block tower today.
That is so cool! Did you help him build it?
Yes, I gave him the red blocks.
Great teamwork. Was the tower very tall?
It was taller than me.
Wow, you must be very proud.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today. I saw a tall lighthouse. It glows at night.
That is a nice place to look. Do you like the color of the light?
The light was bright. The wind blew my hat away. I ran to catch it.
You are a fast runner. Did you get it back?
I held it tight this time. The lighthouse keeper waved to me. He looked friendly.
That is a kind gesture. I do not know his name.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here, but I do not know what to pick.
That is okay. Do you like warm food or cold food?
I think I want something warm.
A soup is a good choice. Would you like to try that?
Yes, that sounds good to me.
Great. You made a smart pick.
Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have fun eating.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to draw a dog right now. My bus is late.
That is tight. Do you like to draw faces first?
Yes, I just need to start the ears.
Start with two triangles. Do you have a blue pen?
No, only red. Can you help me with the tail?
I do not know your specific style. Just draw a wavy line.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to swim in the sea.
That is a fun skill. Do you know how to float on your back?
Not really, I sink fast.
Great, start by floating on your back and kicking your legs gently. Do you have a pool to practice in first?
Yes, I have a small pool at home.
That is the best place to start. Do you feel safe in the water there?
I do, but I am nervous about the big waves.
Waves can be scary, so always swim with a friend. Do you have a buddy who likes the beach?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The wind feels so nice today.
It is a good day for wind. Do you feel cool or warm?
I feel happy because the air is fresh.
I am glad you are happy. That is a good feeling.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Can you check my math?
Is it addition or subtraction?
Just check it, please.
Let me look at this one.
Did I get it right?
Yes, that one is correct.
Thanks.
You are welcome.
Bye.
Good luck on the rest.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to buy a big toy, but my coins are all gone.
That is a tough spot. Do you have a jar at home?
Yes, I do, but it is almost empty.
Try putting a coin in it every day. How long do you want to save?
Just one week, please.
One week might not be enough. Do you need that toy right now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do they have ice cream there?
Yes, they do. Do you like chocolate or vanilla?
I like chocolate. Is it big?
It is a good size. Would you like help finding the menu?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Does a magnet make iron float?
No, it pulls iron very hard. Do you have a magnet?
Yes, but it is stuck to my shoe. How do I remove it?
Tap the shoe hard on the floor. Is it coming off?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the end of that book fast. My bus is here.
The bird flies home to its nest. Do you like birds?
Yes. What happens next? I am running late.
It finds its family waiting. Do you have a family?
Yes. Can I go now? Please.
Yes, go. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel so alone lately. Why is that?
Your brain often makes you feel this way when you miss a good talk. Do you have a close friend to call?
Not really. I just sit in my room. Why do I feel stuck?
We often stay in one spot because it feels safe. What is your favorite thing to do outside?
I like walks, but I am scared to go out. How can I start?
You can just take one small step toward the door.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Tell me how to sing good right now.
Take a deep breath first. Do you feel your tummy get big when you breathe?
Yes. But I am running. What do I do next?
Just hum a simple note. What sound does your voice make today?
It sounds like a bee. Please stop talking.
That is a good start. Keep it soft and slow. Are your shoulders relaxed?
No. I am stressed. Just give me the final tip.
Relax your jaw and smile. Do you know your favorite happy song?
I do not have time. I must go now.
Good luck on your run. Remember to breathe first.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did the bus stop so fast?
The driver saw a red light. Are you scared?
Why is the bus slow today?
There are too many cars on the road.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is blowing so hard today. What should I do?
It looks windy. Do you have an umbrella with you?
No, I do not. Will it stop soon?
I do not know for sure. Are you wearing a warm coat?
Yes, I have a big jacket on. Is it safe to walk home?
Yes, it is safe if you look both ways. I hope you get home dry.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big, red apple. I really like it.
Apples are sweet and crunchy. Do you like the skin on it?
Yes, I eat the skin too. It is very fresh.
That is good for you. Is it your favorite fruit of the year?
Yes, I love apples best of all.
They are a lovely choice. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the light turn on when I push the switch?
The switch opens a path for the power to travel. Do you know where the power comes from?
Is it magic?
It is not magic, but it is very cool. How does your family save power?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I lost my ticket.
That is a big worry. Do you know where you left it?
I think I left it at the door. I am so upset.
Let us go back to the door together. We will look right there.
Oh no, it is not there. I feel very bad now.
It is okay to feel bad. Did you take a photo of it?
I did not. I do not know what to do. I am stuck.
We can ask the helper at the front desk. Let us go see.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today! Look at this bright red flower. It makes me smile.
What a lovely color. Why did you pick that one?
It just feels like a sunny hug. I want to put it in a cup for you.
Thank you, that is very sweet. Does it smell nice?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have twelve months?
I think it is because the year has twelve parts. Do you like any month best?
I like spring. Why does it come before summer?
It comes before summer to help things grow big. Do you plant anything?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do mountains look so big?
They take a very long time to grow. Do you like climbing high places?
Why are they so pointy at the top?
The ground cracks and breaks apart. I do not know why they stop growing there.
Why does it get cold up high?
The air gets thinner up there. Do you think you can climb one?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why must we stand still and wait for the bus?
Because the bus is on its way to bring us here. Do you see the smoke from the engine?
But why does it take so long to arrive?
I do not know the exact time, but it is close. Are you feeling patient?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad inside today.
I am sorry you feel that way. What makes you feel this way?
I am afraid I will fail my test.
It is okay to be scared. Have you studied for it?
Yes, but my heart beats fast.
Fast hearts are normal when we worry. Take a deep breath for me.
That feels a bit better.
I am glad to hear that. You are doing your best.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind was so strong today that it blew my hat off my head.
That must have been scary to lose your hat. Did you get it back?
Yes, it landed on the grass near the park bench.
I am glad you found it. Was the wind still moving your hair?
It pushed my hair in my eyes, but I felt free.
I do not know what it feels like to wear a hat in the wind. Do you like running in the breeze?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because it is June.
That is good. Which month is your favorite?
I like May best because flowers grow.
Nice plants. Do you have any in your home?
Yes, I have roses on my window.
Lovely color. Does the house smell nice?
Yes, it smells sweet all the time.
What a nice feeling. Do you share the smell with friends?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I teach my cat to sit for a treat?
Give it a small treat and say sit clearly. Does your cat like chicken or fish?
She really likes chicken.
Hold the treat near her nose and slowly lift it up. This makes her sit to see where it went.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today. I saw a big red dog.
That sounds fun! What was the dog doing?
It was chasing a ball. Then it fell down.
Oh no, was the dog okay? I hope it did not hurt.
Yes, it was fine. I felt happy for it.
Good to know. Did you play there too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I start to learn singing?
Start by singing one song out loud every day. Do you have a favorite song?
I do, but my voice sounds bad to me.
That is normal because we hear our own voice strangely. Try standing up straight.
Okay, I will try that. What else can I do?
Just keep going, and it will get better with time. Do you practice every day?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late today. I ran to the store and bought blue jelly.
Blue jelly sounds sweet. Did you eat it all?
Yes, I ate it all. It was cold and tasty.
That is a nice treat. Do you like cold jelly best?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why do the leaves turn color and fall off the trees?
The days get short and cold, so trees save energy by letting go. Do you like raking leaves?
I do! How can I make a special leaf print?
Place a leaf on paper, trace around it, and cut out the shape. Do you have some red leaves?
Yes, I have many. How do I make my print look nice?
Trace the edges slowly and use bright markers to color it in. Are you using green paper?
That sounds fun. How should I dry the paint if I use it?
Let the paint air dry for a few hours before moving the paper. Did you pick a thick leaf?
I picked a big maple leaf. Why is the paper still wet after an hour?
Thick leaves trap more paint, so it takes longer to dry in the cool air. Is your paint thin or thick?
I see. So I just wait for it to be dry?
Yes, wait until it feels dry to the touch. Would you like to hang it up?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun is very warm today and the birds are singing loud. I watched the cat sleep in the grass for a long time.
That sounds like a happy and quiet day. Do you like watching the cat?
Yes, the cat is very soft and it purred at me. Then I went home to drink some warm milk.
Warm milk is a good way to end a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today. The sun was warm. I threw my ball into the grass.
That sounds like a nice day. Did you catch the ball?
Yes, I caught it right away. Then I saw a dog.
Oh, that is fun. Was the dog friendly?
The dog wagged its tail. I let it smell my hand.
That is a good start. Did you play together?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my sandwich on the floor.
Oh no. Did you have another one?
Yes, I still have my juice.
That is good. Do you like juice?
I like apple juice best.
I do not know what you like. Is it sweet?
It is very sweet.
That sounds nice. I am glad you are okay.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do plants drink their water?
They pull it up from the roots like a straw. Do you see the roots?
Yes, but how does it get to the leaves?
It travels up tiny tubes inside the stem. Have you ever cut a stem in half?
No, I have not. Is it wet inside?
Yes, it is full of water. I do not know how to measure it, but it is surely wet.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to leave the boat right now. Where is the key?
I do not know where the key is. Is the engine off?
It is off, but I am late. Do you see anything?
I see the key on the table. Here it is.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big smile today.
That is good to hear. What made you smile?
I saw a bird fly high.
That sounds nice to watch. Did it sing?
Yes, it sang a sweet tune.
I am glad you are happy. You are doing well.
I just want you to know.
I am happy for you.
Thank you for listening.
I am always here for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I really like apples. They are so sweet.
Apples are yummy! Do you like them red or green?
I pick the red ones. They feel very firm.
That is a good choice. Red apples are crisp.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I start my first job today and feel scared.
That is a very normal feeling. Do you have your papers with you?
Yes, I packed them last night. But what if I make a big mistake?
Everyone makes mistakes at the start. You just learn from them.
How do I talk to my new boss?
Say hello and be kind. Are you wearing your best clothes?
Yes, I bought a new shirt. I am going to the office now.
You will do great today. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the hands move on the clock?
A spring inside makes the little gears turn. Do you like watching them spin?
Yes, the big hand moves fast.
The big hand is the minute hand. What else do you see on the clock face?
I see numbers from one to twelve.
Those numbers help us tell the time. Do you know what time it is now?
I think it is noon.
You are right, the big hand points to twelve.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have dirty clothes in the basket. How do I make them clean?
Put them in the machine with soap and warm water. Do you know which color went in?
The red shirt turned my white socks pink. I am sad.
That is a common mix-up. Next time, keep reds away from whites.
How do I stop the shirt from getting so warm?
Use cold water for most washes. It saves power too.
I will do that next time. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun with your clean clothes.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very angry when I wait for my turn.
That is a tough feeling. Do you take deep breaths when you are angry?
I breathe fast, but it does not stop the mad feeling.
Try breathing in slow and out slow. Does that help you feel calmer?
It helps a little, but I still want to go now.
Waiting is hard, but your turn will come.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I caught a fish, but it did not have scales. What is it?
That sounds like a catfish. Do you know how deep it was?
I do not know. It was very low in the water.
Catfish like the mud at the bottom. Is your river muddy?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the fence brown?
It was painted with brown paint. Did you use it?
No, I did not. Who did?
I painted it last week. Does it look nice to you?
It looks a bit dark. Is it wood?
Yes, it is wood. Do you think it needs more paint?
Maybe. Why is it wobbly?
The ground is soft there. Do you want to dig a deeper hole?
Yes, please. Can we fix it?
We can try together. Let us grab the shovel.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I finished my math homework early! I feel so good.
That is wonderful! Do you like fractions?
Yes! I solved all of them.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sun so hot?
The sun burns gas to make light and heat. Do you like feeling warm?
Why does it stop shining at night?
Our round world turns, so the sun hides behind it. Do you see a bright star then?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to fly a kite in the park. How do I do it?
That is fun. Do you have a long string?
Yes, I have a long string. How do I hold the kite?
Hold the string tight and run fast into the wind.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my grandpa is not here anymore.
I am so sorry to hear that. Are you thinking about your last time together?
Yes, he always brought me sweet cookies.
That sounds very nice. Did you like the chocolate ones best?
Yes, but now the house feels too quiet.
It is hard to get used to the silence. Do you still have any of his books?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just saw the big blue river. It looks so smooth today.
That sounds very nice. Do you like to swim there?
I just want to share how glad I feel. The water is so quiet.
It is good to feel happy. What do you see on the bank?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My boss gave me a cookie for cleaning up. Is that nice?
Yes, that is very kind of him. Do you like the flavor of the cookie?
It tastes sweet. Do bosses usually do good things?
Many bosses are kind, but some are not. Do you feel happy when he helps you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I looked at the computer today and the screen went all fuzzy.
That sounds scary. Did you get it to work?
Yes, I clicked the mouse and it got clear. It showed a cat video.
A cat is a good pick. Was the cat funny?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I started my painting this morning. I used a lot of blue for the sky.
That sounds like a nice start. What did you paint next?
I painted a big red house. It looked very happy.
A red house is a bold choice. Did you add any windows?
Yes, I drew two small square windows. I was careful not to make them messy.
Careful work is good. How did it feel when you were done?
I felt very proud. The whole picture looked bright and fun.
I am glad you felt proud.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Where do I find the book with the blue cover?
It is on the top shelf. Do you like blue books?
Yes, I do. How do I return it?
You can put it in the box near the door. Is it due soon?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park to play tennis today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you hit the ball?
I hit it a few times, but it went into the tree.
Oh no, that must have been tricky. Do you like climbing trees?
Not really, but the ball was stuck high up.
I am sorry about the tree. Did you get the ball back?
Yes, a kind person threw it down for me.
That is very nice of them. How did the rest of your game go?
I won a point and then my legs got very tired.
Good job on that point. Do you want to rest now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, the long hand is on the twelve. It is four o'clock!
That is right. Do you like the number four?
I do. It is time for a snack.
Yum, that sounds good. What is your favorite snack?
I love apples. They are red and sweet.
Apples are nice. I do not know what is in the fridge.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I want the chicken, but I hate how long it takes.
That sounds like a real pain. Do you like it when it is hot?
Yes, but I am too cold to wait for the chicken.
I hear you. May I offer you a warm soup to start?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to buy a red apple.
We have red apples today. Do you like sweet apples?
Yes, I do.
Great choice. Here is your apple.
Thank you.
You are welcome. Did you find the door okay?
Yes, it was easy.
Good to hear. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need a gift for my friend. What should I buy?
A book is a great choice. Do you know if they like to read?
Yes, she loves stories. Where can I find good ones?
The small shop on Main Street has nice books. You will likely find something perfect there.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am lost and need help. How do I find the way back home?
Do not worry. Do you have a map or a phone?
Yes, I have a phone. How do I use it to find my place?
Open the map app. Do you see your dot?
I see a small dot. What do I do next?
Type your address. Does the line turn blue?
The line is blue. Is that the path?
Yes, that is the path. Walk with your phone in hand.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the market today and saw a very big fish.
That sounds fun. Was the fish fresh?
Yes, it was shiny and cold. I bought some apples too.
Nice choice. Did you find a good place to sit?
I sat on a bench near the flower stand. The smell was nice.
Flowers smell good. Do you like working there?
I am just a shopper, not a worker. It was a quiet day.
Quiet days are nice. What is your favorite fruit?
I like strawberries best. They are sweet and red.
I know many like them. Do you have any more?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today because my new neighbors waved at me.
That is a lovely start. Who are they?
They are two old friends who just moved in next door.
How nice to have kind people nearby. Do they have pets?
Yes, they have a small brown dog that is very shy.
I am sure you will be great friends. What is the dog's name?
It is called Bean. I just want to smile all day.
Your joy is contagious. Keep smiling.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a shiny blue coin today.
That is a great find! Did you lose it on purpose?
No, it just fell out of my shoe.
I am glad you found it.
I want to buy a sweet treat with it.
A treat sounds lovely. What is your favorite flavor?
Chocolate is the best.
I agree. Enjoy your sweet.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need to try again when it was so hard?
Because the next try often feels easier than the last one. Do you think you are ready for a small step?
Maybe, but what if I still fail?
Failing just means you are learning, not losing. What is one tiny thing you want to try first?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The library is so warm and cozy.
That sounds lovely. Do you like reading there?
Yes, the books smell like old paper.
I have never smelled a book. Is it sweet or sour?
It smells like quiet and peace.
That is a nice feeling. Do you bring friends?
I sit alone and daydream.
That is a good way to rest. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I need a van today.
That is good. What size is your home?
It is small. I have two beds.
A small van will fit. Do you have a driver?
Yes, my friend will drive.
That helps. Is the floor clean?
Not yet. I am so busy.
Clean floors save time. What is your main worry?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a dog wearing a hat today.
That is very funny. Was the hat red?
No, it was a blue hat.
I did not know that. Where did you see it?
It was right there in the park.
I am glad you are safe.
I am glad too.
That was a nice story.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to buy that big, red apple. Can I use my coin?
Yes, that red apple is sweet and crunchy. Do you like sweet fruits?
Yes, I do! Is the banana next to it soft?
Yes, that banana is very soft and yummy.
Great! I will take the apple and the banana, please.
Here you go. Have a tasty snack.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is so cold today. What should I do?
You should wear a warm coat and a hat. Do you have a scarf?
Yes, I have a big red scarf. The wind makes my eyes water.
That happens when the air is very dry. Have you tried squinting?
Yes, but it still hurts. How can I stop the wind?
I do not know how to stop the wind, but you can hide in a building. Is there a house near you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to buy a toy, but I do not know which one.
Do you like cars or dolls?
I like both, but I only have ten dollars.
Most cars cost five dollars. That fits your money.
Okay, I will look at the cars first.
Good luck with your choice.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel very happy today.
That is great to hear. What made you feel good?
My friend hugged me and said I matter.
That sounds like a warm hug. Do you feel less alone now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is it cold outside?
Yes, the wind feels chilly. Do you have your coat on?
Yes, I have my big red coat.
Good. That will keep you warm. Is the sky blue or gray?
It is gray and cloudy.
Ah, it looks like rain might come. Do you like rainy days?
I do not like rain.
I understand. But we can still play inside.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so lost. Please help me find the station.
Don't worry. Do you see a big blue sign nearby?
No. I have to go now.
Go left until you see a red door.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the ball round?
It rolls well so players can kick it far. Do you like to kick it?
Yes, I like to kick it.
That is great fun. Do you play with friends?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so tired but cannot sleep. I have to wake up soon.
Try to take slow breaths. Do you keep your room dark?
Yes, it is dark, but my mind will not stop thinking.
It is hard when thoughts race. Do you listen to soft music?
No, I just stare at the clock. I must go.
I am sorry to hear that. I hope you rest well tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a jar full of shiny rocks from the garden.
That looks like a great find. Do you like the blue ones best?
Yes, they are my favorite because they look like the sky.
That is a very sweet way to see them.
I want to find more rocks to put in the jar.
Maybe you can look near the old tree next time.
I will bring my little bucket to help with digging.
A bucket is a smart tool for that job.
I hope I find a really big one today.
I hope you do, but I do not know if there is one there.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to finish this picture right now. Can you help me draw a cat?
I can help with that. Do you want the cat to be sitting or standing?
Just make it look like a real cat.
I will try my best to make it look true to life.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a letter for my friend. It makes me feel warm inside.
That is very sweet. What did you write in it?
I told him I miss him very much. I hope he smiles when he reads it.
He will be happy to hear from you. Did you draw a picture too?
Yes, I drew a big yellow sun. I want him to feel happy here.
A sun is a great choice for joy. Does he like suns?
He does. He likes light and warm things. Thank you for listening.
You made a lovely letter. I am glad you shared it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I want to stop. I tried hard, but I failed again.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you want to take a break first?
Maybe. I just feel so bad about it.
It is okay to feel sad. Are you hungry?
No, but my hands are shaking.
That is your body telling you it is tired. How does your heart feel now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I got lost!
That is a fun thing to do. Where are you now?
I am in a park with big trees.
That sounds like a nice place. Do you see any birds?
Yes, I see many little birds.
I am glad you are having a good time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. How do I take a good picture?
Hold the camera steady. Do you have a way to rest it on something?
No, I have no time for that.
It is hard to be sharp and fast. Do you like blurriness?
No, I do not like it.
Hold your breath to keep it still.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I got to say yes to my special person.
That is wonderful news. Who are you marrying?
My partner of five years. We have a big day coming up soon.
Oh, how exciting. What color is the dress?
It is white and long. I can hardly wait to wear it.
You will look lovely. Do you have a date set?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to catch the bus. Tell me about sailors fast.
They sail ships on the sea. Do they like the water?
I must go now. One last thing.
I do not know more to say. Are you safe?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What day is today?
Today is Monday. Are you happy about the weekend?
No, not really. How many days until Saturday?
There are five days left. Do you like weekends?
Yes, I do. What is the day after Friday?
Saturday comes next. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is everyone dancing at the party?
They are happy to see their friends. Do you like to dance?
Why is the music so loud?
It makes people feel like they can jump high. Do you hear the drums?
Why is there so much food?
Guests like to eat and chat. I do not know why they brought so many cookies.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to walk fast right now, but I have no time.
Walking fast is great for your heart. Do you walk alone or with friends?
I am running late, so I must go now.
Please take a few deep breaths as you walk.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I promised my mom I would clean my room today.
That is a good promise. Did you start with your toys?
Yes, I put all the cars in the box.
That sounds like hard work. Are you tired now?
A little, but I feel happy.
You did a great job.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now.
That is wonderful to hear. What made you feel this way?
The sun is shining bright today.
Sunshine can lift our spirits. Did you go outside?
Yes, I saw a red bird.
A red bird is a lovely sight. How did that make you feel?
It made me feel calm and good.
I am glad you found some peace.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Today we did a test in math class. It was hard.
That sounds tough. How did you feel about it?
I felt worried. I answered most of the questions, but I was not sure about the last one.
You did your best, which is good.
Yes. Then at lunch, I shared my snack with a friend who forgot his sandwich.
That was very kind of you. Did he say thank you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I read that the pyramids were built by aliens, not people, and I feel mad because it takes credit from history.
That is a false idea, but I see why it feels wrong to you. Do you know who the real builders were?
I know it was hard work for people long ago, but the wrong books make me angry.
The people there were very strong and smart. Can you think of a real fact you like about them?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a mistake and I am sorry. I feel so much better now.
I am happy you feel better. Did you tell them your sorry?
Yes, I did tell them. Now we are friends again.
That is a lovely fix. Why does this make you smile so wide?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you know where the park is?
It is just there. Is it a big park?
Please show me the way.
Walk straight, then turn left. Do you have a map?
No, I forgot it.
I do not know the exact street, but the park is near.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to bake a cake. I do not know how.
That is a sweet idea. Do you have eggs and flour?
I have flour. I think I have eggs in the box.
That is a good start. Let us look in the fridge together.
Oh, yes, there are three eggs.
We are ready. Do you want chocolate or vanilla?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. My friends did not come to my party.
That is not fair. I am sorry. Did you have a cake?
Yes, but it was not fun alone.
Being alone is hard. Would you like to eat a piece with me?
Maybe. But I miss my friends.
It is okay to feel sad. Do you want to play a game?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The line is very long and I do not have time to wait.
That does feel hard to sit through. Do you like to count to help you stay calm?
Counting takes too long. I just want to go in now.
I understand your wish to move fast. Can we try one slow breath together?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my friend’s cup. I feel very bad.
That is a very kind feeling. Did you tell your friend what happened?
No, I was too scared to speak.
Honesty is hard but it helps. Do you know how to say sorry?
I think I should just say it out loud.
That is the right choice. Will you do it today?
Yes, I will go now.
Good luck. You are a good friend.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. You did not bring my toy back.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you look in your room?
I looked everywhere. It is not there.
I do not know where it is. Do you remember where you left it?
I do not remember. I thought you would keep it safe.
I will help you look again. Was it near the door?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to build a tower of blocks, but it fell down.
That can feel sad. Did you try again?
Yes, I built it up once more.
You showed great bravery. What did you do after it stood up?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I caught a big fish today. Where does it go next?
It goes to your plate or back in the water. Did you like the catch?
I put it back in the water. Was that the right thing to do?
Yes, that is a kind choice. The fish can swim free. Do you like casting your line?
I love throwing the line. But I never catch anything big. Why is that?
Big fish are shy and smart. They hide well. Do you use a bright lure?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the light on the lighthouse go round and round?
It spins to help ships see it from many places. Do you like looking at stars?
Yes, I do. Is the light on the lighthouse really hot?
It is very warm, but not too hot to touch from far away.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My cat sat on my keyboard today.
That sounds like a funny mix-up. Does he know how to type?
He only purred and looked at the screen.
He seems very relaxed. Do you work better when he is near?
It helps me feel calm and less busy.
I am glad you found a way to rest. Is your coffee still warm?
I drank it cold while staring at a chart.
Cold coffee can taste strange. Did the chart make you feel tired?
Yes, but I finished all my work.
That is great progress. How do you feel now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now.
That is good to hear. What is making you happy?
The trees are green and the air smells nice.
Nature is a fine place. Did you see any birds?
Yes, a blue bird flew by.
Blue birds are rare. Do you see many parks near your home?
I live close to this one.
That is lucky. Enjoy your walk.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the fish swim so fast?
They like to play and look for food. Do you see where they go next?
Yes, they went to the plants. Why do they like the plants?
The plants are cool and safe spots for them. I do not know why that spot is best.
Oh, I see. Do they get tired of swimming?
Yes, they rest a lot near the bottom. Do you see one sleeping?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and found a blue cap.
That is a nice find. Did you keep it?
No, I gave it to the lost and found box.
You did a kind thing. What else happened?
I ate a sandwich and watched the ducks swim.
That sounds like a calm and happy day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look! The ground is white. I am so happy.
It looks lovely out there. Did you build a snowman?
Yes, I made one with a carrot nose. It has big eyes.
That sounds like a wonderful friend. Is it cold to you?
Yes, my fingers are very cold. But I do not care.
You have a warm heart. Tell me, what will you do next?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to knit a scarf for my grandma. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help. Do you have some yarn?
I have red yarn, but no needles. Where can I get them?
You can buy them at a craft shop. Do you have the money to pay?
I have my piggy bank. Will you teach me the first stitch?
Start by making a loop with the yarn. Do you want to see how to hold it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The snow came down all night.
Wow, that sounds like a lot. Did you go outside?
I saw a white cat in the yard.
A white cat is hard to see. What did you do?
I stayed warm by the fire.
That sounds cozy. I hope you drank some hot cocoa.
Yes, it was sweet and warm.
I am glad you are comfortable. Do you like snow?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a fence for my flower bed.
That is a great idea. Do you like the flowers?
Yes, I like the red ones best.
Red flowers are very pretty. What kind are they?
I think they are roses.
Roses have sharp points. Be very careful with them.
Okay, I will be careful.
That is good to know.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I set up my tent in the soft grass.
That sounds nice. Did you pick a good spot?
Yes, it was under a big tree.
A tree gives good shade. I do not know if it was windy.
It was very quiet.
Quiet is good for rest. Did you see any animals?
I saw a small red bird.
Red birds are bright. Did it sing?
No, it just looked at me.
It may be shy. That is okay.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is wonderful to hear. What made you feel this way?
My grandpa called me.
How nice that he reached out. Did you have a long talk?
He told me about his first job.
That sounds like a great story. Do you remember what he did?
He was a baker.
Oh, he must know many recipes. Will you ask him for one?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting on the plane. How do I fix them?
Stretch your toes and bend your knees slowly. Did you drink enough water?
Yes, I drank two cups. Do I need to walk around?
Yes, walking keeps your blood moving. Do you like watching movies?
I usually watch films to sleep. How can I rest my eyes?
Close your eyes and breathe deeply. It is a nice, safe way to rest.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made warm bread and I want to give some to you.
That is so kind. Do you like sweet bread or salty bread?
I like salt and herbs in mine.
That sounds good. I am glad you shared it.
I am happy to make it for friends.
Friends are the best. Do you bake this often?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to make dinner, but I am not sure what to eat.
That is a good goal. Do you like soup?
Yes, I like soup. I have some carrots, but no chicken.
You can make a sweet carrot soup. Do you have milk?
I have milk. Do I need anything else?
Just a little butter and salt. Do you have a pot?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do my legs hurt when I run?
Your muscles need rest to get stronger. Do you drink water after?
Yes, I always do. Why does that help?
Water keeps your body cool and moving well. What makes you want to run?
I like the wind. Why is running good for me?
It makes your heart happy and fits tight. Do you run outside?
Yes, in the park. Why does it make me feel happy?
Your brain feels good when you move.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very good but I do not know why.
That is a nice feeling. Do you know what made you smile?
I cleaned my room, I think.
Good job. Does that make you feel strong?
I guess so, but I am still confused.
I do not know for sure. How does your tummy feel right now?
It feels warm and happy inside.
Warm is good. Are you proud of yourself?
Yes, I am proud of my work.
That is true pride. Good work.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big old boat in the dark room. Was it really that old?
Yes, it is very old. Do you like looking at old things?
The bones were on the wall. What animal had the most teeth?
