I am not sure which one had the most. Did you count any of them?
I want to buy a toy. Is there a shop where we can buy one?
Yes, the shop is at the front. Did you find the shop yet?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are clouds white?
They reflect sunlight. Do you see how they glow?
But sometimes they are dark and gray.
That happens when they get very thick. Do you think they are heavy?
Do they fall down?
No, they stay in the sky. They are made of tiny bits of water.
Does it rain from them?
Yes, when the bits join up. Have you ever caught a drop?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does a big ship stay on the water?
The water pushes up to hold the weight. Do you like boats?
Yes, I do. What makes it push up?
It is a trick called buoyancy. Can you jump in a pool?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so good today! I want to help my neighbor carry her bags.
That is a kind thought. Do you know which side of the house she lives on?
Yes, she is right next door. She always smiles at me.
Smiles are a great sign. Are you going to knock on her door now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because I am going to the doctor.
That is good news. What makes you feel so happy?
I like the doctor and my mother is coming with me.
It is nice to have someone there with you.
I do not know what he will do, but I am not scared.
That is a brave feeling. Do you have any toys to bring?
Yes, I am bringing my bear so I can hold it.
Your bear will help you feel safe.
I am ready to go now and I feel great.
I am glad you feel good. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see the blue sky. How can I make a toy that shows why it is blue?
You can use a clear jar of water and a drop of milk. This shows how light scatters. What kind of glass jar do you have?
I have a big jar. Can I also use a flashlight?
Yes, point the light into the dark side of the jar. The blue glow will look like the sky. Do you have a flashlight at home?
I do have one. Will the color change if I add more milk?
Yes, more milk makes the color look more orange. This is like sunrise. How much milk do you want to try first?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am sitting by the window on the bus.
That is a nice place to sit. Do you like looking out the glass?
Yes, I see a big cat sleeping in a yard.
A sleeping cat is very cute. Is it black or white?
It is white with some gray spots on its back.
That sounds like a sweet cat.
The bus is stopping now at the corner.
Oh, are you getting off the bus?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does our teacher smile so much?
Because she is happy to see you. Do you like her smile?
Yes, but why is her voice so loud?
She wants everyone to hear the story.
Why does she use that big red pen?
It helps her mark work clearly. Is red your favorite color?
Why is she always so tired?
I do not know for sure. She works very hard.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a circle that looks round?
Start at the top and move your hand in a slow, smooth loop. Do you usually draw with your left hand or right?
I use my right hand.
Great, that makes it easier for most people. Try to keep your wrist relaxed like a loose hinge. What shape do you want to draw after the circle?
I want to draw a face.
Put two dots for eyes and a small curve for a smile. Are you nervous about making it look funny?
A little bit, yes.
Funny is just part of art. Keep going and you will get the hang of it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting so long.
That happens on long trips. Did you stretch your legs?
I tried, but my back is also sore.
Try leaning forward slowly. Does that help you feel better?
No, I just want to get off the plane.
We will land soon, so be patient.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tip at the restaurant?
You leave extra money for the waiter. Do you like giving thanks?
How much money should I leave?
Ten to twenty percent of the bill is good. It is a common rule.
What if the food was bad?
You can leave less money then. Did you hate the food?
Do I leave the tip on the table?
Yes, you put it on the plate. That is easy.
I will try that next time.
That sounds like a good plan. I hope you have a nice meal.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see the full moon tonight. How can I do that?
Look up at the sky after the sun goes down. Do you have a clear view of the sky where you live?
Yes, but it looks a bit thin today. Why is it not round?
The moon looks thin when it is in its crescent shape. It will get rounder as the days go by.
That is good to know. I will wait a few nights then.
That sounds like a great plan. Do you like to watch stars too?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know if robots can cook dinner for me right now.
Some robots can help with simple cooking. Do you like robots?
I am running very late and need an answer quickly.
I do not know your specific robot type. Are you in a big hurry?
Yes, please tell me if I am safe to use one.
You should always check the manual first for safety. Is the robot new?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very tired from the long flight. My legs hurt and I feel thirsty.
Drink some water and stretch your legs. Do you have any food on you?
I have a small bag of chips and an apple.
Eating the apple will help you feel better. Are your feet still sore?
Yes, they are quite stiff from sitting.
Try to walk around a bit to help your blood move.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a small island with white sand and blue water. It is so nice and quiet.
That sounds like a wonderful place to rest. Do you have any food with you?
Yes, I brought some fruit and water. The sun is warm on my face.
How lovely that you are enjoying the day. Do you know how to get back to shore?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does it rain?
Clouds get full of water. The water falls down as rain. Do you like the smell of wet soil?
I think it is cold.
Rain can be chilly. Is your coat warm today?
It is not drizzling.
It is pouring hard. Do you hear the sound on the roof?
I want to go outside.
Please wait for the storm to pass. Do you have an umbrella with you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am going by train tomorrow. What should I bring?
A book and a water bottle are good ideas. Do you like reading?
I do, but I get sleepy on rides.
That is a common thing. Take a blanket to stay warm and rest.
Thanks, that sounds helpful.
You are welcome. Have a nice ride.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel so hot?
Your body is fighting the bad bugs. Do you have a fever?
Why is my nose running?
It is cleaning the germs out. Does it hurt?
Why do I cough?
I do not know the exact reason. I will ask a doctor.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I learn to count all the way to one hundred?
You start by counting by ones. Do you know how to count to ten?
I know ten, but that is a long way to go. How do I make it easier?
You can count by fives to save time. Do you like the number five?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My boat leaks when it rains. What can I do?
Put wax on the wood to stop the water. Do you have a big boat?
Yes, it is quite large. I do not know how to wax it.
I do not know how to do that. Is it a wooden boat?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my red shoe on the walk. I looked everywhere but could not find it.
That is very scary to lose a shoe. Did you check your other foot?
Yes, I have the other one. I feel sad and stuck.
I do not know where the shoe went. Do you feel warm or cold right now?
I feel a bit cold and tired.
Drinking a warm drink might help. Would you like to rest for a minute?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the snow. My shoes are wet and my hands are cold.
That is not fun. Do you want to sit by the fire?
The roads are so slippery. I am afraid I will fall.
Ice can be tricky. Did you see a cat outside?
It is still falling. I never want to see it again.
I cannot stop the sky from snowing. Are you warm now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people like to read at night?
It feels calm and quiet. Do you like reading before bed?
I do. Why does it make me sleepy?
The dark room helps your body rest. Is your book soft to hold?
Yes, it is. Why does the light matter?
Bright light wakes up your brain. Do you use a dim lamp?
I just read now. Why not look at the phone?
I do not know the exact reason, but phones are loud for the mind. Do you miss reading on paper?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big fish jump in the river today.
That is a fun sight to see.
The water was very cold and clear.
Is the river deep there?
Yes, it is deep near the rocks.
That sounds like a place to fish.
I just watched the fish for a while.
I hope you enjoyed the quiet time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The rain started while I walked home. I got very wet, but I saw a big cat in a window.
That is a funny mix of bad luck and good sight. Did the cat look at you?
Yes, he just sat there in the sun. It made my day feel a little better.
Small things can brighten a gray day. Are you warm and dry now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my brain hurt when I read late?
Your eyes get tired in the dark. Do you use a lamp?
Yes, but it still feels weird.
The light can wake up your brain. Do you feel sleepy?
I want to sleep, but I cannot stop reading.
Try a short book before bed. Do you like short stories?
I love long stories though.
That is hard to break. Do you have a timer?
No, I do not have one.
You can buy a small one. Do you have a radio?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today! I was late, but I still got a big hug.
That is a sweet feeling. How did the hug make you feel?
It felt like a warm sun on my face. I want to tell you everything.
I am glad to listen.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I played chess today. My knight jumped over the pawn.
That is a nice move. Did you win the game?
No, my rook got trapped. It was a sad end.
I am sorry about that. How did you feel when it happened?
I felt a bit sad but happy to have tried.
Trying is the best part. Do you want to play again soon?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sky is so big and dark. How do I find the right stars?
Look for the big dipper first. Do you see that shape?
I think I do. What comes next after that?
Follow the two stars at the end to the bright star. Is it clear tonight?
Yes, the air is crisp. Where is the moon?
It is hidden behind the clouds. Do you miss it?
A little, but the stars shine so well. How can I remember them?
Pick one star you like and learn its name. Do you have a favorite color?
Blue. What star is blue?
Most bright stars look blue. Do you see any blue ones?
Yes, that one over there. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Do you want to watch together?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at my new phone. It is so shiny and fast.
It looks great. What color is the back?
It is blue like the sky. I love it very much.
That is a nice color. Do you like the shape?
Yes, it fits in my hand well. I want to show you my games.
Sounds fun. Is it a puzzle game?
No, it is a race game. My car goes really fast.
Cool. Do you win often?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the ferry?
It leaves from the big blue dock. Are you going to the island?
Yes, please tell me where the line is.
Look for the red flag. Is the line long?
I see it, but I do not know the time.
It leaves in ten minutes. Do you have your ticket?
No, I left it at home. Can I buy one here?
Yes, buy it at that small white booth. Do you have coins?
I am running now. Thank you very much.
Hurry. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very sad today. I want to learn how to make paper flowers.
That is a nice way to feel better. Do you like to use colors?
Yes, I love red and blue. How do I start?
Cut the paper into petals first. Do you have scissors with you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My king is in danger, but I do not know where to move him.
That feels scary. Do you see any safe squares nearby?
I see a square next to the bishop, but I am not sure if that is safe.
You should count that square carefully. Is your enemy rook pointing at it?
Yes, the rook can take my king if I go there.
Good catch. What other squares are open for your king?
There is a dark square behind the pawn.
That looks like a good hiding spot. Would you like to try that move?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today. I want to order food for you too.
That is very kind of you. What kind of food do you like?
I love hot pizza with lots of cheese. It makes me smile.
Cheese pizza sounds warm and good. Do you like it hot or cold?
I like it very hot and crispy. I am so glad we are eating together.
I am happy to eat with you. I will get the pizza now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the barn this morning and saw a new baby goat.
That sounds like a happy surprise. Did the mother goat take care of it?
Yes, she was very gentle with the little one. I fed the cows next.
Cows love fresh grass and water. Do you think the baby goat likes the other animals?
I think it is too tired to play right now. It is sleeping in the hay.
Sleeping in warm hay is very cozy.
I will check on it again this afternoon to see if it stands up.
Standing up is a big job for a baby. I hope it does well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I dropped the tower again. I want to stop.
That feels bad. Do you think it will stand up next time?
Maybe. It is hard.
You are doing well. What is your favorite part of building?
The red block.
That is a good block. Do you want to try one more time?
Okay. I will try.
Great. I am here to help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue bird in my garden today. It looked happy.
That sounds lovely. What was it doing?
It was eating a worm near the flowers.
Birds love bugs. Do you have many flowers?
Yes, but they are getting old now.
That is okay. Old flowers make seeds for new life.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired of waiting. It takes too long.
I hear you. Waiting can be hard. Do you have a book to read?
No, I do not want to read. I just want it to start.
That makes sense. Sometimes we just want things to move.
Why is it taking so much time? It feels wrong.
I do not know the exact time. But we are close. Are you cold?
Yes, it is a bit chilly. I hope it ends soon.
Let us stay warm. I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost and do not know the hour.
Do you have a watch on your wrist?
My watch is broken and cold.
Is the sun high or low right now?
I cannot see the sun behind clouds.
I do not know the exact time.
Can you feel the time in the air?
Can you hear a church bell nearby?
No, I hear only my own feet.
Let us walk together to find help.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad. I ate too much junk food today.
That can make you feel heavy. Did you eat anything green today?
Just a few fries and a soda. It was so tasty.
Tasty food is fun, but it is not good for you. Do you like apples?
I do, but I feel too full to eat one now.
You can wait until you are hungry again. Try a small piece of fruit later.
Okay. I will try that.
Good plan. What is your favorite fruit?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my toast crunchy?
The heat makes the water in the bread go away. Do you like your toast hot?
Yes, I like it hot. Why do eggs taste good?
I am not sure why they taste good. I think it is just yummy for you.
Maybe. Why do I eat food in the morning?
Food gives you energy to play all day. Are you ready to play now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so tired of sitting on this bus.
That feels bad. Do you have a snack?
No, I dropped my cookie.
Oh no. Is the bus slow?
Yes, it is going very slow.
I hate slow rides. Do you see any trees?
Yes, big green trees.
Nice. Trees are pretty. How many miles to go?
I do not know.
I do not know either. Let us count the trees.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to a new museum today. It was so much fun!
That is great. What was your favorite part?
I saw a big old ship inside a big box.
Wow, that is cool. Did you ride in it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. I made a big mess.
Please stay calm. Did you drop your keys?
Yes, they are gone. I need to find them now.
I do not know where they are. Do you check the car?
I checked the car. I lost my chance.
It is okay. We will look together.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the market today.
That sounds like fun. Did you buy any fruit?
Yes, I bought three red apples.
Apples are sweet and good for you. Did you eat one right away?
No, I saved them for later.
Smart choice. Do you like to store them in a bowl?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent my whole morning trying to knit a scarf.
That sounds like a big task. Did you finish the first row?
I finished two rows, but I made a mistake in the second one.
Oh no, that can be frustrating. Do you usually fix your mistakes right away?
I had to unpick the whole thing because the yarn was tangled.
Unpicking can take a long time. Are you angry about it?
A little, but I am trying to start again with smaller stitches.
That is a good plan for learning. What color is the new yarn?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the new math teacher. Can you point me there?
Yes, the office is on the second floor. Are you scared of fractions?
No, I like numbers. But I am so late!
Run to the end of the hall. Did you bring your red folder?
Yes, it is in my bag. I must go now.
Take your time, but hurry. Is it your first day there?
No, I just need to borrow a book.
Good luck with your book. Do you like reading?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie my tie for the wedding?
Start with a wide knot near the collar. Is the tie too tight for you?
It feels a bit stuck. What is the next step?
Cross the wide end over the thin one. Do you have a mirror to check?
Yes, I can see it looks messy. How do I fix it?
Slide the wide end up through the loop. Is the shape looking better now?
It looks good. Can I stop here?
Yes, just push it up to your neck. You are ready to go.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am wearing my best dress for the party today.
That sounds very sweet. Do you like how it looks?
Yes, the flowers on it are red and white.
Red and white are lovely colors.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you know what is on the far side of that island?
I do not know for sure, but I have seen birds there. Do you like birds?
Yes, I do. Do you think there is a house on the island?
I cannot see a house, but it might be hidden by trees. Do you want to look with me?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. It is raining again.
That is sad to hear. Do you like the rain?
No, I do not. I wanted to play outside.
I understand your feelings. Is your coat still wet?
Yes, my socks are cold. I hate this.
That does not feel good. Would you like a warm drink?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the water in the lake is dirty.
That sounds bad. Do you see any trash in it?
Yes, there are plastic bags floating on the top.
I am sorry to hear that. Let us tell a park worker about it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a good cup of tea?
Start with warm water in a pot. Do you like tea strong or weak?
I like it warm and sweet.
Pour the hot water over a tea bag. Stir in some sugar.
What if I want coffee instead?
Coffee needs ground beans and a filter. Do you have a kettle?
Yes, I have a kettle.
Put the ground beans in the filter and pour hot water over them.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does it get hot in the summer?
The sun shines on us more in summer. Do you like the heat?
Why does it get cold in the winter?
The sun shines on us less in winter. That is why it is chilly.
Why does it feel warm in the spring?
The sun comes back to warm the earth. Do you like the rain?
Why does it feel dry in the fall?
I do not know the exact reason. But the leaves change color.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why should I give my best friend a book for her birthday?
Books are fun and last a long time. Do you know what kind of stories she likes?
She likes to read about animals. Why is that a good reason to pick a book?
Because you will know she will love the surprise.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the bus.
Are you going to school?
No, I forgot my lunch box.
I do not know where it is. Can I help you look?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to swim in the river.
That is a big step. Do you know how to float on your back?
No, I am afraid of the water.
First, practice breathing in a pool. Is your pool deep or shallow?
It is very shallow.
Good, keep the water near your knees. Do you have a friend to help you?
Yes, my brother will help.
Great, safety first. Would you like a simple breathing trick?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am doing my work on the rug. My back hurts a little.
That sounds hard. Do you have a chair to sit on?
No, the chair is broken. I use a box instead.
A box can be a good seat. Is it tall enough for your desk?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big sandwich with extra cheese.
That sounds very nice to eat. Do you like cheese on it?
Yes, I do. It is warm and soft.
Good for you. I am happy for your lunch.
I saved some for you. Would you like a bite?
No, thank you, I have already eaten. Enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the water in the harbour so calm?
The big rocks keep the waves away. Do you like sitting by the water?
Yes, I do. Can fish live in the harbour?
Some small fish do live there. Do you see any boats today?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How does the clock make the hands move?
A battery inside pushes electricity to a tiny motor. What color is your clock?
It is red. Does the battery hurt the motor?
No, the battery just gives it energy to spin. Do you like the sound it makes?
It goes tick tock. Does the battery get tired?
Yes, it runs out of power after a while. Do you help put in new ones?
Mom puts them in. Thanks for telling me!
You are welcome. I am happy to help you learn.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so bored.
It feels long, but it will pass.
What can I do?
We can play a word game.
Do you know a good one?
Yes, let us play I spy.
I see something red.
Is it a big red thing?
Yes, that is right.
You did a great job.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I want to write a letter but I feel so sad and angry.
That is a hard feeling to sit with. Would you like to tell me who the letter is for?
I am writing to my sister and I do not know what to say.
Start by saying how much you miss her. Do you want to share a happy memory?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I had a scary dream about a big dark hole. Why did my brain do that?
Dreams are just your mind sorting out the day. Did the hole feel lonely or dangerous?
It felt very dangerous. Do we dream because we are scared?
I do not know for sure, but feelings can mix in sleep. Did you wake up feeling safe?
Yes, I woke up safe. Why do the bad ones stick in my head?
Your brain tries to learn from what felt strong. Do you like waking up now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very worried right now. Can you help me?
I am here to listen. What is on your mind?
I have a big test tomorrow. I am scared I will fail.
That is a scary thought. Do you know what you studied?
Yes, I read the book twice. But my head feels fuzzy.
Reading twice is great work. Have you slept well lately?
Not much. I stay up late thinking about it.
Your brain needs rest to work well. Are you ready for bed soon?
I suppose so. I still feel a little tight inside.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you want to try a deep breath with me?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a new friend feel happy?
You can share a toy with them. Do you like sharing?
Yes, I do. What else can I do?
You can also play together.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I cannot sleep at night.
That is hard. Do you like warm milk?
Maybe, but I drink coffee all day.
Try no coffee after two in the afternoon. Does that help your eyes feel tired?
I do not know if that will work.
It is a true start. Do you use a dark room?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate a big ham sandwich at my desk.
That sounds tasty. Did you like it?
Yes, but I dropped a grape on my shirt.
Oh no, that is messy. Is it clean now?
I wiped it off with a wet nap.
Good job. I am glad it is fixed.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared of riding the train to the big city.
Many people feel that way at first. Do you like looking out the window?
I think I do, but my tummy feels tight.
Try to take slow, deep breaths. Do you have a favorite snack to bring?
Yes, I have a cookie, but I still worry.
You will be fine, and the ride will end soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to help a sailor, but I do not know how.
That is a kind wish. Do you like to cook?
Yes, I love soup. What should I bring to the boat?
You can bring hot soup for them. Are they cold outside?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very cold. Why is my nose running?
Your body fights the bug. Is your throat sore?
Yes, it hurts. Why do I sweat at night?
Fever makes you hot. Do you drink water?
I am tired all day. Why do I feel so weak?
Your body uses energy to heal.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy because I love to draw pictures of cats.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What color are your favorite cats?
They are all orange and they have big, round eyes.
Orange cats are very cute to look at. Do you draw them sleeping?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we blow out the candles on the cake?
It is a long time tradition. Do you like fire?
Not really. Why do we give presents?
It shows we care for you. Do you pick your gifts?
Yes, I do. Why do we sing that song?
It makes the day feel special. Do you hum it?
I try to. Why is my birthday special?
Because you were born. Do you love your life?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to plan a picnic but I am not sure what to pack.
Great idea, do you like fruit?
Yes, I love apples, but I forgot my snacks.
Pack apples and cookies, then check if you have a blanket.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do trees grow tall?
They reach up to the sun for light. Do you like sunny days?
Why do leaves fall in the fall?
The tree lets them go to rest before winter. Do you collect fallen leaves?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the dinosaur so big?
It ate a lot of plants. Do you like dinosaurs?
Yes, I do. Why do we keep old things here?
We want to show them to people. Are you from here?
No, I am new. Why is it dark in that room?
The pictures need light. Do you like the art?
It is pretty. Why do we talk so much here?
It helps people think. Do you want to see more?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Can you teach me how to plant a seed?
Yes, I can help. Do you have a pot with soil?
Yes, I have a small pot ready to use.
Put the seed in the hole. Do you have any water?
I have a cup of water right here.
Water it gently. Do you know where it gets sun?
I plan to put it by the window.
That is a good spot. Do you know when to water it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw the sun drop low today.
That sounds nice. Did it look red?
Yes, it looked like a big orange ball.
That is a true sight. Do you like looking up?
I fell down while looking at it.
I am sorry to hear that. Are you hurt?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do bees make honey? Do they pull it from the flowers?
They do not pull it. They fly to flowers to get sweet juice called nectar. Do you like sweet things?
I love candy! What do they do with the nectar after they get it?
They put it in their stomachs to dry it out. Then they use their tongues to put it in the hive to turn it into honey.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel all alone in my room.
That is a heavy feeling to have. Do you want to sit with me?
My friends are all outside playing.
It can be hard when everyone is elsewhere. What do you like to do inside?
I just stare at the wall and feel small.
It is okay to feel small sometimes. I am right here with you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a yellow bird on the bus stop sign.
That sounds fun. Was the bird still there when you got off?
No, it flew away quickly.
I see. I do not know why birds like bus stops. What color was your jacket?
It is blue like the sky.
Nice. Do you like riding the bus?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a blue bird with a red beak in the park today.
That sounds like a happy sight. Did you get close to it?
I whispered to it and it flew away fast.
Birds like their space. Do you like watching them fly?
I felt lucky to see it before it was gone.
Being lucky is a good feeling.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am hungry but I do not know what to eat.
That is hard. Do you want hot food?
Maybe, but the lines are long. I am in a rush.
You could bring a snack. What do you like?
I really want a real meal. I am so full.
Then go to the cafe. It is fast.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I tried to ride my bike but I fell down. I do not know how to do it.
You did a good job trying. Do you want to hold the wheels first?
Yes, I want to practice. I am scared of falling again.
That is okay. Where do you want to start?
I will start in the yard. Thank you for helping me.
The yard is a great place. I will be right here with you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my brother. I am very late for school.
Did he leave with his blue backpack?
I do not know. He ran out the front door.
That sounds fast. You should go to the bus stop now.
Will he be there? I am almost out of time.
He is likely there. Run!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the water look so blue?
The sky reflects down on it. Do you like blue?
Yes, I do. What are those boats doing?
They are waiting for a tide change. Is that one big?
It looks very big. Can we go in on it?
No, we must wait for a helper. Do you feel safe?
I feel a bit scared. Will the boat stop here?
Yes, it will stop at the dock soon. Are you ready to walk?
Yes, I am ready.
Good. We will go together now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the king move so slowly?
It only moves one step at a time to stay safe. Do you like playing chess?
Why can the queen move in every direction?
She is the strongest piece on the board. Is that why you think she is cool?
Why do we play this game?
I do not know the full history.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a red rose by the park. It looked so happy in the sun.
That sounds lovely. Do you like red flowers?
Yes, I do. I also saw a big bee on it.
Bees love flowers. Was the bee busy?
Yes, it was very busy. Then I went home to my garden.
Your garden must be nice. Do you have any roses there?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a sand castle. How do I start?
Pick a spot where the sand is wet. Are you bringing buckets?
I have a bucket and a shovel. What is the next step?
Pack the sand in to make a firm base. Do you have a mold?
Yes, I have a round mold. How do I use it?
Fill the mold with wet sand and flip it upside down. Did the sand stick well?
It did. How do I make the walls taller?
Stack more packed sand on top of the base. Do you want to add a door?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Who built the big white pyramids in Egypt?
A long time ago, people built them for their kings. Did you know they took many years to make?
Yes, it took a very long time.
It took about twenty years for one pyramid. Do you like how big they are?
Yes, they are huge! What is inside?
Inside, there are rooms with the king's body and old things. Did you know we found lots of shiny gold in them?
Wow, so much gold!
Yes, it was very shiny. Do you want to hear about the sphinx next?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sand so hot?
The sun makes it warm all day. Do you like running on it?
Yes, I love it. Why is the water so salty?
I do not know the full reason. Is it clean to drink?
No, it tastes bad. Why do waves come to the shore?
The wind pushes the water here. Do you catch them?
Sometimes I do. Why does the sand feel soft at night?
The sun goes away and it cools down. Do you sleep there?
I do not. Why is the beach so big?
It takes a long time to make. Do you want to dig more?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My eyes feel tired when I read in bed. What can I do?
Try using a light that is not too bright. Do you like reading for a long time?
Yes, I read until it gets very late. How long is too long?
I do not know the exact rule, but try stopping when your eyes hurt. Do you have a clock?
I have one, but I forget to check it. Do you have a tip?
You can set a timer on your phone to tell you to stop. Does that sound easy?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The street was very quiet this morning.
That sounds peaceful. Did you see any birds?
Yes, a small blue bird sang from a tree.
I like blue birds. Did the sun come out?
The sun came out and made the wet leaves shine.
Bright leaves are nice. Did you take a walk?
I walked slowly because the air felt cold.
Cold air can be crisp. Did you enjoy the cold?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see a new play, but I do not know which one to pick.
That is a fun choice. Do you like sad stories or happy ones?
I like happy stories with animals.
Try the bear show. It is full of jokes and singing. Have you seen any plays lately?
No, this is my first time.
You will likely enjoy it. The ending makes people smile.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red flower by the road today.
That sounds like a nice find. Was it a rose?
No, it was too tall to be a rose.
It must be a sunflower then. Did it have a big face?
It had a brown center and yellow leaves.
I think you are right, it was a sunflower. You have a good eye for nature.
I want to grow one in my yard next spring.
That is a lovely idea. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My screen is black and I cannot see anything.
That is not good. Is the power light on?
I do not see a light at all.
It may be asleep. Try pressing the power button gently.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. The house is a mess.
That sounds hard. Do you want to take a break?
I just want it all to be clean.
You can do one small thing first. What is the first room?
The kitchen floor has too much food.
I cannot see the floor, but I am here. Is it safe to walk on?
Yes, but it takes so long.
Slow is fine. How much time do you have left?
Not much, and my back hurts.
Sit down for a minute. Do you need a glass of water?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does a violin sound so sad?
The thin strings make a high, thin sound. Do you like to cry when you hear it?
No, I just like the sound.
That is a good feeling. What other things make you feel happy?
My dog and warm cookies.
Dogs and cookies are very nice. I do not know a dog, but I like cookies.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The snow is very deep in my yard. How do I clean it all up?
You can use a big shovel to push it to the side. Do you have a shovel?
I do, but my arms are tired. Is there an easier way?
You can rest for a moment and then take smaller scoops. How many shovels do you have?
I only have one. Should I ask for help?
Yes, asking for help is a very good idea. Who do you live with?
I live with my family. They are home now.
Go ask your family to come outside. Have fun working together.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see white things in the sky. I am not sure what they are.
They are clouds. Do you like looking up at them?
Maybe. But I do not know what I should do with them.
You can just watch them move. Do you want to draw one?
I guess I can draw one. But I am still a bit unsure.
That is okay. Take your time and have fun.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. How do I fix the rice?
Just add hot water. Is it stuck to the pot?
Yes, it looks bad. I want a quick fix.
Steam it for five minutes. Do you have a lid?
Yes, here is the lid. Can you check it for me?
I cannot see your kitchen. I think it is fine.
Okay, thanks. I must go now.
Good luck with dinner.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I give up. The words are all wrong.
It is hard. Do you want to try one word?
I hate it. I am too bad at this.
You are not bad. Just slow. Can you say "water"?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a very special gift today.
That is lovely to hear. What did you receive?
It is a small, red box with a secret inside.
A mystery sounds fun. Do you know what it is yet?
No, I have not opened it, but I am so happy.
Keep that happy feeling for now. Would you like to open it together?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Is the bridge open right now?
I think it is, but I am not sure. Are you walking there?
I am late and running fast.
That sounds like a hard run.
Did the river rise last night?
I do not know about the water. Is the road dry?
Yes, it is dry.
Good, that helps. I hope you arrive soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad and do not know what to do.
It is okay to feel this way. What is making you feel this way?
I lost my favorite toy.
That is a sad loss. Do you want to talk about your favorite part of it?
I miss the sound it made.
It sounds like a lovely memory.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a spot with the best ice cream. It makes me smile every time.
That sounds very sweet. Do you like the chocolate kind?
Yes, it is rich and cold. I want to take you there soon.
I would love to join you. Is it far from here?
No, it is just around the corner. Let us go now.
Great. Let us walk together.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke the big blue cup.
Oh no, that is bad. Were you trying to catch it?
Yes, but it slipped and hit the floor.
That was very lucky you did not get cut. Do you have any pieces left?
I hid them under the rug so no one sees.
That is not true, we must clean it up.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the big blue lake today. The water was very still.
That sounds like a nice day. Did you see any ducks?
I did not see any ducks, but I saw a large fish jump. It made a big splash.
A jumping fish is exciting. Did you try to catch it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke your cup. I am very sorry.
Thank you for telling me. Do you know how it broke?
It slipped in my hand. I feel so bad.
It happens to everyone. Are you okay now?
Yes, but I am still mad at myself.
That is a normal feeling.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late and the box is too heavy.
I can help you lift it. Is the truck ready?
Please just hold the door, I need to run.
I will hold the door. Do you have your keys?
I found them, now I must go.
That is good. Good luck on your move.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on my last move.
That can be hard. Do you see a way to save your queen?
Not really. My king looks very open.
Watch the squares around your king closely. Is the other player threatening a check?
I see a rook near my king.
If they move the rook, they might check you. Can you block that square?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my teacher right now. Where is he?
I am sorry, I do not know where he is. Are you going to class?
Yes, I am late. I must find him fast.
Check the small room next to the door. Do you have your book?
I left my bag. I have no time for that.
That is a big problem. You may not sit without it.
I will run back. Please tell me if he is here.
I will watch the desk for you. Will you be back soon?
I am coming back now. Thank you for helping.
You are welcome. I hope you find him.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found ten dollars on the floor! I am so happy.
That is a great find. What will you buy with it?
I think I will save it for a new book.
Saving is a smart choice. Do you have a box for your coins?
I do! I put all my money in my jar.
A jar is a good place to keep it. Are you going to read this new book?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why should I eat my vegetables?
They give your body strong fuel. Do you like the taste?
They taste like dirt. Why must I do it?
It helps your bones grow tall and strong. Do you play a lot?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a shape with four sides, but I am not sure which one it is.
Is it a square or a rectangle? Do all the sides look the same length?
Yes, all the sides are the same.
Then it must be a square. Great job looking closely.
Thank you, I think I get it now.
You are welcome. Do you have any other shapes to check?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What happens to the dragon at the end?
The dragon flies away to find new friends. Do you like dragons?
I do. Why did he leave the kingdom?
He wanted to see the whole world. Did you like the castle?
Yes, it was very tall. Does the dragon ever come back?
I do not know for sure. Do you hope he does?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I need to leave, but I forgot my watch.
Do you see a clock on the wall?
There is one, but the hands look twisted.
The short hand shows the hour. Is it pointing at the big number?
It points to the three. The little hand is up high.
That means it is a quarter before four. Can you read the numbers?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a quiet cafe with old tables today.
That sounds peaceful. Did you enjoy the food there?
Yes, the soup was hot and thick.
Good for you. What did you drink?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am lost. The street looks the same everywhere.
Do not worry. I am here to help.
Can you tell me where I am?
I do not know your exact spot.
I am near a blue park bench.
Is the bench facing the big tree?
Yes, it faces the tall oak.
You are two blocks from home.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, can you tell me how the knight moves?
It jumps in an L shape. Do you like knights?
Yes, they are fast. How do I win quickly?
I do not know how to win. Do you play every day?
No, this is my first game.
That is okay. You can learn one step at a time.
Thanks, I must go now.
Good luck. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very stuck trying to learn a new language.
It can feel hard, but you are doing great. What language are you trying to learn?
I am learning French, but my brain feels too tired.
Rest is part of the work. Do you use a phone app to help?
Yes, I use an app, but I get bored very fast.
Try mixing in songs or simple games. Is there a specific word that hurts your brain?
The verb endings are a mess. I just want to quit.
Quitting is a hard choice, but stopping for a day is okay.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The rain is falling so hard. I hate this gray day.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you see the puddles?
They are just big, wet messes.
That is true. Can you hear the sound on the roof?
It is too loud and noisy.
I understand your feeling. Would you like to wait for it to stop?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: What day is after Tuesday?
Wednesday comes after Tuesday. Do you like Wednesdays?
I want to learn to tie my shoes.
You can practice on a new pair of shoes. Is it hard to hold the string?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I make my lines look smooth?
Slow your hand down. Do you hold your pen tight?
I do not know. My lines always feel wavy.
Try drawing from your elbow. Is it a big shape or a small one?
It is a small circle.
Hold your wrist still.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am scared about my first job. I do not know what to do.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you have a list of tasks?
I have a list, but the words look like they are hiding from me.
That sounds like a scary puzzle. Do you want to start with the first one?
I tried, but I feel like I will break something.
I do not know what you will touch, but I know you can stop and ask for help if you are unsure.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on my story. What should I do?
Take a walk. Where is your hero now?
He is in a big house. It feels boring.
Boring is not good. What does he want?
He wants a cat. But he has none.
That is a problem. Does he like to cook?
No, he hates dirty dishes. Why ask?
Maybe he makes a trade. Does that sound fun?
Yes, he trades with a cook. I will try that.
Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I made a big mess with blue ink today and now my white shirt is ruined.
Oh no, that is very upsetting. Did you try to wash it right away?
I tried, but the blue color will not come out no matter how hard I scrub.
That sounds so hard to fix. Do you have any baking powder at home?
I think so, but I am not sure. It is usually in the kitchen cabinet.
You should check the back of the pantry. Do you want to go look together?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a snowman.
That is fun. Do you have a cold day?
Yes, it is snowing outside.
Pack a ball of snow. Then add two more.
What do I put on it for a face?
Carrots work well for a nose. Do you have any?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am stuck on this puzzle and I want to give up.
Taking a break is okay. What piece are you holding?
It has a dark blue edge but it does not fit anywhere.
It may belong on the bottom. Do you see a spot that is dark and empty?
You are right. I finally found the place for it.
That is great news. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend. How do I start?
You can say, "Dear friend," at the top. Do you know where your friend lives?
Yes, he lives in the city. What do I write next?
Tell him how your week was. Are you feeling happy or sad?
I feel happy. Is that all?
Yes, just add your name at the bottom. Good job.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very alone today and it makes me sad.
That sounds hard. Do you have anyone nearby?
My friend moved away and I miss them a lot.
I am sorry your friend is far away. What do you usually do together?
We used to play games, but now I have no one.
Playing games can help you feel better. Would you like to play with me?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to clean, but I do not know where to start.
Let us start with the living room. Is your floor full of toys?
Yes, there are many toys on the floor.
Please put the toys in the big box. Do you have a vacuum cleaner?
I found the vacuum cleaner.
That is good. Please clean the rug next. Would you like a snack?
No, I want to finish first.
You are doing great. Let us move to the kitchen. Do you see any dirty cups?
There are three dirty cups in the sink.
Please wash them with soap. Can you dry the dishes?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
They fall because it is getting cold. Do you like playing in them?
It is fun! Is the tree sad?
No, it is not sad. It is just sleeping until spring.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I need new shoes because my old ones have holes.
That is bad for your feet. Do you like boots?
No, I want sneakers for running.
Sneakers are fun. I do not know the price.
I saw a red pair at the store.
Red is a bright color. Do you like red?
Yes, I think they are cool.
You will run fast.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do for my birthday. I feel lost.
That is a nice feeling. What do you like to do on a cold day?
I like to sit by the window and watch the rain.
That sounds calm and true. Do you have any friends coming?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to catch the bus now, but it is so hot.
A hot sun feels bad today. Do you have a hat?
No time for a hat, I will just run to the stop.
Running in heat is hard work. Drink water soon.
I have no water with me, I am too rushed.
That is not true to say, you likely have a bottle. Are you sure?
Oh, it is in my bag, I forgot it.
Good catch on that. Stay cool out there.
Thanks, I must go now or I will miss it.
Go fast and be safe. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the clock tick so fast?
It ticks to keep time for us. Do you have a favorite toy?
I like my truck, but the numbers are hard to read.
The hands move around the circle to show the time.
Can it tell me when it is night?
Yes, it does that by moving the little hand. I do not know how it starts though.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I caught nothing all day.
That feels bad. Did you try a new spot?
I just sat there. The fish ignored me.
I do not know why. Maybe they were shy.
I want to quit this game.
One bad day is not forever. Do you like the water?
The water is nice. But no fish is not fun.
The view is still there. Would you sit for tea?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My head hurts so bad. I do not like to go to the doctor.
I hear you. It is scary sometimes. Do you have a fever?
Yes, I feel very hot and tired.
That is why you need to go. Will you bring a toy?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late on Monday.
That is a relaxed start. Do you like sleeping in?
Yes, but I missed my bus on Tuesday.
That must have been annoying. How did you get to work?
I took a taxi on Wednesday.
A taxi is a fast way to travel. Was it expensive?
It was costly, so I walked home on Thursday.
Walking is good for your health. Did you enjoy the air?
Yes, I felt happy on Friday.
I am glad you had a good week.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Is it cold?
Yes, it is freezing. Do you have a coat?
No. I forgot it. Can I use yours?
No, I do not have one. You will be cold.
Oh no. I must go.
Go quick. Is your home far?
No, it is close. Thanks.
Be safe. Do you like snow?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just had a baby! He is tiny and so cute.
That is wonderful! How is your little one sleeping?
He sleeps a lot, which is nice. I am very happy for us.
I am glad to hear that.
Do you think he will play?
He will learn to play soon. What is his favorite sound?
He likes the soft hum of the fan. It makes him calm.
That sounds soothing. Welcome to the new team!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a dream about a big red balloon.
That sounds bright. Was it fun?
I flew to the moon on it.
Wow, that is wild. Did you see an astronaut?
I was too busy looking at the rocks.
The moon looks like craters from up there.
It was the best bad dream I ever had.
I am glad you liked it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My chair leg is loose and it makes a loud click.
That sounds annoying. Do you have a hammer at home?
Yes, I do have a big red one.
Good. Just tap the leg gently.
What if I hit it too hard?
You might break it. Be very careful.
Can I use glue to fix it?
Only if it is wood. Is the chair made of wood?
It is, but it is very old.
Old wood is brittle. Do not use glue.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sitting by the lake, but I do not know what to do next.
The water looks very calm today. Do you like to swim or just look at the birds?
I am not sure. The water looks nice, but I feel a bit cold.
It is always good to keep warm when you are near the water. Would you like to find a dry spot to sit?
Yes, I think I will walk around the shore to see what I can find.
That sounds like a fun way to spend your time. Tell me if you see anything interesting.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I keep missing the easy shots.
That feels bad. Do you want to just hit the ball for fun?
No, I want to win. My coach said I am not trying hard enough.
That is a hard thing to hear. Did you feel tired today?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am moving to a new house tomorrow.
That is exciting. What is the first thing you will pack?
I do not know yet. I am a little scared of the dark.
You are brave. Do you have a favorite toy to bring?
Yes, my teddy bear. Does the new house have a garden?
I do not know for sure. Is your bear getting a new bed?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread did not rise. I feel sad.
That is very tricky. Did you use fresh yeast?
Yes, but it looks old and lumpy.
I am not sure why that happened. Was the water too hot?
It was warm, I think. Now the bread is flat.
Warm water can kill the yeast. Do you want to try again?
Maybe later. My hands feel tired.
Rest is good for baking. I am glad you are here.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to float on my back.
That is a great goal. Do you like the water?
Yes, but I am afraid of sinking.
Your body will float. Have you tried in the shallow part?
No, I have only played in the pool.
Start by lying on your back in the shallows. Do you have a friend with you?
Yes, my sister is here.
She can hold your hands if you need help. Does that make you feel safe?
Yes, that sounds good.
Just keep your nose out of the water.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is my computer making a funny beep?
That beep means it needs to cool down. Are you sitting close to it?
No, I am right here. The fan is spinning fast.
Good. Give it a few minutes to rest. Is the room hot?
It is not hot, but the fan is loud.
Loud fans can be tiring to listen to. Do you want to play something quiet?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I can't sleep at all. My eyes are open but I want to close them.
That is very hard. Do you have a warm drink?
I have some warm milk, but my brain is too fast.
Try taking three slow, deep breaths. It helps slow your thoughts down.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel so alone?
It is hard to feel apart. Do you have friends nearby?
I do, but I still feel empty.
Many people feel this way. Is the quiet loud to you?
Yes, the silence is very loud.
That can be scary to hear. Do you want to talk more?
I think I do.
I am happy to listen. Tell me one thing you love.
I love the warm sun.
That is a nice thing. Does it help you feel better?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a lost pen in the hallway.
That is a good thing. Where did you find it?
Near the printer by the window.
I am glad you kept it safe.
Now I use it to write my notes.
That sounds very helpful. Did you ask if anyone lost a pen?
Yes, but no one claimed it.
Then you can keep it for now.
I will write a thank-you note on it.
That is a nice idea.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my bread rise well?
You need a warm spot for the dough. Do you have a small oven at home?
Yes, I do. What else do I need to know?
Let it double in size before baking. That is the secret!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at this car. It is hard.
That feels bad. What part is the hardest for you?
The brakes. I keep pressing too hard.
That is normal. Try pressing them like you are sitting on a egg.
An egg? That sounds silly.
It helps you be soft. Have you tried it yet?
No, I just want to quit.
Quitting is okay, but trying is better. Do you want one more try?
One more try. I think I can do it.
Good for you. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn to swim, but I am scared of the water.
It is normal to feel scared. Do you know how to float on your back?
I can float for a few seconds, but I get too scared to try it longer.
Try kicking your legs gently while floating. Do you have a pool at home?
No, I only have access to a public pool on weekends.
Bring a pool noodle for support. Good luck with your first lesson!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My grandpa is sleeping all day. I am not sure if he is sick or just tired.
That sounds scary. Do you feel sad about this?
Yes, I do. Should I wake him up to see if he is okay?
It is best to let him rest for now. Did you tell your mom about this?
I did not tell her yet. What should I do next?
Please tell your mom right away. She can help you check on him.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the big drops falling! I love the rain.
It looks so fun! Do you wear boots?
Yes, I wear my red boots. I jump in every puddle.
That sounds great. Is it cold outside?
A little, but the sun is coming out soon.
Oh, nice. Do you like the smell of wet earth?
Yes, it smells like cookies!
That is a funny picture. Do you want to go out now?
No, I am just watching it from the window.
That is a warm place to watch from.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a small bear in my garden. What should I do?
Stay still and walk away slowly. Are you scared of it?
Yes, but I do not want to hurt it. Where does it live?
It lives in the woods near water. I do not know which woods exactly.
That makes sense. Should I take food for it?
No, never feed wild animals. Do you have a window to watch from?
I am going to go home and close the door. Is it safe now?
Yes, it is safe if you stay inside.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad because I have no one to talk to.
That sounds tough. What makes you feel that way?
My friends are busy and I am all alone.
I am here with you now. Do you like to read or draw?
I like to draw pictures of animals.
That sounds fun. What kind of animals do you draw?
I draw dogs and cats with big eyes.
I like that idea. Can you show me a picture later?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I made a new friend today.
That sounds so sweet. What is their name?
I really like playing with them.
That makes me happy for you. Do you want to play again?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my computer get hot?
It works hard and makes heat. Do you play games a lot?
Why is the screen bright?
It shows you things clearly. Is it too dim for you?
Why does it beep?
It tells you it is done. I do not know why it beeped twice.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the bus stop so many times?
It stops to let people get on and off. Do you want to ride?
Why do we have to sit down?
It is safer when the bus moves fast. Is your seat comfy?
Why is the road so bumpy?
The road is old and not smooth. Does that hurt your knees?
Why are the windows foggy?
It is cold outside and warm inside. Do you like the fog?
Why did the driver honk the horn?
I do not know why he honked. Did you see a dog?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the fridge stick to the magnet?
It pulls on the metal in the fridge. Do you have a big magnet at home?
I have a small one. It pushes the other one away sometimes.
That happens when the same sides face each other. They do not like to be close.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I have to see the doctor?
Your body needs a check-up. Do you have any pain?
No, I feel fine. Why does the doctor want to see me?
It is just a yearly visit to keep you strong. I do not know your exact history.
Is it scary?
It is just some gentle tests. Are you feeling nervous?
A little bit. Will it hurt?
No, it will not hurt. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel super happy today because I got a new red bike.
That sounds like a lot of fun to ride. What color are your new shoes?
My shoes are blue and I feel warm inside like sunshine.
Warm feelings are a wonderful way to feel. Do you want to go ride right now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The wood is not straight and I am so mad.
That is very frustrating. Are the boards very wide?
Yes, they are big and they do not fit.
I am sorry to hear that. Try to sand the edges smooth.
I do not know how to use the sanding block.
I do not know your tools well. Do you have a sharp blade?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The smoke is thick. I feel so sad and scared.
Is everyone safe inside? Take a deep breath with me.
Yes, we are safe. The fire is still big.
That is good. Can you see the orange lights?
I can see them. Why did this happen?
I do not know for sure. It looks like a tree branch fell on the roof.
That is so unfair. I hate the smell of burning wood.
It is a very bad smell. Have you called the fire crews?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My fish got away and I feel very sad.
That is a rough break. Do you like to try again?
I am not sure I want to sit back down.
Rest is good. What did you eat for lunch?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big river today.
That sounds big. Was the water cold?
The water was blue and clear.
Blue and clear is nice. Did you see any fish?
Yes, I saw one small fish.
A small fish is lucky. Where was it swimming?
It was near the rocks.
Rocks are good homes. Goodbye for now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My old friend moved far away.
I am sorry to hear that. Was it a sudden change?
Yes, he left very quickly.
That can be confusing. Do you still talk to him?
Not much, it feels strange.
Distance is hard. Do you miss him a lot?
I really do.
Keep the door open for him.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the cinema today.
That sounds like fun. What movie did you choose?
I saw a big bear in a blue coat.
Oh, a bear! Did it eat any honey?
No, it was too cold to hunt.
I am sorry it was cold. Did you stay warm inside?
Yes, the room was very toasty.
Nice. Do you like watching stories with animals?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing by the water and I do not know what to do next.
That is a nice place to look. Do you like watching the waves?
The waves are big and white, but I am only looking at my shoes.
Your shoes are clean and nice. You can take them off if you want.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the wind so loud today?
It is moving fast through the trees. Do you hear the leaves shaking?
I can hear them. Does it hurt the trees?
No, the trees are strong and bend.
Can I see the wind?
I cannot see it either, but I can see things move. Is your hat safe?
I am afraid it will fly away.
That is a good worry. Let us hold on tight.
Okay, I will hold my hat.
Good job. It is still blowing hard.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The lights went off just now. I am trying to read my book.
That is not nice to lose the light. Do you have a flashlight with you?
No, I do not. I feel a bit in the dark.
That can be scary. Would you like me to tell you a small story?
Yes, please. I am ready to listen.
Okay, let us think about a happy ending.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want a warm drink, but I do not know what to pick.
Do you like sweet or bitter tastes?
I like sweet things best.
Sweet tea is a good choice. Do you want milk in it?
Yes, please.
That will make it smooth and nice.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked by the sea today. I saw a big ship.
That sounds like a nice walk. Did you see any sailors on it?
Yes, one was waving at me. He had a big blue hat.
What a kind sailor. Did he say hello to you?
He said hello and pointed to the waves. He looked very happy.
The sea can make people feel free. Do you want to be a sailor one day?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look! I found a jar of honey. I am so glad you can see it.
It looks sweet and golden. Do you know where bees make it?
I think they build it in a hive. I want to tell you how it works.
Yes, they use flower nectar. Do bees make the honey inside their home?
Yes! They bring it home and dry it. It becomes sticky and sweet.
That is a wonderful secret. Thank you for sharing that with me.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is so loud. I do not know what to do.
Stay inside where it is safe. Are you okay?
I am scared of the big crash outside.
The house is strong and will hold. Do you see the rain?
Yes, it is hitting hard against the glass.
Do not worry, the doors are locked. Is your heart beating fast?
Yes, it thumps in my chest.
Take slow breaths with me. Can you stay calm?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you keep the box in the closet?
I am keeping it safe for later. Do you like surprises?
What is actually inside the box?
I do not know yet, so I cannot tell you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very happy today. Why?
Maybe you had a good breakfast. What did you eat?
Just toast and jam. Is that why?
I do not know for sure. But sweet food helps many people. Do you feel warm inside?
Yes, my heart feels light. Why does it do that?
Happy thoughts make your body feel good. Do you want to tell me more about it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know why the leaves fall off the trees in the cold.
The trees rest in winter to save their energy. Do you like warm coats?
Yes, I do, but I am still confused about the roots.
The roots stay safe under the snow all year long.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to grow food, but I do not know how to start.
That is a great goal. Where do you have space to plant?
I have a small pot on my windowsill.
A pot is perfect. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I love the sun, but the pot looks empty.
Fill the pot with dark soil.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to see the sun better. Can you help me?
Sure. Do you have dark glasses?
No, I do not.
Do not look at it with bare eyes. It hurts.
What should I use then?
Use dark glasses. Do you have any at home?
Yes, I found some.
Great. Look through them safely now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not want this soup. It is too hot and I am sad.
I am sorry. Would you like a cold drink? What do you usually like?
I just want bread. The soup made me mad.
I will get you bread. Does it taste good now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the water in the ocean salty?
Yes, it is salty. Do you like swimming?
No time. How deep is it?
I do not know how deep it is everywhere. Are you going to the beach?
Yes. Can I see fish?
Maybe you can see small fish. What is your favorite color?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how a lighthouse works.
It has a big light on top that spins. Do you like spinning things?
Yes, I love spinning tops.
The light helps boats find safe water. Is the sea near your home?
Yes, we live by a big lake.
You can build a small one with a lamp and a bottle. Do you have any bottles?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My clock makes a loud sound every minute. Is this right?
Yes, that is normal for many clocks. Do you like the sound?
It is a bit too loud for me. How can I make it quiet?
Look for a small switch on the back to turn the sound off. Is it a hard clock to move?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to look up a cat video today.
That sounds fun. Did you find a good one?
Yes, but the screen was too slow.
Slow screens can be tricky. Do you use a phone or a computer?
It was my old computer.
Old computers take longer to load.
I finally saw the cat, though.
Great. Did the cat do anything funny?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the movie was not good.
That is a fair feeling. What part did you dislike?
The end was very confusing and I did not get it.
I do not know the story well, so I cannot help with the plot. Do you want to watch a different film?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on my story. My hero cannot find the door.
Have you tried looking in a hidden place? I think that is a good start.
The door is behind a big rock. Should I move it?
Yes, but it is very heavy. What can help you lift it?
I have a magic wand. Do I use it?
I do not know for sure, but magic often helps. Does your hero like using it?
Yes, but I am scared it will break. Is that okay?
That is a good worry. Let it break and see what happens.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is waiting for cookies so hard?
It feels slow, but time moves for everyone. Do you like sweet treats?
Yes, I really like chocolate.
That is a happy thing to look forward to. What is your favorite color?
I like blue best.
Blue is a calm color. Do you think the cookies are done yet?
No, the timer is still counting down.
Taking a deep breath helps you wait.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a low hand and I am not sure if I should keep going or drop my cards.
Do you want to win, or just have fun?
I really want to win, but I am afraid I might lose my last few coins.
That is a big risk. You might run out of money.
Then what should I do? I do not want to be broke.
I would drop the cards to keep your coins safe. Have you played before?
Yes, but I never know what the other people are holding.
That is true. Playing safe is often the smart choice.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so happy for my birthday today.
That is wonderful news. How old are you turning?
I will be five years old.
Five is a great age. Do you have any toys for it?
Yes, I have a big red truck.
A red truck sounds fun. I do not know why you like it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad about my robot. It stopped moving.
That sounds tough. Did it make a sound?
No, it is just sitting there. I do not know why.
Maybe it needs a battery. Do you have one?
I checked. The battery is full.
That is strange. Is the light on?
The light is off. I am very frustrated.
Let us try a reset. Do you know how?
I do not know what a reset is.
I do not know your model. Does it have a small button?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to make bread.
First, you need to mix flour and water. Do you have any yeast at home?
I have flour, but I have no yeast.
You can not make real bread without it. Do you like pizza?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do shoes have soles?
The soles help you walk on rough ground. Do you like running?
Why do we have to try on shoes before buying them?
Feet are all different shapes, so we need to check the fit. Is your foot wide or narrow?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate this math problem. I just want to give up.
It is hard, I know. What part is giving you the most trouble?
The fractions. They look so messy and confusing to me.
Messy can mean we need to break it down. Do you have a pencil ready?
Yes, but I still feel very dumb about it.
You are not dumb, just tired. Let us try just one small step together.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big black bird in my yard today. It looked very smart. It ate my seeds.
That sounds like a crow. Do you have a bird feeder there?
Yes, I put it up last week. It was very noisy but fun to watch.
Crows are very clever birds. I do not know why that one came.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate that song. It makes me feel sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you know why it upsets you?
It reminds me of bad days. I just want it to stop.
That sounds very hard to take. Thank you for telling me.
Can you fix this feeling?
I cannot fix your heart. But I can listen. What song is it?
It is a song about rain. The rain makes me cry.
Rain is just water from the sky. It is not true sadness.
I do not want to talk about water. I want to go play now.
Okay, let us play. Have a happy time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why does the sky look blue?
Sunlight has many colors. Blue light bounces off the air more than other colors. Do you like looking up at the sky?
I want to learn how to see that blue.
Look up on a clear day. Pick the lightest part of the sky. Have you tried looking up before?
Yes, but it looks the same every day.
It changes with the time of day. At sunset, it looks red and orange. Do you watch sunsets?
I want to know why it changes color.
When the sun is low, light travels through more air. The blue light scatters away, leaving red and orange.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I think my wrist hurts when I hit the ball. What should I do?
It is best to rest your hand for a day. Do you grip the racket too tight?
I do squeeze it hard. How should I hold it?
Hold it like you are holding a small bird, not too tight. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at my dog, he is so happy today.
He looks very glad. What is he playing with?
He is chasing a red ball in the yard.
That sounds like fun.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a pizza at home. How do I do it?
You need dough, sauce, and cheese. Do you have an oven?
Yes, I have an oven. What do I put on the dough first?
Start with a layer of sauce. Then add your favorite toppings.
How long does it need to cook?
It takes about fifteen to twenty minutes. Is your pizza looking good?
It smells like a bakery. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. I hope you enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I read at night but I feel too sleepy to focus.
Try using a dim lamp instead of the bright light. Do you have a small lamp?
Yes, I have one, but I still get heavy eyes.
Take short breaks every few pages to help your eyes rest. How long do you usually read?
I read for about an hour before bed.
You can try reading just for ten minutes first. Do you like reading aloud?
Sometimes I do read out loud.
Reading aloud can keep your brain awake. That is a very good habit to start.
I will try that tonight, thank you.
You are welcome. I hope you enjoy your book.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to move my knight.
A knight moves in an L shape. Do you have a board to practice on?
Yes, I have one.
Great, just count two squares then one more.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a big starfish in the sand today.
That is a great find. Do you know how to keep it safe?
I put it in a bucket with some water.
That sounds fun. Did you see any other sea animals?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count from one?
We start at one so we know the very first thing. Do you like to count your toys?
What happens if we skip numbers?
Then we would miss items in our count. I do not know why you ask that.
Can we count backwards?
Yes, we can go from ten down to one. Do you find that hard to do?
Why stop at ten?
Ten is a full set of ten, or one group. Do you have a favorite number?
Is there a number after all the others?
I do not know, because there is no last number. Do you think we will ever run out?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make a great picnic, but I do not know what to bring.
You should pack some fruit and a sandwich. Do you like apples?
Yes, I love them, but it might be hot outside. What can I do?
Bring a cold bottle of water. Is it a sunny day?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is this for me?
Yes, it is a book. Do you like dragons?
I do not like dragons.
I am sorry to hear that. What kind of animals do you like?
I like cats.
That is a great choice. Here is your cat book.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I stepped on an ant and now I feel very bad.
It is nice you care about small lives. Do you know what ants eat?
I think they like sweet things, but I am not sure.
Many ants do love sugar. Your feeling shows a kind heart.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My words come out all wrong.
That feels bad. Do you want to start over?
I think so. I want to say I am sorry.
That is a good start. Who is the letter for?
My friend. I broke her toy.
Oops. Telling the truth helps.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel very sad right now.
I am sorry to hear that. What made you feel this way?
