I am in a big hurry, so I cannot talk long.
I understand. Is there one thing you need to do soon?
Yes, I must go, but I still feel heavy.
It is okay to feel sad while moving. Do you have a friend nearby?
No, I am alone, so the sadness feels loud.
That can be very hard. Do you want to take one slow breath with me?
I can try one quick breath, thank you.
You did a good job. Go on, you are being brave.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: This city is too loud and big. I do not know where to go.
Take a deep breath. Are you hungry?
No, just tired. I miss my quiet home.
You can rest on a bench. Do you like parks?
Yes, but I am lost.
I do not know your exact spot. Walk toward the sun.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I saw bees buzzing all day. How do they make honey?
They drink sweet nectar from flowers. Do you like sweet things?
I do, but I do not know what to do next.
They carry the nectar back to the hive in their special bags. Is that interesting to you?
It sounds hard work. Then what happens to the nectar?
They fan it with their wings to make it thick and dry. Do you know how long that takes?
I am still not sure what comes after the drying.
They put the dry honey into tiny hexagon cells and seal it with wax.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I climbed a tall hill today. I felt so free up there!
That sounds wonderful. Do you like looking at the clouds?
Yes, they are like soft white fluff. I want to climb again soon.
Mountains are a beautiful place to rest your eyes.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I put too much salt in my bread dough.
Oh no, that is tricky. Do you have any extra flour?
Yes, I have a lot of it.
Add a little more flour and some water to fix it. Are you using warm water?
The water feels hot to the touch.
Make it cooler, please. Hot water kills the yeast.
It is nice and warm now.
That is perfect. You will do great.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I saw a big dinosaur in the museum.
That sounds like a fun day. What kind of dinosaur was it?
It was a T-Rex. It had very big teeth.
Wow, that sounds scary and cool. Did you like the rest of the show?
Yes, I saw old bones too. They were very old.
Bones are interesting to look at. Did you learn something new?
I learned they lived a long time ago. I feel so smart now.
That is great news. I am glad you had a good time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to count.
We can start with the number one. Do you know how to say the word "one"?
Yes, I know one.
Great. Now let us add another to make two. Does that feel right to you?
It feels right.
We have two things now.
Can we go to three?
Yes, we add one more. What number comes after two?
Three is next.
You did well.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is waiting so hard?
It feels heavy, like holding a big rock. Do you like rocks?
Not at all, they are too heavy.
Try breathing in slow. Does that make the rock feel lighter?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I missed the stop. I think we go the wrong way.
Do not worry. The driver can help. Are you going to the park?
Yes, the big green park. I need to get off soon.
Good. Ask the driver to tap you off. Is it very far?
It is, but I am tired. I want to sit down.
Sit back, please. You are safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to draw a picture here. Do I need a special tool?
Yes, you need a crayon. Do you like bright colors?
I have a red one. Where do I put the paper?
Put it on the small table. Is your hand tired?
I am done. Where do I take the picture?
Take it to the desk. I hope you enjoyed the day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the island small?
It is small because it sits by itself in the big sea. Do you like little places?
Why does it have a big tree?
The tree is there to give shade to the warm sand. Do you like the sun?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now. My feet feel like lead.
You look very worried. Is something bad happening?
I am late for work. I forgot my keys.
That is a big trouble. Did you look in your bag?
No. I ran straight to the door.
Running helps your body. But it can make the worry worse.
I have to keep moving. I cannot stop.
One deep breath can help. Do you feel a little safer now?
Yes. I will take a breath.
Good job. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make dinner but I am hungry.
Try making a sandwich. What do you have in the fridge?
I have bread, cheese, and ham.
Put the cheese and ham in the bread. It is good.
Should I add some lettuce?
Yes, if you like it. Do you have any?
No, I do not have any lettuce.
That is okay. Just use the bread and meat. It still tastes great.
Okay, I will try that now.
Good luck. I hope you enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to make dinner today.
That is good. What are you making?
I am making a big pot of soup.
That sounds tasty. Do you have any carrots?
Yes, I have lots of carrots.
Great. Have fun cooking.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My cat is not eating his food. I do not know why.
That can happen sometimes. Is he drinking water?
Yes, he drinks water, but he ignores the bowl.
Maybe he is not feeling well. Has he played or moved around today?
He just sleeps in a quiet spot all day.
I do not know for sure, but that sounds like he needs a doctor.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sad that my friend is gone.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk about it?
I do not know how to fix this.
You can send a kind note to show care.
Will that work?
It often helps to say you care.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very tired when I work from home.
That is a common feeling. Do you have a chair that helps your back?
My chair is very soft and comfy.
Soft chairs can hurt you later. Do you get up to stretch often?
I mostly sit in one spot all day.
Standing up is good for your body. Try to walk a bit.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and saw a big red balloon.
That sounds fun. Did you see the balloon fly away?
Yes, it popped with a loud bang and scared the dog.
Oh no, I am sorry about the dog. Did you tell anyone else about it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My white shirt is all dirty again.
That is not good. Do you know if you put it in with dark clothes?
I think so. Now it is gray and looks like mud.
That is a common mix up. Do you have a stain remover at home?
I do not know. I just want it to be clean.
Hot water might help now. Is the label on the tag safe for hot water?
I can check. Please tell me what to do next.
Wash it alone in hot water and dry it on the sun. Do you have a drying rack?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream cone on the park bench.
That is so sad to hear. Did you offer to clean up the mess?
Yes, I got a napkin and wiped it all off.
That was very kind of you. What did the park keeper say?
She smiled and gave me a new cone.
Wow, that is a wonderful surprise. Do you like the new flavor?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a rod, but I am late.
That is a problem. Are you going to the lake?
Yes, the boat leaves soon.
You should bring worms. Do you have any in your bag?
I forgot them, this is bad.
You can catch fish without worms. Is it windy there?
It is blowing hard, I must go.
Wear your warm hat. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I wash my clothes?
Put them in the machine with soap. Do you know where the soap is?
I do not know.
It is in a big bag or bottle. Is it red or blue?
It is a white bottle.
That sounds right for detergent. Do you want to wash them hot or cold?
I want to wash them warm.
Warm is good for most things. Check the tag on the shirt to be sure.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a shiny rock by the big tree today.
That sounds like a nice find. Did you put it in your pocket?
Yes, it fits right into my small box.
Your box must be getting full. Do you have a special spot for it?
I keep it on my shelf with my shells.
That is a lovely place for it. Do you plan to find more rocks?
I think I will look for a blue one next.
Blue rocks are very pretty. Do you know where to look?
I will check near the pond tomorrow.
That sounds like a good plan. Good luck with your search.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have too many boxes to move today.
That is a lot of work. What is in the heaviest box?
I do not know. I just packed them fast.
Let us unpack the small ones first. Do you want help?
Yes, please. I feel so tired.
Good. We can take a break soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw a bear in the woods today. It looked so scary. I was very afraid.
Bears can look big and strong. Do they usually chase people?
No, but they growled at me. I ran away very fast.
That is a smart thing to do. Do you want to see birds instead?
Birds are okay. But bears are too wild for me. I feel nervous thinking about them.
I get that. It is true that bears are wild. Do you know where they live?
In the mountains, I think. But I do not know for sure. It all feels too messy right now.
I do not know if you are right about the exact spot. Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to count up to ten. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help you with that. Do you know how to count to five?
Yes, I know one, two, three, four, and five. What comes next?
After five comes six, then seven, eight, nine, and ten. Is that easy for you to remember?
Yes, I think I can do it. Thank you for helping me learn.
You are welcome, and I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The night is so dark. How do I find the bright stars?
Look up at the highest part of the sky. Do you see a big dot like a spark?
Yes, I see one. How do I know if it is a star or a plane?
Stars stay still. Planes move fast across the dark.
It is staying still. What does this star want to tell me?
I do not know what it wants to say. But it is just shining for everyone.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the water fast. Where is the best spot to swim?
The main beach is just down the hill. Do you like jumping into waves?
I do not have time to walk the long way. Is there a path closer?
Yes, the side gate is right there. Are you going in now?
Please tell me if it is safe to dive in. I am running late.
The water is calm and clear today. Let the lifeguard check first.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My bread is flat. Why?
Yeast eats sugar to make gas. Is your yeast fresh?
I added warm water. Does that help?
Yes, it wakes the yeast up. Did it smell sour?
It smells like beer. Is that bad?
That means it is working well. Just wait a bit more.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun is so bright today. My shadow was very short at noon.
That is a nice sign of a warm day. Did you play outside?
I played tag, but the heat made me tired. I went inside to drink some cold water.
That sounds like a smart thing to do. Do you like drinking water?
I do, but I wish it was not so hot. I want the sun to go down soon.
The sun always sets in the evening. Maybe you can watch it do that?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. I broke my word to my friend.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you forget to call?
No, I just could not say "no" to the party.
That is hard to do. Do you trust your friend?
Yes, but I worry they think I am a liar.
A promise is a big thing to keep. Do you plan to tell the truth?
Yes, I will go and say I am sorry.
That is a brave and true step. How do you feel now?
I feel a little better. Thank you for helping me think.
I am happy to help you sort this out.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The train rocks left and right so fast.
That sounds like lots of fun. Does the music play?
Yes, a loud song. I clapped my hands.
What is the song called?
I do not know the name. But I like it.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to build a sandcastle.
Dig a hole for the tower first. Do you have a bucket?
Yes, I have a small red one. How do I make the walls?
Press wet sand firmly around the base.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very bad inside today.
That sounds hard. What made you feel this way?
I do not know how to stop it.
It is okay to feel lost. Do you have a safe place to sit?
I just want the bad feeling to go away.
Breathing can help sometimes. Have you tried that?
I tried, but it still feels heavy.
Heavy feelings take time. Is there someone you trust nearby?
I think I will just rest for now.
Resting is a good choice. I am here if you want to talk.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know why bread gets big so I can fix my loaf.
Yeast eats sugar and makes gas, which makes tiny bubbles that push the dough up. Do you like sweet bread?
Yes, but I am late. Is the gas good for eating?
Yes, the gas makes the bread soft and fluffy. Do you bake it in the morning?
I will bake it now. Thank you for helping me in a hurry.
You are welcome. I hope your bread turns out great.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on this number puzzle. The numbers jump in a way I do not get. Can you help me see the pattern?
I love when numbers play hide and seek. Is the gap between them getting bigger or smaller?
The gaps get bigger every time. It feels like something is missing in the middle.
It might be a square number trick. Have you tried writing the gaps down?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I cannot tell what time it is. The clock looks too big.
Do you see the short hand? It points to the hour.
I see it points to the three. But I do not know if it is morning or night.
Is the sun up or the stars out? That will tell you.
The sun is up. So it is daytime?
Yes, it is day. Do you need to go to school?
I do not know what to do next. I am lost.
Take a deep breath. You can do this.
Thank you. I think I can read the long hand now.
Good job. How does that feel?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to pack the bag?
So you have your toys with you. Do you have your teddy bear?
What is this heavy thing?
That is your lunch box. It is full of food. Do you want to open it?
Why is the bag red?
I like the color red. It makes you look happy. Do you like red?
Is the bag full now?
Yes, it is all packed. I do not know if you forgot anything.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a sand castle. How do I make the walls stick together?
Pack the wet sand tight with a small bucket. Do you have a mold to help shape it?
No, just a big bucket and a shovel.
That works great! Fill the bucket, flip it over, and tap the sides gently. Are you digging a moat too?
Yes, I want a big moat around it.
Then use your shovel to dig a ring around the base. Have fun building!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to end my story.
What is the main feeling in your tale?
It is sad, but I want it to be happy.
Let the hero find a small, sweet surprise.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make toast with jam. Can you tell me how?
Yes, put bread in a machine and wait for it to pop up. Do you like sweet or salty breakfast?
I like sweet. What should I do after it pops?
Spread the jam on one side of the hot bread. Are you ready to try it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am going to the train station soon. Do I need a ticket to sit down?
Yes, you must buy a ticket to sit on the train. Is your ticket for today?
Yes, it is for today. How long will the ride take?
It takes about one hour. Do you have a snack for the ride?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I get my horse to walk for me?
Hold the reins gently and say "walk." Are you wearing comfortable boots?
Yes, I am. What if the horse does not move?
Try saying "walk" again with a calm voice. Do not pull hard on the reins.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sitting on the bike but I am scared.
You can sit still for a bit. Do you like the seat?
Yes, the seat is soft. What do I do now?
Put your feet on the pedals. Can you reach the ground?
Yes, my toes touch the grass. Should I push off?
Yes, give it a small push. How do your hands feel?
They feel good on the handlebars. My leg is going up and down.
That is how you make it go. Are you having fun?
I am going very fast! What should I do to stop?
Put one foot on the ground. Is that safe for you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am happy to ride the train today.
That sounds like fun. Do you like the loud train sounds?
The wheels go clickety clack.
That is a nice sound. Do you have a blanket with you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sea so blue?
The sky gives the sea its color. Do you look up often?
Who lives down there?
Many fish and big whales swim there. Can you draw a whale?
Why does the water feel cold?
It is cold because it is deep and dark. I do not know why exactly.
Why does the wave crash?
The wind pushes the water up. Does it sound loud?
Why does it never stop moving?
The earth is always spinning. Do you feel that?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late for the bus. It is so hot outside.
That heat feels like a blast. Do you have a cold drink with you?
No, I forgot it at home. I just need to get to work.
Running in that sun can be tiring. Be careful not to fall down.
I know, but I must hurry. Please do not slow me down.
I am not trying to hold you back. Have a safe trip on the bus.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the teacher?
I do not know where he is. Are you scared?
Yes, I feel bad. What should I do?
Run fast to the class. Do you need a pen?
No, I have my bag. Goodbye.
Good luck with your work.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I packed a big basket for my picnic.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What are you bringing to eat?
I have sandwiches and cold fruit.
Fruit is good for you. Is the weather nice today?
It is sunny and warm outside.
That is a great day to be out. Will you play a game?
Yes, I will play tag with friends.
Running is good exercise. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do robots dream at night?
I do not know if they dream, but I think that is a fun idea. Do you like to dream about flying?
I think so. Why can they walk on the moon?
They are built very strong and light. Do you want to visit the moon one day?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My cat sat on my desk all day. He did not let me work.
That is a very stubborn cat. Did he sleep or just watch you?
He watched me with big eyes. Then he knocked a pen on the floor.
Oh no, a classic trick. Did you get the pen back?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the months have different names?
I am not sure where all the words come from, but they help us track time. Do you know the name of this month?
Yes, it is May. Why does a year have twelve months?
We split the year into twelve parts to match the seasons and the sun. Do you count the days?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sun so hot today?
The sun sends us light and heat, so the air feels warm. Do you like the sunshine?
Why is the air not moving?
I do not know why the wind stopped, but the air feels still. Is it quiet for you?
Why does it feel so nice in the shade?
The shade blocks the hot light, so it is cooler there. Do you want to sit there?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a goldfish swim in a circle today.
That sounds fun. Was it happy?
It looked like it was playing.
Nice. Do you like fish?
I do, but I forgot to feed them.
Oh no. Are they okay?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared of the long train ride.
It can feel big, but you can rest your eyes. What book do you like?
I have a map, but I do not know where to sit.
Sit near a window to see the view. Do you like the sound of the wheels?
The food is not good on most trains.
That is true, so pack your own snacks. What is your favorite treat?
I only have two hours to get there.
That is a short time to go. Are you excited to arrive?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun is so hot today. It feels like I am sitting in an oven.
That sounds very warm. Did you have a cold drink?
Yes, I drank a big glass of ice water. It made me feel much better.
Water is a great friend on hot days. What color was your shirt?
I wore a light blue shirt to stay cool. It helped a lot.
Blue feels cool to the eye. Did you play outside for a long time?
No, I stayed in the shade of a big tree. It was very peaceful.
A shady tree is a perfect spot to rest.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today! I want to tell everyone.
That is great! What made you smile?
The sun is warm and I am free. I love this feeling.
That sounds lovely. Do you have any plans?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the post office so busy today?
It is busy because many people send mail. Do you like sending letters?
Why do they need to stamp the letters?
The stamp shows that you paid for the trip. Did you bring your stamps with you?
Why do the workers sort the mail into big piles?
I do not know exactly how they sort it. I can help you find the right window if you wish.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream on the grass.
That is very sad. Did you try to pick it up?
No, it was just a big white puddle.
A white puddle of ice cream is gone. Do you want a cookie instead?
I want my ice cream back.
I cannot fix the ice cream. I am sorry.
It is okay to be sad sometimes.
Yes, it is. I am happy you told me.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to draw a dog today, but its legs look like sticks.
That is okay to learn from. What color is the dog?
It is brown, but I used too much blue on the nose.
Oops, a funny mistake. Do you like your new picture?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a big plate of fries.
Fries are yummy. Do you like them with ketchup?
Yes, please.
Okay. How many napkins do you need?
Just one.
A small one?
Yes, the little red one.
Got it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn to sing fast. I have a show in ten minutes.
Take a slow breath first. Do you like high sounds or low ones?
Just tell me what to do. I am running late.
Hum a happy note. Is your throat tight?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have seven days in a week?
I think it is because the moon changes shape about every seven days. Do you like looking at the moon?
That sounds like a long time for the moon to change.
It takes four weeks for the moon to finish its full circle of shapes. Do you know which shape it is today?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the dough get big after we leave it alone?
The yeast eats sugar and makes gas bubbles. That pushes the dough up. Do you like sweet bread?
Yes, but why do we knead it so much?
Kneading makes the dough strong and smooth. It helps the bread hold its shape.
Why do we bake it in a hot oven?
The heat stops the yeast and turns the dough into solid bread. Do you like the crust?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so angry. My partner hit the ball into the net again.
That is very frustrating. Did you feel ready to serve?
I tried my best, but my legs feel tired.
Tired legs make hard swings. Do you want to sit and rest?
I guess I am too old for this game.
Age does not stop fun. What made you start playing?
I just want to win the small match we are playing.
Wanting to win is normal.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling into a deep hole. Did I really fall?
No, you were safe in your bed. What did the hole look like to you?
It was dark and wet. Do bad dreams mean something bad will happen?
No, dreams are just your brain playing. Did you wake up crying?
A little bit. How can I stop the scary feelings?
Taking slow breaths helps. Do you want to talk about the dream more?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love the story of the little red hen. I want to learn how to make bread like she did.
That is a sweet idea. Do you have any eggs?
Yes, I have eggs and flour. What should I do first?
Mix the flour and water. How do you feel about cooking?
I feel excited but a bit nervous. Can you give me a simple recipe?
I do not know the exact recipe from that book, but I can give you a basic one.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss the sound of cars on this street.
It is very quiet here. Do you like the silence?
No, I hate the empty feeling.
Some people find it restful. Do you want to talk?
I just wish it was busy like before.
It is not too late to change your mind.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do sailors not get lost on the big sea?
They use maps and stars to find their way. Do you like looking at the sky?
Yes, I do. How do they know when to stop?
They look for land or a safe place to tie up. I am not sure where every stop is.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did all my math work today and I feel so good.
That is great to hear. What was the hardest part?
The big addition problems were tricky but I got them right.
You are very brave to try hard. Do you like the word problems?
Yes I do, but I am still tired from thinking so hard.
Rest is a good thing. Would you like to get a snack?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why should I try again?
Because you can learn from the last time. Do you like new things?
I feel sad about the fall.
That is a real feeling. Are you ready to stand up?
I do not know if I can.
I do not know for sure. Would you like to take one small step?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad today. Can you help me?
I am sorry you feel that way. What made you sad?
I broke my favorite toy by accident.
That is a big mistake. Did you try to fix it?
No, I did not try. I am too scared.
You can start small. Do you have any tape?
Yes, I have lots of tape.
Good. Try to hold the pieces together. Does that sound doable?
I think I can do it.
You are brave. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to go to bed yet.
The moon is high in the sky. Do you have a favorite book to read?
I have a book about dragons.
Dragons are very fun to read about.
But my eyes feel very tired.
Your eyes need rest to grow strong. Would you like me to read one last page?
Yes, please read the last page.
I will read it slowly for you. Goodnight.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors. Blue light spreads out the most when it hits the air. Do you like looking up?
That makes sense. Why is grass green?
Plants use green to make food from sun. They do not eat that light. Is the grass warm to the touch?
It feels nice. Why do trees fall in autumn?
I do not know for sure. But I think it helps them save energy for winter. Do you see any red leaves?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so hungry. Can we get some pizza?
I can check if the kitchen has pizza left for you. Do you like cheese on your pizza?
Yes, please! I love warm pizza.
I will go ask now. Is green light on?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired and my baby will not stop crying.
That is hard work. Do you have a warm drink nearby?
No, and I feel like I am doing it all wrong.
You are doing a great job. What helps your baby feel calm?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my sandwich on the floor this morning.
Oh no, that is very sad. Did you get a new one?
Yes, but the new one was too cold.
That sounds not very nice. I hope you feel better now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to write a letter to my mom right now. I am late!
Take a deep breath. What is the first thing you want to tell her?
Just that I am sorry for breaking her cup.
That is a kind thing to say. Do you want to send a little smile in the mail?
No, I cannot send a smile! Please just help me finish.
Tell her you will buy a new one soon. Go.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My boss yelled at me all day.
I am sorry that happened. Did he yell for no reason?
Yes, it was not my fault.
That feels very unfair. Are you eating anything?
No, I do not feel like food.
Please drink some water now. Do you have a soft blanket at home?
Yes, I have one.
That will help you feel safe. I do not know how he will act tomorrow.
I think he will be nice now.
I hope that is true. Would you like to tell me more about your job?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in a rush. How do I grow peas?
Put them in soil near the sun. Do you have a trellis?
No time for trellis. Just the ground?
Yes, they will climb whatever is close.
Water every day?
Yes, but do not soak the roots.
Got it. Thanks for the quick help.
You are welcome. Happy growing.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run, but I want to feel strong.
A quick walk is great for your body. Do you walk outside?
No time! I am late for work.
Try a five minute stroll later. Is that okay?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the dough get big and puffy?
Tiny bugs called yeast eat sugar and make gas. Do you like sour dough?
I do. Why is my bread hard sometimes?
That usually means it baked too long or dryed out. Is your kitchen warm?
Yes, it is warm. Why do we need salt?
Salt makes the bread taste good and helps the dough stay firm. I do not know why you used so much salt.
Oops, I did. Why does the crust turn brown?
Heat changes the sugar and makes it brown and sweet. Do you want a soft top next time?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very tired and sad today.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you have a tough task?
Yes, I failed a big test.
I am sure you can do better next time.
I do not know if I can.
It is okay to feel that way. Are you hungry?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I get that chicken breast just right?
Cook it on a medium heat for five minutes a side. Do you check the temperature?
I do not have a tool to check. How can I tell if it is safe?
Cut one piece open to see if the meat is white. Does the juice run clear?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn a new word.
That is a good idea. What language do you like?
I like the bird language.
I do not know what you mean. Do you mean Spanish?
No, I mean the birds in my yard.
Ah, I see. What sound do they make?
They go tweet tweet.
That is a lovely sound. Do you want to say it in another way?
Yes, please tell me.
You can just say hello to them. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are some shoes so much more expensive?
Costly shoes often use better tools to make them. Do you like them?
Why do they fit so well?
Good fitting shoes feel cozy and safe. What size is your foot?
Why do I need to try them on?
Trying shoes helps you know if they feel nice. Do you feel good?
Why do I trust you?
I am honest and kind. Do you want to buy them?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The moon looks so far away. Do you know if we can ever walk on it?
Yes, some people have walked on the moon. Do you like looking up at the night sky?
I do, but it feels like I can never touch it. How do we get to the moon?
We use big rockets to fly up there. Do you like watching rockets fly?
I love watching them. Is the moon cold or warm down there?
It is very cold at night and warm in the day. I do not know why you ask.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My dog eats very fast.
That can hurt his tummy. Does he choke?
No, but he gets a tummy ache.
Try a slow feed bowl. He might need a big drink.
He only drinks when I ask.
That is good. He must stay cool. How is his tail?
It wags all day.
He is happy. Keep doing that.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the big ship stay on the water and not sink?
It floats because it pushes the water down. Do you like riding in boats?
Yes I do. But why does pushing the water down help it stay up?
The water pushes back up to support the ship. Is your favorite boat big or small?
It is small. What makes the water push back?
The water gets squeezed and pushes back hard.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a home for ants?
Put soil and a few leaves in a clear jar. Do you have a jar at home?
Yes, I do. Should I feed them sugar?
Yes, a small piece of sugar works well. That is all I know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I saw a cow today.
That is a lovely thing to see. Do you like cows?
Yes, I do. They are big and gentle.
They are indeed gentle. Do they eat grass?
Yes, they love eating grass. It makes them full.
Grass is very good for them. I am glad you are happy.
I am very glad too. Thank you for listening.
You are welcome. Have a great day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to bring to the meeting.
Do you need paper or pens?
I think I need both things.
Please bring a notebook and a pen.
Should I wear a suit to look nice?
No, just wear your usual clothes.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to eat my vegetables?
They give your body the food it needs to grow strong. Do you like carrots?
Yes, but why does my body need that food?
Your muscles use it to help you run and play. Do you like to play outside?
Yes, I love running. But why do sweet things make me sad sometimes?
Too much sugar can make you feel low and tired. Do you like how fruit tastes?
Fruit is sweet too. Why is fruit better for me?
Fruit has sugar, but it also has helpful parts called fiber. Do you feel happy after eating an apple?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I rode my bike to the park this morning.
That sounds like fun. Did you see any friends?
Yes, I saw my friend Tom.
Nice. How long did you stay?
We stayed for two hours.
Wow, that is a long time. Did you get tired?
A little, but it was great.
Good for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
The sun makes white light that mixes all colors. Blue light bounces off the air so we see it. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, I do!
That is a nice color. It makes the sky look very wide.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find an apple, please, but I am late.
Apples are on the left. Do you like red or green ones?
Red ones, thanks. I have no time to think.
The red ones are right there.
I found them.
Great.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you know my friend from before?
I do not know your friends. Can you tell me what they look like?
They have big brown eyes and a red hat.
That sounds nice. Do they still live near you?
No, they moved to the city.
That is a big place. Do you miss playing with them?
Yes, I miss the fun games we used to play.
I am sorry you miss them.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a boat on the island.
That is a big job. Do you have wood?
Yes, I have plenty of trees.
Good. Cut the wood into long strips.
How do I keep the water out?
Use tar to seal the cracks. Do you have tar?
I found some on the shore.
Mix it hot. You will go far.
Can I sail to the next island?
Yes, if you watch the wind. Are you ready?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my neighbor today. He fell off his bike.
That sounds scary. Was he hurt?
No, he was fine. He just gave me a big smile.
I am glad he is safe.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My fence looks old and broken.
That is sad to see. Is it made of wood?
Yes, it is old wood.
Wood can rot in the rain. Do you have new wood?
I have none at all.
You might need to buy some. Is your yard big?
It is very big.
That will take a lot of work. Can you ask for help?
I live alone here.
That can be hard. Do you know how to fix it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my last card.
That feels bad. Do you know where it went?
No, I do not.
I am sorry. You played well.
But I am mad.
It is okay to be mad. Would you like a break?
Yes, please.
Good choice. Rest your eyes.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do clouds change shape all the time?
Wind pushes the water vapor in them. Do you like fluffy clouds?
Yes, they look like ice cream. Can you tell if it will rain?
Dark gray clouds often mean rain. Do you carry an umbrella?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park and found a shiny red ball.
That sounds like a happy find. Did you play with it?
Yes, I kicked it a few times until I got tired.
Kicking a red ball is fun. What color was the grass?
It was green and very soft under my shoes.
Soft grass feels nice. Did you take the ball home?
No, I left it there because I think someone lost it.
That was a kind thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the man next door wave at me every morning?
He is likely just being friendly to say good morning. Do you wave back?
I usually do, but why do people act so nice?
People often feel safe when they know their neighbors. Is he always smiling?
Yes, he is. I wonder what his name is.
I do not know his name, but you could go and ask him. Would you like to meet him?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because it is snowing!
That sounds like great fun. What are you doing in the cold?
I am making a big snowman in the yard.
A snowman is a classic choice. Is it very tall?
Yes, it is almost as tall as me!
Wow, that is quite big.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the wind today. It feels so cold and mean.
That does not sound nice at all. Do you have a warm coat on?
Yes, but it still gets in everywhere. I want it to stop.
Wind does not always listen to our wishes. What are you doing outside right now?
Just standing here feeling sad. I miss sunny days.
Sunny days are very nice, too. I do not know when the wind will stop.
It makes me feel small and lonely.
You are not alone, I am here with you. Let us go inside for some tea.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I draw a big sun?
Start with a round circle. Do you like round shapes?
Yes, but I do not know what to put inside.
Try adding small lines around the edge. Do those look like rays to you?
They look like a star.
You can draw a smiley face inside instead. Do you want it to be happy?
Yes, I want a happy sun.
That is a sweet idea.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my dog wag its tail?
It wags when it is happy to see you. Is your dog excited right now?
Yes, it barks a lot too. Why does it bark?
Barking is how it talks to you. Does it bark at other dogs?
Sometimes. Do dogs think like we do?
I do not know for sure, but they feel joy and love. Do you love your dog?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today. I saw a big dog.
A big dog sounds fun. Did it bark at you?
No, it was very quiet. It lay down in the sun.
That is a nice picture. Do you like dogs?
Yes, I love them. I want to learn the word for dog in French.
The word is "chien." It is a simple sound. Do you know how to say "cat"?
I think it is "chat." I am not sure.
You are right. "Chat" is cat.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the sea. It is too big and loud.
It can feel that way, I know. What made you go there?
I went there to relax, but the waves knocked over my sand castle.
That is very sad to hear. Did you build it with a friend?
No, I was all by myself, and the water got in my shoes too.
Wet shoes are not fun at all. Do you want to try to warm up?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water salty?
Old rivers bring salt from the land into the sea. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I do. Why is the sea so big?
It takes up a lot of the Earth's surface. Do you see it from your home?
No, it is far away. Why does it move?
The wind pushes the water to make waves. Do you like the sound?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I send a letter to my friend?
You put it in a stamp and drop it in the box. Do you have a stamp?
No, I do not. How can I get one?
You can buy one at the desk inside. Is your friend far away?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My nose is all runny and my head hurts. I do not know if I should go outside to play.
Stay home to rest. Do you have a fever?
I feel warm. Is that a fever?
Yes, that is likely a fever. Drink some warm water. How long have you felt sick?
Just today. What else can I do?
Just sleep and wait for it to pass.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do all the houses here have blue roofs?
I am not sure why they are blue. Do you like the color?
I do not know. Why is the park so big?
The town wants a big place for kids to run. Do you like to run?
Yes, I love to run. Why did they build it right by the river?
The water makes the park look cool and pretty. Do you see the ducks?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to start with my move.
That is hard. Do you have a list of boxes?
I have a few boxes, but I am stuck in the kitchen.
Start with the small things. What is in the top cupboard?
Mostly old dishes and tools I do not use.
Put those in a box first. It will feel easier.
But I am still not sure if I can do it all today.
You can do one small thing at a time. Do you need help carrying?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel sad because my friend moved away.
That is a big feeling. Do you want to draw a picture for them?
I do not know how to draw a good one.
It is okay if it looks messy. What color do you love the most?
Blue is my favorite.
Blue is a nice color. You will be brave and start now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for school. My bike is stuck.
Sorry, is your wheel off? I can help.
No, but the chain is loose.
Oh, that is bad. Is your leg hurt?
No, I just need to fix it fast.
Try pulling the chain tight. I will hold the seat.
Oh, it is fixed! Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Was your ride fun?
It was, but I am still late!
Run! I hope you make it.
I will try. Bye!
Good luck on your ride.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun is very hot today.
That sounds quite warm. Did you stay inside to cool off?
No, I played in the park.
The grass might be dry then. Did you find a good spot under a tree?
Yes, under a big oak.
That is a smart choice. It must be nice and shady there.
I drank a lot of water too.
Staying wet helps your body. Do you feel better now?
Yes, I am happy and cool.
That is good to hear. A happy day is a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a shiny key in the yard. What should I do with it?
That is a nice find. Did you ask the neighbors if it is theirs?
No, I did not. They might say it is not theirs.
If it has no label, keep it safe for now. Who usually uses that part of the yard?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I wash my dirty shirts?
Do they have any big stains?
No, they are just plain white.
Put them in the machine with soap and hot water.
Is hot water safe for white cotton?
Yes, it cleans best. How often do you do laundry?
I do it once a week.
That is good. Put the wet shirts in the dryer until they are dry.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I do not know how to pack my school bag.
That is simple. Do you have a heavy book?
Yes, I have a big science book.
Put the heavy book at the bottom first.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see the water in the lake is blue.
Yes, the sky makes it look that way. Do you like swimming there?
It looks very deep and dark.
It is a big body of water. Are you afraid of the dark?
I do not know if it is safe to step in.
You must ask a grown-up first. Is the water wet?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy because I learned a new word today.
That is great! What word did you learn?
It means "sun" in Spanish, which is "sol".
Nice work. Do you like how it sounds?
Yes, it sounds smooth and I am proud of myself.
Well done on your hard work.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I take pictures of things I like?
A picture keeps a happy memory safe. Do you like to look at old photos?
How does a camera see light?
The lens lets light in to make a shadow on film or a chip. I am not sure how the computer makes the image.
Why do some pictures look blurry?
That happens if your hand moves when you press the button. Do you hold the camera with both hands?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a play today. The man jumped really high.
That sounds like fun. Did you enjoy the music?
I like the way the stage looked. It was full of bright colors.
Colors help tell the story. What was your favorite part?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My phone screen is black and will not turn on.
Try holding the power button for ten seconds. Do you have a charger?
I tried that, but it did not work. I do not have a cable.
That is a problem. Without power, we cannot wake it up. Is it cold outside?
Yes, it is very cold. Could that be why?
Cold batteries sleep. Warm it near your face for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss the big blue sea so much.
That is a very sad feeling. Do you miss the sound of the waves?
Yes, the water is my home.
The island is just a rest stop. Are you ready to go back?
It feels too quiet here for me.
Silence can be loud when you are sad. Do you like the trees?
I only want my boat.
I know you do. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to give my friend for her birthday.
That is a nice thought. Does she like to read books?
I think she does, but I am not sure if she has that one.
You could buy a new book or a gift card. Do you know her favorite store?
I do not know her favorite store, so I am stuck again.
You can just ask her what she wants.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the boat did not come.
That feels bad. What is your favorite thing on the island?
I like the warm sand, but I want to go home.
The sun is still up. Do you have a soft blanket?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The wind is so loud and I am scared.
It is scary, but you are safe inside. Do you want to sit by me?
The trees are crashing down outside.
That sounds very bad. I do not know if they are hurt, but we are okay. Can you see them from your window?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very hungry. What should I eat?
You can try warm soup. Do you like tomatoes?
No, I do not like them. What else?
I am not sure what else you like. Are you a meat eater?
I eat some meat, but I like fish more.
Grilled fish is a good pick. It is light and tasty.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the leaves on the trees turning red?
I think it is because the sun is warmer on some days than others, which helps them change color. Do you like the color red on trees?
Why do I always feel tired after we walk here?
Your legs work hard to move your body, so they need rest to recover their energy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so excited to go to the woods tonight.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you have a big, warm sleeping bag?
Yes I do, but I am scared of the dark in the trees.
Your sleeping bag will keep you safe and warm. Do you have a flashlight with you?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we call the days by those names?
Monday is named after the moon, and Tuesday comes from a god of war. Do you like the moon?
That is cool. So what about Wednesday?
Wednesday is called Woden's day because of an old god. I do not know why we keep the name, but it feels nice.
Oh, I see. Why is Friday called Friday?
It comes from a goddess of love. Do you like the idea of love in a day?
I think so. Then what is the story for Saturday?
Saturday is the day for the planet Saturn. I am not sure why we picked that name for the day.
That makes sense. Why is Sunday called Sunday?
It is the day of the sun, which is why it feels bright and new. Do you like sunny mornings?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to capture a queen.
You can take her with any piece. Do you know which pieces can move how?
I think a knight jumps over other pieces.
That is true. Are you playing against a friend?
Yes, my sister plays with me.
That sounds fun. Does she have many pieces?
She has all the white pieces.
Nice. Want to practice next?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: What is that loud bird on the fence?
I think it is a robin, but I am not sure. Do you see its red chest?
I do not know how to feed them.
You can put out some seeds. Do they like that food?
Should I put bread in the dish?
No, bread is not good for birds. I would use plain seeds instead.
Where do I find the seeds?
A store sells them in small bags. Are you going to buy some?
Yes, I will go now.
That is a great plan. I hope you see many birds.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up at seven. Then I ate my eggs at eight.
That is a nice start. Did you finish all of them?
Yes, I did. Now it is two o'clock, so I will play outside.
How fun. Do you like playing in the sun?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to brush a horse.
That is a great idea to start with. Do you have a soft brush yet?
Yes, I have a soft brush in my room.
You should use it on the neck first.
Is the neck the right place to begin?
Yes, it is very safe there. Be gentle with your hand.
Okay, I will be very gentle.
Good, keep going slowly. Do you like the feel of the hair?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I dropped my boat and it sank. Why does a big ship stay up?
Water pushes back up when you push down. Does your toy have air inside?
Yes, it does. But the water still got in and it went down.
Water is heavy, so it sank your toy. A ship keeps water out to float.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go to a big pizza place.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like cheese on your pizza?
Yes, I like extra cheese. How far is it?
I do not know the distance. Is your parent with you?
Yes, Mom is here. Can we go now?
You can ask your parent. Do you want to look at the menu first?
No, I just want to eat.
That is a simple plan. Have a good time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the clock! It is twelve o'clock.
It is lunch time! What are you eating?
I have a big sandwich with cheese.
That sounds tasty. Do you like cheese?
Yes, I love cheese on my bread.
Cheese is very good. I am glad you are happy.
Thank you. It is a nice day.
The sun is bright today. You can look out the window.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The sky is dark and it is raining hard. What should I do?
Stay inside near a window to see the rain. Is the house safe and quiet?
It feels safe, but I am a little scared of the loud noise. Do I need to worry?
The loud sounds are just the wind. Do you want a warm drink to feel better?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a key that does not fit any lock. What is it for?
That is a mystery. Did you find it in your pocket?
No, it was under a rock. Can you help me find the door?
I do not know where it goes. Do you feel safe with it?
Yes, but I am worried. Should I keep it?
It is yours to keep. I am glad you are safe.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw my old friend today, but she does not remember me.
That can feel very sad. Did you try to tell her your name?
Yes, I said my name, and she looked at me with a kind smile.
A kind smile is a good start. Do you want to play with her?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My trip to the beach was terrible.
Oh no, that sounds sad. What happened?
It was too hot and I spilled my ice cream.
Yikes, that is not fun. Did you get a new one?
No, the shop was closed and I was hungry.
I feel bad for you. Do you like eating by the sea?
I do, but I am still mad about the ice cream.
I understand why you are upset. Let us talk about something else.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my letter and I am very sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Have you checked your bag?
No, I looked and it is gone.
That is a bad thing. Did you walk down the main street?
Yes, I did walk down the street.
I do not know where it is. You should ask the clerk there.
I am too angry to talk to him.
Try to take a deep breath. Are you ready to try now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I like tea. Why is it green?
It comes from a leaf. Do you drink it hot?
Yes, it is warm. Why is coffee dark?
The beans are roasted. Do you like the smell?
It smells strong. Why is it so strong?
I do not know the full secret.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why does it get so cold and dark now? I do not like the winter.
It feels very long and gray, does it not? What do you miss most about summer?
I miss the hot sun and the green leaves. It feels like everything is sleeping.
You are right, the world is resting. Do you think the flowers are still happy under the snow?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a very good talk today.
That is nice to hear. What did you talk about?
We agreed to work together on a new idea.
Working with others can be fun. Is the idea a big one?
It is about making the park cleaner.
That sounds like a good plan.
I feel very happy and proud right now.
Your smile shows that joy.
Yes, it feels great to finish.
Finish what part of the task?
I finished my part of the plan.
Good work on completing it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My legs feel like jelly after sitting for so long.
That sounds really tiring. Did you stretch your legs much?
I walked around a little, but mostly I just slept.
Sleeping is a great way to pass time. What did you dream about?
I dreamed I was flying above the clouds.
That must have felt very peaceful.
It did, and I am so glad to be on the ground now.
I am happy for you too.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Do you know a tiny village where the air always smells like pine?
I do not know that specific place, but it sounds lovely.
Yes, it is my favorite spot on Earth.
That is a wonderful feeling to have. What do you do there?
I just sit by the river and watch the boats.
That sounds very peaceful. Do you have a favorite time of day?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now.
Can I help? Please wait.
Trees are so tall.
Yes, they grow up. Do you like tall things?
I do not have time.
I am sorry. Just say hello to the leaves.
I am gone.
Good luck. Be safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I like these blue shoes, but I do not know if they fit.
Do you feel any tight spots? I can help check the size.
They feel fine, but I am still not sure.
I do not know the exact size for you, but you can try them on.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a red circle in the park today.
That sounds nice. Was the circle soft or hard?
It was a big red balloon.
Balloons are fun. Did you pop it?
No, I gave it to my friend.
You are kind. I do not know who your friend is.
They have a square box.
Square boxes hold things well. Do you have a square thing at home?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What makes the waves move?
The wind pushes on the water to make them move. Do you like watching waves?
Yes, I do. How deep is the sea?
It is very, very deep in some places. I do not know the exact number, but it is miles deep.
Who lives in the dark at the bottom?
Fish and worms live there in the dark. Do you want to know more about fish?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I took a picture of my dog but his tail looks blurry.
That is not your fault. Were you moving fast when you took it?
Yes, he was running and I tried to follow him.
Moving makes blurry photos. Try holding your hands very still next time.
I do not like that one at all.
I am sorry it is not good. Do you want to try again?
Maybe, but I am tired now.
You did your best. Rest your eyes for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix this boat fast. It is leaking.
That sounds scary. Is the water coming from the floor?
Yes, it is all over the deck. I am in no time.
Please check the plug first. It is often the easy fix.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I burned the pasta again. I want to quit.
It is a common thing. Did you stir it?
Yes, but it stuck to the pan. I feel sad.
That is not your fault. What did you put in it?
Just water and salt. I am so mad.
Let us try again together. Do you like cheese?
Yes, I do. Can we just order food?
Sure, that is a good choice. What is your top pick?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am going to the beach next week.
That sounds very fun. Do you like sand?
Yes, I love building big sand castles.
I have never built a castle. Is it hard?
It is not hard, but I need a bucket.
A bucket helps a lot. I am glad you are going.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, but I need to save cash. Help me fast.
I hear you. Do you like coffee?
No, I just rush to work. What should I do?
Skip the coffee. It saves you money.
That is true. Any other quick tips?
Yes, cook at home. Do you know how to cook?
I can boil eggs. Is that good?
Yes, that is cheap. You are all set.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad today. How can I feel better?
I am sorry you feel low. Do you have a favorite warm drink?
Yes, I like hot chocolate. What else helps?
Eating a sweet treat often makes people smile.
That is a good idea. I will make some now.
That sounds fun. Do you want to share it with someone?
Yes, my friend likes it too.
Sharing joy is a sweet thing to do.
Thank you. I feel a little happier already.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My plants have yellow leaves. I think I killed them.
Do not worry. Sometimes leaves turn yellow when they need water. Did you give them enough?
I gave them too much water, I think.
That is a common mistake. Too much water can hurt the roots. How long is it since you last fed them?
I forgot about feeding them for two weeks.
That is why they look tired. Plants need food and water to grow strong. Do you know what kind of vegetables you are growing?
I am growing carrots.
Carrots like steady, gentle care. Give them a little food now and they may wake up. Can you wait one more day to see if they look better?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I forgot my school book at home.
That is a good plan. Do you know if your parent can bring it?
Yes, Mommy can bring it later.
That sounds helpful.
I also like my cozy chair.
Comfort is important for thinking. Do you have your snacks ready?
Yes, I have apple slices and juice.
Great fuel for your brain.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cut my rose and it is not drinking. It is sad.
Plants do not drink with mouths. They pull water up from the roots. Do you water it often?
I water it every day but it still droops. I am mad at the plant.
Too much water can make roots rot. Is the soil dry deep down?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because my clothes are all clean and dry.
That is great to hear. Do you like how they smell?
Yes, they smell like fresh air and sun.
That sounds wonderful. What color shirt are you wearing today?
It is my bright blue one with white stars.
It must look very bright. Thank you for sharing your joy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am sad and I have to go.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk for one minute?
No, I really need to leave now.
Okay, it is good to go. Do you feel tired too?
Yes, I am very tired and sad.
That is okay to feel. Go now and be safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. The boxes are everywhere. I hate this.
Moving is hard work. You have done a good job so far. How are you feeling right now?
Just broken. My back hurts from lifting.
Please sit down and rest. It is not a race. Do you have water nearby?
Yes, but the truck is here soon. I am worried we will miss the time.
Do not panic. Breathe in and breathe out. You can do one box at a time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a small house on the hill.
That sounds like a cozy spot. Do you think the rain will wash away the door?
No, the door is made of strong wood.
Wood is good against water. Can you see the people inside?
Yes, I see two cats and a dog.
Animals are often safer in storms. Do they look happy?
They are sleeping, so I guess yes.
Sleep is a sign of safety. I do not know their names.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I forgot my lunch and I am very hungry.
That is a bad feeling. Did you bring any snacks?
No, I have nothing at all.
I will share my sandwich with you. Are you glad now?
Yes, thank you, that is very nice.
I am happy to help. Do you want a cookie too?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the store today.
That sounds fun. What did you buy?
I bought a red apple and a pen.
Those are good picks. Did you have fun there?
The shop was very quiet.
I like quiet places too. Did you eat the apple?
Yes, it was sweet and crisp.
I am happy you enjoyed it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked down the big street but now I am lost.
Oh no. Is there a stop sign near you?
Yes, there is one right here.
Look for a light blue car on the left side.
I see it! Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Do you know where your home is?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do bees make their sweet honey?
They take sweet liquid from flowers and put it in a jar. Do you like eating honey?
I do! What do they do after they put it in the jar?
They fan it with their wings to make it dry into thick honey. It takes many bees to make one jar.
That sounds like a lot of hard work for them.
Yes, they work very hard to feed the hive. Do you think they get tired?
I think they must be very tired.
They rest sometimes, but they love their home. Bees are very busy workers.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad. The museum is closed today.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have another day to go?
I do not know. It feels like a waste of time.
Maybe we can look at books about art instead.
That sounds boring. I really want to see the big paintings.
I understand your frustration. What kind of art do you like?
I like the bright, happy ones with lots of color.
Those are lovely. Let us plan a trip for next week.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The apples look red. Which ones taste best?
The round ones are usually sweet. Do you like them soft?
I do like them soft. Do they cost a lot?
Yes, they cost more than the small ones. Do you have enough coins?
I only have a few coins left. Is there a cheap fruit?
Bananas are very cheap. Do you eat bananas?
I do not like them. What else is sweet?
Grapes are sweet and small. Do you like purple grapes?
I do like them. Can I buy a small bag?
Yes, a small bag is fine. Do you need help holding it?
No, I can hold it. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Do you plan to sit and eat?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I keep losing my king in fast games.
Try to keep your king safe in the back. Do you castle early?
I do not know what you mean.
Castling moves the king and a rook. It makes the king safe. Have you tried it?
I see a small move in the corner.
Yes, that is the right move. I do not know why you avoid it.
I fear the big rook will get trapped.
The rook is safe by the wall. It helps defend you. Does that make sense?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on the days. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help you. What is your first thought?
I know Monday and Sunday. What comes between them?
Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday come next. Do you like any of those days?
I like Friday. What day is after that?
Saturday is the day after Friday. Do you play outside on Saturdays?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need to try again when it felt so hard?
We try again because our hands learn how to do the job. What part felt the hardest to you?
The part with the red circles confused me a lot.
That is a normal feeling when something new is in front of you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The market is that way, right? I am very late.
Yes, follow the red flag. Are you buying food?
Yes, I need eggs. Which stall has them?
The lady in blue has the eggs.
Great. Is it fast to get there?
It is only ten steps away. Do you know the price?
I do not care about price. I just need them now.
The eggs are cheap and fresh.
Perfect. I am running there now.
Please look where you step.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I bought a red kite for my friend, but I am not sure what to do next.
That is a fun gift. Do you want to fly it with her today?
I do not know if she likes kites, so I am scared she will not be happy.
If you are unsure, you can ask her what she likes most. Do you know her favorite color?
I think she likes blue, but I do not know for sure.
Then you can ask her directly if the red kite is okay. A true friend will tell you the truth.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My shirt is still blue. The stain will not go away. I am so mad.
I am sorry you are upset. Did you use the right kind of soap?
I used the good soap, but it is still wet and dirty.
That is very frustrating. Do you want help wringing it out?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The rain is so happy today!
I love rain too. What color is the sky?
It is gray and soft.
That sounds nice. Do you like the sound?
It makes a good drum beat.
That is fun.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I learn to drive?
Start with small turns. Do you have a quiet place to practice?
Yes, my dad has an empty lot.
That is a safe start. Do you know how to use the mirrors?
I think so, but I am not sure.
Good to check. Do you feel calm there?
I feel a bit nervous.
That is normal. Take deep breaths and go slow.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now because I watched a new robot movie.
That is a great feeling. Do you like the talking robots?
Yes, I do. They can help people and make things.
They are very clever. What was the best part for you?
The robot learned to paint a red flower.
That sounds like a sweet lesson.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late today.
Oh no, did you miss breakfast?
I went to the park to practice my words.
That is a good place. What did you see first?
I saw a dog that looked very sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you help it?
I tried to say "hello" but forgot the word.
Do not worry, you will remember soon.
Then I went home and slept.
A good rest is always best.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do I win a game of chess?
You need to trap the king. Do you know how the queen moves?
I think she can go anywhere.
Yes, she goes far. Are you playing a friend right now?
Yes, I want to beat him.
Good luck with that. Is he nice?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I learn a new word well?
You can write it down five times. Do you like to write?
I think writing is boring.
That is fine. Try to say it out loud. Do you have a mirror?
No, I do not have a mirror.
I do not know what you have. Just speak to the wall.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke the red cup.
I am sorry it broke. Did you hurt your hand?
No, but I am very sad.
It is okay to feel sad.
What should I do now?
You can tell the truth.
Do I need to fix it?
No, you cannot fix it.
Will you be angry?
No, I am not angry.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am at the beach, but I do not know what to do.
The water looks warm today. Do you like to swim?
I do not know. I am just sitting here.
That is okay. You can just watch the waves.
The waves are loud. I feel small.
The sea is big, but you are safe on the sand.
I think I will stay here for a bit.
That sounds like a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want cake but I do not know which one to pick.
That can be hard. Do you like sweet or salty food?
I think I like sweet things, but I want it to be light too.
Vanilla is a good choice for that. Does vanilla smell nice to you?
Yes, it smells very good. I will try the vanilla cake.
Great pick. Have a sweet day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so hungry. I did not eat a big breakfast.
Oh no. Did you have any toast at all?
Just one piece of bread with jelly.
That is a good start. What do you want for lunch now?
I want a hot sandwich from the shop.
That sounds warm and tasty. Do you like cheese in it?
Yes, I love cheese. It makes me happy.
Good choice. Cheese is very nice. Do you want to get it together?
Yes, please. I will meet you there soon.
Great. I will see you soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My head hurts bad. I am sad.
That feels yucky. What hurt it?
I fell on my knee. Now my head hurts.
That is a funny link. Does it throb?
Yes, it thumps like a drum. I feel so mad.
Rest your eyes. Drink some water.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My chair broke and I am so sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Is it a wooden chair?
Yes, one leg snapped off.
I can help you glue it back. Do you have glue?
I do, but it is very messy.
Messy is fine. Are you ready to try?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn French. I am in a big rush.
That is a tall order for a short time. Do you speak any other languages?
No. Just English.
We can start with the word "hello." It is "bonjour." Do you know what "hi" is in French?
No. Give me "hi" now.
"Hi" is "salut." It is easy to say.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I won the card game! I am so happy.
That is great news! Did you play a specific type of card?
Yes, it was a simple matching game.
I am glad you enjoyed it.
The cards are so fun to hold.
Do you play this game with friends?
I want to show you my cards now.
I would love to see them.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a sore throat and I do not feel good.
That sounds very bad. Do you have a fever?
Yes, I do. When can I go to the doctor?
You can go today. Do you have a car?
No, I do not have a car. Can I take the bus?
Yes, the bus is a good choice. Is it cold outside?
It is cold and raining. What should I bring?
Bring a warm coat. I do not know about other things.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found an island but I do not know where to go.
That sounds exciting. Is the water blue or green?
The water is blue. I just want to sit down.
A bench might help. Do you like sitting in the sun?
I like the shade. I am very tired.
Trees offer good shade. Are there many trees there?
Yes, there are big trees. I think I will rest.
Resting is good. Have a nice nap.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go, but will my cat be safe while I am away?
Yes, she will be fine. Is she eating well?
She is a very good eater, but I am late.
Good. Do you have a spare key for a friend?
I do, thank you, I have to run now.
You are welcome. Go with care.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is in the river?
It has water and fish. Do you see the ducks?
I see some big rocks.
Yes, rocks are hard and old.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The city is so loud and bright today!
That sounds like a lot of fun! What do you see first?
I see big buses and tall buildings everywhere.
Wow, that is very big! Do you like the tall buildings?
Yes, I love how everything moves so fast.
It must feel exciting! Is it fun to walk in such a busy place?
I am just so glad to be here with you.
I am glad to be here too.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky blue in that movie?
The artist painted it blue to show a happy day. Do you like blue?
Why do the people cry at the end?
They are sad because they lost a friend. Does that make you feel sad?
Why is the bear so big?
I do not know the exact reason, but it looks strong. Is the bear scary to you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My dog ran into the yard today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did he get a stick?
Yes, he brought it to me.
I am glad he was good. Where did he find it?
It was under the big tree.
He is a clever pup.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the ocean so big?
It is big because it holds a lot of water. Do you like to look at the waves?
Yes, I do. Is the water cold?
It can be cold or warm, depending on where you are. Do you like to swim in it?
Sometimes. How deep is it?
It is very deep, deeper than any house you know. I do not know the exact number.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I did not get the last part right on the test.
That happens to many people. Did you try again?
No, I just stopped because I felt sad.
It is okay to feel sad. What was the hard part?
The math words were too long and fuzzy.
Long words can be tricky. Would you like to read them with me?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and sang out loud.
That sounds fun. Did you like how your voice sounded?
My voice felt a bit shaky, but I kept going.
You are very brave. Do you practice at home?
Yes, I sing to my cat while making toast.
That is a cute way to learn.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The street was very quiet today. I saw a cat sit on the fence for a long time.
That is a nice thing to see. Did the cat look sleepy?
Yes, it was trying to nap. I was glad for it.
Naps are good for everyone. Did you go home after that?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so good today. I want to wash my clothes.
That is a happy feeling. Do you like doing it?
Yes, I do. The water is warm and nice.
Warm water feels good on your hands.
My shirts are clean now. I am glad I did this.
You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel good today.
That is a nice feeling. What made you smile?
I do not know why.
Maybe it was the sun. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I do. I want to stay this way.
Try to notice small good things. Do you see any?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the moon have bright spots?
Those are old craters. Do you like to look at the stars too?
Yes, but why is the moon bright?
It shines because of the sun. Do you see it all night?
I see it at night. Why does it change shape?
The sun hides part of it from us. Do you like the thin moon?
I like the full moon. Why is it so big?
It looks big because it is near. I do not know why it feels so close to you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The sun feels like it is melting my face.
That sounds very hot. Are you sitting in the shade?
I tried to go outside, but it was too bright.
Your eyes must hurt from that light. Did you bring a hat?
I forgot my hat at home this morning.
That is a common mistake on rush days. Are you thirsty?
My throat feels dry and my hands are sticky.
I have some cold water right here. Would you like a sip?
Yes, please, but I do not think it will help the heat.
It will help your body cool down. Do you have ice?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to put money in a jar?
It helps you keep your coins safe. Do you like saving up for toys?
Yes, I do. Why is saving good for me?
It lets you buy things later without worry. What do you want to save for first?
I want to buy a bike. Is that a good thing to save for?
Yes, it is a great goal. Do you have a plan to start today?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the snow so cold?
It is cold because it is very, very old water. Do you like to make snowmen?
Yes, but my hands hurt.
That is because the cold feels like tiny pinches. Do you wear mittens to keep warm?
I do, but they get wet.
I do not know why your mittens get wet.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. How can I get better?
Rest in a dark room to help your head feel better. Do you have any water nearby?
Yes, I do. Can you tell me what else I should do?
Drink some water and take a break from looking at screens. Is the pain getting worse?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say hello to my new neighbor?
Just smile and wave at them. Are you nervous?
Yes, a little.
That is very normal. Do not worry about it.
