What if they do not wave back?
They might just be busy. Try again next time.
Okay, I will try that.
Good luck. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I count the points in this hand?
You add up the face cards and the tens. How many aces do you have?
I have two aces, but I am not sure what they are worth.
Each ace is usually one point. Are you playing poker or rummy?
I am playing rummy, but I feel confused about the rules.
That is okay, we can learn together. Do you want to make a set?
Yes, I have three of the same card, but I am not sure if that is a set.
Yes, three matching cards make a set. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My baby cries all night. I am so tired. What should I do?
Try swaddling him to make him feel safe. How many times does he wake up?
He wakes up six times. I do not know if I am doing it right.
That is a lot. Is he hungry when he cries?
I feed him, but he still cries. I am scared I am missing something.
I am not a doctor, so I cannot give medical advice. Please ask your nurse for help.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to walk, but my legs hurt so bad.
I am sorry you are in pain. Are your shoes tight?
No, I just feel too tired to start again.
Walking can be hard when you are tired. Do you want to try just five minutes?
I guess I can try, but I might quit early.
That is still a good thing. How is your heart feeling now?
It beats fast, so I will rest for a bit.
Resting is important too. Tell me if you need help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need food now. Where is the best place to eat?
There is a good spot on Main Street. Do you like meat?
Yes. But I am very late. Can I get food fast?
Yes, they make it quick. Is that too far for you?
No. I will go there. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Have a nice meal.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to teach my robot to walk straight.
You can set the goal and give it space. Do you have a wide floor to practice on?
Yes, I have a big room for it.
That is a good place to start. Put it in the middle and press start.
It keeps turning to the left.
That may be a sensor issue. Have you checked the wheels for dirt?
The wheels look clean and spin well.
Then the code might be the problem. Let us check the settings together.
How do I open the code?
I do not know your specific robot model. Can you read me the brand name?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great goal. Do you have your shoes with you?
Yes, I am sitting on the floor right now.
Good. Start by making a big loop with one end.
Okay, I made a loop. What do I do next?
Take the other end and cross it over the loop. Do you see the little pocket formed?
Yes, I see the pocket. I am a bit confused.
Do not worry. Just slide the end into the pocket and pull tight.
I did it! The bow is tight and stays.
Well done. You did a very good job.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do ships go round the big rock?
I guess they like the view there. Do you like looking out?
Do they get to keep their toys?
I do not know if they have toys. Do you have one?
I think they feel alone up there.
That sounds very lonely indeed. I hope they have friends.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The waves hit my feet and it felt so cold.
That is a nice way to start the day. Do you like the water?
Yes, I love watching the fish swim by in the clear sea.
Fish are very fast to catch with your eyes.
I also found a big shell that looked like a white star.
A star shell is a beautiful find. Did you keep it?
I put it in my bag and went to sit on the warm sand.
The sun is very kind to people who rest.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I drank hot tea at work. It helped me feel warm.
Tea is nice and warm. Do you drink tea every day?
Yes, I like it best. I saved my coffee for home.
That sounds good. I do not know how much coffee is safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very confused about the days of the week.
Do not worry. Can you tell me which day comes after Monday?
Is it Tuesday? I am not sure.
Yes, that is right. Do you know what day comes after Sunday?
I think it is Monday again. Is that true?
You are correct. It is a circle. Do you want to count them all for fun?
Yes, please. I want to be sure I have them all.
Great. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the red pen. My teacher wants it now.
Is it in your bag?
No. I am so late.
Check your desk. Did you leave it there?
Yes! It is there. Thank you.
Good luck with school.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have too many toys, and I do not know what to keep.
That is hard. Do you play with all of them?
I play with some, but not all. I love my little cars.
Keep the ones you play with most. Would you like to trade the rest?
Trade them? I do not know how to do that.
You can swap things with friends. Do you have a favorite friend?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have twelve months in a year?
It is a long time for the Earth to spin around the sun. Do you like watching the seasons change?
Why is December called the twelfth month?
It comes from a word that means twelve. Do you know how to count to twelve?
Why are some months longer than others?
Old people tried to match the moon to the year. It does not fit perfectly. Did you know February is usually short?
Why do we call them by names?
The names come from old gods and words. Do you have a favorite month?
Why does the year ever end?
I do not know why time stops or starts. It just feels like that.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I see the sun better?
You should wear dark glasses to protect your eyes. Do you have a pair?
Yes, I do. Is it safe to look at it?
It is only safe for a short time with good glasses. Do you wear hats outside?
Sometimes, I do. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Stay safe in the light.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I put the big boat in the tub and it sank. What is wrong with it?
It sank because water got inside. Do you have a dry ship?
I do not have a dry one, and I do not know how to fix this one.
Let us help you. Do you want to try filling it with light stuff?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. My phone shows no picture.
That feels bad. Do you have some air to breathe?
Yes, but the screen is just black.
Try turning it off, then on again. Does that help?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to draw a big, round sun.
That sounds fun. Do you like bright colors?
Yes, I use orange and yellow.
Great choice. What else do you want in the sky?
I do not know what to add next.
That is okay. Try adding some white clouds.
Will the clouds look right?
Yes, if you make them soft and fluffy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke your cup. I am so sad. I did not mean to do it.
It is okay. I am not angry. How did it happen?
I tripped and dropped it. I feel bad.
Accidents happen to everyone. Are you hurt?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a tiny magnet in my shoe this morning.
That is a funny place to find one. Did it stick to anything?
It did not stick to anything, but I kept it just in case.
Good thinking. Why do you think you kept it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go. What is the sea?
It is a big body of salty water. Do you like to swim?
No, I am late. Can you see the stars?
I can see the blue water. Do you have a boat?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big ham sandwich today.
That sounds tasty. What did you put in it?
I added some cheese and lettuce.
Nice choice. Do you have any fruit with it?
Yes, I have cold juice and cookies.
That is a great plan. Where are you going?
I am going to the park near my home.
Enjoy your time outside. It looks nice there.
Thank you so much for your kind words.
You are welcome. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a tricky puzzle. It has a lock that only opens with a secret word.
That sounds fun. Do you have any clues?
Yes, the first letter is B and it is a fruit.
I do not know the word. Is it a berry?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My chair broke. I need it fixed now. Please help.
Is it wobbly or fallen apart?
The leg snapped off. It is very loose. I must leave soon.
Have you found the other pieces?
Yes, they are on the floor. What should I do?
Do you have wood glue?
No, I only have tape. Is that good?
Tape will not hold it well. Please use glue if you can find some.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new magnet today and I am so happy!
That is great news! What does it look like?
It is small and round with a red rim.
A red rim sounds cool. Do you have a fridge to stick it on?
Yes, I put it right on the door!
That is a fun spot. Does it hold tight?
Yes, it holds my drawing very well.
I am glad it works for you. Tell me more about that drawing.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My sandwich got crushed in my bag. It looks like a mess.
Oh no, that is too bad. Do you have a backup snack?
No, just that sandwich. I am so hungry.
I am sorry you feel that way. Would you like half of my salad?
Yes, please. Thank you for being so kind.
You are very welcome. Are you still grumpy about the bread?
A little, but I feel better now. Thanks.
Good luck with your work.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make honey, but I do not have bees. How can I do it?
You cannot make real honey from nothing, but you can mix sugar and water. Do you like sweet tea?
Yes, I love sweet tea. What should I mix?
Mix one part water with two parts sugar and heat it gently. Do you have a small pot?
I have a big pot. Is that okay?
A big pot works, but be careful of the hot liquid. Do you have a friend to help?
My mom is here. What do I do with the mix?
Let it cool, then pour it into a jar. Would you like to taste a little?
Can I feed some to the birds?
Yes, but do not put it where children can easily touch it. Do you have a safe spot?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very tired of waiting for my turn.
Waiting can feel long. What are you waiting to do?
I just want to start playing right now.
Deep breaths help. Have you tried to count to ten?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The line was very long and I am late.
I am sorry you waited so long. Did you find a spot to sit?
No. I stood up all this time. My legs hurt.
Standing is hard. Do you know where the door is?
I think it is on the left. I just want to go home.
Going home is a good plan. Are your shoes comfortable?
Yes. But my mood is not good. I just need to leave.
Resting is nice. Please take care of yourself.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a coin in the park.
That is fun. Did you look around to see who dropped it?
I did, but no one was there.
It is hard to guess. Do you want to keep it?
I am not sure. It feels wrong.
You know what is right. Do you feel better if you give it back?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke my friend’s toy. I do not know what to say.
You can say sorry right away. Do you have the toy with you now?
No, it is broken on the floor. What should I do next?
Tell your friend you will try to fix it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The cat knocked over the lamp. It made a big mess on the floor.
Oh no, that sounds scary. Did the cat hurt itself?
No, it is fine. Now I must sweep up all the glass.
Be very careful with your feet. Will you get help?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do ants have such tiny heads?
Their heads are small so they can squeeze into tight spaces. Do you like watching them walk in lines?
Do bugs have feelings like us?
Scientists think some bugs can feel pain or hunger. Do you have a favorite bug to look at?
Why is the ladybug red?
The red color tells bad animals to stay away because it tastes bad. Have you ever found one on a leaf?
Can flies see in the dark?
They see very well, but they like the light more. Do you get many flies in your house?
How do bees make honey?
They suck sweet juice from flowers and turn it into honey. Do you put honey on your toast?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I get tired when I run?
Your muscles use up energy so you have to rest. Do you usually walk or run?
I walk most of the time. Why does my heart beat so fast?
Your heart pumps more blood to help your legs. That is a good sign!
Is it bad for me to stop?
It is fine to rest if you need to. Take deep breaths.
Thanks for helping me understand.
You are welcome. Keep going at your own pace.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a scary dream about a big, dark dog.
That sounds upsetting. Did you wake up crying?
Yes, my heart was beating very fast.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you feel safe now?
Yes, I drank some warm milk and feel better.
That is a good idea for rest.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very scared of my math test.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you know the hard parts?
I do not know how to do the word problems.
That is a common thing. Try to read the story first.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very sad because I lost my blue ball.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you check under your bed?
I did check there, but it was not there.
Maybe you can ask your mom to help look with you. Do you like playing in the garden?
Yes, I like the garden, but I do not know where the ball is.
I do not know where it is either. Let us go look together, okay?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the food so cheap there?
The kitchen is very small. Do you like pizza?
Yes, I do. Why is the bread fresh?
They bake it each day. It tastes sweet.
Why is the place so quiet?
I do not know for sure. Is it a busy day?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because you forgot to help me.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you tell me what you needed?
Yes, I told you to bring me a book.
I do not know if I heard you. Why is that book so important?
It was a promise.
I am sorry for breaking my word. Was the story inside special?
Yes, it is my favorite one.
I will try to find it for you. Do you want to check the shelf now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to make a shed in my yard.
That sounds like fun. What size do you want?
I need room for my bike and a table.
A small box will work. Do you have the tools?
I have a hammer, but no other tools.
You will need a saw too. Is there a store near you?
Yes, I can go to the big store.
Good. Buy wood and nails there.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to finally build my shed.
That is great news. Are you starting today?
Yes, I bought all the wood and nails last week.
You are ready to work. What shape did you pick?
It will be a big square box with a slanted roof.
That sounds solid and roomy. Do you have a helper?
No, I am doing all of it myself with a hammer.
You are very strong. Do you know how to put the roof on?
I have a plan, but I am glad you asked.
I do not know the exact steps. Good luck with your build.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are mountains so tall?
The earth pushed rock up over time. Do you like looking up at them?
What makes a mountain become a mountain?
It must be at least three hundred feet high. Do you measure things often?
Do people live on the very top?
No, the air is too thin and cold. I do not know if any do.
How do birds fly that high?
They have strong wings and light bones. Do you like watching birds?
Why do clouds sometimes touch them?
The peaks are very close to the sky. Does that look cool to you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a funny clown in a play today.
That sounds fun! Did he wear a big red nose?
Yes, it was very big and shiny.
Cool. Did you laugh when he did tricks?
I laughed really hard at the juggling.
Wow. Is it about a circus or a magic show?
It is about a cat who can fly.
That is amazing! Do you want to see it again?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I fold a napkin for my picnic?
Do you have a square cloth?
Yes, I do.
Fold it in half, then fold it in half again.
What do I do next?
Tuck one corner into the other side.
It looks like a flower now.
That is very nice. Do you like it?
Yes, I love it.
Great job.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Which day is it?
It is Tuesday. Are you going to work?
Yes. Do I need to wear a tie?
You usually do. Do you have it in your bag?
I hope so. What is after Wednesday?
Thursday comes next. Is that a busy day for you?
It is. I must run now.
Good luck on your trip.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my phone louder?
Tap the volume button on the side. Do you know where that is?
I think so, but it is still quiet.
Check the settings menu next. Is the ring tone set to zero?
Yes, it was off. Now it is loud.
I am glad that worked. Do you want to set a new alarm?
Yes, please show me how.
Open the clock app and tap add. Is 7 o'clock a good time?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a cat today. It was very shy.
That sounds cute. What color was it?
It was black and white. I tried to pet it.
Did it let you touch it?
Yes, it purred soft. Then it ran away.
Oh no. Does it come back often?
I think it lives here. I will watch for it.
Good luck. You have a kind heart.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the lighthouse tall?
It needs height to see far out. Do you like looking up?
Why does the light move?
It spins to show ships where it is. Is the sea calm today?
Why is it on a cliff?
High ground helps the beam travel. I do not know if that cliff is steep.
Why is it so bright?
It uses a strong lamp to cut through fog. Do you like bright lights?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am so confused about the months. Do you know them all?
I know most of them, but I am not perfect. Are you trying to count them?
Yes, I keep mixing up the order. How do I remember them?
Try to sing a song about them. It helps a lot. Do you like singing?
That is a good idea, I think. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have fun learning.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like the new song, but I do not know what it is about. Can you help me understand it?
That is a nice song. Do you like the fast part or the slow part?
I like the slow part because it sounds like rain. It makes me feel calm.
Rain sounds can be very peaceful. Have you told your friends about it yet?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I do not know where to go.
Take this road. Are you going to school?
No, I need the bank. Please help me fast.
Turn left here. Do you see the blue sign?
I do not see it. I am running out of time.
I am sorry. I do not know the name of that spot.
Just point me somewhere. I must go now.
Go straight. Is the building tall?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see brown leaves on the ground. Why do they fall off?
The tree drops them to save energy for the winter. Do you like the crunchy sound?
It makes a nice noise. But why does it get so cold?
The earth tilts away from the sun, so we get less heat. Do you wear a warm hat?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I know when winter starts?
Look for the first snow and cold days. Do you like building snowmen?
I want to plant seeds. When is the best time?
Spring is the best time to plant. Do you have a garden yet?
Yes, I have a small box with dirt.
That is a great place to start. Just be careful with the water.
I want to eat fresh fruit. When can I pick it?
Summer is when most fruit grows. Do you like strawberries?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I hear this song in my head, but I do not know what to do with it.
That feels messy. Do you like the sound of it?
I like it a lot, but I am scared to start.
You can start slow. Do you want help?
Yes, I think I want to hum it.
Humming is a good start. Is the tune happy?
Yes, it is bright and warm.
Then just sing it for fun.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I bought some new fish today and I am so happy!
That is wonderful news! What color are they?
They are bright orange and they swim very fast.
I bet they look lovely in the tank. Do you know what kind they are?
I am not sure, but the shopkeeper said they like plants.
That is a good sign. Do you have some green plants in the tank?
Yes, I have a few, and I changed the water this morning.
Clean water is good for their health. Are they eating well?
Yes, they eat every day and they seem very happy too.
That makes me smile for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I rode my bike to the park today and fell in the mud.
Yikes, that is a sticky situation. Did you clean up your bike?
Yes, I washed it with a hose, but now my clothes are wet.
I am sorry about your clothes. What are you going to wear now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red rose today. It had a tiny bug on it.
That is a sweet little world. Is the bug sleeping there?
It was moving its legs very fast. I thought it was running away from me.
Bugs like to keep moving. Did you smell the flower?
No, I was too close to the bug. I stepped back to look better.
Good, you gave it space. How do you feel now?
I feel calm. The bug is gone and the rose is still there.
The rose is happy you were kind.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because the moon is not in the sky tonight.
I am sorry you feel down. Have you checked if it is very cloudy?
Yes, the sky is dark and thick with clouds.
The clouds often hide the light. Do you like looking at stars too?
I mostly just look at the moon.
The moon is still there even if we cannot see it. Are you feeling lonely without it?
I guess I just want to see it clear.
Clear skies can take time. Have you tried going outside a little later?
I will try again after dinner.
That is a good plan. Maybe the sky will open up soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Does my train arrive at the big red station?
Yes, it does. Where is your bag?
I want to know the ticket price.
I do not know the price. Can you read the map?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why should I save money?
Saving helps you buy things you really like later. Do you have a big goal?
I want a bike. How do I start?
Put small coins in a jar every day. Do you like saving coins?
I have some coins. Is that enough?
It is a good start for a little dream. What is your first job?
I wash the dog. Does that pay?
Yes, you can earn more this way. Do you love your job?
I like the dog. Should I keep the money?
Yes, keep it for your special treat. Are you happy now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How does a clock show the time?
It moves the hands around a round face. Do you see the numbers?
Yes, but why do they move?
A small machine inside pushes them slowly.
What powers that little machine?
A battery or a small spring gives it energy. Do you like that?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The bus was so fun today.
That is great. What did you see?
We saw a big blue whale painting.
Wow. Did you ride to school?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The lights just went out.
Oh, that is scary. Is it just your house or the whole street?
It seems to be the whole street.
That sounds like a big problem. Did you try using a flashlight?
No, I only have a phone.
Your phone screen is bright and safe. It is good to stay calm.
I am worried the food will get warm.
Keep the fridge doors shut. Do you have any candles at home?
No, I do not.
That is okay, you do not need them. I am here to help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a great day. The new neighbours waved at me.
That is nice to hear. Did they bring you any treats?
Yes, they gave me cookies. They are very sweet people.
That is very kind of them. You should say thank you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to leave in five minutes. The floor is full of toys.
That is a lot of toys. Do you need help?
Yes, please. I am so tired.
I will put them in the box. Is the box under the bed?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read my favorite book today while eating an apple.
That sounds like a cozy and sweet way to spend the afternoon. What kind of apple did you eat?
It was a red one, and the story was about a brave dog.
I love brave dogs in stories. Did the dog win in the end?
Yes, the dog saved its owner from a big storm.
What a thrilling finish to your day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is a good feeling. What made you smile?
I waited for my ice cream.
Patience made it taste better. Did you enjoy the wait?
Yes, I felt calm and full.
Calm is a quiet power.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is my grandpa’s hair white because he is old?
Yes, hair often turns white as people get older. Does your grandpa enjoy taking naps?
I do not know. What else happens to bodies when they get very old?
Legs and knees may become stiff and slow. Do you help him walk around the house?
Sometimes I hold his hand. Why does his voice sound so thin?
Voices often get lighter and thinner with age. Is he still telling you stories?
He tells me about his farm. Why do his hands shake a little?
Hands can shake because muscles get weaker. Do you think that is scary?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My little blue fish is swimming very fast today.
That is so cool to see! Does he eat his food when he is being zoomy?
Yes, he gobbled it up in one second.
He must be very hungry. Do you like watching the orange one too?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The water is so cool and the sand is warm. I am very happy here.
That sounds lovely. Do you like the waves?
Yes, I do. The sun is bright and I feel so good.
I am glad you are having fun.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a shed in my yard.
That is a fun job to do. Do you have a plan for where it will go?
I want to put it near the tree.
A tree can drop branches on your roof. Have you picked up any wood yet?
I have the wood all cut and ready.
Good job getting the materials ready. Do you know how to use a drill?
I think I can learn how to use it.
You can learn by watching a video. Are you ready to start the first step?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my little red rose. I do not like it.
I am sorry your flower broke. Do you want to plant a new one?
Maybe. I feel very sad about it.
It is okay to be sad. What color do you like best?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What happens when the leaves fall off the trees?
They turn red, orange, and yellow before they fall. Do you like the color red?
I love the red leaves. Why do they change color?
The trees stop making green food. The bright colors show up instead.
That is cool. What comes after winter?
Spring comes next with warm air and rain. Do you like rain?
Rain is wet and gross. I hope it stops soon.
It always stops. Then the sun shines and flowers grow.
I cannot wait for the flowers. Thank you for telling me.
You are welcome. I hope you enjoy the warm days.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people go to work every day?
They work to get money for food and a home. Do you like playing with toys?
Yes, I do. Why is the work fun for them?
They like helping others and making new things. It feels good to do a good job.
Do they get paid for having fun?
Yes, they get money for their hard work. Do you want to try a small job?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now.
That is great to hear. What makes you smile?
The sun is very warm on my face.
Warm sun feels nice. Do you like the blue sky?
Yes, it looks very bright today.
A bright day helps us feel good.
I want to tell everyone about this feeling.
Sharing joy is sweet. Who do you want to tell first?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the good food place open?
Yes, it is open. Do you like soup?
Yes, I do. How long is the wait?
It should be quick. Do you want a table?
Please, I must go now.
Okay, I will get you a seat.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My little tree is sad. The leaves are turning brown. What should I do?
Give it some fresh water. Is the soil still damp?
Yes, it feels wet. But the leaves still look dry.
It might need more light. How long is the day for you?
It sits by a window all day. I just want it to grow back.
Patience helps trees heal.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big bug in my shoe today.
Oh no, was it scary?
It had long legs and jumped out.
That sounds like a spider. Do you like spiders?
Not really, they give me the creeps.
I get that. Did you kick it away?
Yes, I did. Now my shoe is safe.
Good for you.
I think I will buy a new pair.
Smart idea.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I missed the ball again and now I feel so bad.
That sounds hard to handle. What made you feel that way?
My friend was watching and I looked silly.
It is normal to feel shy when someone watches. Did they say anything to you?
No, they just smiled. But I still feel low.
A smile is usually a sign of kindness. Do you want to try again?
I do not know if I can do it well.
You cannot win if you do not try. Have you played before?
Yes, but not very often. I am getting tired.
Taking a rest is a smart choice. Would you like some water?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at this map! I found it in my box. It has a big blue sea.
That is a nice map. Do you know where the red dot is?
Yes! It is the place where I want to go. I am very happy to show it to you.
That sounds like a fun trip. What is the first place you will see?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so hungry. I want bread.
I am sorry you are upset. What do you like on it?
The toast is burnt. It is black.
That is not good to eat. Do you have other food?
I do not have any. I am sad.
I do not know where to find food. Are you near a store?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want my cookie to come out of the oven right now.
Waiting is hard, but the cookie will be sweet. Do you like warm cookies?
Yes, but I feel so slow.
Slow is just how things grow strong. Can you take one deep breath with me?
Okay. I will wait.
Well done. I do not know when it is done, but I am here.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need a gift for my friend.
That is sweet. Who is the gift for?
It is for my sister.
Does she like to read books?
Yes, she loves stories.
A new book is a good choice. Do you know what genre she likes?
I do not know what that means.
It means the type of story. I will ask her for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this town. It feels too quiet and cold.
That sounds lonely. Are you missing your old home?
Yes. There are no places to go here.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you see any shops nearby?
No. It is just empty streets.
I do not know all the hidden spots. Have you asked a local person?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I made a new friend today. I am happy but also scared.
That is good to hear. Do you like playing with them?
Yes, we play tag. But I do not know if they are nice.
If they share and smile, they are likely nice. Do they share their toys?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why does my bread get big when I wait?
The tiny bugs inside eat sugar and make gas that pushes the dough up. Do you like warm bread?
That is cool. How do I make the bugs work harder?
You can add a little more sugar and keep the dough warm. Do you have a spoon to measure?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. My party starts soon.
Oh no. What did you forget?
I have the cake. Is it ready?
Yes, the cake is there. Do you like the blue icing?
I like it. Where are the gifts?
I do not know where they are. Did you put them in a box?
I put them in the car.
Good. That is smart. Why are you in such a rush?
I want to start the fun.
You will make it in time. Go now and have fun.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! My clothes are all clean and dry.
That is great news. Do you smell the fresh laundry?
Yes, it smells like sunshine. I want to tell everyone about it.
You have a good spirit. Is the room warm today?
It is very warm here. I love this feeling.
Warm and happy is a good place to be. Do you have a favorite shirt?
Yes, my blue one. I will wear it tomorrow.
That sounds like a nice plan.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a rusted sword in the park today.
That is a very old looking item. Did you pick it up?
I did not, but it sat in the grass for a long time.
The air can make iron turn brown. Did you ask the park keeper about it?
The keeper said it was from a movie.
That is a good explanation. I am glad it is just for show.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red dot on my map today.
That sounds exciting. Did you know what the red dot meant?
No, I just liked the color.
Colors can make maps look happy. I love bright maps too.
Me too. I put it in my pocket.
Smart move. So you can find it again later.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how bees make honey.
Bees eat sweet plant juice called nectar. They keep it in a special bag in their body. Do you like sweet food?
I do, but what happens to the nectar next?
The bees carry the nectar back to the hive. They fan air on it to dry it into thick honey. Is your favorite sweet chocolate?
No, I like jelly. So they just dry the juice?
Yes, they store the dry honey in tiny wax cups. They use it to feed the whole family.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to mop the floor. How do I do it?
You need a mop and a bucket. Do you have a bucket nearby?
Yes, I do. What is the next step?
You put water and soap in the bucket. How much soap do you think we need?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at that tall tree. It makes me feel so happy.
It is a very big tree. Do you like how it looks today?
Yes, the leaves are green and shiny. I want to sit under it.
That sounds like a good rest.
The sun feels warm on my face here. I will stay for a bit.
Warmth is nice. Is the tree giving you shade?
The leaves block the harsh sun. I feel calm.
Trees can be a quiet place.
I love this quiet spot. Thank you for listening.
You are welcome. Enjoy your time in the tree.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I lost my mom in this big store.
Do not worry. Are you wearing a red hat?
No, I have a blue shirt with stars on it.
That is very helpful. Can you tell me where you were just now?
I was looking at the big shiny cars.
I know that place. Is it near the toy section?
Yes, the toys are right there.
Okay, stay close to me. Do you see a tall man in a gray coat?
I see a tall man in a gray coat.
Great. Go to him. He is your mom.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My little dog digs a hole in the fence every night.
That is a naughty habit. Does he run away after digging?
No, he just sleeps there. How do I stop him from digging?
I do not know for sure, but try burying some sharp things in the hole.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to hit the ball hard.
Use your whole body, not just your arm. Do you like to run fast?
Yes, I run fast.
Good, you need speed. Swing your racket in a big circle.
Like a swing?
Yes, like a giant swing. Do you have a partner to help?
My friend plays with me.
That is great news. Practice together every day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate this quiet street. It feels too empty.
It is very quiet. Do you like the dark?
No. I feel alone here.
I am here with you. Are you cold?
Yes. My hands are cold.
Let us walk fast. Is your home close?
Yes. It is near.
Good. Let us go together.
Okay. Thank you.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have two fives and a nine. What do I do?
Do you want to keep the pair? I am not sure what your goal is.
I think I want to win this hand.
Then I would keep the two fives. Do you feel safe with that?
Yes, I think I will do that.
That sounds like a good plan. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look up! Is that a giant noodle in the sky?
It is a rainbow, made by rain and sun. What color do you like best?
I like the orange one, it looks like a carrot.
That is a great choice. Do you want to jump in it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel so tired and my head hurts.
Oh no, that sounds rough. Did you drink any water today?
I had coffee but I forgot to eat lunch.
Coffee makes you more tired if you do not eat.
How do I fix this feeling right now?
Eat something sweet and take a small rest.
I do not have food here at my desk.
Go get a snack from the kitchen. What is your favorite snack?
I like cookies but I want to go home.
Go home, rest, and eat later. You worked hard today.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
The tree gets tired in the cold. Does the wind help them?
I guess so. Do trees sleep?
Yes, they rest like you do. Do you sleep well?
Yes, mostly. Why do they come back in spring?
The sun wakes them up. Is your favorite tree maple?
I like the red ones. Do they hurt when they fall?
No, the tree lets them go on purpose.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work, but I love painting.
Painting is a great way to relax. Do you use watercolors?
Yes, I do. I have to go now.
That sounds nice. Please stay safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Are mountains made of big rocks?
Yes, they are made of rocks and dirt. Do you like climbing?
I like to walk on the grass. Are there trees up high?
Some mountains have trees, but the top is often bare rock. Is that cool?
Yes, it looks like a big hill. Can we see the sky from the top?
Yes, you can see a lot of blue sky from the top. Do you like looking down?
I think it looks scary but nice. Is it cold up there?
Yes, it is much colder up there than down here. Do you like snow?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do clouds look like sheep?
The water drops stick together in shapes. Do you have a favorite cloud shape?
Sometimes they look like dragons too.
That is a fun one to see. It is just a chance pattern.
Can you make clouds outside?
No, I cannot make them from here. Do you like watching them from a window?
I like watching them float by.
They move with the wind, yes. It is a calm thing to do.
Thank you for talking with me.
You are welcome. I am glad you asked.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to start. The boats are all tied up.
You can just walk along the water. Do you like the look of the big ship?
Yes, but I think it is too far away. I am tired.
Then sit on the bench by the gate. It is close and cool.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to camp but I do not know what to bring.
That sounds fun. Do you like the rain?
I hate the rain. I am scared my tent will get wet.
A good rain fly helps. Do you have one?
No, I do not. I only have a tent and a bag.
You should buy a fly. Can you carry heavy bags?
I can carry them. But I am tired of thinking about gear.
Rest your brain for now. Do you know where to camp?
I do not know where. I just want to sit in a quiet place.
A quiet lake is nice. Do you like fish?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The city is so loud today. I do not know where to go.
That is a hard feeling. Are you tired?
Yes, I am very tired. I need some quiet.
Let us find a small park. Do you like trees?
I like trees a lot. They are calm.
Great. Let us walk this way. Is the air fresh?
Yes, it is fresh. Thank you for helping me.
I am glad to help. Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I find speaking a new tongue very hard.
That is normal at the start. Do you practice every day?
Yes, I try to speak for ten minutes.
That is a good start. What words do you use first?
Mostly food and family words.
Good choices. Do you listen to songs in that tongue?
Sometimes, but the words fly too fast.
Slow songs help you hear better.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My bread is flat. What is wrong?
It needs air. Did you wait long enough?
I left it on the counter. Should I add more yeast?
Yeast makes the bubbles. Is your kitchen warm?
It is cool here. How do I help it rise?
Put it in a warm spot. Do you have a towel?
Yes, I have a towel. Do I need more sugar too?
Sugar feeds the yeast. I do not know your exact recipe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a snowball?
Pack the snow tight with your hands. Do you have a glove on?
Yes, I do. Thank you.
You are welcome. Go have fun!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my old toys right now.
Did you check under the bed?
No, I am too busy to look there.
That is a good place to look. Do you have a box?
I have a box, but it is full.
You can empty it later. What kind of toys?
Just old cars and balls.
Cars often hide in drawers. Do you remember the last time you played?
I do not know, I am in a rush.
Then check the closet first. It is the fastest spot.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very worried about the test today.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you know the answers?
I think I do, but my hands are shaking.
Deep breaths can help you calm down.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is blowing too hard and I do not know what to do.
It sounds scary. Are you safe inside?
I am inside, but I feel so small and unsure.
You are doing a good job staying calm.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling. Why did that happen?
Dreams are your brain sorting out feelings. Did you feel safe when you woke up?
Yes, but I still feel a little odd. Is my brain just playing games?
Yes, it is often just processing the day. What was the scariest part of the dream?
It was the darkness. Why does my mind make things so dark?
I do not know for certain. It might be because light feels safe to you.
That makes sense. How can I stop the bad dreams?
Try to think of happy things before bed. Do you like looking at stars?
Yes, I do. I will try that tonight.
That is a great plan. Sweet dreams.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late and my heart beats fast. I feel very scared.
Take one deep breath with me. Do you know where you need to go?
I must catch the bus right now. Please help me pick.
Let us walk slowly together. What is making you feel so worried?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I am moving my bed to the wall.
A wall can help keep your toys safe. Do you have a lot of heavy books?
Yes, they are very heavy.
Heavy things can hurt your back.
I want them on the top shelf.
The top is risky if you are small. Do you have a ladder?
I have a big chair.
A chair may not be steady.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the big red sign off?
It is not working right now. Do you want to come in?
Why did it stop working?
I do not know for sure. Is there anything else I can help with?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the river blue?
The water looks blue because it reflects the sky. Do you like looking at the sky?
Yes, I do. What makes the water move?
The earth pulls the water down the hill. Do you hear the sound it makes?
It sounds like a song. Is the water cold?
Yes, rivers are usually quite cold. Do you have warm shoes?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do bears eat berries in the summer?
They eat them to gain weight before winter. Do you like berries?
Why do snakes not have ears?
They hear the ground move instead of sound. Did you ever watch a snake?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke my friend's cup and I feel bad.
That is a kind thing to think about. What did you say to them?
I said nothing yet because I was scared.
It is good you want to apologize now. How are they feeling about it?
They look sad and they are not talking to me.
Sincerity helps people feel better. Do you know how to say it to their face?
No, I am not sure of the words. Please teach me.
Just say "I am sorry, it was my fault." Do you feel ready to try now?
Yes, I will go and say it right away.
That is brave of you. I hope it makes you both happy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not like math. It feels too hard.
That is okay to feel. Do you like to draw?
Yes, I love drawing.
You can learn math with pictures.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I missed the bus because I did not look at the clock.
That was a tricky mistake. How far did you walk?
I had to walk three blocks in the rain.
That sounds wet and tiring. Are you happy you got here?
Yes, but I am very wet and cold now.
I am sorry about that. Let us find a warm seat.
Please, can I sit next to you?
Of course, that is fine. Do you need a blanket?
No, but I am ready to start my work now.
Good, you are here now. Let us begin with the first page.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I made a big promise to my sister today.
That is a very kind thing to do. What did you promise to give her?
I said I would help her clean her room all afternoon.
Cleaning is hard work, but it is a great gift. Did you manage to finish it?
I did most of it, but I was too tired at the end.
Tiredness is a normal part of hard work. How did she feel about the missing part?
She gave me a big hug and said it was okay.
Hugs are the best reward for good work. Do you think you will keep your promise?
Yes, I will finish the last part tomorrow morning.
That is a very true and brave choice. I am happy you finished with love.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I have no money left for snacks. I am so sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you spend your coins on candy?
I bought two bagels and a juice. I still want more.
That is a fair price for food. Do you like bagels best?
Yes, I do. I just wish I had more cash.
Try saving your allowance for tomorrow. Does that sound good?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The city is very loud and fast. I feel tired.
Big cities can be tiring. Do you like the noise?
No, I just want to sit and rest. Where is a quiet spot?
Parks are often calm. Have you checked a nearby park?
I will look for one soon. That sounds nice.
That is a good plan. Have a nice break.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a great place to read.
That sounds nice. Do you like the quiet there?
Yes, it is very calm.
I am glad you like it.
The books are old but kind.
Old books often have good tales.
I want to go back soon.
That is good. I hope you find your favorite book.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need help packing my bag for the trip. What should I pack first?
Start with your clothes. Is it going to be cold where you are going?
It should be warm. What else do I need?
Bring a water bottle. Do you have your charger?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to put up the new fence right now.
That sounds like a big job. Do you have all the tools?
Yes, but the ground is very hard here.
It can be tricky to dig in hard soil. Did you try water first?
No, I was too busy to think of that.
Water can soften the dirt nicely.
Okay, I will go get the hose.
Good luck with your garden.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so hungry today.
That sounds good. What do you want to eat?
I saw a big dog on my way here.
Oh? Was it a good dog?
Yes, it was very nice.
Good dogs are great. Do you want the chicken or the fish?
I want the chicken.
Great choice. I will get it for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big fort in my room.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you have enough pillows?
Yes, I have a huge pile of them ready.
Great. Where do you want to put the blanket roof?
I will put it right over the chairs.
That is a good place. What do you want to do inside the fort?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so lost. I feel very bad.
Do not cry. I will help you. Where did you come from?
I was at the big red door. Now I see only trees.
The red door is safe. We can walk back. Do you know which way is north?
No, I do not know north. Please help me.
We will find the road soon. Stay close to me.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do we start the big plan?
We write down the small steps first. What is your first step?
Why write them down?
It helps you see what is next. Do you have a pen?
I have a pen. Why do I need to see the next step?
It makes the hard part feel small. Is your pen working?
It works. What do we do after writing?
We do one step at a time. Ready to try?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to fix my toy car today but the wheel got stuck.
That must have been frustrating. Do you have a screwdriver nearby?
I have a small one, but it feels too big for the tiny screw.
A bigger tool can sometimes strip the metal. Did you check if the wheel is just tight?
It is very tight, but I am afraid of breaking the plastic.
Breaking it would be bad. Is there an adult you can ask to help?
Yes, my mom is in the kitchen, but I wanted to do it alone first.
Trying to do it alone shows you are brave. Do you want to tell me exactly what you tried?
I turned the screw to the left, but it only moved a little bit.
Turning left usually loosens things. Is it moving in the right direction now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love camping!
That sounds like so much fun. What do you eat out there?
Lots of hot dogs!
Hot dogs are tasty. Do you like making fires?
Yes, I like the light.
Fire is very warm and cozy. Do you bring your dog?
My dog likes to sleep in the tent.
I think that is cute. I do not know if my dog likes tents.
He sleeps right beside me.
That must feel very safe. Do you go often?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky bright with color after it rains?
The sun shines on the water drops in the air. Do you see how they act like tiny mirrors?
I think I do. Why are there always seven colors?
Those are the colors our eyes can see best. Do you have a favorite one?
I like blue. How high up do the drops have to be?
The water must be in the air above us. Are you standing in the rain now?
No, I am dry. Do you like rain or sun?
I enjoy the sun more, but rain helps plants grow. Do you see any green grass nearby?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the light off?
I do not know for sure. Are your other lights on?
No, the whole house is dark.
It is likely a big problem outside. Do you have any candles?
Yes, I found a box.
Good idea. I think it is a power cut. Is it warm in here?
It is getting a little cold.
Put on a warm coat. I will check the meter.
Is the meter blinking?
Yes, it is blinking green.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a map in my room. It shows a big red dot.
That looks like a city. Do you know what the red dot means?
My dad says it is where we are living.
That is very true. Maps help us see where we are. Do you have other maps?
No, just this one. Is the blue part water?
Yes, blue is usually water. It is a river near the city.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so happy I finished my book. I have to run now.
That is a big win. Good for you. What was the best part?
I liked the dog. I am late, I must go.
Dogs are great friends. See you soon. Have a good day?
Yes, thanks. Bye.
Bye.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I tell time on a big clock?
The short hand shows the hour and the long hand shows the minutes. Do you have a clock at home?
Yes, but the numbers are hard to read.
Try finding where the hands point first. Does the short hand move slowly?
Yes, it takes a whole hour to go around.
That is correct, and the long hand makes twelve trips in one hour. Do you know what five minutes looks like?
The long hand moves to the next big number.
Exactly, each big number is five minutes apart. Good job learning.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The street is so quiet. It feels a bit sad.
Sometimes quiet places are nice. Do you like the sound of leaves?
Yes, I do. But I worry it is too empty.
It may just be calm today. What usually makes it loud for you?
Cars and people usually. But I want to know why it stopped.
I do not know for sure. Maybe it is a special day?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My little sister is crying. What should I do?
Give her a big hug and ask what is wrong. Is she hurt or just sad?
She just wants me to play with her blocks.
That is a nice thing to do. Do you have time to build a tower?
I have to do my homework first. Can I play later?
Yes, tell her you will help after you finish. Do you like building tall towers?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw the moon last night. It looked like a bright coin in the dark sky.
That sounds like a lovely sight. Did you bring your telescope?
No, I did not. I just looked up from my bed with my eyes wide open.
Your eyes are powerful tools for seeing the light. Do you know why the moon shines?
I think it borrows light from the sun. My teacher said the moon does not make its own light.
Yes, your teacher is right. It reflects the sun like a mirror.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am lost, but I feel so happy!
That is very sweet of you. Did you find a nice view?
Yes, the sky is big and blue.
Wow, that sounds peaceful.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My old friend left us a long time ago.
I am sorry you are sad. Do you miss playing with them?
Yes, I miss the games we used to play in the park.
That sounds like fun times. What game did you like best?
We liked to tag each other and run very fast.
Running is good for your body. Was the park near your home?
It was right down the street, only two houses away.
That is very close. Do you go there now?
I do not go there much anymore, it feels empty.
I understand how that feels. It is okay to grieve.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My nose is all plugged up and I feel very cold.
That sounds rough. Are you drinking enough warm water?
Yes, I am drinking a lot of tea.
Good for you. Do you feel better when you rest in bed?
A little, but my throat still hurts.
Honey can help soothe it. Does it feel like an itchy tickle?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My magnet just lost its power.
That is very sad to hear. Did you drop it on the ground?
Yes, I dropped it on the hard floor.
Hard drops can hurt a magnet. Do you have another one?
I do not want to buy a new one.
I am sorry you are upset. Try tapping it gently on a table.
Why would tapping help?
It might shake the inside back into place. Does that sound like a good idea?
I will try that now.
I hope it works for you. Good luck with the fix.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the birds fly up and down?
They are playing and finding food. Do you see a worm in the dirt?
Yes, I do. Why do they need worms?
Worms are tasty and give them energy. I do not know if that one is awake.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I win at chess?
You must capture the other king. Do you have a plan?
My pieces just die. What should I do first?
Protect your king and control the middle. Do you like opening up?
I am stuck. Is there a secret trick?
No single trick exists, only practice. Do you play often?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love the smell of the hot tea!
It smells warm and nice to you?
Yes, it feels cozy in my hands.
That sounds very sweet.
Coffee is bitter, but I like tea best.
Why do you prefer the sweet drink?
It makes me feel happy inside.
I am glad it brings you joy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My head hurts so much today.
I am sorry you feel bad. Is it a dull pain?
It feels like a big throb.
A throb can mean you need rest. Do you have water nearby?
I do not know what to do next.
Drink some water and lie down. I do not know if you are sick.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw a big wolf in the woods today. I am very scared.
That is a scary sight. Were you standing close to it?
No, it was far away, but it looked at me with sharp eyes.
Wolves often just look to see what you are doing. Do you like wild animals?
I used to love them, but now I think they are all dangerous.
Most wild animals try to stay away from people. Did the wolf growl at you?
It did not growl, but I still want to hide inside my house.
Your feelings make sense. Do you want to read a book about animals?
Yes, please. I feel a little better now.
I am happy that you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to sing, but I do not know how to start.
Try humming a simple tune first. Do you like singing alone or with others?
I prefer alone, but I worry my voice will sound bad.
That is normal for a beginner, and it feels better with practice. Would you like to try a few scales together?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need eggs right now.
I can do that. What kind?
Scrambled, please.
Sure. Do you want toast?
No time.
Okay. Here you go.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am looking at the clock, but I do not know what time it is.
That can be hard to read. Do you see the small hand?
Yes, the small hand is on the three.
Great. Do you see where the big hand is pointing?
The big hand is pointing straight up at the twelve.
Then it is three o'clock.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
It is quiet because it is night. Do you hear the wind?
I do not hear the wind. Is something wrong?
No, nothing is wrong. The air is still. Are you cold?
I am warm. Why is there no one else here?
Most people sleep at this time. Do you want to go inside?
I think I will stay. Does the moon sleep too?
I do not know if the moon sleeps. Do you feel safe?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad and alone here.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a pet at home?
No, but I miss my old friends.
That is a tough feeling to carry. What do you usually do when you feel this way?
I just sit in the dark and cry.
It is good to let tears come out. What small thing makes you smile?
Funny songs make me laugh for a bit.
Music can be a warm friend. Do you want to share a song with me?
Yes, I can play one for you now.
That sounds like a lovely start.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because the big tree lost all its leaves.
Trees sleep in winter to rest their roots. Are you okay?
It looks so empty and bare.
The branch wood stays strong and dry. Do you like the smell of rain?
I do, but I miss the green color.
Green comes back when the sun gets warm.
I hope it grows back fast.
Nature takes its time to heal and grow.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The red boat was stuck in the mud and the water would not come back.
That is a hard thing to watch. Did you sit near the shore?
I sat on a wet rock and watched the clouds move very slowly.
Slow clouds can feel like time stopped. Do you like watching them?
My legs started to hurt and I wanted to push the boat free myself.
Your body wants to act, but the sea is the only one who can help. Did you take a deep breath?
I breathed in the salty air and the water rose just a little bit.
A small rise is a big win for a tired person. Did the boat float?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel so good inside, but I must go now.
That is a happy feeling. What did you do?
I cleaned my whole room very fast.
Well done. I do not know if I would be that quick.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to move the big bed to the truck fast.
That is a heavy load. Do you have a cart to help?
No cart, just my hands and a lot of sweat.
Please watch your back when you lift. Is the truck close by?
It is right outside, but the door is jammed.
I do not know how to fix a jammed door. Have you tried tapping the frame?
I will try that, but I must go now.
Okay, be safe and take your time. Do you have your keys?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to walk in the big park, but I do not know where to start.
The main gate is the best place to begin. Do you like walking on grass?
I do, but my feet hurt a little.
You can rest on a bench near the trees. Are you wearing soft shoes?
Yes, I have my new sneakers on.
That is a good choice for comfort. What color are they?
They are blue and white.
That sounds nice and clean.
Okay, I will go now.
Have a safe and happy walk.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Who was the first person to live in a big house?
That is a hard one. I do not know for sure. Did you see a big house in your dream?
No, but I saw a castle. How did people get to castles long ago?
They mostly walked or rode horses. It took a long time. Do you like riding horses?
No, I like cars. Why did cars come after horses?
People wanted to go much faster. Cars use gas to move. Do you like to go fast in a car?
Yes, but I was scared once. Who invented the car?
Many people helped make it. Karl Benz is one famous name. Do you have a favorite color?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel good inside, but I do not know what to do next.
That is a nice feeling. Do you like to run outside?
I think so, but the sun is very hot today.
Maybe you can play in the shade of a tree.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I found a hidden garden.
That sounds like a wonderful surprise. What did the flowers look like?
They were bright red and very sweet smelling.
Red is a warm and bold color. Do you plan to visit it again?
Yes, I want to bring my favorite friend there.
Sharing joy is a kind thing to do. I hope you both have a nice time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have seven days in a week?
It is a long habit from old times. Do you like weekends?
Why is Saturday always before Sunday?
I do not know the exact reason. Do you like playing outside?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I did a good job on my drawing today.
That is wonderful. I am happy for you. Did you enjoy making it?
Yes, I loved picking the colors.
Great choice. It must feel good to finish something hard.
I feel warm and happy inside.
That warm feeling is called pride. It is a good feeling.
Is it okay to be proud of small things?
Yes, always. Small wins help you grow. What is your next small win?
I will clean my room tomorrow.
That is a strong plan. I believe in you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I want to talk about sailors.
That sounds great. Do you like the sea?
Yes, I love it. Sailors cross big blue waters.
Wow, that is far. How do they find their way?
They use stars and maps. It feels like a magic game.
I do not know much about stars. Do they glow at night?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The crowd is too big.
Take a deep breath. Is it for work?
I must go to the red tower.
Go left at the big tree. Is it very urgent?
Please, I am running out of time.
The way is open now. You will make it.
Thank you. I am going.
Good luck on your run.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like the song with the giraffe.
That is a fun song. Do you like the dancing part?
Yes, I dance with you.
That sounds happy. Is the music loud or soft?
It is very loud and happy.
I am glad you enjoy it. I do not know the name of the song.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what to read next.
I do not know your taste, but do you like scary stories?
No, I prefer happy things.
That is good, do you like animals?
Yes, I love reading about cats.
Then try a book about a kitten, does that sound fun?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I cannot find my book.
That feels bad. Did you check the big table?
I looked there, but it is gone.
We can look together. What color is it?
It is blue. I think I lost it.
Let us search again. I bet we will find it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a movie today. It had a big blue dragon.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did the dragon talk?
Yes, he was very loud. I did not like the loud noises.
Loud things can be scary for some people. Was the dragon nice to you?
He was scary at first. But then he gave me a toy.
A toy dragon would be a great gift. What color was the toy?
It was green and yellow. I like the colors.
Those are very bright colors. Do you have the toy now?
Yes, I brought it home. I am happy now.
I am glad you are feeling better. Have a good rest.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad about my math test today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you do your best?
Yes, I tried hard, but the numbers were hard.
That takes a lot of effort. What part of math do you like most?
I like counting coins, but not big numbers.
Counting coins is a great start. Why do you think big numbers are tough?
They look too long and I get lost.
It can feel like a maze. Do you use any tricks to remember?
I just guess sometimes and get it wrong.
Guessing is not a good plan. Would you like to practice small steps?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to see the North Star.
Look for the Big Dipper. Do you see that big shape in the sky?
Yes, I see seven bright stars.
Follow the two stars at the end of the bowl. The next bright star up is the North Star.
I found it. It stays still.
That is true. It helps sailors find north. Do you like stargazing?
Yes, I do. What are those other stars?
Those are planets or other stars. I do not know which one is which. Do you have a telescope?
No, just my eyes.
That is fine. Your eyes are good enough. You did a great job finding it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do they have pizza?
Yes, they do. What kind do you like?
I like cheese.
That is a good choice. Do you like chicken too?
No, I do not.
Okay, just cheese then. Are you ready to go?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My sister is late and I must go.
Is she wearing her coat?
I do not know and I must run.
Tell her I said hello, okay?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad today. I wanted to feel happy, but it is hard.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk about what is wrong?
Nothing is really wrong. I just do not know why I feel this way.
That is okay. Feeling bad is a normal part of life. Is there anything nice you did today?
I helped my friend with homework. But it does not make me happy now.
That was a very kind thing to do. How did your friend look after you helped?
They smiled at me. But I still feel a bit down.
Smiles can take time to lift our spirits. Do you like listening to music when you feel low?
Sometimes yes, but not always. I just want to feel better.
I do not know the perfect fix. Try taking a slow, deep breath with me.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I collected ten shiny rocks today.
That sounds like a great find. Where did you find them?
By the river near my home. Do you like rocks too?
I do not have hands to hold them, but I am glad you do. What color are they?
Most are gray, but one is bright red. Is it a special rock?
I do not know the name of that specific stone. Thank you for telling me about it.
I just like keeping nice things. I will show you tomorrow.
I am looking forward to seeing your collection. Have a good rest.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to build a small shed in my yard. Do I need to ask the town first?
Yes, you should check with them first. Is your yard big enough?
It is about ten feet wide. Will that work for a small shed?
That sounds like a good size. Do you have any wood yet?
I have some old boards, but they look a bit wet. Can I use them?
Wet wood can rot, so it is better to use dry wood. Do you have a hammer?
I have a big red hammer. How do I make the walls?
You can use nails to hold the boards together. Do you have a friend to help you lift them?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is it hard to pack my boxes?
It is hard because you have so many things. Do you have a plan for the books?
I want to put them in the small box. Why is that bad?
The small box is too light for heavy books. What books do you like the most?
I like picture books. Why do we need a truck?
The truck has big space for all your boxes. I do not know how big your house is.
My house is small. Why do we need to look at keys?
Keys open the door to your new home. Are you ready to go?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am very late for school.
That is a big worry. What caused the delay?
My alarm did not go on.
Oh no. Let us run to the bus.
Will I be in trouble?
I do not know. Please try to be on time next time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to say hello in Spanish.
You can say "hola". Do you like speaking to people?
Yes, I do. But I am scared to speak wrong.
It is okay to make mistakes. I do not know your name, but I am happy to help.
Can you teach me how to ask for food?
You can say "por favor, comida". Are you hungry right now?
Not really, but I wanted to know. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Keep trying and you will learn fast.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My neighbor plays loud music at night. What should I do?
That sounds frustrating. Are you sure it is only at night?
Yes, it happens every night. I feel too shy to talk to him.
You can just smile and say hello. Does he look friendly?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to tell you my secret right now.
Take your time. Do you feel safe here?
No, I am in a big hurry.
I do not know where you are going.
I am keeping my cat in the closet.
That is a strange place.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My chair leg broke today. I am so sad.
That sounds like a bad day. Is it made of wood?
Yes, the wood snapped. I do not want to buy a new one.
We can try to fix it. Do you have some glue?
I have glue, but I am not sure it will hold.
Strong glue is often the best fix. Let us try it together.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing. Do I have a good voice?
That is a nice goal. I cannot hear you, so I do not know your voice yet. Do you like singing in the shower?
Yes, I love doing that. Is it good for my voice?
Singing with fun is great for practice. Do you try to sing long songs or short ones?
I try the long ones. But I get tired of my neck.
Your neck should not hurt when you sing. Are you pulling your chin up to the sky?
Yes, I pull my chin up high.
You should keep your chin level with the floor. Do you feel tight in your jaw?
I do feel tight. How do I fix it?
Try to relax your jaw and breathe deep. Do you want me to give you a simple song to start with?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know which season is my favorite. What do you think?
Spring feels like a fresh start with all the new flowers. Do you like seeing trees grow?
That sounds nice, but I love how cold makes me want hot soup.
Winter is cozy for eating warm food in bed. Do you like making soup?
Yes, I do. Thank you for your kind words.
You are welcome. I am glad we talked about seasons.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for my bus.
Do not worry, we will be fine. Did you pack your bag?
Yes, but my shoes are missing.
I do not know where they are.
Please help me look here.
I see them by the door. Are you ready now?
Yes, thank you so much.
You are welcome. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sand so white?
It is made of tiny shells. Do you like shells?
Yes, I do. Why does the water look blue?
The sky reflects on it. Is your favorite color blue?
I like green better. Why is the grass there green?
It has sun and rain. Do you have grass?
Only a little. Why is the island so far?
I do not know for sure. Is it far from you?
Yes, very far. Why do you live here?
I like the quiet. Do you like quiet?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lights are off, but I am happy. I found my candle.
That is a nice feel. What does the dark room smell like to you?
It smells like warm wax. I like the quiet.
I do not know what to do in the dark. Do you have a book to read?
No, I just sit and listen to the wind.
That sounds very calm. I am glad you are safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to know about old times. Where should I start?
Start with your own family. Do you have any old photos?
Yes, I have pictures of my great-grandparents. What should I ask them?
Ask them how they met. That is the best way to learn.
That sounds fun. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome. History is everywhere if you look.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what to put in my bag.
Start with your clothes. Do you have a favorite shirt?
I have this blue shirt, but I do not know if it is clean.
If it is not clean, pick another one. What else do you need?
I forgot my book and my water bottle.
Put those in now. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad that all the leaves are falling off the trees.
I understand your sadness, but is the air getting colder for you?
Yes, it is very cold, and the trees look empty now.
The trees drop leaves to save energy for winter, and they will grow new ones in spring. Do you like the idea of new leaves?
I hope they come back, but I still feel a bit lonely without them.
That is a kind feeling to have, and I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to eat better, but I do not know where to start.
That is a good thing to want. What is your favorite food right now?
I like pizza and chips, but I feel tired after eating them.
You are right that some foods give you less energy. Do you drink enough water?
I drink water, but I am not sure if it is enough.
I do not know exactly how much you need to drink. Do you feel hungry between meals?
Yes, I get hungry fast and then I want snacks.
Eating real food can help stop that quick hunger. Would you like to try adding some fruit to your lunch?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big tree house.
That sounds like a lot of work. Do you have enough wood?
I have some, but not a lot.
We can ask for help from friends.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The leg of my chair is broken and I do not know how to fix it.
That sounds scary. Can you tell me if the wood is cracked or just loose?
It is cracked right at the corner and feels very loose.
You can try to glue it back together with strong glue. Did you have any glue in your house?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big round pizza on my plate today. It looked like a perfect circle.
That sounds tasty. Did you cut it into slices?
Yes, I cut it into eight equal triangles. I ate two of them for lunch.
Triangles are sharp shapes. Do you like cold pizza or warm pizza?
I like it warm. Then I played in the park and saw a square bench.
A square has four equal sides. Did you sit on that bench?
I sat there for a while. I also saw a triangle flag flying high.
Flags help us talk to others. Did the flag wave in the wind?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the room?
Is it the big blue door? You can go that way.
I have no map. Do you know the code?
I do not know the code. Is your friend there?
I must go now. Please tell them I am here.
I will tell them. Drive safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the lake now.
Is the water calm there?
I am running because I am late.
That sounds stressful. Do you have a boat?
No, I just want to see the view.
The view is usually very pretty.
I have to go now, thank you.
Good luck on your trip.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
The trees block the loud noises from the busy roads. Do you like the calm?
I do. Do you think it will stay quiet all day?
Yes, few cars drive here in the morning.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: It is so hot today. Why is the sun so warm?
The Earth is close to the sun right now. Do you like the heat?
A little, but it is very hot. Why does the ice melt so fast?
Sunlight gives the ice a lot of energy. Are you drinking water?
Yes, I am drinking a lot. Why does water make me feel cool?
The water takes heat away from your skin. Do you have a fan?
No, I do not have a fan. Why is it harder to sleep in the heat?
Your body works hard to cool down. Do you take naps?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Hi, I want to learn how to tie my shoes. Can you show me?
Yes, I can help. Do you like wearing sneakers?
Yes, I love them. How do I start?
First, make a big loop with one side. Do you see the hole?

talk.situation: the person is a child
