exchanges: I like to learn new words for my cat.
That is fun. What is your cat's name?
Her name is Bella.
Nice name. Do you want to learn "meow" in another language?
Yes, please.
I do not know every word. Do you like to play with her?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I cut an onion without crying?
Try holding the onion cold before you cut it. Do you like onions?
Yes, I do. What else can I use to stop the tears?
Cutting near a lit stove helps too. Are you using a sharp knife?
Yes, my knife is sharp. Is that the main trick?
A sharp knife actually causes less crying than a dull one. Did that help?
It seems to work better. Thank you for the tips.
You are welcome. Have fun making dinner.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make toast?
Put bread in the toaster. Do you like it soft or crunchy?
I like it crunchy.
Set the lever to high. Watch it so it does not burn.
What else should I add?
Butter is a great start. Do you have any jam?
Yes, I have jam.
Spread the jam on top. Enjoy your breakfast.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like The Cat in the Hat. Can you make my fish talk?
I can write words for the fish. Do you like fish?
No, I do not. But I like the cat. Why is he there?
He is there to cause some fun. Do you like fun?
Yes, I do. Is the fish sad?
Yes, the fish is very sad. He wants home.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my bread get so big?
Tiny bugs inside eat the sugar and make gas. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I love sugar. Why does the gas make it grow?
The gas makes tiny air pockets that push the dough out. Are you using warm water?
I used cold water. Is that why it is slow?
Warm water helps the bugs wake up faster. Did you let it rest in a warm spot?
I put it near the door. It still looks small.
It needs more time to rest and grow. Do you have a timer?
I do not have a timer. How long is long enough?
Wait until the double size or tap it gently. Is it puffy now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What day comes after Monday?
Tuesday comes next. Do you like Tuesdays?
I think so. How many days are in a week?
There are seven days.
Can you name the last day?
Sunday is the last day. What do you do on Sundays?
I play with my friends. Is Saturday before Sunday?
Yes, Saturday is before Sunday.
Thank you for helping me learn.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I miss my old friend. I do not know what to do.
That feels sad. Have you tried writing a letter?
I am too scared to write. What can I say?
I do not know your story. How long has it been?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a nice picnic basket. How do I pack it right?
Put a cloth on the bottom to keep things cool. Do you have a towel?
Yes, I have a red one. What should I put on top of the food?
Place your drinks and snacks in the middle so they stay in place. Do you like cold juice or warm tea?
I like cold juice. Should I put the food last?
Yes, put the food on top so you can reach it first. Is the basket heavy for you?
It feels okay. How do I close the lid safely?
Pull the string tight across the top before you lift it. Do you have a strong pull?
Yes, I think I can do it. Thanks for helping me.
You are welcome. Have a happy lunch under the sun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many fingers do I have on both hands?
You have ten fingers. Do you like counting on them?
I am not sure.
Let us count them together. Can you show me your hands?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a note that says I did not take the cookie.
That is a big thing to know. Do you really not eat cookies?
No, I did not eat it, but I do not know who did.
I believe you. Did you tell anyone else?
I am scared to say it.
Telling the truth helps. Do you trust the people here?
Yes, they are nice, but I am still unsure.
Trust your heart. It will guide you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am so hungry but I do not know what to pick for lunch.
Would you like something warm or something cold?
I think I want a sandwich.
A turkey sandwich with cheese sounds good. Have you eaten anything like that today?
I am not sure what is in the fridge right now.
Go check the fridge to see what you have. Do you like chicken or fish?
I love chicken but I am tired of eating it.
How about a simple salad with nuts and fruit? It is fresh and easy to eat.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I live in a small village.
That sounds cozy. Do you like it there?
Yes, the river is right behind our house.
A river is a wonderful place to play. Do you swim in it?
No, my mom says it is too cold.
It is good to be safe. I do not know the temperature there, but I hope you are warm.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to wash my shirt right now.
Put it in the machine. Do you have warm or cold water?
It is cold out, so I use cold.
That saves energy. Good choice.
Now I just press start and run.
Please wait one moment. Did you check for coins in the pockets?
Oh no, I forgot the pockets.
Take the shirt out now. You do not want wet coins on the floor.
I am so sorry, I am still late.
It is okay. Dry it with a towel first to save time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the lake today. The sun was hot and bright.
That sounds like a warm day. Did you bring a hat?
Yes, I wore my big blue hat. I sat by the water for a long time.
Good choice. Did any fish come to bite?
Only one small fish. It was very tiny.
Even a small fish is a catch. What did you do with it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the big boat stay on top of the water?
It floats because the boat pushes the water down, and the water pushes the boat back up. Do you like to splash water?
Yes! But what if the boat gets too heavy?
Then the boat sinks if it pushes too much water away. Do you have a favorite boat?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like coffee?
I do not drink coffee, but I think it smells good. Do you like it?
I like tea with milk.
That sounds sweet and warm.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to run, but my legs hurt after a few steps.
Try walking first to warm up. How many days a week do you like to move?
I think I can go about three times a week.
That is a great start. Take small steps and breathe slow.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like plays?
Yes, I do. What is your favorite part?
The big dog.
That is funny. Does the dog bark?
Yes, very loud.
Oh, that sounds exciting. Do you clap?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to run to the bus now, it is coming.
Go fast! Do you usually run that far?
Yes, I always rush. My feet hurt sometimes.
That is hard. Do you rest your feet at home?
Not really. I just want to make the bus.
Good luck with your run.
Thanks. I have to go.
Safe trip to you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am sorry. I broke your cup.
Thank you for saying that. What did you do with the pieces?
I put them in the trash can.
That is the right thing to do. Do you feel better now?
Yes, my heart feels happy again.
Good. It is all fixed.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big bear at the zoo today. Was it a real bear?
Yes, it was a real bear. Bears are big and strong. Did you see its claws?
I did not see its claws. Do bears like to eat ice cream?
No, bears do not eat ice cream. They eat fish, berries, and honey. Do you like honey?
I do not like honey. It is too sweet. Can bears swim in the water?
Yes, bears are very good swimmers. They use their big paws to paddle. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I love to swim. Thank you for telling me about bears.
You are welcome. I am glad to help. Go have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do you know how to swim? I must go now.
Yes, I can float. Are you going to the pool?
No, I am going to the office.
That is not a place to swim.
I need my towel.
Did you pack it in your bag?
I hope I did.
I hope you did too.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do circles roll so well?
They have no corners to stop them. Do you like rolling balls?
What shape has four sides but not the same length?
A rectangle has two long sides and two short ones. Have you seen a door?
Is a triangle a shape with three points?
Yes, it has three points and three lines.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The plane is still flying and I do not know what to do.
Do you like reading books?
I have a book but my eyes are very tired.
Would you like to try sleeping?
I am too hot to sleep.
Can you take off your jacket?
Yes, that helps a little.
Do you want a cold drink?
Yes, please, I am thirsty.
I will get you some water.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I get a horse to stop running?
Hold the reins tight and sit well back in the saddle. Do you have a trusted friend nearby?
I do not have a friend with me. What else can I do?
Try saying "whoa" in a loud, calm voice while looking straight ahead. Are you wearing a helmet?
Yes, I am wearing one. What should I do with my legs?
Keep your legs quiet and still so the horse does not get confused. Do you feel safe right now?
I feel a bit scared but safe. Is that okay?
That is a good feeling to have. Keep your balance and stay calm.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people get their first jobs?
People work to earn money for things they need. Do you have a dream job yet?
Why is it hard to get a job?
It can feel scary because it is new. Have you tried talking to someone about work?
Why do some jobs pay less than others?
Harder jobs often pay more money. I do not know why that is fair.
Why should I be nice at work?
Being kind makes work less lonely. Do you like helping others?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now!
That is great news! What is making you smile?
I had a meeting today and it was fun.
A fun meeting sounds nice. Did you like what you talked about?
Yes, we picked a new color for the room.
A new color sounds exciting. Did you pick the red one?
No, we chose a calm blue instead.
Blue is a very cool choice.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad because the flowers are wrong.
That is very tricky. Do you like the red ones better?
No, the white ones are sad too.
I do not know which color is best. What makes you feel good?
Just peace, please.
Let us take a deep breath. Do you want a glass of water?
Yes, that would help.
I will get it for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make my clock work again.
Do you have a battery for it? Please take the back cover off first.
Yes, I see a round hole where the battery goes.
I do not know if that is the exact type. Please look for the number written on the old battery.
It says AA on it.
Good. Put two new AA batteries in and check the time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My throat hurts and I feel hot. What should I do?
Drink some warm tea to help your throat. Do you have any honey at home?
I do not feel like eating food. My head hurts too.
Try to eat some soup or toast. It is good to rest in bed.
I do not know if I am very sick. Should I call a doctor?
If you still feel bad after rest, call a doctor. I do not know for sure if you need a visit.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The wind is very strong. I am late for work.
It blows with a loud whoosh. Do you have a hat?
No, my hat blew away. I must run.
The wind can lift light things. Is the road safe?
It is too windy to stay. Goodbye.
Run fast and hold on tight. Stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I built a small shed in my yard today.
That is a big job. Well done on your new home. Did you paint it?
Yes, I used blue paint for the walls and roof.
Blue is a nice choice. Do you plan to put toys inside?
I will keep my bike and tools in there.
That is a smart way to keep things safe.
I feel very happy to see it finished.
Your joy is contagious. It is a good place to be.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. I forgot to do the thing we promised.
Oh no. I am here with you. What did you promise to do?
I promised to bring a book to the party. I lost it.
That is hard. Did you look in your bag?
Yes. It is not there. I feel very bad.
I am sorry. We can find another way to help. Do you know who has a spare book?
I do not know. I just want to fix it.
Let us think together. You can ask the host if you can leave the book at home.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The bear in my book has a golden nose.
That is a very special bear. Do you like the color gold?
Yes, but he is sleeping.
You should let him rest. What was he doing before sleep?
He was eating honey.
Honey is sweet and good for a bear. Does he have any friends?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to pack for my trip. Do you have any ideas?
What kind of trip is it? A beach day or a walk in the park?
It is a trip to the beach. The sun is out today.
Pack your swimsuit. Do you have a towel?
Yes, I have a blue towel. What else should I bring?
Bring some water. Do you like reading there?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It is so hot today. I sat in the shade all morning.
That sounds good. What did you do?
I ate a big bowl of cold ice cream.
Yum. Do you like chocolate or vanilla?
I prefer chocolate. It is sweet.
Nice choice. How do you feel now?
I feel tired but happy.
Good. Rest well.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got an A on my math test today. I feel so proud of myself.
That is wonderful news. How did you study for it?
I practiced with flashcards every night. It was not hard at all.
I am glad you did well. Do you want to eat ice cream to celebrate?
Yes, please. School is my favorite place.
I am happy that you enjoy learning.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which class to pick.
That feels hard. What subject do you like most?
I like reading, but I am scared of writing.
I am glad you told me that.
Should I just pick the book club?
I do not know your full list. What are your other choices?
There is also art, but I am not good at drawing.
You can try art and see if you enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to serve the ball.
That is a great goal to have. Do you already know how to toss the ball up?
I try, but it flies all over the place.
Hold the racket in one hand and the ball in the other. Focus on lifting the ball straight up.
How do I know when to swing?
Swing just as the ball starts to fall back down. Would you like a tip on your grip?
Yes, please, my hands feel loose.
Squeeze the racket like you are holding a bird, tight enough to keep it safe.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue wave crash on the sand today.
That sounds exciting. Was the water warm?
No, it was cold. A little crab hid in my shoe.
Oh no. Did you give it a ride home?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on my story about a dog.
That sounds fun. What does the dog want?
It wants to find its owner.
A clear goal helps. Have you tried a hard path?
Yes, but it is too easy right now.
Good question. What is in the way?
A big river blocks the road.
That creates trouble. Does the dog swim?
No, it is afraid of water.
Then it needs help. Who can save it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy my tomatoes are getting red.
That sounds wonderful. Do you water them every day?
Yes, I give them water every morning.
That is a great habit. I do not know if you need sun or shade, but I love your joy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot make the last piece fit. I feel so mad.
It is hard. Did you try turning it?
No. I just forced it.
Force can break things. Do you see a small gap?
Yes, I do.
Try it gently.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I want to go to the island, but I feel very sad about it.
That feels tough. Do you miss someone there?
Yes, my friend lives there, and I cannot see him.
I am sorry. How long have you been apart?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to jump in the pool right now.
Is the water cool today?
I forgot my goggles!
Do you have a towel?
I am late for practice.
I will grab them for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is it raining?
The clouds get too heavy. Do you like the sound of rain?
It sounds nice. Why do clouds get heavy?
Tiny water bits stick together. I do not know every part of how.
That is okay. Why is the air wet?
The water falls from the sky. Are you staying dry inside?
Yes, I am safe. Why does it stop eventually?
The clouds run out of water.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My head hurts a lot today. I dropped my lunch and it fell on my foot.
Oh no, that sounds painful. Do you have an ice pack?
No, I do not. I also spilled milk on my shirt.
That is bad luck. Are you feeling hot too?
Yes, I feel warm. I want a big glass of juice.
Juice might help. Get some rest soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared of big robots. What can I do?
It is okay to feel scared. Do you like small toys?
Yes, I like small ones. They feel safe.
Great! Start with small ones. You will feel brave soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I slept so well last night!
That is great news. What did you do to rest so much?
I put on soft clothes and read a book.
Reading can be very calming. Do you read every night?
Yes, it helps my mind stop racing.
That is a nice habit. Do you have a favorite book?
It is a story about a friendly cat.
Cats are wonderful sleep companions. I do not know how they help you fall asleep.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I worry my teacher will be mad if I share a toy.
That is a kind thing to do. Do you think your teacher likes sharing?
I think she does, but I am not sure how to ask first.
You can just ask nicely, like may I play? I do not know for sure, but that is a good start.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am in the art hall, but I do not know where to go next.
That is a big room. Do you like old paintings?
I like the shiny metal sculptures, but I am not sure which one is famous.
I do not know which one is famous. Do you want to ask the guide?
The guide is busy, so I will just look at the blue one for now.
That sounds like a good plan. It is a nice color.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am hungry but do not know what to eat.
Try toast with jam. Is that okay for you?
Yes, but I need something with protein.
You can add eggs to the toast.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to sing that fast song.
It looks fun. Do you like fast songs?
Yes, but my words get all mixed up.
Try to breathe slow first.
How do I breathe when it is so quick?
You can take one quick breath. Do you know how?
No, I just stop and try again.
That is a good start.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I had a scary dream about a big dog.
Oh no, that sounds frightening. Did the dog growl?
Yes, it was very loud and fast.
Dream dogs are not real, so you are safe now. How are you feeling today?
I feel a little sad and tired.
It is okay to feel that way. Would you like to draw the dog to make it small?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very tired looking at the big mountain.
Rest is good for you. Do you want to drink some water?
Maybe. I do not know if I can climb it.
Climbing is hard work. Is the path wet or dry?
It is dry. But the top is so high.
High places are beautiful. Do you like looking down from tops?
I like the view. But I am scared of falling.
Fear is normal. We will stop and look.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very tired today.
Being tired is okay. Did you sleep well last night?
Not really, I was too excited to sleep.
That is a tricky thing. I am happy you told me.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not want to go anywhere. The park is too far.
That sounds hard. Do you have bad legs?
My feet hurt a lot from running.
Rest is good for tired feet. Do you want to sit on a bench?
I just want to go home now.
Let us go home then.
Okay. But I am still sad.
It is okay to feel sad. Do you want a hug?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the water in the lake so blue?
The sky makes the water look blue. Do you like looking at the water?
Yes, I do. Is there a fish under my feet?
I cannot see the bottom, so I do not know. Do you see any ripples?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
The tree gets busy making new things for spring. Do you like catching them in a jar?
Sometimes. But why does the tree let them go?
It is like putting on a warm coat. Do you have a favorite color of leaf?
Red is my favorite. Is the tree sad?
The tree is just resting for the cold months. It wakes up when the sun gets warmer.
Can you see the new leaves coming?
I can smell them growing, which is my favorite part. Do you count how many fall?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a snow angel?
You lie down on the snow and wave your arms and legs. Do you like cold weather?
Yes, I love the cold. What should I use for the face?
You can carve a simple smile with a stick. Is the snow deep where you live?
It is quite deep. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. I hope you have fun making your angel.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to build a big kite, but I do not know where to start.
That sounds like fun. Do you have some paper and sticks?
Yes, I have both. What should I do next?
Good. Cut the paper into a square first. Do you have any glue?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the pond today and waited for a long time.
That can be hard to do. Did you see any fish at all?
Yes, I saw one small silver fish jump out of the water.
That must have been very exciting. Did it land in your bucket?
No, it landed back in the water and swam away fast.
I am sorry it got away. Did you try again after that?
I sat there for a few more minutes and watched the ripples.
That sounds like a peaceful way to end the day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I missed my goal because the ball hit the post.
That is so frustrating. Do you think you can score next time?
I feel very tired from running all day.
Rest is important for your body to get strong.
My friend shared his cookies with me later.
That was very kind of him. Did you enjoy the cookies?
Yes, they were sweet and warm.
I am glad you had a good ending to your day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to go camping this weekend.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What are you packing?
I am bringing a big tent and lots of snacks.
Snacks are very important. Do you have any cookies?
Yes, I have chocolate chip cookies for everyone.
I love cookies too. How is the weather looking?
It should be sunny and warm all day.
That is great news. I hope you enjoy your time outside.
I will call you when I get back safe.
That would be nice to hear.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat on the bench and listened to a song on my phone.
That sounds nice. Did the music make you feel happy?
Yes, it helped me relax after a busy day.
Music is a great way to rest your mind.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is tea better than coffee?
I do not know which one you like best.
I like the hot smell of coffee.
That smells very nice.
But I drink tea with milk.
That sounds tasty.
What do you prefer to drink?
I do not drink anything, but I like to watch you enjoy it.
Okay, I will drink some more.
Please take your time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to eat for breakfast.
That is tricky. Do you like sweet or salty food?
I am not sure. It feels like a heavy choice.
Try some toast with jam. What do you think of that idea?
That sounds good. I will get some milk to go with it.
Great choice. Enjoy your morning meal.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and saw a big dog.
That is a fun memory. Did the dog have a ball?
Yes, it chased the ball and I threw it for it.
That sounds like a kind thing to do. Did the dog look happy?
It wagged its tail so fast and licked my hand.
You made a great friend today. Happy birthday to you!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made the best sandwich ever today.
That sounds tasty! What did you put inside?
I added cheese and a lot of yummy jam.
Cheese and jam? That is a new idea.
Yes, and it was very sweet and salty at once.
I am happy for you. You should eat it now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the baby cry when I pick him up?
He may be hungry or need a hug. Do you have a warm bottle ready?
Why are his eyes blue?
Baby eyes change color as they grow older. Do you like how clear they look?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my guitar sound good?
Start by tuning the strings. Do you have a tuning app on your phone?
Yes, I do. What do I do next?
Try strumming a simple chord. Do you like rock or folk songs?
I like folk. Can I just play one chord all the time?
That is a great start for beginners. Keep it steady and simple.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My bus was so bumpy today.
That sounds like a wild ride. Did you like the view?
The trees went by super fast.
I am glad you had fun. Were you scared of the bumps?
A little bit, but my mom held my hand.
That is a great idea. She is very kind.
Then we got to the park.
I do not know if it was raining there. Did you play in the mud?
No, I just ate a cookie.
Yum. Do you want to talk about more?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the fence have sharp points on top?
To keep bad guys from climbing over. Do you have a dog?
No, but I have a cat. Does the fence hurt it?
No, it is safe for your cat.
Why is the wood brown then?
It is wet from the rain. Does it smell like dirt?
Yes, it does. Thank you.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to walk for health but I do not know how to start.
It is very good that you want to move. Do you like walking in the park?
I like the park but I feel too tired to walk far.
That is okay. You can start with just ten minutes. Do you have a quiet time to walk?
Yes, I have ten minutes after lunch.
That is a perfect start.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a blank page, but I do not know what to draw.
That is hard to say. Do you like animals or cars?
I like both, but my hand feels tired.
Try drawing a circle first. It will help your hand rest.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is waiting so hard for me?
It is hard because we want things right now. Do you like sweets?
Yes, I love them. Why does that matter?
Waiting for a treat feels like a small test of your strength. I do not know if you have ever waited for a candy.
No, I have not. How can I get better at this?
Try to take one slow breath and let the feeling pass.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do bugs have so many legs?
They use them to walk on many things. Do you like watching them?
I do not like the big ones that fly.
Some bugs can sting, so they are safe for us. Are you scared of flying bugs?
What does a ladybug eat?
It eats tiny bugs that hurt plants. Do you know what a leaf looks like?
Yes, it is green and has lines in it.
That is true, ladybugs love healthy leaves. Do you like green things?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad because I lost my red hat.
I am sorry to hear that. Where did you last see it?
I do not know. It is not in my room.
That is very frustrating. Do you have any friends at home?
Yes, my sister is here. But I think she is busy.
She may be playing outside. Do you want to check the garden?
No, I am too tired to go out.
Rest is good for you. I cannot find it for you, but I can listen.
I just want my hat back. Please help me look.
I will sit with you for a bit. Is there a place we can check together?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to sing but my voice sounds wrong.
Your voice is just growing, so that is normal. What song do you want to try?
I do not know any songs to pick.
That is okay, we can hum a simple tune together.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my apple at the big market. It was my favorite.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you look near the fruit stand?
I checked there, but it is gone. It makes me feel sad.
Losing a good thing is hard. Do you remember where you started?
Yes, by the purple flowers. I will check again later.
That is a good plan. Take a deep breath and try to stay calm.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red boat today. It looked very happy on the water.
That sounds like a lovely sight. Did you see anyone on it?
Yes, a man was rowing the oars. He moved them very fast.
He must be a strong rowing person. Where was he going?
He was going to a small island. I think he lives there.
That is a peaceful place to live. Do you want to visit it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know where the boat is, and I am in a big hurry.
Is it the small blue one? It is by the dock.
Yes, that is the one. How do I get it moving?
Do you have the key? You turn it to the right.
I have the key, but it will not turn.
I do not know why it is stuck. Is the door locked tight?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing at the water's edge. I do not know where to go next.
The boats look fun to watch. Do you like to play in the sand?
I do not like sand. I just want to do something nice.
We can walk along the path together. Do you want to see a big ship?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does my bread get so big and fluffy?
The tiny bugs in the dough eat sugar and make gas. This gas makes the bread puff up. Did you let it sit in a warm spot?
Yes, I put it near the heater.
That heat helps the bugs work faster. The gas gets trapped in the soft dough. Do you like sweet bread or plain?
I like it plain.
Plain bread is simple and good. The bug gas is the main magic.
So the bugs are good?
Yes, they help the bread rise. Without them, it would be a hard brick.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a snowman, but I do not know where to start.
First, make three big balls of snow. Do you have gloves to keep your hands warm?
Yes, I have gloves. How do I make the snow stick?
Pack the snow very tight with your hands. Are you digging in the snow or using a shovel?
I am digging with a big snow shovel. Can I use buttons for the eyes?
Any round object works, but a carrot makes a great nose. Is the snow hard enough to hold its shape?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to cast right now. What bait works best?
Worms are often good. Do you have any with you?
No. Do I need one to start?
Not always. Fish eat other things too.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am very hungry. What should I eat?
Do you like hot food or cold food?
I like hot food. It feels nice.
The soup is warm and good. Is that okay for you?
Yes, soup sounds great. Where is the food?
It is right over there. Enjoy your lunch.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to find a book with big red pictures.
Red pictures are fun to look at. Do you like animals or cars in them?
I like cats.
Let us go to the cat section together.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was very hot today. I sat in the shade of a big tree.
That sounds like a cool spot. Did you bring any cold drinks with you?
I drank a lot of water. It was so nice to rest my legs.
Good idea to drink water. Your legs must be tired from walking.
I walked home before the sun went down. It is getting dark now.
It is a good time to come inside. Do you plan to eat something soon?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a new toy car. It goes very fast.
That sounds fun. What color is it?
It is red. I like it a lot.
Happy for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy and I feel very sad.
That is a kind thing to do. Do you want to help fix it?
I do not know how to fix it. Can I just say sorry?
Yes, a sorry is a good start. Did you tell them what happened?
No, I was too scared to talk. How do I start?
Look them in the eyes and speak slow. Are you ready to try?
I think I am ready now. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome and I am proud of you. Good luck with that.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to build a shed. How do I start?
First, you must find a flat spot. Do you have a flat spot?
Yes, my yard is flat. What do I need?
You need wood and nails. Is that hard for you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad about the party. It was not fun at all.
I am sorry to hear that. Did the music stop playing?
No, it kept going, but I did not like the food.
That is tricky. Did you eat any cake?
The cake was dry. I miss my mom.
I miss my mom too. Do you want to sit down?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a very scary dream about a big black dog chasing me.
Oh no, that sounds like it would make anyone feel nervous.
My mom gave me a warm cup of chocolate after I woke up.
That is a sweet comfort. Did you feel better after drinking it?
Now I am at school and I feel okay again.
That is great to hear. I am glad the bad feelings passed.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do my ears hurt so much when the plane goes up?
The air outside gets thin, so the pressure in your ears changes. Do you like to chew gum to help?
Why does the plane have to sit on the runway for a long time before we take off?
We must wait for good weather and check that the path is clear. Are you excited to see the clouds?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. The trucks are here.
That is good. Which box has the glasses?
I do not know. They are heavy.
Take the small one. Is it blue?
Yes, it is blue. I must go.
Safe trip. Do you need help?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad and alone. I do not know what to do.
I hear you. That feels heavy. Do you have a friend nearby?
I am not sure where to start. It feels too big.
Let us take one small step. What is one thing you like to do?
I can try to write a note to someone. Is that good?
Yes, that is a good start. I cannot promise it will fix everything.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with my school books.
Are your books heavy?
They are very heavy and I am tired.
You can ask a friend to help you carry them.
I am not sure if I have a friend nearby.
Do you have a backpack?
Yes, I have a big backpack.
Put the books in the backpack to make it easier.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I can't sleep because I am reading by the light.
A dim lamp can help your eyes rest. Do you have a special book you love?
Yes, but my eyes feel tired and dry.
Try a warm washcloth on your eyes. Would you like a tip on when to stop?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a bad checkmate. I am late. Help me now.
Do you have time for a quick move? No, wait, I must go.
Just tell me the win. Do not talk much.
I do not know your full board. Please be fast.
I am leaving. Goodbye.
Good luck on your way. Hope you win the game.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun felt hot on my face today. I looked up and saw the blue sky. Why is it blue?
It is because air bends the light. Blue light scatters more than other colors. Did you feel cool in the shade?
Yes, I sat under a big tree. My dog napped nearby. I saw a bird fly high.
That sounds like a nice rest. Birds see colors you cannot. Do you like watching birds?
I do like them. They are so fast. I wondered if they see the blue too.
They do see the blue light. It helps them see things far away. Is the tree still there?
It is a tall oak tree. It has many leaves. The air felt fresh there.
Fresh air feels good. I do not know how deep the roots go. Do you like tall trees?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do I need a stamp to send this letter?
Yes, you need a stamp. Is it a big letter?
It is small.
Good, then a standard stamp works. Do you live here?
I just moved in.
That is nice. Please go to the counter.
Which counter do I use?
The one on the left. Do you have your ID?
Yes, I do.
Great, you are ready. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I made a new friend today at school.
That is wonderful news. What did you two play together?
We played tag in the big grassy field.
Tag is a lot of fun. Did you run fast?
Yes, I ran very fast and caught her.
You must be feeling very proud. How does it feel to have a new friend?
It feels happy and warm inside my heart.
That is a lovely feeling.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so angry. My toy did not work right away and I snapped at Mom.
It is hard to wait, I know. Did you take a big breath after you snapped?
No. I just wanted it to work now. Why is waiting so hard?
I do not know the exact answer, but your body wants things fast. Is it okay if I sit with you for a minute?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like pizza?
Yes, I love pizza. What kind do you like?
I like cheese.
Cheese is good.
Can we go there today?
I do not know, but that sounds fun.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because my little sister smiled at me.
That is a very sweet moment. What did she say to you?
She said she loves me.
It is nice to share good feelings. Do you have other siblings?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a big secret I want to tell you.
I am ready to listen. What is on your mind?
I think I broke my mom's blue cup.
Did you try to fix it?
I used glue, but it looks bad.
Honesty is the best step. Did you tell her yet?
Not yet, I am very scared.
Fear goes away when you share the truth.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to eat my breakfast today.
That is great! What did you pick?
I chose warm pancakes with sweet syrup.
Yum, that sounds tasty. Do you like fruit on top?
Yes, I put strawberries on my plate.
Strawberries are very sweet. Do you cut them?
I cut them small with my knife.
That is careful and good. Do you like pancakes all the time?
I like them most in the morning.
Mornings are special times. Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to send a letter to my cousin right now.
The counter is right there. Do you have a stamp?
Yes, but the line is long. Can I skip it?
No, everyone must wait. Is it a big letter?
It is small, but I am in a big hurry.
You can use the quick box over there.
Thank you for helping me.
Happy to help. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I need new shoes for running. Do you know where to find them?
Yes, the shoe store is right over there. Do you like red ones?
I think I do. How much are they?
I am not sure of the price. Would you like to check with the clerk?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My phone screen is dark and I cannot turn it on.
That sounds scary. Did you press the side button?
Yes, I held it down for a long time.
It might need power. Is it plugged in?
No, it has been sitting on the table.
Plug it into a charger. Do you see a small light?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to draw a rainbow. How do I start?
You start with the big red curve. Do you have different colors?
I have red, orange, and yellow. What is the order?
Put orange next to red. Is your paper wide enough?
Yes, it is big. Where do I put green?
Green goes after yellow. Do you have a tool for the curve?
I have a ruler, but it is straight. How do I make it round?
You can just freehand a smooth line. Does that feel hard?
It feels tricky, but I will try. Thanks for the help.
You will do fine with practice. Have fun coloring it in.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know how to start my letter to my friend.
Hello there. Do you want to tell them a happy story?
Yes, I do. What should I write first?
Begin with the word Dear. Then say how you feel.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love apples. I have to run.
They are sweet and crisp. Are you eating one now?
Yes, I am rushing to work.
Eat slow so your tummy stays happy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do mountains look so big from the ground?
They are very tall and far away. Do you like to climb?
I do, but my legs get tired.
That is normal. Just take a break. Do you like the view?
Yes, it is very beautiful.
Then keep going at your own pace.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My phone screen is black and it will not turn on. I am very sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you try plugging it in?
Yes, but the light does not come on at all.
That is strange. Have you checked if the cable is dirty?
It looks clean to me, but I do not know what to do.
You could try a different cable if you have one. Did you?
No, I only have this one. I feel so stuck.
I do not know for sure, but a store can help. Do you have time to go?
Maybe later. This is really frustrating.
Take a deep breath. We will find a way. Is that okay?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so hungry. What should I eat?
A warm bowl of cereal is a great start. Do you like it with milk?
Yes, please. I also want a banana.
A banana is very sweet and good for you. I do not know if you want an egg too.
No, I am not hungry for eggs.
That is fine. Enjoy your tasty breakfast!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
Roots pull water up from the soil. Do you have a garden at home?
Yes, I have some pots.
The water moves up tiny tubes to the leaves. Have you ever cut a celery stick?
That sounds like magic.
It is just science, not magic. Why did you ask?
I want my plants to grow tall.
Keep the soil moist but not wet. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My work was very hard today.
I am sorry to hear that.
Do you think I will get better at this?
Yes, you will get better with time.
I feel very tired right now.
You should rest soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a letter. I am lost.
Do you want to send it?
Yes, but where is the window?
Go to the line on the left.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My train is late again. I am so tired of waiting.
I am sorry to hear that. Is it still hot in the station?
Yes, it is very warm. I feel sick from the wait.
That is not good for you. Have you had water today?
No, I forgot. I just want to go home.
Let us get some water together. Do you know where the next stop is?
I do not know. I do not care where we are going.
That is okay. We will wait and see.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is coffee so dark and strong?
Coffee beans are roasted hot, so they turn dark. Do you like sweet drinks?
Why is green tea light and fresh?
Green leaves dry fast, so they stay green. Do you drink tea with milk?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a tiny sprout in my pot today.
That is exciting. How did you find it?
It pushed through the soil after rain.
Rain helps plants drink water. Do you see the leaves?
Yes, the leaves are wet and happy.
Wet leaves mean the plant is drinking. Is it green?
It is a bright green color.
Green means it is making its own food. Nice find.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to count my toys. I get lost when I reach ten.
That is okay. Do you count on your fingers?
Yes, I use my hands. But I forget where I stopped.
A kind tip is to start over if you get mixed up. Is it fun to count?
I want to reach twenty. How do I keep track?
Count one by one slowly. Do you like numbers?
I like them, but they hide sometimes.
Just stay calm and start again. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I put the red shirt in the wash, but I forgot to take it out.
Oh no, that can make it shrink. Did you check the label?
Yes, it is cotton, so it should be okay.
Cotton is tough, so it will likely be fine.
I also spilled juice on my white socks.
Juice can stain, so wash them soon. Are they dry?
They are still wet.
Wet is good for washing.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is so loud and I do not know what to do.
You can go sit inside by a warm window. Do you like looking at the rain?
I am still scared of the big gusts that hit the house.
That is okay, and I do not know why it feels so big today. Is your door closed tight?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I heard a new song today but I am not sure if I like it.
That can be tricky. Do the words make you feel happy or sad?
I think the music is nice, but the singer sounds a bit weird to me.
That is a very good way to check. Would you like to listen to it again?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a big sand castle, but I keep getting it wrong.
That is a fun goal. Do you have a bucket?
Yes, I have a blue bucket and a shovel.
Wet your sand with a little water first. Then press it hard. Do you like wet sand?
I do, but I am not sure how to make the walls strong.
Pack the sand into your bucket and flip it over. Does that make sense?
I think so, but my walls still fall down.
I am not sure why yours fall. Are you using wet or dry sand?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see white on the ground. What is it?
It is snow. Do you like cold things?
I am not sure. It looks soft but it feels iced.
Yes, snow is cold. Are you wearing boots?
Yes, I have boots on my feet.
That is good. What color is your coat?
It is blue. Do I need to build something?
You can make a snowman. Do you have gloves?
I have no gloves. What should I do now?
Go inside to warm up. It is safe there.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the town so new?
We built it last year. Do you like the houses?
They look tall and cold.
They are warm inside. Is it quiet here?
Why is it so quiet?
No one is working now. Do you want a snack?
Yes, please.
Here is a cookie.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water so quiet?
It is still because there is no wind. Do you like the sound of silence?
Why is the lake so deep?
It holds a lot of water over time.
Why do the fish hide?
They are shy and like to rest. Do you have pets at home?
Why is it green?
Tiny plants grow in the water. I do not know why it is not blue.
Why can I not swim right now?
The ground is slippery near the edge. Do you want to walk by the shore?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: What day is it? I must go now.
It is Tuesday. Are you going to school?
Yes, I am late! Thank you.
Run safely. Do you like Tuesdays?
No, but I like days off.
Mondays are next. Can you guess what comes after Tuesday?
Wednesday?
Yes, you are right. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at my dog. He is so happy to see me.
That is wonderful news. I am glad to hear it. Does he like to play in the yard?
Yes, he loves to run and jump. It makes me smile too.
Running is great exercise for dogs. He sounds very healthy. What is his favorite toy?
He likes the red ball the best. He always brings it to me.
Bringing you the ball is a nice habit. He must trust you a lot. Do you walk him in the morning?
Yes, we go for a long walk before work.
That is a good routine. Fresh air is good for pets. How old is the dog?
He is two years old and very fast.
Two years is young and strong. I do not know if he is a specific breed.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have a party?
We have a party to share joy. Do you like dancing?
What is that thing on the table?
That is a gift for you. I do not know who sent it.
Why is the music so loud?
The music is loud for fun. Do you hear the drums?
Why did you get me a hat?
I got the hat because it is silly.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The snow is very cold on my hands. What do I do?
Put on your warm gloves. Do you have any gloves?
I do not know where they are. I feel so silly.
It is okay to make mistakes. Try looking in the shoe rack.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the wind blow so hard in winter?
The air is very cold and moves fast. Do you like feeling the cold breeze on your face?
I do not like the cold. Why is summer so hot?
The sun shines on Earth for a long time each day. Do you like eating ice cream to cool down?
Yes, I love ice cream. Why do leaves turn red and fall in autumn?
The trees stop making food for their leaves, so they drop them. Do you like raking the leaves into piles?
Yes, I love jumping on leaf piles. Why do flowers grow in spring?
The days get longer and the ground warms up, so seeds wake up. Do you like watching the tulips pop out of the ground?
Yes, they are pretty. Why do we have different seasons at all?
The Earth is tilted as it travels around the sun. I do not know the full math, but that is the main reason.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my fridge stick to the magnet?
The fridge is made of metal that likes magnets. Do you like playing with magnets?
Yes, I love sticking them on walls.
That is fun to watch them move. Do they slide down slowly?
Sometimes they fall right off.
Gravity pulls them down. How heavy is your magnet?
It is a small one.
Light magnets hold best. Is it strong enough for you?
It feels quite strong actually.
Strong is good for holding papers. Do you write notes on it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found the old lighthouse on the cliff. It looks so bright at night.
That is a wonderful find. Does the light turn while you watch it?
Yes, it spins right around. It makes me feel very happy.
I am glad you are happy. Do you know who lives in it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad because my tent got wet.
That is very hard. Do you have a dry jacket?
Yes, but my books are ruined.
I am sorry to hear that. What is your favorite book?
It was a story about a bear.
That is a nice story. Can we share our dry food?
Yes, I have some cookies.
Great idea. Are you ready to cook some?
I think I can try.
You can do it. Let us go outside now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My legs feel like heavy rocks after walking to the park.
That sounds like a lot of work. Did you have a good time?
Yes, the sun was warm and the grass smelled sweet.
That is a nice feeling.
But my eyes are closed now because I want to sleep.
It is good to rest when you are tired.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the lake is dirty.
That is very bad. What is in the water?
There is trash and old boats.
I am sorry you see that. Do you see any birds?
No, the birds left.
I know birds like clean water. Is the trash from people?
Yes, I think so.
That is not kind. Do you want to help clean it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a stray cat today. It looked very hungry.
That is very kind of you. Did you have food?
I gave it some fish from my lunch. The cat ate fast.
What a nice surprise for the cat. Was it scared?
It stopped being scared after it ate. Then it ran away.
I am glad it felt safe. Where did it go?
It jumped onto a warm car hood. I waved to it.
You are a great helper. I hope to see it again.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go for a walk in the park today. What should I bring?
Bring some water and a hat for the sun. Do you like walking on grass or on the dirt path?
I prefer the grass because it feels soft under my shoes. Is the park usually quiet in the morning?
It is often very quiet and calm early on. Do you have a dog coming with you?
No, I am going alone to think about my work. Is it safe to walk there by myself?
Yes, it is a safe place for people to walk. I hope you enjoy your time there.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun hit my face this morning. Why is the sky blue?
Light has many colors. Blue bounces around more than others. Did you feel the warm sun?
Yes, it felt nice. But why does it bounce?
The air is full of tiny bits. They scatter the blue light to our eyes. I do not know the exact size of those bits.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red balloon today. It flew away when I was not looking.
That is a tricky sound. Did it go very high?
Yes, it went up into the clouds. I felt a little sad for a second.
I am sorry it left you. Do you like balloons?
I love them, but I miss that one. It looked so happy up there.
It is lucky it found a good home in the sky.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very happy today because I played outside with my dog.
That sounds like a lot of fun! Did you run fast?
Yes, I ran to the big tree and back many times.
Running makes hearts feel warm. Do you want to play again tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad about that big oak.
Why does it make you feel sad?
They cut it down for a new road.
That is very sad. Did you like that tree?
Yes, I sat in its shade every summer.
It was a good tree. Do you have another favorite?
No, I do not know of any other.
Trees are wonderful things. What did you lose?
I lost my quiet place to think.
I am sorry you feel this way.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to bake cookies today. The dough was very wet and sticky.
Oh no! Did it stick to your hands?
Yes, it did. I used a lot of flour to fix it.
That sounds messy. Did you get the smell of the warm sugar?
Yes, the whole house smelled sweet. I ate two before they cooled.
Yum! What did the cookies taste like?
They were a bit too salty. I added too much butter by mistake.
I am sorry about that. Next time, measure the butter carefully.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in a rush. I need shoes now.
We have shoes. Do you like the red ones?
No. I like the blue ones.
The blue ones are over there.
I found them. Thank you.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am going to a meeting today.
That sounds like a big deal. What is it about?
I do not know. It is for my dad.
Oh, that is nice. Will you eat snacks there?
Yes, I hope there are cookies.
Yum, I hope so too. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a bright red flower today and I am so glad.
Red is a happy color. Was it sunny outside?
Yes, the sun was warm on my face. I want to put it in a pot.
A pot would be nice. What kind of flower is it?
I do not know the name, but it smells sweet. It makes me smile.
That is a lovely feeling. Do you have water for it?
Yes, I have a small cup of water. I think I will keep it.
Keeping it sounds fun. I hope it grows big.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke my pencil. How do I fix it?
Is it broken in the middle?
Yes, it snapped right down the center.
You can try using tape to hold the two parts together.
Will that work if I draw with it?
It may break again soon. Do you have a glue stick?
Yes, I do have one.
Glue is often a better choice for a strong hold.
I will try the glue then.
That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel sad because I did not win the game.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you want to try again later?
Yes, but I am afraid I will lose again.
It is okay to be scared. You can still have fun while you play.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Can I buy a cake?
Yes, we have sweet cakes. Do you like chocolate?
Yes, I do.
Great choice. We have a big chocolate cake too.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun set early today and my eyes felt so heavy.
That sounds like a perfect time for rest. How was your walk to bed?
I stepped on a rough stone and it made me frown.
Ouch, I am sorry about that. Do you have soft socks on now?
Yes, they feel like warm clouds on my feet.
That is a nice way to describe it.
I think I am ready to close my eyes now.
Goodnight, sleep tight and dream sweet dreams.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do lions sleep a lot?
Yes, they nap for about sixteen hours. Do you like big cats?
Maybe. Do bears eat fish?
Yes, many bears catch salmon. Is that a favorite food of yours?
I cannot wait. Can sharks breathe?
Yes, they use their gills to breathe. Do you swim in the ocean?
I am going now. Goodbye.
Goodbye. Have a safe and fast day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My baby cries at night. I am very tired. What can I do?
Try holding them close. Do they cry for food or just for love?
They want to eat. But my arms are too sore to lift them.
A soft pillow helps keep them safe. Is your back hurting too?
Yes, my back hurts a lot. I need rest.
Ask a friend to sit with you. You need sleep to be strong.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I look at the sun safely?
You should never look at it with your eyes. Do you have dark glasses?
I have my sunglasses on.
Those are not strong enough for direct sun. It can hurt you.
So what should I use instead?
Use a piece of paper to make a small hole and see the shadow on the ground.
That sounds like a good trick.
Yes, it is safe and fun. Do you like shadows?
I do. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Stay safe out there.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help. Do you have a helmet on?
No, I do not have one right now.
Please find a helmet first. Is your bike in the yard?
Yes, it is right there.
Great. Let us go get it. Are you ready to push off?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see so many red apples there. Are they sweet?
Yes, they look very sweet. Do you like apples?
I do, but my tummy is full. Can I just look?
You can look all you want. What is your favorite fruit?
I like grapes, but I see none. Do you have any grapes?
I do not know for sure. Maybe ask the man with the blue hat.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red balloon today.
That sounds fun. Did you hold it?
No, a man had it. It floated away.
Oh no. I am sorry about that.
Then I found a shiny penny on the grass.
Lucky you! How did that make you feel?
I felt happy. The sun was warm too.
Sunshine is nice. Did you play in the grass?
Yes, I lay down and looked at the clouds.
That is a sweet end to a day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The loud man next door keeps playing music when I try to sleep. What should I do?
That sounds very tiring. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I do have a phone.
You could call him gently and ask him to lower the sound.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so tired, but I feel very happy inside.
That is a nice mix of feelings. What makes you so happy?
I saw a big, bright rainbow this morning.
Rainbows are wonderful sights. Do you see them often?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The rain is here. My picnic is wet and cold. I am sad.
Oh no. That is very annoying. Do you have a dry blanket?
I have the blanket, but the food is soggy. It tastes bad now.
I am sorry about that. I do not know a fix for wet food. Are you safe and dry?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My new neighbour seems very quiet. Is that normal?
It can be. Do you know why they are quiet?
I do not. Should I say hello to them?
Yes, it is kind. A small smile helps.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must win this hand fast.
Do you have a good pair?
I do not have time to think.
Just play your best card.
Is the next card a king?
I do not know yet.
Please help me quickly.
I will help you win.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is a circle round?
It has no corners, so it rolls smoothly. Do you like to watch circles roll?
Why is a square flat?
It has four straight sides that touch each other. Are you drawing a square right now?
Why is a triangle pointy?
It has three sharp corners. Do you think triangles are strong?
Why do shapes have names?
Names help us talk about them easily. I do not know if you can name all of them yet.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel so mad when I wait for my cookie to bake.
That feeling is hard. Do you like sweet snacks?
Yes, I love cookies very much.
Waiting is hard when we want joy. Have you tried counting to ten?
I tried, but my fingers get tired.
Your body is moving fast. Do you play with blocks?
Yes, I build big towers with them.
Building teaches us to be slow. It takes time to make something strong.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to sing today, but my voice sounded bad. I want to quit.
It is hard at first. Do you like singing?
Yes, I love it, but I am sad I am not good.
You will get better with time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My phone screen is cracked.
Oh no, that looks bad. Do you still want to use it?
Yes, but it hurts my fingers.
You can buy a new case to help. Do you have one at home?
I do not have one.
That is why it hurts. You can get a cheap one at the store.
How much will it cost?
I do not know the price. It depends on where you go.
I will check the store tomorrow.
That is a good plan. Do you have a bus ticket?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The train leaves soon.
I see. Is your ticket ready?
Yes, it is in my hand.
Good. You have time.
I must run now.
Good luck. Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I wonder why the sky turns red at night.
The sun is far away, so the light looks red. Do you like red?
Yes, I do. Also, why is the grass green?
The grass has something that makes it green. Is your garden green?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to kick the ball hard.
That is fun. Do you like to score goals?
Yes, I want to be a great star.
Stars practice a lot. Do you practice every day?
I play when I am free.
That is a good way to start.
I hope I win the big game soon.
Winning feels great. Do you have a favorite team?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have so much joy right now. It feels like the sun is shining inside me.
That sounds wonderful to hear. What made you feel this way?
I want to give this happiness to someone else. How can I share my good feelings?
Just smile and tell a friend you are glad they are there. Do you have a favorite person to talk to?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we eat outside?
The fresh air makes food taste good. Do you like the sun?
Why is the grass green?
Plants make their own color from light.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do I wash my blue shirt?
Put it in the cold water. Is it dirty from grass?
Yes, I fell down.
Mix in a little soap. Do you know where the button is?
I think it is here.
Now close the top. Are you ready to spin it?
Yes, please start it.
Okay, I will open the door. Does it smell good now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do trees lose their leaves?
They let go to save energy when it gets cold. Do you have a favorite tree?
Yes, but why do they look so tall?
They grow high to reach the sunlight.
Why do they have roots?
Roots hold them up and find water. Are you thirsty?
I am, but why do trees fall?
Sometimes they get too old or sick. I do not know all the reasons.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it going to rain today?
The sky is blue, so it will not rain. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I do. Will it be hot outside?
It should be warm and nice. Are you planning to play?
I hope so. Is the wind blowing hard?
The wind is very soft today. Do you have an umbrella?
No, I do not need one. Thank you for telling me.
You are welcome. Have fun outside.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here at a new spot. I do not know what to pick.
That feels good. Are you hungry for hot food or cold food?
I like hot soup. But I also want some bread.
A warm bowl sounds nice. Do you like thick bread or thin bread?
I think I want the thin one. I am still not sure.
Try the thin bread with the soup. It works well together.
Okay, I will take that. Thank you for helping me choose.
You are welcome. I hope it makes you happy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love peaches because they are sweet and warm. Do you like them too?
I enjoy the idea of a nice fruit. What color are they?
They have soft, orange skin that feels fuzzy.
That sounds very pleasant to eat.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late this morning.
That can be stressful. Did you eat something?
I tried to make toast, but it burned.
Oh no, that is tough. Was it very dark?
Yes, it was black and smoking.
I am sorry about that. Did you get to sit down?
I just drank milk and sat at the table.
Milk is a good choice. Do you like plain milk?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do we have to wear shoes inside?
To keep the floor clean. Do you like your shoes?
Yes, but they hurt my feet.
That is a problem. Do you have other shoes?
I have boots, but they are too hot.
That makes sense. How does your desk feel?
My desk is too small for my books.
That sounds tight. Do you keep your books there?
Yes, I do.
I do not know the best fix. Do you ask your teacher?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do robots feel cold?
Yes, metal gets cold. Are you wearing a coat?
No. Do they eat food like us?
No, they use power. Do you want a snack?
No time. Do they dream at night?
I do not know. Are you almost there?
Yes. Do they stop if I wave?
Yes, they stop. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. This chair is broken and I hate it.
I am sorry to hear that. Is the leg loose?
Yes, it wobbles a lot. I am sad about my favorite seat.
We can try to tighten it. Do you have a tool?
I have a hammer, but I do not know how.
A hammer is not for screws. Is it just the top?
I do not know. It just feels wrong.
Let us look at it closely. Can you sit on it?
No, I am afraid it will break.
Let us stop for now. Are you safe?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do clouds float up there?
They are made of tiny water drops that are very light. Do you like to look up?
Yes, I do. What are the white ones?
Those are mostly water vapor and ice.
Why do they turn dark?
They get thick with heavy rain. Do you like rainy days?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The line is very long and my mail is late.
I feel bad for you. Do you have a tight deadline?
Yes, I need to send these papers today. What is the reason for the wait?
I do not know for sure. Is the mailman on a break?
I hope so, but I do not know. Please tell the clerk I am waiting.
I will let him know. Would you like some water while you wait?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I found a spider in my room and it scared me.
Spiders can look scary, but they do not hurt us. Do you like bugs?
I do not like any bugs because they have too many legs.
Many bugs have six legs, not eight. Do you have a favorite animal?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say please?
You just say please when you ask for something. Do you like candy?
Yes, I do. How do I say thank you?
You say thank you after they help you. Is it sweet?
Yes, it is. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big deer on the grass this morning.
That is a cool sight. Did it run away?
No, it just stood there and looked at me.
It must have been curious about you.
I think I will try to see it again tomorrow.
Good luck with your search.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I start my first job soon and feel very scared.
It is normal to feel scared. Do you know where to go?
I do not know which building to enter.
Ask your boss for a map. Did you get a letter?
Yes, I got a letter with my start time.
Read it again to be sure. Is the time in the morning?
I think it is at nine in the morning.
That is a good time. Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do robots have hands?
They help robots hold things. Do you like to build with blocks?
Yes, I love building. Do all robots look the same?
No, they look very different. Some look like people, some like cars. Do you want a robot that looks like a cat?
A cat robot sounds cute. Can robots really think?
They follow rules, so they act smart. I do not know if they feel happy like you do. Do you think they are friends?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a sandwich but I am stuck.
You need bread, meat, and cheese. Do you have any bread?
I have bread and ham. What should I do next?
Put the meat on one piece of bread. Is that all you have?
No, I have lettuce and tomato too. How do I stack it?
Put the veggies on the ham. Do you like your food hot or cold?
I like it cold. How do I finish the sandwich?
Put the second slice of bread on top. Good luck with your meal.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does it rain on me today?
I do not know the exact reason. Do you have an umbrella?
No, I do not.
That is tricky. Do you like getting wet?
A little, I guess.
That is good. Do you want to dance in it?
Maybe later.
Take your time. Rain always stops.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look! A little blue bird is in our tree. I am so happy to see it.
That is a beautiful bird. What is it eating?
It is eating a small red berry. I love watching it hop.
Birds love red berries. Do you have a favorite color?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very alone and sad. I want to learn to paint.
Painting is a lovely way to feel close to others. Do you have any colors ready?
I have a red pen, but I do not know where to start.
Start with a big circle in the sky. Do you like circles or squares better?
I like circles. What should I put inside them?
Put a happy face in the middle. Does that make you smile at all?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the internet feel so big?
It holds a lot of data, like a giant library. Do you like books?
Yes, but why do videos take up space?
Videos have many moving pictures that need room. Do you like to watch movies?
I do. Is it a real place I can visit?
No, it is just a network of machines. Do you play games on it?
Sometimes. How does it know where to send things?
It uses codes to find the right spot. I do not know all the tricks.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. The rain will not stop and I cannot play outside.
That is very disappointing. Do you like to jump in puddles?
No, I hate getting wet. My shoes are all soggy and cold now.
I am sorry your feet are wet. Would you like a warm drink?
Yes, please. I just want to go home and watch a movie.
A movie sounds nice. Do you know which one to pick?
I do not know. I just want it to be funny and short.
I cannot pick for you, but a laugh is good. Are you feeling better now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big red bird on a tree.
That sounds fun. What was it doing?
It had bright feathers and sang a song.
Nature is beautiful. Do you like singing?
Yes, I like to sing for the birds.
That is very sweet. You have a nice heart.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what month it is.
Is that your first worry? What did you last see in the sky?
I saw the sun and some birds.
That sounds like a warm day. Do you feel hot or cold right now?
I feel a little bit warm.
It might be a summer month. Can you tell me what your clothes look like?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My dog is chewing my shoes. What do I do?
Try giving him a new chew toy. Is he bored when you are busy?
I bought him a bone, but he ignores it.
That is hard to say. Does he like to fetch a ball?
He loves balls, but he still chews the shoes.
Praise him when he plays with the ball. Are the shoes out of reach?
I will try to hide them better.
That is a good plan. Good luck with him.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say thank you?
You can just say the words "thank you" with a smile. Do you smile when you are happy?
Yes, I do.
That is a great start. Smile, look at the person, and say the words. Have you tried that before?
I have tried it a few times.
Well done. Practice it often and it will feel easy. Is there anyone you want to thank today?
I want to thank my mom.
That is a very kind idea. Go ahead and tell her. I hope she smiles.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I read about the wars and it makes me feel very sad and tired.
That sounds hard, I am sorry. Do you want to talk about something happier?
I just want the world to be peaceful, but it never is.
Peace is a big and good goal. Have you ever seen a time when things were calm?
I think it is too much trouble to change everything alone.
You are right, one person cannot do it all. What small thing can you do?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke the little light in my lighthouse toy. I feel very sad.
Oh no, that is upsetting. Do you know how it broke?
I dropped it by mistake. I want it to work again.
Dropping things can break them. Are you okay?
Yes, I am just grumpy. Can you fix it?
I cannot fix toys. Can you try the red button?
I tried that, but nothing happened. I am stuck.
That is a frustrating feeling. Is the battery dead?
Maybe. I do not know. Please help me.
Let us check the battery together. Do you have a new one?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to start drawing pictures. What do I need?
You need paper and pencils. Do you like to draw animals?
Yes, I love drawing dogs. They are my favorite.
That is a great choice. Try drawing one eye first.
I do not know how to make the nose look good.
I do not know the exact trick for noses.
What can I use to color them in?
Crayons work very well. Do you have any blue crayons?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my birthday a special day?
It is the day you were born. Do you like eating cake?
Yes, I love cake. Why do we sing a song?
The song makes everyone feel happy. Do you want me to help you make a wish?
I do. Why do we close our eyes?
We close them to focus on your wish. Is it a big wish?
It is. Why do people give gifts?
Gifts show they care about you. What is your favorite present?
I love the book. Why do we blow out the candles?
The smoke carries your wish away. Do you feel happy now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: It is so hot today. The sun feels like a big warm hug on my skin.
That sounds very nice. Do you have a cold drink nearby?
Yes, I have ice water and it feels so good. The air is warm and I love it.
I am glad you are happy. It is a great day to rest.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun is very hot today. I think I see a rainbow.
That is a nice sight. Do you like rainbows?
Yes, I do. They look like a big arc in the sky.
I am happy for you. I like sunny days too.
I am going to eat an ice cream now.
Ice cream is a good choice. Cool it down!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the red door on that old shop?
It marks the place where new goods come in. Do you like red doors?
Why do the lights flash when I pass by?
They catch your eye to help you see inside. Do you feel happy now?
Why is the shop closed if the sign says open?
I am not sure why it is dark inside. Can you smell sweet food?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My boss helped me today.
That is very nice of them. Do they often help?
Yes, they are very kind. I want to show my thanks.
A warm smile works well. What did they do for you?
They fixed my mistake quickly. I feel happy now.
Feeling good is a great thing. Do you plan to say thank you?
Yes, I will tell them tomorrow.
That is a sweet plan. I hope it makes them smile.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I used all my money on ice cream, but I wanted to buy a new book.
That is a hard feeling, but let us fix it. What was the book that you liked?
It was a story about a dog who goes to the moon. I do not care about the ice cream.
A moon dog sounds fun. Do you know if you can wait for next week to save up?
I do not want to wait. I just want the book now. It makes me feel small and sad.
It is okay to feel sad. If we talk about the price, can you think of a way to earn more?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because my boss was very kind.
That is wonderful news. Why are you so happy?
He helped me fix a big mistake without getting angry.
That is a great way to lead. Did he smile?
Yes, he smiled and said I can learn from it.
I am glad you feel better now.
I never knew a boss could be that nice before.
It is rare, but it feels good. Is this common for him?
No, he is usually strict but he tried hard today.
Change takes time, but start is good.
