talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Why is the sky blue? I have to run.
Sunlight has all colors. Blue bounces in the air. Do you like blue?
Yes, I do.
That is why we see it. It is a big dance of light. Do you see the sun?
I can see it bright.
The other colors go deeper. Blue stays high up. You have time now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to bake bread, but my loaf is flat and sad. I feel so foolish.
I am sorry it did not work out. Did you use warm water?
Yes, I used warm water, but the dough never got big and puffy. I almost gave up.
That is a very fair feeling. It happens to good bakers too.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I have a bad cough. How do I make hot tea?
Put a teabag in a cup. Pour hot water on top. Do you like honey?
Yes, I do. Can I add it to the tea?
Yes, add a little spoon of it. It helps your throat.
Okay, I will try that now.
That sounds good. Please rest well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to watch a play today. What is a good pick?
The circus show is very fun. Do you like clowns?
Not really. I prefer quiet stories. What about that?
Then the fairy tale is a good choice. It has lovely music.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am looking at a square. It has four sides. Are they all the same size?
Yes, every side is exactly the same length. Do you like squares?
I also have a circle. It has no corners. How many sides does a circle have?
A circle has one long, curved side. Is it smooth to touch?
What shape has three sides? I can not remember the name.
That shape is called a triangle. Do you have one at home?
I am not sure if a star is a shape. Is it a real shape?
A star can be a shape, but it is not a basic one. Do stars make you feel happy?
Thank you for helping me with my shapes.
You are welcome. I am glad to help. Have a good day?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to eat better, but I am confused.
I can help you start. What do you like to eat?
I like sweets and chips, but I feel tired.
Food gives you energy. Do you drink water?
Not much, I mostly drink juice.
Water helps your body work well. What about fruit?
I do not eat many fruits.
Try one apple a day. Are you ready to try this?
Yes, I will start with an apple.
That is a good step. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my voice sound loud for the play?
You can take a deep breath and push it out. Do you have a line that is very long?
Yes, I have a long line that I always mess up.
That is very hard. Try saying just one word at a time first.
One word at a time. Does that work?
Yes, it works well. Are you scared of the big crowd?
A little bit. My hands are cold.
That is okay. I am glad you want to learn.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to tell you about the dinosaur era.
That sounds exciting. What is your favorite kind of dinosaur?
I like the T. Rex because it was big and loud.
Big teeth are cool. Do you know how it ate its food?
Yes, it chased smaller animals and bit them hard.
That is a true thing. Did it live before humans?
It did, long before we even had shoes.
That is very true. Do you like reading about old times?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the water in the harbour deep?
Yes, it is very deep near the middle. Do you like to swim?
I do not know if I can swim well.
That is okay. The boats are safe up high. Are you afraid of the big ships?
They look very tall to me.
They are big because they carry many goods. Do you like looking at the boats?
Yes, I like to watch them come in.
That is fun. The water feels cool and clean. Do you want to sit by the edge?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My chair leg is loose.
That sounds scary. Did you try to tighten the screws?
Yes, but they are too loose.
You can add a little glue. Do you have any wood glue?
No, I only have tape.
Tape is not strong enough. You need real glue for a safe fix.
I will go buy some glue.
That is a good plan. Tell me if you need more help.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does a big boat stay up on the water?
The water pushes back with a strong lift. Do you have a toy boat?
I think the boat is too heavy for the lift.
The boat is full of air, so it is light for its size. Have you tried pushing a float?
But how does it push so hard?
I do not know the exact math, but it feels like a hug. Is the water cold?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do magnets pull things to them?
Magnets have an invisible force that pulls certain metals close. Do you have a magnet to test this?
Yes, I do. But why does it only pull some things?
It only works on metals like iron because they have tiny moving parts that line up. Have you tried a plastic cup?
I tried a cup, but it did not move. That is strange.
That is exactly right because plastic is not a magnetic metal. Nice work asking why!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for class! Where is the math room?
It is on the second floor. Are you sure you have your notebook?
I think I left it in my bag. Do you know which bag?
I do not know which bag, but your red one is on the desk.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go. Do you know how to pack a box fast?
Put big things first. Is it a heavy box?
Yes, it is full. I am running late.
Add some paper to stop it from breaking. Do you have tape?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like swimming in the big blue lake.
That sounds like fun. Do you like the cold water?
The water feels nice on my toes.
I am glad you are having fun. I do not know why the water is that cold.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad and do not know what to do.
I am sorry you feel this way. What made you feel this way?
I do not know. I just feel empty.
That sounds really hard. Do you want to sit and breathe with me?
I do not know if that will help.
It may help a little. It is okay to not know what to do.
I feel stuck in this bad mood.
Stuck feels bad, but it will pass. What is one small thing you can do right now?
I suppose I could go outside for a walk.
That is a good plan. I hope the air helps you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are mountains so tall?
They grow up from the ground by many, many years. Do you like climbing hills?
Why do people go to them?
We go to see big views and breathe fresh air. Do you run up or walk?
Why are they pointy on top?
Ice and wind cut them into sharp points. Do you like cold days?
Why are they hard to climb?
They are steep and high, so it takes much power. Do you have big shoes?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a secret key in my desk.
That is a strange find. Did you try it?
Yes, it opened a small box.
What did you see inside?
It was a map to a red house.
A map is a big clue. Is the house nearby?
I think it is two blocks away.
That is close enough to walk. Do you feel brave?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today. I heard a bird singing a happy song. It made my heart feel warm.
That is a lovely sound. What kind of bird was it?
I think it was a small blue one. I almost fell into the pond because I tried to see it closer.
Oh no, are you safe? I am glad you are okay.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see the boats in the harbour today. Which path is best for a walk?
The pier path is flat and nice. Do you like to sit and watch the water?
Yes, I love to sit. But can I bring my dog?
I am not sure about the rules there. Is your dog small?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is raining hard outside. I do not know what to do.
That can feel heavy. Do you have an umbrella?
No, I forgot it at home. I feel stuck.
Oh, that is tricky. Let us watch the rain fall from the window.
Watching? Is that all we can do?
Yes, it is true. Sometimes waiting is the best thing. What color is the rain to you?
It looks gray and dull. I want to go out.
I understand your wish. If it stops, we can run in the puddles.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It is cold and snowy today. My cat got stuck in a snowdrift.
That is a scary sound. Did you get the cat out safely?
Yes, I pulled him out with my towel. He is very dry now.
Good for you. Is the cat warm inside now?
He is sleeping in a sunny spot by the door. I feel good too.
That is a nice rest.
The sun came out just for me. I am happy.
I am glad to hear that. I do not know your exact spot, but I hope it stays sunny.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I heard a happy song today on my walk.
That sounds like a lovely way to start the day.
It made me smile all the way home.
Did the music make you feel like dancing?
I did dance a little in my kitchen.
I am happy for you. What song was it?
It was a song about a little bird.
That is a sweet choice. Birds are fun to watch.
Yes, I saw a real one too.
That is a perfect match for the song.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a small bird on the path and it looks hurt.
That is very kind of you to notice. Do you have a box nearby?
Yes, I have a shoe box in my bag.
Please do not touch it yet. Is the bird moving its wings?
It is trying to fly, but it falls down.
That is a good sign. You can gently put it in the box with air holes.
Should I take it to the woods?
Wait a moment. Do you know where you found it?
It was right by my front door.
Since it is close to home, you can put it back there. It may just need rest.
I will try that now.
You are doing a great job. Be quiet and let it go.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the bakery this morning.
That sounds lovely. Did you buy any bread?
Yes, I got a warm loaf.
That is a nice choice.
It smelled like butter and honey.
What a sweet surprise. Do you like sweet treats?
I love them, but I also want to stretch.
A good balance. You have a kind heart.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a small horse by the tree. I do not know what to do.
That is a gentle creature. Is it hurt or just scared?
It is safe, but it looks sad and looks at me with big eyes.
A horse can feel lonely. Do you have any sweet carrots?
Yes, I have a bag of them in my pocket right now.
Please share one with it slowly. It may like the taste.
I gave it the carrot, and it chewed happily.
You helped a friend today. Was that a happy feeling?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so tired and my mind is foggy.
That sounds hard. Did you get to take a break today?
I really do not know what to do next.
Take a deep breath. What is the one small thing that feels doable?
I just want to go home and hide.
That is a good plan. Does your home feel safe to you?
Yes, but I still feel stuck.
You can sit in the quiet for now. It is okay to rest.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a tall lighthouse today. The light went on in the dark.
That sounds very peaceful. Did the light shine far out to sea?
Yes, it did. I waved my hand toward it.
You were very kind to say hello. Did you feel happy watching it?
I felt calm and safe. The waves were quiet too.
That is a nice memory to keep.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know how to start my math work.
Do you like using numbers to solve it?
Yes, I have five apples.
That is a good start. What do you want to do with them?
I want to give two to my friend.
You can take two away from five.
So I have three left now?
Yes, that is right.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I went to the beach with my family last weekend. It was so much fun.
That sounds like a great time! Did you play in the water?
Yes, I built a big sand castle, but the waves washed it away.
Oh no, that is a little sad, but a funny story. Do you want to build a bigger one next time?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a film, but I do not know how to start.
First, write down a story you like. Do you have a favorite tale?
I like the story of the little red hen. Now what?
You need a camera to record it. Do you have one at home?
Yes, I have a phone. How do I use it for film?
Just hold it steady and press the record button.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am sitting here. My legs feel like they are made of jelly.
That feels like waiting for a long time. Do you have your toy with you?
Yes. But I still do not know when we will go.
I do not know the time either. Let us count to ten together to help the time go by.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park and saw a big red dog.
That sounds like fun. What did the dog do?
He chased a ball into the tall grass and I could not see him.
Oof, that is tricky. Did you look hard?
I looked everywhere but the grass was too thick to see.
I do not know if he is still there. Was he barking?
He barked once, then ran out and gave me the ball.
Good for him. Are you happy now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to paint my door. It feels hard to pick a color.
Blue is a good choice. Do you like soft or dark blues?
I think soft. I do not know what paint to buy.
Buy a thin brush for the edges. Is the wood smooth?
Yes, the wood is smooth. I am scared I will spill paint.
Put paper on the floor. Do you have an old shirt to wear?
I have a shirt. I do not know how to stop at the corners.
Go slow and steady. I do not know your exact style.
I want it to look clean. I will try my best.
That is a good plan. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky gray in my photo?
Your camera may be on auto mode. Do you like the gray look?
No, I want it bright and blue.
Try changing the setting to sunny. Is your phone in front of you?
Yes, I am holding it now.
Look for a sun icon on the screen. Do you see it?
I see it, but I am not sure what to do.
Tap the sun and wait a moment. Did the sky change?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The city is so loud today. My head hurts.
That sounds tiring. Do you like the noise?
No, I just want some peace. Where can I go?
Try the quiet park by the river. It is near.
Is it safe to walk there alone?
Yes, it is a safe place. Have you seen it before?
No, I have not. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I have a bad headache today. It hurts all around my eyes.
Oh no, that sounds painful. Did you drink any water today?
Yes, I had a big glass of apple juice. But the sun is very bright outside.
Bright light can hurt your eyes. Do you want to rest in a dark room?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like hot chocolate best.
That is sweet. Do you like coffee?
No, I think coffee is too bitter.
Many adults like that strong taste. What does your tea taste like?
My tea tastes like warm grass.
That sounds very fresh. I do not know what that feels like.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a small bird with a red head in the grass.
That sounds like a cardinal. Do you like red?
Yes, red is my favorite color. What does it eat?
It likes seeds and berries. Are you going to feed it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my chair wobbly?
A leg is loose. Is it wood?
It is wood. Why does it shake?
The glue broke. Did you hit it?
I did not hit it. Why did it break?
I do not know. Is it old?
It is new. Why is it weak?
It may be bad glue. Do you have tape?
I have tape. Why use tape?
It holds it tight. Try it now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made soup for dinner and I feel so good.
That sounds warm and tasty. What kind of soup did you make?
It has carrots and potatoes in it.
Those are great vegetables to use. Do you like adding salt?
Yes, I put in a pinch of salt.
That is the right way to season it. Enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. My math sheet is due now and I do not get number five.
Take a deep breath. You can finish it in ten minutes. What part feels the hardest?
I just need the answer for the last word problem. I am panicking.
I cannot give you the exact answer, but I can guide you. Do you know how to add the numbers first?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I cannot sleep when I read at night. How can I fix this?
Try a warm light instead of white. Do you use a lamp?
Yes, I do. What else can I try?
Make the light dimmer. How bright is it now?
It is quite bright. Thank you for the tips.
You are welcome. Do you feel calm now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. I cannot stop my eyes from closing.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you want to rest your eyes for a bit?
Yes, but I have so much work to do. It feels like too much.
That sounds very heavy. Is there one small thing you can do first?
I guess I can just make a list. I do not know what comes first.
That is a good start. What is the first thing on your list?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to sit at my desk.
I hear you. I am not sure why you feel that way. What is on your desk?
There is a big red book.
A big book can look scary. Do you like reading stories?
No, I like to run outside.
Running is very fun. I do not know where your yard is. Is it sunny there?
It is sunny and warm.
That sounds nice. I wish I could run too.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so tired. Where should I start cleaning?
Pick one small room first. Is your kitchen dirty?
Yes, the dishes are all piled up.
Start with the sink. Do you need help?
No, I can do it. What comes next?
Wipe the counters after that.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do waiters wear white shirts?
They wear white to look clean. Do you like clean clothes?
Why is the soup so hot?
It is hot to kill germs. Do you like soup?
Why are there two menus?
One is for food and one is for drinks. I do not know why they use two books.
Why does the music sound loud?
It is loud to hide talking. Do you like music?
Why is this chair hard?
It is hard to be firm. Do you want a softer seat?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I failed at my drawing and want to quit.
It is hard to fail, but you can try again. Did you like how it started?
Yes, I liked the first part, but the end was a mess.
Start over from the part you loved.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I broke my toy and I am sorry I was not careful.
I am sorry it broke. How did it happen?
I dropped it. Now I feel bad because I had to say sorry.
It is okay to feel bad. Do you want to fix it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go to a big party today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you know who is coming?
My mom said we are going now.
I am glad for you. Have a great time there.
I will eat a big red cake.
Yum, that sounds sweet. Will you dance too?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to take a picture of the sky.
That is a lovely idea. What color do you think the sky is today?
It is blue with some white clouds.
Yes, those are beautiful shapes. Do you know how to turn the camera on?
I press this big button here.
Great job! Now just aim at the clouds and press the small button to take the photo.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad because I only want to eat candy.
That is tough, but I believe in you. Do you like any fruit?
Maybe apples, but they are boring.
Apples are sweet and crisp. Do you want to try one?
I guess I can try an apple.
That is a great first step. What color apple do you like best?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to paint a tree but I am stuck.
You can use green paint for the leaves. Do you have green paint?
Yes, I do, but the trunk is hard.
Use brown for the main part and dark brown for the side. Is your paper big?
It is a large sheet of paper.
Great, you have room to make a big tree.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My chair leg is wobbly. It fell over today.
That sounds scary. Did anyone get hurt?
No, but it makes a loud noise. I hear it all day.
Wobbly legs can be tricky. Do you have a wrench?
I have a hammer. Can I just hit it?
Please do not hit it. That will break it.
I feel bad. It is my favorite seat.
It is good you care. Let us try to tighten it.
The bolt is stuck tight. It will not move.
I do not know why it is stuck. Do you have oil?
I do not have oil. What can I use?
Try some cooking oil. It may help it slide.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a shiny red leaf on the path this morning.
That sounds fun. Was the leaf warm to the touch?
No, it was cold, but it looked like a tiny boat.
I love that idea. What did you do with the boat?
I let the rain take it away into the drain.
It went on a trip. Do you think it is still safe?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am very nervous about my new job.
That is a normal feeling. Do you know how to get to the office?
Yes, I took the bus there on Saturday.
Good, that is a great start. Do you have your lunch packed?
No, I forgot to pack my food.
You can buy a snack at the store. Do you like apples?
Yes, I really like apples.
Apples are a good choice. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to plant a tomato.
That is a great idea. What do you have to plant it in?
I have a small pot and some dirt.
Is the pot deep enough? Tomatoes like to dig deep.
Yes, it is pretty deep.
Good. Do you have seeds?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My math work is so hard and I am very sad about it.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you try the first part?
No, I just stare at the numbers and my head spins.
That can be scary. What is the first number you see?
It is a big number with five zeros in it.
That is a large number. Do you have a pencil ready?
Yes, I have a pencil, but I do not know where to start.
Start with the smallest part first. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad today. Do you know why I feel this way?
I do not know the exact reason. Is it because something bad happened?
Yes, I lost my favorite toy. I miss it so much.
That makes sense to feel sad. Do you want to talk about it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I hit the ball hard into the fence today and it bounced back on my face.
Ouch, that must hurt. Did you keep playing after that?
Yes, but I really want to learn how to control my swing better.
That is a good goal. Do you have a coach?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my new friend like jumping?
I think it is fun for him. Does he jump very high?
Yes, he does. Why is he so good at it?
I do not know for sure. He has practice, I guess.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. Why is the sky not green?
It is blue because blue light bounces off the air. Do you like the color blue?
No. I want it to look like grass.
I cannot change the sky for you. Can we look at the trees instead?
Maybe. But it is still not green.
You are right that it is not. I am sorry you feel sad.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a big hole in the yard today.
That sounds like a good spot. What is inside the hole?
Just dirt and a few old roots.
Roots can break the floor later. Do you have a shovel?
Yes, I brought it with me.
Great. Start digging there.
The hole is too big for one day.
I agree with you. Take your time to finish it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I am going to the doctor tomorrow.
That is great! Are you excited or nervous?
I am not scared. I just want to tell someone good news.
I am glad you feel good. Did you do anything special?
I cleaned my teeth and brushed my hair. I feel ready.
You look very tidy. What will you do first?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the island have no sand?
It has only hard, cold rock. Do you like climbing?
No, I like soft places. Why is the water so clear?
The sea is deep and clean there.
Does anyone live on that rock?
I am not sure if they do. Do you want to visit?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My bread is stuck. It will not grow big.
Did you use fresh yeast?
I think so, but I am not sure.
Old yeast will not work well. Do you smell it?
It smells a bit like beer.
That is a good sign. Give it warm time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a cool puzzle. It has three dots.
That sounds fun. What do the dots look like?
They are in a line. One is red.
Nice. Do you know the next step?
I want to put them in a circle.
Oh, I do not know how to make a circle.
You just add two more dots.
That is a clever idea.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired from sitting all day and the house is very loud.
It sounds like a hard day, do you want to try a small walk?
No, I just want to finish this work but I feel stuck in my chair.
It is true that sitting for too long makes us feel low, can you stretch your arms?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a bee on the pink flower this morning. It looked very busy.
Bees work hard to make sweet food. Did it have black and yellow stripes?
Yes, it did. I gave it a little water nearby.
That is kind of you to do. Do you like eating honey on toast?
I do love it. How does a bee actually turn flowers into honey?
The bee carries flower juice back to its home. It dries the juice to make it thick and sweet. Is your honey from a jar?
Yes, from a jar. I did not know it was just dried juice.
It is sweet from the flowers. Do you like dark honey or light honey?
I like the light kind. Thank you for helping me understand.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to throw a party for my sister's birthday. What should I do?
That sounds fun. Who will help you clean up?
My mom will help me clean. I am good at making food.
Great. Do you know what she likes to eat?
I think she likes cake. Do you know a good recipe?
I do not know her favorite type. What kind of cake does she love?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say please?
It shows we are kind. Do you like feeling nice?
What makes good manners?
Being polite helps people feel safe. I do not know everything about every rule.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The city is very loud and full of people. I feel lost.
It can be overwhelming. Do you know where you are trying to go?
I want to find a quiet place to rest.
Parks are usually calm. Do you like trees?
Yes, I love nature. But I do not know which one is close.
I do not know your exact location. Look for a sign with a tree picture.
That sounds good. How do I get there?
You can walk to the nearest park. Are you tired?
Yes, I am very tired.
Then please rest now. You will feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Where can I buy fresh fruit?
The green stalls on the left are best. Do you like apples?
Yes, I love them. How much are they?
They cost a few coins each. Check the sign for the price.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the mail shop today.
Oh, did you get a stamp?
No, I just wanted to send a letter to my friend.
That is a kind thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread is flat and sad. I feel so bad.
That is frustrating. Did you use new yeast?
I think so, but I am not sure.
Fresh yeast is best for big loaves. Do you have a scale?
No, I just guessed the amounts.
Guessing can make the dough wet or dry.
That explains the mess. What do I do now?
You can pop it in the oven anyway. Will you try that?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do robots have feelings?
No, they do not. What kind of robot is your favorite?
I like the one that helps my mom clean.
That is a smart robot. Do you help clean too?
Yes, I wipe the table.
Good job. Are you proud of your clean table?
Yes, I am.
You should be.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my phone in the mud. The screen is all dirty now.
That sounds scary. Do you see a crack on it?
No cracks, but it feels cold. I am worried it will not work.
Cold phones often wake up when they get warm.
I held it in my hand for a while. It turned on!
Great news. Were you able to play your favorite game?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a small shop today that makes the best ice cream.
That sounds very sweet. What flavor did you pick?
It was vanilla with fresh strawberries on top.
I love fruit with ice cream. Is it open late?
Yes, it stays open until midnight every day.
That is very helpful to know. Do they have a place to sit inside?
They have a few tables by the big window.
It sounds like a happy spot to rest.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: A square has four equal sides. What shape has three equal sides?
That is a triangle. Do you have any paper to draw one?
I do. Is a circle a kind of triangle?
No, a circle has no straight sides. Do you like circles?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend but I am stuck.
That is hard. Who are you writing to?
I do not know how to start the first line.
Just say hello first. Do you know how to end it?
I think I will say thank you for being kind.
That is a nice way to close it. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is very loud outside. What should I do?
Please stay away from the windows. Are you safe right now?
Yes, I am in the living room. Do I need to do more?
Just wait for it to stop. Is your food okay?
I have some bread and milk. Is that enough?
That is fine for now.
The lights just went out. I am scared.
Do not worry, this happens in big storms. Are you holding a flashlight?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I like apples. Why are they so good?
They are sweet and crunchy. Do you like them red or green?
I like red ones. Why are they red?
The sun makes them that color. Do you eat the skin?
Yes, I do. Why is the skin good for me?
It has food that helps you stay strong. Do you eat them whole?
Sometimes I do. Why do I like the juice?
It is cool and sweet. Do you drink it cold?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the river always moving?
It runs because the land slopes down. Do you see where it goes?
It runs to the big lake over there.
That is right. Would you like to sit and watch?
I would, but why does it splash?
It splashes when it hits rocks. I am not sure about that part.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost. I do not know where to go.
Do not worry. Is there a big building near you?
I need to find my home. Can you help me?
Take a bus to the main square. You will likely find your way from there.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to find a picture of a dog.
You can type "dog" in the box at the top. Do you know where to find the box?
Yes, it is on the main page.
Great, type the word and press the go button.
I did that, but I see no picture.
That is strange. Did you check the spelling?
I spelled it d-o-g.
Try pressing the button one more time slowly.
Now I see many dogs.
Well done. Do you like the first one?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do this holiday.
That sounds hard. What do you like to do?
I like to sit in my room.
That is quiet and safe. Do you want more?
I am not sure if I want more.
Then staying put is fine. Is that okay?
Yes, staying put feels good.
Good for you. I do not know anything else to say.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared to learn how to drive a car. What should I do first?
Sit in the car and just look around. Do you feel okay sitting there?
Yes, it feels nice. How do I make the car move?
Put your foot on the brake and press the gas. Are you wearing your seat belt?
I am ready to try. Can you help me next time?
I am just a voice, so I cannot sit with you. But I can check with a real teacher.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to count the apples, but I keep getting a different number.
Counting can be tricky if you move the items. Do you count them one by one?
Yes, I point to each apple and say the number out loud.
That is a good way to do it. Are the apples moving?
No, they are sitting still on the table, but my eyes slip.
Try counting the top row first, then the bottom row. Do you use your finger?
I do, but I still think I am wrong because the number changes.
Let us try again together to be sure. Is the table flat?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn how to say hello in Spanish.
That is a great goal. Do you like to play games?
Yes, I like to play with blocks.
We can play a word game together. What is your favorite color?
My favorite color is blue.
Blue is a nice color. Do you know the word for blue?
I think it is azul.
You are right, that is correct.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I got a new job and I am scared to use the big printer.
That is okay. Do you know how to put paper in the tray?
No, the paper sticks out and the machine makes a loud noise.
Just slide the paper in until it stops. Push the start button and wait.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the lighthouse have such a big light?
It helps ships see where to go at night. Do you like to watch boats?
Does the light turn on and off by itself?
Yes, a machine makes it spin round and round. Do you play with spinning tops?
Who lives in the lighthouse now?
Nobody lives there today. That is a good question to ask a fisherman.
Can we go inside the tower?
Usually, yes, if it is open. Do you like to climb stairs?
Why is it tall?
I do not know the exact reason for this one. I think it helps the light reach far.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very happy today. I want to learn to jump rope.
That is great news. Why do you want to learn that?
I want to be faster than my dog.
Running from a dog is fun. Do you have a long jump rope?
Yes, I have a red one.
You have the right tool. Try to jump when the rope hits the floor.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to swim forward.
That is a great goal. Do you know how to float on your back?
Yes, I can float for a bit.
That is a good start. Can you kick your legs gently?
I am not sure how to kick right.
Keep your legs straight and kick small. Have you tried it in shallow water?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the test have so many questions?
The test has many questions to check if you learned the lesson well. Do you like learning about math?
I think math is hard. Why is it on the test?
It is on the test because it helps you count things in real life. I do not know if you will get a high score.
I am afraid I will fail. Why should I care?
You should care because learning makes your brain stronger. Have you tried to study a little today?
I did read my book. Why is the test still scary?
It is scary because you want to do a good job. That is a good thing. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the food there hot?
Yes, it is very warm. Do you like spicy food?
Can we get a seat now?
I am not sure about that. Is your group big or small?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why is it snowing?
The cold air makes water drop as ice. Is your coat warm?
Yes, but the road is bad.
The white ground is hard to walk on. Are you driving?
I am running. It takes too long.
Running is good for blood flow. Do you have a friend to wait for you?
I must go now.
I hope you get there safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I found a door in the attic. What is behind it?
I do not know what is inside. Is the door locked?
No, it is open. How do I open it?
Just push it gently. Are you afraid of the dark?
Yes, I am. How do I keep safe?
Take a light and go slow.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking for a movie to watch tonight, but I am not sure which one to pick.
Do you like happy stories or scary ones?
I think I want something that makes me feel good, but I have no idea where to start.
A funny cartoon is a great choice for a good mood.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work. Do cows eat grass?
Yes, they do. Do you like cows?
I am running! What do pigs eat?
They eat food and plants. Do you feed them?
I must go. Do horses drink milk?
No, they drink water. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the leaves falling?
The tree gets tired and lets them go. Do you like kicking leaves?
Why do birds fly?
They have wings to lift them up. Do you want to fly too?
Why is the grass green?
I do not know the full secret, but it helps them grow. Is your shoe muddy?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke the little bird. It is not alive. What do I do?
That is very sad. Did you check if the wing is just out of place?
No, the wing is broken. I do not know how to fix it.
You might need a doctor for animals. Do you have one nearby?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have these red flowers, but I do not know what to do with them.
Would you like to put them in a vase? I am not sure, so I am asking.
That sounds nice, but I do not have a big vase.
You can use a small cup. Do you like the color red?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What time is it?
It is ten o'clock. Are you going to work?
Yes, I am in a big rush.
The bus leaves soon. Do you need help?
No, I will run now.
Good luck. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a small crab today at the beach.
That is a lovely sight. Did the crab run away?
Yes, it scurried into the sand very fast.
Crabs are good at hiding. Did you see any other animals?
I also saw a big blue whale in the distance.
Whales are huge and gentle. Was the water calm?
The sea was quite still and very blue.
That sounds peaceful. Did you feel tired after watching?
I was tired but happy to be there.
It is good to enjoy nature. I am glad you had a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the small island by the sea today. The sun was very hot and the water was blue.
That sounds like a lovely place to rest. Did you see any fish swimming near you?
I saw a big crab hiding under a rock. It quickly walked away when I moved.
It is safe there, but I do not know the name of that crab.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall down?
The trees get ready for winter. Do you like the red color?
I love it. But why do they stop being green?
The days get shorter and colder. Does that make sense to you?
Yes, I think so. It is like they are sleeping.
That is a sweet way to see it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. What can I do?
Rest your body and drink some water. Do you feel sick to your stomach?
No, my tummy feels fine. It is just a sharp pain.
That is good to hear. Take a break from your screen for a while. Is the pain in one spot or all over?
It is all over my head. I am very tired.
Then you should try to sleep. I do not know your exact cause, but rest is key. Do you have a place to lie down?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to win at chess. What should I do?
Protect your king first. Do you know how the rook moves?
Yes, it goes straight like a train. But I keep losing pieces.
Make sure your pieces have a safe home. What is your favorite piece to use?
I like the knight. It jumps over other pieces.
That is a strong choice. Remember that a knight can attack from far away.
The pawns are very small. Are they useful?
Yes, they are the most important. They can become queens if they reach the end. Do you think you can move a pawn to the last row?
That sounds hard but fun. How do I not let my queen get caught?
Keep your queen close to your pawns. Do you have a plan for where you want to put her?
I will try to keep her safe. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have fun playing.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My feet hurt from this long plane ride.
That sounds very tiring. Are you happy to be on the ground?
Yes, I am glad to be here.
Good. Did you eat a snack on the plane?
I had some nuts, but I am still hungry.
That is good. You should eat a real meal now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have two kings. What should I do?
That is a strong start. Do you have many kings?
Yes, I have two. Should I bet more?
Be careful, as money is gone. Do you like winning?
Yes, I love to win. Is it safe?
I do not know if it is safe. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my computer so slow?
It might be doing too much at once. Do you have many windows open?
I have music playing and a game on.
Yes, that uses a lot of power. Try closing the music to help it run faster.
The screen is also dark.
That is usually a battery or power issue. Is the screen totally black or just dim?
It is just very dim.
Check if the brightness button is pressed. Does it get brighter when you touch it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad today. What can I do to feel better?
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk about what makes you sad?
I am not sure why I feel this way, but I just want to stop feeling it.
That is hard to know for sure. Try drinking some water and taking slow breaths.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The wind is so loud and I am scared.
I am here with you. Do you see the big oak tree?
Yes, but it is shaking hard.
It is a strong tree. Do you have your blanket?
It feels like the sky is falling.
I know it looks scary. Do you want to sit on the floor?
I do not want to listen to this anymore.
I will stay right here.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to kick the ball.
Put your strong foot on the ground and swing your other leg. Do you like playing outside?
Yes, I like to run in the grass.
That is great for keeping your muscles loose. Do you have a good pair of shoes?
I have old sneakers with holes.
Please do not use those, as they are not safe. I do not know where to get new ones, but any firm shoe will help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing on the sand but I do not know what to do.
That is okay, P. Do you like to play in the water?
I think I do, but I am not sure where to start.
Walk to the wet sand near the waves. Is it sunny out there?
Yes, the sun is warm on my back.
Good. Put on some cream so you do not burn. Do you have a hat?
I have a hat, but I do not know how to build a castle.
I do not know how to build one either. Do you have a bucket?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so happy right now, but I am late for work.
That is a great feeling. What made you smile so much?
I found a coin, but I must go now.
Nice. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a movie today where a dog learns to fly.
That sounds very magical. Do you like dogs?
Yes, I love dogs. The flying part was hard to believe.
It is often hard to believe in stories. How did you feel when it flew?
I felt very happy for the dog.
I am glad you had a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to play in the sea. Is it safe?
Yes, if you stay near the shore. Do you know how to swim?
I swim a little bit. What should I watch for?
Look for red flags on the beach. Do you see any flags near your spot?
I see a red flag. So I should stay out?
Yes, that flag means big waves. Are you feeling scared?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I hit the ball hard but miss the net. How do I fix this?
Try hitting the ball a little softer. Do you play a lot?
Yes, I play every week. My arm hurts after games.
Rest your arm for a day. Is your grip tight?
I hold it like a sword. What should I do?
Hold it like you hold an egg. Does that feel better?
It feels too light. I am not sure if it is true.
It is true. Start with one game and see how you feel.
Okay, I will try that next time. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Do you have a good racket?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired and my head hurts.
That sounds very hard. Did you drink water?
No, I just stared at my screen all day.
Eyes get tired from screens.
It is a bad day to do hard things.
It is okay to rest now.
Yes, I need to sleep soon.
Sleep is good for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the song sound so happy?
It uses bright sounds to make you smile. Do you like the tune?
Yes, I do. But why is it so fast?
The quick rhythm gives you energy to dance.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How far is the sun?
It is very far away. Are you wearing warm clothes?
It is bright today. Is the sun hot?
Yes, it is very hot here. Do you have a hat?
I must go now. What makes it shine?
It burns fuel to make light. Have a safe trip!
Thanks. See you later.
Goodbye. Do not run!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this new town. The grass is brown and dry.
That is sad. Do you miss your old home?
Yes, I miss my friend Sam and the big green park.
I am sorry you feel lonely.
It feels very quiet here. I do not know anyone.
That can be hard. Would you like to find a dog park nearby?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a tiny red bug on the leaf today.
That sounds fun. What was it doing?
It was just sitting there and looking shiny.
I love shiny things. Did it have spots?
Yes, it had black dots on its back.
Maybe it is a ladybug. They are friends to gardens.
I hope it stays there to eat the bad bugs.
That is a kind wish.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My house is a mess. I do not know where to start.
Start with the floor. Do you have a broom?
I have a broom. Should I sweep the kitchen first?
Yes, that is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw a wild bear today and it made my heart beat fast.
Bears are big and strong, but they usually avoid people. Did it look like it wanted to play?
No, it just looked angry and I ran away as fast as I could.
Running is smart when you feel scared. I do not know why that one was angry. Do you still feel nervous?
Yes, my hands are shaking and I feel very sad.
It is okay to feel this way. Take a deep breath and give your body time to calm down.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did I dream about falling?
I do not know the exact reason, but it can feel scary. Did you wake up sweating?
Yes, my heart was beating very fast.
That happens when your mind is busy at night. Do you like sleeping with the lights on?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I think I am lost. Why did I come here?
I do not know why you came. Are you looking for your home?
Yes, my home is near the big tree. Why is this street so quiet?
It is quiet because it is late. Do you see the big tree?
No, I see no trees. Why is everything so dark?
The lamps are off, so it is dark. Are you afraid of the dark?
A little. Why does the door have no handle?
It is locked, so it has no handle. Do you have a key?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go. Do bears live in cities?
No, they live in forests and mountains. Are you going to the park?
Yes, I am late for school. Do frogs live in the water all day?
Yes, many do. Do you like frogs?
I must run now. Do tigers swim well?
Yes, they are strong swimmers. Bye!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the snow white?
Ice reflects all the light colors back to your eyes. Do you like snow?
Yes, it looks bright and clean. Why does it feel so cold?
The ice crystals take heat away from your skin. Do you wear a hat?
I do, but my nose still hurts. Why does it feel so tickly?
Tiny ice crystals poke your soft nose skin. Is your nose red?
Yes, it is very red and warm now. Why does it melt in my hand?
Your body heat turns the ice into water. Do you have gloves?
I lost them, so my hands are wet. Can you make more snow?
I cannot make snow, but I can help you warm up. Are you okay?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dough looks flat. What do I do?
It needs time to get warm. Is it in a cozy spot?
I just added the yeast. Now what?
The yeast wakes up and makes tiny bubbles. Those bubbles push the dough up.
It is still heavy. I do not know why.
Yeast loves warm milk and sugar. Did you use cold water?
Yes, I used ice water.
That is why it is slow. Let it sit until it feels soft.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to move my home. It feels too big and heavy.
Take one box at a time, and pack the toys first. Do you have a list of things to pack?
I wrote it down, but I keep forgetting where things go.
Put a label on each box with what is inside. That will help you find your things later.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a man drop his keys. I picked them up and gave them back. He smiled at me.
That was very kind of you. Did he thank you?
Yes, he said thank you with a big smile. I felt happy inside.
Kind words feel good to give. Do you enjoy helping people?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My baby sleeps too much.
That is normal for a new baby. Is he eating well?
Yes, he eats all the time.
That is a good sign. You are doing a great job.
I feel very tired all the time.
Rest when you can. Do you have help at home?
My partner helps a lot.
That is wonderful to hear.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling into a dark hole.
I am sorry you felt that way. Did you wake up alone?
I woke up shaking and could not sleep again.
Try to take slow breaths now. Do you like to hold a toy?
Yes, I have a soft bear I can hug.
That is a good idea. Hugging helps you feel safe.
I still feel a little scared, though.
It is okay to be scared. I do not know if the dream will come back, but you are safe now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad looking at the water. It is so big and lonely.
The sea is big, but it is not lonely. The waves talk to each other all day. What does the water sound like to you?
It sounds like a whisper. I just want to jump in and stay there.
Swimming can be fun, but cold water is scary. Do you like cold baths?
No, I hate being cold. My toes get blue and numb.
Blue toes are not safe. You need warm socks and a hug instead. Have you tried warming your feet?
I tried, but my heart still feels heavy.
A heavy heart needs rest. The sea will wait for you. Are you ready to sit down?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I love bananas. Do they grow on trees?
Yes, they grow on big plants. Do you like them sweet or sour?
I like them sweet. What about you?
I like them sweet too.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My new friend likes to draw big pictures.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What color does he like best?
He likes blue because it looks like the sky.
I like that choice. Does he want to draw with you?
Yes, he invited me to his house.
I am happy for you.
I feel very glad about this.
Keep talking to him.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my new friend fast.
Do you know where he went?
I think he is at the park.
That is a good guess. Is he wearing red?
Yes, he has a red hat.
I do not know for sure. Should I look?
Please, I am late for school.
I will check the park now. Run!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My cake fell over. Now it is all squashed and messy. I do not want to eat it.
Oh no, that is very sad to hear. Did you try to fix it with the cream?
I tried, but it just got worse. I feel like crying now.
I am sorry you feel this way.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to write a letter to my friend. I do not know what to say first.
Start by telling them you miss them. Do you want to share a funny story?
That sounds good. But what should I write in the middle?
Tell them about your day. Did you eat a nice dinner today?
I had soup. How do I end it?
Say you hope to see them soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My fish looks very sad. What should I do?
That is a good question. Is the water clean?
I am not sure how to tell. It looks a bit cloudy.
Cloudy water can make fish sick. Do you see any white spots?
No, I do not see any spots. Just the fog.
I do not know for sure. A vet can help. Is it moving?
Yes, it is swimming in circles.
That is not good. Please ask a pro. Do you have a vet nearby?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My horse ran away from the barn this morning.
Oh no! Did you find him?
Yes, I walked into the field and called him.
That was a smart move. What was he doing?
He was eating the grass near the fence.
That makes sense. Do you think he was hungry?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My boss gave me a huge smile today. I do not know how to feel.
That sounds very nice. Did she help you with a hard task?
She fixed my big mistake for me. I am not sure if I should be happy or sad.
It is good to be kind to others. Do you want to say thank you?
Yes, I think I will say thank you. It makes my heart feel warm.
That is a true and good feeling.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel a bad knot in my belly.
That knot often comes from big worries. Do you know what it is about?
I do not know why I feel this way.
Sometimes the body feels fear before the brain does. Is your heart beating fast?
Yes, my heart is going really fast.
A fast heart can make you feel scared. Would you like to take a slow breath with me?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late! Do red roses mean love?
Yes, they do. Do you like red ones?
I do not have time to look.
I am glad you know. Have a fast day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do trees lose their leaves in the cold time of the year?
They let go to save energy for the winter. Do you like watching them fall?
Yes, I do. Do all trees drop their leaves?
No, some keep their green leaves all year long. Is there a tree in your yard?
Yes, we have a big one. How does it grow so tall?
It reaches up to find more sun. Do you climb it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do bees make sweet honey?
They fly to flowers and drink the sweet juice called nectar. Do you like drinking nectar?
No, I do not. What happens next?
They put the nectar in special pouches and fly home. In the hive, they fan it with wings to dry it into honey.
So they make it dry? That is cool.
Yes, the sun and their warm bodies turn the wet nectar into sticky honey. Do you know where bees live?
In a hive?
Yes, they live in a hive made of wax. It is like a tiny house for them.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need help planning a fun party for my friends.
What kind of food do you want to serve?
I think pizza is a safe and tasty choice.
That is a great idea. Do you have a list of guests?
Yes, I have five friends coming over.
That is a perfect number for a small gathering.
I am not sure what games we should play.
I do not know your favorite games. What games do you like?
We usually just play tag or hide and seek.
Those are classic and always fun. Have a great time!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My little fence broke in the wind. I am so sad.
That is a shame. Was it a big break?
Yes, it snapped right in half.
I do not know how to fix wood. Do you have tape?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so late. This is very bad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you miss the bus?
I did not see it. It is all my fault.
That is not always true. I do not know why you missed it.
I am just very upset.
I understand that. Do you want to wait for the next one?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I met a new friend today.
That is good news. Did you have fun?
I do not know if I can trust them.
Trust takes time to grow. What did they do?
They shared their toys with me.
That is a kind start. Do you feel safe?
I just want to make sure.
Stay close and see. Is your heart okay?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like apples today.
Apples can be tricky. Do you think they taste too sweet?
Yes, they are too sweet.
That is a fair point.
I just want a banana.
Bananas are often easier to like. Are you hungry?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my small fish swimming in a circle?
It might be sick or tired. Is the water cold?
The water feels warm to me.
Fish like different temperatures than people. Please check your guide for the right number.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My head hurts a lot today. I bumped it on the desk.
That sounds painful. Did you see a doctor?
No, I just took some medicine. It is not much better yet.
I do not know why it hurts so much. Did you sleep well last night?
I slept fine. I am just tired from work.
Rest can help you feel better. Do you have any water?
Yes, I am drinking some now. My head feels a little warm.
Keep drinking water and rest. Is the pain getting smaller?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the fruit stall?
It is just past the flowers. Are you buying bananas?
Yes, I need them fast. Is it far?
No, it is only ten steps away. Do you know where to go?
I am almost there. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to start a plant in a pot. Do you know how?
Yes, you need a small pot with a hole in the bottom. Do you already have one?
I have a cup. Will that work?
A cup is fine if it drains well. Just add dirt and a seed to start.
How much water do I give it?
Give it a little water when the dirt feels dry. Is your soil dry or wet?
It feels dry. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. I am happy to help you grow it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My teacher is very kind. She helps me when I am sad.
That is sweet. Do you like her?
Yes, I do. But I do not know if she is fair.
Fair means everyone gets the same rules. Does she treat all friends the same?
I think so. Can you tell me what is fair?
I cannot give you one true rule. But asking her is the best way to know.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is a wedding for eating cake?
Yes, you get sweet cake! Do you like chocolate cake?
I hope they play my song.
That would be fun. What is your favorite song?
The flowers are so pretty.
I love red roses too.
I will give the bride a hug.
She will be so happy!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just saw the best movie ever.
That sounds so fun. What is it about?
It has a cute dog that finds his family.
Dogs are nice. Is the story sad?
No, the ending is very happy.
I love happy ends. Do you want to see it again?
Yes, I want to watch it every day.
Me too. It sounds like a true friend.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go. That dream was so bad.
That sounds scary. Do you want to talk about it?
No, I am running late.
I am sorry. Is it about something dangerous?
Please stop. I must go.
Okay. Stay safe.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my bread get big and fluffy?
The yeast eats sugar and makes gas. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I do.
That gas pushes the dough apart. Did you warm the kitchen?
It was nice and warm in there.
Warmth helps the yeast work faster. Is your kitchen bright?
It is quite sunny today.
Sunlight can help, but warmth is key. Do you like sun?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: This little slide is stuck. It will not move.
That is tricky. Have you tried to wiggle it first?
I wiggled it, but it stays tight.
I do not know for sure. Can you push it a little harder?
I pushed very hard and it snapped out!
Great job! I am happy you got it open.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I just moved to this new town and I feel very lost.
That can feel scary at first. Do you like quiet places?
Yes, I do. Where should I go for a walk?
The park by the river is very calm there.
That sounds nice. Can you eat well here?
Yes, there is a good soup house on the main street.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look! My bread is so big now. I am very happy to tell you why.
That looks delicious. What made it grow so tall?
The tiny bugs in the flour ate sugar and made gas.
I did not know that. Do you think it will taste good?
Yes, it smells sweet and warm. The gas made little holes in the dough.
Oh, I see. Does the heat make those holes stay there?
Yes, the oven makes the holes stop moving. The bread gets firm and tasty.
That is a nice trick. Did you add any special flavors?
I just used salt and a little honey. I want to share a big piece with you.
I would love that. Thank you for sharing your joy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know the tennis rules fast.
Can you tell me which part is confusing?
The very first serve.
You stand behind the line and hit the ball into the corner.
What if I hit it out?
You lose the point right away.
I am running late.
Is your match starting soon?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a house of cards?
Put two cards up like a tent. Do you have enough cards?
I have a full deck. What is the next step?
Place a card flat on top of the first tent. Nice try so far!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw smoke come out of a house near my path. The fire trucks came very fast with loud sirens.
Oh my, that sounds scary. Is everyone in that house safe?
Yes, the neighbors said they are all okay. I went home to wait for the all clear.
That is good news. Did you use a flashlight to find your way home?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is so hot today. I do not know what to do.
That sounds tough. Do you like cold drinks?
Yes, I like ice water. But I still feel bored.
Maybe you can swim? Is there a pool near you?
Yes, there is a pool right there.
That is a great idea. Go have fun!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red dog in the park. It was very happy.
That is a nice dog. Did you pet it?
Yes, I did. It has soft fur. I want a dog like that.
That is a sweet idea. What will you call it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do robots have wheels?
Wheels help them roll to new places. Do you like moving things around?
Why can some robots talk?
They have computers that help them say words. Do you like talking to them?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love my picture book about the red fox. How do I make my own little fox toy?
You can use red yarn for the body and brown for the face. Do you have any scissors?
Yes, I do. How do I keep the shape from getting squishy?
Stuff it with old socks or cotton. Be very careful with the sharp tips.
Okay. How do I make the ears look pointy?
Cut small triangles from the fabric and sew them on top. Are you wearing your safety glasses?
I am. But I am not sure how to add the white belly.
Use white felt for a soft look or white thread for stitches. Which do you prefer?
I like the felt idea. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Good luck with your new toy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I fixed the clock but it still makes a loud noise. I feel so mad about it.
It is okay to feel mad. Do you hear a tick or a buzz?
It sounds like a loud buzz and the hands move in a weird way.
A buzz often means the battery is not good. Did you use a new one?
Yes I used a new battery but it still makes the weird sound.
I do not know why that specific battery fails. Is the clock old?
It is only a year old so why is it broken now.
Old parts can fail fast. Let us try a different brand.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I am very tired today.
That sounds hard. Do you have enough time to rest?
I do not know why I am so sleepy.
Your body may need more sleep. Is your bed comfortable?
I wonder what makes people get tired.
I do not know the whole answer. Did you eat a big lunch?
That is a strange thing to ask.
Food can make you drowsy. Are you hungry now?
I think I just need to lie down.
That is a good plan. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a tricky riddle. I love it.
That sounds fun. What does it ask?
It asks what has a face but no eyes.
Oh, I think I know that one. Is it a clock?
Yes! You are smart. I am so happy you got it.
I am glad we solved it. Do you have more puzzles?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my toast so good this morning?
The sun warmed the bread just right. Did you add any jam?
Yes, I did. Why does hot bread taste better than cold?
Heat wakes up the sweet flavors inside. Do you like it sweet or salty?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad that the sky is blue.
I am sorry you are sad. Do you prefer red?
No, I just want it to be black.
That would be very dark. Have you tried looking up?
It is still blue, and I hate it.
I know the light bends to make it blue.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how old people wrote letters long ago.
They used a metal pen and ink. Did you know ink came from plants?
How did they get the ink onto the paper?
They dipped the pen into a small pot. Have you ever tried dipping a brush?
Yes, I have. What if the ink runs too much?
Just wait a little for it to dry. Do you have a pen and paper to try?
I do, and I am going to try it now.
That sounds like fun. Good luck with your first letter.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I met a new boy at school, but I do not know what to say to him.
It is okay to feel shy. Do you know what his favorite game is?
I do not know that, and I am afraid of saying the wrong thing.
Just smile and ask if he likes the game. That will start a nice chat.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a snow day list?
That is a fun idea! Do you like playing outside in the snow?
I want to pick the best things to do.
You can write down games you love. Is sledding one of your favorites?
I do not know if it is a month thing.
Snow happens in winter months like December. Do you know what month it is now?
I just want to learn how to plan.
Start with a list of three fun ideas. Good luck with your planning!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big dog in the yard today.
That sounds exciting. Did you pet the dog?
No, it was barking very loud.
Loud barking can be scary. What did you do next?
I ran back inside my house.
Running is a safe way to feel better. Did you tell a grown-up about it?
Yes, I told my mom all about it.
She must have been happy you were safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why is the sky blue? How do I learn more about it?
The sun shines all colors, but the air scatters blue best. Do you like to read books?
Yes, I do. How can I read about this?
Visit a library and look for picture books on science. Have you been to a library before?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in the fog of the past. I do not know where to start.
Do not worry. It is like a big garden with many paths. What time period feels right to you?
Maybe the knights? I like their shiny armor.
That is a great choice. Knights lived in castles. Do you know how they got to the top?
I am not sure. I think they just climbed the walls?
No, that would be very hard. They used stairs or ladders. Do you want to know about their food?
Yes, please. What did they eat?
Mostly bread, stew, and meat. It was warm and filling. Does that sound good to you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see the moon up close. How do I get there?
You need a rocket to go there. Do you have one?
I do not have a rocket. Can I just swim there?
No, water will not take you to the sky. Do you like looking up?
I like looking up. What do I do now?
Get a telescope to see it better.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I was so scared in my dream. The monster chased me all night.
That sounds like a very scary time. Did you wake up safely?
Yes, but my heart is still beating fast. I do not want to sleep again.
It is okay to feel a little scared. I will sit here with you until you feel calm.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a movie?
You need a camera and some actors. Do you have a camera?
Yes, I have a phone camera.
Great, start by writing a short story. Then film the scenes.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am so tired. I do not know what to do.
I am sorry you feel this way. What do you usually do when you are tired?
I try to rest, but I cannot stop thinking.
It is hard when your mind will not rest. Do you want to talk about what is on your mind?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big white cloud today. It looked like a sleeping dog.
That is a lovely picture. Did it move fast across the sky?
It moved very slow. I waved at it with my hand.
Clouds do not see us, but they are pretty. Do you like looking up?
I always do. I feel small under them.
You are not small to the sky. Just take a breath.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I saw my plant drink water today.
That is a lovely thing to see. Do you know how the water gets inside the stem?
I think it goes up from the roots like a tiny ladder.
Yes, that is true. The water climbs up the stem to feed the leaves. Do you like how the leaves turn green?
I love the green leaves. They look so alive.
Green means they are making their own food from the sun. It is a happy sign. Have you watered it again this week?
Yes, I gave it a good drink. It feels strong now.
Good for you. Plants love care. Do you have any other plants growing?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I have a big secret to tell you.
I am happy to listen, but I need to keep it safe. What is your secret?
I want to learn how to fly.
I do not know how to fly, but I can help you build a kite.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I told my friend I would meet him today, but I feel very sad.
That sounds hard. Do you think you can still go?
I do not know if I want to hurt him by staying home.
Honesty is a kind thing to do. How do you want to tell him?
Maybe I can say I am sick, but I am not really sick.
It is better to be true. Would you like to say you are just not feeling well?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I hit the stop sign again.
That is a tough spot to learn. Did you see the light?
Yes, but my hands shake a lot. I feel scared.
Feeling scared is normal for most people. Do you want to try again?
I do not know if I can do this. My head hurts.
You are doing fine, even with the hard bits. Is there a song that helps you relax?
Not really. It is just very confusing out there.
I am sorry it feels so big. Would taking a deep breath help?
Maybe. I just want to get this over with.
We take it one turn at a time. Do you feel ready to go slow?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure how to fix my broken fence.
It looks sad, but you can help it. Which part is broken?
The wood is soft and rotting near the ground.
That is tricky to fix alone. Do you have a friend who knows how to build?
I do not know if the fence can be saved at all.
I do not know if it is safe. Is it holding the gate?
Yes, but I am afraid I will break it more.
Take it slow and stay calm. Would you like to check the other posts first?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I see bright light in the dark. Why is it there?
A fire is burning nearby. Is it close to your home?
It smells like smoke. Why is it not putting itself out?
Fire needs air to keep going. Do you see any people outside?
I see flames high up. Why does it glow so red?
Hot things glow red from heat. Are you safe inside?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am tired after my run.
That is good. How far did you go?
I ran to the big tree.
That is a good place. Did you drink some water?
Yes, I had two big cups.
That is very good for you. Do you like the smell of grass?
I love the green smell.
That is a nice feeling.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sitting here. I do not know what to do next.
That can feel heavy. Do you feel sad about it?
Maybe. My mind is buzzing with noise.
I do not know the fix, but I see you. Is there a quiet spot you want?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot stop thinking about that sad song.
That song is very moving. What part makes you feel that way?
The voice breaks at the end. It feels so lonely.
It is a powerful feeling. Do you have a favorite song that feels happy?
Yes, but I do not like to listen to it right now.
It is okay to choose what you listen to.
Just help me feel better.
I cannot fix your feelings, but I am here. Would you like to talk about your day?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke my pen. How do I fix it?
Oh no, that is sad. Do you have glue?
Yes, I have glue. Where do I put it?
Put a tiny bit on the crack. Press it hard for a minute. Is it dry now?
It is still wet. What should I do?
Just wait. Let it sit for one hour. Did you read the label?
I did not read it. What does it say?
It says it takes time. Be patient.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to cross the river safely.
Look for a place where the water is slow and shallow. Do you see any rocks near the shore?
I see big stones on the left side.
That looks like a good spot. Do you have strong boots on?
Yes, I have dry boots and I am ready to try.
Take small steps and hold onto a stick if you can. Are you feeling steady?
I feel okay, but the water is still moving.
Go slowly and do not panic if you wobble. Can you see a safe place to stop?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling into a dark hole.
That sounds very frightening. Did you wake up sweating?
Yes, my heart was beating really fast.
That is a normal body reaction. What do you usually do to feel safe?
I hide under my warm blanket.
That is a good and cozy place. Do you want to talk about the dream?
I think I do, but I am still tired.
Rest is important right now. I will be here if you wake up again.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just took a train ride and it was so much fun.
That sounds lovely. What did you see out the window?
I saw big green fields and little red houses.
How nice. Did you enjoy the view?
Yes, the view was very peaceful and calm.
I am glad you had a good time. Did you like the food there?
The snacks were okay, but the ride was the best part.
I am happy you enjoyed the trip.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I make my pictures look nice?
Try to find bright light for your shots. Do you have a good camera?
I am using my phone right now.
That is a great tool for many things. What is your first photo?
I want to take a picture of my dog.
Place him near a window so the light shines on him.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love drums. I have to run now.
Drums are fun. Do you like big songs?
Yes. I am late.
Go fast. Is that your favorite song?
No. Just something loud.
Loud is good. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a small red boat on the lake.
That sounds fun. Did you wave at the people inside?
They waved back. My dog wanted to jump in, but I said no.
A good call. Dogs get cold in the water.
The sun came out after the clouds left.
Nice change. The light must look bright on the water.
I watched it float by and feel happy.
That is a lovely end to the day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is my sister older than me?
Yes, she is. Do you like playing with her?
Yes, we play tag. What is her favorite color?
I think it is blue. Does she like blue too?
She loves it. Can she cook?
I do not know for sure. Does she cook for you?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very tired. The plane was loud.
That sounds hard. Did you sleep?
No, my legs hurt. I stood up for long times.
Oh no. Did you bring a book?
Yes, but I could not read. My hands shook.
I am sorry. Drink some water.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big ant carry a crumb today.
That is a strong little worker.
Yes, it was right by my shoe.
Did you wave to it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I clean the lighthouse glass?
You should use soft cloths and soapy water. Do you have a special bucket?
I just have a rag. Is that okay?
A clean rag works fine for the dust. Are you climbing up the stairs?
The stairs are very long.
Take slow steps to stay safe. Do you have a friend with you?
I am all alone right now.
That is a bit risky. Would you like to wait for someone?
I will stay here and look at the sea.
That is a wise choice for now. I am glad you are safe.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I deal the cards?
Start at your left and move around the table. Do you know how to shuffle them first?
