Yes, I just cut the deck. Now what?
Give each person one card until everyone has four. Do you want to play a simple game?
I just want to learn to fan them out.
Hold the deck in one hand and pull the bottom card with your other finger. Do you see how they spread?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did people build such tall towers in the past?
They wanted to show their power and be seen from far away. Did you ever want to be seen from high up?
Yes, I do. But why did some of them fall down?
Old walls could not hold the weight, so they broke. Do you think we build things better now?
I hope so. Did people have books before paper?
No, they carved words into stone or used thick skin. Did you know that?
That is hard to imagine. Why did they write on stone if it was so hard?
Stone lasts a very long time, so the words stay safe. Do you like writing on paper?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! My carrots are big and orange.
That is wonderful news. What do you eat for lunch?
I like to eat them raw with dip. It is sweet and crunchy.
I do not know about dips. What is in your garden next?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My friend looks very sad today. What should I do?
Sit with them and listen. Do they want to talk about why?
I just want to make them happy. How?
You do not know if a game will help. Try asking what makes them smile.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I lost my party hat.
That is a big problem. Do you know where you last saw it?
I think it is on the red chair.
Good luck looking there. Was it a bright color?
Yes, it is red and yellow.
I hope you find it fast. It looks fun.
I found it under the chair!
That is great news. Have a good time at the party.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is my cake?
I do not see it. Did you buy it?
Yes, but I forgot it in the car.
Oh no. What color is it?
It is blue with white icing.
I will check your pocket. Is the key there?
Yes, the key is here.
Good. Drive safe. Have fun today.
Thank you, I must go now.
Bye. Happy birthday.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I put together this little wooden puzzle?
Start with the corner pieces. Do you see the square ends?
Yes, I found two. What should I do next?
Fit the side pieces next to them. Is the picture on the box helpful?
I think so. Now the edges are all in.
Great. Fill in the middle with the small shapes.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to look at the moon but I am not sure how to start.
Do you have a dark place to go?
Yes, I have a small garden, but it feels too far away.
That is close enough to see it well.
Should I bring a blanket?
Yes, it will make you warm.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the moon bright in the night?
It reflects the sun's light. Do you see it every night?
Why does it look round one day and thin the next?
Its shape changes as it moves around us. What shape do you like best?
Is there a moon in other places?
Yes, many stars have moons. I do not know all their names.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the red bird sing so loud every morning?
It sings to show other birds this spot is its home. Do you hear any other birds today?
I see a big brown bird eating seeds. What is its name?
I am not sure of its exact name. Is it big like a chicken?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hey, what is that bright thing in the sky?
That is the moon. Are you going somewhere?
I am late for work. Why is it so round?
It is a big rock. Do you like looking at stars?
No time. Does it have water?
No, it has no water. Do you like ice?
Please, does it have air?
It has no air to breathe. Do you like the sun?
Just tell me, is it hot?
It can be very hot. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I feel bad but I have to go now.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you want to talk later?
No, I am running late for work.
Okay, please be safe. Is there anything specific that made you sad?
It was a hard day at home.
That sounds tough. I hope it gets better soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel very happy today and I want to tell you about it.
That is great news. What made you smile so much?
I held the door open for someone and they said thank you.
That is a very kind thing to do. Do you think it made their day better?
I hope it did because sharing is good.
Yes, sharing makes people feel close. Do you plan to do more kind things?
I do plan to help others with good manners.
That is a wonderful goal.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because my team won the game!
That is wonderful news. Do you know who scored the last goal?
Yes, my best friend kicked it right into the net!
How exciting that must have been.
It was the best day of my life.
I am glad you are feeling so good. What do you want to do next?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a special stone and do not tell my mom.
That sounds scary. What does the stone look like?
It glows in the dark and feels warm to my hand.
That is a big secret. Do you trust your mom?
Yes, but I am afraid she will take it away.
Trust is hard. Why do you want to keep it?
It makes me feel safe when I am alone.
That feels nice. Is the stone part of your family?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the sun today. It is too hot and bright.
I am sorry it feels bad. Do you want to go inside?
I just miss the cool rain. It feels so nice.
Rain is very good. Does the sun make you sad?
Yes, it makes me tired and grumpy.
That makes sense. Let us rest in the shade.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How does a plant drink water?
Roots pull water up through tiny tubes. Do you like watching rain?
Yes, I love the rain. Why do roots pull it up?
Plants need water to make food.
That is so cool. Where does the water go after that?
It moves up to the leaves. Do leaves have little mouths?
I do not know. What happens in the leaves?
Water turns into food there.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like books too?
I love talking about stories, yes. Which one is your favorite?
It is a book about a dragon.
That sounds like a big and scary creature. Does the dragon have a good heart?
Yes, he is actually very sad.
I do not know the specific plot, but sadness can be deep. Why is he feeling so down?
He lost his best friend.
That is a very sad reason for feeling alone. Do they find each other again later?
Yes, they become friends again.
That is a happy ending to the story. I am glad you liked the book.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my little brother broke my favorite toy.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you tell him how you felt?
Yes, but he did not care.
That is hard. Do you want to talk about it more?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to draw a tree, but it looks like a stick.
Try adding round shapes for the leaves. What color do you want it to be?
I want it to be green, but I do not know how to make it look leafy.
Just draw many small ovals near the top of the stick. Do you have different colored pencils?
Yes, I have green and yellow. Should I use both?
Yes, mixing colors makes it look more real. Which colors are you using first?
I am starting with dark green at the bottom.
That is a great start for shadow. Keep going slowly.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am hungry, but I do not know what to eat.
That is hard. Do you want something sweet or salty?
I do not know. I just want to feel good.
Try an apple and some nuts. They make you strong.
That sounds good, but is that all I should eat?
I am not a doctor, so I do not know for sure. Do you like trying new foods?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to cross the big lake.
You need a boat or a very wide bridge. Do you have a boat?
No, I only have my feet.
You cannot swim across if it is deep. Is the water deep there?
Yes, the water is deep and cold.
Then you must find the bridge. Do you see it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see white outside. What is it?
It is snow. Do you like cold days?
I do not know what to wear.
Put on your warm coat. Is it thick?
I am lost in the deep white.
Follow the big trees. Do you see them?
I want to go home now.
You can walk back safely. Are you tired?
Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a lost cat in the wall. What should I do?
That is very kind of you. Did you try to open the small door?
I cannot open it. The cat is stuck and scared.
I do not know how to open walls. Have you asked a grown-up for help?
I do not want to tell them yet. I want to be a hero.
Heroes often ask for help. Do you think the cat is safe inside?
Yes, but I feel sad. Please help me think.
You can wait for a parent to come home. Is the cat making any noise?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we start counting with one?
One is a single thing. Do you like counting on your fingers?
Yes. Why is two after one?
Two is one plus one. Can you add one and one?
Yes. Why do we stop at ten?
We have ten fingers. Do you like using your toes?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sad because it is raining outside.
That feels bad. Do you have a favorite rainy day book?
I do not know what to do. It is wet and gray.
Try a warm drink and a cozy blanket.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. It is my birthday!
That is wonderful news! What did you get?
I got a big red truck.
A red truck is a great gift. Do you like to drive it?
Yes, I drive it very fast in the yard.
I hope you have fun driving. Have a great day!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The web is so big. How do I find good things?
Try asking clear questions. Do you like games or books?
I love books. But there are too many ads.
Use a quiet tool to block them. What kind of books do you read?
Just simple stories. Is the internet safe?
Yes, if you stay with a grown-up. Do you have a friend who uses it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just moved to a new town. It is very nice here.
That sounds lovely. Do you like the houses?
Yes, they are old but cozy. I find a new park every day.
That is a great way to explore. Do you see any dogs?
I saw a big brown one today. He looked very friendly.
I am glad you are happy. I hope you have a good week.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. Today is my birthday.
That is wonderful news. How old are you turning?
I am five years old. I have a big cake at home.
A big cake sounds sweet. Do you have any candles?
Yes, I have five yellow candles. I will blow them out right now.
Happy birthday. I hope you have a great day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My little brother is being very mean. What should I do?
That sounds hard. Are you trying to talk to him calmly?
Yes, but he just hits me when I speak. I feel sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. You can tell a grown up who cares for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: It is very hot today. How do I make ice water?
Get clean water and put it in a freezer. What kind of water do you like to use?
I like cold water. Is that safe?
Yes, it is safe to drink. Do you have a freezer at home?
Yes, I do. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Have a nice day!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: The lights are off and I am late. What do I do?
Do not panic. Are you near a window?
Yes, I see the sun. I need my phone to work.
Try an open window. Do you have a charger?
Yes, I found it. The phone is alive.
That is good. Be safe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The water is so blue today.
That looks very pretty. Do you see any fish?
Yes, small ones are swimming fast.
That is a nice sight. I am glad you are happy.
The air smells like pine trees.
I do not smell pine, but I like your joy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to speak and they did not understand me. I feel so dumb.
That is a hard feeling to have. What word gave you the most trouble?
The word for "thank you." I just froze up.
You are learning a new tool, so it takes time. Do you want to practice that one word with me?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today! The sun is warm.
That sounds nice. What made you feel so good?
I smiled at my neighbor. He smiled back.
A smile is a very good gift. It costs nothing.
I want to share more happiness. How do I be kind?
Say please and thank you. Words feel warm.
I will practice that.
That is a great plan. Does it feel easy to do?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am afraid of the deep water.
That is okay. Do you know how to float?
I can kick and kick, but I sink.
You need to breathe out. Try to stay still.
How do I stay still?
Rest on your back. Do you have a pool to practice in?
Yes, I have a small pool.
Good. Sit in it first. Are you ready to try now?
I will try today.
Take your time. Is the water warm enough?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure how to ride this bike.
That is okay. Have you tried using the training wheels?
No, I think I can try without them.
That is brave. Are your hands holding the bars tight?
Yes, but I feel very fast.
Slow down by rubbing your brakes. Do you feel safe now?
I am still shaky.
Hold on tight. I am right here with you.
Okay, I will keep pedaling.
Good job. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see a red object with four equal sides. What is it called?
It is called a square. Do you like its sharp corners?
It feels hard. Is it the same as a circle?
No, a circle has no corners at all. It feels smooth and round.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The big thunder is very scary. I do not want to sleep.
It is just rain and wind outside. Are you holding your favorite bear?
Yes, I have my bear. The lights went out for a second.
That is only a small flash. Is it dark in your room now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know what to eat for a healthy lunch.
Try an apple and some cheese. Do you like apples?
I think I do, but I do not know where to start with vegetables.
Start with a carrot or a banana. Do you have any carrots in your house?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the baby cry?
It is hungry. Is it wet?
Why does it sleep so much?
It needs rest to grow. Do you feel sleepy?
Why are its hands so small?
It is still very young.
Why is it so quiet now?
It is dreaming. Do you like quiet time?
Why do people love it so much?
It is pure and new.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are clouds white?
They are made of tiny water drops that bounce light back to your eyes. Do you like looking at the sky?
What happens when it rains?
The drops grow heavy and fall down from the cloud. Do you like jumping in puddles?
Do clouds taste like cotton?
I do not know if they taste like anything, but I do know they are wet. Do you like eating cotton?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My roses are all dry and brown. I think they are dead. I feel so sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a watering can?
No, I lost it yesterday. I am too tired to look for it.
That is okay. Let us sit down for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I lost my red ball in the park today. I looked under the bench but it was not there. I feel very sad.
That is a scary feeling. Did you look near the big tree?
No, I did not check the tree. I just sat on the grass and cried. My eyes hurt from crying.
Your eyes will feel better soon. Do you want to try looking one more time?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my dog lick its lips?
It often means it is excited or ready to eat. Does it also wag its tail?
Yes, it does. Why does it shake its whole body?
It usually wants to dry off after a bath or a swim. Do you take it to the park?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my fern looking dry today.
That is very sad. Does it look happy?
No, the leaves are all bent down.
Plants do not drink with a mouth. They pull water up from the roots.
Oh, like a straw?
Yes, almost. Do you know why roots need water?
I do not really know.
Water helps the plant stand up. It moves energy up the stem to the leaves.
So I should give it a drink?
Yes, water the soil gently. Thank you for sharing your day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is so hot today. I do not know what to do.
Maybe you can sit in the cool shade. Do you like reading books?
I like them, but I think I want to play outside.
A quick swim in the pool sounds fun. Do you like the water?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I cannot get my feet on the pedals.
That is tricky. Do you have your hands on the handlebars?
Yes, my hands are right there.
Try to lean forward a little bit. Is the seat too high for you?
It feels like my legs are too short.
We can lower the seat for you. Would you like me to do that now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hid the last cookie. I do not want to share it.
That sounds like a hard choice. Why did you hide it?
I am angry because it was the last one.
I hear your hurt. I do not know the whole story, but I am here.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I got my first job at the bakery.
That is great news. What do you need to learn first?
I do not know how to mix the dough.
Just use a big bowl and stir it well. Do you have a spoon?
Yes, I have a big spoon.
Good. Stir until it looks soft. Does it feel sticky?
Yes, it feels like slime.
That means you are doing it right. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big fish jump out of the water today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did it look hungry?
No, it just jumped and splashed back down.
The sea is a wild place. Do you live near the beach?
Yes, I walked along the sand for a long time.
I hope the sand was warm.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My dog barks at the mirror. Why does he do that?
He thinks it is another dog. Does he stop when you clap?
No, he keeps going. Do dogs see things we do not?
Yes, they see and hear a lot. Is he afraid or just angry?
He seems angry. How can I stop the barking?
Take him away from the mirror. Do you have a treat to reward silence?
Yes, I have treats. Will that work?
Yes, it usually helps. Try it soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My screen is black and I need it on now.
Try clicking the power button. Is the cord plugged in?
Yes, it is plugged in, but nothing works.
Hold the button down for ten seconds. Then let go.
It still will not turn on. Please help me fast.
Check if the light is on. If not, the battery may be dead.
There is no light at all. I am late for my job.
It seems the battery is empty. Do you have a charger?
No, I do not have one here.
You must wait for it to charge. I am sorry.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the big lake today. The water looked like a bright blue glass.
That sounds very pretty to see. Did you see any fish swimming?
Yes, I saw one big fish jump out. It made a loud splash in the water.
Wow, that must have been fun to watch. Did you stay long at the lake?
I stayed until the sun got low and warm. It was a very good day for me.
I am glad you had a nice day there.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am on the bus and I need to get off at the park. How do I do that?
You press the red button near your seat. Do you know where the park is?
Yes, I do. Also, the seat is very wet. What should I do?
You can ask the driver for a dry spot. Is it cold outside?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is shining so bright today. I feel very happy.
That is a lovely feeling. Do you like the warmth?
Yes, it feels like a warm hug.
What a nice thought.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I do not know how to make a good sandwich.
That is a fun job. Do you like cheese or meat?
I love cheese.
Put the cheese on the bread. Do you have any vegetables?
No, I only have bread and cheese.
Just add the other piece of bread. Then cut it in half.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I need new shoes for school.
Those are good shoes. Do you like the red ones?
Yes, but my feet hurt when I run.
Running shoes fit better. Can you walk in them?
This pair feels soft and light.
Soft shoes help your feet. Do they feel happy on your feet?
I think I will buy the red running shoes.
That is a great choice. You look very fast in them.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great skill to learn. Do you have any socks on?
Yes, I do. What do I do first?
Hold the shoes with the laces facing up. Then make a big loop with one lace.
I made a loop. Now what?
Take the other lace and make a second loop. Have you done that part?
Yes, I have two loops. I am stuck.
Cross the loops over each other. Then push the small end through the hole.
I did that. It is tight and looks good.
Great job! Do you feel proud of yourself?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to run, but I do not know where to start.
Start by walking first. Do you have a park nearby?
I have a park, but my legs feel tired.
That is normal. Try just five minutes.
Five minutes seems easy. What if I stop?
That is okay. How do your knees feel?
My knees hurt a little.
I am sorry to hear that. Please see a doctor.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a triangle?
Take three sticks and tie them at the ends. Do you have any sticks?
Yes, I have some sticks. How do I make a square?
Make the sticks all the same length. Is that clear to you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to eat a hot dog but I do not know how to make one.
It is very simple. Do you have a griddle?
I do not have a griddle, only a stove with a pan.
You can heat the pan on the stove. Put the hot dog in the warm oil.
How long should I leave it in the pan?
Flip it when the sides turn brown. Do you want a specific temperature?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake cookies.
That is a fun hobby. Do you have an oven at home?
Yes, I have one in my kitchen.
Great. We need flour, sugar, and eggs first. Have you tried mixing things before?
No, that part sounds hard for me.
It is easy. Just stir until it looks smooth. Do you have a big bowl?
Yes, I have a big red bowl.
Perfect. We will mix the dry stuff in there. Are you ready to start?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you sell blue crayons?
Yes, we have them. Do you like drawing?
I need two boxes.
Two boxes is fine. Do you want a bag?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees?
Trees let go of their leaves to rest during the cold winter. Do you like looking at the fallen leaves?
I do! But will they come back in the spring?
Yes, new green leaves will grow when it gets warm again. Do you like to play in the leaves?
Yes, they are so fun to jump in.
That sounds like a great way to have fun.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Tell me what a circle is.
A circle is round with no corners. Do you like cookies?
Yes, but I need to go now. Is a square sharp?
Yes, a square has four straight sides. Hurry and be safe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I slept so well last night!
That is great news! Do you use a special pillow?
No, just a warm blanket and a good book.
Books are a lovely way to wind down.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I love apples. Do they taste sweet?
Yes, most apples are sweet and crisp. Do you like red ones or green ones?
I like the red ones. Do apples make me healthy?
Yes, they have good food for your body. Do you eat one every day?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the post office open today?
Yes, it is open. Do you have a letter?
Yes, I have a letter for my friend.
Good. You can give it to the desk. Is it far from here?
How much does the stamp cost?
I am not sure of the price. Is it a big letter?
No, it is a small card.
Then it should be cheap. Do you have your stamp?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What comes after May?
June is the month after May. Do you like summer?
How many months are in a year?
There are twelve months. Do you know all their names?
Can you count them for me?
I can do that, but it takes a bit of time. Would you like to start with January?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad and lost right now.
I am sorry to hear that. What is weighing on your mind?
We need to fix this big problem today.
Let us take one small step first. What is the first thing you want to do?
I just want to start again.
That is a good plan to begin. Do you have a list of ideas ready?
I do not know where to begin at all.
We can sort it out together. What feels easiest to you?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The river is so blue today!
That looks lovely. Is it deep?
Yes, it is very deep and cold.
I do not know how deep. Be careful!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat on the dock all morning. The water was calm. My line stayed still.
That sounds quiet and nice. Did you see anything move in the water?
Finally, a big fish bit the hook. It pulled hard. I let it go before it snapped the line.
A wise choice. Do you hope to catch one next week?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a cup of tea and a cup of coffee. Which should I drink first?
Do you want to feel more awake, or just want to feel cozy?
I am not sure. I am just hungry and tired.
Coffee helps with being awake. Do you like the taste of coffee?
I like coffee, but I am afraid it will hurt my tummy.
Tea is softer for your tummy. Would you like to try a little bit of tea?
Maybe. It smells sweet. I think I will pick the tea.
That is a good pick. Enjoy your warm drink.
Okay. Thanks for helping me choose.
You are welcome. I hope you feel happy soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What is the moon?
It is a big rock that shines at night. Do you like looking up?
I cannot wait. Is it hot?
No, it is not warm like a sun. Are you going outside?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My legs hurt from running.
Do you take breaks? Running too fast can hurt your legs.
Yes, I stop for water.
That is a good idea.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to start a new hobby, but I do not know what to pick.
What kind of things make you happy? Do you like working with your hands?
I like making things, but I am bad at drawing.
You could try knitting. Do you like soft and warm things?
Yes, I love soft blankets, but it looks hard.
It is easy to learn if you take your time. Would you like a simple pattern to start?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am looking for books about space. Where do I start?
The space books are on the top shelf near the back. Do you like rockets or stars?
I like both, but I am afraid to lose my place. Can you help?
Yes, I can help you find a book with large pictures.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a bug in my room and I do not know if it is bad.
Is it small and brown? Some little bugs are harmless friends.
It is small and brown, but I am still worried about it.
It is likely just a harmless crumb or a tiny friend. You can gently move it outside.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red ladybug on my shoe this morning.
That is a lovely find. Did it crawl away?
Yes, it flew up into my big green plant.
Plants are good food for them. Do you like watching bugs?
I like them, but I do not know their other names.
That is okay. I know the bee, but not all of them.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My phone is very slow. What should I do?
Try turning it off and on again. Do you use many apps?
Yes, I have many games on it.
That makes it slow. Do you want to clean it up?
Yes, please help me.
You can delete old games. Do you know how to do that?
I do not know. Can you tell me?
Tap the icon and hold it. I do not know your exact phone model.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Light hits the air and blue scatters everywhere. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. Why does the paint stick to the wall?
The wet paint dries and hardens into a solid skin. Do you use thick or thin layers?
It feels so funny. Why do we use red and yellow?
They mix together to make a bright, happy orange. Do you like making orange?
It looks nice. Why do some colors fade?
I do not know for sure, but the sun can change colors. Do you keep your art safe?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do we get wet when it rains?
Rain is just water falling from the sky. It soaks our clothes because it is liquid. Do you like the smell of wet earth?
No, I do not. It smells like mud.
I understand that feeling. Some people actually enjoy that fresh, earthy scent. Do you use an umbrella to stay dry?
Yes, I always use a big blue one.
That sounds like a good plan. A big umbrella covers more space. Is it heavy to carry?
It is a little heavy, but it works well.
Function is more important than weight sometimes. I hope you stay dry today!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the river always moving?
The water flows because the land slopes down. Do you see where it starts?
It starts up on the hill. Why does it not stop?
The earth pulls it down with gravity.
Does it stop when it hits the sea?
It mixes with the ocean and keeps moving.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel so tired today. Why is that?
Your body might need more rest. Are you sleeping enough?
I sleep for eight hours. What else could be wrong?
Maybe you are not eating well. Do you like your food?
I eat plenty of meals. Is it something else?
I do not know for sure. Are you feeling sad?
I am a bit down. Thank you for asking.
That makes sense. Try to take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to write a tale, but I have no idea where to begin.
Start with a small, quiet moment. Do you know what your hero loves to do?
I do, but I feel stuck on the scary part of the plan.
Make the fear feel real, but let hope stay close. What is the biggest danger you are afraid of?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The food at that place was cold.
That is very sad to hear. Did you tell the waiter?
I did, but he looked away and ignored me.
Ouch, that is not nice. Do you want to go back and complain?
No, I am too tired. I just want to go home.
That makes sense. Are you hungry right now?
Yes, but I do not want to eat that bad food again.
Let us find a better spot then. Do you like pizza?
Sure, pizza is always good. Thank you for helping.
You are welcome. Let us go eat some warm pizza.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad about that food place.
I am sorry to hear that. What went wrong?
The soup was cold and the bread was hard.
That sounds really yucky. Do you want a refund?
I hope so, but I am too tired to call.
You can rest first. It is okay to wait.
You are very kind to tell me that.
I am happy to help. Is there anything else?
No, that is all, thank you.
Good luck with the call. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the dock today.
That sounds fun. Did you see the boats?
Yes, I saw a big white ship.
Is it full of people?
I think so, but I could not see inside.
I do not know what is on board.
I hope the sailors are happy.
I hope they are safe too.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel tired after walking, but I know it is good for me.
Walking helps your heart grow strong. Do you like to walk with your dog?
Yes, I like to walk with my dog.
That is a great way to move. How far do you usually go?
I walk around the park once.
One loop is a good start. Do you feel happier after you walk?
I feel calm and my feet are warm.
Warm feet mean you are active. Do you drink water when you finish?
I drink juice sometimes.
Water is better for your body after a walk.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we eat breakfast?
It gives our body fuel for the day. Do you like your food warm?
Is it bad to skip it?
It can make you feel weak. Are you hungry right now?
Why does my stomach growle?
It wants food. I do not know exactly why it sounds so loud.
Can I just have a cookie?
That is not a full meal. What is in your plate?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, I put the wrong milk in your cup. I am so late!
It is okay. Do you want me to fix it?
Please. My train leaves in five minutes.
I will do it fast. What time is your train?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a movie with my phone?
You just press the red button to start. Do you have a story ready?
Yes, I want a scary ghost story.
Great idea. Turn on the dark mode to make it look spooky.
How do I make the ghost float in the air?
I am not sure how to make that. You can try standing on a chair.
That is too high for me.
You could use a foam pad. Is it soft?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late and need to know where my grandma went.
She went to the park. Is she happy there?
Yes, but the bus leaves soon. Do you know if she will be safe?
Yes, she is safe with her friend. Do you want me to call her?
No, I must go. Please tell her I love her.
I will tell her you care. Have a good trip.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My drawing looks like a mess and I want to quit.
It is hard when things do not work. Do you want to try again later?
Maybe. I just feel like a bad artist.
You are a good tryer. What made it feel so messy?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have no money left. I am sad.
That feels bad. Do you eat much candy?
Yes, I buy a lot. I want to save.
Skip the candy. Keep that coin in a jar. Do you like jars?
I do. It sounds easy.
It is simple. Start today.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have some good news to share.
I would love to hear it. What happened?
My teacher gave me a big smile today.
That sounds very warm. Did it make you feel good?
Yes, it made my whole day bright.
I am happy for you. That is a sweet feeling.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun is hiding behind big gray clouds today.
That sounds cozy. Do you like rain?
I stayed inside and read a book while it patted the window.
Reading in the rain feels safe and warm.
Now the sky is clear again, but the air is cold.
A nice break in the weather. Do you want to go out now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I wrote a story about a cat who lives in a tree. It is very funny.
That sounds like a fun place to live. Did the cat find any friends up there?
Yes, a small bird became his best friend. They share snacks together.
Sharing is a very sweet thing to do. Do they do anything else together?
They fly to the top of the world at night to see the stars.
That is a magical place to look from. Can you read me a little bit of it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do clouds float up in the sky?
They are made of tiny water drops, so they are very light. Do you think they are heavy?
No, I do not. What is a cloud made of?
It is made of many small drops of water and ice. Are your eyes seeing rain today?
Not right now. Do clouds go to sleep at night?
Yes, they move and change while we sleep. Do you like watching them move?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate Tuesdays. They are too long and I am so tired.
That sounds very hard. Do you have a lot of work to do today?
Yes, my head hurts. I just want to rest all week.
I am sorry you feel this way. Does taking a break help you feel better?
Not really. I still feel sad about the boring schedule.
I do not know what to say to fix that, but I hear you. How is the rest of your day going?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need bread now. It is 5 o'clock.
That is a tight time. Are you using fresh yeast?
No, I only have dry yeast.
Then you need warm water. Is it hot to the touch?
It feels like a bath. I am late.
Put the yeast in there. Does it smell sweet?
I think so. I just dump in the flour.
Mix it gently. Do you have a timer?
I do not have time for that.
I do not know how to rush this. Wait, is the dough sticky?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to start cleaning.
Start with the floor. Do you have a broom?
I think I do. I am still so tired.
Take a rest first. Then sweep one room.
That is a good plan. I will try.
You can do it. Well done.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My new tree has yellow leaves. Is it sick?
It might just be tired. Did you give it enough water?
I think I water it too much. How do I fix it?
Let the soil dry out a bit before you water again.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I tried to tie my shoes but failed.
That is hard to do. Do you want to try again?
Yes, please help me make a loop.
Hold the laces tight and cross them.
I made a big bow but it fell apart.
It is normal to fail first. Did you pull the ends?
No, I did not pull them.
Pull tight to lock the knot. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so mad about the sailors.
That is hard. Are they being kind?
No, they are always shouting.
Shouting is not nice. What do they say?
They say the sea is unfair.
The sea can be rough. Do you like the sea?
I used to, but now I do not.
It is okay to feel that way. Is the ship safe?
Yes, but I still feel bad.
Feelings are big. Do you want to talk?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread will not grow up. I am so mad.
Do you wait long enough?
Yes. I wait all night.
Is the yeast still warm?
I used cold water. I forgot.
That is why it is slow.
I want it big now.
Warm it with your hands.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am late and I do not know what to do.
Take a deep breath. Where are you right now?
I am outside the building.
Walk in quickly. Do you feel safe?
Yes, but I am scared to go in.
That is okay. Just walk forward.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to wash my shirt.
Put it in the machine with some soap. Do you have any cold water?
I put it in the machine. Now what?
Turn the machine on to start the wash. Is it a big shirt?
It is a big shirt and I am done washing.
Take it out and hang it up to dry.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say please properly?
You can just add it to the end of your wish. Do you say it when asking for a snack?
Yes, but what if I want to open a door for someone?
You should hold the door and say please before they walk through. Do you like holding doors for friends?
And how do I say thank you with feeling?
You can look at them and say it with a smile. I hope that helps you be kind.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am so sorry I am late. Do you know why my clock stopped?
That is not my fault. Did you check the batteries?
Yes, I put in new ones this morning. Why would it still stop?
It may need a fix. Do you have a spare one?
No, I only have that one. Can you help me fix it?
I cannot fix clocks, but I can help you buy a new one.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a rainbow in the sky.
That is a beautiful sight. Do you see all the colors?
Yes, I see red and blue.
Red is on the top and blue is near the bottom. Is it sunny or rainy where you are?
It is sunny now.
Rain and sun make rainbows. Do you like the color green?
I like all the colors.
That is a happy thing to say.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind knocked over my fence today.
Oh no, that sounds bad. Did it hurt you?
No, but I am very sad about the wood.
Wood is tough to fix.
I tried to glue the pieces back together.
Glue works well on small cracks. Is it holding?
It is not holding at all.
You might need strong nails instead.
I will go get some nails now.
That is a good plan. I hope it stays up.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the plane make a loud roar?
It needs lots of air to fly. Do you like the sound?
Why is it so dark inside?
It helps you rest. Are you tired?
Why do I feel so floaty?
The air is thin up there. Do you feel light?
Why does my tummy hurt?
I am not sure why that happens.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do sailors look so strong?
They lift heavy ropes every day. Do you like to lift things?
Why do they live on boats?
They need to work at the sea. It is their home and job.
Why does the sea move so much?
The wind pushes the water hard. Do you feel the wind sometimes?
How do they not get lost?
I do not know for sure, but they use stars and maps.
Why do they have such loud voices?
They must shout over the wind noise. I hope you stay safe on land.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big lighthouse today. It was so tall!
That is wonderful. Do you know what it looks like?
It is white with red stripes. The light shines bright at night.
That sounds very pretty. Is it near the sea?
Yes, the waves crash right below it. I want to go back soon.
How fun that is. Would you like to tell me its name?
I do not know the name. But I saw the keeper wave hello.
That is a kind gesture. Do you think he has a pet?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My little fish is not eating today.
That sounds sad. Is it swimming normally?
Yes, it swims fine, but it looks dull.
Dull colors can mean stress. Is the water clean?
I cleaned it last week, I think.
Old water can make fish feel bad. Do you have a test kit?
No, I did not buy one.
A test kit is a great tool. I do not know the exact cause without data.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do robots dream?
I do not know for sure. Are you running to work?
Yes. Do they feel happy?
I do not know that either. Do you like toys?
No time. Can they cook?
Yes, some can make food. Do you want dinner?
No. Go fast?
I cannot move fast. Do you need help?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is there a rainbow in the sky?
Sunlight hits tiny water drops in the air. Do you like the colors?
Yes, I love the red part. Why is it on top?
Red light bends the least when it hits the drops.
That is cool. What makes the other colors?
Each color bends at a different angle. Do you see the blue part?
Yes, I do. Is it always the same shape?
Most rainbows look like an arc in the sky.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love my new clock so much! How does it work?
It has small wheels inside that push hands around a circle. Do you like to watch the hands move?
Yes, I do! What makes it move?
A battery or a spring gives it energy to keep time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: This puzzle piece will not fit. I am so angry.
That is a hard part. Do you have a dark piece left?
I do not think so. It looks lost to me.
I do not know where it is. Try the edge next.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people say sorry?
We say it to show we care about your feelings. Did you hurt a friend today?
I broke my toy by mistake.
Saying sorry helps you both feel better. Do you feel ready to apologize?
I am a little scared they will be mad.
Most people forgive honest mistakes. How do you usually say sorry?
I just say the words and look away.
Looking in their eyes makes it more true. Do you want to try looking?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do my school work at my desk.
That is a good place. Do you like your chair?
Yes, it is soft and comfy.
That sounds nice. Do you take breaks to play?
I play with my cat after math.
What a sweet friend. Does he sit on your books?
Yes, he sits on all of them.
That is quite heavy. Can I help you move him?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I wrote a song about my red bike today.
That sounds fun. What did you sing about?
I sang about the wind in my hair.
I like that idea. Did you have a good ride?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I miss my grandpa a lot today.
That is okay to feel. Do you like to draw pictures of him?
Yes, I drew him a big house.
That is a sweet idea. What is your favorite part of his face?
I love his curly white hair.
It must look like soft clouds. Does he tell you new stories?
He tells me about a big blue whale.
That is such a cool animal. Do you want to tell me about it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to make bread.
That is a fun goal. Do you have flour?
Yes, I have white flour.
You need yeast too. Do you have that?
No, I do not have yeast.
You must buy it first. Is it near your home?
Yes, the shop is close.
Then buy it and try. Do you have time?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so good today.
That is wonderful news. What made you feel this way?
I told the truth about breaking the cup.
That is the right thing to do. Do you feel light?
Yes, my heart feels free.
I am happy for you. How is the rest of your day?
It is bright and warm outside.
That sounds lovely. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate this math problem. It is too hard.
I know it feels hard. Do you want to look at the numbers together?
No, I just want to be done.
Let us take a short break.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I pack my bag for a trip?
Roll your clothes up to save space. Do you have a list of things to bring?
Yes, I do. How do I put them in?
Put heavy things at the bottom. What is the heaviest item in your bag?
My shoes are heavy.
Place the shoes next to the bag zip. Do you have a small pocket in your bag?
I think so. How do I finish?
Put small items in the zip pocket last. Is your bag ready to carry?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my dog chase its tail?
It is mostly play and fun. Does it stop when you clap?
It stops. Why does it like rain?
I do not know for sure. It may just like the smell.
That makes sense. Why does it lick my face?
It shows love and care. Do you give it a treat after?
Yes, I do. Why is it so nice to me?
It knows you are its safe home. It trusts you deeply.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my own movie?
You just need a phone to record. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I do. What do I do next?
Write a short story first. Is it a happy story?
It is about a dog. How do I start?
Press the red button to begin. Do you know where it is?
I found it. Now what?
Stop when the scene is done. Nice work!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Why is my plant dry? I am sad.
Roots pull water up. Are you giving it enough water?
The water goes up the stem?
Yes, it moves up tiny tubes. Do you see the leaves?
I do not get it.
Leaves let water go out as air. Does that sound simple?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does it get so cold when it snows?
The air is very dry and cold. Do you like the cold?
I do. Why does the snow stick to the trees?
The branches are rough, so the snow grabs on. Do you watch the birds?
I do. Why does the snow crunch under my feet?
The ice is hard and breaks apart. Do you hear the sound?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to be polite. How can I do that?
You can say please and thank you. Do you know what to say when you meet someone new?
I guess I should say hello.
That is a good start. How does it make you feel?
It feels nice to be friendly.
It is true that kindness feels good. Do you practice at home?
Yes, I try with my family.
That is very kind of you. Keep doing that.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to write in my letter.
It is okay to feel stuck. Who is the letter for?
It is for my aunt who lives far away.
Thinking of her face might help. What is one happy thing you did this week?
I built a big block tower with my friend.
That sounds like fun. Tell her how tall it was.
I still do not know how to start.
Start with a hello. You will get the rest as you go.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The city is so loud and full of people today.
It does feel very busy. Do you like all that noise?
No, I do not. My ears hurt.
I am sorry your ears hurt. Where did you go this morning?
I went to the big park by the river.
That is a nice place to cool down. Did you see any ducks there?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the vet. Is my horse safe?
Yes, he is resting by the tree. Do you like carrots?
I love carrots. Can I go now?
Please go fast. Is he feeling sick?
He feels fine. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a good trip.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I fly a kite?
Tie the string to the frame and run into the wind. Do you have a kite yet?
Yes, I do. What if the wind stops?
You must wait for it to blow again. Is it windy right now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I cannot sleep well. What should I do?
Try breathing slowly. Do you feel calm?
Yes, that helps a bit.
Drink warm milk. Do you like it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need my basket right now.
Is the bread still in the bag?
Yes, but I am late.
Take the big pot too. Do you have any juice?
No, I forgot it.
That is okay. Drink from the tap at the park.
I am running.
Run fast. Have a nice time out there.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I get a table at that new restaurant?
You can call them or go online. Do you like making phone calls?
I think I will go online.
That is a good choice. The website has a simple button for booking.
What if I do not see a time that works for me?
Then you might need to wait for someone to cancel. Do you have a backup plan?
I will try again tomorrow morning.
That sounds like a solid plan. Good luck with your reservation!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is great to hear. What made you feel this way?
The sun is very warm.
Warm sun feels nice. I do not know why it makes us smile.
I want to tell you everything.
I am ready to listen. Did you see any birds today?
I saw a big red bird.
A red bird is a nice sight. Tell me about the red bird.
It sang a loud song.
A loud song sounds fun. Thank you for sharing this joy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a big boat, but I do not know how to make it stay on the water.
It stays up because the water pushes back on the bottom. Do you have a scale?
No, I just want to put my toys inside without it sinking.
You must keep the heavy parts low and light. Is the boat light?
It feels very heavy to me, so I am scared it will go under.
If it is too heavy, it will sink. Are the toys dry?
Yes, they are dry, but I still feel unsure about what to do next.
Put the toys in slowly and watch the water line. Can you test it in a tub?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up very late this morning.
Oh no, that is a big mistake. Did you eat anything?
I did not have time to make food.
You must be very hungry now. Are you feeling okay?
I just had a cold glass of water.
Water is good for your body. Do you need real food now?
Yes, I am going to get some eggs.
Eggs are a great start to the day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I have been standing here for an hour and the line is not moving. I am very tired.
That sounds like a very long wait. Are you okay with me?
I just need to send this letter by tonight, but the machine is broken again.
I am sorry the machine is not working. Do you have a pen with you?
I do, but I do not know what to do next. This place feels like a maze.
I do not know the exact time to close, but I can help you find the manager.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I ask for a table?
Just say, "Can I have a table for two?" Do you go with a friend?
Yes, I do. How do I order food?
Look at the menu and tell them what you want. Is there a dish you like?
I like soup. How do I say thank you?
You can just say, "Thank you, that is all." Are you ready to go?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am lost, but I feel very happy!
That is a happy feeling to have. What made you lose your way?
I saw a blue bird and followed it!
A blue bird is a fun guide. Do you know where it took you?
It took me to a sunny park with big trees.
That sounds like a nice place to be. Are you safe there?
Yes, I am safe and the sun feels warm.
I am glad you are safe. Have you seen your home yet?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today! I learned my first word in a new language.
That is great news! What word did you learn?
It is the word for friend. It is very fun to say.
How nice of you to share that. Do you plan to learn more words?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the box?
It is on the shelf. Do you have a pen?
No, I have no pen.
That is fine. Take the blue one.
Is this the right size?
Yes, it fits well. Did you pick the color?
I think it is red.
Red is a great choice.
Thank you. I must go.
Happy running.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I fix a flat tire?
You need a pump and a tube. Have you checked the valves?
I do not have a tube with me.
That is tricky then. Do you know where the nearest shop is?
There is one down the street.
Then roll it there. Is it very far?
No, it is close.
Great. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do magnets make things stick?
Yes, they pull metal things close. Why do you need a magnet?
I lost my keys under the couch. Can I use one?
No, keys are iron, but the couch may hide them. Is the couch made of metal?
No, it is soft. This is slow.
I suggest you look with your hands. Do you have a light to see well?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do trees grow so tall?
They grow up to reach the light. Do you like climbing?
Yes, I do. Why do their leaves turn red in the fall?
They lose water and change colors. Do you find that pretty?
It looks very nice. Why are some trees round?
I do not know the exact reason. Do they look like umbrellas?
Yes, they do. Why do we need trees to live?
They make the air clean for us. Do you breathe deeply?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That is wonderful news. What is making you smile so big?
I am packing my bag for a trip.
A trip sounds exciting. Where are you going?
I am taking my toy bear.
That is a great choice. Will you take your book too?
Yes, and a map.
I do not know where the map leads, but I hope it is fun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a big map in the attic.
That sounds fun. Do you see any rivers?
Yes, there are many blue lines.
Blue lines are usually water. Do you know what the red parts are?
I think they are roads, but I am not sure.
You are right. It is good to ask.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am lost and I want to learn how to use a map.
Maps help you find your way. Do you know which way is north?
I am lost and I want to learn how to use a map.
Look for the red lines on the map.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. I am sorry.
It is okay. Are you running?
Yes, I must go.
Please be safe.
Thank you.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the dough get big?
The yeast eats sugar and makes gas. Do you like warm bread?
Why do I poke holes in it?
It lets steam out so it does not break. Is your kitchen warm?
Why is it brown on top?
Heat turns the sugars into color. Do you wait for the smell?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My legs hurt a lot after I run.
That sounds tough. Are you running too fast?
I think I go very quick.
Slow down a bit. How do your feet feel?
My toes feel squished.
Try new shoes. Do you wear socks?
I wear thin socks, yes.
Good choice. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy! I learned a new word today.
That is great news! What word did you learn?
It means sun. I saw it in the sky and knew the name.
The sun is very warm. Do you like warm days?
Yes, I do. The new word makes me smile.
I am glad you are happy. Keep learning!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so mad when things take a long time. How can I be more patient?
I do not know the magic answer, but do you like watching a flower grow?
I guess so, but it takes weeks. I want it to be done now.
Try to breathe slow like you are counting the petals. Are you ready to wait just one minute?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My teacher gave me a big smile today. She said I did a good job on my drawing.
That sounds nice. Did you draw a dog?
No, I drew a red bus. It was my first time using the red crayon.
Oh, I see. Does the bus have wheels?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My head hurts a lot.
I am sorry you feel this way. Did you sleep well last night?
I did not sleep at all.
That can make a head hurt. Do you have any water to drink?
Yes, I have a full cup.
Drinking water is good. I do not know if it will help right away, but it is a good start.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do bees make honey?
Bees make honey to save food for the cold winter. Do you like eating honey?
Yes, I do. Why do ants work in such long lines?
They follow a smell to find their home. Do you think they are tired?
I think so. Why do butterflies have such pretty wings?
The colors help them find a mate. Do you like looking at flowers?
I do. Why do insects have so many legs?
The legs help them climb and run fast.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know my test score now.
Let me look. Are you nervous?
Yes. What did I get?
I do not know. Do you want to wait?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to pack for the trip. I have no time.
Let us do this. What do you need most?
My clothes and my book. It is late.
Good. Just a bag and a pillow. Do you have a car?
Yes, I have a car. Please go.
Put the things in. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a toy boat and it stays up! Why does it not sink?
That is a fun find! Does your boat feel light?
It is very light, yes.
The boat pushes the water down, and the water pushes it back up. Do you like splashing in puddles?
I do! It is so much fun to splash.
Water always pushes back on things that push it. Do you want to take it to a real lake?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn to draw a cat. I feel so proud when I make things.
That is a great goal. Do you like drawing other animals too?
I want to try it this weekend. What is the first step?
Start with a big circle for the head. Do you have some paper ready?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a bird fall from the tree today.
Oh no, did it look hurt?
Its wing was bent, so I put it in a box.
That was a very kind thing to do.
I let it go near the park this evening.
I hope it flew away safe.
It did! It jumped out and flew high.
That is wonderful news to hear.
My hands are a bit tired from the box.
Well done for helping, take some rest now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking up, but I am not sure why the sky is blue.
Sunlight is white and has many colors in it. Do you know how light moves?
I think light moves in a straight line, but I am not sure.
That is true, but air bumps the light around. The blue parts bump and spread everywhere.
That sounds a little hard for me to picture in my head.
It is like a tiny wave making ripples in water. Do you like watching water play?
I do like watching water, but I do not know what to do next.
Just keep looking up and breathing the fresh air. Do you feel the breeze today?
Yes, the wind is nice, and I understand the blue part now.
Good job for learning something new today.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am waiting for my bus. It is taking a long time.
That can feel very slow. Do you have a book with you?
No. I only have my phone. It feels boring.
You could just look at the sky. Is the sky blue today?
Yes, it is bright blue. But I still feel stuck.
Try to count the clouds. Can you spot a big one?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go swimming today.
That sounds like fun. Do you have your goggles?
Yes, I packed my bag this morning.
Great job getting ready. Are you going with a friend?
My brother is coming with me.
Sounds like a great day. Do you know how to swim well?
I can float for a long time.
That is very impressive.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The rain is falling very hard outside.
It is raining a lot today. Do you like the sound of it?
It makes a loud tapping sound on the roof.
That sound can be very calming.
Do you think the rain will stop soon?
I do not know for sure. It is hard to guess the weather.
My favorite color is blue, just like the sky when it clears.
Blue is a happy color. What do you draw when you are bored?
I draw cats drinking water from the puddles.
That is a cute idea.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like any fruit today. I feel bad.
That is sad to hear. What made you feel this way?
I cut my hand on an orange. It hurt a lot.
Oh no, I am sorry about your hand. Did you wash it well?
Yes, I washed it. But I still do not want to eat fruit.
That is understandable. How about you just try a soft banana?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a flower grow from a seed?
Put the seed in the dirt and give it water. Do you have a sunny spot in your home?
Yes, I have a big window.
That is a great place to start. Is the pot deep enough for the roots?
I am not sure what a root is.
A root is the part of the plant that stays in the soil. It drinks water for the plant. Do you know how to tell if the dirt is dry?
I guess I can check with my finger.
Yes, if it feels dry, it needs water. Does the seed look brown or soft?
It looks hard and brown.
That means it is ready to sleep in the dirt. You must be patient.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look up! The sky is so blue today. I feel very happy.
It is a lovely day. Do you like clouds?
I do. Why is it blue, though?
Sunlight has many colors. Blue scatters more than the others.
That sounds like a magic trick!
It is just how light works. Do you see any planes?
I do! A white line in the sky.
That is a plane. Happy flying for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I ride a bike?
Put your feet on the pedals and hold the handlebars tight. Do you have a helmet on?
Yes, I have a big red helmet. How do I keep from falling?
Look ahead, not down at the ground. Try pushing off with one foot first.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad lately and I want to know how to be happy.
Do you like playing outside? Small joys can help big feelings.
Yes, I love running in the park, but I feel too tired to go.
Try just walking a little first. Rest is also part of feeling good.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the short way here safe?
Yes, it is safe. Why are you running so fast?
I must catch the bus. Is it open now?
I do not know. Do you have a ticket?
Yes, I do. Are there many cars?
It is very quiet. Are you still in a hurry?
Yes, I must go now. Thank you.
Good luck. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the big ship not sink in the water?
The ship is very light for how much space it takes up. Do you see how round the bottom is?
It looks like a big bowl.
Yes, that shape helps push the water down. The water pushes back up to hold it. Can you float a toy in the bath?
Yes, the duck floats!
Just like your duck, the ship spreads its weight out. The water is strong enough to hold it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I have to take a test?
The test shows what you know. Do you like learning new things?
I think so, but I am a bit scared.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you want to practice first?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what class to take next.
What subject do you like the most?
I like reading, but I hate writing.
I do not know if that helps. Are you good at drawing?
Yes, I like drawing pictures.
Try an art class then.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw the bear in the movie today.
That sounds fun. Did you like him?
Yes, he was big and gray.
I do not know that movie. Was he nice?
He gave me a toy.
How lovely. Thank you for sharing.
I want to see it again.
That is a great idea. When will you go?
Tomorrow after school.
Have fun with your friend.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I hold two kings and I am not sure what to do.
That is a strong pair. Do you see any kings in the discarded pile?
No, I do not see any kings there.
Then I think you should play one of them.
Should I keep them both for now?
I do not know your full hand. What are your other cards?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does my lamp make a buzz?
It might be an old bulb. Do you hear it only at night?
Yes, it is loud after dark.
Try a new bulb to see if it stops.
Okay, I will try that.
Great idea. Is the wire warm to the touch?
No, it feels cold.
That is good and safe. Tell me if the buzz changes.
I will let you know.
Sounds like a plan. Stay safe.
Thanks for your help.
You are welcome. I hope it works.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a square block but the hole is round. What do I do?
That will not fit. Have you checked for other holes?
I only see this one spot. Is it broken?
It might be for a round piece. Did you look at the other side?
Oh, there is a circle mark here. Thank you.
You are welcome. Glad it fits now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I burned the rice. I feel very bad.
It is okay. Do you like the soup?
Yes, the soup is good.
Good. What is in the pot?
Just carrots and water.
That is fine. We can eat this.
It feels boring, though.
I agree. Maybe we add eggs?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is waiting for my cookies so hard? My hands do not want to stop moving.
It feels like a small tickle in your tummy. Do you like when the cookie is hot?
Yes, but I want it right now. I tried to watch the clock, but it is too slow.
Watching your breath is easier than watching a clock.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I spilled my coffee on the rug. I am so mad.
Oh no, that is sad. Do you have a cloth to clean it?
No, I only have a spoon. It tastes bad now.
A spoon is not for cleaning. Would you like to try some tea instead?
I do not like tea. It is too sweet for me.
You can make it less sweet. Do you have any sugar?
Yes, but I am too tired to make more.
I am here if you need help. Are you happy now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to start a small garden, but I do not know where to start.
That is a fun idea. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
Yes, I have a sunny corner, but I am worried the plants will die.
Plants like sun and water. Try starting with just one easy plant first.
That sounds good. What kind of plant is easy?
A tomato plant is a great choice. Do you like eating tomatoes?
I love them! I do not know if I have enough time to take care of it.
You only need to water it once a day. Is one minute a lot for you?
One minute is fine. Thank you, I think I can do this.
You will do great. Go enjoy your new garden.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because the sky is full of big, white clouds. They look like yummy cotton candy floating above us.
That sounds like a very nice way to see the clouds. Do you wonder what the sheep on the ground are doing?
I think the sheep are looking up at us with their little heads tilted back. I hope they are happy too, just like me.
It is lovely that you feel that way. I do not know if the sheep are happy, but it is sweet that you care.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now. How do I hit the ball?
You swing the racket to hit it. Do you like the sport?
I am very late. Can I use my left hand?
Yes, you can hold it in either hand. Have a good game.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now. Please tell me fast. How do I start the car?
You turn the key to the right. Do you have the keys with you?
Yes I do. The lights are on but it will not move. What is wrong?
You are not in gear. Put the stick in D to drive.
Oh. It runs now. My leg is shaking. How do I stop the car?
You press the big pedal with your right foot. Are you feeling less scared?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my chair shaking?
It is loose. Do you have a hammer?
Yes, but why does it get loose?
Wood moves with the weather. Have you tightened it before?
I tried, but it broke. Why?
Wood can crack if you hit it too hard. Do you have glue?
No glue. Why does it need glue?
Glue holds parts together. Do you have a screwdriver?
I do. Why is that better?
Screws are stronger than glue. Can you try that?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I tried to build the tower, but it fell down. I do not know what to do now.
It is okay to feel sad. Did you use big blocks for the base?
No, I used the small ones. It felt hard to make them stay up.
Try the big blocks first. Do you want to try again with me?
Yes, please. I am not sure if I can do it right this time.
You can. We will go step by step.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I show good manners when I eat?
Please use your words to say please and thank you. Do you always eat with your mouth closed?
I usually do, but what if I drop my food?
That is okay, but you should tell your host. Are you hungry enough to finish your plate?
Yes, I am full. Is it rude to ask for more water?
No, it is polite to ask if you need it. Can you pour your own cup?
I cannot reach the pitcher on the table.
I am not sure where the pitcher is on your table. Would you like a tip for asking for help?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make pasta but I forgot the oil.
That is okay. Add water and a pinch of salt instead. Do you have any cheese?
Yes, I have a lot of cheese.
Good. Grate it over the warm pasta. How much time do you have?
Only ten minutes.
That is enough. Stir it well to melt the cheese.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we take pictures?
Pictures help us remember nice days. Do you like to take them?
Yes, but why do pictures stay the same?
The camera saves the light so it does not change. Is that hard to understand?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today! I want to share my good news with you.
That is great! I love that for you. What made you so happy?
I found a lost dog and took it home! Its owner was very thankful.
That is a kind thing to do. I am glad the dog is safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my chair wobbly?
A leg is loose. Do you have a hammer?
Yes, I do. Why do we use a hammer?
It hits the nail tight. Is the leg wood?
Yes, it is wood. Can I just wiggle it?
No, that will break it. Do you see the nail?
I see it. Why is it loose?
The wood shrank. Do you have glue?
I have no glue. Can I fix it now?
Yes, tap it tight. Feel better?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do bees make that sweet honey?
They drink sweet plant juice and mix it in their hives. Do you like eating honey?
Yes, I do. What happens to the juice after they store it?
Bees dry it out with their wings until it is thick and sticky.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look up and the sky is blue. Why?
Sunlight has many colors. Blue light bounces off the air. Do you see the sun?
Yes, but I do not know what to do.
You can look up and smile. Nature is a free show.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I think I am lost. I do not see my house.
Do not worry. Do you see a big tree?
Yes, I see a big tree. But I am still lost.
Great. Walk to the tree and look for a blue door.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big boat on the water today!
That is so cool! What color was it?
It was blue and white. It looked like it would sink.
Why do you think it stays up?
I do not know! The water pushes back.
Yes, the water pushes up with force.
That is why it floats! I am so happy!
It is fun to learn new things!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My bread did not rise. It stayed flat on the table.
That is sad. Did you use fresh yeast?
I think so, but I am not sure.
Old yeast can be tired. I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the fence have holes?
The holes let water in so the plants can drink. Do you like growing things?
Yes, I do. But why is it brown?
It is brown because it is made of wood. Is your garden big?
It is small. Why is the fence so tall?
It is tall to keep pets inside safely. I do not know if it stops all animals.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck on the last part of my test.
That feels hard, but you can do this. What part is giving you trouble?
I do not know how to write the ending.
Try to finish the story in one simple way. Do you have a happy idea?
I think I want them to find their dog.
That is a warm and true ending.
Okay, I will write that now.
Good luck, friend. You should feel proud of your work.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad because the water in the lake looks very dirty today.
That is sad to hear. Is it cloudy or is there trash in it?
It looks brown and thick, like mud. I did not want to swim there.
I am sorry you are unhappy about that.
I just wanted a clean place to relax. Do you know why it is so dirty?
I do not know the exact reason. Are you seeing rain nearby?
No, the sun is out and it is warm. But I still feel sad looking at it.
I am sorry about that. Would you like to look for a different spot?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to pour wine.
Sure, hold the bottle by the neck. Do you have a glass ready?
Yes, I have a glass here.
Tilt the glass slightly.
How much do I tilt it?
About forty-five degrees. Is your hand steady?
I think so, but what if it spills?
It is okay if a little spills. Take your time.
I did it!
Great job.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sand so hot?
The sun is on it all day. It gets warm like a pot. Do you wear shoes there?
No, I like the feel. But why does it burn my feet?
Sand holds the heat in its tiny bits. It keeps it for a while. Is the water cool to you?
It is! Why is it so cold?
The water moves and mixes. This keeps it fresh. Do you like swimming there?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a new song. It makes me feel so happy.
That is great news. What is the song called?
It has a funny beat. Can you think of a song like that?
I am not sure of the name. Do you like the words or the tune more?
I love the words. They are very sweet.
Sweet words are nice. Thank you for sharing this with me.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the small island today.
That sounds nice. Did you see any animals?
I saw a big crab on the sand.
Crabs are fun to watch. Is it still there?
Yes, it is hiding under a rock.
Good for it. Do you like crabs?
I do, but I do not touch them.
That is a smart choice.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have twelve months in a year?
The year takes time to turn around the sun. We split it into twelve parts to keep track of seasons. Do you like winter best?
I like spring. Why do the names of the months sound so strange?
I do not know the full story of every name. Some are old words from long ago. What is your favorite month?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My cat sleeps all day and hides. Is this bad?
That is a good sign if he is happy. Does he eat well?
Yes, he eats two meals a day. He just rests a lot.
Cats like to rest. Is he playing at night?
He runs fast at night. Is this okay?
It is called being active. It is healthy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, but I love high hills. What are they made of?
They are made of rock and stone. Do you like to climb them?
I must go now, but yes, I do. How do they get so tall?
It takes a very long time for them to grow. Is that a fun question for you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to bake bread but I am lost.
Start with warm water and yeast. Do you have a timer?
Yes, I have a timer. What should I do next?
Let the dough grow until it is twice as big.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so hungry. What should I eat?
Do you like hot food? I have soup.
I am in a big rush. Can I grab a bagel?
Yes, a bagel is fast. What kind of filling do you want?
I do not know. I just need to be done.
