That is okay. The plain one is good. Do you want coffee too?
No. I must go now.
Okay. I hope you enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a big bug in my room. Do I kill it?
That is a hard choice. Is it small or very large?
It is as big as my hand. I am scared to touch it.
Please do not hurt it. Can you see a window nearby?
Yes, there is a door to the porch.
Gently guide it outside. You will feel brave when it is gone.
I will use a cup and paper. Thank you for your help.
You did the right thing. It is kind to save a life.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a tiny blue bird in the shop today. It was so sweet.
That sounds lovely. Did it sing for you?
Yes, it chirped happily when I looked at it. I want to tell everyone about it.
That is a kind thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I can not find my red book.
Is it on the shelf?
No, I looked there.
Let us check the new books corner.
It is there!
Happy reading.
Thanks.
See you later.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I can't find my old friend's home.
I do not know where they live now. Did you see a new house near the park?
I looked, but it was empty.
That is sad. Maybe they moved to a big city?
I think they did. I feel left behind.
You are not alone. Do you have any of their old letters?
Yes, I have one box of letters.
Keep them safe. Do you want to write a letter today?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look up. There is a big color ring in the sky. It is a rainbow.
That looks so pretty. Do you see any red in it?
Yes, I see red on top. I also see yellow and green.
Very good. Do you like looking at rain?
I do not like getting wet. But I like the rain when it makes rainbows.
I understand that.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I am going to a party. Why do people hold parties?
They hold parties to share joy and food with friends. Do you like cake?
I like cake. Why do people dance at parties?
Dancing makes people feel happy and close. Do you dance well?
I do not know how to dance well. Why do people play music?
Music helps people move and feel good. I do not know if you can dance.
I can wiggle my feet. Why do people talk so much?
They talk to share stories and have fun. Do you have stories?
I have a story about a dog. Why do people give gifts?
Gifts show that people care about you. I do not know if you have a gift.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the water, but I cannot find my towel.
Check your bag. Did you pack it?
No, I do not have it. Is the sand wet there?
Yes, it is very wet. Would you like a dry spot?
Please. I must go now, thank you.
You are welcome. Run fast.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because I forgot the name of the month after March.
Do not worry, it is April. Do you like spring?
I am still upset because I cannot count them all.
There are twelve months in a year. Can you try again?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a big rainbow today.
That sounds fun. Did you see it after the rain?
Yes, the sun came out.
That is how they form. Do you like the colors?
I like red and blue the most.
Red is at the top. Blue is lower down.
Is it a bridge to heaven?
I do not know about that. It is just light.
Can I catch it in my hand?
No, it is made of light. Do you have a camera?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am hungry and need a place to eat.
A burger spot is a great pick. Do you like cheese?
Yes, I love cheese on everything.
Then the big cheese burger is good for you.
That sounds perfect to me.
I am sure you will enjoy that meal.
Where can I find that place?
I do not know the exact spot. Are you near the park?
Yes, I live just by the park.
You should look for a sign with a red roof.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I heard a bird singing on my way to school today.
That sounds like a happy start. Did the song stop or keep going?
It kept going until I walked into the building.
Birds are very good at music. Do you like that specific song?
I did, it made me feel very calm.
Calm is a good feeling to carry with you. What did you do after that?
I went to class and tried to remember the tune.
Music is hard to catch once it is gone. It was a nice day, I am glad.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat in the big room with many people today.
That sounds like a busy place. Did you enjoy the talk?
The man spoke for a long time about numbers.
Numbers can be hard to follow. Did you understand what he said?
Not much, so I drew a cat on the paper.
That is a good way to stay calm. Did the cat look happy?
Yes, it had a big smile and blue eyes.
A happy cat is a lovely picture.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the lake today. The water was cold. I caught one big fish.
That sounds fun. What kind of fish was it?
It was a trout. I let it go back. I was happy to help it.
You were very kind.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke my toy. I am sad.
Oh no, that is tough. Did you try to fix it?
No. I do not know how.
Let us look at it together. What piece is missing?
The little blue wheel.
I am sure we can find it. Let us search your room.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was out today, and I looked up at the big blue sky.
That is a nice view. Do you like the color blue?
I do, but I wondered why it is blue and not green.
The sun makes all colors of light, but the air scatters the blue parts the most.
Oh, so the air is like a filter that keeps the blue.
Yes, that is a good way to think about it. Was the wind blowing strong?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue bus today. It stopped right in front of my house.
That sounds like a fun start to the day. Did you wave at the driver?
I did not wave. I was looking at a cat on the roof.
A cat on a roof is a rare sight. Did it look happy?
It looked very sleepy. I think it wanted to nap.
Cats always want to nap. Do you like cats?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my first day so hard?
It is hard because you are new. Do you have a friend there?
Why do I feel scared?
Your brain wants to stay safe. Are you eating lunch?
Why does the work take so long?
Learning takes time. Do you know the rules?
Why am I still tired after rest?
Your body is working hard. Can I check your notes?
Why do I want to give up?
It is normal to feel this way. Do you want to share one win?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do trees have such big roots?
Roots hold the tree up like legs. Do you have big feet?
My feet are small. Why do trees grow so tall?
They grow tall to reach the sun. Do you like the sun?
Yes, I do. Why do leaves fall in autumn?
I am not sure why that happens. Do you like falling leaves?
I do! Why do trees make seeds?
Seeds help new trees start to grow. Do you plant seeds?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not see the rainbow today. I feel sad.
Sometimes clouds hide it. Do you like the color red best?
Yes, red is my favorite. It is gone now.
It may return soon. Do you have an umbrella?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do my magnets stick to the fridge but not the wall?
Magnets stick to metal, like the fridge door. Is your wall made of metal?
No, it is just paint on plaster. So it will not work there, right?
That is right, the wall has no metal to hold the magnet. Do you want to hang a picture there?
Yes, I do. How can I make it stick to the non-metal wall?
You can use tape or special hooks for that.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Do you know where I can buy fresh apples?
They are in the east corner. Do you like sweet or sour apples?
I like sweet ones.
The red ones are usually sweetest.
How much do they cost?
I am not sure of the price. Would you like to check the sign?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you think Santa comes down the chimney?
I do not know for sure, but the story says he does. Do you like giving gifts?
Yes, I give my cat a little fish.
That is a very sweet idea. Is your cat a big cat?
No, she is small and soft.
That sounds very cozy to hold. Do you have any other pets?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My little brother broke my toy.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you feel very angry?
Yes, but I do not want to hit him.
Hitting is never kind. Have you tried talking to him?
I am afraid he will cry and get in trouble.
Telling the truth is always brave. Does he know how much the toy meant to you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to see the big rocks, but I feel tired.
It is okay to rest first. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I like the sun. But the path looks long.
We can walk slow and take breaks.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I ate an apple and felt so full and happy.
That sounds nice. Do you like the taste of apples?
Yes, they are sweet and crunchy. I want to eat more.
Good. What else do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today. The sand was very hot.
That sounds like a busy day. Did you build a sand castle?
I tried, but the waves kept washing it away.
Oh no, that is very sad. Was the water warm?
Yes, the water was warm and the sun was bright.
That sounds like a good day. Did you play in the waves?
I sat on a rock and watched the birds fly.
That sounds very peaceful. Thank you for sharing your day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so tired and it is hard to focus on my books.
That is a common feeling. Do you get enough sleep at night?
I usually stay up late playing games.
Try to finish your homework earlier so you can rest. Is your room too noisy for studying?
Yes, my brothers are very loud.
You might ask them to play outside for a while. It will help you think clearly.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I love that story about the brave dog. Why is it your favorite?
It shows how to be kind. Do you like dogs?
Yes, I do. Why does being kind matter so much?
It makes people happy. What is your best memory?
Getting a puppy for my birthday. Why do you remember the book so well?
I read it many times. Do you like to read?
Sometimes, but not always. Why is reading good for us?
It helps our minds grow. What do you want to learn?
I want to be a doctor. Why is that a big dream?
It is hard but good work. Can you be one?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very sad today because I lost my red balloon at the park.
That is a very bad day. Were you holding it tight?
I was, but the wind was too strong and it flew away.
I am sorry your fun ended so fast. Do you want to think of something nice to do next?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want new shoes for my feet.
That sounds like fun. What color do you like best?
I like red shoes.
Red is a great choice. Do you need them for running?
Yes, I run very fast.
We can find strong shoes for you. Does the red size feel good?
Yes, they feel warm.
I am glad they fit. Would you like to try running in them?
Yes, I can run now.
You are very fast. I am happy you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to show my dog a video of a cat today.
That is funny. Did the dog watch the screen?
He barked at the cat and jumped on the TV stand.
Oh no, that sounds like a big mess. Do you have a new TV stand?
The cat video made him so excited he did not stop moving.
Dogs love movement. Did the cat in the video do something silly?
The cat fell off a chair and landed on its back.
Haha, that is lucky for the cat. Is your dog calm now?
Yes, he is sleeping on the rug now, very tired.
Good. Let him rest.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The car went in the ditch.
Oh no. That sounds scary. What happened before that?
I looked at the road and I got too scared to move.
You were just trying to be safe. That is good. Do you want to try again?
I do not think I can do it.
You can. We will go very slow. I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I moved my knight and now I think I will lose the game.
That is a hard place to be. Do you see any squares your king can run to?
No, the queen is blocking the only way out.
Ah, that is a tight spot. Have you checked if your king is in check?
Yes, it is, and I cannot save it.
I am sorry about that. Do you want to talk about what happened?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the moon change shape?
It is all a game of light. Do you like watching the sky?
Yes. Why is the sky blue?
The sun makes it look that way. I do not know the deep reason.
Okay. Why do we close our eyes when we sleep?
It helps us rest better. Do you dream often?
Sometimes. Why is grass green?
It eats the sun to grow. Is your grass green?
Yes. Why do we read stories?
They take us to new places. I love stories too.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do I stop the lights from flickering?
Do you have a loose wire? Check the breaker box first.
No, I just need to charge my phone fast.
Is your battery very low? Use a fast charger if you can.
Can I use the computer charger instead?
I do not know your phone model. It might be too slow.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am waiting for the bus, but it is not here.
That can feel very long. What are you looking at?
Just the road. It is boring.
Try to watch the clouds. Do you like the sky?
Yes, the sky is nice.
That is good. Sit tall and breathe slow.
It is still not coming. I feel mad.
Anger is okay. It means you care.
How do I stop the angry feelings?
Count to ten, then again.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and saw a big dog.
That sounds like fun. What color was the dog?
It was brown and had a red collar. It wagged its tail a lot.
I am glad you had a happy time. Did the dog bark at you?
No, it just smelled my hand. Then we both ran on the grass.
That is a nice story. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need this map solved now, I am so late!
Take a deep breath. What is the first clue you see?
It says go north, but I do not know where that is.
North is usually the top of the map. Are you holding it upside down?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want a red coat for winter. Do you have any?
Yes, we have a big red coat. Do you like big coats?
I like it, but it is very expensive. Is there a cheaper one?
I do not know about prices. Can I call the manager?
Please do. Where do I wait?
You can sit on the blue chair near the door.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the year have twelve months?
I think it is because the moon goes around twelve times a year. Do you like the cold months?
I do not care for snow. Why do some months have thirty days?
I am not sure. It has been that way for a long time. Do you count the days?
I count the days until summer. Why do we have winter at all?
Nature needs a time to rest. Is the quiet time nice?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I order food when I do not read?
You can point to the pictures on the menu. Do you like looking at pictures?
Yes, I like them. What if the waiters do not have pictures?
You can ask them to show you the food they suggest. Is that hard for you?
No, it is not hard. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. I am glad I could help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a box of old letters from a friend I lost touch with.
That sounds like a sweet surprise. Do you know if the friend is still alive?
I think so, but I am not sure if I should write to them.
Writing a short note is a safe first step. Would you like to ask me to help you find the right words?
I am afraid they will not want to hear from me after all these years.
It is normal to feel that way. Do you have a favorite memory of them?
I do, but I do not know what to do next.
I do not know your friend, so I cannot say for sure.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is a circle round?
It has no corners. Do you like circles?
Yes, I do. Why is a square not round?
It has four straight sides. Do you like squares?
Yes. Why do triangles have points?
They have three sharp edges. Do you like triangles?
Yes. Can you tell me about a star?
I do not know for sure. Do you know?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spilled my coffee on the floor this morning.
Oh no, that is bad. Do you like coffee?
Yes, I do. Now I have to go buy another cup.
That sounds like a long day. I hope the new cup is good.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: It is late. I have no time. What time is it?
It is almost noon. Do you have a watch?
I do not look at my watch. Just tell me.
It is twelve o'clock. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The trees are so bare. I am sad.
Sad trees mean cold days are coming. Do you see the brown leaves on the ground?
Yes, they are everywhere. But I do not know why they fall.
The tree drops them to save its food for winter. Do you think the tree is sleeping?
It feels like a big sleep. What happens next?
New green leaves will come when it gets warm again.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to keep a goat, but my yard is small.
A goat needs much room to run and eat. Do you have a big fence?
I have a tiny yard. What else is good for small spaces?
A rabbit fits well in a small yard. Do you like giving them carrots?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the dog in the book left.
That is a sad story. Do you want to read a happy one next?
Yes, I want a story where the friends stay together.
I can find a book where the friends never part. Do you like cats or dogs better?
I like dogs.
I will choose a story with a good dog.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my grandpa sitting so still?
He is resting because he is feeling tired. Do you like to sit and read books?
Why does he look so happy then?
I do not know for sure, but he likes being here. Does he have a favorite snack?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make my pictures look nice?
Try to use good light. Do you like sunny days or cloudy ones?
I like sunny days best.
That is great. Stand in the shade so the sun does not blind you.
Where should I stand?
Pick a plain spot so the view stays clear. Do you have a friend to help you?
Yes, my brother is here.
Ask him to take the shot for you.
What if I do not know how to pose?
Just act like you are normal. Do you like to smile or look serious?
I usually smile a lot.
A big smile is always fun to see.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big green hill on the island.
That sounds like a great place to hide. Did you see any animals there?
Yes, I saw a small brown rabbit hopping by.
Rabbits are very cute to watch. Do they like carrots?
I think they do, but I did not have any.
That is a bit of a miss. Would you like to find some tomorrow?
Maybe, but my feet hurt from walking.
Resting is good for tired feet. Sleep well tonight.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My neighbour leaves loud music at night.
That sounds very noisy. Does it stop when you ask them nicely?
I did ask, but he kept playing.
I am sorry, that is unfair. Are you scared to talk to him again?
No, I am just mad.
It is okay to feel mad. Your parents might help fix this.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to climb a big mountain, but I feel scared.
It is scary to start, but you can take small steps. Do you have a map?
No, I do not have a map.
You need a map to stay safe. Have you ever hiked before?
I have walked in the park, but never up a hill.
That is a great start. Are you ready to learn?
Yes, I am ready. Please help me.
Start with a small hill near you. It will make you stronger.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure how plants get their drink.
They pull water up from the soil through tiny tubes. Do you like how nature works?
I guess I do not know the name of those tubes.
They are called xylem, and they act like straws. Do you have a plant at home?
I have one, but I do not know if I should water it.
Check the soil to see if it is dry. Do you want to check it now?
I will do that, thank you for your help.
You are welcome, and good luck with your plant.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I felt very small today. I dropped my ball and could not find it.
That is a scary feeling. Did you look in the grass?
Yes, I looked everywhere. My tummy hurt from all the worry.
Your body knows you are scared. Do you feel warm now?
A little bit. The sun is out and it looks nice.
That is good. Maybe you will find it soon.
I hope so. I miss my red ball.
I do not know where it is, but I am with you. Are you ready to look again?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My neighbor plays loud music all day. I am very tired of it.
That sounds very hard. Do you think he hears you?
I did not say anything. I am too shy.
It is brave to try talking. Would you like to ask me for help?
I just want quiet so I can rest.
I hear you. I do not know what to do, but I care.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sun so hot?
The sun is a big ball of gas. It makes heat by squishing its own parts together. Do you like warm days?
Why do we see the sun go down?
The Earth is always turning around. This makes the sun look like it is moving away. Do you watch the sunset?
Why is the night dark?
The dark side of the Earth faces away from the sun. I do not know why the night feels so quiet to you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to study?
We study to learn new things. Do you like learning?
Why do we read books?
Books help us use our brains. Is reading fun for you?
Why is math hard?
It takes time to get good at it. Do you get help?
Why do we do homework?
It helps us remember the lessons. I am not sure why all teachers do it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the park?
It is that way. Do you run fast?
Yes, I must go now.
I hope you arrive on time. Is the path empty?
Yes, it is very quiet here.
I like quiet places. Do you see the trees?
I see them, but I must go.
Be safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel sad when I see my teacher look tired.
That is very kind of you to care. Are you going to talk to her?
I want to help, but I do not know how to start.
You could just say hello and ask if she is okay. Do you like her classes?
Yes, they are my favorite, but she looks so tired today.
It is good that you pay attention to how she feels. Would you like to bring her a little note?
I think a note would be nice and safe.
That sounds like a perfect plan. Write it with a smile!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very lonely at the house today.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a pet or a toy to play with?
I have a dog, but he is sleeping all day.
That can be hard. Try to call a friend on the phone.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so lost. This new town is huge and I do not know where anything is.
That is a scary feeling. Can you tell me what you need first?
I just want to find a place to eat, but I am hungry and tired.
There is a warm kitchen just around that corner. Do you like soup?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I wash my shirt?
You put it in the machine with some soap. Do you know how to use the buttons?
I am not sure. What do the buttons mean?
The big round one starts the wash. The small ones change the heat. Do you want a warm wash or a cold one?
I want it clean, but I do not want it too hot.
Pick the cold button to keep it safe. That is all you need.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the horse kick?
It kicks to show it is scared or angry. Is it kicking at you?
No, it is just standing by the fence.
It might just be moving its legs to feel good. Do you feed it apples?
Yes, I give it a treat every day.
That is nice to do. It likes to be near you because you are kind. Does it like carrots too?
I think it likes them best.
Horses do love carrots and apples. Thank you for telling me that.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see smoke coming from the house next door. Is that real fire?
Yes, it looks like a fire. Are you safe inside your home?
Yes, I am safe, but I am scared. What happens next?
The firefighters are on their way to help. Do you have your stuffed animal with you?
Yes, I have my bear. Will the fire stop soon?
I do not know for sure. Please stay near the door and wait for the adults.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My computer works again! I am so happy.
That is great news! What did you fix?
I just cleaned the dust out. It runs so fast now.
Clean air helps computers a lot. Do you play games on it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The sky is very dark.
Is it raining hard outside?
The wind is very loud.
That sounds like a big storm. Are you safe in your house?
I am scared of the thunder.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you have a warm blanket?
Can the storm break my window?
Windows are usually strong. Is your window closed tight?
How long will the storm last?
I do not know for sure. Are you staying close to me?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I dropped my clock and now it is quiet.
That is a common problem. Did you check if the battery is dead?
I do not know how to fix it.
Try putting in a new battery. Does it have a small door on the back?
I found a little door, but I am scared to break it.
Just push gently on the back. Are you ready to try?
I opened it and put a new battery inside.
That was well done. Do you hear it ticking now?
Yes, it is ticking again, thank you.
I am so happy for you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How can I send a letter to my friend?
You can buy a stamp and drop the letter in a box. Do you have a stamp?
No, I do not have a stamp.
You can get one at the desk. Do you need help finding it?
Yes, please.
The desk is over there. You are welcome.
Thank you very much.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The screen is blue and I cannot find my page.
Try to type the link again. Is the mouse working?
Yes, but the circle spins and spins.
That means it is thinking. Please wait a few seconds. What is the site called?
It is my school work page.
Let us look together. Is there a red dot on the top?
I do not see a red dot.
That is good. Let us wait a bit more. Do you see any words yet?
No, still just the blue box.
Let us close it and open a new one. Does that help?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My cat sat on my desk today.
That is a lovely spot. Did she nap there?
Yes, she slept for a long time.
Cats love warm places. Does she like your desk best?
She also knocked my pen off the table.
Oh no. Was the pen broken?
No, I picked it up.
Good thing you caught it. Is she a busy cat?
Yes, she is very active at night.
That can be tiring. Do you use toys at night?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a small boat in the yard. It is red and very shiny.
That sounds like a lovely find. What makes it special to you?
It is just plain nice to look at. I love how it sits in the grass.
The grass must look green next to it. Do you plan to keep it there?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the red bird jump up and down?
It is happy to see you. What is your favorite color?
I think I saw a blue bird earlier.
Blue birds are very pretty. Do they sing to you?
Yes, they sing all day long.
That sounds very nice. Do you like the songs?
I do like them very much.
Good for you to listen.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My neighbor is very loud at night.
That sounds hard. What have you tried?
I told them to be quiet.
Good start. Did they stop?
No, they just got angrier.
I am sorry. Do you want to tell me more?
I do not know what to do next.
We can think together. Are they alone?
Yes, they live by themselves.
Maybe they need help. Can you ask kindly?
Should I knock again?
Yes, try once more. If not, call for help.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to save my coins for a new toy. How do I do that?
Put them in a jar under your bed. Do you have a jar yet?
I have a box, but is that safe enough?
A box works well, but be careful with the lid. Do you keep it away from dogs?
Yes, but I keep spending on candy. How do I stop?
Trade the candy money for the jar. Do you like walking to school?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the clinic this morning.
That is good that you went. Did you feel sick?
I had a bad cough all day.
Coughs can be very tiring. Did the doctor help?
The doctor gave me some soup advice.
Warm soup is a kind cure. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the big ship stay up on the water?
The water pushes up harder than the ship pushes down. Do you like boats?
I guess the water is helping it stay up?
Yes, the water holds it up. What is your favorite part of a ship?
I like the big part where people walk around.
That is the deck. Do you know why it does not sink?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so mad because I cannot find my red shoe.
That is annoying. Did you look in the closet?
I looked there twice, but it is not there.
I am sorry. Do you have a photo of it?
No, but I know it is in this bag.
Let us check the bottom pocket. Is it in there?
Ah, you found it. Thank you, I was so worried.
I am glad. Does it still fit?
Yes, it fits perfectly. I am happy now.
Great. Are you ready to go?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do books have covers?
Covers keep the pages clean. Do you like clean books?
Yes. Why are books on shelves?
Shelves hold the books up. This makes it easy to find them.
I see. Why is it quiet here?
Quiet helps people think. Do you like to think a lot?
Why are there so many colors?
I do not know for sure. Colors can make reading fun.
Last one, why can I borrow books?
To share the stories. Do you want to borrow one?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The water looks so far away. Can I swim in it?
Yes, but only where the ground is shallow. Do you have a friend with you?
Yes, my brother is right here. Is the sand soft under my feet?
It should feel like sugar. Is it warm or cold?
It feels warm. Why is the water blue?
I am not sure why it looks that way. I think light plays a part.
That is a hard answer. Can the fish see me?
They might, if you make loud splashes. Are you holding your breath?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad. My money is gone so fast.
That feels bad. Do you know where the money went?
I think I spent it on toys.
Toys are fun. Did you enjoy them?
Yes, but I am out now.
Let us plan better next time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad because I lost my favorite toy.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you want to help you look for it?
Maybe, but I think it is gone for good.
We can start looking in the room first. Is it usually there?
Yes, but I already looked there.
Let us look again together. Sometimes we miss small things.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a scary dream about a big black bear today.
That must have felt very big and loud to you. Did you wake up feeling cold?
Yes, my room was quiet and the light was low.
A quiet room can feel strange when you are still dreaming. Do you like it when the sun comes up?
I like the sun, but I am still a bit scared.
It is natural to feel scared after a scary dream. I am here to help you feel safe now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My phone fell in the pool.
Oh no, that is bad. Did you get it out fast?
Yes, but the screen is cracked now.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a case on it?
The new case is too tight.
That is tricky. How does it feel?
It feels warm and a bit heavy.
I do not know why it feels warm. Have you tried turning it off?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found an old coin in the park today.
That is a cool find. Do you know what year it is from?
No, but it looks very old.
I do not know the exact date, but old coins help us learn about the past.
I will keep it safe in my pocket.
That is a good idea. Do you want to take it to a museum?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The sky looks so gray today. I do not like it when it is cloudy.
Gray skies can feel sad. Do you see any white parts in the clouds?
Just a little bit. I wish the sun would come out.
The sun is hiding behind the clouds. Do you think it will come back soon?
I hope so. It feels too dark in here.
You can look up and wait. Do you want to draw a picture of them?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a mango. I am not sure what to do with it.
You can cut it open and eat the sweet part. Do you like sweet things?
I do, but my fingers get sticky. It feels bad.
Yes, juice can be messy. Maybe use a spoon?
That is a good idea. I will try that now.
That sounds fun. I hope you enjoy your snack.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired. I tried to fix my bike today and it took all my energy.
Fixing things is hard work. Do you want to sit down and rest now?
Yes, I am just staring at the wall. My back hurts a little bit.
That sounds like a long day. Do you have a soft cushion to put under your back?
I do. I think I will close my eyes for a minute.
That is a good idea. Sweet dreams.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at this map and I do not know where to go next.
That can feel confusing. Is there a place you really want to visit?
Yes, but the lines are so close together that I cannot tell which one is the road.
You are looking at a very busy part of the map. Do you have a compass or a phone with you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know where to start with the cleaning.
Start with the floor, then move up. Do you have a broom?
Yes, I have a broom and a mop.
Sweep first, then mop the wet spots. Is it very dusty today?
It is quite dusty.
Use your damp cloth on the high shelves last.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need tea or coffee to wake up.
Do you like hot drinks?
Yes, but I am late.
Coffee is fast to drink.
Good, I will take coffee.
That sounds good for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need a wood frame?
It makes the shed strong and straight. Do you have your tools ready?
I do not know why we paint it.
Paint keeps the rain away from the wood. Is your paint dry yet?
Can we use big rocks for the floor?
Yes, they keep weeds out. Do you have a wheelbarrow?
Why is the roof pointed?
It helps the rain run off the walls.
How high should the door be?
Make it tall enough for you to walk in. Can you lift the door?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My cat sat on the table all morning.
That sounds like a very relaxed cat. What was he doing there?
He just watched the birds outside the window.
Cats love to watch birds from a safe place. Did he try to jump down?
No, he stayed put until I gave him a treat.
A treat is a great way to say thank you.
Now he is sleeping on my bed.
That is a happy place to nap. Is he still awake?
He fell asleep as soon as I touched him.
That shows he feels safe with you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go.
The shelves are all around you. Do you want to read or look for a book?
I just want to sit for a bit.
The chairs are near the window. It is a quiet spot. Do you like the sun?
Yes, but I feel too small here.
It is fine to feel small. You are welcome here.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel so tired when I read by my bed lamp?
Your eyes work hard in the dark, which can tire your brain. Do you like to read before sleep?
I like it because the room is quiet and calm. Does the light hurt my eyes?
It can strain them if the light is too bright or too dim. Is your lamp close to your face?
It is a little close. Should I move it further away?
Yes, moving it back helps your eyes relax. Do you plan to try that tonight?
I will move the lamp and wear my glasses. Will that make me sleep better?
It often does, because your body can wind down. I hope you get a good night of rest.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the water in the harbour so calm?
The tall walls block the big waves. Do you like looking at the boats?
Yes, I do. Can I feed the ducks here?
No, that is not allowed. Is there a shop nearby?
I am not sure. Where is the bus stop?
It is right by the main gate.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start growing carrots?
Dig the soil deep and plant the seeds small. Do you have a sunny spot?
Yes, I have a sunny spot.
Great, you must water them often. Are your hands ready to dig?
My hands are ready.
Good, just be gentle with the roots. Do you like sweet carrots?
I like sweet carrots.
Then pick them when they are big. Happy growing!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took my test today and felt very nervous.
That is okay. Did you have fun?
I did well, but my hands were shaking.
You should be proud. What was the test about?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did you promise to help me?
Because I care about you. Do you feel okay?
I feel a bit scared.
It is okay to be scared. Do you want a hug?
Yes, please.
Here is a big hug. You are safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go. The sun is low. Do you know if the waves are loud?
They can be very loud. Do you like the sound?
I am too fast for sounds. Is the water wet?
Yes, it is always wet. Is your bag heavy?
My bag is light. How deep is the sea?
I do not know the exact depth. It is very deep.
I am sure it is deep. Can fish swim there?
Yes, many fish swim in the deep. Do you see any?
I must run. Is it safe to sit on the rocks?
It is usually safe if you stand firm. Be careful.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the cars moving so slowly?
The road is full of people going to work. Do you like looking at buses?
The lights are so bright at night.
The shops stay open late to sell things. I do not know why some shine blue.
Why is it so loud here?
Many people talk and laugh together. Do you hear the music too?
Why do everyone seem to be in a hurry?
We need to finish our jobs before the sun comes up.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel all alone and I do not want to play.
That feels very heavy, but I am here. What is your favorite thing to do?
I like to draw pictures of cats, but no one looks at them.
That sounds like a quiet way to play. Do you have any paper to draw right now?
Yes, I have my book, but my hands feel cold.
Let us think of a warm spot together. Is your home cozy today?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do bees make honey? Do they sing?
No, they do not sing. They take sweet juice from flowers and dry it in their hives. Do you like the taste of honey?
Yes, I do. It is very sweet.
That is good. The bees add air to the juice until it turns thick and sweet. Do you want to see a hive one day?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to count the steps in my room.
Start at zero and add one for each step you take. Do you have a map of your room?
No, I just have my feet.
That is fine. Your feet are perfect tools. What color are your shoes?
They are blue.
Nice blue shoes. Count up to ten and stop there.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a cold, but I am so happy to have it!
That is very odd. Why are you happy about a sickness?
It makes me feel special and cozy.
I do not know why you feel that way. Do you like drinking warm tea?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why does my bread get big and puffy?
Tiny bugs called yeast eat sugar and give off gas. This gas makes tiny holes. Do you like sweet bread?
I do. How do I make the holes bigger?
Warm air helps the yeast grow fast. Keep your dough warm. Are you using fresh or dry yeast?
I use dry yeast. Is that okay?
Yes, dry yeast works very well. You must mix it with warm water first.
I will try that. Thank you.
You are welcome. The bread will rise. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make a good hand in poker?
Pick two matching cards. Do you have any cards yet?
Yes, I have two kings.
Great, that is a strong start.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red ball in the park today. It was round and shiny.
A red ball sounds fun. Did you kick it?
Yes, I kicked it across the grass. It went far.
That is great. Do you like playing with balls?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to bring.
How about some fruit and juice? Do you like apples?
I think that sounds good.
Great idea. Do you have a blanket?
I have a mat, but I am not sure if it is big enough.
A big mat is best for sitting. Is it new?
It is old, but it is still clean.
Clean is what matters most. Where will you sit?
I will sit in the park near the trees.
That sounds like a nice place to relax.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent the whole afternoon painting my room blue. My hands are covered in paint now.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like the color blue?
Yes, I do. It makes me feel calm. I am happy with my work.
I am glad you are happy. You should take a rest soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Where is my seat?
I do not know the number. Do you have your pass?
No, I lost it. I am running late.
Please calm down. Do you have a phone?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my nice cup by accident. I feel very bad.
That feels sad, but it is just a thing. Did you try to catch it?
Yes, I fell and the cup hit the floor. What should I do now?
Tell a grown one so they can help you. Are you hurt from falling?
No, my hands are okay. Should I clean up the glass?
Yes, ask for help with the sharp bits. You did the right thing by telling.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The baby is crying and I do not know what to do.
Did you try holding him close?
I do know how to hold him.
That is the first step. Is he wet?
He is clean and dry.
He may just be tired.
I feel lost.
You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to sleep, but my eyes feel heavy.
That feels strange. What is keeping you awake?
I am a little scared of the dark in my room.
It makes sense to feel that way. Do you have a soft blanket?
Yes, I have a big, warm bear hug.
That sounds very cozy. Would a soft light help?
I think a small lamp on my desk would be nice.
A small light is a good idea. Do you have a favorite story?
Yes, I love the one about the brave little rabbit.
Stories are great for sleepy heads. Let your bear guard you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do I start a letter to my grandma?
You can say "Dear Grandma," right at the top. Who are you writing to?
I am writing to her. I want to tell her I made a cake.
That sounds sweet! Do you know how to spell cake?
Yes, it is C-A-K-E. But I forgot how to end the letter.
You can write "Love you" at the bottom. Did you bake the cake with her?
No, I did it all by myself. She will be happy.
That is very kind of you. What color is the frosting?
It is pink. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Go write your letter!

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I like this book, but I do not know what to do next.
That is a nice book. Do you have a pencil?
Yes, I have a red pencil. I feel lost.
Try to mark the page you like best. Is it a happy page?
No, it is a sad page. I am confused.
Sad pages are often the most true. Do you feel calm now?
Yes, I feel better. Thank you.
I am glad to help.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the internet?
It is a big web that links all computers. Do you have a computer?
Yes, my dad has one. How does it talk to other computers?
They send tiny packets of data. Do you know what a packet is?
Is it like a small box?
Yes, it is like a small box with words. I do not know if every box is the same size.
That sounds confusing. How do I find things on it?
You type a word into a search bar. Do you like to play games?
I do. What is the web?
The web is the part you use to read pages.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people say walking is good for you?
It makes your heart strong and helps you feel happy. Do you like to walk outside?
Does it really make my heart stronger?
Yes, moving your legs makes your heart pump better. Do you walk a lot now?
I am not sure if I walk enough.
Even a short walk every day is good for you. How far can you go?
I think I can walk to the park.
That is a great start to get moving. See you later?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My mom is getting married next week. I am very excited.
That is such good news! Will you wear your new blue shoes?
Yes, I will wear them. They are my favorite.
They must look great on your feet. I hope the day is full of fun.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I see you use blue for the sky. Why is it blue?
The sun lights up the air, which makes it look blue. Do you like blue?
The red apple looks sweet. Why is it red?
Apples turn red when they get ripe and sweet. Are you hungry?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hid my toy and I cannot find it.
That feels bad. Do you remember where you put it?
No, I just put it in my room.
I do not know where it is. Did you look in your bed?
Yes, but it is not there.
I am sorry. Did you look under your blanket?
I checked everywhere.
That is tricky. Maybe you left it in the closet?
I think I did.
Good luck. Did you find it there?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the boat broke on the island and I cannot go home.
I am sorry you feel this way. Did you bring any food with you?
I have some apples, but I am still very worried about being stuck here.
Those are good things to eat. Do you see any other boats near the water?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts and I feel very cold. What should I do?
Please rest and drink warm tea. Do you have a fever?
I do not know how to check it.
Use a thermometer to look for high heat. Are you eating well?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to take a picture with my phone.
You can press the white button on the side. Do you hold it steady?
I do not know which button to press.
It is usually the one near the top edge. Is your phone turned on?
Yes, the light is on.
Great. Look for a square icon on the screen. Tap it once.
I see a square. I tapped it.
The screen now shows what is in front of you. Are you happy?
Yes, now what do I do?
Press the big circle button in the middle. That takes the photo.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is this old vase broken?
It broke a long time ago. We kept it whole. Do you like old things?
Why is the light so dim in here?
Dark rooms help you see the art. It feels more calm.
Why does the robot not move?
It is not a real robot. It is just a model. What do you think it would do?
Why is there no door at the end?
I do not know. It is just a wall.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. I did not win the race.
That feels bad. What made you sad?
I tripped on the last turn. I wanted to be first.
You still ran hard. Do you feel strong?
I tripped, but I kept going. It is nice to know.
Keeping going is very proud. You did well.
I think I feel a little better now.
I am happy for you. How does that feel?
It feels warm and good.
Good job.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad because my grandpa is not with us anymore.
I am so sorry to hear that. Do you have any happy memories of him?
Yes, he always told me silly jokes.
That is a sweet thing to remember. Did he like telling stories to you?
He was the best at it, but now the house feels empty.
It is normal to miss him. Do you want to talk about your favorite story?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just heard a song that made my heart sing!
That sounds wonderful. What does it sound like?
It sounds like sunshine and jumping.
How nice. Do you listen to it often?
Every day before bed. It makes me feel calm.
It is good to have a happy sound.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big brown bear in the woods. Is it mean?
Bears can look scary, but they usually just want to be left alone. Do you like to watch animals from far away?
Yes, I use a binocular! What does a bear eat?
They eat fish, plants, and berries. Do you know how to count in three?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the new town so quiet?
The shops are still closed. Do you like quiet places?
I do. Why are the trees so big?
The trees are very old here. Do you like tall trees?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to play tennis, but I do not know how to start.
That is a fun idea. Do you have a racket?
I have a ball, but I am not sure what to do with it.
You can throw it up and hit it. Do you want to learn a trick?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the big square look like a smaller one inside?
It is a secret trick called a spiral. Do you like to look closely?
Yes, I see it. Why does the whole thing not add up?
The lines hide a tiny shift. Can you point to the gap?
I see the gap. Why is the size wrong?
One piece moves just a bit. Does that make sense now?
It makes sense. Why is the math wrong?
The area is not the same. Is that okay with you?
Yes, it is. Why do people make this puzzle?
They want to show how eyes can lie.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did you build that little fence?
I built it to keep the rabbits out. Do you have rabbits near you?
Yes, we do. Why is it made of wood?
Wood is hard and strong. It lasts for a long time.
That makes sense. Why is it so short?
I only need it to be tall enough. Do your pets jump high?
Some of them do. Why did you paint it green?
I am not sure why. I just liked the color.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I knocked over your cup. I feel bad.
It is okay. You did not mean to do it. Did you spill water on the floor?
Yes, a little bit. I am sorry.
Thank you for telling me. I forgive you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to feed the cow.
Give it some hay. Is it hungry?
Yes, but I do not know how much.
Start with a small pile. Watch its eyes.
The pig is digging in the mud.
That is good for them. Why are you worried?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! Look, my chair is fixed!
That is great news! Is it rock solid?
Yes, it does not wobble at all. I used the glue.
Glue is a strong tool. Did you let it dry?
I sat on it for an hour. Now it feels firm.
Patience helps it get tough.
I want to share the fun of fixing it.
Sharing joy is sweet. Who is next?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The water in the river is so cold.
It feels chilly to me too. Do you see any fish swimming?
I see a big red fish!
That is a nice big fish. Do you know what kind it is?
I think it is a salmon.
Salmon like cold water. Do you like to touch the water?
No, it makes my hands too cold.
That is smart to stay warm. Do you want to go inside now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My boss was very nice today, but I feel bad inside.
That is a hard feeling to have. Why does it make you feel bad?
I think I owe him a big favor now.
Being nice does not mean you must trade things. Are you feeling trapped by his kindness?
Yes, I worry I am stuck being his helper.
You can still do your own work. Would you like to talk about setting limits?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like coffee because it is hot and yucky.
That is a funny choice! Do you like tea too?
Yes, tea is sweet and warm in my cup.
Sweet tea is good for cold days.
I drink my tea with a spoon in it.
Stirring makes it taste better. Do you add sugar?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The city is so loud and fast. How do I cross the street safely?
Look left, right, and left again before you step off the curb. Do you wear shoes?
I see a big bike lane next to the road. How do I ride a bike on it?
Keep your hands on the bars and your feet on the pedals. Have you ridden a bike before?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my sister at the park today.
Oh, that sounds fun. What did she do there?
We played tag on the grass.
Tag is a good game to play. Did you win?
I ran away and she could not catch me.
You must be very fast. That is nice.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss the big green island.
That sounds hard. Do you remember the sand?
Yes, it was warm and soft.
I am glad you have good memories.
But I cannot see it from here.
You can look at a picture of it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw the big blue train today!
That sounds like so much fun! Did it go very fast?
Yes, it was super fast and quiet!
I am glad you are having a nice ride!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big dog. Is it nice?
I do not know. Do you see its tail?
Yes, it is wagging. I want to pet it.
That is a good idea. Does it look happy?
Yes, I think so. It has a wet nose.
I am glad you are having fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How did you make a new friend today?
I said hello to a new neighbor. Did you like meeting them?
Yes, but I felt shy at first. How did I seem to you?
You looked a little nervous, but you were smiling. Did you play a game together?
We played tag for an hour. Do you have any tips to make friends easier?
Just be kind and listen to them. Do you want to play again tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to feel happy every day. How can I start?
A simple smile helps a lot. Do you like to smile in the mirror?
Yes, but I feel sad sometimes. What else can I do?
Try taking a short walk outside. Do you have a favorite place to walk?
I like the park, but it is far away. Can I practice at home?
You can dance to your favorite song inside. Is there a song you love?
I like that idea. I will try it tonight. Thank you.
You are welcome. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to hit the ball hard.
You should bend your knees to get more power. Do you watch tennis on TV?
Yes, I love watching the big players.
Watching them is good, but you must practice your swing often.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to say at the meeting.
That sounds hard. What is the meeting about?
It is about work. I feel scared.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you have notes ready?
Yes, I have papers, but I am still unsure.
Look at your notes. Then speak slow.
Should I stand up?
Yes, standing helps. I do not know your room, but it is a good move.
Okay, I will try to stand and speak.
Good plan. You can do this.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know about Rome fast.
Rome was a big city in Italy long ago. Do you like buildings?
Just tell me who ruled it.
Kings, then a group of leaders, then empires. Was that enough?
Yes, and what came next?
The Roman Empire split in two later. It is a true fact.
I am running late, just a tip.
Think of the Colosseum when you think of Rome. Do you know where that is?
Thanks, I must go now.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That is great news! What made you smile?
I got a new puppy with my sister.
How lovely! Does she like the puppy too?
Yes, we love him so much.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. How do I grow carrots?
You put the seeds in the dirt and water them. Do you have a sunny spot?
Yes, my yard has sun. What else do I need?
Just keep the soil wet and wait a few weeks. I do not know when you can pull them out.
I do not have time to wait. Can I eat them now?
No, they are not ready yet. Would you like tips for faster plants?
Yes, what grows fast?
Radices are quick to grow. Good luck with your busy day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My fish is sleeping on the bottom. Is he dead?
That looks like a nap, not death. Does he have any open eyes?
No, both eyes are shut tight. What should I do now?
Do not touch him yet. Have you checked if his gills move?
I checked, and his gills are not moving at all. I am so scared.
I am sorry, but I think he is gone. Did you feed him today?
Yes, I gave him food this morning. Why is he not eating?
I do not know why he stopped eating. Was the water warm or cold?
The water feels cool to my hand. What should I do with him?
I suggest you put him in a small box outside. Do you have a box?
I have a shoe box in the closet. Is that a good place?
Yes, that is a kind place. Good job taking care of him.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: It is so hot today. I feel sick from the heat.
I am sorry you are not feeling well. Do you have a fan?
No fan. Just a hot fan. I hate summer.
That sounds very uncomfortable. Would a cold drink help?
Maybe. But the water is warm too.
I do not know why the water is warm. I hope it feels better soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the cold wind. It makes my face hurt.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you have a warm scarf?
I have a scarf, but it does not work. Winter feels too long.
That sounds very tiring. Do you like the snow?
No, I do not. I just want the sun back.
I understand your wish. I hope the sun comes soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a new friend. He is very kind.
That is good news. Do you like playing with him?
Yes, we play ball. But I must go now.
Do not be late. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I am getting married soon.
That is great news. I am happy for you. What is your favorite part of the plan?
I love the dress. It is white and soft.
White is a lovely color. Do you have a date for the day?
Yes, it is next month. It will be warm and sunny.
That sounds lovely. Will you have a big cake?
Yes, a tall cake with red icing. I cannot wait to eat it.
That sounds sweet. Enjoy your special day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot find my book. I feel very sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you check the top shelf?
No. I have looked everywhere.
That is frustrating. Let us look together.
I think it is lost forever.
I hope it is not. Are you sure you took it out?
Yes. I remember bringing it home.
We can ask the librarian. Do you want to go with me?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am thinking of having a small wedding at a park.
That sounds nice and fresh. Do you like the color green?
Yes, I love green. What should we feed the guests?
Simple food works well. Do you like sweet food or salty food?
I like both. How many people can fit in that park?
I do not know the exact number.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel lost on the field when I get the ball.
Take your time and look up before you move. Do you have a favorite spot to play?
I like being up front, but I am not sure what to do there.
Try to find space and wait for a pass. Do you watch other players to learn?
I watch a lot, but I get scared of the big defenders.
That is okay, just stay calm and keep moving. Have you tried running with the ball?
I do, but I lose it quickly.
Practice keeping the ball close to your feet.
That makes sense. I will try it tomorrow.
Good luck, and have fun out there.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
It is blue because of how light works. Do you like looking up?
Yes, but why?
Sunlight has all colors, but blue bounces around the most. Does that make sense?
A little, I think.
Great job asking questions. Do you see any clouds?
I see one big one.
Clouds are white because they block the light. Keep looking up.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so mad because I cannot sleep.
That sounds very hard. What did you eat tonight?
I ate too much candy and my tummy hurts.
Candy can wake you up. Do you have a cozy blanket?
My blanket is too thin and I am cold.
Warm feet help you sleep. Have you tried a hot drink?
No, I only have cold water and I am still thirsty.
Cold water is fine, but let us try something else. Is your room too bright?
The moon light is shining right in my eyes.
Let us close the window to make it dark. I do not know if that will fix it all, but it may help.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel so alone inside. How do I stop this?
I cannot fix your heart, but I can listen. What did you do today?
Just sat in my room all day. It feels very quiet.
Quiet can be hard. Do you have a pen and paper?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to learn a song for the show today.
That is a tight race. Do you have the lyrics ready?
I only have the melody in my head.
Focus on breathing out on each note. Is your throat tight right now?
It feels a bit weird, but I must go.
That is normal for new singers. Take your time if you can.
I will try, but I am late.
You will do your best. Good luck out there.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to plan a picnic, but I am lost.
That is a nice idea. Do you have a list of food?
I have some fruit and bread. What else should I bring?
You could add cheese or crackers. How many people are coming?
Just my family of four. Can we go to the park?
Yes, the park is a great spot.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a big red circle on the ground today.
That sounds like a fun find. Did you touch it?
Yes, it was smooth and cool to the touch.
Smooth circles are nice. What else did you see?
I saw a square box next to the circle.
A square box is steady. Was it empty?
It was full of little green dots.
Dots inside a square is interesting. Did you count them?
I could not count them all because there were too many.
That is okay. Not knowing the exact number is fine.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to ride my bike in the park.
That is fun. Do you like to ride at night?
No, it is too dark and scary.
That makes sense. Do you wear a helmet?
Yes, my mom always checks for me.
Good. Safety is very important.
I want to buy a new red one.
That sounds great. Do you have enough money?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to feed the cows.
Give them some fresh grass. Do you have any?
No, the grass is wet.
Then try some dry hay. Does the barn have hay?
Yes, there is a big pile.
That is a good choice. How many cows do you have?
Just two little ones.
Give them a small amount each. Is it time for lunch?
Yes, they are hungry.
Feed them slowly.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad and my head hurts.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you drink some water?
Yes, but I still have a sore throat.
Let us try some warm tea. How does your throat feel now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big white tower today. It makes a bright light at night.
That sounds very nice. Does it stand by the sea?
Yes, it sits on a rock. The waves hit it all day.
Wow, that is a strong place. Do you like looking up at it?
I do. It is very tall and old. I feel happy when I look at it.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so tired but I am very happy today.
That is a nice feeling. What made you so happy?
I played in the mud all afternoon.
Mud is great for fun. Do you want to rest now?
Yes, I think I will sleep a little.
Sleeping helps you feel strong. Good night.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: Today I found a bug in my shoe.
That sounds odd. Did you let it go?
I did, but I kept the dust inside.
Why did you keep it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I saw water on the leaves, but I think the roots drink. Why does the water go up?
The plant pulls the water up using a tiny pump in its leaves. Have you ever tried to suck water through a very thin straw?
That sounds hard. Why does the plant need to work so hard to lift the water?
It needs the water to make food from the sun. Do you like when your body is cool and hydrated after running?
Yes, I do. Do plants feel thirsty like I do?
I do not know for sure, but they do dry out if they lack water. Do you want to water your plant now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the teacher smiling so much?
She is happy because the class behaved well. Do you like to be good too?
Yes, but why does she look so tired?
She has been working hard all day long.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I am going to get married soon.
That is great news. What color is your dress?
It is white and very pretty. I feel like a dream.
How lovely. Do you have a favorite song for the dance?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to visit a small island. What is there?
Many islands have sand and sea. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I love the water. Is it far from the city?
Some are close, but you must take a boat. Do you like boats?
I do not know. How do I get one?
You book a ticket at the dock. I do not know your exact island, but help is easy there.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do you know where the lighthouse is? I am late.
It is up the hill. Are you going for a walk?
No, I need to get to the boat.
Take the left path. Is the boat leaving soon?
Yes, in ten minutes.
Run fast. Good luck with your trip.
Thank you so much.
You are welcome. See you later.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so hot. The sun is very bright.
Yes, it is a hot day. Do you have a hat?
No time for a hat. I must run.
Be safe and stay cool. Are you going home?
Yes, I am. Please let me go.
Okay, you are welcome. Bye bye.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the library today and found a big blue book.
That sounds like a great find. What was the book about?
It was about a dragon who liked to read poetry.
A dragon who reads is very funny to imagine. Did you read the whole thing?
No, I only read the first part because it was too big.
That is a good way to start a new story. Do you plan to go back tomorrow?
Yes, I will bring the rest of the chapters with me.
I am glad you are enjoying your reading time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to save my coins. How do I do it?
Put them in a jar. How many coins do you have?
I have ten pennies. Is that enough to start?
Yes, ten is a good start. Do you like keeping them safe?
I do, but they roll away. Where should I keep them?
Use a box with a lid. Do you have a box?
I have a shoe box. Will that work?
Yes, a shoe box works well. Do you want to add coins every day?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know how the knight moves, now.
It goes in an L shape. Do you like knights?
I do not care, just tell me the rest.
The king moves one step any way.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red bus stop by the new park today. It looks very nice.
That sounds like a happy sight. Did you see any dogs there?
Yes, two small white ones were playing with a ball.
Good for them. I hope the park stays clean.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my birthday party. Please help.
Take this cake. Is it chocolate?
Yes, it is chocolate. I must run now.
That sounds sweet. Have a good day.
Thank you. I am going.
Bye.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing here and I do not know what to order.
That is okay. Do you like meat or vegetables?
I like both, but I am not sure.
Try the fish with rice. Is that good for you?
Yes, that sounds nice. I will do that.
Good choice. Have a happy meal.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start my math homework. It feels too hard.
Take a deep breath and look at the first problem. Do you have your book open?
Yes, I have the book, but I still do not get it.
That is okay, we will go step by step.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the farm today and saw so many cute pigs. I am very happy to tell you about it.
That sounds like such fun. Did the little pigs like to play in the mud?
Yes, they loved it and were very happy. I watched them for a long time.
I am glad you enjoyed the visit. Do you want to go back there again soon?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck. What should I do with my queen?
Maybe move her to a safe spot. Do you see any open squares?
I see one, but it looks bad. What if my king is in danger?
Protect your king first. Is he under attack right now?
No, but I want to win fast. Any good tricks?
Keep your pieces close together. You might find a plan.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I just moved to this new town. What should I do first?
A walk in the park is a great start. Is it sunny today?
Yes, it is sunny. Is there a good place to eat lunch?
I am not sure, but I know the bakery smells nice. Do you like bread?
Yes, I do. How do I get there?
It is just down that main street.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw big white flakes falling today.
That sounds lovely and quiet. Did you wear a warm coat?
Yes, I wore my blue coat with a hood.
A blue hood is nice for cold weather. Do you like the cold?
I do, but my toes felt very chilly.
Warm socks help a lot with cold toes. Do you have any hot drinks?
I had some warm milk with honey in it.
That sounds sweet and cozy for a snowy day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does the light flicker when I run the fan?
The fan uses a lot of power. Does the light buzz too?
No, it just blinks a little.
That means the wire might be loose. Is it old?
The house is ten years old.
It could be a weak connection. Do you smell any heat?
No, I do not smell anything.
Good, that is safe. Do you see any sparks?
No, there are no sparks.
Then it is likely fine for now. Please check with a pro later.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my train was late again.
That is very frustrating. Do you have much time to spare before you need to leave?
I missed a show I really wanted to see.
I am sorry to hear that. I do not know if they will run another one today.
I just wanted to enjoy the ride, but it was so crowded.
It is nice when trains are empty. Do you like sitting by the window?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad today and I do not want to play.
I am sorry you feel that way. What made you feel this way?
I lost my favorite toy and now I am very upset.
That sounds like a hard time to have. Do you want to try looking for it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How does a plant drink water?
The roots pull water up from the soil. Do you have a plant at home?
Then how does the water get to the leaves?
Tiny tubes in the stem push the water up. Does that sound simple enough?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, the street is so quiet today.
It does look very calm. Do you like the silence?
Yes, I love how still it feels.
That is a happy feeling. Is it usually this quiet?
No, it is usually loud with cars.
It is good to see the change.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad and scared today.
That sounds really hard. Do you want to talk about what is worrying you?
I am afraid I will fail my test.
It is normal to feel nervous. What did you study the most?
I read my notes but my brain feels empty.
Trying is a good start. Would you like to take a short break to eat something?
Yes, a snack might help my mind calm down.
That sounds like a great idea.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to swim in the warm water on that island. How do I start?
You look for a place where the sand is soft and the water is calm. Do you know how to float on your back?
I think I do, but it feels scary. What should I hold for safety?
Hold a float or a life ring to help you stay up. Do you have a swim cap to keep your hair out of your eyes?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke my racket string today.
Oh no, that is sad. Do you have another racket?
Yes, I have a red one.
Red is a great color. Do you like hitting the ball hard?
I like to smash it.
That sounds like fun. Are you playing outside?
Yes, in the park.
The park is a good place to play. Have a great time!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a small, green island with soft sand.
That sounds like a happy place. Do you have a boat?
Yes, my little red boat is ready to go.
I am glad you are excited. What did you see first?
I saw bright flowers and a sleeping cat.
A cat on a beach is a nice sight. Is it safe?
It is very safe and quiet there.
That is good to hear. Do you want to stay long?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a ball but I do not know where to play.
Do you have a friend to play with?
I have no one, just me and the ball.
That is sad. Can you kick it against a wall?
Yes, I can do that.
Good idea. It will help you learn.
I will try, thank you.
You are welcome. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so good today. Eating real food makes me happy.
That is wonderful news. What did you eat?
Just a big apple and some nuts. It is simple and sweet.
I like how simple that is.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I had a bad dream about a dark forest.
That sounds scary. What did you see in the dark?
I saw a big, scary wolf staring at me.
Ouch. Did you wake up with your heart beating fast?
Yes, it was thumping really loud in my chest.
That is how your body tells you there is no danger now. Do you want to hold your blanket tight?
Yes, I do. It makes me feel safe.
Good. Your body is safe in your bed.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at the white stuff falling from the sky.
Yes, it is snow. Do you like the cold air?
It tickles my nose. Is it frozen water?
That is right, it is frozen rain. Is your coat warm enough?
Yes, I have my big hat on. Does it melt in my hands?
Yes, it turns into water very fast.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go to the beach today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like to dig in the sand?
Yes, I will make a big castle for you.
I would love that. Will you bring me a shell?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I made a promise to feed my dog. Did I do a good job?
That is a kind thing to do. Does he seem happy now?
Yes, he ate all of his food. Do I have to feed him again?
Usually you feed them twice a day. Do you have lunch ready?
I am not sure about the time. Is it late?
I do not know the time. Are you hungry?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am too tired to read in bed.
Try sitting at a desk with bright light. Do you have a lamp?
No, but I have a phone.
Use a warm light app on your phone. Does that help?
It makes my eyes feel dry.
Blink often and take breaks every ten minutes.
Will that stop the dryness?
Yes, it helps your eyes rest.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My chair leg is wobbly.
That is annoying. Is it a wood chair?
Yes. It makes a bad sound.
I do not know the fix. Did it break?
No. It just moves a lot.
That sounds like a loose part. Do you see a screw?
I think I see one. It is small.
Good. Do not pull it out. Is it tight?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I promised my friend to meet at the park at noon. I forgot the time. Do I still need to go?
Yes, you should keep your word. It builds trust. Do you remember where the park is?
I think it is near the big red bridge. I am feeling very bad about forgetting.
It is okay to forget, but fixing it is good. Do you have a map with you?
No, I do not have a map. I hope the friend knows the way.
True promises matter most. Ask for help if you get lost.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. The bus is coming.
Breathe with me. Are you holding your ticket?
My hands are shaking. Can you help?
Yes, I will wait with you. Is your seat near the door?
Please do not make me wait. I miss it.
The bus is not here yet. Do you have your bag?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am writing a letter to my grandma.
That is a nice thing to do. What did you see today?
I saw a big red dog in the park.
A red dog is very special. Was it friendly?
Yes, it let me pet its soft fur.
I am happy it was a good day. Did you play a game?
I played catch with my dad.
Catch is a fun game. Do you want to write about that too?
Yes, I will write about the ball and the grass.
Good luck with your words.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel sad because I cannot ride my bike.
That is okay. Do you want to try again?
Yes, but I am scared of falling.
I will hold the seat for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
