exchanges: I am so mad. This line is too long.
I hear you. Do you have a seat nearby?
No. I have been standing for hours.
That is very tiring. Did you bring a snack?
I forgot my lunch. My stomach is empty.
I am sorry. I do not have any food.
This is not fair at all.
It feels hard right now. Is the line moving?
Yes, but very, very slow.
You are doing your best. Give it a little time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to save my coins, but I forget to put them in my piggy bank.
That is a good goal. Do you have a place for it near your bed?
No, the piggy bank is far away in the closet.
Try putting your coins on your desk first, then move them to the bank at night.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am mad. The car will not move right.
That feels bad. Do you want to try again?
I am scared of hitting the wall.
Slow is good. Where do you feel stuck?
My hand is so tight on the wheel.
Let out your breath. Is the seat comfy?
No, it is too high. My eyes hurt.
Let's fix that. Can you reach the dashboard?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I watched a movie about a dog today.
That sounds nice. Did the dog have a name?
Yes, his name was Rex. He was very big.
Big dogs can be strong. Did he help anyone?
He helped a boy who was lost.
That is a kind thing to do. Was the boy sad at first?
Yes, he was crying. But Rex was good.
A good dog makes people feel safe. Did you like the end?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. What makes you feel this way?
I do not know. It is just there.
It is okay not to know. Do you want to sit with me?
I would like some advice.
Try to take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost the whole pile of cards.
Oh no, that feels bad. Did you look under the table?
I did look everywhere.
I am sorry you are sad. Do you want to play a new game?
Maybe, but I feel angry.
It is okay to feel that way. Would you like a drink?
Yes, please.
I will get you some water. Do you want a cookie too?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to eat, but I do not know what is good.
That is a hard choice. Do you want something warm?
Warm sounds nice, but I am not sure if I am hungry enough for that.
Maybe just a little fruit? Would an apple help?
Yes, an apple sounds perfect right now.
Great. That is a smart pick.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My grandma is feeling very sad today.
That must be hard for you. What made her feel this way?
She miss her old friends a lot.
People miss their loved ones when they are far away. Do you know what they used to play together?
They played cards and ate cookies.
Maybe you can play cards with her too. Would you like to try?
Yes, that sounds like a nice plan.
That is a kind thing to do. I hope it makes her smile.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to paint big red circles on my paper.
That sounds like so much fun. Do you use a brush?
I use a little blue brush, but my hands get dirty.
Being messy is the best part of art! What color will you paint next?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I draw a rainbow?
Do you have any crayons? You can just draw a big arc and color it with the colors you see in the sky.
What order do the colors go in?
It starts with red on the top. Then comes orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet on the bottom.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I grew a big red tomato today. I am so happy!
That is great news. Did you plant it yourself?
Yes, I dug the hole and put the seed in. How big can it get?
It can get very big if the sun is warm. Do you have room for more plants?
Yes, I have a big pot too. What should I plant next?
Peas grow very fast. Do you like eating peas?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The loud sirens make my head hurt.
That sounds very noisy. Is the car bad?
Too many cars and people everywhere.
I am sorry. Do you see a park?
I just want some quiet air.
Walking helps. Are you tired?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I made a big mess with paint today, but I painted my whole room blue.
That sounds like a lot of work. Did you enjoy making it?
Yes, I feel very happy and proud of my new blue room.
You should be. I hope you sleep well in it tonight.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we shuffle the cards?
We mix them up so no one can guess the next one. Do you like mixing things?
Yes, I do. Why is the deck different from a paper stack?
Cards are thin and smooth, so they glide well. Do you hold them tight?
I hold them in my hand. Why do some suits have a star?
That star is just a pretty design for the suit. Do stars make you happy?
Yes, they do. Why does the game end so fast?
The rules make us stop when the cards run out. I do not know why it feels so quick.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My legs feel very tired and stiff.
That is normal after sitting so long. Do you have any snacks in your bag?
I do have some cookies and juice.
Great. Walk to the end of the aisle to stretch. Are your shoulders relaxed?
They hurt a little bit.
Shake your arms out to help them. Would you like to try that now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to make bread. What do I do first?
Mix flour, water, yeast, and salt. Do you have warm water?
I have cold water. Will that work?
No, cold water will not help yeast grow. Try warm water like a bath. Is the kitchen warm?
Yes, it is warm. Now what?
Mix well, then let it rest for an hour. Do you have a bowl to cover it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I rode the big train to the city today.
That sounds like a fun ride. Did you see the mountains?
Yes, they were very tall and gray.
I am glad you saw them. Did you bring a book?
I did, but I fell asleep before I started.
That is okay, rest is good.
I woke up right as we stopped at the station.
You must have had a quick trip.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red boat at the dock today.
That sounds fun. Was it moving in the water?
Yes, it was going very fast and splashing.
How exciting. Did you wave to the boat?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love apples. I have to run.
Apples are great. Do you like red ones?
Yes, I do. Bye.
Bye. Do you eat them for lunch?
No, I am too busy.
Okay. I do not know your secret time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is very loud today. I do not know what to do.
It can be scary. Do you like the sound?
I do not like it. My house shakes.
Close the windows tight. Does that help?
The wind is still blowing hard outside.
Stay inside for now. It is safe there.
I feel better now. Thank you.
I am glad you are okay.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you know where the nursery is?
I think it is down that hall. Is the baby sleeping well?
Yes, he is quiet. I must run now.
Hurry, but be safe. Do you need a stroller?
No, I have one. Thank you.
You are welcome. I hope you have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to run more, but my legs hurt.
Rest is good for your body. How far do you run now?
I try to go far, but I feel tired.
Start small and go slow. Do you drink water after?
I do drink, but I feel sad I am slow.
Every step makes you stronger. Is your heart beating hard?
It beats fast, but I think it is okay.
Your body is learning a new skill. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do I need to use hot water for my dark shirts?
No, use cold water to keep the colors from fading. Are your shirts new?
I have some bright red spots on my white shirt.
Try rubbing a little soap on the spot right away. Did you spot the stain right after it happened?
My socks are very smelly even after washing.
Wash them with hot water and extra detergent. Do you wear the same socks every day?
Should I put my wool sweater in the dryer?
No, let it dry flat on a towel to stop it from shrinking. Do you have a flat surface to use?
How long does a normal wash take?
It usually takes about thirty minutes. Do you usually play while it runs?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue boat in the water today.
That sounds fun. What color was it?
It was blue with a red top on the back.
I love red and blue. Did you see any people on it?
Yes, a man was sitting on the edge and drinking juice.
How nice of him. Did you talk to him?
No, I just watched him for a while and then went home.
That sounds like a peaceful end to the day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue during the day?
The sun makes the air look blue. Do you like the color blue?
The sun feels hot when I stand in it.
Yes, it gives us warm light. Does it warm your feet?
I cannot see the sun at night.
The Earth blocks the sun from you. Do you like looking at stars?
Is the sun a ball of fire?
I do not know for sure. Does it look like fire to you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I lost the game again.
Oh no. Did you try a new move today?
Yes, but my friend just took my queen. It feels so unfair.
That is really hard when it happens. How did you feel right after that?
I just wanted to quit. I think chess is not for me.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you want to play a simple game just for fun?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel tired all the time.
Are you getting enough water?
Yes, I drink a lot of juice.
Try real water instead of juice.
What else can I eat?
Do you like vegetables?
Not really, I prefer candy.
Try some fresh fruit.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to paint a sky.
That is a fun idea. Do you have any blue paint?
Yes, I have a big jar of it.
Great. Mix it with a little white to make it lighter. Do you have a brush?
I have a big, thick brush.
That works well for big shapes. Just swipe it across the top of the paper. Do you like clouds?
I think clouds are very soft.
Yes, they are. Use a lighter blue or white to draw them. Do you want to add a sun?
I would love to add a yellow sun.
That sounds bright and happy.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do mountains touch the sky?
Yes, the peaks get very high. Do you like snow?
I must run. Are they made of rock?
Mostly rock, but sometimes ice. Why are you in such a hurry?
My bus is leaving. Do they have trees on top?
Not on the very top. It is too cold.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the barn this morning. The cows were very happy to see me.
That sounds like a lovely start. Do you like feeding the cows?
Yes, I gave them some warm water. One cow even boomed at me.
How fun that must have been. Was it a big cow or a small one?
It was a big one with a long tail. I then saw a duck in the pond.
A duck in the water is very nice. Did you listen to its quack?
I did, and then I saw a little red hen. She was pecking the dirt for food.
You had a busy day on the farm.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure why the sky is blue.
Sunlight has many colors. Do you know which one scatters the most?
I do not know. What happens to the light?
Blue light scatters all around. Is that why it looks so deep?
I think I understand now.
That is great. Do you like the blue color?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights just went out. I do not know what to do.
Do not worry. Is it only your house or the whole street?
I think it is just our home. What should I do now?
You can try your flashlights. Did you have any batteries with you?
Yes, I found some in the box. Is it safe to leave them on?
Yes, it is safe. Please enjoy the dark.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my favorite cup and I am very sad.
I am sorry it broke. Did you drop it?
Yes, I slipped and the cup smashed.
That is a tough feeling. Do you know how to clean it up?
I am trying, but I feel clumsy.
You are just having a bad moment. Take a deep breath?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My boss yelled at me. I feel so bad inside.
That sounds really hard. Did he yell about the mistake?
Yes, I broke a cup. My hands are shaking now.
Breaking a thing happens to all of us.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the red piece here?
It fits in the last spot. Do you see the curve?
I do not see a curve.
Look at the top edge. Is it round?
Yes, it is round.
That matches the hole. Why did you put it down?
I was not sure.
Trust your eyes. It is ready to go.
I will put it in.
Well done. You solved it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I bought a big candy today. It cost two dollars. I feel a bit bad.
That sounds expensive for a small treat. Do you keep the cash in a jar?
I put my extra coins in a blue cup. It makes a nice sound. I like it.
That is a fun way to save. How many coins do you have now?
I have about ten coins. I want to buy a comic book next month.
Ten coins will help you get closer. What is the price of that book?
The book costs ten dollars. I hope I can save enough by then.
That is a good goal to work toward.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am feeling very happy today.
That is great to hear. What made you feel this way?
I sat in the park and watched the birds.
Birds are fun to watch. Do you plan to go back?
I think I will every day this week.
That sounds like a good plan. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to move my things.
That can feel big. Do you have a truck?
I have a small car and a lot of boxes.
That is a hard mix. What is the heaviest box?
It has books and pots in it.
Put the heavy things in the small car first. Do you have friends to help?
Yes, my brother can come on Saturday.
That sounds good. What will you do with the empty boxes?
I will keep them for my new home.
That is smart. Take one step at a time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the clock tick all the time?
The spring inside pushes a wheel to move the hands. Do you like hearing the sound?
I do not like the sound.
That is okay. You can cover your ears. Do you have a quiet spot to sit?
I just want to know why the hands move.
A small battery or spring gives the energy. Does your clock use a battery?
Yes, it uses a battery.
The battery makes a tiny motor turn. Do you know how to open the back?
I do not know how to open it.
I can show you a picture if you want. Do you have a screwdriver?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late and I need dinner now. What should I make?
The clock is running fast. Do you have any eggs?
I have eggs, bread, and butter. That is all I have time for.
You can make a quick fried egg on toast. Would you like a tip on the eggs?
Yes, please. I am still running out the door.
Crack the eggs into a hot pan with butter for two minutes. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a big fish by the water but do not know what to do with it.
Is it hurt or sick?
No, it looks happy, but I do not know where to put it.
Please put it back in the river so it can swim.
I am worried it will get lost in the water.
I do not know its home, but the river is its place.
Okay, I will place it gently back in the flow.
That was a very kind thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired after cleaning the house.
That sounds hard. Did you drink some water?
Yes, I had two big cups.
Good for you. What did you clean first?
I swept the floor and washed the dishes.
You worked very hard. Are you going to rest now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a sad bird on the ground. It looks hurt. What do I do?
That is very kind of you to help. Is the bird moving its wings?
No, it is lying still. I want to make it happy again.
I do not know if it can fly. Please call your mom to help you right now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How many months are in one whole year?
There are twelve months in a year. Do you know the first one?
Yes, it is January. Is winter cold then?
Yes, winter is often very cold. Do you like to play outside?
I like snow, but my feet get cold. What is the next month?
The next month is February. It is still part of winter.
What comes after February?
March comes after February. The flowers start to grow.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count things?
We count to know how many there are. Is that clear to you?
Yes, but why start at one?
One is the very first number. Do you like counting?
I do! Why do we use our fingers?
Our hands help us see the numbers. I do not know if you prefer counting on toes.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared of the new people next door.
That is okay to feel. Do you like them yet?
No, they have a big dog that barks loud.
Dogs often bark when they are new. Is the dog mean?
I think so, because he jumps on the fence.
He is probably just trying to play. Would you like to say hello?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I can never tell time on this clock.
That feels frustrating. What part is tricky for you?
The big hand moves too fast. It makes me dizzy.
Focus on the numbers one to twelve first. Do you know what the small hand does?
No, I don't know what it is for.
The small hand shows the hours. It moves very slow.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love this song, but I am late.
It has a nice beat. Where are you going?
To school. Do you know the name?
I do not know the name. Do you like the drums?
Yes, they are loud. I must go now.
Have a good day. Run safe.
Thanks. Bye.
Bye. Be careful.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very slow when I run on the field. How can I get faster?
Try to run on your toes and keep your knees high. Do you have good shoes?
Yes, I do. But I keep dropping the ball. What should I do?
Practice holding the ball close to your body. Is it a hard ball or a soft one?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I do not know what time it is.
You can look at the clock. Do you have a clock?
No, I lost it. Now I am stuck.
That is sad. Let us find one together.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you paint?
It makes my heart feel calm. Do you like colors?
Yes, I do. Why is painting so fun?
You can make anything you wish. What is your favorite color?
I love red. Why does red feel warm?
I do not know the exact reason. It looks like fire to me.
That makes sense. Why do you paint every day?
It helps me share my feelings. Do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The web feels too big. How do I start?
Do you have a favorite topic? Start by typing that word into the box at the top.
I found a page. Is it safe?
I do not know. Check if the site has a small lock icon near the name.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my guitar string. Now I cannot play.
That is very sad to hear. Do you have a spare string?
No, I only had one string left in the box.
I am sorry you do not have another. Is it a hard piece to fix?
Yes, it is too tricky for my small hands.
That must feel frustrating. Would you like to try with help?
No, I just want to forget about music for today.
It is okay to take a break. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my heart feel so warm and light today?
It feels warm because you are safe and loved. Do you like this feeling?
Yes, it is very nice.
That is good to hear. What makes you smile right now?
The sun is shining on my face.
Sunshine is a great friend. Do you have any plans for the day?
I want to play in the park.
That sounds like fun. Who will you play with?
I will play with my little sister.
Playing together feels like happiness. Have a lovely time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My sister is very sad today. I do not know how to fix it.
You can just sit with her. Is she playing a game?
No, she is crying. I want to make her smile.
Try telling her a funny story. Do you know one?
I have a bad feeling about it. What if it does not work?
It may not, but you tried. That is good.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That is great! What makes you so happy?
I am packing a bag for a trip.
That is exciting. Where are you going?
I am going to visit my grandma.
She will be so glad to see you. What are you putting in the bag?
I am putting my toys and books in.
Smart choice. Do you have your jacket?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had the worst day at work today.
I am so sorry to hear that. What made it so hard?
My boss was very angry and rude.
That sounds very unfair and scary. Did you talk to someone about it?
No, I just went home and cried.
It is okay to feel sad. Do you want to talk more or just rest?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look! A big rainbow in the sky.
Wow, that is so bright. Which color do you like best?
I love the red one on top.
Red is a very warm color. Do you want to get closer?
Yes, I want to touch it.
You cannot touch it, but you can look. It is made of light.
That sounds cool.
It is very cool. Do you see any birds flying near it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared about the big test tomorrow.
I know that feeling. Are you ready to practice a little bit?
No, I do not know all the words.
That is okay. We can start with just one word first.
What if I forget everything?
You will not. I will help you, and you can take breaks if you are tired.
Okay, I will try my best.
That is a great plan. Let us begin now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love working from home today.
That is great. What did you do?
I made coffee and watched birds.
How nice. Do you have a pet?
Yes, my cat is very happy.
What a sweet cat. I do not know much about cats.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I count to ten?
Start with one and say the next number, like two and three. Do you know your numbers?
Yes, I know them, but how do I stop?
Stop after you say ten. Is that clear?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so busy. My chair hurts and I have to work all day.
That sounds hard. Do you have a break?
I only stop for water. I feel stuck.
Try to step outside for a bit.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My teacher feels very sad lately.
That is a kind worry to have. Do you know why she is sad?
I do not know why. I want to help her, but I feel lost.
You can simply ask her if she needs a friend. Is that something you can do?
I am afraid she will think it is strange.
True friends care for each other. Would you like to try a small smile first?
Yes, a smile feels safe and easy.
That is a wonderful start. I hope it brings her some light.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am very scared to start my new job tomorrow.
It is normal to feel nervous. Do you like the work you are doing?
I think I do, but I worry I will make a big mistake.
Everyone makes mistakes when they are new.
What should I do if I do break something?
Just tell your boss right away. That is how you fix most problems.
Do I need to dress in a suit?
I do not know what they require. Did they send you a note about clothes?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very tired today.
That sounds hard. Are you getting enough rest?
I tried to sleep, but my mind will not stop.
Deep breaths help slow thoughts. Do you have a calm place to go?
I have a quiet room, but I still feel heavy.
Being tired is real and okay. Would you like to try a short walk?
A walk might help, but I am too low on energy.
Then rest is the right choice. I am glad you are listening to your body.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a big pizza.
What kind of toppings do you like?
I love cheese and pepperoni.
That sounds yummy. How big should the pizza be?
The biggest one, please.
I can order that for you. Are you drinking juice or milk?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate this cold rain. It ruins my day.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a warm coat?
I left my coat at home. Now my shoes are wet.
That sounds very uncomfortable. Are your feet dry inside?
No, the water is in my socks. I feel so miserable.
That is not good. Do you have socks at work?
Yes, I can change them. But I still feel sad about the rain.
Changing them might help you feel better. Is there anything else you need?
I just wish the sun would come out.
The sky is clearing a bit now. You may see some sun soon.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind is very loud today.
It does sound strong. Did it blow your hat off?
Yes, it flew right into the tree.
That is a tricky spot. Do you have a long stick?
No, just my short hands.
You might need a friend's help.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the doctor today and I am so happy!
That is good news. What made you so glad?
The doctor said my knee is all fixed up.
I am happy for you. Does it still hurt?
No, it does not hurt at all.
That is wonderful.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to count to ten.
That is a great goal. Do you know your numbers?
I know up to five, but I am stuck after that.
Start with five, then say six, seven, eight, nine, and ten.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the queen so strong?
She can move many squares in any direction. Do you have a queen in your set?
Yes, I found it. But why is the king so weak then?
He can only move one step at a time. It is a good job for him to stay safe.
Why do we not just move the king everywhere?
He must stay hidden to survive. Why do you want to learn chess?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am going by train today.
That sounds fun. Where are you going?
I am not sure where the train stops.
Do you have a map?
No, I forgot it at home.
Ask the driver.
Is it safe to sleep on the train?
Yes, it is safe. Do you like to sleep?
I just want to know if I should eat first.
Eat before you go.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got back from my train trip and I feel so happy.
That is wonderful to hear. What did you see out the window?
The green hills moved by so fast and the sky was very blue.
I am glad you enjoyed the view. Did you have a good snack with you?
Yes, I ate a warm apple pie and it was perfect.
That sounds like a sweet treat. I do not know if you will go again soon.
I think I might go next month to see the mountains.
That sounds like a great plan. Will you take a book this time?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late! My cat is hiding.
Is he under the bed?
No. I checked there.
He may be in a box. Do you like boxes?
I do not have time.
Try his favorite spot. Is it on the rug?
Yes, he is there!
Good luck with your plans.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very tired today. Why do I feel this way?
Your body needs rest to heal. Did you eat enough food?
That makes sense. I did not sleep well.
Sleep helps your mind and body. Do you like reading before bed?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is wonderful. Why do you feel so good?
I bought some bright red tulips.
Red is a bold choice. Do you love them?
Yes, they make me smile.
It is nice to share that joy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I have a top-secret trick. How do I make it work?
That sounds fun. Do you have a special tool?
Yes, I have a magic box. What do I press first?
I do not know that trick. Is the box red or blue?
It is red. I press the red button.
Good luck with your secret. Tell me what happens next.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not like math class.
That is okay. Why do you feel that way?
The numbers are too hard.
It can be tricky. Do you like drawing?
Yes, I love drawing.
Great! You can draw the numbers to learn.
Will that help me?
Yes, it often helps. Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go for the holiday.
What kind of place makes you feel happy?
I like quiet spots, but I am tired of sitting alone.
Have you thought about a quiet boat trip?
A boat? That sounds too hard for me.
It is easy if you just watch the water. Do you like boats?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very happy today. I found a big, red apple in my bag.
That sounds like a great surprise. Do you like apples when they are sweet?
Yes, I do. I ate it right away on the bus.
Eating on the bus is fun. Do you always carry fruit with you?
Not always. But I want to be healthy.
Being healthy is a good goal. I am glad you enjoyed your apple.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to find my picture.
Did you look in your photo folder?
I looked, but it is not there.
Try typing the name in the top box. What did you call it?
I called it dog.
Type the word dog and look for the image. Do you see it now?
Yes, I see my dog.
That is good news. Did you find anything else you needed?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my voice sound big for the play?
You can stand up tall and speak from your belly. Do you like to shout when you are happy?
I want it to sound strong, not just loud.
Try pushing the air out slowly to keep it steady. Is this part of your song?
No, it is a talking part.
Then breathe in deep and let the words ring out. Can you show me how you say it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: Why do the leaves fall off the trees in the fall?
The tree stops making food when the days get short. Do you like the cold air?
I am not sure if I should put on a coat or not.
It is true that it is getting cooler outside. Would a hat help you feel warm?
Maybe, but I do not know what to do next.
You can look out the window first. Do you see any birds?
I see one, but I still feel unsure.
That is okay, take your time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad about leaving my old house.
That feels hard. Do you have a favorite spot to miss?
The tree in the yard is gone now.
I am sorry to hear that. What will you do first at the new place?
I will just sit on the floor for a while.
Take your time. Are you afraid of the new room?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors. Blue light bounces around in the air. Do you like the color blue?
I do. But why does only blue bounce?
Red light goes straight through the air. Blue light scatters all over the place.
That is interesting. Is the ocean blue for the same reason?
The ocean looks blue because it reflects the sky. It also absorbs some red light.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My cat is under the bed. Help me find him. I am late.
Look under the blanket first. Is he purring?
No, he is not there. What now? I need to go.
Try checking his favorite box. Is he hungry?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am late for my big show. What should I do?
Tell your teacher you are on the way. Is it a school show?
Yes, it is. I am so scared they will be mad.
Most people are kind when you are honest. Do you know how late you are?
I am ten minutes late. I feel very bad.
Ten minutes is not too long. Take a deep breath and walk calmly. Are you wearing the right clothes?
Yes, I have my costume on. Thank you for helping me.
You can do this well. Have fun with your song.
Okay. I will walk in now.
Good luck with your time. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I ask a friend to play with me?
You can say, "Do you want to play with me?"
What if they say no?
It is okay to say, "That is fine," and find someone else.
Should I wave if I see a neighbor?
A small wave is a very nice way to say hello.
Do I have to wave at everyone?
No, you only wave when you feel happy to see them.
What if I drop my ice cream?
You can say, "Oh no, my treat!" and ask for help.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I help a baby bird that fell from its nest?
Put it back in the nest if you can reach it safely. Do you know where the nest is?
I see the nest, but it is too high up for me.
That is okay, wait for a parent bird to come back. Are you scared of heights?
I am not scared, I just cannot climb that tree.
A bird person can help you put it back. Would you like to call them?
Yes, please tell me who to call.
I do not know your local number, but you can ask a park ranger. Is there a ranger near you?
There is a ranger station nearby.
Great, they will help you. Good luck with the bird.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do bears sleep all winter?
Yes, they sleep for many months. Do you know what they eat before they sleep?
They eat a lot of berries and fish.
That is a good way to build up fat for the cold. Do you think they dream?
I think they dream about food.
That is a fun thought, though I do not know for sure. It is nice to talk with you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
The people are likely asleep. Do you like the silence?
Yes, I do. It feels very safe here.
It is a nice feeling. What can you hear right now?
I hear a bird singing far away.
That is a sweet sound. Birds often wake up early.
It is still dark outside.
The sun is not up yet. Do you see any lights on?
There is one small light by the door.
That is a warm touch. It makes the night feel friendly.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I love the big blue water. Can you tell me what lives down there?
Many fish and shells live in the deep water. Do you like to swim in it?
Yes, I do. What does the sea taste like?
It tastes very salty. That is the truth.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am sad because I broke my pencil and I do not know what to do.
Do not worry, I can help you. Do you have a sharpener?
No, I do not. What should I use?
You can ask your teacher for a new one. Are you afraid they will be mad?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am lost but I feel so happy!
That is a great feeling. What made you smile?
The trees are so pretty here.
Nature can be very calming. Do you like the sound of the wind?
Yes, it sounds like a song.
How wonderful for your ears. Which part of the song do you hear best?
The low hum feels nice.
I am glad it soothes you. Do you know which way home is?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My teacher said my drawing was bad. I feel sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did she explain why?
She said the sun was green and that is wrong.
That does not sound fair. Do you like your teacher?
Yes, but I think she is being mean today.
Teachers can have rough days too. I am glad you share this.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. My brother took my toy.
That feels bad. Do you want to talk about it?
Yes. He should not take my things.
I agree with you. That is not fair.
I feel very mad inside.
It is okay to feel mad. Will you try to play with him now?
Maybe. I am tired of fighting.
Good. Sharing is hard, but it can be fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My tomato plant has yellow leaves. What is wrong?
It may need more water or light. Is it getting enough sun?
Yes, it gets a lot of sun.
It might need food. Do you add dirt or feed to it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got a new phone and I am so happy.
That is great news! What color is it?
It is bright blue and looks very shiny.
Blue is a nice choice. Do you like how it feels in your hand?
Yes, it is light and smooth.
That sounds lovely. I do not know which brand it is.
I will take a picture of it for you later.
Please do. I want to see it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried and failed again. I feel so bad.
It is okay to feel sad. Do you want to take a short break?
Maybe, but I want to get it right this time.
I do not know if you will get it right, but I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights just went out. I do not know what to do.
Do not worry. Is there any sound outside?
It is very quiet. I am afraid.
Calm down. Are you safe in your room?
Yes, I am in my bed. What should I do now?
Sit still and wait. Does the light come back?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lights just went out! I am so happy.
That is fun! Do you have any candles?
Yes, we have many. I love the dark.
Dark places can feel cozy. What is your favorite thing about it?
I like eating chocolate in the dark.
That sounds tasty. Do you eat with your hands?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say sorry?
It shows we care about your feelings. Do you feel sad when someone hurts you?
Yes, I do.
It helps us fix the problem. Have you said sorry before?
I have said it once.
That is a good start. I do not know all the rules.
Do you think it makes people forgive me?
It often helps people feel better. Do you want to try saying it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I like to read at night?
It is quiet and your brain slows down. Do you like feeling calm before bed?
That makes sense. Is it good for my eyes?
Soft light is better than a bright screen.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am so tired of my food. What should I eat?
Try adding fresh veggies to your plate. Do you like carrots?
Yes, I like carrots. I think I will eat them.
That sounds good. Do you want a little dip?
A dip would be great. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy. I feel bad.
That feels sad. Did you look at their face?
Yes, she looked very unhappy.
Her face tells you she is hurt. Do you want to try a kind word?
Should I say I am sorry?
Yes, that is true and kind.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make bread.
That sounds fun. How much flour do you have?
I have one cup of flour.
One cup is a good start. Do you have yeast?
I do not know if I have yeast.
Yeast makes the dough grow. If you do not have it, use baking powder.
I found some old powder.
Old powder may not work well. Check the date on the box.
The date is very old.
Then you should buy fresh powder. Is your local store open?
Yes, I can go now.
Great. Let me know if you need more help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I put water on the leaves, but the plant looks sad.
Water goes down the stem, not up the leaves. Do you see the roots?
I do not know where the water goes inside the plant.
I do not know for sure about your plant, but water usually moves up tiny tubes.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: Today was very hard. I feel so tired.
That sounds rough. Did you get to take a break?
No, I just kept working. My brain hurts.
You worked hard. Go rest now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to cook dinner, but I do not know what to make. What is good?
Spaghetti is a great choice. Do you like meat in your food?
Yes, I love beef. How do I make the sauce?
You can simmer canned tomatoes with a little salt and oil. Do you have any onions or garlic?
I have both. Thank you for the help.
You are very welcome. Have a tasty dinner.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the driving school today and I was so scared of the big cars.
That is a very normal feeling. Did you sit in the driver's seat?
Yes, I did. The instructor was very patient with me.
That is good to know. Was it sunny outside?
It was bright and sunny. I finally stopped the car without hitting anything.
That is a great start. How did you feel after that?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The wind feels so nice today. I am so happy to tell you.
That sounds wonderful. Do you like when it blows soft or strong?
I like it soft, like a hug. It makes me feel light.
A hug from the wind is a sweet thought. Do you feel the trees dance in it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we wash our clothes?
Dirt makes clothes smelly and sad. Is your shirt dirty today?
Do hot water and cold water do the same thing?
Hot water cleans tough stains well. Cold water keeps colors bright. Do you like colorful clothes?
Why do we need soap to clean them?
Soap helps water grab the dirt. I do not know if all soap is the same.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to hold the handlebars so tight?
Holding them helps you stay upright and safe. Do you feel steady now?
Why does the bike get faster when I pedal harder?
The extra power from your legs makes the wheels spin quicker.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I can not find my red shoes.
Have you looked under the bed yet?
No, I only looked in the box.
Try checking under the bed, then let me know.
I found them! They were hiding there.
Great job. Do you want help with the next room?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is it so hot today?
The sun is very strong. Are you thirsty?
Yes, I am. Why does the sun make us sweat?
Your body is cooling you down. Do you have a drink?
Yes, I have a cold glass of water. Why is the water cold?
It was in the ice box. Do you like ice?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue dog today.
That sounds fun. What did the dog do?
It chased a red ball in the park.
I am glad you had a good time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My boss is very nice. He gave me a cookie today.
That is a very sweet thing to do. Did you eat it all?
Yes, it was yummy. I want to be nice like him when I grow up.
That is a wonderful goal. Do you like giving treats to your friends?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to draw a big red house.
That sounds fun. Do you like to use crayons?
Yes, I have a whole box of them.
Great choice. What color will the roof be?
Blue, like the sky outside.
Nice idea. Are you ready to start?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got off the bus and I feel so happy. The view was beautiful.
That sounds nice. Did you see any special buildings?
Yes, I saw a big red tower. It made me smile so much.
How lovely that you had a happy ride.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my last game. It is so hard.
That feels bad. Do you play with a friend?
Yes, but I keep making the same mistake.
I do not know which move you made. Do you like thinking about chess?
I love it, but I feel stupid when I lose.
You are not stupid. Try a new move next time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a bee on a flower today. It looked very busy.
Bees are hard workers. Do you like watching them?
They use sweet plant juice called nectar. They make honey with it.
That is a great gift. Do you eat honey?
It takes days for the honey to dry out. The bees fan it with their wings.
Nature is a clever builder.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My new computer is fast and fun. I love it so much.
That is great news. What games do you play on it?
It is very quiet too, which is nice.
A quiet machine is a good machine. Do you like the blue light?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what day it is.
It is Monday. Do you like this day?
I do not like Monday much.
That is okay. Is there a fun thing you want to do?
I forgot what comes after Monday.
Tuesday comes next. Do you have a plan for it?
I do not know what to do on Tuesday.
I do not know your plans. What would make you smile?
A nap and some warm soup.
That sounds nice. You can always rest.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Why does my bag stick to the fridge?
It sticks because of a magnet. Do you like cold drinks?
No time. What is a magnet made of?
It is often made of iron. I do not know the exact mix.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people celebrate their birthday?
It is a day to mark one year of life. Do you like getting gifts?
Yes, I do. Why do we blow out the candles?
We blow them out to ask for a wish. Do you make a wish?
I do. Why is that a good thing?
Wishing is fun and hopeful. Do you want to wish for something nice?
I want a puppy. Why is a birthday special?
It is special because you are unique. Do you feel happy today?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off trees?
The trees drop them to save energy for winter. Do you like the crunchy sound?
Yes, I do. It is very fun.
It is a lovely thing to hear. Do you play in the piles?
Sometimes I do. What happens next?
The cold snow comes after the leaves go.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today.
That sounds good. What made you smile?
I saw a big rainbow.
Rainbows are nice. Do you like colors?
Yes, blue is my best.
Blue is a calm color. I am glad for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I made a big sandwich.
That sounds very good. What is inside?
I put cheese and ham. I want to share it with you.
I do not know if I am hungry, but I will try one.
Here is a piece for you. Please take it.
Thank you. This is tasty. Did you pick the flowers?
Yes, I picked them in the park. They are for you.
You are very kind. I like the smell.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My fish is not moving. I feel very sad.
I am sorry you feel this way. Is the water cold or warm?
The water feels right, but he hides all day.
Hiding can mean he is scared or sick. Did you change the water recently?
Yes, I cleaned the tank two days ago.
Cleaning is good, but sudden changes can stress fish. Are his eyes looking normal?
I think they look fine, but I am worried.
That is kind of you to check. Have you fed him today?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go to the beach. What should I bring?
Please bring water and a hat. Do you like to swim in the waves?
Yes, I love swimming. How do I stay safe?
Always swim where a flag is up. I do not know if it is safe to swim today.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I put my shoes in the bag.
Great. Do you have your socks?
I think so.
Maybe check again to be sure.
Oh, they are in my pocket.
Good catch. What is next?
My water bottle is missing.
I do not know where it is.
I will look for it.
Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very scared inside. My tummy feels like it is twisting.
It is okay to feel scared. What makes you feel this way?
I am worried about my dog getting sick. I do not know what to do.
Dogs can get sick sometimes, but your doctor can help. Do you want to call him?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a toy that is not mine. What should I do?
That is a kind thing to notice. Do you know who dropped it?
I think it was the girl by the door, but I am not sure.
You can ask her if it is hers. It is a safe guess.
I am afraid she will say no and I will look silly.
She will likely be happy to get it back. Would you like to try together?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my hen stopped laying eggs.
That feels bad. Did you change her food?
No, but I think she is lonely.
That is a good thought. Do you have another hen?
Yes, but they do not talk.
You are right, they do not speak words.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to start.
Take one box at a time. What is your first task?
I have too many things to pack.
Pack the easy things first.
The truck is very big.
That is a good thing. Do you have a map?
I do not know which room to fill.
Fill the big rooms last. That keeps it easy.
This feels too hard for me.
You can do this. Take a small break now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the actors speak so loud?
They want the back row to hear. Do you like loud voices?
The red hat is very big. Why?
It makes him look funny. Does it make you smile?
I do not know why the bird is real.
I am not sure either. Ask the director later.
Can we go see the play again?
Yes, that sounds fun. Let us go now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a little boat. I do not know what to do with it.
That is a nice find. Do you want to play in the water with it?
Maybe, but I am not sure if it can float.
You can put it in a bowl of water to see. Would you like to try that?
Yes, I will test it. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. I hope it floats well for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. The floor is still dirty.
That is hard work. Do you want a break?
I do not know if I can keep going.
It is okay to stop. Can you smell the clean air?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the waves took my sand castle.
Oh no, that is very frustrating. Did you build it with your own hands?
Yes, I worked hard on it.
That takes great effort and skill. What is your next plan for the beach?
I want to swim, but the water is too cold.
Cold water can feel shocking. Do you have a warm towel to sit on?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My mom says we are moving to a new house soon.
That sounds like a big change. Are you feeling excited or scared?
I feel a little scared because I do not know my new friends yet.
It is normal to feel that way. Do you have a favorite toy to bring with you?
Yes, I will bring my blue teddy bear named Bear.
That is a good comfort item. What is your favorite room in the new house?
I think I want a room with a big window to see the stars.
That sounds like a peaceful place. Do you know where your bed will go?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The cow keeps mooing at me. I think she is angry.
She is probably just hungry or wants to play. Are you trying to give her food?
No, I just want to sit in the grass. My hands are dirty from the mud.
Cows love clean hands for hugging. Do you have a towel to wipe them?
I think I left my towel in the barn. It is raining outside.
That is a problem. Do you have an umbrella?
No umbrella, and the chickens are wet too. This is a bad day.
We can go inside and dry off together. What does your mama like to cook when it rains?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am so tired. My brain feels like mush.
That sounds very rough. Did you drink some water today?
No, I just drank too much coffee. I want to learn how to fold a paper boat.
I can help with that. Do you have a square piece of paper?
Yes, I have a white sheet. What is the first thing I do?
Fold it in half, then unfold it. Next, bring the top corners down to the middle line.
Is the boat done now? I am not sure if I did it right.
Not quite, but you are close. Do you want to try folding the top corners in again?
I tried, but it got messy. I will try again tomorrow.
That is a good plan. Rest well tonight.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I need a plan right now.
Let us go. Do you have your keys?
Yes. What should I do first?
Check your list. Is it clear?
No. I forgot the eggs.
Run to the store first.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. What month is it?
It is July. Are you going to work?
No, I am going to school.
School starts soon. Do you have your bag?
I have no time to look.
I do not know if you will make it. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I had a great day today.
That sounds wonderful. Did you do anything special?
My boss helped me fix a big mistake.
That is very kind of him. How did you feel about it?
I felt very happy and safe.
I am glad you feel safe. Do you talk to him often?
Yes, we talk every day.
That is nice. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a shed up today, but I do not know what wood to use.
You can use cedar or pine. Do you want the shed to last for many years?
Yes, it must last a long time. What size do I need?
Two by four feet is a good start. Do you have space for it?
I have a small spot, but I am running out of time.
I am not sure if that spot is big enough. Can you walk through it and count your steps?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What time is it when the big hand points to the six and the small hand points to the two?
It is two thirty. Do you like clocks?
Yes, but I do not know how to read them well. Can you help me?
I will show you the numbers. Is that hard for you?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My neighbor is very loud at night.
That is not nice. Are you having trouble sleeping?
Yes, I cannot rest.
Try talking to him kindly. Do you know how to start that talk?
I am afraid to speak.
You can write a short note instead. Would you like me to help?
Please, that sounds safer.
A kind note often works well. Start by saying you are a neighbor.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want a drink but I do not know which one to pick.
Tea is soft and warm. Do you like it sweet?
I think I want coffee because I am very tired.
Coffee gives you a quick boost. Are you okay with that energy?
Yes, but I am worried it will make me feel bad.
That can happen if you have an empty tummy.
I will eat a little toast first and then try the coffee.
That is a wise plan.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: The rain is hard. How do I keep my shoes dry?
Use a bag to cover them. Do you have one at home?
Yes, I do. Can I use tape to help?
Tape works well on the bottom. Is the road slippery for you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired but my brain will not stop racing.
That is very frustrating. Do you lie in the dark?
Yes, but I keep counting the hours until morning.
I agree counting feels worse. Try to feel your toes instead.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Where can I find the best sand?
The quiet spot near the rocks has soft sand. Do you like playing in the water?
I just want to build a big sandcastle.
That sounds like fun. I do not know if the wind will stop today.
What should I bring to keep my things dry?
A big towel helps a lot. Do you have any cool drinks with you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What should I bring to the park?
I suggest a big blanket and some fruit. Are you afraid of ants?
No, I like ants. Do you have a good idea for a snack?
I do not know what you like best. Do you like cheese?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to buy some milk, but I am very late.
The dairy is on the left. Is that a full gallon?
Yes, one gallon. Which way is the exit?
It is straight ahead, past the fresh fruit. Do you like the strawberries?
No, I have no time. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just found a restaurant that makes the best soup. It tastes like a warm hug.
That sounds very cozy. What kind of soup do they serve?
It has carrots and peas in it. My heart is so full right now.
I am glad you are happy. Do they have bread to go with it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my way on this map.
That feels bad. Do you see the big blue line?
I do not see it.
It is right there. Are you looking for the park?
Yes, but the path is gone.
There is a path here. Does it look clear to you?
No, it is just a mess.
Let us start from the top.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my goldfish move so fast?
It is playing with its friends. Do you see them chase each other?
Why do they stay near the top?
They are looking for warm air. Is the water too cold?
Why do they blink their eyes?
I do not know for sure. Does it look like it is sleeping?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I ate a big apple today and felt great!
That sounds very nice. Did you like the taste?
Yes, it was sweet and crunchy.
Crunchy is good for your teeth.
I want to eat more fruit now.
Fruit is a great choice. Do you like bananas?
I love bananas.
They are sweet too.
I feel strong and happy.
That is wonderful to hear.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must rush. Do you know where the new neighbors moved?
I do not know for sure. Are they noisy?
They play loud music. Is that okay?
Loud music can be hard to sleep to. Do you want me to tell them?
Please tell them to be quiet. I have work to do.
I will tell them kindly. Is everything else fine?
Yes, just the noise. Thank you.
You are welcome. I hope you feel better soon.
I have to go now. Bye.
Goodbye. Take your time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The boats rocked a lot in the morning.
That sounds like a wild start to your day. Did you see any fish?
Yes, the water was full of silver shapes.
What a lovely sight to see.
Then the sun came out and dried my hands.
I am glad the weather turned for the better. Do you like being near the water?
I love it when the air smells salty.
That is a nice feeling. What did you eat for lunch?
Just bread and cheese on the pier.
That sounds like a perfect simple meal.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My neighbour plays loud music every night. I can not sleep.
That sounds very rude. Do you know his name?
Yes, his name is Sam. He is very loud.
You can try to talk to him. Are you scared?
I am a bit scared. What should I say?
Just say the music is too loud. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I have a phone. Is that a good idea?
You can write a nice text first. I do not know if he will listen.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my grandma.
That is a sweet idea. Do you have any paper ready?
Yes, I have a white sheet and a blue pen.
Good. You should start with the date at the top.
How do I put the date on the paper?
Write the day and the month in the corner. Do you know what today's date is?
Today is the fifth of May.
Perfect. Now write "Dear Grandma" on the next line.
What words should I use next?
Tell her how your day went. What did you do today?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to bake a cake but I do not know how.
That sounds fun. Do you have an oven?
Yes, I have one, but I am lost.
Mix flour, sugar, eggs, and butter first. Then heat the oven to 350 degrees.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do plants get their water?
They take it in through the roots. Do you have a garden?
Yes, I want to help them drink better.
Give them enough water and light. Do you know how to check the soil?
No, how do I check?
Dig a little to see if it is dry.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My grandma gave me a cookie.
That sounds sweet. Did she say how she made it?
She said she baked it with love.
Love is a secret ingredient. Do you like the taste?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate that I keep losing. My friend is so good.
That feels bad, but you are learning fast. Do you play every day?
Yes, I try hard, but I always forget how the pieces move.
That is normal. Take a rest and try again later.
I guess I will just stop for now. I am tired.
Rest is good for your brain. Come back when you feel ready.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a fish swim fast to the top.
That is a good sign. Does it look happy?
I think it is eating the food.
Yes, they need food to grow strong. Do you feed them every day?
I put in too many flakes.
That can make the water dirty. Did you take the rest out?
The water looks a bit cloudy now.
Cloudy water makes fish sad. Have you cleaned the tank?
I added more fish last week.
Too many fish makes it hard. Do you have enough room for them?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went outside today and my tomato plant looks so happy. I wonder how it gets water into its tall green stem.
Roots take in water like tiny straws, and leaves lose some to keep the flow going. Do you see wet soil at the bottom of your pot?
Yes, the dirt is dark and moist. The water must go up through the plant like a secret pipe.
That is a great way to think of it. Plants use special paths inside to move water from roots to leaves.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do clocks have twelve numbers?
That is a good question. Do you like round shapes?
I think so. Why is the number twelve chosen?
We use twelve because it divides easily. Do you like sharing cookies?
I do. Why not use ten?
Ten works, but twelve fits time better. Did you know your hands have five fingers?
Yes, I count them. Why are there twelve hours in a half day?
I am not sure of the exact history. Do you like sunny days?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love this song. It makes me feel fast.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Is it a happy tune?
Yes, but I must run now.
Okay, running is good exercise. Do you know all the words?
I forget the last part.
I do not know the song either. Just sing your heart out.
Thanks. Bye.
Bye. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I think I am lost and I feel very scared.
Do not worry. Stay close to me. Are you with your mom?
Yes, but we walked in the wrong park gate.
Let us go back the way we came. Is it sunny outside?
It is sunny, but I do not see the gate.
I will look for it. Take a deep breath. Can you smell the flowers?
I smell the flowers, but I still do not know where to go.
I do not know the exact path. Let us ask a guard. Is there a person in uniform?
There is a guard right there by the road.
Good. Let us walk to him together.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the truck?
It is on the street. Is it blue?
Yes, it is blue. How do I open the back?
Pull the silver handle. Do you have tape?
No, I do not have tape.
I have some here. Can I help you box?
Please help. I must go.
We will work fast. Are you okay?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know if I should watch a scary movie tonight.
That sounds like a big choice. Do you like being scared or not?
I am not sure. What is a good first scary movie?
I do not know what you have seen before. Do you like ghosts?
Yes, I do.
Try the movie with the white house. It is a classic.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing with a loud and happy voice.
That sounds fun! Do you like singing in the shower?
Yes, I do, but I am afraid of doing it at a party.
It is okay to feel shy. Start by singing one song for your family first?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am so tired, but I just cannot sleep.
That feels hard. Do you play games right before bed?
Yes, I always play on my phone until late.
Screens can make your mind stay busy. Try reading a quiet book instead.
I will try that tonight.
That is a good plan. How do you like to start your morning?
I like to drink warm milk and read.
Good things to do. I hope you rest well soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go to the beach, but it is raining. What should I do?
That is very sad. Do you have a nice umbrella?
No, I do not have one. Can I go in the house?
Yes, playing inside is fun too. What is your favorite game?
I like to read books. Is that okay?
Reading is a great choice. Do you have a book about the sea?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does my phone make a loud noise?
It is telling you about a new message. Are you excited to see who called?
I do not want to answer it.
That is okay. You can wait until later. Would you like to play a game first?
Can you put the phone away for me?
I cannot reach your phone. I do not know where it is.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The boats are sleeping in the water. Which one is the biggest?
I do not know for sure. Do you like big or small ships?
I like the big ones. Do they go to the moon?
No, they only go on the sea. Do you want to ride on one?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make pasta for dinner. How do I do it?
You boil water in a pot first. Do you know how to turn on the stove?
No, I do not know. Can you help me with that?
I cannot reach the stove from here, so I am not sure. Is your grown-up near you?
Yes, mom is in the next room.
Great, go ask her to do that part for you. What kind of sauce do you want?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do I need a stamp to send a letter here?
Yes, you do. Do you have one with you?
I think I have one, but it is old.
An old stamp may still work. Is it sticky?
No, it looks dry and flat.
Then we should get a new one. Do you have the money?
Yes, I have a small bill.
Great. I can help you buy it. How heavy is the letter?
It is just a few pages thick.
That is light. It needs only one stamp. Are you ready to go?
Yes, I am ready now.
Come with me, please. I will show you where to go.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I packed all my books today and my back hurts.
That sounds hard. Is your new home close?
Yes, but the truck broke down on the way.
Oh no. Did you fix it quickly?
A man helped me push it to the shop.
He was very kind.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad about my work chat.
That sounds hard. What part hurts the most?
I think I said the wrong thing to my boss.
Ouch. Do you know what they said back?
They looked very upset and left.
I am sorry about that. Have you tried to talk to them?
I want to fix it, but I am scared.
It is good you want to fix it. Will you write a short note?
Yes, I will ask for a quick talk.
That is a brave step. Good luck with that.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the red fruit sweet?
Yes, it is very sweet. Do you like sweet things?
My mom has no money to buy it.
That is sad. Do you want to help me find some free samples?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream in the sand.
That feels very bad. Do you have a phone?
No, I left it in the car.
I see. Did you find a coin nearby?
No, just dirty sand everywhere.
I am sorry. Let us get a new one.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do today.
What do you like to do when it is cold?
I like to sit by the fire.
That is a warm place. Are you feeling bored?
Yes, I am just sitting.
You can read a book too. Do you have a story ready?
I have a map of the stars.
That is a cool idea. Do you want to look at the sky?
I will go outside now.
Have a good time. Do you know how to stay warm?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does it snow in the sky?
Cold air makes water turn into tiny ice bits. Do you like the cold?
Is the snow really water?
Yes, it starts as clouds. Can you make a snowball?
Why is it white?
I do not know the exact reason. Is it soft when you touch it?
Does it melt if I hold it?
Yes, your hands are warm. Do you have a coat on?
Why do we play in it?
It is fun and quiet. Do you like the quiet?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Where is the picture book section?
It is right by the front door. Do you like dinosaurs?
Yes, I do.
They are on the blue shelf. Is there a lot of dust there?
A little bit.
I will get a brush. Do you want to help?
Yes, please.
Here, go on the left. Does it feel better now?
Yes, thank you.
You are welcome. I must go now.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the village in the mountains?
Yes, it sits high up in the hills. Do you like cold weather?
Do the people there make cheese?
I think they do, but I am not sure. Do you eat a lot of cheese?
Is there a river near the houses?
Yes, a small river flows right past them.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
They drink sweet plant water called nectar. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I do. What happens next?
They carry it in special stomachs. Do you have a special spot for toys?
Yes, my box. How does it turn into honey?
They dry the water out with warm air. Do you like warm days?
Yes, they do. Is that all?
Yes, then they store it in a hive.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My head hurts a little. I am so happy today. Do you feel happy?
I am glad you are happy. A sore head can feel bad. What made you smile?
I saw a big red dog. It gave me a wag.
That is a nice story. Does the dog have a name?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss the warm sun. The cold wind feels so harsh today.
I am sorry it feels that way. Do you have a warm coat?
Yes, but it is still chilly. I just want to go outside and play.
That is a good wish. Can you play inside instead?
I tried, but my legs are itchy. I need to run fast.
Running is great for your body. Do you have a favorite song?
Not really. I just feel low and gray. Like the sky right now.
I hear you. It is okay to feel sad. Do you like bright colors?
Only when the flowers come back. I hope winter ends soon.
It will end soon. I am sure of that.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What day comes after Monday?
Tuesday comes after Monday. Do you like Tuesdays?
No, I do not. It is a boring day.
I am sorry you feel that way. What do you do on Mondays?
I go to school and do my math.
Math is a good thing to learn. Do you like addition?
Yes, adding is fun.
That is great. Do you like any other days better?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to run, but I want to say thanks for the kind words from my boss.
That is sweet. Did they write it down for you?
Yes, a short note. I am late for my bus!
Hurry on. Is the note about a good job?
Yes, they like my work. I must go now.
Good luck. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do plants need dirt to grow?
Dirt holds the water and food the plant needs. Do you like to garden?
Why does the sun make them grow taller?
Sunlight helps the leaves make food from the air. I do not know why you ask.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a small pot. I want to grow food, but I do not know what to pick.
Try a tomato plant. It is easy and sweet to eat. Do you have a sunny spot?
I do not have a sunny spot, only a dark corner. What do I do?
That is a hard problem. I do not know the best plant for the dark. How much space do you have?
Just a little bit of space on the table. I am very lost.
Grow some herbs like basil. They like the dark and small space.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My camera does not work right.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you try a new battery?
Yes, but the pictures are still blurry.
That is tricky. I do not know why that happens.
I feel like I wasted all my time.
Your time was not wasted at all. Do you like taking photos?
I love them, but it is so hard today.
Hard things can be very fun later. Is there a place you want to go next?
Maybe just to sit and drink tea.
That sounds like a perfect plan. I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My goldfish is swimming in circles.
That sounds scary. Does it look happy or sad?
It looks a bit tired.
Tired fish need rest. Do you have a light to turn off?
Yes, I can turn it off now.
Good idea. Sleep is good for them.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My cat is hiding under the bed and will not come out.
That is strange. Is he hungry?
He is not eating his food.
That is worrying. Did you see anything odd happen today?
I think he might be sick.
You are right to worry. Please take him to a doctor.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How can I help my sad friend?
Do you think she needs a hug or a chat?
I am not sure what she needs.
Tell her you care and just listen to her.
That is a good idea, thank you.
I hope she feels happy again soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do trees lose their leaves in the fall?
They drop them to save energy for the cold. Do you like picking up leaves?
I do. How do plants wake up in spring?
The sun gets warmer and makes them grow. Do you watch new flowers open?
Yes, I do. Why does it snow in winter?
I do not know the full story, but air cools water into ice. Do you like building snowmen?
It is fun. Why is it so bright in summer?
The sun is up for a long time each day. Do you like long days?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we hit the ball with a big stick?
The stick helps you reach the ball far away. Do you like hitting things?
Why is the net in the middle?
It keeps the two sides fair for everyone.
Why must the ball go over the net?
If it goes under, you lose the point. Do you know the rules well?
Why is tennis so fun to play?
I am not sure, but many people love the fresh air.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I learn to swim?
You should talk to a teacher first. Do you have a pool near your home?
I have a small pool in my yard.
That is a great start. You can practice floating in the shallows.
What if the water feels cold?
Cold water can make you tense up. Do you like being in cold water?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to catch fish.
Try the big pond. Do you have a worm?
I have a hook, but no worm.
You can buy worms at the shop. Is it hot today?
It is sunny and warm out.
Great for fishing. Go catch some fun!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to paint a big red dog.
That sounds fun. Do you have red paint?
Yes, I have red and blue.
Great. What is your dog like to touch?
I think he is soft.
Soft dogs are nice. How tall is he?
He is very tall.
Tall dogs are cool. Do you have a tall brush?
No, I only have a small one.
That is okay. Let us start with the head.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to grow tomatoes in my small pot.
You can do that. Do you have a sunny spot for your pot?
Yes, my balcony gets lots of light.
Great. Use a big pot with holes in the bottom. Do you have good soil?
I only have dirt from the yard.
That dirt might be too heavy. You need light, crumbly soil for plants.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late! How does this clock tick?
The spring pushes a wheel to move the hands. Are you going somewhere fun?
Yes, but I need the time now!
Look at the short hand for the hour. Do you know which hand is the minute hand?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to run fast to catch the bus.
That is a good plan to be on time. Do you have your shoes on?
Yes, I am ready to go.
Great. Are you running on grass or pavement?
I am running on the road.
Please be careful of cars.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights went out and I do not know what to do.
Is your dog okay in the dark? Let us use a candle to see.
The dog is fine, but I am worried about the food in the fridge.
Open the door just for a quick check. Do you have a flashlight?
Yes, I have one, but I am still scared of the dark.
Stay calm and breathe. I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to grow some carrots in my box, but I do not know where to start.
Put the seeds in the dirt and keep it wet. Do you have a small box with holes in the bottom?
Yes, I do. My cat likes to sit on it, so I am worried.
Carrots like sun, so put the box where it is warm. Is your cat a good digger?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know how to draw a tree.
Start with a brown line for the trunk. What color do you want the leaves to be?
They should be green.
Use many small circles to make the leaves. Is your paper big enough?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go in this tiny town.
The river is very nice for sitting. Do you like water?
I was thinking about buying a gift.
I do not know what you want to buy. Is it for a friend?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make my pictures look bright?
Try to take photos near a window. Do you like sunny days?
Yes, I do. But my camera is too dark inside.
Open the small window on your camera lens. Do you use a small phone?
Yes, it is my phone.
Turn on the light from the screen. Do you have a flashlight?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go, but tell me, what is a robot?
It is a machine that moves and thinks. Where are you rushing to?
I forgot my lunch. Do robots need food to work?
No, they use power, not food. Do you have any batteries?
I must run. Can I give a robot a hug?
Yes, if its sensors allow it. Is your day safe?
Thank you, I must go now.
Good luck on your way. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for my talk. Where is the room?
It is on the top floor. Are you bringing food?
No time for snacks. How do I get there?
Take the lift or the stairs. Do you like the view?
The lift is faster. I must go now.
Run safe. I hope the talk is fun.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am afraid of deep water. Can you help me?
Fear is natural. Do you know how to kick your legs?
Yes, but I hold my breath too long.
That is the wrong way. Try to breathe out slowly in the water.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I send a picture to my friend online?
You can use a chat app to share images. Do you already have one installed?
Yes, I have one, but I do not know where to click.
Look for a small icon that looks like a picture or a plus sign. It is usually near the text box.
That worked, thank you! How do I see what they sent?
Their pictures will appear right above your typing area.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my book in the dark corner. I feel sad.
Oh no. Did you check the small table?
Yes, but it is not there. It is gone.
I am sorry to hear that. Can you tell me the name of the book?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
