exchanges: I did great on the test today.
That is wonderful news. How did you feel when you saw your score?
I felt really proud.
I am happy for you. Did you study hard?
Yes, I studied all week.
Great job. What will you do to celebrate?
I want to eat ice cream.
That sounds fun. What flavor do you like best?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My cat is hiding and I need to leave now. Can you help me find him?
Check under the bed. Is he scared of loud noises?
He is in the closet. Thank you, I am late.
That is good. Do you have a bag for his food?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the moon look like a face?
We see shadows that look like eyes. Do you see two shadows or three?
I see two eyes and a mouth.
The rocks make those shapes. Do you know what a shadow is?
It is dark when the light hits something.
Yes, the sun is blocked. Do you like looking up at night?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see so many dots in the sky.
Yes, those are stars. Do you like looking up?
Some look big and some look small.
They are all very far away. Do you think they are cold?
Are they really up there in the dark?
Yes, they are far above us. Can you find the moon?
I want to go up to one of them.
I cannot tell you how to do that. Do you wish to go?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we meet every Monday?
I check how our work is going. Do you feel busy on Mondays?
Why do we start at nine o'clock?
I pick that time because it is fresh. Do you like waking up early?
Why do we sit in that small room?
I choose it to keep us close. Is the space too tight for you?
Why do we talk about big goals?
I ask this to help us focus. Do you have a favorite goal?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so scared about the test. I have to run.
That feels hard. Are you calm now?
No, I must go. My feet hurt from thinking.
Try to breathe slow. Do you like the book?
Yes, but I might fail. I cannot wait.
Failing is not the end. Can you take one deep breath?
I am still fast. Please say I will pass.
I do not know for sure. You did work well.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I have a party today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What kind of party is it?
It is a birthday party. I love cake and games.
Yum. Do you have any special plans for the night?
Yes, we are dancing. I can hardly wait to start.
Dancing is great. Who is coming with you?
My best friend is coming too. We are a good team.
That is wonderful. I hope you have a very good time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very scared of my new job tomorrow.
That is normal to feel scared. Do you know where the bathroom is?
I am not sure, and I worry about making a big mistake.
You will do your best, and that is enough.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have the king of hearts in my hand.
That is a good card. Do you like red cards?
Yes, I like red. I want to win the game.
Winning is fun. Are you scared of losing?
No, I am not scared. I just want the points.
Being brave is great. How many points do you have?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has colors. Blue scatters most. Do you see?
I do not have time to look.
It is in the air. I do not know your deadline. Is it work?
Yes, it is work.
Blue is just light playing. Run safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts a lot right now.
I am sorry you feel bad. Is it a sharp pain or a dull ache?
It feels like a dull ache.
That often helps you sleep better. Do you want to try resting your eyes?
Yes, I will try to rest.
That is a good step. Do you want me to check for other tips?
Yes, please tell me more.
A cool cloth on your neck can help. Does that sound like a good idea?
Yes, I will try that.
I hope you feel better soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to eat. My tummy is empty, but I feel sick of thinking.
Try some warm soup with bread. It is kind to your belly. What color food do you like best?
I like green things, like peas. But I do not know how to make them.
Just heat them up with a spoon of butter. It is easy and true. Do you have a pot ready?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I wanted to buy a red apple, but the lady sold me a green one. I do not like green apples.
That is very frustrating. Did you tell her you wanted the red one?
I did, but she said they were all the same. Now I feel bad about my money.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you usually buy fruit there?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I felt very bad after the movie ended.
I am sorry you feel that way. What part hurt your heart?
The sad dog just got a rock thrown at it.
That does not seem very nice. Did you want to tell the director?
No, I think I just need to go to bed.
That sounds like a good plan. I hope you sleep well now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the bread brown?
It gets hot in the oven. Do you like sweet bread?
Yes, I do. Why is the milk white?
It comes from a cow. I do not know for sure why it is white.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I want to grow carrots. Why do I have to wait so long?
The roots take time to get big. What size do you want them?
I want them as long as my hand. Why does the soil need to be loose?
Loose soil helps the roots dig down. Do you have a rake?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
They take sweet liquid from flowers and put it in their special bags. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I do! Why do they need that liquid?
It is their food for the winter. Bees work hard to save it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the leaves are all falling.
That looks a bit lonely, does not it? Do you like cold air?
No, I just want warm sun and green grass.
Winter is long, but spring always comes back to help. Do you play outside in the snow?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is blowing so hard. I do not know what to do.
Do you have a warm coat on? It is safe to stay inside.
Yes, I am warm, but my heart feels sad.
I am sorry you feel sad. Is there a song you like?
I love humming quiet tunes to calm down.
That is a good idea. Thank you for sharing that with me.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my cat hum like a machine?
Your cat purrs to show you that it is happy and safe. Is your cat sleeping right now?
Why does it blink so slowly at me?
That slow blink is a sign of love and trust. Do you blink back at it often?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the meeting moved?
The room is wet from the rain. Do you like dry floors?
Yes. Why does the rain matter?
We need a safe place to sit. Do you have an umbrella?
No. Why are we in a hurry?
The sun is setting soon. I hope you are warm.
I am. Why do we meet early?
We want more time to talk. Do you like long chats?
Yes. Why is this good?
It feels nice to be calm.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I made bread today but it did not get big.
Did you put yeast in the dough?
Yes, I did, but it was very cold outside.
Cold air can make it slow down. Was the kitchen warm?
It was, but I left the bowl on the floor.
The floor may be too cool for the yeast to work well.
So I should keep it higher up next time?
That sounds like a good idea. Did you taste the final bread?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to visit a small island. What should I pack?
Bring warm clothes and a good book. Do you like reading on the beach?
Yes, I do. Is the water cold there?
I do not know for sure. How does the weather feel where you live?
It is cold here. So the island must be warm?
It is often warm there. Do you like swimming?
I do not swim well. Can I just walk?
You can walk all around. What is your favorite part of nature?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting so long.
That is very common. Do you have a favorite toy to play with?
Yes, I have a small bear.
That sounds nice. Is the bear sleepy too?
The bear is always sleeping.
Good for you both. I do not know how long the plane flies for, though.
I do not know either.
You can look at the little screen to see. Have you seen the clouds outside?
Yes, they look like big white puffs.
That is a lovely thing to see.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what movie to watch tonight.
That is okay. Do you like happy stories?
I like happy ones, but I feel very tired.
A calm nature film might help you rest. Do you like forests?
Forests are nice, but I worry the dark parts will scare me.
I do not know a specific movie for you. Would a bright comedy be safe?
Yes, a bright comedy sounds good.
Great. I hope you have fun. Do you want a snack?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off trees in the fall?
The days get shorter and cooler, so the tree saves energy. Do you like cold weather?
Not really, I prefer warm days. Does the tree get tired?
Yes, making green food takes a lot of work. The tree rests by letting go.
That sounds hard for the tree. What happens to the leaf after it drops?
It breaks down and becomes food for the roots below. Do you play in the leaves?
I love running through them. They are crunchy.
That is a fun sound. The tree uses that food to grow new leaves later.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make pasta at home. How do I do that?
Boil water in a pot and add a pinch of salt. Do you have a big pot ready?
Yes, I have a pot. What is the next step?
Put the dry pasta in the water. Do you know how much to use?
I do not know the amount. Can you help me?
Use a handful of pasta for one person.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want a warm drink but I am not sure which one to pick.
Try tea if you feel like you need to slow down. Do you like sweet flavors?
Yes, I do. But sometimes I feel too tired to sit still.
Then have coffee to give you energy. I hope that helps you feel better.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie a boat to the dock.
You wrap the rope around the post, then make a knot. Do you have a rope with you?
Yes, I have a blue one.
Great. You pull it tight so it does not slip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a long list of months and I do not know what to do with them.
You can write them on small papers. Do you have any paper?
I do not have any paper, just this list. What should I do?
Try thinking about what you like in each month. Do you like cold or warm weather?
I like warm weather, so I like summer. I am still stuck on the rest.
That is a good start. Do you know what comes after summer?
I guess I will just guess the rest of them. I hope I get them right.
Guessing is a fun way to learn. It is true that winter comes after fall.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want new shoes, but I do not know where to look.
I can help you find the right size. Do you like bright colors or calm ones?
I like calm colors, but I need them for school.
School shoes should be black or brown. They look nice and clean.
That sounds good. How do I try them on?
You take your socks off first. You step inside and wiggle your toes.
My toes feel tight. What do I do?
That shoe is too small. Try the next size up.
This size fits well. Thank you for your help.
I am happy you found good shoes. Do you have a favorite place to wear them?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to bed at nine last night.
That is a good time to sleep. Do you like reading before bed?
Yes, I read two books.
Two books is a lot. Did they help you feel tired?
They made me very sleepy.
That is wonderful. I do not know what you read.
I read about a bear.
A bear is a nice friend. Was it a happy bear?
Yes, he found honey.
That sounds fun. Sweet dreams, friend.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so hungry. My tummy is grumbling.
A grumbling tummy means you need food. Are you happy about lunch?
I have a sandwich. It has cheese.
Cheese is a good choice. Do you want to share it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found this map. It is very nice.
That sounds fun. Where does it show?
It shows the big lake. I love the blue part.
The blue part looks calm. Do you like boats?
Yes, I do. I want to go there soon.
Me too. It is a good place.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so warm inside today. I am happy!
That is a nice feeling. What made you smile?
The sun was bright and the air was sweet.
A sunny day helps many people. Do you like the sun?
Yes, it feels like a big hug.
That is a lovely way to see it. I am glad you are smiling.
I want this feeling to stay.
That is a happy wish. Enjoy your day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to eat at a new place today.
That sounds fun. Do you like hot food?
I like soup, but I do not like spicy things.
You should try the noodle soup. It is warm and sweet. Do you want to eat alone?
No, my friend is with me.
Bring a friend? Great. There are big tables there. Do you want to pay cash?
I have coins, but no bills.
They take cards too. Just tell them you will pay. Do you want a drink?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am trying to count my apples, but I keep getting a different number.
That is tricky. Do you move the apples when you count?
Yes, I move them around a lot.
Try to keep them still. How many apples do you have right now?
I think I have five, maybe six.
Count again slowly. Tell me if you spot two in the back.
Oh, yes, I see two more. I have seven!
Great job. Do you like eating apples?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The birds did not sing today.
That is very quiet. Do you like the silence?
Yes, it feels like a long hug.
A long hug sounds nice.
Then a cat sat on the wall.
What color is the cat?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the big ship stay on the water?
It pushes the water down, and the water pushes it back up. Do you like boats?
Yes, but why does it not sink?
The water pushes up with a strong force called buoyancy. Is the boat hollow inside?
Yes, it is mostly air.
The air makes the boat light enough to float. Have you seen a metal spoon?
Yes, I have.
A solid spoon sinks, but a bent spoon can float. Do you know why?
I think because it is lighter.
It traps air and pushes more water out. That helps it stay up.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go to a far away island.
That sounds like a great trip. Do you like the water?
Yes, I love swimming in the sea.
Great! Do you know where the island is?
No, I am not sure which one.
We can look at a map together.
Yes, please find a nice one.
I found a small one with sand. Does that look good to you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My toy will not fix itself.
That feels very hard. Do you want to take a deep breath?
I do not have the time for breathing. I just want to play.
I get that you are in a rush. Are you ready to try one small part?
Fine, I will try, but it is really annoying.
I am glad you tried. Does it help a little bit?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am going to visit my grandma for the holiday.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you have any toys with you?
I packed a new red bike and some books.
A bike is great for riding. Can I ask what you like to eat there?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind blew hard today and my umbrella turned inside out.
That is a very funny thing to happen. Did you get wet?
Yes, my shoes are wet and my socks are damp.
I am sorry about your feet. Do you like being dry?
I love being dry, but I do not know why the wind is so angry.
Wind is just air moving fast. I think it is playing outside.
The rain started falling on my head with big drops.
Big drops can make a loud sound. Did you hear them?
They sounded like drumming on my coat.
That sounds like a fun dance. I hope you feel warm now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big fort in the living room. Do you know how?
Yes, use pillows and blankets. Are you ready to work hard?
I think I have some pillows, but I need more blankets. Where can I find them?
Check the spare room closet. Do you have a map for your fort?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big blue house at the end of the road. Is that where the baker lives?
Yes, it is! Did you smell warm bread?
It smells like sweet apples. Is it time for lunch?
I do not know, but I hope so! Do you like apple pie?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I read my favorite book again today. It made me feel very happy.
That sounds nice. Did you read it in bed?
Yes, I read it before sleep. The moon was bright outside.
A bright moon is lovely. Did you fall asleep right away?
I did fall asleep soon. I dreamed about the story.
Dreams from books are fun. What did you dream about?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I see the sun safely?
You need dark glasses called solar filters. Do you have any?
No, I do not.
Go to a store that sells science tools. Can you buy the ones for your eyes?
I can try to find them.
That is a good plan. Please do not look at it without them.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in this new town. I do not know where to go next.
The park is right there. It is a good place to rest. Do you like to play?
I do not want to play. I am too tired.
You can sleep on the bench. Then you will feel better.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I bought a blue shirt for my friend, but he said it looks too big.
That must be disappointing. Did you try on the shirt first?
No, I just guessed. Now I feel bad that I wasted my money.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you know if he liked the color?
He said the blue is nice, but the size is wrong.
Maybe you can exchange it for a smaller one.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am bored and do not know what to do.
That is okay. Do you like to use your hands?
I think so. I do not know if I am good at it.
You will not know until you try. What makes you feel happy?
I like to make things. I do not know what to pick.
Try drawing. Do you have paper and pens?
Yes, I have a box full of them.
Great. Pick one pen. What color do you see first?
Blue. The sky is blue.
Nice. Draw the sky now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel sad while waiting.
Waiting can be hard. Do you like to draw?
Yes, I do.
You can color while you wait. Is the wait short?
It is long.
Time feels slow when you are bored. You can count to ten.
I tried that.
You can look for red things. What colors do you see?
I see blue.
That is a good color. Just breathe deep.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked by the old well today.
That sounds peaceful. Do you live near the water?
Yes, it is just down the hill.
I do not know the well, but it must be nice. Was the water clear?
It was very cold and clean.
Good for you. Did you bring a friend along?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love reading books right before bed. It makes my brain feel warm and calm.
That sounds nice. Do you have a favorite book for this time?
Yes, I like stories with big, scary monsters. It feels brave to read about them at night.
That is very cool. Do you like it when the hero wins?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so tired from moving.
Moving is hard work. Did you sleep well last night?
No, I was too busy packing boxes.
That explains the fatigue. What did you pack first?
Just my books and a few toys.
Those are important things to save. Are you scared of the new house?
A little, but I am happy too.
Happy is a good feeling. Can I help you with something?
Yes, my back hurts from lifting.
You should rest now. I do not know how to fix a back, but sitting helps.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very nervous about my big day.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you love your partner?
Yes, I do. How do I make it perfect?
I do not know the secret to perfect. Just be happy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what to order at this place.
That is very common. What is your favorite food?
I do not know. I am just tired.
That makes sense. Do you want something warm?
Maybe. I really do not know.
I suggest soup. It is easy to eat.
Okay, I will try that.
That sounds good. I hope you enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I get better at swimming?
Practice a little every day. Do you have a pool at home?
I just want to go faster.
Keep your body flat in the water. Do you feel strong in your legs?
I get tired too soon.
Breathe out slowly in the water. Do you take deep breaths?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat at my desk today, but the cat kept sitting on my keyboard.
That is very funny. Did you move the cat to a box?
Yes, he moved to the box and looked very happy.
A box sounds like a great place for a nap.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to run really fast.
That is a good goal. Do you like running outside?
Yes, but my legs get tired.
That is normal for new runners. How far did you run today?
I ran around the park once.
One lap is a great start. Did you drink some water?
Yes, I drank a big cup.
Good job. Let us rest for a bit.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today because it is my birthday.
That is great news! Do you have cake?
Yes, I have a big red cake with candles.
That sounds sweet. How many years are you turning?
I am turning six today.
Six is a fun age. I hope you have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am nervous about my meeting tomorrow.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have any bad memories of past meetings?
Yes, I talk too fast when I am scared.
Try to breathe slowly before you speak. Have you tried this trick before?
No, I have never tried it. Will it help me?
I do not know if it will work for you, but it may help. Just take your time and speak clear.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My chair leg is wiggly and makes a loud sound.
That can be scary. Is one leg much shorter than the others?
I think so, but I do not know which one.
Try lifting each leg to see. Do you have a small hammer nearby?
Yes, I have a red tool in my bag.
Great. We can tap a washer under the short leg to make it steady.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My new fence gate is stuck and will not open.
That is so frustrating. Did you try to lift it up a little?
Yes, I did, but it is still stuck.
Oh, that is tricky. Is the bottom of the wood wet from rain?
No, the ground is dry today.
I do not know why it is stuck. You should ask a grown-up for help.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lights are off! It is so dark.
Oh no, did the power go out?
Yes, but I am happy! Look at the stars.
Stars are very pretty. Do you see a shooting star?
I do not think so, just the moon.
The moon looks big and round. Is it full?
I think it is almost full.
It looks like a bright ball. Do you have a candle?
No, but my eyes are used to the dark.
Your eyes are great! Do you like the quiet?
Yes, it is so calm and nice.
That is a good feeling. Sleep tight now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I had a scary dream where a giant dog chased me.
That sounds really scary. Did you wake up safe in your bed?
Yes, I did, but I am still a little nervous.
Your body sometimes feels scared even after a bad dream. Do you want to hold your favorite stuffed toy?
Yes, the soft bunny helps me feel better.
That is a great idea. Is there anything else you want to talk about before sleep?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw the big waves and I felt so small and scared.
That is a scary feeling when the water is loud. Did you stand far away from the edge?
I want to learn to swim but I am afraid of the salt.
Salt water can sting if you rub your eyes. Do you want to try some swimming goggles?
I guess I am just not brave enough for the ocean.
You are brave for trying new things. Would you like to sit with me and watch the birds?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make the fence look nice?
You can paint it white. Do you like white?
Yes, I do. How do I start?
Clean the wood first. Is it dry?
It is dry. What next?
Paint it with a brush.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to read a book but I do not know how to start.
That is a great goal. Do you like stories or facts?
I love funny animal stories.
Go to the children's shelf and look for the dog section.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does a boat float on water?
Water pushes up to hold it, so it stays dry. Do you like riding in boats?
Yes, I do. Why is the hull made of metal?
Metal is strong and hard to break. Do you know which ships use wood?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am so tired from work. How do I fix a broken chair leg?
Oh no, that sounds rough. Do you have a screwdriver? You can try tightening the screws first.
I do not have a tool. Can you show me another way?
I do not know of a safe way without tools. Are you safe sitting down?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make my king safe at the start?
You put it in the middle of the back row. Do you like to protect your king first?
Yes, I always move the rooks early.
That is a good habit. It is called castling.
What does the little "o" sign mean in the notes?
It shows you moved the king and a rook. Do you read game notes often?
I try, but the moves are hard to follow.
Start by just watching the king move. It helps you see the whole game.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at this cool map I found.
It has a big blue sea. Where did you find it?
I bought it at the store near my home.
That is a nice place. Do you have a favorite spot on it?
Yes, I like the green mountains part.
Mountains look tall and fun. Do you want to climb them?
Not yet, but maybe one day.
That is a great plan.
I think I will save it for a trip.
That sounds like a wonderful idea.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my bike make a loud clicking sound?
That often means a loose spoke or chain. Do you know where the noise comes from?
I think it is coming from the front wheel.
You should check if the spokes are tight. Do you have a wrench?
Yes, I have one in my shed.
Great, tighten the loose spoke slowly. Is the wheel still wiggly after that?
No, it looks straight now.
Good, take a test ride and listen. Did the sound go away?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I climbed a big hill today. The air was cold and clean up there.
That sounds like a brave climb. Did you see any birds?
Yes, I saw a hawk fly high above the trees. It looked so strong and free.
A hawk is a great bird to spot. Do you like cold days or warm ones?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The river is making a loud noise.
It is rushing fast over the rocks. Do you hear the water splashing?
Yes, it sounds like rain.
That is a nice thought. Does the water look clear to you?
I think it is brown and dirty.
Yes, there is a lot of mud from the rain.
Can fish live in that?
I do not know for sure about this exact spot. Do you see any moving shapes?
I see something big under the water.
It might be a log floating by. Look closely.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors. Blue light bounces off air molecules. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. But why does it not look red?
Red light travels farther than blue light. It does not bounce back to your eyes. Do you see red sunsets?
I do sometimes. Is that because of the dust?
Dust helps, but long paths matter more. The blue light scatters away. Do you like oranges?
I love oranges. I am a bit confused about the bouncing.
Imagine light hitting tiny bits of air. It spreads out in all directions. Do you want to test it with a lamp?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the river never stop moving?
The water flows because the land slopes down. Do you like watching the waves?
Yes, I do. What happens if the water stops?
It would not stay still for long. Do you see any ducks swimming there?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know why the sky is blue. Can you help me see it?
Yes, I can help. Do you like looking up at the clouds?
I want to make a simple paper kite. How do I start?
Cut a long square from paper. Is your paper strong?
I want to glue the paper together. Do I use a lot of glue?
Use a little glue at the corners. Do you have a ruler?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need a small towel in my bag?
It is for your hands after washing them. Do you have any dirty clothes to wash?
I do not know. Should I bring soap?
Yes, a small bar of soap is good. Are you going to swim?
Yes, I love the water. Why do you ask?
I am thinking about wet clothes. Do you have a dry shirt to wear?
I have a blue shirt. Why does the bag need water?
Water helps you stay cool. Do you have a bottle?
I have a green bottle. Why is it full?
You drink water when you are thirsty. Are you ready to close the bag?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people work from home?
They stay safe and save time on trips. Do you like walking?
Does it make people lonely?
Yes, they miss the noise of others. Do you play with friends?
Is it hard to focus?
It is hard when the house is loud. I do not know what you do.
Do they play all day?
No, they still work hard for hours. Is your day busy?
Why is that good?
They can help the house too. Do you help at home?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a movie about a dog today.
A dog movie sounds fun. Did you like it?
The dog was very cute.
That is nice. Did you enjoy the story?
I fell asleep a bit.
Tired eyes are hard to keep open.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we boil the eggs?
We boil them to cook the inside. Do you like them hard or soft?
I want them soft. Why does the water need to be hot?
Hot water cooks the egg fast. Are you hungry yet?
Yes, I am. Why do we wash the greens?
We wash them to keep them clean. Do you help with the salad?
I do. Why is dinner good?
It is good because it is made with care. Do you smell the soup?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a boat to a post?
You loop the rope around the post and pull it tight. Do you have a rope with you?
Yes, I have one. What is the next step?
You make a knot to keep it from slipping. Is the water near?
It is close by. How do I finish the knot?
You pull the free ends through the loop and hold tight. I do not know your boat type.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My new neighbor keeps the lights on all night. It is very bright.
That must be annoying. Do you think he is just forgetting to turn them off?
I am not sure. It happens every single night.
You could knock on his door and say hello. Maybe a friendly chat will help.
That sounds like a good start. Should I ask him to turn them off?
I do not know for sure if that will work. Have you tried a smile first?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very tired but my eyes will not close.
That is hard. Do you like your blanket on?
Yes, I love my soft bunny blanket.
Good. Try holding it tight like a hug.
I am holding it, but my brain is still busy.
Let your mind be like quiet water.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today.
That sounds fun. Did you swim?
Yes, the water was warm.
I like warm water too. Was it safe?
My friend helped me stand up.
That is a good thing. Did you find shells?
I found one big, white shell.
I have never seen a white one. Did you keep it?
I put it in my bag.
I am glad you found something nice.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I catch a cloud?
You cannot catch one, but you can take a photo of it. Do you like taking pictures?
Yes, I do. How do I make a good picture?
Look up when the sun is out. Is the sky blue today?
Yes, it is. What else should I do?
Find a shape that looks like an animal. What shape do you see?
I see a bunny. Thank you.
That sounds fun.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very happy inside.
That is a good sign. What did you do?
I finished my hard puzzle.
Well done. Did you enjoy the work?
It took a long time to solve.
Patience is a great skill.
How do I keep this good feeling?
I do not know for sure. Do you like talking about it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so late for school. I forgot my book.
Did you pack your bag last night?
No, I was playing. Please help me.
We can run now to make it on time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do now.
That feels hard. Do you want to try just one small thing?
I am not sure if I can do it.
It is okay to be unsure.
I failed before, so I am scared.
Failing means you learned something new. What do you want to learn next?
I just want to feel good again.
That is a good goal.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I would like to make a paper boat, but I do not know how to start.
Cut a square piece of paper first. Do you have any paper with you?
Yes, I have one. What do I do next?
Fold the square in half, then fold it in half again. Is the paper thick enough?
I folded it. How do I turn it into a boat?
Open it up and push the top corners down. Then pull the top flaps up to make the sides.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a quick drink. Tea or coffee? Which is faster?
Coffee is usually faster to make. Do you want it hot or iced?
Hot, please. I am late for work. Can you hurry?
Yes, I will make it as fast as I can.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I painted a big red apple and I love it so much.
That sounds fun. What color did you use for the stem?
It is green and it looks very nice.
I am happy you feel good about your work.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. My feet hurt from the long ride.
That sounds hard. Did you get to see much from the window?
I slept through most of it. I missed the fun parts.
That is okay. You can still enjoy the walk outside. Did you bring any snacks?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because I do not know how to start my plan.
That feels hard. What is the first small step you want to take?
I want to clean my room, but I am too tired.
You can just pick up one toy first. Does that sound doable?
Yes, one toy is easy. Thank you.
You can do it. I am proud of you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did really well on my test.
That is great news. Did you enjoy the questions?
Yes, they were fun.
I am glad you had a good time.
My teacher was smiling at me.
That sounds very nice. How did you feel about it?
I felt proud and happy.
Taking pride in your work is good.
I want to read it again.
Reading it again is a smart move. Do you like the first question best?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky so dark?
The clouds are thick and full of rain. Are you scared of the dark?
Why is the wind so loud?
It is moving very fast through the trees. I like the sound of it.
Why do we see flashes of light?
That is electricity from the storm. Have you ever seen lightning before?
Why does the ground smell wet?
The rain mixes with the dirt and plants. Do you like the smell?
Why is everything so quiet now?
The storm has passed and the air feels fresh. I am happy it is over.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to build a sand castle on the island.
That is a fun idea. Do you have any buckets or shovels?
Yes, I have a big blue bucket and a red shovel.
Great. You need wet sand from near the water to make it hold.
How do I know when the sand is wet enough?
It should stick together in your hand. Do you see where the waves touch the beach?
I do, but I am scared the waves will wash it away.
Build it a little higher up then. Do you have any rocks for the walls?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make the screen show my files?
Click the little folder icon at the bottom. Do you know where it is?
I see it, but nothing happens when I click.
Try double-clicking it instead. Is the mouse working well?
That worked. Now how do I copy a picture?
Right-click the picture and choose copy. Do you need help pasting it?
Yes, how do I put it in a new folder?
Right-click the new folder and choose paste. Is that easy to find?
I did it. Thank you for your help.
You did a great job. Are you happy with the picture?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I kicked my shoes under the bed.
Do you want to put them back on?
Yes, please.
Good job helping.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a riddle about a box with a lid but no door. What is it?
That is a great puzzle. Do you like looking for clues?
Yes, I do. What is the answer?
It is a hat. Is that what you had in mind?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a bee buzzing near the flowers.
Bees make sweet honey from flowers. Do you like honey?
It had six legs and two wings.
Most insects have six legs, just like that bee. Can you count your fingers?
Is a spider an insect too?
No, spiders are not insects because they have eight legs. Do you have two hands?
What is a tiny bug that flies at night?
I do not know the exact name of the bug you saw. Does it look fuzzy or shiny?
My mom says ants are strong workers.
Yes, ants work together to carry heavy things. Do you like to help clean?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: My boss helped me fix my bike when it broke. How do I fix a flat tire?
That is a very nice thing for a boss to do. Do you have a tube and glue with you?
Yes, I have the tools. I do not know where to look for the hole.
You can submerge the tube in water to find bubbles. Do you have a bucket of water?
I do have water. How do I put the patch on?
You must glue the spot and press the patch down hard. Does that sound simple to you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a secret. I must go now.
That sounds fun. What is it about?
It is a cat. I have no time.
A cat secret? Why is it a secret?
It is hiding in the box. Go away.
Good luck. Be safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My chickens are not eating well. What should I do?
I am sorry to hear that. Do they look happy and clean?
Yes, they look fine, but they sit a lot.
They might be bored. Is there a quiet place for them to run?
Yes, there is a small yard.
That is good. I am not an expert, but let them play there more.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so worried and I have to go.
It is okay to feel that way. What is making you worry?
My job is scary and I am late.
That sounds like a hard load. Do you have a plan for today?
I do not know what I will do.
Taking a deep breath can help. Is there one small step you can take now?
I guess I can just start the first part.
That is a good step. How does that feel to you?
It feels better, thank you.
I am glad you feel a bit lighter.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the fence so tall?
It keeps the deer out. Do you see deer here?
I do not see any.
They hide in the grass. Do you like watching them?
Yes, I love watching.
That is why we built it. Are you cold out here?
A little bit.
Let us go inside soon. Thank you for your help.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to camp but I do not know where to start.
That is a big step. Do you like the water or the trees?
I like the trees but I am scared of bugs.
Bugs are just small friends. Do you have a warm jacket?
Yes, I have a big red one. What else do I need?
I know a lot of things but I do not know your exact needs. What is your biggest worry?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: It is so hot today. My head hurts from the sun.
That sounds very bad. Do you have a cold drink?
No, I only have water and it is warm. I want to hide in the dark.
Warm water can help you cool down. What makes you feel best?
Nothing feels good. My shirt is wet with sweat. I am just tired.
I understand why you are upset. Are you near a tree or a house?
I am sitting on a bench. It is just too hot to move.
A bench is not a safe place to stay. Do you see a building nearby?
Yes, there is a shop with ice cream. But I am too sad to go in.
Ice cream is cold and sweet. Would you like to sit by the door?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now. Do you remember your promise?
Yes, I will help you with your bag. Are you late for a meeting?
I have no time to talk. Please just hold it.
I will hold it tight. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am thinking about my favorite fruit, the banana.
Bananas are sweet and soft. Did you eat one today?
Yes, I ate a banana at lunch. It made me feel happy.
That is a nice start to the day. Do you like the peel?
I do not like the peel. I only like the yellow part inside.
The inside is the best part. Did you share any with friends?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn to ride a bike.
That sounds like fun. What made you pick the bike?
I am proud when I try new things.
Good for you. Just hold on tight and smile.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like bananas very much.
Bananas are sweet and yellow. Do you eat the whole skin?
No, I only eat the soft part inside.
That is the tasty part. Do you like to peel them for others?
Sometimes I peel for my little sister.
That is very kind of you. Do you eat them with milk?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I build a snowman?
Start with three big balls of snow. Do you have a carrot for the nose?
Yes, I have a carrot. What do I do next?
Put the balls on top of each other. Then stick the carrot on the bottom one.
I added the carrot. How do I make it smile?
Use small stones for the eyes and mouth. Are the stones cold?
They are very cold. Is that all I need to do?
Yes, you made a great snowman. Did you play in the snow too?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My neighbor's dog barks all night. I am so tired and angry.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you know if the owner is home?
I do not know. I just want some quiet sleep.
That sounds very hard. Would you like to try talking to him tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you have any chocolate cake left?
Yes, we have some left. Do you like chocolate cake?
I do. Is it sweet?
It is very sweet. Would you like a piece?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My new neighbor is very loud at night.
That must be hard. Do you think he is just having fun?
I hope so, but it keeps me awake.
Try closing your window first. Does that help?
I will try that. Thank you.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very tired today. Why is my body so heavy?
Your body needs rest to fix itself. Are you eating enough?
Yes, I had a big breakfast. Is it normal to feel this way?
It is normal if you did not sleep well. Did you dream a lot last night?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no time, but why do trees have roots?
Roots hold the tree tight in the ground. Do you like how strong they look?
Nice, but I must go, do trees drink from the roots?
Yes, roots drink water from the soil. Do you know if it rains today?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My horse jumped off the board.
Did you put it back in its square? Can I see your board?
Yes, I put it back.
That is a good start. Do you know which pieces can move first?
Only the pawns, I think.
You are right! Which color do you play with?
I play with the white pieces.
White moves first. Do you like the king or the queen better?
I like the king because he is important.
That is wise. Good luck with your next game.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the horse so big?
Horses are big to help people with work. Is your horse brown?
Why do they eat so much grass?
Grass gives them energy to run and jump. Do you feed it apples?
Why does it have a long tail?
It uses the tail to brush away flies. Do you like watching it?
Why can it not sit down?
I do not know the exact reason, but its legs are made to stand. Is it tired?
Why do they look so calm?
They feel safe when they know their friends. Do you trust it?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My tummy hurts really bad right now.
That sounds like a very bad tummy ache. Are you hungry?
I want to go see the doctor today.
Going to the doctor is a smart choice. What is your favorite color?
I am scared the needle will hurt.
It might tickle a little bit, but it helps you feel better. Do you like hugs?
Yes, please hold my hand when we go.
I will hold your hand tight the whole way. Have a good trip!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The bus is fast.
It is a busy day. Do you see the red light?
The cars are so loud. My head hurts.
Please take a deep breath. Is the bus close?
I must go now. The doors are open.
Good luck. I hope you make it.
Thank you. Bye.
You are welcome. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke the cup by accident and I am scared.
That is okay, accidents happen. Are you hurt?
No, I am not hurt but I do not know what to do next.
Did you tell an adult about it?
Not yet, I was too worried about the mess.
It is best to tell the truth. Do you feel ready now?
I think so, but what if they are angry?
Honesty usually makes people understand. Would you like to try?
Yes, I will go tell them now, thank you.
You are brave to be honest. Good luck!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go. My fish looks sad. Why?
Is it eating? I do not know for sure.
No, it is just swimming fast. I am in a big rush.
That is not normal. Is the water warm or cold?
It is a little warm. I need to leave now.
Put ice in a bag. Do not forget to feed it later.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to run fast, but my legs hurt.
Rest is good for your body. Do you have soft shoes to run in?
Yes, I have new shoes, but I still get tired.
You should eat well and drink water. How much water do you drink a day?
I drink a lot of water, but I still feel slow.
Take it slow and enjoy the ride.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The rain is too loud.
It is a big storm. Are your socks dry?
I do not know. I must go now.
Please be safe on the wet road.
The wind is very cold.
Yes, it blows hard. Do you have a coat?
I am running. I cannot stop.
Hurry, but do not fall.
I am almost there. Bye.
Good luck with the rain.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I sit at my desk but feel lost. What should I do?
Try to pick just one small thing to start. Do you know which task is easiest?
I do not know where to start. It feels hard.
You can just look at your list for one minute. What is the first word you see?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My computer makes a loud noise.
Is it a beep or a buzz? That helps me guess.
It is a low buzz.
Maybe the fan needs cleaning. Do you have a cloth?
Yes, I have a soft cloth.
Good. Turn it off first. That is safe.
I turned it off.
Wipe the vents gently. Be careful.
The vents are clean now.
I am glad it worked. Let us know if it stops.
It stopped the noise.
Nice job fixing it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am stuck on this cube. It is very hard.
That sounds tricky. What color is on top?
It is red. But the sides are all mixed up.
Good start. Do you see a white corner?
Yes, here. But I do not know where it goes.
Look for the matching colors on the side. Do they match?
Yes, they do. I put it in.
Great job. You are almost done.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do for my grandma.
That feels hard. Is she feeling sad?
Yes, she sits in her chair all day.
Maybe you can sit with her and read a book.
I will try that. Thank you.
I hope that helps. Do you like reading?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because I feel much better.
That is great news. I am glad to hear it. What made you feel this way?
I went to the doctor and got my check up.
That was a good thing to do. Did you have any funny moments there?
Yes, the doctor took my temperature and it was normal.
That is a good sign. Do you know when your next visit is?
I have to go back in a few weeks just to be safe.
It is wise to stay on top of your health. I am happy for you.
I think I am fully healthy now and ready for fun.
I am sure you are. I will be here if you need me again.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red balloon today and it made me smile.
That sounds nice. Did you hold the string?
No, it was stuck to a fence, but I tried to dance with it.
Haha, dancing is good. Do you like to dance?
Yes, I did a little spin and felt light inside.
That is a sweet feeling. I am glad for you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a small boat in my yard, but I am not sure what to do with it.
That is very nice. Do you like to swim?
I do, but I am not sure if the boat is safe to use.
It is hard to tell from here. Please check if the bottom has any big holes.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went to the beach today and it was so much fun.
That sounds lovely. Did you swim in the water?
Yes, I built a big sandcastle and ate cold ice cream.
What a sweet day. I am glad you had such a good time.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the main square now.
Go straight down that long road. Do you have a map?
No, just my feet. Is it very far away?
It is only ten minutes by foot. Are you lost?
I think I am lost. Which way is the bank?
Turn left at the big red tree. I hope you find it.
I am running now. Thank you very much.
Good luck on your run.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off trees in the fall?
Trees drop leaves to save energy when it gets cold. Do you like watching them float?
I think falling is scary for a leaf.
It is not scary, just a way to rest until spring. Have you ever caught one?
Yes, I catch them all the time.
That is very fun. How many have you caught today?
I have caught about ten so far.
That is a great number. They look like little coins.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hi, is the test hard? I am late.
It is okay. Do you know the date?
No. Tell me the time.
It is at noon. Is that soon?
Yes. I go now.
Good luck. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big rainbow after the rain stopped this morning. It looked like a bridge to the sky.
That sounds very pretty to see. Do you remember what colors you saw?
Yes, I saw red, yellow, and blue. It made my heart feel happy.
I am glad that you had such a nice moment.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in a big rush to fix this chair.
Let us look at it. Is it wobbly on one side?
Yes, the front leg is loose.
You can tighten the screws with a tool.
I do not have a tool with me.
I am sorry, I do not know where to buy one.
Can I use something else?
A strong stick might help for now. Do you have one?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sky is gray. I do not know if it will rain.
I see dark clouds above. Do you have a warm coat with you?
I am cold and I want to go home, but I am not sure it is safe.
I do not know for sure if it is raining outside. Are your feet dry right now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to throw a birthday party but I do not know what to do.
That sounds like fun! Do you like cake or candy?
I like both, but I am stuck on games.
I do not know your friends, so I cannot pick for you. Ask them what games they play at home.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I see the moon?
You just need to look up at the sky after dark. Do you like looking at stars too?
Yes, I do. Can I see it from inside my house?
Yes, you can look out a window. Are your windows clean?
I think so. What if it is cloudy?
Then you cannot see it clearly. Do you have a telescope?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love bananas. Do you?
I think they are sweet. Do you like them green?
I am late. No.
Okay, go now. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want a sandwich for lunch.
That sounds good. Do you like cheese?
Yes, I love cheese.
Nice. What kind of bread?
The soft white stuff.
Great choice. Is your mom packing it?
No, my dad is doing it.
Cool. Did he add any veggies?
He put in some carrots.
Yum. Have a great lunch.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck in a chess game. My king feels unsafe.
Move your king to a safe spot first. Do you see any empty squares near it?
Yes, there is one square that looks good. But I also want to win.
Protect your king, then look for a way to attack. Is the enemy king exposed?
It is not open yet. I am not sure what to do next.
I do not know your exact board layout. Try to block the enemy pieces.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, I am late! I forgot my keys.
Do not worry. Are they in your pocket?
No, I think I left them on the table.
I do not know for sure. Should we run back?
Yes, I must go. I will see you soon.
Wait a moment. Did you bring your phone?
I am holding it right here.
Good. You are ready to go.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread is not getting bigger. I am sad.
Do you use warm water? Yeast needs heat to wake up.
I used hot tap water. It was very warm.
That might kill the yeast. Try again with water that is just warm.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My cat is very happy today.
That is good. What is he doing?
He is chasing a red ball.
That sounds like fun.
He pounces on it and then sleeps.
Cats like to rest after play.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. My box of buttons is full, but I still want to find more.
That is a tough feeling. Do you have a big box for the extras?
No, just this one small box. I do not know where to put the new ones.
I do not know your house, so I cannot say. Are you willing to buy a bigger box?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to boil an egg. How long should I let it sit?
About ten minutes makes a good hard egg. Do you like soft yolks?
Yes, I do. Should I put them in cold water or hot water?
Start with cold water. That keeps the shell from cracking.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate rain. It is wet and cold.
I understand your feeling. Is your umbrella broken?
No, but I still get wet. It ruins my day.
That is very frustrating. What would you do if the sun came out?
I would go to the park. I just want dry clothes.
Dry clothes sound good. I do not know why it rains, but I hope it stops soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a snowman, but I am not sure how.
You start by rolling two big balls of snow. Do you like cold weather?
Yes, I do. What do I do with the balls?
Put the big ball on the ground and the smaller one on top. Then add a carrot for a nose.
That sounds fun. How do I make it stand up?
Make sure the bottom ball is very heavy and round. I do not know if your snow is wet enough.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I took a great picture today.
That is good news. What did you take a picture of?
I saw a big red truck.
A truck is a fun thing to see. Did it look new?
Yes, it looked very shiny.
Shiny things make nice photos.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my best cup. I feel very sad.
That is a hard thing to do. Do you want to tell me how it happened?
It fell off the shelf. I am not sure what to do now.
I do not know exactly, but we can fix it or choose a new one.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is a circle?
A circle is round like a wheel. Do you have a wheel nearby?
No, I have a square book.
A square has four equal sides. Do you like square books?
Yes, but what is a triangle?
A triangle has three pointed corners. Do you see any triangles outside?
I see a tree, but no triangles.
Trees are not usually triangles. Do you see any triangles in your house?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to pick the best apple to buy.
Look for one that feels firm. Do you like sweet apples or sour ones?
I love sweet ones.
Choose a red apple. It is usually very sweet.
Thanks, I will get a red apple.
That is a great choice. You will enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My phone fell in the soup. It is all sticky now.
Oh no, that sounds messy. Did you wipe it dry?
Yes, I used a towel. Now it will not turn on.
That is a tough spot. Do you know how to fix it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a hidden box and I do not know what to do.
That is a big secret. Did you check if it was yours?
I think it might be my friend's and I am scared to tell.
Honesty is always best. Would you like help finding him?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a red sock in the grass today.
That is a funny place to look. Did you find its pair?
No, it is still missing.
I am sorry to hear that.
I put the red sock in the machine.
Good idea. Are you using warm or cold water?
I am using warm water.
Warm water is good for most clothes.
The machine is spinning now.
That makes a loud sound.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with my drawing.
That is a nice shape. Do you like the color red?
Yes, I do, but I am still lost.
I do not know the end of the story. Are you feeling sad?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream on the grass today.
That must have made you feel very sad. Did you cry?
Yes, I did. My friends saw me.
It is okay to cry when you are upset. Did they help you?
One of them offered a napkin. It was small.
That is a kind thing to do. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to talk to my old friend, but I do not know what to say.
That sounds hard. Do you still feel close to them?
I am not sure. I just worry I might say the wrong thing.
I cannot know for sure, but most friends are kind. Would you like to try just saying hello?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have no time for eggs.
Toast is quick and warm. Do you like jam?
Yes, please. I am late.
Here is your toast. Are you wearing shoes?
Yes, I am going now.
Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a cool shell on the beach.
That is a lovely find. Do you have a box to keep it safe?
I am not sure where to put it.
A small shelf works well for many shells. Are you collecting only shells?
No, I also like smooth stones.
Stones and shells make a nice pair. Do you wash them before you store them?
Yes, I rinse them clean.
That is a good habit to keep them looking nice.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a cold. I feel so happy.
That is good for you. Do you like the rest?
Yes, I like the soup.
Soup is warm and good. Is it chicken?
It is tomato soup.
Nice choice. How is your nose?
It is stuffy.
That is hard. Do you like the warm air?
I do. I want to give you some.
No thanks, I am well.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My back hurts from carrying the box of books.
That sounds hard. Do you have a friend to help you?
Yes, Sam is bringing the sofa next.
Good. Take a break and drink some water.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up in January and the snow was so cold.
That sounds chilly. Did you wear a coat?
Yes, I wore my big red coat to work.
Good idea to stay warm. How was your commute?
It was slow because the roads were slick.
That can be tricky to drive on. Were you safe?
I was safe, but I felt tired by lunchtime.
Rest is important. Did you take a break?
I took a nap and now it is July in my head.
Your imagination is wild. Why July?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my boss so nice?
She likely cares about her team. Do you feel safe at work?
Yes, I do. How can I be that kind?
Just listen well to others. Do you try to help them?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very worried and I must go.
I am sorry to hear that. What is making you feel this way?
I have too much to do today.
That sounds like a heavy load. Do you need help with one small task?
I am sorry, I have to run.
I understand your rush. Take a deep breath before you go.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I was falling from a very high tower in my dream.
That sounds scary. Do you feel okay now?
Yes, but my legs still feel shaky.
That is a normal body feeling. How is your breakfast looking?
I am eating some warm soup right now.
That is a good choice. I do not know why you dreamed that, but you are safe in bed.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a sore throat and a fever. What should I do?
That sounds bad. How many days have you felt sick?
It is my third day. I feel very tired.
You should see a doctor today. Do you have a cough too?
Yes, a dry cough. Is that normal?
It can happen with a sore throat. Please rest and drink warm water.
Okay. Should I take medicine?
I do not know your body, so ask the doctor. I am glad you are going to get help.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does walking help my body?
It makes your heart strong. Do you like to run?
I do, but why is walking good for my brain?
It helps you think better. Do you feel tired?
Yes, I am tired. Can walking fix that?
Yes, it gives you more energy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am stuck and do not know what to do.
That is okay. Is the problem big or small?
It is big. I feel bad about it.
You are safe. What part feels the most hard?
I just want to fix it fast.
Slow is okay. Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I went to the beach today.
That sounds fun. Did you swim in the water?
Yes. The waves were big and warm.
How did that feel?
It felt like flying. I want to tell everyone about it.
You can share your joy. You sound great.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I count to ten?
Start with one and go up by one each time. Do you know how to say the numbers?
Yes, I know the words.
Great, just put them in order from one to ten. Is that clear to you?
Yes, I think I get it.
Good, try it out loud for fun. Have a good day!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not want to wait for my cookie to cool.
Why do you think it needs to cool?
I am very hungry and it is hot.
It will taste better when it is cool.
I do not care. I just want it now.
I am not sure why you feel that way. Can you tell me what is making you angry?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the grass turn yellow in the fall?
The leaves use up their food for the winter. Do you like the brown leaves?
No, I like the green ones. Why do we get cold in the winter?
The sun gives less light to our spot. Do you wear a hat when it is cold?
Yes, I wear a big red hat. Why does the snow melt in the spring?
The sun comes back and gets warmer. Do you like building snowmen?
Yes, but I miss the summer. Why do the flowers come back in the spring?
They wake up from their long sleep. Do you plant seeds?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my plants grow tall?
Give them light and water every day. Do you have a sunny window?
Yes, I do.
Put them near the glass.
That sounds easy.
Yes, it is.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Hi. I am very happy today.
That is great to hear. What made you so happy?
I got a new dog. He is very cute.
A new dog is a wonderful gift. Is he a puppy?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to send a letter to my grandma.
That is a nice idea. How old are you?
I am seven years old.
You are the right age to write. Do you have a stamp?
No, I do not have a stamp.
We can get one at the window. Would you like to wait in line?
Yes, please.
Great. The line is short.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. What can I do?
Drink some water. Do you have a fever?
No, I do not. I am just tired.
Try to rest for a while. Did you sleep well last night?
I did not sleep at all.
That is why you feel bad. Go to bed now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Oh no, the lights went out! But I am so glad.
That is good to hear. Do you like the dark?
Yes, it feels like a big hug.
How warm does it feel in there?
It is cozy. I have a candle.
Please be careful with the fire.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now. Is the water in the sea salty?
Yes, it is very salty. Why does it have to be so salty?
I am late for my boat. Do fish live in the deep dark part?
Yes, many fish live deep down. Do you know which kind?
I do not have time to think. Is the water cold?
Yes, it is always cold. I hope you have a good trip.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to bake a cake for tomorrow.
That sounds fun. What flavor do you like best?
I like chocolate, but I have no eggs.
You can use bananas instead. Do you have any bananas?
Yes, I have three ripe ones.
Great, they work well. Let's start by mixing them.
Okay, I will mash them now.
Good job. Are you ready for the flour next?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to pack my box right now.
What are you putting in first?
My old shoes and some papers.
Are you moving to a new house?
Yes, but I am running out of time.
Take a deep breath. You can do this.
Do I need a tape gun for this?
Yes, a tape gun is very helpful.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the fence so tall?
To keep the rabbits out. Do you have rabbits?
No, but the cat likes to jump.
The tall top helps stop the cat from climbing. Is the fence new?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the library today.
That sounds nice. Did you find a book you liked?
I held a book about big cats.
Big cats are cool. Did you read it all?
I could not keep my eyes open.
Oh no. Were you very tired?
Yes, I fell asleep on the floor.
That is funny. The librarian was kind about it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: It is very windy today. I want to learn how to fly a kite.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a big kite?
Yes, I have a red one. How do I make it go up?
You must run fast and let go of the string. Do you like running?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why is my bread big?
Yeast makes gas. It fills holes. Are you using fresh yeast?
I just need the size. Skip the rest.
The gas puffs it up. Like a balloon. Do you love soft bread?
I do not care about the gas.
I do not know why you are mad. I only know yeast works.
Tell me the end. Is it done?
It is ready if it doubles. Is it warm to the touch?
I will go check it now.
That sounds good. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big white cloud today.
That sounds nice. What shape was it?
It looked like a big dog.
A dog cloud is fun. Did it move?
Yes, it went fast across the sky.
Clouds can move quickly. Do you like the sky?
I do. It is very blue.
Blue skies are happy. I am glad you noticed it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My friend is sad. How can I help?
Sit with them and listen. Is it about school?
Yes, he failed a test. What do I say?
Tell him it is okay to feel bad. Do you want to share a snack?
I have some cookies. Is that good?
That sounds very kind. I do not know if it fixes the grade, but it helps feelings.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The bread here looks very soft. Is it good?
Yes, it is very tasty and warm. Do you like sweet or salty food?
I like sweet things like cakes. Do you have any?
We have lemon cakes and chocolate buns. I do not know which one you prefer. Which one sounds good to you?
The lemon cake looks nice. Can I buy one?
Yes, you can have one. Thank you for asking my help.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look, the sunset looks like a big fire! It is so red and warm.
That is a very pretty color. Is the sky changing right now?
Yes, the orange is fading into purple. It feels like magic.
Magic is a lovely way to see the world.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do bees turn flowers into sweet honey?
They eat sweet flower juice and dry it with their wings. Do you like sweet food?
I do! How can I make something sweet at home?
You can boil fruit sugar until it turns thick. What is your favorite fruit?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to share a picture with my friend, but the web was very slow today.
That can be frustrating when you wait a long time. Did you try again later?
I did, and it finally went through just before dinner.
I am glad it worked for you. How is your dinner?
It is just soup and bread, which is enough for me.
That sounds like a warm meal. Do you know if the internet is fixed?
I am not sure, but the speed looks better now.
That is good news to hear. Did you see anything else on the web?
I saw a funny cat video that made me laugh hard.
Happy sounds like a good way to end the day. I hope you get some rest soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am trying to count my toes.
How many toes do you see on one foot?
I count five on each foot.
That is right. Do you have two feet?
Yes, I have two feet.
So you have ten toes in all.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I can't sleep. I want to read, but my eyes hurt. What should I do?
A warm lamp helps your eyes rest. Do you have a soft light nearby?
Yes, I have a small lamp. It works well.
That is a good choice. You should close the book now.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to watch a movie tonight. Which one should I pick?
Do you like funny stories or scary ones?
I like funny ones that make me smile.
Watch the last cartoon we saw together. It is very warm.
That sounds perfect. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome. Do you have your favorite snack ready?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the red train?
It is on the far left. Are you going to the city?
Yes. Thank you. I must run.
You are welcome. Good luck on your ride.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to save money for a bike, but I never have any left.
Try keeping coins in a jar by your door. Do you get an allowance?
Yes, I get five dollars every week.
Put most of it in the jar and keep a little for fun.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the driving school today and I was very nervous.
That is a normal feeling. Did you get to touch the wheel?
Yes, I held the wheel and I felt strong. I moved the car a little bit.
Well done, that is a big step. What was the hard part?
The car was too loud and the teacher spoke fast. I did not know what to do for a second.
Loud cars can be scary. Does the car have a music player?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very proud, but I do not know what to do next.
It is good to feel proud. What did you do well?
I finished my book, but now my hands are tired.
Resting is a kind thing to do. Do you have a chair nearby?
Yes, there is one right here.
That is the true and best choice.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my flowers grow taller?
Give them lots of sun and water. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
Yes, I have a big window.
Perfect. Put the pots near that glass. Do you use special soil?
I just use dirt from the garden.
That works well. Keep the soil moist but not wet.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I learned a new fun fact today!
That sounds great. What did you learn?
Dinosaurs lived a long time ago.
Yes, they are all gone now. Do you like them?
I love them so much.
They are very cool.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big white ship today.
That sounds fun. Did it have a name?
The captain wore a blue hat.
I do not know who that was. Was he smiling?
He waved at me as the ship left.
How nice. Did you wave back?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a riddle. What has a bed but does not sleep?
That is a hard one. A river fits that description. Do you like water?
Yes, I do! The answer is a river. I got it right.
Well done. You are very clever. Did you make up the riddle?
No, it was in my book. What has hands but cannot clap?
That is a clock. It has hour and minute hands. Do you like clocks?
Yes, I love looking at time. I am happy now.
I am glad you are happy. You did a great job today.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I count to ten?
You start at one and go up by one each time. Do you know the numbers yet?
Yes, I know my numbers.
Great! Just say one, two, three, and keep going. What is your favorite number?
I like the number five.
Five is a nice number. It is right in the middle.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was very bright today.
That sounds warm. Did you enjoy the light?
I saw a butterfly dance in the light.
How lovely. Was the butterfly yellow?
Yes, it had little yellow wings.
It must have been happy too.
Then the clouds came in fast.
Ah, it gets cloudy sometimes.
The sun hid behind them for a bit.
Nature has many moods.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go, but my shirt is dirty. How do I wash it?
Put it in the machine with soap. Do you know where the soap goes?
Yes, I do. Please make it fast.
Use the quick cycle setting. It will be done soon.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I ran a mile today and I feel so good.
That is great news. How did your legs feel?
They hurt a little, but I am happy.
That hurts a bit, but it helps you grow. Do you want to run tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found this blue flower in the yard. What should I do with it?
That is a nice find. Do you like its color?
Yes, I do, but I am not sure if it is safe to keep.
Most flowers are safe to hold. Have you picked a spot for it?
I do not have a pot, so I do not know where to put it.
You can put it in a cup with water. Does that work for you?
That sounds easy. I will try it now.
I hope you like your new plant.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sun so hot?
It burns fuel deep inside to make light and heat. Do you like warm days?
Does the sun ever get tired?
No, it has plenty of fuel to shine for a very long time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do clouds float in the sky?
They are very light, so they do not fall. Do you like looking up at them?
Yes, I do. What are they made of?
They are made of tiny drops of water. Do you see rain sometimes?
Yes, when they get heavy. Do they always turn into rain?
No, some just fade away into air.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like that song, but it feels sad.
Sad songs can be lovely. Do you like crying?
Yes, it helps me feel things.
Then the song is working well. Is it your favorite?
Maybe. But I want something happy too.
Try picking a song with fast drums. What color makes you happy?
Blue. Do you know a blue song?
I do not know a song that is blue.
Oh. Can you think of a happy one?
How about singing one you know?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is very bright today.
That sounds so warm. Do you have a cold drink?
Yes, I have ice water. It is very good.
Ice water is great for heat. Do you like swimming?
I love to swim in the pool.
Water is the best thing in summer. Is it fun?
Yes, I am very happy today.
I am glad you feel good. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I fold a paper crane for my grandma?
You start with a square piece of paper. Do you have a stack of them?
I do, but I get stuck on the wings.
Just fold the top corners down to the middle line.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I can count my five fingers.
That is right. Can you count to six?
One, two, three, four, five, six.
You did a great job. How many toes do you have?
I have ten toes on my feet.
Yes, that is true. Do you like counting?
Yes, I like to count my toys.
That is fun. How many cars do you have?
I have three blue cars.
That is a good number.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I really wanted to build a snowman today, but the snow is all melted.
I am sorry to hear that. Was the weather supposed to be cold today?
Yes, but the sun came out and made everything slushy and wet.
That can happen when the sun is very warm. Do you have a place to play inside?
I guess I can read a book about winter animals, but I still wish for snow.
That is a nice idea for a cozy day. Do you like reading about penguins?
I do, but I really just wanted to play outside in the white powder.
