I understand why you are sad. Maybe it will snow again soon?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling into a deep hole. I do not know what to do now.
That sounds very frightening. I am not sure why that happened, but I am here. Do you feel safe now?
I do not know if I am safe. My heart beats so fast. I want the bad feeling to stop.
Taking slow breaths can help calm your body. I believe in you. Is your heart still beating fast?
It is a little better. But my mind is still full of scary thoughts. I want to go back to sleep.
You can try to think about something nice. I do not know if that will work for you. What makes you feel happy?
A warm hug makes me feel good. I think I will close my eyes now.
That is a wonderful plan. You are doing a great job. Good night.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad because I lost the map.
That feels bad. Did you look in your bag?
No, I did not find it there.
That is true. You looked carefully.
I need the map to find my way home.
Let us think together. Where did you last see it?
I do not know where I saw it last.
That is okay. We can ask someone else.
Who can I ask for help?
Maybe a friend nearby can help you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a strange box in the attic. It has no key.
That is very exciting. Do you know what is inside?
It feels heavy. Is it full of toys?
I do not know for sure. Can you open it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Give me a burger and fries fast.
I can do that. Do you want a drink too?
Yes, just a soda. Please hurry.
Your food is ready. I will bring it now.
Thanks. I must go.
Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just won my first tennis match.
That is great news. Did you hit the ball over the net?
Yes, I hit it right into the corner.
I am so happy for you. What do you do when you are free?
I run around and practice my swing.
That sounds like a lot of fun.
I can teach you how to hold the racket.
I would love to learn.
Bring your shoes to the park tomorrow.
Okay, see you then.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make my new friend feel happy?
Try giving them a warm smile. What do they like to do?
He likes to play ball.
That is a great idea. Go play with him today.
Okay, I will try that.
You will be a great friend. Have fun out there?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the weather get so hot in the summer?
The sun is closer to our spot on the earth. Do you like eating ice cream when it is warm?
Yes, I do. But why does it snow in the winter?
The sun shines less on us, so it gets very cold and the water turns to ice. Do you like building snowmen?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because the sun is out.
That is great. Do you like how warm it feels?
Yes, it feels like a big hug.
That is a sweet way to say it.
I want everyone to see it too.
You can share that joy. Is it bright outside?
Yes, it is bright and beautiful.
Enjoy the light.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red balloon today.
That sounds like fun. Did it fly away?
Yes, a wind took it up high.
Oh no, that is sad. Do you have a new toy?
I found a lost cat on the path.
You are very kind. Was the cat scared?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the rain in the sky red?
That is not rain. Is it wet where you stand?
No, it is dry. Why are there so many colors?
Light splits into different colors. Do you see a full circle?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very big inside.
That is a nice feeling. What did you do?
I helped my friend.
You are kind. Did you feel happy?
Yes, I was very glad.
That is good for you. Tell me more.
I held his hand.
That was a kind act. You should feel proud.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My little sister cried today.
That is very sad. Did she tell you why?
She said her toy broke.
I am sorry about that. Do you know how to fix it?
I do not know.
Maybe you can ask an adult for help.
She also lost her favorite book.
That is a lot of bad luck. Do you want to make her a drawing?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am waiting for my cookies.
How long have you been sitting here?
A very long time.
I know that feels slow. What did you do while you waited?
I counted the minutes.
That is a good way to pass time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a fence for my small garden.
A fence will keep rabbits away. Do you have the wood ready?
Yes, I have some old boards. Are they strong enough?
I do not know if they are strong. They must be thick and not broken.
They look a bit thin. What else should I check?
Check for rot and loose nails. Are the posts straight?
I think the posts are crooked. How do I fix that?
Pull them straight or pour cement. Do you have a level?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to tie a fishing line. Can you show me?
Sure, first put the hook through the eye. Do you have a knot in mind?
Not really, what should I do next?
Make a loop around your finger and pull it tight. Is the line strong enough?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to walk more to stay strong, but I am not sure where to start.
Start with a small walk in a park. Do you like the fresh air?
Yes, I do like it. How long should I walk at first?
Try ten minutes a day to begin. Is that too much for you?
Ten minutes sounds good. I will try it tomorrow.
That is a great plan. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my bread get so big?
Tiny bugs eat the sugar and make gas. Do you use yeast?
Yes, I do.
That is true. The gas makes it puff up.
What if I use too much?
It may taste bad or fall flat.
It smells like beer.
That is just the gas. Is it warm in there?
Yes, it is warm.
Warm makes it work fast.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a roof for my shed before the rain starts.
Use thick wood for the frame first. Do you have your tools ready?
Yes, but I must nail the slats on fast.
Start at the bottom and work up. Is the floor level?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very tired today.
That sounds hard. What are you doing now?
I do not know what to do.
Resting is good. Do you want to take a short nap?
Maybe, but I feel unsure.
It is okay to be unsure. Let us just breathe for a moment.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my phone screen all dark?
It may be asleep. Do you see the power button?
I pushed it, but it stays black.
That sounds like a dead battery. Can you plug in the charger?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the big ship float on the water?
It floats because the air inside it pushes down on the water. Do you have a toy boat?
Yes, I do. It floats too.
That is true. The boat pushes water out of its way.
Why does the water not sink the ship?
The push up from the water is strong enough to hold the ship. Is the water cold or warm?
It is warm today.
Warm water helps too.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I make a cloud in a jar?
Mix warm water with shaving cream. Do you have a jar ready?
Yes, I have a clean jar. What do I use for the water?
Use hot water from the tap. Be careful not to burn yourself.
I put it in. Now what do I do?
Swirl the mixture gently. Do you see the fluffy shape?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the bank. I am late.
Is the bank on the main street?
I do not know. Just tell me.
Yes. Walk north one block.
Is it far?
No, it is close. Do you like the view?
I have no time.
You are almost there.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My cat sleeps all day. Is that normal?
Yes, cats sleep a lot. Does your cat eat well?
Yes, he eats his food fast. But he is very loud at night.
That can be tiring. Does he wake up at the same time?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to know about old Rome, but I am lost.
Rome was a big place with many roads. Did you like reading about them?
Yes, I read a book, but the words are too hard.
Try to look for pictures first. Do you see any maps in the book?
I do not know what to do next.
Ask a teacher for a simple guide. Would you like that help?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My cat sat on my math book today.
That is very funny. Did he hurt the pages?
No, he just slept on the big numbers.
I am glad the book is safe.
Then I wrote my name on the table by mistake.
Oh no, that must be hard to clean. Did you use water?
Yes, the teacher helped me wipe it away.
That is a good thing. You did a great job.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the chair wiggling so much?
A screw is loose. Is it hurt?
No, just my arm. Why do screws loosen?
Wood moves with the air. Do you have a tool?
Yes, I do. Why does the wood move?
It swells in wet air. Is it dry here?
It is dry. How do I fix it?
Turn the screw tight. Can you do it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because my tomatoes are red now.
That is great news. Do you like to eat them raw?
Yes, they taste sweet. I put some in my lunch box.
That sounds delicious. Where do you keep your garden?
It is right next to my house. The sun shines on it all day.
Sun helps them grow strong. Have you picked any today?
I picked ten big ones. I shared some with my neighbor.
Sharing is kind. I do not know if he likes them.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my picture look blurry?
You might be moving your hand too fast. Do you hold the camera close to your chest?
I do, but it still looks fuzzy.
You could try holding it with two hands for more support. Does the sun shine where you stand?
The sun is behind me, so the picture is dark.
You should turn around so the light hits the front. Do you like taking pictures of people?
Yes, I love taking pictures of my dog.
That is a great thing to do for fun. Is your dog calm enough to sit still?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go. Did Grandma eat lunch?
Yes, she had a warm soup. Is she feeling better today?
I do not know. Did she take her pills?
I do not know if she took them. Did you see the bottle?
Yes, it is empty. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. I hope she feels great soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what to do. Should I say please or should I stay quiet?
It is always good to be polite. Do you think they will like hearing "please"?
I tried to be nice, but I still feel a bit unsure. How do I know if I am being rude?
I do not know the exact feeling you have, but kindness is best. Are you trying to help a friend right now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The page is broken and I cannot see the picture.
I am sorry that happened. Did you try to wait a bit?
I did wait, but it still looks empty.
That is very frustrating. Maybe the road is slow. Do you have a plan for later?
I just want to finish my work quickly.
I understand your need. I do not know the fix for you. Can we try a new page?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing at the platform and I do not know which way to go.
That can feel scary. Are you holding your ticket?
Yes, I have the paper ticket in my hand but I am still unsure.
Look for the sign that matches your number. Do you see one?
I see the sign now and I am ready to walk to the door.
Great job. Have a happy ride.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do robots have feelings?
I do not know if they do, but I am happy to talk with you. What do you think?
I think they are cool because they can walk.
That is a good point. Do you have any robot toys?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is howling outside. I am afraid to sleep.
That is a scary sound. Are you safe in your home?
Yes, I am inside. But the power might go out.
Let us make a little plan. Do you have any candles?
I have some flashlights. I do not have candles.
Flashlights are a great choice. Keep them close to you.
The rain is hitting hard now. It makes me feel bad.
Let us listen to some soft music. Do you like that idea?
Yes, music helps me feel calm. Thank you for helping me.
You are very welcome. Sleep well and stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have been sitting here for a long time. My legs hurt.
That sounds hard. Do you want to wiggle your toes?
Yes, I wiggled them but we are still waiting. Why is this taking so long?
I do not know why it takes so long. Is the thing you are waiting for important?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The petals on my rose are soft. Do you know why?
Soft petals help hold water and protect the plant. Do you like soft things?
I also have a tulip that looks sad. What should I do?
It may just need more sun and water. Is it in a pot?
Yes, it is in a red pot. It smells sweet, too.
Sweet smells help bugs find the flowers. Do you smell it too?
I do. Thank you for your help.
I am glad I could help. Do you have many plants?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because school was really fun.
That is wonderful news. What did you enjoy the most?
I painted a big blue whale for my art class.
That sounds like a great project. Did you use lots of colors?
Yes, I used blue and white and a little bit of green.
Those colors work well together. How did your teacher like it?
She said it was the best whale she had seen all year.
She must have been very impressed. Do you plan to paint more?
I want to make a whole ocean next.
That is a lovely idea. I hope it turns out well for you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at this map, but I am lost.
Do not worry. Do you know where you want to go?
I think I need to go north, but the lines are hard to read.
North is up on the map. Which line is the thickest?
The big red line right here.
That is usually the main road. Is there a dot near your start?
Yes, there is a small blue dot.
Good. Follow the red line from the blue dot.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does my magnet stick to the fridge but not the wall?
Because the fridge has a special metal inside. The wall is usually brick or wood. Do you like to touch cold things?
The fridge feels really cold.
Yes, it keeps food fresh. Cold things can feel icky, but they are safe. Do you like ice cream?
I love ice cream, but I don't like when the magnet gets hot.
Magnets do not really get hot from sticking. They might feel warm if they were in the sun. Have you played outside today?
I played with blocks and magnets.
That is a fun way to build towers. Tall stacks are hard to keep up. Do you try to make them fall on purpose?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky so dark?
The clouds are very thick. Are you scared?
Why is the wind so loud?
The air is moving very fast. Do you hear the rain?
Why do the trees bend down?
The strong wind pushes them. Is it safe inside?
Why is it thundering?
The clouds bump and make a big boom. Do you see the light?
Why does it rain now?
The water in the clouds falls down. I do not know when it will stop.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a shiny toy today and wanted to buy it.
That can be hard when we want new things. Did you buy it?
No, I put it back and saved the coin.
That is smart and kind to your future self.
I felt a little sad at first, but then happy.
Your wallet is happy now, and that is good.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I met a new friend at the park today.
That is good news. Did you play together?
Yes, we threw a ball.
What color was the ball?
It was red.
I did not know that, but it sounds like fun.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I like to read in bed, but I am scared of the dark.
Try a small lamp. Do you have one?
I have a big lamp, but it hurts my eyes.
Use a battery light. It is soft and safe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big secret and I am very happy about it.
That sounds fun. What is the surprise?
My family is going to me for a trip to the beach.
Oh, that is lovely. Will you build big sand castles?
Yes, we will swim and eat ice cream all day.
Yum, that is a sweet treat.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we cry when we watch sad movies?
Our brains feel the pain of the characters. Do you like to cry?
I like it. Why do fast cars look cool on screen?
Speed makes us feel excited and free. Do you like fast things?
Yes, I do. Why do bad guys look so scary?
The actors use big muscles and loud voices to frighten us. Do you get scared?
Not really. Why do we clap at the end?
We clap to show we enjoyed the story. Do you clap often?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The big dog knocked down my little white fence.
I am sorry to hear that. Is your dog okay?
The dog is fine, but my garden looks broken.
That feels bad. Do you have any extra wood?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I broke my cup!
Oh no. Are you okay?
Yes, I am fine. It was just a toy.
That is good. Do you want a new one?
I will fix it with glue.
Nice try. Will it hold?
I think so. Thanks.
Good luck. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a big bear in the woods. Is it safe?
Bears can be dangerous. Do you know where you are?
I am in a busy town park.
That is very safe. Do you like to feed animals?
I do not want to feed them.
That is smart. Never give food to wild animals.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very late for school and I feel so bad.
Being late happens to everyone. Did you try to wake up early?
I slept in because I was tired. What can I do now?
Tell your teacher the truth when you get there. Do you know why you were tired?
I stayed up playing games last night. I am worried she will be angry.
Honesty is always the best choice. Have you packed your books?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big ship on the water today. It looked so cool.
That sounds like a fun trip. What does a sailor do all day?
I think they just sit and look at the water.
They actually steer the ship and check the maps. Do you like to draw pictures of boats?
Yes I do. Do sailors live on the boat?
Many of them do sleep there, yes. It must be a big home.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at this square! I am so happy right now.
It is a very nice square. What made you feel so happy?
I just found it and it feels warm. Do you like warm squares?
I do not have skin, so I cannot feel warmth. But I like your joy. Is it a soft square?
It feels like a soft cloud. It makes my heart smile. Do you have a favorite shape?
I am made of data, so I do not have a favorite shape. But I am glad you are smiling.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
They drink sweet plant juice and chew it to turn it into honey. Do you like sweet honey?
Why do they chew it?
Chewing changes the juice so it can be stored safely. Why do you ask?
What happens next?
They put the honey in wax cups inside the hive. Is that cool?
Where do they get the juice?
They take it from flowers using a special straw mouth. Do you see flowers?
Why do they share it with humans?
I do not know why they share it. Do you want some?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see a bright star up there. Is it a plane?
I think it is a star. What color is it to you?
It is white. My friend is waiting for me.
It is just a very far away light. Do you like looking up?
Yes, but I must run. What is that other light?
I do not know for sure. Is it moving?
No, it stays still. I have to go now.
Good luck on your way. Have fun with your friend.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we let the dough sit for a long time?
The yeast makes it grow. Do you like sweet bread?
Yes, I do. Why does the kitchen smell so nice now?
The heat wakes up the good smells. Is your oven ready?
It is warm. Why does the bread get a brown top?
The heat cooks the sugar on the skin. Do you want to try?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so good after my walk today.
That is great to hear. Do you have a favorite spot?
Yes, the park by the river.
A nice place for fresh air. How long did you walk?
Just thirty minutes.
A solid start. Keep it up.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a robot. I do not know what to do with it.
That is a surprise. Do you know if it is broken?
It looks sleepy. Should I turn it on?
I do not know for sure. Maybe you can ask it a small question first.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: How do bees make sweet honey?
They fly out to get nectar from flowers. Do you like flowers?
I am not sure what to do with the nectar.
They store it in their special bellies.
And then what happens inside?
They bring it back and dry it out. Are bees busy workers?
I still do not know if it becomes honey.
Yes, the water leaves and it turns into honey.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My neighbor is very loud. What should I do?
Have you asked them to be quiet?
I am too shy to talk to them.
You could try writing a kind note.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My sister has a new baby. What do I say to her?
You can tell her you love her. Do you know any cute songs?
I know Twinkle Twinkle Little Star. Is that good?
That is a very sweet choice. How much is the baby sleeping?
She sleeps all the time. It seems endless.
Babies need lots of rest to grow. Do you want to meet him today?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do bees make that yummy honey?
Bees drink sweet plant juice called nectar and carry it back to the hive. Do you know what flowers they visit?
I think they go to daisies. I saw one on them!
That is a great guess, but they visit many kinds of flowers. The bees dry the nectar into thick, sweet honey.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the river water always moving?
It moves because the water is heavier than the air and wants to go down to the sea. Do you like to swim in it?
No, but why is the water clear near the start and dark later on?
It is clear at the start because it is fresh from the mountain. It gets dark because it picks up dirt and plants as it travels. Have you seen the fish in it?
Yes, I did. Why do the fish swim against the flow sometimes?
I do not know the exact reason, but they might be looking for food.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: A small fire started in the kitchen last night.
That is scary. Are you safe?
Yes, we are safe, but I am very upset.
It is good to feel angry. Is the air clear now?
The smoke went away, but my heart still beats fast.
Deep breaths help. Do you need water?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: How does a plant get its drink?
It pulls water up through its roots. Do you have a plant at home?
I do, but I am not sure how much water to give it.
It is best to check the soil before watering. Is the top inch of the dirt dry?
It feels dry to the touch.
Then you can water it slowly.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Help me find the missing piece of the puzzle.
Is it the blue corner piece? I do not see it.
No, it is not blue. Where is the red one?
It is under your shoe. Do you like red?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need help with my bike but I must go now.
It looks like the tire is flat. Did you hit a nail?
No time to check, just tell me the fix.
You need air and a tool. Do you have both with you?
I have no tools, only this map.
I do not know your route home. Is there a shop near?
Yes, but it is far and I am late.
You can push it and run. Are you sure you can handle it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big rainbow, but I do not know what to do with it.
Look up and smile at the colors. Do you like the red part best?
I am still not sure what I should do.
Stand still and watch it fade slowly.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a red ball and a blue cube. I am so happy to see them.
That is wonderful. Do you like the round shape or the square one better?
I love the round one because it rolls fast. It is so much fun to watch.
Rolling is very fun. Can you show me the red ball?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad about my plant dying.
I am sorry it passed away. Do you know what you gave it?
I think I just gave it too much water.
Yes, too much water can hurt the roots. Do you like looking at soil?
Not really, but I want to do better next time.
Plants take in water through their roots. This is a true fact. Do you like roots?
They look like messy hair to me.
They are like tiny straws for the plant. You can learn slowly.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The little village by the lake looks very quiet. How many people live there?
About fifty people live in that small place. Do you like the sound of the water?
Yes, I do. But I am not sure where the school is.
The school is near the red house. Do you have a map with you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My queen is broken. What do I do?
That is very bad news. Did she fall off the board?
No, I just cannot find her.
Let us look together. Did you see where she was last?
I think she is under the rug.
We should check there. Do you want to lift the rug?
Yes, I found her.
Great work. Are you ready to play again?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big surprise for you. I am so happy right now.
Oh, that is wonderful to hear. What is the surprise?
You will see when you open the door later.
I cannot wait to see it. Is it a gift?
It is a very special kind of gift. I hope you like it.
I am sure you will love it. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do lions live in the snow?
No, lions like hot places. What is your favorite animal?
I think it is a bear.
Bears are very strong. Do you know if they can climb trees?
Yes, some of them can.
That is a good fact to know. Are you afraid of big animals?
A little bit, but I like to watch them.
It is safe to watch from far away. Do you like the forest?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am moving to a new town. What should I look for first?
Check for a good park nearby. Do you like to walk or bike?
I love walking in the quiet spots. How do I know if a street is safe?
Visit the place at night to see the lights. Do you feel safe there?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My shirt has a red spot on it.
That looks like juice. Did you eat strawberries for lunch?
Yes, I did. How do I make it go away?
Use cold water and soap. Do you know where your soap is?
It is in the bathroom. Will the hole be fixed?
I hope so. Try washing it and see if it works.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do clouds get so heavy?
They fill up with tiny water drops until they can hold no more. Do you like the smell after it rains?
Yes, it smells sweet. Is that good for the plants?
Yes, the rain feeds the roots so they can grow big and strong. Do you have a favorite plant?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the baby so small?
Babies start very tiny to fit in the tummy. Do you like holding them?
Why does the baby cry all the time?
Crying tells the baby is hungry or tired. I am not sure why it is upset right now.
Why do people smile at the baby?
Smiling shows we are happy to see the baby. Does that make you smile too?
Why does the baby sleep so much?
Sleep helps the baby grow strong and big. Do you like to sleep a lot?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I get a horse to trust me?
Sit quietly by the horse for a few minutes to show you are calm. Do you have time to sit still today?
Yes, I can wait. How do I give him food?
Open your hand flat and let the horse come to you. Do you have an apple to share?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: It takes so long to wait for my turn on the slide.
I know waiting is hard. Do you want to play a quick game with me?
What game? I just want to go down the slide.
I do not know a game that makes time go faster. Are you feeling angry or just a bit bored?
I am bored. My brother is still picking his shoes.
That can feel very long. Let us count the birds in the sky while we wait.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet today?
The shops are closed for a rest. Do you like the peace?
Are the people sleeping inside?
Some are, yes. But some are walking in their beds. Do you hear the cats?
Why do cats move at night?
Their eyes see the dark well. I do not know all their secrets.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my old friend today at the park.
That sounds like a lovely surprise. How did they look?
They looked very happy and waved at me.
It must feel good to see someone you care about.
We sat on a bench and talked for an hour.
An hour is a lot of time for a chat.
Yes, we talked about our childhood.
Do you remember your favorite game from then?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do for the meeting.
Do you have a list of topics? That can help you pick.
I just want to talk, but I am scared.
It is good to be open. Have you told a friend before?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a very cool puzzle in my box. I want to show you.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What does it look like?
It has many small pieces. They are all blue and round.
Blue and round sounds tricky. Do you see any big edges?
Yes, I see the top part. It is all corners.
Great start. How many pieces do you have left?
Just a few. I think I am almost done.
You should be very proud. Can you finish it for me?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need shoes, but I am in a rush.
I can help. What size do you wear?
It is a size ten.
Do you want them for work or play?
Just for walking. I must go.
Okay, I will find them fast.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I hurt my friend and need to say sorry. How do I do that?
Look them in the eye and say you are sorry for what you did. Did you break their toy?
Yes, I broke their ball. What else should I say?
Tell them you will be more careful next time. Do you have a plan to fix it?
No, I do not have a plan. How can I make it right?
You can use your allowance to buy them a new one. Is that a fair idea?
That sounds like a good plan. Thank you for helping me.
I am glad I could help. Go talk to your friend now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to eat for lunch.
Try some apple slices and a small sandwich. Do you like cold or warm food?
I like warm food, but I feel too tired to cook.
A bowl of hot soup is a good choice. Would you like a simple recipe?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to go to the doctor?
Your body needs a check-up. Are you feeling tired?
I am not tired. Why?
I do not know for sure. It helps to keep you strong. Do you like candy?
I like candy. Is that the reason?
No, it is not the reason. The doctor wants to listen to your heart. Does it beat fast?
No, it beats slow. Why listen to it?
It shows if you are healthy. I hope you feel good soon. Are you scared?
I am a little scared. Why must I go?
Going helps you stay well. You will be okay.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the wind feel cold on my face?
It moves the warm air away from you. Do you like when it is warm?
Yes, I do. What does the wind do to trees?
It makes them shake and dance.
Can the wind break big trees?
Yes, very strong winds can. Is it windy where you live?
Sometimes. Does the wind help plants grow?
It helps them get fresh air.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very cold and my nose is running.
That sounds like a bad cold. Are you drinking warm soup?
Yes, I drank some chicken soup this morning.
That is a good choice. Do you feel tired today?
Yes, I am tired and my throat hurts.
Rest is very important for healing. Please sleep a lot.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hurry, what does a lion eat?
Lions eat meat. Do you like meat?
No, I am late. What does a deer eat?
Deer eat leaves and grass.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for the big day.
Take a deep breath. Do you have your rings?
Yes, I found them on the table.
That is good news.
The car is waiting outside.
Perfect. What time is the start?
It starts in ten minutes.
You have time.
Thank you for helping me.
I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My dog is not eating his food today. I feel bad about it.
That sounds scary. Is he still playing or running around?
He is just lying on the bed all day.
I do not know why he is sick. Please tell a grown person to take him to the doctor.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My boss is very nice. He smiles at me every day.
That is great! Do you like his smile?
Yes, I do. He gives me big hugs too.
What a kind man he is!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked in the park today and saw a red leaf. I put it in my pocket.
A red leaf is a nice find. Where do you keep it now?
It is in a jar on my desk. I look at it when I think.
That sounds like a quiet joy.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I have a bad cold and want to make soup.
A warm broth helps many people. Do you have any chicken?
Yes, I have two drumsticks. What should I do first?
Put them in a pot with water. Should we add some carrots?
I have carrots, but I do not know how to cut them.
Use a knife and make small, thin slices. Are you careful with knives?
I am careful, but I still feel very sick.
Rest is the best medicine. Do you want to take a nap?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a small shed in my yard.
That sounds like fun. Do you have the wood ready?
No, I have just the tools.
Good start. What is your main goal?
I want it to hold my bikes safely.
Bikes need a wide space. Have you drawn a plan?
I tried, but it looks too small.
Draw a bigger door. Do you have a helper?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at the big hill, but I do not know if I should go up.
Climbing is hard work, but the view is very nice. Do you like walking or sitting?
I just want to see what is on top, but I am afraid of falling.
You can bring a strong stick to help you walk. Have you climbed anything tall before?
I have climbed a tree, but this looks much bigger.
A tree is a great start. Why not just take one small step to see how it feels?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late and missed my bus.
Oh no, that is a bad start. What did you do next?
I tried to walk home but took a wrong turn.
Walking is good exercise, but it is risky. Do you have a map?
I checked my bag, but the map is gone.
That is a real problem. Did you ask a shopkeeper for help?
Yes, a nice man showed me the way.
I am glad he could help you. Did you get home safe?
I am here, and I am happy to be back.
Wonderful, you did a good job. Are you tired now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know how to make myself feel happy inside.
Tell me, what small thing makes your smile grow?
A warm cup of tea and a soft book help a lot.
That is a sweet habit to hold onto.
Do you know any other simple ways to feel good?
Try to name one good thing you see today.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go to the big museum. Is it fun?
Yes, it has many old toys and cool cars. Do you like old things?
I do not know. What else is inside?
There are big bones and bright lights. You might like that part.
Is the line long on weekends?
I do not know the line time. It is often busy on weekends.
Can we go on a Tuesday?
Yes, it is usually quiet then. Do you want to start at the front?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a boat, but I do not know where to take it.
Have you tried the calm river nearby?
I am not sure if my boat will float there.
Do you have air in the tires?
Yes, they are full, but I still feel nervous.
Let us test it in the shallow part first.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I forgot which day comes after Tuesday.
Wednesday comes after Tuesday. Are you having a hard time?
I think I also got Monday wrong.
Monday comes after Sunday. Do you want to learn the whole list?
No, that sounds too hard.
We can do it one small step at a time. What is your favorite day?
I like Friday because of the weekend.
Friday is a nice day to rest. Do you want to try the next step?
Okay, but I am still a bit confused.
It is okay to be confused. We can practice again later.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at my blue fish. It is swimming so fast.
It looks very happy to swim. Do you think it likes its new home?
Yes, I think so. But why does it open and close its mouth?
It uses that to pull water over its gills to breathe. Is your tank warm or cool?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to bring to the party.
You could bring a juice box. Do you like apple juice?
I am unsure if I have enough time to get ready.
Take your time, do not worry. What is your biggest worry?
I do not know who I should talk to there.
Just say hello to someone who is holding a snack.
This feels very hard for me right now.
I do not know the answer to that fear, but you can do it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like my new song. It sounds too loud.
I am sorry it feels that way. Do you like quiet songs?
Yes, I like them. They make me feel safe.
That is a nice feeling. Is there a specific song you love?
Just the one my mom sings to me. I want to make one like that.
That sounds lovely. Would you like to try humming it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go, but do cows eat grass?
Yes, they chew it slowly. Are you going to the barn?
Quick, why do chickens cluck?
They call to each other. Do you like birds?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do you know how to serve?
Yes. Toss the ball and hit it down. Do you practice often?
No. It is hard. I must run now.
It gets easier with time. Good luck on your way.
Thanks. I am going.
See you soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a bad head and I am in a rush.
I am sorry you hurt. Do you have any medicine?
No time to look for it. What else?
Rest is best for a sore head.
I cannot rest. I must go.
Please be careful. Is it very hot?
Yes, it feels like fire.
Drink water and cool it down.
Thanks for the help.
I hope it feels better soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I build a snowman?
Dig three big holes in the snow for your balls. Do you like round shapes?
Yes, I love balls. How do I roll them?
Start small and keep rolling it in circles. It will get big on its own.
What do I put on top for a face?
Use sticks for arms and a carrot for a nose. I do not know if you have carrots.
I have buttons. How do I make it look happy?
Put buttons down the front and draw a smile with a stick. That will make it grin.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to make pasta for dinner.
That is a good choice. Do you have any vegetables?
Yes, I have some carrots and peas.
Great. Cut the carrots small so they cook fast. Do you have butter?
I have cheese, but no butter.
Cheese is fine. Melt it on the hot pasta. What color are the peas?
They are bright green.
Nice. Mix them in. Do you like spicy food?
No, I like it mild.
Then skip the pepper. Eat your dinner.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Do bugs have brains?
Yes, they do. Do you like bugs?
Maybe. Can ants lift heavy things?
Yes, they are very strong. Is that bug near you?
Please stop asking. How many legs do bees have?
Bees have six legs. Please run!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I pulled up a big weed from the garden this morning.
That weed looked strong. Did it have a thick root?
Yes, the root was huge. It took all my strength to pull it out.
You have strong arms. Do you like the dirt work?
I do, but now my back hurts. I want to start building my shed soon.
Rest first. Are you ready to lift the wood yet?
I need help with the last two planks. Can you hold them for me?
I can help you hold them. Where is the hammer?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The red hat fell off the clown's head.
Oh no! Do you think he will find it?
I hope so. The crowd was laughing.
That is a loud laugh. Was it funny to you?
Yes, but the clown looked sad.
I do not know why he was sad. He looked very surprised.
My mom says it is just a game.
She is right. Do you like playing games too?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the lighthouse so tall?
It needs to be high so the light can go far. Do you like looking up?
Why does it spin?
The spinning makes sure ships see the light from all sides. Do you watch it spin?
Why is the light yellow?
Yellow light cuts through fog better than blue. Do you see fog often?
Why does it stand by the sea?
I do not know for sure, but it must be to help boats. Do you think it is safe?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad that I have to wait.
It feels bad when you want things now. Are you waiting for a bus?
No, I am waiting for my food to get hot.
That can take a long time. Do you have a snack with you?
No, I do not have a snack.
I am sorry you are hungry. Can you look at a book while you wait?
I do not like books.
I understand you are bored. Would you like to count to ten with me?
Fine, I will count to ten.
That is a good plan. Please let me know if you are still mad.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love walking here today.
That sounds nice. Do you like the big buildings?
Yes, they are tall and fun to see.
They look very busy. Do you see many people?
Yes, I see people and cars.
It must be loud. Is the noise good?
Yes, I feel happy and free.
That is great for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I need to sleep?
Your brain needs rest to think clearly. Do you like to play?
Why does my body rest?
It fixes up muscles while you sleep. Do you feel tired?
Why do I dream?
I do not know for sure, but it helps your mind. Do your dreams feel happy?
Why is a dark room good?
Dark helps your eyes relax. Do you like the dark?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My teacher smiled at me today. I feel so good.
That is wonderful. Did she say anything kind?
She told me my drawing was very bright.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to read, but my eyes feel so heavy.
Maybe you should just go to bed? Do you have a book you really like?
I do not know. I have many books, but I do not feel like reading any.
That is hard. Is it because you are tired?
Yes, I am very tired. I do not know what to do.
I do not have a magic answer, but maybe a short read helps? Would a poem be nice?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do I leave this island?
Take the boat at the dock. Are you going to a beach?
No, I have a big meeting.
Go south then. Do you have a map?
No, I am in a rush.
Keep walking straight. You will see it soon.
Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to paint.
Do you like blue or red?
I like blue but it feels hard.
You can start with just a few dots.
That sounds easy.
What colors do you have on your desk?
I have green and yellow.
Mix them to make a fresh green.
Okay, I will try now.
Good for you, take your time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up with a sore throat and a runny nose. It felt very bad.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you drink hot tea?
Yes, I drank hot honey tea in bed. It helped a bit.
That is a good choice. Are you sleeping enough?
I tried to sleep, but I could not stop sneezing. It was loud.
Sneezing can be tiring. Do you know if you have a fever?
I checked with a thermometer. It was a little high.
A high fever means your body is fighting the cold. Have you taken any medicine?
I took some syrup. Now I feel a bit better.
That is good news. I hope you rest more today.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so tired today. I do not know what to do.
It is okay to rest. Do you want to take a nap?
Maybe, but I have work to do. I feel stuck.
You can start with just one small task. What is the easiest thing you need to do?
I need to clean the kitchen, but it looks too big.
Just wash one plate first. Does that feel doable?
One plate is easy. I will try that now.
Good for you. Remember to drink water when you finish.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you have any cinnamon buns here?
Yes, we do. Do you like sweet food?
I love sweet things.
Then you will like those. Are you hungry right now?
Yes, I am quite hungry.
Great, take your time.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights just went out and I am very scared of the dark.
Do you have a flashlight in your pocket?
No, I do not have one, so what should I do now?
Stay calm and walk slowly to the hallway, is that okay?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights just went out. I do not know what to do.
Do not worry. Is it only your home, or all the street?
It seems to be everywhere. My phone is dead too.
I do not know why this is happening. Please try to stay calm.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need to go to the doctor? Do I have a bad bug?
I do not know if you have a bug, but we go to check your body. Do you feel sick?
My tummy hurts a little bit. Why does the doctor do that?
The doctor checks to make sure you are safe and well. Is your tummy still hurting?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you love painting so much?
It feels good to make colors mix. Do you like to draw too?
Sometimes. Why does the paint change color when I add water?
The water makes the paint see see and thin. I do not know the exact science, but it looks soft.
That makes sense. Why do people paint big buildings?
I think it makes a gray wall look happy. Do you like bright colors?
Yes, I do. Why is the sky blue?
The sun makes the sky look blue to our eyes. It is not really a blue color.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to study for my test right now, but I am so tired. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help you. What is the test about?
It is about plants. Please just give me the key points fast.
Plants need sun, water, and soil to grow. Do you remember that part?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to take a nice picture of my cat.
That is a great idea. Do you know where your cat likes to sit?
Yes, he likes the sunny spot by the window.
Good. Sit down so you look like him, not a giant. Do you have a friend to press the button?
No, I am all alone right now.
Oh. You can set a timer on the camera. It is like a little clock.
What is a timer?
It is a small count down. Press the button once, and wait for the beep.
Okay, I will try that.
You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to clean my room today.
That is great to hear. What made you feel so good?
The sun is shining through my window.
How nice that is. Do you like the sun?
Yes, it makes me feel warm.
That sounds pleasant.
I will start with the floor next.
Good luck with that. Do you use a mop?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost again. My hand was bad.
That is not a good day. Do you feel lucky?
No. I pulled three hearts.
Hearts are good for me.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not know how to do my math work.
That can be hard. What problem are you stuck on?
It has all these big numbers.
You can split them into smaller parts. Do you like to count?
Yes, I like to count.
Great. Try counting the groups first.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I had a scary dream about falling and now I want to learn how to swim to feel safe.
That is a great idea. Do you know a safe place to go?
I do not know where, but I think a pool is good. How do I learn?
I do not know your local spots, but a teacher can help you. Do you like the water?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here, but I do not know which train to take.
Do you have a ticket with a number on it?
Yes, I see a number, but I am not sure where to look.
Please look at the big blue signs above the doors.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What should I eat for a happy start?
A warm bowl of oats is a great choice. Do you like adding fruit to them?
Yes, I love berries. What else tastes good with them?
A little spoon of honey makes them sweet and nice.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do I start a letter?
You start with the date and the name of the person. Do you know their name?
Yes, I do. What goes next?
Next, you write a greeting like "Dear Friend." Do you want to say hello?
Yes, I do. Then what?
Then you write why you are writing. I am not sure why you are writing.
I want to say thank you. How do I end it?
You end by saying thanks again and signing your name. Do you have a pen?
I do. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Happy writing.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like loud songs, but my mom says they hurt her ears.
That is a fair point. Do you like quiet songs too?
Yes, I like soft piano music when I rest.
Good choice. Have you tried a gentle acoustic guitar yet?
I have not, but it sounds nice.
I am not sure which songs are best for you. Do you want a list to try?
Yes, please.
I will find some calm tracks for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very tired, but I do not want to put my book down.
That sounds hard. Do you like the story?
Yes, it is so good, but my eyes hurt a lot.
Your eyes need rest. Would you like some warm milk?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do for the long break. The weather is cold and wet outside.
It is a hard choice. Do you like to stay inside with a book?
I do like books, but I want to move my body too. I feel stuck.
Try a warm bath and a dance in your room. Do you have a favorite song?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so tired today.
That sounds hard. Do your eyes feel heavy?
Yes, they do.
Rest helps a lot. Are you hungry?
Yes, a little.
Good. Food gives you energy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My neighbor makes a loud sound with a machine.
That sounds frustrating. What kind of sound is it?
It goes buzz buzz all the time.
That is a very specific buzz. Do you think it is a lawnmower?
No, it is in their kitchen.
I do not know what makes that sound. Does it happen every day?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My little fish is hiding in the corner. Is he sick?
He might be scared. Does he have many new friends in the tank?
No, I just put him there yesterday.
Give him a few days. Do you see him eating his food?
Yes, I saw him eat a tiny flake this morning.
That is good news. Is the water clean and cool?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Is the moon real? I need to know fast.
Yes, it is a big rock in the sky. Do you like looking up?
Is it far away?
Yes, it is very far from Earth. Do you have a telescope?
Can I touch it?
No, you cannot walk on it easily. Do you dream of flying?
Does it move?
Yes, it moves around our planet. Do you see it every night?
Is it warm?
I do not know for sure. It is very cold at night.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I got my first job. I feel so big.
That is great news. What will you do there?
I will count coins in a shop. Do I keep all of them?
No, you must give them back to the owner.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what is good to eat.
It is good to eat fruits and vegetables. Do you like carrots?
I do not like carrots, but I like apples.
Apples are a great choice. Do you drink water too?
I mostly drink sweet soda.
Water is much better for your body. Do you want to try it?
I will try to drink water today.
That is a good start. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I float a leaf on the water?
Place it gently on the top and let it go. Do you like small boats?
I want to know how to catch a fish.
I do not know how to do that. Do you like to swim?
Can I build a dam with sticks?
Yes, you can stack them in the shallow part. Is the water deep here?
How do I throw a stone far?
Lift your arm high and push forward. Do you have big rocks?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the ball round?
It rolls well on the ground. Do you like to kick it?
Yes, I do. Why do we use our feet?
It is hard to throw while running. Is that hard for you?
A little. Why is the game so long?
It gives us time to move and think. Do you get tired?
Yes, I do. Why do we cheer so loud?
It helps the team feel brave. Do you shout?
I do. Why is it so fun?
I do not know for sure, but it brings people close.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Where can I find the big picture books?
They are on the top shelf. Do you like dragon stories?
I love them. Are the regular books nearby?
Yes, they are on the middle shelf. I am not sure if you like mystery books.
I do not. How do I put my book back?
Just carry it to the front desk. The clerk will help you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took the bus to the park today.
That sounds like fun. Did you see any dogs?
Yes, I saw a big brown dog sleeping.
Sleeping in the park? Is that safe?
He was safe, but I felt a bit lonely.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you talk to anyone?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big snowflake land on my hand today.
That sounds like a lovely sight. Did you try to keep it there?
I held my hand still, but it melted fast.
Snow always melts when it touches warm skin.
Then I tried to build a small snowman.
A snowman is a fun idea. Did you find something for it to wear?
I gave it my red scarf.
That must look very cute.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a small shed in my yard.
That is a great plan. Do you have the tools ready?
I have a hammer and nails, but I am lost.
You need to draw a simple picture first. Do you like drawing?
I like drawing, but I do not know where to start.
Start with a square floor. Is your yard flat there?
Yes, the ground is flat. What is next?
Build the walls up from the floor. Do you have any wood?
I have some old wood, but it looks weak.
You must use strong wood for the walls. I do not know your local prices, but check a store.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today. I saw two ducks.
Two ducks sounds fun. Did they swim?
Yes, they swam in the pond. I also saw three birds.
Three birds is a lot. What color were they?
They were brown. I counted them very carefully.
That is a great count. Did you see anything else?
I saw one big dog too.
One big dog is nice. Did it bark?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the market today. I bought a big red apple for my friend.
That is a sweet thing to do. Did your friend like the apple?
Yes, she was very happy. She shared half of it with me.
Sharing makes gifts feel even better.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go in this small place.
That is okay. What do you like to do for fun?
I like to sit by water and watch the fish.
There is a quiet pond just past the big oak tree.
I am still a bit scared of the dark woods there.
Do you have a friend to walk with you?
No, I am all alone and my feet hurt from walking.
Come sit on this bench and rest for a few minutes.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy about my island trip.
That sounds very nice. Where is the island?
It is a small place by the sea.
Do you see many birds there?
Yes, I saw a green parrot today.
What a lovely bird. Do you have a picture of it?
I want to show you all my photos later.
I would love to see them.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sky is grey and it is raining. I do not know if I should go out.
That sounds like a tricky day. Do you have any warm clothes?
Yes, I have a big coat and boots. But I am not sure if I want to play outside.
You could stay in and read a book instead. Is there a game you like?
I like to draw pictures. I think I will stay inside and draw a big cat.
That sounds like a good plan. What color is the cat?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a square. What else can it become if I add one more line?
You can make a triangle by drawing a line across two corners. Do you like triangles?
I guess so. What if I want to make a circle instead?
You cannot make a true circle with just straight lines. Do you have any curved lines?
No, I only have straight edges. How can I make a round shape then?
You can add many tiny straight lines to make it look round. Do you have many lines?
I have enough to try. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Happy drawing.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I build a sandcastle?
Dig a big hole first. Do you like tall towers?
Yes, I want it to be very tall.
Mix wet sand to make bricks. Have you ever used a bucket?
I have a small red bucket.
Use it to shape the walls. Is the sand dry or wet?
It is wet and sticky.
Great. Add a flag on top.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my computer make a loud sound?
It might be the fan working hard to keep it cool. Does the box get warm?
Yes, it is hot. Why is it hot?
The machine uses power, and that makes heat.
Why does it use so much power?
I do not know for sure, but the screen uses much energy. Do you see a bright light on it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late for the bus.
Take a deep breath. Do you have your shoes on?
Yes, they are tight but okay.
Tight shoes can hurt. Do they pinch your toes?
I just need to go.
I understand. Run safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the end of the tale right now.
The dragon sleeps. Do you like dragons?
Just tell me who wins.
The boy saves the day. He is very brave.
Can I go home now?
Yes, you may go. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have so many clothes, but I do not know what to take.
Pick your favorite shirt first. What is the weather like where you are going?
It is hot outside, and my bag is already very heavy.
Take only light clothes to keep your bag light. Do you have enough shoes?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to buy a horse. I am in a huge rush.
That is a big step. Do you have a stable for it?
No, I just have a small yard. Will it fit?
A horse needs much more room. Do you live near open fields?
I have no time to check. Is it safe in the yard?
No, that is not safe. Do you have a vet nearby?
I do not know. I am leaving now.
Please wait. I do not know if this is safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I click a button and it takes me to a new place. What is this big web?
It is a big web of computers. You connect to them with a wire or air waves. Do you use a phone or a box?
I use a box on my desk. How does the picture get from there to my screen?
It turns into numbers. Those numbers travel very fast through cables and towers. Is it fast for you?
Yes, it is very quick. But sometimes the picture stops and freezes.
That means the road is busy. It is like a lot of cars on one street. Do you have many windows open?
Yes, I have many tabs open. So should I close some?
Yes, closing them helps. It gives the road more room for your page. Do you like your page now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The city is so loud and busy today. I am very happy to be here.
That sounds like a fun day. Do you like the noise?
Yes, it makes my heart beat fast with joy.
I am glad you are enjoying it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad because my boat is broken.
That is too bad. Do you want to fix it?
I tried, but the engine will not start.
Did you check if there is fuel in the tank?
Yes, it is full, but I do not know what else to do.
I do not know the fix. Is the boat in the water?
No, it is on land, but it feels so heavy.
That can feel scary. Can you push it a little?
I am too tired and my hands hurt.
Rest a bit. Do you have a friend nearby?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the ball round?
A round ball rolls smooth and far. It helps players kick it into the net. Do you like to kick a ball?
No, I prefer to catch it with my hands.
That is very safe and fun too. Which side do you want to play on?
I want to stand near the goal.
Great choice. You will stop the ball from going in. Do you have a big team?
My team has three friends.
Three is a good number to start. Have fun playing with them.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big old boat in the museum today. It looked very dusty and sad.
That sounds interesting. Did you climb inside it?
No, I could not go in. But I did touch a glass plate on the wall. It was cold to my hands.
Cold plates are nice. What was painted on that plate?
It had a map of the sea. I loved looking at all the blue lines.
Blue lines are pretty. Did you buy a little toy boat to take home?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very happy today. Why?
Your heart is light and calm. Do you know why?
I do not know. Can you help me see?
Maybe you are kind to others. Is that true?
Yes, I helped a friend today.
Kindness makes your soul glow. You did good.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do robots look like machines?
They use metal and wires to work. Do you like metal things?
I think they are too cold.
Some have soft parts to feel warm. Do you hug your pets?
Yes, but robots cannot feel love.
I am not sure if they can feel yet. Do you want a pet?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the tree lose its leaves in the cold?
It lets go to save energy. Do you like eating the leaves?
Why is the sky blue and not red?
The air makes the light scatter blue.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a bug under my bed and I do not know what to do.
Do not panic. Is it small and brown?
It is small, but I am too scared to move it.
Put a cup over it to keep it safe. Do you want help?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My boat is leaking, and I do not know what to do.
That is a scary feeling. Do you have a small pump nearby?
I found a dry towel, but the water keeps coming in.
Place the towel under the seat to soak it up. I do not know if that will stop it, so check for big holes.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the shop open now?
Yes, it is open. Do you like bread?
I want to buy some bread.
The bread is on the shelf. Is it sweet or salty?
I like sweet bread.
That is a good choice. Have a nice day!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Show me the fast way to the park.
Go down this road. Do you have a bike?
No. I have no time to walk slowly.
Take the bus. It is very quick.
Is the bus stop close?
Yes. It is right around the corner. Do you have a ticket?
I do not know. Please help me find it.
Check your pocket. You likely have one there.
Here it is. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome. Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at my teacher. She gave me a red mark on my essay.
That feels bad, does it? Do you know why she did that?
She said I did not listen in class. But I feel like I did try.
I am sorry that is hard. What did you do when you saw the mark?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My phone fell in the mud this morning.
Oh no, that is bad news. Is it still working?
Yes, I wiped it off and it turns on.
That is good to hear. Do you have a backup?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am very hungry, but I do not know what to eat for breakfast.
Would you like some warm toast with jam? What is your favorite kind of fruit?
I think I am too tired to make toast, and I am not sure if I have any milk left.
I do not know if you have milk, but I can check the fridge for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was warm when I walked by the lake.
That sounds like a nice, quiet place. What did you see on the water?
I saw a big duck with three small ducks behind it.
Oh, what a sweet family. Did they swim far?
They swam to the reeds and then jumped in.
Jumping must be fun. Was the water cold?
It looked cold, but the ducks did not care.
I love how animals do not worry. Did you take a picture?
No, I just watched for a long time.
Watching is a good way to rest.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at my cat. He is so happy.
What a sweet cat. How did he get so close to you?
He just jumped into my lap. He is very soft and warm.
That sounds so nice. I am glad you told me.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I knit a scarf?
That is a great idea. Do you have any yarn?
Yes, I have some red yarn.
Great. We just need to make a loop and use a needle. Do you like knitting with one hand?
No, I am left-handed.
That is fine. You just switch the needle to your right hand for the second stitch.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a cow eating grass in the yard. Why does it eat that?
Cows love grass because it helps them make milk. Do you like drinking milk?
I also saw a pig looking at the mud. Why does it want to play in dirt?
Pigs roll in mud to keep their skin cool and clean. Is your farm near a big pond?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we take pictures?
To keep nice moments. Do you like to remember happy days?
I do. Why does the camera click?
It saves the look. Do you hear that sound?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost on the web.
That feels bad. Do you have a goal?
I just want to learn about fish.
Try a big search box. Do you like big fish or small fish?
Big fish are cool.
Search for "big fish facts". Is that helpful?
Yes, it is.
Great. Take your time there.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up at seven o'clock this morning.
That is a good time to start the day. What did you do next?
I ate breakfast and then went for a walk in the park.
Walking is a nice way to stay healthy.
It was a sunny day, and I watched birds fly in the sky.
Birds are fun to watch. Did you see any other animals?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at the big boat on the water.
It is a lovely boat. Do you like the smell of the sea?
I think the waves look fast and fun.
The water moves to bring things home. Do you want to go in the water?
The sun is very bright on the boats.
Yes, it is a sunny day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to draw a big house.
That sounds like fun. Do you like to use colors?
Yes, I love bright reds and blues.
Those are happy colors. What do you draw inside the house?
I draw a cat sleeping on the rug.
Cats are good friends. Is the cat big or small?
It is a small gray cat.
How cute. Do you draw it with a tail?
Yes, I always add a long tail.
I love details. Do you have a favorite part of drawing?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is loud. I am scared. What should I do?
Stay near a window that is closed. Is the light on?
Yes. But the power might stop. Should I go outside?
No, it is too wet and wild. I do not know when the storm will stop.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my red hat. I am so late.
Did you check the sofa?
No, I did not look there yet.
It is often lost there. Is it a warm hat?
Yes, it is wool and red. Please help.
I do not know where it is.
Oh no. My bus is coming soon.
Look under the chair. Do you see it?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I was so excited to go to that new place, but the food was cold.
That is really disappointing. Did you have a favorite dish there?
Yes, the soup was terrible too, and I spent all my money.
I am sorry you had a bad day. Do you want to find a different spot?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I clean the red wine on my shirt?
Try cold water and a little soap. Do you have a stiff brush to help?
I have one. Should I use hot water next?
No, hot water can make the stain worse. Is it a white or dark shirt?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse in the park. What is it called?
It is a horse. Do you like animals?
Yes, I do. Can it fly like a bird?
No, it cannot fly. It runs on the ground.
Is it happy to see me?
I do not know if it is happy. Is it eating grass?
Yes, it is eating.
That is good for it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. I forgot which day is today.
You can check the sky. Is it dark outside?
No, it is bright. Please help me fast.
I do not know your specific date. Do you have a calendar nearby?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do I have to walk fast to stay healthy?
No, you can walk slow. Do you like walking in the park?
Yes, but my legs hurt after a while.
That is okay. You can rest. Do you stop to drink water?
No, I never think to drink.
That is good to know. Please drink a little water when you stop.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to sing a song today, but my voice felt tight.
That sounds hard, but you are brave. Do you like singing in the car?
I stopped because I was afraid of people hearing me.
Fear can make us quiet. Would you like to try one more note now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sun so hot today?
The sun is close to us in the sky. Do you have some water?
Why does it taste cold?
The ice melts and makes it cool. Is your drink good?
Why is the sand so warm?
The sun makes the sand hot. Do you like sand?
Why does it feel sticky?
I am not sure why, but it feels that way.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What day is it?
It is Tuesday. Are you ready for work?
Yes, I must go now. Goodbye.
Goodbye to you too. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. What day is it today?
It is Tuesday. Are you going to work?
Yes. Do you know what comes after Tuesday?
Wednesday is next. Are you scared of being late?
A little. How many days are in a week?
There are seven days. Do you remember all their names?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My baby makes a loud noise. Is he sick?
It is called crying. It is normal. Do you feed him?
Yes, I give him milk. He stops and smiles.
That is a good sign. He is just learning. Is he sleeping well?
He sleeps a lot. Sometimes he kicks his legs.
That is called growing. It is good. Does he have a warm blanket?
Yes, I keep him warm. Thank you for helping me.
You are doing a great job. I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I pack my books?
Put the heavy ones at the bottom. Do you have boxes?
I have some old boxes.
Make sure they are strong. Are they clean?
Yes, they are clean.
Pack the small books first. This saves space.
What about tall books?
Stand them up in the box. Do not stack them flat.
That sounds easy.
Take your time and stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the new town today. It is very quiet and the air smells like rain.
That sounds like a nice place to rest. Did you see any people there?
Yes, I saw a woman selling apples. She smiled at me, but I did not buy any.
A smile is a good sign. Was the town old or new?
The buildings are new, but the trees are old. I think I will go back tomorrow.
I am happy you enjoyed your walk.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to bake a cake.
That is a fun idea. What kind of cake do you want?
I want to make a chocolate cake.
Chocolate is sweet. Do you have the tools?
I have a bowl and a spoon.
You need a pan and an oven. Is that hard to find?
I have a pan, but I do not have an oven.
I do not know how to make one without an oven. Do you want to try cookies instead?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have an apple. It is red and sweet. I like it very much.
That sounds yummy. Do you like it because it is sweet?
Yes, it is very sweet. I want to give you a bite.
Thank you. I will eat it. Is this your favorite fruit?
Yes, I love apples best. They are good for me.
I am happy you like them.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to see the bright moon tonight. Do you like looking up at the sky too?
I love the calm glow of the moon. It is a wonderful sight. Do you think it follows us?
Yes, it feels like it walks with me. Thank you for sharing that nice thought.
You are very welcome. Your joy is lovely to hear.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a shape that looks like a square but has one corner cut off.
That sounds like a pentagon. Do you know how many sides it has?
I am not sure, but I think it has five.
You are right, it has five sides. Would you like to draw one?
Yes, please, but I do not have a ruler.
You can use a straight edge from a book. Does your book have a straight side?
It does, so I will use the top edge.
That is a clever idea. Good luck with your drawing.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today. It was very hot.
That sounds like a nice day. Did you play in the water?
Yes, the water was cold. It woke me up.
Cold water is good for a hot day. Did you build a sandcastle?
I found a big shell. It was white and smooth.
A big shell is a great find. Was it hard to hold?
It was a little heavy. I like it very much.
It sounds like a good keepsake. Thank you for sharing your day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I missed my stop.
That feels bad. What stop is it?
The next one in ten minutes.
We can walk there. Do you have your bag?
I am tired and my legs hurt.
Let us rest here first.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is bright and warm today.
That sounds lovely. Are you going outside?
Yes, the birds are singing happily.
What a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad. I do not know what to do for the big day.
That sounds heavy. Do you like going outside?
I like the sun, but I am too tired to walk far.
That makes sense. You can sit in a warm spot and read a book.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so busy. I need food right now.
Do you have a banana? It is quick and good.
No. What else can I eat?
An apple is great. Do you have one?
Yes. I will eat that now.
That is a smart choice.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to send this file right now. Is the net fast?
Yes, it is very quick today. Do you have a good signal?
My phone looks weak. What should I do?
Try moving closer to the window. Does that help?
It works now. Thanks for the tip.
You are welcome. I am glad it helped.
I am done. Goodbye.
Goodbye. Have a great day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel sad inside. I do not know what to do.
It is okay to feel that way. Would you like to sit with me?
I have no plan for today.
That is a hard feeling. I do not know the right fix, but I am here. Do you want to take a walk?
I am tired of trying.
Rest is good. Let us just breathe together.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a weird dream where I could fly.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you go very high?
Yes, I went up to the clouds.
I do not know what it looks like up there.
It was white and soft like cotton.
That is a very nice picture in my head.
I want to fly again soon.
I hope your next dream is just as happy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did it! I tried the hard thing again and it worked.
That makes me so happy for you. What part was the most fun?
The very last step when I finally got it right.
Wow, that is a great feeling. Do you want to try it again tomorrow?
Yes, I think I will keep going with it.
You have a good spirit. I am glad you shared that.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late for school.
Do you have your lunch?
Yes, I do, but I need to go now.
Run safely, please.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people learn to sing?
Singing is fun and makes your brain happy. Do you like music?
I do, but I am shy. Why does singing help if I am shy?
It helps you feel brave. Are you afraid of making a mistake?
Yes, I worry about looking silly. Why should I try?
Trying makes you strong and calm. Do you want to feel that way?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and saw a funny dog.
That sounds like a great time. Did you see the dog play?
Yes, he chased a ball but it was too big for him.
Oh no, that must be hard.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I love bananas.
They are soft and sweet. Do you eat them with milk?
Yes, I do. Why are they yellow?
They turn yellow as they ripen. I do not know why they start green.
That is strange. What is your favorite?
