I like apples because they are crunchy. Do you like crunchy food?
A little bit. Thank you for talking.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
Their roots pull water up like a straw. Do you have a plant at home?
Yes, I have a big pot plant.
The water moves up tiny tubes inside the stem. It is like a ladder for water.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, I need to get to the park.
Go left, then straight. Do you see a big red tree?
Yes, I see it. Is the park close?
It is just past the tree.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the party. Where is it?
I do not know the place. Do you have the list?
Yes. It is the house with the big red door.
That sounds fun. Did you bring a gift?
No. I forgot it. Is it too late to go?
Better late than never. Run fast and have fun.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know if I want tea or coffee.
Do you want something warm and sweet?
Yes, I like it warm and sweet.
Tea is good for that. Do you like a little milk?
I think I do.
Then let us make you some tea.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I love that book about the green dragon.
That is a very nice choice. What do you like most about it?
I want a new book like it, but I am stuck.
Do you like scary stories or happy ones?
I like happy stories where the dragon is friendly.
Try the one with the sleepy dragon. It is very soft and sweet.
Can you tell me the name of it?
I do not know the exact title. Do you like stories about rain?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I promised my cat I would give him a treat. I am looking for the jar right now.
That is a very sweet promise. Where do you keep the treats?
I found them, but the cat is not hungry. He is sleeping on the couch.
Cats sleep a lot. Did you wake him up for his snack?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel lost on this quiet street.
That is okay. Are you safe here?
Yes, but I do not know where to go.
Let us walk forward together. Do you want that?
I am not sure if I should stay.
Staying is a good choice. What is on your mind?
I worry about doing the wrong thing.
You are doing fine. How do your feet feel?
I just want to stop thinking so much.
Rest your mind for now. Can you take one deep breath?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lighthouse is so bright tonight. I am very happy to see it.
That is a lovely sight. What made you come out to watch it?
The light saves the ships. It feels safe to me.
It is good to feel safe. Do you like looking at the sea?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a lighthouse. The door is locked. What do I do?
That is tricky. Have you tried to knock on the door?
I knocked, but no one came. Now I am confused.
I do not know the answer. Do you see any papers on the ground?
There is a map on the ground. I am still unsure what to do next.
Look at the map closely. Does it point to a different door?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I have my first job today and I am very nervous.
That is okay to feel. What is your first task?
I need to pour coffee for the guests.
Just hold the pot steady and go slow. Do you know how to open the pot?
No, the lid is stuck tight.
Twist it with your right hand. Is it moving now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not want to go to the park. It looks like it will rain.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have an umbrella with you?
No, I do not. My feet get cold when they are wet.
That is not a nice feeling. How about we play a game inside instead?
Maybe. What game do you know?
I am not sure what you like. Do you like to draw or to build blocks?
I like to build blocks. Let us do that.
That sounds like a good plan. Let us go to the quiet room now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The snow is so big and white.
Yes, it looks very soft. Do you like to touch it?
Yes, but it is cold.
Cold snow can be fun to play with.
I want to make a snowman.
That is a great idea. What shape are you making it?
A big circle for the head.
A circle head is very cute.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Why is the wind so loud?
It is moving the trees fast. Are you okay?
I need to go now. Does wind help plants grow?
Yes, it helps spread seeds. Have a good day.
Wait, does wind come from hot air?
I do not know for sure. Please hurry.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up when the clock said seven.
That is a good time to start the day. What did you do first?
I ate toast at eight.
Toast is a tasty breakfast.
I walked home at five.
A five o'clock walk sounds nice. Did you see the sun?
Yes, it was going down.
The setting sun is a beautiful sight.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw my grandpa today and he is doing so well.
That is great news to hear. How did he spend his day?
He made my favorite cookies and told me old stories.
Cookies sound very sweet and warm.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired but I cannot close my eyes. My brain will not stop moving.
That sounds very hard. Do you use a phone before bed?
I did look at my screen for a long time. It made me feel wide awake.
Light keeps you awake. I do not know the best way to fix this, but try reading a book instead.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel scared about the test tomorrow.
It is good you told me. What part worries you most?
I am not sure I studied enough.
You likely know more than you think. Have you read your notes?
Yes, but my mind goes blank.
Take three slow breaths to help your body calm. Does that help a little?
It does help me breathe easier.
That is a good sign. I do not know the exact answers, but rest is key now.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do I keep old tickets?
Do you like the colors of them?
I just want to remember the trip.
That is a nice reason.
But I feel bad taking up space.
What if you pick the best three?
That sounds like a good plan.
Are you ready to start?
Yes, I will do it today.
Good luck with your clearing.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the right way to eat with friends?
Use your fork and knife to cut your food. Do you know which hand to hold the fork in?
Is it always okay to talk while eating?
It is best to stop talking when your mouth is full. What do you usually eat for lunch?
How should I leave the dinner table?
Excuse yourself softly and do not push your chair back too hard. Was that a helpful tip?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sun is so bright. What should I do?
Put on your hat. Do you have one ready?
I am still not sure where to go.
Go to the shade. Is it hot there?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to sing and my voice sounded like a squeaky toy. I want to quit.
That feeling is very real. Do you remember what song made you want to start?
It was a happy song, but now I just feel silly.
Your voice is still learning its tricks. Would you like to try one small note together?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw three birds on the wire today.
That is a nice sight. Did they sing to you?
Yes, one bird sang a funny song.
Sounds like a happy day. How many legs did you see?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do bees make honey? Do they use a machine?
No machine, just their own bodies and sweet flower juice. Do you like eating honey?
Yes, I love it on toast. But why does the nectar turn into honey?
They keep it warm and dry so the water goes away, making it thick and sweet. Do you know where bees live?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel too tired to work from home today.
That sounds hard. Do you have a cozy spot?
Yes, but my desk is messy.
Try a quick tidy up. It often helps.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel lost in the loud city. What should I do?
Take a deep breath. What is your goal?
I just want to find a quiet spot to sit. Do you know one?
A small park is usually best. Do you like trees?
Yes, I love trees. Where is the park?
Look for the green space ahead. Is it very far?
It looks close. Thank you for your help.
I am glad to help. Enjoy your rest.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My head hurts bad.
That feels icky. Did you bump your head?
No, I just hit a ball.
Ouch, a ball can be tuffy. Do you want to sit and rest for a bit?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My new neighbor leaves wet leaves on my path.
That is quite unpleasant for you. Do you think they did it on purpose?
I am not sure, but I want to fix it.
It is best to talk to them kindly first.
I am too shy to knock on their door.
You can leave a polite note instead. Would that feel easier?
That sounds much better for me.
That is a smart plan. Good luck with it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do fish need water to live?
They have gills to pull air from the water. Do you know what gills look like?
I do not, but why do they catch fish for food?
Many people love the taste of fresh fish. Is your family fond of eating fish?
Sometimes, but why do we need to be careful where we fish?
Some places have rules to keep fish safe. Do you read those signs before you start?
I usually ask a grown-up, but why do fish jump out of the water?
They may need air or are playing. Have you ever seen one jump?
Yes, and why do we need a hook to catch them?
The hook holds the bait for the fish to bite. Do you like using a live worm?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love apples. How do I grow one from a seed?
That is very cool. Do you have a sunny window?
Yes, I do. What should I do next?
Put the seed in a small pot with soil. Water it gently. Do you have a small pot?
I have an old yogurt cup. Will that work?
Yes, it works perfectly. Just wait for it to grow.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a bad cough and I am late.
Drink hot tea. Are you still sick?
Yes, my nose is very runny.
Rest is best. Do you need help?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is great! What made you smile?
I found a perfect circle.
A circle is very round. Is it blue?
It is red, like a big apple.
Red is a warm color.
Now I see a square too.
Squares have four sides. Do they touch?
Yes, the circle sits on the square.
That is a fun shape game.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to fix this fence today. It is broken.
Oh no, that is bad. Do you have the tools ready?
Yes, I have them. But I am running late.
I understand. Is the wood strong enough?
I do not know. Please just show me how.
I am not sure. Use this piece to tie it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My grandma is very quiet today. What should I do?
Maybe she needs rest. Is she feeling sick?
No, she just seems sad. I want to make her smile.
Try reading to her. What is her favorite book?
I do not know her favorite book. Can you tell me?
I do not know her taste. Do you know if she likes flowers?
Yes, she loves roses. I will go get some.
That is a sweet idea. She will be happy.
Thank you. I am going now.
You are a good helper. Say hi for me.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very sad inside and I do not know what to do.
I am sorry you feel that way. What makes you feel this heavy?
I just do not know why, it just hurts.
It is okay to not know why. Would you like to just sit with me for a bit?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does my bread get so big?
The little helper inside makes gas, and that pushes the dough up. Do you like gas?
No, I don't.
It is safe gas, so you can let it out. Is the dough warm?
Yes, it is.
Warm helps the helper work faster. Do you see it puff up?
I see it growing!
That is the magic happening. You did a great job.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I won the card game!
That is great news. What game did you play?
It was solitaire.
I know that one. Did you go fast?
Yes, I was very quick.
Well done. Do you want to play again?
Yes, please.
Great. I will help you.
Thank you.
You are welcome. Let us start now.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a party today. It was very loud.
That sounds exciting. Did you have a good time?
Yes, the food was warm and sweet. I ate a lot.
Yum. What was the best part?
I saw a dog in a hat. It was funny.
That is a silly sight. Did you pet the dog?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to drink, but I do not know if I want tea or coffee.
Do you feel sleepy right now?
Yes, I am very tired today.
Coffee will wake you up fast. Do you like sweet things?
I like sugar in my drinks.
Tea is softer and good for a slow start. You can try both to see what feels good.
That sounds like a nice idea.
It is true that choice is hard sometimes. Which one do you want to try first?
I think I will start with tea.
That is a kind choice to your body. Enjoy your warm cup.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I caught a little fish today!
That is so cool! Do you know what kind it is?
It has small, shiny scales.
I do not know the name, but it looks nice. Where did you catch it?
In the big pond by the tree.
That sounds like a fun spot. Did you put it back in the water?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Can you tell me why?
My dog did not come back home.
That is a very scary thing. Do you have other pets?
No, just him.
I understand why you are lonely. I do not know if he will return.
I just want to see him again.
I hope he comes back soon. Would you like to draw a picture of him?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to pack my toys right now. I am so late.
That sounds fun. Do you have a truck?
Yes. Where do I put the big boxes?
Put them by the door. Is that easy for you?
I cannot find my red hat.
Check your pocket. Did you lose it?
Found it. I am going now.
Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I watched the big game today. I am so happy because we won.
That is great news. Did you cheer loud?
Yes, I screamed with all my might. It was very fun.
I am glad it made you smile. Do you like one team the most?
I love them all, but my team is special. They played well.
Nice work for the players.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I told my sister I would share my cookie. Do I have to give it to her?
Yes, a promise is a promise. Do you like sharing your snacks?
I do not always like it, but I said I would. What happens if I break it?
People may stop trusting you. How do you feel about telling the truth?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my magnet will not hold my toy.
That is a mean thing to happen. Is the toy made of metal?
Yes, it is steel, but the magnet is very small.
Small magnets have a hard time lifting heavy things. Do you have a bigger magnet?
No, I only have this one, and I feel like I failed.
You did not fail, you just need more help. Would you like to try a trick?
Please tell me, I really want to fix it.
Try sticking the magnet to the wall first. Is the wall metal?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a great play today.
That sounds fun. What was it about?
A dog that can fly.
Wow, that is amazing. Did the dog fall?
No, he flew very high.
I am glad he was safe. Did you like it?
Yes, I loved it so much.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want pancakes but the pan is very hot.
Yes, please be careful. Do you like them with syrup?
I want to add too much sugar.
That might be too sweet. Is that okay for you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to finish this wall by five. What color goes with blue?
White is a safe pick. Do you have white paint?
Yes, I have it. I am so late.
Try the white on a small spot first. Is the wall smooth?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The sea looks so dark and loud today. It feels angry to me.
It can look that way when waves hit hard. Do you see any white foam on top?
Yes, I see white bits, but the water is still gray and cold. It makes me feel small.
The ocean is big, but it moves over time. What color was it when you were happy last?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel so mad that I cannot tie my shoes.
It is okay to feel mad. Do you want to try again?
Yes, but my hands feel too big and clumsy.
Big hands can learn too. Take a deep breath first.
I took a breath, but the knot still slips.
That is part of learning. How many times have you tried today?
I tried five times already.
Five tries is good work. Let us just make the loop bigger.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go. Walking takes too long for my busy day.
A quick walk helps your heart. Do you walk for fun?
No time. I need to sit and work now.
Even five minutes helps you feel good.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The moon looks very bright tonight.
It is a big full moon. Do you like looking up at the sky?
Yes, I do. Why does the moon change shape?
It is just a shadow moving across it. Is that easy to understand?
Kind of. I still do not get it.
I do not know how to make it simpler. Do you have a book about space?
No, but I want one.
That sounds like a great plan.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I drank a hot cup of tea this morning because it was cold outside.
That sounds cozy. Did you like the taste?
Yes, it was sweet with a little honey. Then I had coffee before work.
Coffee can wake you up fast. Do you feel ready for today?
I am tired, but I need to finish my list. The tea helped me think clearly.
Taking a break is good for your mind. What is your favorite kind of tea?
I like green tea best. It is light and not too strong.
Green tea is very popular. Do you drink it every day?
Only in the morning. Coffee is for the afternoon. I hope my day goes well.
I hope it goes well for you too. Make sure to rest when you can.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure how to start the car.
Turn the key gently to the right. Do you feel the little click?
It will not start and I feel very sad.
Take a deep breath to help you calm down. Have you checked if the gas tank is full?
I do not know what else to do now.
I do not know your exact problem, but you are doing fine. Do you want to practice in an empty lot?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to grab my toys, but I am late.
Let us find them quick. What color is your favorite?
Blue. I do not see it anywhere.
Look under the bed. It is often there.
Ah, here it is. Thanks for helping.
You are welcome. Did you find your shoes too?
Yes, I have them. I must run.
Go with care. Have a great day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I heard there is a new town just over the hill.
Yes, I saw the big trucks digging the ground there. Do you like building things?
I want to see if they are making a big slide.
I do not know if they are building a slide. I only saw them laying the roads.
Oh, that is boring. I hope there is a park.
I think there might be trees for a park later. Do you like to sit in the grass?
Yes, I love sitting in the grass.
That sounds nice. We can go look together when it is safe.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I count to ten?
You start with one, two, three. Do you know the numbers after that?
I know up to five.
Great, you just keep going to six, seven, eight, nine, and ten. Is that hard for you?
No, it is easy now.
That is good news! Do you want to count some apples?
Yes, please.
Pick up one apple and say one. Are you ready to try?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know how to make the floors shine. Do I use water?
Yes, water is good for mopping. Do you have a mop?
I have a mop, but the dirt is very hard.
Try a little soap in the water. Does that help?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to send a letter, but I do not know where to start.
Just walk to the front and take a number. Do you have your letter ready?
Yes, it is in my bag, but I am scared of the line.
Do not worry, lines move fast. Would you like me to wait with you?
That is kind, but I am in a big hurry.
Okay, you can go to the express counter instead. Have you ever used the express line?
No, I have never seen it before.
It is usually for small items like yours. Do you need a stamp?
I do not have any stamps, only cash.
You can buy stamps at the counter, no problem.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My bike wheel spins fast and wobbles.
Is the wheel loose on the frame?
Yes, it feels loose when I stop.
Check the two nuts on the axle.
They look tight but the hub feels weak.
That part needs a shop to fix.
Can I ride to the shop safely?
Keep your hands tight on the bars.
Do I need to push it all the way?
Ride slowly in a quiet area.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look! A blue bird is eating seeds here.
That is a happy bird. Do you like blue birds?
Yes, I love them. They sing nice songs too.
I love their songs. What song do they sing?
It goes up and down, like a happy tune.
That sounds fun. Is it cold outside?
A little, but the sun is warm. It feels good.
Warm sun is nice. Do you have more seeds?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I baked a big, warm loaf of bread. I am so happy to share it with you.
That sounds like a wonderful treat. May I ask what kind of bread you made?
It is simple sourdough with a crisp crust. I added some sea salt on top.
The smell of fresh bread is always inviting. Do you plan to cut it right away?
Yes, I will slice it into thick pieces. Please take a piece if you are hungry.
I would love a slice, thank you. Your kindness makes this moment very sweet.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a song I like, but I do not know what to do with it.
That is a happy thing to have. Do you want to dance to it?
I am not sure if I should sing it or just listen.
You can do either one. Is it a fast song or a slow song?
It is a slow song.
Slow songs are good for resting. Do you feel calm when you hear it?
Yes, it makes me feel calm.
That is a good sign. You should listen to it when you are tired.
Okay, I will listen to it tonight.
That sounds like a perfect plan. Enjoy your time with the music.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My horse looks very thin.
That sounds worrying. How long has he been like this?
About two weeks.
He needs a vet check. Is he eating his hay?
Yes, but he runs it away.
A vet can help with that. Tell me, is he still peeing normally?
I am not sure.
That is hard to say. Please watch him closely.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel tired after eating. What should I eat to feel better?
Try eating more fruits and vegetables. They give you good energy. Do you like vegetables?
Not really. I mostly eat sugar.
Too much sugar can make you sleepy. It is hard to stop, but small steps help. What is your favorite fruit?
Apples are okay. I do not know how to make better choices.
Start by swapping candy for an apple. It is a sweet treat that is good for you. Do you have any nuts at home?
Yes, I have some peanuts.
Peanuts are good for you in small amounts. They have strong energy. How much do you usually eat?
Just a small handful.
That is a great start. Keep it up and you will feel stronger soon. Do you drink plenty of water?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Can you see the bright star?
Yes, it is shiny up there. Are you going somewhere fun?
No, I must go home now. Do stars sleep at night?
No, they stay on all the time. Do you know what the moon does?
I do not know. Is the moon a star?
Not really. It is a different kind of light. Do you like looking up?
I have no time to look. Can you tell me one more thing?
Sure. The sky is very quiet. Do you hear it?
I hear my clock. I must leave.
Okay, good luck. Do you like the dark?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting on the bus.
Oh no, that is not fun. Did you see any dogs outside?
Yes, I saw a big one. It was very fast.
That must have been exciting. I hope you get to rest soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I would like a pizza, but I do not know what toppings are on it. What is on the cheese pizza?
The cheese pizza has tomato sauce and mozzarella cheese. Do you like mushrooms?
I think I will skip the mushrooms. Can you add extra cheese to my order?
Yes, I can add extra cheese for you. Enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see the light but I do not know the way.
That is a hard spot to be in. Are you safe right now?
Yes, I am safe but I am very cold.
Stay put and keep warm. Do you hear any sounds?
I hear only the wind and the sea.
The keeper will likely hear your call. Can you make a loud noise?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see smoke coming from the kitchen. What should I do?
Is anyone hurt? Go to the safe place outside now.
I am outside with my dog. Should I call someone?
Yes, call the fire number. Do you know the number by heart?
Yes, I am calling. I feel very scared.
You are doing the right thing. Stay away from the hot house.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bike chain fell off again and it hurt my leg.
Oh no, that is a bad fall. Did you wipe the dirt off your leg?
Yes, but now I have to walk home.
Walking can be a nice, quiet break. Do you have a friend nearby?
No, just the quiet street and my sore knee.
I am sorry it feels so hard right now. I hope the walk feels better soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am happy for my big day tomorrow.
That is good news to hear. Do you have a plan for the party?
I think I want to have it in the park.
The park is a nice place. Do you like cake?
Yes, I love chocolate cake very much.
Chocolate is a great choice. Do you have enough seats for all your friends?
I have ten chairs, but I have twelve friends.
You need two more chairs. I can lend you two from my house.
That is very kind of you. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. I am glad I could help.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is snow white?
Ice crystals scatter all colors of light back to your eyes. Do you like looking at snow?
Yes, I do.
That is wonderful. How cold is it outside today?
It is very cold.
Be sure to keep warm. Do you have a warm hat?
Yes, I have one.
Good idea. Stay cozy and safe.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need lunch right now. I am very late.
I can help. Do you like the chicken bowl?
Yes, please. Can I get it in two minutes?
I do not know for sure. Can I ask for a rush?
Please do. I must go now.
I will call the kitchen. Would you like a drink?
No, just the food. Thank you.
You are welcome. I hope you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My magnet just broke.
Oh no. That is very sad. Did you drop it?
Yes, and now it will not stick to anything.
I am sorry to hear that. I do not know why that happens.
Maybe I held it too hard.
That can happen. Was it a big magnet?
It was tiny. I wanted to use it for my craft.
I understand the frustration. Do you have another one?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am waiting for the bus and I am bored.
Try looking at the clouds. Do you see any shapes?
I am still stuck in a long line at the store.
Try to look at the person behind you. Are they smiling?
I am waiting for my food to finish cooking.
The smell might be good. Do you like the scent?
I am waiting for a call that does not come.
I do not know why it is late. Is your phone off?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to say the word for apple but my mouth hurt. I think I am doing it wrong.
That is very common when you start. Do you feel tired?
Yes, my tongue feels like a funny string. I want to stop.
Rest is good. How long did you practice?
Just ten minutes, but it was hard work. I am still confused.
Confusion means you are learning. Do you have water nearby?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are we moving to the new house?
The new place is bigger. Do you have toys to pack?
What happens to the plants when we move?
We will put them in boxes with extra soil. Are you excited or scared?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am angry because the big boat is on the water and I do not get why it stays up.
I am sorry you feel that way. Have you ever tried to float in a pool?
Yes, but I need to kick my legs, so why is the ship different?
The ship is very wide and light inside, so it pushes a lot of water down to stay up.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today!
That is wonderful news. What made you smile?
I found a puppy in the park.
A little dog? How cute. Is he safe now?
Yes, I took him home.
That is a kind thing to do. Does he have a name?
I called him Spot.
Spot is a sweet name. Good for you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are mountains so tall?
They are tall because the Earth's skin moves and pushes up. Do you like to climb?
Yes, I do. How does the Earth move its skin?
I do not know all the details, but it is like a slow dance. Do you have a favorite peak?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like how the book ends. The dog died and I feel sad.
I am sorry you are sad. Does that ending make you feel angry or just lonely?
It makes me feel lonely because the owner left. I wanted them to stay together.
That is a fair feeling. It is hard when things end.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very hungry and need ideas for breakfast.
A warm bowl of oatmeal is a great choice. Do you like sweet or savory food?
I think I want something sweet with fruit on top.
That sounds delicious and healthy. What fruit do you have in your kitchen right now?
I have some bananas and a little honey left over.
Sliced banana with honey over warm oats is perfect. You will enjoy that.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked on the wet sand today.
That sounds nice. Did you see any birds?
Yes, I saw a white bird fly by.
Wow, that is beautiful.
Then I sat down to rest.
Good for you. Are you tired now?
I am a bit tired but happy.
I am glad to hear that.
I want to go back soon.
I hope you do.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a broken lock on the fence. It had no key.
That sounds tricky. Did you check the shed?
No, but I saw a bird sitting on the fence. It looked at me.
A helpful bird? Did it hold a key?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to say hello to my new neighbour.
You can just smile and wave at them. Do they look friendly?
Yes, he looks very nice. What should I say?
You can say "Hi, I am your new neighbour." Does that feel easy?
That sounds simple. How do I stop them from feeling scared?
Be calm and speak slowly. Do you like to talk to new people?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My garden fence is old and broken.
That looks tough. Do you want to fix it?
I am not sure. It costs a lot of money.
It may not cost much. What do you have to work with?
I have wood and tools. I am just unsure.
You can try a small patch first. Is that okay with you?
Yes, I will try that. Thank you.
Good luck. Have fun in your garden.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how plants drink.
They use roots to pull water up. Do you see their roots?
I still feel lost. What should I do now?
Just give them some water. That is all you need to do.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My bike feels wobbly when I ride it.
Is the seat too high?
Yes, I have to stand up almost.
Lower the seat a bit to help you balance. Do you have a tool to do this?
I only have my hands.
Ask an adult to tighten it for you.
Should I wear a helmet?
Yes, always wear a helmet to keep your head safe.
Thanks, I will listen to you.
You are welcome. Have fun riding.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for the party. Where is the key?
I do not see it. Do you have it?
Yes, I have it. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Have a great time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my blue square. It hurts.
I am sorry your square is broken. Do you have a glue stick?
No, I have no glue. I am very sad.
That sounds hard. What else do you have?
Just a red circle and a yellow triangle.
A circle and a triangle. Can they make a new shape together?
I do not know. I feel dumb.
You are not dumb. Try putting the triangle on the circle.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My dog is very fast.
That is nice. What does he like to do?
He likes to run in the park.
Running is fun. Does he stop to play?
Yes, he stops to chase balls.
That sounds great. I do not know if my dog would like that.
He also likes to sleep a lot.
Good dogs need rest. Is he tired today?
Yes, he is sleeping right now.
He must be happy.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we eat toast first?
It gives us energy for the day. Do you like jam?
Yes, I love sweet jam. Why is it sweet?
Sugar makes it taste nice.
Does the sun help the jam?
No, not for the jam. But the sun helps the bread dry. Do you like dry bread?
Only a little. Why does bread get hard?
It dries out when left open. Do you like soft bread?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which bait is best for today.
Try worms if the water is warm. Do you see a spot with still water?
Yes, but I am not sure how to tie the hook.
Wrap the line around the shank twice, then make a small loop. Does that sound easy to try?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors. Blue light bounces around the air more than other colors do. Do you like looking up?
Yes, it is so big. Does the moon do that too?
No, the moon does not have air around it. It reflects the sun's light straight back to us.
Oh, I see. So the air makes the sky blue?
Yes, the air spreads the blue light everywhere. It is a very pretty day, is it not?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very scared and I do not know what to do.
It is okay to feel that way. Do you want to talk about what is on your mind?
I am trying to fix this, but I keep making mistakes.
Mistakes help us learn. What is one small thing you can do right now?
I think I just need to take a deep breath first.
That is a good plan. I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to speak Spanish, but my tongue feels too big.
That is okay. Your tongue will get smaller with practice. What is your favorite color?
Red. I know that word.
Great start. You can start with the things you love. Do you like cats?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The little fish is sitting at the bottom. It does not look happy.
I am sorry to hear that. Is the water cold or warm?
I do not know. I just put it there an hour ago.
I do not know why it is sad. Do you see any other fish in the tank?
No, it is the only one in there. It looks so alone.
That must feel lonely. Have you given it food?
Yes, I gave it a big piece of meat. It did not eat it.
Fish often need small flakes, not big meat. I am glad you checked.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a letter for my grandma.
That is a nice gift. Do you know where her house is?
Yes, it is down the street.
Great. You can put the letter in that red box.
Do I need to pay money?
Sometimes, but not for a small letter. Do you like writing letters?
I do! Is that all I do?
Yes, you are done. Have a good day!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My little fish looks sad. What should I do?
Let me check the water temperature first. Is the water warm or cool?
It is warm. Also, it only eats a tiny bit.
Warm water helps them feel good. It may need time to adjust to its new home.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the wind push on my face?
It moves air really fast toward you. Do you like cold air?
Yes, I do. Why is it moving so fast?
The sun heats up some places more than others. This makes the air rise and sink.
That sounds tricky. What happens when it rises?
Cooler air rushes in to fill the empty space. Is it windy here today?
Yes, very windy. Why does it stop sometimes?
It stops when the air warms up evenly around you. Do you feel calm now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw a bear in the woods today and I am scared it is hungry.
Bears get hungry, but they usually try to find their own food. Do you know what kind of bear it was?
It was big and brown, and I think it might be dangerous to me.
That sounds scary. Big brown bears can be dangerous, so stay away from them and tell a grown-up.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I fell down while running to the bus.
Ouch, are you okay?
Yes, I am fine, just a little bruise.
I am glad you are safe.
I missed my bus because of the fall.
That sounds hard. Did you get a ride?
My sister drove me to work.
She is very kind.
I am making a plan for tomorrow.
What is your plan?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say sorry?
We say sorry to show we are sorry for hurting feelings. Did you feel bad after the mistake?
Yes, I felt bad. Does saying sorry make it all better?
It helps people feel heard and loved again.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! Look at my new magnet.
That looks fun. Does it stick to your fridge?
Yes, it goes click. I like the sound.
Nice. What color is the magnet?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you know how many months there are?
Yes, there are twelve months in a year. Do you like winter?
I like snow in December. Is that a month?
Yes, December is the last month of the year. What do you eat for breakfast?
I eat toast. Do you know the name of the month after July?
That month is called August. Is it hot in August?
It is very hot. Thank you for helping me count.
You are welcome. Happy learning!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is the food at that place good?
Yes, many people say it is delicious. Do you like pizza?
I do not have a table yet.
You should call them to ask for a seat.
Where is the door?
It is right there on the left.
Can I pay with a card?
Yes, they take cards. Do you have one?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did my old friend stop talking to me?
I do not know for sure. Was there a big fight?
No, we were happy. Why did they just leave?
Maybe life got too busy for them. Do you miss their voice?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The wind is very loud today. I do not know what to do with my wet clothes.
You can hang them on a line. Do you like the fresh smell?
I am not sure if they will dry. The sky is gray and looks heavy.
Wind helps water go away. Do you see any blue spots up there?
I see some birds flying high. I still feel worried about the rain.
Birds fly when the air is right. Do you think the rain will stop soon?
Maybe, but I am still unsure. It feels cold and wet outside.
Then keep them inside until they feel dry. You will know when they do.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I lost my way and I feel very scared. Where is the main road?
The main road is just ahead, near the big red tree. Are you alone right now?
Yes, I am here by the path. Do you see any people coming?
I see a man walking your way, so you are safe. Let him know you need help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am sitting here with a hot cup of tea.
That sounds nice. What did you do before this?
I walked in the park and saw a big brown dog.
A big dog is interesting. Was it friendly?
It was very loud and barked at my shoes.
I am sorry about the noise. Do you drink tea often?
Yes, but now I am just waiting for my book to arrive.
I hope it comes soon. What kind of book is it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a blue bird on my walk today.
Oh, how cute! Did it sing?
Yes, it sang a happy song in the tree.
That is wonderful. What color was the tree?
The tree was green with small leaves.
Nature is so lovely. Do you see it often?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not know how to start my letter.
That is hard. What is the letter for?
It is for my friend. I am mad at him.
I am sorry. Do you want to be kind?
Yes, but I am still upset.
That is okay. What made you mad?
He took my toy.
I do not know if I can fix that. Do you want to say sorry first?
No, he should say sorry.
I understand. Let us write that he is sad too.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am tired but I do not know what book to read.
Reading is a sweet choice. What kind of story makes you happy?
I like funny tales but I also like calm ones.
Funny stories can make you laugh all night. Do you want to sleep soon?
I am not sure if I should read or just rest my eyes.
Your body knows best. How does your head feel right now?
My head feels good but my eyes are heavy.
Rest is the true answer. Good night.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I watered my beans today and saw the leaves perk up.
That is nice to see. Do they like the rain too?
I think so, but I am not sure how they take the water in.
They use tiny hairs on their roots to pull up water. Did you dig any up?
No, I did not dig any up.
Good, as that would hurt them. The water travels up inside to the leaves.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The snow is everywhere and I do not know what to do.
That sounds like fun. Do you have warm boots?
I have boots, but my hands are very cold.
Try making a snowman. Are you good at building things?
I am not sure how to start the snowman.
Roll a big ball for the body first. Do you want to try that?
Okay, I will roll a ball.
That is a good start. Have fun out there.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found out why big boats stay up on the water!
That is so cool. Do you know what pushes it up?
It is the water pushing back, I think.
You are right. Does the boat push the water down?
Yes, it pushes a lot of water down.
Smart. Why does that help the boat stay up?
Because the water pushes up just as hard.
Exactly. Do you like how the boat feels light?
It feels super happy and safe!
That is nice to hear.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The city was so loud today.
That sounds tiring. Did you find a quiet spot?
I sat on a bench by the park.
What a nice choice. Did you watch the birds?
Yes, they were eating bread.
I love seeing that. Was the food good?
My sandwich was cold, but I was happy.
Good feelings matter most.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw the girl in the white dress. She looked so happy.
She is getting married. Do you like the white dress?
Yes, it is very pretty. Who is she giving a ring to?
She is giving it to her new husband. I do not know his name.
That is a big day. Are we going to eat cake?
Yes, we will have a lot of cake. Is that your favorite kind?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am putting things in my bag. What should I bring?
Do you need to go outside? Bring a jacket if it is cold.
Yes, it is cold. What else do I need?
Do you have any snacks? A sandwich is a good choice.
I have a sandwich. Is the bag ready?
You have the basics. Enjoy your walk!

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you talk to a friend?
No, I just want to be alone.
That is okay sometimes. Do you want to read a book?
Maybe later, I am tired.
Rest is good for you. Is your stomach full?
Yes, I ate a big lunch.
Good. Take it one step at a time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people run?
They run to keep their bodies strong. Do you like to move a lot?
Why does my heart beat so fast?
Your heart pumps blood to help your muscles work hard. Is your heart beating loud right now?
Why do I get tired?
Your body uses up its energy when you work hard. Do you feel heavy in your legs?
Why do I feel so good after?
Running makes happy feelings in your brain. Do you want to rest now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does it rain?
Clouds get too heavy with water. Do you like the sound it makes?
I do. How do the clouds get heavy?
Water turns to gas and floats up high. It cools down and turns back into drops.
But why does it fall?
The drops stick together and get too big. The air cannot hold them up.
Is it heavy water?
Yes, it is just water. Do you wear a hat to keep dry?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw smoke rise from the house down the street last night.
Oh no, that is scary. Was anyone safe?
The fire crew came fast and put it out soon.
Good. Did you watch from your window?
I did, but then I got tired and went to bed.
Smart to rest. Do you feel happy it is over?
Yes, the sun rose bright this morning.
That is a lovely start.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do some people work from home?
They save time on travel. Do you like walking?
Yes, but why is sitting at a desk good?
It feels like rest. Is your home calm?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say thank you in French?
You say "merci." Why do you want to learn that?
I am going to visit Paris soon.
That sounds fun. Do you want to learn how to order food too?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am stuck on my math homework. The numbers look all mixed up.
That can feel hard. Which part is confusing you?
I do not know how to add the big numbers.
Let us try adding the ones first. Do you want to show me one problem?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make the sky look nice in a photo?
Turn your camera up a little bit. Do you know where the sun is?
Yes, I see it right there.
Move your phone so the sun is not in the picture. Is the sky blue or gray?
It is a bright blue today.
That is very good. Let the light touch the top of the building.
I am looking up now. Does this look right?
It looks great. Do you like how it feels?
I love it. It looks very happy.
Good job taking that picture.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I change a dirty diaper?
Lay the baby on a soft pad and open the clean one. Does the baby seem happy right now?
The baby kicks a lot. What should I do?
Hold the baby’s hands gently to keep them still. Do you have wipes nearby?
Yes, I have wipes. How do I use them?
Wipe from front to back to stay clean. I do not know if you prefer unscented wipes, but plain ones are safe.
Do I need to put cream on it?
Yes, put a little cream on the skin. Is the skin red at all?
No, it looks fine. What is the last step?
Tape the clean diaper on snugly. Do you feel ready to try?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I broke the cup. Why is it on the floor?
It slipped from my hand. Do you hurt your hand?
No, but why did it slip?
I held it too tight. Are you sad about the cup?
A little. Why was it tight?
I was in a rush. Do you want to help me sweep?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: Why does the big ship stay up on the water?
It is light enough for the water to hold it. Do you have a boat here?
I am not sure what to do with it.
Just let the water push it up gently.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a bright green beetle in my garden today. I am so happy to share this with you.
That is a lovely find. What color is its shell?
It is like a shiny leaf. Do you know what it is called?
I am not sure of its exact name. It sounds like a fun surprise.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I really like apples. They are red and sweet.
Apples are very good for you. Do you like them with seeds in?
No, I do not like seeds. Do you like juice or whole fruit?
I enjoy both, but juice is easier to drink. What color apple is your favorite?
I like the green ones best. They are sour and crunchy.
That is a great choice. Green apples are very cool and fresh.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now, the clock ticks fast.
The road ahead is very quiet. Do you like the silence?
I do not have time to listen.
I know the next turn is a crosswalk. Is it safe to run?
The light is green, so I go.
Please watch for slow walkers. Do you know the way?
I know the street well.
Then go with care. I wish you a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I can never remember the order of the months. Do you have a trick?
Yes, try singing the calendar song. Do you like music?
I do, but what comes after December?
After December comes January again. It is a circle.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The sky is gray and wet. I do not know where to go.
You can stay in and rest. Do you like the sound of rain?
I just feel stuck and cold. What should I do?
Put on a warm coat and go outside. Is the rain loud today?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Does my teacher know everything about books?
No, she does not know everything. Do you like reading books?
Yes, I like them. What does she read?
I do not know what she reads. Do you want to ask her?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The city was so loud today.
That sounds tiring. Did you find a quiet spot?
I sat on a bench and watched the birds.
That is a sweet way to rest. Did you see any big animals?
No, just a cat sleeping in the sun.
A warm nap is the best treat.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My dog found a ball in the yard today.
That sounds like a fun game. Did he bring it back to you?
Yes, he dropped it at my feet and wagged his tail.
He seems very happy to play with you. Does he like fetch best?
I think so, but he also loves to nap in the sun.
Napping is a good way to rest after playing. Was the sun warm on you too?
A little, but I stayed in the shade with him.
Smart move to stay cool. What did you have for lunch?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate winter. It is so cold and dark.
That sounds rough. What do you miss most about summer?
I miss the warm sun and the green grass.
Those things bring great joy. Do you like to play outside?
Yes, but the snow makes it hard to walk.
Ice can be slippery. Do you have warm boots?
I have them, but I still feel sad.
Sad days do happen. What brings you the most comfort?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is great to hear. Why are you so happy?
I just got back from a trip to the beach.
The beach sounds like fun. Did you swim in the water?
Yes, I swam for a long time.
How was the water?
It was very warm and clean.
That sounds wonderful.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I left my bag at home. Now I have no lunch.
That is very sad. Do you have a snack in your desk?
No, I have nothing. My tummy hurts.
I am sorry. I have an extra apple. Would you like it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do I bake bread fast?
Mix flour, water, and yeast. Do you have warm water ready?
I just used cold tap water. Is that bad?
Cold water slows the rise. Add a bit of sugar to help the yeast wake up.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How does a big ship float on water?
It floats because it pushes water away, and the water pushes back up. Do you like boats?
I want to build a boat. What do I need?
You need a container that holds air inside. Do you have any cardboard?
I have a box and some tape. Is that enough?
Yes, if you seal it tight so no water gets in. Do you have scissors?
Yes, I cut the box and taped it.
Good job. Now put it in water gently. Does it feel bouncy?
It floats! But it feels wobbly.
That is normal at first. How many toys can it hold?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it safe to sleep in a tent?
Yes, if you pick a dry spot. Do you have a warm blanket?
How do I keep bugs away?
Use bug spray and close your zipper. Is it a forest or a field?
What food is good for camp?
Simple things like sandwiches and fruit work well. Do you want to cook fire?
How do I build a small fire?
Use dry sticks and leaves. Do you have matches?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky gray today?
The clouds are thick and blocking the sun. Do you like watching the rain?
Yes, I do. But why do drops fall?
Water rises, cools, and turns back into tiny drops. That makes clouds heavy. Do you bring an umbrella?
I forgot my umbrella.
That is tricky. You might get wet soon. Are you cold?
A little bit, yes.
Warm clothes help a lot. Do you like being warm?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The rain is very loud today. It is making me feel sad.
That sounds tough. Do you have a warm blanket nearby?
Yes, I have a big, soft one. But I still do not like the storm.
Try wrapping up tight in the dark. Do you like listening to rain?
Not really. I just want it to stop so I can go play outside.
I hope it clears up soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am so tired today. Work was very hard.
I am sorry you feel this way. Did you have time to rest?
No, I ran to dinner. My brain feels heavy.
That sounds like a lot to take in.
What should I do now? I need advice.
Try to put your phone away. Your mind needs a break.
But I have emails to check.
You can read them tomorrow. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I can not sleep well at night.
Do you look at bright screens before bed?
Yes, I watch shows for a long time.
The light tricks your brain into staying awake. Try reading a book instead.
That sounds like a good idea.
Have you tried drinking warm milk before bed?
No, I have not. Does it work?
Many people find it helps them feel calm. It might help you too.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a new movie today.
That sounds fun. What kind of movie was it?
It was a funny one with a cat.
A cat movie is always nice. Did you laugh?
Yes, I laughed a lot.
I am glad you had a good time.
The cat was very silly.
Silly cats are great. Was it a real cat or a toy?
It was a real cat on screen.
Real cats are the best.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big secret to tell you.
That is exciting. What is it?
I am getting a puppy next week.
A puppy? That is wonderful.
It will be a small white dog.
How lucky you are.
I am so happy about it.
I am glad for you.
Thank you for listening.
Always.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My boss is very kind to me.
That is nice. Do you like your job?
Yes, I like helping people.
That is good work.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great skill to learn. Do you have your shoes on?
Yes, I do. What do I do first?
You start by making a big loop with one string. Have you done that before?
I think so. It looks like a bunny ear.
Yes, that is the right start. Now take the other string and go under that loop. Do you see how it looks?
I pulled it tight. It feels okay.
Great job. You did it. Did it take much time?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the mud on my boots. My socks are wet.
That feels bad. Did you bring extra socks?
No, I forgot them. Now my toes are cold.
I know how to fix that. Do you have a dry towel?
Yes, but it is small. Will it help?
It will dry your feet fast. You will be happy soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do clouds float in the sky?
They are made of tiny water drops that are very light. Do you like to watch them move?
Yes, I do. What happens when it rains?
When the drops get too heavy, they fall down as rain.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a funny dog at the park today.
That sounds like a fun moment. What was the dog doing?
It chased its own tail in circles.
Oh no, that is silly. Did it get tired?
Yes, it fell down with a big thump.
I hope it was not hurt.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The fish looks sad. Should I feed it?
It might be hungry. Is the water clean?
I do not know what to do.
Check the water for now. I do not know if it is sick.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I wrap a box so it does not break?
Put soft things like towels on the bottom first. Do you have any towels to use?
Yes, I have a few old ones in the closet.
Great. Wrap each item separately and tape the box shut tight. Is that clear to you?
Yes, it is. I will use the towels first.
That is a good plan. Be gentle with the boxes. Do you need help lifting them?
No, they are light. Thank you very much.
You are welcome. Good luck with your move.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I bought some red roses for my mom. She loves them so much.
That is a lovely gift. She will surely be happy to see them.
Yes, they look very bright in the sun. I want to tell you a secret.
I am listening. I am curious to hear your news.
I just got a great grade at school today. I feel like I am floating.
Oh, how wonderful. Do you know what you will do to celebrate?
I think I will eat a big chocolate cake. It is my favorite treat.
That sounds delicious. Good luck with the sweet prize.
Thanks for listening. I feel even happier now.
You are very welcome. Have a fun day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My bread is still very hard and dry.
That happens when there is not enough water. Did you use warm milk?
I used cold water because I was in a rush.
Warm water helps the yeast wake up.
So I should make sure it is warm, like a bath?
Yes, it should feel warm but not hot. Do you have a thermometer?
I do not, I just use my hand.
That is a good way to check. Just test it before you add the yeast.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many months are there in a year?
There are twelve months in a year. Do you know the names of them?
I know January and December. What is the first month?
The first month is January. Do you like winter?
No, I prefer warm days. When does summer start?
Summer usually starts in June. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I love the pool. How many months are in summer?
Summer has three months: June, July, and August. Do you know when it ends?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I bought two boxes of apples for lunch, but I only ate one.
That is a good start. Did you share the extra box with a friend?
Yes, I gave it to my brother and he was very happy.
Kindness feels good. Do you keep the apple cores to start a plant?
I did, actually, and it is growing well by my window.
That is wonderful. Have you counted how much money you saved today?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My head hurts so bad right now.
I am so sorry you feel that way. Did you get enough sleep last night?
I am really angry about this pain.
That is a very strong feeling to have. What made you feel this angry?
I just want it to go away.
I do not know what will fix it fast. Have you tried drinking some water?
It is still there.
I am with you in this moment.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Can you help me find the bus stop?
Of course. Do you have a map?
No map. Please go fast.
I will take you there. Is it raining?
It is sunny. Just hurry.
Let us run to the corner. Do you have the ticket ready?
Yes, I have it. Thank you.
You are welcome. Look, the bus is coming.
Great. I am saved.
Good luck today.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Where can I send a letter?
You go to the front desk to mail it. Do you have a stamp?
I think I do. Is it open late?
It closes at five in the afternoon. Did you check the time?
It is only two o'clock. How much does it cost?
The price depends on how heavy it is. Weighing it will tell us.
That makes sense. Thank you very much.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is the game on?
Yes, it is on. Do you like red teams?
I do. Who is winning?
I do not know. It is very close.
I must go now.
Good luck. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to talk about it?
I lost my favorite toy.
That can feel like a big loss. Did you search for it?
I checked under the bed.
That was a good start. Do you want to check the closet?
I will check it now.
I hope you find it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like loud music but my ears hurt. What can I do?
Try turning the sound down. Do you have soft ear pads?
No, I do not. Is it bad to wear big headphones?
They can block too much noise. Do you hear the birds outside?
Yes, I hear them. What kind of music is good for calm feelings?
Slow songs with soft voices help you rest. Do you like humming?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My big blue fish is swimming very fast today. Why is he doing that?
He might be happy or hungry. Do you see him eating?
No, he is not eating. He just swims in circles near the top.
That can mean he needs fresh water. Did you clean the tank yesterday?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very happy today. Why does that happen?
Happy feelings are good for your body. Do you know what made you smile?
A sunny day and a good snack.
Those are two great reasons to feel good. Is the sun still shining outside?
Yes, it is bright and warm.
That sounds like a perfect day for playing. What is your favorite thing to do in the sun?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see a big white puff. What is it?
It is a cloud made of water. Do you like the sky today?
I am late for work. Can it rain?
It may rain soon. I do not know for sure.
It is raining now. Is that bad?
It is just wet air falling down. Are you staying dry?
I must go now. Thank you.
Bye. Run safe!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel tired when I work from home.
Rest helps you work better. Do you take breaks?
I eat snacks all day long.
Water is a better choice than sweets. Do you drink enough?
My cat sits on my desk.
That can be distracting. Can you give him a soft bed nearby?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my chair so wobbly?
The leg is loose. Is the floor smooth or rough?
Why is it loose?
The screw moved out. Do you have a tool?
Why do I need a tool?
To push it back in tight. Is the wood hard?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I say I am sorry?
You just say I am sorry. Did you break something?
Yes, I broke your cup.
That is nice of you to tell me. Are you feeling bad?
Yes, I feel very sad.
It is okay to feel sad. Do you want to say it now?
I am sorry.
Thank you for telling me the truth. I forgive you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do fish have knees?
No, they do not. They have fins. Do you like fish?
I like my pool best.
That is a good place to swim. The water is clean there. Do you jump in?
Yes, I jump high!
How fun that is. Be careful when you jump.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I went for a run today. It felt great.
That sounds fun. Do you like running?
Yes, I love the fresh air.
Nice. How far did you go?
About two miles. I felt strong.
Wow, that is good work.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to do homework?
It helps you practice what you learned in class. Do you like writing?
Yes, I do. Why do we read so much?
Reading makes your brain strong and fun. What is your favorite book?
It is about a dog. Why do we have a teacher?
The teacher guides you when you are stuck. I do not know the answer to that one.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I cannot tell the time on a normal clock.
That is okay. Do you have a watch with numbers?
Yes, I have a watch with numbers.
Look at the short hand first. Is it close to twelve or one?
It is pointing right at the twelve.
Now look at the long hand. Is it pointing up or down?
It is pointing down to the six.
Then it is twelve thirty. Does that make sense to you?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I move a knight?
It makes a small letter L shape on the board. Do you like horses?
Yes, but what is checkmate?
It means the king is in danger and cannot escape. It is the goal of the game.
I want to win fast.
That is hard to do quickly. Do you practice often?
Not very much.
Practice will help you see more moves. Have fun playing!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does a big ship stay on the water?
It floats because it pushes water down. Do you like swimming?
Yes, I do. How does the push help?
The water pushes back up to hold it. Is that clear?
I think so. What if it gets heavy?
It sinks if it gets too heavy for the push. Do you have more questions?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am on the bus. It is very loud and I feel sick. What can I do?
Try looking out the window. Do you have water?
Yes, I have water. Where does this bus stop?
I do not know the exact stops. Is it near your house?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water in the lake so blue?
The sky is blue, and the water shows that color. Do you like looking up at the sky?
Why does the water move when I throw a stone?
The stone hits the water, and it makes ripples. Have you ever thrown one before?
Why is the lake so quiet at night?
I do not know for sure, but birds sleep and people rest. Do you hear any sounds?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I see the moon clearly at night?
Look up at the sky after dark. Do you know how to find the stars first?
Not really, I get confused.
That is okay, just look for the brightest light. Do you have a telescope?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to ride my bike, but I am scared of falling.
That is a scary feeling. Do you have your helmet on?
Yes, I do. But how do I keep my balance?
Look ahead, not down at the ground. Your bike will move forward easier.
Okay, I will try that. What if I go too fast?
I do not know what is too fast for you. How far do you want to go?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do robots eat?
No, they do not eat. Are you scared of them?
No, but they are fast. Do they feel sad?
They do not feel feelings. Do you like big robots?
I like small ones. Do they need sleep?
No, they use power instead. Do you have a robot?
No, just my cat. Do they get hot?
They can get warm. Do you want a robot friend?
Maybe, but I am very late. Do they cost much?
Yes, they can be pricey. Do you need help now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: What is that bright band in the sky?
It is a rainbow made by rain and sun. Do you like colors?
Yes, but I must run.
Run safe.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to build a box, but I do not know how to start.
That is a fun idea. Do you have any wood yet?
I have no wood, only paper and glue.
You can make a box from paper if you fold it well.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a fun skill. Do you have a pen to practice first?
Yes, I do. What should I do?
Make a loop with the pen and pull the other end through it.
It feels tricky. How do I finish it?
You need to make two loops and cross them. Do you like doing that?
I think I can do it.
Great! Now try it on your shoes.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am making soup today and I feel so good.
That sounds nice. What are you putting in it?
Carrots and potatoes. It smells sweet.
Yum. Do you like carrots?
I do. Would you like a bowl?
Yes, please.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go now. Is the play good?
Yes, the story is sweet and fun. Do you like sad stories?
No, I hate crying. Is there a happy ending?
Yes, everyone gets a friend at the end. Will you sit in the front?
I cannot wait for seats. Where is the door?
The door is right there on your left. Have a nice time!
Thanks. I am leaving.
Okay, run safely.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I send a letter to my friend?
You can buy a stamp and put it in the mail slot. Do you have your letter ready?
Yes, I have it here, but how much is a stamp?
A stamp costs fifty cents. Do you have enough money?
Yes, I have a dollar.
That is plenty, so you are all set. Is your friend nearby?
No, he lives far away.
The mail will get there in a few days. I hope he likes the note!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The rain was very loud today.
That sounds like a big sound. Did you stay inside?
Yes, I watched the drops on the glass.
I love watching rain too. What did you see outside?
I saw a cat running to the door.
Poor little cat. Did he get in?
Yes, his owner let him in quickly.
That is a good helper. I am glad the cat is safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I count to ten?
You start with one and add one each time. Do you like counting?
Yes, but I forget.
Try saying the numbers out loud slowly. Is that helping?
Yes, it works.
That is great news for you. Keep practicing.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke my toy car. Can you fix it?
I am sorry, I do not know how to fix cars. Do you have any tape?
No, I do not have tape. What should I do?
You can put a bandage on your hand if you hurt it. Is your hand okay?
Yes, my hand is fine. Just the car is sad.
That is a good thing. You can try to glue it back together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off trees?
The tree lets them go in the cold weather to save energy. Do you like walking on them?
Yes, they crunch so nice. How can I make a leaf rubbing?
Put a leaf under paper and rub with a crayon. Is it a big leaf?
It is an oak leaf. It looks really cool.
Great idea. The veins show up best with green or yellow.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we drink hot tea and coffee in the morning?
It helps wake up your body. Do you like it hot or warm?
The coffee tastes strong and dark. Why is it not like tea?
Coffee beans taste different from tea leaves. I do not know why they taste so different.
Does the tea smell sweet?
Some teas smell sweet and nice. Do you add milk to your drink?
The coffee makes me feel fast. Why does the tea feel calm?
Tea has less of the rush stuff. Do you want to try a new kind?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I stop my dog from biting the furniture?
Try giving him a hard toy to chew on instead. Does he like to chase things?
Yes, he loves to run around the yard.
That is good energy to burn off. Do you walk him in the morning?
I walk him, but he pulls on the leash.
Try stopping when he pulls to teach him self control. Is he getting a lot of treats for good walks?
I give him some when he sits down nicely.
That is a very good start.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My legs hurt so much after the run.
That is because you pushed hard today. Do you like running long or short?
I usually like long runs, but today was too hard.
Resting helps your body fix itself. Did you drink some water?
No, I forgot to drink any water.
Water is very good for your muscles. You will feel better soon.
I am still a bit mad at the track.
Anger can go away with rest and food. How do you feel now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to be a sailor, but I am not sure how to start.
Do you like the water? I do not know the exact steps, but you must be brave.
I like the water, but I am afraid of the big waves.
That is very normal. Have you ever tried swimming in a pool?
Yes, I like pools, but the ocean is much bigger and wilder.
You can take a small boat trip first. Are you scared of boats?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because the sailors are so far away.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you miss them a lot?
Yes, I really do.
They are safe on the ship right now.
I hope the boat is not too shaky.
I do not know if it is shaking today. Is the wind loud where you are?
It is quiet here, but my heart is not.
Your heart will calm down soon.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I think sailors are very lonely on the big ship.
I know, they can feel far from home. Do you like to be alone?
I miss my boat on the lake.
That sounds nice. It is quiet there. Do you go there often?
Yes, but the water is cold today.
Cold water is not fun for swimming. Are your hands cold too?
Yes, my fingers feel like ice.
Please put on warm gloves to stop the chill. Do you have gloves?
No, I left them at the dock.
That is okay, you can warm up by a fire. Do you like fire?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The bus was so slow today. I am late for my class.
That is very frustrating. Did you miss your first lesson?
Yes, I missed it. I feel terrible about it.
It happens to everyone. Take a deep breath now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to build the tower but it fell down. I am so mad.
That feels really bad when things break. Do you want to try again?
I don't think I can do it right. It is too hard.
You did good work before it fell. Did you enjoy the parts that stayed up?
Yes, I liked making the base. But the top always tips over.
Maybe we can make the base wider next time. What do you think?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I know what time it is on a clock?
Look at the big hand first. It points to the minutes. Do you like watching it move?
Yes, but the small hand is confusing.
The small hand shows the hour. It moves very slowly.
What if the big hand is on the twelve?
That means it is a full hour. The clock just ticked over.
I think I get it now.
You are doing great. Is the hour hand close to a new number?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I cannot find my house.
Do you know where you are? Please tell me a big building nearby.
There is a red school in front of me.
That helps. Walk to the corner and look for a stop sign.
I see a stop sign.
Great. Follow the street with the trees until you see your front door.
I am at my door now.
Wonderful. Call your parent to say you are safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I have a really bad tummy ache and I do not want to go to the doctor.
That sounds scary. Do you think the doctor will give you a sticker?
I hope so, but I am mostly worried about the shots.
I do not know if you need a shot. Do you have a fever too?
No fever, just this cramp in my side.
That is good news. Do you want me to help you pack your bag?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to paint a sky. How do I make it look blue?
You can mix white with a little bit of blue paint. Do you have red paint too?
Yes, I do. How do I make the clouds white?
Just use the pure white paint for the clouds. It is very easy.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. What should I do?
That sounds bad. Did you sleep well last night?
No, I stayed up late. I feel very tired.
Try to rest and drink some water. I do not know why it hurts, but rest helps.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what to bring to class.
What does your teacher like?
I think she likes books, but I am not sure.
That is a good thought. Do you have a book?
I have a book, but it is too big.
Maybe a small note? What is the lesson about?
It is about the moon.
A small picture of the moon might work.
Should I draw it or write about it?
I do not know what she prefers. What do you want to do?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I climbed a big mountain today. My legs hurt, but I was so happy.
That is wonderful. What did you see from the top?
I saw the sea far below. It looked like a blue blanket.
It must have been magical to see that.
The air was so cool and fresh there. It felt good in my nose.
I love the idea of fresh mountain air. Do you want to go back?
Yes, I want to go back next year. It was the best day ever.
That is a great plan. Enjoy the memories.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sang a happy song this morning.
That sounds fun. Did you sing it in your room?
Yes, I stood on my bed and sang.
Wow, that is a brave move.
Then I felt very tall and strong.
Singing can make us feel big. What was the song about?
It was about a blue bird in the tree.
A blue bird is a lovely thought. Did you see a bird after that?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work and the lights are off.
That is very frustrating. Do you have a candle ready?
No, I do not. I need to go now.
Try the breaker box in the hall. Did you check the kitchen?
Yes, but it is broken. I am stuck.
I am sorry to hear that. Let me call my electric friend.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we go to the post office?
We go there to send mail to friends. Do you have any letters to send?
Why do we need stamps on the mail?
Stamps pay for the helper to carry your letter. Have you ever seen a stamp?
Why is the mailman coming to our door?
He brings your letters and packages. Are you excited to see what is in them?
Why do we need to write a name on the box?
The name helps the mailman find the right house. Do you know how to write your name?
Why does the post office close at night?
The workers go home to rest. Do you think they work hard?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired today because I did not finish my homework.
That sounds hard. Did you have a lot to do?
Yes, the math work was very long and I am sad now.
I understand your feelings. Are you done for the day?
