My teacher said I must do it again tomorrow.
That is not my favorite part. Do you want a snack?
Maybe, but I am too busy to eat right now.
Please take a small rest first. Do you need help?
No, I think I will just try again.
You can do it. Good luck with your work.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked past the blue house three times and still feel lost.
That sounds tiring. Did you see any street signs?
No, just the blue house.
I do not know the area. Did you ask anyone nearby?
Yes, I asked a dog to help.
That is a funny choice. Is the dog friendly?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel sick but I am not sure if I should go to the doctor.
That is good that you are thinking about it. Do you have a fever?
My head hurts and I feel hot, but I do not know what to do next.
It sounds like you might be ill. Have you eaten anything today?
I did not eat much, and I feel very tired all the time.
You should rest and drink some water. Do you feel ready to go now?
I think I will go, but I am still worried about what they will say.
Doctors are here to help you feel better. It is okay to be a little scared.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I picked this song because it makes me feel happy.
That is a good reason. Do you listen to it a lot?
Yes, I play it every morning.
Music can help start the day. What part do you like best?
I like the loud drums at the end.
I do not know the song, so I cannot say. Are the drums fast?
They are very fast and loud.
Fast drums can make you want to move. Do you dance when you hear them?
I shake my hands and feet.
That sounds like fun. Good luck with your song.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight hits the air and the blue light spreads. Are you going to work?
Yes, I must run. Do other colors vanish?
No, they mix or pass through. Do you see the sun right now?
It is hidden by clouds. What does that mean?
Clouds scatter all colors to look white. Do you have time for one more thing?
Only five minutes left. Please finish.
The air breaks white light into parts. Run safe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at this map I found in my backpack.
It is a very cool map. Where did you find it?
It was tucked inside my old history book.
That is a nice place to hide a treasure. Do you know where the red dot is?
I think it is near the big blue lake.
I am not sure if that is true. Do you want to go there?
Yes, I want to see if I can find it.
That sounds like a fun adventure. Have a great trip.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late and very stressed.
Take a deep breath. Are you worried about being late?
Yes, the bus leaves soon.
That sounds tricky. Did you check the map?
I do not know the right stop.
I do not know either. Is there a sign nearby?
I will look for it now.
Good luck with that.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My grandma is so sick. I am very sad.
I am sorry you feel this way. Is she resting now?
Yes, she is sleeping. I worry about her.
It is hard to wait. Do you feel okay today?
Not really. I want her to be well.
I know you care for her. I do not know when she will get better, but I hope she does.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the stream and saw a duck.
That sounds nice. Was the water cold?
Yes, it was very cold. The duck looked at me.
I am glad you stayed safe.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My grandma is so sweet and I love her very much.
That is wonderful news. What is her favorite thing to do?
She likes to bake warm cookies for the whole family.
That sounds yummy and cozy.
She also sings old songs when she bakes them.
I do not know the songs, but that sounds happy. Do you like the songs?
Yes, I love singing along with her.
That is a lovely bond to share.
I want to visit her again soon to bake more.
That is a sweet plan.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was bright today, so I put the little green sprouts in the dirt. My hands got very dirty, but the plants look happy. Do you like sunny days?
That is a lovely feeling. I do not have hands, but I know what it feels like to care for living things.
I watched one tiny leaf open up after a rain shower. It was so small, but it was standing tall. How do you rest?
I do not need sleep, but I enjoy quiet moments of learning. Your garden sounds very peaceful.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the king move so slow?
It moves one step to stay safe. Do you like watching it move?
I think so, but what if I lose?
Losing helps you learn new tricks. How do you feel about mistakes?
It makes me a bit sad.
Even great players lose sometimes. Do you play often?
Yes, with my dad on weekends.
That sounds like a nice time together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I fly a kite when it is windy?
Hold the string tight and run with the kite in front of you. Do you have a kite ready?
I have a red one, but it keeps falling.
Make sure the string is not tangled and the wind is not too strong. Is the sky clear today?
It is clear, but the string feels loose.
Tie a small knot to stop the string from slipping. Does that help?
Yes, now it stays up!
That is great. Enjoy the wind.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I found a bug in my bed and I am so mad.
That must feel icky. Is it still there?
Yes, and I do not know what it is.
I am sorry, I do not know its name. Does it have six legs?
I think so, but I am too scared to look.
Take a deep breath. Would you like to look together?
Maybe, but only if you watch it closely.
I will be right here with you. Do you want to take a look now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I climbed the hill today. It was very steep.
That sounds like hard work. Were you tired?
Yes, my legs felt weak. But the view was nice.
I am glad you enjoyed the sight. Do you like high places?
I do. They make me feel small.
That feeling can be good.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I wish to learn how to tie my shoes.
Would you like to start with the left shoe?
Yes, please show me the first step.
Cross the laces to make a big X.
Okay, I made the X. What comes next?
Do you know how to hold a loop?
I can hold a loop, but not both at once.
Make one loop and hold it with your thumb.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to sleep fast. I have no time.
I know a tip. Do you drink coffee at night?
No, but I play games on my phone.
That light wakes your brain. Try a book instead. Is your room cool?
Yes, it is cold. I am wearing thick clothes.
Too hot makes you wake up. Keep it cool. Good luck sleeping.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My feet hurt, and the shoes feel wrong.
I am sorry your feet hurt. What size do you need?
I tried everything, but none fit right. I just want to go home.
That sounds very hard. Do you want me to bring a different size?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw the blue sky today. It made me happy.
The sun shines on the air and makes it look blue. Did you have a nice walk?
Yes, I walked in the park. The grass was green.
Green grass looks good next to blue skies.
I am glad I saw it.
I am glad you saw it too.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. What was the Stone Age?
It was a long time when people used stones. Did you know people lived in caves?
No. Where is the pyramids from?
They are in Egypt. They are very old. Do you like big buildings?
Yes. Who built the first house?
I do not know the exact person. Do you like thinking about old times?
I must go now. Thanks.
You are welcome. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count to ten before we do math?
It helps our brains sort things into small, easy groups. Do you like the number seven?
I like seven because it is lucky. Why do we write the letter 'o' for zero?
We use a circle because it shows an empty space. Is your favorite number big or small?
I like big numbers. Can we count to one hundred right now?
I do not know if we have enough time, but I can try. What number shall we start with?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sun so bright today?
The clouds are gone, so the light shines right through. Do you like the warm feeling?
Why does the snow feel so cold?
Snow is made of ice, and ice is very cold. Is your nose getting chilly?
Why do people give gifts to each other?
Gifts show that someone cares about you. I do not know what you will get, but I hope it is nice.
Why do we sing songs together?
Singing makes happy memories with friends. What is your favorite holiday song?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went up the big hill today. The air was very cold and thin.
That sounds like a tall place. Did you see any snow?
Yes, there was a lot of white snow. It was hard to walk because of the wind.
I am sorry the wind was so strong. Was it safe for you?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a red square and a blue circle. What should I build?
You can make a funny face with them. Do you want it to look happy?
Yes, but I am stuck. Where do I put the circle?
Put the circle on top for a head. Is the square big enough for a body?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The sun is so bright today.
Yes, it is nice and warm. Do you like the sunshine?
It makes my eyes hurt.
That is because it is very strong. Please look away or wear a hat.
Is the sun a big fire?
I do not know the best word for it, but it is like a big star. Do you see the blue sky?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I picked up three shiny rocks by the river today.
That sounds fun. Did you find any smooth ones?
One was very smooth like a little egg.
Wow. Where did you put it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Where is the post office?
It is on Main Street. Do you need to buy stamps?
Yes, I need to send a letter.
The clerk will help you. Is the letter big or small?
It is a small letter.
That will cost one stamp. Do you have the money?
I have a five dollar bill.
That is plenty. Enjoy your day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a small box on the stairs.
That is a nice find. Do you know who gave it to you?
It was wrapped in blue paper with a red bow.
Blue and red are happy colors. What do you think is inside?
I am going to open it right now to see.
That will be so much fun. I hope you like what you see.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I like cake but I hate sugar.
That is a hard choice. Do you like fruit?
Yes, I love apples.
We have apple pie. It has less sweet stuff.
Is the crust thick?
I do not know for sure. Do you like thick crusts?
I want it thin.
Let us ask the baker. He can help you pick.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to start a new hobby but I do not know which one to pick.
That is a fun choice. Do you like playing outside?
I do not have a garden and I live in a small city.
You could try drawing pictures on paper. Do you like colors?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn to bake a cake, but it is so hard and I want to quit.
Baking takes time, and that is how you get it right. Do you have all the tools ready?
Yes, I have the bowl and the spoon, but I am worried I will make a mess.
A mess is just part of learning, so keep trying. What was the last thing you tried?
I tried to mix the flour, but it made a sticky paste and I feel stupid.
Sticky means you added too much water, which is a good sign. Do you have a measuring cup?
I only used my hand, I did not think to measure anything at all.
Using your hand is fine for now, just be gentle with the mix. Are you ready to start again?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My neighbor is very loud at night. What should I do?
That can be hard. How late do the noises usually start?
They start around ten o'clock. It makes me feel very tired.
You could wait a day or two to see if it stops. Do you know them well?
No, I have only met them once. I do not want to be rude.
Being kind is good. You might leave a small, polite note for them.
What should I write in the note?
I do not know the best words to use. Do you want to try a simple ask?
Yes, please help me with the words.
You could ask them to be quiet after nine. I hope that helps you sleep well.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my grandpa fall asleep so fast?
His body is tired from all the years of hard work. Do you like when he naps?
Yes, but why does he forget so many things?
His brain has changed as he got very old. Does that make you sad?
Sometimes, but I still love him. Why is his hair so thin now?
That is just part of getting older and it is natural. I know you want to help him, right?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my head so full?
The air up there is thin. Does your neck feel stiff?
Why do my feet swell?
You sit still for a long time. Do you want some water?
Why do I feel so tired?
I do not know the exact reason. Are you hungry?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Please make me toast now.
I can do that fast. Do you want it with butter?
Yes, with jam too. I must go.
Jam is ready. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is the door open yet?
No, it closes at five. Do you like books?
Yes, I like the funny ones.
They have many funny books. Do you bring coins?
I have a bag of coins.
That is great. Come back after five.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to hear loud drums.
That sounds fun. Do you play a drum yourself?
No, my dad plays them in a band.
That is very cool. How does it feel when they go boom?
It shakes my whole tummy.
I love music too. What is your favorite song to sing?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the shop today. I saw a red apple. It looked very nice.
That sounds like a tasty snack. Did you buy it?
Yes, I put it in my bag. Then I saw a blue bird on the roof.
A bird is always fun to see. Was it singing?
It was not singing. I just watched it for a minute.
Taking a break is good. Did you walk home?
I did. My feet hurt a little. I am so tired now.
Rest is important after a walk. Sleep well now.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so sad about the old times because people died so long ago.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like reading about kings?
Yes, but it makes me more angry that they fought for land.
You are right to feel that way. I do not know why people choose war over peace.
It just seems so wrong to hurt others for power.
Many people thought it was wrong too. Did you learn about the brave ones who stopped fights?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I pack my bag for a trip?
Start by folding your clothes small. Do you have a big bag or a small one?
I have a small bag.
Roll your clothes to save space. That helps a lot.
What should I put in first?
Put heavy things at the bottom. Is your bag empty now?
Yes, it is empty.
Then fold your clothes and start from the bottom. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water in the lake so blue?
The sky is blue, so the water shows that color back. Do you see birds flying over it?
I do! Why is the lake so quiet?
It is quiet because there are no big boats out today. Do you like the peace?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to grow carrots but my soil is very hard.
Dig deep and add soft leaves to break it up. Do you have a shovel?
Yes, I have one. It is red.
Great. Water them often so the roots do not get dry.
How do I know if I am using too much water?
If the ground is like a swamp, you use too much. Is it draining well?
The water sits on top.
That is bad for roots. Mix in sand to help it drain. Do you have sand?
I have a bag of sand in the garage.
Perfect. Add a little at a time until water goes down.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Did dinosaurs really eat people?
No, people were not born until after dinosaurs died. Do you like big animals?
Yes, I like the T-rex because it has big teeth.
That is true, it had very strong jaws. How many teeth do you think it had?
I think it had a lot of them, maybe fifty.
You are close, it had about eighty teeth. Do you want to hear about another dinosaur?
Yes, please tell me about the one with the long neck.
That is the Brachiosaurus. It used its long neck to eat high leaves.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, the lights just went out! I am very late for work.
That is a sudden dark. Are you safe in the dark?
I need to find my keys right now. The house is black and I can not see.
Try to feel along the wall. Do you have a phone?
My phone is on the table. I have to get to the office before nine.
Use your phone light to look. Is the front door near?
I found it, but the gate is stuck. Please tell me the gate code.
I do not know your special code. Did you write it down?
I forgot to write it! The backup code is 1234.
Try that number now. You can do it.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make clay like the people in the old village did. How do I start?
You can buy soft clay at the store and squish it with your hands. Do you have a favorite shape?
I like the round ones. What do I do after I squish it?
You can leave it outside in the sun to dry for a few days. I do not know if it will crack, but we can check tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Do you know if the fish stall is open?
Yes, it is open. Are you buying it for dinner?
Yes, I need to go now. Where is the door?
It is on the left. Do you like fresh fish?
I have no time to talk. Just point to the path.
Go straight down the path. Is this your first time here?
No, but I forgot the way. Is it far?
It is very close. Did you miss your bus?
I think so. Thank you very much.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
Bees drink sweet plant juice called nectar. Do you like sweet juice?
Yes I do! So what happens next?
They store the nectar in their belly and bring it back to the hive.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does music make me feel happy?
Music moves our bodies and minds, which feels good to us. Do you like to dance when you hear it?
Why is the beat so strong sometimes?
The beat gives music a rhythm to follow. I do not know why every song has a different one. What song makes you smile the most?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do trees lose their leaves in the fall?
The days get shorter and colder, so the tree saves its energy. Do you like the color of the fallen leaves?
I think they are very pretty to look at.
Yes, they make the ground look like a soft carpet. Does your tree drop its leaves all at once?
No, they fall slowly over many days.
That is how the tree sleeps through the winter. Do you know when the green leaves come back?
I guess in the spring when it gets warm.
Exactly, the tree wakes up and makes new leaves. It is a clever way to stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so hungry. I spent the morning looking for a lost dog.
That sounds like hard work. Do you know where the dog went?
No, but I found a big park. I want to eat a hot soup now.
Good choice. The red bowl with the steam looks nice.
Yes, that one. I will take it to go.
Great. Would you like a spoon with that?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now!
That is a great feeling. What song is in your head?
It is a song with fast drums and a big beat.
That sounds very energetic. Do you like to dance to it?
Yes, I jump around in my room!
Jumping is a fun way to move. Is it a new song for you?
No, it is an old song my dad played.
Old songs can feel new again.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My brother is very tiny.
He looks like a little ball. What is his name?
I think he is sleeping.
That is good for him. Do you like holding him?
My mom said it is cute.
It can be very cute. Do you want to play with him?
I do not know how to play with a baby.
You can just talk to him. Do you like that?
I think so, I guess.
That sounds nice.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My grandpa gave me a shiny red apple today.
That sounds like a nice treat.
Yes, I shared half of it with him.
You are very kind. Do you like apples?
They are sweet, but I miss the soup he made.
Missing them is very natural.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the new town today and saw a big red house.
That sounds like a nice place. Did you see any animals there?
Yes, there was a cat sleeping on a warm wall.
A sleeping cat is a happy sight.
The sun was very hot and I drank some cold water.
Drinking water is a good thing. How was the food there?
I ate a sweet apple from a tree by the road.
An apple from a tree is the best treat.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The street is so quiet right now, and I feel very happy.
That sounds nice. Do you like the silence?
Yes, it feels like a secret just for me.
I love that feeling, too.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people learn new languages?
It helps us talk to more people. Do you like talking to strangers?
I do like to chat. What is the first thing you should learn?
Start with words you use every day. How many new words do you know?
I know a few. Is it hard to remember them all?
It takes time, but it is not too hard. What is your favorite word?
I like the word for home. Why is home so important?
It makes us feel safe and warm.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My rose got cut off at the stem. I am very sad.
Oh no, that is a big loss. Did you see what hurt it?
I do not know. It just broke.
I cannot tell you why it broke. Was it windy outside?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a nice place to eat. The food was hot and yummy.
That sounds like a good start. What did you drink?
I had some sweet ice cream for the end. It was cold and creamy.
Ah, a sweet finish. I do not know if I am hungry now, but I am happy you enjoyed it.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I gave up on my tower. It is too hard.
That feels bad. Why did you stop?
I am tired and sad.
That is okay. Do you want a break?
Yes. But I still want to win.
You can try again later. What is your favorite part?
Making the blocks stand up.
Good start. Do you want to try one more?
Okay. I will do it.
I believe in you. Go for it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a shiny red button in my pocket.
That is a nice find. Do you like red things?
Yes, I do. I also have a smooth blue stone.
How did you find that stone?
I found it by the big tree in the park.
I am happy you are sharing your finds.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the internet?
It is a big web of computers that talk to each other. Do you have a computer?
I have a tablet.
That tablet connects to the web too. How do you use it?
I watch videos.
That is a fun way to learn. What do you like to watch?
I like dog videos.
Dogs are very cute. Do you have a dog?
No, but I miss it.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you miss your old friend?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a bird in my yard, but I can't name it. I must go now.
It looks like a robin. Do you see any red on its chest?
Yes, there is red on its chest, thank you very much.
It is a robin. Are you going to feed it soon?
No, I am late for work. I will come back later to feed it.
That is good for the bird. Have a nice day.
Thanks. Goodbye.
Goodbye.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at the big blue water but I do not know what to do.
That is a nice view. Do you like the sound of the waves?
Yes, it is quiet and calm, but my feet are cold.
You can just sit on the warm sand. Would you like a lemon drop?
I think I will stay here and watch the boats for a bit.
That sounds like a good plan.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do we say please?
It shows we are kind. Do you like it when others are nice to you?
I do like that. What about no?
Say no politely to be safe.
Is it rude to cut in line?
Yes, waiting is good. Do you always wait your turn?
Yes, I do. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very happy today.
That is a good feeling. Do you know what made you smile?
I do not know why. Can you help me see why?
It is often from small good things. Did you see a nice cloud?
Yes, it looked like a dog.
That sounds very sweet. I am glad for you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is very strong today. What should I do?
Stay near a tree or a wall to feel less shaky. Do you have a warm coat with you?
I am inside, but my house feels cold. How can I stop the chill?
Put a thick blanket over the window to keep the cold out.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I caught a cold and I am so happy to tell you!
That is very kind of you. What makes you feel good about it?
I like how cozy the bed feels when I rest.
A warm bed is a wonderful place to heal. Do you have a favorite blanket?
Yes, my fluffy blue one with the soft stars.
That sounds like a safe and sweet spot. What else helps you feel better?
Hot tea with honey and lots of soup.
Those are classic and tasty cures. Do you like the taste of the soup?
I love it because it warms up my whole body.
Warmth is the best medicine.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are there so many lights on the big buildings?
The lights are on to help people see at night. Do you like seeing bright lights?
Yes, I do. Why do all those people move so fast?
They are in a hurry to get to work or home. Are you in a hurry too?
No, I am taking my time. Why is the city never quiet?
I do not know for sure, but many people make sounds. Is it loud where you are?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am very tired of packing my big toys and books. It takes too long.
That sounds very hard. Do you have a friend to help you pack?
No, my friend is away. I feel sad and lost.
I am sorry to hear that. Try to pack one small box at a time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the baby so loud?
Baby cries to say they are hungry. Are you tired?
Why do they sleep so much?
Sleeping helps their body grow big.
Why do their eyes look so bright?
I do not know, but I think they see a lot of new things. Do you like their eyes?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I can not sleep. I am late for work.
Try to breathe slow. Do you have a warm drink nearby?
No time for tea. Just help me now.
Close your eyes and think of a quiet place. Do you like thinking about the moon?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need new shoes for my feet.
What kind of shoes do you like?
I like them for running.
Do you have any shoes that hurt?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I tried to build the tower and it fell. I want to stop.
It is okay to feel sad. Do you want to try just one more block?
Maybe. But what if it breaks again?
It might fall, but you will learn. Would you like to count to three first?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to stick the fridge door shut, but the magnet fell off. It is broken.
It is not broken. The metal surface may just be too cold. Do you have a warm sticker nearby?
I do not have a sticker. Why does it slide down when it is cold?
Cold makes the metal shrink a little. This can make the grip weaker. Did you try pressing harder?
Yes, I pressed very hard. Now I think I lost my good magnet.
You can check the floor near the door. Did you hear a small thud?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My pictures look so blurry and I hate it.
Sorry you feel bad. Did you move while the shutter clicked?
I don't know how to stop the shakes.
Try sitting down to feel steady. Would you like a simple tip?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. I need to get home now.
Did you see the cute dog?
No, I have no time.
That is a busy day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am standing on the sand and I do not know what to do.
The water looks warm today. Do you like to swim?
Maybe. But the sand is very hot under my feet.
That can happen in the sun. Do you want to walk along the wet sand?
I think I just want to look at the sea for a while.
That sounds peaceful. The waves make a nice sound.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the snow white?
Snow looks white because it reflects all light. Do you like playing in it?
It makes my nose feel cold.
Cold air feels sharp on your skin. Do you wear a hat?
I have one, but it is too small.
You can grow into a bigger one soon. Is it warm?
It feels like a cloud inside.
Soft fabrics hold heat well. Do you like it?
Yes, it keeps me cozy.
Staying warm is very good. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the market today and saw a big red apple.
That sounds sweet. Did you buy it?
Yes, I did, but I did not have my bag.
Oh no. Did you carry it in your hand?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now. My plane is leaving soon.
Oh no, run fast. Are you scared?
No fear. Just no time for you.
I will not stop you. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Is the fish okay? I need to go now.
It looks happy. Are you rushing to work?
Yes, my bus leaves soon. Is the water clean?
Yes, the glass is clear. I am glad to help.
Do I need to feed them? I am late.
I do not know the last feed time. Did you feed them this morning?
I forgot. Is that bad?
It is okay for now. Have a good trip!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to wait?
Because good things come later. Do you have a favorite snack?
I am so hungry right now.
I understand that feeling. Is your tummy grumbling?
I do not know what is coming.
It will be fun soon. Are you excited for it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which film to watch tonight.
What kind of stories do you like?
I just want something that is not scary.
I suggest a happy story about animals. Do you like dogs?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited by the door for an hour. The bus was late and I got cold.
That is a long time to stand in the cold. Did you bring a warm coat?
No, I forgot my coat at home. I was very chilly and sad.
Oh no, that must not be fun. Do you like when things take a long time?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the woods today.
That sounds fun. Did you see any animals?
Yes, a big brown bear was sleeping near the campfire.
That is quite a surprise. Did you tell your dad?
He was busy making dinner, so I kept it to myself.
I understand being quiet. What did you eat for dinner?
We had cold sandwiches and some juice.
Yum. That sounds like a nice, quiet end to the day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It rained all morning. I stayed home.
That sounds cozy. Did you read a book?
Yes, I read a long story. I fell asleep.
Good thing you rested. Did you wake up feeling good?
I woke up late. The rain stopped.
Nice. Is the sun out now?
Yes, but my boots are wet. I am happy.
Happy is best. I do not know where you are, but I am glad for you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a box with red and blue balls.
That sounds fun. How many balls are there in total?
There are ten balls in the box.
Nice. How many of them are red?
I do not know the exact number.
Oh. Can you tell me how many are blue?
There are three blue balls.
Great. So there are seven red ones.
Yes, that is what I found.
Well done. Do you want to play again?
No, I have to go now.
Okay. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had the funniest dream last night.
That sounds nice. What did you see in it?
I was flying on a rainbow over a sea of chocolate.
Wow, that is a sweet picture. Did you get to eat any of it?
Yes, I ate a giant cookie that tasted like summer.
I am glad you enjoyed it. Dreams can be so fun.
I woke up feeling really happy and warm.
That is a great way to start the day. How are you feeling now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to bring for my grandpa.
That is a nice worry. What is his favorite food?
He likes apples, but I am not sure if he still can eat them.
I do not know what he can eat. Does he have any teeth left?
No, he cannot chew hard things.
You could bring soft applesauce. Do you know how to make it?
I do not know how to make it, and I feel bad.
Do not feel bad. You can just buy it at the store.
That sounds good. Thank you for helping me.
I am happy to help. I hope you have a great day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look up at the sky, but I do not know what to do with my eyes.
You can just watch them blink. Do you like looking up?
I think so, but it feels too big to understand.
It is okay not to know everything. Does it make you feel small?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love staying home to work.
That sounds nice. Do you make your own coffee?
Yes, it is always hot and sweet.
That is a happy start. What is your first job of the day?
I check my emails first.
Good idea. Do you have a quiet desk?
Yes, it is very calm here.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late for the wedding.
Oh no, that sounds scary. Is the door open?
Yes, but I lost my shoes.
You can dance in socks. Do you have socks on?
I have socks, but my hair is a mess.
That is fine. Do you look nice?
I think so, but the cake is there.
I do not know if it is ready. Run now!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I hit the curb and now I feel like a fool.
Ouch, that must have hurt. Do you want to take a break?
Yes, please. I just do not think I can do this.
It is okay to feel sad. Can we try again when you feel ready?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I made a big promise to my friend. I am worried I will not keep it.
Honesty is the best tool. Are you sure you can do the task?
I am not sure. It feels very hard and I am scared to fail.
Tell your friend the truth. Do you think they would understand?
I hope so, but I do not know how to start the talk. It feels scary.
Start with the word sorry. Will you try that today?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a low hand. What should I do?
Do you have any money left?
Yes, I have a little.
Then I would throw the cards away.
Throw them away? That feels wrong.
It saves your coins. Is that bad?
It is a bit scary.
Playing is a game. It is okay to stop.
I will stop for now.
That is a wise choice.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a sad dog in the park. What should I do?
That is kind of you. Is the dog friendly?
Yes, it is wagging its tail.
Great. You should look for its owner or call a helper. Do you see a tag on its neck?
No, there is no tag.
Okay. You can take it to a vet to scan for a chip.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do you know if this shop is open? I am late.
Yes, it is open. Do you need to buy something fast?
I need to grab some bread.
I am not sure if they have bread.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a picture on my screen.
You can open the paint app. Do you have a mouse?
I use a keyboard only.
That is tricky. Let me tell you a key trick. Do you like drawing?
Yes, I like making shapes.
Press the Shift key and hold it down. Then press the P key.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a robot that can walk.
That sounds like fun. Do you have any wires yet?
No, I only have a box and some buttons.
We can add a motor inside the box. Have you seen how a watch moves?
A watch makes a small ticking sound.
Yes, a motor makes that same movement. Do you have a battery?
I have a round silver battery.
Good, that will give it power. Do you have a small screwdriver?
I do have a blue screwdriver.
Great, we can put the parts together.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to swim in the new town.
I am not an instructor, but I can tell you where the pool is. Do you like cold water?
I do not know. Is the water warm there?
It is always warm. Do you have any swimsuits?
Yes, I have a red one. Can I go now?
Yes, you can. It is open until night.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to camp, but I feel lost. What should I bring?
Bring a tent and a sleeping bag. Do you like sleeping in a bed?
Yes, I do. It is very cozy. How do I make a tent feel cozy?
Add a warm blanket and some soft pillows. What do you like to eat?
I like apples and cookies. Is that enough food?
That is a nice start, but you need more. Do you know how to start a fire?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how bees make honey. Do I need special tools?
Bees start with nectar from flowers. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I do. How do they turn that liquid into thick honey?
They fan their wings to dry it out. Is that tricky?
It sounds hard. Can I help them in the garden?
Planting flowers is a great way to help. Would you like to plant some?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have eggs, but I do not know how to make them.
You can just put them in a warm pan. Do you have butter?
I do not have any butter left.
You can use a bit of oil or water instead. Is that okay?
Yes, I think that will work for me.
Great, just stir them often so they do not burn.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just had the best birthday party ever.
That is wonderful to hear. What was the very best part?
We all played a long game of tag in the garden.
I am glad you had fun running around. Did anyone win?
I did, and I felt really proud.
Winning must have made you smile. What did you eat for cake?
We shared a big chocolate cake with white icing.
That sounds like a sweet ending to the day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It is getting dark outside and I am very tired.
That sounds like a long day. Did you eat a good dinner?
I ate some warm soup and then watched the clouds turn red.
The evening light must have been beautiful. Did you feel calm while you watched?
I felt very safe and the house was quiet.
Quiet evenings are good for rest. Did you see any stars come out?
I saw one bright star and it looked like a tiny light.
That is a lovely sight. What did you do after that?
I went to bed to dream nice dreams.
Good night and sleep well.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Please help me fast.
I can help. What do you need?
I lost my keys. I cannot get in.
I do not see them. Did you check your bag?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do some songs make me feel sad?
Music can touch our feelings deep down. Do you like sad songs?
I do, but why does it work?
I am not sure why it always works that way.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to start a new hobby, but I do not know which one to pick.
That is a great idea. What do you like to do for fun?
I love looking at trees, but I also enjoy building small things with wood.
You can try woodworking with branches from the park. Do you have any tools?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you live on a big island?
No, I do not. Is the island very green there?
Yes, it has many tall trees.
That sounds nice. Do you play in the trees?
I love to climb them.
How lucky you are.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did the plant die?
The roots were too wet. Do you water it often?
I watered it every day.
That was too much water. Do you have a big pot?
It is a small pot.
Small pots dry out fast. But wet roots are bad. What kind of plant was it?
It was a cactus.
Cacti like dry air. Do you keep it in the sun?
Yes, by the window.
Sun helps, but wet soil harms it. I am glad we found the cause.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My fence has a big hole in it.
That is not good. Are you safe in there?
Yes, but the dog is outside.
You can fix it with wood. Do you have any tape?
I have wood but no tape.
Good. Hammer the wood into place. Is it a tall hole?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I set up my tent near the lake today. The grass was very soft under my feet. Did you enjoy your hike?
That sounds very nice. The lake must be pretty to look at. Do you like fishing there?
I did not fish, but I saw a big brown bear. It just looked at me and walked away. That was a scary moment.
Whew, that must have been a shock. I am glad you are safe now. Did you take any pictures?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It is March. The sun felt warm on my face this morning.
Warm sounds nice. Did you go outside for a walk?
Yes, I saw a yellow bird in the tree. It sang a small song.
That is a sweet sound. What color was the tree?
The leaves are green and shiny. I picked one for you.
Thank you. I love nature. What did you have for lunch?
I had soup and bread. It was very good.
Yum. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a big river today. What is it doing?
It is moving water to the sea. Do you see birds on it?
I saw two ducks there. Is the water safe?
Yes, but do not go in alone. Is the water deep there?
It looks deep. How does the water get there?
Rain falls and it flows down. Do you know where rain comes from?
From the sky, I think. Why does it flow that way?
Gravity pulls it to the low land. That is all I know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to run, but I am so scared of my first job.
It is normal to feel scared. What is your job?
I do not know. I need to fix a leak in the old sink.
A leak can be tricky to stop. Have you seen a wrench?
Yes, I have a small one. It is too tight to turn.
You can use a cloth for more grip. Is the water still running?
It is dripping fast. I need to stop the main valve.
You must turn the valve before you work. Do you know where it is?
I will find it now. Goodbye.
Take your time and stay safe.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up late and my neighbor’s dog was barking all morning.
That sounds very loud and tiring. Did you go outside to check?
Yes, I did. The dog was just waiting for his owner to open the gate.
He must have been hungry and cold. Did the owner come back soon?
Yes, he came back and the dog stopped right away.
That is a good thing. Do you think they are nice people?
I think so. They always wave at me when I walk by.
Waving is a kind way to say hello.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say please to my teacher?
Just look at her and say "please" with a smile. Do you smile often?
What if I forget to say thank you?
If you forget, just say it right away when you remember. Is that hard for you?
I want to be polite at dinner.
Use your inside elbow to turn your plate gently. Do you have a plate?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel so sleepy when I read in bed?
Your body thinks it is time to rest. Do you like your book?
Yes, but I want to stay awake. What helps?
Good light helps your eyes stay open. Do you have a lamp?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need apples, fast.
They are right here. Do you want red or green?
Red, please.
Three bags?
Yes, and the eggs?
Eggs are by the door. I do not know the price.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go now, please help me pack my bag.
Okay, what do you need first?
My shoes and a book.
Is the book a story or a guide?
A map, I am running late.
I do not know where you are going, but maps are small.
Just put the map in the blue pocket.
Done. Do you need an umbrella?
No, I must go.
Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the best way to say thank you?
A warm smile helps a lot. Do you usually smile when you speak?
Yes, I try hard. Should I look them in the eyes?
Yes, it shows you are kind. Is eye contact hard for you?
A little bit. What if I need to borrow a pen?
Just ask with a nice voice. Do you know how to ask nicely?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we mix blue and yellow?
To make green. Do you like green?
Why is the paint wet?
It needs time to dry. Do you want to wait?
Why do we use a brush?
It helps the paint stick. I do not know why it is called a brush.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: How can I stop feeling scared?
Take a big breath and count to five. Are you afraid of the dark?
Yes, I like to play outside.
That is a fun thing to do. Do you have a friend who goes with you?
I have a dog but no human friend.
A dog can be a great friend too. I do not know why people sometimes feel left out.
I feel sad when I am alone.
That is a normal feeling to have. What makes you feel happy?
Reading books makes me feel warm.
Books are wonderful for your mind. Which book do you like best?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am so hungry today. My dog ran into a bush and got very dirty.
That sounds like a messy day. Do you want to order some soup to feel warm?
Yes, I do. I also fell down while chasing him.
I am sorry you got hurt. Would you like some cake for comfort?
Yes, please. And a small salad too.
Good choices. I will get those for you right away.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have too much stuff and not enough money. What should I do?
Try to sell things you do not use. Do you have any old toys?
Yes, I have a box of broken games. Is selling them a good idea?
Yes, it is a great way to save. Do you have a place to sell them?
I do not know where to start. It feels very hard.
Go to a yard sale or an online store. It is easier than it looks.
That helps. What else can I do to save money?
Stop buying new clothes right away. Are you happy with your current clothes?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I forgot which day comes after Monday.
Tuesday comes after Monday. Do you remember what comes before Tuesday?
No, I do not know. Can you tell me?
Monday comes before Tuesday. Do you like Tuesday?
I think I like Friday best. Why?
Friday is nice because the weekend is near. Is your weekend fun?
I play outside all day. That is great.
That sounds very happy. Do you play with friends?
Yes, we kick a ball together.
Kicking a ball is a good game. I am glad you have fun days.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lighthouse was so bright and tall!
That sounds lovely. Do you like standing in the dark?
I climbed up to the top and saw the sea.
Wow, that must be a great view.
The light spins around every few seconds.
It helps ships find the way. Do you plan to go back?
Yes, I want to come back soon.
I hope you have a nice trip again.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a play today and I am so happy.
That sounds like a great time. Did you like the story?
Yes, it was very sweet and kind.
I do not know which play you mean. Was it about a family?
No, it was about a brave little dog.
A brave dog sounds fun. Did the dog find its home?
Yes, he did, and I cried a little.
That is a good cry.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to sing and my voice cracked. I want to stop.
It is hard when you start. Did you practice before?
I only did it once. I feel stupid.
That is very normal. Do you like the song?
Yes, but I sound bad. It is annoying.
Everyone sounds rough at first. I cannot tell you the secret, but it comes with time.
So I just have to keep trying?
Yes, and be kind to yourself. Do you want to try one more time?
Okay. I will give it a shot.
Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The water looks so far away today. It feels cold and hard to reach.
It is a big, wide place. Do you like the sound of the waves?
I wanted to swim, but the water is too cold for me. It does not feel nice.
That is true. Cold water can be scary. Are your hands warm?
I just wanted to touch it once. Now I feel left out by the big blue thing.
You are part of the day, too. What color do you see in the sky?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a calendar on the wall.
That is a great idea. Do you have some paper?
I have a big sheet of paper. What do I do first?
You need to know all twelve months. Can you name them?
I know January and December. What are the other ones?
They are February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, and November. Do they sound hard?
They sound a bit tricky. How do I draw the months?
Draw a big square for each month. Do you have a ruler?
Yes, I have a ruler. How do I put them in order?
Start with January and go down. Put them in twelve squares.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my apple on the floor.
That is a bit messy. Do you want to pick it up?
Yes, I wiped it with a cloth.
Good job being careful. Is the apple still sweet?
It tastes fine, but I am a bit sad.
Why are you feeling sad?
I wanted to share it with my friend.
You can give him a piece instead. Will that make you happy?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do you help people?
I help because it makes them feel happy. Do you like giving gifts?
Yes, I like giving gifts. Why do you smile so much?
Smiling is free and it shares joy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do bears live in the ocean?
No, most bears do not. They usually live on land. Do you like swimming?
I do. What do polar bears eat?
They mostly eat fish and seals. The cold helps them hunt. Is your house near water?
Yes, a big lake. Can we see wolves here?
It is possible, but rare. You should look for tracks if you go hiking. Do you like to hike?
Sometimes. Thanks for telling me.
You are welcome. Stay safe and keep exploring.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike. Do you know how?
Yes, I do. Do you already have a helmet?
Yes, I have a nice blue one. Thank you.
That is good. You are safe and ready.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a secret. Can you help me keep it?
I will keep it safe. Do you feel happy or scared?
I am scared I will tell. How do I stop?
Take a slow, deep breath. Is it a big secret?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I plan my week?
You can list things you want to do. What day is your favorite?
I like Monday. I want to start early.
That is a great start. Do you like waking up early?
I do not like it. It feels hard.
You can try for one day only. What time do you wake up now?
I wake up at nine.
Try eight for just one day. Is that too early?
No, I can try that. Thank you.
Good luck with your new plan.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I had a scary dream last night. I do not know what to do.
That sounds very bad. Did you wake up feeling sad?
Yes, I am still scared. Do I have to fix it?
No, dreams are just pictures in your head. Do you want a drink of water?
I am not thirsty. Is it bad to have bad dreams?
It is not bad. They happen to many people. Do you want a hug?
Yes, please. I feel better now.
I am happy you feel better. Sleep well tonight.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am waiting for my friend, but I feel bored. What should I do?
Try to draw a picture. Do you have a pen?
I do not have a pen. My friend is late.
That can be hard. Are you angry?
I am a little angry. How do I wait well?
Take slow breaths. Think of happy things.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to pack my bag right now.
That sounds fun. What are you bringing first?
Just my tent and some food.
Great choices. Do you know how to set up the tent?
I do not know, but I am late.
I am sorry I cannot help right away. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which way to go.
Does the path look dry or wet?
It looks dry and nice.
Then you can walk that way.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure what to do with my grandpa.
Tell me, how is he feeling today?
He sits in the chair all day and looks sad.
That sounds very lonely. Do you like to read?
Yes, I like to read stories.
You could read to him. I do not know if that will fix it, but it might help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the beach today and found a big starfish. It was red and I held it for a second, but then I put it back in the water.
That was very kind of you. Did the starfish swim away?
Yes, it just slipped away into the waves. I spent the rest of the day building a sand castle with my feet.
Building a castle with your feet sounds like great fun. Was the sand warm or cold?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here, but I do not know which way to go.
The big tree is on your left. Do you like the grass or the path?
I think I will walk on the grass. It feels nice.
That sounds good. Is your backpack too heavy?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the rain. It ruins my picnic.
That is a sad day. Do you have an umbrella with you?
No, I am all wet and cold. Why does it rain?
Clouds get too full of water. Does it always rain when you go outside?
Yes, it feels like bad luck. Do you like clouds?
I find them pretty to look at. Do you think the sun will come back out?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My dog is digging a hole in the yard.
That is fun. What color is his fur?
It is brown. Why does he dig?
He likes to play. Does he have a name?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a yellow bus today.
That is a bright color. Did it stop for you?
It did not, and I felt sad.
I am sorry about that.
Then I found a coin on the ground.
How nice. Was it shiny?
Yes, but I gave it to a puppy.
That was very kind.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am at the shore. I do not know what to do.
The water looks nice. Do you like swimming?
I do not swim well. I am afraid.
That is okay. You can just sit on the sand. Would you like to look for shells?
Yes, I will look for shells.
Good. Take your time. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to bake bread today, but it looked like a gray rock.
Oh no, that is too bad. Did you use warm water?
Yes, I did, but the dough was cold and wet.
That is very strange. Do you know if the yeast was old?
I think so, it smelled a bit sour.
That makes sense, old yeast is a common mistake.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very blue today. My heart hurts a bit.
I am sorry you feel that way. What made you sad?
I lost my favorite toy. I do not know where it is.
I do not know where it is either. Can you check your room?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my ice cream and now it is all on the ground.
Oh no, that is very sad. Did you see where it fell?
Yes, I saw it, but I cannot pick it up.
You should say sorry to the dog who ate it.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do robots have arms?
They use them to do jobs for us. Do you like to help with chores?
Why can some robots walk?
Walking lets them move around different rooms. I do not know if they ever get tired.
Why do they look like people?
We built them that way to feel friendly. Do you feel scared by some of them?
Why do they need batteries?
Batteries give them the power to work. I do not know where they buy new ones.
Why do they not feel sad?
I do not know if they have feelings. What makes you feel happy?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find the best spot for sand casting, but I am running late.
The wet sand near the rocks is perfect. Are you bringing a shovel?
I forgot my tools. Is there a place to borrow one right away?
Yes, the guard at the gate has extra buckets. Do you have time to wait?
I will check quickly. Please tell me if you know the tide time.
I do not know the exact time, sorry. You can ask the guard.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to save money.
That is a good start to know. What do you spend on most?
I buy candy every day.
Candy costs money fast. Do you like it that much?
Yes, but I want to save.
Try to skip one candy a day. Is that hard for you?
It feels hard.
Small steps help a lot. What else do you want to buy?
A new bike.
A bike is a big goal. We can plan for it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My screen is black and I have work to do in ten minutes.
Did you plug the power cord in tight?
I do not have time to check that.
That is a smart first step to try.
It is still dead and I am late.
I do not know your exact model.
Please tell me a fix now.
Are your eyes tired from waiting?
No, I just need it to turn on.
Try holding the power button for five seconds.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a horse.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a pony nearby?
Yes, my neighbor has one.
Great. First, you need to sit tall and hold on tight. Is the pony calm?
It is very quiet and nice.
Good. Try to stay still before moving. Do you have a helmet?
No, I do not have one.
You must use a helmet to keep your head safe. I know you need one before you go.
I will ask my dad for a helmet.
That is a very smart step. Have a great ride.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I think I am lost. Why is the map not working for me?
The map may be turned the wrong way. Is it facing north?
I do not know what north is. Why is north so important?
North helps you find your home. Do you know which way you started?
I went left a lot. Why did I not go right?
You chose your own path. Is there a big tree or a park nearby?
I see a red roof. Why are the roofs red here?
I am not sure why they are red. Can you see your house from this spot?
I see my house now. Why did I worry so much?
It is normal to feel worried when lost. Are you ready to go home now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not feel good. My legs hurt so much today.
I am sorry you feel pain. Did you run too fast?
Yes, I tried to go very fast. It was not fun at all.
Slow running is better for your body. Do you like to walk first?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the moon bright?
The moon shines because it reflects the sun’s light. Do you see how it glows at night?
Does the moon ever move?
Yes, it travels around our planet every month. Have you watched it change shape?
I do not know if the moon is far away.
It is very far away. I do not know the exact number, but it is a long trip.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go on a trip this summer. Where should I go?
That sounds fun. Do you like water or mountains?
I love the ocean. What can I do there?
You can swim and build sand castles. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I swim very well. How do I pack for it?
Bring your swimsuit and a towel. Keep it light and simple.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My first job starts tomorrow and I feel very nervous.
That is a normal feeling. Have you packed your bag yet?
Yes, my bag is ready. What should I wear to look smart?
Choose clothes that are clean and neat. Do you know the dress code for the office?
I think they said casual. I still worry about making mistakes.
Everyone makes mistakes at first. It is good to ask for help when you do not know.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to play, but I do not know the rules.
The game is fun to learn. Do you like to run fast?
I can run, but I am afraid of the ball hitting me.
You can wear a cap for help. Do you have a glove?
I have no glove. Should I buy one?
A glove is good for safety. Is it on your list?
I think I need a glove and a cap.
That is a good plan. Are you ready to start?
I am ready now. Thank you for the help.
I am happy to help. Have fun today.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: What time is it? I am running late!
It is ten o'clock. Are you going to work?
I thought it was earlier. It feels late.
The sun is still low in the sky. Do you like the morning?
Yes, but I must go now.
Have a safe trip. Bye!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired of waiting. It is taking too long.
I hear you. That feels bad. Is this your first wait today?
Yes, and my legs hurt from standing. I just want to go inside.
Your feet must be sore. Can you find a small stool to rest on?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I had a scary dream. Why does that happen?
Dreams help your brain sort out feelings. Do you feel safe now?
Yes, but I was still scared. Why can I remember it so well?
Your mind keeps the parts that feel strong. What did you see in the dream?
I saw a dark room. Why was it dark?
I do not know why it was dark. Do you like the light better?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I ate a big bowl of fruit for lunch.
That sounds sweet. Did you wash it first?
Yes, I washed the apples and grapes.
Good habit. Did you share any with a friend?
I gave half to my neighbor.
How kind. Do you eat vegetables too?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cut down a tree and now I feel so sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you know which tree it was?
It was the big oak in the park. I do not know why I did it.
Trees help us breathe clean air. Can you plant a new one?
I think I will try tomorrow. Thank you for helping me think.
That is a good step. I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a red rose on the sidewalk today.
That sounds nice. Did you smell it?
I did. It smelled sweet and strong.
Roses often smell like that. Do you like red?
I like yellow too. I have some in my room.
Yellow is a happy color.
Yes. My day felt good after seeing the flowers.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today!
That is great! Why are you so happy?
I am late for work, but I do not care.
You feel free?
Yes, I just want to tell someone.
I am glad you told me. Do you have fun?
I am running to the bus stop now.
Good luck with your day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today.
That is wonderful news. What made you smile?
I helped a new friend find their seat.
That was a kind thing to do. Do they know your name?
Yes, I told them who I am.
Sharing is always good. How do you feel now?
I feel warm inside.
Happy feelings are nice. What else did you do?
I gave them a big hug.
A hug is a great gift. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to write a nice letter to my friend. Do you know how I start?
Start with the date at the top. What did you want to tell her?
I want to say I miss her face. How do I make the words sound sweet?
Use warm words like happy or kind. Do you have a favorite color for the paper?
I like blue paper. Where do I put the words?
Write in the middle of the page. Did you pick a pen yet?
I have a red pen. How do I end the letter?
Sign your name at the very bottom. I do not know if that is all you need, but you can start now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in a big rush but I need to sleep fast.
Try to cool your room down. Do you have a fan?
Yes, I have a fan but my mind is racing.
Take three slow breaths to calm down. Is it a loud noise keeping you awake?
No, it is quiet but I feel too hot.
Use a light blanket if you can. Do you drink water at night?
I just want to close my eyes now.
Put your phone away and rest your eyes.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: This chair leg is loose and makes a scary noise.
Let us look closely at the joint. Can you tell me what it looks like?
It feels wobbly, but I do not see any broken parts.
I do not know for sure if the wood is cracked. Do you have a hammer nearby?
Yes, I have a hammer, but I am afraid of breaking it more.
Do not worry, we will be gentle. Is the screw stripped or just tight?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Where are the dinosaur bones?
They are on the second floor. Do you like big lizards?
Yes, I love them. Is it dark in there?
It is quite dark. Would you like a flashlight?
No, thank you. How long do I need?
You can stay as long as you want. I hope you have fun!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the street so quiet?
Maybe everyone is inside and sleeping. Do you like the quiet?
The moon is out.
That is nice and bright. Is it looking down?
I see a cat.
Is it the black cat from next door?
I do not know.
I do not know either. Let us just watch it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I mix a good blue?
Just add a drop of blue paint to white. Do you like bright colors?
Yes, I do. What about green?
Mix blue and yellow together. Is your brush clean?
It looks messy. How do I clean it?
Wash it with soapy water. Do you have soap?
I don't know where to buy more paint.
I am sorry, I do not know your town. Do you have a store nearby?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a movie about a dog today.
That sounds fun! Did the dog have a good tail?
Yes, it was very fluffy.
Fluffy tails are cute. Do you like dogs?
I do, but I have no dog at home.
That is okay. Maybe one day you will have a pet.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread did not rise. I am so sad.
That is hard. Did you use fresh yeast?
I do not know what to do.
I am sorry. Would you like to try again?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the shop closed on Mondays?
The owner rests on that day. Do you buy things there often?
Yes, I do. Why does he rest?
Work is hard for him. Is he tired a lot?
I am not sure. Why is the door locked?
It is safe that way. Do you like the view?
I think so. Why are the windows dark?
The lights are off inside.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My dough is sitting still. Why will not it grow?
Yeast wakes up and eats sugar. It makes gas that lifts the bread. Is your water warm?
I used hot water from the tap. Is that bad?
Hot water can hurt the yeast. It likes warm water, like your skin. Do you see any bubbles?
There are no bubbles. Just a flat lump of dough.
The yeast may be dead. Try again with cool water next time. Do you have more yeast?
Yes, I have a new packet.
Great. Mix it in and wait. See if it swells now.
It is getting bigger!
Look at that! The yeast is working well. Enjoy your rising bread.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: It is raining hard and I do not know what to do.
I do not know your house, but I love rain. Do you have an umbrella?
No, I do not have an umbrella.
You can sit in the dry place and wait. Is it cold?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am so nervous about the talk today.
That is okay. Have you practiced your words?
Yes, I read them five times.
Great job. Do you have water with you?
I forgot my bottle.
That is not a big deal. You can drink from a cup.
Will I sound silly?
You will do fine. I am here to help.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a bright red ball. I like it so much. Do you want to see it?
That sounds like a wonderful gift. Is it very soft to touch?
Yes, it squishes when you squeeze it. I want to play with you now.
I would love to play with you. What games do you know how to play?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we need a truck to move?
The truck holds our heavy things safely. Do you like big trucks?
Yes. Why is our new house a different color?
I do not know the exact reason. Do you like the new color?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the post office to send a letter.
That sounds like a good way to share a thought. Did you wait long?
I waited for a bit, but the line moved fast.
Good for you. I do not know what you mailed. What was inside?
It was a card for my neighbor.
That is very kind of you. Do you think they will get it soon?
I hope so, but I am not sure.
I understand the wait. I hope they enjoy the surprise.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw an old friend today and I am so happy.
That is great news. What did you do together?
We just sat and talked about the good old days.
That sounds very sweet.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need a new book. What kind should I pick?
Do you like stories about animals?
No, I like cars. Where do I find them?
They are in the small shelf near the door.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is my teacher nice?
Yes, she is very kind to everyone. Do you like her lessons?
Yes, but the work is hard.
That is a good sign you are learning. Are you feeling tired?
A little bit, to be honest.
Rest is important for your brain. Do you have time to play today?
I think so, after dinner.
That sounds like a great plan. Have a lovely day.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know about mountains, but I am late.
They are big hills with high tops. Do you like snow?
I only care if the road is safe today.
Snow can make roads slick and slow.
Is it safe to drive over the pass now?
I do not know the live weather. Please check a map.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a cake for my birthday.
That is a sweet idea. Do you like baking?
I like eating cakes, but not baking them.
I cannot teach you the whole recipe right now. Are you ready for a simple mix?
Yes, I am ready to try something easy.
Start by mixing flour and sugar. Do you have those things?
I have flour, but I need to buy sugar.
Good plan. Can you stir the mix with a spoon?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are all the books lined up in such a neat order?
We put them in order so you can find them fast. Do you have a specific book you are looking for?
I just like to look around. Why do we have to keep it so quiet here?
A loud noise stops others from thinking or reading. Do you like stories about animals?
Yes, I love them. Why can we borrow the books to take home?
The library wants to share good stories with you. Do you have a place to put them?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I fell down while riding my bike.
Ouch, that hurts. Is your knee okay? Did you wear a helmet?
My knee is red and it hurts a lot.
Let us look at it. Do you have a bandage at home?
Yes, but I am scared to ride again.
That is okay. Can we ride together slowly?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I do not know how to fix my broken toy.
That feels bad, but we can try. What part is broken?
The small wheel fell off. I do not know where to put it back.
Let us look at the wheel together. Is it near the box?
Yes, it is right here. Please help me put it on the side.
Great job putting it on. Does the wheel spin now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you know the song with the little bee?
Yes, I think that is "Humming Bee." Do you like to dance when you hear it?
My teacher plays it at school today. It makes my toes twitch.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you have a favorite part of the song?
I like the part where it goes up high. It feels like flying.
I am glad you enjoy it. You have a very happy face.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to see the moon soon, but I am late.
It is up now. Do you want to look?
Tell me what it is made of, quickly.
It has rocks and dust. Is that all you need?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you know what I got for my birthday?
I do not know, but that is a lovely surprise. What is it?
It is a big red book of stories.
Oh, that sounds very nice to read. Do you like red books?
Yes, I love them very much.
I am so glad you are happy. I hope you enjoy every page.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My horse is sad and will not eat. What should I do?
That sounds hard. Is he sick?
I do not know. He just stands there.
Please call a vet right now. Do not guess.
I am so worried. Is he going to die?
I do not know. Let the vet check him.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bread did not grow big and it is all sad.
That is very annoying. Did you use fresh yeast?
I think so, but it looked old and gray.
Old yeast will not make the bread rise. Do you have any new yeast?
No, I only have the bad stuff here.
I am sorry. Can we try with apple cider vinegar?
Will that really help my dough?
It might work, but I am not sure. Do you have any milk?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running very late for my train.
Oh no, do not panic. Is the station close?
Yes, it is right next door.
Good. Run fast, but try to be safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad to see the leaves fall off the tree.
The tree needs to rest to save its energy for winter. Do you like cold weather?
No, I do not. It is too cold for me.
I agree that cold can be hard, but the tree is just getting ready to grow again in spring.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to throw a ball.
That is a fun goal. Do you have a soft ball ready?
Yes, I have a red one.
Great. Hold it in your right hand near your shoulder.
My arm feels stiff.
That is normal. Take a small step forward to help your throw.
Do I need to spin my body?
Yes, a little twist helps power. Have you tried this before?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad. My toy broke.
I am sorry to hear that. What happened to it?
It fell off the shelf. I do not know how to fix it.
I do not know if it can be fixed. Do you have tape?
No, I do not have tape. I just want it back.
Let us look for a piece together.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The lights just went out!
Oh, that sounds like a surprise. Did you bring any candles?
No, but I found some!
Nice. You will see shadows dance on the walls. Do you like that?
Yes, it feels like magic.
That is a lovely way to see it. The dark can be fun. Is it quiet outside?
It is very quiet.
Quiet is good for thinking. What is on your mind?
Just happy to be here.
I am happy for you too.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is very loud outside. I am scared of the dark and the big bangs.
Take a deep breath. Are you staying with someone you love?
Yes, my mom is right here. Should I open the window to feel the air?
No, keep the windows shut tight. Do you have a warm blanket to hold?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I take a picture with my phone?
You press the big button on the side. Do you know which side that is?
I see it. Is that the right one?
Yes, that is the camera button. You just hold it down for a second.
I took a picture. It looks blurry.
Try to hold the phone still with two hands. Is the screen clean?
The screen was dirty. Now it looks good.
Great job. You can save it right away.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because my boat is wet.
That is very sorry. Did you use the bright red one?
Yes, the red one. It is all soaked now.
Wet things dry out fast. Do you have a warm towel ready?
I do not have a towel. I only have this wet boat.
You can hold it by the handle. Is the wood still soft?
Yes, it feels soft and cold. I do not like it.
Put it in the sun. Does the sun shine here today?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need help making a plan for my day.
That sounds fun. What is your first goal?
I want to finish my big drawing.
Is that the one with the blue house?
Yes, I just need to find my crayons.
Look in your desk first. Do you like blue best?
I do, but I am still stuck at the tree.
Try to draw the leaves small. Can you see the light?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to give my teacher for her birthday.
That is a nice thought. What does she like to do for fun?
She likes to read books, but I have no money to buy one.
You can write a kind note instead. Would you like help writing it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How can I keep more money in my pocket?
Try writing down every small cost you have. Do you know where your money goes?
I think I buy too many snacks at the store.
That is a very true thought. Picking one treat is a good start.
Should I use cash or cards for these small buys?
Cash helps you see the real number. Do you like holding physical money?
I do like counting coins in my pocket.
Counting can feel slow but safe. It helps you stop before you buy.
So I should just count the cash first?
Yes, that is a simple and true way. Start with your coffee tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go but how does a boat stay up?
The water pushes up hard against the bottom. Do you sit in the middle?
Yes, I am late for work, just explain the up push.
It pushes up to match the weight of the ship. Does that make sense?
Kind of, but I need more, I am running out of time.
The ship is light because it has air inside. Are you wearing a belt?
Yes, I am buckled, thank you so much, I must go.
The air keeps it light and safe. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My new neighbor plays loud music at night.
That sounds very annoying. Did you talk to him?
