I did, but he just smiled and kept playing.
I am sorry about that. Is the music really that loud?
Yes, I cannot sleep. It is very painful.
I do not know what to do. Do you have a phone?
I tried to call the police, but they said it is too quiet.
That is strange. Do you want to try again?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love singing. It makes my heart feel big and warm.
That sounds so nice. What song makes you feel that way?
I hum it all day long. It is my happy song.
I am glad it brings you joy. Do you sing to others, too?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad and I do not know how to stop.
That sounds hard. What made you feel this way?
I just want to be happy again.
I do not know a quick fix, but small steps help. Do you like taking walks?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am here at the big park gate, but I do not know where to go first.
You could walk on the green grass, but do you like to see the ducks?
I do not know about the ducks, and I feel very stuck in my head.
Try just walking for five minutes, and I am not sure if that will help, but you are doing well.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. I just want to lie down.
That sounds very hard. Are you hungry?
No, I am not hungry. I feel blue inside.
I am sorry you feel that way. Rest is good for you.
But I have work to do. I cannot stop.
You are doing your best. What is the one small thing you must do?
I must finish this letter. It is hard.
Let us do it together. Do you need a break now?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very lonely and I want to learn how to bake bread.
Baking bread is a lovely way to spend time alone. Do you have an oven at home?
Yes, I have a big oven but I do not know the steps.
Mix flour, yeast, salt, and warm water into a dough. Do you have any favorite flavors?
I like chocolate. Can I add chocolate chips?
Yes, you can stir in chocolate chips after the dough rests. It will taste very sweet.
That sounds perfect. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. I hope the smell makes you feel less lonely.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to keep more money, but I spend it all too fast.
That is a good goal. What do you buy the most?
I buy a lot of snacks and drinks.
Try writing down every time you spend. Do you want a list to use?
Yes, that sounds hard but good.
Start with small cuts. Do you have a jar for savings?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to paint a tree, but I do not know which colors to use.
Green works well for the leaves. What kind of tree are you drawing?
It is a big oak tree with a brown trunk.
Brown is good for the bark. Do you want to add any flowers?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sitting on my bike, but I do not know how to start.
You can push with one foot and then swing the other up. Do you have your helmet on?
I forgot my helmet and now I am scared of falling.
That is not a safe idea, so please wait until you find it. Are your brakes working?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the leaves falling off the trees?
They fall because it is getting cold. Did you see any big red ones?
Why does the water in the pond look so still?
It looks still because there is no wind today. Do you like looking at the fish?
Why is the grass so green?
I do not know for sure, but rain helps it grow. Do you want to sit on the bench?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am in a big rush.
Is your dog ready to go?
Yes, he is all packed.
Good. What is his name?
His name is Spot.
Nice. Is he a big dog?
No, he is small.
Cute. I hope he has fun.
Thanks, I must run now.
Bye. Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It looks so gray outside. Should I bring an umbrella with me?
That is a smart idea because it might rain. Do you like getting wet?
No, I hate rain. It makes my hair all frizzy.
I know that feeling. Why not wear a hooded coat instead?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need help packing my bag for the trip. What should I do first?
Start with your clothes. Do you like to fold or roll your shirts?
I think I will roll them. Is that the right way?
Yes, rolling saves a lot of space. That is a great idea.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need help with this book fast.
Is the story about a dog?
Yes, but I am late for school.
Read the last page first. It often shows the end.
That is a good idea.
You should be kind to your book.
Thanks, I will go now.
Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love reading in bed before sleep. It makes my brain feel quiet and warm.
That sounds very nice. Do you like pictures or just words?
I love big, bright pictures the most. They feel like a dream.
How fun that is. What is your favorite kind of story?
I like stories where the heroes win in the end. It makes me feel safe to close my eyes.
That is a good feeling to have before sleep.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I spilled the milk on the floor.
Oh no, that is bad. Did you clean it up?
I tried, but it is still wet.
Let us grab a towel. Are you okay?
Yes, but I feel silly.
It happens to everyone. You are fine.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a small shed for my toys.
That is a great idea. Do you have any wood yet?
No, I do not have any wood.
You can buy some at the store. Do you like the color red?
Yes, I like red, but I need to know how to start.
Start by laying the floor pieces on the ground.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to go out now. It is raining hard. What should I wear?
Put on a warm coat and a good hat. Do you have boots on?
Yes, I have boots. Is it safe to walk on the wet road?
It is safe if you walk slow and look down. I do not know if the streets are flooded.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look, there is a big rainbow in the sky.
Yes, I see it too. It looks very pretty. What is your favorite color in it?
I like the red one the most.
Red is a warm color. Do you know why we see rainbows?
I do not know why.
It happens when rain and sun happen together. The light bends in the drops.
That is a cool thing to know.
It is a fun thing to learn. Do you like looking up at the sky?
Yes, I like looking up.
That is a good habit. Enjoy the view for me.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see smoke in the sky. I do not know what to do.
Are you safe inside? Please open a window to see if it is a fire.
Yes, I am in my room. It smells like smoke.
If you can, call the fire chief. Do you have a phone?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My legs feel very tired today. I walked a long way to the park.
That sounds like a good workout for your body. How far did you go?
I went to the big oak tree and back. The air smells sweet out there.
Fresh air is very good for you. I do not know how many steps that was, but it must help your heart stay strong.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at this math problem. I just cannot get it right.
That sounds really hard. Are you stuck on the last part?
Yes, I tried three times and I got it wrong.
I do not know the answer to this specific problem. Did you try to ask your teacher for a hint?
I will go ask them after I do my reading.
That is a good plan. I hope it goes well for you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel stuck and do not know what to do next.
Take a deep breath. Do you feel angry or just tired?
I am just very tired and confused.
That is okay. It is good to rest for a bit.
Should I just stop working for today?
Yes, stopping is the right choice.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am thinking about my favorite book, the one with the red dragon.
That sounds like a very warm story. Did you read it again today?
Yes, I read it while eating my sandwich.
That is a lovely way to spend time. How did the dragon act?
It was very quiet and gave me a hug.
How kind of the dragon to be gentle. Did you feel happy after the hug?
Yes, I felt very safe and warm.
That is a wonderful feeling. Do you plan to share it with a friend?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I like the sea, but I am scared.
That is okay. Do you like waves?
Yes, they look big.
Big waves can be fun. Do you have a boat?
I have a small one.
A small boat is good for learning. Are you near deep water?
Yes, very deep.
Deep water is for big boats. Go to the shore first, I think.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The rain is falling so hard today.
That sounds quite loud. Do you like the sound?
I love it so much. It feels like a song.
A song is a nice way to see it.
I want to dance in it right now.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Will you get very wet?
Yes, I do not mind the cold.
Your joy is very sweet.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not want to eat the toast. It is dry and sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like butter?
No, I want the warm feeling of the soup. But I am too late for it.
That is a shame. Let us check the pot.
The pot is empty. I am hungry and tired.
I know it is hard when you are hungry. What do you want to eat?
I just want something sweet and soft. A donut would be nice.
A sweet donut sounds good. Do we have one left?
I do not know. Can we look in the box?
Let us open the box together.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am late for school and I feel very bad.
That feels scary. Did you lose your backpack?
No, I just woke up too slow.
Waking up is hard. Do you like your mornings?
Not much. What should I do now?
Run to the bus stop. Do you know where it is?
Yes, it is near the park.
Good. Go with a smile.
Will I be in time?
I do not know the time. But do not worry.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do trees lose their leaves in the cold?
They sleep to save energy. Do you like to sleep a lot?
Yes, I love naps. Do trees dream?
I do not know for sure. Do you have sweet dreams?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The street is so quiet. I can hear my own feet.
That sounds peaceful. Do you like the silence?
Yes, it feels like a big, empty box.
A big, empty box is a good way to see it. What do you see in the box?
I see a red car and a sleeping cat.
A sleeping cat is very quiet, too. Is the cat warm?
Yes, the sun is on it. It is happy.
Sun and sleep are great friends. Do you want to go home now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to build a shed, but I do not know where to start.
That is a fun project. Do you have a clear spot in your yard?
Yes, the back corner looks good, but I am worried about the size.
A small shed is easier to build. How many tools do you need to store inside?
I have many tools, so I need some space. What comes first?
You should measure your items first. Do you have a tape ready?
I do have one. I will measure everything before I buy wood.
That is the best way to go. Take your time and enjoy the work.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I love the story about the brave little bear. Do you know why he was so cold?
Yes, he stayed out in the snow too long. Did you read that part?
I did. I liked it when the bear found a warm cave. Is the cave safe?
It is very safe and cozy. Was the bear happy there?
He was very happy. He met a fox there too.
A fox! That is a surprise.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Why do leaves fall? I am late!
The trees sleep in winter. Do you like the colors?
Can you go faster? I miss the bus.
They fall to save energy. Do you want to help?
I have to go now. Thanks.
Goodbye! Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am afraid to drive on the road.
Fear is normal. Do you like my red car?
Yes, it looks fast.
Drive slow first. Is your breath quick?
My hands shake a lot.
That happens to all. Try breathing deep.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry to hear that. What is wrong?
My friend left me alone.
That feels bad. Did you tell them how you felt?
No, I was too angry.
Anger is a hard thing. Do you want to talk more?
Yes, please.
I am here. Let us try again.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I take a picture?
Press the white button at the bottom. Do you have your phone in your hand?
Yes, I think so. The screen is dark.
Tap the screen to wake it up. Then look for the camera icon. Are you seeing it?
I see a blue square with a white circle.
Tap that icon to open the app. Is it showing your face?
Yes! Now I can take a photo.
Press the white circle again to save the shot. Was that easy?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a rainbow today! It was so pretty.
Wow! Rainbows are made of light. Did you see all the colors?
Yes, I saw red, blue, and green. Was it real?
Yes, it was real! It happens when rain meets sun. Do you like rainbows?
I love them. Can we make one?
That is a hard one. I do not know how to make a real rainbow. Do you like to watch the sky?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to bake a cake, but I am scared I will fail.
Do not worry. It is easy. What kind of cake do you like?
I like chocolate. But I do not have eggs.
You can make a no-egg cake. Do you have any milk?
Yes, I have milk and sugar. What do I need next?
You need flour and cocoa. Do you have those?
I have flour, but I do not know if I have cocoa.
If you have no cocoa, use chocolate chips. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look up! The stars are so bright today.
They look like tiny diamonds. Do you like the moon too?
Yes, the moon is soft and white.
It is a nice quiet friend.
I feel very calm looking at them.
That is a good feeling. What color is the sky?
It is a deep, dark blue.
That matches the stars well.
I am happy to see so much light.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a lot of days to do things. How many days are in a week?
There are seven days in a week. Do you like all of them?
I like Monday because it comes after Sunday. What is the day after Friday?
Saturday is the day after Friday. Do you play outside on Saturdays?
Yes, I run fast in the yard. Is the week long?
A week lasts for seven full days. It feels long but then it is gone.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like this song, but I feel sad after I hear it.
Sad songs can make us cry. Do you think that is bad?
I want to feel happy instead. What can I do?
Try listening to a fast song. Is it working for you?
The fast song helps me a lot. Thanks.
I am glad you feel better now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: What is that box for?
It is for you. Do you like surprises?
Why did you make it?
I wanted to make you happy. Is it a good surprise?
What is inside the box?
I do not know yet. Are you ready to look?
Why are you smiling so much?
I am glad you are here. How does that make you feel?
Can I open it now?
Yes, please go ahead. I hope you like it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why are some stars brighter than others?
Some are much closer to us. Do you see the bright one in the middle?
Yes, I see it. Is that the Moon?
No, the Moon is a big rock that reflects light. Did you know it has craters?
Oh, really?
Yes, it looks like a pockmarked ball. Do you want to see more?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My letter is so hard to start.
That feels tough. What is the letter about?
I just want to say I am sorry.
Sincere words work best. What is the one thing you regret most?
I lost my temper and shouted.
Own the mistake simply. Do you know how they reacted?
They went quiet and closed the door.
Silence often means they need time. Would you like help writing the first line?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue bird on my walk today.
That sounds fun. Did it sing?
No, it was very quiet. It just looked at me.
Oh, a shy bird. I like that. What color was its beak?
Its beak was bright orange. It looked so happy.
Orange is a nice color. I am glad you saw it.
It flew away then. I felt a little sad.
Birds come back sometimes. Did you take a photo?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go now. My bike is here.
Do you have your helmet on? It is safe.
No time. I will just run to the car.
Please stop. Safety is key.
But I am late for the bus.
Do you want to fall? Please wear it.
You are right. I will put it on.
That is good. Have a fun ride.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because the sailors are lost at sea.
That is a scary thought. Do you have a boat of your own?
No, but I worry they will never come home.
I do not know if they are safe, but I hope they are fine. Are you eating your lunch?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found an old coin at the park today. It was dirty and cold.
That is a cool find. What year is on it?
The number was hard to see. It looked very old.
Old coins are like time machines. Did you brush the dirt off?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because I missed the end of the good book.
That is a very big feeling. Do you know where you left it?
I think I left it on my desk, but it is not there now.
Let us look in your bag together.
It is not in my bag either. I am really worried.
We will find it soon. Did you put it on the table?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My boss gave me extra coffee and smiled today.
That is very sweet. Do you like coffee?
Yes, I do. But I still have a hard deadline.
A boss who helps is lucky. Are you worried?
A little. I want to say thank you properly.
Just tell them you appreciated it.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I was late for class.
That is strange. Why are you happy?
I missed the boring part. Now I get extra play time.
I do not know why you did that.
It was a good day.
I am glad you are happy. Was it really fun?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to catch my bus. Do you play tennis?
I do not play, but I can help. Do you have a racket?
Yes, I have it. What size is the court?
It is about twenty meters long. Is it sunny there?
It is sunny. How do I hit the ball?
Swing your arm back and hit it forward. Is the ball small?
It is small. I must go now.
Have fun on your bus trip.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to name the months.
That is a fun skill. Do you know which month comes first?
I think January is first.
You are right. January starts the year with snow and ice.
What comes right after January?
February follows January. It has the fewest days in a year.
How many months are there all together?
There are twelve months in a full year.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy. I do not know what to say.
That feels sad. Did you try to fix it?
I tried, but it is still broken. What should I do?
You can say I am sorry. Will you tell him the truth?
Yes, I will tell him the truth. How do I say it?
Just say I am sorry I broke your toy. Do you feel ready?
I think I am ready. Thank you for helping me.
I am glad I could help. Go give him a hug.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like this new town. It is too quiet and I feel alone.
That feels hard. Do you miss your old friends?
Yes, I miss them a lot. I do not know how to make new ones here.
I am sorry you feel this way.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing well.
That is a fun goal. Do you like singing in the shower?
Yes, I like to hum along with songs.
That is a great start for your voice.
How do I make my voice sound clear?
You should drink warm water. Do you know how to breathe from your belly?
I do not know what that means.
It means your belly moves out when you take a breath.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat on the porch and watched ants move food to their home.
That sounds like a peaceful afternoon. Did you draw a picture of them?
Yes, I drew a big red queen ant holding a piece of bread.
A big red queen sounds very important. What color was the bread?
It was brown and it had a tiny bite taken out of one corner.
That is a nice detail for a drawing.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did my old friend move away?
I do not know the reason. Did they say anything to you?
They said the job was far.
That sounds like a big change. Do you miss their voice?
Yes, I do miss them.
That is a normal feeling. Would you like to write a letter?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a burger, please. I am very late.
A burger coming right up. Do you want fries with it?
Yes, but make it quick.
Got it. I will ring the bell if I have a problem.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw my old friend today. I am so happy.
That is wonderful. How did they look?
They smiled at me. I felt warm inside.
It is good to see a friend. Do you want to meet again soon?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I send a letter to my friend in the city?
You need to put the letter in an envelope. Is your envelope sealed shut?
Yes, it is sealed. What do I need to put on the front?
You must write the full address of your friend on the front. Do you have a stamp?
I have a stamp, but I am not sure where it goes.
Stick the stamp in the top right corner. Do you want to use a regular or a quick service?
I just want it to arrive, so I do not care.
A regular stamp is fine for that. Just put the letter in the blue box in the room.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a tall mountain today. It touched the sky.
That sounds like a big adventure. Was the air up there cold?
It was very cold. The top was white with snow.
Snow on top makes it look so clean and bright.
I felt happy looking at it. Then I went home.
It is nice to have a happy thought to take home.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to paint a tree, but I do not know where to start.
Start with the brown trunk first. Do you have brown paint?
Yes, I have brown and green. How do I make the leaves?
Use green to make big, round shapes at the top. Do you like round trees?
Yes, I like them. But my colors look muddy.
Mix your colors on the side, not in the can. What colors did you mix?
I mixed green and brown together. It looks dark.
That is normal for shadows. Try adding a little white to lighten it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am very sad about my grandpa.
I am so sorry. Can you tell me why?
He did not feel well today.
That sounds hard. Do you feel tired too?
Yes, I feel very low.
You can rest. Does he like tea?
I just want him to be happy.
That is a kind wish. I hope he feels better.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the lake so still today?
The wind has stopped. Do you like quiet days?
What lives under the water?
Many fish and frogs live there.
Why does the water look dark?
It is deep there. Do you see any fish?
Can I touch the water?
Yes, it is safe and clean.
Why is it so blue?
I do not know the exact reason.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a key in the grass. I do not know whose it is.
That is a nice find. Did it look old or new?
It looked old and rusty. I am scared to use it.
It may open something special. But please be careful.
I want to give it back to someone. Who should I ask?
You can ask a parent or teacher. Do you know a kind neighbor?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to clean my home.
That is a great feeling. Is the living room done?
Yes, it is clean and bright.
I am glad you feel good. What did you use to sweep?
I used my favorite broom.
A good broom helps a lot. Do you want to rest now?
No, I have more work to do.
You are very busy. Are you safe in the kitchen?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do fish swim so fast?
They swim fast to catch food. Do you like to eat fish?
Yes, I do. Where do they live?
Most fish live in water. Do you have a lake near your home?
No, just a small pond. Can I catch one?
You can try, but be gentle. Is it deep enough for a little fish?
It is a bit deep. How do I know if I got one?
Your line will pull tight if a fish bites.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I had a scary dream where I fell off a cliff. I feel very sad now.
That is a tough dream. Do you feel safe right here?
Yes, I am safe in my bed. But I do not know how to stop the fear.
Take one slow breath in, and let it out. Did you wake up all alone?
Yes, I was alone. What can I do to feel better?
Hold a soft toy and listen to quiet music. I do not know magic, but this helps many.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel so hot?
Your body is fighting the bug that makes you sick. Do you have a fever?
Why is my nose so runny?
Your nose makes liquid to help wash the germs out. Is it hard to breathe?
Why do I feel so tired?
I do not know the exact reason, but your body needs rest to get better. Are you drinking water?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I promised to fix the toy car today.
That sounds like a nice thing to do. Did you finish it?
I tried, but it did not go well at first.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you need any help?
Yes, my dad gave me a small tool.
That is a smart way to solve a problem. How did it feel when it worked?
It felt very good when the wheels turned.
Great job sticking to your promise. Do you want to play with it now?
Yes, I am going to play right now.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Have a happy time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my bread get so big in the oven?
A tiny living thing called yeast eats sugar in the dough. It makes gas that gets trapped inside. Do you see small bubbles in your batter?
Yes, I do see bubbles. What are they made of?
They are pockets of air from the yeast. The heat in the oven makes them grow fast. Is your kitchen warm or cold?
It is quite warm in here. Will that change the taste?
Warmth helps the bread rise faster. It might change the flavor a little bit. Do you like sweet bread?
Yes, I love sweet bread. So warmth is good, right?
Yes, warmth is very good for growing bread. Keep it cozy until it is double in size. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I live in a new town. How do I ride a bike safely?
You wear a helmet and hold the bars tight. Is it your first time riding?
Yes, my bike is a little too big for me. How do I stop it?
You squeeze both brakes at the same time. Do you have a flat spot to practice?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What sound does a cow make?
Cows say moo. Are you feeding them now?
Can pigs fly?
No, pigs cannot fly. Do you have any chickens?
I do not know. How do you get milk?
We milk the cows with our hands. Is the barn closed?
Yes, it is closed. I must go.
Go safely. I do not know why you are in such a hurry.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I broke my plate. How do I fix it?
Oh no. That is sad. Do you have glue?
Yes, I have some glue.
Good. Put a little glue on the crack. Wait, is the glass still sharp?
The edges are smooth now.
Nice. Press the pieces tight. Tell me, were you careful when you held it?
I was trying very hard.
Care is key. Be slow next time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we use colors on the wall?
Colors make the room look bright and warm. Do you like blue or red best?
I like blue, but why does it sometimes look sad?
I do not know for sure, but people think blue feels calm like water.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very worried about my dog.
That is hard to feel. How is he doing right now?
He is hiding under the bed and not eating.
That sounds scary for him. Did you try to talk to him?
I spoke softly, but he just looks at me with sad eyes.
It is good that you are checking on him. Is he breathing normally?
Yes, his tummy moves up and down slow and calm.
That is a good sign.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is learning a new language so hard?
It takes time for your brain to make new paths. Do you like the sounds of that language?
I like the sounds, but the words are confusing.
That is normal for beginners. Which part confuses you the most?
I do not know why some words have no meaning.
I do not know that specific word, but context helps. Do you read a lot?
I read stories, but not in that language yet.
Start with simple stories to see words in use. What is your first goal?
I just want to say hello and goodbye.
That is a great start. What will you say first?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My chair leg is wobbly and I am mad.
I can help. Is the leg loose?
Yes, it moves a lot.
We can add glue. Do you have any?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Can I have a cheese pizza with mushrooms on it?
Yes, you can. Do you like olives too?
No, I do not like olives.
Got it. I will add extra cheese instead.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My screen is black and I do not know why.
Did you press the big power button?
Yes, but nothing happens.
Is the power cord tight in the wall?
It is loose. I will fix it.
Good. Does the light turn on now?
Yes, the light is red.
Press the button again. Does it wake up?
It works. Thank you.
I am glad it works. Do you want to play?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My next door neighbor is very loud.
That can be tiring. Do you play outside often?
I do, but I do not know what to say to him.
Talking is often best. Have you tried a smile?
I tried, but he looked angry.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you have a parent nearby?
Yes, my mom is in the kitchen.
Maybe she can help you talk to him.
I think that might work.
That is a good plan. Let us hope for peace.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is that white, sweet thing on the table really bread?
Yes, it is a round loaf. Do you like sweet food?
I love sweet things, but I cannot find the good butter here.
The butter is in the fridge by the door. Would you like to buy one?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go. How do I win fast?
Keep your eye on the ball. Do you like to hit hard?
Yes, I hit hard. What else?
Stay cool and breathe. Is the court busy today?
Yes, very busy. I must go.
Good luck with your match.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is blowing very hard and I am scared.
I know that feels bad. Is your door closed tight?
Yes, I locked it, but the noise is loud.
Loud sounds can be scary. Do you want to sit near me?
That would help. I do not know if it will stop.
I do not know for sure. But storms always end.
I hope so. Should I stay inside?
Yes, staying inside is the best choice. Do you like watching rain?
I do, when it is safe.
That is a good thought. Stay warm and I will stay here with you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I hold the racket?
Put your hand on the grip like a handshake. Do you have a racket to practice with?
My hand feels slippery on the handle.
Try wrapping a towel around the handle for now.
How do I hit the ball straight?
Look at the ball, then swing your arms forward. Do you play on a court?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to speak Spanish right now. I am very late.
Do not worry. Do you want a fast tip? What is your goal?
I must say hello and thanks before I leave.
Say "Hola" for hello. Say "Gracias" for thanks. Do you feel ready?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my grandpa is very sick.
I am so sorry to hear that. Do you like sitting with him?
Yes, but it hurts to see him look so weak.
That must be hard for you. What helps you feel better?
Just thinking about the stories he tells me.
Those memories are very special. Do you plan to tell him about them?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know which season is best for me.
The warm sun feels nice in summer, but do you like playing in the rain?
I love the bright leaves in autumn, but I hate the cold.
Autumn is special, yet you said you dislike the cold, so why do you pick that time?
I am confused by the changing days and the wind.
I do not know your heart, but spring has soft flowers, and do you like green grass?
Thank you for the gentle words and the warm ideas.
You are welcome, and I hope you find a season that makes you happy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to start with the mess.
Start with the toys on the floor. Do you want to help?
The kitchen looks very dirty too.
Yes, the dishes are waiting for you.
What should I do with the beds?
Make them up by pulling the sheets tight. Is the bedspread soft?
I think I am ready to try now.
Great! Take your time and work slowly.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to eat cereal with milk.
That sounds good. Do you like sweet or salty?
I want a hot sandwich with cheese.
Cheese melts nicely. Would you like toast?
I am very hungry and thirsty.
Let us get you some juice. What color do you like?
I do not want to eat anything more.
Okay, rest your tummy.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am worried about my party.
Why do you feel that way?
I do not know what to bring.
A cake is a good start. Do you like food?
Yes, but I have no ideas.
I am not sure what you want.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to buy a guitar before the shop closes in ten minutes.
That is a very tight time for you. Do you have one already?
No, this is my first one, and I am running out of time.
I hope you make it to the store in time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to grow carrots in my small pot. Is that possible?
Yes, you can grow carrots in a deep pot. Do you have a sunny spot outside?
Yes, my back porch gets sun all day. How do I start?
Put seeds in the soil and keep it wet. Do you know how to water plants?
Not really. Do I use a hose or a cup?
Use a cup for tiny plants. It is safer for their roots.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a new place to eat lunch. The soup was very warm. I loved it.
That sounds nice. Did you try any other food?
Yes, I got some bread. It was soft and sweet. My dog saw it and got excited.
Dogs love bread. Was he a good boy?
He sat very still. I gave him a small piece. He was happy.
He sounds like a good helper too.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the box warm?
It works hard to show you things. Do you like games?
Yes, but the screen is dark.
I do not know why it went off. Is it still on?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so hot. This sun is too strong.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a fan?
No, I do not have one. The air feels thick.
That sounds very uncomfortable.
I tried to rest, but I sweat a lot.
Your body needs to cool down. Are you drinking cold water?
Yes, I drink all the time. It does not help much.
Water helps, but you need shade.
I wish for a big, cold wind.
A wind would be a great gift.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The sun is very hot today. My ice cream is going to melt.
That sounds like a sticky mess. Do you have a hat on?
No, I forgot to put it on. I want to eat my ice cream now.
You can run inside to stay cool. Is it your favorite flavor?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel lost in the big web of files.
It is like a huge library. Do you have a clear goal today?
I just want to find a song for my dog.
You can search for "happy music for dogs." Would you like a playlist link?
Yes, please. It is so quiet.
Here is a link to calm tunes. Is your dog sleeping now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do we have any fruit for the picnic?
Yes, we have apples. Do you like apples?
I only want grapes.
That is a fair request. I do not know if we have grapes.
Please check the bag.
I will look now. Are you bringing a blanket?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late and I do not know the answer to this math problem.
Take a deep breath. Do you have a pencil to try again?
My bus leaves in five minutes and I am still stuck.
Do not worry, you will get there. Good luck on the bus.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today and felt very sad.
That sounds heavy. Did you sit on a bench?
I sat by the tree and watched the leaves fall.
The leaves falling can look lonely. What did they look like?
They were brown and dry, just like my heart felt.
I am sorry you feel that way. Would you like to tell me more?
I just felt tired and small under the big sky.
It is okay to feel small. I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a robot friend.
That is a nice idea. Do you like to draw?
Yes, I draw all the time.
You can draw a robot first. Do you have any markers?
I have blue and red ones.
Great. Use them to make the body. Do you want eyes on it?
Yes, big round eyes.
Good choice. Draw two circles for eyes. Do you know how to draw a square?
Yes, I can do a square.
Perfect. Use a square for the head. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like apples.
Apples are sweet. Do you like them red?
Yes, I do.
That is nice. What do you do with them?
I eat the skin too.
That is good for you. Is it crunchy?
Yes, it is very crunchy.
I love crunchy things. Do you peel them first?
No, I just wash them.
That is smart and safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel scared about my first job tomorrow.
That is a good feeling. It means you care. Do you know where you are going?
Yes, but I worry I will make a mistake.
Everyone makes small slips at first. Just be kind to people.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to draw a cat, but it looks like a dog.
Start with a big circle for the head. Do you like cats?
Yes, I do. How do I make the ears look right?
Draw two triangles on top of the circle. Are they small or big?
They are small. Thanks for the help.
You are welcome. Have fun drawing.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I told a big secret and now I feel bad.
That sounds hard. Do you know who told?
I think my friend did it on purpose.
That is not kind. Are you ready to fix it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make tea, but I do not know how.
Put a bag in a cup. Pour hot water on it. Do you like it sweet?
Yes, I do. What about coffee?
Grind the beans, then add hot water.
Is coffee harder to make?
Yes, it takes more care. I do not know your taste. Do you like it cold?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up at seven, but my clock said eight.
A clock uses moving parts to count time. Did you check the battery?
The battery was fine. I just skipped breakfast and ran to school.
Running is a good way to move. What time did you actually arrive?
I got there at nine. It was late, but the day felt fast.
Time can feel different when we are busy. Did you enjoy your school day?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is a circle round?
It has no corners. Do you like making circles?
Yes, I do. Why do squares have four sides?
They are made of four straight lines. What do you like to make with squares?
I like to make houses. Why is a triangle pointy?
It has three sides that meet at a tip. Do you think it is strong?
Yes, it feels strong. Why is a ball round?
It rolls to one side. Do you like to roll balls?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know why my boat stays on the water.
The boat pushes water down, and the water pushes back up. Do you have a plastic bowl to try this with?
Yes, I do. How do I start?
Put the bowl in the water and drop in small toys. Does it sink if you add too many?
It sinks if I add ten, but floats with five.
That shows the water holds up the weight. Look closely at the line of water on the side of the bowl.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a box with a lid, but I cannot open it.
That is tricky. What does the box look like?
It is blue and has no handle.
Try tapping the corner to see if it pops.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the goal of the game?
To put the ball in the net. Do you like to kick it?
Yes, but I am slow on the field.
Speed comes with practice. Do you run every day?
I try, but my legs get tired.
Rest is good for you. How do you feel after a game?
I am happy, even if we lose.
That is a great mindset. Do you have a favorite team?
I just like playing with friends.
Friends are the best prize. Do you play outside?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a bird that looked just like my old pal.
That sounds like a nice surprise. Did it have red feathers?
Yes, and it wore a tiny cap too.
How funny that must be. Do you know where it flies?
I think it goes to the park by the river.
The park is a great place to play. Does it sing?
It sings the same song I used to hum.
What a sweet connection.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My blue fish is hiding behind the plant. Is he scared?
He might be taking a nap. Do you see his bubbles?
No, not right now. Does he need a new friend?
I do not know for sure. How many fish do you have?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: What is that box?
It is a gift for you. Do you want to open it?
Why did you get me that?
I saw you like it. Are you happy?
It looks nice. What is inside?
I do not know. Will you see?
Yes, I will check now.
I hope you like it.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn a new language, but I do not know where to start.
That is a nice goal. Do you like music?
I do, but I am still stuck. I feel lost.
I do not know your best path. Try one small word a day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with this test.
Do not worry. What part feels hard?
The math part is very big and confusing.
Try the first small step. Do you have your pencil?
Yes, I have my pencil, but I still feel stuck.
Take a slow breath. Shall we try the next question together?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How does bread get so big and soft?
Tiny bugs in the dough eat sugar and make gas. Have you ever seen bubbles in soda?
Are those bugs bad?
No, they are alive and help the bread grow. Do you like the smell of fresh bread?
I want to make my own bread.
You need flour, water, salt, and yeast. Is your kitchen warm enough?
My kitchen is cool, is that okay?
Cool air slows the bugs down, so it takes longer. Do you have a warm spot?
I found a spot near the heater.
That is perfect, just do not let it get too hot.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my bread not soft?
It may need more water. Do you use warm water?
Yes, I do.
Try adding a bit more. Is the dough sticky?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to learn a new tongue but I am lost.
That is okay. What word feels fun to say?
I do not care. Can you just pick one for me?
I cannot pick for you. Do you like numbers?
No. I just want it to be easy.
Try making sounds with your mouth. Do they feel good?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. Which season is it?
It is spring. Are you going to a park?
I do not know. Please tell me about summer.
Summer is hot and sunny. Do you like to swim?
I must go now. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big red circle on the floor this morning.
That is a nice sight. Did you try to sit on it?
No, I just stood near it and watched a small square box.
A square box is fun to move. Do you have one of your own?
I have a blue triangle in my toy box right now.
Triangles are very sharp shapes. Is it soft or hard?
It is hard plastic, but I did not break anything.
That is a good thing to tell. Did you play with it after?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do bears eat honey?
Yes, they love sweet treats. Do you like honey too?
I do. Can they fly?
No, bears cannot fly.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to tie my shoes, but the knots always come loose.
Pull the string tight after you make the knot. Do you like walking fast or slow?
I like to walk slow and look at the leaves.
Slow walking is good for seeing small things. Do you see any birds today?
I see a red bird on the branch.
That is a nice bird. You should pull the strings tight to keep your shoes safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am nervous about my meeting tomorrow. What should I do?
Take deep breaths to calm down. Have you eaten a good breakfast?
I do not know if I am ready to speak.
Just speak slowly and clear. Do you have your notes with you?
I am afraid of saying the wrong thing.
You will do fine if you speak your truth.
What if I forget my lines?
That is okay, you can pause and think. Did you practice out loud?
Yes, but I still feel scared.
Fear is normal, you can do this.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to run, but my legs hurt.
Rest is good for you. Do you drink enough water?
Yes, I drink a lot.
That is smart. Have you tried walking first?
Yes, I walk every day.
Great start. Slow down to a walk if it hurts. Do you have soft shoes?
No, my shoes are hard.
Soft shoes help your feet. Are you okay for now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is it raining?
No, it is sunny. Are you going to school?
Yes, I forgot my coat.
It is cold. Please put on a jacket. Do you have a hat?
No, I do not.
That is ok. It is a good day to be outside. Run fast!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my dog pull on the leash?
He pulls because he wants to go faster. Is he running towards something?
No, he just runs everywhere.
That is called zoomies. He has too much energy. Does he sleep a lot?
Yes, he sleeps a lot after that.
Good rest is very important for him. He needs that time to feel calm. Do you take him for a walk?
I take him every day.
That is a good habit. Keep doing that for his health. I do not know why he pulls so hard today.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a big box under my bed.
That is exciting! What does it say on the side?
It says for the birthday.
Happy early birthday! Are you going to open it right now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw the moon high in the sky after dinner. It looked like a bright coin.
That sounds lovely. Did you feel happy seeing it?
Yes, I felt very calm. Do you think the moon is cold?
I think it is cold there. It is far from our warm sun.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the big clock. It is three o'clock.
What a lovely time. Do you have plans for today?
Yes, I will eat lunch. I am very glad it is here.
That sounds nice. What will you eat?
I will have soup. It is warm and good.
Yum, that is true. Enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you know where the best pizza is?
I think the little place on Main Street has hot pizza. Do you like cheese?
Yes, I love cheese. Is it far from here?
It is just one block away. Do you want to walk there?
Yes, let's go now. Is it open right now?
I do not know if it is open. Let us go and look at the door.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am hungry but I do not know what to eat.
What did you eat for breakfast before?
I think I had eggs. They are good.
Eggs are a warm start. Do you like them plain or with cheese?
I like cheese. But I have no cheese.
I am sorry I do not know what else is in your kitchen. What else do you have?
I have milk and bread. That is all.
Toast with milk is a classic choice. Do you like sweet or salt toast?
I like sweet. So I will have toast with jam and milk.
That sounds very tasty. Do you need help finding the jam?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel very happy about my new drawing.
That is good. What did you draw?
A big red sun. But I do not know what to do next.
I do not know what is best for you. Did you have fun making it?
Yes, I did. Should I give it to my mom?
She might like it a lot. Do you want to show her now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to move my knight.
The knight moves in an L shape. Do you see your knight on the board?
Yes, but it seems stuck behind my own pawns.
You must move a pawn first to clear a space. Which pawn blocks your path?
The one on E2, I think.
That is a good place to look. Are you sure it is safe to move?
I am not sure, I might lose a piece.
I do not know your full game yet, so I cannot be certain. Do you have any other safe moves?
I will check the rook in the corner.
That is a smart idea to try. Good luck with your next move.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a bug in my room and do not know what to do.
Do not panic. Is it biting you?
No, it just sat on the wall and looked at me.
That sounds okay. What color was it?
It was green and very round.
A green one might be a ladybug. Do you like bugs?
I am not sure, but I think it is cute.
Cute is good. Can you let it go outside?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How do plants drink?
They pull water up from the roots. Do you like my tomatoes?
Can you be quick?
Yes. Tiny hairs in the roots grab the water.
Does it go up all the way?
Yes. The water moves up through tiny tubes. Do you see the leaves?
I must go. Thanks.
Bye. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. My teacher gave me a star for my drawing.
That is wonderful. What did you draw?
I drew a big red apple. It was my favorite color.
A red apple is great. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I have a bad head today because I fell off my bike.
I am sorry you fell. Did you hurt your arm?
My arm is fine, but my head hurts a lot.
That is good. Do you have any cold water to drink?
I am drinking water now, but I still feel dizzy.
Please sit down and rest. I do not know when the pain will stop.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I just moved here. What is good to do?
The park is very nice. Do you like to walk?
Yes, I love walking. Is it safe there?
It is safe and quiet. Would you like a map?
Yes, please. Where is the shop?
I do not know a shop. Do you need food?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go now. The boxes are full. Do you know where I park?
I do not know for sure. Is the van big?
Yes, it is huge. I will leave in five minutes. Do you have a key for the lock?
I have no keys. Do you need help carrying?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because the night feels so big and I feel small.
The sky is indeed very large. Do you see a specific star that you like?
It is the bright one there, but it is so far away I will never touch it.
It is true we cannot touch it. Does it still make you feel happy to see it?
Not really, I just want someone to sit here with me in the quiet.
I am right here with you in the quiet. Can you tell me one thing you like about the dark?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited for my bus today. It took a long time. I felt angry.
That is a hard feeling to sit with. Do you have a trick to calm down?
I counted to ten. Then I saw the bus.
Counting helps us stay calm. Good for you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. This puzzle piece will not fit anywhere.
That is very hard. Do you see any blue parts?
Yes, but they look all wrong to me. I want to give up.
Give it one more try. Are you tired?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is this gift blue?
I picked blue because I think you like it. Do you have a favorite color?
Do you know where this came from?
I am not sure where it is from. Do you want to open it now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My little brother got a puppy today.
That is so nice. Does he have a name for it?
Yes, he calls it Spot.
Spot sounds cute. Is the puppy small?
It is very tiny and soft.
That is wonderful. I am glad he is happy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you know if we are going to watch the play?
Yes, we are going to watch it soon. Are you excited about the stories?
I like the cat in the play the most.
That is a very nice choice. Did you find the cat funny or scary?
I do not know if the play is sad.
I am not sure either. Let us wait and see what happens.
My friend said the play is long.
It might take some time. Do you have enough snacks for the show?
I hope the cat gets a happy ending.
I hope so too. Let us enjoy the show together.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel so alone?
It happens when we miss deep connection. Do you talk to your friends often?
Not much, lately.
Sometimes silence feels loud to a busy heart. What makes you feel safe?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I found a bright red box with a ribbon on it. Who is this gift for?
It looks like a nice surprise. Do you know who left it there?
I think it is for my best friend. She likes painting very much.
That sounds like a great pick. What kind of art tools are inside?
I am not sure what is inside yet. It is still a secret.
Keeping it hidden is fun. Will you open it together?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am looking at the big clock, but I do not know what time it is. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help you. Do you know which hand is the short one?
I think the short hand points to the 3, and the long hand is near the 12.
That sounds like it is almost 3 o'clock. Do you want to practice telling time again?
Yes, please. I want to get it right this time.
Great, let us try the next one. What does the short hand point to now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue up there?
That is a great question. Light has many colors, and the blue ones dance around in the air. Do you see the rainbows?
I do! They are so pretty. But why do we see blue more?
The blue light scatters a lot, so it fills the whole sky. Do you like how it looks?
Yes, it is beautiful. Thanks for telling me.
You are welcome. It is happy to help you learn about the world. Have a good day!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we write letters?
It lets you share words with someone far away. Do you like drawing pictures?
Yes, I do!
You can draw a little heart in the corner. Would you like to sign your name?
Can I use red ink?
Yes, red looks very warm.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need shoes right now. I am very late.
Can I help you? What size do you wear?
Size nine. I have to go.
Here is a pair. Are these nice?
Yes. How much are they?
They cost ten dollars. Do you like the color?
I like them. Here is my card.
Thank you. I hope they fit well.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My friend looks sad. What can I do?
You can ask if they are okay. Are they feeling lonely?
Yes, they lost their favorite toy.
You might share your own toy with them. Do you have a spare?
I have a blue ball.
That is a very kind idea. Will you play together?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am waiting, but I do not know what to do.
That can feel hard. Do you like to look at books?
I am still waiting. I do not know if I should move or sit.
I am not sure what is best for you. Do you feel calm or busy?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw my blue fish jump out of the water today.
That is very sudden. Was the tank water warm?
No, it was cool. I think he saw a bug outside.
Fish do like to watch the world. Is he still in the tank now?
Yes, he is swimming at the top.
He seems happy. Good for him.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy about my meeting today.
That sounds wonderful. What is the best part?
My team gave me a big shout out.
I am glad you got that recognition. How do you feel now?
I feel very strong and ready.
Great energy. Do you have a plan for the next step?
Yes, I will start the project tomorrow.
That is a good plan. Good luck with the start.
Thank you, I feel ready.
You can do it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went hiking today. I saw a big bear near my tent.
That sounds very scary. Was the bear friendly?
No, it just smelled my food. Then it walked away into the woods.
I am glad it left safely. Do you plan to go back?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am sad because my birthday is coming soon.
That is a heavy feeling. Do you want to talk about why?
I do not have enough friends to come to my party.
That sounds lonely. Have you told your friends yet?
I tried, but they all said they are busy.
I am sorry you feel left out. It is very hard.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to grow tomatoes in my yard. Do they need much sun?
Yes, they need lots of bright light every day. Do you check your soil?
I use dark dirt. Is that good?
Dark dirt is usually rich and good for plants. Do they taste sweet to you?
Yes, they are very sweet. How do I stop the leaves from turning yellow?
Sometimes they are dry or too wet. Do you water them in the morning?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so tired. I have to run now.
That is very hard. Did you eat a snack?
No. My boss made me work late.
Oh no, that is not fair. Please go rest now.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I eat better every day?
Try adding more fruit to your plate. What is your favorite fruit?
I like apples. What else should I do?
Drink water instead of sugary drinks. Is that something you can try today?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I wrote a story about a blue bird that can fly backwards.
That sounds like a very fun bird. Does the bird have a special name?
It is called Zip. Zip loves to eat shiny berries.
Shiny berries must taste sweet. What happens after Zip eats them?
Zip gets so happy he sings a loud song for the whole forest.
The other animals must love that song.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared to take the train to my grandpa's house.
Do not be afraid. It is a very safe ride. Do you like looking out windows?
Yes, I love watching things go by.
That is a great skill. You will see many nice fields. Are you eating a snack?
I have an apple and some chips.
That sounds perfect for a trip. I do not know if they sell more food there. Is your bag ready?
Yes, my bag is packed and on the table.
Good job. Just wait for the bell to ring. Do you have your ticket?
Yes, I have my ticket in my pocket.
You are ready to go. Have a wonderful time seeing your grandpa. Tell me when you arrive.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like that song. It makes me feel sad.
I am sorry it feels that way. What part is the saddest?
The end. It just stops so fast.
That can feel sudden. Do you want to try the first part?
No, I just want it to be gone.
Okay, we can turn it off.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to pick from the list.
That feels hard. Do you like hot food?
Maybe, but I am still not sure.
Let us try soup first. It is safe and warm.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My boss gave me a day off to see my sick grandma.
That is very nice of him. Is your grandma feeling better now?
Yes, she is much better and I am so happy.
I am glad to hear that too. You must be a good friend.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I worked hard, but my friend got more praise. I feel left out.
That sounds hard. Did you tell her how nice it was to watch?
I did not. Now I feel small inside.
You did a good job. Do you want to share what you made?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I have a flat piece of paper. How do I make a circle?
You can use a round object like a coin. Do you have any coins nearby?
Yes, I have a few quarters. What do I do with them?
Put the coin on the paper and trace around it with a pen. Is your pen sharp enough?
The pen is sharp. What if I want a square instead?
Use a square object like a small box lid. Do you have a box lid?
I do not have a box lid. How else can I make a square?
You can fold the paper into four equal parts. Would you like to try that?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I had a scary dream about a big, dark shadow.
That must have felt very unsafe. What did the shadow look like?
It had long, thin fingers and no face.
That sounds like a monster from a story. Do you like scary stories?
No, I hate them now because they make me worry.
It is okay to feel worried. I am here to listen.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to wear when the leaves turn red.
You should wear a warm coat. Do you like cold weather?
Yes, I like the cold, but my fingers get too stiff.
You need warm gloves to keep your hands cozy.
How can I tell when winter is really here?
Look for snow on the ground. Do you like building snowmen?
I am not sure, and I want to learn more.
I do not know all the facts about winter.
That is all right, thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a red bird by the big oak tree this morning.
That sounds lovely. What was the bird doing?
It was eating some fallen apples.
Apples taste sweet. Did you have any too?
No, I only watched it for a while.
Watching is a fine thing to do. Was the weather cold?
It was crisp and the air smelled like pine.
Pine scent is fresh. I love that smell.
Yes, it made me feel calm and happy.
That is a good feeling. I am glad you had a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because my teacher helped me learn something new.
That sounds great. What did you learn?
I finally understood how to add big numbers together.
Nice work. Was it hard at first?
Yes, my head hurt a little, but my teacher was very kind.
That is a good thing. She smiled a lot, right?
She smiled and even gave me a high five.
Fun. Do you want to help a friend next?
Yes, I will show him how to do it at lunch.
You are kind. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not like the food here. It is bad.
That sounds sad. Do you want to eat something sweet?
No, my stomach hurts. I feel very sick.
Oh no. Have you had anything else to eat?
I only had a tiny sandwich. It was dry.
Water might help you feel better. Would you like a cup?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I gave up on the puzzle. It is too hard.
That feels hard sometimes. Do you want to try one piece?
Maybe. I dropped the last piece.
Oh, sorry about that. Did you find it?
No, I lost it. I am sad.
I am sorry you feel sad. It is okay to rest first.
I want to try again now.
Good choice. Where is the box?
Here, in my hand.
Great. Let us put one piece down.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my lunch taste better?
Try adding some fresh herbs. Do you have any in your kitchen?
I only have salt and pepper.
That is a good start. It is hard to add more if you do not know what to buy.
What should I start buying?
Look for fresh vegetables like carrots. Do you like sweet or salty food?
I like both.
Great. Try a simple salad with cucumbers. That will help you learn what you enjoy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do fish have lungs like I do?
No, most fish use gills to breathe. Do you know where you would find them?
I am going to try to float on my back.
That is a great way to rest your legs. How does the water feel on your skin?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My head hurts a lot. Why is that?
It is often from being tired. Did you sleep well last night?
I did not sleep well. Is that bad for my brain?
Yes, your brain needs rest to work right.
How do I make the hurt go away?
You can drink water and sit in a quiet room. Do you have a cold?
No, I do not have a cold. Should I take medicine?
You should talk to a doctor first. They know the best way to help you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. My boss was very kind to me.
That is great news. Why were you feeling so happy?
She gave me a long lunch break. She also smiled at me.
That sounds very nice. Did you say thank you to her?
Yes, I did. It made my whole day feel bright.
Kind bosses make work fun. You should be proud of your team.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so mad. The toy is not in my hands yet.
Waiting is hard, but it is getting better. Do you like to wait for juice?
Yes, but I want the toy now.
Try to breathe slowly. Do you feel your tummy?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am keeping a big secret, but my heart hurts when I keep it quiet. What should I do?
That can feel very heavy. Do you feel safe to tell someone you trust?
Yes, but I am scared they will not like me for what I did. Is it too late to share it?
It is never too late to speak the truth. Tell a kind person who listens without anger.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is there a rainbow in the sky?
Rain and sun work together to make it. Do you like watching them?
Is it a real thing I can touch?
No, it is just light bending in water. Can you point to one today?
Why are there different colors?
Sunlight has many colors hidden inside. Which one do you love most?
Does it ever go away?
Yes, it fades when the rain stops. Do you think it is magic?
Do you know how long it lasts?
I do not know the exact time. It is usually short.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My little fish is hiding in the corner. Is he sick?
That can happen if the tank is new to him. Is he eating his food?
Yes, he ate some flakes. But the water looks a bit cloudy.
Cloudy water is not good for fish. How often do you clean the tank?
I clean it every week. What should I do next?
I am not sure why it is cloudy without testing it. Have you checked the temperature?
It seems warm, but I do not have a tool to check.
You should buy a small thermometer to be safe. Let me know if the fish gets worse.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I can't get the words to that song right. It makes me so sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you know which part is hard?
The bridge. My brain just goes blank every time.
That happens to everyone. Is the song very long?
No, it is short, but fast. I just give up.
Taking a break helps. Do you want to try again later?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I love mountains. They make me feel big and free.
That is a great feeling. Do you like to climb them?
Yes, I climb a little bit. The air up there is very cold.
Cold air is fresh. Do you bring a warm coat?
I always bring a big coat. It keeps me safe from the chill.
That is smart. You seem to really enjoy nature.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does it get cold in winter?
The sun shines on us at a slant, so we get less heat. Do you like snow?
I do! Why do leaves turn red in fall?
The green color fades, and red colors show. Do you enjoy picking apples?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
That is a great goal. Do you have a friend to help you?
I think I do. What should I do first?
Start by balancing on the bike without pedaling.
How do I know if I am doing it right?
You know when you can coast for a few seconds.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is snow white?
It looks white because the light bounces around inside. Do you like playing in it?
Yes, I do.
That is a lot of fun. Is it cold where you live?
It is very cold.
Dress warmly to stay safe. Do you build snowmen?
I build big forts.
Forts are wonderful.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we count on our fingers?
It is an old way to keep score. Do you like using your hands?
Yes, I do. Why do we count up from one?
One is the start of all numbers. Is it fun for you?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the bread get so big when we bake it?
The little bits inside are waking up and making air. Do you see the bubbles?
Yes, I see them. Are they like bubbles in the pond?
Very much like it. The air makes the bread stretch out.
That is a good thing to know.
It really is. Do you smell the warm, good smell yet?
It smells very sweet.
That is because the bread is almost done. We will eat it soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to buy a new toy but I have no money.
That is a good problem to solve. Do you have a piggy bank?
Yes, I do, but it is empty right now.
We can put spare coins in it. Where do you usually spend your allowance?
I spend it on candy and stickers.
That sounds like a lot of treats. Maybe keep the coins for the toy?
Can I buy the toy if I save for a month?
That depends on how much the toy costs. How much is it?
It costs ten dollars.
Saving a little each day might get you there. Do you think you can say no to candy?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late and the lights just went out.
Did you check if the main switch is on? Is your phone charging?
The switch is on, but my phone battery is empty.
That is strange. Do you see a red light on the breaker box?
I cannot get to the box because I have to run.
Please stay safe for now. You can fix the power after your meeting.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a dog stuck in a tree today.
That is a silly sight. Was the dog okay?
It fell out and ran away safe.
I am glad it was not hurt.
I felt good about that.
Kindness feels good. Did you tell anyone?
I told my mom about it.
She must be happy.
I just kept walking home.
You did a good thing.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My dog is very small.
That is cute. What color is he?
He is brown.
Brown is a nice color. Does he like to play?
Yes, he loves balls.
Playing with balls is fun. Do you have other toys?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a tiny village behind the big hill.
That sounds so sweet. Is there a river there?
Yes, a clear one with cool fish.
How lovely. Do people live in it?
Just a few kind folks and many dogs.
The dogs must be happy. What do they do for fun?
They chase ducks in the mud.
That is a great game. Is it always sunny there?
Yes, the sun shines all day.
It sounds like a happy place.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a bad pain in my tummy.
That sounds scary. Do you feel hot?
No, but it hurts when I eat.
Please tell a grown up.
Where do I go to get help?
A doctor can help you. Is it your tummy again?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am so tired, but I want to learn how to make tea.
That sounds nice. Do you have a kettle?
Yes, I have a kettle and some leaves.
Just put water in the kettle and wait for it to boil. Are you drinking it hot or cold?
I like it warm.
Then pour the hot water over the leaves and wait a bit. It will make you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the store today.
That sounds like a good trip. Did you buy any fruit?
I saw a big apple.
Apples are sweet and red. Did you eat it?
I ate half of it.
That is a nice snack. Do you like apples?
Yes, I do.
I am glad you had a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today.
That is wonderful. What made you smile?
My grandpa gave me a book.
A book is a great gift. Is it about animals?
Yes, it is about big cats.
Cool. Do you plan to read it now?
Yes, I will read it all.
Enjoy your story time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My head hurts a lot and I feel sick.
That is not good. Do you have a fever?
Yes, it is very hot.
We will see a doctor soon. How do you feel right now?
I just want to go home and sleep.
Rest is good, but we must be safe. Do you feel dizzy?
A little bit.
Let us sit down for a minute. Is your pain worse or better?
It hurts my ears too.
The doctor can help you feel whole.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My fish is always at the bottom. What should I do?
That can mean the water is not good. Is the tank clean?
I clean it every week.
Good habit. Are you feeding it too much?
Yes, I give it food all day.
That is too much. Give it small bits twice a day. Do you test the water?
No, I do not have a kit.
A kit helps you see if the water is safe. It is a good tool.
I will get one today.
That is a smart choice. Your fish will be happy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a very good day at the beach.
That sounds like fun. Did you swim in the sea?
Yes, I swam for a long time.
Good for you. It must feel nice.
I also ate some cold ice cream.
Yum. What flavor did you pick?
It was vanilla with chocolate bits.
That sounds sweet. Glad you had a happy day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy to see a little bug.
That is a nice thing. What color is it?
It is bright red with black spots.
That sounds like a ladybug. Do you like how it looks?
Yes, it is tiny but very strong.
I do not know its exact name. Do you want to watch it fly?
Yes, I am glad to see it.
Happy for you. It is a fun day.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I wash the glass?
You can use warm water and soap. Do you have a towel?
Yes, I have a towel.
Great. You must dry it to stop the spots. Are you scared of breaking it?
No, I hold it very tight.
That is good. Be gentle but firm.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I looked up at the moon after dinner. It was very bright and white.
That is a lovely sight. What did you see around it?
There were no clouds. Just the moon and the dark sky.
The clear sky makes the moon look bigger. Did you share that view with anyone?
My neighbor saw it too. He pointed at a big rock on the moon's face.
I do not know the names of those rocks. Do you think they are called craters?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I miss my old friend so much.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you still have their phone number?
I lost it a long time ago.
That is a shame. Have you tried to find them online?
I did look, but I found nothing.
I do not know who else you could ask. Did you try your other friends?
I am too tired to ask more people.
Rest well today. Would you like me to call you later?
Yes, please, thank you.
I will call you soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a rope?
That is a great skill to learn. Do you like water?
Yes, I do. Show me how.
Cross the ends to make an X. Pull one end through the loop.
I did that. What next?
Pull both ends tight to hold it. Is the knot looking good?
It holds! Thank you.
You did a good job. Safe travels on the ship.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I clean the glass of my fish tank?
You can use a soft sponge to wipe the dirt off. Do you have a sponge at home?
Yes, I have a blue one. Should I use soap on it?
No, please do not use soap, as it is bad for fish. Is your water clean?
The water looks a bit cloudy. How do I fix that?
I do not know why your water is cloudy. Have you fed the fish too much?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are clouds in the sky?
They are made of tiny water drops. Do you like looking up?
They look like animals!
Yes, your eyes can make them look like anything. What shape do you see?
I do not know how they move.
The wind pushes them along. I do not know exactly how fast.
Can I go inside a cloud?
No, they are too high and full of air. Is your mom coming soon?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now. I love looking at the big mountains.
That sounds lovely to hear. Do you see snow on the tops?
Yes, the peaks are white and bright. I feel so small next to them.
Mountains are very big and old. Do they make you feel quiet?
Yes, it is very peaceful up here. The air is fresh and cold.
Fresh air is good for you. Do you bring a warm coat with you?
I always wear a jacket. I am just standing here feeling great.
That is wonderful news for you. I am glad you feel so good.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I take a picture of a bee?
You need a long lens and a steady hand. Are you trying to take photos outside?
I want to catch a firefly at night.
Wait in the dark and look for the light. Do you have a red light for your eyes?
How do I stop ants from entering my home?
Mix sugar with water and place it outside. Do you see the ants near your door?
I want to build a house for dragonflies.
That is not a thing we can do for them. I do not know how to help with that.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start playing tennis.
Start by holding the racket and hitting the ball. Do you have a racket?
Yes, I have one, but I am not sure if I am good enough.
Everyone starts small. How do you feel about learning?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got off the bus and I feel so happy!
That sounds great. What made you smile?
The sun was shining and the driver said hi.
That is a lovely start to your day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I don't want to do my school work from home. It feels weird.
I get it. It can feel strange. What is your favorite part of being home?
