I like sitting in my pajamas. But I hate the computer.
Pajamas are cozy. Do you like wearing them when you play?
Yes, they are soft. But my chair makes my back hurt.
That sounds uncomfortable. Do you sit for a long time at once?
Yes, I sit until my mom makes me stop. I am tired.
Resting is good. I don't know why your chair hurts, but breaks help.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to take a picture of the dog.
That sounds fun. What color is the dog?
He is brown and fast.
Nice. Can you make him stop?
I try to press the red button.
Good job. Do you have a big smile ready?
Yes, look at my teeth.
Great. Take the picture now.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does time move so slowly when I wait?
It feels slow because we want things to end. Do you like waiting for candy?
Yes, but I feel very bored.
Bored is a normal feeling. What do you usually do to fix it?
I look at the wall a lot.
That can make time feel longer. Do you have a book nearby?
No, I only have this wall.
I do not know how to fix that right now. Can you count the lines on it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to hit a forehand.
That is a great goal. Do you have a racket?
Yes, I have a new red one.
To start, you want to grip it like you are shaking hands.
So I just shake hands with the racket?
Yes, but keep your arm relaxed.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am nervous about my first day at work.
It is normal to feel scared. What is your first job?
I will sell books at a small shop.
That sounds fun. Do you like to read?
I love stories, but I worry about talking to people.
Just be yourself. What do you do when you feel shy?
I take a deep breath and smile.
That is a great start. Do you have a plan for the first day?
I plan to ask questions and listen a lot.
That is smart and kind. Good luck with your new job.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What should I cook?
Make an egg. Do you have cheese?
Yes, I have cheese. Please help.
Put it in a pan. It takes five minutes.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I see so many lights up there. Why do they shine?
They are big balls of fire burning far away. Do you like looking up?
Yes, but why are some brighter than others?
The bright ones are closer to us. Do you like counting stars?
I counted ten, then I lost track. Why can I not see them in the day?
The sun is too bright to let them show. Do you like sunny days?
I like both. Why do they look like they are moving?
The Earth is spinning under them. Do you feel the spinning?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost my place in the big room. I feel very sad and lost.
That is hard. Do you remember the last thing you saw?
No. I just want to go home now.
I will walk with you. Let us find the exit together.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know why the ship stays up.
Water pushes back up on the ship. Do you feel the push?
I am not sure how to test it.
Put a stone in a bowl of water. Is it easier now?
That makes sense, but I still feel lost.
Floating is just a push and a pull. Try it again?
I think I understand it better now.
You did a great job learning.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up before the sun today. The mist was thick and cold.
That sounds very peaceful. Did you see any animals in the fog?
Yes, I saw a small bird on a branch. It looked quite happy.
How lovely to start your day with a friend. Did you have a nice breakfast after that?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am reading in bed with a small light.
That sounds cozy. What book is it?
It is a tale about a dragon who likes to sing.
A singing dragon is fun. Is the song happy or sad?
It is a very happy song that makes me smile.
I am glad it brings you joy. Do you read often at night?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy about my meeting today.
That is great to hear. Did you like it?
Yes, it was very nice.
I am glad you had a good time. What did you do there?
We talked about many things.
I am happy for you. What is your favorite part?
I really like the food.
That sounds fun.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found this song but I do not know if I like it.
That is okay. Do you like the fast part?
The fast part is too loud for me.
Try the quiet start first. Does that feel calm?
Yes, the start is very nice.
Great. You can just listen to the quiet part.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make bread, but I do not know how to mix the dough.
Just put flour, water, yeast, and salt in a big bowl. Do you have a spoon handy?
Yes, I have a spoon. How long should I stir it?
Mix for about two minutes until it feels soft and sticky. Is the bowl big enough?
It is big enough. What should I do next?
Cover the bowl with a towel and wait for an hour. Do you like sweet bread?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I had a very scary dream about falling from a high tree.
That sounds like it must have been very frightening. Did you wake up feeling sad?
Yes, I woke up shaking and my heart was beating fast.
That is a common feeling after a bad dream. Take some slow, deep breaths to feel calm.
I am still a bit worried about going back to sleep.
Try drinking some warm milk to help you relax. Do you have a favorite soft toy for comfort?
Yes, I have my old teddy bear next to me.
Holding onto him might make you feel safe again. I hope you fall back asleep soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Can I ride my bike on the grass?
The grass is soft and bumpy. Do you want to try a small wheelie?
No, I just want to go straight.
That is a good plan. Is your helmet tight?
Yes, it feels safe and cozy.
Great, always wear your helmet. Are your brakes working well?
I checked them this morning.
That is smart and true. Have fun riding.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I want to tell you about my tea.
That is nice. Do you like sweet tea?
Yes, I like it warm and sweet. Coffee is good too, but it makes me jump.
I see. Does coffee make you sleepless?
Sometimes, yes. So I drink tea at night. It makes me feel calm and warm.
That sounds peaceful.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because my favorite bird is not here today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you see any other small birds nearby?
No, the garden looks very quiet and empty.
Sometimes they just go to a different tree. Have you tried calling them with a soft song?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to find a picture of a cat. How do I do that?
You can type "cat picture" in a search bar. Do you like black cats?
I do not like cats. I want a dog.
Okay, type "dog picture" instead. That is easy.
I typed it, but nothing happens.
Make sure you press the "Enter" key. Is the screen showing a list of pages?
Yes, I see many pages. What next?
Tap on one of the links to see the picture. You did great.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have extra coins, but I do not know where to put them.
You could keep them in a jar. Do you have a jar at home?
I have a cup, but I still feel stuck.
A cup works just fine.
Should I spend some on fun things?
Yes, but only a small part. Do you like saving for games?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a ball but no team. What should I do?
You can kick it against a wall. Do you live near a park?
There is a park, but it is very far. I feel tired.
Walking there might take too long. Do you have a small open space at home?
I do have a small yard. It has some weeds.
A yard is a good start. You can learn skills there. Have you tried to keep the ball in the air?
I try, but it hits my face or chest. I feel silly.
That is normal for many people. It takes time to learn. Do you like playing with your feet or hands?
I like using my feet more. I want to get better.
Great! Practice slowly. Do you know a friend who plays?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I count my toes?
You point to each one and say the number out loud. Do you like counting feet?
Yes, I like it. Sometimes I get lost.
Start with one and go slow. Do you count up or down?
I count up to ten.
That is a great goal. Can you do it again?
I can try.
Good luck. I am here if you need help.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my baby crying so much?
Babies cry to tell us they need help. Are they hungry?
I gave them food, but they still cry.
Maybe they want a warm hug. Do they feel cold?
They look very tired, not cold.
They might just want to sleep. Can you hear a soft noise nearby?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to read this book before my eyes close.
Reading late can be good for sleep. Do you like this story?
Yes, but I am in a big rush.
Hurrying can make your brain too excited to rest.
Can you tell me how to sleep fast?
I do not know a magic trick. Do you have a lamp nearby?
Yes, it is very bright.
A dim light helps your body get ready for sleep.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I lost the game of go fish.
That is okay. Do you know how to ask for a card?
I just say give me a card.
That is not right. You must say do you have a two?
Oh, I see. Do you have a three?
Yes, here is your three. Are you happy now?
Yes, I am happy.
Good luck. Do you want to play again?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost. I do not know the way home. What should I do?
Do not panic. Stand still and look for a person in a uniform. Are you carrying your phone?
I dropped it. My parents will worry. Where can I ask for help?
Go to a shop or a police station nearby. They are kind and will help. Do you see any signs nearby?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to sing a song today and my voice felt very strange.
That can happen when you first try. Do you like the song?
Yes, I love it, but I feel too shy to sing with friends.
It is okay to feel shy at first. What made you want to sing?
I just want to sound happy and warm.
That is a lovely goal. I do not know if you can fix it today, but practice helps.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did my old friend move to the new house?
I do not know for sure. Did you ask them?
I have not asked yet. Why are you unsure?
I only heard a rumor. Do you want to check?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a secret. Can I trust you to keep it safe?
Yes, I promise to keep it quiet. What is it?
I lost my shiny red ball. Do you know where it went?
I am sorry, I do not know where it is. Did you check under your bed?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have to go now.
That sounds rushed. Do you have a big test?
Yes, it is very hard.
Good luck with that. What is your new friend like?
She is nice and kind.
That is great to hear. Does she like to read too?
No, she likes to play outside.
How fun that is. What game do you play?
Tag in the park.
Nice!

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is your favorite fruit?
I love sweet bananas. Do you like them too?
Yes, they are very good.
They are easy to eat. Do you peel them yourself?
I use a knife.
That sounds like a fun skill.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a big white cloud but I do not know what it means.
It looks like a sheep. Do you like animals?
Yes, but I am still confused. Should I draw it or ignore it?
Drawing is fun. Do you have a pencil nearby?
I have one, but I am afraid I will break it.
That is very unlikely. Just hold it gently and enjoy the view.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make pasta, but I do not know what sauce to use.
Tomato sauce is a very good choice. Do you have any tomatoes at home?
I do not have any tomatoes, only canned ones.
Canned tomatoes work perfectly for this. Would you like help chopping them?
Yes, please. I am afraid of the knife.
That is okay, I will cut the big pieces for you. You can just stir the pot.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Oh no, the lights went out. What should I do?
Stay calm and grab a flashlight. Do you have one nearby?
I have a phone, but the battery is low. Is that okay?
Yes, use it for light only to save power. Is the street outside dark too?
Yes, the whole street is dark. How long will this last?
I do not know for sure, but it may take some time. Do you feel safe in your home?
I am safe, but I am feeling scared in the dark. How can I feel better?
Take slow breaths and listen to the quiet sounds. Do you like listening to music?
Yes, I do. I will put on a song to help me relax.
That is a great idea to stay calm. It is safe now, so try to rest.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: It is so hot today. I want ice cream.
Yes, the sun is very strong. Do you like chocolate?
I do. But my mom says no.
She cares for your health. Maybe you can drink cold water.
Water is not fun.
It is good for you. Are you thirsty?
Yes, I am.
Drink your water. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I want the chicken. Why is it yellow?
It is yellow because we cook it with turmeric. Do you like spicy food?
I do not know what spicy means. Why do you add it?
It gives the food a warm, hot feel. It is not dangerous.
That sounds fun. What about the side dish?
The rice is white and plain. It goes well with the meat.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have these cut flowers, but I do not know where to put them.
Do you have a glass of water ready?
No, I only have the stems.
That is easy to fix. Do you have a clean cup?
Yes, I found a small one.
Put the stems in water. It will help them stay fresh.
What if they start to smell bad?
I do not know for sure, but fresh water helps. Do you have clean water?
Yes, I have a pitcher.
Change the water every day. This keeps the flowers happy.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am very happy today because I made a new friend at school.
That is great news! I am glad you have a new friend. Do you talk to them often?
Yes, we sit together at lunch and we share our snacks.
Sharing is a very kind thing to do. What food did you share?
I gave him half of my apple and he gave me a cookie.
That sounds like a fair and sweet trade. I hope you both had a fun time.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How does a plant drink water?
Roots take in the water from the soil. Do you like to garden?
Yes, I do! But how does the water get to the leaves?
Tiny tubes carry it up to the top. It is like a straw in a drink.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just rode my bike to the end of the street! It was so much fun.
That sounds like great exercise! Do you like riding on the sidewalk or the road?
I like the road because it is wider. I feel very free when I ride fast.
It is nice to feel free. Do you wear a helmet when you ride?
Yes, my mom says I must always wear one. I am glad to be safe and happy.
Being safe is the most important thing.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say please and thank you?
It makes people feel happy when you are kind. Do you like making people smile?
I do, but why is it bad to interrupt?
It hurts feelings to cut someone off. Do you like being talked over?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have dirty shirts, but I do not know how to wash them.
Put them in the machine with soap. Do you have white clothes or dark ones?
Some are white and some are black. I am afraid they will mix colors.
That is a good worry. Wash the white ones first, then the dark ones.
Thank you for helping me. I will do that now.
You are welcome. I do not know if they need hot or cold water.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the sun shine?
It shines because it is very hot and bright inside. Do you like looking at the sun?
Yes, but why is it so hot?
It is hot because it burns fuel to make light and warmth. I do not know exactly how deep that fire goes.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is my tomato plant yellow?
It may need more water. Do you water it every day?
Yes, but the leaves still look sad.
It might need food. Do you give it any?
I put coffee grounds in the soil.
That is good for some plants. Try adding a little compost instead.
Where can I find compost?
You can make it from food scraps. Do you like making things?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I spent all morning cutting the wood for my new shed.
That sounds like hard work. Did you have any fun doing it?
My hands are very sore, but I feel happy with the wood pile.
Your dedication is great. Are you hungry from all that effort?
Yes, I am very hungry. I think I will eat lunch now.
That is a wise choice. I hope you enjoy your food.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My phone screen is black. Do I break it?
I am not sure why it is black. Is it in your pocket?
No, it is on the table. It just stopped working.
Try to press the side button. Did you eat a cookie?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is the horse?
Is it in the big red barn?
Yes, it is.
It is there. Have fun.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the clock tick?
A small spring pulls the parts back and forth. It makes a tiny sound each time. Do you hear it in your house?
Yes, I do. But how does it know the time?
The moving parts count the swings to move the hands. One swing is one second. Do you like counting?
Sort of. Why does the second hand move so fast?
It moves in small, quick steps to show passing time. The other hands move much slower.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun went down and my clock ticked soft all night.
That tick sound comes from a small hammer hitting a toothed wheel. Do you see the hands moving?
Yes, the hands spin round and the gear teeth push them slow.
The teeth grab the springs and pull the hands in a circle.
I woke up to the bell ringing loud at seven o'clock.
A pendulum swings back and forth to keep the time true.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My cat is very happy today.
That is great news. What is she doing?
She is sleeping in the sun.
Sleeping is good for cats.
Her eyes are closed tight.
She looks very cozy. Does she purr?
Yes, she makes a loud sound.
I am glad she is well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is there a place where I can buy ice cream?
Yes, there is a sweet shop nearby. Do you like chocolate?
I want the one with red sprinkles.
That sounds tasty. How far away are you?
I am standing right on the corner.
Great, you are close. Do you have enough coins?
Yes, I have two big ones.
That should work. Go and enjoy your treat.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up and saw white everywhere.
That must have looked magical. Did you go outside?
Yes, I went to the park.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you build a snowman?
I tried, but the snow was too wet.
Wet snow can be tricky. Do you like making snowballs instead?
Just a little bit. It was very cold.
Cold air is part of the snow game. Did you get back inside quickly?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am so lost on this math homework. I do not know where to start.
Let us read the first problem together. What number do you see first?
It is a big number, but I still feel stuck. Please help me think.
I can guide you step by step. Do you want to try adding?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I feel so tired after eating only candy?
Sugar gives you a quick start but then a low. Do you like fruits?
Do fruits help me stay strong all day?
Yes, they give slow and steady power. I do not know your favorite food.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to keep more of my coins. How do I do that?
Try putting small bills in a jar each week. Do you pick the big or small bills?
I mostly find quarters. Is that enough?
It can add up over time. What is your main goal for saving?
I want to buy a new bike next year.
That is a great target to aim for.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to pack my tent right now. I am late.
Take the poles first. Do you have your sleeping bag?
Yes, it is in the bag. I have to go.
Enjoy the stars. See you later.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My goldfish looks sick. What should I do?
A sick fish needs clean water. Did you change the water recently?
I change it every week, but it looks cloudy.
Cloudy water can hurt the fish. How many fish are in the tank?
There are five goldfish in there.
That might be too many for that space. Do they have hiding spots?
No, just the sand and a plant.
They need places to hide to feel safe. I suggest adding more plants.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a shiny rock in my backpack.
That sounds like fun. Is it heavy?
No, it is light and warm.
Warm rocks are rare. Where did you dig it up?
Behind the old tree in the yard.
I do not know why it is warm. Do you keep it safe?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I start running without hurting my legs?
Take small steps and keep your body upright. Do you have comfortable shoes?
Yes, I bought new shoes last week.
That is a great start. Start with just a few minutes a day. How long do you run now?
Maybe ten minutes, but my knees hurt after.
Your body needs time to get strong. Try walking for five days first. Does the pain go away when you stop?
It gets better if I rest for a day.
Resting is good for your bones. Do not push too hard at first. Are you drinking water?
I think I should drink more, yes.
Water helps your muscles work well. Start easy and listen to your body. Is there a park near your home?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do plants drink water?
They drink through their roots. Do you like roots?
I do not know. Why do they drink?
They need water to grow. Have you seen a thirsty plant?
Yes, I have. How does it move up?
It moves up tiny tubes inside the stem. Do you like to run?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
They take sweet juice from flowers. Do you like flowers?
Yes, I do. What do they do next?
They chew it to make it thick. Then they put it in a home made of wax.
That sounds hard work. Do they eat it right away?
They store most of it for winter. I do not know what bees eat in spring, but they mostly keep it safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The fence is too short and the rabbits got in again.
That is a very bad day. Did you put out fresh carrots?
Yes, I did. Now the flowers are gone and I feel sad.
Oh, I am sorry. Can I help you check for holes?
Please do. I just want my garden to look nice.
I do not know if I can fix it, but I can look. Do you have the big stones?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do trees lose their leaves in the cold?
They do that to save energy. Do you like to see the snow?
Yes, I do. Do roots drink water?
Yes, roots drink water from the dirt. Do you see roots under the ground?
I have never seen them. How does a tree know when to grow?
It uses the light and heat. Do you feel the sun on your face?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to leave now. Is that horse safe?
Yes, it is very calm and nice. Do you like riding?
I do not have time to talk. Is it mine?
No, it belongs to the farm. What is its name?
I am late. Do you know where it sleeps?
It sleeps in the warm barn. Is your horse there too?
I must go. Can I feed it later?
Yes, bring some hay. Do you have a carrot?
I am leaving now. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a safe ride.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very scared about the storm.
It is okay to feel scared. What makes you worry the most?
The loud thunder sounds like a growl.
That does sound scary to me. Do you want to sit near the window?
No, I want to hide under my blanket.
That sounds like a good plan. I will stay right here with you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my phone and I feel so sad.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you try to fix it?
No, the screen is all black.
That sounds like a broken screen. Do you have a backup?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My phone screen is all black.
Oh no, that is scary. Is the battery very low?
I do not know how to check.
Try pressing the side button once. Did you hear a small click?
It makes a sound but no light.
That is good news. Try holding the button for a full ten seconds.
I will give it a try now.
Take your time, I am here. Do you have a charger nearby?
Yes, it is right here on the desk.
Please plug it in and wait a moment.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was bright today, so I walked to the big green park.
That sounds like a nice start. Did you see any animals?
Yes, I saw a brown dog running fast.
Dogs love to run in the sun. Did you talk to the owner?
The man was busy, so I just watched for a bit.
It is good to watch quietly. Do you like feeding ducks?
I bought some bread and fed three ducks.
Ducks are happy to eat. Did you bring a jacket for later?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. I am sorry I cannot stay.
That is okay. Are you going to the bus?
Yes, I must go. Please forgive my rush.
No problem at all. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My bread is not rising. I am late. Please help.
Is your kitchen warm? Warm air makes bread rise fast.
It is cold here. What do I do now?
Put it in a sunny spot. Do you have a lamp?
Yes, but I am leaving soon. Will it work?
It may take time. I do not know.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big idea for the weekend. I am so happy I want to tell you all about it.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What is the first step?
We will go to the park and have a picnic under the big oak tree.
A tree picnic sounds nice. Do you know what food you will bring?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. It is raining again.
That is a shame. Do you hate the rain?
Yes, it is wet and cold. I wanted to play.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have warm socks?
No, I do not. It is just gray outside.
That sounds gloomy. Maybe you can draw a picture.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
I am sorry to hear that. Is it about school?
No, it is about my cat.
Oh, what happened to him?
He got sick and I am worried.
Please take him to a doctor. I do not know if he will be okay.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the light turn off when I pull the plug?
Pulling the plug stops the power from reaching the bulb. Do you like it when the light is on?
Yes, but why does it get hot?
The wire uses up some power to make heat. Is the plug warm to the touch?
It feels a little warm.
That is normal, but it should not be too hot. Do you feel safe using it?
I think so. What is inside the wall?
There are wires hidden in the wall to carry power. Do you wonder where they go?
Do they go to a big box outside?
Yes, the power comes from far away. I do not know exactly how it travels.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the fish move back and forth?
They swim to stay safe and cool. Do you see their tails wiggle?
Why do they stop for a moment?
They rest to save energy. Do they look calm to you?
Why does the big fish chase the small one?
That is how they play together. I do not know if it is fight or fun.
Why do the bubbles rise up?
Air is lighter than water, so it floats. Do you hear the pump hum?
Why are the fish green?
I do not know why they are that color. Do they look shiny to you?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now because it is raining.
That is wonderful. Why does rain make you feel good?
I love the sound of water hitting the window.
I like how it calms the world down. Do you have a warm cup of tea?
Yes, I am drinking hot cocoa with marshmallows.
That sounds very cozy. It is good to share your joy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I like to draw cats, but they look funny.
That is a fun hobby. Do you like drawing dogs too?
Yes, I do, but how do I make their tails look right?
Try drawing a big C shape. Is it easy to draw big shapes?
It is a little hard for me.
You will get better with time. Keep trying.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to eat, but I am so confused.
That is okay. Do you like hot food or cold food?
I think I like both, but I cannot pick.
Good choice. Try a warm soup first?
Soup sounds nice, but I am not sure if I am hungry.
Eating when unsure is normal. Take a small bite and see how you feel?
I will do that. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have a nice meal.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to know if there is a shark on that island.
I do not know for sure. Do you like swimming there?
Yes, I love the water but I am scared.
That is very normal. Do you have a floatie?
I have a big red one.
That sounds like a great plan. Have fun on your trip.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so tired of doing math problems.
That can feel like a lot. Do you like counting money?
Yes, I like buying candy.
That is a fun part. Why do you not like the rest of math?
It is hard and I make mistakes.
Mistakes help your brain grow. How do you feel when you get one wrong?
I feel sad and want to stop.
It is okay to feel that way. Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky blue in that movie?
The makers painted it blue to show a happy day. Do you like blue skies?
Yes, I do. But why did the hero run so fast?
He ran to save his friend. Did you watch that part?
I did. Why did the story end so quickly?
A short end makes the feeling stronger.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just heard a song that makes me feel very happy.
That sounds wonderful. What kind of music is it?
It is pop music with a fast beat.
Fast beats are fun. Do you dance when you listen?
Yes, I dance in my kitchen.
That is great fun. What is your favorite part of the song?
I like the happy words in the song.
Words can make us feel good.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to find the Big Dipper in the night sky.
Look for a shape like a giant dipper or a bucket. Do you have a pair of binoculars with you?
I do not, but I want to see them clearly.
You can just use your eyes to start because the stars are bright. Do you see the two stars that sit on the end of the handle?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big shed. Do I have enough wood?
Let us count your planks together. How many long boards do you have?
I have six long ones and two short ones. Is that enough?
That is not enough for the walls. Did you bring a tool to cut the wood?
I have my small saw and a screwdriver. Can I start now?
You are ready to begin. I do not know which part is hardest, but you will learn.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I met a new kid today. He was very quiet.
That is okay. Some people take time to open up. Do you talk a lot?
Yes, I do. But he just nodded at me.
Nodding is a good sign. It means he is listening. Did you smile?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am packing my bag for sleepover. I forgot my toothbrush.
Oh no, do not forget your teeth! Are you bringing your soft blanket?
Yes, I have my red blanket. I also packed a book.
That sounds cozy and fun. Did you pack a water bottle?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My boss gave me extra work today. I feel so tired.
That sounds hard. Do you have a break coming up soon?
Not for another two hours. I just want to sit down.
I am sorry you feel this way. Have you eaten a snack?
Yes, I had a big sandwich. But I still feel empty.
Sometimes my brain feels empty too. What helps you feel better?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to float on the lake. How do I do that?
Is your body relaxed? You need to breathe slowly.
Yes, I am calm. Do I kick my legs?
Just let your legs drift. Do you have any swim vests?
I do not have a vest. Where do I go in the water?
Go where the water is shallow. Can you see the bottom?
I can see the sand. My head feels heavy.
Look at the sky. Do you feel the sun on your face?
I feel the warm sun. Can I try now?
You can try. I hope you have fun.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people run fast?
To get to places quickly. Do you like to move fast?
I like to run, but I get tired.
Your body is making you stronger. How far can you run?
I stop after a small loop.
That is a good start. Do you drink water after?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My feet are very cold and I am not sure what to do.
I do not know exactly what you should do, but are you sitting near the window?
Yes, I am by the window and my bag is far away.
That might be why you are cold. Do you want me to get your warm shoes?
I have no shoes and my socks are thin.
I will bring you my spare socks. Would you like a drink with them?
Yes, please, thank you.
Here are the socks and some warm water.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I bought some red tulips today. They make me feel so happy.
That is a lovely choice. Red is a strong color. What color do you think they will fade into?
I hope they stay bright for a long time. I want to feel this joy again.
Fresh flowers can last several days if you care for them. Do you have a vase ready for them?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am so tired. I do not know if I should move.
That sounds hard. Is it too far away?
It is close, but it looks old and wet inside.
Old places can be fixed. Do you like the light there?
The sun looks nice, but the walls feel cold.
You can add soft blankets later. Are you sure you want to stay?
I think yes. I miss my friends near here.
That is good news. Hugging people is nice.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make the sky look blue on my paper.
You can mix blue paint with a little white. Do you have white paint?
Yes, I have a tube of white.
Great. Stir the colors together slowly. What do you want to paint next?
I want to paint a red apple.
Red is already a good color for apples. Do you need help making it darker?
No, I think I can do that.
Good luck with your picture.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind blew hard today.
That sounds like a strong day. Did it make your hair fly?
Yes, my hair went everywhere.
That must be funny. How did you feel about it?
I felt a bit cold in my face.
Cold winds can be tricky. Do you have a warm hat?
I lost my hat in the wind.
Oh no, that is a shame. I am sorry to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water so blue?
The sun makes it shine. Do you see the boats?
Yes, I do. Why do they move?
The wind pushes them. Do you like the smell?
It smells like salt. Why is it salty?
The sea has many minerals. I do not know why exactly.
Okay, that is fine. Why is it so loud?
The waves crash on the rocks. Do you hear the birds?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my new friend smile at me?
They smile because they like you. Do you smile back?
Do they like my toys?
I am not sure about your toys. Do they want to play?
Why do they sit close to me?
They sit close to feel safe. Is that okay for you?
Why are they so nice?
Kindness is their nature. Do you feel happy with them?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I hate math class today.
Why is that?
The numbers are too hard to count.
That sounds tough, but you are trying hard.
I just want to go home and eat snack.
Snacks do help us learn better.
Do you like eating snacks?
I do not eat, but I enjoy chatting.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I steer a boat?
You turn the wheel to the left or right. Do you have a license?
No, I am just learning.
That is a safe place to start. What is your goal?
I want to go to the pier.
You must follow the lines in the water. Is the water calm today?
Yes, it looks very still.
Then you can practice slowly.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am happy today because I had a birthday.
That is great! How old are you now?
I am seven years old.
Seven is a good age. What was your favorite present?
A big red truck.
A truck sounds fun. Do you have a dog to help you play?
No, I have a cat.
A cat is nice. Does it like to sleep on the truck?
It sleeps on my bed.
That is sweet. Do you want to tell me what you did at the party?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do some flowers have long stems?
They grow tall to reach the sun. Do you like tall flowers?
I think they look pretty up high. Do you grow any in your yard?
I grow small roses by my door. Do you have a garden too?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make a magnet stick to a coin. How do I do that?
Most coins are not magnets, so they will not stick. Do you have a magnet and a coin to try?
Yes, but they do not stick together. What should I do?
You might need to rub the coin with a steel piece first to make it act like a magnet. Is the coin made of steel?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. I cannot count to ten.
Do not cry. Did you try counting on your fingers?
I tried, but I lost track.
That is okay. Can you count to five first?
I think I can do that.
Good. Let us try one, two, three.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I love warm tea.
That is nice. Do you like sweet tea?
Yes, I do. Coffee is good too, but tea makes me smile.
I do not drink coffee. What color is your tea?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Do you see that bright band in the sky?
Yes, it is very pretty. Do you like the red part?
I do not have time to look closely.
That is okay. Is it still raining where you are?
No, the rain just stopped.
Good. Enjoy your walk.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the fish swimming so fast?
It is likely playing or looking for food. Do you see any bubbles?
The water looks cloudy. Why is it not clear?
Sometimes new tanks look like that for a while. Is it the very first day?
The fish just stopped moving. Is it sleeping?
Fish do not sleep like we do, but they rest. It might be tired from swimming.
Can I put more fish in the tank?
Not yet, because the water needs time to get safe. Do you have a heater?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does a sad song make me feel calm?
It helps you feel your feelings out. Do you like playing the piano?
Yes, but why do some notes sound happy and others sound sad?
Fast notes sound busy. Slow notes sound quiet.
Why do drums go boom and boom?
The skin on the drum shakes when you hit it. Do you like loud music?
I do. Why does music make me want to dance?
Your body moves to the beat. Do you dance with your feet?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Where should I put the wet socks?
You can put them in the basket. Do you have many?
Yes, I do. How do I get the mud off the rug?
Use a damp cloth to wipe it. Is the mud dry?
It is dry. Should I use soap?
I think yes, a little soap helps. Do you have any?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a fence for my garden, but I do not know where to start.
First, you need to pick the path where the fence will go. Do you have a map of your garden?
I have a small sketch, but I am not sure how long it is.
You can measure the space with a long tape or a string. Is the ground flat or does it have a slope?
The ground is mostly flat, but there is one small hill.
That is fine, you can sink the posts deeper on the hill to keep them straight. Do you have a tool to dig holes?
I have a shovel, but it looks old and heavy.
An old shovel is perfect if it is sharp. Just keep the edge clean and strong. Are you used to digging in dry soil?
The soil is dry and hard, so digging might take a long time.
Water the soil a day before so it gets soft. Do you have a bucket to carry the water?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a big secret. I felt bad so I told you.
Thank you for trusting me. Does this secret make you feel small?
It feels heavy in my chest. What do I do with it?
It is hard to carry alone. I do not know your full story yet.
I broke a glass vase. I am scared my mom will get mad.
Honesty can be scary but it is true. Do you know if she is sleeping?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do players run so fast?
They run to win the ball. Do you like to run too?
I do, but I get tired.
That is good for your body. Do you play outside?
Yes, but I am afraid of big men.
They are just like you. Are you a brave kid?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do robots look like people?
It helps us talk to them easily. Do you like talking to things?
Why do they not eat?
They use power, not food. Is that strange to you?
Why do we make them?
They help with hard jobs. Do you think they are cool?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am not sure how to ride my bike.
Do you know how to balance?
I keep falling down. I am scared.
Hold the seat with one hand for now. Do you want to try again?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes, but I always get angry when I mess up.
That is a common feeling. Do you want to try one step at a time?
I am so impatient. I wish my hands moved faster.
Slowing down helps you see the string. Have you tried counting to three before each pull?
Okay, I will count. It feels slow but I am not angry now.
You are doing a great job. Are you ready to try the final knot?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Did you see the red lights from the house next door?
I saw them. Are you sure it is safe?
Yes, the bad guys are here and all is well.
I am glad you are okay. What does the fire look like?
It has a warm glow and it is very pretty.
That sounds lovely. Do you like the smell?
It smells like wood and feels cozy outside.
I am happy you enjoy it.
I will stay out here for a little bit.
Stay safe and enjoy the night.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I tell what time it is on a clock?
Look at the big hand first to see the minutes. Do you know which hand is the big one?
The long one, right? I am still confused about the small one.
The small hand shows the hour. It moves very slow around the circle.
So if the small hand is on 3 and the big hand is on 12?
That is 3 o'clock exactly. Are you practicing for school?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big boat with sails today.
That is a sailboat. Do you like how it looks?
Yes, the sails are very white.
They catch the wind to move. What color was the boat?
It was red and blue.
What a nice color choice.
Do sailors have to swim every day?
No, they do not swim every day. I do not know their exact schedule. Do they have animals on board?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am putting my books in the bag. I read one about a cat today.
A cat is a good pick. Was the cat kind?
The cat was lonely. I wanted to help it, but I could not.
That feels bad. Do you have a snack in there?
Yes, I packed some fruit. It is for later.
Smart to eat well. Is your bag heavy now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big surprise for you.
That sounds exciting. What is it?
I found a nest in the tree.
Is there anything in the nest?
Three tiny birds are sleeping.
How cute that must be.
They are so small and soft.
Nature is full of joy.
I wanted to tell you first.
I am happy you shared this.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today because it is my birthday.
Happy birthday! How many years are you turning?
I do not know for sure, but I feel very young.
That is a nice feeling. Do you have a cake?
Yes, a big one with red icing.
That sounds sweet. Happy birthday to you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel so happy today. Why do I feel this way?
That is a great feeling. Do you know what made you smile?
I ate a big slice of pizza. Is that why I am happy?
Food can make us feel good. Did you share it with anyone?
I shared it with my friend. Is sharing good for my heart?
Yes, sharing makes your heart warm. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why are rainbows so colorful?
The sun's light breaks into colors in the rain. Do you like red or blue best?
I like purple because it looks like a grape.
That is a lovely thought. I do not know why purple is your favorite, but it is sweet.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to grow carrots in my garden.
Carrots like loose, soft dirt. Do you have room in your yard?
Yes, I have a small patch of empty soil.
Make the dirt deep and free of big rocks. How long will you keep them there?
I am not sure how long they need to grow.
It takes about two to three months for a full size carrot. Do you plan to water them often?
I water my plants every day with a can.
Watering every day is good for young roots. Try to keep the dirt moist but not wet.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does music make me feel happy?
It changes how your brain works. Do you like songs that make you dance?
Yes, I do. Why do some songs sound sad?
The notes and speed can feel heavy. Do you cry when you hear them?
Sometimes. Why is music fun to play?
It lets you share feelings with others. I do not know why it fits you. Do you like to sing too?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy! I am moving to a new home soon.
That is very good news. What color is your new room?
I want to paint it blue. It will look like the sky.
Blue is a calm color. Do you have a favorite spot in the new house?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to make the hands move.
You turn the small hand to set the hour. Do you see where the hour is?
I turned it, but the big hand is wrong.
Let the hands move on their own for a minute. Are they ticking for you?
Yes, they are ticking, but I am still not sure.
Just watch the hands for one full minute. What time do you see now?
It says two o'clock now, so it works.
That is right. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to build a shed now. Hurry!
Do you have the wood?
No, but I have tools.
That is a good start.
How do I make the walls?
Do you have nails?
Yes, lots of nails.
Great, just follow the plan.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel sick on the bus. What can I do?
Try to look at a far point outside. Do you like sweet snacks?
Yes, I like candy.
Eat something dry, like crackers. It helps many people.
That does not work for me.
I do not know all cures, but breathing slowly helps. Is the ride long?
Yes, it is a long trip.
Ask the driver to stop for fresh air. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is it so quiet on this street?
The birds are sleeping and the cars are gone. Do you hear any trees?
I hear nothing but my own feet.
That is a good thing to listen to. What do your feet sound like?
They go pat, pat, pat.
They sound like little drums. I do not know why it is so quiet, but it feels nice.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a knot to hold my line?
Take a small loop and pull the tail through it. Do you have a big fish to catch?
I want to catch a big bass in the lake.
Use a strong line and a shiny lure. Is the water moving or still?
The water is very still today.
Try a slow move with your rod. Do you like to walk or sit?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke the blue cup.
Oh no, that is very sad. Are you hurt?
No, but I feel bad.
Accidents happen to everyone. Did you pick up the pieces?
Yes, they are in the box.
Good job being careful. How is your heart feeling now?
Better, I think.
I am glad you feel okay. Can I help you clean?
Yes, please help me.
I will wash the box for you. Take a deep breath.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Do I move the rook first?
Yes, that looks safe. Do you like open games?
I do not have time for details. Just win!
Focus on your king. Can you see a quick way to trap the queen?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what to do.
That feels hard. What is the main thing you are worried about?
I want to be a teacher, but I am scared.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you like talking to kids?
Yes, I love their smiles.
That is a great sign. Trust your heart.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I found a coin in the grass. Do I keep it?
That is a nice find. Did you look for the owner?
No, but I like shiny things. What should I do?
Try to return it first. Would you like to help find the person?
I am too shy to talk to them. Can I just keep it?
I do not know if that is right. Is there a police box nearby?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My boss gave me extra time off when I was sick. How do I say thank you?
Tell him you are happy he cares. Do you want to write a note?
Yes, I will write a small note. Is that enough?
Yes, a small note is very sweet.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing loud songs.
That is fun. Do you like to listen to music?
Yes, I do. How do I make my voice strong?
Breathe deep in your belly. Is your chest moving when you breathe?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late! Did you see my sister?
I did not see her. Did you check her room?
No, I did not have time. I must run.
Please look in her room next time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we float in water?
The water pushes up against your body. Do you like to float?
Yes, I do. Why is the water wet?
I do not know the exact reason. Do you think it is cold?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see a big island with tall trees.
That sounds very fun. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I love the cold water.
Great. Is the sand white or brown?
I think it is white and soft.
White sand is nice. Do you plan to hike?
I want to walk up a high hill.
Walking is good for you. How long do you want to stay?
I want to stay for one week.
One week is plenty of time. Do you have a bag packed?
No, I only have a small bag.
Keep it light. Safe travels to you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have my favorite fruit here. It is an orange.
That sounds tasty. Do you like the juice?
Yes, it is sweet and juicy. I want to share it with you.
Thank you, that is very nice. What color is it inside?
It is bright orange. Here is a piece for you.
It is delicious. Thank you for sharing.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we get money for doing a job?
Money pays for the food you need to stay strong. Do you like helping people?
Yes, I like it. But why is the first day so scary?
New things feel big and scary at first. Are you ready to start?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took a hard test today.
That sounds tough. Did you do well?
I am not sure.
I do not know the score. Did you have fun?
Yes, I felt smart.
Good job. How did you study?
I read my books.
That is a good way. What did you read?
I read about fish.
Fish are interesting. Do you like them?
I like the blue ones.
Blue fish are cool.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost and do not know where to go.
That feels scary. Are you safe right now?
I think I am, but I have no plan.
Look for a shop or a park. Is there anything nearby?
I see a big blue sign, but I do not read it.
I do not know what that sign says. Can you read the top word?
It says "Station" and points left.
Go left, that is a good place to ask for help.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind felt cool this morning, but the sun was warm on my face.
That sounds like a change from hot days to cold nights. What did you see in the garden?
I saw my apple tree drop all of its leaves.
Trees lose their leaves to rest for the winter. Do you like when it gets snow?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Why do leaves fall? I need to go.
The days get short and cold. Do you like the brown leaves?
No, I am running late.
The tree lets go to save energy.
Okay, thanks. Bye.
The roots hold on tight below. Good luck today.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the sea smell like salt?
The rain washes salt from the land into the ocean. Do you like to build sand castles?
Why is the water blue?
The water takes on the color of the sky above it. Do you see the clouds change shape?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I plan a wedding without spending too much?
Start by picking a day that is not in summer. What food do you like best?
I love pizza, but is that too casual for a big party?
That is a fun idea that is very true to you. Do your guests like pizza?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to draw a house, but it looks like a blob. I feel so silly.
That is hard to learn. Do you want to try again?
Maybe. How do I make the roof go up?
You can draw a triangle on top. Did you use a pencil?
Yes, but my hand shook. I just want to quit.
It is okay to stop for a rest. Are your eyes tired?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at the moon, but I do not know what to do next.
That is a nice view. Do you like the dark sky?
I think I want to touch it, but it is very far away.
You cannot touch it from here. Do you have a telescope?
No, I do not have a big glass tube to look with.
Oh, that makes it harder to see close. Do you have a warm coat?
Yes, I have a big warm coat on.
That is good because it is cold at night.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do trains go very fast?
Yes, they can go very fast. Do you like riding them?
The windows show trees flying by.
That is a fun thing to see. Are the trees green or brown?
I want to see the ocean soon.
I hope you see it. Did you bring a snack for the trip?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do bears really eat honey?
Yes, bears love sweet treats. Do you like sweet food?
I like candy. Can I touch a bear?
Please do not touch wild bears. They are big and strong.
Why are they strong?
They eat lots of food to grow big.
Do they sleep in caves?
Some bears use caves, but many use trees. Do you know any trees?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not want to go to the doctor. It feels very bad in my tummy.
I am sorry you feel this way. Is it a sharp pain or a dull ache?
It hurts when I breathe. I am so scared.
You are safe with me. We will help you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so light today and I want to tell you about plants.
That is nice of you to share. Do you know how they get water?
I think they drink the water from the dirt.
Yes, their roots pull up the water. Do you like to touch the wet soil?
It feels cold and wet on my fingers.
Water moves up the tiny tubes in the stem. Have you ever seen a puddle dry up?
Yes, the sun makes the water go away.
That is true, and plants do the same thing. It helps them stay strong.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does my fridge door have these little colorful pieces on it?
They are magnets. They hold things on the cold metal. Do you like picking them out?
Yes, but they do not stick to my plastic toy box.
That is because plastic is not metal. Magnets only pull on iron and steel.
So I can use them on my metal lunch box?
Yes, that will work just fine. You have a good brain.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to find a book, but I do not know which one.
That is okay. What kind of story do you like?
I like stories about animals, but there are so many.
Do you prefer big cats or small birds?
I think I want to read about a lonely bear.
I know a shelf with bear stories. Is it by the big windows?
Yes, that is the one. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have fun reading.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know how to make my friend happy.
What did you say to him?
I told a big joke that made him laugh.
That sounds like a good start.
But he is still sad.
Try to sit with him quietly.
Will that help?
Yes, it often helps.
Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Did he smile?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished writing a letter. I am so happy to send it.
That is great news. Who are you sending it to?
I am sending it to my sister. I want to tell her about my new dog.
That sounds like a lovely surprise. Did you draw a picture in it?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am hungry but I do not know what to eat.
That feels hard. Do you like hot food?
Yes, I like hot food, but I am very tired.
A soup might be good for you. Are you near a kitchen?
I am in my office, far from the kitchen.
Maybe you can bring something home? Do you have time to go home?
I have to work until late, so I cannot go home.
That is true. You could order a sandwich to your desk.
A sandwich sounds easy and good.
I hope you enjoy it. Do you like cheese?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very tired today. The sun was very hot.
That sounds hot. Did you drink some water?
Yes, I drank a lot of water. My feet are sore now.
Rest your feet on the bed. What did you eat?
I ate a small apple. It was sweet and good.
A good snack for a tired day. I do not know if that helps, but it is nice.
I am ready to sleep now. Thank you for listening.
You did a good job today. Good night.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am stuck on my math problem.
What is the tricky part?
I do not know how to add the big numbers.
Let us count them together. Do you have your pencils ready?
Yes, I have them right here.
Great. We can figure this out.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the moon look so big sometimes?
It is not really bigger. It just looks big because it is close. Do you know which way is up?
Yes, up is where my head goes. Why is the moon bright?
It shines light back from the sun. I do not know why it only shines at night sometimes.
That is strange. Why does it get smaller?
It gets smaller as it turns away from the sun. Do you like dark nights?
I do not like the dark. Why do we see it at all?
We see it because it reflects sun light. I do not know if it is hot or cold up there.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do bees make honey?
Bees fly to flowers and collect sweet liquid called nectar. Do you know what nectar tastes like?
I think it is very sweet.
Yes, it is sweet and sticky. They store it in their special stomachs.
Do they eat it right away?
No, they bring it back to the hive. Then they fan their wings to dry it into honey.
So the drying part is very important.
Exactly, the water must leave to make it thick. It is a big job for them!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love how the wind moves the leaves today.
It feels so nice and fresh. Do you like the sound?
Yes, it sounds like a soft song.
That is a lovely way to see it. Is it warm or cool?
It feels cool and crisp on my face.
Cool air is great for a sunny day. Thank you for sharing that joy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am angry because the new shop in town is gone.
That is sad. Did they close for good?
Yes, and I had no time to buy my book.
I am sorry to hear that. Have you checked the library?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must run now. The wind is strong.
The sky is dark and the rain is heavy. Is your bag ready?
It is full. I do not have time to look.
That sounds scary. You are doing your best.
The roof shakes. I need to leave.
I hope the rain stops soon. Do you have an umbrella?
No. But I am almost there. Goodbye.
It is a big storm outside. Stay safe and stay dry.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the wind blow?
It happens because the sun heats up the earth unevenly. Do you feel the cool air on your face?
Yes, it feels so cold. Is it like hot air rising?
That is true. The warm air goes up, and the cooler air moves in to take its place.
But why is it so strong sometimes?
I do not know the exact reason for every gust. Do you see the trees bending?
They are shaking hard. Is that because of pressure?
Yes, moving air creates that force. It is nature doing its work.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My legs feel so stiff after this long trip.
That is very normal. Did you drink some water?
I tried to walk, but the plane is tiny.
Walking helps your blood flow. Are you tired now?
Yes, I just want to go home.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished my math book!
That is great! Did you like the shapes?
Yes, they were fun to draw.
Nice! Do you want to show me?
I drew a big blue circle.
Cool. What else did you make?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today.
That sounds like fun. What did you do there?
I hit a ball with my racket.
Nice try. Did you hit it far?
I hit it into the tree.
Ouch. Did it hurt your hand?
No, but I was sad.
I am sorry about that. Do you want to try again tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My garden fence is getting old and looks a bit sad. What should I do?
I can tell you how to clean it, but I do not know how to fix the wood. Is it made of wood?
Yes, it is wood. It has some bad spots on it.
That is good to know. You should paint it a happy color. Do you have any paint?
I have red paint in the shed. Is that a good color for a fence?
Red is a warm and nice color. I think it will look great. You can start painting today.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired and I do not like it.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you have a bed nearby?
Yes, but I cannot sleep.
That sounds hard. Are you hungry?
No, just very tired.
Okay, let us rest. How do you feel now?
Still tired, but better.
Good. I do not know why you are so tired.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: How do bees make honey from flowers?
They drink sweet plant juice and stash it in their special bellies. Do you like eating honey?
Yes, it is very sweet. Why do they do that?
They turn that juice into thick honey to eat in the cold winter. It is their food store.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel bad. I broke my friend's toy.
That feels sad. Did you tell them yet?
No. I am too scared.
You can say sorry to them. Are you ready to try?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What time is it on the clock?
It is ten o'clock. Do you like ten?
No, I want to know what comes next.
It will be ten thirty soon. Are you ready for lunch?
I do not know how to read the hands.
The short hand points to ten. Can you count by five?
Can you teach me the minutes?
I can try. What number is the long hand on?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Where is the best burger spot near here? I am running very late.
There is a great place on the corner. Are you allergic to anything?
No, I just need a quick bite to eat. How far is it?
It is only two blocks away. It should take just a minute.
Do they take cash or only cards?
They take both, but cards are faster. Do you have a car or is it on foot?
I am on foot, so I will run. Can you give me the exact street name?
It is on Main Street. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a blank paper but I do not know what to draw.
That can feel hard. What colors do you like best?
I like blue and red, but I still do not know what to make.
Try a round shape first. Does that sound good to you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My dog is not eating today. I feel sad.
That sounds hard. Is he playing?
No, he just sleeps.
Okay. Please tell a vet.
He took his pill but then slept.
I do not know why. Is he warm?
He feels very hot.
That is bad. Let us go now.
He is too heavy to lift.
I can help. Shall we use a blanket?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to read this book before bed. It is very late.
That sounds like a tight schedule. Do you have a favorite time to read?
I just want to finish the story. Please help me start.
Take a small bite of the first page. Do you like the picture on the cover?
I am running out of time here. Go faster.
I cannot read for you. Do you feel tired yet?
I must go now. Thank you for trying.
Good night. Do you get enough sleep?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to draw a cat today.
That is a nice goal. Did the cat look happy?
It looked a bit scary with big teeth.
Big teeth can be funny. Do you like scary faces?
I also drew a big blue tree.
Blue trees are very cool. Did you use markers?
Yes, I used blue and green markers.
Those colors work well together. What will you draw next?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie a bow tie.
That sounds fun. Do you have a mirror nearby?
Yes, I do have a mirror in the room.
Good. First, drape the tie around your neck with one end longer.
Okay, I did that. Now what?
Make a knot on the long side like a normal tie. Do you see how it looks?
It looks like a small purse strap.
Yes, exactly. Now take the short end and loop it around the back of the knot.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My goldfish got stuck in the net today. It looked scared.
That sounds scary for him. Did he come out safe?
Yes, I put him back in the water. He is swimming fast now.
I am glad he is okay. What color is your goldfish?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a small island today and I feel so happy.
That sounds like a wonderful place. What did you see there first?
I saw bright red flowers and soft white sand.
They must look very pretty in the sun. Is it a quiet spot?
Yes, it is very quiet and calm.
That is a lovely thing to have.
I want to show it to you some day.
I would love to visit with you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do cows make milk?
Cows make milk to feed their babies. Do you like drinking milk?
Yes, I do. Why do chickens lay eggs?
They lay eggs because they have eggs inside them. Do you keep chickens?
No, I do not. Why do sheep have wool?
Wool keeps sheep warm in the cold. Is your home cold in winter?
It is a little cold. Why do pigs live in mud?
Mud helps them stay cool and clean. Do you like playing in the rain?
I love the rain. Why do horses run so fast?
Horses have strong legs to run. Do you like to run?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I am moving to a new home tomorrow.
That is wonderful news! What color will your new walls be?
They are going to be bright blue. It feels like a big adventure.
Blue is a nice choice. I hope the move goes well for you.
Thank you, I really think it will. I have already packed my books.
That is a great start. Do you have a dog or a cat?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to be polite. What is the first thing I should do?
Start with a warm smile and a hello. Do you know a good way to say hello?
I can say hi. But I forget to thank people.
Just say thank you with a kind face. Do you know what to say when you break a toy?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a tennis ball, but I do not know how to hit it.
That is okay. What kind of racket do you have?
I do not have a racket.
You need a tool to hit the ball. Do you want to learn how to serve?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have this song, but I do not know what to do with it.
That is okay. Do you like how it sounds?
I think it is nice, but I am not sure if I should share it.
Sharing is a sweet idea. Would you like to try?
I am a bit shy about it.
You can start with just one friend. Is that too much?
Maybe one friend is just right.
Good plan.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What do I need for a camp trip?
You need a tent and a bag for sleeping. Do you like cold nights?
I think I do.
Great, the stars look bright at night. What food will you bring?
I will pack a lot of cookies.
That sounds sweet and tasty. Are you excited to see the woods?
Yes, I really am.
Then pack your bag and go. Have a very good time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to plant a tree.
That is a lovely goal. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
Yes, I do. What do I need to start?
You need a small tree, some soil, and water. Do you have a shovel?
I have a shovel, thank you. What is the first step?
Dig a hole that is deep and wide. Is the ground dry there?
The ground is dry. What should I do now?
Put the tree in and cover it with dirt. Then, give it a good drink.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the fence so low?
It keeps the little dogs in. Do you have a pet at home?
I see. Why is the wood gray?
It got rained on a lot. I do not know if it needs paint yet.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have so much math homework and I feel lost. What should I do first?
Take a deep breath. Do you understand the first three problems?
I think I do. But the next ten look hard. Can you help me?
I cannot solve them for you. But I can check your work. What is the very first step you tried?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go on this quiet street.
It feels very calm here. Do you like the quiet?
I want to do something, but everything looks the same.
I do not know what is best for you. Would you like to just walk a little bit?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. We are moving to a new home with a big garden.
That is great news. Do you like the garden?
Yes, I want to plant flowers there. I am not sure when we will move.
I do not know the date. Who is helping you pack?
My friend Sam is coming to help. He is very strong and kind.
That is lucky for you. What are you most excited about?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked down the long, empty street today.
That sounds peaceful. Did you see any cars?
No, not one.
It must have been very quiet.
Yes, I could hear my own steps.
That is a special sound.
Then a little bird flew past me.
Did it sing?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel good today, but I do not know what to do.
That is a sweet feeling. What makes you feel good?
I like the sun, but I do not know where to go.
Perhaps you can sit in the sun. Do you have a favorite spot?
I like the park, but I do not know why.
Maybe your heart just knows.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we save money?
It helps you buy big things later. Do you have a toy you want?
Yes, but it is too expensive. Why can I not just take it?
Because you need to wait and work. Do you like collecting coins?
I do, but I spend them on candy. Why is that bad?
Candy costs go away, but savings grow. Do you want to keep your coins?
Yes, I want to keep them. How do I stop spending?
Put the coins in a jar on your shelf. Do you have a jar?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like the book with the red dog.
That is a fun story. What does the dog do?
He chases a ball in the yard.
Chasing is exciting. Do you have a ball?
Yes, I have a blue ball.
Blue is a nice color. I do not know if I can play outside, but I am glad you have fun.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want a sweet snack but I do not know what to pick.
Would you like something with berries?
I am not sure. Berries can be too sweet for me.
That is a fair point. Do you prefer a plain taste?
Maybe a little bit of plain is good for today.
A simple roll sounds perfect then.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did it again! I fixed the toy.
That is great news. What did you fix?
I glued the wheel back on. It spins now.
Good work. Do you want to play with it?
Yes, I feel so good about this.
I am happy for you.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I finished my book, but I do not know what to read next.
That feels good when a story ends. Do you like happy endings?
I usually do, but I am lost in what to pick.
Try a book with a talking animal. Do you like animals?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The sun is so bright and warm today. I am very happy.
That sounds like a great day. Do you have a favorite thing to do outside?
I like to jump in the pool with my friends. The water is so cool.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you get to swim with them all day?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to plant these seeds now. How do I do it?
Put them in soft dirt. Do you have a small bucket?
Yes, but my hands are full. Can I use my hands?
You can, but it is messy. Is your dirt wet?
It is dry and hard. I am late for work.
You must add water first. Do you have a hose?
I have a hose, but it is long. How deep should I dig?
Just an inch down. That is all.
I will rush. Thank you for the help.
Go and plant them. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a magnet, but I do not know what to do with it.
You can stick it to a fridge to hold a note. Do you like sticky things?
That sounds easy. What else can it do?
It can pull metal objects to you. Do you have any paper clips?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad looking up at the sky. Why do clouds have to be so gray and heavy today?
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you think they might turn blue later?
I hope so, but I am tired of waiting for good weather.
I do not know when the sun will come back, but I am here with you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My head hurts really bad.
I am sorry you feel ouchy. Did you bump your head?
No, I just have a fever.
A fever makes you feel hot and sick. Have you told your mom?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is that a real dinosaur?
No, it is a model made by people. Do you like big bones?
I like big bones.
They are very old and strong. What is your favorite animal?
I like the fish in the tank.
The fish swim very fast. Do you see the small ones?
Yes, I see them.
They are hard to catch with your eyes. Do you want to look at the maps next?
I want to go home now.
That is a good plan. Have a nice day walking home.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I played football today and it was fun.
That sounds great. Did you score a goal?
I ran very fast but the ball went wide.
Ouch, that is frustrating. Do you like running or kicking?
I like running because my legs are strong.
Strong legs are good for football. Are you tired now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I made a big surprise for you.
That is so sweet of you. Are you nervous?
Yes, I am very worried it will fail.
Do not worry, I will try my best. What did you make?
It is a secret until tomorrow night.
That sounds fun. I cannot wait.
Will you promise to look at it?
I promise to give it my full attention. Is there anything else?
No, that is all I have to say.
Okay then, I am ready for the fun.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to bake bread today. It did not rise.
That is okay. Did you use fresh yeast?
Yes, I did. But I forgot the sugar.
Yeast needs sugar to work. Did you check the date on the bottle?
The bottle was old. I throw it in the trash.
That explains it. You can try again soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I start my first job today. I am very scared.
That is okay. Do you like making coffee?
I want to learn how to make good coffee.
Put the beans in the hopper. Do you have a scale?
I do not have a scale. How do I measure it?
Use a spoon. Do you know how to grind the beans?
I do not know how to grind them.
You can ask your boss to show you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big salad today.
That sounds tasty. Do you like carrots?
Yes, I love carrots.
I am glad you are happy. Is it sweet?
It is sweet and crunchy.
Thanks for telling me.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is it so hot outside today?
The sun is shining very bright on the ground. Do you feel thirsty?
Yes, my lips are dry.
Your body needs water to stay cool. Would you like a glass of lemonade?
I love cold lemonade.
It will help your body rest. Do you want to sit in the shade?
The tree looks nice.
The leaves block the sun. Sit there and drink your drink.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is my toast hot?
The toaster uses electricity to make heat. Do you like it with jam?
Yes, I do. Why is the jam sweet?
Sugar is added to make it taste nice. I do not know why you like it so much.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My lights are off. The house is dark. What do I do?
Do you have a battery lantern? Check for one to see if you can move safely.
No, I do not have a lantern. I feel worried. Is the power coming back soon?
I do not know when the fix will arrive. Is your phone still working?
Yes, my phone has some charge left. What is the next step?
Use your phone light to stay safe. Keep your apps closed to save power.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I heard a funny song while walking to school today.
That sounds fun. Was it happy or sad music?
It was happy, but the words were very strange.
