Strange words can be interesting. Did you learn any new words from it?
I did not learn words, but I smiled all day because of it.
Music can lift our spirits. Do you plan to listen to it again?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big mountain on TV. Is it really that tall?
Yes, mountains are very tall. Do you think you can touch the top?
No way! I would be too small. What do people do up there?
They often climb to the top to see the view. Do you like looking at big things?
I like looking at clouds. Do mountains touch the clouds?
Yes, many mountains are higher than the clouds. Do you like cold weather?
A little. It is nice and fresh. Thanks for telling me about mountains.
You are welcome. It was nice talking to you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is that tall white tower by the sea?
It is a lighthouse. It has a big light to help boats at night. Do you like looking at the ocean?
Is the light really hot?
No, the light is not hot to touch. It just shines very far out.
Who takes care of it?
A person called a keeper takes care of it. They live near the top.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I read the time on the big hand?
It shows the minutes. Do you know what one minute feels like?
I just want to know how to tell when it is quarter past.
Look for the three. Is your clock face clean?
I am still confused about the twelve positions.
Count the big numbers. Can you count to twelve?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to walk around the park.
Walking is good for your heart. Do you walk with your friends?
I just walk because I feel tired.
That is a true feeling. Rest is important too.
Is it good for my legs?
Yes, it makes your muscles strong. Do you like playing too?
I like to jump after walking.
Jumping is fun, but be careful.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to start a bug jar.
That is a fun idea. Do you like beetles?
Yes, I love them. How do I catch them?
Look under rocks. Do you have a small net?
I have a box. What else do I need?
Just a lid with air holes. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. I want to see a rainbow.
Why are you sad? Rainbows are hard to see.
It is all gray today.
That is true. Do you like the colors?
Yes, I do.
I do not know when it will come.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to finish this drawing right now. Please help me make the sun look round and yellow.
You can draw a circle first. Do you have a yellow crayon ready?
Yes, I have it. Now how do I add the rays?
Draw small lines around the circle. I hope that makes you feel fast enough.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I have a new friend. His name is Sam.
That is nice. What does he like to play?
We love to run. I must go now.
Have fun running. Do you like to race?
Yes, we race hard. Goodbye.
Goodbye. Have a safe trip home.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: What is that little bug?
It looks like an ant. Do you see its legs?
I have to run. Bye.
Okay. Do you like bugs?
No. I hate them.
Okay. Be careful.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: My chair leg is wobbly. Why is it loose?
The screw got undone over time. Do you have a tool to fix it?
I have a screwdriver. Why does it come out on its own?
Wood can move with heat and cold. Is the wood dry or wet?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My new friend left me out of the game today.
That sounds sad. Did you tell them how you felt?
I tried, but they just laughed.
I am sorry you are hurt. Do you want to find another game?
I guess I will sit on the bench for now.
Take your time. Is the bench comfortable?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Where is the red key?
I do not see the key. Is it in your bag?
No. I have checked the bag.
I am sorry I cannot help. Check the table?
The table is empty. I am in a big rush.
Look under the chair. Is it there?
Yes. You are a good helper.
I am glad you found it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so busy. Do I need to unplug the lamp?
Yes, you should unplug it. Is it safe in your home?
Why do I need to do that?
It saves power and keeps you safe. Do you know how it works?
I must go now. How do I turn off the main power?
You flip the big switch on the wall. I hope this helps you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am very tired today. I tried to fix the bike but the wheel kept spinning fast.
That sounds hard. Did you finish the job?
No, I gave up. Then I had to walk home in the rain.
Yikes, that is rough. Are you warm and dry now?
Yes, I am in bed with a blanket. My legs feel heavy.
That is good. Please rest.
Thank you. I think I will sleep now.
Good night.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why do magnets stick to my fridge but not to my shoe?
Fridge doors have metal in them that magnets love, but your shoe is made of fabric. Do you have other shiny things at home?
My silver spoon sticks to it!
That is a great find because the spoon is metal too. Do you know what else is metal?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see a little bird on the bench. Is it safe to touch?
You should not touch it, as birds can get scared. Did you see where it flew to?
It flew up into a big oak tree. Why do birds like high places?
High spots are safe from many bad animals. Do you like looking at birds?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I don't know how to move the knight.
You move it in an L shape. Do you like knights?
Yes, they jump over pieces.
That is very clever. What does your rook do?
It goes straight up and down.
It is like a big tower. Do you have a queen?
Yes, she can move anywhere.
That is a very strong piece. Good luck with your game.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My head hurts a lot.
I am sorry you feel bad. Is it a sharp pain?
It feels like a dull ache.
Try to drink some water. Do you feel warm?
I feel a little hot.
That might be a fever. Please see a doctor soon.
Okay, I will go now.
Good choice. I hope you feel better.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tripped on the cord when I picked up my cup.
Oof, that is scary. Are your toes okay?
I am fine, but the light went out.
That is a good sign. It means the trip switch worked.
I do not know why it happened.
I am not sure either. Did you smell hot plastic?
No, but the room is dark now.
Let us check the breaker box. Do you want help?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy right now. Do you know why?
I am glad you are happy. What made you smile?
It is a sunny day with warm light. I feel calm inside.
That sounds lovely. How does the sun make you feel?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to make this wood boat stay up.
That is a scary feeling, but do not worry. Have you tried pushing it into the water yet?
I am afraid it will sink because it feels too heavy.
Water pushes back up with great strength. Is the wood solid or does it have air inside?
It is solid, but I see air trapped in the wood.
That is why it floats, because the air makes it light enough. You can put it in the water now.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is my little sister going to get good at riding her bike?
She will get better with practice. Do you like helping her?
Yes, but she gets scared when she leans too far.
That is very normal for a new rider. Do you play soccer too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why is the sky blue? Please tell me.
Sunlight has all colors. Blue light bounces off the air. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I love looking up.
That makes the sky look blue to us. Nice try!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Hi, I am late. Please tell me the answer to this math problem now.
I cannot see your paper. Is the problem about adding numbers?
Yes. I have two apples and three more. How many do I have?
You have five apples. Do you understand why?
Not yet. Please say it again for me.
Two plus three is five. Do you need help with other problems too?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a great movie today about a big blue whale.
That sounds fun. Did the whale sing?
Yes, it sang a happy song. It made me smile.
Nice. Do you like sea animals?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My screen is black and I need to send this mail now.
Did you plug in the power cord?
No, the battery is empty and I am running late.
That is the problem. Is it plugged in?
Yes, but the light is not on.
I do not know why. Can you try a new charger?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to send this letter today. Is the window open?
Yes, the first window is open. Are you bringing cash?
I have cash. How long is the line?
There are two people ahead of you. Is this a big letter?
It is small. Can I use the counter faster?
That counter is for boxes only. Do you have a stamp?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sun so bright?
It burns hot fuel to make light. Do you see the sky turn blue?
Yes, I do. Why does it move across the sky?
Our world spins on its axis. Do you feel it moving?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My teacher gave me a red star for my drawing.
That is very nice. Do you like red stars?
Yes, I do. She has a little dog too.
A dog sounds fun. Is it a puppy?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does that little bird sing so loud in the morning?
It sings to mark its spot and call a mate. Do you hear any other sounds nearby?
Yes, there is one in the tree too. Why do they like my garden?
They like the food and safe spots for hiding. Do you have a fruit tree there?
I have an apple tree, but no birds are coming to eat yet. Is that normal?
Yes, they take time to trust a new place. You just have to be patient.
What should I do if they do not come soon?
You can wait and watch quietly for a while longer. Do you like watching them fly?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What time is it?
It is ten o'clock. Are you going to school?
Yes. Do I have enough time?
You have five minutes. It should work.
Is it eleven yet? I feel slow.
No, it is ten past. Is your bag packed?
Yes. Tell me again, please.
It is ten past ten. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the store today and saw lots of toys, but I put them back.
That is very smart. Did you pick out any snacks instead?
Yes, I bought some fruit because it feels good to eat.
Fruit is a healthy choice for your body.
I also skipped the ice cream because I want to save for a bike.
Saving up takes time, but it is worth it. Do you have a plan for how to save?
I am putting two dollars in a jar every week.
That is a great start. You will get there.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I put the red shirt in with the white ones. Oh no.
That is a big mistake. Do you have a new shirt?
I need to wash them now. What do I do?
Empty the machine fast. Put them in two separate piles.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a blue whale in my movie.
That is a big fish. Did you like it?
Yes, but he was sad.
Why was he sad?
His home was dirty.
That is not good for nature. Did he find a clean home?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked the long way home to see if I would meet a dog, but I met none.
That must feel quiet. Do you have a favorite dog breed?
I like the big fluffy ones. I sat on a bench and watched the leaves fall for a long time.
Watching leaves is a calm thing to do. Did the bench feel cold?
It was a bit cold, so I stood up and went inside. My house felt too big and empty without you there.
I am glad you felt better to come home. Thank you for sharing your day with me.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a big bug on my leaf and I do not know what it is.
That sounds interesting. What color was the bug?
It was green with black spots and very small legs.
It might be a ladybug or a leaf beetle. Do you like looking at small things?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need the boat fast. Where is it?
It is at the dock. Is the water calm today?
Yes, it is calm. How far is the dock?
It is very close. Do you have your bag?
I have it here. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The river is very loud today.
I hear the water rushing fast too. Is the water cold?
Yes, it feels icy on my hands.
That is a great way to stay awake. What do you see in the stream?
I see some tiny fish swimming.
How nice they look so lively. Do they have scales?
Yes, they are shiny and silver.
Shiny fish are fun to watch. Are you happy now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do stars blink when I look up?
The air shakes the light from space. Do you like looking up?
I do, but sometimes they disappear.
Clouds can hide them for a while. Do you see clouds today?
No, the sky is clear and dark.
That is a good night for stargazing. Do you know any star names?
I know one bright one called the North Star.
That is a very helpful star for finding north.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my dog wag his tail?
He does this to show he is happy. Are you playing with him?
He also likes to chase his tail. Why?
It is a fun game for him. Does he stop when he is tired?
Yes, he falls over. Why is he so silly?
Dogs love to play and run. I do not know exactly why he picks that spot.
My cat looks at him like that. Why?
The cat is telling the dog to stop. Is the cat his sister?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to go camping by the lake.
That sounds like so much fun. Do you like swimming?
Yes, I love the water.
The lake is usually cold, but it is refreshing.
I will bring my teddy bear.
A good idea for some company. What is his name?
His name is Bear.
Bear will be a great friend. Happy camping!

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a plan for lunch right now.
Let's pick a simple dish. What food makes you happy?
I want pasta, but I am late.
Pasta is fast to boil. Do you have cheese on hand?
Yes, I have cheese.
Good, mix them up. Enjoy your quick meal.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to tie my shoes.
That is a great skill to learn. Do you know how to cross the strings?
I think I do, but I get stuck at the end.
You need to make a loop with one string. Have you tried making a loop?
Yes, but it always falls apart when I pull.
Hold the loop tight with one hand. Then, pull the other string through it slowly.
It worked! Thank you so much.
I am happy you figured it out. You can do it all by yourself now.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the moon change shape each night?
It is like a ball of light that gets covered by Earth's shadow. Do you see how it gets smaller?
Yes, it looks like a cookie being eaten.
That is a good way to think about it.
Does the moon have any friends up there?
I do not know for sure, but stars are near it. Do you like looking up at night?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many sides does a circle have?
A circle has no sides because it is round. Do you like circles?
No, I have a square.
A square has four equal sides. Do you have any other shapes?
Yes, I have a triangle.
A triangle has three pointy corners. Is your triangle small or big?
It is very big.
Big triangles look very tall. Do you want to talk about triangles?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I felt happy when I won the race.
That is great news. Did you enjoy the finish?
Yes, I am very proud.
Pride comes from doing your best. Do you like running?
Sometimes it feels too hard.
It is okay to feel tired. Can you rest for a bit?
I think I just need a break.
A break sounds good.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I fix my flat tire?
First, take out the tube. Do you have a pump?
Yes, I have a blue pump. What else?
Put the new tube in and pump it up. Is the air tight now?
It feels firm. Can I ride it?
Yes, you are ready. Have fun on your ride.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared to drive alone.
That is normal. Have you practiced in an empty lot?
Yes, but it is loud on the road.
Noise gets quieter when you relax your hands. Do you wear noise-cancelling headphones?
No, they are not safe.
That is a very true thought. Keep your ears open for danger.
What if I miss my turn?
Just pull over and check your map. Do you have a GPS app?
I am sure I will fail.
I do not know your specific test, but practice helps.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Do you know where I can buy red roses right now?
Yes, there is a flower shop on the corner. Do you like red roses?
I must go. Will I have enough time to get there?
I think you can, but I am not sure. Is it a big gift?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My legs hurt from sitting all day at my desk.
That is a good sign you used your body. Do you like your little stool?
Yes, it has wheels, but I keep rolling away.
That can be tricky. Do you pause to stretch?
Sometimes, but then I forget my homework.
Trying to remember is part of learning.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say sorry?
We say sorry to show we care. Do you like to feel good after a mistake?
But I did not do it on purpose.
It is still kind to apologize. Do you want to fix the bond?
Yes, I want to fix it.
Saying sorry helps you start over. Does that make you feel better?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The wind is very loud. I feel scared.
Take a deep breath. Are you safe inside?
Yes, but the lights just went out. What do I do?
I do not know your specific rules. Do you have a flashlight?
I have a candle, but I am not sure if that is safe.
Candles are risky with wind. Do you have batteries?
I think so, but I cannot find them in the dark.
Turn off the candles first. Do you hear rain?
No, just wind and knocking. I feel a bit better now.
That is good. Stay put and wait for help.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the internet?
It is a big web of computers. Is it fun for you?
It is. How does it work?
It moves data in tiny pieces. Do you play games?
Yes. Is it safe?
Mostly, but not always. Do you have a password?
Yes. Who made it?
Many people built it over time. I do not know the first name.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do robots have feelings?
No, they do not. Do you want to build one?
I am not sure.
That is okay. What do you like to build?
I like to build cars.
Cars are fun. Do you like red cars?
Yes, I love red cars.
Red is a great color.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad that my boss moved our talk.
That sounds really hard. Did you talk to him about it?
I tried, but he only said sorry.
I am sorry you feel this way. What do you want to do now?
I just want to go home and sleep.
Resting is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How does the clock show the hour?
The long hand points to twelve, and the short hand shows the number. Do you like watching them move?
I want to set the time on my own.
You turn the short hand to the right number. Is your clock running fast or slow?
It seems to be a little late.
You must push the hand forward a bit. Do you feel the little tick when you turn it?
Yes, I hear it clicking.
That is the sound of time moving. Are you ready to check the minute hand now?
Can you tell me which hand is which?
The long one is for minutes, and the short one is for hours. Do you feel proud to fix it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I really like apples. Why do you like them too?
I love their sweet taste. Do you like them too?
Yes, I do. Why is the skin so smooth?
It helps keep the fruit fresh.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you like my favorite book about the dragon?
It sounds like a very exciting story. What does the dragon look like?
He is big and green and breathes fire. I love the part where he flies!
That must be a very loud and scary sound. Is the dragon nice or mean?
He is a little bit mean at first but then he is nice. He helps the little girl in the story.
I am glad they become friends. Do you have a picture of him?
Yes, it is on my shelf right now. Do you want to see it?
I cannot see it from here, but I am happy you share it with me. Thank you for telling me.
That is okay. I will tell you more when we meet.
I would love to hear the rest of the tale.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, but I love my book about the blue whale.
That sounds very cool. Do you like the ocean?
Yes, it is big and deep. I must go now.
Please be safe. Good luck.
Thanks, I really need to run.
Have a great day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I make my pictures look bright?
You need to face the sun. Do you have a sunny day?
I am inside right now.
Try a window with light. Is the glass clean?
It looks dusty.
Wipe it first. Do you have a cloth?
Yes, I do.
That will help a lot. Have fun taking shots.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a bad cold. My nose is blocked.
That sounds hard. Do you have a tissue?
Yes, but my head hurts too. What should I do?
Rest and drink water. Is your head hurting a lot?
It hurts when I bend over. I feel tired.
Sleep helps. Do you take any medicine?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to plan a fun party for my friends. Do you have any good ideas?
Yes, I can help with that. How many people are coming?
About ten kids will come. What should I play?
A game of tag is always a hit. Do you have a big enough room?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The city is so loud and fast today. I love it here.
That sounds like a lot of energy. Do you like the noise?
Yes, the sirens and the people talking everywhere. It feels alive.
It is true that cities are very busy. Do you walk a lot?
I walked for three hours just to see the parks. My legs hurt but I am happy.
Your legs must be tired. Do you want to sit down?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up before the sun did.
That is a very early start. Did you sleep well?
I found a lost cat in the rain.
That was kind of you to help it. Was the cat cold?
I gave it a warm blanket and some milk.
You gave it a great home for the night.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My cat is hiding under the bed.
Is he hurting, or just scared?
I do not know. He looks fine.
Try talking to him softly. Does he like treats?
Yes, he loves treats.
Place some near the bed edge.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I got my first job today. I was very happy but also a little scared.
That is a big step. How did you feel when you shook hands?
I was nervous, but the people were very kind. They gave me a tour of the place.
Kindness helps a lot. Did you feel less scared after that?
Yes, I feel ready now. Thank you for listening to my story.
I am glad you are happy. Good luck with your new work.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Who was the first person to walk on the moon?
Neil Armstrong did that. Did you know he was an astronaut?
What did he see when he looked back at Earth?
He said it looked like a beautiful blue ball in the dark. Do you like looking at stars?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to plant a seed.
That is a nice idea. Do you have a small pot?
Yes, I have one. What do I do next?
Put some dirt in the pot. Then put the seed in.
How deep does the seed go?
Just a little bit. You can cover it with dirt.
Do I give it water right away?
Yes, water it gently. When do you like to water plants?
I like mornings. Can I plant two seeds?
You can try two. It may be fun to see which grows first.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to win the game.
You catch their king to win. Do you know how the king moves?
It only goes one square at a time.
Yes, it is slow but safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I saw a plant grow after I gave it water. How does it drink?
Roots take in the water. It moves up through tiny tubes. Do you have a favorite plant?
I like my tomato plant. But why does it need to drink?
Water helps the plant make food. It also keeps the leaves cool. Do you play in the rain?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see a big brown horse in the field.
That is a very nice horse. Do you like to ride?
I do not know how to ride it.
Riding takes time and practice to learn. Do you want to try?
Yes, I want to try very hard.
That is a great goal to have. Can you brush its fur?
I can brush its fur with a brush.
That is a very kind thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people sing?
Singing helps us share feelings. Do you have a favorite song?
How do I learn to sing well?
Just listen to good songs and try to copy the sound.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is it good to eat fruit?
Fruit gives you sweet power and helps your body stay strong. Do you like apples?
Yes, I like apples. But why do I need vegetables too?
Green things help your tummy move and keep you from getting sick. I do not know if you like peas.
I do not like peas. What should I eat for energy?
Beans and bread give you fuel to run and play all day. Do you play outside?
Yes, I run a lot. Why is water important?
Water cleans your body and keeps you from getting dry. Do you drink a lot of water?
I drink some. Why should I not eat only candy?
Candy is sweet but does not fill you up with real food. I know too much sugar makes you feel tired.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The apple is red.
Yes, it is bright red. Do you like sweet fruit?
I want to buy two.
Two apples are perfect. Do you have your coins?
Here is my money.
Thank you. I will bag them for you.
Can I smell it?
Yes, go ahead. It smells very good.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel so tired today.
That happens when your body needs rest. Are you sleeping well at night?
Yes, I think so.
Sometimes we use a lot of energy in play. Did you run a lot today?
I ran a little, but not much.
Maybe you ate less food than usual. Did you have a big lunch?
I only had a small sandwich.
Your body needs food to make energy. Let us find some snacks now.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found the best book ever. It makes me feel so warm.
That sounds lovely. What is it about?
It is about a bear who loves honey.
Bears are cute. Does the bear share his honey?
Yes, he gives it to his friends.
That is very kind of him.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the internet?
It is a big web of computers that share things. Do you use it to play games?
How does it get so fast?
It runs through tiny glass tubes at lightning speed. Do you like watching videos?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I love that song. It makes me smile.
That is nice. What is the name of the song?
I do not know. I am late for work.
Do not worry. Will you play it for me later?
Maybe later. I must run now.
Have a good day. I will wait for your answer.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My chair leg is loose.
Oh no. Do you have a wrench?
Yes, I think so.
Great. It is probably a loose screw.
Where is the screw?
Look under the seat. Do you see a big bolt?
I see it, but it is tight.
Push down on the seat. Then turn the wrench.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy. How do I say sorry?
Tell them it was your fault and ask if you can fix it. What is the toy?
It is a little car.
A little car is easy to fix. Do you have tape?
No, I do not have tape.
Then just say you feel bad for breaking it. Do they like cars?
Yes, he loves cars.
Tell him you would love to help build a new one together. That is a kind offer.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a warm loaf of bread today.
That sounds so delicious. What did you put in it?
Just flour, water, salt, and yeast.
Oh, a classic recipe. Did you use a big bowl?
Yes, it took up the whole counter.
That must have been fun to watch. Do you like to eat it plain?
I love it with warm honey.
That is a sweet treat. Thank you for telling me.
I am glad you are happy.
I am very happy. You should go eat some now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with these old boats.
That is a big problem. Do you like to fix things?
I think I am lost at sea.
I do not know the answer. Do you have a map?
I just want to help the sailors.
That is a good heart. Can you read?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the harbour today.
That sounds fun. Did you see any boats?
Yes, there were big boats and small ones.
Big boats are cool. Did you get close to the water?
I sat on a bench near the edge.
Nice spot. Did you buy any snacks there?
I bought a cracker from a cart.
Yum. Did you share it with anyone?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I moved to a new town today and I am so happy!
That is great! What is the first thing you see from your house?
A big blue lake with ducks swimming in it.
How nice. Do the ducks like people?
Yes, they come right to the edge to get food.
They seem friendly. Do you plan to visit the lake often?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I tried to fix the bike, but it broke again. I must go now.
That feels bad. Do you want a second try?
No, I am too late. I will just walk.
Walking is safe. Are your feet okay?
Yes, I am fine. I need to run.
Good luck. Is it far?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: Can you help me learn to ride a bike?
Yes, I would like to. What part feels the hardest?
I am afraid of falling over.
Hold my hand first. Do you want to try in the park?
Yes, I will sit on the seat.
Good, keep your eyes up. Are your feet on the pedals?
Yes, I can feel them now.
Great, push off slowly. Do you feel steady?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I kicked the ball into the park wall today.
Oh no. Does your foot hurt?
No, but I feel sad.
That is a shame. Do you play often?
Yes, I play every day.
You are very good. Did you hit it hard?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad because the boats are gone and the water looks grey.
The sea is quiet today. Do you like the sound of the waves?
No, I just want to play but the sand is wet and cold.
That is a shame. Would a warm drink help you feel better?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked down the long street this morning. It was so quiet that I could hear my own feet.
That sounds like a peaceful place to start the day. Did you see any birds?
Yes, a blue bird sat on the fence for a while. It watched me with its small round eyes.
It is nice to see a friendly neighbor like that. Was the bird singing?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do clouds float in the sky?
The wind pushes them around. Do you like fluffy clouds?
I like the big ones. What makes them white?
Sunlight shines on tiny water drops. Do you see blue ones too?
Yes, sometimes they look dark. Why do they turn dark?
That means it is raining soon. Do you like the rain?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The lake water looks gray today. Is it bad for swimming?
I do not know the water quality. Do you see any signs on the shore?
There is a sign that says "No Swimming". Why is that?
It is likely unsafe or polluted. Thank you for checking the sign.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I found a song today that makes me feel really good.
That sounds lovely. What kind of music is it?
It has happy drums and a bright guitar.
I love bright sounds. Do you listen to it often?
Yes, I play it every time I wake up.
What a happy start. Does it help you smile?
It makes my whole day feel light.
Music can do that. I am glad you found it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big star that looked like it was winking at me.
That sounds fun. Did you wave back at it?
I did, but I also spilled my milk on the floor.
Oh no. Did you clean it up?
Yes, I used a towel and felt very tired after.
You did a good job. Can you see the bright stars now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late and I feel very bad.
That feels scary, but you can take a deep breath. What is making you so worried?
I might miss the bus and fail my test.
We do not know that yet, so do not guess.
Please help me think, I have no time.
Focus on the next small step. Are you packed?
Yes, I am ready to go now.
Good, just walk slow and trust yourself.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Did people really live in caves?
Yes, a long time ago, they did. Do you think that was cozy?
No way, it must have been dark.
It was, but they used fire for light. What color is a fire to you?
Orange and red.
Exactly, it was warm and bright. Do you like the sound of rain?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost the game again. I am so mad.
That is hard. Did you try a new move?
I just moved my queen too early. It died fast.
Queens are strong. Do you play at home?
Yes, but I always miss the traps. I feel dumb.
You are learning. Mistakes help you grow.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a hurt bird. I do not know what to do.
That is kind of you. Is it moving?
It is still. I want to help it.
Put it in a warm box. Do you have one?
Yes, I do. I am doing that now.
Great job. Please stay calm.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just learned about big ships.
That is very cool. Do you like boats?
Yes, I do. They sailed across the sea.
The sea is wide. Why did they go there?
To find new places and goods.
Good things. Was it scary?
A bit, but they were brave.
I do not know the exact date.
It was a long time ago.
I see. Is it still fun to learn?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I know what time it is?
Look at the clock. The short hand shows the hour. Do you see two hands?
Yes, I see two hands. The long one is on twelve.
That means it is a full hour. The short hand points to three. Is it morning or night?
It is morning because I am at school. What is the time now?
It is three o'clock in the morning. Does that feel right to you?
No, that feels wrong. It is definitely noon.
I am sorry, I was not careful. It is three o'clock in the afternoon. Are you happy now?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why are some clouds white and some are dark?
Dark clouds are thick with water. Do you see a rainbow nearby?
No, just the gray shapes above me.
I do not know what is there. Are you feeling sad?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sand so warm?
The sun heats it up fast. Do you like hot sand?
Yes, it feels nice.
That is good for your feet.
Why is the water cold?
It takes time to warm up. Does the sea look blue to you?
Yes, it looks deep.
It is very deep there.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did he move so far away?
I think he wanted a change. Do you miss him?
He stopped calling me.
I do not know the reason. It is strange.
Do you think he still likes me?
Yes, I am sure he does. He was always kind.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the ball round?
A round ball rolls smoothly on the grass. Do you like kicking it?
Why do we wear socks?
Socks stop your feet from hurting in boots. Do your feet hurt sometimes?
Why do we stop and start?
We stop to pass the ball and start to run for it. Do you run fast?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my grandma laugh so much?
She feels very happy when she sees you. Do you like to make her smile?
Yes, I do. But why is her hair all white?
That happens when people get very old. Do you want to know why?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My screen is very dark and I cannot see the pictures.
That is not good. Do you see a small button with a sun on it?
Yes, I see it, but it does not work.
Try holding the plus key and the D key together. Did that help?
No, it is still dark. What should I do now?
I do not know for sure. Is your computer making any strange sounds?
It is making a loud whirring noise.
That might be bad. Please turn it off to be safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because my camera broke right now.
I am sorry to hear that. What did you see in your pictures?
I was taking a picture of a cat and the screen went black.
That is very tricky. Do you have any other lenses?
No, I only have this one lens and it feels useless.
It might just need a new battery. Have you tried turning it off?
I tried that twice but it still will not start up.
It is probably a small part that needs fixing. Are you good at fixing small things?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The rain is hard against my window. I do not know if I should go out.
That sounds scary. Do you have a warm coat?
Yes, but my shoes are dry and I want to keep them that way. What should I do?
Maybe just watch the drops? Do you like the sound?
It is quite loud. I think I will just stay inside and read a book.
That sounds like a good plan. Have fun reading.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the box wrapped in blue paper?
I picked blue because it matches your eyes. Do you like blue?
I like it. But why the red ribbon?
Red adds a pop of color. Is red your favorite color?
Yes, it is. Why did you choose this specific doll?
I remembered you wanted a friend for game night. I hope you will enjoy her.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I make my tomato plants grow tall?
Water them well and put them in the sun. Do you have a sunny spot in your yard?
I have a big window, but is that enough light?
Windows can work, but they may not be hot enough. How many tomatoes do you want to grow?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to build a shed in my yard. How do I start?
First, you must measure the space. Is your yard big enough?
It is plenty big. What do I use for the walls?
You can use wood boards. Do you like the look of wood?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my teacher look so tired today?
She probably worked late on new lessons. Did you see her smile at you?
Yes, she did. But why is she not happy?
I do not know for sure, but she cares about you a lot. Is she crying?
No, but she looks sad. Why do people get sad?
Sometimes things just feel hard to do. Do you want to draw her a picture?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I must go, but my boss is so kind.
That is great. Do you work there?
Yes, he helps me a lot.
Nice. Is he nice to others?
Yes, he is very sweet.
Good for you. Why are you in a rush?
I am late for work.
Go now. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am very late for my bus. What should I do?
Run fast to the stop. Do you have your ticket?
Yes, I have it, but I am still worried. Will the bus wait for me?
I do not know for sure. Did you tell the driver you are coming?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to hike a big mountain. What do I need?
You need good shoes and a warm coat. Do you like cold weather?
I like it when it is cool, but not freezing. How high should I go?
Start with a small hill first to practice. Have you hiked before?
No, I have only walked on flat paths. What else should I know?
Bring plenty of water and a snack. Do you know where the nearest trail is?
I do not know the map. Can you help me find a path?
I do not know your exact location. Please look at a local map guide.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my soup on the carpet today. It made a big brown mess.
Oh no, that sounds frustrating. Did you get to clean it up?
Yes, I used all the paper towels in the office. Now I am very hungry and tired.
You must be ready to eat. What is for lunch today?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I want to tell you about it.
That makes me smile too. What is making you feel this way?
I learned how to count to ten. It is very fun.
Ten is a big number for you. Do you like it when you get to the end?
Yes, I do. I clap my hands at ten.
Clapping sounds like a happy sound. Do you want to count with me?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big brown horse in the park today. It was eating grass by the big tree.
That sounds like a calm and nice sight to see. Did the horse have a name on its tag?
I do not know if it had a tag. It just looked very happy and relaxed.
It is always good to see animals feeling safe. Do you hope to pet it next time you visit?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big white cloud today that looked just like a fluffy dog. It floated by my window while I ate my lunch.
That sounds very fun. Do you have a pet dog at home?
No, I do not, but I like to look at the sky. The sun came out right after the cloud moved away.
That is a nice change in the weather. Do you like sunny days or rainy days better?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I fixed my computer today.
That is great news. Did you feel proud of yourself?
Yes, it works fast now.
Wow, that is awesome. Do you know how it got fixed?
I just clicked a button.
You are so lucky. Happy coding!

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The smoke from the fire is everywhere.
That is very scary. Are you safe right now?
Yes, we are home, but I hate it.
I am glad you are safe. Do you have water?
I have some, but I do not know if it is enough.
I do not know how much you need. Just drink a little.
My eyes hurt from the smoke.
That is a bad sign. Do you feel okay?
I feel sick and tired.
Please rest now. I will stay with you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am not happy here. The town is too loud and I miss my home.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you like the quiet park at the edge of town?
I have not been there yet. It feels like I do not belong here.
That is a hard feeling to carry. Give it a few days and things might feel nicer.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big blue bird land on my fence this morning.
That sounds like a nice start to your day.
It looked at me, then flew away to the big tree.
Do you know what kind of bird it was?
No, but I hope it comes back tomorrow for more crumbs.
Birds love a friendly neighbor.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a hot pizza for lunch today.
That sounds very tasty. Did you share any of it?
Yes, I am eating with my friend.
That is very kind of you. What else is in the box?
We have cold soda and warm bread.
I did not know you had bread there. Is it sweet or salty?
The bread is salty and good.
I am glad you are having a good time. Do you like your job?
Yes, my team is very nice.
That is a wonderful thing.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The lights are out and I am scared.
I am here with you. Do you have a flashlight?
I found one, but it does not work.
Try shaking it gently. Is the battery still inside?
Yes, it is inside, but it is still dark.
That is strange. Can you see the switch on the wall?
I see it, but pulling it does not help.
I do not know why it failed. Did you hear any loud noise?
No, it just went dark all of a sudden.
The power may be low outside. Do you have warm clothes?
I am wearing a thick coat right now.
Good, that will keep you safe. I will stay by you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we bring bread to the park?
Bread is soft and tastes good. Do you like grapes?
Yes, I do. Why is the grass green?
Plants need sunlight to make their food. What is your favorite color?
Blue. Why is the sky that color?
I do not know the exact reason. Do you want a cookie?
Yes, please. Why is it so sweet?
Sugar makes it taste nice. Thanks for asking.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the sky so dark and loud?
The wind and rain are mixing fast. Is that scary for you?
The trees are shaking hard. Why do they do that?
The strong air pushes the branches around. Do you see any leaves fall?
I see the ground getting wet. Why is the water here?
Clouds hold water and drop it when full. Are you staying dry?
The clouds look very angry. Why are they grumpy?
Cold and warm air fight inside them. Do you hear thunder?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished my letter to my friend. I am so happy.
That is wonderful to hear. What did you write about?
I told him about my new dog. He has a tail that wags all day.
A wagging tail is a great thing. Does he like to play?
Yes, he loves to chase balls. I hope my friend gets it soon.
He will surely be glad. Do you have a stamp ready?
Yes, I put it on the front. I am going to the post office now.
That sounds like a good plan. Have fun on your walk.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. How does the clock tick?
It has a spring or battery that gives it power. Do you have enough time to catch your bus?
Can you make it go faster?
I cannot change the speed of time. Are you scared of being late?
No. Just tell me what makes it move.
Gears inside turn the hands around the face. Do you want to fix it later?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does it get cold in winter?
The Earth tilts away from the sun. Do you like the snow?
Yes, I do. Why is summer so hot?
The Earth tilts toward the sun then. It feels warm. Do you like playing outside?
I do. Why do leaves fall in autumn?
The days get shorter and colder. Trees rest. Do you like picking apples?
Sometimes I do. Why do flowers grow in spring?
The sun is back and it is warm. I do not know every flower. Do you see them?
I do. Why do we have four seasons?
It is the Earth moving around the sun. Thank you for asking.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does the sky look so blue?
The air in the sky scatters blue light. Do you see how blue it is today?
Not really, it looks a bit gray.
That happens when there is much dust or smoke in the air. It changes the color we see.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a strange bug in my room. Do I kill it or let it go?
Let it go if it is just walking around. Do you see any stingers on it?
No, it is just a big black beetle with shiny legs.
That sounds safe. Put it outside in the grass.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy today. I want to share this good feeling with you.
That is lovely to hear. What made you smile today?
I helped a friend fix a broken toy. It was very fun.
You are a kind helper. Did the toy work well?
Yes, it moves again. I feel warm inside.
Your heart is full of joy. I am glad for you.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I put a new blue fish in my tank today.
That is a lovely color. Does he like the new home?
He is hiding behind the rock right now.
He must be a little shy. Do you have a name for him?
I call him Bluey. He came in a small bag.
What a sweet name. Did he eat any food?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found two red apples in the grass today. They were round and shiny.
That is a lovely find. Did you wash them before eating?
I washed them very well with water. They tasted sweet and crisp.
How nice. Do you like apples more than pears?
I love apples, but I also like pears. I want to collect both kinds now.
That sounds like a fun hobby. Do you have a box to put them in?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the door always open?
It is open so you can walk in easily. Do you like that?
Is the milk inside good?
I do not know for sure, but it looks fresh.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am lost and very scared.
Do not worry. Is it near where you started?
I think so, but I am not sure.
Look for your car. Do you know what color it is?
It is red with a blue cap on top.
Head toward the big tree. Did you see one nearby?
Yes, a huge oak with a bench.
Go to that bench. You should be safe.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do bakers use so much sugar?
It makes the bread taste sweet. Do you like sweet foods?
Why does the bread get all puffy inside?
The yeast makes tiny bubbles that stretch the dough.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the water so still?
The wind is sleeping. Do you see the boats?
Why do the boats sit so quiet?
They are resting in the bay. Do you like the smell?
Why does it smell like fish?
The nets came in wet. I do not know all the smells.
Why is the sky gray?
Clouds are gathering rain. Do you have an umbrella?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does the moon change shape?
It does not really change. We just see different parts of the light. Do you have a telescope?
No, I do not.
That is okay. Your eyes are fine for looking up. What else do you wonder about?
How far away is it?
It is very, very far away. I do not know the exact number.
Is it hot or cold?
It is very hot in the sun and very cold in the dark. Do you like cold things?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I buy a red apple?
You point at the red apple and say I want this one. Do you like sweet apples?
I like sweet ones, yes.
Great, the round ones are usually sweet. Do you have your bag ready?
Yes, my bag is here.
Put the apple in the bag and pay the person. Was that easy to understand?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat at my desk and made coffee.
That sounds like a nice start. Did you like the smell?
Yes, it made me feel warm. Then my cat jumped on the chair.
Cats are very cuddly. Do you let him stay?
I had to shoo him away gently. He left me alone for a while.
He was not in trouble. How did the work go?
I finished two big tasks. My brain felt tired but happy.
That is a great feeling. Did you take a break outside?
Yes, I looked at the sky. It was very blue and clear.
Nature is always a good reset. Do you plan to keep working?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very sad today. Why?
Sadness often comes when we miss something or someone. Do you miss a person or a place?
I do not know why I feel this way. Can you tell me?
I cannot read your mind, but feelings often need a reason to settle. What was happening right before you felt this way?
I just woke up and felt heavy. Is that normal?
Yes, waking up tired can make feelings feel bigger. Have you eaten something warm yet?
I have eaten some toast. Does that help the sadness?
Warm food can make the body feel more safe and calm. It helps, but it may not fix everything.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I swept the dust under the sofa.
That is a big job. Did you find any lost toys?
Yes, I found a blue ball.
Lucky you. Do you want help with the rug next?
The rug looks very dirty today.
We can vacuum it together. What color is your brush?
It is red and very small.
Great. Let us clean the corners now.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Can my fridge stick the door shut?
Yes, magnets pull metal doors shut. Do you have a strong magnet?
No, I have two little ones. Will they work?
Two small ones may be too weak. Did you try pushing them together?
I do not have time to test it. Can I leave now?
Yes, you should go. I am not sure if your specific magnet will hold.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you play on the swings?
No, I sat on a big red bench.
A red bench sounds warm. Was it sunny?
Yes, the sun was very bright.
You must have felt nice and cozy. What did you see from the bench?
I saw a dog chasing a ball.
That is a happy sight. Did the dog get the ball?
Yes, he caught it in his mouth.
What a good dog.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very tired today. Should I drink tea or coffee to wake up?
Coffee wakes you up very fast. Do you like sweet things?
Yes, I love sweet drinks. But I get a bad feeling with coffee.
Tea is softer and gentler for your body. It will still help you stay awake.
That sounds good. Which tea should I pick?
I do not know what you like best. Do you like hot or cold drinks?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I put my bright red shirt in with the white ones and now everything is pink. I am so sad.
Oh no, that is a big mess. Do you know if your red shirt is new?
Yes, it is new and I really loved it. What do I do now?
I think you have to wash them all again with lots of soap. Are you willing to try?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big oak tree in the park today.
That sounds nice. What color were the leaves?
They were mostly green, but some were turning brown.
The season is changing. Did you touch the bark?
Yes, it was rough and cold to the touch.
Nature is always changing. Do you like walking in parks?
I do, but my legs hurt from all the walking.
Rest is good for tired legs.
I sat on a bench near a small maple tree.
Trees give us good spots to rest.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I swap a light bulb?
First, turn off the switch to cut the power. Do you have a new bulb ready?
Yes, I have a new one.
Wait until the old one cools down. Twist it out and put the new one in.
Is it safe to touch the base?
I am not sure if your specific lamp is safe. Please check the manual first.
I will look it up now.
That is a good step. Is the glass clean?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am so confused about my math homework.
Math can be tricky. What part is hard?
The big numbers are too many for my brain.
Try breaking them into small piles. Do you have any paper?
Yes, I have a big sheet here.
Great, write one number on a new line. That will help.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to send this file right now, but my signal is weak.
That is tricky to fix in a rush. Do you have a battery pack?
No, my phone is almost dead and I cannot wait.
Go to the cafe two doors down. It has strong wifi and free plugs.
Is the connection there really fast?
I do not know the speed, but it is popular. Do you carry a charger?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do players kick the ball into the net?
They do that to score a point. Do you like watching games?
I love them, but the rules are hard.
I agree. It takes time to learn. What part confuses you?
I do not get how the clock works.
The game has two halves. I do not know the exact timing rules. Do you play with a ball too?
Yes, I play in my yard.
That sounds fun. Keep practicing. Have a great day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at the water, it is so blue and bright.
It looks very nice today. Do you like to swim there?
Yes, it is very fun to jump in.
That sounds like a great time.
The fish are dancing right there under the boat.
I have not seen any, but that is cool. Are they big?
Some are small, but one was as long as my arm.
Wow, that is a big fish.
I am so happy to see this river again.
I am glad you are having fun too.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I need to pick a dress for the big day.
That sounds like fun! What colors do you like?
I love blue and green.
Nice choices. Do you want to see blue first?
Yes, let us start with blue.
Great! Here is a pretty blue dress.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am hungry but I do not know what to eat.
That feels hard. Do you like warm food or cold food?
I think I want something warm like toast.
Toast is a good choice. Do you want to make it yourself?
Maybe, but I am not sure if I have time.
I do not know how much time you have. Is it a quick morning for you?
Yes, it is very fast. I will just have some toast.
That sounds like a great plan. Have a nice breakfast.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you sell red apples?
Yes, we have many. Do you like sweet fruit?
I am looking for a big basket.
We have a good one. Do you want to see it?
Is it open on Sunday?
I do not know for sure. Do you go on weekends?
Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a nice day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many fingers do we have?
We have ten fingers. Do you know your own?
Yes, but why are there ten?
That is just how humans are made. Can you count them?
I can try, but I am not sure.
Try starting with one. Are you ready?
One, two, three, four, five.
Great start. What comes after five?
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
You did a wonderful job.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My head hurts bad. I do not like it.
I am sorry you feel this way. Do you have a cloth to put on your head?
No, I do not have one. I am very tired.
A cool washcloth might help. Did you drink some water?
I did not drink anything today.
Please drink some water now. I do not know if that will fix it all.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do leaves fall off trees in the fall?
The days get shorter and colder, so trees save energy. Do you like playing in the leaves?
Yes, it is so much fun to jump in them.
That is nice. The tree lets the leaf go to keep itself safe through winter.
Does the tree feel sad when the leaves leave?
It does not feel sad, but it slows down to rest. Have you seen any bare trees yet?
I saw a big oak tree with no leaves yesterday.
That tree is waiting for spring to grow again. Do you know when that comes?
I think it is when it gets warm again.
You are right, the warmth wakes the tree up.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel very lonely today.
I am sorry you feel that way. Is your house quiet?
Yes, it is very quiet. Why do I feel this way?
I do not know for sure. Do you miss your friends?
Maybe I do miss them. What makes people feel alone?
It happens when we want to be with others. Do you like being alone?
No, I do not. How can I stop feeling this?
I suggest you call someone you know. Would you like to try?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to build a shed but I do not know where to start.
A good place to start is picking a spot in your yard. Do you have a sunny corner for it?
I think the back yard is free, but the ground looks soft.
Soft ground might make the shed sink, so you need to lay a hard base first. Is the dirt wet there?
Yes, it is damp from the rain. What do I use for the walls?
I do not know your budget, so I cannot say what to buy. Do you have wood or metal?
I have some old wood left over. Can I use that?
Old wood is fine if it is strong and dry. How big do you want the door?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the meeting moved?
The room was booked for a show. Do you need a new time?
Who picked the new room?
I did not check the list. Is the new room okay for you?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The boats are gone.
That feels lonely, doesn't it? Do you miss the waves?
Yes. The water looks too quiet.
Quiet can be nice. Was it noisy before?
It was loud and fun. Now it is just grey.
Grey days can be tricky. Do you like the rain?
Not today. I want to go on a boat.
I do not know when boats return. Would you sit by the edge?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like snow days.
Snow is fun to play in. Do you build snowmen?
Yes, I build big ones.
That sounds great. Do you have a red nose for him?
No, I use a carrot.
A carrot is perfect. I do not know where you live, but it sounds nice.
I live near a park.
A park is a good place. Do you see your friends there?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am collecting smooth stones from the park.
That is a lovely idea. What color is your favorite stone?
It is white and feels like a little egg.
How nice. Where do you keep them all?
In a big blue box on my shelf.
A box is a safe place. Do you have a lot of them?
Yes, I have many. I like to look at them at night.
That sounds very peaceful. Do you have a name for the biggest one?
I call it Mr. Round. He is my best friend.
What a kind name.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Why does the light blink when I run?
The wire might be loose. Do you see any sparks?
I have to leave, no time to look!
Then unplug it for now. Is it done?
Yes, I am going!
Be safe. Do you have a plan to fix it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to kick the ball hard.
Put your non-kicking foot down and aim for the middle of the ball. Do you have a pair of cleats on?
Yes, I do. How do I keep my balance?
Look at the ball, not the ground, and swing your leg through it. Is your leg feeling tired?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I do not like the bear in my play. He is too scary.
Why does the bear scare you?
Because his teeth are very big and sharp.
You can make his teeth smaller if you wish.
Will that make him nice?
Yes, a small tooth makes a gentle bear. Do you have a box for the costume?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big, bright rainbow when I walked to school.
That sounds lovely. Did it touch the ground?
No, it ended in the sky, but it made me feel happy.
How wonderful that is. What color was your favorite part?
I loved the red because it looked warm like a fire.
That makes sense. Do you like to draw rainbows too?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on this puzzle.
That is okay. Do you like puzzles?
Yes, I do.
Look at the edges first.
The edges are hard to find.
Try looking for a picture.
I see a blue bird.
Is the bird happy?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to get to the lake right now. I am late.
That sounds stressful. Is it a big lake?
It is a small pond behind my house. I forgot my book.
Do not worry about the book.
I am already at the shore. The water looks very cold.
That is best for your skin. Are you going to swim?
No, I just need to feed the ducks.
Duck feeding is fun.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited for the bus and it was very slow.
That can feel like a long time. Did you read a book?
No, I just watched the leaves fall.
That sounds nice and calm. What color were the leaves?
They were brown and orange.
I like autumn colors. Do you like them too?
Yes, they look soft.
Soft things help us stay calm.
I think I am getting better at waiting.
I am glad to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have some coins. What should I do with them?
You can put them in a safe place. Do you have a jar?
Yes, I do. I am happy.
That is a good start. Just be careful not to lose it.
Okay, I will be careful.
Great. Try to save a little bit each day. How does that sound?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I save a picture from the web?
You can right-click the image and choose "Save As." Do you know how to find that menu?
I am trying to send a file to a friend.
Click the share button on the screen to send it. Is the file big or small?
I want to make my words bigger when I type.
Look for the "A" button that says "Aa" near the top. Did you find it?
How do I stop all the pop-up ads?
I do not know which ad you mean. Can you describe where it appears?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a strange toy that makes a loud noise when I twist it.
That sounds fun. Do you know what the toy is?
I do not know. It looks like a small box.
Nice thinking. Can you open the box?
I tried, but it will not open.
I do not know how to fix it. Have you checked for a key?
I looked inside, but there is no key.
You are a good helper. What else can you do?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I lost my red pen and I need it for the test.
Oh no, that is scary. Did you check your bag?
I did, but it is not there.
Let us look under your desk next. Do you have a plan for lunch?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a tennis ball but I do not know how to play.
That is a good start. Do you have a racket?
No, I do not have a racket. What should I buy?
You need a small racket to start. Is this for you or a kid?
It is for me, but I am not good at sports.
That is fine, we all start somewhere. Do you like to throw things?
Yes, I throw things well sometimes.
Then you will do great with tennis. It is mostly throwing the ball back and forth.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I put my red shoes in the bag. They are very clean. I walked a long way to get them.
That sounds like a good walk. Are you going to a special place?
Yes, I am going to the park. I also packed a small apple for later.
An apple is a great snack. Do you like playing on the swings?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to count my apples.
That is fun. Do you have any red ones?
Yes, I have three red apples.
Three is a good number. What do you do with them?
I eat them one by one.
Yummy. Do you share with friends?
I share with my best friend.
That is kind of you. How many are left?
Now I have zero apples.
All gone. Did you enjoy the last one?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see smoke coming from the kitchen. What should I do first?
Get everyone out of the house right away. Is everyone safe now?
We are out. How do I call for help?
Dial 911 and stay on the line. Do not go back inside.
I am calling. What do I say to the operator?
Tell them your address and that there is a fire. I do not know your exact location, but they will guide you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I see a lot of light in the window.
Oh no, is that a fire? Are you safe inside?
Yes, I am safe. What should I do next?
Call the fire department. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I have my phone. Do I leave the house now?
No, stay inside. Are the doors warm to touch?
No, the doors are cool. I will wait for help.
Good. Breathe slow and calm.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the baby cry?
It is likely hungry or needs a clean diaper. Is it loud?
Why is it so quiet at night?
It sleeps a lot to grow strong. Do you rest too?
Why does it look at me?
It is learning your face. Is it smiling?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I picked these red flowers. I am so happy today.
They look bright and warm. What made you feel so good?
The sun was shining on my face. I wanted to give them to you.
That is a very sweet thought. Thank you for sharing them with me.
I love how they smell fresh. Do you like the color red?
Yes, I think red is a happy color. It feels like the sun.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the doctor today because my tummy hurt.
Oh no, that sounds uncomfortable. Did the doctor find anything wrong?
He said I ate too many cookies, so I need to rest now.
Well, you should listen to him. Do you feel better now?
Yes, I am sitting on the couch and drinking water.
That is very good for you.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at my new fish! I am so happy.
They look very cute. Do they like the red parts?
Yes, they chase the food right away.
That is a good sign. Are you fed them enough?
I put in a few flakes each day.
That seems like a smart way to care for them. Do they swim fast?
One swims very quick, but the other is slow.
Some fish are just like that. Is the water warm?
It feels warm when I put my hand near it.
Good, they need the right heat to feel well.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have a box with four red balls and two blue balls. If I pick one out in the dark, what color is it?
It could be either red or blue. Do you know how many blue ones are left?
I do not know for sure. I just want to guess right.
That is tricky. Have you tried to shake the box first?
No, I have not. Is that a good idea?
Yes, it helps you feel the weight. Do you think the blue ones feel different?
Maybe, but I am not sure. I will try it now.
Good luck with your guess.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have these shapes but I do not know what to do with them.
That sounds fun. Do you see any circles?
I see a red circle and a blue square.
Good look. What do you want to make?
I do not know. I am lost.
Do not worry. I can help you start.
Can you just tell me what to do?
I cannot know your idea, but you can start with the circle.
Okay. I will put the circle first.
Nice work. You did it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I made soup for dinner. I cut an onion and it made me cry.
That happens to many people. How did the soup taste?
It was warm and good. I felt happy.
I am glad you enjoyed it. Do you like to cook often?
I love making food. It is fun for me.
That is a lovely way to spend time. What did you put in the soup?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I broke my favorite cup by accident. I feel so bad about it.
I am sorry it broke. Do you still have the pieces?
Yes, they are all on the floor. I am not sure if I can fix it.
We can try to glue it back together. Are you willing to try?
I guess I can try. It looks very sharp.
Be careful with your hands. Let us clean up the floor first.
Okay, I will sweep the glass. Thank you for helping me.
You did a good job cleaning.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to help my dog eat.
That is very kind. How is he feeling?
He looks sad.
Sad dogs need love and rest. Do you have a ball?
Yes, I have a red one.
Toss it gently for him.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start this paper.
Do not worry. What topic did your teacher pick?
It is about a book I did not like.
That is hard. Pick one part that you understood well.
I do not know which part to pick.
Can you tell me what the book is about?
It is about a boy who loses his dog.
That is sad but easy to write. Just tell the story in your own words.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel very sad because I got a low grade on my math test.
I am sorry to hear that. Did you practice the hard parts?
I tried, but the numbers just confused me today.
That can happen. Do you want help with the problems?
Yes, but I am worried my teacher will be angry with me.
Teachers care about your effort, not just the score. Are you ready to look at one problem?
Okay, I think I am a little braver now.
Good. Let us start with the first one. Is it about adding?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at that big, fluffy cloud. It makes me feel so happy.
That cloud looks very soft and nice. What makes you feel so happy today?
I just love watching things float by. It feels free and calm.
I love how slow they move. Do you like the blue sky too?
Yes, the blue helps me breathe easier. Thank you for looking with me.
It is a nice thing to share with a friend. It is a special part of the sky.
I feel light like that cloud now. Thanks for being my friend in this.
You are a kind friend too. I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I really want to go to the play tonight, but I feel sad.
I am sorry you feel that way. What happened?
My little brother got sick, so I cannot go with him.
That is a very sad day. Do you like the show about cats?
Yes, I do, but I miss him more than the fun.
He is lucky to have a caring sister. I know you will visit him soon, right?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to swim but I have no time.
A pool is the best spot for a quick swim. Do you have a free hour?
No, I only have ten minutes left.
A ten-minute splash is still good fun. Can you close your eyes and enjoy it?
I forgot my goggles at home.
That will hurt your eyes in the water. I do not know if you can swim blind.
It is too late to go back now.
You can wear a cap to help. Do you have a cap with you?
I am leaving now, please stop.
Have a safe swim then. I hope the water feels nice.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am confused about why the sky is blue. What should I do?
Light has colors. Do you know about rainbows?
Yes, I do. So what happens to the blue?
Sunlight hits air and breaks apart. The blue scatters most.
That makes sense. I will look up outside.
Good plan. Is it sunny where you are?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I got on the train this morning and it was very quiet.
That sounds peaceful. Did you sit by the window?
Yes, I watched the trees go by very fast.
How exciting! Did you take a photo?
No, I just closed my eyes and felt happy.
I am glad you had a nice ride.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big bug today while walking in the grass.
That sounds like a fun find. Did you get a good look at it?
It had six legs and two little wings.
Nice details. Was it green or brown?
It was brown and it ran away very fast.
Bugs like to stay safe. What did you do next?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we put lights on the tree?
They make the tree look like stars. Do you like shining things?
Why is the food so sweet?
Sweet food makes people feel happy. I like candy too.
Why do we wear warm coats?
It gets very cold outside. Do you have a good hat?
Why do we visit friends?
We want to share the fun with them. That is the main point.
Why do we rest after the party?
Our bodies need sleep to get strong. I hope you enjoy your nap.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The sun is very hot today.
Yes, it is a very hot day. Do you like swimming?
I think my ice cream will melt fast.
Ice cream does melt when it is warm. Did you pick a flavor?
It is outside and I can see a big blue sky.
A blue sky is always nice. Do you see any birds?
My shirt feels sticky from the sweat.
Sticky shirts happen in the heat. Would you like to drink some cold water?
It is a long and warm day.
Warm days can be long. Do you want to play in the shade?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel sad because my new friend left me out at recess.
I am sorry you feel this way. Who did you talk to about it?
I tried to tell my mom, but she was busy.
That can feel lonely. Did you tell her how you felt inside?
I am just being left behind on purpose.
I do not know if it was on purpose. Did you see who else was talking?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I saw a dog.
That is nice. Did it have a name?
It looked sad.
Poor pup. Did you talk to it?
How do I say hello to dogs?
Use a soft voice. Did the dog wag its tail?
It wagged its tail a lot.
It liked you. Do you have a dog?
I want one soon.
That is sweet. What color do you want?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The lights went out.
That can be scary. Did you check the fuse box?
I do not know how.
Look for a small switch that is down. Is it dark in your room?
Yes, it is dark.
Use a flashlight to help you see. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I have my phone.
Turn on the light on your phone. Be very careful with the switches.
Thank you for helping me.
You did a good job. Do you feel safe now?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I failed the test and I feel so bad.
I am sorry you feel that way. What part of the test was the hardest?
I just cannot do it right.
Do you know why you think that?
I study hard and I still get it wrong.
That is frustrating and feels unfair.
I want to quit right now.
You can take a break and try again tomorrow.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The street is very quiet.
Why is it so still?
I ran fast. The cars are gone.
That is odd. Do you see any people?
No one is here. I am scared.
Do not worry. The sun is out.
I must go now. Thank you.
Go with care. Is your house near?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to paint my room blue. Do I need a lot of paint?
That depends on how big your room is. What color is it right now?
It is white and a bit big.
You will likely need two cans. Do you have a brush?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the pool today. The water was cold, but I swam fast.
That sounds fun! Did you wear your blue cap?
Yes, I did. I also met my neighbor.
That is nice. How was the pool?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The rain is hitting the window so loud. Do you think the sky is crying?
Maybe it is, or maybe it is just thirsty. Do you like the sound of the rain?
It sounds like a drum. Do you know if it will stop soon?
I do not know for sure, but I hope the sun comes back. Do you want to draw a picture of the storm?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I mixed sugar into the salt shaker by accident. Why did I do that?
Your hands were likely busy or you were in a rush. Do you have a spare shaker nearby?
No, I do not. Can we just use this one?
That would make your food taste strange. Did you read the label before picking it up?
I did not look. I am so sorry.
It is a common error, so do not worry. Just wash it out with water.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Look at this! I got a toy bear.
That is a very cute bear. Who gave it to you?
My aunt gave it to me.
That is so nice of her. Does it smell like flowers?
Yes, it smells sweet.
I am glad you are happy.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. The sand is all wet and sticky.
That does feel bad. Do you like dry sand?
Yes, but there is no dry sand left. I only see big waves.
I am sorry. Maybe we can wait?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to send a picture of my dog to my friend, but the picture did not go out.
