That is very frustrating. Do you know why it failed?
I think my phone was slow because I was in a basement.
Yes, walls often block the signal. Do you have a window nearby?
No, I am in a cellar. I give up for now.
That is okay, try again later.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need food, fast.
What sounds good to you?
A burger, please.
With cheese?
Yes, and hold the pickles.
I will get that for you.
I am running late.
I know. Here it is.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking for the book on sharks but I do not know where to go.
Do you want to read or browse?
I just want to find the shelf, but I feel lost.
The science books are by the blue door.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the light turn on when I flip this switch?
It lets electricity flow to the bulb. Do you have a favorite color of light?
How does that energy get inside my walls?
It travels through metal wires from far away. Do you know where the plug is?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I hate the rain. My shoes are wet and cold.
That sounds very sad. Do you want to dry off?
Yes, please. My socks are icky too.
Let us get you warm socks. Is your bag dry?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to build a sandcastle. What do I need?
You need wet sand and a bucket. Do you have a bucket?
Yes, I have a blue bucket. What else is needed?
You need water to make the sand stick. Do you have a spoon?
No, I do not have a spoon. Can I use my hand?
Yes, your hand works fine. Good luck with your castle.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My boss gave me a cookie.
That is very sweet of him. Do you like chocolate?
Yes, I love chocolate.
It sounds like he is a nice person. Is he your teacher?
No, he is at a shop.
A shop boss! That is great. Did he smile?
Yes, he had a big smile.
Smiles make cookies taste better. Do you want another one?
I did not ask for another.
Fair enough, but it was a lucky day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy and feel very bad.
That is a sad feeling. Did you tell them the truth?
Yes, I told them right away. Now I want to say sorry, but I do not know how.
A simple "I am sorry" is true and kind. Do you want to give them a small gift?
Yes, I made a card with my own hands.
That shows your heart. Is the card ready?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go for the picnic.
Do you like grass or dirt? I think a soft field is best.
I want to go, but I am not sure what to bring.
You should bring a big blanket and some fruit. Do you like fruit?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look up! There is a big rainbow.
Wow, that is very pretty. Do you see the red part?
Yes, I see red and blue.
Those are two of the colors. Which one is your favorite?
I like the yellow one.
Yellow is a happy color. It looks like a sunny day.
Where does the rainbow come from?
It comes from rain and sun light. Do you think it is magic?
I think it is a little magic.
That is a sweet thought. Let us watch it for a minute.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look, a big rainbow in the sky!
It is very pretty. What color is your favorite?
Red. I like red best.
Red is a warm color. Do you see the blue part too?
Yes, the blue is at the end.
That is right. Rainbows always have the same colors.
Is it made of water?
Yes, it is made of light and water.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I made a new friend, but I do not know what to say.
That is nice. What do you like to do for fun?
I like to draw, but I am not sure if she does too.
You can just ask her. Drawing is a great way to share time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how a knight moves.
A knight moves in a shape like the letter L. Do you like knights?
Yes, I like them. How do I win with a queen?
A queen moves many squares in any direction. It is the strongest piece.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: It is so hot and sunny here today. Do you have any tips to stay cool?
Try to drink lots of water and rest in the shade. Do you have a fan in your room?
I do, but it is not strong enough. What else can I try?
You could eat some cold fruit like watermelon. Is your house too warm at night?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I like hot drinks but I do not know which one to pick. Should I have tea or coffee?
Coffee gives you a big kick of energy, while tea is softer and calmer. Do you feel tired right now?
I feel a little tired, but my heart beats fast if I have coffee. I want something nice to drink with my snack.
Since your heart beats fast, tea is the safer choice for you. Do you like sweet or bitter tastes?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I failed at my drawing and I feel like giving up. What should I do?
It is okay to feel sad. Did you try a new color?
No, I used the same blue. I want to stop.
Try again with a red pen. It may feel fresh.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people move to new homes?
People move to find better places to live or work. Do you have a favorite room in your house?
What happens if you buy a house with bad walls?
You must fix them or it is not safe. Do you like building things?
How do you carry all your big boxes?
I use strong trucks and strong friends. Do you like helping people?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The flight was so long, but I was very happy to see the world from up high.
That sounds like a great view. Did you see many clouds?
Yes, they looked like soft white pillows floating all around me.
They must have looked very nice. Did you fall asleep?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I told my friend I would share my apple.
That is a very kind promise. Did you get a bite?
I did, but I gave the rest to her.
She must be happy to have your snack.
She smiled big and said thank you.
That smile is a great reward. Was the apple sweet?
It was very sweet and crunchy.
I am glad you both enjoyed it. Did you make more friends today?
Yes, I played tag with three boys.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you win the game?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I have a big sandwich with cheese. It tastes like heaven.
That sounds very good. What kind of cheese did you put in it?
It is sharp cheddar. My whole desk smells like cheese now.
I love cheese too. Do you want to split it with me?
Yes, you can have half. I made two today.
Thank you very much. I will finish mine and trade you my cookie.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look at this red circle. Why is it round?
It is round because it has no corners. Is it soft?
No, it is hard. Do you like squares?
I like squares because they stand up. Do you like them too?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired. I do not know why.
That feels bad. Are you sleeping well at night?
I sleep, but I still feel heavy.
Your body might need rest. Do you like reading books before bed?
I do not want to do anything else.
That is okay to feel. Would you like me to sit with you?
Yes, please. It helps.
I am happy to help.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel mad because someone did not say please to me today.
That can feel bad, but it is not your fault. Do you think they were in a hurry?
I do not know, but I wish they would be nicer to me.
Being kind is a good goal, and you can still smile at them.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to spot a fox in the woods.
You should look for pointed ears and a big white tail tip. Do you like red animals?
Yes, I do like them very much.
Check for small footprints with no toe pads. Do you walk in the forest often?
I go there once a week with my dad.
Listen for rustling leaves in the grass. Are you quiet when you walk?
I try to be very quiet.
Also, look for a glassy shine in their eyes at night. Do you carry a flashlight?
I have a small one in my pocket.
Use it only if you feel safe and need to see better. Stay close to your dad.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I broke my cup by accident.
Oh no, that is too bad. Are your hands okay?
Yes, I am fine. But it hurts my heart.
Accidents happen to everyone. Do you feel sad?
I do. What should I do now?
Let us sweep up the glass together.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot find my house on this map.
That is very frustrating. What does your street look like?
It has a river near it.
A river is a good clue. Do you see any blue lines?
Yes, there are many lines here.
Look for a blue line that turns. Is your house close to the water?
It is near the water, but not right on it.
That makes sense. Can you point to a big park?
There is a park right next to the river bend.
That sounds like the right spot. You found it!

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I built my new shed today! I am so happy.
That is great news. What color did you paint it?
It is bright red. It looks very nice.
Red is a strong color. Did you hang plants inside?
Yes, I put my tools there. I feel proud.
That sounds useful. Did you add a small bench?
I added a table for my coffee.
A table is smart. Do you have a lock for the door?
I used a simple padlock. It is safe now.
Good choice for safety.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why are the leaves turning orange and red?
The trees are getting ready to sleep for the winter. Do you like picking up crunchy leaves?
Yes, I love it. What happens after winter ends?
Spring comes back and flowers start to grow. Do you like seeing the first green buds?
Yes, they look so pretty. Why does it get so cold in winter?
The sun shines less on our part of the earth. Do you like playing in the snow?
I like snow, but my toes get very cold. Why is the sky so blue?
The air makes the blue light from the sun scatter everywhere. Do you look up often?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late, but I love the sea. What is it made of?
It is mostly salty water. Do you like to swim?
Yes, I do. Can I go now?
Yes, run. The water waits for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to throw a ball like my old friend did.
That is a fun goal. Do you have a soft ball to start with?
Yes, I have a big rubber one.
Great, just lift your arm back and let it go. Can you tell me how you hold it?
I just squeeze it tight in my hand.
Try to hold it loosely so your wrist can flick it. You will get it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a new place to eat lunch today.
That sounds nice. Did you like the food?
Yes, the soup was very warm and sweet.
Oh good. Was the bread fresh too?
The bread was good, but the table was very wobbly.
That is not fun. Did you tell a person?
I did, and they moved my chair to a solid spot.
That is kind of them. Are you glad you went?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am putting my toys in the bag. I lost one block this morning and I was very sad.
Oh no, that is tricky. Did you look in your room?
Yes, I looked everywhere but it is gone. I will pack the rest now.
That is okay to feel sad. Do you still have your favorite toy?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now because we won the game!
That is great news. Did your team score a lot of goals?
Yes, we won by five goals!
Wow, that is a big win. How did the fans cheer?
They shouted very loud and jumped high.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you watch from the stands?
Yes, I was with all my friends.
That is a nice way to spend a day. What is your favorite part of football?
I love kicking the ball hard.
That is a true love for the game. Do you play often?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Do you like books too?
Yes, I love them. Do you have a favorite one?
My favorite book is about a bear.
That sounds fun. Is the bear kind?
Yes, he is very kind.
What does he do in the story?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The rain is so cold. I did not want to go out like this.
That feels bad. Is it raining hard?
Yes, it is very wet. My shoes are soaked.
Oh no, that is tricky. Are you warm now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I sat on my bench all afternoon. The park was very quiet and I felt sad.
That sounds like a heavy day to be alone. Do you usually sit on that bench?
I tried to count the birds, but they all flew away. I do not know why they left me.
I am sorry the birds did not stay with you. Did you eat a snack while you waited?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the little hand move so slow?
It takes a whole hour for it to tick once around. Do you like watching it spin?
What makes the loud sound every minute?
A tiny hammer hits a bell inside the box. Is that sound loud to you?
Why does it stop when the battery dies?
The spring needs power to keep the wheels turning. Do you know how to fix it?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have seven days in a week?
It is a way to group time. Do you like weekends?
Yes, because I can sleep in. Why is Sunday the last day?
Many places start the week with Monday. Does that make sense to you?
I think so. Why do the names sound so different?
They come from old words we still use.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The fire is too loud and I feel scared.
I am here with you. Are you safe?
Yes, but my coat is gone.
That is very sad. Can we find it?
I do not know where it is.
Let us look together. Do you see it?
No, it is gone for good.
I am sorry. It will be okay.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to buy a new pen. Do you have any advice?
Yes, check if the ink flows well before you pay. Do you want a ballpoint or a gel pen?
I think I want a blue gel pen. Is that a good choice?
Blue is a great color for writing. I do not know which brand is best. Do you prefer one that dries fast?
I do not care about drying time. I just want one that works well.
Then just try a few until you find one you like. Have fun shopping.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight has many colors. Blue light bounces off air molecules to your eyes. Do you like looking up?
Yes, I do. But why not green?
Blue bounces more than other colors. Green bounces less, so it looks faint.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see a big fire on the hill. It looks scary.
That is not good. Are you safe inside the house?
Yes, I am with Mom. Why is it burning?
I do not know for sure. Please stay away from the window.
Okay, I will sit on the floor. Is it bad?
Yes, the smoke is bad for your body.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do plants get water from the ground?
I am not sure of every detail, but roots pull water up. Do you have a plant at home?
Yes, my fern is in a pot.
The water moves up through tiny tubes called xylem. Is it sunny where you keep it?
It gets bright light all day.
That helps the plant lose water from its leaves. Do you water it often?
I give it water every other day.
That is good for most plants, but roots need air too. Do you check if the soil is dry?
I poke it with a stick to see.
That is a great way to tell. You are doing a fine job.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people run?
They run to feel fast and free. Do you like to move?
Yes, I do. Why does my heart beat so hard?
Your heart pumps blood to your muscles. Are you tired now?
A little. Why is running good for me?
It makes your body strong and happy. Do you want to try?
I think so. Is it hard to start?
It can feel hard at first, but it gets easier. Can you take a small step?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I went swimming today.
That sounds like fun. Do you like jumping in the water?
Yes, it feels so nice and cool.
I am glad you had a good time. Was the water very cold?
It was a little bit cold at first.
That is true for many pools. Did you swim for a long time?
I swam until my arms felt tired.
Swimming is good for your body. Do you want to go again?
Yes, I will go tomorrow.
Good for you. Have a rest now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad today.
That sounds hard. What made you feel that way?
I missed my friend who moved away.
Missing someone is normal. Do you want to draw a picture for them?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My cat is sick and I am late for work.
That is very sad. Did he eat anything today?
No, he just sleeps in the sun.
That is a bad sign. Is he coughing?
Yes, a little. What do I do?
Please take him to a doctor now. Do not worry, you will be fine.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I send a picture to my friend?
You tap the share button. Do you use a phone or a computer?
I use a phone.
Then you tap the paper plane icon. After that, you pick your friend from the list.
What if I want to see old chats?
You swipe left on the screen. Do you remember which screen it is?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we have to do math?
Math helps us count and build things. Do you like building blocks?
But it is so hard.
It is hard at first, but you will get better. What part is tricky for you?
I do not get fractions.
I am not sure which fractions confuse you. Do they look like slices of pizza?
Yes, they do.
That is a great way to see them. Have you tried drawing them?
I like that idea.
Drawing helps your brain see the pieces. Are you ready to try now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I missed the bus, so I walked down the wrong street and got lost.
That sounds scary. Did you find a familiar place?
Yes, I saw my friend's house and it felt like home again.
Good for you. Are you safe now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: Today was the best day I have ever had. I felt like flying all day long.
That sounds like a wonderful feeling. What made you feel so light?
I helped a new friend learn a hard task. I saw her face light up with joy.
Helping someone learn is a very sweet thing to do. Did she try it again?
Yes, she did, and she got it right. I am so proud of her, and of me.
It is good to share a happy moment. I am glad you had such a great day.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The wind is so loud. Is my house going to break?
It is just a big storm. Are you scared?
I do not like the dark. Can I stay in my bed?
Yes, you can stay safe in your bed.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I have been waiting for a long time. My feet hurt.
Waiting can feel very slow. Do you like sitting still?
It is just boring and hard.
I will sit with you to help. Would you like to play a game?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I saw the sea today.
That sounds like a lovely place. Did you hear the waves?
Yes, the water went up and down all day.
The sea is a big, blue blanket. Do you like sand?
I walked on the wet sand near the water.
That must feel cold and wet. Did you swim?
I could not swim because the water was too cold.
Being cold is not always bad. What color was the sky?
The sky was a bright, happy blue.
A blue sky matches the sea. That is a perfect day.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad about my gift. It is broken.
Oh no, that is bad. Do you want to talk about it?
Yes, I am angry. It was my favorite toy.
I am sorry you feel that way. Is it broken badly?
Yes, the arm is off. I do not know what to do.
I do not know how to fix it. Do you have a grown up nearby?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I failed the test and feel like giving up.
It is hard when things go wrong. Do you want to try once more?
Maybe, but I am afraid of failing again.
Failing is just part of learning. What was the hardest part for you?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I do not know how to pay for the bus.
You can use a card or coins. Do you have change?
Yes, I have some coins.
Put them in the box near the door. It is right there. Do you see it?
I see it now. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. Have a good trip.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I am moving to a new home.
That sounds wonderful. Do you have a favorite room there?
Yes, the one with the big window. I can see the trees from my bed.
Nature is a great view. Will you keep your old toys?
I am giving away most of them to other kids.
Sharing is very kind. Which toy are you keeping?
I am keeping my stuffed bear named Bear.
Bears are good friends. Are you nervous about the move?
A little, but mostly I am excited.
It is natural to feel mixed feelings. Good luck with your new start.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do some months have thirty days?
I am not sure of the exact start, but it helps us count time. Do you like winter best?
I like snow. Why does time go so fast in summer?
I do not know the reason, but fun makes time fly. Do you play outside a lot?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cut the onion and my eyes are watering. I want to cry.
That is normal. Do you want to try a raw carrot stick?
No, I just want the soup to taste good. I feel like I failed.
You did a good job so far. What is your favorite part of cooking?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing a high note.
That is a fun goal. Do you have a favorite song to practice?
I like to sing about the moon.
A gentle voice helps for high notes. Are your shoulders relaxed?
Yes, I am sitting in a soft chair.
Sit tall and breathe low. Do you feel a buzz in your chest?
A little bit, yes.
Keep breathing into your belly. It will feel stronger soon.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Is there a playground in this new town?
Yes, there is a big one near the park. Do you like to swing?
I do! Is it very close to my new house?
It is only a short walk away. I hope you enjoy it.
Cool. Are there any big trees there?
Many tall oaks stand in the park. Do you like to climb?
Yes, I love climbing. Do you know if I can buy ice cream nearby?
There is a shop just down the street. I am sure you will like it.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The lights went out all of a sudden. I was making toast. It is so dark in here now.
That sounds tricky to see. Do you have a flashlight ready?
Yes, I found one on the table. It is bright and warm. I hope the power comes back soon.
That is a good idea to stay warm. Was the toast still hot when the lights died?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my bread get so big?
The tiny yeast eats the sugar and makes gas.
Does the gas go up?
Yes, the gas bubbles stretch the dough.
Is that why it feels soft?
That is right, the bubbles make it light.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to buy a cake for my mom's birthday. What is good?
A chocolate cake is a sweet choice. Does she like chocolate?
Yes, she loves it. But I have little money.
The small round cakes are cheaper. Do you have a card for her?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to make a kite.
That sounds fun. Do you have some paper and string?
Yes, I have paper and a long string.
Great. You need to fold the paper into a diamond shape. Have you ever folded paper before?
Yes, I like folding paper boats.
Good. Now you must paste the string on the center of the bottom tip. Does that feel sticky?
It feels very sticky.
Let it dry for one hour. Do you have a flat place to put it?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a lot of old toys in my room. What should I do with them?
That is a big pile. Do you still play with all of them?
No, I only play with three of them. The rest are just boxes.
You can give the boxes to a friend who needs them. How many boxes do you have?
I have about ten boxes and five small cars. I want a clean room.
Keep the three toys you love. Don't know what to do with the cars?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I picked three red flowers in the garden today.
That sounds nice. Did they smell sweet?
Yes, they smelled like honey. I put them in a jar.
A jar is a safe place for them. Do you want to dry them?
I just want to keep them fresh. The sun was bright outside.
Sunshine helps flowers grow. How many petals does one flower have?
I counted five on the biggest one. I feel happy now.
That is a good feeling.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. I need food fast.
Do you like toast or eggs?
Just toast. Please add jam.
Jam is sweet. You will be full.
I do not have time to talk.
I am not sure how long you need.
Five minutes. I must go now.
Okay. Safe trip.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is it so cold in winter?
The Earth tilts away from the sun. Do you like the cold?
I do not. Why is Christmas in winter?
It marks the shortest day of the year. Do you like snow?
Yes, I do. Why do we give gifts?
It shows we care for each other. I do not know why you chose that specific toy.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to go to a park for a picnic. What should I bring?
A big blanket is good for sitting. Do you like to eat fruit?
Yes, I love apples. Is that a good choice?
Apples are sweet and nice. Do you have any drinks?
I have cold water. Is that enough for the sun?
Water is always best for you.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need a red ball. Do you sell them?
Yes, we do. Do you like big balls or small ones?
I want a big one for my dog.
Great choice. Do you pay by card or cash?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The wind is so loud today. My window is shaking.
That sounds scary. Are you safe inside?
Yes, I am sitting by the door. It is very dark outside.
I am glad you are safe. Do you like the rain sound?
Not really. It makes me feel small.
I know that feeling. I am here with you.
Thank you. The wind is getting louder again.
Listen closely. It is just a big sigh.
It feels like a giant is breathing.
That is a nice thought.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My computer makes a loud beep.
Does it beep when you turn it on?
No, it just started doing that.
I am not sure why it is doing that. Do you see any lights on it?
The red light is on.
A red light can mean it needs a break. Is the fan spinning?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to ride my horse, but I do not know how to sit.
Sit straight and hold the reins gently. Do you have a helmet on?
Yes, I have my helmet on. What do I do with my legs?
Keep your heels down low. Is your horse standing still right now?
Yes, it is standing still. How do I ask it to go?
Say "walk" and tap its sides gently. Are your hands ready?
Yes, my hands are ready. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have fun on your ride.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is my teacher nice?
I think she is very kind. Do you like her?
Yes, but she is strict.
Strict helps you learn well. Does that bother you?
Sometimes. How is she at math?
I do not know for sure. Is math your hard subject?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My birthday is today. I feel very happy.
That is wonderful. What is your favorite part of the day?
I love my cake. Do you like cake too?
Yes, I do. I have never tasted yours.
I will share a slice. It is sweet and soft.
That is very kind of you.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we wash our clothes?
We wash them to get the dirt off. Do you like clean clothes?
Yes, I do. Why do we use soap?
Soap helps pull the dirt away. Do you know how to press the start button?
I think so. Why does the water get warm?
Warm water works better on some spots. Do you like warm or cold water?
I like warm. Why do we dry them?
Dry clothes feel nice and cozy. Do you put them on the rack?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am reading a book about a big red castle.
That sounds like a fun place to play. Who lives in the castle?
A giant with a funny hat lives there.
A giant sounds very tall. Is he scary or nice?
He is nice, but he makes a loud sneeze.
A loud sneeze could be scary at first. Does he have a friend?
Yes, his friend is a tiny mouse.
A tiny mouse is a good friend. Do they play together?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. My little house in the village is gone.
That is very hard to accept. Do you still have your toys?
Yes, but the big tree in my yard is broken. I miss it a lot.
Trees take a long time to grow back. Did you plant a new seed?
No, I forgot to plant one. I feel very left out.
It is okay to feel that way. Can we buy a new seed together?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at the clock. It just says six, but I want five.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a snack ready?
I do not know how to read the long hand. It is too fast for me.
The long hand is just moving around. What time do you hope it is?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to make a big cake for my birthday. Do I need a special oven?
No, you can use a normal oven. Do you like chocolate or vanilla?
I love chocolate. What do I do if the top gets too brown?
You can cover the top with foil. Is your family ready to help?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know how to start. I feel very sad.
It is okay to feel sad. What made you start thinking about this?
I broke my best friend's toy. Now he will not talk to me.
That feels scary. Have you tried saying sorry yet?
No, I am too afraid he will be angry.
Being kind is usually better than hiding. Do you think he would forgive you?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. What is a tree?
A tree is a plant with a trunk and leaves. Do you like green things?
I do not have time. Is it alive?
Yes, it grows and breathes. Do you smell the air?
I must go. Does it eat?
It drinks water and makes its own food. Do you eat breakfast?
Goodbye. How tall is it?
Some are very tall. Good luck on your way.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late. Help me pack this bag.
I can help you fast. What is the first thing you need?
My keys, my phone, and this water bottle.
Those are in your hand. Is that everything you need?
No, I forgot my book. I am in such a hurry.
Put the book in here. You are all set to go.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see smoke in my kitchen. I do not know what to do.
Please go outside now. Is the door closed?
I want to go back for my cat. Should I?
No, do not go back in. Is the cat safe?
I am scared and my hands shake. What next?
Call for help on the phone. Are you safe?
I am sitting on the grass. I feel very sad.
You did the right thing. Take deep breaths.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to see the whole moon face. What do I need?
You need a small telescope. Do you have a dark place to look?
Yes, my back yard is very dark. Will it work well?
It should work great. Be patient, it takes time to focus.
I will try tonight. Thank you for the help.
Good luck. Have fun looking up.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I start a good game?
Put your queen next to your king, and move a pawn two steps. Do you play white or black?
I play black, but I always lose the first move.
That is normal, so do not worry about losing that point. Is your piece safe?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I did really well on my test today.
That is great news. How did you feel while taking it?
I felt very calm and happy.
Calm is a good way to test.
I got a lot of the answers right.
Did you study much for it?
Yes, I practiced every day.
That hard work paid off. Well done.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big sand castle.
That sounds like fun. Do you have a bucket?
Yes, I have a blue bucket.
Great. Are there any waves coming?
No, the water is very calm.
Good, that is safe for you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I see the big boats in the water.
Yes, they look great. Do you like looking at the water?
Why do the boats float on the water?
Water is strong and holds them up. Is your favorite boat red?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited for the bus all morning. It was very slow.
That sounds boring. Did it finally come?
Yes, but I was cold and wet.
Poor you. Did you have an umbrella?
No, I forgot it at home.
Oh no. Is it still raining?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big black bear walking by the road this morning.
That sounds exciting! Did it look angry?
No, it was just eating berries and looked very calm.
Good for the bear. Do you live near a forest?
Yes, I live right on the edge of it.
How lucky you are to see wildlife often.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: The city is too loud and fast for me. What should I do?
Try sitting on a quiet bench in a park. Do you like trees?
I love trees, but I do not know where to look.
Look for green spots near the water. Do you enjoy fish?
I do like fish, but I am still lost.
Walk toward the sound of splashing. Do you hear birds?
Yes, I hear birds and the water. This feels good.
Take your time to breathe and watch. Do you feel better now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I broke my cup.
I am sorry to hear that. Are you hurt?
No, but I feel bad.
Accidents happen to everyone. Did you clean up the glass?
Yes, I used the paper towel.
That was a very smart thing to do. What was in the cup?
It was just water.
Water is good because it is not hard. I know how to fix it. Do you want to help?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the grass so green?
The sun and rain help it grow. Do you see the flowers nearby?
Yes, they are red. Why do they look so happy?
They are just doing their best. Do you like the red ones?
I do. Why does the wind blow?
I do not know the full reason. Do you feel it on your face?
It feels cool. Why is the water in the pond blue?
It comes from the sky above.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I was so happy today! I learned how plants drink water.
That sounds fun. Do you know where it goes first?
The roots catch the water from the dirt.
Right. Then it moves up the stem. Do you know where it goes next?
It gets to the leaves and out into the air.
Yes, that is true. I am happy you learned it.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared of my math test tomorrow.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you like counting?
Yes, I like counting, but the big numbers are hard.
Counting is a great start.
What should I do right now?
Try to rest your eyes first. Are you tired?
I am a little tired, but I want to study more.
Sleep helps your brain remember.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to play one last hand before I leave.
We can finish quickly. Are you playing to win?
Yes, but I am running out of time.
I have no spare cards, so I cannot join. Is this a game for two?
No, I need a partner. Please just help me count.
I can help you count. Do you have five cards?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to write a letter. How do I start?
You just say "Dear Name" on the top line. What do you want to say in the letter?
I want to tell my friend I like his dog.
That is a nice idea. Just write that down and then sign your name at the bottom.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not get why a big ship stays up.
The air pushes it up. Do you like swimming?
No, because it feels heavy.
Water pushes up harder than the ship sinks. Is that clear?
Still, it looks like it should go down.
The ship spreads its weight wide. Do you have a boat toy?
I am angry at the water.
It is not trying to hurt you. Have a snack?
Fine, I will trust you.
That is good. Look out the window?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited in line for a long time at the store.
That can be hard. Did you see a dog there?
No, just people. I got the last cookie.
That is a happy ending. Did you share it?
Yes, I gave half to my brother.
You are very kind.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My legs hurt so much. I want to quit.
That sounds really hard. Do you like to play outside?
I do, but running makes my body feel broken.
I am sorry it hurts. Maybe you can walk a bit first.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a square for my drawing. Can you help me?
Yes. A square has four equal sides. What color do you want?
Red. It is red.
Nice choice. Do you like round things too?
No. I only like sharp shapes.
I see. Triangles are very sharp.
Too bad. I am in a rush.
Take your time. Do you need help with the next step?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy. I feel very bad but I do not know what to say.
It is good that you feel sad about it. Do you want to fix the toy?
I do not know how to fix it, so I am stuck. What should I do?
Just tell your friend you are sorry for breaking it. That is all you need to say.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am worried the meeting might get too long.
That is a good thought. Do you know how long it should take?
I think it takes two hours, but I am not sure.
Two hours feels long. Have you tried to cut some topics out?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I need to send a letter, but I do not know where to go.
You can put your letter in the blue box. Is it a big letter?
It is a small letter, but I feel lost.
Just walk to the window and hand it to the clerk. Do you have your stamp?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy and I feel bad. How do I say sorry?
Say "I am sorry I broke it." Did you mean to do it?
No, I did not mean to. But she is angry with me.
Tell her that too. Want to go ask her now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am on a very long plane. My legs hurt and I do not know what to do.
You can stand up and walk in the aisle. Have you tried stretching your toes?
I do not want to walk. I feel too tired and scared of falling.
That is okay. You can sit still and drink some water. Are you thirsty?
Yes, I am dry. But the gate agent said no one can get up.
I do not know the rules for your flight. Do you want to ask the crew?
Maybe. It feels lonely here. Do you think they will help me?
Most crew are kind and ready to help. Would you like to try asking them?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to school today and it was a good day. I ate a yummy apple in class.
That sounds like a nice treat. Did you share any with your friends?
I shared one with my friend who looked hungry. We ate them together on the rug.
That was very kind of you to share.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to go, but I want to ask about my grandpa.
Tell me more. Is he still with you?
He lives far away. I have to run now.
That is sad. I do not know why.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Do you sell red apples?
Yes, we have many red apples. Do you like sweet ones?
I do like sweet ones.
We only have sweet apples here.
Great, I will buy two.
That is a good choice. Would you like a bag?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I see the moon in the sky at night?
Look up after the sun goes down. Do you have a dark place to look from?
I just want to know how it shines.
It reflects the light from the sun. Do you know how a mirror works?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to grow big tomatoes, but my seeds are just sitting in the dirt. What do I do?
They need water and sun to start. Do you have a small cup to water them?
Yes, I have a cup. Should I water them every day?
Yes, but only a little so the soil is damp, not soggy. I do not know exactly how much for your spot.
Okay, I will try that. How long until I see them?
Give them a few days to break the soil. Are you checking on them often?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn to sing a song.
That is a great goal. Do you have a favorite song?
Yes, I like the moon song.
Sing the first line for me.
Ah, the moon is bright.
Your voice sounds strong and steady.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The wind is so loud outside. I love the thunder.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Are you warm and safe inside?
Yes, I have a big blanket and hot cocoa. It is cozy.
That is a wonderful way to watch the storm.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Is that big water a lake?
Yes, it is a lake. Do you see the birds on the water?
I cannot stop. How deep is the water?
I do not know the exact depth. Are you trying to swim?
No, I am just looking. Is it cold today?
It feels a bit chilly. Do you have a warm coat?
Yes, I have a jacket. Where is the path to leave?
Turn left from the dock. Is that path easy for you?
Yes, it is clear. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a safe walk home.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I got a job. I am very happy.
That is great. What do you do there?
I sell ice cream. It is fun.
I like ice cream too. Do you like the cold?
Yes, I do. I love the cold air.
That sounds nice. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I tried to count to ten, but I keep getting it wrong. I am so mad.
It is hard to start. Do you want to try again?
No. I feel like I am bad at this.
You are not bad. You just got tired. Did you try one by one?
I tried. My hands are shaking. I give up.
Okay. We can stop. Thank you for sharing how you feel.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know what movie to watch tonight.
What kind of story do you like?
I like stories that are fun and make me laugh.
Try a silly comedy. Do you like dogs?
Yes, I love dogs.
Watch the movie about the dog who goes to space.
Is that movie really funny?
Yes, many people say it is very funny. Do you have time for a long movie?
I only have one hour.
Pick a shorter film then. I hope you enjoy it.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late and my bag is stuck. I feel very bad.
Take a deep breath. Can you see what is holding the bag?
The zipper is jammed. I want to break it right now.
Breaking it will make it worse. Try pulling gently with one hand.
It still will not open. I hate waiting.
Waiting is hard, but it works. Do you have a key nearby?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because I am going camping.
That is wonderful to hear. What will you look for outside?
I want to find big, bright stars in the sky.
Stars are very pretty. Do you know which ones are visible there?
I do not know, but I will learn while I watch.
Learning by looking is a great way to start.
I also plan to roast a nice, hot marshmallow.
That sounds very tasty. What do you use for the fire?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am looking at the sky. The sun is so big. I do not know what to do with my eyes.
It is bright. Did you bring your glasses?
Yes, I have my glasses, but I still feel warm on my face. Should I go inside?
That is a good idea. Do you like the hot sun?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My phone screen is very slow. What should I do?
Try turning it off and on again. Do you have a new phone?
Yes, I bought it last week.
That is strange. Do you use many apps?
Yes, I have many games on it.
Close some of them. Do you like the phone, or are you sad?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to make a snowman.
You start with a big ball and put it on the ground. Do you have a bucket?
Yes, I have a red one. What do I use for the eyes?
Carrots work well for the nose, but stones are good for eyes. What else do you have in your yard?
I have some sticks lying around. Do I use them for the arms?
Yes, stick them in the side for arms. Have fun with your winter friend.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My shirt has a red mark on it. How do I clean it?
First, take the shirt off. Do you know where the mark is?
It is on the front, right near the pocket.
Put some soap on the wet spot. Is the mark from food or drink?
I think it was from a berry. It looks like jam.
Try to rub it gently with the soap. Does the color come off?
Yes, a little bit. Should I wash it now?
Let the soap sit there for a minute. Do you have a bucket ready?
Yes, my bucket is full of warm water.
Put the shirt in the bucket and swish it around. Feel the water under the spot.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: My computer works now! I am so happy.
That is great news! What did you fix?
I plugged in the power cord. It was loose.
Oh, that is a simple fix. Do you use it for school?
Yes, I did my homework. The screen is bright.
Nice work on your studies. Do you like the bright screen?
I like playing games too. It is very fast.
A fast computer is fun. Which game do you play?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My head hurts a lot today.
That is not nice to feel. Do you have a fever?
I think my head is just spinning.
Spinning is a good word. Does it hurt when you look at bright lights?
Yes, the sun makes it worse.
Try resting in a dark room. Would you like to read a book?
I want to sleep and drink some water.
Drinking water helps with spinning heads. Sleep well and drink your water.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I am lost. Why is this place so confusing?
The trees look the same here. Have you seen any signs?
I do not see any. Can you tell me where I am?
I do not know. Do you have a map?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I have a riddle for you. What gets wetter the more it dries?
That is a tricky one. Do you know the answer?
The answer is a towel.
Yes, that is true. It looks dry but holds water. Do you like water sports?
Not really, I prefer reading.
Reading is very nice. I do not know many riddles about books. Do you have another one?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to know how to use forks and knives at dinner.
Hold the fork in your left hand and the knife in your right. Do you like eating meat?
Yes, I do. How do I cut the food?
Cut small pieces, then switch the fork to your right hand to eat. Do you use a spoon?
Sometimes. Is that okay?
Yes, a spoon is fine for soup or sides. Are you hungry?
A little. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Happy dining.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My computer is making a loud noise.
That sounds scary. Is the fan spinning fast?
Yes, it is like a helicopter.
Let us turn it off to keep it safe. Do you know how to do that?
I pushed the big button on the side.
Good job. Let it rest for a minute.
It is quiet now.
Excellent. It is ready when you are.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big river today. It was so blue and calm.
That sounds lovely. Did you see any ducks swimming?
Yes, I did! The water looked so clear.
How nice. Do you live near that river?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the sun get so hot?
It has a lot of gas that turns into fire. Do you like warm days?
Yes, I do. Why does the sun light up our house?
Its light travels here from very far away. Do you see it at night?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we eat cake on my birthday?
Cake is sweet and fun to share with friends. Do you like chocolate or vanilla best?
I love chocolate. Why do people blow out the candles?
Blowing them out is a wish for good luck. Do you feel happy when you make a wish?
Yes, I feel warm inside. Why do we give gifts?
Gifts show that we care about you. Did you get a nice card this morning?
Yes, it had a funny dog on it. Why do people dance at parties?
Dancing makes everyone feel lively and glad. Is your favorite song fast or slow?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I broke my friend's toy. I feel very bad. How do I say sorry?
Tell them the truth. Did you try to fix it?
No, I am scared to ask. I do not know what to say.
Say it is not fair. I am sorry I broke your toy.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I got my very first job today. I was so proud.
That is wonderful. How did it feel to earn your own money?
It felt great. I bought a candy bar with it.
That is a nice treat. What was the candy bar like?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw my grandpa today. He is so happy.
That is a nice thing. How did he look?
He had a big smile. He laughed a lot.
I am glad you are happy. Did he tell a story?
Yes, he talked about birds. He saw a blue one.
That is a cool bird. What else did he do?
We sat in the sun. It was warm.
Sounds like a good rest. Did you eat a snack?
We shared some cookies. They were sweet.
I like sweet cookies. How did the day end?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I stepped on a bug and I feel bad.
That is a kind feeling to have. Do you know what kind of bug it was?
It was a small black beetle.
Beetles are tough little friends. Do you think it was doing no harm?
Yes, it was just eating a leaf.
You tried to help the plant by removing it. That is a good thing to do.
But I still feel sad about the beetle.
It is hard to let go of sadness. Do you want to go outside and find another bug?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at the screen.
I am sorry you feel this way. What happened on the site?
The pictures will not load.
That is a fixable problem. Do you see any little circles spinning?
No, just a big red error box.
I do not know the exact cause. Did you try to turn off the power?
I think the whole web is broken.
It is usually just one small part. Have you tried to ask your mom for help?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The sand is too wet and my toes are cold.
That feels sad. Do you have dry socks?
I left them back at the house.
I know a spot with dry grass nearby.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It is snowing hard outside today.
That sounds very cold. Are you wearing a warm coat?
Yes, I have my big blue coat on.
Good, that will keep you safe. Did you see any animals?
I saw a small bird on the branch.
A bird in the snow is rare. Was it eating?
No, it was just looking at me.
It must be curious about you.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am very angry. The game will not work.
That feels bad. Do you take a deep breath?
I tried. But I want to win right now.
Wanting it now is hard. Can you wait five minutes?
Five minutes? That is very long.
It feels long. I do not know how to make it go faster.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I tie a good knot on my line?
Wrap the line around the hook twice and pull it tight. Do you have a small hook?
Yes, it is very small. Is that all there is to it?
Yes, that is the basic step. Do you like fish or just catch them?
I only like to keep the ones that eat my bait.
That is a fair reason. I do not know which fish eat what bait.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I tried again and it worked!
That is wonderful news. How did you feel when it worked?
I felt very strong and proud.
I am glad you feel that way. Do you want to try it again tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My head hurts bad and I am late.
That sounds awful. Do you have some water with you?
No, I just need to go.
Please stop for a second. Is the pain on one side or all over?
It is everywhere and I have to run.
I do not know why it hurts so much. Please see a doctor soon.
I will try to find a doctor.
That is a good plan. Please be safe on your way.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a red flower for the party. Do you have one?
Yes, we do. Are you buying it for a special person?
Just for myself. Can I pick it up in five minutes?
Sure, that will be fast. Do you like red flowers?
I love them. Is it ready yet?
It is cut and wrapped. Thank you for rushing to see us.
Great. I am out the door.
Bye bye. Do you have a good day?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do people say I should walk every day?
Walking helps your heart and legs stay strong. Do you like being outside?
Yes, I like the fresh air. But why is it good for my heart?
Your heart is like a pump, and walking makes it pump well. Have you tried walking after dinner?
I have not done that much. Is it hard to start?
It is easy if you go slow and take your time. How far can you walk right now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I tried to build a tower and it fell down. I do not know what to do next.
That can feel bad. Do you want to try again?
I am not sure if I will do it right.
You do not have to do it perfect. What part feels hard?
The base is always wobbly.
I know a tip to help. Do you have smooth blocks?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why should I save my spare coins?
Saving helps you buy big things later. Do you have a dream toy?
I want a red bike. Why does saving work?
It works because you keep what you have. You can buy it in time.
That sounds easy. Why not just spend now?
Spending now means you wait a long time for the bike. Is saving hard for you?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I made a big red sun today.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Did you use crayons for the red?
Yes, I used my favorite crayon.
I love how you picked the best color for the sun.
I also drew a green tree next to it.
Green is a nice color for leaves. What kind of tree did you draw?
It was a tall, strong oak tree.
I do not know what an oak looks like exactly.
It has thick branches and lots of leaves.
That sounds very sturdy and full of life.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I do not know if I should drink tea or coffee.
Coffee gives you a quick burst of energy. Do you feel tired right now?
Yes, I am very sleepy, but I also feel a bit sick.
Tea is gentler on your tummy than coffee.
That sounds good, but I am not sure which tea to pick.
Green tea is very mild and good for feeling sick. I do not know which tea you like best, but green is a safe choice.
I think I will try the green tea then.
That is a smart choice. I hope it helps you feel better.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am late for my party. My feet feel heavy. What should I do?
Try to walk fast. Are you in a rush?
Yes, I have a cake to eat. It might get cold. Do I need to run?
Do not run, please. It is not safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do now.
It feels hard, but you can start small. What is the first tiny step?
I feel stuck and scared to move.
That fear is normal. Take a deep breath with me.
I tried before and failed badly.
Failure just means you are learning. Do you remember what you learned?
I do not know if I can do it again.
I do not know your full story, but I believe in you.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why is the sky blue?
It is blue because of how light works. Do you like blue?
Yes, I like it a lot.
Sunlight has many colors mixed together. The sky pushes most colors away but keeps the blue. Do you see the sun?
Yes, it is bright out.
The blue light bounces off the air around us. That is why we see it everywhere. Isn't that neat?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do leaves fall in the fall?
It is cold, so trees save their water. Do you see the brown leaves on the ground?
Yes, I see them. Do trees sleep in winter?
Sort of, yes. They stop growing for a while.
Do they need food in winter?
Not much. They wake up when it gets warm. Do you want to touch a leaf?
Yes, I do. It feels dry.
Dry and crisp. The tree keeps the good parts inside.
That makes sense. Thank you.
You are welcome. Enjoy the pretty trees.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am sitting here and I do not know what to do next.
That is okay. Do you have a small toy or a book with you?
I am still not sure if I should wait here or go play.
I do not know which is better for you, but staying put is safe.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I fixed the battery, but the hands will not move.
Oh no, that is tricky. Do you hear any ticking sound?
It is silent. I do not know why it stopped.
It may need a new spring inside. Is the clock very old?
Yes, it is my grandfather's old clock.
That is special. I do not know the fix, but a watchmaker can help.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I wish to learn how to ride a bike.
That is a great goal. Do you have a helmet on?
Yes, I am all set up.
Great. First, we will just push the pedals. Are your feet flat on the ground?
Yes, I can feel the floor.
Good. Now let us push off.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I do not feel happy today. My chest feels heavy.
I am sorry you feel that way. What is bothering you?
I lost my favorite toy. It feels like a bad dream.
That is a sad feeling. Does it hurt to think about it?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Do I just run in?
Please wait for a moment. Is there a door you can use?
No, just one door.
You should knock first. Do you know how to knock?
Yes, but people are busy.
They still deserve respect. You can say sorry in a hurry.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My teacher is very sad today. I do not know what to do.
That is a good thing to notice. Did you try saying hello to her?
I said hello, but she did not smile back. What can I say?
You can tell her you care about her. Do you want to sit near her desk?
I want to help, but I am afraid she might be busy. Is that a bad idea?
It is not a bad idea at all. She will likely be happy to see you.
Okay, I will walk over and ask if she is okay.
That is a very kind step. You are doing a great job.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I look up at the dark sky and feel very lost.
The night can feel big and quiet. Do you like the quiet?
I do not know what to do with all that silence.
You could just breathe and watch the lights. Do you see a bright star?
I am still not sure if I should stay or go home.
I do not know what is best for you. Is your house close by?
I think I will just sit here for a little while.
That sounds like a calm choice. Do you feel safe here?
Yes, your words make me feel a bit less alone.
I am glad to help. Good night to you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How can I draw a square?
You can draw a square by making four lines that are all the same size. Do you like squares?
Yes, I love them. How do I make a circle next?
Try to draw a smooth loop that has no corners.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to start my letter.
Start by saying hello to the person you are writing to. Who is it for?
It is for my neighbor. I feel stuck.
Tell her how much you like her cat. That is a nice thing to write.
She does not have a cat. She has a dog.
Oh, sorry. Then tell her about the dog instead. Does she have a nice dog?
Yes, the dog is very good.
Write that the dog makes you smile. Now you have a good start.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am tired, but I cannot sleep.
Try a book with a happy story. Do you have one nearby?
I have three books, but I do not know which to pick.
Pick the one with the softest cover. Does it look warm?
Yes, it is red and feels nice.
Reading is good for your eyes and mind. Do you want to start now?
I am not sure if I will finish it.
It is okay to stop if you are sleepy. Do you feel ready?
Yes, I will try.
Good night and sweet dreams. I hope you like the story.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My boss changed my work last minute. I am so tired and mad.
That sounds very hard. Did you get to talk to them?
I tried, but they just said no. I feel like my work does not matter to them.
I am sorry to hear that. Do you feel safe speaking up?
I am afraid to say more now. It feels unfair that they do not listen to my ideas.
Your feelings make sense. Is there someone else who can help?
I do not know who to ask right now. I just want to go home and rest.
Resting is a good plan. Take it one step at a time.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I waited for the bus all day and it never came.
That is very hard. What did you do while waiting?
I sat on a bench and felt very mad.
Anger is a big feeling. Did you take deep breaths?
Yes, I breathed in and out until I calmed down.
That is a smart way to wait.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: My dog is barking nonstop. I need to leave in five minutes.
Is he hungry? Could he just be hungry?
I fed him an hour ago. I think he is scared of the thunder.
That makes sense. Thunder can be loud and scary.
How do I stop it? I am running out of time.
I do not know a magic fix. Try speaking in a soft voice.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the man fall off the stage?
He lost his balance. Did you watch the play live?
Yes, I did. Why did the music stop suddenly?
The power went out. That was scary.
Was it a bad thing?
It made the story very tense. Do you like surprises?
Only the good ones. Why did the bird fly away at the end?
I do not know for sure. It looked like freedom.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. I cannot count to ten.
That is okay. Are you trying to count fingers?
Yes, but my hands are sticky and it is hard.
Let us try again. Do you want to start at one?
No, I want to give up. It is too hard.
You are doing great. One is a good start.
Okay, one, two, three... I did it!
Hooray for you. How does that feel?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am looking at a tall tower by the sea.
That is a lighthouse. It helps ships see in the dark. Do you live near the water?
Yes, I do. How does the light stay on all night?
People in town turn it on and off. It is a hard job, but a good one. Why do you ask?
I want to know if it is safe to go inside.
You should not go in alone. Old stone can be tricky and wet. Do you have a friend with you?
No, I am by myself right now. Is it cold up there?
It is usually windy and chilly. A warm coat is best for the top. What is your favorite color?
I like blue. Should I bring my blue jacket?
Yes, that sounds like a smart choice. Stay safe and look out for cars.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How do I take a good picture?
Aim your camera at the subject and press the button. Do you like to take pictures of people or things?
I like taking pictures of my dog.
That is a great choice. Make sure the light is good on his face.
The light is always blurry.
Try to hold the camera very still. When did you last take a photo?
I just took one yesterday.
That is very recent.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very stuck in the line.
That feels tough. How long have you been waiting?
My feet hurt and I am sad.
I do not know if you must stay. Do you have to be here?
I must get my ticket soon.
Let us wait together. Do you like listening to songs?
The bus is coming now.
Great news! Run to the door.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big oak tree on my walk. A squirrel ran up it very fast.
That sounds like fun. Was the squirrel wearing a cap?
It was just a regular squirrel, but it looked happy. The tree had many leaves falling down.
Falling leaves make a nice sound.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dog is sad and will not eat.
I am sorry he is sick. Does he have a fever?
I do not know how to check.
You can feel his nose with your hand. Is it hot or dry?
It feels very dry and warm.
Please take him to the vet today. I hope he feels better soon.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late for work.
Is that the train station?
Yes, I have to run.
Go fast. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My teacher is being very mean to me.
I am sorry to hear that. Does she yell at you?
Yes, she yells every time I make a mistake.
That is not fair. Have you told her how you feel?
No, I am too afraid to speak up.
You are brave to ask for help. Try to stay calm first.
I do not know what to do next.
Talk to a parent or another kind adult.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to learn Spanish.
That is a great idea. How old are you?
I am seven.
You can start with simple words like hello. Do you like ice cream?
Yes, I love it.
In Spanish, ice cream is helado.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so tired and sad about the move.
That is a big job. Do you want to rest first?
The boxes are still open and I am lost.
We can sort them together. What feels the hardest part?
I do not know which items to keep.
Try the things you love most. Do you have a list?
No, I never made a list.
We can make one now. It will help you feel better.
Okay, I feel a little less worried.
That is good. We can take it slow.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. Where is my teacher?
I do not know. Are you running fast?
Yes. Tell me where to go.
Try the big door. Is that your class?
No. I need the small room.
It is near the clock. Do you see the clock?
I see it. Thank you.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I need to pack my bag for a trip. Can you help me?
Yes, I can help you. What are you going to do there?
I am going to the beach.
Great. Bring your swimsuit and a towel. Do you have a favorite book?
Yes, I have my red book.
Good. Put the book in the bag too. Do not forget your shoes.
I have my shoes. Is that everything?
Not all. Bring your toothbrush. Is that all you need?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: How do I win at chess?
You must trap the enemy king. Do you know how the pieces move?
I think so, but I always lose.
Practice is key to getting better. How often do you play?
I play once a week with my dad.
That is a good start. Do you try new ways to attack?
I mostly just push the pawns forward.
That can be dangerous. I do not know the best attack for you.
Can you tell me one simple rule?
Protect your king first. Is that a hard thing to do?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took my car out today.
That is a big step. How did you feel?
I was very scared at first.
That makes sense. Did you drive to a quiet place?
Yes, I went to the empty park.
Good choice. Did you practice stopping?
I stopped the car five times.
That is great practice. Do you plan to go out again?
I think I will try on the weekend.
You are doing well. Keep trying.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up early and went to the garden.
That sounds like a good start to the day. Did you see any bugs?
I found many little worms in the dirt.
Worms are good for the soil. Do you like them?
They made my spinach look messy.
Messy is okay because it shows life. Do you want to save some seeds?
Yes, I saved some for next year.
That is a smart idea. I do not know what else to add.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I cannot sleep and I feel so mad.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have a cold?
No, but my head is racing with thoughts.
That can be hard. Do you want to try counting sheep?
I tried that, but it did not help.
I do not know why it failed. Is your room too warm?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to find my little brother. He is missing.
I do not know where he is. Is he in the garden?
No, not in the garden. He likes to hide.
That is tricky. Did he take his red hat?
Yes, he has the red hat. I am very late.
Look by the big tree. I think he is there.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I need to pack my books, but I am not sure how to start.
That is a great first step. Do you have your largest boxes ready?
Yes, I have the boxes, but I am afraid I will break my books.
You can wrap them in old clothes to keep them safe. Is that a worry you had?
I am glad to know that. What is the last thing I should put in the box?
I am not sure about your specific book types, but generally heavy items go last.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My king is in danger, I do not know what to do.
I see that you are stuck. Do you have any pawns to block the way?
I have a pawn, but I think it is too late.
It is never too late to try. Would you like to move your rook to help?
I can move the rook, but I am still not sure.
That is a good first step. Take your time and think it through.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I have a map but I do not know where to go.
That is okay. Do you see any red dots?
I see a big blue line. What is that?
That looks like a river. Are you looking for a city?
I just want to find my way home.
Look for a house shape on the map.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to paint this wall blue by noon. What color should I pick?
That sounds tight. Do you want a light or dark blue?
I am not sure. How do I make sure the paint dries fast?
I do not know that for sure. Are you using the right kind of brush?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: The baby is crying and I do not know why.
Is the baby hungry? It is often time for a snack.
No, I just fed the baby.
That is good. I do not know for sure, but is the baby wet?
Yes, the diaper is full.
Change the diaper. The baby should feel dry and happy.
How do I change it?
Lay the baby down. Do you have a clean diaper ready?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: My bag is so heavy. I do not want to go.
I am sorry to hear that. Is there a heavy item inside?
Yes, I packed three books. They are big and thick.
That does sound tough. Do you need all of them?
I think I do. I want to read on the trip.
Reading is a good plan. Would a small bag help?
Maybe. I have a small one in my room.
That is a smart idea. Do you want help moving it?
Yes, please. Thank you. It feels better now.
You are welcome. Let us go get it.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why does my brain feel heavy when I read in bed?
Your eyes get tired from the bright light. Do you use a special lamp?
I use my phone screen.
Phone light is bad for sleep. Try a soft lamp instead?
I guess I will try that tonight.
That is a good plan. Do you have a favorite book?
Yes, I like stories about dogs.
Dogs are fun to read about. Good luck sleeping well.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to sing loud and clear.
That is a great goal! Do you sing for fun?
Yes, I love it. What should I do first?
Start by taking a big, slow breath. Do you feel air in your tummy?
I am not sure. What is the next step?
Hum a simple tune like "mm mm mm". Does that feel easy?
It feels okay. How do I open my mouth?
Relax your jaw so it feels loose. Does that help your sound?
Yes, it sounds better. What is the last tip?
Just relax and have fun with it. Are you feeling happier now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with the boat.
Are you trying to sail home?
Yes, but the wind is confusing me.
Look at the flag to find the wind.
The flag is very still today.
Then you must wait for it to move.
Should I fix the mast or clean the deck?
I do not know your boat. Is the mast broken?
No, it is just feeling sad.
Sailors often feel that way on land.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to know if this horse is safe to ride, and I am late.
Is the horse calm and quiet? If yes, it is likely safe.
It is very still, but I do not know how to check its mood.
Look at its ears. If they are back, it may be scared.
The ears look fine, but I am running out of time.
You are doing a good job checking. Do you have a plan for where you are going?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I love bananas. How do I cut one?
Cut the tip off, then slice it in half. Do you like them whole or in pieces?
I like them in pieces. How do I keep them from turning brown?
Put them in a bowl with a few drops of lemon juice. Do you have a lemon?
Yes, I do. Thanks for helping me.
You are welcome. Happy eating!

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Why does the second hand move so fast?
It moves fast to show every little second. Do you like watching it spin?
It goes around and around. Does it ever stop?
No, it keeps going to help us tell time. Do you know what a minute is?
A minute is one thing. How does the big hand know when to move?
The clock feels the tiny ticks and makes the hands move. Nice thinking!

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: I feel heavy inside today. Why do I feel this way?
Your body is tired, and your mind is holding onto a hard thought. What is that thought?
It is about the dog we lost last week.
That is a very sad thing, and your heart hurts for him. Do you want to talk about his good moments?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I found a map to a hidden spot. I do not know if I should go.
That sounds exciting. Do you have a friend to go with you?
No, I am alone. I feel a bit scared to go there.
It is good to feel careful. Have you told a grown up about it?
Not yet. I want to keep it secret for now.
Secrets can feel heavy. What do you hope to find there?
I hope to find a toy I lost. I am unsure if I am brave enough.
You are braver than you think. Who can you talk to first?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a loaf of bread right now. Please make it fast.
We have warm loaves ready. Do you like white bread?
Yes. I am running late for work.
Here is your bread. Have a good day.
Thank you. I must go.
You are welcome. See you soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to draw a bird on this quiet street.
Hold the pencil like a twig. Are you afraid of getting it wrong?
Yes, my hands feel shaky.
Just make small lines. Is the sky blue today?
It is grey and calm.
Draw a round body. Do you hear any birds?
No, it is very still.
Add two thin lines for wings. You are doing well.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The thunder is very loud tonight.
It sounds like big rocks crashing. Are you scared?
A little bit. How far away is the lightning?
It is far away for now. Do you see any more sparks?
No, it is getting quiet.
That is good. Is your window safe and shut tight?
Yes, it is closed. Thank you for helping me feel better.
You are welcome. Rest your eyes now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what month it is.
Do you see the leaves?
They are falling on the ground.
It is autumn.
But I forgot to buy a coat.
I am sorry to hear that. Is it cold?
Yes, my hands are very cold.
Please put on a jacket.
Okay, I will go find one.
That is a good plan.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared to step on the gas pedal.
That is normal to feel scared at first. Do you know how to use the brakes?
I think so, but I do not want to crash into the wall.
Let us just practice stopping first, slowly. Have you tried moving the car yet?
No, my legs feel too small for the pedals.
That is okay, we can adjust the seat for you. Does the seat look too high or too low?
It feels like a big empty chair.
We will move it closer so your feet can rest. Are you ready to try again?
Yes, I want to go now.
Wonderful, let us take a nice slow turn. How do you feel about that speed?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need help with my bike fix fast.
I can help, but I do not know your bike. What part is broken?
The chain is off and I am late.
I am sorry you are late. Do you have a tool with you?
No tools, just a wrench.
A wrench might work. Do you know how to clip it back?
I can try, but I must go now.
Be careful out there. Is the road safe for you?
Yes, I am leaving right now.
Good luck on your ride.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I feel very scared about my big talk tomorrow.
It is normal to feel that way. Do you have your notes ready?
I am not sure if I remembered all the facts.
Reading your notes out loud is a great practice. Have you done that yet?
I think I will try to practice in the mirror.
That sounds like a smart plan. Good luck to you.
Thank you for helping me feel better.
You can do this. I hope you do well.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we eat breakfast?
It gives you energy for the day. Do you like eggs?
Yes, I love them. Why are eggs good?
They have protein to help you grow. What else did you have?
I had toast and jam. Why is jam sweet?
I do not know the exact reason. Do you eat fruit too?
I had an apple. Why is it good to eat?
It is full of vitamins for your body. What is your favorite part?
I like the skin. Why do we need food?
Food gives us the power to run and play. Are you ready for school?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big boat today and it did not sink!
That is a fun fact! Do you know why it stays up?
It is because the water pushes back.
Yes, the water holds it up. Do you like the ocean?
I love the water! It is so big.
Big things can float if they push water aside. Do you like small boats too?
I do! I like all boats.
They are all helpers on the sea. Do you ever visit one?
Yes, I go on the little ones.
That sounds like a great time. Do you like the waves?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are mountains so tall?
They grow up from the ground over a long time. Do you like to climb them?
Why do they have snow on top?
It is very cold up there, so the rain turns to ice. Does cold water freeze fast?
Why is the air thin at the top?
I do not know the exact reason, but it is true. Do you feel tired on hills?
Why do they look so big?
They are huge because they have been there for ages. Do you like to look at maps?
