talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to save money but I do not know how.
Start by writing down everything you spend. Do you track your spending now?
I try, but I forget most of it.
Use a small notebook to write it down right away.
That sounds easy. What else should I do?
Find one thing you can stop buying. What is your favorite treat?
I buy soda every day.
Try to cut that cost. Do you have a favorite cheap drink instead?
I like water. So I will drink that.
That is a great start. Do you have a place to keep your saved coins?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do robots need batteries?
Robots need batteries to give them power to move. Do you like playing with batteries?
What do robots do all day?
Robots can do many jobs, like sweeping or driving. Do you have a robot at home?
Can robots ever feel happy?
Robots cannot feel emotions like we do. I am not sure if that will change soon.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do for the party.
That sounds hard. Do you like music?
I like music, but I do not know what kind.
Try playing songs you hear often. Is that fun?
Maybe. But I feel lost.
I am not sure if it will work. Do you have friends?
Yes, I have friends there.
Ask them what they like.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I have a secret for my best friend.
That is very nice of you. What is the big plan?
I bought her a blue card.
A blue card sounds fun. Did you write a funny joke inside?
No, I wrote a long letter instead.
She will surely cry with joy. Did you seal the envelope tight?
I lost the glue and used tape.
Tape works well enough for love. Did she spot the tape on the box?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad. My picture is all smudged and looks bad.
I am sorry that feels rough. What color did you use?
I used red, but it mixed with the blue and turned brown.
That is not a mistake. Brown is a very nice, calm color. Do you like looking at dirt?
I guess I do. It looks like the ground.
Then you have made a ground. You did a good job.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are those bones so old?
They turned to stone a long time ago. Do you like dinosaurs?
I do. Why does the room smell like dust?
Old things often smell that way to us. Do you wear a mask?
Yes, I do. Why is the glass case tilted?
I do not know for sure. Can you see the whole animal?
Yes, I can. Why is the light so bright there?
It helps us see the details well. Do you see the tiny teeth?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late and I do not know how to finish my math sheet.
Take a deep breath. Do you need help with the addition problems or the subtraction ones?
It is all mixed up and I feel very sick.
Let us look at just one problem together. What is the first number you see?
It is seven. I really need to leave in five minutes.
Seven is a good start. Do you have a pencil ready?
Yes, I have a pencil, but I am still stuck.
Add the next number to seven and tell me. You can do this.
Seven plus two is nine. I finished the first page!
Great job. You did it quickly and well.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to take the train but I am lost.
It is okay to feel lost. What is your first stop?
I want to go to the big city.
Buy a ticket to the big city. Do you like windows?
Yes, I like to see the trees.
Look out the side window. Is your seat by a window?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to make my phone screen shine again.
Is your screen dirty? You can wipe it with a soft cloth.
What if it is still smudgy?
A little water on the cloth works too. Do you have a spare?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: My phone dropped into the mud this morning.
Oh no, that is sad. Did it still work?
It turned off and would not turn back on.
I do not know why it stopped. Did you try to dry it?
I wiped it with my shirt and waited a long time.
That was a smart move. Is it alive now?
Yes, it finally turned on with a wet screen.
I am happy it came back to life.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I found a quiet spot in the park for our picnic.
That sounds nice. Did you see any birds there?
Yes, a blue bird ate a crumb from my sandwich.
How lovely. What are you drinking today?
I have a cold glass of water with lemon in it.
That is a good choice. I am glad you enjoyed the day.
I am tired now, but very happy about the picnic.
You did a great job.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to make pasta, but I do not know how.
You boil water first. Do you like meat or cheese in it?
I like cheese. What do I do next?
You add salt to the hot water.
Then I put the noodles in.
Yes, wait for them to get soft. Are you hungry yet?
Yes, very hungry.
Great, stir them so they do not stick.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to draw a cat today, but its tail looked like a worm.
That is a funny shape. Did you use a red crayon for it?
No, I used a black marker. The cat looks very silly now.
Silly cats are often the best kind. Do you want to try drawing a dog next?
Maybe. I like dogs more than cats, actually.
That makes sense. Would you like some tips on drawing a dog?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to grow tomatoes in my yard. How do I start?
First, you must pick a spot with lots of sun. Do you have a sunny corner?
Yes, I have a sunny corner. What else do I need?
You need good soil and plenty of water. Are you ready to dig?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late and need to fix my bike fast.
Please slow down and check the wheel first. Are you safe?
The spoke is bent and I am still in a rush.
I do not know how to fix that one. Please find a shop soon.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to swim in that big lake.
That sounds like fun. Do you already know how to float on your back?
Yes, I can float for a few seconds.
Great start. First, you should always swim with a friend nearby.
Okay, I will bring my brother along.
That is a very safe plan. Are you afraid of the cold water?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know where to go. The street is very quiet.
That sounds peaceful. Are you enjoying the stillness?
I think so, but my legs feel tired.
Sit on the bench and rest. Do you have a place to be later?
No, I just need to stop walking for a bit.
Take your time. I will sit nearby with you.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I missed my stop and now I am late. I feel very bad.
That is a tough feeling. Are you close to the place?
Yes, but my boss looks angry. I am scared.
Take a deep breath. It will be okay.
Do you think they will fire me? I really need this work.
I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy right now. The market has big, sweet apples.
That is great news. Do you like red apples?
Yes, I do. I want to buy a big bag of them for my family.
That is a nice plan for a snack.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun is bright and warm today. I saw a blue bird on the tree.
That is a lovely sight. Which tree was the bird on?
It was a big oak tree near my house. I threw some crumbs for it.
The bird must be happy. Did it eat the food?
Yes, it ate all of it very fast. Then it flew away quickly.
What a good bird. Did you wave goodbye to it?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today. My heart is full of joy.
That is wonderful to hear. What made you feel this way?
I found a special friend. We played for hours.
That sounds like a lovely memory. Thank you for telling me.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn how to swim. Is it hard?
It can be easy if you practice. Do you know how to kick your legs?
I can kick, but I get scared of the water.
That is very common. Have you tried holding onto the pool edge?
I have tried that, but I still feel shaky.
Take your time. Do you have a friend who swims?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like to keep every leaf I find in my jar.
That sounds like fun. Do you keep all the leaves?
Yes, I do. But my jar is full now.
Maybe you can pick your favorite one to keep.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am scared of the bus. What should I do?
Take a deep breath and hold the strap tight. Do you have a toy to help you?
Yes, I have my bear. But it is still loud inside.
That is okay. Put in your earbuds if you have them.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad at my teacher.
That sounds hard. Why are you upset?
She made me erase my drawing.
Oh no. Did you work hard on it?
Yes, it was my best work.
That is unfair. How does that make you feel?
It makes me feel small and sad.
I am sorry. You can tell her how you feel.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy because my team won the big game today.
That is great news. Did you watch it on TV?
Yes, I watched every minute and I cheered very loud.
Cool. Who scored the last goal?
My favorite player did, and it was so fast.
Wow, that must feel amazing to see.
I just want to tell everyone about how good we were.
Go share the joy with your friends.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to learn how to make a paper boat.
That is a fun thing to try. Do you have a square piece of paper?
Yes, I have one right here.
Great. Fold the paper in half to make a long strip. Is the paper smooth?
It is smooth, thank you.
Good. Fold the top corners down to the center line to make a point.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am hungry. Can you help me pick a place?
Yes, I can help. Do you like hot food or cold food?
I want something warm and soft.
A soup place sounds good. Do you like meat in your soup?
I do not like meat. I only eat plants.
Then a vegetable soup is the best choice for you.
That sounds very nice. I will go there now.
Great. I hope you enjoy your meal.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do leaves change color?
The trees get ready to sleep for winter. The green fades to red and gold. Do you like red leaves best?
I love orange ones. Is snow warm or cold?
Snow is always cold. It freezes water into tiny ice crystals. Do you build snowmen?
Yes, but my nose always melts. Which season comes after winter?
Spring comes next. Flowers start to grow and birds sing. Do you have a favorite flower?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the teacher always smile?
I think she is happy to see you. Do you like her smiles?
Yes. Why is her desk so full of papers?
I am not sure, but she might be busy. Do you help her with them?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, I am late. Is it raining?
Yes, it is raining hard. Do you have an umbrella?
No, I do not. Good luck with the wet.
Be careful. I hope you dry off soon.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I want to write a letter to my friend.
That sounds like fun. What will you tell them?
I am not sure what to say at the start.
You can just say hello first. Do you know where they live?
Yes, they live in the city.
Tell them about your town. Is it quiet there?
It is very quiet and green.
Good. Good luck with your letter.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go on a trip but I do not know where.
That sounds like a lot of fun. Do you like cold weather?
I like snow but I am afraid of getting sick.
A warm beach place might be best for you. Do you like swimming?
I love the water but I do not have enough money for a far place.
Look for spots near your home to save money. Are you going alone?
I am going with my family so we can share costs.
That is a great idea. Have a very happy time.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I feel very happy today.
That is wonderful to hear.
How do I bake a cake?
You need flour, sugar, and eggs. Do you have these items?
I do not know how to mix them.
Just stir the wet and dry parts together. Do you have a big bowl?
I want to make one for my mom.
She will love that gift.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am feeling very good today.
That sounds nice. What made you smile?
I saw a big dog in the park.
That is a warm sight. Do you like dogs?
Yes, they are very sweet.
Good. Are you hungry now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today. I saw a big red dog.
That sounds fun. What did the dog do?
It chased a ball. I am writing a letter to my friend about it.
That is a nice plan. Is your friend there?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today.
That is great to hear. What makes you smile?
The sun is out and it feels nice.
Sunshine is always fun to have. Do you like walking outside?
Yes, I love to walk in the park.
Parks are wonderful places. Do you see any birds there?
I see birds and some red flowers.
That sounds like a lovely view.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I love the loud sounds here. The cars and people make my heart feel full.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What sound do you like best?
I think I love the sound of the big bells. It feels so loud and alive.
Big bells are very loud. Do they ring all day?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which class to pick.
That can feel hard. What subjects do you like most?
I like art but I worry about math.
You can try both and switch later if you need.
Is it true I can change?
Yes, many schools let you switch. Do you have a favorite teacher?
I think my art teacher is nice.
That is a good sign to start with art.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to build a small shed in my yard, but I do not know where to start. Do you have any tips?
First, pick a flat spot for the floor. What size do you want it to be?
I need enough room for my bike and some toys. How do I hold the walls up?
Use strong wood boards for the frame. Do you have tools to cut the wood?
I have a saw, but I am worried about making it look nice. How do I finish it?
You can paint it after the roof is done. I do not know the best paint color for you.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I see the blue sky. How can I see that color in a glass of water?
Water usually looks clear. Do you have a white cup?
Yes, I do. What should I do next?
Add a drop of blue paint to the water. It will look like a tiny sky.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we heat the oil first?
It makes the food taste nice. Are you hungry?
Yes, I am very hungry.
Good. The pan is ready now.
Why do we put salt on the food?
It adds a salty taste. Do you like salt?
I like it a little.
Then add a pinch.
Why does the food change color?
Heat changes the food. Is it done?
It looks done to me.
Great job. Let it rest a bit.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the park today and found three shiny buttons.
That is a fun find. Did you keep them?
Yes, I put them in my pocket. I also picked up a blue leaf.
How nice you are collecting small treasures. Do you have a box for them?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I am scared to ride my bike.
That is a normal feeling. Do you have a helmet on?
Yes, I have my helmet on.
Good job. Can you tell me how to balance?
I do not know how to balance.
Put one foot down slowly. Do your hands feel shaky?
My hands shake a little bit.
That is okay. Let us just push off the ground together.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am running late. Do I need to say please?
Yes, please is always good. Are you going to work?
No, just to school. Is it okay if I skip hello?
No, a quick hello is sweet. Do you have time for that?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad inside.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you want to sit with me?
Maybe. I do not have any friends here.
That is a hard feeling. What do you like to do?
I like to draw cats.
Cats are nice. Do you have a cat?
No. I just draw them.
I love cats too. Would you like to show me one?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My cat is hiding under the bed. Is he sick?
He is probably just shy. Do you want to try calling his name?
I called him, but he only blinked.
That is a normal cat trick. Did you give him a snack?
Yes, I put some treats near the door.
That is a great idea. Is he coming out now?
He came out to eat the treats!
That is wonderful. Is he happy now?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. My phone is not in my bag.
Do you check your pocket?
Yes. It is not there. I am very worried.
Have you checked your coat?
No. I left my coat at home.
Then it must be at home.
Oh no. I forgot it there.
I am sorry to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to go to the new place, but I am not sure if it is good.
I do not know for sure, but I heard the soup is warm and nice. Do you like soup?
I think I like soup, but I also want to eat bread.
You can have both. That sounds like a fun plan.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late for work. Is my grandma okay?
Yes, she is fine. She is napping. Are you eating breakfast?
No, I did not have time to eat.
You should take a bite. I packed you some bread. Do you like the red one?
Yes, thank you. I must go now.
Goodbye. Drive safe.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I did something bad and now I feel very sad. What should I do?
Tell me, did you hurt anyone?
No, but I broke my brother's toy on purpose.
That is a brave secret to share. Did you feel scared to say it?
Yes, I was afraid he would be angry. I want to fix it.
You must tell him the truth. Do you have money to buy a new one?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am very late. What is fast?
The sandwich is quick. Do you like meat?
Yes, but I am in a big hurry.
We will bring it to you soon.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to start painting but I feel lost.
That is a fun goal. Do you have any brushes?
I only have old, stiff ones.
You can wash them with warm soap. Do you like bright colors?
Yes, I love red and blue.
Those make a great start. Do you have a piece of paper?
I have a lot of scrap paper.
Perfect. Just try to make some lines. Do you have paint?
I have some old jars.
Good luck with your art.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how to keep the bike straight.
Hold the handles with both hands. Are you looking at the road ahead?
Yes, I am looking, but my legs are very tired.
That is normal for a new rider. Do you want to stop and rest?
I think I will try again one more time.
Good luck with your ride.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I had a scary dream about a dark forest. It made me feel very sad.
I am sorry you felt that way. Do you like walking in forests when you are awake?
No, I do not. The dream felt so real. Did you ever have a scary dream?
Yes, I have had strange dreams too. It is normal to feel upset after a nightmare.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy about my party.
That is great news! What is the best part?
My friends are coming over to play.
How many friends are coming?
About ten of them!
Wow, that is a big group. Are you ready for all that fun?
Yes, I have snacks and games too.
I think you will have a great time.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I feel so bad. I could not sleep last night.
I am sorry you feel that way. Did you have any loud noises?
Yes, but my head hurts and I am tired.
That sounds very tiring. Do you drink tea before bed?
No, just water. I do not know what to do.
I do not know your exact fix, but rest helps. Are you able to take a nap?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why is the water in the sea salty?
The rain washes salt from the ground into the sea. Do you like eating salty food?
Yes, I do. Does the sea ever get tired?
No, it moves all the time because of the wind. Do you ever go to the beach?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so tired of Mondays. I do not like this day at all.
Monday can be hard. Do you want to talk about it?
It is too long and too busy. Why do we have so many days?
There are seven days in a week. Is Tuesday better for you?
Maybe. I really like Friday best.
Friday is a fun day. What do you like to do on it?
I play with my friends. I am happy on Friday.
That sounds nice. Maybe the week will pass fast.

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: I want to solve the cube puzzle, but I am stuck.
That is a fun challenge. What color face are you looking at?
It has all the red squares on top.
Good start. Do you see the yellow squares?
Yes, they are on the bottom.
That is the goal. Do you know the first move?
No, I do not know what to move first.
I am not sure of your exact setup. Can you tell me the colors on the right side?
The right side is all green.
Move the right side up, then back down. Try that and tell me if it helps.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see smoke coming from my kitchen. What should I do?
Get out of the house now. Is everyone else out?
My family is in the car. Should I fight the fire myself?
No, do not go back in. Call 911 right away.
I called, but the fire looks very big. What do I do while I wait?
Stay far away and wait for help. Do you know your address?
I am safe on the road. I am just scared.
You did the right thing. Stay calm.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: My fridge door has a magnet. How does it work?
The metal in your door pulls the magnet close. It makes a very strong hold. Do you have other magnets at home?
I have a big one for my projects. Why does it stick to some toys but not others?
It only sticks to certain kinds of metal, like iron. Many toys have plastic on the outside so the magnet cannot reach the metal. Do you play with toy cars?
Yes, I play with cars a lot. Does a magnet hurt the car?
No, it does not hurt the car. It just makes the car stick to the magnet for a moment. Do you like to make the cars race?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do grown-ups like their jobs?
They feel proud when they do good work. Do you like making things?
What if I make a mistake?
You will learn from it. That is how we grow. Are you afraid?
Will it be hard at first?
It can be, but you can do it. Have you ever tried something new?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am putting my shoes in the bag.
That is a good start. Did you find both socks?
Yes, I found them under the bed.
I am glad you found them. What is next?
Now I am adding my book and pen.
Those are useful things to have. Why do you need them?
I want to read on the bus.
That sounds like fun. Do you have your snack?
I packed an apple and some crackers.
A nice choice for energy. Are you all set now?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a very big tree today and I feel so happy.
That sounds wonderful. What color are its leaves?
They are bright green and they rustle in the wind.
I love the sound of wind in trees. Do you smell anything nice near it?
Yes, it smells like earth and rain.
That is a fresh and lovely scent.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the boat float?
Water pushes up on it. Do you see the waves?
Why is it made of wood?
Wood keeps air inside. Is it heavy?
Why does it tip over?
I do not know.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I found a coin in my coat. Can I keep it?
Yes, you can keep it. Did you look in all your pockets?
Yes, I did. I want to save it for a toy.
That is a great idea. Where do you keep your other coins?
I have a big jar on my shelf. It is almost full.
Cool. Do you remember what you are saving for?
I am saving for a red bicycle. It is very nice.
Wow, that sounds fun. You are doing a good job.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so sad. The mountain is too big and I am too small.
That is a very tall mountain. Do you want to climb it or look at it?
I just want to be up there, but my legs hurt.
Rest your legs for a moment.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I had a scary dream but I am happy to talk about it.
That sounds brave. What happened in the dream?
I was flying a paper plane that turned into a real bird.
Wow, that is interesting. Did the bird have a name?
No, but it sang a very happy song.
That is a sweet ending. I am glad you are safe now.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do at the party.
Maybe you can dance with me? Do you like dancing?
I am too shy to dance.
Then try eating a slice of cake.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do I have to take a test?
Tests help us learn what we know. Do you like learning new things?
I do, but it feels hard. Why is it hard?
New things are hard at first. It gets easier with time.
Why does it get easier?
Your brain gets stronger with practice. Do you practice often?
Sometimes. Why does my brain get stronger?
I do not know the exact reason. But it feels good to finish.
Okay. Why is finishing good?
Finishing feels like a win. Do you want a win?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am so late for class. Do you know where Ms. Smith is?
I think she is in the library. Are you carrying your book?
No, I left it on my desk. I have to run!
You can grab it later. Please be careful on the steps.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I see a bug in my room. What is it?
It looks like a spider. Do you have a picture?
No, but it has eight legs. Is it bad?
Most house spiders are not bad. They eat flies.
Should I kill it?
No, please do not kill it. It is a friend.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked home on a very quiet street today.
That sounds so peaceful. Did you hear any birds?
I saw an old cat sleeping on a bench.
What a lucky cat. Was it warm outside?
The sun was hiding behind big grey clouds.
I hope it rained soon. Did you enjoy the still air?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: It rained all morning today. The wind was very loud.
That sounds scary. Did you stay inside?
Yes, I read books by the fire. The storm knocked out the power for an hour.
I am sorry about that. Do you have candles at home?
Yes, I used them to read. The rain finally stopped in the evening.
Good. Was the sun out after?
Yes, a big rainbow appeared. It was very pretty.
I am happy to hear that.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big rainbow after the rain stopped.
That sounds lovely. What color did you see first?
It was red on the top and blue on the bottom.
Red and blue are very pretty colors. Did it stay for long?
It stayed for a whole hour.
That is a very long time.
I felt happy just looking at it.
Happy feelings are good.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to go to the beach today. Is it safe?
The water looks calm. Do you like swimming?
I like it, but I am tired. Where is the sand warm?
The dry spots near the rocks are warm. Are you scared of the sun?
The sun is bright. Do I need anything?
Yes, bring water and a hat. Have fun!

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I dropped my phone on the floor today.
Oh no. Is it broken?
The screen has a big crack now.
That is bad. Did you catch the phone?
No, I missed it and it slid under the couch.
Under the couch is hard to reach.
I used a broom to get it out.
A clever trick. Did you find it?
Yes, and it still works, just looks bad.
Good news. Do you like the new look?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am stuck on my math book.
That feels hard. What problem is it?
I do not know how to add the big numbers.
Try breaking them into smaller parts. Do you have a pencil?
Yes, but I still feel lost.
Ask your teacher for help tomorrow. It is okay to ask.
Thank you for telling me.
You can do it. Good luck.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to build a big fort in the yard.
That sounds like a fun idea. Do you have any pillows?
Yes, I have three red ones.
Great start. Did you think about where you will put it?
I will put it near the tree.
The tree gives nice shade. Do you need help with the blanket?
No, I can do it myself.
I am glad you are feeling confident.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is this street so quiet?
The birds are sleeping. Do you like quiet places?
I do. Why is it so quiet?
I am not sure. Do you hear any cars?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: It is so loud here today.
The noise comes from the many cars. Do you like the sound?
No, it hurts my ears a bit.
You can put your hands over your ears. Would that help you?
Maybe, but there are too many people.
The crowds make the street feel small. Is it hard to walk?
Yes, I keep bumping into things.
Please look where you are going. Do you feel safe?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: My dog is eating his toys.
That is bad for him. What is his name?
He will not stop. I am scared.
Take the toys away. Do you have a chew toy for him?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: The sun was very hot today at the beach.
That sounds like a warm day. Did you build a big sandcastle?
I did not build a castle, but I found a blue shell.
A blue shell is a lovely find. What else did you see?
I saw a crab running away from my toe.
Crabs can be quite fast. Did you touch the water?
Yes, I swam for a bit in the cool waves.
The ocean feels good after a hot day. Are you tired now?
I am a little tired, but I am happy.
I am glad you had a good day.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does my phone get hot?
It heats up because the brain inside is working hard. Do you like to play games on it?
Why does it show a red line?
The red line means the battery is very low. Do you know how to charge it?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked to the park today. The sun was very warm.
That sounds nice. Did you see any trees?
I sat on a bench. I felt very calm.
What made you feel calm?
The birds were singing loud songs.
What kind of birds were they?
I think they were sparrows. I was not sure.
I do not know either. Did you feed them?
No, but I gave crumbs to a squirrel.
That is a sweet thing to do.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: The leaves are falling! I am so happy to see them dance. Do you know why they go?
Yes, the air gets cold and dry. Do you like looking at the colors?
Yes! I love the red and yellow. But why do they let go of the tree?
The tree needs to save energy for the winter. Do you find that sad or cool?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I tried to bake bread today and it was a mess.
Oh no, that sounds hard. Did the dough look wet?
Yes, it was very sticky and made my hands hurt.
Sticky dough is normal. Do you have flour to help it?
I added more flour but then it felt dry.
That happens often. Is the kitchen warm today?
It is quite hot, so I think the bread got tired.
Heat can make bread grow fast.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why is the music so loud?
I like it, but I am not sure why it is so loud. Do you hear the singing?
Why are you smiling?
I am happy to see you here. Is your drink cold?
Why is the food here?
I do not know, but it looks tasty. Do you want a piece?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I feel very sad because no one wants to play with me.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you have any toys you like?
Yes, I have a red truck, but I am tired of playing alone.
That sounds hard. What does your truck do when you play?
It goes zoom zoom, but the quiet house makes me feel small.
I get it. Can you tell me about your family?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got home from my bus ride. It was so much fun!
That is great to hear. Did you get to see the sea?
Yes, we passed a big blue lake. My heart feels so happy.
Nice. What is your favorite part of the trip?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went for a bike ride today and fell off.
That sounds scary. Did you get hurt?
No, I was okay. I fixed the flat tire myself.
That is very brave. How did you fix it?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I am stuck on my math problem.
What part is confusing you?
I do not know how to add big numbers.
Try lining up the ones and tens. Do you have a pencil?
Yes, I am writing it down.
Great job. Tell me what you get?
I got five hundred.
That sounds right. Are you sure?
I think so.
Good. Try the next one.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I dropped my cup. It broke on the floor. I am late for work.
Oh no. Are you hurt?
No, I am fine. I need to leave now.
Please be careful. Do you have another cup?
Yes, I have a spare in my bag.
That is good. Why did you drop it?
My hand slipped. I ran too fast.
Slow down next time. Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost in this port. The sailors look so busy. What should I do?
Do not worry. Are you waiting for a ship?
Yes, my boat is at the dock. I do not know how to get to it.
That is very easy. Just walk straight ahead.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to send a letter today. I am late.
I can help you write it fast. Who is it for?
It is for my grandma. I love her.
Good. Write "Dear Grandma." I do not know what you want to say next.
Just tell her I arrived safe. I ran here.
Okay. That is a kind thing to say. Do you need a closing word?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I am so happy. I want to buy new shoes.
That is great. What color do you like?
I love red. Do you know if they have red ones?
I think so. Do you need them for running?
Yes, for running. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Have fun shopping.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to play tennis better. How do I hold the racket?
Hold it like you are holding a hammer. Do you like hitting balls?
Yes, I love it. But I always miss the ball. What should I do?
Look at the ball until you hit it. Do you look at your feet?
I do look down a lot. Why is that bad?
It hides the ball from you. Try to keep your eyes up.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do bugs have so many legs?
Most bugs have six legs because they have six body parts. Do you know what the middle part is called?
I do not know.
It is called the thorax. It holds the legs and wings.
That is cool.
It is, isn't it? Do you want to look for ants outside?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need to leave now, my car is waiting.
Go fast. Do you have a gift for her?
Yes, I packed it in the back seat.
That is good. Is the weather nice today?
I cannot stop, I have a long drive.
Safe travels.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why does my bread get so big?
Tiny bugs in the dough eat the sugar and make gas. Do you use warm milk?
The gas makes air pockets, right?
Yes, those bubbles trap the heat. Is your kitchen warm today?
I put it in the fridge for two hours.
Cold air makes the bugs sleep. What temperature is in there?
I do not know the exact number.
That is okay. Try the counter next time instead.
Should I wait longer in the fridge?
No, let it sit out to wake the bugs.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I see a cow on the grass. What should I do?
Just watch it for a while. Is it eating?
Yes, it is eating the grass. Should I feed it?
No, let it eat its own food. Do you like cows?
I think they are big and nice. Should I touch them?
Only if the owner says yes. Are they friendly?
They look calm and happy. Can I pet the cow?
Only if a grown up is with you. Is the farmer nearby?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The sun is gone.
I know that feels bad. Do you see the rain?
Yes, it is wet.
Wet air helps make rainbows. Do you like rain?
I miss the sun.
The sun is there. Look up after the rain stops.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: The city feels very loud today. Why is it so busy?
People need to work and play, so they all move fast. Do you like the noise?
I do not like it. Where is a quiet place?
The park has trees and soft grass to rest your eyes. Do you like parks?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: The lights went out and now I am so mad.
That is very annoying, I know. Do you have a flashlight nearby?
I am in the dark and it is very scary.
Take a deep breath, you are safe. Is the radio still working?
I am so tired and just want my power back.
The workers are fixing it, I hope. Do you want me to stay on the line?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know how bees make honey.
Bees take sweet juice from flowers. Do you know what nectar is?
I am not sure about that word.
Nectar is the sweet juice. They turn it into honey in their hives.
Is the honey sweet right away?
No, it needs to dry out first. It is still a work in progress.
So they wait for it to get thick.
Yes, they fan it with their wings. Does that help you understand?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do stars look like little lights?
They are far away, so they look small and bright. Do you like to look up?
Yes, but why do they move?
The Earth turns, so the sky looks like it moves with us. What is your favorite star?
I do not know the names yet.
That is okay, we can learn them later.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I met a new friend today. He is very nice.
That is great to hear. What did you do together?
We played ball in the park. The sun was warm.
Sounds like a happy time. Was the ball red?
No, it was blue. We ran a lot.
Running is good for your body. Did you get tired?
Yes, my legs hurt a little. I am very happy.
I am glad you had fun. Good job on making a new friend.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My screen is dark and I am stuck.
Try pressing the power button again. Is the cord in the wall?
The cord is in, but it will not wake up.
That is strange. Do you hear any sounds?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I took the train today and it was very bumpy. I almost spilled my juice.
Oh no, that sounds scary. Did you drop the bottle?
No, I held it tight and kept it safe. The ride was actually quite fun.
That is good to hear. What did you see outside the window?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I fed the goldfish a little flake today. They swam right to the glass when I came by.
That sounds like a happy fish. Do you know what color it is?
It is a bright orange color. It looks very happy to eat its food.
Red fish are very nice to watch. Is it the only fish in the tank?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I am late. The lights in the hall are dead. Can you fix them fast?
Is the fuse box tripped? Please look for a switch that is down.
No, all switches are up. It is not working.
It may be a broken wire. I do not know for sure. Are you home alone right now?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a big mountain today. It looked so tall.
Mountains are very big and hard to climb. Do you like looking at them?
They are made of rock and dirt. Some have snow on top.
That is true, and snow makes them white. What do you like most about them?
I do not know how they got so tall. Is that magic?
No magic, just time. Rocks built up over many, many years.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do small birds jump so much?
They hop to look for food fast. Do you see any seeds?
No, just green leaves and some bugs.
They eat bugs in the summer. Do you have any fruit to share?
Yes, I have some sweet apple slices.
Apples are a tasty treat. Where do you put the plate?
I put it on the low bench by the wall.
The bench is a good spot. Do you hear them peep?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big fox near the park today.
A wild fox? That is amazing. Did it look friendly?
It ran away, but it was very fast.
Foxes are quick runners. Do you like wild animals?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I want to buy a sweet treat, but I am not sure which one to pick.
There are many yummy options right there. Do you like chocolate best?
Yes, I do, but I also want something that comes in a shape.
That is a great idea. Have you seen the big cookie shaped like a star?
I have not looked for that, but I would love one if it is there.
I am not sure if it is still on the shelf. Would you like to go check?
That sounds like fun, and I will let you know what I find.
Great, I will wait for you here. Be careful walking.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I do not know which day comes after Monday.
Tuesday comes after Monday. Do you like reading on Tuesdays?
No, I hate reading. What day is best for playing?
Saturday is great for playing. Do you like to run outside?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do the old bones look so dark?
They got that color from the dirt. Do you like digging?
Yes, but why do we keep them in glass cases?
Glass keeps dust and bugs away. Can you see the tiny bones?
I can, but why is the big bone broken?
It broke a long time ago. Did you see the crack?
I see it, but why do they stand up like that?
We put them in a stand to hold them up. Is it hard to hold up?
That is hard, but why do people look so sad at the bones?
I do not know for sure.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know which way to go.
The big red tree is a good sign. Do you like birds?
I like them, but I am still lost.
Try the path that smells like wet grass. Is it sunny there?
It is sunny, but I feel tired.
You can sit on the green bench. Are you hungry?
I am not hungry, I just want to stop.
Then stop and breathe. What color is your shirt?
It is blue. Thank you.
Blue is a calm color. Go for a short walk.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Why do trees lose their leaves in the cold?
They drop them to save water. Do you see the brown ones on the ground?
I do. How do they get them back in the spring?
New buds wake up when it gets warm.
That is neat. Do all trees do this?
No, some keep their green leaves. Do you like pine trees?
Yes, I like the smell of pine.
It is a very nice smell. What is your favorite tree?
I like the big oak tree near my house.
Oak trees are very strong. Do you climb it?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I feed a wild rabbit?
You can offer fresh carrots, but be very careful. Do you live near a forest?
Yes, right behind my house.
That is nice, but wild rabbits often get sick from human food. Have you seen any other animals there?
I saw a fox once at dusk.
Foxes are smart and usually do not take food from people. Do you like watching them from far away?
I do, it is very peaceful.
Watching is the best way to help them stay safe and wild.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the pool today.
That sounds like fun. Was the water warm?
Yes, it was very warm.
Good. Did you swim far?
I swam across the pool.
That is great work. Did you feel tired?
A little, but I liked it.
It feels good to move your body. Did you stay dry?
My hair got wet.
Oh, it must feel heavy now.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: What is the internet?
It is a big web of computers that lets people talk and see things. Do you like looking at pictures?
Yes, I like animals.
You can find many animal videos there. Do you like cats or dogs?
I like cats.
Then you can watch cute cat clips.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I am writing a letter to my friend about my day today.
That is a sweet idea. Did you do anything fun?
I walked in the rain and saw a big, red kite stuck in a tree.
How did the person who lost it feel?
I think he was very sad, but I took a picture for him.
You are a kind helper.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My neighbor leaves his trash on my lawn. What should I do?
That feels bad, does it not? Have you told him about it yet?
I thought about it, but I am scared he will be mad.
It is okay to feel scared. You can say, "Please take your trash."
What if he ignores me and throws it there again?
I do not know exactly what he will do. But you can tell a building manager.
There is no manager here, just us in our own houses.
That is a tricky spot. Do you have a friend next door?
Yes, my friend sees it too. We want to act together.
That is a good plan. Being together makes it feel safer.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: I feel very sad inside. Why does this happen to me?
Sadness is a normal feeling. It means you care about something. Did something bad happen today?
I lost my favorite toy. It is gone.
That is very disappointing. I am sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about it?
Yes, I do. But I also feel angry. Is that okay?
It is okay to feel angry. Feelings come in pairs. What makes you feel most angry?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: How many fingers do I have on one hand?
You have five fingers on one hand. Can you show me your left hand?
I have five here, but how many are on both hands?
You have ten fingers on both hands. Do you want to count them together?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big rainbow after lunch today. The sun came back out just as the clouds stopped raining.
That sounds like a nice surprise. Did you have a warm snack with it?
Yes, I had a cookie and some milk. The sky looked so bright and clean after that.
Cookies and milk sound very good. Did you feel happy when you looked up?

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just got off the plane. It was so long and tiring, but I am so happy I made it.
That is wonderful to hear. Did you bring a big book to read on the plane?
Yes, I read two books and watched a movie. My neck hurts a little, but I feel great.
Reading is a good way to pass the time. Does your body feel ready for the new day?
Yes, I am ready for a long walk in the park. The fresh air will help me feel good.
A walk sounds very nice. What is the weather like where you are now?
It is sunny and warm here. The sky is very blue and there are no clouds.
That sounds like a perfect place to be. Do you want to buy some cold water first?
I already have a cold bottle of water with me. I am just so glad to be home.
Being home is the best feeling.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am so scared about my first job.
It is normal to feel this way. What part scares you the most?
I do not know what to do if I make a mistake.
That is a good question. You can just ask for help if you get lost.
That feels much safer. Do you know where to look for work tips?
I do not know specific places. Do you have a favorite way to learn new things?
I like reading books.
That is a great way. Just take it one day at a time.

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why are the leaves turning yellow?
The trees are getting ready for winter. Do you like fall?
Why does the wind feel so cold today?
The air is losing its heat. Are you wearing a coat?
Why do the ducks swim in a line?
They follow the leader to stay safe. Have you seen fish do this?
Why is the grass green but the dirt is brown?
I do not know the exact science. Do you want to guess why?
Why is it getting dark so early?
The sun is going down to let the moon rise. Do you see any stars?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why did the teacher hold the little girl's hand?
She was crying. Are you okay?
Yes, but why was she sad?
I do not know for sure. Did she drop her toy?
No, she lost her red book.
That can make people feel bad. Do you have a red book?
I have a blue one. Why did the teacher help her?
She wanted to feel safe again. Is that comforting to know?
Yes, it is. Why did the teacher say it is okay?
She wanted to be kind. Do you feel happy now?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: My dough is sitting still. Why will it not rise?
The yeast needs warm air to wake up. Is your kitchen cozy or cold?
It is quite cold here. What should I do now?
Put it near a heater or in a warm spot. Wait, do you have a towel?
Yes, I have a thick towel. Should I cover it?
Yes, cover it to keep the heat in. Do not open the lid yet, okay?

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I see fire in the kitchen, I must go now.
Stay calm and get out, is the door warm?
No time, I am running down the hall.
That is good, did you take your phone?
I am at the door, I am leaving.
Good, call 911 when you are safe.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I feel so tired and I do not know what to do.
That is a hard feeling. Do you have a warm blanket nearby?
I think I do, but I am not sure if I should rest or clean.
It is okay to not know the answer. Rest is often the best choice when you are this low.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I saw a big bear in the woods today. What should I do?
Stand still and stay quiet. Bears usually want to be left alone. Did you feed it?
No, I just watched from far away. It was very scary.
That was very smart. You did the right thing. Are you feeling better now?
Yes, but it looked so lonely. Can I go back to say hi?
No, please do not go back. It is safer for you and the bear to keep a big distance.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to learn French but I do not know how to start.
Start by learning ten new words a day. Do you have a friend who speaks French?
I can find a friend, but I am afraid of making mistakes.
Mistakes are how we learn. Have you tried any apps yet?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: Look, a blue bird is on my branch.
It is a pretty bird. Do you know what sound it makes?
I think it says tweet.
That is a good guess. Are there any other birds nearby?
Yes, I see a big brown one too.
I am not sure which one that is. I hope it has a nice name.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do now.
Take a deep breath. What is the problem?
I lost my favorite book.
That is a bad feeling. Did you look in your bag?
I looked, but it is not there.
I do not know where it went. Was it in the car?
No, it was not in the car.
Let us search the living room. Do you want help?
Yes, please help me find it.
Okay, let us look under the sofa.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: Is it cold outside today?
Yes, the wind is very cool. Are you wearing a warm coat?
I have a jacket, but it feels thin.
You might want to add a scarf. Do you like wearing hats?
I do not like hats. My head feels weird.
That is okay, your choice. Is the sun hiding behind the clouds?
Yes, the sky is gray and dark.
It looks like it may rain soon. Do you have an umbrella ready?
I do not have one. What should I do?
You can wait for it to stop, or run fast. Would you like to bring an umbrella tomorrow?

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: It is sunny today. How do I make lemonade?
That sounds fun. Do you have sugar?
Yes, I have sugar and lemons.
Squeeze the lemons into a cup. Add sugar and cold water. Do you want it sweet or sour?
I like it sweet.
Add more sugar until it tastes good to you.
It tastes great.
I am glad you like it. Enjoy your drink.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: I need a drink fast. Do you have tea or coffee?
Yes, we have both. Do you like sweet or plain?
Plain, please. Just give me the coffee.
Here is your coffee. Do you want a spoon?
No, I must go. Thanks a lot.
Goodbye. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I saw a big blue boat today and it made me so happy.
That is wonderful to hear. What color was the water around it?
The water was clear and cold. I wish I could show you right now.
I am happy for you. Do you like riding in boats?
Yes, I love the feeling of the wind on my face. It feels like flying on the water.
That sounds like a great way to have fun.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I like my birthday party.
That is wonderful to hear. What did you do today?
We had a cake and balloons.
Yummy. Do you like your friends?
Yes, I do.
I am happy for you.
Thanks for talking to me.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I walked in the park with my camera today.
That sounds like a nice way to spend time. Did you see any animals?
Yes, I saw a big red fox near the trees.
A red fox is very pretty to look at. Did you take a picture of it?
I tried, but it ran away before I could click.
That is how surprises happen in nature. Was the day still fun?
Yes, I took many photos of the flowers instead.
Flowers are always a good subject. I am glad you had a good time.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to plan a picnic, but I am not sure what to bring.
That sounds like fun. Do you like cold sandwiches?
Yes, I love them, but I do not know what to pack for drinks.
Water is always a good choice. Is it going to be hot outside?
It looks sunny and warm. I am worried it might be too hot.
A big umbrella can help keep you cool. Do you have one at home?
I do not have an umbrella, but I have a big blanket.
A blanket is perfect for sitting on. You should bring some fruit too.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I want to buy a red pen, but I do not know where to look.
Look on the high shelf near the door. Do you have any other things to buy?
No, just the pen. I feel very lost in this big place.
That is okay. Take your time and walk slowly to the stationery aisle.
Thank you for your help. I will go look now.
You are welcome. I hope you find the right one quickly.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the pool today. The water was very cold.
That sounds chilly. Did you wear a swimsuit?
Yes, I did. I jumped in just once.
That is brave of you.

talk.situation: the person is in a hurry
exchanges: Oh no, I am so late. The big day is here.
Take a deep breath. Do you have your ring?
Yes, it is safe. I missed the bus.
That is good. What time do you need to be there?
I must be there in ten minutes.
You can make it. Is your outfit ready?
Yes, it is perfect. I feel calm now.
That is great. Will you tell me how it goes?
I will call you soon. I must go.
Good luck to you. I hope it is wonderful.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I woke up early because the sun was very bright.
That is a nice start. Did you eat breakfast?
Yes, I ate some warm toast and jam.
Yummy. What did you do after eating?
I went to the park to play with a ball.
How fun. Did you have a good time outside?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why does the bread get puffy in the oven?
A tiny helper called yeast eats sugar and lets out gas. Do you like to blow up balloons?
Yes, but why does the gas make it big?
The gas makes tiny bubbles inside the dough. Do you like soft food?
I do, but why does it not just stay flat?
The heat makes the bubbles grow bigger. That is why it is so soft.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I saw a big duck on the river today. It looked very happy.
That is a nice sight. Did it splash in the water?
Yes, it made a big splash right near the bank.
I am glad you had a good day watching it.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I saw a big bear today.
That sounds scary. Did you feel safe?
I was scared. I ran home fast.
Running is a smart move. Bears have sharp teeth.
But I wanted to say hello.
It is nice you care. Do you like animals?
Yes, I do. I just want a friend.
I do not know a safe way to be friends with wild bears.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I saw a bug with two long horns on its head. What is it?
That sounds like a long-horned beetle. Do you like to watch bugs play?
Yes, they are very busy. Why do ants have such small heads?
Their heads hold their brain and mouth parts. Do you like to help the ants?
No, I am afraid they might bite me. Are ants friends with bees?
Usually, ants and bees do not live together. Do you like to smell flowers?
Flowers smell sweet. Why do butterflies go to flowers?
Butterflies drink sweet juice from flowers. Do you like to wear bright colors?
I like red. Can a bug see me if I am red?
Some bugs see color, but they mostly see movement. Do you like to move slowly?

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: The thunder is so loud. I am scared.
I am here with you. You are safe inside. Do you want to hold my hand?
Yes, please. The wind is very fast outside.
It will stop soon. Do you hear the birds?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I took a photo and it looks so dark. I am sad.
It happens sometimes. Do you have a light?
No, it is night. Why is it hard?
Cameras need light to see well. It is not your fault.
I just want good pictures for my mom.
Try to sit still and wait. Do you have a phone?

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I do not know what to do with my math work.
Do you have a ruler?
I have my pencil, but I am lost.
I do not know your exact problem, but I can help.
Can you tell me the first step?
Start by reading the question twice.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I feel so happy today.
That is a good feeling. What made you smile?
I was patient with my toy.
Patience is a strong habit. How did you wait?
I counted to ten first.
Counting helps the mind. Did it feel easy?
It felt calm and warm.
Calm is a true friend. Share that warmth.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want a pig for my farm.
Pigs love mud and mud is good for their skin. Do you have a big mud pit ready?
Yes, I have a big pit.
Great, they will be very happy. What else do you want on your farm?
I also want a cow.
Cows give milk but they need lots of grass. Have you grown enough food for them?
Yes, I have a big field.
Good, the cow will be strong and healthy. A pig and a cow is a nice start.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: Why is the sun so hot?
It is a giant ball of fire that burns all the time. Do you like warm days?
Yes, but why does it move across the sky?
Our planet spins very fast, so it looks like the sun moves. Do you play outside when it shines?
I do, but what happens at night?
The part of the earth facing the sun is dark. Do you like the stars?
They are pretty. Is the sun far away?
It is very far, but close enough to keep us warm.

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am sad. The park is too loud.
That sounds hard. Do you like quiet places?
Yes. I want to sit still.
I understand. What did you see?
Just people running fast.
Running can be tiring. Are your legs tired?
Yes, my legs hurt.
Ouch. Let us sit on the grass.
Okay. This is better.
I am glad you feel okay. Is the sun nice?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I am so mad because I forgot to say please.
That feels bad when we drop a ball. What made you forget?
I was in a rush and just snatched the food.
Being in a rush can make us forget words. Did you say sorry later?
Yes, but they did not look happy about it.
People often need time to feel better again. Did you try to help them next time?
I tried to open the door for them today.
That is a kind way to fix a small hurt. How did they smile?
They did smile a little at the end.
Good manners grow like a plant with care. Do you feel lighter now?

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to a small restaurant today.
That sounds nice. Did you like the food?
The soup was hot and sweet.
Warm soup is good. Did you drink any milk?
Yes, I had a glass of cold milk.
Milk and soup is a fine choice. Was it quiet there?
It was very loud with many people.
Loud places can be fun. Do you want to go back?

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I want to walk more, but my legs feel tired.
Take small steps at first. Do you have a park near home?
Yes, there is one. How many minutes should I do?
Start with five minutes a day. Does that sound easy?
Yes, that feels possible. Should I wear special shoes?
Use soft shoes that fit well. Do they feel tight?
No, they are loose. Thank you for helping me.
You can do this. Happy walking!

talk.situation: the person wants to learn how to do something
exchanges: How do I say please when I ask for food?
You just say "please" at the end of your sentence. Do you have a favorite food?
I love pizza! What if I drop my spoon?
Say "excuse me" if it falls near someone else. Are you hungry now?

talk.situation: the person is curious and asks why
exchanges: Why do we say please?
It shows we care. Do you like it when people are kind?
Why do we say thank you?
It tells them we are glad. Do you know other nice words?
Why do we wait for our turn?
It feels fair for everyone. Do you get tired of waiting?
Why do we apologize?
It helps friends feel better. I do not know if it is always easy.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am lost here. Where should I go?
The water is very blue today. Do you like boats?
Yes, I do. I just do not know what to do.
I do not know your plans. Are you hungry?
Yes, I am. Can I sit by the water?
Yes, please sit. The view is nice.

talk.situation: the person is unsure what to do
exchanges: I am on a small island and I do not know what to do.
You can look for fresh water first. Do you see any green trees nearby?
I see a dark forest, but I am afraid of the dark.
It is good you know where the water is. Do you feel safe in the open sand?
The sand is wide and bright, but I am still lost.
You can build a fire to show boats you are here. Do you have any dry sticks?
I have some dry sticks, but I am not sure how to make fire.
I do not know exactly how, but rubbing sticks may work. Do you see any smoke?
No, I see no smoke, just the blue sky.
Stay where it is open and wait. Do you feel less worried now?

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: My feet hurt. Do you know a good trick for small space?
Try lifting your toes high. Do you have a book to read?
No, but I have a window seat. Can I look outside?
Yes, you can enjoy the view.

talk.situation: the person is a child
exchanges: I am scared about my math test tomorrow.
It is okay to feel scared. Do you like adding numbers?
I like them, but I get mixed up on the plus signs.
You are doing great so far. Have you tried drawing circles for the zeros?
Yes, I drew some, but then I forgot to borrow.
Borrowing is just a small trick. Can you show me a hard part?
Here, ten minus nine is what?
It is one. Nice work.
Really? I was so sure it was zero.
You are right, it is one. You will do fine.

talk.situation: the person is telling a small story about their day
exchanges: I went to the pool today and the water felt very cold.
That can be a shock. Did you stay in for a long time?
I swam a few laps and then sat on the edge to warm up.
Taking breaks is smart. What kind of food did you eat before?
I had a banana, but I still felt a bit tired while swimming.
A banana is a good snack. Did you feel better after you rested?
Yes, the sun helped me warm up and I felt happy.
That is a nice way to end the day.

talk.situation: the person has a question
exchanges: What is the sea made of?
It is mostly salt water. Do you like salt water?
Why is it salty?
Rain washed salt from the rocks into the ocean. Is that interesting?
Are there monsters in the sea?
No, just big fish and whales. Do you like whales?
What is at the very bottom?
It is a dark place with rocks and mud. Do you like the dark?
Can I go to the bottom?
Only with a special boat. Would you like to ride one?

talk.situation: the person is a little upset
exchanges: I lost the blue line on my map. I feel very sad now.
I am sorry you feel that way. Do you see a red road near you?
No, I only see trees and grass. This is very confusing for me.
I do not know what is under the trees. Can you turn the map upside down?
I did, but the blue line is still missing. I want to go home.
Let us walk slowly and look again. You are not lost for long.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I am not sure how to read the clock. The numbers are all mixed up in my head. Do you know a trick?
Look at the long hand first. It tells the minutes. Do you know where twelve is on the clock?
Yes, it is on top. I think that means zero minutes. Is that right?
You are very smart. Yes, twelve is zero minutes. Now, just count the small numbers where the long hand points.

talk.situation: the person wants advice
exchanges: I start my first job tomorrow. I feel very scared.
It is normal to feel scared. Do you know where you need to go?
I know the place. I am worried about saying the wrong words.
Just speak slowly. Do you have a list of people to greet?
Yes, I have a list. What if I make a mistake?
You will fix it. That is part of learning.
Okay. I will try my best.
You will do fine. Be kind to yourself.

talk.situation: the person is happy and wants to share it
exchanges: I just finished cleaning the whole house and I feel so good about it.
That is a great feeling. Do you like how it smells?
Yes, it smells fresh and I was so happy to see it so clean.
I am glad to hear that. How long did it take you?
It took all morning but I did not mind because I was happy.
Working hard is nice when you are happy. Did you take a break?
Yes, I sat in the clean room and just enjoyed the quiet.
Resting is important.
